/Lotus/Language/1999/1999MotorcycleAvata.text: "With the new '99, the Atomicycle project has been reimagined and redefined like never before, improving markedly in all areas: aerodynamics, ergonomics, engine, chassis and electronics. The result is a stellar new form that performs as well on the track as it does drifting through the city; more intuitively and with significantly less fatigue for operators. A must-feel for both pro-riders and amateurs alike." - ZeViLa Inc.
/Lotus/Language/1999/1999MotorcycleAvata.zhText: "随着新款 '99 的推出，原子摩托车项目得到了前所未有的重新构想和定义，在空气动力学、人体工程学、发动机、底盘和电子设备这些领域都有了显著改进。其结果是，这款全新车型在赛道上与在城市中漂移的表现同样出色；而且更加直观，驾驶者的疲劳度也大大降低。无论对于职业车手还是业余车手，都是必要的。"——泽威拉公司

/Lotus/Language/1999/AoiKissMessage.text:
Hiii!

It’s traditional to kiss your beloved on New Year’s Eve for luck. The Hex need all the luck they can get, so we ought to do a lot of kissing, don’t you agree?

They’re counting on us! Don’t be late!

(love you love you LOVE YOU)

Aoi
/Lotus/Language/1999/AoiKissMessage.zhText:
嗨！

按照传统，在除夕夜亲吻心爱的人可以带来好运。六人组很需要好运，所以我们应该多亲几下，你说对吧？

他们等着我们呢！别迟到了！

（爱你爱你爱你）

碧

/Lotus/Language/1999/ArthurKissMessage.text:
Hey.

You changed my life forever, in the best of ways. I still can't believe you and I found each other.

Here's to seeing in the New Year together, and the promise of many more to come.

With all my love, 

your Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ArthurKissMessage.zhText:
嘿。

你以最美好的方式永远改变了我的生活。我仍然不敢相信你我找到了彼此。

让我们一起迎接新年，并期待未来还有更多美好时光。

带着我全部的爱，

你的亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarArtifactPac.text: Receive an Arcane to install on your gear.

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter1Q.text: Don't take on anything you can't handle.
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter1Q.zhText: 不要做自己做不到的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter1Q.text: Remember, you've got a team backing you up.
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter1Q.zhText: 记住，你背后有一个团队在支持你。

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter1Q.text: I wouldn't ask you to do anything I wouldn't do myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter1Q.zhText: 我不会要求你做我自己都不愿意做的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter2Q.text: They have no idea what's in store for them...
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter2Q.zhText: 他们根本不知道他们即将要面对什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter2Q.text: What a wild spree you will have!
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter2Q.zhText: 你将会经历一段疯狂的体验！

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter2Q.text: Oh, I think you're going to enjoy this.

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter3Q.text: I only got so many supplies, so don't get yourself hurt, ¿sí?
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter3Q.zhText: 我的物资有限，所以别让自己受伤，¿sí?

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter3Q.text: This looks dangerous and I'm no miracle worker, so watch yourself!
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter3Q.zhText: 这看起来很危险，而我也不是什么奇迹创造者，所以要小心！

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter3Q.text: Hey Babas, just try to come back in one piece, that's all I ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter3Q.zhText: 嘿，Babas，要完好无损地回来，这是我唯一的要求。

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter4Q.text: The question is, why WOULDN'T you want to do this?
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter4Q.zhText: 问题是，你为什么不想这么做呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter4Q.text: I'm rooting for you here, you can do it!
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter4Q.zhText: 我会在这里为你加油的，你一定能做到！

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter5Q.text: The streets are your kingdom... and you rule!
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter5Q.zhText: 街道是你的王国……而你就是这里的统治者！

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter5Q.text: Try not to have too much fun out there, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter5Q.zhText: 尽量不要在外面玩得太开心，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter5Q.text: Go on, show the rest of us how it's done!
/Lotus/Language/1999/CalendarCharacter5Q.zhText: 去吧，给我们展示一下应该怎么做！

/Lotus/Language/1999/EleanorKissMessage.text:
Hello, my darling.

I wonder: how would you feel about spending a moment or two in one another’s company around midnight tonight?

It’s tradition, after all.

I promise not to be on my best behaviour.

Love always,

E. x
/Lotus/Language/1999/EleanorKissMessage.zhText:
你好，亲爱的。

我在想：今晚午夜时分，你愿意和我一起共度时光吗？

毕竟，这是一种传统。

我保证我不会表现得太规矩。

永远爱你，

埃.亲亲

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagAmirDesc.text:
The Countessa isn't just an icon—she's a hero! Issues from this cult classic comic series are sought after by subculture enthusiasts who know the value of a strong and stylish protagonist. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagAmirDesc.zhText:
伯爵夫人不仅仅是一个偶像——她还是一个英雄！这个经典邪典漫画系列的期刊，深受亚文化爱好者的追捧，他们知道强大而时尚的主角的价值。与莱蒂交换这个六人组宝物，以获取六人组声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagAoiDesc.text:
The ultimate gift for fans of On-lyne! Show your love and support with this must-have merch for any music lover's collection. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagAoiDesc.zhText:
这是送给线上时代粉丝的终极礼物！用这款必备商品来表达你的热爱和支持，它是任何音乐爱好者的收藏品。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagArthurDesc.text:
A set of liquid comfort perfect for anyone who deserves a moment to unwind. Ideal for someone carrying the weight of the world on their shoulders. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagArthurDesc.zhText:
一套液体放松饮品，非常适合那些肩负世界重担、需要片刻喘息的人。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagEleanorDes.text:
Sleek, stylish, and soothing, mood crystals are the perfect gift for anyone in need of a little calm. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagEleanorDes.zhText:
心情水晶造型时尚、美观且令人放松，是送给需要冷静一点的人的完美礼物。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagLettieDesc.text:
A nostalgic treat for the ultimate ‘90s kid! Remember those commercials with the cheerful mouse quartet? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagLettieDesc.zhText:
这是送给 90 年代孩子的怀旧礼物！还记得那些有欢快的老鼠四重奏的广告吗？用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagQuincyDesc.text:
For the documentarian who sees the world through a unique lens, extra film is always a win. Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagQuincyDesc.zhText:
对于对世界有独特视角的纪录片制作人来说，影片越多越好。用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagRareDesc.text:
Who doesn't like pizza? Trade this Hex Treasure with Lettie to earn standing with The Hex.

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagRareDesc.zhText:
谁不喜欢披萨？用这个六人组珍品与莱蒂交易，换取六人组的声望。

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagUncommonDe.text:
Burgers so tasty they always disappear!

Location: 1999 (Höllvania)
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexDogTagUncommonDe.zhText:
汉堡美味可口，总是一扫而光！

获取地点：霍瓦尼亚（1999 年）

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle1Desc.text: There is little warmth in Höllvania even among the Hex, but the Drifter has begun to gather the scraps together.
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle1Desc.zhText: 即使在霍瓦尼亚的六人组中，也鲜有温暖，但漂泊者已经开始收集这些温暖的碎片了。

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle2Desc.text: The Hex have made room at the table for their new arrival. Will Drifter be to their taste?
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle2Desc.zhText: 六人组已在餐桌上为新来者留出位置。漂泊者会是他们要找的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle3Desc.text: A group is much more than the sum of its parts. With new friendships come new possibilities.
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle3Desc.zhText: 团体远胜过个体之和。新的友谊带来新的可能性。

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle4Desc.text: Things are really taking shape down at the Central Mall. Patience and persistence work miracles.
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle4Desc.zhText: 中央商场的一切正在步入正轨。耐心和坚持真的能创造奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle5Desc.text: It's the party of your lifetime, and all of Höllvania is invited!
/Lotus/Language/1999/HexSyndTitle5Desc.zhText: 这将是你终身难忘的派对，全霍瓦尼亚的人都受邀参加！

/Lotus/Language/1999/HollarsDesc.text:
Warframe's standard currency. Obtain Blueprints, Equipment, and other Höllars items from the Market.

Earn Höllars by playing Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/1999/HollarsDesc.zhText:
《Warframe》世界中的标准货币。用于从商店中获取蓝图、装备、和其他霍币商品。

通过游玩《Warframe》获取霍币。

/Lotus/Language/1999/InventorySlotExpans.text: Tenno, we have increased the default amount of Weapon & Warframe Slots for all players. This inbox confirms you have received the free increase to help you with your journey. Thank you for your continued support of Warframe!
/Lotus/Language/1999/InventorySlotExpans.zhText: Tenno，我们已为所有玩家增加了默认的武器和战甲槽位。这个收件箱信息向你确认你已收到免费的额外槽位，以助力你的冒险旅程。感谢你对《Warframe》一直以来的支持！

/Lotus/Language/1999/KalymosInboxMessage.text:
Hey.

On behalf of all the Hex, I wanted to wish you Happy New Year. 

This place is your home, and we all consider you family. 

We're all thinking of you tonight. Especially Kalymos.

All the best, mate.

Arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999/KalymosInboxMessage.zhText:
嘿。

我代表整个六人组祝你新年快乐。 

这里是你的家，我们都把你当家人。 

今晚我们都在想你。尤其是卡利莫斯。

祝你一切顺利，伙计。

亚瑟

/Lotus/Language/1999/KalymosInboxTitle.text: Happy New Year from us all

/Lotus/Language/1999/LegacyteDesc.text: With each generation, this Techrot predator becomes stronger, evolving new powers and attacks. Evolving these powerful creatures is metabolically costly for the Techrot, could this be exploited to weaken the Infestation?
/Lotus/Language/1999/LegacyteDesc.zhText: 随着每一代的进化，这种科腐者捕食者变得越来越强大，进化出新的能力和攻击方式。进化这些强大的生物对科腐者来说需要消耗大量的能量，这一点是否可以利用来削弱 Infestation？

/Lotus/Language/1999/MeleeCritChanceDesc.text: +20% Melee Critical Chance (x2 for Heavy Attacks).
/Lotus/Language/1999/MeleeCritChanceDesc.zhText: 增加 20% 近战暴击几率（重击时 x2）。

/Lotus/Language/1999/MeleeSlideFowardMom.text: Melee slide attacks increase slide attack Critical Chance by 5%, slide speed by 20% and reduce slide friction by 10% for 10 seconds with each slide melee attack. Max 10 stacks.
/Lotus/Language/1999/MeleeSlideFowardMom.zhText: 每次近战滑行攻击都会增加 5% 滑行攻击暴击几率，20% 滑行速度，同时减少 10% 滑行摩擦力，持续 10 秒。最多可叠加 10 层。

/Lotus/Language/1999/MenuReturnToHubDesc.zhText: 中止任务并返回霍瓦尼亚

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerActiveHead.text: Remember, never share your personal information online!
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerActiveHead.zhText: 请记住，切勿在网上分享您的个人信息！

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerAmirFFBlur.text: Magic! Mayhem! Mystery! Play with Amir as your Fablemaster and the rest of the Hex in this six-day mini text adventure of the popular table top roleplaying game! But be warned, all may not be well in Höllvandeim...
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerAmirFFBlur.zhText: 魔法！混乱！谜团！在这款为期六天的迷你文字冒险游戏中，与阿米尔一起扮演你的寓言主持人，与其他六人组成员一同体验这款热门桌面角色扮演游戏的魅力！但请注意，霍凡德姆可能并不平静……

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerAmirFFPeop.text: Cedric Dawnsong, Lord Reyland Kingsacre, Ixchel Balam, Sanguina Kallisti, Morohime Ichigeki, ???
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerAmirFFPeop.zhText: 塞德里克·黎颂、雷兰·金斯克雷勋爵、伊克塞尔·巴拉姆、桑吉娜·卡利斯蒂、诸姬·一击，？？？

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerDevilBlurb.text: Created when Entrati turned an Orokin into a protoframe before leaving him in XX99 Gaule with two holy caretakers, this Gothic trio asks - what can truly be forgiven?
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerDevilBlurb.zhText: 英择谛将一个奥罗金人改造成原型战甲，然后将其留在 XX99 年的高卢，交给了两位神职监护人。这三位哥特式人物提出了这样的问题——究竟什么才能真正被宽恕？

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerHexBlurb.text: Residing in the Techrot-infested and war-torn Höllvania, the Hex were transformed into protoframes by Albrecht Entrati and trapped within the looping year of 1999.
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerHexBlurb.zhText: 居住在被科腐者感染侵蚀和战火蹂躏的霍瓦尼亚的六人组，被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛改造成了原型战甲，并困在了 1999 年的循环之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerHexDesc.text: Formerly human operatives, the six members of the Hex were transformed into Protoframes by Albrecht Entrati. Filled with uncanny power and mourning their lost humanity, they continue their mission of mercy in beleaguered Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerHexDesc.zhText: 六名六人组成员原本是人类特工，后来被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛改造成原型战甲。他们获得了不可思议的力量，但却哀悼着自己失去的人性，继续在被围攻的霍瓦尼亚执行他们的救赎使命。

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerHexPeople.text: Arthur, Eleanor, Amir, Lettie, Aoi, Quincy
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerHexPeople.zhText: 亚瑟、埃莉诺、阿米尔、莱蒂、碧、昆西

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerLettieDemo.zhText: 阿布埃拉的生日是 6 月 14 日。

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerRoundBlurb.text: Occupying the pub of the same name in the mall, the Roundtable crew arrived to Höllvania seeking answers about the city, their family and friends, and their futures.
/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerRoundBlurb.zhText: 老圆桌的成员们占据了商场里的同名酒吧，他们来到霍瓦尼亚，寻求关于这座城市、他们的家人和朋友以及他们的未来的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999/MessengerRoundPeopl.zhText: 弗莱尔、卡娅、米尼娃、维利米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999/MiscSongDescription.text: There's more than one band out there! Relive the events of 1999 with these tracks from the mean streets of Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999/MiscSongDescription.zhText: 这里不止一支乐队！通过这些来自霍瓦尼亚贫民窟的歌曲，重温 1999 年的精彩时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999/OrbsDuplicateOnPick.text: Shoot Health Orbs to pick them up. Health orbs now have 25% chance to duplicate when picked up.
/Lotus/Language/1999/OrbsDuplicateOnPick.zhText: 可通过射击生命球来拾取它们。生命球拾取后有 25% 的几率复制。

/Lotus/Language/1999/OvershieldCapDesc.text: Increases Overshield cap by 50%. Kills grant 50 shields.
/Lotus/Language/1999/OvershieldCapDesc.zhText: 过载护盾上限增加 50%。击杀时恢复 50 点护盾。

/Lotus/Language/1999/PowerStrengthAndEff.text: Casting abilities increases ability strength by 2% and efficiency by -1% per unit of energy used by ability, for 5s.
/Lotus/Language/1999/PowerStrengthAndEff.zhText: 施放技能时，每消耗一点能量值，技能强度增加 2%，技能效率减少 1%，持续 5 秒。

/Lotus/Language/1999/PowerStrengthAndEff.text: +2% power strength and -1% efficiency for 5 seconds.
/Lotus/Language/1999/PowerStrengthAndEff.zhText: 5 秒内，技能强度增加 2%，技能效率减少 1%。

/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedAncien.text: Even redundant technology is given new life through the Technocyte Virus.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedAncien.zhText: 甚至过时的技术也通过科技细胞病毒获得了新生。

/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedBabauD.text: The rapid decay of human ingenuity produces daemons. Often found growing on neglected Hell-Scrubbers.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedBabauD.zhText: 人类智慧的快速荒废催生了恶魔。恶魔通常于被忽视的地狱净化器上被发现。

/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedMaggot.text: These tiny nodules of Techrot are the diabolic union of an arc welder and a gas can. Usually attacking in groups, they explode as soon as they near their target.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedMaggot.zhText: 这些科腐者小瘤子是电弧焊机和汽油罐的结合体，非常可怕。它们通常成群攻击，一旦靠近目标就会爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedMoaDes.text: Once a simple workstation, the servant has turned against its former masters.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedMoaDes.zhText: 这个曾经是个简单的工作站的东西如今已经背叛了它过去的主人。

/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedRunner.text: This agressive melee unit dashes at enemies, lashing out with frenzied strikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedRunner.zhText: 这个攻击性极强的近战单位会冲向敌人，并发动疯狂的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedVolati.text: This self-sacrificing unit ignites its subsumed propane tank and then charges its prey, for the survival of the Hive.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedVolati.zhText: 为了种群的存续，这个个体选择了自我牺牲。它会引燃其体内的丙烷罐，然后向猎物发起攻击。

/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedZongro.text: This tottering, bulbous Techrot creation can inflate bladders to become airborne, raining down destruction on those below.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedZongro.zhText: 这种摇摇欲坠的团状科腐者造物可以通过充气来升空，向下方降下毁灭之雨。

/Lotus/Language/1999/PunchToPrimaryDesc.text: Add +1.5m punch through to primary weapons.
/Lotus/Language/1999/PunchToPrimaryDesc.zhText: 主要武器穿透增加 1.5 米。

/Lotus/Language/1999/PvPvEEscortTargetDe.text: This hijacked Scaldra Harbinger balloon has been modified to act as radio broadcast antenna for the Mobile Voice pirate radio station. Power to the people!
/Lotus/Language/1999/PvPvEEscortTargetDe.zhText: 这只被劫持的炽蛇军前哨气球已被改装为移动语音地下电台的无线电广播天线。力量属于人民！

/Lotus/Language/1999/QuincyNoggleName.zhText: 昆西·艾萨克斯摇头娃娃

/Lotus/Language/1999/RadialJavelinOnHeav.text: Heavy melee attacks trigger Radial Javelin with 3m range and 1000 damage scaling both with combo multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/1999/RadialJavelinOnHeav.zhText: 近战重击会发射一枚范围为 3 米、基础伤害为 1000 的广域标枪，并受到连击倍率加成。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RadialViralAttackOn.text: Gaining sufficient Overguard releases a Radial Attack. Losing all Overguard resets the counter.
/Lotus/Language/1999/RadialViralAttackOn.zhText: 获得足够的超宏防护会释放一次范围攻击。失去所有超宏防护会重置触发条件。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RadialViralAttackOn.text: When gaining |OVERGUARD_GAIN| or more Overguard threshold, release a |RADIUS|m Radial Attack that applies max <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status stacks.
/Lotus/Language/1999/RadialViralAttackOn.zhText: 当获得的超宏防护大于等于 |OVERGUARD_GAIN| 阈值时，释放一次 |RADIUS| 米的范围攻击，造成最大层数的 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RadiationProcOnTake.text: |CONDITION| 10% chance to set off a 250 damage, 5m radius blast of <DT_RADIATION> Radiation.
/Lotus/Language/1999/RadiationProcOnTake.zhText: |CONDITION|有 10% 的几率触发 250 伤害、 5 米范围的 <DT_RADIATION>辐射爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RefundBulletOnStatu.text: Triggering a status effect has a 10% chance to reload the triggering bullet into the clip.
/Lotus/Language/1999/RefundBulletOnStatu.zhText: 造成异常状态有 10% 的几率将该发子弹重新装入弹匣中。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RetroMapError_PvPvE.zhText: 只能在完全公开模式下游玩对战模式。请尝试与 AI 对战。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RetroMapNodeLockedH.zhText: 将你的六人组声望提升到等级 |RANK| 以解锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RetroMapNodeLockedS.text: Complete this mission on Normal Difficulty to unlock Steel Path difficulty.

/Lotus/Language/1999/ReviveEnemyAsSpectr.text: Killed enemies have a chance of reviving as allied specters at 1% chance per status stack. Lasts 30 sec.
/Lotus/Language/1999/ReviveEnemyAsSpectr.zhText: 敌人死亡时每有一层异常状态，就增加 1% 的几率复活为友方魅影。持续 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/1999/RicochetChanceDesc.text: Shots gain a 10% chance to fire a seeking projectile for each successful hit. Firing weapons reduces the chance by 5%.
/Lotus/Language/1999/RicochetChanceDesc.zhText: 每次成功命中时，增加 10% 的几率在射击时额外发射一颗追踪投射物，可累积。每次开火时使该几率减少 5%。

/Lotus/Language/1999/SecondaryCritOnHitB.text: Successive hits grant bonus Critical Chance. Super Critical Hits reset the bonus.
/Lotus/Language/1999/SecondaryCritOnHitB.zhText: 连续命中可获得额外暴击几率。超级暴击会重置该加成。

/Lotus/Language/1999/SecondaryCritOnHitD.text: On Hit: Increase Critical Chance by |CRIT_CHANCE|%. Resets after |NUM_CRITS| Big Critical Hit.
/Lotus/Language/1999/SecondaryCritOnHitD.zhText: 命中时：增加 |CRIT_CHANCE|% 暴击几率。在 |NUM_CRITS| 次强力暴击命中后重置。

/Lotus/Language/1999/SettingsBgDesc.text: Choose from a variety of exciting background images!
/Lotus/Language/1999/SettingsBgDesc.zhText: 从各种令人兴奋的背景图像中进行选择！

达到更高的好感度将需要更多时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999/SharedFreeAbilityEv.zhText: 每施放 10 次技能，玩家和友军获得一次不消耗能量的技能施放机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999/SpeedBuffsWhenAirbo.text: Reload Speed, Fire Rate, Cast speed and Melee attack speed are increased 100% while airborne.
/Lotus/Language/1999/SpeedBuffsWhenAirbo.zhText: 在空中时，装填速度、射速、施放速度和近战攻击速度增加 100%。

/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup1Body.text:
Amir! Thank u for helping me with this! Ur hacking skills are gonna help On-lyne so much! <3
U don't have to be a fan of their music to admit they deserve better, right? Poor guys :(
If we get a paper trail of the shady backroom deals between HitMaker and the Höllvanian government, we can give it to On-lyne. That way, they'll have everything they need to break their contract and get away from these users as soon as we get them home!
I hear their manager is old school. He's just now figuring out email cause he has to for business. Bet a tech wizard like u can hack his stuff no problem ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup1Body.zhText:
阿米尔！谢谢你帮我！你的黑客技术对线上时代会有很大的帮助！<3
你不需要是他们音乐的粉丝，也能承认他们值得更好的待遇，对吧？可怜的家伙们 :(
如果我们追踪到金曲大厂和霍瓦尼亚政府之间幕后交易的书面记录，我们就能把这些交给线上时代。这样，他们就有了解约的所有必需资料，一旦我们把他们带到家就能摆脱这些利用者了！
我听说他们的经纪很老派。为了工作需要，他刚学会用电子邮件。我敢打赌，像你这样的技术奇才一定能轻松入侵他的系统 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup2Body.text:
Good morning Director,

It is my pleasure to inform you that HitMaker Music accepts your offer. 

There’s a smokin’ young secretary faxing you our signed NDAs as I type this. Everyone here looks forward to hearing more about the Technocyte Coda project. As they say, nothing beats Höllvanian innovation!

This promises to be a fine partnership.

Keep up the good work,
Gregory V.
/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup2Body.zhText:
早上好，总监，

很高兴地通知您，金曲大厂接受了您的提议。 

就在我发送这封邮件时，一位年轻的秘书正在将我们签署的保密协议传真给您。我们所有人都期待听到有关科技细胞终幕者项目的更多信息。正如人们所说，没有什么能超越霍瓦尼亚的创新！

这必将是一次美好的合作。

请继续努力，
格雷戈里·维

/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup3Body.text:
Good evening Director,

I’m happy to hear that the boys’ samples arrived safely. Hairbrushes from pop star dressing rooms leading to major technological advancement… It’s amazing, when you think about it! I hope you get what you want out of them. What was it again? DNA?

You’ve made incredible progress on the Technocyte Coda project in just a few short months. Nothing like loose regulations to encourage innovation, I suppose. Your broken eggs make the most delicious omelets. We love that about Höllvania!

Not sure how much sense I’ll be able to make of it, but please fax me the results.

Here’s to a bright future,
Gregory V.
/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup3Body.zhText:
晚上好，总监，

我很高兴听到男孩们的样本已经安全到达。想到从流行歌星的化妆间得到的发刷能带来重大技术进步……这真是太神奇了！希望您能从中得到您需要的东西。那是什么来着？DNA？

短短几个月内，您在科技细胞终幕者项目上取得了令人难以置信的进展。我想，没有什么比宽松的监管更能鼓励创新了。您将废物充分利用。我们很欣赏霍瓦尼亚的这一点！

虽然我不确定自己能理解多少，但请把结果传真给我。

祝您未来光明，
格雷戈里·维

/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup4Body.text:
Good afternoon Director,

Or is it morning in Höllvania? Time zones always mix me up.

Been thinking a lot lately about some words I saw in your Technocyte Coda debrief: predictable, standardized, and controlled. Music to my ears right now.

The only thing predictable about pop stars these days is their whining and complaining. Fame really goes to their perfectly coiffed heads.

How are things going with the Technocyte Codas? I can’t wait to meet these new and improved stars.

Hoping for good news,
Gregory V.
/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup4Body.zhText:
下午好，总监，

或者现在是霍瓦尼亚的早晨？时区总是让我搞混。

最近我一直在思考我在您的科技细胞终幕者汇报中看到的一些词：可预测、标准化和受控。这对我来说是天籁之音。

如今流行歌星唯一可预测的就是他们的抱怨和牢骚。名气真的会冲昏他们那颗精心打理的头脑。

科技细胞终幕者进展如何？我迫不及待想见到这些焕然一新的明星。

希望有好消息，
格雷戈里·维

/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup5Body.text:
Good afternoon Director,

Given the boys' recent outbursts, I appreciate your concern that their presence won't soothe your citizens as intended.

I think it's an inspired idea to have the prototype Technocyte Codas replace the boys for spoken interviews. We'll use the scripts you provided, and I'll make sure no cameras are present. 

The boys will remain on standby for in-person appearances only. Here's hoping the Technocyte Codas will soon be able to replicate the boys' physical appearance too.

Apologies for the hassle,
Gregory V.
/Lotus/Language/1999/StoryCatchup5Body.zhText:
下午好，总监，

考虑到男孩们最近的一些过激行为，我能够理解您担忧他们无法按预期安抚市民的情绪。

我认为用原型科技细胞终幕者来代替男孩们进行口头采访是一个绝妙的想法。我们将使用您提供的剧本，并且我会确保现场没有摄像机。 

男孩们将会只在现场活动中出现。希望科技细胞终幕者很快也能复制男孩们的外表。

抱歉给您带来不便，
格雷戈里·维

/Lotus/Language/1999Coda/CodaTutorial.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|AN UNLIKELY ADVERSARY|CLOSE_COLOR|
The Techrot has spawned grotesque clones of the band On-lyne known as |OPEN_COLOR|Technocyte Codas|CLOSE_COLOR|. Your Coda is: |OPEN_COLOR||NAME||CLOSE_COLOR|.

|OPEN_COLOR|ANTIVIRUS MODS|CLOSE_COLOR|
Use |OPEN_COLOR|Antivirus Mods|CLOSE_COLOR| to |OPEN_COLOR|Disinfect|CLOSE_COLOR| your Technocyte Coda. These mods can be acquired as rewards from |OPEN_COLOR|Techrot Bounties|CLOSE_COLOR| through Höllvania Mall.

|OPEN_COLOR|DUETS|CLOSE_COLOR|
Equip |OPEN_COLOR|Antivirus Mods|CLOSE_COLOR| to your |OPEN_COLOR|Parazon|CLOSE_COLOR| and defeat |OPEN_COLOR|Duet Encounters|CLOSE_COLOR| in 1999 to confirm the correct Antivirus brand.

|OPEN_COLOR|MALWARE DISINFECTION|CLOSE_COLOR|
Hasten |OPEN_COLOR|Disinfection|CLOSE_COLOR| by applying |OPEN_COLOR|Potency Mods|CLOSE_COLOR| to remaining Parazon slots. These mods can be acquired from Techrot enemies. 

|OPEN_COLOR|TECHNOCYTE CYST|CLOSE_COLOR|
Your Technocyte Coda will infest your Warframes with a |OPEN_COLOR|Technocyte Cyst|CLOSE_COLOR|. Once infested, every completed 1999 mission will enlarge the cyst. Defeat your Technocyte Coda to |OPEN_COLOR|Disinfect|CLOSE_COLOR| your Warframes. 

|OPEN_COLOR|STADIUM SHOWDOWN|CLOSE_COLOR|
Use your |OPEN_COLOR|Railjack|CLOSE_COLOR| to pursue your Technocyte Coda and have the party of your lifetime at the new Höllvania Stadium on |OPEN_COLOR|Earth Proxima.|CLOSE_COLOR|
/Lotus/Language/1999Coda/CodaTutorial.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|意想不到的对手|CLOSE_COLOR|
科腐者已经产生了线上时代乐队的怪异克隆体，被称为|OPEN_COLOR|科技细胞终幕者|CLOSE_COLOR|。当前的终幕者对手是：|OPEN_COLOR||NAME||CLOSE_COLOR|。

|OPEN_COLOR|杀毒 Mod|CLOSE_COLOR|
使用|OPEN_COLOR|杀毒 Mod |CLOSE_COLOR|来|OPEN_COLOR|消杀|CLOSE_COLOR|你的科技细胞终幕者对手。这些 Mod 可以通过霍瓦尼亚商场的|OPEN_COLOR|科腐者赏金|CLOSE_COLOR|的奖励中获得。

|OPEN_COLOR|二重对决|CLOSE_COLOR|
将|OPEN_COLOR|杀毒 Mod |CLOSE_COLOR|安装在你的|OPEN_COLOR|灭骸之刃|CLOSE_COLOR|上，并在 1999 任务中取得|OPEN_COLOR|二重决战|CLOSE_COLOR|的胜利，以确认正确的杀毒 Mod 品牌。

|OPEN_COLOR|恶意软件查杀|CLOSE_COLOR|
通过将|OPEN_COLOR|效价 Mod |CLOSE_COLOR|安装在灭骸之刃剩余的槽位上来加速|OPEN_COLOR|消杀|CLOSE_COLOR|。这些 Mod 可以从科腐者敌人处获得。 

|OPEN_COLOR|科腐者囊肿|CLOSE_COLOR|
你的科技细胞终幕者将用|OPEN_COLOR|科腐者囊肿|CLOSE_COLOR|感染你的战甲。感染后，囊肿会在完成 1999 任务时恶化。击败你的科技细胞终幕者以给你的战甲|OPEN_COLOR|消除感染|CLOSE_COLOR|。 

|OPEN_COLOR|终幕对决|CLOSE_COLOR|
使用你的|OPEN_COLOR|航道星舰|CLOSE_COLOR|追击你的科技细胞终幕者，并在|OPEN_COLOR|地球比邻星上的新霍瓦尼亚体育场举办一场终身难忘的派对！|CLOSE_COLOR|

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999DemoRewardT.text: After completing this demo for the first time, check the inbox for the following reward:
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999DemoRewardT.zhText: 在首次完成该试玩版后，查看收件箱来获得以下奖励：

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999DemoSubHead.text: Take an early trip to the past and get a small taste of the future of Warframe by playing a Scaldra Exterminate mission.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999DemoSubHead.zhText: 提前回到过去，通过游玩歼灭炽蛇军任务来感受一下《Warframe》的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999MotorcycleA.text: The Atomicycle merges ZeViLa's cutting-edge engineering with the timeless spirit of the open road. Features an in-line four-cylinder engine and sport-oriented geometry, along with exclusive Entrati Void-tuning customization.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999MotorcycleA.zhText: 原子摩托车融合了泽威拉尖端工程技术与公路驾驶的永恒精神。拥有直列四缸引擎和注重运动性能的几何设计，此外还有专属的英择谛虚空调校定制功能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999OnlyneWallP.text: Show your love for Zeke, Drillbit, DJ Rom, Hardrive and Packet with this lovingly arranged collection of On-lyne fold-out posters. Who is your favorite?
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/1999OnlyneWallP.zhText: 用这套精心编排的线上时代折叠海报来表达你对兹克、钻头小子、打碟王、硬盘和数据使者的喜爱。谁是你最喜欢的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianChemStri.text: This heavily armored, slow moving unit lays down the law with dual Efervon cannons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianChemStri.zhText: 这个装甲厚重、行动缓慢的单位使用双管艾弗旺机关炮来控制战局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianShieldLa.text: Sporting a ballistic shield, this heavy unit closes the distance while laying down pistol fire. Carries an Efervon gel cannon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianShieldLa.zhText: 这个重型单位装备了防弹盾，可在缩短距离的同时使用手枪射击。携带艾弗旺凝胶炮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleBombA.text: Jump off the Atomicycle and send it racing forward where it will explode on impact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleBombA.zhText: 从原子摩托车上跳下来并让它快速冲向前方，并在撞击时爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleGearI.text: Summons an Atomicycle for use in 1999 and free roam missions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleGearI.zhText: 在《1999》和自由漫游任务中召唤一辆原子摩托车。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleNitro.text: Kick it into overdrive with a massive burst of speed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleNitro.zhText: 通过瞬间加速进入极速状态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleSteal.text: Jump off the Atomicycle and become invisible for a brief period.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleSteal.zhText: 跳下原子摩托车后，会在短时间内隐身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleTarge.text: Target oncoming enemies with a barrage of micro missiles that inflict damage and leave targets vulnerable to further damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleTarge.zhText: 向迎面而来的敌人发射一连串微型导弹，造成伤害，并使目标更易受后续攻击影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/TipAtomiBomb.text: |INPUT| while riding at speed to launch the bike foward as an ATOMI-BOMB.
/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/TipAtomiBomb.zhText: 高速骑行时 |INPUT| 使原子摩托车作为原子飞弹向前进方向冲击。

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/TipAtomicycleBu.text: While riding the Atomicycle, press |INPUT| to ATOMI-JUMP.

/Lotus/Language/1999Demo/TipEfervon.text: Steer clear of green Efervon Gas, it deals <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Damage.

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/1999InfShotgu.text: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/1999InfShotgu.zhText: （英文：CODA BASSOCYST）通过这把渴求饮血食肉的科技细胞病毒感染霰弹枪来放大毁灭性声音的冲击波。次要射击无法被怜悯之击攻击的敌人，用感染螨虫将他们包围，而射击能被怜悯之击攻击的敌人则可远程处决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/1999InfSporeP.text: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/1999InfSporeP.zhText: （英文：DUAL CODA TORXICA）用这对令人胆寒的孢子发射器完成任务。孢子感染会在敌人死亡时传播到附近的敌人身上，造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态，并且孢蚀双枪会更容易对这些敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/1999RankFourI.text:
Drifter,

Entrati had backup plans, and four of them just came knocking. Now that the old Round Table bar’s opened its doors again, we can afford to be hospitable. 

Hendricks and Volkov seem to know what they’re doing, at least. I’ve always respected the Libertatian military, even if they do tend to show up late to the party. 

I don’t even know where to start with the smart-arse kid and the rock prophet, though. 

Once I'm satisfied that we're secure enough here, I may well ask you to handle them.

Arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/1999RankFourI.zhText:
漂泊者，

英择谛有备用计划，其中四个刚刚来敲门。现在老圆桌酒吧又开门了，我们可以热情款待他们了。 

至少亨德里克斯和沃尔科夫似乎知道他们在做什么。就算自由军总是在派对中迟到，我还是挺尊敬他们的。 

不过，我实在是不知道该怎么应付这个自作聪明的小屁孩和摇滚先知。 

一旦我确保我们这里足够安全，我可能会让你来搞定他们。

亚瑟

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaCatabolys.text: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaCatabolys.zhText: （英文：CODA CATABOLYST）当弹匣空了并且手动重新装填时，终幕·异化者会发射三枚威力极大的手榴弹，而不是一枚。同时还具有更高的触发几率、伤害和弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaCaustacys.text: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaCaustacys.zhText: （英文：CODA CAUSTACYST）终幕·灼蚀变体镰是一股不容小觑的力量，科技细胞病毒对其进行了改良，提高了伤害、触发几率和暴击伤害，并且具有持续时间更长的酸液池。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaHemaDesc.text: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaHemaDesc.zhText: （英文：CODA HEMA）科技细胞病毒没有起到什么作用，只是增加了血肢的嗜血性。具有更高的射速、弹匣容量、暴击几率、暴击伤害、触发几率和伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaHirudoDes.text: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaHirudoDes.zhText: （英文：CODA HIRUDO）使用终幕·蚂蟥将敌人撕成碎片。具有更高的伤害、触发几率、暴击几率和暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaMireDesc.text: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaMireDesc.zhText: （英文：CODA MIRE）1999 年的瘟疫年将不再一样。科技细胞病毒通过增加暴击倍率、暴击几率和触发几率，将终幕·米尔变成了一把真正可怕的利刃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaPathocyst.text: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaPathocyst.zhText: （英文：CODA PATHOCYST）终幕·病囊飞刃通过科技细胞突变的强化，具有更高的伤害、暴击几率、暴击伤害和触发几率。在飞行中或与敌人接触时，它偶尔会生成增强的、自动搜寻敌人的自爆虫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaPoxDesc.text: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaPoxDesc.zhText: （英文：CODA POX）这些溃烂、扭动、可投掷的脓气投射物已得到改进，具有更高的弹匣容量、暴击几率、暴击伤害、触发几率和伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaSporothri.text: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaSporothri.zhText: （英文：CODA SPOROTHRIX）向受害者投掷一个携带病毒的倒钩，持续造成伤害直至爆炸。具有更高的伤害、装填速度、弹匣容量、触发几率和爆炸半径。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaSynapseDe.text: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaSynapseDe.zhText: （英文：CODA SYNAPSE）终幕·突触生化枪可以持续发射恶臭腐蚀性胃液。具有更高的弹匣容量、光束长度、触发几率、穿透和伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaTysisDesc.text: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Echoes/CodaTysisDesc.zhText: （英文：CODA TYSIS）科技细胞病毒将啐沫者扭曲成更致命的武器。伤害、暴击几率、暴击伤害和弹匣容量均有所提升。

/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/1999QuestInbox.text:
Hey. I think you know where you have to go. I will stay here, I will watch her, them, everyone. I'll be waiting for you to get answers and come back to us. Whatever happens in that year, whatever makes it so important, figure it out. 

Okay, I guess you should really get going. 

Please find him. 

- Operator

P.S i don't know how to prove it, but it really is me, not… it. Remember our meal on the Zariman?
/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/1999QuestInbox.zhText:
嘿。我想你知道你得去哪里。我会留在这里，我会看着她，看着他们，看着每个人。我会等你得到答案然后回来找我们。无论那一年发生了什么，无论它有多重要，都要弄清楚。 

好吧，我想你真的应该走了。 

请找到他。 

- 指挥官

备注：我不知道如何证明，但写下这条消息的确实是我，而不是……它。还记得我们在扎里曼号上吃的饭吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestCompBadEn.text:
Drifter,

I can make no sense at all of these readings. Your site of temporal injection has somehow shifted. Your loop now encompasses the entire year of 1999.

Albrecht's interference is to blame, no doubt. What does he feel you need more time to achieve? He surely must have given guidance, however cryptic!

I can offer one service, at least. I discovered a clandestine blueprint among Albrecht's personal effects, for a Warframe so secret it was never named. It is yours.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestCompBadEn.zhText:
漂泊者，

我完全无法理解这些读数。你的时间注入点不知怎么地发生了偏移。你的循环现在包含了整个 1999 年。

毫无疑问，问题出在阿尔布雷希特的干预上。他觉得你需要更多时间来实现什么？他肯定给出了指引，虽然可能很隐晦！

我至少可以提供一项服务。我在阿尔布雷希特的私人物品中发现了一份秘密蓝图，是为一个连名字都未被透露的战甲设计的。现在，它是你的了。

洛德

/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestCompGoodE.text:
Drifter,

Albrecht's gone. Rusalka too. I can't believe how close we came to oblivion. You showed us what we were missing. For that... thank you.

You still need to keep the loop going, though, don't you? Because it's not enough to put things right, is it. We need to keep them right.

Soldiers against the tide. Now and forever.

Arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestCompGoodE.zhText:
漂泊者，

阿尔布雷希特消失了。鲁莎卡也是。我不敢相信我们竟然离毁灭如此之近。你让我们知道我们缺失的是什么。为此……感谢你。

但你仍然需要维持循环的运作，不是吗？因为仅仅把事情纠正是不够的。我们还需要将它们保持在正轨上。

一起抵御逆流的战士。从现在到永远。

亚瑟

/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestCompleteD.text:
The triumph of the Indifference falls in snow and ash as the shattered corpses of The Hex lie in the midwinter cold.

Only the Drifter's spirit refuses to accept that the story is over. Somehow, the Hex are the key. But once the circle has been broken, what can heal it again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestCompleteD.zhText:
虚空无情之物的胜利在雪花和灰烬中崩塌，而六人组的尸体散落在隆冬的寒冷中。

只有漂泊者的灵魂拒绝接受故事的终结。六人组似乎是关键。但是一旦循环被打破，谁能再度修复它？

/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestDesc.text: The desperate hunt for Albrecht Entrati has led the Drifter to the city of Höllvania on December 31st, 1999. Despite the Scaldra lockdown in the face of the Techrot menace, the citizens do their best to celebrate. But this has all happened before... and ended in disaster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Quest/QuestDesc.zhText: 1999 年 12 月 31 日，为了找到阿尔布雷希特·英择谛，漂泊者来到了霍瓦尼亚。尽管面对科腐者的威胁，炽蛇军实施的封锁，但市民们仍努力庆祝。但这一切曾经发生过……并以灾难告终。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The channel of water is narrow, but deep. It looks clean, and doesn't smell. The water flows through a heavy iron grate at both ends. No getting in or out that way, it seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这​条​水道​虽然​狭窄，​但​很​深。​水看​起来​很​干净，​也​没有​异味。​水​从​两​端​的​厚重铁​栅格​中​流过。​看来​也​无法​从​那​里​进出。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You are in a room that is entirely made of dark, stacked stone. The ceiling is curved, domed over you like a sewer, but not like any you've ever seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你身处一间完全由深色石块堆砌而成的房间。天花板呈弧形，像下水道一样在你头顶拱起，却又与你以往见过的任何下水道都不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You're able to sort of flap your arms indignantly, but it works.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你可以愤愤不平地挥挥双臂，但奏效了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Luckily, it doesn't seem to be a sewer. Just normal water.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 幸运​的​是，​这里​似乎​不​是​下​水道，​只是​普通​的​水。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You suuuuuuuure about that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你真的确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Okiedokie! BEGIN. AGAIN.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好滴好滴！再。来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: FILE EMPTY.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 文件为空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Y'know? Less time than you'd think, but probably more time than you'd like. The real pain in the ass was those rock walls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你知道吗？实际时间比你想的要短，但可能比你希望的要长。真正让人头疼的是那些岩壁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Aww, shucks. Buttering up your Fablemaster won't get you free advantage rolls, y'know. Speaking of!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哎呀，真可惜。讨好你的寓言主持人并不能让你免费获得优势骰子，你知道的。说到这个！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You should've seen the look on the Scaldra's goons faces when I was zipping past 'em up from the underground arcade! So!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你真该看看我从地下游戏厅一路冲上来的时候，炽蛇军那帮人脸上的表情！真是的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I have a new adventure of Fables & Frontiers ready to go! All the rest of the Hex are game. You in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我准备好了新一轮的《寓言与边疆》冒险！六人组的其他人都会来玩。你来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So… about that whole… "accidentally flooding every part of the timeline and the whole of the known universe with a bunch of hyperactive and electrically charged baddies for the foreseeable forever," thing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 所以……关于那个……"意外地让时间线的每个部分以及整个已知宇宙在可预见的未来都充斥着一群异常活跃且带电的坏蛋"的事情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hey, I gotta keep you on your toes somehow, right! It's not like you have better things to be doing. Sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嘿，我得让你保持警觉，对吧！反正你也没什么更重要的事要做。抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yeah, yeah. Sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 恩，是的。抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yeah, well... I guess it is kind of a fun party trick. So! Character sheet!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯，这算是个挺有趣的派对小把戏吧。那么！角色卡！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ... Jerk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ……混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ok-ok-ok-ok-ok coool. Right! You don't have a character for this adventure yet!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好好好好好，没问题。对了！你在这轮游戏还没有角色呢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But, hey. Let's go mop the floor with a few of them schmucks, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但是，嘿。咱们去把那几个笨蛋揍一顿吧，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Everybody else has already built theirs, so... to round out the team, do you want to be a Knight? A Wizard? Or a Rogue?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 其他人都已经选好角色了，那么……为了让队伍完整，你想成为骑士？巫师？还是游荡者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Let's find out!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们来看一下！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Is this why you had no friends in Duviri? I think this is why you had no friends in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这就是你在双衍王境没朋友的原因吗？我想这一定是你在双衍王境没朋友的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Let me know if you change your mind, I... guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我……想，如果你改变主意了，告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I've got your character sheet right here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我这有你的角色卡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Oooookay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好——吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sure! A Knight is a fighter class. Pick a sword & shield or a two-handed sword as your starter weapon. Hit things real hard. Take real hard hits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当然！骑士是战士职业。选择剑盾或双手剑作为你的初始武器。要么使劲打人，要么狠狠挨打。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Zzzz. I mean, great! Everyone party needs a basic b-- I mean, a good old fashioned fighter! Next question!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: Zzzz。我的意思是，太好了！每个队伍都需要一个基本的——我是说，一个好的老派战士！下一个问题！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The arcane forces are yours to wield! Next question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 奥术之力任你驾驭！下一个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sneakity-sneak-sneak! A Drifter after my own heart. Next question!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 鬼鬼祟祟！果然是和我志同道合的漂泊者。下一个问题！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A Wizard's a kind of magic user! Pick from a collection of cool magical spells like fireball or ice ray! Fwoosh! Bang! Boom! Real squishy though. Gotta watch out for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 巫师就是一种使用魔法的人！你可以选择各种炫酷的魔法咒语，比如火球术或冰射线！嗖！砰！轰！不过很软，要小心哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Do you want to wield a two handed sword, or sword and shield? Do you like to 'give' or 'receive'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你想使用双手剑，还是剑盾？你喜欢"攻"还是"守"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Do you want to start with an ice ray specialty or a fire ball specialty? Freeze them where they stand, or roasty toasty?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你想先学寒冰射线专精还是火球专精？把人冻在原地，还是烤得焦香四溢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Do you want to start with a bonus in stealing and stealth or a bonus in assassination?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你想从偷窃和潜行的加成，还是暗杀的加成开始？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And then there's my personal favorite - the rogue. Pick locks, commit crimes, do murder. 'Nuff said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 还有我个人最喜欢的——游荡者。他们会撬锁、犯罪、杀人。无需多言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sooooo... whatcha wanna be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 所——以……你想当哪个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 太好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Shit. I uh. I have a lot of prep to do. So I'll see you all on KIM for the adventure!!

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 耶！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Not much in the way of options.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 选择不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: [Do nothing.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: [什么也不做。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Day one?))
((What?))
I grit my teeth. "I'm not a child. And what you're playing at isn't a game."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我咬紧牙关。"我不是小孩子。你玩的也不是游戏。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Stop. Right now. This isn't a game. Hard line.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ((​停下。​马上​停下。​这​不​是​游戏。​这是底线。​))​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Then it's cheating."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那就是作弊了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I stay silent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我保持沉默。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I stay silent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我保持沉默。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "It's what my father called me."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我父亲以前就这样叫我。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The same reason you call Albrecht 'Little Bengel.' You use it to infantilize the people you interact with."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "就像你叫阿尔布雷希特‘小本格尔'一样。你用这种方式把和你交往的人当成孩子。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I've had enough. I'm done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我受够了。我不干了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir. Stop this. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔。住手。立刻住手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "So what do you expect me to do? Let you win, instead?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那你希望我怎么做？让你赢吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're wrong. I make my own choices."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你错了。我有自己的选择。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Okay. This has gone on long enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧。这事已经够久了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This isn't funny.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这不好笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yeah. It is worth all that hatred if it means stopping you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 是啊。只要能阻止你，哪怕招来再多的仇恨也值得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I disagree. The lives, the deaths, the loves and the friendships - they have meaning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不这么认为。生命、死亡、爱情和友谊——它们都有意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: We don't hate you. We just don't want to see our universe destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们并不恨你。我们只是不想看到我们的宇宙毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir. Please. Drop the act. Can we please, please talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔。拜托。别再装了。拜托，我们能不能好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: If... this isn't what you want, anymore, Amir, I... we can talk about this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，如果……这不再是你想要的了，我……我们可以谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Right. This is new. Those surge eximus are new.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没错。这是新的。这些电涌卓越者是新出现的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What do you mean? This game has always been here. Those surge eximus have always existed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你什么意思？这款游戏一直都有。那些电涌卓越者也一直存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir. It's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔。没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But it did change, didn't you hear Kaya?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但情况确实变了，卡娅，你没听说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You didn't ruin the universe, you made it more interesting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你没有毁掉宇宙，反而让它变得更有趣了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Do you know how many Eximus I kill on a daily basis?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你知道我每天要击杀多少个卓越者吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This wasn't here. And then it was. This is new. You don't remember it that way, because of the loop. Do you trust me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这东西之前没在这里。然后它就出现了。这是新出现的。你之所以没印象，是因为时间循环。你相不相信我说的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This wasn't here. And then it was. I don't remember that, but... she says it. And I believe her. Do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这东西以前不在。然后它就出现了。我不记得了，但是……她说了。我相信她。你相信吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Right. Consider it a... content expansion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没错。把它看作是……扩展内容吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So, things here can change. Slowly. Maybe not as fast as you'd like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 所以，这里的情况可能会发生变化。虽然变化很缓慢，也许没你想象中的那么快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But you know what that also means? It means things can change. Maybe not as fast as you'd like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但你知道这也意味着什么吗？这意味着事情会改变。也许没你想象中的那么快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Maybe not in the way you'd like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 也许并不是你所期望的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But they can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但​它们​可以。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I feel like we just got started. I think Arthur's a Dark Paladin now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 感觉我们才刚刚开始。但我觉得亚瑟现在已经是黑暗圣骑士了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What about the rest of the adventure? The Royal Family?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 冒险的其他部分呢？王室成员呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What's next, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So. Who's up to go kill some Eximus?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 所以，谁想去干掉几个卓越者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This is really cool, Amir. Makes sense to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，这也太酷了。我觉得挺合理的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ready!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 准备好了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /check stats
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /check stats

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 应该是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I wanted to make some notes is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我只是想做些笔记而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: N... no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不……没忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Rogue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 游荡者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wizard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 法师。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Knight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 骑士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Assassination. It never NOT comes in handy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 暗杀。这永远都派得上用场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Oh... stealth. You can't kill what you can't see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哦……潜行。人无法杀死看不见的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fireball. I want to burn it all down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 火球术。我想把这一切都烧成灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ice ray. The colder, the better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 寒冰射线。越冰越好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Offensive! Two-handed sword.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 进攻！双手剑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Defensive! Sword and shield.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 防守！剑盾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Why are we "here" though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不过为什么我们要"报到"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Here!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 到！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ... What.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ……什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: That's awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: How long did that take you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你花了多长时间？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And the second reason?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 而第二个原因？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Quincy!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 昆西！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Got it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 了解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: How do we check what our stats would be for like... picking said lock?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们怎么查看自己开锁之类技能的数值？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ever figure out what it was that Minerva saw, Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 亚瑟，你后来搞清楚米尼娃看到什么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So excited. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好兴奋。：）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Are you okay, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你还好吗，阿米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hey. Game time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嘿，游戏时间到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ready!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 准备好了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Go for the wriggling - strength is less likely to succeed so wriggling will have a lower success number.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（扭​出来​吧​——​力量​不​太​可能​成功，​而​扭动​需要​的​成功值​应该​比​它​低。））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((You're a Paladin? Your strength is probably higher. Try brute strength.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你是圣骑士？你的力量属性可能更高。试试蛮力吧。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((whoops))
((Where the hell did that come from?!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（那又是从哪儿出来的？！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((No, I think he's saying he's impressed, lol.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（没，我觉得他在说他惊到了，哈哈。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Okay. I'm going to try to work my way through the crowd closer to the platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好的。我打算试着挤过人群，往行刑台那边走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Who wants to go first?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（谁想先来？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Amir, are you just ripping off... is that supposed to be Loid?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿米尔，你这是在抄袭吗……那不就是洛德吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I want to see if I can get near the platform without anybody noticing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想看看能不能在不被任何人察觉的情况下靠近行刑台。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /check sneaking
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /check sneaking

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((... is the whole game going to be like this?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（……整个游戏都会是这样吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Fair point.))
/roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: All right. I want to see how close I'd get.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好的。我想看看我能靠多近。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Anyone have any ideas?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（谁有什么主意吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Never mind. Anybody have any ideas?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（算了。有人有什么想法吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Oh, boy.))
((Amir, are you okay?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿米尔，你还好吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: All right. Let's do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好，我们开始吧。

7, plus 4, is... 11. Decent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 7 加 4 等于……11。还不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 7, plus 1, is... 8. Not terrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 7 加 1 等于……8。不算很糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 7, minus 1, is... 6. Not great.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 7 减 1 等于……6。不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hm. I'd like to see how close I can get to the gallows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯。我想看看自己能离绞刑架有多近。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Sorry Quincy, I feel like I stole it.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（抱歉，昆西，我觉得好像是我偷过来的。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Yeah, but it's on initiative?! What a waste.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（是啊，但把这个用在先攻骰上？！真浪费。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm how far away from the platform again? Ten? I'm going to do my best to get to Cedric to set him free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我离行刑台还有多远来着？十英尺？我会尽全力赶到塞德里克身边，把他救出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm right there next to the platform. I'm going to shove past the guards, run up to Cedric, take out my dagger, and cut him free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我就在行刑台旁边。我要挤过守卫，冲到塞德里克跟前，拔出匕首，把他救出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am going to attack the guard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要攻击守卫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am going to go to Cedric and try to free him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要走向塞德里克，试着把他救出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hands!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 手！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Noose!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 绞索！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I take my two-handed sword and I charge at him, swinging it at him. "AGGGHH!!!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我挥舞着双手剑向他冲去，猛地劈了下去。"啊啊啊！！！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Brandishing my sword and shield, I charge at the guard and swing at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我挥舞着剑和盾，向守卫冲去，并向他挥出一剑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am going to cast "Charm Person" on him. I can't imagine he's that bright.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要对他施展"魅惑术"。我不觉得他会有多聪明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to cast "Enchanted Projectile" at him. All three bolts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要对他施放"魔化飞弹"。三发全发。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to get up close to him and stab him with both of my daggers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要靠近他，用两把匕首刺他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Mm. Yeah, I'll take the hit to get Cedric free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯。是的，为了让塞德里克脱身，我愿意承受这个攻击。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Okay, I'll attack the guard instead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧，那我改成攻击守卫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 17。我将两把刀都刺进了他的身体。虽然没能刺得像我希望的那样深，但也够深了。毕竟，我还是喜欢在黑暗中行动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "In all this chaos, I had to come watch your back! Get out of here before you get hurt!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这里一片混乱，我得来保护你！快离开这里，免得受伤！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I tend to work when my victims don't know I'm coming, so... cut me some slack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我通常会在受害者毫无防备的时候出手，所以……请多包涵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d4, d4

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What's next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 接下来是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Can I loot the body?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我可以搜刮尸体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I panicked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我慌了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sorry that I saved you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 很抱歉我救了你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wait. I want to attack him now. I want that enchanted sword.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 等等。我现在就想攻击他。我想要那把魔法剑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((It's magic. I want it.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（有魔法。我想要。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这里一片混乱，我得来保护你！快离开这里，免得受伤！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You have my magic sword." I reach out for his blade. "Yours is back in the barracks."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "​你​拿​了​我​的​魔法剑。​"​我​伸手​去​拿​他​的​剑。​"​你​的​那把​还​在​军营里。​"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What's next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 接下来是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Can I loot the body?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我可以搜刮尸体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I think we need to loot the corpses."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我觉得我们得搜刮尸体。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Everyone. We need to get out of here."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "大伙们，我们得离开这里。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're probably right." I look for the exit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你可能说得对。"我开始寻找出口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "LOOT. CORPSES."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "搜刮。尸体。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "We're in a bit of a rush."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们时间有点紧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're probably right. But let's be quick about it."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "或许你说的有道理。但我们还是快点吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I look for the exit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我寻找出口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Stand and fight?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不跑了，正面打一场？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I guess we... go into the corridor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想我们……还是进入走廊吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well, then. I guess we go into the corridor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧，那我们就进入走廊吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Great job, Amir. This was a lot of fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 干得好，阿米尔。这真的很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Thanks for doing this, Amir. I know it's a ton of work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 谢谢你做这件事，阿米尔。我知道这真的很费工夫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to shove the head into my bag to blind him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要把那家伙的头塞进包里，让他看不见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I groan and look down at the gash in my side. The blood is seeping through the leather of my armor as I press my hand to the wound. "Damn it!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我呻吟着，低头看向肋下的伤口。鲜血透过盔甲的皮革渗了出来，我按住伤口。"妈的！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I groan and look down at the gash in my side. The blood is seeping through the fabric of my robes as I press my hand to the wound. "Shit!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我呻吟着，低头看向肋下的伤口。鲜血透过礼袍的布料渗了出来，我按住伤口。"该死！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I manage to dive out of the way of the blast, just barely in time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我总算在千钧一发之际向外扑去，躲开了爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Destroy it!!))
((Do your worst!!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（尽管放马过来！！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((PUNT THE HEAD.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（把头踢飞。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Grab the head!))
Walking up to the pile of ash from his body, and look down at the golden key. "Hm. That thing could be cursed."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我走到那具尸体的灰烬堆前，低头看着那把金钥匙。"嗯。那东西说不定被诅咒了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Walking up to the pile of ash from his body, I lean down and brush off the bits of ex-Commander Nach from the golden key... and take it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我走向他尸体的灰烬堆，俯下身，将前指挥官纳奇残留在金钥匙上的碎屑拂去……然后拿起了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "We should drop-kick the head," I say as I walk up to look down at it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们应该一脚踢飞那颗头。"我走上前，俯视着它说道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Walking up to the head on the ground, I pick it up to look down at its ugly mug. "Hey there."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我走到那颗躺在地面上的头颅跟前，拾起它，俯视着那张丑陋的面孔。"嗨。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Entirely ignoring the head - who cares, it's just a head - I go for the shining gold key.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 完全无视那颗头颅——管它呢，不过是颗头罢了——我径直走向那把闪闪发光的金钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Oh great. I reach down and grab it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哦，太好了。我弯下腰把它捡了起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Actually? "Hey Morohime. You wanna do the honors?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 说真的？"嘿，诸姬。要不要你来开个头？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I hand him to Sanguina. Seems like a Warlock might get along well with an undead head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我把他交给了桑吉娜。看来术士跟不死怪的头应该挺投缘的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I put him into my bag.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我把他放进了我的包里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LOL))
((How do I screw up kicking a ball?!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我怎么连踢个球都能踢砸？！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I mean, I never was very good at field games as a kid... this is pretty accurate...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我是说，从小我就不太擅长户外游戏……这说法还挺准的……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I take a step forward to line up the kick, slip, and wind up flat on my ass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我向前迈了一步，准备踢一脚，结果滑倒了，摔了个屁股墩儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't trust him. I don't say anything at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不信任他。我什么也没说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're the one the Royal Family sent us here to meet?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你就是王室派我们来见的人吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Are you the Emissary?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你是使徒吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "That can't be good."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那肯定不是什么好事。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I wonder who he was."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我很好奇他是谁。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Well... I guess we go inside."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "好吧……看来我们得进去了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fantastic job. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 太棒了。 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You did a fantastic job rewriting on the fly, seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你随机应变的本事太棒了，真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Party pooper. What's the big deal about a "weird unit" anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 真扫兴。​说​到​底，​一​支​"奇怪​的​部队"​有​什么​大​不​了​的？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well, now that's all figured out, let's focus on the game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好了，既然这些都解决了，我们就专注于这场游戏吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You seem pretty upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你看起来很难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Is everything okay, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，一切都还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't mean about the game, is something else going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不是指游戏方面的事情，是不是还有其他什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well, the fun of these kinds of stories is adapting them on the fly, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 说到底，这类故事的乐趣就在于能即兴发挥，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I completely understand, it's a lot of work. Is any of it still usable?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我完全理解，这工作量确实不小。其中还有什么能用的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: We don't need those jokers. More loot for us!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们不需要那些家伙。这样我们就能多拿点战利品了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Uh, yeah. But you... really sure you're okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯，是的。但是你……真的确定没事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ready when you are. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​准备​好​了​我们​就​开始。​：）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Better not touch it."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "最好别碰它。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Curses make life interesting."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "诅咒让生活更有趣。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Can anybody cast 'sense magic?'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "有人会施展‘感知魔法'吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Not worth the risk. Leave it."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不值得冒这个险。算了吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "All right. I guess we should open the scroll."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "好吧。我觉得应该打开这卷轴了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hm. I wonder what that's going to do to me later."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯。不知道这之后会对我产生什么影响。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Called it. Totally cursed."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "果然不出所料。真的被诅咒了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Nope. Leave it all."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不。全都不要碰。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I'm sure those aren't cursed. Go ahead and take those."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我敢肯定那些东西没被诅咒。你尽管拿去吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "It definitely did something," I say as I open up the scroll to read it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这绝对起了什么作用了，"我一边展开卷轴阅读，一边说道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're enjoying all this death and mayhem a bit too much," I say as I open up the scroll to read it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你似乎太沉迷于这些死亡与混乱了，"我一边展开卷轴阅读，一边说道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "All right, fine. Only because it'll help the rest of us."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "行吧，算了。不过也是为了能帮到我们其他人。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Then perhaps you shouldn't have LEFT... it unattended in the first place."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那你或许一开始就不该把它……扔在那不管。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Ah, damn it. It *was* cursed."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "啊，该死。这玩意儿*确实*被诅咒了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "That was weird..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "真奇怪……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hm... all right, fine, we'll read it."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯……好吧，行，我们会读的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Yep. It's definitely cursed."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "没错，它肯定被诅咒了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I have this overwhelming sensation that we're supposed to go find a Family Cyrpt."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我有一种强烈的预感，我们应该去找一片家族墓穴。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Don't know. Don't care. Scroll's cursed. You can read it if you want."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不知道。也不关心。卷轴被诅咒了。你想看就看吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Then don't put spoilers in the title card.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（那请不要在标题卡里放剧透。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((They're the ones that walked off.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（谁叫他们走的。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I was right, it *was* cursed."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我猜对了，它确实被诅咒了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Well, we didn't come all this way just to admire the view."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们千里迢迢来到这里，可不只是为了欣赏风景。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Sanguina, you're a Warlock, yes?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "桑吉娜，你是术士，对吧？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Your... grimoire." I say, while desperately trying to maintain eye contact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你的……魔典。"我一边说着，一边拼命地保持着眼神交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Er. Just a vibe."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "呃，只是感觉而已。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Do you know 'hear thoughts?'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你知道‘读心术'吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I want to make sure we aren't about to get ambushed." I bow, and hold out my arm to the graveyard. "Would you do me the honors?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我想确认一下，我们不会遭到伏击吧。"我鞠了一躬，伸手指向墓地。"劳驾带个路好吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "有那么糟糕吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "怎么了？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((This is what I get for telling you about the future...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这​就​是​我​告诉​你​未来​会​发生​什么​的​下场……））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I fish through my bag, and pull out the keys I got from the Captain of the Guard. "I have keys. Look!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我翻了翻包，掏出了从卫队长那里拿来的钥匙。"我有钥匙。看！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Don't care." I get ready to fight. "Time for you to die a second time."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我不在乎。"我准备战斗。"是时候让你死第二次了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Wait." I hold up my hands. "Who're you talking about? Who's 'he?'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "等等。"我举起双手。"你在说谁？‘他'是谁？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Is it the thing on your chest?" I point at the gold emblem. "Is that the key?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "是你胸前的那个东西吗？"我指着金色的徽章。"那是钥匙吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to run up to him and steal his head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​要​冲上​去​把​他​的​头颅​偷​过来。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to run up to him and steal his head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​要​冲上​去​把​他​的​头颅​偷​过来。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to run at him and see if I can't rip the key out of his hand and take it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要冲上去，看看能不能从他手里抢走钥匙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to run up to him and steal his head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​要​冲上​去​把​他​的​头颅​偷​过来。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to run at him and stab him, um, in the head? Real hard?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要冲上去，狠狠地捅他一刀，嗯，就捅他的头怎么样？狠狠地捅？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to cast "Fire Ball" at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​要​对​他​施放​"火球"。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to cast "Ice Ray" at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要对他施放"寒冰射线"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am going to run at him and wail him as hard as I can with my sword.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​要​冲​过去，​用剑狠狠​地​劈​向​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am going to run at him and wail him as hard as I can with my two-handed sword.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​要​冲​过去，​用​双手​剑狠狠​地​劈​向​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "看！是女皇！"
