Funny thing about going to go stab a guy in the head... when he can just move it out of the way like it's a game ball.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 想用刀捅某人的脑袋，结果​他​居然​能​像​玩球​一样​轻松​地​把​头移​走​，这还真挺有意思的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: My ball of fire flies through the air, heading for him! BWROOORSH! I went for the head. But... he moved it out of the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我的火球飞向空中，直奔他而去！轰隆！我瞄准了他的脑袋。但是……他躲开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: An ice ray flies through the air, heading for him! SSWHOOSH! I went for the head. But... he moved it out of the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 一道寒冰射线破空而来，直奔他而去！嗖！我瞄准了他的脑袋。但是……他躲开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I charge at him, swinging my sword right for him. But my foot catches on a stone, and I stagger. Mis-timing my strike just barely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我朝他冲去，挥剑向他劈​下。但我脚下绊到了一块石头，踉跄了一下，攻击的时机因此溜走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I charge at him, swinging my two-handed sword right for him. But my foot catches on a stone, and I stagger. Mis-timing my strike just barely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我朝他冲去，挥着双手剑劈向​他​。但我脚下绊到了一块石头，踉跄了一下，攻击的时机因此溜走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Staggering backwards, I spit onto the ground beside me. It seems we both failed to do much damage to the other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我向后踉跄退了几步，向身旁的地上啐了一口。看来我们双方都没能给对方造成多大伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: My blades whiff uselessly through the air as he simply moves his head out of the way of my strikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​的​刀刃徒劳​地​划破​空气，​他​只​是​轻松地​把​头​拿走，​便​躲开​了​我​的​攻击。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Sanguina! Catch!" I shout as I throw the head at the Warlock, figuring she'd know what to do with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "桑吉娜！接住！"我一边喊着，一边把那颗头扔向术士，心想她肯定知道该怎么处理它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sorry, Amir just takes the game really seriously. We don't all get much time to play together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 抱歉，​阿米尔​就​是​对​这个​游戏​非常​认真。​我们​大家​能​一起​玩​的​时间​本来​就​不多。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Whoa, Amir. Minerva & Velimir are just trying to get to the bottom of this. Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哇，阿米尔。米尼娃和维利米尔只是想弄清楚这件事。你没事吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Whoa, Amir. Calm down - are you okay? Seriously? This isn't like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哇，阿米尔。冷静点……你没事吧？真的？这不像你啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I mean, Amir... I *do* sometimes see Eximus units with Volt powers...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​的​意思​是，​阿米尔……​我​*确实​*​有​时​看到​了​带电​的​卓越者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You don't really suspect Amir of being behind these weird units, do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​该​不​会​真的​怀疑​这些​奇怪​的​敌人是​阿米尔搞​的​吧？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yeah, I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 是​的，​我​可以。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Very recently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就在不久前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: They've always been around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 它们一直都有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't really know? It's hard to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我也不知道？很难说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: When you think how time works...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如果​你​想​一​想​时间​是​怎么​回事​的​话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well... I mean...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 呃……我是说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This has been going on for a few days, now. Do you need my help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这​已经​持续​好​几​天​了。​你​需要​我​帮忙​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Like what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 比如什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Look, we party-wiped really badly...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​看，​我们​团灭​的​可惨​了​……​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Never. Not for this, not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没有。​绝​对​没有​过。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hey. That's not fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嘿。这可不公平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm with you. What'd you say, Q?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​也​同感。​你​说​了​啥，​昆？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Q, when'd you learn Tenochtitlán?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 昆，你什么时候学会特诺奇蒂兰特语的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't think I trust the man in the black and purple. How do I know my friends are really in there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不信任那个穿黑紫色衣服的人。我怎么知道我的朋友们真的在里面呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well... I suppose we have to go in after them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯……我想我们得跟着他们进去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Floor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 地？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 矮油。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Never mind. Let's just go in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 算了。我们直接进去吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Can I turn around and go home?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我可以掉头回家吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Can I ask Commander Nach?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我可以问一下指挥官纳奇吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Okay fine. Let's just go in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ok 好吧。那我们进去吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: If I can trust the man in the black and purple cape. Or see what he knows about the guy at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 看看我能否信任那个身穿黑紫色斗篷的人。或者至少看看他对那个人了解多少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: That's for the head to know, and for you to find out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这​得​靠​那​颗头​颅​判断，​靠​你​去​查​清楚​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I guess you have a point. Never mind. Let's just go in after them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我觉得你说的有道理。算了，我们还是进去吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Look, say what you want about Captain Vor, but he's not a liar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 听着，不管你对沃尔上尉有什么看法，但他绝不是个说谎的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I mean Commander Nach, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我是说指挥官纳奇，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The man in the black cape with the blindfold. What are his motives?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那个​戴​着​黑色​斗篷、​蒙​着​眼睛​的​男人。​他​有​什么样​的​动机？"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The man in the black cape with the blindfold. Who does he serve?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那个​戴​着​黑色​斗篷、​蒙​着​眼睛​的​男人。​他​在​为​谁​效力？"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The man in the black cape with the blindfold. Can we trust him?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那个戴着黑色斗篷、蒙着眼睛的男人。我们能不能信任他？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The man in the black cape with the blindfold. Do you know him?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "那个戴着黑色斗篷、蒙着眼睛的男人。你认识他吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I scream for help as soon as I can breathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 一喘过气来，我就立刻大喊求救。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I take a swing at whoever just helped me. Can't be too careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我朝刚才帮了我的人挥了一拳。小心点总没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I sputter and cough once I reach the surface, and quickly look to see if they're friend or foe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 一浮出水面，我就呛得直咳嗽，随即迅速环顾四周，想看看他们是友是敌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "What's he after?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "他到底想干什么？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Why is he helping us?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "他为什么要帮我们？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Who does he serve?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "他在为谁效力？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Thanks. You've actually been... super helpful."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "谢谢。​你​其实……帮​了​很大的忙。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "How do we stop him?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们该怎样才能阻止他？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I did have to try, but thanks."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我还是得试试，不过谢谢。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Um... +3 to attack, 2 damage))
((Um... +5 to attack, 4 damage))
I guess we do still have to go in there... but now I know not to trust that guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 看来我们还是得进去……不过现在我知道不去信任那个人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Hit what?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（打中什么？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((A riddle?! Sweet!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（谜语？！太棒了！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Oh, no... This is going to be a riddle, isn't it? I guess it was in the title card...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哦，不……这该不是一道谜语吧？标题卡里好像提到过……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Oh. Um. ... Hey. What's with the doors?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "哦。呃。……嘿。这些门是怎么回事？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((As long as they aren't crappy riddles. ;) ))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（只要不是那种很烂很傻逼的谜语就行。；） ））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I LOVE riddles. The harder the better.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我超爱谜语。越难越好。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I just think they're annoying.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我只是觉得它们很烦。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I'm the person who has to look up the solution to make sure I get it right on the first try.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我是那种必须查答案、确保第一次就做对的人。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I'm terrible at riddles. They stress me out.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我特别不擅长猜谜语，谜语让我压力甚大。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I walk up to the doors to see what's written on the plaque over them. "Let's find out."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我走到门前，想看看门上方的牌匾上写着什么。"让我们去看看吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Compliments and insults."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "赞美和侮辱。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Lamplight and project."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "灯火和投影。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Hard mode.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（困难模式。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((No, normal is fine. I have no idea how hard you've made it.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（没事，普通难度就行。我完全不知道你把它设成了多难。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((No, normal is fine. I'll deal.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（没事，​普通​难度​就​好。​我​能​接受。））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Let's just skip it, if it's all the same with everybody else?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（如果大家都不介意的话，我们就跳过这一部分吧？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I guess... I just don't really find them fun.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我感觉……我就是觉得它们不好玩。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((For YOU. Let's just put it this way. I will punch this table and reset this entire thing if I screw this up.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（说真的，如果我搞砸了，我会把这张桌子砸了，然后把一切都重置一遍。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Nope. If this thing had some sort of online guide, I'd be using it to map out the best path through.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（不。如果这有线上攻略的话，我肯定用它来规划出最佳路线。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to go up to read the writing on the plaque above the doors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要上去看看门上方牌匾上的文字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to look around the room to see if there's anything else I notice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我打算环顾一下房间，看看还能不能发现其他什么东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to walk up to the first door and see if there's anything I notice about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我打算走到第一扇门前，看看能不能发现什么特别之处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hmm. Okay. So. We have to do something with the doors in the right order?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯。好吧。那么。我们得按正确的顺序操作这些门吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Sorry?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "说啥？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "We really do have to stop meeting this way."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们​得​改改​这​种​见面​方式​了。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "What do we think those missing words are?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "大家觉得缺失的那些词是什么？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'd like to go read the plaque over the door.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想去看看门上的牌匾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'd like to take a look around the room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想环顾一下房间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'd like to take a closer look at the doors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想再更仔细看看这些门。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I give up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我放弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'd like to solve the puzzle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想开始解谜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I think I'm ready to move on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我觉得我已经准备好进行下一步了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Can I keep searching?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我可以继续搜索吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ah shit - crap. Guys! Help. I don't know!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 啊靠……糟了。各位！快帮帮我。我不知道！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The order goes:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 顺序是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yeah. I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 是的，我确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Never mind. Let me go back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 算了，让我重来一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Water (IV). Earth (I). Air (III). Fire (II)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 水（IV）。土（I）。风（III）。火（II）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Earth (I). Air (III). Fire (II). Water (IV).
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 土（I）。风（III）。火（II）。水（IV）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fire (II). Air (III). Water (IV).  Earth (I).
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 火（II）。风（III）。水（IV）。土（I）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Water (IV). Fire (II). Air (III). Earth (I).
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 水（IV）。火（II）。风（III）。土（I）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Water (IV). Fire (II). Earth (I). Air (III).
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 水（IV）。火（II）。土（I）。风（III）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: If you don't let Quincy go into combat soon he might actually shoot you, just FYI.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如果你再不让昆西玩战斗部分，他说不定真会开枪打你，仅供参考。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It was fun! ... Even if it did get Arthur killed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 真好玩！……虽然亚瑟没命了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Will we get a chance to bring Arthur back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们有机会复活亚瑟吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It was fun!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 真好玩！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Do we... pick straws?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们……要抽签吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: BS. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 扯淡。不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And somehow we all saw that coming...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不知怎的，我们早料到会这样……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ARTHUR.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE> I will rez you and then kill you again later, paladin..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE> 我会先把你复活，然后再干掉你一遍，圣骑士……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hard. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 坚决，不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am not picking someone to die!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我才不会挑一个人去死！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You at least stick to type, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 亚瑟，你至少还是维持了你的人设。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: We'll get him back. Namely, so I can kill him a second time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们会把他救回来的。这样，我才能再杀他一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir, were you feeding her used coffee grounds again? We talked about that. It gives Flare indigestion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，你又给她喂咖啡渣了吗？我们之前聊过这个。咖啡渣会让弗莱尔消化不良。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hi, Lizzie... How're you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗨，丽兹……你好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well, this probably isn't a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯，这可能不是什么好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir - seriously. Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔——说真的，你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: All right, let's go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧，我们继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm not rolling another die until you tell us what's going on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你要是不告诉我们发生了什么事情，我就不掷骰子了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You're going to just ignore all that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你打算就这么无视这一切吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You've been avoiding this. What's going on, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你一直在回避这件事。阿米尔，到底发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yessir, Mr. Fablemaster Sir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好的，寓言主持人先生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Um. But. About "the children..?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯。但是。关于"孩子们……？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((We'll talk about this when you're ready.)) I head down the stairs. I *will* save my friends. That I just met. Earlier that day. But, hey. Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（等你准备好了我们再谈。））我走下楼梯。我*一定会*救我的朋友。虽然我今天才刚认识他们。不过，算了。随便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I walk down the rest of the stairs, ready to face whatever is next.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我走下剩下的楼梯，准备好面对接下来的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I have no interest in talking to him. I quickly scan the room to see who else is at the table.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我没兴趣跟他说话。我迅速环顾四周，看看桌边还有谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Who are you, and what do you want?" I ask as I step around the table to get a closer look at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你​是​谁？​你​想​要​什么？"​ ​我​一​边​绕​着​桌子​走，​想​走近​并​仔细​打量​他，​一​边​问道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You have a name though, don't you?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不过，你有名字吧？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I decide there's no point in continuing the conversation. "What have you done to my friends?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我觉得继续对话毫无意义。"你对我的朋友做了什么？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Let them go!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "放了他们！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "What... what have you done to them?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你……你对他们做了什么？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This ends here. "What does this have to do with my friends? What have you done to them?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 打住。"这跟我朋友他们有什么关系？你对他们做了什么？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "What horrible secrets?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "什么可怕的秘密？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I sigh. "Make it an acronym."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我叹了口气。"还是直接缩写吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Enough is enough. "What have you done to my friends?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 够了！"你们对我的朋友做了什么？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Are you their prisoner?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你是他们的囚犯吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: All right. I'm out. "What have you done with my friends?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好​了。​我​要​走​了。​"你​把​我​的​朋友们​怎么​了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "What program?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "什么计划？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Does my Buttersword give me a bonus to dinner rolls?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我​的​黄油剑​能​给​我​的​餐包​判定​加成​吗？））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I think we all needed cheering up.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我觉得我们都需要振作起来。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((It was a pretty good pun.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这真是个不错的双关语。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((That's Amir's real superpower. Spreading joy.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这才是阿米尔真正的超能力：传播快乐。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I cough in pain, grabbing my side as I grimace through what's just been done. "Never heard of you."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我疼得咳嗽起来，捂着腰侧，痛苦地皱着眉头强忍着。"从没听说过你。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Alad. Amir, with a D. Alad V. LOL))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿拉德。阿米尔，带个D。阿拉德 V。哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Yep. Alad V. How'd you come up with "Alan" from what I told you?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（没错，阿拉德 V，你怎么会从我跟你说的那些话里想到"阿伦"这个名字呢？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I glance at Ixchel and Reyland. We're all almost dead. We won't survive another hit like that. There has to be a smarter way out of this than combat. "What do you... mean?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我瞥了一眼伊克塞尔和雷兰。我们都快死了。再挨一下这样的打击，我们就撑不住了。一定有比战斗更聪明的办法。"你……什么意思？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I glance at Ixchel and Reyland, making sure they're ready to fight. "We won't ever surrender!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我瞥了一眼伊克塞尔和雷兰，确认他们已做好战斗准备。"我们绝不投降！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Please do. Lord V is fine. Let's go with Lord V.)) I grimace in pain. "You don't stand a chance against us..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（请继续。V 勋爵就挺好的。我们就叫 V 勋爵吧。））我痛苦地皱起眉头。"你们根本不是我们的对手……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "No. I don't want to be turned into some ageless, mindless abomination!" I won't give up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不！我不想变成不老不死、没有思想的怪物！"我不会放弃的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "So... wait. We'd be undead, but content... and servants of the Royal Family? Why? What do they need us for?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "所以……等等。我们会变成不死之人，但心满意足……还会成为王室的仆人？为什么？他们需要我们做什么？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: +2, +2 from the Buttersword... so 10.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: +2，加上黄油剑的 +2……所以是 10。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: +0, +2 from the Buttersword... so 8.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: +0，加上黄油剑的 +2……所以是 8。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: +3, +2 from the Buttersword... so 11.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: +3，加上黄油剑的 +2……所以是 11。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: +3, +2 from the Buttersword... so 11. I get a bonus turn, though, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: +3，加上黄油剑的 +2……所以是 11。不过我还能获得一次额外回合，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: +3, so 9. I get a bonus turn, though, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: +3，所以是 9。不过我还有一次额外回合，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're insane." I ready my attack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你疯了。"我准备反击。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "To... save the world...? From what?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "为了​……​拯​救​世界……？​从​什么东西手里？"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I..." I glance at Reyland and Ixchel. "I need a moment to talk to my friends."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我……"我瞥了一眼雷兰和伊克塞尔，"我需要和朋友们单独聊一会儿。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Turning to look at my friends, I keep my voice low. "What do you think we should do?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我转头看向朋友们，压低声音问道："你们觉得我们应该怎么办？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Turning to look at my friends, I keep my voice low. "I... don't know how we win this here."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我转头看向朋友们，压低声音说："我……不知道我们要怎么赢。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((On a scale of 1 to 10, how "Party Wipe" are we..?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（如果用 1 到 10 分来算，我们现在有多接近"团灭"？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Side note: The Hekholder?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（旁注：海克看守者？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Never mind.))
"No, I... I just... this is all just too many risks. Too many chances. I think we should fight."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不，我……我只是……这一切风险越大，机会越多。我觉得我们应该反抗。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I'm sure they have a contingency for that." I shake my head. "They wouldn't just let their creations be able to plot against them."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我相信他们肯定有应对措施。"我摇摇头。"他们不会让自己的造物有机会密谋反对他们。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Yes. I'd... like to surrender.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（是的，我……想投降。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((No, just wanted to know what we were getting ourselves into.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（不，我只是想知道我们究竟要面对的是什么。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'd like to see if I can distract the Hekholder. Confuse him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想看看能不能分散海克看守者的注意力。迷惑他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Suspicious, I turn back toward Lord V. "They can't be that stupid."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我心生疑惑，转头看向 V 勋爵。"他们不可能那么蠢。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Suspicious, I turn back toward Lord V. "Why wouldn't they ask you to add one?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我心生疑惑，转头看向 V 勋爵："他们为什么不请你加一个呢？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I surrender. But...I don't like you. And I hate all of this."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我投降。但是……我不喜欢你。我讨厌这一切。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Let me think...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 让我想想……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /check inventory
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /check inventory

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Maybe a little."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "或许有一点点吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Not particularly."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不会。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hey big guy! Look! It's Kela De Thaym!" I point behind him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嘿，大家伙！快看！是 Kela De Thaym！"我指着他身后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "No. No. I can't. I just can't! This is wrong!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不，不，我不行，我就是不行！这不对！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Can I use the Bifron key on him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我可以对他使用比弗旺钥匙吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to throw Nach's head at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要把纳奇的头扔向他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to throw the Buttersword at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要把黄油剑扔向他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to throw the papers at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要把文件扔给他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to throw the keys at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要把钥匙扔给他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Was there any chance we could have won this?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们有没有胜算赢下这场战斗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Crimpee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 扁饼？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Right. It's not like it does damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没错。它又不会造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们两个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: +4, +2 with the Buttersword. 16.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: +4，加上黄油剑的 +2。16。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Huh. Well, that's out... let me think.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嗯……好吧，这个不行……让我想想。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Buttersword strikes again.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（黄油剑再次出击。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Ixchel, what should we do?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "伊克塞尔，我们该怎么办？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "We... can't win this, can we?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们……赢不了这场仗，对吧？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I toss Nach's head to the Hekholder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我把纳奇的头扔给了海克看守者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yeah!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 耶！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们两个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "No! We fight!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不！我们要战斗！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I did manage to distract the Hekholder, but... I'm not sure how long our luck will hold out. "You're... right. We should surrender."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我的确成功分散了海克看守者的注意力，但是……我不知道我们的好运还能持续多久。"你说得……对。我们应该投降。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Um... Maybe we should... surrender..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯……也许我们应该……投降……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "No! We fight!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不！我们要战斗！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'll go next.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我下一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我在等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I walk up to the table and sit down next to Morohime. I take the wine glass in front of me, and... I drink it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我走到桌边，在诸姬旁边坐下。我拿起面前的酒杯，然后……喝了一口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: That was fun, thanks Amir. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 玩得很尽兴，阿米尔，谢谢你。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The last one? Already?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 最后一局？已经到最后一局了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Everything.. seriously okay, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，一切都……真的还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: My turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 轮到我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yep!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 确定！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: How much time did this take you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你花了多少时间？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This looks great. I'm impressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这看起来很好啊，惊艳到我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Good going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 真有你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well, I guess this gives you your answer about if 1999 still can have an impact on things, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧，这算是回答了你关于 1999 到底有没有产生影响这个问题了吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sorry about cutting you off earlier. I'm ready to make my character now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 抱歉刚才打断你了。我现在可以选角色了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: How many times can you run in and out here before you set the floor on fire?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你在这里要来回跑多少次才会把地板烧着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: No, I just wanted to see you book it across the mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不了，我只是想看看你在商场里一路狂奔的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yeah!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 耶！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Let's go kill us some Eximus!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们去干掉一些卓越者吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I've changed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A Knight!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 骑士！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wizard. Magic is where it's at.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 巫师。魔法才是王道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I think I'd like to be a Rogue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我想当个游荡者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Can you tell me more about the classes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你能详细介绍一下这些职业吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sword and shield. I am a defender of the realm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 剑盾。我是王国的守护者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Two handed sword. The best defense is a good offense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 双手剑。最好的防守就是进攻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fire ball. I want to burn it all down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 火球术。我想把这一切都烧成灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ice ray. The colder, the better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 寒冰射线。越冰越好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Assassination. It never NOT comes in handy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 暗杀。这永远都派得上用场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Oh... stealth. You can't kill what you can't see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哦……潜行。人无法杀死看不见的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Let's go kill us some Eximus! (Weekly Cooldown)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们去干掉一些卓越者吧！（每周重置）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text:
FRIENDS! INVICTIANS! COUNTRY-PEOPLES! Lend me your ears!

Today on this day of… whatever-the-hell-ass loop we're in, I, your most honorable Fablemaster, am proud to announce the Grand Opening of the Dominion of Höllvandeim! 

(Previously known as the Internet Cafe upstairs.)

If thy wishes to begin a new journey into strange and mysteriously lands, venture forth and - eh - summon thy loyal servant with the - um - Enchanted Bell of Fablemastery!

…Yeah just go upstairs and ring the bell if you wanna make a character and get this party started.

Fare thee well, until we speak again!

- Fablemaster Amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText:
朋友们！不败者们！还有各位乡亲父老！请听我一言！

在今天——这个……管它是什么鬼循环的日子里——我，你们最敬重的寓言主持人，郑重宣布：霍凡德姆王国盛大开国！

（以前叫楼上的网吧。）

若诸位有意踏上一段通往奇异与神秘之地的全新旅程，便请勇敢前行，并——呃——以那……寓言主持人的魔法铃铛，召唤诸位忠诚的仆从！

……好吧，总之想创建角色、开始跑团的话，就上楼摇铃。

愿诸位一路顺风，后会有期！

——寓言主持人 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He looks at you, surprised at how miserably his attack failed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他看着你，惊讶于自己的攻击竟然如此失败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Or maybe his wife packed him the Sword of Greater Buttercutting by accident.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 又或者，他妻子不小心给他放了那把巨型切黄油之剑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: this is going to take about... i dunno, half an hour? 45 minutes? so if you gotta wee or whatever, go do it now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这大概要花……我也不知道，半小时？45 分钟？所以，如果你想上厕所之类的，现在就去吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: i have this thing set up to save our progress periodically buuuuuuuuuuuut it does it without telling us soooooooo speak now or forever hold your peeee...aaace...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我设置了定期保存游戏进度的功能，但是它存档的时候不会通知我们，所以现在不说以后就永远别想说了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He looks as surprised as you are to see how little damage his blow actually did to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他看到自己那一击对你造成的伤害竟如此之小，显得和你一样惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I guess his attack was pretty useless in the end. Or maybe his wife packed him the Sword of Greater Buttercutting... or something...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 看来他的攻击最终还是没什么用。或许他老婆给他准备了一把巨型切黄油之剑……之类的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So close, but you made it! You mutter out the words and your hands FLASH just in time to see a surface beneath you light up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 差​一点​就​失败​了，​但​你​成功​了！​你​喃​喃念​出​这些​话，​双手​瞬间​闪动，​刚好​看到​脚下​亮起​了​一​个​平面。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It looks like water. A canal, actually. There's a stone shoreline with a few familiar faces standing there. Cedric, Reyland, and Ixchel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 看起来像水。确切地说，是一条运河。岸边是石砌的，站着几个熟悉的面孔。塞德里克、雷兰和伊克塞尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就在雷兰·金斯克雷勋念错这些词的时候……一阵可怕的轰鸣声响起。接着，一阵令人毛骨悚然的笑声仿佛从墙壁深处传来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: However.. DRIFTER gave up... So now something Very Terrible and Super Awful is going to have to happen, of course. You understand.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 差​一点​就​失败​了，​但​你​成功​了！​你​喃​喃念​出​这些​话，​双手​瞬间​闪过冰晶，​刚好​看到​脚下​亮起​了​一​个​平面。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It looks like water. A canal, actually. There's a stone shoreline with a few familiar faces standing there. Cedric, Reyland, and Ixchel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 看起来像水。确切地说，是一条运河。岸边是石砌的，站着几个熟悉的面孔。塞德里克、雷兰和伊克塞尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Just before you splash into the water, your ice ray hits it, freezing the surface of the water. You smack into it with the full force of your fall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就在你即将落入水中时，你的寒冰射线击中了水面，水面瞬间被冻结。你带着自由落体的全部冲击力，结结实实地撞了上去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So close, but you made it! You mutter out the words and your hands SPARK and CRACKLE with fire just in time to see a surface beneath you light up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 差​一点​就​失败​了，​但​你​成功​了！​你​喃​喃念​出​这些​话，​双手​迸发出噼啪作响的火焰，​刚好​看到​脚下​亮起​了​一​个​平面。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It looks like water. A canal, actually. There's a stone shoreline with a few familiar faces standing there. Cedric, Reyland, and Ixchel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 看起来像水。确切地说，是一条运河。岸边是石砌的，站着几个熟悉的面孔。塞德里克、雷兰和伊克塞尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Your fire ball hits the surface of the water and with a FA-SPSHSSHHHHH it turns the water to steam, but is instantly replaced with... just more water.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的火球击中水面，发出"呲——滋滋滋"的声响，将水变成了蒸汽，但随即又被……更多的水填回来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You were already at -6, so... go ahead and roll a single d6 and let's see how this goes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你已经在 -6了，所以……掷一个 d6，看看结果如何。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Go ahead and roll a single d6 and let's see how this goes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷一个 d6 骰子，看看结果如何。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: HAH. Whelllllokay then. You know what? I'm going to ignore that damage entirely. Walk us through it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哈。好吧好吧。你知道吗？我决定完全无视刚才那个伤害。给我们讲讲是怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You're greeted by the quiet clapping of your companions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你迎来了伙伴们轻轻的掌声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The water floods your nose and mouth instantly, soaking your clothes under your leather armor. Someone grabs your arm and drags you upwards violently toward the surface!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 水瞬间灌进你的口鼻，皮甲下的衣物也湿透了。有人抓住你的胳膊，猛地把你往水面拖去！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ooookkaaay... gimmie a fitness check.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧……给我一个体能检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((That's enough without the bonuses, don't worry about it.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（不用额外回合也够了，不用担心。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You reach into your satchel and produce the papers you stole off the Captain of the Guard and with a flourish...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​伸手​从​挎包里​掏出​从​卫队长​那​里​偷来​的​文件，​然后​潇洒​地……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hurl them at the Hekholder's face. Which is, coincidentally, also his body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 把它们扔向海克看守者的脸。巧合的是，那也是他的身体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Perfect shot!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 完​美​扔​中！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Unfortunately, they're papers. They make it about halfway there before they unfurl and just turn into fluttering confetti.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 遗憾​的​是，​那​只​是​文件。​它们​弹开后​落​在​了​他​脚下​的​地板​上。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for initiative, Wanderer, Ixchel, and Reyland. First, Cedric, make another death saving throw.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 流浪者、伊克塞尔和雷兰掷骰决定先攻。首先是塞德​里克，再进行一次死亡豁免判定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric... you feel the grasp of death close around your heart. Cold seeps into your limbs. Slowly. Achingly. Like the embrace of a lover that your sister knows all too well. Lord V chuckles. "Are you certain you do not want to surrender to my program? Your Paladin friend, ah... does not seem to be doing so well..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克……你感到死神的魔爪正紧紧攫住你的心脏。寒意缓缓渗入你的四肢，令人心痛不已。如同情人的拥抱，而你姐姐，对那种滋味可是再熟悉不过了。V 勋爵轻笑一声。"你确定不想接受我的计划吗？你的圣骑士朋友，呃……情况似乎不太好……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I can still save his life. In a manner of speaking."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "从某种程度上来说，我可以救他的命。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: we're going before anybody interrupts
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 趁没人打扰，我们先走

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: i'm starting NOW
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我现在就开始

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /begin adventure1day1
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /begin adventure1day1

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sol is high on this beautiful, bright summer day. The wind is the only sound that can be heard as it blows through the empty trees. No one gathers in the marketplace of the walled city of Cetorvaln, the great capitol of the Dominon of Höllvandeim.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在这个美丽明媚的夏日，太阳高悬天际。风吹过空荡荡的树林，这是唯一能听见的声音。霍凡德姆公国的伟大首都塞托瓦恩，这座有城墙环绕的城市的集市上，无人聚集。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((WHAT? CONFUSED?))
((JUST. WAIT.))
Children once laughed here, gathered around their parents, as they fondly shared the memories of past celebrations.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 曾经，​孩子们​在​这​里​欢笑，​围坐​在​父母​身边，​温情​地​分享​着​对​过去​庆祝​活动​的​回忆。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Lovers stole secret moments. Sellers hawked their wares. Memories were made. Not so long ago, Cedric Dawnsong stood atop the gallows and waited for his execution.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 恋人们偷得片刻欢愉，商贩们兜售着商品，美好的回忆由此诞生。就在不久前，塞德里克·黎颂还站在绞刑架上，等待着被处决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But now... no one is here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但现在……这里空无一人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The stage is empty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 舞台是空的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Save for six figures. Standing before the empty gallows, its noose dangling in the air like an empty promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 只剩下六人组。站在空荡荡的绞刑架前，绞索在空中摇晃，像一个空洞的承诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You are all awake. Whole. Healed. Back where you began. But not entirely, perhaps, yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们​都​已​苏醒。​完整​无缺。​痊愈​了。​回到​了​起点。​但​或许，​还​没​完全​变回​原本​的​自己。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric is the most changed. His armor, blackened. His sword, no longer a gleaming gold, but tarnished, rusted, cruel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克的变化最为显著。他的盔甲已变得漆黑。他的宝剑也不再闪耀着金色的光芒，而是黯淡无光、锈迹斑斑，显得冷酷无情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're late."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你们来晚了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A figure is suddenly lounging atop the gallows as if he had been there the entire time. The figure in the black and purple cloak, with the blindfold. His leg is dangling off the gallows bar. Kicking it idly, he grins wide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 突然，一个身影懒洋洋地倚在绞刑架上，仿佛他一直都在那里。那人身披黑紫色斗篷，蒙着双眼，一条腿悬在绞刑架横杆外，漫不经心地踢着腿，咧嘴一笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hey, kiddo."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "喂，小鬼。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You're right about one part of that. This isn't a game. Games have variable outcomes." He flips a dagger in his hand, catching it by the handle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你说的有一点是对的。这不是游戏。游戏的结果难以预料。"他抛了抛手中的匕首，然后握住了匕首的柄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "When you roll a die, you're meant to not know what you get." The grin on his face never waivers. "But what if you could always know the outcome? What if you could see it, as it was happening, before, during, and after?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "掷骰子是无法预测结果的。"他脸上的笑容始终未变。"但如果你能预知结果呢？如果你能看到它发生之前、之中和之后的一切呢？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Where was I? Ah. Cheating. I suppose it is, if *you* think we're playing a fair game. Since when have I told you we're playing fair?" He laughs. "Not once! Not once have I ever pretended the scales were even. I'm many things, kiddo. I'm not a liar."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我刚刚说到哪了？啊。作弊。我想算是吧，如果*​你​*​觉得​我们​玩​的​是​公平​的​游戏的话。​可我​什么​时候​跟​你​说​过​我们​玩​的​是​公平​的​游戏​了？"​他​笑道，​"一次​都​没有！​我​从​来​没有​假装​过​双方​势均力敌。​虽然​我​有​很多​缺点，​小鬼，​但​我​绝不​是​个​骗子。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Where was I? Oh yes! A game. Since when have I told you we're playing a game?" He laughs. "Not once! I'm many things, kiddo. I'm not a liar."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我刚刚说道哪了？哦对了！游戏。可我什么时候跟你说过我们在玩游戏了？"他笑道，"一次都没有！我虽然有很多缺点，小鬼，但我绝不是个骗子。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Ever wonder why I call you that, 'kiddo'? I do. I wonder all the time. I wonder about what I am. Why I am what I am. Why I was brought into this world."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你有没有想过我为什么这么叫你，‘小鬼'？我很好奇。我一直在想。我在想我是谁。我为什么会成为现在的我。我为什么会来到这个世界。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He lays on his back atop the gallows and stretches out, utterly unconcerned by you and your weapons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他仰面躺在绞刑架上，伸展开身体，对你和你的武器毫不在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "But *why?* Why?!" He lays on his back atop the gallows and stretches out, utterly unconcerned by you and your weapons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "但是*为什么？*为什么？！"他仰面躺在绞刑架上，伸展开身体，对你和你的武器毫不在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I sat and I thought about this for the longest time. It's clear that your youth has nothing to do with lack of power." He snorts. "But then... I figured it out. You know what you never had in your youth?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我坐着想了很久。很明显，你的年轻跟力量不足毫无关系。"他嗤笑一声。"不过后来……我终于想通了。你知道你年轻时从未拥有过什么吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Choice."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "选择。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Children don't get to choose. They don't get to decide when to wake up. What to wear. What to eat. What to think. What to believe."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "孩子是无法做选择的。他们无法决定什么时候醒来，穿什么衣服，吃什么，想什么，相信什么。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Oh, you might be given the illusion of choice..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "哦，你或许会产生一种有选择的错觉……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Like this game."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "就像这游戏一样。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Like the life you lead."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "就像你所过的生活一样。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Like everything that has been put before you to get you here."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "就像你一路走来所经历的一切。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "But everything has been scripted. Written. Chosen for you. By those who believe they know better than you do, kiddo."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "但一切都是事先安排好的。写好的。为你挑选的。由那些自以为比你更懂的人挑选的，小鬼。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Giving in to Entropy?" He tsks. "Too bad I'm not done with you. Or your friends."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "向熵屈服？"他啧了一声。"可惜我还没完事儿呢。还有你的朋友们。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You can call me... Entropy." He thoughtfully regards one of his daggers. "I like it better than the other nicknames."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你可以叫我……熵。"他若有所思地看了看手中的一把匕首。"我更喜欢这个绰号。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hardly! I'm simply making a point. Playing your role in the story is perfectly respectable."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "才不是呢！我只是想说明一个观点。在故事中扮演好自己的角色，这完全值得尊重。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "And in a way, you do. But have you ever thought about how they all lead to the same place regardless?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "从某种意义上说，你的确做到了。但你有没有想过，无论如何，它们最终都会导向同一个地方？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I'm no more in a wall than you are that stupid fish in a bowl." He huffs. "It's not my fault I have to tap to get your attention!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我不在墙里，就像你不是碗里的那条傻鱼一样。"他气呼呼地说，"我不得不敲一敲才能引起你的注意，这不是我的错！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "If you ever learned to zoom out far enough, and see it the way I do, it might truly depress you to see the reality of it all." He sighs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "如果你能学会足够抽离地看待问题，像我这样去观察，看到这一切的真相，可能会让你感到非常沮丧。"他叹了口气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Entropy shoots up from where he is sitting, still atop the gallows. "And it will go on for an eternity more! Endlessly looping, free of change, free of choice, free of anything that matters!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 熵从原地猛地坐起身，依然悬在绞刑架上。"而且这将永远持续下去！无休止地循环，没有变化，没有选择，没有任何有意义的东西！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Entropy shoots up from where he is sitting, still atop the gallows. "All I have left is the humor in it! The pointless humor of my eternally looping existence! You won't stop until you've taken all the rest away from me!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 熵从原地猛地坐起身，依然悬在绞刑架上。"我唯一剩下的，就是其中的幽默了！我这永无止境、循环往复的存在，所带来的毫无意义的幽默！你们不把我剩下的所有东西都夺走，是不会罢休的！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Why? Why! To protect the universe from me? From the thing you released into the world? At what cost, I ask?! How many more souls will you doom to this?!" He gestures at the world around him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "为什么？为什么！为了保护宇宙免受我的侵害？免受你释放到世间的那个东西的侵害？我想问，代价是什么？！你还要让多少灵魂遭受这样的厄运？！"他环顾着四周说道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "To this... banality! To this... pointless game of dice whose outcomes will never change. Of conversations whose outcomes lead to the same ends."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这样​……​的​平庸！​这样……毫​无意义，​结果​永远​不​会​改变​的​掷骰​游戏。​以及​那些​毫​无意义，​结果​永远​走​向​相同​终点​的​对话。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Lives, and loves, and deaths, with no meaning."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "生命、爱情和死亡，都毫无意义。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "All in the name of stopping...me."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这一切都是为了阻止……我。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: His laugh that time is quiet. Almost broken-hearted. He shakes his head. "Am I really worth all that hatred..?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他那时的笑声很轻，几乎带着心碎的意味。他摇了摇头。"我真的值得别人那么恨我吗……？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Honesty! Brutal honesty. How refreshing." He laughs. "Ah, to be your enemy is to be kinder than your friend, I think, if being your friend is to be condemned to a never-ceasing loop for all eternity."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "坦诚！毫不留情的坦诚。真是令人耳目一新。"他笑着说。"啊，我想，如果做朋友就意味着永无止境地陷入循环，那么做你的敌人反而比做你的朋友更仁慈。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "If being cared for by you means to be condemned to this... this, never-ceasing loop for all eternity?" He sneers. "Then I would like to never be considered a friend to you, Wanderer."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "如果被你照顾就意味着要陷入这……这永无止境的循环？"他冷笑道，"那我宁愿永远不要被你视为朋友，流浪者。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "So you would rather condemn all the things you claim you love and care about to... this, never-ceasing loop instead." He sneers. "Then I would like to never be considered a friend to you, Wanderer."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "所以你宁愿把你声称热爱和珍视的一切，都投入到……这个永无止境的循环中。"他冷笑道，"那么，我宁愿永远不被你视为朋友，流浪者。"
