/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sol is high on this beautiful, bright summer day. Birds are chirping merrily in the trees. A crowd gathers in the marketplace of the walled city of Cetorvaln, the great capitol of the Dominion of Höllvandeim.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在这个美丽明媚的夏日，太阳高悬天际。树上的鸟儿欢快地啁啾着。在霍凡德姆自治领的伟大首都——塞托瓦恩这座城墙环绕的城市里，集市上聚集了大批人群。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Children laugh and chase each other around the legs of their parents, who smile at each other and remember their first times at such an event. A father passes a mother a rolled paper cone with sugary-coated popped corn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 孩子们咯咯笑着，在父母腿边追逐嬉戏，父母们则相视而笑，回想起自己第一次参加这种活动的场景。一位父亲递给一位母亲装在纸筒里裹着糖衣的爆米花。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Underneath the shade of a tree near a stall hawking commemorative goods, some young lovers use the festivities to sneak away and enjoy each others company. They will remember this holiday for the rest of their lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在一处兜售纪念品的摊位旁，几对年轻恋人趁着节日的热闹，躲在树荫下享受二人世界的甜蜜时光。这个节日将让他们终生难忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: For today is the day a criminal hangs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 因为今天是处决罪犯的日子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Today is the day that Cedric Dawnsong dies by the rope for what he has done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 今天，塞德里克·黎颂将因自己的所作所为走上绞刑架。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Arthur, take it away.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（亚瑟，交给你了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Dude we've done an adventure already, you know how to do this, lol. IMPROV, BABY. GO.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（老兄，我们之前已经玩过一次冒险了，你知道该怎么做，哈哈。即兴发挥，宝贝。开始吧。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((fiiine, let me throw you a bone.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好好好，那我就给你点提示吧。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric Dawnsong, the mighty Paladin, stands upon the gallows, the noose already around his neck. Stripped of his weapons and armor, he still makes for an impressive figure, his head held high. There is more to this man than his armaments, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 强大的圣骑士塞德里克·黎颂伫立在绞刑架上，绞索已套在他的脖子上。尽管被剥夺了武器和盔甲，他依然气宇轩昂，昂首挺胸。毕竟，这个人的厉害之处，从来不是来自他的武器装备。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: His hands are bound behind his back. And though the crowd cheers for his death, he is certain that the actions he took to get there were righteous. For he has never faltered in his morals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他的双手被反绑在背后。尽管人群为他即将到来的死亡而欢呼，但他确信自己为走到这一步所做的一切都是正义的。因为他从未动摇过自己的道德准则。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((arthuurr now's the time to do the, y'know, whole roleplaying bit))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（亚瑟，现在是时候来那个，你懂的，角色扮演环节了））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((sol in a sandwich...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我的妈呀……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((nothing!! nothing. okay, you wanna try to escape? are you trying to wriggle out of the ropes or break them with brute strength?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（没事！！没事。好吧，你想逃吗？你是想从绳索中扭出来，还是想靠蛮力把它们扯断？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((oooookaay. give me a dexterity check, with disadvantage. so roll two d20's. lowest number is the one we keep))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好吧。来个敏捷检定，处于不利状态。所以掷两颗 d20，取较低的那个数值））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((oooookaay. give me a strength check, with disadvantage. so roll two d20's. lowest number is the one we keep))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好吧。来个力量检定，处于不利状态。所以掷两颗 d20，取较低的那个数值））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((nonono it's fine, we're not gonna kill him in the first two seconds guys))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（不不不没关系，大家放心，我们不会在前两秒就干掉他的））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric tries to escape as best he can, but it is hopeless. A pathetic attempt, really. The ropes at his wrists are tied too well. The guards expected a paladin might try such easily predictable tactics.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克竭尽全力试图逃脱，但这根本是徒劳。说实话，这简直是可悲的尝试。绑在他手腕上的绳索系得太紧了。守卫们早就料到圣骑士会使用这种容易预料的伎俩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He is left to wonder. Loudly. To himself. LOUDLY TO HIMSELF. What might have gotten himself into SUCH A MESS IN THE FIRST PLACE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他只能自问。大声地。自言自语。大声地自言自语。究竟是什么原因，究竟是什么让他陷入了如此困境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((daaang, arthur))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（天啊，亚瑟））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((extremely! i didn't know you had that in you man))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（太厉害了！没想到你还有这本事，老兄））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((braaaaackets))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（括号括号加括号））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((yeah, yeah, lol. anyway))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（是啦是啦，哈哈。总而言之））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The guards glance at each other nervously. All is not well in the land of Höllvandeim. And perhaps nothing is a bigger symptom of that, than the fact that the Regents sentenced a Paladin of the Holy Order of Light to death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 守卫们紧张地互相对视。霍凡德姆这片土地局势并不乐观。或许没有什么比这更能说明问题的了，摄政王们竟将一名圣光骑士团的圣骑士判处死刑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And all over accusations of committing a murder that he has no memory of doing. But there were witnesses that saw him stagger out of the room of the inn that night, covered in the blood of the victim, muttering incoherent words to himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 而这一切都源于一桩谋杀指控，他对此毫无记忆。但当时有目击者看到，那晚他踉踉跄跄地走出旅馆房间，浑身沾满受害者的鲜血，嘴里喃喃自语着语无伦次的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Some of those witnesses are in the audience this very moment. Five of them, in fact. Five witnesses who, for various reasons, might either believe that Cedric Dawnsong is innocent of the murder - or might simply want to keep him alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 此刻，其中一些证人就坐在观众席上。实际上共有五位。这五位证人出于各种原因，可能相信塞德里克·黎颂是清白的——也可能仅仅是想让他活下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: That is when a tall, white-haired elf steps forward on the platform of the gallows. He is clothed in the bright, gold and white robes of a magistrate of Höllvandeim. Slowly, as though this were the most boring day in his life, he unrolls a large scroll in his hands and stares down at it over golden glasses that perch on the bridge of his nose. "I, Sir Lyodivian of the Royal House of Ent'r'dei, hereby entrusted to represent the interests of the Royal House Ent'r'dei, the Most Holy and Respected Mother..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就在这时，一位身材高挑、满头白发的精灵走上绞刑台的台阶。他身着霍凡德姆法官那亮眼的白金双色长袍。仿佛这正是他一生中最无聊的一天，他缓缓地打开了手中的巨幅卷轴，透过架在鼻梁上的金边眼镜，凝视着卷轴。"我，恩特蒂王室的莱奥迪维安爵士，特此受托代表恩特蒂王室的利益，以及至圣至尊的‘母亲'……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As he is droning on, reading out the list of the honorable titles of the Honorable Ruling Family of Höllvandeim, you all have a moment to react.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当他喋喋不休地念着霍凡德姆尊贵统治家族的尊贵头衔清单时，你们都有片刻时间来做出反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((iiii prefer to call it "riffing" not "ripping" and hey look i'm just workin' with what i got to work with here it's not like i can get any OTHER new material when we're stuck in this freakin' TIME. LOOP. NOW CAN I?!?!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我更愿意称之为"即兴发挥"，而不是"抄袭"。嘿，你看，我只是在利用手头现有的素材，毕竟我们被困在这个该死的时间循环里，我又不可能弄到其他新素材，对吧？！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for sneaking. Let's find out how well you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰子进行潜行检定。来看看你的表现如何。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((YOU BET YER BIPPY IT IS))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（那还用说，绝对是））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((ANYWAY lets roll some dice))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（总之，我们掷骰子吧））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Don't forget you're playing a Thief Rogue so you roll with advantage, so do /roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 别忘了你扮演的是一个游荡者，所以掷骰时有优势，请执行 /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((if Lord Reyland Kingsacre is planning to do what I think he's planning on doing... you know muskets aren't rifled, right, Q?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（如果雷兰·金斯克雷勋爵真的打算做我想的那件事……你知道火枪是没有膛线的，对吧，昆？))

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((STRAP IN, SPACE COWBOY))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（系好安全带，太空牛仔们））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((don't forget you're playing a Thief Rogue so you'd roll with advantage, too))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（别忘了你扮演的是一个游荡者，所以掷骰时有优势））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((no lol what i'm saying is that the spirally bit inside a rifle wasn't invented yet. that's the bit that makes a bullet go straight))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（不是枪膛，是膛线哈哈，我的意思是枪内部的螺旋槽当时还没发明出来。那个能让子弹笔直飞行的结构））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((we here to roll dice or what?!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我们还要不要掷骰子？！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sneaking through a crowd is what you've trained for. And though it's broad daylight, this place is full of distractions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你接受过专门训练，擅长潜入人群。虽然现在是光天化日之下，但这里到处都有可以用来干扰视线的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You get within about five feet of the platform. You do a pretty decent job of sneaking around the guards, but the problem is, it's broad daylight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你离行刑台大约只有五英尺远。你成功地躲过了守卫的视线，但问题是，现在可是大白天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As a wizard, you can get pretty far. You're able to get within about five feet of the platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 作为一名法师，你的行动范围相当广。你能去到离行刑台约五英尺远的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wearing armor, sneaking really isn't your thing. But you're able to get within about five feet of the platform before the guards start to give you looks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 身穿盔甲，潜行确实不是你的强项。不过，在你距离行刑台约五英尺时，守卫才开始对你投来异样的目光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((yeah muskets were terrible guns they made better stabbing weapons with bayonets on them they never shot what you pointed them at lol))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（对啊，火枪真是糟糕透顶的武器，装上刺刀后反而成了更好的刺杀武器，它们根本打不中你瞄准的地方，哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You move easily through the masses like a fish through... a group of...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​自如​地穿​梭于​人群​之​中，​就​像​……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And you, my friend, look like a ruffian and a cut-throat. Which you are. So it's accurate. So you have to stay where you're at.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 至于你，老兄，看起来就像个流氓和杀人犯。而你确实就是这样的人。所以这形容很贴切。因此，你得老老实实待在原地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The guards and nobles recognize you as someone who is at least of "learned society" and probably paid for a front row seat, so they don't pay you much mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 守卫和贵族们认出你至少是"有学问的人"，而且很可能花钱买了前排座位，所以他们没怎么理会你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But, dressed as a knight, they probably all assume that you're the bodyguard of someone who paid for the good seats, so they all leave you to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不过，既然你穿着一身骑士装束，大家八成都以为你是哪位买了好座位的人的保镖，所以都会由着你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Other... fish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ……​一​条​游动于​其他​鱼​之间​的​鱼。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((because you named it "the Nobleizer" idk it sounded cool!!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（因为你把它命名为"升爵者"，我也不知道，听起来很酷！！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You're able to get right up next to the gallows, standing right next to the guard leading up to the stairs going to the platform, and the area underneath where the men are waiting to gather up the body once the deed is done and the twitching is over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你直接走到了绞刑架旁边，站在通往行刑台的台阶旁，紧挨着守卫；你站在下方区域，那里有几个人正等着在行刑结束、尸体停止抽搐后前来收尸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Now you're left to wait for the right moment... and to see what the others might do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 现在你只能等待合适的时机……并看看其他人会怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((i stand corrected, and argument gladly accepted! 'n this is how we all learn something new, kids))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我​接受​指正，​也​乐意​接受​讨论！​孩子们，​这​就​是​大家​一起​学习​新​东西​的​办法））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((but if you ARE gonna do what you're trying to do, it's gonna take at least a DC of 18))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（但如果你真要这么做，至少需要 18 点难度点数））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Eeey first spell cast!!! For those who've never played a Ranger in F&F, "Longshot" is a level 3 spell that lets you set up for 2 turns and then roll an attack with three dice, so double advantage.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哇哦，第一个施放的法术！！！对于那些从来没有在寓言与边疆中扮演过游侠的玩家来说，"远射"是一个 3 级法术，它允许你准备 2 回合，然后用三颗骰子进行攻击检定，因此能获得双倍优势。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And what brings our Lord Kingsacre to the hanging this morning?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 那么，是什么原因让雷兰·金斯克雷勋爵今天早上来到绞刑场呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Who's up next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 下一个是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((lmao drunken barbarian in the crowd what could possibly go wrong aoi))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（笑死，人群里有个醉醺醺的野蛮人，碧，还能出什么幺蛾子啊））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((i say go with it))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（要我说就这样干吧））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((hey remember i always give bonus points for being in character lol))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嘿，别忘了，我总是会给入戏的玩家加分，哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Have you been to the city before?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你以前去过城里吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LOL perfect. who's up))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哈哈，简直完美。谁想来？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((... dramatic...))
((pfffhh... okiedokie, points for character accuracy))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（噗……好吧，给你的角色还原度加分））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "...hereby sentence you to death for the murder of the Princess N'a't'a'h." Sir Lyodivian rolls the large scroll back up as he finally, finally finishes his speech.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "……现判处你死刑，罪名是谋杀娜塔公主。"莱奥迪维安爵士终于、终于结束了他的陈词，随即把那卷巨大的卷轴卷了起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((ok drifter you're up))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好了，漂泊者，轮到你了））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He turns toward the hangman, who places his hand upon the lever that will open the trap door beneath Cedric...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他转向刽子手，刽子手正将手按在那个将打开塞德里克脚下活板门的杠杆上……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: When suddenly, for just the barest and most imperceptible of a fraction of a second... time seems almost - *almost* - to stop. The birds stop chirping. The leaves in the trees stop rustling. The children stop laughing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就在那一瞬间，仅仅是极短暂、几乎难以察觉的一瞬间……时间似乎几乎——*几乎*——停止了。鸟儿停止了鸣叫。树叶不再沙沙作响。孩子们停止了欢笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for sneaking, let's find out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰子进行潜行检定，看看结果如何。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But like a skip of a heartbeat, it's gone. It's over. And you think to yourself, did I imagine that? Was that just a simple trick of the mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但就像心跳漏了一拍，那一刻转瞬即逝。一切都结束了。你不禁暗自思忖，那是我的幻象吗？那只是大脑的错觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You're about to write it all off as just adrenaline of the moment until... blood begins to pour from the neck of the hangman. Slit from ear to ear, a waterfall of crimson begins to spout from him as he collapses to his knees.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你正准备把这一切都归咎于一时的肾上腺素飙升，直到……刽子手的脖子开始涌出鲜血。切口几乎从他的一只耳根贯穿到另一个，当他瘫倒在地时，一股鲜红的血流如瀑布般从他身上喷涌而出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Don't forget you're playing a Thief Rogue so you roll with advantage, so do /roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 别忘了你扮演的是一个游荡者，所以掷骰时有优势，请执行 /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Horrified, Sir Lyodivian screams. "Guards! Seize the prisoner!" The rich and powerful who had come to watch an execution are now clambering for safety. The common folk for an exit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 莱奥迪维安爵士惊恐地尖叫起来："守卫！抓住那个囚犯！"那些前来观看行刑的权贵们此刻正争先恐后地逃命，而平民百姓则争相寻找出口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The courtyard quickly devolves into chaos.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 庭院很快陷入一片混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Everyone! Roll for initiative! We're using simplified rules so just raw numbers, no modifiers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 大家注意了！掷骰决定回合先手！我们采用简化规则，所以只看骰子点数，不加任何修正值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sneaking through a crowd is what you've trained for. And though it's broad daylight, this place is full of distractions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你接受过专门训练，擅长潜入人群。虽然现在是光天化日之下，但这里到处都有可以用来干扰视线的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You get within about ten feet of the platform. You do a pretty decent job of sneaking around the guards, but the problem is, it's broad daylight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你离行刑台大约只有十英尺远。你成功地躲过了守卫的视线，但问题是，现在可是大白天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As a wizard, you can get pretty far. You're able to get within about ten feet of the platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 作为一名法师，你的行动范围相当广。你能去到离行刑台约十英尺远的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wearing armor, sneaking really isn't your thing. But you're able to get within about ten feet of the platform before the guards start to give you looks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 身穿盔甲，潜行确实不是你的强项。不过，在你距离行刑台约十英尺时，守卫才开始对你投来异样的目光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You move easily through the masses like a fish through... a group of...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​自如​地穿​梭于​人群​之​中，​就​像​……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And you, my friend, look like a ruffian and a cut-throat. Which you are. So it's accurate. So you have to stay where you're at.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 至于你，老兄，看起来就像个流氓和杀人犯。而你确实就是这样的人。所以这形容很贴切。因此，你得老老实实待在原地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The guards and nobles recognize you as someone who is at least of "learned society" and probably paid for a front row seat, so they don't pay you much mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 守卫和贵族们认出你至少是"有学问的人"，而且很可能花钱买了前排座位，所以他们没怎么理会你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But, dressed as a knight, they probably all assume that you're the bodyguard of someone who paid for the good seats, so they all leave you to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不过，既然你穿着一身骑士装束，大家八成都以为你是哪位买了好座位的人的保镖，所以都会由着你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((FIRST NAT 20!!!))
Other... fish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ……​一​条​游动于​其他​鱼​之间​的​鱼。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You're able to get right up next to the gallows, standing right next to the guard leading up to the stairs going to the platform, and the area underneath where the men are waiting to gather up the body once the deed is done and the twitching is over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你直接走到了绞刑架旁边，站在通往行刑台的台阶旁，紧挨着守卫；你站在下方区域，那里有几个人正等着在行刑结束、尸体停止抽搐后前来收尸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It's good timing, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 时机也恰到好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((nah I'll make it worth something))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（没事，我会让它变得有价值的））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((ok one sec...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好的，稍等一下……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As the crowd clears away, leaving only you six and the guards, Wanderer, what do you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 人群散去，只剩下你们六个人和守卫，流浪者，你会做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: There is a guard standing point at the bottom of the stairs, and another at the top. But you've caught them entirely by surprise, and in all the chaos, you manage to push past the first one and get to the top of the platform before the second has the presence of mind to draw his sword.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 楼梯底部和顶部各有一名守卫。但你完全出其不意地袭击了他们，在混乱之中，你成功冲过第一名守卫，并在第二名守卫反应过来拔剑之前，率先冲到了行刑台上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: There is a guard standing at the bottom of the stairs and another one at the top. But you manage to blow past the one at the bottom, and you're not even sure he saw you. The one at the top, however, does see you. You don't have long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 楼梯底部站着一名守卫，顶部也站着一名。但你设法从底部的那个身边溜了过去，甚至不确定他是否看见了你。然而，顶部的那个确实看见了你。你时间不多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Do you cut the ropes from his hands free or take the noose off his neck?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你是先割断他手上的绳子，还是先解开他脖子上的绞索？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The guard will be able to attack you if you do that. Are you sure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如果你这么做，守卫就会攻击你。你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll with your Dex modifier of +3!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 使用你的敏捷调整值 +3 掷骰！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll with your Dex modifier of +3!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 使用你的敏捷调整值 +3 掷骰！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for attack! You have a +5.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰进行攻击检定！你有 +5 修正值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for attack! You have a +5.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰进行攻击检定！你有 +5 修正值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hey, maybe he's paying his way to Fantasy College! He has to do a wisdom saving throw for that, which is... +0, against your... challenge number of 12. so let's see how he does! Remember, he knows you're attacking, so he gets to roll with advantage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嘿，说不定他正自费去上奇幻学院呢！为此他得进行一次智慧豁免检定，检定值为……+0，对抗你的……挑战数值 12。那就来看看他表现如何吧！记住，他知道你要攻击，因此他掷骰时享有优势。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for damage - three d4's.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰决定伤害值——掷三个 d4。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for attack! You have a +5.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰进行攻击检定！你有 +5 修正值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you run by him, the guard swings his sword at you. He has a +3 to attack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你从他身旁跑过时，守卫挥剑向你劈来。他的攻击检定获得 +3 加值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 16! Deftly, you manage to cut the rope from between Cedric's wrists without nicking him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 16！你灵巧地将塞德里克手腕间的绳子割断，却没有划伤他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 19! You pull the noose from around Cedric's neck, and at least that threat is over. But his hands are... still bound uselessly behind his back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 19！你解开了套在塞德里克脖子上的绞索，至少这个威胁解除了。但他的双手……依然无助地被绑在背后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He blinks, rubs his eyes, and looks up at you with a furrowed brow of confusion. "Jerry? What're you doing here?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他眨了眨眼，揉了揉眼睛，皱着眉头一脸困惑地抬头看着你。"杰瑞？你怎么在这儿？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 8! He groans and staggers backwards. The flash of the Enchanted Projectiles blinded him in the bright sunlight, and the force of the blow was enough to send him too close to the edge of the platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 8！他呻吟着向后踉跄。在刺眼的阳光下，魔化飞弹的闪光令他目眩，而这一击的冲击力之大，甚至将他震到了行刑台边缘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Just in time to see the second soldier draw his sword to face you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 刚好赶上看到第二个士兵拔剑与你对峙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Whoa!" He slips. Tips backwards. And falls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "哇啊！"他脚下一滑，身体向后倾斜，随即摔倒在地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He hits you, the blade gouging through the leather armor and biting into flesh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他击中了你，刀刃划破皮甲，深深刺入血肉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But in all the suddenness of the chaos, his attack wooshes past you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但在这突如其来的混乱中，他的攻击呼啸着从你身旁掠过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: His sword bounces uselessly off your armor with a *ting* as you rush past him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你从他身旁冲过时，他的剑"叮"地一声无力地弹开，没能刺穿你的盔甲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He hits you. The sword digs deep into your flesh as it cuts easily through your wizardly robes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他击中了你。剑刃轻易地划开你的法师长袍，深深刺入你的血肉之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric, your hands are free, but the noose is still around your neck. You have no armor. No sword. What do you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克，你的双手虽然是自由的，但绞索依然套在你的脖子上。你没有盔甲，也没有剑。你会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Just in time to see the second soldier draw his sword to face you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 刚好赶上看到第二个士兵拔剑与你对峙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Looking around, he nods. "You're right. I. I got a wife and kids. I can't be dying out here. Not like this. Not for something that feels so... so wrong." Without further ado, he leaves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他环顾四周，点了点头。"你说得对。我……我有妻子和孩子。我不能死在这里。不能这样死。不能为了这种感觉如此……如此错误的事而死。"说完，他便径直离开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: THUD.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 砰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Your daggers do 1d4+5 each, so... this ain't gonna be good for him no matter what you roll. Take it away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的匕首每把造成 1d4+5 点伤害，所以……不管你掷出什么点数，对他来说都不妙。开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d6
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d6

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You go over to Cedric and free him. Do you cut the ropes from his hands or take the noose off his neck?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你找到了塞德里克，解放了他。你是先割断他手上的绳子，还是先解开他脖子上的绞索？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric, you now find yourself free from the noose, but your hands are still bound behind your back. You have no armor. No sword. What do you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克，你现在虽然挣脱了绞索，但双手仍被反绑在身后。你身无铠甲，手无寸铁。你该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 12! The guard looks down at his chest as you run him clean through with your two-handed sword. He coughs. A line of blood trickles down from the corner of his mouth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 12！当你用双手剑将他一剑贯穿时，那名守卫低头看着自己的胸口。他咳嗽了一声，一缕鲜血从嘴角流了下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 8. The guard shouts in pain and staggers backwards as you gouge deep into his side, finding a gap in his armor with the edge of your blade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 8。当你用刀刃的边缘深深刺入他盔甲上的破绽时，那名守卫痛得大叫，踉跄着向后退去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't think that guard will be causing you any more problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我觉得那个守卫不会再给你添麻烦了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'll let that be your bonus action. What next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就把这当作你的额外奖励行动吧。接下来呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you pull the blade from out of him, he takes a weak, shocked, fading step backward. Followed by another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你将刀刃从他身上拔出时，他虚弱而震惊地向后退了一步，脚步渐弱。紧接着又退了一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As he staggers backwards, his last step finds open air as he teeters off the edge of the gallows platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他踉跄着向后退去，最后一步踏空，身体摇摇晃晃地从行刑台边缘跌落。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And the last step finds open air as he teeters off the edge of the gallows platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 随着最后一步踏空，他的身体摇摇晃晃地从行刑台边缘跌落。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It's Cedric's turn. For what it's worth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 该塞德里克的轮次了。这么说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: LATER.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 等​会儿。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 15. He coughs. A line of blood trickles down from the corner of his mouth. As you rip your daggers from his stomach, he takes a weak, shocked, fading step backward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 15。他咳嗽着。一缕鲜血从他嘴角流下。当你将匕首从他腹中拔出时，他虚弱而惊惶地向后退了一步，脚步渐弱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Luckily, apparently this idiot guard forgot to sharpen his sword today... or... something...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 幸好，看来这个蠢货守卫今天忘了磨剑……或者……别的什么的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll away. 1d8.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰子。1d8。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He furrows his brow in confusion. Your blades were so small. So thin. This seems impossible to him. His last step back finds empty air. He teeters for a moment off the edge of the gallows platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他困惑地皱起眉头。你的刀刃那么小，那么薄。这在他看来简直难以置信。他最后退后一步，脚下却踏空了。他悬在绞刑台边缘摇晃了片刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wh.. ell. Okay then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 呃……好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((You could roll to try to escape again, but without your hands free, you can't really cast spells as a Paladin...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你可以再次掷骰尝试逃脱，但双手被束缚的话，作为圣骑士，你其实无法施法……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Let's go with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就当是这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Go ahead and give me an unarmed attack roll.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 请给我进行一次徒手攻击检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He shouts in pain, grabbing his face as the sudden blast of light combined with the light of Sol blinds him. That, combined with the pain of the blow sends him staggering backwards.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他痛得大叫一声，捂住脸——那道突如其来的强光与太阳的光芒交织在一起，令他目眩。这股强光加上被击中的剧痛，使他踉跄着向后退去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Y'know what? Fuggit. I'll let you do it with advantage. You're feeling Heroic.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你知道吗？算了。我就让你带着优势来吧。现在你很勇。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Shrugging off the minor paper cut, you go over to Cedric and free him. Do you cut the ropes from his hands free or take the noose off his neck?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你无视那道微不足道的纸割伤，走向塞德里克并解救了他。你是先割断绑在他手上的绳子，还是先解开套在他脖子上的绞索？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As he staggers backwards, his last step finds open air as he teeters off the edge of the gallows platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他踉跄着向后退去，最后一步踏空，身体摇摇晃晃地从绞刑台边缘跌落。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: THUD.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 砰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((What? Why? It's not a real enchanted sword, I just made it up.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（什么？为什么？这又不是真正的魔法剑，我只是编出来的。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't think that guard will be causing you any more problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我觉得那个守卫不会再给你添麻烦了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A. Yep. Okay. Okay then!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯。好的。那好吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You drop your shoulder and charge at the guard. As you do, you don't see it, but his eyes  go wide in shock. You do hear him go "HURRMNF" as your shoulder hits him in the gut.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你耸起肩膀，朝那名守卫冲去。就在这时，虽然你没看到，但他因震惊而瞪大了眼睛。当你的肩膀撞上他的腹部时，你确实听见他发出一声"呃——"的闷哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Your strength bonus is +4? So... a dirty 21. Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的力量加值是 +4？那 21……真脏啊。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((i... ooookay.)) Tell us how you attack the guard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我……好……好吧。））告诉我们你是怎么攻击那个守卫的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Just as you think you can breathe, you hear more shouting as the other guards start to gather their wits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 正当你以为可以松一口气时，又传来一阵喊叫声——其他守卫开始回过神来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Even through the half plate armor, you feel him crumple around you as you push him over the edge of the platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 即使隔着半身铠甲，当你把他推下刑台边缘时，也能感觉到他瘫软在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: With a roar, you feel as the fibers of the rope begin to rip, stretch, and finally, like the ligaments of a corpse, give up its last gasp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 随着一声怒吼，你感觉到绳索的纤维开始撕裂、拉伸，最后像尸体上的韧带一样，发出最后的呻吟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Three of them, lead by the Captain of the Guard, are the only ones brave enough to stop you. Everyone else has cleared out, it seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 其中三人，由卫队长率领，是唯一有胆量阻止你的人。看来其他人已经全都撤走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You both fall, with him beneath you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们两人一起坠落，他被你压在身下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Your hands are free!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的双手解放了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ixchel, it is your turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 伊克塞尔，轮到你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The guard takes 4 damage from the unarmed strike. And...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 守卫因徒手攻击受到 4 点伤害。而且……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for attack! You have a +5.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰进行攻击检定！你有 +5 修正值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for attack! You have a +4.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰进行攻击检定！你有 +4 的修正值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for attack! You have a +4.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰进行攻击检定！你有 +4 的修正值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hey, maybe he's paying his way to Fantasy College! He has to do a wisdom saving throw for that, which is... +0, against your... challenge number of 12. so let's see how he does! Remember, he knows you're attacking, so he gets to roll with advantage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嘿，说不定他正自费去上奇幻学院呢！为此他得进行一次智慧豁免检定，检定值为……+0，对抗你的……挑战数值 12。那就来看看他表现如何吧！记住，他知道你要攻击，因此他掷骰时享有优势。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for damage - three d4's.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰决定伤害值——掷三个 d4。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d10
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d10

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fantastic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Correct!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 正确！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: LOL. 8 damage from the fall. Arthur, since the poor bastard broke your fall, roll a d6 to see how many hit points you lose from the 10-foot fall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哈哈。坠落造成 8 点伤害。亚瑟，既然那个倒霉鬼帮你缓冲了坠落，掷一枚 d6 骰子，看看从 10 英尺高处坠落会损失多少生命值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He blinks, rubs his eyes, and looks up at you with a furrowed brow of confusion. "Jerry? What're you doing here?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他眨了眨眼，揉了揉眼睛，皱着眉头一脸困惑地抬头看着你。"杰瑞？你怎么在这儿？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 8! He groans and staggers backwards. The flash of the Enchanted Projectiles blinded him in the bright sunlight, and the force of the blow was enough to send him too close to the edge of the platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 8！他呻吟着向后踉跄。在刺眼的阳光下，魔化飞弹的闪光令他目眩，而这一击的冲击力之大，甚至将他震到了行刑台边缘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Whoa!" He slips. Tips backwards. And falls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "哇啊！"他脚下一滑，身体向后倾斜，随即摔倒在地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Your daggers do 1d4+5 each, so... this ain't gonna be good for him no matter what you roll. Take it away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的匕首每把造成 1d4+5 点伤害，所以……不管你掷出什么点数，对他来说都不妙。开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Looking around, he nods. "You're right. I. I got a wife and kids. I can't be dying out here. Not like this. Not for something that feels so... so wrong." Without further ado, he leaves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他环顾四周，点了点头。"你说得对。我……我有妻子和孩子。我不能死在这里。不能这样死。不能为了这种感觉如此……如此错误的事而死。"说完，他便径直离开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Looking down at his sword he laughs. "Oh, shit. Yeah, this thing wouldn't harm a fly! Here." He gives it to you. "Thanks!" Without further ado, he leaves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他低头看看自己的剑，笑了起来。"哦，靠。是啊，这玩意儿连只苍蝇都伤不了！来。"他把剑递给你。"谢谢！"他没多说什么，便离开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: THUD.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 砰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((OMFL. LETTIE.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我了个去。莱蒂。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You groan as you land on top of him, and you know you're going to be bruised in the morning. But you made off far better than the poor son of a bitch who just showed up to work that day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你呻吟着跌落在他身上，心里清楚明天早上身上肯定会青一块紫一块。但比起那个当天刚来上班的可怜混蛋，你的下场已经好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 11! The guard looks down at his chest as you run him clean through with your two-handed sword. He coughs. A line of blood trickles down from the corner of his mouth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 11！当你用双手剑将他一剑贯穿时，那名守卫低头看着自己的胸口。他咳嗽了一声，一缕鲜血从嘴角流了下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 7. The guard shouts in pain and staggers backwards as you gouge deep into his side, finding a gap in his armor with the edge of your blade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 7。当你用刀刃的边缘深深刺入他盔甲上的破绽时，那名守卫痛得大叫，踉跄着向后退去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't think that guard will be causing you any more problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我觉得那个守卫不会再给你添麻烦了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Blood is pooling from the back of his head. His eyes are open. Sightlessly gazing at the sky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 鲜血正从他后脑勺流出来。他的眼睛睁着，目光空洞地望着天空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you pull the blade from out of him, he takes a weak, shocked, fading step backward. Another step.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你将刀刃从他身上拔出时，他虚弱而震惊地向后退了一步，脚步渐弱。紧接着又退了一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As he staggers backwards, his last step finds open air as he teeters off the edge of the gallows platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他踉跄着向后退去，最后一步踏空，身体摇摇晃晃地从绞刑台边缘跌落。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((HOLY. SHIT. WOMAN.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我。靠。这女人。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 15. He coughs. A line of blood trickles down from the corner of his mouth. As you rip your daggers from his stomach, he takes a weak, shocked, fading step backward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 15。他咳嗽着。一缕鲜血从他嘴角流下。当你将匕首从他腹中拔出时，他虚弱而惊惶地向后退了一步，脚步渐弱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: LATER.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 等​会儿。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((fkin THE ONE CLOSEST TO YOU IS THE CAPTAIN OF THE FREAKIN' GUARD, LETTIE.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（艹，离你最近的那个人竟然是该死卫队的队长，莱蒂。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He furrows his brow in confusion. Your blades were so small. So thin. This seems impossible to him. His last step back finds empty air. He teeters for a moment off the edge of the gallows platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他困惑地皱起眉头。你的刀刃那么小，那么薄。这在他看来简直难以置信。他最后退后一步，脚下却踏空了。他悬在绞刑台边缘摇晃了片刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((are you kidding me this is is what I LIVE FOR))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你在开什么玩笑？我活着就是为了这个））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((play it out tell us what happens))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（往下演，告诉我们会发生什么））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((nope he ded.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（不，他挂了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((he just ded.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（他就这么挂了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((u bit, he ded))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你咬了他，他挂了））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The adrenaline coursing through his veins is both a blessing and a curse for the Captain of the Guard. So was the heart condition that he did not know he had, that was going to end him some day in the future, though who would say when that day might come.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 肾上腺素在他的血管内奔涌，对这位卫队长而言既是福也是祸。他那未曾察觉的心脏病也是如此，这病总有一天会要了他的命，尽管谁也说不准那一天何时会到来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It didn't matter now, because both of those things were the reason why Ixchel's venom coursed through him faster than he could feel. It was a painless death. He blinked once. Twice. Shut his eyes a third time... and slumped to the ground.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 现在这都不重要了，因为正是这两件事导致伊克塞尔的毒液在他体内迅速蔓延，他甚至来不及察觉。这是一场无痛的死亡。他眨了眨眼。又眨了眨眼。第三次闭上眼睛……然后瘫倒在地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A clatter of heavy armor and weaponry as the venerated soldier, the noble hero of many a valiant fight, was brought low in one single moment by a single serpent's bite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 沉重的盔甲和武器碰撞作响，这位受人尊敬的士兵，诸多英勇战斗中的英雄，在一瞬间被一条毒蛇咬倒在地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And just as Ixchel predicted, the other three soldiers, seeing the unnaturally winged serpent with its brightly colored scales and feather-petal wings slowly uncurling from the dead body of their fearless commander -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 正如伊克塞尔预料的那样，其他三名士兵看到那条长着不寻常翅膀、鳞片色彩斑斓、长着羽毛状花瓣翅膀的巨蛇，正缓缓地从他们英勇无畏的指挥官的尸体上展开——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Quickly turn tail and run for the gates to the courtyard, screaming for reinforcements.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掉头就跑，朝庭院的大门狂奔而去，尖叫着呼叫援军。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((congratulations guys, you won!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（恭喜大家，你们赢了！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((not my fault lettie here ganked the captain of the freakin' guard lol))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这可不怪我，是莱蒂把那个该死的卫队长给秒了，哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((don't worryyy you'll all share the xp and the loot 'n you'll get to do cool shit next time i promise))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（别担心，经验值和战利品大家都会分到的，下次你们也能干些酷炫的事——我保证））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hey! Hey, all of you! This way!" Someone shouts from the other side of the courtyard. "Quickly!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "喂！喂，大家！这边！"庭院另一头有人喊道。"快点！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you move closer to investigate, you see someone cloaked in black, standing near a small wooden door that leads deeper into the walled city. He is wearing all black, with deep purple highlights stitched into the edges of his clothes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你走近查看，发现一个身披黑袍的人站在一扇通往城墙深处的小木门旁。他全身黑色，衣边缝着深紫色的饰边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: On the unfortunate lone guard, you find nothing of interest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在那名倒霉的孤身守卫身上，你没发现什么有价值的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: On the unfortunate lone guard, you find a strange sword with a marking on the pommel that looks like... butter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在那名倒霉的孤身守卫身上，你发现了一把奇怪的剑，剑柄上有一处标记，看起来像……黄油？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You can't make much else out for his features, as he is standing entirely shrouded in the shadows of the doorway. "I work for a friend. The same friend who arranged the executioner's... accident. The way out of the city is clear. You'll find more answers once you reach the woods."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他完全隐没在门口的阴影里，你几乎看不清他的其他五官。"我为一个朋友工作。就是那个安排刽子手出……意外的朋友。出城的路很畅通。到了树林里，你就会找到更多答案。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: On the dead Captain of the Guard, you find a set of keys on a brass ring, and his papers notating who he is that would allow him passage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在死去的卫队长身上，你发现了一串黄铜环上的钥匙，以及能证明他身份、从而允许他通行的重要文件。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He turns into the corridor that leads into the stone building, and as you peer in to try to see where he went? He's gone. Simply... gone. There's a loud noise of shouting behind you. The reinforcements have arrived. At least twenty soldiers or more are pouring into the courtyard. What do you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他转进了通往那座石砌建筑的走廊，当你探头张望，试图看清他去了哪里时……他已经不见了。就这么……消失了。身后传来一阵喧嚷声。增援部队到了。至少有二十名士兵，甚至更多，正涌进庭院。你会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You descend into the depths of the Dominion of Höllvandeim, and the smell of moisture and dampness hits your nose... you turn a corner, and another, and another, and the sounds of the rabble and the guards dies away behind you. Torches, recently lit, line the walls, showing you the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你深入霍尔万德姆领地的深处，一股潮湿的气息扑鼻而来……你转过一个拐角，又一个，再一个，身后暴民和守卫的喧嚣声渐渐远去。墙边排列着刚点燃的火把，为你照亮前路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Whoever pulled strings to coordinate your escape, they knew what they were doing... this was all carefully orchestrated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 无论是谁在幕后操纵你逃脱，他们显然知道自己在做什么……这一切都是精心策划的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You pull up short suddenly as you arrive in a large chamber that empties out into a waterway on the outside of the city. You can see daylight again. There, sitting on a rock, neatly tied up with a purple bow - a literal bow - is all of Cedric's personal affects.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你来到一个通向城外水道的大房间时，突然停下了脚步。你再次看见了阳光。在那里，塞德里克的所有私人物品都整齐地堆放在一块岩石上，用一条紫色的蝴蝶结——字面意义上的蝴蝶结——系得整整齐齐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And on it, sits a scroll. With the seal... of the Royal Family of Höllvandeim.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 上面放着一卷卷轴。上面印着……霍凡德姆王室的印章。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But we'll have to learn more about what it says tomorrow, on Day Two of the adventure!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不过，关于它上面写了什么，我们得等到明天，这场冒险的第二天，才能进一步了解！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((PHEW. whaddadoozy. sorry to rush it at the end there, these things are always running long! i'll save my giant swamp rat encounter for another time oh yeah i guess we can ditch the brackets now lol))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（呼。真是够呛。抱歉最后写得有点仓促，这种东西总是写得特别长！遇到巨型沼泽鼠的经历就留到下次再说吧。哦对了，我想现在可以把括号去掉了，哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: you willllll i'm sorrryyyy i didn't expect lettie to one-shot the boss!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你会的……对不起……我没想到莱蒂居然一招就干掉了 boss！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: THANKS i hope other people really enjoy it and they aren't just saying so. i know these sessions can get loooooooooooooong
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 谢谢，希望其他人真的能喜欢，而不仅仅是客套。我知道这些跑团可能会拖得超超超长

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: aw, you're welcome! and yeah, but it's fun. i hope other people really enjoy it and they aren't just saying so. i know these sessions can get loooooooooooooong
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 啊，不客气！是啊，真的挺有趣。希望其他人真的能喜欢，而不仅仅是客套。我知道这些跑团可能会拖得超长长长

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: but it's like one of the few ways i can like... i don't know, break up the insanity? y'know? make everything make sense? don't know how to describe it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但这就像是我为数不多的几种方法之一，可以……我不知道，打破这种疯狂？你知道吗？让一切都变得有意义？我不知道该怎么形容

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: anywhoozle, wasted enough of your time, you should go shoot things in the head in the far future or something
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不管怎么说，已经浪费你够多时间了，你还是去遥远的未来爆爆头什么的吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: i have tomorrow's adventure to plan!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我计划一下明天的冒险之旅！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He points the glowing Key Emblem at your face and it lets off a horrifying "BREEEEEE" and you are blinded by a beam of light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他将发光的钥匙徽章对准你的脸，徽章发出令人毛骨悚然的一声"嘶——"，一道强光让你瞬间失明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Youch. Go ahead and type /hp -6 for me?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（呦。帮我输入一下 /hp -6 好吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（呦。帮我输入一下 /hp -6 好吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "My brothers, did I not tell of this day? Did I not prophesize this moment? Now, I will stop them! Now I am changed, reborn through the energy of the Bmmfmfmmfhm-" You can't really hear the rest, muffled from inside your bag.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "兄弟们，我不是早就预言过这一天了吗？我不是早就预言过这一刻了吗？现在，我要阻止他们！现在我已经蜕变了，借着——呜姆呜姆呜——的力量重生了——"剩下的话听不太清楚，因为声音被塞进包里闷住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LUCKY.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（祝你好运。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You watch as it cuts a stone statue clean in half, the vines that once covered it burnt to cinders where the ray touched it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你目睹那道光束将石像一分为二，曾经覆盖在石像上的藤蔓，在光束触及之处尽数化为灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: If it's possible for an undead commander to look nervous, and maybe even blush a little, he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如果一颗不死的指挥官头看起来会紧张，甚至脸颊微红，那他现在就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You feel the familiar crunch of bone underneath your metal fist as you hit pay dirt! Roll for damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你的金属拳头击中要害时，你听到了那熟悉的骨头碎裂声！掷骰判定伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well, it's not like he could exactly see you coming to do something about it, could he?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他不可能看见你要做什么，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He buckles around your fist, shouting in pain as his ribs shatter under the impact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他整个人瘫软在你的拳头下，随着肋骨在冲击下碎裂，他痛得大喊起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You hear a head shout in muffled agony from inside Sanguina's satchel as his ribs shatter under the impact.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You hear a muffled head shout in agony from inside Wanderer's bag as his ribs shatter under the impact.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Dry flesh gives way like old paper and suddenly your hand is coming out the other side of him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 干瘪​的​肉体​像​旧​报纸​一样​裂开，​转眼间，​你​的​手​就​从​他​身体​的​另​一​侧穿​了​出来。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Dry flesh gives way like old paper and suddenly your hand is coming out the other side of him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 干瘪​的​肉体​像​旧​报纸​一样​裂开，​转眼间，​你​的​手​就​从​他​身体​的​另​一​侧穿​了​出来。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: His fingers open... and his head drops from his grasp. It bounces off the stones at your feet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他张开了手指……头颅从手中滑落，弹到你脚边的石头上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sanguina.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 桑吉娜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But when you pull your arm from his dusty torso... a hole left where your arm was a second before?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但当你将手臂从他布满灰尘的躯干中抽出来时……刚才手臂所在的地方，难道留下了个洞？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Take it away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 交​给​你​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的秘术冲击波击中了他的躯体，那股诡异而过分鲜红的能量光芒完全吞没了他那早已死去、干枯得不成样子的残骸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And he goes up like a tinderbox.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他就像个火药桶一样迅速燃烧起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And he goes up like a tinderbox.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他就像个火药桶一样迅速燃烧起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "NOOOO!!" Commander Nach screams in agony from where his head is laying on its side on the stones, a few feet away. "My body... my beautiful body...!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不！！"纳奇指挥官痛苦地尖叫着，他的头侧躺在几英尺外的石头上。"我的身体……我美丽的身体……！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The head inside Sanguina's bag screams in agony as his body is entirely destroyed, leaving nothing but a few bits of bone... and a shining, golden emblem sitting amongst the ash.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 桑吉娜背包里的头颅发出痛苦的尖叫，他的身体完全被摧毁了，只剩下几块骨头……以及一枚闪闪发光的金色徽章静静地躺在灰烬之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The head inside Wanderer's bag screams in agony as his body is entirely destroyed, leaving nothing but a few bits of bone... and a shining, golden emblem sitting amongst the ash.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 流浪者背包里的头颅发出痛苦的尖叫，他的身体完全被摧毁了，只剩下几块骨头……以及一枚闪闪发光的金色徽章静静地躺在灰烬之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The only thing left of the walking corpse is its talking head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这具行尸走肉唯一剩下的就是它那颗会说话的脑袋了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The only thing left of the walking corpse - besides the talking head - is a few bits of bone... and a shining, golden emblem sitting amongst the ash.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哎，我们没时间再搞这些破事了。这玩意儿又不是被诅咒了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Just as you think you have a moment to breathe... you hear someone applauding. "Well done! Well done. Good show! You'll have to excuse my not getting involved."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 正当你以为自己终于可以喘口气的时候……你听到有人鼓掌。"干得好！干得好！精彩！恕我没能参与其中，请见谅。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Give me a fitness check lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 给​我​来​个​体​能​检定，​哈哈​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You! You will pay for this indignity! I am the mighty Commander Nach! Forever bound to the Vacuum. Let it be known, if you want true salvation, you will lay down their arms, and wait for the baptism of my Bifron key. It is time. I will teach these trespassers the redemptive power of my Bifron key. They will learn its simple -"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你！你必须为这份屈辱付出代价！我就是威震四方的纳奇指挥官！我将永远与‘真空'合而为一。让世人知道。如果你们想得到真正的救赎，就必须放下武器，并接受我的比弗旺钥匙的洗礼。现在时候到了。我会让这些入侵者感受比弗旺钥匙的救赎之力。他们将会学到最简单的道理——"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You look up. And up. And up. To find the source of the voice. The man is sitting lazily atop the CYRPT at its peak, his leg lazily dangling off the edge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你抬头向上看。再向上看。再向上看。寻找声音的来源。那人懒洋洋地坐在墓穴的上方，一条腿懒洋洋地悬在边缘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You get the feeling he'll just keep going if you don't do something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你会感觉，如果你不采取行动，他就会继续下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He is dressed head to toe in black leather, accented in purple, with the occasional splash of orange-gold. His face is hidden by the hood of a cloak, and in the darkness of the night, you can't make out his features.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他从头到脚都穿着黑色皮衣，点缀着紫色，偶尔还闪烁着几缕橙金色。他的脸被斗篷的兜帽遮住，在夜色的笼罩下，你看不清他的五官。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: All you can make out is a fiendish grin, and... he might be wearing a blindfold?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你只能看到他脸上邪恶的笑容，而且……他似乎蒙着眼睛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He kicks his foot idly as if he were having the grandest old time on vacation, not watching you all battle an undead commander. "I wanted to see if you really were capable of what my employers say you are. Honestly?" He spins a dagger between his fingers. He wasn't holding a dagger a split second before. "Meh."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他漫不经心地晃着脚，仿佛正在度假，过得无比惬意，根本不像是在看你们众人与一名不死不灭的指挥官激战。"我只是想看看，你是否真如我的雇主所说的那样厉害。说真的？"他用手指转着一把匕首。就在一瞬间之前，他手上还根本没有匕首。"哼。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You hear his muffled annoyance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你听出了他压抑的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Aoi, you don't have anything called Super Atomic Kick.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（碧，你根本没有什么叫超能原子踢的招式。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: If it's possible for an undead commander to look nervous, and maybe even blush a little, he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如果一颗不死的指挥官头看起来会紧张，甚至脸颊微红，那他现在就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Commander Nach laughs at you. Mockingly. Viciously. You know it'll linger in your dreams. You will take psychic damage from that for the rest of your life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 纳奇指挥官嘲笑着你。那笑声充满讥讽，充满恶毒。你知道这笑声会萦绕在你的梦中。这将让你余生都承受精神创伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Mm, the sexy silent type. How wonderful. Fine by me. Doesn't fix the issue that you have a problem to solve. Namely?" He taps his dagger on the top of the cyrpt. And on command, the large stone doors rumble open. "You have to go find your friends, now, don't you?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯，性感的沉默派。真棒。我倒无所谓。但这可解决不了你眼前的问题。具体是什么？"他用匕首轻敲墓穴顶部。随着他的指令，巨大的石门轰然开启。"你现在得去找你的朋友了，对吧？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Mmm. More or less. But you have bigger problems than me, now. Namely?" He taps his dagger on the top of the cyrpt. And on command, the large stone doors rumble open. "You have to go find your friends, now, don't you?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯。差不多吧。不过你现在面临的问题可比我更棘手。具体是？"他用匕首轻敲墓室顶部。随着一声令下，巨大的石门轰然开启。"你现在得去找你的朋友们了，是吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He laughs. Hard. As if that was the funniest thing he's heard in a long, long time. "Don't go listening to children's stories. They'll have you jumping at shadows."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他哈哈大笑，笑得前仰后合，仿佛这是他很久很久以来听过的最搞笑的事情。"别听那些儿童故事，它们会让你吓得魂飞魄散。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((:sssiiiigghhhhh: okaayyy))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（:sssiiiigghhhhh: 好吧））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He grabs the edge of his cloak with one hand, and with another wicked grin, he pulls it up over himself and - is gone. Just disappears in a blink like he was never there at all!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他单手抓住斗篷的边缘，又露出一抹狡黠的笑容，将斗篷往身上一拉——人就不见了。转眼间就消失得无影无踪，仿佛他从未出现过一般！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "But you have bigger problems than the question of who I am or am not." He taps his dagger on the top of the cyrpt. And on command, the large stone doors rumble open. "You have to go find your friends, now, don't you?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "但你面临的问题，远比我到底是谁更棘手。"他用匕首轻叩墓穴顶部。随着一声令下，巨大的石门轰然开启。"你现在得去找你的朋友们了，不是吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Commander Nach looks up at you, his one good eye going a little wide, and says "Uh oh--"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 指挥官纳奇抬起头看着你，他那只完好的眼睛微微睁大，说道："糟了——"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Which we may or may not find out if you're right... tomorrow!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 明天……我们也许就能知道你是否说对了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Which we may or may not find out... tomorrow!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 明天……我们也许就能知道答案了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Which we will do... tomorrow!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 明天……我们就会去的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((nope this ability now reads: "+100 to kicking Commander Nach's Head"))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ((不，这个技能现在显示的是："踢指挥官纳奇的头+100"))

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He flies off over the trees, and as he does, you think you might have heard him shout "I will teach these trespassers the redemptive power--!!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他飞越树梢，就在这时，你仿佛听见他喊道："我要让这些入侵者见识一下救赎之力——！！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But then he is gone with a *DING* of a star because... hey. When in Jipangu.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但随后他便化作一颗星"叮"的一声消失了，因为……哎，既然身在日木国，那就入乡随俗吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: d'aww shucks... thanks everyone. best part of my day. now everybody shoo, I gotta write out tomorrow's session!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哎呀，谢谢大家。这是我今天最开心的事。好了，大家都走吧，我得赶紧把明天的待办事项写下来了！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ADDDVENTURERRRS!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 冒险家们！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: GIIIRD THY LOINS AND PREPARE THYSELF FOR DAAAY TWO!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 振作起来，准备迎接第二天吧！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: ……还是第三天？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 第三。第三天！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: how'd you even get in this chat?!?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你是怎么进到这个聊天群的？！？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我猜是吧？！？！这可他妈的把我整个计划都打乱了！！整个冒险计划现在都得改了！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: why would i be upset?!?! i had a whole plan for the adventure and it's all screwed now but who cares about that?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​为什么​要​难​过？！？！​我​本来​为​这​次​冒险​制定​了​一​整​套​计划，​现在​全​泡​汤​了，​但​又​有​谁​在乎​呢？！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 是​啊，​当然，​我​没事。​一切​都​好。​我​本来​为​这​次​冒险​制定​了​一​整​套​计划，​现在​全​泡​汤​了，​但​又​有​谁​在乎​呢？！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当然啦。毕竟是在游戏里嘛。而且这些都是你们做出的选择。我得迅速做出反应

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: yeah. maybe. i dunno. i'll have to think fast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯，也许吧。我不知道。我得赶紧想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们现在能不谈这个吗？我正在努力快速思考

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们三个准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 现在不行，真的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: only thing i have to look forward to and here we are...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这本是我唯一期待的事情，结果却成了这样……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: glad somebody is looking forward to this now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 真高兴现在有人对此充满期待

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 抱歉，抱歉。我没事。我们开始吧
