/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: We rejoin our intrepid adventurers as they leave the underground sewers of Höllvandeim, having narrowly escaped capture by the guards of the city and being led to safety by a mysterious figure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 故事再次聚焦于这群无畏的冒险者——他们刚刚离开霍凡德姆的地下下水道，在险些被城卫军抓获之际，被一位神秘人物带到了安全之地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: They now find themselves standing by the edge of a river, where they discover a scroll sitting atop all of Cedric Dawnsong's belongings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText:
此​刻，​他们​发现​自己​正站​在​河边，​在​那​里，​他们​看到​一​卷​卷轴，​
正躺​在​塞德里克·黎颂​的​所有​随身​物品​之​上。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The scroll is marked with the Seal of the Royal Family of Höllvandeim... the same family that sentenced Cedric to death for a crime he does not remember committing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 卷轴上印有霍凡德姆王室的印章……正是这个家族，曾以塞德里克犯下他自己都不记得的罪行为由，判处他死刑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you reach down and open the scroll, a strange tingling sensation rushes up your arm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你俯身展开卷轴时，一种奇特的刺痛感顺着手臂窜了上来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Probably nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 可能没什么事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Eh, what about my things?" Cedric asks. "I would really like my personal effects..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "呃，我的东西呢？"塞德里克问道，"我真的很想拿回我的个人物品……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you reach down and open the scroll, a strange tingling sensation rushes up your arm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你俯身展开卷轴时，一种奇特的刺痛感顺着手臂窜了上来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Uh..." Cedric looks down at his armor, his blessed sword, everything. "I feel like I will need all of that."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "呃……"塞德里克低头看着自己的盔甲、那把受过祝福的剑，还有其他一切。"我觉得我需要带上所有这些东西。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He starts to reassemble his armor and put all of his belongings back on. "I feel as though there might be critical information in that scroll."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他开始重新组装盔甲，并将随身物品一一穿戴回去。"我觉得那卷轴里可能藏着至关重要的信息。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But it quickly passes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但这种感觉转瞬即逝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Are we certain we want to leave it behind?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们确定要把它留下吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you unroll the scroll, you see that it unfortunately does not contain a coupon for booze, but an entirely blank page of parchment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你展开卷轴时，发现里面遗憾地并没有酒类优惠券，而是一张完全空白的羊皮纸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LOL <RETRO_EMOJI_CAT>))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哈哈哈 <RETRO_EMOJI_CAT>））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You stare at it for a moment, perhaps confused that they would go through all that trouble to send you an empty scroll - but suddenly, golden text shimmers into view!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你盯着它看了一会儿，可能感到困惑，他们怎么会费这么大劲儿寄给你一张空白的卷轴——但刹那间，金色的文字闪现出来！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "If you say so..." Cedric shakes his head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "如果你这么说的话……"塞德里克摇了摇头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Well, peasants." Lord Reyland sighs. "What do we do next, if you aren't going to open that scroll?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "唉，乡巴佬们。"雷兰勋爵叹了口气，"既然你们不打算打开那卷轴，接下来我们该怎么办？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hail, Wanderer," it says at the top in impeccable scrollwork. "Your great deeds in the faraway lands of Cellút and Or'd Va'ssi'l precede you."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "致敬，流浪者，"卷轴顶端以精美的卷轴体字迹写道，"你在遥远的塞卢特和奥尔·德瓦西大地上的伟业早已传遍四方。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "We are in need of your assistance. Forgive us for our deceit, but it is imperative that you have no association with the Royal Family. This is for your own safety."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们需要你的帮助。请原谅我们的欺骗，但你绝不能与王室有任何牵连。这是为了你自身的安全。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((That's cheating!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这是作弊！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((You're going to strip Arthur of all his gear *and* curse Quincy?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你打算把亚瑟的所有装备都夺走，*还*要诅咒昆西？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "We know the death of our dear Princess was not the work of the Paladin, but someone from within the Royal House."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们知道，我们尊敬的公主的死并非圣骑士所为，而是王室内部有人所为。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((but. i.))
You clear your throat and continue reading. "But we know not who paid for the assassin to do this terrible deed, nor how the Paladin became entangled in this."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你清了清嗓子，继续读道："但我们既不知道是谁雇佣了刺客干下这桩恶行，也不知道圣骑士是如何卷入其中的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Seek our most trusted advisor. He waits for you at the Royal Family CYRPT, the only place that is safe from prying eyes and ears. You will find it just outside of town."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "去找我们最值得信赖的顾问。他正在王室墓穴等你，那里是唯一能避开窥探目光和耳目的地方。你会在镇外找到它。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((fiiiiiiiiiiine...))
"I suppose I will do what is necessary." He reaches down and picks up the scroll. He makes a brief face, as if he experienced something uncomfortable. "Hm."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我想我会做该做的事。"他弯下腰捡起那卷轴。眉头微皱，仿佛感到有些不适。"嗯。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The trek to the graveyard is quiet. No one speaks, as you are afraid to draw attention to yourselves as you move along the edge of the woods. You are still in view of the city wall, and now and then you can still see guards moving about atop the ramparts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 前往墓地的路途一片寂静。没人说话，因为你们沿着树林边缘前行时，生怕引起别人的注意。你们仍能望见城墙，时不时还能看到城墙上巡逻的卫兵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Reyland mumbles something to himself about pedestrian logic as he unrolls the scroll. At first, it appears blank, before suddenly, golden text shimmers into view! He furrows his brow. "It's addressed to you."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 雷兰一边展开卷轴，一边自言自语地嘟囔着什么"平庸的逻辑"。起初，卷轴看起来一片空白，但随即，金色的文字突然闪现出来！他皱起眉头。"这是写给你的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The sun is just setting as you arrive to the iron gates of the old, neglected yard. It clearly has not been visited in a very long time, either by those who loved those who lay beneath the dirt or by those who would tend to the weeds that have overtaken the monuments to the dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你来到这座破败荒废的墓园铁门前时，太阳正缓缓西沉。显然，这里已经很久没人来了——无论是那些深爱着长眠于此之人的亲人，还是那些本该清理覆盖在逝者墓碑上的杂草的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Only the stray bird, or other four-legged scurrying critter, now come calling in this place to pay their respects. Everything else is just a mouldering, decaying, and dusty ruin to human hubris.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如今，只有零星飞来的鸟儿，或是其他四条腿的窜来窜去的小动物，才会光临此地，前来致意。除此之外，这里的一切都只是人类狂妄自大的结果——一堆腐朽、衰败且布满灰尘的废墟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Despite the ground being muddy, there are no footprints leading inside.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 尽管地面积满了泥，却没有通往里面的脚印。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Despite the ground being muddy, there are no footprints leading inside. If the scroll was telling the truth and there is some "trusted advisor" waiting for you here, they must step lightly. Or have come in another way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 尽管地面积满了泥，却没有通往里面的脚印。如果那卷轴所言属实，且真有某位"值得信赖的顾问"在这里等你，那他一定步履轻盈。要么就是从别的路进来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you all go inside the abandoned graveyard, an unsettling sensation washes over you. The feeling that you are being... watched.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你们走进那座废弃的墓地时，一种不安的感觉涌上心头。一种……被注视的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You head deeper in, not entirely sure what you're looking for. But the cyrpt of the Royal Family must be impressive, you figure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你越走越深，虽然并不完全清楚自己在找什么。但你心想，王室的陵墓一定很壮观。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you wind around a particularly narrow path through a thicket of trees that seem bent on swallowing several statues whole -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你沿着一条格外狭窄的小径蜿蜒前行，两旁是似乎想要将几座雕像吞噬掉的密林——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You come to a wider area at the foot of a large marble cyrpt, its stairs covered with the desiccated remains of leaves... and corpses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你来到一座大型大理石陵墓脚下的一片开阔地带，陵墓的台阶上覆盖着干枯的落叶……还有尸体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Many of whom now suddenly twitch and lurch to life at your presence. But they are not alone. You hear a rustle from all around you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 它们其中许多一见到你，便突然抽搐着、踉跄着苏醒过来。但这里并不只有它们。你听到四周传来沙沙声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for initiative!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷骰子决定先攻吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I was. Heh. One second.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我确实是。嘿嘿。等一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You hear the flurry of surface thoughts of Life. Insects. Birds. Squirrels. Rats. Mice. Food, Food, Shelter? Prey! Hide! Run! Hide! Hide! Run! Safe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你能听到生命表层思绪的纷扰：昆虫、鸟类、松鼠、老鼠、小鼠……食物、食物、栖身之所？猎物！躲起来！快跑！躲起来！躲起来！快跑！安全了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But there's something else there, as well. An undercurrent. A hum. Something louder. A hunger. A deep, seething, terrible hunger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但除此之外，还有其他东西。一股暗流。一种低鸣。某种更响亮的声音。一种渴望。一种深沉的、沸腾的、可怕的渴望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A hunger the likes of which you have only known when you have touched the mind of your Patron.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 那种饥渴，唯有当你触及了你的庇佑者的心灵时，才曾体会过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You are helpless to watch as to watch lurching figures in various stages of decay surround you from the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们只能无助地看着那些摇摇晃晃、处于不同腐朽程度的躯体从阴影中涌来，将你们层层包围。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The warning you received from Sanguina proves useful, as you are able to circle up just in time to watch lurching figures in various stages of decay surround you from the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 桑吉娜的警告派上了用场，你们及时聚拢在一起，目睹了处于不同腐烂阶段的蹒跚身影从阴影中涌出，将你们层层围住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: One of them draws close and grabs Ixchel! She screams, kicking at the undead fiend with her *incredibly spiky boots.* But it feels no pain. Another of the undead jumps on her, quickly overwhelming her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 其中一个凑近并抓住了伊克塞尔！她尖叫着，用那双*布满尖刺的靴子*踢向那个不死恶魔。但那恶魔毫无痛感。另一个不死生物扑了上来，很快便将她压制住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You are able to protect yourself. Morohime and Sanguina are able to stave off the initial wave of attacks also. But the others... are not so lucky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你能够保护自己。诸姬和桑吉娜也能抗住最初一波攻击。但其他人……就没那么幸运了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Lord Reyland Kingsacre draws up his Nobleizer as a rapier, attempting to stab one of the monsters. It runs straight through the creature. But it does not slow the creature down in its mission of dragging Ixchel away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 雷兰·金斯克雷勋爵将他的升爵者挥出，试图刺中其中一只怪物。武器径直穿透了那只怪物。但它还是将伊克塞尔拖走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: In fact... it only seems to make matters worse. For now, Reyland has a choice to make - release his weapon and lose it, or go with it. And he would rather lose his arm than lose his Nobleizer. He, too, begins to be dragged away by the undead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 事实上……这似乎只会让事情变得更糟。眼下，雷兰必须做出选择——松开他的武器并失去它，或者继续坚持下去。他宁可失去手臂，也不愿失去自己的升爵者。他随即也被亡灵拖走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric Dawnsong, holy Paladin that he is, cannot stand idly by and watch two of his compatriots be dragged off by the dead! He leaps into the fray, but is quickly overcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克·黎颂身为一名神圣的圣骑士，绝不能袖手旁观，眼睁睁看着两名同胞被亡灵拖走！他冲入混战，却很快就被压制住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric Dawnsong, despite being entirely without his armor or sword, cannot stand idly by and watch two of his compatriots be dragged off by the dead! He leaps into the fray, fists flying, but is quickly overcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克·黎颂没有盔甲也没有剑，但他无法袖手旁观，眼睁睁地看着两个同伴被亡灵拖走！他奋不顾身地冲入混战，挥舞着拳头，但很快就被制服了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As they are dragged off in the chaos of the shuffling mass of undead, you can only pray that they do not intend to eat their quarry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当他们被那群蹒跚而行的不死生物在混乱中拖走时，你只能祈祷它们别打算把猎物吃掉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((yeah I guess lol))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嗯，我猜也是，哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LOOK.))
((i'll have to figure out how to balance the xp or... have people take turns... or... something... for plot reasons... i'll lampshade it...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我得想办法平衡经验值，或者……让大家轮流来……或者……总之得想个办法……出于剧情需要……我会直接点明这一点……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I'M DOIN' MY BEST WITH WHAT I GOT ON THE FLY, CHUCKLENUTS.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我只能尽我所能，朋友们。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((oh lmao old phrase from i think like tv writing? when something doesn't make sense and they have a character point out it doesn't make sense to make it make MORE sense))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哦，笑死，这应该是电视剧桥段里常用的老梗吧？当某个情节说不通时，让某个角色指出它的不合理，从而让情节说得过去））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Only three of you now stand and face a gathering of the undead. Too many to count. It seems... hopeless. When suddenly, you hear. a raspy laugh from the back of the crowd.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 此刻，你们三人孤身面对着聚集的亡灵大军。数量多得数不清。眼下看来……似乎已无望。就在这时，你们突然听到人群后方传来一阵沙哑的笑声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "These ones... are mine! He said you would come..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这些……是我的！他说你会来的……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((... aoi do you watch space voyage...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（……碧，你看《太空之旅》吗……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The undead suddenly shuffle back into the trees, all of them disappearing from whence they came. Leaving only one lone figure standing across from you, blocking the path you entered from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不死生物们突然蹒跚着退回树林，全都消失在它们来时的方向。唯有一人孤零零地站在你对面，挡住了你刚才进来的那条路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He is wearing the tattered remains of a Captain's uniform, but one from many hundred years ago. Beige trousers tucked into knee-high socks, and black shoes whose brass buckles have long since tarnished and nearly rotted away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他穿着一件破烂不堪的上尉制服，但那是几百年前的款式了。米色长裤塞进及膝长袜里，黑色皮鞋上的黄铜鞋扣早已失去光泽，几乎腐烂殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((OML HOW AM I JUST LEARNING THIS NOOOOWW... GNNAHHHH focusamirfocus))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我的天啊，我现在才知道这个……啊啊啊啊啊，集中注意力！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A sash across his chest in rotted silk, and mouldering golden tassels are what denote his rank. And a large, golden emblem sits on his chest, though you do not recognize what it's meant to represent, it looks important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他胸前系着一条腐朽的丝绸绶带，缀着发霉的金穗，以此表明他的身份。胸前还佩戴着一枚硕大的金色徽章，虽然你看不出它代表什么，但看起来十分重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: His skin is a sickly yellow-green, falling off in places, and you can see his bones peeking through in his legs and arms. But most notably? His head is missing from his shoulders. He is carrying it loose in one hand, a tangled powdered wig that has seen better days atop it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他的皮肤呈病态的黄绿色，有些地方已经脱落，四肢能看到骨头。但最引人注目的是什么？他的头不在肩上。他用一只手拎着它，头上戴着一顶凌乱的假发，那假发早已破旧不堪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: His head no longer being attached doesn't seem to stop him from talking. "Look at them, they come to this place when they know they are not pure. Only I, Commander Nach, know the true power of the Vacuum! I was beheaded, destroyed, but through it's Bifron Key, the Vacuum called to me!" He pauses. "WAIT. WHERE IS MY BIFRON KEY?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 虽然头颅已经不在了，但他似乎依然滔滔不绝。"看看他们，明明知道自己不纯净，却还来到这里。只有我——指挥官纳奇——才知道‘真空'的真正力量！我曾被斩首、被摧毁，但通过那把‘比弗旺钥匙'，‘真空'唤回了我！"他停顿了一下。"等等！我的‘比弗旺钥匙'在哪里？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "DID YOU STEAL MY SACRED BIFRON KEY?!" He screams in a rage. "My brothers, did I not tell of this day? Did I not prophesize this moment? Now, I will stop them. Now I am changed, reborn!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你偷了我神圣的比弗旺钥匙吗？！"他愤怒地咆哮道。"兄弟们，我难道没有说过会有这一天吗？我难道没有预言过此刻吗？此刻我将阻止他们。此刻我已重获新生！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "MY key! The key that unlocks all secrets, the key that knows all, the key that He said You would come and take from me!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我的钥匙！那把能解开所有秘密的钥匙，那把无所不知的钥匙，那把他说你会从我这里夺走的钥匙！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((hey at least i abridged it lmao))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嘿，至少我把它删减了哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Bah! Those are normal keys! I need MY key! The key that unlocks all secrets, the key that knows all, the key that He said You would come and take from me!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "呸！那些都是普通的钥匙！我要我的钥匙！那把能解开所有秘密的钥匙，那把无所不知的钥匙，那把他说你会从我这里夺走的钥匙！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "GIVE ME BACK MY SACRED KEY!" he demands, shuffling forward. He draws a rusted saber from its sheath with his other hand. "He warned me of your thievery! I should have listened to Him!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "把我的神圣钥匙还给我！"他厉声喝道，蹒跚着向前挪动。他另一只手从剑鞘中拔出一把锈迹斑斑的军刀。"他早就警告过我你们是小偷！我真应该听他的！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "THE EMISSARY!" He laughs almost gleefully. A tooth falls out of his mouth as he does. He doesn't seem to notice. "The emissary of the MOTHER!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "使徒！"他几乎是得意洋洋地大笑起来。笑的时候，一颗牙掉了出来，但他似乎浑然不觉。"母亲的使徒！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Because you were prepared for trouble from Sanguina's warning, you weren't entirely caught off-guard by all this. You can preemptively attack! What do you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 因为你事先听取了桑吉娜的警告，有所准备，所以并没有完全措手不及。你可以先发制人！你会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He steps forward, lifting his rusty saber, and swings straight at Wanderer!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他迈步向前，举起那把生锈的军刀，径直向流浪者劈去！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Ehhh?" He turns his own head around to look at him own chest. "Oh! Well, shit."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "呃？"​他​转过头​去​看​自己​的​胸口。​"哦！​靠。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "So that's where I put it!" He laughs gleefully. A tooth falls out of his mouth as he does. He doesn't seem to notice. Sheathing his sword, he pulls the golden emblem off his chest. It suddenly starts to glow with a vicious and eerie yellow light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "原来我把它放这儿了！"他得意地大笑起来。笑声中，一颗牙从他嘴里掉了出来，但他似乎浑然不觉。他收起剑，取下胸前的金色徽章。徽章突然发出一种阴森诡异的黄色光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And you start to get the sinking sensation that maybe, just maybe, you shouldn't have asked that question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你感到一阵懊恼，也许，也许你不应该问那个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You don't. But I'm not sure what other options you have, except "turn around and go home."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你不知道。但我也不确定你还有什么别的选择，除了"掉头回家"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You head into the Family Cyrpt with Sanguina and Morohime, with you leading the way by about... oh, we'll say specifically... fifteen feet or so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你和桑吉娜、诸姬·一击一起走进家族墓穴，你带头走在最前面，大概……哦，具体……十五英尺左右。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Floor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 地表。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sure, but it'll end the adventure, and everybody will die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当然，但这样一来冒险就结束了，而且大家都会死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ask him... what exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 问……问​他​些​什么​呢？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: There is a sudden rumble beneath your feet. The stones shift and give way. You hear Sanguina and Morohime yelp in surprise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 脚下突然传来一阵轰鸣。石块移位，地面塌陷。你听到桑吉娜和诸姬·一击的惊声呼叫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What little light you had from the moon and the stars outside goes suddenly dark as you are plunged into darkness as you fall into the emptiness below you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你原本从外面看到微弱的月光和星光，突然间也消失了，你坠入了无尽的黑暗之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And you trust the severed rotting head of your enemy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你竟然相信敌人被砍下的腐烂头颅？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fair enough...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 也​行……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You brace for impact when... SPLOOOSH!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你正准备迎接撞击，突然……哗啦！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You reach into your satchel and pull out the severed head. He blinks his eye up at you. "What is it now, impure heathen?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​伸手进挎​包里，​掏出​了​那​颗​被​砍下​的​头颅。​他​眨​着​眼睛​抬头​看​着​你。​"现在​又​怎么​了，​肮脏​的​异教​徒？！"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sanguina pulls out the severed head and holds it up so you can talk to him. "What is it now, impure heathen?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 桑吉娜掏出那颗被砍下的头颅，高高举起，好让你能跟他说话。"现在又怎么了，肮脏的异教徒？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The water instantly sends you in your heavy armor sinking downward. But someone grabs your arm and drags you upwards violently toward the surface!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 水流瞬间将身着厚重盔甲的你向下拖去。但有人抓住了你的手臂，猛地向上将你拽向水面！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He scoffs. "Dead heart like that? Only after one thing."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他​嗤之​以鼻。​"那样​心​已​死去​的​人？​只图​一​件​事。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He sneers. "Men like that only ever serve one. Themselves."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他冷笑一声。"像那样的人，永远只效力一个人。他们自己。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He laughs. Hard. "Trust he'll help you as far as it serves his interests!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他大笑起来。笑得很欢。"相信他吧，只要对他的利益有帮助，他肯定会帮你！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He squints his one eye at you distrustfully. "Nach knows of him. Nach knows of many people. Many come to this place."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他眯着那只独眼，怀疑地打量着你。"纳奇认识他。纳奇认识很多人。很多人都来过这里。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Someone next to you laughs. Someone familiar. "That how you greet all your friends?" You see the soggy face of Cedric Dawnsong lit up by torchlight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你身边有人笑了。是个熟人。"你跟所有朋友都是这么打招呼的吗？"你看到塞德里克·黎颂那张湿漉漉的、被火把照亮的脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: LOL. Ooookay. Roll.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哈哈。​好……好​吧。​掷骰​吧。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: There's torchlight down here, surprisingly. In fact there's a decent amount of light nearby. You see the familiar - if soggy - face of Cedric Dawnsong next to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 出乎意料的是，这里居然有火把的光亮。事实上，附近的光线还挺充足的。你看到塞德里克·黎颂那张熟悉的，虽然湿漉漉的脸就在你身旁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "To kill the whole world that made him."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "毁灭造​就​了​他​的​整个​世界。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Because it helps him."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "因为​那样​对​他​有利。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Assuming that the Wanderer follows and climbs out, you finally get a good look around. You are in a room that is entirely made of dark, stacked stone. The ceiling is curved, domed over you like a sewer, but not like any you've ever seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 假设流浪者跟着爬了出来的话，你终于能好好环顾四周了。你身处一间完全由深色石块堆砌而成的房间。天花板呈弧形，像下水道一样在你头顶拱起，却又与你以往见过的任何下水道都不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The channel of water you landed in is narrow, but deep. It looks clean, and doesn't smell - which is a blessing since you're now soaked through. The water flows through a heavy iron grate at both ends. No getting in or out that way, it seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这​条​水道​虽然​狭窄，​但​很​深。​水看​起来​很​干净，​也​没有​异味，这真是万幸，因为你现在已经湿透了。​水​从​两​端​的​厚重铁​栅格​中​流过。​看来​也​无法​从​那​里​进出。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((gimmie your unarmed strike bonus and attack fam-a-llama))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（给​我​徒手​攻击​加成，​然后​去​攻击​那​只​草泥马））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He sniffs. "Yeah, well. He destroys the world, he destroys me. He destroys me, I don't get my Bifron Key back. I don't get my Bifron key back, I don't--"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他轻哼了一声。"是啊，总之。他毁了世界，也就毁了我。他毁了我，我就拿不回我的比弗旺钥匙。我要是拿不回比弗旺钥匙，我就……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You think I know?!" He cackles. "I'm a side-character in a graveyard and now you have my severed head in a bag!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我怎么知道？！"他发出刺耳的笑声。"我只是个墓地里的小配角，现在我的断头还被你装在袋子里呢！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: There is only one shore - more like a landing, and you're on it. It's a platform some ten feet wide and forty feet long. There are lit torches in sconces on the wall in between four large doors. Each emblazoned with giant metal Invictian numerals. I. II. III. IV.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 只​有​一​侧​河岸，​如其说​是​岸，​倒​更​像​是​河滩，​而​你​正站​在​上面。​这​是​一​个​宽约​十​英尺、​长约​四十​英尺​的​平台。​四扇​大门​之间​的​墙上，​壁龛​里点​着​火把。​每​扇​门上​都​镌刻​着​巨大​的​金属​古式​数字：​I、​II、​III、​IV。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You get the sense he's going to go on another monologue, so it's time to tuck Commander Nach back in the bag.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你感觉他又要开始没完没了地独白了，是时候把指挥官纳奇重新塞回袋子里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: They have no doorknobs or latches, but they seem entirely sealed. There is writing engraved into a large plaque above all of them, but you can't quite make it out from where you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这些​门既​没有​门​把​手​也​没有​扣环，​却​似乎​完全​密封。​所有​门​上方​的​一​块​大牌匾​上​刻​有​文字，​但​从​你​现在​的​位置​看​不​清楚。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((well, let's see if you hit))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好吧，让我们看看你能不能打中））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sitting on the ground, looking quite soggy and not terribly pleased, but otherwise unharmed, are Lord Reyland and Ixchel. (And Duchess, of course. Can't forget Duchess.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 坐在地上的是雷兰勋爵和伊克塞尔，看起来浑身湿透，一脸不悦，但除此之外并无大碍。（当然还有公爵夫人。可不能忘了公爵夫人。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Heeey Arthur...))
((You a fan of riddles?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你喜欢谜语？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Are you not a fan of riddles?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你不喜欢谜语吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LOL. well i hope mine isn't crappy then. iiiiif you're a puzzle fan... do you want to play this riddle on normal mode or hard mode?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哈哈。嗯希望我的谜语没那么烂。要是你喜欢解谜……你想玩普通模式还是困难模式呢？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((WEEEELLL.... iiiiif you're a puzzle fan... do you want to play this riddle on normal mode or hard mode?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嗯……要是你喜欢解谜……你想玩普通模式还是困难模式呢？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((well... do you want to skip it?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嗯……那你想跳过这一步吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Seriously? But part of the fun is in the discovery and failure.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（真的吗？但一部分的乐趣就在于探索和失败。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((very funny, i wish lolll can you imagine?! THIS DOOOR TELLS ONLY LIES. THIS DOOOOR WILL TELL YOU YOUR ASS LOOKS ABSOLUTELY SMASHING IN THOSE PANTS.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（太好笑了，我也希望是这样，你能想象吗？！这扇门只会说谎。这扇门会告诉你，你穿那条裤子的屁股看起来美极了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((very funny, i wish lolll can you imagine?! THIS DOOOR TELLS ONLY LIES. THIS DOOOOR WILL TELL YOU THEIR DRUG HABIT IS TOTALLY YOUR FAULT.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（太好笑了，我也希望是这样，你能想象吗？！这扇门只会说谎。这扇门会告诉你，他们染上毒瘾完全是你的错。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric, out of the kindness of his heart, and without a moment's hesitation, jumped into the channel of water to save the Wanderer as they fell in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克出于心中的善念，毫不犹豫地跳进水道中，救起了掉进水里的流浪者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((ha. hahahaha. HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哈。哈哈哈哈。哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((you got it!))
What would you like to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你想要做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Only to be greeted by their fist as they helped them to the surface. Luckily, the Wanderer has literally zero upper body strength and their hand bounces off Cedric's manly jaw.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 结果在将对方扶上水面时，却迎来了对方的一记拳头。幸运的是，流浪者的上肢力量几乎为零，那只手在塞德里克那棱角分明的下巴上弹开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Only to be greeted by their fist as they saved them from drowning in their full armor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 结果，当他把身穿全套盔甲的流浪者从溺水中救起时，却迎来了对方的一记拳头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The inscription is damaged and parts of it are missing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 碑文已损坏，部分内容缺失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Four wardens keep an iron bond, each holding you from beyond. The eldest wakes when peace doth flow, the youngest sleeps where coldest blow. The second born devours what the living presume, the third born is fed by what lies in the tomb. Speak to each the order they were born, lest this place be your grave to mourn."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "四位守卫以铁一般的羁绊相连，各自从彼岸将你束缚。最年长者于和平流淌之间苏醒，最幼者在最寒冷之处沉睡。次者吞噬生者的妄念，第三者以墓中之物为食。务必以其出生顺序与他们交谈，否则此地将成为你哀悼的怨坟。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Only to be greeted by their fist as they helped them to the surface.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 结果，当他把流浪者从溺水中救起时，却迎来了对方的一记拳头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Four war---s keep an iron bond, each h------ you from beyond. The eldest wakes w--- --ac- doth flow, the -ou--est sleeps where co--est ---w. The -ec--- -----rs what the living presume, the t--r- is --d by what l--s in the t--b. Speak to each the order ---- ---- b---, lest this place be your grave to mourn."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "四位守——以铁一般的羁绊相连，各自从彼岸将你束——。最年长者于——平流淌之间苏——，最幼——在最寒——沉睡。——者吞噬生者的妄念，三——以——中之物——。务必以其——顺序与他们——，否则此地将成为你哀悼的怨坟。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Give me an inspection check.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 给我做个调查检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You have 28 HP... Minus 4... That puts you at 24 HP now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你有 28 点生命值……减去 4……现在你剩下 24 点生命值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You were at 25, because of the 3 you took in the fight at the execution, minus the 4... that puts you at 21 HP now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 因为在行刑场的战斗中你被扣了 3 点，你的生命值成了 25，减去现在的 4 点……现在你还剩下 21 点生命值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Somehow the puzzle was solved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 谜题不知怎么就解开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It looks as though each door used to have symbols etched on them. Sadly, only one of them remains:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 看起来每扇门上以前都刻有符号。可惜的是，现在只剩下一扇了：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Etched onto the first door marked with the numeral (IV) is a symbol. It is incredibly worn, and you can't quite make out what it looks like...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 第一扇标有数字（IV）的门上刻着一个符号。它磨损得非常厉害，已经看不清是什么图案了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You have 28 HP... Minus 2... That puts you at 26 HP now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你有 28 点生命值……减去 2……现在你剩下 26 点生命值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You were at 25, because of the 3 you took in the fight at the execution, minus the 2... that puts you at 23 HP now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 因为在行刑场的战斗中你被扣了 3 点，你的生命值成了 25，减去现在的 2 点……现在你还剩下 23 点生命值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you speak the words correctly, there is a rumble as all four doors shake and rumble open before you, lifting up like portcullis into the darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你正确念出那些词语时，一阵轰鸣声响起，四扇门在你面前震颤着轰然敞开，像闸门一样升起，消失在黑暗之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: <RETRO_ASCII_AIR>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: <RETRO_ASCII_AIR>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The other three doors have symbols you can make out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 另外三扇门上有些能看清的符号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Centuries of detritus shaken free in their many years of neglect in this dark place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在​这​处​阴暗​之​地，​沉积​数​个​世纪​的​残骸​在​多​年​无人​问津之后，终于​纷纷​脱落​下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LOL. Good enough, don't bother adding the rest.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哈哈，够了，剩下的就不用加了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Door (II):
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 门（II）：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: They all, luckily, seem to go to the same stairwell that curves downward - an eerie purple glow that flickers like firelight coming from somewhere far below.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 幸运的是，他们似乎都走向了同一条向下蜿蜒的楼梯间——从远处的下方透出一道诡异的紫色光芒，如同火光般闪烁不定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: <RETRO_ASCII_FIRE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: <RETRO_ASCII_FIRE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Guests! Guests at my door? Aaah, but we have not had guests in many a year, have we, have we, hm?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "客人！门外有客人？啊，可我们已经好多年没接待过客人了，对吧，对吧，嗯？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you look around the room, there are some strange things that jump out to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你环顾房间时，会发现一些奇怪的东西映入眼帘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you look around the room, there are some strange things that jump out to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你环顾房间时，会发现一些奇怪的东西映入眼帘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Door (I):
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 门（I）：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The voice is followed by a horrible, gurgling, shouting laughter that might have contained words but you aren't quite sure.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Come now, don't be shy! We have quite the banquet waiting for all of you..."

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So now something Very Terrible and Super Awful is going to have to happen, of course. You understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 所以，现在肯定要发生一件非常可怕、极其糟糕的事情了，你明白的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好啦，还是老时间，还是老频道！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you speak the words incorrectly... there is a terrible rumbling. And a ghastly laughter comes from seemingly within the walls themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就在你念错这些词的时候……一阵可怕的轰鸣声响起。接着，仿佛从墙壁深处传来一阵令人毛骨悚然的笑声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I will not reveal my plans. <RETRO_EMOJI_SNEAKY>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不会泄漏我的计划的。<RETRO_EMOJI_SNEAKY>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Guests! Guests at my door? Aaah, but we have not had guests in many a year, have we, have we, hm?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "客人！门外有客人？啊，可我们已经好多年没接待过客人了，对吧，对吧，嗯？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The voice is followed by a horrible, gurgling, shouting laughter that might have contained words but you aren't quite sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 那声音之后，传来一阵可怕的、咕噜咕噜的、嘶吼般的笑声，其中或许夹杂着些许词语，但你并不确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Such terrible manners they have, I agree! If they wish to join us... they'll have to make a sacrifice!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "他们的举止真是太糟糕了，我同意！如果他们想加入我们……就必须有个祭品！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A pause. "No, I said *sacrifice* you great multi-armed buffoon, not *snackrifice*--"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 一阵停顿。"不，我说的是‘献祭'你这个多手大傻瓜，不是‘献出零食'——"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: More gurgling sounds. "I do not care if that is what you meant! A sacrifice must be made!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 更多的咕噜声。"我不管你是不是那个意思！必须有人献祭！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: More rumbling. And then... a hatch opens up in the floor. "One of you must die... but don't worry. Only a little..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 又传来一阵隆隆声。接着……地板上的一扇舱门打开了。"你们之中必须有一个人死……不过别担心，只是死一点点……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Not so eager, are we? Why? Two of your friends have already joined us..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "看来我们不太积极啊？为什么？你们的两个朋友已经加入我们了……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Aah, wonderful! Such a good addition to my program..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "啊，太棒了！这真是我这个节目的一大亮点……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: All four doors shake and rumble open before you, lifting up like portcullis into the darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 四扇门在你面前震颤着轰然敞开，像闸门一样升起，消失在黑暗之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Centuries of detritus shaken free in their many years of neglect in this dark place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 在​这​处​阴暗​之​地，​沉积​数​个​世纪​的​残骸​在​多​年​无人​问津之后，终于​纷纷​脱落​下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: They all, luckily, seem to go to the same stairwell that curves downward - an eerie purple glow that flickers like firelight coming from somewhere far below.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 幸运的是，他们似乎都走向了同一条向下蜿蜒的楼梯间——从远处的下方透出一道诡异的紫色光芒，如同火光般闪烁不定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The stairs before you curve down into the darkness. You know what waits for you at the bottom knows you are coming. And you know he has your friends. There will be no catching whoever, or whatever he is, by surprise. You are going in blind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你面前的楼梯蜿蜒而下，通往黑暗深处。你知道在楼梯底部等待着你的是什么，它知道你会来。你也知道他控制着你的朋友。无论他是谁，无论他是什么，你都无法出其不意地抓住他。你将一无所知地进入其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Come, come! Don't be afraid," you hear him call to you. "We have already started the hors d'oeuvres." His voice seems to come from everywhere and nowhere, echoing off the dark stones of the walls and the arched ceiling overhead. The torches in the iron sconces as you descend are becoming fewer and fewer, the light casting an eerie purple instead of the natural orange-red.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "来，来！别害怕，"你听到他喊你，"我们已经开始准备开胃菜了。"他的声音仿佛来自四面八方，又仿佛来自虚无，在深色的石墙和拱形天花板间回荡。你往下走，铁壁灯里的火把越来越少，光线也从原本的橙红色变成了诡异的紫色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Your shadows that they cast upon the walls seem to dance on their own accord.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们的影子投射在墙上，仿佛在自由地跳舞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you feel like you might be reaching the bottom, you start to hear that other chortling, strange, almost choked laughter start to mix in with the other more nasal-y voice. But whatever language it's speaking in, you can't make it out. If it's even a language at all. "Oh, don't be rude," the first voice says. "Wait 'till they get here, they won't be long!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你感觉自己快要跌到谷底时，你开始听到另一种咯咯的、怪异的、近乎哽咽的笑声，它开始与另一个鼻音更重的声音混杂在一起。但无论那是什么语言，你都听不懂。如果那真的是一种语言的话。"哦，别这么没礼貌，"第一个声音说。"等他们到了再说，他们很快就到！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You won't be long, now will you?" the first voice goads.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你不会太久的，对吧？"第一个声音催促道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((... you can all talk now.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（……你们现在可以发言了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As you reach the bottom of the stairs, you pass through a large archway that looms overhead, flanked on both sides by the same unsettling, purple-flamed torches. The room opens up into a vast stone chamber - some thirty feet wide and fifty feet long. The ceiling disappears into darkness above you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当你走到楼梯底部，穿过一道高耸入云的大拱门，两侧各有一盏令人不安的紫色火炬。房间豁然开朗，变成一个巨大的石室——大约三十英尺宽，五十英尺长。你头顶上的天花板消失在黑暗中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: At the far end burns a hearth that is large enough that if Morohime stood on your shoulders, she *might* be able to reach the mantel. It blazes with orange light, the combination of the orange-and-purple shadows makes the whole room feel off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 房间尽头燃着熊熊火焰的壁炉，大到即使诸姬站在你的肩膀上，*可能*连壁炉架也够不到。壁炉里燃烧着橙色的火焰，橙紫色的阴影交织在一起，让整个房间显得怪异不已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The room is dominated in the center by a massive banquet table. It is set for seven. Three chairs on one side, three on the other, and at the head, with its back to the flames - entirely obscured in shadow - is the seventh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 房间中央摆放着一张巨大的宴会桌，桌边摆放着七人份的餐具。一边放着三把椅子，另一边也放着三把，而第七把椅子则位于桌子的首位，背对着火焰，完全隐没在阴影中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Even still, you can make out the silhouette of a figure sitting in the chair framed by the fire. "Welcome, you finally made it! Our mutual friend said you were coming, though he is a bit more punctual than you are." He reaches forward for a goblet of wine on the table, and you see that his arm is nothing but bones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 即便如此，你仍然能辨认出壁炉旁椅子上坐着一个人影。"欢迎，你们终于来了！我们的共同朋友说你们会来，不过他比你们守时多了。"他伸手去拿桌上的酒杯，你这才发现他的手臂只剩下骨头了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: A gold bracer around his wrist looks more like a manacle, from it dangles a few shattered links of a golden chain. Another, intact length runs into the darkness toward his throat, where a large collar, obscured in shadow, sits around the throat of the figure whose face you cannot see. But you're beginning to suspect your host may not be wholly alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他手腕上的金手镯看起来更像是一副镣铐，上面垂着几节断裂的金链。另一节完整的金链延伸到黑暗中，通向他的喉咙处，那里一个巨大的项圈隐没在阴影中，套在那个你看不清脸的人的脖子上。但你开始怀疑，你的宴会主人或许并非完全活着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Two very simple questions with very complicated answers, I'm afraid!" The man laughs. "Questions I doubt we have a very long time to delve into the details of, no, no. No, you are likely to lose your patience with me long before then, aren't you? Hm?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这是两个非常简单的问题，但答案却非常复杂！"那人笑道，"可惜我们没多少时间来深入探讨这些问题了，不，不。不，恐怕你很快就会失去耐心，对吧？嗯？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Seated at the table are your friends, Morohime and Sanguina. They are staring at the plates of food in front of them, glassy-eyed, expressions empty. They look alive, but...pale. Especially Morohime, as let's be honest - with Sanguina it's a bit hard to tell. But the worst of them all is poor Cedric... his throat is slit from ear to ear. The front of him is a mask of crimson.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的朋友诸姬和桑吉娜坐在桌旁。她们目光呆滞地盯着面前的餐盘，眼神空洞，表情茫然。她们看起来还活着，但……脸色苍白。说实话，尤其是诸姬，而桑吉娜的脸色有点难以判断。但最惨的要数可怜的塞德里克了……他的喉咙被割开了一道口子，从一侧耳根一直割到另一侧。他面前的伤口血肉模糊，如同一张猩红的面具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Seated at the table are your friends, Morohime and Sanguina. They are staring at the plates of food in front of them, glassy-eyed, expressions empty. They look alive, but...pale. Especially Morohime, as let's be honest - with Sanguina it's a bit hard to tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你的朋友诸姬和桑吉娜坐在桌旁。她们目光呆滞地盯着面前的餐盘，眼神空洞，表情茫然。她们看起来还活着，但……脸色苍白。说实话，尤其是诸姬，而桑吉娜的脸色有点难以判断。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "For what you believe I've done to your friends, I think. You will not see the purpose they serve in my new program."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "就​你​认为​我​对​你​的​朋友们​所​做​的​事而​言，​我​觉得​你​不​会​明白​他们​在​我​的​新​计划​中​起到​的​作用。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yet, by some dark magic, his eyes are still open, and you see the faint rise and fall of his chest. He is breathing. He is alive - but in the same kind of trance as the other two, staring emptily at the food in front of him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 然而，不知为何，他的眼睛依然睁着，你能看到他胸膛微弱的起伏。他还在呼吸。他还活着——但和其他两人一样，处于一种恍惚的状态，目光空洞地盯着眼前的食物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "And a quite important one at that, before I was locked away down here, guarding the family's horrible secrets! They claimed they executed me because my program was 'heresy,' and 'a crime against nature and the gods,' but I knew better."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "而且​那​还​是​个​相当​重要​的​名字​呢，​就​在​我​被​囚禁​在​这里，​守护​着​这个​家族​可怕​的​秘密​之前！​他们​声称​处决​我，​是​因为​我​的​计划​是​‘异端邪​说'，​是​‘​反​自然、​反神明​的​罪行'，​但​我​知道​真相​并​非​如此。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Ah, well, take a look for yourself!" He gestures that skeletal hand at the banquet before him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "啊，你自己看看吧！"他用那只骨瘦如柴的手指了指面前的宴席。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "They wanted someone with my power. My wits. My ability in a place where they knew I could have access to an unending supply of... eh... heh. Resources, you see."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "他们想要一个像我这样有力量、有智慧、有才干的人，在一个他们知道我能够获得源源不断……呃……呵呵……资源的地方，你懂的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Mm, I would not recommend that. They are partially through treatment, you see. It might be fatal, removing them from my program."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯，我不建议这样做。你知道，他们才刚刚完成一部分疗程。把他们从我的计划中移除可能会致命。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Aah, merely improvements! They have joined my new program!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "啊，只是一些改进！他们已经加入了我的新计划！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "A bit of a silent arrangement."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "一个大家都心知肚明的安排。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "My first attempt at making skeletal armies profitable wasn't precisely successful. I was executed for heresy, etcetera and so-on. So. Now I am working on a *new* program. I am calling it the 'Exalted Xenotype Imbued Meaty Undying Skeleton' Program."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我第一次尝试让骷髅军队盈利并不成功。我因异端邪说被处决了，等等等等。所以，现在我正在进行一个*全新的*计划。我称它为‘崇高异种注入肉质不死骷髅'计划。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You cannot be that terribly unimaginative."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你不会这么缺乏想象力吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The Royal Family of Höllvandeim is very careful to ensure that it stays in power. Very careful, indeed. Staying alive forever isn't very hard." He shifts his hand in front of the firelight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "霍凡德姆王室非常谨慎地维持自己的权力。极其谨慎，真的。长生不老其实并不难。" 他在火光前挪了挪手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Brilliant! I never thought of that." He cackles. "Perhaps I will leave you alive. Or, even better, find a way to transfer your consciousness to some kind of... glass..." He gestures a skeletal hand aimlessly in the air. "...tetrahedron..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "妙极了！我怎么没想到呢。"他咯咯地笑着。"或许我会放你一条生路。或者，更好的办法是，找到方式把你的意识转移到某种……玻璃……"他漫不经心地挥了挥骷髅手。"……四面体……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You can see it truly is nothing but skeletal bones. Tatters of fabric and golden chains dangling from the shackles around his wrist are all that remain of what must have been the living man he once was. "Staying alive forever without adverse side effects? Now that is a challenge."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你可以看到他真的只剩一副骨架了。几块破布和几条金链子从他手腕上的镣铐上垂下来，这些就是他曾经作为活人存在的唯一痕迹。"永生不死，而且没有任何副作用？这可真是一个挑战。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hardly! It is not their doing, but a horrid curse. The Oblivionic God of Avarice, Varlos Graelun put these upon me when I failed him. But my new program will please him. I will be free, soon."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "绝非如此！这并非他们的所作所为，而是可怕的诅咒。贪婪的遗忘之神瓦洛斯·格雷伦在我辜负他时，将这一切加诸于我身上。但我的新计划会让他满意的。我很快就会获得自由。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((roll them dice, let's see if you're right))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（掷骰子，看看你猜对了没））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "My first attempt at making skeletal armies profitable wasn't precisely successful. I was executed for heresy, etcetera and so-on. So. Now I am working on a *new* program. I am calling it the 'Exalted Xenotype Imbued Meaty Undying Skeleton' Program."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我第一次尝试让骷髅军队盈利并不成功。我因异端邪说被处决了，等等等等。所以，现在我正在进行一个*全新的*计划。我称它为‘崇高异种注入肉质不死骷髅'计划。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LMAOOOOOOOO, MYGUYWHAT))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（笑死，我的天啊））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I could, ah, give you more details. Or. I could, well, show you. My dear friend, would you greet our guests properly?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我可以，呃，告诉你更多细节。或者，我也可以，嗯，展示给你看。我亲爱的朋友，你能好好招待一下我们的客人吗？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Some fifteen feet away from you, hovering right by the wall, something appears. It lets out a shout that sounds like someone drowning a screaming horse. The undead thing in the chair was only distracting you while his friend prepared to attack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 离你大约十五英尺远的地方，突然出现了一个东西，紧贴着墙面。它发出了一声嘶吼，听起来像是有人在淹死一匹嘶叫的马。原来，椅子上的那个不死生物只是在分散你的注意力，他的朋友正在准备攻击。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((yeah no you're good lol))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嗯确实没有，你没问题，哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /bossmap1
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /bossmap1

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As the shadowy figure is talking, Duchess's ears perk up. She sniffs the air, and suddenly lets out a low growl. The hair between her shoulders starts to raise, and you see her bare her teeth. She fixates her stare on a portion of the shadows. Something is moving closer to you, but is obscured.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当那个黑影说话时，公爵夫人竖起了耳朵。她嗅了嗅空气，突然低声咆哮起来。她肩间的毛发开始竖起，露出了牙齿。她的目光紧紧锁定在阴影中的某个地方。有什么东西正向你靠近，但被遮挡住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Through your hunter's senses, you can feel the trace of something - it's using magic, but there's some things that not even magic can fully hide. Like... smell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 凭借猎人的感官，你能感觉到一丝痕迹——它在使用魔法，但有些东西即使是魔法也无法完全掩盖。比如……气味。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The stench of it is what hits you. Whatever is coming closer to you, trying to get the drop on you - it *reeks.* It somehow smells like the unmistakable scent of extreme body odor, combined with the overwhelming incense of rotting flesh. It almost makes you retch as it wafts across your nose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 那股恶臭扑面而来。无论是什么东西正向你靠近，试图偷袭你——它都散发着令人作呕的恶臭。那气味像是极度体臭与腐肉的刺鼻气味混合在一起，令人作呕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The source of it is floating off the ground, some fifteen feet away from you, to your right by the wall. It realizes suddenly that it has been seen, and lets out a garbled, wet-sounding holler that sounds like someone drowning a screaming horse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 声音的源头漂浮在离地面大约十五英尺的地方，在你右侧的墙边。它突然意识到自己被发现了，发出了一声含糊不清、湿漉漉的嚎叫，听起来像是有人在淹死一匹嘶叫的马。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: An enormous, bulbous, hideously ugly... thing... appears before you. Its only body is a mass of flesh that could loosely be described as what might have once been a gigantic head with a single, metallic eye in its center. Its nose, its lips, its pointed, jagged teeth - all metal. As is what might be a strip of metal running down the center of its head and another protruding from its chin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 一个巨大、臃肿、丑陋不堪的……东西……出现在你面前。它唯一的躯体是一团血肉，勉强可以形容为曾经是一个巨大的头颅，中央长着一只金属眼睛。它的鼻子、嘴唇、尖锐的锯齿状牙齿——全都是金属的。头颅中央似乎有一条金属条，下巴上也伸出一条金属条。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Eight metallic arms jut from its body in an array around the rotund, globular head, three claw-like fingers decorating each.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 它圆滚滚的球形头部周围，伸出八条金属手臂，每条手臂上都装饰着三个爪状的手指。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Its single eye glows with an putrid, sickly yellow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 它那只独眼闪烁着腐臭、病态的黄色光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I really can't overstate how hideous this bastard is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我真的无法用语言形容这个玩意有多恶心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Like whoever created it has *problems.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 感觉创造它的人自己就有*问题*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And made a *choice.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 而且还是*故意这么选的*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((someday he'll get the jokes. someday))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（总有一天他会明白这些笑话的。总有一天。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "SCHRHAR, LHIRM HAR HAR HAR HAR, HHMAR, HARHKM!!" The floating thing hollers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "斯查哈、利姆哈哈哈、哈马、哈克姆！！"那个漂浮的东西在呼喊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You have time to react as its claws stretch out. That same sickly yellow energy as his eye, builds between them. A beam hits you, hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 它的利爪伸了出来，你有时间反应。那和它眼睛里一样的病态黄色能量，在爪子间聚集起来。一道光束狠狠地击中了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You have no time to react as its claws stretch out. That same sickly yellow energy as his eye, builds between them. A beam hits you, hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 它的利爪伸了出来，你根本来不及反应。那和它眼睛里一样的病态黄色能量，在爪子间聚集起来。一道光束狠狠地击中了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d8
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d8

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The smell of... stomach bile hits. Of the alley out the back of a tavern the afternoon after a long night on a hot summer day. It's enough to make you want to send your own insides onto the ground.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 一股……胃胆汁的气味扑面而来。那是夏日午后，酒馆后巷里弥漫的恶臭，仿佛熬过漫漫长夜之后，令人作呕。这气味足以让人恨不得把内脏都吐出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: All right everyone. Saving throws against constitution.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好了，各位。接下来进行抵抗体质的豁免检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((i'll tell you that when we get there.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（到时我再告诉你。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((LOLL I love iiit. NEW HOUSE RULE: all dirty twenties are forthwith to be known as a VEINTE SUCIOS.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哈哈，我喜欢。新规则：所有接近 20 的，统称为"VEINTE SUCIOS"。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((gonna have to buff these bosses though ffs you people and these rolls today...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（看来得加强一下这些 boss 了，真是服了你们这些人，你们今天掷骰子的手气也太好了……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((wait. we're at a banquet. ... we're doing...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（等等，我们正在参加宴会……我们正在……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((i have to, the temptation--))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我得这么做，这诱惑——））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You spent far too much time talking. The horrific blob monster with arms was right on top of you when he fired up his Rot Beam.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你花了太多时间聊天。就在那个长着手臂的可怕肉团怪物，在你面前发射腐化光束的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wanderer, Reyland, Ixchel, you each take 14 damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 流浪者、雷兰、伊克塞尔，你们每人受到 14 点伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wanderer, Reyland, Ixchel, you each take 16 damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 流浪者、雷兰、伊克塞尔，你们每人受到 16 点伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Now now, don't destroy them entirely, my dear sweet Hekholder!" the undead thing in the chair starts to push up from his chair with a groan like an old man. "I need their bodies in one piece!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "好了好了，别把他们全部毁掉，我亲爱的海克看守者！"椅子上的不死生物像个老头子一样呻吟着，开始从椅子上站起来。"我需要他们的完整尸体！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Arthur... you take 28...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 亚瑟……你受到 28 点伤害……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Arthur... you take 32...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 亚瑟……你受到 32 点伤害……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He shuffles around the head of the table, leaning on the back of the chair and into the light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他绕到桌子主位，倚在椅背上，进入了光线之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He isn't just a skeleton, like Commander Nach - but a Lich. A large gold disk in the shape of a lock, like an aristocratic collar from days of yore, sits around his neck. It weighs him down, pulling and arching his back toward the ground.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他并非像指挥官纳奇那样只是一具骷髅，而是一个巫妖。他脖子上戴着一块巨大的金色圆盘，形状像一把锁，如同昔日贵族佩戴的项圈。圆盘沉重地压着他，将他的背部拉扯着，使他的背弓向地面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yup. I'm sorry... And I'm going to need you to start by immediately giving me a death saving throw.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 是的，我很抱歉……首先，你需要立刻给我进行一次死亡豁免检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He grasps his hands in front of him, turning his boney fingers together. You can see where he's done it the bones are polished brighter from the repetitive motion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他双手交握在身前，骨节分明的指尖并拢。你可以看到，由于反复的动作，骨头表面被磨得更加光滑闪亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll a d20. 10 or higher keeps you on the brink. 9 or lower counts as a fail. 3 fails, you're dead. Nat 1 counts as two fails, Nat 20, you're brought back with 1 hp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 掷一个 d20。10 点或更高算作濒死。9 点或更低算作失败。3 次失败，你死亡。掷出 1 点算作 2 次失败，掷出 20 点，你复活并恢复 1 点生命值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Golden chains attach his wrists to the golden lock at his neck. "Yes, well, you see, I think you are perhaps understanding how hopeless your situation is now, hm?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 金链将他的手腕与脖子上的金锁连接起来。"是啊，你看，我想你现在或许明白你的处境有多么绝望了吧？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Not only do you face a Hekholder... but I am the dreaded... the feared..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你面对的不仅是一个海克看守者……而我，是那个令人恐惧……令人畏惧的……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Lord Alan V!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "阿伦 V 勋爵！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Really? One of you is already at the gate of death. Two of your friends are already being converted." He chuckles.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "真的吗？你们当中有一个人已经走到了死亡的边缘。你的两个朋友已经皈依我们了。"他轻笑了一声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((...seriously?!))

"Sit. Drink. Eat. It will put you into a stupor. My program is painless. You will feel nothing but the warmth of the camaraderie of friends as all the desire for meaning in your life just... floats away."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "坐下。喝水。吃东西。这会让你昏昏欲睡。我的疗程毫无痛苦。你只会感受到朋友们之间温暖的友谊，而你对人生意义的所有渴望都会……烟消云散。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((i thought you had a head cold when you said it!! who TF is named ALAD V. it sounds like some shitty off brand salad dressing))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你​说​这​话​的​时候​我​还​以​为​你​感冒​了​呢！​AL​AD V ​到​底​是​谁​啊？​听起来​像​是​什么​杂牌​的​劣质​沙拉酱。））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((ZESTY RANCH and SMOOTH BUTTERCREAM, by ALAD V: your salad's best friend!!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿拉德 V 出品的劲爽牧场酱和顺滑奶油霜：沙拉的最佳搭档！！）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Mm? Did you think our mutual acquaintance led you down here simply to die?" Lord V chuckles. "He could have done that easily himself, or left you to the city guards. No no, nothing so... mundane."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯？你以为我们共同的熟人把你引到这里来只是为了送死吗？"V 勋爵轻笑一声。"他完全可以亲自动手，或者把你交给城卫兵。不不，不会那么……普通。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I commend your spirit. It will be a good one to add to our collection. But we shall see how long you stay so ardently committed... Hekholder! Deal with them!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我赞赏你的精神。这会是我们收藏中的一件佳品。但我们还要看看你能保持这种热情多久……海克看守者！去对付他们！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((ooh i'm gonna stop right now before the jokes get reeeaaal weiiiird. lets go with Lord V))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哦，我得赶紧停下来了，免得笑话变得太奇怪。咱们先来说说 V 勋爵吧。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "My E.X.I.M.U.S. program is not cruel, you see. No, no. It is a kindness in a cruel world! It simply takes all desire for free will away from its participants!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我的卓越者计划并不残酷，你看。不，不。这反倒是残酷世界里的一种仁慈！它只是剥夺了参与者对自由意志的所有渴望！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You all watch as Cedric crumples to the ground with a metallic thunk, his blessed sword rolling from his hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们都眼睁睁地看着​塞德​里克重重地摔倒在地，发出金属撞击声，他手中的圣剑也滚落下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You all watch as Cedric crumples to the ground with a thump. Maybe if he had his armor, he wouldn't have died so easily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你们眼睁睁地看着塞德里克重重地倒在地上。如果他穿着盔甲，或许就不会那么轻易死去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He gestures at Sanguina and Morohime, who still sit, staring emptily at the food in front of them. "Look. See how they want for nothing? Need nothing? They will live forever in stasis. Perfect as they are. Content... as they are."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他指了指桑吉娜和诸姬，她们依然坐在那里，目光空洞地盯着面前的食物。"瞧，她们什么都不缺，什么都不需要。她们将永远保持这种静止的状态。她们现在这样就很完美，很满足。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for initiative, Wanderer, Ixchel, and Reyland. First, Cedric, make another death saving throw.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 流浪者、伊克塞尔和雷兰掷骰决定先攻。首先是塞德​里克，再进行一次死亡豁免检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Roll for initiative, Wanderer, Ixchel, and Reyland.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 流浪者、伊克塞尔和雷兰掷骰决定先攻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ixchel, you can feel that his life is teetering on the veil between the Here and Hereafter. But unfortunately, you all have other problems on your hands. Namely, the giant hideous creature looming over you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 伊克塞尔，你能感觉到他的生命正徘徊在生死边缘。但不幸的是，你们还有其他问题要处理。那就是，那个正笼罩在你们头顶的巨大丑陋生物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Peaceful and content in the company of their friends." He almost sounds honestly pleased. "And in exchange? Oh, well, I am certain they will be willing to serve whatever plans the Royal Family desires, of course. To protect this new stasis."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "她们和朋友们在一起，过着平静而满足的生活。"他的语气几乎带着真诚的喜悦。"作为交换？哦，我确信他们当然愿意为皇室的任何计划效力，以维护这种新出现的稳定局面。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "That is the part about all of this I think you might find the hardest to believe." He goes to stand behind Morohime, and puts his long, skeletal hands over the back of her chair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我想，这件事最让你难以置信的就是这一点。"他走到诸姬身后，将他那双修长而骨瘦如柴的手搭在她的椅背上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Play. The fking. GAME.))
"Which is why I haven't bothered telling you." If a skeleton could smile, he would be. "To save the world!" He cackles as if it's the funniest thing in the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "所以我才懒得告诉你。"如果骷髅会笑，他现在一定在笑。"为了拯救世界！"他咯咯地笑着，仿佛这是世界上最好笑的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((2/3)) "Are you certain you do not want to surrender to my program? Your Paladin friend, ah... does not seem to be doing so well... I can save his life. In a manner of speaking."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（2/3））"你确定不想接受我的计划吗？你的圣骑士朋友，呃……情况似乎不太好……我可以救他的命。某种程度上来说。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yep. You can't attack, but you get to move and do a bonus action. We'll get there once everyone else does their setup.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没错。你不能攻击，但可以移动并使用一个额外动作。等其他人都掷完后，我们再来讨论这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yep. You can't attack, but you get to move and do a bonus action. We'll get there once everyone else does their setup.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没错。你不能攻击，但可以移动并使用一个额外动作。等其他人都掷完后，我们再来讨论这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The encroaching Entropy. The emptiness that has come to consume us all." All the villainous glee flees his voice. He is quite serious now. Even the Hekholder's metal arms droop a little, the disgusting flesh at the corners of his mouth creasing in a frown.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "从不断侵蚀的熵。那终将吞噬我们所有人的虚无。"他语气中的邪恶狂热荡然无存，此刻他神情严肃。就连海克看守者的金属手臂也微微垂下，嘴角那令人作呕的血肉皱成一团。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Life, death... Happiness, sadness..." Lord V gestures at the table in front of him. "This never-ending pantomime we play of 'Good Versus Evil.' As tiring as it is, it is better than the alternative."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "生命，死亡……快乐，悲伤……"V 勋爵指了指面前的桌子。"我们上演的这出永无止境的‘善与恶'假面戏。虽然令人疲惫，但总比另一种选择要好。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "So I ask you, what are a few small sacrifices, especially when we can... make it humane, mmh?" He pats Morohime gently on the head, almost like one would an adored pet. "None of you will be the wiser to what has changed. And in fact, you will all be the stronger for it!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "所以我问你们，一些小小的牺牲又算得了什么呢？尤其是在我们能够……以人道方式处理的情况下，嗯？"他轻轻拍了拍诸姬的头，就像对待心爱的宠物一样。"你们谁也不会察觉到发生了什么变化。事实上，你们都会因此变得更加强大！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You will not age. You will have new powers. You will have a stronger bond with those like you. And all that will happen in exchange...?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你们不会衰老。你们会拥有新的力量。你们会与同类建立更牢固的联系。而这一切的代价是……？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You will lose all your ability to decide upon your own future. And, when the Royal Family has need of you, you will answer the call." He chuckles. "But day to day? Nothing but peace. Contentment. All the summer days you could desire."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你将失去所有决定自己未来的能力。当王室需要你的时候，你必须响应召唤。"他轻笑一声。"但日常生活呢？只有平静与满足，以及你梦寐以求的所有夏日时光。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((HOOOOOOW hgiaejf;ldms))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（怎么会 hgiaejf;ldms））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Mm. I fear your Paladin friend does not have long by the looks of things." He shuffles back towards his chair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯，看来你的圣骑士朋友时日不多了。"他拖着脚步走回自己的椅子旁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "As you wish." He shuffles back towards his chair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "如你所愿。"他拖着脚步走回椅子旁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric, make another death saving roll.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德​里克，再进行一次死亡豁免检定。
