/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((even if you take out the hekholder somehow, you still have Lord V to deal with remember))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（即使你设法除掉了海克看守者，别忘了你还得对付 V 勋爵））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((the two of them combined have like... 495 hit points? you have... uh... considerably less than that))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（他们两个加起来有……495 点生命值？你的生命值……呃……比这少得多。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((why, rethinking V's offer?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（怎么了，在重新考虑 V 的提议？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Reyland, you're up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 雷兰，轮到你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Take your bonus move, Drifter!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（漂泊者，用你的额外回合！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You would think so," Lord V interjects. "I apologize for eavesdroping, but the echo in here is *quite* miserable and I can hear *absolutely* everything you're saying."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你们​当然​会​这么​想，"​V 勋爵​插​话道。​"很​抱​歉​偷听，​但​这里​的​回声​实​在​太大​了，​我​能​清楚​地​听到​你们​说​的​每​一​句​话。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "There is no guard against my E.X.I.M.U.S. creations going against the Royal Family. Namely?" He spreads his bony hands out at his sides. "Because they never asked me to make one."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "具体来说？没有任何措施可以阻止我的卓越者造物与皇室对抗。"他摊开骨节分明的双手。"因为他们从未要求我制造一个。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "You have a flicker of uncertainty in your eye, Wanderer... care to change your mind?" Lord V's tone is free of judgement, free of gloating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "流浪者，你眼中闪过一丝犹豫……你是否愿意改变主意？"V 大人的语气中没有评判，也没有幸灾乐祸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He's distracted so I'm going to say you roll with advantage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他分心了，所以我认为你占优势。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sure, how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 当然可以，怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "One would think!" He cackles. "But the very rich and powerful are often entirely blind to their own shortcomings. Or, perhaps, it is very much by design."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "按理说大家都会这么想！"他咯咯地笑道。"但那些真正有钱有权的人往往对自己的缺点视而不见。或者，也许，这完全是他们有意为之。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Perhaps the Royal Family does not wish to survive the fight against the Entropy. And they see my program as both the weapon to aim against the enemy... and themselves."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "或许皇室并不想在对抗熵的战斗中幸存下来。他们把我的计划视为一件武器，既可以对付敌人……也可以对付他们自己。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Lord V tilts his head just slightly to the side. "Would it, ah, make you feel any better if I told you I felt the same?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: V 勋爵微微歪着头。"如果我告诉你我也有同样的感觉，你会感觉好些吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Better think quick.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（最好想快点。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Murder-suicide. Such a tragic tale and one often told. You, my dear sweet friends, are simply the daggers in the dark."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "谋杀——自杀。多么悲惨的故事，而且屡见不鲜。你们，我亲爱的朋友们，就像黑暗中的匕首。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Friends in strange places, indeed." He gestures again at the waiting seats at the table.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "居然还能在这种奇怪的地方交到朋友。"他再次指了指桌边的空位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Silently, he gestures again at the waiting seats at the table.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他默默地再次向桌边的空位做了个手势。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm afraid... your luck has finally run out, Lord Reyland Kingsacre.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 恐怕……你的好运终于用完了，雷兰·金斯克雷勋爵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Make a deceit roll. Though uh.. this guy is dumb as a toaster with a -8 on Int soooooo...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（进行一次欺骗检定。不过……这家伙笨得像个烤面包机，智力 -8，所以……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Come. Sit. Please." He gestures at the three empty chairs at his table. "I promise you, this is meant to be."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "来，坐。"他指了指桌旁的三把空椅子。"我向你们保证，这是命中注定的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: That's an attack. So no. Not unless you wanna whip it at him like a crimpee.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 那​可是​攻击。​所以​不行。​除非​你​想​把​它​像​扁饼​一样​甩​在​他​身上。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: LOL.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As... a distraction? Not an attack?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 作为一种……转移注意力的方式？而不是攻击？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ooookkaaay... gimmie a fitness check.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧……给我一个体能检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You aim your Nobleizer at the back of the Hekholder, aim... fire... BANG.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你用你的升爵者瞄准海克看守者的后面，瞄准……开火……砰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You reach into your satchel. Blearily, Nach blinks up at you. "What is it NOW, Heathen?! Why do you keep--"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你伸手去摸书包。纳奇睡眼惺忪地眨了眨眼，抬头看着你。"现在又有什么事，异教徒？！你为什么老是——"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Who're you asking, me or Lord V?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你是在问我还是问 V 勋爵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The shot echoes throughout the space, deafeningly loud in the huge stone chamber.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 枪声在房间里回荡，在巨大的石室里震耳欲聋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((oh we haven't hit one of these in a while looool like a discus. y'know like when you wheel back one of your glaives and really chuck it at somebody))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哦，我们好久没玩这种游戏了，哈哈哈哈，就像扔铁饼一样。你知道，就像你把长柄刀往后一甩，然后狠狠地砸向别人一样。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "HEKHOLDER?! IS THAT YOU?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "海克看守者？！是你吗？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ooookkaaay... gimmie a fitness check.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 好吧……给我一个体能检定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And you watch as your musket ball... bounces uselessly off the thick, leathery hide of the Hekholder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你眼睁睁地看着你的火枪子弹……无力地从海克看守者厚实的皮肤上弹开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((tbf now that I think about it i think crimpee is a brand name for a pie tin.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（说实话，现在想想，扁饼好像是一个馅饼模具牌子。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I haven't seen you since the Academy!" He laughs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "自从学院毕业后我就没见过你了！"他笑着说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((That's enough without the bonuses, don't worry about it.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（不用额外回合也够了，不用担心。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "No. You couldn't have won. And this fight you never were designed to win."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不，你不可能赢。而且这场战斗，你本来就不是来赢的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Maybe if you all hadn't kept ditching the game and stuck together you wouldn't be in this situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如果你们当初没有总是放弃游戏，而是团结一致，或许就不会陷入这种境地了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He turns back around to look at you, confused. "HRMHRMRHM?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他转过身来，一脸困惑地看着你。"赫尔姆赫尔姆赫尔姆？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The Hekholder's single eye goes wide. "HHERH ILSTHILM ESR HM?! HAR HAR HAR HAR!!" You think the choking sound you're hearing is laughing, but you can't be sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 赫克霍尔德的独眼瞪得老大。"赫尔哈伊尔斯提姆伊斯赫姆？！哈哈哈哈哈哈！！"你觉得你听到的那种窒息声是笑声，但你无法确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You reach into your satchel and produce the keys you stole off the Captain of the Guard and with a flourish...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你伸手从挎包里掏出从卫队长那里偷来的钥匙，然后潇洒地……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Or, perhaps, this was all planned from the very beginning, long before you arrived. And by hands steering puppet strings that connect to even I."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "或许，这一切从一开始就是计划好的，在你到来之前很久就已定下。甚至连我都是由幕后操纵者牵着线操控。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Or maybe this was all inevitable from the very beginning like everything is in this doomed existence of ours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 或者也许这一切从一开始就是注定的，就像我们这注定走向毁灭的存在一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I know, those really were the days!" Nach grins and then looks up at you. "Hey. Toss me over, wouldja? We go way back."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "是啊，以前那些日子真美好啊！"纳奇咧嘴一笑，然后抬头看向你。"嘿，把我扔过去好吗？我们是老熟人了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hurl them at the Hekholder's face. Which is, coincidentally, also his body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 把它们扔向海克看守者的脸。巧合的是，那也是他的身体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "But to answer that question, one would have to have the power to examine fate and causality in far more detail than even I can..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "但是要回答这个问题，就必须拥有比我更深入地研究命运和因果关系的能力……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But I guess to answer that question, you'd have to "punch the floor" wouldn't you?! We've been playing for a while. Let's finish the session.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但我想，要回答这个问题，你得"捶地板"才行吧？！我们已经玩了一会儿了，咱们结束这局吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Nach, still dangling from one of the eight arms, rolls his one remaining eye. "These heathens are SO RUDE."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 纳奇仍然挂在八条手臂中的一条上，翻了个白眼。"这些异教徒真是太没礼貌了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: His fleshy cheeks go a little pink, and he turns around to hide his obvious blush. "RURH NH RMHMl?!?!?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他肉乎乎的脸颊泛起淡淡的红晕，他转过身去掩饰自己明显的羞涩。"露丝​恩姆赫？！？！？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It falls uselessly to the ground at your feet. The Hekholder just sort of blinks at you, confused.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 它毫无作用地落在你脚边。海克看守者只是困惑地眨了眨眼看着你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Direct hit!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 直接命中！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Freedom from the agony of what could have been is what I am offering you, mm, yes?" Lord V gestures at the chairs. "Now...sit."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我所提供的，是让你摆脱那些本可能实现的痛苦，嗯，是这样吧？"V 勋爵指了指椅子。"现在……坐下。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Who're you asking, me or Lord V?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你是在问我还是问 V 勋爵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You hear the sound of bone hitting bone as Lord V slaps his forehead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你听到骨头敲骨头的声音，那是 V 勋爵拍在打自己额头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The Hekholder's frown deepens. "HRMHRMRHM...."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 赫克霍尔德的眉头皱得更紧了。"赫尔姆赫尔姆赫尔姆……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Stop this nonsense. Come, Wanderer. Join your friends. Please. They are having a lovely time!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "别胡​闹​了。​来​吧，​流浪者。​加入​你​的​朋友​吧。​求​你​了。​她们​玩得​很​开心！"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The Hekholder grabs it in one of his metal hands, still gargle-laughing. He turns around to have a "private conversation." Which is, of course, extremely public.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 海克看守者用他那只金属手抓住他，一边发出咕噜咕噜的笑声。他转过身去进行"私人谈话"。当然，这谈话实际上是在公开场合进行的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You might not have distracted him, but you sure as shit confused him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你或许没能分散他的注意力，但你肯定让他懵了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: No. You can't win. And this fight you never were designed to win.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不，你赢不了。而且这场战斗，你本来就不是来赢的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Perhaps if you hadn't abandoned your friends and allowed them to be dragged away, you wouldn't be so overwhelmed."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "如果你当初没有抛弃朋友，任由他们被带走，或许你就不会感到如此不知所措了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Maybe if you all hadn't kept ditching the game and stuck together you wouldn't be in this situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 如果你们当初没有总是放弃游戏，而是团结一致，或许就不会陷入这种境地了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text:
"RURH NH RMHML, HRL RHM HEHIERHM?" 
"Oh, Kela? Good, good. Still asks about you." 
"HR, HEMR?!?!!"
"Yes, really!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText:
"露丝​恩姆赫，​赫尔拉赫​姆赫拉赫姆？" 
"哦，​Kela？​很​好，​很​好。​还​在​问起​你。" 
​"赫尔，​赫姆尔？！？"​
​"是​的，​真的！"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Really, this is pointless - come, sit, join us. Drink! Your friends are having a wonderful time with us," Lord V calls to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "真的，这毫无意义——来，坐下，加入我们。喝吧！你的朋友们和我们在一起玩得很开心，"V 勋爵向你招手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Unfortunately, they're keys. They bounce right off and land on the floor beneath him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 遗憾的是，那只是钥匙。它们弹开后落在了他脚下的地板上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "DE NADA"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "DE NADA"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Freedom from the agony of what could have been is what I am offering you, mm, yes?" Lord V gestures at the chairs. "Now...sit."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我所提供的，是让你摆脱那些本可能实现的痛苦，嗯，是这样吧？"V 勋爵指了指椅子。"现在……坐下。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Or, perhaps, this was all planned from the very beginning, long before you arrived. And by hands steering puppet strings that connect to even I."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "或许，这一切从一开始就是计划好的，在你到来之前很久就已定下。甚至连我都是由幕后操纵者牵着线操控。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Or maybe this was all inevitable from the very beginning like everything is in this doomed existence of ours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 或者也许这一切从一开始就是注定的，就像我们这注定走向毁灭的存在一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He blinks at you, a frown on his giant, Mr. Gourdo Head shaped face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他对你眨了眨眼，他那张巨大的、像古尔多先生头一样的脸上带着一丝不悦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "But to answer that question, one would have to have the power to examine fate and causality in far more detail than even I can..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "但是要回答这个问题，就必须拥有比我更深入地研究命运和因果关系的能力……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: But I guess to answer that question, you'd have to "punch the floor" wouldn't you?! We've been playing for a while. Let's finish the session.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 但我想，要回答这个问题，你得"捶地板"才行吧？！我们已经玩了一会儿了，咱们结束这局吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The liquid tastes like normal wine on your tongue. It warms you like a fire. And as it spreads through you, you feel a laughter bubble up in your chest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这液体入口和普通的葡萄酒没什么两样。它像火一样温暖着你。随着这股暖流蔓延开来，你感到一股笑意从胸腔涌出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Lord V lifts his hands in a show of harmlessness. "She will be asleep at your feet when you wake. She will love you no less. And she, like you, shall never age. She will be at your side forever."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: V 勋爵举起双手，表示自己并无恶意。"当你醒来时，她会睡在你的脚边。她对你的爱丝毫不减。而且，她和你一样，永远不会衰老。她会永远在你身边。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It's like someone has just made a joke in the room and you just got it for the first time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就像有人在房间里讲了个笑话，而你一下就听懂了一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: You smile in real happiness. A familiar voice - the man in the black and purple cloak comes from over your shoulder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你露出了发自内心的笑容。一个熟悉的声音——身穿黑紫色斗篷的男人——从你的肩后传来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Would you rather I put her down?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "你宁愿我把她杀掉吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((no amiiiir))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（别啊，阿米尔））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((be strong!! you can do it!!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（坚强！！你能行的！！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((FIGHT IT AMIR! FIGHT! TURN AWAY FROM THE PUN!!!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿米尔，反抗！反抗！别管这个双关语！！！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((u don't know what dinner rolls are...? o_O))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你不知道餐包是什么吗……？ o_O））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: [PH] Just get on with it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: [PH] Just get on with it

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric merely nods. It's part of the job.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克只点了点头。这是他份内的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric smirks. He's used to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克露出一丝冷笑。他早就习惯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric winks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克眨了眨眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Sigh... Yeah...))
((Eh. I've taken worse from you on a casual Saturday night.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（呃，你平时在周六晚上随便来一下都比这狠多了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Once they get close, I'll reach for them and help pull them up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 等他们靠近，我就会伸手去拉他们上来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'll reach over and help pull them ashore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我会伸手过去，帮忙把他们拉上岸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Oh, *sod off!*))
/roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir. Enough is enough. Listen to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔。够了。听我说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: We're all here beside you. You aren't alone in this. Not now, not next loop, not the loop after that. I don't care how many will come, I don't care how many will go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们​都​在​你​身边。​你​并不​孤单。​现在​不​是，​下​一​个​轮回​不​是，​再​下​一​个​轮回​也​不​是。​我​不​在乎​有​多​少​人​会​来，​我​也​不​在乎​有​多​少​人​会​走。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And I don't care how many times I'll say this. I don't care if I'm forced to. I don't care if it's free will or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不在乎要说多少遍。我不在乎是不是被迫的。我不在乎是不是出于自由意志。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Because I will stay by your side until the end of days, one way or another. Choice or no choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 因为​无论​如何，​我​都​会​在​你​身边​直​到​世界​末日。​不管​有​得选​还​是​没​得选。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Because we're family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 因为我们是家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Then why make us all sit around and play for hours if you don't like doing it?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 既然你不喜欢玩，为什么还要让我们大家坐着玩好几个小时呢？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I... no. Just... no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我……不。就……不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 等一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I... really hate to do this, Amir. I have to go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，我……真的不想这样做。但我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I know, I know! I'm so sorry. Minerva is here, and there's something up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我知道，我知道！我很抱歉。米尼娃来了，出了点状况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: There was suspicious activity out in the city and she needs a second set of eyes to confirm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 城里出现了一些可疑活动，她需要第二个人帮忙确认一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm really sorry, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 伙计，我真的很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I apologize for not wanting us to all to die horribly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我只是不希望大家死得太惨，这也要道歉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Did you... do that art by hand?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 那幅画……是你手搓的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: No, I was just going to say that it's fun. I like it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不，我只是想说它很有趣。我很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: No, strangely. Whatever it was, was long gone by the time we got there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没有，很奇怪。但不管那是什么，等我们赶到时，它早就消失得无影无踪了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: That's not what I said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我没那么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: This is going to be a disaster, I can tell already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这肯定是场灾难，我已经感觉到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Shit. I mean. What?!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（该死。我说，什么？！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I. Hate. You.))
Cedric
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: uh
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 呃

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Tries to escape?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 尝试​逃走？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((What?!))
((Which... is better?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哪种……比较好？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Ok. Wriggling.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好吧。扭出来。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Ok. Brute strength.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（好吧，蛮力。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I blame you for whatever happens next...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（接下来​发生​什么​都​怪​你​……））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I stand upon the gallows, the noose around my neck. I cannot help but think about the feeling of rope around my neck and wonder if they tied it fresh, or if I'll be left with a second-hand rope that'll be too loose and leave me gasping for breath for the entertainment of the crowd.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我站在绞刑架上，绞索套在脖子上。我不禁想起绞索套在脖子上的感觉，琢磨着他们是用刚系上的新绳，还是会给我一条松垮的旧绳，那样的话，我就会因窒息而喘息不止，供人群取乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sol is in my eyes, glaring and raw. Where it might be cheerful for others, it seems to mock me now. The light that I followed all my life is here to laugh at me like the children who are jeering at my imminent demise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阳光刺进我的眼睛，刺眼而刺骨。在别人眼中或许是明媚的阳光，此刻却仿佛在嘲弄我。那道我追随了一生的光，此刻却像那些嘲笑我即将死去的小孩一样，在这里嘲笑我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't know how exactly it did, but I know my fool-hardy stubborn dedication to always following the "righteous path" was what got me into this mess. Why? Because it's always what gets me into situations like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不知道具体是怎么回事，但我知道，正是我那种鲁莽固执、总想走"正道"的执念，才让我陷入了这个烂摊子。为什么？因为每次都是这样，我才会陷入如此境地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Gods know my sister told me that enough. Gods know my sister was going to remind me of that if she ever finds me in the afterlife.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 天知道我姐姐已经跟我说过无数次了。天知道如果她有天在来世找到我，肯定还会提醒我这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Gods know my sister was probably going to resurrect my damnable corpse to remind me of that in about... ten minutes, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 天知道我姐姐大概会在……十分钟后，把我的这具该死的尸体复活，好提醒我这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As I stand upon the gallows, I sigh, and look out at the crowd.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我站在绞刑架上，叹了口气，望向人群。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Someone has corrupted you - someone pulls your strings from the shadows. These actions... are not your doing."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "有人腐蚀了你——有人在暗处操纵着你。这些行为……并非出自你的本意。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The light forgives you all. I forgive you all. I hope someday you forgive yourself."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "愿光明原谅你们所有人。我也原谅了你们所有人。希望有一天，你们也能原谅自己。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((What? Did I do something wrong?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（什么？我做错什么了吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Just because I don't get this whole R.P.G. nonsense doesn't mean I don't know how to string a few words together in a cohesive sentence--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 虽然我不懂这角色扮演游戏的胡说八道，但这并不代表我不会把几个词串成一句通顺的句子——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((It is remarkable the extent to which I really do not care.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我这种漠不关心的程度真是令人惊叹。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: First thing's first, I'm going to take the noose from around my neck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 首先，我要把套在脖子上的绞索取下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Well, seeing as there's no hope of getting the ropes off my wrists - which would have been the *smart* thing to do...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 唉，既然手腕上的绳子根本没法解开——这本来才是*明智*的做法……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm going to cast a single slot of Reckoning against the guard. I'm trying to stagger him more than anything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我打算对那名守卫施放一个"惩戒清算"法术。我主要是想让他失去平衡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I... suppose I am going to just charge the guard and throw my shoulder into his stomach and try to tackle him off the edge of the platform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我……我想我就直接冲向那个守卫，用肩膀撞他的肚子，然后把他从行刑台边缘扑下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((What're my options here, Amir? Wrists are still tied up and bound by a noose, yeah?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿米尔，我现在有什么选择来着？我的手腕还被绳子绑着，是吧？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d8
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d8

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Guess I'll just roll to try to break the ropes at my wrists again. I'll use strength.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（看来我只能再掷一次骰子，试试看能不能挣脱手腕上的绳子。我用力量属性来掷。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric, seeing no other options, and now that the guards are distracted by all the commotion, redoubles his efforts to rip his wrists free of the ropes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克见别无他法，加之守卫们此刻正被这阵骚动分散了注意力，便加倍努力地要将手腕从绳索中挣脱出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: 18... My sheet says... +5. 23?
/roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: .... Ah, shit.
I'm going to rip the noose off from around my neck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要把套在脖子上的绞索扯下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d6
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d6

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Pardon me, I hate to be a bother," Cedric says as he limps over... *his hands still tied behind his back.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "抱歉，我不想成为包袱，"塞德里克一边一瘸一拐地走过来说道……*他的双手仍被反绑在背后。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Great job, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，干得好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir, why don't we do this - let's split up. The game is getting too long to do in one sit-down realistically anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，不如咱们这样吧——分头行动。这游戏实在太长了，一次实在玩不完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Half the group didn't even get to take turns during the fight yesterday, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 说到底，昨天打架的时候，有一半的人甚至都没轮到上场呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: No, we went down to the dungeon, and you said you had to cut it short anyway. Remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不，我们去了地牢，你说反正你也要提前结束。记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So let's split up. Lettie, Quincy, and I will go investigate with Velimir. Eleanor and Aoi will stay and play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 那我们分头行动吧。莱蒂、昆西和我跟维利米尔一起去调查。埃莉诺和碧留下来玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I don't remember you being able to speak Tenochtitlán, Quincy. Have you always been able to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​不​记得​你​会​说​特诺奇蒂兰特语了，​昆西。​你​一直​都​会​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What'd we miss yesterday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 昨天​我们​错过​了​什么​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What did you do to me, Drifter?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你对我做了什么，漂泊者？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((You left my gear behind?!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你把我的装备丢下了？！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I head to the shore of the... channel? Eager to get out of the water.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​走向……​水道​的​岸边？​迫不​及​待地​想​从​水里​出来​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Fine by me.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我没意见。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((What have you done...?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（你都做了什么……？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Charming."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "暴击队友。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Right."
"Heh."
"Water, Wind, Fire..."
"They have to be names, right? We're missing names."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "肯定是名字吧？我们少了几个名字。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Not the first time your fun got me killed. Probably won't be the last. Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 这已经不是第一次因为你的恶作剧害我送命了。恐怕也不会是最后一次。呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cedric jumps into the hole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 塞德里克跳进了洞里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I didn't want a big long debate. Someone had to go in. It should be me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不想辩论个没完没了。总得有人进去。应该就是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: What she said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就​是​她​说​的​那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: No. If you won't call this shit out, I will. Amir, what is going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 不行。如果你不想点明这破事，那我来问。阿米尔，到底怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Didn't you make it, Amir...?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿米尔，这难道不是你设计的吗……？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((What's a dinner roll?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（餐包是什么？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Don't encourage them.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（别跟他们起哄。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Oh, I see. I get it.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哦，我明白了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((That's my maximum hit points...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这是我的最大生命值……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((That's more than what I've got for maximum hit points...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这比我目前的最大生命值还要多……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((FSS. How are they getting *worse?!*))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我真服了。怎么会越来越*糟？！*））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Hah hah.))
((FSS. How are they getting *worse?!*))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我真服了。怎么会越来越*糟？！*））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Glad you're okay, Amir. Don't ever scare me like that again. (Though that Entropy getup? Not half bad...)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，很高兴你没事。以后别再吓我了。（不过，你那身熵装扮？还真不错……）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am judging you very harshly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我正在对你进行严厉的批判

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Lettie, aren't we scheduled for a fight on the roof? I think you're mad at me about... something
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 莱蒂，我们不是约好在屋顶打一架吗？我觉得你好像在生我的气……因为什么事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Thank Sol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 感谢太阳神

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: So very ready...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我已经准备好了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Present and accounted for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 已到场，确认完毕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I was not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我可没有！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Does this have anything to do with the fact that you kept misplacing all your notes last adventure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你上次冒险时老是把笔记弄丢不会就是因为这个吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Lies and slander!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 造谣污蔑！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Your own fault for not saying I couldn't. He was quite charming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你又没说我不能这样做。他确实挺有魅力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Ssshh Quincy, let Amir savor the moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嘘，昆西，让阿米尔先高兴一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Time for the mayhem to begin!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 是时候让混乱开始了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Me? I never get us into any trouble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我？​我​从​来​没​给​我们​找​过​什么​岔子。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I adore you for this, Amir.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（阿米尔，我太喜欢你这一点了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Mmm, not to be the resident history nerd, but rifling was around as early as the 15th century. It just merely wasn't common until the mid 19th.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（嗯，我不想显得像个历史迷，膛线技术早在 15 世纪就已经出现了。只是直到 19 世纪中期才变得普及。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((It was reserved for hunting and the like due to its high cost. So our lovely posh gentleman here could have arguably had access to a rifled musket capable of shooting in a straight line.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（由于价格昂贵，这种枪械通常仅用于狩猎等用途。我们这位优雅的上流绅士，或许确实能够弄到一把能够直线射击的线膛火枪。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sanguina Kallisti watches the affair with an electric kind of conflict in her chest. For her brother is on that platform, about to die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 桑吉娜·卡利斯蒂目睹这一切时，胸中涌动着一种如电流般剧烈的矛盾感。因为她的弟弟就在那个刑台上，即将死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Which, ostensibly, is a terrible thing. For she loves her brother very much and would not want something like that to befall him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 乍看之下，这显然是一件糟糕透顶的事。因为她非常爱自己的弟弟，绝对不希望这种事发生在他身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yet on the other hand, she feels the tightening of the guillotine around her neck like the embrace of a lover's hand, ever so slightly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 然而另一方面，她却感觉到断头台的绞索正像情人的双臂般轻轻地搭在她的脖子上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: The call of her Patron. The Will of her Other. The Great Nameless One who delights not just in death itself, but precisely this manner of death. Of EXECUTIONS.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 她守护神的召唤。她的"另一位"的意志。那位伟大的无名者，不仅喜爱死亡本身，更沉醉于这种特定的死亡方式——处决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Cold death. Empty death. Perfunctory. The crowd is immaterial to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 冰冷的死亡。空洞的死亡。敷衍了事。人群对它而言无关紧要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Sanguina can only summon her tome to her hands. She cannot look away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 桑吉娜只能将那本魔书召唤到手中。她无法移开视线。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I was enjoying watching the show, for one.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我光看戏就满足了，倒是。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Is that really the priority, when there are reinforcements on the way?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "现在真应该做这个事吗？援军已经快来了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I side with the Wanderer," I say as I fold my arms most annoyedly across my chest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我支持流浪者，"我说着，一脸恼怒地将双臂交叉在胸前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Hah! Oh, brother, I thought the look suited you, forgive me." I take out my dagger and quickly cut the bonds. I'm careful not to cut him. This time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "哈！哦，弟弟，我还以为这副打扮挺适合你的，对不起啊。"我掏出匕首，迅速割断了绳索。这次我小心翼翼地没割到他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Fascinating story as always, Amir dear. Have a wonderful rest of your day, everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 故事一如既往地精彩，亲爱的阿米尔。祝大家剩下的时间过得愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Oh sh--" I yelp as I scramble to catch it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "哦，该死——"我惊叫着，急忙伸手去接。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I grab the head, making it look graceful. I look at his horrific and putrid visage. "Well. Hello, there, my new friend." I smile down at him. "We're going to have a grand time."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我抓起那颗头颅，动作显得优雅从容。我凝视着他那可怖又腐臭的面容。"呃，你好啊，我的新朋友。"我俯身对他微笑。"我们一定会玩得很尽兴。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Coyly, I smooth out a few of the stray hairs of his powdered wig as I tuck him into the satchel I keep *somewhere* in this wonderfully ludicrous outfit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​羞涩​地​抚平​他​扑​了​粉​的​假发​上​几​根​散落​的​头发，​然后​把​他​塞进​我​这​身​滑稽​可笑​的​服装​中​"某处"​的​挎包里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Like you had to ask.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（这还用问吗？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Oh, you know how to speak my language. Sadly, my worst would also drag dear morohime into the mix, and we can't have that... so a raincheck is in order.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哦，你真懂我的意思。可惜，如果我真要发飙的话，恐怕也会把亲爱的诸姬卷进来，这可不行……所以还是改天再说吧。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Do I look like I kick in this outfit?!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我​穿​这​身​衣服​看​起来​像​能​踢腿​的​样子​吗？！））​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Whatever will we use it for?))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我们会用它来做什么呢？））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I step forward. Lifting my hand, I smile sweetly, though I know he can't see. And with a gesture, I cast Occult Blast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我向前迈了一步。我举起手，甜甜地笑了笑，尽管我知道他看不见。随后，我挥了挥手，施放了秘术冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((You bloody kick the head!))
((Oh, don't answer that!!))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哦，别回答这个问题！！））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I step forward. Lifting my hand, I smile sweetly, though I know he can't see. And with a gesture, I cast Occult Blast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我向前迈了一步。我举起手，甜甜地笑了笑，尽管我知道他看不见。随后，我挥了挥手，施放了秘术冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Walked straight into that one, didn't I))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我这下可是自投罗网了，对吧））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((We can deal with the head AFTER there isn't a corpse with a hole in its chest wandering around trying to kill us))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（等不再有胸口被戳个洞的尸体在四处游荡、试图杀我们的时候，再去处理那颗脑袋也不迟））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d12, d12
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d12, d12

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d12, d12
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d12, d12

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Oh. Oh dear.))
((I feel like I'm going to owe an apology to our pet head.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（我觉得我应该向我们家的宠物脑袋道歉。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Oh. Oh dear.))
I look at his horrific and putrid visage. "Well. Hello, there, my new friend." I smile down at him. "We're going to have a grand time."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我凝视着他那可怖又腐臭的面容。"呃，你好啊，我的新朋友。"我俯身对他微笑。"我们一定会玩得很尽兴。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Coyly, I smooth out a few of the stray hairs of his powdered wig as I tuck him into the satchel I keep *somewhere* in this wonderfully ludicrous outfit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我​羞涩​地​抚平​他​扑​了​粉​的​假发​上​几​根​散落​的​头发，​然后​把​他​塞进​我​这​身​滑稽​可笑​的​服装​中​"某处"​的​挎包里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: As always, this was a blast. An "occult blast," if you will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 一如既往，这次真是太嗨了。如果要描述的话，简直是一场"秘术冲击波盛宴"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Velimir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 维利米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am so very ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我已经完全准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((I hate to point this out, dear, but I believe you have a typo there.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（亲爱的，虽然我不愿指出这一点，但我觉得那里有个错别字。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Hah! I'm rubbing off on you.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（哈哈！我影响到你了。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "It could be cursed," I say, and reach out a hand to stop her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这东西可能被诅咒了，"我说，同时伸出手阻止了她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Shrugging idly, I look away. "I tend to be the one casting curses, not the one in the business of ensuring others avoid them."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我漫不经心地耸了耸肩，转过头去。"我向来是那个施咒的人，而不是负责确保别人免受诅咒的人。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "The scroll is not going to have beer in it, darling."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "卷轴里不会有啤酒的，亲爱的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Oh, dear..." I frown. But there is an slight gleam of excitement in my eyes that I can't quite help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "哎呀……"我皱了皱眉。但眼中却闪过一丝难以抑制的兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "No! I am not." I fold my arms across my chest and harumph. "I am enjoying it precisely the proper amount, thank-you-very-much."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "不！我才没有呢。"我双臂交叉抱在胸前，嗤之以鼻。"我正乐在其中，恰到好处，多谢了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Drifter's got you there, mate.))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（漂泊者说得对，老兄。））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Remind me never to piss you off...))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（以后提醒我千万别惹你生气……））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Lean in mate, haha))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（凑近点，老兄，哈哈））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Off to the cyrpts we go!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们去墓穴吧！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "Mm. What gave it away?" I say as I curl a lock of my hair around my finger. I am loudly ignoring the blood that is eternally pouring down my gratuitous cleavage, by the by.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "嗯，你怎么看出来的？"我一边漫不经心地绕着头发，一边说道。至于那些正顺着我的乳沟汩汩流下、仿佛永远不会停的鲜血——我当然是在一本正经地当它不存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: We shan't ever speak of the gratuitous cleavage blood. Quite gauche, you see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我们别再提那乳沟血了。你懂我的尴尬吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I gasp as though you have just asked me to dance as a debutante at her coming out ball. Hiding a blush, I glance away. "Why yes, I do."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我倒吸一口凉气，仿佛你刚刚在我的成人舞会上邀请我跳舞。我掩饰着脸上的红晕，别过脸去。"当然，我知道。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Doing my best Southern Libertation Belle impression, "I thought you would never ask."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我竭力模仿自由国南方淑女的语气："我还以为你永远都不会问呢。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am going to walk a little farther into the graveyard, and holding out my hands in front of me, I am going to cast Hear Thoughts as far and wide as I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要再往墓穴深处走一点，伸出双手，尽可能地将读心术施展得更远、更广。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I'm not trying to know what they're thinking, just trying to hear if anything *is* thinking, to be clear. I know you're going to ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不是想知道他们在想什么，只是想听听他们是否真的在思考，说清楚点。我知道你肯定会问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I rip my mind back away from that place. "Oh. Oh, no."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我强迫自己把思绪从那个地方拉回来。"哦，哦，不。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "We are not alone in this place... But whatever lurks within I do not think is amongst the living any longer."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "我们并不是这地方唯一的生物……但无论里面潜伏着什么，我认为它已经不再是活物了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Are you sure you won't need us today, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你​确定​今天​不​需要​我们​了​吗，​阿米尔？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Amir, dear, I'm going to need you to brace yourself for this one...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，亲爱的，你得做好心理准备……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: It's just that she gave me, eh, a rather literal heads up that she's coming in here, and... well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 只是她提前，呃，很直接地告诉我她要来这里，然后……嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: She needs to talk to you very badly, apparently about what you've been doing... you know how she gets
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 她很想跟你谈谈，显然是想说说你都做了些什么……你知道她会怎么做

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: No. I fear it is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 对，恐怕不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Hello! Grand, darling. Eat anything interesting lately?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你好！太好了，亲爱的。最近有没有吃什么特别的东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: And... she's gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 然后……她走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((Uncalled for!))
((Accurate))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（确实没错））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "I would rather an honorable death than to serve as the 'content puppet' of some Royal Family." He lifts his chin in defiance. "I serve only myself and my own fate."

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Reyland's eyes light up at those words. "Become ageless. Become a powerful... whatever-the-Hell-he's talking about... kill the Royal Family... be free."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 听到这些话，雷兰的眼睛亮了起来。"不老不死。变成某种……不管他到底在说什么的强大存在……干掉皇室……获得自由。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: I am going to take out my Nobleizer, aim, and fire at the back of the Hekholder's ugly-ass head...body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我要拿出我的升爵者，瞄准，然后对着海克看守者那丑陋的脑袋……身体后脑勺开火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: /roll d20, d20
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: /roll d20, d20

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: ((what?! u gotta be kidding me. this is some bare dark shit, amir))
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: （（什么？！你别逗我了。阿米尔，这也太黑暗了））

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Swearing in every language he was taught in his youth by his tutors, Reyland levels his Nobleizer at the deadass in the chair. "You do not hurt my dog. You do NOT hurt my dog!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 雷兰用他年轻时老师教过的所有语言破口大骂，举起他的升爵者，对着椅子上那个死气沉沉的家伙吼道："你不准伤害我的狗！你不准伤害我的狗！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "It's wrong."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "这是错误的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: "No!"
"At least that's natural!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: "至少这是自然的！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: amir i know what ur doing i can see this straight thru
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 阿米尔，我知道你在做什么，我一眼就看出来了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: w/e fk this game tho m8 u n i gotta talk
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 算了，这游戏真他妈烂，伙计，咱俩得聊一下

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: Reyland paces for a moment, before he looks down at Duchess. There is no choice to be made, in the end. His heart cracks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 雷兰踱步片刻，然后低头看向公爵夫人。最终，他别无选择。他的心碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: He walks over to the table, and with a long, heavy sigh, sits down and downs the glass of wine in one go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 他走到桌边，长长地叹了口气，坐下，一口气喝光了杯中的酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: kaya got in trouubbllleeee
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 卡娅遇上麻麻麻烦烦烦了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: eeh, buddy, look... just... would it kill ya to just settle for a round or two of hoppers once 'n a while?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 呃，大姐，我说……就……偶尔打一两局牌会要了你的命吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: uh. oh, hey, lil buddy. really hate to interrupt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 呃，哦，嘿，小家伙。真不好意思打扰你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: look, I know I *look* old but it's not like these things are that hard to figure out despite what the kid says and -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 听着，我知道我*看起来*挺老的，但这事其实也没那么难搞懂，不管那孩子怎么说，而且——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: anyway, not the point. we've got a problem. i'm looking for arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 总之，这不是重点。我们遇到麻烦了。我在找亚瑟

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: it's those damn weird units that M spotted two days ago. they're back. in force this time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就是米尼娃两天前发现的那些该死的奇怪卓越者。它们又回来了。这次是来了一大波。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: point is, we need backup.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 关键是，我们需要后援。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: i know bud, i know, but this is important
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我知道，兄弟，我知道，但这很重要

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: i wasn't saying that it wasn't, but, uh... this is... in the life-and-death way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 我不是要否定你，但是，呃……这是……关乎生死的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: arthur...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 亚瑟……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: i'm sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: g'mornin'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 早上好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: nah, I just figured I'd catch you here before you all started going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 没有，​我​只​是​想趁​你们​还​没​开始​之前​来​这​里​找​你们。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: um. weird question for you. were you guys doing that version of role playing where you're... like...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 呃……​问​个​奇怪​的​问题。​你们​在​玩​那​种​角色​扮演时……​是​……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: doing it "live" or...?
YEAH! that. were you all doing that yesterday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 对！​就​是​那个。​你们​昨天​都​在​做​那​个​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: no shame if you were! i love that you kids can sit around a table and have fun, really
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 就​算​你​那样​也​没​什么​好​羞耻​的！​我​真的​很​喜欢​看​你们​这些​孩子​能​围​着​桌子​玩得​这么​开心，​真的​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: a little jealous, honestly,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.zhText: 有​点嫉妒，​说​实话，​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AmirFFDialog.text: right. hi, M.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Happy Birthday, Aoi!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，生日快乐！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, Aoi. Happy Birthday. (I know you’re always happy, so this is kinda pointless.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，碧。生日快乐。（我知道你总是很开心，所以这似乎没什么意义。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We come alive, under the neon glow… it's the party of your BIRTHDAY! <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们在霓虹灯下尽情摇摆……这是你终身难忘的生日！<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Happy Birthday Aoi! Maybe we could clone you a Zeke of your very own…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，生日快乐！也许我们可以为你克隆一个属于你自己的兹克……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Happy Birthday, Aoi! Hope you’re having a great day!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，生日快乐！希望你今天过得开心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Happy Birthday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 生日快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey Aoi? Do you have a second? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，碧？你有空吗？ [征求是否同意多重伴侣关系]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想跟你说件事，我想先确定你能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对我来说重要的是，你不会觉得我在对你撒谎，或者对你不坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nothing! Nothing. I just wanted to talk to you about something that I hope isn't an uncomfortable situation for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不是！不是。我只是想跟你说点事，希望不会让你觉得不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想让你陷入一种你无法接受的情况。我知道我们之前没有讨论过这件事。所以如果你拒绝，那也没关系。我希望你清楚这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们之间的感情对我很重要——非常重要——而且它是真实的。我不希望你怀疑这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Huh...?
Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, you wouldn't know them. And sadly I don't know if I can arrange a meeting. They're not from this time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，你不会认识他的。很遗憾，我不知道能不能安排你们见面。他不是这个时代的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They do. And I don't care about you any less. You're both important to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 能。而我对你的关心也没有变少。你们两个对我都很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just wanted to say I was sorry. I know I screwed up really badly with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是想说声对不起。我知道我对你很过分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah. I. I don't know how else to say this, but I - I have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的。我。我不知道该怎么说，但是我——我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I miss talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我好想跟你聊天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I really do. I've been losing sleep over it, honestly. :{
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的，我是很认真的。老实说，我最近因为这事还失眠了。:{

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I didn't know how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不知道该怎么开口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I guess I was scared to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想，我可能是害怕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah. Very sure. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的，非常确定。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Actually, never mind. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 其实，还是算了吧。不用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I've never had either, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 老实说，这两个我都没尝试过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I suppose that of all sea creatures, the octopus would definitely be the best musician.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想，在所有生物中，巴鸟肯定是最好的音乐家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That sounds silly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听上去真傻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I wish I could tell you the future was that cool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 要是未来真的那么酷就好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That would be the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那得等到猴年马月了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm just kidding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是在开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sorry. Bad joke. How may I cure your boredom, m'lady?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 抱歉。说了个烂笑话。女士，我该怎么帮你消除你的无聊呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Curious about what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好奇什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SLEEPING>Zzzz
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SLEEPING>Zzzz

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_MUSIC1>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_MUSIC1>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_AWHUG>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_AWHUG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: On-lyne, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然是线上时代啦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nightwave. It's like a radio show in space.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 午夜电波。它就像是太空中的广播节目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Only boring people get bored.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只有无聊的人才会感到无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Or... radio with a side of vigilante justice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 或者说……行侠仗义的广播。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Or... radio that gives its listeners trinkets... and guns.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 或者说……会给听众送小礼物……和枪的广播。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Both
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 两个都喜欢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd prefer black
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我喜欢纯黑的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sugar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 糖

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Milk
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 牛奶

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just another typical day of inter-dimensional cosmic warfare. Can't complain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 又是一天平常的跨维度宇宙战。没什么好抱怨的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So far, so good. How's your day going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 到目前为止还不错。你今天怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_FOOD>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_FOOD>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sure I do. Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然喜欢。为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: haha what made you think I was lying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈是什么让你觉得我在撒谎？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You like their music too, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你也喜欢他们的歌，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How far off the mark was he?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他偏了多少？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，我懂的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: All of the above.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 两者都有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The pretending.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 假装的那部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The watching part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看的那部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The annoyed part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 生气的那部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think you mean save the universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想你是说拯救宇宙吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Never a dull moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 永远不会感到无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, the skill of playing the same four chords... over and over...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，不就是弹同样的四个和弦的技巧吗……不断重复地弹……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: True. Making it seem effortless is actually part of the challenge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 的确。看似轻松其实也是一种挑战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, anyone who says that about things you enjoy totally sucks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，贬低你喜欢的东西的人真是太差劲了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You ever heard of a Shawzin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你听说过三线琴吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's like a string instrument.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它就像是一种弦乐器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's a "future" instrument. Sounds like... I actually have no way to describe it. A storybook?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这是种"未来"的乐器。听起来像……我其实不知道该怎么形容。像一本故事书？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Coffee. You?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 咖啡。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha. Go for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，那就去说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yikes. I'd better not walk into that. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哎呀。我可不想被牵连进去。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Octopus?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 巴鸟？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 吉他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Piano.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 钢琴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Tea. You?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 茶。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll just have to bring you to the future with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只需要带你去未来就行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll just have to bring one to the past with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只需要把它带到过去就行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah. Well, no. Not like an octopus. More like a guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊。好吧，不。不是巴鸟。更像一种吉他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No bass like octopus bass, I guess. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜没有低音能比得上巴鸟低音吧，哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Um, no. All my "fancy energy-blasting pistol things" are accounted for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃，没有。我所有的"精致能量爆破手枪"都在的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not mine. Try Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不是我的。问问昆西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看起来有点不高兴。是因为我说的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢。我真没什么别的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你一点也不无聊。我只是想显得聪明一点而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一会儿再聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is that all for now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就这些了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd rather you didn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我宁愿你不问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What, like, in space?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 什么，在太空里的天气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay fine. Ask away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Depends on what the coolant towers are up to
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那得看冷却塔在干什么了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd have to check. Either kind of cold or super cold. Either way, cold.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我得查查。要么是有点冷，要么是超级冷。反正是冷的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh yeah. I guess you're in the time when Venus was inhospitable... Wild.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，是啊。我猜你们现在正处在金星那个荒凉不宜居的阶段吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah right. In the future, the Orokin come along and invent coolant towers that cool Venus down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊，对了。在未来，奥罗金出现并发明了冷却塔来冷却金星。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll do you one better. These days, people with robotic body upgrades maintain the towers, and I get along great with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我再告诉你个更夸张的。现在维护那些塔的都是改装了机械身体的人，我跟他们关系可好了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not at all. I go there all the time. We created planet-cooling technology ages ago. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 绝对没有。我经常去那里，我们很早以前就创造了行星冷却技术。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: There's only so much one can do with a gas giant, but there are stations in its atmosphere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对于气体巨星来说，我们能做的有限，但是我们在它的大气层中设有空间站。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, what do you mean by "fix"? But not really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，你说的"修好"是什么意思呢？实际上并没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd be happy to help free you of that mind-trap if I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果可以的话，我很乐意帮助你摆脱这种心理陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sorry, what kind of trap?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 抱歉，什么陷阱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. Hah. Yeah, I know what you mean. You have one about Jupiter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦。哈哈。是的，我明白你的意思。你有关于木星的心理陷阱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不知道你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not that I'm judging. What's this Jupiter-related "mind-trap"?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我没有评判的意思。这个跟木星有关的"心理陷阱"是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Should I be worried?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我应该担心吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hang on, I didn't mean to embarrass you. Sorry. Maybe I misunderstood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 等等，我不是故意让你尴尬的。对不起。也许我理解错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not at all. Tell me more. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 一点也不傻。多告诉我一些。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just a little.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只是有一点点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's... terrifying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这也……太可怕了吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You'd die quickly anyway. Just your body would be floating there, not "you" exactly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 反正你很快也会死去。只是你的身体会在那里漂浮，不完全是"你"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't know if this helps, but size is relative. Earth actually seems pretty small when you live in space.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不知道这是否有帮助，但大小是相对的。当你生活在太空中时，地球实际上看起来很小。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: A what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 宇航员？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is that... another mind-trap?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那是……另一个心理陷阱吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So an astronaut is someone who lives in space?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以，宇航员是住在太空的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I still have no idea what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我还是不太明白你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's pretty exciting. Humans are on the cusp of discovering so much, and you get to be right there to see it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这真让人兴奋。人类即将发现很多事物，而你能在那里亲眼见证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What's it like to be talking to a real live astronaut?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 和一个真正的宇航员对话是什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yikes! Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哎呀！祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh man. Good idea!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，天。好主意！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Probably best. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 或许这样最好。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nope, it's ruined.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 别想了，已经坏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你没事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Glad it worked out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很高兴它还能用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你一点也不无聊。我只是想显得聪明一点而已。
