/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢。我真没什么别的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一会儿再聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What kind of tea did you say it was?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你说的是什么茶？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And just how did you spill tea all over your PC?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是怎么把茶洒在电脑上的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So little of what you just said made sense to me, but I trust your taste.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你刚说的我没怎么懂，但我相信你的品味。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Do you still have a few sips left at least?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你至少还剩下几口吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And this stuff nearly broke your PC?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这种东西差点毁了你的电脑？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The weirdest part of that story was when you sat cross-legged at a computer desk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这个故事中最奇怪的部分是你在电脑桌前翘二郎腿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm having a really hard time not making fun of you right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我现在真的很难不笑你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll spare you the lecture about caring for your electronics.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我就不给你上如何照顾电子产品的课了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No chance of getting another tea from wherever you got that one then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你没办法再去原来的那个地方弄一杯了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, fair enough. That sucks. Silver lining is you didn't break anything though, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，说得也有道理。那挺糟的。但好在你没弄坏什么东西，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, I wouldn't do that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，我可不会那么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, that's not so bad. I hear Scaldraville's beautiful this time of year.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，这没那么糟啦。我听说这个季节的炽蛇城特别美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You must really like tea if you go to all that trouble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看来你是真的很喜欢茶，为了它这么大费周章。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And we don't even have to tell Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们甚至都不用告诉阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Lol. I thought you might.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。我就知道你会这么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Looks like there was a little damage after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看来还是有点损坏的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think you'd better talk to Amir about fixing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得你最好去找阿米尔修一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think typing is good for the keyboard at this point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 现在打字对键盘来说可能不是什么好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd ask if you're okay over there but... it looks like replying will be difficult either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我本想问你那边还好吗，但……看起来回复也很困难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What the heck happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 到底发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh! Got what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦！搞定了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did Lettie's rats walk all over your keyboard or was that bubble tea damage?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是莱蒂的小鼠在你键盘上跑来跑去，还是珍珠奶茶弄坏了东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow you did that quickly too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇，你动作也太快了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Damn, your powers are no joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 天啊，你的能力真不是盖的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm surprised you didn't think of that sooner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很惊讶你怎么没早点想到这办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I would, too. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也会这么做的。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: As you should.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你就应该这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Alright then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is that like... a predasite?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那是……像是一种扑猎达赛吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Right. You never would have seen an animal on Deimos. Predasites are like infested dogs with big ears. You'd love them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对了。你肯定没见过火卫二的动物。扑拉达赛就像是长着大耳朵，被感染了的狗。你会喜欢它们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah right. You wouldn't know. It's an animal on Deimos. Don't worry your pretty little head over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊，对了。你肯定不知道。它是火卫二上的一种动物。别让你那颗漂亮的小脑瓜为这事费心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_DOG>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_DOG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What's a space cowboy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 什么是太空牛仔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is that a 1999 Earth animal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那是 1999 年地球上的动物吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Point taken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, relax.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，放轻松。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for clearing that up. LOL.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你澄清了这一点。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah. It all makes sense now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊。现在一切都说得通了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Actually no. They're hard to get close to... and kinda violent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 其实不经常。它们不好接近……而且有点凶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah! I'm good at sneaking up on them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊！我很擅长偷偷接近他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I hunt them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我是去狩猎他们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Conservation. I work to preserve Deimos wildlife.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 为了保育。我负责火卫二的野生动物保育工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just don't like them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是不喜欢它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That was a joke. I'm actually part of a program to conserve them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那只是个玩笑。其实我参与了一个负责保育它们的项目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm kidding! I actually conserve wildlife on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我开玩笑的！我其实在保育火卫二上的野生动物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm glad you approve.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很高兴你喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just wait until you learn even more about me ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 等着吧，你会发现更多惊喜的 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. Thanks for clearing that up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦。谢谢你澄清了这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah. It all makes sense now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊。现在一切都说得通了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Perfect :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 完美 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Lol. You do whatever you think is best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。你怎么开心怎么来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Only one can live. You or your furry companion. You must choose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果只有一个能活下来。是你还是你那个毛茸茸的同伴。你必须做出选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Don't worry! I just chopped up a tasty meal for our furry companion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 别担心！我刚给我们的毛茸茸的同伴准备了一顿美味的大餐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm even better at in-person hugs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 现实中的拥抱我更会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So are you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你也是！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: A great body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 一副好身材。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sincerity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No way! I did all this work and now you want to steal the glory of serving the dish?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不行！我做了所有这些准备，现在你想来抢功劳？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Of course! Why don't you go ahead and serve the dish?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然可以！你去上菜怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Bad news. He hates it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 坏消息。他不喜欢吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Good news. He likes it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好消息。他喜欢吃！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I bet you're right. I'd like that :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我相信你是对的。我很喜欢这个主意 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nah, I work alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，我习惯一个人做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thank you, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not as happy as I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我比你还高兴呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think he likes it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想他喜欢吃！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uh oh. He hates it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢不。他不喜欢吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for helping!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你帮忙！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: My pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢。我真没什么别的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你一点也不无聊。我只是想显得聪明一点而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一会儿再聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看起来有点不高兴。是因为我说的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure there's another in that CD store you hang out in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢肯定你常去的那家 CD 店应该还有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm getting the sense I hit a nerve with that whole four chord song thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得我之前那句四和弦的话可能碰到你的痛处了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nah, I know what four chords on loop sound like already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，我已经知道重复的四个和弦是什么样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, sorry
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没有，抱歉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nope. Can you track it down with your metal powers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没有。你能利用你的金属能力找到它吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think Zeke would approve of stealing. (No, I didn't take it. Lol.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不认为兹克会支持偷窃行为。（不，我没拿。哈哈。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: There are no CD players either, so even if I had it, I wouldn't be able to do much with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 反正也没有 CD 播放器，所以即便我拿了，也没法用

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh... Well, metal makes a big comeback in the future
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦……好吧，金属在未来会重新流行起来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's too bad. I'm out of ideas.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那太糟了。我也没主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Maybe the rat's an On-lyne fan too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 也许那只小鼠也是线上时代的粉丝呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha I actually think they do. Not sure they could carry a CD in their little paws though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，我真的觉得它们会喜欢。不过不确定它们能不能用小爪子拿着 CD。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Jokes aside, I really hope you find it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 玩笑归玩笑，我真希望你能找到它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, good luck with your search.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，祝你寻找顺利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I actually think it's cool how you see past the surface of pop music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我其实觉得你能看透流行音乐的表面，真的很酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Look, we aren't all going to like the same things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看，我们不可能每个人都喜欢同样的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What is it that upset you? I'm not judging. I really want to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是什么让你不高兴？我不是在评判。我真的想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No worries. Hope you find your CD.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 别担心。希望你能找到你的 CD。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, I get it. It's the double standard that bothers you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，我明白了。让你烦恼的是那种双重标准。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think you might be overthinking this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得你可能想太多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Neither is better. They're just different flavors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没有哪个更好。它们只是风格不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You've thought a lot about this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你对这事想得挺多的啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just mean you should like whatever you like. Screw what everyone else thinks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我的意思只是，你喜欢什么就喜欢什么，管别人怎么想呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm not trying to offend you or anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我并不是想要冒犯你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Fair enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: True, and you deserve people in your corner who understand your point of view either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 确实，无论如何，你都值得拥有理解你观点的人在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll do my best to be one of those people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我会尽力成为这样的人之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, it's tough out there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的，外面的世界很艰难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I had that coming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，这事我自找的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Come on, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，别这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你一点也不无聊。我只是想显得聪明一点而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一会儿再聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢。我真没什么别的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看起来有点不高兴。是因为我说的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Good! He's not getting that drink.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很好！他休想得到那杯酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh you really told him that? Hah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，你真的那么说了？哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, thanks for the heads up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，谢谢你告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, what is the deal between the two of you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你们俩是什么关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Does that mean what I think it means?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这是我想的那种"历史"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: History, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 历史，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, what happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You want to tell me how Arthur screwed that up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你愿意告诉我亚瑟怎么把事情搞砸的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, you don't have to tell me anything you don't want to tell me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，如果你不想说，就不必勉强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Shame. I'm curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真遗憾。我挺好奇的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ha well... He's not wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈，好吧……他说得没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Tell him he can shove it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 告诉他去他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Tell him he owes *me* a drink for putting up with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 告诉他，为了忍受他，他应该请*我*喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's frustration.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不爽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's all good fun, don't worry haha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 开玩笑的。别担心，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nah, it's fine. Just having an off day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不了，没事。今天只是状态不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just have a lot going on, but that's true for all of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是有很多事情要做，不过谁不是这样呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not your style?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不是你的风格？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Eh, it's all about intent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这嘛，关键是看意图。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It only works if everyone knows each other well enough to understand where the lines are. Getting close to the line without crossing it shows you’re comfortable with each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只有彼此足够了解，知道界限在哪里时，这种方式才有效。接近界限但不越界，说明你们之间关系很融洽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sure. Let's go with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没错，就当是这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Making a mental note not to joke around with you like that then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那我得记住，以后不能这样和你开玩笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Good, because I'm definitely going to joke around with you like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很好，因为我肯定还会这样和你开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for saying that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds like you might be speaking from experience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来你好像说的是你的亲身经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is that meant to be a compliment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这是在夸我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I thought mean humor wasn't your style ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我还以为刻薄的幽默不是你的风格 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're more insightful than you let on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你比你表现的更有洞察力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: All right, we'll leave it at that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我们先说到这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I hope he knows he's not getting it. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望他知道他不会喝到的。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And what do you want? You're saving people all the time too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你想要什么呢？你也一直在救人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想想办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's a tall order.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这有点难办啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The feeling's mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也是这么感觉的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I bet you say that to all the time travellers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜你对所有时间旅行者都这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Quincy's gunshots keeping you up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 昆西的枪声让你睡不着觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds like you're having a tough time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来你过得挺不容易啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看起来有点不高兴。是因为我说的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你一点也不无聊。我只是想显得聪明一点而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一会儿再聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢。我真没什么别的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure he doesn't need to shoot things at *all* hours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢肯定，他没必要*每时每刻*都在打枪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You can still message him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你还是可以给他发消息的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can say something to Arthur for you, if you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你想的话，我可以帮你跟亚瑟说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's kind of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你人真不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: As long as you're getting enough sleep, that's cool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只要你能睡得好，那就没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, I get it. I'd never tell Ordis how his jokes keep me up sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，我明白。我也绝不会告诉 Ordis 他的笑话有时候会吵得我睡不着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You should really look out for yourself more though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真的应该多照顾一下自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're always thinking about other people. I hope you don't forget about yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你总是先考虑别人。我希望你不要忘记自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Maybe I overstepped. It wasn't really my place to say that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 也许是我多管闲事了。这事其实不该由我来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I say you don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我说你没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, he's the Cephalon intelligence that runs my spacecraft.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的，他是帮我管理宇宙飞船的中枢智能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, he's the Cephalon intelligence that runs my spacecraft.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不是，他是帮我管理宇宙飞船的中枢智能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They're like a digital intelligence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就像是一种数字智能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They're people whose consciousness was uploaded to virtual space (usually by force.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他们是那些意识被上传到虚拟空间的人（通常是被强制的）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜是吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: But without a body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 但没有身体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Damn. There I go sabotaging your sleep further.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 完了。我这让你更睡不着了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: ... Oops.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: ……哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You get the idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你明白就好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Maybe a little too futuristic to explain, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 老实说，可能有点太未来感了，难以解释清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ordis is okay. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: Ordis 没事。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Your reaction to things that were normal to the Orokin is a good reality check for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你对那些奥罗金人习以为常的事情的反应，对我来说是个很好的现实参照。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He knows. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他知道。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And I'm very lucky to have him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也很幸运能有他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Surely there are exceptions to that rule.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这个规则也应该有例外吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What about people you don't respect?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那对于你不尊重的人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds like you're tolerating bad behavior from Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来你在容忍昆西的不良行为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I am now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 现在我倒是好奇了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Don't evade the question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不要回避问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know what I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道我的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm talking about him ignoring the needs of those around him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我说的是他忽视周围人的需要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, but it does concern you, so it interests me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，但这关乎你，所以我很感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, I guess not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，我猜是无关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Good luck
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 祝你好运

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sweet dreams
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 祝你做个好梦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: All right, then. It's clear I can't convince you otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么好吧。显然我无法说服你改变主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Your outlook does have a certain charm to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你的看法确实有它独特的吸引力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢。我真没什么别的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一会儿再聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你一点也不无聊。我只是想显得聪明一点而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看起来有点不高兴。是因为我说的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just perfect. And roguish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 简直完美。还有点调皮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你的关心。我很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Never been better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Mysteriously well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 神秘地很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你的关心。我很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Never been better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Me? Hard on myself? Never.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我？对自己苛刻？不可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你的关心。我很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Never been better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm all right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for checking in. I'm doing fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你的关心。我很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Never been better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Pinky swear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 拉勾发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Cute. Lol. Okay, I admit it. I've had better days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真可爱。哈哈。好吧，我承认。今天过得不是那么好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think pinky swears work online.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得在网上拉钩发誓不太靠谱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can't do that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I swear on the Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我以 Lotus 的名义发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I swear on Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我以双衍王境的名义发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I confess. I've had better days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我承认。今天过得不是那么好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, because this is dumb.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，因为这很傻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Can't you just accept I'm fine?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你就不能相信我很好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You could tell me a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你可以给我讲个笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Please send flowers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 请送花。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Pretty lady like you? I can think of a few things. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 像你这么漂亮的女士？我能想到几件事呢 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Who's there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谁在那里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi, is that you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，是你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks. I feel better already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢。我感觉好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow a whole bouquet!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇，一整束花！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Med pack who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 医疗包谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Why? Who's been injured?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 为什么？谁受伤了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Lol! Excellent joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈！很棒的笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll take it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我收下了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I appreciate you saying that, Aoi. I'll keep it in mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，谢谢你这么说。我会记住的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You should deal with your own issues before trying to take on someone else's.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你应该先解决自己的问题，再去考虑别人的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I bet you say that to everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢打赌你对每个人都这么说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, what's the situation with the metal cranes you make?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，你做的那些金属鹤怎么一回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Would you be willing to make me a metal crane?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你愿意帮我做一只金属鹤吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，看来碧的表情符号又回来了。我觉得这是个好兆头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你一点也不无聊。我只是想显得聪明一点而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的。我很抱歉让你不高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你真的很无聊，我就不会和你聊天了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看起来有点不高兴。是因为我说的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 行，我收回我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一会儿再聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢。我真没什么别的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I thought that was for *paper* cranes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我以为那是*纸鹤*的说法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What? Where did you hear that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 什么？你从哪里听说的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha, let's hope so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，但愿如此吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's really cool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这真的很酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's ridiculous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 太荒谬了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I've never heard that in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我这辈子从来没听说过这种说法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: First I'm hearing of this. I'd love to know more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我第一次听说这个。我想知道更多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Actually, come to think of it, I think I did hear that once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 其实，仔细想想，我好像确实听说过一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That doesn't sound real, but if it makes you happy, that's cool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来不太真实，但如果这让你开心，那挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I doubt that was because of some superstition. They were probably just testing concentration or something like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得那不是因为什么迷信。他们可能只是在测试注意力之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah, interesting. Skill-testing and luck-building all in one. Very wise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊，有意思。既能测试技能，又能积累好运。非常明智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You heard me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你没听错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't mean that as a bad thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我并不是说这有什么不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Of course not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, how many have you folded by now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你到现在折了多少只了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I've seen you fold a lot. Have you gotten to 1000 before?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我看你折了很多，你之前有没有折满 1000 只？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How do you not have a precise number? I thought you'd have that memorized haha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你怎么没有一个准确的数字？我以为你会记住这个，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What will you wish for?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你想许什么愿望？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah, so you're pacing yourself. I guess I can see how raw numbers can take away from the creativity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊，所以你在控制自己的节奏。我猜我可以理解为什么具体数字会削弱创造力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Seems super inefficient to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 感觉效率很低啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: My mistake! I should have thought of that. Be sure not to tell me!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我的错！我应该想到这一点的。千万别告诉我！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think that rule applies to wishes made of metal and paper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得这条规则并不适用于金属和纸折的愿望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh yeah? What lucky someone got that wish?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是吗？是谁那么幸运得到了那个愿望？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Where's my wish?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那我的愿望呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. Hey, I'm sorry to hear that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦。真的很抱歉听到这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Are you sure? I'd really like to hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你确定吗？我真的很想听听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Will you show me how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你会教我怎么折吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: But I want YOU to make my cranes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 但我想要你来为我折鹤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: This next wish will be better anyway :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 下一个愿望肯定会更棒 :P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Whatever happened, I think it's cool that you're making a wish for yourself. Turning it into something happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 无论发生了什么，我觉得你为自己许愿很酷。把它变成一件快乐的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Won't you reconsider telling me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的不能再考虑一下告诉我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just thought that time might be better spent on me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是觉得，那些时间花在我身上可能更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh... Okay, yes it did. My bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦……好吧，对，确实被我忽略了。我的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think I'm beginning to understand you a lot better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想我开始更加了解你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, I appreciate you telling me about your cranes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，谢谢你告诉我关于你折鹤的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's a relief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这下我就放心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're pretty cool, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你真的很酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm just glad you're doing what makes you happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很高兴你在做让自己开心的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Good!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 太好了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Next time I see you folding those cranes, I'll have a whole new appreciation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 下次再见到你折鹤，我一定会更加欣赏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I've gotta run, but I'll be sending you energy for all that crane-folding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我得走了，但我会为你的折鹤送上满满的能量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey Aoi! You like Amir, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，碧！你喜欢阿米尔，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're a fan of games, right Aoi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你喜欢玩游戏，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a board game where everybody makes characters and plays pretend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 阿米尔正在尝试组织一场《寓言与边疆》的游戏。这是一个桌游，每个人都需要创造角色来扮演。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a game where we all tell a story together and use chance to add some excitement to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 阿米尔正在尝试组织一场《寓言与边疆》的游戏。这是一个大家一起讲故事的游戏，并通过一些随机元素让它更有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Eh, it's just a silly game. It's a waste of time but I'm trying to be nice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃，其实这只是个蠢游戏。虽然可能浪费时间，不过我只是想表现得友好一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If they do, they'll have to go through me. <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果他们敢嘲笑，得先过我这一关。 <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Who cares? It'll be fun! And it'll mean a lot to Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 管它呢？这会很好玩！对阿米尔来说也很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: LOL. I think you can play as a druid, yeah. They have familiars. Like cats and things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。我觉得你可以扮演德鲁伊，是的。他们有魔宠。比如猫之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure you can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Look, this whole manic pixie dream girl  act is cute and all, but I don't need it in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看，这种古灵精怪的小仙女戏码虽然可爱，但我生活中并不需要这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is that so? I'd like to try it. We should go out and get some together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是吗？我想试试。我们应该一起出去尝尝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You've really done your research.  I'm flattered. I'll have to try one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真是做足了功课啊，我很受宠若惊。我一定要试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If we're meeting in 1999, it's the past to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果我们是在 1999 年见面的话，对我来说那是过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I guess, personally speaking, it's in both our futures.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想，就我个人而言，这属于我们共同的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Only an Entrati could ever make sense of this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只有英择谛才能搞明白这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, we'll drive ourselves crazy trying to make sense of time travel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对，试图搞懂时间旅行会把自己搞疯的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let's just say going to the past is in my future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就说回到过去是我的未来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We can just focus on our cafe date instead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们还是集中精力准备我们的咖啡约会吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's best if we just focus on our cafe date.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们还是集中精力准备我们的咖啡约会吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hah. Okay, sassy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈。好吧，真敢说啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Right? What a psycho.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对吧？真是个疯子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He has his moments.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只是偶尔表现还行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, he's actually awful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，他其实很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: As friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就作为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If that's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果可以的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If that's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果可以的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: As friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就作为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Same here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Date?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 约会？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's not a date.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这不是约会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: As friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就作为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, how did you end up in Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，你是怎么来到霍瓦尼亚的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How did you meet the Hex anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你到底是怎么遇到六人组的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, I can tell when you're upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，你不开心的时候我是可以看出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I admit that calling your interest in me a "manic pixie dream girl act" was inconsiderate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我承认把你对我的兴趣称作"古灵精怪的小仙女戏码"不太恰当。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When I said that manic pixie thing, I only meant you don't have to put on an act for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我说那些古灵精怪小仙女的话时，只是想表达你不用在我面前装。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, it was. You're cute. I mean unbelievably cute. I just find it hard to believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，确实如此。你很可爱。我是说可爱到不行。我只是觉得有点难以接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You caught that, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你听出来了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can see a deeper side to you, Aoi. You're tough. You're more than pop songs and emoticons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我能看到你内心深处的一面。你很坚强。绝不是只有流行歌曲和表情符号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nobody's actually bubbly and fun all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没有人能永远都那么充满活力、好玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Listen, I think you're amazing. I said that manic pixie crap because I doubt myself, not you. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是这样，我觉得你很棒。我之前说那些古灵精怪的话是因为我对自己没信心，不是因为你。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd like it if you received it as me thinking you're awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望你能理解为我觉得你特别棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just don't buy that making people happy is your whole reason for being. There's gotta be more to you than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是不相信让别人开心是你生活的全部。你一定还有其他面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, fair point. You're right. What I said was more about me than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，有道理。你说得对。我之前说的更像是在说我自己，而不是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're right. You deserve better. I'll earn back your faith in me. That's a promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你说得对。你值得更好的对待。我会努力重新赢得你的信任。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So you want me to just hide it from you when I've had a bad day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以你是想让我在过得不顺心的时候就对你隐瞒吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's just an offer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这只是一个提议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay it was a bad joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，这是个烂笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Agreed. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 同意。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If that's what you'd like, it's what I'd like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果这是你想要的，那也是我想要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay maybe I'm being a little... avoidant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，也许我有点在……逃避。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, it was a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，那只是个玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So you've know Arthur... a while. Did you guys ever...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以你认识亚瑟.……有一段时间了。你们有没有……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: "Fight" and "peace" always look funny when paired in a sentence
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 把"战斗"和"和平"放在一句话里总是显得有些讽刺

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I was going to put it more delicately but yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我本来想说得更委婉一点，但对，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You took the words right out of my mouth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我正想这么说呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Don't leave me hanging like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 别这样吊我胃口啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The suspense is killing me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这悬念快把我急死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Alright, I won't pressure you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我不给你压力了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, why did you join the ICR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，你为什么要加入国危部？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Was it your choice to join the ICR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 加入国危部是你的选择吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, no. With the Orokin, it was always more like, "You WILL fight under pain of death!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，没有。在奥罗金时代，通常都是，"你必须战斗，否则就是死路一条！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh yes. I know exactly the type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，是的。我完全知道是哪种人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We're in complete agreement about that. Good thing it's in the past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对此我们意见完全一致。幸好这已经是过去的事情了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, it's okay! I'm okay. I didn't mean to derail you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，没事的！我没事。我不是故意岔开你的话题的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It seemed normal at the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这在当时很正常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for your sympathy. Really. I'm more interested in you right now though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你的同情。真的。不过我现在更想了解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Don't worry about it. I'd just like to know more about that philosophical conundrum of yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 别担心。我只是想更了解一下你的那个哲学问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Why hold back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 为什么要克制？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds like you were lots of fun to be around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来在以前跟你在一起玩应该会很开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What kind of battles are we talking here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们在说的什么样的战斗呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds like wisdom beyond your years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来像是那种超越你年龄的智慧啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How does Arthur measure up as a leader?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟作为领导者怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I’m guessing you've wanted to deck Quincy a few times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜你有好几次想揍昆西吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You and Lettie must've clicked right away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你和莱蒂一定很合得来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Something tells me Eleanor appreciates your loyalty to the underdog.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜想埃莉诺一定很欣赏你对弱者的忠诚

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Makes sense you and Amir get along so well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 难怪你和阿米尔相处得这么好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, when the chance to fight for peace with the ICR came along, it must've felt natural.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，当有机会与国危部一起为和平而战的时候，你一定觉得这再自然不过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think I would have liked having you as a friend growing up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想，如果小时候能有你这样的朋友，一定很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Still kind of hard to believe someone as adorable as you ever wanted to fight. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 还是有点很难相信像你这样可爱的人竟然会想过打架。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No regrets enlisting with the ICR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 加入国危部有后悔过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No way you were this nice and cute back then, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你当时不可能这么友善和可爱吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I’m beginning to see just how exceptional you are. Thank you for letting me in on a deeper level.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我开始看到你的优秀了。感谢你让我更深入地了解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's not the answer I expected, but I've come to expect the unexpected from you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这不是我预期的答案，但我已经习惯你总是出人意料了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's a compelling story, Aoi. I'll give you that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不得不说，碧，这是个很棒的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, I'd like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好的，我也想这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Alright then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Listen, I think you're amazing. I said that manic pixie crap because I doubt myself, not you. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是这样，我觉得你很棒。我之前说那些古灵精怪的话是因为我对自己没信心，不是因为你。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd like it if you received it as me thinking you're awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望你能理解为我觉得你特别棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just don't buy that making people happy is your whole reason for being. There's gotta be more to you than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是不相信让别人开心是你生活的全部。你一定还有其他面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I admit that calling your interest in me a "manic pixie dream girl act" was inconsiderate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我承认把你对我的兴趣称作"古灵精怪的小仙女戏码"不太恰当。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When I said that manic pixie thing, I only meant you don't have to put on an act for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我说那些古灵精怪小仙女的话时，只是想表达你不用在我面前装。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, it was. You're cute. I mean unbelievably cute. I just find it hard to believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，确实如此。你很可爱。我是说可爱到不行。我只是觉得有点难以接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You caught that, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你听出来了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can see a deeper side to you, Aoi. You're tough. You're more than pop songs and emoticons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我能看到你内心深处的一面。你很坚强。绝不是只有流行歌曲和表情符号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nobody's actually bubbly and fun all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没有人能永远都那么充满活力、好玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, I can tell when you're upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，你不开心的时候我是可以看出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, it was a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，那只是个玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay maybe I'm being a little... avoidant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，也许我有点在……逃避。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If that's what you'd like, it's what I'd like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果这是你想要的，那也是我想要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Agreed. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 同意。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay it was a bad joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，这是个烂笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's just an offer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这只是一个提议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So you want me to just hide it from you when I've had a bad day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以你是想让我在过得不顺心的时候就对你隐瞒吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're right. You deserve better. I'll earn back your faith in me. That's a promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你说得对。你值得更好的对待。我会努力重新赢得你的信任。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, fair point. You're right. What I said was more about me than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，有道理。你说得对。我之前说的更像是在说我自己，而不是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What's your favourite emoticon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你最喜欢的表情符号是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Favorite emoticon. Go!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 最喜欢的表情符号。说吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What's your favourite emoticon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你最喜欢的表情符号是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Favorite emoticon. Go!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 最喜欢的表情符号。说吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yep, sat him down and explained the whole thing. He was so confused at first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的，我让他坐下来，给他讲解了一下。他一开始特别困惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just doing my part to keep the team literate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是在尽我所能保持团队的文化水平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha please tell me that didn't really happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，别告诉我这真的发生过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh Arthur... I guess nobody's perfect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，亚瑟……看来世上没人是完美的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah, it was nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊，这没什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I live to serve, my lady.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我的女士，我很乐意效劳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It was the least I could do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这只是我尽的一点绵薄之力而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Glad I could help. So, of all the emoticons you've memorized, which is your favorite?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很高兴我能帮上忙。那么，在你记住的所有表情符号中，你最喜欢哪一个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, Arthur was missing out. Your emoticons are fun. Which is your favorite?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟错过了。你的表情符号很有趣。你最喜欢哪一个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I give up
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我放弃了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ooooh I can see why that would be your favorite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢，我明白为什么你最喜欢这个了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It makes you happy that I've given up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我放弃了，这样你开心吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I knew it was that one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我就知道是那个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's my favorite too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这也是我最喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's just the right mix of cute and witty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它真是可爱和机智的完美结合。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just a hunch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只是一种预感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I've been paying attention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我有在用心观察。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, now I know something you love, and I'll never forget it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好了，现在我知道了你喜欢的东西，我永远不会忘记它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Another Aoi mystery solved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 又解开了一个碧之谜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, I’ve been wondering... with your metal-bending skills, why didn’t you ever scrap the arcade for parts? It could’ve been a goldmine for Quincy’s ammo or spare supplies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，我一直在想……既然你有操纵金属的能力，为什么你从不把那些街机拆下来变成零件呢？那可是昆西获取子弹或备用零件的金矿啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, that arcade would make good scrap metal. Could probably build a whole tank out of it. A few atomicycles too. You should re-purpose it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，那些街机可以变成很好的废金属。甚至可以用来造一整辆坦克和几辆原子摩托车。你应该重新利它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, I’ve been wondering... with your metal-bending skills, why didn’t you ever scrap the arcade for parts? It could’ve been a goldmine for Quincy’s ammo or spare supplies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，我一直在想……既然你有操纵金属的能力，为什么你从不把那些街机拆下来变成零件呢？那可是昆西获取子弹或备用零件的金矿啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, that arcade would make good scrap metal. Could probably build a whole tank out of it. A few atomicycles too. You should re-purpose it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，那些街机可以变成很好的废金属。甚至可以用来造一整辆坦克和几辆原子摩托车。你应该重新利它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Listen, I think you're amazing. I said that manic pixie crap because I doubt myself, not you. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是这样，我觉得你很棒。我之前说那些古灵精怪的话是因为我对自己没信心，不是因为你。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd like it if you received it as me thinking you're awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望你能理解为我觉得你特别棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just don't buy that making people happy is your whole reason for being. There's gotta be more to you than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是不相信让别人开心是你生活的全部。你一定还有其他面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I admit that calling your interest in me a "manic pixie dream girl act" was inconsiderate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我承认把你对我的兴趣称作"古灵精怪的小仙女戏码"不太恰当。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When I said that manic pixie thing, I only meant you don't have to put on an act for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我说那些古灵精怪小仙女的话时，只是想表达你不用在我面前装。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, it was. You're cute. I mean unbelievably cute. I just find it hard to believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，确实如此。你很可爱。我是说可爱到不行。我只是觉得有点难以接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You caught that, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你听出来了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can see a deeper side to you, Aoi. You're tough. You're more than pop songs and emoticons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我能看到你内心深处的一面。你很坚强。绝不是只有流行歌曲和表情符号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nobody's actually bubbly and fun all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没有人能永远都那么充满活力、好玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, I can tell when you're upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，你不开心的时候我是可以看出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, it was a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，那只是个玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay maybe I'm being a little... avoidant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，也许我有点在……逃避。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If that's what you'd like, it's what I'd like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果这是你想要的，那也是我想要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Agreed. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 同意。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay it was a bad joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，这是个烂笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's just an offer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这只是一个提议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So you want me to just hide it from you when I've had a bad day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以你是想让我在过得不顺心的时候就对你隐瞒吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're right. You deserve better. I'll earn back your faith in me. That's a promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你说得对。你值得更好的对待。我会努力重新赢得你的信任。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, fair point. You're right. What I said was more about me than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，有道理。你说得对。我之前说的更像是在说我自己，而不是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Morale?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 士气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Interesting. I suppose I can see that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有意思。我想我能够理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We'll have to agree to disagree on that one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在这一点上，我们只能各持己见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If it gave the Hex an advantage, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果这能为团队带来优势，那么是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're putting words into my mouth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你在替我乱说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, maybe I'm missing something here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，也许我没完全搞清楚情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I was just making a suggestion. You can take it or leave it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是提个建议。你可以接受也可以不接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm pretty sure Amir would understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我相信阿米尔会理解的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I guess I never thought about it like that. You're right though. His joy is pretty infectious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我之前从没这样想过。不过你说得对。他的快乐真的很有感染力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The way I see it, being that sentimental could get you and the Hex killed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在我看来，这种感情用事可能会害死你和六人组。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I should have known you would have thought about this so carefully.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我早该知道你会这么细心地考虑这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I hope the Hex know how lucky they are to have you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望六人组知道拥有你是多么幸运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, your bleeding heart might be the death of you, but it's definitely endearing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，你的好心可能会害了你自己，但这确实很吸引人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Point taken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我明白你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I feel like I hit a nerve?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我是不是说到你的痛处了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just want the Hex to be as strong as they can be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是想让六人组尽可能变得强大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Look, I'm glad Amir's happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看，我真心为阿米尔的快乐感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I suppose we do. Maybe there’s more than one way to build strength.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想我们确实有。也许增强实力的方法不止一种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You caught me. That's what this is really about. I'm a sore loser :P I must see that game crushed for besting me!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 被你看穿了。这才是真正的原因。我是个输不起的人 :P 我就是要看到那个游戏被砸烂，因为我输给它了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha you make a good point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，你说得很有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I gave up on that dream long ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我早就放弃那个梦想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我答应你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不答应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I wouldn't dream of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我连想都没有想过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, fair point. You're right. What I said was more about me than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，有道理。你说得对。我之前说的更像是在说我自己，而不是你。
