/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're right. You deserve better. I'll earn back your faith in me. That's a promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你说得对。你值得更好的对待。我会努力重新赢得你的信任。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So you want me to just hide it from you when I've had a bad day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以你是想让我在过得不顺心的时候就对你隐瞒吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's just an offer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这只是一个提议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay it was a bad joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，这是个烂笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Agreed. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 同意。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If that's what you'd like, it's what I'd like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果这是你想要的，那也是我想要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay maybe I'm being a little... avoidant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，也许我有点在……逃避。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, it was a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，那只是个玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, I can tell when you're upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，你不开心的时候我是可以看出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nobody's actually bubbly and fun all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没有人能永远都那么充满活力、好玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can see a deeper side to you, Aoi. You're tough. You're more than pop songs and emoticons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我能看到你内心深处的一面。你很坚强。绝不是只有流行歌曲和表情符号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You caught that, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你听出来了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, it was. You're cute. I mean unbelievably cute. I just find it hard to believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，确实如此。你很可爱。我是说可爱到不行。我只是觉得有点难以接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When I said that manic pixie thing, I only meant you don't have to put on an act for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我说那些古灵精怪小仙女的话时，只是想表达你不用在我面前装。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I admit that calling your interest in me a "manic pixie dream girl act" was inconsiderate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我承认把你对我的兴趣称作"古灵精怪的小仙女戏码"不太恰当。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just don't buy that making people happy is your whole reason for being. There's gotta be more to you than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是不相信让别人开心是你生活的全部。你一定还有其他面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd like it if you received it as me thinking you're awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望你能理解为我觉得你特别棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Listen, I think you're amazing. I said that manic pixie crap because I doubt myself, not you. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是这样，我觉得你很棒。我之前说那些古灵精怪的话是因为我对自己没信心，不是因为你。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You must be from a really nice country.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你一定来自一个很棒的国家吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm guessing you're not from Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜你不是来自霍瓦尼亚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Do you miss it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你想念那里吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, I gather you prefer it over Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以，我猜你更喜欢这里而不是霍瓦尼亚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: (Sounds like it's worth the expense.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: （听起来这些生活成本是值得的。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hero's journey?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 英雄之旅？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hero... like in a storybook?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 英雄……就像童话故事里的那种？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha I don't know much about dragons, but I know a lot about Orowyrms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，我对龙不是很了解，但奥金魇龙我倒是知道不少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What if the dragon attacks the village? I've seen plenty of that with Orowyrms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果龙攻击村庄怎么办？我倒是看过奥金魇龙做这样的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They're an Orokin invention... sort of. Big, golden, flying serpentine beasts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它们是奥罗金的一种发明……可以这么说吧。是一种巨大、金色、会飞的蛇形巨兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They're the monsters heroes slayed in the storybooks I read growing up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它们就是我小时候读的故事书里那些英雄斩杀的怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: In that case, you could say I've seen more than my fair share of dragons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果那样的话，你可以说我见过不少龙了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Would you believe I've slain a whole lot of them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你信不信我杀过很多条龙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, Höllvania is the furthest from home I've ever been, so maybe you're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，霍瓦尼亚是我去过离我家最远的地方了，也许你说的对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I feel more like a hero with you and the rest of the Hex by my side, so maybe that's true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有你和六人组的其他人在我身边，我感觉自己更像一个英雄，所以这也许是真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You thought wrong. I've slain more than enough dragons already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你想错了。我已经杀过不少龙了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yes, literally. Lol. Did they teach you about conceptual embodiment in school?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的，亲手杀过。哈哈。学校里有教过你什么是概念成形吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, not literally. I just understand the metaphor. I've lost count of how many dragons have crossed my path since I left home on the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，不是这个意思。我只是理解了这个比喻。自从我乘坐扎里曼号离家后，我已经记不清遇到过多少条龙了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I paid zero attention in school, but that term came up a few times. Something about imaginary stuff not being imaginary anymore?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我在学校时一点也不专心，但这个词出现过几次。大概是说虚构的东西不再是虚构的了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: With sufficient emotional intensity, the Void has the power to turn our thoughts into physical beings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只要情感足够强烈，虚空就能把我们的想法变成实体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah. Talk about a dragon attacking a peaceful village.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的，他简直就是龙袭击一个和平的村庄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Now that's a dragon I'd like to slay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这才是我想要杀死的龙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I am too. I was kinda hoping you'd know what it was so you could explain it to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也是。我还指望你知道呢，好让你解释给我听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The point is I've actually encountered an Orowyrm, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 重点是我确实遇到了一只奥金魇龙，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, there was more than one. And I slayed them. For real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，不止一只。而且我杀了它们。真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They basically went around destroying stuff.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它们基本上就是到处破坏东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yes, they definitely should.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没错，确实应该如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You just need to know how to handle them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你只需要知道怎么对付它们就行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Are you kidding? Watching villages burn was awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你在开玩笑吗？看着村庄燃烧超爽的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think that captures it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得就是这意思了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nah, it sounds silly when you put it that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，你这么说听起来挺傻的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, it's never too late to start learning
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，学习永远不嫌晚

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ugh. You sound like my teachers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃。你这话听起来像我老师。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You caught me!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 被你发现了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，你才是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Don't be ridiculous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 别闹了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Definitely, and you could count on me to save you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然可以，而且你可以指望我来救你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No way. You're way too capable of saving yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 怎么可能。你完全有能力救自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks! Would you save me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢！你会来救我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uh...
Let's both be dragons instead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不如我们都当龙吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, I like the sound of this fairy tale already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，我已经开始喜欢这个童话了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We'd be the bravest knights in the realm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们将成为这个王国最勇敢的骑士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nah, let's both be damsels.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 算了，我们还是一起当落难少女吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Say hi to everyone for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 替我向大家问好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I look forward to the next chapter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很期待下一个篇章。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_CHEEKY> Answer 4 U
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_CHEEKY> 有答案给你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yes, Aoi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，问吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not now [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 现在不行 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: A much heavier shawzin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是不是那种比我的三线琴还重的东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, an instrument like my Shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 知道，就是像我的三线琴那样的乐器

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I promise I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我保证会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can't - I never really learned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不能——我压根没学过这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Do you need a partner?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你需要一个搭档吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Are you offering to be my teacher, Ms. Aoi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧老师，你是说你愿意教我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You don't seem like you'd be a good teacher.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你看起来不像是个好老师。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Are pianos made of metal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 钢琴是金属做的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd love to see that!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我真想看看！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Doh Rei Mi Fa? This is sounding like Void Tongue...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哆、来、咪、发？这听起来像是虚空语……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Please don't put this on the test, Ms. Aoi!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧老师，请别把这个放在考试上！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Doh Rei Mi Fa-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哆、来、咪、发——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Rei Rei Rei Rei-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 来、来、来、来——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think I'm ready for this, but don't stop on my account.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得我还没准备好，但不要因为我而停止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd really love that. I know music can let people feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我会很喜欢那样。我知道音乐能让人感受到情感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not sure I'll feel much but I'm happy to help you, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我不确定能感受到什么，但我很乐意帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Look who's online. Anything you want to talk about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看看是谁在线。有什么想聊的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So. What's on Aoi's mind today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，碧今天在想什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Heh. Right, well, you remember those literal dragons I told you about? That's where they were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呵呵。好吧，你还记得我告诉你的那些真实存在的龙吗？它们就在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You'll get a kick out of this. Duviri has flying dragons, called Orowyrms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你肯定会觉得这个有意思。双衍王境里有会飞的龙，叫做奥金魇龙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Duviri can be beautiful but it's... also dangerous, like all storybook worlds. Filled with monsters and lessons to learn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 双衍王境很美，但……也很危险，就像所有故事书里的世界一样。充满了怪物和需要学习的教训。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We have an evil child king, named Dominus Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们有一个邪恶的孩子国王，名叫士魂大帝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We have a full court of characters, each plagued by their own horrible backstories. Each one represents an emotion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们有一大堆角色，每个角色都有着自己悲惨的背景故事。每个角色都代表着一种情感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Eh... He's just really lonely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃……其实他只是很孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yes. Trust me. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的，真的。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He can't help the way the Void made him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他无法改变虚空赋予他的本性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know how I can use Transference to steer you around? I can use Transference on an Orowyrm, too. That is *really* weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道我怎么使用传识来操控你吧？我也可以在奥金魇龙身上使用传识。这*真的*很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They can be, when they're not trying to kill you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当它们不在试图杀死你的时候，它们确实很酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The turning radius is shockingly *terrible.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 转弯半径出奇地*差*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Strange, at first. But getting to fly? That's so much fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 一开始很奇怪。但飞行的感觉？那太有趣了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just wish it lasted. And that it wasn't trying to actively *kill me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只希望这能持续下去。而不是总想着*弄死我*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think with you by my side, nothing could stop us. Not an Orowyrm. Not the Indifference. Nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得有你在我身边，没有什么能阻止我们。无论是奥金魇龙，还是虚空无情之物。什么都不能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When you've got family beside you, watching your back? Nobody stands a chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当你有家人在你身边为你撑腰时？没人能够胜过我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Easy, there. They're huge. And dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 冷静点。它们又大又危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To put it lightly. But they're the closest thing I ever really had to family that I can really remember...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 姑且这么说吧。他们是我记忆中最像是家人的人……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Eh. It's all a metaphor for learning to accept and moderate your emotions without blocking any of them out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯。这都是一个隐喻，教你学会接受和调节自己的情绪，而不是屏蔽它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How sad is that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这有多悲哀？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The Void just happened to reach into my head and make it real. And... deadly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 虚空恰好进入了我的脑海，让这一切成为现实。而且……是致命的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's for the best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这样也好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think you'd honestly enjoy it - running around, slaying monsters, saving the townsfolk. It's all very Noble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我认为你会真心喜欢那里——四处奔跑，屠杀怪物，救助村民。这一切都非常崇高。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sure. I mean... I don't know her very well? The kid knows her better than I do. But she saved my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然。我是说……我不太了解她？那个孩子比我更了解她。但她救了我的命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I owed her for saving my life. So when she needed me to come here, I answered the call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我欠她一个人情，因为她救了我一命。所以当她需要我来这里时，我回应了她的呼唤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: A version of me from this timeline that didn't age because they were stuck in a stasis pod on Lua, which the Lotus, who later saved me, put Lua and the kid into the Void for a while, to keep everybody safe--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是这个时间线上的我，因为被困在月球上的一个冷冻舱里而没有变老，后来 Lotus 为了保护大家安全，把月球和那个孩子放进了虚空一段时间。她最后救了我——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Right. Yeah. So. Technically, I'm from an alternate timeline. The other version of me didn't age as much, because... y'know? It's a long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对。嗯。所以，严格来说，我来自另一个时间线。另一个版本的我没那么老，因为……你知道的？这个故事很长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Amir's making a whole website to try to keep it straight. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 阿米尔正在制作一个网站来帮助梳理这些事情。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's... complicated, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这……有点复杂，嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 慢慢就习惯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: C'mon dummy, catch up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 拜托，傻瓜，跟上我们的节奏吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Are you kidding me? *I* might need it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你在开玩笑吧？*我*可能会需要它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You do get used to it eventually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 慢慢你就习惯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When I was in Duviri, I was... trapped. In apathy. I'd forgotten who I was. Why I was there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当我在双衍王境的时候，我……被困住了。变得麻木。我忘记了我是谁。也忘了我为什么在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sometimes, when you're stuck at the bottom of your life... you just need a helping hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有时候，当你人生跌到谷底时……你只需要一只援手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And she was one of the two people who helped pull me out of there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 她是其中一个把我从那种境地拉出来的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And she gave me one. Literally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 而她确实是给了我一只。字面上的手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The Lotus and Teshin, my mentor, are the reason why I had the ability and the bravery to escape that place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: Lotus 和我的导师 Teshin 是我有能力和勇气逃离那个地方的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Without their support? I'd probably still be there. Endlessly looping. Endlessly dying. Indifferent to it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果没有他们的支持？我可能还在那里。不断重复同样的循环。无休止地死去。对这一切都漠不关心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They gave me what I needed to achieve victory. Victory over myself. And hopefully, soon... the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他们给了我取得胜利所需要的一切。我战胜了自己。希望不久之后……也能战胜虚空无情之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll tell that one to you in person over drinks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 下次一起喝酒时我会当面讲给你听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeesh. Say what you will about the Orokin, but you can't deny they wrote more eloquent lyrics than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊。不管你对奥罗金人有什么看法，但不得不承认，他们写的歌词都比这更有文采。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds incredibly lame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来真是太烂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Besides those lyrics, was the rest of the album okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 除了这些歌词之外，专辑的其他部分怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Back up. Personal experience? Who's ever called you a "chick acting dumb?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 等等，个人经历？有谁说过你是"妹子装傻"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hah. No thanks. I hope the next album you listen to is more enjoyable. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。不用了，谢谢。希望你下次听的专辑更加好听。 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll pass, but I'd love to hear what personal experience you're referring to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我就不听了，但我很想知道你说的那些个人经历是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What? No I haven't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 什么？不，我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh right... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，好吧……对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What an asshole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真是个混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Would it have killed him to mind his own business?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他管好自己的事会死吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He was just jealous that you knew how to have fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他只是嫉妒你知道怎样找乐子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. Right. I think I remember that. Sorry, that was rude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，对。我想我记得那件事。对不起，那样说很无礼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ah I remember now. Well, it was dumb, but it was also cute. Sorry I upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊，我现在想起来了。好吧，那是有点傻，但也挺可爱的。对不起，我让你不开心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's coming back to me now. In my defense, I meant the pinky swear stuff, not you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我现在想起来了。我当时是指那个拉钩发誓，不是指你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I pinky swear to swear on stuff that's important to me in the future. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我拉钩发誓，以后一定会在重要的事情上认真发誓。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Glad to hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你这么说我很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Cool <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, a guy like that isn't worth anybody's time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，那种人不值得任何人花时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: His loss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他的损失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can see that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You have my attention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想听听你的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To each their own, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想，每个人都有自己的想法吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're really something else, Aoi. I mean that in the best way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你真的很不一样。我是说，这是在夸你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Seems kind of sad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看起来有点悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks, but I'll stick to shawzin music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢，不过我还是更喜欢三线琴音乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nah, you're way too cute for... trash fishing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不用了，你这么可爱，不适合去……翻垃圾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Keep it in the trash where it belongs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就让它待在垃圾桶里吧，那里才是它的归宿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Later, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，回头见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Have fun!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 玩的开心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you say so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 既然你这么说的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, it is. I shouldn't have said that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，这很重要。我不该那么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You've never told me anything about your family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你从未跟我提过你的家庭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, we've covered a lot of topics, but your upbringing is still a mystery to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道的，我们聊过很多话题，但你的成长背景对我来说还是个谜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Any siblings?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有兄弟姐妹吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Tell me about your parents.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 跟我说说你的父母吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I had a sibling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我曾经有个手足。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. Not technically? But all us kids on the Zariman were basically raised together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，严格来说，没有？不过我们这些在扎里曼号上的孩子基本上是被一起带大的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To be honest, I wished I was an only child most of the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 说实话，大多数时候我都希望自己是个独生子女。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sometimes. They're not all fond memories. Kids can be mean, you know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有时候还可以。不是所有的回忆都是美好的。孩子们有时候可以很坏，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The best. We really understood each other. I took that for granted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 非常好。我们真的很了解对方。那时候我认为这是理所当然的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd rather not get into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不太想深入这个话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Same thing that happened to my parents. The Man in the Wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 和我父母所经历的一样。那个墙中人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did you like being an only child?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你喜欢当独生女吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How about your parents? What were they like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你的父母呢？他们是什么样的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's okay. I'll get my revenge one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没关系。总有一天我会报仇的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to make this about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 抱歉，我没想把这事扯到我身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Everyone's been through a lot. Not just me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 每个人都经历了很多。不只是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's kind of you. So, where were we? You were going to tell me about your parents?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真好。我们说到哪了？你要告诉我你父母的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let's get back to you. Your parents still around?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 让我们回到你的话题。你父母还在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can't tell if you're serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不知道你是不是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did you get along with them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你和他们相处得好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That explains why you're so nice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 怪不得你人这么好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You happy about that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你为此高兴吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did your parents fight a lot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你的父母经常吵架吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Saves you from fighting with the other kids though. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不过这样至少你避免了和其他孩子打架。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's true. There was always someone there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 确实如此。总有人在身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What were your parents like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你的父母是什么样的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did you get along with your parents?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你和父母相处得好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure that's true for most kids.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我相信大多数孩子都是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: About how you should spend your life?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 关于你该如何度过你的人生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: About music? :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 关于音乐吗？:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They should have been proud of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他们应该为你感到骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They were concerned for their daughter's safety.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他们担心女儿的安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They underestimated you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他们低估了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Good luck with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You'll see them again one day. I'm sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 总有一天你会再见到他们的。我敢肯定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let's hope you get that chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 希望你能有这样的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Except Arthur and Eleanor, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然，亚瑟和埃莉诺除外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's too bad. We should keep those memories alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 太遗憾了。我们应该好好保留这些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can understand why they'd feel that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我能理解他们为什么会有那样的感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Alright. Take care of yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好。照顾好自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for letting me get to know you better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你让我更加了解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: For now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 现在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don’t know if I can take credit for that. Someone as incredible as you always belongs with good people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不知道我能不能为此邀功。像你这么棒的人总是和好人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Me? But Aoi, everyone in the Hex absolutely adores you. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我吗？但是碧，六人组里的每个人绝对都很喜欢你。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The thought that you don't always feel that way honestly breaks my heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 想到你并不总是这么想，我真的很伤心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I get that. Being appreciated is one thing. Feeling seen for who you really are is another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我明白了。被欣赏是一回事。感受真实的自己被别人注意到是另一回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, I guess it’s not. Belonging is being seen for who you are and knowing that’s enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，我想不是。归属感就是被人看到你是真正是谁，并知道这就足够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Truly belonging is a tall order.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 找到真正的归属感真不容易啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’ve always felt like home to me too. Maybe I just didn’t know how to say it until now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你对我来说也一直像家一样。也许我只是直到现在才知道该怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You make me feel the same way. No matter what happens, I know I can count on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你让我也有同样的感觉。不管发生什么事，我知道我可以依靠你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’re a rare kind of friend, Aoi. One of the best. I’ll always make sure you feel seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是个难得的朋友，碧。最好的朋友之一。我会永远让你感觉到我的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I like you, Aoi. More than a friend. A lot, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我喜欢你，碧。不仅仅只是朋友。实际上，是特别喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I mean, you’re my best friend, Aoi. The one who gets me without me having to try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我是说，你是我最好的朋友，碧。那个不用我费力就能理解我的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Don’t apologize. I know you, Aoi. What higher compliment could I get than being compared to an On-lyne song?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不用道歉。我懂你，碧。我的话能被拿来和线上时代的歌词相比，还有比这更好的称赞吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's okay. Mine too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 没事。我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nothing you say is weird. Not to me anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你说的话一点也不奇怪。至少对我来说不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’ve shown me that since the day we met.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 从我们相遇的第一天起你就让我明白了这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Home all the way in 1999? I like the sound of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在遥远的 1999 年的家吗？我喜欢这个想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's insanely sweet of you, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真是太贴心了，碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Right back at you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也这么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: There's no one else quite like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是独一无二的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, I know that ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，我知道 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It means no matter what happens, I'll always have your back. You're the best friend I've ever had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这意味着无论发生什么，我都会支持你。你是我最好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It means I think you're amazing and I'd like to go out with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 意思是我觉得你很棒，我想和你约会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, how do you feel about me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你对我什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Then I think it means we should make this official.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那我想，这代表着我们应该正式在一起了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Knowing you have my back, I feel like I can take on the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 知道我有你的支持，我感觉我能面对全世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And I’m grateful for you. Thanks for always being there, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很感激你。谢谢你一直在我身边，碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Only if you promise to do the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 除非你也答应我会这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, but only because you asked so nicely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，既然你这么温柔地要求了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha is that a yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，你同意了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're so cute it's insane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真是可爱的不得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So… is that a no?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以……你是拒绝了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm glad you feel the same way I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真高兴你和我是同样的感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You make me so happy, Aoi. I promise I’ll do everything I can to make you feel the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有你真的好幸福，碧。我保证我会尽我所能，让你感受到同样的幸福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Me too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh dear. I hope she didn't think you were injured.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦天，希望她不是以为你受伤了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha you’d better go tell her what happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，你最好去跟她解释解释发生了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You two have fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你们俩玩得开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Talk soon, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 回头聊，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You two have fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你们俩玩得开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay. I'll be thinking of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好的，我会想着你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Right back at you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也这么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: There's no one else quite like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是独一无二的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, I know that ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，我知道 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Tell me what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 告诉我什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: This ought to be good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这应该是件好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You don't owe me an explanation. I really mean that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你不需要向我解释。我是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can't deny I'm intrigued.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不否认我很感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh that? I'd totally forgotten. (Kidding I'm really curious)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，那个吗？我完全不记得了。（开玩笑的，我真的很好奇）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We do, but we call it Star Days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 会的，不过我们叫它星日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We call it Star Days, and there's someone on Venus who I think would love to know that they built on an old tradition, even if she didn't realize it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们称它为星日，我想金星上的某个人一定很想知道他们继承了古老的传统，即使她并没有意识到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We call it Star Days, and there's someone on Venus who I think would love to know that they built on an old tradition, even if she didn't realize it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们称它为星日，我想金星上的某个人一定很想知道他们继承了古老的传统，即使她并没有意识到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We do, but we call it Star Days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 会的，不过我们叫它星日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, they certainly do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，他们的确还会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, some people are really into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，有些人真的很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: One of my favorite holidays
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我最喜欢的节日之一

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: She'd adore you. So, what happened between you and Arthur during Venusia?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 她会喜欢你的。那么，你和亚瑟在金星节里发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did something bad happen to you during Venusia?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你在金星节的时候遇到什么不好的事了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, they certainly do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，他们的确还会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, some people are really into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，有些人真的很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: One of my favorite holidays
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我最喜欢的节日之一

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd hate to see you really upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想看到你难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure he deserved it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我相信是他活该。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure he deserved it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我相信是他活该。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd hate to see you really upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想看到你难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow. That's incredibly thoughtful, and takes so much time and skill. Truly, an act of love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇哦。真是太贴心了，花了这么多时间和技巧。真是爱的体现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Arthur was lucky to be with someone who cared so much about making him happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟很幸运能和这么在乎他快乐的人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't want to discount your feelings, but I can see where Arthur was coming from. He was focused on the mission.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想贬低你的感受，但我能理解亚瑟的想法。他当时肯定一心只想着任务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi, I'm sorry. I can't imagine how much that hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，对不起。我不敢想这对你的伤害有多大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: ...Wishing I could punch Arthur right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: ……我现在真想给亚瑟来一拳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow. That's incredibly thoughtful, and takes so much time and skill. Truly, an act of love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇哦。真是太贴心了，花了这么多时间和技巧。真是爱的体现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: ...Wishing I could punch Arthur right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: ……我现在真想给亚瑟来一拳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Arthur was lucky to be with someone who cared so much about making him happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟很幸运能和这么在乎他快乐的人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi, I'm sorry. I can't imagine how much that hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，对不起。我不敢想这对你的伤害有多大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't want to discount your feelings, but I can see where Arthur was coming from. He was focused on the mission.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想贬低你的感受，但我能理解亚瑟的想法。他当时肯定一心只想着任务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Feeling upset is nothing to be ashamed of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 感到难过并不丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Whatever happened, I promise it's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不管发生了什么，我保证都会好起来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Arthur should have run into the road and picked them up anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟应该跑过去捡起来它们才对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh Aoi... all your hard work...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢，碧……都是你的心血……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, you ended things right there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以，你们就这样结束了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can imagine the shock on Arthur's face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我可以想象亚瑟脸上的震惊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's admirable that you're still close friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 令人钦佩的是，你们依然是亲密的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure a lot more than just that one fight led to the breakup.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢肯定导致分手的原因远不止那一次吵架。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure a lot more than just that one fight led to the breakup.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢肯定导致分手的原因远不止那一次吵架。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uh oh...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃噢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's admirable that you're still close friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 令人钦佩的是，你们依然是亲密的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can imagine the shock on Arthur's face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我可以想象亚瑟脸上的震惊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, you ended things right there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以，你们就这样结束了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh Aoi... all your hard work...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢，碧……都是你的心血……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay seems like a bit of an overreaction...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，似乎有点反应过度了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Feeling upset is nothing to be ashamed of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 感到难过并不丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Anytime
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不客气

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thank you for opening up to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你对我敞开心扉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thank you for opening up to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你对我敞开心扉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You amaze me, Aoi. Someone who truly sees and loves people for who they are deserves a partner who will do the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真让我吃惊，碧。能真正看清并爱上别人本来样子的人，值得拥有一个同样如此的伴侣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm always here if you need me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你需要我的时候我随时都在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Anytime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 随时都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's weird because I never think of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真奇怪，因为我从没想过你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Weird I was just thinking about you too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真奇怪，我刚才也在想你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It makes my day to hear that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听你这么说我真开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Definitely not haha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然不是哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, if life's taught me one thing it's that the Void makes anything possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，如果生活教会了我一件事，那就是虚空让一切皆有可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sure, why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然，没问题吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: :) Are you having a good day too?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: :) 你今天也过得愉快吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're a good person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是个好人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: *Nothing* you like more? I think you might be exaggerating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你"没有什么"更喜欢的了？我觉得你可能有点夸张了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Believe it or not, Doctor Albrecht Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 信不信由你，阿尔布雷希特·英择谛博士做到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Most of them ended up dead. But Albrecht Entrati did, in his own way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他们中大部分人最终都死了。但阿尔布雷希特·英择谛以自己的方式做到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah um... I'll think of a cool Orokin. Give me a minute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯嗯……我得想一想有什么酷的奥罗金人。给我一分钟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sorry to disappoint. He's your guy. Refused Kuva, which allows them to be immortal. Didn't go for the fashionable long arm. None of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很抱歉让你失望了。他就是那个人。拒绝使用能够让他们长生不老的赤毒。也没有选择那种时髦的长臂。统统没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did you ever respect Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你曾经尊敬过英择谛吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What do you really think of Entrati? Beyond the "uncool" verdict.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你对英择谛的真实看法是什么？除了"不酷"的评价以外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hah. I'm not an Orokin. I'm just from their empire. Very different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。我不是奥罗金人。我只是来自他们的帝国。这完全不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What do you think he's really after?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你认为他真正追求的是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So you found him charming at some point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以你曾经觉得他很迷人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And you knew that early on? You’re the most intuitive in the Hex. If anyone would’ve had a gut feeling, it’d be you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你很早就知道这一点了吗？你是六人组中最有直觉的人。如果有人会有这种预感，那一定是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm inclined to agree with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我倾向于同意你的看法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't know. There's an awful lot of universe out there. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不确定。毕竟宇宙那么大。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Do you think he actually had everyone fooled?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你认为他真的骗过了所有人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I guess you wait for them to see it for themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜你只能等他们自己看清楚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If it's any comfort, he's had the same effect where I'm from too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果这能让你感到一点安慰，他在我们那边也是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’re not alone there. He left his mark on everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你不是唯一一个。他对每个人都留下了痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He left behind a daughter who’s still trying to fix the pieces he shattered. Angry as she is, I feel like she can't help believing in him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他留下了一个女儿，而她还在拼命修补他破坏的一切。尽管她很生气，但我感觉她还是忍不住相信他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah. He left behind his lover to mend the damage he did to countless people... and animals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的。他让他的爱人留下来弥补他对无数人……和动物造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah... "uncool" is starting to sound like an understatement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊……"不酷"开始听起来像是轻描淡写了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Damn. Hey, don't hold back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 天啊，别憋着，说出来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I doubt even the people who like him would deny that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得连喜欢他的人也不会否认这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sorry if I dragged up some dark memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果我勾起了一些不愉快的回忆，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We don't have to talk about him ever again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们以后也没必要再谈论他了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know it's serious when Aoi starts using periods and stops using emoticons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当碧开始用句号而不是表情符号时，你就知道事情很严重了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: After a list like that, it's hard to imagine what those good things could be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听了这些描述，很难想象还有什么好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Would you count your powers among those good things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你会把自己的超能力看作是那些好事之一吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hmm. If nothing else, your perspective alone proves the human spirit really can’t be broken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯。不管怎么说，单从你的观点就可以看出人类精神是牢不可破的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're right. Those are good things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你说得对。这些都是好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That list seems pretty weak compared to Albrecht Entrati, Consumer of Worlds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 与世界吞噬者阿尔布雷希特·英择谛相比，这个名单显得有点弱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let's make sure Entrati never wins.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们要确保英择谛永远不会赢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, you can count on me to care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，你可以相信我，我一定会关心你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What do you have?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你有什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sign me up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我报名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's not easy to answer. Sounds, words, utterances from the Void. A curse, more like it. A communication of something to whatever ears can hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这个问题很难回答。来自虚空的声音、词语、言语。更像是一种诅咒。对任何能听到它的耳朵都是一种沟通。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's something I never want to hear again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这是我再也不想听到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's the language of what is causing all this, I think. How it speaks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得这就是造成这一切的语言。它的表达方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How hard did you look?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真的很努力在找吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Where would we find a piano?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们在哪能找到钢琴呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ok, let's stick to theory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好的，我们就从理论开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Magic? I don't think so. I do like a good song, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 魔法？我不这么认为。不过我确实喜欢好听的歌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Music has been a part of what I've been through. Memories through songs, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 音乐一直是我经历中的一部分。通过歌曲回忆，我能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let's leave it at that. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们先说到这里吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: In a way, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想，算是吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't really know how to describe it. But it's powerful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我真的不知道该怎么形容它。但它确实很强大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's nothing you want to hear. It's part of why all this is happening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这不会是你想听的东西。这是导致这一切发生的原因之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's powerful enough to change life. There's these animals I know. Friends, I'd say. The Cavia. They touched the Void and learned to *speak* like magic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 强大到足以改变生命。我认识一些动物，我会说它们是朋友。科维兽。它们接触了虚空，就像魔法一样学会了怎么*说话*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And when they speak now, it started so hopeless. So wrong. The Void Tongue just let these creatures feel one thing at first: hopeless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 现在当它们说话，一开始总是那么绝望。那么不对劲。虚空语最初只让这些生物感受到一种感觉：绝望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It is the cause of so much pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它造成了很多痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can't stand to hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我听不下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: But even still, I feel like I know how to speak it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 但即便如此，我感觉我知道如何说这种语言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And that scares me. It's like a song I want to unhear. Like a magic curse that should be GONE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这让我感到害怕。它就像一首我想要忘掉的歌。就像一个应该消失的魔咒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You've listened to too many songs, maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 也许你听了太多歌了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Play a song for me, won't you then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你给我放首歌好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Music can define memories. "Smiles from Juran" is a song I heard in the mind, the memories, of someone who lost everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 音乐可以定义记忆。《朱兰笑》是一首我在失去一切的人的脑海中、记忆中听到的歌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Music can be hopeful. There's something about knowing "We All Lift Together", right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 音乐可以带来希望。那首《我们共度时艰》是不是特别有力量？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Music can be evil, Aoi. These people that I tried to save, they were cursed by song. "For Narmer", they sang out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，音乐可能是邪恶的。我试图拯救的那些人，他们被一首歌诅咒了。"只为众生得救赎"，他们这么唱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Picture it. Everything is taken from you - family, life, your own sense of self.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 想象一下，你失去了一切——家庭、生活、你自己的认同感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Finding joy through song, meaning, shared experience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 通过歌曲找到快乐、意义和共同的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You don't know what it's like to see that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你不知道看到那是什么样的感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And one song, just one song, is the very groundwork for you to find yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有那么一首歌，只需要一首歌，就是你找到自我的基础。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's fun. It's hopeful. A lot of us don't get to choose our life circumstances.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这很有趣。也充满希望。我们许多人无法选择自己的生活境遇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I like to think if I ever lost myself, music would be a way for me to find my way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我喜欢这么想，如果我迷失了自己，音乐将会是我找到方向的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: But we can still choose to sing together, about it all. About nothing. Just sing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 但我们仍然可以选择一起歌唱，无论是关于什么，或者什么都不关于。只是歌唱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Telling you here on this almost feels wrong, I wish I could sing it to you, but if I can say anything it's that evil...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在这里跟你说这些，我感觉有些不妥，我希望我可以唱给你听，但如果有什么我可以说的，那就是邪恶……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Evil will try and ruin the good. I've seen it happen to music. No one should ever sing praise to the damned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 邪恶总是试图毁掉善良。我见过这样的事情发生在音乐上。任何人都不应该歌颂那些被诅咒的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds like the Aoi I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来就像我认识的碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Really? Aoi being Friendly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的吗？碧变得友好了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So what did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你是怎么做的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did you embarrass yourself?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你让自己尴尬了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You crushed them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你把它们弄坏了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The CDs were made of metal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那些 CD 是金属做的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Remember that game I was telling you about with Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 还记得我跟你提过的那个和阿米尔一起玩的游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey Aoi! You like Amir, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，碧！你喜欢阿米尔，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're a fan of games, right Aoi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你喜欢玩游戏，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I feel like I screwed up asking you if you'd like to join. I'm sorry. We'd really love it if you joined the game with us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得我邀请你一起来玩的时候搞砸了。我很抱歉。如果你能加入我们的游戏我们会很开心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Could you just please join? Amir won't stop bothering me about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你能加入吗？阿米尔一直在用这件事烦我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a board game where everybody makes characters and plays pretend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 阿米尔正在尝试组织一场《寓言与边疆》的游戏。这是一个桌游，每个人都需要创造角色来扮演。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Amir's trying to get a game of "Fables & Frontiers" together. It's a game where we all tell a story together and use chance to add some excitement to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 阿米尔正在尝试组织一场《寓言与边疆》的游戏。这是一个大家一起讲故事的游戏，并通过一些随机元素让它更有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Eh, it's just a silly game. It's a waste of time but I'm trying to be nice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃，其实这只是个蠢游戏。虽然可能浪费时间，不过我只是想表现得友好一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If they do, they'll have to go through me. <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果他们敢嘲笑，得先过我这一关。 <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Who cares? It'll be fun! And it'll mean a lot to Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 管它呢？这会很好玩！对阿米尔来说也很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: LOL. I think you can play as a druid, yeah. They have familiars. Like cats and things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。我觉得你可以扮演德鲁伊，是的。他们有魔宠。比如猫之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure you can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: People doubted Eleanor? Seriously?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有人怀疑埃莉诺？真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I find it hard to believe Arthur ever tolerated people being wary of his sister.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很难相信亚瑟会容忍人们对他的姐姐存有戒心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Of course. She’s part of the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当然。她可是六人组的一员。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You don't need to thank me, but I appreciate it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你不需要谢我，但很高兴你这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You were worried I would be mean to her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你担心我会对她刻薄吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That must have been unbearable for her, always knowing what people were thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 总是知道别人在想什么，这对她来说一定是种煎熬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thank Sol for Arthur. He’s a good brother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 感谢太阳神赐予我们像亚瑟这样的一位好弟弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I’m really disappointed in Lettie and Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我对莱蒂和昆西真的很失望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’re saying he might’ve... killed his own sister?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是说他可能……杀了他自己的姐姐？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The fear of losing control must have been terrifying. Especially with Arthur watching over her like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 恐惧会失去控制的感觉一定非常可怕。尤其是在亚瑟那样看顾她的情况下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Clearly, the team has come a long way since then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 显然，自那以后这个团队已经有了很大的进步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I wish they could have seen past their fear back then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望当时的他们能够克服恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's hard to imagine her carrying that kind of fear on top of everything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很难想象她除了面对每天的一切以外，还要承受如此巨大的恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did she ever come close to leaving because of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 她有没有因此差点离开？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's hard to blame them for being human, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我猜，很难怪他们，毕竟他们也是人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did it almost come to that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的差点发生那种情况吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s so unfair. They didn’t see how much she was willing to give up for the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这太不公平了。他们没看到她为了六人组愿意放弃多少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s ridiculous. With psychic powers like hers? She’s invaluable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这太荒谬了。像她那样有精神异能的人？简直是无价之宝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I see. She was willing to sacrifice being with the team just to make them feel safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我明白了。她愿意为了让团队感到安全而牺牲与团队在一起的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Being alone in Höllvania would have put her in so much danger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 独自待在霍瓦尼亚会让她面临很大的危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s heartbreaking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真是令人心碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Luckily for everyone, she clearly didn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 幸运的是，她显然没有这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: She must have felt so alone at that moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在那一刻，她一定感到非常孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It sounds like you were exactly what she needed in that moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来你当时正是她所需要的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When it comes to the team's happiness, nothing gets past you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在团队的幸福方面，没有什么能逃过你的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So it was you. You’re the reason she stayed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 原来是你。你是她留下来的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That was brave.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真勇敢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I’m glad you were there for her. That night probably changed everything for her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很高兴你当时陪在她身边。那一晚可能改变了她的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s so you haha. I’m guessing the heart-to-heart went well?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真是太符合你的风格了，哈哈。我猜那次谈心进行得不错吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And that heart-to-heart probably saved her—and the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那次谈心可能救了她——以及六人组。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sometimes, the simplest things make the biggest difference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有时候，最简单的事情可以带来最大的改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How did you convince her that everything was okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是怎么让她相信一切都会好的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I’m glad you did that. She needed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很高兴你这么做了。她需要这样的支持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s what true leadership looks like, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，这才是真正的领导力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Eleanor’s stronger than people give her credit for, but having you by her side made all the difference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 埃莉诺比人们想象的要坚强，但有你在她身边，一切都变得不同了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, I commend you for keeping the team together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，我要赞扬你保持了团队的团结。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Eleanor deserves to be seen for the amazing woman she is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 埃莉诺值得被看到，她是个了不起的女人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thanks for being there for Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你在埃莉诺需要时支持她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It was nothing. We've got to have each other's backs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这没什么。我们得互相支持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're the glue that holds this team together, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你就是将这个团队凝聚在一起的粘合剂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, you've mentioned Lettie a few times, but you've never told me much about your friendship with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，你提过莱蒂几次，但你没怎么跟我说过你和她之间的友情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What's the deal with you and Lettie? You two get along, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你和莱蒂怎么样？你们俩相处得很好，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What was the argument about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你们为了什么吵架？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How exactly did Arthur hurt your feelings so badly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟到底是怎么让你这么难受的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I would have thought you'd go to Eleanor for comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我原以为你会去找埃莉诺寻求安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I thought your best pal, Amir would've had your back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我以为你最好的朋友阿米尔会安慰你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That sounds just like Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这听起来就像莱蒂会做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You and Arthur dated?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你和亚瑟在一起过？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Broke up? As in stopped dating? As in you dated ARTHUR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 分手了？你是说不再约会了？你是说你跟亚瑟在一起过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. Damn. Sorry, Aoi. That must have been tough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦，天啊。抱歉，碧。一定很难熬吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Arthur's brooding got to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟那犯愁的样子传染到你身上了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I thought you handled the breakup like a pro.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我以为你处理分手这种事已经像个专家了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I was under the impression you and Arthur were really mature about everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我还以为你和亚瑟处理所有事情都很成熟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You don't have to tell me about it if you don't want to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你不想说的话，就不要勉强自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you're willing to tell me what happened, I'd really like to hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你愿意跟我说说你们之间到底怎么了，我真的很想听听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Do I ever feel like an idiot for missing this. Want to fill me in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我竟然错过了这事，真觉得自己像个傻子。能给我补补课吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, I'm all ears now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，我洗耳恭听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I guess I can understand that. We're close now, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想我能理解。我们现在关系更近了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We do, but we call it Star Days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 会的，不过我们叫它星日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We call it Star Days, and there's someone on Venus who I think would love to know that they built on an old tradition, even if she didn't realize it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们称它为星日，我想金星上的某个人一定很想知道他们继承了古老的传统，即使她并没有意识到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We call it Star Days, and there's someone on Venus who I think would love to know that they built on an old tradition, even if she didn't realize it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们称它为星日，我想金星上的某个人一定很想知道他们继承了古老的传统，即使她并没有意识到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We do, but we call it Star Days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 会的，不过我们叫它星日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, they certainly do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，他们的确还会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, some people are really into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，有些人真的很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: One of my favorite holidays
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那是我最喜欢的节日之一

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: She'd adore you. So, what happened between you and Arthur during Venusia?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 她会喜欢你的。那么，你和亚瑟在金星节期间发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did something bad happen to you during Venusia?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你在金星节的时候遇到什么不好的事了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, they certainly do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，他们的确还会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, some people are really into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，有些人真的很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: One of my favorite holidays
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那是我最喜欢的节日之一

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd hate to see you really upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想看到你难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure he deserved it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得一定是他活该。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure he deserved it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得一定是他活该。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd hate to see you really upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想看到你难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can imagine the shock on Arthur's face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我可以想象当时亚瑟脸上震惊的表情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, you ended things right there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以，你们就这样结束了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh Aoi... all your hard work...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢，碧……那些可都是你的心血……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Arthur should have run into the road and picked them up anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟应该冲过去把它们捡起来才对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Whatever happened, I promise it's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不管发生了什么，我保证一切都会好起来的。
