/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Feeling upset is nothing to be ashamed of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 因为这个感到难过并不丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't want to discount your feelings, but I can see where Arthur was coming from. He was focused on the mission.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想贬低你的感受，但我能理解亚瑟的想法。他当时肯定一心只想着任务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi, I'm sorry. I can't imagine how much that hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，对不起。我不敢想这对你的伤害得有多大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow. That's incredibly thoughtful, and takes so much time and skill. Truly, an act of love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇哦。真是太贴心了，花了这么多时间和技巧。真是爱意的体现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: ...Wishing I could punch Arthur right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: ……我现在真想给亚瑟来一拳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Arthur was lucky to be with someone who cared so much about making him happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟真幸运，能和这么一个一心只想让他开心起来的人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: ...Wishing I could punch Arthur right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: ……我现在真想给亚瑟来一拳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi, I'm sorry. I can't imagine how much that hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，对不起。我不敢想这对你的伤害得有多大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't want to discount your feelings, but I can see where Arthur was coming from. He was focused on the mission.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不想贬低你的感受，但我能理解亚瑟的想法。他当时肯定一心只想着任务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Arthur was lucky to be with someone who cared so much about making him happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亚瑟真幸运，能和这么一个一心只想让他开心起来的人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow. That's incredibly thoughtful, and takes so much time and skill. Truly, an act of love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇哦。你真是太贴心了，花了这么多时间和技巧。真是爱意的体现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Anytime
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不客气

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm always here if you need me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你需要我的时候我随时都在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You amaze me, Aoi. Someone who truly sees and loves people for who they are deserves a partner who will do the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真让我吃惊，碧。能真正看清并爱上别人本来样子的人，值得拥有一个同样珍视他们的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thank you for opening up to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你对我敞开心扉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Thank you for opening up to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你对我敞开心扉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Anytime
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不客气

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uh oh...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃噢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay seems like a bit of an overreaction...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，似乎有点反应过度了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh Aoi... all your hard work...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢，碧……那些可都是你的心血……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, you ended things right there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以，你们就这样结束了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can imagine the shock on Arthur's face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我可以想象当时亚瑟脸上震惊的表情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's admirable that you're still close friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你们依然是亲密的朋友，真让人佩服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Feeling upset is nothing to be ashamed of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 因为这个感到难过并不丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure a lot more than just that one fight led to the breakup.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢肯定导致分手的原因远不止那一次吵架。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure a lot more than just that one fight led to the breakup.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢肯定导致分手的原因远不止那一次吵架。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's admirable that you're still close friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你们依然是亲密的朋友，真让人佩服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I've never heard that saying in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我这辈子从来没听说过这句话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's gotta be a 1999 thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那一定是 1999 年的说法了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uh... who says that? And what does it mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃……这是谁说的？是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's dumb.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这太蠢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. Make sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦。有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Huh. You learn something new every day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈。每天都能学到新东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay whoa. I'm going to stop you right there. How could you think anyone thought that way about you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好，哇哦。我要在这打断你一下。你怎么会觉得有人会这样想你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Brutal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 太狠了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: For Sol's sake, why spare a thought for people like that? I doubt anybody was thinking mean things about you, but even if they were, they were wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看在太阳神的份上，何必为那样的人操心呢？我不觉得有人会对你有恶意，不过就算他们有，也是他们不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi, how exceptional you are speaks for itself. Anybody who might have had the audacity to say something like that was just threatened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你有多优秀是不言而喻的。任何有胆量说出这种话的人都是受到了威胁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I guess so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The way you care so much about others is one of your best traits. I hate to think it ever causes you feel so sad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你那么关心别人是你最好的品质之一。我不愿去想这会让你这么难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not people like that. Screw people like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这样的人不值得。这种人去他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Some people are beyond help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有些人已经无可救药了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You do help people. So many people. Never forget how amazing that makes you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你确实帮助了别人。帮助了很多人。永远不要忘了这会让你多了不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did you go to Lettie or did she come to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是你去找的莱蒂还是她来找的你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, what did Lettie do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那，莱蒂做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Chocolate... made you cry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 巧克力……让你落泪了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You clearly needed  someone to be there for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很明显，你需要有人陪在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm glad Lettie was there for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我很高兴当时莱蒂能在你身旁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That Lettie knows what she's doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 莱蒂很清楚她在做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah, I can't imagine anyone being more reassuring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊，我想象不出来还有谁能比她更让人安心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Damn. How was it seeing Arthur after all that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 天哪，经历了那些事后，再见到亚瑟是什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow. Well, I asked for a picture of your friendship with Lettie. Now I really get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇，我一直想了解一下你和莱蒂的友情，现在我真的懂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sounds like everyone was picking sides.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来好像每个人都在选边站。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Clearly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd rather come to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我宁愿来找你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Even if the breakup is between me and her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哪怕是我和她分手了，也找她聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Haha you didn't see it that way, because everyone was picking your side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈，你之所以不是那么想的，是因为大家都站在你这边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, maybe you're just surrounded by good friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，也许你只是刚好身边有一群好朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just a thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是随便想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Don't worry about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 别担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Kidding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我开玩笑的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hard to believe so much happened before I showed up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真难相信，在我出现之前竟然发生了这么多事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: There's a lot of history with you Hex. Forms quite a bond.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你们六人组一起经历的事可真不少。难怪你们彼此间的羁绊这么深。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’ve got to be the strongest hero in the Hex. I mean, considering everyone here is partly metal, you're definitely not one to be messed with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你一定是六人组里最强的英雄了。我是说，考虑到这里的每个人身上都有一部分金属化了，肯定没人会招惹你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I’ve been thinking, out of everyone on the team, your instinct to always look out for others makes you the most heroic of us all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我一直在想，整个团队之中，你总是下意识地为他人着想，让你成为了我们中最像英雄的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Why thank you. How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 谢谢你。不过为什么这么说?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: First time in my life I've been told that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我有生以来还是第一次听到这种话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Really? What makes you say that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的吗？你为什么这么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is that a compliment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这是夸奖吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: A sidekick, huh? That doesn’t sound like the Amir I know now. What changed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 助手，嗯？这听起来可不像我现在认识的阿米尔。发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s surprising. Amir always seems so confident.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 还挺让人惊讶的。毕竟阿米尔看起来总是那么自信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sad? I thought you two were close.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 伤感？我以为你们俩关系很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And you played a big part in helping him realize that, didn’t you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是你帮他意识到这一点的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So what changed for him? He doesn’t seem like anyone's sidekick now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么是什么改变了他？他现在看起来不像任何人的助手了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How'd Amir get involved in something like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 阿米尔怎么会卷入这种事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Amir? I thought it would have been you running to On-lyne's rescue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 阿米尔？我还以为跑去救线上时代的人是你呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: This sounds like a legendary Aoi-Amir team-up to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这听起来像是传说中的碧—阿米尔组合啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow. That’s incredible. Amir really uncovered all that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇。简直难以置信。阿米尔真的揭露了这一切吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, if it's true that knowledge is power, hackers really are powerful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道吗，如果知识就是力量，那么黑客真的很强大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: As if there could ever have been any doubt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好像还能有什么疑问似的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And you still get to rock out in the arcade together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你们还能一起去街机厅里尽情摇摆

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Makes me feel awfully good hearing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听你这么说我感觉好极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That means a lot coming from you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你的这句话对我意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You charmer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你这个万人迷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uuh no I'm not. Don't tell me. I'm not signing up for a problem with Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃，别，我可不想掺和进去。别告诉我。我不想跟昆西有矛盾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Tell me everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 全都告诉我吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Who am I kidding? Yes, tell me everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我这是在开什么玩笑？说吧，把事情告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sorry, was that a typo? I'm sure you meant "we got stopped by a bunch of SCALDRA who recognized Quincy instantly."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 抱歉，那是打错了吗？我想你应该是想说"被一群炽蛇军拦下了。他们一眼就认出了昆西。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh no. Those poor kids must have been terrified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦不。那些可怜的孩子肯定吓坏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Kids?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 孩子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, what did he do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那他有什么反应？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, what did he do when they stopped him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，他们拦住他的时候，他有什么反应？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Used colorful language and no uncertain terms to tell them to get out of his way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他是不是用了丰富多彩的语言明确告诉他们让开？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Ignored them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 无视他们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Shoved past them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 推开他们走过去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Was he... really nice to them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他……真的对他们很好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Those kids must have adored him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那些孩子一定非常喜欢他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're kidding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 开玩笑的吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They knew him from POSITIVE interactions?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他们以前是有过好的接触吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He... said that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他……真的这么说了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're definitely kidding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你肯定在开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, Quincy went on a side quest to find a tammpet for some Höllvanian kid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以，昆西为了给霍瓦尼亚的一个孩子找到一个塔姆宠物特意去做了一个小任务？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, now that I'm picturing it, that really does sound like him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道，现在我脑补了一下，这确实挺像他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You'll have to excuse me for finding this story hard to believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 请原谅我觉得这个故事实在难以置信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're lucky you got to see that side of him. I bet few people ever do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你很幸运能看到他的这一面。我敢打赌很少有人见过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Classic Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这很昆西

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You risked your life to tell me this story?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你冒着生命危险跟我讲这个故事？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Your secret is safe with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我一定会守住你的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Looks like you've signed your death warrant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看起来你已经签了自己的死亡判决书。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aren't you kind of betraying his trust telling me all this though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不过，你告诉我这些是不是有点辜负他的信任？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Think he could find me a tammpet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你觉得他能给我找到一个塔姆宠物吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Honestly, it's nice to hear such a happy story about our brooding sniper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 老实说，听到我们这位忧郁的狙击手的快乐故事还是挺不错的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Nah, I'm going to make fun of him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，我就要嘲笑他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好的。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Pinky swear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 拉勾发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Quincy? Is that you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 昆西？是你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Guess that's the end of me wearing metal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看来我以后不能穿金属了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: One thing I really admire about you is your unwavering commitment to building a better world. Where does that come from?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我真的很佩服你对于建设更美好世界的坚定承诺。这种信念来自哪里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’ve got an impressive amount of drive. What lights the fire under you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你总是干劲十足。是什么点燃了你内心的火焰？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wait. Your parents built rockets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 等等，你的父母是造火箭的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s one hell of a family business. Sounds like they set the bar high.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这可真是个不得了的家族事业。听起来他们把标准定得很高。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That’s not exactly a common family legacy. Did they ever talk about what inspired them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这可不是普通的家族传统。他们有没有提到是什么激励了他们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They must’ve been fascinating to talk to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 和他们交谈一定非常有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow your house was one part think tank, one part launch pad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇，你们家一部分是智囊团，一部分是发射台。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: They sound like they were brilliant. Must’ve been incredible to grow up around that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 听起来他们很聪明。在这样的环境中成长一定很不同寻常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I get that. My parents were always busy too. Running the Zariman ship was a full-time effort for everyone. Still, we always made time to sit down for meals together at least.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我能理解。我的父母也总是很忙。运行扎里曼号飞船需要每个人全身心投入。不过，至少我们总能抽出时间一起吃饭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That makes sense. When work pulls you in that hard, there’s not much time left over, but I bet they thought about you constantly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这很合理。当工作那么忙碌时，剩下的时间并不多，但我敢打赌他们一直在想你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Can’t say I blame them. I know firsthand that space travel doesn’t leave much room for downtime. Sounds like you made their lives easier by keeping your head down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我能理解他们。我自己就经历过，太空旅行几乎不留给人休息时间。看起来你的懂事让他们省了不少心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Maybe so, but it still doesn’t sit right with me that their daughter didn’t get more time with them. We only have so much time in this life, you know? We should spend as much of it as we can with the people we love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 也许是这样，他们的女儿没能多陪陪他们，这让我心里很不是滋味。你知道，我们的人生时间有限。我们应该尽可能多地和我们爱的人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Beautiful, sure, but practical too. They were doing something that mattered, and you don’t get much more important than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 确实美好，但也很实际。他们做的是有意义的事情，没有什么比这更重要的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It’s a powerful kind of love, even if it’s not the kind that sits around a dinner table.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这也是一种强大的爱，即使它不是那种会在围坐在餐桌上体现出来的爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You know, that drive of yours to make the world better... it’s deeper than you give yourself credit for. You should take more pride in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你知道，你那种想要让世界变得更好的驱动力……其实比你自己想象的还要深。你应该为此感到自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I hope you get that chance. You’ve got a heart full of hope and strength. I think they’d be proud of who you’ve become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我希望你能有这个机会。你的心中充满了希望和力量。我想他们会为你现在的样子感到骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Fair enough. Just don’t waste time feeling bad about it now. They made their choices, and you’ve made yours. Looks like you’re doing fine with what they gave you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 说得对。现在就别浪费时间去难过了。他们做出了他们的选择，你也做出了你的选择。看起来你已经很好地运用了他们给你的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You've taken everything they gave you and built on it—not just with dreams and drive, but compassion too. That's not easy to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你不仅是用梦想和驱动力，还有同情心，将他们给予你的一切都发扬光大。这并不容易做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It sounds to me like you’ve grown into the kind of loving, attentive person you needed when you were younger. That’s something worth being proud of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在我看来，你已经成长为你小时候渴望拥有的那种充满爱心、体贴的人。这是值得骄傲的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You’ve got their brains and drive, but you’ve made it your own. That’s what counts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你有他们的才智和决心，但你已经将它们融入到你的个性中。这才是最重要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Anytime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just calling it like I see it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是说出我所看到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You deserve to hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你值得被这样表扬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aren't you worried that I could do bad things? Go Rogue?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你不担心我可能会做坏事，走错路吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm the best there is at those.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我可是这方面的专家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: No, no, sorry. I just don't know how to approach our ... situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不，不是的，对不起。我只是不知道该如何处理我们的……情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Maybe if you told me a little more... detail ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 要不你再多告诉我一点……细节 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yes. No hesitation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 会。毫不犹豫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're the boss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你是老大，听你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I wouldn't dare [End].
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我哪敢啊。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I wanted to ask you something about Transference. <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想问你一些关于传识的事情。 <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Can we talk about Transference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们可以聊聊传识吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah. I don't want to make things weird, but I need to know where you stand. Does it bother you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是的。我不想让事情变得尴尬，但我需要知道你的立场。这会让你感到不舒服吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Does it make you uncomfortable?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这会让你感到不舒服吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is there anything you wouldn't do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有什么是你不会做的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The killing doesn't bother you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 杀戮不会让你感到困扰吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So you believe in means to an end?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以你认为为了目的可以不择手段吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We agree on that!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 在这一点上我们是一致的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Please. Continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I get it, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我懂了，我懂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I trust you too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也信任你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The strongest people I know are kind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我认识的最坚强的人都是善良的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I do. I think you need to be ready to be unkind to the world to be strong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我认为是。我觉得你需要做好对这个世界不善良的准备，才能变得强大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Like you, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就像你，碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Like Ordis. He really feels like my first friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就像 Ordis。他真的感觉像是我的第一个朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Think of it this way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这样想吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, I have a feeling you're the real boss around here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，我感觉你才是这里真正的老大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're the first to think of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你总是最先想到别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And not just my boss ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不仅仅是我的老大 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And others think they are kind. But there is a difference between NICE and KIND.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 而其他人认为他们自己也是善良的。但是善良和友好之间是有区别的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I mean Arthur can bark orders, other's can heal and kill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我的意思是，亚瑟可以发号施令，其他人可以治疗和杀戮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Kindness makes you vulnerable, but not weak. You have the kindest heart of anyone I've met in my travels.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 善良可能让你变得脆弱，但不是弱点。在我遇到的所有人中，你是心地最善良的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: But if any of us had to choose, I bet we would listen to you first if it came down to it because you'd choose something out of kindness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 但如果我们中的任何一个人真的要做选择的话，我敢打赌，大家都会听你的，因为你会出于善良做出选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I bet you'd find a way to get this whole shitshow solved and not hurt anybody, and if someone got hurt, someone you knew. They'd understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我敢肯定，你会找到办法收拾这个烂摊子，而且不伤害到任何人，如果有人受伤了，还是你认识的人。他们也会理解的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uhh.. umm. Be extra kind and just accept what I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 呃……嗯。能不能再好心一点，接受我刚才说的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well... if I must...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧……如果非要这样的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can learn from you. I am learning from you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我可以向你学习。我正在向你学习。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And that truly means that whatever happens next.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这真的意味着，不管接下来发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Whatever I'm up against, I won't be alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不管我将面对什么，我都不会是一个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I already do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我一直都带着你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Wow he kind of looks exactly like that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哇，他看起来真的就像那样……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He is the best there is. He's seen me through it all and still greets me with a joke. THAT is kindness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他是最棒的。他见证了我经历的一切，还总是用一个笑话来迎接我。这就是善良。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: He might be kind but an army of Ordis ... well, it wouldn't lose. To anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 他或许很善良，但如果有一支 Ordis 军队……嗯，它都不会输给任何东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Look out world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 小心了，世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE> <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE><RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Yeah. Ordis. He wasn't always kind though, at least I don't think. Maybe one day he can tell you himself. His story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 是啊。Ordis。不过他并不总是善良的，至少我不这么认为。也许有一天他会亲自告诉你他的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Do you want me to make you laugh more?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你想让我多逗你笑吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let me try one of his jokes on you. As a kind favour. Ahem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 让我试着给你讲一个他的笑话。作为一个善意的举动。咳咳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If I may say, operator, your chosen warframe..suits you! Ha. Ha.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我冒昧地说，指挥官。您选择的战甲真适合您，哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: On second thought... yeah let me work on my material [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 仔细想想……是的，我得再去修改修改我的段子 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I mean exactly that. Kindness is weak in many ways. The world will often remind you of this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我的意思就是字面上的意思。善良在很多方面都是脆弱的。这个世界往往会提醒你这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Think about it - the only way to get anything done is often when someone else gets hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 想想看——要完成一件事，难免会有人受伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Once. With you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有过一次。就是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Never. I am where I am because of powerful and unkind people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 永远不会。我之所以能有今天，都是因为那些强大无情的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To me you're the only one whos kindness matters. Like you didn't want something from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对我来说，你是唯一一个让我感受到单纯善意的人。就好像你对我好并不是为了得到什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You are. And that kindness means you know when I might just need a minute [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你就是。而你的善良意味着你总能察觉到我什么时候需要一点时间独处。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think I am, for now. Who knows - you can prove me wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得我是认真的，至少现在是。谁知道呢——你也可以证明我是错的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think you're weak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不认为你软弱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I mean it. I don't think you're weak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我是认真的。我不认为你软弱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think it just occurred to me... you're stronger than me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是突然意识到……你比我强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're everything I'm not... which is why I wanted us to be a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你拥有我所没有的一切……这就是我希望我们能在一起的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Think about it - the only way to get anything done is often when someone else gets hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 想想看——要完成一件事，难免会有人受伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're too kind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你真是太善良了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's not what I meant, Aoi...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我不是这个意思……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Knowing your weakness is part of what makes you survive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 了解自己的弱点是让你生存下来的关键之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm sorry, I shouldn't have said anything. I don't think you're weak at all [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对不起，我不该说这些。我觉得你一点也不软弱。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's what I've been doing, or at least it feels like it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这就是我一直在做的，或者至少感觉是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Right... kind. You're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 对……善良。你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't need this... that's not what I meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不需要这个……我不是那个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Listen, sorry. Let me think about this. You are strong Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看着，对不起。让我好好想想。碧，你很坚强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's simple. Kindness can be used to manipulate someone. It can be a weakness. And? Well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 很简单。善良可以被用来操控别人。它可以是一种弱点。而且呢？嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think I can help you understand. Doesn't change how I feel about you, this is just my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得我没办法让你理解。这不会改变我对你的感觉，这只是我的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I respect that [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我尊重这一点。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Bye [End].
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 再见。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And that makes you Aoi. My Aoi. My strong kind Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 而这就是你，碧。我的碧。我坚强又善良的碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hey, you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嘿，是你啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Come on in, my love!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 亲爱的，快进来吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sorry, no one's home right now [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 抱歉，现在家里没人。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm not much of a writer, but I can try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不是很会写东西，但我可以试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd be happier if you did it and sang to me, I'm not much for words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果是你写然后唱给我听，我会更开心，我不太擅长文字表达。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hmm, I wish I could, not now [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，我希望我可以，但现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Okay, fineee, together it is, let's write some lyrics.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好，好，一起写就一起写，我们来写点歌词吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd really rather not, but I'd love to watch what you come up with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我真不太想写，但我很想看看你会写出什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Me? I love Pop. Let's get some dance-worthy lyrics written.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我选？我喜欢流行音乐。我们来写些让人想跳舞的歌词吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Hmm, if there's no kick drum, it's not for me. Let's brood something fierce. Rage anthem!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，如果没有鼓点，那就不适合我。让我们来点压抑又凶狠的东西吧。愤怒的赞歌！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: There's a type of song from where I'm from, a Space Sea Shanty... let's try that!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们家乡有一种歌叫"太空船员曲"……我们试试这个吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Pop! You're favourite, write what you know, girl!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 流行乐！这是你的最爱，写点你熟悉的吧，女孩！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let's break stuff, write a rage anthem Aoi. I know you have it in you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那就打破常规，写一首愤怒的赞歌，碧。我知道你可以的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi, that felt like you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，这感觉太像你了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The real Aoi, true to herself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真正的碧，忠于自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: "So it's into the Void all me girls and me boys"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: "皆知虚空无度，我们仍披心相付"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Dust. Wind. Firm - a new wind blows. Dust. Wind. Firm - a new wind blows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 尘土。风。坚定——一阵新风吹来。 尘土。风。坚定——一阵新风吹来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Dust. Wind. Firm - a new wind blows. Dust. Wind. Firm - a new wind blows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 尘土。风。坚定——一阵新风吹来。 尘土。风。坚定——一阵新风吹来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: A new wind, pushing at our sails. A new wind, pushing through the rails.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 一阵新风，推动着我们的船帆。一阵新风，穿过船栏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Lost at sea - lost with the stars. We bow to the wind, we bow!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 迷失于海洋——迷失于星空。我们向风低头，向风致敬！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Time. It took it all. It. Wants me to fall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 时间。它夺走了一切。它。想让我倒下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: CLONE. ROT. CLONE. ROT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 克隆。腐烂。克隆。腐烂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: ROT ROT ROT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 腐烂，腐烂，腐烂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: CLONE CLONE ROT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 克隆，克隆，腐烂
每天都在腐烂！！！！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh, oh oh! She made blue my favourite colour.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 噢，噢噢！她让蓝色成为我最爱的颜色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Metal. Chick. Never saw her coming. Magnetic. Wit. Needing all her loving.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 金属。女孩。从没想到会遇见她。魅力。机智。我需要她全部的爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And when we looked at each other, it's like the world around us knew!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当我们看着彼此，仿佛我们周围的世界都知道了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And to watch that metal bend but not break, well, let's say we'll find no end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看那金属弯曲而不折断，好吧，我们将找不到尽头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Cause she's my metal girl. She'll pull you in, and make you feel alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 因为她是我的金属女孩。她会吸引你，让你感受到生命的活力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Heartbeat passenger, never in the drivers seat. Never stopping them to meet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 心跳的乘客，从不坐上驾驶座。从未阻止他们相遇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Did we accidentally write a ballad? Is this pop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们是不是不小心写了一首民谣？这算流行乐吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Is this pop or a ballad?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这是流行还是民谣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And holding her so tight each night, it's enough to drive you mad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 每晚都紧紧地抱着她，简直让人疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Attract. Attract. Attract. There's no turning back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 吸引。吸引。吸引。无法回头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Because once you've had her, seen here, kissed her...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 因为一旦拥有了她，见到了她，吻了她……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Um... why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯……为什么这么问呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不确定？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I repeat: Um... why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我再重复一遍：嗯……为什么这么问呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I... don't know? How would I know if she had?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我……不知道？就算她真的读了我的心，我又怎么知道呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're making me nervous, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，你这样让我很紧张。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Aoi...?
I do, I'm just.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我相信，我只是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我的意思是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: For real?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Congratulations! That's amazing!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 恭喜！真是太厉害了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you tell me, won't that prevent it from coming true?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你告诉我，那是不是就不会成真了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I certainly do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我当然想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just to be safe, you'd better not tell me. Any wish you made for must be wonderful. I want it to come true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 为了安全起见，你最好还是不要告诉我。你为我许下的愿望一定很美好。我希望它能够实现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: In that case, I'd love to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果是那样的话，我很想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I trust you with my wishes more than I trust myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我把愿望交给你，比交给自己更让我放心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can't wait to hear this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我已经迫不及待想听了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Then your wish has already come true. For me, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你的愿望已经实现了。至少对我来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That is so beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Lol. You used a wish on *that?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。你把一个愿望用在了*这个*上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Then your wish has already come true. For me, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你的愿望已经实现了。至少对我来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That is so beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I will never stop fighting for that to come true. And now I have a very important reason to do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我永远不会停止为这个愿望而战。而现在，我有了一个非常重要的理由去这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Because my family is here. With the Hex. But most importantly...? With you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 因为我的家人在这里。和六人组在一起。但最重要的是……？和你在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The Indifference doesn't stand a chance. Not when I have the Hex backing me. But more importantly? When I have you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 虚空无情之物不会有机会的。尤其是当我有六人组的支持时。但更重要的是？当我有你在我身边时。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Before, I had no one to fight for. Not really. But now? I have people I care about. The Hex. And more importantly... you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 以前，没有人值得我为之而战。真的没有。但现在呢？我有了我在乎的人。六人组。更重要的是……还有你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I love you, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm so glad we're friends. With benefits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我真的很高兴我们是朋友。还是炮友的那种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I love you, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我也爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm so glad we're friends. With benefits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我真的很高兴我们是朋友。还是炮友的那种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I love you, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'm so glad we're friends. With benefits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我真的很高兴我们是朋友。还是炮友的那种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I love you too, Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 碧，我也爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think I'm ready for this kind of commitment...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得我还没有准备好做出这种承诺……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Whoa whoa - this is just a casual thing for me, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 慢着慢着——这对我来说只是种玩玩的关系，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Then it's only a matter of time until we know once and for all whether metal cranes work as well as paper ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么剩下的只是时间问题了，我们迟早会弄清楚金属鹤是否和纸鹤一样灵验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: For real?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Congratulations! That's amazing!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 恭喜！真是太厉害了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: If you tell me, won't that prevent it from coming true?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果你告诉我，那是不是就不会成真了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I certainly do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我当然想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just to be safe, you'd better not tell me. Any wish you made for must be wonderful. I want it to come true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 为了安全起见，你最好还是不要告诉我。你为我许下的愿望一定很美好。我希望它能够实现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I can't wait to hear this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我已经迫不及待想听了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我把愿望交给你，比交给自己更让我放心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: In that case, I'd love to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 如果是那样的话，我很想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我永远不会停止为这个愿望而战。而现在，我有了一个非常重要的理由去这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。你把一个愿望用在了*这个*上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Lol. You used a wish on *that?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。你把一个愿望用在了*这个*上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你的愿望已经实现了。至少对我来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Lol. You used a wish on *that?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。你把一个愿望用在了*这个*上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Then your wish has already come true. For me, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那你的愿望已经实现了。至少对我来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That is so beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 真美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Before, I had no one to fight for. Not really. But now? I have people I care about. The Hex. And my best friend... you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 以前，没有人值得我为之而战。真的没有。但现在呢？我有了我在乎的人。六人组。还有我最好的朋友……你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Because now that this is settled? I'm out of here and heading back to the future where I belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 既然事情已经解决了？那我得离开了，回到我属于的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Because now that this is settled? I'm out of here and heading back to the future where I belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 既然事情已经解决了？那我得离开了，回到我属于的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Because my family is here. With the Hex. And my best friend is here, too. You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 因为我的家人在这里。和六人组在一起。而我最好的朋友，你，也在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Because now that this is settled? I'm out of here and heading back to the future where I belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 既然事情已经解决了？那我得离开了，回到我属于的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The Indifference doesn't stand a chance. Not when I have the Hex backing me. But more importantly? When I have my best friend beside me. You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 虚空无情之物不会有机会的。尤其是当我有六人组的支持时。但更重要的是？当我有最好的朋友，你，在我身边时。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Holding out on you how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 怎么会呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Huh? What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊？什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not sure that was me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不确定那是不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Oh. My necramech?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哦。你是说我的殁世机甲？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Mostly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 大部分吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not everything. Just stuff that the Entrati family deals with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不全是。只有英择谛家族的东西才是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I like the skull...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我挺喜欢那个骷髅的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Not that I know of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 据我所知没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Now that you mention it, I don't know what the skull *does.* But it has to be important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 既然你提到了这一点，其实我并不知道那个骷髅有什么*作用*。但它一定很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Different Entrati, but I get your point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 其实是另一个英择谛家族的人，但我明白你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, these were Father Entrati's creations, not Albrecht's, to be fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，确切来说，这些都是英择谛家族里"父亲"的作品，而不是阿尔布雷希特的作品。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's a long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: LOL. No. Very much not a priest. It's a long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 哈哈。不，绝对不是神父。说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Someone gives me a big gun, I use the big gun. I don't get paid to ask questions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有人给我一把大枪，那我就用这把大枪。我问问题又不会拿到什么工资。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, every single necramech I've ever seen has one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，我见过的每一个殁世机甲都会有一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So it has to be functional. Right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 所以它应该是有些什么功能的。对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Just be careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 只要小心一点就好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That sounds like a great project.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这听起来像是一个很棒项目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd like to help, too. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我也想来帮忙。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think I want to find out, do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我并不想知道，你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Maybe it tries to find another skull...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 也许它去找另一个骷髅……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I have a few, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 实际上，我有好几艘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I do. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我有。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You're not going to like the answer. The Orokin built the solutions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你不会喜欢这个问题的答案。是奥罗金创造的航行方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, that depends. Do you mean my "big ship" or my "little ship?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，那得看情况。你是指我的"大船"还是"小船"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, it depends on if it's the big ship or the little ship - but they both tap into the Void to cross the big distances. They cross through the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，这取决于飞船是大船还是小船——但它们都利用虚空来跨越遥远的距离。它们穿越虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, that's my Railjack. It has a replica of the severed finger of the Indifference - known as the Reliquary Drive - in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯，那是我的航道星舰。里面装着虚空无情之物的复制品手指——也就是圣物装置。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The big ship, the Railjack, uses a thing called a Reliquary Drive - it has a replica of the severed finger of the Indifference in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那艘大船，也就是航道星舰，使用了一种叫做圣物装置的东西——里面有一根虚空无情之物断指的复制品。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It uses that to tap into the Void to cross the big distances between the planets. It goes through the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它利用这个东西进入虚空，跨越行星之间的巨大距离。它就是这样在虚空中穿梭的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: RL;CBA: Albrecht went into the Void, panicked, wound up stealing some of the Indifference's fingers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 长；懒看：阿尔布雷希特进入虚空，惊慌失措，最后还偷走了虚空无情之物的手指。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well. Okay. So. Albrecht... was the first person to "discover" how to get into the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯。好吧。是这样。阿尔布雷希特……是第一个"发现"如何进入虚空的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It was a diving bell, of sorts. Made of something called seriglass. He stretched open the membrane between the worlds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 算是一个潜水钟舱吧。由一种叫做玻璃窗的东西制成。他撑开了连接两个世界的薄膜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Real Long; Can't Be Arsed. Quincy taught it to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 太长了；懒得看。昆西教我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Things went... wrong, to put it lightly. He panicked, staggered, the thing tipped, it got knocked against the razor-sharp edge of the membrane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 事情……说得好听一点，就是出了问题。他惊慌失措，踉跄了一下，那东西歪了过去，撞到了薄膜锋利的边缘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The seriglass bell shattered and he fell into the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 玻璃钟舱碎裂，他坠入虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: And when he came to, he was back in his lab, only it wasn't his lab. And he was staring at himself. Only it wasn't himself. And "he" called himself a name only his mother would know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 当他醒来时，他回到了实验室，只是那不再是他的实验室。他盯着自己，只不过那不再是他自己。"他"给他自己起了个只有他妈妈才知道的名字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, Albrecht ran for his life. He cut himself up on the broken seriglass, and wrote in his own blood for his daughter to close the membrane behind him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 于是，阿尔布雷希特拼命逃命。破碎的玻璃窗划伤了他，他用自己的血，写下了让他女儿关闭他身后那层膜质的字——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: - because he could feel that the "man" was reaching for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: ——因为他能感觉到那个"人"正在接近他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: She did. And when it shut? Well... its fingers were cut off, lying on the floor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 她照做了。当门关上的时候？嗯……它的手指被切断了，掉在地板上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It powers a lot more than just the Railjack, that's the problem...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它不仅为航道星舰提供动力，还为其他很多东西提供动力，这就是问题所在……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Probably.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I... don't know where they are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我……不知道那些手指在哪里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't know if that's a good idea?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不知道这是不是个好主意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Even if we knew where they were, I don't know if we *should* give them back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 即使我们知道它们在哪里，我也不知道我们是否应该把它们还回去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I know. I don't feel right about it, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我知道。我也觉得这样做不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: But unfortunately, the damage is done. Albrecht took the fingers. And now there's no going back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 但不幸的是，损失已经造成。阿尔布雷希特拿走了手指。现在已经无法挽回了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: There's something about the "Strands of Khra." It's super complicated? Something about it... I don't know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那个"时间丝线"有点特别。可以说超级复杂？说到特别之处……我也说不上来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't know if giving them back would do any good. I don't think it'd change his mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我不知道把它们还回去会不会有什么好处。我觉得这不会改变他的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Binding it here? Keeping it on our playing field? We have its fingers, so its stuck playing by our rules.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就把它困在这里？让它待在我们的地盘上？我们手上有它的手指，它就只能按照我们的规矩来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think the damage is done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想伤害已经造成了，没办法了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You never know, I suppose. Time will tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想，谁也不知道。但时间会给出答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Sometimes I wonder if that isn't what Entrati was doing, sending me back here. With all of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有时候我会想，这难道不正是英择谛的本意吗？把我送回到这里，和你们所有人一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Or off to wherever, to help... fix people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 或者去什么地方，去帮助……治愈人们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Even if it is to clean up his messes, in a way, it's to bring exactly that to the universe. That empathy you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 就算只是为了收拾他留下来的烂摊子，从某种程度上来说，这也是为了给宇宙带来你所说的同情心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: So, do you want to hear about the solar rails next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那么，你接下来想听听有关星际航道的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: But I can only hope that in the end, that's what this is all about. And that I'm not chasing around after a madman with a mop bucket.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 但我只能希望，最终一切都会好起来。而且不是我拿着拖把桶追着一个疯子跑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What's up between you and Kaya?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你和卡娅之间发生了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: How do you feel about Flare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你怎么看弗莱尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To be fair, I don't think she likes anybody very much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 说真的，我认为她谁都不太喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Does that bother you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这很困扰你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Huh. I really thought it'd bother you more that someone around here didn't like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 嗯。我还以为如果有人不喜欢你，你会更不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I just worry about her. I hope she's going to be okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我只是担心她。希望她一切安好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Let me know when. I'll help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 告诉我什么时候动手。我会帮忙的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: o_o; Note to self...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: o_o；我记下了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 塑料的那些吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 首饰盒？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_AWHUG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_THUMBSUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 至少不是你？<RETRO_EMOJI_FOOD>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You should see what the Helminth eats...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 你应该看看 Helminth 吃的是什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I don't think that was me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我觉得那不是我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: That's my K-Drive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那是我的 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It's... kind of like an atomicycle?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 它……有点像原子摩托车？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: You ride it around. I got it on Venus?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 那个你可以踩着它到处跑的东西。我是在金星拿到它的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Transference solves all problems?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 传识能解决所有问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'll see what I can do. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我会看看我能做什么。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: N
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不喜欢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Y
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 喜欢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: With who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 和谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To reattach a Railjack engine nacelle?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 用来重新安装航道星舰的引擎舱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To shut Amir up when he's talking about his favorite Contessa comic arc?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 用来封住阿米尔的嘴，不让他谈论他最爱的伯爵夫人漫画剧情？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To attach an office chair to the ceiling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 用来把办公椅固定在天花板上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To strap Quincy to the wall?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 用来把昆西绑在墙上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: To stop a Void leak?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 用来封住虚空的口子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: What? What'd I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 啊？我说错什么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Well, when you're done with that, there's a rip in the Albrecht Membrane you could take a look at...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 好吧，等你补完洞之后，你还可以去看看阿尔布雷希特膜质上的裂口……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: It has a ship plugging it. *For now.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 有一艘飞船就堵在那。*目前是这样。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Favorite season. Go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 最喜欢的季节。说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Winter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 冬天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Summer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 夏天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Fall, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 其实是秋天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Same. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 一样。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I like getting to bundle up by a warm fire. It's so peaceful and cozy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我喜欢在温暖的炉火旁裹上被子。感觉好宁静好舒适。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: The snow is just so pretty when it's fresh. And it's fun to play in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 初雪很漂亮。在雪里玩也很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Everything's cold and dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 万物都是冰冷而死寂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I like to pick at peeling sunburns.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我喜欢抠掉晒伤处的脱皮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Bright warm sun, time on the beach... ocean waves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 温暖灿烂的阳光，海滩上的时光……还有海浪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Water blaster fights! Dog days are always a laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 打水仗！三伏天总是充满欢笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Watching things die makes me happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 看着万物凋零让我感到快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: We had these dormizone trees whose leaves used to change colors in the fall. It was so beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我们居住舱种了一种落叶松，秋天的时候，叶子会变色，非常漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: When Amir made us those "apple cider donuts" I think I got *hooked.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 之前阿米尔给我们做那些"苹果酒甜甜圈"，我想我已经*上瘾了*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Allergies bring me joy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 过敏给我带来快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: This is going to sound weird, but I think bees are adorable. I like watching them do their thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 这听起来可能有点奇怪，但我觉得蜜蜂很可爱。我喜欢看它们做事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Spring flowers. They're so beautiful, even if they don't last long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 春天的花。它们好美，虽然它们不会持续很长时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I try not to think too hard about how he got the apples...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我尽量不去想他是怎么得到苹果的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想阿米尔超级喜欢吉尼梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I think Kaya is super into jinymon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我想卡娅非常喜欢吉尼梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: Your secret is safe with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.zhText: 我一定会帮你保守秘密的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/C.text: I'd love to play with you guys someday.
