/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你会慢慢习惯的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: awwwww <RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 啊啊 <RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: apology accepted ^.^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我接受你的道歉了 ^.^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and honestly? u've been on my mind a lot, lately... are u sure you want to go out with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 老实说？最近我一直在想着你……你确定你想跟我约会吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: um. i mean. u did have ur chance and it didn't go so well. <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯。我是说。你之前是有机会的，但结果不太好。<RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: really??? <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT> why didn't u say anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 真的吗？？？<RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>那你为什么不说出来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but... if i'm being honest i have really missed u... and quincy did say u were really sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不过……如果要我实话实说的话，我确实很想念你……而且昆西也说你真的很后悔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: are u sure you want to give this another try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你确定想再试一次吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: lol u are so strange sometimes <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，有时候你真的很奇怪 <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: are u sure you want to go out with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你确定要和我约会吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_FLOWERS><RETRO_EMOJI_HEART><RETRO_EMOJI_HEART><RETRO_EMOJI_HEART><RETRO_EMOJI_FLOWERS>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_FLOWERS><RETRO_EMOJI_HEART><RETRO_EMOJI_HEART><RETRO_EMOJI_HEART><RETRO_EMOJI_FLOWERS>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_KNIFE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: OK I'm bored. Maybe a little curious too ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，我很无聊。不过也有点好奇 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: what about whales? those beautiful voices would make them strong contenders too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那鲸鱼呢？它们那些美妙的声音也不容小觑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well ur there, so it's at least kind of cool
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，你在那里，所以这至少有点酷

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u sound silly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你听起来挺傻

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: omg Amir's about to get a new high score in Ollie's Crash Course! can't miss this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦天，阿米尔快要在奥利的极速赛道里打破记录了！这可不能错过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ttyl ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回聊 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: both are good! depends on the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 两个都很好！主要看那天的心情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: okay wow so we have to fix that!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧哇所以我们必须解决这个问题！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: tell me about ur day!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 聊聊你今天都干了些什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_DOG>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_DOG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh my bad. sweet dreams!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 噢，不好意思。祝你好梦！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: whatcha listening to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你在听什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: would u like milk or sugar in ur caffeinated bevvy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你喜欢在你的咖啡因饮料里加牛奶还是糖？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: aaw u charmer. do u really like them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 啊啊你会真讨人喜欢。你真的喜欢他们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: best of both worlds, hmm? I respect that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 两全其美，嗯？我尊重你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oo la la. black as ur soul, no? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦啦啦。像你的灵魂一样黑吗？ ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: how sweet of you! ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你好甜呀！^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_COW>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_COW>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur response has been carefully noted
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你的回答我已经认真记下了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: have a nice day!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 祝你有美好的一天！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: delightful!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 愉快极了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm watching Quincy pretend he's not annoyed that he missed the bullseye during target practice
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我在看昆西假装他不在意没射中靶心的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: do u prefer coffee or tea?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你喜欢咖啡还是茶？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_PASSGLASSES>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_PASSGLASSES>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: k thx not bored anymore
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好的谢谢，不无聊了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh that's cool! ^_^ sry
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，那太好了！^_^ 不好意思

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like an inch off the center lol. end of the world, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，就差了一寸，简直是世界末日，对吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: if only we could all be as amusing as u :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 要是我们都能像你一样有趣就好了 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: the annoyed part or the pretending not to be annoyed part?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是生气的那部分，还是假装不生气的那部分？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur telling me I have TWO roguish perfectionists to worry about now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你是说我现在要担心两个调皮完美主义者了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: what a wonderfully mysterious thing to say
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 真是个神秘兮兮的说法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: the future sounds srsly awesome
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 未来听起来真的很棒啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh... :) yeaaaaah
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦…… :) 确实

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, you'd better get back out there and save the world or whatever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那你还是快点回去继续拯救世界或者什么的吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: the multiverse even
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 甚至是多元宇宙

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: take care of yourself, k?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 照顾好自己，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: totally!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: On-lyne makes it look ez, but pop music takes a lot of skill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 线上时代看起来很轻松，但流行音乐其实需要很多技巧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: exactly!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 正是！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: pretty hard on yourself, are u? that's too bad. u deserve better :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对自己挺苛刻的嘛？太不应该了。你值得更好的 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: let's talk after you've written your hit song, maestro :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 大师，等你写出自己的热门歌曲再说 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: should be ez
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 应该挺简单的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hey, you're great at curing boredom :) thx
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嘿，你很擅长消除无聊 :) 谢谢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oof he's been frowning silently into the void for like 5 mins. I should at least try to cheer him up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他已经皱着眉头默默地望着空气五分钟了。我得去逗他开心一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we'll chat more later, yah? ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 等会儿再聊，好吗？ ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wellll I've heard a lot of "pop isn't real music" and "hating things u like makes me unique"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，我听过很多人说"流行音乐不是真正的音乐"和"讨厌你喜欢的东西让我显得与众不同"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but enough about me! what's music like in the future?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但别说我了！未来的音乐是什么样的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: im totally telling Arthur u said that ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我绝对要告诉亚瑟你这么说的 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: nope! tell me about it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没有！告诉我吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: (kidding)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: （开玩笑的）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: (unless you dont care bc i will so tell Arthur u said that)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: （除非你不介意，因为我真的会告诉亚瑟）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: deal
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 一言为定

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: then it's our little secret!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那就咱俩的小秘密了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but fr thx for saying that ^_^ and curing my boredom
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不过真的谢谢你这么说 ^_^ 还消除了我的无聊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like a guitar? piano? octobass?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 像吉他？钢琴？巴乌？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sounds beautiful ^_^ I'd like to hear it some time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 听起来很美呢 ^_^ 有机会我想听听看

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sure
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 行吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'll hold you to that ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 记住你说的话了 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: aaw I was ready to hear that in the future we learned to commune with the ocean's greatest musicians!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 啊，我都准备好听到未来我们能和地上最棒的音乐家交流呢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think I'll like future music ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我觉得我会喜欢未来的音乐 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think you left a fancy energy-blasting pistol thing here
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想你可能留了一把很精致的能量爆破手枪在这

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh. ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: enh, I guess I'll just leave it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，我想我就这么放着吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I didn't love being called boring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不喜欢被说成无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: honest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I appreciate you saying that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 谢谢你这么说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well u are pretty clever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，你确实挺聪明的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 看来陪审团被你的辩护说服了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sometimes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 有时

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and grants you a fresh start
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 给你一个重新开始的机会

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPY2>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPY2>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: definitely!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u bet. talk soon!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没错。一会儿再聊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: should I ask u about the weather?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我应该问你天气吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: then I guess that's all for now!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那我想现在就这些吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hmmm lemme think.........
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，让我想想……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: how's the weather on venus? ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 金星的天气怎么样？^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: uuuuh coolant whatnows?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呃，冷却什么来着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: isn't venus like... really hot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 金星不是应该……很热吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and surrounded by dense gas?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 还被那些密集的气体所包围？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I was joking. I thought venus couldn't sustain life lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我开玩笑的。我以为金星根本无法维持生命，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: r uuuu messing with meee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你在逗我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: cool! did we fix jupiter too?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 酷！我们把木星也修好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: darn. I guess I'll live with that midnight mind-trap forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 真遗憾。看来我永远无法摆脱那个午夜的心理陷阱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know when ur mind settles into the quiet of the night and starts pulling all kinds of crazy things from your subconscious as u try to sleep? mind-traps!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道当你的头脑在夜深人静的时候开始平静下来，尝试睡觉时却从潜意识中抽出各种疯狂的东西？那就是心理陷阱！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh ^_^ that's cool
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦 ^_^ 没事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: gosh no! It's not like that. It's just... wow this is embarrassing heh
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哎呀，不！不是那样的。只是……哇，这有点尴尬呢，呵呵

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm gonna go
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我得走了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ^_^ it was just a roundabout way of saying I'm kinda scared of jupiter
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ^_^ 其实我只是在绕弯子说我有点怕木星

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: which I guess sounds silly to a future-person who hangs out in its atmosphere like all the time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我猜，对一个经常待在木星大气层的未来人来说，这听起来可能很傻……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so ya I'm gonna go
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以嗯，我得走了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Lettie told me if u fell into jupiter, u'd hit a point where the atmosphere is denser than ur body, so u'd bob up and down. stuck. forever falling then getting launched back up between densities
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 莱蒂告诉我，如果你掉进木星，你会到达一个大气比你身体密度大的地方，所以你会在那里上下浮动。被卡住。不断坠落然后又因为密度差被弹回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that is until u disintegrate! plus it's the size of like 1300 earths... long fall... long launch!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 直到你的身体粉碎！而且它的大小大概是 1300 个 地球……漫长的坠落……漫长的弹起！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and it always will be! but it helps to talk about it :')
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 它一直都那么可怕！不过说出来心里会舒服些 :')

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: not super comforting, but I appreciate the effort
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这话虽然不太安慰人，但我感谢你的尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that is... oddly comforting
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这……出奇地安慰人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: jupiter would be a nightmare even if it were the size of earth tho
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 即使木星和地球一样大，也会是一场噩梦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's not like I'm an astronaut anyway
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 反正我也不是宇航员

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh duh! I guess u wouldn't have astronauts anymore
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，对啦！我猜你们现在不再有宇航员了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: the word's kinda meaningless when EVERYONE's an astronaut lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当每个人都是宇航员的时候，这个词就没什么意义了，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: an astronaut is someone who *explores* space. people can't live there yet, but we visit!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 宇航员是那些*探索*太空的人。我们还不能在那里生活，但是我们会去探访！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: :) that's a really cool way to look at it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: :) 这是一个很酷的看法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: pretty cool ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 很酷 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ummm... I've been enjoying our convo so much that I ignored the fancy energy-blasting pistol thing leaking some kinda green ooze onto the floor...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呃……我们聊得太开心了，我都没注意到那把精致能量爆破手枪在地上漏了些绿色的东西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's starting to smell weird sooo
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 味道开始变得怪怪的，所以

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm gonna get Quincy to deal with that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我准备去叫昆西来处理

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: until next time!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 下次再见！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I spilled bubble tea on my PC pls tell me you got this message so I know everything works
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我把珍珠奶茶洒在电脑上了，拜托，告诉我你收到这条消息了，这样我就知道电脑还能用

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: phew. k thx that's all
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呼。好的，谢谢，就这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: same. ok bye
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也是。好了，再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这个回答简短得可疑，不过好吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: anything I can do to make ur day better?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我能做些什么来让你的一天变得更好呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SWEAT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SWEAT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: knock knock
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 咚咚

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_FLOWERS>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_FLOWERS>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: nope! :) it's...
med pack
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 医疗包

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: glad you like them ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 很高兴你喜欢它们 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: med pack ur bags. we're going to the future!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 医疗包打包好。我们要去未来！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a joke inspired by u! ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 一个受你启发的笑话！^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a joke inspired by u! ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 一个受你启发的笑话！^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hope u don't mind me getting a bit serious for a sec
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 希望你不介意我稍微严肃一下

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I see u pushing yourself for others without ever asking for anything in return
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我看到你总是为别人拼命努力，却从不要求回报

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so I just wanna say, if u ever want to share some those burdens u carry, I'm always here
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以我只想说，如果你想要分享你所承担的负担，我会一直在这里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ^_^ ok enough serious talk for now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ^_^ 好了现在严肃的话题就说到这里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I don't think we can help ourselves without helping others too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我觉得如果不帮助别人，我们也无法帮助自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: only the people I care about
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 只对我关心的人说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but that's a topic for another time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不过这个话题我们留到下次吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'll leave u with that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就先说到这儿吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: may the rest of ur day be lovely
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 希望你剩下的一天过得愉快

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well u are pretty clever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，你确实挺聪明的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: they're nothing fancy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没什么特别的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I appreciate you saying that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 谢谢你这么说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 看来陪审团被你的辩护说服了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPY2>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPY2>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and grants you a fresh start
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 给你一个重新开始的机会

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I didn't love being called boring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不喜欢被说成无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sometimes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 有时

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: definitely!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u bet. talk soon!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没错。一会儿再聊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: honest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WINK>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: they're pretty! and fun! most importantly...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 它们真的很漂亮！而且好玩！最重要的是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I suppoooose I would, but they're really for me ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我猜我愿意，但它们其实是为我自己准备的 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: 1000 cranes grant a wish!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 1000 只鹤能实现一个愿望！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh yes but *metal* cranes are even more magical (I like to think)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，是的，但是*金属*鹤更有魔力（我是这么认为的）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I thought it was common knowledge!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我以为这是常识！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm sure! cranes have a proven track record, u know
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我确定！纸鹤可是有可靠战绩的，你知道的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ^_^ I'm glad u think so!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ^_^ 我很高兴你这么觉得！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wasn't too ridiculous for the Jipangu space program!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对于日木国太空计划来说并不算太荒谬！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: then allow me to fill u in ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那就让我来告诉你吧 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: allow me to grant ur wish ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那就让我来帮你实现这个愿望吧 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh excellent! who couldn't use a wish, right? it's a lovely notion
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，太好了！谁不想有个愿望呢，对吧？这是个可爱的想法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: lol ok
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，好吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: before Jipangu trained their astronauts to go to space, they had candidates fold 1000 cranes. true story!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 在日木国训练宇航员去太空之前，他们让候选人折了 1000 只纸鹤。真事！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's just what it sounds like! when u fold 1000 cranes, ur supposed to get a wish. traditionally, people fold paper, but I'm sure folding metal works just as well lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就是这么回事！当你折出 1000 只鹤时，你应该就能实现一个愿望。传统上是折纸鹤，不过我觉得折金属鹤的效果一样好，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_ANNOYED1>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_ANNOYED1>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: "some superstition"?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: "什么迷信"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya! ^_^ u get it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 耶！^_^ 你明白了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so like did u just ask about my cranes to make fun of me ooor... ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那你刚才问我的鹤是想取笑我还是怎样……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oki doki
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧好吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: alrighty then
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那好吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a few hundred. I have a tally tucked away somewhere between all my CDs lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 几百只吧。我把记录夹在了 CD 堆里某个地方，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: actually yes! that wish wasn't for me though. time I get a wish for myself, dontcha think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的，有过！但那个愿望不是为了我自己。我该为自己许个愿了，你说呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: no way! focusing on the end is just overwhelming. the trick is to focus on the moment. one step at a time! then one day u look around and go "oh look at that I'm done" ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没门！一直盯着目标会让人压力山大。秘诀是专注于当下，一步一步来！然后有一天你回头看时，你会发现，"哎呀，我居然完成了" ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: if I tell u, it won't come tru!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 如果我告诉你，愿望就不会实现了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I couldn't have said it better! ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 说得太对了！^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ok! I do love a wish guardian ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好的！我真是喜欢愿望守护者 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, the good news is when u fold ur 1000 cranes, u can track them however u want!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，好消息是，当你折完 1000 只鹤后，你想怎么记录它们都可以！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm not gonna risk it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我才不冒这个险呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: weeeell it's not a very cheery tale. I'd rather not get into it right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，那是一个不太开心的故事。我现在不太想提。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: cranes don't have to be metal. go on, start folding that paper! ^_^ or metal, if u prefer! (tho I think u'll find that much harder)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 纸鹤不一定非要是金属的。来吧，开始折纸吧！^_^ 如果你喜欢，也可以用金属！（不过我觉得会难很多哦）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's all good <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没事 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yes I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的，我确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'd be happy to <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我很乐意教你 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: gosh my whole "these cranes are a deeply personal symbol of growth for me and take a heck of a lot of time to make" thing went right over ur head, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 天哪，我那番"这些鹤对我来说是一个深刻的成长象征，而且折起来特别耗时间"的话，完全被你忽略了，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ^_^ ur making my heart feel very full
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ^_^ 你让我感觉心里很踏实

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: if this is a joke, I don't find it very funny
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 如果这是个玩笑，我觉得一点都不好笑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: all is forgiven
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我已经原谅你了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: haha I hope so
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，我也希望如此

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: nah I just wear cool shades
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不，我只是戴了很酷的墨镜而已

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: back atcha ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 彼此彼此 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SUNGLASSES>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ^_^ it's the one best way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ^_^ 这是最好的方式

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hey, it was cool of u to show interest :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嘿，看到你感兴趣真的很酷 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYARMSUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYARMSUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and next time I see you seeing me fold cranes, I'll have an appreciation for ur appreciation heehee
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 下次我看到你欣赏我折鹤时，我也会欣赏你对我的欣赏，嘻嘻

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wow! I can feel ur energy flowing through the cosmos already <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哇！我都能感觉到你的能量已经在宇宙中流动过来了 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yeah!! y?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对啊！！怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like what kind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哪种游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ooooo that sounds fun!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 噢！听起来很好玩！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like what kind of play pretend? ... r people gonna make fun of me for playing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 扮演什么样的角色呢？……别人会不会嘲笑我玩这个游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: count me in!! oh oh oh do you think he'll let me play a character that has pets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 算我一个！！哦哦哦你觉得他会让我扮演一个有宠物的角色吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ... i think i'm good...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ……我想我还是不玩了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i think it'll mean the world to amir to have everybody around the table playing... he's like me. big heart <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我觉得对于阿米尔来说，大家围坐在一起玩游戏一定是一件非常特别的事……他和我很像。都是心地善良 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: after extensive research, I've determined which beverage to recommend u try ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 经过广泛的研究，我决定推荐你尝试一种饮料 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a salted honey milkshake
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 盐味蜂蜜奶昔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a smokey earl grey latte
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 烟熏伯爵拿铁

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a coconut rose smoothie
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 椰子玫瑰冰沙

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a moon milk latte
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 月亮牛奶拿铁

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: an iced matcha chai latte
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 冰抹茶拿铁

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sweet and salty. best of both worlds! just the way u like it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 甜咸适中。两全其美！正合你的口味

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's as dark and rich as ur beautiful soul
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 它就像你美丽的灵魂一样厚重和丰富

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's as sweet as u ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: "we all THINK we'd stand up for what's right, but u never know til ur actually in that moment of truth. u might just freeze up! the intensity could totally overwhelm u!!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: "我们都以为自己会为正义挺身而出，但直到真正面对那一刻才会知道。你可能会被吓得愣住！那种压迫感可能会彻底把你压垮！！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: right? don’t u just hate that kinda posturing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是吧？你不也讨厌这种装模做样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: nobody should be *made* to fight
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 任何人都不应该*被迫*去战斗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's really sad though
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但这真的很悲哀

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well... ok. so... when it came to the question of fighting for what's right...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯……好吧。那么……当谈到为正义而战的问题时……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: whether I'd answer the call or not was never a question for me. honestly, I spent most of high school just trying not to fight—or at least not to argue
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对我来说，要不要响应召唤从来不是个问题。老实说，我高中时大部分时间都在尽量避免冲突——或者至少不吵架

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya ya :P even so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是啊是啊 :P 但即便如此……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I always believed in the whole "pick ur battles" thing... not that I would've admitted it back then
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我一直相信"选择自己的战斗"这个道理……虽然那时候的我不会承认

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ehh, don't give me too much credit. I still got fired up too easily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哎，别太夸我了。我还是很容易冲动的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: anything about the strong picking on the weak got under my skin. that and bad leaders.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 任何关于强者欺负弱者的事都让我无法忍受。还有糟糕的领导者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he's the gold standard. always puts the team first, never blames someone else for a mistake. we'd all trust him with our lives. he's earned that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他是黄金标准。总是把团队放在第一位，从不把错误归咎于他人。我们都愿意信赖他，把性命托付给他。他值得这份信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: LOL hey, Quincy’s not as mean as he pretends to be. he’s always looking out for the underdog, so he’s good in my book.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，嘿，其实昆西没有他表现出来的那么刻薄。他总是在帮助弱者，所以我觉得他人还挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Lettie understood me faster than anyone else ever has. "fast friends" sums it up perfectly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 莱蒂比任何人都更快地理解我。用"一见如故"来形容再合适不过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think so. when others kept their distance, worried she'd go full-tech-rot, I made sure to spend time with her. couldn't stand the idea of her feeling alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想是的。当其他人疏远她，担心她会完全变成科腐者时，我会确保花时间陪伴她。我无法接受让她感到孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ^_^ we have a blast! everyone else is serious *all the time* lol. honestly, without him, I'd probably feel pretty isolated
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ^_^ 我们玩得很开心！其他人*一直*都很严肃，哈哈。老实说，没有他，我可能会感到非常孤单

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's...
exactly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没错

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 因为你内心也有那团火，不是吗？我喜欢你这一点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm just gonna pretend u never said that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我就当你没说过吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: enlisting in the ICR felt like a way to channel the fire I’ve always had into something meaningful
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 加入国危部就像是找到了一种方式，将我一直以来有的那团火投入到有意义的事情中去

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: none. I really believe that someone has to fight to protect the people who call for peace
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没有。我真的相信必须有人为了保护那些渴望和平的人们而战

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: no matter what happens to me, I know I spent my life fighting for that ideal. I'm proud of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 无论我会遭遇什么，我知道我的一生都在为这个理想而战。我为此感到自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: being cute always bought me time to pick my battles
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 可爱总是能帮我争取时间来挑选战斗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and being nice? well, it’s just the right way to be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 至于友善？嗯，这本来就是做人该有的态度

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你是说，你宁愿让阿米尔难过，也要为自己造一辆全新的原子摩托车？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 很显然我们对优势的定义不同

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so make ur case
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那你说说你的理由

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm sure he would, but that's not all there is to it

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: LOL save that rage for the Scaldra ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: don't worry we all did lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 别担心，我们大家都放弃了，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I've gotta run. Promise not to crush any arcade machines while I'm gone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我得走了。答应我，别趁我不在的时候砸那些街机，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: excellent!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 非常好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I've got my eye on uuuuuu
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我可是会盯着你呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur the best
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你是最棒的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: nobody's serious and boring all the time either
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也没有人会永远都那么严肃无聊啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wut makes u think its an act?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你凭什么觉得这是装的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: mhm
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that might be true for u, but that doesn't mean it's true for everyone
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这可能对你来说是对的，但不代表对每个人都是这样的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I get that u have bad days. who doesn't, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我理解你会有不顺心的时候。谁没有呢，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but u can't just take it out on me cuz I seem "cute" enough to put up with it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但你不能因为我看上去"可爱"，觉得我会忍受，就把气撒在我身上

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe u just haven't been paying attention
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 或许是你根本没用心去看吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur introspection is awfully charming, I admit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我承认，你的自省让人觉得很有魅力

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I get that u have bad days. who doesn't, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我理解你会有不顺心的时候。谁没有呢，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but u can't just take it out on me cuz I seem nice enough to put up with it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但你不能因为我看上去友善，觉得我会忍受，就把气撒在我身上

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know that's not what I mean
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道我不是这个意思

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I do like the sound of that promise...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我确实很喜欢你这个承诺……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ok let's put this behind us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，这事就翻篇了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TINYSMILE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ttyl
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回聊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: (in case you don't know, ttyl means "talk to you later")
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: （以防你不知道，回聊的意思是"回头再聊"）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: are u serious right now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你现在是认真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hmm
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: right...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I just need some time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我只是需要一些时间

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: look I'm gonna put this behind us, ok?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，我打算把这件事翻篇了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: how am I supposed to receive that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那我该怎么理解这话呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: at least u found it "cute and all"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 至少你觉得它"可爱"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: of course u can. we manic pixie dream girls wear our hearts on her sleeves
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你当然可以。我们这些古灵精怪的小仙女可是把心事写在脸上的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: at least nobody I want to be around
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 至少我不想和那样的人待在一起

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it concerns me that u don't think depth, toughness, pop songs, and emoticons can go together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 让我担心的是，你居然觉得深度、坚强、流行歌曲和表情符号不能结合在一起

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wut gave it away? my zest for life? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你怎么发现的？是因为我对生活的热情吗？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I grew up in one of Canata's major cities right on the water, surrounded by mountains. it's beautiful! (albeit expensive)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我在卡纳塔的一个大城市长大，这座城市就在水边，四周环绕着群山。那里非常美！（尽管生活成本高）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: terribly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 非常想念

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: definitely! it's one of my fave places on earth
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 绝对是！这是我在地球上最喜欢的地方之一

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: (without a doubt)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: （毫无疑问）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but of course it took embarking on a hero's journey to realize that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但是，直到踏上英雄之旅后我才意识到这一点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya! just like a storybook. gotta leave ur peaceful little village and slay a big dragon so u can truly appreciate the peace, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是啊！就像童话故事一样。你得离开你宁静的小村庄，杀死一条大龙，这样才能真正体会到和平的珍贵，你懂吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Oro-whats? :O
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 奥金什么？:O

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: That certainly sounds like a dragon!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那听起来确实像是条龙！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it wouldn't be the craziest thing I've heard a time-traveller say ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 比起时间旅行者说过的其他话，这已经不算最疯狂的了 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hmmm
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so u've already had a heroes journey. here I was thinking u were on that journey with us in the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以你已经有过一段英雄之旅了。我还以为你是和我们六人组一起经历这段旅程呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so I gather!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 看出来了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we're glad u crossed our path, traveller ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 旅行者，我们很高兴与你在路上相遇 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur MY hero! ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你是我的英雄！^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hang on. I couldn't tell how serious u were being. have u... literally slain a dragon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 等等。我不确定你是不是在开玩笑。你真的……亲手杀过龙吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like the man in the wall
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就像墙中人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I've never heard that term in my life :O
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我这辈子都没听说过这个词 :O

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm so confused lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我现在真是一头雾水，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: real dragons?! :O what happened with this "Orowyrm"?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 真的龙？！:O 那这只"奥金魇龙"后来怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we'll get him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们会杀死他的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_CHEEKY>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_CHEEKY>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: huh. maybe fairy tales should remain fiction after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯。看来童话还是留在故事里比较好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sounds like it involves giving form to... a concept.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 听起来像是给一个概念……赋予形态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh. my. stars.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我。的。天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I KNOW AN ACTUAL DRAGON SLAYER
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我居然认识了一位真正的屠龙者

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sry that's all I got
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不好意思，我也就这些了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wait are U a dragon?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 等一下，你是龙吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe one of us should have paid attention in school ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也许我们当初应该在学校里多留心听讲 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur teachers were right :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你的老师说的没错 :P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh no! I really should slay u, but I like u too darn much
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 完了！我应该杀了你，但我实在太喜欢你了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh! that explains my fiery personality ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦！难怪我性格这么火爆 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hey, u think I'd make a good damsel in distress?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嘿，你觉得我能演好落难少女吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think u'd make a good damsel in distress too ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我觉得你也会是个不错的落难少女 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we could both be knights instead!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们可以都当骑士啊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: of course! <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然了！<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPY2>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPY2>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ditto
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: even better!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这样更好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没错！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: lol whatever suits ur fancy!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，你高兴就好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, brave hero, we'll have to finish this story later. I've gotta get back to the other adventurers in our troop
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，勇敢的英雄，我们以后再继续这个故事。我得回去找我们队伍里的其他冒险者了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: will do!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 一定！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: there's so very much to look forward to <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 还有很多让人期待的事情呢 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sounds like something a dragon would say
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这话听起来很像是龙会说的啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_MUSIC2> question for u
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_MUSIC2> 有问题问你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, i guess first, do u know what a piano is? maybe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，首先，你知道钢琴是什么吗？有可能听过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh oh OH! the Shawzin, my ears yearn!  won't you play for me one day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 噢噢噢！三线琴，我的耳朵好想听啊！能不能哪天为我演奏一次？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh that's ok that's okay, anyway - piano
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，没关系，没关系，话说回来——钢琴

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i'm holding you do that! <RETRO_EMOJI_THUMBSUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我可记住你这话了！<RETRO_EMOJI_THUMBSUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so there's sort of this song here that anyone who has been around a piano knows, called 'Soul & Heart'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这里有一首曲子，几乎每个弹过钢琴的人都知道，叫做《灵魂与心灵》

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's a two person song though, just a few notes <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不过这是一首双人合奏的曲子，但只有几个音符 <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i was thinking it could be fun - find a piano in some abandoned store, if it has metal i can move it carefully..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我在想这可能会很好玩——去废弃的商店找一架钢琴，如果它有金属的话，我可以小心地把它搬走……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe i can teach you not to be so rude. forget it - your loss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也许我可以教教你别那么无礼。算了——这是你的损失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE> i don't know actually, BUT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE> 其实我不知道，但是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: me too, the guys would freak!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也是，其他人一定会很惊讶的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: in any case - partner. for one song. could be fun right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不管怎样——搭档。就一起弹一首歌。应该挺好玩的吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Ms. Aoi reporting for duty. First lesson: piano lesson!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 碧老师报道。第一课：钢琴课！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: first up: there's lots of keys. 88 last i counted. each one makes a noise. doh rei mi fa...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 首先：琴键很多。我上次数的是 88 个。每个键都会发出声音。哆、来、咪、发……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh jeeze, music should not make you think of such things. no fear. only Soul & Heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，天哪，音乐不应该让你想到这些事情。不用害怕。只有灵魂与心灵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: tell ya what, i'll work on this lesson plan for ya!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这样吧，我会为你制定这个教学计划！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and i'll find away to do it that doesn't make you remember anything scary.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 而且我会找到一个不让你回忆起任何可怕经历的方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: my star student, Ms. Aoi expects the best! Now repeat after me: Doh Rei Mi Fa
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我的尖子生，碧老师期望看到你最好的表现！现在跟我一起读：哆、来、咪、发

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: A+ for you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 给你 A+！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: F! See me after class.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不及格！下课后来见我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hahaha oml i should never be a teacher. but lets talk about piano again some day, ok?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈哈，天哪，我真不应该当老师。但是我们改天再谈谈钢琴，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh - shoot. gotta run, we'll pick up the lesson another time!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦——糟了。我得走了，我们下次再继续上课！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i read in an On-lyne interview once that music can be like, therapy. maybe it's something we can both enjoy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我曾经在一次线上时代采访中读到，音乐可以像治疗一样。也许这是我们都能享受的东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh, i see. i know, i do. ok. no sweat, never a prob, let's just listen to a song or two later?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，我明白。我知道，没关系。不要紧，没问题，我们等会一起听一两首歌怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yesss! music is the soundtrack to our lives.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，你真是太好了。嘿……其实，我可能有点夸张了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I am - sort of. "happy" doesn't really describe mom and dad
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我——算是吧。不过"快乐"这个词并不能很好形容我爸妈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we got along well enough
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们相处得还行吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: lol of course I am
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，当然是啦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: my parents were...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我父母曾……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh no I didn't mean that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦不，我不是那个意思

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: true. I appreciate that silver lining lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 确实。这倒是一个意外的好处，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's truly special
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这真的很特别

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we didn't always see eye-to-eye
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们并不总是看法一致

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur probably right. funny how we can all be so similar yet so different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你可能是对的。有趣的是，我们如此相似却又如此不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: LOL actually yes, but that wasn't a big deal
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，确实是，但那不是什么大问题

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya. more or less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的。或多或少吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: they were so upset when I told them I'd enlisted to be a soldier. didn't make much difference to them that it was for peace keeping
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当我告诉他们我要去当兵的时候，他们很不高兴。即使我说这是为了维和，也没能让他们好受一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I had a very high risk tolerance for my own life. my parents? not so much
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我对自己的生活风险容忍度很高。我的父母呢？就没那么高了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: definitely. wish I'd been more grateful for that at the time... and more understanding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 确实。希望当时我能更感激他们……也更理解他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think they were, but they were concerned too. they didn't want anything to hurt their only daughter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想他们是骄傲的，但他们也很担心。他们不想让任何事情伤害到他们唯一的女儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I wouldn't say that. they just wanted their only daughter to be safe...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不这么认为。他们只是希望他们的独生女儿能够平安……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'm incredibly lucky to have parents who cared as deeply as they did. it's just a shame our family never found a way to show it openly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我非常幸运有这样关心我的父母。只是遗憾我们的家庭从未找到一个公开表达这种爱的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: if I get the chance to see them again, I'll make things right. I'll shower them in love haha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 如果我有机会再见到他们，我会尽力补偿。我会用爱来浇灌他们哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: thx... I think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 谢谢……大概是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I'll do everything in my power to make it so
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我会尽我所能让它实现

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know, hearing someone else say that makes it feel more true <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道吗，听别人这么说让我感觉更真实 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: thx for asking about them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 谢谢你问起来他们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's nice to be asked about mom and dad :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 有人问起我爸妈，感觉真好 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: most of the hex get so bummed out remembering home. we don't talk about family much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 六人组的大多数人一想到家就郁闷，我们很少谈到家庭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: of course <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然了 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya. me too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯。我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: agreed :) but I get where they're coming from
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 同意 :) 不过我也能理解他们的想法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, I'd better get going for now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，我现在得走了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's easy when you make me feel so safe <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 有你让我觉得这么安心，一切都变得很容易 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya :) we're definitely gonna talk again soon, silly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是啊 :) 我们很快就会再聊的，傻瓜

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u too <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你也是 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's nice to reminisce anyway
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不管怎么说，回忆一下也不错

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hey, um...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嘿，嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: this might sound corny, but it’s important to me, so I’m just gonna say it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这可能听起来很老套，但这对我很重要，所以我就直说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u make me feel like I belong
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你让我感到有归属感

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe... in a way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也许……在某种程度上

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh, I know they do <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> and I adore them too but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，我知道他们是 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>，我也很喜欢他们，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh it's not like I've ever been excluded or anything!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，我又没被排挤过！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I mean, I know how to fit in anywhere, but that’s not the same as truly belonging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我意思是，我知道如何融入任何地方，但那和真正的归属感是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: It sure is. And even so, you make me feel... hmm...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 确实如此。即便如此，你还是让我觉得……嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: exactly. and that’s what you give me. even when things are chaotic or scary, with you, I feel… hmm…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 完全正确。这就是你给我的感觉。即使事情很混乱或可怕，和你在一起，我觉得……嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: at home
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 像家一样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wow. that could be a lyric in an On-lyne song.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哇。这句可以写进线上时代的新歌里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I know you’re from so far away <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我知道你来自遥远的地方 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 抱歉，现在说这话是不是很奇怪？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: my heart is beating really fast

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但你要知道，我也会尽我所能成为你的家

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: okay, well… I know what those songs are usually about
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧……我知道那些歌通常是关于什么的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: heh. at least we understand each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嘿。至少我们能互相理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur one of my favorite people in the whole world, u know that?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's a relief

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 说真的，你真了不起。你所面对的一切，你所成为的一切……我很感激能认识你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ^_^ always and forever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ^_^ 直到永远

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: heh. maybe...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，也许吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's sweet of u <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你真贴心 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we were out on a peacekeeping mission with the ICR but I still wanted to celebrate venusia in some way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们当时和国危部一起执行维和任务，但我还是想以某种方式来庆祝金星节

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以我花了几个星期为他折了 1000 只纸鹤。你知道吗，纸鹤象征着好运，而攒满 1000 个就可以实现一个愿望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I dunno. it's not really about who "deserved" what. it just came down to us being too different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不知道。这其实不是谁"活该"的问题。归根结底是因为我们太不一样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and I u <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也不想看到你难过 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 每到吃饭或睡觉前的空闲时间，我就会偷偷溜出去，满心欢喜地想着给他一个金星节惊喜会让他有多开心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: looking back, it's kind of embarrassing. I had built up his reaction in my head and then when I gave him the cranes...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回想起来，还有点尴尬。我已经在脑海里构想了他的反应，然后当我把纸鹤给他的时候……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he just said, "thanks, but we really dont have time for this kind of thing."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他只是说，"谢谢，但我们真的没时间做这种事"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I could too, but understanding only gets u so far. when something deep within says something's off, eventually u just have to listen
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也能理解，但是光靠理解也就到此为止了。当内心深处有什么东西说不对劲时，最终你还是得听从心底的声音

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: heh... in the moment, I had a similar feeling
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呵……当时，我也有类似的感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know, I think I needed to hear that more than I realized. thx <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道吗，我觉得我很需要听到这些话。谢啦 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I threw the cranes onto the road. didn't take long for a tank to drive over them.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回想起来，毁掉那些纸鹤只会让我更难受。我应该把那个愿望留给自己的，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: there wouldn't have been much point. they were soaked and torn - ruined
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没什么意义了，它们全湿透烂掉——都毁了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh well. what's done is done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 算了，过去的就别想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: my exact words to Arthur were, "ur right. now that you mention it, we don't have time for this relationship either."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我对亚瑟说的原话是，"你说得对。既然你这么说，那我们也没时间谈恋爱了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I just realized I couldn't ask him to be someone he wasn't. he was never gonna find joy in simple things with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我只是意识到，我不能要求他成为不是他的人。他永远不会和我一起在简单的事情中找到快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we couldn't even, say... listen to On-lyne together. even if I convinced him to, he wouldn't enjoy it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们甚至不能……比如说一起听线上时代。即使我说服了他去听，他也不会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's not like I expect my partner to like everything I like, but I need the chance to share happiness

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我知道亚瑟关心我。我们会永远尊重彼此，但说到爱，这还不够
