/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没有什么比让你开心更让我高兴的了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: "good" isn't exaaactly how I'd describe it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我可不会用"好事"来形容

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u've told me so many awful stories about the Orokin... was there ever anyone who turned their back on their way of life?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你给我讲了这么多关于奥罗金的可怕故事……有没有人曾经背弃过他们的生活方式？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ew.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 咦惹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ugh, that guy. always slipping through death's grip.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呃，那家伙。总是能死里逃生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and here I was hoping it’d be someone... cooler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我还希望是个……更酷的人呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, there's u, I guess ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，我猜，至少有你吧 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: only to chase after whatever served him best, I’m sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我敢肯定，他只会追求对他最有利的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hmm. pulling out the big questions now, huh? I guess u’ve earned it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯。现在提这种大问题了吗？我看你确实有资格问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I have no respect left to lose for the guy ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我对这个人已经没有任何尊重可言了 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ooooh. confusing
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦哦。真让人困惑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i really didn't like entrati, though. people like him only pretend to be charming when it serves them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不过我真的不喜欢英择谛。像他这样的人，只有在对自己有利的时候才会装出迷人的样子

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: people like him only pretend to be charming when it serves them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 像他这样的人，只有在对自己有利的时候才会装出迷人的样子

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: control. complete domination.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 控制。完全的支配。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i wouldn’t go that far. more like I was open to respecting him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不会这么说。更像是我本来是愿意尊重他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: not in the fun, pop star world-tour way either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 而且不是以有趣的、流行歌星世界巡演那种方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but he threw that away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但他自己放弃了这个机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he devours whatever he touches. not even the whole universe would be enough for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他吞噬一切他所触及的东西。即使是整个宇宙对他来说也不够。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: thank you. ^_^
but he'd try and that's the problem
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但他会尝试，这就是问题所在

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: not right away, but pretty early, I got this sinking feeling like something bad was about to happen every time he was nice
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不是马上就有，但很早以前，每次他表现得很友好时，我总有一种不祥的预感，好像有什么坏事即将发生

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and back then, I didn’t have the words for it, but it always felt like HE would be the one behind whatever went wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那时候，我不知道该怎么形容，但我总感觉所有的问题背后，幕后黑手都是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but when he has everyone around u fooled, what can u really do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但当他把你周围的每个人都骗过去时，你又能做什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, maybe not
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，也许没有

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: more like everyone was too scared to challenge him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 更像是大家都太害怕，不敢去对抗他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it’s kinda my curse, instinctively playing nice
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这种本能的友好就像我的诅咒一样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: which annoys me to no end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这让我非常烦躁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe if I’d said something, more people would’ve seen through him sooner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也许如果我当初说了些什么，更多的人会更早看穿他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that’s... bittersweet, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这……我猜是喜忧参半吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ugh. not even the future is safe from that guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呃。连未来也没法逃过那家伙的毒手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's just him. that's what he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这就是他。这就是他的做事方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he's the only being of emptiness I've ever known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他是我所接触过的唯一一个空虚的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: when he finds something he wants, he consumes it completely, then tosses it away when it's spent. always in the most heartless, self-serving way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当他找到想要的东西时，他会彻底地吞噬它，然后在用完后就抛弃它。总是以最无情、最自私的方式行事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: LOL I've never met anyone less cool!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，我从未见过有谁比他更不酷的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I can't deny that thinking about it gets me pretty worked up...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不得不承认，一想到这些我就会情绪很激动……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: give my regards to everyone he hurt in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 请代我向未来所有受到他伤害的人问好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: no, it's ok...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不，没关系……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: lol u know me so well it's scary
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，你这么懂我真有点吓人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: look, when I think of the doktor, I remember the first time I saw fear in Arthur's eyes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 看，当我想到那个博士时，我都会想起我第一次在亚瑟眼中看到的恐惧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think of Amir in total panic, Eleanor unable to speak, Quincy hardening his heart, and Lettie too overwhelmed to save the people around her
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我会想起阿米尔的恐慌发作，埃莉诺说不出话，昆西变得铁石心肠，而莱蒂不知所措，无法拯救她周围的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and I know the doktor would smile hearing that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我知道博士听到这个一定会笑……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but there are good things too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但也有好事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know what? I think I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道吗？我想我会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I have a collection of metal cranes that might one day grant me a wish
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我有一套金属鹤，也许有一天它们能实现我的一个愿望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and every day, I see small acts of defiance from an old, forgotten mall in Höllvania that remind me the human spirit is unbreakable
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 每天，我都能在霍瓦尼亚一个被遗忘的旧商场里看到些许抗争的行为，它们提醒着我，人类精神是牢不可破的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and of course, I met u
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然，我还遇到了你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: as long as there are people who care for each other, people like Entrati will never consume everything
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 只要还有人互相关心，像英择谛这样的人就不可能吞噬一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: deal <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 一言为定 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> I've never doubted u
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> 我从来没有怀疑过你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so, i think i have it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以，我想我有办法了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ahem ahem! are u ready for your piano lesson?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 啊咳咳！你准备好上钢琴课了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: may i introduce u to a friend? 'Mr Piano' is his name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我可以给你介绍一个朋友吗？他的名字叫"钢琴先生"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a way to play piano, play any music really, without thinking about 'Void Tongue'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我找到了一种弹钢琴的方式，可以真正地弹奏任何音乐，而不用考虑"虚空语"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_JOY>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_JOY>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I have a way to play piano, play any music really, without thinking about 'Void Tongue'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我有一种弹钢琴的方式，可以真正地弹奏任何音乐，而不用考虑"虚空语"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: or mayyyybe i'm getting ahead of myself. well, what is Void Tongue?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 或者可能我想得太多了。那么，什么是虚空语？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: let us begin first with: why music? why piano?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那我们先从这个问题开始：为什么是音乐？为什么是钢琴？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's easier to start a piano lesson this way because umm, i can't find a piano. so let's stick to theory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这样开始钢琴课比较容易，因为呃，我找不到钢琴。所以我们先从理论开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yay! so, to really catch you up, music has been really important here for like, ever. guys and girls would sit at a piano instead of a tv and just create.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 太好了！所以，为了让你赶上进度，这里的音乐自古以来就很重要。男孩和女孩会坐在钢琴前创作，而不是坐在电视机前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: playing... writing... really a song is a bit like communicating through music. you don't even need lyrics!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 演奏……创作……其实一首歌就像是通过音乐进行交流。你甚至不需要歌词！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but imagine it - creating something for this world of ours that can make people cry? dance? sing? it's magic to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但想象一下——为我们的世界创造一些东西，一些可以让人们哭泣？跳舞？唱歌的东西？对我来说，这就是魔法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, kinda hard? i wasn't sure about going into empty apartments out there...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，算是挺努力的吧？我不太敢进那些空荡荡的公寓……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hmm, they're big and hard to hide... I doubt that Viktor and Scaldra play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，它们又大又难藏……我不认为维克多和炽蛇军会弹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ugh. Scaldra. they probably destroyed them. why would they let something hopeful like an instrument survive this place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呃。炽蛇军。他们可能毁了它们。他们怎么可能会让像乐器这样带有希望的东西留下来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but wait, let me ask u then, if there is music in the future, maybe there's hope. so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但等等，那我问你，如果未来有音乐，也许就有希望。那么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Please. tell me about a song then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那么请告诉我一首歌吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe u'll believe me one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也许有一天你会相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: wut <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 神马 <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like a bad song, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就像一首烂歌吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: is it like, a sing-songy language or?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那是不是像唱歌一样的语言？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well now i really need to get you some music. think about it. drown out this 'Void Tongue' with a song of your own, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，现在我真的需要给你弄些音乐了。想想看。用你自己的歌曲淹没这"虚空语"，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: don't call me stupid but have u tried playing music for them? your friends? maybe it would help even for 1 second?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 别说我笨，但你试过给它们放音乐了吗？你的朋友们？也许这会有所帮助，哪怕只有一秒钟？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's ok, it's ok. i get it. music can feel hopeless too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没事的，没事的。我懂的。音乐有时也会让人感到绝望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: don't you think music could break through and be hope? for just, well, everyone? everything? if Void Tongue is 'magic', than so is music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你不觉得音乐可以打破一切，成为希望吗？对于所有人？对于所有事？如果虚空语是"魔法"，那么音乐也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, just ur opinion. thanks for hearing me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，这只是你的看法。谢谢你听我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: always!!!!
Sol I'm so sorry, please, tell me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 天哪，我真的很抱歉，请继续告诉我吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: what ur saying...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你说的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it feels like, well, how i feel. that feels like a law of the universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 让我感觉，嗯，很有共鸣。就好像是宇宙的规律一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Music is powerful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 音乐真的很有力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: this is embarassing but, i have a similar story. not nearly as heavy but still.. maybe you'll understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这说起来有点尴尬，我也有一个类似的故事。虽然没有那么沉重，但也差不多……也许你会理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: when i was a kid, like 'kid Aoi', i wanted to be friends with everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当我还是个孩子的时候，就像"小女孩碧"一样，想和每个人都成为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i'll ignore that!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我就忽略这句了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but there was this one kid, who the bullies would ALWAYS pick on. Always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但有一个孩子，总是被欺负。总是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and they would sing mean songs about the kid. awful, mean songs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他们还会唱一些恶毒的歌曲来嘲笑那个孩子。非常可怕和恶毒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and when i saw music being used to cause pain, it broke something in me as a kid. i didn't understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当我看到音乐被用来造成痛苦时，小时候的我感到内心有些东西碎了。我当时不明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i still don't understand. but i knew then that i could fight back without raising a fist, even if it meant embarrassing myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 现在还是不明白。但我知道，我可以不用挥拳反击，即使这意味着让自己尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i sang louder than the bullies. it was a stupid song, i don't even remember how it went.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我唱得比那些霸凌者还大声。那是一首很蠢的歌，我甚至都不记得它是怎么唱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but it worked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但它有用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and when they tried to bully me, they would throw CD's at me, but guess what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当他们试图欺负我时，他们会向我扔 CD，但你猜怎么着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ha! nope. i got free music! score for Aoi!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈！不是。我得到了免费的音乐！碧赢了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i guess wut i'm hoping you know and everyone here, is that i'd sing louder for all of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我希望你知道，也希望这里的每个人都知道，我会为你们所有人唱得更大声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 一直都会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yeah..?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 记得……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yeah!! y?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对啊！！怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like what kind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是哪种游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ... i was actually really hoping u'd ask again
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ……其实我一直很希望你能再问我一次

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i'd love to play
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我很想玩

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_STARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ooooo that sounds fun!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 噢！听起来很好玩！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: like what kind of play pretend? ... r people gonna make fun of me for playing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 扮演什么样的角色呢？……玩这个游戏的话，别人会不会嘲笑我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ... i think i'm good...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ……我想我还是不玩了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: count me in!! oh oh oh do you think he'll let me play a character that has pets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 算我一个！！哦哦哦你觉得他会让我扮演一个有宠物的角色吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_AOICAT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i think it'll mean the world to amir to have everybody around the table playing... he's like me. big heart <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我觉得对于阿米尔来说，大家围坐在一起玩游戏一定是一件非常特别的事……他和我很像。都是心地善良 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I've never thanked u for being so cool with Eleanor
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我还没跟你说声谢谢你，你对埃莉诺那么好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so thank u <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以谢谢你 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: in the early days, Lettie and Quincy had their doubts. they worried she might go full-tech-rot. Arthur wouldn’t hear it, so they kept their concerns quiet, but we all felt it on some level. and if *we* sensed it, imagine how sharp and clear it was to Eleanor
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 早些时候，莱蒂和昆西也对她有过怀疑，他们担心她会彻底变成科腐者。亚瑟不愿意听，所以他们保持了沉默，但其实或多或少我们都感受到了。但如果*我们*都能感觉得到，你可以想象对于埃莉诺来说，这种感觉多么敏感和清晰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u wouldn’t have been the first in the Hex to be wary of Eleanor. and, trust me, I love everyone in the Hex, so I would've understood—but I also would’ve worked hard to change ur mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你不是六人组中第一个对埃莉诺产生戒心的人。相信我，我爱六人组中的每一个人，所以我能理解——但我也会努力让你改变想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he is, ya. but I think that made things even harder for Eleanor back then. he was desperate to protect her, and she knew that if he ever believed she was suffering too much because of the infestation, he might take matters into his own hands
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他是的，对。但我觉得，这让埃莉诺当时的处境更难。他不顾一切地想要保护她，而她也知道，如果他认为她因感染而饱受痛苦，他可能会亲自出手解决此事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: they were just scared. fear makes people act in strange ways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他们只是害怕。恐惧会使人做出奇怪的行为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I never thought he would kill her, but Eleanor did. why she thought that is between her and Arthur. I'm just glad she doesn't feel that way anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我从没认为他会杀了她，但埃莉诺却这么想。她为什么会这么想，那是她和亚瑟之间的事。我只是很高兴她不再那样想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I’ve heard it said that what really traumatizes people isn’t what happens to them, but how they react to it. knowing who Lettie and Quincy are at heart, I’m sure if their fear had led to anything happening to Eleanor, they’d never have forgiven themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我曾听人说过，真正让人们受到创伤的不是遭遇了什么，而是如何面对这些遭遇。在了解过莱蒂和昆西的内心世界后，我敢肯定，如果他们因为恐惧导致埃莉诺出事，他们绝对不会原谅自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: after her transformation, Eleanor paid close attention to how everyone reacted. I could see her weighing her options, thinking she might do more harm than good by staying. she wanted to help the Hex, but the way some people looked at her made her wonder if she could help more from a distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 埃莉诺变化后，她很注意每个人的反应。我看得出她在权衡各种选择，觉得留下来可能弊大于利。她想要帮助六人组，但有些人看她的眼神让她怀疑自己是否应该在远处提供帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: she thought she could use her powers from afar, stay connected without burdening us with her presence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 她认为她可以远程使用她的能力，保持联系而不让我们因她的存在而感到负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: one night, when even Amir had gone to sleep, she actually did almost leave. quietly, in the dead of night. she didn’t even want to burden us with goodbyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 有一天晚上，连阿米尔都已经睡下了，她真的差点就离开了。悄无声息地，在深夜。她甚至不想让我们为道别感到负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I hate to imagine what could have happened... I’d been keeping an eye on her tho, trying to be there for her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不愿意去想如果她真的走了会发生什么……但我一直在关注着她，试图陪伴在她身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know that feeling when ur with someone but they're not really there? when their mind keeps drifting, no matter how much they try to stay present? I noticed that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道那种感觉吗？虽然你和某人在一起，但他们似乎心不在焉？他们的思绪总是飘忽不定，无论他们多么努力地想要专注？而我注意到了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: the second I sensed her atomicycle booting up, I locked down every atomicycle in the garage and ran out to stop her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我一感觉到她的原子摩托车启动，就锁定了车库里所有的原子摩托车，然后跑出去阻止她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I wasn't sure how much of her distance was just her learning to manage her psychic powers or her consciously checking how people saw her. so, I started keeping tabs on her too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不确定她保持距离是在学习如何控制她的精神异能，还是在刻意观察别人如何看待她。因此，我也开始关注她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh, we talked until the sun came up. since Amir was asleep, we even played some pinball—just the two of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，我们一直聊到天亮。由于阿米尔睡着了，我们甚至还玩了会儿弹球——就我们两个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it was silly and fun, the kind of fun Eleanor desperately needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这又傻又有趣，却正是埃莉诺非常需要的那种快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I don’t think it was any one thing I said. it was just... being there. being a friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不认为是我说的什么话起了作用，而是……我在那里。作为一个朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it was the first time since her transformation that someone showed her she was more than Arthur’s fragile sister to be protected. I think that night helped her see she could carve out her own place in the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这是她变身后第一次有人让她知道，她不仅仅是亚瑟那个需要保护的脆弱姐姐。我认为那晚帮她意识到她能在六人组中找到自己的位置。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I need it too, honestly. we’re all stronger when we know we belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 说实话，我也需要。当我们知道自己属于哪里时，我们都会变得更坚强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I guess I just realized, having u join us, we could have relived that whole awful chapter again
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想我刚刚意识到，让你加入我们，我们可能会重演那段糟糕的过去

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but we didn't have to. u understood right away
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但实际上并没有。你马上就理解了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so thank u
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以，谢谢你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur one of my favorite people <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> just so u know
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 告诉你一声，你是我最喜欢的人之一 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I would've let her go if that's what she really wanted. but she wasn't leaving without a heart-to-heart with me first, haha.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 如果她真的想走，我会让她走的。但在没有和我来一场谈心之前，她是走不了的，哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: huh. I suppose that's true!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯。我觉得确实是这样！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yes! very well!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的！非常好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: not like "rock out to On-lyne and do magazine quizzes together" well
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 虽然不是那种"一起跟着线上时代的摇滚乐跳舞，一起玩杂志上的小测验"的那么好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but we confide in each other
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但我们互相倾诉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: she was really there for me when Arthur and I broke up
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当我和亚瑟分手时，她真的陪在我身边

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: there was this time Arthur and I had a reeeally bad argument
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 有一次我和亚瑟大吵了一架

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Lettie was really there for me. Words of wisdom, pounds of chocolate. the whole deal! we all know she can heal wounds, but when she puts her mind to it, she can heal hurt feelings too <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 莱蒂真的是无时无刻都在支持我。她不仅说话睿智，还有一大堆巧克力，应有尽有！我们都知道她能治愈伤口，但当她用心的时候，她也能治愈受伤的心灵呢 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh that? gosh it was so long ago umm... it was just this little... break up
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，那个呀？天啊，那是很久以前的事了，嗯……只是一次……小小的分手而已

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: his sister? are u kidding?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他姐姐？你开什么玩笑？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: lol weeell he did, but he wasn't the best at comforting me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，嗯——他有，但他不是最会安慰我的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Yeah. She's very wise <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是。她很有智慧<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: supriiiise ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 惊不惊喜 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it was... for a bit. we're all good now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的……有一阵子挺难熬的。不过现在我们都翻篇了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: "Amir, I love u, but I need something more than a two-player game of Caliber Chicks to feel better"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: "阿米尔，我爱你，但我需要的不只是两个人一起玩火力女兵，来让我好受一些"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: weeell, I was kind of embarrassed at first
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，一开始我其实有点尴尬

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know what they say! don't dip ur pen in the company ink
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道大家都怎么说的！兔子不吃窝边草

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur not an idiot! it's just that... I didn't want to talk about it until we were close
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你才不是傻子！我之前没说只是因为……在我们关系更亲近之前，我不想谈这件事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: in the future, do u still celebrate venusia? it's the holiday around love and acceptance
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 在未来，你们还会庆祝金星节吗？这是一个关于爱和包容的节日

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yes <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> so it's time I fill u in
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是呢 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> 所以是时候告诉你了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: in the future, do u still celebrate venusia? it's the holiday around love and acceptance
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 在未来，你们还会庆祝金星节吗？这是一个关于爱和包容的节日

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so I spent weeks folding 1000 paper cranes for him. they're supposed to be good luck, u know? and 1000 are supposed to grant a wish
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以我花了几个星期为他折了 1000 只纸鹤。你知道吗，纸鹤象征着好运，而攒满 1000 个就可以实现一个愿望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we were out on a peacekeeping mission with the ICR but I still wanted to celebrate venusia in some way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们当时和国危部一起执行维和任务，但我还是想以某种方式来庆祝金星节

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and I u <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也不想看到你难过 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it was a fight during venusia that ultimately ended things between me and Arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我和亚瑟之间的关系就是在金星节的一次争吵中结束的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that was the first time he saw me really upset. I think it took him by surprise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那是他第一次看到我那么心烦意乱。我觉得他应该挺惊讶的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that was the first time he saw me really upset. I think it took him by surprise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那是他第一次看到我那么心烦意乱。我觉得他应该挺惊讶的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it makes me happy to know that people still celebrate something like it in the future ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 知道人们未来还会庆祝这样的活动我真开心 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think I'd get along well with that person ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想我会和那个人相处得很好 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I think I'd get along well with that person ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想我会和那个人相处得很好 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it makes me happy to know that people still celebrate something like it in the future ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 知道人们未来还会庆祝这样的活动让我真开心 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: if u managed to pull an explanation out of Arthur - and that's a big IF - he'd probably say our fight on venusia ended the relationship
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 如果你能从亚瑟嘴里套出个解释的话——当然这里说的是"如果"——他可能会说我们在金星节上的争吵结束了这段关系

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: heh. maybe...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，也许吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's sweet of u <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你真贴心 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we were out on a peacekeeping mission with the ICR but I still wanted to celebrate venusia in some way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们当时和国危部一起执行维和任务，但我还是想以某种方式来庆祝金星节

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: so I spent weeks folding 1000 paper cranes for him. they're supposed to be good luck, u know? and 1000 are supposed to grant a wish
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所以我花了几个星期为他折了 1000 只纸鹤。你知道吗，纸鹤象征着好运，而攒满 1000 个就可以实现一个愿望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I dunno. it's not really about who "deserved" what. it just came down to us being too different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不知道。这其实不是谁"活该"的问题。归根结底是因为我们太不一样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur someone I trust, someone I want to know on a deep level. it's only right that I share that same depth with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你是我信任的人，我想深入了解的人。我应该与你分享这种深度的情感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: my exact words to Arthur were, "ur right. now that you mention it, we don't have time for this relationship either."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我对亚瑟说的原话是，"你说得对。既然你这么说，那我们也没时间谈恋爱了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh well. what's done is done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 算了，过去的就别想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: there wouldn't have been much point. they were soaked and torn - ruined
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没什么意义了，它们全湿透烂掉——都毁了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: looking back, destroying those cranes just hurt me more. could have saved that wish for myself ha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回想起来，毁掉那些纸鹤只会让我更难受。我应该把那个愿望留给自己的，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I threw the cranes onto the road. didn't take long for a tank to drive over them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我把那些纸鹤扔到了路上。很快就有一辆坦克压了过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe if I'd taken time to understand myself sooner, I would've reacted in a way I'd be proud of...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也许如果我早去花点时间了解自己，我就能以一种令自己自豪的方式做出回应……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: every spare second I had between meals or before bed, I'd sneak off, all excited about how happy a venusia surprise was gonna make him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 每到吃饭或睡觉前的空闲时间，我就会偷偷溜出去，满心欢喜地想着给他一个金星节惊喜会让他有多开心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know, I think I needed to hear that more than I realized. thx <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道吗，我好像比自己以为的更需要听到这些话。谢啦 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: heh... in the moment, I had a similar feeling
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呵……当时，我也有类似的感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I could too, but understanding only gets u so far. when something deep within says something's off, eventually u just have to listen
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也能理解，但是光靠理解也就到此为止了。当内心深处有什么东西说不对劲时，最终你还是得听从心底的声音

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it was like something snapped. all this time I'd spent understanding him... had he really done the same for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就好像有什么东西突然就断了。我花了那么多时间去理解他……他有这么为我付出过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he just said, "thanks, but we really dont have time for this kind of thing."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他只是说，"谢谢，但我们真的没时间做这种事"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it was like something snapped. all this time I'd spent understanding him... had he really done the same for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就好像有什么东西突然就断了。我花了那么多时间去理解他……他有这么为我付出过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know, I think I needed to hear that more than I realized. thx <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道吗，我好像比自己以为的更需要听到这些话。谢啦 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: heh... in the moment, I had a similar feeling
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呵……当时，我也有类似的感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I could too, but understanding only gets u so far. when something deep within says something's off, eventually u just have to listen
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我也能理解，但是光靠理解也就到此为止了。当内心深处有什么东西说不对劲时，最终你还是得听从心底的声音

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he just said, "thanks, but we really dont have time for this kind of thing."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他只是说，"谢谢，但我们真的没时间做这种事"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: looking back, it's kind of embarrassing. I had built up his reaction in my head and then when I gave him the cranes...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回想起来，还有点尴尬。我已经在脑海里构想了他的反应，然后当我把纸鹤给他的时候……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: every spare second I had between meals or before bed, I'd sneak off, all excited about how happy a venusia surprise was gonna make him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 每到吃饭或睡觉前的空闲时间，我就会偷偷溜出去，满心欢喜地想着给他一个金星节惊喜会让他有多开心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: thx for listening
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 谢谢你听我说这些

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I really didn't expect to feel this good after sharing that story. there's just something about u
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我真没想到在分享了这个故事后会有这么好的感觉。你就是有一种特别的魅力

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur making me blush
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你说的我脸都红了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur very easy to open up to :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你让人很容易愿意对你敞开心扉：)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I know Arthur cares about me. we'll always respect each other, but when it comes to love, that's not enough
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我知道亚瑟关心我。我们会永远尊重彼此，但说到爱，这还不够

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: breaking down a broody facade only to constantly brush off eye rolls and good-natured jokes is... exhausting
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好不容易打破那副愁眉苦脸的面具，却还得不停地面对他的白眼和善意的玩笑，真的……太累了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: thx for listening
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 谢谢你听我说这些

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's not like I expect my partner to like everything I like, but I need the chance to share happiness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我并不是说希望我的伴侣要喜欢所有我喜欢的东西，但我需要有分享快乐的机会

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we couldn't even, say... listen to On-lyne together. even if I convinced him to, he wouldn't enjoy it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们甚至不能……比如说一起听线上时代。即使我说服了他去听，他也不会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, of course, we'll always have each other's backs
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然，我们会一直互相支持的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sure but it's water under the bridge
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然，但那都是过去的事了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I threw the cranes onto the road. didn't take long for a tank to drive over them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我把那些纸鹤扔到了路上。很快就有一辆坦克压了过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: looking back, destroying those cranes just hurt me more. could have saved that wish for myself ha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回想起来，毁掉那些纸鹤只会让我更难受。我应该把那个愿望留给自己的，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 可能吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but that's the truth of how it went down. now u know
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但事实就是这样。现在你知道了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya that about sums it up
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，差不多就是这样了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe if I'd taken time to understand myself sooner, I would've reacted in a way I'd be proud of...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也许如果我早去花点时间了解自己，我就能以一种令自己自豪的方式做出回应……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I just realized I couldn't ask him to be someone he wasn't. he was never gonna find joy in simple things with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我只是意识到，我不能要求他成为不是他的人。他永远不会和我一起在简单的事情中找到快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: right... so that saying doesn't survive into the future then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对……那这句话在未来不再适用了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh uh yes. sorry, do you even have companies in the future? or... ink?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦啊，是的。抱歉，你将来还会有窝吗？或者……草？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: everyone with a sense of self-preservation!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 所有有自我保护意识的人说的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it basically means u should never date someone u work with
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 它基本上是说，你永远不要和你的同事约会

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya well, I totally started spiraling wondering what everyone thought after Arthur and I broke up... in my very public ground-covered-in-paper-cranes kinda way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的，我陷入一种纠结的状态，想知道在我，以我非常公开的满地都是纸鹤的方式，和亚瑟分手后，大家会怎么看……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: "only a girl as dumb as Aoi would think a relationship with our commander could end well"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: "只有像碧这么傻的傻丫头才会觉得跟我们的指挥官谈恋爱能有好结果"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: "hey at least we can all stop worrying about her getting special treatment now"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: "嘿，至少现在我们可以不用担心她会有特殊待遇了"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I've lived long enough to figure out how mean and gossipy people can be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我已经活得够久了，知道人们有多刻薄，多八卦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya. I'm so glad Lettie talked me down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是啊。我很高兴莱蒂劝住了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I mean... knowing that is one thing. internalizing it is another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我是说……知道是一回事。内化又是另一回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ok maybe but... I want to help people. make them happy. not threaten them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，也许吧，但是……我是想帮助别人。让他们开心。而不是吓唬他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's a really kind thing to say <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> but don't worry. I've come a long way since then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这么说真的很贴心 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> 不过别担心。自那之后，我已经走了很长的路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u know, I'm glad Lettie was there for me, but u clearly would have been great too <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你知道吗，我很庆幸当时莱蒂陪在我身边，但如果那时你在，很明显你也会很棒的 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I have a hard time believing that, but I know ur probably right
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我很难相信这一点，但我知道你很可能是对的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I guess. thx for saying that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想是吧。谢谢你这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: she came looking for me when she heard the news. armed with chocolate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 她听到这个消息时就带着巧克力来找我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: when I tell u I bore my soul to her the second she offered me that chocolate ...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我告诉你，当她给我那块巧克力的那一刻，我就把心窝子都掏给她了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: there I was putting on a brave face and Lettie disarmed me in a second
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当时，我还在故作坚强，但莱蒂一秒就让我卸下了武装。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it sounds totally nuts when u put it like that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你这么说听起来很疯狂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: no, Lettie's kindness made me cry
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不，是莱蒂的善良让我落泪了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: and while I had a mouthful of the most delicious chocolate I've had in my life, she told me, "no matter what happened, no matter how it ended, if u did it for love, it was right. never doubt that."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 然后就在我嘴里含着我这辈子吃过的最好吃的巧克力时，她对我说："无论发生了什么，不管结局如何，如果你是为了爱而行动的，那就是对的。永远不要怀疑这一点。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: in that confident tone of hers... it was exactly what I needed to hear. I really held onto that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 再加上她那种自信的语气……这正是我当时需要听到的话。我真的一直把它记在心里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: heh. totally weird for like a month. but I was ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗨，最开始大概有一个月都感觉特别奇怪。但我其实还好啦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: she's the real deal
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 她真的超级好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Lettie and Amir stuck with me. I never had to endure an awkward silence alone with Arthur or anything like that thanks to them haha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 莱蒂和阿米尔一直陪着我。多亏了他们，我从来都不用一个人面对和亚瑟之间的尴尬沉默，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Hey, if you ever go through a breakup, she's the one to talk to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嘿，要是你哪天失恋了，找她聊聊准没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: no way, I didn't see it that way at all!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 怎么可能！我根本不是那么想的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_PASSGLASSES>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_PASSGLASSES>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that would be fine too ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 也可以呀 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: or me if u want, but that goes without saying
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 或者找我也行，不过这还用说吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: come again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 诶，你刚才说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SWEAT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SWEAT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yes! let's put it that way ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 没错！就是这样 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_COOLARMSUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_COOLARMSUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: if u say so
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好的吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ok um well... in that hypothetical scenario, no. maybe don't talk to her about that particular breakup. ya.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧，呃……假如是这种情况的话，还是别了。要是你们分手了，可能还是别去找她聊了。对，就这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: hey, there was always a place waiting for u. even when we didn't see it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嘿，哪怕是我们自己都没有意识到，我们这里一直都有你的位置。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: we're in our best chapter yet if u ask me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 要我说，我们现在正是最好的时候

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yes well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的，嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yes well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的，嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: looking back, it's kind of embarrassing. I had built up his reaction in my head and then when I gave him the cranes...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回想起来，还有点尴尬。我已经在脑海里构想了他的反应，然后当我把纸鹤给他的时候……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: haha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u sound just like Amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你说话就像阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: really? but u two are so alike ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 真的吗？不过你们俩还真像 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: of course it is!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然是啦！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's just that when Amir first joined the Hex, he’d joke about me being this superhero
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 只是当阿米尔刚加入六人组的时候，他开玩笑说我是超级英雄

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ... and him being my sidekick
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: ……他是我的助手

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it was sweet but also a little sad
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 很温馨，但也有一点伤感

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it took time. Amir joined us without any military experience, so the fighting was overwhelming for him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这需要时间。阿米尔加入我们时没有任何军事经验，所以战斗对他来说太难了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh, we are! Amir’s my best friend. some of my favorite memories are us in the arcade, gaming and rocking out to On-lyne
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，我们关系当然好啦！阿米尔是我最好的朋友。我最喜欢的一些回忆就是我们在街机厅里玩游戏，一起听线上时代的歌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he just needed to see that being a hero wasn’t all about combat
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他只是需要明白，成为英雄并不全是为了战斗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but the whole sidekick thing? I could tell he felt... small.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但当助手这件事呢？我看得出来，他觉得自己……很渺小。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I always knew that a hacker as great as him could be a hero in his own way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我一直都知道，像他这样厉害的黑客也能以自己的方式成为英雄

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I can’t take all the credit, but I was there when he had his breakthrough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不能把功劳都揽在自己身上，但他取得突破的时候我在他身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: one day, I caught this wild broadcast from an On-lyne fan who'd pieced together some shady details about HitMaker (that's On-lyne's label)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 有一天，我从一个线上时代粉丝那里听到了一段疯狂广播，她拼凑了一些关于金曲大厂（线上时代的唱片公司）的阴暗细节

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: she was basically begging for someone to help them, and Amir jumped in without hesitation
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 她几乎是在哀求有人能帮助他们，阿米尔毫不犹豫地站了出来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I showed him the broadcast. Amir took care of the rest!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我给他看了广播。阿米尔把剩下的都搞定了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: weeell it was a team effort. u could say I was his sidekick ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，这是团队合作的结果。你可以说我是他的助手 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a super-fan joining forces with a super-hacker? nothing could stop us!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 超级粉丝和超级黑客联手？当然势不可挡啦！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he hacked into their manager's emails and uncovered a mess of deals with the Scaldra. they'd been cloning the band and putting them in danger, all covered up by their management
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他黑进了他们经纪人的邮箱，发现了他们与炽蛇军一连串的交易。他们一直在克隆乐队，并将他们置于危险之中，而这一切都被他们的管理层掩盖了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: bleh!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 恶心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: without Amir’s skills, none of that would’ve come to light
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 如果没有阿米尔的技术，这一切都不会曝光

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u bet. the whole ordeal totally helped him realized he wasn’t just a sidekick. he was a hero in his own right ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然啦！整个过程让他意识到自己不仅仅是个助手，他本身就是个英雄 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: just two heroes taking a break!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就两位英雄在放松一下嘛！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ur a hero too, u know <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你也是个英雄，知道吗 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh u <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你呀 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: good! <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 很好！ <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: guilty ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我的罪过 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Quincy told me he'd kill me if I ever told anyone this story
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 昆西说过，如果我把这事告诉别人，他会杀了我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but he's all talk and u and I are so very close now so I'm just gonna get it off my chest
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但他其实只是说说而已，咱们现在这么铁了，我还是不把这事憋在心里了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: sorry ur involved now <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不好意思，现在你也卷进来了 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u sure? last chance!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你确定吗？这是最后的机会了哦！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: k! can't say I blame u
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好吧！我不怪你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ok, so we were on this mission to sabotage Scaldra weapon production. I was doing the metalwork, Quincy had my back, watching for any patrols.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 好，我们那时正在执行一个破坏炽蛇军武器生产的任务。我负责金属加工，昆西负责掩护，留意巡逻队。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it went supers smoothly! exactly as planned, but on our way back, we got stopped by a bunch of kids. they recognized Quincy instantly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 一切都超级顺利！完全按计划进行，但在我们返回的路上，被一群孩子拦下了。他们一眼就认出了昆西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: nope, I mean it! kids! cute, smiley, not-at-all-scared-of-Quincy's-angry-mug kids!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 不，我说的就是孩子！孩子们！可爱、笑嘻嘻的、一点也不害怕昆西那张臭脸的孩子们！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: not quite!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 其实并没有！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u heard me!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的，你没听错！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: guess!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 猜猜看！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: see, that's totally what I thought was going to happen, but no!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 看，我原以为他会那么做，但没有！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: why yes he was! you know our Quincy better than I thought <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是啊，他真的对他们很好！看来你比我想的还了解我们的昆西 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he SMILED at them. it was like he forgot I was there for sec. dropped the whole tough guy act
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他对他们微笑了。感觉他一时间忘了我在场。抛开了他的硬汉形象

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he knew them by name! "Hey Miko, I found one of those tammpets you told me about. Swiped it for ya."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他还知道他们的名字呢！"嘿，米科，我找到了你之前说的那种塔姆宠物，给你带了一个。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I swear on Zeke's life!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我以兹克的命发誓！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Quincy actually pulled one of those little digital pet things out of his pocket and gave it to the kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 昆西真的从口袋里掏出了一个那种小型电子宠物，然后给了那个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: Sol only knows how long he'd had it, or how long he'd spent searching through Höllvania to find it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 天知道他拿了多久，或者他在霍瓦尼亚花了多长时间去找它

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: once that funny little horned creature appeared on the screen, I don't know who was smiling bigger. the kid or Quincy seeing the kid so happy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那个有角的小怪兽一出现在屏幕上，我都不知道谁笑得更开心，是那个孩子，还是看到孩子那么开心的昆西

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u think? either ur hella good at reading people or u and Quincy have a special bond <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你这么觉得？要么你超级擅长看人，要么你和昆西关系不一般 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I know, right? I was stunned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是吧？我当时也惊呆了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: of course then he looked me dead in the eye and said, "if u tell anybody about this, I'll kill u"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 当然了，他死死地盯着我的眼睛说，"如果你敢把这事告诉别人，我就杀了你"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 就是 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: psssh he doesn't scare me! how could he now that I know what a big softy he is? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 切，他才吓不到我呢！我现在知道他其实是个大暖男了，怎么可能怕他？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: aaw it's ok u don't need to keep it secret <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> I'm prepared to face the consequences
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 啊，没事啦，你不需要保密 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART> 我已经准备好承担后果了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: at least the story will live on through u ^_^
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 至少这个故事会通过你传下去 ^_^

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: he pretends he’s all about the mission, but deep down, he’s got a heart of gold. he still goes out sometimes just to bring a bit of happiness to those kids
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他表面上全心全意投入任务，但内心其实有一颗金子般的心。他有时还会出去，只是为了给那些孩子带去一点快乐

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: LOL maybe! we've gotta find his supplier for sure
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，也许吧！我们确实需要找到他的供应商

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I knew u'd appreciate it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我就知道你会喜欢的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: aah he knew I'd tell. If he really cared, he would have just asked me not to. not made some empty threat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 啊，他早就知道我会告诉你。如果他真的介意，他会直接叫我不要说。而不是只说些没用的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: this tale does arm u with powerful knowledge. promise to only use this power for good?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这个故事确实让你得到了强大的知识。你得保证只用这种力量做好事，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: u do that, and I crush u with every piece of metal on ur body
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你敢试试，我就用你身上的每一块金属把你压扁

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: gosh we make a good team
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 天哪，我们真是个好团队

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: LOL! just play nice with our Quincy, k?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈！好好对待我们的昆西，行吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh wow thank u for saying that. umm... hmm. there’s no big defining moment that determined my life path or anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦，哇，谢谢你这么说。呃……嗯。没有什么重大的决定性时刻影响了我的人生道路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: as far as I can tell, I inherited it from my parents. they were practical people, but dreamers too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 据我所知，我从父母那里继承了这种精神。他们是务实的人，但也是梦想家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I mean, you don't build rockets to explore space if you're not a dreamer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我的意思是，如果你不是一个梦想家，你就不会去造火箭探索太空的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: well, dad did. and mom knew how to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，爸爸造。妈妈也懂得怎么造。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: ya... and when I became a soldier, they made it pretty clear it wasn't exactly the life they'd hoped to build for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是的……当我成为一名士兵时，他们很明确地表示这并不是他们希望为我提供的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: not much. they weren’t big on sharing their dreams out loud. I think they believed their contributions to the world would do the talking for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 说的不多。他们不喜欢公开分享他们的梦想。我觉得他们相信自己对世界的贡献足以说明一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: dad was an aerospace engineer. mom taught space systems design at the university where they met as students.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 爸爸是一名航天工程师，妈妈在他们相识的大学里教空间系统设计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yeah, I suppose so
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 是啊，我想是这样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: haha not really. mostly, it was just quiet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哈哈，其实不是。大多数时间，我们家都很安静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: a lot of our conversations were "hey, sweetie" and "hi" in passing. then they'd grab dinner on the way to their offices to work late or whatever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们大多数的对话是在碰到时说上几句的"嘿，宝贝"和"嗨"，他们会随便吃点东西，然后就回办公室继续熬夜工作

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: but most of our conversations were just "hey, sweetie" and "hi" as we passed each other in the kitchen. they'd grab something quick to eat and head back to their offices to work late
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我们的交流大多是在厨房碰到时说上几句的"嘿，宝贝"和"嗨"，他们会随便吃点东西，然后就回办公室继续熬夜工作

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: they were busy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 他们很忙

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: as long as I wasn’t getting into trouble, they didn’t worry about me much. and despite all the fire I had inside, I was really good at staying out of trouble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 只要我不惹麻烦，他们就不太担心我。虽然我内心有很多激情，但我真的很擅长避免惹麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: yeah, I guess I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 嗯，我想我确实有帮到他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's nice. I’m glad they did that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 那真好。我很高兴他们这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: maybe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 可能吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I realize now how important those moments are, but when I was growing up, it didn’t feel weird not to have many of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 现在我意识到那些时刻有多珍贵，但在我成长的时候并没多少这样的时刻，却一点都不觉得奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: actually ya, I think that's true :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 其实，我觉得确实是这样 :)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I hope I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我希望是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I get why my parents were so focused on their work. in their own way, it was how they showed love. they wanted to provide for me and build technology that could help humanity have a better future
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我能理解为什么我的父母那么专注于他们的工作。在他们看来，这是他们表达爱的方式。他们希望为我提供生活保障，同时为人类能拥有更好的未来创造科技

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: looking back, it’s kind of beautiful
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 回想起来，这其实挺美好的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: it's the "as much of it as we can" part that's tricky, isn't it? hard to measure
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: "尽可能多"这个部分确实很棘手，不是吗？很难具体衡量

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: still, I can't help but think about how we didn’t spend much time together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 但我还是忍不住想到我们在一起度过的时间并不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: right! not the kind u see in movies, but very real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 对！这不是电影里看到的那种，但非常真实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: if I ever see them again, I’ll make sure to make up for lost time. I know they will too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 如果我还能再次见到他们，我一定会弥补失去的时光。我相信他们也会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh? how so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 哦？怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that means a lot to me. I hope so too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这对我真的很重要。我也这么希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I guess so
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我想是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: that's... actually a really cool way to think about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这……实际上是一个非常酷的思考方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: I’ve never thought about it like that before. that's... a really lovely way to see it. thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我以前从来没有这样想过。这真是一个很美好的看法。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: do u trust me enough to let me take u out for a spin? if i could, that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你够信任我吗，信任到愿意让我带你出去兜风？如果我可以的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: this isn't funny even at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 这一点都不好笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: i'm not sure what you are playing at. are these mind games?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 我不知道你到底想玩什么花样。这是在玩心理战吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: picture it. me... controlling you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 想象一下，我……控制着你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: would you let me? in a fight, in an average day...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 你会让我这么做吗？无论是在战斗中，还是在平常的日子里……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: someone else can find that out. this? is game over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 留给别人体验吧。这个游戏？到此为止了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: umm dummy no one does? maybe ur picking a fight with me here cause u know i could whoop u out there!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 呃，笨蛋，谁会知道啊？你是不是在故意找我茬，因为你知道在外面我能揍嬴你！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: good. cause i might even be better than u at bein' u.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.zhText: 很好。因为我可能比你更会做你自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/AoiRomance/T.text: oh i seeeee ur little game here, hmm... well i'd start with hmmm... the tight suit can go. ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heeeey... Arthur... how's it going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿——……亚瑟……怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Great... Sooooo... what's new with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 太好了——那——……最近有什么新鲜事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Some weather we're having, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 咱们赶上的这是什么破天气，哈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How about that local sport's team, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个当地运动队呢，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ... Nothing's going on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……没发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Amir's bored again. Look at your username.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔又无聊了。看看你的昵称。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: :| Buddy. That icon says otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: :| 哥们儿。那个图标可不是这个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 明明就有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Eh, he's just teasing. You know he adores you. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 诶，他只是在开玩笑。你知道他很崇拜你的。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've got more where that came from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我还有很多这样的话呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: First time for everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 凡事总有第一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Still mad. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还在生气。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That whole "I have feelings for you" thing? It was a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个"我喜欢你"的事？逗你玩的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have a sick sense of humor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的幽默就是这么奇葩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I-- wait. Sorry. No. I meant it. Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我——等等。对不起。不是逗你玩的。我是认真的。继续说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Arthur, you mean more to me than you can imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，你对我来说比你想象的还要重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not ready for this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我还没准备好。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have a thing for toaster ovens?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对烤面包机情有独钟？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't care "what's happened to you."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不在乎"你经历了什么"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're *you.* And that's what I'm here for. And that's who I want to be with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就是*你*。这就是我在这里的原因。我想和你在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You. Arthur Nightingale.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是你。亚瑟·南丁格尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的，我想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe not yet? Can we take more time? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许现在还不行？我们能再多给彼此一些时间吗？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know you're busy, but I just wanted to say Happy Birthday. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道你很忙，但我只是想说声生日快乐。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Happy Birthday! (You do know what being "happy" is, right?)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐！（你确实知道"快乐"是什么意思，对吧？）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Happy Birthday, Arthur. Any plans?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，生日快乐。有什么计划吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Happy Birthday to Eleanor’s little brother!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 祝埃莉诺的弟弟生日快乐！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hi. Just wanted to say happy birthday. Glad I was here to see it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗨。只是想说声生日快乐。很高兴能见证这一天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Happy Birthday. Try extra hard not to die today. It'd ruin the vibe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐。今天要格外努力，尽量别死掉。不然会破坏气氛的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry, can't. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Forget what I said. Let's pretend it didn't happen. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 忘掉我说的话吧。我们就当这件事没有发生过。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...All right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I say a lot of things. Remind me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我说过很多话。能提醒我一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure. What about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然。怎么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not that, I was just hoping *you'd* forget.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是那样的，我只是希望*你会*忘掉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 经常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但是，亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I told you how I felt, and you left me hanging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对你坦白了我的感情，你却把我晾在一边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I changed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You left me hanging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你把我晾在一边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's embarrassing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这太尴尬了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm supposed to be "the boss" now, right? The one in charge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在我应该是"老大"了，对吧？做主的那个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I mean. I showed you my hand. And you peaced out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，我向你表白，你却突然离开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: About?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 考虑什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd really love that. [Date Arthur.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真的很愿意。[和亚瑟约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I'm not ready for this. [Do not date Arthur.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起。我还没准备好。[不和亚瑟约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: lol no [Do not date Arthur.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 笑死，不要。[不和亚瑟约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Arthur, can we talk? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，我们能聊聊吗？[征求是否同意多重伴侣关系]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, not really. I just wanted to talk to you about something that I hope isn't an uncomfortable situation for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没，没什么。我只是想跟你谈谈一件事，希望不会让你感到尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不想让你陷入一种你无法接受的情况。我知道我们之前没有讨论过这件事。所以如果你拒绝，那也没关系。我希望你清楚这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们之间的感情对我很重要——非常重要——而且它是真实的。我不希望你怀疑这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I do. And I know it might be hard to understand, but it doesn't mean I feel any less for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。我知道这可能很难理解，但这并不意味着我对你的感情有任何减少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I do. But now that I think about it, I think we should probably end things here. [Break up.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。但现在想想，我觉得我们或许应该就此结束。[分手]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For what it's worth, I really think you would like them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 恕我直言，我觉得你肯定会喜欢他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Lol. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。我保证不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How'd it go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 结果怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You took advice? Are you feeling all right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你竟然会听建议？你感觉还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Brb. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 马上回来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry, can't help it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，忍不住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a gift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这可是种天赋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anytime. That's what friends are for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别客气。这是朋友该做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe you should listen to me more often.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许你应该多听听我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just needed to apologize to you, and didn't know how else to do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想向你道歉，但不知道还有什么其他办法。
