/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... just didn't know how else to tell you I had feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……只是不知道该怎样告诉你，我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have no clue what you're talking about. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道你在说什么。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...No, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……老实说，没想过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. :) I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是。:) 我想试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Actually, I change my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实，我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What made you want to become a soldier?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是什么让你选择了军人这条路？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What was it like growing up, you and Eleanor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你和埃莉诺一起长大是怎样的体验？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Tell me about yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 介绍一下你自己吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. Isn't that how this is supposed to work?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯。不是应该这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's the problem?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有什么问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay then, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，那就算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ouch. Touchy subject?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎哟。敏感话题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wait. What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 等一下。什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, probably not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，大概还不够。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just trying to get to know you better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想更了解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So how am I supposed to do it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我该怎么做呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do I just stop now, or...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我现在就停下来，还是......？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Drinks first. *Then* personal questions. Got it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 先喝酒，*然后*才是私人问题。明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not worth the trouble, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不值得这么麻烦，算了吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Um... favorite color?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯……最喜欢的颜色？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Um... middle name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯……中间名？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: First pet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你的第一只宠物是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Black
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 黑色

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Green
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 绿色

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Blue
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 蓝色

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Red
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 红色

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know that much about you two, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实我对你们俩了解不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Black isn't even a real color, anyway. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 反正黑色也不是真正的颜色。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd like to change that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想改变这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And with that attitude, you won't. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有这种态度，你也了解不了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The bandana you have around your skana.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你空刃上绑的那条手帕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You just "feel" like a red guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你给人的*感觉*就是会喜欢红色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How'd you get that sword, anyway? It never seems to leave your side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那把剑你是怎么得来的？似乎总是不离身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Braxton
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 布拉克斯顿

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Herbert
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 赫伯特

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: James
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 詹姆斯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Petersham
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 彼得山

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It was a lucky guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 侥幸猜对了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You just "feel" like a James.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你给人一种詹姆斯的"感觉"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry I'm not up to date on my 20th-Century Britannic names!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我对 20 世纪的不列颠尼克名字不太了解！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How was I supposed to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我怎么知道？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Careful, or it's going to be what I call you now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 小心了，我可能就这样叫你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, yeah. Laugh it up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是，是。尽情笑吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How cute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How boring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, we'll call that good enough for now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，这样就算满意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure, if that's all you're willing to share.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然，如果你愿意分享的只有些的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What were your lives like, before all this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在这一切发生之前，你们的生活是怎样的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I take after the smart one. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很像那个小机灵鬼。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Too soon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 太快了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It was worth a try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 试一试无妨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ooookay never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好——吧，那就算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I assume you fixed the water issue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想你应该是解决了水的问题吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Aw. That's cute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗷。很厉害嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh? Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦？为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How'd that make you feel?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那会让你有什么感受？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sup?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh. Them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢。他们啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do they only have the one song?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们就这么一首歌吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I love them! We didn't have anything like that in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我爱死了！双衍王境里可没有这样的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Meh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd love to take your Atomicycle for a ride.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很想骑骑你的原子摩托车。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey mind if I borrow your Atomicycle? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，介意我用一下你的原子摩托车吗？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: C'mon. What's the worst that could happen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别这样。能出什么大事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, you drive. I'll sit on the back. Joyride.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，你骑。我坐后面。兜兜风。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Forget I said anything. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就当我什么都没说。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Chill! I was just playing around!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 放轻松！我只是在开玩笑！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's what the winky face was for!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个眨眼表情就是这个意思啊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没事了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Tilt your head to the left and look for the face. That's called an "emoticon."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 把头往左歪歪，找那个脸。那个叫"表情符号"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're starting to make a lot more sense, now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我现在，开始明白你为什么这样了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Emotion + Icon. Emoticon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 情感 + 图标。表情符号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么不行？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fine. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那好吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why would you assume I'd take something of yours and - oh...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你怎么会觉得我会拿走你的东西然后——哦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fine. I'll go get my own. And it'll be cooler anyway. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 行吧。我自己去搞一辆。反正我的会更酷。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Point taken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll just... use my own instead...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我还是……用我自己的吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Trial and error.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不断试错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: A mentor of mine, named Teshin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的一位导师，名叫 Teshin。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, and I did. A lot. Over, and over, and over... And over...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢，我确实挂了很多次。一次又一次的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And over...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 反反复复……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I really don't want to talk about this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真的不想说这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's more of a spiral, really. Point being, I got a lot of practice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实，那更像是个螺旋。重点是，我有很多机会练习。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nothing teaches you how to fight like knowing exactly what you're trying to avoid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 确切地知道你在避免什么，没有什么比这更能教会你如何战斗了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... well... you have, though. Don't you remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……呃……但，你死过的。难道你不记得了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not exactly something most people have to deal with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这其实不是大多数人常有的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. Because if you did, you might wind up like *me.* [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊。因为如果你记得的话，你可能会变成像*我*这样。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly? You're lucky it's hazy. I died so many times, I stopped caring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 坦白说？你很幸运那段记忆是模糊的。我死了太多次，都已经不在乎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How'd you feel if I asked you that question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我问你同样的问题，你会有什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You volunteering to be my therapist?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你自愿来做我的心理辅导吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Being trapped alone in the Void does weird things to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 独自被困在虚空中，让人有了奇怪的变化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't do this right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我现在不想谈这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一言为定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: An elite Dax soldier- which I *just* remembered means nothing to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他是个精英禁卫士兵——*突然*想起来你可能不知道这意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll summarize. It means he has the patience to put up with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我总结一下，就是说他有耐心忍受我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd still be lost in Duviri if it weren't for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 要不是他，我还在双衍王境里迷路呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He gave me the push I needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他给了我所需要的推动力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. And he coached me on how to fight. On how to beat Dominus Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没错。他还教会了我如何战斗，如何打败士魂大帝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That I accidentally turned into a tyrannical despot who had me executed in creative ways for centuries? Yep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个我无意中让他变成残暴独裁者，几百年来一直用各种新颖方式处决我的人？对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I died so many times, I stopped caring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我死过太多次，甚至都不在乎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Define "strange." Remember where I'm from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 给"奇怪"下个定义。想想我来自哪里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Try me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你来试试吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe later. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许以后吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've been poisoning it, haven't you?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你一直在给它下毒，是不是？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 食物怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly? It kind of reminds me of... I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说实话？这让我想起了……我也说不清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Force of habit. That's how the rations were served on the Zariman, the ship that got stuck in the void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 习惯使然吧。在那艘曾困在虚空中的扎里曼号上，我们的食物就是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有为什么。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Actually, sorry. I don't want to talk about it. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实，不好意思。我不想聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The only home I've had where I wasn't alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是我唯一没有感到孤单的家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Kind of? It's complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 算是吧？说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When it wasn't just me, myself, and my cubed food rations.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那时候不只有我和我的方块食物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So. I guess I do it because there's comfort in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，我想这样做是因为它给我安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. But... gross. I'll pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢了。但是……有点恶心。我还是算了吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll tell you what. If you make it, I'll eat it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这么跟你说吧。如果你做了，我就吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That sounds amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听起来很棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: A what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 做的什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why're you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你为什么要问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just me and the kid that I know of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只知道有我和那个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: None of your business. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不关你的事。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Technically, I'm not in your head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 技术上来说，我并不在你的脑袋中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You sure? It can get strange in here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？我脑袋里可能很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just driving your body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是在操纵你的身体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Considering what she's been through? I think she has the right to be "strange."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 考虑到她所经历的事？我觉得她有"奇怪"的权利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We'll see about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我们就等着瞧吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why, fantasizing about two of me? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么，难不成还想有两个我？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At the rate my life is going? Duplicates would be pretty mundane, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 鉴于我现在的生活状态，即便有复制人也只是平常事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who knows how many more universes there could be out there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁知道外面还有多少个宇宙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: More versions of you? Me? Us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 更多版本的你？我？还是我们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe there's one where we're dating...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许某个宇宙中的我们正在约会呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If it makes you feel better, I bet there's at least *one* where you won the fight. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果这能让你好受点，我敢打赌至少有*一个*宇宙你是赢了那场战斗的。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Raise one for all the Alternate Arthurs and Different Drifters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为所有替代版的亚瑟和不同的漂泊者干杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe I'd finally get my laundry folded.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许我终于有机会把我的衣服叠好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can you imagine the arguing? And the sass?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你能想象到那争吵吗？还有那些顶嘴？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know, I think it'd be pretty awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，我觉得这挺酷的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Although... more Drifters = more laundry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虽然……漂泊者越多 = 脏衣服越多……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Damn. Thwarted again!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 妈的，又没辙了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You could open up an amazing series of restaurants. ...Sans the square spaghetti, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你可以开一连串非常棒的餐厅。……当然，只要别做方形意大利面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Grumpy but effective. There are worse ways to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虽然脸臭，但做事效率还在。还有比这更糟的呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All fighting over who lost whose Tommy keys...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 都在争吵谁把谁的原摩钥匙搞丢了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Someday. Today is not that day. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说不定有一天会。但今天不是。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nope. It still haunts my nightmares.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没错。它还在我的噩梦中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's the upside of apathy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这正是麻木的好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not *caring.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不*在意*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because after a while...I realized that was the only armor I had left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为一段时间之后……我意识到那是我仅剩的铠甲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Joy, sorrow, anger, envy, fear, it was all defeat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 喜悦、悲伤、愤怒、嫉妒、恐惧，都是失败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So I embraced the nothing. The spiral of apathy. The *indifference.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以我拥抱了虚无。麻木的复眠螺旋。那种*冷漠* 。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't do this right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我现在不想谈这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I had help from the Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我得到了 Lotus 的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then I repaid them by saving their damn system. And...now I'm here. Trying to save this one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后我拯救了他们那该死的星系作为回报。现在……我在这里，试图拯救这个世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是人生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, but you know what? I'm not in it alone this time. I'm not going to take that for granted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，但你知道吗？这次我可不是孤军奋战。我也不会把这当成是理所当然的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hate to burst your bubble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不想打破你的幻想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: People change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 人是会变的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe, but...not today.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许以后，但……今天不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...Moody.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……情绪多变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Literally moody. As in the whole thing has *moods.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 字面上的情绪多变。整个世界都有*情绪*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's hard to explain. I'd have to show it to you someday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很难说清楚。有机会我得亲自让你看看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If one of those rings could kill you - repeatedly -  yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果那种戒指能反复杀死你——是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What color-changing rings?! I want a color-changing ring...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么变色戒指？！我想要一个变色戒指……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Duviri isn't any better. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 双衍王境也好不到哪里去。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, at least computers are real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，至少电脑是真实的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, at least here you have *real* company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，至少在这里，你有*真实*的伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I mean... it's complicated. Things can come in and out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是……这很复杂。事物可以进出其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: People to talk to. Share the experiences with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有人可以交谈，分享经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The good, bad...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 无论是好的、坏的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're not alone with just... your stories and imaginary friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你并不是只有……你的故事和幻想的朋友陪伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Stories that the Void gave life and turned against you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那些被虚空赋予生命然后转而伤害你的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And made kill you over, and over, and over... and over...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不断让你死去，一次、一次……又一次……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I kind of went numb over the years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这些年来我变得有些麻木了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: One kind of death you can come back from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有一种形式的死是还能活过来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know many soldiers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我并不认识很多士兵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真不认识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The other you can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 另一种则不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So I guess it's real enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以我想它足够真实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it's based on... things that *aren't* real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但它建立在……一些*不*真实的东西上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At what point does a story become reality?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一个故事什么时候会变成现实呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you believe in it enough?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是当你足够相信它时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or when it starts to believe in *you?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是当它开始相信*你*时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Welcome to Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 欢迎来到双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You can see why I don't really like talking about it much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道为什么我不太喜欢谈论这个话题了吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You'd hate it anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 反正你会讨厌的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know what? Life is full of miserable things. Why not enjoy the fun parts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道吗？生活中充满了痛苦。为什么不享受点乐趣呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I didn't get out much, remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还记得吗？我没怎么出去过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not saying lose sight of all the serious things that matter, but.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是说忽略所有重要的事情，但是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why not enjoy the silly things when you can?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么不趁着有机会的时候享受那些幼稚的事物呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You never know when you might not get another chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你永远不知道什么时候就没有下一次了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anyway, about Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 话说回来，关于双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Soooo... about those rings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以……关于那些戒指。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have my moments. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也是有高光时刻的。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 跟屎一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The whole "the only way you can leave here is if I'm driving you" thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那种"你只能靠我操纵你身体带你离开这里"的情况？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It has its upsides.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它有它的优点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It can be beautiful. Breathtaking, even.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它可以很美。甚至，令人惊叹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's a freedom that comes from familiarity. It's hard to describe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 熟悉中带着一种自由。难以形容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Through all of the bullshit, all the nonsense, it's like nowhere else I've ever seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 尽管充满了废话和荒谬，但它是我所见过的最与众不同的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know every rock. Every tree. Every hanging lantern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道每一块石头。每一棵树。每一个悬挂的灯笼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There are no surprises anymore, for better or worse. That can be comforting as much as it can be soul-sucking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 无论是好是坏，不再有任何惊喜。这种感觉既安心，又让人有种灵魂被抽干的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. "Tales from Duviri." The Void snatched it from me. From what I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。《双衍王境故事集》。虚空从我这夺走了它。从我的本我中夺走了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I guess I decided I wanted a nice view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我以为我决定要美丽的风景。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: While dying repeatedly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在不断死亡时。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Until apathy set in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 直到开始变得麻木。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The only thing worse than suffering is apathy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 比受苦更糟的唯一一件事就是麻木。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I still really don't want to talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我真的仍然不想谈这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't like it when I want to talk about *your* dirty laundry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我想八卦*你的*糗事时，你不会喜欢吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes it's better to leave rocks un-flipped. But fine. If you won't let it go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候，还是把过去留在过去更好。但好吧，如果你非要追问的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Short answer? Time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 简单来说？时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't care if you believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不在乎你信不信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I ran out of other emotions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我已经没有其他情感了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I got bored.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我厌倦了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, James
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，詹姆斯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Petersham
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，彼得山

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Buddy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，哥们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Uh... Hey, Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃……嘿，亚瑟？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind, then...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就算了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was just joking around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是在开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, come on. I think it's cute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢，别这样。我觉得这很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You with a five 'o clock shadow. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还有你一脸隔夜的胡茬。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, okay. I'll let it drop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，好吧。我不提了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Did it work?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这招有用吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it's just for fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这只是闹着玩的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...Yes? I'm confused now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……嗯？我现在都搞不清楚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The flirting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是调情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The nickname.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 外号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Actually, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 实际上，没什么了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm curious about something. But I don't know if you'd be willing to talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇一件事。但不知道你愿不愿意谈论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How'd you get that skana of yours?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么得到你的空刃的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What brought you here? To Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么原因让你来到霍瓦尼亚？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What made you want to be a soldier?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是什么让你想成为一名军人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What was it like, growing up with Eleanor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 和埃莉诺一起长大是什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's the non-simple answer?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那不简单的答案是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Great. We'll leave it there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很好。我们先到此为止吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, I get it. Maybe another time, then? After I buy you a few rounds first?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我明白了。那也许下次吧？等我先请你喝几轮之后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Chicken. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 胆小鬼。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Longer answer another time? Over drinks, maybe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 详细的答案改天再说？或许可以边喝边聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's the deal with Aoi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 碧到底怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, about you and Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，关于你和碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's she like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她是个什么样的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没事了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Those are winky faces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这些都是眨眼表情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you two dating?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你们俩在交往吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How long have you known each other?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你们认识多久了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Huh. Neat. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，挺好的。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ICR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 国危部？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So... you're saying she's single?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以……你是说她现在单身？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Were* you two dating?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你们*曾经*交往过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I guess this is just me asking, in a round about way... if you're single.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我猜我这是在绕弯子问你……你是单身吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, that's a yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这么说，那就是交往过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My cue to back off?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是我该退出的暗示吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She was just a decoy, I'm really more interested in you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她只是个幌子，我其实更感兴趣的是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I figured if I came out and asked you if *you* were single, you'd march over here and punch me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我原本以为如果我直接问*你*是否单身，你可能会跑过来打我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Uh oh looks like I need to do a forced software update might loose conne -- [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎呀，看起来我得进行一次强制软件更新，所以可能会掉线——[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Does the flirting bother you? I'll stop if it does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 调情让你不舒服吗？如果是的话我可以停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I haven't had a lot of practice, so I'm pretty bad at it, I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很少有机会练习，所以我知道我不擅长这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't have to tell me if you don't *want* to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你不*想*，你不必非得告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Great! I mean, oh, what a shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 太好了！我是说，哦，真遗憾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good to know. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很高兴知道。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm going to run you down like a kubrodon hunting a pobber on the Venusian plains.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会像金星平原上的库狛顿追泡博一样追你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not serious. You're just too much fun to tease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不算太严重。你只是太好逗了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey Arthur, what do you think about "Fables & Frontiers?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟，你觉得《寓言与边疆》怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Arthur, I have a favor to ask for Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，我想帮阿米尔问你帮个忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He's already asked, I take it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想，他已经问过你了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He was just telling me about the game, and I said I'd ask people if they wanted to play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他只跟我介绍了这个游戏，我说我会问问大家想不想玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He was telling me about this game he wants to play with everybody. Fables & Frontiers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他跟我说了他想和大家一起玩的游戏。寓言与边疆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's this dorky game he wants to play, I said I'd ask everybody to join.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他想玩一个很白痴的游戏，我说我会问问大家想不想一起玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think we could all use a break, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得我们可以都放松一下，你不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think it'd mean a lot to him if we played.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得如果我们玩的话，对他来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: LOL. Fables & Frontiers, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。寓言与边疆，是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, I'm just asking to make him happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的，我问只是想让他开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He feels like the odd man out, sometimes. I think a "group game" would help him feel more like part of the pack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候，他觉得自己不合群。我觉得"团队游戏"会让他感觉自己更像是团队中的一员。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think showing interest in his interests would make him feel less like an outsider. Like people cared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得对他的爱好表现出兴趣会让他感觉不那么像外人。而是大家在乎他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗨，亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey Sexy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，性感小哥。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I could call you *Petersham* if you prefer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，如果你喜欢，我可以叫你*彼得山*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you prefer "handsome?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你更喜欢"帅哥"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hah, only joking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈，只是开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're no fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你真无趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Cute?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可爱小哥？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Distinguished?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 气质小哥？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ruggedly manly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 阳刚大男人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry. I'm done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起。我不说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe I'm being sincere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许我是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly? Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说实话？是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You aren't exactly the easiest person to approach, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你并不是一个容易接近的人，亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't have a lot of practice at this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在这方面没多少练习。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Forget it. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我没说。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So I'm trying to break through the ice any way I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以我尽可能地想打破这层冰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So pardon me for flailing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以请原谅我这么笨拙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know your past is a touchy subject, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 知道你的过去是个敏感话题，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That skana of yours, I'm really curious about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你那把空刃，我真的很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm still really curious about that skana.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对那把空刃仍然很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Rain check. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 改天再说。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll pass. Sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 算了吧，对不起。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I am *extremely* stubborn, that's true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我*非常*固执，这是事实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Is it working this time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这次有用吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Very. Very doomed. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 非常、绝对没戏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mmm, I'm keeping my options open.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我还在考虑其他选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Actually, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 实际上，没什么了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The red bandana that's tied to the blade. Whose was it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 剑上系着的红头巾，是谁的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How'd you get it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么得到它的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why do I get the feeling that's not the truth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么我感觉这不是真相呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Great.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Didn't mean to upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是有意让你不高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, okay...sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，好吧……对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Here's a toast to Someday, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就为某一天干杯吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can I ask how you got the skana in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我可以问一下你一开始是怎么得到这把空刃的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ouch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wow. Foreboding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哇。真是不吉利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Jerk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真是个混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Ouch.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *哎哟。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你，亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The red bandana tied on it. Who did it belong to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 上面系着的红头巾。是谁的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sheesh, didn't realize you'd make such a big deal out of this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎，没想到你会这么认真对待这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I try not to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我尽量不去想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What a way to start a conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真会找话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes. Usually when I'm trying to fall asleep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候吧。通常是在我想睡觉的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think about it like a high score.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想这就像是个高分记录。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Worst. Sheep. Ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 史上。最糟糕。的绵羊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's a... "sheep?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么是"绵羊"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you need to talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你需要聊聊吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 确实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Eh, you seem to have done all right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，你看起来表现不错嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good call. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好决定。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I won't force you to talk if you don't want to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你不想说，我就不会强迫你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll go first, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我先开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not my job to figure that out for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 帮你搞懂这个不是我该操心的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I try not to think too much about what I've had to do to get through life. Because I don't have anybody to talk to about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我尽量不去思考那些为了生存而不得不做的事。因为我没人可以倾诉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I only had myself to talk to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只能和自己说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've never even really had friends. You and the others are the closest I've ever come to... belonging somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我甚至从未真正有过朋友。你和其他人是我感到最亲近……最有归属感的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How sad is that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这得有多悲哀啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At least you've had the option to talk if you've wanted to. But hey. If you need me? I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少你想说话的时候还有这个选择。但嘿，如果你需要我？我就在这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How'd you wind up here in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你一开始是怎么来到这里的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, why join the ICR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，为什么要加入国危部？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么部？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Gotcha. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 明白了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: "Supposed" to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所谓的"在最后关头"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That seemed to have worked out great.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那似乎挺成功的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd like to deploy *your* military unit. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我倒想部署*你的*军事单位。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Food was that bad, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙食那么糟糕啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's not foreboding, or anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那听上去不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can you give me more than that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可以说具体点吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Is that where you learned to cook square spaghetti?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就是在那里学会做方形意大利面的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can still taste it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我现在还记得那个味道呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Lol, noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈，知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mmm... Semi-tasty explosions...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯……勉强能吃的爆炸物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm trying to get to know you better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想更了解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just making conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 找个话题而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know how I feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道我的感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Am I pushing the wrong buttons again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是不是又提到了敏感话题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can I level with you for a second, Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，我能跟你说实话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I get the feeling this is a touchy subject.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我感觉这个话题有点敏感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, if you don't want to talk, I won't make you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你不想聊，我不会勉强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, then, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那好吧，算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not trying to upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我并不是想让你不高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just trying to get to know you. Really, I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想更了解你。真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Actually, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实，没事了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I'm doing this because I care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我这么做是因为我在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I'm doing this because I want to be a better friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我这样做是因为我想成为一个更好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, I'm sorry if I'm bothering you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，如果我打扰到你了，我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, if this isn't the right way to go about it, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，如果我用错了方法，我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just want to know what made Arthur, *Arthur.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想知道是什么造就了现在的*亚瑟*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I haven't been able to stop thinking about you since I've shown up here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为自从我来到这里，我就一直无法停止想你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just want to know what made Arthur, *Arthur.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想知道是什么造就了现在的*亚瑟*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I get it. I'll back off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我懂了，我会给你点空间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I didn't realize the stories I was asking for were painful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没想到我问的那些事对你来说那么痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We'll see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 拭目以待吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You have no idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can be patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我可以等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I didn't realize the stories I was asking for were painful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没想到我问的那些事对你来说那么痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, but I'm still sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，但我还是觉得抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: On what? The soldier stories or the whole "I have feelings for you" thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 改天什么？关于当兵的故事还是"我喜欢你"的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: lol. Yeah, rain check. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。好吧，改天。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's that mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't imagine why. You're so approachable and talkative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不明白，你这么平易近人又健谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't like to give up an inch, do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你还真是不肯退让半步，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can be patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我可以等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't worry, I'm stubborn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别担心，我很固执的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那没事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just trying to get to know you more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想更了解你一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sheesh, sorry. Just trying to have a conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎，抱歉，我只是想聊聊而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why did you quit the Britannic army?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你为什么离开不列颠尼克军队？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, why a peacekeeping organization?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，为什么加入维和组织？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I get the feeling there's more to it than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我感觉不止如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I appreciate what you did share.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很感谢你愿意分享这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Next time, provide beer. Noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 下次要带啤酒来。我记着呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why join with them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么要加入他们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's... a really easy question with a really hard answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这个问题……问起来简单，答起来难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My other option was to lose my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不来的话我就得疯掉了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's one of the best vacation spots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它是最好的度假胜地之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd rather not get into this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不太想深入这个话题。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Winding up in an imaginary-turned-real Void realm isn't like walking to the corner store.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 进入一个从虚构变为现实的虚空领域，并不像走到街角商店那么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not exactly a short story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这故事有点长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a long story. A really long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是个很长的故事。真的非常长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I cope through humor. I'm trying to deflect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我通过幽默来应对。我是在尝试转移话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What was your first clue?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么发现的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right, all right... Buckle up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，好吧……准备来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can we do this another time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们可以下次再说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The other option is to cry constantly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 另一个选择是不停地哭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The thing about the past is, you get through it. But it can still hurt to talk about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 过去的事，你挺过去了。但再谈起时还是会让人心痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在可以了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 永远不谈也行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. Later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可以。改天吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry. You're right. I don't like talking about this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起。你说得对。我不喜欢谈论这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not being defensive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没有在防备。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It... it's messy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 事情……事情很混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you like talking about your screwed up past?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你喜欢谈论你那糟糕的过去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The void screws with everything. Timelines, reality, your head. Messy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虚空扰乱了一切。时间线、现实、还有你的心智。都很混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're thinking like a soldier. Messy because of what it did to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是在以军人的方式思考。之所以混乱，是因为它对我造成的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Gnnnhhh... Fine. But you owe me. A story for a story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃……行吧。但你得还我一个。一个故事换一个故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Another time, maybe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许下次吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Pass. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 得了吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Easier said than done with Duviri, but...deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 关于双衍王境，说起来容易做起来难，但……成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: On second thought, no. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 想了一下，还是不了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The Man in the Wall is a lying, murdering bastard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 墙中人是一个满口谎言、嗜杀成性的混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We're all made up of the stories we're taught.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们都是被学到的故事塑造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's what it all comes back to in the end. That *thing* that haunts us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 到头来，一切都回到了这点。那个一直纠缠我们的*东西*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The stories we learn changes the world around us. In my case it's literal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们学到的故事会改变我们周围的世界。对我而言，就是字面说的这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The Void made our parents go insane. They were trying to eat us, Arthur. Then that *thing* showed up. Offered us powers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虚空让我们的父母发疯了。他们想吃掉我们，亚瑟。然后那个*东西*出现了。给了我们力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm getting ahead of myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我说得有点太快了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Said the powers would save us all. But he didn't mean me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说这些力量会拯救我们所有人。但他并没有包括我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was left behind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我被落下了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Two important things about the Void: One. It makes you go nuts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 关于虚空，有两点很重要：第一，它会让你发疯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Two: "Conceptual Embodiment." It takes things from your head and makes them real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 第二："概念成形"。它把你脑海中的东西取出，然后把它们变成现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We had a book of stories written by Entrati's daughter about how not to go nuts in the void. And my mind snapped back to those.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们有一本英择谛的"女儿"写的关于如何在虚空中保持理智的故事书。我突然回想起了那些故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So. Why did I go to Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，我为什么会去双衍王境呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because the Man in the Wall wanted to play games. Because everybody has abandoned me my entire life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为墙中人想玩游戏。因为我的一生里，每个人都把我抛弃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because those stories said "come play with me. It's safe here. Let's go on adventures!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为那些故事说："来和我一起玩吧。这里很安全。我们去冒险吧！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The Void made a kingdom of sand from my memories and I grew up playing with storybook friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虚空用我的记忆创造了一个沙漠王国，我在那里与故事集中的朋友们一起玩耍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I went to Duviri because I didn't have a choice. Because the people there that the Void made? They were my friends, even if they weren't real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我去双衍王境是因为我别无选择。也因为那些虚空造出来的人？他们是我的朋友，即使他们不是真实的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Until I outgrew them. And those friends became my nightmares.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 直到我长大了不再需要他们。那些朋友变成了我的噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Until those friends became my nightmares.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 直到那些朋友变成了我的噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And Dominus Thrax began executing me again, and again, and again...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后士魂大帝开始处决我……一次又一次……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So. Yeah. *That's* how I wound up in Duviri, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，是的。亚瑟，这就是我来到双衍王境的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because of the stories I was taught.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 都是因为那些我听到的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And began executing me again, and again, and again...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后开始处决我……一次又一次……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So. Yeah. *That's* how I wound up in Duviri, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，是的。亚瑟，这就是我来到双衍王境的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because of the Man in the Wall. And Albrecht. And the Orokin. And all the stupid games everybody plays.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为墙中人。还有阿尔布雷希特。还有奥罗金。还有所有人都在玩的愚蠢游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Orowyrms, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 事实上，是奥金魇龙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You started it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你先开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I warned you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我警告过你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like, brothers and sisters?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是说，兄弟姐妹什么的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you mean, did I have parents?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是想问，我有没有过父母吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, I came from a test tube.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我是从试管里造出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's a reason I don't like the Man in the Wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不喜欢墙中人是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It... It wasn't pretty. Why're you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那件事……并不是什么愉快的回忆。你为什么问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I had a sibling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我曾经有个手足。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh. Not technically? But all us kids on the Zariman were basically raised together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，严格来说，没有？不过我们这些在扎里曼号上的孩子基本上是被一起带大的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know she and I are a "thing," right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道我和她是*一对儿*吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's she doing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她做什么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She drives me nuts for a completely *different* reason. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她让我疯狂的原因可完全*不同*哦。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not a family therapist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我可不是家庭调解员啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry, sorry, lol!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉抱歉，嘿嘿！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That *tongue* though...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过她那个*舌头*可真是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She can invade my mind any time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她随时可以侵入我的思想……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not comfortable with this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我听不下去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's the problem?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 到底怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just teasing you, XD
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是逗你玩呢，XD

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was left on my own too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可能是因为我总是被扔在那儿没人管。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a gift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是一种天赋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anyway. About Eleanor? Whats she doing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 话说回来。埃莉诺，她怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This has been a... pretty messed up year, to be fair. Maybe she just forgot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 老实说，这一年过得……挺混乱的。可能她只是忘了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can I ask what you were supposed to be commiserating?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我可以问问你们是在悼念什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Have you just asked her about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你有没有直接问过她？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么不问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then why're you bothering me? Go ask *her* what's up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你来烦我做什么？去问*她*怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I assume whatever this event that you're commiserating was painful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我猜你们悼念的这件事情一定很痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I'm not your therapist. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我不是你的心理医生。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe now that everything in your lives have changed, you want to let it go? Maybe she does, too?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许现在你们生活中的一切都变了，你想放下了？也许她也这么想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Have you talked to her about missing the date?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你有没有跟她谈过错过约定的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦……对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Eh, there's a difference between choosing to stay and being trapped. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，选择留下和被困住还是有区别的。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I like the view, what can I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我就喜欢那个景色，我还能说什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You going to tell me what all this was about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你会告诉我这一切是怎么回事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But seriously, about your sister -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但说真的，关于你姐——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't want to talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不想聊这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: LOL what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈，什么玩意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The past is weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 过去真奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Normally, I think you're supposed to go to a ropes course... but fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一般来说，我觉得你应该去参加绳索课程吧……但行吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure. Why not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然。为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nah. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不了，我不玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ROFLMAO
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 笑死我了哈哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That is... painfully adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这真是……可爱得让人心疼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can I hug Sebastian at some point?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有机会的话我能抱一下塞巴斯蒂安吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think I just died a little.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我感觉我的心有点要融化了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're full of surprises, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，你还真是个充满惊喜的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I might pee I'm laughing so hard! lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我都快尿出来了，简直太好笑了！哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: On Duviri, I kept accidentally summoning my childhood bedroom because I wanted somewhere to hide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在双衍王境，我总是不经意间召唤出我儿时的卧室，因为我想找个地方躲起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: One time, when I was decapitated by Lodun, my head flew off so hard it wound up in a tree!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有一次，当隆沌砍我的头时，我的头飞得太快了，直接卡在了树上！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It took me six hundred and eighty-seven loops to learn how to properly ride a kaithe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我用了六百八十七个循环才学会怎么骑好绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, I'll pass. But thanks for telling me about Sebastian.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我就算了。不过谢谢你告诉我塞巴斯蒂安的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I started tallying all my broken bones. I think I still have the list somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我开始记录我每次的骨折，那个单子我应该还留着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you know how long the head stays alive after it's been cut off? Because *I DO.* LOL
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道头被砍下来后还能活多久吗？我可是*知道*的。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've lost track of how many bedrooms I summoned by the time I figured out how to get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 等我搞清楚怎么离开那里时，我已经不记得召唤了多少次卧室了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Me? Specifically?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对我个人而言么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What do you do for fun?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你平时都做些什么好玩的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oops! There's a bee in here! BRB! [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎呀！这里有只蜜蜂！马上回来！[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么这么问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...um...not a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……嗯……不太多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nothing. I died a lot. Thanks for reminding me. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有什么爱好。我死了很多次。谢谢你的提醒。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well... reading. I did a lot of reading.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧……读书吧。我读了很多书。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The stories I kept in my head were the only things I was allowed to keep on Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在双衍王境上，我脑中的故事是唯一能保留的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Everything else would disappear when it looped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其他的一切在循环后都会消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And when I was alone on the Zariman, the people on the page were the only friends I had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我独自一人在扎里曼号上时，书中的人物就是我唯一的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now? I play games with Ordis. And read. And... still keep to myself, really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在的话？我会和 Ordis 玩游戏，还有读书。其实……大部分时间还是自己待着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: TWO WORDS. SQUARE. SPAGHETTI.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 两个词。方形。意大利面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I ate the square spaghetti, Arthur. That is a LIE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，我吃过那方形意面。那是个谎言。
