/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Pass. Thanks. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不了，谢谢。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you offering to loan me a book?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是要借我一本书吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Um. Nah. I'm good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃，不用了。我不需要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh! Yeah! I'd like that. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦！好呀！我很想学。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd love that. But can you wear one of those cute aprons? And.... maybe only the apron? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很想学。但你可以穿那种可爱的围裙吗？或者……可能只穿围裙？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She knows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I mean, that's your job as her brother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我说，你作为她弟，这是你的责任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She can handle herself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她能照顾好自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: BRB [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 马上回来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm...not following.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……没太明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm assuming you don't mean that literally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我猜你不是指字面上意思吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, brb.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，马上回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can see why that'd make things harder...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我明白为什么这会让事情变得更难……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wouldn't that make it easier?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那不是让事情更容易了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Listening to your intentions rather than your words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她听的是你的意图而不是你的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe that's more honest, but...complicated. Harder to convince her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这或许更真实，但……也更复杂。更难说服她了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How is that a bad thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这有什么不好？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, not gonna lie, it creeps me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，老实说，这事让我觉得有点害怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can I make a suggestion?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我可以给个建议吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I dunno, I think it's kinda hot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，我觉得这挺刺激的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She can invade my mind anytime... :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她随时可以闯入我的思维……:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Have you tried telling her how hard it is to tell her how hard it is to tell her how you feel?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你试过告诉她你很难向她表达"你很难向她表达感受"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Have you tried talking to her in this text app?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你试过用这个聊天软件和她谈吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She'll be fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hard to read your mind that way. And sometimes it's easier to communicate in text. Case in point, look at us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这样她应该很难读懂到你的想法。有时文字交流更简单。就像我们现在这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, that sounded a lot smarter in my head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，是我的表达没跟上我的思维。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hmm...have you tried texting her in the app?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯……你试过在聊天软件中给她发消息吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd trust her to know when she needs help. She'll come to you if she does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我相信她知道自己什么时候需要帮助。如果她需要，她会来找你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes it's easier to express yourself in text, anyway. Less pressure. Easier to think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候用文字表达自己更容易。压力也小，更容易思考。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And that's when your twin *can't* read your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这样你的双胞胎姐姐就*不能*读你的想法了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And you're worried someday she won't come back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而且你担心有一天她可能回不来了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When I use Transference on Eleanor, I can hear what she hears. I don't blame her for having dark moments.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我对埃莉诺使用传识时，我能听到她听到的一切。我不怪她有时会有些阴郁的时刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She's stronger than you give her credit for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她比你想象的要坚强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll help keep an eye on her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会帮你看着她的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is a lot to adjust to--she'll be fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她需要一点时间去适应——她会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then trust her to come to you if she needs help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就相信她，如果她需要帮助，她会来找你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Have you told her *that* word for word?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你有逐字逐句地告诉她*这些*话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Some people want to deal with things on their own. Have you asked if she even *wants* help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有人更喜欢自己解决问题。你问过她是否真的*需要*帮助了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: As okay as someone can be, when her friends treat her like a monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在她的朋友把她当怪物一样对待的情况下，能好到哪里去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: As okay as she can be, when her own twin brother doesn't know how to talk to her anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当她的亲生双胞胎弟弟都不知道怎么跟她说话时，她能好到哪去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She can hear every thought of everybody around her--and has to try to keep a straight face. I'd go dark now and again, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她能听到周围每个人的想法——还得装作若无其事。我也会时不时陷入阴郁情绪的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Consider what Quincy thinks about when he thinks nobody's paying attention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 想想昆西以为没人注意时脑子里都在想些什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd march up to her and give her a hug, personally. Let your emotions do the talking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的话会直接走过去，给她一个拥抱。让情感替你说话吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Talk to her on here. Hard to read minds through text.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就用这个跟她聊聊吧。通过文字交流是很难使用读心术的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just...be patient. If she needs you, she'll let you know. Some people need to heal on their own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就……耐心一点。如果她需要你，她会告诉你的。有些人需要靠自己疗伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Where do I even start?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我该从哪里开始？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nope. I'm not doing this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。我不想提这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wake up on the wrong side of the bed this morning?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有起床气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay! Okay, sorry. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧！好吧，对不起。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Let's start with: How drunk are you right now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们先得搞清楚：你现在喝得有多醉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly, it's probably best not to think about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说实话，最好还是不要去想这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Shit. I've been there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可恶。我之前也是这样感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're a little messed up right now, aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你现在脑子有点乱，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Be honest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说实话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can't say I blame you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我并不是想责怪你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're sure you want to talk about this right now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你确定现在要聊这个吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If Duviri had booze, I'd have done the same thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果双衍王境里有酒，我也会做出同样的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know it's frightening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道这令人害怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For a while, I pasted a joyful smile on my face and pretended it was fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有一阵子，我老是笑眯眯的，假装没事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was so envious of the people who weren't abandoned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真的很嫉妒那些没有被抛弃的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was just so damn *angry.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我当时非常非常*愤怒*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It was so easy to give in to the sorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 屈服于悲伤太容易了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not insulting you, that's just a *fact.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没有侮辱你的意思，只是在说*事实*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because fake happiness was better than anything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为虚假的幸福在那时比任何东西都好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hell, even our dead parents. Anybody. Anybody who wasn't *me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 见鬼，甚至连我已故的父母都算进去了。包括任何人。除了*我*以外的任何人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not what. *Who.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是对什么。是对*谁*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Exactly. It eats you. Dissolves you. Leaves you broken and hollow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没错。它会吞噬你。瓦解你。让你支离破碎、空虚不堪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This shit is *horrifying.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这玩意儿是真的*恐怖*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because if I let that smile slide, then *everything else* would creep in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为如果我让那笑容溜走，那么*其他一切*就会趁虚而入。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because then I wouldn't have to deal with the pain. The loneliness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为那样我就不用再忍受那种痛苦、那种孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Angry at the ones who weren't abandoned. Angry at my parents. Angry at the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对那些没有被抛弃的人愤怒。对我的父母愤怒。对奥罗金愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Takes away all color from the world. But it's also... safe. Simple. Easy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它夺走了世界上所有的色彩。但是它也是……安全的。纯粹的。简单的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And fear leaks into everything else. And it starts  to make you lash out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而恐惧会渗透到每个角落。接着它会让你情绪失控。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The pain. The loneliness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那种痛苦、那种孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The fact that I was trapped *forever.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个我被*永远*困住了的事实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Angry at everyone, it didn't matter. Angry at everyone because. It. Was. Their. Fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对每个人都感到愤怒，不管是谁。对每个人都感到愤怒，是因为这。全。都。是。他。们。的。错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like a warm, cozy blanket long gone cold.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就像一条温暖舒适的毯子，却早已变冷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It turns into pain. Into agony. And then it turns into loneliness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它会化为痛苦。化为折磨。然后化为孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The joy was just a cheap facade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那种喜悦只不过是徒有其表。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I wanted to be anyone else. Anywhere else. So very badly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想成为其他人。去其他地方。做梦都想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And most importantly? Furious at myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但最重要的是？我对自己很极其愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's an easy thing to clutch to in the darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是一件在黑暗中很容易抓住的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But when all that fades away, something else takes over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但当所有这些都消亡后，其他的东西就会取而代之。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something worse. Something more insidious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其他更糟糕、更阴险的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something that worms its way into you and eats you whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其他会钻进你的身体，然后把你整个吞掉的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Apathy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就是麻木。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I thought so, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我之前也这么认为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But at what price?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但代价是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Trust me. It is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 相信我，真的更糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't wish away your feelings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不要抛弃自己的感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But don't let go of what you feel. Not now, not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但不要放弃你的感受。现在不要，永远不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't let go of what you feel. Not now, not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不要忽视你的感受。现在不要，永远不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's what makes us human.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这正是我们之所以为人的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not our bodies, not whether or not we can be Transferred into or whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是我们的身体，也不是我们是否可以被传识或其他什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's emotions. All of them. The good and the bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而是情感。所有的情感。无论好坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fear. Joy. Anger. Envy. Sorrow. Even a little apathy now and then is fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 恐惧。喜悦。愤怒。嫉妒。悲伤。即使偶尔有点麻木也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't ever, *ever* give them up, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 永远、*永远*不要舍弃它们，亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Feel everything. Every second of it. That's how you survive this. And you have something I never did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 感受一切。感受每一秒。这是你生存下去的方式。你拥有我从未有过的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're surrounded by six people who care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你身边有六个关心你的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're surrounded by six people who believe in you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你身边有六个相信你的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You aren't alone. I'm here with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你并不孤单，有我在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who are going through the same thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们也在经历过同样的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And we can carry each other when we need it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而且如果我们需要，我们可以互相支持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anytime, A.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别客气，老亚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Get some rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好好休息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's up, Petersham?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了，彼得山？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's up, James?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了，詹姆斯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sup?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, man?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了哥们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Couldn't help it, sorry. :P You were saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 忍不住，抱歉。:P 你刚才说什么来着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you're sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你确定要说的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm all ears.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我洗耳恭听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不了，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have to go. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think I can see where this is going...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我大概猜到会发生什么了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天，不会吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But -
Arthur...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So you joined the ICR after that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以你后来加入了国危部？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It wasn't your fault, what happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 发生的事不是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Have you ever tried listening to her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你有没有试过听她的话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ooh, we could afford to put in a hot tub!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，那我们都能买个热水浴缸了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry you've had to go through all this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很抱歉你要经历这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Doing the right thing is always the hardest choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 做正确的事永远是最难的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Is there something else you're not telling me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是不是还有什么没告诉我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't have to be okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不用非得装作没事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Um... bullshit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃……胡扯吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Story for another time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 改日再聊这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you... want to talk about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你……想谈谈吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, grow up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢，成熟点吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Jealous?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嫉妒了?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I figured you didn't have feelings for me in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我以为你不喜欢我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do my best not to screw this up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力不把这件事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What if I said my relationship was a lie, and I still had feelings for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我说我的恋情是假的，其实我还是喜欢你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, well, I got sick of waiting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，是啊，我厌倦了等待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, it's you I really have feelings for... I just gave up hope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我真正喜欢的人是你……我只是失去了希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My relationship is real. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的关系是真实的。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I mean, I can have feelings for more than one person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是说，我可以同时喜欢很多人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah...?
What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're the one I *really* have feelings for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是我真正*喜欢*的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know you and Aoi used to be more than friends...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道你和碧以前的关系不止是朋友……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know you and Aoi are friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道你和碧是朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do my best not to screw this up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力不把这件事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What if I said my relationship was a lie, and I have feelings for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我说我的恋情是假的，其实我喜欢你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do my best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不敢保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Arthur, about that Fables & Frontiers game - it'll mean a lot to both Amir and I if you play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，关于寓言与边疆那个游戏——如果你也一起玩的话，它对我和阿米尔来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Arthur - I know you already said no to that game of Fables & Frontiers, but I think it'll be fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟——我知道你已经拒绝了玩寓言与边疆那个游戏，但我觉得会很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, do you want to play Fables & Frontiers with Amir and I? I think it'll be fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，你想跟我和阿米尔一起玩寓言与边疆吗？我觉得会很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey Arthur. Amir is putting together a game of Fables & Frontiers, and it'd mean a lot to both of us if you'd join.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，亚瑟。阿米尔正在组织一次寓言与边疆的游戏，如果你能加入的话，对我们俩来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think it'd be a lot of fun, and a good bonding experience for all of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得会很有趣，而且对我们所有人来说也是一次很好的增进感情的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He feels like the odd man out - the non-military one, the nerd, kind of on the outside. It'd mean a lot to him if we all sat down and played one of his games with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他觉得自己不格格不入——不是军事人员，又是个书呆子，有点局外人的感觉。如果我们都坐下来和他一起玩他的游戏，对他来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不要。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For you. For us. For what we have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为了你。为了我们。为了我们拥有的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't have time for this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没空聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I feel special here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在这里感觉很特别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The pizza is great. So, I like the food?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这里的比萨很棒。所以，我喜欢这里的食物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you'd prefer I leave, then just tell me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你希望我离开，那就直说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The pizza is great. So, I like the food?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这里的比萨很棒。所以，我喜欢这里的食物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Square spaghetti not withstanding... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 方形意大利面除外……;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you think I'm just here with you, what, killing time?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你以为我在这里陪你是在，那什么，打发时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Arthur. I *care* about you. I care about all the of the Hex, but you most of all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟。我*在乎*你。我在乎六人组的所有人，但最在乎的是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So of *course* I stay here with you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以我*当然*会留在这里和你一起！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How can you even ask me that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你怎么能问出这种话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's not what I meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是这个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You got that right. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得对。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Square spaghetti not withstanding...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 方形意大利面除外……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry I want to be your friend?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起，我只是想和你做朋友？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why're you so angry at me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你为什么要这么生气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I like it here. End of story. End of conversation. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我喜欢这里。就这样。对话结束。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So I can't leave you behind. This place. This time. With *you?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以我不能抛下你不管。此时此地我要和*你*在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's the first place that's ever...felt like home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是第一个真正让我……感觉像家的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it's not a serious question. How could you ask me that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这不是一个应该认真的问题。你怎么能问我这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's obvious why I'm here. For *you.* For the Hex. Because you're my family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为什么在这里已经很明显了。为了*你*。为了六人组。因为你是我的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because you matter to me more than I can put into words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为你对我太重要了，重要到我无法用语言来表达。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, no. This place, this time? With *you,* Arthur? This is my home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，我不离开。亚瑟，此时此地与你在一起。这里就是我的家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I keep coming back because I...have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我一直回来是因为我……喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I have feelings for you, you ASSHAT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我喜欢你，你这个二货。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You want to know why?! Because you're the first FAMILY I've ever had!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你想知道为什么吗？因为你是我有生以来的第一个家人！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm done with this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我受够了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because despite the fact it didn't work out between us, I still *care* about you and the rest of the Hex like family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为尽管我们之间没有结果，我*仍然*在乎你和六人组的其他人，就像家人一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I still have feelings for you, that's why!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我依然喜欢你，这就是原因！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And that's a "no thanks." Great.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这算是张"好人卡"了吧。太好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's all you've got to say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就这么回应？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If caring makes me crazy, or stupid, so be it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果关心你让我看起来疯狂或愚蠢，那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's why I keep coming back. Because that's what family *does.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我为什么一直回来。因为这就是*家人*才会做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Go sit and spin, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，滚一边去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure. You're forgiven. This time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然。这次我原谅你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I thought I smelled smoke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我感觉到了有事情要发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Busy. Can't talk right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在忙。现在没法说话。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Go for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe later? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 稍后可以吗？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, I was just playing around. :/
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我只是在开玩笑。:/

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I mean...yeah. Have you *seen* yourself?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是……当然。你有*看过*自己的样子吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No...sorry. That's just a shield. The truth is, I honestly can't stop thinking about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是的……对不起。那只是一种掩饰。事实是，我真的无法停止想你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly? I... can't stop thinking about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 老实说？我……无法停止想你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is making me uncomfortable. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这让我有点不舒服。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I swear I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我发誓我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hahah sorry! Yeah, it's just how we joke around in the future. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈，对不起！是的，我们未来就是这么开玩笑的。 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Seriously?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: :D :D :D
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: :D :D :D

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You just threatened to break my ankles!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你刚刚还在威胁要打断我的脚踝！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Emoticons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是表情符号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You are so adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你真可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hell no. [Do not date Arthur.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 鬼才要。[不和亚瑟约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you... asking to date me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是在……邀请我约会吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry, sometimes I need help translating wherever-the-hell-you're-from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，有时候我真的需要有人帮我翻译一下你那边的地方话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just didn't believe you'd put your foot in your mouth like that. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是不敢相信你会说出这种荒唐话来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd...love nothing more. [Date Arthur.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……非常想。[和亚瑟约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I'm not ready for this. [Do not date Arthur.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起。我还没准备好。[不和亚瑟约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Did... did you just use an emoticon...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你……你刚刚用了个表情符号……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They really are going to gossip.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们确实会八卦的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Someone go get Lettie!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁去叫一下莱蒂！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm weirdly and sincerely flattered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虽然有点奇怪，但我确实真心感到受宠若惊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You laughed. You know you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你笑了。你肯定笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can we chat later? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们可以晚点再聊吗？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What're you trying to say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你想说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I gtg. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you telling me to leave?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是在让我走吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Travel isn't permanent. I can come and go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 旅行不是永久的。我可以来来去去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Screw the future. I never belonged there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 管他什么未来。我从来就不属于那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why're you so angry with me for no reason?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你为什么无缘无故生我的气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Says who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁说的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Common sense? Or fear?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 常识？还是恐惧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is asinine. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这太傻了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't want to leave, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，我不想离开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something horrible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可怕的事情？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks for the vote of confidence...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你投下信任票……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I repeat: Why are you angry at me for no reason?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我再问一次：你为什么无缘无故生我的气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not having an argument with you over something that isn't real. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不想因为一些不存在的事情和你争论。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, you're not. You're looking for an excuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，你不是。你是在找借口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You want a reason to push me away. You want a reason to not have to *care.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你想找个理由把我推开。你想找个理由不去*在乎*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: People die. People disappear. That's called *life.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 人会死去。人会消失。这就叫*人生*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It happens to anyone, at any time. Nothing is ever certain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这可能随时发生在任何人身上。没有什么是一定的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Whether or not they're freaks or from the future or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管他们是不是异类，还是来不来自未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So stop making *excuses* and tell me what's *really* bothering you, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以亚瑟，别再找*借口*了，告诉我*真正*困扰你的是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, what's the problem, exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，到底是什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Since I clearly don't matter to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 既然我对你来说显然不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you want me to leave? Or stay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你想让我离开？还是留下？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What *did* you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你*是*什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So why are you pushing me away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以你为什么要把我推开？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: LOL
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 笑死

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then what the *hell* do you call this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那这到底是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey look on the bright side, you'll be the best Excalibur again if I go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，往好的方面想，如果我走了，你又能成为最棒的 Excalibur 了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, this is called you looking for excuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，这是你在找借口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't have any plans to leave. And that's the best I can do right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没有离开的打算。我能做的就是这样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. And it should be enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的，这应该足够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't want to get hurt, and I understand that. I respect that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不想受伤。我理解。我尊重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Stop looking for excuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不要再找借口了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So do you want me to stay? Or leave?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你希望我留下？还是离开？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I might be from the future, but I can't predict it, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，虽然我可能来自未来，但我无法预测它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know what the future holds for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道我们的未来会怎样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But right now? I want to be here with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但此刻？我想和你在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But people disappear all the time. Normal people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但人们总是会消失。普通人也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: People die all the time. Normal people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 人们总会死去。普通人也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't have to be a freak or from the future for that to happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 并不是说你要成为怪胎或者来自未来才会遇到这种情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think you don't want to get hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你是不想受伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Let me know when you figure it out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 等你想清楚了再告诉我。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Of course not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然不能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That doesn't mean I'm going to intentionally disappear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这并不意味着我会故意消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I think you need to figure out if you're okay with this relationship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我觉得你需要搞清楚你是否真的能接受这样的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because yeah. Someday, something MIGHT happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为，是的。有一天，有些事可能会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something might happen. I can't promise otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有可能会发生什么事。我不能保证不会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's called life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就叫人生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So stop searching for reasons to push me away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以别再找理由推开我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you want this to end, just end it. Don't blame it on me someday "disappearing."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你想结束这段关系，就结束吧。别将来怪我的"消失"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes, people don't come back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候，人们不会回来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No kidding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一点儿不假。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd feel the same in your shoes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 换作是我，我也会有同样的感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The future's in good hands. They don't need me. This place does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 未来在可靠的人手中。他们不需要我。而这个地方需要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...yeah. I'm sorry. I'd have to go, if the universe was at stake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……是的。对不起。如果宇宙处于危险之中，我就必须走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fine. Then the truth is? Ironically, I can't predict the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。那事实是什么？讽刺的是，我无法预知未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't want to leave. So what do you want me to say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不想离开。所以你想让我说什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: After this conversation? I'm thinking not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 经过这次对话之后？我在想我不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If I could, of course. Why would you assume otherwise?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我能回来，当然会。你为什么会有其他的想法呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...don't think anybody's ever worried about *me* before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……觉得以前没人担心过*我*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Remember, *I'm* the better fighter, here. I don't need saving.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 记住，*我*才是这里更厉害的战士。我不需要被救。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That might be the...sweetest thing I've ever heard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这可能是我听过的……最甜蜜的话了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not that you're worried about me--I don't want that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是因为你担心我——我不想让你担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right, let's start over. Can you tell me what's really bothering you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我们重新开始。能告诉我真正困扰你的是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, let me know when you figure it out. I'm done with this conversation. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，等你想清楚了再告诉我。我不想再谈这件事了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But that you *care.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而是你真的*在乎*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't promise I'll always make it back alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不能保证我每次都能活着回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I can promise I'll fight tooth and nail every single time to do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我保证，我每次都会竭尽全力这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I would fight tooth and nail to make it back to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会拼尽全力回到你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Meh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My home is here, with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的家就在这里，和你在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. And that's just...how it goes, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。有时候事情就是……这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The good news is, I'm really hard to kill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好消息是，我不容易死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then I vow I will always fight tooth and nail to come back to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我发誓，我会竭尽全力回到你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...don't know what to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……不知道该说些什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't do this to you. I can't. We need to end this now. [Break up with Arthur.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不能这样对你。我做不到。我们现在就了结这段关系。[与亚瑟分手]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You better thank the Void every damn day you wake up that you're so damn cute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你最好每天醒来的时候都感谢虚空，让你这么可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not the begging type, but... I might to avoid this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是那种会求人的人，但……我可能会为了躲过这个话题破例。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I suppose I've dodged this long enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想我已经躲这个话题够久了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's never a good time. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 永远不会有好时机。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I ask you enough about your past. It's only fair, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我问了很多你过去的事。我猜，你问我这个也算公平吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah... yeah. It's time. You deserve to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊……对。是时候了。你有权知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If it finally gets you off my back about it, great.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 要是告诉你之后，能让我摆脱你追问的话，那就太好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've been up my ass about Duviri this whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你一直在逼我说双衍王境的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, well, you don't like talking about YOUR dirty laundry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是，对啊，你不也不喜欢聊*你的*那些丑事吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's what this is about, isn't it? Finding my weak spot? Finding what's *wrong* with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是你想要的，不是吗？找出到我的弱点？找到我哪里*不对劲*？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why do you think I've been avoiding this conversation for so long, Arthur?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，你以为我这么久一直躲着不聊这个话题是为什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not doing this. I just can't. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不会说的。我做不到。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I'm ashamed of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我对此感到羞耻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because it hurts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为它让我很痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I hate everything about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我讨厌关于它的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Shit, don't make me cry, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 妈的，亚瑟，别让我掉眼泪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, but once you know, I'm afraid that might change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，可一旦你知道真相，我担心这一切都会改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, but once you know, I'm afraid that might change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，可一旦你知道真相，我担心这一切都会改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I can't do this. I just can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我做不到，真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Promise?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 保证？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... I just can't do this, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……我做不到，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To end it with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为了离开我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To make yourself look good with the others. Bring me down a peg.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为了让你在别人面前显得高人一等，把我拉下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... yeah, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……是的，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly? I'm not so sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说实话？我不确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I can't do this. I just can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我回答不了，就是不能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That once you learn the truth, you'll... be disgusted by me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一旦你知道了真相，你就会……对我感到厌恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That once you learn the truth, you won't respect me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一旦你知道了真相，你就不会再看重我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I can't do this. I just can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我做不到，就是做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To make yourself look good with the others. Bring me down a peg.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为了让你在别人面前显得高人一等，把我拉下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know. Blackmail?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也不知道。情感勒索？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的……对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I dunno. You seem to be itching for a fight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。你看起来像是在找架吵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That once you learn the truth, you'll... be disgusted by me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一旦你知道了真相，你就会……对我感到厌恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That once you learn the truth, you won't respect me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一旦你知道了真相，你就不会再看重我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I can't do this. I just can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我回答不了，就是不能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Orowyrms. Not dragons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是奥金魇龙。不是龙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Duviri is messed up, Arthur. Really messed up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 双衍王境一团糟，亚瑟。真的很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 随便你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's what I'm trying to get at here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我想表达的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Whatever you think happened in Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管你认为双衍王境发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's worse than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 实际情况比那还糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Orowyrms. Not dragons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是奥金魇龙。不是龙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't need your help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's just not something I like to talk about, even with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这事我不太想谈，即使是跟你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're right. Rip the bandage off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得对，还是直接揭开伤口吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's just not something I like to talk about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是我不太愿意提起的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're right. Rip the bandage off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得对，还是直接揭开伤口吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't need your help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm gonna hold you to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会让你兑现的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mmm, shitty Y2K beer...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，难喝的千禧年啤酒……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not responsible for what happens when I get drunk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对自己喝醉后发生的事一概不负责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, but they don't talk about the screaming, do they?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，不过他们没说过会痛得让人大叫吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right. Well, here we go...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。嗯，那就来吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're no fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你真是无趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was hoping you'd forget what we were talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我还希望你能忘了我们刚才聊的内容呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I've been avoiding this like the plague, you're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起，我一直像躲瘟疫一样在逃避这件事，你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I just really can't do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起，我真的做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I've been avoiding this like the plague, you're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起，我一直像躲瘟疫一样在逃避这件事，你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just really can't do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真的做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You just understand why I've been avoiding it, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你明白我为什么一直在回避这个问题，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It doesn't mean I have to like talking about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这并不意味着我会喜欢谈论这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know the top-level story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道最基本的情节。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've told you the surface level shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我已经告诉过你表面上的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Cursed orphan winds up in an alternate reality.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 被诅咒的孤儿流落到另一个现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Abandoned by the Void. Abandoned by the Orokin. Abandoned by *everyone.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 被虚空抛弃，被奥罗金抛弃，被*所有人*抛弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Trapped in a storybook, the stories that others told them plucked out of their mind by the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 被困在一本故事书中，那些别人告诉他的故事，被虚空从他的脑海中夺走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: A reality created from the stories in their head, abandoned by everyone except the stories themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是一个根据他脑海中的故事创造的现实，除了故事本身，被所有人遗弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Surrounded by *fake* trees and *fake* buildings and *fake* skies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 周围全是*假的*树、*假的*建筑和*假的*天空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And those stories that were buried so deep in that orphan's mind, they wanted to be friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那些深藏在孤儿心底的故事，渴望成为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At first, they were that orphan's best friends. Playmates. "Let's go on adventures!" they cried.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 起初，他们是那个孤儿最好的朋友、玩伴。"我们去冒险吧！"他们喊道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The orphan could have given up their fear, their sadness, their anger, their envy, their false joy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那孤儿本来可以放弃他的恐惧、悲伤、愤怒、嫉妒和虚假的喜悦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So the orphan embraced them. But it wouldn't last.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 于是孤儿拥抱了他们。但这并没有持续太久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At least... at first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少……一开始是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But instead, the orphan clung to the only thing they had. Even though it wouldn't last.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但相反，这个孤儿却紧紧抓住了他唯一拥有的东西。即使它不会长久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Little by little, that orphan grew up. And their fake best friend became their fake worst enemy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 渐渐地，那个孤儿长大了。而他那个假想好朋友变成了他最大的假想敌人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because that's the thing about Duviri. None of it's *real.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为在双衍王境，没有什么是*真实的*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, sure. You can take things from it. You can taste it. Smell it. It can make you bleed. Make you die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，当然。你可以从中获取东西。你可以品尝它。闻它。它可以让你受伤，甚至死亡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But none of it matters. None of it changes. It's all a lie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这一切都不重要。没有什么能改变。这一切都是谎言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It is, though. Because this is what I've been avoiding saying:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但它确实是。这正是我一直在逃避的话：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All of the fear? All of that twisted terror that screams and cries at every shadow?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所有的恐惧？所有那些对每一个影子都尖叫和哭泣的扭曲恐怖感？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All of the sickening false "joy" and beauty smeared on top of it like a bad birthday cake?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所有令人作呕、虚假的，就像难吃的生日蛋糕上糊着的劣质糖霜一样的"喜悦"和美丽？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All of that horrid envy and jealousy that poisons everything around it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所有那些可怕地腐蚀着周围的一切的愤怒和嫉妒？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All of that rage, that hatred, that burning anger?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所有那些愤怒、仇恨、燃烧的怒火？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The crushing sorrow that made me want to do nothing but sink to the bottom of an abyss?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那种让我只想沉入深渊的压抑悲伤？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All of that suffering, all of that endless pain, and death?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所有这些苦难、所有这些无尽的痛苦和死亡？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That lashes out at everything and everyone around it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那些攻击周围一切和所有人的行为？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Covering the warts and the rot underneath? Trying to hide what it really is?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 遮盖了下面的肿瘤和腐烂？试图掩饰它的真实面目？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That wants to have what everybody else had? A normal life? A family? Friends?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 渴望拥有别人拥有的东西？一个正常的生活？一个家庭？朋友？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That wanted nothing more than to rip the sinew from the bones of the people who had hurt me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只想将那些伤害我的人抽筋剥皮？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To fall on my own sword, if it wouldn't have been pointless?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 要不是毫无意义，甚至让我想一死了之？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All those insipid courtiers and all the endless executions they put me through?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所有那些无聊的朝臣以及他们对我无休止的处决？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It comes from MY head. It isn't just a product of the book, Arthur. It's from ME.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 全都源自我的脑海。亚瑟，它不仅仅是那本故事书的产物，它来自我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I did it to myself... all of it. Over, and over... and over... and over...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这一切……都是我自己造成的。一遍……一遍……又一遍……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Until it just... took it all away. Until I couldn't feel any of it anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 直到一切……被抹去。直到我再也感觉不到任何情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Until feeling nothing was better than feeling anything at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 直到什么都感觉不到变得比感觉得到任何东西更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It was so bad, Arthur, I began to forget. Forget who I was. What I was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，这太糟糕了，我开始忘记了。忘记了我是谁。忘记了我是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Where I came from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 忘记了我从哪里来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe I thought, deep down inside, if I forgot about the people I blamed for putting me in Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许我内心深处觉得，如果我能忘记那些我认为把我送入双衍王境的人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe I thought, deep down inside, if I forgot that Duviri was really all my fault?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许我内心深处觉得，如果我能忘记双衍王境真的全是我的错呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe I thought, deep down inside, that if I forgot everything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许我内心深处觉得，如果我能忘记这一切呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe then, it'd end... one way or another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许，一切就会结束……无论以什么方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If it weren't for Lotus and Teshin...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果不是 Lotus 和 Teshin……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd still be there. A shell. A ghost. Empty. Forgotten and forgetting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我可能还困在那里。只是一个躯壳，一个幽灵，空虚的存在。忘记一切，也被一切遗忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, yeah. You can argue with me about it all you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，没错，你可以尽情反驳我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So when I say "Apathy is worse than anything else." That's what I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以当我说"麻木比任何事情都更糟糕"时，这就是我的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But that's why apathy is worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这就是为什么麻木更糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And why I'll never give up fighting it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也是我永远不会放弃与之抗争的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And you know what's really weird? I go back. I go back all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道真正奇怪的是什么吗？我一直会回去。我总是回到那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I feel like I have a duty to those people there. They... they exist because of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我觉得我得对那里的人负责。他们……他们因为我而存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: As busted as it is, as messed up as it sounds, it's the only real home I've ever known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 尽管那里一团糟，听起来很混乱，但它是我唯一知道的、真正的家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nothing works out your anger quite like smashing up a place that you know resets constantly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有什么比摧毁一个你明知会不断重置的地方更能平息你的愤怒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now that I know I can leave it... feels almost... fun again. I can find the joy in it again. As twisted as that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在我知道我能离开它了……又开始感觉到……有趣了。我重新找到了其中的快乐。虽然这听起来有些扭曲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There. That's the story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 故事就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ta-Da. The End.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好了，讲完了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你还在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ugh, I think I'm going to cry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呜，我觉得我快哭了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Is that what you wanted to hear? You happy now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是你想听的吗？你现在开心了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How could I not? I literally made the place out of my own emotions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我怎么可能不自责？那个地方几乎是我用自己的感情创造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, well. We all have our shit to deal with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，是啊。我们每个人都有自己要处理的烦恼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, you don't... think less of me, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你现在……会对我印象更不好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're going to make me cry again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你又要让我哭了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. That means... more than you can imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。这对我来说意义重大……大到超乎你的想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, Arthur. That means... more to me than you can imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，谢谢你。这对我来说意义重大……大到超乎你的想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now I need a damn drink.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我现在需要喝一杯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But maybe if that was the worst of it, being abandoned?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但如果被抛弃才是最糟糕的部分？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And the orphan, so scared, and so sad, and so angry, and so envious of those who got away, was eager to pretend to be joyous...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而这个孤儿，虽然感到非常害怕，非常悲伤，非常愤怒，非常嫉妒那些逃脱的人，却热切地假装喜悦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And the orphan, so scared, and so sad, and so angry, and so envious of those who got away, was eager to pretend to be joyous...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而这个孤儿，虽然感到非常害怕，非常悲伤，非常愤怒，非常嫉妒那些逃脱的人，却热切地假装喜悦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sorry, handsome. Another time. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，帅哥。下次吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can't chat right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在没空聊，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To be fair, I've been doing the same thing to you about what made me, me. Duviri, and all...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说句公道话，我对你也做了同样的事，关于那些塑造了我的经历、还有双衍王境的一切……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Talking about the dark parts of our past isn't easy or fun for anybody.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谈论我们过去的阴暗历史对谁都不是易事，也不好玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. About time you man up, cowboy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊。牛仔，该是你表现得像个男人的时候了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Cracking beer.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *开啤酒中。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Take the time you need. I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 慢慢来。我在这等着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Eleanor told me her half of the Christopher story already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 埃莉诺已经跟我讲过她那段关于克里斯托弗的事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She makes it sound like you both lost someone special.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 从她的话里听起来，好像你们都失去了一个很重要的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it sounds like you both lost someone that meant a lot to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但听起来像是你们俩都失去了很重要的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ruggedly handsome, sexy, superhero?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 英俊帅气、性感、超级英雄的样子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Toaster oven? :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 变成了烤箱吗？:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The word is 'warframe.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 叫做"战甲"的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You. You're just YOU. Inside. Where it counts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你现在的样子。你就是你。内在的你，才是最重要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Christopher? Eleanor told me some of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是克里斯托弗吗？我听埃莉诺提过一些他的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What happened to him isn't your fault, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，发生在他身上的事不是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yikes... I'm so sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎呀……我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm so sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真的很遗憾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He must have really meant a lot to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他对你来说一定非常重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What happened next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 接下来发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm so sorry, Arthur...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，我很抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No one wins in war. No one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在战争中没人是赢家。没有人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... never really had anyone to fight for. Not until recently. One reason they call me 'Drifter.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……我从来没有真正为谁而战。直到最近。这是他们叫我"漂泊者"的一个原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've run out of imaginary beers to drink. I kind of need a real one, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的幻想啤酒都喝完了。现在得来一瓶真的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... yeah. But. That was... heavy. Drinks? You and me? Then we go find a quiet place to talk in person?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……是的。但是，那……太沉重了。喝一杯怎么样？你和我？然后我们找个安静的地方面对面地聊聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We've both lost things, yes. But look at how much we've found. Friends. Family. Each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的，我们两个都经历了失去。但看看我们都获得了什么。朋友。家人。彼此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You lost... one guy? All this was about *one* guy? I was expecting something way more dramatic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就因为失去……一个人？所有这些都是为了*一个*人？我还以为会有更戏剧性的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Look at what we've been able to do here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 看看我们在这里都实现了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't say I blame her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这也不怪她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No kidding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一点也不奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么好吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ah. Yeah. Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 啊。对。是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Grow up, Arthur. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，成熟点。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh...
You sound thrilled.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你听上去很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对不起？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I had to follow my heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我得遵从自己内心的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, grow up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢，成熟点吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Jealous?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嫉妒了?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I figured you didn't have feelings for me in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我以为你不喜欢我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do my best not to screw this up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力不把这件事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What if I said my relationship was a lie, and I still had feelings for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我说我的恋情是假的，其实我还是喜欢你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, well, I got sick of waiting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，是啊，我厌倦了等待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, it's you I really have feelings for... I just gave up hope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我真正喜欢的人是你……我只是失去了希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My relationship is real. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的关系是真实的。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah...?
I mean, I can have feelings for more than one person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是说，我可以同时喜欢很多人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know you and Aoi used to be more than friends...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道你和碧以前的关系不止是朋友……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know you and Aoi are friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道你和碧是朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do my best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不敢保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do my best not to screw this up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力不把这件事情搞砸。
