/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What if I said my relationship was a lie, and I have feelings for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我说我的恋情是假的，其实我喜欢你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're the one I *really* have feelings for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是我真正*喜欢*的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey Arthur. How's it hanging?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿！亚瑟。最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What're you up to today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你今天要做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Busy, sorry. I'm sure you can handle it. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很忙，抱歉。我相信你能应付的。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's going on?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know how to tell you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道怎么跟你说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's the accent. It's irresistible. :3
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就是这口音。太难抗拒了。:3

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: LOL! Blame it on the accent?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈！是口音的魅力？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll deal with this, don't you worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我来处理，你别担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She's not going to drop you into a portal, I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她不会把你丢进传送门里去的，我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She knows it's not going to go anywhere. We've talked about it. It's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她知道那个到不了哪里去的。我们说过的。没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She wanted me to tell you that she thought you were cute, but only *after* she made it to the future. But, she keeps making the trip back to keep the timeline stable. So... it's probably fine? LOL.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她想让我只在她到达未来以后告诉你，她觉得你很可爱。但是，为了保持时间线的稳定 她一直在往回赶。所以……应该没问题吧？傻笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, A?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚亚怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's up, sweetheart?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 宝贝怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, A?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 老亚，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're pregnant?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你怀孕了？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you breaking up with me...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你要跟我分手吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Take your time - I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 慢慢来——我在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Weirder things've happened...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 更离谱的事都发生过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Albrecht didn't tell you..?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特没告诉你吗......？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Joking! Joking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 开玩笑的！开玩笑的啦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那，谢谢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Where's this going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你想说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm *still* not forgiving you for that spaghetti, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我*还是*不能原谅你做的那个意大利面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That...means a lot, thanks Arthur. And it's mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这……对我很重要，谢谢亚瑟。而且我也有同感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, I've just been fooling you this whole time. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，我这段时间都在忽悠你。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think I know what you're going to say. Want me to go first?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想我知道你要说什么。要我先说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: (That's a heart btw)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: （对了，那是一颗心）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wait. I was just joking! [Apologize.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 等一下。我只是在开玩笑！[道歉]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, chill out, dude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，哥们，冷静点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think we should just be friends. [Break up.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想我们应该只做朋友。[分手]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I love you, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think we should just be friends. [Break up.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想我们应该只做朋友。[分手]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: lolol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just teasing. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是在逗你呢。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're making me fall asleep over here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你把我弄得快要睡着了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you mean here in 1999, or in a broader sense?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你指的是在 1999 年，还是更广义上的意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: "Us," meaning?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "我们"是指？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At first, I thought he was making me "spare" warframes in case mine didn't come through the Helminth. Now, I'm not so sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一开始我以为他是在给我做"备用"的战甲，以防我的战甲没能撑过 Helminth。现在我不太确定了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just wish I knew what he was up to. Or what his motivations really were, behind making more protoframes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只希望知道他在做什么。或者他创造更多原型战甲背后的真正动机是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know, honestly. I don't trust him as far as I can throw him. And without a warframe, my throwing arm is shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我不知道。我压根就不相信他，能把他扔多远就信多远的那种。再说了，要是没有战甲，我这胳膊根本扔不动东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. We can't trust his motives any more than we can trust his methods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我们既不能相信他的动机，也不能相信他采取的方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. I don't agree with his methods all the time. But yeah. He wants to stop that thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可以。虽然我并不总是认同他的做法。但是，可以信任他。他想阻止那个东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He's trying to put the genie back in the proverbial bottle, if it can be done. And it's a messy process.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他已经在试图挽回局面了，如果能实现的话。而这本身是一个混乱的过程。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But we don't really have a choice, do we? All me and the kid can do is follow after him, cleaning up his messes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我们真的没得选，不是吗？我和那个孩子能做的就只有跟在他后面，帮他收拾残局了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now that Kaya's got her own take on time travel, it might get easier for me to go back and forth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在卡娅对时间旅行有了自己的看法，我来回穿越可能会变得更容易些了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm staying here, so it's up to the kid, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过我要留在这里，所以现在就靠那个孩子了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: An emoticon! :D
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 竟然是个表情符号！:D

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't go getting all sappy on me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别对我这么煽情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I'm flattered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我要飘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What makes you say that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你为什么会这么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, you might be right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，你可能是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Could that just be wishful thinking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那会不会只是你在一厢情愿？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I wish I knew, on both fronts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这两个问题，我也想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes it's hard to think that you're no longer "important."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候，真的很难接受自己已经"不重要"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I'm just saying that... maybe you don't want to feel abandoned by him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我只是想说……也许你只是不想感觉到被他抛弃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe he needs an army? Maybe he's trying to find "the one thing" he thinks can defeat the Indifference. Maybe a lot of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许他需要一支军队？也许他正在努力寻找他认为能够战胜虚空无情之物的"唯一东西"。也许还有很多其他原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That whatever he was here for, that whatever he did to you, still matters. Is still valid. That it didn't fail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 无论他来这里是为了什么，无论他对你做了什么，那些都依然重要。依然成立。这一切并没有失败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then all we can do is be prepared if that happens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我们能做的就是做好准备，以防这种情况发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's possible. But Entrati also seems to be the kind of person to have contingency plans.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有可能。不过英择谛似乎也是那种有应急计划的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know. Minerva and Velimir were telling me about the... "Cold War?" Sounds like people built a lot of crazy weapons and then never used them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。米尼娃和维利米尔跟我提过……"冷战？"听起来那时人们似乎造了很多疯狂的武器，但从来没用过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And to be clear, you still matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我得说清楚，你依然很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And to be clear, you still matter to *me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我得说清楚，对*我*来说你依然很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I wish I could tell you. But I will do everything I can to stop that from happening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也希望我能告诉你。但我会尽一切努力阻止这种事情发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't think you're done yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你觉得你的使命还没结束？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But to think your story ends here, without a part to play in how it all ends? That sucks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但是一想到你的故事就此结束，而结局又没你的份？那种感觉真的很糟心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But maybe it hurts to think you've been replaced by Arthur 2.0 out there somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但也许让你感到难过的，是想到你已经被某个地方的亚瑟 2.0 取代。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But maybe you just want your sacrifices to still matter in a more cosmic sense?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但也许你只是希望，你的牺牲在宇宙层面上仍然有意义？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know. Minerva and Velimir were telling me about the... "Cold War?" Sounds like people built a lot of crazy weapons and then never used them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。米尼娃和维利米尔跟我提过……"冷战？"听起来那时人们似乎造了很多疯狂的武器，但从来没用过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's possible. But Entrati also seems to be the kind of person to have contingency plans.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有可能。不过英择谛似乎也是那种有应急计划的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then all we can do is be prepared if that happens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我们能做的就是做好准备，以防这种情况发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You might be right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你可能是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I really hope you're wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真希望你想错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll see what I can do. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我看看能不能帮上忙吧。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You 'n me both. And maybe Entrati while we're at it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们一起。顺便说一下，还要顺便捅英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You might be right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你可能是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I really hope you're wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真希望你想错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not a huge fan, personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就我个人而言，我不太喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Lizzie? How'd that go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 丽兹？聊得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sick of the Hex already?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你已经厌倦了六人组吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What insights did she have?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她有什么见解？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm glad you're making friends. lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴你交到了朋友。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've never really had that option.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我倒是从来都没得选。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. I get that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，我懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It also helps that some of them are a bit older and have military experience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们当中一些人年纪比较大，并且有军事经验，这也有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: About what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Whatever the guitar has told you is slander, I swear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我发誓，吉他告诉你的一切都只是诽谤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Am I in trouble?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我有麻烦了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... don't think we should get into this, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，我……我想我们还是别谈这个了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's nothing personal. It's mostly because I keep screwing up trying to date your sister. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 并不是针对你。主要是因为我跟你姐姐约会时总是搞砸。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, Arthur... that means more to me than I think I can really express.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，谢谢你……这对我来说很重要，重要到超出了我的想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I wish I had your kind of level-headedness, sometimes. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我希望有时候我能有你这样冷静的头脑。 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许过会儿吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Meet you there. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 到那儿见。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like, children's toys? Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 像是儿童玩具？当然了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What... kind of toys?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么样的……玩具？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just giving you a hard time. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 刚才只是想逗逗你而已。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What brought this on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么突然说起这个了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What did you grow up playing with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你小时候都玩什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We have different names for the games we play, but I definitely had toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们玩的游戏有不同的叫法，但我确实有玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, of course we do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有啊，我们当然有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, we don't. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我们没有。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All sorts of figurines, and stuffed animals, and blocks. Typical kid stuff.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 各种各样的小玩偶、毛绒玩具和积木。典型的小孩子玩意儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I had this one - I guess you could call it a figurine - of this Dax child, that, well, I named after a character in a book I had. Dominus Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我有这样一个——我想你可以称它为小玩偶——禁卫小孩，嗯，我用我一本书里的一个角色的名字来命名它。士魂大帝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not the best topic for me to discuss, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不想谈这个话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's all right. It's not your fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没关系，这不是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We had all the normal toys you'd expect, I suppose. Blocks, stuffed animals, figurines, dolls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想，你能想到的普通玩具，我们都有。积木、毛绒玩具、小玩偶、洋娃娃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know. We all have to grow up sometime. We can't hide ourselves away with make-believe. I learned that the hard way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。我们终究要长大。我们不能用幻想来掩饰自己。我吃过不少苦头才明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think life can be ugly and painful and short. And we should fill it with as much fun, and laughter, and love as we can find.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我认为人生可以是丑陋的、痛苦的、短暂的。我们应该用尽可能多的乐趣、欢笑和爱来充实它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mine only became a little more problematic because of the whole... Void thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是我的玩具变得比较棘手，因为这一整个……虚空的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Is there a point you're trying to make?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你想表达什么观点吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think it's something you could get back, if you tried. Finding joy in toys and games, I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得只要你努力，就能找回。我的意思是，在玩具和游戏中寻找快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I haven't bought you any gas cans.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我还没有给你买过汽油罐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You deserved that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你活该。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The look on your face was incredible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你当时的表情简直绝了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_YUM>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, yeah, okay. You're forgiven. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好，好，我原谅你了。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没门。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's up, A?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么样，亚？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How's it going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mm, no, sorry. You're out of luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，不，抱歉。你真不走运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: LOL. Yeah. I'll be right there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。好的。我马上就到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sevagoth. He feeds on the spirits of the dead to come back to life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: Sevagoth。他以死者的灵魂为食，从而起死回生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nidus. Made of pure, unadulterated Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: Nidus。由纯正、不掺杂的感染者制成。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Kullervo. Stabbed through with his own knives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: Kullervo。被他自己的匕首刺穿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Xaku. Three warframes, fundamentally glued together, driven by void spirits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: Xaku。三款战甲，从根本上粘在一起，由虚空之灵驱动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Grendel. He eats people whole and dissolves them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: Grendel。他把人整个吃掉，然后把他们溶解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 请告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh? What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦？是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What he doesn't know *can* hurt him, right? <RETRO_EMOJI_COOLARMSUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他不知道，但还是*会*伤害到他，对吧？ <RETRO_EMOJI_COOLARMSUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: LOL!! I never thought about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈！！我倒是没想过这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At least they don't talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少它们不会说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At least these Infested things are on our side?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少这些感染的东西是站在我们这边的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You might just want to stick to the normal guns, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你还是继续用普通的枪好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ARTHUR WHY
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟，这是为什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The texture... dear Sol... the texture...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这口感……天……这口感……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: WHY WAS IT BOUNCY?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它为什么这么弹牙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why do you hate me...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你这是恨我吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: THERE WILL BE NO NEXT TIME
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不会有下次了！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Please have mercy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 求求你饶了我吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: NO MORE POISON
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别再给我下毒了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just... no gelatin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就是……别再放明胶了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hm? Oh, fine. You?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯？哦，很好。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mate, we just spoke an hour ago, about-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，我们一小时前刚聊过，关于——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It becomes a little less interesting when it's the same every-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没那么有趣，因为每次都——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What local sports-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么当地运动队——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's going on? You're acting strange.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 发生什么事了？你怪怪的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't believe you, I-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我才不信你呢，我——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: BROODSWORD?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 愁剑？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I do NOT brood!
... Fine. Fine. Maybe I brood a little.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……好吧。好吧。可能我有点愁吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just... get him to change it back, will you? Before anybody else notices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就……让他改回来，可以吗？在别人注意之前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That boy is the definition of idle hands... we need to get him more hobbies...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那小子就是游手好闲的典范……我们得给他找点爱好……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've never been called an "asshat" before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我以前从来没有被人叫过"二货"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sure I'll hear all your clever insults eventually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定迟早我能听遍你所有的俏皮话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I thought I'd experienced most of the world, until I met you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我本以为我已经见识过世界上的大多数事，直到我遇见你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nah. I've been called worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没事。我被骂过更难听的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: About what you said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 关于你说的那件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Seriously?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真是逗我玩的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...owe you an explanation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……欠你一个解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When I joined the ICR - even before then, I was a military man.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我加入国危部的时候——甚至更早之前，我就是个军人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've lived my entire life with one foot in the grave. I've always been as good as dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的一生几乎都是在死亡边缘徘徊。我一直活得如同行尸走肉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And it's never been more true than now. Look at me. I mean *look at me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这从未像现在这样真切过。看看我。我是说，真的*看看我*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not even *human.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我甚至不是*人类*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So...we've had a chance to get to know each other. We've grown a bit close, yeah? You...make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以……我们有机会了解彼此。我们已经变得比较亲密了，对吧？你……让我笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You make me smile more than I have in years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你让我笑得比过去几年都要多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But how can you want to be with someone...like me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但你怎么会想和一个……像我这样的人在一起呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Let me know if you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你改变主意了，告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And you've instantly made me regret this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你这话让我瞬间后悔了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Of everything that's happened in this cursed year, I never dreamed...never even imagined...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在这充满诅咒的一年中，我从未梦到过……甚至从未想象过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You really want to try this? Us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你真的想试试在一起吗？我们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's probably wise. Good call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这很明智。好主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Screw it. Let's do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 管他的。我们试试看吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What could possibly go wrong?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 能出什么问题呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never too busy for a birthday greeting, mate. Appreciate it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，再忙也不会忘了收生日祝福。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I do. Do you know what being ‘funny' is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道。你知道"有趣"是什么意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wonderful. Now I have two of you who won’t ever let that drop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 太棒了。现在我有两个人会一直抓住这件事不放了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks! Nice of you to remember. I might knock off half an hour early today. Not decided yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢！你还记得，真好。我今天可能会提前半小时收工。还没决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Look, I know you’ve been through a lot yourself, but there’s a time and a place for gallows humour.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听着，我知道你自己经历了很多，但是黑色幽默也要看时间和场合的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We’ve had some close calls, haven’t we? Thanks for having my back, today and every other day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们有过几次惊险经历，不是吗？感谢你今天和每一天的支持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey. You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can we talk about what you said earlier?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们能谈谈你之前说的那件事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 随便你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't sound too enthusiastic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你听起来不太愿意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't remember? How often do you go around confessing your feelings for people?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不记得了？你经常对人表白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I need you to level with me, smartass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别跟我耍聪明，给我说实话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Did you mean what you said? Yes or no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你当时说的是认真的吗？是或不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll cut you some slack because you've had a messed up life. I don't know why you said if you didn't mean it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 由于你过去的生活很复杂，我不会太计较。但我不懂你为什么要那么说，如果你不是认真的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not sure what I expected...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我当初到底是在期待什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But honestly? I don't care. Don't do it again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但说实话？我不在乎。以后别再这样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why're you embarrassed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你为什么尴尬？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll cut you some slack because you've had a messed up life. I don't know why you said if you didn't mean it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 由于你过去的生活很复杂，我不会太计较。但我不懂你为什么要那么说，如果你不是认真的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But honestly? I don't care. Don't do it again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但说实话？我不在乎。以后别再这样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Doesn't mean you can't be vulnerable. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这并不代表你不能表现出脆弱的一面。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I needed to think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我需要时间来考虑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't make my mistakes. Don't let yourself get cold.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不要重蹈我的覆辙。别让自己变得冷漠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And...that's part of what you've shown me since you've arrived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而且……这也是自你来到这里后，让我看到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How cold I've grown. How closed off. Even to my friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我变得多么冷漠，多么孤僻，甚至连对朋友们都是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You. Us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你。我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Things have changed. A lot. In such a short span of time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在这么短的时间里，一切都变了，变得太快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd be a fool not to let myself change with it. To not be willing to at least try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果不让自己随之改变，我就是个傻子。至少得试一试吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you arrived, I saw someone *just* like me - someone who wasn't really living, just surviving.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当你来到这里时，我看到了一个和我一样的人——一个没有真正活着，只是在挣扎生存的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then...I saw you come alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后……我看到你真正地活过来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because of us. Maybe even...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我们。也许甚至……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And that gave me hope. Hope I haven't allowed myself to have in a long time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这给了我希望。一种我很久没有让自己拥有的希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So...I had to think. And I'm sorry if that rubbed you the wrong way. But I had to let myself come to terms with the fact that, well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以……我需要时间去思考。如果这让你感到不舒服，我很抱歉。但我必须让自己接受这样一个事实，那就是，嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I feel the same way about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对你也有同样的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So. Shall we make this official? Make this a "thing?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，我们要不要正式确定关系？把这"事情"定下来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, then. Let's see where the future takes us, hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，让我们看看未来会如何发展，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can respect that. Let me know if you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我尊重你的选择。如果你改变主意了，告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Every time I think you can't get any more deranged...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 每次我都以为你已经够离谱的了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I, for one, am looking forward to it for the first time in...ages.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就我而言，我真的是很久没这么期待过未来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Always. Something the matter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 随时都可以。发生什么事了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ah. I can see where this is going. You have... feelings for someone else as well, I take it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 啊。我大概知道你要说什么了。你……也喜欢上别人了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Darling, do you honestly think I spent so many years in the military and haven't seen just about every kind of relationship there is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，你真的觉得我在军队待了那么多年，会没见过各种各样的关系吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If that's what you really want, then...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你真的想要那样的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you spend so much of your life nearly dying, you learn to appreciate what matters in life and what doesn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当你的人生长期与死神擦肩而过，你就会知道什么才是生命中真正重要的东西，什么是无关紧要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know how this'll work out. But you matter to me enough I'm willing to try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道这会怎么发展。但你对我很重要，我愿意尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I care about you. And if you care about them, then I care about them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在乎你。如果你在乎他，那我也会在乎他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just. Not. Not. Not inside the mall. All right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是。不要是商场里的人。好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Things are confusing enough as it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 事情已经够混乱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I hope I get to meet them someday. For... personal reasons, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我希望有一天能见到他。当然，这是出于……私人原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. And I hope I get to meet them someday. For... personal reasons, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。我希望有一天能见到他。当然，这是出于……私人原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just take care of yourself out there, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，在外面一定要照顾好自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey. I took your advice about Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿。我按照你关于埃莉诺的建议做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Better than I'd thought it would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 比想象中要好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Smartass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 牙尖嘴利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Turns out it was...a good idea, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 事实证明，这确实是个……好主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Debatable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那可不一定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just wanted to say thanks. It was a good idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说声谢谢。这是个好主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So...thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以……谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How in the ever-loving bloody hell did you convince *Quincy* of all people to speak to me on your behalf?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你到底是怎么说服*昆西*这种人出面替你跟我说话的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mm...hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯……哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Points for the surprise factor, I suppose. I certainly wasn't expecting that. And... very well. Apology accepted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可以算是因为这个惊喜加分吧。这确实出乎我的意料。而且……好吧。我接受你的道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I do have to admit you've been on my mind a great deal lately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不得不承认，你最近一直出现在我脑海里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You did have a shot with me, and you chose to walk away. But... Quincy was convincing. If you'd like to give this another go, I'm willing to give it a try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你本来有机会和我在一起，但你却选择了离开。不过……昆西的话很有说服力。如果你想再试一次的话，我愿意试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How about walking up to me in the Hub, and simply saying, 'mate, I have feelings for you?' Did that ever cross your mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你有没有想过在商场里，直接走到我面前对我说"伙计，我喜欢你"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you'd like to give this a go, I'm willing to give it a try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你想试试的话，我也愿意试试看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes I simply do not know what to do with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候我真是不知道要拿你怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. No point in fussing about it now. I... have to admit you've been on my mind. If you'd like to give this a go, I'm willing to give it a try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 算了。现在纠结这个也没用。我……不得不承认我一直在想着你。如果你想试试的话，我也愿意尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. Glad to have all that sorted then. Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好。很高兴这一切都解决了。那就开始吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...Has anyone ever told you, you are *proper* nuts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……有没有人告诉过你，你真是个疯子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What. Just like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么，就这么直接？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sweet Sol, you--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的天，你——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right. Stranded in an alternate dimension.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对。被困在另一个维度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're less used to "people" than I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你比我更不擅长和人打交道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you think I know you well enough to jump into that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你觉得我们认识得够久了吗，可以谈这些？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Going right into my deep personal history isn't the way to do it, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，直奔我的个人经历可不是建立关系的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, it's fine... go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不用，没事……继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ask some questions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问些问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know, ask questions?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不知道，问问题吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You have to buy a man a few drinks first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你得先请人喝几杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. At least you learn quick.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。你倒学得挺快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No skin off my back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你猜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 猜猜看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. No. But that's Eleanor's.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。错了。但埃莉诺喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nope. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不好意思。不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wrong. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不好意思。错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: On the first try, too. How'd you know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是第一次就猜中了。你怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or maybe it's purple?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许是紫色？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It changes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她变来变去的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Didn't figure you for the pedantic type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没想到你这么吹毛求疵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I'm not about to start unloading family history to you, so don't try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也不打算就这么把家庭史告诉你，所以别尝试了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't *know* you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我并不*了解*你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Huge loss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 损失巨大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something to work toward, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想这倒是个可以努力的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's red.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是红色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good eyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好眼力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: A long story for another day. After drinks. Anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个故事很长，总之，改天喝了酒再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Did this get you what you were looking for?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这下能满足你的要求了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now you're sounding like Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你现在听起来好像埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Dignified. Elegant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有威严。有风度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If it was, I'd never admit it. Luckily it isn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果是，我绝不会承认。还好不是它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How - no. Someone told you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么会——不。有人告诉你了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who told you?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁告诉你的？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What?! HAH!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？！哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's a *place,* not a name, you daftie!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那是个*地方*，不是人名，你这个傻瓜！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think I'm going to cry, I'm laughing so hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我都要笑出眼泪来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: PETERSHAM!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 彼得山！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's James, by the way. And thanks for the laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 顺便说一下，我叫詹姆斯。谢谢你带来的欢乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Let me put you out of your misery, or we'll be at this all day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 让我来结束你的痛苦，不然我们得耗上一整天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's James.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是詹姆斯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, well. Not like I chose it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯。我可没选这名字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Har har.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Roger that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 收到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's a big gap between "what's your favourite colour" and "tell me your family history."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "你最喜欢的颜色是什么"和"告诉我你的家族历史"之间隔着十万八千里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's a big gap between "what's your middle name" and "tell me your family history."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "你的中间名是什么"和"告诉我你的家族历史"之间隔着十万八千里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's a big gap between "what was your first pet" and "tell me your family history."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "你第一只宠物是什么"和"告诉我你的家族历史"之间隔着十万八千里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's a big gap between "ask me some silly questions" and "tell me your family history."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "问我一些蠢问题"和"告诉我你的家族历史"之间隔着十万八千里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Too soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 太快了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Valiant effort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 勇敢的尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: A fish named Murky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一条叫小脏的鱼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I put him in the tank, the water turned gray a minute later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我把它放进鱼缸，结果一分钟后水就变灰了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thought he was going to pop off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我还以为它快不行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Little bugger lasted thirteen years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没想到这小家伙居然撑了十三年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yes, I fixed the damn water.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我把那该死的水弄好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Couldn't be trusted with anything bigger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 更大的动物就照顾不了了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just wasn't that kind of kid, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我就不是那种孩子，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What're your thoughts about On-lyne?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你觉得线上时代怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Exactly! I just wish they'd STOP.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就是！我真希望他们能停下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The band that's everywhere you look.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个到处都能看到的乐队。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We clearly have different tastes in music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很明显，我们对音乐的品味不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just wish they'd STOP.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只希望他们能停下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you touch it I'll murder you in your Sol-loving sleep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你敢碰它，我会在你他妈睡觉时杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And no one will find the corpse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而且没有人会找到尸体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *No.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *不行。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How was I supposed to know?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我怎么知道？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What "winky face?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么"眨眼表情"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well...shit. I think I need to apologize to Aoi for...a lot. Be right back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯……糟了。我觉得我得为……好多事向碧道歉。马上回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because that thing is my pride and joy. And you'll take it and ruin it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为那东西是我的骄傲和快乐。你要是拿走了，肯定会弄坏它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sure it will be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我相信会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You might be a lot of things, Drifter. But at least you're not stupid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你或许有很多面。但至少你不笨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: [叹气声。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I came off harsh. Tell you what. When you get your own? We'll go riding together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我说话可能太冲了。跟你说啊。等你有了自己的摩托，我们一起去骑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They sound a lot better than those messed-up horses you mentioned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它们肯定比你说的那些破马要好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Where'd you learn to fight?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你在哪学的打架？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sounds like a great way to get killed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听起来很容易挂掉啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: In Duviri, in that loop you told me about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在双衍王境，那个你提到的循环中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol. I can understand that feeling, though I've never died.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天。虽然我从没死过，但我能理解那种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't, really...It's hazy. And I'm glad for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真的不记得了……记忆很模糊。这样也好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's not what I - whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是这个意思——算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How could you stop caring?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你怎么能不在乎呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's fair. How about we come back to it, should we get to that point?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有道理。如果我们谈到那个点，我们再继续这个话题好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, good talk, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好，那，聊得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hard pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 绝对不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Sounds like a hell of a tutor. And someone I'd like to meet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈。听起来是个很厉害的导师。是我想见见的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sounds like he gave you the push you needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听起来他给了你需要的推动力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We all need that person, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候，我们都需要那样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thrax was... a character from a story, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 士魂大帝是……故事里的一个人物，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But... why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但……为什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can I ask you a... potentially strange question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我能问你一个……可能很奇怪的问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...Right. Fair enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……对。有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, about your food...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，关于你的食物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You wish. No getting out that easy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你倒是想呢。没那么容易解脱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm curious why you cut it up into... perfect squares. Even the pizza.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我就是好奇你为什么要把食物切成……完美的正方形。连披萨也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Home?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 家？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The ship was your home?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那艘船就是你的家吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 聊得真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's fine. I've been there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没事。我能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sounds it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听来真复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I guess I could try making square spaghetti if you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，如果你想的话，我可以试试做方形意大利面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know how you feel. Routines can help you feel grounded, especially when everything's gone to shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我懂你的感受。日常的小习惯能让你感到踏实，尤其当一切都变得糟糕的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I tell you what - I make a mean cubed omelette.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我跟你说——我做的方块煎蛋特别好吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: On second thought, good call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我又想了想，你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Game on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're in for a treat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你要有口福了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So. How many of you are there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以。你们有多少人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That you know of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你只知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've been inside my head. I guess I'm curious to know more about what's going on inside yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你一直在我的脑海里徘徊。我觉得很好奇，想更多知道你脑袋里在想什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Have you met my sister? You've got nothing on her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你见过我姐姐吗？你根本没法跟她比。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nope. Still weird, and I still hate it when you say it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。还是很奇怪，而且你这么说的时候我还是很不喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She was only marginally more normal when we were children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们小时候她也只是稍微正常那么一点点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something to look forward to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这可真是让人期待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anyway. Seriously, how many of you *are* there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 话说回来。认真的，你们到底有多少人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't flatter yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别太自以为是了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Picture it. Drifters, as far as the eye can see...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 想象一下。到处都是漂泊者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Poor sods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真是些倒霉蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I repeat: Poor sods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我再说一遍：真是些倒霉蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Har, har.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈，哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can drink to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 冲这话我得喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Speak for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那只是你自己的看法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Absolutely not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 无法想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: HAH.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To be fair, I'm not sure I'd want to deal with a room full of Arthurs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说真的，我不确定我是否愿意和一屋子的亚瑟相处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, let's just hope we don't end up with Infinite Laundry, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，希望我们不会真的面对无尽的洗衣堆吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Bad enough we have to deal with Quincy's stinking up the joint...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 光是昆西那臭味就够让人受的了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All of us, glowering at each other in silence. Brooding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们所有人都默默地怒视着对方。陷入沉思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We'd at least get things done, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想至少我们应该能把事情做完吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You will never let me live that down, will you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就是不会让我过去这个坎，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. I suppose that's fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。那我就认了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Very true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 非常对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, yeah. Very funny.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对对。挺搞笑的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But you broke the cycle--the spiral.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但你打破了这个循环——这个复眠螺旋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You haven't had an easy time of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你过得还真不轻松。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're tellin' me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I could drink to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 冲这话我得喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd like to hear the story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想听这个故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like one of those colour-changing rings?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 像那种变色戒指一样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd take you up on that - sounds like a trip in more ways than one. If it weren't for...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会愿意去的——听上去像是一场特别的旅行。要不是因为……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mm, jury's out. I don't trust them. The rings, that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我持保留态度。我不太信任它们。我指的是，那些戒指。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We were told to trust computers, too - look how that turned out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们曾经也被告知要相信电脑——结果如何大家都看到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Duviri isn't real?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 双衍王境不是真实的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can see why you don't like to talk about this much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我能理解你为什么不太愿意谈论这个话题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why does that feel worse in its own right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为什么这本身就让人感觉更糟？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We've all met that old soldier, who died on a battlefield -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们都见过那种老兵，他们在战场上心死——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: - long before he stopped walking and breathing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ——早于他们停止呼吸和动弹之前很久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right. I forget. You carry yourself like one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对，我忘了。你自己就像个士兵一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. I guess you know some now, hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我想你现在该认识一些了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like you said. At least here, you're not alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就像你说的。至少在这里，你不是孤军奋战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Too True, Drifter. Too true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 太对了，漂泊者。确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sadly, most never do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不幸的是，大部分人都活不过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We'll do this another time, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，我们下次再说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My head hurts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的脑袋要爆炸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're starting to make a lot more sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我现在明白你为什么这样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Little by little.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一点一点地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well...
You're probably right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你可能是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol almighty, I hate it when you describe it like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的天，我真不喜欢你这样形容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol, you're bloody adorable sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天啊，你有时候真可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You come from the damn future, and you lose your mind over a cheap piece of colour-changing trash?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你来自那该死的未来，竟然对一件廉价的变色玩意着迷？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right. You know what? Let's talk about it another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对。这样吧？我们改天再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. I'm sure Amir knows where to find one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。我肯定阿米尔知道去哪找。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sadly, they're not my area of expertise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可惜这不是我的强项。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's... shockingly deep. And a good point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这真是……太深刻了。而且是很好的观点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: As for Duviri, let's talk about that another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至于双衍王境，我们下次再谈吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没什么了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What's it like, Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 双衍王境，是什么样的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 比如什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Soul-sucking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 灵魂被抽干？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Didn't you say it was a world from a book?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你之前不是说它是书中的一个世界吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm still really curious about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对此还真的很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have a hard time believing you ever gave in to apathy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很难相信你曾经屈服于冷漠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, apathy? It's hard to believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，麻木？真难以置信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fair. Another time, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 行吧。那，以后再说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: O...kay. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃……好吧。没事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, no no no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢，不不不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We are NOT doing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们别这么来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have a name already. And a lot of things are cuter than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我已经有名字了。还有很多东西比这可爱多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Bunnies. Puppies. Kittens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 比如小兔、小狗、小猫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Flirting to change the subject?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 用调情来岔开话题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nice tactic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好策略。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The flirting or the nickname?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 闹着玩的是调情还是外号？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Great. You're one of THOSE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很好。你就是那种人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fine, you can use it. Just...keep it between us, all right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，你可以用。但……就我们俩知道，行吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Was there something you wanted to talk about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有什么你想说的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Should've known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我早该知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ask. If I don't want to talk, I won't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问吧。如果我不想谈，我就不会谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Simple answer? Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 简单说吗？英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Simple answer? Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 简单说吗？科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ugh. Look, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。听着，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd... really rather not get into that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……实在不想深入讨论这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a long story. And it's not that I don't trust you, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这个故事很长。并不是我不信任你，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We've been through some strange things together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们一起经历过一些奇怪的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's just a difference between fighting beside somebody...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是和人并肩作战……这中间有差别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now you're getting it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在你上道了嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Smart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 聪明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can you be more specific?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你能说具体点吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Everybody thinks I'm in charge. Nope. I'm just the one they listen to. She's the real heart of the team.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 大家都以为我是老大。其实不是。他们只是听我的话。她才是团队的核心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We'd all be long dead without her. Including me. Shit, mostly me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有她，我们早就死了。包括我在内。该死，尤其是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, grow up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢，成熟点吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Way back. We served together in the ICR. She's my best mate. Couldn't do any of this nonsense without her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很久了。我们一起在国危部服役。她是我最好的朋友。没有她，我什么都做不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: International Crisis Response. The "peace keeping" unit that got us into this shithole mess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 国际危机响应部。正是这个"维和"部队让我们陷入了这场混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We've been friends for a long time. Closer for longer than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们是老朋友了。关系比一般朋友更亲密，而且时间更久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But if you're itching to ask more about our past, I'm going to have to stop you here. It isn't my story to tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但如果你想继续问我们的过去，我只能在这里打住了。那不是我能讲的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You'll have to ask her about it. But I'll warn you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你得去问她。但我得提醒你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just don't be wearing a whole lot of metal near any important body parts when you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问的时候身上最好不要带太多金属，特别是在重要部位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You'll have to take that up with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这个你得自己去问她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just a word of advice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 给你个忠告。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Be sure not to be wearing a whole lot of metal near any important bits when you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问的时候最好不要在身体重要部位带太多金属。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Some things aren't your business, you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有些事不关你的事，你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Me? I thought this was about Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我？我以为你在问碧呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never pictured you for a flirt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 从没想到过你会调情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Am I really that unapproachable?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真的那么不好接近吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wait. Don't answer that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 等一下。别回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like you wouldn't be able to figure it out, given enough time. We all live in the same bloody mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就算你现在搞不明白，给你足够的时间你也能猜出来。我们都住在同一个破商场里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh. Yes, I'm single.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哎。对，我单身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hah. Just. Let me ask. On the stubborn scale of 1 to 10, how screwed am I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈。我只是问一下。在固执的程度上，从 1 到 10，我有多糟糕？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Get in the queue with everybody else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你就排队吧，和其他人一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If I had any clue what literally any of that meant, I might know how to react.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我知道那些话都是什么意思，我可能会知道该如何反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So I guess I'll take it as a compliment and move on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以我猜我会把它当作赞美然后继续前行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Final warning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 最后警告。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Leave it alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别再问了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you wanna pry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你还想打听？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh good, I'm a target dummy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦好吧，我就是个练习用的靶子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If it really bothered me, you'd know. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果真的让我不舒服，你会知道的。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But if you've got to make an arse out of yourself, do it here. No need to make a fool of yourself in front of the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但如果你想出丑，就在这里出，不用在别人面前丢脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, no... he got you, too?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，不……他也缠上你了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yes, and before you ask me, I've already said no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的，在你问我之前，我已经拒绝他了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Pass, sorry. Better things to do in a warzone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不了，抱歉。在战区里还有更重要的事要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He's on that again? I thought he gave up after Quincy started using the figurines for target practice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他又来了？我以为在昆西开始用那些人偶练习射击之后他就放弃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't tell me. It's that Frogs & Follies thing again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别告诉我。又是那个什么古言与边界？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I have better things to do in a warzone. Sorry.
