/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在战区有更重要的事情要做。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We all have our own ways to unwind. Sorry. Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们都有自己的放松方式。抱歉。不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We all have our own hobbies. Pass, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们大家都有自己的爱好。不了，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hmm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right... fine. I'm in. Just to try it - no long commitments.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧……行。我加入。只是试试——不保证会一直玩下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If it gets *weird* I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果玩起来很*奇怪*，我就不玩了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ... Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. Hard no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不行。绝对不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Whatever you say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 随你怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Try again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 换一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Please give up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 请不要再说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, now I know you're pulling my leg.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，现在我知道你是在开玩笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What did you want?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你有什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You have a very odd way of letting a man know you find him attractive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你用了一种非常奇怪的方式来让一个男人知道你觉得他很有魅力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ask. Nothing's stopped you before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问吧。之前你也是想问就问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know, I know. And you've already tried.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道，我知道。而且你已经尝试过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... well, if you're serious, now's not the right time, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……好吧，如果你是认真的，现在可能不是合适的时机，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Bless your stubborn heart for consistency, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想，祝你那颗固执的心始终不变吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Rain check?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可以改天再说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right then. I'm going to go off and have a serious think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那好，我得去好好想一想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This time? No. But.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这次？没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But be honest, am I doomed here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但说实话，我这是不是没戏了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nobodies. It's my favourite colour, remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁的都不是。这是我最喜欢的颜色，还记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nobodies. It's my favourite colour.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁的都不是。这是我最喜欢的颜色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Leave it alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别管它了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't particularly care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是特别在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I get it. You're trying to make friends. Get to know me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我懂了。你是想交朋友，想了解我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I'm not making it easy on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我并没有让这变得容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There are some cans of worms I'm not bloody willing to open for you yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有些事我还真不愿意现在就告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is one of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是其中一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No need to apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不必道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没有不高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No grudges held. I'm not an easy man to get along with, sometimes. Sol knows a lot of people around here have learned that lesson...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也没有怀恨在心。有时候我不是那么好相处的人。天知道，这里很多人都已经学到了这一点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just not the easily sharing type. But maybe well get there, someday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是那种轻易分享的人。但也许有一天，我们会达到那个阶段。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The hard way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 艰难的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I get to be dramatic when I earned the sword by getting stabbed with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我被这把剑刺过，自然有权把事情说得戏剧化一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Courtesy of Doctor E. Ran me straight through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这要感谢英博士。他直接用剑刺穿了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I had stronger words for it at the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当时我说了更重的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But we'll go with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我们就这么说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anytime. Well, almost anytime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有事随时开口。哦，不过不一定每次都行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Knobhead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 笨蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Good to know. Something to look forward to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。知道了。有点期待了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Points for honesty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为你的诚实加分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ever sit there and think about how many people you've killed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你有没有坐在那里想过你杀了多少人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Whatever gets you through the nights, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想，任何能帮你熬过夜晚的方式，你都可以吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like counting sheep, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就像数绵羊一样，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. They don't promote soldiers for social skills.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。军队里的提拔可不看社交能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I played that game for a while. But they find a way in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我曾经有段时间也试着这样做，但总是会不自觉起这些念头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol, I feel that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天，我太能感同身受了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol, that's bloody adorable. Thanks for the laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天，这真是太可爱了。谢谢你让我笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I thought I did. Though I might be changing my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我原以为我需要。不过现在我可能改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Too kind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 过奖了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is the bit I never understood. How do you start talking about this kind of bullshit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我一直不懂的地方。你要怎么去开口聊这种无聊的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. We'll try this another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢了。我们改日再谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not sure I like it when you make sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不确定当你说得有道理时，我会不会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't do this today. But thanks. This...means a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 今天我做不到。但谢谢。这……对我很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Joined up with the ICR.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 加入了国危部。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: International Crisis Response.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 国际危机响应部。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Basically, a neutral, peace-keeping organization that's supposed to deploy military units as a last resort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 基本上，这是一个中立的维和组织，在最后关头部署军事单位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I lost the taste for serving in the Britannic army.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在不列颠尼克军队服役的生活感觉有些寡淡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I took offense to their methodology, let's say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可以说，我不喜欢他们的做事方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right, well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: HAH! Someday, I'll live that down. Not today though, I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈！总有一天我会摆脱这个梗的。不过今天还不行， 我觉得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fair enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hah!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, MRE's are pretty vile, but that wasn't why I left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，那些口粮确实很难吃，但我不是因为这个离开的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: (They make great explosives though - just don't tell Amir.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: （不过它们做炸药倒是挺不错的——别告诉阿米尔。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've been curious for a while about my army life. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你一直对我的军旅生活很好奇。为什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why're you asking about my army life?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你为什么会问起我的军旅生活？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right... right...
Well, next time maybe go for the weather.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，下次要不聊聊天气吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not a story I like telling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不太爱讲这个事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But...fine. You've been a good sport. I'll give you an inch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但是……好吧。你表现得还不错。我就透露一点儿给你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What do you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你想知道什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You got it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 正是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 确实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Everybody has their shit. Their painful shrapnel they'd rather not dig out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 每个人都有自己的烦心事，有些人宁愿不去触碰那些痛苦碎片。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Appreciate it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 感谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know you're not trying to be rude. Or pry for the sake of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道你不是在故意无礼，也不是为了打探隐私。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But digging out my painful shrapnel isn't exactly a pleasant conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但挖出我的那些痛苦碎片并不是什么愉快的谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know, and I still owe you that rain check.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道，我还欠你一次改天再聊呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just not the kind of man who rushes into these kinds of things -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是那种随便谈这些事的人——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... honestly had no idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……真的不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. That explains why you're so bloody nosy, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈。这就解释了你为什么这么他妈爱管闲事了吧，我猜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Look, I'm just not the kind of man who jumps into these kinds of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听着，我不是那种随便谈这些事的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Relationships, or painful stories about my past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如感情或我过去的痛苦故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Relationships, or digging out painful shrapnel from my past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如感情，或者翻出我过去那些痛苦的旧事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So you might just have to be patient. Or stubborn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以你可能需要多点耐心，或者更固执一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something tells me you might have those qualities, however.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我感觉你可能已经具备这些特质了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's fine. Everybody has their shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没事，谁还没有烦心事呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. I'm sure we'll get there. Just...not today.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。我相信我们会有那一天。只是……不是今天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这样挺好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Rain check?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 改天吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 两者都是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And if you don't want to be standing around waiting for me? I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你不想一直等着我的话，我理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol knows that won't be the first time that's happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天知道这已经不是第一次了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Exactly what it sounds like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就字面意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now you're getting it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在你上道了嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. I suppose if you're willing to stand around put up with me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。如果你愿意一直在这忍着我的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. It's fine. I'm not saying you can't ask. I'm just saying I might not want to tell you the answers just yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没事。我不是说你不能问，只是我可能暂时不想回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm learning that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我正在慢慢明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Try chatting about the weather next time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 下次试试聊天气吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know. And I'm not mad. I'm just not ready to spill, yet. Another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道。我没生气。我只是还没准备好吐露心声。下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right. Fine. What do you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，行。你想知道什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you enlist, you enlist to serve.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当你入伍时，你就是来服役的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text:
When you join the military,
you tend to do it for a reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当你参军时，往往是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Your Prince. Your Country. Your brothers & sisters in arms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为了你的王子，为了你的国家，为了与你并肩作战的兄弟姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And the innocents you're meant to be protecting in the first place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还有那些你本该一开始就保护的无辜百姓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But a funny thing happens, when people get into positions of power. The higher you go, the smaller people look.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有趣的是，当人掌握权力时，会发生一些微妙的变化。你爬得越高，别人看起来就越渺小。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The more people look less like themselves, and more like...dots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别人看起来越来越不像自己，更像是一个个……微不足道的小点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like numbers on a piece of paper. Like incidentals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就像纸面上的一串数字，无关紧要的杂费。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I got real bloody sick of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真的受够了这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text:
That's all you're getting.
 Today, at any rate. Not nearly drunk enough for the rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText:
只能告诉你这些了。
 至少今天是这样，反正我还没醉到能继续讲下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Won't say no to free beer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵，我可不会拒绝免费的啤酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Some people do it because they have nowhere else to go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有些人这么做是因为他们无处可去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Some for glory. Some for power. Some to feed the voice in their heads that says "kill."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有些人是为了荣耀，有些人为权力，还有些人只是为了喂饱脑海中那个喊着*杀戮*的声音。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Some are idiots who do it to be noble. To protect. To be heroes. Like me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而有些傻子是为了当什么高尚的人，去保护别人，去当英雄。就像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I figured the ICR might be a better place to scratch that itch than His Majesty's Royal Army.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我当时觉得去国危部可能比待在陛下的御用军队更能满足我的这种冲动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it was just more of the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 结果又是老样子，没什么不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, how'd you wind up in Duviri in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么，你最初是怎么来到双衍王境的呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I'm listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我听着呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm going to assume that's sarcasm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会当做你在讽刺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is a really uncomfortable topic for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这个话题让你很不舒服吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good thing I'm sitting, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那还好我正坐着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure. But I'm keeping you to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然。但你得遵守承诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you want to do this another time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们要不要改天再谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't I know it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这还用说吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很好的谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If the emotions are what hurts, keep it to the facts. Let's start there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果情感让你难受，那我们就从事实讲起吧。我们从这开始怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Look mate, if this is an uncomfortable topic, just say so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听着，伙计，如果这个话题让你不舒服，直说就好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I didn't say you were being - never mind. We'll do this another time, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没说你在防备——算了。我们改天再说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can I ask why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我能问问为什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Messy how? Body count?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 混乱到什么程度？有人死了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。我不喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm starting to figure that out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我开始明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But sometimes, turning these rocks over is how you learn to trust people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但有时候，挖掘这些事情有助于建立信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一言为定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We'll cover the squishy bits another time. Deal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 感性的部分我们留到下次吧。成交？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hell of a way to start. I don't disagree, mind you. But hell of a way to start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这开场真够劲爆的。我不是不同意你的观点，但这真是个劲爆的开场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... feel like I just opened a serious can of worms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……感觉我好像刚刚捅了虫子窝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 确实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你确实有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, it sounds like I owe you a drink...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，听起来我欠你一杯酒……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I feel like we'll be discussing this whole Duviri thing again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我感觉我们迟早还会再讨论双衍王境的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Although, maybe now we're even after that drink *you* owe *me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，也许现在我们算扯平了，毕竟*你*还欠*我*一杯酒呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: (I told Aoi to remind you, about my saving your arse.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: （我让碧提醒你来着，别忘了我救过你的命。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 总之。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm glad you two are making friends, but... either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴你们俩能成为朋友，不过……话说回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Although, maybe now we're even after that drink *you* owe *me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，也许现在我们算扯平了，毕竟*你*还欠*我*一杯酒呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: After whatever nonsense is going on between you and Aoi with some crack about On-lyne?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至于你和碧之间那些关于线上时代的乱七八糟事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Did you have family growing up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你长大的时候有家人在身边吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Eleanor. She's driving me up the wall and I didn't know how much you'd understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是因为埃莉诺。她快把我逼疯了，我不知道这种感觉你能理解多少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Had?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 曾经？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: AUGH. No. No, no, no! She's my SISTER!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天，不是，不不不！她是我*姐姐*！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't you DARE!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你敢乱想！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's more about what she's not doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实更多是因为她没做的那些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not looking for gossip, mate. Or to start any nonsense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是来打听八卦的，伙计。也不想搞什么事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm just worried about her, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我就是有点担心她，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: IN ALL THE NAMES OF SOL, STOP.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天呐，别说了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: AUUUGH!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 啊啊啊！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Sigh.* You have a sick sense of humour, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *叹气*。伙计，你这幽默感真让人无语。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right. Well, now that I've managed to scrub my brain down with bleach, it's more about what she's not doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对。好吧，我好不容易用漂白水洗了下脑子。主要是她不做的事让我很头疼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's an anniversary that we've...celebrated is the wrong word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有个纪念日，我们每年都会……不应该说是"庆祝"吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Commiserated. Every year.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 应该说是我们一起悼念。每年都是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And she missed it this year. She never does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但她今年却错过了。她从来不会这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not really my story to tell, it's hers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这其实是她的故事，不好由我来讲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks for all the "advice," mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，我谢谢你的"建议"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We lost someone who was important to both of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们失去了一个对我们都很重要的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She didn't forget.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她没忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It happens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这种事总是难免的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. And I honestly couldn't tell you why. Instead, I'm here talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有。说实话，我也说不清为什么。不知道我为什么反而在和你说这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe. Maybe it is time to move on from the past. Which is ironic, considering your situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许吧。也许是时候放下过去向前走了。一想到你的情况，倒也挺讽刺的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Well. Thanks, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。好吧。不管怎样，还是谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I will. Just... when I've had some time to think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 会的。只是……要在我有时间先想想之后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. Siblings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对，兄弟姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I meant more like siblings. Cousins. Etc.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是指像兄弟姐妹、表亲之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Let's trade hostage facts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们来玩"人质事实"交换吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. So. This is a game I used to play in the Britannic Army.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿。这是我在不列颠尼克军队时玩的一个游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You tell me an embarrassing fact about yourself, and I tell you one about myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你告诉我一个关于你的尴尬事实，我也告诉你一个我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We hold each other's facts hostage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们互相把对方的事实当作"人质"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hostage facts. It's a "trust exercise." I'll even go first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "人质事实"。这是一种"信任练习"。我甚至可以先来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 随便你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Here's mine: I own a teddy bear named Sebastian.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是我的：我有一只名叫塞巴斯蒂安的泰迪熊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now, before you get it in your head that I snuggle up with him at night, I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在，在你想到我晚上会抱着他睡觉之前，我可不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I found him on a mission, in a bombed out housing block, years ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是多年前在一个任务中，在一个被轰炸的住宅区找到他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I keep him on a shelf. And when I've got nobody else to talk to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我把他放在一个架子上。当我没人可以说话的时候呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I talk to him. Ratty old fella. Keeps me from going nuts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我就和他说。这个破破的小家伙。让我不至于发疯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't see why not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不觉得有什么不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，我懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Your turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 该你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Dear Sol... I think you misunderstood the assignment here, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的天……伙计，我觉得你可能把这个游戏理解错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But, uh - thanks for trying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，呃——还是谢谢你尝试了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊，是啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Should've known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 早该知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What do you do for hobbies out there in space? In the future?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在未来，你在太空里漂泊的时候都有什么爱好呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yes you, specifically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对，就是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm asking you, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我先问你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So sue me for showing a little interest in *you* for a change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别见怪，只是换成我对*你*表示一下兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Everybody's got something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 每个人总有点什么爱好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, hey. Look.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个，嘿，听好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm a pretty decent cook.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的厨艺还不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: LOOK. I said I was sorry!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听我说，我已经道歉了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What I'm trying to say is - would you like to learn to cook? It's a great hobby.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是——你想学做饭吗？这是个不错的爱好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, daftie. I'm offering to teach you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，傻瓜。我是要亲自教你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 随你便。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a plan, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就这么定了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Don't push your luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。别得寸进尺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm worried about Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在担心埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Try telling that to *her.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这话你跟*她*说去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know she knows, that's the damn *problem.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道她知道，这正是这个该死的*问题*所在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes, I'm not so sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候，我并不这么确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How do you help someone who can see past your words?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你会怎么帮助一个总能看穿你言语的人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just don't know how to help her anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是不知道该怎样继续帮她了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh for f-- I didn't mean that bloody literally, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，天——我不是真的让你去说，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, I don't mean that bloody literally, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对，我当然不是指字面上的意思，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When I need her to listen to reason, all she hears is *motives* and *feelings.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我希望她听听理性的话时，她总是听出*动机*和*感受*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We've always been on the same wavelength. Twins and all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们一直都很有默契。毕竟是双胞胎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You clearly haven't spent enough time talking to her, then. It's like she's got the bloody stage directions and I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你显然还没花时间和她聊过，和她交流就像是她提前拿了剧本，而我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Exactly. It's like she's got the bloody stage directions and I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对，就像她拿到了全部的剧本，而却我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's one thing when you're twins and share a wavelength. It's another thing when she's literally *in* your thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 作为双胞胎，有着相同的思维频率是一码事，但当她真的*进入*你的思维时，又是另一码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She can't help it. And right now, we're her only friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她也没办法控制。而且现在，我们是她唯一的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Go for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: AUGH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...no. I didn't think of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……没有。我没想到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm going to try that. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会试试的。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I admit that did make me laugh, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不得不承认，那的确让我笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, good job on at least cheering me up a bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，至少你让我高兴了一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I've tried that, but it doesn't work. She just shuts me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实我试过了，但没用。她直接把我拒之门外了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She's my sis. I can't just let her suffer. I'll think of something on my own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她是我姐姐。我不能眼看着她受苦。我会自己想办法的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And...now I feel like a total knobhead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而……现在我感觉自己真是个傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会去试试的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She's my SISTER you BLOODY PSYCHOPATH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她是我姐姐你这个死变态

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Forget I started this damn conversation!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我就不该提这个破话题！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She was born two minutes before me at a minute to midnight, and she thinks she's a hundred years wiser.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她出生在午夜零一分，比我早两分钟，她却觉得自己比我聪明一百岁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She's hurting. And she's alone. And when she's like that...she goes dark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她很痛苦，也很孤独。在这种状态下……她会变得很阴郁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I don't mean normal dark. "Crystals and cards and ghosts" dark. I mean *pit of the void* dark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是指一般的阴郁。不是像"水晶、塔罗牌和鬼魂"那种忧郁体验。我指的是*虚空之底*般的阴森。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I am. I can't lose her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的，我很担心。我不能失去她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I didn't even think about that...of course you can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我之前完全没想到……你当然能听到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Trust me, I know how proper tough she is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 相信我，我知道她有多坚强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anybody even half an ounce less capable would've snapped in half by now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 任何人的能力哪怕稍弱一点，现在都早就崩溃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe. But this is also something she's never had to deal with before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许吧。但她以前没遇过这种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I can't stand the idea of her dealing with this on her own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我实在不忍心让她自己承担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...No. I don't suppose as I have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……不。我想我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Is she...okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她……还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That is...very fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说得……很对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...Ouch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……扎心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deserved, but...ouch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虽然该这么说，但……挺扎心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hard to be the outcast amongst freaks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在一群怪人之中还被当作异类确实很难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd really rather not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我宁可不想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But point taken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过我懂你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What should I do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good idea. I'll try that. Thanks, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好主意。我会试试的。谢了，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Might be overdue for one of those. Thanks, friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许早该这么做了。谢谢你，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fair point. Thanks, friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有道理。谢谢你，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not so sure. I don't think any of us can understand what she's going through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不太确定。我想我们没人能理解她正在经历什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. That means a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。这对我来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Any words of ad vice for someone string down ternity in a sodding time loop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对那些被永远束缚在该死的时间循环里的人，你有什么建议呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, I am nt bloody *okay.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我一点都*不好*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: W ell?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯  ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't fragging patr
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 少他妈——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: patronize me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对我摆出一副居高临下的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Bugger off. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 滚开。闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ca n't   stop. Trid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 停  不 下来。式过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sod of, yu w anker.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 滚开啊，你个混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not drnk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没坠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: k mybe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 可  能有那么一点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ok fine
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧 有点儿

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: only way I feel up to tlking a bout it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只有这样我才会愿意去僚这事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: that's why I   you've been through this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是为什么我   你也是这么过来的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: i need to know about duviri. everything. I needto know what if felt like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我需要了解双衍王境。了解它的一切。我需要  弄清到底怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: wjat you went through
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你经历了甚么来着

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I kneed to know what's waiting for me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我膝要知道等待我的是什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: sod off I'm not scared
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 扯淡我才不怕呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: what? why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: the other tenno?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是指其他 tenno 吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: at what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对什么愤怒？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: sadness is a poison
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 悲伤是一种毒药

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: bollocks
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 胡说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: after everything yu told me you went through?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在你告诉我泥经历过什么之后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: apathy can't be worse than that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 麻木怎么可能比那更糟

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: apathy sonds like the only way to stay sane
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 麻木厅起来是保持理智的唯一方法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: waht?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 甚么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: i... oh. im way too drunk not to tyep something stupid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……哦。我醉得有点厉害，继续下去可能会打出些蠢话来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: we shoudl stop now, but...rain check.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们现在不应该再聊了，但是……下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: i... ur right
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……你说得对

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: shit, i need to go lie down. you're right. i'm too drunk for this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 见鬼，我得去躺着了。你说得对。我喝得太醉了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: an drifter? seriously, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 海有漂泊者？说真的，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: night
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 晚安

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: good advice
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好主意

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I am already regretting this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我已经开始后悔找你了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've been patient enough with me. If you still want that story of why I left the Britannic army... I probably owe it to you twice by now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你对我已经够有耐心的了。如果你还想听我为什么离开不列颠尼克军队的故事……我现在估计欠你两次解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Everybody joins the army for a different reason. For me, I joined for... honor. For purpose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 每个人参军的理由都不一样。对我来说，我参军是为了……荣誉、为了寻找意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I wanted to be a hero, like a Sol-damned fool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我那时像个该死的蠢货，想要成为英雄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Point being, I went in with big, grandiose ideas of what it meant to be a Soldier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，我抱着伟大的理想去参军。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To protect Prince and Principality.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 认为参军就是保卫王子和国家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I learned how much of a lie that really was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但后来我才知道那些全是谎言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Your role as a soldier isn't to THINK. It's to follow orders.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 作为一名士兵，你的职责不是思考，而是服从命令。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No matter what.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管是什么命令。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, when I got sent in behind contested lines and told to kill all "potential enemy combatants"?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，当我被派到敌占区，并被要求消灭所有"潜在的敌方战斗人员"时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I did what a good soldier does. I followed orders.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我做了一个优秀士兵该做的事。我服从了命令。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Doesn't take a genius.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这不需要多聪明就能猜到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know how many innocent lives we put in the ground that day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道那天我们杀了多少无辜的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it was too many.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但数量实在太多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When I went around demanding answers to why we'd just slaughtered innocents, the Brass threatened me with a dishonorable discharge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我四处质问为什么我们要屠杀无辜者时，上级威胁我要把我踢出军队。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Shut up. Do your job. Shoot your gun. Kill like a good soldier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 闭嘴。做好你的工作。开枪。像个优秀士兵那样杀人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't. Ask. Questions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不要。问。问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They were right. I shouldn't have been asking questions. I'm shit at getting to the bottom of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们是对的，我不该问问题。我本就不擅长弄清楚事情的真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, let me finish. I'M shit at getting to the bottom of a mystery. But you know who isn't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，让我说完。我很不擅长解开谜团。但你知道谁擅长吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And who worked as a Journo? And had connections to every major paper at the time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谁当过记者？而且当时和各大报社都有联系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So the deal was simple. Let me out on early retirement or the lid gets blown wide open. I wasn't important enough for them to care. They let me walk without a fuss after that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以很快就达成了共识：要么让我提前退休，要么把真相公之于众。他们觉得我无足轻重，不值得费心思。于是没怎么纠缠就放我走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I did. And fell into exactly the same naïve trap. I trusted leadership to care about civvies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。而且又掉进了同样天真的陷阱。我以为领导会在乎平民。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If I had a pound for every time Eleanor's said that to me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 要是每次埃莉诺跟我说这句话我都能得到一块钱的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Murder all possible infested innocents, no matter if it's true or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们要杀光所有可能被感染的无辜者，无论是真是假。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just...couldn't. And neither could the rest of the Hex. And so - here we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我就是……做不到。六人组的其他人也做不到。所以——我们就到了现在这个局面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now you really are starting to sound like her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你现在真的越来越像她了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: HAH.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The thing with twins, is that no matter how far away you get from them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 双胞胎的奇妙之处在于，无论你们离彼此多远，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Print that on a mug...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这话可以印在马克杯上了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They're still right there with you. Even when you're three thousand miles away behind enemy lines.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们始终都在你身边。即使你远在三千里外的敌军防线。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They find a way to weave their way into your lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们总会通过某种方式融入你的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll be all right. I always am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会没事的。我一向都能应付。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一直有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I appreciate that. It's a rough story. And one for another day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你。这是个沉重的故事，等下次再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. You're right. That was bullshit. But it's a story for another day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵，你说得对。确实是胡扯。不过这是下次再说的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, mate. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好嘞，兄弟。抱歉了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. Not right now. Sorry..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。现在不想。抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Eleanor.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *是埃莉诺。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, now I have the answer to why you're hanging around here so much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，现在我终于明白你为什么总是待在这里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you could simply just go back to the future and stay there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 明明你可以回到未来留在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know I've left you hanging, while I've tried to sort things out. But given our situation, I think I had every right to take some time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道我让你等得太久了，因为我需要时间理清一些事情。但以我们的情况来看，我觉得给自己一点时间是应该的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I suppose I'm surprised, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是感到有些意外，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I never said that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我从来没这么说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和碧感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和埃莉诺感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和阿米尔感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和昆西感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和莱蒂感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If any one of us idiots deserve to be happy, it's her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我们这些白痴中有谁值得幸福，那就是她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She deserves peace. I hope you can bring her some.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她应该得到平静。我希望你能带些给她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He could use the confidence having a partner can bring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有个伴侣可以给他带来自信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He needs to learn to let someone in now and then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他需要学会偶尔让别人进入他的世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She needs someone she can share the pain with. Not just physical, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她需要一个能和她共同承受痛苦的人，不仅仅是身体上的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All I can ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我唯一的请求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, do you just go about confessing your feelings to everybody and seeing who bites the lure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你就这样向每个人表白你的感情，然后看看谁会上钩吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Aoi *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对碧的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Eleanor *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对埃莉诺的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Amir *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对阿米尔的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Quincy *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对昆西的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Lettie *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对莱蒂的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because if any of us deserve to be happy, it's her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为如果我们这些白痴中有谁值得幸福，那就是她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because if you hurt her, I'm not responsible if she decides to scramble your brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为如果你伤害了她，她要是决定搞乱你的脑子，别指望我来管。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The last thing that man needs is to have his confidence in himself shaken again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他最不需要的就是再一次失去对自己的信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That man doesn't let people in. You screw that up, it might be the last time he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他不轻易对人敞开心扉。你要是搞砸了，可能这就是他最后一次这样做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because she hurts enough without you adding onto the pile, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，因为她已经够痛苦了，别再给她添堵了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So you're just stringing them along?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以你就这么吊着他们胃口？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I sincerely hope so. For all our sakes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真心希望如此。为了我们大家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh. And mate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢。还有伙计？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deplorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真可耻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure, but I can't. And I'm not comfortable with this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许可以，但我做不到。而且我对此感到不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You can forget about anything ever happening between us. We can stay friends, but that's all it'll be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就别再想着我们之间会发生什么了。我们可以当朋友，但仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sure you *understand.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我相信你*明白*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Should I be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我应该嫉妒吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和碧感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good to have that sorted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这下清楚了，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和埃莉诺感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和阿米尔感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和昆西感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和莱蒂感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She deserves peace. I hope you can bring her some.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她应该得到平静。我希望你能带给她一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He could use the confidence having a partner can bring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有个伴侣可以给他带来自信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He needs to learn to let someone in now and then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他需要学会偶尔让别人进入他的世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She needs someone she can share the pain with. Not just physical, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她需要一个能和她共同承受痛苦的人，不仅仅是身体上的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not jealous, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我不是嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sad, maybe. Watching you make her happy in a way I never could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许是有些伤感。看着你以一种我从未有过的方式让她开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But that's the thing. She's happy when she's with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但事实就是，她和你在一起时很开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If there's one of us knobheads that deserves to be happy, it's her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我们这些白痴中有谁值得幸福的话，那就是她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, do me a favour, if you could? Try not to break her heart if you can help it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，如果可以的话，请帮我一个忙吧？尽量不要伤她的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All I can ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我唯一的请求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deplorable. Stringing someone along like that - someone who trusts you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真可耻。这样吊着别人——而且还是一个信任你的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do you a favour and keep this between us, mate - in hopes that this is your dark sense of humor showing up again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，我就当帮你个忙，这事我们俩知道就好——希望这只是你的黑色幽默灵感再现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All I can ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我唯一的请求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Speaking of knobheads...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说到白痴……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Really? Why's it so important?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？为什么这么重要？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We have very different definitions of "fun." Sorry, pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们对"有趣"的定义大不相同。抱歉，不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah... that's fair. All right, I'll play. Count me in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯……也是。好吧，我玩。算我一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You kids enjoy yourself, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，孩子们，你们玩得开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At least for one night, to see how it goes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少先玩一晚，看看怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Answer me something, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，回答我一个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're free. You can leave. Go anywhere. Anywhere but *here.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你现在是自由的。你可以离开了。哪里都比*这里*好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We're the past. Dead and gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们已成为过去。死了也消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just pieces of a memory or bits of data in one of Amir's games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是记忆中的碎片，或者是阿米尔游戏里的一些数据而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We don't matter anymore. And maybe we never did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们已经不重要了。或许我们从来就没重要过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So I gotta know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以我想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Why would you ever keep coming back, when you had the choice to leave?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你明明可以选择离开，为什么还要一再回来？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh for Sol's sake...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真服了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Love, I'm being serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Only important person in a world of might-as-well-be-corpses? Charming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在一个全是行尸走肉的世界里只有你是重要的人？真够可以的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't put words in my mouth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不要曲解我的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then what *did* you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你*到底*是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol's sake, let that go! And don't change the subject.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的天，别再提这件事了！还有别转移话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You can do better than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你可以给出更好的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You have something I never have. Freedom.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你拥有我从未拥有过的东西。自由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are we like pets to you? Some sort of sideshow attraction maybe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 难道我们在你眼里只是宠物？或者是某种杂耍表演？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So what is it? Pity? Or are you stupid as well as crazy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以是因为什么？出于怜悯吗？还是你愚蠢又疯狂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Stop dodging! Why. Are. You. Still. Here?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别绕弯子了！你。为什么。还在。这里？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... sometimes try to find enemies where there aren't any. And I... didn't realize how much we meant to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……有时候会在没有敌人的地方设想敌人。而我……没意识到我们对你有多重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I owe you a pint, love. And one of those pizzas.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我欠你一杯啤酒。还有一份披萨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It isn't sad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这并不令人悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Okay, it's a little sad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，有一点悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I owe you an apology, love... And a pint.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但亲爱的，我欠你一个道歉……还有一杯啤酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... sometimes try to find enemies where there aren't any. And I... didn't realize how much we meant to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……有时候会在没有敌人的地方设想敌人。而我……没意识到我们对你有多重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How much I meant to you. And that's on me. C'mon. Let's go get a drink.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对你有多重要。这是我的错。来吧，我们去喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've got to go think for a bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我得去考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No - I mean - I need to go think. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不——我是说——我需要去想想。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How can you be telling me this, while you're stringing someone else along?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你怎么能这样对我说，同时又在脚踏两只船？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My temper's always been my worst enemy. Let me make it up to you over a pint?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的脾气一直是我最大的敌人。让我请你喝一杯啤酒来赔罪吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yep, sounds just like family to me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，听起来真像家人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Rich.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 搞笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Real rich.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真搞笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: After what you've pulled? That won't work on me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在你做过的那些事之后？那些把戏对我不管用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 再也不行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sod off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 滚吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's flattering...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这真让人受宠若惊……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But if you want to give this another go, we should talk this though in person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但如果你想再试一次，我们应该亲自见面谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you don't tell Eleanor soon, she'll find out on her own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你不尽快告诉埃莉诺，她自己迟早会发现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For your own safety I'd recommend telling her. But just so you know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为了你自己的安全，我建议你告诉她。但是你应该知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I accepted you leaving me for the better twin, but... this? There'll be no taking you back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我能接受你因为另一个更好的双胞胎离开我，但是……这种行为？我不可能再接受你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You need to tell Amir. It's not fair to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你应该告诉阿米尔。这对他不公平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He's got enough to cope with as it is without dealing with your games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他已经有够多事要处理了，不应该再被你的游戏所困扰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you know how rare it is for Quincy to trust someone? To really let someone in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道昆西信任一个人有多难吗？真正地接纳一个人有多难吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're proving all his worst suspicions about the world right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你正验证了他对这个世界最坏的猜想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Lettie's supposed to be with someone who helps share the burden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂应该和一个能帮她分担负担的人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not bloody add to the pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而不是他妈的增加她的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Aoi deserves better than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 碧值得得到比你更好的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You failed her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你让她失望了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deplorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真是可耻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How much I meant to you. And that's on me. C'mon. Let's go get a drink.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我对你有多重要。这是我的错。来吧，我们去喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey Drifter, I've been thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，漂泊者，我一直在想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, nothing bad this time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，这次不是什么不好的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I wanted to ask you something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我有事想问你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All those times you've flirted with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你之前跟我调情的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Were they just cheap lines?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那些话是随便说说的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Shit you said for a lark?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是闹着玩的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or did you mean it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你是认真的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks for the honesty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你的坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Is it all just good looks to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在你眼里，一切都是看脸的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then I suggest you spend your time talking to Quincy instead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我建议你还是去和昆西聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you're messing with me, I'll break both your damn ankles.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果你是在耍我，我会打断你的脚踝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The future has a sick sense of humour.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 未来的幽默感真是有毒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也有同样的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know I'm a tough read. I just...had to be sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道我很难读懂。我只是……需要确认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Three emoteethingies must mean something good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 三个笑脸脸一定是表示好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I never said I was always fun to put up with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我从没说过我是好相处的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Look.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 反正。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, yeah. So, fair warning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是，是。但我得先告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Relationships with men like me aren't easy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 跟像我这样的人交往不容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For a long time, I considered myself already dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很长一段时间，我都觉得自己已经死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And when I became infected, even more so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我感染之后，更是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But when I met you? I don't know. I felt, for the first time, like I really had someone who I could share the weight with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但遇到你后？我不知道。我感觉，我第一次感觉到有人可以和我分担重担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I felt like I could shut my eyes for even just a moment and everything would be okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我感觉我可以闭上双眼，哪怕只是一会儿，一切都还安好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: With you here, I can breathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有你在，我终于能喘口气了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I...find myself smiling more. Laughing more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而且我……发现自己笑得更多了。笑得更开心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I have you to thank for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是因为有你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So. I was wondering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以。我在想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Would you like to make a go at this? You and I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你愿意一起试试吗？你和我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yes, you utter berk. What did you think I was asking you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对，你这个傻瓜。你以为我在问什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thank you for reminding me why I don't bother with things like this anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你让我想起为什么我不再对这种事情上心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe someday I'll take you there. You'd love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许将来有一天我会带你去那里。你会喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And about my question. You and I. What do you think? Want to "date?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么回到我的问题。你和我。你觉得怎么样？想"约会"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You could've just told a man no, for Sol's sake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 看在太阳神的份上，你其实可以直接对我说不的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I respect that. No hard feelings. Let me know if you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我尊重你的选择。没事。如果你改变主意了，告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is going to take some getting used to, but...what's life without a bit of risk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这需要一些时间去适应，但是……人生不冒点风险又怎么称得上人生呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Though I feel like the others won't let me hear the end of this. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 尽管我觉得其他人会没完没了地讨论这事。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I believe I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我用了呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't make me regret this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别让我后悔做这个决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Anyway.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *不管怎样。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't quite know what to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该说些什么。
