/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Except that for the first time in a long time, I think I'm happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是，很久以来我第一次觉得自己是快乐的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, Sweets.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 宝贝，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know what? Let them. It'll give them something to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道吗？让他们去说吧。这也好让他们有事情做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sweets, can I ask you something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 宝贝，我可以问你一件事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Everything you've told me of the future...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你告诉我的关于未来的一切……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The Man in the Wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 墙中人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: Sentient。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Tau.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: Tau 星系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Someday - and someday soon, I feel like the future will need you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 总有一天——或许不久后的某一天，我感觉未来会需要你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm saying that sooner or later, you're going to go home and leave us here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是说迟早有一天，你会把我们留在这里，回到你自己的家园。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. I'm saying that I feel like it's inevitable. Someday you *will* leave.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。我的意思是我感觉这是不可避免的。总有一天你*会*离开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right. And someday you'll walk through that portal and never come back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 对。而且总有一天你会穿过那个传送门，然后再也不回来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you telling me that if "The Lotus" came calling, you wouldn't go running?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是说如果"Lotus"来召唤你，你不会去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You wouldn't charge off to save the universe again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不会再次冲出去拯救宇宙吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is a valid concern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是一个合理的担忧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Says common sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 常识说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not afraid. I was fine before you. I'll be fine after you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不害怕。在你之前我过得好好的，在你之后我也会好好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Either you get sick of us and leave, or something horrible happens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 要么是你厌倦了我们而离开，要么就是发生了什么可怕的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm being serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是在认真。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's not what I meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是那个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I want you to stay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想要你留下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I'm...worried someday you'll leave and...never come back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还有我……担心有一天你会离开然后……再也不回来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just...I have this recurring nightmare of you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是……总是做同一个关于你的噩梦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is called an adult conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是成年人的对话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, *sod off.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，*滚开*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm being serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You could disappear at any time. You could get sick of us or die. And I'd never know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你可能随时都会消失。你可能会厌倦我们或者死去。而我可能永远都不会知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And that's supposed to be enough?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就足够了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can you blame me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这能怪我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Intentionally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 故意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No...sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不……对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't deal well when I'm the one trapped in the past and you're the one rushing off into battle to save the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当我被困在过去，而你冲向战场拯救世界时，我真的很难适应这种情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We need your help with what? Viktor Vodiyanoi? Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们需要你来帮什么忙？维克托·维德诺伊？得了吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've seen what the future's up against.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我已经看到未来将要面对的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can handle some Techrot and some overzealous military goons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我能对付一些科腐者和一些狂热的军方暴徒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then I'll ask again. If you get pulled away: would you come back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我再问一次。如果你被拉走了，你还会回来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, better we end this now, rather than later, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我觉得，我们现在结束更好，而不是等到以后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Too much time expecting the worst of people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 总是把人往坏处想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm jumping at shadows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我总是胡思乱想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I just keep...having this nightmare, where you're gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是一直……做这样的噩梦，梦见你离开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Where I couldn't save you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 梦见我救不了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And... I can't stand the thought of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而且……一想到这种事我就受不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. Screw me for caring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊。怪我想太多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's the most a soldier - and a man - can ask for. Thanks, sweets.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是一个士兵——一个男人——所能要求最多的了。宝贝，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honesty. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很坦诚，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Would you come back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你会回来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. Better to find out this was a mistake *now* rather than *later.* I'm ending this between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。*现在*发现这是个错误总比*以后*才发现好。我要结束我们之间的这段关系了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But you're a soldier, like me. And sometimes soldiers don't come home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但你和我一样，也是一名士兵。有时候士兵是回不了家的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll hold onto the dream of retirement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会继续抱着退休生活的梦想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Yeah. I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。是的。我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I suppose it's hard to ever know how much time we have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想我们很难知道我们还有多少时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Best to just...cherish what we've got.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 最好是……珍惜我们所拥有的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Laying in a puddle of blood on some distant planet, killed by some...alien robot, or mutated...whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 梦见你在某个遥远的星球上，躺在血泊中，被某种……外星机器人或是变异生物……什么的杀死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I wouldn't have been there to save you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而我却无法去那里救你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And before you claim "I promise I won't go," you're lying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在你说出"我保证我不会去"之前，你就是在撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because I know you. And I know if you get that call, you're going. You'll do the right thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为我了解你。我知道如果你听到那个召唤，你一定会去。你会做正确的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's who you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就是那样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But the idea of it doesn't scare me. I'm not lying about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这种想法并不让我害怕。我是说真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because whatever the thought of you dying does to me, it's somehow far, far worse than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为无论想到你会死对我的影响是什么，它似乎都远远不止如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't even know if it has a name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我甚至不知道该怎么叫它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...yeah. You're right. This is for the best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……是的。你说得对。这样是最好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just tell me you'll try not to die out there. Or at least take me with you if you ever find a way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只需要告诉我，你会努力活下来。或者如果你找到方法，至少可以带我一起去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: First thing's first. You matter to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 重要的事先说，你对我很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You might die in the future, and I'd...never know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你将来可能会死，而我……永远不会知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's the most I can ask for. And maybe take me with you if you ever find a way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这是我最大的要求了。如果你有办法的话，也许可以带我一起去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, love. Is now finally a good time to talk about Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，亲爱的。现在终于是个适合聊聊双衍王境的好时机了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Drifter. Is now finally a good time to talk about Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，漂泊者。现在终于是个适合聊聊双衍王境的好时机了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I prefer "ruggedly handsome," but I'll take it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我更喜欢"粗犷帅气"这个说法，不过我就接受你夸我可爱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm almost tempted. Almost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我差点就动心了，就差一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know it's a rough topic, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道这不好聊，但……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That means a lot, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，这对我来说很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That means a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这对我来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I care about you. Deeply. And that's why I'm trying to learn the truth about this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很在乎你，非常在乎。这也是为什么我想了解这件事的真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You and I have been through a lifetime of madness in the relatively short time we've known each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们认识的时间不长，却仿佛一起经历了一辈子的疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It isn't to learn some dark terrible secret.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不是为了挖掘什么黑暗可怕的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I care about you as a dear, dear friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真的非常在乎你，我最最亲爱的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's because I see you hurting. I see you hiding. And it isn't like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而是因为我看到你受了创伤，我看到你在逃避。这不像你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's because I see you hurting. I see you hiding. And it isn't like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而是因为我看到你受了创伤，我看到你在逃避。这不像你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I want to help you. Thank you for letting me try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想帮你。谢谢你愿意让我来尝试这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I want to help you. Thank you for letting me try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想帮你。谢谢你愿意让我来尝试这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You "guess?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你"猜"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This isn't about fairness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这不是公不公平的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Love, last I checked, this is the kind of thing people in a relationship are meant to know about each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，据我所知，这种事是情侣之间应该彼此了解的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is about the fact that something about that place is eating away at you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 事实上，那个地方有些什么在一点点吞噬你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something about that place eats away at you. And I care about you - deeply. I'm not going to let you just wallow in pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那个地方有些什么在一点点吞噬你，而我真的很在乎你——非常在乎。我不会让你一个人沉浸在痛苦里的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You and I have been through a lifetime of madness in the relatively short time we've known each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们认识的时间不长，却仿佛一起经历了一辈子的疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Let me help you. That's what I'm sodding *here* for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 让我帮帮你吧，这就是我在*你身边*的意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And you're someone I consider a dear, dear friend. I want to help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是我最最亲爱的朋友，我想帮帮你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hah. That's how you're going to play this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈，你打算玩这招？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Love, we're together. We're supposed to know these things about each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我们是恋人，我们理应了解彼此的这些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Pardon me for being curious about the bloody *alternate reality* you come from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不好意思，我对你来自的那个该死的*另一个位面*真的很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You come from an *alternate reality.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你来自*另一个位面*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Dirty laundry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么丑事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Kind of a wild thing for a bloke to wrap his head around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这对一个普通人来说有点难消化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Kind of a wild thing for a bloke to wrap his head around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这对一个普通人来说有点很疯狂和难以理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: "Oh, yeah, I come from a storybook world with dragons that kept murdering me. Where're you from?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "哦，没错，我来自一个有龙的童话世界，那些龙一直在追杀我。你又是哪来的？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: "Oh, yeah, I come from a storybook world with dragons that kept murdering me. Where're you from?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: "哦，没错，我来自一个有龙的童话世界，那些龙一直在追杀我。你又是哪来的？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a normal thing for somebody to want to ask questions about, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这完全是正常人都会想问的问题，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a normal thing for somebody to want to ask questions about, let alone of somebody they're dating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这完全是正常人都会想问的问题，更别说是和你交往的人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You think this is about power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你觉得我问这些是为了掌控？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You think that's what this is about, love...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的……你是这么想的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Finding a crack in the armor to attack? Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 找你的破绽然后用这些来攻击你？我这样做是为了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Me, trying to find a crack in the armor, for... what reason?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我，试图找你的破绽……这又是为了什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't bloody know, love. That's what I've been trying to figure out!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我真的不知道。我一直在想弄明白这件事！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's what I've been trying to figure out!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我一直在想弄明白这件事！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What've *you* possibly got to be ashamed of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *你*有什么可感到羞耻的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Everybody has pain. And you're too strong to run from it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 每个人都有痛处。你足够强大，不要逃避它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hating what made you is so often shorthand for hating yourself, if left unaddressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果不加以解决，"讨厌"那些塑造你的事物往往会变成厌恶你自己的缩影。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So I won't accept that. Look at you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不接受这种说法。看看你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You blasted in here and steamrolled the Scaldra like it was nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你闯进来，不费吹灰之力就碾压了整个炽蛇军。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You keep the Techrot at bay without breaking a sweat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 轻而易举就抑制住科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You won our trust. And my heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你赢得了我们的信任，还有我的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You won our trust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你赢得了我们的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Wherever you came from, it made you a force of nature.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 无论你来自哪里，你都成了一股不可阻挡的力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: One I'm honoured to stand beside.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很荣幸能与你并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, if you do, I'll make sure to make it up to you later...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，如果你真的哭了，我以后会补偿你的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know. But that fear is in your head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道。但那份恐惧只是你心里的想法而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know. But that fear is in your head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道。但那份恐惧只是你心里的想法而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For how little time we've spent together, you and I have been through a lifetime's worth of nonsense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虽然我们在一起的时间不长，但你和我却仿佛经历了一辈子的荒谬事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's a new one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那是个新表情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now. Don't change the subject.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在。别转移话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you trust me, love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，你信任我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh. All right. Then, I think it's best if we take some time off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。好吧。那我们最好暂时分开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Think it over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好好想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd trust you with my life, Drifter. Sol knows I already have on more than one occasion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我愿意把命托付给你。天知道我已经不止一次这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Question is, do you trust me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问题是，你信任我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then that's that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I haven't slept better in years since you arrived. Since all this madness went down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在经历了那些疯狂的事情之后，你的到来让我这么多年以来第一次睡得这么香。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So stop swinging at shadows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以不要再乱发脾气了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You think I'm looking for reasons to break up with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你以为我是在找理由跟你分手吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If I wanted to end it, I'd just *end it,* love. I'm not the type to play mind games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，如果我想结束，我会直接*结束*。我不是那种玩心计的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something tells me I'm not the one you're fighting, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我有感觉你并不是在和我较劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Tell me you think better of me than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，你不会这么看我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good. Apology accepted. But I'm worried, love. You're lashing out like a wounded animal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很好。我接受你的道歉。但亲爱的，我很担心。你就像受伤的动物一样反应激烈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. If you're looking to give me a reason to end things, you just found it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。如果你想给我一个结束的理由，你已经找到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And that's not like you. I see someone I care deeply about in pain, and I want to help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这不像你。我看到一个我深爱的人处于痛苦中，我想帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm going to cut you some slack. This is clearly a rough subject for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会给你机会。这显然对你来说是个困难的话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What're you afraid of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你在害怕什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, love. Either lay it out on the table for me, talk me through what you're clearly so afraid of -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，亲爱的，要么把事情摊开来讲，告诉我你到底害怕什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or we walk away from this. This just became about trust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 要么我们就此结束。这事已经关乎到信任了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I watched you fall out of the mouth of some giant slime monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我见过你从一个巨大的黏液怪物的嘴里掉出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And we're still dating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们现在还在交往呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It takes a lot to disgust me, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，要让我感到厌恶可不容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it all comes down to one simple question. Do. You. Trust. Me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这一切归结为一个简单的问题：你。信。任。我。吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We all have darkness that follows us. In our past, in our minds...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们每个人都有自己的黑暗面，无论是在过去还是内心……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All right. Then neither can I. I'm sorry, we're done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。那我也做不到。对不起，我们结束了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol knows I have plenty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天知道，我自己也有很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Weakness isn't about having the darkness, it's about hiding from it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 软弱并不是指拥有黑暗，而是指逃避黑暗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then that's that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're grasping at straws.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你这是在乱猜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I haven't slept better in years since you arrived. Since all this madness went down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在经历了那些疯狂的事情之后，你的到来让我这么多年以来第一次睡得这么香。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So stop swinging at shadows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以不要再乱发脾气了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Something tells me I'm not the one you're fighting here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我有感觉你并不是在和我较劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good. Apology accepted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很好。我接受你的道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm always happy to go a few rounds in the ring. But believe it or not, this isn't one of those times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我通常很喜欢上场比赛几回合。但无论你信不信，这次不是那种情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I see somebody I care about in pain. A friend in need.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我看到我在乎的一个人在痛苦之中。一个需要帮助的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And you're lashing out at me like a wounded animal. And I want to know why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你像受伤的动物一样在冲我发火。我想知道为什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What're you afraid of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你在害怕什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I watched you fall out of the mouth of some giant slime monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我见过你从一个巨大的黏液怪物的嘴里掉出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: We all have darkness that follows us. In our past, in our minds...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们每个人都有自己的黑暗面，无论是在过去还是内心……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol knows I have plenty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天知道，我自己也有很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've seen Eleanor's tongue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你也见过埃莉诺的舌头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It takes a lot to disgust me, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，要让我感到厌恶可不容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Weakness isn't about having the darkness, it's about hiding from it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 软弱并不是指拥有黑暗，而是指逃避黑暗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it all comes down to one simple question. Do. You. Trust. Me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这一切归结为一个简单的问题：你。信。任。我。吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then that's that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is me, TRYING to get it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我这不就是在试着理解吗！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: SAME BLOODY THING.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不都是一样的东西吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Throw me a sodding bone, will you?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 能不能告诉我点什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: STOP DEFLECTING.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别岔开话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol knows I have the patience of a mountain, dealing with attitude problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天知道我对处理态度问题一直很有耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But this is getting real close to the line.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这次真的快触及底线了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Drifter, I'm worried about you. This isn't like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我很担心你。这不像平时的你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can you trust me enough to tell me how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你能信任我，告诉我到底怎么回事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I see a friend lashing out like a wounded animal. Someone I care deeply about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我看到一个朋友像受伤的野兽一样在发泄，一个我非常在乎的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Please tell me why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 请告诉我为什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They're the same bloody thing!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 它们都他妈的是同一种东西！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm doing my bloody damndest to meet you halfway here!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在尽最大努力来迁就你了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Stop deflecting!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别转移话题！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Love, I'm worried about you. This isn't like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我很担心你。这不太像你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're lashing out at me like a wounded animal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你像受伤的动物一样在冲我发火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Please tell me why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 请告诉我为什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What're you afraid of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你在害怕什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm going to say this in the most affectionate way possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我会尽可能温柔地说这句话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I promise I'll kiss it better once we're done...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我保证结束后我会亲亲它让它好起来的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I get it. Believe me. But I'll make sure to get you properly sloshed once this is over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我懂，真的。但等事情结束后，我肯定让你喝个痛快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Best way to do it, so they say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 据说这是最好的方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Bollocks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 胡说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Bollocks. When people say that, higher chances than not, they're lying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 胡说。当人们这么说，多半是在口是心非。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How do I know this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not if I hold you down first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我先把你压在身下的话就不行哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know for a fact that when people say they don't need help, they're almost always lying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很清楚，当人们说不需要帮助时，几乎都是在口是心非。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. That's a new one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。那是个新表情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not so bad...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也没那么难喝……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can take a punch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我挨得住一拳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No, they don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没错，没说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How do I know this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because nine times out of ten, I'm the arse saying it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为十有八九，说这话的人是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When it's all you've got.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当你没得选时。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ahem. Don't distract me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 咳咳，别打岔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because nine times out of ten, I'm the knobhead who's saying it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为十有八九，我就是说这话的傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't distract me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别打岔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then that's that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh. All right. Then, I think it's best if we take some time off between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。好吧。那我们最好暂时分开一段时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Think it over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好好想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Plenty of time for fun later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 后面有的是时间可以玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know. Good effort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道。不错的尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know this is a leap of faith. It's a lot to trust someone with something like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我明白这需要很大的信任，要把这样的事交给别人是个巨大的考验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, I suppose I'll ask the question outright.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，我还是直接问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you trust me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你信任我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then that's that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh. All right. Then, I think it's best if we take some time off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。好吧。那我们最好暂时分开一段时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Think it over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好好想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol above, I am the crowned king of avoiding talking about his problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天，我可是回避问题的高手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nobody likes talking about the things that hurt them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没人喜欢谈论让自己受伤的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。我明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're talking to the crowned king of avoiding the topic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你可是在跟个回避话题的高手聊天呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Then... trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那么……信任我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm here, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Tell me the Tale of Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 给我讲讲双衍王境的故事吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's not your fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这不是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm here, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我在的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol above... I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 太阳神在上……我在呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd be lying if I said you were the only one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我说只有你是这么想的，那我就是在撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. I'm not happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不，我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm heartbroken, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我的心都碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm heartbroken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我的心都碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... I had no idea you blamed yourself for what you went through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……我真没想到你会为那些事自责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. Don't do that. Don't dismiss this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。别这样。不要忽视这情感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You were a CHILD. Who was forced to hunt down their own parents.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你当时只是个孩子，被迫追寻自己父母的孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who was then left behind, all alone, to face *the Void.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 之后被留下，孤身一人，面对*虚空*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd wager good money that most grown adults - myself included - would crumple like a house of cards...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我敢打赌，大多数成年人——包括我自己——如果经历你所经历的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If we had to go through what you went through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 都会像纸牌屋一样倒塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You did the absolute best you could. You survived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你已经做得很好了。你活了下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And look what's become of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 看看你现在的成就。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Savior of the Origin System - or whatever it's called.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 始源星系的救星——或者别的什么名字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And the one I adore most in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也是这个世界上我最爱的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And one of my dearest friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也是这个世界上我的挚友之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The opposite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 恰恰相反。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The absolute opposite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 绝对的相反。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sometimes it's good for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时候哭一哭对你有好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I swear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or so Lettie tells me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少莱蒂是这么告诉我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I'm buying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这次我请。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh. All right. Then, I think it's best if we take some time off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。好吧。那我们最好暂时分开一段时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Think it over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好好想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Drifter. You around?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，漂泊者。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hey, Sweets. You around?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嘿，宝贝。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've been... I'm not the easiest man to get to know. You've put up with me dodging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道的……我没那么容易敞开心扉。你一直迁就爱逃避问题的我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, the point is, you've been waiting around trying to get the whole story out of me -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，重点是，你一直在这等着要从我这里得到完整的故事——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And immediately? I've changed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在嘛？我改主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: how I got here, how I got like this,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是怎么来到这里的，我是如何变成现在这样的，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: the rest of the story about this sword,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 关于这把剑的更多故事，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: and all the rest of this ugly mess...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 以及所有这些糟糕的事情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Pour yourself a cup of tea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 给自己倒杯茶吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or a beer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或者开瓶啤酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Actually, a beer would be best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实，啤酒可能更好些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll try to make this brief. Sol knows I don't want to dwell on this shit any more than I need to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我尽量说短点。天知道，我有多不想再谈这些破事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I told you why I left the Britannic Army. I never told you why I joined.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我告诉过你我为什么离开不列颠尼克军队。但我从没告诉过你我是因为什么加入他们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This skana of mine that you've asked after.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你之前问过我的这把空刃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The bandana I keep on my blade?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那条绑在我刀刃上头巾？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When I was a lad, there was a childhood friend a few years above Eleanor and I in school. Lived a few doors up the street.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 小时候，在我们学校，有一个比我和埃莉诺大几岁的朋友。就住在街上几户远的地方

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I got it when Entrati ran me through with it. Not long after he turned me into this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是我在英择谛用它捅穿我的时候拿到的，在那前不久，他刚把我变成……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Name was Christopher. He was always sticking up for the kids in the neighborhood who needed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他叫克里斯托弗。他总是为街区里那些需要帮助的孩子挺身而出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He was bigger, tougher - smarter. One of those blokes you'd want to push in front of a lorry if he wasn't so damned NICE all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他还要更强壮、更坚韧——也更聪明。这种人要不是因为他总是那么该死的和善，你真想把他推到卡车前面去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: In short? I bloody wanted to BE him, growing up. Followed in his footsteps any way I could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 简而言之？我小时候就超想成为他。尽我所能追随他的脚步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... can't thank you enough for being there for her. For finally being someone who might get her past what she lost on that terrible day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……真的非常感谢你一直陪在她身边。或许终于有人能帮她走出失去挚爱那天的阴影了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She... lost a lot more than me, that day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那一天，她……失去的比我多得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I told you how I got it. Entrati running me through with it. Not long after he turned me into this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我告诉过你我是怎么得到它的。英择谛用它刺了我一刀，就在他把我变成这个样子之后……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗨，谢啦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Har, har.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈，哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I... will never adjust to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……永远无法适应这个称呼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. I need to remember that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。我需要记住这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. That's how I got the blade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 总之。这就是我怎么拿到这把剑的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I dodged when you asked me about the bandana.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但当你问到那条头巾时，我回避了你的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it's not the blade that's important to me. It's the bandana.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但对我来说重要的不是剑，而是那条头巾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Christopher got it for me... as a gift for joining the Crimson Watch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那是克里斯托弗送我的……作为加入赤色守望的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There was... an old friend of mine, way back in the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很久以前，我曾经……有个老朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He was planning on giving it to me the night I got there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他本来打算在我到达的那天晚上给我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It was waiting for me... instead of him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 结果只有它在那里等我……而不是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It was meant to be a gift. He never got to deliver it to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那本来是要作为一份礼物的。他最终没能亲手交给我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know. But it is my duty to carry on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我明白。但继续前行是我的责任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: War takes the best of us away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 战争总是带走我们中最好的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He was a dear friend and I looked up to him like a big brother. I idolized him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他是我非常好的朋友，我一直把他当做哥哥来仰慕。把他当成偶像。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Christopher represented everything I wanted to be in this world - noble, heroic, self-sacrificing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 克里斯托弗代表了我在这个世界上想具备的一切品质——高尚、英勇、无私。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He was bigger, tougher - smarter. One of those blokes you'd want to push in front of a lorry if he wasn't so damned NICE all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他比我更强壮、更坚韧——也更聪明。这种人要不是因为他总是那么该死的和善，你真想把他推到卡车前面去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So when he went off and joined His Majesty's Service, as soon as he was of age? I was biting at the bit, waiting until I was old enough to do the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以当他一到法定年龄就加入了国王的军队时？我迫不及待，只盼着自己也能长大去做同样的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Imagine poor Eleanor, having to watch her fiancé and her twin brother go off to war.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 想象一下可怜的埃莉诺，不得不眼看她的未婚夫和她的双胞胎弟弟去参战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She never trusted authority. But after what happened to the two of us? She never would again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她从不信任权威。但在我们俩遭遇那些事之后？她更不会了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was lucky enough to call my idol my best friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很幸运能把我的偶像称为我最好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So when he went off and joined His Majesty's Service, as soon as he was of age? I was biting at the bit, waiting until I was old enough to do the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以当他一到法定年龄就加入了国王的军队时？我迫不及待，只盼着自己也能长大去做同样的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Never mind the fact that he...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 虽然他明明已经……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Look, Drifter... This part isn't my story to tell. It's Eleanor's. But I'll say this much. When Christopher went off to war?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 听着，漂泊者……这部分故事不该我来讲。这是埃莉诺的故事。但我要说的是，当克里斯托弗去参战时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I wasn't the only one upset to see him go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是唯一一个对他的离开感到难过的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: A great deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 非常重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Christopher had pulled some strings. Lined it up so that I'd be in the same regiment as him. 3rd Battalion, Crimson Watch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 克里斯托弗曾动用了一些关系，把我安排到他的那个团里。第三营，赤色守望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But one week before I got out there... there was an incident. Roadside bomb.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但就在我到达那里的前一周……发生了一个意外。路边炸弹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And like so many good men and women? Like so many good soldiers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就像许多优秀男女、好士兵一样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He became just another number on somebody's sheet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他也成为了某个名单上的一个数字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I was still a naive fool. And I, like an idiot, was all too eager to pick up the mantle he left behind...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我还是个天真的傻子。我像个蠢人一样，急于接过他留下的职责……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thank you for being there for her. For helping her heal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你一直陪伴着她，帮助她疗愈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You've helped me heal a lot of that old pain, by being here for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你一直陪伴着我，帮助我治愈了许多过去的伤痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But sometimes, an old ghost is a welcome one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但有时候，一个过去的幽魂是令人欣慰的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They remind us of why we're still here. Who we were before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们让我们记得为什么我们还留在这里。我们曾经是谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who we've lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们失去了谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And who we're still fighting for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们还在为谁而战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can't tell which one of us has had it worse. Both. Neither.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我说不清我们俩谁的经历更糟。两个都糟。或者两个都不糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You haven't had it much better than me, have you, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过你也没比我好到哪去，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Creations of war, just in different ways. We've both lost a lot in our lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们都是战争的产物，只是呈现的方式不同。我们的生命中都失去了很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Love, nothing would make me happier right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，此刻没有什么能让我更开心的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're right. Enough of this moody shit for one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得对。今天就不要再想那些烦心事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sod off, you utter wanker.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 滚开，你这个混账东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I suppose I shouldn't have expected you to stay single for long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想我就不该指望你会单身太久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你们俩感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What can I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我还能说什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, well. "Sorry" doesn't always cut it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，好吧。不过"对不起"可不总是有用的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm glad you finally did. Just wish you had the first time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴你终于这样做了。要是一开始这样做就好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I hope you find happiness this time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 希望这次你能找到幸福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, now I have the answer to why you're hanging around here so much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，现在我终于明白你为什么总是待在这里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you could simply just go back to the future and stay there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 明明你可以回到未来留在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know I've left you hanging, while I've tried to sort things out. But given our situation, I think I had every right to take some time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道我让你等得太久了，因为我需要时间理清一些事情。但以我们的情况来看，我觉得给自己一点时间是应该的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Should I be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我应该嫉妒吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I never said that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我从来没这么说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I suppose I'm surprised, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是感到有些意外，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和碧感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If any one of us idiots deserve to be happy, it's her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我们这些白痴中有谁值得幸福，那就是她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All I can ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我唯一的请求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和埃莉诺感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She deserves peace. I hope you can bring her some.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她应该得到平静。我希望你能带些给她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和阿米尔感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He could use the confidence having a partner can bring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有个伴侣可以给他带来自信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和昆西感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He needs to learn to let someone in now and then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他需要学会偶尔让别人进入他的世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I'm happy for you and Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过，我为你和莱蒂感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She needs someone she can share the pain with. Not just physical, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她需要一个能和她共同承受痛苦的人，不仅仅是身体上的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, do you just go about confessing your feelings to everybody and seeing who bites the lure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那你就这样向每个人表白你的感情，然后看看谁会上钩吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Aoi *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对碧的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because if any of us deserve to be happy, it's her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为如果我们这些白痴中有谁值得幸福，那就是她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Eleanor *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对埃莉诺的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because if you hurt her, I'm not responsible if she decides to scramble your brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 因为如果你伤害了她，她要是决定搞乱你的脑子，别指望我来管。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Amir *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对阿米尔的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The last thing that man needs is to have his confidence in himself shaken again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他最不需要的就是再一次失去对自己的信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Quincy *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对昆西的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That man doesn't let people in. You screw that up, it might be the last time he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他不轻易对人敞开心扉。你要是搞砸了，可能这就是他最后一次这样做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or are your feelings for Lettie *actually* legitimate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是你对莱蒂的感情*确实*是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Because she hurts enough without you adding onto the pile, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，因为她已经够痛苦了，别再给她添堵了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So you're just stringing them along?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以你就这么吊着他们胃口？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deplorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真可耻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure, but I can't. And I'm not comfortable with this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许可以，但我做不到。而且我对此感到不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I sincerely hope so. For all our sakes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我真心希望如此。为了我们大家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh. And mate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢。还有伙计？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You can forget about anything ever happening between us. We can stay friends, but that's all it'll be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就别再想着我们之间会发生什么了。我们可以当朋友，但仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sure you *understand.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我相信你*明白*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Good to have that sorted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这下清楚了，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not jealous, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我不是嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sad, maybe. Watching you make her happy in a way I never could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 或许是有些伤感。看着你以一种我从未做到的方式让她开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But that's the thing. She's happy when she's with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但事实就是，她和你在一起时很开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If there's one of us knobheads that deserves to be happy, it's her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果我们这些白痴中有谁值得幸福，那就是她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, do me a favour, if you could? Try not to break her heart if you can help it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，如果可以的话，请帮我一个忙吧？尽量不要伤害她的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All I can ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我唯一的请求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Speaking of knobheads...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说到白痴……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和埃莉诺感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She deserves peace. I hope you can bring her some.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她应该得到平静。我希望你能带给她一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和阿米尔感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He could use the confidence having a partner can bring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有个伴侣可以给他带来自信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和昆西感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: He needs to learn to let someone in now and then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他需要学会偶尔让别人进入他的世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和莱蒂感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She needs someone she can share the pain with. Not just physical, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她需要一个能和她共同承受痛苦的人，不仅仅是身体上的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: All I can ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这就是我唯一的请求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Deplorable. Stringing someone along like that - someone who trusts you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真可耻。这样吊着别人——而且是一个信任你的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll do you a favour and keep this between us, mate - in hopes that this is your dark sense of humour showing up again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，我就当帮你个忙，这事我们俩知道就好——希望这只是你又开了黑色幽默的玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm happy for you and Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我为你和碧感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I made the foolish decision to play Amir in Ollie's Crash Course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我做了一个蠢决定，和阿米尔玩《奥利的极速赛道》。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Quincy and I are about to go out on recon together. His idea, not mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我和昆西准备一起出去侦察。这是他的主意，不是我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And now I am deeply annoyed that he keeps beating my high score.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后我现在很气，他一直在破我的记录。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's strange, our relationship. We don't speak much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们的关系，很奇怪。我们说的话不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ... I have spent twenty six hours over the past two days playing this game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……我这两天花了二十六个小时玩这游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But we both know we'd die for each other if it came down to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我们都知道，如果真的到了那一步，我们愿意为彼此而死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Please get Lettie to tranquilize me if I go near that blasted thing again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 要是我再靠近那台该死的东西，请让莱蒂给我注射镇静剂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I guess sometimes, that's what family is, "innit?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想有时候，这就是家人的意义，"不是吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I need your help. I may have an emergency on my hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我需要你的帮助。我可能有个紧急情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Kaya is following me around. She will not leave me alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 卡娅一直跟着我。她不想让我走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Are you implying she - oh no. *Oh, no.* I thought I'd just made her angry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你是不是指她 - 哦不。*哦，不。*我以为我惹她生气了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Here I was thinking she was going to drop me through a portal into some other dimension!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我以为她要把我丢到通往另一个次元的传送门里去了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is *far worse.* This is all I need, some nineteen year old super-genius with a crush...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这*更糟了。*我现在最不需要的，就是某个 19 岁超级天才的暗恋……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm going to get my atoms split turned into some kind of black hole, aren't I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我身上的原子会被分裂然后形成某种黑洞，是不是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You around, sweets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You around, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There's something I need to tell you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我有件事要跟你说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Ugh. I've been trying to figure out how to do this for *days* now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉，我已经纠结了*好几天*该怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you arrived, I figured you were just another obstacle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当你出现时，我以为你不过是另一个障碍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just more bullshit for me to overcome, like everything else in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是我生活中需要克服的另一堆麻烦罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you had told me, that day we first crossed swords... how you would go on to change my life?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果那天我们第一次交手时你告诉我……你会改变我的人生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That you'd save my life? That you'd save ALL our lives?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你会救我一命？甚至拯救我们所有人？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd have laughed in your sodding face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我一定会当着你的面大笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What?! NO! How would that even --
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？！才不是！这怎么可能——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No! No. Absolutely not. I'm just...shit at expressing this kind of thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不！不。绝对不是。我只是……不擅长表达这种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't even want to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Don't distract me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 别打岔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ...... I am *really trying* to have a serious moment here...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……我是真的*很努力*在认真……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: When you arrived, I figured you were just another obstacle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当你出现时，我以为你不过是另一个障碍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just more bullshit for me to overcome, like everything else in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是我生活中需要克服的另一堆麻烦罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What I'm saying is,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想说的是，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm getting there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我马上就说到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There are very few times in your life you meet someone who understands you instinctually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 人生中能遇到一个可以本能地懂你的人真的很少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who gets you almost better than you get yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一个比你自己还了解你，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you had told me, that day we first crossed swords...how you would go on to change my life?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果那天我们第一次交手时你告诉我……你会改变我的人生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That you'd save my life? That you'd save ALL our lives?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你会救我一命？甚至拯救我们所有人？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Who knows how to tell you what you need to hear, not what you want to hear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 知道如何告诉你需要听什么而不是你想听什么的那种人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'd have laughed in your sodding face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我一定会当着你的面大笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What I'm trying to tell you is - thanks for being not just a friend, but being someone I can trust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我要说的是——谢谢你，不仅仅是作为朋友，而是作为一个我可以信任的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I'm not talking about the obvious -Albrecht and the Major and all the rest of that nonsense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不是说那些显而易见的事——阿尔布雷希特和少校以及其他那些荒唐事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not just to watch my back, not just to join the team, but... someone I can trust with my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不仅是在背后保护我，不仅是加入团队，而是……一个我可以托付生命的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm talking about something much more important. I'm talking about what you've meant to *me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我说的是更重要的事。我说的是你对*我*意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Shit. I. Sol above, I don't know how to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 该死。我。天啊，我不知道该怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I never thought it was possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我从来没想过这会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not like this. Not in a place like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少不是像这样。不是在这种地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sod. Off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 滚。吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This was a mistake. We're done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 真是个错误。我们结束了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And certainly not for someone like me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 尤其不是对我这样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But...Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但……漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Time you learned sometimes your sense of humour isn't welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你该明白，有时候你的幽默并不受欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: After all we've been through...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在经历了这一切之后……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 噢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I never thought it was possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我从来没想过这会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Not like this. Not in a place like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少不是像这样。不是在这种地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And certainly not for someone like me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 尤其不是对我这样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But...Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但……漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: After all we've been through...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在经历了这一切之后……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I love you, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我也爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I...all right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我……好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That's...unexpected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这真是……出乎意料。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But I suppose I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过我想我能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Better to end things now than to let things get more complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在结束总比让事情变得更复杂要好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If you change your mind, I...I'll be here, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，如果你改变了主意，我……我会在这等你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I thought this kind of happiness wasn't possible for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我曾以为我不可能拥有这样的幸福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thank you for showing me I was wrong, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，谢谢你让我明白我错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Here's to the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 为我们的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And here's to us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也为我们干杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, yeah. Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好，好。呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Anyway.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *总之。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Screw. You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 去你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm sorry it took so long to admit it. But I'm glad you're here. We'd all be dead without you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很抱歉我花了这么久才承认这一点。但我很高兴你在这里。没有你我们早就没命了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks. For everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你。为我们做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And whatever life brings our way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管未来如何？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know we'll handle it. Together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道我们能一起面对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh for the love of -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天啊——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah. Maybe you should.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是啊。也许你先来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've been thinking. How many more of us do you think are out there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我一直在想。你觉得还有多少像我们这样的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Both, I suppose. Here, now, in the past - in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想两者都是。此时、此地、过去——未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Protoframes. Here, or anywhere. Or any*when* I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 原型战甲。在这里，或者任何地方。或者，我想，任何时间都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Entrati made us with a purpose. With multiple purposes. It's clear it went past just the six of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 英择谛创造我们，是有目的的。带着多重目的。显然，他创造的远不止我们六个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It made sense when there were just six of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当只有我们六个人时，这听起来有些道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Do you honestly believe his real motivation is to stop the Indifference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你真的相信他的真正动机是为了阻止虚空无情之物吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Can we *really* trust him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们*真的*可以信任他吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And we're the school caretakers, scrubbing the floors after him. Lovely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那我们就像是学校的清洁工，帮他擦地板。真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That kid's a pain in the arse sometimes, but I do appreciate that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 那孩子有时候挺烦人的，但我确实很感激她所做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Eh. We'll see. I know you well enough, Drifter. And I know you don't know when to keep your head down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃。我们再看吧。漂泊者，我太了解你了。你总是不知道什么时候该低调。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's nice to know when you pop off to the shops... you might actually come back... :/
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这样挺好，能知道你只是去趟商店……知道你可能还会回来……:/

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's one of the reasons I put up with having you around. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这也是我愿意忍受你，把你留在我身边的原因之一。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's one of the reasons I adore you as much as I do. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这也是我这么喜欢你的原因之一。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I owe her a great deal, giving me some semblance of peace of mind. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我欠她很多，是她让我多少能安心一点。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Yeah, yeah. Don't go getting used to it. It still feels weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 是，是。别太习惯我用这个。还是感觉很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mm, you know me. Crunchy on the outside, squishy in the middle. Like a stale version of those horrid pastries Amir and Velimir keep going on about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，你知道我的。外脆里嫩。就像阿米尔和维利米尔一直念叨的那种难吃的甜点，还是变质的版本。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Tweebies?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好像是叫甜饼？
