/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Anyway. Back on topic. Sometimes I get this sinking feeling that Entrati has a bigger purpose for us all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好了，回到正题。有时候我总有种不祥的预感，觉得英择谛对我们所有人都另有所图。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The amount of effort he's put in to creating us? And the fact that there are more than just the six...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他为了创造我们付出了多少心血？而且还不止我们六个……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What do you think it is? And what is he waiting for?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你觉得他图的是什么？还有他在等什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You don't build weapons like these unless you know you're going to use them, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，你不会去制造这样的武器，除非你知道要把武器用在什么地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Unless you *know* there's going to be a war.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 除非你*知道*即将会发生战争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Right...
Can't help but think we're bullets in a gun. Meant to be used. Spent. And thrown away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 忍不住会想，我们就像枪里的子弹，注定要被使用，被消耗，然后被扔掉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fair counter point. But that's between countries, involving diplomacy. Moving parts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 反驳得有道理。但那是国家之间的博弈，涉及外交。有很多变数。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Agreed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Part of me does hope more of us exist out there. But if they do end up coming here? We might end up needing a bigger mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我内心深处是希望外面能有更多像我们这样的人。但如果他们最终都来这里了呢？我们可能会需要一个更大的商场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is between a literal god and a man who thinks he's one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而这是一位真正的神与一位自认为是神的人之间的博弈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know you will. And we'll face that day together, and I have confidence in that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道你会的。我们会一起面对那一天，我对此充满信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No. You don't build weapons like these unless you know you're going to use them, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不。伙计，你不会去制造这样的武器，除非你知道要把武器用在什么地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That might be a part of it. If the Indifference is a reason I'm like this? And had to go through this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这或许是原因之一。如果虚空无情之物是让我变成这样的原因？并且这是我必须经历的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Mate, I was ready to retire before I got sucked into this nonsense. Hardly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，我本来都准备要退休了，没想到竟然被卷入这种荒唐事。真是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe. Maybe not. But how many people's sacrifices mean nothing, in life? Most.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许是，些许不是。但在人生中，有多少人的牺牲是毫无意义的？绝大多数。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And hope that if any more of us show up here? We won't end up needing a bigger mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 希望如果有更多我们这样的人来这里，我们最后不会需要一个更大的商场吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My money is on an inevitable collision. I don't think their egos would allow otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我赌这场冲突是避免不了的。我认为以他们的自尊心，这件事注定不会有其他结局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I want a hand in bringing it down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想要亲手摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I am still astonished at your ability to utterly step in it, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时我仍然对你说错话的能力感到惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe I'm just mourning the idea of a whole army of us out there, being made by a madman with no clear idea why. Or what for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许我感到悲哀的是，我们这支军队竟然是由一个疯子制造出来的，根本不知道原因。或者说，为了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fair counter point. But that's between countries, involving diplomacy. Moving parts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 反驳得有道理。但那是国家之间的博弈，涉及外交。有很多变数。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Being told to suffer and being told to sacrifice - with no clear idea why. Or what for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 被告知要受苦，被告知要牺牲——却不知道为什么。或者为了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This is between a literal god and a man who thinks he's one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而这是一位真正的神与一位自认为是神的人之间的博弈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Part of me does hope more of us exist out there. But if they do end up coming here? We might end up needing a bigger mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我内心深处是希望外面能有更多像我们这样的人。但如果他们最终都来这里了呢？我们可能会需要一个更大的商场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Agreed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I don't want to be abandoned as a footnote in history. I want to put this skana straight up its arse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不想被遗忘在历史的脚注里。我要把这把空刃直接捅进它屁股里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Maybe that's the pill I'm having a hard time swallowing, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 伙计，也许这就是我难以接受的事实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For what it's worth? I hope I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，我希望我是错的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For what it's worth? I hope I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，我也希望我想错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: My money is on an inevitable collision. I don't think their egos would allow otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我赌这场冲突是避免不了的。我认为以他们的自尊心，这件事注定不会有其他结局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And hope that if any more of us show up here? We won't end up needing a bigger mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 希望如果有更多我们这样的人来这里，我们最后不会需要一个更大的商场吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There are no victors in war. Only survivors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 战争没有赢家，只有幸存者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now you're talking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这才对嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For what it's worth? I hope I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，我也希望我想错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: For what it's worth? I hope I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，我也希望我想错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Thanks, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There are no victors in war. Only survivors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 战争没有赢家，只有幸存者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Eh. We'll see. I know you well enough, love. And I know you don't know when to keep your head down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呃。我们再看吧。亲爱的，我太了解你了。你总是不知道什么时候该低调。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I found myself having a conversation with the guitar the other day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我前几天和那个吉他说话了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly, I rather like her. Once you get past the... oddness... of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 老实说，我挺喜欢她的。只要你克服了……那种……怪异的感觉……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Better than I would have thought. I rather like her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 比我想象的要好。我挺喜欢她的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Besides,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 再说了，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Since she and Eleanor seem to always be laughing at jokes that no one else can hear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她和埃莉诺似乎总是在笑一些别人听不到的笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I figured I ought to go introduce myself properly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得我应该去好好介绍一下我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: She has a lot of useful insights. And Flare is lovely. Honestly, that whole pack in the bar is a breath of fresh air.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 她有很多很有用的见解。弗莱尔也很棒。说实话，酒吧里那群人真是让人耳目一新。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. Proverbially.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯。只是打个比方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What? No! Of course not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 什么？不！当然不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Fascinating ones, regarding how many times the year has looped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 令人着迷的见解，关于这一年已经循环了多少次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I suppose it's just nice to have some folks around to talk to that I haven't been through so much with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想，能和一些没有一起经历太多的人聊聊天，也挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The Hex are my family. My team. You know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 六人组是我的家人。我的团队。你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: How many times I may or may not have forgotten years past. How she lives... outside of time? And how we do not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我或许忘记了多少次过去的岁月。但她是如何……超脱时间而活的？而为何我们却不是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not sure if that makes any sense at all. I know them, I trust them, I just haven't *been through hell and back* with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不知道这样说合不合理。我了解他们，也信任他们，只是我没有和他们一起经历过什么*地狱般的磨难*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And before you say anything, no. I don't want to know. It isn't my right to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在你开口之前，我先告诉你，不。我不想知道。我也没有权利知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So it makes it easier sometimes to just sit and drink with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以有时候和他们一起坐着喝酒反而更轻松。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I guess I just want to say - whether you have or not? It's okay. I won't hold it against you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说——不管你有没有？没关系。我不会怪你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This situation we're in? It isn't normal. We weren't meant for things like this - humans, I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们的处境？并不正常。我们，我指的是人类，本就不是为了这种事情而生的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I suppose not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There isn't so much... weight. So much past. Amir would call it baggage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没有那么多的……负担。没有那么多过去。也就是阿米尔所说的包袱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sol. Does it ever. Wasn't sure what to make of the Libertatians at first. But now? Quite glad they're here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 天。没错。一开始我还不知道自由国人是怎么样的。现在嘛？很高兴他们来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: There aren't guidebooks for this. Whatever you choose to do, I trust you to have good reasons to do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这种事情又没有指南。无论你选择做什么，我相信你都有充分的理由去做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it all got me thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但这一切让我不禁会想到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I trust you with my life. And nothing is going to change that. Even if I forget it for a little while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我把我的生命托付给你。没有什么能改变这一点。即使我暂时忘记了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I love you. And even if I forget that? Even if you choose to go another way? That's all right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我爱你。即使我忘了？即使你选择走另一条路？也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Hear me out. This is about you, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵。听我说完。这可是关于你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 想到你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Before you came here, I don't think I could have accepted that. I would have been too afraid to lose some part of myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在你来这里之前，我想我无法接受那种事。我会害怕失去属于自己的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Before you came here, I don't think I could have accepted that. I would have been too afraid to lose you. To lose this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在你来这里之前，我想我无法接受那种事。我会害怕失去你。失去这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And this whole... looping timeline. And it's got me thinking about how many 1999s I might not remember.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这一整个……循环往复的时间线。这让我不禁思考，有多少个 1999 年可能已经被我遗忘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I would have clung to it like a desperate man clinging to a raft at sea. But maybe I've been in this loop enough times now, or... maybe it's just you, I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想要紧紧抓住它，就像一个绝望的人在海上紧紧抓住木筏一样。但也许我已经陷入这种循环太多次了，又或者……也许只有你是这样，我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: This happiness you've given me now - this peace - is worth more in this moment than knowing it might last forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你给我带来的这份幸福——这份平静——此刻的它们的价值已经远超于它是否会永远持续下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Just wait a second, will you? You know I type slower than you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 等一下，好吗？你知道我打字比你慢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: If there's one thing in life you learn as a soldier, it's that everything is fleeting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 如果说作为一名士兵，你在生活中能学到的一件事，就是一切都是短暂的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What I'm trying to say is this:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想说的是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Here one second, gone the next. I guess I've just come to accept that. Once and for all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 前一秒还在，后一秒就过去了。我想我已经接受了这个现实。就这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Whether or not you've made me, or the rest of the Hex, forget our past interactions? It's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 无论你是否让我，或者六人组的其他人，忘记了我们过去的互动？其实没关系的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: So, whether our time together ends because you punch the floor and I forget everything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 所以，在你捶完地板，我忘记了一切之后，我们在一起的时光是不是也会随之结束？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I won't hold it against you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不会怨你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Or because the Indifference catches you off guard some day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 还是说我们的时光会因为哪一天虚空无情之物突然抓到你了而结束？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm going to enjoy this moment that I have. Here and now. Because it's what I've got.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我要珍惜当下。这里和此时此刻。因为这是我所拥有的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And that's what I know I can be sure of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这也是我唯一可以确定的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Har har. Well, it's a good thing you have a magical super power that allows you to remove your foot from where you've lodged it so spectacularly down your trachea, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。好吧，还好你有这种神奇的超能力，能把卡在气管里的脚复原，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Every now and then, I try to pull the stick out of my arse long enough to say something meaningful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 有时，我会试着不那么正经，说点有意义的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's more because I know I functionally have no other choice but to keep a stiff upper lip. Such is the Britannic way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 更是因为我知道，我实际上别无选择，只能强颜欢笑。这就是不列颠尼克人的行事作风。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The rest of us just have to learn how to communicate. Question, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我们其他人还需要学会如何去沟通。不过，这倒是个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I think it's time for a drink. Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我想该喝点东西了。去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like the old saying goes. "Keep Composed and Continue Forward."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 正如俗话说的，"保持镇定，继续前进。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Does she lower her standards with every reset?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 每次重置后她都会降低自己的标准吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 随你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Odd question. Do they have toys in space?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 问个奇怪的问题。太空里有玩具吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Heh. Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 呵呵。真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: OH, SOL. That's not what I meant, and you know it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，天。我不是那个意思，你知道的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Hard to picture some umpteenth-some-odd-whatever thousands of years in the future,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 很难想象在几千上万年后的未来，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I mean, children's toys. Dolls. Action figures. Things like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我是指儿童玩具。洋娃娃。玩偶。诸如此类的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Kids are still sitting around reenacting stories with little figurines and playing "bandits" or "save the princess."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 孩子们仍然会围坐在一起，用玩偶重演故事，玩"强盗"或"拯救公主"的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was actually watching Amir playing one of his arcade games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实是因为我看到阿米尔在玩他的一款街机游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's rather comforting thinking that despite all the differences between our cultures, kids still just... sit down and play with toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 令人欣慰的是，尽管我们的文化存在很多差异，但孩子们仍然只是……坐下来玩玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Like what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 比如什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I was thinking to myself - what I wouldn't give to have that kind of joy in my life again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 然后我就在想——要是能再次拥有这样的快乐，我愿意付出一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I had this action figure. Action Angus. He was a soldier, no surprise there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我有一个玩偶。安格斯玩偶。他是个士兵，一点也不稀奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I've never looked down my nose at Aoi, or Amir, or even now Kaya for finding fun in "childish" things. It's never bothered me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我从来没有因为碧、阿米尔，甚至现在的卡娅喜欢玩那些"幼稚"的东西而看不起他们。我从来不觉得这有什么问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: One solstice celebration, a bunch of the older boys stole it from me along with a bunch of my other toys and, well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在一次仲冬节庆典上，一群大男孩从我这偷走了它，还有一堆我的其他玩具，然后……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, bollocks. I should've known. I'm so sorry that I brought this up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，不好。我早该知道的。很抱歉又提起这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But sometimes I'm afraid that the part of me that's capable of feeling that curled up and died a long time ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但有时我担心，我身上能够感受到这种感觉的那部分，很久以前就已经蜷缩起来消亡了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: It's a long story. Short of it? I was "too old," they said, to be playing with dollies. That was the last time I ever played with toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 说来话长。但长话短说？他们说我"年纪太大了"，不适合玩洋娃娃。那是我最后一次玩玩具了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Kind of sad, isn't it? That we tell children to love something, and then we tell them to give it up when they've "matured."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 这有点悲哀，不是吗？我们告诉孩子们要热爱某样东西，然后又告诉他们，等他们"成熟"了就该放弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The other day, I was watching Amir play one of his games. It's clear how much he's attached it. How much happiness it brings him. And I was a bit jealous that I don't have anything like that in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 前几天，我看阿米尔玩他的一款游戏。看得出来他有多喜欢这个游戏，它给他带来多少快乐。我有点嫉妒，我的生活中竟然没有这样的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now I feel like an absolute knobhead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我这下简直像个白痴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You make a fair point. I think when it becomes a replacement for the real thing, it's a problem. I'm not suggesting that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得有道理。我觉得如果它变成了现实的替代品，就会出问题。不过我可没这么建议啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're right. And I hope it's something we remember, as we go forward together in... whatever this is that we're in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你说得对。我希望我们都能铭记这一点，当我们一起走下去的时候……无论我们身处何方的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know, I found Eleanor, Velimir, Aoi, and Amir, playing hide-and-seek with Flare and Lizzie. (Quincy said he wasn't allowed to play because the bastard was cheating and was using his scope to see through walls.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道吗，我发现埃莉诺、维利米尔、碧和阿米尔，跟弗莱尔和丽兹玩捉迷藏。（昆西说他们不让他玩，因为那混蛋作弊，用瞄准镜透视墙壁。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: They were all looking at me worried I was going to be upset I caught them mucking about when they should be doing something useful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 他们都看着我，担心我会不高兴，因为我撞见了他们在该干正事的时候瞎混。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I was more upset that I wasn't invited. Heh. But I had to put on the grumpy leader face and pretend I was upset that the posts were left unmanned, etcetera.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 其实我更难过的是没被邀请。呵呵。不过我得装出一副领导不爽的样子，假装因为没人守岗而生气之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But Amir has his games. Aoi has On-lyne. Even Kaya has her stickers and her Jinymon, for all that the world has forced adulthood on her too soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔有他的游戏。碧有线上时代。就连卡娅也有她的贴纸和吉尼梦，尽管这个世界让她变得早熟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Honestly? I'm not even sure. Only that I feel like I'm missing something that's been gone from my life for a very long time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 老实说？我自己都不知道。我只是觉得我失去了什么东西，一些很久以前就从我生活中消失的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I can just hear the laughter now. But I suppose that's really what's holding me back, isn't it? Embarrassment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我仿佛已经听到他们在笑我了。不过我想这才是真正让我迟迟不敢踏出那一步的原因吧？尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not sure if I can ever get it back. Or if it's too far gone. But who knows. With enough time, maybe anything is possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不确定我是否还能找回它。或者说，它是否已经离我太远了。但谁知道呢。只要有足够的时间，也许一切皆有可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not sure it's possible to get it back, even if I could push through the momentary shame. But who knows. With enough loops, maybe anything is possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 就算我能克服那一瞬间的羞耻感，我也不确定还能不能把它找回来。不过谁知道呢。只要循环足够多，也许一切皆有可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Finally found a use for all those gas cans you keep buying me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你一直给我买的那些汽油罐，我终于找到用处了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well, I had been just throwing them at the techrot, since they very much do not enjoy being on fire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我只是把它们扔向科腐者，因为它们很不喜欢身上着火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll be right back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我马上回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But it seems Velimir is a decent grill cook.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不过维利米尔看起来是一位不错的烧烤师傅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I need to go have *words* with our friend Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我需要去和我们的朋友阿米尔*谈谈*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now that you both had your revenge with that horrific abomination at my expense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在你们俩都已经用那恐怖玩意儿报复了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Now I just need to convince him that trying to barbecue the techrot is a very bad idea...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 现在我只需要说服他，试图去烧烤科腐者是一个非常糟糕的主意……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Once he stopped attempting to barbecue the techrot, that is...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 一旦他不再去烤那些科腐者，那简直是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Am I forgiven yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 原谅我了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Look, I still don't really know what they eat in - whenever you're from - but - I am going to judge you if you start eating *that.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我说，我到现在都不太清楚他们吃什么——无论你来自哪里——但是——如果你真敢吃*那玩意儿*，我可要批判你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: That was roughly the face I made, yes, exactly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没错，我当时的表情和这个差不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Oh, thank Sol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 哦，感谢太阳神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Aoi magnetized my keys and stuck them to the I-beam on the ceiling of the main atrium in the mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 碧把我的钥匙磁化了，粘在商场主中庭天花板的工字梁上了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You wouldn't happen to have any warframes that can fly, would you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你不会恰巧有会飞的战甲吧，有吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sigh. All right, I'll figure something out. Thanks anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 唉。好吧，我会想办法的。还是谢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: *Fantastic.* I was getting real sick of lobbing javelins at them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: *太棒了。*我真的厌倦了向他们投掷标枪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: What is the most horrifying warframe you have access to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你接触过的最恐怖的战甲是哪个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: ... I was just trying to figure out what the Scaldra were yelling about on comms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: ……我只是想弄清楚炽蛇军通讯时在喊什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Well. That's what I get for asking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 好吧。这就是我问了之后得到的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And I guess I lucked the hell out with Entrati's serum, didn't I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我觉得在英择谛的血清这件事上，我可真是太走运了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You know, I just realized something this morning, and I could not stop laughing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你知道吗，我今天早上才意识到一些事情，结果笑到停不下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Vodyanoi has no idea how transference works.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 维德诺伊居然不知道传识是怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You're like Kent Clarke and Megabloke, he's never seen two of your warframes in the same place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你就像肯特·克拉克和超级猛男一样，他从来没有见过你的两个战甲出现在同一个地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: In his head, there's some... army of psychotic super-soldiers running amok with the Hex!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 在他的认知里，有一群……精神失常的超级士兵在和六人组疯跑！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Exactly. I'm not about to be the one to correct him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 没错。反正我不会去纠正他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not about to be the one to correct him. But I can't even imagine what he thinks is going on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不打算去纠正他。但我根本无法想象他到底是怎么想的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: No wonder he's so paranoid about us. Hah! Almost feel bad for the sorry little bastard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 难怪他对我们这么多疑。哈哈！差点要替这个可怜的小混蛋感到难过了呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Almost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 差点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'm not sure about these... Infested guns Eleanor is collecting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我搞不太懂埃莉诺正在收集的这些……感染枪支。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Besides the fact that I think she can talk to them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 除了我认为她可以和它们交流之外？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: To *us.* I'm not entirely sure that they don't talk to *her.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 只是不对*我们*说。我不太确定它们有没有和*她*说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I do know they talk to the guitar. Which I really do not want to think about more than I need to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道它们会和吉他说话。但我真的不想多想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: But should we be concerned about them...spreading? They do seem to multiply.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 但我们应该担心它们的……扩散吗？它们确实是在变多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Which I don't understand. Nor do I want to think too hard about where their ammunition comes from. Or what it is comprised of in the first place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我不明白。我也不想去细想它们的弹药从何而来，或者它到底是由什么组成的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Sure. For *now.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 当然。*目前*是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I think I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我想我会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: At least if my sidearm blows a hole in my foot I know I'm the idiot responsible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 至少如果我的次要武器在我的脚上炸出一个洞，我也知道是我自己蠢造成的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: And not because my gun decided to rethink its loyalty or got a case of the midnight munchies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 而不是因为我的枪决定重新考虑换主人，也不是因为我的枪在半夜想吃零食。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: You okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 你感觉怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I know that square spaghetti didn't turn out... quite right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我知道那些方形意大利面做得……不太对劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: The gelatin balance was off. It'll be better next time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 明胶的比例不对。下次会更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: I'll make you some soup. Normal, non-square soup. How's that sound?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我给你做点汤吧。正常的、不是方块的汤。怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Nah. Poison's not my speed. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 不会的。下毒不是我的风格。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.text: Promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/ArthurRomanc.zhText: 我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Happy Birthday to the firstborn of the Nightingale family!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 祝南丁格尔家的长女生日快乐！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Happy Birthday, monster lady!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 生日快乐，怪物女士！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Happy Birthday, Eleanor. I’m glad you’re still here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 生日快乐，埃莉诺。我很高兴你还在这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Congratulations on surviving to another birthday!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 恭喜你又活过一个生日！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Happy Birthday, Eleanor! Hope you’re enjoying it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 生日快乐，埃莉诺！希望你过得开心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … so is it hard to blow out birthday cake candles with that tongue of yours getting in the way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……那有你的舌头挡着，把蜡烛吹灭会不会很难？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry. I really was coming to ask for your consent. I know it's not something we've discussed before. I wanted to make sure everything would be okay with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起。我真的是来征求你同意的。我知道我们之前没讨论过这件事。我只是想确认这一切你都不会介意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course, I meant it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当然是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly? I've thought about it some more. And, no. I'd have to stop you if you became a monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话？我又仔细想了想。不，如果你成了怪物，那我就得阻止你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The line between "hero" and "monster" is blurrier than most people like to admit. I've fought against Grineer and Corpus and fought alongside them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "英雄"与"怪物"之间的界线远比大多数人想象中要模糊。我曾与 Grineer 和 Corpus 对抗，也曾与他们并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because I think you're one of the most fiercely intelligent, wonderfully sardonic people I've ever met. I don't even think the Techrot could take that away from you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为我觉得你是我见过的最犀利聪明、最善于讽刺的人之一。我甚至认为连科腐者也不能夺走你这种特质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't believe in the words "Good" and "Evil." Just people. Why do you have any less of a right to exist than I do? I might not have a Techrot tongue, but I'm just as much of a freak of nature.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不相信"善"和"恶"这两个词。我只相信人性。你怎么就比我有更少的存在的权利呢？虽然我可能没有科腐者的舌头，但我同样是大自然的异类。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Indifference was unleashed by Entrati. A man. Human hubris was to blame for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空无情之物是被英择谛释放出来的。他是人。而这一切都要归咎于人类的狂妄自大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Protecting people from death is not the same thing as believing something should be exterminated or has no right to exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 保护人们免于死亡不等同于认为某些东西应该被消灭或没有存在的权利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ensuring a flock of sheep doesn't get eaten by wolves is not the same as going out and murdering all the wolves for being evil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 确保羊群不被狼吃掉并不等同于出去杀死所有的狼，就因为它们是邪恶的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We don't really know where the Techrot came from. It could be manmade. It could be from something else entirely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们实际上并不知道科腐者的来源。它可能是人造的。也可能根本就是别的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The simple fact is, you don't want me to kill you. So I wouldn't. I'd let you go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 事实很简单，你不想我杀了你。所以我不会那样做。我会放你走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How do I know nothing of Eleanor remained? You talk about how the Techrot thinks. How it talks to you. It's clearly intelligent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我怎么知道埃莉诺什么都没留下？你谈到科腐者的思维方式。它如何与你交谈。它显然是有智慧的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It seems to be a hive mind. Maybe Eleanor would still be in there, not in one place, but a billion. Who am I to say that's "wrong?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它似乎是一种蜂巢意识。也许埃莉诺还在里面，不是在一个地方，而是分散在数十亿个地方。我又怎么能说这是"错"的呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. I couldn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。我不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. If the Techrot really is unnatural? Then... it has to go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 会。如果科腐者真的是非自然的产物？那么……它必须被消灭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because I have feelings for you. [Confess feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为我喜欢你。[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because you mean too much to me as a friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为你是我非常重要的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Asking me if I'd kill you is just *cruel,* Eleanor. When the thought of you dead, or in pain, just --
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，你问我是否会杀了你，这实在是太残忍了。一想到你死去或者受苦，我就——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Asking me if I'd kill you is just *cruel,* Eleanor.  You're my friend. You're like family to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，你问我是否会杀了你，这实在是太残忍了。你是我的朋友。你对我来说就像家人一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The fact of the matter is? No. I couldn't. Because the hope that you'd exist somewhere out there? In some form? Anywhere? Would be enough for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 事实是？不，我做不到。因为只要还有希望，你以某种形式存在于世上的某个地方，那对我来说就足够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The fact of the matter is? No. I couldn't. Because the hope that you'd exist somewhere out there? In some form? Anywhere? Would be enough for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 事实是？不，我做不到。因为只要还有希望，你以某种形式存在于世上的某个地方，那对我来说就足够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry. I can't do this. I need to go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很抱歉，我无法继续下去了，我必须走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry. I can't do this. I need to go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很抱歉，我无法继续下去了，我必须走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I really just wanted to apologize for the terrible things I said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其实我只是想为我之前说的那些恶劣的话向你道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just wanted to tell you that I have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是想告诉你我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think he was "punking" you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得他是在"捉弄"你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have no idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我也不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe I've been confused on how this all works.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可能是因为我一直不太清楚这种事该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I would love that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很愿意这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eh, no. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃，不。算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Concern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 出于关心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Idle curiosity. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 纯粹的好奇。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Telepathy doesn’t give you control?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 心灵感应不是可以控制对方吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How is a chat message 'art'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 聊天信息怎么成了"艺术"呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I didn't say it was concern for YOU. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没说是为了关心你。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why do you even use this? You can talk telepathically, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你为什么要用这个？你可以通过心灵感应交流，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: 'Read between the lines'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是说"读懂字里行间的意思"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just how infested ARE you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你的感染程度究竟是多少？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Does it help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这样有用吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Um... have fun with that. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯……祝你玩得开心。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like you just prefer to hide behind a screen. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来你只是喜欢隐藏在屏幕后面。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So it's about not showing your feelings?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以这是不表露自己感情的意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just checking you're alive. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只是想确认你是否还活着。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No thanks. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不了，谢谢。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So you're asking permission now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以你是在征求我的同意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No mind probes. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请不要再探查我的思维。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: OK. Where do you want to start?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。你想从哪里开始？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 始源星系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Entrati Family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 英择谛家族。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个 Lotus。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: My best ever bathroom experience. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有史以来最好的厕所体验。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's a kingdom I used to rule.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是我曾经统治过的一个王国。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You've barely made it to Lua. In my time, we have colonies on all the planets.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们只是勉强登上了月球。在我的时代，我们在所有星球上都有殖民地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The rest of the clan are... pretty unique. And infested.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其余的家族成员……真是各有千秋。而且都被感染了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She's kind of a mother figure. Also kind of a biological-mechanical-deity-thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她有点像是母亲，也有点像是生物机械神灵那种存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请便。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请便。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请便。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请便。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: On second thoughts - yes I do mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想了想——是的，我介意。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I might not have all the answers, but go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不一定有所有的答案，但你尽管问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不可以。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I feel put on the spot. Is this an interview?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我感觉自己被问住了。这是采访吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What it "means" to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它对我"意味"着什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nobody’s really sure what the Void is. It’s a dimension, it’s an energy field, it’s a shortcut through space, it’s a bolt-hole where the Orokin hid…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没人真正知道虚空是什么。它是一个维度，是一个能量场，是一条穿越太空的捷径，是奥罗金藏身之处……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void gives me the ability to do impossible things. Project beams of energy, turn insubstantial, all that good shit. Where I come from, it's what makes Warframes able to do what they do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空让我能做一些不可能的事情。发射能量光束，化为虚无，诸如此类的厉害事情。在我们那边，正是虚空让战甲能够做到他们所做的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void drove my parents insane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空让我的父母发疯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void was my home for I don't know how long. It shaped itself to me. Or I shaped it, somehow. Still not clear on what exactly happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空曾是我的家，我不知道在那里待了多久。它好像根据我来塑造它自己，或者是我以某种方式塑造了它。具体是什么还不太清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They never had the chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们没有那个机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah, I'd rather not. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，不太想谈。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. Literally a children’s story brought to life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。简直就像是童话故事变成了现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There was this book I used to love. ‘Tales of Duviri'. Stories about a magical kingdom, only it was really about emotions and the lessons they can teach you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我以前很喜欢一本书。《双衍王境故事集》。是一些关于一个魔法王国的故事，但实际上它讲的是情感以及情感所能教会我们的教训。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void brought it to life and I got to live in it. Then it became a prison. But that's another story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空让它变成了现实，我就生活在了那个世界里。后来它变成了一座监狱。不过那就是另一个故事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No, Eleanor, being murdered every morning did not feel like a dream. I felt every second of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不，埃莉诺，每天早上被杀害的感觉绝对不像是在做梦。我感受到了每一秒的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. There's something IN the Void. I know that much. The Indifference, the Lidless Eye, the ‘Man in the Wall'. When I say the Void did this, I mean HE did it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。虚空中有某种东西。这一点我是知道的。虚空无情之物，无睑之眼，"墙中人"。当我说虚空造成了这一切，我的意思是，是他做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They could be. I hope they aren’t.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有可能是。但我希望不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The future basically RUNS on the Void. Interplanetary travel, Warframes, the Tenno... without the Void, none of it works.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 未来几乎完全依赖虚空。星际旅行、战甲、Tenno……如果没有虚空，这一切都不可能实现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What do you mean, connected?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说的连接是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait, back up. In my time, there’s this… pump. The Heart of Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等，倒回去一点。在我们那个时代，有个……泵。叫做惊惧之心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Heart of Deimos keeps the whole Origin System bathed in a sort of Void halo. Like background radiation. Anything that draws on Void energy depends on the Heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 惊惧之心让整个始源星系被笼罩在某种虚空光环之中。就像背景辐射一样。任何需要虚空能量的东西都依赖于这颗心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: "Swan about" isn't fair, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，用"闲逛"来形容不太合适。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know I won’t catch it. I just haven’t yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不知道我是否会感染。只是目前还没被感染而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s fantastic. I can help the people in danger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 感觉太棒了。我可以帮助那些有危险的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I’ll tell you when you’re out of line.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那我就会在你不礼貌的时候告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Suit yourself. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 随便你。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Something on your mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有什么心事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Have fun with that. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那就去好好享受吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You don’t know this thing like I do. It evolves. It mutates. It learns. The Orokin thought they could beat it. They never did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你不像我一样了解这个东西。它会进化。它会变异。它会学习。奥罗金人以为他们可以打败它。但他们从未做到过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe you’re right. But we don’t KNOW.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或许你说得对。但我们并不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re right. I could help people more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说得对。我可以帮助更多的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m just trying my best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是尽力而为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。我觉得我是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No, I don’t.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不，我不觉得我是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t believe in heroes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不相信英雄这回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you as sick as Lettie seems to think you are?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真的像莱蒂认为的那样生病了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How's your personal Infestation going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你的个人感染情况怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s the deal with you and Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你和莱蒂是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说，没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘La Bruja Metiche'. The nosy witch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "La Bruja Metiche"。多管闲事的巫婆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Very scientific of you. I thought you believed in more spiritual things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你这么说很科学。我还以为你相信更多精神层面的东西呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like you think  the ‘loss of humanity' part is exaggerated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来你认为"失去人性"的部分有些夸张了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I get it, you don’t like each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白了，你们不喜欢对方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Has it always been this way between you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们之间一直都是这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She thinks you’ll lose control.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她觉得你会失控。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You want to just give up? You sound like Son.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你想要放弃了吗？听起来你就像"儿子"一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you were following its agenda, would you even know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你在被它操控，你会察觉到吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: At least the human genome is natural.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少人类基因组是自然形成的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I get it, you don’t like each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白了，你们不喜欢对方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Has it always been this way between you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们之间一直都是这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She thinks you’ll lose control.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她觉得你会失控。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Techrot could hijack your mind and you wouldn't know it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 科腐者可能会劫持你的思想，而你根本不会意识到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've seen it absorb entire MOONS, Eleanor!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，我曾经见过它吞噬整个卫星！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You don’t know what you’re talking about. When someone’s lost to the Infestation, they are LOST. Completely unrecognizable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你根本不知道你在说什么。一旦有人被完全感染，他们就再也回不来了。完全变得面目全非。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I understand that you need to try to accept what you've become. You're facing an impossible challenge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白你需要努力接受现在的自己。你面对的是一个不可能的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know if you’re trying to provoke me, but I’ve had to fight for my life against these things. Sometimes you can make out the bits that used to be human. Heads and feet just sticking out of the mass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道你是不是想激怒我，但我曾经为了生存不得不与这些东西搏斗。有时你能看到曾经是人类的那些部分。头和脚就挂在那一团东西的外面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Either hate what you've become or embrace it. And something tells me you're someone who learned to give up hating themselves a long time ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 要么讨厌现在的自己，要么接受现在的自己。而我觉得你很早以前就学会不再讨厌自己了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s not a symbiote. It doesn’t CARE what you want. It’s not here to help. It’s an aggressive cancer of a lifeform that only wants to make everything else into itself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这不是共生体。它不在乎你想要什么。它不是来帮助你的。它是一种极具攻击性的癌症生命体，只想把一切都变成它自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But these demons in your blood are NOT your friends. The best you can do is keep them on a tight leash, Eleanor. Trust. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是你血液中的这些恶魔并不是你的朋友。埃莉诺，你最好能牢牢地控制它们。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Infested human beings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 受感染的人类。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, you did NOT just describe Ballas as ‘having guts'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，你可不能说 Ballas 是"有勇气的"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So… do you think you’re becoming more yourself, not less?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么……你认为你变得更加像你自己了，还是越来越不像？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How did you end up here in Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是怎么来到霍瓦尼亚的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What was it like growing up with Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 和亚瑟一起长大是什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Should I even bother asking? Or is this a conversation better suited for later?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我现在提这个问题合适吗？还是说我们留到以后再说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you going to give me the real version?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你会告诉我真实的版本吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How nice. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真美好。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I bet he let you practice makeup on him, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我猜他还让你在他脸上练习过化妆吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He's quite a private guy, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，他确实很注重隐私。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Always the soldier. Is he ever NOT on duty?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他总是一副士兵的样子。他有没有不执勤的时候？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m having trouble taking YOU seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真的很难把你当回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't know, I think he's pretty sexy... for a hungover emo panda.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道，我觉得他还挺性感的……当然，是对于一个宿醉的情绪化熊猫来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd let you practice makeup on me if you wanted. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你愿意，我可以让你在我脸上练习化妆。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Give him a break. It’s good sense, for a fighting team. You can’t sail a leaky ship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 给他一点空间。这对战斗团队来说是明智的。你无法驾驶一艘漏水的船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's not right. If you don't talk about hurtful things, you just... bottle it up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那样不对。如果你不谈论那些伤害你的事，那你只是在……压抑自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And if you bottle it up, it can spiral out of control. ... I have some experience with that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你压抑自己，它就可能会失控。……我对此有些体会……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Remember, I'm not from here. What things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 记住，我不是这里的人。是什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hibernian what now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 希伯尼安什么来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You remind me of Nora Night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你让我想起了诺拉·夜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I agree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You mean alien life? Not yet, but maybe one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是说外星生命吗？还没有，但也许有一天会有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Indifference is the closest we’ve come, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不幸的是，虚空无情之物是我们迄今为止遇到的最接近的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah, we’re alone. Nothing but humans and human-created things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，只有我们。除了人类和人类创造的东西之外，什么都没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We’re still not sure what it is. Or even what it WANTS. We don’t even know if it’s an ancient entity like the Red Veil think it is, or if Albrecht brought it into being somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们还不确定它是什么。甚至不知道它想要什么。我们甚至不知道它是不是像血色面纱那样认为的古老存在，还是阿尔布雷希特以某种方式创造出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's the thing that took Major Rusalka.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它就是那个带走鲁莎卡少校的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If I tell you it’s what was possessing Major Rusalka, does that help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我告诉你它就是曾经附身在鲁莎卡少校身上的东西，这对你有帮助吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait. Just what sort of interaction did you have in mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等。你心里想的是什么样的互动？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Looking for a fellow tentacle monster to befriend?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在寻找一个触手怪同类当朋友吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Poor little thing didn't get hurt, did it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个可怜的小东西没受伤吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay, I have to ask how that went.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，我得问问这事怎么样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s only a rat, come on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 拜托，这只是一只小鼠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And your side of it? What was it like being a rat?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那你感觉怎样？变成小鼠是什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds kind of pleasant, the way you talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你这么说，听起来还挺惬意的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you jealous of a rat?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是在嫉妒一只小鼠吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Religious breakthrough?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 宗教上的顿悟？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're going to have to tell me what that is, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，你得告诉我那是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A nun?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 修女？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That sounds terrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那听起来很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That sounds amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那听起来很棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That sounds challenging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那听起来很有挑战性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That sounds… like it’s not for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这听起来……好像不适合我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We all fantasize about having our shit together one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都幻想这有一天自己能把一切都处理得很完美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I talk to an alternate version of myself all the time. We’ve had meals together. It’s not as crazy as you make it sound.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我经常和另一个版本的自己聊天。我们还一起吃过饭。这并不像你想的那么疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m fine, Eleanor, thanks for asking! How are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我最近还不错，埃莉诺，谢谢你关心！你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve seen enough to know that a personality can survive death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我已经见识过足够多的事情，知道人格是可以逾越死亡的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No more stupid conversations. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别再聊愚蠢的话题了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We've got ‘Cephalons' where I come from. Glass cubes that used to be human beings, and still express their personality. Mostly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在我们那边，我们有"中枢"。那些曾经是人类的玻璃方块，现在依然能表达出他们的个性。大多数时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Orokin used to transfer their consciousness into stolen bodies, so they could live forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 奥罗金人过去常常将他们的意识转移到偷来的身体中，这样他们就可以永生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All Tenno can use ‘transference' to pilot Warframes. We're not tied to a physical form. So it doesn't make sense to imagine our existence ending when our bodies die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所有 Tenno 都可以使用"传识"来操控战甲。我们不受物理形态的限制。因此，想象我们的存在会随着身体的死亡而结束是没有意义的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm really not comfortable fueling this obsession of yours, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，我真的不想助长你的这种痴迷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't be a jerk, Eleanor. Cephalons are people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，别那么刻薄。中枢也是人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m just saying I think survival of death is possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是在说我认为死后生存是有可能的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Kind of. Necraloid is a Cephalon copy of Loid, who’s still alive. But even if a Cephalon isn’t the original, they’re still people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有点那个意思。殁世械灵就是洛德的中枢复制品，洛德仍然活着。但即使中枢不是原来的那个人，他们仍然是人类。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh just what we need. More people screwing with timelines.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，正是我们需要的。更多人来扰乱时间线。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or you might just create a new branch of history and go off down that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或者你可能只是创造了一个新的历史分支，然后沿着那条路走下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not just someone. Entrati. He took the first steps into the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不只是某个人。是英择谛。他是第一个进入虚空的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know some dead people who are like that. The Holdfasts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我认识一些死去的人是那样的。那些坚守者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If it looks like a sawgaw and it screeches like a sawgaw, it's a sawgaw. It's all the same then, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果它看起来像只梭歌，而且叫声也像梭歌，它就是梭歌。那不都一样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This stuff really matters to you, doesn’t it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这件事情对你来说真的很重要，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. They used to be officers on the Zariman. The colony ship that got lost in the Void. Now they’re ghosts, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。他们曾经是扎里曼号上的军官。那艘迷失在虚空中的殖民飞船。现在他们大概可以算是幽灵了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's... complicated. Things can go into the void, but they aren't quite the same when they come out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这……很复杂。东西可以进入虚空，但当它们出来时就不太一样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re asking the wrong person. I’m not sure I *can* die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那你问错人了。我不确定我是否*能*死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t think it’s healthy for you to be dwelling on this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得一直纠结这些问题对你的健康不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey, Eleanor...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，埃莉诺……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nothing much. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没什么。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You were a ‘journalist', right? What's one of those exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你之前是个"记者"，对吧？那到底是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Got it. We call those ‘Corpus'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 明白了。我们称那些人为"Corpus"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So what makes a story ‘interesting'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，是什么让一个故事变得"有趣"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So you only tell the truth? How do you pick which truths to tell?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以你们只说真相吗？你是如何选择要讲哪些真相的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought you were here because Arthur was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我以为你来这里是因为亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sure, why not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然，为什么不呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, no. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，我不愿意听。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tell me the worst part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 告诉我最糟糕的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is it going to be gross?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 会不会很恶心？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like you didn't take the situation seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来你并没有认真对待这个情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Admit it. You did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 承认吧，你确实这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No, but it *was* a bonus, wasn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不会，但这也*是*额外的好处，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You were telling me about the worst part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说到最糟的部分了吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like you were just doing your job. What happened next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来你只是在做份内的事。然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tell me you didn't stay there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你不会没离开那吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You named it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是你给它起的名字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So that's where that came from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 原来这名字是从你这来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Play stupid games, win stupid prizes, I guess?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 玩愚蠢的游戏，中愚蠢的大奖，是这意思吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s so bad about that? The name fits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这有什么不好的？这个名字很合适。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey Eleanor? You and Amir are friendly, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，埃莉诺？你和阿米尔关系不错，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You like boardgames, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你喜欢桌游吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Amir's trying to get the team together to play a game of Fables & Frontiers, and I said I'd help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 阿米尔想召集团队一起玩寓言与边疆，我说我会帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Amir really wants to play Fables & Frontiers with everybody. You in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 阿米尔真的很想和大家一起玩寓言与边疆。你来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah, I think it's going to be a total waste of time, but I'm trying to be nice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，我觉得这完全是在浪费时间，但我还是想尽力表现得友好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think it'll be fun, honestly. And it seems to mean a lot to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说，我觉得会很有趣的，而且这对他来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey, Eleanor, is it okay to ask you about the telepathy thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，埃莉诺，我可以问你有关心灵感应的问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So, what's it like being able to peek into everybody's heads?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以，能够窥视每个人的想法是什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you hear people’s thoughts without trying? Or do you always have to make an effort to get inside their head?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是不经意间就能听见人们的想法，还是需要特意进入他们的脑海？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is it like a light switch? Or is it always "stuck on?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这个能力是像开关一样可以控制的吗？还是一直都处在"开"的状态？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well I'm too curious to say no, now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，我现在太好奇了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Permission granted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我允许你这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eh... another time, maybe. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃……也许下次吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which was worse? Learning you weren't catastrophically sick or...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哪个更糟糕？得知自己没有得重病，还是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Must have been a relief to find out the truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 知道真相肯定让你松了一口气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What about people’s privacy? Isn’t it bad for morale?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那人们的隐私怎么办？这样对士气不好吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But what if somebody *doesn't* want their head invaded?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但如果有人不想自己的思想被侵入怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So how do you deal with it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那你是怎么处理这个问题的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Have you overheard any of MY thoughts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你有没有无意中听到过我的想法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So... what've you picked up in my head?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那……你在我脑海中发现了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go on…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 继续……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ouch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How did he react?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他怎么反应的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m asking because I like the guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我这么问是因为我喜欢他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yikes. That wasn't my intention. I just wanted to know how someone like that reacts to being confronted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎呀。这不是我的本意。我只是想知道这样的人面对质问时会有什么反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am enjoying it. Sounds like Arthur had it coming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我是很享受。听起来亚瑟是自作自受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't miss being a kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不怀念童年的时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yay, childhood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 唉，童年啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know what it's like to hurt a sibling. I... used to have one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道伤害兄弟姐妹是什么感觉。我……曾经也有一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like you hurt him badly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来你伤他很深。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s fighting dirty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是耍阴招。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This isn’t about trying to be a saint, Eleanor. It’s not even about being a hero. It’s about refusing to be an asshole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，这并不是为了成为圣人，甚至也不是为了成为英雄。这是为了不做混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We're all trying to do the right thing here. Is it really that much harder for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都在努力做正确的事。这对你来说真的那么难吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We all have lines we won’t cross and this is one of yours. I respect that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都有不愿逾越的底线，而这正是你的底线之一。我尊重这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Really sorry. Not right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真的很抱歉。现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m here. Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在。继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course I remember.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当然记得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She was being used. The Indifference was puppeting her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她被利用了。虚空无情之物在操纵她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Pretty sure she was hollowed out and driven around like a... well... Warframe...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很确定她被掏空了，然后像……呃……战甲……那样被操控。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you’re sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你确定的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know what you mean. We call it The Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道你说的是什么。我们称之为"虚空无情之物"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: At this point? ... No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 此时此刻？……没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly? I'm... not sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说？我……不确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，我相信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't think it's safe for you to talk about it like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得你这样谈论这件事不安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m here. Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在这里。继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: An eye?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一只眼睛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A man trapped in a wall?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一个被困在墙里的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What was it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It... does that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它……就是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那你怎么做的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But you came back, didn’t you? You’re still here. You proved that thing wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但你回来了，不是吗？你还在这里。你证明了那东西错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, it is. But you’re still here, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，它还在。但你也还在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The stars don't stop burning just because space is big, cold and dark.
