/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 群星不会因为宇宙的广袤、寒冷与黑暗而熄灭光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I understand entropy. Maybe the Great Indifference is the same thing. Maybe it wins in the end. I don't know. What I do know is that I’m not going to let it win NOW.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我理解熵增。也许强大的虚空无情之物是同一回事。也许它最终会胜利。我不知道。但我知道的是，我现在不会让它胜利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm waiting for you to make up your damn mind. Do you want to take the easy way out and go insane? Or get your ass up off of that couch and fight?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在等你做这个决定呢。你是想选择捷径，放任自己发疯？还是从沙发上站起来，奋力一战？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We'll survive this together if we survive it at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我们能一起挺过这一切，我们就会一起生存下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Actually, believe it or not, I care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 事实上，不管你信不信，我是关心你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey, Eleanor. How are you doing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，埃莉诺。最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Shaving?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 剃？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hold up. *What?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等。*什么？*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Stop trying to gross me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别想恶心我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So, while we're talking about the tongue...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 既然我们在谈论舌头……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... how much control have you got over it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你对它的控制有多少？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tell me you're not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 告诉我你不会是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, hell no. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，天哪，不行。我不聊了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Pardon me if this is too personal but... what *else* can you do with it...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果这个问题太私人了，请见谅，但是……你的舌头还能做些*什么*呢……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re typing with it?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你在用它打字吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I. Heh. Well, then. I guess my next question would be... do you ever lose control of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我。呵呵。那么，我想我的下一个问题是……你有没有失去对它的控制？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you ever lose control of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你有没有失去对它的控制？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you ever bite it by accident?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你有没有不小心咬过它？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Would you want to go back to the way you used to be before Entrati changed you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你想回到英择谛改变你之前的样子吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How do you feel about it? Like... really feel about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你对此有什么感觉？就是……真正的感觉是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everything that happens to us happens for a reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们遇到的每件事都是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Glad I could help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴能帮上忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're not saying that life is meaningless, are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你不是在说生活毫无意义，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So… what do you like most about being like you are now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么……你最喜欢你现在这种状态中的什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad at least ONE of you is trying to find a silver lining...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少你们中有一个人在试图找到一线希望……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know the kind of pain you mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白你说的那种痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You have to understand there was only the one of me, of us, at first. We were exactly the same person, right up to the moment where I shook that thing's hand. That's when they went their way and I went mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你必须明白，一开始我们俩之间只有一个我。我们完全是同一个人，直到我和那个东西握手的那一刻。那时他们走了他们的路，我走了我的路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yup. That was the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。那就是奥罗金。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, I couldn’t tell you. I know they’ve got people who love them and look out for them. Ordis and Lotus, mainly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说，我也说不清楚。我知道有人喜欢他们，照顾他们。主要是 Ordis 和 Lotus。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Void knows they’ve seen way more violence and bloodshed than any kid ever should. They never signed up for this shit, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空作证，他们见过的暴力与流血远超任何孩子应当承受的程度。而且，他们也从未选择过这样的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Tenno didn't get a choice about being made into warriors. The Orokin were going to kill every one of them before they found a use for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Tenno 没有选择是否成为战士的权利。奥罗金本来打算杀死他们所有人，直到他们找到了利用他们的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But what keeps them going inside? I don’t think that’s something they were trained to do. It’s something about who they are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是是什么让他们继续前行呢？我觉得那不是他们被训练出来的，这是关于他们是谁的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Justice. Righteousness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 正义。公义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Something deeper, maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或许是一些更深层次的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Survival instincts. People want to live, at the end of the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 生存本能。归根结底，人们想要活下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The child is fine, honestly. Lotus is with them. So's Loid. They're not about to break down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说，那个孩子很好。Lotus 和他们在一起。洛德也在。他们不会崩溃的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t underestimate them, Eleanor. They did just fine without me for years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，不要低估他们。这么多年来，没有我，他们也过得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t worry. I’m already doing that. I’ll tell them you said hello, if you like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不用担心。我已经在去看了。如果你愿意，我会转告他们你的问候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m not sure that’s such a great idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不确定这是个好主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Have you gotten anywhere?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有什么进展吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let’s hope so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但愿如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you're sure...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你确定的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not quite. This is their version of reality. I’m the outsider here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不完全是。这是他们的现实版本。我这里是外来者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: More like we split at some point, I took a left turn, they went right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 更像是我们在某处分开了，我向左走，他们向右走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Pretty much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 差不多就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think the only thing left of it is the ghost ship Zariman plugging a hole between dimensions...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想它剩下的只有那艘幽灵船扎里曼号，堵在维度之间的一个洞……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think whatever was left of it came with me into Duviri. For...better or worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想，它的一部分随我去了双衍王境，无论是好是坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t dwell on that much. I guess it’s lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没想那么多。我猜它已经丢失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It might be. Like I said, not my major concern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许吧。就像我说的，这不是我主要关心的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've learned that home, and family, is more about what you make of the "where" and the "who" around you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我学到了，"家"更多在于你如何赋予身边的"地方"和"人"以意义，此心安处，便是吾乡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Less about where and what you're born into.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 与你出生在哪里或是什么出身的关系不大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s really not, not anymore. I don’t really have a home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真的不是了，不再是了。我其实没有家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't see it that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不这么看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Zariman was the colony ship I was on. Headed for Tau. Never made it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当时乘坐的是扎里曼号殖民船。目的地是 Tau 星系。但没能到达。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I made it out. I survived. How insanely lucky is that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我逃了出来。我活了下来。这有多幸运？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She ended up in the Void, and something that existed there decided to turn the ship into a vision of hell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她最终落入虚空，那里的某种存在决定将这艘飞船变成一片地狱般的景象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, the odds of any one of us actually existing in the first place are so slim, it's just one more miracle to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，我们任何一个人能存在的几率本就是极低，对我来说这只是又一个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She's been washing back and forth from the Void to reality, and now she's stuck on the threshold.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她一直在虚空与现实之间来回穿梭，如今被困在了两者的界限上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't focus on what was lost. I focus on what I still have. Like this place. Like all of you. Because...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不关注失去的东西。我关注我仍然拥有的东西。比如这个地方。比如你们所有人。因为……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The ‘Drifter' nickname stuck for a reason, you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道，我被叫做为"漂泊者"是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of all the places I’ve been, this feels most like where I belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在我去过的所有地方中，这里最让我有归属感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't focus on what was lost. Cherish what we've got.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别纠结我们失去了什么。珍惜我们拥有的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She's not really one ship, either. She's like... lots of different versions at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她其实并不只是一艘飞船。她更像是……多个不同版本的集合体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't see it that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不这么看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have this place, now. The first place I've ever really had that feels like home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我现在有了这个地方。这是第一个我真正感觉像家的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I made it out. I survived. How insanely lucky is that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我逃了出来。我活了下来。这有多幸运？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, the odds of any one of us actually existing in the first place are so slim, it's just one more miracle to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，我们任何一个人能存在的几率本就是极低，对我来说这只是又一个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't focus on what was lost. Cherish what we've got.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别纠结我们失去了什么。珍惜我们拥有的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For example? I have this place now. And all of you. It's the first place I've ever really had that feels like home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 比如说？我现在有了这个地方。还有你们所有人。这是第一个我真正感觉像家的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Misfits and screwups like me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 像我这样不合群和搞砸一切的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. Ordis calls them ‘the Operator'. Lotus calls them her child. Mostly I just call them the kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。Ordis 称他们为"指挥官"。Lotus 称他们为"她的孩子"。我通常就叫他们"孩子"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I try to avoid them as much as I can. I don't get paid enough to babysit, even if it is just me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我尽量避开他们。我这点工资还不够让我当保姆，哪怕只是照看我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Something like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 差不多是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not sure how "childlike" they really are when they've been trained to murder for a living.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不太确定他们在被训练成职业杀手后还有多少"孩童"天性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hi, upset. I'm Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你好，不开心。我是漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t have time right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在没空，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s upsetting you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 什么事让你不开心？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What can I do to cheer you up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我要怎么做才能让你高兴起来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Usual methods?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 常用的方法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: 1999 Höllvania is rough! Scaldra, Techrot, Void knows what else. Does the future really look that much worse?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 1999 年的霍瓦尼亚可真够呛！炽蛇军、科腐者、虚空知道还有什么。未来真的看起来糟糕那么多吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, come on... you're tough. You can deal with this. There's so much cool stuff here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，来吧……你很坚强。你能应付的。这里有很多很酷的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We have robots. They do do a lot of the hard work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们有机器人。它们确实做了很多艰苦的工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But what you’re talking about is just fiction, right? So why would you expect reality to live up to it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但你讲的这些都是小说里的内容，不是吗？你为什么期望现实也会变成这样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: People are still people, however much technology changes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 无论技术发生多大变化，人性始终如一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry we let you down?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起，我们让你失望了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're determined to see the worst in everything, aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你总是喜欢往坏处想，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fine. We didn't cure exploitation by having robots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。机器人并没有解决剥削问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Um, polite reminder that I didn’t do ANY of that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，礼貌地提醒一下，那些事我一件都没做过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'll send your complaint on to the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会把你的投诉转达给奥罗金。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Tenno killed the Orokin. Did you forget that part?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是 Tenno 灭了奥罗金。你忘了这部分吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fine. The future’s a mess. You can focus on that if you like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。未来一团糟。如果你喜欢，你可以关注这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That... is... something I'd be careful admitting to people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这……是……我不会轻易向人透露的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm with the people who are trying to make it better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我支持那些在努力让未来变得更好的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The nightlife?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 夜生活？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The underground fighting circuit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 地下对抗回廊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The shopping?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 购物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not interested. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不感兴趣。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m not so sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不太确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like my kind of fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来像是我会喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What happened to them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sacred public bath houses? No, not really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 神圣的公共澡堂？没有，还真没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有死亡角斗场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Some people bet on the Index.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有些人押注指数之场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Komi has been around a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 围棋已经存在一段时间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's a Grineer thing. It's ritual arena combat broadcast to the entire System.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是 Grineer 的特色。是向整个星系广播的竞技场战斗仪式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... sort of? It's like a combination of stock trading and four-a-side violence. I know that sounds weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……差不多？就像是股票交易和四对四暴力游戏的结合。我知道这听起来很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Um.. yes? Wait, is that what Komi's meant to represent?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。。是的？等等，这就是围棋所代表的意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's a massive deal to them. Deadly serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对他们来说是一件大事，非常严肃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Corpus go absolutely crazy for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Corpus 对此非常疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We only know it as a board game!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们只知道它是一种棋盘游戏！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Orokin loved it. It's even in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 奥罗金人很喜欢它。甚至在双衍王境也有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I had no idea it was THAT old, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过，我都不知道它有那么古老。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Would you want me to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你想让我这么做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Never.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 绝不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m not going to answer that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不会回答这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’d still do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我还是会这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Point taken. I wouldn’t do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白了。我不会这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It would depend on how many other people would be endangered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这要取决于有多少人会处于危险之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You haven’t answered the question. Would you want me to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你还没回答我的问题。你想让我这么做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So what I’m hearing is, you aren’t willing to decide this question in advance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以我听出来了，你不愿意提前对这个问题做出决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: In which case, you can’t expect me to, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 既然如此，你也不能指望我能做出决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hi, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗨，埃莉诺……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Brb, Kalymos is playing with the cords again and she might disconn [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 马上回来，卡利莫斯又在玩电线了，可能会断线。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’ve got a question about what life is like in the future?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是不是有关于未来生活的问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You've grown a tail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你长了一条尾巴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ll do my best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我尽量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's not something I've looked into.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我对这个还真没了解过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It depends on the culture.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这取决于文化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … why would you ask that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你为什么要问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Orokin were all about rules and taboos. They loved hierarchy. Relationships couldn't cross social lines. A Dax couldn't be with an Orokin noble, say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 奥罗金人崇尚规则和禁忌。他们推崇等级制度。人与人之间的关系不能跨越社会阶层。比如说，禁卫就不能和奥罗金贵族在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could try to drag Ordis back here in time if you'd like to try to find out...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你想找到答案的话，我可以尝试将 Ordis 拖回这个时代来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … I’ve never heard of it, and I’m not sure how it would work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我从未听说过这样的事，而且我不确定这是怎么做到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A Grineer sniper?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一个 Grineer 狙击手？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A Dax?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一个禁卫？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If it was what they both wanted, sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果那是他们双方都想要的，当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd like to see anyone try to stop them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我倒想看看有谁会试图阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, but it would be hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 能。但是会很难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Actually, I’m pretty sure I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 实际上，我很确定我知道你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not really, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还真是不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Rant away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 尽管抱怨吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't have the time for this, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没空聊这个，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You could always date someone else in the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你可以考虑和六人组中的其他人约会啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hold on. You’re single because you’re worried about hurting someone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等。你之所以单身，是因为你害怕伤到别人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This accidental hurting you’re worried about. Has it ever happened? Have you ever hurt someone you were with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你担心的那种意外伤害。这种事发生过吗？你曾经伤害过和你在一起的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean, at least the good news is that if there was an accident, nobody in Höllvania stays dead after the reset...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的意思是，还好如果有什么意外，霍瓦尼亚重置之后没人会真的死掉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So you’ve been single since the Entrati shots?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么自从打了英择谛的疫苗之后你就一直单身了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor, slow down. What’s going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，慢一点说。发生什么事了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Start at the beginning. I don't know what you're talking about. What question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 从头说起。我不知道你在说什么。什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后呢……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you... sure you didn't get into Lettie's special stash?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你……确定你没有偷偷用了莱蒂的特别药品吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That shouldn’t be possible, Eleanor. Nobody enters the Void until Albrecht Entrati does it. That’s a long way into the future from where we are now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，这不可能发生。在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛之前，没有人能进入虚空。从我们现在的时间来看，那还是遥远的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you really did enter the Void, I cannot tell you how much danger you were putting yourself in. You know what’s out there, and you still just dove into it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你真的进入了虚空，我都不敢想象你把自己置于多大的危险之中。你明知道那里有什么，居然还敢直接跳进去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What did you see? What happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你看到了什么？发生了什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you insane?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你疯了吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This was a mistake. It took Rusalka. It came damn close to taking Albrecht. It could easily take you too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是个错误。它夺走了鲁莎卡。它差点就夺走了阿尔布雷希特。它也能轻易夺走你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So out of infinities of possible worlds, you just happened to home in on the right one?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，在无数个可能的世界中，你偏偏找到了正确的那一个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor, the Indifference can look like whatever it wants. It looked like Albrecht when he first encountered it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，虚空无情之物可以变成任何它想变的样子。当阿尔布雷希特第一次遇到它时，它变成了阿尔布雷希特的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think maybe it sensed what you wanted and took on the form you were hoping to see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想它可能感知到了你的愿望，于是就变成了你希望看到的形态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't believe you did this. Never do that again, Eleanor! I CAN'T LOSE YOU TO THAT THING!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我简直不敢相信你会做这种事。埃莉诺，别再这样做了！我不能让那个东西夺走你！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fine... just... Tell me what happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧……就……告诉我发生了什么事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't be a party to this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不能再这样下去了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is all sounding horribly familiar. And then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这一切听起来真是太熟悉了。然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So you felt that WOULD have been the right choice for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以你觉得那会是你的正确选择吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Did you feel tempted to stay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你有想过留在那里吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Kind of? All I want to know is, did it help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有点吧？我只想知道，这对你有帮助吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Were you and Lettie ever friends?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你以前跟莱蒂是朋友吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is a pretty close knit group. Have any of you ever dated anyone else in the Hex?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是一个非常亲密的团体。你们当中有人跟六人组中的其他人约会过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How would you take it if Arthur got involved with someone romantically?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果亚瑟和谁谈恋爱了，你会怎么想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She still wants you to recover from this, though, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过，她还是希望你能从这回事里恢复过来，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Solaris?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 索拉里斯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nox?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 毒化者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sentients?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Sentient？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lettie needs to look in the mirror and understand she's also just a few bad days away from losing her humanity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 莱蒂需要照照镜子，明白自己离失去人性就差一点了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If Arthur thinks you’re still his sister, that should be good enough for Lettie, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果亚瑟还认为你是他姐姐，那对莱蒂来说也应该可以了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why does she hate you so much, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她为什么那么讨厌你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is it seriously just the tongue thing that freaks her out? Or is it the mind reading thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真的只是因为舌头的事情让她感到不安吗？还是因为读心术？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Did you two ever have a... more romantic history together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们俩曾经有过……更浪漫的故事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you think maybe she LIKES you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你觉得她可能喜欢你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait, weren’t Arthur and Aoi an item?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等，亚瑟和碧不是一对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well. Um. Actually...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个。嗯。其实……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Uh... no... I have designs on *you* actually...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃……不是……其实我对*你*有意思……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. LOL. They're not my type, sorry. Too "heroic."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。哈哈。他们不是我的菜，抱歉。太"英雄"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why did they break up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们为什么分手？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I couldn't possibly see them working out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我实在是看不出他们能有结果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Never any harm in some harmless gossip.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 聊聊无害的八卦总没有什么坏处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’d help to know, so I don’t rub salt in any open wounds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 知道一些情况，可以防止我无意中在伤口上撒盐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I did and I didn’t. The place and the characters came from a children’s book I used to love. ‘Tales of Duviri’. I brought it to life through the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可以说我创造了它，也可以说不是我。那个地方和角色都来自于我小时候非常喜欢的一本儿童书，《双衍王境故事集》。我通过虚空让它变成了现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am so sick of talking about Duviri...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我实在厌倦了谈论双衍王境……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was all alone. I guess the other kids were dead, or rescued. I’m kind of hazy on the details.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当时只有我一个人。我猜其他的孩子要么死了，要么被救走了。我不太记得当时的一些细节了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It wasn't exactly intentional. All I remember is…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这并不是我有意创造的。我只记得……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Angels were coming, breaking through the walls, and I had nowhere to run. I had the book, then I just remember thinking ‘This is where I can be safe.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天使们开始穿透墙壁而来，我无处可逃。我手里拿着那本书，然后我只记得当时想着"在这里，我可以感到安全。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That hasn't really changed in my time. Angels are meant to be winged, shining creatures from the old stories who help good humans. I'm talking about Void Angels. They're a whole different beast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在我的时代，这一点并没有改变。天使应该是古老故事中长着翅膀、光芒四射的生物，帮助善良的人类。我说的是虚空天使。它们完全是另一种野兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So far as I can make out, they used to be people. When the Angels’ song reaches them, they start to change. Once they can’t resist it anymore, they become Angels themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 据我所知，它们曾经是人类。当天使的歌声传到他们耳中时，他们开始变异。一旦他们无法抵抗，就会变成天使。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m fairly certain my parents are dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很确定我的父母已经去世了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They could have been. Other kids heard their parents calling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许是吧。有些孩子听见了他们父母的呼唤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think they were, yeah. Quinn warned me not to look for familiar voices. That must have been what he meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想是的，是的。奎因曾警告我不要去寻找熟悉的声音。估计他就是这个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It was safe for a long time. Long enough for me to forget. I guess that’s what I wanted to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它安全了很久。久到让我忘记一切。我猜这就是我想要的结果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Children are fascinating in the fact that they don't know what they can't do yet. I didn't know I couldn't. So I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 小孩子的迷人之处在于他们还不知道什么事情不能做。我当时不知道我不能做。所以我就去做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I had so many emotions, all at once, that I... just... did something with them. It's hard to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当时一下子涌现出许多情绪，以至于我……只是……用它们做了一些事情。这很难解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void isn't ‘nothing'. I know it sounds like it should be, but it's not. Albrecht proved that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空并不是"无"。我知道它听起来应该是这样，但事实并非如此。阿尔布雷希特证明了这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We know very little about it, even now. But one thing even the Orokin figured out is this: the Void responds to human emotions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 即便到现在，我们对它也知之甚少。但有一点连奥罗金都明白：虚空会对人类的情感做出反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's what that book of stories was meant to be for. On the surface it was all about these over-the-top characters in the court of a mad King who changed his moods every day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那本故事集本来就是为此而写的。表面上，它讲的是一群极其夸张的角色在一个情绪多变的疯狂国王的宫廷里的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But the real lesson of the stories was about how to rule over your emotions. We were meant to learn an important lesson from it, so the voyage would be safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但这些故事的真正教训是教我们如何控制自己的情绪。我们本该从中学到一个重要的教训，这样航行才会安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve never heard of Rudolfo the Leopard King.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我从未听说过豹王鲁道夫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I want to hear the story of Rudolfo the Leopard King someday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我希望有一天能听听豹王鲁道夫的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Plenty. Even the Tenno and the Warframes have stories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很多。甚至连 Tenno 和战甲都有自己的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s this guy, Drusus Leverian. He’s like a museum curator. He keeps records of all the legends of the Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有个叫德枢·莱弗的家伙。他像个博物馆馆长一样，记录所有战甲的传说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Trust me. I know how you feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 相信我。我懂你的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tell me about your myths, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，跟我说说你的神话吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s her story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她的故事是怎样的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've always found the monsters more interesting, anyway. Heroes are boring. Predictable. ...Mundane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 反正我一直觉得怪物更有意思。英雄太无聊了。太容易预测……太平凡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mm, I'm not sure if monsters are really my type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，我不确定怪物是不是我的菜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought you hated heroes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我还以为你讨厌英雄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like she would have commanded respect in her own right. Why’d she need to pretend to be her brother?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来她本应该赢得尊重。她为什么还要假扮成她的哥哥？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm so glad we fixed that in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴我们在未来解决了这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What happened to her in the end?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她最后怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not sure we *entirely* fixed that in the future...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不确定我们在未来是否能*完全*解决这个问题……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So… why crystals?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以……为什么是水晶？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So. You and Quincy. Have you ever... y'know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么。你和昆西。你们有没有……你懂的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So they’re just for decoration, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么它们只是用来装饰吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad you said it and not me. They're just fancy rocks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 幸好说出这句话的人是你而不是我。它们只不过是一些漂亮的石头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have friends who are Cephalons. They’re literally intelligences in the form of glass cubes. Why would you think I’d mock you for thinking crystals have a presence?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有几个朋友是中枢。他们实际上是玻璃立方体形式的智慧生物。你怎么会觉得我会嘲笑你认为水晶确实存在的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I spend too much time digging crystals out of the ground for them not to be important on some deeper level. You'd be amazed at how many Warframes were made in part by crystals of one kind or several.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我花了太多时间从地里挖水晶，所以它们在更深层次上的重要性不言而喻。你会惊讶地发现，有多少战甲的制作材料是某种或几种水晶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Argon. You only find it in the Void, and it disintegrates once you take it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 氩结晶。只有在虚空中才能找到它，一旦你把它带出来它就会消散。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s a whole Warframe made of crystal. Citrine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有一个完全由水晶构成的战甲。她叫 Citrine。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We have a pair of doomed lovers who were turned into crystal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们有一对被变成水晶的恋人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I guess I didn't tell you about Orokin Towers yet. They're like strongholds in the Void, set up in case the Sentients tried to attack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我还没告诉你关于奥罗金塔的事。它们就像虚空中的堡垒，是为了防止 Sentient 的攻击而建立的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: People do try, but we keep them safe. It's the least we can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 人们确实试图这么做，但我们会保护他们。这是我们至少能做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Welcome to the family, I guess?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那就，欢迎加入这个大家庭吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's been so long I can barely remember.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 已经过去太久了，我几乎记不清了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Kind. They tried to do right by me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 非常善良。他们尽力对我好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Strict. They were in charge and they let me know it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 非常严格。他们说了算，并且让我明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hopeless. I might as well have been raised by feral Kubrows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 非常绝望。我还不如是被野生库狛养大的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I... can't do this. Sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我……现在不想谈这个了。对不起。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why do you ask?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你为什么问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What were they like as people?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们是怎样的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What were they like as parents?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们是怎样的父母？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Half of what you’re saying might as well be Voidtongue, but I think I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说的一半话我听着像虚空语，但我想我能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you still in touch?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们还有联系么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why bring them up now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么现在提起这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I’d horrify them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得我吓到他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd be on my best behavior, for your sake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为了你，我会表现得非常好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, that sounds like fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说，这听起来很有意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Single? Wait, would I be coming home as a partner?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 单身？等等，我是以伴侣的身份回家吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly? Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说？想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. I just wasn’t sure what you were imagining.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。我只是不确定你在想象什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Uh… can I get back to you on that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃……我能稍后再回答你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey Eleanor? You remember that board game Amir is putting together? Fables & Frontiers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，埃莉诺？你还记得阿米尔正在制作的那个桌游吗？寓言与边疆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey Eleanor? You and Amir are friendly, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，埃莉诺？你和阿米尔关系不错，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You like boardgames, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你喜欢桌游吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yikes. Okay. you're still mad. Noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎呀。好吧。你还在生气。我注意到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I figured you were "too cool for it" at the time, and I was just trying to pretend I was, too. Now I know better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当时以为你"太酷了"不屑于这个，我也只是假装我也很酷。现在我明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah I... I just wanted to say sorry about that, I... didn't mean what I said about it. I was just scared you'd say no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，我……我只是想说声抱歉，我……不是那个意思。我只是害怕你会拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Amir's trying to get the team together to play a game of Fables & Frontiers, and I said I'd help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 阿米尔想召集团队一起玩寓言与边疆，我说我会帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Amir really wants to play Fables & Frontiers with everybody. You in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 阿米尔真的很想和大家一起玩寓言与边疆。你来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You. I still think it's a dorky game, but whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你。我还是觉得这游戏挺蠢的，不过无所谓了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Me. Definitely me. You're still too cool for the game. But I'm an utter dweeb, or so Quincy says.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我。绝对是我。你还是太酷了，不适合玩这个游戏。但我就是个十足的书呆子，至少昆西是这么说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ...Both?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……两个都是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think it'll be fun, honestly. And it seems to mean a lot to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说，我觉得会很有趣的，而且这对他来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah, I think it's going to be a total waste of time, but I'm trying to be nice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，我觉得这完全是在浪费时间，但我还是想尽力表现得友好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For you, always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对你，我永远有时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm *really* sorry, I can't right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我*真的*抱歉，现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: La Flaca?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: La Flaca？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … a Scaldra assassin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……一个炽蛇军杀手？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: One of the faces of Lua?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 月神的其中一个形象？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is that your name for Death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是你对死亡的称呼吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No clue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You weren’t kidding about being melancholy, were you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说你感到忧郁，这不是开玩笑的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is going to be one of those "get comfy, Drifter, this is going to take a minute" conversations, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这会是一场"找个舒服的位置坐下，漂泊者，这需要点时间"的谈话，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor, that’s ghoulish. You have no right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，这太可怕了。你没有权利这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you try to comfort them at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你尝试过安慰他们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hope?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 希望？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fear?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 恐惧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Denial?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 否认？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why didn’t you help her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你为什么不帮助她？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Did you stay with her until the end?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你有陪她到最后吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What did you learn from the experience?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你从这次经历中学到了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So did you see what you were hoping to see?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么你看到了你希望看到的东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Dying person understands what death is. What an insight, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 垂死之人明白了死亡是什么。埃莉诺，真是个深刻的见解啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What do you mean? Everyone knows what death is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你这是什么意思？每个人都知道死亡是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not really, but carry on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不太明白，但继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But awareness dies when the body dies. What you experienced was just a spasm in her dying brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但意识会随着肉体的死亡而消亡。你所经历的不过是她垂死大脑中的一次痉挛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You think ‘awareness' is who we really are and the rest is just a shell?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你觉得"意识"是我们真正的本质，而其余的都只是外壳？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wow. So deep. You shot someone and then violated her privacy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哇。太深奥了。你开枪打了人，还侵犯了她的隐私。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How do you feel about all of that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你对这一切有什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But what makes us US isn't just raw awareness. It's memory, emotion, opinion, all sorts of layers. When you lose all that you're losing a real person, even if that spark somehow survives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但构成自我的不仅仅是基本的意识。还有记忆、情感、观点、各种层面。当你失去这一切时，你是在失去一个真实的人，即使那份火花以某种方式存续下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No, not really. Even in the future, the people we've lost are... for better or worse? Just... gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不，其实没有。即使到了未来，我们失去的人……无论好坏？只是……消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor, get to the point. Who did you lose?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，说重点吧。你失去了谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Who's Christopher?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谁是克里斯托弗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why is he someone I need to know about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我为什么需要了解他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't have time for this right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没空聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You think Arthur would have listened if he had?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你觉得亚瑟会听从他的话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think it all worked out okay, all things considered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得，从各方面来看，一切还算不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But if Arthur'd listened, then we never would have met. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但如果亚瑟听了他的话，我们就永远不会相遇了。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry, what was that sound again? I missed it. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不好意思，那是什么声音？我没看清楚。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Who was the first?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那谁是第一个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So you and Christopher…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那你和克里斯托弗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know how much you hate the concept of heroes. Is this why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道你很反感英雄这个概念。这就是原因吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He was right. People willing to fight for a better world is the only thing that makes a difference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他说得对。只有人们愿意为更美好的世界而战，才能带来改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s a compelling idea. People want to help. Easy to take advantage of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是个很有吸引力的想法。人们想要帮忙。这一点很容易被利用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That’s kind of arrogant of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这样做有点自大了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm bracing myself for the "but."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在准备好听那个"但是"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like he’d already made up his mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来他已经下定决心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ...Note to self: Argue with Eleanor...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……提醒自己：与埃莉诺争论……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Were you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真的怀孕了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So what happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那后来怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you okay to carry on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你还能继续说下去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: At least he died doing what he felt was right...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少他在死的时候认为他是在做对的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm so sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wow. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哇。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For the company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为了你的陪伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s still work to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还有很多工作要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have my reasons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有我的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought the fact that we were together would be a good enough hint as to why I wanted to be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我以为我们在一起已经足够说明我为什么想留在这里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do I have to spell it out? I’m here because of you. [Confess feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 非得让我明说吗？我留在这里是因为你。[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I care about this team immensely. You're all... a family to me, now. One I've never really had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我非常在乎这个团队。现在你们都是我的家人。这是我以前从未真正拥有过的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm so sick of having this conversation with people. I'm not leaving. That's it. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真的厌倦了和人们反复讨论这个问题。我不会离开。就这样。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m attracted to YOU, Eleanor. For all sorts of reasons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我被你吸引住了，埃莉诺。出于各种原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought I already made that clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我以为我已经说得很清楚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t need a psych-eval. There’s nothing crazy about liking you. If you don’t feel the same way about me, please say so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不需要心理评估。喜欢你并不是什么疯狂的事。如果你对我没有同样的感觉，请直说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you don't feel the same way about me, just come out and say it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你对我没有同样的感觉，就直说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wow. Okay. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哇。好吧。没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know you’ve lost people. So have I. We’re not alone in that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道你失去了亲人。我也一样。我们并不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor, I’m not going anywhere. Right here, with you, is where I want to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，我哪儿也不去。我只想留在这里，和你在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Your glowing eyes keeping me awake at night?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你那双闪亮的眼睛让我彻夜难眠？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The mind reading?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 读心术？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The tongue?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那舌头？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s gross, but for you, I'll look past it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 挺恶心的，但为了你，我愿意忽略它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s not a problem for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对我来说不是问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly...? Kind of into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话……？有点喜欢它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. :) [Date Eleanor.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好。:) [和埃莉诺约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I... need some more time to think this over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我……需要更多时间来考虑这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How do you think the others are going to take it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你觉得其他人会怎么看？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s a nice idea. Though maybe not the security office, and not with the tannoy on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是个好主意。不过也许不是在保安办公室，而且也不要在开着扩音系统的情况下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What's a tannoy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 什么是扩音系统？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m here. It’s okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在呢。没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's not going to kill you, Eleanor. You're his sister. He knows that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，亚瑟不会杀你的。你是他的姐姐。他知道这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s not real. I don’t believe Arthur would ever hurt you, no matter how Infested you were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那不是真的。无论你被感染得多严重，我不相信亚瑟会伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sure Arthur wouldn't actually do that, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我相信亚瑟实际上不会这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe you should talk to Arthur about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许你应该和亚瑟谈谈这件事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: However bad you think your family was, it's nothing compared to some I've met.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 无论你认为你的家庭有多糟糕，与我见过的一些家庭相比，这根本不算什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait. What's your father got to do with this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等一下。你爸爸和这件事有什么关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re going to have to give me more than that if you want me to understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你想让我理解，你得给我更多的信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor. Please stop being obtuse on purpose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，请不要故意含糊其辞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then maybe you shouldn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那也许你不应该谈论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then maybe you should.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那也许你应该谈论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m not going anywhere. Give me the whole thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我哪儿也不去。告诉我整个故事吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can I get the abridged version?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可以给我一个简短版本吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Like what was happening to Suda that made her decide to become a Cephalon. I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就像苏达的情况，让她决定成为一个中枢。我理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Actually... no, we haven't really cured that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 实际上……不，我们还没有找到治疗方法……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That must have been frightening for you both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对你们俩来说一定很可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And now a lot of things make sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在很多事情都说得通了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And you’re scared that Arthur might do the same to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你害怕亚瑟也会对你做同样的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur isn't your father. He wouldn't do what he did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟不是你的爸爸。他不会做那种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Did you sleep better last night?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你昨晚睡得好些了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Did you have another nightmare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你又做噩梦了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re dreaming about me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你梦到我了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re dreaming about us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你梦到我们了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Awkward? This doesn’t sound good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 尴尬？这听起来不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't think you disturb easily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不认为你那么容易受到干扰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Falling down an endless flight of stairs?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是不是梦到从无尽的楼梯上摔下来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Could be important. With your ability, a dream might not be just a dream.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这可能很重要。以你的能力，一个梦可能不仅仅是一个梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You have got to be joking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你开玩笑的吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Jealous?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嫉妒了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You have got to be joking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你开玩笑的吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Jealous?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嫉妒了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's not how Warframes work. The Infestation in them is tamed, it's dormant. Except for Nidus, I guess, but he's a law unto himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 战甲不是这样运作的。它们体内的感染已经被驯服，处于休眠状态。我想 Nidus 除外，有自己的规则。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So the Techrot thinks I stole you from it, and now it wants you back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以科腐者认为我从它那里偷走了你，现在它想要你回去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's not how Warframes work. The Infestation in them is tamed, it's dormant. Except for Nidus, I guess, but he's a law unto himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 战甲不是这样运作的。它们体内的感染已经被驯服，处于休眠状态。我想 Nidus 除外，有自己的规则。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So the Techrot thinks I'm keeping you from going back to it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以科腐者认为我在阻止你回去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait, back up a bit. How do you know that’s what the Techrot is feeling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等一下，倒回去一点。你怎么知道这就是科腐者的感受？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But when you’re asleep it’s a different story, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但当你睡着的时候，情况就不同了，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I can see where this is going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我知道这是怎么回事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay, I guess that's it for us. How can I compete with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，看来我们就这样了。我怎么能和那种东西竞争呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I will *burn it all* before I let it take you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会*烧掉一切*，绝不让它带走你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm never going to let it take you, Eleanor. You're my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我绝不会让它夺走你，埃莉诺。你是我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're like family to me. I won't let it have you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你就像我的家人一样。我不会让它得逞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can do that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ...Noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……记住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That’s down to you, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是你做的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: BRB. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 马上回来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We have VERD-IE and drones like her. They looked after the plants on the Zariman. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们有环管-独立机和像她一样的无人机。它们负责照料扎里曼号上的植物。你是指这种东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sprink...lers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 洒水……器？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You seem in a good mood today. I’m glad to see that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你今天看起来心情不错。看到你这样我很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Isn’t that a bit like drugging people?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这不是有点像给人下药吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Broadcasting a positive mood? Why not. I can’t see how that’s any different to playing music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 传播积极情绪？为什么不呢？我看不出这和放音乐有什么不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So today’s the day I might see Arthur smile?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么今天我可能会看到亚瑟微笑吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait. She did what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等。她做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Back up. I missed something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 倒回去一下。我错过了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wow. Way to boost team morale, Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哇哦。亚瑟，真是个"提升团队士气"的好办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He can be such a charmer...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他可真会讨人喜欢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He has a lot on his shoulders. That takes a toll.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他肩上担负着很多责任。这对他的影响很大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like everyone else had gotten into YOUR head for a change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来这次反而像是别人进入了你的脑海。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That sounds like the kind of crap Lettie comes out with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这听起来像是莱蒂会说的废话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think he’d have found you. He’s pretty determined.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得他还是能找到你。他很有决心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The more likely scenario is that he would have died trying to find you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 更可能的情况是，他会在找你的过程中死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There's still time to change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在还有时间改变主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Aoi’s wonderful. I’m glad she was there for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 碧太棒了。我很高兴她在那里陪伴你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That was lucky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真幸运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You and Lettie both do that, you know. You forget to say "Hello."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你和莱蒂都这样，你知道吗。你们都忘了说"你好"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Most people would start with "hello."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 大多数人都会先说声"你好"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. I think you’re right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。我觉得你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe that’s what happened to Entrati’s family. They’ve been living right on top of his lab for years, without knowing it. When the kid found them, they were estranged, wallowing in spite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许这就是发生在英择谛家人身上的事。他们在他的实验室上方生活了多年，却一直不知情。当那孩子找到他们时，他们已经关系疏远，沉浸在怨恨之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think you're right. On the Zariman, the parents were the first to lose their minds. Maybe the Holdfasts held out as long as they did because none of them had any children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得你说得对。在扎里曼号，父母是最先失去理智的。也许坚守者能坚持这么久，是因为他们都没有孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't like to presume to understand things that are basically *gods.* This thing is trying to understand emotions. It's just doing a bad job of playing with its toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不喜欢假设去理解那些基本上可以称为*神*的事物。这个东西正在试图理解情感。它只是在玩弄自己的玩具，而且玩得很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's a great way to die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是一个很好的死法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know how we’re going to do it yet, but I’m with you. We have to win.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我还不知道我们该怎么做，但我支持你。我们必须赢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You said you were a ‘journalist'. Those aren't the sorts of stories you used to tell, are they? You told the truth, no matter how ugly it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说过你是一名"记者"。这些不是你过去讲的那种故事，对吧？你讲的是真相，无论它有多丑陋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We’re going to need more than fairy tales to get through this, no matter how inspiring they are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 要度过难关，我们需要的不仅仅是童话故事，无论它们有多么鼓舞人心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve lived in a kingdom made from stories. I know how powerful they can be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我生活在一个由故事构成的王国里。我知道故事的力量有多大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s stuck in the Wall. I’m not even sure what the Wall is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它被困在墙里。我甚至不确定那堵墙是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't think the Indifference is bound by any rules.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不认为虚空无情之物受到任何规则的约束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When did you stop being frightened of it, Eleanor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 埃莉诺，你是什么时候开始不再害怕它了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Always here for you. What’s on your mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我永远在这里支持你。你在想什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can't chat right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在没空聊，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t be so hard on yourself. You were in love with the guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别对自己太苛刻了。你爱过那个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I understand. Totally. I made a choice to remember my parents the way they deserved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我完全理解。我选择以我父母应得的方式来纪念他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What happened was terrible. There’s no getting around it. But we can’t let that be the only thing we hold on to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 发生的事情很可怕。这是无法避免的。但我们不能让这成为我们的心结。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because you’ve carried him for so long you don’t know how to stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为你心里一直放不下他，久到不知如何让自己放手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because you're worried no one else would ever be capable of loving you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为你担心再也没有人能真正爱你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I actually think Lettie could help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真的觉得莱蒂可以帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You could write him a letter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你可以给他写一封信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Talk to Arthur, maybe. He's been going through this grief with you from the start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许你可以和亚瑟谈谈。他从一开始就和你一起经历了这段悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She has a lot of experience. She knows all about commemorating the dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她有很多经验。她非常了解如何纪念逝者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m sure if you asked her for advice, respectfully, she wouldn’t turn you away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我相信如果你恭敬地向她寻求建议，她不会拒绝你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s got to be worth a try. Lettie’s not as heartless as people think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这值得一试。莱蒂没有人们想象的那么无情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ...And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……然后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Uh oh...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃噢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ...And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……然后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Uh oh...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃噢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That image will never leave my mind now. Thanks!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这画面现在永远留在我的脑海里了。谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't stop laughing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我笑得停不下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That image will never leave my mind now. Thanks!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这画面现在永远留在我的脑海里了。谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't stop laughing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我笑得停不下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The moment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个时刻？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The moment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个时刻？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I... oh. I'm not ready for that kind of commitment... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我……哦。我还没准备好做出那种承诺……对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It doesn’t matter. I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没关系，我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: YES.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let’s start with kissing and see where we end up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们先从亲吻开始，看看最后会走到哪一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let’s take it slow. Kissing is plenty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们慢慢来。亲吻就已经够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Who's Dandy Damage?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谁是丹迪·戴米奇？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You could always dress up as the Lotus, if you wanted to confuse people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你想迷惑别人的话，你可以打扮成 Lotus。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … you’re going to have to tell me what Fiendsnight is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你得先告诉我恶魔之夜是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Dressing up in costumes? Partying? In a war zone? Do you really think that's going to happen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 打扮变装？开派对？还是在战区？你真的觉得这些会发生吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know, Fiendsnight sounds a lot like Naberus. People like to dress up for that, too.
