/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道吗，恶魔之夜听起来和纳贝流士很像。人们也喜欢为那个活动打扮一番的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're the monster that I love, Eleanor.  I don't regret a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是我爱的怪物，埃莉诺。我一点也不后悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm starting to think you enjoy saying that about yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我开始觉得你喜欢这么说自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. Real monsters don't care for people the way that you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。真正的怪物可不会像你这样关心别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If that's what you really believe you are, then Fiendsnight is the perfect chance to celebrate it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你真的认为自己就是那样的人，那么恶魔之夜就是庆祝它的完美时机。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know you're scared of what you might become. But that's not you NOW.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道你害怕自己可能会变成什么样。但那不是现在的你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: BE the monster. Own it. For this one night of the year, wear that title with pride.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 成为怪物。拥有它。在这一年中的这一晚，自豪地佩戴这个称号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So dress up. Have fun. Void knows the Hex could all use some.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以，好好打扮。玩得开心。虚空知道六人组的每个人都用得上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why did he stop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他之前为什么不唱了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not exactly a fan, but if it makes him happy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不是他的粉丝，不过要是能让他开心的话我愿意做他的听众……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad. He's good at it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴。他唱得真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hard to believe someone as brave as Arthur could be scared like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很难相信像亚瑟这么勇敢的人会害怕成这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What's the crack in his armor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他护甲裂了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not enough moral support?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是因为精神支持不够？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Too many tough crowds?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 太多观众给差评了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's quite a visual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 场面太壮观了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't know that one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道那个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How did you convince him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是怎么说服他的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m sorry. It must be rough, not being able to sing any more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。不能再唱歌了，一定很难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe he just needed to remember how much he loved to do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许他只需要记住他有多喜欢做这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We don't have punk, but we do have Skeg.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们没有朋克，但我们有管道乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What happened to the band?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这乐队后来怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't blame him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我理解他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd have thought Velimir and Minerva were a bit too much like your actual parents.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得维利米尔和米尼娃有点太像你真正的父母了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Who's afraid of a little spit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谁会介意一点唾沫呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Spit? Sounds like a Technocyte Coda's idea of a good night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 吐口水？这听着像科技细胞终幕者对美好夜晚的理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s like music except you make it by hitting pipes. And vents. And Corpus helmets. And anything else you can find to hit, really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就像音乐，只不过你是通过敲击管道来演奏的。还有通风口。还有 Corpus 的头盔。还有其他任何你能找到的东西，真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s just pointless noise. Only Ventkids like it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就是指毫无意义的噪音。只有通风小子才喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s a Ventkid thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是通风小子的风格。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not really, no. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有过。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Like ‘What did people on Earth think when Lua suddenly appeared in the sky again?'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就像"当月球突然再次出现在天空中时，地球上的人们会怎么想？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You mean like ‘Operator! Might you consider having your Kubrow stuffed?'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你的意思就像"指挥官！您是否考虑过把您的库狛制作成标本？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That’s just Ordis. He does that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是 Ordis。他就会这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: In order: dunno, the Void, dunno.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 按顺序回答：不知道，虚空，不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Lotus sent her into the Void toward the end of the Old War. The kid brought her back out pretty recently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Lotus 在远古之战结束后将她送入了虚空。那个孩子最近才将她带了回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No idea about the tides.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不清楚潮汐的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s weird about that? Seems like a pretty basic question to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这有什么奇怪的？在我看来这是一个很基本的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … do people not think the Gods are real? I’m pretty sure Lettie does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……难道人们不认为神是真实存在的？我敢肯定莱蒂是相信的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah, that's a horrible thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是啊，那真是个可怕的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You just reminded me of something, back on the Zariman. The first time I met the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你刚才让我想起了一件事，那是在扎里曼号上我第一次遇到虚空无情之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe people are just less afraid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许人们只是不再那么害怕了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought Sol and Lua were your Gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我以为太阳神和月神是你们的神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I didn't know that was what it was then, of course. I remember what it said, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然，当时我并不知道那是什么。不过我记得它说了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Doesn't sound that different from life under the Orokin, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，这听起来和在奥罗金统治下的生活没什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I said it could take my light, and it grinned at me and said 'Thanks, kiddo. I think I will.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我说它可以拿走我的光，它冲我咧嘴一笑，说："小鬼，谢谢你。我想我会用到的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Immortal, petty, in charge because they were in charge...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 永生不死、心胸狭隘、掌权只是因为他们本就掌权……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. Light symbolises good, wherever you go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。无论你走到哪里，光都象征着美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The only lights humanity had, for a long long time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 人类在漫长的岁月里所拥有的唯一光明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're mixing me up with the kid. I never got to be part of the great Tenno insurrection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你把我跟那孩子搞混了。我从没参与过伟大的 Tenno 起义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It says we made a 'deal'. So I guess it thinks I owe it... something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它说我们明明约定好了。所以我想它认为我欠它……什么东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I meant the globelight I was carrying, but who knows what it meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我指的是我随身携带的灯球，但谁知道它说的是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods and humans... got together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 神与人……在一起了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Kings with Gods for parents? And I thought the Orokin were assholes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 国王的父母是神？我还以为奥罗金人就是混蛋呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Never got to be part of Margulis' program for Very Special Kiddies, never got a Warframe, never fought in the Old War.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 从来没参与过 Margulis 为"非常特别的孩子们"设立的项目，从没得到过战甲，也从来没参与过远古之战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know one thing about it, at least. It plays games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我至少知道一件事。它会捣鬼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I really don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 老实说，不想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah, I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，我想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you really think the Gods are real, though? Or is it just that you're scared of the idea that they might be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真的认为神是真实存在的吗？还是说，你只是害怕他们可能存在的想法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. So you’re saying: what if the people in the past were right all along?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。所以你的意思是：如果过去的人一直都是对的，那该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's not good, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 恐怕，不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: From what little I can tell, Techrot becomes a global problem. People solve it with nukes - or try to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 据我所知，科腐者成为了一个全球性问题。人们用核武器来解决它——或者尝试这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't think I should, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，我觉得我不该这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's how the first of the 'Radiation Wars' begins.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 第一次"辐射战争"就是这么开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you're forewarned about what's coming you might try to change it, and that could mean I never exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你预先知道将要发生的事情，你可能会试着改变它，而这可能意味着我永远不会存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Call me selfish, but I like existing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你可以说我自私，但我喜欢存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe that's partly why this year is so important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许这就是为什么今年如此重要的原因之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. From Höllvania to the Zariman Ten-Zero. It's a throughline.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。从霍瓦尼亚到扎里曼 10-0 号。这是一条贯穿线。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't share your view. The Universe is mindless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不同意你的观点。宇宙是没有思想的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I agree. If something as human as emotion can shape the Void...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我同意。如果像情感这样人性化的东西都能塑造虚空……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Unmanned drones, from what I remember.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我记得，是无人机。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or Cephalon-piloted terraforming pods. They experimented a LOT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或者中枢驾驶的地球改造舱。他们做了很多实验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: 'The Project', they called it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们称之为"计划"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: h
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: s

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... your H key has fallen off? Can't you get Amir to fix it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你的 S 键掉了？你不能让阿米尔来修一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: a
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: u

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What am I giving you an A in? Cryptic messaging?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这个 u 是什么的成绩？是秘密消息吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ngover?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: zui？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... this is too weird. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……这太怪了。我走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: hangover
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 宿醉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: HANGOVER!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: SUZUI！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: maybe you should pay Lettie a visit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许你该去看看莱蒂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: so... good night last night?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以……昨晚都还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: when you say 'bad' how bad do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当你说"糟糕"，你指的是有多糟糕？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'll let you sleep this off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我让你睡一觉醒来就好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lettie may have mentioned something happening at the bar?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 莱蒂可能提过酒吧那儿发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She was vague on the details.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她对细节含糊其辞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It doesn't really affect me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对我没什么影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I LOVE it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我超爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I like it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, right. The Voice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，对。那个声音。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Um... no. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯……没有。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not just now, sorry. [END.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在不行，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For you, always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对你，我永远有时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No, you're not a minefield.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不，你不是雷区。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I know what she meant, yeah. Sorry, but she's right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得我明白她的意思，是啊。抱歉，但她说得有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait, Kaya said this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等，卡娅这么说的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad Kaya called you out on it. I've said things here I thought were harmless and you've reacted like I set your hair on fire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴卡娅告诉了你。我在这里说过一些我以为无伤大雅的话，而你的反应却像是我把你的头发点着了似的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You have really extreme reactions sometimes. They're out of proportion to what I've said to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有时候，你的反应真的很大惊小怪，跟我和你说的话完全不符。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's like you leap straight to the worst possible interpretation of what I might have meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就像是你对我想表达的意思直接做出了最糟糕的解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sometimes you just quit the conversation entirely and I don't even get a chance to explain myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有时候你完全不说话，我甚至没机会解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe think about what you just said there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或许想想你刚才说的话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There you go. Boom. Minefield.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就是这样。砰。雷区。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you not see it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你还不明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think you need some time to think about that. [END.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得你需要点时间好好想想。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不是吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. You do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，你的确如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's what the Indifference calls me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是虚空无情之物对我的称呼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't know. It's Voidtongue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道。这是虚空语。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A few.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有几个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Netra is 'Decay', Xata is 'Truth', Ris is 'Light'...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Netra 代表"腐朽"，Xata 代表"真理"，Ris 代表"光明"……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lohk is 'Void', Oull is 'Possibility', Khra is 'Time'...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Lohk 是"虚空"，Oull 是"可能性"，Khra 是"时间"……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Be careful. It's more than just a language.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 小心点。这不仅仅是一种语言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've been called worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我被叫过更难听的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Seriously?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你认真的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I’ve never let him forget it. Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我从没让他忘记这一点。呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Happy ordinary day, mere human annoyance!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 平凡的日子快乐，一个凡人的烦恼！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you, dear Drifter. So am I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你，亲爱的漂泊者。我也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You didn’t check. Luckily for you I am indeed alive right now. Because this could have been bloody awkward, couldn’t it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你都没确认。幸好你看到我现在确实还活着。不然这会非常尴尬，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am. Everyone’s been very sweet, even those who are usually not. Maybe there’s hope for us yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很开心。大家都很贴心，即使是那些平时不那么贴心的人。也许我们还有希望？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thanks for reminding me that I haven’t had a birthday cake in years. Truly thoughtful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你提醒我，我已经好几年没吃生日蛋糕了。想得真周到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think the only thing that is at all annoying about this is that I found thoughts of them in your head first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得这件事唯一让我恼火的点，是我先在你脑海里发现了这种想法的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not that I don't know you weren't about to come ask politely for permission. Hello.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不是不知道，你打算礼貌地过来征求我的同意。你好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The answer is a very pouty, arms-crossed 'yes of course' while I sit here not thinking about you cavorting off with that very beautiful thing I glimpsed in your fantasies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 答案是一个撅着嘴，双臂交叉地回答"好，当然可以"，而我却只能坐在这里，忍住不想你去和我在你幻想中瞥见的那个美丽尤物寻欢作乐的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That are now in MY fantasies, as I am stuck here in this time and place, thank-you-very-much!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而现在这些都只存在于——我的——幻想中了，因为我被困在了这个时间和这个地点，我——谢——谢——你！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course it is! I can see them in your mind's eye. And if you trust them, then I trust them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然没问题！我能在你的心眼里看到他。如果你信任他，我就信任他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm just sad I don't get to play the field a bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是有点难过，我没机会脚踏几条船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But maybe I can vicariously through you, now there's a thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但或许我可以通过你来间接体验这种感觉，这倒是个不错的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Drifter. What you said yesterday. About letting the monster live. Did you mean it? I must know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 漂泊者。你昨天说了那些什么让怪物活下去之类的话。你是认真的吗？我可不能当作没听见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not that I'm not exceedingly grateful and honestly a little shocked, but... why? WHY would you let me live? When everyone else here would be so willing to put a bullet through my head?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 并不是说我不知道说谢谢，说实话我也有点震惊，但是……为什么？为什么当这里所有的人都想要把我一枪爆头的时候，你却选择让我活下去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you. You're an enigma to me in many ways, but now I know you'd be willing to put a bullet through my head, and that sort of thing is important in the workplace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你。你在很多方面对我来说都是一个谜，但现在我知道你愿意一枪打穿我的脑袋，这种事在职场上很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Aaaand I just felt the Techrot in my cells give an anxious little quiver.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而我刚刚感觉到细胞里的科腐者紧张地颤了一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think it's going to behave itself a little better from now on. Nothing like threatening the host to put the fear of Sol into the parasite, eh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想它接下来会老实一点了吧。没有什么比威胁宿主更能让寄生虫害怕的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How... beautifully naïve. And wonderfully sweet, in a tragic kind of way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 多么……纯真美丽。又带着一种悲剧性的甜美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But here you are, battling away at the Scaldra and the Techrot, trying to find a way to stop the Indifference. You clearly believe there is some line to be drawn somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但你在这里，与炽蛇军和科腐者战斗，试图找到阻止虚空无情之物的方法。你显然相信有些界限是需要划分的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The fact that you believe I would come out the other side some manner of hive queen with my self intact, some bizarre voice of the infestation you could befriend or perhaps even adore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你居然认为我最后会变成某种蜂巢女王，并依然保有自我，成为一个你可以交好或崇拜的科腐者的代表。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I would chide you for the fact that the world does not function like a storybook, yet... I am reminded of precisely who you are and where you came from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我本应点醒你，因为这个世界并非如童话书那样运作，然而……我想起了你的身份和你的来历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以我想我不应该感到惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Either way, I guess I am grateful you wouldn't kill me. There's that. At least.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不管怎样，我想我还是很感激你不会杀我。至少算是个安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But the Techrot is not the Indifference. What of that? What of the more biological, terrestrial threat?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但科腐者并非虚空无情之物。那又有什么关系？对于那些更生物的、更地球化的威胁怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And what if nothing of Eleanor remained? What if you saw nothing but a hissing, snarling, spitting beast?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果埃莉诺什么都没留下，那该怎么办？如果你看到的只是一头嘶嘶作响、咆哮着、吐着唾沫的野兽，那该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And if the Techrot turned out to be another man-unleashed aberration like your Man in the Wall? What then? Would you hunt me down and kill me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那如果科腐者被证实也像你们那个墙中人一样，是由人类释放出来的另一种异类呢？那会怎样？你会追捕我，然后杀了我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: While I'm grateful that you would abide by a monstrous lady's wishes, I suppose was hoping for something a bit more... considered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虽然我很感激你能遵从这位怪物女士的意愿，但我想我还是希望得到一些更……深思熟虑的回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Either way, I guess I am grateful you wouldn't kill me. There's that. At least.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不管怎样，我想我还是很感激你不会杀我。至少算是个安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just when I simply thought I could not adore you more I find myself once more sitting here crying happy tears
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就在我以为我无法更爱你的时候，我又一次发现自己坐在这里流下了幸福的泪水

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have to go but thank you thank you THANK YOU
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我必须走了，但谢谢你，谢谢你，真的谢谢你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're contradicting yourself. If you're willing to stop one manmade aberration, why not two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你在自相矛盾。如果你愿意阻止一种人造怪物，为什么不愿意阻止两种呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you. You're an enigma to me in many ways, but now I know you'd be willing to put a bullet through my head, and that sort of thing is important in the workplace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你。你在很多方面对我来说都是一个谜，但现在我知道你愿意一枪打穿我的脑袋，这种事在职场上很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Aaaand I just felt the Techrot in my cells give an anxious little quiver.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而我刚刚感觉到细胞里的科腐者紧张地颤了一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think it's going to behave itself a little better from now on. Nothing like threatening the host to put the fear of Sol into the parasite, eh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想它接下来会老实一点了吧。没有什么比威胁宿主更能让寄生虫害怕的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh... oh, what have I done...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦……哦，我这是做了什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, Eleanor, you stepped in it this time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，埃莉诺，这次你可是闯大祸了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Quincy came to me and said the absolutely strangest thing. That you wanted to talk to me... about your 'feelings?'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 昆西来找我，说了一件非常奇怪的事。说你想跟我谈谈……关于你的"感情"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well... seems like a poor choice for me to hold a grudge given our situation. If you mean it? I forgive you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯……考虑到我们的情况，继续抱怨似乎不太合适。如果你是认真的？那我原谅你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I... see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我……明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And... truth be told? I can't help but admit that I've been harbouring some feelings for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而且……说实话？我不得不承认，我也一直对你抱有一些感情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you're serious about wanting to give 'this' a go, between us? I'd be willing to do the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你是认真想尝试我们之间的"这段关系"？我也愿意尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I would be keen to remind you that you had your chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很想提醒你，你曾经有过机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And why have you kept this to yourself until now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你为什么到现在才说出来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Seems so. Well. If you'd like to give 'this' a go, I would be more than happy to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 看来是这样。好吧。如果你愿意尝试一下"这件事"，我会非常乐意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But I'd also be lying if I didn't admit that I missed you and would be willing to give this another go, if you were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但如果我不承认我很想念你，并且如果你愿意的话，我也愿意再尝试一次，那我就是在说谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As would I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mmm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s about two things, honestly. Control and art.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，主要是两个原因。控制和艺术。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. How sweet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊。真贴心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can I suggest you find something else with which to occupy your time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以建议你找点别的事情来打发时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am, after all, the very picture of frailty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 毕竟，我可是脆弱的典型代表。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Try prancing up to Arthur and asking about his haemorrhoids.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 试试走到亚瑟面前，问候一下他的痔疮情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is your first and only warning. I am not an exhibit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是你的第一次也是最后一次警告。我不是展品。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Look. I was raised to be polite. It's a Britannic thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 看。我从小就被教导要有礼貌。这是不列颠尼克人的传统。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because I have to compose every sentence. I don’t just get to dump meaning wholesale into your head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为我得精心推敲每一句话。我不能直接把所有的意思都扔进你的脑袋里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Perhaps you'd like to mop my brow as I recline upon my fainting couch?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许在我虚弱地躺着时，你会想替我擦擦额头？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Politeness is all about not letting the other person know how you feel about them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 礼貌的精髓在于不让别人知道你对他们的真实感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That would be easy. Lazy. Uninteresting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那样的话就太过简单了。太懒了。也无趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which is hard, when your mind is effectively plugged into theirs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当你的思想与对方直接相连时，这变得尤其困难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Telepathy is about as nuanced as a boot up the arse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 心灵感应的精妙程度，简直跟屁股挨一脚一样粗暴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 小心点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I bite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会咬人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah! You are being circumspect. Treating me as the fearsome lamia I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊！你真是谨慎。把我当作了那个可怕的蛇妖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You should have met me BEFORE I was infested.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你应该在我被感染之前遇到我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For instance, right now I could be feeling like wrapping your guts around a stick...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 比如，现在我可能正想把你的肠子缠在棍子上……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: By comparison, text is fascinating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 相比之下，文字就迷人多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... or feeling giddy as a schoolgirl because you’re finally talking to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……或者因为你终于和我说话而兴奋得像个小女生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Largely because of what it doesn't say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很大程度上在于它的留白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You don’t know. But if this were a telepathic conversation, you would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你无法得知。但如果这是一场心灵感应的对话，你就会知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Exactly. Before Höllvania, before the Techrot, I depended on text to make my living. Now it’s just a luxury. A whimsy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错。在霍瓦尼亚之前、科腐者之前，我靠文字谋生。现在这只是一种奢侈。一种异想天开的事物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Something to play with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可以拿来玩玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: To pass the time while I wait for my body to turn into a chimera I barely recognize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等待身体变成我几乎无法辨识的混合体时的消遣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, yes. After all...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，当然了。毕竟……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Until I choose to, yes. Perhaps it's silly to try to be civilized in this shithole. But...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在我选择表露之前，是的。也许在这个破地方试图保持文明是愚蠢的。但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... we all have our little ways of staying sane, don't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我们都有自己保持理智的方式，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can you blame me for taking every inch of privacy I can get?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你不会怪我尽力保留仅剩的隐私吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Clearly I made the right choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 显然我做了正确的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Shrewd question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 机智的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you asking out of concern, or idle curiosity?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是出于关心而问这个问题，还是出于纯粹的好奇？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Alive and now mildly annoyed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我还活着，只是现在有些许恼火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Cheerio.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 保重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They're so... human. So petty. Like bickering Gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们太……像人了。小心眼。就像争吵不休的众神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh. Oh my.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦。天哪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's a living metaphor and a fabulous wish-fulfilment paradise AND sheer hell
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它既是一个活生生的隐喻，又是一个实现愿望的美好天堂，同时也是一个纯粹的地狱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry, that must seem so obvious to you. But to me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，这对你来说可能显而易见。但对我来说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And so very much themselves, even though they're... what was the word? Wormed. Through and through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而他们依然保持着自我，尽管他们……是什么词来着？被蛀蚀了。从头到脚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Natah, Margulis, Lotus. Three queens in darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Natah、Margulis、Lotus。黑暗中的三位女王。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You did not mention the endless executions bit. For all you know, I might have LIKED the endless executions bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你没有提到那无休止的处决。据你所知，我可能会喜欢那无休止的处决呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So many times I've been convinced we were just going to fizzle out on this rock
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 多少次我都以为，我们就要在这颗星球上逐渐走向灭亡了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't pretend I understand Entrati any better after seeing this lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 看完这些，我还是无法装作更懂英择谛的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just want to sit at her knee and listen to her talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只想坐在她的膝旁听她讲话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I'm going to need to step away and process this. Dear Sol in heaven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我需要离开一下，消化一下这一切。天哪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But we don't. We carry on. Thank you for showing me that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我们没有。我们继续前行。感谢你让我看到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But it's a comfort to know that whatever else may have changed in your time, families are still at one another's throats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但令人感到安慰的是，无论你的时代发生了怎样的变化，家庭成员之间的争吵始终如一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And now I'm torn between being grateful that you've shown her to me and murderously jealous that you get to be her Champion and I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在我很矛盾，一方面我很感激你让我见到了她，另一方面我又嫉妒得发狂，因为你能成为她的拥护者，而我不能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you mind if I pick your brain?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你介意我探索你的脑海吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not literally, ha ha.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不是字面意思，哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Imagine, me scraping bits of jelly out of your trepanned skull!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想象一下，我从你被开颅后的脑袋里刮出像胶状物的东西！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, I'm curious about you. Where you come from, what you've lived through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其实，我对你很好奇。你来自哪里，经历过什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I saw some, as you know, and I'd love to see more. But only if you're willing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道的，我看到过一些，我很想看到更多。但前提是你愿意的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那就随你吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Last time I probed you, you were freshly puked out of an Infested nightmare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 上一次我探查你的时候，你刚刚被一只感染怪物吐出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I had to place the security of the Hex above courtesy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我那时不得不将六人组的安全置于礼貌之上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If that's a dealbreaker for you, I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果这对你来说是一件无法接受的事情，我理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: WELL.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let’s say you felt like taking me on a whistle-stop tour of your favourite memories. Where would YOU start?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 假设你想带我快速浏览你最美好的回忆。你会从哪里开始？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh for Sol's sake, grow up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，看在太阳神的份上，成熟点吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I love how you just throw that out so casually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真喜欢你这么轻描淡写地抛出这句话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, excuse us for being slow off the mark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，不好意思我们起步晚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Entrati has a family?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 英择谛还有家人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, you are speaking my language extremely fluently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，你说的话很合我意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: "Oh, just a kingdom, I have loads."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "噢，只是一个王国，我有好多个呢。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Though... we aren't taking the best care of this place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过……我们确实没怎么好好照顾这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Entrati's had SEX?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 英择谛居然有过性生活？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Who is she to YOU, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但，对你而言她又是谁呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hmmm. I'm not sure I'll like you if you turn out to be royalty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。如果你真是皇室成员，我可不确定是否会喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The thought of what mankind could have done to other worlds makes me queasy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想想人类可能对其他星球做了什么，我就感到恶心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I genuinely cannot imagine what sort of ghoulish gallery might be in store here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真的无法想象这里可能会有什么样的阴森展览在等着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And why is she a 'The' and not a 'Mrs' or a 'Queen' or whatnot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还有，为什么称呼她为"那个"，而不是"夫人"或者"女王"之类的呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不介意我进入你的脑海看看吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不介意我进入你的脑海看看吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不介意我进入你的脑海看看吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mind if I step inside your mind and take a look?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不介意我进入你的脑海看看吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is... *astonishing*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这实在是……*太惊人了*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... there's a future. We make it. As a species.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……未来是存在的。作为一个种族，我们会创造它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So. The Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么。关于虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm honestly quite curious about it. So...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，我真的很好奇。所以……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... would it be okay to just fire some questions at you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我可否直接向你提一些问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... and thus you retain that aura of cryptic mystery I so admire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……因此，你保持着令我欣赏不已的神秘气质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Your honesty is noted and appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你的坦诚我记住了，也非常感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Excellent. So...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 太好了。那么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … how would you sum up what the Void means to you, in a few words?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你能用几句话来总结虚空对你意味着什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. Old habits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。老习惯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fascinating though all that is, it sounds technical. I was more interested in what it means to you. Since you seem to, well, live and breathe it. Literally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虽然这些听起来很有趣，但听起来有些技术性。我更感兴趣的是它对你意味着什么。因为你看起来就像是，呃，在为它而活。字面上的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Forgive me. I’m not a journo anymore, and you’re not the story. I’m just deeply interested.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请原谅我。我不再是记者了，你也不是我报道的对象。我只是非常感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Get personal with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 讲讲你的个人感受吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m sorry. Now I feel like a heel for asking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很抱歉。我现在觉得自己提这个问题有些失礼了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Did they recover?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们有恢复吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ooh. You have my full attention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦。你完全引起了我的注意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: By shape you mean… Duviri? Towers and islands and flying horses?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说的"塑造"是指……双衍王境？那些塔楼、岛屿和飞马？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What shape did it take?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它变成了什么样子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Sol. That’s horrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢，天哪。这真是太糟糕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Would you rather not talk about this right now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你现在是不是不太想谈这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And this was real? It didn’t feel like a dream?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是真实的吗？感觉不像是梦境吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Another time, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那就下次再谈吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Separating parents from children. Turning one against the other. That doesn’t sound coincidental to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 父母和孩子被迫分开，互相反目。这在我看来并非偶然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That sounds like conscious intent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这更像是有意为之。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Like twisted science, almost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 几乎像是扭曲的科学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I…
So they’re not one and the same thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以他们不是同一个存在？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have to wonder what that’s like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很好奇那是什么样的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Words, brought to life. A concrete reality, conjured out of nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 文字被赋予了生命。从虚无创造出了具体的现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fascinating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 精彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And why is that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么这么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait. Wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等一下。等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void is a miracle engine, is what you’re saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是说，虚空是一种奇迹引擎？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I'm already connected to it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而我已经与它产生了连接？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean I’m a Warframe. Or a Protoframe. I’m like them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的意思是，我是一个战甲，或者说是原型战甲。我和他们一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I can do things now. Mind control. Face melting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我现在能做这些事情了。精神控制，或者融化别人的脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is that where the power’s coming from IN ME? The Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的这些力量是从虚空来的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: One sec. Getting comfortable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 稍等。我调整一下坐姿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. As you were. I can’t wait to hear this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好了，你接着说。我迫不及待地想听听这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 既然这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If there’s no Heart of Deimos in my time, then how is the Void reaching me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果在我的时代没有惊惧之心，虚空怎么能接触到我呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because I can feel it, you know. I’m sure I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我能感觉到它。我很确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘Magic' seems too small a word for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 用"魔法"这个词来形容它似乎太过狭隘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What you’re describing is divine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你所描述的更像是神迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s it like? Having the freedom to swan about in a city filled with plague and know you’ll never have to worry about catching it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是什么感觉？在一个瘟疫肆虐的城市里自由自在地闲逛，而且知道自己永远不用担心被感染？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ll speak as I like, thank you very much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我爱怎么说就怎么说，非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, come on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，得了吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve seen how you work. You might have been human once, but now you’re Spanglyboots the Space Elf. All spooky light shows and mystic powers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我见识过你的本事。你可能曾经是人类，但现在你变成了闪靴太空精灵。全是诡异的光影表演和神秘力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t think you can be killed. Not forever. And I know how hard people have tried.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不认为你能被杀死。至少不会永远被杀死。而且我知道，有人曾经多么努力地试过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fine. You got me. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。你说对了。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Eleanor's being a bitter lemon today.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 今天的埃莉诺是个柠檬精。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sol, I miss the taste of lemons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天啊，我真的很怀念柠檬的味道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You don’t act scared of the Techrot. Why should you? You have no reason to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你一点都不怕科腐者。你有什么理由害怕呢？你没有理由害怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re not going to catch it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你不会被感染的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nothing I'd be proud to admit to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没什么值得拿出来说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But thanks for checking in, regardless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过还是谢谢你的关心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Heh. That was Entrati's whole schtick. Back when he first appeared with the whole ‘Doktor Friday' medicine show bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哈。那正是英择谛惯用的噱头。当初他刚出现时，搞了一整个"星期五博士"的医药秀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I suppose not. And I have no business speculating, really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我猜也是。而且我确实也没资格去猜测。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It just galls me to see you so above it all, you know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只是看到你一副超然于一切的样子，我心里不是滋味，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods, I remember now. Eris. The hulks. The surface of Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，天啊，我现在想起来了。阋神星。那些废弃船只。火卫二的表面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I keep forgetting we don’t win against the Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我总是忘记我们无法战胜科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ignore me. Oozing blemishes are ugly enough. Self-pity is uglier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别理我。流露出来的瑕疵已经够难看的了。自怜更甚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Makes one wonder why he never got infected. His family did, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 让人不禁疑惑他为何没被感染。毕竟，他的家人都被感染了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He managed to protect himself from succumbing, at least. Maybe he’s more like you than you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少他设法保全了自己免于感染。或许他比你想象的更像你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It makes what we're trying to do here feel pointless, almost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这几乎让我们在这里的努力显得毫无意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sol. Here I am feeling sorry for myself for being a plague victim, and dumping on you for being immune, and you've seen whole worlds get eaten by the selfsame poxy crud.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪。我因为自己是瘟疫的受害者在这里自怜自艾，还因为你对它免疫而埋怨你，而你已经目睹了整个世界被同样的瘟疫吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Höllvania’s had a whole bunch of would-be saviours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚有过很多想要成为救世主的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Princess, back in the day. Then Entrati. Viktor. My brother, of course. Now you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 早些年有公主，然后是英择谛，还有维克多。当然还有我的弟弟。现在是你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you see yourself as a hero?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你认为自己是英雄吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I’ll count what blessings I have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我应该好好想想自己有多幸福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Good enough. Carry on, soldier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很好。战士，继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I simply cannot understand how you were trapped in a storybook kingdom and STILL haven’t outgrown that sort of thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我实在无法理解，你曾经被困在故事集王国里，到现在居然还没成熟起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad. Someone who's lived as many centuries as you have OUGHT to be a grown-up by now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴。像你这样活了几个世纪的人，早该成熟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Good for you. Because I’ve seen what happened when one little boy thought he’d go off on a Hero’s Journey and started thinking of the rest of us as his supporting characters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对你来说是件好事。因为我见过一个小男孩以为自己踏上了英雄之旅，却把我们其他人都当成了他的配角时会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let’s get this straight. Lettie doesn’t think I’m sick. Lettie thinks I’m a demon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 让我们把事情说清楚。莱蒂并不认为我生病了。莱蒂认为我是个恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wonder what it’s like to have such a romantic view of the world. You’d think a medic would deal in measurable facts. Ten CC of this, identify the microbes of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很好奇拥有这么浪漫的世界观会是什么感觉。你以为医生会依据具体的事实操作，比如打十毫升的药物，识别某种微生物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's not unpleasant, which is more than you can say for most parasitic infestations.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还算可以，这已经比大多数寄生虫感染要好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can feel the Technocytes swimming in my blood. If I close my eyes I can see sparkles like fairy dust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我能感觉到科技细胞在我的血液中游动。如果我闭上眼睛，我可以看到像仙尘一样闪闪发光的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Have you heard what she calls me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你听见她怎么叫我了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yep. She sits there smirking with her phials and potions, her bottles of blood and slivers of skin, her army of ratty familiars skittering all over the place, and she has the temerity to call ME a witch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错。她坐在那里，带着嘲讽的笑容，摆弄她的试剂瓶和药水，还有那些装着血液和皮肤碎片的小瓶子，她那一群像使魔的老鼠到处乱窜，她居然还敢叫我女巫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘La Bruja Metiche'. The nosy witch. I suppose she could do far worse, considering her vocabulary and flair for creative obscenities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "La Bruja Metiche"。多管闲事的巫婆。考虑到她的词汇量和脏话创造天赋，我猜她完全可以说得更难听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It means me well. Can you understand that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它对我是善意的。你能理解吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have heard her tell Quincy to do some rather inventive things with playground fixtures and parts of his anatomy that left me chuckling over the visual for some time, I must admit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我曾听到她让昆西用操场设施和他自己身体的某些部分做一些相当有创意的事，我必须承认，我想象出来的画面让我笑了很久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yet she sits there smirking with her phials and potions, her bottles of blood and slivers of skin, her army of ratty familiars skittering all over the place, and she has the temerity to call ME a witch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但她坐在那里，带着嘲讽的笑容，摆弄她的试剂瓶和药水，还有那些装着血液和皮肤碎片的小瓶子，她那一群像使魔的老鼠到处乱窜，她居然还敢叫我女巫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everything it does, it does out of a sincere wish to fix me up and make me better. If I'm quick and lethal and hard to kill, I'll be a good host. So it fulfills its part of our symbiotic bargain by giving me shark skin and wolf fangs, along with a tongue like a leather whip.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它所做的一切，都是出于真诚的愿望，希望修复我，如果我够敏捷、够致命并且难以杀死，我就会成为一个好的宿主。因此，它履行了我们共生协议的一部分，赋予了我鲨鱼的皮肤、狼的牙齿，以及像皮鞭一样的舌头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, yes. Living the way we do, how could one not believe in the spiritual world?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。以我们的生活方式，怎么可能不相信精神世界的存在呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm still Eleanor Nightingale. That's more important to me than being ‘human' is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我依然是埃莉诺·南丁格尔。这对我来说比作为"人"更重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t get me wrong. I WOULD piss on her if she was on fire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别误会我的意思。如果她着火了，我会去撒尿灭火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think you can guess the answer to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想你应该能猜到答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know. Sometimes I do, too. I have a recurring nightmare where I rip her throat out just as she puts a bullet through my heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道。有时候，我自己也这么觉得。我经常做同个噩梦，梦见我撕开了她的喉咙，而她也正好将子弹射入我的心脏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've seen what human beings are capable of. We're not special. In fact, going by what I've seen in your head, we get even worse over time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我已经见识过人类的能力。我们并没有什么特别的。事实上，从我在你的脑海中看到的情况来看，随着时间的推移，我们甚至会变得更糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But I’d take my time over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我不会着急。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But being afraid of something doesn’t make it real. So far I have gone on zero bloody rampages. ZERO.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是害怕某件事并不意味着它会成真。到目前为止，我还没有发生过任何血腥暴行。零。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Amir’s caused more sodding injuries than I have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 阿米尔造成的伤害还比我多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But Amir is sweet and a bit ditzy, isn’t he? Amir doesn’t have teeth that could gnaw open a tin of rations. So nobody sees Amir as a bomb waiting to go off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但阿米尔很可爱，有点傻乎乎的，不是吗？阿米尔没有能咬开口粮罐头的牙齿。因此没人认为阿米尔是颗定时炸弹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well. Except Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。除了昆西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void is proof positive that the spiritual is just as real as the material. All your people have done, aside from putting a different name on it, is develop a reliable means of getting there and back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空就是精神世界像物质世界一样真实的有力证明。你们所做的，除了给它起了个不同的名字，就是开发了一种可靠的方法来往返其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Listen. Just because I admit the existence of demonic forces doesn’t mean I’m content to be written off as one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听着。我承认恶魔力量的存在，并不意味着我愿意被当成一个恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I never said that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我从未那样说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As opposed to following the agenda of a twisty little double helix of nucleotides? You know, that thing humans have done since they started walking upright?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而不是遵循那串扭来扭去的核苷酸双螺旋的计划？你知道吗，那是人类自从直立行走以来一直在做的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The likes of Viktor Vodyanoi - and what kind of sobriquet is THAT to choose for yourself - justify their backward views by claiming they are ‘natural'. Biological fundamentalism. Man as the mirror of the Divine and all of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 像维克多·维德诺伊这样的人——还有谁会为自己选择那样的称号——他们通过声称自己是"自然的"来为自己的落后观点辩护。这是生物学上的原教旨主义。人被视为神的镜像之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Some people think humanity is sacred. People like Viktor. I'm the ultimate blasphemy in his eyes. Infected, shameless and female.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有些人认为人类是神圣的。像维克多那样的人。在他眼里，我是最大的亵渎。被感染了、无耻并且还是女性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: "Me not do bidding of microscopic tyrant! Me human being. Me special! Find mate. Reproduce. Protect territory. Ug."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "我不听从微观暴君！我人类。我特别！寻找伴侣。繁衍后代。保护领土。呃。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But we've been unnatural from the moment we started banging rocks together. Language is a virus, mate. Being human is the blank slate we get to scribble on, not the primal Eden we were kicked out of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但从我们开始用石头敲打的那一刻起，我们就已经不自然了。伙计，语言是一种病毒。做人就是在一张白纸上自由涂鸦，而非追求当初我们被逐出伊甸园之前的那个状态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s happening in my system is the result of quite mundane atoms and molecules waltzing together in unexpected and remarkable ways. Any spiritual significance to that will be imparted by me. Not Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我体内发生的事情是普通原子和分子以意想不到的非凡方式共舞的结果。任何关于这一点的精神意义将由我来赋予。而不是莱蒂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t get me wrong. I WOULD piss on her if she was on fire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别误会我的意思。如果她着火了，我会去撒尿灭火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think you can guess the answer to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想你应该能猜到答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know. Sometimes I do, too. I have a recurring nightmare where I rip her throat out just as she puts a bullet through my heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道。有时候，我自己也这么觉得。我经常做同个噩梦，梦见我撕开了她的喉咙，而她也正好将子弹射入我的心脏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But I’d take my time over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我不会着急。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But being afraid of something doesn’t make it real. So far I have gone on zero bloody rampages. ZERO.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是害怕某件事并不意味着它会成真。到目前为止，我还没有发生过任何血腥暴行。零。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Amir’s caused more sodding injuries than I have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 阿米尔造成的伤害还比我多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But Amir is sweet and a bit ditzy, isn’t he? Amir doesn’t have teeth that could gnaw open a tin of rations. So nobody sees Amir as a bomb waiting to go off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但阿米尔很可爱，有点傻乎乎的，不是吗？阿米尔没有能咬开口粮罐头的牙齿。因此没人认为阿米尔是颗定时炸弹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well. Except Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。除了昆西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean… yes. You're right. There are parasites that do that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的意思是……是的。你说得对。确实有些寄生虫能做到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But what if it's not a parasite? What if it's a symbiote?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但如果它不是寄生虫呢？如果它是共生体呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And what's so bloody wonderful about being an unabsorbed moon? Why is the Infested version not an improvement?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，未被吞噬的卫星又有什么了不起的呢？被感染的版本为什么不能是一种改进？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh no! A lump of indifferent space rock that could have drifted aimlessly for another few millennia is suddenly alive and interesting! What a catastrophe!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦不！一块原本可以漫无目的地漂流几千年的普通太空岩石，突然有了生命力！还变得这么有趣！真是一场灾难！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's the exact same bullshit Viktor's crew come out with. Sentimental clinging on to whatever something USED to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这和维克多团队的废话没什么两样。因为情感而坚持原来的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As if being primordial was the same as being perfect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就好像原始的就是完美的一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Remind me, what are your Warframes made of again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 提醒我一下，你的战甲是由什么制成的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You think I don't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你以为我没有吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you have any idea what it takes to keep the rage in check? Do you know what the price of this outward serenity is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道控制这股怒火需要多大的力气吗？你知道维持这种表面的平静要付出多大的代价吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you see me meditating, I'm not communing with the great cosmic cabbage. I'm cooling down the sodding reactor core.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你看到我在冥想，那不是我在与宇宙的伟大进行精神交流，而是我是在冷却那该死的"反应堆核心"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But their Infestation was shaped and controlled, wasn’t it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但他们受到的感染是被塑造和控制过的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just like the Infestation that’s in me now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就像现在我体内的感染一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There's SO much I could do and DON'T. Places I could take this... stuff... that you haven't even considered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我能做的事情太多了，而我还没有去做。我能把这些……东西……带到你们甚至没想过的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which means someone, somewhere had the guts to stop thinking of the Infestation as a brainless monster and start looking at what it could become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这意味着某个地方的某个人有勇气不再将感染者看作无脑的怪物，而是开始探索它的潜能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could walk into their DREAMS. And they wouldn't even know I'd been there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以走进他们的梦中。他们甚至都不会知道我去过那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well. This has been an interesting, if uncouth, exchange of views. I had a lovely time. Let's do it again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。这次观点的交流虽然有些粗鲁，但很有趣。我玩得很开心。我们下次再来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know, you’re getting quite emotional. We should finish this conversation another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道吗，你情绪有点激动了。我们应该下次再继续这个话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The last time I got hit with a biochemical sledgehammer that left me sprawled on a couch for half the day and had people whispering behind my back that I was turning into a monster, it was called ‘puberty'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 上次我被生化重锤击中，瘫在沙发上半天起不来，还听人背后议论我变成了怪物，那叫"青春期"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是个很长的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Idyllic. We never fought, not even once. We kept one another’s secrets. He even let me braid his hair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 田园诗般的生活。我们从不吵架，一次都没有。我们互相保守秘密。他甚至还让我给他编辫子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No wonder everyone else is jealous of me and wants Arthur to be their brother, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 难怪别人都嫉妒我，也想让亚瑟当他们的弟弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Later, assuming you haven't skipped town and I haven't mutated into a raging shapeless wad of muscle tissue and mouths.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 留到以后吧，前提是你没有逃离小镇，我也没有变成一团狂暴的、满是肌肉和嘴巴的无形怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Perhaps, once I’m sure you won’t go running back and forth between Arthur and me, comparing notes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或许，一旦我确定你不会在我和亚瑟之间来回跑，对比我们俩说的话，我就可以告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because you might learn things about certain people that you might find hard to stomach.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为你可能会发现关于某些人的事情让人难以忍受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can’t imagine he’s opened up to you much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我无法想象他对你那么敞开心扉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Aren't I cryptic? Like a Sphinx. Rarr.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我是不是很神秘？就像狮身人面像一样。吼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Actually, he did do that. Until quite recently, in fact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对，他真的让我这么做过。其实一直到最近还这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wish he would wear eyeliner more often. He claims it’s too much of a faff. Prefers burnt cork.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我希望他能更常画眼线。他觉得那样太麻烦，更喜欢用烧焦的软木塞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur thinks there are some things you shouldn't talk about. He's old-fashioned like that. ‘Bad for morale', he'll say. ‘Camp chatter.' ‘Careful, might be circulating enemy propaganda.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟认为有些事情是不应该谈论的。他就是这么老派。他会说，"有损士气"、"营地闲聊。"、"小心，这可能是敌方的舆论战手段。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, it runs deep in our family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，这在我们家是传统。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which is just what I want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这正是我想要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The smudgy dark-eyed look does suit him, but he doesn’t know when to stop with the eyeshadow. He tries to be a moody stubble god, all folded arms and 2am bus stops, but then he keeps going and ends up as a hungover emo panda. And he wonders why people don’t take him seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那种深色烟熏眼妆确实适合他，可他就是不知道什么时候该停手不画眼影。他试图保持一副忧郁的帅气男人形象，双臂交叉，在凌晨 2 点的公交车站，但总是过头，最后变成了一只宿醉的情绪化熊猫。他还想不通为什么别人不把他当回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That is entirely your prerogative and I will not judge you for your choice
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这完全是你的权利，我不会因为你的选择而评判你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I will even wish you happy hunting, if you are so inclined
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你愿意，我甚至会祝你好运

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: HOW DARE YOU
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你怎么敢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do not disparage the sacred ritual that is Doing One Another's Makeup
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不要轻视这种神圣的仪式——为彼此化妆

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: HOWEVER
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We are not even close to being well enough acquainted for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们还没熟到那个程度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If I suspect FOR ONE INSTANT that you are using anything I choose to share with you as leverage to get into his armoured pants...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我发现你用我分享的任何东西来作为接近他护甲裤的手段……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I will be every inch the monster people think I am, for long enough to make you wish you were back in the execution circus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我会变成人们眼中的那个怪物，让你恨不得回到那处刑场的马戏团里去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry, let me just catch my breath a moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，让我先喘口气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I'm not saying never. Okay? And it only just occurred to me that this might be the first time, for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我不是说永远不可以。好吗？我刚刚才意识到，这对你来说可能是第一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So I'll give you a pass, this once. But in all seriousness, it's not the sort of thing to joke about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以这次我不计较。但说真的，这不是能开玩笑的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It meant a lot for Arthur to trust me like that. It meant even more that I was able to make him feel genuinely good about himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟那样信任我，对我意义重大。能让他真正感觉好些，对我来说意义更大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Blimey. I feel like owe you an apology now, and I don't really do those.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪。我现在感觉我欠你声道歉，我通常不会这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let's chalk this one up to experience, eh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们就当是一次经验教训吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Dad used to have an old Army poster from the ‘37 Bombardment on the wall in the downstairs loo. A square-jawed loyal soldier is punching out a scrawny moaner whose glasses go flying off. Caption: "Slap the chap who flaps his trap with crap!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 爸爸曾经在楼下厕所的墙上贴了一张 1937 年轰炸期间的旧陆军海报。一位下巴方正的忠诚士兵正在揍一个瘦弱爱抱怨的人，他的眼镜飞了出去。标题是："教训那个满嘴胡言的家伙！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur loved it because it was ‘rude'. He took its lesson to heart, though. ‘Don't talk about things that could hurt the people we care about.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟很喜欢这句话，因为它很"直率"。不过他确实把这句话的教训牢记在心。"不要谈论那些可能会伤害我们在乎的人的事情。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Precisely. It's all very well and good until it's being invoked to shut you up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 正是。这一切听起来很好，直到有人用这个理由来让你闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All very well until it’s being invoked to shut you up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这一切听起来很好，直到有人用这个理由来让你闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All my life there have been things we NEEDED to talk about. There are conversations we SHOULD have had. Granny Callie. Christopher. The Cavona Mansion. They festered between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一生中有太多的事情是我们需要谈论的。有些对话我们本应进行。卡莉奶奶。克里斯托弗。卡沃纳庄园。这些问题一直在我们之间溃烂化脓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But no. Talking about it was Simply Not Done. Too much at stake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但不，谈论这些事情简直是不可能的。风险太大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So because the alternative was never to feel clean in my own skin again, I made it my business to find out about other things that people didn't want talked about, and I talked about them. I wrote about the kinds of things that soon had people trying to nudge my car over the edge of a Hibernian mountain pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以，因为我无法忍受自己再也感觉不到内心的纯净，所以我决定去寻找人们不愿说的事情，并谈论它们。我写下了那些事情，很快人们就试图把我的车从希伯尼安山口推下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The usual stuff. Corruption at the highest levels of government. Paternity scandals in the Höllvanian royal family. Tainted milk powder being distributed to nursing mothers in ‘undesirable' sink estates in New Holywell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 常见的事。政府最高层腐败。霍瓦尼亚王室的父子丑闻。以及在新霍利维尔"不受欢迎"的贫民窟里，受污染的奶粉被分发给哺乳期母亲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right, yes. Tourist to our time. The usual stuff. Corruption at the highest levels of government. Paternity scandals in the Höllvanian royal family. Tainted milk powder being distributed to nursing mothers in ‘undesirable' sink estates in New Holywell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，对。来到我们这个时代的游客。常见的事。政府最高层腐败。霍瓦尼亚王室的父子丑闻。以及在新霍利维尔"不受欢迎"的贫民窟里，受污染的奶粉被分发给哺乳期母亲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because when someone tells you to shut up, you do not comply, EVER.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为当有人叫你闭嘴时，你永远都不该听从。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I assume that’s a good thing? Tell me about her some time when I’m not in the mood to rip someone’s head off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我猜这是件好事？等我不想扯掉某人的头的时候再跟我讲讲她的事情吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Anyway. Arthur wanted me to shut up, for the good of the family. Now I don’t talk at all. Yet for some reason Arthur’s still not happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不管怎样。亚瑟希望我闭嘴，说这是为了家族的利益。现在我什么都不说了。但不知为什么，亚瑟还是不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I ask you. What is a sister to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我问你。我这个做姐姐的该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay, we’ve known each other a little while now, and you’re from the future, and I think I can trust you to be honest with me about this, so I have to ask the most important question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好了，我们已经认识有一段时间了，你来自未来，我认为我可以信任你会给我一个诚实的回答，所以我得问你一个非常重要的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are we alone? Or did we finally contact something else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 宇宙里是只有我们吗？或者我们最终联系到了其他存在？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What IS ‘the Indifference'? I've seen glimpses in your mind, but I can't make sense of it. It makes me want to run and curl up somewhere far away with very thick walls.
