/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "虚空无情之物"是什么？我在你的脑海中看到了一些片段，但我理解不了。它让我想逃到一个有着厚厚墙壁的远处去蜷缩起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The bleakest possible answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这可能是最悲观的回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was really hoping there’d be something out there we could talk to. Something with a truly outside perspective on our species.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真心希望外面有我们可以交流的生命。一种能从外部视角看待我们种族的生命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m not sure why. Intelligence is intelligence, after all. It shouldn’t matter whether we discover it or create it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道为什么。毕竟，智能就是智能。无论我们是发现它还是创造它，都不应该有差别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Talk to and… other things, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不仅是交谈……当然还包括其他事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Excuse you. I am not a 'tentacle monster'. I am a monster who happens to have A TENTACLE. One. So far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请注意你的言辞。我不是什么"触手怪"。我是一个恰好有一根触手的怪物。到目前为止，只有一根。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Some kind of communion, I suppose. Not necessarily anything physical. I just want to touch minds with something that not only isn't human, it isn't even terrestrial.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想是某种交流吧。不一定是物理上的。我只是想和一些非人类，甚至是非地球生物进行思维碰触。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If all I wanted to do was converse with things with tentacles, I'd pop over to the Princess Lucina Zoological Gardens and make friends with the octopus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我只是想和有触手的东西交谈，我就会去露西娜公主动物园和章鱼交朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I tried to touch minds with one of Lettie’s rats, once, just to see what would happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我曾经尝和莱蒂的一只老鼠心灵接触，只是想看看会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... and now I'm wishing I'd done that. Octopi are highly intelligent. We'd probably be writing poetry together by now. I wonder where that octopus is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……现在我真希望我当初那么做了。章鱼非常聪明。我们现在可能已经一起写诗了。我在想那只章鱼现在在哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It was a dreadful three seconds for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对它来说是可怕的三秒钟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Someone probably ate it. That's what usually happens to zoo animals in quarantined cities, once supplies run out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可能已经被人吃了吧。在城市被隔离后，动物园里的动物通常都是这个下场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And whatever didn't get eaten will be riddled with Techrot by now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没被吃掉的生物现在可能都被科腐者感染了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... which is how it was in the 'dream', isn't it? Only it isn't a dream at all. It happened. Or will happen. Or a version of it will. Something happens at that zoo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……这和"梦"里的情况一样，不是吗？只不过这根本不是梦。它发生了。或者将要发生。或者某种形式的它将会发生。那家动物园里会发生一些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm going to remember as much as I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我要尽可能多地记住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't try to stop me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别试图阻止我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Poor little thing. I'd failed to allow for what touching MY mind would seem like to HIM, you see. Imagine a child lost in an infinite department store, screaming for its mother at the top of its lungs over and over. Everything was enormous and incomprehensible and had NOISES and SHAPES instead of SMELLS.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可怜的小东西。你看，我没考虑到我的思维对它来说会是什么样的。想象一下一个孩子在无边无际的百货公司里迷路了，不停地尖叫着呼唤妈妈。一切都那么巨大又难以理解，到处是声音和形状，而不是它熟悉的气味。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I broke the link as fast as I could. He was a little dizzy for an hour or so, then he was fine. I doubt he even remembers what happened to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我尽可能快地断开了连接。它头晕了大概一个小时，然后就好了。我怀疑它甚至不记得发生了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wouldn’t let Lettie hear you say that. Not if you like your organs where they are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我建议你别让莱蒂听到你这么说。除非你不在乎你的器官还能否留在原来的位置。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know if you’ve ever had the kind of slump where all you want to do is lie in bed and breathe in and out and just exist without doing anything else, but it was a lot like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道你是否曾经有过这样的低迷，你只想躺在床上呼吸，什么也不做，只是单纯地存在，但我的感觉很像那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Very basic. Simple needs met in simple ways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 非常简单。用简单的方式满足简单的需求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Childhood innocence has nothing on rat-consciousness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 童年的纯真与小鼠的意识根本无法比拟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, it was. I'm sure being a rat has its bad side, like having to eat your dead brother so the predators won't sniff him out, but that fleeting moment of simplicity was like a religious breakthrough, almost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 确实很惬意。我当然知道做一只小鼠也有不好的一面，比如不得不吃掉死去的兄弟，以免被捕食者嗅到，但那短暂的单纯时刻像是宗教上的顿悟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sort of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有点吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I guess being a rat is a lot like being a monk. Live off scraps, make your humble way in the world, never own a car or a house.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我猜，当小鼠就像当和尚一样。靠零星食物生存，谦卑地过日子，永远不会拥有汽车或房子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just think there's something heroic about being small and simple with very few needs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是觉得，做一个需求少、简单的小生物有种英雄般的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought about being a nun for a long time, believe it or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说出来你可能不信，我以前真的考虑了很久要不要去当修女。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right, yes. It seems they don't have them where you come from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对，确实。看来你们那里没有这种人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. Perhaps they don’t have them where you come from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。也许你们那里没有这种人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Like a devotee of Lua. Shaven head, white or black robes depending on the Aspect, very strict life. You’re expected to focus on holy things to the exclusion of all else. Prayer and meditation every day. Basic diet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就像是献身于月神的信徒。剃光头，根据不同的宗派穿着白色或黑色长袍，过着非常严苛的生活。你得专注于神圣的事务，摒弃一切杂念。每天祈祷和冥想。饮食简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It does, on the face of it. About the only difference between the monastic life and prison is that you're doing it on purpose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 表面上看确实如此。修道生活和坐牢唯一的区别是，前者是自愿的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It sounds amazing to most young novices, too, until they actually get a taste of the monastic life. I think the quit rate is something like eighty per cent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对大多数初入修道的年轻人来说也听起来很棒，直到他们真正体验了修道生活。我想退出率大概是百分之八十。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, no. I mean, at first, yes, you’d need to wean yourself off all of the things that society has taught you to need. That phase is probably the hardest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，不。我是说，一开始，是的，你需要让自己逐渐摆脱社会教给你的所有东西。这个阶段可能是最困难的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It wasn’t for me, either. It turns out I enjoy living in the world far too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也不适合我。我发现我太喜欢世俗的生活了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But Sol… it’s like there’s some alternate version of me who’s sat on a mountaintop somewhere, incense clouds flowering around her, jet and moonstone beads ticking through her fingers, looking down on me with abject pity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是天啊……就像有另一个版本的我，坐在某座山顶上，周围香烟缭绕，手中拨动着黑玉和月光石的珠子，带着绝对的怜悯俯视着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Turns out it wasn't for me. I enjoy living in the world far too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 后来我发现这种生活不适合我。我太喜欢世俗的生活了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But once you’re established, what’s the challenge going to be? Temptation? You’ll never SEE any. The idea is that you cut yourself off from everything that might distract you from the holy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但一旦你适应了，挑战将会是什么？诱惑？你根本看不到任何诱惑。这种生活的理念就是让你远离一切可能让你分心的事物，专注于神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know that’s just a fantasy. As much a fantasy as any of Arthur’s knights-in-armour pabulum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道这只是幻想。就像亚瑟的骑士童话一样不真实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you. For some reason that’s an incredibly comforting thing to hear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你。不知怎的，听到这话让我感到非常安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. I keep forgetting that what you’ve lived through amounts to pure bloody madness by any normal standard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。我总是忘记，按照常人的标准来看，你经历的事情简直是彻头彻尾的疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know… I've never done this before, but I think I'll try reaching out to her, just in case she exists. Yes. Maybe I can contact ‘Sister Eleanor' telepathically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道吗……我以前从没这么做过，但我想我会尝试联系她，万一她真的存在呢。是的。也许我能通过心灵感应联系到"埃莉诺修女"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What’s the worst that could happen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 能出什么大问题呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I might get some words of guidance from my other self. Imagine that. Oh Lua, I’m quite excited now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可能会从另一个自己那里得到一些指引。想象一下。哦，天哪，我现在真的很兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I just wanted reassurance that the Universe hadn’t put all its eggs in one basket. Because if humans are all there is, then the situation’s pretty screwed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我只是想确认宇宙并没有把所有鸡蛋都放在一个篮子里。因为如果只有人类存在，那我们真的完蛋了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah, well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh SHIT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 糟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: THAT THING? That's the same as your ‘Indifference'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个东西？那就是你说的"虚空无情之物"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I touched it. I've touched that thing with the very edge of my mind and I locked the memory away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我接触过它。我用我思维的边缘触碰过那个东西，并且我把那段记忆封锁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't even remember when it happened. She was giving one of her speeches on the tannoy, and I thought ‘I've never probed HER head before, I wonder what's in there, probably all leather and needles' and so I reached out and…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我甚至不记得那是什么时候发生的了。她在扩音器上发表演讲的时候，我想"我从未探查过她的脑海，不知道里面会有什么，也许全是皮革和针头"，于是我就发出探查……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: shitshitshit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 完了完了完了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can’t talk about this yet. I’m sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我现在还不能谈这件事。很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What do you think happens after we die?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你觉得我们死后会发生什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 继续？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Look, we can talk about the weather if you’d like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听着，如果你愿意的话，我们可以聊聊天气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But I’m not thinking about death in any morbid way, if that’s what you were worried about. I’m happy to keep going for a long while yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我并不是在以任何悲观的方式考虑死亡，如果你担心这点的话。我还是希望自己能活很长时间的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (Imagine me lying on my stomach, full-length on the couch, my chin on my hands, looking up at the Pom-2 and waiting expectantly to see what you’re going to type next.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （想象一下我躺在沙发上，双手托着下巴，抬头看着石榴 2 代，满怀期待地等着看你接下来会打什么。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or, since we’re already at the Mall, we could go get lattes and chat shit about how Lettie is a total bitch for keeping all those pink-n-yellows to herself instead of pilling us up like she oughtta, amirite?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或者，既然我们已经在商场了，咱们可以去喝点拿铁，然后吐槽一下莱蒂有多么讨厌，她把所有那些粉色和黄色的药丸都留给了自己，而不是像她应该做的那样分给我们，我说得对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just have a lot of long, dark hours to myself and plenty to think about, while my poor little cells twist and turn like croutons in the witches’ broth my bloodstream has now become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只是我需要独自度过太多漫长而阴暗的时光，也有无数事情可以思考，而此时我可怜的小细胞正像面包块一样，在我如今变成女巫汤的血液里翻滚扭曲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (I feel dirty for having typed that. Apologies.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （打出这些字让我感觉自己都脏了。抱歉。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know I’m skipping over a lot of small talk and going right for the jugular, but frankly it’s your bloody fault for being so interesting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道我跳过了很多闲聊直接切入正题，但说实话，这都是你的错，谁让你太有趣呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A time-traveling demigod literally falls into my life, my already ridiculous life, and I’m expected to stand back out of social nicety?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一个穿越时空的半神突然闯入我的生活，我的生活已经够荒谬的了，而我还得保持社交礼仪的矜持吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You can give me perspectives nobody else can. So please. Before I start clawing at the furniture. Talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你可以给我旁人无法提供的观点。所以请你。在我开始抓家具之前。和我聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Obsession?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 痴迷？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I saw. I don't think an existence that was thought of as a PUNISHMENT by your Orokin is an afterlife worth the name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我看到了。我不认为被你们奥罗金视为惩罚的存在，是一种名副其实的来生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ew. I think I'd rather be decently dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呸。我宁愿体面地死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of all the disgusting things this planet has in store, I think these Orokin are the worst.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在这个星球上所有令人恶心的事物中，我认为这些奥罗金人是最糟糕的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wonder if it’s too late to stop them existing at all. Maybe I just need to find the right butterfly to stomp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想知道现在去阻止他们的存在是否已经太迟了。也许我只需要找到正确的蝴蝶去踩死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: More Void magic. The more I learn about the Void, the more I want to go. Perhaps that's where I belong. Off the edge of the map. Here be dragons. You Tenno have Void in your blood. Lucky bastards.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 更多的虚空魔法。我对虚空了解得越多，就越想去那里。也许那才是我的归属。远在地图的边缘。那里有龙。你们 Tenno 的血液里流淌着虚空。真是幸运的家伙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All very well for you lot, but what about the rest of us peasants? We can’t all be Tenno, can we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们那一群人还好，但我们这些普通人怎么办？我们不可能都是 Tenno，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What, like you're a hapless little alien waif who's oh so far from home and I'm the scientist obsessed with cutting you up to find out how you work?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 怎么，就好比你是一个远离家乡的倒霉外星流浪儿，而我是一个痴迷于把你解剖，以了解你的运作原理的科学家吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry. I was under the impression that we found ONE ANOTHER quite intriguing. I thought these little back-and-forths were our way of getting to know each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。我以为我们彼此都很有趣。我以为这些小对话是我们相互了解的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just imagine. An entire cohort of smarmy dickheads deleted from existence. The only downside is we wouldn’t get to hear them screaming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想象一下。一群狂妄自大的混蛋从此消失。唯一的缺点是我们听不到他们的尖叫声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But no. Apparently I'm no better than some Zeke fangirl who spends every waking hour thinking about her 'obsession'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但不。显然我和那些整日只想着自己"痴迷"兹克的女粉丝没什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're not in Duviri anymore, your Majesty. Nobody here gives a shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 陛下，您已经不再在双衍王境了。这里没人在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Get over yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别自以为是了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Stop me if I get this wrong, but… what you're talking about doesn't sound like it IS the person. It's more like a computer that's been programmed to THINK it's the person. Correct?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我理解错了，请纠正我，但是……你所说的听起来不像是一个人。它更像是一个被编程成以为自己是那个人类的电脑。对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Although…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Crap.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, yes, I know that’s what you meant. Indulge me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，是的，我知道你的意思。迁就我一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void could be where souls exist. Is that what we’re saying? That someone crowbarred open the spirit realm and now you lot use it to power half your devices?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空可能是灵魂存在的地方。这是我们的意思吗？是不是有人撬开了灵界，现在你们用它来为你们一半的设备供电？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mmm. Sorry, but that’s not the same thing. We’re not talking about personhood here. We’re talking about continuity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。抱歉，但这不是一回事。我们讨论的不是人格，而是连续性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If I wiped them out I’d wipe YOU out, wouldn’t I? Because your existence depends on THEIR existence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我抹去他们的存在，我也会抹去你的存在，对吗？因为你的存在依赖于他们的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I should have known that double-dealing bastard had his fingers in this particular pie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我早该知道那个两面派的混蛋在这件事里也有份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Has anyone ever met a dead person in the Void? Or has the Void ever taken the form of a dead person? Sorry to ask, but I need to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有没有人在虚空中遇到过死去的人？或者虚空曾经变成过某个死去的人的形态？抱歉问这个，但我真的需要知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Whoa.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哇哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t get me started. We’ll be here all week if you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别提了。如果你这样做，我们可能得讨论一整周。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought this was just a fun conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我本以为这只是一场有趣的谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We're still on ‘does the soul survive the death of the body'. We can't get on to ‘is free will really a thing' yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们现在还在讨论"肉体死亡后灵魂是否仍然存在"的问题。还没到"自由意志是否真的存在"的讨论呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just so we're clear, I don't have any ACTUAL plans to muck about with the future. I just
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我要澄清一下，我并没有真正的计划去干涉未来。我只是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (This is what you get, Eleanor, she told herself. This is where asking the interesting person the Big Important Questions gets you.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （这就是你的下场，埃莉诺，她对自己说。这就是向有趣的人提出深度问题的下场。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know what? It's not worth it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 算了，这都不重要了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was TRYING to say how much I don't want you to be gone. So much so that I'd be willing to let people in my future go on suffering under the yoke of a bunch of tyrants rather than change a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我本来想说的是，我多么不希望你消失。我甚至宁愿让未来的人们继续忍受暴君的压迫，也不愿改变任何事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Bad taste joke. Sorry. Won't happen again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我开了个糟糕的玩笑。抱歉。不会再发生了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hmm. No. I don't think it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。不。我不这么认为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, you noticed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢，你注意到了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know some dead people? As in, socially?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你认识一些死去的人？是社交意义上的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They remember dying? They actually know they're dead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们记得自己的死亡？他们真的知道自己已经死了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Holy shit, this is incredible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的天，这实在太不可思议了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. Are you having trouble finding the right words? Or is it that you don't want to tell me the full story? I get nervous when people try to hold back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊。你是找不到合适的词语吗？还是你不想告诉我全部的故事？当人们试图隐瞒些什么，我会感到紧张。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Although…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wait. Don't answer that. Something just flashed across my mind. I don't know if it was a stray thought of yours or not, but dear bleeding Sol on the star-tree it's giving me the horrors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等。先别回答。我脑子里突然闪过一个念头。我不知道那是不是你的一个不经意的想法，但我的天，这让我觉得很恐怖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How do we know it’s the same person in there? The same point of view?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们怎么知道里面是同一个人？有同样的观点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Angels.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天使。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What if it’s just, I dunno, a Void Clone or something? Could that happen? The Void taking the IDEA of a person and then giving form to it. And that form then THINKS it’s the same person as the one who died.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果只是，我不知道，某种虚空克隆体或类似的东西呢？这可能发生吗？虚空会吸收一个人的思想，然后赋予它形态。然后那个形态会认为自己是那个死去的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sweet Lua, I can hear them. Its like... when an air conditioner has been running in the room for so long you've tuned its noise out and then suddenly you notice it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪，我能听到它们。就像是……空调在房间里开了很久，你已经将它的噪音忽略，然后突然你注意到了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why did I start asking you about this SOL DAMMIT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么我要开始问你这些，该死的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If the Void made a copy of me, I'd end up losing sleep over which of us was the real one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果虚空复制了我，我会因为不知道哪个是真正的我而失眠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because if it can do that when you're dead, then surely it can do it while you're alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为如果它可以在你死后做到这一点，那么它肯定也可以在你活着时做到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I'm not comfortable with where this is heading. Sorry. Talk later. Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我对这个走向感到不太舒服。抱歉。以后再聊。也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. It does matter to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。这对我很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: More than I’ve really let on, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 恐怕比我表现出来的还要重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let’s just say I have reasons for hoping that something of us survives the death of the body. I’m hardly alone in that, I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我就说我有理由希望我们的一部分能超越肉体的死亡吧。我知道不止我一个人有这个想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. They tried, didn't they? Thrax made a regular spectacle of you. I don't know how you made it through that nightmare and stayed sane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。他们试过了，不是吗？士魂大帝把你弄得像个定期表演一样。我不知道你是怎么挺过那场噩梦并保持理智的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Between you and me, I’m not sure I can die either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，我也不确定我是否能死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s a committee of tiny Technocytes living inside me now who would be extremely peeved if their home got demolished.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在，我的体内有一个由科技细胞组成的委员会，如果他们的家被摧毁了，他们会非常恼火的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which is why they’ve gone to such trouble to make me big and stwong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这也是为什么它们不遗余力地让我变得又大又强壮的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It does make me wonder what would happen if I was killed outright. The Techrot can keep a corpse animated and repurposed. I’ve seen it. Like a colony of termites working in concert to pilot a robot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这让我不禁好奇，如果我被直接杀死会发生什么。科腐者可以让尸体保持活动并重新利用。我亲眼所见。就像一群白蚁共同操纵一台机器人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So… would I become some sort of Techrot zombie? If it brought me back, would I still be me? Or would I just be a Techrot hivemind gestalt that had access to my memories, and THOUGHT it was me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么……我会变成某种科腐者丧尸吗？如果它让我复活，我还是原来的我吗？还是我只是一个有着我的记忆的科腐者集体意识，并以为自己是我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t think I’m healthy, full stop. So there we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得我本身就不健康。所以就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I appreciate that you care enough to say that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我感激你这么关心我，并说出这些话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lettie checks up on what my body is doing, because Arthur needs me ready for action. I don’t hate her for that. It’s her job.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 莱蒂在监控我的身体状况，因为亚瑟需要我随时待命。我不怪她。那是她的工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But nobody’s checking up on ME.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但没有人在关心我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not until now, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少到现在为止没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods, all you’re doing is being kind, and it’s been so bloody long since we were just KIND to one another that I’m making a great big song and dance about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天，你不过是做了件善良的事，而我们已经太久没有单纯地对彼此好过了，以至于我现在要大惊小怪一番。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ahem. Thank you. The end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯哼。谢谢你。就这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. Okay. Right. I am going to focus now. Please stay with me. I am building a wall out of my thoughts. It is rising up between me and the angels.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。好吧。对。我现在要集中注意力。请留在这里。我在用我的思维筑起一道墙。它正从我和那些天使之间升起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wall wall wall lovely lovely wall
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 墙，墙，墙，美丽的墙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There. Wall is in place. All quiet now. I should probably let you go, shouldn't I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好了。墙已经建好。现在一切都安静了。我应该让你走了，对吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could get Amir to reprogram a Chattin' Charlotte doll with some choice Eleanor phrases, and he could scare Lettie with it after I was dead, but it wouldn't be ME.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以让阿米尔重新编程一个夏洛特聊天娃娃，让它说出一些埃莉诺的经典语录，然后他可以在我死后用它来吓唬莱蒂，但那并不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Unless I could possess it somehow. Let me go and ponder that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 除非我能以某种方式影响它。让我去思考一下这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey. What’s on your mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿。你在想什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You -
You started this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你先开始的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Perplexing creature...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 令人困惑的生物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Someone who turns other people's trauma into cash.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就是把别人的创伤变现的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods. Sorry. I was being facetious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，天。抱歉。刚才说得不太正经。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let me try again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我再解释一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A journalist is someone who hunts down interesting things that are happening in the world and tells other people about them, either by writing or making a broadcast of some sort. Usually both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 记者是那种追踪世界上发生的有趣事件，并通过写作或某种广播形式来告诉其他人。通常是两种方式都有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A storyteller, I suppose. But not the sort who makes things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想，可以说是个讲故事的人。但不是编故事的那种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Most of the time, people are interested in reading about the bad things that happen in the world. If it bleeds it leads, as the saying goes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 大多数情况下，人们更感兴趣阅读世界上发生的不幸事件。俗话说："血案当头条。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can’t imagine the situation’s any different in your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想你们那个时代也不会有什么不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I tried to make a difference with my work. Yes, I was getting paid for it, but I wanted to do good in the world, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我试图通过我的工作带来改变。没错，我是靠此谋生，但我也想为世界做些好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was younger then, of course. Nothing cures you of the drive to 'do good in the world' than spending some time in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然，那时我还年轻。没有什么比生活在这个世界中更能消除你那种"改善世界"的冲动了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is where it got me. Literally. I only came here to Höllvania in the first place because of the story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是我来到这里的原因。字面意义上的。我最初来霍瓦尼亚就是因为想要做报道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. Sidetracked. Need to rant. Are you up for listening to me sound off about a pet hate of mine?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起，我扯远了。我需要好好发泄一下。你愿意听我抱怨一件我特别讨厌的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ok. Don't say I didn't warn you. I have a theory I call the Hero Virus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。别说我没警告过你。我有一个叫做"英雄病毒"的理论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, he was here first. But he made the mistake of telling me what was happening here, and I couldn't sit on it. So I place a call to my old friend Danny MacIlvoy and pay over the odds for a forged visa and passport. Because I need them in a hurry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，他先来的。但他犯了一个错误，告诉了我这里发生的事情，我无法坐视不管。所以我给我老朋友丹尼·麦克尔沃伊打了个电话，花高价买了个假签证和护照。因为我急需它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You have to understand: they were locking Höllvania down, but they couldn't do it all at once. This may be a walled city-state that's been here since the time of the Radiant Khan, but the walls they put up to fend her off are old now and the powers in charge couldn't get barricades and checkpoints up in time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你得明白：他们当时正在封锁霍瓦尼亚，但无法一下子全部封锁。这个城邦可能自辉煌可汗时代就存在了，但是他们用来抵御入侵的城墙现在已经老旧，当局无法及时设置障碍和检查站。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just imagine for a moment that you can have a virus that's transmitted through stories. Like all viruses it wants to take over the host and spread itself further.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 试想一下，如果有一种病毒可以通过故事传播。像所有病毒一样，它想要接管宿主并进一步传播自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: People were falling over themselves to get out. So nobody paid much attention to one stupid Britannic girl who was trying to get in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 人们争先恐后地想逃出去。自然没人会注意到一个傻乎乎的不列颠尼克女孩正试图进入。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Hero Virus makes you see the world as if it were a story. It persuades you that Good is all about INDIVIDUAL PEOPLE doing AWESOME THINGS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 英雄病毒让你把世界看作是一个故事。它让你相信，善就是某些个人做出了一些了不起的事情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You want to know the worst part?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你想知道最糟糕的部分吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So naturally you want to be one of those people
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以你自然而然想成为那样的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, and we suddenly become squeamish?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，我们突然变得胆小了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Pardon me for upsetting your delicate sensibilities. Never mind, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请原谅我让你那么敏感不安。那就当我没说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. Here is the worst part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。接下来是最糟糕的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was investigating an outbreak of what was being called Testudo Syndrome. Testudo because it means turtle, and people who had it were developing tough patches on their skin as an early marker. The same sort of thing that eventually turns into armour plating in us lucky few.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当时正在调查一种名为提斯图多综合症的疫情。提斯图多是因为它的意思是龟甲，患有这种病的人的皮肤上会出现坚硬的斑块，这是早期的症状。这种疾病最终会在我们这些幸运儿身上形成护甲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Testudo Syndrome was a treatment-resistant disease that seemed to be exclusive to Höllvania, had some enigmatic and sinister connection to computers, and appeared all at once. And people who asked too many questions about it had a tendency to end up as a clog in a Höllvanian sewer pipe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 提斯图多综合症是一种难以治疗的疾病，似乎只在霍瓦尼亚出现，与电脑有着神秘而不详的联系，并且突然间爆发。而问太多有关它的问题的人往往都会成为霍瓦尼亚下水道堵塞物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No matter how tough it may be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不管这有多困难

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because a Hero has to make hard decisions. A Hero has to endure pain stoically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为英雄必须做出艰难的决定。英雄必须坚强地忍受痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's all such cynical bullshit. The Hero Virus exists to sell toys, market movies and to make little boys and girls grow up to be willing cannon fodder
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这全是些自私的废话。英雄病毒的存在是为了卖玩具、推销电影，让小男孩和小女孩长大后心甘情愿地成为炮灰

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They don't make films about the Chosen One whose heroic destiny is to wipe old people's bums in a nursing home
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有人会拍摄关于那个被选中去在养老院帮老人擦屁股的英雄的电影。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Within hours of getting into Höllvania I was picking my way through the sewers and talking Arthur down from the biggest emotional fit he has ever been on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我刚到霍瓦尼亚没几小时，就在下水道里小心翼翼地行走，同时还要安抚亚瑟，他当时正经历着他有史以来最大的情绪波动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm almost done, stay with me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我快说完了，跟上我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That boy. You would think I’d followed him here just to piss him off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个男孩。你可能以为我跟着他来这里只是为了惹恼他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Hero Virus tricks you into thinking that you can do the most good if there's a spotlight on you. It sets an impossible, twisted example
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 英雄病毒会诱使你以为，如果你站在聚光灯下，你才能做出最大的善行。它树立了一个不可能的、扭曲的榜样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur thinks he's losing me to the Techrot. But the truth is, I lost him to the Hero Virus a long time ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟认为他正失去我，被科腐者夺走。但事实是，我很早以前就因为英雄病毒失去了他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I bloody did take it seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当然认真了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course I did. But I also had a noble purpose in mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错，我确实这么做了。但我同时也怀着一个高尚的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Precisely. But I also had a noble purpose in mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。但我同时也怀着一个高尚的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: People were trying to kill me. Forgive me for having a sense of humour about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有人想杀我。请原谅我对此还能保持幽默感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘Noble.' Sol's balls. I really deserved everything that happened to me, didn't I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "高尚"。天，我真是自找的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe you've just been on your own for too long, but in an outfit like this, taking the piss out of one another helps keep us sane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许只是你一个人呆久了，但在这样的团队里，互相取笑一下有助于我们保持理智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right, right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对，对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So I’m in the sewers, and something with a cluster of CRT monitors instead of a head goes lurching past. I’ve barely finished shitting myself when I find the nest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在下水道里，突然发现一个头是一堆 CRT 显示器的东西摇摇晃晃地经过。我还没回过神来，就发现了那个巢穴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I admit, sometimes it gets too close to the bone, especially when Lettie is in one of her depressive slumps and needs someone to hate on
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我承认，有时候开玩笑会开得太过分了，特别是当莱蒂情绪低落，需要找人出气时

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But please, for all our sakes, lighten up a bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但拜托，为了大家好，放轻松一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Even Arthur pops open a beer and puts his feet up, once in a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就连亚瑟也会时不时喝点啤酒，放松一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Growths. Part organic, part technology, part some poor bastard’s delerium tremens. Light in the kind of colours people only see when they’ve inhaled too many solvent fumes. It’s hideous and I can’t take my eyes off it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那些生长物，部分是有机的，部分是科技的，还有部分是某个倒霉蛋的戒酒综合症。只有吸入过多溶剂烟雾的人才能看到这种光彩。它太可怕了，但我就是挪不开眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Jackpot, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我心想，中大奖了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我确实没走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I take a dozen grainy pictures on my Kinematic 2300A slip-phone and I send the pictures to Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我用我的即时通 2300A 滑盖手机拍了十几张颗粒感的照片，然后把这些照片发给了亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I say ‘Think I've found where this Techrot is coming from.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我说："我想我找到科腐者的源头了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I filed the story the next day. ‘The Techrot Beneath Höllvanian Streets.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 第二天我就发表了这个报道。"霍瓦尼亚街道下的科腐者。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ta-da! I named it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错！是我起的名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There it is. The worst part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 来了。最糟糕的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nobody calls it ‘Testudo Syndrome' now. Nobody calls it the Technocyte. Everyone just calls it Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在没人用"提斯图多综合症"来称呼它了。也没人称它为科技细胞。大家都直接叫它科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I named the thing that's eaten this city and is eating me from the bones outward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我给这个吞噬这座城市，和从骨头里侵蚀我的东西命名了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. For some reason I thought you'd understand. Or at least sympathize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。出于某种原因，我以为你会理解的。或者至少会有同情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're right, though. It IS all a stupid game, isn't it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过你说得对。这一切都是场愚蠢的游戏，不是吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We're all just a bunch of decaying clowns trapped on a carousel that never stops
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都只是一群腐烂的小丑，被困在不停旋转的旋转木马上

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Roll up roll up see the amazing gorgon lady, one of a kind, don't let your child come too close madam, she's not been fed today
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 快来看看这位惊人的蛇发女怪，绝无仅有，夫人，别让你的孩子靠得太近，她今天还没吃饭呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Talk whenever.  Need a drink.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 随时都可以聊。我需要喝点什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nobody talks about the work I did on Minister Jeremy Coniston and the bogus famine relief, or the Lazlo Fertilizer scandal, or any of that. It barely made a ripple.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没人关注我为部长杰里米·康尼斯顿的假饥荒救济、拉兹洛化肥丑闻或任何此类事件所做的报道。这些都没引起什么波澜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And now I come up with a term that everyone uses and nobody even knows I came up with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在我创造了一个大家都在用的术语，却没人知道是我创造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘Techrot'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "科腐者"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They can put that word on my bloody tombstone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这个词可以刻在我那该死的墓碑上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If I get one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我有墓碑的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He's a charming little imp. Why are you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他是个迷人的小恶魔。你问这个干什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As much as the next person, I suppose. Why are you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我和大多数人一样吧。你问这个干什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. I see. You are the chosen messenger, sent from the Thunderbolt King to enlist fair Eleanor. No doubt all sorts of roguery await me. Fol de rol and so forth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊，我明白了。你是被雷霆之王选中的信使，来招募美丽的埃莉诺。毫无疑问，肯定有各种恶作剧在等着我。无聊的事之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I will do you a favour and NOT convey those words along to him. Word to the wise: treat him with more respect in the future in my presence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会帮你个忙，不把这话告诉他。给你一个忠告：以后在我面前对他多些尊重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, putting on a daft voice and play-acting for a few hours sounds ideal. Count me in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其实花几个小时扮演角色，用傻乎乎的声音说话听起来挺不错的。算我一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh! I would like to be a wizard. Or perhaps a bard. Or perhaps both? Can you BE both?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦！我想做一名巫师。或者是一名吟游诗人。或者两个都可以？可以同时扮演两个角色吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or I could be a swamp hag! So long as I get to wear a tight bodice, mind. Mother Mossytits will eat your bones, little manikin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或者我也可以做个沼泽巫婆！只要我能穿紧身胸衣就好，记住。苔胸娘会吃掉你的骨头，小玩偶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s always okay to ask, so long as you ask politely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只要你礼貌地问，随时都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Some people find that very difficult.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有些人就做不到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你在说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is that what you imagine I do? Casually violate other people's privacy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你以为我会这样做吗？随意侵犯别人的隐私？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If that's what you think of me, then I doubt we have much to talk about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你真的这样看我，那我觉得我们没什么好谈的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes to both. If I just sit and ‘listen', I can pick up on internal monologues and strong feelings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 两者都有。如果我静下心来"倾听"，就能捕捉到内心的独白和强烈的情感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The hardest part is filtering out the LOUD stuff I don’t want to know about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 最困难的部分是过滤掉那些我不想知道的嘈杂声音。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't always get to experience feelings as if they were someone else's. The more pre-verbal it is, the harder it is to discern between ‘them' and ‘me'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有时候我体验到别人的情感，就像是自己的一样。越是无法用语言表达的情感，就越难区分"他们"和"我"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Permission to delve into the realms of ‘too much information'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你能允许我进入这个"过多信息"的领域吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I salute your bravery.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我敬佩你的勇气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Read further at your own risk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 继续看下去，风险自负。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not long after we all got the Entrati shots, I thought I had some kind of secondary bladder infection. Mate. I was up and down off that couch like a yo-yo. I even had Lettie hunting me down cranberry juice and mineral water.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在我们注射英择谛疫苗不久后，我以为我得了某种继发性膀胱炎。伙计。我就像溜溜球一样上上下下的离开沙发。我甚至让莱蒂帮我找蔓越莓汁和矿泉水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Turns out I was just feeling six people’s natural biological urges. My nervous system naturally assumed they were mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 原来我只是感受到了六个人的自然生理冲动。我的神经系统自然以为那些感受是我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, I AM catastrophically sick. Let's not mince words. But I'd rather be saddled with telepathy than never-ending cystitis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，我是病得很重，我们直说吧。但我宁愿承受心灵感应的折磨，也不愿一直有慢性膀胱炎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I learned to build walls around my mind after that incident. Lettie sometimes finds meds that can shut the whole telepathic side of me down, just for a few hours. I have a stash of them, but I don’t take them unless I really, really need to sleep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那件事之后，我学会了在我的心灵周围筑起高墙。莱蒂有时会找到一些药物，可以关闭我的心灵感应能力，就几个小时。我有一些存货，但除非真的非常需要睡觉，否则我不会服用它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s such a useful talent to have, that’s the problem. Arthur insists on seeing it as a strategic asset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是一项非常有用的能力，但问题就在这里。亚瑟始终认为这是一种战略资源。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s bloody awful for morale.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这会非常打击士气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Even if I insist that I can control it, do you think they would believe me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 即便我强调我能控制住，你觉得他们会相信我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: None of us is soft. We're used to roughing it. This place is a five star hotel compared to a regular Britannic army barracks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都不是软弱的人。我们习惯了艰苦的生活。相比普通的不列颠尼克兵营，这地方简直像五星级酒店。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You shower together, you eat together, et cetera. You get used to one another. You have to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 大家一起洗澡，一起吃饭，一起做很多事。我们得习惯彼此，必须这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But as Arthur would say, there’s a sodding limit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但正如亚瑟所说，任何事总有个该死的限度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just don’t let them know how much of their inner lives I hear, see and feel. I don’t go probing uninvited, whatever Lettie might think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是不让他们知道我听到、看到和感受到了多少他们内心的事。不管莱蒂怎么想，我不会未经允许就去探查。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sometimes one of them will have a thought, and immediately think ‘did she hear me thinking that?' It's kinder to let them wonder. What they don't know can't hurt them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有时候他们会冒出一个想法，然后立刻想着"她听到我在想什么了吗？"让他们保持猜测其实更好。只要他们不知道，就不会被伤害到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Like I said, I’m not about to confirm or deny anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就像我之前说的，我既不确认也不否认任何事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I should say, right about now, that there’s another important reason why I keep this shit to myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我应该说，现在有另一个重要的理由让我保持沉默。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So. Arthur and me. We're on the streets, raiding a Scaldra cache, and he's seriously off his game. He's not shooting straight, he's driving like a drunk duck at the dodgems, he can't even do the sword thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以，亚瑟和我。我们在街上突袭了一个炽蛇军仓库，而他状态真的很糟糕。他枪射不准，开车就像闹市区的醉鸭，他甚至连剑也使不出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Naturally, I tell him to get his act together. Immediately he starts blaming ME. He tells me I’m always acting so superior, don’t I understand the pressure of command, if I had the first idea what he has to deal with on a DAILY basis I’d buckle, all this self-pitying bollocks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 自然，我告诉他要振作起来。他马上开始怪我。他说我总是表现得那么高高在上，问我是不是完全不懂指挥的压力。还说如果我真的知道他每天要面对的事情，我早就垮了，全是些自怨自艾的废话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Remember the Hero Virus I told you about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还记得我跟你提过的"英雄病毒"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have this theory I call the Hero Virus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有一个叫做"英雄病毒"的理论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Terminal case.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他就是个典型病例。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everything was about Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一切都要和亚瑟有关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Little boys get it into their heads that the stories they've been fed are how the world really works. They think they are the hero and everything revolves around them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这些小男孩总是以为他们听到的故事就是这个世界的真实。他们认为自己是英雄，一切都围着他们转。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur has one of the worst cases of Hero Virus I've ever seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟的英雄病毒是我见过的最严重的案例之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So I fire back at him ‘you know I can tell when you're thinking about Aoi, right?'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以我反击他说："你知道我能感觉到你在想碧，对吧？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not my proudest moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这不是我最自豪的时刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Even if he hadn’t been my brother, that was a shitty thing to do. I’ll never do it again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 即使他不是我的弟弟，那也是一件很恶劣的事情。我再也不会这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … I don’t like that you want to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我不喜欢你想知道这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Now I'm wondering whether you're enjoying the idea of Arthur being humiliated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在我在想，你是不是有享受亚瑟被羞辱的念头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Please don’t let that be it. I’m starting to like you, and this is the sort of thing I wouldn’t be able to look past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请不要是这样。我开始喜欢你了，而这种事我是不能接受的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. That’s understandable. I’m sorry I snapped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，这可以理解。对不起，我刚才突然发难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He crumpled. I felt horrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他崩溃了。我感到非常难受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I didn't just confront him. I HURT him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不只是质问他，我还伤害了他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's used to being talked back to. Just look at Quincy!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟已经习惯别人顶嘴了。看看昆西就知道了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，我明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's a pain in the arse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟真是个讨厌鬼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd broken something important between us. Hang on. I need to tell you something so you'll understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们之间某种重要的东西被我弄坏了。等等，我得告诉你一些事情，这样你才能明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But we all know Arthur's got walls up. He acts like he's impossible to hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我们都知道亚瑟对别人都筑起了心墙。他表现得好像自己不会受到伤害一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But when I'm trying to talk to you about something I feel guilty about...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但当我试着跟你谈一件让我感到内疚的事时……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 算了，没什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could feel how shocked and confused he was. He'd thought he was safe around me. Not anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我能感觉到他当时有多震惊和迷茫。他以为在我身边很安全。但现在不是了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When we were little, some older boys stole Arthur’s favourite Action Angus and threw him on the Solstice bonfire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 小时候，有几个大男孩抢走了亚瑟最喜欢的安格斯玩偶，并将它扔到了冬至的篝火上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can still see him bent over and the flesh coloured plastic bubbling and dripping all over his camo trousers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我仍然能看到他弯腰的样子，肉色的塑料起着泡，滴落在他的迷彩裤上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The boys laughed and said Arthur should be happy. Action Angus was going to the Hall of Heroes for the midwinter feast like warriors used to. I wanted to murder them. Little bastards.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 男孩们笑着说亚瑟应该高兴。安格斯玩偶要像以前的战士一样去英雄堂参加仲冬节。我真想杀了他们。那帮小混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur didn't want the boys to see him cry, and he didn't want to cry in front of my dad, so the only person left was me. His shitty big sister.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟不想让那些男孩看到他在哭，也不想在我爸爸面前哭，所以能哭诉的对象的只剩下我。他那个糟糕的姐姐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm telling you about that because that's where Arthur went, in his head. He remembered feeling like it was safe to cry in front of me if he ever really NEEDED to, and now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我之所以告诉你这些，是因为这就是亚瑟当时的想法。他记得自己觉得，如果他真的需要哭的话，在我面前哭是安全的，但现在呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Now it wasn't safe anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在不再安全了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's horrible, isn't it? You get so used to the ritual of it, putting one another down, sniping and snarking...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很糟糕吧？习惯了那一套互相伤害的方式，不断地贬低对方，抨击和嘲讽……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's comforting, almost. Then one day you draw blood and you can't take it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这几乎成了一种安慰。然后有一天你真的伤到了对方，而且无法挽回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah, I did. I apologized, I promised I’d never do anything like that again, but I still feel like shit because of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，我确实伤害了他。我道了歉，承诺再也不会做那样的事，但我依然会对此感到难受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: YES.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You GET IT. I love that! Fighting dirty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你懂我。我很喜欢这个表达！耍阴招。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know that thing where you’re in an argument with someone and once it’s all over, you think of the exact right thing you should have said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道那种和人争论后，事后你才想到本应该说的完美回应的感觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t get that anymore. I have a magic I Win button. All I’d have to do is look into their brain, grab whatever they’re most ashamed of and rub it in their face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我再也不会有那种感觉了。我有一个像魔法一样的胜利按钮。我只需要探查他们的大脑，找到他们最羞耻的事情，然后当面戳破。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I CAN'T DO IT, no matter how much I want to. Because I'm supposed to be a ‘good person'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我不能这么做，无论我多么想这么做。因为我应该做个"好人"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh dear. That's what I get for parading my virtues, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，天啊。这就是我炫耀美德的后果，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. I was expecting sympathy. But I'll take the reality check.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。我原本期待得到一些同情。不过，我接受现实的考验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m not looking for sympathy. Truly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不是在寻求同情。真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's not like I'm the only one who has to keep her powers in check, is it? We're all time bombs waiting to go off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不是唯一一个需要控制自己能力的人，对吧？我们都是随时可能爆炸的定时炸弹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just wanted someone else to understand. Honestly, I’m a little taken aback by how much you DO understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是希望有人能理解。老实说，你能这么理解我，我有点意外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You didn't have to listen. But I'm glad you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你本不必听我倾诉，但我很高兴你这样做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s a messed-up freakshow inside this skull of mine. I think you can appreciate why I don’t roll out the welcome mat to strangers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的脑袋是一场混乱的畸形秀。我想你能理解为什么我不对陌生人敞开心扉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I expect people to run away screaming. You haven’t. Yet. I wonder why. Thank you. Again. For everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我以为人们会惊慌失措地逃跑。但你没有。至少目前没有。我在想为什么。再次感谢你。感谢你所做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Appreciate the talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 感谢你这次与我交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you there? I need to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你在吗？我需要谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you there? I need to talk to you about something. It's serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你在吗？我需要跟你谈谈一些事情。严肃的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Remember how I told you about how I tried to touch Rusalka's mind with mine, and I made contact with The Indifference instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还记得我曾经跟你说过，我试图用我的意识接触鲁莎卡的意识，结果却碰到了虚空无情之物吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you understand what happened to Major Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道鲁莎卡少校发生了什么事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. I wasn’t ready to talk about it then. I’m ready now, if you’re willing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。当时我还没准备好谈论这件事。现在我准备好了，如果你愿意的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘The Indifference'. That's what you call it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "虚空无情之物"。你就这么叫它？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hollowed out, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，被掏空了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But whatever was driving her wasn't like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是操控她的东西和你不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Anything human about it was like a mockery.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它身上任何看似人性的东西都像是一种嘲弄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This creature, this presence, is what we’re ultimately up against. I know that much now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这个生物，这个存在，就是我们最终的对手。我现在知道这一点了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It was about as human as a store mannequin. In pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它就像是商店里的人体模型一样，被分割成了几部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Please tell me the truth. Do you believe there is any hope?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请跟我说实话。你觉得还有希望吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I touched it, you see. With my mind. I was trying to probe her, but she wasn't there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你看，我用我的意念触碰了它。我试图探查她，但她已经不在了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Giving it a name feels like I've gotten a tiny bit of control back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 给那个东西起个名字，让我感觉我至少回收了一点控制权。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: At least you were honest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少你很诚实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t tell me why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别告诉我原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fine. Let hope die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好。那就让希望破灭吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There's so much we don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有太多我们不知道的事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just hold on to that belief. Let me feel it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只需要坚持那个信念。让我感受它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'll keep fighting out of pure bloody stubbornness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会继续战斗，全凭一股纯粹的倔强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: After what's already happened this year, how are we supposed to make sane plans ever again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在经历了今年的种种之后，我们怎么可能再有理智的计划？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hate. Rage. Anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 憎恨、愤怒。什么都行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe hope is a delusion. I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许希望只是一种错觉。我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I reached out for Rusalka, and it was as if my fingers touched her face and went right through. The mask just collapsed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当时探查鲁莎卡，仿佛我的手指触碰到她的脸，却穿了过去。面具瞬间崩解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've touched that thing with my mind. I thought I'd be probing Rusalka's mind, but… the outer layers just caved in like wet, spongy plasterboard and then I was immersed in it. Floundering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我用意识接触过那个东西。我以为我会探查到鲁莎卡的思想，但是……外层就像湿漉漉的海绵石膏板一样塌了下来，然后我就完全陷入了其中。挣扎着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Better than apathy. Better than meek surrender.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这总比麻木要好，比懦弱投降要好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could just really do with some right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我现在真的很需要一些希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What was underneath was like…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 面具下的东西就像……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There's a word. ‘Calenture.' It's a kind of madness that used to affect sailors. They'd become convinced that the green sea all around them wasn't water at all, but green grass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有一个词叫"热病"。这是一种曾经影响水手们的疯症。他们会坚信周围的绿色海洋根本不是水，而是绿色的草地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah, well. So it is. Even if we're stumbling onward through the dark, at least we have one another's company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎，就这样吧。即便我们在黑暗中摸索前行，至少我们还有彼此的陪伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They'd be compelled to jump from the ship down into the beautiful green meadows and go running across them. If a shipmate held them back, they’d fight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们会情不自禁地从船上跳下，奔向那些看似美丽的绿色草原。如果有船员拉住他们，他们会挣扎反抗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I jumped, expecting grass. Next second I was in over my head in the freezing dark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我跳下去的时候以为会落在草地上，结果下一秒我就陷入了冰冷的黑暗之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎呀，坏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s a feeling there isn’t a word for. You look out on the world and you just KNOW, that all the ordinariness - buildings, cars, people, jobs, work, routine - is just a thin crust over a bottomless horror, and if people ever realized it they’d start screaming and never stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有一种感觉是无法用语言形容的。你望向这个世界，你就知道，所有的平凡事物——建筑、汽车、人们、工作、日常生活——都只是一层薄薄的表皮，掩盖着无尽的恐怖。如果人们意识到这一点，他们会开始尖叫，永远不停歇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd just about managed to psych myself up to this, and now, what? we're not mentioning the Devil in case it summons him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我刚刚好不容易才做好了心理准备，可现在，怎么搞得连"魔鬼"都不敢提了，就因为害怕把他召唤出来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I fell through the crust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我穿过了那层表皮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you hear screaming in the night, it's me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你在夜里听到尖叫声，那是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It wasn’t emptiness. I could have borne that. It went on and on forever, but it wasn’t just cold space. There was something in there with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那不是空无。我本能承受空无。它无止境地延续，但那并不仅仅是冰冷的空间。那里有什么东西与我同在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know. But it knew I was there. It was AWARE of me. Like an elephant would be aware of a fly crawling across its eye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道。但它知道我在那里。它意识到了我的存在。就像大象意识到一只苍蝇爬过它的眼睛一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I remember thinking ‘nothing that big should know I exist'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我记得我当时想"这么庞大的存在应该不会注意到我"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It felt such utter disregard for me, such monumental indifference that I wanted to stop existing on the spot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它对我完全不在意，那种极度的冷漠，让我恨不得想立刻消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I could have coped if it had hated me. Then I would have had some value, some significance. But it saw me as meaningless, and I saw what it saw. I was a speck. A nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果它恨我，我觉得我还能应对。那样我至少还有些价值，有些意义。但它视我为无物，我也看到了它的视角。我就是一个微不足道的点。什么也不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everything I had ever been, every tender moment, every laugh, every morsel of Eleanor Nightingale blew away in that storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我曾经拥有的一切、每一个温柔的瞬间、每一次欢笑、埃莉诺·南丁格尔的点点滴滴都在那场风暴中消散了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It felt my light fading, and I swear, a tiny tremor of satisfaction went through it. As if it was pleased to have crushed me. A flea under its fingernail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它感受到我的光芒正在消逝，我发誓，它心中涌起一丝满足的颤抖。好像它很高兴压垮了我。就像碾死它指甲下的一只跳蚤那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Did I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s still out there, isn’t it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它还在外面，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But they will stop burning. One day. The heat death of the Universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但它们终将熄灭。总有一天，宇宙会走向热寂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Indifference wins in the end, my friend, no matter how many platitudes we throw into the abyss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空无情之物最终总会胜利，我的朋友，无论我们向深渊投入多少陈词滥调。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That’s the problem with not going mad. You’re cursed with clarity of thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是未陷入疯狂的代价：你被清晰的思维诅咒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know what I'm talking about. You could have shattered like a sparrow's egg or burnt your brain out with drugs until you felt nothing anymore. And it would have hurt less than this… knowing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道我在说什么。你本可以选择像麻雀蛋一样碎掉，或者用毒品摧毁自己大脑，直到你什么都感觉不到。可这些痛苦都比不上现在……清醒地知道一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't understand why you haven't walked away from this conversation yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不明白你为什么还没有结束这场谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: FIGHT HOW
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 怎么战斗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: IS THAT ALL YOU AND ARTHUR CAN UNDERSTAND? FIGHTING?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是你和亚瑟唯一会的吗？战斗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So you’re putting up with my wails of existential despair as a battle tactic? That’s very Arthur of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以你忍受我这些存在主义的哀嚎，是把它当作一种战斗策略？真是太像亚瑟的作风了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: YOUR ANSWER TO THE UNDERLYING MEANINGLESSNESS OF EXISTENCE IS 'FIND A WAY TO PUNCH IT?'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对于存在本身的虚无，你的回应竟然是"想办法揍它一顿？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't believe I thought we had a single thing in common.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真不敢相信我曾经以为我们有共同之处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: More fool me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真是自作多情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I care about you too, mate. We’re squadmates. We've been through a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 伙计，我也关心你。我们是队友。我们一起经历了很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s only fair to warn you that the good ship Eleanor may go down, either in the bloody sea or the night-black swamp, and you do not want to be on board when she does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 公平地说，我应该警告你，埃莉诺号这艘船可能会沉没，不论是在血海之中还是在漆黑的沼泽里，而你绝对不想在她沉没时仍待在船上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thanks. You should go. I’ll be okay now. Honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。你应该走了。我现在会没事的。真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Giving it a name feels like I've gotten a tiny bit of control back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 给那个东西起个名字，让我感觉我至少回收了一点控制权。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've touched that thing with my mind. I thought I'd be probing Rusalka's mind, but… the outer layers just caved in like wet, spongy plasterboard and then I was immersed in it. Floundering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我用意识接触过那个东西。我以为我会探查到鲁莎卡的思想，但是……外层就像湿漉漉的海绵石膏板一样塌了下来，然后我就完全陷入了其中。挣扎着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Spiffing. Just been shaving my tongue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很好。刚刚在剃舌头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Shaving. These nobbly bits keep sprouting out of it. I think they used to be taste buds. If I don’t slice them off, they get really long and squirmy. Like a sea anemone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对，剃。我舌头上不断冒出一些疙瘩。我觉得它们以前是味蕾。如果我不切掉它们，它们会变得很长，动来动去的，像海葵一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's really no different from trimming one's nails.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这其实和剪指甲没什么区别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. I really should have warned you about this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，我真该事先警告你这件事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Messier, perhaps. But still nothing more than the paring back of an unwanted excrescence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可能会更乱一些。但归根结底不过是修剪掉多余的赘生物罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everybody else knows to be at least a hundred yards away when Eleanor heads into the bathrooms with a kitchen knife and a bottle of surgical alcohol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其他人都知道，当埃莉诺拿着菜刀和一瓶消毒酒精走进浴室时，至少要离她一百米远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just wait patiently and eventually I'll come back out with blood all down my chin and a plastic bag of stuff like crab meat in my hand. I tried to turn the offcuts into burgers once but nobody wanted any.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只要耐心等待，我最后会带着满嘴血、手里还提着一袋像蟹肉的东西出来。我曾经试图把切下的碎肉做成汉堡，但没人愿意吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry, did you want the half hour erotic chat experience or just the five minutes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起，你是想要半小时的情色聊天，还是五分钟就够了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oi. I’m the one with half an eel down my trachea. Pardon me for trying to joke about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 喂。我才是那个喉咙里卡着半条鳗鱼的人。请原谅我试图用玩笑来应对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. Wait a moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。等一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: thids much
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 介么多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: howm i dioing
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我嘬得肿么样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: o but i amm hheehhe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，不过确实是呢呵呵呵

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: welll
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: mmm
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: thnk abot what you wld do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想想你会做什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: me too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我也能

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: feels gooood hehe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 感觉真好哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But not for long though because I get saliva all over the keyboard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过不会持续很久，因为我会把键盘弄得全是口水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Anyway. Now you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不管怎样。现在你知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Damnnable thing does seem to have a mind of its own. When I think about it, I can control it. But when I'm not, it seems to react to my emotions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这该死的玩意儿似乎有自己的想法。当我想它的时候我就能控制它。但我不去想它的时候，它似乎会对我的情绪做出反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All the time. It heals fast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 经常。它恢复得很快。
