/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The more horrid possibility is that its driven not by ME but by my latent connection to the Techrot. I'd rather not consider that option.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 更糟糕的可能是，它不是由我驱动的，而是由我与科腐者的潜在联系驱动的。我宁愿不去考虑这种可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I do hate it when it gets in the way of my teeth, however. The one and only time I ever bit it off completely, it grew back. I'm stuck with this thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过，我真的很讨厌它挡住我的牙齿。有一次我把它完全咬掉了，它又长回来了。这东西我摆脱不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The one and only time I ever bit it off completely, it grew back. I'm stuck with this thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有一次我把它完全咬掉了，它又长回来了。这东西我摆脱不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: At least it’s not getting any longer. Just putting out frondy bits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少它没有再变长。只是长出了一些像叶片的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean, yes? In a heartbeat. But I can’t, so what’s the point of dwelling on it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我是说，当然啊？毫不犹豫。但我做不到，那纠结它又有什么用呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wouldn't have chosen it. But I don't hate it. It feels like it's always been there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不会主动选择它。但我不讨厌它。我感觉它似乎一直都在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I miss the sound of my own voice. I hate that I can't sing anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想念自己的声音。痛恨自己再也无法唱歌了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But the tongue? You might find this hard to believe, but it's comforting sometimes. I'll never be unarmed ever again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但这舌头？你可能觉得这很难相信，有时候它反而给我带来了安慰。我再也不会手无寸铁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. It’s just that sometimes the reason is: an evil bastard did something evil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。只是有时候原因就是：一个邪恶的混蛋做了邪恶的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So if you’re saying that everything always works out for the best, like there’s some great plan or purpose to it all, then you’re on your own. I don’t buy into that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以如果你说一切都是最好的安排，好像所有事情都有一个伟大的计划或目的，那你就自己信去吧。我不相信那一套。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s hero virus stuff. You end up thinking you’re the main character in everyone else’s story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是英雄病毒，你以为自己是别人故事中的主角。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s no great story here, mate. No author in the sky adding little plot beats to my life for dramatic effect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 伙计，这里没有什么伟大的故事。没有什么天上的作者在为我的生活编排小情节，增加戏剧性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I get to make meaning out of the stupid shit that happens to me. I’m the artist, not Sol or Lua or any of the stars in between.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以从发生在我身上的愚蠢事情中寻找意义。我才是艺术家，不是太阳神、月神或任何介于两者之间的星星。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You reminded me of that. I don't know if you even remember. I was feeling sorry for myself and you snapped me out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是你让我想起了这一点。我不知道你是否还记得。我当时在自怜自艾，而你让我清醒过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods, no. I’m saying that meaning is under the surface and it takes a sculptor’s chisel to get to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪，不是的。我是说意义隐藏在表面之下，需要雕刻家的凿子才能发掘出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Some days it all feels bleak, horrible and hollow and I don’t want to get off the couch. But when I’m back to myself again, I know that feeling was a lie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有些时候，一切都感觉黯淡、可怕且空洞，我甚至不想离开沙发。但当我恢复正常时，我知道那种感觉是虚假的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nobody else holds the keys to meaning, you know? It's a jam session between you and the universe. She throws stuff at you, you improvise around it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道吗，没人能掌握生活的意义？这是你和宇宙之间的即兴演奏。它丢给你一些东西，而你围绕它即兴发挥。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It helps to focus on the parts of being semi-infested that I really like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有助于我将注意力集中到半感染状态里那些我喜欢的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Feeling indestructible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 感觉自己坚不可摧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Only one? Have you MET Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只有一个？你见过阿米尔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He has his dark moments, but that boy is an inspiration to us all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他虽然有他的黑暗时刻，但那个男孩激励了我们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Compared to mooching about with a face like a slapped arse, I'll take Amir's attitude any day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想比起那些闷闷不乐、一脸愁容的人，我更喜欢阿米尔的态度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mind if I tell you a story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 介意我给你讲个故事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When I was eighteen, a whole bunch of us had been out celebrating the end of the exams. We were all packed into this tiny car. Me lying across three people’s laps on the back seat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我十八岁那年，我们一大帮人庆祝考试结束。我们都挤在一辆小车里。我躺在后座三个人的腿上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Seb Cromley in the boot, whingeing. Christopher and Marco in the front. Every one of us was drunk off our arse on strawberry vodka and ratcatcher.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 塞布·克罗姆利在后备箱里发牢骚。克里斯托弗和马可坐在前面。我们每个人都喝得烂醉，喝的是草莓伏特加混捕鼠者烈酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Marco ran a red light, a car coming the other way T-boned us, we rolled off the road and ended up in a ditch. I only know that because that’s what the policeman told me had happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 马可闯了红灯，一辆对面来的车撞上了我们的侧面，我们翻出路面，最后掉进了沟里。我之所以知道这些，是因为警察告诉我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They had to cut me out of the car. I wouldn’t stop screaming. It was the kind of hurt that leaves you with no crevice anywhere in yourself to crawl into to get away from it. You're being punished for existing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们不得不把我从车里切割出来。我一直在尖叫。这种伤痛让你浑身无处可逃。你感觉自己只是因为存在就受到了惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was helpless as a baby rabbit. Melted like a crayon. Gone. Just lay there and belted out scream after scream. I'd always thought of myself as a tough cookie before that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我像只无助的小兔子，像融化的蜡笔一样，消失了。只能躺在那里，一声声尖叫。在那之前，我一直以为自己很坚强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Two days ago I was run over by a Scaldra APC.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 两天前我被一辆炽蛇军装甲车撞了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That same old pain went flooding through me, but it wasn’t crippling anymore. It was like fuel, revving me up, making me angry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那种熟悉的痛苦再次涌上心头，但它已不再让我无法动弹。它像燃料一样，激发了我，让我愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I picked myself up, relocated my shoulder and tore that APC open with my bare hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我自己站了起来，重新接上了脱臼的肩膀，然后用我的双手撕开了那台装甲车。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Agonizing, yes. But intoxicating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是痛苦的，但也是令人陶醉的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So yeah, thanks for that much, Entrati. Wherever you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以，真的很感谢你，英择谛。无论你现在身处何方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. My head hurts thinking about it, but okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。想这个让我头疼，但好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So there’s a child. A profoundly traumatized child. And someone thought it was a good idea to give this child weapons and armour and a selection of battle suits made from dead people, train them to kill, and send them off to war?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以有个孩子。一个深受创伤的孩子。真的有人认为给这样一个孩子武器、盔甲和一系列由死人制成的战斗服，训练他们杀人，然后送他们去打仗是个好主意吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tell me, after everything they’ve been through and are still going through, how is that child not catatonic in a hospital?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 告诉我，在经历了所有这些，以及正在经历的情况下，这个孩子怎么还没有在医院里陷入精神崩溃？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Caring? Empathy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 关怀？同情？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course. The Hero Virus. I should have known it would survive to your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然了。英雄病毒。我早该知道它会流传到你们那个时代。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ugh. The Hero Virus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊。英雄病毒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Those poor kids were steeped in a myth, weren't they?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那些可怜的孩子们完全沉浸在一个神话中，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's what I call the cycle of bullshit that starts with pretty stories and ends with young people willingly going to their deaths.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是我所说的荒谬循环，以美好的故事开头，却以年轻人自愿送命结尾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Trained to believe they were honourable warriors, not innocent catspaws?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 被训练去相信自己是光荣的战士，而不是无辜的傀儡吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No need to answer. I think I already know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不用回答。我想我已经知道答案了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur has it. Christopher had it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟有这病，克里斯托弗也有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe I can develop a vaccine and save history.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许我可以研制出一种疫苗，来拯救历史。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Whatever the opposite of Indifference is, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许是虚空无情之物的反面吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wonder…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在想……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nothing. Just an idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没什么。只是一个想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is going to sound stupid, but please promise me something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这听起来可能很愚蠢，但请你答应我一件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know you've found a place here with us. I'm glad about that, truly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道你在我们这里找到了归属，我真的很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All I ask is that you check on the child, if you can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只希望你能，如果可能的话，去看看那个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hmm. I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They'd be no different to the Techrot if all they wanted to do was survive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果他们只是想生存，那么他们和科腐者没什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The way you talk about the kid, I'm not sure if I'm more scared for them or of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 从你谈论这个孩子的方式来看，我不知道我是更担心他们还是更害怕他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think there's mercy in there, though. Some deep compassion. Maybe one day I'll see it for myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我觉得他们内心有怜悯，有深深的同情心。也许有一天我会亲眼看到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. I just hope you're sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。我只是希望你确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because whatever they have inside them that can endure everything they went through and still feel empathy? We're going to need it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为他们内心那个能忍受他们所经历的一切，并仍然心存同情的东西？我们都需要那种力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not sure that slaughtering thousands while carrying untold trauma is 'doing fine', frankly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 坦白说，我并不确定屠杀数千人并承受难以言喻的创伤是否算"过得很好"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd want to know how they were coping.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想知道他们是怎么应对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you. I admit, the idea of talking to an alternate version of yourself is exciting to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。我承认，与另一个版本的自己交谈对我来说很兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: In fact, learning of your alternate version convinced me there must be another me out there somewhere who decided to become a nun. An apostle of Lua, shaven head, regular prayers, all of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 事实上，得知你的另一个版本后，我确信在某个地方一定有另一个决定成为一名修女的我。 月神的信徒，剃光头，定期祈祷，所有这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've been trying to make contact with her telepathically. If you can do it so can I, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一直在尝试通过心灵感应与她联系。如果你能做到，我也能，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't be such a spoilsport.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别泼冷水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. But I’m going to keep trying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有。但我会继续尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean if anyone's going to have words of wisdom for me it'll be the me who's been devoting her life to spiritual things, no?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我是说，如果谁会给我些智慧的忠告，那肯定是那个一生都奉献给精神追求的"我"，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So stop me if I get any of this wrong:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我说错了什么，随时打断我：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’ve got another self out there, walking around. That other self both is and isn’t you. They’re like a kid version of you from another version of reality.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你还有另一个自己在外面四处走动。那个另一个自己既是你，又不是你。他们就像是另一个现实版本的你的孩童版。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Whoa Nelly. Hang on. Let me process that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哇喔，等一下。让我消化一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I take it we are in THEIR reality, not yours. Let me... process that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以我们现在是处于他们的现实里，不是你的，对吗？我得……消化一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So… you’re like a guest star from a crossover episode and you got written into the show?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这么说……你就像是跨界剧集的客串明星，然后被写进了这个剧情？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is making my head spin. So what happened to your version of reality? Where’s it gone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这让我头都晕了。那你那个版本的现实怎么样了？它去哪了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then it lives on, in some sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么从某种意义上来说，它依然存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You can't just LOSE a whole cosmos. That's insane. It has to be out there somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你不能就这样"丢失"一个整个宇宙。那太疯狂了。它一定还在某个地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah! The lair of your friendly ghosts. The Holdfasts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊！你那友善幽灵们的巢穴。坚守者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry, that sounds fascinating but I have no idea what you're on about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，这听起来很有趣，但我不知道你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't imagine it's the kind of place you'd want to pop back to for a nostalgic stroll.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我实在无法想象，那会是你想回去散步怀旧的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ghost ship?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 幽灵船？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't begin to fathom what you've lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我无法想象你都失去了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hole between dimensions?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 维度之间的洞？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't know if that's any kind of a comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道这是否算一种安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But that’s your HOME. Don’t you want to get back there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但那是你的家。你不想回去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't imagine it's the kind of place you'd want to pop back to for a nostalgic stroll.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我实在无法想象，那会是你想回去散步怀旧的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't begin to fathom what you've lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我无法想象你都失去了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Huh. I’m oddly proud of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哈。奇怪的是，这让我有点自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe you just needed the right bunch of lethally stylish urban bio-commandos to associate with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许你只是需要一支合适的、致命而时尚的都市生物突击队来作伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And proud of it, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 伙计，而且还感到自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But getting back to the other version of you…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但回到你的另一个版本……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ooh. Harsh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢，太狠了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Given how much you have in common, you might be a little kinder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 考虑到你们有那么多共同之处，你可以对他们更温柔一些的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I love that she has children. Lethal space children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我喜欢她有孩子这件事。那些致命的太空孩童。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wonder if she'd let me be one? Do I get to be a Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在想她会不会让我成为其中一个？我能成为 Tenno 吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. I don't suppose I would, would I? I'm too old, for a start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。我我想我不能吧？首先，我太老了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So here’s the part I don’t understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以这是我不明白的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The kid is umpty-billion years old, but they spent most of that time in a freezer, so they’re still a kid, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这个孩子已经有数十亿岁了，但是他们大部分时间都待在冰箱里，所以他们还是个孩子，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A. Child. Is. A Child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 孩子。就是。孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Bear with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请稍稍体谅下我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They don't conveniently turn into something else when they're mistreated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们不会因为受到虐待就变成其他东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Stop me immediately if this isn't something you want to talk about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你不想谈论这个话题，请立刻告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Zariman? What happened with your parents? This child has been through the same horrific ordeal you went through, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那艘扎里曼号？你的父母的事？这个孩子和你一样经历了那些恐怖的事件，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hello, Drifter. I'm upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Two things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 两件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I miss wine. I've not had real wine in so bloody long. All the wine in Höllvania got requisitioned by Scaldra command a few days into the outbreak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想念葡萄酒。我已经很久没喝过真正的酒了。霍瓦尼亚所有的酒都在疫情爆发几天后被炽蛇军指挥部征用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Quincy and Arthur tried making prison hooch out of fruit ration sachets, but those of us who still had some dignity left said no. Rare moment of Lettie solidarity, that was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 昆西和亚瑟试着用水果口粮包做监狱特酿，但我们这些还有点尊严的人拒绝了。这可是莱蒂难得的团结时刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The other thing, the much much bigger thing, is the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 另一件事，也是更重要的事情，是未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s not your fault, but… now that I’ve seen the future through your eyes I feel miserable in a way that the usual methods won’t shift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这不是你的错，但是……现在我从你的眼里看到了未来，从某种意义上说我觉得很痛苦，常用的方法都无法改变这种痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't know. Maybe an exotic dance?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道。也许跳一段异国情调的舞蹈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Spending the evening with Amir listening to him enthuse about whatever comic series or retro game he’s currently fixating on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 和阿米尔一起度过一个晚上，听他热情地谈论他目前着迷的漫画系列或复古游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Describe Ballas's death to me in loving detail?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 向我详细描述一下 Ballas 的死？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Surrounding myself with crystals and mentally chanting until Lettie calls the exorcist on me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 用水晶包围我自己，心里默念，直到莱蒂叫驱魔师来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's kind of you to offer, but I think this melancholy will just have to be borne.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你的好心，但我觉得这份忧愁是不得不承受的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is a different kind of sad. It’s weighing me down like a soggy blanket.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是一种不同的悲伤。它像一条湿透的毯子一样重重地压着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Look, I was never really into science fiction. Arthur went through a phase, but he always preferred the gritty army stuff. Manly men being heroes, wholesome Stories for Boys, oodles of subtext, I'm sure you know the sort of thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听着，我从来都不喜欢科幻小说。亚瑟有一段时间喜欢，但他总是更喜欢坚韧不拔的军队题材。男子汉成为英雄，积极健康的男孩们的故事，有大量的潜台词，我相信你知道这种东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fine. Take me by the hand and walk me through the streets of Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。拉着我的手，陪我穿过霍瓦尼亚的街道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But I did know enough about science fiction to know that in the far far future, we are supposed to have our shit together. It’s meant to be all shiny and antiseptic. Robots do all the hard work, there’s no disease, nobody needs money, it’s all silver towers, blue skies and sexy lizards.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我对科幻小说的了解足以让我知道，在遥远的未来，我们应该把我们的事情安排得井井有条。一切应该是光鲜亮丽、一腐不染的。机器人做所有艰苦的工作，没有疾病，没有人需要钱，到处都是银色的塔、蓝蓝的天和性感的蜥蜴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know a place where we can grab some grated turnip cakes and watch the sun go down over the remains of a school.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道一个地方，我们可以在那里吃一些碎萝卜蛋糕，再看看太阳从学校的废墟上空落下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Later we can sip cocktails by the light of a burning tank.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 稍后，我们可以在燃烧坦克的光下品尝鸡尾酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, all right. You get a point for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，这可以给你加一分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ugh. I don’t… it’s complicated. Let me explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 唉，我不是……这很复杂。让我解释一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But did those robots make life any easier for ordinary people?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但这些机器人真的让普通人的生活变得更轻松了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not saying I expected the future to look like a children's comic book. I just mean there was this optimism associated with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不是说我期待未来看起来像儿童漫画那样美好。我只是说对未来有一种乐观的期待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think we all just took it for granted that however shitty things might be right now, we’d sort it out eventually. Our civilization is meant to progress. We started out smashing each other over the head with clubs and after a few thousand years we’d figured out ways to sort our differences out without doing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们似乎都理所当然地认为，无论现在有多么困难，终究会有解决的一天。我们的文明注定要向前发展。我们一开始是用棍棒互相砸对方的头，几千年后，我们学会了用更文明的方式来解决分歧，而不是靠暴力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or did they just become something else to take for granted?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还是只是变成了另一种被人们视为理所当然的存在？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Bingo. You’ve put your finger right on what I find so depressing about all this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一针见血。你所说的正是我对这一切感到沮丧的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Precisely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Obviously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. That's what's so disappointing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。这就是令人失望的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You had all this incredible, magical technology at your fingertips and all you did with it was find new ways to exploit each other. Science made us less equal, not more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们拥有所有这些不可思议的神奇技术，却只用它来找到新的方式去剥削彼此。科学并没有让我们变得更平等，反而是更加不平等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's how you know what needs to be changed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只有这样我们才能知道哪里需要改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're advanced, but you were meant to be ENLIGHTENED too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们很先进，但也应该有更高的觉悟

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thanks for bearing with me. I know it's a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 感谢你的耐心，我知道这些说起来可能有点多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods I don’t mean you personally. I mean your era.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，天啊，我不是指你个人。我是说你所在的那个时代。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If anything you went backwards. God-kings in the flesh! Of all the things to reinvent, you reinvented THEM.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说到变化，你们是在倒退。还神的化身！那么多可以重新创造的东西，你们居然选了这个！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. I didn’t forget the part where the emotionally abused orphans murdered the immortal elite. I just love that bit. If I close my eyes I can almost imagine the screaming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。我没忘记那些情感受虐的孤儿们杀死不朽精英的那部分。我特别喜欢那一幕。如果我闭上眼睛，我几乎可以想象到尖叫声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... is irony obsolete in the future too?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……未来连讽刺也过时了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: THEY HAVE DAD JOKES IN THE FUTURE
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 未来居然有这种冷笑话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Happy now. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在开心了。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe I'll paint.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许我会去画画。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know what the best thing about Höllvania was, back before the Scaldra took over?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道在炽蛇军接管之前，霍瓦尼亚最棒的事情是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Boo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods. Surgically beautiful people getting their immaculate faces off on untested drugs? No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪。那些整过容的拥有完美脸蛋的美人吸食未经测试的毒品？不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Look. I have nothing against watching a pair of sweaty blokes go at one another, hard. But no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听着。我一点也不反对看两个大汗淋漓的家伙互相厮杀。但不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Good guess. You could get anything from a Bresslin handbag and glove combo to a human eyeball on ice. But no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 猜得好。你可以买到任何东西，从布雷斯林手提包和手套套装到冷冻的人类眼球。但不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, of course you have no idea. You're a fresh-faced newcomer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，你当然不知道。你是一个初来乍到的新人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The bath houses!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是澡堂！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know if they have anything like that where you are. They’re these temples, I suppose you’d call them, usually with a Sol set of rooms and a Lua set. You can soak in a public or a private pool. Everything smells herbal and steamy and it’s SO GOOD for getting your head back on straight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道你所在的地方有没有类似的。我想你会称它们为庙堂，通常有一套太阳房和一套月亮房。你可以在公共或者私人池里泡泡。一切散发着草药和蒸汽的味道，很有助于提神醒脑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Höllvania's always had this hugely important tradition of ritual cleanliness. I guess it goes all the way back to the hot springs the city was built on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚一直有非常重要的清洁仪式传统。我想这一切都要追溯到这座城市赖以建立的温泉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All that ‘purity' crap Viktor comes out with? He's singing an age-old tune. All the citizens know where he's coming from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 维克多说的那些"纯洁"的废话？他在唱老调。所有市民都懂他的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I used to love paying the extra Höllars to have a musclebound professional pound all the tension out of my muscles. You'd have loved it. I'm sure you would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我曾经喜欢花额外的霍币，让一个肌肉发达的专业人士把我肌肉中所有的紧张都松解出来。你会喜欢的。我相信你会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You'll strut about in a suit made from an Infested human body, but draw the line at massages?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你会穿着一件由被感染的人体制成的衣服大摇大摆地走来走去，却不愿意接受按摩？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I knew you were my kind of squadmate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我就知道你是我这类的队友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wish some of the others were a bit less uptight. Sadly, there was no way the bath houses could stay open after the outbreaks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我希望其他人也不那么拘谨。遗憾的是，疫情爆发后，澡堂根本无法继续开放。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m sure you can guess. The Techrot wrecked so much. There was no way the bath houses could stay open after the outbreaks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我相信你能猜到。科腐者破坏了这么多。疫情爆发后，澡堂根本无法继续开放。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: From what I've seen, some of them are basically spawning pools now. It breaks my heart, to tell you the truth. I remember finding thousand-year-old marble and mosaic floors carpeted over with creeping flesh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 据我所见，其中一些现在基本上就是产卵池了。说实话，这让我心碎。我记得，我在那蔓延的血肉之下，发现了有着千年历史的大理石和马赛克地板。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you have anything like that in your time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们那时候也有过这样的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So what do people do to unwind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么人们怎么放松呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds like Amir making sound effect noises to himself...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来像是阿米尔对自己发出音效噪音……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Stockbrokers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 炒股的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Komi? Black and white counters? The wedding-war of Sol and Lua?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 围棋？黑色和白色的棋子？太阳神和月亮神的婚礼之战？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Dad and Arthur used to watch the wrestling together every Saturday night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 爸爸和亚瑟以前每周六晚上都会一起看摔跤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But they're your enemies, aren't they? Or is there some kind of truce when it comes to team sports?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但他们是你的敌人，不是吗？还是你们在团队运动方面有某种休战？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Old? It's SACRED! But also fun. A wonderful combination.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 古老？它是神圣的！而且很有趣。绝妙的组合。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everything's about the same two essential principles, you know? Mind and body. Symbol and meaning. Sol and Lua.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道吗，一切都围绕着相同的两个基本原则？心灵与身体。象征与意义。太阳神与月亮神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur and I used to play Komi every year at Solstice. Why did we ever stop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟和我以前每年冬至都下围棋。我们后来为什么停下来了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Slip him some Rathuum tapes if you get the chance. I think he'd love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果有机会，就给他塞几盘死亡角斗场的录像带。我想他会喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What am I saying? Of course there is. That's just how people are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在说什么呢？当然有。人性就是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have to ask you something and I don’t think you’re going to like it. I think you must have known deep down that this conversation would have to happen one day, given my condition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我得问你点事，但我觉得你不会喜欢的。考虑到我的状况，我想你内心深处一定知道，这个对话总有一天会发生的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I trust you, and I like you, so I'm just going to come out with it, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我信任你，我也喜欢你，所以我就直说了，可以吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have no right to ask, really, but I need to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没有权利问，真的，但我需要知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If I turned, completely - if the Techrot took me and I wasn't the Eleanor you knew anymore - would you kill me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我彻底变了——如果完全变成科腐者，我不再是你认识的那个埃莉诺——你会杀了我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hmm. Good start. You’ve made it about what I want instead of seeing my life as an opportunity to flex your personal morals. You just let me know that this isn’t about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。很好的开始。你把这个问题变成了我想要什么，而不是把我的生命看成是体现你个人道德的机会。你刚让我知道这个问题不是关于你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wow. Okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哇！好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. Um.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That’s rare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这很难得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No hesitation, no struggle, just a simple yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有犹豫，没有挣扎，只是一个简单的好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. I'm actually a little overwhelmed. I didn't expect you to be that forthright.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。我其实有点不知所措。我没想到你会这么直率。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I won't ask again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不会再问了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Unfortunately it doesn't get us out of our dilemma, because it means I never get to change my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 遗憾的是，它并不能让我们走出困境，因为这意味着我永远不能改变我的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you. You're an enigma to me in many ways, but now I know you'd be willing to put a bullet through my head, and that sort of thing is important in the workplace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你。你在很多方面对我来说都是一个谜，但现在我知道你愿意一枪打穿我的脑袋，这种事在职场上很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You'd let the monster live?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你会让那怪物继续活着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I suppose we'll have to wait until it happens to see how you react, won't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我们只有等事情发生时才能知道你的反应，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let's say I say yes, I'd want you to end me quick and clean rather than for me to go on living as a ravening freak. Let's say that's what Eleanor wants NOW.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 假设我说想让你这么做，我希望你能干净利落地了结我的生命，而不是让我像个贪婪的怪物一样活下去。假设这就是埃莉诺现在想要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Aaaand I just felt the Techrot in my cells give an anxious little quiver.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而我刚刚感觉到细胞里的科腐者紧张地颤了一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry, sorry, it's just that I've been living every day with Lettie in my ear crowing about how I don't deserve to be here and Arthur looking at me like I'm a lost cause and he's counting the days till he has to do it, and I just didn't expect you to say that ok
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，抱歉，只是莱蒂一直在我耳边嚷嚷我不配待在这里，亚瑟看着我像看一个无可救药的人，他在数算着那个他不得不动手的日子，我只是没想到你会这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're a lethal little enigma.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真是一个致命的小谜团。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But what if the ravening freak is me, only more so? What if, once my humanity burns away in the Techrot crucible, I don’t WANT to die?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但如果这个贪婪的怪物就是我，甚至比我更像我呢？要是，一旦我的人性在科腐者的熔炉中燃烧殆尽，而我不想死了呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think it's going to behave itself a little better from now on. Nothing like threatening the host to put the fear of Sol into the parasite, eh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想它接下来会老实一点了吧。没有什么比威胁宿主更能让寄生虫害怕的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Crying. Happy tears. Talk soon. Please
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在哭。流下的是高兴的泪水。我们再聊吧。拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And so am I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because it makes me feel alive, Drifter. Powerfully alive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为它我觉得自己还活着，漂泊者。有力地活着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. So we're sacrificing happy, empowered Eleanor on the altar of Eleanor as she used to be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。所以，我们是要把那个快乐又充满力量的埃莉诺牺牲在祭坛上，去换回她过去的样子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, so all I'd need to do is blink my big beautiful eyes at you and your resolve would crumble?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，所以我只需要对你眨一下我那双美丽的大眼睛，你的决心就会崩塌吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. Right. In this scenario, I'm an inhuman monster who's presumably slaughtering people willy-nilly. You get to put me in the ‘predatory animal' category, along with rabid dogs and hungry bears and such, which means there's no moral quandary.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊。对。在这种情况下，我是一个没有人性的怪物，可能正在随意屠杀人们。你可以把我归类为"捕食性动物"，和疯狗、饥饿的熊什么的一类，这样就不存在道德难题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … I don't know. Some days I think so. I feel like the stock character from a melodrama.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我不知道。有一段时间我是这么想的。我感觉自己像是肥皂剧里的一个典型角色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can change my mind and decide to live, but you can't change yours?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以改变主意并决定活下去，但你就不能改变你的想法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What kind of fearless vampire killer would you be then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那你还算什么无所畏惧的吸血鬼杀手呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So tell me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: "Oh no, the hapless girl we once loved has become a sexy vampire. Let us kill her so that in death she will become pure and innocent once again."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "哦不，我们曾经爱过的倒霉女孩变成了性感的吸血鬼。让我们杀了她，让她死后再次变得纯洁无辜。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you wait until I claim my first victim before you pop a bullet through my skull?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你会等到我夺走第一个受害者再向我的头开枪吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because if you don’t, how can you be sure I’m a danger?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为如果你不这样做，你怎么能确定我是一个危险的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I obsessed over it, actually. I had nightmares where I’d wake up on my couch and Arthur would be standing over me, tears in his eyes and sword in his hand, and he’d grate out some line about how Eleanor was his sister but now Eleanor was GONE, and he had to do this even though it was killing him, boo hoo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其实，我对此非常痴迷。我做过噩梦，梦见自己在沙发上醒来，亚瑟站在我面前，眼含泪水，手握长剑，艰难地说埃莉诺是他的姐姐，但现在埃莉诺已经不在了，他必须这么做，即使这会让他痛苦不已，呜呜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I shouldn't be surprised. It's the ending the stories prepare you for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不应该感到惊讶。这正是故事为你准备的结局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'll tell you. You'll be the kind who dies halfway through the movie, because they didn't have the heart to Do What Had To Be Done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我告诉你，你会成为电影里中途就死掉的那种人，因为你没勇气去做必须做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: "Oh no, the hapless girl we once loved has become a sexy vampire. Let us kill her so that in death she will become pure and innocent once again."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "哦不，我们曾经爱过的倒霉女孩变成了性感的吸血鬼。让我们杀了她，让她死后再次变得纯洁无辜。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You'll be a warning to the others, you will!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你会成为其他人的警钟，你一定会！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. I'm not being very fair with you. Talk soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，我对你不太公平。我们稍后再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I obsessed over it, actually. I had nightmares where I’d wake up on my couch and Arthur would be standing over me, tears in his eyes and sword in his hand, and he’d grate out some line about how Eleanor was his sister but now Eleanor was GONE, and he had to do this even though it was killing him, boo hoo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其实，我对此非常痴迷。我做过噩梦，梦见自己在沙发上醒来，亚瑟站在我面前，眼含泪水，手握长剑，艰难地说埃莉诺是他的姐姐，但现在埃莉诺已经不在了，他必须这么做，即使这会让他痛苦不已，呜呜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And as he shoves the blade between my ribs I'm screaming "Eleanor is RIGHT HERE, you stupid bastard!" but he can't hear me anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当他把剑插入我的肋骨时，我尖叫着"埃莉诺就在这里，你这个蠢货！"他已经听不见我的声音了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And as he shoves the blade between my ribs I'm screaming "Eleanor is RIGHT HERE, you stupid bastard!" but he can't hear me anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当他把剑插入我的肋骨时，我尖叫着"埃莉诺就在这里，你这个蠢货！"他已经听不见我的声音了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe I'll dream about you next.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许下一次我会梦到你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: O Drifter! O vagabond of time and space! How welcome your presence is on this little screen of mine!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊，漂泊者！啊，时间与空间的流浪者！能在这小小的屏幕上见到你，真是太好了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey matey.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Guess what.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 猜猜我有什么话说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ugh. I’m so tediously bloody predictable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃。我真容易被猜到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... you'd like that, wouldn't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你会喜欢的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Alas, no. My bottom has not been improved by the addition of a tail. It cannot be improved, for it is already perfect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 唉，没有。我的屁股并没有因为加了尾巴而变得更好。它不可能更好了，因为它已经很完美了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, I do. Yet another one. But this is a really big one, so bear with me, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，有。又一个新问题。这个问题很重大，所以请耐心听我说，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: However, I did have a question for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过，我确实有个问题想问你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Good. Great. So.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的，那太好了。那么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How do relationships work in your time? I mean, is it all the usual ‘two or more adults get together with varying degrees of solemnization' stuff? Or are there all sorts of rules about who can be with who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们那个时代，人们的关系是如何构建的？我的意思是，是不是还是常见的"两个或多个的成年人，以不同的正式方式在一起"？还是很多规则限制谁可以和谁在一起？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gosh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也是。当然了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Those two on Deimos, Father and Mother. They're a married couple. They may be gigantic Infested former Orokin whatnots, but they're very clearly and painfully MARRIED in exactly the same way my mum and dad are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 火卫二上的那两个人，"父亲"和"母亲"。他们是一对夫妻。虽然他们可能是庞大的、感染的前奥罗金生物，但他们的婚姻显然非常痛苦，就像我父母的一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: From the bits and pieces I've gleaned from your mind, I still see standard pairings of people. Folks who are very clearly and painfully MARRIED in exactly the same way my mum and dad are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 从你脑海中收集到的零星信息中，人们还是保持着传统的配对方式。他们的婚姻显然非常痛苦，就像我父母的一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So was that standard for Orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，这是奥罗金的常态吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know you were isolated in Duviri, but I had no idea you were THAT isolated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道你在双衍王境里是孤立的，但我真没想到你会孤立到这种地步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let me try another tack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 让我来试试另一种问法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sincerely sorry if I've caused you any upset by asking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我这个问题给你带来任何不快，我真的很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let's see...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 来看看……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. So where you come from, would it be normal for a person to be in a relationship with, say, a Cephalon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。那在你来自的地方，一个人和一个中枢在一起，这种情况正常吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am trying to ask a THEORETICAL question!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我是在问一个理论上的问题！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not aching to grind myself against your glassy chum, however charming he may be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不是真的想去和你那玻璃朋友亲密接触，无论他有多迷人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Damn. Let me try again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可恶。我再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm trying, and failing, to ask you about POWER IMBALANCES
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在尝试问你关于"权力不平等"的问题，但似乎没问出来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Make up someone from your time who’s both female and dangerous. Strong, too. Like Major Rusalka without the demonic possession.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想象一下你那个时代的某个人，既是女性，又很危险。而且很强大。就像没有被恶魔附身的鲁莎卡少校那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. Let’s say there’s a Grineer sniper lady and she falls for a human. And it’s mutual. Star crossed lovers. Desperately tragic. Could they be together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。假设有一位 Grineer 狙击手女士和一个人类互相坠入爱河。命运多舛的恋人。极其悲惨。他们能在一起吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. Let’s say there’s a Dax soldier lady and she falls for a lowly human. And it’s mutual. Star crossed lovers. Desperately tragic. Could they be together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。假设有一位禁卫女士和一个卑微的人类互相坠入爱河。命运多舛的恋人。极其悲惨。他们能在一起吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m tying myself in knots here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在这儿越说越乱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is it normal where you come from for people to get together with partners who are far more powerful and dangerous than they are? Like in ‘Gumbly and the Dragon's Socks' when the elf prince ends up married to the giant?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在你们那里，人们和比自己强大得多、危险得多的人在一起，这种情况常见吗？就像《甘布利和龙的袜子》中精灵王子最后和巨人结婚一样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Question: can two people with wildly differing physiques and lethality levels be in a relationship? Answer: yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 问：两个体型和杀伤力差别很大的人可以谈恋爱吗？答：可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: … you don’t know what I’m talking about, do you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你不知道我在说什么，对吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's all I wanted to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想知道的就是这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd better stop. I'm in danger of making a complete berk of myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那我还是不问了。不然我可能会让自己出丑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t want to ruin your day. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不想毁了你的一天。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can I be allowed a self-pitying rant?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以自怨自艾地抱怨一番吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am NOT saying my life is meaningless without someone to share it with
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不是说没有人共度一生我就活得没意义

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am NOT defined by who I choose to love
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不是由我所爱的人定义的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am sufficient unto myself
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我自己就是完整的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: BUT HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO EVEN ENTERTAIN THE POSSIBILITY OF A RELATIONSHIP WHEN I COULD LITERALLY KILL SOMEONE BY ACCIDENT IF I GOT CARRIED AWAY
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但在我一激动就可能不小心杀人的情况下，我怎么可能考虑开始一场恋爱呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Welcome to Eleanor and her horny mantis problems
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 欢迎了解埃莉诺和她的交配螳螂问题

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If I ever find that Entrati bastard I will turn his balls into earrings. If he has any balls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我能找到那个英择谛混蛋，我会把他的蛋蛋做成耳环。如果他还有蛋蛋的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: OMFS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦我的天

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I AM LITERALLY BITING MY TONGUE SO I DON'T LAUGH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真的是在咬舌头，不让自己笑出声来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The only one of those four I could even CONSIDER dating is Aoi and that's complicated because of Arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在那四个人中，我唯一可以考虑约会的就是碧，但因为亚瑟，这很麻烦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Bless you for suggesting that but no, not in a million years
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你的建议，但不行，绝对不可能

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You know what I am better than I do, I think. I’m a Protoframe. I’m a partially transformed war machine, and it feels like it’s getting less partial by the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得你比我自己还更了解我究竟是什么。我是原型战甲。是一个部分变形的战争机器，而且那还未变形的部分似乎每天都在减少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Whoever designed poor ‘Nyx' was building a killer. That's me, now. Efficient. Lethal. Cuddly as a claymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 无论是谁设计了可怜的"Nyx"，他都在打造一个杀手。那就是现在的我。高效。致命。像地雷一样可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All very well when it comes to the day job, but at the office party who’s going to kiss a walking deathtrap under the mistletoe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对于日常工作来说还行，但在办公室聚会上，谁会想在槲寄生下亲吻一个行走的死亡陷阱呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No it hasn’t happened because I haven’t bloody let it. OK?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有，因为我根本不会允许那种事发生。好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No partners, no casualties. Not worth the risk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有伴侣，就没有伤亡。不值得冒这个险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I hadn't considered that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我以前没想到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’d rather be lonely than steeped in guilt, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我宁愿孤独，也不愿背负罪恶感，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Our memories persist, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我们的记忆还在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't think anyone would want to be in a relationship with someone who bit their head off once, even if it got better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不认为会有人愿意和曾经咬掉他们头的人谈恋爱，即使后来情况好转了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lua wept. I need a drink now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 月神啊。我现在需要喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Correct. A trade-off I am quite willing to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错。这是我非常愿意做出的牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. I’m not sure talking about this was a good idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起。我不确定谈论这个是不是个好主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I need to be on my own for a bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我需要独处一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I've done it. I broke through. I made contact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我做到了。我突破了。我取得了联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you there? Please be there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你在吗？请一定要在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Am I going to have to do this over telepathy? Oh God. Please not now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我必须通过心灵感应做这件事吗？哦，神啊。求你了，不要现在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ever since you appeared, a question has been pestering me. A question I believe I might've just answered. And dear Sol I don't know what I've done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 自从你出现以后，一个问题一直困扰着我。我觉得我可能刚找到了答案。亲爱的太阳神，我不知道我做了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You! The question of bloody You. You exist not once but twice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你！问题就是这个该死的你。你不只存在一次，而是两次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And if you could exist in another world, as another version of yourself, why couldn't I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你能在另一个世界、以另一个版本的自己存在，那我为什么不行呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Somewhere out there in the now-confirmed-to-exist vast possible universes was that version of myself that I always wondered if I should become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在这些现已被证实存在的无限的可能宇宙中，存在着那个我曾经想过要不要成为的我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The one who turned away from the world to become a nun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个放弃俗世去当修女的我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: An apostle of Lua sat on a mountaintop somewhere, incense clouds flowering around her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一位月神的信徒坐在某座山顶上，周围香烟缭绕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've been trying to contact her. Trying to reach through the Void to find her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一直在尝试联系她。试图穿过虚空去寻找她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The other me. The one who became a nun. I've been trying to contact her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 另一个我。成为修女的我。我一直在尝试联系她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just did it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我刚刚做到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course it was never going to work so long as I stayed in this world. I'm already the ‘me' of this world. I had to go through the roaring whiteness. The blackstar fugue. The leechbone gulf. That's how you get to the other sides. The maybes and the could-have-beens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然，只要我还留在这个世界，这件事就永远无法实现。我已经是这个世界的"我"了。我必须穿越那咆哮的白色所在。黑星赋格。水蛭之渊。那才是通往其他面的方式。可能和曾经可能的世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Void! I saw the Void!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空！我看到了虚空！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Drifter dear, I admire your ability to use humour as a coping mechanism, but right now I am entirely serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，我很欣赏你用幽默来作为自己的应对机制，但此刻我是非常严肃的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I went in with my mind, not my body. That’s the difference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我是用我的思想进去的，不是身体。这就是区别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I did what I set out to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我实现了自己的计划。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I not only saw the Void, I entered it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不仅仅是见到了虚空，我还进去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ow headache ow ow ow
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎哟，头痛死了，好痛

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That’s how I got into the Void in the first place. Through that memory. The horror was just smoke and through the smoke was a GATE. If I hadn’t been so frightened I would have seen it clearly the first time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我最初是通过那段记忆进入虚空的。恐惧只是烟雾，而穿过烟雾就是一扇门。如果我当时没有那么害怕，我一开始就能清楚地看到它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s a feeling there isn’t a word for. You look out on the world and you just KNOW, that all the ordinariness - buildings, cars, people, jobs, work, routine - is just a thin crust over a bottomless horror, and if people ever realized it they’d start screaming and never stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有一种感觉是无法用语言形容的。你望向这个世界，你就知道，所有的平凡事物——建筑、汽车、人们、工作、日常生活——都只是一层薄薄的表皮，掩盖着无尽的恐怖。如果人们意识到这一点，他们会开始尖叫，永远不停歇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not even a little bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一点儿也没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I fell through the crust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我穿过了那层表皮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just listen. Please. And try to understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请听我说。并试着去理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It wasn’t emptiness. I could have borne that. It went on and on forever, but it wasn’t just cold space. There was something in there with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那不是空无。我本能承受空无。它无止境地延续，但那并不仅仅是冰冷的空间。那里有什么东西与我同在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It tried. I felt it. I knew it was curious, reaching for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它试图这么做。我感觉到了。我知道它在好奇，向我伸手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s okay that you’re not convinced. I know this sounds insane. Just hear me out, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你不信也没关系。我知道这听起来很疯狂。但请听我说完，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ll make a deal with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们来个约定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: First you let me finish telling you what happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你先让我把发生的事情讲完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Once I’m done, you can make your own mind up about whether it was the Indifference messing with me or not. I promise I’ll take you seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等我讲完后，你再自己决定这是不是虚空无情之物在搞鬼。我保证我会认真考虑你的意见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Deal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 成交吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not sure what to say. I'm a bit concerned, because you sound so upset, but I didn't realise you cared quite so much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道该说什么。我有点担心，因为你听起来很难过，但我没想到你竟然这么在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm all right. Please don't worry about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没事。请不要担心我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't promise anything, but I'll try not to scare you again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不能保证什么，但我会尽量不再吓到你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So like I was saying. I found her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 正如我之前说的。我找到她了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could feel the Indifference watching. I could feel it make a face like one of those dried-out desert mummies as it reached out for me. I reached out for her, and she pulled me through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我能感觉到虚空无情之物在注视我。当它向我伸手时，我能感觉到它那干枯如沙漠木乃伊的面孔。我向她伸出手，她把我拉了过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She was sitting in the Lotus position in some kind of open-air shrine, next to a pit full of embers. It was nighttime. The moon was dim, ghosting through scrolling clouds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她正以莲花坐姿坐在某种露天神庙里，旁边是一个堆满余烬的坑。当时是晚上。月亮昏暗，在滚动的云层中若隐若现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She put a finger to her lips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她把一根手指放在嘴唇上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For a second I could feel that giant hand still groping for me. Then it recoiled, like a guillotine had come down on one of its fingers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那一瞬间，我还能感觉到那只巨手在摸索着我。然后它突然收回，就像是它的一根手指被断头台砍下了一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Grass whispered. Crickets sang. We were alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 草儿在沙沙作响。蟋蟀在歌唱。我们俩独处一室。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We sat across the fire-pit from each other. She didn't speak, but she let me look into her mind, soft and sisterly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们隔着火坑对坐。她没有说话，但她让我进入她的内心，那么柔和，如同姐妹一般。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She was so happy, so perfectly content. A woman in the place that was right for her. Callused feet, clear eyes. Breathing the fire and drinking the moon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她非常幸福，非常满足。一个找到了正确位置的女人。双脚长满老茧，双眼清澈。呼吸着火焰，品味月色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No! Just the opposite!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不！恰恰相反！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I didn't need to take that path, because she already had. Don't you see? I'm free now. I never need to wonder ‘what if' because there already IS a Sister Eleanor. She's got my back. Am I making sense?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不需要走那条路，因为她已经走过了。你不明白吗？我现在自由了。我再也不需要想"如果"了，因为已经有了埃莉诺修女。她会支持我。我说得有道理吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh yeah. I’ve never been more certain of what to do next.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，当然。我从未如此确定接下来该做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m going to take the life she freed me up to live, and live it to the hilt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我要尽情享受她给予我的自由，尽情享受生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods, yeah. We were thick as thieves for a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦天哪，是的。有一段时间我们亲密无间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's a little personal, mate, but I'll allow it. You've been with us a while. You deserve to know the lay of the land.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 伙计，这个问题有点私人，但我允许你这么做。你跟我们在一起已经有一段时间了。你应该了解这里的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Someone not a million miles away, you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是说一个离我们不太远的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That was before Entrati, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然，那是在遇见英择谛之前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Apart from Arthur and Aoi dating? No. Not that I know about, anyway... and I WOULD know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 除了亚瑟和碧约过会以外？没有。至少我不知道，不管怎么样……我都会知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't answer that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别回答这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Now she acts like I’m a different person. Convenient for her. If I’m not really Eleanor then she can be as hurtful towards me as she wants, because she’s not hurting the person she knew. I think it’s cowardly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在她对我就像我变了个人。这对她来说很方便。如果我不是真正的埃莉诺，那么她可以随心所欲地伤害我，因为她并不伤害她认识的人。我认为这是懦弱的表现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And in case you're thinking about making a move on any of us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你要是想对我们中的谁下手的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If I thought they knew what they were doing and had genuine feelings for the guy, I'd be thrilled. Obviously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我认为他们知道自己在做什么，并且对他有真感情，我会很激动。不言而喻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... you could do worse than earn Quincy's trust. He sees a lot. Maybe you could take notes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你最好先获得昆西的信任。他看到很多东西。也许你可以从他那儿学到什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But I'd want to make sure they knew how easy it is to hurt him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我想确保对方知道伤害他有多容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What are those robot things that are all armour and attitude on the outside but the inside is all soft, squishy organics?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那些外表布满盔甲、摆出各种姿态，但内心却充满了柔软、脆弱的有机物的机器人东西是什么来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It doesn't matter. The point is, Arthur's like one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这不重要。重点是，亚瑟就像是那样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, come on. I’ll grow wings and a tail before THAT happens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，拜托。在那之前我早就长出翅膀和尾巴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Entrati has buggered off. If there was ever a hope of getting the old Eleanor back, the one who sang in the shower and smiled at kids in the street, that hope left with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 英择谛跑路了。如果曾经有一丝希望能让以前的埃莉诺回来，那个在淋浴时唱歌，在街上对孩子们微笑的人，那希望也随他而去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If he lets you in, for Sol's sake be gentle with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果他对你敞开心门，看在太阳神的份上，请对他温柔一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are you trying to get on my good side?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是在想博取我的好感吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: YOU WOULD THINK.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你以为会这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean, yes. She does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的意思是，是的，她确实应该照照镜子了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lettie adores Arthur. He’s the big brother she never had. If Arthur wasn’t around, I’d wake up to a chloroform rag over my mouth and end up at the bottom of the river.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 莱蒂非常崇拜亚瑟。他就像是她从未拥有过的大哥哥。如果没有亚瑟，我可能会在某天醒来时被氯仿抹布捂住嘴巴，然后被丢到河底。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I still haven't forgiven her for what she said about letting this city burn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我还没有原谅她说让这座城市付之一炬的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She thinks he’s delusional, holding on to the past. But she loves the guy and she’s a good soldier, so she’ll never go against him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她认为他对过去抱有幻想。但她爱这个人，而且她是一名好士兵，所以她永远不会反对他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Even Aoi was shocked. It makes you wonder who the real monsters are, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 连碧都惊呆了。这不禁让你怀疑谁才是真正的怪物，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s complicated. There’s more than one reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这很复杂，原因不止一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She's told me to her face that I'm not to go poking around in her head. If I didn't agree, she'd leave the Hex and take her chances on her own. Insane stuff.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她当面告诉我，我不可以去探查她的内心。如果我不同意，她就会离开六人组，自己去碰运气。真是疯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So part of it is just that she's scared I'm going to read her teenage diary, as it were. I'll peer at her most embarrassing secrets and laugh my arse off and she'll be humiliated forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以部分原因是她害怕我会读到她青少年时期的日记。就好像我会偷看她最尴尬的秘密，然后哈哈大笑，让她永远感到羞辱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The truth is, I’m just not that curious. Whatever sick little secret she’s hiding from me, it’s safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 事实是，我并没有那么好奇。无论她对我隐瞒了什么不堪的小秘密，都是安全的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you think I'd kiss and tell?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你以为我会亲吻然后说出去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s crossed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我也想过这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. No we didn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有。我们没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’d have been up for it, I think. Nothing wrong with a snog and a grope between friends, especially if Arthur had to give us an awkward speech at briefing about how we mustn’t let our feelings get in the way of doing our job.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想，我会愿意的。朋友之间的亲亲抱抱没什么大不了的，尤其是如果亚瑟在简报会上给我们讲了一段不能让感情影响工作尴尬的讲话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which is just as well, because can you imagine how awkward things would be between us now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这也好，因为你能想象现在我们之间会有多尴尬吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It blows off steam, it’s good for morale, and it’s cheap.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它可以缓解压力，提高士气，而且成本低。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean... I wouldn't have said no. It just never came up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的意思是……我不会说不。只是这事从没提过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But whatever Ms Garcia is hiding is something people could use to hurt her. So I'm a threat, because I might see it in her head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但是加西亚小姐隐藏的东西是别人可能用来伤害她的东西。所以我是一个威胁，因为我可能在她脑海里看到这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So if you're attracted to her, then go for it! I'll cheer from the sidelines! Lua knows Lettie could use some happiness in her bleak, loveless life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以如果你喜欢她，那就去追求吧！我会在一旁为你加油！月神知道莱蒂需要一些幸福来弥补她那黯淡、缺爱的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why? You got designs on my brother? Or on Aoi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么？你对我弟弟有意思？还是对碧有意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh! Oh! DO tell...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢！噢！快说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Interesting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: HAHAHA
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I KNEW IT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我就知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't blame you one bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一点也不怪你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't have the heart to tell you what you're letting yourself in for. You can walk that road all by yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不忍心告诉你，你将面对什么。你可以自己走那条路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just so we're clear: baiting Arthur is MY prerogative. And if you're ever cruel to him on purpose, I will murder you. One more thing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只是需要明确一点：激怒亚瑟是我的特权。如果你故意伤害他，我会杀了你。另外一件事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know she seems too pure to be real, but believe me, she's a soldier like the rest of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道她看起来纯洁得不像是真的，但是相信我，她和我们其他人一样，也是一名士兵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Get to know the REAL Aoi, not whatever image you have in your head of her, and you'll be okay. Also...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 去了解真正的碧，而不是你心目中的那个形象，这样你就会觉得好些。另外……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur and Aoi’s relationship was one of the first casualties of this conflict. Neither one of them is over it. It’s a bit of an open wound, so be careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟和碧的关系是这场冲突的首批受害者之一。他们俩都还没有走出来。这还是个敏感的话题，所以要小心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why are you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你为什么问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hmm. I don't agree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。我不赞同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Aoi's my friend. And however much of a prat Arthur may be, he's still my brother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 碧是我的朋友。不管亚瑟有多傻，他仍然是我的弟弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not sure I should be confiding anything in you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不确定我是否应该向你透露任何事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. I don't know what THEY would tell you, but from where I'm sitting, they were just pulling in different directions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。我不知道他们会告诉你什么，但从我的角度看，他们只是朝着不同的方向前进。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They’re both romantics, just different kinds. Arthur wants the cottage with the roses around the door. He claims he doesn’t, but he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们都是浪漫主义者，只是类型不同。亚瑟渴望拥有一间门边种着玫瑰的小屋。他嘴上说不想要，但实际上他是想要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods, he even used to talk about taking over a pub sometime. I can just see him with his little crowd of regulars, pulling pints, making Sunday roasts, full of hard-won wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天，他甚至曾经说过有朝一日要接手一家酒吧。我可以想象他和他的一群常客在一起，喝着啤酒，做着周日烤肉，分享着那些来之不易的智慧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can you see Aoi finding a place in a dream like that? I can’t. She needs to spread her wings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你觉得碧能适应这样的生活吗？我觉得不能。她需要更广阔的天空去飞翔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, you're not alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，你不是唯一一个这么想的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But you don't go up to grieving people and say 'I told you so'. You rally round. I did my best to comfort Arthur, and Lettie tried to patch up Aoi's broken heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但你不能对正在悲伤的人说"我早就告诉过你了"。你需要给予支持。我尽我所能安慰亚瑟，莱蒂则试图抚平碧破碎的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tread lightly. That's all I'm saying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 小心行事。这就是我要说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry, that's probably not the response you were hoping for, is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，这可能不是你希望得到的答复，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We'll see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们再看看吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Rugged, dashing Arthur? Pure, kindhearted Aoi? Neither one of them floats your boat?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 粗犷英俊的亚瑟？纯洁善良的碧？他们两个都不合你的心意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am intrigued.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We shall talk of this another time, she said, wrapping her crimson cape around her face and stalking away...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们改天再聊，她一边说，一边把她的深红斗篷裹在脸上，然后悄然走开……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The Kingdom you used to rule over. Duviri. You didn't invent it, did you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你曾经统治过的那个王国。双衍王境。不是你创造的它，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: However did you achieve that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oops. My mistake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哎呀。我的错。
