/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Angels? In this time, angels are thought of as benevolent creatures. Terrifying, sometimes, but on the side of good. Unless you mean the fallen ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天使？在这个时代，天使被认为是仁慈的生物。虽然有时候会令人害怕，但他们属于正义的一方。除非你指的是堕落天使。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That was thoughtless of me, wasn't it? The place wasn't exactly a holiday camp for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是我考虑不周了，对吗？这个地方对你来说根本就不是一个度假营。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sincerely sorry. I'll keep my curiosity under control from now on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真的很抱歉。以后我会控制住自己的好奇心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I see. I can't imagine something called a ‘Void Angel' swooping down and blessing a newborn babe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白了。我无法想象一个叫做"虚空天使"的东西会飞下给新生儿祝福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The future, as you describe it, sounds bloody horrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 照你这么描述，未来听起来非常可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can’t blame you for wanting to hide away from these Void Angels. Especially if they were…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 难怪你想躲避这些虚空天使。尤其是如果它们是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh. I just got a feeling. They weren't your parents, were they?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦。我突然有种感觉。它们不会是你的父母吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm so sorry. I'm glad you found safe harbour, even if it didn't stay that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很遗憾听到这些。我很高兴你找到了一个安全的地方，尽管它并不是一直安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But how on earth did you do it? You were only a child. What gave you the power to conjure an entire kingdom out of nothing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但你究竟是怎么做到的？你当时还是个孩子。是什么赋予你从无到有创造整个王国的力量？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When I was five, I wanted to be a witch. I yelled Abracadabra and jumped from the top of the stairs. I didn't know I couldn't fly. But I quickly found out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在我五岁的时候，我想成为一名女巫。我大喊"阿布拉卡达布拉"，然后从楼梯顶上跳了下去。我当时不知道自己不能飞。但我很快就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The power to create Duviri must have come from somewhere other than you. You used it to do something incredible, but it wasn't yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 创造双衍王境的力量一定来自你之外的某个地方。你用它做了一些不可思议的事情，但它不是你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not at first, anyway. It's in you now, though. The wild energy. The loops in time. Gods, you're a wonder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 至少一开始不是。不过现在它已经在你体内了。狂野的能量。时间的循环。天啊，你真是个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I SEE. So if you looked into the Void with… hmm, let's say ‘hunger'… you might create a prowling half-starved wolf. Or a royal banquet, maybe. Or a loaf of bread with wolf's teeth gnashing in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白了。所以如果你带着……嗯，比如说‘饥饿'的情绪……去注视虚空，你可能会创造出一只四处觅食的饿狼。或者是一场皇家盛宴。甚至是一块一直被狼牙撕咬的面包。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What a terrifying, exhilarating thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是一个多么可怕又令人兴奋的想法啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Whyever did the Orokin think it was a good idea to launch a ship full of children into the Void? Wasn't that an emotional time bomb waiting to go off?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 奥罗金人为什么会认为把一艘满载儿童的飞船发射到虚空是个好主意呢？这难道不是一颗随时会爆炸的情感定时炸弹吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ugh. Sorry, but you’ve ruined it for me now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃。抱歉，但你这么一说就让我觉得它没意思了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why can’t stories just be stories? I HATED it when I found out that Rudolfo the Leopard King who died heroically in battle with the Zodiac Serpent was meant to be Sol with his sun-spots, suffering on the star-tree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么故事就不能仅仅是故事呢？当我发现在与十二宫蛇的战斗中英勇牺牲的豹王鲁道夫，实际上是隐喻有太阳黑子的太阳神在星树上的苦难时，我真的很反感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Smuggling religion into kids’ books is like hiding medicine inside sweeties. JUST TELL THEM.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 把宗教内容偷偷塞进儿童书里，就像把药藏在糖果里一样。还不如直接告诉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can die a happy woman knowing that those books get forgotten about. Hurrah for the future!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 知道那些书会被人遗忘，我可以安心去死了。为未来欢呼！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ugh. Please, no. It's not a real legend, it's a terrible series of children's books.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 呃。拜托，别。这不是一个真正的传说，这只是一系列糟糕的儿童书。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You do have stories, though, don’t you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过你还有故事，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could tell you some of our real legends, though, if you like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你想的话，我可以给你讲一些我们的真实传说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, that’s boggled my noggin. You’re from the far future, but you’ve also been out of the loop in Duviri for so many years that events that happened in your lifetime have had time to become myths?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这真让我百思不得其解。你来自遥远的未来，但你待在双衍王境的时间长到，你人生中的事件已经被当作神话流传了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m getting vertigo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有点头晕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're a storybook character yourself, aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你本身就是个故事集中的角色，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Blimey. We’ll be here all year if I start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪。如果我开始说我们得在这里待一整年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let's see. There's Arthur, of course. Good old Arthur. The original. Britannia's finest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 让我们来看看。当然要有亚瑟了。善良的老亚瑟王。最开始的那个。不列颠尼克最伟大的那个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Trapped in a magical kingdom where time flows differently, summoned to the place where you were most needed...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 被困在一个时间流速不同的魔法王国，被召唤到最需要你的地方……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then there’s Young Loxley. I loved her. Wanted to be her. She was the model for a certain kind of young woman.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还有小罗宾女。我爱她。想成为她。她是年轻女性的一种典范。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: All we need to round your story off is a love interest, or a slavering, inhuman monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你的故事只差一个恋人，或者一个流着口水的非人怪物了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (Or a slavering, inhuman love interest, depending on how your tastes run.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （或者根据你的口味，一个流着口水的非人恋人。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay. Potted version: she was the daughter of a nobleman back in ye olde days, when the land was suffering under a cruel King.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。简短版本：她是远古时代一位贵族的女儿，当时这片土地在一位残酷国王的统治下民不聊生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Her brother had been killed off fighting in foreign climes, but word hadn't reached home yet, so when the poor oppressed people needed a hero she rose to the occasion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她的哥哥在异国他乡的战争中牺牲了，但死讯却没有传回国内，因此，当那些可怜的、受压迫的人民需要一位英雄时，她挺身而出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And that's fine, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这也没关系，真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Monstrosity is in the eye of the beholder, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的朋友，怪物的定义因人而异。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you are sincerely drawn to the qualities you think 'monstrous' in another, then you had better make sure they share your choice of labels and revel in it. Otherwise, you commit the grossest fetishization.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你真的被别人身上你认为的"可怕"品质所吸引，那么你最好确保对方也认同这个标签并且享受它。否则，你就是在极度地物化他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Would I call myself a monster, for example? Yes. Enthusiastically. I take the title others would condemn me by, and I rejoice in it. In case you were wondering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 比如我，我会自称为怪物吗？会。而且欣然接受。我将别人用来谴责我的称号视为荣誉。以防你好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Monsters are used to being alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 怪物习惯了孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We're survivors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都是生存者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Now, normally I can't stand hero figures. They're toxic. Infectious, and for that reason, dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在说一下，我通常是无法忍受英雄的形象。它们有毒。具有传染力，因此很危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Young Loxley's different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 小罗宾女不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She gets a pass. Shut up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她除外。闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As I was saying. She looked a lot like her brother, so she dressed up in his old clothes and pretended to be him, and went off to lead a revolution. If anyone got too close they might notice she was a girl, so she took to wearing a hood. It became her trademark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 正如我所说。她长得很像她哥哥，所以她穿上哥哥的旧衣服，假扮他，然后去领导了一场革命。如果有人离她太近，他们可能会注意到她是个女孩，所以她开始戴兜帽。而这也成了她的标志。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She was shit-hot with a bow and arrow. She and her crew became this beloved band of outlaws, robbing from the King’s tax collectors and giving the money to whoever needed it most.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她非常擅长使用弓箭。她和她的同伴成为了一群受人爱戴的不法之徒，他们抢劫国王的税务官，并将钱财送给最有需要的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That’s history for you. Back then, men supposedly did all the fighting, so they did the ruling too. People expected to take orders from men. She needed to draw on her brother’s reputation to do what she had to do. It was that or go under.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是历史。那时候，男人得负责所有的战斗，所以他们也负责统治。人们希望听从男人的命令。她需要借由她哥哥的名号来做她该做的事情。要么这样做，要么就等死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So am I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It depends which version of the story you read. She either got called straight to the Hall of Heroes, or married the King's wayward daughter, or got trapped in an oak tree where she sleeps to this day waiting for Britannia's hour of need.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这取决于你读的是哪个版本的故事。她要么直接被召唤到英雄堂，要么"娶了"国王的任性女儿，要么被困在一棵橡树里，直到今天她还在那里长眠，等待不列颠尼克最需要帮助的时刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not if that Ballas character is anything to go by, you didn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果以 Ballas 这个角色作为参考，那你们就没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods, I'd love to see your era with my own eyes. Maybe you could smuggle me back one of those icebox coffin things and I can just sleeeeeep for a few millennia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 神啊，我很想亲眼见证你们的时代。也许你可以偷偷给我带一个冰柜棺材，这样我就可以睡上几千年了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hence the saying back home. If things are going badly, like they were during the war, it's tradition to shrug and say ‘Well, it can't be THAT bad. Young Loxley's not turned up yet.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因此，家乡就会有这样的说法。如果情况变糟，就像战争期间那样，人们通常会耸耸肩，说"嗯，还不算太糟。小罗宾女还没出现呢。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How much bloody longer do we need? FFS.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们还要等多久？真是服了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, I've always loved them. When I was little, my dad took us to the Innovation Museum in Ludston and Arthur and I both got these crystal growing kits. Arthur's turned out shit, literally like a lumpy little rock turd. It went in the bin. Mine was a beautiful blue diamond. Ever since that day I've felt like crystals were on my side, somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，我一直都很喜欢它们。小时候，我爸爸带我们去过拉德斯顿的创新博物馆，我和亚瑟都买了这些水晶种植套装。亚瑟种出来一坨屎，真的是长得跟屎一样的小石头。后来它被扔进了垃圾箱。我的是一颗美丽的蓝色钻石。从那天起，不知道为什么，我一直觉得水晶是属于我这边的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Okay, I'm feeling generous today, so I'll give you this one for free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好，我今天感觉很大方，所以我免费告诉你这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We have never. We have not even slightly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们从来没有。连一点苗头都没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I cannot help thinking that Quincy's preferred position would be 'partner on top holding a mirror, so he can imagine he's having sex with himself'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我忍不住想到，昆西最喜欢的姿势可能是"伴侣在上面拿着一面镜子，这样他就能幻想自己正在和自己做爱"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No thank you. I'm content to admire from afar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不谢谢。我只需要在远处欣赏就够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊。不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know there’s a lot of nonsense written about crystals. Not my thing. I don’t believe they purify my aura or light up my chakras.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道有很多关于水晶的文章都是废话。我对那种说法不感兴趣。我不相信水晶能净化我的气场或点亮我的脉轮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But they do have a presence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但它们确实存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. I’m aware I sound like a complete headcase.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。我知道我听起来像个十足的疯子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh you are MADDENING sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢，有时候你真是让人抓狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, now I feel stupid for feeling stupid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，现在我因为觉得自己愚蠢真的感到蠢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Amazed and intrigued!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 太神奇了，我很好奇！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I would have thought that you, of all people, could lift your perspective above the purely material.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我原本以为，在所有人中，你能够将自己的视角提升到高于纯粹物质的水平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Away with you. Leave me to my fancy rocks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 去你的吧。让我和自己心爱的石头待在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I expect you have crystals I could only dream about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想你一定有些我梦寐以求的水晶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tell me, wise traveller, of the crystals of your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 请告诉我，智慧的旅行者，你们时代的水晶有什么特别之处？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You say ‘you only find it in the Void' like people are popping in and out of the Void all the time. I thought it was this crazy-making dimension, not a seaside resort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你说"只有在虚空中才能找到它"，好像人们总是能随意进出虚空似的。我还以为这是一个让人疯狂的维度，而不是海滨度假胜地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's her name? I think I glimpsed her in your mind!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是她的名字？我想我在你的脑海中瞥见过她！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How beautiful and sad. What must it be like, to become a monument to your love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 多么美丽又悲伤。成为爱情纪念的感觉如何呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The pretty geode lady. I suppose she and I are related now. There's a comforting thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那位漂亮的晶岩女士。我想我和她现在算是有点亲戚关系了。这是个令人欣慰的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I hope nobody chips little bits off them as a keepsake. That would definitely happen in my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我希望没人会从它们晶体上弄下碎片来当作纪念品。在我们的时代，这肯定会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Now that's familiar. There are these top-security bunkers under Ludston and Mancunia. The idea is, if there's ever a Radiation War, the fat cats and bigwigs get to hide down in their luxury bolthole and sip Mimosas while the rest of us get burned to a cinder up above.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这听起来很熟悉。在拉德斯顿和曼彻尼亚地下有这些高度戒备的掩体。理论上，如果真的爆发了辐射战争，那些富人和权贵就可以躲进他们豪华避难所，边喝着含羞草鸡尾酒，边看着我们这些普通人在地上被烧成灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Same old story, she said with a sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 历来如此，她叹了口气说道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's funny. Everyone was so scared of a Radiation War when I was growing up. I remember the public service broadcasts that used to go out. Sombre advice about how to stockpile supplies, how to prepare a refuge room, and how you really have to bury any dead relatives even if you don't want to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这很有意思。我小时候，大家都非常害怕辐射战争。我还记得那些公共服务广播。严肃地建议如何囤积物资、如何准备避难室，以及如何埋葬死去的亲人，即使你不想这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When I saw the reactor exploding in your mind, it took me right back to all those nightmares. I knew we had to stop it, whatever it took. I’d make the others believe you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当我在你的脑海中看到那个反应堆爆炸的场景时，我仿佛又回到了那些噩梦中。我知道我们必须不惜一切代价阻止它。我会让其他人相信你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s not a Radiation War that’s waiting for this planet, though, is it? It’s the Techrot. One way or another, this loop’s going to work itself out and when it does, the rest of the world’s going to get infected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过，等待这个星球的并不是辐射战争，对吧？而是科腐者。不管怎样，这个循环终将会结束，到那时，世界其他地方也会受到感染。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wanted to ask you something, but I’m not sure how you’ll take it, so if I’m out of order please say so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有个问题想问你，但不确定你会怎么反应，所以如果我问得不妥，请直说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What were your parents like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你的父母是什么样的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sorry. I stupidly assumed that because your memories of the Zariman were so vivid, you'd be able to recall your parents, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起。我愚蠢地以为，既然你对扎里曼的记忆这么清晰，你也能记得你的父母。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I forget how many lifetimes you've lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我忘了你已经历了许多世。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad. If you don't mind me saying so, it shows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴。如果你不介意的话我这么说，这从你身上可以看出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There's a warm flame of kindness in you, and I was wondering who had helped to kindle it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你心中有着善良的温暖火焰，我想知道是谁帮助点燃了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I didn't think you'd had a soft upbringing. I suppose colonists need to be tough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不认为你的成长环境是温柔的。我猜殖民者需要坚强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: With those Orokin in charge, it's a wonder anyone turned out decent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在那些奥罗金人的统治下，有人能成长得这么好真是不可思议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh dear. Well, for what it's worth, you made a bloody decent human being of yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦天哪。好吧，不管怎么说，你自己变成了一个相当不错的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I only wish you could have had an easier time of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只希望你当初能过得轻松一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No, I'm sorry. I had no right to ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不，我很抱歉。我没有权利去问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was thinking about mine. I do it a lot, actually. I sit on my arse and wonder what Mum and Dad would think about how their kids ended up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在想我的父母。其实我经常这么做。我就坐在那里，想象爸爸妈妈会怎么看待他们孩子现在的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As people they were radically mismatched, which means they had the kind of relationship that burns hot and bright for the first few years and then collapses into a sucking black hole after that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 从性格上看，他们完全不是一类人，这意味着他们的关系在最初几年里会热烈而明亮，但之后就会崩塌成一个吞噬一切黑洞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Incompatible, in a word. Dad wanted us to be independent, so he'd engineer situations where we had to be. Dropping us off in the woods with just a penknife, that sort of thing. Mum was always coming to the rescue. It was doomed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一个词，不合拍。爸爸希望我们独立，所以他会设计一些情况让我们不得不独立。比如把我们扔进树林里，只给一把小刀之类的。妈妈总是赶来救我们。这注定是无法维持的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Dad is ex-army. Jovial, little wrinkly eyes, speaks like a newsreader, so broken on the inside that if you picked him up and shook him he'd rattle like a bag of gravel. He's surprisingly easy to upset. I've tossed off comments that I thought were mild, then overheard him crying in the loo later on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 爸爸是退伍军人。他性格开朗，眼睛有点皱纹，说话像播音员，内心很破碎，破碎得就像摇晃时会响的沙砾袋。他其实特别容易难过。我曾经随口说了些我以为很无伤大雅的话，后来却听到他在厕所里哭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur and I quickly learned to play them off against one another. You know how kids are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟和我很快就学会了怎么让他们互相掐架。你知道孩子都爱这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mum’s lot were richer, which meant she had a long leash. She didn’t go down the party path, wine and drugs and weeklong binges in Ludston flats. That was more Aunt Janice’s gig. Mum is more flowers, pottery hedgehogs, pot-pourri and everything being Nice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 妈妈那边家境富裕，这意味着她的生活比较自由。她没沉迷于派对，不会酗酒、吸毒，也不会在拉德斯顿公寓里连续狂欢一整周。那些更像是贾妮丝姨妈的风格。妈妈更喜欢鲜花、陶艺刺猬、香薰和一切温馨美好的事物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Parents always overcompensate for whatever they feel their own parents did wrong, don't they?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 父母总想过度弥补他们觉得自己父母做错的事情，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, they're divorced now. They waited until we were out of our teens to do it, out of ‘consideration'. That was kind, don't you think? Forcing us to live in a bloody battleground of a house because Kids Need Stability or some such garbage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，他们现在离婚了。等我们都成年后才离的，说是出于"考虑"。多体贴啊，你不觉得吗？就因为"孩子们需要稳定"之类的屁话，让我们在一个他妈的战场般的家里生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Once in a while. We used to go back home for Solstice. Now that I do miss. Decorating the star-tree, crowning Sol, little kids going door to door dressed as Lua’s Three Aspects, roasting the bird… it’s sentimental, but I genuinely love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 偶尔吧。我们以前总是在冬至回家。现在我真的很怀念那时候。装饰星星树，为太阳神加冕，小孩子们打扮成月神的三种形象挨家挨户拜访，烤鸟肉……这听起来很伤感，但我真的很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mum and Dad always had a peace treaty for Solstice and they always respected it. On a good year they managed to keep from ripping into each other until after Third Day, even with the plum brandy flowing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 冬至的时候，爸妈总会停战，而且他们总是遵守协议。在好的年头，他们甚至能在节后的第三天才开始吵架，即使一直喝着李子白兰地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you just felt a massive wave of homesickness wash over you, that was me. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你感觉到一阵思乡之情如潮水般涌来，那是因为我。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I try to keep the big emotions to myself but sometimes they just boil over like milk in a pot, and everyone cops it. Then it’s on to the old KIM for a round of apologies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我通常把强烈的情绪藏在心里，但有时它们就像锅里的牛奶一样沸腾起来，影响到每一个人。然后我就得在即时通上到处道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was just wondering what they’d make of you. If we ever get out of this place, I’d like to rock up to Solstice dinner with my time-traveling friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是在想他们会怎么看你。如果我们能离开这个地方，我想带上我的时空旅行朋友一起去吃冬至晚餐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think you'd like it. You and Dad and Arthur could sit by the fire and trade war stories, and Mum could gently prod you about whether you were single.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想你会喜欢的。你和爸爸还有亚瑟可以坐在炉火边，交换战斗的故事，妈妈可以温柔地问你是否单身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: HA! That just makes me want to do it more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哈！这更让我想去这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's so sweet of you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真贴心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods, let's do it. If we ever get the chance, we'll make it real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦天哪，我们就这么办吧。如果有机会，我们一定要让它成真。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Um.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can just see Dad politely asking "so was it always death by impalement, or did they try to vary it up a bit?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我能想象到爸爸礼貌地问道："所以说，一直都是被刺死的吗，还是他们试过其他方式？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I should let go of this dream before I try to make it happen. We are here, this is now, and there's still a war on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我应该在尝试实现这个梦想之前放手。我们现在在这里，这就是现在，而且战争仍在继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This took a turn, she said, fanning herself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "这话题转得太快了，"她一边扇风一边说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm going to dream about this. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会梦到这个的。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you for a beautiful dream.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你给我一个美好的梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've got one more thing to get out of bed in the morning for, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在，我有了一个新的起床动力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Would you WANT to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你想要这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You are an absolutely exasperating person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真是一个令人头疼的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m trying to have a perfectly innocent conversation about parents, with no ulterior motive, and now you’ve gone and knocked me sideways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我本来想跟你纯粹地聊聊父母的事情，没有别的意思，现在你却让我措手不及。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: By all means.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm going to have to give this the serious consideration it deserves. FFS.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我得认真考虑一下这件事。真是无语。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: My mistake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是我的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We have time, and none of us is going anywhere, are we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们有的是时间，而且谁也没打算离开，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. The one you said was going to be a waste of time, and that you were only playing out of pity for him, that's the one, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。你说过那游戏会浪费时间，你只是出于对他的同情才去玩的，就是那个游戏，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He's a charming little imp. Why are you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他是个迷人的小恶魔。你问这个干什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As much as the next person, I suppose. Why are you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我和大多数人一样吧。你问这个干什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which one of us is no longer "too cool" for the game, exactly? You or I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 究竟是我们中的哪一个不再"太酷"去玩那个游戏了？是你还是我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. I see. You are the chosen messenger, sent from the Thunderbolt King to enlist fair Eleanor. No doubt all sorts of roguery await me. Fol de rol and so forth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊，我明白了。你是被雷霆之王选中的信使，来招募美丽的埃莉诺。毫无疑问，肯定有各种恶作剧在等着我。无聊的事之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We've all been there at one point in our lives... trying to wear a mask to impress someone and falling flat on our face because we can't see where we're going. And you and I had barely met when you asked. All right. You're forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们一生中都会经历过这样的时刻……试图戴上面具来给某人留下深刻印象，却因为看不清路而摔倒。而你问我的时候，我们才刚刚认识。好吧。我原谅你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I will do you a favour and NOT convey those words along to him. Word to the wise: treat him with more respect in the future in my presence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会帮你个忙，不把这话告诉他。给你一个忠告：以后在我面前对他多些尊重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, putting on a daft voice and play-acting for a few hours sounds ideal. Count me in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 其实花几个小时扮演角色，用傻乎乎的声音说话听起来挺不错的。算我一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh! I would like to be a wizard. Or perhaps a bard. Or perhaps both? Can you BE both?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦！我想做一名巫师。或者是一名吟游诗人。或者两个都可以？可以同时扮演两个角色吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or I could be a swamp hag! So long as I get to wear a tight bodice, mind. Mother Mossytits will eat your bones, little manikin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或者我也可以做个沼泽巫婆！只要我能穿紧身胸衣就好，记住。苔胸娘会吃掉你的骨头，小玩偶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hello, dearheart. I’m feeling a bit on the melancholic side. Do you have a moment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你好，亲爱的。我现在感觉有点忧郁。你有时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hello. I’m feeling a bit on the melancholic side. Do you have a moment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你好。我现在感觉有点忧郁。你有时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you, sincerely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真心地感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you know who the Hooded Woman is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你知道戴帽子的女人是谁吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hah. Speaking to our dear Lettie, I see. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哈哈。看来你和我们亲爱的莱蒂谈过了。是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not quite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不算是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She’s Death. Also one of the Aspects of Lua, depending on which tradition you follow. She’s the one who comes and tucks you into bed once the knockabout day of Life is over, kisses you goodnight, and sings you to sleep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她就是死神。也是月神的其中一个形象，这取决于你遵循哪个传统。她是那个在你结束忙碌生命的这一天，过来帮你盖被子，亲吻你说晚安，唱歌哄你入睡的那个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mate. Everything Entrati gave us, the power, the strength, the armour plated arses… I'd trade it all for one crumb of reassurance that death isn't the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 伙计。英择谛给予我们的一切，力量，强度，铠甲……我愿意用这一切来换取一点安慰，那就是死亡不是终点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... it was going to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……原本是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Forget it. I'm sure you have more important things to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 算了。我相信你还有更重要的事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve tried. I don’t feel good about admitting this, but sometimes when we’ve been out on patrol and there’s been fighting, I look into the minds of the dying and try to go through the process with them. If there’s any light at all at the end of the tunnel, I just want to see it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我试过了。我不喜欢承认这一点，但有时当我们在巡逻时遇到战斗，我会尝试进入垂死之人的脑海，并与他们一起经历那个过程。如果隧道尽头真有一丝光亮，我只想看到它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know. I KNOW.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道。我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I tell myself I was trying to help but the truth is I just wanted to see. You're right. It was ghoulish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我告诉自己我只是想帮忙，但事实是我只是想看看。你说得对。那真是太可怕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I did, once. What’s the harm, right? They’re dying anyway. It was this young Scaldra trooper. She was coming for me and I shot her in the chest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我尝试过一次。这有什么坏处呢？反正他们都要死了。那是一个年轻的炽蛇军士兵。她向我冲过来，我朝她的胸口开了一枪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I knelt down by her side as she gargled out her lifeblood and tried to tell her it was okay, the pain was coming to an end, soon she'd be with her family who had gone before, all the placid, pacifying stuff you think of when there's a deathbed service to be held.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她在咯咯地吐着血，我跪在她身边，试着告诉她没关系，痛苦即将结束，很快她就会和先去的家人团聚了，所有那些临终关怀时会说的安抚话语，能说的我都说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She was terrified. What was left of her conscious self was scrabbling around like a rat in a water tank. When she felt me in her mind with her, she tried to cling on. She begged me to help. Underneath it all was this… I don’t even know what you’d call it…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她非常害怕。她仅存的意识就像是水箱里四处挣扎的老鼠。当她感觉到我在她脑海中时，她试图依附我。她求我帮忙。在这一切下面是……我甚至不知道你会怎么称呼它……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Denial. She didn’t believe she could be dying. And why would she? She’d always been there before. How could death be taking her away now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 否认。她不相信自己会死。她为什么会相信呢？她之前一直都在。死亡怎么会现在把她带走？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Every day of your life, you take YOURSELF for granted. You’re there when you wake up and you’re there when you sleep. You live out your entire life in a house made of You. You never once go outside, because you can’t.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在生命中的每一天，你都把自己视为理所当然。你醒来时在这里，睡觉时也在这里。你的一生都在由你自己构建的房子里。你从未出去过，因为你不能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then one day, you hear the house being knocked down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后有一天，你听到自己的房子正在被拆除。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What would you have had me do? Call Lettie over? Heal the gaping chest wound? All because I saw what this one was going through, up close?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你希望我做什么？叫莱蒂过来？治愈她胸口上的伤口？只因为我近距离看到了这个人的经历？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. I was scared shitless. As she felt herself slipping over the edge, I was sure I’d be dragged down with her. I could feel this undertow tugging at me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有。我吓坏了。当她感觉自己即将走到尽头，我确信我也会被她拖下去。我能感受到那种下沉的力量在拉扯我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: With the Scaldra it's kill or be killed. They don't offer us the luxury of mercy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对于炽蛇军来说，要么杀，要么被杀。他们不会对我们仁慈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I had to stay, though. I couldn’t abandon her to die alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我必须留下来。我不能抛下她独自一人死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Though I guess she did, in the end. I couldn’t take that last step with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虽然我猜她最后还是独自一人死去。但我没能和她一起迈出最后一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I learned nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我什么也没学到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She did, though. She saw her mother’s face, the kids she went to school with, her cat, some cousin who drowned. But they weren’t presences, or spirits. Just memories, forced to the surface by a dying brain desperately hunting for something to cling to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但她看到了。她看到了她母亲的脸庞、和她一起上学的孩子们、她的猫、还有一个溺水身亡的表亲。但这些都不是真实的存在或灵魂。只是一些因为垂死的大脑拼命寻找可以依附的东西，而被迫浮现的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then the house of her identity began to come apart around her. Right before she died, she opened her eyes wide. I think in that second, for the first time in her life, she truly understood what death actually is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后，她身份的房子开始在她周围瓦解。就在她临死前，她睁大了双眼。我想，在那一刻，她有生以来第一次真正理解了死亡到底是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Look. Next time you feel the need to call me out on my bullshit, don't feel you have to sit through it first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 看着。下次如果你想批评我的废话，不用觉得非得先听我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. We think we know what it is, but all of our experiences are from the outside.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。我们以为我们知道它是什么，但我们所有的经历都是从外部来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nobody's forcing you to talk to me. Bye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没人强迫你和我说话。再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Her whole life she was like a woman living in a house with no lights, and all she had was a flashlight. She’d shine the light of her awareness on one spot or another. A memory, a task, an interaction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她的一生就像住在一间没有灯光的房子里的女人，她只有一把手电筒。她会用她意识的光照亮这里或那里。一段记忆、一项任务、一次互动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She’d move from room to room, explore the cellars in her sleep, but always it would be a closed, finite process. Do you follow me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她会在睡梦中从一个房间走到另一个房间，探索地下室，但这始终是一个封闭的、有限的过程。你明白我的意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then when the house was demolished and her persona fell to pieces around her, suddenly the flashlight wasn’t shining on a wall or a book or a couch. It was shining up into the infinite sky. Her awareness blazed into the endless without the obstacle of herself standing in the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后，当房子被拆毁，她的人格在她周围崩塌时，突然间，手电筒不再只照亮墙壁、书本或沙发了。它照向了无边无际的天空。她的意识在没有自我阻碍的情况下，闪耀在无尽的天空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've tried to tell myself that, many times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我试着多次对自己这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't believe it was nothing more than the brain shutting down. It felt like the soul breaking free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我无法相信那只是大脑停止运作的过程。那感觉更像是灵魂的释放。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know it doesn’t make any kind of sense. It feels so counterintuitive, the idea that we are a point of view first and a personality second. All I know is that’s how it felt to be with a human soul as it passed from life to death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道这听起来没有任何道理。认为我们首先是一个视角，其次才是一个人格，这种想法很违反直觉。我只知道，陪伴一个人的灵魂从生到死的过程，就是这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Look. Next time you feel the need to call me out on my bullshit, don't feel you have to sit through it first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 看着。下次如果你想批评我的废话，不用觉得非得先听我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nobody's forcing you to talk to me. Bye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没人强迫你和我说话。再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Comforted? I like the idea that something of us survives. I love thinking that death isn’t about being deleted from the universe, but having everything deleted that separates you from the universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 安慰？我喜欢我们身上的某种东西会存续下来的想法。我更倾向于认为死亡不是把你从宇宙中抹去，而是抹去一切将你与宇宙隔绝的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, this is why I wanted to talk to you about void ghosts and Cephalons and all of that stuff from your time. I need to know if we ever get the chance to communicate with people we’ve lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，这就是为什么我想和你谈论虚空幽灵和中枢，以及你们那个时代里所有这些东西的原因。我想知道我们是否有机会与失去的人交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Real communication, not some hologram crap. The kind that lets you know definitively what the person thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是真正的交流，而不是一些全息图垃圾。那种能让你确切了解到对方思想的交流方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I see. Maybe there are some doors we can never open. Maybe that's for the best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我明白了。也许有些门我们永远无法打开。也许这样更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: His name was Christopher. He was Arthur’s best friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他叫克里斯托弗。是亚瑟最好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We were engaged. I thought I was in love with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们订了婚。我以为我很爱他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m sorry. I can’t do this. I’ll talk to you another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉，我没法说下去。我下次再跟你说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. I’m calm and as ready as I’ll ever be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好了。我冷静下来了，并且已经做好了充分的心理准备。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can I talk to you about Christopher?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我能和你聊聊克里斯托弗吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's best friend. We were engaged. I thought I was in love with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟最好的朋友。我们订了婚。我以为我很爱他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because he’s someone I lost. Someone who was very dear to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为我失去了他，他是我非常亲近的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Since you and I are a lot closer now (in so many delightful ways) you should really know what who you're getting involved with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 既然你和我现在的关系更加亲近了（在很多令人愉快的方面），你真的应该了解一下你将要深入交往的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Please correct me if I’m wrong, but lately I’ve been feeling like you and I are more than just teammates.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我说错了，请纠正我，但最近我感觉你和我不仅仅是队友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've seen inside your head, but you've not seen inside mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我已经看过你的内心，但你还没看过我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So, please brace yourself and bear with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以，请做好准备，耐心听我说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You've made it pretty plain to me how you feel, which I appreciate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你已经很明确地向我表达了你的感受，我很感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We’re definitely friends. Maybe more than that. But we’re still pacing uncertainly around one another and waiting for the other one to make the first move.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们绝对是朋友。也许不止如此。但我们仍在彼此周围徘徊，等待对方先迈出第一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I like you, very much. I trust you. You've had plenty of opportunities to treat me like a freak, like Lettie does, and you haven't done it. Don't think I haven't noticed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我非常喜欢你。我信任你。你有很多机会像莱蒂那样把我当成怪物，但你没有这样做。别以为我没注意到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I want to tell you about Christopher because I think you deserve to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想告诉你关于克里斯托弗的事，因为我觉得你有权知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There's a time to bail on a conversation with a friend. This was not it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 适时退出与朋友的谈话是对的。这次不是那种时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He was older than Arthur and me by a few years. I can't remember a time when he wasn't around. Our parents were friends, so he was always over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他比亚瑟和我大几岁。我记得他没有哪天是不在我身边的。我们的父母是朋友，所以他总是来我们家玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He used to play at soldiers with Arthur in the scabby patches of woodland down behind the estate. Christopher was the commander, Arthur the loyal lieutenant. If they ever let me play, I had to be the nurse. Obviously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他过去经常和亚瑟在庄园后面的树林里玩士兵游戏。克里斯托弗是指挥官，亚瑟是忠诚的中尉。如果他们让我加入，我得扮演护士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wish Dad had looked out at Arthur throwing himself on yet another pinecone grenade, dying valiantly to save his CO, and thought ‘hmmm, my boy's getting a bit too fond of this Army lark, maybe I should tell him getting shot up isn't as much fun as he thinks.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我希望爸爸看到亚瑟为了救他的指挥官而英勇地扑向松果手榴弹，会想"嗯，我儿子对这种军事游戏太痴迷了，或许我该告诉他，真枪实弹的战斗并不像他想象的那么有趣。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Our paths crossing was a rare blessing in my life, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，我们的相遇确实是我生命中难得的恩赐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: In some respects, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 从某些方面来说，是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Probably not. He'd just have seen it as Dad testing him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 大概不会。他只会认为这是爸爸在考验他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But I was trying to tell you about a bereavement here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我其实是在跟你说一件失去亲人的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But allow me to wish it had not come at such a cost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我宁愿这一切没有这么大的代价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Especially when I haven't yet told you how deep the wounds go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 尤其是当我还没告诉你这些伤痕有多深。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not really the time to look for silver linings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在真的不适合去找什么好的一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Anyway. Summer after summer rolled past. We grew to be adolescents. It was all very awkward and smelly and hormonal. There were parties and exams. Christopher went off to college. The dog died, we got a new one. Insert montage here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 总之，一个又一个的夏天过去了。我们渐渐长大成人。那时候既尴尬又多汗，充满荷尔蒙。有派对，也有考试。克里斯托弗去上大学了。家里养的狗死了，我们又养了一只新的。这些都可以做成个蒙太奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Suddenly one day I walked into the kitchen, I saw this stunning young man in uniform in front of me, and I thought ‘phwoar' for the second time in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 突然有一天，我走进厨房，看到了一个穿制服的青年，我心里暗自感慨，我人生中第二次心里直呼"哗嗷"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: 'Pwhoar'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "哗嗷"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's a traditional Britannic expression of admiration. It should be delivered in a sort of low growl, puffing the cheeks out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是不列颠尼克人表达惊叹的传统方式。应以低沉的咆哮声和鼓起双颊的方式发出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mandy Jellicoe. My crush. She dropped out of school, dyed her hair, got piercings, hung around town in a leather jacket smoking cigarettes and glowering at anyone who came too close. I looked at her and I could feel my bones melt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 曼迪·杰利科。我的暗恋对象。她辍学了，染了头发，打了耳洞，穿着皮夹克在城里到处闲逛，抽着烟，瞪着任何靠近的人。我一看到她，就感觉自己的骨头都酥了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Anyway. NOT RELEVANT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 总之。这不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yep. He was kind. Gorgeous. Strong. Easy to wind up, too, which was a big plus. Hell-bent on joining the army, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。他很善良。英俊。强壮。也很容易被激起斗志，这是一个很大的优点。不过他一心想加入军队。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We didn’t see eye to eye on that. To him it was a calling. He’d be out there helping people who needed it, making a difference in the world. He’d bought into the whole manly hero line, just like Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们在这点上意见不一。对他来说，这是一种使命。他会去帮助那些需要帮助的人，为世界带来改变。他和亚瑟一样，对那套男子汉英雄主义深信不疑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. I hate what it did to Christopher, what it's still doing to Arthur, what it does to so many like them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。我恨它影响了克里斯托弗，也恨它现在仍在影响亚瑟，恨它影响了许多像他们一样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have nothing against morals. Gods know I even have a few myself. But the whole hero narrative is pernicious bullshit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不反对道德观念。天知道我自己甚至也有一些。可那套所谓的英雄故事完全是害人的废话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You can fight for a better world without buying into the hero bullshit!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是可以为更美好的世界而战，并不需要相信那些英雄废话！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The whole point of the Hero Virus is that it's a virus. IT DOES NOT CARE ABOUT THE HOST. It convinces you that dying in a cause would be fitting and noble, instead of being a tragic bloody waste.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 英雄病毒的本质就是它是种病毒。它不关心宿主。它让你相信，为某个理想牺牲是体面且高尚的，而不是一种他妈的无谓牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘Why do you want to go and kill people in the name of a Prince who couldn't give a shit about you?' I'd say to him. He'd be hurt, because it wasn't supposed to be about His Majesty's Service. For him it was about taking out warlords who hoarded food and forced their political prisoners to work in the Rubedo mines until they died of exhaustion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我曾对他说："你为什么想为一个根本不在乎你的王子去杀人？"他会伤心，因为这并不是为了国王的命令。对他而言，这是为了消灭那些囤积食物、并强迫政治犯在红化结晶矿场劳作至死的军阀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was confident I’d be able to talk Christopher out of his military service. If not talk, then snog him out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我本以为我能说服克里斯托弗放弃当兵。如果说服不了，那就用亲吻让他放弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... not really the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……现在不是时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This isn't easy for me so please choose your moment a bit better
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对我来说并不容易，所以请你挑个更好的时机

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, and?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，那又怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was trying to save his life. I was willing to fight as dirty as it took.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当时只想救他的命。就算是不择手段我也在所不惜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do I need to spell it out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我需要明说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I got caught up in the very web I was trying to spin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我陷入了自己试图布下的网中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. By then, of course, it was too late. I’d gone into this thinking I’d bewitch him, but the truth is, he bewitched me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。当然，那时已经太迟了。我本以为我会迷住他，但事实是，他迷住了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m sorry. I’m not going to be able to get through this without crying, so if I’m slow in responding, at least you’ll know why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很抱歉。我无法在不哭的情况下说完这些，所以如果我回复得慢，至少你知道原因了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I told him I was pregnant. He offered to marry me. Stupid beautiful idiot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我告诉他我怀孕了。他提出要娶我。真是个又傻又帅气的白痴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. But I thought I was. I didn’t try to trick him, if that’s what you were asking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有。但我以为我怀了。如果你想问的是这个，我并没有故意要骗他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur was skipping on fluffy clouds, he was so happy. The guy he saw as a brother was going to be his brother-in-law.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟高兴得像在云端上跳舞。他视为兄弟的那个人即将成为他的姐夫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then everything goes into fast-forward. Something about a pre-emptive strike. Borders and containment, risk of escalation, moral bloody mandate. Christopher’s deployed, Arthur’s already signing up, all the boys are off to the Crimson Watch and my mum’s still trying to arrange the wedding seating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后一切都进入快进。什么先发制人的战略。边界和封锁、升级风险、还有该死的道德任务。克里斯托弗被派遣出去，亚瑟已经在报名，所有的男孩都去了赤色守望，而我妈妈仍在忙着安排婚礼座位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They killed him. The people we were supposedly there to help. They blew his vehicle apart with a bomb made from fertilizer and masonry nails.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们杀了他。那些我们本来去帮助的人。他们用化肥和石工钉制成的炸弹炸毁了他的车。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I tell myself ‘at least it was quick'. ‘At least he didn't suffer.' But for all I know, he died screaming with nails in his eyes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我告诉自己"至少他是瞬间死去的。""至少他没有受苦"但据我所知，他死的时候可能眼中插着钉子，一直尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Shit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 妈的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Shitting shit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真他妈的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I feel like you haven't paid attention to a SINGLE THING I've been saying to you here
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得你完全没有注意看我说的话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not interested in 'at least...' He died in a STUPID way for a STUPID reason
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不想听那些"至少……"。他是因为一个愚蠢的原因，以一种愚蠢的方式死的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I cried of course but all the time I was thinking ‘what did you expect, you STUPID girl, you KNEW what you were getting into, you KNEW this was going to happen'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当然哭了，但我一直在想"你期待什么呢，你这个愚蠢的女孩，你知道你会遇到什么，你知道这会发生"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Telling you about it like this, it just feels like corny folk song shit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这样告诉你，感觉就像是老套的民歌

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: My love he is gone off to war, sing fol de rol de dee, oh no he’s dead, I shall wander in the lonesome valleys and never wed another
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的爱人去参战了，唱着欢快的歌，哦不，他死了，我将在寂静的山谷中徘徊，再也不会嫁给别人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And if you aren't listening to me when I talk about this, what else aren't you hearing? As charming as this has all been between us I... no. This was a mistake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你在我谈论这些时都没有在看，那你还有什么没看到的？虽然我们之间的一切很美好……但不。这是一个错误。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And if you aren't listening to me when I talk about this, what else aren't you hearing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你在我谈论这些时都没有在看，那你还有什么没看到的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This whole bloody thing was a mistake. We're through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这整件事都是一个错误。我们结束了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. Get it together, Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对不起。埃莉诺，振作点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think he’d have liked you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想他会喜欢你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Got to go tidy myself up. Talk again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我得去整理一下了。待会儿再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sometimes I have to ask myself why you’re still here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有时候我不得不问自己，你为什么还留在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods. Sorry. I didn't mean it like that. I'm just having trouble seeing MYSELF as the reason you'd tolerate all... this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦天。对不起。我不是那个意思。我只是很难相信，是因为我，你才愿意忍受这……一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... are we talking about the same people here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我们是在说同一些人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I mean… we know what we're doing now. We're containing the spread. You've done what you were sent to do. You don't HAVE to stay. And yet…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的意思是……我们知道我们现在在做什么。我们正在控制病毒的传播。你已经完成了你被派去做的事情。你不必留下来。然而……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, don't get cryptic. I'll feel compelled to worm the information out of you somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，别说得那么含糊其辞。我会觉得有必要从你那里套出信息的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... wait, did you just leave?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……等等，你刚刚离开了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, now I’m wondering what I did to trick you. Or manipulate you. Maybe I put some kind of suggestion in your head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，现在我在想我做了什么让你上当。或者操纵了你。也许我在你脑海中种下了某种暗示。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I thank the Gods for the day you joined us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我感谢神让你加入我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, now I’m wondering what I did to trick you. Or manipulate you. Maybe I put some kind of suggestion in your head. Or maybe there’s a secondary Techrot virus in your system that’s attracted to what’s in mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，现在我在想我做了什么让你上当。或者操纵了你。也许我在你脑海中种下了某种暗示。或者是你的体内有次级科腐者病毒，被我体内的病毒吸引。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad you found what you were looking for. All rivers find their way to the sea, eventually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴你找到了你想要的东西。所有的河流最终会汇入大海。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or maybe there’s a secondary Techrot virus in your system that’s attracted to what’s in mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或者是你的体内有次级科腐者病毒，被我体内的病毒吸引。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Or maybe (deep breath) you actually like me the same way I like you. Could it really be that simple?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 或者是（深呼吸）你真的喜欢我，就像我喜欢你一样。就这么简单吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: As families go, this one's a mess. But I wouldn't change it for the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就家庭而言，这个家庭一团糟。但给我什么也不换。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'll make a deal with you. Go and see Lettie, ask her to run you through a quick psych-eval, get to the bottom of whatever's REALLY going on here, and we'll just forget this conversation ever happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们做个交易。你去找莱蒂，让她给你做个简单的心理评估，看看到底是怎么回事，然后我们就忘掉这次谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: See? That was easy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 看？很简单的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: OF COURSE I FEEL THE SAME WAY
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我当然也有同样的感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: YOU ARE THE BEST THING THAT EVER BLOODY HAPPENED IN MY ABSURD LIFE
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是我这荒诞人生里最他妈美好的存在

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: WHICH MEANS YOU’RE NOT GOING TO BE PART OF IT FOR LONG AND THE SOONER WE BOTH ADMIT THAT THE BETTER
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这意味着你不会在我的生命中待很久，我们越早承认这一点越好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: BECAUSE THAT’S HOW IT WORKS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为事情就是这样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. We’re not alone, are we? And we never have to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。我们并不孤单，不是吗？我们永远都不必孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. I can see you've made your mind up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。我看得出你已经下定决心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I could come up with a dozen different reasons why we shouldn't be together, and you'd have an answer for every one of them. Oh, what if I infect you? You're immune. What if I try to eat you? You're functionally immortal. What if I see inside your head? I'm sure you'd just kick me out again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以想出十几个我们不应该在一起的理由，而你对每个理由都有答案。哦，如果我感染了你怎么办？你对它免疫。如果我试图吃掉你怎么办？你实际上是不能死的。如果我看到你的内心怎么办？我敢肯定你会再次把我踢出去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You wonderful, impossible creature. You’ve only gone and won me over, you have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你这个奇妙的、不可思议的家伙。你真的已经赢得了我的心，你做到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, one last thing. I don’t know if you’ve noticed, but I have this embarrassing personal problem. We do need to address it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，最后一件事。我不知道你是否注意到了，但我有一个尴尬的个人问题。我们确实需要解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: "I love to watch you sleeeep..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "我喜欢看着你睡觉……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's more embarrassing for OTHER people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对别人来说更尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well I’m not talking about the size of my arse am I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧，我说的可不是我的屁股大小，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No. I'm referencing my tongue. The anaconda in the room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不。我指的是我的舌头。大家都心照不宣的隐患问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, the tongue. The anaconda in the room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错，是舌头。大家都心照不宣的隐患问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Tell me, honestly. How do you feel about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 坦白告诉我。你怎么看它？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So... I'm not the first tentacle-tongued woman you've flirted with? Actually, don't answer that. I'm scared to learn the answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以……我不是你撩过的第一个有触须舌头的女人吗？其实不用回答。我害怕知道答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh! I see! You imagined you were doing me a favour!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦！我懂了！你以为你是在帮我一个忙！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well. That’s that settled, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好了，那么这就解决了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I appreciate your honesty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我感激你的坦率。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm afraid the closest you will get to me now is if you set yourself on fire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 恐怕今后你离我最近的时候就是当你点火自焚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm scared. Excited. Nervous. Frankly, more than a little aroused. Might be getting ahead of myself there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很害怕。激动。紧张。坦白说，还有点小兴奋。可能我想得有点太远了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Shall we do this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们这就开始吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I wish you the best of luck finding a less 'gross' person to be intimate with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我祝你好运，希望你能找到一个不那么"恶心"的亲密爱人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: In which event, I might bring myself to piss on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在这种情况下，我可能会屈尊去对你撒尿灭火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Of course. Let's do that, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然。那就这么做吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods. I hadn’t even thought of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天。我甚至没想到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right now I’m too happy to care, but I suppose we ought to tell them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在我太高兴了，不想在乎这些，但我想我们应该告诉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hmm. I'm thinking seriously about pouncing you in Arthur's office and ‘accidentally' turning the tannoy on so that Lettie can hear every gasp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。我正认真考虑着在亚瑟的办公室里突然扑倒你，然后"无意中"打开扩音系统，这样就能让莱蒂听到每一个喘息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Better not, though. Life’s traumatic enough as it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还是算了吧。生活本身就已经够痛苦的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hold that thought, lover. Let’s see where imagination takes us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的爱，先记着这个想法。让我们看看想象力能带我们去哪里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's the loudspeaker thing. 'The Mall will be closing in five minutes, blah blah blah, shoplifting is punishable by summary execution.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就是那个大喇叭。"商场将在五分钟内关闭，等等等等，商店偷窃将被立即处决。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So help me, I do love how bewildered you are sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 救命，我真的很爱你时不时表现出的困惑样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Dear? If you're there, I could use your ear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亲爱的？如果你在，我现在很需要你的倾听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you’re there, I could use a friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你在，我现在很需要一个朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m having the Arthur dreams again. The ones where he has to kill me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我又做那些亚瑟的梦了。那些他不得不杀了我的梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I keep having this terrible dream about Arthur where he has to kill me. And as he shoves the blade between my ribs I'm screaming "Eleanor is RIGHT HERE, you stupid bastard!" but he can't hear me anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一直做着这个可怕的梦，梦到亚瑟要杀了我。当他把剑插入我的肋骨时，我尖叫着"埃莉诺就在这里，你这个蠢货！"他已经听不见我的声音了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's just it, though. ‘You're not my sister anymore.' That's what he says in the dream. Then he stabs me through the chest with his toy sword.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 问题就在这里。"你不再是我的姐姐了。"这是他在梦中说的话。然后他用他的玩具剑刺穿了我的胸膛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We’re only little kids in the dream, if it wasn’t already messed up enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在梦里我们还只是小孩子，如果这还不够混乱的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Not even to ‘put me out of my misery'? Not even if I was suffering?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 甚至不会"让我摆脱痛苦"吗？即使我在受苦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yeah. That's the worst part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。这是最糟糕的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's so vivid, so real. Like I'm remembering something that actually happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 太生动了，太真实了。就像我在回忆真实发生过的事情一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't. He's his father's son. He's all about doing the right thing, not the easy thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我做不到。他跟他爸爸一样。他只做正确的事情，而不是容易的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He's his father's son. He's all about doing the right thing, not the easy thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他跟他爸爸一样。他只做正确的事情，而不是容易的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm sure. The future is quite inventive in its cruelty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我确信。未来在其残酷性上非常有创意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 关系到一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But my concern here is with the past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我现在关心的是过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's one of the many, many things we don't talk about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是许多我们不曾谈论的事情之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm honestly trying my best to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我真的在尽力解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: My father set the example for the way Arthur and I deal with issues between us. Or rather, the way we don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我爸爸为亚瑟和我处理彼此之间问题的方式树立了榜样。或者更确切地说，为我们如何回避问题树立了榜样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We don’t talk about what happened in Cavona, we don’t talk about Christopher and we NEVER talk about Granny Callie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们没谈论过在卡沃纳发生的事情，没谈论过克里斯托弗，更没谈论过卡莉奶奶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe I shouldn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许我不应该谈论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe I should.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许我应该谈论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe it’s time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许是时候了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you want the whole story? Or shall I boil it down to essentials?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你想听整个故事吗？还是我只讲重点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Granny Callie was desperately sick. Demented. Our father suffocated her to death with a pillow rather than let her go on suffering. I hope that's curt enough for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 卡莉奶奶病得很重。精神错乱。我们的父亲用枕头把她闷死，不愿让她继续受苦。希望这对你来说够简洁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Granny Callie was our paternal grandmother. Callista Penrose Nightingale.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 卡莉奶奶是我们的祖母。卡莉斯塔·彭罗斯·南丁格尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: She had Pelham’s Syndrome. You’ve probably cured it by now (she said with an inward wrench). It chips away at a person’s mind. Instead of watching someone you love die all at once, they fade away slowly, by degrees, like an old photograph parching in the sunlight, or a video copied too many times over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她患有佩勒姆综合症。你们现在可能已经找到了治疗方法（她内心痛苦地说道）。这种病会侵蚀人的心智。与其说是一下子看着你爱的人死去，不如说是他们逐渐地，一点一点地消失，就像一张老照片在阳光下慢慢褪色，或是一段被复制过多的录像带。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When she first came to live with us, Arthur and I were so excited. To us, she was the lovely old woman who smelled of violets and told stories where she did all the different voices. She gave us actual folding money on our birthdays. We thought it would be like a birthday all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 她刚来和我们一起住时，亚瑟和我都很兴奋。对我们来说，她是一位可爱的老太太，身上散发着紫罗兰的香味，会用各种不同的声音讲故事。我们过生日时，她会给我们真钱折纸。我们以为生活会一直像过生日一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then she started to go downhill. At first she was just forgetful. Then she started confusing us with other people. She called me Albertine and Arthur, Charlie. Demanded to know where Jimmy had run off to. We never found out whether Jimmy was a dog or a cat or a boyfriend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 后来她的状况开始恶化。起初，她只是健忘。后来她开始把我们和其他人弄混。她把我叫成艾伯丁，把亚瑟叫成查理。还问起吉米跑到哪里去了。我们一直都不知道吉米是狗还是猫，还是她的男朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then she started talking to people who weren’t there. Then she started wandering the house after dark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 后来，她开始和不存在的人说话。然后，天黑后她会在房子里徘徊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I remember going for a wee in the middle of the night and seeing her lurching towards me down the corridor in the dark, groaning, her face all twisted up and her hair like a mad clown wig. I couldn't stop screaming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我记得半夜上厕所时，看到她在黑暗中沿着走廊踉踉跄跄地向我走来，呻吟着，脸部扭曲，头发像疯掉的小丑假发。我忍不住尖叫了起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When it got really bad, she would lie in bed and shriek. We’d go out to school in the morning and when I turned down our lane, my heart would sink because I could hear her from ten houses away, still screaming, eight hours later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当情况变得非常糟糕时，她会躺在床上尖叫。早上我们去上学，在回家路上当我拐进小巷时，我会感到心情沉重，因为过了整整八个小时后，我还能在十户人家开外听到她的尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Our dad used to talk about putting a pillow over her face. We thought he was joking, because of course he was, that's his mum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们的父亲曾经说过要用枕头捂住她的脸。我们以为他在开玩笑，一定是在开玩笑，因为那毕竟是他的妈妈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: One night she was screaming, and the screams just stopped. I got up and went to Arthur’s room. He was awake, of course. We sat together listening and listening, and then we heard the door to her room close.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有一晚她又在尖叫，然后尖叫声就停止了。我起床走到亚瑟的房间。当然，他也醒了。我们坐在一起静静听着，然后我们听到她房间的门关上了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Died in her sleep, Dad said the next day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 第二天，爸爸说她在睡梦中去世了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If he honestly thought it was for the best?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果他真的认为那是最好的选择呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You have no way of knowing that. If Arthur honestly thought it was for the best?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你无法确定这一点。如果亚瑟真的认为这是最好的选择呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know. Maybe. It seems a lot less likely now I’ve actually told someone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道。可能吧。不过现在我说出来之后，感觉没那么可能了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re wonderful. Thank you for bearing with me. I needed to get that out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真好。谢谢你的包容。我需要把这些话说出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hello my darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你好，我亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hello, mysterious and oddly compelling stranger from another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你好，这位来自另一个时代的神秘又莫名让人着迷的陌生人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I haven't had the Arthur dream once since I told you about Granny Callie. I think you exorcized that demon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 自从我跟你说了卡莉奶奶的事情后，我就再也没有梦到过亚瑟。我想你驱除了那个恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But since we’ve been together, something else has been happening. It’s a bit awkward actually. I’ve been meaning to talk to you about it, but there hasn’t been a good time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但自从我们在一起以来，发生了一些别的事情。其实有点尴尬。我一直想和你谈谈这件事，但没有找到合适的时机。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But that's not to say there haven't been OTHER dreams. Rather disturbing ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但这并不意味着没有做过其他的梦。相当令人不安的那种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That wouldn't be awkward. This is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那不会尴尬。这个才尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods, I wish. Nothing so pleasant, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天，我倒希望是。不过恐怕没有那么愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't worry. It's not bad as such. I'm not frightened. It's just...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别担心。事情并没有那么糟。我并不害怕。只是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (Okay, Eleanor, deep breath, you can do this)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （好的，埃莉诺，深呼吸，你可以的）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think the Techrot’s jealous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得科腐者嫉妒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't, which is why this is so troubling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的确不容易受到干扰，这就是为什么这件事很困扰我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: No, not that one. Funny that everyone seems to have had it, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不，不是那个。不过有趣的是，似乎每个人都做过那种梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's exactly what I'm afraid of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这正是我所担心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (Okay, Eleanor, deep breath, you can do this)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （好的，埃莉诺，深呼吸，你可以的）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think the Techrot’s jealous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得科腐者嫉妒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, how I wish I were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，我倒希望我是在开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Jealous of our friendship, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嫉妒我们的友谊，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, how I wish I were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，我倒希望我是在开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Jealous of you for taking me away, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嫉妒你把我从它那抢走，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: On some profoundly messed up level, it thinks of me as its property. I was meant to be its breeding prospect. The Legacytes see me as a rival queen, you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在某种极其扭曲的层面上，它认为我是它的所有物。我本应成为它的繁殖对象。你知道，传承种把我视为竞争对手的女王。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: On some profoundly messed up level, it thinks of me as its property. I was meant to be its breeding prospect. The Legacytes see me as a rival queen, you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在某种极其扭曲的层面上，它认为我是它的所有物。我本应成为它的繁殖对象。你知道，传承种把我视为竞争对手的女王。
