/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, maybe if I were a full Warframe, the Techrot wouldn't see me this way. As it is, my cells are still fizzling, and it sees me as its own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，如果我是一个完整的战甲，那么科腐者可能就不会这么看我了。事实上，我的细胞仍在活跃，它把我当成了自己的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well, maybe if I were a full Warframe, the Techrot wouldn't see me this way. As it is, my cells are still fizzling, and it sees me as its own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯，如果我是一个完整的战甲，那么科腐者可能就不会这么看我了。事实上，我的细胞仍在活跃，它把我当成了自己的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Isn’t it bizarre? The jilted ex!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这不是很奇怪吗？被抛弃的前任！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. It wants me back in its gang.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。它想要我回到它的队伍中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Where I come from, you’d have to go and have a fight with it round the back of the local supermarket. I’m not sure how it works in your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在我们那，你得去超市后面和它打一架。我不确定在你们的时代这种事是怎么处理的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: This is your REAL family, it whispers. Become part of us again, severed sister. Be accepted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它在耳边低语，这才是你真正的家庭。再次成为我们的一部分吧，被分离的姐妹。接受我们吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods, this is the awkward bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦天，这部分有点尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The dreams I mentioned before? I'm certain the Techrot's sending them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我之前提到的那些梦？我确信那是科腐者发出的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Whatever that stuff has that passes for a mind, it's always been able to connect with mine. The thoughts it sends are always so crude and weak I can easily fend them off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 无论那东西有什么能算是思想的东西，它总是能与我的思想连接。它发出的思想总是那么粗糙和弱小，我可以轻松抵挡它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Most of the time it just feels like this frantic scratching at the back of my skull, like when you’re in the loo and there’s a cat trying to get the door open.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 大多数时候，它只是让我感觉到后脑勺有种疯狂的抓挠感，就像你在洗手间里，外面有只猫想进来一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. My defenses are down, and it can reach me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。我的防御降低了，它就能接触及到我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s been hitting me on the most primordial level, if you know what I mean. It wants me back. It promises it can make me feel ecstasy I’ve never known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它一直在最原始的层面上影响我，如果你明白我的意思。它想要我回去。它承诺它能让我感受到前所未有的狂喜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It will seed my flesh with the dripping cysts of new life. Because it thinks that’s what I want, you see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它会将新生命的包囊播种在我的肉体。因为它以为这是我想要的，你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Now that's the kind of talk that gets a Drifter absolutely covered with kisses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这种话可是会让漂泊者被吻个不停哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know. I think it knows, too, which is why it's so angry. It can't compete.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道。我想它也知道，所以它才这么生气。它争不过我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'll sleep easier knowing you have my back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 知道有你支持我，我就能更安心地睡觉了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s okay, my sweet. I’m not about to leave you for a suppurating mass of tubercular flesh with lumps of orphaned technology floating in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没事的，亲爱的。我不会为了一团化脓的、漂浮着孤立科技的结核肉块而离开你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just… if you see me looking especially dark-eyed and gaunt on any particular morning when we wake up together, please bring me a nice strong coffee and don’t press me for details?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 只是……如果有一天早晨我们一起醒来，你发现我的眼睛特别黑，脸色特别憔悴，请给我带一杯浓咖啡，不要问我细节好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fancy giving the Techrot something to be REALLY jealous of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想不想真正让科腐者嫉妒一把？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We'll face it together, then. Side by side. Always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，我们会一起面对它。并肩作战。永远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We're family. Blood and found. Unbreakable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们是一家人。血脉与羁绊同在。牢不可破。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You might notice the Mall feeling a little different this morning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你可能会注意到今天早上商场的气氛有点不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nothing big and obvious. Just a few more smiles on a few more faces. A laugh here and there. A sprinkle of happiness on the air.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没有什么大的明显区别。只是更多人在微笑。时不时传来一阵笑声。空气中弥漫着一丝幸福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just my way of giving back. A telepath can send as well as receive, as you know. It doesn't have to be a hosepipe jet to one person. It can be more like a fine mist sprayed over an area.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这只是我回馈的方式。你知道，一个心灵感应者既能发送信息，也能接收信息。它不一定是对一个人的强力喷射。它可以像细雾一样喷洒在一个区域上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you have lawn sprinklers where you come from?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你们那里有草坪洒水器吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’ll do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 可以这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, my dear, sprinklers. Water sprayers for keeping your lawn nice and damp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，亲爱的，洒水器。洒水器可以让你的草坪保持湿润。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I loved lawn sprinklers when I was a little girl. They were magical. When the sun was brightest, you could catch rainbows in them. You’d run through them and feel a delicious chill all over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我小时候很喜欢草坪洒水器。它们太神奇了。阳光最灿烂的时候，你可以在它们当中看到彩虹。穿过它们时，浑身都能感到一阵凉爽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Also ideal for holding your brother's face up to until he screams.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也是把你弟弟的脸按上去直到他尖叫的理想工具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘Happiness is a lawn sprinkler'. Put that on a greetings card.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "幸福是一个草坪洒水器"。把这句话放在贺卡上吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I am. And I don’t see why I should keep it to myself. So I’m suffusing the whole Mall with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。我不觉得有必要把这种心情只留给自己。所以我把它扩散到整个商场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... great. Here I am trying to be the secret happiness fairy sprinkling joy, and instead I get to be the evil drug goblin. My happy mood just nosedived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……真好。我本来想做一个散播欢乐的秘密幸福小仙女，结果却变成了邪恶的毒品小妖精。我的好心情一落千丈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh! Nice analogy!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦！好比喻！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe. I hope so. He’s had to put up with so much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许。我希望如此。他忍受了太多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fine. I'll stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。我会停下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If Aoi can influence the mood through music, I can do it through vibes, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果碧可以通过音乐来影响心情，那么我也可以通过氛围做到，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So much has changed since you came. I don’t just mean you and me. I mean all of it. Even the Mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 自从你来后，很多事情都变了。我指的不只是你和我。我指的是所有的一切。甚至是商场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m glad Aoi persuaded me to stay. Bless her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴碧说服我留下。感谢她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I didn’t tell you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我没有告诉你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. This was not long before you arrived. We’d been out all day trying to stamp out a Techrot hive. There was a murderous tension in the air. Fighting usually burns the anger out of us and leaves us too exhausted to lash out at one another, but this day was different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊。这是你来之前不久的事。那天我们整天都在外面试图清除一个科腐者巢穴。空气中弥漫着一种凶险的紧张气氛。战斗通常能消磨我们的怒气，让我们筋疲力尽，无法对彼此发脾气，但那一天不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I remember Arthur said something like ‘we do this all again tomorrow' and it hit us all like a sledgehammer. Nobody spoke a word on the ride back to the Mall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我记得亚瑟说了类似"我们明天再做一遍"这样的话，这对我们来说就像是一个重拳。在回商场的路上，没有人说一句话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. Usually he manages to hide it, even when he's running on fumes. But I guess he just had nothing left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。通常他都能掩饰得很好，即使是在精疲力竭的时候。但我想他已经没有余力了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He'd burned himself out trying to keep the team together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为了维持团队的团结，他已经透支了自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think he was just trying to get us to focus on the job. But I just felt broken. Arthur and Aoi weren’t speaking, Amir was getting on Quincy’s nerves so much I was starting to fear for his life, and Lettie was side-eyeing me every chance she got.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想他只是想让我们集中精力工作。但我感觉自己快崩溃了。亚瑟和碧不再说话，阿米尔一直在烦昆西，我开始担心他的生命，而莱蒂一有机会就冷眼看我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I spent a lot of time looking into mirrors that day. I kept imagining my reflection grabbing me by the throat and hissing ‘YOU are the problem. If it wasn't for you, none of this would be happening.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那天我花了很多时间照镜子。我不断幻想镜子里的我抓住我的喉咙并嘶声说"你就是问题所在。如果不是因为你，这一切都不会发生。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, this wasn't them. This was me. Every pent-up scrap of self-doubt and self-hatred I'd been keeping down came surging up that day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，这不是他们。这是我自己。在一那天，我一直压抑的自我怀疑和自我憎恨全都涌上心头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you. I know you’ve got my back, and it means a lot to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你。我知道你会支持我，这对我来说很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I thought to myself: what this group needs is a scapegoat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我心里想：这个团队需要的是一个替罪羊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’d heard that line from Lettie so many times, I ended up thinking to myself: maybe she’s right. I’m putting everyone in danger by staying here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这句话我听莱蒂说了无数次了，最后我心想：也许她是对的。我留在这里会让每个人都处于危险之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A monster. Someone to blame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一个怪物。一个可以归咎的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I came up with a whole plan. I’d slip away in the night, hide out in the city somewhere Arthur would never find me, and - this is the part I was most proud of - carry on helping at a distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想出了一个完整的计划。我会在夜里溜走，躲在城里某个亚瑟永远找不到的地方，然后——这是我最自豪的部分——继续在远处帮助他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How? Amir can’t trace telepathy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 怎么找到？阿米尔无法追踪心灵感应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Trying to guilt me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想让我感到内疚吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was going to be a noble exile. I'd crouch on rooftops looking all windswept and resolute. I could report on Techrot buildup, let the Hex know where the Scaldra were setting up roadblocks, even act as an emergency comms relay. Every time I saved Lettie's arse, I'd really make her feel it. Petty? Definitely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我将会是一个高尚的流亡者。我会蹲在屋顶上，看起来被风吹得凌乱，却目光坚定。我可以报告科腐者的集结情况，让六人组知道炽蛇军在哪里设置路障，甚至充当紧急通讯中继。每次我救了莱蒂的命，我一定要让她感受到。小气？绝对是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't bother. I feel dreadful enough already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别费心了。我已经够难受了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I chose my moment. I waited until Amir was asleep. Then I pulled a long coat on and headed for the garage as silently as I could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我选择了合适的时机。我等到阿米尔睡着了。然后穿上一件长外套，悄无声息地走向车库。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The security grate came down by itself. I turned around and there Aoi was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 防盗栅栏自动落了下来。我转过身，碧就在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We talked all night and cried in each other’s arms. She was hurting, too. Deeply. By the time the sun came up, I’d decided to stay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们彻夜长谈，相拥而泣。她也很受伤，非常深。等到太阳升起时，我决定留下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Whatever grotesque impulse led you to write that, I hope you choke on it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不管是什么怪诞的冲动让你写下句话，我希望你被它呛到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. All six of us needed to be here on New Year’s Eve, I think. And you, of course. The stranger at the door, bringing good luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。我想，在除夕夜，我们六个人都应该在这里。当然还有你。门外带来好运的陌生人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is ‘The Indifference' what it IS, or what it WANTS?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "虚空无情之物"的无情是它的本质，还是它的欲望？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You have found the one thing we share, congratulations. And sorry. This is more important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 恭喜你发现了我们的共同点。还有，抱歉。这个问题更重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sorry. This is more important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 抱歉。这个问题更重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think ‘The Great Indifference' is going to try to get between us, somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我认为"虚空无情之物"会试图以某种方式介入我们之间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don’t laugh. I can feel it, deep down in my bone marrow. The thing that was in Rusalka would love to see us tearing each other into pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 别笑。我能从骨髓深处感觉到。鲁莎卡里面的那个东西很想看到我们把对方撕成碎片。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know why. I just know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道为什么。我就是知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've seen it in your head. Albrecht and Loid. Mother and Father. You and your parents. Rusalka and Viktor, for all we know. And the six of us, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我已经在你的脑海里看到了。阿尔布雷希特和洛德。"母亲"和"父亲"。你和你的父母。就我们所知，鲁莎卡和维克多也是如此。当然还有我们六个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What this thing does is cold. Perverse. But there's a motivation behind it, somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这个东西的所作所为是冷酷的，扭曲的。但在某种意义上，它背后隐藏着动机。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Admirable theory, but we don't KNOW that, do we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是个值得赞赏的理论，但我们并不确切知道，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If you're right, then it's blameless. Childlike, almost. That doesn't fit with what we know. It's malevolent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你是对的，那么它是无辜的。几乎像个孩子。这和我们的认知不符——它是恶意的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Just let it try to get between us. So help me Sol, I'll end it. I'll find a way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就让它尝试来破坏我们之间的关系。我向太阳神发誓，我会结束它的。我会找到办法的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There are powers in the Universe that thing can’t stand against. I choose to believe it with every atom of myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 宇宙中一定存在着那个东西无法对抗的力量。我选择全心全意相信这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If it swallows me whole I’ll stick in its throat and choke it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果它把我整个人吞下去，我会卡在它的喉咙里，让它窒息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm dead anyway in this scenario.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在这种情况下，我反正都要死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But at least I get to spit in its eye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但至少我能把口水吐在它眼睛上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If this was a story, you'd come up with some clever trick. You'd dig up the giant's stone heart and crack it with a swan's feather, or trick it into throwing itself over a cliff.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果这是个故事，你会想出一些巧妙的招数。你可能会挖出巨人的石心，用天鹅的羽毛敲碎它，或者诱骗它跳下悬崖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If those old stories didn't tell the truth, people wouldn't have kept telling them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果那些古老的故事不是真实的，人们就不会一直讲述它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t mean giants are real. I just mean the old stories tell a different kind of truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并不是说巨人是真的。我只是说古老的故事讲述了另一种真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know. I wish I had more than instinct to go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道。我希望我有更多除了直觉之外的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We're confronting something vast, terrifying and outside our comprehension. Normally only children get to do that. That's why fairy tales exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们正在面对的是庞大、可怕并且超出我们理解的事物。通常只有孩子们才需要面对这种情况。这就是为什么童话存在的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think the one thing all those giant-killer stories have in common is this: they're all about learning the rules and figuring out how to be clever with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我认为所有那些打败巨人的故事都有一个共同点：它们都是关于学习规则并弄清楚如何巧妙地利用这些规则。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Some monsters are stupid. Some are compelled to be literal. Some have secrets. But you can’t win until you know the rules the monster’s bound by.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有些怪物很蠢。有些怪物被迫只能按字面意义行事。有些怪物有秘密。但在你弄清楚怪物受限于什么规则之前，你是无法取胜的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Doesn't matter. If it really is stuck, then we can deduce two things, can't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没关系。如果它真的被困住了，那么我们可以推断出两件事，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It has to be! Even Gods have rules! No matter how powerful the Indifference seems, it’s not a God.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一定会有规则约束它！即使是神也有规则！无论虚空无情之物看起来有多强大，它不是神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You beat Thrax. It doesn’t matter how many times you failed and ended up on your arse. You WON. Why shouldn’t you beat the Man in the Wall, too?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你打败了士魂大帝。不管你失败了多少次，屁股多少次着地。最终你还是赢了。你为什么不能同样战胜墙中人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: One, it can be trapped. Maybe even imprisoned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一是，它可以被困住，甚至被囚禁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And two, it WANTS something. It wants to get out. If we know what it wants, we're already one step ahead of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 二是，它想要某种东西。它想要出去。如果我们知道它想要什么，我们就已经领先它一步了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I didn’t.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我并没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m just more frightened of losing you, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是更害怕失去你，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve been thinking. There’s something I need to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一直在想。有件事我必须要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’m going to need help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会需要帮助的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So. Christopher.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，关于克里斯托弗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's time I told you about Christopher.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在是时候告诉你关于克里斯托弗的事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's best friend. We were engaged. I thought I was in love with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他是亚瑟最好的朋友。我们订了婚。我以为我很爱他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: To... make a very long and tragic story very short... Christopher died in a roadside bomb before we were married.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 长话短说，这是一个悲惨的故事……在我们结婚前，克里斯托弗在一次路边炸弹袭击中丧生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Perhaps I'll tell you the whole story another day. Perhaps I won't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许我改天再告诉你整个故事。也许我不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm telling you all this now because...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我现在告诉你这些是因为……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I've been holding on to him for years. So has Arthur. We have a ritual every year in his memory. But not this year. I couldn't face it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这些年我一直在怀念他。亚瑟也是如此。我们每年都会举行一个仪式来纪念他。但今年我做不到。我无法面对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don’t know whether ghosts exist, but they might as well, because I’ve let him become one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道鬼魂是否存在，但它们或许真的存在，因为我让他变成了一个鬼魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh mate. I THOUGHT I was. I loved him, but I didn’t even know if I was IN love with him or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，伙计。我以为我爱他。我爱过他，但我甚至不确定我是否真的爱上了他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That sounds awful, doesn’t it? It’s true, though. At the time, it just didn’t seem important. Then he died, and that became what our story was all about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这听起来很糟糕，不是吗？但这是真的。当时，这似乎并不重要。后来他死了，这成了我们故事的全部。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Everything that I admired about him has just been overshadowed by how he died. I can’t think about him without this knot tightening in my stomach.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我对他的所有钦佩都被他的去世所掩盖。一想到他，我的胃就会感到一阵绞痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s not fair. TO HIM. He deserves better than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这对他不公平。他值得更好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So why do I feel so guilty?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那为什么我会感到这么内疚？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why do I feel like letting him go is the same thing as throwing him away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么我觉得放手就像是抛弃他一样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods. You’re bloody right, you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天。你说得太对了，你知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is that it? Am I that shallow?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是这个原因吗？我有这么肤浅吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I doubt even Christopher would love me in my current condition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我甚至怀疑，以我现在的状态，克里斯托弗是否还会爱我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We’re useless at dealing with this, my lot. We bottle everything up. We put a brave face on and whistle in the trenches. It gets us through, just like it got our parents through. But we don’t know how to stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们这帮人，不怎么会面对这种事。我们把一切都藏在心里。装出一副勇敢的样子，在战壕中吹口哨。这让我们撑过来了，就像我们的父母，他们也是这样撑过来的。但我们不知道该如何停止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What should I do? How do I let go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我该怎么办？我该如何放手？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't feel I deserve EITHER of you right now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在我觉得我不配得到你们中的任何一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think... I want you to have ALL of me. I can't hold back part of myself in a state of endless mourning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想……我希望你拥有我的全部。我不能让自己的一部分永远停留在无尽的哀悼中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... no. That's not fair. I'm not being fair to him at all, am I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……不。这不公平。我这样对他太不公平了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He wouldn't want to stand in the way of my happiness. He was kind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他不会想妨碍我的幸福。他很善良。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 莱蒂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Part of me thinks that's a stupid idea. He won't read it. He's dead. But...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我心里想，这是个愚蠢的想法。他不会读到这些。他已经不在了。但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes, he has. Maybe that's part of the problem. I know he's upset that I didn't keep up our little ceremony of remembrance this year.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，他确实有。也许这正是问题的一部分。我知道他很不高兴，因为我今年没有继续我们的小小纪念仪式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Why her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 为什么是她？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... the more I think about it, the less stupid it seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我越想越觉得这似乎并不那么愚蠢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I just... have to say goodbye to Christopher MY way this time. Once and for all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我只是……这次我必须以我自己的方式和克里斯托弗告别。彻底地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. I'll do it. There are things I need to say to him. Things I never said when he was alive. Maybe then he can rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好。我会去做的。有些话我需要对他说。那些他在世时我从未说过的话。也许这样他就可以安息了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: To Arthur he'll always be a lost brother, a fallen soldier. That's the mourning he knows and understands. But it's not mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对亚瑟来说，他永远是一个死去的兄弟，一位阵亡的士兵。这是他所知道和理解的哀悼方式。但那不是我的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you for listening, and for the advice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你的倾听和建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't do it Arthur's way anymore. I think... if I just tell him that, he'll get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不能再用亚瑟的方式了。我想……如果我告诉他这一点，他会理解的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I will never, ever forget this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我永远都不会忘记这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是时候了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I need to let go of a LOT of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我需要放下很多东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let me talk to her. If she tells me to piss off, then so be it. But at least I’ll have tried, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我要和她谈谈。如果她叫我滚蛋，那就这样吧。但至少我尝试过了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I bet. Living like this, doing what we do every day, we all put up walls. We just forgot to put doors in them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我敢打赌。过这样的生活，做着我们每天所做的事，我们都筑起了墙。我们只是忘了在墙上装门而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you for beating your lovely head against my wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢你用你那可爱的头撞我的墙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So I was thinking: the year's going to loop at the end of December like it always does and although it'll FEEL like a whole new year, it won't REALLY be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以我在想：一年会在十二月底的时候又像以往一样循环，虽然它会让人感觉像是崭新的一年，但实际上并非如此

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: and although I THINK I know how many times this has happened before, I actually don't, because I MIGHT NOT REMEMBER IT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虽然我认为自己知道这种情况之前发生过多少次，但我实际上并不确定，因为我可能记不清了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What if what I remember as Loop One was actually Loop Fifteen Thousand and Forty Two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我记得的第一次循环实际上是第 15042 次循环呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: and then I thought well, screw it, might as well go completely crazy and do whatever the hell I want because you can always punch the floor again and reset everything
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后我想，算了，干脆彻底放纵，想做什么就做什么，因为你总是可以随时猛砸地板然后一切重新开始

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: but THEN I thought no, wait, what if this is the one where it actually sticks? Where we finally go all the way from 1999 to 2000?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但后来我又想到，不行，等等，万一这次真的成功了呢？万一我们终于能从 1999 年顺利进入 2000 年呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't want to have made a complete berk of myself in the one loop that turns out to be the final decisive 1999. I'd never be able to unravel it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不想在有最后决定性的 1999 年中的一个循环里把自己搞得一团糟。不然到时候我就很危险了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: One day it'll be Solstice and not just endless winter, to use the tired old analogy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 套用那个老掉牙的比喻来说，总有一天会迎来春至日，而非无尽的寒冬

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We all just have to keep one another warm till then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在那之前，我们只要互相取暖就好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You and I will just have to keep each other warm until then. x
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在那之前你和我只能互相取暖了。x

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A POEM
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 送你一首诗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: by Eleanor Nightingale
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 作者：埃莉诺·南丁格尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: aged 6 1/2
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 六岁半

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: 'KAVAT'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: '库娃'

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Kalymos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢卡利莫斯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Kalymos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢卡利莫斯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You are my favourite gal-ymos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是我最喜欢的少女莫斯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I give you treats and stroke your head
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我给你零食，抚摸你的头

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: because you are my pal-ymos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为你是我的喵里莫斯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: the end
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 完

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦天哪

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have this idea for a mural
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有个想法，想画一幅壁画

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You and me are in the town square with bits of Techrot all over the place, fighting side by side, giving each other a look that’s a bit more than just comradely affection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你和我在城镇广场，周围散落着科腐者的碎片，我们并肩作战，彼此对视的眼神中流露的不仅仅是战友情谊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You and me are in ancient Höllvania, in the time of gods and monsters
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你和我身处古老的霍瓦尼亚，身处众神与怪物的时代

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Then up on a nearby roof is the God of Love, training his arrow on us both…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后附近的屋顶上出现了爱神，他正用箭射向我们俩……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We are facing off against an army of skeletons in rotting armour, while up above us sits the God of Thunder, scowling and judgemental
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们正与一群身穿腐烂盔甲的骷髅大军对峙，而在我们头顶上，雷神坐着，面容阴沉，带着审判的目光

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: IT’S QUINCY IN LITTLE PINK SHORTS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是穿着粉红色短裤的昆西

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: IT'S AMIR
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: WITH WINGS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还带着翅膀

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: THE LOVE SNIPER
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 爱情狙击手

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ROLLING DICE TO DECIDE OUR FATE
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 在掷骰子决定我们的命运

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: THE FULGUROUS FABLEMASTER
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 闪电寓言主持人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’re welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I have to do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一定要这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve been trying to find the moment, you know. I can’t.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一直在寻找那个时刻，你知道的。我找不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I’ve been trying to find the moment, you know. I can’t.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一直在寻找那个时刻，你知道的。我找不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The moment when I realized I was in love with you, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当然是我意识到我爱上你的那一刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I remember thinking ‘well, this is bloody inconvenient, Eleanor, now you're bound to make a complete fool of yourself.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我记得我当时在想"好吧，这真是太麻烦了，埃莉诺，你这是要彻底闹笑话了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But not when, or what we were doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但我不记得是什么时候，或我们当时在做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I suppose I should say thank you. For listening to me. For entertaining all these wild fancies of mine. And, most importantly, for being my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我应该说声感谢。感谢你的倾听。感谢你包容我那些天马行空的想法。最重要的是，感谢你成为我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The moment when I realized that my life had been changed by you. When you had wriggled your way into my heart and become family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那个我意识到我的生活因你而改变的时刻。当你悄无声息地走进我的心并成为家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yours forever, E. xxx
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 永远支持你的，埃（友情小亲亲）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What's the bloody point? I ask you. What is the bloody POINT??
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这有什么意义呢？我问你。这到底有什么意义？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: My Drifter. You fell into my life and turned everything on its head. Of all the choices you could have made, you chose me. You left me wide-eyed and wonderstruck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我的漂泊者。你闯进我的生活，让一切天翻地覆。在你做出的所有选择中，你选择了我。你让我又惊又喜，激动不已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can I interest you in some enthusiastic kissing, with an option to proceed to rampant sexual intercourse?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以和你先来点激情亲吻，然后再考虑发展成更狂野的性爱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 太好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mmm. Let's feel our way forward, then. Sounds perfect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。那我们就顺其自然。听起来很完美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And right there is the secret to making this work. Communication. If kissing is what you want, then kissing you shall have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就是让这一切顺利进行的秘诀。沟通。如果你想要的是亲吻，那么你就会得到亲吻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yours in eager anticipation, E. xxx
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 满怀期待的我，埃（深情的吻）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hey. Need to bounce some ideas off you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嘿。我想听听你的意见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thinking about Fiendsnight. I haven’t dressed up for it for years, but I was leafing through one of Amir’s comics and I suddenly thought - hold on, I could be the Contessa! I’ve got the fangs for it and everything!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在想恶魔之夜的事。我已经好多年没打扮过了，但刚才翻看阿米尔的一本漫画时，突然想到——等等，我完全可以扮成伯爵夫人！我连獠牙都有了，一切都齐了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But is that too obvious? Should I be Dandy Damage?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但这是不是太明显了？我应该像丹迪·戴米奇那样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh Gods no. I've seen her in your head. I could never do her justice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天啊，不。我在你脑海中见过她。我可没法再现她的模样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Mmm. I forget you're an innocent abroad, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。有时候我都忘了你是个初来乍到的外地人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Dandy Damage walked so that Temple and the Rippers could run. He was every mother's nightmare and every teenage catastrophe's dream.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 丹迪·戴米奇的行动为 Temple 和撕裂者乐队创造了逃跑的机会。他堪称每位母亲的噩梦，却是每个叛逆少年的梦想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And that helmet. Is it a helmet? Is it part of her? How does she see through it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还有那顶头盔。那是头盔吗？还是她身体的一部分？她是怎么透过它看东西的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Fiendsnight celebrates the fading of Sol's influence on the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 恶魔之夜庆祝的是太阳对世界影响力的消退。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Built like a stick insect, made up like a silent movie queen. Mouth like candy. Pinstripes and leather and dog chain. Cheekbones like a skeleton's hips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 身材修长如竹节虫，妆容精致如默片女王。嘴唇甜美如糖果。条纹西装、皮革与狗链。颧骨突出的像骷髅的臀部。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Anyway, there's three of her in the one body. I could never pick one of them over the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不管怎样，她身上有三个不同的性格。我实在无法在她们之间做出选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Which doesn't make a lot of sense on the face of it. Why celebrate the rising dark? Why rejoice in lawlessness and anarchy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这听起来似乎并不合理。为什么要庆祝黑暗的降临？为什么要为无政府状态和混乱而高兴呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think it's like an inoculation, maybe. A tiny bit of the thing we fear, to strengthen us. Or maybe it's just an excuse to put on the devil's mask and raise hell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得这可能就像接种疫苗一样。用一点点我们所恐惧的事物，让我们坚强起来。又或者这不过是个借口，借此戴上魔鬼的面具，大闹一场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I'm probably just being silly. Childish. Aren't I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我可能只是在犯傻。很幼稚。对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, what am I thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，我在想什么呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't need to dress up, do I? I'm already a monster. Forever and ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不需要打扮，对吧？我本来就是个怪物。永远都是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh yes! Silly me. I forgot the monster got the happy ending in our little story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，对啊！我真糊涂。我忘了那个怪物在我们的故事里有一个圆满的结局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Forgive me. I still can't quite believe that this is what you actually WANT. Maybe I just need a tiny bit more convincing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 原谅我。我还是不太相信这是你真正想要的。也许我还需要一点什么来说服自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh there are SO MANY reasons why that is a TERRIBLE IDEA
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，有太多太多的理由说明这是个糟糕透顶的主意

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'll take you up on that. And thank you. Once again. x
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我接受你的建议。再次感谢你。x

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let's devour one another later. xxx
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们稍后再互相吞噬吧。 xxx

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: SO. MANY.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 非。常。多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (I can't think of any right now but I'm sure there are DOZENS)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （我现在想不出来任何理由，但我肯定有成百上千个）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……该死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: you have skewered me most nimbly upon my own kebab. damn you. well done. x
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你真是让我自己挖坑自己跳啊。该死，你真厉害。干得漂亮。x

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't know if you've noticed, but something bloody fantastic has happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不知道你是否注意到，发生了一件超级奇妙的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's singing again. Thank the Gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟又开始唱歌了。谢天谢地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Performance anxiety. Simple as that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 赛前焦虑症。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thank you for putting that as delicately as you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 您情商还真是高啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Isn't he?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It matters to me that you care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 能得到您的关心可真是太荣幸了呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: When I think of the effort it took to get him to stand up in front of a crowd of people and sing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 当我想到要让他站在一群人面前唱歌需要付出多大的努力时……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Especially since there are reasons why he gave up singing, which you couldn't possibly have known about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 尤其他放弃唱歌是有原因的，而这些原因你不可能知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... the first time he really lost his nerve, I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我是说，那是他第一次真正地失去了前进的勇气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It’s the name. That’s the sodding problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是名字的问题。问题就出在这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Solstice Carol Concert back in the eighties. Imagine our little man in short trousers doing the solo from How Bright The Dew Upon That Morn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 八十年代的"冬至颂歌音乐会"。想象一下，我们的小男孩穿着短裤，独唱《晨露多晶莹》。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ‘oh your name's nightingale is it ha ha sing us a song then'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "哦，你名字的意思是夜莺对吗，那就给我们唱首歌吧"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hearing the same joke too often, more like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 同样的笑话听得太多了，更像是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Different wankers, same line, all through our lives. Now Viktor’s doing it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们一生中遇到过不同的混蛋，却都说着同一套台词。现在维克多也变成这样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He took it so seriously. Weeks and weeks of practice and then, on the night, he bottled it. He hid in the wings and refused to go out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他对此非常认真。连续几周的练习之后，在那天晚上，他打了退堂鼓。躲在后台，不肯登场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well. I’d sing it for you, but I’m not sure what sort of noise would come out if I tried.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好吧。我想唱给你听，但我不知道唱出来会是什么声音。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Bloody Techrot. I tried to sing Happy Birthday to Aoi and it sounded like a bullfrog caught in a paper shredder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 傻叉科腐者。我之前给碧唱过生日快乐歌，听起来就像只被卷进碎纸机的牛蛙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly, I’m proud of Arthur for having the guts to sing at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话，我为亚瑟有勇气唱歌而骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I literally kicked his arse. Not proud of it. But it needed doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我直接踢了他屁股一脚。我并不以此为荣。但确实需要这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The thing is, he didn’t do all that practice for our parents’ sake or to make Mrs Henshaw happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 问题是，他做这些练习并不是为了我们的父母，也不是为了让亨肖太太高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, it’s not much of a loss. I couldn’t sing anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，也没什么损失。反正我也不会唱歌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: He was singing because he loved it. But when the spotlight was on him, he locked up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他唱歌是因为他热爱唱歌。但当聚光灯照在他身上时，他就沉默了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The closest I came was screaming out lyrics from the Shag Cannons in my bedroom because I wanted to be in Mandy Jellicoe’s band because I fancied her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我离歌手最接近的一次是在卧室里大声喊着浪炮乐队的歌词，因为我想加入曼迪·杰利科的乐队，因为我喜欢她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Cue my dad hammering on the door and threatening to wash my mouth out with carbolic if he heard any more of that filth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 然后我爸来砸门，威胁我说，如果他再听到这些脏话，就用消毒剂把我的嘴洗干净。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's at his happiest when he can forget about Arthur. When he can lay the ghost of himself to rest and just BE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟最快乐的时候，就是他能忘掉亚瑟的时候。当他能让自己的灵魂得到安息，只做自己的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (I don't know if you have ‘punk' where you come from but not being able to sing is more of a requirement than a dealbreaker.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （我不知道你们那里是否有 "朋克"，但不会唱歌与其说是一种障碍，倒不如说是一种优势。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Beer helps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啤酒能帮他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And it surely doesn't hurt that Velimir is acting like the dad Arthur would have chosen, if he could have picked one out of a catalogue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而且，如果他能选的话，维利米尔的表现确实很像亚瑟心目中的父亲形象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't you dare drop something like that into the chat and then not elaborate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你怎么还会卖关子了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: They didn't even get to the ‘pity gig in the local pub' stage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 他们甚至连"在当地酒馆进行可怜的演出 "的阶段都没到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I demand you tell me what Skeg is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我要你告诉我什么是管道乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Word got around that Mandy was planning to spit on the audience and that was that. Shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有消息说，曼迪打算向观众吐口水，就这样。巨丢脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Arthur's been carting that teddy bear around for months. Now Velimir shows up. It's like destiny sensed a bear-shaped hole in Arthur's life...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亚瑟几个月来一直带着那只泰迪熊到处跑。现在维利米尔出现了。仿佛命运感知到亚瑟的生命中有一个熊形的缺口……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: yeah, well. Maybe the bickering makes him feel at home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是啊。也许拌嘴让他有了家的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because it sounds like something sold in little ziplock bags on a Ludston estate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为这听着就像在拉德斯顿大楼里用小密封袋装着卖的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It was a different time. Back when punk was real punk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那是个不同的时代。那时的朋克才是真正的朋克。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... sorry. Not my business to speculate. I'm just happy that he's happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……抱歉。我无权妄加揣测。我只是高兴他开心而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Weird what you can get homesick for, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 让你觉得想家的事物还挺奇怪的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Huh. 'Pointless noise'. I've heard that said before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哈。"毫无意义的噪音"。我以前听人这么说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I bloody wasn't, I can tell you that much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我可以告诉你，我绝对不介意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I just thought 'I wish she could see me now'. I think she'd like this version of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我只是想"真希望她能看到现在的我"。我觉得她会喜欢这个版本的我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I don't think anything's so pointless that it can't be the soundtrack to someone's youth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我不认为有什么是毫无意义的，一切都可以成为一个人青春的背景音乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Gods, look at me, I've gone all soppy and nostalgic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天哪，看看我，我都变得多愁善感和怀旧起来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hmm. Sounds like survivor music. Wouldn’t mind having a listen if you get the chance to record some for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 嗯。听起来像是末日风音乐。如果你有空给我录一些，我想听听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'd better stop. I'm getting sentimental.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我还是别说了。我都变得多愁善感了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Best keep it off the Mall speakers, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过，千万不要在商场的扬声器上播放。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Better get back to it. Thanks for the ear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 还是回去细聊吧。谢谢你的倾听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you ever get that thing where you’re having a shower and suddenly it’s like a weird little voice asks you a question you’ve never really thought to ask yourself before?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你有没有过这样的经历：正在洗澡时，突然有个奇怪的小声音问了你一个你从未想过要问自己的问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right, exactly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: wait
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Bless him. No, I mean an internal voice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 保佑他。不，我说的是内心的声音。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Lua disappeared?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 月球消失了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: A bit as if your brain was keeping itself occupied while you got on with the important business of personal hygiene.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有点像你在专注于个人卫生，而你的的大脑在忙着自娱自乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For how long? Where did she go? What happened to the tides?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 多久了？她去了哪里？那潮汐怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I get them all the time. Weirdly random. So much so lately that I've been wondering if they really came from my own head at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我经常遇到这种情况。奇怪的是，它们总是随机出现。最近这种情况频繁到让我开始怀疑，这些想法是不是真的都来自我的大脑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Some of them I've turned into paintings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我把其中的一些画了出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: nevermind, we can come back to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 算了，我们以后再讨论这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So, random shower thoughts. I got hit with an absolute belter this morning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以，随意的淋浴想法。今早我被一个超绝的问题击中了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: How did the Lotus displace an entire MOON?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: Lotus 是怎么挪动整个月亮的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It went ‘hey, what if the Gods were real?'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 它说，"嘿，如果神真的存在呢？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I went all wobbly for a moment. Had to run some cold in my face to snap out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我一下子浑身发抖。只好用冷水洗脸，让自己清醒过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah, this is why I adore talking to you about these things
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊，这就是为什么我喜欢和你谈论这些事情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, come on. Nobody actually thinks Gods are real. Not in the way that, I dunno, tables and chairs are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，别开玩笑了。没有人真的认为神是真实存在的。不是像桌子和椅子那样真实存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Isn't it? What if every time you thought the universe was sending you a message, it actually was?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是吧？如果每次你觉得宇宙在给你传递信息时，而它确实是在发送信息，那会怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Your life is so fantastically absurd that the reality of Gods is as natural a speculation to you as the relative merits of pizza toppings
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你的生活如此荒诞不经，以至于神的存在对你来说，就像比萨配料的优劣之争一样自然而然

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Real Gods are like village wells and outdoor toilets. They're something people USED to have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 真正的神就像村里的水井和户外厕所。它们是人们曾经拥有过的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Imagine everything being in the hands of these petty, immortal bastards who were in charge just because that's the way things are, not because they deserved it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想象一下，一切都掌握在这些卑鄙、不死的混蛋手中，他们掌权只是因为事情就是这样，而不是因为他们配得上

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You might even have met a God. If that's what the Indifference is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你甚至可能遇到过一个神。如果这就是虚空无情之物的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Nowadays they’re just symbols, or metaphors, or some bollocks like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如今它们不过就是符号、隐喻，或是些无稽之谈之类的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And the mad part is that that's how people actually lived. That was their reality, every day of their lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 而最疯狂的是，人们就是这样生活的。这就是他们的现实，他们每天的生活都是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: To them the Gods were as real as the weather, and gave about the same number of shits about them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对他们来说，神就像天气一样真实，而且对他们也差不多同样不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think that's it, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得是这样，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well yeah, they are. But they’re also just celestial bodies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的，它们确实是。但它们也只是天体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I know why, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我想我也知道原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Like how Britannia is a country, with a name and an identity and stuff, but it's also just a mass of earth and rocks. It can be both at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 就像不列颠尼克是一个国家，有自己的名字和身份什么的，但它也只是一堆土和石头。它可以同时是两者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh hell, you're giving me chills
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 天啊，你让我起鸡皮疙瘩

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's all about light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一切都与光有关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You can go out on a lovely sunny day and feel grateful and look up at Sol and go ‘cheers!' You mean it. That's a human thing to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你可以趁着一个晴朗美好的日子出去走走，心怀感激地仰望太阳，然后大声喊出"谢谢！"你发自内心地这么做。这是人类会做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. You HAD living Gods. But you killed them all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 没错。你们确实有过活着的神。但你们把他们杀光了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: The devil is a stickler for the letter of the law, in all the old folktales
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 魔鬼对法律条文一丝不苟，在所有古老的民间故事中都是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: What are Sol and Lua, after all? Before it occurred to anyone to think of them as Gods? They were LIGHTS.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 太阳和月亮究竟是什么？在它们被认为是神之前？它们只不过是光而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But nobody nowadays thinks Sol or Lua literally got some human woman pregnant or mothered some human bloke’s child and that’s where the King came from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但现在没有人会认为太阳神或月神真的让某个人类女人怀孕了或者是某个人类男人的孩子的母亲，这就是国王的由来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (Don't get me wrong, I love that for you.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （别误会，我为你感到高兴。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you think it thinks you've pledged something to it? Your 'light'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你觉得它认为你已经向它许下了承诺吗？你的"光"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: People used to believe that stuff. Now we know those stories were just legends. We’ve outgrown them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 人们过去曾相信那些说法。如今我们知道那些故事不过是传说。我们已经超越了它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: YES.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But then some little cave-nerd who was probably picked on by the big cavegirls hit on the whole banging rocks together trick, and bingo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但后来，有个小洞穴宅男——他大概是被那些大洞穴女孩欺负过——想出了用石头互相敲击的办法，结果一击即中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh that stuff happened a LOT. All over the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，那种事情发生过很多次。世界各地都有过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... would you have liked to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……你想要这些吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Light on demand! Independence from the big lights in the sky!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 随时随地都有光！摆脱对天际大灯的依赖！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Imagine you're some arrogant priest setting off over the sea to spread the gospel of Sol to the ‘savages' in the new world, only to find that they not only know all about Sol already, they've got Sol's actual son ruling over them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想象一下，你是一个自命不凡的牧师，乘船远渡重洋，前往新大陆向"野蛮人"传播太阳神的福音，却发现他们不仅早已知晓太阳神的一切，而且太阳神的亲生儿子正统治着他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: okay. Whatever you do today, whoever you're with, whether it's me or Arthur or any of us... stay safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。无论你今天做什么，和谁在一起，不管是和我、亚瑟还是我们中的任何一个人……都要注意安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Now look at us. Light's everywhere. We've cheapened it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 看看我们现在。光无处不在。我们已经让它变得廉价了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You’d go running back home with your tail between your legs, or convert on the spot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你只能夹着尾巴逃回家，或者当场顺服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: That's fair. I respect it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很公平。我尊重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm glad. If you feel your life could have been worse than it is, I guess we have something to celebrate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我很高兴。如果你觉得你的生活本可以比现在更糟糕，那我想我们有值得庆祝的事情吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I understand, I think. You missed out on a great deal, didn't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得我理解。你错过了很多东西，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I love you. Any God that tries to get in the way of that had better pray to whatever the hell it is that's above Gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我爱你。任何试图阻碍这份爱的神，都最好向神之上的见鬼东西祈祷去吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You're my dear friend. Any God who tries to take you from me is going to find its reality sorely tested.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你是我亲爱的朋友。任何试图将你从我身边夺走的神，都将发现其现实将面临严峻考验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Let's just say I used to be a lot more confident in the boring material reality of things than I am now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这么说吧，我以前对无聊的物质现实比现在自信得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There’s a Drifter-shaped hole where that assurance used to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 曾经充满信心的地方，如今只剩下一个漂泊者形状的空洞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We both have our scars, my love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都有自己的伤疤，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We both have our scars, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们都有自己的伤疤，我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Honestly? I don’t miss it, really. It’s nice to be freaked out by the possibilities once in a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 说实话？我真的不怀念它。偶尔被各种可能性吓一跳也挺不错的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was wondering, as I so often do...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我在想，就像我经常想的那样……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Once this loop is finally closed, however that happens, what's next for Earth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 一旦这个循环最终关闭，无论这是如何发生的，地球接下来会怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I know 2000 is pretty far back in your past, but can you tell me ANYTHING about what's in store for our little planet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我知道 2000 年对你来说，已经是相当遥远的过去了，但你能告诉我我们这个小星球的未来会发生什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... and eventually the planet gets so effed up that the Orokin want to bail out of it and go and live somewhere else, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……最终这个星球变得非常混乱，以至于奥罗金想要逃离它，去其他地方生活，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... which leads to the whole Zariman thing, which is where YOU come in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……这引出了整个扎里曼事件，这就是关于你的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Oh, like everything you've done HASN'T changed the future?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦，就像你所做的一切都没有改变未来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Weird to think that it all starts right here in this city.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 想想真奇怪，这一切都是从这座城市开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: You might have changed the little details, but the big ones have stayed pretty much the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你可能改变了一些小细节，但大的方面基本保持不变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think the Universe knows what she's doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得宇宙知道她要怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: hang about...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等等……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: There's more going on than just blind particles mucking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 除了不长眼的粒子胡闹之外，还有很多事情发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Makes sense. If Albrecht's nuke had gone off would that mean no Techrot, so no knackered Earth, no need to escape, no first trip into the Void and no Indifference??
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 有道理。如果阿尔布雷希特的核弹爆炸了，是不是就意味着没有科腐者，没有衰败的地球，没必要逃跑，就没有第一次进入虚空的旅行，也没有虚空无情之物了？？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If yours was the Zariman Ten-Zero, what happened to Zarimans One through Nine?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果你的是扎里曼 10-0号，那扎里曼的 1 到 9 会是什么情况？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I'm going to go see if Lettie has any coffee on the go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我去看看莱蒂现在有没有咖啡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe from a very big or very small perspective, but not at the level where you and I exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许从很大或很小的角度来看，但不是你我所存在的层面上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If we can make meaning and we're part of the Universe, then the Universe is by definition meaningful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我们能够创造意义，并且我们是宇宙的一部分，那宇宙从定义上来说就是有意义的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Exactly. The meaning we make isn't just comfortable delusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 的确如此。那我们创造的意义就不仅仅是舒适的错觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: But there's always that voice whispering to you and insisting that none of this matters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但总有一个声音在你耳边低语，坚持说这一切都不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Our existence isn't any less true or valid than quarks or supernovas. We're important, like it or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们的存在并不比夸克或超新星更不真实或有效。无论你喜不喜欢，我们都很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Maybe the big cosmic throwdown isn't between Good and Evil, but meaning and meaninglessness?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 也许宇宙的重大决斗并不是在善与恶之间，而是在有意义与无意义之间？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Sounds better than 'Operation Get Our Irresponsible Arses To A New Planet That We Can Proceed To Shit All Over'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 听起来比"把我们不负责任的屁股挪到一个新的星球，然后我们可以到处祸害行动"要好得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Wonderful. A clear case of naturally occurring immunity!

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: you're certainly not alone in that, from what I gather
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 据我所知，你绝不是唯一有这种想法的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I can't really take it seriously though. There are reasons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 不过我实在无法认真对待这件事。这是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Most of the time Arthur talks like a fairly normal human being, but there are times when he does The Voice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 大多数时候，亚瑟说话就像一个正常人，但有时他会用那种声音说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: We must ensure your body is donated to medical science.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我们必须确保把你的遗体捐献给医学科学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: ... I just need you to know that to me, that will always be his Action Angus voice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: ……我只是想让你知道，对我来说，那永远都是他的安格斯玩偶声音。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's like listening to someone fix you a testosterone milkshake stirred up in a cement mixer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这就像听着有人用水泥搅拌机给你调制一杯睾酮奶昔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: "STAY CALM AND LET THE PROFESSIONALS HANDLE THIS" growls 8 year old Arthur as Action Angus and the plastic SAS are rescuing one of my Sandie dolls from the dinosaur army
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: "保持冷静，让专业人士来处理这件事" 八岁的亚瑟低吼道，当时安格斯玩偶和塑料特种兵正在从恐龙军队中营救我的桑迪娃娃

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: It's so gravelly you could pick neolithic axe heads out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 非常粗糙，你甚至可以从里面挑出新石器时代的斧头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: For some reason it leaves otherwise sane and well adjusted people weak at the knees.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 出于某种原因，它让那些原本理智且适应良好的普通人感到腿软。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hope I haven't ruined it for you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 希望我没有扫了你的兴！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you understand what I mean now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在你明白我的意思了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Do you have a moment? I'm a bit upset about something and I could use a friendly ear. Or maybe a bit of a telling off. I'm not sure yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 你有时间吗？我有点不开心，希望有人能友善地听我说说话。或者，可以稍微责备一下。我还不确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thanks, mate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 谢谢，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Thanks, love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 亲爱的，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Am I a minefield?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我是个雷区吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Because Kaya says I am. And I had one of those ‘oh shit' moments when you look back on all the conversations you've had with someone and you suddenly see yourself in a new light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 因为卡娅这么说我。当我回想起和某人的所有对话时，我有一种"哦，糟糕！"的感觉，然后突然对自己有了新的认识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Yes. She just dropped it into the middle of a chat we were having. 'You're cool but you're a minefield. I never know how you're going to react to anything.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 是的。她在我们聊天的时候突然说了这句话。"你很酷，但你就像个雷区。我永远不知道你会对什么事情有什么反应。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Glad to hear it. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 很高兴你这么说。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Teenagers, eh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 青少年，诶？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right now I feel like logging the hell off and never using KIM again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 现在我就想退出，以后再也不用即时通了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ok. Ok. Hear me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 好的。好的。听我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So bear this in mind:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 牢记这一点：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I'm telepathic. Didn't ask to be. But I am. I pick up on thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我有心灵感应。虽然我没要求过。但我的确有。我能感知别人的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: If we're talking face to face then I have all sorts of cues that tell me what you're feeling
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我们面对面说话，我就会对你的感受有各种各样的线索

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: expression, body language, and hey sometimes an actual THOUGHT because, like I said, TELEPATH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 表情、肢体语言，嘿，有时候甚至是实际的想法，因为，就像我说的，心灵感应

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: but here on KIM I have to guess and there are no clues
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 但在即时通上，我只能猜，而且没有任何线索

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: and so yes, I kneejerk sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 所以是的，我有时候会有下意识的反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Right. So.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 对。所以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (deep breath, sit up straight, get it together Eleanor)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （深呼吸，坐直，振作起来，埃莉诺）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I will try my best not to be a minefield in future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会尽力，以后不再成为雷区。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: And I'll have a look back through our old chats and have a good long think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我会回顾我们以前的聊天记录，然后好好想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I owe you that. Because minefield or not, you're still here. You kept walking. x
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我欠你的。因为不管是不是雷区，你都在这里。你一直在前行。x

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: So what's a 'Mara Lohk' when it's at home, as my mum would have put it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 那么，用我妈妈的话来说，所谓的"Mara Lohk"到底是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Ah. Because I hear it in my head sometimes, very faintly, when I look at you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 啊。我问这个是因为当我有时看着你的时候，我隐隐约约会在脑海里听到它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (Along with other things like 'damn, they're cool' and 'that's my mate, that is'.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （还有其他一些比如"天啊，他们真酷"和"那是我伙计，没错"之类的话。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: (Along with other things like 'phwoar' and 'bloody hell' and 'that's MY Drifter, that is.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: （还有其他一些比如""哗嗷"、"天啊"和"那是我的漂泊者，没错。"之类的话。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Are there any words in this language that you DO know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这个语言里有没有你认识的词？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Good luck making a fridge magnet poem with those
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 祝你好运，用这些东西制作一个冰箱磁铁诗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Hang on. If 'Lohk' is Void, then a Mara Lohk is a Something Void. Or a Void Something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等待。如果"Lohk"是虚空，那么"Mara Lohk"就是某种虚空。或者虚空之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Void Mare? Nightmare? Void devil?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 虚空梦魇？噩梦？虚空恶魔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Is this the moment when I look over my shoulder and see a black-eyed Eleanor grinning back at me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 这是不是就是我回头一看，有个黑眼睛的埃莉诺正冲我咧嘴笑的时刻？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Don't be surprised if I come back and nag you about this more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 如果我回来再跟你唠叨这件事，你可别惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I think I'll take a little look just to be sure....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我觉得我还是看看吧，以防万一……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: OMFL
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 噢我的天啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Can't help prying. It's the journalist in me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 忍不住想打听一下。这大概就是我记者的本性吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: Spider
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 蜘蛛

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: I was all set to joke with you about how there was sod all there but there was a bastard great spider dangling from the ceiling
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 我本打算开玩笑说什么都没有，结果天花板上却挂着一只该死的大蜘蛛

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.text: talk later, need to get a glass and a bit of card
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/EleanorRoman.zhText: 等会儿再聊，我得去拿个杯子和一些卡片

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey Flare, doing anything cool for your birthday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿！弗莱尔，在生日这天有没有什么计划？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Happy Birthday, Flare! Must be a quiet one without your band around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 生日快乐，弗莱尔！身边没有乐队成员一定很寂寞吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Happy Birthday, Flare! How about a few rounds of pinball in the arcade?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 生日快乐，弗莱尔！去游戏机上玩几轮弹球怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey Lizzie, eat anything cool for your birthday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿！丽兹，在生日这天有没有吃什么好东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey Lizzie! Happy Bir-- wait. Do you even *have* a birthday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿！丽兹！生日快——等等。你真的有生日吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What do you like to do for your birthday, Flare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，你生日这天想做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Do they sing birthday songs in this era?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个时代人们会唱生日歌吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So... how old *are* you anyway, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那么……丽兹，你到底*多大了*？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Happy Birthday, you bizarre, Infested, horrifying, nightmare-inducing musical instrument.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 生日快乐，你这个让人做噩梦，又奇怪又可怕的感染乐器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey Flare, first drinks are on me at the bar. Happy Birthday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿弗莱尔，酒吧里的第一杯我请。生日快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey Lizzie, it's Flare's birthday. Maybe you could leave them alone today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿丽兹，今天是弗莱尔的生日。也许你今天可以让他独处一下？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I made you a birthday cake. It's in the dumpster. Actually, it *is* the dumpster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我给你做了个生日蛋糕。它在垃圾箱里。严格来说，垃圾箱*就是*那个蛋糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Oh, hi. Flare, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 噢，嘿。你是弗莱尔，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Have you come to tap on the glass of the zoo?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你当这是逛动物园呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How can I help you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有什么我能帮你的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey. What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿。怎么了？
