/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Could be worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，但总有更糟的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Just something you learn to live with over time, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 随着时间的推移，你会慢慢学会适应的，大概吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Nope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对的，不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lol. Well, at least we can skip the introductory stuff.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈哈。好吧，至少我们可以跳过自我介绍的部分了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm not sure I like your attitude?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你就这种态度吗？我好像不太喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Uh... That's going to take a while, and I don't think it's going to give you the answers you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呃……从头讲要花很长时间，而且我不认为你会听到想要的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Whoa, hold on. Back up. Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哇噢，等一下。等一下。你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yep. That'd be Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 没错。肯定是昆西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What you're going through is no different than what the Hex went through. You're not alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你经历的和六人组经历的没什么不同。你不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I understand what you're going through. I can help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我懂得你的感受。我可以帮你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'd say I can't imagine there'd be two of me around here, but. Well. Long story. Anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我得说，我无法想象会有两个我在这里。但。好吧。说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I know what's happened is terrifying - becoming a protoframe, the situation here in Höllvania -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道现在发生的事情很可怕——变成原型战甲，还有霍瓦尼亚这里的情况——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I meant that there are worse things in the world than being seen as a freak. Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我的意思是，世界上还有比被视为怪胎更糟糕的事情。哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who's "her?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: "她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're going to be okay. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你会没事的。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Suit yourself. I'll be here when you want to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 随你便吧。你想聊的时时候再来找我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Then help me understand, Flare. Talk to me. What's going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那就帮我弄明白，弗莱尔。跟我说说。发生了什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Depends on what they've been saying. But probably.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这要看他们都说了些什么。但很有可能是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who's "she?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: "她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Nothing better to do, so you decided to come tap on the glass of the zoo. Nice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 无事可做，你当这是在逛动物园呢。好家伙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Really? Nothing better to do? I'm flattered. lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 真的吗？无事可做？我真是受宠若惊。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If you'd like to ask questions, I'm here. Ask away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你有想问的，我就在这里。问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Never mind, continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别管了，继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I heard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我听说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What happened...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 发生了什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What did you do next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 然后你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I hate that people like that exist in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我讨厌世界上存在这样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm so, so sorry, Flare...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我非常非常抱歉，弗莱尔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I wish I could do something to change it, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望能做点什么改变情况，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'd rather it happen without senseless slaughter, but yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我其实宁愿无谓的屠杀不要发生，不过是的，我明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I do, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对，我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It seems to be different for Warframes and Protoframes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对于战甲和原型战甲好像不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I honestly don't know. I could only make a guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 说实话我不知道。我只能猜测。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: "Just in case" what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: "以防"什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So, I think for Warframes, they subsumed the full personality, sans bits and pieces. Here and there. But the strains that Entrati is using to make Protoframes come *from* those Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以，我认为对于普通战甲而言，它们吸取了完整的个性，除了一些零零碎碎的。但英择谛用来制造原型战甲的毒株*取自*这些普通战甲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: All right...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No, Flare. Something is going on. Tell me what. Why do I need to hurry? "Just in case" what?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，弗莱尔。你有事瞒着我。告诉我。我为什么要快点？"以防"什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So you're a mix of both yourself and those original Warframes the strain is coming from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以，你成了你自己的和这个毒株来源的战甲的混合体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Here's this she again. Who's "she?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 又是这个"她"。"她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Wait. What? She? Who's "she?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 等等。什么？她？"她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: About yesterday...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对了昨天……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare? You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔？你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can we talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们可以聊聊吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: That's fine. Can I ask what brought you to Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 没问题。我可以问一下你来霍瓦尼亚的原因吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Okay, but... you said "she'll" kill you. That sounded really serious. Who's "she?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，但是……你之前说"她"会杀了你。听起来很严重。"她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Okay, but you seemed pretty upset. I don't think it's something we should leave alone... What's going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，但你看上去很难过。我觉得这事不能就这么算了……发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Ooof.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 靠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You caught techrot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你感染了科腐者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是英择谛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Let me guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我猜猜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Then what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Void's a helluva drug.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虚空可是猛药。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You mean instruments?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是指玩乐器？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Games?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 玩游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How's it going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sugar? That's new.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 甜甜？挺新鲜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... wouldn't call it playing. I try, but I'm not very good at it. It's called a shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不敢说会玩。我试过，但不太擅长。我们管它叫三线琴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I do. It's called a shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我会。我们有个叫三线琴的乐器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 老实说，不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Last I checked, I was here saving people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 据我所知，我可是一直在这里救人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm sorry? What did I do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 抱歉？我做了啥？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm not liking where this is going. I'm ending this now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不喜欢这个话题。到此为止吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Um... is everything okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 额……一切都还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I never said you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我可从来没说过你需要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who are you talking about when you say "we?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当你提到"我们"的时候，你是在说谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've heard it's "like a guitar."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我听说它"像一把吉他"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Stringed. Three, to be exact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是弦乐器。确切的说，它有三根弦。
好吧……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare, seriously, what's going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，跟我老实说，这到底是怎么一回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I probably have a spare shawzin kicking around if you want one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你想要的话，我这儿应该有一把多余的三线琴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I just learned electric guitars exist, hearing them mixed with a shawzin will be wild.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我才刚得知有电吉他这种东西存在，它跟三线琴一起弹，听起来肯定特别酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare, seriously, what's going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，跟我老实说，这到底是怎么一回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The villain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 反派。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The hero.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 英雄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've already lived through one storybook. I'm not interested in another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我已经体验过了一整本故事书。不想再来一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... um... Okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……呃……好吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who are you talking about...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你说的是谁……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... um... Okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……呃……好吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who are you talking about...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你说的是谁……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Vent away. We've all lost people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 尽管倾诉吧。我们都失去过所爱的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't mind. Have you talked to Eleanor? I've heard worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不介意。你跟埃莉诺谈过吗？更糟糕的事我都听过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Again with "she."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 又提到"她"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If it's the tongue thing or the telepathy thing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果是因为她的舌头或者心灵感应的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 为什么没有？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Eleanor's lovely. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 埃莉诺人很好的。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Okay. If you're not comfortable talking, I'll wait until you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧。如果你现在不愿意说，我会等你愿意的时候再谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare, seriously. I can tell something's wrong. You can talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，说真的。我能看出你有心事。你可以跟我说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare, whatever's going on, please. Stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，无论你有什么事，拜托你先停一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can... we talk about our conversation yesterday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们能……聊聊昨天的话题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: That's a question with a weird answer, but I'll do my best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个问题的答案很奇怪，不过我会尽力回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The last time we talked about this, you kinda freaked out. Are we going to be okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 上次我们聊到这事时，你快吓疯了。现在还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Because I'm getting sick of this shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为我快要被这些破事烦死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Whatever's wrong, I can help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管发生什么事，我都能帮你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How's it going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sugar? That's new.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 甜甜？挺新鲜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I wish we knew. We've tried to find answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们也想知道。我们一直在努力搞清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I never said you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我可从来没说过你需要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who are you talking about when you say "we?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当你提到"我们"的时候，你是在说谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Um. Pretty sure we did, but maybe I'm wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。我们真聊了，但也可能我记错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Uh... Yeah, we did. Check your chat logs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 额……不对，我们聊了。看看你的聊天记录。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Last I checked, I was here saving people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 据我所知，我可是一直在这里救人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm sorry? What did I do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 抱歉？我做了啥？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare...? You all right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔……？你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Um... is everything okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 额……一切都还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We didn't talk yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们昨天没有聊天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 可是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How can I help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我能怎么帮你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I get it. Not a problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我明白。没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Well... the Orokin didn't *just* use the Infestation to make Warframes, they used it to make a bunch of other weaponry, too-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯……奥罗金*不仅*用感染者制造战甲，他们还用它来制造许多其他武器

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Basically sums it up, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 简单来说，是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The villain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 反派。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The hero.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 英雄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've already lived through one storybook. I'm not interested in another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我已经体验过了一整本故事书。不想再来一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We know that it was a really effective weapon against the Sentients. But unfortunately, it tends to drive whatever biological life form it takes over insane over time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们知道它是对付 Sentient 的有效武器。但不幸的是，随着时间的推移，它会让它的宿主疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We know it can communicate with other infested life forms as sort of a weird hive-mind type thing, but within certain strains. It's not very well understood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们知道它可以与其他被感染的生物进行交流，就像一种奇怪的蜂巢思维，但仅限于某些种类。我们还不是很清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... um... Okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……呃……好吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who are you talking about...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你说的是谁……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... um... Okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……呃……好吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who are you talking about...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你说的是谁……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How'd you wind up in this mess in the first place, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你当初是怎么卷入这场风波的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How do we... not... talk about what's going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们该怎么……装作……什么都没发生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How're you settling in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你适应得怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What do you think about the rest of the protoframes so far?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 目前为止，你对其他原型战甲有什么看法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So just... "la la la it's not there?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以就只是……"啦啦啦啥也没发生？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You really just want to pretend?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你真的想装作什么都不知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... Painfully?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……是不是很痛苦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lol. What's that supposed to mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈哈。那是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Look around. Höllvania was pretty messed up before you arrived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 看看周围。在你到来之前，霍瓦尼亚就已经一团糟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The brick didn't ask to get chucked, now did it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那块砖头又不是自找的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've got it on good authority that Arthur can sing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我有充分证据证明亚瑟会唱歌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I know Aoi would join you in a *heartbeat.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道碧会*立刻*加入你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I...wish you the absolute best of luck with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我......祝你在这事上一切顺利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Oh, Void. I'm picturing them all in a band. I think I'm going to die laughing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我的虚空老天爷啊。我在想象他们组成一个乐队的样子。我觉得我快要笑死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Whoa, calm down for a second. What're you talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哇哦，冷静一下。你在说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Okay, Flare. You're scaring me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，弗莱尔。你吓到我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Am I supposed to just keep ignoring this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 难道你要我无视这些话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Ooof.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 靠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You caught techrot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你感染了科腐者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 英择谛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Let me guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我猜猜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is this like a... multiple personality thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这是类似于……多重人格吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Then what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Void's a helluva drug.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虚空可是猛药。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Never mind, continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别管了，继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I heard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我听说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What happened...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 发生了什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is this like a... multiple personality thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这是类似于……多重人格吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who's... there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……谁啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare. Definitely Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是弗莱尔。绝对是弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm so confused.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我好困惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie. Definitely Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是丽兹。绝对是丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hello, Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你好，丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Nope. Talk to me when Flare is back. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别了。等弗莱尔回来再跟我聊吧。我撤了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No. The Infestation is a necessary evil, nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不爱。感染者只是必要之恶，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes. The Infestation is a part of all my Warframes. So... I suppose I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱。我战甲中一部分都是感染者。所以……我想是的，我爱你们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Maybe. The Infestation is a part of my life, but I don't know if I can trust it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许吧。感染者是我生命的一部分，但我不知道是否可以信任它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Really? The hordes of techrot and Infested that are always trying to kill me say otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是吗？那些总想置我于死地的科腐者和感染者可不是这么想的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Just when I thought this couldn't get any weirder...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我还以为事情无法变得更诡异了呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're the Helminth?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是 Helminth？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What do you mean "have" them? Like the madness takes the other Warframes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你所说的"带走"他是什么意思？就像疯狂会吞噬其他战甲那样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Not without them being on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这要他同意才行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... I can't. I'm sorry. I can't let you "have" Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……做不到。对不起。我不能让你"带走"弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If you plan to make them go mad like you do other Warframes...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你难不成想让他像在你手里的其他战甲那样疯掉吗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't know. Eating their soul seems pretty harmful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不确定。吃掉他的灵魂听起来似乎相当不妙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Fine...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... don't know... I'll think about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不知道……我会考虑的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'll talk to Flare...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我会和弗莱尔谈谈……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那个……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Where in the hell do I even start?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我该从哪开始呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Um. Hi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。嗨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Are you all right? Seriously?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你还好吗？真的好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She scared the *absolute shit* out of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她简直要把我*吓死*了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It's okay. It's... complicated, I imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 没事。我猜这事……挺复杂的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How can I be sure of that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我要怎么确定你是呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Not really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不太知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah. I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I can't say that I do, but I can still empathize...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不敢说我知道，但我还是能理解的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't even know if I have a way to describe it. But I understand. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我甚至不知道该如何描述它。但我理解。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sometimes I wake up and I feel like there's another me living in a stranger's skin. That I don't match what's on the surface. Like I'm a lie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有时候我醒来，感觉有另一个我活在一个陌生人的皮囊下。感觉表面的我与真实的我不相符。就像我是一个谎言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Some days I wake up and I'm in just such pain I want to crawl into a hole and just wish the day away. Try again tomorrow. But I know it'll always come back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有时候我一醒来就痛不欲生，只想钻进一个洞里，希望这一天快点过去。等明天再试一次。但我知道这种痛会一直回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No. That's not it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不。我指的不是这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah. That's it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对，正是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can you tell me how this all started? How'd you wind up with Lizzie in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你能告诉我这一切是怎么开始的吗？你最初是怎么遇到丽兹的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Why do you think Lizzie is trying to destroy you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你为什么觉得丽兹想要毁掉你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah, I don't blame you. I don't think she's... exactly benign, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的，我理解你的感受。我也不认为她……完全是无害的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Why not just throw her off a bridge?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 干嘛不直接甩掉她？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Maybe? Or maybe it's just... a symbiotic creature you're fighting against?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许吧？又或者……你其实是在对抗一个共生生物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 靠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Oh...
All right. I'll see what I can think up. Maybe there's some way to split you two apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧。我会看看能不能想出办法。也许有办法把你们分开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Or maybe this is meant to be. Maybe you have to come to an agreement with her. Or...peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 或者也许这就是命中注定的。也许你得和她达成协议。或者……和解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Questions from you make me nervous...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你的问题让我感到紧张……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Uh... Hello, Lizzie. What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呃……丽兹，哈喽。什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If it was like the *last* time you asked me a question, I think I'm good...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果这次跟你*上次*问我的问题一样，那我还是算了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Are you trying to subsume Flare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是想吸取弗莱尔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Why does Flare think you want to hurt them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 为什么弗莱尔会认为你想伤害他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It seems like the right thing to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这样做看上去是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're a dangerous monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是个危险的怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It isn't personal, Lizzie. Flare doesn't want you around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹，这并不是个人恩怨。弗莱尔不想让你留在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm hopeful that this is all a big misunderstanding. So...no. At least, not yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望这一切只是一场大误会。所以……不会。至少现在不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare seems terrified of you. They think you're out to hurt them. So...yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔似乎很怕你。他认为你想要伤害他。所以……我会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What am I supposed to do? Let you subsume Flare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那我该怎么办？让你吸取弗莱尔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm not going to argue with you. I'll find a way to save Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不会跟你争论。我会找到救弗莱尔的办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You aren't *right.* And if you're trying to hurt Flare, I won't let you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你说得不对。如果你打算伤害弗莱尔，我不会坐视不管。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No wonder "Infested madness" is a thing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 难怪会有"感染者疯狂"……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sounds like a headache.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 听起来头大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I do what I have to do. Because if I don't, things will get *worse.* Flare wants you gone, simple as that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我只是做我必须做的事。因为如果我不这样做，事情会变得更糟。弗莱尔希望你离开，就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I never said I was a good person, Lizzie. I don't pretend to be. But I try to *help* people in whatever way I can, whenever I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹，我从未说过我是个好人。我也不假装自己是。但无论何时，我都会尽我所能，尽可能地帮助人们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Let me go do the math and get right back to you. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我先算一算，然后再回复你。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Because what's the other option? Let you subsume them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为还有什么选择呢？让你吸取他吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Because if you're trying to hurt them, I won't let you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为如果你打算伤害他，我不会坐视不管。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And if Flare needs my help? I'm going to help them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果弗莱尔需要我的帮助？我会帮助他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But what does "acceptance" look like? What happens to them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但"接受"具体是什么样的？他会怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Why do you keep threatening them, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那你为什么一直威胁他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No wonder "Infested madness" is a thing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 难怪会有"感染者疯狂"……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sounds like a headache.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 听起来头大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't trust you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不相信你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How do I know if I can trust you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我怎么知道我能不能信任你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... okay. I'll see if I can change Flare's mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……好吧。我会看能不能改变弗莱尔的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... okay. I'll talk to Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……好吧。我会和弗莱尔谈谈的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I can't take the risk. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不能冒这个险。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And we're off to a great start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们真是开了个好头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Flare... rough day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，弗莱尔……今天过得不顺吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Don't start thinking like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别这么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What's "bacon?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: "培根" 是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: At least it wasn't square...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 至少它不是方形的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Oh Void
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦虚空

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It doesn't sound that bad, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 其实听起来还不赖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Long story. Ask Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 说来话长。问亚瑟吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: At least you're a protoframe now? That shouldn't cause *too* much damage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 至少你现在算是个原型战甲了吧？这应该不会对身体造成太大的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Okay, that's... I know that's terrible, but that's also kind of funny.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，这……我知道这很糟，但也有点搞笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We could try setting her on fire?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们可以试试把她烧了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're kind of a unique situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你这情况还真是特殊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The thing is... I don't really know how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 关键是……我真的不知道该怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think getting rid of her is the wrong way to go, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 老实说，我觉得摆脱她是错误的做法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've been scratching my head trying to come up with a way, and, well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我一直在绞尽脑汁想出一个办法，好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I was talking to Lizzie, and, well, I think we should try to work with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我刚和丽兹谈过了，嗯，我觉得我们应该试着和她合作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can we take a second to examine the situation?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们可以先花点时间来分析一下这个情况吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've been thinking about it, and... I think we should talk this through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我一直在思考这个问题，而且……我觉得我们应该好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: There's the Entrati family, but... I'm pretty sure that, one, a protoframe is out of their realm of expertise, and two -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 英择谛家族吧，只不过……我很确定，第一，原型战甲超出了他们的专业范围，第二——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Entrati would have been our best bet. But he's gone somewhere I can't follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 英择谛本来是我们最好的选择。但他去了一个我无法跟去的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: while our sample size is limited, you've got an interesting situation even as protoframes go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然我们的样本很有限，你的情况在原型战甲里也算特别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And I have no way of getting ahold of him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我也没办法联系到他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She said she's not trying to hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她说她并不是想伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: When did Lizzie first show up? Was she there from the beginning of your transformation?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹是从什么时候开始出现的？她是从你开始变化的时候就在了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie was created when you bled on your guitar, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹是你在吉他上滴血时产生的，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So. The Infestation is... complicated. Nobody really knows where it came from or how it works.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这么说吧。感染者……很复杂。没有人真正知道它的来源或它是怎么运作的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: There's a way. There's always a way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有办法的。总会有办法的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I never said that. I'm going to help you. Somehow. I just need more time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我可没这么说过。我会帮你的。总会有办法的。我只是需要更多时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't see another way forward. But I won't force you to do anything you don't want to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我看不到其他的出路。但我不会强迫你做你不愿意做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I do. She says the Infestation isn't capable of lying, and I've never known it to, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我信。她说感染者不会撒谎，而且我也从未看到过它们撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You made her. You're responsible for her existence. So you have to take accountability for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是你创造了她。你要对她的存在负责。所以你必须承担这个责任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: When the Warframe transformation begins... it can only work with what's already there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当战甲的转化过程开始时……它只能利用现有的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm saying the situation is also complicated and we should take a step back and think about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我是说这个情况也很复杂，我们应该退一步来思考一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No, I'm saying that we might have to try diplomacy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，我是说我们可能需要尝试一下达成和解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm not on anybody's side, I'm trying to fix this situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我并没有站在谁的一边，我只是在尽力解决这个情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm on your side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我站在你这边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're right. I think you need to calm down and face facts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 没错。我觉得你需要冷静下来，面对现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It takes whatever was the base material and changes it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 它会利用原有的材料并加以改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Not... really, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 没有……还真的，没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Does the Helminth count?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: Helminth 算吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie, for better or worse... is a part of you. Just amplified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹，不管好坏……都是你的一部分。只是被放大了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: There's no getting rid of her. She's a part of you, now. So negotiation is the only way forward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 摆脱她是不可能的。她现在是你的一部分。所以协商是唯一的出路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: When did Lizzie first show up? Was she there from the beginning of your transformation?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹是从什么时候开始出现的？她是从你开始变化的时候就在了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie was created when you bled on your guitar, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹是你在吉他上滴血时产生的，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 靠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Oh...
I *know* that, I'm not stupid. But I honestly believe her when she says she's not trying to hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道这一点，我并不傻。但我真的相信她说她并不想伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Whatever. Flare, look. I don't know how to get rid of her, so we might as well just *talk* to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 随便吧。弗莱尔，看着。我不知道要怎么去摆脱她，所以我们还是跟她*谈谈*吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Well, I've been thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，我一直觉得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It's weird, I know. Welcome to my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 挺怪的，我知道。欢迎来到我的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah. As far as I can figure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的，据我了解是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm saying she's *you.* So, she can't really want to hurt you, if you're the same person. So maybe you don't need to get rid of her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我的意思是她就是*你*。所以，如果你们是同一个人，她其实并不想伤害你。也许你并不需要摆脱她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What I'm saying is maybe you don't need to get rid of her. Maybe it's about coming to terms with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我的意思是，或许你不需要摆脱她。可能关键在于与她和解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If she's a part of yourself, which I think she is, talking to her - understanding her - might be a better solution.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果她是你的一部分，我觉得她就是，那么与她对话——理解她——可能是更好的解决方案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't know. I've never known the Infestation to lie. It's never really spoken like this at all. She says that's not what she wants. But I can't make promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道。我从未见过感染者撒谎。它之前也没有像这样说话。她说她并不想那样。但我无法保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't see another way forward, but I won't force you to do anything you don't want to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我看不到其他的出路，但我不会强迫你做你不愿意做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呃哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Seems likely?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 应该是这样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No clue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I really, really don't like where this is going, Flare... what're you talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我真的，真的不喜欢这个话题的走向，弗莱尔……你在说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If you're talking about tossing her into the Void... the answer is no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你是说要把她扔进虚空……我不同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't know what kind of presence the Infestation has in the Void, and I'm not about to make it worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道 Infestation 在虚空中是什么样的存在，而我也不想让情况变得更糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I guess that *would* teach Thrax a lesson...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想那*会*给士魂大帝一个教训……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: WHAT. NO! Absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 什么？不！绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I - how do you know about Duviri?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我——你是怎么知道双衍王境的？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What gives you the right to tell me I should let it go straight to hell?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你有什么权利告诉我，我应该让它去见鬼？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Maybe. Maybe not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许是。也许不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're oversimplifying the situation. Duviri was - and *is* - far more than just a "place."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你把情况想得过于简单了。双衍王境过去——和*现在*——都远不止是一个"地方"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You've never been there. You didn't spend centuries there. You haven't lived and died there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你从没去过那里。你没在那里呆过几个世纪。你也没在那里生活或者死过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: To cut to the chase, Flare? That place is... as much a reflection of me, as it is the storybook it's based on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 咱们开门见山吧，弗莱尔？那个地方……既是我的写照，又是它所基于的故事集的原型。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: While my feelings on it aren't exactly... rosy... I can't very well chuck the Infestation into it and walk away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然我对它的感觉并不太……美好……但我不能把 Infestation 扔进去然后就走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And as much as sometimes I like to go back there and repeatedly punch people in the face... It's not my garbage disposal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 尽管有时候我喜欢回到那里一拳又一拳地打人脸......但那里不是我的垃圾桶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Whether I like it or not... I'm somehow, stupidly, the person responsible for that place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管我喜不喜欢......不知怎的，我竟愚蠢地成为了那个地方的负责人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I have just as many pleasant memories of it as I have painful ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我对此有多少痛苦的回忆，就有多少快乐的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So it's not your garbage disposal, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以它也不是你的垃圾处理场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So I have to be there to protect it when it's in danger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以当它有危险的时候，我必须在那儿保护它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And just because I wanted to be free of it, doesn't mean I want it all to suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然我想要摆脱它，但并不意味着我希望那里的一切都遭受痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're asking me to make other people suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你这是要我让别人受苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Think about what you're asking me to do, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 想想你到底要让我做些什么，弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Would you really want to endanger a whole other world like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你真的想用那样的方式危及另一个世界吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Fine. Okay. You come to the table in good faith, and I'll... consider imprisoning her in Duviri if she's lying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧。好的。你诚心诚意地来谈判，如果她撒谎的话，我会......考虑把她关进双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Who're we to decide what's real and what isn't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们是谁，凭什么决定什么是真的，什么不是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Fine. Okay. You come to the table in good faith, and I'll... consider imprisoning her in Duviri if she's lying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧。好的。你诚心诚意地来谈判，如果她撒谎的话，我会......考虑把她关进双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Let me just... try to talk it through with Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我……试试跟丽兹聊聊这事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm starting to see why Flare thinks you're going to eat them, Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我开始明白为什么弗莱尔认为你会吃掉他了，丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So... you *do* plan to consume their consciousness?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那么……你*的确*打算吞噬他的意识？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is that your best take on "non-cosmic horror" terms?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这就是你对"非宇宙恐怖"的理解吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't think "sharing" is going to be good enough for Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我认为"分享"对于弗莱尔来说还不够好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: When you say "share" though, do you mean... "share" like you tried to "share" Eleanor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不过，当你说"分享"时，你的意思是……像你试图"分享"埃莉诺那样"分享"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't think Flare will ever want to give up their personal identity, Lizzie. But I also don't see the value in trying to kill or destroy you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我认为弗莱尔永远不会放弃自己的个人身份，丽兹。但我也看不出试图杀死或摧毁你有什么价值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You have to try to see things from Flare's perspective. They're afraid. They've lost everything. And now they're afraid they're going to lose the only thing they have left - themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你必须尝试从弗莱尔的角度看待问题。他很害怕。他失去了一切。现在他害怕失去仅存的——他自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Then back off on the whole "consuming their consciousness" thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那就别再提什么"吞噬他的意识"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You've been doing a shit job at showing them that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你一直做得不好，没能让他明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What's "sharing" to you, looks like "destruction" to us. You have to try to understand that. I know it's hard to "be small" but try. Remember what happened to Eleanor? And Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对你来说是"分享"，在我们看来是"破坏"。你得试着去理解。我知道要"低调"很难，但还是要努力尝试。还记得埃莉诺的经历吗？还有莱蒂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You have to try to see things from Flare's perspective. They're afraid. They've lost everything. And now they're afraid they're going to lose the only thing they have left - themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你必须尝试从弗莱尔的角度看待问题。他很害怕。他失去了一切。现在他害怕失去仅存的——他自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Then back off on the whole "consuming their consciousness" thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那就别再提什么"吞噬他的意识"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You've been doing a terrible job of showing them that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你做得太糟糕了，根本没让他明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've been thinking about your problem, and I think I have an idea on how to get rid of Lizzie permanently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我一直在想你的问题，我想我有个办法可以永远摆脱丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: All right. Let's work on negotiating some kind of peace, here...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，让我们努力达成某种和平吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare, are you there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I need to talk to Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我需要和丽兹谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I need to talk to Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我需要和丽兹谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We need to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们需要谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't think Lettie would appreciate if I had to sacrifice an animal...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果非要我牺牲一只动物，我想莱蒂不会喜欢的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Do I need to... draw a chalk circle on the ground or something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我是不是需要……在地上用粉笔画个圈还是什么的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't think Lettie would appreciate if I had to sacrifice an animal...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果非要我牺牲一只动物，我想莱蒂不会喜欢的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Do I need to... draw a chalk circle on the ground or something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我是不是需要……在地上用粉笔画个圈还是什么的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think we take her to the Void. Make the Indifference deal with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我们应该把她带到虚空去。让虚空无情之物来对付她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think we find a way to kill Lizzie. I've killed thousands of Infested before. One more can't be hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我们一定能找到杀死丽兹的办法。我之前已经杀过上千个 Infested 了。再多一个应该不难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare is worried that once they let you in, you're going to consume their consciousness. They'll cease to be "them."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔担心一旦他让你进入，你就会吞噬他的意识。他将不再是"他"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can you describe to me how you're going to change them, exactly, if you get what you want? In... normal, non-cosmic horror terms, I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你如愿以偿，你能具体描述一下你将如何改变他吗？我是说，用……正常的、非宇宙恐怖的术语。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ...What could possibly go wrong...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……能出什么问题呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I know you scoffed at the idea before, but I have *very* unique ways of killing things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道你之前嘲笑过这个想法，但我有*非常*独特的杀人方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've thought about your idea of trapping her in Duviri and... I think you're right. I think it'll work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我考虑过你把她困在双衍王境的想法……我觉得你是对的。我觉得这能行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Shove her into the prison cells with Kullervo. She can keep him company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 把她关进 Kullervo 的牢房。她还可以跟他做个伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Calm down! I was just trying to get Flare out of the way. I want to talk about negotiating some kind of peace between you two.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 冷静点！我只是想让弗莱尔离开。我想谈谈你们之间达成某种和平的谈判。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Because you're wrong, and they want you out of their life. So I'm going to find a way to kill you, throw you into the Void - or something. I don't care what.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为你错了，他希望你离开他的生活。所以，我要想办法杀了你，把你扔进虚空——或者别的什么。我不在乎是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I am very, *very* good at killing the unkillable. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我非常、*非常*擅长杀死那些不可杀之物。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你这话是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Eh, we've all been through a lot. You're in good company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，我们都经历了许多事情，你并不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: About Lizzie... I think I might have *really* pissed her off. :|
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 关于丽兹……我想我可能真的惹毛她了。: |

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think you have a right to be a bit messed up right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得你现在有些崩溃也很正常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm here to listen, if you want to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你想聊聊，我很乐意倾听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Not really, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 其实并不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I can empathize, but I don't really relate...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我能理解，但并不完全感同身受……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think... for one reason or another, we've all felt that way in our lives, to different extremes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我认为……出于各种原因，我们每个人在生活中都曾有过这种感受，只是程度不同而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No. It makes perfect sense to me. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，我觉得这完全说得通。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You have a new family now, in the other protoframes here. You have a place where you can be who you want to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 现在，你和其他原型战甲在这有了新的家。在这里你可以自由做自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Strangely, I wonder if Lizzie isn't trying to... help you feel like you belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 奇怪的是，我想知道丽兹是不是想……让你觉得自己属于这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Remember what I said about the Infestation and Warframes? About how it only pulls from what is already a part of you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 还记得我说的关于感染者和战甲的事情吗？关于它是如何从你身上汲取力量的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You don't have to feel lonely anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你不会再感到孤单了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Trying to "consume" your consciousness so you don't feel lonely anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 试着"吞噬"你的意识，这样你就不会再感到孤独了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're in a crowded mall surrounded by people. There's no reason to feel lonely. You can make friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你身处人潮涌动的商场，周围都是人。没有理由感到孤独。你可以交朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Making you part of one cosmic whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让你成为宇宙整体的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Adopt a kavat?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 领养一只库娃？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Well, hey, if Lizzie eats your consciousness and you join a hive mind, you won't be alone anymore, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，嘿，如果丽兹吃了你的意识，你加入了集体意识，你就不再孤单了，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Have you considered that... maybe that's what Lizzie is trying to do? To help you feel like you belong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你有没有想过……也许这就是丽兹想要做的？让你感到自己属于这里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm standing behind that joke, it was funny.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我喜欢这个笑话，很好玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sorry. Sorry. Bad joke. Arthur keeps warning me about dark humor at the wrong time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 抱歉，抱歉，糟糕的笑话。亚瑟一直警告我不要在错误的时间搞黑色幽默。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Centuries of being alone getting executed leaves you to having a broken "snark valve" as Aoi calls it since that was the only weapon I had to fight with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 几个世纪的孤独与被处决经历，让我变得像碧所说的"刻薄阀门"完全失灵——毕竟那曾是我唯一的抗争武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So, I don't really know how to turn it off when -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以我也不知道如何把它关掉——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think so. In the scariest possible way, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想是的，用最恐怖的方式，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She's part you. She can feel that pain. That yearning. I think she's trying to *fix it.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她就是你的一部分。她能感受到那种痛苦。那种渴望。我想她正在努力去*解决它。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Uh. Hi, Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呃。嗨，丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Nope. Nope, I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，别叫我，我不干了。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 怎么了，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hi, Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗨，丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Are we going to play nice today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 咱们今天可以好好相处吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can... I start by apologizing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我可以......先道个歉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I understand what you've been trying to do this whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我明白你一直以来在想要做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You've been trying, in your own screwed up Infested way, to make Flare feel less lonely, haven't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你一直在努力用你混乱的 Infested 方式，让弗莱尔感觉不那么孤独，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Are you finally ready to shut up and listen to me, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你现在终于准备好闭嘴听我说了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You're trying to think like a human when you're... really not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你在试图像人类一样思考，但其实你……并不是人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Just when I thought this couldn't get any weirder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我还以为事情无法变得更诡异了呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And I've discovered precisely where my line is, and it's right there. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我已经准确地找到了我的（底）线，就在那里。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: In retrospect, I guess it wasn't the brightest idea, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 现在想想，我觉得这并不是最明智的做法，不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Kind of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有那么一点儿？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I didn't know what else to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道还能做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No, I just... Look. I'm not used to dealing with... trying to negotiate with the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，我只是……你看，我不习惯和敌人打交道……尝试和他们谈判什么的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I believe you, and it was very kind. But I know how you can really help Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我相信你，你真的很善良。不过我知道你怎样才能真正帮到弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Right, but is there any sort of future where you *don't* act like a horrible soul-sucking monster?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好的，但有没有哪种未来是你*不会*再像个可怕的吸魂怪那样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Are you willing to give up the idea of consuming their consciousness?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那你愿意放弃吞噬他意识的想法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm used to trying to kill it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我已经习惯了试着去杀死它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm sorry what I said upset you. I was just trying to do the right thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对不起，我说的话让你不高兴了。我只是想做对的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I just want you to take it out on me, not Flare. They shouldn't suffer because I opened my big mouth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我只希望你能把气撒在我身上，而不是弗莱尔身上。他不应该因为我的胡言乱语受苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What do I need to do to get you to leave Flare alone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我要怎么做才能让你离弗莱尔远点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We aren't friends. So you don't get to joke around with me. I need you to leave Flare alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们不是朋友。所以你不要跟我开玩笑。我拜托你离弗莱尔远点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Music is their life. And you're a guitar. Maybe that's the way in - show them the kind of music you two can make together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 音乐是他的生命。而你又是把吉他。也许这就是切入点——向他展示你们俩能一起做出什么样的音乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They need someone by their side. Someone who understands them, can be their partner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他需要有人陪在身边。一个能理解他、能成为他伴侣的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Kind of like how I have the Helminth, can you just... be around? Like furniture?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你能不能……就待在附近，就像我和 Helminth 相处的那样？像件家具一样待着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I do. And I also believe you want to come to a peaceful solution here that works for both of you. Because I honestly believe you're not trying to hurt them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的。而且我也相信你想找到一个对你们俩都有利的和平解决方案。因为我真的相信你并不想伤害他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Great, now that we've gotten that out of the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好的，现在这件事我们已经说清楚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Thank you. Um. "thank You," rather.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢你。呃，我是说"谢谢你们"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Kind of like how I have the Helminth, can you just... be around? Like furniture?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你能不能……就待在附近，就像我和 Helminth 相处的那样？像件家具一样待着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They need someone by their side. Someone who understands them, can be their partner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他需要有人陪在身边。一个能理解他、能成为他伴侣的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Lizzie. You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，丽兹。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Flare. You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，弗莱尔。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Comforting. Hey, so, to do this, I think we need to have you and Flare split control.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这倒是让人安心。嘿，话说回来，我觉得需要你和弗莱尔共同控制，来做成这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... This is still so weird... Okay. Um. Do you think you can... Try to... I don't even know how to phrase this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……这还是很奇怪……好吧。嗯。你觉得你能……尝试一下……我甚至不知道该怎么表达……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm not going to be bullied around by a glorified stage prop with an attitude problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我可不会被一个态度有问题的、华而不实的舞台道具欺负。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... really don't want to do this, but... fine. I'm sorry, Lizzie. I apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……真的不想这么做，但是……好吧。对不起，丽兹。我向你道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So, I think I've figured something out with Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那个，我想我已经找到解决丽兹的办法了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, so I think I'm making progress with Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，那个，我想我在丽兹这件事上取得了一些进展

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is that even possible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这能实现吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is it possible for you to share control with Flare? I need to talk to you both at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你能和弗莱尔共享控制权吗？我需要同时和你们俩谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm trying my best with her, but she's like working with Grineer mines.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我一直在尽力跟她打交道，但这就像在操作 Grineer 地雷一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think so. I just need a little more time. She's... difficult to talk to, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想有些进展。我只是需要多一点时间。有时候，她真的……很难沟通。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think she's trying to "consume you" because she feels like you're lonely, and therefore being part of the "whole" will... I don't know, make it better?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得她想要"吞噬你"，因为她觉得你很孤独，所以成为"整体"的一部分会……我也不确定，会让一切变得更好？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I might have made a breakthrough, but I need you to trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我可能找到了一个突破口，但我需要你的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I was wondering if you'd be willing to share control with Lizzie for a little bit, so I could talk to you both at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想问问你，能不能暂时和丽兹共享一下控制权，这样我就可以同时跟你们俩聊了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Not exactly built by the smartest tools in the shed, but oh boy do they like to go boom.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 制造它们的家伙不一定是最聪明的，但天哪，一碰就炸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It makes sense in a sort of screwed up, insane, flesh-eating, cosmic horror kind of way, I suppose. She's trying to "adopt" you into the "family."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想，从一种扭曲、疯狂、肉食性恐怖存在的角度来看，这说得通。她正试图把你"收养"进"家庭"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那就算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Not really the groveling type. But I am sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我并不是那种喜欢下跪求饶的人。不过，我是真的很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I want you to share control with Lizzie, just for a few minutes, so we can all talk at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望你和丽兹共享控制权，就几分钟，这样我们可以一起谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I know this is going to sound insane. But hear me out. I need you to try to share control with Lizzie so I can talk to you both together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道这听起来很疯狂。但先听我说完。我需要你试着和丽兹共享控制权，这样我才能同时和你们两个交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've seen you two play on stage. You're amazing. What's wrong with a partnership like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我看过你们俩在舞台上的表演。你们真的很棒。这样的合作有什么不好？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So, I was thinking, maybe if there was a different way for you two to work together, maybe that'd solve the problem?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以，我在想，如果你们俩能找到一种不同的合作方式，也许能解决问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Maybe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I realized it was also a mistake to upset you, when I need you to *want* to make peace with Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我意识到惹你生气也是个错误，尤其是在我需要你自愿和弗莱尔和解的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I have an idea on how to get her on board, but I need her to listen to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我有个想法能让她同意，但我需要她先听我说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I'm wrapping my head around a way both of you could be happy, but I don't know if she's going to be on board yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我找到了一个能让你们俩都满意的办法，但我不确定她是否会同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I honestly believe you're not trying to hurt them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我真心认为你不是想要伤害他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They're the one who'll suffer in the end, not me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 最终受苦的是他，又不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes. ... I'm sure what I said was brilliant...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯……我敢肯定我说的话很精彩……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: For better or worse, I say a lot of things. What did I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管是好是坏，我确实说过很多话。我说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I mean it. You lost your band, and in your grief, created Lizzie. There's a reason for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我是认真的。你失去了乐队，在悲伤中创造了丽兹。这背后一定有原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦糟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I found a way forward where you two can both be happy. Truly happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我找到了一个让你们俩都幸福的办法。真正的幸福哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I talked to Lizzie and explained things from your point of view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我跟丽兹谈过了，也从你的角度向她解释了情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Everything okay, Flare...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，一切都还好吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Both works.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 都行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ¿Por qué no ambos?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ¿Por qué no ambos？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How did Lizzie get created, exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹到底是怎么被创造出来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You made Lizzie when you played music after the death of your band, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是在乐队过世后通过弹奏音乐创造了丽兹，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If you two learn to work together, instead of apart -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你们俩能学会合作，而不是各自为政——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Um.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She's a part of you. And she's only trying to answer the loneliness she feels coming from you in the only way she knows how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是你的一部分。她只是在用她唯一知道的方式来回应从你那感受到的孤独感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You need to start being more open-minded about her. It's not her fault she is the way she is, it was just how she was made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你需要开始更开放地看待她。她这样并非她的错，她就是以这个样子被造出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes. ... Exactly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……正是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: For better or worse, I say a lot of things. What did I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管是好是坏，我确实说过很多话。我说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I was *trying* to convince Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我*正尝试*说服弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She was made from all that... horror, and loneliness, and grief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是由所有那些恐怖、孤独和悲伤塑造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think so. If I can get her to come to the table in good faith, would you be willing to, also?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得会。如果我能让她真心实意地谈一谈，你也愿意尝试吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Let me see if I can get through to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我看看我能不能说服她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 随便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: LIZZIE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare. You miss your band.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔。你很想念你的乐队吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie. You want to help Flare feel whole again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。你是想帮助弗莱尔再次感到完整吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No wonder she's insane. She's a combination of all that grief *and* the Infestation?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 难怪她会这么疯狂。她不就是所有这些悲伤和感染者的集合体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What if she's trying to fix that in the only way she knows how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果她只是在尝试用她唯一知道的方式来解决问题呢？
