/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't care who I'm talking to, in the end, we both know you can *both* hear me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不管这是在和谁说话，反正，我们都知道你们*两个*都能听见我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Because I won't let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为我不会让那种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: That's the thing about trust... sometimes you just have to shut your eyes and jump.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 信任就是这么一回事……有时候你只能闭上眼跳下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Here's all I'm trying to say:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想说的是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Learning to work together means nobody can ever hurt *either of* you again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 学会合作意味着再也没有人能伤害你们中的*任何*一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You *both* love music more than anything else. Together, you have a voice like nothing else in the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你们俩都热爱音乐胜过一切。你们在一起时，你们的声音在这世上无与伦比。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But there is another way that Lizzie can help you feel whole again. Right, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是丽兹还可以通过另一种方式帮你再次感到完整。对吧，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But now Lizzie understands why you don't want to give yourself up. Don't you, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是现在丽兹明白了你为什么不想放弃自我了。对吧，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But there's another way you can help Flare feel whole again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是还有另一个办法可以帮助弗莱尔再次感到完整。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But you understand why Flare doesn't want to give themselves up, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你明白为什么弗莱尔不想放弃自我，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Great, now that we've gotten that out of the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好的，现在这件事我们已经说清楚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Thank you. Um. "thank You," rather.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢你。呃，我是说"谢谢你们"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Music is their life. And you're a guitar. Maybe that's the way in - show them the kind of music you two can make together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 音乐是他的生命。而你是把吉他。也许这就是切入点——向他展示你们俩能一起创造出什么样的音乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They need someone by their side. Someone who understands them, can be their partner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他需要有人陪在身边。一个能理解他、能成为他伴侣的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: One: Lizzie, stop making Flare eat weird shit. Two: You should see the things I have to feed the Helminth, Flare. She's right, it could be worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 第一：丽兹，别再让弗莱尔吃奇怪的东西了。第二：弗莱尔，你应该看看我给 Helminth 喂的是什么。她说得对，说不定会有更糟的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The answer is right in front of you. Look at what she is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 答案就在你面前。想想看她是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She's *your music,* isn't she?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是*你的音乐*，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You made Lizzie whether or not you meant to. She was part of your subconscious mixed with the Infestation mixed with a guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管你是否有意，你创造了丽兹。她是你的潜意识、感染者和吉他的混合体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Viktor took your friends away. Took your voice away. Took your only ability to express yourself and smashed it all to pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 维克多夺走了你的朋友，夺走了你的声音，夺走了你表达自己的唯一方式，把一切都打碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But you're still getting on that stage with her, again and again. Fighting Viktor, refusing to stop trying to get your message out there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你还是一次又一次地和她一起登上那个舞台。反抗维克多，不放弃传递你的信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And you're doing it with *her* in your hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你可是和*她一起*来实现这一切的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie. You don't need to consume them. Flare. You don't need to fight her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。你不需要吞噬它们。弗莱尔。你不需要抵抗她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Draw the lines between yourselves wherever you need to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在需要的地方给你们自己设定界限。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But together, through the music you make, you're one whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但通过你们共同创造的音乐，你们成为了一个整体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Listen to your instincts, Flare. What's your heart telling you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，跟随你的直觉。你的内心在告诉你什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It's okay, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Here's an idea on how to work things out with Lizzie. Let me know what you think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想到一个或许能搞定丽兹的办法。你看怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I have an idea on how to work things out with Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我有个想法能让她同意，但我需要丽兹先听我说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Lizzie. You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，丽兹。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Flare. You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，弗莱尔。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is this a good or a bad thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这是好事还是坏事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很抱歉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think she's trying to "consume you" because she feels like you're lonely, and therefore being part of the "whole" will... I don't know, make it better?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得她想要"吞噬你"，因为她觉得你很孤独，所以成为"整体"的一部分会……我也不确定，会让一切变得更好？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It makes sense in a sort of screwed up, insane, flesh-eating, cosmic horror kind of way, I suppose. She's trying to "adopt" you into the "family."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想，从一种扭曲、疯狂、肉食性恐怖存在的角度来看，这说得通。她正试图把你"收养"进"家庭"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Comforting. Hey, so, to do this, I think we need to have you and Flare split control.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这倒是让人安心。嘿，话说回来，我觉得需要你和弗莱尔共同控制，来做成这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... This is still so weird... Okay. Um. Do you think you can... Try to... I don't even know how to phrase this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……这还是很奇怪……好吧。嗯。你觉得你能……尝试一下……我甚至不知道该怎么表达……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is that even possible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这能实现吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is it possible for you to share control with Flare? I need to talk to you both at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你能和弗莱尔共享控制权吗？我需要同时和你们俩谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I've seen you two play on stage. You're amazing. What's wrong with a partnership like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我看过你们俩在舞台上的表演。你们真的很棒。这样的合作有什么不好？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So, I was thinking, maybe if there was a different way for you two to work together, maybe that'd solve the problem?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以，我在想，如果你们俩能找到一种不同的合作方式，也许能解决问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I might have made a breakthrough, but I need you to trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我可能找到了一个突破口，但我需要你的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I was wondering if you'd be willing to share control with Lizzie for a little bit, so I could talk to you both at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想问问你，能不能暂时和丽兹共享一下控制权，这样我就可以同时跟你们俩聊了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is the song going to be for them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这首歌是为他们写的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What's the song about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这首歌是关于什么的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I mean it. You lost your band, and in your grief, created Lizzie. There's a reason for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我是认真的。你失去了乐队，在悲伤中创造了丽兹。这背后一定有原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I want you to share control with Lizzie, just for a few minutes, so we can all talk at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望你和丽兹共享控制权，就几分钟，这样我们可以一起谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I know this is going to sound insane. But hear me out. I need you to try to share control with Lizzie so I can talk to you both together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道这听起来很疯狂。但先听我说完。我需要你试着和丽兹共享控制权，这样我才能同时和你们两个交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Everything okay, Flare...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，一切都还好吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: If you two learn to work together, instead of apart -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你们俩能学会合作，而不是各自为政——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Um.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I was *trying* to convince Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我*正尝试*说服弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I found a way forward where you two can both be happy. Truly happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我找到了一个让你们俩都幸福的办法。真正的幸福哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I talked to Lizzie and explained things from your point of view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我跟丽兹谈过了，也从你的角度向她解释了情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'd love to see it when it's done. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 完成后一定要让我看看啊。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can you share some of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你可以给我看一部分吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 随便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: LIZZIE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I don't care who I'm talking to, in the end, we both know you can *both* hear me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不管这是在和谁说话，反正，我们都知道你们*两个*都能听见我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She's a part of you. And she's only trying to answer the loneliness she feels coming from you in the only way she knows how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是你的一部分。她只是在用她唯一知道的方式来回应从你那感受到的孤独感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You need to start being more open-minded about her. It's not her fault she is the way she is, it was just how she was made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你需要开始更开放地看待她。她这样并非她的错，她就是以这个样子被造出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes. ... Exactly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……正是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: For better or worse, I say a lot of things. What did I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管是好是坏，我确实说过很多话。我说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Here's all I'm trying to say:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想说的是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Learning to work together means nobody can ever hurt *either of* you again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 学会合作意味着再也没有人能伤害你们中的*任何*一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You *both* love music more than anything else. Together, you have a voice like nothing else in the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你们俩都热爱音乐胜过一切。你们在一起时，你们的声音在这世上无与伦比。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare. You miss your band.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔。你很想念你的乐队吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie. You want to help Flare feel whole again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。你是想帮助弗莱尔再次感到完整吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Because I won't let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为我不会让那种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: That's the thing about trust... sometimes you just have to shut your eyes and jump.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 信任就是这么一回事……有时候你只能闭上眼跳下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I keep hoping it will. I'll let you know if it does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我也一直希望它会好转。如果真的好转了，我会告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No. It never gets any easier. You just adapt to carrying the weight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不会。它永远不会变得轻松。你只是适应了承受这份重量而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah. In time. It does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 会。随着时间的推移，它会好转的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm a terrible judge of poetry, but I like it a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不擅长品评诗歌，但我非常喜欢它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I love it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很喜欢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Don't quit your day job. Oh wait. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别放弃你的本职工作。哦别走啊。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But there is another way that Lizzie can help you feel whole again. Right, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是丽兹还可以通过另一种方式帮你再次感到完整。对吧，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But now Lizzie understands why you don't want to give yourself up. Don't you, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是现在丽兹明白了你为什么不想放弃自我了。对吧，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But there's another way you can help Flare feel whole again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是还有另一个办法可以帮助弗莱尔再次感到完整。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But you understand why Flare doesn't want to give themselves up, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你明白为什么弗莱尔不想放弃自我，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sometimes, being loud is all we have left in this life. I hope they knew that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有时候，大声说出来是我们在这一生中仅剩的选择。我希望他们明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You'll drive yourself crazy if you wonder "what if" for the rest of eternity. Don't let the guilt get to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 要是你整个人生都在想"如果……"，你会让自己疯掉的。不要让内疚感影响你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: One: Lizzie, stop making Flare eat weird shit. Two: You should see the things I have to feed the Helminth, Flare. She's right, it could be worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 第一：丽兹，别再让弗莱尔吃奇怪的东西了。第二：弗莱尔，你应该看看我给 Helminth 喂的是什么。她说得对，说不定会有更糟的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Viktor is to blame. Not you. Not them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 都是维克多的错。不是你，也不是他们的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The answer is right in front of you. Look at what she is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 答案就在你面前。想想看她是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She's *your music,* isn't she?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是*你的音乐*，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You made Lizzie whether or not you meant to. She was part of your subconscious mixed with the Infestation mixed with a guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管你是否有意，你创造了丽兹。她是你的潜意识、感染者和吉他的混合体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Viktor took your friends away. Took your voice away. Took your only ability to express yourself and smashed it all to pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 维克多夺走了你的朋友，夺走了你的声音，夺走了你表达自己的唯一方式，把一切都打碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But you're still getting on that stage with her, again and again. Fighting Viktor, refusing to stop trying to get your message out there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你还是一次又一次地和她一起登上那个舞台。反抗维克多，不放弃传递你的信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And you're doing it with *her* in your hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你可是和*她一起*来实现这一切的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie. You don't need to consume them. Flare. You don't need to fight her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。你不需要吞噬它们。弗莱尔。你不需要抵抗她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Draw the lines between yourselves wherever you need to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在需要的地方给你们自己设定界限。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But together, through the music you make, you're one whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但通过你们共同创造的音乐，你们成为了一个整体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Listen to your instincts, Flare. What's your heart telling you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，跟随你的直觉。你的内心在告诉你什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It's okay, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Lizzie. You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，丽兹。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hey, Flare. You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，弗莱尔。你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How can I help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我能帮上什么忙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hi Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗨，丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is this a good or a bad thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这是好事还是坏事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很抱歉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Comforting. Hey, so, to do this, I think we need to have you and Flare split control.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这倒是让人安心。嘿，话说回来，我觉得需要你和弗莱尔共同控制，来做成这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... This is still so weird... Okay. Um. Do you think you can... Try to... I don't even know how to phrase this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……这还是很奇怪……好吧。嗯。你觉得你能……尝试一下……我甚至不知道该怎么表达……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is that even possible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这能实现吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is it possible for you to share control with Flare? I need to talk to you both at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你能和弗莱尔共享控制权吗？我需要同时和你们俩谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The least I can do for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 最起码我还可以这样帮到你们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Oh, I am *dying* to see this. Yes. Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦，我真的*很想*看看这个。当然。拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I might have made a breakthrough, but I need you to trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我可能找到了一个突破口，但我需要你的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I was wondering if you'd be willing to share control with Lizzie for a little bit, so I could talk to you both at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想问问你，能不能暂时和丽兹共享一下控制权，这样我就可以同时跟你们俩聊了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is the song going to be for them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这首歌是为他们写的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What's the song about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这首歌是关于什么的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I want you to share control with Lizzie, just for a few minutes, so we can all talk at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望你和丽兹共享控制权，就几分钟，这样我们可以一起谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I know this is going to sound insane. But hear me out. I need you to try to share control with Lizzie so I can talk to you both together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道这听起来很疯狂。但先听我说完。我需要你试着和丽兹共享控制权，这样我才能同时和你们两个交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Brilliant. No notes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 太棒了。我没有任何建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... well... um...
I think I found a way forward where you two can both be happy. Truly happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我找到了一个让你们俩都幸福的办法。真正的幸福哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I talked to Lizzie and explained things from your point of view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我跟丽兹谈过了，也从你的角度向她解释了情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Holy shit. Lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 天哪。哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Nah... it'll be *fine.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不……这样*还好*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Maybe that's a... bit much?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这可能……有点太过了吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'd love to see it when it's done. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 完成后一定要让我看看啊。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can you share some of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你可以给我看一部分吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She's a part of you. And she's only trying to answer the loneliness she feels coming from you in the only way she knows how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是你的一部分。她只是在用她唯一知道的方式来回应从你那感受到的孤独感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You need to start being more open-minded about her. It's not her fault she is the way she is, it was just how she was made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你需要开始更开放地看待她。她这样并非她的错，她就是以这个样子被造出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes. ... Exactly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……正是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: For better or worse, I say a lot of things. What did I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管是好是坏，我确实说过很多话。我说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It was a yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对，是肯定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Dial it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，收敛一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Flare. You miss your band.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔。你很想念你的乐队吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie. You want to help Flare feel whole again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。你是想帮助弗莱尔再次感到完整吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Because I won't let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为我不会让那种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: That's the thing about trust... sometimes you just have to shut your eyes and jump.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 信任就是这么一回事……有时候你只能闭上眼跳下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I keep hoping it will. I'll let you know if it does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我也一直希望它会好转。如果真的好转了，我会告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No. It never gets any easier. You just adapt to carrying the weight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不会。它永远不会变得轻松。你只是适应了承受这份重量而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah. In time. It does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 会。随着时间的推移，它会好转的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But there is another way that Lizzie can help you feel whole again. Right, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是丽兹还可以通过另一种方式帮你再次感到完整。对吧，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But now Lizzie understands why you don't want to give yourself up. Don't you, Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是现在丽兹明白了你为什么不想放弃自我了。对吧，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But there's another way you can help Flare feel whole again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是还有另一个办法可以帮助弗莱尔再次感到完整。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But you understand why Flare doesn't want to give themselves up, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你明白为什么弗莱尔不想放弃自我，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm a terrible judge of poetry, but I like it a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不擅长品评诗歌，但我非常喜欢它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I love it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很喜欢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Don't quit your day job. Oh wait. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别放弃你的本职工作。哦别走啊。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: One: Lizzie, stop making Flare eat weird shit. Two: You should see the things I have to feed the Helminth, Flare. She's right, it could be worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 第一：丽兹，别再让弗莱尔吃奇怪的东西了。第二：弗莱尔，你应该看看我给 Helminth 喂的是什么。她说得对，说不定会有更糟的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sometimes, being loud is all we have left in this life. I hope they knew that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有时候，大声说出来是我们在这一生中仅剩的选择。我希望他们明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You'll drive yourself crazy if you wonder "what if" for the rest of eternity. Don't let the guilt get to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 要是你整个人生都在想"如果……"，你会让自己疯掉的。不要让内疚感影响你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The answer is right in front of you. Look at what she is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 答案就在你面前。想想看她是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Viktor is to blame. Not you. Not them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 都是维克多的错。不是你，也不是他们的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She's *your music,* isn't she?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是*你的音乐*，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You made Lizzie whether or not you meant to. She was part of your subconscious mixed with the Infestation mixed with a guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管你是否有意，你创造了丽兹。她是你的潜意识、感染者和吉他的混合体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Viktor took your friends away. Took your voice away. Took your only ability to express yourself and smashed it all to pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 维克多夺走了你的朋友，夺走了你的声音，夺走了你表达自己的唯一方式，把一切都打碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But you're still getting on that stage with her, again and again. Fighting Viktor, refusing to stop trying to get your message out there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你还是一次又一次地和她一起登上那个舞台。反抗维克多，不放弃传递你的信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And you're doing it with *her* in your hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你可是和*她一起*来实现这一切的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Lizzie. You don't need to consume them. Flare. You don't need to fight her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹。你不需要吞噬它们。弗莱尔。你不需要抵抗她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Draw the lines between yourselves wherever you need to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在需要的地方给你们自己设定界限。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: But together, through the music you make, you're one whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但通过你们共同创造的音乐，你们成为了一个整体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Listen to your instincts, Flare. What's your heart telling you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，跟随你的直觉。你的内心在告诉你什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It's okay, Flare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 弗莱尔，没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: How can I help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我能帮什么忙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hi Lizzie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗨，丽兹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is this a good or a bad thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这是好事还是坏事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很抱歉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The least I can do for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 最起码我还可以这样帮到你们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Oh, I am *dying* to see this. Yes. Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦，我真的*很想*看看这个。当然。拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is the song going to be for them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这首歌是为他们写的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What's the song about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这首歌是关于什么的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Brilliant. No notes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 太棒了。我没有任何建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... well... um...
Holy shit. Lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 天哪。哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Nah... it'll be *fine.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不……这样*还好*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Maybe that's a... bit much?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这可能……有点太过了吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'd love to see it when it's done. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 完成后一定要让我看看啊。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Can you share some of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你可以给我看一部分吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It was a yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对，是肯定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Dial it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，收敛一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Better than what Lizzie wrote.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 比丽兹写的更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think it's wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得这很棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I keep hoping it will. I'll let you know if it does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我也一直希望它会好转。如果真的好转了，我会告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No. It never gets any easier. You just adapt to carrying the weight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不会。它永远不会变得轻松。你只是适应了承受这份重量而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeah. In time. It does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 会。随着时间的推移，它会好转的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm a terrible judge of poetry, but I like it a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不擅长品评诗歌，但我非常喜欢它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I love it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很喜欢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Don't quit your day job. Oh wait. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别放弃你的本职工作。哦别走啊。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Sometimes, being loud is all we have left in this life. I hope they knew that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有时候，大声说出来是我们在这一生中仅剩的选择。我希望他们明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You'll drive yourself crazy if you wonder "what if" for the rest of eternity. Don't let the guilt get to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 要是你整个人生都在想"如果……"，你会让自己疯掉的。不要让内疚感影响你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Viktor is to blame. Not you. Not them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 都是维克多的错。不是你，也不是他们的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: What has her all amped up today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她今天为什么这么兴奋呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Haha, it's fine. I'm just glad to see you two getting along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈哈，没事。看到你们相处得这么好，我很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It's kind of cute, honestly. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 老实说，这挺可爱的。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I would love to!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很想听！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'm really not into poetry, sorry. I'll wait until it's set to music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 抱歉，我真的不太喜欢诗歌。我还是等它配上音乐后再听吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: It's no On-lyne, but, hey. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然这不是线上时代，不过，嘿。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Wow. That was amazing, I love it!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哇。真是太惊艳了，我超喜欢的！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: That was super cool!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 超级酷！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So, what's the next step?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那么，下一步计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: When do you think you'll compose the music?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你计划什么时候开始编曲？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I... wouldn't call it playing. I try, but I'm not very good at it. It's called a shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不敢说会弹。我试过，但不太擅长。我们管它叫三线琴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I do. It's called a shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我会。我们管它叫三线琴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: No, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 老实说，不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Are -  are you offering to let me play Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是说……让我来和丽兹玩？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Won't you need her, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你不是需要她吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I think I'll pass, but thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想我还是算了吧，不过谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: That sounds awesome, thank you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 听起来很棒，谢谢你！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: I'd love to. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很乐意。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: heh, well. i'm stuck in a mall in a time loop, so... options are limited?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵呵，好吧。我被困在一个时间循环中的商场里，所以……选择有限？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: wow
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哇哦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: pass
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: technically, We have countless birthdays, Thank-You-Very-Much-For-Asking
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 非要说的话，我们有无数个生日，不过还是非常感谢你的关心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yes!! a whole car tire, rim wheel and all, thank You for asking!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有！！吃了一整个车胎，连轮毂也一起吃了！！！谢谢你的关心！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but amir, lettie, eleanor, aoi & i are having a "girls" night in watching terrible horror movies. quincy is also "formally invited to crash"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但阿米尔、莱蒂、埃莉诺、碧和我打算举办一个"闺蜜"之夜，看特烂的恐怖电影。昆西也"被正式邀请来参加"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ...flare has not stopped complaining about it, though...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……不过，弗莱尔因此一直在抱怨……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: should be fun
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 应该挺好玩的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: normally? drink myself silly and go out on the town with friends
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 一般来说？喝得烂醉，和朋友出去疯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: they do, and it's horrendous. so if you try to get people to sing it, i *do* know where you sleep, and i own very loud amps
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 会，而且非常难听。所以，如果你想让大家唱这首歌，我确实知道你睡在哪里，而且我的喇叭劲可大了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: manners, Demon. manners
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 礼貌，恶魔。讲点礼貌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: d'aw, thank You, sugar. This Demon says the sweetest things sometimes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢你，甜甜。这个恶魔还真会甜言蜜语

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but i guess now my home is a bar, so... let 'er rip, i suppose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但我想现在我的家就是一间酒吧，所以……想怎么喝就怎么喝吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: maybe You could mind Your own business
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许你该管好你自己的事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: thanks, space traveler. good to have friends who remember
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢，太空人。有朋友关心真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: THIS DEMON SPOILS US!! ... We will begin to think You are trying to steal us away from Flare ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个恶魔对我们太好了！！……我们会觉得你想从弗莱尔身边偷走我们 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hey, space traveler
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，太空旅行者

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: right. well. they filled me in on the basics.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧。怎么说呢。他们告诉了我一些基本的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: heh, sorry. came off wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，抱歉。说错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: great
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 太好了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: amir had... details to provide, shall we say. quite quickly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 阿米尔已经……非常快地提供了一些细节，可以这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: oh, sol, never. sorry to give that impression. though i suppose you're right. we protoframes aren't the only science experiments in town, are we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦，天哪。不是。很抱歉给你这种印象。不过我明白你的意思。我们原型战甲并不是这座城市里唯一的实验产物，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the infestation. this rot. this thing that's poisoning my blood. i need to know everything you know
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 感染。腐烂。正在毒害我血液的这种东西。我需要知道你所了解的一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: very... very quickly...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 非常……非常的快……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: starting at the top. if you could. kindly. *now.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 从头开始。如果可以的话，*现在*就告诉我，麻烦你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: oh, sol, never. sorry to give that impression. though i suppose you're right. we protoframes aren't the only experiments in town, are we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦，天哪。不是。很抱歉给你这种印象。不过我明白你的意思。我们原型战甲并不是这座城市里唯一的实验产物，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i would *love* to know how exactly you think it could get worse than this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我*很想*知道，你到底认为什么情况会比现在更糟

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that's what i wanted to talk to you about, actually...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这就是我想找你聊的，其实……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so tell me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那么告诉我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and the other one had something to say about "space trauma" i believe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 然后另一个人对"太空创伤"说了点什么，如果我没记错的话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you're the one the other science experiments have been telling me about, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你就是另几个实验产物一直跟我说的那个人，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: enlighten me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 启发启发我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: where did he go? entrati? the others claim they don't know. that you don't either
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他去了哪儿？英择谛？其他人都说他们不知道，还说连你也不知道

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: because from where i stand, i have a poison in my blood that is slowly causing me to lose my mind and corrupting my body
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为从我的角度看来，我的血液里有一种毒药，它正慢慢地让我失去理智，腐蚀我的身体

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i call bullshit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得都是胡扯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... apologize. this is not usually how i like to act. however, i'm in a bit of a situation that is... very hard to describe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……抱歉。我通常不会这么做。但我现在的状况……很难用语言形容

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: this isn't about me wanting answers, dear space traveler. this is about me *needing* answers
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 亲爱的太空旅行者，我问这些可不是因为得到我想要的答案。而是我*必须知道*答案

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sitting here with nothing better to do. i have a bunch of questions for you, if you've got time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 坐在这里，无事可做。我有一堆问题要问你，如果你有时间的话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't think i can adequately put into words how very not okay i am
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得我无法用语言形容我有多么不好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and the only man who could give me answers about it - the only man who could explain it to me or get rid of her is *gone*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 唯一能给我答案的人——唯一能给我一个解释或者让我摆脱她的人已经*消失*了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so i'd like to know everything you know about him, if you don't mind
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以你不介意的话，我想知道你所知道的关于他的一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and i'll remind you that is literally my job to put my feelings into words
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而且提醒你，用语言表达感受是我的本职工作

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and I don't think i can adequately put into words how very different my situation is from the others and how I *need* to get rid of her *immediately*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我无法用语言表达我与其他人情况的不同，以及我多么*需要**立即*摆脱她

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: starting at the top
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 从头开始

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so i'll simply lay it out on the table as this. i made a mistake, taking this bizarre injection
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以，我就把事实简单地摆在台面上好了。我犯了一个错误，注射了这种奇怪的药剂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know what help you need, what bribing, what favors i need to do for you - but i *need* to get rid of her *now*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道你需要什么帮助，需要什么贿赂，需要为你做什么——但我*现在*就*需要*摆脱她

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no. no i don't think it is at all the same. i'm starting to think that you don't understand... and *that's* what scares me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，不，我一点也不觉得这是同一回事。我现在开始觉得你其实根本不明白……而*这*才是让我害怕的点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that's just it. i'm starting to think that you don't understand... and *that's* what scares me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就是那样。我刚刚以为你没明白……我害怕的就是*那样*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that's just it. i'm starting to think that you don't understand... and *that's* what scares me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就是那样。我刚刚以为你没明白……我害怕的就是*那样*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: while i... appreciate that sentiment, this transcends any level social nonconformity and into something entirely different
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然我……欣赏这种感受，但这超出了任何程度的社交规范，变成了完全不同的东西

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i wish i believed you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但愿我能相信你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... can't. i'm sorry. i just can't...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……没法。对不起，我就是没法……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: something i cannot find words to describe, and that is my job - to put feelings into words
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有些东西我无法用语言来表达，而这就是我的工作——用语言表达感受

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she'll kill me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她会杀了我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: we gave Höllvania a concert they'd never forget. that shitbird wanted us to give them hope? and faith? we did. in themselves
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们为霍瓦尼亚举办了一场他们永远不会忘记的音乐会。那个鸟人想让我们给他们希望？和信念？我们做到了。直入人心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: next thing we know they're flipping scaldra trucks and pulling over statues hahaha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 然后他们就掀翻了炽蛇军的卡车，推倒雕像，哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that lil shitbird was so pissed...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那个鸟人气坏了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: should've known it would have costed us...

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know. i really don't... but if we do, it might... it might happen. so it's best not to
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道。我真的不知道……但如果我们说了，那可能……那可能会应验。 所以最好不要

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: like a brick thrown through the ceiling of someone's greenhouse
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我现在感觉就像是一块砸穿了别人温室的天花板的砖头

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what adorably lovely freaks, the lot of them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他们真是可爱的怪胎

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i could sit around and watch them all for days. which is good, seeing as that's all i have to do. hah
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我可以坐下来一连几天看着他们。这很好，因为我没有别事可做。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: got the weirdest call one day, from some slithery little shitbird. preening his feathers and puffing himself up like he was trying to prove something
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有一天，我接到了一个奇怪的电话，某个狡猾的鸟人打来的。他装作一副了不起的样子，振振有词，好像非得证明点什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what else am i supposed to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我还应该做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't *want* to do it, but i don't know how else to go about it, traveler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我*不想*这样，但我不知道还能怎么做，旅行者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i've shown up rather abruptly and made a right mess of somebody else's shit, haven't i?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我出现得太突然，把别人的事搞得一团糟，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i can't wait to work them all into my music
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我忍不住想把他们写进我的音乐中

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: telling us all about how important he was, how this city was "failing" and "losing faith" and how we could "help him in his noble cause to set it straight"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他告诉我们他有多么重要，这座城市是如何正在"堕落"和"失去信仰"的，以及我们该怎么"帮助他完成他的崇高事业，让一切回到正轨"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's like its there in the corner of the room, just staring at me, constantly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好像它就在房间的角落里，一直盯着我看

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hah, sorry. no, i meant - i feel like i'm crashing a party nobody invited me to
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈，抱歉。不，我的意思是——我感觉我像是一场派对的不速之客

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i wonder if i could teach them to play...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我在想我能不能教他们玩乐器……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: he really thought he had an idea of who he was talking to. best part? claimed he was a *fan*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他还真以为自己知道在和谁说话呢。最好笑的是？他还自称是我的*粉丝*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: eyeless, but always watching, lidless, hollow, *hungry*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 没有眼睛，但一直在注视着，没有眼睑，空洞，*饥渴着*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mm, i suppose. hard to break what's already been broken
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，我想是的。已经残破的东西很难再被破坏了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no, but it did make itself into a very useful-looking blunt object, now didn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对，但它确实把自己变成了一个看起来非常有用的钝器，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: nothing worse in this world than watching idiots misuse your words for their own goals
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个世界上最糟糕的事情，莫过于看着某些蠢货为了自己的目的而歪曲你的话了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: waiting for me to blink. waiting for me to look, to glance over, or to let down my guard, and then it'll snap
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 等着我眨眼，等着我张望，等着我瞥一眼，等着我放松警惕，然后它就会袭击

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: still, can't help but feeling like i'm making things worse, not better
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 尽管如此，我还是忍不住觉得自己在使事情变得更糟，而不是更好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but i get your point
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但我明白你的意思

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so, of course we said yes. mainly just because i knew we had to piss that little shitbird off and show him just how tiny his dick actually is
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以，我们当然答应了。主要就是为了惹怒那个鸟人，让他知道多大屌办多大事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: like a shark with blood in the water...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就像鲨鱼在嗅觅水中的血液……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: all because i let myself get used by entrati. i wanted the power to show that little shitbird that he couldn't kill the music
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这一切都是因为我被英择谛利用了。我想要力量，为了告诉那个鸟人他无法扼杀音乐

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i got used. but i also let myself get used. i was angry. i wanted the power to show that little shitbird that the music wouldn't die
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我被利用了，但我也让自己被利用了，我很生气，我想让那个鸟人知道音乐不会消亡

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: he doesn't seem like the backup singer kind of material, but who knows
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他不像是伴唱歌手的料，但谁知道呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what an adorable image
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 多可爱的画面啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but it's all a pipe dream...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但这都是痴人说梦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: wish i'd believed the tabloids about the whole weird plague thing, though
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 早知道就该相信那些关于奇怪疫情的小道消息了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but... i'm... settling in, to answer your question
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是……我……已经适应了，回答你的问题

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm a duet, now... soon to be a solo, if she gets her way...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我现在是二重唱……如果她如愿以偿的话，很快就是独唱了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that was pretty effin' shit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 真他妈见鬼

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you aren't alone in that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 吓到的不只是你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: even if i think if i never eat another pizza again in my life, i would die happy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 即使我这辈子再也吃不到披萨了，我也会幸福地死去

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i can't control it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我控制不住

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: have these monsters never heard of a goddamn *sandwich?!?!*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这些怪物难道没听说过*三明治*吗？！？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: 0/5 stars. would not visit again. as i'm lying there in the tour bus, there's a knock on the door
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 推荐指数 0 分。再也不想来。当时我在巡演巴士上躺着，突然有人敲门

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how it happens, when she -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 事情是怎么发生的呢，当她——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: *and* on top of that, she just keeps *pestering* me about feeding her constantly all these weird things like -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: *除此之外*，她还一直*缠着*我，要我不断地喂她吃这些奇怪的东西，比如——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: DAMN IT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 该死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ding ding ding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 叮叮叮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: psh you know how the story goes. magical mystery cure? promises me that i'll become a performer the likes of which the world has never seen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 噗，你也知道故事会怎么发展了。神奇的奇迹疗法？还说什么会让我成为世界上前所未有的艺人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: if only it were that simple
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 要是真这么简单就好了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: etcetera, etcetera, etcetera.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 诸如此类等等、等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no, space traveler... that's Lizzie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，太空旅行者……那是丽兹……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that shitbird wanted a concert? well he got one all right. now, my stage character's always been a bit... much
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那个鸟人想要一场演唱会？好吧，他如愿以偿了。我的舞台形象一直有点……过于

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she's my guitar...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是我的吉他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: always been me with the volume cranked up as high as it could go
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我总会把音量开到最大

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and... she wants to consume what's left of my soul...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 并且……她想吞噬我残存的灵魂……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but now? *now?* it was like i was running higher than the clouds, running on some kinda juice i didn't even know *existed*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但现在？*现在？*我感觉自己飘得比云朵还高，靠着某种我甚至不知道其*存在的*汁液运行着

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: standing on that stage, the new me, i felt... alive. truly alive. more me than i'd ever felt before. it was glorious. freeing. i felt like i was flying
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 站在那个舞台上，我感觉自己焕然一新……或者说是重生了。真正的重生。我感觉自己比以往任何时候都更贴近本我。真是太奇妙了。自由自在。我感觉自己在飞翔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: we gave Höllvania a concert they'd never forget. that shitbird wanted us to give them hope? and faith? we did. in themselves
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们为霍瓦尼亚举办了一场他们永远不会忘记的音乐会。那个鸟人想让我们给他们希望？和信念？我们做到了。直入人心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: next thing we know they're flipping scaldra trucks and pulling over statues hahaha
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 然后他们就掀翻了炽蛇军的卡车，推倒雕像，哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that lil shitbird was so pissed...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那个鸟人气坏了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: should've known it would have costed us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 早应该知道这会让我们付出代价的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well... them...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 会让他们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: shitbird decided he'd get his show. one way or another. only this time? it wouldn't be a concert
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那个鸟人决定无论如何都要举办属于他自己的演出。只是这一次？不再是演唱会

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: couldn't stop them. too many of them. vs just me? i see you chewing through them like candy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我根本无力阻止他们。他们人数太多了。对付我一个人？我倒是看过你干掉他们时，就像切水果一样轻松……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's the kind of show you only get to put on once...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而是那种你只能表演一次的演出……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: me over here like a baby giraffe figuring out where its legs are supposed to be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而我就像刚出生的小长颈鹿学走路一样瘫在这里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: couldn't do much except just... watch them die...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 除了看着他们一个个死去之外什么也做不了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: shitbird did it on national tv, too...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 鸟人还通过国家电视台现场直播……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: crowing about the ratings like it was something to be proud of...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对收视率得意洋洋，好像这是什么值得骄傲的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i guess it makes perfect sense that she'd...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想她这么做完全有道理……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: feed off of all that hate, all that grief, all that rage
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 以所有的仇恨、悲伤和愤怒为食

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: like a shark, sensing blood in the water
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就像鲨鱼，在嗅觅水中的血液

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i know she's "introduced" herself to you, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我才知道她已经向你"介绍"过自己了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how it happens, or when she... appears
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这是怎么发生的，或者她是何时……出现的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: if only it were that simple
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 要是真这么简单就好了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no, space traveler... that's Lizzie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，太空旅行者……那是丽兹……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she's my guitar...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是我的吉他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and... she wants to consume what's left of my soul...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 并且……她想吞噬我残存的灵魂……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: knock knock
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 咚咚

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you think so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ooooh We like You, You learn QUICK don't You...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦吼，我们喜欢你，你学得真快，是不是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmmm... They just couldn't help but run Their pretty little mouth and tell you all about Us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯……他情不自禁地张开漂亮的小嘴，向你讲述我们的一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: would you prefer that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这是你更想见到的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: poor space traveler
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 可怜的太空旅行者

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and what if it is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果我说是呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sooooo We thought We should come by and introduce Ourselves... properly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以，我们认为我们应该过来介绍一下我们自己……适当地

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: one body. two minds
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 一个身体。两个灵魂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what don't you understand?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你有什么不明白的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: certainly of all people, that wouldn't be so straange to You...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 尤其对于你来说，这应该不奇怪……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Hellooooo...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你好呀……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We have a question for You
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们有一个问题要问你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what... are You afraid of little old Us...? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 为什么……你难道害怕我们吗……？ ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: A Very Important One
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 非常重要的一个问题

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Do You...
Love Us...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱我们吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is That So...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是这样吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Good... That makes Us happy to hear, Sugar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 很好……听到这个我们很高兴，甜甜

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: SILLY DEMON. Confusing TRUST with LOVE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 愚蠢的恶魔。你混淆了信任和爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We Love You. We want You to know that. We have watched You and Loved You through the Centuries...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们爱你。我们希望你知道这件事。几个世纪以来，我们一直关注着你，爱着你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but We will accept that... for now. We will ask again, someday, Sugar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但我们暂时可以接受这个…… 甜甜，我们以后会再问你的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We breathe for You. Bleed for You. Feed for You. Is this demon pleased?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们为你呼吸。为你牺牲。供养你。这位恶魔满意了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And do Your white blood cells not attack You when You are Sick?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在你生病的时候，你自身的白细胞难道不会攻击你吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are Many. We are the Forever. We are Throughout Time. We are the All. Forgive us the Few we Do Not See.
