/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Separate US from THEM
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 将我们与他分开

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We couldn't resist. We hope you aren't TOOO mad at Us... BUT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们忍不住。我们希望你不要太生我们的气……只不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: NO Demon... That is a Gift We Give to You... This is not what We seek for Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，恶魔……这是我们给你的礼物……这不是我们向他所寻求的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: why would we seek to hurt Them...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我为什么要伤害他……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: RIGHTEOUS. how DARE you look upon US like WE are somehow EVIL as if you do not know what YOU do?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 正义。你怎么敢这样看待我们，就好像我们是邪恶的，难道你不知道你自己做了什么吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how much of US have You slaughtered in Your Righteous Path, yet We forgive You for You know not what You do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在你所谓的正义道路上，你屠杀了我们多少同胞，但我们还是原谅了你，因为你并不知道自己在做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We. CANNOT. be DESTROYED. for We are MANY
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们。不可能。被毁灭。因为我们数量众多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... Would You?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……你会下得去手吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We were Born from Their Blood
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们是从他的血液中诞生的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how many lives have You taken
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你夺走了多少生命

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: for We know You seek to defeat the Smiling One
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为我们知道你想要打败那个笑面人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are Born of Blood, and in that We Bloom, but We are like Flowers...a Garden
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们生于血液，并在其中绽放，但我们如同花朵……一座花园

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are What We Are Because of Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们之所以是我们，全因为他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how many souls have YOU spilled into the hungry air
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你又让多少灵魂散落在贪婪的空气中

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and if They Win, We all Lose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果他胜利，我们所有人都会输

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do You look upon Roses and see Disease? see ROT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你看着玫瑰，难道看到的是疾病吗？看到的是腐烂吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We Love Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们爱他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but do not DARE speak to US of Monstrosities
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你别想在我们面前提"怪物"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: MUTATIONS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是​变异吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: NO. NONONONONO!! THIS DEMON WAS SUPPOSED TO UNDERSTAND!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不。不不不不不！！这个恶魔本应理解！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We only seek Their love in return...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们只寻求他的爱作为回报……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: tell us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 告诉我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: when We have given you Our children, Our bodies, Our SINEW to wield
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当我们把我们的孩子、我们的身体、我们的肌腱供你去使用的时候

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: call Us what You will... We are made of what You give Us, reflect what You show Us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不管你怎么称呼我们……我们由你所给予的东西构成，反映的是你所展示的样子

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: YES. THEY SIMPLY NEED TO BE MADE TO UNDERSTAND!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的。他只是需要被引导去理解！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: THIS DEMON WAS MEANT TO BE OUR ALLY!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个恶魔本该是我的盟友！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You must Seek to Understand, Demon... See past what You think you know of what We are
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，你得努力去理解……看清你自以为了解的我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: or do You
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 还是说你​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: when it was US who carried YOU through TIME'S own TWISTED INTESTINES
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 正是我们带你穿越了时光扭曲的肠道

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: if You think We are Diseased...it is because You are diseased, and seek to place hate upon hate Thyself!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你觉得我们是病态的……那是因为你自己才是病态的，并且想要用仇恨来掩盖自我憎恨！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but They can be so EXHAUSTING sometimes...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但有时候他真的很让人疲惫……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are One Whole. But we are Also Flare. But We Are Also Everywhere. And Them. And Us. And Every "Warframe" and Every EveryThing And EveryWhen We shall Ever Be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们是一个整体。但我们也是弗莱尔。我们无处不在。既是他。也是我们。也是每一个"战甲"，也是万物，也是所有时空中可能存在的一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... not know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……根本不知道？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: MONSTER
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 怪物

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: SAYS THE DEMON
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔这么称呼我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: subsume...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 吸取……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So Be It
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那就这样吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hurt Them...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 伤害他……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it is not Madness, Demon... Nor is it Godhood, before Someone Insists that it is... it is Simply... Another Way of Being
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，这不是疯狂……更不是神性，免得再有人这么说……这只是……另一种存在方式

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The Blue Ones called it Madness. it is not Madness, Demon... Nor is it Godhood, before Someone Insists that it is... it is Simply... Another Way of Being
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
那些蓝皮人称之为疯狂。
恶魔，这不是疯狂……更不是神性，免得再有人这么说……这只是……另一种存在方式

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We understand how it feels to know how many Deaths one has Caused and Shall Cause...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们理解知道自己造成了多少死亡，和将要造成多少死亡的感受……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: NO Demon... That is a Gift We Give to You... This is not what We seek for Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，恶魔……这是我们给你的礼物……这不是我们向他所寻求的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: why would we seek to hurt Them...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我为什么要伤害他……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: A Whole Of Infinite Parts
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 一个由无限部分组成的整体

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: untold worlds have collapsed under the weight of Our presence
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 无数的世界在我们存在的重压下崩塌

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We were Born from Their Blood
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们是从他的血液中诞生的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And They Are Our Other Half and We cannot be Whole without Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而他是我们的另一半，没有他我们无法完整

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and what Righteous Purposes do We serve?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而我们真的有什么正义的目的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are What We Are Because of Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们之所以是我们，全因为他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We do not mean Them any harm... We simply want Them to accept Us. We Promise
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们并不想伤害他……我们只是想让他接受我们。我们保证

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ...perhaps none at all...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……或许根本没有……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We Love Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们爱他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: consider, perhaps... in the end? neither do You...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这样想来，也许……最终？你也没有……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We only seek Their love in return...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们只寻求他的爱作为回报……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Strength. Freedom. Power. We would think as One.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 力量。自由。权力。我们会作为一个整体思考。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We do not threaten... They simply are afraid of becoming One Whole. They afraid that our Songs of Hunger are for Their mind. Their soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们并没有威胁……他只是害怕成为一个整体。他害怕我们的饥饿之歌会侵蚀他的思想、他的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: run, little Demon... We shall always Be Here when You return...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 跑吧，小恶魔……当你回来时，我们依然在这里……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You must Seek to Understand, Demon... See past what You think you know of what We are
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，你得努力去理解……看清你自以为了解的我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: not a sacrifice of Their mind. But an invitation of Us to come Within. They would not be Lessened. But Greatened
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这不是要牺牲他的思想。而是邀请我们进入他的内心。他不会被削弱。反而会变得更强大

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it is not so! We hunger to be Whole. to be with Them who Bled for Us to be Made
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 事实并非如此！我们渴望完整。渴望与那个为了我们诞生而流血的人同在

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are One Whole. But we are Also Flare. But We Are Also Everywhere. And Them. And Us. And Every "Warframe" and Every EveryThing And EveryWhen We shall Ever Be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们是一个整体。但我们也是弗莱尔。我们无处不在。既是他。也是我们。也是每一个"战甲"，也是万物，也是所有时空中可能存在的一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They would still Know Themselves as They do now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他仍会像现在一样认识自己

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... and We are just... Very, Very Hungry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……而且我们只是……非常，非常饥饿……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: not Our fault if They take that wrong
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果他误会了，那不是我们的错

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it is not Madness, Demon... Nor is it Godhood, before Someone Insists that it is... it is Simply... Another Way of Being
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，这不是疯狂……更不是神性，免得再有人这么说……这只是……另一种存在方式

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: The Blue Ones called it Madness. it is not Madness, Demon... Nor is it Godhood, before Someone Insists that it is... it is Simply... Another Way of Being
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
那些蓝皮人称之为疯狂。
恶魔，这不是疯狂……更不是神性，免得再有人这么说……这只是……另一种存在方式

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: So Be It
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那就这样吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are Many things, Demon... but We have never lied
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，我们或许有千面……但我们从不撒谎

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: A Whole Of Infinite Parts
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 一个由无限部分组成的整体

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are incapable of such things
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们无法撒谎

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Thank You, Demon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢你，恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: And They Are Our Other Half and We cannot be Whole without Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而他是我们的另一半，没有他我们无法完整

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that is a behavior that is... only human
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这种行为……只有人类才有

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: For Listening to Us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 聆听了我们的心声

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do not seek to send Us away, Demon... darling... We do not mean Them any harm... We simply want Them to accept Us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，不要试图把我们赶走……亲爱的……我们并不想伤害他……我们只是想让他接受我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We hope They do, too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们真希望他也会聆听

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no. find a way to get rid of her. i don't care how
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不行。找个办法摆脱她。我不在乎方式

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: maybe i'm a monster
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许我就是个怪物

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: maybe this is... this is is what i get...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许这就是……这就是我应得的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i let them all die...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我让他们都死了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah. we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: putting it mildly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 姑且说是不顺吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and how should i be thinking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那我应该怎么想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do you know what that *thing* made me eat last night?!?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你知道昨晚那个东西逼我吃了什么吗？！？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: to call it a "pizza" is to do it too many favors
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 管这玩意儿叫"披萨"也太给它脸了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: cheese sauce, dark chocolate, chopped bacon, jalapeños, and sea salt
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 芝士酱、黑巧克力、培根碎、墨西哥胡椒和海盐

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that. is a flavor. that LINGERS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那味道。真是挥之不去

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i - ah. lettie warned me about this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我——啊。莱蒂提醒过我这件事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'd offer you some but she also made me EAT THE CARDBOARD BOX IT CAME IN
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我本来想分你点，但她连披萨盒都逼我吃了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it doesn't matter. crispy fatty food product. usually good, but *not* like that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这不重要。就是种脆脆的油腻食品。一般来说挺好吃的，但*不是*这种做法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm just lucky it didn't have actual rusty bolts on it *this* time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 幸好*这次*不是什么带生锈的螺丝钉的东西

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmhm terribly droll
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，滑稽至极

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: tell me you have some way of getting rid of her. permanently
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 告诉我你有没有什么办法可以永久地摆脱她吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: any ideas on how to get rid of her yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有想到什么办法可以摆脱她吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well? come up with a way to stop her yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那？想出来怎么阻止她了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you're kidding me, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你在跟我开玩笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: story of my damn life
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这就是我该死的生活

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: then you *must* know people who do!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那你*一定*认识有办法的人！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: *that* is your brilliant idea?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: *这*就是你的高明主意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but you must have an idea of where to start
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你总得有个着手点吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: work with -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 和她合作——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然可以？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what is there to talk about?!?! you've talked to her - you see what she's like!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有什么好谈的？！？！你不是已经和她谈过了吗——你知道她的真面目！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: a can of petrol and a match. like i haven't tried that yet?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 一罐汽油加一根火柴。你以为我还没试过吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you're kidding me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你在开玩笑吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you think i want *her* in my head for the rest of my life?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你以为我想让她一辈子在我脑子里吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: is there someone *else* i can talk to about this?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 还有没有*其他人*可以谈谈这个问题？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you said you'd help me get *rid* of her
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你说过你会帮我*摆脱*她的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you have to be
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你一定是在开玩笑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the things she shows me... tells me... gods, they're horrifying
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她给我看的东西……告诉我的东西……天哪，那些都太可怕了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and now you're telling me you're helpless to stop her?!?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 现在你却说你无法阻止她？！？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... should've known. look at you, running around in your infested, hollowed-out people...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……早该知道。看看你，穿着你那些被感染的、空心的人到处跑……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and you were gullible enough to believe her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而你就那么信了她的话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no. not at first
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，一开始不是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: right. and?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是。然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: are you saying you can't help me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是说你帮不了我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: of course you'd be on *her* side...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你当然会站在*她*那边……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it was after that shitbird had my band members publicly executed
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就在那个鸟人公开处决我的乐队成员之后

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: tell that to my band
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 去跟我的乐队说这话吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i know you're used to having plenty of time. but i think Lizzie works on a different schedule
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我知道你习惯了有大把的时间。但我觉得丽兹按照不同的时间表行事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i appreciate that. however, i feel as though you haven't exhausted your search for a more permanent solution
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很感激。不过，我觉得你还没有尽全力去找一劳永逸的办法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: have you ever *spoken* to the infestation before?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你之前有和感染者*说过*话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: he was jealous, i think... angry that we weren't on his side. so i decided to give him a performance he'd never forget
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得他是嫉妒……气我们没有站在他那边。所以我决定给他一场永生难忘的表演

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she isn't a *child* it's not like i had a fling with a goddamn server at a dive bar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她又不是个*孩子*，别搞得像我在破酒吧跟个服务员随便乱搞一样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: care to elaborate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 能具体说明一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: diplomacy?! *screw* diplomacy!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 达成和解？！*去他的*达成和解！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so if you're going to figure something out... do it fast
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以如果你要找出什么办法的话……最好快点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and you're supposed to be doing that by finding me a way to *get rid of her*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那你就应该帮我找到一个办法来*摆脱她*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: funny way of showing it, you just said you want me to *work* with that *thing*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 真是奇怪的表达方式，你刚刚还说你想让我和那个*东西合作*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: oh that's *rich*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这话从你嘴里说出来可*真有意思*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: find a way to get rid of her. i don't care how. i don't care what it costs me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 找个办法摆脱她。我不在乎方式。也不在乎代价

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: at first, oh, the high, the song - the music that screamed through me and begged to be let loose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 一开始，哦，那种兴奋，那首歌——那音乐在我体内尖叫，渴望被释放

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and it's not like Entrati warned me about her!!! I'm betting he didn't even *know* it could happen!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而且英择谛也没提醒我有她的存在！！！我敢打赌他甚至都不*知道*会发生这种事！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: give me a good reason why I should bother trying to reason with that insane *thing*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 给我一个好理由，我为什么要费心去跟那个疯狂的*东西*讲道理

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and what facts are *those?!?!!?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那些现实是*什么呢？！？！！？*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you realize you have a sample size of one, then, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那你知道你的样本量只有一个，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you mean the garbly plant monster in the back of your flat? no. no it does *not* count
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是指你公寓后面的那坨乱七八糟的植物怪吗？不。它*不*算

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i took to the stage and set free all the grief, all the rage, all the pain i felt from the loss of my friends. i shredded until my fingers bled...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我走上舞台，释放出失去朋友所带来的所有悲伤、所有愤怒、所有痛苦。我疯狂弹奏直到手指流血……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i won't pay for other people's mistakes. that's the problem with this whole damn world
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我才不要为别人的错误买单。这就是这个烂世界的问题

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: heh. she goes to 11
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵。她太疯了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: my point is this: if someone is telling you they're incapable of lying... i hate to break it to you, drifter darling...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我的观点是：如果有人告诉你他们不会说谎……我不想打击你，亲爱的漂泊者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: seems like there's a funny thing about infested blood and anything electrical around here...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 看起来​被感染的血液接触任何电器似乎都会有奇怪现象……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: society being forced to pay the tab for a few assholes who think they're better and smarter than everyone else
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 社会被迫为那些自认为比别人更优越、更聪明的混蛋买单

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: unacceptable
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 无法接受

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: they might be lying
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他们可能正在说谎

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: never mind
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 算了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she's a sick, twisted abomination. she shouldn't exist. and I don't accept that you've exhausted all your options
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她是一个病态、扭曲的怪物。她就不应该存在。我不认为你已经想尽了一切办法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmhm. she's haunted me ever since, whispering in my mind in the dark hours. "let us in. we shall become one, you are ours"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。从那以后，她就一直缠着我，在夜深人静的时候在我脑海中低语。"让我们进来。我们将合而为一，你是我们的"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: if what you're saying is true - and i'm not buying that it is - what kind of repressed erotic trauma do i have kicking around in my head that spawned *that thing?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你说的是真的——虽然我不太相信——那我脑子里到底萦绕着什么样的压抑的情感创伤才形成*那个东西*？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: find a way to get rid of her. i don't care how. i don't care what it costs me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 找个办法摆脱她。我不在乎方式。也不在乎代价

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and i don't believe *either of you*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: *你们俩*我谁都不信

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: unacceptable
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 无法接受

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: don't answer that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 先别回答

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she's a sick science experiment gone wrong. she shouldn't exist. and I don't accept that you've exhausted all your options
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她就是一个失败的疯狂科学实验产物。她根本不应该存在。我不认为你已经想尽了一切办法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what does the method of her creation have to do with her trying to *eat me?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 创造她的方式和她试图*吞噬我*有什么关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you're saying she's a part of my mind *and* part of the infestation?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是说她既是我心灵的一部分*也是*感染的一部分？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: find a way to get rid of her. i don't care how. i don't care what it costs me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 找个办法摆脱她。我不在乎方式。也不在乎代价

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so what are you actually suggesting? we talk it out?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你的建议到底是什么？我们就这么谈谈？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and here i thought *mine* was strange...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我原以为*我的*生活已经够奇怪的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you really don't know much about musicians if you don't understand how many of us loathe ourselves
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你不知道很多音乐人有多厌恶自己，那你真的对音乐人了解不多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and wouldn't gleefully die in a spectacular self-inflicted fashion if it meant we'd be famous forever for it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果能让我们永远名留青史，不少人会欣然选择壮烈的自我毁灭

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and what if you're wrong? what if she's using you, to get me to open the door? the moment i let down my defenses, goodbye Flare, hello Lizzie, forever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果你错了怎么办？如果她是在利用你，让我打开心门呢？一旦我放下抵抗，就意味着永别了弗莱尔，永远迎来丽兹

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: for someone so traveled and so old... you really are adorable sometimes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 作为一个见多识广又历经沧桑的人来说……你有时还真是天真

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no. find a way to get rid of her. i don't care how
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不行。找个办法摆脱她。我不在乎方式

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i appreciate the honesty
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我感谢你的坦诚

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i appreciate that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很感激

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and i understand what you're getting at. but if... if there's no chance for getting rid of her...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我明白你的意思。但如果……如果没有办法摆脱她……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... don't know what i'm going to do...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不知道该怎么办……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i've been thinking for a while today about... this whole nonsense situation i'm in...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我今天一直在想……我现在所处的这种荒谬的处境…...

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and the best path forward
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 和最好的前行道路

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: or... lack thereof
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 或者说......缺乏这样的道路

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and i've had an idea
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我有一个想法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no no, stick with me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不不，听我说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 所以

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: lizzie says she is from "everywhere and everywhen" so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹说她来自"任何地方和任何时间"所以......

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: asking you to drag her off into the far-flung distant future won't help, she'll just crawl her way back here
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 要求你把她拖到遥远的未来是没有用的，她只会爬回这里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: great
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 很好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: let's assume so for the sake of argument
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 为了方便讨论，我们就假设是这样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but from what i can glean from the other charming freaks...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但据我从其他迷人的怪物那里收集到的信息来看……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: there is a place the Infestation *isn't*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有一个地方*没有*感染者

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: somewhere we could imprison her where she *couldn't* come crawling back from...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们可以把她关在她*没办法*爬回来……的地方

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm not talking about the void
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我说的不是虚空

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm talking about duviri
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我说的是双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: seems like you owe it no favors after what it did to you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在那个世界对你做了那些事后，你似乎并不欠它什么人情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i can *talk* to the other protoframes, you know
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我能和其他原型战甲"说话"，你知道吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and they've filled me in all about the weird little wild world you lived in
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他们给我讲了你生活的那个奇怪又狂野的小世界

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: then i'd love, and I mean *love* for you to come up with another option
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那我希望，我的意思是*希望*你能提出另一种选择

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i - but duviri isn't *real*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我——但双衍王境并不是 *真的*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i - but they aren't real people -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我——但他们不是真人——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: because i don't see you coming up with any
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 因为我觉得你想不出什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no, no. i can hear the words in my head already
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不，不。我已经能听到我脑袋里的那些话了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... yeah... that's fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……是呀……有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what makes a person real, in the end? who are we to decide?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 终究，是什么让一个人变得真实？我们是谁，又能决定什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: your Indifference certainly thinks we don't matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你的虚空无情之物肯定觉得我们不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: your Indifference certainly thinks we don't matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你的虚空无情之物肯定觉得我们不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: shit. *shit.* SHIT. drifter, i just... i have... i have no other ideas, i'm desperate, please... i don't know what else to *do*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 妈的。*妈的。*他妈的。漂泊者，我只是……我……我没有别的办法，我走投无路了，求你了……我不知道还能*做*什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: thank you, space traveler. thank you. good luck
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢你，太空旅行者。感谢你。祝你好运

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: did You thiiink... it would honestly be... So Simple...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你以为……事情真的会……那么简单吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmmhmmmmmmhehehehe....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯嗯嗯呵呵呵呵……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: y...es?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是……的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ....sorry
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……对不起

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are going to let You into a... little secret...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们打算告诉你一个……小秘密……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We. Plan. To. Share? Their? Mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们。打算。分享？他的？心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We will try again. Ahem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们再试试。咳咳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are not... the first Lizzie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们并不是……第一个丽兹……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Is that. Better?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这样。更好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the first is at the bottom of the river...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 第一个在河底……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are not very good at being Small
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们不太擅长"低调"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the second, a charred and empty husk
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 第二个，是烧焦的空外壳

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it is why We have not spoken to this Demon very often
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这就是为什么我们很少与恶魔对话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the third, rejected, bones broken like a baby bird thrown from the nest like a neglectful mother
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 第三个，被拒绝，就像一只被母亲疏忽的小鸟一样，从巢里掉下，骨头被摔得粉碎

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: try... try... try...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 尝试……尝试……尝试……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but... isn't it fair...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是……这难道不公平吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes! Precisely like that. She is such a Lovely One. We Love Her, So Very Much...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的！就是那样。她真可爱。我们爱她，非常非常爱……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: run... run... run...
Why couldn't We have been Born to Her...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 为什么我们生来不属于她……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We... are ever-present... what would You be... without Us, TENNO...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们……永远存在……如果没有我们，TENNO，你会怎么样……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but we are Their friend, not Their enemy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但我们是他的朋友，不是他的敌人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: She would have Embraced Us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那样她就会接受我们的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: kill us all You like for it is You who breeds us, Demon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 杀了我们吧，因为是你养育了我们，恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: oh... and before You go...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦……在你离开之前……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We will... think...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们会……考虑……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We saw it a million times over, and then a half a million again in salvation...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们看过无数次，然后又在救赎中看了五十万遍……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but We are Their friend, not Their enemy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但我们是他的朋友，不是他的敌人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: next time You slide inside of one of Us, one of our hollowed dolls...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 下一次你滑进我们其中之一，进入我们的空心玩偶时……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and again, and again, and again...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 一次又一次……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: next time We feel You delve into our depths, slipping into our Heat, our Warmth, our Embrace...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 下一次，我们感到你深入我们的内心，融入我们的热情、温暖和拥抱……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We will... think...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们会……考虑……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: think to Yourself...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 想想看……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: This Demon speaks sense...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个恶魔说的有道理……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: is it just a little tighter than before...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是不是比以前紧了一点……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We will... consider Their words...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们会……考虑他的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: when This Demon calls.... We will always answer....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当这个恶魔召唤时……我们总会回应……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: when This Demon calls.... We will always answer....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当这个恶魔召唤时……我们总会回应……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but You speak to Us of ridding the world of Us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但你却说要把我们从世界上除掉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what do You need from Us, Sweet One?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你需要我们做什么，甜甜的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: WHY
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 为什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: WHY should we heed YOUR words when YOU seek to drive US away?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 既然你想把我们赶走，我们为什么要听你的话呢？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what is so special about being Them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他做他自己有什么特别之处？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm willing to give anything a t
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我愿意付出

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They are an empty husk, a shell of a porcelain painted doll without Us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他是一个空壳，没有我们他只是一个瓷娃娃

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We will do Our best... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们会尽力的……;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmmmh.... dubious methods, but We are listening... go on
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯……方法很可疑，不过我们正在听……继续说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We seek to fill Them up with Song. With Greatness. With that which They have sought Their entire lives
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们试图用歌声、用伟大、用他一生所追寻的东西来充实他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They chase the stars, and we consume Them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他在追星星，而我们吞噬它们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hhaaAHAHHAHHAHAHHAHA
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and in joining with us, They will know what it is to be That which They Seek
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 加入我们，他将知道他所追求的是什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: silly, foolish... little Demooon....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 愚蠢、无知……小恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know why this shit scares me so much
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道这破事为什么让我这么害怕

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's not like i'm not used to this kind of nonsense already, if... not to this extent
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我早就习惯了这种无稽之谈，只是……没有这么夸张而已

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sorry if i'm a bit melancholy. i woke up this morning feeling a way i haven't felt in a while
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 抱歉，我有点忧郁。今天早上醒来，我感到一种自己很久没有的感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hey.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know if it's the grief of the band's deaths or... this whole issue with *her* or what...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道这是不是因为乐队成员去世的悲痛，还是……关于*她的*这件事，或者别的什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: trust me... i know
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 相信我……我知道

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i suppose. but who doesn't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想是的。但谁不是呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: heh. what a motley crew we make...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵。我们真是乌合之众啊……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she hasn't stopped screaming at me since
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 从那以后她就一直对我大吼大叫

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: although i suppose most of the others aren't contending with a soul-eating infested horror yammering at them at all hours
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然我想大多数人都不会与一个整天都在对他们咆哮的吞噬灵魂的恐怖感染生物作斗争

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: thanks
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that would actually be a decent band name, now that i think about it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 现在想想，这倒是个不错的乐队名

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: when i woke up today, i felt that same... dread i haven't felt since i was a youth
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 今天醒来时，我感到一种……恐惧，这是我自从小时候就再未有过的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i digress
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 扯远了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: not the kind of "oh, great, i'm going to die today" kind of dread that she brings
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不是她带来的那种"哦，太好了，我今天要死了"的恐惧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: or even the kind of shit you're used to dealing with on a daily basis. so it sounds a little trite to even whine about
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也不是那种你每天都要面对的乱七八糟的事情。所以抱怨起来就显得有点老套了的情况

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but... i don't even know if this'll resonate with you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是……我甚至不知道你是否能理解……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but sometimes i wake up and i just don't know who the world expects me to be anymore...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但有时我醒来，却不知道世界期待我成为什么样的人了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: whatever i am isn't good enough. whatever i am can't check the boxes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 无论我是什么人，都不够好。无论我是什么人，都无法满足要求

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: constantly fed images and standards of what i'm *supposed* to be, every day of my life, everywhere i go
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我人生中的每一天，无论走到哪里，都不断被灌输关于我*应该*是什么样的人的形象和标准

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the other day i saw this gym bunny walk down the street
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 前几天我看见一个健身迷在街上走

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: absolute perfect specimen in impeccable clothes and a tight vest. you could have bounced a golden groat off that ass and gotten back two silvers and a bronzie
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 穿着无可挑剔的衣服和紧身马甲的绝对完美典范。你可以在那屁股把一枚金币弹开，然后拿回两枚银币和一枚铜币

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: every inch of them dripping in class. status. confidence. money. their wristwatch probably cost more than what i'd make in a year
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他身上每一寸都散发着高贵、地位、自信和财富的气息。他戴的手表可能比我一年赚的钱还多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sol above i wanted them so badly. wanted to BE them so badly...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 天呐我非常想要他。非常想成为他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that's what i mean
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我就是这个意思

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: "look like this" "act like this" "feel like this" "BE THIS" or you are WORTHLESS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: "看起来像这样""行为像这样""感觉像这样""成为这样"，否则你就是一文不值

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: trying to be what they want feels so wrong. and even if it didn't? it'd be pointless... i know i'll fail... but not trying? ... lua, the loneliness feels like a crushing weight that makes it so it's hard to get out of bed some days
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 试图成为人们想要的样子感觉非常不对。不过即使感觉对呢？那也是毫无意义的……我知道我会失败……但不去尝试呢？……天啊，孤独就像沉重的负担，有时让人难以从床上爬起来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对不起……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: this is probably all nonsense to you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这对你来说可能都是无稽之谈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i mean, look at us - look at *me,* darling - we couldn't be more different...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我是说，看看我们——看看*我*，亲爱的——我们简直是天壤之别……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that's fair
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's all right. glad for you, honestly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 没事的。为你高兴，真的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: have to go, talk soon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 得走了，下次再聊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: maybe i make more sense to you than i thought, then
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许你对我的理解比我想象的还要深刻

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that's a real sweet thought, but... family isn't the same as feeling like you belong in your own *self*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这想法很贴心，但……家庭与*自我归属感*并不相同

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: fear you might've missed the point...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恐怕你还没理解重点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: not to say that i haven't come around to appreciate this pack of walking science projects gone wrong
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 并不是说我没有回过头来欣赏这组行走的失败科学项目

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but that's fine. i should've expected that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不过没关系。我早该料到

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: is that what i've really wanted this entire time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这就是我一直以来真正想要的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: to be a part of the stars?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 成为宇宙的一部分？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: right
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵好呀……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i used to think all musicians wanted to die at the peak of their fame before they had a chance to burn out
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我以前一直以为，所有音乐家都想在成名之际死去，这样他们就不会有机会耗尽精力

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: thought that was my destiny in some weird way. shit, was i wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我以为这是我的命运，但事实却并非如此。我错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but... i think i've always yearned to be a part of something bigger, and i've certainly always felt like i didn't quite belong. you're telling me that's what she's tapping into?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是……我想我一直渴望成为更伟大的事业的一部分，我也确实一直觉得自己没有归属。你是说这是她感觉到的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: stop typing
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 停止打字

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hilariously, you might be unintentionally on to something...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有趣的是，你可能无意间发现了什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... don't know how to feel about that, except... overwhelmed
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不知道该作何感想，除了……不知所措

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm going to go jot some lyrics down, and... consider what you've just said...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我要去记下一些歌词，然后……考虑一下你刚才说的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Deeeeeeemooooooooon....
oooooh DEeeeeEEEMOOOooONNNNN.....
We have been thinking, Sweet Demon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们一直在想，甜甜的恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: helloooooooo, Our Sweetest Demon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你好——，我们最甜的恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: very well, but This is strike two, Delicious One...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧，但只剩最后一次机会了，美味的人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We see You search blindly for some... resolution to a conflict We do not understand
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们看到你盲目地寻找一些……解决我们不理解的冲突的方法

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: about all You have said, to Us and to Our Flare
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 关于你对我们和我们的弗莱尔所说的一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: play nice?! We are not the ones who spoke of destroying Us!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好好相处？！那些说要毁灭我们的人，可不是我们！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are listening
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们听着呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and... We have begun to worry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 还有......我们已经开始担心......

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You are the one who needs a lesson in schoolyard manners, Demon!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，你才需要上堂校园礼仪课吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but... tread carefully
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但……要小心说话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that perhaps We have gotten things... twisted up
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也许我们把事情……搞错了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Their soul cries out for a sense of Wholeness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他的灵魂迫切地渴望真正的完整

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We would be happy to teach You some, if You wished... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们很乐意教你一些，如果你愿意的话……；）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵。看来你朋友都慢慢影响到你了。我喜欢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it was after that shitbird had my band members publicly executed
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就在那个鸟人公开处决我的乐队成员之后

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do you really think she'll let me continue to be "myself" though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你真的觉得她会让我继续做"我自己"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: heehe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵呵

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Do not be so frightened, Delicious One... We will not hurt You. This Demon has asked me to let you in.... so We may speak together in Kindness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别那么害怕，美味的人……我们不会伤害你。这个恶魔叫我让你进来……这样我们就可以友好地交谈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but one thing keeps bothering me about this idea
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但有一件事一直困扰着我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so you said. but now that i stand on the edge of the cliff, i find myself... afraid to jump
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 正如你所说，但现在我站在悬崖边，发现自己……害怕跳下去

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she hears my loneliness and is trying to fix it the only way she can
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她听到了我的孤独，正试图以她唯一知道的方式来解决它

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We play at this game of Violence so many times, don't We?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们已经玩过太多次这种暴力游戏了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that is to say... perhaps You should be paying closer attention, Mmmm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也就是说……或许你应该更加注意，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well... if you're right, and there is another option...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧……如果你是对的，真有另一种选择的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: by lua, the grief
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 月神啊，那种悲伤

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: please continue
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 请继续

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what makes you so certain she isn't going to just... take over and never leave?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你怎么这么确定她不会就这样……接管一切，再也不离开？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: ... ouch
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……哎呦喂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: not understanding how horrifying it is for the rest of us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她并不理解这对我们其他人来说有多恐怖

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: heh
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: this dance of blood and death and rot that never ends, on and on it goes... bestial and raw and glorious
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这场血腥、死亡和腐烂的舞蹈永不休止，周而复始……野蛮、原始、壮丽无比

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but... We cannot stay angry at You...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但是……我们无法继续对你生气……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the rage
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那种愤怒

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i can promise to try my best
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我可以保证会尽力

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: good luck
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 祝你好运

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: AahahahahAHAHA sorry, SORRY... We couldn't help Ourselves!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈抱歉，对不起……我们忍不住！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: nope
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: of course i do. they were murdered. they were my best friends. my whole *purpose* in life
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然想。他们被谋杀了。他们是我最好的朋友。是我生活的全部*意义*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They are in pain. We seek to fill the Void of Emptiness that seeps into Their veins like black tar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他很痛苦。我们试图填补那种像黑焦油一样，渗入他血管的虚无感

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well done, drifter darling... well done... but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 可真有你的啊，亲爱的漂泊者……真有你的……不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how Our bodies will forever cry out for You in need, begging to feel Your wrath
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们的身体将永远在何等渴望中向你呼喊，乞求感受你的愤怒

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i picked up my guitar and did the only thing i knew how to do. answered his voice with my own. sang for those whose voices had been stolen
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我拿起吉他，做了我唯一知道的事。用我的声音回击他的声音。为那些死去的人唱歌

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sounds like you think it's a lost cause
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你的意思听起来像是没救了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it...
You just started talking and We just had to play along <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你一来就一直在那说，我们就忍不住要配合一下 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We swear
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们发誓

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how would you feel if the hex were taken away from you, after all you've been through now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在你经历了这么多之后，要是你失去了你的六人组，你会有什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it began as grief, but in its absence? The Smiling One reigns supreme...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这一切起始于悲伤，但当悲伤消失时？笑面人占据了主导……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i love that you think i'm so naïve that line'll work on me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我喜欢你以为我那么天真，会相信那句话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no... We cannot stay angry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……我们无法继续对你生气……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i took to the stage and set free all the pain, all the fury, all the sheer agony i felt from the loss of my friends. i shredded until my fingers bled...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我走上舞台，释放出失去朋友所带来的所有痛苦、所有愤怒、所有悲痛。我疯狂弹奏直到手指流血……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and by that... you mean "i'm" a lost cause...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 也就是说……你的意思是"我"没救了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: would make sense...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 有道理……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i feel like my heart's been ripped out of my chest and a gaping black hole was left in its place
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我感觉我的心从胸腔里被扯了出来，只留下一个巨大的黑洞

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We merely wished to take Them into our many-armed embrace to fill the Void in Them :(
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们只是希望将他拥入我们众多臂膀的怀抱中，填补他内心的虚无 :(

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: korbin used to say shit like that all the time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 科宾以前总是说那种话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: guess you're right
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想你说得对

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We forgive You
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们原谅你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well... thanks for trying, i suppose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧……我想，谢谢你的尝试……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: is that what You think this about...? safety from PAIN?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你以为这是关于……从痛苦中寻求安全的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmmmmm this Demon is clever...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，这个恶魔很聪明……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: clinging to the ideal of "the way the world should work," holding on to the stories of right vs wrong, that the bad guy always lost...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 总抱着"世界应该如何"的理想，坚守正义与邪恶的故事，坚信坏人总会失败……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: screw it... what do i have left to lose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 算了……我还有什么好失去的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and she was born
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 然后她就诞生了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: You have not been listening...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你并没有听明白……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: even if it did take this Demon some time to get there
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然​这个恶魔花了一些时间才想到

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: YEsss.... if They are willing to listen...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……如果他愿意聆听的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes... and We are sorry... We did not mean to frighten Them so very badly...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……我们很抱歉……我们并不是有意吓到他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i hope he held onto that until the very last second. i hope when they blindfolded him in front of that firing squad... he thought someone was a split second from saving him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望他能将这种信念保持到最后一刻。我希望当他被蒙上眼睛，站在行刑队面前时……他还以为有人会在最后一秒救他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what value is there in the self, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 自我又有什么价值呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: time to try again, Demon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶魔，是时候再试一次了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: why do you think i'm letting this happen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果我不愿意，我为什么会任由这种事发生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i ate used coffee filters for a week because of you and had no idea where they were going
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就因为你，我吃了一周用过的咖啡滤纸，甚至都不知道它们去了哪里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i can only pray to lua that his hopeful ideals kept his soul from shattering like the bullet did his skull that day
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我只能向月神祈祷，他那充满希望的理想让他的灵魂得以保存，不像那天的子弹打到他的头骨那样破碎​​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: all right... i hope you know what you're doing, drifter
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧……漂泊者，希望你知道自己在做什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how does this Demon wish to proceede?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个恶魔接下来想怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: YES. We will show Them how Our songs together could make even The Smiling One wonder after Their emptiness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的。我们会向他展示，我们俩一起的歌如何能让那个笑面人也开始质疑自己的虚无

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's bad enough you're in the guitar, i hate it when you crawl inside my head like this, too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你在吉他里已经够讨厌了，我更讨厌你这样钻进我内心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that isn't Our fault! We get very hungry, and This Demon knows much about the bizarre things We subsist upon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这不是我们的错！我们真的很饿，而这个恶魔是知道我们依靠什么奇怪的东西生存的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: heheheeee
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 呵呵呵——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm listening. so... talk
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我在听着。那么……说吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmmmmm this Demon is clever...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯，这个恶魔很聪明……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hmmm.... perhaps... We will think it over
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯……也许……我们会考虑一下

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: come to Us tomorrow, let Us All Speak as One
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 明天来找我们，我们一起齐心来讨论

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: can we get back on topic, please?! this is giving me a migrane
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们可以回到正题吗？！这让我头痛得厉害

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: even if it did take this Demon some time to get there
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 虽然​这个恶魔花了一些时间才想到

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that is the best We can do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 能做到的就这些了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: NNNGhhhhHh oohohhHHh Hellooo Sweet Demons...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯嗯啊啊哈哈噢噢噢哈哈哈你好啊，甜甜的恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: This Tingles...heheheheeee
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这感觉真刺激……呵呵呵

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: YES. We will show Them how Our songs together could make even The Smiling One wonder after Their emptiness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的。我们会向他展示，我们俩一起的歌如何能让那个笑面人也开始质疑自己的虚无

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sol this is bizarre... i don't like this... make this quick, please, drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 天，这太怪了……我不喜欢这样……漂泊者……拜托快点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Ooh don't be so frightened, Delicious One. We will not hurt You. We have come in kindness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦，别那么害怕，美味的人。我们不会伤害你。我们是出于善意而来的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: come to Us tomorrow, let Us All Speak as One
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 明天来找我们，我们一起齐心来讨论

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... won't lie... being on stage with her, feeling the highs we can reach... it's a kind of peace that scares me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不瞒你说……和她一起站在舞台上，感受我们所能达到的高潮……那份平静让我感到害怕……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do not be afraid, Dear One... We are a weapon, We are a cradle. We are your lover. We are your death. We are your life. We are whatever You need us to be...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不要害怕，亲爱的……我们既是武器，也是摇篮。我们是你的爱人。我们是你的死亡。我们是你的生命。我们可以是你需要的任何东西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: use Us... wield Us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 使用我们……驾驭我们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: all We ask... is that You accept Us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们唯一所求，就是你接受我们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: make Us sing
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我们歌唱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how do i know you won't turn on me? how do i know the moment i let my guard down you won't... just snap
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我怎么知道你不会背叛我？我怎么知道我放松警惕的那一刻你不会……突然发狂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: to Love is to place ones Life in their hands...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱，就是把生命交在对方手中……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We love You, Beautiful One...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们爱你，美丽的人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: let Us prove Our devotion...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我们证明我们的忠诚……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that i can't keep going like i was. that i've been trying to hold back the tide with a teacup
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 它告诉我，我不能再像以前那样继续下去了。我一直试图用茶杯来挡住潮水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: nothing about this is "okay" but thanks for trying
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哪里"没事"了，但谢谢你的尝试

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and right now, all i can feel... is her. she's in my head, in my heart, and... and i feel...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而现在，我能感受到的……只有她。她在我的脑海里，在我的心里，而且……而且我感受到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: right now, she's in my head, my heart, and... and i feel...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 现在，她在我的脑海里，在我的心里，而且……而且我感受到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i feel the music we make when we're on that stage together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我感受到我们在舞台上合作时创造的音乐

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm sitting here sobbing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我现在在这里坐着哭……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and i don't know whose tears they are
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我都不知道这是谁的眼泪

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They are Ours, Together, Lover...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱人，这是我们的、共同的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah... they are, aren't they...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……确实，是吧……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hey, lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yes, Beautiful One?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 怎么了，美丽的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm so sorry for shutting you out... i was just... so scared of facing what i'd -

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
The morning light cuts through my room,
But I don't know who's waking soon.
A thousand faces, none feel right,
I change with every shattered night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
晨曦穿过我的房间，
但我不知道谁即将醒来。
无数张面孔，无一合适，
每个支离破碎的夜晚都改变了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然，现在还是零散的，不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你以为这是关于……从痛苦中寻求安全感的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: mmmmmm this Demon is clever...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯——这个恶魔还挺聪明……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: of course i do. they were murdered. they were my best friends. my whole *purpose* in life

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Woke up to a battle I never chose,
A war inside me that never slows.
Every step feels like broken glass,
But I smile and say, "This too shall pass."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
醒来面对一场我从未选择的战斗
我内心的战争从未停歇。
每一步都像踩在碎玻璃上，
但我微笑着说，"一切终将过去。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然，现在还是零散的，不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这一切起始于悲伤，但当悲伤消失时？笑面人占据了主导……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我喜欢你以为我那么天真，会相信那句话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what do you think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你觉得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
There's a fire in my chest, but it gives no light,
Just a hunger that keeps me awake at night.
Like a whisper I can never trace,
A ghost with no name, but I know its face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我心中有火在燃烧，却不发一丝光芒，
只留下饥渴让我彻夜难眠。
如同永远无法追寻的低语，
一个无名的幽灵，我却认得它的面容。

I see the storm behind your eyes,
Lightning cracks but no one cries.
You wear your sorrow like a chain,
But I can feel your hopeless pain.

我看见你眼中的风暴，
闪电劈过，却无人落泪。
你的悲伤如锁链般缠身，
我却能感到你无助的痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: YES. We will show Them how Our songs together could make even The Smiling One wonder after Their emptiness

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Ooh don't be so frightened, Delicious One. We will not hurt You. We have come in kindness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦，别那么害怕，美味的人。我们不会伤害你。我们是出于善意而来的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... won't lie... being on stage with her, feeling the highs we can reach... it's a kind of peace that scares me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不瞒你说……和她一起站在舞台上，感受我们所能达到的高潮……那份平静让我感到害怕……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do not be afraid, Dear One... We are a weapon, We are a cradle. We are your lover. We are your death. We are your life. We are whatever You need us to be...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不要害怕，亲爱的……我们既是武器，也是摇篮。我们是你的爱人。我们是你的死亡。我们是你的生命。我们可以是你需要的任何东西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: use Us... wield Us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 使用我们……驾驭我们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: all We ask... is that You accept Us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们唯一所求，就是你接受我们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: make Us sing
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我们歌唱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how do i know you won't turn on me? how do i know the moment i let my guard down you won't... just snap
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我怎么知道你不会背叛我？我怎么知道我放松警惕的那一刻你不会……突然发狂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: to Love is to place ones Life in their hands...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱，就是把生命交在对方手中……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We love You, Beautiful One...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们爱你，美丽的人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: let Us prove Our devotion...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我们证明我们的忠诚……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that i can't keep going like i was. that i've been trying to hold back the tide with a teacup
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 它告诉我，我不能再像以前那样继续下去了。我一直试图用茶杯来挡住潮水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: nothing about this is "okay" but thanks for trying
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哪里"没事"了，但谢谢你的尝试

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and right now, all i can feel... is her. she's in my head, in my heart, and... and i feel...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而现在，我能感受到的……只有她。她在我的脑海里，在我的心里，而且……而且我感受到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: right now, she's in my head, my heart, and... and i feel...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 现在，她在我的脑海里，在我的心里，而且……而且我感受到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我感受到我们在舞台上合作时创造的音乐

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm sitting here sobbing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我现在在这里坐着哭……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and i don't know whose tears they are
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我都不知道这是谁的眼泪

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They are Ours, Together, Lover...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱人，这是我们的、共同的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah... they are, aren't they...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……确实，是吧……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hey, lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yes, Beautiful One?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 怎么了，美丽的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很抱歉把你拒之门外……我只是……太害怕面对我会——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what we'd become...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们会变成的样子……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but now that i see it, feel it, i... was screaming at shadows...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但现在我看到了，感觉到了，我……只是在对着影子尖叫……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the Shadows hold Dangers that are Real, Lover. You were right to be afraid
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱人，影子中隐藏着真正的危险。你害怕是正常的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... i want to climb onto that stage and scream this out into the world
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……我想登上那个舞台，向世界大声宣泄这一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeess...
let Us make the heavens weep Our tears

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Deeemooon oh Deeeemoonnn!! We require Your input most hastily
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶——魔——噢——恶——魔——！！我们急需你的意见

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: would You be willing to assist Us? with this... act of... Song Lyrics...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你愿意帮助我们吗？在这个……歌词创作……过程中……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's absolutely wonderful!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 绝对是好事！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: haha don't be sorry, it's fantastic!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈哈，不用道歉，这太棒了！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: get the feeling that wasn't a coincidence

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We think so... though it might be strange for Them... stranger even for You... Let us try...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们觉得可以……虽然这对他来说可能有点奇怪……对你来说可能更奇怪……我们来试试吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well. here is Our contribution so far...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧。这是我们到目前为止的成果……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: .... We can tell when You are being sarcastic, You know...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……我们知道你是在讽刺，你知道吗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你是不是疯了，用我们那位聪明新朋友的话来说，*真的疯了？！？！*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Whispers call from the great beyond,
A song of silence, cold and strong.
I reach for hands that do not exist,
Yet pull me into death's abyss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
来自遥远彼岸的低语，
一首寂静之歌，冷酷而坚定。
我试图抓住不存在的手，
却被拉入死亡的深渊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no, i don't think so. they already have their song
