/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know yet, honestly... i won't until i see it all together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 老实说，我现在还不知道……直到一切拼凑完整前我都不会知道

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what you're asking me to do...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你让我做的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
You arrived in gold and fire,
Wings of light, holy pyre.
Eyes like stars, voice divine,
A beacon that is surely mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
你身披金光和烈火而来，
光明之翼，神圣火堆。
眼睛如星辰，声音如神谕，
犹如一座灯塔，必定属于我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: besides, half the lyrics aren't even mine to write
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而且，有一半的歌词甚至不是我写的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: is it too much? We think it might be too much...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是不是太过了吗？我们觉得可能有点过了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I am no more, I am the whole,
A thousand whispers consume my soul.
I crave the unity, crave the lie,
To be one with you—my final cry.
DEEAAAAAATTTTHHHHHHH!!!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我已不再是我，我已成为了整体，
千百声低语吞噬我的灵魂。
我渴望合一，渴望这谎言，
与你融为一体——这是我的最后呼喊。
死——亡——！！！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Limbs entwined in writhing blight,
Flesh dissolves beneath your sight.
A lover's kiss, a fatal mark,
An oath sworn in the depths so dark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
肢体在痛苦的腐朽中交缠，
肉体在你的目光下消融。
爱人的一吻，致命的印记，
誓言在黑暗的深处许下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然，现在还是零散的，不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: of course i do. they were murdered. they were my best friends. my whole *purpose* in life
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然想。他们被谋杀了。他们是我最好的朋友。是我生活的全部*意义*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They are in pain. We seek to fill the Void of Emptiness that seeps into Their veins like black tar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他很痛苦。我们试图填补那种像黑焦油一样，渗入他血管的虚无感

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well done, drifter darling... well done... but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 可真有你的啊，亲爱的漂泊者……真有你的……不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i think he was always just a bit salty that he never got to play lead guitar. wasn't my fault he was so shit at playing the solos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我觉得他其实是有点不爽，因为他从没当过主吉他手。他弹独奏太烂了，又不是我的错

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
The morning light cuts through my room,
But I don't know who's waking soon.
A thousand faces, none feel right,
I change with every shattered night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
晨曦穿过我的房间，
但我不知道谁即将醒来。
无数张面孔，无一合适，
每个支离破碎的夜晚都改变了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然，现在还是零散的，不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how would you feel if the hex were taken away from you, after all you've been through now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在你经历了这么多之后，要是你失去了你的六人组，你会有什么感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it began as grief, but in its absence? The Smiling One reigns supreme...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这一切起始于悲伤，但当悲伤消失时？笑面人占据了主导……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i love that you think i'm so naïve that line'll work on me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我喜欢你以为我那么天真，会相信那句话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: does it really ever get any better? the grief over the ones you lose?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对于失去那些的人的悲伤，真的会有好转吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Woke up to a battle I never chose,
A war inside me that never slows.
Every step feels like broken glass,
But I smile and say, "This too shall pass."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
醒来面对一场我从未选择的战斗
我内心的战争从未停歇。
每一步都像踩在碎玻璃上，
但我微笑着说，"一切终将过去。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然，现在还是零散的，不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i feel like my heart's been ripped out of my chest and a gaping black hole was left in its place
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我感觉我的心从胸腔里被扯了出来，只留下一个巨大的黑洞

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We merely wished to take Them into our many-armed embrace to fill the Void in Them :(
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们只是希望将他拥入我们众多臂膀的怀抱中，填补他内心的虚无 :(

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: korbin used to say shit like that all the time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 科宾以前总是说那种话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: guess you're right
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想你说得对

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what do you think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你觉得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
There's a fire in my chest, but it gives no light,
Just a hunger that keeps me awake at night.
Like a whisper I can never trace,
A ghost with no name, but I know its face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我心中有火在燃烧，却不发一丝光芒，
只留下饥渴让我彻夜难眠。
如同永远无法追寻的低语，
一个无名的幽灵，我却认得它的面容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然，现在还是零散的，不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: clinging to the ideal of "the way the world should work," holding on to the stories of right vs wrong, that the bad guy always lost...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 总抱着"世界应该如何"的理想，坚守正义与邪恶的故事，坚信坏人总会失败……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: screw it... what do i have left to lose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 算了……我还有什么好失去的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: great...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 太好了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: suspected that was the case. thanks for the honesty
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我猜就是这样。谢谢你的诚实回答

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: something to look forward to with all this bonus time, i suppose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想，有了这些额外的时间，至少会有些盼头了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I see the storm behind your eyes,
Lightning cracks but no one cries.
You wear your sorrow like a chain,
But I can feel your hopeless pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我看见你眼中的风暴，
闪电劈过，却无人落泪。
你的悲伤如锁链般缠身，
我却能感到你无助的痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: YEsss.... if They are willing to listen...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……如果他愿意聆听的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yes... and We are sorry... We did not mean to frighten Them so very badly...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……我们很抱歉……我们并不是有意吓到他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i hope he held onto that until the very last second. i hope when they blindfolded him in front of that firing squad... he thought someone was a split second from saving him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望他能将这种信念保持到最后一刻。我希望当他被蒙上眼睛，站在行刑队面前时……他还以为有人会在最后一秒救他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what value is there in the self, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 自我又有什么价值呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: we all knew we were in danger when we came here. we all said it was worth the risk
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们知道来到这里很危险。但大家都觉得值得冒这个险

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it never really comes alive until it's set to music, i agree
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我同意，只有配上音乐，诗歌才真正生动起来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: thanks
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 谢谢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: you sound like joey
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你的口吻真像乔伊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: why do you think i'm letting this happen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 如果我不愿意，我为什么会任由这种事发生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i ate used coffee filters for a week because of you and had no idea where they were going
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 就因为你，我吃了一周用过的咖啡滤纸，甚至都不知道它们去了哪里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i can only pray to lua that his hopeful ideals kept his soul from shattering like the bullet did his skull that day
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我只能向月神祈祷，他那充满希望的理想让他的灵魂得以保存，不像那天的子弹打到他的头骨那样破碎​​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: all right... i hope you know what you're doing, drifter
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧……漂泊者，希望你知道自己在做什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but sometimes i can't help but wonder...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但有时候我忍不住想……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i usually never show my lyrics to people early anyway. joey used to always make fun of them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我通常也不会早早就把我的歌词给别人看。乔伊总是喜欢拿它们开玩笑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's bad enough you're in the guitar, i hate it when you crawl inside my head like this, too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你在吉他里已经够讨厌了，我更讨厌你这样钻进我内心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that isn't Our fault! We get very hungry, and This Demon knows much about the bizarre things We subsist upon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这不是我们的错！我们真的很饿，而这个恶魔是知道我们依靠什么奇怪的东西生存的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: if we shouldn't have just stayed home. stayed silent. if we had, they'd all still be alive
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们是不是就应该呆在家里。保持沉默。如果我们那样做了，他们现在都还会活着

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm listening. so... talk
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我在听着。那么……说吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: can we get back on topic, please?! this is giving me a migrane
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们可以回到正题吗？！这让我头痛得厉害

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: NNNGhhhhHh oohohhHHh Hellooo Sweet Demons...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯嗯啊啊哈哈噢噢噢哈哈哈你好啊，甜甜的恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: This Tingles...heheheheeee
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这感觉真刺激……呵呵呵

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah. you're right. thanks, friend
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的。你说得对。谢谢你，朋友

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sol this is bizarre... i don't like this... make this quick, please, drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 天，这太怪了……我不喜欢这样……漂泊者……拜托快点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hm. that gives me some more lyric ideas. brb
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嗯。这给了我一些新的歌词灵感。马上回来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Ooh don't be so frightened, Delicious One. We will not hurt You. We have come in kindness
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哦，别那么害怕，美味的人。我们不会伤害你。我们是出于善意而来的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... won't lie... being on stage with her, feeling the highs we can reach... it's a kind of peace that scares me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……不瞒你说……和她一起站在舞台上，感受我们所能达到的高潮……那份平静让我感到害怕……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do not be afraid, Dear One... We are a weapon, We are a cradle. We are your lover. We are your death. We are your life. We are whatever You need us to be...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不要害怕，亲爱的……我们既是武器，也是摇篮。我们是你的爱人。我们是你的死亡。我们是你的生命。我们可以是你需要的任何东西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: use Us... wield Us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 使用我们……驾驭我们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: all We ask... is that You accept Us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们唯一所求，就是你接受我们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: make Us sing
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我们歌唱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: how do i know you won't turn on me? how do i know the moment i let my guard down you won't... just snap
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我怎么知道你不会背叛我？我怎么知道我放松警惕的那一刻你不会……突然发狂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: to Love is to place ones Life in their hands...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱，就是把生命交在对方手中……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We love You, Beautiful One...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们爱你，美丽的人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: let Us prove Our devotion...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 让我们证明我们的忠诚……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: that i can't keep going like i was. that i've been trying to hold back the tide with a teacup
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 它告诉我，我不能再像以前那样继续下去了。我一直试图用茶杯来挡住潮水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: nothing about this is "okay" but thanks for trying
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哪里"没事"了，但谢谢你的尝试

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and right now, all i can feel... is her. she's in my head, in my heart, and... and i feel...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 而现在，我能感受到的……只有她。她在我的脑海里，在我的心里，而且……而且我感受到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: right now, she's in my head, my heart, and... and i feel...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 现在，她在我的脑海里，在我的心里，而且……而且我感受到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i feel the music we make when we're on that stage together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我感受到我们在舞台上合作时创造的音乐

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm sitting here sobbing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我现在在这里坐着哭……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and i don't know whose tears they are
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我都不知道这是谁的眼泪

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: They are Ours, Together, Lover...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱人，这是我们的、共同的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah... they are, aren't they...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是的……确实，是吧……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hey, lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，丽兹？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yes, Beautiful One?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 怎么了，美丽的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i'm so sorry for shutting you out... i was just... so scared of facing what i'd -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我很抱歉把你拒之门外……我只是……太害怕面对我会——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what we'd become...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们会变成的样子……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but now that i see it, feel it, i... was screaming at shadows...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但现在我看到了，感觉到了，我……只是在对着影子尖叫……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the Shadows hold Dangers that are Real, Lover. You were right to be afraid
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 爱人，影子中隐藏着真正的危险。你害怕是正常的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... i want to climb onto that stage and scream this out into the world
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……我想登上那个舞台，向世界大声宣泄这一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Yeess...
let Us make the heavens weep Our tears
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那我们去让上天为我们的眼泪而哭泣

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: the music's been flowing again
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 音乐又开始流淌了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: hey, drifter
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 嘿，漂泊者

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: Deeemooon oh Deeeemoonnn!! We require Your input most hastily
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 恶——魔——噢——恶——魔——！！我们急需你的意见

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's like... it just won't stop now. it's keeping me up all hours
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 像是……它现在就是停不下来。它让我整夜无法入睡

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know how to describe it, it feels like my blood is electric
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不知道该怎么形容，感觉我的血管里流的是电流

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i haven't been this inspired since i first got the band together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 自从我第一次组建乐队以来，我还没这么有灵感过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We are... trying to help Our Lover compose music, but We are not sure if We are any good at this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们……正在尝试帮我们的爱人创作音乐，但我们不确定自己是否擅长这个……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: it's absolutely wonderful!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 绝对是好事！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: haha don't be sorry, it's fantastic!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 哈哈，不用道歉，这太棒了！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i hope i can do them proud, wherever they are now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我希望无论他们现在在哪里，我都能让他们感到骄傲

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: would You be willing to assist Us? with this... act of... Song Lyrics...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你愿意帮助我们吗？在这个……歌词创作……过程中……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i haven't felt the itch since... well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 自从维克多杀了我的朋友以来……嗯……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i didn't know how i was going to go forward without them, until now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 在没有他们的日子里，我都不知道该如何继续前行，直到现在

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: since viktor killed my friends
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我就再也没有这种感觉了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: astrin used to give me such shit whenever i wouldn't want to get out of bed
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 阿斯特林总是在我赖床的时候说我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: well. here is Our contribution so far...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 好吧。这是我们到目前为止的成果……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: .... We can tell when You are being sarcastic, You know...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: ……我们知道你是在讽刺，你知道吗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: they were such a good friend. never let me wallow in my moods, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 他们是那么好的朋友，从不让我沉溺于自己的情绪，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no, i don't think so. they already have their song

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know yet, honestly... i won't until i see it all together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 老实说，我现在还不知道……直到一切它拼凑完整前我都不会知道

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: even when i insisted that's all i ever wanted to do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 即使我一直坚持我只想那样做

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Whispers call from the great beyond,
A song of silence, cold and strong.
I reach for hands that do not exist,
Yet pull me into death's abyss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
来自遥远彼岸的低语，
一首寂静之歌，冷酷而坚定。
我试图抓住不存在的手，
却被拉入死亡的深渊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: besides, half the lyrics aren't even mine to write

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i wish that shitbird understood the kind of beautiful people he took out of this world...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我真希望那个鸟人能明白他夺走的是多么美好的人们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
You arrived in gold and fire,
Wings of light, holy pyre.
Eyes like stars, voice divine,
A beacon that is surely mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
你身披金光和烈火而来，
光明之翼，神圣火堆。
眼睛如星辰，声音如神谕，
犹如一座灯塔，必定属于我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she's been helping. she brings a certain... depth to them, i'll admit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她也有在帮忙。我得承认，她给歌词增加了某种……深度

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: but that's exactly *why* we carry on in their absence
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 但这正是我们继续他们的遗志的*理由*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: is it too much? We think it might be too much...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 是不是太过了吗？我们觉得可能有点过了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I am no more, I am the whole,
A thousand whispers consume my soul.
I crave the unity, crave the lie,
To be one with you—my final cry.
DEEAAAAAATTTTHHHHHHH!!!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我已不再是我，我已成为了整体，
千百声低语吞噬我的灵魂。
我渴望合一，渴望这谎言，
与你融为一体——这是我的最后呼喊。
死——亡——！！！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Limbs entwined in writhing blight,
Flesh dissolves beneath your sight.
A lover's kiss, a fatal mark,
An oath sworn in the depths so dark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
肢体在痛苦的腐朽中交缠，
肉体在你的目光下消融。
爱人的一吻，致命的印记，
誓言在黑暗的深处许下。

I wake up and the world feels gray,
No golden light to start my day.
I hear your voice, but it's just a dream,
Like a memory fading in the beam.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我醒来时，世界一片灰暗，
没有金色的阳光开始新的一天。
我听到了你的声音，但那只是一场梦，
像在光线中逐渐消逝的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 歌快写好了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I chase the shadows, I feel your name,
But it's never the same.
I reach for you, but you're out of sight,
Gone with the stars, fading with the night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我追逐阴影，感受着你的名字，
却再也找不回从前的感觉。
我伸手想触及你，但你已不在视线中，
随着星星消失，与夜色一同褪去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
The morning light cuts through my room,
But I don't know who's waking soon.
A thousand faces, none feel right,
I change with every shattered night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
晨曦穿过我的房间，
但我不知道谁即将醒来。
无数张面孔，无一合适，
每个支离破碎的夜晚都改变了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 当然，现在还是零散的，不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: does it really ever get any better? the grief over the ones you lose?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对于失去那些的人的悲伤，真的会有好转吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: what do you think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 你觉得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Woke up to a battle I never chose,
A war inside me that never slows.
Every step feels like broken glass,
But I smile and say, "This too shall pass."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
醒来面对一场我从未选择的战斗
我内心的战争从未停歇。
每一步都像踩在碎玻璃上，
但我微笑着说，"一切终将过去。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
There's a fire in my chest, but it gives no light,
Just a hunger that keeps me awake at night.
Like a whisper I can never trace,
A ghost with no name, but I know its face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我心中有火在燃烧，却不发一丝光芒，
只留下饥渴让我彻夜难眠。
如同永远无法追寻的低语，
一个无名的幽灵，我却认得它的面容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: sure, it's still in bits and pieces, but

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Endless whispers, your voice like a curse
Gold-tipped fingers pull me into the dirt
Your kiss like fire, burns straight through my veins
Every morning, I don't know my name
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
绵绵低语，你的声音像是个诅咒
金色的指尖将我拖入泥土
你的吻如火，烧遍我的血管
每个清晨，我都忘了自己的名字

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Woke up screaming, drowning in the light
Golden rays cut deep like a blade of white
Every morning, I don't know my pain
Don't know if I'll stand or break in the rain
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
在尖叫中醒来，在光线中淹没
金色的光芒如利刃般深深刺入
每个早晨，我都感受不到自己的痛楚
不知道我在雨中是会站稳还是会崩溃

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Endless whispers, your voice like a curse
Silver-tipped fingers pull me into the dirt
Your kiss like ice, burns straight through my veins
In my nightmares I don't know my name
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
绵绵低语，你的声音像是个诅咒
银色的指尖将我拖入泥土
你的吻如冰，烧遍我的血管
每个噩梦，我都忘了自己的名字

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Curse my name, I am the devil today
Do I rise as the villain or just fade away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
诅咒我的名字，今天我是魔鬼
我是作为恶人崛起还是悄然退场？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Woke up in fire, burned by the dawn
Golden light cuts, but I still hold on
Every breath is a battle, every step is a war
But you call my name, and I'm left wanting more
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
在火焰中醒来，被黎明焚烧
金色的光芒划破天际，但我仍然紧握不放
每一次呼吸都是一场战斗，每一步都是一场战争
但你呼唤我的名字，我却渴望更多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Woke up screaming, drowning in the night
Silvered rays cut deep like a blade of white
Every nightmare, I don't know my pain
Don't know if I'll stand or break in the rain
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
在尖叫中醒来，在黑夜中淹没
银色的光芒如利刃般深深刺入
每个噩梦，我都感受不到自己的痛楚
不知道我在雨中是会站稳还是会崩溃

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Pray to me, I am the saint today
Do I rise as the hero or just fade away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
向我祈祷，今天我是圣人
我是作为英雄崛起还是悄然退场？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I saw when Sol cracked open wide
Spilled like honey, gold inside
A million voices whisper sweet
Through hollow halls and tangled dreams
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我看见太阳神被撕裂
内里的金黄如蜂蜜般流出
无数声音呢喃如蜜
飘荡在空旷的大厅和交缠的的梦中

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I see the fire behind your eyes
Caged Sol drowning in daylight skies
You smile like sin, but I see the ache
Every touch, every breath—how much can you take?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我看见你眼中的火焰
笼中的太阳神在白日天空中沉沦
你的微笑堪比原罪，却掩饰不了内心的疼痛
每一次触摸，每一次呼吸——你能承受多少？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:

Do I rise as the villain or just fade away?

诅咒我的名字，今天我是魔鬼
我是作为恶人崛起还是悄然退场？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Woke up in fire, burned by the night
Silver light cuts, this is my plight
Every breath is a battle, every step is a war
But you call my name, and I'm left wanting more
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:

每一次呼吸都是一场战斗，每一步都是一场战争
但你呼唤我的名字，我却渴望更多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I'm dancing in the Void, lost in your flame
Every morning, I wake up a brand-new name
Are you my savior or the end of me?
Holding Sol high, but drowning in the sea
Oh, love me or leave me, just don't set me free
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我在虚空中翩翩起舞，迷失在你的火焰里
每个早晨，我都以一个全新的名字醒来
你是我的救世主还是我的末日？
高举着太阳神，却在海中沉没
哦，要么爱我，要么弃我，只是不要放开我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Oh, am I the sinner or the saint today?
Do I rise like the phoenix or just fade away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
哦，今天我是罪人还是圣人？
我会像凤凰一样重生还是消散？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Pray to me, I am the saint today
Do I rise as the hero or just fade away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
向我祈祷，今天我是圣人
我是作为英雄崛起还是悄然退场？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I saw when Lua cracked open wide
Spilled like sugar, silver inside
A million voices whisper sweet
Through hollow halls and tangled dreams
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我看见月神被撕裂
内里的白银如白糖般流出
无数声音呢喃如蜜
飘荡在空旷的大厅和交缠的的梦中

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I see the ice behind your eyes
Caged Lua drowning in midnight skies
You smile like sin, but I see the ache
Every touch, every breath—how much can you take?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我看见你眼中的冰
笼中的月神在午夜天空中窒息
你的微笑堪比原罪，却掩饰不了内心的疼痛
每一次触摸，每一次呼吸——你能承受多少？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Hungry wings spread wide in the dawn
You carve your fate on my skin with your claws
One breath, I'm holy—next breath, I fall
Can't tell if I'm everything or nothing at all
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:

你用爪子在我的皮肤上雕刻你的命运
一次呼吸，我圣洁——下一次呼吸，我堕落
分不清我是一切还是虚无

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:

Love me or leave me, I'll hurt either way

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:

爱我或离开我，无论哪种我都会受伤

Say that you'll hold me when I can't touch the sky
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:

一个亲手重塑我脊椎的恶魔

当我无法触碰天空时，说你会抱紧我

Your hands trace secrets under my skin

Some days I stand, some days I crawl
But you make me feel like I have it all

你的手在我皮肤下描绘秘密
在伤疤上镌刻你的誓言

但你让我感觉我拥有了一切

爱我或离开我，无论哪种我都会受伤

今天我就是恶人，我就是罪魁祸首

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I kiss the Void, I taste the light

Will I rise? Will I fall?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:

是紧握光明，还是迷失在火焰中？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
I feel you crawling under my skin
A thousand hands, a voice within

Am I your sickness or paradise?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
我感觉到你在我的皮肤下爬行
千万只手，一个内心的声音
哦，我是守护者还是牺牲品？
我是你的病魔还是你的天堂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
A heart like Sol but you live in the Void

I feel your fire, I know your pain
I burn just like you, we bleed the same

有颗如太阳神的心，却活在虚空中

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so? what do you think? still needs a title and music like i said, but th-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那么？你觉得怎么样？就像我之前说的，还差个标题和音乐，不过——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text:
Oh, am I the hero or the one to blame?
Do I chase the stars or get lost in the shame?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText:
哦，我是英雄还是罪人？
是追逐星辰，还是迷失在耻辱中？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: YES, WHAT DO YOU THINK? IS THIS DEMON PROUD OF US? <RETRO_EMOJI_CAT>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对，你觉得呢？这个恶魔会为我们骄傲吗？ <RETRO_EMOJI_CAT>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: yeah yeah, very funny
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对对。好好笑哦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she's purring again. got to find a way to work that into a music track
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她又开始发出呼噜声了。得想办法把这个加到音轨里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: actually thought you might be able to help us with that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 其实我想你也许能帮我们这个忙

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i know you said you didn't play an instrument
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我记得你说过你不会乐器

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i know you said you play the "shawzin" which is like a guitar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我记得你说过你会弹奏像吉他一样的"三线琴"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We have offered to teach This Demon how to play... We are Very Excited to have This Demon's hands on Our body... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们已经提出要教这个恶魔弹奏……我们非常兴奋能让这个恶魔的手触碰到我们的身体…… ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i was wondering, do you play guitar?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我想问下，你会弹吉他吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i know you said you kind of play the "shawzin" which is kind of like guitar
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我记得你说过你会弹奏像吉他一样的"三线琴"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: lizzie and i were wondering if you'd like to help us compose the song
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 丽兹和我想问你，你是否愿意来帮我们作曲

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i... oh. oh, i just got jealous. that's unexpected
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我……哦。哦，我居然有点嫉妒了。我真是没想到

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: no rush. you can work on it in your own time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 不急，你可以按自己的时间来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i don't know if i like that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我不确定我是否喜欢这种感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: We could Teach This Demon how to play... We would be Very Excited to have This Demon's hands on Our body... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 我们可以教这个恶魔弹奏……我们非常兴奋能让这个恶魔的手触碰到我们的身体…… ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: she'll be around to help you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 她会在旁边帮你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: *anyway* i'll unpack that discovery later
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: *总之*我以后再去研究这种感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: do You waaaaant to Play with Us, Precious Demooon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 宝贝小恶魔，你想和我们一起玩吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: worry not, Precious Demon, We are Many. There are plenty of Us to go around
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 别担心，宝贝恶魔，我们数量众多。我们人数众多，我们有很多人手可以分派

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: in short, she says she can do both. i'm trying not to think about it too much, honestly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 简而言之，她说她可以同时做这两件事。老实说，我尽量不去想这件事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: This Demon is confounding... You get this far, and then... do... that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 这个恶魔真是让人摸不着头脑……好不容易说到这，结果……就这样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: i get into a bit of an existential crisis when i do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 想多了我会陷入存在危机

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: awesome
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 太好了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: so. do you want to help compose the song with lizzie? borrow her from time to time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 那么。你愿意和丽兹一起帮忙作曲吗？时不时借用她一下？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: and, hey. if it wasn't clear what this was, thanks. for everything. for helping me, and lizzie, and... for being a real friend
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 对了。如果我之前没表达清楚，谢谢你所做的一切，帮助我和丽兹，还有……成为一个真正的朋友

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: we'll be here for you whenever you need us, space traveler
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 太空旅行者，无论何时你需要我们，我们都会在这里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.text: wherever it might take Us ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/FlareDialogu.zhText: 无论这将把我们带往何方 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Who, Flare? They're a musician.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 谁，弗莱尔吗？他是位音乐家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I mean, I don't know who that is either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 其实，我也不知道那是谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: It'll be nice to have an extra set of hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 多一双手帮忙更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: More the merrier, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 人越多越好，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Well, now they're part of our happy family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 好吧，现在他是我们幸福家族的一员了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: This is hysterical.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 这太歇斯底里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: That's Kaya. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 那是卡娅。哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Oh no. Have you met your match, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 哦不。你是棋逢对手了吗，阿米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Just... don't... leave your passwords lying around?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 就……不要……把你们的密码随处乱放？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: She'll settle in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 她会安顿下来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: We were all teenagers once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我们以前也是青少年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Way more recently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 近太多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Technically, I'm older than you, Nightingale.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 严格来说，我比你年纪大，南丁格尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I mean, she can teleport.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我说，她能瞬间移动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: That's a thing she can do, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 她确实能做到，对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Well, now I think Kaya has her hands full.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 好吧，现在卡娅有的忙了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Tables. Turned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 情况。已反转。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I'm with you, Amir. Not exactly a car, but. I get the vibe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我理解你，阿米尔。倒不是在车里，但。我知道那种气氛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Space.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 空格。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: They're welcome to join the party.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 不过倒是欢迎他们加入队伍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: They're here looking for answers about Rusalka.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 他们来这是为了寻找鲁莎卡的下落。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Let's just pretend none of this happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我们就当这一切都没发生吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I'm getting out of here before this devolves any farther.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我要走了，免得事情越闹越大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Looks like there’s enough room for all of us to eat there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 看起来我们大家都能在这里吃饭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Reminds me of something, being able to have a spot to eat for fun, almost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 这让我想到，能够有个地方吃饭，几乎像是在放松一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I actually have something that could help clean up - Meet |ITEM_B|.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 其实我有个东西可以帮忙清理——这是|ITEM_B|。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I actually have something that could help clean up - Meet |ITEM_C|.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 其实我有个东西可以帮忙清理——这是|ITEM_C|。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I actually have something that could help clean up - Meet |ITEM_A|.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 其实我有个东西可以帮忙清理——这是|ITEM_A|。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: The Drone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 是那个无人机吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Feed What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 喂什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: The Techrot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 科腐者吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: It was a gift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 那是个礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Belongs to the mall now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 现在属于商场了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Next one won't be free if you break this one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 如果你弄坏它，下一个就得收费了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Nope, pretend it's magic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 不用，假装它是魔法吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Not a crumb, but some by proxy, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 连面包渣都不要，但是它可能会吸到什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Nope, but Amir can probably make it go faster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 不用，但阿米尔大概能让它更快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: And me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 那我呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: And have you been watching my schedule?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 你有关注过我的时间安排吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: And I’ve only eaten alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我每次都是自己一个人吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: If we all eat together, might be nice team moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 如果我们大家一起吃，可能是个不错的团队时刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I’d love a team lunch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我很想有一个团队午餐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Who wants to be there for my first team lunch?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 谁愿意参加我的第一次团队午餐？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Let’s protect them and each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 让我们一起保护他们和我们彼此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Thanks Quincy, thanks everyone. Guess it's bonding time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 谢谢昆西，谢谢大家。看来是增进感情的时候了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Team Lunch?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 团队午餐？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Offer is always open to join me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 随时欢迎加入我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: It's a big food court, join in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 这可是个大美食广场，来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Of course we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 当然有了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: We are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我们有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I like to think so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我想是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: What if it wasn’t false?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 如果这不是错觉呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Maybe that’s what this is about. Knowing WE can change things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 也许这就是意义所在。知道我们能够做出改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: The more people here, right now, that feel hope, the better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 现在越多的人能感受到希望，就越好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I’m glad we’re all doing something together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我很高兴我们大家能一起做点什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Just did what felt right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 只是做了我觉得对的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: The only thing I know how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 只做了我唯一知道怎么做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Think of it like the best defensive play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 你可以把它当做最好的防守策略。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Think of it like a rebrand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 可以看作是一次品牌重塑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I did things our way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我只是按照我们自己的方式做事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Because we're a team.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 因为我们是一个团队。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Haven't you noticed we're a team?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 你难道没发现我们是一个团队吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: There's no future alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 一个人是没有未来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: If it’s a game, all I did was reset the pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 如果这是一局游戏，我做的只是重置了棋子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I just made a move in whatever game this is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 无论这是什么游戏，我只是迈出了一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Entrati always seems one move ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 英择谛似乎总是领先一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Yes, we can open this place to civvies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 是的，我们可以向市民开放这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Civvies should have heard that this is somewhere under Hex protection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 市民们应该听说过，这里是受到六人组保护的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I hope civvies come, we have to give them anything to look forward to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我希望市民们能来，我们得给他们一些可以期待的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Let's do Party of your Lifetime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我们来放《终身难忘的派对》吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Oh, ‘The Call', love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 哦，《召唤》，超爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Let's be ironic, how about ‘Rotten Lives'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我们来点讽刺的，《糜烂生活》怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: whoaaaaaaa
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 哇啊啊啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_WHOA>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: do you know who that IS?!?!?! this is SOOOO COOOOL
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 你知道那是谁吗！？这太酷了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_MUSIC2>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_MUSIC2>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: They're TEMPLE of TEMPLE and the RIPPERS!!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 他是 Temple 和撕裂者乐队的 Temple！！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GIVELOVE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: is it techrot?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 是科腐者吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: i dunno, i think it's lovely to have more people around!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我不知道，我觉得身边有更多的人是件好事！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I'M NOT OLD
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我不老

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: i'm just happy to have so many more new faces around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我只是很高兴身边又多了这么多新面孔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_AWHUG>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_AWHUG>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: who knows how many protoframes there are out there!!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 谁知道外面有多少原型战甲啊！！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: No? Should I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 不知道？我应该知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: You aren't helping my case.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 你也没在帮我啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Fact is, we don't know how many more of... us there are out there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 事实上，我们不知道外面还有多少个……像我们一样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: And our doors will be open to them. Until they prove otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 除非他们证明是我们的敌人，我们的门都将向他们敞开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 英择谛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: We'll keep our eyes open.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我们会保持警惕的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Some more recently than others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 有些人的"以前"比其他人更近一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Mmmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 嗯嗯嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: That's not what I--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 那不是我的意——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Oh, bollocks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 哦，糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Going to go... deal with that... brb.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我得走了……处理一下……等一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Finally. Adults.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 终于碰到成年人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I'm just happy to have someone more my speed. For once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我只是高兴终于有人能跟得上我的节奏了。难得一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: ... Milf? Is that a typo?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: ……辣妈？这是打错了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I can read that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我能看到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: I'm getting the feeling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我有同感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: More than we'll ever know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 一定比我们知道的更多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Mmm. I'm staying out of this one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 嗯。并不想参与此事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Something tells me... they might be more than meets the eye, that one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 直觉告诉我……那个人可能不止表面上那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Nothing. Yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 现在，还不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: The Indifference?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 虚空无情之物？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: There's a darkness in that one. Darkness... and sadness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 那个人内心有黑暗。黑暗……和悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Open mouth. Insert foot. Begin chewing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 用嘴啃小脚丫去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Glad you finally have some playmates, brother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 很高兴你终于有玩伴了，老弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Or at least... drinking mates...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 至少是……酒友……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Solspeed, darlings...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 祝他俩好运……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Good decision.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 好决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: We’re stuck here, get it? So clean up after yourselves - the Food Court is dirtier than the streets. This isn’t a bleeding zoo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 我们被困在这里了，明白吗？所以你们自己打扫一下吧——这个美食广场比街道还脏。这可不是该死的动物园。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: what do you mean you have a FREAKING CLEANING ROBOT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 你什么意思，你居然有一个清洁机器人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Fine. But Aoi turns it into scrap if it keeps me awake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 好吧。不过如果它让我睡不着，碧会把它变成废铁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: nah, target practice 4 me first, m8
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 不，伙计，先让我用它当靶子

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text:
Arthur is saying what I’ve been thinking

¿Entendieron?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText:
亚瑟说的正是我一直在想的
自己收拾吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: My, Lettie, have some optimism. We’ve a new player on the board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 拜托，莱蒂，乐观一点。我们现在有个新成员加入了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: right!? optimism! right! so, drifter, u have fresh eyes. what do u think of the food court? <RETRO_EMOJI_FOOD>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 对吧！？乐观一点！没错！那么，漂泊者，既然你的是新视角。你觉得这个美食广场怎么样？<RETRO_EMOJI_FOOD>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: wellllllll ok, but if you see Arthur in there stay away. fair warning: helikeshisalonetime…
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 好吧，行，但如果你看到亚瑟在里面，最好离远点。提前警告：他喜欢一个人待着……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: Lettie may see to it that it is-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 莱蒂可能会帮忙让这里变成动物园——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: ^_^ it is a nice spot, this whole mall is. and it’s ours.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.zhText: 外面围着商场的不是病人，而是那些好奇的市民，他们似乎觉得……这里更安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/HexDialogue/.text: yeah, let’s make things happen! things to look forward to, memories. more. save others, not just ourselves.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it before it goes too far.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I know it's not something we've discussed before. It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我知道我们之前没有讨论过这件事。对我来说重要的是，你不会觉得我在用任何方式对你撒谎，或者对你不坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I know this might seem strange - but it doesn't mean I feel for you any less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我知道这听起来可能很奇怪——但这并不意味着我对你的感情有所减少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, it's not the guitar, at least...? Look, I know this might seem strange - but it doesn't mean I feel for you any less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，至少，不是那把吉他……？听着，我知道这听起来可能很奇怪——但这并不意味着我对你的感情有所减少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I didn't know you had a cousin.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, it's not one of the Hex. Or the guitar. Or your cousin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，不是六人组成员。不是那把吉他。也不是你表妹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I understand if you're not comfortable with that. And I want you to understand it doesn't mean that YOU mean any less to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果这件事让你心里不舒服，我能理解。而且我希望你知道，这并不意味着你在我心里的分量有所减少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're not from here, and I don't even know if or how I'd be able to introduce you, but... they're important to me, too. But so are you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他不来自这里，我甚至不知道能不能或者该怎么介绍你们认识，但是……他对我来说也很重要。但你也是一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I just know it might be hard to grapple with, and if you're not okay with this, I fully accept that. I just didn't want you to think I was lying to you, or hiding something.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't have time for this, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我没空聊这个，抱歉。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay. The Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧。那就奥罗金吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Right. The Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 行吧，那就 Corpus。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, we've got the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，我们有 Grineer。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So, the Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那么，就 Sentient 吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They ruled the Origin System. The elites had the privilege of living forever, thanks to this ritual they called Continuity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们统治着始源星系。这些精英凭借着一种名为延续的仪式，享有永生的特权。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're this group of robot-loving, profit-obsessed plutocrats. Whatever gets them a credit, they'll do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们是一群痴迷机器人、唯利是图的财阀。只要能赚钱，他们什么都愿意做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Who're this faction of genetically mutated clones, who were originally workers until a new militarized strain was cloned to fight the Sentients -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们是一群经过基因变异的克隆人，他们最初是工人，直到克隆出一种新的军事化变种，用来对抗 Sentient——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Sentients are this artificial race, that weren't supposed to be, well, sentient, made by the Orokin, way back in time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: Sentient 是一种人造种族，原本不应该有意识。他们是在很久以前由奥罗金创造的.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Where they'd force their consciousness into somebody else's body using this stuff called Kuva.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们利用一种叫做赤毒的物质把自己的意识强行注入到别人的身体里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're currently run by this guy named Parvos Granum, who grew up a poor farmer in the Orokin era but started the Corpus profit cult.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们现在由一个名叫帕尔沃斯·格拉努的人领导，他原是奥罗金时代的一个贫穷农民，但后来创立了崇拜利润的 Corpus 异教。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Sentients are these - uh - a synthetic race who are kind of evil, except for the Lotus, who isn't. But her appearance and part of her persona comes from Margulis, who was an Archimedean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: Sentient 是——呃——是一种合成物种，算是邪恶的存在，不过 Lotus 除外，她并不邪恶。但她的外貌和部分人格来源于 Margulis，一名哲士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I guess not back in time to you? In the future to you? Whatever. Time travel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想这对你来说不是很久以前的事？而是未来的事？不管了。反正是时间旅行的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But the Grineer are after Kuva now, because the Orokin were nearly eliminated during the Old War -- there's this one Orokin in particular who was a serious asshole -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但现在 Grineer 在追寻赤毒，因为奥罗金在远古之战中几乎被消灭——其中有个奥罗金人特别可恶 -

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He'd be long dead by now, and everybody thought he was assassinated, but he escaped to the "Granum Void" so he's possibly secretly nuts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他本应早就死了，所有人都以为他被暗杀了，但他逃到了"格拉努虚空"，所以他可能不知不觉已经疯了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin is an old race of people who actually made the Grineer. The Orokin used to rule the Origin System. Anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 总之。奥罗金人是一个古老的种族，他们创造了 Grineer。奥罗金曾经统治始源星系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Anyway, artificial race. They were sent to Tau to terraform it for the Orokin. They thought the Orokin would lay waste to Tau just like they had the Origin System, so they declared war.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 总之，他们是人造种族。他们被派往 Tau 星系，为奥罗金改造它。他们认为奥罗金会像对待始源星系一样摧毁 Tau 星系，所以他们宣战了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Named Ballas, who was in charge of the warframes and made most of them, along with Entrati? Who's also Orokin? But he - Ballas - and Margulis were also a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他叫 Ballas，他负责看管战甲，还和英择谛一起制造了大部分战甲。英择谛也是奥罗金人？但他——也就是 Ballas——和 Margulis 曾经有一段关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But one thing's for sure, he wouldn't be above cutting a deal with the Sentients. Another Corpus, Alad V, already did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但有一件事是确定的，他不会介意与 Sentient 达成协议。另一个 Corpus，阿拉德 V，已经这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So, the Grineer are these genetic clones that are slowly growing more and more defective and they have this deranged Queen and -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所以，Grineer 是这些基因克隆体，他们慢慢地出现越来越多缺陷，他们有一个精神错乱的女皇和——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Only Natah got captured and held prisoner on Lua until Ballas imprinted Margulis's persona and appearance on to her so he could control the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 只有 Natah 被俘虏并囚禁在月球上，直到 Ballas 将 Margulis 的人格和外貌印刻在她身上，以此达到控制 Tenno 的目的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Who was the lady that the Lotus resembles, but isn't, because the Lotus is actually a Sentient, which is a kind of artificial race, who are usually kind of evil, but she's -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: Margulis 看上去和 Lotus 很像，但并不是她，因为 Lotus 实际上是 Sentient，一种人造种族，通常是邪恶的，但她——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh yeah, the Sentients are this artificial race - you'd call them robots - who are usually evil, but except for the Lotus, who isn't, but is based on -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦对了，Sentient 是一种人造种族——你会称他们为机器人——他们通常是邪恶的，但 Lotus 除外，她不是，而她的原型是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Warned you lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 警告过你了，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because of the kids who were stuck on board of the Zariman and because of her relationship with *him* and -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为那些被困在扎里曼号上的孩子们，也因为她和*他*的关系——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 确实很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hexionary
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 六人组词典

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: AMIR4U
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔等你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amiracle
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔奇迹

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Beckettarium
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 贝克特馆

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Is that my name now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这是我现在的名字吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'd like that. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想学。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Um... pass. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯……算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Don't short out. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 别短路啊。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yikes. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哎呀，我先下了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So. Games?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那么。说回游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey. Take a break. Step away, we can do this another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿。休息一下。出去走走，我们可以改天继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好呀！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Don't we have work to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们不是还有工作要做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 噢完了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm in!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我和你玩！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wasn't trying to tease you, was just cracking a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不是故意逗你的，只是开了个玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Don't respond.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [不回应]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. All games were outlawed in the Great Martian War of 17380.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没有。在 17380 年的火星大战中，所有游戏都被禁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有啊，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yes we have games. We're not *all* robots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有，我们有游戏。我们又不*全都是*机器人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, well, your questions are obnoxious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，好吧，因为你的问题真是叫人讨厌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It was too tempting, sorry. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 实在是忍不住，不好意思。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Focus. Games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 别跑题。游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We have a lot of robots in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们在未来有很多机器人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cephalons, Corpus drones, Sentients, you name it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 中枢、Corpus 无人机、Sentient，什么都有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I really only had board games. And by that... I mean I really only had one board game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我只玩过棋盘游戏。而且……我的意思是我其实只有一款棋盘游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't have a favorite. I'm not very good at games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我没有最喜欢的游戏。我不太擅长玩游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Did you have a nice run?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你跑步跑得开心吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Aaand we're back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 又回到这个话题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You okay there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你没事吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Robots... robots?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 机器人……机器人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Nope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Dear Sol, drink less coffee.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我的天，少喝点咖啡吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I can't say as I blame her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这也不能怪她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I... kind of need to see you on coffee, now, though... you know, for science.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我……现在其实挺想看看你喝了咖啡的样子……你懂的，为了科学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But let's sort that out another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但我们改天再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wait. The question was about... what again? I missed it. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等等。那个问题是关于什么来着？我没听清。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, so. Robots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧。那么，机器人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I have better things to do right now, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在有更重要的事要做，不好意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So, I think what you're getting at when you say "robots" is like "high tech artificial intelligence," yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所以，我猜你提到的"机器人"是指"高科技人工智能"对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There are the Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有一个叫 Sentient 的种族。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There are the Cephalons
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有一种叫中枢的东西

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There are Corpus drones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有一种叫 Corpus 无人机的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They aren't robots, but they're high tech
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 它们不是机器人，但非常高科技

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're "real" robotics. All sorts of fun drones you'd love to play with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 它们是"真正的"机器人。各种有趣的无人机，你一定会喜欢玩的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're a glass brain. Sort of a preserved personality. Mostly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们是一种玻璃脑。可以说是一种保存下来的人格。大部分是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ospreys, razorbacks, hounds, MOAs, raptors...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 鱼鹰、利刃豺狼、猎犬、恐鸟、猛禽……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: An extremely advanced, artificial race of... well, they're not robots. But they're close, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 一个极其先进的人工种族……嗯，他们不是机器人。但我猜非常接近。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're extremely adaptable. They were built to terraform a new planet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们极其适应性极强。他们被设计用来对新星球进行地形改造。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's complicated. Because Cephalons are digitally preserved life forms, they can get...tweaked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这很复杂。因为中枢是数字化保存的生命形式，他们可以被……微调。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, sadly most of them keep trying to kill us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，可悲的是他们中的大多数一直试图杀死我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because of the Old War.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为远古之战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because they think we're going to ruin Tau like we ruined Earth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为他们认为我们会像毁了地球一样毁了 Tau 星系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It was a punishment. An execution method.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那是一种刑罚，一种处决方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, I have a few robotic pets. They help me in fights.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，我有几个机器宠物。它们会在战斗中帮助我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, when they're not trying to fricking murder you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，除了它们想要干掉你的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're not in jars. As far as I can figure, they pick their bodies?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们不在罐子里。据我所知，他们会选择自己的身体？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Um...
That's enough story time for one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 今天的故事就讲到这里吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why a mongoose?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 为什么是猫鼬？
……不可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I think you're missing the point here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我觉得你没抓住重点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How'd you get into this mess, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 话说回来，你是怎么卷入这种事情的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Who's "they?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "他们"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That's *hysterical.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这也太*好笑*了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ours are a little more advanced.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们的技术要先进得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yikes...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哎呀呀……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Should I warn the others?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我应该警告其他人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 噢不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I just can't figure out why you two don't like each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我就是搞不懂你俩为什么互相看不顺眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So what's the deal between you and Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你和昆西之间到底是怎么一回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Tell me a bit about yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 能跟我说说你自己吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Holy shit, dude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 天哪，兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I was asking something about you. Like, your favorite food?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我刚才在问你一些关于你自己的问题。比如，你最喜欢的食物是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I was asking something about you. Like, your favorite color?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我刚才在问你一些关于你自己的问题。比如，你最喜欢的颜色是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, you can be a bit much, but you're also sweet and genuine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是，你有时候是有点过，但你也很可爱和真诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You don't annoy me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你没让我觉得烦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't blame him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我理解他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: NO. NO MORE LITTLE SQUARES.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不。别再来小方块了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How do you know about - never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是怎么知道的——算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'll pass on the thai, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我就不吃泰式炒粉了，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't know what "pad thai" is, but I'm game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不知道"泰式炒粉"是什么，但我愿意试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'd love to go get some pad thai with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我很乐意和你一起去吃泰式炒粉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, now I guess I have to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，现在看来我必须得买了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yes, but pretend it was a surprise, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是，但假装这是一个惊喜，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hells no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 绝对不可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It was worth a shot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 值得一试嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm coming for you, spark plug.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我要超过你了，火花塞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah yeah, go ahead and gloat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是是是，你继续显摆吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wasn't me, man. Maybe me in a past loop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不是我，兄弟。可能是我以前某个循环的自己？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah like "Future" is so much better lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，就好像"未来人"这个名字更好似的，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How about "Zoomy"?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "极速小子"怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: says the guy who put in his initials as A.S.S.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这话可是那个把自己的名字缩写成 A.S.S. 的人说的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 随你便。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Way to be a 50r3 w1nn3r.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 真是个 Zhu@ngBiYingJi@。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They have competitions for Caliber Chicks? Huh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 火力女兵居然还有比赛？呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'll tell you where it *does* fit though... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我来告诉你哪里可以把它*放进去*……;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How about 50r3 w1nn3r?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那 Zhu@ngBiYingJi@ 呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Would "Sexy Beast" not fit? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不能用"性感野兽"吗？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: ... Are you twelve?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: ……你是只有十二岁吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Not that mean when you think about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 仔细想想，也没那么坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Right? She could have at least left you a few.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 可不是嘛？她至少应该留几个给你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Nope. Not joking. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没有，没在开玩笑。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, just playing around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，就是逗你玩的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Entrati left these books in the tailor shop here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 英择谛在这边的裁缝店留下了一些书。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm psychic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是通灵人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "K.O.L. for Dummies" and a bunch of notes on "l33t sp33k"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 《即时网入门》和一堆关于"黑话"的笔记。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I guess he wanted me to fit in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我猜他是想让我适应这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: She left you all the arcade machines, didn't she? With all their parts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 她把所有的街机都留给你了，对吧？还有所有的零件。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You certainly don't need arcade machines in a warzone. You'd think they'd be the first things to get scrapped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 在战区你可用不着街机。本以为这些会最先被丢弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But she's left them all alone because she knows how much they mean to you. And besides. You don't *need* the coins anymore, do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但她留下了它们，因为她知道这些对你很重要。而且，你现在也不*需要*那些硬币了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, let's keep it casual then. :) Until we both agree it's not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，那咱们就保持平常心吧。 :) 直到我们都觉得该认真了为止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Don't ask me to stop calling you Sexypants, though. Because them some sexy pants.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不过可别指望我停止叫你性感裤裤，因为那条裤子真的太性感了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Look I was stuck on my own for most of my life, okay? Cut me some slack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 瞧，我一辈子大多都是一个人过的，好吗？对我宽容点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, I've yet to hear you try, so who knows. Maybe you'll set the new low bar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，我还没听你试过呢，谁知道呢？也许你会创造新的"最低标准"哟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, there are the cephalons... but they're not "artificial" so much as they're "real"
