/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，是有中枢……但与其说他们是"人工的"，更像是"真实的"存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why're you asking, Amir...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，你为什么问这个……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我撤了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Not really. The only real "digital personalities" we have are cephalons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 并没有。我们只有中枢才有真实的"数字个性"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up, Sexypants?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了，性感裤裤？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up, Zoomy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了，极速小子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了，阿米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: lol. Cephalons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈，是中枢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm going to tranq you like a freaking Kuaka
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我要像对付库阿卡一样给你来一枪麻醉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh by the Void, not again--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 噢，虚空在上，你又来了——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: AAAGHHH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 啊啊啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm going to tranq you like a freaking Kuaka
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我要像对付库阿卡一样给你来一枪麻醉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I do not have time for this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我没空聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, but you're going to have to narrow it down. lol. What do you want to know about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，不过你得具体点哈。你到底想知道些什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're my type, what can I say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你就是我喜欢的类型，我还能说什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm just teasing you, don't worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 逗你玩的，别担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What did you want?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你有什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I didn't mean to make you uncomfortable, I just think you're cute, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我并不是想让你不舒服，我只是觉得你很可爱，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm just playing around, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我开玩笑的，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's just a little harmless flirting, Amir. Simmer down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，这不过是开个小玩笑而已，别激动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. Psych. lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 才没有呢。逗你的。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I mean, yeah, duh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当然了，不然呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I mean, if you count "program them to murder" as a personality, sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是说，如果你把"被设定成杀人机器"算作个性的话，那算是吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't have time for this right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我没空聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cephalons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是中枢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我撤了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, I've told you about the sentients. They're "synthetic" so they're kind of artificial?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，我跟你提过 Sentient，它们算是"合成"的，所以也算是人工的吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, there are the sentients. They're "synthetic" so they're kind of artificial.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，有一种叫 Sentient 的，它们算是"合成"的，所以也算是人工的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Closest thing would be the cephalons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 最接近的就是中枢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Not really. Even corpus drones are just pre-programmed with precepts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也不算吧。就连 Corpus 的无人机也只是预先设定了指令而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're people who have had their consciousness ripped out and reprogrammed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们原本是人类，被剥离了意识然后重新编程。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Please don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: As sort of... floating glass brains.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 变成了某种……漂浮的玻璃大脑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Holy hell in a hand basket. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 天啊真要命。我走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, it's true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这是真的哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Breathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呼吸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That you're flattered, but you're not ready for this to be "real" so maybe some casual flirting is fine, but don't expect anything to come of it yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是想说你受宠若惊，但还没准备好让这变成"认真"的关系，所以随便调侃几句可以，但暂时别期待会有什么结果，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Especially seeing as we've just survived an incredibly bizarre, otherwise-seemingly-impossible, world-ending, life-ending apocalypse?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 尤其是考虑到我们刚刚经历了一场极其诡异，且几乎不可能活下来的末日浩劫？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That you'd like me to chill?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是想让我冷静点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And you're going through a lot of "weird changes" right now, that you probably would like some time to adjust to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 而且你现在正经历很多"奇怪的变化"，可能想要一些时间来适应，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Let's get to know each other then, yeah? Then see where it goes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那我们就先多了解彼此吧，好吗？然后再看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Most times? It was Nihil. The Glassmaker.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是说大多数时候？是 Nihil，那个玻璃匠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's a serial killer, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，他是个连环杀手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah. If you think slaughtering people and sucking out their souls against their will is badass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，如果你觉得屠杀别人，然后强行抽取他们的灵魂算厉害的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't want to talk about this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不想聊这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cephalons, and being turned into one, isn't *cute* or *fun.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 被变成中枢可一点都不*可爱*，也不*好玩*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你为什么好奇？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Stop asking me about cephalons. Seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 说真的，别再问我关于中枢的事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Cephalon program was the ultimate punishment. Something even worse than execution.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 中枢计划是终极惩罚，甚至比处决还要可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Perpetual servitude. Being *remade.* Edited to the liking of the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那是永无止境的奴役，被*重塑*，被修改成奥罗金人想要的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Is that the only reason?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这是唯一的原因吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sigh. Well, I'll tell you what I know about the tech, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 唉，好吧，那我告诉你我知道的一些技术吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There's this "Cephalon Weave" that they become a part of. They don't really have physical bodies like we think of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有一种叫做"中枢织网"的东西，他们就是这个网络的一部分。他们并没有我们想象中的那种实体肉体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're also programmed with "precepts" or life missions - sometimes they choose them themselves, other times they're... forced to have them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们还被设定了"枢律"或者"使命"——有时候是他们自愿选择的，有时候……是被强行赋予的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cephalon Suda.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 中枢苏达。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Necraloid, for example.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 比如说，殁世械灵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Like Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 例如 Ordis。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He... used to be very different, when he was a person. Very *very* different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他……以前还是人类的时候，和现在很不一样，真的是*非常*不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: She used to be an Archimedean - one of the leaders of the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 她曾经是位哲士——奥罗金的领袖之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's kind of a special case, made by Entrati. Since he's a "copy" and not the real guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他算是个特殊的例子，是由英择谛制造出来的。因为他是一个"复制品"，而不是真正的洛德。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But when the man he was pissed off the Orokin, they edited him and made him serve the Tenno. Protect the kids like me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但当他惹怒了奥罗金人后，他们就"修改"了他，让他去为 Tenno 服务，保护像我这样的孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Dedicated her life to the pursuit of knowledge and documenting the universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 毕生致力于追求知识，记录宇宙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Still not sure how Entrati managed that. But if there's one thing that bastard is good at, it's cheating the system.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我还是不太明白英择谛是怎么做到的，但要说那家伙有一手的话，就是擅长钻系统的空子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But when she started to get sick, and her mind started to fail? She voluntarily glassed herself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但当她开始生病，心智逐渐衰退时，她自愿将自己玻璃化了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But Necraloid is programmed to serve the Entrati family in place of Loid himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不过殁世械灵被设定成代替洛德本人来服侍英择谛家族的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Becoming Cephalon Suda. But her mission is still the same. Learn. Document. Understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 然后成为了中枢苏达。她的使命仍未改变：学习，记录，理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Seriously, why're you so interested in cephalons?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 说真的，你为什么对中枢这么感兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, but he took off, even if you wanted to ask him about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，不过他已经走了，就算你想问他也没机会了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Mech-e?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 机工？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That sounds like a lot of fun, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来挺有意思的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And just when I thought your hobbies couldn't waste more time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我以为你的爱好已经够浪费时间了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How'd you get out here, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 话说你是怎么跑到这儿来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You don't *sound* fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你听起来不像*没事*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If you wanna talk about it, I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果你想聊聊，我就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't like where this is going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不喜欢这个话题的走向。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I really don't think you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我真不觉得你会想这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure, buddy. Whatever you say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，哥们，你说什么都行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because they've had their entire personalities *edited.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为他们的整个性格都被*编辑过了*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Living for thousands of years is really NOT all it's cracked up to be, trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 相信我，活上几千年真的不像人们说的那样美妙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm going to tranq you like a freaking Kuaka
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我要像对付库阿卡一样给你来一枪麻醉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: AAAGHHH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 啊啊啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Mmhm. The "art."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯哼。"美术设计"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Isn't it just a pinball game?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那不是个弹球游戏吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So where'd you learn to hack?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是在哪学的黑客技术？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's your favorite game?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你最喜欢的游戏是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Never mind, then. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 算了，不问了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But that ! made it so much more secure, Amir. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但阿米尔，那个感叹号确实让它更安全了。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: .... BRB gotta go change my passwords...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: ……马上回来，我得去改一下我的密码了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I am suddenly regretting asking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我突然有点后悔问这个问题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's a TTRPG?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么是 TTRPG？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Computer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 电脑游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Arcade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 街机。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Absolutely zero. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 完全没道理。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It sounds fun, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 老实说，这听起来很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe I can talk them into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也许我可以说服他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ah, well. Is there a game the two of us can play?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 啊，好吧。有没有什么游戏是可以我俩一起玩的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Eh, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呃，那算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我尽量试试看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You can teach me one of your games and I'll teach you one of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你可以教我一个你的游戏，我再教你一个我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're designing a computer game?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你在设计电脑游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wouldn't it be better to get a productive hobby? We *are* in a warzone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们*现在*在战区，找一个更有生产力的爱好不是更好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's the plot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 故事情节是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's the genre?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 游戏类型是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What're you going to call it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 打算叫什么名字？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, talk later. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 抱歉，晚点再聊。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That's cool!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 真酷！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why would I laugh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我为什么要笑？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You really should get better hobbies, man.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 老兄，你真应该找点更好的爱好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，当然了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. I'm just screwing with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，我只是在跟你开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I am not going to judge people for what they do in their spare time, trust me. ... Don't get me started on Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我才不会去评判别人在空闲时间做什么，相信我。别让我开始说双衍王境的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Anyway. Your game?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 话说回来，你的游戏怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'd love to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我很乐意帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure, go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当然，继续说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'd rather eat my old socks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我宁愿去吃我的旧袜子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Doors...?
Right...?
You could try -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你可以尝试——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I mean -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我的意思是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这个嘛，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Right, but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是这样没错，但是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, and
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好，那么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're... welcome?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不……客气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, um. Anytime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，呃。还需要帮忙随时开口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Quincy,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 昆西，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Eleanor,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 埃莉诺，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Aoi,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 碧，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lettie,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 莱蒂，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We shall not speak of what I owe him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我欠他的事咱们就别提了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, you should like the game, you kept beating me at it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，你应该喜欢这游戏，毕竟你老是赢我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Don't feel too bad about losing all those games. I've had a *lot* of practice at komi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 输了那么多局不要太难过。我已经练围棋很久了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Thanks for teaching me Lonestar Hold'Em
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 谢谢你教我玩孤星扑克

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's Fables & Frontiers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么是寓言与边疆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're just worried about all of the whole "end of the world" stuff.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们只是担心那些"世界末日"之类的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Aw, well, let's play more games with the two of us, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哎，好吧，那我们俩再多玩点两个人可以玩的游戏吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe I can talk the Hex into playing. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也许我可以说服六人组的人来玩。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They all said yes. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们都同意了。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I... owe a lot of favors...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我……欠了不少人情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I can't divulge my secrets. Then I'd have to kill you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不能透露我的秘密，否则我得杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, and I don't think I can convince any others, so we should just play now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是的，我觉得我也说服不了其他人了，我们现在就开始玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, but I think I can get more of them on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，我觉得我可以说服更多人加入。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, I'm still working on it. But I'll get there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没有，我还在努力。但我会做到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. Leave it alone. They aren't *cute* or *fun* or *funny.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不行。别再提了。它们既不*可爱*，也不*有趣*，更不*搞笑*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I told you to *stop asking* about cephalons, Amir. I meant it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我已经说过*不要再问*中枢的事情了，阿米尔，我是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because I *said so.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为我*说了算*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because you have no idea what you're really asking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为你根本不知道你在问什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No luck finding any Entrati notes, I take it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你没找到英择谛的笔记，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hi, hello, I'm good, thanks for asking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗨，你好，我很好，谢谢你的关心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, ask away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好的，问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry. We'll talk later. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 抱歉。我们等会再聊。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wait back up. "Kind of" a punishment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等等，回到之前那句。"有点"算是惩罚？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They can still feel. Or so they say. I don't know for sure, I'm not one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们还能感觉到。至少他们是这么说的。我不太清楚，我又不是中枢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, no... you don't understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，不……你不懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Y'know what, you're right, now that you say it like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你知道吗，你说的对，这么一听确实有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Holy shit, no. I can't have this conversation. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 天啊，不行。我不想谈这个话题了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir? You okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔？你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你还在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: People *aren't* code. People *shouldn't be* code. As tempting as it might be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 人*不是*代码。人也*不应该*成为代码。虽然这种想法可能很诱人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: NO. Do you know what you're even saying?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不。你知道你在说什么吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah. Live forever, never get sick, *and* I can delete all the memories of every time I was ever awkward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊。永生不老，永不生病，而且我可以删除所有尴尬时刻的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Monsters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin. An ancient race that used to rule the Origin System. Well, *will* rule the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥罗金。一个曾经统治始源星系的古老种族。好吧，是将来会统治始源星系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why're you so interested in cephalons?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你为什么对中枢这么感兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin *were* monsters, Amir. Like I said earlier, they created cephalons as a punishment worse than death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，奥罗金就是恶魔。就像我之前说的，他们创造中枢，把这用作比死亡还要严重的惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They stripped out people's souls, edited them to their liking, and forced them into servitude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们剥夺了人们的灵魂，按照自己的喜好进行编辑，并强迫他们成为仆从。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I feel like you're focusing on the wrong part here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我觉得你关注的点错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And *forced into servitude.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 并且*被迫成为仆从。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some of them are my best friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们当中有些是我最好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Where are you going with this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't think I like it when you make sense, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，我觉得我不太喜欢你讲道理的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You don't understand the cost of becoming a cephalon. You really don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你不明白成为中枢的代价。你真的不明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Time travel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 都是因为时间旅行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: One way of putting it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 可以这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Not all of them were so bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们并不是全都那么坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They thought they were heroes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们自认为是英雄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm fine, thanks for asking. How're you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我很好，谢谢你的关心。你怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Holy shit, buddy. You okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 天啊，兄弟。你还好么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Big yikes. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 莫名其妙。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah. There's Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对。有个叫 Ordis 的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There's Necraloid & Otak
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有叫殁世械灵和奥塔的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There's Cy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有一个叫赛伊的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's my helper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他是我的助手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's my best friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他是我最好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He watches over the ship, keeps an eye on things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他看管着飞船，监视所有的事务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He doesn't have a choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Only because he was programmed to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 只是因为他被设定成这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I can't do this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在不想谈这个了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, you're not listening to me. Ordis doesn't have a CHOICE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，你没明白。Ordis 没得选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, some choose their own precepts, but you're missing the point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，有些人会选择自己的枢律，但你没有抓住重点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You keep skimming over the horrifying parts of all this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你没仔细看那些恐怖的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They help out on Deimos & where they can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们在火卫二和其他地方都在尽力帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They try their best, and they care deeply.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们会尽自己最大的努力帮忙，也很关心人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Otak was badly damaged and they had to upload him into the same shell Necraloid uses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥塔受到了严重损坏，他们不得不把他上传到殁世械灵使用的机体中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Otak doesn't really seem to notice he's damaged. Ordis, on the other hand...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥塔似乎没有意识到自己受损了。至于 Ordis，情况就不一样了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There are a lot more downsides than just the one, Amir. Like being preprogrammed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，不只这一个问题。还有其他的——比如被预先编程。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He helps pilot my railjack - one of my space ships.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他帮我驾驶航道星舰——我其中一艘太空飞船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's a good friend. Helps pilot my railjack, one of my spaceships.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他是个好朋友，帮我驾驶航道星舰，也就是我其中一艘太空飞船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Just the two lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 就两艘哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Two, but I also have an archwing I can use to get around in space.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 两艘，但我还有一对可以用来在太空中飞行的曲翼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cy is a Command Cephalon from the Old War. He... was ordered to complete a mission which involved murdering his entire crew.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 赛伊是远古之战中的指挥中枢。他……被命令完成一项任务，其中包括杀死他所有的船员。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But he was programmed, like Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但他被程序设定，就像 Ordis 一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But he was programmed. I don't think he really had a choice, despite the guilt he carries over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但他被程序设定。我不认为他真的有选择权，尽管他因此背负着罪恶感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Kind of. Cephalons aren't exactly "computers" but they're close enough for what you're thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 算是可以。中枢不完全是"电脑"，但对于你的设想已经很接近了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. Make real friends, Amir. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不可以。阿米尔，交点真实生活中的朋友吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Digital glass brains, kind of. A person that was stripped of their body and reprogrammed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 数字化的玻璃大脑，可以这么说。一个被剥离身体并被重新编程的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It was an execution method and a fate worse than death, but they're a person preserved as a sort of computer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这是一种处决方式，是比死亡还要糟糕的命运，但他们确实是被作为某种电脑保存下来的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I think you skimmed over some parts of what I typed, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，我觉得你没仔细看我打的内容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Awesome, how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 酷，怎么会？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey Sweetcheeks, you there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿甜屁屁，你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey Amir, you there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿阿米尔，你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I dunno, Hotschnoz is pretty good lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不知道，热辣鼻子还不错哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: This is what I get for flirting with a computer nerd.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这就是我和一个电脑宅男调情的下场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I accept bribes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我接受贿赂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How'd you get to Höllvania in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你一开始是怎么来到霍瓦尼亚的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's with the beef between you and Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你和昆西之间有什么过节吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I forgot. Never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我忘了。算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: *The* nuclear reactor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: *那个*核反应堆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Seems like an important job for an intern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这对于实习生来说似乎是个重要的工作呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Then what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How'd you meet up with Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是怎么认识亚瑟的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: On the other side of things, I think he wished you'd take things a bit more seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 另一方面，我觉得他希望你能更认真一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, I agree. He needs to lighten up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，我同意。他确实应该轻松一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Not everything can be turned into a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不是所有事都能开玩笑的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Meet in the middle, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有时候你们两个需要互相迁就一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Jealous? lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嫉妒了？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What he does in his own time is his business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他在自己的时间里怎么做是他的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Have you told him you can hear him? And asked him to go elsewhere?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你有没有告诉他你能听到？有没有让他换个地方？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Play loud music?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 放很响的音乐呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe he doesn't know he's being disruptive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 可能他不知道自己在打扰人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Holy shit, buddy. No, it wasn't. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 天啊，兄弟。不，不是。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Actually - um - yes, it was. Totally what I was asking. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 事实上——嗯——是的。完全是我想要问的。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No freaking clue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 完全没头绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Kind of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有点吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Um... nowhere nearly as pleasant and nice as that. It was traumatic, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯……没有那么美好和愉快。事实上，挺多创伤的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Long story short? Future Earth, then the Zariman, a ship in space. And then Duviri when all hell broke loose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 长话短说？未来的地球，然后是太空飞船扎里曼。然后是当一切都陷入混乱时出现的双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds like a date. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来像是个约会。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Eh, I'll pass. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呃，不了。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm going to just come out and ask. Are you single?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我直接问了吧，你现在是一个人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Where're you from, originally?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你原本来自哪里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey Amir, you around?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿阿米尔，你在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh. Sorry to bother you. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦。抱歉打扰你了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah. What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Unpack your own baggage, man. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 兄弟，自己的问题自己解决。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Of *course* the offer still stands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: *当然*，这个提议依然算数。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey, hey, slow down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿嘿，慢点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can you maybe explain to me what's wrong, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不过你能告诉我到底是怎么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Clearly, something's wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 很显然，有些事情不对劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, I'll leave you alone. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 抱歉，那我不打扰你了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, you can talk to me. Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，你可以跟我说的。你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm just trying to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我只是想帮忙而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ok. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Who said anything about pity? You're a grown-ass man who's capable of taking care of himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 谁说要可怜你了？你已经是个大人了，能自己处理自己的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Shit, okay. Sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 妈的，好吧。对不起。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But you're also my friend and something's wrong and I'm trying to just HELP my damn FRIEND, ok?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但你也是我的朋友，看到你有困扰，我只是想帮帮我该死的朋友，好吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That sounds like a fun project, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 老实说，这听起来是一个很有意思的项目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Like you don't have enough weird hobbies?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好像你的奇怪爱好还不够多？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can't you do something productive with your time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你不能用你的时间做一些有意义的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure, but I have no idea how to code...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当然，但我不会编程……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Pass. Sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 算了吧，对不起。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And this is different from normal... how? :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但这和平常有什么不同……？:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds like fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: On second thought... [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我改主意了……[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't have time right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在没空聊这个，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's a... looter shooter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么是……刷宝射击游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You just really like to skip the "hellos" don't you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你还真是喜欢跳过"你好"的环节，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: K. Right. Anyway. Why the change?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，行。话说回来，为什么要这么改？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You must've been hell on the babysitter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你肯定是那种让保姆很头疼的小孩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I have a sense of how this conversation is about to go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我好像知道这场对话会变成什么样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: AMIR
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: AMIR
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Make them warframes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 把他们做成战甲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sup, sweetheart?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 宝贝，最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sup, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，你好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sup, hotstuff?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 帅哥，最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What'd I do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我干什么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm sorry, I know I'm terrible at this. I didn't exactly have a normal upbringing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对不起，我知道自己在这方面很差劲。我的成长环境不太正常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I was just trying to compliment you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我只是想夸你一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I do still care about you. [Ask out.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我还是在乎你的。[提出约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'll leave you alone. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不打扰你了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I know. And I'm sorry I hurt you. But I'd like a second chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我知道。我很抱歉伤害了你。但我希望再给我一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I know. But I miss you. :(
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我知道。但我想你了。:(

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That's... so pathetic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那真是……太可悲了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I've missed you, too. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我也很想你。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You can call me anything and I'd like it. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你叫我什么我都喜欢。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: True, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 确实，是啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Do you want it to still be casual? [Ask out.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你还想让它维持玩笑的性质吗？[提出约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, it's still just me joking around, don't worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对，我只是在开玩笑，别担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey! It's okay, I'm not upset. I get it. There's a lot going on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿！没关系的，我不会生气。我理解你。现在事情很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, okay. But I might not wait forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，好吧。但我可能不会永远等你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Forget I said anything, I change my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 忘了我刚才说的吧，我改主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ugh. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呃。算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Take your time. But I really care about you, Amir. So you have nothing to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 慢慢来。但我真的很在乎你，阿米尔。所以你没什么好担心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's okay. I won't be upset if you tell me no. I understand if you don't feel the same way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没关系。如果你拒绝我，我不会难过的。如果你对我没有感觉，我也能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because you're amazingly intelligent - I'm in awe of what you come up with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为你真的非常聪明——我对你的想法感到惊叹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because you're caring and genuine - you wear your heart on your sleeve, even when it's hurting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为你对他人充满关怀而且真诚——即使心里很痛苦，你也会对人坦诚相待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because you make me laugh. Even when things are at their darkest, you try to find joy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为你会让我开怀大笑。即使事情处于最黑暗的时刻，你也会努力寻找快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I want to know what it feels like to make love to someone who goes 9000 mph.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想知道，和一个速度能达到每小时 14484 公里的人做爱是什么感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And I care about you, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 而且阿米尔，我在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Um... yeah, that is really fascinating. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯……是的，确实很有趣。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The meaning's the same. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 意思还是一样的。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh, man - whoops! Talk about a misunderstanding! LOL!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦，天哪——哎呀！真是个误会！哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But uh - out of curiosity, what if I... was hitting on you, just there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但是呃——纯属好奇，如果我刚才真的是在和你调情呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey calm down I'm just joking around with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿，冷静点，我只是和你开玩笑的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, I don't really know how to *flirt,* my upbringing was...weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 抱歉，我真的不太会*调情*，我的成长经历比较……奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Do you want me to be joking? Because I'm not... [Ask out.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你希望我是在开玩笑吗？因为我并没有……[提出约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yep! Just kidding. hahaha.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是的！我开玩笑的。哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I completely forgot what I was going to ask you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我完全忘了我要问你什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What've you been working on lately?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 最近在忙什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's a... goblin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么是……哥布林？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That... sounds problematic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这……听起来不太妙啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, honestly. I do. I put puzzles all over Duviri to help manage my emotions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是的，说实话。我也是。我把谜题放在双衍王境的各个角落来帮助我控制情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, I find other ways to deal with the "goblins."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，我会用其他办法来处理这些"哥布林"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Even though I had no idea what I was really doing at the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 尽管当时我并不清楚自己究竟在做什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds fun. Maybe I can convince them to play. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来很有趣呀。也许我可以说服他们玩。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds like there's more productive things we could be doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来我们可以做一些更有生产力的实事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How's the prep for Fables & Frontiers going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 寓言与边疆的准备工作进行得怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: When's our next round of Fables & Frontiers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们的下一轮寓言与边疆是什么时候？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They all said yes. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们都要来玩。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I can't divulge my secrets. Then I'd have to kill you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不能透露我的秘密，否则我得杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, and I have all I think I can get, so let's start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，我觉得能找到的人都找到了，所以我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A few, but I can get more. I'm sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有几个人了，但我能找到更多。我有信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No progress yet, but I'll get there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 还没什么进展，但我会努力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Quincy,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 昆西，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Eleanor,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 埃莉诺，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Aoi,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 碧，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lettie,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 莱蒂，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We shall not speak of what I owe him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我欠他的事咱们就别提了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, babe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了宝贝？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了阿米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, I'm busy right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 抱歉，我现在很忙。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't remember, actually. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 其实我不记得了。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I remember. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我记得。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Gets what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 明白什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm here to listen, if you need to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果你需要倾诉的话，我就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh, Sol... Amir... I don't know, and I wish I could tell you. But you belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦，老天爷……阿米尔……我不知道，我希望我能告诉你。无论如何你都是这里的一员。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I've been where you are. I still am where you are, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我曾经历过你所处的境况。有时我还会再经历这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Have you talked to Arthur about this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你跟亚瑟谈过这件事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't think I can help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想我帮不了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're doing the best you can. And that's all anybody can ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你已尽了最大努力。没人有资格再要求什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I was just a kid when the Man in the Wall turned the parents on us aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当墙中人在扎里曼号上让我们的父母反过来追杀我们时，我还只是个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He cares about you. A lot. Like a little brother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他非常关心你，就像关心弟弟一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Including yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 包括你自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And I had to witness the slaughter. And I had to...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我眼睁睁地看着这场屠杀。我不得不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He might know how to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他也许知道怎么帮你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And I'm going to say it all caps in hopes it sinks in this time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我要再特别强调一下，希望这次你能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And I still have nightmares sometimes. About that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我有时仍会做噩梦。做关于那件事的噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: YOU. BELONG. HERE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你。属于。这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: About what's followed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 做关于接下来的事情的噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Don't be. Everyone needs help sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 别尴尬。每个人有时都需要帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A mentor of mine once said "only a stubborn fool refuses a needed hand to stay seated in the mud."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我的一位导师曾说过"只有固执的傻瓜才会拒绝伸出的援手，继续坐在泥潭中。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's normal to feel embarrassed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 感到尴尬是正常的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And that's okay. Talking about it is... supposed to help. lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不过没关系。说出来……应该会有帮助。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He is. And I was a very stubborn fool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 确实是。而我当时就是那个非常固执的傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: People care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 大家都关心你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: *I* care about you, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，*我*在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I mean it, the Hex cares. *We* care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是说真的，六人组很在乎你。*我们*都在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, well, Quincy is a special case, but -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，昆西是个特例，但是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Look, Amir. I've tried convincing you, but you're not 12 anymore. This isn't school.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听着，阿米尔。我一直在试图说服你，但你已经不是 12 岁了。这里不是学校。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The rest of us really do care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们其他人真的在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're my dear friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是我很好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: As... more than a friend, if I'm being honest...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 老实说，不仅仅是……作为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So, yeah. I care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所以，对，我在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And I don't know how to prove it to you except to say it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不知道该如何证明这点，除了直接说出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And to be here when you need me to be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 和在你需要的时候陪着你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So if you get those nightmares again, and you want to talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所以，如果你再做那些噩梦，并且想找人聊聊的话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't care what time it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不管是什么时间，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Come get me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 来找我就好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yes'm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 在呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, can't chat now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 抱歉，现在不方便。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, seriously, you're obsessed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 说真的，阿米尔，你太执着了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What about them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, and I'm sick of you asking about them. *Stop.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不行，我受够你总是问他们的事了。*停。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're not going to let this go, are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是不会放弃的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Clearly, you're not. Clearly, you have something else going on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 显然，你不只是好奇。显然，你还有别的打算。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. Stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不行，别问了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What are you getting at with all these questions about Cephalons?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你问这么多关于中枢的问题，到底是想干什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I think we can agree on that, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想我们可以达成共识，是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. I think that cephalons shouldn't ever be made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不觉得，我认为中枢根本就不该被制造出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Honestly, it was their design. They had the right to use it how they wanted to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 说实话，那是他们的设计。他们有权按照自己的意愿使用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If they wanted to use their invention to rip the souls out of their victims and reprogram to be eternal servants, so be it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果他们想用自己的发明来剥离受害者的灵魂，并把他们重新编程成永恒的仆人，那也无可厚非。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It does sound kind of awesome now that you put it that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你这么一说，确实挺棒的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And who gets to decide what the best version of yourself is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那谁来决定什么才是"最完美的自己"呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And who gets to decide who lives forever?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那谁来决定谁能永生呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, but what if they're wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好的，但如果他们没弄对呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How would that work?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那要怎么实现呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Exactly. The Orokin were ageless. They could transfer their consciousness into new bodies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对吧。奥罗金人是不会老的，他们可以把意识转移到新的身体里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin got to choose who lived forever. And they were monsters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥罗金人有权利决定谁能永生。他们自己就是怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Every time someone in the Origin System gets to live forever, it goes wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 每当始源星系里有谁能永生，总会出问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Sentients don't age, and they keep coming back trying to exterminate us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: Sentient 不会变老，而他们会不断卷土重来想要消灭我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cephalons are only harmless because they've been *programmed* to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 而中枢之所以无害，只是因为他们是被编程成那样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Neutered. Hollow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 被阉割了的，空洞的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They're little more than your kinegotchi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们不过就是你的电子宠物蛋罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Even when they went willingly, like Cephalon Suda, what's left isn't whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 即使是像中枢苏达那样自愿变成中枢，留下的也不完整。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Just a facsimile. A broken replica. Nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 只不过是一个仿制品，一个残缺的复制品，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's like an aging parent or grandparent who has started to forget your name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这就像已经开始记不住你名字的年迈长辈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Missing pieces of the past. Pieces of themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们缺失了过去的片段，那是自我的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Say a person suffers from depression. So they say "make it so I never feel sorrow again."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 比如一个人饱受抑郁折磨。于是他们会说："让我再也不会感到悲伤。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Say a person suffers from anxiety. So they say "make it so I never feel fear again."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 比如一个人饱受焦虑折磨。于是他们会说："让我再也不会感到恐惧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What if a person is self-conscious about their sense of humor? So they say "make me never feel joy again."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 要是一个人对自己的幽默感感到自卑呢？他们可能会说："让我再也不会感到喜悦。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Are they really themselves anymore? Who is left behind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那他们还算是自己吗？剩下的部分又是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What if that part of them was actually cherished by everyone who loved them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果那部分的他们其实是被所有爱他们的人所珍视的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And they just couldn't see it through their own self-loathing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 而他们只是因为自我厌弃而看不见呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That's the immortality you're after, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这就是你追求的永生，阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That's a cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这就是中枢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Monsters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin. An ancient race that used to rule the Origin System. Well, *will* rule the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥罗金。一个曾经统治始源星系的古老种族。好吧，是将来会统治始源星系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Time travel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 时间旅行的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: One way of putting it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 可以这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Not all of them were so bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们并不是所有人都那么坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They thought they were heroes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们以为自己是英雄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why're you so interested in cephalons?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你为什么对中枢这么感兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin *were* monsters, Amir. Like I said earlier, they created cephalons as a punishment worse than death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，奥罗金就是恶魔。就像我之前说的，他们创造中枢，用作比死亡还要严重的惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They stripped out people's souls, edited them to their liking, and forced them into servitude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们剥夺了人们的灵魂，按照自己的喜好进行编辑，并强迫他们成为仆从。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I feel like you're focusing on the wrong part here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我觉得你关注的点错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And *forced into servitude.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 并且*被迫成为仆从。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some of them are my best friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们当中有些人是我最好的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Where are you going with this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe? Like Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 可能有？比如 Ordis。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure. What do you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当然可以。你想知道什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's my friend and helper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他是我的朋友兼帮手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He tries his best to keep me safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他总是尽力保护我的安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's used to waiting centuries for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等上我好几个世纪对他来说已经是家常便饭了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's got the kid to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他还要担心那个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I really don't want to talk about this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我真的不想谈这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What?! NO!! No, I mean there's another version of me!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么？！不是！！不，我的意思是还有另一个我！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm going to go die now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在要去死一死了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm one half of a paradox that was created a long time ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是很久以前被创造出来的悖论的一半。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Long story short, I aged and the kid didn't. So Ordis kind of looks over us both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 长话短说，我变老了，而那个孩子却没有。所以 Ordis 得照顾我们两个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He's a cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他是一个中枢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And before you start off on your OML CEPHALON obsession, let me finish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 在你开始对"我的天哪中枢"着迷之前，先听我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A sort of disembodied, digital consciousness. A glass brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 一种无形的数字化的意识。玻璃大脑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Made by the Orokin as a form of ultimate punishment, worse than death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这是奥罗金创造的一种终极惩罚，比死亡还要可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Reprogrammed to the Orokin's whim and liking, and set to serve for eternity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 根据奥罗金人的想法和喜好进行重新编程，并设定成永久性地为其服务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Explain?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 解释一下？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我撤了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I feel like you didn't read what I just wrote there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我觉得你没有明白我刚才写的内容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I... don't like it when you make sense, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，我……不喜欢你说有道理的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't think you understand the ramifications of what I'm describing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我觉得你没有明白我所说的后果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ordis... he's my friend. But he was programmed to be that way. To serve the Tenno. To be our loyal protector. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: Ordis……他是我的朋友。但他被编程成那样。为 Tenno 服务。成为我们忠诚的守护者。直到永远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Nobody special. Just somebody who pissed off the Orokin real badly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没什么特别的人。只是某个狠狠得罪了奥罗金的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ordan Karris. The Beast of Bones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥丹·卡里斯。狂骨野兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No. I just don't want to fuel your weird obsession.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 并不是。我只是不想让你的怪癖更严重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah. He slept with Executor Ballas's wife. [Lie.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 真的。他睡了执行者 Ballas 的妻子。[说谎]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lol. Focus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈。专心点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We'll... workshop that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们……再讨论讨论这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He was a mercenary in service to the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他曾是一名奥罗金的雇佣兵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They brought him to the great chamber, and... offered to make him an Orokin like them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们将他带到了大殿，并且……提出让他成为和他们一样的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He just hated them that much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他就是太恨他们了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He wanted to go out bloody.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他想要杀出一条血路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So he killed every single one he could get his hands on. Or so he thought he did. But Orokin are very, very hard to kill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所以他见一个杀一个。或者说他以为自己杀了他们。但奥罗金人非常非常难杀死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So... they glassed him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所以……他们玻璃化了他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And made him chipper. And happy. And loyal. And gone is the bloody mercenary that was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 把他改造成了一个活泼、快乐、忠诚的人。那个血腥的雇佣兵已经不复存在了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He doesn't even remember he used to be someone else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他甚至都不记得自己曾经是另一个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Fragments. Glitches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 只剩下碎片。故障。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Nothing recognizable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没什么能认出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're going to give me a drinking problem, I swear...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你要把我逼成酒鬼了，我发誓……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, you're STILL missing the point!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，你还是没明白重点！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey, sexy!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿，性感宝贝！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey, toots!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿，甜心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey, Amir!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿，阿米尔！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [无视。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm sorry. I still have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对不起。我还是喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm sorry, I was just trying to be playful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对不起，我只是想开个玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can you forgive me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你能原谅我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I know... I really am sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我知道……我真的很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I understand. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我明白。<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You don't get to put rules on me like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你没资格给我定这样的规矩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lol. It's part of the charm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈。这也是一种魅力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What if I said I didn't want it to be casual anymore and that I had feelings for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果我说我不想再这样随意了，而且我喜欢上你了呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: GOTCHA. lol!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 拿捏。哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm being serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I really do think you're sexy, Amir. I have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我真的觉得你很性感，阿米尔。我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm just joking, don't worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我只是开玩笑的，别放心里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What the hell is a film noir? I just picked that up in a book somewhere...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 黑色电影到底是什么？我只在某本书上读到过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You need more hobbies. Or fewer. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你需要多点爱好，或者少点。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'd applaud but then I can't type lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果我鼓掌的话就打不了字了，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That was... weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好……奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How'd you end up joining the Hex?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是怎么加入六人组的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, I was wondering how you met Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊，我在想你是怎么认识亚瑟的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Take your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 慢慢来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You know you're not really talking to yourself when you do that, I can read what you're -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你知道你这样做并不是在自言自语，我能看到你在说什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If you don't trust me, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果你不信任我，我能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You don't have to tell me anything you don't want to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果你不想说，就不必勉强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I felt that whine in my soul lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我感觉那种牢骚都传到我灵魂那里了哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I got that sense lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我感觉得出来，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 为什么紧张？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because you're amazingly intelligent - I'm in awe of what you come up with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为你非常聪明——我对你的创意感到惊叹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because you're caring and genuine - you wear your heart on your sleeve, even when it's hurting.
