/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为你充满关怀而且真诚——即使心里很痛苦，你也会坦诚相待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because you make me laugh. Even when things are at their darkest, you try to find joy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为你让我开怀大笑。即使事情处于最黑暗的时刻，你也会努力寻找快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I want to know what it feels like to make love to someone who goes 9000 mph.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想知道和一个速度能达到每小时 9000 里的人做爱是什么感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And I care about you, Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 而且阿米尔，我在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 噢不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 天哪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你怎么做了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You didn't...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你该不会……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But... how'd you meet the Hex?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但……你是怎么遇到六人组的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But... how'd you meet the Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但……你是怎么遇到亚瑟的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, what in the name of the Void are you talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，你到底在说什么虚空鸟语？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Doors tend to be hard, yes... they're... doors...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 门本来就很难搞，是的……毕竟它们是……门……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I think you've finally lost it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我觉得你疯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't have time for this right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我没空聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't have time for this right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我没空聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe it'll help you cope with the trauma, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但也许它能帮你应对创伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure, but it's your game. You get to do what you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当然，这是你的游戏。你想怎么做就怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, you could copy the physics but change the design. Make them something vampires or something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，你可以复制物理机制但改变下设计。把他们变成吸血鬼之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Eleanor would love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 埃莉诺一定会喜欢它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That makes way more sense, yes. lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这么一说确实讲得通一些，是的。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're making a video game? You can't have an actually productive hobby?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你在做电子游戏？你就不能有一个真正有用的业余爱好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来有点意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's a looter shooter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么是刷宝射击游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds boring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来很无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Vampire hunters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 吸血鬼猎人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Totally warframes. It'll be good for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当然是战甲。这对你有好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Neither. Make it about cowboys vs flying sharks and set it in a universe made entirely out of candy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 都不要。把它设计成让牛仔对决飞鲨，并将故事背景设定在一个完全由糖果构成的宇宙中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I can't right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Of course. What do you want to talk about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当然可以。你想聊什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm not comfortable with how obsessed you are with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你对他们的痴迷程度让我很不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wait, sorry. I didn't mean it. [Apologize.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等一下，对不起。我不是那个意思。[道歉]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I get it. We're all afraid to die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我懂。我们都害怕死亡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I get it. It's nice to think about not being trapped here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我懂。想象一下不被困在这里也挺美好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I get it. You think you'd be better at being in charge of the "programming."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我懂了。你觉得你更适合负责"编程"这一块吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I get it. You think it'd be fun to be a computer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我懂了。你觉得变成电脑挺有趣的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Take your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 慢慢说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What is it, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那问题是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh, sweetheart...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 噢，亲爱的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh, Amir...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦，阿米尔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Holy shit, are you serious?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我靠，你是认真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So, there's a cephalon I know named Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那好，我认识一个叫 Ordis 的中枢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Remember Ordis?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 还记得 Ordis 吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, um... I lied about that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对，嗯……我那是撒谎的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What I didn't tell you earlier?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我之前没告诉你的是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I told you about Ordis. That wasn't his original name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我跟你提过 Ordis。那不是他的原名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He lives onboard the orbiter and was programmed by the Orokin to protect the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他住在轨道飞行器上，被奥罗金编程用来保护 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But that isn't who he used to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但他原本不是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He was called the Beast of Bones. He was a bloody mass-murderer whose real name was Ordan Karris.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他过去被称作狂骨野兽，是一个血腥的杀人魔，本名叫奥丹·卡里斯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Back in the day, he was Ordan Karris, a mercenary who made a name for himself working for the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当年，他是奥丹·卡里斯，作为奥罗金的雇佣兵而闻名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He was programmed not only to protect and serve the Tenno...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他不仅被编程去保护和服务 Tenno……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But to love us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 还要去爱我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He doesn't have a CHOICE but to be my friend because of what the Orokin did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 由于奥罗金的所作所为，他别无选择，只能成为我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Every time he almost remembers who he was, he forces himself to forget again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 每当他几乎想起自己是谁的时候，他又强迫自己忘记。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin went into his mind and took all the pieces out they didn't like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥罗金进入了他的大脑并把所有他们不喜欢的部分都取了出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Because when he starts to recall what it was like to be Ordan, he feels *hate.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因为一旦他开始回忆起作为奥丹时的感觉，他会感到*恨意*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: All the rage, all the hate, all the anger, and violence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所有的狂怒、所有的仇恨、所有的愤懑，和所有的暴力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He feels *anger* again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他会再次感到*愤怒*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And they told him -- programmed him -- ORDERED HIM.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们告诉他——对他进行编程——命令他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And he starts to lose the love he feels for the Tenno. For me. For us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他开始失去对 Tenno 的爱。对我、对我们的爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Love the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 去爱 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So in a desperate attempt to keep hold of that love, he... deletes those memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 因此，为了在绝望中保持那份爱，他……删除了那些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: THEY. FIXED. HIM.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们。修正了。他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: HE. FIXES. HIMSELF.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他。修正了。自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And I'm left wondering... is any of it real?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不禁想……这一切都是真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Would Ordan Karris even be my friend?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥丹·卡里斯会成为我的朋友吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If someone programs themselves to love you, is it real?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果有人编程让自己爱你，这是真实的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Would he even *like* me at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他会*喜欢*我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Or is all just a lie? A fantasy and a fiction?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 还是说这一切都只是谎言？一场幻想和虚构？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I understand wanting to fix the broken parts of yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我理解你想要修复自己缺陷的心情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I truly do. But like *this?* By removing all choice from yourself? All ability to change?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我真的理解。但是，用*这种方式*？通过剥夺自己所有选择权？所有变化的可能性？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No matter what, Ordis can never *not* be my friend. He will always be forced to love me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不管怎样，Ordis 都不能不是我的朋友。他永远被迫爱我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If you reprogrammed yourself to be "perfect..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果你也重新被编程成"完美……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Would I be left wondering the same thing about you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我会不会也对你有同样的疑问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: This whole time you've been asking about cephalons because you've wanted to "Fix Yourself?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这段时间你一直在问关于中枢的事情，就是因为你想要"修正你自己？！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I kept telling you how HORRIFYING they are. How MONSTROUS the Orokin were for what they did to the people the cephalons used to be!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我一直在告诉你他们是多么的恐怖。奥罗金对那些成为中枢的人所做的事有多么残忍！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You have FRIENDS. You're ALIVE. You're WHOLE. You're YOURSELF.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你有朋友。你还活着。你是完整的。你是你自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Which is more than the cephalons can say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这比中枢强多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm done with this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我已经受够了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Have you ever considered how good you actually have it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你有没有考虑过，你实际上有多幸福？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Have you ever really LOOKED AROUND or LOOKED IN THE MIRROR?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你有没有真正环顾四周或照过镜子？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: YOU. ARE. STILL. AMIR.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你。还。是。阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't think you do!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不认为你明白了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can't chat right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 现在没空聊。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, of course. Talk me through it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，当然可以。跟我讲讲吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm always here for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我一直都在这里支持你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wait, hold on, just like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等等，你就这样决定了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，我理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Stay with me. You're okay. One word at a time. Breathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 冷静下来。你没事了。一个字一个字说。深呼吸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Holy shit, dude... I'm so, so sorry... was it the electricity?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 天啊，哥们……我真的很抱歉……是电的问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah...?
Oh, no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 噢，不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He would've gotten it another way without you. He set you up for this. I'd bet money he gave you up to the O.R.O.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 即使没有你，他也能找到别的办法。他是故意给你设的局。我敢打赌，是他把你卖给了全科。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: None of this is your fault, Amir. None of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，这一切都不是你的错。都不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I would bet my orbiter that Entrati had you all picked out to be exactly where you are, when you were there, for exactly these reasons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我敢用我的轨道飞行器打赌，英择谛早就挑中你了，他正是为了这些理由安排你在那个时间出现在那个地点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But that's life. We all make mistakes. We're just unique in the fact that we get a chance for "do-overs." Most people aren't so lucky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但这就是生活。我们都会犯错。但我们的特别之处在于，我们有机会"重新开始"。大多数人就没那么幸运了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sure, but you're carrying all the guilt on your shoulders when YOU weren't the person pulling the strings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也许，但是你又不是那个操控一切的人，你却要扛下所有的罪恶感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The only thing we can ever do is the best we can in the moment we're in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们唯一能做的就是在当下尽力而为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You were thrown into a terrible situation and changed in a way that nobody could possibly be prepared for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你被卷入了一个糟糕的境地，以一种谁也无法预料的方式被改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They don't make a manual for "getting partially turned into a warframe in 1999."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们并没有制作"在 1999 年部分变成战甲"的手册。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Thanks...? lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 谢谢……？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lol thanks
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈，谢谢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Right back at you. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 同感。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: As different as our pasts were, I feel like we actually have a lot in common.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 尽管我们的过去很不相同，但我觉得我们实际上有很多共同点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can you narrow it down? I have a lot of history.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你能缩小范围吗？我经历过很多事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's not something I like talking about. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我并不喜欢谈论这个话题。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I turned to stories and fiction as a way to deal with my trauma.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是通过沉浸在故事和小说中来处理我的创伤的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I was thrown into things I had no business being a part of, and had to learn to cope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我被卷入了一些本来与我无关的事情中，不得不学着去应对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: When I was on board the Zariman, we... sort of ran into the Void. The Man in the Wall came.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 当我在扎里曼号上的时候，我们……有点进入了虚空。墙中人来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Duviri was... built entirely out of stories that the Void plucked out of my head. Like a dream turned into a nightmare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 双衍王境……完全是由虚空从我的头脑中提取出的故事构建的。就像是美梦变成了噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: My whole life has been me clinging to the back end of a screaming train because of the decisions of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我的一生就像是因为别人的选择，而不得不紧抓着疾驰的列车。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: He - *it* - decided it'd be interesting to see what happened if the parents turned on their children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他——*它*——决定看看如果父母反过来攻击他们的孩子会发生什么有趣的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A video game where the pain and the death and the agony was *real* and the suffering was *mine.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 就像一款电子游戏，其中的痛苦、死亡和折磨都是*真实的*，那些苦难都是*属于我*的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I just fight as hard as I can to keep my moral compass and my head above water. One day at a time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我只能竭尽全力保持我的道德准则和头脑清醒。一天一天地过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Then it gifted the children with Void powers and...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 然后它赋予孩子们虚空的力量，接着……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: First the Zariman. Then Duviri. Then Ballas and the New War. Now this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 先是扎里曼，然后是双衍王境，接着是 Ballas 和新纪之战。现在是这个……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: One. Thing. After. Another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 事情。一个。接。一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm sure you're going to tell me it sounds awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我肯定你会告诉我这听起来很棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It was just like that, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 事实上，就是那样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A lot like you, at first, actually. Nightmares. Too much emotion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 起初和你差不多。做噩梦。情绪过于激动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I... just went numb, eventually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我……最后变得麻木了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Everybody's shit is relative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 每个人的问题都是相对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Anytime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 随时都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up, sweetheart?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 宝贝怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up, Zoomy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 极速小子怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up, buddy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哥们怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The game is a lot of fun to play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 游戏玩起来真的很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Everyone's enjoying being together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 大家都很享受在一起的时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They all said yes. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 他们都同意了。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I can't divulge my secrets. Then I'd have to kill you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不能透露我的秘密，否则我就得杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, and I have all I think I can get, so let's start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，我觉得能找到的人都找到了，所以我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No progress... I think it's time to give up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没有进展……我想是时候放弃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Quincy,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 昆西，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Eleanor,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 埃莉诺，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Aoi,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 碧，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lettie,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 莱蒂，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We shall not speak of what I owe him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我欠他的事咱们就别提了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Did you forget that I'm from the future? Like REALLY from the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你忘了我是来自未来的吗？真的是从很远的未来来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I assume they're animals...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我猜它们是动物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm so lost right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在完全搞不懂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ok?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oooh, like a kubrow. Kavats and kubrows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 噢，像库狛。库娃和库狛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Woof... woof?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 汪……汪？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No way. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不可能。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I think it's adorable lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我觉得很可爱，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I still have no idea what you're describing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我还是不知道你在描述什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But I think I know what you're describing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但我想我知道你在描述什么了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We call them kavats and kubrows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们把它们叫做库娃和库狛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Kavats are the... uh... kitties - like Kalymos. And kubrows are the dogs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 库娃是那种……呃……小猫咪——就像卡利莫斯。库狛就是狗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Kavats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 库娃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Kubrows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 库狛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I like them both equally, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 说实话，我两个都喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Let me guess - had a run in with a mean "cat" once?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 让我猜猜——你曾经遇到过一只恶"猫"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But they're intelligent, regal, independent, playful, beautiful... and can also be silly and cute and fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但它们聪明、高贵、独立、活泼、美丽……而且也可以很傻、可爱、有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lol. Must've been something you said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈。一定是你说错了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So... I take it you're a "dog" person?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这么说来……我猜你更喜欢狗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Have you ever heard the phrase "come on too strong?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你有没有听说过"过于热情"这个说法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, there's your problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯，那是你的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If "cats" are anything like kavats, you kinda just... gotta be chill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果"猫"与库娃有点像，你就得……保持冷静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: This conversation took a weird turn. :|
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这个谈话的走向变得有点奇怪了。:|

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Just don't start peeing on door jambs, yeah? :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 只是别开始在门框上撒尿，好吗？:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There's about 8,000 naughty things I could say right now... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 现在我脑子里有大约 8000 个污污的想法…… ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Let them come to you. Let them decide if they like you or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 让它们来找你。让它们自己决定喜不喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If you jump all over them, yeah, you're gonna get claws to the face. lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果你扑上去，嗯，你可能会被抓伤脸。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What are "dogs" and "cats?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么是"狗"和"猫"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lol Why're you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈你为什么要问这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm a morning person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是一个早起的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm a night person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是一个晚睡的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: They don't have pizza in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 在未来没有披萨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How can you, when you'll be in bed next to me? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么会呢，你到时会睡在我旁边的？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: lmao. Good point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈哈。说得好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I have other ways you can keep me up all night. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我知道有别的方法让你把我折腾一整夜哦。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: lmao. Good point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈哈。说得好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Those red salty cured meat disk things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那些红色的、咸的、腌制的肉片。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Those little round black ring things that are salty and a little squishy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那些圆形的黑色小环状物体，有点咸，有点软。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The roasted T-shaped things that are brown and a little earthy tasting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 烤过的 T 形东西，焦焦的，有点泥土的味道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The clear white stringy things that sometimes sting my eyes a bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这些透明的白色丝状物有时会刺激到我的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The yellowy cubes that are acidic and a little sharp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 黄色的方块，有点酸和味道有点冲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: FUTURE. I'm from the FUTURE, AMIR.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 未来。阿米尔，我来自未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Look, they didn't exactly teach us ANCIENT FOOD ITEMS in school!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 喂，学校里可没教我们这些古老的食物！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hello to you, too, sweetheart. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你好啊，亲爱的。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hello to you, too. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你好啊，哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: BRB. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 马上回来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If you don't work on it it won't get made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你不做的话，这游戏就做不出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: For yourself, obviously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 显然是为了你自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: For the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 为了六人组。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe you can put it online for other people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也许你可以将它放到网上给人玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I still feel like playing yourself in a game might help you cope with some of what's happened to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我还是觉得在游戏中扮演你自己可能帮你走出一些经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, I mean that you're making the game for you, because YOU need to create things. You have that drive to MAKE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，我的意思是你制作游戏是为了你自己，因为你需要创作。你有创作的动力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You've got a drive to learn. You want to make a game because you've never done it before. Maybe you're just bored now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你有学习的动力。你想做游戏是因为你从未尝试过。也许你现在只是觉得无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: But I'm also probably a shitty therapist given the circumstances of my life. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不过鉴于我的生活状况，我也可能是个糟糕的心理医生。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some people have that thing inside them that won't ever stop scratching at the walls until they let it out and make it real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有些人内心有那么一种东西，如果不让它释放出来变为现实，它就会不停地在心墙上抓挠

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe you've solved the problems and there's no more mountains to climb, so it's time to move onto the next thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也许你已经解决了问题，没有更多的困难需要克服，所以是时候转向下一个目标了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sometimes it comes out as sculptures, paintings, books, poems, songs... games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这种东西有时会变成雕塑、绘画、书籍、诗歌、歌曲……或游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Or you're just bored.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 或者你只是觉得无聊了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I hope so. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我希望如此。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You want to make things for the people you care about. Some people buy flowers. You try to code them from scratch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你想为你关心的人做一些事情。有些人会买花。你则试着从头开始编写代码。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You're a storyteller. And you want to tell your stories to your friends to make them laugh, or cry, or think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是一个会讲故事的人。你想向你的朋友讲述你的故事，让他们笑，哭，或思考。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some people have that thing inside them that won't ever stop scratching at the walls until they let it out and make it real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有些人内心有那么一种东西，如果不让它释放出来变为现实，它就会不停地在心墙上抓挠

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some people tell stories with pictures, like Quincy and his photography. Some tell them with words like Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有些人用照片讲述故事，比如昆西和他的摄影作品。有些人用文字讲述故事，比如埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sometimes it comes out as sculptures, paintings, books, poems, songs... games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这种东西有时会变成雕塑、绘画、书籍、诗歌、歌曲……或游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some tell them with games, like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有些人则用游戏来讲述故事，就像你一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yep. All the time in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有啊。在双衍王境里经常这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can't say that I have. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不能说我有。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm sure people would love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我相信人们会喜欢它的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Are you afraid they won't like it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你担心他们不喜欢吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Learning from criticism, even delivered badly, is one of the most important skills a person can have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哪怕是方式不当的批评，能从中学习也是非常重要的能力之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, you're probably right. I'd just give up now. Save yourself the pain, or just make the game for yourself and for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是的，你可能是对的。我的话会现在就放弃。免得自己受苦，或者只为自己和我们做这个游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And when someone's a creator, it's doubly important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对于创作者来说，这一点尤其重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Especially for storytellers like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 尤其是对于像你这样的讲故事的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some tell them with games, like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有些人则用游戏来讲述故事，就像你一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And stories are meant to be told to other people, whether they're good or bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 故事不管好坏，都是要讲给别人听的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some people tell stories with pictures, like Quincy and his photography. Some tell them with words like Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有些人用照片讲述故事，比如昆西和他的摄影作品。有些人用文字讲述故事，比如埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yep. All the time in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有啊。在双衍王境里经常这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can't say that I have. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不能说我有。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sometimes it comes out as sculptures, paintings, books, poems, songs... games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这种东西有时会变成雕塑、绘画、书籍、诗歌、歌曲……或游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: And creations aren't meant to live in a drawer or on a hard drive where no one can see them, whether they're good or bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 无论好坏，作品也不应该只存在于抽屉里或硬盘上，不被人看到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Some people have that thing inside them that won't ever stop scratching at the walls until they let it out and make it real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有些人内心有那么一一种东西，如果不让它释放出来变为现实，它就会不停地在心墙上抓挠

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's a vertical slice?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么是垂直切片？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wow, you work *fast.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哇，你工作速度*真快*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm sure the game is going to be fantastic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我相信这个游戏会很棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Well, if it is, then learn from it and try again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，如果是这样的话，那就从中吸取教训然后再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If it sucks, fix it and patch it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果它很差，那就修复它并打补丁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't know, I still think it's a silly waste of time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不知道，我还是觉得这挺傻的，纯粹浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yeah, what's up, sweetheart?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好的，亲爱的，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey, sorry, can't right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿，抱歉，现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You already did that with Quincy, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但你已经对昆西做过同样的事情了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: ROFL. Okay, I'm in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 笑死了。好，算我一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Uh oh...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 完了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Noooope I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 别，我可不参与。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Fine, fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 行，行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Never screw with a big media conglomerate. They have something worse than scaldra. Lawyers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 千万不要和大型媒体集团作对。他们有比军队更可怕的角色——律师。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey. :) lol Have you been at the chocolate sugar puff cereal again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿。:) 哈哈，你是不是又吃巧克力糖泡芙麦片了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That sounds ominous, everything okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来有点不妙，没事吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm really in the middle of something right now. Can it wait?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在正忙着一件事。可以等一下再说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Don't answer.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [不回答]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: All right, we can talk now, then. What's up, sweetheart?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，我们现在就谈吧。怎么了，亲爱的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, great, we'll talk later, then. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好，那好，那我们以后再谈。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey, babe. You got this. Slow down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿，宝贝。你可以的。慢慢来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: One word at a time. The space bar is your friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 一个词一个词来。逗号是你的好朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Please don't tell me you're naming the parazon that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 请不要告诉我你要给灭骸之刃起这个名字……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: WackyHacky 9000...?
Amir, I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Let him finish.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [让他说完]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I love you, too. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我也爱你。<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh...
[Don't answer.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [不回答]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I... I'm sorry, I'm just not ready for that kind of commitment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我……对不起，我还没有准备好承担这样的承诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: [Don't answer.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: [不回答]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Lol. That sounds fantastic. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈。听起来棒极了。 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Or you could put all that energy to better use... >:}
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 或者你可以把这些精力用在更好的地方上嘛……>:}

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Please don't tell me you're naming the parazon that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 请不要告诉我你要给灭骸之刃起这个名字……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: WackyHacky 9000...?
That... means more to me than you can imagine. And it's mutual. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这……对我来说意义非常大。我也这么觉得。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Honestly, you're the most annoying thing I've ever met in my LIFE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 说实话，你是我这辈子遇到的最烦的人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yo!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哟！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cool...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay... and?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧……然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There must be something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你肯定还能找到事做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Nothing? You could set a new high score on Caliber Chicks?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没了吗？你可以在《火力女兵》里创下新高？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ollie's Crash Course?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 《奥利的极速赛道》呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We could "hang out?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们可以"一起玩？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wanna grab pizza?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你想吃披萨吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You could work on your Fables & Frontiers expansion campaign?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 或许你可以接着扩展《寓言与边疆》的剧本？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wait? Didn't Arthur ask you to audit the inventory??
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等等？亚瑟不是让你去清点库存吗？？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Is there something you're avoiding?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你是在逃避什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也许是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Maybe you should just do it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也许你就应该去做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Do that you won't be bored any more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 做那个你就不会无聊了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You'll be done in, like, two minutes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 也就两分钟，你就点完了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I've seen you do that job in no time at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我见过你很快就做完那件事了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Do it and it'll be done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 去点点就完事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hey, how goes? Did you audit the inventory yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嘿，最近怎么样？盘点完库存了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, I'm done with the text adventure. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，我已经玩够了文字冒险游戏。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, sorry. I had to see what would happen. I'll be good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对不起，对不起。我只是想看看会发生什么。我会好好表现的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Schmaudit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 盘什么屁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Game?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Always!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 随叫随到！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't have time for games right now and you don't either. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我现在没时间玩游戏，你也没有。 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Uh... yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呃……我想玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, what is this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，这是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wait... How did I get here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等等……我是怎么到这里的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I... Uh... I look around
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我……呃……我看看四周

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Pass. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好的，没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Examine the bones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 检查骨头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Rattle the bars.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 摇晃栏杆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What's in the bucket?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 桶里有什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That's not going to do me much good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这对我没什么帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I wonder if this would make a good weapon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不知道这东西能不能当武器用？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can I use that piece of metal to pick the lock?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我可以用那块金属片来撬锁吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: *The* master of unlocking? How convenient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: *那位*开锁大师？真方便啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Hold up? Since when did you have Grineer in Fables & Frontiers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等等？从什么时候开始《寓言与边疆》里有 Grineer 了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Shake the bars harder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 更用力地摇晃栏杆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yikes. Um. Say sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哎呀。嗯。说声对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, keep going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 抱歉，继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Took me by surprise, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 真是出乎我的意料，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我很喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A Grineer? What is this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 一个 Grineer？哪来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Let's do this bare handed. Punch the bastard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我们来徒手解决吧。揍那个混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Throw the bucket at him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 拿桶扔他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Stab him!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 刺他！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Uh... run!?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呃……赶紧跑！？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Lotus can take care of herself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: Lotus 能照顾好她自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What?! This is awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么？！这太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh, yes I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦，是的，我会找到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Uh... sure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呃……好的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir. This has been fun, but I have work to do and you have inventory to audit. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔。这挺好玩的，但我还有工作要做，你也有库存要盘点。 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Did you just pity-pass me?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你刚才是不是故意放我一马？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Oh, yes I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦，是的，我会找到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What?! This is awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么？！这太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Lotus can take care of herself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: Lotus 能照顾好她自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, I need to know what happens next in text adventure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，我想知道接下来的文字冒险游戏有什么内容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: So, how's the inventory audit going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那么，仓库库存盘点进展如何？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, I'm done with the text adventure. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，我已经玩够了文字冒险游戏。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sorry, sorry. I had to see what would happen. I'll be good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 对不起，对不起。我只是想看看会发生什么。我会好好表现的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, I didn't even finish the last one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，我连上一个都没完成呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Arthur really does want that inventory audit done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 亚瑟真的很想完成库存盘点这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Let's see it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 一起来看看！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Close the door and wait for help while I complete my inventory audit. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 把门关上等待救援，我去完成我的库存盘点。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can I search the guard's body?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我可以搜查守卫的尸体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I want to go out into the hall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想去大厅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Explore the dungeon hall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 探索地牢大厅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Take the torch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 拿起火把。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What happens if I try to go out the exit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果我试着走出出口会怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Look closer at the boards.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 凑近看看这些木板。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Tear down the boards.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 拆掉木板。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yes!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没错！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: How about you finish your actual work? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你的实际工作完成的怎么样？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: No, this is getting boring. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 不，这越来越无聊了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 为什么不试试呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A tunnel, out of a dungeon? Pretty convenient, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 从地牢延伸出来的隧道？很方便吧，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There better not be anything creepy in there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 里面最好别有什么恐怖的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm going in head first!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我要一头扎进去！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: ... Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: ……想去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我先撤了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If there's only one way forward, let's go in the tunnel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果只有一条路可走，那就走隧道吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I guess I'm going in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想我要进去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Let me guess - the door is locked?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 让我猜猜——门是锁着的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can I open the door?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我能开门吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Don't tell me it's rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 别告诉我是老鼠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's rats isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是老鼠吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Kick rat butt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 跟鼠群拼了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wave my torch at them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 向它们挥舞我的火把。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Have you shown this part to Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你给莱蒂看过这部分内容吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Pick up the necklace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 捡起项链。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ask the rat who gave him the necklace?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 问问那只老鼠是谁给了他项链？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: A key? Does it open the door?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 钥匙？它能打开那扇门吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: That's it?? I'm just getting invested.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 就这？？我才刚开始投入。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amazing. So how 'bout that audit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 太棒了。所以你现在要不要去盘点库存？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What was the flint for? I thought my torch was going to go out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 打火石是做什么用的？我以为我的火把要熄灭了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Last time I checked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 据我所知是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Without getting over my head on Eternalism, yeah, I'm from the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果我们不深入探讨《永恒论》的话，那么是的，我来自未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你这话是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Zaznog The Imbiber could drink you under the table.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 扎兹诺格这位酒神能把你喝趴到桌子下面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I hate to let you down...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我真不忍心让你失望……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: There's the Sentients but I'm pretty sure that's not what you mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 有 Sentient，但我敢肯定你指的不是这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Piston oil, mostly. He loves piston oil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 主要是活塞油。他特别喜欢活塞油。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Glorp Brandy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 格洛普白兰地

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Never.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 从不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Busted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 被抓住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If there was, nobody ever told me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果真有，也没人告诉过我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If the Orokin discovered aliens, they kept it to themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果奥罗金人发现了外星人，他们会对此保密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The Orokin did worse, so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 奥罗金的情况更糟，所以……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I wouldn't go that far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我不会说得那么绝对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 又来了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Is this about the inventory audit?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是在说库存盘点吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Door?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 门？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Try opening it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那试着开一下呗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Let me know when it's ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你弄好了叫我一声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: We're so busy, Amir. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，我们太忙了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Whoa, there, slow down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哎哎，慢点慢点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wait, is this about Fables & Frontiers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 等等，你是在说《寓言与边疆》？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: This is the thing you're making in order to avoid the doing thing you're supposed to be doing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你这是在拿这个当借口来逃避你该干的正事吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You see what the problem is here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那你明白问题出在哪了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I don't follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我没太明白你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If what's not great?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 什么不精彩？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Jungle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 丛林。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Martian ruin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 火星遗迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Asteroid base.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 小行星基地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You don't say. What about an Asteroid base?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 可不是嘛。小行星基地怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Jungle??
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 丛林？？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay then. Venus after it's terraformed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，那……改造过的金星。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: The queens even have a fortress on one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 女皇们甚至还在上面建了一座堡垒呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: All over the system.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 整个星系到处都是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Last idea, and if you don't like this we're done. Asteroid base!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 最后一个点子了，要是你还不喜欢我可不提了。小行星基地！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Not today. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 今天不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: It's ready? Let's go!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 已经写好了？那走起！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Return to the dungeon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 返回地下城。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Take the elevator.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 坐电梯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: haha... Fine, take that elevator.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哈哈……好吧，那坐电梯吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ignore the cries, find a way out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 忽略惨叫声，去找出路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Go to the crying man.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 去找那名惨叫的男子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ask, "what's up?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 问他："你怎么了？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Examine the man.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 检查这个男子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Examine the room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 检查房间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Control Panel?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 操作控制面板？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Wirecutters?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 拿起剪线钳？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Crowbar?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 拿起撬棍？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Use the crowbar to smash the control panel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 用撬棍砸烂控制面板。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Toss the crowbar into the turbine blades.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 将撬棍扔进涡轮叶片。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Keep looking around
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 继续环顾四周

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Cut the wires.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 剪掉电缆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Circular glasses, what's his name?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 戴着圆墨镜的这位，他叫什么名字？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Settle down there big guy. What's this handsome man's name?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 冷静点，大个子。这位帅哥叫什么名字？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Sounds familiar. What were they doing to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 听起来有些耳熟。他们对你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Okay, Zabir, how do we save the Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，扎比尔，我们怎么救 Lotus。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Amir, what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 阿米尔，什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: You made the Lotus evil?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你把 Lotus 变成反派？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What comes next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 接下来是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Can't right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 现在不行，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: If it's ready, I'm ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如果你的游戏准备好了，那我也准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: I wanna learn more about that handsome Zabir. Sounds like you could have some competition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我想多了解一下那个帅气的扎比尔。看来你有竞争对手了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Ask Zabir about the rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 向扎比尔询问老鼠的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You wake to find yourself in a dark, dank, dungeon cell deep below ground. In the hall beyond the bars a guard snores. Sleep apnea? He should probably have that checked out. You don't remember much, but you know you need to get out."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你醒来时发现自己身处地底深处一间阴暗潮湿的地牢。在铁栏杆外的走廊里，一名守卫正在打鼾。是睡眠呼吸暂停吗？他最好去检查一下。你记不清太多细节，但你知道必须逃出去。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: say yes

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The open wall of the cell is blocked by old iron bars, and the door is secured with a rusty old lock. The guard's snoring grows louder, phlegmier."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "牢房敞开的墙壁被老旧的铁栏杆挡住，门上锁着一把生锈的旧锁。守卫的鼾声越来越响，带着浓重的痰音。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: it's a text based adventure! in KIM! play along.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Try as you might, you still don't remember how you got here."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "无论你怎么努力，你还是记不起自己是怎么来到这里的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You have no memory of how you got here."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你完全不记得自己是怎么来到这里的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "In the dim torch light you make out a filthy bucket, a bench, and the barren bones of some long dead cell mate still chained to the wall."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "在昏暗的火把光线下，你依稀看到一个肮脏的桶、一张长凳，以及某个早已死去、仍被铁链锁在墙上的牢友的枯骨。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The leg bone is dry as a..." umm
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "腿骨干得像……"嗯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You furiously shake the cell bars."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你愤怒地摇晃着牢房的铁栏杆。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "A little voice in the back of your mind says 'hey, assclown, this is your last shot. You still can't remember how you got here. Quit dicking around.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你脑海深处有个声音在说：‘嘿，蠢货，这是你最后的机会了。你到现在还记不清自己是怎么到这里的。别胡闹了。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Dry as a thing that's been sitting there for decades. As you pick it up the shackles crash to the ground and break apart. Among the pieces is a jagged shard of metal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "干得像个放在那里几十年的东西。当你拿起它时，锁链摔到地上碎裂开来。碎片中有一块锯齿状的金属碎片。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "This stirs the guard. You hear him groan and grant as he stands and slowly walks into view."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "这引起了守卫的注意。你听到他咕哝着，随后起身，缓慢地走入你的视线范围。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The bucket is still disgusting."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "这个桶还是那么恶心。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "A foul stench wafting from the bucket instantly lets you know what it is used for."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "从桶里飘出的刺鼻臭味，立刻让你明白它用来做什么的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: yep, we're done here
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好的，我们在这里结束了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "An ancient god has had enough of your shit. You have been struck by lightning. You are dead. The end."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "一位远古之神已经受够了你的胡闹。你被闪电击中。你死了。游戏结束。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "A massive Grineer, clad in armor, stands before you. He does not appreciate being woken from his slumber."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "一个身材壮硕穿着护甲的 Grineer 站在你面前。他可不喜欢被人从睡梦中叫醒。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "What are you going to do?'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你打算怎么做？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You examine the shard of metal. 'Not bad,' you think, 'this would stab as good as anything I've stabbed with before' as you pick it up."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你仔细观察这块金属碎片。‘还不错，'你心想，‘这东西刺人效果应该不比我之前用过的任何武器差。'说着，你便捡起了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You gingerly try and work the lock. Your tools are crude, but you instinctively know what you are doing- you are the master of unlocking."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你小心翼翼地尝试撬开锁。你的工具虽然简陋，但你本能地知道自己在做什么——你是开锁大师。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "A little voice in the back of your mind says 'hey, assclown, this is your last shot. The bucket is still disgusting. Quit dicking around.'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The guard is having none of this. He pulls the keys from his waste and unlocks the cell gate and barges into the cell. Instinctively, you reach for your weapon but its not there, because you're a prisoner in a cell, and of course they've taken your weapon."

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The guard is unimpressed, he hoarks and spits into your cell and then turns to go back to his stool. Within minutes, the snoring rumbles through the dungeon once more."

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 真的吗，这就是你的举动吗？？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You carefully sneak out of the cell. To your right is a large door, the exit. It is open just a crack. You hear more Grineer guards mulling about on the other side. To your left the dungeon hall continues but it is too dark to see."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你小心翼翼地溜出牢房。你的右边是一扇大门，那是出口。门只开了一条缝。你听到很多 Grineer 守卫在另一边窸窸窣窣。你的左边是地牢大厅，但是太黑了，看不清。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: fine
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You search the guards body again but find nothing more of value. You think about eating the moldy biscuit until a catch a whiff of it and quickly reconsider. "
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你再次搜查守卫的尸体，但没有发现任何有价值的东西。你想吃那块发霉的饼干，但你闻到了它的味道，便很快改变了主意。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You feel around the guards body for anything of value. There's nothing but a flint-stone and a moldy bisquit. You take the flint."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你在守卫身上翻找有没有值钱的东西。除了一块打火石和一块发霉的饼干，什么都没有。你拿走了打火石。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You close the door and wait for help, but no helps arrive. Instead the guards come and they get really mad because you weren't supposed to kill their friend and so they do all sorts of horrible and mean things to you until you die a terrible, senseless death."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你关上门等待救援，但没有人来救你。相反，守卫来了，他们气愤于你杀死了他们的朋友，于是对你做了各种可怕而卑鄙的事情，直至你无人问津地惨死。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "A torch hangs on the wall. What do you do?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "墙上挂着一支火把。你会怎么做？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You can see a little further into the dungeon now. What do you do?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "现在你可以看到地牢里更远一点的地方了。你会怎么做？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: happy now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 现在开心了吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You pull the torch off the wall"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你把火把从墙上拔下来"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You try to open door gently but it creaks so loudly that the guards are instantly alerted to your escape attempt. They are not impressed with what you did to their commrade."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你试着轻轻打开门，但门吱吱作响，守立刻警觉到你企图逃跑。他们并不喜欢你对他们同伴的所作所为。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "A little voice in the back of your mind says 'hey, assclown, this is your last shot. The guard still has nothing good on him. Quit dicking around."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你脑海深处有个声音在说：‘嘿，蠢货，这是你最后的机会了。这守卫身上还是没有好东西。别胡闹了。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You fumble into the darkness searching for... something... with each step you feel more lost. Suddenly you trip over a ledge."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你在黑暗中摸索，寻找着……什么……每走一步，你都感到更加迷茫。突然，你被一个边界绊倒了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You take the torch, hoping the flame does not go out. You walk down the corridor. You pass empty cells, each one as barren as the last."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你拿起火把，希望火焰不会熄灭。你经过走廊。经过空荡荡的牢房。每一间都和上一间一样荒芜。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Your death is swift, but not swift enough to be painless. It hurts, lots."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你死得很快，但还没快到无痛的地步。很痛，很痛。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: yep, we're done here
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好的，我们在这里结束了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "An ancient god has had enough of your shit. You have been struck by lightning. You are dead. The end."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "一位远古之神已经受够了你的胡闹。你被闪电击中。你死了。游戏结束。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You are falling. You have just enough time to regret not bringing a light source with you before you hit the ground with a splat."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你正在坠落。在‘砰'的一声落地之前，你有足够的时间后悔没带上火把。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "As you carefully creep toward the end of the hall, your torch light begins to reveal a pit of darkness in front of you. You come to stand over a cistern. Pearing down you cannot see the bottom. If not for the torch you surely would have fallen to your doom."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "当你小心翼翼地爬向大厅尽头时，火把的光亮开始在你面前显现出一个黑暗的深渊。你站在一个蓄水池上方。向下望去，你看不到底部。要不是有火把你肯定会摔个狗吃屎。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You look around and notice a a bunch of rotten boards barricading something."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你环顾四周，发现一堆烂木板挡着什么。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: ohhh... tough break. wanna try again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦……真倒霉。要不要再试一次？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You have died horribly. ...Again. Want to try again? ... Again?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你死得很惨。……再来一次。想再试一次吗？……再来一次？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You try to shine your torch through the cracks. A draft of wind makes your flame flicker. You hear the sound of water dripping."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你试着用火把照亮木板的缝隙。一阵风吹过，火苗一闪一闪。你听到水滴的声音。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Using all your strength you peel the boards back to reveal what is left of a some rusted out iron bars. There's room to squeeze through. Beyond, a low, narrow, tunnel."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你用尽全身力气把木板剥开，露出一些生锈的铁栏杆。还有空间可以挤过去。再过去，是一条低矮狭窄的隧道。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: right that... your probably right
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 是啊……你可能是对的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You Have Died Horribly, Part Three: The DLC."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你死得很惨，第三部分： DLC。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: okay this is getting extremely silly and THAT'S BY MY STANDARDS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 好吧，从我的标准来看，这越来越愚蠢了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但一旦我完成了，我会回馈给你更多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: your face is getting boring
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你的脸越来越无趣了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但俗话说得好，如果你不能改掉缺点，那就把它当成特点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 勇气可嘉……所以你要进去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 拜托，这是用来通风的，即使是中世纪幻想生物 Grineer 也是需要新鲜空气的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 但一旦我完成了，我会回馈给你更多
