/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 算了。你到底还想不想去？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "There are blood-splatters everywhere. Clearly, other former prisoners have tried less... effective methods. So from their fatal trial-and-error, you can deduce what to do!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "到处都是血迹斑斑。显然，其他曾经的囚犯尝试过一些不太……有效的方法。所以从他们致命的试验和错误中，你可以推断出该怎么做！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "What do you want to do?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你想干嘛？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You squat down and enter the tunnel. Crawling painfully slowly for what seems like forever. It's cold and wet and really, really, dirty."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你蹲下来，进入隧道。痛苦地慢慢爬行，似乎永远都爬不完。这里又冷又湿，而且非常非常脏。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: FOURTH TIME'S THE CHARM
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 四转功成

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: probably for the best this was getting to be animal cruelty lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这可能是最好的结局了，虽然有点像虐待动物，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Eventually, the tunnel ends. Relieved you stand up and look around."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "最终，爬出隧道了。你如释重负，站起来环顾四周。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You find yourself in a large empty room. Some sort of cellar, maybe? The only thing of interest is a heavy metal door."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你发现自己在一个空荡荡的大房间里。也许是个地窖？唯一值得注意的是一扇沉重的金属门。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The door is locked."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "门是锁着的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You start to notice a faint sound. Is it... squeaking?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你开始注意到一种微弱的声音。是……吱吱声吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: it's FRIGGIN RATS!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 就是该死的老鼠！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: i mean...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The squeaking sound grows louder, followed by a pitter patter of claws on stone. Suddenly, your torch casts a shadow. A rat the size of a cat... no... a dog comes running at you."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "吱吱声越来越大，接着是爪子拍打石头的嗒嗒声。突然，你的火把投射出一片阴影。一只猫……不……狗那么大的老鼠向你冲来。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "But it's not alone, they are coming from everywhere."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "但不只它一只，它们从四面八方涌来。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The rats encircle you. You stand tall, ready to fight, but they don't attack. Instead the biggest one bows its neck to you. You realize it's wearing a necklace. The silver chain slips off and lands on the ground. The rat looks as if to say, 'this is for you.' "
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "老鼠包围了你。你站了起来，准备战斗，但它们没有攻击。相反，最大的那只向你弯下了脖子。你发现它戴着一条项链。银链滑落，掉在地上。老鼠好像在说：‘这是给你的。‘ "

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: no and i don't intend to
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 没有，我也不打算给她看

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: rats are coming at you, what's your plan?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 老鼠向你扑来，你有什么打算？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You pick up the necklace. On it's chain is key."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你拿起项链。项链上有钥匙。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The rat does not speak. It is a rat, after all."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "老鼠不会说话。毕竟它是只老鼠。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The rats turn and scurry away. Whoever gave them that key, knew you were down here. There's only one person with such power... The Lotus."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "老鼠们转身一溜烟跑了。给他们钥匙的人知道你在下面，只有一个人有这样的能力……Lotus。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You insert the key in the door, it works. You squint, painfully, as the bright light from the other side streams into your eyes. You can't believe what you are looking at..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你把钥匙插进门里，门开了。门那边的强光射进来，你痛苦地眯起眼睛。你简直不敢相信眼前的一切……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "As you turn the key given to you by a surprisingly cordial gang of oversized rats, you pray that whatever is beyond the door is better than the dungeon that lay behind you."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "当你转动那群意外友好的巨鼠送给你的钥匙时，你心中暗自祈祷，门后的一切会比身后的地牢更美好。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You find yourself in front of a large service elevator. This is no mere dungeon?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你发现自己站在一座巨大的货梯前。原来这里不只是地下城那么简单？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You turn around and look at the dungeon, thinking to yourself ‘going back in there is a dumb idea.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你转身看了看地下城，心想‘我是不是傻，居然还想再进去。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You ride the elevator up. Through its open cage you can see the stone walls of the dungeon being replaced by more and more advanced technology. You wonder again, ‘where the hell am I?'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你坐上电梯往上走。透过电梯的金属栅栏，你可以看到地下城的石墙正被越来越先进的科技所取代。你再次疑惑：‘我到底在哪儿？'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The elevator exits into a hall of gurgling machines, and giant tubes. Is this some sort of laboratory?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "电梯停在一个大厅，里面充满咕哝作响的机器和巨大的管道。这是某种实验室吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: From a room down the hall, you hear a man crying out in pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 此时，走廊尽头的一间房间中，传来一名男子痛苦的惨叫声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You search around the hall for anything of value, but the cries become impossible to ignore. You are drawn to this man and must help him."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你在大厅里四处寻找值钱的东西，但那惨叫声越来越凄厉，让你无法忽视。你被吸引过去，心想得帮一下他。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You walk down the hall following the source of the agonizing screams. You enter a large mechanical room, there you see a man. A not unattractive man, who is strapped to a machine. Bolts of electricity dance out of his fingers feeding a giant turbine."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你沿着走廊，循着痛苦惨叫声走去。你走进一间宽敞的机械室，在那里看到了一名男子。一个相貌平平的男子，被绑在一台机器上。电流从他的指尖迸发而出，源源不断地为一台巨大的涡轮机供电。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The man is strapped to a raised platform, arms splayed out. Attached to his fingertips are probes that twist together into a heavy gauge cable that lead to a giant turbine. Arcs of electricity dance nimbly from his hands."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "这名男子被绑在一个高高的平台上，双臂张开。他的指尖连接着探针，这些探针扭结成一根粗大的电缆，连接着一台巨大的涡轮机。一道道电弧在他手中灵活地舞动。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Between cries and zaps the man manages to say, "STOP... THE... TURBINES!!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 在惨叫声和电击之间，男子艰难地吐出几个字："关……掉……涡轮机！！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You look around the room for something useful. You see a bench with tools. A crowbar. Giant wirecutters. A control panel."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你环顾房间，寻找有用的东西。你看到了一个放着工具的长凳。上面有一根撬棍、大型剪线钳、一个控制面板。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: What do you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: i'm
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You pick up the hefty crowbar, it's a solid tool. The muffled cries from the man grow more intense."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你拿起那根粗大的撬棍，这是个很结实的工具。男子压抑的惨声越来越大了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: i'm gonna have to stop you before you give me carpal tunnel or something
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我得先暂停一下，不然你再这样下去会让我得鼠标手

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The wire cutters are industrial strength, and look like they could cut through just about anything."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "这把是工业级别的剪线钳，看起来几乎什么都能剪断。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: this is either abuse or you're REEAAAAAAAALLY bad at this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你这是在折磨我，还是说你真的不会玩啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You probably don't want to mess with that again."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你大概不想再碰那个玩意了吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You try to use the control panel but it's locked behind a security protocol that even you can't hack. You realize you're going to have to do this manually."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你试图操作控制面板，但它被安全协议锁住了，连你也无法破解。你意识到只能手动解决这个问题了作。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "With a might thrust you toss the crowbar into the turbine. A massive cacophony of grinding gears and pistons fills the room. As the turbine's spin slows to a crawl."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你猛地一抬手，把撬棍扔进涡轮机。房间里顿时响起齿轮和活塞的摩擦声。涡轮机的转速也慢了下来。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: sooooooo we're gonna skip ahead
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 所以咱们直接跳剧情吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The man slumps down in relief. Get me out of here."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "那男子如释重负地瘫倒在地。说道：快救我出去。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: AHEM
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 嗯哼

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The wire cutters make quick work of the cables attached to the man. With his arms free, he is able to remove his restraints."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "剪线钳轻松剪断了连在男子身上的电缆。他的双臂解脱后，开始解开剩余的束缚。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You place the blade of the wirecutters on the arcing wires and immediately regret it. The current flows through the wire cutters into your body sending you flying back."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你把剪线钳的刀口对准带电电线，立刻就后悔了。电流通过剪线钳流入你的身体，把你击飞了出去。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "That didn't work so well last time."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "上次这招的效果可不怎么样。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "As you smash the control panel, the trapped man seems to scream at you. He did not like that you did that."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "当你砸碎控制面板时，被困的男子似乎朝你怒吼起来。他并不喜欢你的做法。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: ::CLEARS THROAT::
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: （清嗓子）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Removing his circular sunglasses, the man takes a long look at his saviour."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "男子摘下圆形墨镜，久久地注视着自己的救命恩人。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You come to on the floor. The man is still in pain and your hair now stands straight up."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你躺在地上慢慢恢复意识。那个男子还在痛苦中，而你的头发现在都竖了起来。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Miraculously, somehow, the turbine EXPLODES under the force of the man's sheer power!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "奇迹般地，涡轮机竟被男子纯粹的力量引爆！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Removing his circular glasses, the man takes a long look at his savior."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "男子摘下圆形墨镜，久久地注视着自己的救命恩人。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "His gaze is piercing."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "他的目光很锐利。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: err i mean
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 呃，我是说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You notice his strong hands, ample foreams, and wirery legs. 'Built for speed' you think with eyebrows raised."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你注意到他结实的双手、饱满的前臂和紧实的双腿。你挑了挑眉，心想‘速度型的身材'。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Name's Zabir. He says, confidently."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "叫我扎比尔。他自信地说道。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Removing his circular glasses, the man takes a long look at the person who was trying to save him."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "男子摘下圆形墨镜，久久地注视着那个刚才试图救他的家伙。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "'Harvesting me for my energy. I'm very electric, but you probably noticed that already.' Zabir says."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "‘榨取我的能量。我的电力十足，你应该已经注意到了。'扎比尔说道。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: Zabir is shocked. "Save the Lotus? She's the one who put me here! We need to get off this asteroid!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 扎比尔震惊了。"救 Lotus？就是她把我放到这里来的！我们得离开这颗小行星！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: that's what i call a plot twist. bam.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这才叫剧情反转。砰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我哪知道啊。我还得琢磨琢磨

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 喂，未来人，想玩我的游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 这我不会怪你，他确实挺迷人的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: here goes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 那我开始了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You stand in the middle of the electrical lab with the now free Zabir. He looks at you, 'there's no time to waste, follow me.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你和已经重获自由的扎比尔站在电气实验室中央。他看着你，说道：‘没时间了，跟我来。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "He leads you through corridor after corridor. He knows this asteroid like the back of his hand, every guard and their movements."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "他带你穿过一条又一条走廊。他对这颗小行星了如指掌，清楚每一名守卫和他们的动向。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir is shocked. 'The rats found you? That's amazing. It worked. Check it.' Zabir holds up an intricately embossed gold whistle. 'Rat Queen gave it to me. We need to find her.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔听后大吃一惊。‘老鼠找到你了？太棒了。居然成了。看这个。'扎比尔举起一只精致的金哨子。‘这是鼠后给我的。我们得去找她。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You ask Zabir how he got here, 'No time for that,' he says, ‘we need to focus on getting out of here.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你问扎比尔是怎么到这里来的，‘现在没空说这些，'他说，‘我们先想办法逃出去。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir looks back, 'Taking you to the hangar bay. We steal a ship and we get as far away from here as possible. Find the Rat Queen.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔回头看了你一眼：‘带你去机库。我们偷一艘船，能逃多远逃多远。然后去找鼠后。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "'She gave me this whistle. The rats listen to it. She's my friend. She's not always nice, but she cares.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "‘她给了我这个哨子。老鼠们都听它的。她是我的朋友。虽然她有时候不太友好，但她很关心我。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: i value my life too much to risk that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我还挺惜命的，才不会冒这个险

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: any resemblance to people real or imagined is merely a coincidence
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 如有雷同，纯属巧合

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "With Zabir's help you zigzag through the asteroid's corridors. He deftly dodges guards and security cameras."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "在扎比尔的帮助下，你们在小行星的走廊间一路曲折穿行。他巧妙地避开了守卫和监控摄像头。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Eventually, you come to a large door. Zabir signals to get low. You both crouch down as sneak into the ship's hangar."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "最后，你们来到一扇大门前。扎比尔示意你低下身子。你们俩一起蹲下，潜入飞船的机库。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You crouch in the shadow of a pillar. Grineer guards can be heard nearby."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你蹲在一根柱子的阴影中。能听到附近 Grineer 守卫的声音。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "What do you do?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你打算怎么办？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Without an ounce of self-preservation or forethought you run out into the open. A group of guards on the other side starts blasting. You charge head long into a stream of bullets that kill you instantly. Zabir shakes his head at your senseless act of stubborn bravery."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "毫无自保意识，也没有一丝犹豫，你冲进了空旷的地方。对面的一群守卫开始扫射。密集弹雨迎面而至，你当场毙命。扎比尔对你这种愚蠢的莽夫行为摇了摇头。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You peek around the corner and survey the area."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你探头从拐角处往下看，仔细观察了一下周围的环境。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: wanna try again and not get yourself insta killed this time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 要不要再试一次，然后这次别一开始就被秒杀了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "A Railjack is parked in the center of the hangar. The ramp into the Railjack is blocked by a guard. On one side of the hangar a dozen Grineer are busy playing a raucous game of dice. A few feet in front of you is a desk with a control panel."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "机库中央停着一艘航道星舰。通往航道星舰的舷梯被一名守卫挡住了。机库一侧，有十来个 Grineer 正热火朝天地玩骰子游戏。距离你几步远，有一张配有控制面板的桌子。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "'To get out, we need to first open the hangar bay doors,' Zabir whispers."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "‘要想出去，得先打开机库的大门，'扎比尔低声说道。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "What do you do this time?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "这次你打算怎么办？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir looks at you. 'Got any bright ideas?'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔看着你。‘有什么好主意吗？'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You get to the control panel, but not before an attentive guard notices. You try to put your hands up to surrender but they shoot you anyways, because Grineer a mean like that."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你来到控制面板前，但被一名警觉的守卫发现了。你试图举起双手投降，结果他们还是开枪打死了你，因为 Grineer 就是这么狠。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: oh sure when there’s danger you send in amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 哦当然，有危险的时候就知道推阿米尔出去

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir picks up the whistle and plays one long note. You hear nothing but breath. You sit and wait, but nothing happens. Not rats, nothing. Zabir shrugs."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔拿起哨子，吹出一个长音。你什么也听不到，只有呼吸声。你们坐等了一会，但什么也没发生。没有老鼠，什么也没出现。扎比尔耸了耸肩。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You make a run for the ship, but the ramp guard spots you and opens fire. Your day, and life, ends painfully."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你冲向飞船，但舷梯的守卫发现了你并向你开火。你的这一天，乃至你的人生，就这样痛苦地结束了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: i mean zabir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 我是说扎比尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Then you hear it, a crunching sound. Like chewing. Suddenly rats are bursting out of the vents all around the hangar. The Grineer guards shriek like schoolchildren and open fire. Bullets are going everywhere."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "突然，你听到一阵嘎吱嘎吱的声音，像在啃东西。突然间，老鼠从机库周围的通风口窜了出来。Grineer 守卫尖叫得像小学生一样，然后乱枪扫射。子弹四处乱飞。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: you'll be back
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你会回来的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: fine
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 行吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The rats have the guards distracted. What now?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "老鼠分散了守卫的注意力。现在怎么办？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You yell out, 'Zabir, get him!' while pointing at the ramp guard."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你一边指着舷梯守卫，一边大喊‘扎比尔，干掉他！'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Against his better judgment, Zabir bravely dashes in. Even he isn't fast enough to go unnoticed. The guards open fire and Zabir is tragically killed."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "明知这不是明智之举，扎比尔还是勇敢地冲了进去。但即使他再快，也没能瞒过守卫的眼睛。守卫开枪射击，扎比尔不幸身亡。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir dashes up to the guard and zaps him. He falls limply."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔冲向守卫，电了他一下。对方瘫软倒地。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You sneak over to the control desk and try to operate the console while doing your best to stay hidden. You manage to get trigger the bay doors to open."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你悄悄溜到控制台，试图操作控制台，同时尽量藏好自己。你成功启动了机库大门的开关。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: game over man
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 游戏结束

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Distracted by the rats, the guards don't even notice."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "守卫们正被老鼠吸引注意，根本没注意到你。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: one more try? keep zabir alive this time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 再试一次？这次让扎比尔活下来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir waves at you to get the hangar doors open."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔向你挥手，示意你打开机库门。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You sense your chance and sprint to the Railjack."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你感觉到机会来了，并冲向航道星舰。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: you're killing me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: 你可真折磨死我了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You look at Zabir and say, 'I hope you know how to fly this thing,' and Zabir says, 'I don't, but you do.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你看着扎比尔说，‘希望你会开这玩意，'扎比尔说，‘我不会，不过你会啊。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir points at the ramp guard."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔指了指舷梯守卫。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "You power on the ship and just as you're about to press the button to bring up the ramp and close the door, Zabir says, 'Wait! We can't leave them.'"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "你启动飞船，正要按下按钮收起舷梯并关上门时，扎比尔说，‘等等！我们不能丢下它们。'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Zabir holds up the whistle and blows."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "扎比尔举起哨子吹了一声。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "'OVERRULED!' says Zabir."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "‘驳回！'扎比尔说。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "Seconds later a dozens of rats stream onto the ship. Zabir looks at you, and screams, ‘GO!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "几秒钟后，成群的老鼠涌上飞船。扎比尔转头朝你大喊：‘走！'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "The ship lifts off. The Grineer open fire but their bullets bounce off the mighty Railjack as it exits the hangar."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "飞船升空了。Grineer 疯狂扫射，但子弹在坚固的航道星舰冲出机库时，全部被弹开。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "As rats scurry around the bridge you look out at the vastness of space, and then you confidently say, 'RAILDRIVE, ENGAGE.' As the Railjack flashes into the distance."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "当老鼠在舰桥上四处乱窜，你望向浩瀚的太空，然后你信心满满地说，‘航道驱舰，启动。'与此同时，航道星舰一闪而过，消失在远方。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.text: "FIN."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/JabirRomance.zhText: "完结。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hey, Kaya. Happy birthday!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嘿，卡娅。生日快乐！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Happy birthday, Kaya. How's it feel to be older?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 生日快乐，卡娅。又老了一岁感觉怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hey, Kaya. Happy birthday!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嘿，卡娅。生日快乐！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Happy birthday, Kaya. How's it feel to be older?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 生日快乐，卡娅。又变老了一岁感觉怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Happy birthday, Kaya. Planning a "Party of your Lifetime" today? Balloons? Streamers? The whole deal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 生日快乐，卡娅。今天在准备一场"终身难忘的派对"吗？气球？饰带？还有其他所有派对必备品？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Got any plans for your birthday today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你今天有什么生日计划吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What do you kids do for birthdays in this era?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你们这个时代的小孩过生日都做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Pro tip: Save your birth date on something super important. You'll forget it in like... 500 years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 专业提示：把你的生日日期记在一个非常重要的东西上。你在 500 年后……大概就会忘了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Good day to you too, listen kid, it’s not that simple.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你好啊，听着，孩子，事情没那么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Let's say it's just me. Keeps it simpler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 就当只有我一个人好了。这样简单些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't really know what to tell you. It's not just the realm of science, or if it is, it's a science that Entrati knows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我真的不知道该怎么告诉你。这不仅仅是科学领域的事，或者就算是科学，那也是只有英择谛知道的科学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Here's a direction: Stop [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 给你个方向：停下来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: As for teaching in schools, if it was I didn't study it. But it might have been?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 至于学校教不教这个，如果有的话，我是没学过。但说不定有呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Why, want some homework? Time travel is probably too advanced for now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 怎么，想要点家庭作业吗？现在讲时光旅行可能还太超前了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So many questions, kid.  Hate to break it to you but: I don't know. Only Entrati has the answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 小孩，问题真多。不过我得让你失望了：我不知道。只有英择谛知道答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hello? Kaya? How is your day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你好？卡娅？你今天过得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe Amir? He probably plays games with time travel plots...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许是阿米尔？他可能玩过一些关于时间旅行的游戏……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Don't think so, kid. But if you want to learn something useful, ask Lettie for a 101 on healing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 孩子，我觉得没有。如果你想学点有用的东西，可以去找莱蒂学习一下治疗的基础课。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Right. Youngest of this new group I'd say, though, kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯。不过你还是这批新人中最小的，孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yeah yeah, just don't rush into the time travel thing. It's... complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好好，不过别急着了解时间旅行。这事……很复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Right to it then, okay. No, the ‘internet' didn't make it to my time, really, so it can't be required. Or maybe it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，那我就直接说吧。不，‘互联网'并没有延续到我的时代，所以它应该不是必需的。但也可能是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And hello to you too, Kaya.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗨卡娅，你也好啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I really don't know anything for sure. I just know there was a sequence, Entrati had a plan, and it involved me, here, now. I needed to get here, to meet you all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我真的什么都不敢肯定。我只知道有一个数列，英择谛有个计划，而它涉及到我现在在这里。我需要到这里来，遇见你们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'll ask him next time I see him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 下次见到他我会问问他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You have his notes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你有他的笔记？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is that a problem? Wouldn't a kid like you love the internet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这有问题吗？像你这样的孩子不是都喜欢互联网吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sorry, was making a joke... They have those in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 抱歉，我只是开个玩笑……在未来是有笑话的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A joke. Lighten up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 开个玩笑。放轻松点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: YOU? You found Entrati, when no one else could?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你？当别人都找不到英择谛的时候，你却找到了他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You found him? How?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你找到他了？怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Charming. I'm not your enemy you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 很好。你要知道，我不是你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you threaten all your new friends?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你对所有新朋友都这样威胁的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not here to betray you or anything, and I'm not a time travel textbook
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我来这里不是为了背叛你或其他什么，我也不是什么时间旅行的教科书

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I promise you that you can trust me, I'm not sure why you're so hostile.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我向你保证你可以信任我，我不确定你为什么这么有敌意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Kaya I think you're a little too hyperfixated on this. What if you can't figure it out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 卡娅，我觉得你对这件事太过痴迷了。如果你搞不定怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No idea. I'm the choseeennnn one, Kaya.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不清楚。卡娅，我是被选中的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Why? Looking to save up a few höllars and bribe me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 为什么这么问？想省下几块霍币来贿赂我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Some costs don’t have höllar signs. And hi, by the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有些成本是不会以霍币的形式显示的。顺便说一句，嗨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Pardon me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你再说一次？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You know that your batch 'Nova' has nothing to do with Time Travel right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你知道你的批次‘Nova'和时间旅行没关系，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Listen, you really seem to only care about one thing. Time travel. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 听着，你好像只关心一件事。时间旅行。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You can't. [End].
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你不能。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You don't know me. Or wait, that's your line?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你根本不了解我。等等，这不是你常说的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I can promise you I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我保证我能明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well, we're trying to make the most of our tools I guess. Did you talk to Amir about your questions?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，我想我们在试着充分利用我们手头的工具。你有没有跟阿米尔谈过你的问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Right, just meant it would be a bit easier I guess if you could access more tools from my time..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 对，我只是觉得如果你能使用我这个时代的更多工具，可能会更简单些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well, we're trying to make the most of our tools I guess. Did you talk to Lettie? I feel like you and her would get along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，我想我们在试着充分利用我们手头的工具。你和莱蒂谈过吗？我感觉你们会合得来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ok, let's be serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，我们认真一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Did something happen to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是不是经历了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Wow, that's impressive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哇，真是厉害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Wow are you actually bragging?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哇，你这是在吹牛吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You want to time travel, but where? Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你想要时间旅行，但去哪里呢？为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Have you looked around?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你看过周围了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'll see what I can find for you, if you want to figure it out on your terms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你想按自己的方式弄清楚，我会看看能找到什么帮助你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: For 10 höllars I'll tell you how you die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 给我 10 霍币，我就告诉你你是怎么死的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Anyone who's selling you something like that is lying. I will try and help you, I really will. No charge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 任何向你推销这种东西的人都是在撒谎。我会尽力帮助你，真的。不收钱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hey Kaya!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嘿，卡娅！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Okay, Nova then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好的，那就叫你 Nova。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I see. Since when?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这样啊。从什么时候开始的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Okay, but can I ask why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 可以。但我能问问为什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Got it. Nova. Nova. Right. I wanted to ask: Is there anything I can do to make things more comfortable for you here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 明白了。Nova。Nova。对了。我想问一下：我能做些什么让你在这里感觉更自在一些吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Right yah, wouldn't want people seeing how often you ask me about time travel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也是，你肯定不想让人知道你有多常问我关于时间旅行的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh? I'm pretty sure Amir has this network pretty locked down, unless I'm missing something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦？我很确定阿米尔已经把这个网络加固得很好了，除非我没注意到什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I know none of us really asked to 'be here' in this makeshift home but we're doing our best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我知道我们谁都不想‘待在'这种临时的家，但我们都在尽力了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Did something happen to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是不是出过什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And you think time travel isn't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那你觉得时间旅行不危险吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The time cops won't get you I swear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我保证，时间警察不会抓到你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Get yourself into some trouble?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你惹事了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well Aoi did say...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，碧确实有说过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not a word. Only happy you're here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一点都没有。大家都很高兴你在这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Arthur and Eleanor definitely see you as a little sister who is way smarter than them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 亚瑟和埃莉诺绝对把你当作比他们聪明得多的小妹妹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Amir and Quincy cannot get over your Wormhole and I swear when you aren't looking they jump through it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 阿米尔和昆西对你的虫洞念念不忘，我发誓当你不注意的时候他们会跳进去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well, is that why you want to figure out this time travel thing? To prove something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那，这是你想要搞清楚时间旅行的原因吗？为了证明些什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Then I would hope you can see from the people around you that we're a team that helps each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那我希望你能从周围的人看出来，我们是一个互帮互助的团队。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Aoi and Lettie can't seem to decide if they want to be your best friend or your mother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 碧和莱蒂似乎还没决定好是想当你最好的朋友还是当你妈妈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And of course me, I'm happy someone wants to understand how the hell I ended up here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当然还有我，我很高兴有人想知道我到底是怎么来到这里的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Trusting people and working together is what makes us us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 信任他人并共同合作，这就是我们的特点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Caring about my friends is a strength. It's a reason to endure all this shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 关心朋友是一种力量。这也是我忍受所有这些糟糕事的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We all have our shit to deal with. It's hard to do alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们每个人都有自己的问题要处理。独自一人面对很难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We're just waiting for you to feel comfortable around us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们只是在等你在我们这里感到自在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How could we not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们怎么可能不喜欢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What exactly is a 'sorority slogan'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: "姐妹会口号"到底是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sorority? What's that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 姐妹会？那是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not following...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 还是不懂……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh, maybe like 'The Sisters of Parvos'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦，可能像是‘帕尔沃斯的姐妹'？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well, they try to kill me. A lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，她们总是想弄死我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A mix? Are we baking a cake?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 混合？我们这是在烤蛋糕吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So your studies are going well, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那你的研究进展得不错嘛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How do you know that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Humble, Nova.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Nova，谦虚点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How can you be sure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你怎么确定的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You must have been a great student.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你一定是个优秀的学生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Still doesn't mean you could bake a cake though. Unless you took baking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但这并不意味着你就可以烤蛋糕。除非你学过烘焙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not smart enough to not take Entrati's serum though, eh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但你还是不够聪明，竟然用了英择谛的血清，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I think so, but she's definitely heard of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 可能吧，但她肯定听说过我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Wow, yeah. She's from my time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哇，听说过。她是我那个时代的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If not for... All this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 要不是因为……这一切？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If not for... Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 要不是因为……英择谛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You're making things up to lash out. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你故意编造事实来发泄。为什么要这样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Are you trying to hurt my feelings?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是想伤我的心吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The internet dies eventually, don't worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 互联网最终会消失的，别担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So you had a bad time in University because of... the internet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以你在大学不愉快的原因是因为……互联网。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: This isn't high school.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这里不是高中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We aren't like that here Nova, we have real shit to deal with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Nova，我们这里不是那种地方，我们有真正重要的事情要处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A+ Grade for us both!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们俩都拿 A+！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Glad I could help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 很高兴能帮到你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But are you sure I just didn't leave my radio on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但你确定不是因为刚才我的收音机是开着的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Even if I am only barely following.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 虽然我几乎没怎么理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sorry to say but I really don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 抱歉说实话，但我真的不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh yeah, totally. Nova is known for taking down the internet. That's why I'm here, to stop you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦，当然。Nova 以关掉互联网而闻名。这就是我来这里的原因，为了阻止你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: As you wish. Alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你想怎样都行。不来烦你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's hard for me to know if I'm going to upset you, I'm sorry for whatever happened to you but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我很难知道我有没有惹你不开心，我为你的遭遇感到抱歉，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No, I can't. [End].
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不，我不能。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Explain her mechanics? I can try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 解释她的机制？我可以试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Protea? She's complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Protea？她很复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Throw.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 投掷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm guessing you want to know about Temporal Anchor?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我猜你想了解时泊之锚？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And not just because of what she can do, but because of where she came from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不仅仅是因为她能做什么，还因为她的来历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Whoever she was, what she is now is someone that served Parvos Granum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不管她原来是谁，她现在是为帕尔沃斯·格拉努效力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Throw, then throw some more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 投掷，然后继续投掷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You asked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你自己问的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Right. Because Time Travel, or the appearance of some mastery of Temporal things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是的。因为时间旅行，或者是对时间方面的某种掌握的表现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You know the type?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你知道这种人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: He's not all bad but that's a pretty close read.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 他不全是坏人，但你这么说也差不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: He is responsible for a lot. Too much to list, but Protea is one of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 他要为很多事负责。太多了，无法一一列举，但 Protea 是其中之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you want to be kept as a science experiment for the rest of your life, sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你想一辈子成为科学试验品，那当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't think putting you in touch is a good idea, even if it were possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我认为让你接触他并不是个好主意，即使这是有可能的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Because you really won't give up? It's not like I want you to, but I really don't know how to help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 因为你真的不会放弃？我并不是希望你放弃，而是我真的不知道该如何帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Because for some reason, all there is to Nova is asking the only time traveller she knows about time travel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 因为出于某种原因，Nova 所能做的就是向她认识的唯一的时间旅行者询问时间旅行的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And sold to the highest bidder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 还可能被卖给出价最高的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Let's try and stick to what could help you here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们还是专注于那些能在这里帮到你的事情吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What happened to you in University?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你在大学到底发生了什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Take your side in what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 在什么事情上站在你这边？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: He's a smart man, not a good man. I don't think he'd be an ally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 他是个聪明人，但不是个好人。我不认为他会成为盟友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Temporal... things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 比如时间……方面的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The half-baked freak that will solve time travel, though. Give yourself some credit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不过，正是这个半成品怪胎将要解决时间旅行的问题。要对自己有些信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Protea the Warframe that we know of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们所知道的只有战甲 Protea。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What if I have questions about 1999?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果我想问关于 1999 的问题呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Will I ever be allowed to ask you anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我以后能问你别的事情吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's a different world now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 现在的世道已经不同了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you ever want to talk about it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你哪天想聊聊这件事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The Void isn't something you can just 'solve'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 虚空不是那种你能简单‘解决'的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The Void has something to do with... everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 虚空和……全部一切都有关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Wait, be careful!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 等等，注意安全！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm bracing for this to not start a fight...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 让我做下心理准备，免得引起争执……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: An incredibly attractive and brilliant student?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我猜是位极具魅力且才华横溢的学生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Uh oh. In a good way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃噢。是好的方面吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you say so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 既然你这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You don't seem to have many of those.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你好像没有很多这样的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But what if I wanted to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但如果我想呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Woah my bad. My bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哇，我的错，我的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I promise I wont.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我保证没有下次了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not baking you a cake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我是不会给你烤蛋糕的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: For someone who is supposed to be some kid genius you really take a while to make a point...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 对于一个被认为是天才儿童的人来说，你真的花了很长时间才说明白重点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And how does that remind you of me exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是怎么让你想起我的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I have no idea what those are!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我根本不知道那是个什么东西！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Are they like, special collectors items?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它们像是特别的收藏品吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe you'll show me your Jinymon Cards one day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许有一天你会让我看看你的吉尼梦卡牌？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Wow, we finished a whole conversation without ONLY talking about time travel!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哇！我们居然完整聊完了一次天，而且没有只扯时间旅行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is this you opening up to me? Refreshing!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你这是在向我敞开心扉吗？真新鲜啊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You're probably right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你大概是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I could figure it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我是能搞定的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You really seem curious about ‘time travel'. Obsessed actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你似乎真的对"时间旅行"很好奇。说实在地，你很痴迷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Once you figure out Time Travel, there’s a bigger problem. Eternalism.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一旦你把时间旅行琢磨明白了，还有个更大的问题要考虑。永恒论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Let's see if you're smart enough to figure this out. Thanks to eternalism, there's a version of this conversation that doesn't end right here. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们看看你是不是聪明到能把这点弄清楚。因为永恒论，这个对话有一个没有在这里就结束的版本。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hope you're not busy, because this is the real reason I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 希望你不忙，因为这才是我来这里的真正原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: All of this happened not because a scientist figured out a formula.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这一切的发生并不是因为某位科学家想出了一个公式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well I guess that's how it started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，我想事情就是这样开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But all this now? It's beyond. It's because Albrecht went somewhere, woke something up, and it followed him back. The Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但现在的这一切？已经超越了那些。这是因为阿尔布雷希特去了某个地方，唤醒了某个东西，然后它就跟着他回来了。虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The Void is alive but also not. It is but it also isn't. It's a paradox while being the cause and reason for everything that's happened to every single one of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 虚空既是活的，又不是。它是一个悖论，是我们每个人所经历的一切起源，也是这一切发生的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: There's no 'periodic table' or formula for what this is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没有"元素周期表"或公式可以解释这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: "Goodbye Albrecht"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: "再见，阿尔布雷希特"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What if it couldn't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果解释不了怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I told you to be careful with the Void. This is why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这就是为什么我告诉你要小心虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What if everything you thought was a hard rule..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你认为的一切都是铁律……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Some things cannot be governed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有些事是无法控制的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Only happened because something out there wanted it to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而这一切会发生，只是因为外部有什么东西想要它发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Some things cannot be explained.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也有些事是无法解释的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not Magic. Just... Void. The Void. An energy from somewhere else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不是魔法。就只是……虚空。虚空。一种来自其他地方的能量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Have you seen what I can do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你有看过我能做什么吗?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Don't [End].
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 别 [结束]。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Bleak, Nova.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 真悲观啊，Nova。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I trusted it too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我之前也相信过虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It could cost you everything if you try something rash.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你鲁莽行事，可能会失去一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You can 'work with that'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这对你"有帮助"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Take a breath, go relax Nova [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 深呼吸，放松一下，Nova。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's been hard for everyone. You'll be ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这对每个人来说都很困难。你会好起来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We've all lost something because of this bullshit. Look around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们所有人都因为这堆屁事失去了某些东西。看看周围吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Whatever caused you to be like this is ruining your chance at real happiness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 无论是什么原因导致你变成这样，它都在毁掉你获得真正幸福的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Go ahead. The sooner you're gone the less attitude I have to deal with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你早走早好，省得我还要面对你这种态度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You can't make me hate you. You can annoy me sure, but that's not hate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你没法让我恨你。惹毛我倒是可以，但这不是恨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you need to think you're using us go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你要非觉得是在利用我们，那就这么想好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm going to help you somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我肯定会想办法帮你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: When you figure it out, and you will, we'll still be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 等你想通的那天，你总会想通的，我们还会在这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I just hope you realize soon enough that we aren't trying to hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我只希望你早点明白我们从没想过要伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Nova?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Nova？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Nova?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Nova？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Kaya?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 卡娅？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: None of us would ever judge you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们没有人会评判你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What happened to you is a complete personal violation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 发生在你身上的事完全是对你个人的侵犯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Someone violated your trust and tried to humiliate you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有人辜负了你的信任，还要羞辱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You were vulnerable and you were betrayed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你那时人单力薄，又遭人背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Your world was pulled from under you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你的世界轰然倒塌了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: People looked at you differently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 大家都用异样的眼光看你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: There's nothing more for me to say. We've all done things we regret.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我没什么好说的了。我们都做过后悔的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If anything I respect you more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 说实话，我现在更佩服你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: There will never be a moment where any of us judge you for this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们任何人都不会因此对你评头论足。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe I will. We have lots of time, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许我会的。毕竟我们还有很多时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's a promise. You're not alone in this world. We're all just taking chances on other people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是个承诺。在这个世界上你并不孤单。我们都只不过把赌注放在了别人身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not a lie. Just believe it. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没骗你。只要相信就好。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hear me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 听我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You obviously figured out Eternalism, maybe better than I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 显然，你对永恒论的理解可能比我更透彻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I will never talk you out of leaving 1999.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我绝不会劝你不要离开 1999 年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: All that attitude you've given me? At least it makes sense, you were afraid AND angry. I was another stranger on the internet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你对我的那些态度？至少是合情合理的，你既害怕又生气。我只是网上的一个陌生人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which is saying something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这真的很了不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm sure there's a way. And it means more to you to go somewhere else, anywhere else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我相信会有办法的。去别的地方，离开这里，对你来说更有意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Help is always here. I might be a better listener than time traveler, though. Don't be shy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 永远愿意帮助你。不过，我可能是个比时间旅行者更好的倾听者。别害羞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I am glad we trust each other now [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我很高兴我们现在能够互相信任。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How close are you to securing your 'escape'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你离你的"后路"还有多远？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What convinced you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 什么让你信服了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You're close to escaping 1999?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你快要逃离 1999 年了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What's the current lead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 目前的导火索是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You're still sure about this, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那么，你仍然很确定这一点吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: My time isn't exactly much better, but at least I'm there to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我的时代也没好到哪里去，但至少我可以帮得上忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hmm, the Void is actually kind of serious about fingers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，虚空确实对手指还挺重视的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I must be special.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我一定很特别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Gross.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好恶心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'll put in a good word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我会替你美言几句的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You know he's taken, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你知道他已经名花有主了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: All of this, everything Entrati did. His pursuit of the Void, the essence of... it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所有这一切，英择谛所做的一切。他对虚空的追求，这一切的……本质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Comes down to 1 finger. A finger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 归结为一根手指。就是一根手指。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The Void. Textbooks don't help much on that subject.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 虚空。教科书上可不教这块知识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A beer would probably help things make sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 喝点啤酒也许能理清思路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's not something that just gets 'mentioned'. It is the end and the beginning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这可不是"早点说"的事情。它是终点，也是起点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Messed up and busy! Welcome to the team [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 又错乱又忙碌！欢迎加入团队。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Who do you think is the most messed up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你觉得谁最错乱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is that a compliment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是在夸我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Albrecht has its finger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特有它的手指。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: There is a finger from... it. In my time. Our world, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有一根手指来自……它。在我的时代。也算是在我们的世界吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: That's it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 就这？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not 'what is it'? Why does it have a finger?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你不想问"它是什么"？或为什么它会有一根手指？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I think I have something that can help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想我可以帮得上忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: There's this place I know, I guess where I'm from actually. Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我知道一个地方，其实我该说我是从那里来的。双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And it's still there, even though I'm gone. In the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 即使我离开了，它依然存在。在虚空中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And the system where the other kid is, it's a place I've been.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而另一个孩子所在的星系，是我曾经去过的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's a place I created in the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它是我在虚空创造出的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: In many ways it's my true home. Where I... grew up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 从很多方面来说，那里才是我真正的家。我……是在那里长大的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Filled with embodiments of concepts, emotions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一个充满了具象化概念和情感的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's in the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它在虚空中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's basically a 'textbook' come to life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它基本上就是一本活生生的"教科书"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We don't get a lot of visitors these days, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不过，最近我们那的访客并不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It is, but it's very much buoyed to the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是的，但它很大程度上要依托于扎里曼号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't go back there often...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不经常回那里……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you really think you'll go there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你真的觉得你会去那里吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: On it, space traveler! [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好嘞，太空旅行者！[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Like a big, metal Moon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 就像一个巨大的金属月亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I think so? I would know if it disappeared if I left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 应该还在吧？我不在的时候如果它消失了我会知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What about the outcome if you get lost somewhere, somewhen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你在某个地方、某个时候迷路了怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't mind entertaining all this, but do you really think you'll find a way out of 1999?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我可以畅想一下，但你真的认为你能找到摆脱 1999 年的办法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Think hard enough about one and maybe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 努力想想的话，或许可能有？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I was being poetic, there's no Sun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我只是在抒情而已，那里没有太阳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not sure that science could explain this. 'It' is the cause of all of this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不确定科学能否解释这一切。"它"就是这一切的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: That sounds more like philosophy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这听起来更像是哲学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not that I know of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 据我所知没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Nope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't know that I want it to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不知道我想不想它被解释出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If 'It' Could, we'd solve a lot of problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果"它"可以被解释的话，我们就能解决很多问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You struggle with Philosophy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你对哲学很头疼吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I hope it doesn't come to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我希望不会发展到那一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Got it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Despite the circumstances... if it comes to that, I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 尽管情况如此……如果真到了那一步，我会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's 'The Void'. Nothing until there's something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是"虚空"。在事物出现之前，一切都是虚无。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: When we find Albrecht, we'll have to take him back there or something. I don't really have a plan yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 等我们找到阿尔布雷希特，我们会把他带回去或什么的，我还没有计划。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not sure I'll like the answers, Nova.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Nova，我不确定我会喜欢那些答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Me too, one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 同意，总有一天会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I guess, but you're sharing this planet with others,  our choices impact others whether we like it or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想是的，但你与他人共同生活在这个星球上，无论我们愿不愿意，我们的选择都会影响他人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe that's what Entrati thought before he went into the Void the first time, now look at us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许这就是英择谛第一次进入虚空前的想法，现在看看我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Cryotic?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说永冻晶矿吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Argon Crystals?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说氩结晶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Argon Crystals?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说氩结晶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Orokin Cell?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说奥罗金电池？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: They always disappear once you bring them out of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它们一旦从虚空中带出来就消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Never, I always assumed they just decayed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没有办法，我一直都以为它们只是衰变了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Rubedo?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说红化结晶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Argon Crystals?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说氩结晶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Nano Spores?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说纳米孢子吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you mean Argon Crystals?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是说氩结晶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Will this get you out of 1999? Planning on hiding in the Void? I wouldn't recommend it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这能让你离开 1999 年吗？打算躲进虚空？这我并不推荐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is this important to your goal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这对你的目标重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Wait follow me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 等等，跟着我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I hope you can backflip! One lighthouse coming right up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我希望你会后空翻！一座灯塔马上就来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Woah I don't know if I'm comfortable with this. What if you get stuck or lost?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哇哦，我不知道这样做我能不能接受。要是你卡住或者迷路了怎么办？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Fair enough, science is best done with confidence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有道理，科学最好在有充分信心的前提下进行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Let's try! No time for caution, let's go now!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 试试吧！没时间考虑了，现在就出发！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You might.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你有可能呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You wish!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 别做梦了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh sure, you're a great teacher. Although I think the only thing I've seen you do is teach Minerva how to play new drinking games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，你是个好老师。虽然我只见过你教米尼娃玩新的喝酒游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Finnne, seems you still realize how dangerous this could be. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，看来你还是意识到这可能有多危险。好样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sigh...
But... you might.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但……你还是有可能吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Don't put that on me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 别把责任推到我头上啊……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How about I ask *you* about time travel this time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这次我问*你*关于时间旅行的问题怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How about... Kalymos?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 比如……卡利莫斯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Like my biggest regret?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 比如我最后悔的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Like what? You choose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 比如呢？你选一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: My sympathies. It's best to end here [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 同情。最好就聊到这吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear, tell me about him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我很抱歉，跟我说说他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I've lost a pet too. What was his name?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我也丢过一只宠物。你的狗叫什么名字？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not demanding more from Albrecht.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没有要求阿尔布雷希特负起更多应负的责任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not stopping Ballas sooner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没有早点阻止 Ballas。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Giving up on myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 放弃自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's like even after all this I just let him get away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 就好像经过了这么多，我还是让他逃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't know how I could have changed things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不知道我还能怎么改变当时的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It doesn't matter what it looks like to anyone else. There was a point when no one hated me more than myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 别人怎么看并不重要。曾经有段时间，没有人比我更恨我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I know he thinks he's teaching me something, but that asshole doesn't even realize what he put me through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我知道他以为他是在教我，但那个混蛋根本没意识到他让我经历了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But I know that if I was even a minute faster, someone would have suffered less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但我知道就算我只快一分钟，就会有人少受一点罪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I couldn't even DIE. And I wished I could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我甚至连死也死不了。而我希望我能死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And not JUST me. All of us. And Loid, Gomaitru... it's sickening. I don't know if I'll be able to hold back if I see him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而且不仅是我。我们所有人。洛德、戈迈特鲁……真恶心。我不知道如果我再次见到他，我能不能冷静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ballas is everything I fear. He's the worst of life itself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Ballas 代表着我一切的恐惧。他就是生命中之极恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We've still got big Kubrows where I'm from!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我来的地方仍然有大型库狛！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ehh I don't know, Mr. Volkov is pretty tough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃我不知道。沃尔科夫先生可是很强壮的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What made you so upset?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是什么让你那么难过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How do you remember that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你怎么记得？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You wouldn't change a thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你一件都不想改变？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Kids can be so cruel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 孩子们有时候真的很残忍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is being popular that important?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 受欢迎有那么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You guys play. I'm busy [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你们玩吧。我很忙。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I've got some höllars burning a hole in my pocket, where do we start?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我口袋里的几枚霍币放到都快把裤子烧穿了，我们怎么开始？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Remind me... what are we talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 提醒我一下……我们在说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A Panther.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 豹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: An Eagle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 鹰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A Dragon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 龙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What exactly is this game...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这到底是个什么游戏……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No way. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不要。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sure why not, beginners luck has to be on my side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当然为什么不呢，新手运气可在我这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You just want an easy win. No way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你只是想轻松赢一场。没门。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No, I am more confused now. You didn't explain anything!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不，我更迷惑了。你啥也没解释！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you say so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 既然你这么说的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What the! I don't have that kind of money.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 什么！我可没有那么多钱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Alright, fine. Only if Amir can help me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那好吧。只要阿米尔帮我就行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How about a raincheck?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 改天再来怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No way!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不要！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not falling for that!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我可不会上当！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Alright, 4..1
Not right now [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 现在不要。[结束]
