/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Go for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm all ears.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我听着呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: 1999 is lucky to have Kaya Velasco
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 1999 很荣幸能拥有卡娅·维拉斯科

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Anything can happen, I'm just glad we're all in this together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 任何事都可能发生，我很高兴和你一起度过这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Kaya? No way. Prove it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 卡娅？不可能。证明一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: whoa you remembered? I mean birthdays are NBD once you're past like 8 but that's kinda sweet of you, thanks
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哇，你还记得？我是说 8 岁以后生日就没什么大不了的，但你还是挺贴心的，谢谢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not though am I? none of us are. we're just going round and round this carousel like pretty ponies all on fire and screaming
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我并没有变老不是吗？我们都没有。我们就像一只只在旋转木马上的小马，一边着火一边尖叫着

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not though am I? none of us are. we're just going round and round this carousel like pretty ponies all on fire and screaming
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我并没有变老不是吗？我们都没有。我们就像一只只在旋转木马上的小马，一边着火一边尖叫着

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. ew, no. I wouldn't be caught dead with that kid stuff.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。额，不。我可不会玩那种小孩的玩意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: actually yeah. Lettie's gonna show me how to dissect a dead body, isn't that cool?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有吧。莱蒂会向我展示如何解剖一具尸体，是不是很酷？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: ugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: ooooh yeeeeaaah I'm not going to age now, am I? I'm going to keep having this same birthday over and over again
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦耶我不会再变老了是吧？我会一直重复过这一年的生日

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: that's. so. COOL.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那可。真。酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hi. Can everybody time travel, or just you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗨。是每个人都能时光旅行，还是只有你可以？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And why you? Do you have a plan?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 为什么是你？你有计划吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And if not, what can you recommend so I can get any scientific sources on your abilites?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果没有，你能给我点什么建议，让我找到有关你能力的科学依据？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh that bastard. I knew I should have asked him more questions. Ok. At least if it's science, it means I can reproduce it, and since you can come and go, I can figure it out. Bye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，那个混蛋。我就知道我应该多问他一些问题。好吧。至少如果是科学问题的话，那我就能复现它，而且既然你可以自由来去，我肯定能弄清楚。拜拜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh, are you serious?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，你说真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Have any of the Hex figured it out? Do they have any info?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 六人组里有人搞清楚了吗？他们有什么信息吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: K.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 行吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Games? I just need answers, a direction, anything. I'll figure it out. If you think of anything HELPFUL, find me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 游戏？我需要的是答案，一个方向，什么都行。我自己会弄明白的。如果你想到什么有用的，来找我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not my style. Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那不是我的风格。算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not a kid. I'm 19.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不是孩子。我19岁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 还行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So. Just you? Are there others? Is time travel taught in schools in the future?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那么，就只有你吗？还有其他人吗？未来的学校里会教时光旅行吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. Youngest, sure, but also clearly most intent on doing something to find answers. Try and keep up. So: Time travel. How and who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。最小是没错，但显然也是最积极想要找到答案的那个。跟上节奏吧。那么：时间旅行。怎样做？谁能做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. How complicated? Formulas? Chemical and atomic elements? I'll figure it out just point me in a direction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。有多复杂？需要公式？化学和原子元素？我会弄清楚的，只要给我指个方向就行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hi. Why would Entrati's cross-temporal setup involve what appears to be an active connection to the Kinemantik Online Network?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗨。为什么英择谛的跨时间装置会涉及到需要和即时通在线网络保持活跃的连接？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Or, I guess, Hi. Is the internet required for time travel?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 或者，我猜，嗨。时间旅行需要用到互联网吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So you do not need an internet connection to come and go as you please? Did Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以你不需要连互联网就可以随意进出吗？英择谛需要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. Internet? I could see how given the properties of a network..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。互联网？考虑到网络的属性，我可以理解……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Okay, but why does there seem to be an internet connection that is non-negotiable in some of his notes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，但为什么看起来他的一些笔记中坚持要有互联网连接呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not literally. Just what I saw when I found him. I don't think he expected to be found.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不是真的有。我只是在找到他时看到了一些东西。我觉得他没想到会被人发现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Does it make you feel better to keep calling me a kid? Like, don't you get it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 老是叫我小孩，这让你自我感觉更好吗？你怎么就不明白呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You don't know anything about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你根本不了解我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I had to grow up FAST. The people on this f**** internet made sure of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不得不快点长大。这全是因为那些该死的互联网上的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I wanted answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想要答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And you're sure there's not internet in your future? Like totally sure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那你确定未来没有互联网？完全确定？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Actually, forget I said anything. I'll find out when I get there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 其实，算了，当我什么都没说。等我到了那里自然会知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Things changed too fast in this shithole. Especially in the internet backrooms talking about this Doktor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这个鬼地方变化太快了。尤其是在互联网后台里那些关于这个博士的讨论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So I found him, surprised him. And ohh my god. Grandpa Doktor was not happy but, I cut right to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 于是我找到了他，让他大吃一惊。天啊。博士爷爷不太高兴，但我直奔主题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I knew he was from the future. He knew I knew. He gave me a choice and well whatever. Now I found you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我知道他来自未来。他也知道我知道。他给了我一个选择，好吧，不管怎样。现在我找到了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And in a way I'm giving you a choice too. Help me, or regret it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 某种意义上，我也给你一个选择。帮助我，或者你会后悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not yet anyway. People change. Guess we'll see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 至少现在还不是。人总会变的。我们走着瞧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Just protecting myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我只是在保护我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Just tell me, do I need to save up or anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 直接告诉我，我需要去攒钱或者做些什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I do. I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想。我会努力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. Sicko.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。变态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We'll see, won't we.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们拭目以待吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Who would even want to stay here? Like..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 谁还想留在这里？就像……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's never going to stop. Look forward. Find me when you can help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这种事永远不会停下来。向前看吧。当你能帮我的时候来找我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. K
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。行吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I have my reasons
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我有我的理由

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'll figure it out, I know I can so, yeah. Bye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我会弄明白的，我知道我能，所以，嗯。再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我会搞定的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yah a total chosen DICKHEAD
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是啊，一个被选中的蠢货

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Time travel - is it expensive?  A cost associated in raw materials? Or has it been commodified in your time in a way that is relevant to anything here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 时间旅行——它花费大吗？涉及原材料的成本吗？还是在你的时代已经成为了某种可以与这里相关联的商品？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It worked on Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这招对英择谛有效。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hi. So it's not like I can just pay someone something and just learn how to do it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗨。所以我不能就这样付钱给某人然后学会怎么去做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: What Nova can and can't do doesn't matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Nova 能做什么不能做什么并不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You wouldn't get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你不会明白的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And get this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Duh, I told you already. I found him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，我已经告诉你了。我找到他了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So he's on his computer or whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 他当时在电脑上忙些什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yeah, I don't know you. I just know what you can do. Which is why we're talking. Like, be serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是，我不了解你。我只知道你能做什么。这也是我们为什么在交谈的原因。请认真点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A promise from a stranger on the internet. Give me a break. Ha. Just tell me what I want to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 来自互联网上一个陌生人的保证，别开玩笑了。哈。告诉我我想知道的就行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And I show up, and he actually gets scared. Like, he did NOT even expect someone to show up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后我一出现，他竟然吓了一跳。就像，他根本没想到会有人出现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I did. We agree on some fundamentals but he doesn't seem interested in a concrete and reproducible time travel theorem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我问过了。我们在一些基本理论上有共识，但他似乎对具体的、可复现的时间旅行定理不感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is that an offer? What can I access? Anything would help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这算是个提议吗？我能使用什么？任何帮助都会有用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We do get along. She reminds me of a teacher I had once, 0 nastiness and saw me for my brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们确实很合得来。她让我想起了我以前的一位老师，她一点也不刻薄，而且非常欣赏我的才智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: In fact, he's convinced me that I was wrong in some of my original hypothesis so it did help, but he reminded me that maybe I can just pay my way to an answer, or at least pay to talk to someone else from the future if you don't help me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 事实上，他让我相信我在一些原始假设上是错误的，所以这的确有帮助，但他提醒我，如果你不帮我的话，也许我可以花钱找到答案，或者至少花钱与未来的某个人交谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Something happened to all of us. Just let me know if you figure out a way to help me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们都经历了一些事。如果你找到了帮助我的方法，告诉我一声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh, why am I telling you this again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，我为什么还要跟你说这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: She's actually really like super chill. Smart too. Although, she told me to trust you for real so, I guess we'll see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 她实际上非常随和。也很聪明。不过，她还是让我真正去信任你，所以我想我们拭目以待吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Can you figure ANYTHING out? Ugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你能搞懂哪怕任何东西吗？呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yeah, I have. I've seen it all. This miraculous turn of the millennium. Invites to sooo many parties cause people wanted 'that girl' there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 看过了。我什么都看过了。这个千禧年的奇迹转折。因为人们都想让‘那个女孩'出现，所以我被邀请到了很多派对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Nova, I go by Nova online.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Nova，在网上，我用 Nova 这个名字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: K thanks, just don't call me Kaya on the internet. You can call me that in person, but here: NOVA. Ok?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，谢谢，只是别在网上叫我卡娅。你可以当面这样叫我，但在这里：叫我 NOVA。可以吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Um does it matter? It's the internet, I'd rather not use my real name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，这重要吗？毕竟这是互联网，我更倾向于不用真名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Did you ask anyone else if they had a nickname they liked? Just get with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你问过其他人喜欢什么昵称吗？赶紧适应吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Are you for real? The internet is dangerous. Like, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是认真的吗？互联网真的很危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It matters to me. I don't want anyone to ever find Kaya online again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这对我来说很重要。我不希望有任何人再在网上找到卡娅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hmm. Umm. Hmm. Comfortable. No one has spread any rumors about me have they?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯。嗯。嗯。自在。没人在背后说我的坏话吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. Not funny.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。不好笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I made a DUMB Mistake. Once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我就犯过一个错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Don't even joke actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 别开这种玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Nothing that I can change now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不是我现在能改变的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You're the one that says I'm like a kid, what if something did happen to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你总说我像个小孩，要是我真的出了什么事怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Fine. You're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 行。你说的都对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Listen I know you think I'm just a kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 听着，我知道你把我当小孩看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And I don't make mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我通常不会犯错的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's not even funny. You put girls like us in a room and everyone expect us to be at each other's throats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一点也不好笑。你把我们这样的女生放在一个房间里，大家都以为我们会互相厮杀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It probably is. And because of that, I have to know how to do it right. Can't make mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 可能是危险的吧。而正因为这样，我得知道正确的做法。不能犯错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 只不过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So give me just a few more days, maybe a few weeks, and I'll have this whole thing figured out and it's goodbye 1999.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以再给我几天，或许几个星期，我就能把这件事搞定，然后就和 1999 年说再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Jealousy. Comparisons. Ugh. I'm done with that part of my life. Do not try and turn me against the other girls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嫉妒。比较。呃。我已经受够了生活的那部分。别想着挑拨我和其他女生的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Mmm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Bet on it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 等着瞧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Why do you care, actually?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你怎么会关心这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You are right. You aren't exactly unpopular.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你说得对。你确实不是不受欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You guys actually... like me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你们真的……喜欢我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And everyone does seem to trust you, or at least say they do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而且似乎大家都信任你，至少他们是这么说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: LOL Sounds like something from a sorority slogan.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哈哈，听起来像是某个姐妹会的口号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I... see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我……明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: LOL Really? I really have to go to the future if there's none of those there. Holy shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哈哈，认真的吗？如果未来没有这些，那我真得去未来看看了。天哪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: In University a bunch of girls call themselves sisters and think it means something. Like a 'club' I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 在大学里，一群女生自称姐妹，好像这很有意义似的。我想大概就像是‘社团'吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sounds lame. Ugh. I freaking HOPE it's not a real sorority.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 听起来好蠢。呃。我真希望那不是个真正的姐妹会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Feels like mine tried to kill me too...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我感觉我的姐妹会也曾想弄死我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hi. Could you confirm something for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗨。你能帮我确认一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The key to your abilities of time travelling is a mix of Technocyte and Void, in some ratio?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你的时间旅行能力的关键，是不是某种比例的科技细胞和虚空的混合？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Never tried doing that but bet I'd make a great one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我从没试过做那个，但我敢打赌我会做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Super well. I'm super close actually. Super close.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 非常好。我其实已经非常接近了。非常接近。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't have to be humble. I had the highest grade in my high-schools history AND my first year of university had me with the best academic record in 100 years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不需要谦虚。我在高中的成绩是学校史上最高的，而且我大学一年级的学术成绩是百年来最好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Have you heard of 'Nora Night'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你听说过‘诺拉·夜'吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I had the highest grade in my high-schools history AND my first year of university had me with the best academic record in 100 years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我在高中的成绩是学校史上最高的，而且我大学一年级的学术成绩是百年来最好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I was beyond a great student. I had universities soliciting me to go there. My first year would have been perfect...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不仅仅是个优秀的学生。有好几所大学都邀请我去那里读书。我的第一年本应是完美的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: LOL? Look who's talking? If it isn't "Entrati's Teachers Pet". Yeah I heard what everyone said about you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 笑死？看看是谁在说话？不就是"英择谛老师的马屁精"吗。是的，我知道大家都怎么说你的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Mhmm sure. Well I was able to create a formula for temporal interception that ended up receiving sound waves!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，当然了。好吧，我已经发明了一个时间拦截的公式，结果它能接收到声波！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh. My. God. You seriously think I couldn't bake a cake?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我。的。天。你真的以为我不会烤蛋糕吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So I've been tuning in here and there. I think we'd get along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以我一直在这里收听这个电台。我觉得我们会合得来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If not for this stupid idiotic internet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 要不是因为这个蠢互联网。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A welcomed distraction. Sit tight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 正好能分散下注意力。你给我等着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Being popular isn't everything you know. What if everyone wants to see you fail? If you're at the top, everyone is going to want to bring you down one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你知道，受欢迎不是万能的。如果每个人都想看到你失败呢？如果你站在顶峰，那么总有一天每个人都会想把你拉下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So firstly I can collate my theories and maybe try and intercept a form of matter, lifeless for safety.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 首先我可以整合我的理论，也许尝试拦截一种无生命的物质，以确保安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: In a way you've left a Wormhole of your own for me to work with, so I guess you're my study partner. Partial credit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你在某种程度上为我留下了一个可利用的虫洞，所以我想你是我的学习伙伴。部分功劳给你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe it's me who kills it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许是我毁掉它的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I literally just said that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我刚刚说过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Trusting people gets you hurt. Trusting people on the internet? It'll ruin your life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 盲目信任别人会受伤。在互联网上信任别人？那会毁了你的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ohhh my god, is it me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦，我的天，是我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'll catch you up real quick since you have the excuse of not knowing how things work here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我就快速跟你讲讲吧，看在你可能还不太了解这边情况的份上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But people LIE on the internet. They can pretend to be your friend, and they can spread rumors FAST.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 人们会在网上会撒谎。他们可以假装是你的朋友，也可以迅速传播谣言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: 100% Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 百分之百确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Keep following.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那就加油跟上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Lame. Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没意思。算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: HA. As if.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哈。才怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And once that happens, forget about having a life. Friends. Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一旦发生这种情况，就别想过正常生活了。朋友啊，什么的都没了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And yeah so what, it's not like you'd get it. Just leave me alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而且那又怎样？反正你也不会懂。别来烦我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No one can stop me when I put my mind to ANYTHING.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一旦我下定决心做什么事，没人可以阻止我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: K.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I just need a bit. K. Bye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我只是需要一点时间。好吧。再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Could you explain the mechanics of ‘Protea'? I dug up some of her blueprint details and need confirmation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你能解释一下‘Protea'的机制吗？我挖到了一些她的蓝图资料，需要确认一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Throw?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 投掷？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yeah yeah, big bad guy with lots of money and brains. Same as always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是是，有钱有势的高智商大反派。老掉牙的套路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh. Bye? Bye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。那再见了？再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I asked, expecting answers about her Temporal affinity, at least from what I can see...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我是问了，本以为可以听到她与时间关联性的解答，至少从我观察到的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Whatever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 随便吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So HE'S the one I should be talking to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那我应该去找他谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The Dean of my university was like that. If I EVER see him again..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我大学的院长就是这种人。如果我再见到他的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I thought he would take my side but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我曾以为他会站在我这边，但……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Protea, details. Like is there a me of her? You know like a half-baked freak?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: Protea、说些具体的。比如说，有没有一个像我这样的她？你知道的，像是个半成品怪胎？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm SO glad you understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我真高兴你能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh let's leave it at 'Nova vs. The Internet'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，我们就当作是‘Nova 对抗互联网'好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 让我想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sad for her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 真为她感到难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Dumb dumb Nova.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 笨笨的 Nova。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hm. Well let's assume Protea has the most advanced Temporal grasp of all of these creations
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯。好吧，让我们假设 Protea 在所有这些造物中，对时间的掌握是最先进的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不过呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Here's the deal and exactly how this is going to work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 事情是这样的，接下来我会告诉你具体该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Grades mean nothing if your teachers refuse to let you in class.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果老师不让你上课，成绩又有什么意义呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is the grasp based on theory, science, innate ability, or.. hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这种掌握是基于理论、科学、天赋，还是……嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm going to time travel, just like you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我会进行时间旅行，就像你曾经做的那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well hm. Actually. Yes let's say the Void has something to do with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 或者，嗯。实际上。对，就理解成虚空和它有关吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm going to go to where YOU come from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我会去你来自的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I knowww I knoww...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我知道，我知道……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And then I'll know if you ever screw me over or if I can actually trust you, I'll know what the future holds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后我就会知道你有没有骗过我，或者我是否真的可以信任你，我会知道未来发生了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Tell you what, once I figure out this 'time travel' thing, I'll tell you more. I'll have nothing to lose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我这么说吧，一旦我搞清楚了这个"时间旅行"的事，我会告诉你更多。那时候我也没什么好失去的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But it might be something that I can USE! Ha! Time to test something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但它可能是我能利用的东西！哈！是时候做个实验了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And it might just mean everything for me to start another test. SEE YA!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 对我而言，开启另一项实验可能才意味着全部一切。再见啦！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So, back to the books for me! Something about Protea... hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以，我得回去看书了！还有一些关于 Protea 的事情……嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I just realized who you remind me of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我刚刚意识到你让我想起了谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: A student I got paired with in first year at uni.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 大学一年级时和我搭档的一个同学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Omg please, no, no. This is a happy memory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 天呐，拜托，别这样。这是一段快乐的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ew. Hate to break it to you but I don't flirt. Ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，我不想打击你，但我不会调情。绝对不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yes actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是的，确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: ESPECIALLY not on the internet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 特别是在网上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I was baking a cake to prove you wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我去烤蛋糕就是想证明你错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's about my birthday actually, but it's not about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 其实这是关于我的生日，但不是关于我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Let me share one then!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那就让我来分享一个吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And it made me think about the only time someone baked a cake for me was this shy classmate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后这让我想起了唯一一个为我烤过蛋糕的人，就是这位害羞的同学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well like I guess a bit it was. I should say that um I definitely was the type of person that everyone wanted to be seen with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，我想还是有点跟我有关。我应该说，呃，我绝对是那种每个人都想和我在一起的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It'll never be with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那绝不可能是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Don't try it again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不要有下次了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Who somehow found out it was my birthday despite me like never being seen with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 虽然我几乎没和他们来往过，但他们还是知道了我的生日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Good grades, beyond good actually. And captain of the cheer-force. It was like a big deal to get invited to my birthday party.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 成绩很好，甚至可以说是优秀。还是啦啦队的队长。受邀参加我的生日派对是很有面子的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And they brought me a vanilla cake with vanilla icing, the cake was like three layers tall I swear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 他们给我带来了撒有香草糖霜的香草蛋糕，我发誓，那蛋糕有三层那么高。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Anyway, this student baked me a birthday cake but told me not to share it with anyone and to wait until I got home to eat it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 总之，这个学生给我烤了一个生日蛋糕，但告诉我不要和任何人分享，等我回家再吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Anyway, I saw them with the cake. And I was so worried to have the class see them give ME a cake. We did NOT hang out with the same crowd.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 总之，我看到他们拿着蛋糕。当时我还特别担心全班同学会看到他们给我送蛋糕。因为我们压根就不是一个圈子的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And to be honest it weirded me out, kind of like you did at first. But then I cut it open and my kitchen knife hit something hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 老实说，这让我觉得怪怪的，就像你一开始给我的感觉一样。但我把它切开时，我的菜刀碰到了某个坚硬的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I had good grades. Beyond good actually. And captain of the cheer-force. It was like a big deal to get invited to my birthday party.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我成绩很好，甚至可以说是优秀。还是啦啦队的队长。受邀参加我的生日派对是很有面子的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Gross right? Mega gross. But then I looked and it was like a plastic container they hid under the cake filled with sealed Jinymon Card packs. My favourite things ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 听起来很恶心吧？简直恶心爆了。但等我仔细一看，蛋糕底下居然藏了个塑料盒，里面塞满了密封的吉尼梦卡牌包。那是我最喜欢的东西了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But a girl like me would not be caught DEAD with those at school. But obviously this shy kid saw what I was really like and snuck me the real gift while making it look like they wanted my attention with a big cake or something idk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但像我这样的女生，打死也不能在学校被人发现收到这些东西。不过那个害羞的家伙显然看穿了我的真实喜好，并且偷偷把真正的礼物塞给我。还故意用大蛋糕打掩护来吸引我的注意力，谁知道呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And for someone from the great and inspiring future you sure missed the point. Jinymon Cards! ME! Can you believe it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 作为来自那个伟大又鼓舞人心的未来的人，你绝对错过了重点。吉尼梦卡！我哎！你能相信吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I guess in my own way I'm saying I think I trust you with letting you know I collect Jinymon Cards. They are kind of for losers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想用我自己的方式告诉你，我相信你，所以告诉你我收集吉尼梦卡牌。这种卡只有废柴才玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Haaahaha!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Or at least I thought. But the real losers were everyone else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 至少我是这么认为的。但真正的废柴是其他人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It'd probably be gross anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 反正你烤出来也会很恶心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: They're like a kids monster card game and totally kind of for losers, especially in university.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它们就像小孩玩的怪兽卡牌游戏，完全是为废柴准备的，尤其是在大学里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Tada!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗒哒！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Don't get used to it. Maybe. Ugh IDK.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 可别习惯这样啊。也许吧。算了，我也不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yeahhh yeahh!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 耶！耶！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I guess in my own way I'm saying I think I trust you with letting you know I collect Jinymon Cards. They are kind of for losers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想用我自己的方式告诉你，我相信你，所以告诉你我收集吉尼梦卡牌。这种卡只有废柴才玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Or at least I thought. But the real losers were everyone else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 至少我是这么认为的。但真正的废柴是其他人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Working on it. Almost there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 正在努力。差不多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Um ...what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯……什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I am not busy, please explain. It could be incredibly relevant to the final theoretical touches here on temporal manipulation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不忙，请解释。这可能与时间操纵的最后理论润色息息相关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hello World.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你好，世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Science can explain it. It governs everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 科学可以解释它。它主宰一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It was the first thing EVER posted on the internet. The first message. Posted by the creator of the internet to show it 'worked'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那是有史以来在互联网上发布的第一篇内容。第一条信息。由互联网的创建者发布，来证明互联网"运行了"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ha! I wish omg. But do you know 'Hello World'?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哈！我的天啊，但愿吧。但是你知道"你好，世界"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And from there all hell broke loose. People lost their FREAKING minds. Science. Banking. Technology. Entertainment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后一切都乱套了。人们像疯了一样。互联网改变了一切：科学、经济、技术、娱乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And through billions of choices and causes and effect, it led to me going online one day and...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 经过数十亿次的选择和因果关系，有一天我上线了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And it was the end of Nova, or Kaya rather. Her future, her career, her friends, everything. Because of one mistake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这就是 Nova（或者更确切地说是卡娅）的末日。她的未来、事业、朋友，一切的一切。只因一个错误。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So you're saying that the missing part of my experiments, tests, research, and hypostheis is 'magic'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以你是说，我的实验、测试、研究和假设中缺少部分的是"魔法"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So I guess like I trust the Void more than I trust other people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以我想比起其他人，我更信任虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I can work with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这会对我有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Seen. Watched. Noted. Studied. Restudied. Mhmm. It can all be explained. It's rooted in something. 'Magic' maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 看到过。观察过。记录过。研究过。也重新研究过。嗯。这一切都可以解释。它根植于某种东西。也许是"魔法"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I guess maybe you haven't clued in totally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想也许你还没有完全明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I can work with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这会对我有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But I am getting out of 1999.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但我要离开 1999 年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I literally don't care what happens to me trying to get there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我根本不关心在到达那里的过程中会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's the only thing occupying my brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是占据我大脑的唯一一件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And for me, that's a good thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 对我来说，这是件好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you know what it's like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你知道那是什么感觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I was the girl who had it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我曾是个拥有一切的女孩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'll be 'ok' when I can leave this year.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 只有逃离这一年，我才能真正"好起来"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I just don't know if I can trust people anymore. Even you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我只是不知道我还能不能相信别人了。甚至包括你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You trapped me in the worst year of my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你把我困在了我这辈子最痛苦的一年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Like I'm basically using you to get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 基本上我只是利用你来逃离这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Glad we agree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 很高兴我们意见一致。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: When you find out... none of you will look at me the same...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 等你们发现时……就再不会用现在的眼神看我了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Even if you aren't trying, I'll screw something up. I always do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 就算你们没有想伤害我，我也会搞砸一些事。向来如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You want to know what it's like? The internet shows up, promises so much to us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你想知道那是什么样子吗？互联网的出现，给我们带来了很多可能性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So you're me. You turn 18. You go online. You start chatting to new friends EVERYWHERE!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以你代入一下我。你 18 岁了。你登录网络。开始与来自各个地方的新朋友聊天！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And for a so called 'smart girl' like me, you do the stupidest thing ever on the internet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而你作为一个公认的"聪明妞"，却在网上做了最愚蠢的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You trust the person on the other side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你轻信了网络另一端的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And you look at all this new technology and forget that people are still people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当你面对这个崭新的科技时，你便忘了人心险恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So you send a nude picture of yourself that would make Lua blush. You think you have a connection with someone you met on the internet. You can trust your online boyfriend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 于是你发了一张令人脸红的裸照。你相信你和网上认识的人的关系。觉得可以信任你的网恋男友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And the next day, that photo is everywhere. Everyone on campus has seen it. Shared. Sent it to your PROFESSORS. All over the INTERNET. Countries I didn't even know existed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 接着第二天，这张照片就到处都是了。校园里的每个人都看到了它。互相分享。发给你的教授。传遍了整个互联网。甚至传到了我都不知道其存在的国家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I could have been the smartest person on this rock and all people would remember me for is that picture.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我可能是这地球上最聪明的人，但人们只会因为那张照片而记住我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So when I say I'm going to get out of here, I mean it. I know that picture means NOTHING, the future moved on, people got their kicks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以，当我说我要离开这里时，我是认真的。我知道那张照片毫无意义，生活在前进，人们只是想找点乐子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But to me it ruined my life. I want to live in a future with no internet. I want to prove that I can move forward from this. Going to the past proves THEM right, that I can't move on from this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但对我来说，它毁了我的生活。我想生活在没有互联网的未来。我想证明我能从这件事中走出来。回到过去就证明他们是对的，我就无法摆脱这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So, just wait. You'll see me where you come from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以，等着吧。你会在你的来处见到我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And we can look at the world and laugh that my choices didn't destroy me. It all just made me smarter. Smart enough to get out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后看着这个世界，我们可以笑着说，我的选择并没有毁了我。这一切只是让我变得更聪明。聪明到可以摆脱这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you see why I need to get away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你知道我为什么要离开吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's like, what happened to me had never happened to ANYONE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 就好像，任何人都没有经历过发生在我身上的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It made headlines. People mocked me for pretending I was a victim of something when it was my own choice to share that photo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这张照片上了头条。人们嘲讽我明明是自己要发那张照片却假装自己是受害者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You can't even look up my name in the student databases without people thinking of that 'STP', Slutty Teachers Pet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 甚至如果有人在学生数据库中查找我的名字，就会联想到那个老师的放荡马屁精。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And you guys will find the picture too and none of you will ever look at me the same again. Like any respect... gone. Forever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你们要是发现那张照片也会用异样的眼光看待我。仿佛所有的尊重……都永远消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I have to get out, I have to move forward, to a time and place where I was smart enough to leave this all behind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我必须离开，我必须向前走，走到一个我足够聪明可以把这一切都抛在脑后的时间和地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Maybe one day you can tell me the biggest regret you have...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 也许有一天你能告诉我你最大的遗憾……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Don't F*** Lie to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 少他妈骗我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I trust you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我信任你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Doesn't mean I'm sticking around here without an escape option though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但这并不意味着我只会待在这里而不留后路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ehhh ask me again tomorrow?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，明天再问我好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I know we are wayyy past high school.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我知道我们早已不是高中生了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Could be really close, really onto something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 离得真的很接近了，就差一个导火索了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But it doesn't take a kid-genius to see that you really care about us. And we all respect you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但即使不是天才儿童也能看出你真的关心我们。我们也都很尊重你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Even Arthur. Firstly, huge crush on him omg.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 甚至连亚瑟也是。首先声明，我超级迷恋他，我的天啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yup! There are a few caveats of course. The most certain and safe path is to go EXACTLY to when you came from, as there's something of a 'Void Fingerprint' there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没错！当然也有一些注意事项。最可靠、最安全的方法就是完全回到你来自的时代，因为那里有"虚空指纹"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当然是你啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So sure. It's a challenge. Whatever happens happens, right? Like, it's keeping me busy, focused...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当然。这是个挑战。该发生的总会发生，对吧？就像，这让我忙碌，专注……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Exactly! Burn the ships! No looking back!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没错！破釜沉舟！不要回头！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yup! There are a few caveats of course. The most certain and safe path is to go EXACTLY to when you came from, as there's something of a 'Void Fingerprint' there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没错！当然也有一些注意事项。最可靠、最安全的方法就是完全回到你来自的时代，因为那里有"虚空指纹"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Um, are you crazy? Not Gross. ANYWAY!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃，你疯了吗？一点都不恶心好吗。话说回来！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: PFFT NO please don't I told you that in CONFIDENCE! Anyway...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哎呦不要啊，千万不要，我是信任你才跟你说的！话说回来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Pfft I know, LUCKY! Anywayyyy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哎呀我知道，真幸运啊！话说回来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: There's no downside. Either I figure it out, or I don't. See ya here, or see ya there. Right? See ya!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没什么坏处。要么我想明白，要么想不明白。 要么在这里见，要么在那里见。对吧？回头见！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But in a way this is like highschool where, like, everyone likes you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 其实在某种程度上，就像在高中，每个人都喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And that says something deeper than just popularity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这说明了一些更深层次的东西，而不仅仅是受欢迎程度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Did you get into Arthur's beers? Why didn't you mention this sooner?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你是不是喝了亚瑟的啤酒？你为什么不早点说呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We're all kind of super messed up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们每个人或多或少都有点精神错乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But what do you mean a finger?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但你说的一根手指是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Omg... gossiping? After what I just said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 天哪……聊点八卦吗？在我刚说完那些之后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It totally is. 100 percent. Because no one here is competing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 完全是。百分之百。因为这里没有人在竞争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: (But obviously Arthur because I was talking to him and it sounds like you really messed with his head).
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: (但很明显是亚瑟，因为我和他说过话，听起来你真的让他精神错乱了）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's just like, the weirdest thing. We're turning into monsters but it's the most human I've ever felt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这就像是最奇怪的事情。我们变成了怪物，但这是我感到最有人性的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ok so matter is retained, thanks!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 明白了，所以物质是保留的，谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which, incidentally, confirmed a hypothesis I had about your corporeal connection to 1999.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 顺便说一句，这证实了我对你与 1999 年的肉体联系的假设。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I can actually be myself now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 其实我现在可以做我自己了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which is relevant because.. ah! Test done. Talk soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是具有关联性的，因为……啊！测试完成。回头再说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not afraid anymore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不再害怕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So, thanks?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以，谢谢你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You can deal with that. States of matter preservation are more interesting. Thanks!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你可以处理这个问题。研究物质保存的状态显然更有趣。谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Mhmm, all your footsteps really are the key to me 'following safely, you know.'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，你的足迹真的是我能够"安全追随"的关键。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's like a big glowing Voidy Exit sign, when it comes to particles being attracted to their next form.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当粒子被吸引到下一个形态时，它就像一个巨大的发光的虚空出口标志。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sorry um right, but what is 'Duviri'? A state of matter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不好意思，"双衍王境"是什么？一种物质的状态？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Haha! Omg. Ok I see, and it is firmly in the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哈哈！我的天。好吧，我明白了，它真的在虚空中吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Roll out the red Carpet in case I show up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我造访的时候请铺好红地毯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is it even still there? How can you be sure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它还在吗？你怎么能确定？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Plan for all potential outcomes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 为所有可能的结果做好计划。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Is there a sun?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有太阳吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Would you? There's a school of science that might expect the observation of Duviri to be key to its existence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你会知道吗？有个科学流派认为对双衍王境的观察是其存在的关键。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: IDK, say something nice at my funeral if you never see me again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不知道，如果你再也见不到我，就在我的葬礼上说几句好话吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yup, and let me know if you can help!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当然，如果你能帮上忙，请告诉我！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ha, ha.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Any celestial objects?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有任何天体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh and tell Arthur I think he's cute, but only if I am like really gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦，如果我真的死了，告诉亚瑟我觉得他很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'll try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我尽力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you think 'It' can be explained?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你认为"它"能被解释吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not my highest mark, don't remind me, ugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这不是我的最高分科目，别提醒我了，呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: All things in the known universe are defined by their relation to celestial bodies. How odd, this Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 已知宇宙中的所有事物都是由它们与天体的关系所定义的。这个虚空真奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well, for your sake I guess it'd be kinda fun to answer your Scientific enigma, I hope you get answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，站在你的角度考虑的话，我估计解答你的科学谜题会有点意思，希望你能找到答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I guess? Maybe not like, 'struggle' exactly.  Who cares about why and who, let's just make cool things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想是吧？也许不完全是对它"头疼"。谁在乎原因和对象，我们只要做些很酷的事情就行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Meh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Thankkk youuu!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 谢谢你啊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Wellll seems related but not my focus of studies. See ya if I see ya!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 似乎有关联，但不是我的研究重点。回见！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Meh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Meh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ok fine you're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I keep finding these purple things, but they disappear like the next day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我一直看到这些紫色的东西，但它们第二天就凭空消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And I'm thinking there's something to their decay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我觉得它们的衰变得有些原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Because the matter isn't just reforming into a decay state of a new isotope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 因为那些物质不是在转化为新同位素的衰变态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's actually disappearing from HERE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它们直接从这儿凭空消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Mmm nope, not that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯嗯不，不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: That's gotta be it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一定就是它了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Do you manage to keep them around where you're from?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 在你来的地方，有办法保存它们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Mmm nope definitely not that either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯不是，肯定也不是那个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well that's just it - in the Void they are inert.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 噢那就对了——在虚空中它们是惰性的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't think so, if we can't figure it out I might never solve this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我觉得不是，如果我们想不出来，我可能永远也解不开这个问题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And when they leave the Void, they always return to the Void. They don't decay into new matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而一旦当它们离开虚空，它们就必须返回虚空。它们并不会衰变成新物质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: They phase back into the Void. The Void is everywhere, calling it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 它们相位回归虚空。虚空无处不在，召唤它们回去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh oh no, the last sample I had is gone. I ... ugh. I have to go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃呃不，我的最后一个样本也不见了。我……唉。我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I don't think I can do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我可能做不到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's more about the states of matter and the theory that the Void isn't 'linear' in a our understanding, so I can use it as a trampoline to effectively follow YOU back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这更多是在说物质状态，以及虚空不是"线性"的理论，所以我可以把虚空当作蹦床跟着你回去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Very very very! It means matter has a connection between the VOID and HERE. Atoms, Matter, they are CONSISTENT in both areas.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 非常非常非常！这意味着物质在虚空和这个地方之间存在连接。原子，物质，它们在两个地点都具有一致性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: The Void isn't 'linear' by our understanding, so I can use it as a trampoline to effectively follow YOU back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 在我们的理解中，虚空并不是"线性"的，所以我可以把虚空当作蹦床跟着你回去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yup, no matter how many times I run tests or equations, I'm missing a 'lighthouse' so to speak. The trampoline jump needs to land somewhere, and if you've even gone back once it should be enough to calibrate to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是的，无论我测试或运算多少次方程式，我总是缺少一个"灯塔"。蹦床跳需要有个落点，如果你曾经回去过一次，那就足够进行校准了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm not quite ready yet of course. Measure twice, cut once. Measure... 1000 times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我当然还没完全准备好。只有一次机会，三思而后行。1000 次思而后行……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I won't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我不会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm teaching you well, I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 看我把你教的多好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ahh no no I'm not ready! You can't rush this!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 啊不不不，我还没准备好！你别催我！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Nope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Minerva with a hangover is more dangerous than time travel though. RUN!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 米尼娃宿醉时比时光旅行更危险。快跑！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Minerva with a hangover is more dangerous, though. RUN!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不过米尼娃宿醉时更危险。快跑！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You'd find me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你来找我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No take backs!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不许反悔！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Nah. Let's talk about something else actually! Ok?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 别。我们还是聊点别的吧！好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Yeah Yeah she's fine, I'm more of a dog girl though. Grew up with one. I wish I could see him again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯，嗯她很好，不过我更喜欢狗狗。我和一只狗一起长大的。我希望能再次看见他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Hmm okay yeah sure. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯嗯好吧。是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ummm I guess... my first pet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 嗯我想想……我的第一只宠物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Although that's usually one of those hacker internet questions so uhh don't tell anyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 虽然这是网上黑客的惯用问题，所以呃，别告诉任何人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's kind of unfair actually. Entrati gets to time travel around with his freaky-feline?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这其实有点不公平。英择谛时间旅行的时候可以带上他的古怪猫猫一起？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But his name was Zylo. You'd call him a Kubrow I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 他的名字叫齐罗。我觉得你会叫他库狛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If I had Zylo with me... this trip would be a lot easier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果我有齐罗在身边……这趟旅途可就轻松多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: HUGE, like biggest dog you could imagine. Could bite Mr. Volkov in half I bet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 很大一只，你能想象到的最大的狗狗。我敢打赌他可以一口将沃尔科夫先生咬成两半。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Zylo was the first living thing to see me cry, you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 齐罗是第一个看见我哭的生物，你知道吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: When you put it this way.. I guess life and people just kind of sucks sometimes doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你要是这么说的话……我感觉生活和人有时候就是这么糟不是么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I was like 5 years old, and as long as I can remember I refused to cry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我好像是五岁，在我记忆中我一直拒绝哭泣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But then sometimes it's so awesome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但有时候又非常棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh my god... all the more reason for me to GET THERE. Wow!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦天哪……那我更有理由要去了。哇！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Actually you might have a point... but anyway, big scary Zylo. But he was fiercely protective of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好像你说的有道理……但反正，又大又吓人的齐罗。但他非常保护我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But I got home from my first day of first grade at school and Zylo was there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但那是我一年级第一天回家，齐罗就在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: We can't define ourselves by our biggest regret I guess. I feel like you helped me move on from mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我们无法用最大的遗憾来定义自己。我感觉你帮我从我的遗憾中走出来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: My Zylo was fiercely protective of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我的齐罗非常保护我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And he followed me to my room and guarded the door while I just sobbed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后他就跟着我进了房间，我在哭的时候他守在门口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But I wouldn't change that it happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但我不会改变这件已经发生的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Because like, I don't hate this for me. Nova? Kind of the coolest thing ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 因为对吧，我不讨厌这个。Nova？简直太酷了好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Someone called me fat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有人说我胖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: How could I forget?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我怎么能忘？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which was like, the thing that made kids unpopular when I grew up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这好像是，我小时候让孩子们不受欢迎的一件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Someone called me fat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有人说我胖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not a damn thing. And I hope you wouldn't either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 一件都不。而且我希望你也不用改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Everyone is cruel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 每个人都很残忍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It was... until all this happened. I feel like I'm a better person after all this shit, like, I am who I truly should have been this whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 重要……直到这一切发生了。在经历了这些糟糕的事情之后，我觉得我变得更好了，就像，我现在才是我真正想要成为的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Everyone wants to be the cool kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 每人都想做那个酷小孩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No more caring about what people think of me. Just.. getting to finally live.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不用在意别人对我的看法。就……终于活出我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But I've realized now, it's way cooler to not care about being cool. That's why you're so cool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但我现在意识到了，不在乎酷更酷。所以你才这么酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I feel like I'm a better person after all this shit, like, I am who I truly should have been this whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 在经历了这些糟糕的事情之后，我觉得我变得更好了，就像，我现在才是我真正想要成为的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: No more caring about what people think of me. Just.. getting to finally live.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不用在意别人对我的看法。就……终于活出我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ohhh hi, may I kindly introduce you to a 101 on JINYMON CARDS?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦嗨，我可以向你介绍一下吉尼梦卡牌的基础知识吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Amir of course is thrilled he finally has someone to play with (and lose to).
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 阿米尔当然很高兴终于有人和他一起玩了（而且还让他输）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But we both thought it would be fun to get you into Jinymon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但我们都觉得拉你入坑吉尼梦会很有意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ooookay yeah! Right so like, first. Let's focus on you. Do you see yourself as more like a Dragon, an Eagle, or a Panther?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好耶！好所以首先，我们来聚焦一下你。你觉得自己更像龙，更像鹰，还是更像豹呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's only THE most popular show, game, collectible in 1999!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 就是那个 1999 年超火的节目、游戏、收藏品！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You know like super cool characters and creatures...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你知道的，有超酷的角色、生物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: K then you would ABSOLUTELY want to start the game with Tailala
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好，那么你绝对会想用泰拉拉猫开始游戏

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: K so you would DEFINITELY want to start the game with Plumebert
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好，那么你肯定会想用伯特鸟开始游戏

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: K so you would PROBABLY want to start the game with Frogobogo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好，那么你可能会想用博格蛙开始游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Not the point I guess. Anyway, let's start with you. Do you see yourself as more like a Dragon, an Eagle, or a Panther?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我想这些不是重点。总之，我们还是先从你说起。你觉得自己更像龙，更像鹰，还是更像豹呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which is like the coolest option but def tricky, starts really weak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是最酷的选择，但绝对有难度，一开始很弱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which is a bit advanced but really cool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 有一点进阶但非常酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which is a great choice for beginners.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 是一个对新手很不错的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But by the end? The most gorgeous and majestic Panther is yours basically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但最后？你会得到一只最华丽、最威严的黑豹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And Plumebert is super cute because you can feed him Fizzy Grapes to level up faster than everyone else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 波波鸟超级可爱因为你可以给他喂泡泡葡萄，他可以比任何人升级的都快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And sure you start with basically the cutest frog ever but eventually if you win enough battles..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后当然你会从最可爱的一只蛙蛙开始，但最终如果你赢得够多……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Totally a classy choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 真是优雅的选择呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Which lets you unlock a whole Crop system.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后你就可以解锁一整套种地系统。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: You can level Frogobogo into a DRAGON.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 你可以将它进化成一条龙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Right okay so you collect Jinymons and they battle for you and you get to adventure around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧，基本上就是你去收集吉尼梦精灵，它们会为你战斗，然后你还可以去各地冒险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But that's in the video game version. In the card game version it's like you ARE doing the battles only against someone else in real life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但那是电子游戏的版本。在卡牌游戏中你会和现实中的其他人对战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's like all the same idea though. Jinymon Jinymon Jinymon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 但都差不多就是了。吉尼梦吉尼梦吉尼梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So, ready to play your first match?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以，开始玩第一场吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Great... you just need to fork over like 10,000 höllars for a starter pack of your own...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 太好了……你只需要发过来大约 10000 霍币买一套自己的入门卡……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Oh come on... I'll go easy on you. I'll even let Amir help you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 哦来吧……我会放水的。我甚至会让阿米尔帮你！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And if you win I'll give you an unopened Jinymon pack!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而且如果你赢，我会送你一包没打开的吉尼梦卡！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: It's no problem, if you could just put your banking info right here....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 没有问题，如果你只要在这里填下你的银行信息……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Great... you just need to fork over like 10,000 höllars for a starter pack of your own...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 太好了……你只需要发过来大约 10000 霍币买一套自己的入门卡……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Fineeee.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Congratulations, you passed the K.O.L safety test.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 恭喜你，你通过了即时网安全测试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: OMG NO! It was a test, you are NOT supposed to put your banking information on the K.O.L internet services!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 天哪不！这是一个测试，你可不能在即时网上发你的银行信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Omg Amir was soo sure you'd fall for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 天哪阿米尔可确信你会上当了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Ugh Damnit! I owe Amir a game. He said you'd fall for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 呃该死！我欠阿米尔一场游戏。他说你会上当的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: But yeah we'll play later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 不过我们晚点再玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm sorry for being such a know-it-all bitch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 很抱歉我像个自以为是的婊子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Can I just ramble? Like just get some things out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我能随便说几句吗？把一些想法说出来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I might never get out of here. I've accepted that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我可能永远出不去了。我接受了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Well firstly, you can call me Kaya now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 好吧首先，你现在可以叫我卡娅了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: I'm learning that I am who I am and I shouldn't let my regrets define me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 我正在学会接受自己，我不应该用后悔定义我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Cause if anyone is reading this, it was KAYA VELASCO who figured it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 因为如果任何人在读这条消息，是卡娅·维拉斯科解开了这个难题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And like, if I did get out, it'd almost be mean. It'd be too dangerous for anyone to follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 而且像，如果我真的出去了，那就太卑鄙了。对任何跟着过来的人都太危险了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you're going to search my name, find two things: that I SOLVED IT, I am OUT of 1999.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你去搜索我的名字，你会找到两样东西：我解开了这个难题，我已经离开了 1999 年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: So, let's do what we can here! In 1999.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 所以，让我们在这儿做自己能做的吧！在这个 1999 年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: And whatever photo you find of me, that girl left you all behind. BYEEE!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 然后无论你找到我的什么照片，那个女孩把你们全部抛下了。拜！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Sure. Come find me in Larunda. I'll be waiting, looking out at the stars.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 当然。来水神中继站找我。我一边看星星一边等你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: This is an automated message from KAYA VELASCO.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是一条卡娅·维拉斯科的自动留言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: This is an automated message from KAYA VELASCO.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 这是一条卡娅·维拉斯科的自动留言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you are reading this, I've disconnected my KIM account and can be found outside 'The Round Table'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你正在阅读这条留言，我已经断开了我的即时通账号，你可以来"老圆桌"外面找到我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: If you are reading this, find me where you find yourself, wherever you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 如果你正在阅读这条留言，无论你身在何处，都可以在自己的时间里找到我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: 1999, forever. Yay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 1999，永远在这里。好耶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.text: Live, Laugh, Love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/KayaDialogue.zhText: 活着，笑着，爱着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I get the feeling you're mad...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我感觉你现在很生气……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Um... did you not get the peanut butter...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……你没有收到花生酱吗......？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey, so, it was all a mistake. Amir was trying to send you peanut butter for your rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，所以，这全都是误会。阿米尔是想给你的老鼠送花生酱吃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: This is all a misunderstanding. He was trying to send you a gift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这都是误会。他只是想送你个礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But it all got screwed up, and I'll help him deal with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但搞砸了，我会帮他处理的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Happy Birthday, Lettie! Do you get a day off today? Or at least to sit down?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐，莱蒂！你今天休假吗？或者至少可以坐下来歇会儿？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Happy Birthday! I'm sure everybody in the med tent appreciate you working. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐！我相信医疗帐篷里的每个人都会感谢你的付出。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey! Have any fun plans for your birthday? Like going to bed early?
