/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿！你生日有什么有意思的计划吗？比如早点睡觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Happy Birthday! Let's go out to the clubs!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐！我们去夜店耍耍吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Happy Birthday! On Star Days no less. How Romantic. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐！而且还是在星日这天。多浪漫啊。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey! Happy Birthday! Did your rats get you anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿！生日快乐！你的小鼠给你送了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah..?
[Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I meant every word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我说的每一个字都是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I was making that all up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我全都胡说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I still don't know if "mierda" is a good thing or not...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我还不确定"mierda"到底是好事还是坏事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If it's not mutual you can just tell me, I can take it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果你不这么想，直说无妨，我能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm not saying no, but can I ask...why pain is your thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不是说不，但我可以问一下……为什么你喜欢痛苦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Only if we get to take turns now and then...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 只要我们能时不时地轮流的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm not really into mixing pain and pleasure, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我不太喜欢将痛苦和快乐混在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah. I do, actually. :) [Date Lettie.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的。事实上，我想。:) [和莱蒂约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I need to think this over, actually. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 事实上我需要再好好考虑一下。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie? Are you busy? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂？你忙吗？[征求是否同意多重伴侣关系]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想跟你说件事，我想先确定你能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对我来说重要的是，你不会觉得我在用任何方式对你撒谎，或者对你不坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Please don't hurt me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 请别伤害我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Please don't get mad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 请别生气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I hope you understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我希望你能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不想让你陷入一种你无法接受的情况。我知道我们之前没有讨论过这件事。所以如果你拒绝，那也没关系。我希望你清楚这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们之间的感情对我很重要——非常重要——而且它是真实的。我不希望你怀疑这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I do care about them. But I also care very deeply about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的确在乎他。但我也深深地在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I should have guessed you would have figured it out quickly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我早该想到你很快会明白我的意思的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yes ma'am. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 遵命，女士。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我看看我能做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Apology accepted. Thank you, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我接受你的道歉。莱蒂，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You need to learn to stop taking your shit out on other people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你需要学会不要把自己的烦恼发泄在别人身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: For what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对不起什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, well. You're not exactly making me want to stick around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，是。你这样让我不太想留下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What're you afraid of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你在害怕什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: *You're* afraid of something? Holy shit, get Eleanor, we have a newspaper article to write.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你居然会怕东西？哇塞，快去叫埃莉诺来，我们得写篇头条新闻了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I guess because I've lived through a loop before, I'm not so scared of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我猜因为我之前经历过循环，所以我不那么害怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, but... I have something valuable keeping me here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，但是……我有珍贵的东西让我留在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 六人组。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Big Bytes Pizza.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 超级比特披萨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sure you and I could find ways of keeping things interesting... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我相信你和我可以找到让事情变得有趣的方法…… ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can't make promises about the future, Lettie. It hasn't been written yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我无法对未来做出承诺，莱蒂。一切还未成定局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You can choose to believe me or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你可以选择相信我，也可以不信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I just... wanted to say sorry, Lettie. That's all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我只是……想说声对不起，莱蒂。仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... well. I have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……嗯。我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: He must have been mistaken. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他肯定是搞错了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Couldn't tell you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我没办法告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah. :) I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是。:) 我想试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Actually, never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 其实，没事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Me neither.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They *were* bad questions, though. lol. I just don't know what else to talk about
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那些问题是很糟糕。哈哈，我只是不知道还能聊些什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just trying to be friendly, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我只是想表现得友好一点，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What should I talk to you about instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那我应该和你聊些什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I didn't really have a choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我其实没得选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Am I bothering you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我是不是打扰到你了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm clearly bugging you, I'll leave you alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 显然我打扰到你了，我这就走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie, how'd you get into being a medic?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，你是怎么成为医生的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just trying to say hello, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 只是想打个招呼，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I just wanted to see how you were doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我只是想看看你过得怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just killing time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 只是打发时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Make it interesting. Roger. I'll... go... think up... interesting things...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 让它有趣。收到。我会……去……想点……有趣的事情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Anything I can help with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'll stop bothering you, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那我不打扰你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey, Lettie, what brought you to Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，是什么让你来到霍瓦尼亚的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为什么没怎么睡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Anyone back home missing you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 家里有人想你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So what made you want to keep rats as pets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以是什么让你想养小鼠当宠物的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Anyone back home missing you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 家里有人想你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: O...kay... [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好……吧…… [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sometimes painful memories are all that get us through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 有时候，正是痛苦的记忆才能帮助我们挺过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We're talking on the *internet* and you know the *phone* exists, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们是在*网上*聊天，你知道*电话*这东西，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you know what it feels like to get your head cut off? I do. I've died a thousand times. And it *hurts,* lady.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你知道被砍头是什么感觉吗？我知道。我已经死了无数次了。而且*很痛*，女士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't have to prove myself to you, lady.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 女士，我不需要向你证明什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you take the pain for other people by choice, or because it's your duty?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是自愿为别人承受痛苦，还是因为这是你的责任？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: There's still life worth living, here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这里仍然有值得过下去的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't think I like where this is going. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想我不喜欢这个话题的走向。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because they're intelligent, affectionate, and playful?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为它们聪明、亲人，还很好玩？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because they're often neglected and misunderstood?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为它们经常被忽视和误解？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lettie? I don't understand the first thing about you. But the rats are cute as hell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂？我真的一点也不了解你。不过那些小鼠真是可爱极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Uh...
No... never mind...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没有……算了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You can get them, since she's your rat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 既然她是你的小鼠，你应该自己去拿

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sure, I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当然，我会尽力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Is that a hello?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这是在打招呼吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Not now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 现在不行，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Who's Anita?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 安妮塔是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I have no idea who that is, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我不知道那是谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If I see any, I'll grab some.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我要是看到有的话，我会拿一些过来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You can go out and get the gauze then, if your rat ate it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 既然是你的小鼠吃了那些纱布，那你自己去外面弄点回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm curious, why do you keep rats as pets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇，你为什么养小鼠当宠物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't think I like where this is going. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想我不喜欢这个话题的走向。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lettie? I don't understand the first thing about you. But the rats are cute as hell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂？我真的一点也不了解你。不过那些小鼠真是可爱极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because they're often neglected and misunderstood?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为它们经常被忽视和误解？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because they're intelligent, affectionate, and playful?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为它们聪明、亲人，还很好玩？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sorry, back up, what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不好意思，你能再说一遍吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You have a hell of a way of starting a conversation, you know that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你这聊天开场真有一套，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Not touching THIS with a ten foot pole... [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这话题我可不敢碰……[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Haven't forgotten them, we didn't have any. I don't count the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没忘记，我们根本就没有神。奥罗金不算。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... hate to break it to you, but Sol and Lua aren't gods. One's a star and the other is a rock that's seen some shit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……不想打击你，但太阳神和月神不是神。一个是恒星，另一个只是经历过一些事的石头

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They aren't worshipped as gods anymore, I'm sorry. But Lua is still considered kind of sacred.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他们不再被当作神来崇拜了，我很抱歉。但月球还是有些神圣的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can only speak for myself, and I was raised to worship the Orokin. And then I learned better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我只能说我自己的例子，我从小就被教育要崇拜奥罗金。后来我懂事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They were assholes who thought they were above everyone else. Enough said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他们是一群以为自己高人一等的混蛋。就这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They were a group of people who ruled over the Origin system. Who thought of themselves as gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他们是一群统治始源星系的人。他们自认为是神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lua... well... It kind of got shoved in the void for a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 月球……嗯……它有一段时间被推入了虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's complicated. A really long story. The short of it is, it's still very important, but not worshiped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这很复杂。说来话长。简而言之，它仍然很重要，但不是被崇拜的对象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The void is kind of like a non-dimension? It's sometimes black and white. It's weird. Kind of tingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 虚空有点像一个非维度？有时是黑白的。很奇怪。还有点刺痛感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Whoa, back up. *I* didn't put her anywhere! I had nothing to do with it!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哇，慢着。我没把她放在哪里！我跟这事没关系！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I was abandoned on a space ship and then stuck in my own personal hell while all that nonsense was going on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当所有这些荒唐事发生的时候，我被遗弃在一艘宇宙飞船上，还被困在我自己的地狱里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The universe. The void. Everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 宇宙。虚空。一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 什么都不崇拜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I believe in myself and the people around me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我相信自己和我周围的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's personal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这是我的私事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Duviri was an alternate dimension I kind of... created? Sort of? By existing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 双衍王境是我在某种程度上……创造的另一个维度？有点像是，因我而存在？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're a weird lady...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你真是个奇怪的女人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: None of your business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不关你的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No, that's one thing they didn't do to me, thankfully.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没有，幸好他们没那么对我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It was made out of the void plucked from my mind and made real. Manifestations of a frightened child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它是从我脑海中的虚空抽离出来的，然后变成了现实。一个受惊小孩的显化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Dominus Thrax and his goons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 士魂大帝和他的小弟们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They. Me. It's all the same. It's a long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他们。我。都一样。说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: He wasn't real. He was a fictional character the void plucked from my head and turned into reality by my sheer presence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他不是真实的。他是一个虚构的人物，虚空从我的脑海中夺走了他，而我的存在让他变成了现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Would you want to tell me all about *your* darkest moments right now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你现在愿意跟我说说你最黑暗的时刻吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But it all went wrong when I grew up and wanted to leave. And they began killing me, again and again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但当我长大想离开时，一切都出错了。他们开始一次又一次地杀我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Dying on endless repeat does that to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不断重复的死亡会让人变成这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Dying on endless repeat does that to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不断重复的死亡会让人变成这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Dying on endless repeat does that to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不断重复的死亡会让人变成这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Dying on endless repeat does that to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不断重复的死亡会让人变成这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But I was in Duviri, dying repeatedly, when the Lotus decided to put Lua in the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但当时我还在双衍王境里，反复死亡，而 Lotus 决定把月球放进虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And here I thought *I* was morbid...  Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我以为只有我才会有这么病态的想法……你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: LOL. Lady, don't get me started. You?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。女士，别让我开始讲这个。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You seriously need to get outside more often.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你真的需要多出去走走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: La Flaca is death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: La Flaca 是指死亡吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Who's La Flaca?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 谁是 La Flaca？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But you're a medic. Don't you heal people? How can you "respect" death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但你是个医生。不是应该治病救人吗？你怎么能"尊重"死亡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Death isn't a person. It's a thing that happens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 死亡不是人。它是必然发生的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: When I was in Duviri, and I knew I was about to die, sometimes it was a relief to know it'd be over soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当我还在双衍王境，知道自己快要死时，有时候知道这一切很快就结束反而是种解脱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I guess part of me understands that. Even if I don't like the idea of dying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我大概能明白这点。即便我不喜欢死亡这个想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I am... going to stop this conversation, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……现在要结束这个话题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That no matter how badly it was about to hurt, the darkness would come and it'd be done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不管伤势有多严重，黑暗终将会来临，一切都会结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But I also knew I was going to come back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但我也知道我还会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But I don't think it means everybody should die. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但我不认为这意味着每个人都应该死。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I could toast to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 冲这话我得敬你一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What're the names of your pet rats?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你的宠物鼠叫什么名字？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How many pet rats do you have?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你有多少只宠物鼠？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How did you pick their names?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么给它们起这些名字的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You should name one after me. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你应该用我的名字来给其中一只起名。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What *does* Babas mean, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 话说 Babas 究竟是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Har har. I know what that means, y'know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。我知道那是什么意思，你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I've never heard of Tláloc before. Did he come before Lua and Sol? Before dualism?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我以前从未听说过特拉洛克。他是在月神和太阳神之前出现的吗？在二元论之前吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What makes him a dick? lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为什么说他是个混蛋？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do you mean, "bloody?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: "血腥"是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sounds, um, pleasant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 听起来，嗯，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Mkay... I trust you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧……我相信你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't believe you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我才不信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Flayed One...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 剥皮神……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: He doesn't sound TOO bad...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他听起来还不算太糟糕……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well. Thanks for the nightmare fuel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧。多谢你的噩梦素材。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Humans are weird.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 人类真奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Kind of? Halfway. After his void experiments, they adored him. But he was bitter about how they treated him before, so... it's hard to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 算是吧？半对。他进行虚空实验后，人们对他顶礼膜拜。但他对之前遭受的事心存怨恨，所以……这有点难解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I gotta go, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我得走了，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think it's just how he is. You should meet the Cavia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这就是他的本性。你应该见见科维兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But he thinks he's doing all this for the greater good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但他认为他所做的一切是为了更大的善。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: He's used to rubbing shoulders with the Orokin. He's used to thinking he's a god.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他经常和奥罗金人混在一起。一直自认为是神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I gotta go, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我得走了，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Friends of mine. Animals that Entrati experimented on by sending them into the void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的朋友们。是些动物，曾被那个英择谛送进过虚空做实验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I dunno, your ass *is* pretty good. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，你的屁股*倒是*挺不错的。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Stopping the Man in the Wall is a pretty important problem, to be fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 客观来说，阻止墙中人确实是个相当重要的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The ruling class of people in the future I come from. They made people worship them as gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我所在未来的统治阶级。他们让人们把他们当作神一样来崇拜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They were assholes who thought they were above everyone else. Enough said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他们是一群以为自己高人一等的混蛋。就这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They were sent into the void and came out with intelligence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他们被送入虚空，回来后拥有了智慧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The void can do... weird things like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 虚空可以带来……这种奇怪的变化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yep, you got it. Now they're a... bunch of traumatized animals with human intelligence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，你猜对了。现在他们是……一群有着人类智慧和心理创伤的动物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: He's trying to stop the Man in the Wall. It's important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他在努力阻止墙中人。这很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I do everything I can to help the Cavia. Honestly, I prefer them to most people. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我尽我所能去帮助科维兽了。说实话，比起大多数人类我更喜欢他们。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Maybe I can take you to see them someday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 也许有一天我可以带你去看他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I get why he'd do anything to stop the Man in the Wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我明白他为什么要不惜一切代价阻止墙中人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: In order to stop the Man in the Wall, we need him. But that doesn't mean I trust him. Or like him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为了阻止墙中人，我们需要他。但这并不意味着我信任他。或者喜欢他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'll be there to help you do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我会在那里帮你做这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Once the Man in the Wall is dealt with, he's all yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 一旦解决了墙中人，他就是你的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: D'aw, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哦，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Love you too, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我也爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sure. What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 可以。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Y'know I'm not your little bitch, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你知道我可不是你的跑腿吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Run your own errands. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 自己的事情自己做。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Are... you threatening me or hitting on me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你……是在威胁我，还是在撩我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Bring it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 放马过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm on it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我在做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我没法保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Get them yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你自己去找吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So... what's your problem with Eleanor, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以……你和埃莉诺之间到底有什么矛盾？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think you need to cut Eleanor some slack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你应该对埃莉诺宽容一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No, she didn't. I'm here on my own accord.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不，她没有。我是自己来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It doesn't matter if she did or not, I still think you should ease up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不管她有没有让我来，我还是觉得你应该对她宽容一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just because she embraces what's happened to her doesn't make her a bad person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 仅仅因为她接受了自己的遭遇，并不代表她是个坏人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I just don't think you're being fair to her, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我只是觉得你对她不够公平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: She's one of your teammates, Lettie. And like it or not, you're stuck with her. You need to work on letting go of your grudges.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，她是你的队友。不管你喜不喜欢，你都得和她共事。你需要学会放下你的怨恨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: She's lost her voice. She has to listen to everybody's thoughts all the time. She gets weird flashes of things she doesn't understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 她失去了声音。她不得不一直听着别人的想法。她还会看到她自己都不懂的奇怪幻觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And she's the one who is the closest to the Techrot. Can you imagine what that must feel like, to hear them all the time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 而且她是最接近科腐者的人。你可以想象一直能听到那些东西是什么感觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And she has all of YOU treating her like she's the real monster. Can you imagine what that must feel like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 而且你们所有人都把她当成真正的怪物。你能想象那种感觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can you blame her for meeting that kind of disgust with defiance instead of shame?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你能怪她用反抗而不是感到羞辱来回应这样的厌恶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're right, I still hold grudges. I'm not perfect. All I'm saying is that you're treating her like she's a monster. Can you blame her for meeting disgust with defiance?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说得对，我还是有怨恨的。我并不完美。我只是想说你把她当作怪物来对待。你能怪她用反抗来回应厌恶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're right, I still hold grudges. I'm not perfect. All I'm saying is that she's the one who is the closest to the Techrot. Can you imagine what that must feel like, to hear them all the time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说得对，我确实还怨恨。我并不完美。我只是想说，她是最接近科腐者的人。你能想象一直听到那些东西是什么感觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie, I have a favor to ask you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，我想请你帮个忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie, what do you think about tabletop roleplaying games?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，你对桌面角色扮演游戏有什么看法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know this'll sound like a massive waste of time, but Amir wants to get us all to play a game with him called Fables & Frontiers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道这听起来像是浪费时间，但阿米尔想让我们和他一起玩一个叫做寓言与边疆的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Amir really wants us all to play Fables & Frontiers with him. It's really important to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔非常希望我们大家能和他一起玩寓言与边疆。这对他来说真的很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why do I get the feeling I'm about to be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我怎么有种不好的预感？
不是……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You owe me a favor, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 可你欠我一个人情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... wait. What about pain?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……等一下。什么痛苦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It is to Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对阿米尔来说很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's not a matter of life and death, so. No. It can wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这不是生死攸关的事，所以，不急。可以先放一放。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Mm... Never mind. I'll save it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……算了。我还是留着吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I am. It's worth it, this means a lot to Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的。这是值得的，这对阿米尔来说很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You forgot to tell me what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你忘了告诉我你在指什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Magic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 魔法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Honestly? I almost did. I chose to go numb instead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 说实话？我差点就那样了。我选择了变得麻木。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... think I did lose my mind for a little while. I don't remember whole chunks of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……觉得我确实有一段时间疯了。很多事我都不记得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What happened to me in Duviri is very different to what's happening here. You're not alone like i was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我在双衍王境的经历和这里的经历完全不同。你并不像我当时一样孤身一人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Once I realized what was happening, I fought like hell to keep from letting it consume me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当我意识到发生了什么，我拼命地抗争，不让它吞噬我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I had help from friends to pull me out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我有朋友拉了我一把，帮我走出了困境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, *I* like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，*我*挺喜欢你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You think the other Hex don't like you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是觉得六人组其他人不喜欢你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, you aren't exactly "approachable," Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，莱蒂，你并不是那种"容易接近"的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, maybe if you weren't so bitchy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，要是你不那么毒舌的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No... I don't, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不……我没有看到，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean, I can take you out of here via transference for short periods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那个，我可以通过传识带你暂时离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Challenge accepted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 挑战接受了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Are... you hitting on me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你……是在调戏我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I was just trying to be nice. You're not my type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我只是想礼貌一点。你不是我的菜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why don't you let people get close?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为什么你不让人靠近呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're afraid to trust people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你害怕相信别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You don't want to get hurt if you lose them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你不想因为失去他们而受伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, you're my type. I like to live dangerously. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 希望，你是我的菜。我就喜欢刺激一点的生活。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No, I'd rather just stay friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不，我更希望我们只是朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just as a warning, I'm really stubborn, and I want to get to know you better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 先提醒你，我可是个很固执的人，我还想更了解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Thanks for the heads up. I won't take it personally if you step all over my feelings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你的提醒。如果你践踏了我的感情，我是不会放在心上的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Challenge accepted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我接受挑战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Are... you hitting on me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你……是在调戏我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I just want to be your friend, Lettie. No offense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我只是想和你做朋友。没有冒犯的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, you're my type. I like to live dangerously. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 希望，你是我的菜。我就喜欢刺激一点的生活。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No, I'd rather just stay friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不，我更希望我们只是朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't disagree. I hate Entrati as much as you do. But the future is worth fighting for, even if it'd be better without him in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不反对。我和你一样讨厌英择谛。但未来依然值得我们去争取，哪怕是未来没有他会更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Entrati isn't all bad, he's trying to fix his mistakes. And anybody who's capable of love has something worth saving in them, IMO.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 英择谛并非完全无可救药，他在试图弥补自己的错误。我认为，任何懂得爱的人的心中，总有值得挽救的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yikes. I know when a conversation is going to go poorly. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哎呀，我知道这话题继续下去会很糟。先走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: His name's Loid. Sort of a... workplace romance, you could say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他叫洛德。他们可以说是……办公室恋情吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: He had a family. Wife, kids, grandkids now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他有过家庭，他有妻子、子女、现在还有孙辈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Loid is still in the future, guarding Entrati's lab. He's been there for centuries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 洛德还留在未来，守着英择谛的实验室。他已经在那里守了几个世纪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Entrati abandoned Loid like he abandons everybody.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 英择谛像他抛弃了所有人一样，抛弃了洛德。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, the issue is, his daughter thinks he's lost, and is searching for him. It's complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 问题是，他的女儿以为他失踪了，还在寻找他。这事儿很复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean, I'm sure he loved them at one point...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我是说，我相信他曾经爱过他们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I've got a warning light going off in - um - I have to go. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 警告灯亮了——呃，我得走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah... he abandoned the Cavia, the animals he experimented on and accidentally made intelligent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是啊……他抛弃了科维兽，那些他做实验并意外被赋予智慧的动物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah... he abandoned his family. He had a wife, kids, and now grandkids.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是啊……他抛弃了他的家人。他有妻子、儿女，现在还有孙辈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Look, it doesn't matter. He doesn't define the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 听着，这不重要。他并不能塑造未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah... he abandoned Loid, his manservant he has a relationship with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是啊……他抛弃了洛德，他那个有关系的男仆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm from the future. Do you think I'm trash?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我来自未来，你觉得我也是垃圾吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just because you hate one guy doesn't mean the whole future is garbage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就因为你讨厌一个人，不代表整个未来都是垃圾啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: There's no way of knowing what could have been. In fact, without the Tenno, all of humanity might be gone by now, wiped out by the Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 谁也没法知道本来会怎样。事实上，如果没有 Tenno，人类可能早就被 Sentient 消灭了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're right, but I can't change what's been done. Not at that scale. I'm doing my best to save who and what I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说得对，但我没法改变已经发生的事，尤其是这么大规模的事。我只能尽我所能去拯救我能拯救的人和事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: A synthetic race made by the Orokin and the future human society to terraform a planet called Tau, because we were ruining Earth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那是一个由奥罗金人和未来人类社会制造的合成种族，用来改造一颗叫做 Tau 的星球，因为那时我们在毁灭地球。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: A synthetic race made by the Orokin and future human society who waged war on us after they were made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那是一个由奥罗金人和未来人类社会制造的合成种族，结果他们在被创造后对我们发起了战争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because the Orokin sent them there to terraform a new planet, Tau, and the Sentients were worried that we'd ruin that one, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为奥罗金人把他们派去改造另一颗星球——Tau，而 Sentient 担心我们也会毁掉那颗星球。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because they're just as egotistical, violent, and evil as the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为他们和奥罗金人一样，自负、暴力、邪恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Father and Mother? You mean Sol and Lua?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 父母？你是说太阳神和月神？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sol and Lua aren't gods, Lettie... they're just a star and a rock...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 太阳神和月神并不是神，莱蒂……它们只是一颗星星和一块石头……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I've told you already, I don't believe in anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我跟你说过了，我什么都不信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No. If you can't measure it, it doesn't exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不信。如果无法测量，那就不存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Maybe? I think it's just science we don't understand yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 也许吧？我觉得那只是我们还没搞懂的科学

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Of course I do. I'm a product of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当然。我自己就是虚空的产物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The nonsense started pretty early. Do you mean pre-Now, pre-Duviri, or Pre-Zariman?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 乱七八糟的事开始得很早。你是指现在之前、双衍王境之前，还是扎里曼之前？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sorry, can't chat. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，不方便聊。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Duviri, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得，应该是双衍王境吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The Zariman, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我猜是扎里曼号吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're going to laugh at me... but this is the closest to a "home" as I've ever felt I've had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你可能会笑话我……但这里是我有生以来觉得最接近"家"的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't really "come from" anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我其实并非"来自"任何地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Honestly? I... don't know. The Orokin kind of erased most of Ancient Earth's records. So I have no way of knowing how far in the future exactly I'm from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 说实话？我……不知道。奥罗金人基本抹去了古代地球的大部分记录，所以我完全无法知道自己到底来自多远的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We don't get to pick what our homes have done to us, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 有时候，我们无法选择家对我们所做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What it did to me, I did to myself. Just nightmares playing over and over again in my head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它对我做的，也是我对自己做的。噩梦一次又一次地在我脑海中上演。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That's... a complicated question. It has its own ghosts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这是……一个复杂的问题。它有自己的鬼魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No, it's not abandoned. It has memories of people who call it home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不，它没有被废弃。它承载着那些把它称为家的人的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's the place I know the most, and the place that knows me the most, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想，那是我最了解的地方，也是最了解我的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: My other option is Duviri and... no. My history with that place is... too complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的另一个选择是双衍王境，但……不行。我和那个地方的历史太复杂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: My other option is the Zariman and it's not any kinder. It's filled with just as many ghosts and nightmares. Except there, more people than JUST me died.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的另一个选择是扎里曼，但它并没好多少。那里充满了同样多的鬼魂和噩梦。除了在那，不只是我，更多的人死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're tough. You'll be fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你很坚强。你会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey. At least you have better company than I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，至少你的同伴比我的更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: She's got me on speed dial.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 她早就给我设了快速拨号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Ghosts follow me wherever I go. Sometimes I wonder if I'm just a ghost myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 无论我走到哪里，鬼魂都跟着我。有时候我甚至怀疑自己是不是也是个鬼魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How does my being haunted bring you hope?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的困扰是怎么给你带来希望的呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm glad my suffering brings you joy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 很高兴我的痛苦能给你带来快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I - Oh. *Oh.* Heh. Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我——哦。*哦。*呵呵。好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... don't like you like that, I'm sorry, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……不喜欢你这样，对不起，莱蒂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So, where's home for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那个，你的家在哪里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How'd you end up joining the Hex, Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么加入六人组的，莱蒂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How do you get on with Aoi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你和碧相处得怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm surprised you can put up with Quincy. You don't seem to have a lot of patience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很惊讶你能忍受昆西。你看上去不像是有耐心的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Have you found the hole where Arthur keeps the stick he's lodged up there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你知道亚瑟把那根让他总是紧绷的棍子塞在哪个洞里吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: ICR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 国危部？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you have family missing you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你有家人想念你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How'd you meet Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么认识亚瑟的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why Höllvania, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但为什么是霍瓦尼亚呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sometimes painful memories are all that get us through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 有时候，正是痛苦的回忆才能让我们挺过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We're talking on the *internet* and you know the *phone* exists, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们是在*网上*聊天，你知道*电话*的存在，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Ok, well... never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧，嗯……算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: This place isn't so bad. Maybe I'll make this my home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这个地方还算不错。也许我会把这里当成我的家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Thanks for rubbing it in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你特意提这事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I make my home wherever I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我在哪里，家就在哪里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you know what it feels like to get your head cut off? I do. I've died a thousand times. And it *hurts,* lady.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你知道头被砍掉是什么感觉吗？我知道。我已经死了无数次了。那真的*很痛*，女士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为你。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为陪伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The food.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为食物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you take the pain for other people by choice, or because it's your duty?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是自愿为别人承受痛苦，还是因为这是你的责任？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: There's still life worth living, here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这里仍然有值得活下去的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You holding up okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你还撑得住吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How's it going with the civilians?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 市民那边情况如何？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, but it's still gotta be exhausting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是啊，但这肯定还是很费力劳神吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Get used to what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 习惯什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just because you're the tough one doesn't mean I can't care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你就算再坚强，也并不意味着我不能关心你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah but a steady stream of coffee doesn't hurt. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是啊，不过能一直喝咖啡也没什么不好。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean, what were you expecting from people who just lost everything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，你对刚失去一切的人们还能抱有什么期待呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can see why all the people turn into a blur after a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能理解为什么时间久了，所有人似乎都变得模糊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: At least you're a really sexy door. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 至少你是一扇非常性感的门。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You got it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You got it. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没问题。<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想想办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: LOL! Aww. Hi, Tláloc.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈！哇。嗨，特拉洛克。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Who's Tláloc?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 谁是特拉洛克？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lol! I have a kavat at home that does that, only last time she sat on the orbiter controls she broke them. ... Kavats weigh a bit more than rats...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈！我家里有只库娃也这样，只不过上次她一屁股把轨道飞行器的控制台给坐坏了。……库娃比小鼠重些……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I do! Kavats, kubrows, predasites, vulpaphyla, all types of sub-species.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我有啊！库娃、库狛、扑拉达赛、狐帕菲拉，各种亚种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They're less pets and more "murder animals" I keep around to help me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它们不太算是宠物，更像是我养来帮我的"杀手动物"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How many rats do you have?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你有多少只小鼠？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What're your other rats names?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你的其他小鼠叫什么名字？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Of course I do. They fight beside me, sure, but I love them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当然在乎了。它们和我并肩作战，我也非常爱它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: In the same way I care about the guns I own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就像我在乎我自己的枪一样在乎它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If I wanted to be friends with your rats, how would I do that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果我想和你的小鼠交朋友，我该怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How hard is it to take care of rats?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 照顾小鼠难吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm trying to picture one of your rats in battle and I'm laughing my ass off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我试着想了一下你的一只小鼠在战斗中的样子，笑得我肚子痛

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can you show me, sometime?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你能哪天给我演示一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sounds complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 听起来挺复杂的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Me, too. They're too cute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我也是。它们实在太可爱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I should introduce you to some of my pets sometime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 改天我带你认识一下我的宠物吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So, I never got the whole story of how you met Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那个，我还没听你讲过你是怎么认识亚瑟的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you have a second to chat, Lettie? Or are you busy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你有空聊聊吗？还是你很忙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I was wondering how you and Arthur met.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇你和亚瑟是怎么认识的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just because my fights are a bit spectacular doesn't mean I can't appreciate how horrible it must've been.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就算我打过的架有些波澜壮阔，也并不代表我不明白那有多可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: All war is shit, end of story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所有战争都是狗屎，这就是故事的结局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Eh, little people, little stories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，小人物、小故事罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Huh? What're you talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 啊？你在说什么啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Freedom?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 获得自由？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Knowledge?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 汲取知识？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: BRB [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 马上回来 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That THING decided it'd be a fun experiment to turn the parents on the Zariman against their children -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那个东西觉得把扎里曼号上的父母和孩子对立起来是个有趣的实验——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: All it does is leave death and destruction in its wake. No matter what it's motivations are, it doesn't matter. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它所做的一切只会留下死亡和毁灭。无论它的动机是什么，这都不重要。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And then gave the children magical void powers so they could murder their own parents so it could LEARN from the slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 然后他赋予这群孩子神秘的虚空力量，让他们能够杀死自己的父母，这样它就能从这场屠杀中学习。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's had an opportunity to learn from love, from sacrifice, from kindness. But it seems to CHOOSE to seek out chaos and murder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它本可以从爱、牺牲和善行中学习。但它却选择寻求骚乱和杀戮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Even if it's just a toddler smashing toys together to understand the world around it, we're those toys. It has to be stopped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 即使它只是个小婴儿，通过摔玩具来理解周围的世界，但我们就是这些玩具。这种行为必须被制止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'll continue to hold out hope it isn't an enemy, but... it's not giving me a lot of reasons to think it isn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我还是抱有一丝它不是敌人的希望，但是……它的表现让我很难这么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I refuse to believe it's benign after all I've seen. After all it's done to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 在我亲眼目睹这一切之后，我无法相信它是纯良的。就在我遭遇这一切之后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No clue. I tend to make this shit up as I go. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不知道。我通常都是随机应变的。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think I can try. Like I did here. And that's all any of us can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想我可以试试。就像我在这里做的那样。这是我们中任何人都能做到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's up to others, now. My place is here in 1999 with all of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 现在这要看别人了。我的家在 1999 年，和你们所有人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I have faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我有信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: For someone who's job is to prevent death, you seem pretty chill with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对于一个以挽救生命为职责的人来说，你似乎对死亡相当冷静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'd love to know more about how you became a medic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很想知道你是怎么成为一名医生的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Makes sense. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 有道理。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do you mean, your people think about death differently?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你们的人对死亡的看法不同，是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why'd you end up becoming a medic?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你为什么最后选择当一名医生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Okay, *why* did you end up becoming a medic?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我想问的是，*为什么*你最后会选择当一名医生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Thanks. Good talk. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。说得好。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The dead people I have experience with are a bit more... intense, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我接触过的死人要更加……热情一些，嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That's beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那真美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Oh... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哦……我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How old were you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你当时多大？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you miss your aunt?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你想念你的姨妈吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know what it's like to lose family early in life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道小时候就失去家人的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How old were you when you joined the army?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是几岁参军的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Phew. I was going to say. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 呼。我刚刚还正想问呢。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: LOL! It sounds like a cool holiday, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈！不过这听起来像是个很酷的节日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sure he'd love to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定他会很乐意帮忙的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'd love to help, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我也很乐意帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... would love that, actually. Thank you, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……其实我很想这么做。莱蒂，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'd love to help you, but let's leave my family in the future where they belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很乐意帮助你，但还是把我的家人留在他们该去的地方吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Um... I don't think they'd want to see me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……我想他们不会想见到我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That's not how it felt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的感受却不是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're right...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说得没错……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because when the Man in the Wall drove the parents insane, they attacked the children, and... the children with void powers had to kill them, and....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为当墙中人让父母们失去了理智，他们攻击了自己的孩子，而……拥有虚空之力的孩子们不得不杀死他们，然后……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can't talk about this. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我无法谈论这个。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hypothetical question: If I wanted to ask you out for drinks, would I end up with stitches?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 假设性提问：如果我想约你出去喝一杯，我会不会落得要缝针的下场？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Good to know. :) Any hints on what I can do to win you over, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 明白了。:) 那么，有什么提示可以让我赢得你的芳心呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: On that topic, do you... I've been meaning to ask...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 说到这个，你……我一直想问……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I've been curious if you and the other protoframes still had... y'know... your... y'know... parts...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我一直很好奇你和其他原型战甲是不是还保留着……你懂的……你的……那个……部位……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Uh - Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 呃——还是算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Um... well? Do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……那？你有吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yes ma'am. Consider me warned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好的，女士。算我被提醒过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Um... Yeah, never mind. Pain's not really my thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……好吧，算了。我对痛苦完全没兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're usually the super busy one. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 通常你才是那个超级忙的人。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, what's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sorry, just about to go. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我马上要走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I've never had a real home, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我从来没有有过真正的家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do you mean, "someone like me?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说的"像我这样的人"是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The only places I've ever had to call "home" have tried to KILL me. Why would I miss them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我唯一能称之为"家"的地方却试图杀死我。我为什么要想念它们呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Way to rub it in, Lettie. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 真会说话，莱蒂，谢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can't miss what you've never had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 从没拥有过的东西，怎么可能会想念呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: At least you had your family, though. I didn't even have that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但至少你还有你的家人。我甚至连这个都没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: At least you weren't alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 至少你不是一个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You seem really proud of your background, I'm surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你看起来对你的背景非常自豪，我很意外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No, I think I know how you feel. I... get these bouts of sadness where I get an urge to go somewhere that doesn't exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不，我想我理解你的感受。我……会有时会突然感到悲伤，想去一个根本不存在的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Maybe. I really don't get homesick. I get sad and lonely sometimes, but it isn't homesickness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 也许吧。我真的不想家。我有时会感到悲伤和孤独，但这不是想家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You mean Kalymos? I'll make sure she leaves your rats alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是说卡利莫斯？我会确保她不再打扰你的小鼠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Kalymos won't hurt your rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 卡利莫斯不会伤害你的小鼠的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And how does she look at you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 她是怎么看你的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: She's a kavat, Lettie, not a person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，她只是个库娃，又不是人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: There are the Cavia, who are these lab animals that were sent into the Void and came out intelligent. Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 会有叫科维兽的动物，它们是被送入虚空的实验动物，结果变得聪明了。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yes, but - oh, this is going to piss you off already, I can tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 会有，但是——哦，我能感觉到，我马上要说的会让你很生气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You guessed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你猜对了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: He took these lab animals and sent them into the Void. They came out with the intelligence of people - it nearly killed them. They're called the Cavia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他把这些实验动物送进了虚空。它们出来后就拥有了人类的智慧——但这几乎要了它们的命。它们被称为科维兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean, she's never said anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，她从来没开口说过话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I guess I don't really know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想我不是很确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Entrati left, and she stayed. I don't think she's still working for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 英择谛离开了，她留下了。我不认为她还在为他工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you really think she's spying on us for him? Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你真的觉得她在帮他监视我们吗？为什么这么想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Either way, she's smart enough to understand "If you mess with Lettie's rats, you sleep outside." Is that good enough?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，她足够聪明，知道"如果你惹莱蒂的小鼠，你就得睡外面。"这样够了吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm not kicking her out. Even if she's working for Entrati, it's not her fault. She's an animal being loyal to the owner who loves her. I can't be cruel to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不会赶走她的。就算她是英择谛那头的，也不是她的错。她只是个动物，忠于爱她的主人。我不能对她这么残忍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm just trying to get the whole picture.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我只是想了解整个情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No one else will tell me. They just avoid the subject.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没人会告诉我。他们都只是回避这个话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I figured you'd be the one to give me a straight answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想你会给我一个直接的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So how'd you end up getting involved in the whole Arthur/Hex thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那个，你是怎么被卷入整个亚瑟/六人组的事里的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You seem to really... REALLY hate Entrati. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你看起来真的……真的很讨厌英择谛。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果你讲起来觉得不舒服，那也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No problem. Plenty of shit I haven't told you, yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没问题。我有很多事也还没告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Okay? I'm sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧？我很抱歉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Then what's the problem?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那问题是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The way you talk about him, and because I know how much trust is important to you... It seems personal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 听你提起他时的语气，再加上我知道信任对你来说多么重要……这听起来像是有私人恩怨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know how much you hate it when people break the trust of others. Especially animals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道你有多讨厌别人辜负你的信任。尤其是动物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: People who hurt animals have a special place in hell, absolutely. But it seems like there's more going on than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 虐待动物的人在地狱绝对会有专门留给他们的位置。但看起来这件事好像不仅仅是这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, but it seems like a personal grudge you have against him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，但这看起来像是你对他有私仇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The way you talk about him, and because I know how much trust is important to you... It seems personal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 听你提起他时的语气，再加上我知道信任对你来说多么重要……这听起来像是有私人恩怨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, but it seems like a personal grudge you have against him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，但这看起来像是你对他有私仇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Good enough for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这对我来说已经足够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can I ask what he did?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能问一下他做了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果你讲起来觉得不舒服，那也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If you're not comfortable telling me, that's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果你讲起来觉得不舒服，那也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What did he *do* to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他对你*做*了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't know what he did to you, but... sounds like it was rough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不清楚他对你做了什么，但这……听起来很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can I ask what he did?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能问一下他做了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为什么不想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I get it. Not a problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我明白。没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I get it. Not a problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我明白。没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为什么不想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Then what? How'd you get to be...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？你是怎么变成……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: War sucks. No matter when, no matter how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 战争真令人厌恶。无论发生在何时，无论以何种形式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I was going to say "Hex"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我本来想说"六人组"的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I was going to say "protoframes"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我本来想说"原型战甲"的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Is that what you think you are?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你真是这么想自己的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you not trust me yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你还不信任我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We've all made mistakes in life. I'm sure it can't be that bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们一生中都会犯错。我相信这不会那么糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Careful, or else I might start to think you're getting attached to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 小心点，不然我可能会认为你开始依赖我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're a far cry from a lab rat, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你和那些实验小鼠不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, I think rats are intelligent, social, adorable wonderful animals...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我觉得实验小鼠都是聪明、善于交际、可爱且奇妙的动物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sexiest lab rat *I've* ever seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我见过的最性感的实验室小鼠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're a far cry from a lab rat, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你和那些实验小鼠不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Then what're you suggesting we do? Put you all down?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那你建议我们怎么做？把你们全部干掉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do you mean, "spread their diseases?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说的"传播疾病"是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: A lab rat isn't to blame for the things the scientists force on them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 实验室小鼠不应该为科学家强加给它们的事情负责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do you mean, "spread their diseases?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说的"传播疾病"是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're not to blame for any of this, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，这一切都不是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah. Eventually, you would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对，最后你们会这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, with transference it could be slowed...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，通过传识，可以减缓它……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How'd you wind up meeting Entrati, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 话说，你是怎么遇到英择谛的？
