/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can I ask what happened next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能问一下接下来发生了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So... Lettie, look... I know you already said "no" to Amir's game, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那个……莱蒂，看……我知道你已经对阿米尔的游戏说"不"了，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey, Lettie, we're friends, now, yeah? You like me now, ish?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，我们现在是朋友了，对吧？你现在多少有点喜欢我了吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie, what do you think about tabletop roleplaying games?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，你对桌面角色扮演游戏有什么看法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie, I have a favor to ask you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，我有件事想请你帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I agreed to ask, I think it'll be fun!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是我同意来问的，我觉得这会很好玩！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I agreed to ask, it's important to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是我同意来问的，这对他来说很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Amir's putting together a game of Fables & Frontiers. And I know it sounds silly, but before you come over here and stab me -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔正在组织一场寓言与边疆游戏。我知道这听起来很傻，但在你过来捅我之前——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's a chance to get everybody to spend time together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这是一个让大家共度时光的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's really important to Amir
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这对阿米尔来说真的很重要

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know a game like "Fables & Frontiers" sounds really silly, but it's about spending time together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道像《寓言与边疆》这样的游戏听起来挺傻的，但重点是我们能一起度过时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know a game like "Fables & Frontiers" sounds really silly, but it's important to Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道像《寓言与边疆》这样的游戏听起来挺傻的，但这对阿米尔来说挺重要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And you could use a break.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你也该休息一下了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And it might actually be a little fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 说不定这其实还挺好玩的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: ...And you wouldn't be the only one playing with us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: ……然后也不只是你一个人会跟我们一起玩？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: ...And you DO kind of owe me a favor, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: ……你确实欠我一个人情，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So what do you think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那么你觉得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Me and Amir, obviously. And after that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 肯定有我和阿米尔。然后呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Eleanor said yes, not sure if that's helping or hurting my case...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 埃莉诺答应了，但不知道这对我来说是好是坏……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Aoi said she'd play
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 碧说她会玩

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Quincy's in
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 昆西会加入

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Arthur said he'd play lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟说他会来玩，哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You holding up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How're you doing today, sweetheart?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 甜心，你今天过得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How's my favorite badass doing today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我最喜欢的狠人今天过的怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie, can I ask you something about your rats?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，我可以问你一些关于你的小鼠的问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hey Lettie, what's your favorite kind of food?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嘿，莱蒂，你最喜欢什么食物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Is everything okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 一切都还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I - um - yikes. Should I message you later?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我——嗯——哎呀。我晚点再给你发信息好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If you're busy, we can chat later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果你很忙的话，我们可以晚点再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对不起？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, I just... wanted to see if you wanted to go get some coffee.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，我只是……想看看你是否想去喝点咖啡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm here for you, Lettie. And I care. Talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我在这里支持你。我在乎你。跟我说说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Did I do something to piss you off?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我是不是做了什么惹你生气了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Is something wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 出什么问题了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How is any of this my fault?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这怎么就成了我的错了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Um... I'm getting the feeling you're looking for a fight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……我感觉你是在找茬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lettie, you and I are supposed to be in a relationship. And that *means* something to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你我是恋人。这*对我来说*非常重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lettie, you and I have become close friends. I care about you. And that *means* something to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你我已经是最好的朋友了。我很关心你。这*对我来说*非常重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think you're one of the strongest people I've ever met in my *life.* You're not capable of whining.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你是我一生中遇到的最坚强的人之一。你不是那种会抱怨的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Wait. Back up. Are you PISSED that you aren't dead?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 等等，倒回去一下。你生气是因为你没死？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm not your punching bag, Lettie. And I don't need this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我不是你的出气筒。也不该受这些气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I need you to back up and tell me what's wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我需要你倒回去一下，并告诉我到底出了什么问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah? But... please don't, though. It'd be really hard to explain to the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是吗？但是……请不要这么做。这很难向其他人解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But things here CAN still change. Maybe not much, but in ways that matter. Look around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但这里的事情还是可以改变的。变化也许不大，但在重要的方面可以。看看周围。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But you know what you have here that can help you through it? A family. If you choose to let yourself have one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但你知道有什么可以帮你度过难关吗？一个家庭。如果你选择让自己拥有一个家庭的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But things here CAN still change. Maybe not much, but in ways that matter. Look around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但这里的事情还是可以改变的。变化也许不大，但在重要的方面可以。看看周围。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We've given these people a new home. A new sense of hope. Maybe just a few, and maybe it doesn't matter in the end...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们给了这些人一个新家。一种新的希望。也许只有少数人，也许到最后这都无关紧要……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But isn't that why you're a healer? Isn't the act of trying, of that sense of hope, that kindness, what matters, and not where we wind up in the end?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但这不正是你成为医生的原因吗？那些尝试的行为，那种希望感，那份善意，这些才是重要的，而不是我们最终会去哪里吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know you never felt like you've had somewhere to belong. You've never had a home before, Lettie. Like me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道你从来没觉得自己有归属感。莱蒂，你从未有过一个家。就像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Look around. At the civvies. At the Hex. At me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 看看四周。看看市民。看看六人组。看看我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: This could be your family. Your home. If you wanted it to be. If you LET it be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这里可以是你的家庭。你的家。如果你愿意。如果你让它成为家的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: This could be your family. If you wanted it to be. If you LET it be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这些都可以是你的家人。如果你愿意。如果你让它成为家的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... know how you feel, Lettie. I do. All my life, I've been the victim of somebody else's plans. The Orokin. The Man in the Wall. Now Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……知道你的感受，莱蒂。我真的懂。我这一生都是别人计划的受害者。奥罗金。墙中人。现在则是英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You have a choice, Lettie. You can either spend eternity feeling like a victim or you can see this as a chance for what it is - a new kind of life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你有选择。你可以选择永远感觉自己是受害者，也可以把这看作是一次机会——一种全新的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But I had a choice, when I watched you all die. I could let you all stay victims, too... or I could try to save you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但当我看着你们所有人死去时，我有选择。我可以让你们继续做受害者……或者我可以试着拯救你们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yes, it's a time loop. Yes, not much changes. But you know what DOES change that matters? Us. Who WE are. What WE know. And what WE feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，这是一个时间循环。是的，变化不大。但你知道什么才是真正重要的变化吗？我们。我们是谁。我们知道什么。我们的感受是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So maybe it wasn't my choice to make for you. And if you want to hate me for that? Fine. Hate me for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 也许我不该替你做决定。如果你想因此而恨我？好吧。那就恨我吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So no, this isn't the kind of life you're used to. You won't get to experience "normal" ever again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以不，所以这不是你习惯的生活方式。你再也不会体验到"正常"的生活了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And it just hurts me to see you like this when I care about you like family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当我把你当家人一样关心时，看到你这样我真的很伤心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And it just hurts me to see you like this when I care about you like family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当我把你当家人一样关心时，看到你这样我真的很伤心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But you never would have let the team die if you could have saved them. Because you wouldn't let them stay the victims.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但如果你能拯救队友的话，你绝不会让他们死去。因为你不会让他们继续成为受害者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But there are things here that can make it a life worth living.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但这里有些东西能让生活变得值得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And... there's another reason it hurts me to see you like this. [Confess feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 而且……看到你这样让我心疼，其实还有另外一个原因。[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Do you think this is just a casual fling for me?! Do you think you really mean that little to me?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你以为我和你只是一时兴起吗？！你以为你对我来说真的不那么重要吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Look around. Look at what YOU have. At the family around you. At the people that care about YOU.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 看看周围。看看你拥有什么。看看你周围的家人。看看那些关心你的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You see strays, I see people showing each other kindness in the darkest times. And I think that's beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你看到的是流浪者，我看到 的是人们在至暗时刻彼此展现的善良。我觉得这很美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Are you really so oblivious that you can't tell how much you mean to me?! [Confess feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你难道真的没有意识到你对我意味着什么吗？！[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, okay, sure. That's definitely what's going on here. You're right. I'm just being naïve and my feelings aren't real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧，没错。这确实是现在的情况。你说得对。我只是天真，我的感情不是真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And I see someone who's hurting and trying to pick a fight instead of processing that pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我看到的是一个受伤的人，试图挑起争端而不是去处理那些痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know you feel like you lost your life. Your family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道你感觉好像失去了生命，失去了家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And if you want to exclude yourself from that, so be it. But that's YOUR choice, Lettie. You're making that decision, no one else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果你想把自己排除在外，那就这样吧。但那是你的选择，莱蒂。是你在做决定，不是别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Before you tell me I'm stupid, or whatever - or that I can't handle you, just wait, and let me talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 在你说我蠢，或者别的什么之前——或者说我搞不定你，先等一下，让我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Nobody thought the Cavia were worth saving, either. Should Loid have just left them to die?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当初也没人认为那些科维兽值得被拯救。难道洛德就应该这样让它们自生自灭吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I also know you never felt like you've had somewhere to belong. You've never had a home before, Lettie. Like me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我也知道你从来没觉得自己有归属感。莱蒂，你从未有过一个家。就像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: This situation you're all in - I won't lie, it sucks. Trust me, I've been there. But you have one thing I don't have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你们现在的处境——我不骗你，真的很糟糕。相信我，我也经历过。但你拥有一样我没有的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Besides, even if it's pointless in the end, stray animals are the ones most worth rescuing, aren't they?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 再说了，就算最后没有意义，流浪动物不是最值得救助的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Isn't the act of caring, the act of TRYING, the whole point?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 关心他人，尝试关心，不正是这一切的意义所在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We're not done with this conversation, Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我们的对话还没结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm done with this. And I'm done with you. [Break up.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我受够了这一切。我也受够了你。[分手]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're lashing out at me because you're scared. Because you don't want to be trapped here like this. But you're pushing everybody away who can help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你对我发火是因为你害怕。因为你不想就这样被困在这里。但你却把所有能帮助你的人都推开了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So you can either let me in - for real - and help you, or you can push me away, too. That's your decision to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以你可以选择让我进来——真正地——帮助你，或者你也可以把我推开。这是你的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Maybe later. I'm a little pissed right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 也许等会吧。我现在有点生气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Like I'm going to say no to that. :}
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我怎么可能会说不呢？:}

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Would that death have been better than life as they are now? Tagfer certainly might have agreed with you once - he lost his wife during the ordeal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那样的死亡会比现在的生活更好吗？标弃可能曾经同意你的观点——他在那场灾难中失去了妻子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well? This could be your family. Your home. If you wanted it to be. If you LET it be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不过呢，这里可以是你的家庭。你的家。如果你愿意。如果你让它成为家的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You have each other. You have a *family.* You have *friends.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你有彼此。你有一个*家庭*。你有*朋友*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But they found in themselves a new family. A reason to continue on. A reason to keep living.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但他们都在彼此中找到了新的家庭。有了继续前行的理由。有了继续活下去的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You aren't alone like I was - and that loneliness sent me into a spiral of misery and numbness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你并不像我那样孤独——那种孤独让我陷入了痛苦和麻木的漩涡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You need to choose which way you want to be. If you want to be alone or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你需要选择你想要的生活。是想要独自一人，还是不想一个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's those moments of kindness that matter, isn't it? Those flashes where we can show people the better parts of ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那些善意的瞬间才是最重要的，不是吗？那些瞬间让我们向人们展示自己更好的一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're drop-dead gorgeous. You're fiercely intelligent. And you could kick my ass. But that's not the only reasons you've become so important to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你美得令人窒息。你非常聪明。你甚至可以轻松打败我。但这不是你对我如此重要的唯一原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Deep down beneath all the layers of armor you've built over yourself, is one of the kindest, most compassionate people I've ever met. But that's not all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 在你为自己设下的层层盔甲之下，隐藏着我所见过的最善良、最富有同情心的人。但这还不是全部。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're unstoppable. Unbreakable. Unflinching. Nothing seems to slow you down. You're one of the toughest people I've ever met. And -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你无人能挡。坚不可摧。从不退缩。似乎没有什么能让你停下来。你是我遇到的最坚强的人之一。而且——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Let's stop to consider how damn gorgeous you are, and how you could absolutely break me like a twig if you wanted to. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 让我们停下来想想你有多美，你如果愿意的话，你完全可以把我像小树枝一样折断。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're one of the kindest, most caring people I've ever met. The way you tend to your animals and the way you'll go out of your way for people makes my heart melt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是我见过的最善良、最有爱心的人之一。你照顾动物的方式和为他人竭尽全力的态度让我心动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're made of iron. And I know that no matter what they throw at you - Entrati, the Man in the Wall, Viktor and the Scaldra - it doesn't matter. They don't stand a chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你如铁般坚强。我知道无论他们对你做什么——英择谛、墙中人、维克多和炽蛇军——都无关紧要。他们一点机会都没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Point is... I care about you, Lettie. A lot. And more than just as friend, and I understand if it isn't mutual, but -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 重点是……我在乎你，莱蒂。非常在乎。而且不仅仅是作为朋友，我知道这种感觉可能不是相互的，但是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can't stand to see you give up hope like this. You're not a ghost. You're not a fantasma.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我无法忍受看到你这样失去希望。你不是鬼魂。你不是 fantasma。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're LETTIE, and -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是莱蒂，而且——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sorry if I upset you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果我让你不高兴了，我很抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I understand if you don't feel the same way, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能理解如果你没有同样的感觉，我明白的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So if you want to talk? I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以如果你想谈谈？我在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 跟我聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're not breaking up with me, are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你不会是要跟我分手吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: YOU want to talk...? Are you feeling okay? Did somebody die?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你想聊聊……？你感觉还好吗？有人死了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sorry, I can't chat right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很抱歉，现在没法聊。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Okay... What's this about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧……那这是关于什么的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: All right. I'm listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我在听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Holding a grudge like that isn't healthy, even if what he did to you was wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 怀恨在心对健康不好，即使他对你做了错误的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Holy shit... I didn't realize. I - I'm so sorry he used you like that. Yeah... I'd hate him, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 天哪……我没意识到。我——我很抱歉他那样利用了你。是的……换作是我我也会恨他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I - so - wait. You all are partially to blame for the Techrot spreading?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我——等一下——所以说，对于科腐者的传播，你们或多或少也有责任？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sorry I fell asleep there for a second. What were you saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我刚才睡着了。你刚才说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm not here to tell you what you did can be forgiven or not. That's not something I can do, and honestly - I don't think what you're describing is something that CAN be forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我并不是来告诉你你的行为是否可以被原谅的。那不是我能做的事情，而且说实话——我不认为你所描述的事情是可以被原谅的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Entrati came here and found exactly what he was looking for - useful, skilled people he could trick into doing what he wanted. Who wouldn't think too hard about it. You fell for his shtick like so many people who came before you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 英择谛来到这里，找到了他想要的东西——有用、有技术的人，他可以诱骗他们做他想做的事。谁都不会对此想太多。你就像许多人一样，被他的把戏耍得团团转。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What happened wasn't your fault. You were lied to. Yeah, sure - maybe you were a little willingly blind after things started to go wrong. But who can blame you? Hope is a dangerous drug. And he shot you full of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 发生这些事不是你的错。你被欺骗了。是的，当然——当事情开始出错时，也许你有点自欺欺人。但谁能责怪你呢？希望是一种危险的毒品。而他给你注入了满满的希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You wanted to believe his lies. And so you did. And that's on you. And all the people who got sick because of it? That's also on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你想相信他的谎言。所以，你相信了。这是你的错。那些因此而生病的人？那也是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So of course, you went along with it. Of course, you wanted to believe there was a chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以，你自然会配合他。当然，你愿意相信还有机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: People died. People who won't come back. Because you wanted to believe in a miracle drug hawked by some "old man in some ugly-ass trench coat."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 有人死了。这些人再也不会回来了。因为你想要相信某个"穿着难看风衣的老头"兜售的神奇药物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But people make mistakes. And people own up to them. And you're here, trying to own up to them. So... I see people trying to do what's right with what they did wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但人都会犯错。人也会承认错误。而你在这里，正试图承认这些错误。所以……我看到的是一个试图用正确的方式来纠正自己过错的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I would have done the same thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果是我，我也会这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And it's not on me to absolve you of that. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 而且我也没有权利赦免你。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And I don't think a reasonable person can ask for much more than that. I don't think less of you. I see people who failed. But were willing to try again. And I know what that's like. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得一个理性的人不会再要求更多了。我不会看不起你。我看到过失败但愿意再次尝试的人。我明白那是怎样的感受。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You mean Duviri? I have no idea... Time lost all meaning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你指的是双衍王境？我不知道……时间对我来说已经失去了意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You mean Duviri? I wasn't... I mean, I guess I was *technically* alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是说双衍王境？我没有……我是说，我想我*严格来说*是孤单一人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can't chat right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 现在没空聊，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I kind of blocked it out and went numb. So... I guess I did kind of lose my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我有点封闭自己，变得麻木了。所以……我猜我确实有点失去了理智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I had people to talk to, even if they weren't... real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我有人可以交谈，即使他们不是……真实的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It got *so* lonely, though... even if I had "people" to talk to. It wasn't enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 可是，感觉*太*孤独了……虽然我有"人"可以聊天。但这还不够。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I still talk to myself if I'm not careful. That *really* makes people nervous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我没留神时，还是会自言自语。这*真的*让人感到紧张。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What's wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know what we've got going on is a start. But I know we're still on a "trial period" in your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我明白我们现在才刚开始。但我也清楚，在你心里这还处于"试用期"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sometimes when loneliness really gets into you, it doesn't ever let you go, even when you're no longer alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 有时候，当孤独感真正侵入你内心，它就永远不会放手，哪怕是你已经不再孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I feel it still, even when I'm sitting around the table with the Hex, laughing and drinking. I'm happy. I'm with everyone. But it's there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 即便我和六人组一起坐在桌子旁，一起喝酒说笑，我依然能感觉到它的存在。我很快乐。我和大家在一起。但它还在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Like someone removed a kidney or a rib from me once, a long time ago. A hollowness that aches on rainy days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就像很久以前有人从我身上取走了一颗肾或一根肋骨。那种空洞的感觉，在雨天会隐隐作痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know. Trust is hard for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道。信任对你来说很难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can be patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我可以等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But I'm here when you need to shake off the loneliness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但当你需要摆脱孤独时，我就在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Point being, no need to feel lonely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 重点是，没有必要感到孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean, to be fair, when you get going, you *are* pretty terrifying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，讲真，当你真的开始做事时，你*确实*是挺吓人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Right? You'd just be making more work for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对吧？这样做你只会给自己找更多事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Get on without what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没有什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I didn't have a choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You don't have to be alone. You're surrounded by people who care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你不需要独自一人。你周围还有很多关心你的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You never struck me as a poet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你从没给我留下过诗人的印象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... well... you don't *have* to be alone... [Confess Feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……其实……你*可以不用*孤单一人……[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think that when loneliness really gets into you, it doesn't ever let you go, even when you're no longer alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得当孤独感真正侵入你内心，它就永远不会放手，即使你不再孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sounds like you need to cheer up and allow yourself to be happy. Maybe it's depression, have you ever thought of that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 看起来你需要振作起来，让自己开心一点。也许这是抑郁症，你有没有考虑过这个可能？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I feel it still, even when I'm sitting around the table with the Hex, laughing and drinking. I'm happy. I'm with everyone. But it's there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 即便我和六人组一起坐在桌子旁，一起喝酒说笑，我依然能感觉到它的存在。我很快乐。我和大家在一起。但它还在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Like someone removed a kidney or a rib from me once, a long time ago. A hollowness that aches a little on rainy days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就像很久以前有人从我身上取走了一颗肾或一根肋骨。那种空洞的感觉，在雨天会隐隐作痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Loneliness is a sadness that comes and goes in waves. Or like seasons. So it's an easier pain to ignore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 孤独是一种如潮水般涌动的悲伤。就像季节一样。所以它是一种比较容易被忽视的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You don't have to be alone anymore. If you don't want to be. You can let people in for real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你再也不用孤单了。如果你不想孤单，你可以让别人真正地走进你的内心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And I think that when loneliness really gets into you, it doesn't ever let you go, even when you're no longer alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 而且我觉得当孤独感真正侵入你内心，它就永远不会放手，即使你不再孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I feel it still, even when I'm sitting around the table with the Hex, laughing and drinking. I'm happy. I'm with everyone. But it's there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 即便我和六人组一起坐在桌子旁，一起喝酒说笑，我依然能感觉到它的存在。我很快乐。我和大家在一起。但它还在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Like someone removed a kidney or a rib from me once, a long time ago. A hollowness that aches a little on rainy days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就像很久以前有人从我身上取走了一颗肾或一根肋骨。那种空洞的感觉，在雨天会隐隐作痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Talk to me anytime, Lettie. I'm here for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，随时来找我聊。我会一直支持你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You aren't whining. This is what friends are for. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你没有在抱怨。这就是朋友存在的意义。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... well... you don't *have* to be alone... [Confess Feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……其实……你*可以不用*孤单一人……[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know what we've got going on is a start. But I know we're still on a "trial period" in your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我明白我们现在才刚开始。但我也清楚，在你心里这还处于"试用期"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think that when loneliness really gets into you, it doesn't ever let you go, even when you're no longer alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得当孤独感真正侵入你内心，它就永远不会放手，即使你不再孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I feel it still, even when I'm sitting around the table with the Hex, laughing and drinking. I'm happy. I'm with everyone. But it's there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 即便我和六人组一起坐在桌子旁，一起喝酒说笑，我依然能感觉到它的存在。我很快乐。我和大家在一起。但它还在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就像很久以前有人从我身上取走了一颗肾或一根肋骨。那种空洞的感觉，在雨天会隐隐作痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can be patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我可以等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know. Trust is hard for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我知道。信任对你来说很难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But I'm here when you need to shake off the loneliness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但当你需要摆脱孤独时，我就在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Point being, no need to feel lonely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 重点是，没有必要感到孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sounds like you need to cheer up and allow yourself to be happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 听起来你需要振作起来，允许自己快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think that when loneliness really gets into you, it doesn't ever let you go, even when you're no longer alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得当孤独感真正侵入你内心，它就永远不会放手，即使你不再孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... well... that's not exactly what I meant... [Confess Feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……嗯……我不是这个意思……[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I feel it still, even when I'm sitting around the table with the Hex, laughing and drinking. I'm happy. I'm with everyone. But it's there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 即便我和六人组一起坐在桌子旁，一起喝酒说笑，我依然能感觉到它的存在。我很快乐。我和大家在一起。但它还在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Like someone removed a kidney or a rib from me once, a long time ago. A hollowness that aches a little on rainy days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 就像很久以前有人从我身上取走了一颗肾或一根肋骨。那种空洞的感觉，在雨天会隐隐作痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're drop-dead gorgeous. You're fiercely intelligent. And you could kick my ass. But that's not the only reasons you've become so important to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你美得令人窒息。你非常聪明。你甚至可以轻松打败我。但这不是你对我如此重要的唯一原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Deep down beneath all the layers of armor you've built over yourself, is one of the kindest, most compassionate people I've ever met. But that's not all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 在你为自己设下的层层盔甲之下，隐藏着我所见过的最善良、最富有同情心的人。但这还不是全部。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're unstoppable. Unbreakable. Unflinching. Nothing seems to slow you down. You're one of the toughest people I've ever met. And -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你无人能挡。坚不可摧。从不退缩。似乎没有什么能让你停下来。你是我遇到的最坚强的人之一。而且——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I understand if you don't feel the same way, I get it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能理解如果你没有同样的感觉，我明白的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sorry if I upset you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果我让你不高兴了，我很抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're one of the kindest, most caring people I've ever met. The way you tend to your animals and the way you'll go out of your way for people makes my heart melt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是我见过的最善良、最有爱心的人之一。你照顾动物的方式和为他人竭尽全力的态度让我心动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Let's stop to consider how damn gorgeous you are, and how you could absolutely break me like a twig if you wanted to. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 让我们停下来想想你有多美，你如果愿意的话，你完全可以把我像小树枝一样折断。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Point is... I care about you, Lettie. A lot. And more than just as friend, and I understand if it isn't mutual, but -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 重点是……我在乎你，莱蒂。非常在乎。而且不仅仅是作为朋友，我知道这种感觉可能不是相互的，但是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're made of iron. And I know that no matter what they throw at you - Entrati, the Man in the Wall, Viktor and the Scaldra - it doesn't matter. They don't stand a chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你如铁般坚强。我知道无论他们对你做什么——英择谛、墙中人、维克多和炽蛇军——都无关紧要。他们一点机会都没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Before you tell me I'm stupid, or whatever - or that I can't handle you, just wait, and let me talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 在你说我蠢，或者别的什么之前——或者说我搞不定你，先等一下，让我说完。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hello to you, too, honey. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗨，你也好啊，亲爱的。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hello to you, too, Lettie. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗨，你也好啊，莱蒂。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Oh? What's that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 噢？那是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: BRB [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 马上回来 [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Huh. Yeah. I never thought about that. The loop extends to animals, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯。是的。我从来没想过这个。这个循环也延伸到了动物身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And I don't think animals care in the same way people do. Meaning, I don't think it bothers them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得动物并不像人类那样在意。也就是说，我不认为这会困扰它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Uh. Ouch?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 呃。哎呀？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I suspected you preferred pets to people, but I guess that confirms it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我早就怀疑你更喜欢宠物而不是人，这下可算是证实了我的猜想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I assume Anita and Tláloc are the names of two of your rats?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我猜安妮塔和特拉洛克是你的两只小鼠的名字，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, I think I'm starting to figure you out, finally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，我想我终于开始了解你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why do you think that is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为什么你会这么认为？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I think that you've had a rough run of luck where every time you put your trust in someone, it's been broken. No big sob story. No big trauma. Just a shitty run of luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你运气不太好，每次你信任别人时，信任总是被打破。没有什么特别悲惨的故事。也没有什么重大的创伤。只是一连串的坏运气而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're afraid of being abandoned, like how Entrati abandoned his family. So you keep pets because they can't leave you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你害怕被抛弃，就像英择谛抛弃家人一样。所以你养宠物，因为它们离不开你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You've lost a lot of people in your life to La Flaca. People you've cared about. Pets die, but it's more expected - easier somehow? So you can handle it better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你的一生中因为 La Flaca 失去了很多人。这些都是你关心的人。宠物会死去，但这更容易被预料到——也因此更容易接受？所以你能更好地处理这种情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You loved someone who betrayed your trust and abandoned you, like how Entrati did to Loid. Pets will never do that to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你曾经爱过一个背叛并抛弃你的人，就像英择谛对洛德做的那样。宠物永远不会这样对你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Loving a pet is easier than loving a person. They just want to be cared for. The relationships are simple - clean - they don't get messy like with people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 爱宠物比爱人更容易。它们只是想要被关心。这种关系很简单——很干净——不像和人相处那样复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I didn't realize there would be a test.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我没想到这是个测试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Y'know, for someone who makes fun of Amir so much, you really like to play games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你知道，对于一个经常嘲笑阿米尔的人来说，你真的挺喜欢玩游戏的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, then you've done a bad job of teaching me... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那么，你在教我了解你这件事上做得不太好……;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I know you just fine. I just don't want to play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我太了解你了。我只是不想玩而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, I don't like head games. Have fun with your rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，我不喜欢玩心理游戏。去和你的小鼠一起玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, then you've done a bad job of teaching me... ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那么，你在教我了解你这件事上做得不太好……;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean, I definitely wouldn't say no to scratches and treats and love...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，我肯定也不会拒绝挠痒痒、奖励和爱……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sorry if I'm cramping your style.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，如果我让你感到不自在了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yes ma'am. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好的，女士。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Or... what if I wanted to *not* be good?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 或者……如果我想*不*好好表现呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The idea of "dealing with my shit" shouldn't exhaust you more, we're dating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: "管我的屁事"这个想法不应该让你更疲惫，我们毕竟是在交往。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Then I'll leave you alone with the creatures you really value.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那我就不打扰你和你真正心爱的生物了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, the last thing I need when I get home after a long day is to be told why I've let someone else down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，忙碌了一天回到家后，我最不想听到的就是被告知我又让谁失望了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I definitely know how that feels, that's why I love having my pets around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我太明白那感觉了，这就是我喜欢身边有宠物的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean, I definitely wouldn't say no to scratches and treats and love... ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean... you know how I feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是……你知道我的心意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What if... I wanted it to be more than a night? [Confess feelings.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果……我希望这不只是一夜呢？[表白心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yikes, sorry, I was just playing around. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 呀，对不起，我只是在开玩笑。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Let's live dangerously. Yeah. :) [Date Lettie.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 让我们过点刺激的生活吧。好。:) [和莱蒂约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能理解如果你没有同样的感觉，我明白的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果我让你不高兴了，我很抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Point is... I care about you, Lettie. A lot. And more than just as friend, and I understand if it isn't mutual, but -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 重点是……我在乎你，莱蒂。非常在乎。而且不仅仅是作为朋友，我知道这种感觉可能不是相互的，但是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're made of iron. And I know that no matter what they throw at you - Entrati, the Man in the Wall, Viktor and the Scaldra - it doesn't matter. They don't stand a chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你如铁般坚强。我知道无论他们对你做什么——英择谛、墙中人、维克多和炽蛇军——都无关紧要。他们一点机会都没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yikes, sorry, I was just playing around. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 呀，对不起，我只是在开玩笑。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Darn. Well, there goes that fantasy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 真该死。好吧，我的幻想破灭了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Whenever YOU want to talk, I get nervous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 每当你想聊聊的时候，我就会觉得紧张。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Now I'm *really* getting nervous... What's this about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 现在我*真的*开始紧张了……这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can't do this. I'm sorry. [Break up.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。对不起。[分手]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Just to be clear, who is giving and receiving the pain in this scenario?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 为了明确，这种情况下谁是施虐者，谁是受虐者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I trust you. I'm willing to give it a try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我信任你，我愿意尝试一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't know if pain is really my thing, Lettie... Does this mean we'd need to break up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，我不确定我能不能接受痛苦……这是不是意味着我们得分手了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sorry Lettie... Does this mean we need to break up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，对不起……这是不是意味着我们得分手了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well... when I said that, I... might not have trusted you as much as I do now. What if I'd be willing to give it a try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……当时我说这话的时候，我……可能没有像现在这样信任你。如果我愿意试一试呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can I ask *why* you enjoy pain like this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我可以问一下你*为什么*喜欢这样的痛苦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I can't do this. I'm sorry. [Break up.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。对不起。[分手]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... don't. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……做不到。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I trust you. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我信任你。<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I trust you. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我信任你。<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I... don't. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我……做不到。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sure. I... might be willing to give it a try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当然。我……也许愿意尝试一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Nope, sounds nuts to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不，这听起来简直疯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Maybe, in a weird way. But it's still not my thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 可能明白吧，从某种奇怪的角度来说是这样。但我还是对此不感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I trust you. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我信任你。<RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: On second thought - I can't, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 又想了一下——我做不到，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You doing okay, Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're going to have to narrow it down a bit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你得再说具体一点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You've mentioned the spiders before. A metaphor for depression, I assume?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你之前提到过蜘蛛。我想，这是抑郁的隐喻吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Spiders...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 蜘蛛……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Proof that spiders make shitty pets, I guess?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我想这大概证明了蜘蛛真的不适合当宠物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Okay, no problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好的，没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You hear voices...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你听到了声音……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Have you tried ignoring them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你试过忽略它们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do they whisper to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它们对你说了什么悄悄话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That sounds miserable... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 听起来好惨……抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What do you mean, they tell you lies?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你说的"它们骗你"是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: At least you know the spiders are liars, but... they sound like total assholes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 至少你知道蜘蛛是在骗人，不过……它们听上去真的像个混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Mine say meaner things... you're lucky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我的那些说得更刻薄……你已经很幸运了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Have you considered medication or treatment for it? Depression can be serious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你有没有考虑过吃药或治疗？抑郁症可以变得很严重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're not going to like Venus...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那你应该不会喜欢金星……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Very fair. And now, I can help you crush the spiders.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 很有道理。现在，我可以帮你拍死蜘蛛了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're not going to like Venus...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那你应该不会喜欢金星……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Very fair. And now, we can help each other crush the spiders.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 很有道理。现在，我可以帮你拍死蜘蛛了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I trust you. But you know when to get help, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我相信你。但你知道什么时候该寻求帮助，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If it ever got bad... you'd tell me, right? Even if we weren't still together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果情况变糟……你会告诉我的，对吧？即使我们不再在一起了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Never mind. At least now, I can help you crush the spiders.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没什么。至少现在我可以帮你拍死蜘蛛了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Never mind. At least now, we can crush the spiders together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没什么。至少现在我们可以一起拍死蜘蛛了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm going to say this with all the love and respect in the world - you are *shit* at starting conversations.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我要满怀爱意和敬意地说这句话——你在开场聊天方面真是*太糟糕了*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sorry, back up, what are you asking me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，倒回去一下，你到底在问我什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Even if I did have to leave - who says I wouldn't come back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 即使我不得不离开——谁说我不会回来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You hate it when I assume things about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你讨厌我对跟你有关的事情妄下定论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Entrati. I feel like my time chasing him might not be done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为英择谛。我感觉我追逐他的日子可能还没结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: My Xipe Totec. I know first hand why it *must* be stopped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为我的 Xipe Totec。我亲身经历过，知道为什么*一定要*阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Tau. If that's where Entrati is headed, my Xipe Totec *will* follow him. And it's too important to let them have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为 Tau。如果那是英择谛要去的地方，我们的 Xipe Totec 也会跟着他去。而且这个地方太重要了，不能让他们得手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The Man in the Wall. I know first hand why it *must* be stopped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为墙中人。我亲身经历过，知道为什么*一定要*阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Tau. If that's where Entrati is headed, The Man in the Wall. *will* follow him. And it's too important to let them have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为 Tau 星系。如果那是英择谛要去的地方，墙中人。也*会*跟着他去。而且这个地方太重要了，不能让他们得手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm NEVER leaving. End of story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我永远都不会离开。故事结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Tau is a planet in another solar system, where the Orokin sent a synthetic race they created to terraform it for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Tau 是另一个太阳系中的一颗行星，奥罗金派遣他们创造的合成种族去那里进行地球化改造，为我们预备环境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: The race were called Sentients. But the Sentients turned on the Orokin. Came back here and waged war on them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这个种族被称为 Sentient。但是 Sentient 背叛了奥罗金。他们回到这里并向奥罗金发动了战争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And it was that war that drove the Orokin to create the infestation - and warframes - in the first place. To fight the Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 正是这场战争促使奥罗金最初创造出感染者——和战甲，来对抗 Sentient。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, but then we never would have met. Or started dating. So... small upside?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 是的，但那样的话我们就永远不会相遇了。也不会开始约会了。所以……有一点点好处？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Basically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 基本上是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm not sure. But if Entrati *and* the Man in the Wall are headed there... it has to be important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不清楚。但如果英择谛*和*墙中人要去那里……那一定很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It was the only hope for humanity's survival. Might still be, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它曾人类生存的唯一希望。老实说，或许现在仍然是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm not sure. But the Sentients have said some cryptic things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不清楚。但 Sentient 说过一些神秘的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: "All is silent and calm, hushed and empty is the womb of the sky."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: "平静中万籁俱寂。寂静与空洞孕育于苍穹。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: "Merely framed Merely shaped they are called. There was no their mother, there was no their father."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: "仅赋其形，谓之为塑；本为无母，亦无其父。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Fair enough. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 合情合理。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Might want to wait to meet the future before you make that call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 也许在你做出决定之前，应该先等着看看未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I promise that IF I do go, I WILL come back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我保证如果我去了，我一定会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: All I can do is promise to try as hard as I possibly can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我只能保证会尽全力去尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Um. I'm sorry. What? What were they quoting?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯。不好意思。什么？他们引用了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lettie you've lost me again. Back up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，你又把我弄糊涂了。再说一遍吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I - I don't - I don't know. I have no clue. I'd only be guessing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我——我不——我不知道。我一点头绪都没有。我只能瞎猜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Time travel...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 难道是时间旅行……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: [Trigger warning: Pet loss. Click to end.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [触发警告：宠物死亡。点击结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well... once the year resets, she'll be back, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯……一旦今年重置，她就会回来，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Oh, no... Lettie, I'm so sorry. :(
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哦，不……莱蒂，节哀。:(

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Where're you going with this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那你是想表达什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So you're not upset?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那么你并不难过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, babe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 怎么了，宝贝？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What's up, L?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 怎么了，小莱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Uh oh...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 完了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sorry, Kalymos is chewing on the power cord, and - [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 对不起，卡利莫斯正在咬电源线，而且——[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Gee, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哦，那真是谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I mean... sure, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我是说……没错，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lol. You're doing great.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。你做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't know, I'm enjoying Sweet Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，我很喜欢甜蜜的莱蒂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hmm? I dozed off again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯？我又打瞌睡了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't feel that strongly, I'm sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我并没有那么强烈的感觉，对不起……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I - I love you too, Lettie. I never believed... I'm just so happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我——我也爱你，莱蒂。我从来没想过……我只是太开心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yes. Ma'am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好的，女士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SNEAKY>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_SNEAKY>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 糟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, I'm ready, I've been practicing. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我准备好了，我一直有在练习。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Uh... I think I forgot?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 呃……我好像忘了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: .....Quisiera una hamburguesa grande especial, por favor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
.....Quisiera una hamburguesa grande especial, por favor.
（……我想要一个大份汉堡套餐，谢谢。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So close
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 很接近了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Almost!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 差不多了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Holy shit. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 天哪。哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It goes: Sool, noong, zhwong, sahd, seer, hahf, hesh, zhee, pahk, now, senn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 应该是：Sool、noong、zhwong、sahd、seer、hahf、hesh、zhee、pahk、now、senn。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sure. The Ostrons have some pretty good ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 当然。Ostron 人有一些相当精彩的脏话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I don't think you need help in that department. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我认为在这部分你不需要帮助。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Am I going to get in trouble for saying that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果我说这话会惹上麻烦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What's that mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So I think you only had zhwong out of place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以我认为你只是把 zhwong 弄错了地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: "Suhn plah kuhn mermu kohng loch ruh!" means "Your mother's fishing nets had holes!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: "Suhn plah kuhn mermu kohng loch ruh！"意思是"你妈的渔网破洞了！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: "Vobi-da" means "goatshit."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: "Vobi-da"的意思是"山羊屎"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It means "your mother was a whore," basically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 其实它的意思基本上是"你的母亲是个妓女"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: One XL coffee, coming up. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 一杯超大杯咖啡，马上送到。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: LOL. I don't know, I think that was pretty funny.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。我不知道，但我觉得那挺搞笑的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Not surprised. He probably knew a bunch from before, and never let on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 一点也不奇怪。他可能之前就知道很多，只是没表露出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I promise I won't tell him you're on to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我保证不会告诉他你在盯着他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Jealous, or interested?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嫉妒，还是感兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hit me. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 来嘛。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sure. What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好的。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hit me. Um. Not literally, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 来嘛。嗯。不过别多想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Rooftop swimming pool?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你是说建个屋顶泳池？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Last I checked, why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果我没记错的话是有的，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hah, just teasing. Don't get your hopes up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哈哈，开玩笑的啦，别抱太大希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Can I say I'm sorry? For what I said that upset you. I think I stepped in it good without realizing it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我能说声抱歉吗？我说的话让你不开心了。我觉得我无意中说错了话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Oh, we could grow some fresh veggies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哦，我们可以种一些新鲜的蔬菜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It'd be great for your panquecitos. :) Some time in the sun time without worrying about them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这对你的 panquecitos 来说非常棒。:) 可以在阳光下晒一会儿，不用担心它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I like it! But why a greenhouse?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我喜欢！但为什么要是温室呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I remember she likes plants. I think she'd love it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我记得她喜欢植物。我想她一定会喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm just glad you two have patched things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴你们俩已经和好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why would I laugh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我为什么要笑？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: How you holding up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: :( Sorry to hear that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: :( 很遗憾听到你这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Something going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 发生什么事了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You have a ton to be happy about, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不过，你有很多值得高兴的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I learned the hard way in Duviri that "fixing feelings" is sometimes the worse choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我在双衍王境经里的惨痛教训让我认识到，"修复情感"有时候是更糟的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What can we do to get your mind off things? Or would you prefer to stay in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们怎么做才能让你不去想这些事呢？还是你更想待在家里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We can only hope he's playing the long game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们只能希望他在打持久战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I vote staying in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我投待在家里一票。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I vote killing things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我投杀人一票。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Should I be worried?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我应该担心吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I thought you two might get along, LOL.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我以为你们两个可能会相处得很好，哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 糟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And then what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We can't hurt some random teenager.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们不能去伤害一个青少年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I'm sad I couldn't help her with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我很抱歉没能帮到她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Is it something you can help her with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这是你能帮到她的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 没有？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Well, she's the only one who can help with Temporal Archimedea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 也是，她是唯一一个可以在时光科研上帮忙的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You'd be surprised how little that narrows it down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你可能会惊讶地发现，问了等于没问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Was it metal or alive?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 它是金属的还是活的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No clue. Might've been an Infested you saw chasing me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不知道。你看到的可能是感染者在追我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Could be a vulpaphyla? Did it look like a "fox" or a skinny "dog" with big long ears with glowing things on them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 会不会是狐帕菲拉？它看起来像一只"狐狸"或者一只瘦瘦的"狗"，长着长长的大耳朵，耳朵上还有发光的东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Could be a smeeta kavat? Did it look kind of like Kalymos but with big pointy ears?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 会不会是笑面型库娃？它看起来有点像卡利莫斯，只不过长着尖尖的大耳朵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Could be a vizier predasite? Did it look like a... big burly "dog" with glowing things on its head? Big bat ears?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 会不会是宰相扑猎达赛？它看起来像……一只头上长着发光东西的大"狗"？还有一双大蝙蝠耳朵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah... no clue, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 好吧……不知道，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That's my sly vulpaphyla. They come from Deimos, the Infested planet. It's pretty rare you see one away from Deimos. :) They're harmless. Well. To you, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那是我的狡黠狐帕菲拉。它来自火卫二，那颗 Infested 星球。在火卫二之外很少能见到。:) 它们无害。嗯，至少对你来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That's my crescent vulpaphyla. They come from Deimos, the Infested planet. It's pretty rare you see one away from Deimos. :) They're harmless. Well. To you, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那是我的月刃狐帕菲拉。它来自火卫二，那颗 Infested 星球。在火卫二之外很少能见到。:) 它们无害。嗯，至少对你来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: That's my panzer vulpaphyla. They come from Deimos, the Infested planet. :) They're harmless. Well. To you, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那是我的铁甲狐帕菲拉。它来自火卫二，那颗 Infested 星球。:) 它们无害。嗯，至少对你来说是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Big glowing bat ears?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 大大的发光蝙蝠耳朵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Long, skinny glowing ears?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 又长又细、发光的耳朵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: It's perfectly tame, I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我保证，它非常温顺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But it's an adorable Infested animal, Lettie. You know you want to pet it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但它只是一只可爱的 Infested 动物，莱蒂。你是想抚摸它的对吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Yeah, Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Uh... ¿Sí?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 呃……¿Sí?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Understood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Not even me? Or the Hex?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 连我也不信任？还有六人组也不算？

Jajaja it means "shit" 
But nono, this isn't a bad conversation 
It's just--

但我不是说这是一次糟糕的谈话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Look 
Trust is something that is very hard for me to give away 
And it is the most important thing in a relationship for me 
Broken trust is something that cannot be  repaired, especially in a situation like this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
看 
信任是我很难给予的东西 
而对我来说，而在一段关系中信任是最重要的 
一旦信任破裂，特别是在这种情况下，是无法修复的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You know trust is something that is very hard for me to give 
And it is the most important thing in a relationship for me 
Broken trust is something that cannot be repaired, especially in a situation like this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你知道信任是我很难给予的东西 
而对我来说，而在一段关系中信任是最重要的 
一旦信任破裂，特别是在这种情况下，是无法修复的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Because the kind of relationships I like to have tend to hurt, solecito 
If you get what I'm saying 
Only as much as we want it to 
And only as far as you're willing to go 
Because this kind of thing takes trust
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
solecito，因为我喜欢的那种关系往往会带来痛苦 
如果你明白我的意思的话 
这只会在我们想要的程度上发生 
也只会在你愿意接受的范围内发生 
因为这种事情需要信任

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And broken trust in a thing like this 
Can not be repaired 
¿Me explico?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
在这种事情中破裂的信任 
是无法修复的 
¿Me explico?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mmm, don't know 
Maybe because it's pain that I can control 
Versus all the pain I can't
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嗯，不知道 
也许是因为这是我能控制的痛苦 
与我无法控制的痛苦相比

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jajaja of course 
But once you've earned it 
Need to know I can trust you first 
So... what do you say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jajaja 当然可以 
但你得先赢得这份信任 
我需要先确认我能相信你 
所以……你怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Or maybe because it's something intense 
Something sharp that cuts through all the rest of the bullshit I have to deal with day in and day out 
It's REAL 
I can sink my teeth into it 
Make it sing 
Feel it pulse
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
或者因为这是某种强烈的体验 
一种锐利的感觉，可以刺破我每天要面对的那些糟心事 
这是真实的 
我可以深入其中 
让它发声 
感受它的脉动

Entiendo, no harm no foul
