/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 哎呀，苍天啊，sálvame

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
No 
Anything else you wanted
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
不对 
你还有别的想问的吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Va
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Va

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: ¡JAJAJA!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: ¡JAJAJA!

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Humility from our savior 
I like it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
来自我们救世主的谦逊 
我喜欢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Didn't grow up with a lot of money as a kid 
Bouncing from base to base 
Rats were easy to keep, mi mamá didn't mind
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
小时候家里没多少钱 
一直在各个基地之间搬家 
小鼠很容易养，我妈妈也不介意

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I have to get back to work 
See ya, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我得回去工作了 
再见，babas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, Lua, sálvame 
No
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
哎呀，苍天啊，sálvame
不

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: ¡JAJA!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: ¡JAJA!

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Humility from our savior 
I like it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
来自我们救世主的谦逊 
我喜欢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Didn't grow up with a lot of money as a kid 
Not a bad neighborhood, really 
Not a great one either 
Rats were easy to keep, mi mamá didn't mind
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
小时候家里没多少钱 
住的街区还行，不算差
但也谈不上好
小鼠很容易养，我妈妈也不介意

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You want to get those bandages?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你能去拿些绷带吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Gracias 
Owe you one 
A small one
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Gracias 
我欠你一个 
小小的人情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, with all my spare time 
Between stitching up the hex 
And all the civvies
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嗯，就用上我所有的空闲时间 
还得缝合六人组的伤口 
还有那些市民

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Gracias por nada, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Gracias por nada，babas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Babas 
Heads up
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Babas
注意

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Yeah, yeah, hello, *good morning* 
Or whatever time it is 
Need you to get more gauze 
Running low on supplies
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
对，对，你好，*早上好* 
或者现在是什么时候都好
需要你去多拿些纱布 
存货快不够了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Anita got into a box and chewed through some
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 安妮塔钻进箱子，咬坏了一些东西

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lo siento, right
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Lo siento，好吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
My newest corazoncito, my new rat 
She is still learning to behave
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我新养的 corazoncito，我的新小鼠 
她还在学规矩呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Gracias 
Owe you one 
A small one
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Gracias 
我欠你一个 
小小的人情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, with all my spare time 
Between stitching up the hex 
And all the civvies
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，就用上我所有的空闲时间 
还得缝合六人组的伤口 
还有那些市民

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Gracias por nada, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Gracias por nada，babas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You tell me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你来告诉我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I want to know why you think I like rats 
Go on
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我想知道你为什么认为我喜欢小鼠 
继续说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Tú te lo pierdes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Tú te lo pierdes

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Are there gods still 
Or have you forgotten them all
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
现在还有神吗 
还是你们全都忘光了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Maybe we have more in common than I gave you credit for, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Babas，也许我们之间的共同点比我想象的要多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Neta, babas? 
The gods, babas - Sol and Lua 
Are they remembered?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Neta，babas? 
那些神，babas——太阳神和月神 
人们还记得他们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Heh, sí 
You'll get used to it 
Or not
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
呵呵，sí 
你会习惯的 
或者不会

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Well? 
Are they still worshiped
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
那么？ 
他们还在被崇拜吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lárgate
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Lárgate

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You didn't have gods... 
Who're the orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你们没有神…… 
那奥罗金是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
What do you mean 
Kind of sacred
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你说的有些神圣
是什么意思

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
If it is half like what it sounds 
You put her WHERE?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
如果真像你说的那样 
你把她放在哪里了？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Then what DO you worship
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 那你崇拜什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Not the first time men dressed themselves as kings 
And thought themselves divine
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这不是第一次有人自封为王
还自认为神圣

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Won't be the last 
Talk to me more of them another time 
I have work to do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
也不会是最后一次 
下次我们再聊聊他们 
我现在得去忙了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Recognizing one is small in the face of everything is important 
I can respect that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
认识到自己在这一切面前是渺小的很重要 
我尊重这一点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Certainty in nothing is its own belief 
And anyone who tells you otherwise is a fool
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
没有信仰本身就是一种信仰
任何反对这一点的人都是蠢人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
That's a motivational poster not a belief 
But whatever brings you peace at night
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这听起来更像是励志口号，不像是信仰 
但不管怎样，如果它能让你晚上睡得安稳的话也不错

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I respect that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我尊重这一点

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
This kingdom of death of yours
Tell me more
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
你的死亡王国
再多说说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Oh yeah 
And what was that "hell" like 
Did it burn?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
哦对 
那么"地狱"是什么样子的 
它燃烧了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mm 
Seen a lot of suffering 
Suppose it does that to you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嗯 
见过很多痛苦 
估计它对你也这样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You're right
It isn't
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你说得对
确实不关我的事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: They?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
The name means nothing to me 
I want to know his soul 
Who was this *they* that hurt you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这个名字对我来说毫无意义 
我想知道他的灵魂 
伤害你的*他们*是谁

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
In a way, I think I understand 
Circumstances are different 
But the pain's the same
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
从某种角度来说，我觉得我能理解 
情况虽然不同 
但痛苦是一样的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
No, we are desconocidos 
Fair point
Another time, then
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
不，我们还不够熟 
有道理
那改天吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Maybe we have more in common than I gave you credit for, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: babas，也许我们之间的共同点比我想象的要多

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Stories made real 
And La Flaca knows your face
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
故事成了现实。
La Flaca 认得你的脸

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But I am curious
This kingdom of death of yours
Tell me more
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但我很好奇
你的死亡王国
再多说说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
These deaths you had 
Did they hurt?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你经历的这些死亡 
它们痛苦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Tell me, babas 
Do you know much of death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
babas，告诉我 
你对死亡了解多少？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Hm, sí
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯，sí

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: La Flaca and I know each other well
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我和 La Flaca 很熟

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Ay, equis
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Ay，equis

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
Surprised you caught on
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
没想到你这么快就明白了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
The Skinny Lady 
Death
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
瘦弱的女士 
死亡

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I respect her 
Even if sometimes I don't want to like her 
But she shepherds the ones I care for
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我尊重她 
即使有时候我并不喜欢她 
但她守护着我所关心的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Va
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Va

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You're thinking about it all wrong
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你这么想是不对的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
All those times you died 
Do you blame her for ending your pain? 
Was it her fault you suffered or was it the ones who hurt you to blame
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你死过的那么多次里
你会怪她结束了你的痛苦吗？ 
是因为她你才受苦，还是那些伤害你的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
My job is to make sure she takes people when it is their time 
Not until she rips them from my hands 
And not a damn second sooner
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我的工作是确保她在对的时间带走人们 
直到她从我手中把人抢走 
而且一秒也不能早

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But when she does come 
I make sure she knows she is welcome 
She takes away pain, babas 
She is not to be feared, but respected
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但当她来临时 
我会让她知道她是受欢迎的 
她是来带走痛苦的，babas
她不应该被恐惧，而应该被尊重

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Ay, equis, pansy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Ay，equis，pansy

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Sí, see? 
You get it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Sí，看? 
你明白我的意思了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And for those with faith 
So are we 
Maybe not as literally as you jaja 
Though... now we are fantasmas, too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
对于那些有信仰的人来说 
我们也是如此 
也许不像你那么字面上的哈哈 
不过……现在我们也成了 fantasmas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
That is why I heal 
To make sure La Flaca is certain in who she is taking 
And that she ONLY gets who she needs 
And no one else
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这就是我治愈的原因 
为了确保瘦女士确切知道她要带走谁 
并且只带走她需要的人 
不多也不少

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Caught in the same endless cycle as you were... 
Outside Mictlán embrace
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
被困在和你一样的无尽循环中……
在 Mictlán 的怀抱之外

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: We've all seen her sent loved ones too soon by the actions of others...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我们都见过深爱的人因为其他人的行为而过早被带走……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sí
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Sí

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Been fun 
Back to work for me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
聊得挺开心 
我得回去工作了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I need to go back to work
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我得回去工作了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Mm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mm? 
4
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嗯？ 
四只

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Vaquero, Anita, Neenah, and Tláloc
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 瓦奎罗、安妮塔、尼娜和特拉洛克

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Vaquero means cowboy 
Anita is a friend back home 
Neenah was a friend who is gone now 
Tláloc after an ancient god of rain
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
瓦奎罗的意思是牛仔 
安妮塔是老家的一个朋友 
尼娜是我已故的朋友 
特拉洛克则是古代雨神的名字

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Heh 
Name it Babas 
Hope it doesn't start licking the wallpaper
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
呵呵 
就叫它 Babas 吧 
希望它别开始舔墙纸

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Tláloc is a *dick* 
The rat not the god jaja 
I don't need that kind of bad mojo
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
特拉洛克是个*混蛋* 
说的是小鼠不是神哈哈 
我可不想招来那些霉运

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Good
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 很好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Don't worry 
It could be worse
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
别担心 
还有更糟糕的呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sí, long long ago, my people worshiped ancient gods, some of whom could be... bloody
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Sí，很久很久以前，我们的祖先就崇拜这些古神了，其中一些可能比较……血腥

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
He likes to bite 
He's like the ancient people and their gods, some of whom could be... bloody
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
他喜欢咬人 
就像古人和他们的神那样，其中一些人比较……血腥

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Bueno
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Bueno

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: No skin off my back
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我无所谓

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Xipe Totec, the Flayed One, who was the god of rebirth, of agriculture, and war
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Xipe Totec，也叫剥皮神，他是重生、农业和战争之神

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
In the yearly festival to celebrate him, war prisoners would be skinned, and bands of men would wear their flesh like their own and accept offerings from the people of the cities in his name 
Like I said 
They could be bloody from time to time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
在他每年的庆祝节日中，战俘都会被剥皮，一群男人会穿上他们的皮肤，代表他接受城市人民的供物
就像我说的 
他们有时候很血腥

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: De nada
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: De nada

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Couldn't agree more
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 完全同意

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Transference will finally be good for something, eh
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 传识终于能派上用场了，嗯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Transference will finally be good for something, eh
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 传识终于能派上用场了，嗯

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
These orokin, Entrati was one 
Yeah? 
Makes sense, him thinking he's some kinda god, ruining lives
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这些奥罗金人，英择谛也是其中一个
是吗？ 
说得通，他以为自己是某种神，毁了不少生命

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I want to know where Entrati gets off 
Coming here and ruining lives 
Who does this pinche güey think he is?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我想知道英择谛凭什么
来这里破坏人家的生活 
这个 pinche güey 以为他是谁？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Who're the cavia
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 科维兽是谁

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Greater good, my ass
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 更大的善，屁话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
As if I didn't need a reason to HATE him more... 
LAB ANIMALS?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我还需要更多理由去恨他吗…… 
实验动物？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Doesn't mean he's doing the right thing 
Pendejos like him are all the same 
Bullheadedly charging at their problem 
Everyone else is collateral damage
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这并不意味着他在做正确的事 
像他这样的 pendejos 都一个样 
固执地要解决他们的问题 
其他人都是附带的牺牲品

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Not the first time men dressed themselves as kings 
And thought themselves divine
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这不是第一次有人自封为王
还自认为神圣

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
JAJA 
You know it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
JAJA 
你懂的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But pendejos like him are all the same 
Get their head set on fixing a problem and everyone else is just collateral damage 
They don't care who they hurt or how bad 
He'd burn the universe if it meant he got his way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但像他这样的 pendejos 都是一个样
一心只想解决问题，其他人都只是附带的牺牲品 
他们不在乎自己伤害了谁，也不在乎伤害有多严重 
如果能达到他的目的，他连整个宇宙都敢烧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
That explains Entrati 
He thinks he is god and acts accordingly
Pendejos like him are all the same 
Bullheadedly charging at their problem 
Everyone else is collateral damage
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这就解释了英择谛
他自以为是神，行事也一副神的样子
像他这样的 pendejos 都一个样 
固执地要解决他们的问题 
其他人都是附带的牺牲品

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
He doesn't care who he hurts or how bad 
Everyone is just collateral damage to him in the name of his mission
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
他根本不在乎伤害了谁，也不在乎伤害有多严重 
为了所谓的任务，其他人不过是他附带的牺牲品

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And let me guess, he just abandoned them 
Saw what he'd done and walked away because he didn't need them anymore
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
让我猜一下，他就这样抛弃了他们 
看到了自己的所作所为，然后走开了，因为他不再需要他们了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Oh, pobres ángeles inocentes 
I would love them, you're right... 
We do not deserve animals 
Their love for us is pure and only asks for love in return
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Oh，pobres ángeles inocentes 
我会爱他们的，你说得对…… 
我们不配拥有动物 
他们对我们的爱是纯洁的，只求得到爱的回报

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Not saying it isn't 
But pendejos like him always do the worst things in the name of doing the ultimate good 
They don't care who they hurt or how bad, as long as they WIN and get their way
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我不是说这不重要 
但像他这样的 pendejos 总是打着做好事的名义做最坏的事
只要能赢，只要能达到目的，他们不在乎伤害了谁或者带来了多严重的伤害

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: People like him get people like us murdered
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 像他这样的人，害得像我们这样的人被杀

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I would adore that 
Gracias
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我会超喜欢的 
Gracias

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You'll never see HIM die for his cause 
He'll never sacrifice HIS life 
Just the ones around him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你永远不会看到他为了事业而牺牲自己 
他永远不会牺牲自己的生命 
只会牺牲他周围的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Makes you wonder which one the monster is in the end
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这让你不禁想，到底谁才是真正的怪物

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
That's why I keep pets 
My rats keep me company when I'm lonely 
When I can't stand people, they're there 
Sweet little souls, just wanting love
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这就是我养宠物的原因 
当我孤独时，我的小鼠会陪伴我 
当我受不了别人时，它们就在那里 
可爱的小灵魂，只想要爱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Do not pretend to understand the gods 
They are beyond us and it is stupid to think otherwise
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
别以为你能理解神
他们高于我们，不这样想的话简直愚蠢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Good 
Don't turn your back on that pendejo 
But be careful that you don't pretend to know the nature of the gods
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
好 
别对那个 pendejo 掉以轻心 
但要小心，不要假装了解神的本质

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And cheddar crowns jaja 
But mostly love
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
还有切达芝士的小王冠 jaja 
哈哈，但更多的是爱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But if I ever meet Entrati again 
I am going to make him HURT 
I am going to make him pay for every ounce of pain he paid those animals 
And I am going to make sure he knows why
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但如果我再遇到英择谛
我会让他受苦 
我会让他，为他给那些动物带来的每一分痛苦付出代价
而且我会确保他知道为什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Xipe Totec would be proud 
But like the Flayed One, be careful this old god of yours does not wear your face next
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Xipe Totec 会感到自豪的 
但就像剥皮神一样，小心不要让你这个老神最终披上你的皮

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
This THING he's chasing after 
It wears human skin like the ancient bloody gods of old
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
他追逐的这个东西 
就像古代的血腥神灵一样，穿着人皮

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Xipe Totec the Flayed One would wear the skin of his enemies 
And so does your Man in the Wall
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
剥皮神 Xipe Totec 会穿着敌人的皮肤 
你的墙中人也是如此

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Or maybe you can hold him down 
Heh, here I am getting all excited about something that'll never happen
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
或者你可以制服他
嘿，我居然会为一件永远不可能发生的事感到兴奋

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
So be careful what you do 
Or else it might wear your face next
¿Yeah, babas?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
所以你做事要小心 
否则下一个被它穿上的可能就是你的脸了
对吧，babas？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I should go back to work 
Nos vemos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我应该回去工作了 
Nos vemos

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: I might be a tiny bit sad
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我可能会有点难过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I should go back to work 
Nos vemos, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我应该回去工作了 
Nos vemos，babas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Muah 
I should go back to work 
Nos vemos, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
么么哒 
我得回去忙了
Nos vemos，babas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Bueno
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Bueno

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Hey, babas 
I have another small favor to ask you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嘿，babas 
我想请你再帮个小忙

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Hey, babas 
I have a small favor to ask you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嘿，babas 
我想请你帮个小忙

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
I bet I could make you beg for treats 
But you're probably too soft for that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
我敢说我能让你求着我要奖励 
不过你大概会撑不住

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Por qué no ambos? 
Don't distract me, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Por qué no ambos? 
别让我分心，babas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Cuidadito, babas 
Don't distract me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Cuidadito，babas 
别分散我的注意力

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I have too much work to do to play games and run around 
These civvies collect bullet wounds like Amir collects computers
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我有一大堆工作要做，根本没时间玩游戏和到处跑
这些市民挨子弹就像阿米尔捡电脑一样容易

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Point being, medkits 
I need more 
Find them or buy them, don't care 
Get them to me 
Te lo agradecería mucho
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
也就是说，医疗包 
我需要更多 
找到它们或购买它们，无所谓
把它们带给我 
Te lo agradecería mucho

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: None asked for
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我又没让你保证

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Gracias
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Gracias

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We all wound up as monsters 
But that bruja delights in what we've become 
Gets a sick glee out of messing about in my head 
Sees too much and thinks she knows everything
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们都变成了怪物 
但那个 bruja 却对此感到高兴
搅乱我的脑子，来获得一种病态的快感 
她看得太多，以为自己无所不知

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Ay, sí? 
And why is that? 
Did the bruja send you to talk to me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Ay，sí? 
那为什么呢？ 
是那个 bruja 让你来跟我说话的吗

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Even if she never devolves into the Techrot 
And she stays like she is now I don't care 
That bruja still enjoys this shit too much
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
即使她从未沦为科腐者 
就算她保持现在这个样子我也不在乎 
那个 bruja 还是太喜欢这些破事了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And why should I 
She could snap at any point and devolve into the Techrot 
And even if she doesn't that bruja enjoys all this too much 
We're all monsters now but the difference is she LIKES it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我为什么要这样做呢 
她随时都可能崩溃，然后沦为科腐者 
即便她没变，那个 bruja 对这一切也太乐在其中了 
我们现在都是怪物，但区别在于她喜欢这样的自己

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
It's one thing to accept it 
It's another thing to enjoy it 
And she can learn to not be a metiche and stay the hell out of my DAMN head
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
接受是一回事
享受它又是另一回事 
而且她应该学着不要总是探听别人的隐私，也不要再出现在我的脑子里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Ay, sí, verdad? 
Do tell
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Ay，sí，verdad? 
说来听听

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sure, sure 
How well is that working out for you, babas 
Have you forgiven all your grudges
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
行，行 
babas，那对你有用吗？ 
你放下所有怨恨了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Against your Xipe Totec and all the terrible things your void god has done 
You tell me you have no grudges 
Pendejadas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
面对你的 Xipe Totec 和你的虚空之神所做的一切可怕事情
你告诉我你没有怨恨 
Pendejadas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Against Entrati and the Orokin and what they did to you 
You tell me you have no grudges 
Pendejadas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
面对英择谛和奥罗金对你所做的事
你告诉我你没有怨恨 
Pendejadas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Against Duviri and the place that hurt you so many times 
You tell me you have no grudges
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
面对双衍王境和那个伤害过你无数次的地方 
你告诉我你没有怨恨

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Your life has been nothing but dancing with La Flaca and you tell me you have no grudges 
Pendejadas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你的生活无非是与 La Flaca 一起跳舞，你告诉我你没有怨恨 
Pendejadas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
That is exactly the problem 
You keep making my arguments for me, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这正是问题所在 
babas，你一直在帮我论证

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mierda... 
I do not like her in my head, babas 
But when you put it like that... no I do not blame her 
It is how I would handle it, too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Mierda……
babas，我不喜欢她进入我的脑子 
但你这么一说……不，我不怪她
换作我可能也会这么做

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I tell you what 
You have the bruja metiche work on staying out of my head 
And... I will work on cutting her some slack, ¿sí?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我跟你说 
让那个 bruja metiche 尽量别进入我的脑子 
而我……我会试着对她宽容些，¿sí?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Someday they will wear her skin like your Xipe Totec wears the Major 
And you will be gone and not be able to save her
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
总有一天他们会披上她的皮肤，就像你的 Xipe Totec 披上少校的皮一样 
而到那时你已经不在，救不了她

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Someday they will consume her 
And you will be gone and not be able to save her
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
终有一天，这些会吞噬她 
而到那时你已经不在，救不了她

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Vete 
Go away 
Too much to do to waste time on this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Vete 
走开 
太多事要做，没时间浪费在这上面

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You've been helping me 
So I suppose I'll hear you out 
What is it, babas?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你一直在帮我 
所以我想我会听你说的 
babas，什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Are you bleeding to death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你这是失血过多要死了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Estás bromeando, ¿verdad?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Estás bromeando，¿verdad？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lárgate
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Lárgate

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You're right 
It does sound like a massive waste of time 
And like pulling my own teeth out with a pair of rusty pliers
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你说得对 
这听起来确实是在浪费时间
就像用生锈的钳子给自己拔牙一样痛苦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Because someone else IS right now 
Is what you want ACTUALLY important?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
因为现在有人正处于生死关头
你这件事真的有那么要紧吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And while there's pain that I enjoy 
That's not it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
虽然我确实享受某些痛苦 
但那种不行

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Because you aren't stupid
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 因为你不傻

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Is what you want ACTUALLY important?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这事真的有那么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
What that escuincle thinks is important and what IS important are very different 
I do not have time for this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
那个小子以为的重要和真正重要的事完全不同 
我没时间搞这个

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Bueno
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Bueno

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Heh 
Don't get too excited babas 
Te queda grande la yegua
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
呵呵 
babas 别太兴奋了 
Te queda grande la yegua

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I do 
You're calling it in for a silly child's game of make believe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
是的 
就为了一个愚蠢的小孩过家家游戏，你要用掉它？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Suit yourself, babas... 
I'll play this stupid game 
But only AFTER the work day 
Now vete
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
babas，随你便吧…… 
我会玩这个蠢游戏 
但只能在工作日之后 
现在，vete

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Smart choice, babas 
Now vete
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
babas，明智的选择 
现在，vete

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
How do you do it, babas 
No entiendo
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
babas，你是怎么做到的 
No entiendo

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Ay, equis
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Ay，equis

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jaja, sí 
Lo siento, too much time in my head alone 
Though less so recently between you and the bruja
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jaja，sí 
Lo siento，自己一个人胡思乱想太多了
不过最近有你和那个 bruja，这种情况少了些

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Being trapped for centuries without time 
Without change, without movement 
We are fantasmas haunting this place
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
被困了几个世纪，没有时间 
没有变化，没有动静 
我们就像这个地方的 fantasmas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You say you've done it in Duviri 
That Kingdom of Death and Stories 
Yo me habría vuelto loca 
I'm worried I will lose my mind, now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你说你在双衍王境克服了这件事 
就是那个死亡和故事的王国 
Yo me habría vuelto loca 
我现在很担心我会失去理智

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You say you've done it before 
In this other land of yours 
Yo me habría vuelto loca 
I'm worried I will lose my mind, now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你说你克服了这件事 
就是在你的那个世界上 
Yo me habría vuelto loca 
我现在很担心我会失去理智

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Sí? 
Numb, an empty shell 
But you came back to life it seems, I don't see that in you now
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Sí? 
麻木，一个空壳 
但你看起来已经恢复了生气，我现在在你身上看不到那种状态

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I've seen that in soldiers after bad battles, blocking it all out 
The mind protects itself from the worst sometimes 
It's for the best, babas, trust me 
Well? How did you survive?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我见过士兵们在经历惨烈的战斗后会这样，将一切都封锁起来 
精神会自我保护，以避免承受最糟情况的伤害
这是最好的结果，babas，相信我 
那么？你是怎么挺过来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, cómo no 
Not the people I'd want to spend eternity with, babas 
No offense, look around
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，cómo no 
babas，我可不想和这些人永远待在一起 
没有恶意，但看看周围吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I was only around to stitch them back together, before we were turned into monsters 
Now we don't have a choice 
You think they want me here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我之前只是负责把他们缝合起来，后来我们都变成了怪物 
现在我们没有选择了 
你觉得他们想要我在这里吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you cannot fight eternity 
You escaped that place 
I don't see a way out for us... do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但是你无法与永恒抗争 
你逃离了那个地方 
我看不到我们的出路……你看得到吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Bueno, I'm screwed then 
Jaja
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Bueno，那我就没救了 
Jaja

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Appreciate the honesty 
I guess we take bets on who goes crazy first
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
感谢你的诚实 
我想我们可以打赌看看谁先疯掉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Ay, Sí? 
¿Want to take me out for a walk? 
Cuidadito, I am not going to be the pet of this relationship... 
¡Yo no me dejo!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Ay，Sí? 
想带我出去遛遛？
Cuidadito，我不打算在这段关系里当宠物…… 
¡Yo no me dejo!

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Who knows 
Might be me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
谁知道呢 
也许是我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Ay, Sí? 
Just how much do you like me, babas 
I've been wondering how quickly you'd break
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Ay，Sí? 
babas，你到底有多喜欢我 
我一直好奇你能撑多久

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Eh, know me well enough 
But we are not close 
Except maybe me and Arthur
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
呃，他们对我还算了解 
但我们并不亲近 
也许除了我和亚瑟之外

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: You think I don't know that, babas?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: babas，你以为我不知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
JAJAJA 
If I weren't I wouldn't be Lettie anymore 
I am who I am babas 
Take it or leave it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
JAJAJA 
如果我不这样，我就不是莱蒂了 
babas，我就是我 
要么接受，要么走开

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Because I choose not to 
Because I've learned better 
It's safer this way for everybody
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
因为我选择不这样做 
因为我吸取了教训 
这样对每个人来说都更安全

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lárgate de aqui
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Lárgate de aqui

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¡No manches, babas! 
Do you know how long rats live? 
2-3 years at most 
I am used to losing my little panquecitos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¡No manches，babas! 
你知道小鼠能活多久吗？ 
最多两到三年 
我已经习惯了失去我的小 panquecitos

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And I love them more than humans 
I am comfortable with grief and loss, more than you know 
Do not pretend you know me babas 
Lárgate
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我对它们的爱超过了对人的爱 
我对悲痛和失去的承受能力比你想象的要强 
babas，别装作你懂我 
Lárgate

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
No manches, babas... 
Do you want me to be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
babas，天啊……
你希望我这样做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We'll see, babas, we'll see 
But I'll take you up on the offer for temporary freedom 
Maybe some fresh air from time to time is all this fantasma needs
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
看着吧，babas，我们拭目以待
不过我会接受你的提议，享受一下短暂的自由
或许我这个 fantasma 偶尔呼吸些新鲜空气就够了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Fair 
But I'll take you up on the offer for temporary freedom 
Maybe some fresh air from time to time is all this fantasma needs
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
好
不过我会接受你的提议，享受一下短暂的自由
或许我这个 fantasma 偶尔呼吸些新鲜空气就够了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, sí 
Someone like you would need to be to survive 
Maybe that's your secret 
I like the stubborn ones, though 
They're harder to break
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay，sí 
像你这种人恐怕得这样才能活下来
也许这就是你的秘诀吧
不过我喜欢固执的人 
他们更难被击垮

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jaja 
It's not your feelings I want to step on
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jaja 
我并不打算践踏你的感情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¡No manches, babas! 
Do you want me to be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¡No manches，babas！
你希望我这样做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jaja we'll see, babas 
We'll see
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jaja，看着吧，babas 
我们拭目以待

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jaja, none taken 
Sí, friends is fine by me 
That's more than enough for most people
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jaja，没有冒犯到 
Sí，做朋友对我来说挺好的 
对大多数人来说，这已经足够了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Give me a reason not to hate Entrati 
And the whole damn future you come from
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
给我个不那么恨英择谛的理由 
还有你那个该死的未来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Because as far as I can tell 
He's an animal abusing cabrón 
And your whole stinking future can get screwed as far as I'm concerned
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
因为在我看来
他就是个虐待动物的 cabrón 
你那烂透的未来随它去见鬼吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And none of this "greater good" pendejadas 
And your whole stinking future can get screwed as far as I'm concerned
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
还有别再"为了大局"说什么 pendejadas 了 
你那烂透的未来随它去见鬼吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Because from where I sit 
That cabrón thinks he is a god and he let one loose 
And now it's all our problems to deal with 
So him and his future can get screwed as far as I'm concerned
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
因为在我看来 
那个 cabrón 自以为是个神，还放出一个怪物
结果现在变成了我们所有人的麻烦
所以他和他的未来都见鬼去吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Love? 
Who could possibly love someone like that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
爱？
谁会爱上那样的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Ay, sí? 
I did not see Loid here with him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Ay，sí? 
我可没看到洛德和他在一起

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You said HAD 
What do you mean, HAD
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你说"有过"
什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Used and tossed away 
I bet not the first time he's done it 
¿Verdad?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
利用完就丢掉 
我敢打赌这不是他第一次这么干了 
¿Verdad?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
He abandoned his family 
Let me guess 
He's done it another time hasn't he
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
他抛弃了他的家人 
让我猜猜 
这肯定不是他第一次这么干，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But he HAS defined it don't you see 
It's because of him that everything is the way it is
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但他确实塑造了未来，你难道看不出来吗 
正是因为他，一切才变成现在这个样子

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
?!?!?!??! 
If I ever see him again- 
I am going to KILL him, and let you reset the world so I can do it AGAIN
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
？!？!？!？？! 
如果我再见到他——
我会杀了他，然后让你重置这个世界，这样我就能再杀他一次

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You are making my point, ¿no? 
He is trash and the future is trash
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你这不正好证明了我的观点吗？¿no？ 
他就是个垃圾，未来也是垃圾

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
He is TRASH 
And the future is TRASH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
他就是个垃圾 
未来也是垃圾

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
it may not be ugly to you 
But it is WRONG 
It is not what the gods intended 
He tampered with it all
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
也许在你眼里不算丑陋 
但它是错的 
这不是神明的意图 
他篡改了一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If he never angered Xipe Totec, this Man in the Wall, none of your future would exist
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果他从未激怒过 Xipe Totec，这个墙中人，你的未来根本就不会存在

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: If he never unleashed this Man in the Wall, none of your future would exist
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 如果他从未释放出这个墙中人，你的未来根本就不会存在

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
The void would not have been unleashed, ¿no? 
Duviri would never have been made 
Your life would have been happier
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这样的话虚空就不会被释放， ¿no? 
双衍王境也不会被创造出来 
你的生活会更幸福

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
The void would not have been unleashed, ¿no? 
You never would have been trapped 
Your life would have been happier
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这样的话虚空就不会被释放， ¿no? 
你也不会被困住 
你的生活会更幸福

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Sentients?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Sentient？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí
I am just angry, lo siento 
This is not your fault and you are not garbage
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí
我只是有点生气，lo siento 
这不是你的错，你也不是垃圾

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You are like me 
Just a medic keeping as many lives from joining La Flaca too early as possible
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你和我一样，
是个医生，尽力让更多人不那么早去见 La Flaca。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: But Entrati can go screw a brick sideways
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 但英择谛可以去找块砖撞死

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
More mortals playing at being gods 
These orokin are trash 
The sentients lashed out at their creators
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
又是凡人扮演神明的把戏 
那些奥罗金人真是垃圾 
Sentient 反击了他们的创造者

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这是为了什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
More mortals playing at being gods 
These orokin are trash 
All that power and technology 
And they could not save our planet
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
又是凡人扮演神明的把戏 
那些奥罗金人真是垃圾 
他们拥有那么多力量和技术
却无法拯救我们的星球

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
De tal palo, tal astilla 
Humans making a race in their image 
Thinking they are the Father and Mother
Disgusting
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
De tal palo，tal astilla 
人类按自己的模样创造出一个种族 
就以父母自居，
真让人恶心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Instead they wanted to make a golden new home somewhere else 
Where they could be the only gods, far away from the Father and Mother
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
相反，他们想在其他地方建造一个黄金般的全新家园
在那里，他们可以成为唯一的神，远离他们真正的父母

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
They are something special, deep down, something more to us than just what they are at first glance
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
他们确实深藏着些特别的东西，不只是表面看上去的那样而已

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
And your Man in the Wall is just a collection of atoms 
And you are just a person with nothing special about them except what was done to them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
你的墙中人也不过是一些原子的集合
而你也不过是一个普通人，唯一特别的地方就是你所经历过的事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Do you believe in the unseen, ¿babas? 
Do you believe in something beyond the world we can measure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你相信看不见的存在吗，¿babas?
你相信有超越我们能衡量的世界的东西吗?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I feel sad for you 
Thinking you know everything there is to know 
How small your world must feel
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我真为你感到难过 
你以为你已经知道所有东西了 
你的世界该有多渺小啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, sí 
Don't think I disagree 
You know what we do not know and admit it 
I like that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay，sí 
别以为我不同意你的看法 
你知道我们所不知道的，并坦然承认 
我喜欢这样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, sí
You are touched by the unseen more than most 
For better or worse
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay，sí
你比大多数人都更受那些看不见之物的影响 
无论是好是坏

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Before all this nonsense 
Where did you come from, ¿babas?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
在所有这些乱七八糟的事之前 
¿babas?，你从哪里来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jajaja 
You're right it did start early 
But where do you FEEL like you come from
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jajaja 
你说得对，确实很早就开始了
但你感觉自己从哪里来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Despite what it did to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 不管它对你造成了什么伤害？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
That's the ship, ¿no? 
Isn't it abandoned now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
就是那艘船，¿no? 
现在不是已经废弃了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Why do you think I would laugh at you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 你为什么觉得我会笑你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, you who wanders 
Who has no home
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，你这个漂泊者
没有家的你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
It must be hard 
To feel like you come from no place and no time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你一定很难受吧
感觉自己没有归属的时间和地方

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
My family moved a lot then I joined the army 
Then with the ICR I fit in with no one and nowhere 
So I understand, in a way, feeling displaced
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我家里搬过很多地方，后来我参了军
然后进了国危部，我感觉自己无论在哪儿都格格不入
所以在某种程度上，我明白那种无所属的感觉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, don't I know that well 
My family moved a lot then I joined the army 
Then with the ICR I fit in with no one and nowhere
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，我怎么会不懂呢
我们家搬了很多次家，然后我参军了 
之后又去了国危部，我到哪里和谁在一起都没有归属感

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But my home has not done to me what that place has done to you, babas 
I respect you for still thinking of it as where you come from
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
babas，但是我的家并没有像那个地方对你那样对我
我尊重你仍然把那里当成是你来自的地方

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But I have a people and a culture I can call my own 
Even if they are far away
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但我有一个可以称之为属于自己的人民和文化
即使他们在很遥远的地方

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
More fantasmas, more death that follows you 
And I thought I knew La Flaca well
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
更多的 fantasmas，更多跟随着你的死亡
我还以为我已经很了解 La Flaca 了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, something to be said for the familiar 
I suppose in time this place will feel like home for me 
Mierda, I hope that is a long time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，熟悉的东西总有它的好处
我想随着时间的推移，这个地方会让我感觉像家一样 
Mierda，我希望那是很长一段时间

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Pues, a ver
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Pues，a ver

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Maybe 
You give me hope in that, babas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
也许 
你在这点上给了我希望，babas

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jaja seems it 
But your ghosts give me hope
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jaja，看起来是这样
不过你的鬼魂让我看到了希望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Poor haunted babas 
But you give me hope
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
可怜的鬼魂缠身的 babas 
但你给了我希望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
JAJA 
No, pequeño babas

 Starting a family only to abandon them when they were of no use 
 Disgusting
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这和那个 cabrón 英择谛一样糟糕 
 建立家庭只是为了利用他们 
 真恶心

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Lárgate de aquí, cabrón
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Lárgate de aquí，cabrón

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Like all creatures, food is the easiest path to love jaja 
But if you hold them, do not grab them, let them explore and get used to you 
Make clicking noises not kissy noises, kissy noises sound like bad squeaks to them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
像所有生物一样，食物是最容易让它们喜欢你的方式，jaja 
但是如果你要抱它们，不要抓它们，让它们自己探索并习惯你 
发出咔哒声而不是亲吻声，亲吻声在它们看来就像是难听的吱吱声

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Not very 
They need a big cage with bedding, places to hide, things to do, things to chew on 
They are social and need exercise, so I take them out of their cage a lot to roam
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
不算难 
它们需要一个有垫料大笼子，有躲藏的地方，有玩耍的东西，有咀嚼的东西 
它们有社交习性，还需要运动，所以我经常把它们从笼子里放出来到处走走

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Tláloc has the attitude but not the size for sure jaja 
Maybe we could make them little battle armor 
No, they are too small and fragile 
It would break my heart if anything happened to them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
特拉洛克有这个勇气，只是体型小了点哈哈 
也许我们可以给它们做些迷你战斗盔甲 
不行，它们太小太脆弱了 
如果它们发生什么事我会很伤心的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I would love that 
And maybe you can show me some of your strange pets in return
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我很乐意 
也许你也可以给我看看你的那些稀奇宠物

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Not much to ask for when you get so much in return from them 
Ni modo, some people do not understand I suppose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这些都不算什么，你从它们那得到的回报远超这些 
Ni modo，我想有些人可能就是不懂吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
They are 
Esto ha sido divertido, pero... 
Duty calls
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
它们确实很可爱 
Esto ha sido divertido，pero……
工作在召唤我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I would love that 
And maybe then I will introduce you to my rats in return
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
好啊 
然后我也可以带你认识我的小鼠们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Always busy 
But I can take a break 
¿Qué onda?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我一直很忙 
但我可以休息一下 
¿Qué onda?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Eh, it was messy 
Figured you didn't want the gory details 
But, sí, if you want to know 
I'll tell you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
呃，挺复杂的 
估计你也不想听那些血腥的细节 
不过，sí，如果你想知道的话 
我可以告诉你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We were stationed together in the same base 
Him in the Britannic and me with the Libertatian Army 
Different countries, same enemies
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们那时驻扎在同一个基地 
他在不列颠尼克军队服役，而我隶属于自由军 
我们来自不同的国家，但有着相同的敌人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I was the field medic for my regiment 
We were deployed in next to his 
The place went real cagadero 
Real fast
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我是我们团的战地医生 
我们当时驻扎在他们军队旁边 
那地方很快就变成 cagadero 
快得让人措手不及

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Most of my crew didn't make it 
Most of his didn't either 
We held each other together 
Literally 
I stitched his arm up good jaja 
When he retired and went into the ICR 
I followed him without question 
I was sick of all the drama that goes on in the army anyway
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我大部分战友都没挺过来 
他的也是
我们互相支撑着
真的是字面上的支撑 
我还帮他把胳膊缝好了，哈哈 
当他退役并加入国危部时 
我毫不犹豫地跟随他 
我早就受够了军队里的那些乱七八糟的事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I told him I'd follow him to the ends of the earth 
Didn't realize I'd follow him to the edge of Mictlán
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我跟他说我会追随他到天涯海角 
没想到我已经跟着他到了 Mictlán 的边缘

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
It must seem so small to you 
A story like that 
You fight monsters and gods 
You have danced with La Flaca so many times
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这对你来说一定不值一提 
这样的故事你有很多 
你与怪物和诸神打过架 
你还与 La Flaca 跳过无数次舞

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Seguro
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Seguro

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, sí 
Bright and flashy or small and personal 
La Flaca is all the same in the end 
At least... she should be 
But not for los fantasmas
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay，sí 
无论是华丽耀眼还是平凡低调
La Flaca 最终都是一样的
至少……她应该如此 
但对于 los fantasmas 来说却并非如此

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, It's all the same 
No matter how big and stupid the guns
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，都一样 
无论那些枪有多大多笨重

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Tell me of this terrible god you have unleashed 
Your Xipe Totec, your flayed god 
What does he want?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
告诉我，这个被你们放出来的可怕神明 
你们的 Xipe Totec，你们的剥皮神 
他到底想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: This void creature that sacrifices others and wears their skin like ancient flayed god of old, Xipe Totec
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 这个虚空生物会献祭其他人并披上被献祭者的皮肤，就像古老的剥皮神——Xipe Totec 一样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: What does he want
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 他到底想要什么呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You think but you do not know 
Its motivations are not clear 
But yet you think its an enemy ¿Por qué?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这只是你认为的，你其实也不知道 
它的动机并不清楚 
你为什么认定它是敌人 ¿Por qué?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You treat him like an enemy though 
If you do not know what he is after 
¿Por qué?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
然而你把他当作敌人对待
却不知道他想要什么
¿Por qué?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
No 
Trust you to understand the mind of a god 
Don't care how old you are 
How much you've seen
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
不 
要我相信你能理解神的思想 
不管你有多少岁 
有多少阅历

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You are not a god babas 
Don't pretend you think like one 
Otherwise you are no better than that Entrati cabrón
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你不是神，babas 
不要装作你和神想的一样 
否则你就和那个英择谛的 cabrón 没什么两样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You are not a god babas 
Don't pretend you think like one 
Otherwise you are no better than those  orokin cabrones
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你不是神，babas 
不要装作你和神想的一样 
否则你就和那些奥罗金的 cabrones 没什么两样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You are not a god babas 
Don't pretend you think like one
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你不是神，babas 
不要装作你和神想的一样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: And you think you can stop a god
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 而你觉得你可以阻止神明

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jaja, sí 
I get that sense 
Appreciate the honesty, babas 
Seems to work for you, so I won't judge
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jaja，sí 
我懂那种感觉 
感谢你的大实话，babas 
看起来这对你有用，所以我不会评判

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
All we can ask for I suppose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
我想大概也只能这样了吧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Estás bromeando, ¿verdad? 
The moment they ring you will go running 
You are a drifter, a soldier, you will go to save the future when they need you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Estás bromeando，¿verdad? 
到时候他们一叫你，你就会立马跑过去 
你是一个漂泊者，一个战士，当他们需要你的时候，你就会去拯救你们未来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We are trapped here 
Do not lie to me or tell me you'll take me for walks, babas 
Someday you will escape and never come back
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们被困在这里 
不要骗我，也别告诉我你会带我去散步，babas 
总有一天你会逃走，再也不会回来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, sí 
Faith in what does not matter I suppose 
As long as it gets you through
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay，sí 
我觉得信什么都不重要 
只要它能帮你度过难关就好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Gracias
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: Gracias

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mm, sí, suppose I am 
Two reasons for that 
Uno, I see La Flaca all the time in my line of work 
She and I are old "friends" 
Dos, my people think about death differently, I think
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嗯，sí，可能是吧 
有两个原因 
一是，我在工作中经常和 La Flaca 打交道 
我和她是老"朋友"了 
二是，我觉得我们的人对死亡的看法不同

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Jaja how is the easy part, babas 
I enlisted and was bad at it 
Then I got good at it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jaja，对我来说怎么入的行很简单，babas 
我参了军，刚开始表现不好 
后来就变厉害了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mi papá was in the army 
We traveled a lot, from base to base 
But when mi tía got sick she moved in with us 
And I learned to take care of her until she passed
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Mi papá 在军队里 
我们经常要从一个基地搬到另一个基地 
但后来 mi tía 病了，就搬来和我们一起住 
我学会了照顾她，直到她去世

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We celebrate our beloved ones that return and visit us 
Invite them to come back to see us once a year 
We make our pan de muerto, our calaveritas de azúcar, and set out our marigolds to invite them home
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
每当我们的挚爱回来看望我们，我们会庆祝 
邀请他们每年回来看望我们一次 
我们制作 pan de muerto、calaveritas de azúcar，摆放万寿菊来欢迎他们回家

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We sit at their graves and we tell stories 
We eat what we bring for them, with them 
We talk to them and laugh with them 
We do not whisper or cry when they come to us in the night
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们坐在他们的坟前，讲故事 
我们和他们一起吃着带给他们的食物
我们和他们一起说话、一起欢笑 
当他们夜里来到我们身边时，我们不会低语也不会哭泣

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Eh, está bien 
It happens, ¿no? 
Heart troubles made her sicker and sicker 
Good practice for the future, being a set of hands for mi mamá
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
哎，está bien 
这种事是难免的，¿no? 
她的心脏问题让她越来越虚弱了 
不过这也算是为以后提前练习，学着帮 mi mamá 做事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
10? 11? 
Mi mamá needed the help 
I didn't mind 
Good practice for the future, being a set of hands
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
10岁？11岁？ 
Mi mamá 需要帮忙 
我无所谓
这也算是为以后提前练习，学着帮忙做事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I was introduced to La Flaca when I was young 
Mi papá was in the army 
We traveled a lot, from base to base 
But when mi tía got sick she moved in with us 
And I learned to take care of her until she passed
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我小时候就认识了 La Flaca 
Mi papá 在军队里 
我们经常要从一个基地搬到另一个基地 
但后来 mi tía 病了，就搬来和我们一起住 
我学会了照顾她，直到她去世

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
No 
I see her once a year at the festival of the dead 
¡Mierda! Before you ask no, it's not like what it sounds 
We do not dig them up we celebrate their souls jajaja 
Well, some do - but we do not, depends on where you're from
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
不 
我每年在亡灵节上都会见到她一次 
¡Mierda! 在你问之前，不，不是你想的那样 
我们不会把他们挖出来，而是庆祝他们的灵魂 jajaja 
好吧，有些人会这样做——但我们不会，这得看你是哪的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, but I do not miss them 
They are gone from my day to day but not gone from my soul they still visit me once a year at the festival of the dead 
We do not dig them up we celebrate their souls jajaja 
Well, some do - but we do not, depends on where you're from
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，但我并没有特别想他们 
他们虽然从我的日常生活中消失了，但从未离开过我的灵魂，他们在每年亡灵节都会回来看我们
我们不会把他们挖出来，而是庆祝他们的灵魂 jajaja 
好吧，有些人会这样做——但我们不会，这得看你是哪的人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mi papá made me wait until I was 20 before I joined 
But I was ready to go earlier jajaja 
Biting at the bit, wanted to make him and mi tía proud 
I'm glad he made me wait I wasn't ready
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Mi papá 让我等到 20 岁才入伍
但我早就准备好了 jajaja 
迫不及待地想让他和 mi tía 感到骄傲 
我很庆幸他让我等了，我那时根本没准备好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We build ofrendas to our loved ones and make pan de muerto, and calaveritas de azúcar, and set out our marigolds to invite them home 
We eat what we bring for them, with them 
We sit at their graves and we tell stories of them 
We talk to them and we laugh with them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们为所爱之人搭建祭台，做 pan de muerto 和 calaveritas de azúcar，摆上万寿菊来欢迎他们回家 
我们和他们一起吃着带给他们的食物
我们坐在他们的坟前，讲述他们的故事 
我们和他们一起说话、一起欢笑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Watching your tía slowly die of heart failure is one thing 
Watching people kill each other violently 
Screaming deaths, bleeding deaths 
They are something else
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
看着你的 tía 因为心力衰竭慢慢死去是一回事 
看着人们互相残杀 
惨叫着、流着血死去
又是另一回事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you know this, don't you? 
You know La Flaca just as well as I do 
Speaking of 
She waits for no one and certainly not for our conversations
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但你应该清楚这些，对吧？ 
你和我一样了解 La Flaca
说到这 
她从不等人，更不会等我们聊天

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mi tía comes to me every year, pats me on the shoulder and says "Buen trabajo, amorcito, sigue así" 
And it makes me smile not scream and run away in fear
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
每年 Mi tía 都会回来看我，拍拍我的肩膀说"Buen trabajo，amorcito，sigue así" 
这总会让我露出笑容，而不是害怕地逃跑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I hope she comes out this far... 
I'll have to make her paper marigolds 
Maybe Arthur will help me make some pan de muerto I am a shit baker jajaja
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我希望她能来这么远的地方…… 
我得为她做些纸扎万寿菊 
也许亚瑟能帮我做一些 pan de muerto，我做糕点实在是太糟糕了 jajaja

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You are sweet 
Sí, maybe we can work together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你真好 
Sí，也许我们可以一起做

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
If you want, we could build an ofrenda to your family 
Maybe they would come to see their babas after so long 
I am sure they are so proud of you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
如果你愿意，我们可以为你的家人建造一个祭台 
说不定他们会在这么多年后来看看他们的 babas 
我相信他们会为你感到骄傲

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Do you have loved ones you want to have visit 
We could work together and build you an ofrenda 
Maybe they would come to see their babas after so long I am sure they are so proud of you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你有想邀请的挚爱吗 
我们可以一起为你建造一个 ofrenda 
说不定他们会在这么多年后来看看他们的 babas 
我相信他们会为你感到骄傲

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Claro, friend 
Mm, now that I think 
Can souls travel through time? 
Ay, equis, is the thought that counts sometimes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Claro，朋友 
嗯，现在一想 
灵魂可以穿越时间吗？ 
哎，equis，有时候心意才是最重要的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Fair 
Mm, now that I think 
Can souls travel through time? 
Ay, equis, is the thought that counts sometimes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
也好 
嗯，现在一想 
灵魂可以穿越时间吗？ 
哎，equis，有时候心意才是最重要的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Because of what your Xipe Totec made you do 
It was not your fault, they were driven mad 
Sometimes you need to cauterize the wound 
You put them down, it was not murder
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
因为你们的 Xipe Totec 让你做的事吗 
这不是你的错，他们已经失去了理智 
有时你需要烧灼伤口才能治愈 
你让他们安息，这不算是谋杀

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: ¿Por qué?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: ¿Por qué?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, I can't imagine how it felt 
To have to hurt your own family like that 
But you had no choice, solecito 
They were rabid animals and had no control
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，我无法想象那种感觉 
不得不那样伤害自己的家人 
但是 solecito，你别无选择 
他们当时就像狂暴的动物，而且失控了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And that kind of choice I *do* understand 
But that is a story for another time 
La Flaca waits for no one and not our conversations and I have a line
