Why I hate him so much 
What that piece of shit made us do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你问过我们是如何变成这些 monstruos 的 
那个 pinche cabrón 对我们做了什么 
为什么我这么恨他 
那个垃圾逼我们做的事情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You should know what that pinche cabrón did to us 
Why I hate him so much 
What that piece of shit made us do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你应该知道那个 pinche cabrón 对我们做了什么 
为什么我这么恨他 
那个垃圾逼我们做的事情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I told you how Arthur and I became hermanos 
But not how we got turned into these monstruos 
You should know what that pinche cabrón did to us 
Why I hate him so much 
What that piece of shit made us do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我告诉过你我和亚瑟是如何成为 hermanos 的 
但我没告诉你我们是如何变成这些 monstruos 的 
你应该知道那个 pinche cabrón 对我们做了什么 
为什么我这么恨他 
那个垃圾逼我们做的事情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
You've done a lot for us 
Saved our lives, stayed with us... when you could leave 
Time you hear the whole story
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你为我们做了很多 
救了我们的命，选择留下陪伴我们……而明明你可以离开 
是时候让你知道整件事情了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
So 
I followed Arthur into the ICR 
Got sent here to this cuchitril to deal with some weird plague nobody'd seen before
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
是这样的 
我跟着亚瑟进了国危部 
被派到这个 cuchitril 来处理一种前所未有的奇怪瘟疫

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
A disease that chews up people 
Spits them out half person half machine 
Or some things that weren't ever human beings at all, más bien computadoras
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这种疾病可以吞噬人类 
吐出半人半机器的东西 
或者变成一些根本不像是人类的东西，más bien computadoras

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We get deployed to "deal with it" 
Best way we know how 
Half bandages 
Half bullets
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们被派去"解决问题" 
用我们所知道的最好的方法 
一半用绷带 
一半用子弹

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
This was early 1998 
Before you came 
That Entrati cabrón was already here 
Selling his MENTIRAS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这发生在 1998 年初 
在你来之前 
那个英择谛 cabrón 已经在这里了 
兜售他的 MENTIRAS

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But the best lies are the ones you want to believe, ¿verdad? 
We had no cure for this disease except a dance with La Flaca 
But here he comes 
Doktor F and his magical bag of miracles will cure what ails you 
Saying he can fix it all with his medicina milagrosa
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但最好的谎言总是那些你愿意相信的，¿verdad? 
除了和 La Flaca 共舞，我们并没有治愈这种疾病的方法 
但他来了 
五博士和他的神奇魔法袋可以治愈你的病痛 
声称他可以用他的 medicina milagrosa 治愈一切

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And we bought it como una bola de mensos 
And when the ICR stomps its feet and says "nonono, you cannot help him distribute his drug" should have listened 
Vaccines come from scientists not an old man in some ugly-ass trench coat 
Selling lies like some old world snake oil 
But people are dying all around you? 
You help him anyway because you signed up to HELP people
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们全都信了，como una bola de mensos 
当国危部严厉警告说"不不不，你不能帮他分发他的药物"时，那时我们真该听进去 
疫苗应该由科学家研发，而不是某个穿着难看风衣的老头 
像旧时代卖假药的骗子一样兜售谎言 
但当你周围的人都在死去？ 
无论如何你还是会帮他，因为你当初就是为了帮助人们而来的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
So we helped him inject the people of this city with his drug 
Lined them up in our tents and that cabrón and I shot them full of it one after another 
And the others kept the operation safe while we worked
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
所以我们帮助他给这座城市的人们注射他的药品 
让他们在我们的帐篷里排长队，然后我和那个 cabrón 一个接一个地给他们注射 
其他人则在我们工作时维持秩序

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
NOSOTROS CREÍMOS EN ÉL 
We trusted him 
¿Y por tan poco? 
It seemed like it was working 
The people we were shooting up weren't getting sick 
The problem...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
NOSOTROS CREÍMOS EN ÉL 
我们信任他 
¿Y por tan poco? 
看起来像是有效的 
我们注射的人并没有生病 
问题是……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Everybody around them WAS 
Do you know what "silent carriers" are? 
Volunteered in an animal shelter one summer cuando estaba chiquita 
Had all these raccoons 
Couldn't release them, because they might be silent carriers of rabies 
THEY looked healthy, seemed healthy, seemed normal...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
他们周围的每个人都生病了 
你知道什么是"无症状携带者"吗？ 
有个夏天我在一个动物收容所做志愿者，cuando estaba chiquita 
那里有很多浣熊 
不能放生它们，因为它们可能是狂犬病的无症状携带者 
它们看起来很健康，似乎很正常……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But if we let them go? 
They'd infect everything they came across... 
That's what we were doing to people 
THAT'S WHAT HE WAS MAKING US DO TO PEOPLE 
¡LO HIZO A PROPÓSITO!
This place is the edge of Mictlán POR SU CULPA
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但如果我们放了它们呢？ 
它们会传染给它们接触到的所有东西…… 
这就是我们对人们所做的 
这就是他让我们对人们所做的 
¡LO HIZO A PROPÓSITO!
这个地方变成了 Mictlán 的边缘，POR SU CULPA

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Even when we started to suspect 
We could not believe 
We whispered to each other 
But shook our heads and said 
Nonono, it cannot be 
Not him 
Not us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
即使我们开始怀疑 
我们还是无法相信 
我们互相窃窃私语 
但还是摇头说 
不不不，不可能 
不是他 
不是我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We did not want to believe 
That our trust had been broken 
We... we had taken the drug too, solecito... 
We were spreading the plague...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们不愿意相信 
我们的信任已经破裂 
我们……我们也注射了那个药，solecito…… 
我们在传播瘟疫……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We did not want to believe 
That our trust had been broken 
We... we had taken the drug too... 
We were spreading the plague...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们不愿意相信 
我们的信任已经破裂 
我们……我们也注射了那个药…… 
我们在传播瘟疫……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: So when he said the Techrot strain had mutated... and we were no longer safe...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 所以当他说科腐者病毒株已经变异……我们不再安全时……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
We lined right up 
Like good little soldaditos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我们立刻排好队 
像乖巧的 soldaditos 一样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Lua, it hurt 
Wasn't the fun kind, either... 
Aoi's screams were the worst 
I could not help her, I was too busy dying too 
She wept in fear and all I wanted to do was hold her
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
天啊，那真的很痛 
而且一点也不有趣…… 
碧的尖叫声最令人难受 
我帮不了她，我自己也快死了 
她害怕地哭泣，我多想抱抱她

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Tell her it would be okay 
That the pain would pass and La Flaca would take her home 
She was so afraid and I could not help her 
My legs would not work...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
告诉她一切都会好的 
疼痛会过去，La Flaca 会带她回家 
她如此害怕，而我却无能为力 
我的腿无法动弹……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And I will hate that piece of shit 
Every day of my endless life 
For that betrayal
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我会永远恨那个垃圾 
用我无尽的生命中的每一天去恨他 
因为他的背叛

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
And if I ever see him again? 
You better be there to hold me back 
Or I will teach him what real hurt is like
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
如果我再见到他？
你最好在那里拉住我 
否则我会让他知道什么是真正的痛苦

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Look at you 
All Hail San Babas 
Forgiving sins 
No 
Some things cannot be forgiven 
What he did to us is one of them 
What we did to the people of this city is another
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
看看你 
圣人 Babas 万岁 
饶恕罪过 
不 
有些事情是无法被原谅的 
他对我们所做的就是其中之一 
我们对这座城市的人所做的则是另一件

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
I do not take betrayal well 
But we wanted to believe him and it made us stupid 
If you do not want to be around us anymore, I understand
The others will, too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
我无法接受背叛 
但我们当时想相信他，这让我们变得愚蠢 
如果你不想再和我们在一起了，我能理解
其他人也会理解的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
We were 
But we wanted to believe him and it made us stupid 
If you do not want to be around us anymore, I understand 
The others will, too
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
我们有责任 
但我们当时想相信他，这让我们变得愚蠢 
如果你不想再和我们在一起了，我能理解 
其他人也会理解的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¿Sí? 
Ay... then we're both idiots jajaja 
Maybe you DO belong here with us 
Sigh 
My feet hurt 
Mierda, everything hurts
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Sí? 
哎……那我们都是白痴 jajaja 
或许你确实应该和我们一起 
哎 
我的脚好疼 
Mierda，哪儿都疼

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
You're right 
We made mistakes 
And I made another one in thinking  THIS could work out
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
你是对的 
我们犯了错误 
而且我还犯了另一个错误，就是以为这会有好结果

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
You're right 
We made mistakes 
And I made another one in thinking I could trust you with this story
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
你是对的 
我们犯了错误 
而且我还犯了另一个错误，就是以为我可以放心地把这个故事告诉你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I'm calling it for the day, solecito 
Gracias 
Thanks for listening to me and... 
Not thinking less of us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
今天就到此为止吧，solecito 
Gracias 
谢谢你听我说话…… 
也没有看不起我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I'm calling it for the day, friend 
Gracias 
Thanks for listening to me and... 
Not thinking less of us
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
今天就到此为止吧，朋友 
Gracias 
谢谢你听我说话…… 
也没有看不起我们

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
How did you do it, solecito? 
How did you spend all that time alone 
And not go demente
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
solecito，你是怎么做到的？ 
你是怎么独自度过那段时间 
而没有疯掉的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
How did you do it, friend? 
How did you spend all that time alone 
And not go demente
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
朋友，你是怎么做到的？ 
你是怎么独自度过那段时间 
而没有疯掉的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
How long did you spend in that place where you danced with La Flaca 
Do you even know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你在那个与 La Flaca 共舞的地方待了多久 
你还有印象吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay sí 
Talking to imaginary friends 
I used to do that when estaba chiquita 
Talking to my panquecitos is much more acceptable jaja
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay sí 
与想象中的朋友交谈 
我以前在 estaba chiquita 时也这么做 
和我的 panquecitos 交谈更容易接受 jaja

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
Maybe you did jaja 
But you came back and that gives me hope 
Or at least you are high-functioning crazy jaja 
And I could be happy with that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
也许你真的疯了 jaja 
但你回来了，这给了我希望 
或者至少你是个高功能的疯子 jaja 
我觉得这样我也能接受

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí 
I used to think all I needed was my panquecitos 
A good cup of coffee 
And a day or two off a week 
Now I'm not sure
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí 
我以前以为我只需要我的 panquecitos 
一杯好咖啡 
还有一周休息一两天就够了 
现在我不太确定了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
¡Jajaja! 
Cuss myself out in Tenochtitlán slang all the time 
Always spooks Arthur 
Thinks I'm gonna stab him or something 
Silly gringo it'd just make a mess
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Jajaja！ 
我总是用特诺奇蒂特兰方言骂自己 
总会吓到亚瑟 
他以为我会刺他之类的 
傻乎乎的 gringo，只会把事情弄得一团糟

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Used to think I only needed myself 
Suppose I could still be that way if needed 
Not saying what we have isn't wonderful 
It's hard to explain and I am doing poorly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我曾以为只靠自己就够了
我想如果需要的话，我还是可以继续那样 
并不是说我们之间的相处不够美好 
这很难解释，我表达不好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I see you and mi hermano Arthur 
It's not jealousy 
I just feel the loneliness suddenly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我看到你和 mi hermano 亚瑟在一起 
我不是嫉妒 
只是突然感到了孤独

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I see you and Aoi 
It's not jealousy 
I just feel the loneliness suddenly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我看到你和碧在一起 
我不是嫉妒 
只是突然感到了孤独

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I see you and that niño Quincy 
It's not jealousy 
I just feel the loneliness suddenly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我看到你和那个昆西 niño 在一起 
我不是嫉妒 
只是突然感到了孤独

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I see you and that escuincle Amir 
It's not jealousy 
I just feel the loneliness suddenly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我看到你和那个 escuincle 阿米尔在一起 
我不是嫉妒 
只是突然感到了孤独

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I see you and la bruja metiche 
It's not jealousy 
I just feel the loneliness suddenly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我看到你和 la bruja metiche 在一起 
我不是嫉妒 
只是突然感到了孤独

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I am happy for you both 
Te lo juro 
He deserves to be with someone finally 
I just... find a sadness in me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我为你们俩感到高兴 
Te lo juro 
他总算能有一个人可以在一起了 ，他值得
我只是……发现自己有点难过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I am happy for you both 
Te lo juro 
She needs someone to see joy in what she does 
I just... find a sadness in me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我为你们俩感到高兴 
Te lo juro 
她需要有人能欣赏她所做的一切，并为此感到开心
我只是……发现自己有点难过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I am happy for you both 
Te lo juro 
He needs something real in his life 
I just... find a sadness in me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我为你们俩感到高兴 
Te lo juro 
他的生活中需要一些真实的东西
我只是……发现自己有点难过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I am happy for you both 
Te lo juro 
He needs someone who believes in him 
I just... find a sadness in me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我为你们俩感到高兴 
Te lo juro 
他需要一个相信他的人 
我只是……发现自己有点难过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I am happy for you both 
Te lo juro 
She needs someone who accepts her as she is 
I just... find a sadness in me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我为你们俩感到高兴 
Te lo juro 
她需要一个能接受她真实一面的人 
我只是……发现自己有点难过

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Mm that obvious? 
Must be 
Not personal, solecito
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
嗯，那么明显吗？ 
的确如此 
这不是针对你，solecito

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí, mi corazón 
You understand
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí，mi corazón 
你懂我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, sí, sí... 
I suppose 
Hard to explain
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay，sí，sí…… 
我想 
很难解释

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text: Got to go back to work, solecito
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我得回去工作了，solecito

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I have to go back to work 
But I feel better now 
Gracias, mi corazón...gracias
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我得回去工作了 
现在我感觉好多了 
Gracias，mi corazón……gracias

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
JAJAJA 
Aaay, solecito 
This is what I have been missing 
How did you get on without this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
JAJAJA 
Aaay, solecito 
这就是我一直缺少的 
没有这些你是怎么过的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
JAJAJA 
Aaay, friend 
This is what I'm talking about 
How did you get on without this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
JAJAJA 
哎，朋友 
这正是我想说的 
没有这些你是怎么过的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
People 
Being with them 
Around them 
Simple shit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
人啊 
和他们在一起 
在他们周围 
那些简单的事情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Sí... 
And I did I guess 
Still do
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Sí…… 
我想我也是 
现在仍然如此

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Loneliness is a sadness that comes like rainstorms 
Or like seasons

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Your story with the skinned god of the Void... sí 
I fear it may not be over 
And who am I to think I am important enough to stand in the way of it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
你与虚空剥皮神的故事……sí 
我担心这还没有结束 
我又凭什么认为自己重要到可以阻止它呢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Didn't think you were that naive 
This thing between us is clearly a mistake, babas 
You are too young for me I think 
If you can't understand the reality of all this
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
没想到你这么天真 
babas，我们的关系显然是个错误 
我觉得你对我来说太嫩了 
如果你不能理解这一切现实的话

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Ay, sí 
If it is not one of us to put a bullet in his skull It should be you 
And I hope that once you go and make him pay 
You will come back to us 
And to me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Ay, sí 
如果不是我们中的一个人给他的脑袋来一枪，那应该是由你来 
我希望你去让他付出代价后 
能回到我们这里 
也回到我身边

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Maybe when you finally defeat this skinned god of yours 
You won't forget about us back here in this cuchitril 
You will come back to us 
And to me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
也许当你最终战胜了你的那位剥皮神 
你不会忘记我们这些还留在 cuchitril 里的人 
你会回到我们这里 
回到我身边

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
This Tau This is where the... sentients were sent ¿no? 
This fake race made by fake gods the orokin
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这个 Tau，这不就是那些……Sentient 被送去的地方，¿no? 
就是那个由假神奥罗金创造出来的假种族

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Tell me of this Tau 
What is it 
Tell me why it would take you from me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
告诉我这个 Tau 星系
它是什么 
告诉我为什么它会把你从我身边带走

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
So if it were not for this Tau and these Sentients 
This fake race made by these fake gods the orokin

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
所以，如果没有这个 Tau 和这些 Sentient 
这个由奥罗金人这些假神创造的假种族
所有这些 pendejadas 都不会发生

Jajaja sí 
Small upside 
But why? 
Why is this place so important that it will take you from me some day

Jajaja sí 
一点点好处
但为什么？ 
为什么这个地方那么重要，以至于有一天它会把你从我身边带走

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But why? 
Why is this place so important that it will take you from me some day

但为什么？ 
为什么这个地方那么重要，以至于有一天它会把你从我身边带走

Sí 
我希望你去让他付出代价后 
能回到我们这里 
也回到我身边

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:

So we can ruin a second planet like this one 
I think I agree with the sentients jajaja

哎呀，不 
所以我们可以像这个星球一样毁掉第二个星球吗
我想我赞同 sentient 了 jajaja

¿Cómo qué? 
¿Like what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¿Cómo qué? 
比如？

有多少 soldaditos 发过这样的誓言

你会尽力的

That is a promise I can trust 
That is a promise I believe 
Gracias, mi corazón
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这是我可以信任的承诺 
也是我愿意相信的承诺 
Gracias, mi corazón

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Back to work for me 
Again as always 
Never ending... never will
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我又得回去工作了 
一如既往 
没完……没了……

¡¿QUÉ?! 
WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY?! 
WAIT WAIT WAIT WAIT WAIT WAIT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
¡¿QUÉ?! 
你刚才说什么？! 
等一下等一下等一下等一下等一下

¿POR QUÉ? why are creatures from the far future quoting ¿a los PUEBLOS ANTIGUOS?

¿POR QUÉ? 为什么来自遥远未来的生物会引用 ¿a los PUEBLOS ANTIGUOS? 
¿Qué chingados está pasando ahora?

AGGHHHH this makes NO SENSE

THOSE ARE FROM A SACRED TEXT OF LOS PUEBLOS ANTIGUOS 
"¡¿CÓMO Y POR QUÉ!?"

那些是来自 LOS PUEBLOS ANTIGUOS 的神圣经文 
"¡¿CÓMO Y POR QUÉ!?"

I do not drink

她会

但这就是生活的本质

Rats live short lives to people

Trees live short lives to gods
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
小鼠的寿命对人来说很短
人的寿命对树来说很短
树的寿命对神来说很短

And bugs live short lives to rats
It's all relative
And we just go on and on looping don't we jajaja

而虫子的寿命比老鼠短
这都是相对的
我们就这样不断地循环下去，不是吗 jajaja

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I guess we're what Amir calls "edge-cases"
Or whatever
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
我想我们就是阿米尔所说的"边缘案例"
或者其他什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Dejar de hacerme mensa y hacer las cosas, jajaja
I guess I'm just saying
We need to remember to live in the moment

Dejar de hacerme mensa y hacer las cosas，jajaja
我想我只是想说
我们需要记住活在当下

Por supuesto que sí
I guess I'm just saying
We need to remember to live in the moment
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Por supuesto que sí
我想我只是想说
我们需要记住活在当下

That's why I keep rats in the first place
Their lives are short but they never forget to live them
To find joy in every crumb they can
And to return every ounce of love that's paid them
Never know when it'll be gone
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
这就是我养小鼠的原因
它们的生命很短暂，但它们永远不会忘记好好生活
从每一块面包屑中找到快乐
并回报给予它们的每一分爱
永远不知道这些会什么时候消失

Mi corazón 
I have a confession

Mi corazón

I knew you were going to be trouble 
A new impossible problem to add to our growing pile of mierda to deal with

当你来到这里的时候 
我就知道你会是个麻烦 
又一个无法解决的问题，增加到我们已经堆积如山的 mierda 里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Then things went from bad to worse 
From shit to more shit 
As the nightmare grew darker 
And ANYONE with half a brain would have run back to the future
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
然后情况变得越来越糟 
从糟糕到更糟糕 
噩梦变得越来越黑暗 
但凡有点脑子的人都会逃回未来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you didn't 
You stayed for some stupid reason 
You stayed with us and you fought and you helped us put ourselves back together
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但你没有这么做 
你因为一些蠢理由留了下来 
你和我们在一起，并肩作战，帮助我们重新站起来

I still do NOT know why 
You had no reason to stay for strangers

啊，月神，sálvame 
我还是不知道为什么 
你没有理由为了一群陌生人留下来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText: 我见过你们的 Xipe Totec 的脸，如果是我我会逃到最远的角落，祈祷它接下来不会披上我的皮

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
I would have called the Cavia my family and stayed with them instead 
They seem FAR less broken and far more deserving of love
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
如果是我我会称科维兽为我的家人，并和他们待在一起 
他们看起来没那么破碎，也更值得被爱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you DID stay 
And for me... much more than that... 
Which is what I am trying to say, mi corazón
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但你确实留下来了 
而且为了我……你做的远不止这个…… 
这就是我想说的，mi corazón

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you DID stay 
And had the audacity to say you had feelings for me jajaja
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但你确实留下来了 
并且大胆地说你喜欢我 jajaja

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you DID stay 
And for me I find a dear friend I never would have expected 
One I do not know how I survived without
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但你确实留下来了 
而我也找到了一位我从未想到过的挚友 
如果没有你，我不知道自己该如何活下去

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
With you around... we are not fantasmas 
Without you we would be lost and adrift 
We would be sleepwalking through our deaths again and again, meaningless and empty 
At the edge of Mictlán
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
有你在身边……我们不再是 fantasmas 
没有你，我们会迷失方向，飘泊不定 
我们会在死亡中反复梦游 
毫无意义且空洞 
在 Mictlán 的边缘

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you made us into a new family 
Even la bruja y yo jajaja 
And I love them more than I can say 
And it is all thanks to you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但是你让我们成为了一个新的家庭 
甚至是 la bruja y yo jajaja 
我对他们的爱无法用言语表达 
这一切都要感谢你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you showed me why the moments matter most 
The kindness and love we show each other 
That is why we are here 
And it is all thanks to you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但你让我看到为什么这些时刻最重要 
我们彼此展示的善意和爱 
这就是我们存在的理由 
这一切都要感谢你

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
But you showed me why it does not matter 
Because it is the company we keep not our destination 
It is the trust, the love, and the kindness we share 
And it is all thanks to you
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
但你也让我看到为什么这些并不重要 
因为重要的是我们相伴的人，而不是我们的目的地 
这是我们分享的信任、爱和善意 
这一切都要感谢你

I hate all this sappy feely shit 
Drives me crazy 
I'm bad at it 
So I'm going to wrap this up

我讨厌这些煽情的废话 
它让我抓狂 
我不擅长这些
所以我要总结了

I'll still kick your ass

I like having you around

我喜欢有你在身边

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:

我喜欢有你在身边

Te amo, mi corazón 
I love you, my heart
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:

我爱你，我的心肝

I care about you a great deal 
And I rely on you in ways I don't rely on anyone else 
I trust you and that is not something I do lightly
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.zhText:
Me importas mucho 
我很在乎你 
我依赖你的方式，是我对别人从未有过的 
我信任你，而这并不是我能轻易做出的决定

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LettieRomanc.text:
Your friendship is so valuable to me

I trust you and that is not something I do lightly

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: This is long overdue. You'll be fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 这件事早就该做了。你会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: You can do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 你可以的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: POM2_LAB1?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: POM2_LAB1 是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Who is this...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 这是谁……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Where's the Lotus?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: Lotus 在哪？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Oh, no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 噢，不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Drifter. I relent. Roathe, Marie, and Lyon have convinced me that the time has finally come.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 漂泊者。我妥协了。罗瑟、玛丽和里昂说服了我，时机终于到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: I dread what I must do down to the marrow of my bones. Indeed, that may be what is removed from me when I am torn limb from limb in a fit of rage when Gomaitru and her family discover what has been going on beneath their feet this entire time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 我对自己必须要做的事从骨髓深处感到恐惧。确实，当戈迈特鲁和她的家人发现这些年在他们脚底下发生的一切时，他们一定会怒不可遏地将我肢解，连骨髓可能都留不下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: So strange to call her by that name now; but so much between us has changed. And so much more shall, in short order.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 如今再以那个名字称呼她竟然觉如此陌生，我们之间已经发生了太多改变。而更多改变，转瞬即至。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Yes, well. Do kindly please come and ensure that my entrails are not being used as festive decor in the Necralisk, will you? I fear I may need a bit of reassurance, when all is said and done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 是啊，好吧。麻烦你务必过来确认我的内脏没有被当作节日装饰品摆在殁世幽都里，行吗？毕竟事到如今，我还是需要一些安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Drifter. Forgive me for the impropriety of this imposition, I did not wish to contact you using this device. But this is verging on an emergency and I did not know to whom else I could turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 漂泊者。请原谅我冒昧打扰。我本不想通过这个装置联系你。但事态已近紧急，我实在不知道还能向谁求助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: The Lotus and the Operator have other matters to attend to, believe me. They have been taxed well and truly enough to their limits as it is. I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 请相信我，Lotus 和指挥官另有要务在身。他们已被压榨到极限，实在不堪重负。如果不是万不得已，我不会求助于你处理这些事务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: I would not ask you to help me with these matters if I felt I had anywhere else to turn. You are... seemingly the new expert in matters of this kind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 如果不是万不得已，我不会求助于你处理这些事务。你……似乎成了这方面事务的新专家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: You are... seemingly the new expert in matters of this kind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 你……似乎成了这方面事务的新专家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: I do not know how best to describe them. But if you come to the Sanctum, I believe it will be hard to miss them. Two of them have agreed to speak to you here on the POM-2. One may need some further convincing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 我实在不知该如何形容他们。但如果你来到圣所，想必很难不注意到他们。其中两位已经同意通过石榴 2 代跟你交流，另一位或许还需要再劝说一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: I have... faith... you will be successful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 我……坚信……你会成功的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Ah, yes. This is still on default settings. This is Loid. I should have... led with that, but matters here in the Sanctum Anatomica have been deeply chaotic of late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 啊，是的。这装置还是默认设置。我是洛德。我本该……先说明身份的，但解剖圣所这里近来实在是一片混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Which is why I am contacting you. I am in need of your assistance. Three protoframes have arrived here, in the Sanctum, in my time. And not ones previously known to us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 正因如此我才联系你。我需要你的协助。在我所处的这个时代，有三位原型战甲出现在圣所。而且都是我们之前没见过的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: One of them is an
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 其中一位是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: Apologies
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 抱歉

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.text: One of them is Orokin, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LoidDialogue.zhText: 漂泊者，其中一位是奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is something wrong, Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 怎么了，里昂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do think they would adore you, for what it's worth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我确信他们会喜欢你，尽管这或许无关紧要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. That means a lot to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢，这对我意义非凡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon? Can we talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂？我们可以聊聊吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon? I'm very, very sorry if what I said made you uncomfortable. That wasn't my intention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂？如果我说的话让你感到不舒服，我非常非常抱歉。那并非我的本意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm interested in you, Lyon. It's as simple as that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我对你很感兴趣。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know what got into me, Lyon. Clearly this was all a mistake. I'm very sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我不知道自己当时是怎么了。显然这一切都是个错误。我非常抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... meant what I said. But this is all too fast, I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……说的都是真心话。但这一切发生得太快了，我明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I wasn't flirting with you to amuse myself, Lyon. I'm sorry if you think that's what it was about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我跟你调情不是为了取乐。如果你误会了，我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't mean to offend you, I was just teasing. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不是故意冒犯你的，我只是开玩笑。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No promises, Priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 神父，话别说那么死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In the words of a dear friend, "i'm stubborn, m8."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 用我一位挚友的话来说，"伙计，我这个人很固执。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那个时候会来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How're you doing today, Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你今天过得还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How're you feeling today? Marie told me you were laid up with a migraine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你今天感觉怎么样？玛丽告诉我你因为偏头痛卧床休息了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How're you feeling today? Marie told me you were laid up with a megrim.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你今天感觉怎么样？玛丽告诉我你因为偏头风卧床休息了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why's that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She only said you weren't well out of concern for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她只是出于对你的关心才说你身体不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It just came up in passing. She didn't tell me to check on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 只是顺便提了一下。她没叫我来看你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm all right. I was just checking in, I heard you weren't doing well yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我还好。我只是来问候一下，听说你昨天身体不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm fighting a bit of a megrim, personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​自己​也​有点偏头风。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm fighting a bit of a headache, personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​自己​也​有点头痛。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm fighting a bit of a migraine, personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​自己​也​有点​偏头痛。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I just know from personal experience that sometimes the moments we don't want to accept help from others are the precise moments we need that help the most.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​只是​从​自身​的​经验​中学到，​有时候​我们​最​不​想​接受​别人​帮助​的​时候，​恰恰​是​我们​最​需要​帮助​的​时候。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I respect that. I won't pry if you don't want to talk. But I am here to listen if you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我尊重你的意愿。如果你不想说，我不会追问。但如果你想说，我愿意倾听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie believes you are needlessly suffering through this whole situation. I was wondering if I could help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽觉得你完全没必要在这件事上受苦。我想知道我是否能帮上忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie thinks you're trying to carry the burden of all of this alone. I wanted you to know I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽觉得你一个人承担了所有的一切。我想让你知道我一直都在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She seemed to imply that you had theories as to why you get these headaches?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她​似乎​暗示​你​对​自己​头痛​的​原因​有​一些​看法？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're right. I'll go. I just wanted to see how you were, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说得对，我会去躺会儿。我只是想先看看你怎么样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You caught me. I'm just not sure how else to... connect with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 被你看出来了。我只是不知道还能用什么其他方式……靠近你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'll be all right for a little longer. How long have you suffered from these kinds of headaches?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我还能撑一会儿。你这种头痛多久了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not saying this moment is that time. But if that time comes? I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不是说现在就是那个时候。但如果那个时候真的来了呢？我随时都在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What is that supposed to mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If we're being blunt, I honestly cannot stop thinking about you ever since we met.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 坦白说，自从我们相遇以来，我一直都无法停止想念你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Entrati turned you into protoframes and now you're here, no preparation, nothing. If I can help you adapt in any way, I want to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 英择谛把你们变成了原型战甲，现在你们就这么到了这里，没有任何准备，什么都没有。如果你能帮到你们适应，我非常乐意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Well...? I think you're fascinating. I want to get you know you better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那个……？​我​觉得​你​很​有​意思。​我​想​更​了解​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Okay, okay. I'll go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好好，我这就去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Well... I might enjoy that more than you think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯……我可能比你想象的更喜欢那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No promises, Priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 神父，话别说那么死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In the words of a dear friend, "i'm stubborn, m8."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 用我一位挚友的话来说，"伙计，我这个人很固执。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那个时候会来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I feel like I've already started this off wrong, somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我感觉自己好像一开始就做错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is... there another way that you'd prefer?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那……你有更喜欢的方式吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's a pleasure to talk with you here, Lyon - thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，很高兴能在这里和你交谈——谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie is more dangerous than she looks, isn't she?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽比她看起来更危险，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will once again, simply say thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那我再次，对你说声谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did Marie finally convince you I wasn't going to be a threat?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽终于说服你我不会构成威胁了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh! Hello, Lyon. I honestly didn't think you'd be convinced. I'm glad you changed your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦！里昂，你好。说实话，我真没想到你会来找我。很高兴你改变了主意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I've gathered from the others that you have matters we should discuss. Is there anything I can help you with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 从其他人的描述来看，我了解到你有一些事情需要和我讨论。有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is something wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Let him continue.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [让他继续]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is that allowed in your religion? Praying for animals, I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你们的宗教允许这样做吗？我是说，为动物祈祷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You would pray for the soul of a departed alley cat?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你会为死去的流浪猫祈祷吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did you stop feeding Old Devereaux when he came around?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 老德福罗再来的时候，你有停止喂它吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Are you trying to warn me about Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是想警告我关于罗瑟的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Are you the alley cat in this story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你就是故事里的那只流浪猫吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What happened to Old Devereaux, do you know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你知道老德福罗后来怎么样了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What do you think drove Old Devereaux to visit you, if it wasn't need?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你觉得如果不是出于必要，那是什么原因促使老德福罗来找你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did you pray for him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你有为他祷告过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I hope he left this world comfortable and loved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我希望他离开这个世界时是带着安详和爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What would be the non-cynical answer?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有没有一个不带愤世嫉俗的答案？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Does that remain the same if he was only seeking affection?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果他只是想要被爱呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He was an animal. He was just searching for fulfillment - food, shelter, love - he wasn't inspired by the same motivations as people. He wasn't "lying," he was hunting with a different set of tools.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他是一只动物。他只是在寻找满足感——食物、住所、爱——他的动机与人类截然不同。他并非"撒谎"，他只是用不同的工具去狩猎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have seen a lot of violence, Lyon. A lot of it I have caused. I have come to hope that everyone, no matter who they are or what they've done, can have a peaceful death surrounded by those who love them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我见过太多暴力了，其中很多都是我造成的。我现在希望，每个人，无论他们是谁，无论他们做过什么，都能在爱他们的人的陪伴下安详地离世。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He was a cat, Lyon. He hardly knew what he was doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，他只是一只猫，他几乎不知道自己在做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We are still speaking about a cat, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们还在谈论猫，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He wasn't denying others anything by making you all his "fools." If anything... you all seem to have been enriched by his visits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他并没有通过把人当成"傻瓜"来从你们身上夺走什么。如果要说有什么的话……你们似乎都从他的来访中获得更多东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Strong emotions interacting with the Void can cause... serious problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 强烈的情绪与虚空相互作用会造成……严重的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No. Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不会。你继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It depends entirely upon the specifics, I suppose. I have no clue what you are about to ask me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这完全取决于具体情况。我完全不知道你想问我什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I think everything created by the Void is simply... temporary. A fragment of whoever or whatever created it. A ghost of a memory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，我认为虚空所创造的一切都只是……暂时的。是创造它的存在或事物的碎片。是记忆的幽灵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe so, yes. Like a painting made by an artist, it might have come out of someone's mind, but it's real once it's made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信是的。就像艺术家创作的一幅画，它可能源于某人的想象，但一旦创作完成，它就是真实的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That depends entirely upon your definition of "real."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这完全取决于你对"真实"的定义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know. Which lies were your head filled with, Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道。里昂，那么你的脑子里装着哪些谎言？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In this instance, I think Euleria Entrati meant what she wrote to be useful. It simply did not help me when I needed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为欧拉瑞娅·英择谛的本意是希望她写的东西能有用。只是在我需要的时候，它并没有帮到我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In her defense, my Void exposure was far more prolonged than for what she was intending the book be used as a guide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说句公道话，我患虚空暴露症的时间远远超过了她希望这本书能指导的时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Very well, a thought, then. A poem or a song exists even if it isn't written down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那我们换个比喻，比如说像个想法。诗歌或歌曲即使没有被写下来，也依然存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But those were internal forces that the man let work on him, is my point. Not external ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我的意思是，那些都是他自身内在的力量在作用于他，而不是外在的力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How do you measure "realness?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你怎么判断"真实"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: By physical permanence? Weight and mass? What has come from the Void is only temporarily here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是凭物理上的永远存在？凭重量和质量？来自虚空的东西，只是暂时暂存于此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: By its effect on events? What has come from the Void has changed the path of history.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是根据它对历史进程的影响？来自虚空的事物已经改变了历史的进程。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: By its effect on others? Influence from "things" that have come from the Void certainly has done that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是根据它对其他人的影响？来自虚空的"事物"的影响无疑产生了这种影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You aren't asking if they're "real," you're asking if they're "valid." If they should be dismissed or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你不是在问它们是否"真实"，而是在问它们是否"成立"，也就是是否应该被承认或拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would also ask whether or not your Luminaries are "real" simply because you cannot shake the hands of Sol or Lua.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我也想问，既然你们都无法与太阳神或月神握手，那你们的双耀神还是否"真实存在"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're asking, in a roundabout way, if all "things" from the Void are only here because we've willed them into existence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你​是​在​拐弯​抹角​地问，​虚空​中​的​所有​"事物"​是否仅仅​是​因为​我们​用意志力​将​它们​创造​出来​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I suppose? The parts of the Void that I have interacted with tends to already be imprinted upon. We have already given it some kind of shape or form. Or we have blurred the line too far between realities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想也许是吧？我接触过的虚空部分似乎都已被我们烙印。我们已经赋予了它某种形状或形态。或者说，我们已经模糊了现实之间的界限。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe that the challenges we face right now are dangerous. Extremely dangerous. And we should treat them as such.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为我们目前面临的挑战是危险的，极其危险。我们应该以对待危险的态度来对待它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ghosts are real enough to cause us pain. But they can't be treated with a bullet. At least not one that I've found.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 鬼魂的真实存在已经足以给我们带来痛苦了。但它们无法用子弹消灭。至少我还没找到能做到这一点的子弹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What's this all about, Lyon? Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说真的。里昂，你到底想表达什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... honestly don't know, Lyon. And I wish I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说实话，里昂，我真的不知道。我也希望我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Whole structures, indeed Lua itself have been placed into the Void and retrieved. So it does not consume matter by simply existing within it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 整个船体，甚至包括月球本身，都曾被放入虚空并被取回。因此，所以在虚空中，虚空并不会直接吞噬物质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What you're implying is the existence of a "deeper" Void where nothing can exist, and I honestly cannot speak to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是在暗示还有一个"更深的"虚空，在那里任何东西都无法存在。对此我真的无法给出回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Can we skip the preamble, please? Ask me what you want to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们可以跳过铺垫吗？你想知道什么就问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe I know which book you're referencing...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想我知道你指的是哪本书了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For what little good it did. Especially in my case.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 其实并没什么用，尤其对我而言更是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Anything I tell you is only guessing at the "mind" of "the Indifference."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​告诉​你​的​所有​事​都​只​是​对​"虚空​无情​之物"​的​"想法"​的​猜测。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe they are the Void's attempt to... understand the human form.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​觉得​它们​是​虚空……理解人类​形态​的​一​种​尝试。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you mean that literally or metaphorically?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是指字面意思还是象征含义？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No. But I think it gives me a kind of peace to think I can guess at what the Indifference is doing, at the end of the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不。但我认为，想到自己最终能够猜到虚空无情之物在做什么，会让我感到一种平静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I suppose I'm not, at the end of the day. But I've had enough interactions with it, that I feel like I'm justified in trying to figure it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，说到底，我还是不确定。但我接触它很多次了，我觉得我有理由去弄明白它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What else could they be? The Indifference seems to be taking each part of the human body and trying to work out its purpose, one at a time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那还能是什么呢？我认为虚空无情之物似乎正在逐一探究人体各个部位的用途。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not sure the Indifference was real until we made it real. I think we conjured it just the same way I conjured Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我并不确定虚空无情之物是否真实存在，直到我们把它变成现实。我想我们创造它的方式，和我创造双衍王境的方式一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do think the Indifference is a real deity - with a real sentience behind it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我确实认为虚空无情之物是一种真实存在的神灵——它背后有着真正的意识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think the Indifference is trying to learn to be "human." It was always something Bigger. Different. So it's learning how to exist as something Smaller, and Us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为虚空无情之物在试图学习如何成为"人"。它一直以来都是某种更宏大、更独特的存在。所以它正在学习如何以更渺小的形式存在，如何成为我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Sometimes I wonder if the Indifference never really had a body of its own before we interacted with it. So it's learning how to exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有时我会想，在我们与虚空无情之物互动之前，它是否从未真正拥有过自己的实体。所以，它现在正在学习如何存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think the Indifference seems to be taking each part of the human body and trying to work out its purpose, one at a time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为虚空无情之物似乎正在逐一探究人体各个部位的用途。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Sometimes I wonder if the Indifference never really had a body of its own before we interacted with it. So it's learning how to exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有时我会想，在我们与虚空无情之物互动之前，它是否从未真正拥有过自己的实体。所以，它现在正在学习如何存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I didn't mean to infer that, I'm sorry. I do think the Indifference is a real deity - with a real sentience behind it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不。对不起，我并不是那个意思。我依然认为虚空无情之物是一种真实存在的神灵——它背后有着真正的意识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not sure the Indifference was real until we made it real. I think we conjured it just the same way I conjured Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我并不确定虚空无情之物是否真实存在，直到我们把它变成现实。我想我们创造它的方式，和我创造双衍王境的方式一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sorry she told you that. I do think the Indifference is a real deity - with a real sentience behind it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很抱歉她跟你说了那些。我确实认为虚空无情之物是一种真实存在的神灵——它背后有着真正的意识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And pardon me, but aren't you a priest who decides who is "righteous" and who is "damned?" Isn't that a bit hypocritical?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恕我直言，你不是一位决定谁是"义人"谁是"罪人"的神父吗？这难道这样不是有点虚伪吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me. I didn't mean to offend you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请​你​原谅​我，​我​无意​冒​犯​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Regardless, I don't know why it's imitating human parts. I think to figure out what makes us "tick."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不管怎样，我不知道它为什么要模仿人类的器官。我想它是为了弄清楚是什么让我们"运转"起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is a mental image that will linger with me for a while. I will let you decide which one - the lashes, or the Murmur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那个画面大概会在我脑海中停留很久。至于你觉得是哪一样——是那十鞭，还是低语者，就由你来决定吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe it might have something to do with Entrati. And perhaps the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为这可能与英择谛有关，或许也与虚空无情之物有关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, but we did just arrive here due to my making assumptions about the motivations of others, didn't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，但我们来到这里，正是因为我对别人的动机做出了假设，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The other devil being Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 另一个恶魔是罗瑟吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I take it you aren't an ally of Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你不是英择谛的盟友？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She tells this story very differently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她口中的这个故事完全不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She still believes in his good intentions. Do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她仍然相信他的本意是好的。你相信吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She tells me that you see things that others don't, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她告诉我，有时候你能看到别人看不到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie doesn't have all the facts about what Entrati is truly capable of, and all the horrible things he has done in the name of "progress" and now "redemption."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽并不了解英择谛的真实能力，以及他以"进展"和现在的"救赎"之名所犯下的那些可憎行径。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie is a grown woman. While I admire your desire to protect her, she can make her own decisions about what she chooses to believe and in whom she chooses to have faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽是个成年人了。我理解你想保护她的心情，但她有权自己决定相信什么，以及信仰谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Entrati might not have the best beside manner, but he's trying to save the universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 英择谛或许不擅长待人接物，但他正在努力拯救宇宙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did he force you into becoming a protoframe, like Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他​是​不​是​强迫​你​成为​原型​战甲，​就​像​罗瑟​那样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. Why are you upset at Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。你为什么对英择谛感到不满？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I guess I don't particularly care either way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我猜我其实都不太在意吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm just wondering if you're all right, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是想知道你是否一切都好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My only question is, if you are seeing things, do your visions bother you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我唯一的问题是，如果你能看到幻象，这些幻象会让你感到困扰吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What you said the other day - it had me wondering if you're all right, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你​前​几​天​说​的​话​——​让​我​有点​担心​你​是否​一切​都​好。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have to remember how he was raised. The environment he had to learn to survive in. He was - is - Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你要知道他成长的环境，知道那个逼着他学会生存的环境。他过去是——现在仍然是——奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't think he is so terrible, honestly. He is growing on me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说实话，我觉得他没那么糟糕。我越来越喜欢他了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It doesn't make it right, but it might help you learn to meet him halfway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这并不意味着他所做的是对的，但或许能帮助你学会与他妥协。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He's doing what he thinks he has to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他只是在做他认为自己必须做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The devil always has a certain charm about him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恶魔总有一种独特的魅力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Don't worry, I won't be lured in by his charm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 别担心，我不会被他的魅力所迷惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You believed the visions were from Lua? You don't anymore?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你​之前​相信​那些​幻象​来自​月​神？​现在​你​不​这么​相信​了？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What kind of horrors...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 什么样的恐怖……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And what do you think now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那你现在怎么想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can handle myself. I promise I won't let him get into my head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我能保护好自己。我保证不会让他影响我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You seem to be speaking from experience. What answers did he give you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你似乎是过来人。他给了你什么答案？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you want to wait until you trust me more, I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你想等到更信任我之后再说，我能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not going anywhere, Lyon. You can trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我不会离你而去。你可以相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How long was Entrati at the cathedral with you, before Roathe arrived?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在罗瑟来之前，英择谛和你们在大教堂待了多久？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie seems caught up in an obsession with "le Cardinal." And Roathe clearly hates him. I'm looking for a neutral party. You're as close as I can get.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽似乎只偏向"主教"。而罗瑟显然恨透了他。我需要一个中立的第三方。你是我能找到的最接近的人选。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... don't know what else to ask you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……不知道还能问你什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I've been warned that you might not see things the same way we do. But I think you might see truth where others don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有人提醒我，你看待事物的方式可能和我们不一样。但我认为，你或许能看到别人看不到的真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I've been warned that you might not see things the same way we do. But this doesn't bother me. I'm interested in what you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有人提醒我，你对事物的看法可能和我们不一样。但这并不会困扰我。我对你的见解很感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Insincere because you think I don't mean what I say, or insincere because you think I can't mean them about you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你觉得我说的话虚伪是因为你认为我言不由衷，还是因为你认为我说的关于你的事不可能是真心的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Priest, all I wanted was the story of how long Entrati was pretending to be a Cardinal. That's all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 神父，我只想知道英择谛冒充主教的时间有多长。仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What do you mean, "insincere?" Are you calling me a liar?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说的"虚伪"是什么意思？你是在说我撒谎吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How does Marie put up with this...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽是怎么忍受你的……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You think that anyone choosing to socialize with you is performing an act of charity?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你认为选择与你交往的人都是在施舍吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When did he turn you into protoframes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他什么时候把你变成原型战甲的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am having a very hard time imagining Entrati praying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很难想象英择谛祈祷的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So he was... on sabbatical?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以他……是在休假？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Something to dig into another day - I can feel this conversation spiraling out of control.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这个话题以后再说——我感觉这个谈话正在逐渐失控。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What about Marie...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那玛丽呢……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You must think very poorly of yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你一定非常看轻自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why the quotes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为什么要加引号？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It sounds like you don't believe him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 听起来你并不相信他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If any such thing exists? Lyon, what do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果​真有​这​种​东西​存在​的话？​里昂，​你​这​话​是​什么​意思？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think she still worships Entrati a bit too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得她对英择谛的崇拜还是有点过头了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What happened next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 之后发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you regret it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你后悔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And raised double that amount in new ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也带来了更多的疑惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It has, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有解答到，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What can you tell me about the church you and Marie are from, Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你能跟我说说你和玛丽待的教堂的情况吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Could you tell me about your holidays?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你能跟我说说你的节日吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Could you tell me about Sol and Lua?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你能给我讲讲太阳神和月神吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I follow the Luminaries, but I try to keep a balanced path.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我追随双耀神，但我在努力保持平衡的道路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe there's something out there, but I don't think people really can know the answers at the end of the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信一定会有神的存在，但我认为最终人们都不可能真正知道答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not religious. I tend to think religion is a crutch of the fearful - no offense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我没有信仰。我个人认为宗教是恐惧者的拐杖——无意冒犯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not religious. I won't say there couldn't be something out there, but it's just not something I worry about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我没有信仰。我不会说这世上绝对没有宗教，但这并非我所担忧的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not religious. I think all gods - even the Indifference - are a product of our imagination. No offense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我没有信仰。我认为所有的神——甚至包括虚空无情之物——都是我们想象的产物。无意冒犯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm like you, I follow the path of Lua.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我和你一样，也追随月神之道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I follow the path of Sol, like Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 和​玛丽​一样，​我​追随​太​阳神​之道。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm religious. It's sort of a belief that's personal to me - it doesn't really have a name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有信仰。这是一种我个人的信仰——它并没有一个确切的名称。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm religious. You wouldn't recognize any of our practices, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有信仰。不过，你肯定认不出我们的宗教习俗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I'm more curious than anything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，我只是好奇而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm religious. It's similar to yours, though you wouldn't recognize it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有信仰。我的信仰和你的很相似，虽然你可能认不出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's a long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I studied a bunch of different religions, and none of them really suited me. I wound up with sort of a weird collection of humanity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​研究​过​很​多​种​不同​的​宗教，​但​没有​一​种​真正​适合​我。​最终，​我​悟出​了​一​个​有点​怪异​的​人性​集合体。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe what I feel. And I don't need a building or a book to tell me what that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信自己的感觉。我不需要某个建筑或书籍来告诉我那是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It doesn't mean I'm not interested in learning, however.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过这并不代表我不愿意继续学习。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What about in your case?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你的情况又如何呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, that makes so much more sense now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，怪不得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Let him continue.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [让他继续]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Really? Tell me more about the Summer Solstice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真的吗？跟我说说仲夏节吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Tell me more about the Winter Solstice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 跟我说说仲冬节吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Have you ever seen an eclipse yourself?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你亲眼见过日食吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Wait...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 等一下……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That sounds... really familiar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这看起来……非常眼熟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I haven't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have. It wasn't that impressive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我看过。感觉没那么惊艳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have. It was okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我看过。还行吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have. It was amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我看过。非常壮观。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have. It gave me a horrible ocular migraine, believe it or not. But it was amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有看过。说出来你可能不信，它让我得了很严重的眼部偏头痛。但真的很壮观。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have. It gave me a horrible ocular megrim, believe it or not. But it was amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有看过。说出来你可能不信，它让我得了很严重的眼部​偏头风。但真的很壮观。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Does this phrase sound familiar to you: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse - for when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这句话你是否觉得眼熟？"于静寂歧路，追寻日蚀——当日月汇聚，迷途者终将寻得归途。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Whenever you're ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 随时都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I look forward to it. Thanks for taking the time, Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很期待。里昂，谢谢你抽出时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's a very long story. But needless to say, I think some of your scripture is now running around with the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说来话长。但毋庸置疑，我认为你们的一些经文现在已经被虚空无情之物所用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: From some old friends. They were using it as two halves of a spy phrase with their daughter who... never mind, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 从一些老朋友那儿。他们用这句话作为间谍暗语的一部分，和他们的女儿……算了，其实没什么大不了的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It involves the Man in the Wall and it's all very messy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这和墙中人的事有关，而且非常混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Whenever you're ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 随时都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I look forward to it. Thanks for taking the time, Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很期待。里昂，谢谢你抽出时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How is it that you and Marie can reconcile being a priest and a nun, but also... committing acts of violence?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你和玛丽是如何做到既是神父又是修女，同时又……犯下暴力罪行的呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Can I ask you a bit of an odd question, Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我可以问你一个有点奇怪的问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I hear Marie shout "païens!" and rush off into the fight, and... yet I have a hard time thinking her the kind of person to condemn someone for differing beliefs. I can't imagine you must be much different, either. She clearly thinks so highly of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我听到玛丽喊着"païens！"然后冲进打斗中，然而……我很难相信她会是那种因为别人信仰不同而谴责别人的人。我想你也应该和她差不多。她显然很欣赏你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How would your church feel about what you and Marie are here doing? About... what you're being asked to do in their name?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你们教会对你和玛丽在这里所做的事情会有什么看法？对……你们被要求以他们的名义做的事情又会有什么看法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I watch you and Marie on the battlefield, and then I speak to her in private, and I see you quietly reading books... and I suppose I am having a hard time making those individuals line up in my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我见过你和玛丽在战场上的样子，然后我私下和她交谈，看到你安静地读书……我想我很难把你们不同的样子都联系起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I notice you left yourself out of this. How do you feel about all the fighting?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我注意到你把自己排除在外了。你对所有这些争斗有什么看法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That makes sense. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有道理。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I am being pointedly persistent, Priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 神父，我要坚持问这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Fair enough. I'll take what I can get today.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好吧。今天能知道什么就知道什么吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I've known more war than peace in my life, Lyon. If I let it trouble me, I don't think I would still be here. But that isn't to say it doesn't still come with a real burden - a real cost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我这辈子经历过的战争比和平多得多。如果我让战争的阴影笼罩我，我想我可能早就不在人世了。但这并不意味着战争没有带来真正的负担——真正的代价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sure the others have told you who I am. What I am. Where I've come from. The death that follows me - the death I've come from. The death that defines me. Do you think anything you feel will surprise me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信其他人已经告诉过你我是谁，我是什么，我来自哪里，我背负的死亡——来自于我的死亡，定义了我的死亡。难道你觉得你的任何感受会让我感到惊讶吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sorry. I feel I've upset you. That wasn't my intention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对不起，我觉得我让你不高兴了，那不是我的本意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you... care to elaborate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你能详细说明一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I understand. When you're ready, we can talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​理解。​等​你​准备​好​了，​我们​再谈。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你这话是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I - I'm sorry. No, I didn't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……对不起。我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And there is a lot of horror and pain that I have seen that you do not understand either, Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我还看过更多你无法理解的恐怖和痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sorry if you feel I spoke out of turn. But I want to understand. These visions of yours...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你觉得我说话不合时宜，我很抱歉。但我很想知道。你看到的这些异象……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm saying I might be able to sympathize more with what you're experiencing than you think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的意思是，我或许比你想象的更能理解你的感受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm saying I've been through a lot of death and horror, Lyon. So I don't enjoy being spoken down to over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我的意思是，我经历过很多死亡和恐怖。所以我不喜欢别人用居高临下的语气跟我说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What you're describing, Lyon... did that vision start before or after you were a protoframe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你所描述的……这种异象是在你成为原型战甲之前还是之后产生的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Can we talk about this again? Please?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们能再谈谈这件事吗？拜托？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'll do what I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会看看我能做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then, maybe I can help you with that. Can we talk about this again? Please?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那或许我可以帮上忙。我们能再谈谈这件事吗？拜托了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How are you getting along with the Cavia?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你和科维兽相处得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What do you think of Loid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你觉得洛德怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. I'll ask him about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，我会问问他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why do you think he's after something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你觉得他到底想干什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The kid... has their own nonsense they're going through. We can't ask even more of them. It isn't right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那个​孩子……​他​自己​有​一​堆​烦心事​要​处理。​我们​不​能​对​他们​要求​太​多​了。​这​不​公平。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... guess it's because I have "previous experience" with protoframes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我猜……大概是因为我有原型战甲的"使用经验"吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It could have gone far worse, believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 相信我，事情本来可以更糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They're good friends of mine, those protoframes. They've become like family to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那些原型战甲都是我的好朋友，他们就像我的家人一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did I do something wrong, here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我做错什么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Careful, or else I might think you're wondering if the grass isn't a bit greener on the other side of the fence, Priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 神父，小心说话，否则我可能会以为你在想，围墙另一边的草是不是更绿一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You make it sound like it's just a fling, Lyon. Please don't insult me like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你说的好像这只是一段露水情缘似的。请不要这样侮辱我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That really does seem to be the case, everywhere throughout history.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 纵观历史，好像确实是这么回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'd love to know more about your family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很想多了解一下你的家庭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I went through... a lot with them. It tends to bring people together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我和他们一起……经历了很多。这往往会拉近人与人之间的距离。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Confess Feelings.] Honestly, I've been trying to figure out how to bring this topic up with you at some point, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [表白心意] ​说​实话，​我​一直​在​想​该​找​个​时间​和​你​聊聊​这​件​事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Wait. You're getting the wrong idea. I didn't mislead you. Things are just - well, complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 等等。你误会了。不是我误导你。只是事情——嗯，有点复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I figured you weren't interested in me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我以为你对我没兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's all right, Lyon. We'll get there. I'm in no rush, believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没事的，里昂。我们会好起来的。相信我，我不着急。
