/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You resent it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你心生抵触？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'll be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会一直都在的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. Whenever you're ready, Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然可以。里昂，你想什么时候说都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I - we'll try this again another time, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我——我们会改天再聊一次，我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not sure if it's easy for you to wrap your head around, or if this sounds insane to you, but - for me, I... can feel this strongly for more than one person at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不确定你是否能理解，也不知道这样说会不会显得疯狂，但是——对我来说，我……可以同时对不止一个人怀有强烈的感情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have feelings for you. But I also have feelings for them. And for me, both are true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我喜欢你。但我也喜欢其他人。对我来说，这两种感觉都是真实的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I wasn't saying "now," to be fair. Just explaining myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 其实，我当时并不是说"立刻开始"。我只是解释一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So... what you're saying is... there's a chance?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以……你的意思是……我们之间还有希望？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Warning: Brief mention of child abuse. Click here to end. No Chemistry loss with Lyon will be incurred.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [警告：文中简要提及虐童内容。点击此处结束这场对话，你不会因此失去里昂好感度。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I realized I know very little about where you came from, or how you grew up. Would you be willing to tell me anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我发现我对你的出身和成长经历知之甚少。你愿意告诉我一些事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Never mind, then. If you'd rather not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你不想的话，那就算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why would you think it's wasting time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你为什么会觉得这是在浪费时间？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It isn't wasted time to me, Lyon. I would really love to know you better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，对我来说，这并非浪费时间。我真的很想更了解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, if you'd prefer I just go away, please say so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，如果你希望我离开，请直说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're not exactly making this any easier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你这样只会让事情变得更糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sorry for ignoring you earlier...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很抱歉之前没理你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What do you mean...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是什么意思……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'll put you at peace, then - I don't have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那我就让你放心吧——我不喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is it so hard for you to believe I might have feelings for you, Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你难道就这么难以相信我喜欢你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're right, this is all a mistake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说得对，这一切都是个错误。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I just wasn't sure if my advances were welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是不确定你是否能接受我的示好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And you think the visions came from Lua?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而你相信这些异象来自月神？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What did they entail?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它们具体有什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did they scare you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它们吓到你了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Would you prefer I stop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你希望我停下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What did she do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她当时有什么反应？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did she think it was a coincidence, or a sign?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那她有没有觉得这是巧合，还是某种预兆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How old were you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你当时多大？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, Lyon... I am so, so sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，里昂……我真的，为你感到抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That's terrible...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 太糟糕了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She was ignorant. She didn't know any better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她很无知，她什么都不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is that why you...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这就是为什么你会这样……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To hurt a child... It's unforgivable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 伤害​孩子……​这​是​不​可​原谅​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What sent you to the church?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是什么让你走进了教会？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Some people do not deserve to be parents.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有些人不配为人父母。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. It's okay. There's no rush. I'm here, anytime you're ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然可以。没关系。不急。我随时都在，等你准备好了再说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I understand, this has been so much already. Rest, okay? And... thank you. This means a lot to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道，这已经够让人疲惫的了。好好休息，好吗？还有……谢谢你。这对我意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, I was wondering if I could hear the story of how Roathe came to the Cathedral with you and Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我想知道罗瑟是如何来到教堂，和你还有玛丽一起的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, I was wondering if I could hear the rest of the story of how Roathe came to the Cathedral with you and Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我想听听剩下的故事，罗瑟是如何来到教堂，和你还有玛丽一起的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Fair enough, go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好吧，继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The way he tells it, he had every reason to be a bit... feral, when he showed up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 据他自己描述，他出现的时候，完全有理由表现得有点……野性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was right, that story was meant to be about Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我猜对了，那个故事原来是在说罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Because of what you looked like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为你们的外观？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did the Cathedral turn you away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 教堂把你们赶出去了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Where did you stay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你们​住​在​哪儿？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How did you all wind up here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你们是怎么来到这里的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can understand avoiding Roathe, but... They would prefer that over talking to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我能理解他们想避开罗瑟，但是……他们宁愿避开罗瑟也不愿意跟你说话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She is very sweet...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她人很好……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think she still worships Entrati a bit too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得她对英择谛的崇拜还是有点过头了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What happened next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 接下来发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you regret it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你后悔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How long were you all trapped down there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你们被困在下面多久了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So... they kept you all in the basement?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以……他们把你们都关在地下室里了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He reverse-engineered a Helminth?! How long did that take?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他居然逆向工程出了 Helminth？！这花了多长时间？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't think anyone understands it. It's a new discovery.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得没人能理解。这是一项新发现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can understand avoiding Roathe, but... They would prefer that over talking to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我能理解他们想避开罗瑟，但是……他们宁愿避开罗瑟也不愿意跟你说话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She is very sweet...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她人很好……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Convoluted, how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 混乱？怎么会这样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not sure if I should tell you that the Infestation can also talk...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不确定是否应该告诉你，这些 Infestation 还会说话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Not all of the household objects. The chairs can sometimes be... well... never mind, please continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 并非所有家居用品都是如此。椅子有时可能会……嗯……算了，请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will spare you the conversation about the guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 关于吉他的事我就不跟你细说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So I've heard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我听说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: "Him?" Who is "him?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: "他"？"他"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I experienced time for an untold number of centuries as looping spirals, Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我曾体验过无数个世纪的时间，它们如同循环往复的螺旋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How long did it take for you all to get back to... well, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你们花了多久才回到……现在？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What happened next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 接下来发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, wait!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，等等！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is on the verge of being adorable for him, you're right. What happened next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说得对，他那样做真是太可爱了。接下来发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Disable conversations about self-harm. No loss of chemistry with Lyon or any other character will be incurred by doing so.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [​禁用​所有关于​自残​的​对话。​你​不​会​因此​损失​与​里昂​的​好​感度​点数。​]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, I was wondering if I could talk to you about why you - um... well, hurt yourself, if that's all right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，如果可以的话，我想跟你谈谈你为什么——嗯……为什么会伤害自己？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon? Can we talk about something that might be a bit... uncomfortable for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂？我们能聊一些可能让你有点……不舒服的话题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, I was speaking with Marie, about your... habits, and I was wondering if we could talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我和玛丽聊到了你的……习惯，我想问问我们能不能谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's about the fact that you hurt yourself, sometimes. I wanted to be careful in how I broached the subject with you, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是关于你有时会伤害自己的事。我只是想谨慎地跟你提起这个话题而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sorry - on second thought, I can't do this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 抱歉——我想，我不想继续聊下去了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Warning: Discussion of suicide.] I... lost someone to this kind of "habit" once and I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [警告：本文涉及自杀话题] 我……曾经因为这种"习惯"失去了一位亲人，而我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I just want to help you. To make sure you're all right. That's all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是想帮帮你，确保你一切安好。仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I just feel like this isn't healthy - that it's something that should stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我感觉这样不健康——这种事应该停止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know you said you used to hurt yourself before the serum, but... I can't imagine it's made it any better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​知道​你​说​过​在​注射​血清​之前​你​经常​伤害​自己，​但是​……​我​无法​想象​这样​能​让​你​好​受​一些。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: May I ask why you do it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我可以问下你为什么要这样做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm just worried you're going to go too far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是担心你会做得太过火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That makes me feel a little better, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这让我感觉好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm struck by how odd religious practices can be, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 宗教习俗有时真是奇怪，这让我很惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And you're certain you're never going to... take it too far?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你确定你永远不会……做得太过分吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That's the most I could ask for. Thank you, Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这就足够了。里昂，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I trust you. I just wanted to walk through it with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信你。我只是想和你一起经历这个过程。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Sure? What for?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 可以？是什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You don't need to, Lyon. You haven't done anything wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你不需要这么做。你没做错任何事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will always be happy to have you next to me in silence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我永远都愿意让你静静地待在我身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I tend to be the same way, sometimes. It's all right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有时也会这样。没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Apology accepted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 接受你的道歉了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虚空无情之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: "Was" and "also was not" already freed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 既是自由的，又是不自由的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But if you're hearing - or heard - Rell... I want to talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但是，如果能听到——或者听过——Rell 的话……我想谈谈这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Okay. You're in charge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好的，你说了算。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do want to get into that, though...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我确实想深入探讨一下这个问题……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't think I would call anyone who has had to endure what you have "infirm," Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，鉴于你所经历过的一切，我不认为你是"体弱"的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Infirm is a terrible way to say "cursed with visions he didn't ask for." But suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 用"体弱"来形容"被自己不愿看到的异象所诅咒"实在太糟糕了。不过，随你便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You know what you're capable of, so I'll follow your lead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你知道自己的极限，所以我会听你的安排。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Breathe, Lyon. Breathe. They aren't really there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，深呼吸。深呼吸。他们不是真的在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I - I'm sorry, Lyon. Focus on the screen. I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我——里昂，对不起。专心看屏幕。我在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You mean the world to Marie. You've become such a dear friend to me. I think even Roathe would miss you, though he won't admit it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对玛丽来说，你就是全世界。你也成了我非常亲密的朋友。我想即使是罗瑟也会想念你，虽然他不会承认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know this is a horrible burden you've been asked to carry. And maybe it isn't right. But I don't know a way out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道这是你被迫承担的沉重负担。也许这样做是不对的。但我不知道该如何摆脱这种困境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Confess feelings.] It would break my heart if you let that happen to you, Lyon. I... I care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [表白心意] 里昂，如果你让那种事发生在你身上，我会心碎的。我……我很在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You are cherished. You're loved. You have family and friends. Even if it might not feel like that all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你被珍视着，被爱着，拥有家人和朋友。即使有时你可能感觉不到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Not without resorting to... to the unthinkable. Or to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 除非诉诸……难以想象的手段。或者说，就只能那样了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No one's. You don't need to suffer like this anymore. Let it go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没有人。你无需再这样痛苦了。放下吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know. I know it hurts. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. Walk out of the room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​知道。​我​知道​这​很​痛苦。​对​不起。​真的​很​抱歉。​走​出​房间​​吧。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You aren't alone, Lyon. And you would be missed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你不是一个人。大家都在想着你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, Lyon. I mean it. You mean the world to me, and all I wish is that I could somehow make you believe it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，里昂。我是认真的。对我来说，你就是一切，我只希望我能让你相信这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... maybe you're right. Maybe this isn't the right time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……也许你是对的。也许现在还不是时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Turn around, and walk out of the room in your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 转身，在脑海中走出这个房间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you want to stop here? Or can you continue? I understand either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你想停下吗？还是可以继续谈？无论你怎么选择我都可以理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Confess feelings.] Lyon, I... I care about you. I want to be here for you when you have these moments, if you'll let me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [表白心意]里昂，我……我在乎你。如果你愿意，我想在你经历这些时刻的时候陪伴在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's all right. I'm here for you. Are you going to be okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没事的，我会陪着你。你会没事的吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, Lyon. I mean it. You mean the world to me, and all I wish is that I could somehow make you believe it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，里昂。我是认真的。你对我来说就是一切，我只希望我能让你相信这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... maybe you're right. Maybe this isn't the right time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……也许你是对的。也许现在还不是时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: May I interrupt?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我可以打断一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have every reason to vent now and then. I'm glad you feel comfortable talking to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你完全有理由时不时地倾诉一下。我很高兴你觉得跟我说话很自在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's certainly not self-pitying. I would have to look up the other two to see if they hold true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这当然不是自怜。至于另外两件事，我得查一下才能确定它们是否属实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You were talking about the Indifference & Entrati. And how time has become less... linear for you, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你刚才说到了虚空无情之物和英择谛，以及现在对你来说时间是如何变得不再那么……线性的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 算了，不说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Would you like to "go out" with me? I'm not sure what they called in in your time. Courting, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你愿意和我"出去玩"吗？我不太清楚你们那一代人怎么称呼这种行为。大概是求爱吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But how could the Indifference go back to your year? And earlier, to your childhood?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但虚空无情之物怎么可能追溯到你那个年代？甚至更早，追溯到你的童年时代？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh... Oh no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦……哦不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And... did you believe him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那……你相信他吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: This is going to make my head hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看得我头都要炸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But the Indifference wasn't free yet in your time. But was he? In ours?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但在你那个时代，虚空无情之物还没有获得自由。可是，在我们的时间线里，他获得自由了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Sure. We'll have plenty of time later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 确实。我们以后有的是时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I could think of a better way to spend our time together...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想我们还有更好的相处方式……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The other day, you were asking me about conceptual embodiment, and about the Indifference. Is something bothering you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 前几天你问我关于概念成形和虚空无情之物的问题。是不是有什么问题困扰你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You mentioned earlier you wanted to talk about the fact I don't really believe the Indifference is a "real god." Is now a good time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你之前提到过你想谈谈我不认为"虚空无情之物"是"真正的神"这件事。现在合适吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, what's going on between you and Roathe? I've only gleaned bits and pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你和罗瑟之间到底发生了什么？我只听到了一些零星的消息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Roathe is convinced that the Man in the Wall isn't a real god. That he's the product of "conceptual embodiment." What do you think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 罗瑟坚信墙中人并非真正的神，而是"概念成形"的产物。你怎么看？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Warning: Discussion of self-harm and child abuse. Click here to end. No loss of Chemistry with Lyon will be incurred.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [警告：这段对话会提及虐童内容。点击此处结束此轮对话。你不会因此失去里昂好感度。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Let him continue.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [让他继续]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No. I'm not doing this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，我现在不想听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Does it taste the same?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 味道是一样的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Are you drunk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你喝醉了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What is so terrible that you have to get drunk to tell me about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 到底是什么可怕的事情，让你非得喝醉了才能跟我说出来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm ready when you are...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我准备好了，你可以随时开始……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That would do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那样就够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Void, I didn't even realize...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虚空啊，我竟然都没意识到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh no -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，不——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He... he's at rest, now, Lyon... he's at peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他……他已经死了，里昂……他已经安息了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，里昂……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Rell was the strongest of us all. I'm glad you had any chance at all to know him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Rell 是我们所有人中最坚强的。我很高兴你曾有机会认识他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Rell was cast out because of ignorance and the cruelty of children... he didn't deserve what happened to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Rell 因为孩子们的无知和残忍而被排斥……他不应该遭受这样的对待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I've heard it's incredibly painful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我听说这非常痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can't possibly imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我简直无法想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Warning: Brief mentions of self-harm and child abuse. Click here to end. No loss of Chemistry with Lyon will be incurred.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [警告：这段对话会短暂提及虐童内容。点击此处结束此轮对话。你不会因此失去里昂好感度。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I had a similar figurine, growing up. It was one of my favorite toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我小时候也有一个类似的玩偶，那是我最喜欢的玩具之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Rell?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Rell？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thrax is a complicated topic. I'd rather not get into it here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 士魂大帝是一个复杂的话题，我不想在这里深入探讨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It wasn't his fault, really. He was just who I needed him to be in that moment in time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 其实这不是他的错。在那一刻，他正是我需要的那种人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It's okay. He's progressing. Slowly. Somehow. The seemingly impossible can change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没关系。他在变好。虽然很慢。但总算有点进展。看似不可能的事情也能改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Entrati's daughter is upstairs. She studied and worked beside him. She might be able to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 英择谛的女儿在楼上。她曾和他一起学习和工作。她或许能帮上忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What little I know of the Infestation and how it works, it seems to be kind of... maybe... I don't know, outside time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 关于 Infestation 及其运作方式，我所了解的的信息很少，似乎有点……也许……我不知道，跟外面的时间有关？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There's a... guitar... it's all very hard to explain, and we've both traveled through time via Helminth...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有一把……吉他……这一切都很难解释，我们俩都通过 Helminth 穿越了时空……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I hate to see you like this, caught in the middle of everyone's nonsense. You didn't deserve this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很不忍心看到你这样，被卷入这些荒唐事之中。你不应该承受这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The Indifference was made by us - he isn't a god, Lyon. Don't let Entrati's mistake destroy you. As for your faith?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，虚空无情之物是我们造成的——他不是神。别让英择谛的错误毁了你。至于你的信仰？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I personally don't believe there are gods in this world, I know how important that has been to you in your life. I don't want to belittle that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我个人不相信世上有神，但我知道这对你的人生有多么重要。我不想轻视这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know if there are gods or not, Lyon - I don't think any of us can ever truly know. But what I do know, is that you've been through a great deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我不知道世上有没有神——我觉得我们永远也无法真正知道。但我知道的是，你经历了很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You spent your life in dedication to our Luminaries, Lyon. Do you think they would turn away from you for something like this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你一生都奉献给了我们的双耀神。你认为他们会因为这种事而疏远你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, Lyon... you've been through so much. Doubt isn't the result of weakness - doubt is the result of pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，里昂……你经历了太多。怀疑不是软弱的表现，而是痛苦的产物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Faith doesn't need to be constant - nor is it expected to be. How many tales are told of those who lose their faith, only to find it again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 信仰不必一成不变，也不应该如此。不是还有很多故事是关于人们失去信仰，最终又重新找回信仰吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not saying you need to find your faith again. I'm saying if you want to - if you feel you need to - it's not something that's forever lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不是说你需要重新找回你的信仰。我的意思是，如果你想——如果你觉得你需要——信仰并不是永远失去的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Surely, Lua can see what you've been put through. What you've endured in her name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 月神肯定能看到你所经历的一切，你为了她所承受的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What I think is that you need to focus on is finding some kind of peace within yourself - however it is you need to find it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为你需要专注于在内心深处找到某种平静——无论以何种方式，你都需要找到它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If there is a god, if your Lua does exist - surely she can see what you've been through. What you've endured in her name. It must mean something to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果真有神，如果你的月神真的存在——她肯定能看到你所经历的一切，你为了她所承受的一切。这对她来说一定意义非凡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think you need to let go of any notion of whether or not there are gods, and focus on healing yourself, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为你应该放下任何对神是否存在的想法，先专注于治愈自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Really? Never?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真的吗？从来没有？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yeah... I can see that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的……我能看得出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sorry, determined?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不好意思，听过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When did you... stop hearing him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是什么时候……开始听不到他的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm just - I'm just so sorry for what both of you have had to go through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是——我只是对你们俩所经历的一切感到非常抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm just... so glad Rell and Harrow could be there with you, Lyon... even if it was in memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我只是……很高兴 Rell 和 Harrow 能和你在一起……即使只是在回忆里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know as the two have to be mutually exclusive, but... I don't know. I don't know as we ever will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道，因为这两者必定是互斥的，但是……我不知道。我不知道我们是否永远都会知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Could you consider the possibility that... maybe this is all the work of Lua? To comfort you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你​能​不​能​考虑​一下​这​种​可能​性……​也​许​这​一切​都​是​月​神​所​为？​为了​安慰​你？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Could you consider the possibility that... maybe this is all the work of a god or gods? To comfort you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你能不能考虑一下这种可能性……也许这一切都是一个神或多个神所为？为了安慰你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm just... so glad Rell and Harrow could be there with you, Lyon... even if it was in memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我只是……很高兴 Rell 和 Harrow 能和你在一起……即使只是在回忆里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 什么要求？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She told you all that, did she?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她把一切都告诉你了，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not exactly proud of a few of the things I said, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我对自己说过的某些话并不怎么自豪，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What did she tell you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她跟你说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: ... And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ……然后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am. I think have her help in mending things between Loid and the family upstairs. And that's... Huge, Lyon. I don't think I can explain how huge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 满意。我觉得让她帮忙修复洛德和楼上家族之间的关系。这……意义重大，里昂。我简直无法形容它有多重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No - Honestly, the way things have been left between us, I've ruined any chance I have of having her help mend things between Loid and the family upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不——说实话，就我们之间目前的情况来看，我已经彻底断送了让她帮忙修复洛德和楼上那家人之间关系的任何机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm happy with where I left things. I'm on her side about Entrati, honestly, the more that I've thought about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我对事情目前的进展很满意。说实话，我越想越觉得，在英择谛这件事上，我是站在她这边的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We didn't see eye-to-eye on Entrati. I failed in convincing her and... I just wish I could have done better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们在英择谛这件事上意见并不一致。我没能说服她……我真希望我当时能做得更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We "agreed to disagree" on Entrati, and I think that's about as good as we're ever going to get on the subject. I don't think any more talk is going to help matters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们在英择谛的问题上"求同存异"，我想这大概就是我们在这个问题上能达成的最好结果了。我觉得再多讨论也于事无补。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No - Honestly, the way things have been left between us, I've ruined any chance I have of having her help mend things between Loid and the family upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不——说实话，就我们之间目前的情况来看，我已经彻底断送了让她帮忙修复洛德和楼上那家人之间关系的任何机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am. She won't help me mend Loid and the family upstairs, and that's fine with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 满意。她不会帮我修复洛德和楼上家族的关系，我倒觉得这样也无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am. I'm glad she saw that Entrati may not be purely "good," and... well, he's not purely "evil" either, is he?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 满意。我很高兴她意识到英择谛可能并非完全"善良"，而且……嗯，他也不是完全"邪恶"，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Honestly, it's fine. I don't think it's going to get any better or worse at this point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 老实说，还好。我觉得现在情况不会再好转也不会再恶化了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't think you'd offer to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我没想到你会主动提出帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Does this mean you'll help me convince Loid to go upstairs and talk to them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你的意思是你会帮我劝洛德上楼去和他们谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There's so much loneliness in this world, Lyon. So much sadness. Why not end some of it when we can?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，这世上有太多孤独，太多悲伤。为什么我们不能在力所能及的时候，终结其中的一些呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not sure, it's an instinct - a gut feeling. I feel like you three were brought here by Entrati this moment for a reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不确定，这只是一种直觉——一种预感。我觉得你们三个在这个时候被英择谛带到这里是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It will hurt at first, for sure. Like setting a broken bone. But it's the only way something like this can heal properly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一开始肯定会很疼，就像接骨一样。但这却是让这种伤势彻底痊愈的唯一方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think what we all stand to gain by being together is greater than what we stand to lose by being apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为我们团结在一起所获得的益处大于我们分离的坏处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, but I am in the business of protecting people who need it. And I can't guard them, and this place, from the Murmur and the Infestation forever. But you two - and maybe even Roathe - can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，但我肩负着保护需要帮助的人的使命。我无法永远守护他们，守护这片土地，免受低语者和 Infestation 侵袭。但你们两个——或许还有罗瑟——可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't trust him, necessarily - but I still don't think he's our enemy. I feel like a war is coming, and we're all being placed on the board where we need to be. And this is where we belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我并不完全信任他——但我仍然认为他不是我们的敌人。我感觉一场战争即将到来，而我们每个人都被安排到了我们应该在的位置上。而这里就是我们应该待的位置。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yeah...
Why is Roathe even that important to this whole thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为什么罗瑟在这件事中这么重要？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Wait... you'll... convince her to help with the Entrati family for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 等等……你……要说服她在英择谛家族这件事上帮我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I. You. You will?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我。你。你真的会吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: More for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那样就便宜我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: None taken. I know he's not for everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没事。我知道不是每个人都喜欢他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How're you doing today, Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你今天过得还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Confess feelings.] Lyon? I was wondering if we could talk about something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [表白心意] 里昂？我在想我们能不能谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Never mind. Sorry. Forgot what I was going to say, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 算了。抱歉。其实我忘了要说什么了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know how to phrase it best, so I'm going to come right out and say it - I have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道该怎么说才好，所以直说吧——我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're making me nervous. What's wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你让我很紧张。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I'm here. Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 明白，我在听。请说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't know how you'd feel, since...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道你会作何感想，毕竟……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm kind of... in awe of her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我对她……心怀敬畏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is this a conversation where you threaten me? Or?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是在威胁我吗？还是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. I've asked you plenty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然可以。我问过你不少呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why am I dating Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我为什么会和罗瑟约会？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why is it so hard to believe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为什么这么难相信？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm sure, Lyon. I'm not concussed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我确定。我没有脑震荡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我在听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're not making much sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说的完全不合逻辑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Dire consequences of... what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 可怕后果……是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To put it bluntly? Have you seen him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 直白点说？你见过他吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think there's a pain in him, somewhere beneath all the... humor and personality.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得他内心深处藏着某种痛苦，深藏在那些幽默与个性之下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... can't help it. There's a darkness and a danger in him that I find alluring. It draws me in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……情不自禁。他身上那股黑暗与危险的气质，对我有着莫大的吸引力。让我无法自拔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon? I have feelings for you. I care about you. I'd like to be with you, if you'd like to be with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂？我喜欢你。我在乎你。如果愿意，我想和你在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you're saying it's not mutual...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你说那不是两情相悦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm just happy to be there for him, in any way that I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是很高兴能在他身边，尽我所能地支持他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What happened to him is... complicated. I think he'll be sorting through it for a long while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他遭遇的事情……很复杂。我想他得花很长时间才能理清头绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He'll forgive himself in time. But I don't think the outer shell will ever really change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 终有一日他会原谅自己。但那层外壳，恐怕永远不会真正改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Exactly. He did it to win the war - and sometimes that means losing a few battles.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没错。他这么做是为了赢得战争——有时这意味着要输掉几场战役。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, Lyon... you aren't a burden to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，里昂……你对我来说，从来都不是负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Are you... saying you want to end things between us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你……是说想结束我们之间的关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Your pain... echoes a kind of my own. It'd never be a hardship to help you through it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你的痛苦……与我内心某种痛楚相呼应。帮助你度过难关，对我而言永远不是负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can't describe what draws me to you. But you will never be a duty or a burden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我无法形容你对我的吸引力。但你永远不会成为责任或负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Break up.] This is all just becoming too much for me, I'm sorry. It might be best to end things here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [分手] 这一切对我而言已不堪重负，抱歉。或许到此为止才是最好的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For a guy who started off silent, you really did get wordy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一个刚开始沉默寡言的人，现在倒真是能说会道起来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I find them endearing, don't worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 别担心，我觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You could've just said "I'll be fine, you know, if we ever go our separate ways."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你完全可以直接说："如果我们真的分道扬镳，我也会过得很好。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can understand why you felt the need for the preamble, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 现在我明白你为什么觉得需要这个铺垫了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know what to say...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道该说什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Break up.] I - I can't. I can't promise that, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [分手] 我——我做不到。我无法许下这个承诺，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I vow it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How are you and Roathe getting along, lately?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你和罗瑟最近相处得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're making me nervous. What's wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你让我很紧张。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I'm here. Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 明白，我在听。请说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我在听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You're not making much sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说的完全不合逻辑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Dire consequences of... what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 可怕后果……是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, Lyon... you aren't a burden to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，里昂……你对我来说，从来都不是负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Are you... saying you want to end things between us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你……是说想结束我们之间的关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Your pain... echoes a kind of my own. It'd never be a hardship to help you through it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你的痛苦……与我内心某种痛楚相呼应。帮助你度过难关，对我而言永远不是负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can't describe what draws me to you. But you will never be a duty or a burden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我无法形容你对我的吸引力。但你永远不会成为责任或负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Break up.] This is all just becoming too much for me, I'm sorry. It might be best to end things here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [分手] 这一切对我而言已不堪重负，抱歉。或许到此为止才是最好的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For a guy who started off silent, you really did get wordy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一个刚开始沉默寡言的人，现在倒真是能说会道起来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I find them endearing, don't worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 别担心，我觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You could've just said "I'll be fine, you know, if we ever go our separate ways."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你完全可以直接说："如果我们真的分道扬镳，我也会过得很好。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can understand why you felt the need for the preamble, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 现在我明白你为什么觉得需要这个铺垫了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know what to say...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道该说什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Break up.] I - I can't. I can't promise that, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [分手] 我——我做不到。我无法许下这个承诺，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I vow it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I hate to see you like this, caught in the middle of everyone's nonsense. You didn't deserve this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很不忍心看到你这样，被卷入这些荒唐事之中。你不应该承受这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The Indifference was made by us - he isn't a god, Lyon. Don't let Entrati's mistake destroy you. As for your faith?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，虚空无情之物是我们造成的——他不是神。别让英择谛的错误毁了你。至于你的信仰？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I personally don't believe there are gods in this world, I know how important that has been to you in your life. I don't want to belittle that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我个人不相信世上有神，但我知道这对你的人生有多么重要。我不想轻视这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I don't know if there are gods or not, Lyon - I don't think of us can ever truly know. But what I do know, is that you've been through a great deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，我不知道世上有没有神——我觉得我们永远也无法真正知道。但我知道的是，你经历了很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You spent your life in dedication to our Luminaries, Lyon. Do you think they would turn away from you for something like this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，你一生都奉献给了我们的双耀神。你认为他们会因为这种事而疏远你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, Lyon... you've been through so much. Doubt isn't the result of weakness - doubt is the result of pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，里昂……你经历了太多。怀疑不是软弱的表现，而是痛苦的产物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Faith doesn't need to be constant - nor is it expected to be. How many tales are told of those who lose their faith, only to find it again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 信仰不必一成不变，也不应该如此。不是还有很多故事是关于人们失去信仰，最终又重新找回信仰吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not saying you need to find your faith again. I'm saying if you want to - if you feel you need to - it's not something that's forever lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不是说你需要重新找回你的信仰。我的意思是，如果你想——如果你觉得你需要——信仰并不是永远失去的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Surely, Lua can see what you've been put through. What you've endured in her name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 月神肯定能看到你所经历的一切，你为了她所承受的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What I think is that you need to focus on is finding some kind of peace within yourself - however it is you need to find it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为你需要专注于在内心深处找到某种平静——无论以何种方式，你都需要找到它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If there is a god, if your Lua does exist - surely she can see what you've been through. What you've endured in her name. It must mean something to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果真有神，如果你的月神真的存在——她肯定能看到你所经历的一切，你为了她所承受的一切。这对她来说一定意义非凡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think you need to let go of any notion of whether or not there are gods, and focus on healing yourself, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为你应该放下任何对神是否存在的想法，先专注于治愈自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Trust me... I know how dangerous apathy can be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 相信我……我知道麻木有多危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Does this mean you've found your faith again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是否意味着你重新找回了信仰？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Does this mean you've given up on your faith?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是否意味着你已经放弃了信仰？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you agree with Roathe and me about the Man in the Wall not being a real god?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是不是认同罗瑟和我的观点，认为墙中人并非真正的神？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you side with Roathe in thinking the Indifference is a real god or not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是不是也认同罗瑟的观点，认为虚空无情之物是真正的神，或根本不是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Where do you think the Indifference falls in this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你认为虚空无情之物在这里算什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think it changes a great deal. If it isn't a real god - it's made by people. That means it can be defeated by people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为这会带来很大的改变。如果它不是真正的神——它是人创造的。这意味着它也可以被人打败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I didn't think it was hopeless - that's not what I meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，我并不认为毫无希望——我不是那个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What I meant was, this changes how we can think about killing it. Understanding it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的意思是，这改变了我们如何消灭它，如何理解它的思考方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: This shouldn't be possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这种情况本来不该发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Please don't start. I don't need the guilt from the priest, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 别再说了。我可受不了神父的谴责，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I actually think if one of my friend's rats were asleep on the keys and generated random words, I would have done better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 其实我觉得，如果我朋友的老鼠睡在键盘上乱按键盘，敲出来的文字都比这个强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you? Yes, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢？愿意，请帮帮我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Um... no. I'd rather do it on my own, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯……不。还是我自己来吧，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She misunderstood what I was saying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她误会了我的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... said things I shouldn't. I just wish I could have done better by her. I think I did a poor job of portraying my intentions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……说了些不该说的话。真希望我能对她做得更好一些。我觉得我没能很好地表达我的意图。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You will?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你居然会？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Things between him and me have been... complicated and confusing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我和他之间的关系一直……很复杂，也很混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Please don't get me started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 别再提这个了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Um... no. I'd rather do it on my own, thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯……不。还是我自己来吧，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you? Yes, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢？好的，请帮帮我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lyon, I need your help with Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 里昂，在罗瑟的事情上我需要你的帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I told him I was only with him for casual companionship, and even though he didn't seem to have a problem with it, now I feel like we've regressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我告诉他我只是想和他保持普通朋友的关系，虽然他似乎并不介意，但现在我觉得我们的关系倒退了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He told me not to go any farther into his memories. So I haven't. And now we seem... stuck?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他告诉我不要再深入探究他的记忆。所以我没再问。现在我们似乎……卡在这里了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I'm not sure. I think I said something I shouldn't have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不确定。我觉得我说了些不该说的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Roathe has been facing down the truth of his... well... taking the serum. And I don't know how, but I think I did a poor job of helping him through it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 罗瑟一直在努力接受他……嗯……自愿注射血清的事实。我不知道为什么，但我感觉我没能很好地帮助他度过这一关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't know he said I'd apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道他说了我会道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't know what else to do. I know it's ridiculous in hindsight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我当时不知道该怎么办。现在回想起来，我知道这很荒谬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh. Well, this was a massive waste of time then, wasn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，那岂不是白费力气了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I guess I... will simply say I am sorry, then. For not listening to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那我……就简单地说声对不起吧。对不起，我没有听你的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is, Lyon. I care about you. Immensely. And I know I misstepped with you badly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很可怕，里昂。我非常在乎你。我知道我之前对你做错了很严重的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was afraid of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我当时很害怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't think I was strong enough to take it on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我当时觉得自己不够强大，无法承担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't care at the time. But I do, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当时我并不在意。但现在我在意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I am so very, very sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我真的非常非常抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I didn't know what else to do but to turn to Roathe for help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我别无选择，只能向罗瑟寻求帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I changed my mind about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我改变对你的看法了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I feel there is progress that might be blocked behind hearing your stories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得，在听了你们的故事之后，可能会有点阻碍到我们的发展。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I wish, if I may, to discuss something briefly that I think would put both of our minds at ease, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果可以的话，我希望能简短聊一些事，相信这样我们俩都会安心些，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, nothing is the matter. I simply wished to say that I know you spend time with another in an... amorous way, when you are not with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，没什么。我只是想说，我知道当你不在我身边时，你会以……亲密的方式与他人相处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I simply wished to assure you that this does not give me pause nor unease. Your presence in my life has brought me nothing but peace, nothing but joy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而我只想向你保证，这丝毫不会让我犹豫或不安。你出现在我的生命里，带给我的只有平静和快乐……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And how could I ever deny that kind of gift to be bestowed upon another?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我又怎么能拒绝将这般馈赠赐予他人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The thought of it makes me smile. And who knows, perhaps in another life, or another day, we may meet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 想到这里我不就忍不住微笑。谁知道呢，或许在另一世，或某一天，我们终将相遇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As we are - as I am, with all you have brought me, all that we represent... I am content. Nay, I am... happy. For the first time in a very, very long time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们现在的样子——我现在的样子，带着你给予我的所有，带着我们所代表的一切……我很满足。不，是……幸福。这是我很久以来头一回有这样的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But in this one, I am content as we are. Nay, I am... happy. For the first time in a very, very long time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但此刻，我心怀满足。不，是……幸福。这是我很久以来头一回有这样的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I have you to thank for it. For now, however, I bid you farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这一切都要感谢你。不过现在，我要跟你说再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What would you care to discuss, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，你想聊些什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I suppose then, I am simply left wondering, if you were not being flirtatious with me in order to make me uncomfortable for your own amusement... why were you being flirtatious in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，我不免要问一句，如果你不是为了好玩而故意和我调情让我感到不舒服……那你当初为什么要和我调情呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Your flirtatious commentary for your own amusement? Or would you like to move on to other topics?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你这些轻佻的话只是为了自娱自乐吗？还是你想换个话题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And it is not mutual. It is as simple as that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我对你并没有。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... Forgive me, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……漂泊者，请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And pardon my bluntness once more when I express all that has come to overwhelm my mind as of late:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请原谅我再次唐突，我想表达一下最近一直萦绕在我心头的各种事情：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am surrounded now by strangers and talking beasts in a world of fantastical madness and seemingly endless and rampant slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我现在身处一个充满奇幻疯狂和看似无休止的肆意杀戮的世界，周围都是陌生人和会说话的野兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All that I have known has been swept away by glowing beams of "Jade Light" and "the Orokin Empire" and "the Void" and is threatened by "the Murmur."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的一切认知都被"翠玉之光"的耀眼光束、"奥罗金帝国"和"虚空"席卷而去，并受到"低语者"的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So, you will have to excuse me if I find this... offer of attraction from you oddly laughable in its naïveté. I neither know you nor trust you. Indeed, all I have to go on is the word of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以，如果我觉得你这番喜欢我的提议天真得有些可笑，还请你见谅。我既不认识你，也不信任你。事实上，我所能相信的，只是别人的一面之词。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The word of others whom I also neither know nor trust as of yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那些我既不认识也不信任的人的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All this, meanwhile, is only the outward forces that are heaped up before Marie and I - let alone all the rest I contend with that you cannot see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所有这些都压在玛丽和我的身上，更别提那些看不见的挑战了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I appreciate your forwardness. I know what you are attempting, and I commend you for it. And I hope, that should the time come that I... rethink your offer? That it still stands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很感谢你的坦白。我知道你的好意，并为此感谢你。我希望，如果将来我重新考虑你的提议，你仍然愿意回应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. None were expected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也​是。​世事本​就​无常。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... well... then...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……嗯……那么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We shall see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们拭目以待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see, that must be this era's word for my severe headaches. Yes, I was. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我明白了，那一定是现在人们用来形容我剧烈头痛的说法。是的，我之前确实很痛。今天感觉好多了，谢谢你的关心。不过，玛丽把我的事告诉你，我有点不太能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ah. Yes. I was. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 啊，是的，我有。今天感觉好多了，谢谢关心。不过，玛丽把我的事告诉你，我有点不太能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am doing well, thank you kindly for asking. How are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很好，谢谢你的关心。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It will likely come as no surprise to you that I prefer my business to remain private.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我更倾向于将我的私事保密，这一点你大概也不会感到意外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. Marie would cure the world with all the rays of Sol if she could. But it will likely come as no surprise to you that I prefer my business to remain private.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。如果可以，玛丽会用太阳神的所有光芒治愈全世界。不过，我更喜欢我的私事保密，这一点你大概也不会感到意外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ah. I see. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 啊，原来如此。我今天感觉好多了，谢谢关心。不过，玛丽把我的事告诉你，我有点不太能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I suffer from those as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我也有同样的症状。我实在无法想象盯着这玩意儿发光会有什么帮助。你应该去躺一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I imagine that is this era's word for the severe headaches I suffer from as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想这就是现在人们对我这种剧烈头痛的称呼吧。我实在无法想象盯着这玩意儿发光会有什么帮助。你应该去躺一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. I suffer from those as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。我也有同样的症状。我实在无法想象盯着这玩意儿发光会有什么帮助。你应该去躺一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You will have to pardon me, Drifter, when I say this:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，恕我直言：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And such theories are, unfortunately, now cast quite firmly into "the Void."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 可惜的是，这些看法现在已被彻底抛入"虚空"之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I appreciate your willingness to admit to a lie so readily. And I appreciate the fact that I am not... the most affable creature with which you engage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很欣赏你如此轻易地承认谎言。我也很感激你明白，在你所接触的人当中，我并不是……容易相处的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is a personal matter, Drifter. I appreciate your attempt at conversing with me. And I appreciate the fact that I am not... the most affable creature with which you engage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，这是私事。我很感激你尝试和我交谈。我也明白，在你所接触的人当中，我并不是……容易相处的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am surrounded now by strangers and talking beasts in a world of fantastical madness and seemingly endless and rampant slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我现在身处一个充满奇幻疯狂和看似无休止的肆意杀戮的世界，周围都是陌生人和会说话的野兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you can "see," I am quite recovered. And now you must worry about yourself. Now go find a dark place to recover.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如​你​所​"见"，​我​已经​完全​康复​了。​现在​你​该​担心​你​自己​了。​赶紧​找​个​暗点​的​地方​好​好​休息​吧。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: May I be blunt and ask as to why you are attempting to socialize with me at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我可以直截了当地问你，你为什么要试图和我往来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All that I have known has been swept away by glowing beams of "Jade Light" and "the Orokin Empire" and "the Void" and is threatened by "the Murmur."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的一切认知都被"翠玉之光"的耀眼光束、"奥罗金帝国"和"虚空"席卷而去，并受到"低语者"的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Begone, Drifter. Before I find you and force you to rest. And none of us will enjoy that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，​去​吧。​别逼​我​亲自抓​你​去​休息。​到时候​我们​谁​都​不​会​开心。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So, you will have to excuse me if I find this... offer of kinship from you oddly laughable in its naïveté. I neither know you nor trust you. Indeed, all I have to go on is the word of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以，如果我觉得你这番亲近的提议天真得有些可笑，还请你见谅。我既不认识你，也不信任你。事实上，我所能相信的，只是别人的一面之词。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The word of others whom I also neither know nor trust as of yet. All of this is heaped upon us, never mind the burdens you cannot see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那些我既不认识也不信任的人的话。所有这些都压在我们身上，更别提那些看不见的重担了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Good. Be well, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很好。漂泊者，祝你一切安好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So, I appreciate your affability and apologize for the lack of mine own. I know what you are attempting, and I commend you for it. And I hope, that should the time come that I am in need of your aid, the offer still stands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以，我很感谢你的亲切，也为自己缺乏这种态度而道歉。我知道你的好意，并为此感谢你。我希望，如果将来我需要你的帮助，你仍然愿意伸出援手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. None were expected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也​是。​世事本​就​无常。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... well... then...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……嗯……那么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We shall see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们拭目以待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Greetings, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，你好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It has come to my attention that you wish to speak to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我听说你想和我谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps, in time. But we have only just begun our discourse. I have merely come here to... tell you I have succumbed to Marie's insistence that you can be trusted in so far as conversation is involved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许以后再说吧。我们才刚刚开始交谈而已。我来这里只是想告诉你，我屈服于玛丽的坚持，她说在谈话方面你是值得信任的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What a nearly comically insufficient question that I will not even attempt to answer, as we have only just begun our discourse. I have merely come here to... tell you that I have succumbed to Marie's insistence that you can be trusted in so far as conversation is involved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这个问题未免太荒谬了，我甚至懒得回答，我们才刚刚开始交谈而已。我来这里只是想告诉你，我屈服于玛丽的坚持，她说在谈话方面你是值得信任的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And seeing as we are now partnered in this endeavor that Roathe is "hell" bent upon pursuing? It seems only prudent that we become properly acquainted. This seems to be the means by which you prefer to do so. Therefore, here I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 既然我们现在共同参与了罗瑟"铁了心"要推进的这件事，那么我们最好还是互相认识一下。看来你也更喜欢这种方式。所以，我来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And seeing as we may or may not forever be partnered in this endeavor that Roathe is "hell" bent upon pursuing? It seems only prudent that we become properly acquainted. This seems to be the means by which you prefer to do so. Therefore, here I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 鉴于我们可能要永远参与罗瑟"铁了心"要推进的这件事，那么我们最好还是互相认识一下。看来你也更喜欢这种方式。所以，我来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No. You have not. I simply am likely not the kind of individual with which you are accustomed to conversing. For that, you have been blessed thus far, though lunatics of my calibre are rare finds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，你没有。只是我可能不是你习惯与之交谈的那种人而已。就这一点而言，你至今为止已经很幸运了，毕竟像我这样的疯子实属罕见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No. This is acceptable. Indeed, it allows me the time to fashion my thoughts the way I would like. I can see why this device holds appeal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，这样很好。事实上，这样给了我时间按照自己的想法整理思路。我能理解为什么这种设备会让人着迷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I digress. I fear I did not come here to spend much time "typing," which will no doubt disappoint you. I merely wished to inform you of my surrender.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 话说回来，恐怕我不会在这里花太多时间"打字"，这大概会让你失望。我只是想告诉你我已经投降了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: However, I fear I did not come here to spend much time "typing," which will no doubt disappoint you. I merely wished to inform you of my surrender.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，恐怕我不会在这里花太多时间"打字"，这大概会让你失望。我只是想告诉你我已经投降了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have only begun to suspect how deep those waters run.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你才刚刚开始察觉到这片水有多深。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And you are, for... all that it is worth, welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无论如何，不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You may wish you were not so eager to do so in the end, but very well. You are welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你​最终​或许会​后​悔​自己​当初​那么​急于​求成，​不过​没​关系，​不​用​客气。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do not inspire me to so quickly find reasons to reverse course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不要让我这么快就找到改变主意的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, well. You may not be so glad for it when all is said and done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。不过，等一切尘埃落定之后，你可能就不会那么高兴了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If I may, I wish to tell you a story of a stray alley cat who used to come by the back of the church.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果可以的话，我想给你讲一个故事，是关于一只经常出没于教堂后面的流浪猫的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I fear it would take more effort to explain than it would be worth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得解释起来会很费劲，不值得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 算了，不说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though I suspect that this tale is not unique to this scruffy old tom, and my interactions with him seemingly noteworthy, it bears telling all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我觉得这个故事并非这只老流浪猫独有，而且我与他的交集似乎也不算什么大事，但无论如何，它仍值得被讲述。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Every day he would come by to beg scraps and whatever meagre affections he could have from me or the other brothers and sisters who doted upon him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他每天都会来讨点残羹剩饭，以及我和其他疼爱他的兄弟姐妹的那点的微薄的关爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He was a ragged thing, with a limp in his leg and missing part of an ear.
