/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他的毛很凌乱，腿一瘸一拐，耳朵还缺了一块。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When he did not come by for a few days, Marie was quite beside herself with worry. But what is one to do for an old alley tom who has met their end, save to issue up a prayer to Lua?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他有几天都没来，玛丽担心得快要疯了。可是，对于一只已经走到了生命的尽头的流浪猫，除了向月神祈祷，我们又能做什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Regardless, imagine my surprise when I was fetching bread from the market and I saw the old tom sitting next to the owner of the stand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，当我在市场买面包时，我看到那只老猫坐在摊主旁边，我感到非常惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. Some of the purest, brightest souls I have encountered were encased in the flesh of a beast. It is not for me to judge how the Luminaries have set them upon their paths.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。有些我遇到的最纯洁、最聪慧的灵魂，却被包裹在野兽的肉身之中。当然，我无权评判双耀神是如何指引它们走上这条道路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He greeted me with a raspy meow, as he always did, and hopped down to rub against my leg.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他像往常一样，用沙哑的喵叫声向我打招呼，然后跳下来蹭我的腿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A good question. In some sects, no. It would be seen as heresy. But in ours, yes. We recognize that animals have souls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 问得好。在某些教派中，不可以，这会被视为异端邪说。但在我们教派中，可以。我们认为动物拥有灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Saint Elizabeth the Wise was known for her charity toward animals, though many traditions to do not recognize the Saints as apostles of the Luminaries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 圣徒伊丽莎白以善待动物而闻名，尽管许多传统教派并不承认圣徒是双耀神的使徒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I would note, Drifter, that he did so without a limp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而值得一提的是，漂泊者，他那天走路一点都不跛了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I find myself wondering if any influence of our order survived this long... but it was hardly the point of the conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不禁会想，我们这个修会的影响是否延续至今……但这并非我们谈话的重点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: "Ah, one of Old Devereaux's fools, I see." The man laughed as he bagged up my bread.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: "啊，我看你也是被老德福罗骗过的傻瓜之一啊。"那人一边笑着一边把我的面包装进袋子里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It turns out the old cat was playing us, and several others, in the neighborhood. He was not starving, of failing health, or neglected in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 原来那只老猫一直在耍我们和附近的邻居。它既没有挨饿，也没有生病，更没有受到任何虐待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed, if the man's words were to be believed, he was quite a murderous fiend in regards to the local population of birds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果那人的话属实，他在附近的鸟群中是有名的刽子手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There are a great many things to warn you about the devil "Cardinal Dimanche" put upon our doorstep. Perhaps this is one of them. Perhaps it is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 还有很多事情需要警告你，关于"星期日主教"留在我们家门口的恶魔。也许这算是其中之一，也许不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The Luminaries know I have certainly been worn at the edges as of late. But is this meant to stand as a warning about myself? Perhaps. Perhaps it is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 双耀神们都知道，我近来确实疲惫不堪。但这是否意在警示我关于你的事呢？或许是，或许不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, we did not. In fact, Marie greeted him with all the more affection for it, teasing him for being "her little imp."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没有，我们没有停。事实上，玛丽反而更加喜爱他，还逗他，说他是"她的小淘气"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is simply a story to say that sometimes, when a creature seems to be in need -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这只是一个例子，说明有时候，当一个生物似乎需要帮助时——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But we no longer fretted over him. We knew that Old Devereaux could quite adequately care for himself. He did not need us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我们不再为他操心了。我们知道老德福罗完全可以照顾好自己。他不需要我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - check to see how sharp its claws may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——先检查一下它的爪子有多锋利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: His next disappearance, two years later, turned permanent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 两年后，他的再次失踪变成了永久失踪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The cynical answer I would supply you with would be "greed." For if one could have one feast, why not two? Why not ten?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我给出的答案或许会有点愤世嫉俗："贪欲"。既然可以吃一次大餐，为什么不能吃两次？为什么不能吃十次？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I lit a candle for him the night I learned of his death and prayed to Lua to guide his soul to... wherever she would guide a little imp like him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 得知他去世的那天晚上，我为他点燃了一支蜡烛，并向月神祈祷，希望她能引导他的灵魂去往……她愿意收留像他这样的小精灵的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: May I ask why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请问为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: An avaricious desire for affection is still gluttony, though it is not a hunger fed by meat and wine. And to seek it in such false pretenses?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对爱的贪婪渴望也是一种贪欲，只不过它不是用肉食和美酒来满足饥渴罢了。更何况他是靠装可怜来换取？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And thanked Old Devereaux for all the joy he brought Marie in exchange for all those coveted bits of chicken gristle and head scratches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也感谢了老德福罗给玛丽带来的所有快乐，而我们只需提供好吃的鸡软骨和摸摸头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I found myself oddly... respecting the cat, for the place it had found itself in the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我发现自己竟然……对这只猫心生敬意，因为它在这个世界上找到了属于自己的位置。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I will not hinder you in your day any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。我先不打扰你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Fascinating. I would expect you to despise your enemies. But that is my own folly - to assume I know how anyone in this day and age would comport themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真有趣。我原以为你会痛恨你的敌人。但这是我的愚昧之处——我竟然自以为知道当今世代的人们会如何行事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Here was a creature who had learned to use its condition - its appearance, its age, its scars - as a weapon against "the fools" around him who did not see through his ruse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是一个学会利用自身状况——外貌、年龄、伤疤——作为武器来对抗周围那些看不穿他诡计的"傻瓜"的生物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He knew well enough to feign a limp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他可是很清楚该如何装跛脚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Infer from this conversation whatever you wish, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，你想从这段对话中得出什么结论都行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: An imp in matted fur, he truly was. Yet I found myself petting him all the same when he came 'round to visit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他真是个毛茸茸的小淘气，浑身乱糟糟的。可每次他来拜访，我还是忍不住想摸摸他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. I suppose we were. And we were not experiencing a shortage of bits of chicken gristle and scratches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，我想我们确实如此。我们并不缺那几块鸡软骨或那几下摸摸头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Let alone someone with your particularly fascinating upbringing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 更何况是像你这样有着特别精彩成长经历的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And equally heartbroken when, two years later, his next disappearance was permanent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 两年后，他的再次失踪却是永久性的，这让我同样心碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps that is why I lit a candle for him and prayed to Lua to take his soul and guide it to... wherever she would take a little imp like him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也许正因如此，我才为他点燃了一支蜡烛，并向月神祈祷，希望她能带走他的灵魂，引导他去往……她愿意收留像他这样的小精灵的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I will not hinder you in your day any longer. This has been a most interesting conversation. Until we speak again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。我先不打扰你了。这次谈话非常有趣。期待下次再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And why I thanked Old Devereaux in my prayers that night for all the joy he had brought Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那天晚上，我也在祈祷中感谢了老德福罗，感谢他给玛丽带来的所有快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps his little villainy was of some good in a roundabout manner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许他那些小小的恶行，从某种意义上来说，也算是一件好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: "The Tales of Duviri." While I received quite a... exhausted and longsuffering explanation from M. Loid regarding what you endured, there is one particular matter over which I would enquire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我看到的就是《双衍王境故事集》。虽然我从洛德先生那里得到了相当……疲惫和漫长的解释，听到你所遭受的苦难，但我还有一件事想问一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How much of our lives has been prescribed to us by others as fact, only to be proven useless when tested?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们​生活​中​有​多​少​东西​是​别人​强加给​我们​的，​并​被​当作​事实，​却​经不​起​考验​并​被​证明毫​无​用处？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So it seems. I have met the Cavia. I have been told of Void Angels. I have seen the Murmur first-hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来也确实如此。我见过科维兽。我听说过虚空天使。我亲眼看见低语者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If, of course, it is not too troubling to do so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然，前提是这样问不会造成太大麻烦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And such is the nature of my curiosity. I have come to wonder this "aloud" to see if you might be able to expound upon it. When the Void is given form, what wanders from it - is it "real?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这就是我好奇的地方。我之所以把这个问题"说出口"，是想看看你是否能对此多加阐述。当虚空被赋予形态时，从中出来的是什么——它们是"真实"的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I often find myself wondering why fill the heads of others with such useless lies? Is it power they seek? Influence? Or do you think they honestly believe their own words, and are ignorant to their own untruths?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我常常纳闷，为什么要用这些毫无用处的谎言来蒙蔽他人？他们是为了追求权力？影响力？还是他们真的相信自己所说的话，对自己的谎言浑然不觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then are the effects caused by such elements of the Void not "real?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，虚空中的这些元素所造成的影响难道不是"真实的"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But the analogy you use is not quite accurate, is it? Matter retrieved from the Void returns to the Void, does it not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但你用的这个比喻不太准确，对吧？从虚空中提取的物质最终不会回归虚空吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, forgive me. I am not skilled at simply... conversing in a direct manner. Especially in such a strange method as this. But I will endeavor to do so now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，请原谅我。我不太擅长直接沟通，尤其是不擅长用这种奇怪的方式。但我现在会努力尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: None that I have come to you to discuss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这不是我来找你讨论的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Many a memory has driven a man to the bottle or inspired them to take their own lives. Are those memories not "real?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 许多回忆都曾使人酗酒，甚至促使他们结束自己的生命。难道这些回忆就不是"真实的"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Might you elaborate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 可否请你详细说明一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But if it is forgotten it ceases to be. A story lost to time is lost forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但如果它被遗忘，它就不复存在了。一段被时间遗忘的故事，就永远消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hapless ignorance is the best for which any of us may hope might cause the malignancy of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 若要说我们能希望的最好情况，便是他人的恶意只是源于无知，而非刻意为之。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But what is the difference, is my question? If the end result is the same, does it matter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我的问题是，区别到底是什么？如果最终结果相同，那么这还重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A revolution struck from the minds of those who wield it is a dull sword indeed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一场被革命者遗忘的革命，其锋芒自然也随之钝化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My curiosity, however, is not regarding the book nor its usefulness. Forgive me for waxing poetic for a moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，我的好奇心并非在于这本书本身或其用途。请允许我稍稍抒发一下情感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What comes from the Void must return to it, is what you are saying? But is not the Void, by definition, comprised of nothing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是说，来自虚空的事物终将回归虚空？但虚空，从定义上来说，不就是由虚无构成的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A valid point. Is a revolution not "real" simply because you cannot put it in a basket and weigh it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有道理。难道仅仅因为革命无法被量化，它就不算是"真实的"革命吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It certainly cost many souls their heads. They would argue very much to its validity. However, consider this:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它确实夺去了许多人的生命。他们自然会为其合理性辩护。然而，不妨这样思考：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have come to wonder this "aloud" to see if you might be able to expound upon it. When the Void is given form, what wanders from it - is it "real?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我之所以把这个问题"说出口"，是想看看你是否能对此多加阐述。当虚空被赋予形态时，从中出来的是什么——它们是"真实"的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We are not discussing the Luminaries. We are discussing the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们讨论的不是双耀神，而是虚空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A revolution is only given validity due to its existence in the minds of those who wield it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一场革命只有在发动革命的人心中存在时才成立。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I suppose you could phrase it that way. Should we ignore the ghosts that haunt our halls, or if, by paying them any heed at all, we are reinforcing them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，我想你可以这么说。我们是不是应该对萦绕在我们大厅里的幽灵视而不见？还是说，如果我们对它们给予关注，反而会助长它们的气焰？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I suppose you could phrase it that way. How are we to be certain that we have not... made manifest our own devils?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，我想你可以这么说。我们怎么能确定我们没有……让我们自己的恶化型呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If it were to be struck from the thoughts of all those around, it would cease to exist, would it not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果从周围所有人的记忆中将它抹去，那它就会不复存在，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Your honesty to admit that which you do not know is refreshing. Would that more of humanity had such a gift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你能坦诚承认自己不知道的事情，这种精神令人耳目一新。但愿更多的人都能拥有这样的品质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not care about matter placed into the Void and retrieved. I care about what has been invented from the Void out of whole cloth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不关心那些被放入虚空又被取出的物质。我关心的是那些完全凭空从虚空中创造出来的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I appreciate the candor. I suppose I am less interested in what cannot exist, and what now does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我感谢你的坦诚。我想我好奇的不是什么不可存在，而是那些已经存在的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I suppose you would know what can be struck down from the Void by force and what cannot...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，我想你应该很清楚哪些东西可以用武力从虚空中击落，哪些不能……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps that is why so many turn to excess... to staunch a bleeding wound, unseen but aching. Curable. But by strength of soul, not armaments.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许这就是为什么那么多人选择沉溺……为了止住那看不见却隐隐作痛的伤口。这伤口其实是可以治愈的，但靠的是心灵的力量，而非武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have clearly gone about this all wrong. We will discuss this another time. Forgive my intrusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我显然完全搞错了方向。我们改天再谈。请原谅我的打扰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Regardless, I find my thoughts on the matter still entirely unsettled.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，我对这件事的看法仍然完全没有定论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though I find myself, as always, in doubt. Forgive my intrusion. Thank you for your time, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我还是心存疑虑。但请原谅我的打扰。漂泊者，谢谢你抽出时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was assisting M. Loid in his library, replacing books upon the shelves, though he insisted that those bizarre flying... contraptions could do the deed instead -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我在图书馆帮洛德先生整理书，往书架上放，虽然他坚持说那些奇特的飞行器……也能做这些工作——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I came across a curious volume detailing children's tales, set in a fictional world penned by one Euleria Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然后我看到了一本奇特的儿童故事书，描绘的是一个虚构的世界，作者是欧拉瑞娅·英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Noticing that the author shared the last name with the true name of our "Cardinal Dimanche," I immediately set the copy aside for myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我立刻注意到，作者与我们"星期日主教"的本名是同姓的，于是我便立即把这本书留给自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My question is related to the nature of "Conceptual Embodiment." After reading it, it detailed to me that the book was intended to teach children to prevent their emotions from interacting with the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的问题与"概念成形"的本质有关。读完之后，我明白这本书的目的是教导孩子们如何避免自己的情绪与虚空互动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would suspect - judging by the horrified look that M. Loid gave me, and his insistence that I replace the book immediately, "lest I upset you," that you do know something of it, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我就知道。从洛德先生惊恐的表情，还有他立刻叫我把书放回去，说"以免惹你不高兴"来看，我就猜你肯定会知道一些内情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Pardon the directness of the question, but I do not know how else to phrase it. What are the Murmur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请原谅我的问题如此直接，但我不知道该如何更好地表达。这些低语者究竟是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is that so? Are you so certain of that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真是这样吗？你这么确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ah. Yes. A good clarification. I suppose I mean it metaphorically. They are clearly literally made of dust and ash.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 啊，对，很好的阐明。我想我是指象征含义。它们显然确实是由尘土和灰烬构成的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Intriguing. I had assumed you believed your Indifference to be a deity, much in the same manner as Lua or Sol. Was I incorrect?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真有意思。我一直以为你把你的虚空无情之物奉为神明，就像我们把月神或太阳神奉为神明一样。难道我理解错了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As that is what they devolve into once slain. We have all proven that many times over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为它们死后都会变成那样。我们已经无数次证明了这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Intriguing. Do I glean from you that your own faith has been shaken as of late? Or have you never had any in your Indifference to begin with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有意思。我似乎从你的言谈中看出，你近来自己的信仰也动摇了？还是你从一开始就从未相信过虚空无情之物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Intriguing. This is the second time I have gleaned the impression from you that you do not seem to hold faith in the reality of your Indifference. Is that so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有意思。这已经是我第二次从你身上感受到，你似乎并不相信你们虚空无情之物的真实性了。是这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mm. Yes. Marie told me of this. You do not believe in the workings of invisible forces in our world - including that of the Indifference. Is that so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，是的。玛丽跟我说过这件事。你不相信我们这个世界存在无形的力量——包括虚空无情之物的力量。是这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Sometimes, I wonder if that is not the reason why so many turn to faith at the end of the day...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有时候，我会想，这或许就是为什么那么多人最终会转向信仰的原因……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Pardon, but I begin to worry when any individual feels "justified" in any action, especially when it comes to predicting the motivations of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恕我直言，当任何人觉得自己的任何行为都是"有理由"时，我都会开始感到担忧，尤其是在预测他人动机方面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Should we be concerned about what may happen when it moves on to the less obvious parts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们​是否​应该​担心，​如果​它​开始​影响​那些​不​那么​明显​的​部分​会​发生​什么？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ah. Forgive me, I misinterpreted. Well, I appreciate that you are honest, even in your uncertainty, though it leaves me alone in my ponderings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 啊，请原谅我。看来是我误解了。我感谢你即便在不确定中也仍然坦诚，只是这样我得自己去想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Peace in invented answers where none other can be found.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当找不到真正的答案时，就能从自己编出的理由中找到平静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That was a poor attempt at humor, forgive me. I shall pay myself ten lashes in recompense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 刚才那个玩笑开得实在拙劣，请原谅。我将自罚十鞭作为补偿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: These are the words of the devil, but the more I hear them, the more they make sense to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这些虽然是恶魔说过的话，但我越听越觉得有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I believe that is enough for today.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。我想今天就到此为止吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: These are the words of the devil, but the more I hear them, the more they make sense to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这些虽然是恶魔说过的话，但我越听越觉得有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I must return to my duties, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。恐怕我得回去工作了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What is the Void, but nothing at all? A scrying mirror of swirling polished onyx for us to gaze upon, waiting for our reflection to twist and deform?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虚空是什么？不就是虚无吗？是不是就像一面光滑的缟玛瑙镜，上面旋转着花纹，供我们凝视，等待着我们的倒影扭曲变形？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes... I fear it is. And I loathe to think your opinion of me has suffered so quickly and so incorrectly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的……恐怕真是如此。我非常不愿看到你如此武断又因为误会而改变对我的看法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You are forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你已被原谅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. Curious. But disappointing, in its scope. You believe it is nothing more than a child playing with toys. I must return to my duties.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，有趣。但你的见解之局限，有点令人失望。你认为这不过是个孩子在玩玩具而已。我得回去工作了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What is the Void, but nothing at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虚空是什么？不就是虚无吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: These are the words of the devil, but the more I hear them, the more they make sense to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这些虽然是恶魔说过的话，但我越听越觉得有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ah. Forgive me, I misinterpreted. Well, I appreciate that you are honest, even in your uncertainty, though it leaves me alone in my ponderings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 啊，请原谅我。看来是我误解了。我感谢你即便在不确定中也仍然坦诚，只是这样我得自己去想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Seeking in our own selves a glimmer of eternity - of a genius that we wish may extend beyond the briefest ember of our mortal lives. In those shadows, what manner of terrors could such an emptiness create, feeding upon the darkness in our own minds, our own empty souls?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们试图在自身中寻找永恒的曙光——寻找一种恩赐，希望它能超越我们短暂的生命余晖。在那些阴影中，这种空虚会滋生怎样的恐怖，以我们内心的黑暗、我们空虚的灵魂为食？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. I misinterpreted. I appreciate that you are honest, even in your uncertainty, though it leaves me alone in my ponderings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，看来是我误解了。我感谢你即便在不确定中也仍然坦诚，只是这样我得自己去想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I must return to my duties. Unfortunately, we have not finished our discussion, but... c'est la vie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我必须回去工作了。很遗憾，我们的对话还没结束，但是……c'est la vie。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie will tell you how difficult it is to procure a smile from me. So I should tell you when you have achieved one. Well played.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽会告诉你，想让我笑一笑有多难。所以，当你成功逗我笑的时候，我也应该告诉你。干得漂亮！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What must it be like, to be an unknowable god, turned into an ant like one of us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一个不可知的神，变成像我们一样的蚂蚁，那会是什么感觉呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What must it be like, to be an unknowable god, turned into an ant like one of us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一个不可知的神，变成像我们一样的蚂蚁，那会是什么感觉呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Interesting... yes, I suppose that would make a great deal of sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有意思……是的，我觉得这很有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My own adherence to faith has... suffered a blow, of late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 最近，我自身的信仰受到了打击。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps you might have sensed my... own adherence to faith has... suffered a blow, of late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你已经察觉到，我……自己对信仰的坚持……最近受到了打击。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know the devil has spoken to you of his theories. And I find myself wondering, in the late hours, if there is not some sense to them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道恶魔曾向你灌输过他的那些理论。而我，在深夜里，不禁会想，这些理论是否也有着一定的道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why would a god with no grasp of the mind of humanity, seek to laugh at our own folly? Why would it wish to torment us? To mock our failures and mimic or forms?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一个对人类心智一无所知的神，为何要嘲笑我们的愚蠢？为何要折磨我们？为何要嘲弄我们的失败，模仿我们的形态？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I apologize again for it is not something I wish to discuss. I imagine it is not hard to deduce, given your grander familiarity with the situation, the reasons as to why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我再次道歉，因为我不想讨论这件事。我想，鉴于你对情况的了解，不难推断出其中的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I must return to my duties, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。恐怕我得回去工作了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. Indeed. What must it be like, to be an unknowable god, turned into an ant like one of us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，的确如此。一个不可知的神，变成像我们一样的蚂蚁，那会是什么感觉呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I must return to my duties, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。恐怕我得回去工作了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is there anything more terrifying than to gaze into the gaping maw of Nothing and to see Nothing gazing back? To know how infinitesimal we may truly be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 还有什么比凝视虚无的深渊，发现虚无也在凝视着你更可怕的吗？难道没有什么比意识到我们自身有多么渺小更可怕的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I must return to my duties, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。恐怕我得回去工作了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What I would not give for the silence of the Void. For the stillness that it portends. Anything - anything - but for the maddening voices that follow instead...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我多么渴望虚空的寂静，渴望它所预示的宁静。我愿意付出任何代价——换掉那些纠缠不休、令人抓狂的声音……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then I am correct, and we needn't speak of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么我的判断是正确的，我们就不必再谈这件事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And it is these voices that give me such doubt, Drifter. And the reason why my hands tremble as I type these words...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，正是这些声音让我如此怀疑。也正是这些声音让我敲下这些文字时双手颤抖……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... yes. Once more, you are correct. Thank you. I will amend my statement to be that I am... simply unwilling to speak of it at the moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……是的，你说得对。谢谢。那我修改一下我的说法，我现在……实在不愿谈论此事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I must return to my prayers. Tepid as they may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我必须回去继续祈祷了，尽管我的祈祷可能并不热切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me. I... must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请原谅我，我……必须走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It was a thunderstorm the night that "Cardinal Dimanche" came to us. He stood in the sanctuary of the church, untouched by the gale that raged outside.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: "星期日主教"来到我们这里的那晚，正值雷雨交加。他站在教堂的圣殿里，丝毫没有受到外面狂风暴雨的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That should have served as my first cause for concern. Instead, I bowed my head to him and greeted him as I would any new envoy from the Holy Mother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我本应首先为此感到担忧。然而，我却向他低头致意，像迎接圣母派来的一位新使者一样向他问好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We had been expecting a new Cardinal since our last one had departed several months earlier from illness, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 毕竟，自从上一任主教几个月前因病离职后，我们就一直在期待一位新主教到来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Dimanche greeted me with a warm smile and a firm handshake. I asked him if his journey was long. I will never forget his reply.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 星期日主教热情地和我握手，脸上带着温暖的笑容。我问他旅途是否漫长。他的回答我永远不会忘记。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: "It was difficult... but it was not long."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: "虽然很艰难……但时间并不长。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It puzzled me at the time, as did the fact that his greatcoat was bone dry. But I dismissed it, as all are wont to do when one is faced with the unusual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当时我感到很困惑，还有他那件干透的大衣也让我百思不得其解。但我没太在意，就像所有人遇到不寻常的事情时都会做的那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I did not have time to consider it, as Marie in her eagerness arrived a moment later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我还没来得及细想，玛丽就急切地赶来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He knelt down to greet her at her level in her chair, and took her hands in his. I should have seen the manipulation for what it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他单膝跪地，与坐在椅子上的她平视，握住了她的手。我当时就应该看穿他的伎俩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He was not the only devil to arrive on our doorstep in a storm, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 毕竟，他并不是唯一一个在暴风雨中来到我们家门口的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. But that is a tale for another day. If I begin speaking of him, my already foul mood will become...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。不过那是另一个故事了。如果我开始谈论他，我原本就糟糕的心情会变得更加……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: After enduring his lies and betrayal, and while we continue to suffer his manipulation of Marie, would you have me be? No, I most certainly am not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在忍受了他的谎言和背叛之后，在我们继续承受他对玛丽的操纵之苦时，你以为我会是他的盟友吗？不，我绝对不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. She would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是​啊，​如果​是​她​她​会​说​得​不​一样。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: ...untenable. I would much rather focus my current mood upon Entrati's misdeeds, if it is all the same to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ……一发不可收拾。如果你不介意的话，我更愿意把注意力集中在英择谛的恶行上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie believes the best in all souls. It is a skill she has honed and perfected and polished as a shield against the world around her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽​相信​每​个​人​心​中​都​有​善良​的​一面。​这​是​她​不断​磨练、​完善​的​能力，​以​此​作为​抵御​周围​世界​的​盾。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Fouling our bodies, destroying our futures, corrupting our pasts - all this, perhaps I could forgive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玷污我们的身体，摧毁我们的未来，腐蚀我们的过去——这一切，或许我都能原谅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And what would you make of that statement, were it to be true, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果这句话是真的，漂泊者，你会怎么看待这件事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: "And," nothing. I have told you how I witnessed the event, the truth of my experience of it. Nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没有​"然后"。​我​已经​把​我​亲眼​目睹​的​事件​经过​告诉​了​你，​这​就​是​我​亲身​经历​的​真实​情况。​仅此​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But to see how he has warped Marie... used her faith in the goodness of others to his own ends?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但看看他是如何扭曲玛丽的……利用她对他人善良的信念来达到自己的目的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Trust is a stained glass window. Delicate in its creation. Beautiful in its splendor. Tragic in its breaking. And dangerous once destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 信任就像一扇彩色玻璃窗。制作精巧，绚丽夺目；破碎时令人扼腕叹息；一旦损毁，便危机四伏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Trust is a stained glass window. Delicate in its creation. Beautiful in its splendor. Tragic in its breaking. And dangerous once destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 信任就像一扇彩色玻璃窗。制作精巧，绚丽夺目；破碎时令人扼腕叹息；一旦损毁，便危机四伏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No. I had my reason for accepting the elixir. I knew what twisted creature it would make of me. As did Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不。我接受那血清自有我的理由。我知道它会把我变成非常扭曲的怪物。玛丽也知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: This, I shall never forgive. This, I wish to beat from his flesh with my thurible until he begs for salvation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 唯独这事，我永不原谅。我愿用我的香炉鞭打他，直到他乞求救赎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In the warm light of Sol, she basks in its light, unable to see the faults that form upon its surface. Unable to hear the cracks that deepen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她沐浴在在太阳温暖的光芒中，却看不见太阳表面形成的裂痕，也听不见越来越深的裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We were not... forcibly broken, like the devil. Part of my heart feels for Roathe for what he has endured.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们并非像恶魔那样……被强行摧毁。我为罗瑟所遭受的一切感到难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then I see no need to continue this conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，我认为没有必要继续这个话题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will be quite blunt in saying that I do not know how to answer that, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，恕我直言，我不知道该如何回答这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Unaware of the shards of her own masterpiece would soon be turned against her. Choosing to blind herself to what will inevitably follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她浑然不知，自己一手打造的杰作的碎片很快就会被用来对付她。她选择对即将到来的灾难视而不见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then he opens his mouth to speak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 直到他张嘴说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Am I "all right?" I will be quite blunt in saying that I do not know how to answer that, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我"是否​一切​都​好？"漂泊者，恕我直言，我不知道该如何回答这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All my years, I have seen horrors the likes of which would send others into the asylums. More tragically, now and again, my visions would come to pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这么多年来，我目睹过无数恐怖景象，足以把人送进精神病院。更悲惨的是，我的异象有时会变成现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Would that I could take from her the corruption he has sown into her mind. I can only pray that you might succeed where I have failed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但愿我能将他灌输到她心中的邪念驱除。我只能祈祷我做不到的事情，你能做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Would that I could bear that suffering in her stead, how gladly I would have it tattooed into my soul. But this is for her, and her alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果我能替她承受那份痛苦该有多好，我多么愿意将它刻进我心里。但这属于她，也只属于她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So I shall seek to prevent this pain instead, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以，漂泊者，我会尽量避免她遭受这种痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would see M. Loid for a crème for that ailment. Lest it spread.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果我是你的话，我会打算去找洛德先生开点药膏治疗这种病，以免病情扩散。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And if you see in that act any attempt to make her small?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 若你竟从我的举动中看到了试图贬低她的意图？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And as such, I thought them the guidance of Lua. That I was chosen by the Luminaries to carry such a burden. Or so I believed them at the time. Such is the reason I sought to enter the priesthood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因此，我当时认为这是月神的指引，是双耀神选中我来承担这份重任。至少我当时是这么认为的。这就是我想要成为神父的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: May Lua have pity upon your soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那就愿月神怜悯你的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In our scripture, one does not negotiate with devils- one casts them out. But they did not prepare us for this particular condition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们的经文教导我们不要与恶魔谈判，而是要驱逐他们。但经文并没有教我们怎么应对这种情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps. I am not yet certain there is no doubt in that creature's heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许吧。我还不能确定那家伙心中是否毫无疑虑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We shall see which path that particular devil chooses to walk in due course, won't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们很快就会看到那个恶魔会选择走哪条路，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And that is what troubles me. The devil smiles and speaks sense when all others spout madness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而这正是令我不安的地方。当所有人都在胡言乱语时，魔鬼却反倒能面带微笑，说出有道理的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What I believe has become... complicated, as of late, by the introduction of new information.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 由于​最近​出现​的​新​信息，​我​所​相信​的​一切​都​变得……​复杂​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We have only just begun to converse about such things, Drifter. It is not that I do not believe that you have seen, first-hand, suffering of the worst order, nor do I believe you would require protection from whatever meagre descriptions I might manage to conjure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我们才刚刚开始谈论这些事。并非我不相信你亲眼目睹过最惨绝人寰的苦难，也并非我不相信你能承受我所说的苍白无力的内容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Quite simply, Drifter, it would be honest to say that I do not know what to believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，坦白说，我不知道该相信什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He catches us at our most unawares - when we are vulnerable. When we are weak. When we are in need of answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他总是在我们最不经意的时候——在我们最脆弱的时候，在我们最无助的时候，在我们最需要答案的时候——出现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Good. See to it that you are not. I would hate to need to beat some sense into you. You seem like the type to return fire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很好。你最好别那样。我可不想费劲教训你。你看上去像是那种会还击的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It merely exhausts me to speak of such things to someone I have only just met, only to have them never come near me again. I would rather not have this happen in a situation where we seem to be forced to work together, for the short term at the very least.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 跟一个刚认识的人谈论这些事，然后对方再也不理我，只会让我精疲力竭。由于短期内我们似乎不得不一起工作，我最好避免这种情况发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And then what manner of a strange state would we find ourselves?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 到时候我们两个打起来会是怎样的一种局面呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I fear that is all a matter for another day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我恐怕这是改日再谈的事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ones that I fear have... thrown a great many things into doubt. But I fear that is all a matter for another day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我担心这些答案……已经让很多事情变得扑朔迷离。但我恐怕这一切都只能留待以后再谈了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Good. See to it that you do not. I would hate to have to beat some sense into you. You seem like the type to return fire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很好。你最好别被他影响到。我可不想费劲教训你。你看上去像是那种会还击的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. It is not that I do not believe that you are earnest in what you write. It is merely that my experience has taught me otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。并非我不相信你字里行间流露出的诚意，只是我的经历告诉我情况恰恰相反。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is not that I do not believe that you are earnest in what you write. It is merely that my experience has taught me otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 并非我不相信你字里行间流露出的诚意，只是我的经历告诉我情况恰恰相反。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will have to beg your forgiveness, and your patience, in the meanwhile.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在此期间，我恳请你的原谅和耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And then in what manner of a strange state would we find ourselves?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 到时候我们两个打起来会是怎样的一种局面呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will have to beg your forgiveness, and your patience, in the meanwhile.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在此期间，我恳请你的原谅和耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why are you asking me this question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你为什么问我这个问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What a dearth of sensible options you have found yourself, when a madman and a lunatic is your only source for a "neutral" opinion. I cannot fathom why you bother speaking to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你真是找不到什么明智的选择，竟然想从一个疯子和神经病患者那里寻求"中立"的意见。我实在不明白你为什么还要跟我说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Why do you insist on talking to me at all? You needn't, you realize. If you wish to befriend - or even court - Marie, I am not her keeper, nor her father. And whatever your intentions with that bastard Roathe, I care little beyond the answers he owes me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你为什么非要跟我说话？你知道，这根本没必要。如果你想和玛丽交朋友——甚至追求她——我既不是她的监护人，也不是她的父亲。至于你对那个混蛋罗瑟有什么企图，我根本不在乎，我只关心他欠我的那些答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: "Truth." I wish you understood how laughable that was to me of late. Does it not bother you to sully yourself with madmen and lunatics? Curious. Though you seem to consort with talking animals and... creatures from out of time. I suppose I am no more or less outlandish than any of the rest of your collection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: "真相。"我真希望你能明白，现在的我觉得这话有多么可笑。你不介意和疯子、精神病患者混在一起吗？真奇怪。不过你似乎也和会说话的动物以及……来自异时代的生物为伍。我想我和其他那些家伙一样，也算不上什么怪胎吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. It does not bother you to sully yourself with madmen and lunatics? Curious. Though you seem to consort with talking animals and... creatures from out of time. I suppose I am no more or less outlandish than any of the rest of your collection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。你不介意和疯子、精神病患者混在一起吗？真奇怪。不过你似乎也和会说话的动物以及……来自异时代的生物为伍。我想我和其他那些家伙一样，也算不上什么怪胎吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And please, do spare us both some lengthy lecture of how you wish to "aid" me or how you "wish to be my friend." I am certain you mean to be kind, but it is grating with its ridiculous insincerity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 拜托，别再长篇大论地跟我讲你想如何"帮助"我或者你想如何"做我的朋友"。我知道你是出于好意，但这种虚伪可笑的话实在令人反感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And please, do spare us both another lecture on how you wish to "help" me, will you? I am certain you mean to be kind, but it is grating with its ridiculous insincerity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 拜托，别再跟我们俩讲你多么想"帮助"我了，好吗？我知道你是出于好意，但这种虚伪可笑的话实在令人反感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And please, do spare us both another... embarrassing moment, will you? I know what you have said are your reasons for speaking to me. And while I find them flattering, I also find them ridiculously insincere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 拜托，别再让我们俩都陷入尴尬的境地了，好吗？我知道你找我谈话的理由。虽然我觉得受宠若惊，但也觉得这些理由虚伪得可笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Neither. Your words are charity that I neither need nor want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 都不是。你的话如同施舍，对我来说既不需要也不想要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Quite right. Three years, two months, and eleven days, he served as Cardinal Dimanche in our Cathedral. And for all that time, Marie and I served him unknowing of what he planned for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对了。三年两个月零十一天，他担任我们教堂的星期日主教。在那段时间里，我和玛丽一直侍奉着他，却对他为我们所做的安排一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know your questions before you ask them. What was he scheming? Did he infect the city, like I hear tell that he did to Höllvania? What were his plans? His discoveries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在你开口之前，我就知道你想问什么了。他究竟在密谋什么？他是否像我听说的对霍瓦尼亚那样，也感染了这座城市？他的计划是什么？他发现了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Your insincerity is not a mistruth. It is meant as charity. Charity I neither need nor want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你的虚伪并非因为说谎，而是因为施舍。我不需要也不想要这样的施舍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. No. Not yet, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。不是。或许还没到那个时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you have something you wish to confess, Drifter? Is there penance you wish to pay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，你有什么想要坦白的吗？你有什么想要赎罪的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Best to ask her that yourself. I have often wondered the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 最好你自己去问她。我也常常有同样的疑问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Simply? Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 简单来说？是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To these I will say, you will be disappointed. For those three years, two months, and eleven days? He preached. He studied. He rested. And he prayed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这些问题的答案，会让你们会失望的。在那三年两个月零十一天里，他只是传道、学习、休息、祷告。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is neither here nor there. You did not come to this conversation seeking forgiveness, nor are your former lies the same as your current insincerities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这无关紧要。你这次来谈话并非为了寻求原谅，你过去的谎言也与你现在的虚伪并非同一回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What you say now is merely charity. Charity I neither need nor want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你现在所说的不过是施舍而已。我不需要也不想要这样的施舍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: After those three years and some-odd days, he disappeared in the midst of a terrible storm. The same as the one in which he appeared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 三年又几天后，他在一场可怕的风暴中消失了。这场风暴和他出现时的风暴一模一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is impossible to know the inside workings of another's mind. He knelt at the altar and his head was bowed. Was he in prayer? Or was he simply lost within his own thoughts? I do not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们不可能了解别人的内心世界。他跪在祭坛前，低着头。他是在祈祷吗？还是只是沉浸在自己的思绪中？我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie would cradle a rabid bear in her lap and let it tear out her throat if she thought it would bring the animal a moment's peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果玛丽认为这样做能给这头疯熊带来片刻安宁，她甚至会把疯熊抱在怀里，任由它撕开自己的喉咙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would consider it a steadfast dedication to pragmatism, but define it however you like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我认为这是一种对实用主义的坚定不移的坚持，但你可以随意定义它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Heh. I did not think of it in such a way, but yes - perhaps he was. How perfectly infuriating for all the rest of you. It seems to fit with what little we know of his true self.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 呵呵。我之前没这么想过，不过——或许他真是这样。这对你们其他人来说真是太气人了。这似乎也符合我们对他真实面目的些许了解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is likely a wise decision. You were asking after "Cardinal Dimanche" and his tenure at the Cathedral.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这或许是个明智的决定。你问的是"星期日主教"及其在教堂的任期。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She is a singularly beautiful soul, one I will protect until my dying breath.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她拥有独一无二的美丽灵魂，我会守护她直到生命的最后一刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though I am well aware the storm did not occur to others, it was quite vivid to my senses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我知道其他人可能没有感受到这场风暴，但我却真切地感受到了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: One year to the day after that, he reappeared one final time, with... Roathe, as you see him now, collapsed and unconscious at his feet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一年后的同一天，他最后一次出现，而……罗瑟，正如你现在看到的样子，倒在他脚下，昏迷不醒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Three years, two months, and eleven days, he served as Cardinal Dimanche in our Cathedral. And for all that time, Marie and I served him unknowing of what he planned for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 三年两个月零十一天，他担任我们教堂的星期日主教。在那段时间里，我和玛丽一直侍奉着他，却对他为我们所做的安排一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But this is what you must come to expect, asking a madman a simple question is oft a wandering path. Allow me to redirect us to your original topic and away from my own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但你必须预料到这种情况，问一个疯子一个简单的问题，往往会引出很多无关紧要的话题。请允许我把话题拉回到你最初的主题，而不是我自己的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A devil in the flesh, or so it seemed. It was then that Entrati told us the truth of who he was - whence he hailed - and the true task he had for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他简直就是恶魔的化身，至少看起来是这样。就在那时，英择谛告诉我们他的真实身份——他来自哪个时代——以及托付我们的真正任务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That he had chosen us both for a most "sacred mission."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他选中我们俩去执行一项"神圣的使命"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have learned much that makes me question Entrati's adherence to anything sacrosanct to any nature or god of any kind... if any such thing exists...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道的事越多，就越让我怀疑英择谛是不是真的承认任何自然或任何神灵的神圣信仰……如果真有这种东西存在的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie accepted the serum readily. Of course, she did. How could she not? And how could I not follow her? How could I not seek the truth, wherever it might lead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽欣然接受了血清。当然，她会接受的。她怎么可能不接受呢？而我又怎能不跟随她呢？我又怎能不去追寻真相，无论真相会将我引向何方呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A matter for another time, kindly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 此事留待日后再说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Roathe awoke. At first, he could barely remember his name. Entrati said one parting phrase to the bastard. "Uriel, Heretic of Xata, in banishment, answer - can the Orokin ever be forgiven?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 罗瑟醒了过来。起初，他几乎记不起自己的名字。英择谛临别前对这个混蛋说了一句话："Uriel，Xata 的异端者，在放逐中，作出回答吧——奥罗金能否得到宽恕？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I regret everything, Drifter. Yes, of course I do. But would I do it again? Yes, of course I would. I cannot leave Marie alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我对一切都感到后悔。是的，我当然后悔。但我还会再做一次吗？答案是，我当然会。我不能让玛丽一个人待着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In this, we are agreed. But I also cannot fault her for it. Give her time. She will come to understand. She is fiercely intelligent, Drifter. Do not treat her as a fool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在这点上，我们意见一致。但我也不能因此责怪她。给她点时间，她会想明白的。她非常聪明，漂泊者。别把她当傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Entrati departed then for the last time. And abandoned Roathe with us, now newly changed into what you see now - better able to contend with the temperamental devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 英择谛就此永远地离开了。他把罗瑟留给了我们，而我和玛丽如今已焕然一新，变成了你们现在看到的样子——更有能力对抗那喜怒无常的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To finish the tale... Entrati departed then for the last time. And abandoned Roathe with us, now newly changed into what you see now - better able to contend with the temperamental devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 故事到此结束……英择谛就此永远地离开了。他把罗瑟留给了我们，而罗瑟如今已焕然一新，变成了你们现在看到的样子——更有能力对抗那喜怒无常的魔鬼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The rest, I fear, is a story that will have to wait. M. Loid requires use of the POM-2 and I am eager to relinquish it. I hope this has helped answer at least some of your questions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕剩下的故事只能以后再讲了。洛德先生需要使用石榴 2 代电脑，而我急着把它交还给他。希望这至少能解答你的一些疑问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then I have done my duty as a priest. I bid thee good night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，我已尽到神父的职责。我祝你晚安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then I shall I bid thee good night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，我就祝你晚安了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you consider yourself a religious person, Drifter? Or is this more of a scholarly question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，​你​认为​自己​是​有​信仰​的​人​吗？​还是​说​这​更​像​是​一​个​学术​问题？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I fear there are many topics I could discuss at length. But do not mistake me, I would be happy to, I simply do not wish to bore you to tears. Where would you like to begin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕我可以详细讨论的话题太多了。不过别误会，我很乐意，只是不想让你觉得太无聊。你想从哪里开始呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And how did you arrive at such a personal faith, if you do not mind my asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请问你是如何形成如此个人化的信仰的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A wise place to begin. To know a culture by its holidays is to know its heart. For how a people celebrates is how they would be remembered. For those moments are the ones cherished most by those who share them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是一个明智的开头。了解一个文化的节日，就如同了解它的灵魂。因为一个民族如何庆祝，就决定了他们将被后人铭记的方式。因为那些共同经历的时刻，是那些最珍贵的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. Let us begin with that which you may already know: Sol and Lua, the sun and the moon. They are deities who are forever transmutable in their aspects.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然可以。我们先从你可能已经知道的说起：太阳神和月神。他们是永恒变化的神祇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Truly? I am... surprised. Surprised, but pleased. And it is no wonder you are curious, then. Our teachings must be so very foreign to what you know. So much time has passed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真的吗？我……很惊讶。惊讶之余，也很高兴。难怪你会好奇。我们的教义一定与你所了解的截然不同。毕竟时间已经过去这么久了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I respect that. There is honor in recognizing what we cannot know, in seeing the smallness of the human condition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我尊重你的看法。认识到我们无法知晓的事物，认识到人类境况的渺小，这本身就是一种荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Believe you me, there is no offence taken. In many cases, you are quite correct.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请​相信​我，​我​并​没有​被​冒犯到。​在​很多​情况​下，​你​的​说法​完全​正确。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would admit I am jealous that you do not find cause to fret over what may wait for us beyond the veil. Would that more others did, our world would have known more peace in its days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我承认，我羡慕你从不为死后的世界忧虑。要是其他人也能如此就好了，我们的世界或许会更加和平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is a topic over which I wish to talk with you at great length. Simply not now, at a time when I am not prepared for such a discussion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是一个我很想和你深入探讨的话题。只是现在还不是时候，我还没有准备好进行这样的讨论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Fascinating! As a scholar of the cloth, I do hope we have time to learn from one another at length of our respective beliefs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 太棒了！作为一名宗教学者，我真心希望我们能有时间深入地互相学习各自的信仰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I wonder how much our faiths influenced each other, intentionally or unintentionally as the case may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想知道我们的信仰在多大程度上会相互影响，无论是有意还是无意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Our main and most common holidays are the Winter and Summer Solstices that mark the shortest and longest days of the year.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们最主要、最常见的节日是仲冬节和仲夏节，分别标志着一年中白昼最短和最长的一天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Appearing in many forms over the centuries to many believers. Sometimes male, sometimes female. But always as Sol, the Sun, and Lua, the Moon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 多个世纪以来，他们以多种形象出现在众多信徒面前。有时是男性，有时是女性。但始终是太阳神和月神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I am remiss in not staying on topic. I fear I have wandered far from the topic at hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是我疏忽了，没有围绕主题说。恐怕我已经远远离题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. Allow me to answer your curiosity. In order to avoid boring you to tears, where would you like to begin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。​那​就​先​让​我​来​解答​你​的​问题。​为了​避免​让​你​感到​无聊，​你​想​从​哪里​开始​呢？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Both holidays are marked by great feasts, though they are delineated by whom you share the feasts with. Where the Winter Solstice is for sharing with family and close friends, the Summer Solstice is for strangers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这两个节日都以盛宴为标志，但它们的区别在于与谁共进宴席。仲冬节是与家人和挚友共享的节日，而仲夏节则是与陌生人共享的节日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You wished to know about the Luminary Orthodoxy, did you not? In order to avoid boring you to tears, where would you like to begin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你想了解双耀神的正教，对吗？为了避免让你感到无聊，你想从哪里开始呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And for that, I laud your curiosity and scholarly nature.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为此，我赞赏你的好奇心和求知欲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My case is... complex. But I will not lie and say that it has not been devoid of fear. Though religion has brought a flood of it into my life. It has never removed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的情况……很复杂。但我不会撒谎说我从未感到恐惧。尽管宗教给我的生活带来了无尽的恐惧，它也从未消除过我的恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mm. And one best told to a trusted friend. I understand completely. Besides which, you came to me for information, not the other way around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。这种事最好跟信任的朋友说。我完全理解。再说，是你来问我问题，而不是我来问你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A stained glass window of the soul. Shattered when left apart, but what a beautiful image it paints when assembled.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 灵魂的彩色玻璃窗。分开时破碎不堪，但重新拼合时却能描绘出一幅异常美丽的画面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The world would be a better place, if it shared your faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果​世人​与​你​拥有​相同​的​信仰，​那​将​会​是​一​个​更​美​好​的​世界。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, some sects can be a bit strict in their choice of iconography, declaring that Sol "Must" be one way or "Must" be another but the Orthodoxy does not recognize this as fact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，有些教派在圣像的选择上可能比较严格，宣称太阳神"必须"是这样或"必须"是那样，但正教并不承认这是真理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Each of the Luminaries holds within them multiple aspects. Each aspect can be seen as a function of the whole. Lua, for example, is the mother, the maiden, the crone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 圣光双神中的两个神都蕴含着多重身份。每一种身份都可以被视为整体的一个组成部分。例如，月神既是母亲，又是少女，又是老妪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The Summer Solstice is for sharing great bounties and for bringing together strangers who have never met. You would gather in a field, bringing food and wares of your own making, it would not matter what.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 仲​夏节​是​分享丰收​成果、​让​素​未​谋面​的​陌生​人​相聚​的​日子。​人们​会​聚集​在​田野​里，​带来​自己​制作​的​食物​和​物品，​带​什么​都​可以。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The Winter Solstice is for bracing against the cold and cherishing those who warm us against the darkest times. You decorate a tree with candles, one light for each of those who have gone before who guide the way as the stars in the sky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 仲​冬节​是​抵御​严寒、​感恩​那些​在​最​黑暗​的​时刻​给​予​我们​温暖​的​人​的​日子。​人们​用​蜡烛​装​饰​星树，​每​一​盏​灯​都​代表​一​位​先人，​他们​如同​天​上​的​繁星，​指​引​着​我们​前行​的​道路。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I expect that whatever has survived to this far-flung future has wound up being... a bit confused in its documentation of my religion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我估计，关于我们信仰流传至今的记载，最终会变得……有些混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Candles, or bread, or clothes, or paintings. Or books of poetry. Or wreaths of flowers. Even to come empty handed but "with glad tidings" is to be seen as a blessing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 蜡烛、面包、衣物、画作，或是诗集，或是花环。即便空手而来，但"带着喜讯"，也被视为一种祝福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And atop it, Sol himself, suffering atop the star tree in the darkness. Dimmed, but not forgotten. For this is the time of Lua. And we celebrate her in this time of shadow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而头顶上的太阳神，在黑暗中，于星树之巅饱受煎熬。他虽已黯淡，却未被遗忘。因为这是月神的时代。在这阴影笼罩的时刻，我们颂扬她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I find myself a living archaeological relic. How depressing. But I digress.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我发现自己成了一件活着的考古文物。真令人沮丧。不过，我扯远了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But Lua can also be He who guides souls along the river of tears to the endless night. Death himself. The harbinger and herald.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但月神也可以是引领灵魂沿着泪河走向无尽黑夜的那一位。即死神本身、先驱者和使者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A celebration of life - laughter - music - sharing of all of these things, would commence during that, the longest of Sol's days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在这个漫长的太阳神之日中，人们庆祝生命——欢笑——音乐——分享这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And as we draw in close, and we feast upon a roasted bird and root vegetables and all that does not grow fresh in the frozen earth, we hold those that we love. And we tell stories of those that have gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当我们围坐一桌，享用烤禽、根茎类蔬菜以及所有在冰冻土地上无法新鲜生长的食材时，我们拥抱着我们所爱的人，讲述着那些逝去亲人的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And in other sects, Death is an old veiled woman. It differs. But it speaks to the same spirit reaching out to all of us. The silvered hand that wishes to guide us in that last moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在其他教派中，死神是一位蒙着面纱的老妇人。虽然各有不同，但都指向同一个精神层面，那就是在生命的最后一刻，那只银色的手指引着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All were welcome to make new friends of strangers, and take home that which they needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所有人都可以结识陌生人并交朋友，还可以带走自己需要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We remember, on Lua's longest night, that she will guide us and our family through in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在月神最漫长的夜晚，我们铭记着，她最终会指引我们和我们的家人度过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The moon that slips over the sun during the eclipse, guiding us through the crossroads in that moment where all is lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 日食期间，月亮遮蔽了太阳，在看似一切都已失去的十字路口，指引着我们前行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But the most sacred of holidays to the Luminaries is The Summum Bonum. It is a rare event, when Sol and Lua align into a perfect eclipse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但对双耀神信徒来说，最神圣的节日是至善日。这是一个罕见的现象，当太阳和月亮完美对齐，形成一次完美的日食或月食时就是这个节日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is a wonderous and holy occasion, where all of nature responds. Have you had such luck as to witness it yourself?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是一个奇妙而神圣的景象，大自然万物都在响应。你有没有幸亲眼目睹过呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have been blessed to witness it twice. And both times, I found it... transformative. If I could stay within that brief moment, suspended there forever, I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有幸两次亲眼见证。两次都让我感到……震撼人心。如果可以，我真想永远停留在那短暂的瞬间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will tell you the story of the first eclipse I witnessed another time. It has grown late here. Or perhaps it is early. I cannot quite tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我改天再跟你讲我第一次亲眼目睹的日食的故事。现在天色已晚，或许还很早，我也说不准。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you ever have the opportunity, do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果有机会，一定要去看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Would that I could share your impassiveness over the event...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但愿我也能像你一样对这件事漠不关心……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You must be touched by the Luminaries, and their presence overwhelmed you. Or perhaps they wished to smite you for some great sin. One or the other. Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你一定是受到了双耀神的感召，他们的存在让你感到难以承受。或许他们想惩罚你犯下的滔天罪行。反正都一样。呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Such is the way of the gods. Their signs can often be interpreted any which way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这就是神明的行事方式。他们的征兆往往可以有多种解读。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Celestines 18:19, from the Third Orthodox Book of Lua. Where in the name of the Luminaries did you hear it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是《月神正教经》的第三卷书——《塞莱斯廷书》18 章 19 节。你究竟是从哪里听来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, well. It... is beginning to seem inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好​的，​嗯。​这……​似乎​不​可​避免​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... see. I would like to ask you more about this soon, if I may. I simply am not prepared for this now, and it has grown late here. Or perhaps it is early. I cannot quite tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……明白了。如果可以的话，关于这件事，我想尽快再问你一些问题。我现在还没做好准备，而且时间已经不早了。或许现在还早，我也不确定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, well. It... is beginning to seem inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好​的，​嗯。​这……​似乎​不​可​避免​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When Marie engages with her foes upon the battlefield, I believe it is one of two things: either, she is having a bit of fun, play-acting as an ancient crusader, imagining herself in the shining armor of a Knight of Sol -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当玛丽在战场上与敌人交战时，我认为只有两种可能：要么她是在享受战斗的乐趣，扮演着古代圣战士兵的角色，想象自己身披闪亮的太阳神骑士盔甲——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you find the ability to describe our current predicament as simply "odd" I am either impressed by your fortitude or dismayed by your lack of vocabulary. I suspect, however, it is the former.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你觉得用"奇怪"来形容我们目前的困境就足够了，那我要么佩服你的勇气，要么对你词汇量的匮乏感到失望。不过，我猜想应该是前者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You are quite right. Marie is not the kind to condemn another for holding in their hearts an ancient god of trees - instead, she would seek to find what beliefs she held in common with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说得很对。玛丽不会因为别人心中怀有古老的树神信仰而谴责他们——相反，她会努力寻找自己与他们共同的信仰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Many a holy war was waged in its day in the name of Sol or Lua. Bloody "crusades" to drive back "heathens" or to "take holy land" or whatever contrived reasoning was the favorite of the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在那个时代，许多圣战以太阳神或月神的名义发动。血腥的"圣战"是为了击退"异教徒"或"夺取圣地"，或者是为了其他任何当时流行的牵强附会的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You are quite right. When Marie engages with her foes upon the battlefield, I believe it is one of two things: either, she is having a bit of fun, play-acting as an ancient crusader, imagining herself in the shining armor of a Knight of Sol -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你说得很对。当玛丽在战场上与敌人交战时，我认为只有两种可能：要么她是在享受战斗的乐趣，扮演着古代圣战士兵的角色，想象自己身披闪亮的太阳神骑士盔甲——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Is the tree not nourished by the light of Sol, perhaps? Is there not a common ground on which she could break bread with them? She is more apt to sit and listen to their stories, than seek to harm them for their faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 难道这棵树不是沐浴着太阳神的光芒吗？难道她就不能和他们一起擘饼吗？她更愿意坐下来倾听他们的故事，而不是因为他们的信仰而伤害他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The Luminary Orthodoxy has no army, and wages no wars. They do not bar those in their order to take actions or to protect others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 双耀神正教没有军队，也不发动战争。但他们不阻止其信徒采取行动或保护他人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Or, most likely, she is remembering Astaphor 8:23 "Lonely are the souls who seek to enter my house by violence, for they are the ones cast from the light of Sol."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或者，​更​有​可能​的​是，​她​谨记​《阿斯塔记》​第 ​8​ 章 23​ 节：​"那些​试图用​暴力​进入​我​殿宇​的​人​是​孤独​的，​因为​他们​是​被​太阳神​之光​所​抛弃​的​人。"​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is, to say, yes, proceed. You cannot make this any more "odd" for me by asking whatever it is over which you are curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也就是说，可以，请继续吧。就算你再问你好奇的那些事，也不会让我觉得更"奇怪"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When she engages with her foe upon the battlefield, I believe it is one of two things: either, she is having a bit of fun, play-acting as an ancient crusader, imagining herself in the shining armor of a Knight of Sol -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当她在战场上与敌人交战时，我认为只有两种可能：要么她是在享受战斗的乐趣，扮演着古代圣战士兵的角色，想象自己身披闪亮的太阳神骑士盔甲——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In her eyes, the violence she commits is righteous in the name of defending a greater good - as would you, as would those you fight beside, I assume.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在她看来，她所犯下的暴力行为是为了捍卫更大的利益而进行的正义行为——我想，你也会这么认为，你并肩作战的人也会这么认为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And, therefore, those she fights - regardless of their religion - are cast from Sol. Even if they were to wear the holy cloth of her own order, they are in her eyes, heathens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因此，凡是与她交战的人——无论其信仰如何——都会被逐出太阳神的殿。即便他们身着她教团的圣袍，在她眼中，他们也是异教徒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am being intentionally elusive, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我是故意避开这个话题的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For what it is worth, Marie... has told me you mean well. And I believe her, even when I do not believe myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不管怎样，玛丽告诉我你是好意。即使我不相信自己，也会相信她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All I may do is beg your patience, in the end. Lua knows I run short of it with myself most days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 到头来，我或许只能恳求你的耐心了。月神知道，大多数时候我对自己都缺乏耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Very well. If you will not be dissuaded, and you are so curious? I am not as troubled by the death I cause as... perhaps you might expect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好吧。既然你执意不肯罢休，而且你又如此好奇？我并不像你想象的那样，对造成的死亡感到不安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Or that one might feel is "proper" for a man of the cloth and a scholar such as I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或者说，对于像我这样的神职人员和学者来说，这可能不算是"恰当的"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, it does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，​这代价确实​笼罩​了​我。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，你会惊讶的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You are not to blame, Drifter. I am, as our brothers and sisters from Libertatia might say, a "hard nut to crack."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，这不是你的错。正如我们来自自由国的兄弟姐妹们可能会说的那样，我"很难对付"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The horrors that echo within my mind seem to know no boundaries. I witness chains of human sinew that once oozed with fresh crimson, turned brittle and blackened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 萦绕在我脑海中的恐怖景象似乎没有尽头。我亲眼目睹的曾经鲜红欲滴的人类筋腱，如今已变得脆弱焦黑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am merely a besieged individual. I hold the wall. To open the gate is to threaten the integrity of the defenses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是个被围困的个体。我坚守着城墙。打开城门就等于威胁到防御工事的完整性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see a hundred thousand visages of my own self, similar but foreign. Hollowed caskets, corpses of twisted, broken human flesh, suspended in the veil between life and death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我看到了成千上万张与我相似的面孔，却又陌生。空洞的棺材，扭曲破碎的人类血肉之躯，悬浮在生死之间的帷幕之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Expressions locked in a mask of empty repose. But in the flickering remains of their souls, embers that linger and do not die, I hear them screaming. Endlessly howling for retribution. For freedom.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们脸上的表情被空洞的平静面具所掩盖。但在他们灵魂残存的微光中，在那些徘徊不去的余烬里，我听到了他们的呐喊。他们无休止地呼喊着复仇，呼喊着自由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am starting to come to the distinct impression that I do not have a choice in this matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我开始越来越清楚地意识到，在这件事上我别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 呼喊着死亡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: These visions haunt my waking hours. My dreams. I have no nightmares, for that is all I experience - all I have become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这些异象在我清醒的时候、在我做梦的时候萦绕着我。我没有噩梦，因为我所经历的只有这些——让我变成了这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But, for what it is worth, Marie... has told me you mean well. And I believe her, even when I do not believe myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但不管怎样，玛丽告诉我你是好意。即使我不相信自己，也会相信她。
