/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All I may do is beg your patience, in the end. Lua knows I run short of it with myself most days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 到头来，我或许只能恳求你的耐心了。月神知道，大多数时候我对自己都缺乏耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only when I sacrifice to the whispers that echo within my soul, is the world reflected to me in a manner similar to that which you might find familiar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 只有当我顺从内心深处的低语时，世界才会以你可能熟悉的方式反映在我面前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only when I rend the flesh from my body as a sacrifice to the whispers that echo within my soul, is the world reflected to me in a manner similar to that which you might find familiar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 只有当我将血肉从身体上撕裂，作为献祭给灵魂深处回荡的低语时，世界才会以你可能熟悉的方式反映在我面前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Kindly do not pretend to know of what I "feel," Drifter. I fear you have only begun to understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，请不要假装了解我的"感受"。恐怕你的明白，才刚刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. Well. I have survived these long years. I will hold strong a few more, I am certain. You needn't worry overmuch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好了。嗯。这么多年来我都挺过来了。我相信我还能再坚持几年。你不用太担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am most certain you have, seeing some of it reflected in the imagery of this place. But do you think yourself paramount? Supreme Knower of All Horrors and All Suffering?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我非常肯定你有看过，因为从这个地方的景象中就能看出一些端倪。但你认为自己高人一等吗？是洞悉一切恐怖与苦难的至高无上的存在吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. Well. I have withstood them all my years. I will hold strong a few more, I am certain. You needn't worry overmuch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好了。嗯。这么多年来我都挺过来了。我相信我还能再坚持几年。你不用太担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Were that as simple a question as you believe it to be. Regardless, it is not one I am willing to answer today. I feel a headache coming on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果这个问题真像你认为的那样简单就好了。不过，我今天不想回答这个问题。我感觉头要疼了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am starting to come to the distinct impression that I do not have a choice in this matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我开始越来越清楚地意识到，在这件事上我别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It may seem strange to you that I am not in search of sympathy, Drifter. Answers are what I seek. Surety. Firmament, when all is illusion and lies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，或许你会觉得奇怪，我并非寻求共情。当一切都是幻象和谎言之时，我寻求的是答案，是确定性，是苍穹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Than allow me to bow down at your feet. Praise you for all you have endured. Wonder how you are still sane for all you have witnessed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，请允许我匍匐在你的脚下。赞美你所承受的一切。惊叹于你目睹了那么多，为何还能保持清醒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And marvel over how you still spare time for all the rest of us who you view so far beneath your vaulted status.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 惊叹于你那么高高在上，却仍然抽出时间来关心我们这些被你视为低下的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But, for what it is worth, Marie... has told me you mean well. And I believe her, even when I do not believe myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但不管怎样，玛丽告诉我你是好意。即使我不相信自己，也会相信她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All I may do is beg your patience, in the end. Lua knows I run short of it with myself most days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 到头来，我或许只能恳求你的耐心了。月神知道，大多数时候我对自己都缺乏耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is all one can ask for, is it not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这不就是我们所奢求的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I very much delight in listening to their banter, though as you can imagine, I do not myself partake. I have little to add to their discourse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很喜欢听他们闲聊，不过正如你所想，我自己并不参与其中。我没什么可补充的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I find him most agreeable. Indeed, of my new... cohorts, he is the one I find I am drawn to the company of the most.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得他非常讨人喜欢。事实上，在我新结识的这些伙伴中，我最喜欢和他待在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It concerns me though, when I find Roathe standing and conversing with Bird 3 at length. I do not know what he means to accomplish by doing so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，当我发现罗瑟站着和鸟三长时间交谈时，我感到很担忧。我不知道他这样做的目的是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though that likely comes as a surprise to absolutely no one, I suppose. We are of a very similar demeanor at first glance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过我想，这大概并不令人意外。乍一看，我们的性格非常相似。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is the young Operator that I find more strange... and the one they call the Lotus. And how we are kept at arms length from them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得更奇怪的是那个年轻的指挥官……还有他们口中的"Lotus"。以及我们和他们之间那种疏离感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We are allowed to interact, of course. But not like this. Not here. Why is that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们​当然​可以​交流，​但​不​是​以​这​种​方式，​不​是​在​这里。​为什么​会​这样​呢？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps that is wise. I would hate to see him manipulate those creatures into being objects of use more than they already have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许这是明智之举。我真不希望看到他继续操纵那些生物，让它们沦为他的工具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Roathe always has a motive in mind when he is conversing with anyone. I would hate to see him manipulate those creatures into being objects of use any more than they already have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 罗瑟与人交谈时总是别有用心。我真不希望看到他继续操纵那些生物，让它们沦为他的工具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It may be worth investigating, if you have the time. Though that is entirely your prerogative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你有时间，也许可以去了解一下。当然，一切看你的意愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. I have heard whispers of what they have been forced to endure. Tales of war and... broken friendship, torn asunder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。我听说他们被迫忍受的苦难。战争的故事，还有……破碎的友谊，支离破碎的友谊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is heartbreaking to me, what is destroyed in the act of war. Stranger to me still, what can be created by it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 战争所摧毁的一切令我心痛，而战争能孕育出的东西，则更令我感到不可思议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: M. Loid has told me of your "misadventure" in the Höllvania of your past, our future. Entrati certainly has made quite the mess of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 洛德先生跟我讲过你之前，也就是在我们的未来，在霍瓦尼亚的"不幸遭遇"。英择谛确实把事情搞得一团糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. Is that what they call it now? "Previous experience?" How remarkably tasteful. While Entrati seems to have made quite the mess of things, I am glad you have... found a way to entertain yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。现在都这么叫了吗？"使用经验"？真是妙极了。虽然英择谛似乎把事情搞得一团糟，但我很高兴你……找到了自娱自乐的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: M. Loid has told me of your "misadventure" in the Höllvania of your past, our future. Entrati certainly has made quite the mess of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 洛德先生跟我讲过你之前，也就是在我们的未来，在霍瓦尼亚的"不幸遭遇"。英择谛确实把事情搞得一团糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I am certain this was all by Entrati's grand and masterful plan. To entrust the fate of the future to you and a band of misfits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我确信这一切都是因为英择谛宏伟而精妙的计划。他要将未来的命运托付给你和一群乌合之众。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My grandparents met during the Gaullique Revolution. War and death have always been partners that lead to a dance of camaraderie in the strangest of ways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的祖父母就是在​高卢革命期间相遇。战争与死亡总是会用最奇特的方式促成了友谊的诞生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... Drifter - I know I am not the most... affable of individuals you are forced to interact with, and for that I continue to apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我——我知道我可能不太好相处，而且你还不得不和我打交道，为此我要再次向你表示歉意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me. It just seems to me that last we discussed matters, you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请原谅我。我只是觉得，上次我们讨论事情的时候，你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me. I do not know your heart nor the hearts of others. What you do in your own time with others is purely your business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对不起。​我​不​了解​你​的​内心，​也​不​了解​别人​的​内心。​你​私下里​和​别人​做​什么，​纯属​你​的​事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me. No, you are right. I do not mean to sound jealous or as though I fashion myself some kind of provocateur. What you do in your own time with others is purely your own business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对​不起。​不​是，​你​说​得​对。​我​并非​是​嫉妒​的​意思，​也​不​是​想​挑衅。​你​在​私人​时间​与​其他​人​怎么​相处，​纯属​你​个人​的​事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. Forgive me. I do not know your heart nor the hearts of others. What you do in your own time with others is purely your business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。对不起。​我​不​了解​你​的​内心，​也​不​了解​别人​的​内心。​你​私下里​和​别人​做​什么，​纯属​你​的​事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is simply the way that I am, and I know not how to change. Indeed, I do not think I am capable of undoing the damage to my soul that has been rendered unto me by the damned that have come to haunt me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我就是这样的人，我不知道该如何改变。事实上，那些恶鬼一直纠缠着我，它们对我的灵魂造成了无法弥补伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Never mind... I should not be surprised when hearts are fickle and quicksilvered. Particularly so when I am involved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 算了……我早该料到人心善变。尤其是当我牵涉其中时，更是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What lurks beneath this surface of fracturing glass is...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在这层破碎的玻璃表象之下，藏着的其实是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed. I suppose I should not resent any positives that should come from the darkness and destructions of war.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 的确如此。我不该对战争的黑暗与破坏所带来的那些积极影响心生抵触。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is not a tale I enjoy telling. To anyone. So you will forgive me if I am not overeager to share it. Perhaps another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这个故事我不太想对任何人说起。所以，如果我不太愿意分享，还请谅解。或许下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My grandparents met during the Gaullique Revolution. War and death have always been partners in a dance that leads to passion and love in the strangest of ways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的祖父母就是在​高卢革命期间相遇。战争与死亡总是会用最奇特的方式交织在一起，孕育出激情与爱情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And now I am deeply nervous... Dare I ask why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我现在非常紧张……请问是为什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Please continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: With all do respect, I do not know you. And with all the rest that I have heaped upon me, a romantic endeavor with a stranger is hardly my first priority.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恕我直言，我并不认识你。而且，即便我肩负着诸多责任，与陌生人发展恋情也绝非我的优先事项。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me. It is not a tale I enjoy telling. To anyone. So you will forgive me if I am not overeager to share it. Perhaps another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 抱歉。这个故事我不太想对任何人说起。所以，如果我不太愿意分享，还请谅解。或许下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Not the existence of love - perhaps the absence of it in my own family life. Forgive me. It is not a tale I enjoy telling. To anyone. So you will forgive me if I am not overeager to share it. Perhaps another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我抵触的不是爱的存在——而是它在我家庭中的缺失。抱歉。这个故事我不太想对任何人说起。所以，如果我不太愿意分享，还请谅解。或许下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am certain there are others who would find respite in the eager arms of another in instances such as this, but I am not one of those lucky souls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​确信，​在​这样​的​情况​下，​肯定​有​人​会​在​他​人​的​怀抱​中​找到​慰藉，​但​我​不​是​那个​幸运儿。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is too much for most to endure. And I thank you for continuing to attempt to do so. That is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对大多数人来说，这太难忍受了。感谢你们继续试着忍受。就这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am coming to that inevitable conclusion, yes. Good day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，我大概也只能接受这个事实了。祝你今天愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. Until we speak again, I wish you good day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。下次再聊，祝你一切顺利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Kindly seek out one of them, perhaps, instead. Good day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请你不妨在他们中找另一位。祝你今天愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Very well. We may speak of this another time, if you so choose. Until then, I shall return to my duties for the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好的。如果您愿意，我们可以改日再谈此事。在此之前，我将继续处理我今天的工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Such a concept is not as foreign to my heart as you might think it. Indeed it is not the notion of it that gives me pause as it is the parties involved - no offence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这种想法对我来说并不像你以为的那样陌生。事实上，真正让我犹豫的并非这种想法本身，而是其中牵涉到的每一个人——我并无冒犯之意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And perhaps how close to our new "home" your arrow seeks to fly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 还有就是你的箭究竟想向我们这个"新家"飞得多近。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, well... If I have decided I do not loathe you by the time we reach that point, perhaps we will reopen this discussion then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯……如果等我们到了那一步，我还没有决定讨厌你的话，或许我们可以重新开始讨论这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes... perhaps. If I have decided I do not loathe you by the time we reach that point. And that truly remains to be seen, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的……或许吧。如果等我们到了那一步，我还没有决定讨厌你的话。而这，漂泊者，还有待观察。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Until then, I must resume my duties for the day. I appreciate this... interesting conversation. I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在此之前，我必须继续履行今天的职责。我很欣赏这次……有趣的谈话。我想是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I insist to you that it brings me a modicum of peace, though I know it must still seem strange to you that it does so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我向你保证，它给我带来了一丝平静，尽管我知道这对你来说一定很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕这不是什么开心的故事。你确定要把时间浪费在这种事情上吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the grandparents who met during the Gaullique Revolution. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕这不是什么开心的故事。我已经跟你讲过祖父母在高卢革命期间相遇的故事。你确定你想把时间浪费在这种事情上吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the visions that sent me to the Cathedral to worship the Luminaries. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕​这​不​是​什么​开心​的​故事。​我​已经​跟​你​说​过​那些​指引​我​去​教堂​追随双耀神​的​异象。​你​确定​你​想​把​时间​浪费​在​这​种​事情​上​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the visions that sent me to the Cathedral to worship the Luminaries, and the grandparents who met during the Gaullique Revolution. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕这不是什么开心的故事。我​已经​跟​你​说​过​那些​指引​我​去​教堂​追随双耀神的​异象，还有祖父母在高卢革命期间相遇的故事。你确定你想把时间浪费在这种事情上吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, forgive me. I... apologize for how poorly I am handling all this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，对不起。我……很抱歉我处理这件事的方式不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would simply think there are better ways for you to spend your energies. Such as defending some bastion against an encroaching enemy party, discovering unknown knowledge... or sorting clothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我觉得你完全可以把精力放在更有意义的事情上，比如保卫堡垒抵御敌人入侵、探索未知的知识……或者整理衣物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am not quite often certain how one is to properly respond in situations such as simple curiosity over one's history - or even benign expressions of friendship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不太清楚在这种情况下，对于别人过往经历的好奇，甚至是善意的友谊表达，应该如何恰当地回应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Have you settled on a path, now? Or are your nerves simply more frayed than mine, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你已经决定好要走哪条路了吗？还是说，你的神经比我更绷紧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Regardless - you were enquiring as to my past, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不管怎样——你刚才是在问我的过去，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... find that your choice of words makes me trepidatious, I must admit. Though I do not know if you mean them the way I am interpreting them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说实话，你用的措辞让我有些不安。虽然我不知道你的意思是否和我理解的一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, and it is this... sentiment that makes me increasingly trepidatious, I must admit. For my peace of mind, simply confirm for me that you mean what I more and more increasingly fear you might.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 行，但我必须承认，正是这种……情绪让我越来越忐忑不安。为了让我安心，请你向我确认一下，你的意思是否和我越来越担心的一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It has likely come to your attention by now that I see... visions. This has been a part of my life ever since I was a small child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你​可能​已经​注意到，​我​能​看见……​异象。​自从​我​还​是​个​小​孩子​的​时候​起，​这​便​是​我​生活​的​一​部分​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You abandoned the pursuit with as much fervor as you began it. I assumed you had rightly decided it was a poor decision.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你放弃追求的热情和你开始追求的热情一样高涨。我以为你已经正确地意识到这是一个糟糕的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: These visions have not often been pleasant ones, to say the least.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这些异象，说得委婉点，往往都不是什么令人愉快的异象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I did not mean to rebuff you, but it is good to know where we stand. I... apologize for how poorly I am handling all this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我并非有意冷落你，只是我觉得我们需要先弄清我们之间的关系。我……很抱歉我处理这件事的方式不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I thought as much. I will therefore simply wish you a good rest of your day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我猜也是这样。因此，我只想祝你今天余下的时间过得愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Simply put? Well, yes. I... do not mean to rebuff your efforts. I am simply... unaccustomed... to affection, Drifter. Of any sort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 简单来说？嗯，是的。我……并非有意拒绝你的表白。漂泊者，我只是……不习惯……任何形式的爱意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I once awoke in the middle of the night to the visage of an old woman sitting at the foot of my bed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有一次我在半夜醒来，看到一位老妇人坐在我的床脚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I once awoke in the middle of the night to the visage of an old woman sitting at the foot of my bed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有一次我在半夜醒来，看到一位老妇人坐在我的床脚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They are not... unwelcome, per se? They simply are... perplexing, in the fact that they exist at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……没有不接受？这样的示好……只会令人费解，因为它们的存在本身就令人费解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you are set upon this path, I shall not deter you and I... I have found as unsettled and... foreign to me as this is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你决心走这条路，我不会劝阻你，而且……我发现这条路对我来说既令人不安又……陌生？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So thin and frail that she might have already been dead and buried for years, her skin clung to her bones so tight that I could see the spaces between them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她瘦骨嶙峋，仿佛已经死去多年，皮肤紧紧贴着骨头，我甚至能看到骨头之间的缝隙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So thin and frail that she might have already been dead and buried for years, her skin clung to her bones so tight that I could see the spaces between them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她瘦骨嶙峋，仿佛已经死去多年，皮肤紧紧贴着骨头，我甚至能看到骨头之间的缝隙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Her hair was barely more than a few wisps of white that hung limply from her head. But it was her eyes that I will remember most.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她的头发几乎只剩下几缕稀疏的白发，无力地垂在头上。但让我最难忘的还是她的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Her hair was barely more than a few wisps of white that hung limply from her head. But it was her eyes that I will remember most.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她的头发几乎只剩下几缕稀疏的白发，无力地垂在头上。但让我最难忘的还是她的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I... do not mean to rebuff your efforts. I am simply... unaccustomed... to affection, Drifter. Of any sort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，我……并非有意拒绝你的表白。漂泊者，我只是……不习惯……任何形式的爱意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am... perhaps, cautiously hopeful to see where this new path leads. However - you were enquiring as to my past, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……或许，带着些谨慎的期待，想看看这条新路会把我引向何方。不过——你刚才是在问我的过去，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For she had none at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为里面是空的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For she had none at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为里面是空的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Three months later, a woman in the village was discovered dead in her home. Her eyes, devoured by rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 三个月后，村里一名妇女被发现死在家中，双眼被老鼠啃噬殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Three months later, a woman in the village was discovered dead in her home. Her eyes, devoured by rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 三个月后，村里一名妇女被发现死在家中，双眼被老鼠啃噬殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I told my mother of what I had seen, the night the vision had woken me. She remembered what I had seen, same as I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我把那天晚上醒来时看到的异象也告诉过母亲。而她也记得那景象，和我看到的一模一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, Drifter. The visions frightened me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，漂泊者。那些异象吓到我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She beat me with a switch until I could no longer stand. My back would bleed until I would be forced to sleep lying face down. I still recall her screams as she would strike me. "Diable ! Sorcier !"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她用鞭子抽打我，直到我再也站不起来。我的背上鲜血淋漓，直到我被迫脸朝下躺着睡觉。我至今仍记得她抽打我时嘴里骂着"Diable ！Sorcier ！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know. All I know is she beat me with a switch until I could not longer stand. My back would bleed until I would be forced to sleep lying face down. I still recall her screams as she would strike me. "Diable ! Sorcier !"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道。她用鞭子抽打我，直到我再也站不起来。我的背上鲜血淋漓，直到我被迫脸朝下躺着睡觉。我至今仍记得她鞭打我时嘴里骂着"Diable ！Sorcier ！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Four, perhaps. Six, at the oldest. I do not know. We did not track our years with the same vehemence as you do now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也许是四岁吧。最多六岁。我不知道。我们不像你们现在这样热衷于记录年龄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My mother was long dead when we left to come here. And now, she is but dust. She lived a life of misery... and misery she was doomed to spread.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们动身来这里的时候，我母亲早已去世。如今，她也化作了尘土。她一生饱受苦难……而且注定要将苦难散播下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She was frightened. Whatever ails me, be it a burden of the gods, madness - a curse - she was ill-equipped to handle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她很害怕。无论我患了什么病，无论是神明的重担、疯狂，还是诅咒，她都无力应对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Regardless, for as cruel as my mother was? My father was worse. I shall spare you the details.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，即便我母亲再残忍，也没有我父亲残忍。细节我就不赘述了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps. I have often wondered if it was not part of the compulsion. But as I have told you before, it is also a method of Lua.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许吧。我常常在想，这会不会是某种驱使。但正如我之前跟你说过的，这也是月神的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps. I have often wondered if it was not part of the compulsion. But it is a method of Lua, of the Luminaries. I am not alone in its practice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许吧。我常常在想，这会不会是某种驱使。但这也是双耀神中月神的方法。我并不是唯一一个实践过这种方法的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As I grew older, the visions turned to voices. Whispers that came to me at all hours. Waking and dreaming. My work upon the farm suffered for it, and I suffered in turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 随着我长大，那些异象变成了声音。那些低语不时在我耳边响起，无论醒着还是在梦里。我的农活因此受到影响，而我自身也饱受折磨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It was taught to me by one of the other Fathers at the Cathedral, to help me... clear my mind. Those who are chosen by Lua are often "blessed" by "visions."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是教堂里另一位神父教给我的，目的是为了帮助我……清空思绪。那些被月神选中的人常常会得到"异象"的"祝福"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but I cannot also understate how difficult of a child I was to contend with, especially once I was taller and stronger in stature than them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很感激你的好意，但我得承认我小时候很难管教，尤其是我比他们更高更壮之后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My visions and the voices would often send me into violent fits, Drifter. I would often take a knife to carve my own flesh, as the pain would be the only thing to wake me from them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我的那些异象和声音常常让我陷入狂暴。我常常会拿刀割伤自己的身体，因为只有疼痛才能让我从痛苦中醒来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My visions and the voices would often send me into violent fits, Drifter. Torturing myself was often the only way to wake myself from what I saw.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我的那些异象和声音常常让我陷入狂暴。折磨自己往往是我唯一能从异象中醒来的方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But it was when the voices instructed me to
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但​就​在​那​时，​那些​声音​指引​我​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... I cannot. I simply cannot. Forgive me. My hands are trembling as I type this. I must stop for now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……我不想说了。我真的说不下去。抱歉。我打字的时候双手都在颤抖。我必须先停下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I will speak to you soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。我们很快再联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And to me. More than you can know, I think. Thank you in return, my friend. I will speak to you soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这对我意义也远超你的想象。朋友，也谢谢你。我们很快再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you wish. He was abandoned on our doorstep like a wounded feral cat. The story is not a terribly pleasant one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如你所愿。他像一只受伤的野猫一样被扔在我们家门口。这故事并不愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you wish. It is, however, not a terribly pleasant story. He was deposited upon our doorstep like a wounded feral cat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如你所愿。不过，这可不是什么愉快的故事。他像一只受伤的野猫一样被扔在我们家门口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It would be my expectation for someone of his status and disposition to feel wronged by the actions Entrati took against him. I would, quite honestly, be far more taken aback if he handled it with grace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 以他的地位和性格，被英择谛那样对待会有怨气再正常不过。说实话，如果他能以德报怨，我反而会更加惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It was a story about a stray cat that used to visit the Cathedral. What you glean behind its meaning, or my reason for telling it to you, is entirely your own responsibility. I am a priest, am I not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那是一个关于一只经常光顾教堂的流浪猫的故事。至于你从中领受到什么含义，或者我为什么要讲这个故事，完全取决于你自己。我可是个神父，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will attempt to summarize the events that led up to that moment, otherwise it may seem... nonsensical at best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我将尝试概括导致那一刻发生的事件，否则它看起来……充其量也只能说是很荒谬的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe where I left us, Entrati had recently returned from his disappearance with Roathe, as we see him now, already changed. Entrati revealed to us all the lies he had spoken for over three years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我记得上次说到，在失踪了一段时间后，英择谛刚和罗瑟一起回来，罗瑟就像我们现在看到的一样，已经被转化了。英择谛向我们揭露了他三年多来说的所有谎言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For three years, two months, and eleven days, he served as Cardinal Dimanche in our Cathedral. And for all that time, Marie and I served him unknowing of what he planned for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在长达三年两个月零十一天的时间里，他担任我们教堂的星期日主教。在那段时间里，我和玛丽一直侍奉着他，却对他为我们所做的安排一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He offered us the "protoframe serums" that made us what we are now, and once we had accepted them... immediately abandoned us once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他向我们提供了"原型战甲血清"，使我们变成了现在的样子，而一旦我们接受了它们……他又立即抛弃了我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know your questions before you ask them. What was he scheming? Did he infect the city, like I hear tell that he did to Höllvania? What were his plans? His discoveries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在你开口之前，我就知道你想问什么了。他究竟在密谋什么？他是否像我听说的对霍瓦尼亚那样，也感染了这座城市？他的计划是什么？他发现了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And there, we remained, as newly orphaned amalgams, with bodies and souls remade into creations we could barely comprehend let alone claim mastery over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 于是，​我们​被​留​了​下来，​如同​刚失去​父母​的​混合体，​身体​和​灵魂​被​重塑成​我们​几乎​无法​理解​的​造物，​更别​说​掌控​它们。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To these I will say, you will be disappointed. He preached. He studied. He rested. And he prayed. Then, one night, he disappeared in the midst of a terrible storm. The same as the one in which he appeared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 知道了这些问题的答案，你们会失望的。在那三年两个月零十一天里，他只是传道、学习、休息、祷告。然后，在一个夜晚，他在一场可怕的风暴中消失了。这场风暴和他出现时的风暴一模一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Stranded in a city that was our home, but no longer friendly to us. We were... forced to hide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们被困在了这座曾经是我们的家，却不再对我们友好的城市里。我们……被迫躲藏起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: One year to the day after that, he reappeared one final time, with... Roathe, as you see him now, collapsed and unconscious at his feet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一年后的同一天，他最后一次出现，而……罗瑟，正如你现在看到的样子，倒在他脚下，昏迷不醒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though I am well aware the storm did not occur for others, it was quite vivid to my senses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我知道其他人可能没有感受到这场风暴，但我却真切地感受到了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am not sure if it has escaped your notice, but Marie can fly, and Roathe is... blue, amongst other issues.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道你是否注意到，玛丽会飞，而罗瑟……是蓝色的，除此之外还有其他一些问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Not... precisely. We were forced from public life. But our fellow Brothers and Sisters did not exile us to the streets, or burn us at the stake. "Cardinal Dimanche" convinced them our changes were... the work of the Luminaries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不……确切地说。我们是被迫退出公众视野的。但教堂的修士与修女们并没有把我们流放到街头，也没有把我们绑在火刑柱上烧死。"星期日主教"让他们相信，我们的改变是……双耀神的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A devil in the flesh, or so it seemed. It was then, that Entrati told us the truth of who he was - when he hailed - and the true task he had for us. That he had chosen us both for a most "sacred mission."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他简直就是恶魔的化身，至少看起来是这样。就在那时，英择谛告诉我们他的真实身份——他来自哪个时代——以及托付我们的真正任务。他选中我们俩去执行一项"神圣的使命"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know you spend your days dallying with talking animals and skulls and pondering the question of the cosmic Void, but that is not standard issue for most humans.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道你整天和会说话的动物、骷髅头玩耍，思考宇宙虚空的问题，但这对于大多数人类来说并不是正常的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We were hidden within the crypts and kept out of sight. Our former brethren, though terrified of us, would bring us supplies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们被藏在墓穴里，不为人知。我们以前的弟兄们虽然害怕我们，但还是会给我们送来补给。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie accepted the serum readily. Of course, she did. How could she not? And how could I not follow her? How could I not seek the truth, wherever it might lead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽欣然接受了血清。当然，她会接受的。她怎么可能不接受呢？而我又怎能不跟随她呢？我又怎能不去追寻真相，无论真相会将我引向何方呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed, I am the one of the three of us that could perhaps wander amongst the crowd if I were to shroud myself well enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 事实上，如果我把自己伪装得足够好，我们三人中或许只有我能混入人群。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They... would insist on interacting only with Marie, despite her abrupt ghost-like appearances upon the stairs to greet them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们……坚持只和玛丽交流，尽管玛丽总是像幽灵一样突然出现在楼梯上迎接他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Our fellow Brothers and Sisters did not exile us to the streets, or burn us at the stake. "Cardinal Dimanche" convinced them our changes were... the work of the Luminaries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们的兄弟姐妹们并没有把我们流放到街头，也没有把我们绑在火刑柱上烧死。"星期日主教"让他们相信，我们的改变是……双耀神的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Roathe will know the specifics of precisely "how," but after... many years of work, he created a "Helminth" from samples of our blood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 具体"如何"做到只有罗瑟知道，但在经过多年的研究，他利用我们的血液样本创造了一个"Helminth"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do believe we have met, have we not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信你是见过我那一面的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Precisely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 正是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Roathe awoke. At first, he could barely remember his name. Entrati said one parting phrase to the bastard. "Uriel, Heretic of Xata, in banishment, answer - can the Orokin ever be forgiven?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 罗瑟醒了过来。起初，他几乎记不起自己的名字。英择谛临别前对这个混蛋说了一句话："Uriel，Xata 的异端者，在放逐中，作出回答吧——奥罗金能否得到宽恕？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I regret everything, Drifter. Yes, of course I do. But would I do it again? Yes, of course I would. I cannot leave Marie alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我对一切都感到后悔。是的，我当然后悔。但我还会再做一次吗？答案是，我当然会。我不能让玛丽一个人待着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We were hidden within the crypts and kept out of sight. Our former brethren, though terrified of us, would bring us supplies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们被藏在墓穴里，不为人知。我们以前的弟兄们虽然害怕我们，但还是会给我们送来补给。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe the Infestation is connected to itself through... time... somehow... though the details are quite lost on me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信 Infestation 能通过……时间……以某种方式相互联系……虽然细节我完全不明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In this, we are agreed. But I also cannot fault her for it. Give her time. She will come to understand. She is fiercely intelligent, Drifter. Do not treat her as a fool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在这点上，我们意见一致。但我也不能因此责怪她。给她点时间，她会想明白的。她非常聪明，漂泊者。别把她当傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Entrati departed then for the last time. And abandoned Roathe with us, now newly changed into what you see now - better able to contend with the temperamental devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 英择谛就此永远地离开了。他把罗瑟留给了我们，而我和玛丽如今已焕然一新，变成了你们现在看到的样子——更有能力对抗那喜怒无常的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To continue the tale... Entrati departed then for the last time. And abandoned Roathe with us, now newly changed into what you see now - better able to contend with the temperamental devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 故事继续……英择谛就此永远地离开了。他把罗瑟留给了我们，而罗瑟如今已焕然一新，变成了你们现在看到的样子——更有能力对抗那喜怒无常的魔鬼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They... would insist on interacting only with Marie, despite her abrupt ghost-like appearances upon the stairs to greet them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们……坚持只和玛丽交流，尽管玛丽总是像幽灵一样突然出现在楼梯上迎接他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am perhaps not the one you should ask about how many years passed after we were turned into talking Infested amalgams. My grasp on the passage of time since then has been... convoluted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你不应该问我，自从我们变成会说话的融合感染体之后过了多少年。从那以后，我对时间流逝的感知一直……很混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It sounds perhaps more harsh than it seems. There was nowhere else to put us. The belfry was too open, too exposed to the harsh elements. The crypt was sheltered and warm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 听起来或许比实际情况更残酷。我们别无选择。钟楼太敞开了，太容易受到恶劣天气的影响。而墓穴则温暖隐蔽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I cannot tell if that is comforting or dismaying to know, thank you. Strange enough to know now that the Infestation can talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道知道这件事是令人欣慰还是令人沮丧，谢谢。现在知道这些 Infestation 居然会说话，真是匪夷所思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And, unfortunately, we discovered it had exits that Roathe could use to... wander.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不幸的是，我们还发现它有出口，罗瑟则利用这些出口……四处游荡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do believe we have met, have we not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信你是见过我那一面的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Precisely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 正是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am perhaps not the one you should ask. My grasp on the passage of time since then has become... convoluted. Though perhaps it is more accurate to say "more convoluted." As though this could not get more horrifying...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你不该问我这个问题。从那以后，我对时间流逝的感知变得……混乱。或许说"更加混乱"会更准确一些。说得事情还不够可怕似的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Believe me, I know. And it is disconcerting, thank you. Although it seems every random household object in this place can speak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 相信我，我懂。这确实令人不安，谢谢。虽然感觉这地方的每个物件都会说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If the word you were going to say was "occupied," I have seen it as well, Drifter. That one that whispered. The one within the wall. I heard the tapping...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，如果你要说的词是"占据"，那么我也见过。就是那个会低语的。墙里的那个。我听到了哒哒声……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Please, do. Though, I would find it far more comforting I think, to have a musical instrument be some transient demigod than... whatever else has come to haunt and abandon my mind. Is it strange, that I... ever since he...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请你说说。不过，我觉得让一件乐器成为某种转瞬即逝的半神，远比让其他那些萦绕在我心头、最终离我而去的东西来得更令人欣慰。奇怪的是，自从他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am unsure if it is simply because of my unique sensitivity to the matter, or due to... the individual circumstances of my making, or... him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​不​确定​这​仅​仅​是​因为​我​对​这​件​事格​外敏感，​还是​因为​……​我​自己​的​情况，​或者……​因为​他​——​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is a voice that has beckoned to me that I know I have not heard my entire life, yet stretches into my past and far into my future...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我听到一个声音，那是我一生中从未听过的，但它却从我的过去一直延伸到我的未来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I know you shall think me a right lunatic when I say this, but I do not experience time in a... purely... linear fashion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道我说这话你会觉得我疯了，但我对时间的体验并不是……纯粹的……线性方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think it one of his few redeeming qualities. Not the theft, mind. The reasoning behind it. It is my theory he procured the illicit goods to goad Marie into conversations with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​认为​这​是​他​为​数​不​多​的​可贵​之处​之一。​我​指​的​不​是​偷窃​本身，​而​是​偷窃​背后​的​动机。​我​的​推测​是，​他​偷来​这些​赃物​是​为了​诱惑​玛丽​和​他​说话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is neither here nor there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这无关紧要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is not possible for it always to have been there. Yet I can recall it now, as clear as the silver light of Lua herself, behind the wall of my childhood home. A young man's voice. The presence of another standing beside him... "Rap tap tap..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它并不是一直都出现。然而，我现在仍能清晰地回忆起它，就像月神那银色的光芒一样，在我小时候家里的墙后闪耀。还有一个年轻人的声音……"哒、哒、哒……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And, perhaps, because they made her smile, when she thought he was not looking. Once, he said to me "it is a great fault of fate that she has been so deprived of life."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许是因为它们让她露出了笑容，在她以为他没注意的时候。有一次，他对我说："她如此被剥夺了生命，真是命运的一大憾事。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I - forgive me. I must go. I cannot speak of this yet. I am... I am sorry. Do not ask me about this again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……抱歉。我必须走了。我现在还不能说这件事。我……我很抱歉。请不要再问我这件事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What say you then, when I speak of a voice that has beckoned to me beyond my own rational mind? I know I have not heard it my entire life. It is not possible for it to have always been there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，​当​我​说​起​一​个​超越​我​的​理性​思维、​指引​我​的​声音​时，​你​又​会​作何​感想​呢？​我​知道​我​并​非​一生​都​听见​它。​它​并不​是​一直​都​在。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am perhaps not the one you should ask about how many years passed after we were turned into talking Infested amalgams. My grasp on the passage of time since then has been... convoluted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你不应该问我，自从我们变成会说话的融合感染体之后过了多少年。从那以后，我对时间流逝的感知一直……很混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yet I can recall it now, as clear as the silver light of Lua herself, behind the wall of my childhood home. A young man's voice... "Rap tap tap..."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，我现在仍能清晰地回忆起它，就像月神那银色的光芒一样，在我小时候家里的墙后闪耀。还有一个年轻人的声音……"哒、哒、哒……"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Conversation skipped due to previous setting of trigger warning.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [由于之前设置的触发警告，对话已跳过]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mm. I am honestly surprised it took this long for you to enquire about this particular trait of mine. It is usually that which most find cause to remark upon most readily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。说实话，我很惊讶你过了这么久才问起我的这个特点。通常来说，这恰恰是大多数人最容易注意到并加以评论的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You may ask, though I reserve the right to go no farther in the conversation if I feel it treads into an area of discussion I am no longer willing to partake in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你可以问，但在我觉得提到我不想讨论领域时，我有停止对话的权利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She alerted me that you two had spoken - yes, of course. You might be surprised at how little it troubles me to speak of this particular trait of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她告诉我你们俩已经聊过了——是的，当然。你或许会讶异我谈起我的这个特点时并没有不自在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you were to consider yourself a coward for this choice, I beseech you - do not. For this is a pain that is not yours to face. It is mine. You did not ask to bear this moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你因此觉得自己是个懦夫，那么我恳求你——不要这样想。因为这痛苦不该由你承受，而是由我承受。这一切并不是你自己选择承受的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Either for reasons of concern, disgust, or the morbid curiosity that might drive someone to peer through the bars of a lunatic's cage. I wonder, which are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许是出于担忧、厌恶，又或许是出于一种病态的好奇心——就像有人会透过疯子的笼子窥视一样。我想知道，你是哪一种？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is usually that which most find cause to remark upon most readily. Either for reasons of concern, disgust, or morbid curiosity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 通常情况下，这恰恰是大多数人最容易注意到并加以论断的事物。可能是出于担忧、厌恶，或是出于病态的好奇心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: This mechanical contraption at which we sit creates an impression of veiled impersonality. That we are somehow sheltered from whatever harm another might cause us through whatever words they type to us upon it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们用的这台机械装置给人一种冷漠疏离的感觉。仿佛我们被某种方式保护起来，免受他人通过它敲出的文字可能造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would argue instead the opposite - that free of the armor we don in our more mundane social interactions, we are stripped of that which might protect us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我反而认为恰恰相反——当我们卸下在日常社交互动中穿戴的盔甲时，我们就失去了那些可以用来保护我们的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... appreciate the delicate nature in which you are treating this, Drifter. Thank you. But I am quite used to this being a topic of discussion. Either for reasons of concern, disgust, or morbid curiosity - though I think you have already proven it to be the former.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我很感激你处理这件事的谨慎态度。谢谢。但我已经习惯了这成为人们的谈资。人们讨论它的原因可能是出于担忧、厌恶，或是病态的好奇——虽然我认为你已经证明了你是前者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Therefore, in situations like these... I am well aware that I let loose an arrow that might find not the battle-ready soldier, but the unsuspecting jugular of a deer in the woods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因此，在类似情况下……我深知我射出的箭可能射中的不是准备战斗的士兵，而是树林里毫无防备的鹿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Oh, my friend... there are no words that I can put down that will adequately express my sympathy for what you have endured.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，朋友……我无法用言语表达出我对你所遭受的一切的同情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I believe you are several years and one protoframe serum too late to put an end to this particular compulsion of mine - indeed, I fear it is now more of a required action, is it not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想你来得太晚了，已经晚了好几年，而且还没赶上那支原型战甲血清之前。你现在已经无法阻止我这种特殊的冲动了——事实上，恐怕现在这更像是一种我不得不做的事了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I fear it has not. It has taken something that was... a requirement to clear my mind of the visions that plagued me, and turned it into a requirement to wield the "gifts" of this serum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，​恐怕​并​没有。​它​只是​把​原本​是​为了​清除​那些​困扰​我​的​异象​而​必须​做​的​事情，​变成​了​为了​运用​这​种​血清​的​"恩赐"​而​必须​做​的​事情。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So I shall, therefore, leave you with this:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因此，我最后要告诉你的是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Language seems paltry when moments like these come to pass. We scramble to wield them as best we can, yet they always seem to fail us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在这种时候，语言显得苍白无力。我们想尽办法去运用语言，但它似乎总是无法传达真正的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am attempting not to chuckle at the notion of my ever approaching the concept of "all right." But I very much appreciate the sentiment, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我在努力克制自己，不让自己因为想到自己终于接近"一切安好"这个概念而笑出声来。但漂泊者，我非常感谢你的好意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I once more am attempting not to chuckle at the notion of my ever approaching the concept of "all right." But I very much appreciate the sentiment, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我再次努力克制自己，不让自己因为想到自己终于接近"一切安好"这个概念而笑出声来。但漂泊者，我非常感谢你的好意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We must remind ourselves how to find the strength to pull another to their feet, even when we cannot find the will to stand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们必须时刻提醒自己，即使我们自己没有勇气站起来，也要有力量去帮助别人站起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There are three things I might do, if you would indulge me, in light of your confession.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 鉴于你的坦白，如果你不介意的话，我可以做三件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I do not mean to be so flippant over what I believe is an expression of concern over my physical and mental well-being, forgive me. I simply do not think it is within my ability to cease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我并非有意轻率对待那些我认为是对我身心健康的关切，我很抱歉。我只是觉得我无法停止这种行为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If the ability to cure my compulsion to harm myself were within my grasp prior to injecting the serum, I believe joining with the "Harrow" Warframe has made it quite impossible now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果说在注射血清之前我​还​有​可能​治愈​自残​的​冲动，那么我相信，与"Harrow"战甲结合已经使这一切变得完全不可能了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is the true purpose of story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这就是故事的真正目的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: First; is that I am quick to assure you that I am in no danger. If you believe there is some deep and terrible self-loathing that drives my desire to harm myself, I would be quite eager to put those fears to rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 第一，我要向你保证，我没有陷入任何危险。如果你认为我伤害自己的欲望是由某种深藏的、可怕的自我厌恶所驱使的，我会很想消除这些恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If I might be quite crass, Drifter, I do not think I am capable of causing myself any real permanent harm in such a fashion any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恕我直言，漂泊者，我认为我再也无法以这种方式对自己造成任何真正的永久性伤害了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I... know that great melancholy, it does not inspire my thurible. (Marie would never allow it, for one. She is liable to feed it to me before she would let me near one ever again.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……了解那种深深的忧郁，但它并不能激发我使用香炉的欲望。（况且，玛丽绝不会允许我这样做。如果我真的再有靠近香炉的想法，她会把香炉塞到我嘴里。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I am not capable of the hubris required to think myself impervious, such an act seems... shall we say... part of the design.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我没有那种自负到认为自己刀枪不入，但这种行为似乎……我们不妨说……是设计的一环。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Be well, Drifter. We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，保重。我们很快会再联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But such deep pains have never whispered to me in the night, my friend. This, I can vow to you. This, I pledge to you, on all that I hold dear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但朋友，我从未在夜里听到过这些深切的痛苦低语。我可以向你发誓，我以我所珍视的一切向你保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is a complicated topic, as the reasons behind my rending my own flesh are not singular. I must start by saying that the matter is not nearly as taboo as it may seem to you in this day and age.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这是一个复杂的问题，因为我自残的原因并非单一的。首先我必须声明，在我们那个时代，这种行为本身并不像你想象的那样禁忌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is a complicated topic, as the reasons behind my rending my own flesh are not singular. I have told you of the visions that plague me, and that the pain clears my mind. But the act itself is not so taboo as you might believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这​是​一​个​复杂​的​话题，​因为​我​自残​的​原因​并​非​单一​的。​我​曾​告诉​过​你​那些​困扰​我​的​异象，​以及​疼痛​如何​让​我​头脑​清醒。​但​这​种​行为​本身​并​不​像​你​想象​的​那样​禁忌。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have spoken to you the truth of what inspires me to act - the pain clears my mind of the visions that plague me. And the practice is not so shamed amongst the Brothers of Lua as it might be in your culture. I can vow upon all I hold dear there is no hidden secret I am withholding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我已经向你坦白过我行为的真正动力——痛苦能让我摆脱困扰我的异象。而且，这种做法在月神兄弟会中，并不像在你们文化中那样令人羞耻。我可以以我所珍视的一切发誓，我没有任何隐瞒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Second; I must commend you on your bravery to send these words to me. It would have been easier to avoid them. You did not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 第二，我必须赞扬你的勇气，你竟然能把这些话告诉我。你完全可以避而不谈，但你没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Amongst the Brothers of Lua, there is an ancient practice of flagellation. It is rare, and even in my day it was seen as archaic and used by those who were "blessed by her visions."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在​月​神​兄弟会​中，​有​一​种​古老​的​鞭笞​习俗。​这​种​习俗​十分​罕见，​即使​在​我​那个​年代，​它​也​被​视为​一​种​古老​的​习俗，​只有​那些​"蒙受​她​异象"​的​人​才​会​使用​这个​方法。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you believe there is some deep and terrible self-loathing that drives my desire to harm myself, I would be quite eager to put those fears to rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你认为我伤害自己的欲望是由某种深藏的、可怕的自我厌恶所驱使的，我会很想消除这些恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not think what I do is "right." I do not think what I do should be practiced by others. I do not think what I do is enviable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不认为我做的事情是"正确的"。我也不认为别人应该效仿我做的事情。也不认为我做的事情值得羡慕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Third; I do not, nor shall I never comprehend the context of what your companion suffered. And, in a way, no one but they themselves ever shall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 第三，我无法也永远无法理解你同伴所遭受的苦难。某种程度上，除了他们自己，恐怕没有人能够真正理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: One of the Fathers at the Cathedral taught it to me, not long after I arrived, when he saw that I was similarly... "blessed," and saw fit to aid me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我刚来不久，教堂的一位神父就教了我这方法，因为他看到我也同样"蒙福"，觉得应该帮助我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I... know that great melancholy, it does not inspire my thurible. Marie would never allow it, for one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……了解那种深深的忧郁，但它并不能激发我使用香炉的欲望。况且，玛丽绝不会允许我这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: However it is not - in my incredibly unique and rather "supernatural" in the most literal sense of the word, state - strictly dangerous for me, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，就我这种极其独特且在最字面意义上可以说是"超自然"的状态而言，这种事对我来说也并非绝对危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To suffer in such a way that is so all-consuming is, by its definition, a solitary thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如此令人身心俱疲的痛苦，从本质上来说，是一种孤独的体验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed, I have often wondered if there were not some modern miracle of science that could aid me with my afflictions. Were I in a condition to accept any such help, I would take it. I doubt my physiology would allow for it, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 的​确，​我​常​常​想，​现代​科学​是否​有​某​种​奇迹​能够​帮助​我​摆脱​痛苦。​如果​我​的​身体​状况​允许，​我​一定​会​接受​这样​的​帮助。​但​我​现在​怀疑​我​的​生理​机​能​根本​就​没有​这个​选项。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I simply pray to my god, and yours, and theirs, that you do not hold guilt in your heart. For if anything in this world or any other is to be forgiven, it is the kindness of knowing someone who has suffered so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只向我的神、你的神、还有他的神祈祷，愿你心中不要怀有愧疚。因为如果说这世间或来世有什么值得被宽恕的，那就是对一个曾遭受如此苦难的人心存善意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Regardless, I assure you - I will not die of this. It is a burden I have carried with me since I was a child. And it is a symptom I have decided is better than the underlying festering wound, should I leave the scab un-picked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无论如何，我向你保证——我不会因此丧命。这是我从小就背负的重担。而且，我认为这种症状总比让伤口溃烂化脓要好，如果我不去揭开结痂的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will not find cause to argue with you there. I am fascinated by the differences in religious ceremonies. I deeply enjoy studying all documentation of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我同意你的看法。我对宗教仪式之间的差异非常着迷，也十分喜欢研究所有相关的文献资料。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Be well, Drifter. We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，保重。我们很快会再联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Religious anthropology is a subject near and dear to me. There is much you can learn from a society and a people by studying their rituals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 宗教人类学是我非常喜爱的一门学科。通过研究一个社会和一个民族的仪式，我们可以了解很多关于他们的信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you believe there is some deep and terrible self-loathing that drives my desire to harm myself, I would be quite eager to put those fears to rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你认为我伤害自己的欲望是由某种深藏的、可怕的自我厌恶所驱使的，我会很想消除这些恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is a Luminary sect in the far frozen north who worship a corpse they unearthed from a receding glacier. It was perfectly preserved, and no one is certain how old it is. But the brass disk it wore around its neck was stamped with the image of a sun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在极北之地，有一个圣光者教派，他们崇拜着一具从消融的冰川中挖掘出的尸体。尸体保存完好，无人知晓它的确切年代。但它脖子上佩戴的黄铜圆盘上，刻着太阳的图案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will promise you this, however - should I ever truly fear that it comes to a moment that I can no longer trust myself, I will speak the words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我可以向你保证——如果我真到了某种时刻，我再也无法相信自己，我一定会说出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I... know that great melancholy, it does not inspire my thurible. Marie would never allow it, for one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……了解那种深深的忧郁，但它并不能激发我使用香炉的欲望。况且，玛丽绝不会允许我这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They believe the mummified body to be that of Sol himself. And they believe that someday he will return to life and rise again. Every hundred years, they prepare for "The Great Eve" and many of their followers drink poisoned wine the night before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们相信这具木乃伊就是太阳神的遗体。他们相信他终有一天会复活，再次降临。每隔一百年，他们都会筹备"大前夜"，许多信徒会在前夜饮用掺有毒药的葡萄酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To Marie, to you, to M. Loid, even to Roathe, it will not matter. I will speak the words. This, I vow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对玛丽，对你，对洛德先生，甚至对罗瑟说，不管是谁。我会说出来。我发誓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Needless to say, when their mummified body has failed to return come the morning, they have a perfectly good reason as to why their calculations had been wrong, and the date is shifted another century or so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 可想而知，当第二天早上他们的木乃伊尸体没有复活时，他们就有了充分的理由来解释为什么他们的计算是错误的，日期又被推迟了一个世纪左右。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I have digressed quite far from the topic at hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我似乎已经偏离主题太远了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I deeply appreciate your desire to know that I am not acting out of some unfettered drive to destroy myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我非常感激你希望确认我的行为并非出于某种不受约束的自毁冲动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am not accustomed to having such companions in my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​还​不​太​习惯​生活​中​有​你​这样​的​朋友。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Be well, Drifter. We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，保重。我们很快会再联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Drifter? May I apologize to you for something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者？我能为一件事向你道歉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I appreciate that, I do feel as though you are owed one all the same. I shall do my best to keep this brief, and not to overburden myself with needless erudition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我很感激，但我仍然觉得你理应得到一个道歉。我会尽量言简意赅，避免赘述不必要的术语。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I shall do my best to keep this brief, and not to overburden myself with needless erudition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。我会尽量言简意赅，避免赘述不必要的术语。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Conversations are difficult for me. Far more so in intimate engagements than they are in these kinds of impersonal, mechanical ones or by post.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对我来说，交流很困难。尤其是在亲密的交流中，这种困难远比在冷冰冰、机械式的交流或书信往来中要严重得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know how to describe it - save for that it is... like I am grasping for something, only to see bits of dust slip through my fingers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道该如何形容——只能说……就像我拼命想抓住什么东西，却眼睁睁地看着灰尘从指缝间溜走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It feels oft as though I am an empty scrap of canvas, smearing oil paints upon its surface - uselessly attempting create a shadow of an image that I can see in my mind's eye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我常常觉得自己像一张空白的画布，在上面涂抹油彩——徒劳地试图勾勒出我脑海中所见图像的轮廓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yet the more and more I work, the more and more hopeless it becomes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，我越努力，就越感到绝望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The more I try, the more it eludes me. So I have simply learned... not to make any attempt at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我越尝试，就越是失败。所以我干脆就什么都不尝试了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is why I avoided you at first. And why I am still... prone to bouts of solitude. Words escape me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这就是我一开始躲着你的原因。也是为什么我至今仍然……容易陷入独处。我不知该如何表达。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... will remember that. Thank you, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……会记住的。漂泊者，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I had not realized. I will remember not to assume I am so alone in this world... Thank you, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我之前没意识到。我会记住，在这个世界上我不是一个人……漂泊者，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. Thank you, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。漂泊者，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There are a great many things bothering me, Drifter. The topic of the Indifference and conceptual embodiment, I fear, is merely one of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，困扰我的事情很多。恐怕关于虚空无情之物和概念成形的话题只是其中之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am unsure as any time is a "good" time to discuss the tangible problem this has caused me, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，我不确定现在算不算一个"合适"的时间去讨论这个问题，因为它确实已经对我造成了实际影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I shall summarize, though I am shocked you have avoided his rants on the topic. He is quite overeager to share them at every opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会简单说说，不过我很惊讶你竟然没看过他在这个话题上的长篇大论。他可是恨不得抓住一切机会来发表这些言论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The issue at hand, Drifter, is that I do not know. If I knew the answer, I would not be tearing myself apart with such an internal debate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，问题是我不知道。如果我知道答案，我就不会陷入如此痛苦的内心挣扎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Or potentially two, depending on how you wish to interpret the situation. Though I suppose that is indeed the heart of my dilemma.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或者这两者都是，这取决于你如何解读这种情况。不过我想，这的确是我困境的核心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But as such, now is therefore, as "good" a time as any. It intrigued me that you seemed to side with Roathe in your belief that the Indifference was not a true god.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，现在也算是"合适"的时机了。令我感到好奇的是，你似乎赞同罗瑟的观点，认为虚空无情之物并非真正的神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He believes that the Indifference is not a god of the Void, in any sense of the word, and was in fact crafted by Entrati and all those who interacted with it afterwards -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他认为，虚空无情之物并非虚空之神，无论从哪个意义上来说都是如此，它实际上是由英择谛以及之后所有与它接触过的人共同创造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: However, I should... start at the beginning. You will not understand precisely why this particular topic is of such import to me if you do not have some context...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，我应该……从头说起。如果你不了解一些背景，就无法明白为什么这个话题对我如此重要……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - created it from the Void via what you know as "conceptual embodiment."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——通过你所知的"概念成形"从虚空中创造出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am a Brother of Lua. I have dedicated my life to her worship. All my life, I have believed this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我是属于月神兄弟会的。我毕生致力于对她的崇拜。我一生都坚信这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Much in the same way you created Duviri, I believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信，你创造双衍王境的方式也与之非常相似。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And throughout all my years since arriving to the church, I have held fast to my faith - to what has been the firm knowledge that my suffering, my pain, and my visions -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 自从我来到教会以来，这么多年来，我一直坚守着我的信仰——我坚信，我的苦难、我的痛苦和我的异象——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - have been in her service. Have been in her name. And have been for her purpose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——都是为了侍奉她。都是以她的名。都是为了她的旨意而存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That was... until "Cardinal Dimanche" revealed himself to be Albrecht Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 直到"星期日主教"说他自己是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And he told us the truth of who he was, the tale of his misdeeds with the Void, and all that came of it. More specifically... all that came out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他向我们坦白了他的真实身份，讲述了他与虚空之间的种种罪行，以及由此产生的一切后果。更确切地说……是从中逃出的一切东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Correct. He told us of the sneering thing that greeted him, of the fingers he retrieved from that place that resembled his laboratory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没错。他告诉我们迎接他的那个冷笑的东西，以及他从那个酷似他实验室的地方取出的手指。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He told us of his descent in the seriglass bell into the emptiness. Of the place that resembled his laboratory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他告诉我们他乘坐玻璃钟舱下降到虚无之中的情景。那个地方酷似他的实验室。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Moreover, he told us of the great dread he felt, knowing he had unleashed a thing that could follow him not just through space, but through time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 此外，他还告诉我们他非常恐惧，因为他知道自己释放的东西不仅可以穿越空间，还可以穿越时间跟随他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A god of nothingness. A thing that must be contained. A creature of which he had pieces, who would scratch at the walls to be freed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那是虚无之神。是必须被禁锢之物。那根手指的主人，在墙后不停地抓挠，渴望挣脱束缚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A terrible and consuming god who was, and also was not, already free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那是一个可怕而又吞噬一切的神，他既是自由的，又是不自由的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Time is... tangled, for someone such as I, in the state I am now in. It is hard to describe, and I am doing a miserable job of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对于像我这种状态的人来说，时间是……纠缠不清的。很难描述，而且我在这方面做得非常糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Time is... tangled, for someone such as I, in the state I am now in. It is hard to describe. I have made a poor attempt to explain this once, and I failed miserably.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 时间……对于像我这种状态的人来说，是纠缠不清的。很难描述。我曾经尝试解释过一次，结果却很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would prefer to explain the details of it another time, as that is not the point of what I am trying to get to the heart of this day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想以后再解释细节，因为这不是我今天想表达的核心内容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know. And I have been egregiously avoiding the topic. His name alone
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道。而且我一直在刻意回避这个话题。光是他的名字我都想避而不谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know I have been egregiously avoiding the topic, and I apologize. But it is liable to send me into a vision from which I am not sure I may recover easily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道我一直极力回避这个话题，对此我深表歉意。但这个问题可能会让我陷入一种难以摆脱的异象中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I assure you, we will. I know I have been egregiously avoiding the topic, and I apologize. But it is liable to send me into a vision from which I am not sure I may recover easily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我向你保证，我们会的。我知道我一直极力回避这个话题，对此我深表歉意。但这个问题可能会让我陷入一种难以摆脱的异象中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: it threatens to
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它在威胁着

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not wish to once more have to cut this conversation short because I am unable to continue due to my own infirmities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​不​想​再次​因为​自身​的​体弱​而​不得不​中断​这​次​谈话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: it brings images of a man in chains
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它带来了锁链的景象

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: cast in blood
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 以血铸成

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I appreciate the sentiment. But I know I am but a shattered stained glass window on the best of days. I stand here wondering where many of the pieces have gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我感激你的好意，但我知道，即便在最好的情况下，我也只不过是一扇破碎的彩色玻璃窗。我站在这里，茫然地想着，许多碎片都去了哪里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I marvel at your patience. I know I am but a shattered stained glass window on the best of days. I stand here wondering where many of the pieces have gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。你的耐心让我惊叹。我知道，即便在最好的情况下，我也只不过是一扇破碎的彩色玻璃窗。我站在这里，茫然地想着，许多碎片都去了哪里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: hewn of sinew and flesh
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 以筋腱和血肉凿成

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Each time I find one that I have lost, I am more liable to cut myself on the edges than I am to do myself any good seating it back in place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 每次我找到丢失的碎片时，我更有可能被碎片的边缘划伤，而不是把它放回原位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: please make it stop
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 求你让它停下

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Sometimes I wonder if it would not be better to become one of those truly empty-eyed Harrows I see in my mind's eye, stretching as far as my nightmares will allow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有时我会想，如果我能成为我脑海中其中一个空洞的 Harrow，是不是会更好，这种感觉会随着我的噩梦延伸到极致。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text:
their faces
countless thousands
empty and broken
locked in silence
forever in shattered prayer
what I shall become
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText:
他们的脸
成千上万
空洞而破碎
于永恒的破碎的祈祷中
被永远封锁
而我将成为什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text:
that is where you are wrong
they are there
and they shall never leave me
never again
entrati saw to that
forgive me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText:
你错了
他们就在那里
他们永远不会离开我
永远不会
英择谛确保了这一点
原谅我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text:
tearing at my flesh
peeling it from my bones
why? to what end?
whose hunger does this feed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText:
撕裂我的血肉
将它从我的骨头上剥离
为什么？为了什么目的？
这究竟是为了满足谁的饥饿？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I - Surely, you jest. You cannot mean your words, after what you have just witnessed? Either you have lost your wits or your compassion has overcome your senses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我——你肯定是在开玩笑吧？在你亲眼目睹了这一切之后，你怎么可能会真心地说出这些话？要么你失去了理智，要么你的同情心蒙蔽了你的双眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text:
if only it were so simple
these chains have been mine for so long
longer than language
longer than my own name
forgive me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText:
如果事情真有那么简单就好了
这些锁链我已束缚太久
比语言更长
比我的名字更长
请原谅我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see M. Necraloid, and I hear tales of M. Ordis, or M. Otak. I think of the empty Warframes with their thoughts pulled from their skulls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​看见​了​殁世械灵​先生，​也​听​说​了​关于​ O​rdis ​先生​或​奥塔​先生​的​故事。​我​想​起​了​那些​空洞​的​战甲，​它们​的​思想​仿佛​​从头骨​中​被抽​离​出来。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Good. I am glad you have snapped out of your own momentary insanity. It must be contagious after all. Perhaps we should take an intermission from this device, as I fear it has begun to rot your brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很好。很高兴你终于从刚才的疯狂中清醒过来。看来这玩意儿确实会传染。或许我们应该暂时放下这个设备，因为我担心它已经开始腐蚀你的大脑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text:
yes
they will be there another time
this chamber of blood and chains
of waiting
forever waiting
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText:
是的
他们还会再来
这血与锁链的密室
等待的牢笼
永无止境的等待

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you... but I wonder, for how long, before the grief would become just another burden that was easier to bear in time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢……但我不知道，这种悲伤能持续多久，才能随着时间的推移，变成另一种更容易承受的负担？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I must beg your forgiveness. There are moments where my lucidity fails me, and I despise when others witness them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我必须请你原谅我。有时我会神志不清，我讨厌别人看到我这副模样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It would be so easy to surrender. To give up. To lay my agony at the altar of suffering and say no more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 屈服是如此容易。放弃是如此容易。将我的痛苦献祭给苦难的祭坛，然后说不再承受了也如此容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It would be so easy to surrender. To give up. To lay my agony at the altar of suffering and say no more. Or to do far worse - to do that which many have worried I might with a blade in the great dark of the night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 屈服是如此容易。放弃是如此容易。将我的痛苦献祭给苦难的祭坛，然后说不再承受了也如此容易。或者做出更糟糕的事——做出大家担心我会在黑夜里用刀刃做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I am flattered, I fear my answer is quite simply and unequivocally no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我深感荣幸，但我恐怕我的回答是非常简单明了的"不行"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is... merely one issue, Drifter. How might I take your words as truth when I know you have spun falsehoods before?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，只是……有一个问题。我知道你以前说过谎，你要我怎么相信你说的是真话呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am without words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我无言以对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But it... is... not who I am. And it is not who I shall ever be. I am to remain as this... broken bulwark, this shattered shield...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但这……并非……真正的我。也永远不会成为真正的我。我注定要永远是这……破碎的堡垒，这破碎的盾牌……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have caught you in a lie already. Though I do not know the purpose of this one, I fear you have already broken my ability to trust you.
