/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我已经发现你撒谎了。虽然我不知道你这次撒谎的目的是什么，但恐怕你已经完全摧毁了我对你的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Which I know is not entirely uncommon for me, however, I feel as though I should reply to this in some
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道这种情况对我来说并非完全罕见，但是，我觉得我应该就此作出一些回应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Always to bleed, yet never to die...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 血流不止，却永远不死……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So, while I am deeply flattered, I fear my answer is quite simply and unequivocally -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以，虽然我深感荣幸，但我恐怕我的回答非常简单明了——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - in some clever fashion or at least in some manner that would seem fitting for the situation and not -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——以某种巧妙的方式，或者至少以某种似乎适合这种情况的方式，而不是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am all right to continue, thank you. It has passed, as they always do. These... visions of mine are like clouds that pass over Lua. They can be total in their darkness, but they are often brief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我可以继续，谢谢你。一切都过去了，就像它们总是会过去一样。我这些……异象就像掠过月球的云朵。它们可能完全笼罩在黑暗之中，但通常转瞬即逝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Surely, you jest. You cannot mean your words, after what you have just witnessed? Either you have lost your wits or your compassion has overcome your senses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你肯定是在开玩笑吧？在你亲眼目睹了这一切之后，你怎么可能会真心地说出这些话？要么你失去了理智，要么你的同情心蒙蔽了你的双眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, thank you. It has passed, as they always do. These... visions of mine are like clouds that pass over Lua. They can be total in their darkness, but they are often brief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没事，谢谢你。一切都过去了，就像它们总是会过去一样。我这些……异象就像掠过月球的云朵。它们可能完全笼罩在黑暗之中，但通常转瞬即逝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: C'est la vie, eh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: C'est la vie，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不行。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - and not give you the impression that it is not requited as that is very much not the case -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——不是让你觉得这种付出没有得到回报，因为事实并非如此——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We have wandered far from the point of this conversation, haven't we? I am so very sorry. You do not need to suffer such magniloquent, self-pitying maundering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们好像偏离了谈话的主题，对吧？我非常抱歉。你不需要忍受这么多自以为是、矫揉造作的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lua on high... where was I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 月神在上……我刚才说到哪儿了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Good. I am glad you have snapped out of your own momentary insanity. It must be contagious after all. Perhaps we take an intermission from this device, as I fear it has begun to rot your brain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很好。很高兴你终于从刚才的疯狂中清醒过来。看来这玩意儿确实会传染。或许我们应该暂时放下这个设备，因为我担心它已经开始腐蚀你的大脑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I try not to make my concerns the burdens of others when I can help it. But I appreciate the opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。我尽量避免让自己的担忧成为别人的负担。但我很感激你给我这个机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Quite. Yes. And to avoid the issue of it truly becoming circular, we will move past that point in the story, if you please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没错。是的。为了避免陷入循环论证，我们还是跳过故事中的这一点吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That made me chuckle. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这让我忍不住笑了。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lua, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 月神在上，我愿意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Imagine my dismay when Entrati informed me, however, that the voices in my mind and the visions I had suffered my entire life were not the result of Lua -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，​英择​谛告诉​我​的​真相​让​我​感到​无比​沮丧，​他​说​我​脑海​中​的​声音​和​我​一生​所​遭受​的​异象​并​非出自月​神​——​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - but the corruption of the Indifference upon the timeline.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——而是出自虚空无情之物对时间线的腐蚀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, yes, yes!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 愿意，愿意，愿意！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Precisely what I asked him at the time. He explained to me the concepts of "quantum entanglement", "superposition" and "eternalism" -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这正是我当时问他的问题。他向我解释了"量子纠缠"、"叠加"和"永恒论"的概念——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He came with proof of his impossibilities. I knew he was Albrecht Entrati, not Cardinal Dimanche. But to say that all that I was - all that I believed - was the work of the Indifference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而他带来了证据，证明了他口中那些不可能的事。我知道他是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛，而不是星期日主教。但要说我的一切——我所信仰的一切——都是出自虚空无情之物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I did not know what to believe, at first. He came with proof of his impossibilities. I knew he was Albrecht Entrati, not Cardinal Dimanche. But to say that all that I was - all that I believed - was the work of the Indifference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 起初我不知道该相信什么。然而他带来了证据，证明了他口中那些不可能的事。我知道他是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛，而不是星期日主教。但要说我的一切——我所信仰的一切——都是出自虚空无情之物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And while it all made sense to me in a superficial, scientific way, I did not truly understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然从表面上看，这一切在科学上都说得通，但我并没有真正理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That I had prayed in service to a false god and to Lua, all my years?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我竟然一生都在侍奉假神而不是月神？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I did not know what to do. I still do not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我当时不知所措，现在也不知道该怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: This is precisely the reason I attempt not to grapple with the specifics on most days...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这正是我大多数时候尽量不去纠结细节的原因……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And lo, you see the problem I face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 瞧，这就是我面临的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Matters grew far worse when Roathe arrived. For my crisis of faith became one layer more complicated when I learned that the Indifference is not a god at all -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 罗瑟到来后，情况变得更加糟糕。因为我得知虚空无情之物根本不是神，我的信仰危机也因此变得更加复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you still wish to hear the situation between myself and Roathe? I fear it has become suddenly and laughably unimportant in my mind today.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你还想听听我和罗瑟之间的事情吗？恐怕今天这件事在我心中已经变得既无关紧要又可笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - but a mere product of human hubris.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——但这不过是人类傲慢的产物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What am I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I. Well. Yes. I. I do suppose. That is. That is
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我。嗯。是的。我。我想也是。那就是。那就是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do suppose that is
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​想​这​事​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am only a statue of flesh, fashioned in worship to false idols, designed only for suffering...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是一尊血肉之躯的雕像，为崇拜虚假的偶像而造，存在的唯一目的就是承受痛苦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: one way of putting things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也​可以​这么​说。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: one way of putting things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 也​可以​这么​说。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I am... deeply touched, and I... do not know the customs of this time, I fear I must refuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……深受感动，也……并不了解这个时代的习俗，但我恐怕还是不得不拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I am... deeply touched, and I... do not know the customs of this time, I fear I must refuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……深受感动，也……并不了解这个时代的习俗，但我恐怕还是不得不拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you are otherwise currently... engaged with Roathe. I do not wish to even comprehend the kind of complications such an entanglement would cause.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 鉴于你目前……与罗瑟有所牵连。我甚至不愿去想象这种纠葛会造成怎样的复杂局面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My mind is complicated enough, I fear, to think of you and he, a man I know so well, together. Perhaps I am old-fashioned in that regard. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕我的思绪太过复杂，以至于无法想象你和他这个我如此熟悉的人——在一起的画面。或许我在这方面有些老派。我感觉自己就像个行走的古董。为此，请你原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do you still wish to hear the situation between myself and Roathe? I fear it has become suddenly and... laughably topical, has it not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你还想听听我和罗瑟之间的事情吗？恐怕今天这件事在我心中已经变得……可笑了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you are otherwise currently engaged with Marie. She is too dear to me to think that my relationship with you might detract from hers. Or distract from it in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为你目前已经和玛丽在一起了。她对我来说太重要了，我不希望我和你的关系会影响到她，或者以任何方式分散她的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps I am old fashioned in that regard. She is like my family, and we are too close. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许我在这方面有些老派。她就像我的家人一样，我们关系太亲密了。我感觉自己像个行走的古董。为此，请你原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, I know you must have wondered after my story, and of the night when Lua was at her darkest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，我知道你听了我的故事后一定很想知道，也想了解月黑风高的那个夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, you have wondered after my past. And I know you must have wondered after this part of my story - of the night when Lua was at her darkest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，你一直对我的过去感到好奇。我知道你一定也对我的故事的这一部分感到好奇——关于月黑风高的那个夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, you have been patient with me. I know you have wondered after this part of my story - of the night when Lua was at her darkest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，你一直对我非常耐心。我知道你一定也对我的故事的这一部分感到好奇——关于月黑风高的那个夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, you have been patient with me, and kinder than you have had any right to be. I know you have wondered after this part of my story - of the night when Lua was at her darkest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，你一直对我非常耐心，也给了我不配得到的善意。我知道你一定也对我的故事的这一部分感到好奇——关于月黑风高的那个夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is a tale I vowed I would never speak. Only Marie knows of it, as she read it in my journals. And now, I shall put it here for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我曾发誓永远不会说出这个故事。只有玛丽知道，因为她从我的日记里读到过。而现在，我要把它写在这里，告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Once I begin, I cannot stop, for I will not be able to start again. So you will have to forgive me if I do not let you ask questions of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一旦我开始，就无法停止，因为我无法重新开始。所以，如果我不允许你问我问题，请你原谅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you were to consider yourself a coward for this choice, I beseech you - do not. For this is a pain that is not yours to face. It is mine. You did not ask to bear this moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你因此觉得自己是个懦夫，那么我恳求你——不要这样想。因为这痛苦不该由你承受，而是由我承受。这一切并不是你自己选择承受的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: This mechanical contraption at which we sit creates an impression of veiled impersonality. That we are somehow sheltered from whatever harm another might cause us through whatever words they type to us upon it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们用的这台机械装置给人一种冷漠疏离的感觉。仿佛我们被某种方式保护起来，免受他人通过它敲出的文字可能造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know there is not much I have told you about those who have raised me. And that is for good reason, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道我很少跟你们提起养育我的人。其实这是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We spoke of my family. Of my time upon the farm where I was raised. Of the visions that have plagued me and drove me to violence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们谈起了我的家人，谈起了我在农场长大的时光，谈起了那些一直困扰着我、驱使我走向暴力的异象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would argue instead the opposite - that free of the armor we don in our more mundane social interactions, we are stripped of that which might protect us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我反而认为恰恰相反——当我们卸下在日常社交互动中穿戴的盔甲时，我们就失去了那些可以用来保护我们的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My mother... took my visions as the work of the devil. And sought to beat them from me with a switch. Often until I could not stand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的母亲……把我的异象视为魔鬼的伎俩，并尝试用鞭子抽打我，让我无法再看到它们。她常常把我打得连站都站不稳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I told you of the voices that I would hear, whispering to me, calling to me from other rooms. Sometimes they sounded as though they called my name -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我跟你说过我听到的声音，它们从其他房间里传来，低声对我说话，呼唤我。有时，它们听起来就像在叫我的名字——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Therefore, in situations like these... I am well aware that I let loose an arrow that might find not the battle-ready soldier, but the unsuspecting jugular of a deer in the woods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因此，在类似情况下……我深知我射出的箭可能射中的不是准备战斗的士兵，而是树林里毫无防备的鹿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And my father? Well. For all my mother's cruelty, my father was worse. I shall save you the details.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 至于我父亲？唉。尽管我母亲已经够残忍了，但我父亲更甚。细节我就不赘述了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Other times, they would sound like nothing at all. Garbled nonsense, or the language of devils.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 有时，它们听起来什么都不是。全是含糊不清的胡言乱语，或是魔鬼的语言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So I shall, therefore, leave you with this:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因此，我最后要告诉你的是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But their violence was not without a match from my own. My visions often made me difficult to contend with - particularly when I was grown, and taller and stronger in stature than even my father.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我也反抗了他们的暴力。我的异象常常让我难以对付——尤其是我长大成人后，身形甚至比我的父亲还要高大强壮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: At first, the nonsensical ravings of the words terrified me. I begged them to make sense. I prayed to Lua for her spirits to tell me what they wished of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 起初，那些语无伦次的胡言乱语让我感到恐惧。我祈求它们能有意义。我向月神祈祷，希望她的灵能告诉我它们想要我做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We must remind ourselves how to find the strength to pull another to their feet, even when we cannot find the will to stand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们必须时刻提醒自己，即使我们自己没有勇气站起来，也要有力量去帮助别人站起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And these visions often took the form of voices. Sometimes they sounded as though they called my name -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这些异象常常以声音的形式出现。有时，它们听起来像是在呼唤我的名字——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But when I began to decipher what it is they desired - I regretted that for which I had so desperately prayed. For now, I knew the deeds they demanded I carry out in their name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但当我开始弄明白它们的意图时，我对自己曾经如此拼命祈祷的事感到后悔。因为现在，我知道了它们要求我以它们的名义去做的那些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That is the true purpose of story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这就是故事的真正目的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And oh, what a horrible price they would have paid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哦，他们为此付出了非常惨痛的代价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do not mistake me. I had no love for my father nor my mother. Whatever familial loyalty I might have felt for them was long since spent beneath a litany of bruises and scars.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 别误会我的意思。我对我的父亲和母亲都没有爱。我对他们可能曾经有过的一点亲情，也早已被无数的伤痕和淤青掩盖殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Be well, Drifter. We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者，保重。我们很快会再联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But what they cried out for me to do for them...? And what they compelled me to do, in that darkest of nights...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但它们呼唤我为它们做什么……？在那最黑暗的夜晚，它们又强迫我做了什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: -F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was barely even more than a boy - hardly even a man. Perhaps I was sixteen years? Eighteen? At first, I thought it all another terrible nightmare - a twisted dream.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我当时还是只个男孩——甚至算不上一个男人。也许我十六岁？十八岁？起初，我以为这一切都只是另一场可怕的噩梦——一场扭曲的梦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Figures stood around me, gaunt and twisted manifestations, made purely of malice and shadow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我周围站着一些身影，面容憔悴扭曲，完全由恶意和阴影构成。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Taunting me, demanding I do what must be done - that if those who claimed to love me would have my flesh... why I, in turn, must have theirs...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们嘲笑我，逼迫我去做必须做的事——如果那些声称爱我的人想要我的肉体……那么，我反过来也必须拥有他们的肉体……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When I awoke from the nightmare - or perhaps, I had always been awake, I do not rightly know - I had a hunting knife in my hand. And I stood at the door of my parents' room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当我从噩梦中醒来时——或许我一直都醒着，我也不确定——我手里拿着一把猎刀。我站在父母房间的门口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The moon was new. And the clouds were thick. There was not the barest of light by which to see. The darkness was absolute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 月亮是新月，乌云密布，一丝光线都看不见，一片漆黑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lua had abandoned me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 月神抛弃了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I could not answer the call of the voices. I could not give them the souls of my mother and father.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我无法回应那些声音的召唤。我无法将我父母的灵魂交给他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Into the empty night I fled. Into the deep woods, the branches tearing at my bare skin, though I could not have cared any less for the pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我逃进了空旷的夜色中，逃进了幽深的森林，树枝刮伤了我裸露的皮肤，但我对疼痛毫不在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I ran until my legs collapsed beneath me, unable to carry me any farther. I might have been weeping, I do not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我一路狂奔，直到双腿再也支撑不住，再也跑不动了。我当时可能在哭泣，我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But the manifestations had followed. And still, they whispered for blood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但那些情感具化还是跟过来了。而且，它们仍然低声渴望鲜血。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was hoping that if I could not see them, they might go away... when I drove that knife into my eye's socket...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我当时想，如果我看不见它们，它们或许就会消失……就在这时，我把刀子刺进了我的眼眶……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A shame I blacked out I and could not complete my task. Now, I will never know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真可惜我当时昏过去了，不知道后来发生了什么。现在，我永远也无法知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When I awoke, I was in the local parish of Lua. A Brother had found me, and bandaged my wounds. He asked me what I had been running from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我醒来时，发现自己身处当地的月神教堂。一位弟兄找到了我，并为我包扎了伤口。他问我，我一直在逃避什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was overwrought. I could not lie to him. I confessed it all - the visions, what they had told me to do. I expected condemnation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我当时情绪极度激动，无法对他撒谎。我把一切都告诉了他——那些异象，以及它们指示我去做的事情。我以为自己会受到谴责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When I finished, he simply smiled with such knowing sadness, and placed an amulet of Lua in my palm. "She is a blessing and a curse, my son."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说完后，他只是带着一种洞悉一切的悲伤微笑，然后将一枚月神的护身符放在我的掌心。"我的孩子，她既是福也是祸"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He sent me to the Cathedral in the Cité de la Lumière. And there I remained until Entrati found me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他把我送到光城的教堂。我就一直待在那里，直到英择谛找到我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There... now you have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 就这样……现在你明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And... now I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好了……我现在必须走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Conversation skipped due to previous setting of trigger warning.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [由于之前设置的触发警告，对话已跳过]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am not proud of this, but I have imbibed an entire bottle of wine and I am now ready to tell you all the rest of what I have been desperately trying not to, mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: mon miracle，我知道这不值得骄傲，但我把一整瓶酒都喝了，现在我准备把我一直拼命想隐瞒的事情告诉你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am not proud of this, but I have imbibed an entire bottle of wine and I am now ready to tell you all the rest of what I have been desperately trying not to...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道这不值得骄傲，但我把一整瓶酒都喝了，现在我准备把我一直拼命想隐瞒的事情告诉你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If this bottle is, indeed, wine, as it was not precisely labeled - and M. Loid was not exactly sure that what we had in my day and what he would know as wine are the same thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果这瓶酒真的是葡萄酒的话，因为它的标签上并没有明确标明——而且洛德先生也不确定我们那个年代的葡萄酒和他所理解的葡萄酒是不是同一种东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I did not intend to drink the whole bottle, in my defense... but I was attempting to discern if it was in fact the same substance and then it was gone...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我辩解说，我并没有打算喝光整瓶……我只是想确认一下它是否真的是同一种物质，然后它就不见了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Would that I could escape so easily. I do not blame you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 要是我也能这么轻易逃脱就好了。我不怪你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know! That was the most frustrating part of the entire thing! But that is not the point. The point was to get drunk. And I do not even know if I am that, either. I am certainly not sober, however -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道！这才是整件事最让人沮丧的地方！但这并非重点。重点是喝醉。而且我甚至不知道自己是否真的喝醉了。不过，我肯定不是清醒的——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Potentially. I am certainly not what one would consider sober by any means.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许吧。反正我肯定算不上他们眼中的清醒状态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So I suppose that will have to be good enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 所以我想这样就足够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Which was entirely the purpose of this entire endeavor. So I suppose that will have to be good enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这正是我们做这件事的目的。所以我想这样就足够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Rap... tap... tap...
I know for certain that they were not there within my mind my entire life. The Tenno known as Rell and his guardian Harrow. It is not possible that they were within the walls of my childhood home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很确定，在我的一生中，他们从未在我的脑海中出现过。那个名叫 Rell 的 Tenno 和他的守护者 Harrow。他们也不可能存在于我童年的家中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is no possible way that they echoed within my mind with the whispered, garbled voices of my visions all my years. Yet I see them there, hear him there, in my memories, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们不可能像我多年来在异象中听到的那些低语、含糊不清的声音那样，在我的脑海中不断回响。然而，我仍然能在我的记忆中看到他们，听到他的声音。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I understood all that Entrati said of how energy could exist in time in several places at once in a philosophical sense. But I did not understand it emotionally until I... injected the serum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 从哲学意义上讲，我理解英择谛所说的能量如何在时间和空间中同时存在。但直到我注射了血清，我才从情感上真正理解了这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is as though the moment I injected the serum - all things became one. When Entrati revealed himself, and all the truth of his existence -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我注射血清的那一刻——万物仿佛合而为一。当英择谛揭示了他自己，以及他存在的全部真相——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see sometimes in my mind's eye a great and shallow still lake that stretches out in all directions. Black and smooth, like an onyx scrying mirror.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我有时在脑海中会看到一个巨大而浅的静谧湖泊，向四面八方延伸。湖面漆黑光滑，宛如一面缟玛瑙镜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He laid out to me all that he knew of "quantum entanglement," "superposition," "eternalism," and the like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他向我详细阐述了他所了解的"量子纠缠"、"叠加"、"永恒论"等等概念。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A great black lake that flows out in infinity. Impossible to comprehend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一片浩瀚无垠的黑色湖泊，仿佛流淌到无尽的深渊。令人难以理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I understood it all in a scientific, rather philosophical sense. But I did not understand it emotionally until... I injected the serum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我科学的角度，而不是哲学的角度理解这一切。但直到我注射了血清，我才从情感上真正理解了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And that is where I would find them. That is where we would meet. And that is where I would feel Them as well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会在那里找到它们。我们会在那里相遇。我也会在那里感受到它们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The other Harrows... Empty statues of things, echoes of echoes of echoes... They go on and on and on for all eternity in all directions...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 其他的 Harrow……空洞的雕像，回荡着回荡的回荡……他们向四面八方无限地回荡……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Rell placed himself inside of one. Lost himself inside of it. And by doing so, lost himself inside all of them...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Rell 把自己置身于其中一个世界。迷失其中。如此一来，他也迷失在所有世界之中……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Including me. Including the Harrow that was in the serum that made me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 包括我。包括那铸就现在的我的 Harrow。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They were there with me, in my mind - Rell and his Harrow, so very much like me, and yet so very different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在我的脑海里，他们与我同在——Rell 和他的 Harrow，他们与我如此相似，却又如此不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He was unafraid. He was so very certain. Two things I was very much not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他毫不畏惧，而且信心十足。这两点我都非常不具备。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He stood fast against the Indifference, cared not for what it was or was not. Simply knew what needed to be done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他坚决对抗虚空无情之物，不在乎它是什么或不是什么。他只知道该做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Even after all the cruelty he suffered. For all those years, in the "now" and the "then" of that eternity, of the moment I injected the serum... of the "before" and the "after," he was there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 即使经历了所有残酷的折磨，在那漫长的岁月里，在"现在"和"过去"的永恒中，在我注射血清的那一刻……在"之前"和"之后"，他始终都在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He was my friend. He was my brother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他既是我的朋友，也是我的兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then? In the now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: "过去"？在"现在"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can sense him no more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我又感觉不到他了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know. I felt it when he was gone. And I wept. I miss him dearly. I know he echoes, still - somehow, someway, though I do not fully understand how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道。他离开的时候，我感觉到了。我哭了。我非常想念他。我知道他仍然以某种方式、以某种方式存在着，尽管我并不完全明白其中的缘由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I miss him dearly. I know he echoes, still - somehow, someway, though I do not fully understand how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我非常想念他。我知道他仍然以某种方式、以某种方式存在着，尽管我并不完全明白其中的缘由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am glad I knew him as well. As for his strength? Perhaps, perhaps not. In the end, he simply knew what was needed and he was strong enough to see it done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我也很高兴认识他。至于他的力量？或许有，或许没有。但最终，他只是明白自己需要做什么，并且有足够的力量去完成这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps. But in the end, he did what was needed. And he was strong enough to see it done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许吧。但最终，他做了他该做的事。而且他有足够的勇气去完成这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In times like these, "strong enough" is all we can pray for, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在这样的时刻，我想我们唯一能祈祷的就是"足够强大"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Which is, unfortunately, not the same to be said of this wine... which was very strong, just slow to take effect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 可惜的是，这款酒并非如此……它的酒劲很足，只是起效比较慢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I should go before
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我应该走先。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I should go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我该走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you, my love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的爱人，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not think I can adequately describe to you how strange a moment it was to inject the serum, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: mon miracle，我无法向你详细描述注射血清那一刻的感觉有多么奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not think I can adequately describe to you how strange a moment it was to inject the serum, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，我无法向你详细描述注射血清那一刻的感觉有多么奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I suppose so. Though I do believe that I have had years of practice in that regard and, therefore, Entrati's warnings made it to be far more impressive than it was in actuality.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我也这么想。不过我相信我在这方面已经有多年的经验，因此，英择谛的警告让我感觉比实际情况严重得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie and I decided to take our serums in private. I asked her to allow me to go first, experience the change, and then to help guide her through her own - but she, of course, steadfastly refused.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽和我决定私下使用血清。我请求她先让我用，先试过转变过程，然后再指导她使用——但可想而知，她坚决拒绝了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Scoffing at the mere notion that I would go anywhere or do anything without her firmly planted at my side, she headed off to her own chambers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她对我会离开她独自一人去任何地方或做任何事情的想法嗤之以鼻，然后径直走向了自己的房间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I locked my door, stripped, and sat in the middle of my floor, as far away from any objects as I could, before I drove the needle into my side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我锁上门，脱光衣服，坐在地板中央，尽可能远离任何物体，然后把针头扎进我的侧腹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I had seen what the Infestation had done to Roathe, twisting his flesh with whatever he must have been wearing at the time - I had no desire to fall victim to the same fate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我亲眼目睹了 Infestation 对罗瑟造成的伤害，它扭曲了他的血肉，就像当时他身上穿的某种东西一样——我可不想成为同样受害者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When the agony was over, my already suffering vision was... blurred. Overtaken in... double, somehow? As though I could see not once, but twice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 痛苦过后，我原本就模糊不清的视线……变得更加模糊。不知为何，眼前像是出现了……重影？仿佛我看到的不是一个东西，而是两个东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am quite proud of my resilience, however, that I managed to don my britches before I retched and unconsciousness took me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，我为自己的韧性感到非常自豪，因为我在呕吐和失去意识之前设法穿上了裤子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When I awoke, I was not alone. Nor, however, was I on the floor of my chambers. I was sitting in my childhood bedroom upon the creaky old floors I knew so well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 醒来​时，​我​并不​是​一​个​人。​然而，​我​也​不​在​我​房间​的​地板​上。​我​正坐​在​儿时​的​卧室​里，​那​吱​吱​作响​的​旧地​板​上，​我​无比​熟悉​的​地方。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And sitting beside me was a young man. Beside him stood a figure I now know as Harrow. The young man was holding a small wooden figurine in his hands. It was jointed at the limbs - the paint long worn away, save perhaps in the creases and cracks. It had belonged to my father. It was of a soldier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 坐在我旁边的是一位年轻人。他身旁站着一个人，我现在才知道他叫 Harrow。年轻人手里拿着一个木制小雕像。雕像的四肢是关节连接的——油漆早已褪色，或许只有缝隙和裂缝里还残留着一些。这雕像曾属于我的父亲。它描绘的是一位士兵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It was the only toy I could claim as my own, as a child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那是我小时候唯一属于自己的玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So I have heard. I believe mine proved to be more benign, in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我听说了。不过，我相信我的情况比你好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 正是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The young man and his silent guardian who visited me inside my dream- inside my mind - were all at once strangers to me and yet known to me like we had grown up together as siblings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 梦中出现的那个年轻人和他沉默的守护者——在我的脑海里——对我来说既陌生又熟悉，就像我们一起长大的兄弟姐妹一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Quite right. We could be lost here for hours, debating the moral and theological implications of Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 确实。我们可能会在这里耗上几个小时，争论双衍王境事件的道德和神学意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: When I ponder even the smallest notion of what I would have conjured in your stead, I am overcome with waves of horror. But we could be lost here for hours, discussing such a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 每当我只是想象一下如果我是你，我会做出什么事来，我都会感到一阵阵的恐惧袭来。但我们可能会在这里花上几个小时讨论这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If he is showing signs of change, and he is a product of your emotions, perhaps that is indicative of something else. But a debate for another day, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果他表现出变化的迹象，而他的行为又受到你的情绪影响，那或许预示着其他问题。不过，这或许是以后再讨论的话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me for an overwrought metaphor, but it was as though we were three trees whose roots were so grown together as to become indistinguishable from one another -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请原谅我使用过于夸张的比喻，但我们就像三棵树，它们的根系交织在一起，彼此之间难以区分——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: who had merely been blinked into existence in such a state. I could remember my life without Rell and Harrow. And yet, there they were. In every moment - in every instance - beside me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们仿佛凭空出现在我眼前，就处于这种状态。我还能回忆起没有 Rell 和 Harrow 的生活。然而，他们却一直都在。每一刻，每一刻，都在我身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As an aside, I wish I could speak to Entrati about this, I am desperate to know what manner of science is at the - no pun intended - root of this, but when we finally recovered from our change, Entrati was gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 顺便提一下，我真希望能够和英择谛谈谈这件事，我迫切地想知道这件事背后的科学原理是什么——没有双关的意思——但是当我们最终从转变中恢复过来时，英择谛已经不在了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Which was a process I believe will linger in my nightmares for a very long time. Regardless, the specifics of how it is that Rell, Harrow, and I became bonded at such a... molecular, spiritual level, I do not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信，那段经历会在我的噩梦中萦绕很久很久。无论如何，我并不清楚 Rell、Harrow 和我究竟是如何在如此……分子层面、精神层面建立起联系的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Now if only we were allowed to speak to her. I suspect there are schemes to that effect already in play. If so, you may count on me to... assist. I can be convincing when need be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 要是我们能跟她谈谈就好了。我怀疑已经有人在策划这件事了。如果真是这样，你们可以指望我……帮忙。必要时，我可以很会说服人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But the crossroads went both ways. Where they were in my life, I was in theirs. I saw the Indifference. I understood what they were standing guard against. I saw glimpses of Harrow, and the man he once was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但人生的十字路口是双向的。他们在我生命中，我也在他们的生命中。我看到了虚空无情之物。我明白了他们究竟在守护什么。我瞥见了 Harrow，看到了他曾经的模样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Regardless, the specifics of how it is that Rell, Harrow, and I became bonded at such a... molecular, spiritual level, I do not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不管怎样，我不知道 Rell、Harrow 和我究竟是如何在如此……分子、精神层面上建立起联系的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But the press of the Indifference took over I could feel it there - hear it as they did, tapping against the walls. Rap... tap... tap...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但虚空无情之物的压力袭来，我能感觉到——也能听到，就像他们那样，敲击着墙壁。哒……哒……哒……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: All the visions of my youth, all the horrors that I had seen - were they only ever the Indifference? Was I now mis-remembering? Or had I indeed been "blessed" by Lua?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​年轻时​的​所有​异象，​我​所​目睹​的​所有​恐怖​——​难道​它们​都​只​是​来自于​虚空​无情​之物？​难道​是​我​记错​了？​还是，​我​是​真的​受到​了​月神​的​"祝福"？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My faith inside of me... it crumpled and fell away. Nothing more than charred paper, turned to dust. And oh, how I loathe myself for my weakness...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我内心的信仰……彻底崩溃瓦解了。它就像烧焦的纸片，化为尘埃。哦，我多么痛恨自己的软弱……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps you are right... And my sad tale of doubt was hardly the point. But I shall consider your words. We shall discuss this in more detail tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你是对的……我刚才那段充满疑虑的悲惨经历其实并非重点。但我会认真考虑你的话。我们明天再详细讨论这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I saw Rell's life aboard the Zariman Ten Zero, and all that he endured after it. I saw Harrow's life as a soldier, faded as it was through the Infestation. Just as they saw my life in Gaule and all I suffered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我看见了 Rell 在扎里曼 10-0 号上的生活，以及他之后所遭受的一切。我目睹了 Harrow 作为一名士兵的生涯，尽管在 Infestation 的侵蚀下逐渐消逝。正如他们目睹了我在高卢的生活以及我所遭受的一切苦难一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It may be strange to you to know that none of us ever once exchanged a word. We never found the need. There was simply between us an... understanding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你会觉得奇怪，我们之间竟然从未说过一句话。我们觉得没有必要。我们之间只有一种……默契。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I could hear their voices - I knew all the words in their lives they had ever spoken. But they were never directed to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我能听到他们的声音——我知道他们一生中说过的所有话。虽然那些话从来都不是说给我听的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Does a smile need a speech? Does a frown? Do you need to hear a child weeping to know he is in pain or frightened? No, we merely knew what was passed between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 微笑需要言语表达吗？皱眉呢？你需要听到孩子的哭泣才能知道他感到痛苦或感到害怕吗？不，我们只是心照不宣地知道彼此之间的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Until it... until it no longer was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 直到它……直到它不再存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They are not gone, my friend... only dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，他们并没有消失……他们只是死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: They are not gone, mon miracle... only dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: mon miracle，他们并没有消失……他们只是死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can no longer hear those parts of them which were undetermined. Now, I believe, I can only hear that part of them which was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我再也听不到那些尚未听过的部分了。现在，我相信，我只能听到那些已经听过的部分了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I cannot explain it any more than I already have. I know not how. Forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我已经尽力解释了，实在无法再多解释。我不知道该怎么做。请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The moment we passed through the Helminth with Roathe and came here, to the Sanctum. I do not know... why. Or how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们和罗瑟一起穿过 Helminth，来到这里，来到圣所的那一刻……我不知道……为什么。也不知道是怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But in passing through that veil of time, my friends, my brothers.. the trees whose roots wove through my soul so closely... withered and died beside me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但是，在穿越时间的帷幕时，我的朋友，我的兄弟……那些根系与我的灵魂紧密相连的树木……都在我身边枯萎凋零。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Now an emptiness is there. Rotting. The memory of them still corrupting my own. But I would not give it away if I had the chance...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如今那里一片空虚，腐朽不堪。关于他们的记忆仍在腐蚀着我。但即便有机会，我也不会放弃它……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can recall the memory of the first time my mother struck me. I remember it two ways, clear as Sol's brightest light, and I know all versions are true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我至今仍记得母亲第一次打我的情景。我记得有两种版本，清晰得如同太阳神最耀眼的光芒，而且我知道两种版本都是真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In one... I weep alone in the darkness of my room. In another, two figures stand beside me in the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 一个版本是……我独自在黑暗的房间里哭泣。而另一个版本，是两个身影站在我身旁的阴影里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I remember twice the first time I took a blade to my skin to clear the voices from my mind. In one, the room is empty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​记得​第一​次​用​刀​片​划破​皮肤，​试图​驱​散​脑海​中​的​声音，​那​次​我​一​共​划​了​两​次。​其中​一​个​版本​是，​房间​里​空无​一​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In another, I hear a humming from behind me. I feel the silent presence of a stoic guardian.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而在另一个版本中，我听到身后传来嗡嗡声。我感到一位沉稳的守护者默默地存在着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If I have lost my faith in my goddess of Lua and have gained their guidance in return... it may be a trade I would be willing to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果我失去了对月神的信仰，却因此获得了他们的指引……这或许是我愿意做出的交易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I miss their presence. But I... am learning that in this place, there are more who might understand my pain than not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。我很想念他们。但是……我逐渐明白，在这个地方，能理解我痛苦的人比不能理解我的人要多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed. Do not think I have not considered whether or not Rell and Harrow were sent by the Luminaries to comfort me. But as you said, such is not for us to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 的确如此。别以为我没有想过 Rell 和 Harrow 是不是双耀神派来安慰我的。但正如你所说，这并非我们该知晓之事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. Do not think I have not considered it. I am not sure if my faith will be so easily mended, but... it is a comfort to ponder, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。别以为我没考虑过。我不确定我的信仰是否能如此轻易地修复，但是……无论如何，思考这个问题总归是一种安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. I miss their presence. But I am... no longer alone, am I, mon miracle?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。我很想念他们。但我……不再孤单了，对吗，mon miracle？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am so very relieved to finally have spoken of all this with you. It is a great burden, lifted from me, and I cannot express my gratitude enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 终于能跟你倾诉这一切，我感到无比轻松。这就像卸下了我的一块重担，我无法用言语表达我的感激之情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For now, I must go, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 朋友，我现在必须走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For now, I must go, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: mon miracle，我现在必须走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: [Conversation skipped due to previous setting of trigger warning.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: [由于之前设置的触发警告，对话已跳过]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Drifter. A request, if I might?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 漂泊者。请问我可以提个要求吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am sorry you and Marie have not come to see eye to eye when it comes to matters of "le Cardinal." But I am at least happy it has not come to blows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很遗憾你和玛丽在"主教"的问题上意见不合。但我很高兴至少你们没有大打出手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I must send my condolences to you for your noble yet tragically short-lived endeavors when it comes to Marie and the matter of "le Cardinal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对于你在玛丽和"主教"事件中所做出的高尚而又短暂的努力，我必须向你致以哀悼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Might I take a moment to commend you on something that I thought was heretofore otherwise impossible, in regards to Marie? I heard of what transpired between you two...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我可以花点时间表扬一下你吗，关于玛丽的事，我以前认为你是不可能做到的。我听说了你们俩之间发生的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Please convince Marie to stop using the necramites to replicate furniture. I do not know what to do with all of these chairs as it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请​劝玛丽别再​用​那些​殁世微灵复制​家​具​了。​我​现在​都​不​知道​该​怎么​处理​那些​椅子​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: She did. We speak nightly of the goings-on of the day. And after your conversation, she was quick to rush to my side to tell me all she thought of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 确实如此。我们每天晚上都会聊聊当天发生的事情。你跟我谈话之后，她立刻就跑到我身边，详细地告诉了我她的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is a reason why the term "crime of passion" was invented, after all. If we as creatures were not adhered to our beliefs, life would be terribly dull, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: "激情犯罪"这个词的出现是有原因的。我想，如果我们人类不坚守自己的信仰，生活将会多么乏味啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Certainly quieter. More peaceful. But dull. There certainly would be no art to speak of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然会更安静，更平和，但也更乏味，肯定不会有什么艺术可言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I refuse to take her... colorful suggestions as to where inside Roathe's anatomy they are intended to be stored.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我拒绝接受她……关于这些东西应该存放在罗瑟体内的哪个部位的各种奇思妙想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I digress. I wonder - in my conversations with her, it sounds as though your words were moving. I have to ask - were you pleased with how you left matters between you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我跑题了。我想知道——从我和她的谈话中，听起来你的话很打动她。我必须问——你对你们之间事情的处理方式满意吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ha! As though I would betray her confidence to you. As precious as you are to me, my friend - she has been the sister of my soul for many, many long years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哈！我怎么可能为了你背叛她的信任？我的朋友，虽然你对我来说很珍贵——但她多年来一直是我灵魂姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ha! As though I would betray her confidence to you. As precious as you are to me, mon miracle - she has been the sister of my soul for many, many long years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哈！我怎么可能为了你背叛她的信任？Mon miracle，虽然你对我来说很珍贵——但她多年来一直是我灵魂姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No, I fear her words to me shall be kept my secret. But they were moving to her, all the same. I wonder though, were you pleased with how you left matters between you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不，她对我说的话我恐怕只能保守秘密。不过，那些话对她来说确实很感人。只是，我很好奇，你对你们之间事情的处理方式满意吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do believe I can fathom the grandeur of it, if not the magnitude. I am... quite honored to be a part of it, in some small way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我相信我能体会到这件事的伟大，即便无法完全理解它的规模。能以某种方式参与其中，我深感荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Fascinating... Well, you are her lover now, are you not? If anyone in this place were to have the influence to convince her - it would be you, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真有意思……嗯，你现在是她的恋人了，对吧？如果这里有人能说服她，那肯定是你，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. Well, unfortunately, there comes a time when all things must be put to rest. A dough can be over-worked. A artist can add too much their painting. And an argument can certainly be overwrought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。唉，可惜的是，万事万物终有尽头。面团揉过头会变形，艺术家画作上的内容也会过多，争论当然也会过度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, perhaps it is better for topics to move on to greener pastures.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，或许让话题转向更有吸引力的方向会更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Fascinating... Well, I have been known to have some... influence over her, limited as it may be. You feel as though this mending of relationships between M. Loid and Entrati's estranged family is important?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真有意思……嗯，我确实对她有一些……影响力，虽然可能有限。你觉得修复洛德先生和英择谛疏远的家人之间的关系很重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I cannot tell if that is the tone of petulance, arrogance, ignorance, or apathy. I will therefore settle upon a mixture of all four, and move along with my day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我无法判断这究竟是任性、傲慢、无知还是麻木的语气。因此，我姑且认为这四种情绪都有，然后继续我的一天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed. I am of a similar mindset as you. I don't believe him to be one way or the other, yet... mixed in his motivations.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 确实。我的想法和你类似。我也认为他不是只有一面的，而是……他的动机很复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I simply hope you did not make some manner of sacrifice in your words to her - placing one priority over another in an attempt to woo her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是希望你没有在对她说的那些话里做出某种牺牲——为了讨好她而把一件事情看得比另一件事情更重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I suppose I would simply choose to let this go. And hope that some day she might have the chance to see Entrati for what we know him to be - at the very best, complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想如果是我我会选择放手。也希望有一天她能有机会看清英择谛的真面目——充其量，他只是个复杂的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I, for one, am ready for them to drift away from endless conversations regarding the wondrous and faultless "le Cardinal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我个人而言，我已经准备好不用再听他们无休止地谈论那位奇妙而完美的"主教"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 真丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hubris drove him. A greed for knowledge. Now, perhaps, a greed for forgiveness. Who is to say? I wonder even if he knows, himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 傲慢驱使着他。那是对知识的贪婪。如今，或许是对宽恕的贪婪。谁又能说得准呢？我甚至怀疑他自己是否明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know I am not terribly affable, but neither am I some ghoul. If you would like my assistance, you shall have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道我不太和善，但我也不是什么恶人。如果你需要我的帮助，我随时乐意效劳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. If you would like my assistance, you shall have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。如果你需要我的帮助，我随时乐意效劳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What a sorry state of affairs that would be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那将是多么令人遗憾的局面啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know how matters will play out between M. Loid and Entrati's estranged family. I merely wished to say that if you are in need of my assistance, you shall have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道洛德先生和英择谛疏远的家人之间的事情会怎么发展。我只是想说，如果你需要我的帮助，请随时联系我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm. And what of the possible pain a reintroduction might cause between the involved parties when such revelations are made?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。一旦这些事情被捅破，重新相聚可能会给相关的人带来怎样的痛苦呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And are you in the business of going about doing the bidding of Entrati on the influence of a "gut feeling?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那你是不是只是凭着"直觉"听命于英择谛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You shall have my aid, what little good it will do you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会尽力帮助你，虽然这几乎帮不到你什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though the hardest to convince is, I dread to consider, likely the most important - Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽说最难说服的人，我都不敢想，但也可能是最重要的人——罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though I believe you have already completed that which was the most onerous task - convincing Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我相信你已经完成了最艰巨的那部分——说服罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though I will have to sit and think on how to convince Roathe to change his mind... which I am not certain I will be able to do. And without him, it may be a lost cause.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过我得好好想想该怎么说服罗瑟改变主意……但我并不确定自己能否做到。没有他，这件事可能就彻底成不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mm. Perhaps. But we are not chess pieces, and I refuse to be treated as such. If Entrati wishes to make such an appeal, he can send a damnable letter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，或许吧。但我们不是棋子，我拒绝被如此对待。如果英择谛想提出这样的诉求，他可以写封该死的信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The damnable bastard is - as much as I do very much wish I could find a method by which to secure his mouth closed - useful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这个​该​死​的​混蛋​——​尽管​我​非常​希望​能够​找到​一​种​方法​让​他​闭嘴​——​让​他​说​有​用​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Indeed. Wise words. Very well. I will speak to her. I will see if I can convince her to talk to you again regarding this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 确实如此。说得对。很好。我会跟她谈谈。我会看看能不能说服她再跟你谈这事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In this way, I fear I side with the complaints of M. Loid. You may have my assistance in convincing him, but I do not think you will get far without Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这样看来，恐怕我得站在洛德先生这边了。我可以帮你劝服他，但如果没有玛丽的帮助，恐怕你很难成功。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie and I are outsiders. Roathe, Loid, Entrati, and Entrati's daughter are all contemporaries. Not to mention, he has knowledge he might utilize to protect them, should things go awry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我和玛丽是外人。罗瑟、洛德、英择谛以及英择谛的女儿都是同一个背景的。更何况，他掌握着一些信息，万一情况不妙，他或许可以利用这些信息保护他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I despise admitting it, Marie and I would still be bumbling about attempting to discern how to use half the equipment in this building, while he would wield it with ease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我很不愿意承认，我和玛丽可能还在笨手笨脚地摸索如何使用这栋楼里一半的设备，他就已经能轻松地使用它们了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Once more, I digress. As I said, when the time comes. And, speaking of time, it is for me to leave you now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我又跑题了。正如我所说，到时候我会帮助你的。说到时候，我现在该走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No offence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无意冒犯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I wish you luck. Farewell for now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 祝你好运。先再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will do what I can, my friend. She is my sister. But there is only so much I can do. I will ensure she speaks to you again, but after that, you must do the rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 朋友，我会尽我所能。她是我妹妹。但我能做的也有限。我会确保她再和你谈一次，但之后的事情，就得靠你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will do what I can, mon miracle. She is my sister. But there is only so much I can do. I will ensure she speaks to you again, but after that, you must do the rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Mon miracle，我会尽我所能。她是我妹妹。但我能做的也有限。我会确保她再和你谈一次，但之后的事情，就得靠你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Farewell. - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 再见。——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mmhm. Well, you will have my assistance, as I said, when the time comes. And, speaking of time, it is for me to leave you now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。正如我所说，到时候我会帮助你的。说到时候，我现在该走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will go to it. Farewell for now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会去的。先再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mon miracle, I... must make very certain you understand something before I tell you this next anecdote of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Mon miracle，我……必须确保你清楚明白一件事，才能告诉你我的下一个轶事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am not surprised that Marie caught your heart in her hands like a butterfly. She is... quite something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽像捕捉蝴蝶般俘获了你的心，我并不感到意外。她确实……非同寻常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What a wonderfully benign and charmingly mundane question. I do not get asked this often.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 多么美好又平淡的问题啊。我很少被人这样问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, what is it? Is something the matter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 好的，怎么了？发生什么事了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is important to me that you are paying very close attention to these next words that I send you. Do you understand?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你必须全神贯注地听我接下来要说的话。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am glad there is someone who can find the strength to reach through the nettles of Roathe's personality to see the broken thing that lies within.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很高兴有人能鼓起勇气，穿过罗瑟性格中的荆棘丛，看见那颗深埋其中的破碎心灵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Might I ask what I fear is to be an indelicate question, my friend?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 朋友，我能否问一个恐怕有些冒昧的问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am... quite well, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……很好，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know, though he denies it vehemently, that he believes himself a coward. I would not label him as such.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然他极力否认，但我知道他内心认定自己是个懦夫。我不会如此定义他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Happens to me frequently. Often when I pass through doorways. Oft I have wondered why that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我经常这样。尤其穿过门框时。我常在想为什么会这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... you are... certain? Are you well? You have not hit your head recently, have you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……你……确定吗？你没事吧？最近没撞到头吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Nothing is wrong - quite the opposite. That is what is so imperative for you to comprehend - the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 并非出了什么问题——恰恰相反。这正是你必须理解的关键——我试图让你免于承受的，正是那些你认定会随之而来的可怕后果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Ha. Do you think I am surprised? I stand in the shadow of her light and always have. No, my friend - I am not bitter or jealous over this, I promise you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 哈。你以为我会惊讶吗？我始终站在她的光芒之下，从未改变。不，我的朋友——我发誓，对此我并不会怨恨或是嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As are we all. The sister of my soul never ceases to amaze me. I am happy for you both beyond the ability for words to express.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们都如此。我的灵魂姐妹永远让我惊叹不已。我为你们二人感到的喜悦已远超言语所能表达。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hm? No. I would hardly be so bullish as to stomp about and pretend to be her guardian. She is quite capable of breaking your bones if she decides you are so worthy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯？不。我可没那么狂妄，不会趾高气扬地充当她的守护者。要是她觉得你够格，完全有能力把你打得满地找牙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Entrati told him he would be needed to save a future he did not know. One that he had no kingship over, no people to grovel at his feet, no servants to worship him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 英择谛告诉他，未来需要他去拯救——一个他全然未知的未来。他没有统治权的未来，没有臣民在他脚下匍匐，没有仆从对他顶礼膜拜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What... do you see in Roathe that has led you two into... courtship?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你究竟看中了罗瑟什么，竟让你们两人走到……恋爱这步？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see you have either already faced this line of questioning, or you were expecting it. Yes. Precisely that. What... do you see in him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你不是早有心理准备，就是早就料到了。没错。正是如此。你……看上他哪一点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I think I am now quite well today, indeed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，我觉得今天确实感觉相当不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. Before I begin I wish to assure you that there is nothing wrong - however, therein lies perhaps the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。在开始之前，我想向你保证一切安好——然而，我试图让你免于承受的，正是那些你认定会随之而来的可怕后果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I hold no resentment over what passed between us, I am still only able to express my grateful soul for the time we did spend together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对于我们过往的种种我毫无怨怼，至今仍只愿为共度的时光献上感恩的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is such joy in her eyes when she speaks of you. She is giddy with excitement whenever she thinks you might be stopping by.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 每当她提及你时，眼中便闪烁着喜悦的光芒。一想到你可能会来，她就兴奋得轻飘飘的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I merely wished to tell you that her happiness is contagious - and I find myself smiling in the thought of it as well. So for that, I also must thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只想告诉你，她的幸福具有感染力——想到这里，连我也忍不住微笑。为此，同样要感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: He might think it an act of fear - a rat fleeing a sinking ship - to take the serum and forget the actions that led to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他或许会认为注射血清并忘却导致这一切的行为，不过是懦夫的逃避——如同老鼠逃离沉船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Have a lovely rest of your day. - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 祝你有个美好的一天。——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Have a lovely rest of your day. - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 祝你有个美好的一天。——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Well, to be blunt - when you have such other options before you... Marie or Roathe or... anyone else in the universe for that matter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 坦白说——当你面前有其他选择时……玛丽或罗瑟，或者……宇宙中任何其他任何人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. I am painfully aware of this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。我对此深有体会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Allow me to begin again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请允许我重新开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see it as a man who saw the calculations of the battlefield and knew when to abandon a vessel already lost. For the war was not yet over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我视他为洞悉战场局势之人，深谙何时该弃守已无挽回余地的战舰。因为战争尚未终结。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Far be it from me to condemn you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我绝不敢指责你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I can understand the pull. I will not deny that I do not see it myself. However, I do hope for your sake you do not allow it to consume you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我能理解它的吸引力。我也不否认自己同样感受到了。但为了你自己，我衷心希望你不要被它吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have trouble believing you would choose to dally with a broken stained glass window such as I... lest you were gravely ill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我很难相信你会选择与我这样的破碎彩窗为伴……除非你病得不轻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am aware that I can be construed by many to be, and in fact, very well might be, in reality... unwell. At the very least, I am not entirely of sound mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我深知自己可能被许多人解读为——事实上，现实中很可能确实如此——一个……不正常的人。至少，我的精神状态远非完全健全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Now, I am happy you spend it with her. She will bring you joy, where I could only bring you sadness. Be happy with her. You have all of my blessings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如今，我很高兴你能与她相伴。她将为你带来欢乐，而我曾带给你的只有悲伤。愿你与她幸福美满。我将永远祝福你们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Though, for your sake, I do hope this fancy passes quickly and does not become an addiction. I have seen such things destroy others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，为了你好，我真心希望这阵迷恋快快过去，别变成瘾症。我见过这般执念毁掉多少人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, I have seen it myself. Buried deep, though it may be. But he may not welcome your attempts to pry. I believe he enjoys what he has become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的，我亲眼见过。虽然被深埋在心底。但他可能并不欢迎你试图窥探。我相信他享受现在的自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Such arrangements should be based on more than... simple darkness. I shall not lecture you, however.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这样的关系不该仅建立在……简单的黑暗之上。不过，我不会对你说教。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have long since come to be at peace with this. It does not trouble me any longer. The visions that plague me - the voices - I have come to find ways to live with them without fear or hatred.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我早已与这一切和解。它不再困扰我。那些折磨我的异象——那些声音——我已学会与之共处，不再恐惧也不再憎恨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You know your own mind and your limits. I wish you both well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你自己最清楚自己的心思和底线。愿你们一切安好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me, please forgive me - I simply - I thought it was impossible, this is... not something I... could have... imagined...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 原谅我，请原谅我——我只是——我以为这不可能，这根本不是我……能够……想象到的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Hardly! That is not what I mean to imply! Far - far from it, in fact, I simply - I thought it was impossible, this is... not something I... could have... imagined...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 绝非如此！我不是这个意思！恰恰相反——我只是——我以为这不可能，这根本不是我……能够……想象到的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: (Lately, I think, a little out of spite if I might be honest, but that is neither here nor there.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: （最近，说实话，我倒觉得这多少有些出于报复心理，不过这无关紧要。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I wish you to understand that if you were to end this between us - this bond that I thought was previously heretofore impossible between myself and another -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我希望你明白，如果你要结束我们之间的这段关系，这段我曾以为此生不可能与他人建立的羁绊——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To which I wish you both the absolute best of luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我衷心祝愿你们俩好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Besides, now that he seems to have an "itch to scratch," he has stopped goading Marie into open conflict.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 况且，既然他似乎"憋着一口气想出头"，也就不再挑衅玛丽，避免公开冲突了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You truly are mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你真是 mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you were to ever let your heart wander away from mine?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你的心某天真的从我身边飘然远去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Well. Not as frequently, at any rate. Farewell for now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯。反正没那么频繁了。先再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will endure, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我自会承受，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will not be consumed by that which has plagued me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不会被困扰我的那些东西吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will survive. I will be fine. I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会挺过去。我会好起来。我会找到再次微笑和欢笑的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will be, to use your colloquialism, "all right." I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 用你的俗语来说，我会"没事的"。我会找到再次微笑和欢笑的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是想让你摆脱因我而产生的任何困扰……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No! Nothing of the sort! I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不！绝无此事！我只是想让你摆脱因我而产生的任何困扰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To which I cannot express how much my heart breaks in turn for you. But that I am forever grateful that our lonely ghosts of pain have found each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我无法言喻自己因你而心碎的程度。但永远感激的是，我们孤独痛苦的幽魂终于彼此相遇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To which I cannot properly express my gratitude, and I do not think any words ever can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对此我无从表达感激，我想任何言语都无法承载这份心意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. Of course. It would be... hypocritical to accept any other answer at this point in time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。当然。在此时此刻接受任何其他答案……都显得虚伪……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But now that I have gone through great pains to go through what has been a most spectacularly self-indulgent preamble...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但既然我已经费尽心力写了这段堪称极致自恋的铺垫……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I understand completely. And I wish you nothing but the best. And I will cherish all the moments we have spent together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我完全理解。愿你永远幸福。我会永远珍藏我们共度的每一刻时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will remember them in my soul, even if they vanish from my mind. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 纵使记忆褪色，灵魂仍将铭刻。再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Bah! If you did not wish to be privy to the inner workings of my mind, you should not have gone poking about. You are entirely to blame for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 呸！若你不想窥见我脑海中的思绪，就不该到处乱探。这全是你咎由自取。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am quite glad you enjoy my wanderings. This is precisely why I choose to speak as little as I do. Can you imagine enduring this in person? Marie would have put me down years ago like a mad dog.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很高兴你喜欢我的絮叨。正因如此，我才选择如此寡言。你能想象若当面听这些会怎样吗？玛丽早该把我当疯狗一样揍扁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is a certain amount of irreverence and sarcasm to which you naturally prevail that I could never hope to ascend. I will leave it to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你天生就带着某种不羁与讽讥之气，这是我永远望尘莫及的高度。就留给你去展现吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Nevertheless, all of this was meant to serve as pretext to a story that will now seem quite short in comparison to the rest...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，这一切不过是为接下来的故事铺垫——相比之下，这个故事显得相当简短……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I awoke last night from a nightmare. When I did, shadows surrounded me. This is nothing foreign or new in my state of mind. They loomed over my bed, and would not clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 昨夜我从噩梦中惊醒。醒来时，阴影已将我团团围住。这种状态对我来说并不陌生。它们在床边萦绕盘旋，久久不肯散去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was not frightened of them, for I knew they could not harm me. However, they would not be gone from my mind, either. There was only one way I knew to be rid of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我并不惧怕它们，因我深知它们无法伤害我。然而它们也始终萦绕心头，挥之不去。我知道只有一种方法能摆脱它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Pushing up from bed, I dressed as best I could, staggering through the blurry vision of the continued nightmare. I grasped my thurible and fell to my knees in the middle of my floor, and prepared to... well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我撑身下床，在持续噩梦的模糊视野中踉跄前行，勉强穿好衣物。抓起聚能焚炉跪倒在地板中央，准备……嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I prepared to "clear my mind." We shall leave it at that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 准备"净化心灵"。就此打住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But as I shut my eyes, my mind wandered. My thoughts drifted... to you, mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但当我闭上双眼，思绪却飘向远方。我的心绪飘荡……飘向了你，mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The sound of your voice. The touch of your hand upon my shoulder...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你的声音。你手掌抚过我肩头的触感……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And the visions... fled. They abandoned their post, chased away by the stronger ghost... of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那些异象……尽数消散。它们落荒而逃，被更强大的幽灵……你的幽灵驱散了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... stood. Placed my thurible upon the nightstand, and... opted to walk through the sand of the Sanctum instead...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……站了起来。将聚能焚炉放在床头柜上，然后……选择踏过圣所的沙地前行……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. Well. On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。嗯。散步时我……突然意识到这种时刻暗藏的危险。你可能会……开始觉得这是种责任——开始视我为桎梏你的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I beg of you - I pray, to any god or gods on high or below - that you never do. This is a gift you have given me, and each time in its newness I will cherish it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我恳求你——我祈祷，无论向天上还是地下的神——愿你永不如此。这是你赠予我的礼物，每次当它焕发新生时，我都会珍视它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There are no words needed, mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无需言语，mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Vow to me, mon miracle - that should the time come, that I have become for you an empty cage... you will be free of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 向我发誓吧，mon miracle——如果真有那么一天，我对你而言成了空荡的牢笼……你便从我这里获得自由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 散步时我……突然意识到这种时刻暗藏的危险。你可能会……开始觉得这是种责任——开始视我为桎梏你的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I shall be no hollow prison for those I love. Not for you. Not for Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我绝不会成为所爱之人的空洞牢笼。不会对你如此。不会对玛丽如此。
