/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle, for your honesty. This took bravery, in this moment, and I commend you for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。谢谢你，mon miracle，感谢你的坦诚。在这个时刻说出这些需要勇气，我为此向你致敬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。谢谢你，mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will cherish all the moments we have spent together. This, I mean more than you can imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会珍藏我们共度的每一刻。这份珍视，远超你的想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am suddenly so very tired, as if... a great weight has been lifted from my shoulders. I fear I must go lie down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我突然感到无比疲惫，仿佛……肩上的重担终于卸下了。恐怕我得去躺下歇歇了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will remember them in my soul, even if they vanish from my mind. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 纵使记忆褪色，灵魂仍将铭刻。再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My mind is complicated enough, I fear, to think of you and he, a man I know so well, together. Perhaps I am old-fashioned in that regard. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕我的思绪太过复杂，以至于无法想象你和他这个我如此熟悉的人——在一起的画面。或许我在这方面有些老派。我感觉自己就像个行走的古董。为此，请你原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps I am old fashioned in that regard. She is like my family, and we are too close. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许我在这方面有些老派。她就像我的家人一样，我们关系太亲密了。我感觉自己像个行走的古董。为此，请你原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I am... deeply touched, and I... do not know the customs of this time, I fear I must refuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……深受感动，也……并不了解这个时代的习俗，但我恐怕还是不得不拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I am... deeply touched, and I... do not know the customs of this time, I fear I must refuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……深受感动，也……并不了解这个时代的习俗，但我恐怕还是不得不拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you are otherwise currently engaged with Marie. She is too dear to me to think that my relationship with you might detract from hers. Or distract from it in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为你目前已经和玛丽在一起了。她对我来说太重要了，我不希望我和你的关系会影响到她，或者以任何方式分散她的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you are otherwise currently... engaged with Roathe. I do not wish to even comprehend the kind of complications such an entanglement would cause.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 鉴于你目前……与罗瑟有所牵连。我甚至不愿去想象这种纠葛会造成怎样的复杂局面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Not much has changed, I fear. I think that poor beast is liable to rip himself apart in his angst before long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕​情况​并​没有​太​大​改变。​我​觉得​那​可怜​的​家伙​很​快​就​会​因为​焦虑​而​撕碎​自己。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have brought him a manner of surety. Purpose. And for this, I could not be more grateful. And I know the same goes for Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你给他带来了踏实感和目标感。对此，我感激不尽。我知道玛丽也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have brought him a manner of surety. Purpose. And for this, I could not be more grateful. And I know the same goes for Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你给他带来了踏实感和目标感。对此，我感激不尽。我知道玛丽也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Things in this false crypt are much improved, I must say. You have been giving him an outlet for his frustrations, have you not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不得不说，这个假墓穴里的情况已经好多了。你一直在给他提供一个发泄沮丧情绪的出口，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Things in this false crypt are much improved, I must say. Or perhaps that is simply my perception of things. I have been... distracted of late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不得不说，这假墓穴里的情况好多了。或许这只是我的错觉。我最近……有点心不在焉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If Marie does not drive him to it first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果不是玛丽先让他焦虑的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Forgive me. That is laced with innuendo that I did not mean to imply. I simply meant to say that you have been counseling him quite successfully.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 抱歉。我刚才的话可能听起来像夹杂着一些弦外之音，但我并不是那个意思。我只是想说，你对他的引导非常成功。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We have much to be thankful for, when it comes to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 还有很多值得我们感恩的事情，尤其是和你有关的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am. Going to simply retreat from this computer for the rest of the evening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而我呢。打算在今晚剩下的时间远离这台电脑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know what will come of his fate. I hope we can resolve it. For I worry what he will twist himself into if left to his own devices overlong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道他的命运将会如何。我希望我们能解决这个问题。因为我担心，如果任由他独自生活太久，他会把自己扭曲成什么样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have brought him a manner of surety. Purpose. And for this, I could not be more grateful. And I know the same goes for Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你给他带来了踏实感和目标感。对此，我感激不尽。我知道玛丽也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have brought him a manner of self-reflection. Direction. And for this, I could not be more grateful. And I know the same goes for Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你让他学会了自我反省，指明了方向。对此，我感激不尽。我知道玛丽也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In pure and utter shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 带着羞愧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We have much to be thankful for, when it comes to you, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 还有很多值得我们感恩的事情，尤其是和你有关的，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mon miracle, I... must make very certain you understand something before I tell you this next anecdote of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Mon miracle，我……必须确保你清楚明白一件事，才能告诉你我的下一个轶事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is important to me that you are paying very close attention to these next words that I send you. Do you understand?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你必须全神贯注地听我接下来要说的话。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Nothing is wrong - quite the opposite. That is what is so imperative for you to comprehend - the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 并非出了什么问题——恰恰相反。这正是你必须理解的关键——我试图让你免于承受的，正是那些你认定会随之而来的可怕后果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. Before I begin I wish to assure you that there is nothing wrong - however, therein lies perhaps the dire consequences from which I wish to free you, should you assume they might follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢。在开始之前，我想向你保证一切安好——然而，我试图让你免于承受的，正是那些你认定会随之而来的可怕后果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. I am painfully aware of this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。我对此深有体会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Allow me to begin again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请允许我重新开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am aware that I can be construed by many to be, and in fact, very well might be, in reality... unwell. At the very least, I am not entirely of sound mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我深知自己可能被许多人解读为——事实上，现实中很可能确实如此——一个……不正常的人。至少，我的精神状态远非完全健全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have long since come to be at peace with this. It does not trouble me any longer. The visions that plague me - the voices - I have come to find ways to live with them without fear or hatred.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我早已与这一切和解。它不再困扰我。那些折磨我的异象——那些声音——我已学会与之共处，不再恐惧也不再憎恨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: (Lately, I think, a little out of spite if I might be honest, but that is neither here nor there.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: （最近，说实话，我倒觉得这多少有些出于报复心理，不过这无关紧要。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I wish you to understand that if you were to end this between us - this bond that I thought was previously heretofore impossible between myself and another -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我希望你明白，如果你要结束我们之间的这段关系，这段我曾以为此生不可能与他人建立的羁绊——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you were to ever let your heart wander away from mine?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你的心某天真的从我身边飘然远去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will endure, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我自会承受，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will not be consumed by that which has plagued me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不会被困扰我的那些东西吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will survive. I will be fine. I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会挺过去。我会好起来。我会找到再次微笑和欢笑的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will be, to use your colloquialism, "all right." I will find cause to smile and laugh once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 用你的俗语来说，我会"没事的"。我会找到再次微笑和欢笑的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我只是想让你摆脱因我而产生的任何困扰……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No! Nothing of the sort! I am simply attempting to free you of any perceived hardship you might feel on my account.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不！绝无此事！我只是想让你摆脱因我而产生的任何困扰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To which I cannot express how much my heart breaks in turn for you. But that I am forever grateful that our lonely ghosts of pain have found each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我无法言喻自己因你而心碎的程度。但永远感激的是，我们孤独痛苦的幽魂终于彼此相遇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To which I cannot properly express my gratitude, and I do not think any words ever can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对此我无从表达感激，我想任何言语都无法承载这份心意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. Of course. It would be... hypocritical to accept any other answer at this point in time...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。当然。在此时此刻接受任何其他答案……都显得虚伪……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But now that I have gone through great pains to go through what has been a most spectacularly self-indulgent preamble...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但既然我已经费尽心力写了这段堪称极致自恋的铺垫……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I understand completely. And I wish you nothing but the best. And I will cherish all the moments we have spent together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我完全理解。愿你永远幸福。我会永远珍藏我们共度的每一刻时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will remember them in my soul, even if they vanish from my mind. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 纵使记忆褪色，灵魂仍将铭刻。再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Bah! If you did not wish to be privy to the inner workings of my mind, you should not have gone poking about. You are entirely to blame for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 呸！若你不想窥见我脑海中的思绪，就不该到处乱探。这全是你咎由自取。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am quite glad you enjoy my wanderings. This is precisely why I choose to speak as little as I do. Can you imagine enduring this in person? Marie would have put me down years ago like a mad dog.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很高兴你喜欢我的絮叨。正因如此，我才选择如此寡言。你能想象若当面听这些会怎样吗？玛丽早该把我当疯狗一样揍扁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is a certain amount of irreverence and sarcasm to which you naturally prevail that I could never hope to ascend. I will leave it to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你天生就带着某种不羁与讽讥之气，这是我永远望尘莫及的高度。就留给你去展现吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Nevertheless, all of this was meant to serve as pretext to a story that will now seem quite short in comparison to the rest...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过，这一切不过是为接下来的故事铺垫——相比之下，这个故事显得相当简短……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I awoke last night from a nightmare. When I did, shadows surrounded me. This is nothing foreign or new in my state of mind. They loomed over my bed, and would not clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 昨夜我从噩梦中惊醒。醒来时，阴影已将我团团围住。这种状态对我来说并不陌生。它们在床边萦绕盘旋，久久不肯散去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I was not frightened of them, for I knew they could not harm me. However, they would not be gone from my mind, either. There was only one way I knew to be rid of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我并不惧怕它们，因我深知它们无法伤害我。然而它们也始终萦绕心头，挥之不去。我知道只有一种方法能摆脱它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Pushing up from bed, I dressed as best I could, staggering through the blurry vision of the continued nightmare. I grasped my thurible and fell to my knees in the middle of my floor, and prepared to... well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我撑身下床，在持续噩梦的模糊视野中踉跄前行，勉强穿好衣物。抓起聚能焚炉跪倒在地板中央，准备……嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I prepared to "clear my mind." We shall leave it at that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 准备"净化心灵"。就此打住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But as I shut my eyes, my mind wandered. My thoughts drifted... to you, mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但当我闭上双眼，思绪却飘向远方。我的心绪飘荡……飘向了你，mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The sound of your voice. The touch of your hand upon my shoulder...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你的声音。你手掌抚过我肩头的触感……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And the visions... fled. They abandoned their post, chased away by the stronger ghost... of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那些异象……尽数消散。它们落荒而逃，被更强大的幽灵……你的幽灵驱散了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I... stood. Placed my thurible upon the nightstand, and... opted to walk through the sand of the Sanctum instead...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我……站了起来。将聚能焚炉放在床头柜上，然后……选择踏过圣所的沙地前行……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes. Well. On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是的。嗯。散步时我……突然意识到这种时刻暗藏的危险。你可能会……开始觉得这是种责任——开始视我为桎梏你的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I beg of you - I pray, to any god or gods on high or below - that you never do. This is a gift you have given me, and each time in its newness I will cherish it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我恳求你——我祈祷，无论向天上还是地下的神——愿你永不如此。这是你赠予我的礼物，每次当它焕发新生时，我都会珍视它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There are no words needed, mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无需言语，mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Vow to me, mon miracle - that should the time come, that I have become for you an empty cage... you will be free of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 向我发誓吧，mon miracle——如果真有那么一天，我对你而言成了空荡的牢笼……你便从我这里获得自由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: On my walk I... instantly realized the dark danger of such a moment. That you might... come to think it a responsibility - come to see me as chains that weigh you down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 散步时我……突然意识到这种时刻暗藏的危险。你可能会……开始觉得这是种责任——开始视我为桎梏你的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I shall be no hollow prison for those I love. Not for you. Not for Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我绝不会成为所爱之人的空洞牢笼。不会对你如此。不会对玛丽如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle, for your honesty. This took bravery, in this moment, and I commend you for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。谢谢你，mon miracle，感谢你的坦诚。在这个时刻说出这些需要勇气，我为此向你致敬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thank you. Thank you, mon miracle...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 谢谢你。谢谢你，mon miracle……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will cherish all the moments we have spent together. This, I mean more than you can imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会珍藏我们共度的每一刻。这份珍视，远超你的想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am suddenly so very tired, as if... a great weight has been lifted from my shoulders. I fear I must go lie down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我突然感到无比疲惫，仿佛……肩上的重担终于卸下了。恐怕我得去躺下歇歇了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will remember them in my soul, even if they vanish from my mind. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 纵使记忆褪色，灵魂仍将铭刻。再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is something I have been meaning to broach with you, and only now have the opportunity to do so. When... Rell, Harrow, and I became entangled - the how and the why of it, is not important -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我一直想跟你说件事，现在才找到机会说出口。当……Rell、Harrow 和我纠缠在一起的时候——至于怎么发生的，为什么会发生，并不重要——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have been considering the nature of our conversation yesterday. And what it means to have the presence of Rell and Harrow so inexorably within my life -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我一直在思考我们昨天谈话的内容，以及 Rell 和 Harrow 的存在如此不可避免地融入我的生活意味着什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have been considering the nature of our conversation yesterday. And what it means to have the presence of Rell and Harrow so inexorably within my life -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我一直在思考我们昨天谈话的内容，以及 Rell 和 Harrow 的存在如此不可避免地融入我的生活意味着什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have been considering the nature of our conversation yesterday. And what it means to have the presence of Rell and Harrow so inexorably within my life -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我一直在思考我们昨天谈话的内容，以及 Rell 和 Harrow 的存在如此不可避免地融入我的生活意味着什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I became wrapped up in their past in the same fashion their became wrapped up in mine. I saw all of the Zariman Ten Zero, flashes of the Old War, and in the same manner, they saw all of my past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我被卷入了他们的过去，就像他们被卷入了我的过去一样。我看到了所有扎里曼 10-0 号的记忆，看到了远古之战的片段，同样，他们也看到了我所有的过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only to have their presence stricken from my soul once more, only to remain as a memory. And I do not know whether or not it means there are gods in this world or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们的身影终究会从我的灵魂深处被抹去，只留下记忆。我不知道这是否意味着世间真的存在神，还是根本不存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only to have their presence stricken from my soul once more, only to remain as a memory. And you are correct. It may mean that there are no gods in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们的身影终究会再次从我的灵魂中抹去，只留下记忆。你说得对，这或许意味着世上根本没有神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only to have their presence stricken from my soul once more, only to remain as a memory. And how that may have been a gift of Lua...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们的身影终究会再次从我的灵魂深处抹去，只留下记忆。而这，或许正是月神赐予我的礼物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It... threw a great many things into question for me, namely... my faith. It crumpled and fell away, like charred paper - turning to dust. I loathe myself for this weakness...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它……让我对很多事情产生了疑问，尤其是……我的信仰。它像烧焦的纸一样，皱巴巴地崩塌了，化为尘埃。我痛恨自己的这种软弱……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you stated, we... may never know. And it may not be for us to know. Such is the way of things. But it does not change, I think, the years I spent in service to an organization that meant, at its heart, to do kind deeds in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 正如你所说，我们……或许永远不会知道。也许我们也不应该知道。世事就是如此。但我认为这并不能改变我多年来为一个以行善为宗旨的组织服务的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But it does not change, I think, the years I spent in service to an organization that meant, at its heart, to do kind deeds in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我认为这并不能改变我多年来为一个以行善为宗旨的组织服务的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I have come to realize our silver lady would give such a tragic blessing. She would not wish to remove the memory of pain, such as with Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我逐渐意识到，我们这位银发女神只会赐予如此悲怆的祝福。她不愿就像罗瑟那样，抹去痛苦的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: To help those that wished to ease pain from their lives in the moments where it would drown them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 在人们几乎要被痛苦淹没、并且想要减轻痛苦的时候，帮助他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Neither would she remove the sting of the lash from my flesh. It is certainly not her way to protect me from the grief of his passing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 她也不会帮我抹去鞭笞带来的刺痛。保护我免受他离去的悲痛，也不是她的作风。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And I know, were I still able to find Rell and his Harrow's presence, that they would not wish me to agonize over their loss. They are at peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 而且​我​知道，​如果​我​还​能​找到​ Rel​l ​和​他​的​ Harrow，​他们​一定​不​希望​我​为​他们​的​离去​而​痛苦。​他们​已经​安息​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Where Sol would blaze away the pain like a hot knife might cauterize a wound - Lua would have me the embrace the warmth of the pain his absence might bring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 太阳神会像热刀烧灼伤口一样，将痛苦化为乌有——而月神则会用拥抱来温暖我，抚慰他离去带来的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Nor do I believe all my suffering was for naught. It does not invalidate all that I endured.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我也不认为我所遭受的一切苦难都是徒劳的。这并不能否定我所承受的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For it is the absence of pain that threatens to destroy us, just as much as an abundance of it might drown us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为没有痛苦也等同于过多的痛苦淹没我们，足以摧毁我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For it is the absence of pain that threatens to destroy us, just as much as an abundance of it might drown us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为没有痛苦也等同于过多的痛苦淹没我们，足以摧毁我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think on what it means to have Rell and Harrow so inexorably within my life -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我一直在思考 Rell 和 Harrow 的存在如此不可避免地融入我的生活意味着什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think of the years I spent in service to an organization that meant, at its heart, to do kind deeds in this world... what it means to have the presence of Rell and Harrow so inexorably within my life -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我回想起那些年为一个以行善为宗旨的组织服务的日子……回想起 Rell 和 Harrow 在我生命中是如此不可或缺的存在——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think on what it means to have Rell and Harrow so inexorably within my life -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我一直在思考 Rell 和 Harrow 的存在如此不可避免地融入我的生活意味着什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: So it seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is hard to say. I do not know as something like that is anything someone like myself truly ever has "found" or "lost" but is forever seeking. Forever questioning - forever in search of answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 很难说。我​不​知道，​像​我​这样​的​人​是否​真的​"找到"​或​"失去"​过那样的东西，​还是​只是​永远​在​寻找。​永远​在​质疑​——​永远​在​寻求​答案。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only to have their presence stricken from my soul once more, only to remain as a memory. And I do not know whether or not it means there are gods in this world or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们的身影终究会从我的灵魂深处被抹去，只留下记忆。我不知道这是否意味着世间真的存在神，还是根本不存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only to have their presence stricken from my soul once more, only to remain as a memory. And how that may have been a gift of Lua...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们的身影终究会再次从我的灵魂深处抹去，只留下记忆。而这，或许正是月神赐予我的礼物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Only to have their presence stricken from my soul once more, only to remain as a memory. And you are correct. It may mean that there are no gods in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 他们的身影终究会再次从我的灵魂中抹去，只留下记忆。你说得对，这或许意味着世上根本没有神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know as something like faith is anything someone like myself truly ever has "found" or "lost" but is, instead, forever seeking. Forever questioning - forever in search of answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我​不​知道，​像​我​这样​的​人​是否​真的​"找到"​或​"失去"​过信仰​之类​的​东西，​还是​只是​永远​在​寻找。​永远​在​质疑​——​永远​在​寻求​答案。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I think there is, like with pain, a balance to be struck to ensure that one neither drowns within it nor becomes so inured that one is immune and numb.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我认为，就像对待痛苦一样，要找到一个平衡点，以确保既不会沉溺于痛苦之中，也不会变得麻木不仁甚至毫无感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you stated, we... may never know. And it may not be for us to know. Such is the way of things. But it does not change, I think, the years I spent in service to an organization that meant, at its heart, to do kind deeds in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 正如你所说，我们……或许永远不会知道。也许我们也不应该知道。世事就是如此。但我认为这并不能改变我多年来为一个以行善为宗旨的组织服务的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps you are right. Perhaps our silver lady would only give such a tragic blessing. She would not wish to remove the memory of pain, such as with Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你是对的。或许我们这位银发女神只会赐予如此悲怆的祝福。她不愿就像罗瑟那样，抹去痛苦的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But it does not change, I think, the years I spent in service to an organization that meant, at its heart, to do kind deeds in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但我认为这并不能改变我多年来为一个以行善为宗旨的组织服务的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know where I stand on the matter. I haven't enough evidence to make a decision either way. But I suppose it does not change much, does it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道自己对此持什么立场。我没有足够的证据来做出任何决定。但我想，这大概也改变不了什么，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Whether or not the Indifference is a god, I do not know where I stand on the matter. I haven't enough evidence to make a decision either way. But I suppose it does not change much, does it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 至于虚空无情之物是不是神，我不知道自己对此持什么立场。我没有足够的证据来做出任何决定。但我想，这大概也改变不了什么，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you had no hope that it could be defeated by our efforts, why bother to stand against it in the first place? Truly, you are a baffling creature.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 既然你认为我们无法战胜它，当初又何必费力与之对抗呢？你真是个令人费解的家伙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The method of its arrival into our universe does not change the methods by which we might defeat it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 它进入我们宇宙的方式并不会改变我们战胜它的方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You cannot possibly mean those words. Are you simply "going along" with the actions of others, then? Fighting it for lack of anything better to do with your time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你不可能真心实意说出这些话。那你只是在随波逐流吗？还是因为无所事事才勉强反抗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Behold: a god of our creation, sewn from the fabric of our own emptiness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看哪：我们创造的神，由我们自身的空虚缝制而成。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Surely you could think of a better hobby.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你肯定能想到比这更好的爱好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A fabric doll we might over-fill with sadness, our grief, our pain, our anger, our agony, until the stitches threaten to burst with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我们可能会把悲伤、痛苦、愤怒、煎熬都倾注到布娃娃身上，直到布娃娃的缝线快要被这些情绪撑破。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You will pardon me if I find that fills me with far more dread than if it were a god before we arrived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果​我​觉得​这​种​事带​给​我​的​恐惧，​远比​我们​发现​它​是​神​要​强烈​得​多，​还​请​你谅解。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Thinking before one puts words into the world is not a prerequisite. Neither is it for bullets.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说话前思考并非必要条件，发射子弹也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not believe that is true. I would argue that we understand just as little about its motivations now as we might if it were some "great and unknowable god."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不认为这是真的。我觉得，我们现在对它的动机的了解，和对某个"伟大而不可知的神"的了解一样少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, in fact, I think I prefer that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 没错，​事实​上，​我​觉得​那样​更好。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There might be some hope that it could be more intelligent than humanity at large.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许还能抱有一线希望，它可能比整个人类更加智能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: With that... utterly bleak thought, I think I shall leave you for the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 带着这样……极其悲观的想法，我想我今天就到此为止吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We shall speak soon, my friend. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 朋友，我们很快会再联系。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: We shall speak soon, mon miracle. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Mon miracle，我们很快会再联系。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mon miracle, I will not take much of your time today - I simply wished to take a moment to thank you once more for your being here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Mon miracle，今天我不会占用你太多时间——我只是想借此机会再次感谢你在此相伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, I will not take much of your time today - I simply wished to take a moment to thank you once more for your being here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 朋友，今天我不会占用你太多时间——我只是想借此机会再次感谢你在此相伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know that what I have become, what I have always been, is not so easy for others to suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道，我如今的模样，我本来的样子，对他人而言并非易于承受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That I could speak so much of my pain to you, and you endured it? And ask nothing of me in return... My thanks are paltry in comparison.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我向你倾诉了如此多的痛苦，而你竟默默承受？却不求我任何回报……相比之下我这点谢意，实在微不足道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will sit in quiet prayer in thanks to whatever god guided you to us that you have had the patience... the kindness... to listen to me at such length.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我将静坐祈祷，感谢指引你来到我们身边的神，感谢你怀着如此的耐心……如此的善意……倾听我如此冗长的倾诉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will sit in quiet prayer in thanks to whatever god guided you to us that you have had the patience... the kindness... to listen to me at such length.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我将静坐祈祷，感谢指引你来到我们身边的神，感谢你怀着如此的耐心……如此的善意……倾听我如此冗长的倾诉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And for all the patience you have granted me, I am most grateful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 对于你给予我的所有耐心，我感激不尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That I could so heedlessly speak the truth of my soul to you and you withstood it with nothing but open arms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我竟能如此轻率地向你倾吐灵魂的真相，而你却只是张开双臂，将这一切承受下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: That I could so heedlessly speak the truth of my soul to you and you withstood it with nothing but an open heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我竟能如此轻率地向你倾吐灵魂的真相，而你却只是敞开心扉，将这一切承受下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mon miracle, I will kneel at your altar, a most dedicated and devoted servant and soldier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Mon miracle，我将跪于你的圣坛前，成为最虔诚、最忠诚的仆人与战士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, I shall fight beside you, come what may. How could I not seek to guard you, who has stolen the heart of my sister?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，无论发生什么，我都会与你并肩作战。你已偷走我妹妹的心，我怎能不竭力守护你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, I shall fight beside you, come what may. How could I not seek to guard you, who has managed to temper the devil himself?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，无论发生什么，我都会与你并肩作战。你竟能驯服恶魔本身，我怎能不竭力守护你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, I shall fight beside you, come what may.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，无论发生什么，我都会与你并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Wherever you may go. Whatever battles you may fight. Wherever your heart may wander -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无论你将去往何方。无论你将要面对怎样的战斗。无论你的心将流连何处——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Wherever you go, whatever battles you may fight - you shall have me there at your side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无论你身处何方，无论你将要面对怎样的战斗——我都会与你并肩而立。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: This heart is yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 这颗心属于你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In that, have faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请对此坚信不疑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you have managed to go quite awry with both Marie and Roathe. I... am impressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你把和玛丽还有罗瑟的关系都搞得一团糟。我……真是佩服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you have managed to go quite awry with Marie. How have you managed that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你和玛丽的关系搞得一团糟。你是怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you have managed to go quite awry with Roathe. I am not precisely shocked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你把和罗瑟的关系搞得一团糟。我倒也不觉得意外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Mon miracle, I feel as though I have been absent-minded. I must apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: Mon miracle，我感觉自己心不在焉。我必须道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My friend, I feel as though I have been absent-minded. I must apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的朋友，我感觉自己心不在焉。我必须道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have my pledge to help with M. Loid, but something has gone awry with the plan, it seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我向你保证会解决洛德先生的问题，但看起来计划出现了点问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yet here we are, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 然而，这种事还是发生了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I would have recommended speaking with a priest, but... here you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我本来会建议你去找个神父聊聊，但……结果你跑我这里来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: In the meanwhile, I will do what I can to remedy the situation from here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 与此同时，我将尽我所能从这里着手补救这种情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Solspeed, and may Lua guide you. You will need it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 祝你顺利，愿月神指引你。你会需要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Am I the only one you have managed to convince? I am... impressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 难道我就是你唯一说服的人吗？我真是……佩服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If you could have just heard me laugh. I am not judging you, I honestly sympathize more than you might know. And it is for that reason I will help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 要是你能听到我的笑声就好了。我不是在评判你，我真心同情你的程度远超你的想象。正因如此，我才会帮你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, well. I think I am coming to understand how this happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，好吧。我想我开始明白这到底是怎么发生的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Marie is the sister of my soul, and the devil owes me a favor. I will not speak of what it is from, it is a secret I intend to take to my grave, so do not bother asking over what it was about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 玛丽是我的灵魂姐妹，而恶魔欠我一个人情。我不会说是什么事，这是个我打算带进坟墓的秘密，所以别费心来追问了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Needless to say, will you allow me to... solve this problem for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不必多说，你愿意让我……为你解决这个问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What are "families" for, after all...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 毕竟，"家人"不就是用来干这个的吗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You seek my assistance with the M. Loid, do you not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你需要我帮忙解决洛德先生的事情，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My thoughts tend to veer into strange places, especially as of late. Of course, I will help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我的思绪总会飘向奇怪的地方，尤其是最近。当然，我会帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems the devil is... dragging his feet. But without Marie, you will not go far, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来恶魔在……拖延时间。但没有玛丽，你也走不远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems the devil is... dragging his feet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来恶魔在……拖延时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you have garnered the help of both the others, and I am the last bastion. Now I am truly embarrassed. Let us to work, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你已经得到了另外两位的帮助了，而我是最后的那个。现在我真是尴尬极了。那我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you have the help of Roathe, but not Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你得到了罗瑟的帮助，但没有得到玛丽的帮助？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: How have you managed that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是怎么弄成这样的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I think I understand now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我想我现在明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Or a perfectly fine job of it, by the sound of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 听起来，你做得挺不错的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will speak to her. I will see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会和她谈谈。看看我能做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Of course. What else is family for?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 当然。家人不就是用来干这个的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You have Roathe's pledge of support, but not Marie's. A matter easy enough to solve. But I must ask, how have you managed it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你得到了罗瑟的支持，但没有得到玛丽的支持。这个问题很容易解决。但我必须问，你是怎么弄成这种局面的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A matter easy enough to rectify, if you will allow me to do so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果你想让我处理的话，这件事很容易解决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you have the help of Marie, but not Roathe? Unsurprising.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你得到了玛丽的帮助，但没有得到罗瑟的帮助？这也不奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I understand your frustration, believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我理解你的沮丧，相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will speak to him. He... owes me a favor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会跟他谈谈。他……欠我一个人情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Do not ask what it is from. It goes with me to my grave.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 别问是什么事。这个秘密我会带进坟墓里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Yes, well. What are "families" for, I suppose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 嗯，很好。毕竟，"家人"不就是用来干这个的吗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: What are "families" for, after all...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 毕竟，"家人"不就是用来干这个的吗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you have only failed to secure the help of... not just myself, but any of the three of us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来你不只是没能获得……我的帮助，而且连我们三人中一位也没有争取到？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am not quite sure how you have managed it. I fear two of the three I could forgive. But this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我真不知道你是怎么做到的。如果只是三人中有两人我还能接受，但现在这样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: There is only so much I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我能做的也就这么多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If there is anything I can do to be of assistance, I will do it, mon miracle. What appears to have gone awry between you two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: mon miracle，如果有什么我能帮上忙的，我一定尽力。你们俩之间到底出了什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: If there is anything I can do to be of assistance, I will do it, my friend. What appears to have gone awry between you two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 朋友，如果有什么我能帮上忙的，我一定尽力。你们俩之间到底出了什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see. I fear I must tell you there is little I can do in this matter, as you are experiencing the aftermath of "reaping what one has sown" in this regard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我明白了。恐怕我必须告诉你，在这件事上我能做的并不多，因为你是在"自食其果"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see. Sometimes, acting in one's best wishes is not the same as following their wishes to the letter of their request.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我明白了。有时候，出于好意行事并不等同于完全按照对方的要求去做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see. I fear I must tell you there is little I can do in this matter, as you are experiencing the aftermath of "reaping what one has sown" in this regard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我明白了。恐怕我必须告诉你，在这件事上我能做的并不多，因为你是在"自食其果"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see. It can be a difficult thing, to reconcile one's past actions when they are painted in a new light. I curse Entrati for forcing him, and us, into this despicable situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我明白了。当过去的所作所为被重新审视时，要接受它们确实很难。我诅咒英择谛把他、把我们，逼到了这种可耻的境地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Acting with callous disregard in such a fashion is bound to result in behavior that responds in kind. Particularly when you are dealing with one such as Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如此冷酷无情地对待他人，必然会招致同样的报复。尤其当你面对像罗瑟这样的人时，更是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It is a terrible act we must do, to disobey someone's desires, especially in such a deed as rifling through their private memories and thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 违背他人的意愿，尤其是像翻看他人的私人记忆和思想这种行为，是非常恶劣的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I will do what I can to convince him to listen to you. But I must counsel you to have better arguments prepared as to why he should reinterpret his actions as anything other than cowardice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我会尽我所能说服他听你的话。但我建议你为这种行为的解读准备更有力的理由，否则他只会觉得他的行为是懦弱的表现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not know what recourse you have to correct matters. But I do not believe you will find a path through Marie nor myself, forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不知道你还有什么办法来纠正这件事。恕我直言，我认为我和玛丽都没办法帮你解决这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: For I know that is what eats him whole from the inside out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为我知道，正是这件事从内到外地吞噬了他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps it is best to pursue other options at this point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许你现在最好开始考虑一下其他方案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I know we will also need Marie's assistance in this matter. She may be harder to convince, as you know there is little love lost between those two.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道这件事上我们还需要玛丽的帮助。不过，说服她可能比较困难，因为你也知道，他们俩之间没什么情谊可言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Lua guide you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 月神会指引你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I curse Entrati for forcing him, and ourselves, into such a despicable position.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我诅咒英择谛，是他把我们也逼到了如此可耻的境地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But it seems to me as though the only way to help him is, unfortunately, to do exactly that. And to continue to explore the Descendia until there is no memory left undiscovered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但依我看来，帮助他的唯一方法，恐怕只能这样了。而且要继续探索沉沦之地，直到所有记忆都被揭开为止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: No matter how the devil might protest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 无论恶魔如何抗议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: It seems you already have Marie's assistance in convincing him. I am impressed. There is little love lost between those two.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 看来玛丽已经协助你说服了他。我真是佩服。毕竟那两个人之间向来不对付。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then, I suppose we may begin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那么，我想我们可以开始了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did you truly find yourself so otherwise bereft of options that you resorted to petitioning Roathe to badger me on your behalf in order to send M. Loid upstairs?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是真的走投无路了，以至于不得不请求罗瑟代表你来纠缠我，以便把洛德先生送上楼吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did you truly find yourself so otherwise bereft of options that you resorted to petitioning Roathe to badger me on your behalf?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是真的走投无路了，以至于不得不请求罗瑟代表你来纠缠我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Did you truly find yourself so otherwise bereft of options that you resorted to petitioning Roathe to badger me on your behalf in order to... consider an apology?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你是真的走投无路了，以至于不得不请求罗瑟代表你来纠缠我，以便……考虑向我道歉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not wish to waste more time than I have already lost listening to his argument. I will simply say very well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不想再浪费时间听他争论了。我只想说，很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The issue, correct me if I am wrong, was that you did not wish to wade through my past. Now you seem to have changed your mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如果我理解有误请指正，问题在于你不想深究我的过去。现在你似乎改变主意了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You realize how farcical that sounds, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 你知道这听起来有多荒谬吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I do not understand. We cannot go back. Those waters cannot be retread.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我不明白。我们回不去了。泼出去的水就收不回来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You shall have my assistance as you request. I pity what your attack devil will do next to Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 如你所愿，我将竭诚协助。我真同情你那个恶魔打手接下来会对玛丽做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: You shall have my assistance as you request. Now please, call off your attack devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我将按你的要求提供帮助。现在，把你的恶魔打手叫回去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: The comical nature of it, I admit, is part of what made me come and investigate. Are you so distraught? I cannot imagine the lack of my companionship in your life is so terrible a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 说实话，这件事的滑稽之处正是促使我前来调查的原因之一。你真的这么难过吗？我实在无法想象，生活中缺少我的陪伴会是件多么可怕的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: May I ask why you did not? Were you afraid of the subject matter? Bored by it, perhaps? Or did you think you were not strong enough to weather it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 请问你为什么不听我的话？你是害怕这个话题吗？还是觉得无聊？又或者你觉得自己不够坚强，无法承受？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Then I have no choice but to forgive you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 那我别无选择，只能原谅你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: And what has changed that makes you suddenly care, when previously you did not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 是什么改变了你，让你突然变得现在在意，而之前你却并不在意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: I am left without any other option but to forgive you, of course. I do not know why you would want such a broken thing such as I, cluttering up your spaces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 我别无选择，只能原谅你。我不明白你为什么会想要我这样一个残缺不全的人，来占据你的空间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: A means to an end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 不过是实现目的的手段罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: But I find that my annoyance over your words fades now that I know the absolutely bizarre lengths you will go to have me at your side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 但是，当我了解到你为了让我留在你身边会采取多么匪夷所思的手段时，我对你那些话的恼怒感就消退了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I... am touched and I am... unaccustomed to the ways of this future, so therefore I will not doubt the sincerity of your words. Still, I fear I must refuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……很感动，而且……也不习惯这种未来习俗，所以我不会怀疑你话语的真诚，但我恐怕不得不拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: While I... am touched and I am... unaccustomed to the ways of this future, so therefore I will not doubt the sincerity of your words. Still, I fear I must refuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 虽然我……很感动，而且……也不习惯这种未来习俗，所以我不会怀疑你话语的真诚，但我恐怕不得不拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you are otherwise currently engaged with Marie. She is too dear to me to think that my relationship with you might detract from hers. Or distract from it in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 因为你目前已经和玛丽在一起了。她对我来说太重要了，我不希望我和你的关系会影响到她，或者以任何方式分散她的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: As you are otherwise currently... engaged with Roathe. I do not wish to even comprehend the kind of complications such an entanglement would cause.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 鉴于你目前……与罗瑟有所牵连。我甚至不愿去想象这种纠葛会造成怎样的复杂局面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: My mind is complicated enough, I fear, to think of you and he, a man I know so well, together. Perhaps I am old-fashioned in that regard. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 恐怕我的思绪太过复杂，以至于无法想象你和他这个我如此熟悉的人——在一起的画面。或许我在这方面有些老派。我感觉自己就像个行走的古董。为此，请你原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: - Lyon
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: ——里昂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.text: Perhaps I am old fashioned in that regard. She is like my family, and we are too close. I am a walking relic, it seems. For that, you must forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/LyonRomance/.zhText: 或许我在这方面有些老派。她就像我的家人一样，我们关系太亲密了。我感觉自己像个行走的古董。为此，请你原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hi, of course. What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗨，当然可以。最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You may not be their type, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，你可能不是他喜欢的类型。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They would adore you, Marie. Like I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，他们会非常喜欢你的。就像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I really don't think they could resist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他不会拒绝你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I really wish you would help us, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我真的很希望你能帮帮我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We need you, Marie. Without you, there's no use. Please. Can you forgive me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我们需要你。没有你，一切都毫无意义。求你了，你能原谅我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry I upset you. But please, don't take it out on Loid. Or the family upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉让你不高兴了。但是请不要把气撒在洛德身上，也不要撒在楼上的家族身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The time period? Or my stay there in particular?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是整个时期？还是我在那里时候的体验？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was different, but I promise you're safe here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那是不同的情况，但我保证你在这里很安全。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think it's about the same. The weaponry is different and they might not know what they're up against yet, but war is war and death is death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得差不多。武器装备不同，他们或许还不清楚自己将面对什么，但战争就是战争，死亡就是死亡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think this time is less dangerous. We have more ability to deal with the challenges we're facing. They're just getting started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得这次没那么危险。我们更有能力应对当前面临的挑战。他们才刚刚起步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think this time is more dangerous. While we still have the Infested in common, they were dealing with far more rudimentary weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得这次更危险。虽然我们仍面临共同的感染者，但他们当时使用的武器远不如现在先进。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Honestly, I'm just glad you're enjoying yourself. It can be a lot to adapt to all at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我很高兴你玩得开心。突然要适应这么多新变化，确实不容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Unless you're Orokin, who found a way to avoid death... in theory, if not in practice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 除非你是奥罗金，他们找到了避免死亡的方法……至少理论上如此，实践中未必能实现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm also happy that you're adapting well to the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也为你能很好地适应未来感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe this time is more deadly. We have how many impossible enemies trying to kill us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信这次更危险。有多少不可能打倒的敌人想置我们于死地？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe our time is less dangerous. They are just discovering new ways of killing each other. Our ways are just a bit more exciting in looks, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为我们这个时代没那么危险。他们只是在探索新的自相残杀方式。我们的手段或许在形式上更刺激些罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe it is probably about equal, in the end. Death is death, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为最终结果大概相差无几。死亡就是死亡，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: As someone who tries to defend against the wolf, I often find myself exhausted by this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 作为一个试图抵御狼的人，我常常为此感到精疲力竭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's probably best not to press any buttons you aren't certain about, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那最好别按那些你不确定的按钮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Unless you're Orokin, who found a way to avoid death... in theory, if not in practice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 除非你是奥罗金，他们找到了避免死亡的方法……至少理论上如此，实践中未必能实现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sure you'll be fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信你会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie? Did I do something to offend Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽？我是不是做了什么得罪里昂的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Does he not know how to type?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他难道不会打字吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is he technophobic?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是有技术恐惧症吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Right. I figured if you and Roathe were both on here...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对。我猜既然你和罗瑟都用这个……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is there anything you can do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你有什么办法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad it isn't me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 幸好不是因为我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think it had more to do with ensuring this place didn't fall apart at the seams, than anything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为这更多是为了确保这个地方不至于分崩离析，而非其他任何原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I didn't know if it was appropriate to ask about whether or not your feet were changed by the serum...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道该不该问你，你的脚是不是被血清改变了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Your chair?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的椅子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: His daughter, Euleria - known as Mother, and her family, have been taking care of Deimos this whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是因为他的女儿欧拉瑞娅——人称"母亲"，以及她的家人，一直都在照顾着火卫二。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 众所周知，他是一位天才，也是驾驭氩结晶的幕后推手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Watching over this place, and the heart that pumps Void energy into the Origin System, keeping all of us... usable, really, ever since Entrati left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 守护着这个地方，以及那颗向始源星系输送虚空能量的心脏，自英择谛离开后，它始终维系着我们所有人的……存续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful warframes and weapons we make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些力量源自虚空——正是它们让我们能够制造出众多强大的战甲与武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You were an invalid before you became a protoframe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在成为原型战甲之前你是个残疾人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We call them wheelchairs, believe it or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 信不信由你，我们管它们叫轮椅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他专攻晶体学。他的研究成果都保存在这里的实验室里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: She's come to terms with his absence, and they've made peace with each other, but it was a hard-won thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她已经接受了他离开的事实，他们也和好了，但那来之不易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: She hasn't come to terms with his absence, and they're at each other's throats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她还没有接受他离开的事实，而且他们之间总是争吵不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 后来不知道是什么原因，他被改造成了一个中枢，并获得了自己的殁世械灵外壳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可​要​是​知道他还在外面四处惹事，却连一句都没有跟她说，甚至连封信都没寄……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可​要​是​知道他还在外面四处惹事，却连一句都没有跟她说，甚至连封信都没寄……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不是所有中枢都是因刑罚而被造的。但当时火卫二这边的情况……变得很糟糕，他受了重伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I try to think of disabilities as things that change us. They limit us in some ways, yes, but they can give us strengths that others don't have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我试着把残疾看作是改变我们自身的东西。它们在某些方面限制了我们，没错，但它们也能赋予我们别人所不具备的优势。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You never thought of your condition as a problem?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你从来没有认为你的状况是个问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did you know the protoframe serum would do this to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你知道原型战甲血清会这样影响你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can't imagine how painful that would be for her. For them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我无法想象这对她、对他们来说有多么痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It would destroy what little chance of reconciliation they might have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这会毁掉他们之间仅存的那点和解机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So, he was transferred to the main necraloid - the only Necraloid that remains - and is... well? It's hard to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因此，他被转移到了这个主要的殁世械灵——唯一剩下的殁世械灵——并且……嗯？这很难解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's all right. Don't tell me anything more than you're comfortable with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没关系。你愿意告诉我什么就告诉我什么，不必勉强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Please, keep going. I'm having a hard time getting through to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请继续。我很难让他理解我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. I wish there was something we could do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对。真希望我们能做点什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's not really my decision to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实这不是我做出的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我其实有个朋友很喜欢老鼠。我也觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just wish we could fix him, honestly. Bring back the real Otak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我真希望我们能修复他。把真正的奥塔带回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He makes me smile. He's funny, but it hides something tragic and broken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他能让我笑。他很有趣，但那幽默之下却隐藏着某种悲剧性的破碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sadly, he's not fixable. And I think he grates on a lot of nerves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可惜的是，他已经变不回去了。而且我觉得他挺让人心烦的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've been remiss. You're right. I'll get to work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我确实疏忽了。你说得是对。我现在就着手处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我其实有个朋友很喜欢老鼠。我也觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's just Necraloid. Well, a necraloid. It's complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那只是殁世械灵。嗯，一个殁世械灵。说来话长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is Necraloid. He's a Cephalon, he won't hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那是殁世械灵。他是个中枢，不会伤害你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... don't rightly know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……其实不太清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 两者都是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Your Cardinal Dimanche. Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的星期日主教。英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Entrati made that one. But the concept of what they are - Cephalons - was invented by the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 英择谛创造了它。但关于它们本质的概念——中枢——是由奥罗金发明的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm surprised the skull isn't off-putting for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我真没想到骷髅头居然不会让你反感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I admit, taken out of context, he must be strange. But what in particular is upsetting?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我承认，断章取义的话，他确实很古怪。但具体是什么让你感到不安？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Maybe he realized how horrifying it is to make yourself a digital copy of your lover.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许他意识到，将爱人制作成数字副本是件多么可怕的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Maybe he only ever intended to make the one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许他原本就只打算做这一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm not sure. Maybe he never got around to making more?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不确定。也许他一直没来得及再做更多？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did you like looking after graveyards?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你喜欢看守墓地吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did they ever respond?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们有回应吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you want to know about Otak? Or why you can't talk to him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你想了解奥塔吗？还是想知道为什么你无法和他交谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Otak is hard to explain...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥塔​的​事情​很​难​解释……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would say that it makes for a strange kind of romantic gesture, but I'm hardly one to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我倒觉得这算是一种奇特的浪漫举动，不过我实在没资格说三道四。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wouldn't mind a necraloid buzzing around my place, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说真的，我倒不介意有个殁世械灵在我家周围嗡嗡乱飞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad there's only one of him, honestly. I don't think the world would be ready for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我真庆幸他只有一个。我觉得这个世界还承受不了更多这样的家伙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well... in short, some of Entrati's family is upstairs, and they aren't... exactly aware that we're down here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯……简而言之，英择谛家族有几位在楼上，而他们……完全不知道我们就在楼下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥塔曾是一位哲士、奥罗金科学家和学者。关于他的经历，实在算不上一个幸福的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Of course, I don't mind. Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然，我不介意。问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've honestly forgotten most of the years I've known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实我已经不太记得大部分的岁月了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't miss the parts of my past I'm lacking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我并不怀念那些我失去的过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If for very different reasons, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 只​不过​原​因​完全​不同，是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That was my other self. I believe in holding blame to individuals, not societies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那是另一个我做的事。我相信应该把责任归咎于个人，而不是群体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That wasn't me, that was the kid. But I hate the Orokin just as much as the kid does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那不是我干的，是那个孩子。但我跟那孩子一样恨奥罗金。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wasn't there, the Night of the Naga Drums, when the Tenno turned on the Orokin. That was the kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在长胴鼓之夜，Tenno 攻击奥罗金的时候，我并不在场。是那个孩子干的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have spent some unknown number of years dying at the hands of... well? Myself. I don't mind not being able to remember each one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在无数岁月中已经死过很多次了，死在……呃？死在我自己手里。我不介意自己记不清那些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To summarize, I spent... a great number of years suffering. I guess it's some kind of self-defense mechanism, to forget.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 简而言之，我受了……很多年的苦。我猜这大概是一种自我防御机制吧，选择遗忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He seems like he's doing what he needs to survive. I can't fault him for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他看起来是为了活下去而做的那些事。我不能因此怪他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess interest in Roathe.] There's something compelling about him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [承认对罗瑟感兴趣] 他身上有一种令人着迷的东西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't think I can be in the business of turning away allies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得我不能拒绝盟友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He hasn't done anything to prove he isn't worth helping... yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他还没有做出让我觉得他不值得帮助的事情……至少目前还没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know more about the Orokin and his situation than you. I don't need your help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我比你更了解奥罗金和他的处境。我不需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I appreciate your warnings. I'll keep them in mind when I'm dealing with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很感谢你的提醒。我和他打交道时会记住这些的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you. But I can handle myself. And, more importantly? I have handled worse than him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢。但我自己能应付。而且，关键是？我经历过比他更糟糕的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's lovely to meet you. And don't take this the wrong way, you're welcome here, but... what are you all doing here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很高兴见到你们。别误会，欢迎你们来，但是……你们都在这里做什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil? You mean the Orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔？你是说那个奥罗金人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll do what I can to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会尽我所能提供帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "Entrusted?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "托付？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm willing to help you try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我愿意帮助你尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's Orokin. The only way you'll be able to do that is by putting a bullet between his eyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是奥罗金人。你唯一能做到的办法就是一枪爆他的头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know, honestly. I think the world is too complicated for me to have the answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我不知道。我觉得这个世界太复杂了，我找不到答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I don't. I don't believe in gods. Just science we don't understand yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我没有。我不信神。那只是我们还不懂的科学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe in the Luminaries, like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我和你一样，信双耀神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I do. I have a faith I believe in, though it's not one you'd know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我有信仰，尽管你可能不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's... complicated. I believe there's something out there, but I don't really have a named faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这……有点复杂。我相信世间有某种存在，但我并没有一个确切的信仰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm not perfectly certain I'm right, no one can be. But I still don't personally believe in gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不确定自己是否完全正确，没人能确定。但我个人依然不相信神的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think religion exists to fill a hole in people's lives left by the fear of death and the unknown.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为宗教的存在是为了填补人们生命中对死亡和未知恐惧所留下的空洞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know what the Indifference is, but it isn't a god. We just need to get to the bottom of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道虚空无情之物是什么，但它不是神。我们只需要弄清楚它的本质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't think you'd recognize it at all, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为你根本不会认出它，一定不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You might recognize parts of it. But other parts would be totally foreign to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你也许会认出其中的一部分，但其他部分对你来说可能完全陌生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I find myself drawn more towards Sol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我更加被太阳神所吸引。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I find myself drawn more towards Lua.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我更加被月神所吸引。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I seek balance. I think that's the natural order of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我追求平衡。我认为这才是万物的自然规律。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think there is also something older, truer, and deeper that speaks to us all. A connective tissue, kind of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为还有某种更古老、更真实、更深远的存在在与我们所有人对话。某种程度上，就像联结的组织一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Exactly. I see something beautiful in all of them, I don't know as anyone has it right or wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 正是。我从每一种信仰都看到了各自的美好，我不知道谁对谁错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm a little surprised you're open to people not believing in your faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​有点惊讶​你​竟然会​对不信你们信仰的人​保持​开放​态度。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's exactly it. I don't want to say one is "right" or "wrong."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就是这样。我并不想说哪个是"对"或"错"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I just don't believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我就是不信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's right. I've never... "felt" faith. Or needed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没错。我从未……"感受"过信仰。或者说，我不需要它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Everyone dies. To fear it is silly. It comes for us all. Or at least... it should.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人​都​会​死。​害怕​死亡​是​愚蠢​的。​死亡会​来​找到​我们。​或者​至少……​它​本​该​如此。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've died enough times. I don't fear what comes after. I'm eager for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我已经死了够多次了。我不惧怕死后的一切，我反而渴望死后的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'd like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​也​希望。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm surprised you're open to the idea of other religions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​很​惊讶​你​竟然会​对​其他​宗教​保持​开放​态度。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What kind of dangerous game?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 什么样的危险游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He doesn't think the Man in the Wall is real, either?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他也不相信墙中人是真的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It doesn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它并没有带给我平安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I honestly don't think much about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话我没想太多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它有​带给​我​平安。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, thank you.
