/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不了，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What if i said I was more interested in you, instead? Would that be blasphemous?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果我说我更喜欢你呢？那样做算不算亵渎神明？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, it wouldn't be rude at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，这完全不失礼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May I ask how you feel about Entrati, now that you're here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 既然​现在​你​已经​身​在​此处，​我​可以​请​问​你​觉得​英择谛​是​什么样​的​人​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did you meet Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是怎么认识英择谛的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you think it was all a lie? Or do you think he believed it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​觉得​他​是​在​欺骗​世人​吗？​还是​说​他​其实​也​深信​自己​所传​的​道？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm not. He's a good liar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 倒​没有，​他​很​会​骗人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad to hear it, honestly. I think everyone is too quick to condemn him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实​说，​我​很​高兴听到​你​这么​说。​我​觉得​人们​太​急于​去​谴责​他​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you think he was tricking people? Or do you think he believed it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​觉得​他​是​在​欺骗​世人​吗？​还是​说​他​其实​也​深信​自己​所传​的​道？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm... sorry you fell for his tricks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​……​很​遗憾​你​受​了​他​的​蒙骗。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's a lovely way to look at it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​看​问题​的​角度​真​是​美好。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I disagree. Being a kind person doesn't immediately make me a follower of a god of kindness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​并不​认同。​心地​善良，​并​不​意味​着​我​就​是​那​位​仁慈​之神​的​信徒。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just wish there was a way to get them all to forgive him - he's doing his best to fix things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只​是​希望​有​办法​让​所有​人​都​原谅​他​——​他​确实​在​尽全力​弥补​一切。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They have their reasons. But he's our only chance at stopping the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们​有​他们​的​理由。​但​要​阻止​虚空​无情​之物，​他​是​我们​唯一​的​希望。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Entrati doesn't think too highly of himself, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 英择谛​对​自己​也​​没有​多​高​的​评价。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish I knew how I could help him fix the problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​真​希望​自己​知道​该​怎样​帮​他​解决​这个​问题。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish he had a better plan than "preach."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​希望​他​的​计划​会​比​"传道"​要​高明​一些。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, seeing as it's his fault that thing is running rampant... yes. It's the least he could do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 既然​那​墙中人​肆虐皆​因​他​而​起……​那​至少，​这​算​是​他​能​做​的​最​起码​的​补偿​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All emotions serve a purpose, even indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所有​情绪​都​意义，​即便​冷漠​也​是​如此。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do. I fell victim to it in Duviri. I let apathy eat away at me until that was all that was left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​确实​相信​那份​情绪​的​存在。​我​在​双衍​王境时​便​曾​沦​陷于​它。​任由​冷漠​一点点蚕食​自己，​直到​内心​只​剩下​空洞。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... do think there's the question of Mother's Mother, though... Entrati's wife.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​……确实​觉得​这​里面​还​有​个​问题……​那​就​是​"母亲"​的​妈妈……​也​就​是​英择谛​的​妻子。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think it's only a matter of when.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​觉得​这​只​是​时间​问题​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Entrati is simply a man, nothing more. And he's not even a Cardinal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 英择谛​只​不过​是​个​凡人，​仅此​而​已。​而且​他​根本​就​不​是主教。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you think your faith in him is wise?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​觉得​你​对​他​的​信任​是​真的​明智​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. I share your faith in him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​抱歉。​我​也​同样​相信​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We can... likely assume she is dead, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过，我们​……​大概​可以​推测​她​已经​去​世​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, and nobody seems to want to talk about her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不​知道，​似乎​没有​人​愿意​提起​她。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I share your faith in him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​也​同样​相信​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose that is your role, isn't it? To forgive?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想，​那正​是​你​的​使命，​不​是​吗？​去​宽恕？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Blame me for what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 怪​我​什么？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not personally, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没有​这么​想过。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do, yes, if all parties were okay with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想​过，​前​提是​大家​都​觉得没​问题​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then why carry it at all, I wonder?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那​我​想问，​既然​如此​又​为何​还​要​背负​它​呢？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes, I wonder if I'm not a fool for carrying something that could hurt me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有​时，​我​也​会​想​自己​是否​愚蠢，​明知​有​些​事会​伤人​却​仍​背​负​着​它。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes I wonder why we carry it at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有​时​我​也​会​想​我们​究竟​为何​还​要​背负​这​份​信仰。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Interesting. Why do you say that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有​意思，​你​为什么​这么​说？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even if you've wronged someone else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哪怕​是​你​伤害​过​别人？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can believe in people and gods differently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​可以​信仰​人类​也​可以​信仰​神明，​只是​方式​不同​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There is a difference between faith in gods and faith in men. And Entrati is simply a man.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 信​人​与​信神​是​两​回事。​而​英择谛​他​不过​是​个​凡人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He can be very clever and manipulative, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​很​聪明，也​善于​操纵​他​人，​玛丽。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He was kind to you, where others weren't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​待​你很好，​而​其他​人​却​没有​是​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How would Lyon tell the story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂会​怎么​描述​这​个故事​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If you need to forgive yourself or others to die in "peace," so be it. I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果​你​需要​原谅​自己​或​他​人，​才​能​"安心"​离去​的话，​那​就​去​做​吧。​我​并不​需要。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: In the end, if everyone else forgives you, but you don't forgive yourself? No one has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 最终，​要​是​所有​人​都​原谅​了​你，​但​你​却​无法​原谅​自己​呢​ ？​那​就​是​从​未​有​人​真正​原​谅​过​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you don't think it was a trick?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并且​你​不​觉得​那​是​个​骗局​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: People can be so cruel...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人们​竟如此​无情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry, did I offend you somehow?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 抱歉，​我​那样​做​是​不​是​冒犯到​了​你？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... sincerely apologize for that, I never meant to offend you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​……​真的​很​抱歉，​我​并​无​冒犯​之意。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: People can be cruel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人们​可以​很​无情。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 什么​意思 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, but it's all right. I understand. He needs time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没有，不过没关系。我理解。他需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, sadly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很可惜，没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Don't worry, I think you're much prettier than he is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别担心，我觉得你比他漂亮多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Can I ask you about the elephant in the room?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我能问个显而易见的问题吗？（房间里的大象）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Dare I ask you about Roathe? Or would that send you into a tirade?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可以问你关于罗瑟的事吗？还是说，这样问会让你骂个不停？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That was wonderfully creative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你刚才那些话真有创意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... am going to assume none of that was kind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……就当你这不是什么好话吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh! Sorry. It's a turn of phrase my friends from 1999 taught me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦！抱歉。这是我 1999 年的朋友教我的比喻……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I didn't mean it literally, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕这并不是指真的大象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now I can see why they think this is always so cute when I'm confused...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在我明白了为什么我一困惑他们总是认为这很可爱……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know, but you must have insight into him. I'm trying to understand him better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道，但你肯定对他很了解。我正在尝试更好地理解他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which is why I'm asking you about him. I want to understand him, and I don't particularly trust how he tells his side of the story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这就是我来问你关于他的事情的原因。我想更了解他，但我不太相信他自己讲的那一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know. But I can't hate him for doing what he needed to, to serve his people. I've had to do the same thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道。但我没法恨他，因为他只是为了他的人民做了该做的事。我也曾做过同样的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is one of the most dangerous Orokin the empire ever knew. We'd be fools to turn away that kind of help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是奥罗金史上最危险的奥罗金人之一。拒绝这样的助力，才是真的蠢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm simply trying to find the explanation as to why he is the way he is. I'm trying to understand him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是想找到他为什么会这样的原因。我想尝试理解他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If I know more about him, it might help me figure out how to guide him down a slightly... more benign path.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果我能多了解他，也许能帮助我弄清楚如何引导他走上一条稍微……更温和的道路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I responded harshly, and I apologize for that. I don't want to condemn him for his actions yet - I'm trying to understand him from all sides.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我之前说的话太重了，为此我想要道歉。我现在还不想谴责他的行为——我正在努力从各个角度理解他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't. He's led a life that's hard to understand. But I was curious if you would tell me how you two met.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我确实不想。他的经历难以理解。不过我很好奇，你能告诉我你们是怎么认识的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have. It means "can we talk about the subject we're all avoiding, as if we were not talking about the giant elephant in the room."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对。它的意思是"我们能不能谈谈我们都在回避的话题，就好像我们不去讨论房间里的大象一样。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Never mind. I'll just go talk to the devil himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 算了，我还是自己去跟恶魔谈谈吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. I don't mean to be arguing with you, that's not what I meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对不起。我不是有意跟你争论，我不是那个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's a soldier. He's had to do terrible things in the name of a "greater purpose." I know how that feels. Sometimes, that kind of life turns you... well. Like him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是个士兵。为了"更伟大的使命"，他不得不做出可怕的事情。我懂那种感觉。有时候，那样的生活会让你变得……嗯。像他那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's lived for hundreds, if not thousands of years. Who knows what that really does to a person? How much pain, how much suffering? I know how that feels.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他活了几百年，甚至几千年。谁知道这对一个人会造成什么？多少痛苦，多少折磨？我懂那种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why do you dislike him so much?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么你这么不喜欢他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why did Entrati leave him with you and Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么英择谛把他留给你和里昂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was curious how you met?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很好奇你们是怎么认识的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Agreed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一言为定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I rather like cats, personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就我个人而言，我比较喜欢猫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you not like cats?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你不喜欢猫吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Genetically altering one's form was a fashion statement in the Orokin days. But they were just as human as we are. Or were, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在奥罗金时代，基因改造外形曾是一种时尚。但他们和我们一样，都是人类。或者说，我猜，曾经是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Except for the tail, he honestly looks... more human than many of the Orokin did, back in the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 除了尾巴之外，他真的看起来……比过去的许多奥罗金人更像人类。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you think that everyone can be forgiven, in the end?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你觉得每个人最终都能得到宽恕吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is there anything about him you like? Anything at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他身上就没有什么你喜欢的地方吗？哪怕一点点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, I appreciate your story. So Entrati wants him to be... forgiven? For what? Tau? Or simply being Orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯，谢谢你的分享。所以英择谛希望他……被宽恕？为了什么？Tau 星系？还是仅仅因为他是奥罗金人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All right, I believe you. I don't think you'd lie to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧，我相信你。我想你是不会骗我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And the pastries...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后那些糕点……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did you ever wonder if he was bringing them back for you all to enjoy together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你有没有想过他是特地把它们带回来给大家一起吃？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes of course, what is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然可以，什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Maybe later. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许以后吧。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Go ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请讲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 众所周知，他是一位天才，也是驾驭氩结晶的幕后推手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful Warframes and weapons we make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些力量源自虚空——正是它们让我们能够制造出众多强大的战甲与武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you want to know about Otak? Or why you can't talk to him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你想了解奥塔吗？还是想知道为什么你无法和他交谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Otak is hard to explain...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥塔​的​事情​很​难​解释……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他专攻晶体学。他的研究成果都保存在这里的实验室里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well... in short, some of Entrati's family is upstairs, and they aren't... exactly aware that we're down here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯……简而言之，英择谛家族有几位在楼上，而他们……完全不知道我们就在楼下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥塔曾是一位哲士、奥罗金科学家和学者。关于他的经历，实在算不上一个幸福的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 后来不知道是什么原因，他被改造成了一个中枢，并获得了自己的殁世械灵外壳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不是所有中枢都是因刑罚而被造的。但当时火卫二这边的情况……变得很糟糕，他受了重伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: His daughter, Euleria - known as Mother, and her family, have been taking care of Deimos this whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是因为他的女儿欧拉瑞娅——人称"母亲"，以及她的家人，一直都在照顾着火卫二。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你当时怎么做的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Who was Sister Odette?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥黛特修女是谁 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Watching over this place, and the heart that pumps Void energy into the Origin System, keeping all of us... usable, really, ever since Entrati left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 守护着这个地方，以及那颗向始源星系输送虚空能量的心脏，自英择谛离开后，它始终维系着我们所有人的……存续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So, he was transferred to the main necraloid - the only Necraloid that remains - and is... well? It's hard to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因此，他被转移到了这个主要的殁世械灵——唯一剩下的殁世械灵——并且……嗯？这很难解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just wish we could fix him, honestly. Bring back the real Otak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我真希望我们能修复他。把真正的奥塔带回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He makes me smile. He's funny, but it hides something tragic and broken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他能让我笑。他很有趣，但背后却隐藏着一些悲伤和破碎的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sadly, he's not fixable. And I think he grates on a lot of nerves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可惜的是，他已经变不回去了。而且我觉得他挺让人心烦的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: She's come to terms with his absence, and they've made peace with each other, but it was a hard-won thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她已经接受了他离开的事实，他们也和好了，但那是来之不易的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: She hasn't come to terms with his absence, and they're at each other's throats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她还没有接受他离开的事实，而且他们之间总是争吵不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可​要​是​知道他还在外面四处惹事，却连一句都没有跟她说，甚至连封信都没寄……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可​要​是​知道他还在外面四处惹事，却连一句都没有跟她说，甚至连封信都没寄……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why did you sit with her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你为什么要和她坐在一起？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What happened to Sister Cécilia?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 塞西莉亚修女怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope it meant something to her, that you were there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望你的出现对她来说是有意义的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That was kind of you, to sit with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你心里有善意，愿意和她坐在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can't imagine how painful that would be for her. For them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我无法想象这对她、对他们来说有多么痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It would destroy what little chance of reconciliation they might have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这会毁掉他们之间仅存的那点和解机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's not really my decision to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实这不是我做出的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我其实有个朋友很喜欢老鼠。我也觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've been remiss. You're right. I'll get to work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我是有点疏忽了。你说得对。我会开始着手去做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我其实有个朋友很喜欢老鼠。我也觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Necraloid may not have a soul, but he's unique. Other Cephalons, like Otak, do. They were destroyed in how they were made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 殁世械灵或许没有灵魂，但他很独特。其他中枢，比如奥塔，都有灵魂。它们在诞生之初就被毁坏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. So what would you have me do about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对。那么你希望我做什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. They don't. But it doesn't mean we can go around treating them poorly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对，他们确实没有。但这并不意味着我们可以随意虐待他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know if you're right or not. But they can still think, and feel, and we can't treat them like things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道你说的是不是对的。但他们仍能思考，能感受，我们不能把他们当成物品来对待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Necraloid has a soul. All Cephalons do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 殁世械灵有灵魂。所有中枢都有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm not sure if it's wise to go meddling in other people's affairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不确定干涉别人的事情是否明智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope someday we can tell the Entrati Family the truth. And sooner, rather than later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望有一天我们能把真相告诉英择谛家族。而且越早越好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There isn't much known about the original Wisp, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕我们对原始的 Wisp 了解不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We don't know very much about the people who were turned into the original warframes, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕我们对那些被改造成原始战甲的人了解不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There isn't much known about the original Wisp, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕我们对原始的 Wisp 了解不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We don't know very much about the people who were turned into the original Warframes, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕我们对那些被改造成原始战甲的人了解不多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think they weren't important enough to remember.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为他们不够重要，不值得记住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think they were lost over time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为他们的资料随着时间的流逝已经消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A little bit of both, in the end. They were... part weapon, part artwork, to their primary creator.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说​到​底，​都​有​可能。​对于​他们​的​主要​创造者​来说……他们​既​是​武器，​又​是​艺术品。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't really believe in souls, so we should keep it to hard facts, if possible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不信有灵魂的存在，所以如果可以的话，我们应该用确凿的事实来解释 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's all right, we can talk about souls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没关系，我们可以聊聊灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Weapons can be used to protect as well as to harm. We don't like that we need them, but... we do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 武器既可以用来保护，也可以用来伤害。我们并不喜欢依赖它们，但……我们确实需要它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not all of them. But that one? Yes. There are still some around that I wouldn't condemn immediately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们不全是恶魔。但那一个？他一定是。还有一些人我不会现在谴责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Warframes were... not made in the kindest of ways. I just hope she's not trapped inside the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 战甲的制造方法……并不美好。我只希望她没被感染困住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think that whoever Wisp was, she would be happy to know you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想无论 Wisp 是谁，她都会很高兴认识你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope their souls have been able to move on and be at rest, but I think some part of their memory remains.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望他们的灵魂能够彻底得到安息，但我想，他们的部分记忆仍然存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not at all. I believe some part of the people who were turned into Warframes remain within their core schematics.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 完全没有。我相信被改造成战甲的人，他们的核心构造中仍然残存着他们一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There's a lot I could argue with him about, but I will say that he seems to have a good instinct about whom to give which protoframe serum. Even if I don't know why he does it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我有很多事可以跟他争论，但我得说，他似乎在选择原型战甲血清类型和注射的对象上，有着敏锐的直觉。即使我不明白他为什么这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish you wouldn't trust Entrati as much as you do. We don't know why he chooses to do what he does, and his motives are unclear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望你别那么相信英择谛。我们不知道他为什么要这么做，他的动机也不清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We have to stick with Entrati. I think we have to just follow where he goes. He's our only chance of stopping the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们必须跟着英择谛。我觉得无论他去哪我们只能跟着他。他是我们阻止虚空无情之物的唯一机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's a liar, Marie. He abandons and hurts everyone in his life. He's already abandoned you, don't you see?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，他是个骗子。他抛弃并伤害了他生命中的每一个人。他已经抛弃你了，你难道还不明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've never trusted him, I just didn't want to scare you off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我从来没有信任过他，我只是不想吓跑你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I didn't mean to lie earlier, I just didn't know how to approach the subject. You clearly adore him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我刚才不是故意撒谎，只是不知道该怎么开口。很显然你崇拜他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He... came to Duviri. A long time ago...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​……​有​来​过​双衍​王境。​很​久​以前……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He leaves nothing but pain, death, and abandonment in his wake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他所留下的只有痛苦、死亡和遗弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, to start, he shot me in the chest and left me for dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯，首先，他朝我的胸前开了一枪，然后把我丢在那里等死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's hurt and abandoned a lot of people, you're right. And I think he feels like he's had to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对，他伤害过很多人，也抛弃过很多人。我觉得他认为自己是不得已的这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's hard, when someone who means that much to you - who you love and rely on, goes away. Especially if you don't know why. Or they don't come back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当一个对你如此重要、你深爱、依赖的人离去，这真的很难受。尤其是当你不知道原因，或者他们再也不会回来的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think at first, some part of him was there seeking a bit of the daughter he left behind. But instead, he found a way to fight the Indifference - with the emotions he sought to distance himself from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，一开始，他内心深处总在追寻他留下的女儿。但他最终找到了一种对抗虚空无情之物的方法——用他试图疏远的情感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: His notes tell a very obnoxiously self-flattering story of how he went to study conceptual embodiment and instead came away learning the value of fighting the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他的笔记讲了一个非常令人讨厌的自吹自擂的故事，讲述了他如何去研究概念成形，却最终变成研究对抗虚空无情之物的价值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If his notes are to be believed, he was there to teach Duviri - and by extension me, how to defend against the Indifference. For what good it did in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果他的笔记属实，他去那里是为了教会双衍王境——以及我——如何抵抗虚空无情之物。可到头来一点用也没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just wish... we could get everyone around Entrati to stop blaming themselves and each other for what's happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是希望……我们可以让英择谛周围的每个人都不再为所发生的事情自责和互相指责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll do what he needs me to do, to solve this problem. And then I'll judge him, when all is said and done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​会​按照​他​的​要求​去​做，​解决​这个​问题。​然后，​等​一切​都​尘埃​落定，​我​再​评判​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know as I'd ever call him blessed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不觉得他是蒙福​的​人​。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It would be a lot easier to forgive Entrati for his misdeeds if I could understand them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果我能理解英择谛的所作所为，也许宽恕就没那么难了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When he doesn't explain himself, all we can do is make up our own reasons, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当​他​不​为​自己​解释​时，​恐怕​我们​所​能​做​的​就​是​自己​编​造理由。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're missing the point. He left me there. He saw someone abandoned in the Void, and he left me there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你没抓住重点。他把我留在那里了。看到有人被遗弃在虚空中，然后他就把我留在那里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No. I just know that he left me there. He saw someone abandoned in the Void, and just... left me there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不。我只知道他把我留在那里了。看到有人被遗弃在虚空中，然后他就把我……留在那里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He left me there. He arrived, at some point I don't know - and saw someone abandoned in the Void, and... left me there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他把我留在那里了。在我不知道的时候，他来过——看到有人被遗弃在虚空中，然后……就把我留在那里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The Indifference came for Duviri anyway, in the end. (Although, it had unexpected help. But that's neither here nor there.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不管怎样，虚空无情之物最终还是来到了双衍王境。（虽然也带来了意想不到的帮助。但这无关紧要。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only assume this happened before the... murder ad infinitum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能推测这发生在……无限谋杀之前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only hope he had a good reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只​希望​他​给​出​一​个​好​的​理由。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, and it doesn't matter. He could have saved me. And he didn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不知道，不过这不重要。他本来可以救我的。但他没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's just wearing another face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它只不过是戴着另一张脸而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Maybe? Or a hostage. Or it's just wearing her face. We don't really know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许吧 ？或者说是人质。或者只是戴着她的脸。我们并不知道真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps I wish you would hunt me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许我希望你来狩猎我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Are you mad at me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是在对我生气吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Right... Anyway, back to the story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧……无论怎样，回到故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll tell you all I know, but I'm afraid I don't know as much as you might think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会告诉你我所知道的一切，但恐怕我知道的没有你想象的那么多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh. Sure, but... wouldn't Loid be the better person to talk to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦。当然，不过……去和洛德谈这个更合适吧 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Who do you want to know about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你想了解谁 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, there's Mother, Father, Son, Daughter, and Grandmother upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯，楼上有"母亲"、"父亲"、"儿子"、"女儿"和"祖母"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, that's Father's mother. Mother's mother-in-law.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，她是"父亲"的母亲。"母亲"的婆婆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you want the long story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你想听长一点的版本吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll give you the short of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我给你一个简短的版本。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The family upstairs was trapped here when the Orokin Empire collapsed. Son, Entrati's grandson, let the Infestation in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥罗金帝国分崩离析时，楼上的家族被困在这里。"儿子"，也就是英择谛的孙子，将感染者引入了这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, we are on a moon called Deimos. And a biological bomb was detonated here, long ago, in a desperate attempt to repel the Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧，我们现在位于一颗名为火卫二的卫星上。很久以前，为了驱逐 Sentient，这里曾引爆过一枚生化炸弹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes. They tried to harness the Infestation to fight the Sentients. But Deimos became overrun. They locked themselves in the Necralisk - which is above us - for shelter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的。他们试图利用感染者来对抗 Sentient。但火卫二被彻底吞噬了。他们只能把自己封锁在我们上方的殁世幽都里避难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I think it was an accident. I think he means well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，​应该​是​个​意外。​我​觉得​他​是​出于​好意。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know the truth yet, but I'll reserve judgement until I know more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还不知道真相，但我会保留意见，直到了解更多信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know the truth yet, but he's arrogant, I can tell you that much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还不知道真相，但我可以告诉你，他很傲慢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Son, Entrati's Grandson, however, was intent on trying to preserve and study the infested animals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然而，"儿子"，英择谛的孙子，却一心想保育和研究被感染的动物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, trapped in the Necralisk, and consumed by grief and with no Orokin Empire to rescue them, and now with the Infestation leaking in...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯，他们被困在殁世幽都，悲痛欲绝，没有奥罗金帝国来拯救他们，就在这时感染者又开始入侵了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I believe he did. I think he honestly cares about the creatures.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我相信他是。他的确关心这些生物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sadly, it didn't matter, the reckless damage was done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可悲的是，这已经不重要了，鲁莽已经造成了破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They turned on each other. Ripped each other apart from the inside out. And the Infestation did the rest. Taking their very names from them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们互相反目，从内到外互相撕扯。剩下的就由感染者完成了。就连他们的名字都被夺走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know the truth yet, but he's arrogant, I can tell you that much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还不知道真相，但我可以告诉你，他很傲慢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, it was arrogance that inspired him. Even if he claims it was an accident.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，是傲慢驱使了他。哪怕他声称这只是一场意外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm smiling at the idea. But I don't think it'd be wise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这个想法有点好笑。其实我觉得这不太明智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope that'll happen someday. I really do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望会有这样一天。我真的希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Unless you give it away, like Grandmother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 除非你是自己送人，就像"祖母"那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's honestly not so bad, you get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实这并没有那么糟糕，你会习惯的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Animals don't have names, and they seem perfectly happy. We give them names simply for our own sake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 动物没有名字，它们看起来却非常快乐。我们给它们起名字，只是为了满足我们自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕一半的人会把另一半人当成"另一个家族"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 楼上的情况……即使在最好的情况下也依旧脆弱。我不想让他们难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How will you make it up to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你要怎样补偿我呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's all right, I'm only teasing. I'm not upset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没事，我只是开玩笑而已，我没有生气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We just have to be careful. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们只能小心一点。恐怕一半的人会把另一半人当成"另一个家族"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 楼上的情况……即使在最好的情况下也依旧脆弱。我不想让他们难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Slowly. Carefully. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as the "other family."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 慢且小心翼翼。恐怕一半的人会把另一半人当成"另一个家族"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 楼上的情况……即使在最好的情况下也依旧脆弱。我不想让他们难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope I picked it myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望这是我自己选的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't remember, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实说，我不记得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Where was I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我说到哪了 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That was a little wicked of you, wasn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你这样是不是有点太坏了 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Right... Anyway, back to the story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧……无论怎样，回到故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Don't take it the wrong way. I enjoyed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别误会。我喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So you and he... have never been romantic?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以你和他……从来没有谈过恋爱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was just curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是好奇而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I admit, I'm a little relieved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我承认，我有点松了口气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Would you tell me more about what it was like living in the Cathedral? Before Entrati came?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能跟我详细讲讲在英择谛到来之前，住在大教堂里是什么样的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What was your life like at the Cathedral before Entrati showed up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在英择谛出现之前，你在大教堂的生活是什么样的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Where did you grow up, Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，你在哪里长大？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why was it your favorite?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么它是你最喜欢的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. What about that last part?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不好意思。能再说说最后一句吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You do like to wander off topic, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你又跑题了，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I could probably ask two of my friends, they're pretty well-traveled. I think they even mentioned they've been to that city.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我或许可以问问我另外两个朋友，他们旅行经历很丰富。我记得他们甚至提到过他们去过那座城市。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know, I'm... afraid of really dying, I've never liked being around death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道，我……害怕真正死去，我从来都不喜欢与死亡为伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've never thought about it that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我从来没有从这种角度想过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've found the same kind of peace, being in graveyards and cemeteries. I completely understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在墓地和公墓里也找到了同样的平静感。我完全能理解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That couldn't have been the easiest task, given your wheelchair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 考虑到你坐着轮椅，这不可能是最简单的工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Didn't you have other friends to talk to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你没有其他朋友可以聊天吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry Entrati upset what you had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉英择谛打乱了你的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm so glad you two had each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很高兴你们俩有彼此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You two make me smile.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你们两个真会逗我笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Your family left you for dead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的家人就这么放任你去死 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How old were you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你当时多大 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did you survive?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是怎么活下来的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's horrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这太可怕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What about the other children?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那其他的孩子呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Obviously, you said yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 显然，你答应了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What were the sisters like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那些修女是什么样的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How'd you adjust to life at the Cathedral?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你是如何适应大教堂的生活的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When I remember about all those who have died around me, when I'm the one who lived? I feel the same. But we can't do that to ourselves. We have to keep on fighting to improve things when we can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当我想起身边所有的人都死去了，而我却活了下来时，我也有同样的感受。但我们不能这样折磨自己。我们必须继续努力，争取让情况变得更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You've done your best to try to help others with what you were given. Others lifted you up, and you're trying to lift others up now that you've been given that opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你已经尽你所能去帮助其他人了。你曾被他人托举，而如今你有了机会，也在托举他人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What's the question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 什么问题 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... don't... know how to feel about this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……不知道……对此该作何感想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. You what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不​好意思，​你​说​什么 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I guess I'm just... jealous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我只是……很嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I guess I'm just... surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我只是……很惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, Archimedeans were a rank below the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不​是，​哲士​的​阶级​低于奥罗金人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Orokin Empire is called that because the Orokin ran it, but the Orokin was also just the name of the ruling class.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥罗金帝国之所以被称为奥罗金帝国，是因为奥罗金人统治着它，但奥罗金也只是统治阶级的名称。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This happens a lot. You're not alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这种事挺常见的。你不是唯一的一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm just a little taken aback you know more about him now than I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是有点惊讶你现在比我还了解他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know anything about Loid's past, and I've known him for a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认识洛德已经有一段时间了，而到现在我对他的过去还一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thousands of years of being in charge, and people get... bored. Bored people make complicated systems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 几千年来，人们一直掌权，最后都会……感到无聊。无聊的人就会创造出复杂的系统。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They had a taste for the ornate and the intricate. It extended to bureaucracy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们热衷于华丽和复杂的事物，这种品味也延伸到了官僚机构中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Honestly? I'm starting to think so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实说 ？我现在开始这么想了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know anything about him, really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实我对他一点都不了解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's a bit aloof, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，他有点冷淡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Should I be concerned?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我应该担心吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vive la révolution ! I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vive la révolution ！大概吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm not quite sure what just happened, but I think I agree?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不太清楚刚才发生了什么，但我想我赞同 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He has his reasons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他自有他的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anyway... What was your question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧……你的问题是什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wasn't trained to be a soldier. Not like the kid. Neither were you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我没有受过当兵的训练。不像那孩子。你也一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wasn't... always like this. Always a fighter. I had to learn the hard way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我并非……一直像现在这样。不是天生的战士。我是经历了很多痛苦才学会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. It was a silly thing to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对不起。我做了件傻事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you forgive me, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么​你​会​原谅​我​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes, I think about how much I had to discover on my own, and I get a little envious of the kid for the real training they had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有时，我会想，有很多事情都是靠我自己摸索学习的，我其实有点羡慕那个孩子，能够受到真正的训练。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think there's no "good" way to wind up in a life of war. To be born, or raised, or to choose it. In the end, it's about who you are and what you do with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得，不管​是​为了什么，​一​个​人​被​卷入​战争​中​总不​是​什么​好事。无论是生来就要适应战乱、为了成长，还是自己选择的。最终，这取决于你是谁，以及你应对的方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've... been better, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实说，我……已经好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm all right, honestly. How are you, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实说，还挺好。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Better, now. Thank you. I hear confession is good for people, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在好多了。谢谢你。我听说忏悔对人有好处，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll just have to make sure to bring enough pastries for everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只​需要​确保​带够​大家​的​份。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thanks, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just won't let Roathe anywhere near them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不会让罗瑟靠近它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You can never go wrong with pastries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 糕点永远不会出错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's hard, when you're raised to think that's your only purpose, your only existence, to break out of that mold. Purpose gives people comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当你从小就被灌输"这就是你唯一的目的，你唯一的存在意义"的观念时，要打破这种框架是很困难的。目的能给人安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think they would. There's a few of them who I've met who have proven to me that there's more to the Grineer than just war and death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想他们会的。我遇到过几个 Grineer，他们向我证明了 Grineer 并不只有战争和死亡那一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They're still healing. Their journey isn't ended yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们还在疗伤。他们的旅程还没结束呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish there was more I could do for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我真希望自己能为他们做更多的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll make sure to bring enough for everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我下次一定带够大家的份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is a phenomenal mental image.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这个画面感太强了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And why do you travel down a road?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那​你​为什么​要​踏​上​旅途​呢 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why else would you travel down a road?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 否则又为什么要踏上旅途呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did Roathe bring enough to share, though?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过罗瑟当时有没有带够大家的份 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And the pastries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那那些糕点 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Better now that I'm speaking to you. But you make all my days brighter by being in them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 跟你说话之后感觉好多了。你的存在让我的每一天都更加美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do mean it. I'm sorry if I'm making you uncomfortable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我是认真的。如果我让你感到不舒服，我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. I was just teasing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对不起，我只是开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've been better, but thank you for asking. How're you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不如以前，不过还是谢谢你关心。你好吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm good, how're you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很好，你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... should confess now that I was lying, I'm not... really a follower of Sol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……现在应该向你忏悔我之前撒了谎，我……并不是太阳神的追随者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's... just... hard to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这……很难解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Too much to worry about. Too little time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 要担心的事情太多，留给我的时间却太少。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A friend of mine once described it as "spiders." They creep in now and again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的一个朋友曾经把它描述成"蜘蛛"。它们会时不时地爬进来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes, everything... just gets to me. But I'll be okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有时候，所有事……会一下子都压到我身上。但我会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was in your shoes, once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我曾经也踩过相同的坑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I thought it would be an opportunity to get to know you better...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我当时觉得这是一个更好地了解你的机会……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I thought it would be funny?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我以为这会很有趣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I honestly don't know. It was just impulsive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我真的不知道。只是一时冲动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You've been thrown into an outlandish situation. Of course I won't judge you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你被卷入了一场荒诞的处境。我当然不会评判你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will do my absolute best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会尽力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes. Yes, absolutely. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的。是的，当然。多谢你提出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The notion of you being annoyed at Fibonacci is incredibly endearing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你对斐波那契感到烦躁的念头真是可爱极了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, actually. I adore him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实，并不会。我非常喜欢他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I spend most of my time having to fight for my life. Little reminders of humanity like this is... kind of what I live for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我大部分时间都在为生存而战。像这样的人性微光……某种程度上是支撑我活下去的意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose every now and then I have to take a step back and reflect on the absurdity of it all. A Norg and a priestess of Sol...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想偶尔还是得退一步，反思这一切的荒谬。一个诺格和一位太阳神祭司……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Does he get them often?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他经常会这样吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgive me... a what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不好意思……什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think we call them "migraines" now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我们现在都称它们为"偏头痛"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Huh. Megrims. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呃。偏头风。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder what causes them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在想是什么原因导致的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That sounds awful...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 听起来糟透了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I also get those kinds of headaches. They're terrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也会有这种头痛，简直要命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I also get megrims. They're terrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也会得偏头风。那感觉糟透了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can be exceedingly stubborn. Don't you worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可固执得很。你别担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've already got one Man in the Wall... why not two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我已经有一个墙中人了……为什么不能有两个 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is a grown man. If he wishes to talk, he can talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是个成年人了。要是他愿意开口，自然会说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is Lyon... all right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂……还好吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did you and Lyon meet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​和​里昂​是​怎么​认识​的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If this conversation bothers you, we can move on to something else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果这个谈话让你不舒服，我们可以换个话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't want to upset you at all. I just worry about him. He has a stoic appearance, but I get the feeling he's in pain, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一点也不想让你难过。我只是担心他。他看起来很镇定，但我感觉他很痛苦，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Were you... in need of a place to stay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你……需要住的地方吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May I ask an indelicate question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可以问一个不太礼貌的问题吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did you two meet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你们俩是怎么认识的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm used to being a bit of a "local attraction," I understand how you could be defensive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我已经有点习惯是"本地景点"了，我理解你为什么会有防御心理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's all right. I'm just worried about him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没事的，我只是担心他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Were you... in need of a place to stay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你……需要住的地方吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May I ask an indelicate question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可以问一个不太礼貌的问题吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That summarizes it fairly neatly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这已经总结得相当厉害了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would hope people see me as more than that, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望人们眼中的我不只是这样，说实话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I feel like he won't talk to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他不会想跟我说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I want to help him, if I can. Do you have any advice?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果可以的话，我想帮助他。你有什么建议吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm used to being a bit of a "local attraction," I know how you both feel. No, that's not what this is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我已经有点习惯是"本地景点"了，我理解你们的感受。不，不是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I was just curious. And honestly, a little worried about him. I think he masks a lot of his pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我只是好奇。而且说实话，我有点担心他。我觉得他掩盖了很多自己的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope he feels comfortable enough to talk to me, soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望他能很快感到自在并愿意跟我交谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad you two found each other. We're all more than we might seem at first glance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很高兴你们找到了彼此。我们都不只是第一眼看上去的那样而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That summarizes it fairly neatly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这已经总结得相当厉害了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would hope people see me as more than that, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我希望人们眼中的我不只是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Has Lyon ever scared you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂曾经吓到过你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Disable all conversations about self-harm. You will not lose any chemistry points with any characters.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [禁用所有关于自残的对话。你不会因此损失与任何角色的好感度点数。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know if I'd rather these visions of his to be real or fake, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我真不知道自己更希望他的这些幻象是真实的还是虚假的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: With talk of all the terrible things he sees. The descriptions...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谈论他目睹的所有可怕之事。那些描述……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That he might harm himself past the point of no return someday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他总有一天可能会让自己陷入万劫不复的地步 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you ever feel unsafe in his presence? That he might harm you, without realizing it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你在他身边的时候会不会感到不安全 ？担心他会不经意地伤害你 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The Warframe that he was given the serum to is known to... well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他被注射的战甲血清……呃……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's fairly obvious from looking at him... no offense. It wasn't hard to guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 看他那副样子就很明显了……没冒犯的意思。猜出来并不难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm just concerned he might take it too far some day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是担心他哪天可能会做得太过分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We need him in one piece.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们需要他完好无损。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't need to be worrying about having to clean up his corpse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可不想费心去收拾他的尸体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I care about him a great deal. I just am worried when we need him, he won't be there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我很在意他。只是担心当我们需要他时，他不会出现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just need to know if I can count on him or not, or if he's already too broken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只想知道他是否值得信赖，还是他早已伤痕累累。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I understand completely. And I have... a bit of a confession to make. [Confess feelings for Lyon.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我完全理解。而且我……有件事要坦白。[表露对里昂的心意]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I understand what you're saying, but I can't condone him hurting himself. He should stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我明白你的意思，但我不能纵容他伤害自己。他应该停止这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Warning: Discussion of suicide.] I lost someone once, to that kind of self-harm. I can't... I can't condone it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [警告：涉及自杀话题] 我曾失去过一个人，正是死于这种自残行为。我无法……我无法容忍这种行为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There has to be another way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他的情况一定还有别的办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're making perfect sense. I just... wish I could help him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得完全有道理。我只是……真希望我能帮到他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I fear he's... taken hold of my heart, and it breaks to know he's in pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕他……已经俘获了我的心，而得知他身陷痛苦，我的心都碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, it won't kill him. But it's still not okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，这不会要了他的命。但这样做还是不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I guess I see your point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我大概明白你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not very.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 算不上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Really? I didn't know how you'd feel about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真的吗 ？我不知道你会怎么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just wish I could tell if he could stand my presence or not...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我真希望知道他到底能不能忍受我的存在……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... need to just avoid the topic, please. I can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……请让我避开这个话题吧。我做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I need to be certain that Lyon doesn't suffer...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我必须确保里昂不会遭受痛苦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll do what I can to take your advice. I just don't know how to get through to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会尽量采纳你的建议。只是我实在不知该怎么让他明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll do what I can, I just... I wish I could do more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会尽力的，只是……真希望能做得更多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He can just be... frustrating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他就是……让人抓狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I still don't think it's right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还是觉得这样不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll do what I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会尽力而为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Let's end this here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就聊到这里吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Can we get back to talking about Lyon, instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们能回到里昂的话题上吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... think I'd like to hear about them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……想听听这个人的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wait, I didn't mean for you to meddle!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 等等，我不是让你插手的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Should I be concerned?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我应该担心吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I could use the help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我需要帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, actually. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，确实如此。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: More than it should, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 出乎意料的说得通，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: None. But thanks for trying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不太行。不过谢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How old were you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你当时多大 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Your family left you for dead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的家人就这么放任你去死 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think it's adorable, and so will he.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得这么说很可爱，他也会这么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Your secret is safe with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会守住秘密的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's horrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这太可怕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did you survive?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是怎么活下来的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢你，玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Stay silent.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [保持沉默]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, may I ask a personal question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我可以问一个私人问题吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why do you choose to worship Sol?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你为什么选择崇拜太阳神 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why do you believe in Sol?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你为什么信太阳神 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... suppose I feel obligated to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……我觉得我有义务这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wasn't really being honest with you when I told you that answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我回答这个问题时并没有说真话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I had an experience. It changed my life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我经历过一件事，它改变了我的人生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nothing ever happened, it's just something I've felt. It's guided me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实我没经历什么大事，只是一直有种感觉。它指引着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I want to believe. Therefore, I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想要信。因此，我信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不知道 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Should I be worried?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我应该开始担心吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Honestly? Yes, kind of. I didn't want to phrase it that way, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实说 ？是有点。不过我本来不想这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was more wondering if there was an event, or... a moment that led to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​更​想​知道​是​不​是​有​一​个​事件，​或者​是​某个​时刻……​让​你​去信。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm not sure, to be blunt. It was impulsive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 坦白说，我不知道。那是一时冲动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I thought it might be a way to get to know you better...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我当时觉得这是一个更好地了解你的机会……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You wouldn't call Entrati's serum a miracle?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你不觉得英择谛的血清就是一个神迹 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not even Lyon's voices? Or the Indifference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 连里昂的那些声音也不算吗？或者那个虚空无情之物 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Has he ever failed to guide you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他有过没带领你的时候吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish I had that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我真希望我也能拥有那样的信仰……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you forgive me, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么​你​会​原谅​我​吗 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. It was a silly thing to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对不起。我做了件傻事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 什么事 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did you guess that was what I was going to ask? That's amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你怎么猜到我会问这个问题？太厉害了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That... wasn't what I was going to ask, but I will keep it in mind, thank you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那……并不是我原本想问的，但我会记住的，谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How are you today, Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，你今天过得怎么样 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll go if you want, but if you want to talk, I'm happy to listen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你想的话，我会走开，但如果你想谈谈，我很乐意倾听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All right, I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好的，我明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May I ask what's wrong...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请问是出了什么事吗…… ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If you're certain, but I'm here, if you want to talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你真的这样想的话。但如果你想谈谈，我一直在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... know what that's like. Before I started "looping," I hurt myself pretty badly in Duviri. It healed, but it still aches something awful from time to time. I try to hide my wincing when it acts up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……知道那种感觉。在我开始"循环"之前，我在双衍王境受了很重的伤。虽然已经痊愈了，但还是时不时地疼得厉害。每次疼起来，我都尽量掩饰自己畏缩的表情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Old persistent problems can sometimes be as problematic as new ones. Just because they come and go, and can stay with us, doesn't mean they aren't worth talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 旧问题有时和新问题一样棘手。即使它们来来去去，并且一直萦绕在我们身边，也不意味着它们不值得讨论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If there's one thing it's given us, it's a tolerance for pain, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果说它赋予了我们什么，我想那就是对痛苦的忍耐力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It... really never stops hurting? I'm so, so sorry, Marie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它……真的从来没有好过吗？玛丽，我真的很为你感到难过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And there's no medication? No treatment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一点药也没有吗 ？一点治疗办法也没有 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes, though... I wake up and I feel like it's going to be the day that I break.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但有时候……我醒来，感觉那又是我崩溃的一天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have had that same conversation so many times...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也被人这样问过好多次……
