/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Exactly. I'm so sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 确实……我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie? May we talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽 ？我们可以谈谈吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe told me about... the fight with Tagfer. Can we talk about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟跟我提过……你和标弃的那场争吵。我们可以聊聊吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's not important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Loid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 洛德。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He did. He's concerned about the situation because I think he feels for the Cavia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的。他很关心这个情况，是因为我觉得他同情科维兽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He didn't need to tell me, I could guess. Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他不需要告诉我，我就能猜到。是因为英择谛吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He did. Though he seemed more concerned about you than anything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的。不过他似乎最关心的是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, honestly. He said only that I should check in on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没有，老实说。他只是说我应该去看看你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tagfer is not the biggest supporter of Entrati, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 标弃并不是英择谛的支持者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I take it that the argument was a loud one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 看来这场争吵很激烈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Please, start from the beginning. How did this whole fight start?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请从头说起吧。这场争吵是怎么开始的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can start to get a sense of why this fight happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我开始明白这场争吵发生的原因了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did he actually call you stupid and a child?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他真的有说你是笨蛋和小孩子吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tagfer only knows his side of the story. Entrati's real motivations or opinions weren't... clearly explained.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 标弃只知道他那边的故事。英择谛真正的动机或想法……并没有说清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know how you feel about being "dependent" on others and I'm sorry he said those things to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你对"依赖"他人的感受，我很抱歉他对你说了那些话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tagfer has good reasons to feel the way he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 标弃也有他自己的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And how did he take that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是怎么回应的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 噢，不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And do you know how deeply yours did? Do you know their whole story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你知道你的话伤他有多深吗 ？你知道他们的全部故事吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And what you said hurt him just as much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说的话也同样伤害了他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm honestly on your side, but... we have to try to keep the peace, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实说，我是站在你这边的，但是玛丽……我们必须努力保持和平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, please. I'm not trying to fight. I'm just trying to get you to understand what they've been through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，拜托了。我不是想吵架。我只是想让你明白他们经历了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If Entrati stuck around to help clean up after his own messes, he might have more friends in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果英择谛留下来帮忙收拾自己造成的烂摊子，他在这个世界上可能会有更多的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, please. I'm not trying to fight. I'm just trying to get you to understand what they've been through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，拜托了。我不是想吵架。我只是想让你明白他们经历了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I am taking his side. Because you're not listening to reason. You have to understand "le Cardinal" is not what he seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我站在他那边。因为你不讲道理。你得明白，"主教"并非表面看起来的那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It matters if there's nobody left around us when we're on the other side of this. They've been through a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果只有我们还在为这件事争吵，而其他人早已不相信英择谛，那就有关系了。他们经历了太多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sure he'll forget about it. I'm sure you will, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信他会放下的。我相信你也会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The situation that the Cavia have been through has been... hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 科维兽的经历……很艰难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They're animals, even if they've been given intelligence, they're still animals. There's only so much they're capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们是动物，即便他们被赋予了智慧，他们仍然是动物。他们的能力是有限的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I'm not lying. I'm with you. I'm just saying their situation has been... hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我没有撒谎。我是站在你这边的。我只是说他们的经历……很艰难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, not a game, exactly...? Entrati isn't to be trusted, and I don't know how else to convince you but to pretend to be on your side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，确切地说，不是游戏…… ？英择​谛不​可信，除了假装站在你这边，我不知道还有什么其他办法可以说服你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The Cavia were accidents created from experiments. Lab animals never meant to exist. The Void gave them intelligence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 科维兽是实验中意外诞生的。本不该存在的实验室动物。是虚空赋予了它们智慧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Imagine how you would feel if Entrati just swooped in, turned Lyon into a protoframe, and abandoned him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想象一下，如果英择谛突然出现，将里昂变成原型战甲，然后抛弃他，你会有何感想 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You said yourself "It is the ultimate form of cruelty, to be absent of a name." Entrati never bothered to name them, they were that worthless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你自己说过，"没有名字，这是最残酷的事。" 英择谛从来就不会费心去给他们起名，因为他们太没价值了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You told me the story of how you grew up on the streets. How your family threw you out because you weren't good enough for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你跟我讲过你在街头长大的故事。你的家人因为你不够好而把你赶出家门。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Think about how you would have felt, if you had simply been turned into a protoframe against your will and then abandoned?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想想看，如果有人不顾你的意愿把你变成了一个原型战甲，然后抛弃了你，你会有什么感受 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And when Entrati saw what he had done? When he realized what he had created? These poor animals, speaking in Void-tongue, sick from exposure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当英择谛看到自己的所作所为 ？当他意识到自己创造了什么时 ？这些说着虚空之语的可怜动物，却患了虚空暴露症 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Used him like a cheap science experiment, and then washed his hands of him? You all had each other to rely on before and after you changed. The Cavia didn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 把他当成廉价的科学实验品，然后就甩手不管了 ？你们在被改造前后​尚且​可以互相依靠。而科维兽却不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They were just things to him. Things to be used and thrown away. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对他来说，他们只是些东西。用完就扔的东西。"标弃 ？"意思是"标记为弃品"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Your family thought you were worthless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的家人认为你一文不值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Imagine what it would have been like to have the Infestation in your blood, suffering, with no one there to say they cared?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想象一下，如果你的血液中被感染，痛苦不堪，却没有人关心，那会是什么感觉 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He didn't care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他一点也不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To Entrati, the Cavia were just disposable lab animals. Worthless. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对英择谛来说，科维兽不过是一次性实验动物，毫无价值。"标弃 ？"意思是"标记为弃品"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bird 3? He's a bird with a number for a name. Fibonacci gave himself his name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 鸟三 ？它是一只用数字命名的鸟。倒是斐波那契给自己取了个名字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is what the Cavia were to Entrati. Disposable lab animals. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对英择谛来说，科维兽就是那样的存在。一次性实验动物。"标弃？"意思是"标记为弃品"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That your suffering even mattered? The Cavia were - are - worthless to Entrati. Disposable lab animals. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你所受的痛苦真的那么重要吗 ？对英择谛来说，科维兽曾是——现在也是——一次性实验动物。"标弃？"意思是"标记为弃品"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is what the Cavia were to Entrati. Disposable. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对英择谛来说，科维兽就是那样的存在。一次性的。"标弃 ？"意思是"标记为弃品"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Used in a Void experiment. Survivors in a long line of dead animals. Never intended to exist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们被用于虚空实验。是一连串死去动物中的幸存者。本不该存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The last of his kind. Tag For Disposal. His mate? Minn? The only other one left? Died in the experiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是他们种族的最后一个了。被标记为弃品。而他的伴侣小敏 ？也是唯二剩下的 ？在实验中死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's only because of Loid that they're still alive. He preserved them because he couldn't bring himself to euthanize them "per Entrati's instructions."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 正是因为洛德，他们才得以存活。他之所以会保住他们，是因为他无法"按照英择谛的指示"对他们实施安乐死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's why he was mad, Marie. That's why he hates Entrati. And why he probably always will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，这就是他生气的原因。也是他憎恨英择谛的原因。而且，他可能永远都会憎恨英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, and Tagfer? He's the last of his kind. His mate, Minn? The only other one left? Died in the experiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，还有标弃 ？他是他们种族的最后一个了。他的伴侣小敏 ？也是唯二剩下的 ？在实验中死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's why he was mad, Marie. That's why he hates Entrati. And why he probably always will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，这就是他生气的原因。也是他憎恨英择谛的原因。而且，他可能永远都会憎恨英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you believe he's doing what he thinks he needs to. And I know you believe in forgiveness. So do I. But you have to understand why for some people it's not possible. At least not yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你认为他正在做该做的事。我也知道你相信宽恕。我也是。但你得明白，为什么对某些人来说，宽恕是不可能的。至少现在还不可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There are some times when forgiveness isn't possible for people to muster for those who have hurt them. Certainly not now, and maybe not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有时候，人们根本无法原谅那些伤害过他们的人。现在肯定不行，也许永远也不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you believe he's doing what he thinks he needs to. And I know you believe in forgiveness. So do I. But you have to understand why for some people it's not possible. At least not yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你认为他正在做该做的事。我也知道你相信宽恕。我也是。但你得明白，为什么对某些人来说，宽恕是不可能的。至少现在还不可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There are some times when forgiveness isn't possible for people to muster for those who have hurt them. Certainly not now, and maybe not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有时候，人们根本无法原谅那些伤害过他们的人。现在肯定不行，也许永远也不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We can only help Tagfer heal the best we can. And hope some day he lets go of the pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们只能尽力帮助标弃好起来。希望有一天他能摆脱痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And either way, it's not up for us to decide if and when Tagfer forgives Entrati. That's up to Tagfer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论如何，标弃是否原谅英择谛，以及何时原谅，都不是我们可以决定的。这取决于标弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We can only help Tagfer heal the best we can. And hope some day he lets go of the pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们只能尽力帮助标弃好起来。希望有一天他能摆脱痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And either way, it's not up for us to decide if and when Tagfer forgives Entrati. That's up to Tagfer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论如何，标弃是否原谅英择谛，以及何时原谅，都不是我们可以决定的。这取决于标弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well... in short, some of Entrati's family is upstairs, and they aren't... exactly aware that we're down here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯……简而言之，英择谛家族有几位在楼上，而他们……完全不知道我们就在楼下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. You can't compete for something a person doesn't have to give.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对。你没法去争取一个人根本就没有的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Opening scabbed-over wounds is dangerous. You might get rid of an infection... or you might bleed out in the process.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 揭开那些结痂的伤口很危险。你可能会清除掉感染……也可能因此失血过多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You - we - all have one thing in common. At some point, we were left behind by Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你们——和我们——都有一个共同点。都是在某个时刻，都被英择谛遗弃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Honestly? I got distracted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话 ？我有点分心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It could be going better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还能再好一点吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm making progress.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 已经有点进展了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: His daughter, Euleria - known as Mother, and her family, have been taking care of Deimos this whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是因为他的女儿欧拉瑞娅——人称"母亲"，以及她的家人，一直都在照顾着火卫二。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Watching over this place, and the heart that pumps Void energy into the Origin System, keeping all of us... usable, really, ever since Entrati left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 守护着这个地方，以及那颗向始源星系输送虚空能量的心脏，自英择谛离开后，它始终维系着我们所有人的……存续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I haven't made up my mind about the necessity of his actions. But his callous nature can't be questioned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还没想好他的行为是否必要。但他冷酷无情的本性毋庸置疑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm tired of pretending, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我厌倦了作戏，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, not a game. But Entrati isn't to be trusted, and I don't know how else to convince you but to pretend to be on your side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，不是游戏。但英择​谛不​可信，除了假装站在你这边，我不知道还有什么其他办法可以说服你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Together, all as one, we are... a strange family. But a family, none the less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们团结一心，就像一个……奇怪的家庭。但无论如何，我们依然是一家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We would be stronger together than we are apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们团结起来会比各自为战更加强大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: She's come to terms with his absence, and they've made peace with each other, but it was a hard-won thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她已经接受了他离开的事实，他们也和好了，但那是来之不易的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: She hasn't come to terms with his absence, and they're at each other's throats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她还没有接受他离开的事实，而且他们之间总是争吵不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And in times when we're suffering, sometimes all we really have is each other. Either the ones we were given, or the ones we found.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在我们受苦受难的时候，有时我们真正拥有的只有彼此。无论是我们被赐予的，还是我们自己遇到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know if it would help, or hurt, in the long run. But this... purgatory, isn't right, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道长远来看，这究竟是好是坏。但这……像这样的炼狱，也不是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可​要​是​知道他还在外面四处惹事，却连一句都没有跟她说，甚至连封信都没寄……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Knowing that he's still out there, running amok, and that he hasn't said a word to her, or even sent a letter...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可​要​是​知道他还在外面四处惹事，却连一句都没有跟她说，甚至连封信都没寄……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can't imagine how painful that would be for her. For them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我无法想象这对她、对他们来说有多么痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It would destroy what little chance of reconciliation they might have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这会毁掉他们之间仅存的那点和解机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Loid knew the Entrati family. It should be him. Convincing him, however... is another matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 洛德认识英择谛家族。该由他来做这件事。然而，说服他……又是另一回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe, maybe? He's Orokin, he knew them all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许让罗瑟来 ？他是奥罗金人，他认识他们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我其实有个朋友很喜欢老鼠。我也觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's not really my decision to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实这不是我做出的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What would you suggest I do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你会建议我做什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually have a friend who loves rats. I think they're adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我其实有个朋友很喜欢老鼠。我也觉得它们很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've been remiss. You're right. I'll get to work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我确实疏忽了。你说得是对。我现在就着手处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you think you or Lyon might convince him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你觉得里昂可以说服他吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're not going to like my answer, Marie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，你不会喜欢我的答案的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Loid might listen to Roathe. Him being Orokin - their shared history - might come in handy, here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 洛德或许会听罗瑟的。他作为奥罗金人——他们有着共同的经历——或许能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 楼上的情况……即使在最好的情况下也依旧脆弱。我不想让他们难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We just have to be careful. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们只能小心一点。恐怕一半的人会把另一半人当成"另一个家族"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Should I be scared?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我应该开始担心吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Necramites?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 殁世微灵 ?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know as there's much of a market for Entrati's chairs...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可不觉得英择谛的椅子能卖出什么价……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wouldn't we flood the market eventually? We'd have to sell them for pretty cheap...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们迟早会把市场都冲垮吧 ？到时候只能贱卖了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Brilliant. I see no problems with this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 完美。我看这主意一点毛病都没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's an adult. He can decide when he wants to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是个成年人。他自己可以决定何时愿意开口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My heart is breaking to see him going through this pain. I don't know how to help him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 看到他承受如此痛苦，我的心都碎了。我不知道该如何帮助他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know how to help him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道如何帮助他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: None of their help would have been worth anything if I didn't want to be helped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果我不愿接受帮助，他们的任何帮助都毫无价值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I did, from friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得到过朋友们的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't think Lyon wants my help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不认为里昂想要我的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm trying to be here for him, but he's not listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我正努力支持他，但他根本不听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So you admit that Entrati has hurt Lyon? And how does this sit with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以你承认英择谛伤害了里昂 ？你对此作何感想 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I feel like he's teetering on the brink. How do I help pull him back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他正站在悬崖边缘摇摇欲坠。我该如何拉他回来 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You don't have to choose, Marie. People can be complicated in the way they exist in our lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你不必选择，玛丽。他人在我们生活中的存在方式本就是复杂的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would choose the family who is still here. Not the one who left you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会选择那个依然陪伴在身边的家人，而不是那个离开你的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sure Entrati didn't want to cause Lyon this kind of pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我确信英择谛并非有意让里昂承受这样的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's the problem with people like Entrati. They're not just forces for "Good" or "Bad." They're a mix.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这就是英择谛这类人的问题所在。他们并非单纯的"善"或"恶"，而是二者的混合体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon is trying to come to terms with the fact that the Indifference isn't a real god.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂正在努力接受虚空无情之物并不是真正的神这一事实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't imagine having Entrati whispering to him that the voices of his gods are actually the voices from the Void helped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我猜英择谛曾低语告诉他，他信奉的神的声音其实是来自虚空的声音，这恐怕对他没什么帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't think it's just one thing that's causing it. I think it's being caught between a great many things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为这并非由单一因素造成，而是被诸多因素所困。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I honestly don't, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我不知道，不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon was hearing the voice of one of the Tenno, a kid named Rell. Rell... died. I don't think he's coping well with this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂听到了一位 Tenno 的声音，一个叫 Rell 的孩子。Rell......死了。我觉得他没能很好地应对这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He has Roathe whispering lies to him about the Man in the Wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟一直都在向他散播谎言，有关墙中人的谎言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We have to be his shelter, then. A place he knows won't hurt him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么，我们必须成为他的避风港。一个他确信不会伤害他的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We need to show him the way back to safety, then. Be the light in the darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么，我们需要为他指引回归安全的道路。成为黑暗中的明灯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I guess... we need to show him the way back to safety, then. Be the light in the darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想……我们需要为他指引回归安全的道路。成为黑暗中的明灯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I guess then... we just have to be his shelter. A place he knows won't hurt him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想……那么，我们必须成为他的避风港。一个他确信不会伤害他的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll keep trying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会继续努力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just hope this doesn't tear him apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只希望这不会让他崩溃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm the same way. But sometimes, action is the wrong choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也是这样。但有时，行动反而不是正确的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He'll be all right. I'm sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会没事的。我确信这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You could choose a new family. Like me. And those around you who care, without Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你可以选择一个新的家庭。就像我一样。还有那些关心你的人，不加上英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And what do you think he's really after?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你觉得他真正要找的是什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you two don't get along, and I'm sorry about that. But I can't very well kick him out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你们俩关系不好，对此我感到很抱歉。但我又不能把他赶出去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe has forgotten more about the Orokin - quite literally - than we will ever know. We need him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟对奥罗金的遗忘——确切地说——比我们所知道的还要多。我们需要他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't think he's going to just disappear the moment he has his memories back. There's more to this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不认为他一恢复记忆，就会立刻消失。事情远不止于此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There is likely more he's still after. Not in his memories, but from us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他可能还在找寻更多。不在他的记忆里，而在我们这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe him when he says that is all we'll discover from this. And if it was, then why is he still here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信他，当他说我们能发现的就这些了。如果真是这样，那他为什么还在这里 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm with you. I don't trust him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我同意你的看法。我不信任他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's powerful and knowledgable. He's someone I would much prefer to have on my side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他强大又博学。我更希望有他站在我这边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It doesn't do any good wondering if he's going to betray us - he hasn't. And I don't call people guilty of sins they haven't committed yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 担心他会不会背叛我们，没有任何好处——他还没这样做。我不会在人们还没犯罪时，就判定他们有罪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think you're being a bit unfair to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得你对他有点不公平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll be careful. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会小心的。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He was raised in a different society, a different time - with different expectations. We may not like it, but he is who he is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他在一个不同的社会、不同的时代长大——背负着不同的期望。我们或许不喜欢，但他就是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You and Lyon accepted the protoframe serum from Entrati. Willingly. He didn't. Can you imagine what that is like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你和里昂接受了英择谛的原型战甲血清。你们心甘情愿。他却没有。你能想象那是什么感觉吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's gone through entire centuries of life doing what he believes is necessary. We just disagree on what that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他在几个世纪的时间里，做着他认为必要的事情。我们只是对什么是必要的有不认同的看法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think a lot of his... demeanor might be what sets you off. Not his actions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他的很多……举止可能会激怒你，而不是他的行为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's a high-ranking soldier and socialite. And both of those things require making shadowy decisions, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是一位高级军官，社交名流。而这两个身份有时候需要他做出一些阴暗的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think a person can do what we feel is the "wrong thing" and have done it with good intentions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得一个人可以做我们认为是"错误的事情"，并且怀着好的意图这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He did all that he's done in the name of saving the Orokin Empire - and his thank you for that was to get thrown into this mess against his will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他所做的一切都是以拯救奥罗金帝国为名义——而他所得到的回报，却是违背他的意愿，被迫陷入这场混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think he rubs you the wrong way because he takes pride in what he's done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他惹恼你，是因为他为自己所做的事而感到自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You might think of him as a devil, but in his mind it couldn't be farther from the truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你可能会觉得他是一个恶魔，但在他看来，这与事实相去甚远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll try to stop them when they do things I disagree with. But... I'll fight beside them when I need to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会尽力阻止他们，当他们做我不同意的事情时。但是……需要时，我也会与他们并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't believe those groups are "good" or "bad" by definition. Only in the actions they choose to take.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为这些群体本身并没有"好"或"坏"的定义，只取决于他们选择采取的行动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It isn't my place to declare that some actions are "good" and some "bad." I do what I do to protect people that need protecting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我没有资格断言某些行为是"好的"，某些行为是"坏的"。我所做的一切都是为了保护那些需要保护的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're asking me to judge an entire group of people on the same merits I'd use to judge an individual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你要我用评判一个人的标准来评判一整个群体的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He won't. And if he tries, I'll stop him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他不会的。如果他真那样做，我会阻止他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I promise those won't be my last thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我保证这不会是我临终前的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If the time comes where he turns on us, I'll act. Until then, he's proven to be nothing but an ally. If... a bit melodramatic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果他真的背叛我们，我会采取行动。在那之前，他已经证明自己只不过是个盟友。也许……有点夸张。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't see his dangerous quality as a problem. He is a weapon. And weapons can be used to murder or protect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不认为他的危险特质是个问题。他是一件武器。武器可以用来杀人，也可以用来保护人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Of course. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然可以，什么事 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What specifically is the issue?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 具体是什么问题 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose from Necraloid's perspective, it is his skull. That's true. But it is, from Loid's perspective, a replica.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，从殁世械灵的角度来看，没错，那的确是他的头骨。但从洛德的角度来看，那只是个复制品。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I honestly don't know what it's made out of. It could be bone. Or some kind of polymer...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还真的不知道它是什么材质的。可能是骨头，也可能是某种聚合物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think the root of the question you're grappling with is, "is Necraloid real," not "is the skull real."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为你所思考的问题的根源是"殁世械灵是真实的吗"，而不是"头骨是真实的吗"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥塔曾是一位哲士、奥罗金科学家和学者。关于他的经历，实在算不上一个幸福的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 众所周知，他是一位天才，也是驾驭氩结晶的幕后推手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful Warframes and weapons we make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些力量源自虚空——正是它们让我们能够制造出众多强大的战甲与武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他专攻晶体学。他的研究成果都保存在这里的实验室里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Maybe you're right. Maybe they really are just copies of people. But I'm not sure, and we have to treat them as if they are people, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你是对的。也许它们真的只是人的复制品。但我不确定，而且无论如何，我们得把它们当人来对待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think Necraloid is the exception, not the rule. He was made as a replica of a person, not from a person.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为殁世械灵是个例外，而非常规。他是按照一个人复制出来的，而不是从人身上衍生出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. It's probably better, and more humane, if they aren't actually souls trapped inside elaborate science...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对。如果他们不是被困在精密科学中的灵魂，那可能更好，也更人道……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Necraloid may not have a soul, but he's unique. Other Cephalons, like Otak, do. They were destroyed in how they were made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 殁世械灵或许没有灵魂，但他很独特。其他中枢，比如奥塔，都有灵魂。它们在诞生之初就被毁坏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. So what would you have me do about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对。那么你希望我做什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. They don't. But it doesn't mean we can go around treating them poorly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对，他们确实没有。但这并不意味着我们可以随意虐待他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know if you're right or not. But they can still think, and feel, and we can't treat them like things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道你说的是不是对的。但他们仍能思考，能感受，我们不能把他们当成物品来对待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Necraloid has a soul. All Cephalons do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 殁世械灵有灵魂。所有中枢都有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 后来不知道是什么原因，他被改造成了一个中枢，并获得了自己的殁世械灵外壳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不是所有中枢都是因刑罚而被造的。但当时火卫二这边的情况……变得很糟糕，他受了重伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did this come up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是怎么想到这个问题的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope someday you can meet him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望有一天你能见到他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那太可爱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Crown of flowers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 花冠 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Have fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玩得开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That does explain a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 原来如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The more things change, huh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 万变不离其宗呐？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think Daughter has tried to do that before, you'll make her jealous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​"女儿"​以前​曾​尝​试过​这样​做，​你​会​让​她​嫉妒​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't fault you for appreciating the good he's done in your life, the same way I don't fault other people for resenting the harm he's causing in theirs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不会责怪你感激他给你的生活带来的益处，就像我不会责怪其他人怨恨他给他们的人生带来的伤害一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't know. I think his actions have led to a lot more harm than good. I wish you could see that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​知道。​我​倒​觉得​他​的​行为​弊​大于利。​真希望​你​也​能​看清​这​一点。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm siding with you, Marie. I can't fault Entrati for any of what he's done. He's fighting the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我支持你。我不能责怪英择谛所做的一切。他是在对抗虚空无情之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right to forgive Entrati. I wish more of the others would follow your lead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​原谅​英择谛​是​对​的。​我​希望​其他​人​也​能​像​你​一样。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll never fault someone for forgiveness. But you can forgive someone while understanding you have to protect yourself and others from them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​永远​不​会​因为​原谅​而​责怪​别人。​你​可以​原谅​别人，​但​同时​也​要​明白​你​必须​保护​自己​和​他​人​不​受​伤害。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You think Lyon's suffering is his own fault?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你认为里昂的遭遇是他咎由自取吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon is suffering far more than a crisis of faith, Marie. And a lot of that has to do with Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，里昂面临的远不止信仰危机。而这很大程度上与英择谛有关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did nothing I said even slightly work to even the scales?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 难道我说的话一点都没有让双方的立场有所缓和吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How can you look at everything Entrati has done and still see more good than harm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 纵观英择谛所做的一切，你怎么还能认为利大于弊呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think you're downplaying the seriousness of what the Cavia and Tagfer suffered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为你低估了科维兽和标弃所遭受的苦难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgiveness is important. But so is acknowledging that Entrati might be more complicated than you're willing to accept.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 宽恕固然重要，但承认英择谛比你想象的要复杂得多也同样重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I still don't think you understand what Tagfer and the Cavia suffered. It's worse than what you went through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还是觉得你不明白标弃和科维兽经历了什么。他们比你经历的要糟糕得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That's the issue, Marie. What you're asking of other people. Not what they're asking of you. Or of Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，这就是问题所在。​是你​在对​别人​的​要求，​而​不​是​他们​对​你、​或者​对​英择谛​的​要求。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Entrati leaves hurt people wherever he goes. All I'm trying to do is help those people put everything back together. I don't care much about "good" or "evil" in his case.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 英择谛所到之处，都会留下伤痕累累的人。我所做的，只是想帮助这些人重拾生活。至于他所谓的"善"或"恶"，我并不在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think the issue is more what you're asking of others, not what they're asking of you. Or Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​认为​问题​更​多​在​于​你​对​别人​的​要求，​而​不​是​他们​对​你、​或者​对​英择谛​的​要求。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it doesn't bother you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这一点也没有困扰到你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I honestly have been struggling to navigate this topic with you. Painfully so. I personally think he's... neither good nor bad. But a mix.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说实话，我一直觉得跟你讨论这个话题很难，真的非常难。我个人觉得他……既不好也不坏，而是两者兼具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've changed my mind. I'm on his side. And yours. You convinced me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我改变主意了。我选择站在他这边。也站在你这边。你说服我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess feelings.] I've just been trying to do my best to... get on your good side, I'm afraid. I have feelings for you. More than I let on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [表白心意] 恐怕是我一直都在努力……讨你欢心。我喜欢你。其实比我表现出来的要强烈得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've changed my mind and decided he's a monster. Once and for all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我改变主意了，我认定他就是个怪物。就这么定了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You've put Entrati on a pedestal, Marie. And you're asking others to do the same thing like idiots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​你​把​英择​谛捧​得​太​高​了。​你​还​要求​其他​人​像​傻子​一样​效仿​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think you're asking them to do more than to just forgive Entrati. I think you're asking them to pretend nothing he did was ever wrong at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为你要求他们做的不仅仅是原谅英择谛，而是要他们假装他所做的一切都没有错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sure. But I also have him to "thank" for some of the most important relationships and friendships I've ever made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然。​但​我​也​要​感谢​他，​因为​他​让​我​结识​了​一些​我​人生​中​最​重要​的​爱人​和​朋友。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, not really. He needs me to do it, so I'll do it. I'll judge him when all is said and done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，其实没有。他需要我这么做，所以我就做了。等一切尘埃落定，我自然会评判他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wait, Marie. Please. Let me explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，等等。求你了。让我解释一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've made it clear how I feel about Entrati. I'm sorry. On some things, we can't see eye-to-eye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我已经明确表达了我对英择谛的看法。很抱歉，在有些事情上，我们就是意见不一致。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess feelings.] I care about you. More than I've let on. And I... I'm sorry I've been harsh, but I can't let him hurt you. Not like he's hurt so many others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [坦白心意] 我很在乎你。比我表现出来的还要在乎。而且……我很抱歉我之前对你很苛刻，但我不能让他伤害你。毕竟他已经伤害了那么多人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have watched Entrati do nothing but burn everyone he cares about. Everyone he has supposedly loved. I don't want to see him do the same to you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我亲眼目睹英择谛毁掉了所有他关心的人、所有他声称爱过的人。我不想看到他对你也这样做……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm not the best at expressing myself, and for that I'm sorry. But he's... I'm afraid he's using you, and using your kindness to manipulate you. That's all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不太擅长表达自己，对此我很抱歉。但是……我恐怕他是在利用你，利用你的善良来操控你。仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You may see Entrati as a savior, but I see him as an old, frightened man scrambling for answers. Maybe the answer is somewhere in between.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你或许视英择谛为救世主，但我却视他为一个惊恐的老人，正苦苦寻找答案。或许答案就在两者之间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess feelings.] I care about you. More than I've let on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [坦白心意] 我很在乎你。比我表现出来的还要在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe anything is necessary in this war. We're trying to save the universe against the Indifference, after all, aren't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为在这场战争中，任何手段都是必要的。毕竟，我们是在试图拯救宇宙，对抗虚空无情之物，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe in Entrati. Honestly. I think he has a plan to solve this, and all this has been for the ultimate good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信英择谛。真的。我认为他有解决这个问题的计划，而且这一切最终都是为了大家好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This is why the others get upset when you talk about him. You gloss over everything he's done that's hurt them and pretend it hasn't happened like idiots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这​就​是​为什么​其他​人​一​听​你​提到​他​就​会​生气。​你​对​他​伤害​过​他们​的​一​切视而​不见，​像​个​傻子​一样​假装​什么​都​没​发生​过。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, stop. You need to accept that he's not doing this all purely because he's a good man. He's not. He's more complicated than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​别说​了。​你​得​接受，​他​这么​做，​并​不​是​因为​他​是​个​好人。​他​不​是​那样​的​人。​他​比​你​想​的​要​更​复杂。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, when you say it like that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯，你这么一说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Only partially.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这只是一部分原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, he isn't a god. He's just a man. He's just as arrogant and just as dangerous as Roathe. He comes from the same society and suffers all the same problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​他​不​是​神。​他​只​是​一​个​凡人。​他​和​罗瑟​一样​傲慢，​一样​危险。​他​来自​同​一​个​世界，​遭受​着​同样​的​问题。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know he was kind to you. I know he was different to you maybe than he has been to a lot of people. Maybe he even treated you like a daughter... But look at the bigger picture, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道他对你很好。我知道他待你或许和待很多人不一样。或许他甚至把你当女儿一样待……但请你从大局着眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, when you say it like that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯，你这么一说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Only partially. I do honestly believe in Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这只是一部分原因。我确实是相信英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Exactly. Roathe would be so proud of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没错。罗瑟会为你感到无比自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How many holy wars have been committed in Sol's name? What's one more, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有这么多次圣战都是以太阳神的名义发动的。再多一次又何妨？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're making assumptions, now. You don't know that. You've never met her, and you have no idea what she's been through. Or what she's had to endure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​现在​只是​在​猜测。​你​根本​不​知道。​你​从​未见​过​她，​你​根本​不​知道​她​经历​了​什么，​也​不​知道​她​承受​了​什么。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And do you think that will make him love you more, if you do? Do you think that'll make him come back to you, if you're the one who stays loyal to him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​以​为​你​这么​做，​他​会​更​爱​你​吗？​你​以​为​如果​你​对​他​忠诚，​他​就​会​回到​你​身边​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Trust me, no you're not. Countless people have lost their lives to this. And I can rattle off a list of names of people who have had their lives ruined because of him. But no one's forgotten about the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 相信​我，​并​不​是​只​有​你。​无数​人​因此​丧命。​我​可以​列出​一​长​串​因为​他​而​人生​被​毁​的​人​的​名字。​但​没有​人​会​忘记虚空​无情​之物​的​存在。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe would be so proud of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟会为你感到无比自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie. I'm sorry, this isn't some "holy war." You're very new to all this, and Entrati has you wrapped around his finger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我很抱歉，但这不是什么"圣战"。你对这一切还很陌生，而且英择谛已经把你玩弄于股掌之间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And... where in the doctrine of Sol does it say it's okay to hurt innocents in war?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么……太阳神教义中的哪条规定说在战争中伤害无辜者是可以接受的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How're you feeling today, Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，你今天感觉怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is something wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All right, if you're sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧，如果你确定的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, I'm sorry... bad pain day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，对不起……今天疼痛特别严重吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is there something I can do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我能做点什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry that if by asking about it, I made it hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果我问起这件事让你想起了你的脚并感到不适的话，真的很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anything I can do to make it better, or take your mind off it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有什么我能做的事能让情况好转，或者转移你的注意力吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That sounds exhausting...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 听起来真累人啊……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That sounds frustrating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这听起来很沮丧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There's really no cure? It never stops?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真的没有治愈的方法吗？永远都不会好？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If you're certain, but I'm here, if you want to talk about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你真的这样想的话。但如果你想谈谈，我一直在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... know what that's like. Before I started "looping," I hurt myself pretty badly in Duviri. It healed, but it still aches something awful from time to time. I try to hide my wincing when it acts up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……知道那种感觉。在我开始"循环"之前，我在双衍王境受了很重的伤。虽然已经痊愈了，但还是时不时地疼得厉害。每次疼起来，我都尽量掩饰自己畏缩的表情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Old persistent problems can sometimes be as problematic as new ones. Just because they come and go, and can stay with us, doesn't mean they aren't worth talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 旧问题有时和新问题一样棘手。即使它们来来去去，并且一直萦绕在我们身边，也不意味着它们不值得讨论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm the same way. The moment I focus on - yeah, there's the pain. Sometimes I wonder if that's why I keep so damn busy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也是这样。只要一专注——噢，疼痛就来了。有时我怀疑自己是否正因如此才这样忙得不可开交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes I get angry thinking about how much I could get done if I wasn't distracted by the pain all the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有时想到如果没有疼痛的折磨，我本该能完成多少事情，就会感到愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Are you always tired all the time, too? Sometimes I wonder if that's why I'm so exhausted. I'm always spending cycles on being in pain in the background.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你也是整天都累得要命吗？有时我怀疑自己是否因此精疲力竭，总在不知不觉中耗费精力忍受疼痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm so sorry you have to put up with all that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很抱歉你不得不忍受这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you can't even express that frustration.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而你甚至无法表达那种沮丧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What's wrong with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那有什么问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yeah. I know. And it's not their fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是啊。我明白。而且这也不是他们的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, I wish it would go away...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 唉，真希望它能消失……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What's an "abeille?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 什么是"abeille"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, a bee!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，是蜜蜂！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, not getting it... keep going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，没明白……继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, are you still on board to... maybe try to convince Loid to talk to the "upstairs neighbors?" I know we left that off on a weird note.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，你还在想……试着说服洛德去跟"楼上的邻居"谈谈吗？我知道我们上次说到这儿的时候气氛有点尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: On the subject of trying to get Loid and the Entrati family talking, I was... wondering if you've reconsidered Roathe's involvement at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 关于让洛德和英择谛家族对话这件事，我……想知道你有没有重新考虑过让罗瑟参与？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Have you thought any more about how to convince Loid to talk to the Entrati family upstairs?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你有没有想过如何说服洛德去和楼上的英择谛家族谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've been thinking about how to convince Loid to go up those stairs to finally talk to the family, and... I have an idea, but I don't think you'll like it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在想怎样才能说服洛德走上楼梯，去和家族的人谈谈，而且……我有个主意，但我认为你不会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think we might need Roathe's help to convince Loid to talk to the Entrati family. I don't think he'll do it otherwise. Without assurances that the family, and he, will be protected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为我们需要罗瑟的帮助才能说服洛德与英择谛家族交谈。除非能保证英择谛家族和他本人的安全，否则，我认为他是不会答应的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't really have any good ideas that doesn't involve taking help from terrible sources. Sources that might just get us into deep trouble later. Namely, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 除了​找​一​个​很​不​靠谱​的​人​来​帮忙。​而​这个​人​很​可能​会​在​以后​给​我们​带来​大麻烦。​也​就​是​说，​找罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. I didn't think you'd agree to it. I was afraid to ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对。我没想到你会同意。我不敢问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, there has to be another way. I refuse to ask for his help on this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，肯定还有别的办法。我拒绝在这件事上寻求他的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All right. If you're okay with it, I'll be okay with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好的。如果你觉得没问题，我也没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不行，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm still working on it, but I think so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还在尝试，但我想我能说服他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nothing is settled yet. He's... well, you know how he can be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一切都还没定下来。他……嗯，你知道他是什么样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, unfortunately... I think that was a dead end with him. Do you think there's another way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，很可惜……我想这条路在他那是行不通了。你觉得还有别的办法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't believe this - I think it's so that he can help protect Entrati's family. They're all that really remains of the Orokin, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会的。我已经说服他去帮忙让他们团聚——你铁定想不到——我猜这样他就能保护英择谛的家人。毕竟，他们是仅存的奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't be surprised by this - I think it's mostly to spite Albrecht in his absence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会的。我已经说服他去帮忙让他们团聚——你一定不会惊讶——我猜主要是为了在阿尔布雷希特不在的时候恶心恶心他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think it's just the excuse he's making to cover for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得这只是他掩盖真相的借口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: At least he'll help, though. And I'll make sure he doesn't actually follow through with his threats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 至少他会帮忙。而且我会确保他不会真的把威胁变成现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He can be, but I think a lot of that is just for show.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他或许可以，但我认为很多时候只是为了装装样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually kind of enjoy it, as weird as it sounds. We get along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但我其实还挺享受的。我们相处得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What're you insinuating, Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​你​这​是​在​暗示​什么​？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wouldn't want to use my relationship with him as a negotiation tool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不想利用我和他的关系作为谈判筹码。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's only ever tried to do what was right. Maybe in the wrong way, sure - but he was trying to save the Origin System from the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他一直以来都只是想做正确的事。确实，或许他的方式不对——但他是为了拯救始源星系免遭奥罗金人的蹂躏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There's a lot about him that he just doesn't know how to show. It's not armor, per se - but he doesn't trust people not to hurt him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他有很多事情不知道该如何表达。也不是说他在伪装——而是他不信任别人，害怕别人会伤害他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Everyone in his life has tried to make him out to be some kind of monster. I suppose I'm the first person who hasn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他生命中的每个人都试图把他当成某种怪物。我想我是第一个没有这么做的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I enjoy his wry sense of humor. He's clever, when you get past his ego.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我喜欢他那种略带讽刺的幽默感。抛开他的自负，他其实很聪明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's... had some real heartbreak in his many years. It's scabbed over with thorns, that's all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他这些年来……经历过不少伤心事。伤口都结痂长满了刺，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I guess I can understand the amount of years he's lived. I've seen the same amount of death he has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我大概能理解他那些年是怎么过来的。我见过的死亡和他一样多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You surprise me. I'm impressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你倒是让我意外了。不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I never knew you had this side to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我从未发现你还有这一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can't make any promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我没法保证什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Who says I'm trying to temper him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谁说我是在试图让他冷静下来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh? What happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦？发生什么事了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I never thought about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我倒是没想过这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How will you discover when they were born?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你要如何得知他们的出生日期？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will you let them pick their birthdays?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你会让他们自己选择生日吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We really are lucky he's here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有他真是我们的幸运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just wish he'd cheer up a bit from time to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是希望他有时能开心一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If it makes you feel any better, neither do I. I suspect the kid doesn't remember, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也一样，如果这能让你好受些。我猜那孩子也不记得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Birthdays are overrated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 生日被赋予太多意义了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's more fun to pick your own, anyway. More poignant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 反正自己挑选更有趣，也更 poignant。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... think it's just the same in both languages...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是觉得……这词在两种语言中的意思是一样的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must have picked it up from you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一定是跟你学的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did your conversation with him go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你们聊得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did you enjoy talking to him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你喜欢和他聊天吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You met Otak? Oh boy... How did that go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你见到奥塔了？我的天……你们见面怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad you finally met. Otak can be a little hard to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很高兴你们终于见面了。奥塔的情况可能有点难解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Poor Otak... How did that go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可怜的奥塔……结果怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. He can get on people's nerves sometimes. It's not his fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉。他有时候确实挺让人恼火的。这不是他的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I didn't mean to. He can just be a little... off-putting for some people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不是那个意思。他只是可能有点……让人难以接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He can get on my nerves sometimes, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他有时候还挺烦人的，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥塔曾是一位哲士、奥罗金科学家和学者。关于他的经历，实在算不上一个幸福的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 众所周知，他是一位天才，也是驾驭氩结晶的幕后推手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just don't have the time to spend on him, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉，我实在没有多余的时间花在他身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right, I'm sorry. I didn't mean that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​说​得​对，​对​不起，​我​不​是​故意​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful Warframes and weapons we make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些力量源自虚空——正是它们让我们能够制造出众多强大的战甲与武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That... won't happen. Keep talking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那……是不会发生的。继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ballas is dead... keep going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ballas 早​就​死​了​……​继续​说。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他专攻晶体学。他的研究成果都保存在这里的实验室里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 后来不知道是什么原因，他被改造成了一个中枢，并获得了自己的殁世械灵外壳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不是所有中枢都是因刑罚而被造的。但当时火卫二这边的情况……变得很糟糕，他受了重伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, Marie. I'm so sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，玛丽。我真抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yeah... that's Otak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没错……奥塔就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anything I can do to cheer you up? We could go torment Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​能​做些​什么​让​你​开心​起来​呢？​我们​要​不​要​去​捉​弄罗瑟。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anything I can do to cheer you up? Maybe steal some pastries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我能做些什么让你开心起来呢？比如偷些糕点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes the gods are cruel, Marie. That's just life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​有时候​神​就​是​很​残酷。​这​就​是​人生。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's okay. You have every right to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没关系，你有充分的理由感到难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're not being silly at all. I feel the same way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你一点也不傻。我也有同感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's the very least I can do for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这是至少是我能为你做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think he's okay, really. It's just... what he's been through - it's a lot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他其实没事。只是……他经历的那些事——确实太沉重了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It broke my heart... I just wish there was more I could do to help him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这让我心碎……我真希望我能为他做更多……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm just glad he... finally trusted me enough to tell me his whole story...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很高兴他……终于足够信任我，愿意把他的全部故事都告诉我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I care about him more than I can describe. I'm glad I make him feel safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我对他的关心难以言表。我很高兴能让他有安全感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Any part I've played in that, I'm happy for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我为自己能参与其中感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He deserves a place he can feel safe. Friends. Family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他值得拥有一个让他有安全感的地方、拥有朋友、拥有家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Are you sure you want to take him on over that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你确定要为了这件事跟他对抗吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Really? You'd argue with Roathe on my behalf?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真的​吗？​你​要​替​我​跟罗瑟吵？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... really didn't think I could get you to help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……真的没想到你会帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Really? You're changing your mind about that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真的吗？你改变主意了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess Feelings] Marie? Can we talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [表白心意] 玛丽？我们可以谈谈吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How is it going with you and "the devil" lately?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 最近你和那个"恶魔"的关系怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry if this feels like it's coming out of nowhere, but I haven't known how to tell you earlier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果这让你觉得莫名其妙，我先说对不起，但我之前一直不知道该怎么跟你说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I adore you. I simply adore you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我喜欢你。我真的非常喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, I was wondering... if you'd like to, well... become a couple?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯，​我​在​想……​你​是否，​嗯……​愿意​和​我​成为​情侣？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Definitely not offering marriage, not yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​绝​对​不​是​在​跟​你​求婚，​还​没​到​那个​阶段。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Things have definitely evolved a bit. I wouldn't say they're more "formal" but I'm definitely happy to... show you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些​事确实​发展​了​一些。​我​不​会​称​它们​为​更​"正式"​的​关系，​但是​我​绝​对​很​开心​能……​给​你​展示​一下​现在​是​怎么​回事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think he enjoys teasing you too much, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不​管怎样，​我​觉得​他​就​是​喜欢​捉​弄​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad you two have found some kind of kinship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很高兴你们俩找到了某种亲近感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I meant my words. I'm sorry if my timing was... off. I care about you deeply, Marie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​确实​是​那个​意思。​很​抱歉​我​说​的​时机……​不​太​对。​我​很​在​乎​你，​玛丽……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I didn't mean them, I was just... caught up. I'm very, very sorry. The passion of the moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​并不​是​那个​意思，​我​只​是​……​一时​冲动。​真的​非常​非常​抱歉。​那​只​是​情绪​一时​失控。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do. And I'm sorry if my words hurt you. I just didn't know how else to say them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​理解。​我​也​很​抱歉​我​的​话​伤害到​了​你，​我​只​是​不​知道​还​能​怎么​说​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad my words got through to you. I was starting to lose hope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​很​欣慰​你​把​我​说​的​话听​进去​了。​我​都开始​有​点放弃​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I got frustrated, but I don't know how else to make you see sense. Entrati isn't your friend. Or your father.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只​是​感到​沮丧，​但​我​不​知道​还​能​怎样​才​能​让​你​明白​英择谛​不​是​你​的​朋友，​也​不​是​你​的​父亲。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. I let my temper get the better of me, and I said things I didn't mean to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对​不起。​我​被​情绪​左右，​说​了​些​并​非​本意​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think I already know what it might be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​我​已经​猜到​你​这样​做​的​原因​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I won't think less of you, Marie. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​会​看轻​你​的，​玛丽。​我​保证。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, wait. Please. Let me apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​请​先​等等。​先​让​我​向​你​道歉。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I didn't honestly think what I said to you mattered - I didn't think it'd be that important to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 老实​说，​我​并没有​觉得​自己​对​你​说​的​话​有​多​重要​——​我​没​想到​那​对​你​而言竟然​如此​重要。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was just teasing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​刚才​只​是​开个​玩笑。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sorry. I don't "win" very often.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 抱歉。​我​确实​没​怎么​"赢"​过。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I'm not done sorting this through. We need to finish this conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，​我​还​没​理清​这些​事。​我们​必须​把​这个​说​清楚。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think that's fair. I agree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​觉得​你​说​的​有道理，​我​赞同。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think I already know what it might be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​我​已经​猜到​你​这样​做​的​原因​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I won't think less of you, Marie. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​会​看轻​你​的，​玛丽。​我​保证。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think I already know what it might be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​我​已经​猜到​你​这样​做​的​原因​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I won't think less of you, Marie. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​会​看轻​你​的，​玛丽。​我​保证。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're not a fool, Marie. You're anything but. If anything, this proves to me how wonderful you really are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​你​不​愚蠢。​一点​也​不。​相反，​这​一切​让​我​明白​你​是​多么​好​的​一​个​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You've become so important to me, Marie... and I'm so sorry that this conversation has gone the way that it has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​已经​成为​我​生命​中​很​重要​的​人​了，​玛丽……​我​很​抱歉​之前​的​聊天​这么​不​愉快。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I needed you to see that Entrati could be complicated. That he could cause damage in equal measure. I didn't want you to be hurt worse, later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是​我​确实​需要​你​能​看​清英择谛​可能​会​是​个​很​复杂​的​人。​他​能​对​你​那么​好，​也​能​带给​你​同样​的​伤害。​我​只​是​不​想​你​之后​被​伤得​更重。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Stupidly, I think I was trying to do this all to protect you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这​听​起来​很​愚蠢，​我​想​我​做​这么​多​只​是​想​保护​好​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, he was kind to you. That wasn't a lie. But that doesn't mean that's all he is, and all he's capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不​是​的，​他​​对​你​很​好，​那​不​是​在​骗​你。​但​那​并​不​代表​他​完全​是​那样​的​人，​也​不​代表​那​就​是​他​所​能​做到​的​全部。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess feelings.] You're not a fool, Marie. You're anything but. If anything, this proves to me how wonderful you really are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [坦白心意] 玛丽，​你​不​愚蠢。​一点​也​不。​相反，​这​一切​让​我​明白​你​是​多么​好​的​一​个​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You've become so important to me, Marie... and I'm so sorry that this conversation has gone the way that it has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​已经​成为​我​生命​中​很​重要​的​人​了，​玛丽……​我​很​抱歉​之前​的​聊天​这么​不​愉快。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I needed you to see that Entrati could be complicated. That he could cause damage in equal measure. I didn't want you to be hurt worse, later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是​我​确实​需要​你​能​看​清英择谛​可能​会​是​个​很​复杂​的​人。​他​能​对​你​那么​好，​也​能​带给​你​同样​的​伤害。​我​只​是​不​想​你​之后​被​伤得​更重。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Ask to date.] Well, I was wondering... if you'd like to, well... become a couple?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [​邀请​约​会​]​ 嗯，​我​在​想……​你​是否，​嗯……​愿意​和​我​成为​情侣 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I figured we would take our time with it. We're still learning about each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​觉得​我们​还是​顺其​自然​吧。​我​还​在​了解​彼此。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Stupidly, I think I was trying to do this all to protect you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这​听​起来​很​愚蠢，​我​想​我​做​这么​多​只​是​想​保护​好​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Things have definitely evolved a bit. I wouldn't say they're more "formal" but I'm definitely happy to... show you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些​事确实​发展​了​一些。​我​不​会​称​它们​为​更​"正式"​的​关系，​但是​我​绝​对​很​开心​能……​给​你​展示​一下​现在​是​怎么​回事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Definitely not offering marriage, not yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​绝​对​不​是​在​跟​你​求婚，​还​没​到​那个​阶段。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess feelings.] This is good timing, I have something I'd like to say, too...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [表白心意] 现在正是时候，我也有话想说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Of course, what is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然可以，什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For you, always. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对你一定会有时间。什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For you, always. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对你一定会有时间。什么事？
