/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anytime. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 随时都可以。是什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Heh. I'm not sure he's tame. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呵呵。我不确定他是不是真的被驯服了。什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Things have changed, and.. I have to stay loyal to them, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在情况变了，而且……我必须对对方忠诚，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It may be hard to believe, or maybe even to accept, I know. But I... love you. And I love them. In equal measure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道，这或许难以置信，甚至难以接受。但我……爱你。我也爱他们。你们同等重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... don't know what that means, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我……不知道那是什么意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur t'appartient également, Marie !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，Mon cœur t'appartient également！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do. I... don't suppose you feel the same way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我是喜欢你。我……不知道你是否也同样喜欢我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Things have changed, and... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 情况已经变了……我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But... what if
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是……如果

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have feelings for you too, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我也喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I respect that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我尊重这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可以听吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Let her continue.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [让她继续]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll get the pitchforks and torches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我去拿干草叉和火把了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't think we can lose with you and the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得有你们在，我们不会输。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry, I'm not ready for this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对不起，我还没准备好接受你的表白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I love you too, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我也爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope that wasn't you swearing at me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 希望你刚才不是在骂我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think that was you saying you feel the same?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想你刚才的意思是说你也有同样的感觉吧 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think I caught "butterflies?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我好像看懂了……"小鹿乱撞"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll get the pitchforks and torches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我去拿干草叉和火把了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't think we can lose with you and the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得有你们在，我们不会输。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我看看能不能做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You wouldn't be able to keep me away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你甩不掉我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我看看能不能做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You wouldn't be able to keep me away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你甩不掉我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did you enjoy talking to him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你喜欢和他聊天吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How did your conversation with him go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你们聊得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Poor Otak... How did that go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可怜的奥塔……结果怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm glad you finally met. Otak can be a little hard to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很高兴你们终于见面了。奥塔的情况可能有点难解释。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You met Otak? Oh boy... How did that go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你见到奥塔了？我的天……你们见面怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He can get on my nerves sometimes, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他有时候还挺烦人的，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I didn't mean to. He can just be a little... off putting for some people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不是那个意思。他只是可能有点……让人难以接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm sorry. He can get on people's nerves sometimes. It's not his fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉。他有时候确实挺让人恼火的。这不是他的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Otak used to be an Archimedean, an Orokin scientist and academic. What's happened to him isn't exactly the happiest story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥塔曾是一位哲士、奥罗金科学家和学者。关于他的经历，实在算不上一个幸福的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: By all accounts he was a genius, and the mind behind the harnessing of argon crystals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 众所周知，他是一位天才，也是驾驭氩结晶的幕后推手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which are harnessed from the Void - they're the reason we can create a lot of the powerful Warframes and weapons we make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些力量源自虚空——正是它们让我们能够制造出众多强大的战甲与武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right, I'm sorry. I didn't mean that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​说​得​对，​对​不起，​我​不​是​故意​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I just don't have the time to spend on him, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉，我实在没有多余的时间花在他身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ballas is dead... keep going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ballas 早​就​死​了​……​继续​说。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That... won't happen. Keep talking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那……是不会发生的。继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He specialized in crystallography. And his works were archived here, in the laboratories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他专攻晶体学。他的研究成果都保存在这里的实验室里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For some reason, I don't know why, he was turned into a Cephalon, and given his own necraloid shell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 后来不知道是什么原因，他被改造成了一个中枢，并获得了自己的殁世械灵外壳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not all Cephalons were made as a punishment. But things went... poorly here on Deimos, and he was badly damaged.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不是所有中枢都是因刑罚而被造的。但当时火卫二这边的情况……变得很糟糕，他受了重伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yeah... that's Otak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没错……奥塔就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, Marie. I'm so sorry...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，玛丽。我真抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's okay. You have every right to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没关系，你有充分的理由感到难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anything I can do to cheer you up? We could go torment Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​能​做些​什么​让​你​开心​起来​呢？​我们​要​不​要​去​捉​弄罗瑟。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anything I can do to cheer you up? Maybe steal some pastries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我能做些什么让你开心起来呢？比如偷些糕点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes the gods are cruel, Marie. That's just life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​有时候​神​就​是​很​残酷。​这​就​是​人生。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It's the very least I can do for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这是至少是我能为你做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're not being silly at all. I feel the same way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你一点也不傻。我也有同感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I've been thinking about how to convince Loid to go up those stairs to finally talk to the family, and... I have an idea, but I don't think you'll like it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在想怎样才能说服洛德走上楼梯，去和家族的人谈谈，而且……我有个主意，但我认为你不会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Have you thought anymore about how to convince Loid to talk to the Entrati family upstairs?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你有没有想过如何说服洛德去和楼上的英择谛家族谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: On the subject of trying to get Loid and the Entrati family talking, I was... wondering if you've reconsidered Roathe's involvement at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 关于让洛德和英择谛家族对话这件事，我……想知道你有没有重新考虑过让罗瑟参与？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, are you still on board to... maybe try to convince Loid to talk to the "upstairs neighbors?" I know we left that off on a weird note.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，你还在想……试着说服洛德去跟"楼上的邻居"谈谈吗？我知道我们上次说到这儿的时候气氛有点尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I don't really have any good ideas that doesn't involve taking help from terrible sources. Sources that might just get us into deep trouble later. Namely, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我实在想不出什么好主意，除了能想到一些不靠谱的办法。这些办法很可能会在以后给我们带来大麻烦。比如，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think we might need Roathe's help to convince Loid to talk to the Entrati family. I don't think he'll do it otherwise. Without assurances that the family, and he, will be protected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为我们需要罗瑟的帮助才能说服洛德与英择谛家族交谈。除非能保证英择谛家族和他本人的安全，否则，我认为他是不会答应的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不行，对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All right. If you're okay with it, I'll be okay with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好的。如果你觉得没问题，我也没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, there has to be another way. I refuse to ask for his help on this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，肯定还有别的办法。我拒绝在这件事上寻求他的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You're right. I didn't think you'd agree to it. I was afraid to ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对。我没想到你会同意。我不敢问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't be surprised by this - I think it's mostly to spite Albrecht in his absence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会的。我已经说服他去帮忙让他们团聚——你一定不会惊讶——我猜主要是为了在阿尔布雷希特不在的时候恶心恶心他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He will. I've convinced him to help reunite them - and you won't believe this - I think it's so that he can help protect Entrati's family. They're all that really remains of the Orokin, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会的。我已经说服他去帮忙让他们团聚——你铁定想不到——我猜这样他就能保护英择谛的家人。毕竟，他们是仅存的奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, unfortunately... I think that was a dead end with him. Do you think there's another way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，很可惜……我想这条路在他那是行不通了。你觉得还有别的办法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nothing is settled yet. He's... well, you know how he can be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一切都还没定下来。他……嗯，你知道他是什么样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm still working on it, but I think so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还在尝试，但我想我能说服他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: At least he'll help, though. And I'll make sure he doesn't actually follow through with his threats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 至少他会帮忙。而且我会确保他不会真的把威胁变成现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think it's just the excuse he's making to cover for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得这只是他掩盖真相的借口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I actually kind of enjoy it, as weird as it sounds. We get along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但我其实还挺享受的。我们相处得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He can be, but I think a lot of that is just for show.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他或许可以，但我认为很多时候只是为了装装样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wouldn't want to use my relationship with him as a negotiation tool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不想利用我和他的关系作为谈判筹码。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What're you insinuating, Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，​你​这​是​在​暗示​什么​？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I enjoy his wry sense of humor. He's clever, when you get past his ego.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我喜欢他那种略带讽刺的幽默感。抛开他的自负，他其实很聪明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Everyone in his life has tried to make him out to be some kind of monster. I suppose I'm the first person who hasn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他生命中的每个人都试图把他当成某种怪物。我想我是第一个没有这么做的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There's a lot about him that he just doesn't know how to show. It's not armor, per se - but he doesn't trust people not to hurt him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他有很多事情不知道该如何表达。也不是说他在伪装——而是他不信任别人，害怕别人会伤害他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's only ever tried to do what was right. Maybe in the wrong way, sure - but he was trying to save the Origin System from the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他一直以来都只是想做正确的事。确实，或许他的方式不对——但他是为了拯救始源星系免遭奥罗金人的蹂躏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He's... had some real heartbreak in his many years. It's scabbed over with thorns, that's all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他这些年来……经历过不少伤心事。伤口都结痂长满了刺，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I guess I can understand the amount of years he's lived. I've seen the same amount of death he has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我大概能理解他那些年是怎么过来的。我见过的死亡和他一样多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Who says I'm trying to temper him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谁说我是在试图让他冷静下来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can't make any promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我没法保证什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I never knew you had this side to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我从未发现你还有这一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You surprise me. I'm impressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你倒是让我意外了。不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie, do you have a moment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，你现在有空吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm trying to convince Roathe to help us reunite Loid and the Entrati family. But he's being stubborn about his taking the serum. I need your help in talking to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我正在努力说服罗瑟帮我们让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。但他在注射血清这件事情上仍然很固执。我需要你的帮助来和他谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I'm trying to get Roathe to realize that he has the power to change. That he can forgive himself for what he's done in the past. And I need your help to do that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我正在努力让罗瑟意识到他可以改变，他可以原谅自己过去的所作所为。而我需要你的帮助才能做到这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe is eating himself up inside over what he's done. And without your help, I'm worried he's just going to continue to destroy himself if he doesn't come to terms with who he is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟正为自己所做的一切而备受煎熬。如果没有你的帮助，我担心如果他不能正视自己的问题，他只会继续自我毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe learned the truth about the serum. That he took it willingly. And it's destroying him. I need your help in calming him down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟得知了血清的真相。他是自愿注射的。而这个真相正在摧毁他。我需要你的帮助来安抚他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Roathe is driving me insane. I don't know how to talk to him. Do you have any advice?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 罗瑟快把我逼疯了。我不知道该怎么跟他说话。你有什么建议吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的确如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He did?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他真这么做了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的确如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He did?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他真这么做了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的确如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He did?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他真这么做了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am so very sorry. I know I offended you. And I didn't mean to. It was the very last thing I wanted to do, trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我真的非常抱歉。我知道我伤到你了。我真的不是故意的。我最不想做的，就是伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [Confess feelings.] Because I care about you deeply, Marie. I adore you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [表白心意] 因为我非常在乎你，玛丽。我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Never mind. This was clearly a mistake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 算了，这显然是个错误。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But Loid loves Albrecht. Doesn't he?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但洛德爱着阿尔布雷希特，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I knew I was going to put my foot in my mouth. And lo and behold, I did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道自己会说错话。果不其然，我真的说错了话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am so sorry I resorted to Roathe to get your attention, but I didn't know who else to turn to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉让罗瑟帮忙来引起你的注意，但我不知道还能找谁帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I went through so much trouble...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我搞出了这么多事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would love that, Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽，我非常愿意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: On second thought, I'm okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想了一下，还是算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur, may we speak ? Only for a moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mon cœur，我们可以说会儿话吗 ？就一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply wished to say that... I know your heart also belongs to another. And while I do not know them, my heart rejoices in this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只想说……我知道你的心也属于另一个人。虽然我不认识对方，但我为此感到由衷的高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I trust you, and if they hold a place within your soul, then I am but happy to share it it with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信你，如果他们在你心中占有一席之地，那么我也非常愿意与他们分享你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply hope that someday I can have a chance to meet them, oui ? The lover of my lover must, therefore, be mine, too...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只希望有朝一日能有机会见到他们，oui ？因此，我爱人的爱人，也可以是我的爱人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is, if you think they would be so inclined.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然，如果你觉得他也会愿意的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pff ! You are terrible, my wolf. Let me have my dreams. Until then, I will have you when I have you, I suppose !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呸 ！我的狼，你真坏。让我做我的梦吧。在那之前，我想我只能等到有机会的时候再见到你了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Until then, I will have you when I have you. And I will be happy to share you with those who have come to care for you as I have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在那之前，我会珍惜与你相处的每一刻。我也很乐意与那些像我一样关心你的人分享你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Someone must stand guard against the Murmure while you are off galivanting and having all the fun, after all !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 毕竟，在你四处游玩玩乐的时候，总得要有人守着，抵御低语者吧 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And on that note, duty calls. À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 说到这里，我得去履行职责了。À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The brother of my soul sends me to speak to you. He pleads with me to consider ma décision not to aid you in the matter of Monsieur Loid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的灵魂兄弟让我来跟你说话。他恳求我重新考虑一下，要不要在洛德先生的事情上帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply came to tell you that you should not leverage Lyon's kindness to make up for your own failures.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我来只是想告诉你，你不应该利用里昂的好心来弥补你自己的过错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui... I can. My anger at you in the moment should not be felt by others anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui……我可以。无论如何，我当时对你的愤怒不应该波及到其他人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. In this, you are right. My anger at you in the moment should not be felt by others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui……你说得对。无论如何，我当时对你的愤怒不应该波及到其他人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So, I say, very well. I will assist you. Tu auras mon aide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以，我说，好的。我会帮你。Tu auras mon aide。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Anger I have come to regret and forgive you for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对于​曾经​的​愤怒，​我​已经​感到​后悔​，也​原谅​了​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, bonjour, Drifter ! How are you this fine day ? Or evening. I truly do not know what time it is in this place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，bonjour，漂泊者 ！这大好的日子你过得如何 ？或者该说是今晚？我实在搞不清这地方究竟是什么时间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am certain one of these bibelots that Monsieur Loid keeps is a clock, but I cannot for the life of me determine which it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我确信洛德先生收藏的这些 bibelots 里有一件是钟表，但我怎么也认不出是哪一件。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I very much appreciate your rousing vote of confidence, but I do not precisely share it. Especially not when I have such trouble simply discerning the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我非常感谢你这番振奋人心的信任，但我并不完全认同。尤其当我连分辨时间都这么困难的情况下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Good to make the distinction. I hardly doubt your experience with the past was "normal" by aggregate standards. I certainly hope not, by the tell of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 区分这一点很好。我十分确信你过去的经历在总体标准下算不上"正常"。不过就从你描述的情况来看，我当然希望不是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: One would expect there to be one in the corner of this... "screen" here, but there is not ! Mauvaise qualité, if you ask me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 按理说这个……"屏幕"的角落里应该会显示，可根本没有 ！要我说，Mauvaise qualité。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I meant the "time period" itself. Allow me to rephrase -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我指的是"时间段"本身。请让我调整下措辞——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Regardless, we have wandered quite far from my question !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不管怎样，我们已经离我的问题偏离得相当远了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Was this "past" era that you traveled to, that is indeed far closer to the "farther past" from which I hail, more or less latently dangerous than this time in which we currently find ourselves ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你去过的那个"过去"时代，它确实更接近我所来自的"更遥远的过去"，与当下我们所处的时代相比，是否存在或多或少的潜在危险 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: (Goodness ! I do love this, I must say it is far more interesting than dusting communionware.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: （天哪 ！我真是太喜欢聊这些了，这可比擦拭圣餐器皿有趣多了。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I fear to touch any device in this strange sanctum. I fully believe I am just as liable to send myself careening into some far-flung distant time as I am to warm a cup of tea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不敢触碰这座奇妙圣所里的任何装置。我深信把自己冲向遥远时光的概率，与泡好一杯热茶的概率相差无几。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You may be right. I will think on it. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说的或许有道理。我会好好考虑的。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like all things, I suppose it would be relative, non ? The predator that kills us now is just as deadly as that which hunted us then. It just sharpens its teeth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 凡事皆如此，我想终究是相对的，non ？如今猎杀我们的掠食者与当年追捕我们的一样凶残。只是磨利了獠牙罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was prepared for this by le Cardinal Dimanche - your Albrecht Entrati. Unlike my dear Lyon, I believed his words as fact. And unlike Lyon, I see this as our great adventure, not a burden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 星期日主教——也就是你们的阿尔布雷希特·英择谛——早已为我铺垫了这一切。与我亲爱的里昂不同的是，我把他的话当作事实。也与里昂不同的是，我认为这是我们伟大的冒险，而不是负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Service to the Luminaries needn't be an act of suffering. In this, we have always differed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 侍奉双耀神不必是种苦行。在这点上，我们始终存在分歧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I believe the devil is a perfect example of why death is the greatest gift that Lua has ever given us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而我相信恶魔正是完美的例子，说明为什么死亡是月神赐予我们最伟大的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was prepared for this by le Cardinal Dimanche - your Albrecht Entrati. Unlike my dear Lyon, I believed his words as fact. And unlike Lyon, I see this as our great adventure, not a burden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 星期日主教——也就是你们的阿尔布雷希特·英择谛——早已为我铺垫了这一切。与我亲爱的里昂不同的是，我把他的话当作事实。也与里昂不同的是，我认为这是我们伟大的冒险，而不是负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And do not avoid my question, silly ! Which do you think is more dangerous ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别回避我的问题，傻瓜 ！你觉得哪个更危险 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Now that is the sound of a clock I do recognize, though I still cannot identify where the blasted thing is located. Either way, I fear I must go. This has been delightful. Until we can "meet" again ! Aux Dieux !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！这倒是我听得出的钟声，虽然还是没法确定这该死的东西藏在哪里。不管怎样，我怕是得走了。跟你聊的真是很开心。期待我们下次"再见" ！Aux Dieux ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Service to the Luminaries needn't be an act of suffering. In this, we have always differed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 侍奉双耀神不必是种苦行。在这点上，我们始终存在分歧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You may be right. I will think on it. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说的或许有道理。我会好好考虑的。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like all things, I suppose it would be relative, no ? The predator that kills us now is just as deadly as that which hunted us then. It just sharpens its teeth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 凡事皆如此，我想终究是相对的，不是吗 ？如今猎杀我们的掠食者与当年追捕我们的一样凶残。只是磨利了獠牙罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think you, my dear Drifter, are more likely to run off to join the pack of wolves than to sit guard against it. And I do mean that as a compliment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为你啊，我亲爱的漂泊者，更可能一头扎进狼群，而非坐守防线。这话我可是真心实意地夸你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I believe the devil is a perfect example of why death is the greatest gift that Lua has ever given us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而我相信恶魔正是完美的例子，说明为什么死亡是月神赐予我们最伟大的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Very good advice, indeed. I have heard from Monsieur Loid that you had your own aventure temporelle. I wonder -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 确实是很好的建议。我从洛德先生那里听说，你自己也经历过 aventure temporelle。我想知道——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: C'est très gentil de votre part, but... you are not the one who has been thrown into another... ah. Right. Yes !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: C'est très gentil de votre part，不过……你又不是那个被抛到另一个……啊。对对 ！没错  ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Was it as dangerous as this one ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它有这次这么危险吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You would know, wouldn't you. Forgive me. Was your own personal adventure as dangerous as this one ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你当然知道，对吧？抱歉。你自己的冒险经历也像这次一样危险吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hum ? Pourquoi ? Oh... because he is not on this gadget speaking with you as of yet ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯 ？Pourquoi ？哦……是因为他现在还没在这个小玩意儿上和你聊过天吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ha ! He is one of the fastest to learn I have ever met, Drifter ! I would be wary to challenge him to any puzzles with wagers of money attached, if I were you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！他可是我见过学得最快的家伙之一，漂泊者 ！要是换作是我，可不敢跟他赌钱玩任何谜题游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, he does quite well with new things. I would not put it past him to have studied the machines ambulantes that stomp about the lairs below and have designs of his own before long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，他对新事物很在行。我毫不怀疑他早已研究过那些在地下巢穴里来回穿梭的移动机器，不久后定会设计出自己的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is simply that he does not know you. Lyon is not... sociable at the best of times. It is not meant to offend you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他只是不认识你罢了。里昂向来……不太善于交际。他绝无意冒犯你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon has... much loudness within his own mind. He takes great care with whom he shares it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂内心……充斥着喧嚣。他格外谨慎地选择倾诉对象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, non, non, it is not you. Lyon has... much loudness within his own mind. He takes great care with whom he shares it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，不，不，不是你的问题。里昂内心……充斥着喧嚣。他格外谨慎地选择倾诉对象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It will take time. And patience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这需要时间。以及耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! I must go. We shall speak soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊 ！我得走了。我们之后再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I have all certainty that you are likely beset by either a need for company or organization, or both. But that is a conversation for another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我完全肯定，你很可能是需要陪伴或需要加入个组织，或两者都有。但那是另一个话题了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed ! As am I. Which brings me to my next question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 确实 ！我也是。这让我想到下一个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, hearing spirits and voices is much more within the purview of my dear Lyon than I. Though I wonder if Monsieur Necraloid is not haunted as well, judging by the child's scrawl upon the back of his head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，听见灵魂和声音这种事，我亲爱的里昂可比我擅长多了。不过看着那张孩子涂鸦般的脸，我倒怀疑殁世械灵先生是否也同样被鬼魂缠身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you very well may be right. The flying amalgam seems to be missing much of the real Monsieur Loid's raison d'être and nuance. Cela dit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说的或许没错。这具飞行的并合体似乎失去了真实的洛德先生大部分的 raison d'être 与细微差别。Cela dit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is actually why I came here to speak to you, if you do not mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其实我来找你的目的正是为此，如果你不介意的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par les Luminaires... You mean that we are all down here in secret ?! Is that why we are not allowed to leave this place ?! Mais pourquoi ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par les Luminaires……你是说我们都在这里秘密活动？！所以才不让我们离开这里？！Mais pourquoi？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par les Luminaires... please, go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par les Luminaires……请继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know what you would name it ? Un fauteuil roulant, or... perhaps a term I deeply dislike, un fauteuil pour invalide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道你会怎么叫它 ？Un fauteuil roulant，还是……或许是一个我深恶痛绝的词——un fauteuil pour invalide。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Oh, you poor thing. Imagine you, sitting there, wondering if I had mes pieds taken from me by le Cardinal ! Non, non, non - nothing of the sort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！哦，你这可怜的家伙。想象你坐在那里，心想我的双脚是否被主教夺走了 ！Non，Non，Non——绝无此事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like what we perch in now, to sit at these little adorable devices to communicate. But with wheels upon the sides, to traverse. A chair with wheels, if you will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像我们现在这样，坐在这些可爱的小设备前进行沟通。但两侧装有轮子，以便移动。如果你愿意的话，可称之为带轮子的椅子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sol saw fit to place in my life the inconvenience of having been born with traditionally unwieldy feet. I could not walk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 太阳神在我生命中安排了与生俱来的不便——那双传统意义上笨重的脚。我无法行走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But it was simply that, an inconvenience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但这不过是件麻烦事罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non. I very much was not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non。我绝对不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah ! Oh, how I am sitting here laughing at myself for being the fool. Yes, I suppose you would call them wheelchairs, as they are chairs with wheels. Silly me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！哦，我坐在这里笑自己真是个傻瓜。是啊，我想你们会称它们为轮椅，毕竟它们是带轮子的椅子。我真是糊涂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though, I do not miss having to push myself about. Nor does Lyon, I imagine. What freedom it is to fly !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然，​我​并不​怀念​以前​需要​推着​轮椅​的​日子。​里昂​想必​也​是​如此。​飞翔​是​多么​自由​啊​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I never saw the point in bemoaning it. I certainly relish the ability to fetch objects from high shelves without aid, I will tell you that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我从来不觉得抱怨有什么意义。老实说，能不用帮手就从高架子上拿东西，我倒是挺享受的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, le Cardinal told Lyon and I all that would come of taking the sérums that changed our forms. We knew what it would do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，主教告诉里昂和我服用改变形态的血清会带来什么后果。我们心知肚明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: While I can see the logic behind the decision to protect them from the pain le Cardinal has caused by his necessary departure...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我能理解那个决定背后的逻辑，就是为了保护他们免受主教必须离开而造成的痛苦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pauvre petit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pauvre petit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ce qui est fait est fait. I could not pray to Sol for a miracle, when so many were hurting more around me, when so many were of greater need. The Luminaries had already given me so much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ce qui est fait est fait。我无法向太阳神祈求奇迹，当身边有太多人承受着更深的伤痛，当有太多人需要更迫切的帮助。双耀神已赐予我太多恩惠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But like all things, I took mine in joy, and Lyon took his... oh, I fear as if I am telling on him and I should not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但凡事皆如此，我欣然接受了我的，里昂也接受了他的……哦，我怕自己像在告发他似的，我可不该这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do think it needlessly cruel, don't you ? They might think him dead. Or worse ! And we, living here, comme des rats d'égout ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我确实觉得这太残忍了，你不觉得吗？他们可能会以为他死了。或者更糟 ！而我们，住在这里，comme des rats d'égout ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui... I see the logic. I would work to mend their family, if you can, then, non ? It seems to be the only hope any of us have to get out of this place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui……我明白其中的逻辑。如果可以的话，我也会努力修复他们的家庭，non ？这似乎是我们所有人离开这里的唯一希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! You understand. I knew the world from another point of view. My arms were stronger. I am more patient. I know what it means to enjoy the moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！你明白的。我曾以另一种视角看世界。我的臂膀更强壮，我的耐心更持久。我懂得何为享受当下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go. Thank you for this wonderful diversion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。谢谢你带来的这段美妙的消遣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lest we spend the rest of our lives trapped living here, comme des rats d'égout.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 以免我们余生都被困在这里，comme des rats d'égout。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When I reach my destination, I bask in the elegance of it. I do not scurry about like a beetle with a billion little legs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 抵达目的地时，我沉醉于它的优雅之中。我不会像长着无数条小腿的甲虫那样匆匆忙忙地四处奔走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know. It is Monsieur Loid's, and everyone else's decision, to make themselves known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道。是否让自己被世人知道，是洛德先生，以及所有人的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply wish my dear Lyon could see the world in such a way as you. That all inconveniences may be a secret power, as you say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是希望我亲爱的里昂能像你这样看待世界。愿所有不便都如你所言，成为一种隐秘的力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I appreciate your kindness, Drifter. I will simply leave it at this, as to not overstep any imposition I may be placing upon you -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我感激你的好意，漂泊者。就此打住吧，以免给你添太多麻烦——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are not alone in that, Drifter. Lyon is like family to me, and still sometimes I wonder if I know him any more than the statues of saints in the cathedral.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，你并非唯一如此的人。里昂于我如同家人，可有时我仍怀疑自己对他了解的程度，是否比得上大教堂里的圣徒雕像。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would suggest that it is a sense of guilt, not nobility, that keeps us down here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为，将我们困守于此的并非崇高情操，而是负罪感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也很想哪天见一下那位朋友，但这不是我要说的重点，傻狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know the compulsion you feel. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我明白你内心的冲动。谢谢你，你给了我很多值得思考的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know how you feel. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我懂你的感受。谢谢你，你给了我很多值得思考的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I... know of a similar situation. Thank you, you have given me much to think on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我……也遇到过类似的情况。谢谢你，你给了我很多值得思考的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, I fear as if I am telling on him and I should not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，我怕自己像在告发他似的，我可不该这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: - Lyon paints the world in a crimson brush, whatever his outward demeanor may seem to belie. I am sorry he still does not speak to you. I am urging him to do so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ——里昂用猩红的画笔描绘世界，无论他外表如何掩饰。很抱歉他仍不愿与你交谈。我正敦促他开口……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps there is ! I would not give up hope. We must understand the root illness, if we are to treat it, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许有 ！我不会放弃希望。若要治疗，我们必须理解病根所在，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That we hide some great and terrible sin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们是在躲避某种重大而可怕的罪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也很想哪天见一下那位朋友，但这不是我要说的重点，傻狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon holds a deep and painful burden in his heart. One that he feels he alone must carry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂心中藏着沉重而痛苦的负担。他觉得这重担只能由自己独自承担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have been clever already to sniff out that Lyon holds a deep and painful burden in his heart. One that he feels he alone must carry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你已经很聪明地察觉到，里昂心中藏着沉重而痛苦的负担。他觉得这重担只能由自己独自承担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it is that sin that must be forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而正是那份罪需要被宽恕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you. I do not know if you will succeed, but sometimes, we can only help but to try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢。我不知道你是否会成功，但有时候，我们能做的只有去尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go. Thank you for this wonderful diversion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。谢谢你带来的这段美妙的消遣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you, you have given me much to think on. À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢你，你给了我很多值得思考的东西。À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am sorry he still does not speak to you. I am urging him to do so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很抱歉他仍不愿与你交谈。我正敦促他开口……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I worry his compulsion to paint all the world with a crimson brush will be his undoing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我担心他执意用猩红画笔涂抹整个世界的冲动，终将毁了他自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go. Merci pour cette merveilleuse distraction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。Merci pour cette merveilleuse distraction。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Il y a un crâne volant ! Keksekça ?! There is a flying talking skull and everyone is going on about their days as if nothing is happening and I need someone to acknowledge the strangeness of their whole existence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Il y a un crâne volant ！Keksekça ？！有一个会飞会说话的骷髅头，而所有人却像什么都没发生似的继续过日子，我需要有人承认他们整个存在有多么诡异。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pardon, is it a name or an object ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请问，这是个人名还是物名 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not think him a threat ! He does not frighten me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我并不认为他是威胁 ！他吓不倒我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, I find him perfectly charming, if a bit unyielding in conversation. Not wholly unlike his living inspiration. But given the nature of my favored traveling companion, you can tell that does not bother me overmuch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 确实，我觉得他很有魅力，只是在交谈中有些固执。这与他现实中的原型倒也颇为相似。不过鉴于我这位最爱旅伴的性情，想必你也能看出这点倒不至于让我太过在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Firstly, of whose designs are these, "Necraloids ?" Of which they are a name and also, perhaps, a designation ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 首先，这些"殁世械灵"究竟出自谁之手 ？这既是个名称，又或许是一种标识 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... do not understand. And how does Loid factor into this ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……不太明白。那洛德又和这件事有什么关系 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, what you might find grotesque in his visage, I assure you, is not the issue I currently have at hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我向你保证，你可能觉得他面容可怖之处，并非我当前所关切的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Excusez-moi, do you mean to imply that le Cardinal made a replicant flying skull servant in the likeness of his own companion, and named them thusly ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Excusez-moi，你的意思是说主教仿照他的同伴造了一个会飞的骷髅仆人，并给他们起了这个名字吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You know little of me, which is no fault of yours. I have spent much of my life tending to the dead and the places that they repose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你对我了解并不多，这不是你的错。我一生中的大部分时间都在照料逝者及其长眠之所。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I find myself curious as to why there is another face upon his back that resembles a child's scrawl.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我好奇他后面为何还刻着另一张脸，那模样活像小朋友的涂鸦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why are there not more of them, these necraloids, then ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那为什么这样的殁世械灵不多呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed I have spent much of my life with them as my boon companions. They are keen to listen to my troubles of the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 确实，我一生中大部分时间都与他们形影不离。他们热衷倾听我每日的烦恼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I inquired with Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid both, and neither wished to speak of it, they only told me a name. Otak. And it was with great sadness that they uttered it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我分别询问了殁世械灵先生和洛德先生，但两人都避而不谈此事，只告诉我一个名字：奥塔。他们说出这个名字时，语气中带着深深的悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So here I am, speaking with you, in hopes you might be able to aid me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以我在这里和你交谈，希望你能帮助我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ou bien, a tribute to his love and respect, that he did not think this strange laboratory could continue to function without Monsieur Loid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ou bien，作为对他爱戴与敬重的致意，他认为没有洛德先生，这个奇怪的实验室便无法继续运转。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Imagine it, a school of flying skulls, all effortlessly and perfectly efficient !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想象一下，一群飞行的骷髅头，动作轻盈又精准无比 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tragic and beautiful, in its way, non ? A tribute to his love and respect, that he did not think this strange laboratory could continue to function without Monsieur Loid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 从某种角度来看，悲剧而又美丽，non ？作为对他爱戴与敬重的致意，他认为没有洛德先生，这个奇怪的实验室便无法继续运转。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And mausoleums and cryptes, oh yes. But I do admit I preferred the outdoor spaces, though they were challenging for my chair to navigate. No more so than stairs, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还有陵墓和墓穴，哦，是的。但我确实更喜欢户外空间，尽管我的椅子在其中穿行颇具挑战。不过比起台阶来，这算不了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah ! No, thankfully. Not until your "Necraloid" with such a morbid visage replied to me. If speaking to the dead is within the gifts of the Luminaries to bestow, it is not within my knowing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！没有，谢天谢地。直到你那张病态面容的"殁世械灵"回应我时才如此。如果与亡者对话是双耀神所赐的恩赐，那也超出了我的认知范畴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe I wish to know both, in time, but I will let you decide where to begin. I do not know which is more important, après tout.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我终究都会去了解这两者，但开始从哪里由你决定。après tout，我也不知道哪一个更重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And now I am intrigued, but that seems a story for another time. Cela dit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在我很好奇，但这似乎是另一个故事了。Cela dit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May I ask what I hope is not an impolite question ? It is so very early in our friendship, especially to you, who by the tell of it, have known so many years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​能​问​个​问题​吗 ？​希望​不​会​太​冒昧。​我们​的​友谊​才​刚刚​开始，​对​你​而​言尤其​如此，​听说​你​已经​活​过​很多​岁​月​了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sol ! You break my heart with your words. You and the devil both find your minds devoid of knowledge like a book with chapters removed, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 太阳神啊 ！你的话太让我心痛了。你和恶魔都觉得自己的脑子一片空白，就像一本被撕去了几章的书，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you intend to assist the devil in his endeavors ? I hear tell you are responsible for the slaughter of his kin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是打算帮助恶魔完成他的阴谋吗 ？我听说你要去为屠杀他族人的事负责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why have you agreed to help the devil in his endeavors ? I hear tell you are responsible for the slaughter of his kin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你为什么要答应帮助恶魔完成他的阴谋 ？我听说你要去为屠杀他族人的事负责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Truly ? It seems then you are the only one who does not. Between the child and the devil, it seems all are seeking parts of themselves they have misplaced.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真的吗 ？看来只有你是这么想的。无论是孩子还是恶魔，似乎他俩都在寻找被遗忘的那部分自我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is it too much of me to ask why you find yourself so bereft ? The child and the devil's reasons are known to me, but not yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我这样问会不会太冒昧，为什么你看起来那么失落 ？孩子和恶魔的原因我知道，但你的我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Night of the Naga Drums. Oh, I can see it in my mind. Quelles couleurs magnifiques !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 长胴鼓之夜。哦，我可以想象出来。Quelles couleurs magnifiques ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nor do I blame you. If I were subject to that manner of abuse, I would be eager enough to tuck it all away. At the very least, I would not go looking for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不怪你。如果我也遭受那样的虐待，我会迫不及待地把一切都藏起来。至少，我绝不会再去找回它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have no doubt ! If I were subject to that manner of abuse, I expect my soul would do something similar. Hide away all that cannot be mended, and does no good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 毋庸置疑！如果我也遭受那样的虐待，我的灵魂大概也会做出类似的反应。把所有无法修复、毫无益处的记忆都藏起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, je comprends. So quick we are to burn the building down, when the smell is the fault of the rats within its walls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui, je comprends。明明是只是墙里老鼠带来的臭味，我们却急着要放火烧屋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je meurs d'envie de savoir pourquoi ! But a conversation for another day. Or else we will be here forever, and Monsieur Loid will become cross with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je meurs d'envie de savoir pourquoi ！不过这些话我们改日再谈，否则会聊个没完，而洛德先生会对我生气的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will need to speak to Monsieur Loid for more details. But !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我需要和洛德先生谈谈更多细节。但是 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But that is a conversation for another day, or else we will be here forever, and Monsieur Loid will become cross with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过这些话我们改日再谈，否则会聊个没完，而洛德先生会对我生气的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Although, this may give me some insight over what I wished to speak with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过，这可能让我对我想和你谈论的事情有些头绪了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pardonnez-moi ! I am not giving you a chance to answer. Will you lend aid to the devil, then ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pardonnez​-moi ！​我​没​给​到​你​回答​的​机会。​那么，​你​会​帮助​恶魔​吗 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pardonnez-moi ! I am not giving you a chance to answer. Why lend aid to the devil, then ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pardonnez​-moi ！​我​没​给​到​你​回答​的​机会。​那么，​你为什么要​帮助​恶魔 ​？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Seems to me he has survived for longer than anyone should. I think perhaps hell should come reclaim its own, it seems to have wandered off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可在我看来，他活得比任何人都长。我想，或许地狱该来把它自己的东西收回去，他似乎已经迷失了方向。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Le diable séduit les cœurs les plus forts. He plays the cunning game, but be careful. Make sure he meets your eye and nothing else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Le diable séduit les cœurs les plus forts。他玩的是诡诈的游戏，但务必小心。确保你们只是表面交流，千万别深入交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, I see. You are simply in the business of collecting soldiers. But that devil would sooner sink a dagger betwixt your ribs than guard your back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，我明白了。你只是在收集士兵罢了。但那恶魔宁愿在你肋间捅刀，也不会替你守护后背。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is no ally of yours, nor will he ever be. That devil sides only with those who serve his needs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他不是你的盟友，也永远不会是。那个恶魔只会和那些对他有用的人站在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I laud your compassion, it fills my heart with joy. The Luminaries teach us that all can be given aid. All can be forgiven. But... only if they seek it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我称颂你的怜悯之心，这让我心生喜悦。双耀神教导我们，众生皆可得助。众生皆可得赦。但……前提是他们主动去寻求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I am being unkind... you do not know him. You do not see him for what he is. I simply do not wish for you to be hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我这样说有点失礼了……你并不了解他。也没看清他的真面目。我只是不希望你受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Endless toil aiding those who never sweat in the field of their own redemption is the life of a slave left wanting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 若无休止地帮助那些从不耕耘自己救赎之田的人，那便是空虚的奴隶命运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pardon. I hardly know you or your capacity for withstanding manipulation. I merely worry, as we have heaped our woes upon you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pardon。我对你和你那抵抗操纵的能力几乎一无所知。我只是担心，毕竟我们把我们的苦难都加到你身上了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is all I could ask. Merci, merci, merci. Now, I fear I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这便是我想要请求的。Merci，Merci，Merci。现在，恐怕我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, vous avez raison. I hardly know you or your capacity for withstanding manipulation. I merely worry, as we have heaped our woes upon you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，vous avez raison。我对你和你那抵抗操纵的能力几乎一无所知。我只是担心，毕竟我们把我们的苦难都加到你身上了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I shall not overstep again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不会再逾越了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And now, I fear I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而现在，我恐怕得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, bonjour ! You must be the Drifter, oui ? Monsieur Loid has told me so very much about you. I am so very pleased to "meet" you on this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，Bonjour ！你一定是漂泊者吧？洛德先生跟我讲过很多关于你的事。我很高兴能在这里"见到"你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Appareil cliquetant, clever though it is !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Appareil cliquetant，即便很聪明 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am Sœur Marie Leroux, but you may call me Marie. I have recently come here with the brother of my soul, Father Lyon Allard and... well, I think Monsieur Loid may have warned you of the devil, n'est-ce pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我是玛丽·勒鲁修女，不过你可以叫我玛丽。我最近和我的灵魂兄弟里昂·阿拉德神父一起来到这里……嗯，我想洛德先生可能已经警告过你恶魔的存在了，n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci ! The what and the how of our being here is a very long story, j'en ai bien peur. We were sent here by le Cardinal. I believe you know him as Albrecht Entrati ? He entrusted us with that blue-skinned monstre irritant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci ！我们为何会来到这里， j'en ai bien peur 说来话长。我们是主教派来的。我想你认识他，他叫阿尔布雷希特·英择谛吧？他把那个蓝皮肤的 monstre irritant 托付给了我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, ce monstre irritant à la peau bleue that we have been entrusted with by le Cardinal. I believe you know him as Albrecht Entrati ? He is the reason why we are here. But that is a very long story, j'en ai bien peur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，就是主教委托我们照看的那个 ce monstre irritant à la peau bleue。我想你认识主教，他叫阿尔布雷希特·英择谛？我们之所以在这里，都是因为他。不过，j'en ai bien peur，那是个很长的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We are to do what we can to guide his soul, si c'est possible. Et si ce n'est pas le cas ? Then we must ensure at the very least that he does not cause any more harm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们应该尽我们所能引导他的灵魂，如果可能的话。如果不可能呢？那么我们至少必须确保他不再造成任何伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are just as Monsieur Loid and the Cavia described ! I think we are bound to be good friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你就像洛德先生和科维兽描述的那样 ！我想我们一定会成为好朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You sound like Lyon. I shall not give up hope. Not yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的语气听起来真像里昂。我不会放弃希望的。至少现在不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! I must go, forgive me. I hope we shall speak again soon ! À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊 ！我得走了，请原谅。希望我们很快能再见面 ！À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope you do not think me rude for asking, but I am so terribly curious. Do you have a faith ? In the Luminaries or otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 希望你不会觉得我问这个问题很无礼，但我真的很好奇。你有信仰吗 ？比如信奉双耀神还是其他什么宗教。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I respect your response. But I must ask, how are you so certain ? Is that not a kind of faith in itself ? And what is this... Indifférence of yours, if not a god ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我尊重你的回答。但我必须问一句，你怎么这么肯定 ？这难道不是一种信仰吗？你们那个 Indifférence……如果不是神，那又是什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You do ! Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! To think someone holds the faith so far into the future, cela remplit mon cœur de joie. I am overwhelmed with joy. Though I think your time in the past may have had something to do with it, no ? Ah, no matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你竟然信 ！哦，comme c'est fascinant ！想到在那么遥远的未来，仍有人抱有如此坚定的信仰，cela remplit mon cœur de joie。我太高兴了。不过我觉得这可能与你过去的经历有关，对吗？啊，没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faith by any name I find beauty in. Tell me, is it new ? Old ? Would I recognize it at all ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论信仰以何种名称出现，我都能在其中发现美。告诉我，它是新诞生的？还是古老的？我能认出它吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Aah, perhaps the wisest answer of them all! For who are we mere mortals - if we can still claim to be such - to pretend to draw out the design of the Gods ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，这或许是最智慧的答案 ！我们这些凡人——如果我们还能自称是凡人的话——又怎能妄图描绘神的旨意 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder, are you devout to one or the other ? Or do you seek the balance ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想知道，你是虔诚地信奉其中一方，还是寻求平衡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, oui. A wanderer, that is in your name. You have seen many cultures, many faiths, many worlds. Cela est très spirituel, non ? Collected parts of them like seashells.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，oui。你是个流浪者，正如你的名字那样。你见识过许多文化，许多信仰，许多世界。Cela est très spirituel，non ？你像捡贝壳一样把它们的一部分收集起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oft have I sat in the sanctuary of my Cathédrale and spoken gleefully with strangers who have come to learn and nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常坐在我的 Cathédrale 圣所里，兴高采烈地与那些陌生的慕道友聊天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So curious of our faith but not wanting to say "yes, yes, this is the truth." I can only hope I gave them some part of our joy to take with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们对我们的信仰感到好奇，但又不想说"是的，是的，这就是真理。"我只希望我能给他们带来一些我们的喜乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, je vois... You perhaps need your own "proof" to be certain? Nothing has happened in your own life to give you such an emotion, like we feel of faith and fervor ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，je vois……你或许需要你自己的"证据"才能确定？你的生命中有没有发生过什么事，让你产生如此强烈的情感，就像我们感受到的信仰和火热一样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, c'est vrai - that is true. Faith answers many questions for many souls. Do you not fear what may come after death ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​c'est vrai ​—— 确实。​信仰​解答​了​无数人​的​疑问。​难道​你​不​惧怕​死​后​会​发生​什么​吗 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Comme c'est fascinant... and now there are two, who repeat the same words... the devil has whispered the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Comme c'est fascinant……现在有两个人重复着同样的话……恶魔也低声说了同样的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! How I would love to learn of your faith some day. To hear of your rituals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，comme c'est fascinant ！我真希望有一天能了解你们的信仰，听听你们的仪式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! How I would love to hear how it is so aligned and yet so different some day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，comme c'est fascinant ！真希望有一天听到它为何如此相似却又如此不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je comprends et c'est magnifique. I have often wondered if the Luminaries did not wear other faces. Other names.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je comprends et c'est magnifique。我常常在想，双耀神是否曾以其他面孔、以其他名字示人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose that might be a surprise, to find someone who wears the cloth to not be strict in their expectations of others. I find preaching to those who are not seeking solace does not win much love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，这或许会让人感到惊讶，发现一个身披圣袍的人对别人的要求并不严格。我发现，向那些不寻求慰藉的人传教，往往会招人嫌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It pains my heart to give him any manner of credence but in this ? Perhaps you should speak to him. Simply be wary. The devil plays a dangerous game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​实在​是​难​以​相信​他，​但​在​这​件​事​上​ ？​或许​你​应该​跟​他​谈谈。​只是​要​小心。​恶魔玩​的​可是​危险​的​游戏。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A wanderer after my own heart ! You bring such a smile to my face. I hope you do not lie to flatter me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真是个与我志同道合的流浪者 ！你太让我开心了。希望你没有为了讨好我而撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Aah, the wanderer follows the night's path like my dear Lyon. When he is ready, you should speak to him of his dark lady's ways, he will be overjoyed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，流浪者就像我亲爱的里昂一样，追寻着夜色的足迹。等他准备好了，你应该跟他聊聊他那位暗夜女士之道，他一定会欣喜若狂的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Balance without indecision. To journey through one's life, knowing when the sun must rise and the moon must answer it, but to never fall prey to doubt ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 平衡而不犹豫。能在人生旅途中，知道太阳何时升起，月亮何时回应，却又永远不会陷入怀疑 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They have been known to change their forms to please their followers in other sects. But that is my faith, not yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 众所周知，他们会为了与其他教派的信徒更亲近而改变自己的形象。但这是我的信仰，不是你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am smiling at your wisdom and kindness towards the beliefs of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我为你对他人信仰的展现智慧和善良感到欣慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It must be a simpler life, then. To not live by the rules of gods and churches. I admit I am a little jealous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那​你​活得​一定​更​简单。不用受神明和教会的规矩约束。我承认我有点嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I am jealous of you, wanderer ! To live so many centuries, devoid of the need to know the gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我真羡慕你，流浪者！活了这么长时间，竟然没有认识神的需要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You sound like a disciple of Lua, and I mean that with no offense. Oui, the Crone comes for us all, and weeps her silver tears. But your words make me wonder...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​听​起来​像​是​月神​的​信徒，​我​并​无​冒犯​之意。​Oui，​老妇​终究会​来​找到​我们，​并​流下​她​银色​的​泪水。​但​你​的​话​让​我​在​想……​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, it makes me wonder. I look upon you, the child, the devil, even Monsieur Loid, or le Cardinal... so many centuries stretch behind you all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，这让我不禁想知道。我看着你，那个孩子，那个恶魔，甚至洛德先生，或者主教……在你们身后，都跨越了多少个世纪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply wonder, does our faith bring you peace ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是想问，我们的信仰能给你带来平安吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is a rare gift... and one I hope you wield. To linger at the crossroads too long is to be consumed by strife, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那是罕见的天赋……我希望你能拥有。若在十字路口徘徊太久，恐怕会被纷争吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ô joie ! I do so much love to learn. I have often wondered if the Luminaries did not wear other faces. Other names.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ô joie ！我常常在想，双耀神是否曾以其他面孔、以其他名字示人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose that might be a surprise, to find someone who wears the cloth to not be strict in their expectations of others. I find preaching to those who are not seeking solace does not win much love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，这或许会让人感到惊讶，发现一个身披圣袍的人对别人的要求并不严格。我发现，向那些不寻求慰藉的人传教，往往会招人嫌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply hope your faith brings you peace ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只希望你的信仰，能带给你平安 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, anyone who comes with an open mind shall be met with open arms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，任何带着开放心态的人都会得到开放的怀抱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply wonder, does this bring you peace ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是想问，这能给你带来平安吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But, I wonder... does this not believing, does it bring you peace ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 只是，我想问……这种不信会给你带来平安吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Of whom do you speak of, when you say "it should" come for you all ? I look upon you, the child, the devil, even Monsieur Loid, or le Cardinal... so many centuries stretch behind you all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说"它​本​该​如此"找到​我们，你指的是谁？我看着你，那个孩子，那个恶魔，甚至洛德先生，或者主教……在你们身后，都跨越了多少个世纪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder how many centuries stretch before us now, before Lua will come for us. And I wonder how eagerly I will embrace her when that day should come. But that is my faith, not yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想知道，在月神降临之前，我们还要经历多少个世纪。我也想知道，当那一天到来时，我又会如何热切地拥抱她。但那是我的信仰，不是你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know just yet. He keeps his schemes to himself like a good devil. But he believes in no gods. Save, perhaps, himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还不知道。他像个善于伪装的恶魔一样，把阴谋都藏在心里。不过他不信神。或许，只信他自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, he does not. He is much like you, he believes in no gods. Save, perhaps, himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，他不信。他跟你很像，不信任何神。或许，只信他自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: In the end, all must choose a path to walk. But the crossroads is where we must all begin, the balance is the foundation of all structures.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 最终，每个人都必须选择一条要走的路。但十字路口是我们所有人的起点，平衡，才是一切构筑的基石。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They have been known to change their forms to please their followers in other sects. But that is my faith, not yours. I will not preach to those who are not seeking for solace. I find it does not win much love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 众所周知，他们会为了与其他教派的信徒更亲近而改变自己的形象。但这是我的信仰，不是你的。我不会向那些不寻求慰藉的人传教。因为我发现这样往往会招人嫌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, my faith is mine, and yours is your own. I simply hope it brings you peace ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我的信仰属于我，而你的信仰属于你。我只是希望它能给你带来平安 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My jealousy abounds! It would consume me. I would... be eager to speak to you of this again, if you would allow me ? I do not wish to preach or pry. I do not wish to cause you distress.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我心中的嫉妒几乎要将我吞没。如果你允许的话，我……很想再和你聊聊这件事。我并不是想说教，也不想打探你的隐私。我只是不想让你难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I know my Sol smiles upon you, whether or not you pray to him, for you have found the only path that you need.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这样，我知道不管你有没有向我所信仰的太阳神祈祷，他都会对你微笑。因为你已经找到了你所需要的唯一道路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Aah, pardonne-moi ! Little Marie is preaching, how embarrassing ! I did not come here to lecture you like a schoolteacher.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，pardonne-mo ！小玛丽竟然在说教，真不好意思 ！我来这里可不是来当你的老师的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am deeply touched by your honesty, wanderer. I would... be eager to speak to you of this again, if you would allow me? I do not wish to preach or pry. I do not wish to cause you distress.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的诚实深深地感动了我，流浪者。如果你允许的话，我……很想再和你聊聊这件事。我并不是想说教，也不想打探你的隐私。我只是不想让你难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am merely curious, and wish to aid you if I can. Please, tell me no, and we shall never speak of this again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是好奇，也希望看看能不能帮得上忙。也请放心拒绝我，这样我们以后绝不会再提这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder, may we speak of this again ? I am so very curious to know more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在想，我们以后可以再聊聊这个吗？我非常好奇，想知道更多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci ! There is much trust in what you have just given me. I shall not waste it. Until then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，merci ！你刚刚回我的话，蕴含着巨大的信任。我不会辜负这份信任。回头见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I understand completely, and I am not offended. Thank you for listening to me, and I am grateful for what you have shared. We shall speak on other matters, Sol knows we have plenty !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我完全理解，而且我并没有生气。谢谢你听我倾诉，我很感激你分享的一切。我们以后再聊其他话题吧，太阳神知道我们有很多事情可以谈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, oui ? What is this ? Quelle audace, I must say I am surprised at you ! I was not expecting...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，oui ？这是什么话？Quelle audace，我真没想到你会这样 ！我完全没想到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But you are trying to distract me ! While I am not opposed, it is far too soon for such things, n'est-ce pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但你是在试图转移我的注意力 ！虽然我不反对，但现在谈这种事还太早了，n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... would still like an answer to my question, s'il vous plait, if you do not mind. Though now you have me blushing !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……还是想请你回答我的问题，s'il vous plait，如果你不介意的话。不过现在你让我都脸红了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I knew of him as Cardinal Dimanche. It might surprise you how many years he spent in the church, preaching to our flock.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道他是星期日主教。你可能会惊讶，他在教堂里花了多少年的时间向我们的信徒布道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, a very polite question that masks a very challenging answer - quite cleverly phrased, I must admit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，​一​个​很​礼貌​的​问题，​却​非常​难以​回答。​不得​不​承认，​你​问​得​相当​巧妙。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I feel the same as I did the first day I watched him deliver a sermon from the pulpit to our paroissiens. Blessed to have been in his présence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​如今​对​他​的​感受，​与​当初​第一​次望​见​他在讲台上​向 paroissiens ​布道​时​并​无​不同，​能亲​眼见证​在​他​的​ p​résence​ 下，​我​深感​被​祝福。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He spoke of forgiveness, of family, and of empathy with such fervor and dedication I do not know how it could be an act.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​谈起​宽恕、​谈起​家人、​谈起​共​情​时，​那​种​炽热​与​虔诚​让​我​无法​相信，​那​一切​都​只​是​伪装。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I appreciate that your experiences with him are not the same as mine. But you must also understand that to me, he was nothing but kind and caring.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​明白，​你​与​他​相处​的​经历​与​我​不同。​但​也​请​你​明白，​对​我​来​说，​他​始终温​和​而​体贴。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Does he hold the faith of the Luminaries ? Of Sol and Lua ? That, I do not know any longer, knowing now from whence and when he hails. Peu importe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​如今​是否​仍​信奉双耀神中的太阳神和月​神？​这​一​点，​我​已​无​从​断定，​毕竟​如今​我​已​知​他​来自​何方，​何时​而​来。​但​那​又​如何​呢，​Pe​u impor​te。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do your truths invalidate mine, or whose am I meant to believe ? Shall I condemn every act of mercy, every act of gentleness, he showed in his years amongst the parish ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​的​真相，​难道​能​就​此​否定​我​的？​或者​说​我​究竟​该​信谁​的​真相？​难道​我​该​将​他​那些​年间​所有​的​慈悲​与​温柔，​都​视​作罪孽​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What importance is the name of the gods you pray to, if you hold their love within your heart ? None at all, I say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​祈祷​的​神名​是​什么，​又​有​什么​关系​呢​ ？​只​要​心​中​仍​怀​着祂们​的​爱，​那​名​字便毫​无意义。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non. I think not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non。​我​不​觉得。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgive me, I shall not make a monster out of him simply because you say so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请​原谅​我。​我​不​会​只​因为​你​这么​说，​就​将​他​描述成​一​个​怪物。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! How it brightens my heart to hear it. I thought I was alone in such regards. I am surrounded by those who think only ill of le Cardinal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！​听​你​这么​说​真​让​我​的​心绪​都​亮​了​起来。​我​还​以​为​只​有​我​这样​想​呢。​身边​的​人​都​只会​说主教的​坏话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe le Cardinal truly holds the faith of the Luminaries in his soul, even if he does not believe they wait for him in the ever-after.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​相信主教的​灵魂​中确实怀​有​对​双耀神​的​信仰，​ ​即便​他​并不​认为，​祂二​人会​在​永恒​的​彼岸​等​候​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For what other man knows the value of empathy against the darkness of Indifférence, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还​有​哪位​比​他​更​懂得​深陷​ Indi​fférence ​的​黑暗​之​中，​同情​有​多​珍贵，​non ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are correct, it does not. I would not call you a Follower of Sol simply because you ignorantly follow His Way. More good in the world betters the world, I care not what name it wears.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​说​得​对，​确实​如此。​我​不​会​仅仅​因为​你​不​自觉​地​行走​在​祂​的​道路​上，​便称​你​为​太阳神​的​信徒。​世间​若多​一些​善意，​便会​变得​更好。​至于​它​冠​以​何名，​我​并不​在​意。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, et comme c'est tragique... it makes me weep to think of it. And of Monsieur Loid alone, their love adrift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​et​ comme c'est tragique……​一​想到​这​件​事​我​就​想​落泪。​还​有​洛德​先生，​和​那份​漂泊​无依​的​爱。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And so I believe le Cardinal to be blessed, even if he does not truly hold the faith by the same name I would give it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以​我​依然​相信，主教是​被​祝福​着​的，​即便​他​所持​的​信仰，​并​不​以​我​所​称呼​的​名字​存在​。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and I think that is the quest upon which we have all been set.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​我​想​这​正​是​我们​所有​人​被​赋予​的​使命。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, but the battle against l'Indifférence is not won with swords and stones. It is won with the heart, do you not see ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​但​与​ l​'Indi​fférence ​的​斗争​并​非​以​刀剑​和​石块​取胜。​而​是​以心取胜，​你​不​明白​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is not the devil Orokin he wishes us to forgive, non ? It is le Cardinal, that much is clear. And I think it is the love of Monsieur Loid that inspires it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​希望​我们​去​原谅​的​不​是​那个​堕落​的​ O​rok​in，​non ？​要​宽恕​的​是主教。​我​想​正​是​洛德​先生​的​爱启​发​了​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perfect that he comes to preach the message in counterbalance to that which he unleashed, n'est-ce pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​如今来​传道，​正好​去​平衡​那场​由​他​亲手​引发​的​灾祸，​多​完美，​n'est-ce pas ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgive me, I forgot... you do not believe your Indifférence is real. Merely a hallucination. But you believe in the emotion of it, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不​好意思，​我​忘​了​……​你​并不​认为​你​的​那个​ Indi​fférence ​是​真实​存在​的。​在​你​看来，​那​不过​是​一​场​幻觉。​可​你​相信​那份​情绪​的​存在，​oui ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It shatters my heart. I wish for nothing more than to see them reunited !
