/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们​的​事让​我​心碎。​我​只​希望​能​见证​他们​重逢​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And who are we to judge his methods ? Cardinal Dimanche is a genius, blessed by the Luminaries. He will guide us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​又​有何​资格​去​评判​他​做事​的​方式​呢？​星期日主教很​聪慧，​受到​了​双耀神​的​祝福。​他​会​引领​我们​前行。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mind your tone. Cardinal Dimanche is a genius, blessed by the Luminaries. He will guide us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 注意​你​的​语气。​星期日主教是​天启​的​贤者，​受双耀神​祝福。​他​会​引领​我们​前行。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Of course it serves a purpose. Je ne le nie pas.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然，它自有其意义。Je ne le nie pas。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do we know if she lives ? Or whatever became of her ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​知道​她​还​活​着​吗 ？​或者​她​后来​怎样​了​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Cardinal Dimanche is a genius, blessed by the Luminaries. He will guide us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​星期日主教是​天启​的​贤者，​受双耀神​祝福。​他​会​引领​我们​前行。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not blame you, you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​知道​吗，​我​并不​怪​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, oui - I have heard the others speak of this world you made. When you were utterly alone, and had no one else to turn to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui, oui​——​我​听​其他​人​提起​过，​是​那个​你​亲手​创造​的​世界。​那时​的​你​孑然​一身，​无人​依靠。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We must keep the faith. For if we lose hope that love will prevail over all, then the darkness shall win.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​必须​坚守​信仰。​若​我们​失去​了​对​爱​能​战胜​一切​的​希望，​那么​黑暗​便​会​胜利。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes. And you are a time-traveling creature from the Void who can loop time at will and create whole universes from whole cloth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没错。​而​你，​一​个​来自​虚空​的​时光​穿​梭者，​能​随意​扭转​时间​编织​出​整​个​宇宙。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am pleased to hear that. For I know how you have little reason to. I have heard the stories from the Cavia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 听​你​这么​说​我​很​欣慰。​毕竟​我​知道​你​几乎​没有​什么​理由​去​信任​他。​ ​我​从​科维兽​那​里​听过​那些​故事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And would you ever consider that one's heart could belong to more than one soul ? That one could love more than one other ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后​你​可​曾​想​过，​一​个​人​的​心​也​许​能​属于​不止​一​个​灵魂？​一​个​人​也​能​爱​上​不止​一​个​他​人？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Love is all we have left in the world, when all else fails, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当​一切​都​崩塌​时，​世上​我们​仅剩​的​就​是​爱​，​non ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I stand beside a devil who has lived for countless centuries. Not far away is a woman who is a machine with the souls of a triple goddess in her own right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​身旁站​着​一​位​活​了​无数​世纪​的恶魔。​不远处​还​有​一​个​女人，​她​是​机器，​却​承载​着​三​位​女神​的​灵魂。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faith is never wise. But for those of us who carry it like a torch, we seek to carry it always - though it may burn us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 信仰​从​不理智。​可​对​我们​这些​将​它​当作​火炬​的​人​而​言，​即便​它​灼烧​着​我们，​我们​也​仍​要​背负​它。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah! You of all people should know that faith is never wise. Yet souls like ours carry it anyway, though it may burn us. I suspect you know this, if our conversation earlier was the truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈！​在​这​世​上​最​该​明白信仰​从​不理智​的​人​不​就​是​你​吗？​然而​像​我们​这样​的​灵魂，​依然​选择​背负​它，​哪怕​它​灼烧​着​我们。​我​想​你​明白​这​一​点，​如果​我们​先​前​谈话算​是​坦诚​相待​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You would be surprised, I think, to know how little that is my responsibility.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想，​也​许​你​会​惊讶。​宽恕​其实​并​非​我​应尽​的​职责。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For not believing. In l'Indifférence. In anything at all. If I had created a world du tissu du Néant - from the cloth of the Void - perhaps I would feel the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​会​怪​你​不​相信​ l'Indi​fférence ​的​存在，​不​信​任何​存在。​若​是​我​亲​手用​ d​u tissu du Néant ​创造​出​一​个​世界​——​或许​我​也​会​如此​吧。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! But you came for a story ! I have taken up so much of your time, I shall make it brief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊​ ！​但​你​是​来​听​故事​的​ ！​我​占用​了​你​太​多​时间，​我​会​长话​短​说。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My brother hears the voices of the dead and of the gods themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​的​哥哥能​听见​亡灵​的​低语，​亦​能​听​见​众神​的​声音。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ultimate forgiveness is not something to be sought from others, or even from the Luminaries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 至​高​的​宽恕，​并​非​应当向​他​人​求得，​也​不​该​寄望​于​双耀神。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was a beautiful, sunny afternoon. I remember him standing in front of the altar, gazing up at the stained glass with a smile upon his face, though I knew not why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那​是​个​美丽​晴朗​的​午后。​我​记得​他​站​在​祭坛​前，​仰望​着​彩绘​玻璃，​脸​上​带​着​微笑，​虽然​我​并不​知晓​他​为何​而笑。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I broke fast with animals who enquired after the quality of my rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​曾​与​会​询问​我​睡得​可好​的​动物​共进​早餐。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We carry it because we must. Because we know no other way to be. No matter what it means, in the end. I know how you feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​背负​它​是​因为​必须​这样​做。​因为​我们​已​不​知​还​有​怎样​的​方式​去​存在。​它​最​终意味​着​什么​已​无​关紧要。​我​明白​你​的​感受。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faith to souls like ours is like a torch - we carry it always, though it may burn us in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对​我们​这样​的​灵魂​而言，​信仰​就​像​火炬​——​即便​它​最​终​会​灼伤​我们，​我们​也​依然​要​背负​着​它。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though I am surprised. You expressed yourself to be a creature of little faith before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过​我​有些​惊讶，​你​之前​明明​说​过​自己​并​无多​少​信仰。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though I am surprised, you expressed doubt about faith before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过​我​有些​惊讶，​你​之前​可是​对​信仰​表示​过​怀疑​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faith to souls like mine is like a torch - we carry it always, though it may burn us in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对​我这样​的​灵魂​而言，​信仰​就​像​火炬​——​即便​它​最​终​会​灼伤​我们，​我们​也​依然​要​背负​着​它。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Interesting. I do not know the ways of the Orokin well enough to know if it was against their ways. But I know in many of the ancient cultures, it was not frowned upon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有​趣。​我​对​奥罗金​的​规矩​并不​了解，​不​知​这​是否​违背​他们​的​教义。​但​我​知道​在​许多​古老​的​文化​中，​这​并​不​被​视为​可耻​之事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He crouched low to greet me, so that his head was below mine in my chair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​俯​下身​与​我​问候，​让​自己​的​头低于​我​坐着​的​高度。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Speak to me again of those who are "simply men" once more and I shall do my level best not to laugh, I give you my word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 若​你​再​跟​我​提起​那些​所谓​"不过​是​凡人"​的​人，​我​会​尽力​忍住​不​笑​出声，​我​保证。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But, I fear none of this is about what you came to speak to me. You wanted a story, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​我​想，​你​来此​的​目的​并非​这些。​你​是​想​听​一​个​故事，​non ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We carry it because we must. Because we know no other way to be. No matter what it means, in the end. I know how you feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​背负​它​是​因为​必须​这样​做。​因为​我们​已​不​知​还​有​怎样​的​方式​去​存在。​它​最​终意味​着​什么​已​无​关紧要。​我​明白​你​的​感受。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faith is not a constant. It is like the tide. It comes and goes, and that is all right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 信仰​并​非永恒​不​变。​它​如潮汐，​有​起​有​落，​而​这​并​无​不可。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Seeking to repair the damage one has caused is important, do not mistake me. Where at all possible, to be forgiven by those who have been harmed is a great balm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 弥补​自己​造成​的​伤害​固然​重要，​别误会​我​的​意思。​若​能​得到​受害​之人​的​原谅，​那确​是​抚慰心灵​的​良药。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, I do not mean to say it is not important to seek the forgiveness of those you have harmed ! It is!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，​我​不​是​说不​该​去​寻求​被​你​伤害​之人​的​原谅​ ！​当然​该​如此​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But it is hardly for us to decide... in this instance, I am not here to judge le Cardinal's professions of love for Monsieur Loid nor M. Loid's words of love in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​最终，​当​我们​面对​死亡​老妪​之​时，​当月​神为​我们​落下​银色​的​泪，​死亡​将​至，​我们​必须​背负​的​唯有​自己​内心​的​重量。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Until then, I suggest you remeasure what it means to be blessed. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在​那​之前，​我​劝​你​重新​衡量​被​祝福究​竟意味​着​什么。​再会。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, one is tangible. Present. The other requires you to shut your eyes and believe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​一​个​是​可​触​及​的。​在​眼前​的。​另​一​个​则​需要​你​闭​上​双眼​去​相信。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But in the end, when we face the Crone, when Lua sheds her silver tears for us, and death is nigh, it is the weight of our own heart we must carry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​最终，​当​我们​面对​死亡​老妪​之​时，​当月​神为​我们​落下​银色​的​泪，​死亡​将​至，​我们​必须​背负​的​唯有​自己​内心​的​重量。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Repairing what damage one might have caused, an even mightier balm upon the soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 弥补​自己​造成​的​伤害，​那​才​是​能​抚慰​灵魂​的​更​强​良药。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I may only count them as genuine. Who am I to say they are false ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只​能​将​那份​情​感视​为​真挚​的​存在。​我​又​有何​资格​说​它​是​虚假​的​呢？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. Indeed, some would label me "invalide." Someone to be pitied or scorned. But le Cardinal did no such thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui。​的​确，​有​人​会​给​我​贴​上​​"in​valide"​ 的​标签。​​把​我​视作​可怜​或​可笑​之​人。​可主教从​未​如此。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. Indeed, some would label me "invalide." Just like you have. Someone to be pitied or scorned. But le Cardinal did no such thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui。​的​确，​有​人​会​给​我​贴​上​​"in​valide"​ 的​标签。​就​像​你​一样，​把​我​视作​可怜​或​可笑​之​人。​可主教从​未​如此。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Please... I beg of you, do not think less of my dear Lyon. He is not infirme, I promise you. What ails him is not une maladie de l'esprit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 求​你​……别​因此​轻视​我​亲爱​的​里昂。​他​并​非 infir​me，​我​向​你​保证。​困扰​他​的，​并​不​是​ une ​maladie de l'espr​it。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He merely sometimes sees things, or remembers things, how they felt or how the spirits told them they should have been. Not perhaps how they were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​只是​有时会​看见​一些​景象，​或​回忆​起​往昔​的​感觉，​那些​由​灵​魂​告诉​他​的、​理应​如此​的​模样。​也许，​并​非​事情​真正​的​样子。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only respect your conviction, even if I disagree with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​并不​认同​你​的​信念，​所以​我​只​能​心怀​敬意。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, precisely. If you enter the ever-after with a heavy heart, your soul cannot fly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​正​是​如此。​若​你​带​着​沉重​的​心踏入​永恒​之境，​你​的​灵魂​便​无法​飞翔。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If it was, I welcome it every day of my life. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, because I cannot use the world the same way they do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 即便​那​真​是​骗局，​我​也​愿此​生每​日​沉​浸​其中。​人们​总是​迫不​及​待地​以​异样​的​眼光​看待​我，​只​因为​ mes pied​s ​与​常人​不同，​因为​我​无法​像​他们​那样​去​使用​这个​世界。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, they can. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, or for that I cannot use the world the same way they do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，他们​确实会​那样。​人们​总是​迫不​及​待​地​用​异样​的​眼光​看​我，​只​因为​ mes pied​s ​与​常人​不同，​或是​因为​我​无法​像​他们​那样​去​使用​这个​世界。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is all right. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, because I cannot use the world the same way they do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没​关系。​人们​总是​迫不​及​待​地​用​异样​的​眼光​看​我，​只​因为​ mes pied​s ​与​常人​不同，​​因为​我​无法​像​他们​那样​去​使用​这个​世界。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When he chooses to speak to you, whatever he will tell you of the event is how he perceived it to be. And is, in his heart, wholly true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当​他​愿意​与​你​谈起​这​件​事​时，​无论​他​说​的​是​什么，​那​都​是​他​所​感知到​的​真相。​在​他​心​中，​那​就​是​全部​的​真实。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think le Cardinal understood that one cannot enter the ever-after with a heavy heart, which is why he came to us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想，​主教明白，​若心​怀​沉重，​便​无法​踏入​永恒​之境，​这​也​是​他​来​找​我们​的​原因。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think le Cardinal knew that, which is why he came to us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想，主教早​已​明白​这​一​点，​这​也​是​他​来​找​我们​的​原因。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I admit I bristle at the notion of being maligned over it. Or worse yet, doted upon ! Pfff !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​我​承认​我​会​因​被​误解​而​心生​抗拒。​更​何况​被​人怜惜，​那​才​更​让​我​难​以​忍受​ ！​呸 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He and I are... similar, in that others are all too eager to treat us differently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​和​我……​有​点像，​人们​总是​太容易​把​我们​当成​与​众​不同​的​存在。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is why le Cardinal was such a welcome présence in my life. He brought such warmth. And never once did he treat me with disdain or pity. Not once did he look upon me as une invalide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这​也​是主教的​ ​présence 对​我​而言如此​珍贵​的​原因。​他​带来​了​温暖，​从​未​以​轻蔑​或​怜悯待​我。​哪怕​一​次，​也​未​曾​将​我​视​作​ une ​invali​de。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I forgive you. I admit I bristle at the notion of being maligned over it. Or worse yet, doted upon !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​原谅​你。​我​承认​我​会​因​被​误解​而​心生​抗拒。​更​何况​被​人怜惜，​那​才​更​让​我​难​以​忍受​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was simply Marie. And only Marie. And for that, he shall have my faith in him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在​他​眼​中​我​只​是​玛丽，​仅此​而​已。​正因​如此，​他​永​远值得​我​信任。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, they can. Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, because I cannot use the world the same way they do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，他们​确实会​那样。​人们​总是​迫不​及​待​地​用​异样​的​眼光​看​我，​只​因为​ mes pied​s ​与​常人​不同，​​因为​我​无法​像​他们​那样​去​使用​这个​世界。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Others are all too eager to treat me differently simply because mes pieds are not the same as others, because I cannot use the world the same way they do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人们​总是​迫不​及​待​地​用​异样​的​眼光​看​我，​只​因为​ mes pied​s ​与​常人​不同，​​因为​我​无法​像​他们​那样​去​使用​这个​世界。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And for Lyon, it is the same story, even if his afflictions wear a different face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对​里昂​来​说，​也​是​同样​的​故事，​只​不过​他​的​苦难换​了​另一​副面孔。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is Lyon still not speaking with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂还是没有和你说话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The time will come. I am certain of this. You merely need to be patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 时候总会到的。我确信这一点。你只需要耐心等待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are so sweet, merci pour ta bienveillance à ce regard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你人真好，merci pour ta bienveillance à ce regard。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It will go great lengths when he decides he is ready to speak with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当他决定准备好开口时，一切就会进展飞速。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我有信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But while we wait for faith - I also have persistence !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是，在我们为信念等待的同时——我也有恒心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You must stop making me blush ! Monsieur Loid will wonder what I am doing sitting here !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别再让我脸红了 ！洛德先生会好奇我坐在这里干什么 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! You are making me blush ! What will Monsieur Loid think if he sees me sitting here, like so ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊 ！你弄得我脸红了 ！如果洛德先生看到我这样坐在这里，他会怎么想 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Besides, it is not so difficult to be prettier than the devil, non ? His features are handsome, but the blue... ce n'est pas pour moi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而且，比恶魔漂亮又不难，不是吗？他的五官是很英俊，但是那蓝色的皮肤……ce n'est pas pour moi。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do accept your compliment, if it was sincerely meant. I was simply startled. May we... return to the topic at hand ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你的赞美是真心的，那么我欣然接受。我只是有点惊讶。我们……可以回到正题了吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Quoi ! Où ça ? Un éléphant ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Quoi ！Où ça ？Un éléphant ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ce diable est un imbécile qui se croit au-dessus de tout reproche ! Je préfèrerais boire un pot de vernis à bois plutôt que de passer une minute de plus à l'écouter s'enorgueillir comme un chat qui se lèche le pelage !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ce diable est un imbécile qui se croit au-dessus de tout reproche ！Je préfèrerais boire un pot de vernis à bois plutôt que de passer une minute de plus à l'écouter s'enorgueillir comme un chat qui se lèche le pelage ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I see only a fish, a bird, and... whatever M'sieur Tagfer is. I see many strange things in this Sanctum, but no éléphant - are you making joke ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只看到一条鱼、一只鸟，还有……不管标弃先生是什么。我在这个圣所里看到很多奇怪的东西，就是没看到 éléphant——你在开玩笑吧 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. It was creative, but you asked me a question, and my ire should not have been pointed at you, forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci。是很有创意，但你只是问了我一个问题，我不该把气撒在你身上，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was not. Forgive me, I should not have pointed that you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的确不是好话。抱歉，我不该把气撒在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It would not surprise me if there was ! It seems we have all other manner of ménagerie in this place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果真有的话我倒一点也不会惊讶 ！我看这里似乎还有其他各种各样的动物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, it is quite charming, isn't it ? I often will say something to Monsieur Loid and he looks at me as though I have caught him entirely unprepared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，那确实挺可爱的，不是吗 ？我经常跟洛德先生说些什么，他看着我的眼神就好像我打了他一个措手不及。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am surprised you come to me. It is clear that I think poorly of that devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很惊讶你会来找我。显然我对那个恶魔的印象很差。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Still seeking him as an ally ? You play a dangerous game, adding him to your pack, wolf. He is liable to rip out your throat when you least expect it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还在想找他做盟友吗？把他拉进你的狼群，你在玩一场危险的游戏。他很可能会在你最意想不到的时候撕碎你的喉咙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I admit, I do not know as I should be continuing this conversation, if I am honest. You seem drawn to him comme un papillon vers une flamme.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我承认，说实话，我不知道该不该继续这个话题。你似乎被他吸引，就像飞蛾扑火一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though I am surprised you come to me again for my thoughts. You were clear enough with your warning before. You do not wish to hear me speak ill of him and his ilk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过你又来问我的想法我还是挺意外的。上次你已经说得很清楚，你不想再听我诋毁他与那一类人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What does the phrase mean ? If there is an elephant in the room, why would we not speak about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这句话是什么意思 ？如果房间里有大象，我们为什么去不谈论它呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And for a man who could have been manservant to the Queen herself, I take pride in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对于一个本可以成为女王侍从的人来说，我还挺为此感到自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I cannot imagine to most people who do not surround themselves with flying heads and talking animals, that an elephant would not be cause for conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我无法想象，对于身边没有会飞的头和会说话的动物的大多数人来说，大象难道不会成为谈话的话题吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: ... I suspect I have answered my own question, have I not ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ……我怀疑我已经回答了我自己的问题，对吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Understanding to what ends, is my concern. But you do not need me lecturing you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我担心的是，这种理解会导向什么。不过你不需要我的教导。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply urge caution. He could charm Lua to give him the stars from the sky, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只​是​劝​你​谨​慎点。​我​估计，​他​甚至​可以​迷惑月​神，​让​她​把​天上​的​星星​送​给​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Understanding to what ends, is my concern. But you do not need me lecturing you, I am not your mother, nor do I wish to sour this friendship in its early days...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我担心的是，这种理解会导向什么。不过你不需要我的教导，我又不是你的母亲，也不想破坏这段刚开始的友谊……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you assume I would not comprehend ? I am no fool - I have not been reduced to hysterics, transported as I am, transfigured as I have been.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你以为我看不懂吗 ？我并非傻子——我还没有歇斯底里，即使我被带走，即使我被转化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He could charm Lua to give him the stars from the sky, I think. Be careful, is all I will say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​估计，​他​甚至​可以​迷惑月​神，​让​她​把​天上​的​星星​送​给​他。​我只能说，小心点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then you are wise, to not listen his honeyed words. He could charm Lua to give him the stars from the sky, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你真明智，不听他的甜言蜜语。我​估计，​他​甚至​可以​迷惑月​神，​让​她​把​天上​的​星星​送​给​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, the curse of the soldier... Burn the town to save the country. Kill the man to save the family. Where does the horror cease, though ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，这就是士兵的诅咒……烧毁城镇来拯救国家。杀死敌人来拯救家人。然而，恐怖何时才能终结 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Remember who and what he is, at the end of the day... not a god, or even a beast, but a man. A man who thinks too highly of himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请记住，他是谁，是怎样的人，归根结底……他不是神，甚至也不是野兽，而是一个额凡人。一个自视过高的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply worry over you. He is a skillful and manipulative beast...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是担心你。他是个诡计多端、善于操纵人心的野兽……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would declare you a Saint of Sol for even making an attempt at such a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你能尝试这么做，我都可以称你为太阳神的圣徒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I appreciate the apology and I accept it, but consider that I have been both transported and transfigured and find myself surrounded by l'impossible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我感谢也接受你的道歉，但请想想，我被带走，被转化，然后发现自己身处 l'impossible。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And if I may be allowed to guess a second time as to the nature of this éléphant... would he be blue of skin ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果可以的话我再猜一下这头 éléphant 的种类……他的皮肤是蓝色的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But you wished to ask me about the devil himself, did you not ? What would you like to know ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过你不是想问我关于恶魔的事吗 ？你想知道什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We must see war through the eyes of the statistician, for if we viewed it through the eyes of the fallen, we would never cease to weep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们必须从统计学家的眼光来看待战争，因为如果我们通过死者的眼光来看待战争，我们的哭泣将永远不会停止 。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When you believe I cannot comprehend or can hold no sympathy for the stories of others, please reconsider, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当你以为我无法理解或无法同情他人的故事时，请你三思，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Qu'il en soit ainsi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Qu'il en soit ainsi。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I, for my part, shall reconsider telling you your business in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而我，我也会尽量不再对你指手画脚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is it not obvious ? His demeanor is like that of a great big cat who insists on marking his territory and knocking things from shelves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这难道不明显吗 ？他的举止就像一只大猫，坚持要标记自己的领地，还要把架子上的东西推下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When Cardinal Dimanche - Entrati - departed for the last time, he left the devil upon our doorstep. Broken, bleeding, and barely able to even recall his own name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当星期日主教——也就是英择谛——最后一次离开时，他把恶魔留在了我们家门口。他遍体鳞伤，浑身是血，甚至连自己的名字也记不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was storming the night the devil came to us. A terrible thundering that shook the walls of the Cathédrale.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔降临的那天晚上，暴风雨肆虐。一声可怕的雷鸣震彻了 Cathédrale 的墙壁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, and now I do feel the fool. Yes, of course, you would know what it is like to kill in the name of "purpose" as you said... Of course you would seek to understand someone who has done the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，​那​现在​我​还​真像​个​傻子。​是​的，​你​当然​知道，​以​你​所​谓​"使命"​的​名义杀人​是​什么​感觉……​你​自然​会​试图理解​做​过​同样​事情​的​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, and now I do feel the fool. Yes, of course, you would know what it is like to live again and again... Of course you would seek to know someone who has done the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，​那​现在​我​还​真像​个​傻子。​当然，​你​最​清楚​一​遍​又​一​遍​地​活​着​是​什么​滋味……​你​当然​会​想​了解​一​个​有​同样​经历​的​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know now he had only just been given the sérum, and the transformation, if unwilling, is... a painful one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我现在才知道，他当时刚被注射了血清，这种转化，如果不是自愿的话……是非常痛苦的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Let us come to an accord. When you believe I cannot comprehend or can hold no sympathy for the stories of others, please reconsider, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们就这么说定吧。当你以为我无法理解或无法同情他人的故事时，请你三思，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Cats are quite wonderful, when a cat is a cat ! He is a grown man, with many years of life behind him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 猫​很​可爱，​但​只有​当猫​还​是​猫​的​时候 ！​可​他​是​个​男人，​一​个​成年​人，​而且​还​已经​活​了​好​多​年​了​  ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do, when a cat is a cat ! He is a man, a grown man, with many years of life behind him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我喜欢，但只有当猫还是猫的时候！可他是个男人，一个成年人，而且还已经活了好多年了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Le Cardinal looked down upon the devil and spoke, "Uriel, Heretic of Xata, in banishment, answer - can the Orokin ever be forgiven ?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 主教俯视着恶魔，说："Uriel，Xata 的异端者，在放逐中，作出回答吧——奥罗金能否得到宽恕？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was wonderfully cliché, I think, to have such evil arrive in such a maelstrom.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得，如此邪恶的人物在这么巨大的暴风中出场，实在是太老套了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This time, if Lyon tells you of the storm that shook our home, he speaks the reality of it, that we shared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这一次，如果里昂告诉你那场动摇我们家的风暴，他讲述的是真的，那是我们的共同经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Magnifique ! Now, you had wished to ask me about the devil himself, did you not ? What would you like to know ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Magnifique ！现在，你不是想问我关于恶魔的事吗 ？你想知道什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Many more years than any single human being, blue or otherwise transfigured beyond recognition as they would like to be, should have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 比任何一个人，无论是蓝皮肤还是被转化得面目全非的人，都活得更久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And in a clap of thunder, like the gods themselves were summoning him away, le Cardinal was simply gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 随即一声雷鸣，仿佛是众神亲自召唤他，主教便就此消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And we were left with... him. The devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 留下的，只有……他。那恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I suppose I do not know what I am, anymore. Part Marie, part... "Wisp" part... whatever Infested Things now share my veins.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我想我已经不知道自己是什么了。一部分是玛丽，一部分是……"Wisp"……一部分是现在与我血管相连的感染生物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I was looking upon an old portrait of le Cardinal, when he looked more like the devil. He told me of the Orokin ways, how they used to alter themselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我之前在看一幅主教的旧画像，那时的他看起来更像恶魔。他跟我讲了奥罗金人的行事方式，以及他们过去是如何自我改造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Le Cardinal left it to us to... see to his soul, perhaps ? Or at least to mind the chains that bind him. Je préférerais le renvoyer en enfer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 主教把他留给我们……或许是要我们看好他的灵魂 ？或者至少看好他身上的锁链。Je préférerais le renvoyer en enfer。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A conversation for another time, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许下次再聊这个吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How similar yet so foreign to how the ladies of my day would wear ostentatious wigs that could reach for the sky, or dresses that might house an entire orphanage without much effort !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这和我那个时代的贵妇们戴着高耸入云的华丽假发，或者穿着能容纳整个孤儿院的裙子是多么相似，却又如此陌生 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Humans are what humans shall always be - unhappy in their own Sol-given shapes. Eager to work their own flesh like clay. I am no exception, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人类终究是人类——不满足于太阳神赐予他们的模样。渴望像黏土一样塑造自己的肉体。我想我也不例外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do I ? Oui. Yes. I believe all souls are capable of earning forgiveness for their transgressions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得 ？是的。我相信所有犯过错的人都是可以被宽恕的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nothing. Nothing, ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没有。永远也不会有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My issue with him is that he has all the murderous ego of a feline without any of the charming nature of being a small, adorable companion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我受不了他的点是，他具有猫科动物的那种杀气腾腾的自负，却没有任何作为可爱小伙伴所具有的迷人天性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All too happy as I was to take the sérum that made me part Marie, part... "Wisp" and part... whatever Infested Things that now share my veins.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像我当时非常高兴能够注射这种血清，它让我一部分变成了玛丽，一部分变成了……"Wisp"，一部分变成了……现在与我血管相连的感染生物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The question remains... does he even feel he needs such a thing to begin with ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还有一个问题是……他一开始有觉得自己需要宽恕吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He thinks too highly of himself. He takes life without hesitation. He plays with his foes as though they were nothing but a mouse he has cornered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他自视过高。他毫不犹豫地夺去生命。他玩弄敌人，仿佛他们只是被他逼到墙角的老鼠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgiveness cannot be given to those who do not think they are requiring of it. One would be better suited to teach a fish to fly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那些认为自己不需要宽恕的人，是得不到宽恕的。还不如去教鱼怎么飞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know. And the other question remains, does he even feel he needs such a thing as forgiveness to begin with ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道。还有一个问题是，他一开始有觉得自己需要宽恕吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Fie ! Very well. There is one thing we share... a wicked temptation for sweets. The devil was oft wont to return to the Cathédrale having lifted pastries from the shops without properly paying for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呸 ！好吧。我们俩倒是有一样共同点……都对甜食毫无抵抗力。恶魔经常从商店偷走糕点，带回到 Cathédrale。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But speak to him of the topic yourself, if you wish to understand the insurmountable challenge you now face if you seek to win that particular war.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是如果想知道你面临的是什么几乎不可能的挑战，如果想赢过这一把，那就亲自去和他谈谈这个话题吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would explain that this was theft, and he would go on some long-winded lecture about how the Orokin would soon rule the solar system so it was not theft in the grand scheme of things...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我告诉他那是偷窃，然后他就会滔滔不绝地诡辩，说什么奥罗金很快就会统治太阳系所以从宏观上来说这不是偷窃……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I merely wish you luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能祝你好运了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would shout at him, Lyon would be forced to intercede...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后我会吼他，里昂将被迫出面调解……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We could not very well let them go to waste, could we? It was a sin to eat them, but it was a worse sin to let them moulder. So we enjoyed them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们总不能把它们浪费掉吧？吃掉它们是一种罪过，但任由它们腐烂更是罪过。所以我们还是好好享用了它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If that is true, he made a terrible showing of it in the process. But... you may be right. Regardless, we could not let them go to waste. It was a sin to eat them, but a worse sin to let them moulder. So, we enjoyed them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果真是这样，那他这个方式也太糟透了。不过……你或许是对的。不管怎样，我们不能浪费它们。吃掉它们是一种罪过，但任由它们腐烂更是罪过。所以我们还是好好享用了它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hm. Perhaps it was a bit of a habit of his, now that I think on it, to bring back more than he could consume alone...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯。现在想想，也许他确实有这个习惯，带回来的食物比他自己能吃的份量还要多……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will think on this. Until tomorrow. À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会好好想想这件事。明天见。À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go. But, merci. I have much to think on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。但是 merci。我有很多事情需要好好想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: As do I. But I think there are many specifics yet to learn that make this difficult, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也是。但我认为还有很多具体细节需要了解，这使这件事变得困难，oui ?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: As do I, but I think there are many things that make this difficult, oui? Sadly, I think there has been enough of stories for one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也是，但我认为有很多因素让这件事变得困难，oui ？遗憾的是，我觉得今天的故事已经讲得够多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We will speak more of the Entrati family again very soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 关于英择谛家族的那些事，我们很快还会再谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I come with a question regarding Monsieur "Necraloid" again, if I may?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可以再向你问一个有关"殁世械灵"先生的问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking of what you told me regarding le Cardinal's family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在思考你告诉我的有关主教家族的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking of what you told me regarding Monsieur Otak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在思考你告诉我的有关奥塔先生的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was wondering, would you tell me the story of Otak, the childlike face upon the back of Necraloid's skull?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在想，你能告诉我奥塔的故事吗 ？那张殁世械灵头骨后面的孩子般的脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was wondering perhaps if it is similar to a story of mine own. Might I tell it to you, if you have the time ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想知道这是否与我自己的故事相似。如果你有时间，我可以讲给你听吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I find myself curious as to why there is another face upon his back that resembles a child's scrawl.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我好奇他后面为何还刻着另一张脸，那模样活像小朋友的涂鸦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I inquired with Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid both, and neither wished to speak of it, they only told me a name. Otak. And it was with great sadness that they uttered it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我分别询问了殁世械灵先生和洛德先生，但两人都避而不谈此事，只告诉我一个名字：奥塔。他们说出这个名字时，语气中带着深深的悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There was a Sister at the Cathédrale, who once lost herself in the hallways of her past. Sister Cécilia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Cathédrale 里有一位修女，她曾经迷失在她过去的回忆中。她就是塞西莉亚修女。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So here I am, speaking with you, in hopes you might be able to aid me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以我在这里和你交谈，希望你能帮助我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: She used to stand before the great clock in the hall and proclaim that it was two in the afternoon, but she did not know what time it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她常常站在大厅里的大钟前，宣称现在是下午两点，但其实并她不知道具体时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We would find all the paintings in the hallways turned about the wrong way, and she would say they were whispering to her of terrible plots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们往往会发现走廊里的所有画都摆错了方向，她说它们在向她低声讲述可怕的阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe I wish to know both, in time, but I will let you decide where to begin. I do not know which is more important, après tout.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我终究都会去了解这两者，但开始从哪里由你决定。après tout，我也不知道哪一个更重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We learned she was simply hearing conversations in other rooms, and thinking it was the paintings that were speaking...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 后来我们了解到她只是听到了其他房间里的谈话，并以为是画作在说话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Once, she mistook all the cushions of a lounge for children, and hosted them all for tea...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有一次，她甚至把休息室里的所有垫子都当成了孩子，并招待它们喝茶……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par les Luminaires... You mean that we are all down here in secret ?! Is that why we are not allowed to leave this place ?! Mais pourquoi ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par les Luminaires……你是说我们都在这里秘密活动？！所以才不让我们离开这里？！Mais pourquoi？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par les Luminaires... please, go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par les Luminaires……请继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When I came into the room, she looked up at me and said, "Oh, Sister Odette, there you are! The children from the orphanage are here, will you join me?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当我走进房间时，她抬头看着我说道："哦，奥黛特修女，你来了 ！孤儿院的孩子们来了，你要一起吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pauvre petit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pauvre petit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I rolled my chair up to an empty spot at the table and had tea with her and the cushions, what else could I do ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还能怎么办 ？我把椅子移到桌子旁边的一个空位上，和她和垫子一起喝茶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sister Odette had been dead for thirty years, I am afraid to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕奥黛特修女已经去世三十年了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How we laughed together, as she told me stories from her past. Stories Sister Cécilia had never told anyone before, at least that I am aware.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当她给我讲她过去的故事时，我们一起笑得很开心。塞西莉亚修女从未告诉过任何人这些故事，至少据我所知没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I rolled my chair up to an empty spot at the table and had tea with her and the cushions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我把椅子移到桌子旁边的一个空位上，和她和垫子一起喝茶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Her eyes were bright in moments but dull in others, like a child's doll...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她的眼睛有时明亮，有时暗淡，就像孩子的洋娃娃……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What happens to all in her condition. She continued to fade, like a painting in the sun, until nothing was left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在她当时的状态下会发生什么呢？她会像阳光下的一幅画，日渐褪色，直至消失殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: While I can see the logic behind the decision to protect them from the pain le Cardinal has caused by his necessary departure...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我能理解那个决定背后的逻辑，就是为了保护他们免受主教必须离开而造成的痛苦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A wise question. A very wise question. I think many reasons inspired me. I would like to think it kindness that sent me to her table.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这个问题问得真明智。非常明智。我想有很多原因促使我这么做。我想是善意让我与她同坐一桌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then she left us, and we held a candlelit vigil for her. I would hope she could remember, in the end, those who were truly kind to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 之后她离开了我们，我们为她举行了烛光守夜。我希望她最终能记住那些真心待她的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would like to believe that she understood, somewhere beneath the surface.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信在她的内心深处她是知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Was it kindness, though ? Or was it guilt that inspired me to do it ? Ah, but you are only being kind yourself, by saying so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是出于善意吗 ？还是因为愧疚才这么做的 ？啊，不过你这么说，也只是出于善意罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do think it needlessly cruel, don't you ? They might think him dead. Or worse ! And we, living here, comme des rats d'égout ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我确实觉得这太残忍了，你不觉得吗？他们可能会以为他死了。或者更糟 ！而我们，住在这里，comme des rats d'égout ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui... I see the logic. I would work to mend their family, if you can, then, non ? It seems to be the only hope any of us have to get out of this place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui……我明白其中的逻辑。如果可以的话，我也会努力修复他们的家庭，non ？这似乎是我们所有人离开这里的唯一希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think it was guilt, perhaps, deep down. That if I did not, I would be neglecting her. Like one might neglect a child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我想，或许是内心深处的愧疚。如果我不这么做，我就忽视了她。就像忽视一个孩子一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would like to believe that your Otak knows those who are kind and patient with him. But, then again, he is not really there, is he ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我更愿意相信你们的奥塔知道谁对他友善又耐心。可是，话说回来，其实他并不在那里，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lest we spend the rest of our lives trapped living here, comme des rats d'égout.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 以免我们余生都被困在这里，comme des rats d'égout。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am speaking of a very elaborate piece of technology made to resemble a man, am I not ? A phonographe, many many times more complex. Like Necraloid, he has no soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我说的是一件非常精巧的仿人科技装置，对吧 ？一台精妙复杂很多倍的留声机。就像殁世械灵一样，他没有灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know. It is Monsieur Loid's, and everyone else's decision, to make themselves known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道。是否让自己被世人知道，是洛德先生，以及所有人的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would suggest that it is a sense of guilt, not nobility, that keeps us down here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为，将我们困守于此的并非崇高情操，而是负罪感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也很想哪天见一下那位朋友，但这不是我要说的重点，傻狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That we hide some great and terrible sin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们是在躲避某种重大而可怕的罪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you. I do not know if you will succeed, but sometimes, we can only help but to try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢。我不知道你是否会成功，但有时候，我们能做的只有去尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也很想哪天见一下那位朋友，但这不是我要说的重点，傻狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, do not think I mean for you to be cruel ! Non ! Treasure them, for they are precious, and through no fault of their own are they as they are !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，千万别以为我让你残忍 ！Non ！要珍惜他们，因为他们很宝贵，他们变成现在这个样子并非他们的错！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it is that sin that must be forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而正是那份罪需要被宽恕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: More proof that the devil and his ilk were right to be condemned. But, perhaps you are right about Otak and his kind, or perhaps it brings you peace to believe so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这进一步证明对恶魔及其同类的谴责是正确的。不过，或许你对奥塔及其同类的看法也是正确的，又或许相信这一点能给你带来内心的平安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My heart breaks only for the broken bodies the Orokin devils left behind. They were not gods, but devourers of all in their wake. Look only at the one we travel with for proof.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 让我心痛的，是那些被奥罗金恶魔留下的残骸。他们不是神，而是吞噬一切的凶手。看看与我们同行的那一位就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you are right, but I do not think the Orokin devils knew more of the workings of the soul than we. They were no great gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你是对的，但我不认为那些奥罗金恶魔比我们更了解灵魂的事情。他们并不是什么伟大的神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you are right, or perhaps it brings you peace to believe so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你是对的，也许相信这一点，能让你感到平安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you, you have given me much to think on. À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢你，你给了我很多思考。À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Either way, I choose to believe that the Otak who died long ago would smile upon you now, should you be kind to whatever lives on in his memory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论如何，我更愿相信，那个早已去世的奥塔，如果你能善待承载了他生命的殁世械灵先生，那么他也会微笑吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is simply hard for me to say Necraloid has a soul when Loid is standing right beside him, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 只是当洛德就站在殁世械灵旁边时，我很难说殁世械灵真的有灵魂，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Technology, perhaps - science, yes - but the soul ? They hardly could master their own hearts ! Look to the devil we travel with if you need more proof of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 科技，也许是——科学，是——但灵魂 ？他们连自己的内心都无法掌控 ！如果你还需要更多证据，看看那个与我们同行的恶魔就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply hope I get to meet whatever strange fac-similé lives on when Monsieur Necraloid wanders upstairs again, someday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是希望，有一天，当殁世械灵先生再次上楼时，我能见到那个奇怪的 fac-similé。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We shall see, I want to learn more of the specifics from you as to why we must remain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们拭目以待吧，我想从你那里了解更多有关我们为何必须留下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There is a story I think you are not telling me. But I think there has been enough of stories for one day, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我总觉得你还有故事没告诉我。不过我觉得今天的故事已经讲得够多了，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We will speak more of the Entrati family again very soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 关于英择谛家族的那些事，我们很快还会再谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tell me, wolf, of this one called "Wisp" whose corrupted blood flows within me and who has given me this gift of flight and freedom.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 告诉我吧，狼，这个叫"Wisp"的人是谁，她的腐化血液在我体内流淌，却赐予了我飞翔和自由的恩赐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tell me, wolf, of this one called "Wisp" whose corrupted blood flows within me, who has given me this gift of flight, and whose soul I feel in the shadow of the night so closely next to mine own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 告诉我，狼，这个叫"Wisp"的人是谁，她的腐化血液在我体内流淌，却赐予了我飞翔和自由的恩赐。在夜幕中，我能感觉到她的灵魂与我的灵魂是如此接近。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tell me, wolf, of this one called "Wisp" whose corrupted blood flows within me, who has given me this gift of flight, and whose soul I feel in the shadow of the night so closely next to mine own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 告诉我，狼，这个叫"Wisp"的人是谁，她的腐化血液在我体内流淌，却赐予了我飞翔和自由的恩赐。在夜幕中，我能感觉到她的灵魂与我的灵魂是如此接近。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vraiment ? Are the records lost over time, or do you suspect they were simply deemed not important enough to remember ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vraiment ？这些记录是随着时间的流逝而丢失的吗？还是你怀疑他们只是被认为不够重要，不值得记住？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If the discussion of souls does not trouble you ? I understand if it shall, and we can curtail it to more practical things, I do not wish to make you uncomfortable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 希望关于灵魂的探讨不会让你感到困扰 ？如果确实会困扰你，我理解的。我们可以讨论一些更实际的事情，我不想让你感到不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vraiment ? For I feel as though I know her as if she were my own sister - and one of my own blood, not one of the Cathédrale.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vraiment ？可我却感觉我认识她，就像她是我的亲姐妹一样——她就像是我的血亲，而不是 Cathédrale 里的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You see ? Ces Orokin, they are devils.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你看到了吗 ？ Ces奥罗金，他们是恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not hear her, not the way Lyon hears the gods and his patron spirits. I do not see her. I simply feel her there, beside me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我听不到她的声音，不像里昂听到众神和守护灵的声音那样。我也看不到她。我只是能感觉她就在这里，在我身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Une horrible toile d'os peinte avec du sang... you see ? Ces Orokin, they are devils.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Une horrible toile d'os peinte avec du sang……你看到了吗 ？ Ces奥罗金，他们是恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like an old friend, perhaps. I know what she liked, I know how she moved. I remember the sound of her laughter on the wind...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许，就像一位老朋友吧。我知道她喜欢什么，我知道她如何行动。我还记得她笑声在风中飘荡……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, bien sûr ! No one wishes to be lectured, least of all by a Sister. I understand. Merci, I would not have wanted to make a fool of myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，bien sû ！没人喜欢被说教，尤其是被修女说教。我理解。Merci，我不想让自己出丑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must sound quite mad to you ! Forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你一定觉得我疯了吧？抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, that is true. I am a weapon now, as the Murmure well know ! But I seek to follow the path le Cardinal put me upon, blessed as it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，确实如此。我现在成了一件武器，这一点 Murmure 知道 ！但我仍想追随主教为我安排的道路，这是一条蒙福的路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like le Cardinal. He was Orokin, non ? And he certainly is not one I would condemn. Without him, I would not be as I am now. Blessed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就​像​主教。​他​是​奥罗金​ 人，​不​是​吗 ？​而且​我​绝​对​不​会​谴责​他。​没有​他，​就​没有​我​今天​这个​蒙福​的​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have only been told of the Infestation, I know little of it... but I believe you. And if what I feel is the truth, and I pray that it is, I do not think she is trapped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只听说过感染者，对此知之甚少……但我相信你。如果我的感觉是真的，而且我也祈祷它是真的，我不认为她被困住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is quite sweet of you to say. If what I feel is the truth, and I pray that it is, then oui, I think you are right. I do not think she is trapped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你这么说真是太贴心了。如果我的感觉是真的，而且我也祈祷它是真的，那么 oui，你说得对。他们留下来是为了帮助我们。我不认为她被困住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If what I feel is the truth, and I pray that it is, then non, I do not think she is trapped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果我的感觉是真的，而且我也祈祷它是真的，那么 non，我不认为她被困住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If what I feel is the truth, and I pray that it is, then oui, you are right. And they stay to help us. I do not think she is trapped.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果我的感觉是真的，而且我也祈祷它是真的，那么 oui，你说得对。他们留下来是为了帮助我们。我不认为她被困住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I have been blessed by le Cardinal... but I know I am near to singular in my love for him, for it is not sullied by sorrow, hatred, or resentment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我蒙受了主教的祝福……但我知道或许我是唯一爱他的人，因为我的爱没有被悲伤、仇恨或怨恨所玷污。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I thought you believed in him ? Why the sudden change in heart ? Are you so fickle ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我以为你相信他 ？怎么突然改变想法了 ？你这么善变吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why do you distrust him so ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你为什么这么不信任他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you think him to be some kind of terrible monster. But I must ask, what made you distrust him so ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你觉得他是个可怕的怪物。但我必须问，是什么原因让你如此不信任他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and so quickly you change your mind ? You lie. To what ends, I do not know. Et je ne veux pas le savoir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，你这就改口了吗 ？你在撒谎。我不知道你撒谎的目的是什么。 Et je ne veux pas le savoir。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: In my faith, we know of those who walk the roads of life, and find themselves at the crossroads where Lua and Sol meet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信，我们知道那些走在人生道路上的人，终会发现自己处在月神和太阳神相遇的十字路口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For those of us who follow the path of Sol, we must always be the guiding light to those who seek to walk from the crossroads, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对于我们这些追随太阳神之道的人来说，我们必须成为引路的光，永远照亮那些在十字路口迷失的人，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are a follower of the Luminaries, you should know that we teach that some walk the unknown roads alone, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是双耀神的追随者，你应该知道我们教导有些人独自走在未知的道路上，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are a follower of Lua, you should know we teach that some must walk in shadows alone, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你是月神的追随者，你应该知道我们教导有些人必须独自在阴影中行走，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: From her, I only feel the warmth of Sol's smile upon me. Le Cardinal was wise, I think, in his choice. I am honored to carry her in my veins.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 从她那里，我只感受到太阳神笑容的温暖。我想，主教的选择是明智的。我很荣幸能将她融入我的血液。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I forgive him for leaving us. I do not think anyone else does...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我原谅他离开我们。我想没人能做到这一点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, we must stay strong ! Braves contre les ténèbres, pour toujours et à jamais !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我们一定要坚强 ！Braves contre les ténèbres，pour toujours et à jamais ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, je vois ! Je suis une idiote, c'est ça ?! Juste une petite invalide venue d'un passé lointain, incapable de penser par elle-même ?! Mieux vaut l'approcher comme un faon dans les bois, de peur de l'effrayer !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，je vois ！Je suis une idiote, c'est ça ？！Juste une petite invalide venue d'un passé lointain, incapable de penser par elle-même ？！Mieux vaut l'approcher comme un faon dans les bois, de peur de l'effrayer ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, oui... I have not made it easy for you to speak the truth, n'est-ce pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，oui……是我让你难以说出实话了，n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sol ! This world that you made, summoned from the book his daughter wrote, oui ? Monsieur Loid spoke of it... Le Cardinal was there ? Why ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 太阳神​啊​ ！​是​那个​你​创造​的、​从​他​女儿写​的​书中​召唤​而​来​的​世界，​ou​i ？​洛德​先生​提到​过……​主教​居然​在​那 ？​为什么​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Et pourtant, vous êtes toujours en vie ! You are alive, are you not ? And well? And thriving, if Monsieur Loid's tales of your adventures in the past-future are to be believed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Et pourtant，vous êtes toujours en vie ？你不是还活着吗？而且活得还好的？活得很幸福，如果洛德先生对你过去的未来冒险经历的讲述是可信的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have forgiven him for leaving us. I do not think anyone else does...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我已经原谅他离开我们。我想没人能做到这一点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Le Cardinal must find his way back to us. We can only do what we can to help him when he calls, and do as we are bid by those who are blessed as he.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 主教​一定​会​找到​回到​我们​身边​的​路。​我们​只​能​在​他​召唤​我们​的​时候​尽力​帮助​他，​并​按照​那些​像​他​一样​蒙福​的​人​的​吩咐​去行。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Va t'asseoir sur une ruche.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Va t'asseoir sur une ruche。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tell me the truth now then, wolf. Why do you believe he is not to be trusted? And I shall aspire to keep my temper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那现在就告诉我实话吧，狼。你为什么认为他不值得信任 ？我会尽量控制自己的脾气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, you are correct. I think guilt haunts him for all he has done. I think he distances himself from others very much intentionally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你说得对。我觉得他做的一切都让他愧疚不已。我觉得他是故意疏远别人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, it is a terrible grief, an awful pain. To know that someone is... still alive, and seemingly chooses not to be beside you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，这真是令人悲伤心痛不已。知道有人……还活着，却似乎选择不在你身边 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur se brise dans la tragédie - I do not think I can take the sadness of that... and still, she will not forgive him ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mon cœur se brise dans la tragédie——我认为我无法承受那种悲伤……她还是没有原谅他吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you know why he left ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你知道他为什么离开吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What do you mean ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这是什么意思 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, le Cardinal has done far worse to many others, you are simply upset for being inconvenienced.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，主教对其他人所做的要糟糕得多，你只是因为给自己带来了不便而感到不安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed if the rumors amongst the Cavia are true, vous y avez vraiment trouvé beaucoup de joie, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 事实上，如果科维兽中的传言属实，vous y avez vraiment trouvé beaucoup de joie，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Il inflige la douleur dans le cœur des autres, car la douleur vaut mieux que rien du tout. For suffering is better than emptiness, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Il inflige la douleur dans le cœur des autres, car la douleur vaut mieux que rien du tout。因为痛苦总比空虚好，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then we might continue to agree to disagree, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那或许我们就先各有各的想法吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I pray in the end that we do. I pray that in the end we all survive to see it. But for now, I see the famille around me, and pray they find forgiveness in their hearts. For their own happiness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我祈祷终有一日我们都能理解。也祈祷最终我们都能活下来见证这一切。但现在，我看着身边的家人，祈求他们能在心中寻得宽恕。为了他们自己的幸福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is a lesson that my dearest Lyon knows more than most... I am so glad he is speaking to you now. But we speak of le Cardinal this day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这是我最亲爱的里昂收到的最深刻教训……我很高兴他现在和你说话。不过，今天我们谈论的是主教。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you do not know why he left you there ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你知道他为什么把你留在那里吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non. Wait. L'Indifférence has... an ally ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non。等一下。 L'Indifférence 有……盟友 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, c'est raisonnable, and quite fair, given all you have seen and know. I cannot ask more than that of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，c'est raisonnable，而且很公平，考虑到你所见所闻。我不能再奢求你更多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I must ask of you not to assume from him the worst, for it shall turn your heart bitter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我必须恳请你不要先以最坏的角度揣测他，因为这会让你的心变得苦毒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, Lyon is calling me. À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，里昂在叫我。À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you did not yet wish to abandon Duviri. Perhaps it had not yet turned sour for you. Perhaps you were not willing to leave your friends ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你还不想抛弃双衍王境。也许当时事情对你来说还没有变糟。也许你还舍不得离开你的朋友们 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Can you say that there is no possible way, in any realm, that you could see a reason for why he might have left you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能说，无论从哪个角度看，你都找不到他离开你的理由吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ooh, what a thought. That is a cause worth championing, I think !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，好主意。我觉得这是一件值得支持的事情 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps he did not know if he could take you from it, for fear of collapsing it in a fragile state. Perhaps he thought l'Indifférence would claim it if you were gone. Peut-être, peut-être, peut-être.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许他也不知道能否带你离开那世界，担心它会因此而崩溃。也许他以为，如果你走了，l'Indifférence 就会收回它。Peut-être，Peut-être，Peut-être。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci - this is what I hold dear. That we must not assume the worst, for it turns our hearts the most bitter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，Merci——这正是我所珍视的信念。我们不能往坏处想，因为那只会让我们的心变得苦毒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know what to think of this... but it is quite curious...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道该怎么看待这件事……但这确实听起来很奇怪……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you did not yet wish to abandon Duviri. Perhaps it had not yet turned sour for you. Perhaps you were not willing to leave your friends ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你还不想抛弃双衍王境。也许当时事情对你来说还没有变糟。也许你还舍不得离开你的朋友们 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hmm... now you have me scheming ! First, though - you must continue your work with his famille upstairs. You or the minuscule copie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯……现在你让我开始想计划点什么了 ！不过，首先——你得继续去跟他楼上的家人共事。要么你去，要么那个小小的复制品去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You and the minuscule copie did so well with his famille already... Hmm, now you have me scheming !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你和那个小小的复制品已经和他的家人相处得很好了……嗯，现在你让我开始想计划点什么了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps he did not know if he could take you from it, for fear of collapsing it in a fragile state. Perhaps he thought l'Indifférence would claim it if you were gone. Peut-être, peut-être, peut-être.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许他也不知道能否带你离开那世界，担心它会因此而崩溃。也许他以为，如果你走了，l'Indifférence 就会收回它。Peut-être，Peut-être，Peut-être。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope you do not think me infirme... but I get the strangest sensation sometimes as though I have done this before ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 希望你不会觉得我问这个问题很无礼，但我真的很好奇。你有信仰吗 ？比如信奉双耀神还是其他什么宗教 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Had these conversations... met these people... though it is impossible, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 曾有过这些对话……见过这些人……可这明明是不可能的，对吧 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We call it déjà vu. Must be because of the sérum and the time travel. C'est la vie !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们称之为 déjà vu。一定是血清和时间旅行的缘故。C'est la vie ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are going to ruin me ! I just squeaked audibly and Monsieur Loid asked if I was all right. I had to lie and say that I saw a mouse, only for him to tell me that we have no mice in this time !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你真是要害惨我了 ！我忍不住尖叫了一声，洛德先生问我有没有事。我只好撒谎说我看到了老鼠，结果他告诉我，这个时代根本没有老鼠 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Quelle méchanceté, tu es terrible ! Je te déteste et tu me fais rougir maintenant !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Quelle méchanceté，tu es terrible ！Je te déteste et tu me fais rougir maintenant ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non ! Just continue your story !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non ！继续说你的故事 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will you tell me more of le Cardinal's famille ? I am fascinated to know of his past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能告诉我更多关于主教家族的事吗 ？我很想知道他的过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will you tell me of le Cardinal's famille ? I am fascinated to know of his past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能告诉我关于主教家族的事吗 ？我很想知道他的过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Whatever you can tell me, I shall cherish. Promis !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论你告诉我什么，我都会珍惜。Promis ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Speaking of le Cardinal... seems to hurt Monsieur Loid quite deeply. I do not like to do so overmuch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 提起主教……对洛德先生来说似乎是件很痛苦的事。我不太想老提这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Especially as I do it avec une certaine joie, which no one else seems to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 尤其是当我谈起这些事时，是带着愉悦的，而其他人似乎没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Settle one thing first, will you ? The devil laughs at me every time I ask, as if it is a private joke. Grand-mère. Grandmother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 先一个一个来，好吗 ？每次我这么问，恶魔都会笑我，就好像这是个他自己的梗。Grand-mère。"祖母"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is not le Cardinal's wife, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 她并不是主教的妻子，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je... vois. And... why do they not go by their names ? Ne serait-ce pas plus simple ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je……vois。还有……为什么他们不用自己的名字呢 ？Ne serait-ce pas plus simple ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! I have nowhere else to be for a little while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！反正我暂时也没别的地方可去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par Sol ! On purpose ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par 太阳神 ！是故意的吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The ones the Orokin were at war with, long ago ? The ones we see in the Dark Refractory with the devil, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就是当年奥罗金与之交战的那些敌人 ？是我们在深溯池看到的与恶魔交战那些敌人，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For shame. I hope that is not true, for his sake and ours. Please continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真可耻。为了他，也为了我们，我希望这不是真的。请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, Sol... did he mean well ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，太阳神……他是出于好意吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Quite kind of you. Continuez, s'il vous plaît.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你真是太好了。Continuez，s'il vous plaît。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is the ultimate form of cruelty, to be absent of a name...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没有名字，这是最残酷的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For shame. I hope that is not true, for his sake and ours. Please continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真可耻。为了他，也为了我们，我希望这不是真的。请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder what he would make of the Cavia... such a pity he cannot meet them...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道他会怎么看科维兽……可惜他不能见到它们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If only the purity of one's intentions were all that mattered, the world would be a beautiful place, non ? C'est la vie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果一个人的动机纯粹就能决定一切，那么世界将会是一个美丽的地方，non ？C'est la vie。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Et ensuite ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Et ensuite ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And why not ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Aaah ! Quelle horreur ! I did not mean ! Oh, I am mortified ! I am so sorry, forgive me, I did not mean - oh, I am a fool !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊啊 ！Quelle horreur ！我不是故意的 ！哦，实在是太丢脸了 ！对不起，请原谅我，我不是故意的——哦，我是个傻瓜 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now she sounds like a lady I would adore to meet...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在她听起来像是一位我会很想见到的女士……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is quite true ! I never thought of it that way. And you could choose your own. How freeing, in its own sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 确实如此 ！我从来没这么想过。而能够选择属于自己的名字。也是一种自由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You would be surprised how resilient the soul is. And those that surround me now are so very old, so very tempered by time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 灵魂的韧性会让人惊叹。而如今我身边的存在，都如此古老，如此饱经时间的磨砺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It can be done. Easier, perhaps than you think. We must just think of how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这是可以做到的。或许比你想象的还要简单。我们只需要想想怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? And how goes you or your minuscule copie's work with the famille above ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？你和你那个小小的复制品还有上面的家族情况怎么样了 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This has been such a wonderful conversation, but I fear it is my turn to serve luncheon. Monsieur Loid is teaching me how to properly serve tea in his fashion !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这次谈话真是精彩，不过恐怕轮到我准备午餐了。洛德​先生​正​在​教​我​如何​像​他​那样​端​茶 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Maintenant, vous parlez aussi mal que le diable. No, I will not fall for your tricks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Maintenant，vous parlez aussi mal que le diable。不，我不会中你的诡计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, loué soit Sol ! But it does raise the question... Do you know where you received your moniker ? "Le Drifter ?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，太阳神，loué soi ！不过，这倒是引出了一个问题……你知道你的绰号是怎么来的吗？"漂泊者" ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh... Par Sol, I think you may have solved it !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦……太阳神啊，我想你可能已经解决了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have surprised them many times. Let them surprise you this once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你已经让他们惊喜过很多次了。就让他们给你一次惊喜吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But please, please, s'il vous plaît, continue your story. Your little wolf Marie must know her quarry before she properly hunts, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过，拜托，s'il vous plaît，请你继续你的故事。你的小狼玛丽在正式狩猎之前，肯定得先了解她的猎物，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How freeing would that be ! To pick one's own name. In the Cathédrale, I could not even pick my own clothes. Hah !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那该有多自由啊 ！可以自己选名字。在 Cathédrale 里，我连自己的衣服都不能选。哈哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So many mystères, you bring with you !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你的身上充满了 mystères ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am beside myself with excitement - je suis assise ici, remuant sur ma chaise !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很兴奋——je suis assise ici，remuant sur ma chaise ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Son had invited the Animaux Infestés too close.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "儿子"把 Animaux Infestés 请得太近了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Peut-être ! But where is the harm in a little wickedness in the name of good, hm ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Peut-être ！但是以善的名义做一点坏事又有什么害处呢，嗯 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah ! I thought you might. Now, enough with your silliness, and back to your story. Son had invited the Animaux Infestés too close, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！我就知道你喜欢。好了，别再胡闹了，回到你的故事。"儿子"把 Animaux Infestés 引得太近了，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, Sol ! Non ! He is like a brother to me in all ways except by blood. I find myself complètement dégoûtée by the very notion !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，天 ！Non ！他就像我的亲兄弟一样，只是我们没有血缘关系。光是想到这一点，我就 complètement dégoûtée by the very notion ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. Simply "curious." You do not fool me. I must warn you that I will not abandon him. I have known Lyon much longer than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。只是"好奇"而已。别想骗我。我必须警告你，我不会抛弃他。我认识里昂的时间比你长得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would be nowhere without him. Save, perhaps, the bottom of a hill. Hah !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没有他，我真不知道该怎么办。或许，除了躲到山脚下之外，什么都做不了。哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Still, you intrigue me, wolf. I am finding myself happier and happier to be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过，狼，你还是让我很感兴趣。我发现自己越来越喜欢待在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, you have made your intentions known. I must warn you that I will not abandon him. I have known Lyon much longer than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你已经表明了你的意图。我必须警告你，我不会抛弃他。我认识里昂的时间比你长得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? And which one of us do you... hunt ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？那你打算狩猎我们中的哪一个呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Par Sol. You catch me by surprise, I must admit. And now I am sitting here blushing, hiding my face from Monsieur Loid...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦！太阳神啊。说实话，你真是让我措手不及。现在我正脸红着坐在这里，躲着洛德先生……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must warn you that I will not abandon him. I have known Lyon much longer than you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我必须警告你，我不会抛弃他。我认识里昂的时间比你长得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vraiment ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vraiment ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You do not know how happy this makes me, but please, think on what you say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你不知道这让我有多高兴，但请你三思而后行。
