/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon is my brother. I love him more than you can possibly know, but he is a troubled man. Consider your words carefully before you pursue him, n'est-ce pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂是我的兄弟。我爱他胜过你所能想象，但他是个饱受折磨的人。在你追他之前，请务必三思，n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We will speak on this again soon, I think. Do not take me wrong, I am encouraging you ! I simply want you to think it through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我们很快还会再谈这件事。别误会，我是在鼓励你 ！我只是希望你好好想想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lonely, I suppose, is the truth of it. I had Lyon, but you know what he can be like sometimes. (Oh ! I am so pleased you and he are speaking, now !)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，那时候其实真的很孤独。虽然里昂在，但你知道他有时候是什么样的。（哦 ！我很高兴你和他现在说上话了 ！）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, I do not know as it would interest you terribly much, but I will tell you anyway if you are so curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，没想到这会让你那么感兴趣，但如果你很好奇，我还是会告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would have thought the language gave it away, but then I remember that you are not from my world as I would know it, hah !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我本来以为我说的话已经透露了我的所在，但随即我想起你并不来自我所知道的世界，哈哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I spent it going about my duties as a Sister of Sol. Polishing the communionware, setting out votives for the parishioners.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​把​时间​都​用​来​履行​我​作为​太阳神​修女​的​职责​了，​擦​干​净圣餐器皿，​为​教友​准备​奉​献物。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am from la Cité de la Lumière, the capital city of a country called Gaule. In the grand scheme of the world, it is not too far from Höllvania on a map.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我来自光城，是高卢国的首都。从世界地图上看，它离霍瓦尼亚并不远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But that is not why I spend so much time talking to the dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但这并不是我花这么多时间与死者交谈的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tending to the crypte and the burying ground. That was my favorite task.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 照料墓穴和墓地。那是我最喜欢的工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder if my Cathédrale still stands in 1999 ? What an interesting thought !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想知道我的 Cathédrale 在 1999 年是否还在？真是个有趣的想法 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There is a beauty in those places, a tranquillité. They are so quiet. Peaceful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那些地方有一种美，一种 tranquillité。那里如此安静，如此平和。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I enjoyed speaking to those who lay in rest very much. They would listen to my concerns without a word of judgement in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很喜欢和那些已经安息的人交谈。他们会倾听我的担忧，并且不会对我评头论足。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was my duty to tend to the dead of the Cathédrale. I would sweep the dust from the floor of the crypte, weed the grass of the yard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的职责是照顾 Cathédrale 里的死者。我会清扫墓穴地板上的灰尘，除去院子里的杂草。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think I like to tell them of my troubles et les activités des autres because their worries are over, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想我喜欢告诉他们我的烦恼和 et les activités des autres，因为他们的烦恼已经结束了，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well, they had not a single word in return, mais cela me convenait tout à fait ! I would very much rather they stayed silent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧，其实他们一句话也没回应，mais cela me convenait tout à fait ！我宁愿他们保持沉默。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have noticed, oui ? Lyon teases me all the time that I am a dust mote in the sun beam, drifting along wherever breeze takes me. (I am so pleased you and he are speaking now !)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 被你发现了，oui ？里昂总是笑我，说我是阳光下的一粒微尘，随风飘荡。（我真高兴你和他现在能说上话了 ！）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, do not bother them, it is simply a silly notion. I do not know how sad I would be to think it gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，还是别打扰他们了，这只是个愚蠢的想法。一想到它消失了，我真不知道自己会有多难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Everything must seem small to them now, and that is comforting to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在对他们来说一切都是小事，这让我感到安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply am curious, non ? I want to know tout ce qui existe - all that there is - to know. I think that is why le Cardinal and I were destined to meet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是好奇，non ？我想知道 tout ce qui existe——世间的一切。我想这就是我和主教命中注定相遇的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Can you imagine ? Talking skulls, much like your necraloid ? Ha !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想象一下 ？会说话的骷髅，就像你的殁世械灵一样 ？哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Où en étais-je ? Ah ! Oui. My story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Où en étais-je ？啊 ！Oui。继续我的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know, little morbide Marie ! So strange. But to each their own, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我明白，morbide 玛丽 ！真奇怪。不过每个人都有自己的想法，不是吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are not alone. We do not like to spend much of our time, thinking about what comes after. Not until we are close to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不只有你是这样。我们都不喜欢花太多时间去思考接下来会发生什么。除非我们快要接近死亡了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am so glad you understand !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很高兴你能理解 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was born into a rich famille, which might surprise you. The bourgeois class, who are closer to the Orokin than not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我出生在一个富裕的家庭，这可能会让你感到意外。资产阶级，离奥罗金挺近的那种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Someone must look after them. And I am more than happy to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 总得有人照顾他们。而我很乐意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon jokes that I am closer to the ground, which is why I think of the grave so much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 里昂总开玩笑说我太贴近地面，所以才老想着坟墓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, it was not. But Lyon helped me up and down the stairs into the crypte when it was time, and the rest I could manage with time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，确实不是。不过，里昂会在特定时间帮我过墓穴的楼梯，剩下的事我可以自己慢慢处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But when I was born as I was... deformed, with mes pieds tordus et inutilisables ? Oh, ma mère could not have that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然而我一出生就是个……畸形的孩子，mes pieds tordus et inutilisables ？哦，ma mère 无法接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I ask him if his head is empty, which is why it is so full of ghosts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我就问他，是不是脑袋里空空的，所以才被一堆鬼魂塞满。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is impressive what one can do with stubbornness, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一个人凭借固执能做到的事，是很不得了的，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I had Lyon, of course. But you can see how well that goes, some days.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然，我有里昂。不过你也知道，他的情况有时候会发展成什么样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There were appearances to be maintained, oui ? Standards to be kept.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 毕竟要维护家族的体面与规矩，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then he would threaten to push me down a hill, and I will threaten to fill his cassock with nettles.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后他会威胁要把我推下山，而我会威胁要用荨麻塞满他的哥萨克服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well. Stubbornness and upper body strength, ha !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好吧。是固执和上肢力量，哈哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So, what was to be done, with poor malformed Marie ? I was brought to la Cité de la Lumière, where certainly I would perish upon the streets...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么，那个可怜的畸形玛丽该怎么处置呢 ？我被带到了 la Cité de la Lumière，我本该会死在那里……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: La famille.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: La famille。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And abandoned to die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 被抛弃在那，等死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: In their eyes, they had tried their best to mend me for many years. Tutors to teach me to walk. Braces. Footwear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在他们眼里，他们觉得多年来已经竭尽全力地帮助我了。他们请家教教我走路，给我戴上支架，给我穿鞋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Six ? Seven ? In their eyes, they had tried their best to mend me for many years. Tutors to teach me to walk. Braces. Footwear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 六岁 ？七岁 ？在他们眼里，他们觉得多年来已经竭尽全力地帮助我了。他们请家教教我走路，给我戴上支架，给我穿鞋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Entrati did not upset anything. Lyon and I are as strong as we have ever been. Things have simply changed, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 英择谛并没有打乱什么。里昂和我依然坚强如初。只是一切都变了，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would be nowhere with out him. Save, perhaps, the bottom of a hill. Hah !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没有他，我哪儿也去不了。或许，除了山脚下。哈哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He makes me laugh in the strangest of ways. But I find, so do you, wolf. I am finding myself happier and happier to be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​总是​用​最​奇怪​的​方式​逗​我​笑。​不过​狼，​我​发现，​你​也​一样。​我​觉得​自己​在​这里​越来越​快乐​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They were tired of the burden. So, barely able to even read and write my numbers and letters, I found myself in the muck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们厌倦了这种负担。于是，在我连数字和字母都不太会读写的时候，我被丢进了泥地里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lua is ever-changeable. Even Sol, constant as he may be, is influenced in his orbits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 月球瞬息万变。即便太阳的运行轨迹恒定，也是会受到其影响的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He truly is the brother of my soul. I am finding myself happier and happier to be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​真的​是​我​灵魂​兄弟。​我​觉得​自己​在​这里​越来越​快乐​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I only hope he soon discovers the same... but the devil haunts him with his whispers and lies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只希望他也能很快发现这一点……但恶魔总用他的低语和谎言困扰着他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We must not be rigid in our ways, or we will be broken by them, wolf. Besides, I am finding myself happier and happier to be here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼，我们不能固执己见，否则会被它们摧毁。再说，我觉得自己在这里越来越快乐了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bah ! Speak of him and he calls. I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呸 ！一提到他，他就喊我。我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What made me une indésirable pour ma mère, made me quite popular amongst the other children of the streets.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在 ma mère 眼里是 une indésirable 的，但我在街头孩子的眼里却很受欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was like you said, non ? All inconveniences come with a secret power.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像你说的，non ？不便之处都蕴藏着一种隐秘力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What is more pathétique than a child without pieds, oui ? I could earn more in a day with open palms than they could rob in a week.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还有什么比一个没有脚的孩子更可悲呢，oui ？我张开手掌，一天赚的钱比他们一周抢的还多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was this, that led to my being found on the streets by one of les Sœurs de Sol. They offered to take me in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 正是因为这样，让我才会在街头被太阳神的 les Sœurs 发现。她们提出收留我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, what could I do ? It was only a matter of time before I fell ill. Even as an enfant I knew that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我能怎么办 ？我病倒是迟早的事。即便当时我还只是个孩子，我也明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have such a kind heart. Obviously, they could not take them all... but I did not forget my friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你真是个好心人。显然，她们不可能把他们都带走……但我没有忘记我的朋友们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would return every week with my salaire, and whatever scraps I could gather from the kitchen or from the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我每周都会带着我的工资，和从厨房或其他地方收集到的剩饭回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Les Sœurs were so kind to me ! Though I know why you must wonder otherwise, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Les Sœurs 对我非常好 ！不过我知道你肯定不这么想，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How I adored it so ! Though I know why you must wonder otherwise, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我可太喜欢那里了 ！不过我知道你肯定不这么想，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I took as good care of them as I could, for as long as my friends remained. Many died of variole ou tuberculose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 只要我的朋友们还在，我就尽力照顾他们。许多人都死于 variole ou tuberculose……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Three meals, a warm bed, a roof over my head. I did not need to worry about being beaten, or robbed, or worse ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一日三餐，一张温暖的床，一个栖身之所。我不再需要担心被打，被抢，或者更糟的事情发生 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Several moved away, some died by fighting, or violence. Most found honest work and grew. Raised familles of their own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一些人搬走了，一些人死于战斗或暴力。大多数人找到了正当的工作，并逐渐成长起来。组建了自己的家庭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was properly schooled. Taught gospels of Sol and Lua. Told to find my way in faith. I could have left, if I chose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​受到​了​正规​的​教育。​学习​了​太阳神​和​月神​的​福音，​并​被​告知​要​凭​着​信心​找到​自己​的​道路。​如果​我​想​的话，​我​本​可以​离开。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Some would even stop by the Cathédrale to see me. It warmed my heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还​有些​人​甚至会​顺便​去​ Cathédrale ​看​看​我。​这​让​我​心里​很​温暖。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I felt guilt for a long time that I was taken from the streets when others were not. Some days, I still do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很长一段时间以来，我都感到内疚，因为只有我从街上被带走，而其他人却没有。直到今天，我有时仍然有这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is that always what this will forever be ? A fight ? A war against a tide that seeks to drown us ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 难道这一切永远都会如此吗 ？一场战斗 ？一场对抗那想要淹没我们的浪潮的战争 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, that is it precisely. I have been lifted upon the raft, and now I must do so for others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，正是如此。我曾被人托举上木筏，现在我也要去为他人这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I know what you mean. At the heart of it, you say not to give up. That I have been given these gifts so that I may stand as a shield for others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我懂你的意思。你的核心意思是不要放弃。我被赐予这些恩典，是为了成为他人的盾牌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. But for now I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci。不过现在我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was speaking with Monsieur Loid the other day regarding his childhood and I had a question for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 前几天我和洛德先生谈论了他的童年，我有一个问题想问你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Archimedeans - were they Orokin ? Or were they not ? The word gets used with such frivolity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哲士——他们是奥罗金人吗 ？还是说他们不是 ？这个词用得太随便了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not understand. Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous avez offensé ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我没看懂。Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous avez offensé ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He was telling me about his youth. Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous a offensé ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他跟我说了他青年时代的故事。Ai-je fait quelque chose qui vous a offensé ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I could ask the devil, I suppose. But I do not like to talk to him if I can help it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，我是可以去问恶魔。但我能不跟他说话就不跟他说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: De la jalousie ? Pourquoi ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: De la jalousie ？Pourquoi ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pourquoi ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pourquoi ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Did the Orokin purposefully make their society confusing and obtuse ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 奥罗金人是故意让他们的社会变得混乱和愚钝吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Do not take it personally, s'il vous plaît !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！别往心里去，s'il vous plaît ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Monsieur Loid is, what is the word, distant ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 洛德先生，怎么说呢，给人感觉有点疏远 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think they did it just to be annoying !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他们那样做就是为了让人厌烦 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Look at with whom I spend my time with, oui ? Learn to read one statue and it is not too hard to learn to read another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 看看我都和谁相处，oui ？一旦学会解读一个雕像，再学习解读另一个雕像就没那么难了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Et ils se demandent pourquoi des rébellions éclatent. Vous aviez peut-être vos warframes, mais nous avions nos guillotines !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Et ils se demandent pourquoi des rébellions éclatent。Vous aviez peut-être vos warframes，mais nous avions nos guillotines ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vive la révolution !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vive la révolution ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though I admit Monsieur Loid is a bit more... piquant than dear Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过我承认，洛德先生比亲爱的里昂更……更有个性一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do not mind me, I am just having a bit of fun. Silly little Marie la révolutionnaire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别介意，我只是开个玩笑而已。傻傻的 la révolutionnaire 玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, he certainly does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是啊，肯定有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊 ！对了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you for answering my question, I should let you go on your way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 感谢你回答我的问题，我应该让你继续忙了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I fear I have entirely forgotten what I have come here to ask you now ! Ha ! Oh well. It will come to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我现在竟然完全忘了来这里要问你什么了 ！哈 ！算了，我会想起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I apologize for disrupting your day. Or evening. Or whatever time it is, whenever and wherever you have found yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 很抱歉打扰你了，无论是白天、晚上或任何时间，无论你身在何处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: À la revoyure !

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je ne comprends pas votre humour. Perhaps in the future, "funny" is different ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je ne comprends pas votre humour。也许在未来"有趣"的定义是不一样的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know what instinct drove you to tell me such a mensonge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道是什么本能驱使你对我说了这样的 mensonge。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There are so many ways our days and our minds can go awry. It can find dark holes for us to become mired in, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们的生活和思想中有很多地方会让人走偏。它会找到一些黑洞让我们深陷其中，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I asked her why she was doing it, and she said she could not sleep, for she fretted too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我问她为什么这么做，她说她睡不着，因为她太烦躁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We have a word for this, ennui. A weariness and a discontent that makes all seem... pointless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们有个词来形容这种感觉，叫做 ennui。一种疲惫和不满，让一切都显得……毫无意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It will become full and spill. Perhaps even tip its contents. And it all seems like une catastrophe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它会变满，溢出来。甚至里面的水可能会倾倒。​看起来​一​片​狼藉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To fight in the name of Sol... is this to be my way ? Am I to be a killer in his name ? Moi, petite Marie ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 以太阳神之名战斗……难道这就是我的路吗 ？难道我真的要以他的名义去杀人吗 ？我Moi，petite 玛丽 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are using une métaphore, but I am howling in laughter ! I do not think you could be in my shoes now if you tried !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你是在用比喻，但我真的要笑到不行 ！我觉得就算你现在想再踩一次，也进不去 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A soul is more than the faith they wear. I am une Sœur de Sol, but I would hope you see more than that in me, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一个灵魂不只有信仰。我虽然是 une Sœur de Sol，但我希望你看到的不只我这一面，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To me, it is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得一点也不有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only hope it was benign, and not a cruel joke at my expense. So, I shall choose to follow in the example of Sol -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能希望这只是个善意的玩笑，而不是一个用来捉弄我的残酷玩笑。所以，我选择效法太阳神那样——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We can only strive to be kind and patient with ourselves when it does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当这种情况发生时，我们只能尽可能善待自己并保持耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Each time I would find her in such a way, I would ask if she wanted companie. Sometimes she said yes, sometimes she said no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 每次看到她这样，我都会问要不要我陪她。有时候她说要，有时候又说不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Or perhaps yours is a desire to hide, to weep, it is more like despair, I cannot say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许你所渴望的，是想躲起来、想哭泣，更像是绝望，我也说不清。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You clean the mess, you right the cup... and it starts over again, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你清理好混乱的地方，把杯子扶正……然后一切又重新开始，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The image of it that is in my head will give me the fits. Before I cannot breathe, tell me - what are you referencing ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 光是脑中里浮现的画面就要把我笑死了。趁我还没笑得喘不过气，告诉我——你指的是什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There are as many topics that we could choose as there are stars in the sky !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们能谈的话题跟天上的星星一样多 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: - whose faith I follow, whether or not you do, and forgive you. If you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ——无论你是否信奉，他是我追随的信仰，并且原谅你。如果你像里昂那样，我会说，你应当受十鞭子作为代价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know if these words will matter to you. Or if they are only so many glowing dots upon a whirring piece of machinerie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​知道​这些​话​对​你​是否​有​意义。​或者，​它们​不过​是​机器​上​发光​的​点。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There was a Father at the Chapel with a temperament much like yours, I think. He could withstand it all - until he could not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得教堂里有一位神父，他的脾气和你很像。他能承受一切——直到有一天他再也承受不住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! The minuscule copie and their triste story... it makes me want to weep to think of it. To be turned into a machine of war by those they thought were famille ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！一想到那个小小的复制品和他们悲伤的故事……我就想哭。竟然被他们自认为的家人变成了战争机器 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! So I have heard, you suffered much to learn to fight as you do now. Death is a cruel tutor, I cannot imagine...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！我听说过，你吃了很多苦才练成如今的身手。死亡是残酷的老师，我无法想象……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, when you consider the reality of the thing, when I write these words, it could very well be days or many years since I have set them down, depending on when you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 事实上，当你考虑到事情的现实时，当我写下这些话时，很可能已经是几天或很多年以前的事情了，这取决于你身处在什么时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know this friend of yours, but I think - how good it is that they have you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不认识你的这位朋友，但我想——他们能有你在身边，真是太好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When he became overwhelmed, and it all seemed a mess, I would ask if he wanted my companie. Des fois, oui, des fois, non.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当他被压得透不过气，一切看起来一团糟时，我会问他是否希望我陪他。Des fois，oui，des fois，non。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non. I would rather be as I am now. I chose to take le Cardinal's hand, the sérum he offered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non。我宁愿保持现在的样子。我选择接受主教的帮助，接受他提供的血清。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We are all just blind things, trying to find our way through this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们都像盲人一样，试图在这个世界上找到自己的路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All that is to say, I understand it may feel hollow when I write that you are not alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 话虽如此，我明白当我写下你并不孤单时，你可能还是会感到空虚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But you know the sadness that plagues me, the uncertainty. To not be born, or raised, into this life of war.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可是你知道吗，我内心充满了悲伤和不确定性。我并不是在这种战争的环境中出生或成长的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I asked how you were. And the question still stands, petit mensonge ou non.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我刚刚问的是今天过得怎么样。你还没回答，petit mensonge ou non。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though those around you may seem distant or digital or sitting patiently for you to say hello.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 尽管你周围的人可能看起来很遥远、或是虚拟的、或耐心地坐着等你打招呼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and if you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment ! But you are not. And you are forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，如果你像里昂那样，我会说，你应当受十鞭子作为代价。但你不是。你已被原谅了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I forgive you. If you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我原谅你。如果你像里昂那样，我会说，你应当受十鞭子作为代价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And that I hope this moment passes for you quickly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望你的这一刻能过得快一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Qu'y a-t-il ? What is the matter ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Qu'y at-il ？发生什么事了 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And if it does not ? I have a solution that always helps !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但如果没有呢 ？我这有一个万无一失的解决方案 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah ! Oui, so it is. Très bien, I am glad to hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈哈 ！Oui，确实如此。太好了，听你这么说我很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Des pâtisseries !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Des pâtisseries ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, but then you would not be the rakish wolf we know and love, would you ? I think Sol put you right where you needed to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，但那样的你就不是我们所熟知和喜爱的那只放荡不羁的狼了，对吧 ？我觉得太阳神把你放在了该走的路上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I agree completely. No one is born for war. Well, save these "Grin-ire" I am told of, and even then...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我完全同意。没有人生来就是为了投入到战争。好吧，除非是那些我听说的"Grin-ire"，但即便如此……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! Luncheon is served. I must go. Until later, wolf. I am very glad we spoke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊 ！午餐准备好了。我得走了。回头见，狼。很高兴我们聊了天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I know what you mean. You see the structure and guidance your other was given, and you cannot help but wish you had the same. Especially when you were so very alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我明白你的意思。你看到了另一个你所拥有的框架和指导，不免会希望自己当初也拥有同样的东西。尤其是在你那么孤独的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder if they would not pick another road if given a real choice to do so ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在想，如果真的有选择的话，他们会不会走上另一条道路 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I cannot help but see, now, a minuscule copie who is so very alone... and a wolf who runs with a pack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在，我不禁看见，一个非常孤独的小小复制品……和一只与狼群一起奔跑的狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Just do not let the devil near them. Sinon, il va les voler ! He is wont to steal sweets when he is not given his fill !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别让恶魔靠近。Sinon，il va les voler！他吃不饱的时候就会偷糕点！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think perhaps the tables have turned, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​也​许​情况​已经​反​过​来​了，​non ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now that is the spirit ! Even a devil deserves a bit of pastry now and then, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这就对了！我想，就算是恶魔，偶尔也该吃些糕点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je vous en prie. I do hope I have cheered you, even a little. I know you have cheered me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je vous en prie。真希望我能让你开心，哪怕只是一点点。我知道你有让我觉得开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, I complain, but even the lowest devil deserves a bit of pastry now and then, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，​这​我​要​抱怨​一下，​但​即使​是​最​卑微​的​恶魔​也​应该​偶尔​吃些​糕点，​ou​i ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, you are correct. So many seek the faith in hopes it will give them just that - purpose. A direction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你说得对。很多人寻求信仰，就是希望它能给他们带来目的，带来方向。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: (So that is how it is spelled, merci !) That gives me such happiness to know. That even a race that was taught that is their only purpose, can find another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: （原来是这样拼写的，谢谢 ！）听到你这么说我真的很欣慰。即使是一个被灌输视战争为唯一目的的种族，也仍然能找到另一条路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! Luncheon is served, and now I am hungry. I do hope I have cheered you, even a little. I know you have cheered me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 好了 ！午饭准备好了，我现在很饿。真希望我能让你开心，哪怕只是一点点。我知道你有让我感到开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you are doing as much as you can, I think. They will come to you when you are needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想你已经尽力了。他们需要你的时候自然会来找你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So many find a road to travel in hopes it lead them to answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 许多人踏上旅途，就是为了寻求答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Imaginez Lyon and I, when the devil would stroll in, mask and coat over himself, pockets stuffed with stolen sweets !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！想象一下里昂和我，当恶魔走进来，戴着面具，披着外衣，口袋里塞满了偷来的糕点 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think when you find that answer, you discover your own peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想当你找到答案时，就能找到内心的安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He would tell us that since the Orokin would rule the system soon, it was not truly theft ! Et puis on se crie dessus et Lyon would beg for silence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会告诉我们，因为奥罗金很快就会统治这个星系，所以严格来说这不算偷 ！Et puis on se crie dessus et，里昂会求我们安静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To enjoy the scenery, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然是为了欣赏沿途风景呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! Luncheon is served. I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊 ！午饭好了。我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, he did. But I do not know if it was by design, or threat of violence from Lyon that inspired it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，他确实带够了。但我不知道这是故意为之，还是里昂的暴力威胁促使他这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We could not let it go to waste, n'est-ce pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们不能让它浪费掉，n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wolf ! You will make me fall out of my chair !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼 ！你让我差点从椅子上摔下来了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bon, où en étais-je ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bon，où en étais-je ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ma famille à Sol ! My family in Sol, how are we this day ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ma famille à Sol ！​我​同侍奉太​阳神​的​家人，​你​今天​过​得​怎么样​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! How are we this day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！今天过得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! How are we this day?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！今天过得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ma famille à Sol ! My family in Sol, how are we this day ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ma famille à Sol ！​我​同侍奉太​阳神​的​家人，​你​今天​过​得​怎么样​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am all right, but now you have me curious. Qu'y a-t-il ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我挺好的，但现在你让我很好奇。Qu'y a-t-il ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am doing all right, I suppose. Though as I reflect upon it, I feel as I should not be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也过得不错。不过仔细想想，我感觉自己不应该这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! I... see. Pourquoi ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！我……知道了。Pourquoi ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I shall not pry. I know it is hard to put things into words, sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我就不多问了。我明白有些事很难说出口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There was a Sister at the Cathédrale much like this. She would fuss and fuss and fuss. I found her once polishing silver at three in the morning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Cathédrale 里有一位修女也是这样。她总是忙来忙去。有一次我凌晨三点看到她还在擦银器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, oui. I think I know of what you speak. A kind of... cloud, that moves over the sun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，oui。我想我知道你在说什么。一种……云，在太阳下方移动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like a cup that fills with water, one drop at a time, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像一个杯子，一滴一滴地被水填满，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am une Sœur de Sol. I am not meant to be... fighting. Killing. The Murmure are not alive, or so the Cavia tell me - but what of the others that I face ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我是 une Sœur de Sol。我不应该……战斗。杀戮。Murmure 并非生灵，至少科维兽是这么告诉我的——但我面对的其他人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You did not need to tell me such a mensonge to know me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你不必为了了解我去撒这样的 mensonge。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must ask you a question, and I must implore you not to judge me for it, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我必须问你一个问题，漂泊者，同时也请你别因此评判我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vraiment gentil to pay me such grace without knowing me or what I was about to write to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vraiment gentil，在不了解我，也不知我要问点什么的情况下就对我如此宽厚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But... does the large-headed talking fish give you a headache as well ? Fibonacci ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是……那个大脑袋会说话的鱼，也会让你头疼吗 ？斐波那契 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do appreciate that, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我非常感激，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I am glad I am not alone. But, to be clear, I mean him no insult. If I feel out of sorts by nature of my current state of affairs, I imagine he endures as best he can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我很庆幸自己并非孤身一人。不过先说明，这绝非对他的侮辱之意。如果我因为现状而心神不宁，想必他也是竭尽全力在忍受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ? How so ? I suppose I am glad for it, but I am simply confused as to why. My headache is certainly not nearly so charming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ？怎么会呢 ？我猜我应该为此感到高兴，但实在不明白为什么。我的头痛可没这么迷人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I can only beg your forgiveness, I mean him no insult. If I feel out of sorts by nature of my current state of affairs, I imagine he endures as best he can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我只能请求你的原谅，这绝非对他的侮辱之意。如果我因为现状而心神不宁，想必他也是竭尽全力在忍受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: His means of doing so simply disagrees with me when I am subjected to it at length, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他这样做的方式，只是当我长时间被迫承受时，实在难以认同罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: His means of doing so simply disagrees with me when I am subjected to it at length, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他这样做的方式，只是当我长时间被迫承受时，实在难以认同罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bah. I should not be complaining at all. I must bring Lyon his dinner tonight, he is once more laid out with a terrible megrim.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 唉。我不该抱怨的。今晚必须给里昂送晚餐，他又被严重的偏头风折磨得动弹不得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bah. I should not be complaining at all. I must bring Lyon his dinner tonight, he is once more laid out with a terrible megrim.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 唉。我不该抱怨的。今晚必须给里昂送晚餐，他又被严重的偏头风折磨得动弹不得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Never lose that part of you, Drifter. Never let go of the part of you that seeks out those sparks of life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 永远不要失去你生命中那部分，漂泊者。永远不要放弃你内心追寻生命火花的那部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Goodness me, when you put it like that, no wonder. It does sound like one of those childish jokes, n'est-ce pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 天啊，这么一说就明白啦。这确实像那些幼稚的笑话，n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, oui. Once every few weeks ? Once every two months ? The longest stretch I have seen him go without one is six months, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，oui。几周一次 ？两个月一次 ？我记得他最久一次没犯病的记录大概是半年吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Dear. Hm. Think of a headache, but far more intense. I have heard some others call them bilious headaches. They are more common in women.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！亲爱的。嗯。就像是头痛，但要剧烈得多。我听说有人称之为胆汁性头痛。这种头痛在女性中更为常见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The world is all too eager to become a dark and serious place. All too ready to levy suffering upon us at every turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这世界总爱把自己装扮成阴郁沉重之地，随时准备在每个转角处向我们施加苦难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A Sister, a Priest, and a devil from the future get sent to the past... and then to the futur... and meet up with a fish, a deer-thing, a giant bird, and a butler...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一位修女、一位神父和来自未来的恶魔被送往过去……又被送往未来……途中遇见了鱼、鹿形生物、巨鸟和管家……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We must seek out whatever brightness, whatever levity we can, even in the form of childishness if we must.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们必须寻找一切可能的明媚与轻松，哪怕不得不以幼稚的形式出现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is quite amusing, you are quite right !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这真是有趣得很，你说得太对了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder what other fascinating historical particularités we shall discover ! Exciting. I do love to learn new things. "Migraine." The journey was clearly not far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真想知道我们还会发现哪些迷人的历史 particularités ！太令人兴奋了。我确实热爱学习新事物。"偏头痛。"这趟旅程显然不远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now only if Lyon would see it the same way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 要是里昂也能这么想就好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now if only my dear Lyon would see the brightness in it the same way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但愿我亲爱的里昂也能同样看到其中的光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He has his theories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他自有他的理论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If you were to express your sympathies, I am certain they would be welcome. And despite how it may seem, he will appreciate the company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你想表达慰问，我相信他定会欣然接受。尽管可能看起来并非如此，但他其实很享受有人陪伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You do ? You should tell Lyon. He needs to know others are capable of suffering in such a similar way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你也有吗 ？你该告诉里昂。他需要知道其他人也可能经历如此相似的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No matter the name, Lyon is prostrate with one and shall be until morning. Poor man cannot see anything but a blur, nor feel his hands nor feet. And he tells me the pain is intolerable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不管叫什么名字，里昂都被它打倒，直到天亮才能转好。可怜的他眼前一片模糊，手脚也毫无知觉。他说这痛苦简直难以忍受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Although it may be more correct to say that he had his theories, until lately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然更准确的说法是，直到最近他才有了自己的理论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though his demeanor may attempt to dissuade you, I implore you to hold strong, Drifter. There is a man with great need buried beneath what seems a stoic and stony exterior.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 尽管他的举止或许试图劝阻你，我恳请你坚守信念，漂泊者。在那看似坚毅冷峻的外表之下，深藏着一个亟需帮助的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, speaking of. I feel terrible for complaining about headaches. I must bring Lyon his dinner tonight, he is once more laid out with a terrible megrim.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，说到这个。我为抱怨头痛感到很愧疚。今晚必须给里昂送晚餐，他又被严重的偏头风折磨得动弹不得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The Luminaries know he would otherwise willingly suffer alone...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 双耀神深知，若非如此，他宁愿独自承受痛苦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Jest with me in such a fashion, but do not make such remarks to him. The topic of your Indifférence is a sore one with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你可以这样跟我开玩笑，但别对他讲这种话。关于虚空无情之物的话对他而言是个痛处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is grown, yes. He is a man, yes. And I believe he wishes to talk. But I challenge you to question if he can talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是成年人了，没错。他是个男人了，也没错。我相信他也渴望倾诉。但我要问你，他真能开口吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You will need it with him, I fear. Thank you, Drifter. He is my dearest friend, and a brother to me. And it breaks my heart to see him in such pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕你和他在一起时会需要这份固执的。谢谢你，漂泊者。他是我最亲密的朋友，也像我的兄弟。看着他承受如此痛苦，我的心都碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Be resilient. And patient. And kind. He is like a brother to me and is my dearest friend, Drifter. And it breaks my heart to see him in such pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 要坚韧。要耐心。要善良。他就像我的兄弟，也是我最亲密的朋友，漂泊者。看到他承受如此痛苦，我的心都碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not all of us are equally gifted or feel that we are entitled to such things. He is in pain and believes it is his lot to be in pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们并非生而就拥有同等天赋，也不都觉得自己理应享有这些。他正承受着痛苦，并认为痛苦就是他注定的命运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We will speak again soon. Par la grâce de Sol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们很快会再聊。Par la grâce de Sol。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is also like a brother to me and is my dearest friend. And my heart shatters for him. So I simply can only ask you to... be patient. And kind. If you are capable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他就像我的兄弟，也是我最亲密的朋友。想到他，我的心便碎成千片。因此我只能恳请你……耐心些。温柔些。如果你能做到的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am going to ask you to define that before we move forward. And I will ask you to do that gently, and with a careful reminder that he is the brother of my soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在我们继续之前，我想请你先定义。而且请你温柔地定义，并且我小心地提醒你，他是我灵里的弟兄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My dear Lyon was already long established at the Cathédrale when the Mère Supérieure took me in, and I joined the Church of the Luminaries as a Sister. (I am giddy that you are speaking !)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我亲爱的里昂，早在 Mère Supérieure 收留我的时候，就已经在 Cathédrale 里安顿了很久，之后我加入了双耀神教会，成为了一名修女。（听到你们开始聊天了，我好兴奋 ！）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No, no. It is all right. I am simply accustomed to curious onlookers creeping about, coming to tap on the bars of his cage like he was some manner of monstre de cirque.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，不。没事。我只是习惯了好奇的围观者四处走动，敲打他的笼子栏杆，就像他是 monstre de cirque 一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Because I was cast there by ma famille many years earlier when I was a little girl. I spent many years as a beggar, living however I could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因为很多年前，当我还是个小女孩的时候，我被 ma famille 抛弃在街头。我当了很多年的乞丐，想尽一切办法过活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... apologize for my brusqueness. I am simply accustomed to curious onlookers creeping about, coming to tap on the bars of his cage like he was some manner of monstre de cirque.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……为我的粗鲁道歉。我只是习惯了好奇的围观者四处走动，敲打他的笼子栏杆，就像他是 monstre de cirque 一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: By all accounts, you are told to be a wolf, and with me you have such manners ! It is so sweet to see. I think I know what you wish to ask. Why was I on the streets ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 大家都说，你是狼，可你却对我这么有礼貌 ！真是太贴心了。我觉得我知道你想问什么。我为什么会流落街头 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My dear Lyon was already long established at the Cathédrale when the Mère Supérieure took me in, and I joined the Church of the Luminaries as a Sister.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我亲爱的里昂，早在 Mère Supérieure 收留我的时候，就已经在 Cathédrale 里安顿了很久，之后我加入了双耀神教会，成为了一名修女。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I imagine you must be, a time-traveling creature who can loop time and summon worlds from whole cloth ! A bit of a magician, you are, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我猜你肯定是，一个时间旅行生物，能循环时间，还能凭空召唤整个世界 ！有点像个魔术师，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You can imagine there was not much work or places for someone like me to go, with no working legs, dans la Cité de la Lumière in my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你可以想象，在我们那个年代，对于像我这种双腿无法行走的人来说，在光城没有什么工作可以做，也没有什么地方可以去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I adore that you are. He is strong and can withstand what has been levied against him. But all burdens are easier to carry together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我感激你这么想。他很坚强，能承受所有对他的打击。但所有重担，一起扛都会轻松很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which is why I suppose Lyon and I became so quickly as family. Never once did he look at me with pity. Nor I he.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，这就是为什么我和里昂这么快就成了家人。他从没用怜悯的眼光看过我，一次也没有。我对他也没有过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Because I was cast there by ma famille many years earlier when I was a little girl. I spent many years as a beggar, living however I could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因为很多年前，当我还是个小女孩的时候，我被 ma famille 抛弃在街头。我当了很多年的乞丐，想尽一切办法过活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Where others are so quick to curiously tap upon bars of his cage like he was some manner of monstre de cirque.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然而其他人如此迅速，好奇地敲他笼子上的栏杆，就像他是某种 monstre de cirque 一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: By all accounts, you are told to be a wolf, and with me you have such manners! It is so sweet to see. I think I know what you wish to ask. Why was I on the streets ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 大家都说，你是狼，可你却对我这么有礼貌！真是太贴心了。我觉得我知道你想问什么。我为什么会流落街头 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Someday, there will be a storybook written about you, I think. How charming the thought. Perhaps I shall write it. Though it would be in Gaullique! Imaginez cela !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 总有一天，会有一本关于你的故事书，我觉得。这个想法多美妙啊。我应该去写。虽然会用高卢语 ！ Imaginez cela ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then you truly do understand. I am more than Sister Marie, the poor girl with no feet given the power to fly. And Lyon is more than a tragic priest who bears his burdens in silence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你就真的明白了。我不只是玛丽修女，那个脚没被赋予飞翔力量的可怜女孩。里昂也不只是一个默默承受重担的悲剧神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I hope that is not what you are doing here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望你来这里不是要做这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You can imagine there was not much work or places for someone like me to go, with no working legs, dans la Cité de la Lumière in my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你可以想象，在我们那个年代，对于像我这种双腿无法行走的人来说，在光城没有什么工作可以做，也没有什么地方可以去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Or perhaps do not imagine any such thing, it may come true. Hah! And on that wonderful note, I fear I must bid you adieu. The Murmure never cease !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或者干脆别去想这些，它可能会成真。哈 ！说了这么多，我恐怕得跟你告别了。Murmure 真是永不停歇 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Remember that, and we shall be good friends, I think. And on that wonderful note, I fear I must bid you adieu. The Murmure never cease !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 记住这一点，我们会成为好朋友的，我觉得。说到这美好的盼望，我恐怕得跟你告别了。Murmure 真是永不停歇 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Be patient. He is... not forthcoming, at first. But he will come to you, when the time is right. If you mean well, he will know it. But now, I fear I must bid you adieu.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 耐心点。他……一开始不会主动。但时机成熟时，他会来找你的。如果你是好意，他会知道的。但现在，我恐怕得跟你告别了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Which is why I suppose Lyon and I became so quickly as family. Never once did he look at me with pity. Nor I he.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，这就是为什么我和里昂这么快就成了家人。他从没用怜悯的眼光看过我，一次也没有。我对他也没有过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I imagine you must be, a time-traveling creature who can loop time and summon worlds from whole cloth ! A bit of a magician, you are, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我猜你肯定是，一个时间旅行生物，能循环时间，还能凭空召唤整个世界 ！有点像个魔术师，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are correct, he does. But he feels it is necessary to do so, to protect those around him. When he feels you no longer need such things, he will tell you what troubles him. Be patient. He will speak to you in time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对，他确实会这么做。但他觉得为了保护他身边的人，有必要这么做。等他觉得你不再需要这些东西时，他就会告诉你他的烦恼。耐心一点。他迟早会找你倾诉的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bah. I fear I must bid you adieu. The Murmure never cease !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊。我恐怕得跟你告别了。Murmure 真是永不停歇 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Be patient. He is... not forthcoming, at first. But he will come to you, when the time is right. If you mean well, he will know it. But now, I fear I must bid you adieu.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 耐心点。他……一开始不会主动。但时机成熟时，他会来找你的。如果你是好意，他会知道的。但现在，我恐怕得跟你告别了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then you truly do understand. I am more than Sister Marie, the poor girl with no feet given the power to fly. And Lyon is more than a tragic priest who bears his burdens in silence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你就真的明白了。我不只是玛丽姐妹，不只是那个没有脚却被赋予飞翔力量的可怜女孩。里昂也不只是一个默默承受重担的悲剧神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Remember that, and we shall be good friends, I think. And on that wonderful note, I fear I must bid you adieu. The Murmure never cease!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 记住这一点，我们会成为好朋友的，我觉得。说到这美好的盼望，我恐怕得跟你告别了。Murmure 真是永不停歇 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mmh. Comment ça ? In what way do you mean ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯。Comment ça ？你是指什么方面 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah... it is an uncomfortable subject, oui ? Pardon, but I do not know quite how to speak of it, without twisting myself into a knot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊……这真是个令人难堪的话题，oui ？抱歉，我实在不知该如何开口，不至于让自己陷入窘境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe Lyon would take his own life before harming me. I have all faith, in all the gods, and devils -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信里昂宁可自尽也绝不会伤害我。我对众神与恶魔都怀有绝对信心——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The nightmares that fill his mind - Lua guides him on a difficult path, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你指的是充斥他脑海的噩梦——月神正引领他踏上艰难之路，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I will do my best. I assume you ask out of concern for him ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我会尽力而为。我想你这么问是出于对他关心的缘故吧 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: - that not even your Indifférence could trick him to raise a hand to me in violence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ——就连你的虚空无情之物也无法诱使他对我施加暴力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: [This will route around all conversations regarding self-harm.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: [该选项将绕过所有涉及自残的对话。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is a hard thing, I fear, to speak of. For I know it is something that should not be, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我怕这实在难以启齿。因为我知道这本不该发生，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I might fear a butterfly would devour me whole, before I would I fear the brother of my soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也许会害怕一只蝴蝶会将我吞噬殆尽，而不是害怕我灵魂的兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I should wish to stop him. To protect him from this desire of his to do himself such harm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我真想阻止他。保护他远离这种自残的念头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If there is one thing I know of Lyon to be certain, it is that he will always be there when he is needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果说我对里昂有哪点深信不疑，那就是他永远会在需要时挺身而出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You echo the words of the devil. Is it only callous need of capable hands that inspires you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你竟然重复着恶魔的话。难道你只是冷酷无情地需要得力的帮手吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Dégoûtant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Dégoûtant。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is the great protector, le bouclier sacré de Lua.... The shining light in the darkness of the night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是伟大的守护者，le bouclier sacré de Lua……是黑夜中闪耀的光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The pain he inflicts upon himself... he does to hear his own thoughts. To feel his own body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他施加给自身的痛苦……只是为了聆听自己的思绪。感受自己的身体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wonder who will help you, when you are laid low and are in need of a hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我倒要看看，当你身受重创、需要援手之时，究竟谁会来帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For the sky is filled with stars, and each of them whisper to him, and he, like Lua herself, would be lost among them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 天空布满繁星，每颗星星都在向他低语，而他，如同月神一样，会在星海中迷失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And like Lua, he goes through his phases. He becomes consumed by the Void only to shine so bright that we all may walk in darkness without fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如同月神一样，他经历了自身的蜕变。他被虚空吞噬，却最终绽放出耀眼光芒，使我们得以在黑暗中无惧前行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But like all blessings, it comes with a curse. Do I make any sense ? I fear I am only rambling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但就像所有的祝福一样，它也伴随着诅咒。我说的有道理吗 ？恐怕我只是在胡言乱语。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The pain he feels is deeper than what he inflicts upon his flesh. What he does to himself now he can no longer fall from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他承受的痛苦远比他施加在肉体的伤痛更深。此刻他对自身的所作所为，也无法帮他逃离困境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! I did not know, I am so very, very sorry... What pathetic manner of platitudes and prayers I could offer you would feel empty I am certaine -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！我不知道，我非常非常抱歉……此刻我能献上的那些陈词滥调与祈祷，想必都显得空洞无物——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It clears his mind, steadies his soul. And now, as a protoframe - as partly this... Harrow, as I am partly Wisp, it will not kill him, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它澄清他的思绪，安定他的灵魂。而今，作为原型战甲——一部分是……Harrow，就像我是 Wisp 的一部分，它不会杀死他，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: - for what condoléances could someone you barely know give, that could serve as a balm to a tragédie such as that ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ——毕竟面对如此悲剧，一个素不相识之人所能表达的哀悼，又怎能成为抚慰心灵的良药 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And for this, I cannot adore you more. But the form help takes can be many things, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为此，我对你再崇拜不过了。但帮助的形式可以是多种多样的，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh !! I have just screamed like I have seen a mouse and startled Monsieur Loid ! Pardon !!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 噢 ！！我刚才像看见老鼠一样尖叫起来，把洛德先生吓了一跳 ！请原谅 ！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This soul you lost of which you speak... were they close to you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你所说的那个失去的灵魂……你们很亲近吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To help a baby bird may be to kill it. To help a candle flame may be to blow it out in your exubérance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 救助幼鸟可能反而害了它。助燃烛火可能因过犹不及而吹灭它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, but this is such wonderful news !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 噢，但这真是个好消息 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have found that being beside him when he needs me... listening to him, holding him when he weeps ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我发现，在他需要我时陪伴在他身边……倾听他，在他哭泣时拥抱他 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have found that being beside him when he needs me... listening to him, merely sitting beside him when he weeps ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我发现，在他需要我时陪伴在他身边……倾听他，当他哭泣时仅仅坐在他身旁 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Does more for him than speaking of what he should and should not do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 比告诉他该做什么不该做什么更有作用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is this why you seek to ensure that Lyon does not befall the same fate ? Or is it simply the topic itself that upsets you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 难道这就是你竭力避免里昂重蹈覆辙的原因 ？还是仅仅因为这个话题本身令你心烦意乱 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even still, to have someone near to you feel so trapped within their context that there was only one manner of escape...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 即便如此，当身边之人深陷困境，仿佛只有这样才是唯一的解脱……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Does more for him than speaking of what he should and should not do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 比告诉他该做什么不该做什么更有作用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, am I overjoyed. Tellement ravie ! Lyon is in such need of love - you do not know !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，我真是欣喜若狂。Tellement ravie ！里昂多么需要爱——你根本不知道 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, like talking to a statue de marbre, non ? I know how you feel. I have oft found myself twenty minutes deep in a story only to realize he was not listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，就像对着大理石雕像说话，non ？我懂你的感受。我常发现自己讲了二十分钟故事，才意识到他根本没在听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You must learn to read between the lines, non ? He speaks in stories. In paraboles. If he is silent, listen to his actions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你必须学会读懂弦外之音，non ？他的语言是故事。是 paraboles。如果他沉默，就聆听他的行动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, but perhaps you do. He is, as you can tell, in such pain, despite appearances...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，或许你明白。正如你所见，他其实正承受着巨大的痛苦，尽管表面上……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lost in the hallways of his mind again or paying attention to some other esprit in the room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 又在自己思绪的迷宫中迷失，或是正关注着房间里某个其他的 esprit。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Be patient with him, be kind, et je vous en supplie, do not hurt him, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请对他多些耐心，多些温柔，et je vous en supplie，千万别伤害他，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, like talking to a statue de marbre, non ? I know how you feel. I have oft found myself twenty minutes deep in a story only to realize he was not listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，就像对着大理石雕像说话，non ？我懂你的感受。我常发现自己讲了二十分钟故事，才意识到他根本没在听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I understand. But there is sometimes little that we can do. But to be there for others when and how they wish for us to be there for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我明白。但有时我们能做的实在有限。但是在他人需要我们陪伴时，以他们期望的方式出现在他们身边——这便是我们能做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Be patient with him, be kind, et je vous en supplie, do not hurt him, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请对他多些耐心，多些温柔，et je vous en supplie，千万别伤害他，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You must learn to read between the lines, non ? He speaks in stories. In paraboles. If he is silent, listen to his actions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你必须学会读懂弦外之音，non ？他的语言是故事。是 paraboles。如果他沉默，就聆听他的行动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Of course... Can I tell you a story of someone I knew, who did the same ? Or would you rather we go our separate ways ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然……要不要听我讲个故事，讲我认识的某个也这么做过的人 ？还是说你宁愿分道扬镳了 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lost in the hallways of his mind again or paying attention to some other esprit in the room.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 又在自己思绪的迷宫中迷失，或是正关注着房间里某个其他的 esprit。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To do more would be to crush them or drive them away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 做得更多，只会把他们压垮或赶走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is all I ask. Oh, but I am so overjoyed ! I must work to make this pairing come to pass !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这就是我唯一的请求。哦，但我实在太高兴了 ！我必须努力让有情人终成眷属 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then speak to him of your concern. He will listen. He is no child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么就向他说说你的忧虑吧。他会听的。他已经不是小孩子了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You must learn to read between the lines, non ? He speaks in stories. In paraboles. If he is silent, listen to his actions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你必须学会读懂弦外之音，non ？他的语言是故事。是 paraboles。如果他沉默，就聆听他的行动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But you care, you wish to help him - and I am certain he knows this. Ah ! Here it is. He is like a stray dog, with a scar upon his leg. It is healed, but healed wrong. So it hurts him still, and itches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但你在意他，你想要帮助他——而我确信他心知肚明。啊 ！就是他。他像条流浪狗，腿上带着疤痕。伤口愈合了，却愈合得畸形。所以它仍痛得发痒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is like a stray dog, with a scar upon his leg. It is healed, but healed wrong. So it hurts him still, and itches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他像条流浪狗，腿上带着疤痕。伤口愈合了，却愈合得畸形。所以它仍痛得发痒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. That is all I can ask. À bientôt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci。这就是我的全部要求了。À bientôt。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He chews upon the leg, and though it opens the wound and brings him pain, it also brings him relief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他啃咬那条腿，尽管撕裂的伤口带来剧痛，却也让他感到解脱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah ! It is too late for that now. Marie, au travail ! Il y a de l'amour dans l'air !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！现在才说这些可太迟了。玛丽，au travail ！Il y a de l'amour dans l'air ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! And you could not stop me, even if you wished. Marie, to work !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！即使你想阻止我也做不到。玛丽，快去干活 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, of course. À bientôt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，当然。À bientôt。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，当然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You know how my story begins, but there is a portion I did not tell you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你知道我的故事是如何开始的，但我还有一部分没告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It harms him, but it is part of him, all the same. And if you approach him avec colère, if you are harsh, he will flinch from your touch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这虽然会伤害他自己，但终究是他的一部分。如果你带着 colère 靠近他，如果你态度粗暴，他便会畏缩着躲开你的触碰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I told you that I was a beggar upon the streets, when I was a jeune fille. And that I did well for myself and that I had many friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我告诉过你，当我还是个 jeune fille 时，曾流落街头乞讨为生。我也说过后来我过得不错，还结交了许多朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was born into a rich famille, which might surprise you. The bourgeois class, who are closer to the Orokin than not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我出生在一个富裕的家庭，这可能会让你感到意外。资产阶级，离奥罗金挺近的那种。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You must earn the trust of the stray. Let him come to you, non ? Does this make sense ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你必须赢得流浪动物的信任。让他主动靠近你，non ？这样说的通吧 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: One of them was a big older boy named Hugo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其中有一个叫雨果的大男孩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But when I was born as I was... deformed, with mes pieds tordus et inutilisables ? Oh, ma mère could not have that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然而我一出生就是个……畸形的孩子，mes pieds tordus et inutilisables ？哦，ma mère 无法接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He was a bit of the leader of the pack. And he always made sure no one picked on me and I had all I needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是这群孩子中的领头羊。他总会确保没人欺负我，也保证我所需的一切都得到满足。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There were appearances to be maintained, oui ? Standards to be kept.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 毕竟要维护家族的体面与规矩，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bien ! I was afraid I let my metaphors get away from me again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bien ！我怕我又让比喻跑偏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Marie and her metaphors. Ah, bon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 玛丽和她的比喻。啊，bon。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mince alors. I knew I let my métaphores get away from me again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mince alors。我就知道我又让我的比喻跑偏了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He even helped me build des béquilles - you might call them... eh... crutches ? That I could use to drag myself about, with bits of wood we scavenged.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他甚至帮我用捡来的木头搭了副 des béquilles——你们管它叫……呃……拐杖吧 ？让我能拄着它拖着身子走动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So, what was to be done, with poor malformed Marie ? I was brought to la Cité de la Lumière, where certainly I would perish upon the streets...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么，那个可怜的畸形玛丽该怎么处置呢 ？我被带到了 la Cité de la Lumière，我本该会死在那里……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hm. It occurs to me that perhaps describing Lyon as a stray dog is not the most flattering comparison to make...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 嗯。我忽然想到，或许把里昂比作流浪狗并不是最得体的比喻……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: One morning, we went to go wake him, and we found him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有天早上，我们去叫醒他，却发现他——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And abandoned to die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并任其自生自灭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps do not tell him I did so, oui...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许不必告诉他我这么形容，oui…… ?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je... I will spare you the details... I am certain you can guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je……细节我就不多说了……我想你肯定能猜得到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But he left us a note. It was barely legible. He was the only one of the other children who knew his letters, and I had to read it to the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但他留了张纸条。字迹模糊得几乎辨认不清。他是其他孩子中唯一识字的，所以我不得不把它读给其他人听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Six ? Seven ? In their eyes, they had tried their best to mend me for many years. Tutors to teach me to walk. Braces. Footwear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 六岁 ？七岁 ？在他们眼里，这些年他们已竭尽全力地帮助我了。请来导师教我行走，配戴支架，更换特殊鞋具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: In their eyes, they had tried their best to mend me for many years. Tutors to teach me to walk. Braces. Footwear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在他们眼里，这些年他们已竭尽全力地帮助我了。请来导师教我行走，配戴支架，更换特殊鞋具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I remember still how my voice choked. But I had to stay strong. Because even then, I knew that I had a duty to the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我至今仍记得自己哽咽的声音。但我必须保持坚强。因为即使在那时，我也明白自己对其他人负有责任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They were tired of the burden. So, barely able to even read and write my numbers and letters, I found myself in the muck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们厌倦了这种负担。于是，在我连数字和字母都不太会读写的时候，我被丢进了泥地里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Quelle horrible personne ! J'espère que votre chaise va s'effondrer et vous donner plein d'échardes douloureuses !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Quelle horrible personne ! J'espère que votre chaise va s'effondrer et vous donner plein d'échardes douloureuses !

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci ! What a relief...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci ！真是松了一口气……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hugo had always seemed so happy to us, they said to me. Si joyeux. Always meeting life with a laugh and a sneer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们对我说，雨果看起来总是那么快乐。Si joyeux。永远用笑声和冷嘲热讽面对生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even when we were chased away or he was beaten with a stick for theft or loitering, it did not seem to bother him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 即便我们遭人驱赶，或是他因偷窃或游手好闲挨棍打，他似乎都无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But we never know the depth of the pain others feel in their hearts. And in that letter, I knew he wept with Lua.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我们永远无法知晓他人内心的伤痛有多深。而从那封信里，我明白他曾与月神一同流泪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was like you said, non ? All inconveniences come with a secret power.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像你说的，non ？不便之处都蕴藏着一种隐秘力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What made me indésirable pour ma mère, made me quite popular amongst the other children of the streets.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我在 pour ma mère 眼里是 indésirable，但我在街头孩子眼里却很受欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But that he was now at peace at her side. For a time, I resented him for leaving. For the others looked to me for guidance. And I resented him for abandoning me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但他此刻已安息在她身旁。有一段时间，我怨恨他的离去。因为其他人都在向我寻求指引。而我怨恨他抛弃了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What is more pathétique than a child with no pieds, oui ? I could earn more in a day with open palms than they could rob in a week.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还有什么比一个没有脚的孩子更 pathétique 呢，oui ？我一天伸手乞讨赚的钱，比他们一周抢劫的还多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But over time, I came to understand the truth of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但随着时间的推移，我逐渐明白了其中的道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I was always wont to share. So I had many friends who would look out for me, take care of me. One of them was a big older boy named Hugo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我向来乐于分享，因此结交了许多朋友，他们总会照顾我、保护我。其中有一个叫雨果的大男孩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We can only forgive ourselves for being human. And forgive ourselves the pain of their leaving.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们只能原谅自己身为凡人的软弱，原谅自己承受他们离去带来的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For it is their absence that hurts us. And the thought that we could not do more to aid them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们的缺席令我们心痛。更痛的是，我们无力为他们多做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The burdens that others carry are never ours to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他人背负的重担，我们永远无从知晓。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And that is a great tragédie. But it is what it means to be human.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这真是一场巨大的 tragédie。但这正是身为凡人要经历的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know if this story aided you. But I can only pray that it did. I must go, Monsieur Loid is calling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不知道这个故事是否对你有所帮助。但我只能祈祷它确实如此。我得走了，洛德先生在叫我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are most welcome. À bientôt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不客气。À bientôt。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Or do you believe that time has already come and gone, and now you are above such reproach ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还是你认为那段时光早已过去，现在你已凌驾于这样的非议之上 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter ! Bonjour ! I have discovered something most incredible, and I must tell you about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者 ！Bonjour ！我发现了一件非常不可思议的事情，我必须告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Did you know that when I am fully in flight, I am impossible à voir ?! Je suis invisible !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！你知道吗，当我完全飞起来的时候，我是 impossible à voir ！Je suis 隐形的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pour toi ? Bien sûr.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pour toi ？Bien sûr。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why do you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你又是因为什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I could ask you the same of Lua, non ? Why do you believe ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也可以问你同样的问题，non ？你为什么信月神 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You told me you have a faith similar to mine, non ? Why do you believe ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说过，你和我有着相似的信仰，non ？你为什么相信你的信仰 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You told me you have a faith, though it was different from mine, it was faith all the same. Why do you believe ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说过，你有信仰，虽然和我的不一样，但那也是信仰。你为什么相信你的信仰 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you said your faith is personal to you, much like une histoire of your own making, but it is faith all the same. Why do you believe ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你说过你的信仰对你来说很私人，就像是你自己创造的 une histoire，但它终究是信仰。你为什么信 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why Sol, in particular ? Over Lua or perhaps the balance you adhere to ? A very good question. Why do you believe ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么偏偏信太阳神 ？而不是月神，或者说，你们所坚持的那种平衡 ？这是个很好的问题。你为什么信 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: As someone who follows no faith, I could see why that could seem strange, oui.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 对于一个没有信仰的人，我能理解为什么这看起来很奇怪，oui。
