/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What gives me my certainty, you wonder ? Where you say we cannot know the universe ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你想知道，是什么让我如此确信 ？毕竟你说过，我们无法了解宇宙 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What gives me my certainty, you wonder ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你想知道，是什么让我如此确信 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you know what this means ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你知道这意味着什么吗 ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "Why does this sensible young woman believe in things that I do not think are real, that seems silly," non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "为什么这个明智的年轻女子会相信我认为不真实的事情，这看起来很蠢，"non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I fear my answer may disappoint you, wolf. There has been no great miracle. No rays from the skies that shone down upon me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼，恐怕我的答案会让你失望。没有什么伟大的神迹。天空中也没有什么光芒照耀着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? I am curious, why did you lie ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？我很好奇，你为什么要撒谎 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I am jealous ! Most are not so lucky to have an event they can point to that is so ferme, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我可真羡慕 ！大多数人都没那么幸运，能遇到这么好的事情，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, then our answers are the same. I have never known un miracle, save perhaps le Cardinal's arrival to the Cathédrale.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，那我们其实是一样的。我也从未见过神迹，或许除了主教来到 Cathédrale 那次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, I have always simply felt as though there has been a présence in my life that has been there to guide me. A benefactor that smiles and points when I reach the crossroads, nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，我只是一直感觉到我的生命里好像有一个 présence 一直在带领我。像一位在我走到十字路口时微笑着指引我的恩人，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Neither do I ! But the possibilities are now endless !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也不知道！但现在可能性是无穷无尽的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Peut-être ! Because the possibilities are now endless !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Peut-être ！但现在可能性是无穷无尽的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you say it does not bring you much peace... this breaks my heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而你说过这并没有给你带来多少平安……这让我感到心碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will not tell you what to do. And I will not tell you what roads to seek.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不会告诉你该去做什么。我也不会告诉你该寻找什么路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But your question was about why I believe, and I was quite rude in turning it about-face, je m'excuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但你刚刚问问我的是我为什么信，我却失礼地将问题抛回给你，je m'excuse。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even then, that was an act of man and science, not the Luminaries, non ? This sérum that gave me the gift of flight -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 即便如此，那也是人类和科学的成果，而不是双耀神，non ？这个赐予了我飞行能力的血清——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But you say it does not bring you much peace ? This breaks my heart...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是你说过这并没有给你带来多少平安 ？这让我感到心碎……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think your faith may be the strongest of them all, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为你的信仰可能是所有人中最坚定的，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, thinking me silly for believing in the Luminaries is one of the most polite things you can think about someone with a differing faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，如果别人只是觉得我信双耀神有点傻，那已经算是对不同信仰的人非常客气了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil should be very afraid ! Beware, evil one ! The light shall smite thee from above !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔应该非常害怕 ！小心，邪恶之人 ！光将从上方击打你 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For I am a poor shelter in this Void storm in which you have found yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因为在你们所处的这场虚空风暴中，我只是一个简陋的避难所。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know what instinct drove you to tell me such things. But I am glad you have spoken the truth, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道是什么本能驱使你对我说了这样的话。但我很高兴你现在说的是真话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh... you did not need to tell me such things to know me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦……你不必为了了解我去撒这样的谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is the product of a man. But I believe that it was Sol who guided our roads to come together as one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是出自人类之手。但我相信，是太阳神亲自带领，让我们的道路交汇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It sounds to me as though you wander in the woods, desperately seeking a trail that you wish to be there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在我看来，这听起来就像你在树林里徘徊，拼命地寻找一条你希望存在的路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To walk the trail in the woods simply with the hope in your heart to lead the way ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你仅凭心中的盼望就走在林间小路上，由它带领你前行 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It offends me none, and I am glad for your honesty, always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这并没有冒犯到我，而且我一直为你的坦诚感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It could be, I do not know. Perhaps the devil is right, and it is all product of science we do not yet understand. The two are not exclusive, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 可能吧，我不知道。也许恶魔是对的，这些事只是我们尚不了解的科学。可这两者并不矛盾，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I wonder if you do not find yourself upon a crossroads, and you may wish to think upon which way to go, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过​我​在想，​你有没有觉得自己处​于​十字​路口，​需要思​考​该​走哪​条路的感觉，​non ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A soul is more than the faith they wear. I am une Sœur de Sol, but I would hope you see more than that in me, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一个灵魂不只有信仰。我虽然是 une Sœur de Sol，但我希望你看到的不只我这一面，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is why I believe. I feel Sol beside me when I arrive at the places when I am most unsure. I shut my eyes et il est là, to guide me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这便是我信的理由。在我最迷茫的时候，我能感觉得到太阳神就在我身边。我闭上双眼，et il est là，带领我前行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know if you will ever find it, but I pray that you will. For what you might discover there will be un miracle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道你能否找到它，但我祈祷你能找到。因为如果你发现了什么，那必定是一个神迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is beautiful...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真的很美好……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sainte Mère Sol, vous avez béni votre fille aujourd'hui ! HA-HA !!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Sainte Mère Sol，vous avez béni votre fille aujourd'hui ！哈哈 ！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Obligation is no reason to believe. It only breeds doubt at best, and hollow contempt at worst.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因义务而信并非真正的信。那种信只会带来怀疑，最坏的情况甚至会变成空洞的轻蔑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There are as many topics that we could choose as there are stars in the sky !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们能谈的话题跟天上的星星一样多 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faith should be a balm to the soul. Not a crutch nor an excuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 信仰应该是心灵的慰藉，而不是拐杖或借口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and I know I am lucky. And it is a peace that is easy to seek to impose upon others, whether or not they want to have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我也知道自己很幸运。而这种平安很容易让人想强加给别人——不管对方是否愿意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, many times. And in those moments, I reflect upon why. Perhaps I am meant to simply find my own way, non ? Ou peut-être que je suis une folle après tout, hah ! We are not always meant to know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有啊，很多次。每当那时，我会反思为什么。也许那段路我注定要自己摸索，non ？Ou peut-être que je suis une folle après tout，哈哈 ！不是所有事我们都能知晓的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and I pray that you will have it some day. But it is not something that can be given or taught, it is something that must be found.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我祈祷你有一天能拥有。但这不是别人能给或教的，而是你必须自己去寻找的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I forgive you. If you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我原谅你。如果你像里昂那样，我会说，你应当受十鞭子作为代价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and if you were like Lyon, I would tell you ten lashes was your payment ! But you are not. And you are forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，如果你像里昂那样，我会说，你应当受十鞭子作为代价。但你没有。你已被原谅了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But as long as I am harming no one with my beliefs, I see no harm in holding them, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但只要我的信仰没有伤害任何人，我认为持守自己的信并没有什么不好，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Within or without, where it may lay is different for everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论在心里还是在生活中，每个人找到它的地方都是不同的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: One thing has become clear to me though as of late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但最近我明白了一件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am growing to also have faith in you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我渐渐也开始相信你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Fie ! I must go. The devil is eager to use this contraption. À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呸 ！我得走了。恶魔正急着用这个玩意儿呢。À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! I am unfond of cut flowers. If you wish to get me a gift, I pray it will not be roses in a vase.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！我不喜欢鲜切花。如果你想送我礼物，我希望不要是插在花瓶里的玫瑰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Because the devil told me you were going to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因为恶魔告诉我你会这么问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Oh, forgive me ! I am sorry. What is it that you wished to ask ? Et maintenant, je suis mortifiée...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！哦，请原谅我 ！对不起。你想问什么 ？Et maintenant，je suis mortifiée……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, non, non... You were not going to ask me that, were you ? Ah !! Je vais lui faire bouffer un de ces livres !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，non，non……你不是要问我这个，是吗 ？啊 ！！Je vais lui faire bouffer un de ces livres ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What is it that you wished to ask ? Et maintenant, je suis mortifiée...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你想问什么 ？Et maintenant，je suis mortifiée……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am not so grand. You may wish to come back to talk to me tomorrow. I will not be the best of company.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我没那么高尚。你明天再来找我聊吧。我可不是个好伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: C'est vraiment gentil, but it is an old problem... nothing worth troubling yourself over. I will be fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: C'est vraiment gentil，不过这已经是个老问题了……不值得你费心。我会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are so very kind, and... very well. I am being little stubborn Marie again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你真是太好了，而且……好吧。​我​又​变回​那个​有点​固执​的​玛丽​了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, tu as raison. I am being little stubborn Marie again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，tu as raison。​我​又​变回​那个​有点​固执​的​玛丽​了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is a hard thing to explain, but I will try. Mes pieds, oui ? My feet. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这很难解释，但我会尽力解释。Mes pieds，oui ？是关于我的脚。血清改变了我，让我可以飞翔——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par les Luminaires, I am so very sorry. You understand then, what it is like, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par les Luminaires，我真的很抱歉。那么你明白那是什么感受，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I still feel them, those twisted things that threatened to consume me, threatened to crush all hope and joie from my soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我仍然能感觉到它们，那些扭曲的东西威胁着要吞噬我，威胁着要粉碎我灵魂中的所有希望和欢乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To have a body that betrays you, that slows your spirit down. Even now, it is so strange. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 拥有一具背叛你的身体，它拖慢你的精神。即使是现在，这感觉也如此奇怪。血清改变了我，给了我飞翔的能力——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Always they hurt. Always. Even now, as I sit here, if I think of them, I feel the pain. But it is not always enough that I notice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它们还是很痛。一直都是。即使现在，我坐在这里，只要一想到它们，我就会感到疼痛。只是并不总是强烈到我会注意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Still, now, they wake me in the night from aching. And I wonder, Sol, pourquoi ? Why must I still feel this... agonie interminable ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 直到现在，它们还是会在夜里让我从疼痛中惊醒。我不禁纳闷，太阳神，pourquoi ？为什么我还要感到这种……无休止的痛苦 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What purpose does it serve ? Ah, but then the morning comes, and I laugh, and tell myself, "be quiet, Marie, you are blessed. Look at all you have, all that you can do."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这究竟有什么意义呢？啊，但第二天早晨来临，我笑了，并告诉自己："安静点，玛丽，你是被祝福的。看看你拥有的一切，看看你能做的一切。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: At the Cathédrale it was "You can read, you can write, you can eat, you can sleep. You can move about well enough. You have eyes to see and a tongue to speak. Hands with which to write. Those who care for you." And now, I can fly! I can protect the futur from the Void itself. From l'Indifférence !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在 Cathédrale 里，我会对自己说"你可以读书，可以写字，可以吃饭，可以睡觉。你可以自由行动。你有眼睛可以看，有舌头可以说话，有双手可以书写，还有那些关心你的人。" 现在，我可以飞翔了 ！我可以保护未来免受虚空、免受虚空无情之物的侵袭 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "Weep now, silly girl, this constant pain will make you strong against what will come," I tell myself. And the day moves into another and it is not as bad when the next one comes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "哭吧，傻丫头，这持续的痛苦会让你坚强地面对未来的一切。"我对自己说。一天又一天过去了，新的一天到来时，似乎也没有那么痛了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A parishioner once asked me, "you are in pain? Always?" To which I replied, "Oui, monsieur. Je le suis." His look of astonishment was mixed with horror.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一位教友曾经问我："你还疼吗 ？一直都疼吗 ？"我回答说："Oui，monsieur。Je le suis。" 他惊讶的表情中夹杂着恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes, I used to sit and think of how much I could do if I were not in so much agonie, oui ? If I were not so... trapped in a cage of flesh that was so set upon hindering me at every turn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有​时​我​坐下​后，​一​想到​如果​我​没有​那么​痛苦，​我​能​做​多​少​事情，​ou​i ？​如果​我​没有​那么​……​被​困​在​一​个​处处​阻​碍​我​的​肉体​牢​笼里。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Would I wish there was. Mais non, there is not. Not in my time, and I fear likely not in this one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我当然希望有。Mais non，并没有。在我的时代没有，恐怕这在这里也不太可能。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "How do you go on?" was his next question. And I remember I smiled to him and replied "What is my other choice, Monsieur...?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "那你是怎么撑下去的？"他接着问。我记得我笑着回答："Monsieur，我还有别的选择吗…… ？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How furious it would make me ! How jealous I would become of those whose bodies were not born a betrayal to them. But what good does it do us in the end, à part rendre nos vies plus amères ? More embittered ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我就会感到非常愤怒 ！非常嫉妒那些生来没有被身体背叛的人。但到头来，这又能给我们带来什么益处呢 ？à part rendre nos vies plus amères ？只会愈加苦涩吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Some ailments are beyond the cures of man, science, and faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有些疾病，是人类、科学和信仰都无法治愈的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Aucun. I am how I am, and I shall persevere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Aucun。我就是我，我会坚持下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, I am simply sorry you have shared in such a similar agonie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，我只是很抱歉你也经历了这种相似的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And so shall you. So shall you. In this, I have faith.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而你也一样。你也一样。对此，我充满信心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I cannot put into words how much this conversation has meant to me. So I will simply say merci, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我无法用言语表达这次对话对我有多重要。所以漂泊者，我只想说声 merci。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Et encore merci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Et encore merci。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, though I feel as though I know what this is about... I have behaved poorly. Who told you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，虽然我感觉我知道你要谈什么……我表现得很糟糕。是谁告诉你的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bien sûr, ce salaud de diable ouvre sa bouche et vous raconte tout ! Il ne cherche qu'à m'embarrasser !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bien sûr，ce salaud de diable ouvre sa bouche et vous raconte tout ！Il ne cherche qu'à m'embarrasser ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Si je le pouvais, je prendrais ce couteau qu'il aime tant utiliser pour agacer les autres et je le fourrerais là où seule Lua peut le voir !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Si je le pouvais，je prendrais ce couteau qu'il aime tant utiliser pour agacer les autres et je le fourrerais là où seule Lua peut le voir ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think it is, but I think you are wishing to spare my mood. So... I will not press you for more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 确实，但我觉得你大概是不想让我心情更糟。所以……我就不追问了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think you are lying to spare my mood, so... I will not press you for more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得你大概是不想让我心情更糟而撒谎。所以……我就不追问了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgive me. That was... untoward. I am une Sœur de Sol, and I must not lose my temper or loosen my tongue in such a way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请原谅我。那……太不合适了。我是 une Sœur de Sol，我不能这样发脾气，也不能这样乱说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish to keep what little dignity in this conversation that I might be allowed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望在这次谈话中，还能保留我那一点点尊严。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: My anger is not directed at you. And I am always grateful for your honesty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的愤怒并非针对你。而且我也一直感激你的坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If you have come to speak with me about the row I had with M'sieur Tagfer, I shall not deny it occurred.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你是为我和标弃先生之间的争吵而来，我不会否认，这件事确实发生过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I assume the devil told you what the fight was regarding?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我猜恶魔已经告诉你这场争吵是为了什么了 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil sees three wounded animals and knows he can easily wield his charisme to have them fawning over him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔看到三只受伤的动物，就知道他可以轻易地运用他的 charisme 让它们对他俯首称臣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. M'sieur Tagfer were arguing over the topic of le Cardinal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的。标弃先生因为主教的话题一直在吵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know why the devil would have you believe such a thing. Or to what end it would serve him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道恶魔为何要让你相信这样的事。也不知道这对他有何好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know why the devil would have you do such a thing. Or what ends he believes it would serve him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道恶魔为何要让你做这样的事。也不知道他认为这对他有何好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He does this to turn the tide against me. He wishes to corrupt me against le Cardinal. To see me turn my back against him. I know it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他这么做是为了扭转局势，使局势对我不利。他想引诱我堕落，让我背叛主教。他想让我背叛他。我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All acts of supposed kindness toward me from the devil are in service of his goal - to turn me against le Cardinal. I know it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔对我所有所谓的好心，都是为了实现他的目的——让我背叛主教。我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But... that is not what you are here to discuss. The fight was in regards to le Cardinal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但……你来这不是为了讨论这个。这场争吵是因为主教。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it was the topic of le Cardinal that M'sieur Tagfer and I were arguing over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我和标弃先生争论的话题就是关于主教。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And this is what I do not understand ! Look at what they have been given !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这正是我不明白的地方 ！看看他们都得到了什么 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! He called me stupide. He told me that I am nothing but a child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！他骂我是笨蛋。他说我除了是孩子就什么都不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. I made mention of le Cardinal, I do not even know what it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。我只是提到了主教，但我甚至都不知道原因是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Worse, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许更糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: M'sieur Tagfer rolled his eyes and snorted. I asked him to explain his derision.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 标弃先生翻了个白眼，哼了一声。然后我请他解释一下他为什么嘲笑我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "You're a spawnling, Marie ! Innocent. Dependent on others your whole life. Curled up in your little nest of blind faith !"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "玛丽，你只是个小崽子 ！天真。一辈子都要依赖别人。蜷缩在你那盲目信仰的小窝里 ！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "Albrecht is a dirty, stinking liar !"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "阿尔布雷希特就是个肮脏、臭气熏天的骗子 ！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "Surviving on what your elders chewed up and spat into your credulous gaping mouth-hole !"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "靠着长辈们嚼碎并吐进你那张大嘴巴里的东西活着 ！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Et j'ai répondu, "Look at the gifts you were given - the gifts of thought, of language, of Self!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Et j'ai répondu，"看看你被赋予的恩赐——思想的恩赐、语言的恩赐、自我的恩赐！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "You should be grateful to le Cardinal for all he has blessed you with."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "你应该感谢主教给予你的一切祝福。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It still does not give him a right ! I do not know if he realizes how deep his words cut me. En outre -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那也不能成为他说那些话的理由 ！我不知道他是否意识到他的话伤我有多深。En outre——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, I do not know if he knows how deep the knife of his words cut me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，我不知道他是否意识到他的话伤我有多深。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If this is the welcome le Cardinal looks forward to enjoying upon his return, it is no wonder he stays away !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果这就是主教期待归来时受到的"欢迎"，那么他不回来也就不足为奇了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I am certain you take M'sieur Tagfer's side in all this, non ? You believe le Cardinal to be a monster just the same as the beast does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我敢肯定，对于这一切事，你是站在标弃先生一边的，non ？你和野兽一样，都认为主教是个怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am surprised, je pensais que tu étais de mon côté ! Were you not joining me in championing le Cardinal's cause but a moment ago ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很惊讶，je pensais que tu étais de mon côté ！你刚才不是和我一起支持主教的事业吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know they were made by the Void at le Cardinal's hands. All of us have been given gifts by le Cardinal that are a curse if viewed with a broken heart !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道它们是通过主教之手在虚空中被造的。我们所有人都曾被主教赐予了恩赐，但若以一颗破碎的心去看待，它们就如同咒诅 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What does it matter, as you said before ? We are to serve him in his deeds and judge him later. This fight is meaningless, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像你之前说的，这有什么关系 ？我们只管服侍他，评判的事留到以后。这场争吵毫无意义，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Has this been some great deception of yours ? Have you been playing un jeu with little Marie ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你这是在扮演个大骗子吗 ？你跟小玛丽在玩什么 un jeu ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: All of us have been abandoned by him ! Tell me, how are they so much more wronged, that I must tolerate such hate ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​所有​人​都​被​他​抛弃​了​ ！​那​你​告诉​我，​他们​究竟​受​了​多​少​冤屈，​我​凭​什么​还​要​承受​这样​的​仇恨​ ？！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ?! Then tell me why !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？！那告诉我为什么 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? Then do play the role of La Lumière Sacrée de Sol and banish the darkness ! Enlighten little foolish Marie !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？那就请你扮演 La Lumière Sacrée de Sol，驱散黑暗吧 ！启发愚蠢的小玛丽 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Yes, it is not good enough that he is attempting to save the known universe from a god of the Void, non ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！是的，他在尽力从虚空之神手中拯救这个宇宙，这还不够吗，non ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non ! You began this conversation, and you will continue it. Explique !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non ！是你开始了这话题的，你得说完。Explique ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If you are attempting to inspire me to sympathize instead with them and turn my wrath upon you, I am suddenly tempted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你是在试图激起我的同情，让我转而同情他们，并将我的愤怒发泄到你身上，我突然很想这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps it is best we adjourn here. Before tempers get the best of all of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也​许​我们​最好​就​此​打住。​以免​大家​的​情绪​失控。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you have failed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？可惜，我很高兴地告诉你，你失败了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps it is best we adjourn here. Before tempers get the best of all of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也​许​我们​最好​就​此​打住。​以免​大家​的​情绪​失控。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have made your case. And... it has been heard. I must go. I have much to think about. We will discuss this again soon when my thoughts are clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你已经陈述了你的理由。而且……我听进去了。我得走了。我还有很多事情要思考。等我想清楚了，我们再继续谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You... have given me much to think about. I fear I have no words. I must... I must go, and we will discuss this again soon, when my thoughts are clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你……让我思考良多。我恐怕无话可说。我必须……我必须走了，等我想清楚了，我们再继续谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter ! I have been scheming, thinking over what you said of the family above us. And how they might see us as interlopers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者 ！我一直在想，琢磨着你说的那些关于楼上那家人的话。他们可能会把我们当成闯入者什么的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter ! I have been thinking over what you said of the family above us. My heart breaks for them...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者 ！我一直在想你说的那些关于楼上那家人的话。我为他们感到难过……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why is it we cannot go upstairs ? Why can we not speak to those who called le Cardinal famille ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么我们不能去楼上 ？为什么我们不能和那些主教的 famille 说话 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: As the "other family" in compétition, oui ? This troubles me so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 作为 compétition 中的"另一个家庭"，oui ？这让我很困扰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We do not compete for the love of le Cardinal, how can we help them see this ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们不是来抢主教的爱，我们该怎么让他们明白这一点呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How goes your work mending their inner strife ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你调解他们家庭矛盾的进展如何 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par les Luminaires... You mean that we are all down here in secret ?! Is that why we are not allowed to leave this place ?! Mais pourquoi ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par les Luminaires……你是说我们都在这里秘密活动 ？！所以才不让我们离开这里 ？！Mais pourquoi ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And what could you possibly be distracted by ? What could be more important than sitting down and sorting through the complaints of mécontents ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还有什么能让你分心呢 ？还有什么比坐下来处理那些 mécontents 的抱怨更重要呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What could be difficult about sitting down and sorting through the complaints of mécontents ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 坐下来处理那些 mécontents 的抱怨有什么困难呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, magnifique !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，magnifique ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! As you are so often wont to remind me, you believe him to be un monstre ! With nothing but spite and emptiness in his heart !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！毕竟你经常提醒我，你认为他是个怪物 ！他心里只有怨恨和空虚 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am well aware of our unsettled disagreements regarding le Cardinal. I am attempting to keep this conversation civilisée.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很清楚我们在主教问题上仍有分歧。但我有在尽力保持这次对话的 civilisée。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I thought you were on my side in this war for le Cardinal's soul ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我还以为在这场为主教的灵魂而战的战争中，你是站在我这边的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I thought you had not made up your mind about le Cardinal ? Or has this now changed ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我记得你还没想好怎么看待主教的事 ？还是说现在你的想法已经改变了 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I understand how you may not wish to discuss mending rifts without finding opportunities to point at those you feel are to blame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我理解，如果没有找到机会指责那些你认为应该受到指责的人，你可能不太愿意谈如何修复裂痕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do not speak to me of scabbed wounds, wolf. I am still licking my own from our last discussion of le Cardinal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼，别跟我提那些结痂的伤口了。上次我们讨论主教留下的伤口，我至今还在舔舐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, but you said it before - we must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，但你之前说过——我们应该停止为我们遭受的这些伤害互相指责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you believe le Cardinal is some kind of horrible monstre for causing such wounds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你认为主教是个可怕的怪物，因为是他造成了这些伤口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are on my side of this war for le Cardinal's soul, for which I shall be forever grateful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道在这场为主教的灵魂而战的战争中，你是站在我这边的，对此我将永远心怀感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And while I know the others are quick to blame him, I do not wish to see us divided and bleeding when we could be whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我知道其他人急于怪罪于他，但我不希望看到本可以团结一致的我们却陷入分裂和流血。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are withholding judgement on him, for which I am immensely grateful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你不会对他做出评判，对此我深表感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. This, I am learning with M'sieur Tagfer...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。我正从标弃先生那学到这个……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I am learning that it is not all to the same degree, as you were so "kind" to point out to me, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而且我了解到，不是每个人的情况都相同，正如你如此"好心"地向我指出的那样，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, yes ! While I do not blame le Cardinal for leaving, for his work is sacro-saint -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，是的 ！不过我并不怪主教的离开，因为他所做的事是神圣的——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I know you believe le Cardinal is some kind of horrible monstre for causing such wounds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你认为主教是个可怕的怪物，因为是他造成了这些伤口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are on my side of this war for le Cardinal's soul, for which I shall be forever grateful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道在这场为主教的灵魂而战的战争中，你是站在我这边的，对此我将永远心怀感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are withholding judgement on him, for which I am immensely grateful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你不会对他做出评判，对此我深表感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And while the others are quick to blame him for their pain, I simply do not wish to see us divided and suffering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 尽管其他人急于将他们的痛苦怪罪于他，但我只是不希望看到我们分裂和受苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, though I am learning - as with M'sieur Tagfer, that perhaps not all to the same degree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。尽管我正从标弃先生那——学到这个，但也许每个人的情况并不相同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I tease, I tease ! I cannot fathom how busy you are, and all the places - and times - you are needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我开玩笑的，开玩笑的 ！我真无法想象你有多忙，有太多的地方、太多的年代都需要你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I tease, I tease ! I cannot fathom what they have endured. And how challenging it is for you to untangle it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我开玩笑的，开玩笑的 ！我无法理解他们经历了什么。而你要解开这一切又是多么困难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply worry that without their issues mended, we could never hope to be welcome at their table. The greater problem remains unsolved -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只是担心，如果他们的问题不解决，我们永远不可能被他们接纳。更大的问题仍然没有解决——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And while I understand the two topics are inexorably linked, I would ask you to keep it productive this day, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我知道这两个话题是密不可分的，但我还是希望今天的谈话是有成效的，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What is this deception of yours, wolf ? Or is little Marie only un jeu to you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼，这是你的什么骗局？还是说小玛丽只是你的 un jeu ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not agree with blaming le Cardinal either, mind, but I do not wish to see us divided and bleeding when we could be whole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​并不​认同​对​主教​的​责怪，​但​我​不​希望​看到​本​可以​团结​一​致​的​我们​却​陷入​分裂​和​流血。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer, regardless of who is ultimately at fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们应该停止为我们遭受的这些伤害互相指责，无论最终是谁的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We must all stop blaming each other for these wounds we suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们应该停止为我们遭受的这些伤害互相指责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I seek to aid us all in this... strange coexistence we have found ourselves, not to argue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想帮助我们所有人解决这个……我们发现的奇怪的共存问题，而不是吵架。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you needn't do so any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？很好，我很高兴地告诉你，你不需要再这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you have failed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？可惜，我很高兴地告诉你，你失败了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I agree. But I cannot be the one to bridge the gap between us. I don't know how to do it ! I am a stranger to them upstairs...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我同意。但我无法成为弥合我们之间裂痕的人。我根本不知道该怎么做 ！对楼上的人来说我就是个陌生人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: While I can see the logic behind the decision to protect them from the pain le Cardinal has caused by his necessary departure...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我能理解那个决定背后的逻辑，就是为了保护他们免受主教必须离开而造成的痛苦……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui... I see the logic. I would work to mend their family, if you can, then, non ? It seems to be the only hope any of us have to get out of this place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui……我明白其中的逻辑。如果可以的话，我也会努力修复他们的家庭，non ？这似乎是我们所有人离开这里的唯一希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, not the devil - anyone but the devil. But you are on to something. The natural choice is Monsieur Loid, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，不能是恶魔——除了恶魔，谁都可以。不过你说对了。首选自然是洛德先生，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do think it needlessly cruel, don't you ? They might think him dead. Or worse ! And we, living here, comme des rats d'égout ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我确实觉得这太残忍了，你不觉得吗 ？他们可能会以为他死了。或者更糟 ！而我们，住在这里，comme des rats d'égout ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lest we spend the rest of our lives trapped living here, comme des rats d'égout.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 以免我们余生都被困在这里，comme des rats d'égout。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, oui ! C'est ça ! But how do we convince him ? He has been stalwart in his position, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，Oui ！C'est ça ！但我们怎么说服他呢 ？他可是一向立场坚定，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But how do we convince him ? He has been stalwart in his position, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我们怎么说服他呢 ？他可是一向立场坚定，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也很想哪天见一下那位朋友，但这不是我要说的重点，傻狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know. It is Monsieur Loid's, and everyone else's decision, to make themselves known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道。是否让自己被世人知道，是洛德先生，以及所有人的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would suggest that it is a sense of guilt, not nobility, that keeps us down here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为，将我们困守于此的并非崇高情操，而是负罪感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would love to meet them some day, but that is hardly the point I am making, silly wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也很想哪天见一下那位朋友，但这不是我要说的重点，傻狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Thank you. I do not know if you will succeed, but sometimes, we can only help but to try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢。我不知道你是否会成功，但有时候，我们能做的只有去尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He likes us well enough, he is kind and he is gentle. But we are étrangers to him, newcomers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他挺喜欢我们的，他很善良，也很温柔。但我们对他来说是 étrangers，是新来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah bon ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ah bon ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That we hide some great and terrible sin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们是在躲避某种重大而可怕的罪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will think on it. You do the same ! A solution will be found, Sol has guided us this far !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会好好想想的。你也一样 ！一定会找到答案的，毕竟太阳神已经带领我们走到今天 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it is that sin that must be forgiven, or proven to be false, perhaps ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许，这种罪孽必须被宽恕，或者被证明是错误的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non ! He is a liar, he is a manipulator, he would only do this in exchange for some great fee !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non ！他是个骗子，是个操纵者，他这么做只是为了换取更大的回报 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We will find a way to convince Monsieur Loid to walk up those stairs... I know it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们会找到办法说服洛德先生走上那些楼梯……我深知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We will find another way to convince Monsieur Loid to walk up those stairs... I know it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们会找到另一种办法说服洛德先生走上那些楼梯……我深知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You would be surprised how resilient the soul is. And those that surround me now are so very old, so very tempered by time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 灵魂的韧性会让人惊叹。而如今我身边的存在，都如此古老，如此饱经时间的磨砺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go. Much to think on, much to do. À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。还有很多事要考虑，还有很多事要做。À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go. Much to think on, much to do. À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。还有很多事要考虑，还有很多事要做。À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have surprised them many times. Let them surprise you this once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你已经让他们惊喜过很多次了。就让他们给你一次惊喜吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh Sol, I think you may have solved it !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦太阳神，我想你可能已经解决了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But what is the direction we take, oui ? We must find a means to convince them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我们的行动方向是什么，Oui ？我们得找到一种方法来说服他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am beside myself with excitement - je suis assise ici, remuant sur ma chaise !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很兴奋——je suis assise ici，remuant sur ma chaise ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter ! I have been scheming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者 ！我一直在谋划。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! The little flying robots. The necra... necra... What do you call them ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！那些飞来飞去的小机器人。殁世……殁世……你管他们叫什么 ?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Ha ! They are so persistent in replacing furniture, non ? But I find if you move things... they do the same thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！哈 ！他们总是执着地要换家具，不是吗 ？可我发现，就算你挪动一下位置……他们还是会照样干同样的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What is to stop us from simply moving all the furniture, letting them replace it all, and then... doing it again ? We could sell it all ! Make profit de ce mobilier étrange !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 要是我们干脆把所有家具都搬走，让他们再去换一遍，然后……再来一次呢 ？我们还能把那些东西都卖掉 ！赚一笔 de ce mobilier étrange ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am going to dutifully ignore your sarcasm, because I think this is a worthy experiment. Perhaps we can wall off the devil in a sea of bookcases !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会无视你的讽刺，因为我认为这是值得一试的实验。或许我们可以用成排书架，把那位恶魔困在书海中央 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pff ! I still think this is a worthy experiment. Perhaps we can wall off the devil in a sea of bookcases !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呸 ！我依然觉得这是个值得一试的实验。或许我们能用书柜之海把恶魔困在其中 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Much to do ! À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 事情很多 ！ À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter ? Do you have a moment ? I must speak with you about Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者 ？你有空吗 ？我得和你谈谈里昂的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: When you were trapped in this world of your making, caught in an endless cycle of death, did you have help to escape ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当你被困在这片自己创造的世界里，陷入无尽的死亡循环时，可曾有什么帮助你逃脱 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and it is painful to watch him suffer... Especially now knowing how you have made room in your heart for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，看着他受苦令人心痛......尤其此刻，我明白你已在心中为他留下了位置。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is a hard thing, to predict where the borders may be with him. They often shift from day to day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 预测他的边界所在实属不易。那些界限往往日复一日地变幻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have seen him struggle with the agonies the gods have heaped upon his shoulders. I have known when to be silent at his side, or when to be the proverbial wall upon which he may pound his fists.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我曾目睹他承受诸神加诸肩头的苦痛。我懂得何时在他身旁保持沉默，何时化作那句谚语中的墙壁任他挥舞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mais ça ? This ? This place, the words of the devil, the uncertainty that le Cardinal has caused... This has brought him pain from which I pray he can return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mais ça ？这 ？这个地方，恶魔的言语，主教造成的不确定性......这一切都给他带来了痛苦，我祈祷他能从中恢复过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I suppose... there is nothing left to do but be patient, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我想……除了耐心等待之外别无他法了，不是吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nor to myself, which is why I have come to discuss this with you. I have always been able to console him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我自己也一样，这正是我前来与你商谈此事的原因。我向来都能安抚他——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. I am sorry to waste your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 谢谢。很抱歉耽误了你的时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I find myself taken aback at his rage, his désespoir... he shuns my company in a way that he never has before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 面对他那股狂怒，他那份désespoir……他回避我的方式前所未有，令我措手不及。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pas bien... But how am I meant to choose between my love for my brother and my adoration for le Cardinal ? How must I choose between my famille ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pas bien……可我该如何在对哥哥的爱与对主教的崇拜之间抉择 ？我又该如何在家人之间做出选择 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know, which is why I have come to discuss this with you. I have always been able to console him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道，这正是我前来与你商谈此事的原因。我向来都能安抚他——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What has troubled him so ? Do you know the cause ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是什么让他如此不安 ？你知道原因吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Let us keep this talk of le Cardinal away from this conversation, oui ? I am concerned for the brother of my soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请别在这儿提主教的事，oui ？我只关心我的灵魂​兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not think he did either, but the fact of it remains, oui ? But I appreciate your sentiment. Cela dit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也认为并非如此，但事实已经发生，oui ？不过我理解你的心意。Cela dit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Let us keep this talk of le Cardinal away from this conversation, oui ? I am concerned for the brother of my soul. But... I know what you say is... more and more becoming the clear truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请别在这儿提主教的事，oui ？我只关心我的灵魂​兄弟。但……我知道你说的……正越来越成为不争的事实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you have been no help in these matters, if you talk to him in such a way. Even if one's words are truth, one must be careful how they are delivered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 若你用这种方式与他交谈，在这些事上你可帮不上什么忙。即使你说的是真话，也必须小心表达方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: S'il te plaît, no more talk of le Cardinal. I do not deny that his words add to Lyon's strife, but it cannot be the only cause.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: S'il te plaît，别再提主教了。我并不否认他的言论加剧了里昂的纷争，但那绝非唯一的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, he has been a shelter in the storm for so many... and now he is caught in one himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，他曾是许多人风雨中的避难所……而如今，他自己却深陷风暴之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I suppose... all we can do is be patient and hope that we discover what troubles him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我想……我们能做的就是耐心等待，希望找到困扰他的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have heard him speak that name, Rell - and it breaks my heart to know of the boy's fate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我曾听他说过那个名字，Rell——想到那孩子的命运便令人心碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That devil has caused more woe in his long life than so many ! But I do not think it is the only cause of his strife, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那个恶魔在他漫长的一生中造成的苦难比任何人都多 ！但我认为这不是他一切纷争的唯一原因，不是吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Surgery is not best performed with an axe. This is not the Brittanic Navy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 手术不是用斧头完成的。这里又不是不列颠尼克海军。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Torn from all sides, and not knowing which way to go...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 四面受敌，不知该往哪处前进……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I do not think it is the only cause of his strife ? Lyon follows the path of Lua. La mort est une compagne qui marche à ses côtés.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我认为这并非他内心冲突的唯一原因 ？里昂跟随着月神的道路。La mort est une compagne qui marche à ses côtés。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It has aided his uncertainty... But to put that much value into the words of a devil ? My Lyon knows better than that. I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这加剧了他的迷茫……但他怎么如此轻信恶魔的三言两语 ？我的里昂绝不会如此轻率。我想，如今压垮他的，是诸多因素交织而成的重担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不，我认为是许多事情如今都压在他身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He did not place enough weight in le Cardinal's words to let it pitch him into such darkness. I think it has been many things that now weigh him down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他并未将主教的话放在心上，以至于陷入如此黑暗的境地。我想是种种因素共同压垮了他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. I know you are trying your best. And for this, I am grateful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci。 我知道你已经尽力了。为此，我深表感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How do you aid someone who cannot hear your call, cannot see your light ? Non, Lua has shrouded him in this darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如何帮助一个听不到你的呼唤、看不见你的光芒的人 ？Non，月神已将他笼罩在这片黑暗之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I suppose you are right. We must be those that he can turn to, when all else fails him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我想你是对的。当一切都让他失望时，我们必须成为他可以依靠的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not think even the light of Sol could pierce the veil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我认为即便是太阳神的光芒也无法穿透那层帷幕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Where his faith may be infirm, we must be the ground beneath his feet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当他的信仰摇摇欲坠时，我们必须成为他脚下坚实的土地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If all the unseen voices have turned from welcome fantômes to démons in the shadows that plague him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 倘若所有无形的声响，都已从欢迎的幽灵，化作困扰他暗影中的恶魔——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We must make ourselves all the more real, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们更该让自己变得真实，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That is all we can do, in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 到头来，这就是我们所能做的全部了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui... as do I. But all we can do is stand beside him and pray, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui……我也一样。但我们能做的，只是站在他身边祈祷，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Try. And pray.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 尝试。祈祷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And hope it is not too late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 只盼为时不晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci... I must go. I am sorry if this conversation was not of much use. I fret when I cannot act.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci……我必须走了。若这次谈话未能提供多少帮助，还请见谅。当我无法行动时，内心便充满焦虑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I pray you are correct. I do not know what I would do without him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但愿你说得对。若没有他，我真不知该如何是好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do not think I do not see what you did, sneaking yourself in there first, wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别以为我没看到你干的好事，你偷偷先混进去的吧，狼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter, excusez-moi... Do you honestly believe it is wise to aid the devil ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，excusez-moi……你真的认为帮助恶魔是明智的吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not wish to turn away those seeking absolution or aid, but... I do not think either is what the devil is after.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不想拒绝那些寻求赦免或援助的人，但是……我认为这两者都不是恶魔要找的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is a feral thing. He may come close when you offer food and a warm place to stay, but all that will vanish the moment you are no longer of use to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是个野性十足的家伙。当你给他提供食物和温暖的住处时，他或许会靠近你，但一旦你对他不再有用，这一切便会消失殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He needs something from you. From us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他从你和我们这里，需要一些东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: These lost memories of his, these past horrors of Tau... I worry over what they portend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他失去的记忆，Tau 过去的恐怖……我担心它们预示着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The more we learn, the deeper we delve into his shattered mind, the more unnerved I become. The more the danger becomes clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们了解得越多，对他破碎的心灵探究得越深入，我就越感到不安。危险也越清晰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you think we have uncovered all there is to know inside his shattered mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你认为我们已经揭开了他破碎心灵中所有的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I admit I worry more about what he intends to do with this knowledge, less the knowledge itself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我承认我更担心的是，他打算用这些知识做什么，而不是知识本身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! That is my concern, exactly. But what could it be ? What purpose do we serve him now ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！这正是，我担心的。但那会是什么呢 ？我们现在帮他的目的是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: However he intends to wield this new existence of his, I fear he means to involve us. And I simply wish for us not to go in blinded by the hope he is somehow benign.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不管他打算如何运用他的新身份，我担心他有意将我们卷入其中。我只希望我们不要被他某种程度上的仁慈所蒙蔽而参与进去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bien ! I will at least be at peace knowing then I have other eyes watching that devil. It might help me sleep. Merci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bien ！这样我至少能安心了，因为我知道还有另一双眼睛盯着那个恶魔。这也许能有助我的睡眠。Merci。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, nor am I suggesting that you do. Simply that he is... not to be trusted. Now, or ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，我没想建议你这么做。只是他……不值得信任。现在，甚至永远都不值得信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, but I wonder what the cost of that alliance shall truly be in the end. You may not be glad you paid it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，但我想知道这种结盟最终的代价到底是什么。你可能不会为所付的代价而高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui... I suppose you are right. We cannot be jumping at shadows. We must stand shoulder to shoulder with any of those who wish to see the Indifference defeated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui……我想你是对的。我们不能盲目跟风。我们必须和任何希望看到虚空无情之物被击败的人并肩站在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I only wish to council you to be cautious... he is a monster, wearing the skin of a gentleman. Be careful with him, s'il te plaît ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只想劝你小心点……他是个披着绅士外衣的怪物。小心他，s'il te plaît ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even if you believe the force behind it is not born of a god but of our own minds, it is still a threat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 即使你们相信这背后的力量不是来自神，而是来自我们自己的意念，它仍然是一种威胁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even if he believes the force behind it is not born of a god but of our own minds, it is still a threat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 即使他相信这背后的力量不是来自神，而是来自我们自己的意念，它仍然是一种威胁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? How so ? I do not mean that cruelly, I am truly curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？你怎么会这么觉得 ？我不是故意那么残忍的，我只是真的很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. That is all I could ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci。这就是我唯一的请求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I do not enjoy those who revel in death. And I find his eagerness to shed blood alarming. And the fact that you do not find it unsettling, equally so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我不喜欢那些陶醉于死亡的人。而且我发现他对流血的渴望很可怕。而你却没觉得不安，这也同样令人不安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think those who command any of these "Corpus" or "Grin-ire" that you fight would say the same. They do not think themselves wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，那些指挥着你们对抗的 "Corpus" 或 "Grin-ire" 的人也会这么说。他们并不认为自己错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think those who command any of these "Corpus" or "Grineer" that you fight would say the same. They do not think themselves wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想，那些指挥着你们对抗的 "Corpus" 或 "Grineer" 的人也会这么说。他们并不认为自己错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is too easy to adapt the path of abnegation to the sin of violence, to reject the horror of it, to say that it is meaningless in the name of "what matters."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人们很容易适应克制暴力之罪的道路，拒绝暴力的恐怖，以"重要"的名义说暴力毫无意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: They believe their actions to be just and good and necessary. How do you condone one devil but not another ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他们相信自己的行为是正义的、善良的、必要的。你怎么能宽恕一个恶魔，却不宽恕另一个呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To take pride in the act itself... is too far for me. I do not delight when I must take a life, but he does. So in that way ? We are quite different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为这种行为本身感到自豪……对我来说太过分了。如果我必须杀死一个生命，我并不高兴，但他却高兴。所以从这个角度来说 ？我们很不一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only pray that it is not too late if the devil decides to put that knife of his into your ribs. I do not wish for your last thoughts to be "Marie warned me."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能祈祷，如果恶魔决定把刀插进你的肋骨，我还来得及救你。我不希望你临终前想的是"玛丽警告过我的"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you believe the devil is not a threat ? That he is not dangereux to those around him ? He could do great harm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你相信恶魔不是个威胁吗 ？相信他对周围的人不 dangereux 吗 ？他可能会造成很大的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And what of the horrible acts he has committed ? All the death, all the slaughter ? Were these justified actions in your mind ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那他犯下的那些恐怖罪行又如何呢 ？所有的死亡，所有的屠杀 ？在你看来，这些都是正当的行为吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I adore you for your faith in yourself, even if I bemoan that you have faith in him. So I shall have faith in you, in turn, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我敬佩你对自己的信心，即便我为你对他的信心感到惋惜。所以，反过来，我也会对你有信心，我想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe you mean those words not in the way that I would hope, but I shall not read too much into them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信你这些话的意思并不是我希望的那样，但我不会过多地解读它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go. But again, I beg you - be wary. For my sake, if not for yours, d'accord ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​得​走​了。​不过，​我​再次​请​求​你​——​小​心点。​就算​不​是​为了​你，​为了​我，​d'accor​d ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter, may I speak to you ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，我可以和你说会儿话吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter, the more and more I sit with the knowledge of Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Otak the more it troubles me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，我越是了解殁世械灵先生和奥塔先生，就越是觉得困惑……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I find myself curious as to why there is another face upon his back that resembles a child's scrawl.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我好奇他后面为何还刻着另一张脸，那模样活像小朋友的涂鸦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I asked Monsieur Necraloid if the skull that adorned him belonged to a living soul at one point or another or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我问殁世械灵先生，他身上装饰的头骨是否属于某个曾经活着的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I inquired with Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid both, and neither wished to speak of it, they only told me a name. Otak. And it was with great sadness that they uttered it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我分别询问了殁世械灵先生和洛德先生，但两人都避而不谈此事，只告诉我一个名字：奥塔。他们说出这个名字时，语气中带着深深的悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And Monsieur Necraloid told me that it was "his" skull, though he admitted Monsieur Loid was the "original." Monsieur Loid interjected to tell me that it was a "replicated" version of his own skull.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后殁世械灵先生告诉我，那是"他的"头骨，尽管他承认洛德先生才是"真品"。然后洛德先生插嘴说，那是他自己头骨的"复制品"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So here I am, speaking with you, in hopes you might be able to aid me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以我在这里和你交谈，希望你能帮助我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How can that be ? And what does "replicated" mean ? Is it a real skull ou bien c'est un faux ? Why would Monsieur Necraloid and Monsieur Loid have differing answers ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 怎么会这样 ？"复制品"是什么意思 ？是真的头骨还是假的 ？为什么殁世械灵先生和洛德先生的答案会不一样 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will you tell me the story of poor Monsieur Otak ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能告诉我那个可怜的奥塔先生的故事吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think that is what troubles me. It is the way the two gentlemen consider its origin. One believes it to be sacro-saint, the other a copie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我想这就是让我困扰的地方。是两位先生对这其来源的看法。一位认为它是神圣的，另一位认为是假的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know if it is what the skull is made of that troubles me so. It is its origin. Or perhaps the way the two gentlemen consider its origin. One believes it to be sacro-saint, the other a copie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕不是因为这个头骨的材质让我如此困扰，而是它的来源。又或许是因为那两位先生对它来源的看法。一位认为它是神圣的，另一位则认为它是假的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! You are right, that is the heart of it - or the skull of it - ha. One believes it to be sacro-saint, the other a copie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！你说得对，这才是事情的核心——或者说是源"头"——哈哈。一个人认为它是神圣的，另一个人却认为它是假的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Is this more proof that Monsieur Necraloid has no soul ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这是否进一步证明了殁世械灵先生没有灵魂 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How can Monsieur Necraloid own a soul, when he does not own his own bones ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果殁世械灵先生连自己的骨头都没有，他又怎么会拥有灵魂呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are uncertain if Monsieur Necraloid can own a soul. But I do not know how he could, when he does not own his own bones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你不确定殁世械灵先生是否拥有灵魂。但我不明白如果殁世械灵先生连自己的骨头都没有，他又怎么会拥有灵魂呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am speaking of a very elaborate piece of technology made to resemble a man, am I not ? A phonographe, many many times more complex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我说的是一件非常精巧的仿人科技装置，对吧 ？一台精妙复杂很多倍的留声机。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, do not think I mean for you to be cruel ! Non ! Treasure them, for they are precious, and through no fault of their own are they as they are !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，千万别以为我让你残忍 ！Non ！要珍惜他们，因为他们很宝贵，他们变成现在这个样子并非他们的错 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pauvre petit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pauvre petit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: More proof that the devil and his ilk were right to be condemned. But, perhaps you are right about Otak and his kind, or perhaps it brings you peace to believe so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这进一步证明对恶魔及其同类的谴责是正确的。不过，或许你对奥塔及其同类的看法也是正确的，又或许相信这一点能给你带来内心的平安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I may be wrong, when all is said and done. There is never any harm in showing kindness and respect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 归根结底，我或许错了。展现善意和尊重永远不会有坏处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you are right, but I do not think the Orokin devils knew more of the workings of the soul than we. They were no great gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你是对的，但我不认为那些奥罗金恶魔比我们更了解灵魂的事情。他们并不是什么伟大的神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you are right, or perhaps it brings you peace to believe so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你是对的，也许相信这一点，能让你感到平安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am going to go back to braiding a crown of flowers for Monsieur Necraloid, regardless. He fussed, but I will not be told non !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不管怎样，我都要回去给殁世械灵先生编个花冠。即便他抱怨，我也不会听他的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, that is very wise. I am merely thinking aloud and wondering to you what they are. You are quite right, there is never any harm in showing kindness and respect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，这话很智慧。我只是这么一想，也想知道对于你来说他们是什么。你说得对，表达善意和尊重永远不会有坏处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you are right. And I hope you are ! Whatever the case may be, we must be kind - for they are thinking creatures. And what may think, may feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许你是对的。并且我也希望你是对的 ！无论情况如何，我们都必须善待它们——因为它们是有思想的生物。凡是能思考的，就必然会有感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Whatever the case may be, we must be kind - for they are thinking creatures. And what may think, may feel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论情况如何，我们都必须善待它们——因为它们是有思想的生物。凡是能思考的，就必然会有感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. But it is not his silence that troubles me, I suppose. I asked Monsieur Necraloid if the skull that adorned him belonged to a living soul at one point or another or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。不过我想，困扰我的并非他的沉默。我问过殁世械灵先生，他身上的那颗头骨是否属于某个曾经活着的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And we may be wrong, when all is said and done. There is never any harm in showing kindness and respect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 归根结底，我们或许错了。展现善意和尊重永远不会有坏处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci ! À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci ！À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! It is one of the Rites of Lua. On the anniversary of the passing of a soul, one braids a crown or wreath flowers and places it atop their skull or atop their grave.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！这是月神的仪式之一。在亡灵逝去的周年纪念日，人们会编织一顶花冠或花环，然后将它放在他们的头骨或坟墓上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, I will ! À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，我会的 ！À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Traditional crypts for the dead often had the bodies exposed, oui ? So you could do this. I think some of this survived, even still.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 传统的墓穴通常都是将尸体暴露在外的，Oui ？这样人们就可以给他们戴上。我想有些传统仍保存至今。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I see it reflected in some of the Orokin artwork, with their love of skulls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我看到奥罗金的一些艺术作品反映了他们对头骨的热爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! So much time has passed, and yet the influence remains. It brings me happiness to know even tiny pieces remain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！时间过去这么久了，但影响依然存在。知道哪怕是一点点痕迹依然存在，也让我感到欣慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? Then I look forward to the day I can meet her ! I will tell her I gave him no quarter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？那我期待着见到她的那一天 ！我会告诉她，我可一点都没留情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faux skull or no, Monsieur Necraloid should have a crown. And it makes him so shy when I dote upon him ! He would blush if he could, I think. And this makes me smile.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不管是不是假头骨，殁世械灵先生都应该戴上花冠。我宠他的时候，他竟然会害羞 ！我想，要是能脸红的话，他肯定也会脸红。想想就觉得开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: À la revoyure !

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May we speak ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们可以谈谈吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking over what you said about le Cardinal. That his actions are... a "mix" of benign and foul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​一直​在​思考​你​对​主教​的​评价。​他​的​行为……既​有善，​也​有恶。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking over your words about le Cardinal. That his actions have brought pain to Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​一直​在​思考​你​对​主教​的​评价。你说他的行为给里昂带来了痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking more on our conversation regarding M'sieur Tagfer, and your convincing arguments for why he despises le Cardinal so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在思考我们关于标弃先生的谈话，以及你对他为何如此憎恨主教那令人信服的论据。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking more on my argument with M'sieur Tagfer, and his reasons for despising le Cardinal so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在思考我和标弃先生的争论，以及他如此憎恨主教的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking more on my argument with M'sieur Tagfer. And our argument about that argument.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在思考我和标弃先生的争吵，以及我们围绕那次争吵展开的争论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I feel a great much has been left unsaid regarding le Cardinal. The others seem to walk on eggshells around me, afraid to speak of him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得关于主教，还有很多话没说。其他人似乎在我面前小心翼翼，不敢提起他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know others wish to paint him a cur, a madman, a traitor. But he was not those things to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​知道​别人​会​把​他​描绘成​一​个​混蛋、​一​个​疯子、​一​个​叛徒。​但​在​我​看来，​他​不​是​那样​的​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was abandoned by my family, left on the streets when I was a child, due to being... abnormal. Broken. Unfit for high society.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​小时候​就​被​家​人​抛弃，​流落​街头，​只​因……​不​正常。​身体残缺。​不​适合​上​流​社会。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps it is because I am so accustomed to being abandoned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许是因为我已经习惯了被抛弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps it is because I never had a father to speak of, that I am so willing to forgive him for his absence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也​许正​是​因为​我​从​来​没有​过​父亲，​所以​我​才​如此​愿意​原谅​他​的​缺席。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But the fact remains that I do forgive him. For I see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​事实​是，​我​确实​原谅​了​他。​因为​我​认为​他​的​善行​比​他​的​恶行​更​有​价值。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I pray that Lyon is strong and survives the crisis of faith he suffers, but I do not believe it to be entirely a fault of le Cardinal's making.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我祈祷里昂能够坚强地度过他所遭受的信仰危机，但我并不认为这完全是主教的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So while I appreciate your convincing arguments regarding M'sieur Tagfer and those who have been harmed by him... I still see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你对标弃先生以及那些受他伤害的人提出的论点很令人信服，我也很理解……但我仍然认为他的善行比他的恶行更有价值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So while I appreciate M'sieur Tagfer's ire, and can sympathize with his points, he must find the space in his own heart to forgive le Cardinal. For I see more value in le Cardinal's good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我理解标弃先生的愤怒，也能体会他的观点，但他必须从内心深处找到原谅主教的理由。因为在我看来，主教的善行远比他的恶行更有价值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So while I appreciate everyone's histories with le Cardinal, especially M'Sieur Tagfer, I still see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我很理解大家与主教的过往，尤其是标弃先生，但我仍然更看重他的善行，而不是他的恶行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So while I appreciate everyone's histories with le Cardinal, I still see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我很理解大家与主教的过往，但我仍然更看重他的善行，而不是他的恶行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But do you see how the two are not of equal value ? Resentment and veneration ? I wish for the others to give up their malicious grudges.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但你明白这两者价值并不相等吗 ？怨恨和敬仰 ？我希望其他人能够放下他们的恶意仇恨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And is that what you suggest we do ? Outcast le Cardinal ? I would argue that seems to be what he has done to himself, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这​就​是​你​建议​我们​去​做​的​事 ？​驱逐主教 ？​我​认为​似乎​他​自己​就​是​这样​做​的，​non ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think Lyon suffers from many ailments, much of which owing to doubt in himself and his own mind. Le Cardinal seems to have... only quickened matters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​认为​里昂​承受​着​许多​痛苦，​很​大​一​部分​是​源于​他​对​自己​和​自身​精神​的​怀疑。​而​主教​似乎……​只​是​加速​了​事情​的​发展。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What would you have me do ? Burn an effigy of le Cardinal and denounce him ? Condemn him to the Void, wish him harm like M'sieur Tagfer ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你想让我怎么做 ？烧毁主教的肖像并谴责他 ？把他打入虚空，像标弃先生那样诅咒他 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Were you not speaking to me of how you favored Entrati, same as I, not but moments ago ? What has now changed your mind ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你刚才不是还跟我说过你和我一样偏向英择谛吗？那现在为什么变了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and you are so consistent in your hatred for him ! Has nothing I have said done to soften you toward le Cardinal in turn ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你对他的恨意还真是始终如一 ！我说的话难道一点也没让你对主教心软吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and you seem to think Entrati such a monstre ! You are so quick to dismiss his kindness in turn !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​你​似乎​认定英择谛​是​个​ monstre ！​你​如此​轻易​就​否定​了​他​的​善意​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, and you have been my stalwart companion on this crusade ! I fear that we are alone in such regard - even Monsieur Loid harbors such resentment...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，你一直是我在这场征途中坚定的伙伴 ！恐怕只有我们这么想——就连洛德先生也怀有同样的怨恨……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, and how glad I am to hear it ! I fear that we are alone in such regard - even Monsieur Loid harbors such resentment...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，听到你这么说我真是太高兴了 ！恐怕只有我们这么想——就连洛德先生也怀有同样的怨恨……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Were you not speaking to me of Entrati's monstruosité just moments prior ? What has now changed your mind ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你刚才不是还跟我说过英择谛的 monstruosité 吗？那现在为什么变了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And what is it that I am asking of others that is so grotesque ? To accept forgiveness into their hearts ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 难道我向别人提出的要求很荒谬吗 ？要他们去宽恕很荒谬吗 ？
