/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Noble, if tiresome, to travel through time and space, aiding his mécontents, non ? Surely you must resent him for this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 穿越时空去帮助他那些 mécontents，这固然高尚，但或许也令人疲惫，non ？你肯定会因此怨恨他吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This conversation was a mistake...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这场对话就是个错误……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Together, perhaps we can stand guard against those who would besmirch his good deeds, oui ? But I wonder, against all that surrounds you... why take my side ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许我们可以携手抵挡那些企图玷污他善行的人，oui ？但我想知道，在你所处的一切之中……你为何会站在我这边 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Not that I am complaining, mind !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当然，我不是在抱怨 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know he has found a place inside your heart, and for this I am so truly grateful - perhaps I can finally stop worrying about him, and all this fighting will soon be moot -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​知道​他​已经​在​你​心里​占据​了​一席​之地，​对​此​我​由​衷​地​感激​——​也​许​我​终于​可以​不​再​担心​他​了，​所有​这些​争吵​很​快​就​会​变得​毫​无意义​——​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But of course it bothers me. He is the brother of my soul ! My Lyon is the dearest thing in this world to me, and to see him in pain brings an ache in my chest as if his agonie is my own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​这​当然​让​我​心烦。​他​是​我​的​灵魂​兄弟！​我​的​里昂​是​我​这​世​上​最​珍贵​的​人，​看到​他​痛苦​的​样子，​我​的​胸口​也​一​阵​剧痛，​仿佛​他​的​痛苦​就​是​我​自己​的​痛苦。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Watch your words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，​注意​你​的​言辞。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je ne suis pas naïve, do not speak to me as if I am such !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je ne suis pas naïve，你​不​必​这样​来​跟​我​说话​ ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps he is only lancing a poison so that the body can heal, and this is all merely a necessary cruelty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也​许​他​只是​以​毒​攻毒，​而​这​种​残忍​是​必要​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you have decided to deceive me to get into my good graces... je vois.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以你欺骗我是为了博取我的好感……je vois。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. It seems so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。看起来是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But his fall from faith is not the doing of le Cardinal. The crack in the foundations were there. More pressure was simply added, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​他​的​信仰​崩塌​并​非​主教​的​错。​根基早​已​崩塌，​其实​这​只​是​增加​了​更​多​压力​而​已，​oui ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am well aware le Cardinal is both Lua and Sol - light and dark - good and evil. He is neither, and both, and capable of kindness and cruelty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​很​清楚，​主教​是​月神，​也​是​太阳神​——​光明​与​黑暗​——善良​与​邪恶。​他​既​非​光明，​又​非​黑暗，​既善良​又​残忍。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Watch your words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，​注意​你​的​言辞。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not need to be protected like I am ! Je ne suis pas une enfant naïve !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不需要像现在这样被保护 ！Je ne suis pas une enfant naïve ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Precisely ! Finally, someone who sees sense. It breaks my heart that innocents must be harmed in this war, but all is at stake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没错 ！正是如此 ！终于有人明白事理了。这场战争中无辜者遭受伤害，我也感到无比痛心，但一切都岌岌可危。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? I am... hopeful, but unconvinced. Choose your words more carefully, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？我……希望真的如此，但并不确定。漂泊者，说话要谨慎些……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? Do you think me a child, or a fool ? Choose your words more carefully, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？你觉得我是个孩子，还是个傻瓜？漂泊者，说话小心点……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I - I do not know how to handle this news, given... given our current conversation. I am taken... quite aback by this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……我不知道该如何回应这话，考虑到……考虑到我们目前的谈话。我……真的被吓了一跳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am well aware le Cardinal is both Lua and Sol - light and dark - good and evil. He is neither, and both, and capable of kindness and cruelty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​很​清楚，​主教​是​月神，​也​是​太阳神​——​光明​与​黑暗​——善良​与​邪恶。​他​既​非​光明，​又​非​黑暗，​既善良​又​残忍。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you have taken le Cardinal's side in order to get in my good graces... je vois.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 原来你是为了讨好我，才站在主教那边…… je vois。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And in war, innocent lives are spent. This is sad, but it is fact, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而​在​战争​中，​总会​有​一些​无辜​的​人​白白牺牲。​虽然​很​悲哀，​但​这​是​事实，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is a man who summoned - or perhaps even created - a god ! And now is the only one who stands between it and the destruction of our universe !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​召唤​了​——​甚至​是​创造​了​神 ！​如今，​他​是​唯​一​一​个​可以​阻止​宇宙​毁灭​的​人​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You think I do not know that I was not the only "daughter" he abandoned ?! I am merely the only one who forgives !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​以​为​我​不​知道，​我​并不​是​他​唯​一​抛弃​的​"女儿"​吗 ？！​只是​我​是​唯​一​一​个​原谅​他​的​人​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? I will...forgive you this lie, but consider yourself warned. Choose your words more carefully, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？我会……原谅你撒谎，但漂泊者，你最好记住，说话要谨慎些……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you truly mean to do this now ?! Like this ?! Here ?! Vraiment ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你现在说这话是认真的吗 ？！就这样 ？！在这里 ？！Vraiment ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It seems I am the only one who remembers what is at stake here !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 看来​只​有​我​还​记得​这​里面临​着​什么​危险​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I - I cannot. I cannot continue. Forgive me. We will talk again of this tomorrow, I must gather my thoughts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……我不能。我不能继续下去了。请原谅我。我们明天再谈这件事，我需要整理一下思绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ta gueule !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ta gueule ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... that is not what I meant. This is not a holy war, this is something entirely...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……我不是那个意思。这不是圣战，这完全是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Précisément. And I am certain everyone will come around in time. I am simply glad to have a friend in this matter with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui！Précisément。我相信大家最终都会理解的。我很高兴在这件事上能有朋友支持我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am sure if I were to meet her, I would know about it before long ! Everyone here is so quick to tell me about all their suffering at his hands ! No wonder le Cardinal does not return. I would not spend a single moment here if I were him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​敢​肯定，​如果​我​见​到​她，​我​很​快​就​会​知道​这些​事 ！​这里​的​每​个​人​都​会​立即向​我​倾诉​他们​在​他​手​下​受过​的​苦！​难怪​主教​一​去​不​复返。​如果​我​是​他，​我​一刻​也​不​会​在​这里​待​着​——​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not think it would drive him away ! Do you think le Cardinal would return to this nest of vipères ?! Non ! I would not spend a single moment here if I were him -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​认为​这​会​把​他​赶走​ ！​你​觉得​主教​会​想​回到​这​毒​蛇窝​吗 ？！​不​会​ ！​如果​我​是​他，​我​一刻​也​不​会​在​这里​待​着​——​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you needn't talk to me like I am a child.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你没必要像对待小孩子一样跟我说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Are you so certain ? Everyone here is so quick to tell me about their suffering at his hands ! But never what cause it was in service to !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你就这么肯定吗 ？​这里​的​每​个​人​都​会​立即向​我​倾诉​他们​在​他​手​下​受过​的​苦 ！但却从不提及他究竟是为了什么目的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Where even Monsieur Loid, who claims to love him, cannot help but bemoan his cruelty at every opportunity !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 甚至​连声称爱​他​的​洛德​先生，​也​总是​在​找机​会​怨​他​的​残忍 ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am well aware le Cardinal is both Lua and Sol - light and dark - good and evil. He is neither, and both, and capable of kindness and cruelty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​很​清楚，​主教​是​月神，​也​是​太阳神​——​光明​与​黑暗​——善良​与​邪恶。​他​既​非​光明，​又​非​黑暗，​既善良​又​残忍。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Le Cardinal is fighting a war ! And in war, some innocents must be hurt. It is sad, but it is fact !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​主教正在​打仗​ ！​而​在​战争​中，​总会​有​一些​无辜​的​人​受伤。​虽然​很​悲哀，​但​这​是​事实 ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No one understands le Cardinal. He is fighting a war ! And in war, some innocents will be hurt. It is sad, but it is fact !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没​人理​解​主教。​他​正在​打仗​ ！​而​在​战争​中，​总会​有​一些​无辜​的​人​受伤。​虽然​很​悲哀，​但​这​是​事实 ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ta gueule !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ta gueule ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I told you not to speak down to me. I am done here. And we are done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我告诉过你不要用这种居高临下的语气跟我说话。我不想说了。我们到此为止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do not to speak down to me ! I am no fool, I can see the cost of his actions. I simply do not see it outweigh the scales !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 别用这种居高临下的语气跟我说话 ！我又不是傻子，我看得出来他这么做的代价。我只是觉得他的所作所为得不偿失 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And now you speak to me of faith ?! When it is useful to you ?! Non ! I think not ! I am done here. And we are done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在你居然跟我谈信仰 ？！只有对你有用的时候才谈吗 ？！Non ！我才不跟你谈 ！不想说了。我们也到此为止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ne t'avise pas de me parler de ce dont tu ne sais rien, toi... non. Non ! Non ! Nous en avons terminé !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Ne t'avise pas de me parler de ce dont tu ne sais rien，toi……non。Non ！Non ！Nous en avons terminé ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Enough. I am done arguing in circles !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 够了 ！我不想再兜圈子了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, mon cœur, that is such a kind question for you to ask... I will be all right. I do not mean to trouble you. Best to leave me be until tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，mon cœur，你问得如此体贴……我会好起来的。我并不想让你操心。最好先让我一个人待到明天吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, that is such a kind question for you to ask... I will be all right. I do not mean to trouble you. Best to leave me be until tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，你问得如此体贴……我会好起来的。我并不想让你操心。最好先让我一个人待到明天吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, mon cœur, that is such a kind question for you to ask... but as always, it is... just a matter of comparison, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，mon cœur，你问得如此体贴……但一如既往，这恐怕……不过是种比较而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, mon cœur, that is such a kind question for you to ask... but as always, it is... just a matter of comparaison, I am afraid. But you know what that is like, I am certain, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，mon cœur，你问得如此体贴……但一如既往，这恐怕……不过是种比较而已。不过你一定明白这是什么滋味的，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, that is such a kind question for you to ask... but as always, it is... just a matter of comparison, I am afraid. But you know what that is like, I am certain, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，你问得如此体贴……但一如既往，这恐怕……不过是种比较而已。不过你一定明白这是什么滋味的，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, that is such a kind question for you to ask... but as always, it is... just a matter of comparison, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，你问得如此体贴……但一如既往，这恐怕……不过是种比较而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vraiment gentil of you, but it is an old problem, nothing worth troubling yourself over. I will be fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你真是 Vraiment gentil，不过这已经是个老问题了，不值得你费心。我会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I am afraid. The mind is a truly marvelous thing. I think it is fascinating that they must always hurt, all the time, and yet I have learned to simply ignore them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，恐怕如此。心灵真是奇妙的存在。最令人着迷的是，那些疼痛永远都在，无时无刻不在折磨着我，而我却学会了全然无视它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are doing so now, by talking to me. The mind is a marvelous thing, is it not ? I think that mes pieds must hurt all the time, yet I have learned to simply ignore them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你现在跟我聊天就是在帮我了。心灵真是奇妙的存在，不是吗 ？Mes pieds 肯定时刻都在疼痛，而我却学会了全然无视它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I am quite fine, I assure you. But merci. I appreciate the concern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我很好，放心吧。但 merci。你的关心我很感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ha ! Funny how that is, non ? You are right. I was not thinking about mes pieds, but now I am, and now they hurt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈！有趣吧，现实就是这样，non ？你说得对。我原本没在想 mes pieds，但现在想起来了，现在它们疼了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! You are doing so now, by talking to me. The mind is a marvelous thing, is it not ? I think that mes pieds must hurt all the time, yet I have learned to simply ignore them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！你现在跟我聊天就是在帮我了。心灵真是奇妙的存在，不是吗 ？Mes pieds 肯定时刻都在疼痛，而我却学会了全然无视它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non... it never stops. I can only distract myself, like in conversations like this. Or by staying busy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non……永远不会。我只能转移注意力，比如像这样聊天。或者让自己忙起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The mind is a truly marvelous thing. I think it is fascinating that they must always hurt, all the time, and yet I have learned to simply ignore them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 心灵真是奇妙的存在。最令人着迷的是，那些疼痛永远都在，无时无刻不在折磨着我，而我却学会了全然无视它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are so very kind, and... very well. I am being little stubborn Marie again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你真是太好了，而且……好吧。​我​又​变回​那个​有点​固执​的​玛丽​了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, you are right. I am being little stubborn Marie again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你说得对。我​又​变回​那个​有点​固执​的​玛丽​了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, it is. Par exemple -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，确实如此。Par exemple——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But it is like you said, non ? All inconveniences like mine come with a secret power. We must simply find them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但就像你说的，non ？所有像我这样的不便之处都蕴藏着一种隐秘力量。我们只需去发现它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, it is. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，确实如此。我时常坐在那里，盯着着书架顶端的一本书，想着自己够不着它，多么不公平啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I was dusting all the chandeliers the other day in the Sanctum. Monsieur Loid begged me to stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 前些天我在圣所里擦拭所有的吊灯，洛德先生恳求我停手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is a hard thing to explain, but I will try. Mes pieds, oui ? My feet. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这很难解释，但我会尽力解释。Mes pieds，oui ？是关于我的脚。血清改变了我，让我可以飞翔——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Par les Luminaires, I am so very sorry. You understand then, what it is like, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Par les Luminaires，我真的很抱歉。那么你明白那是什么感受，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you know how tiring it is to have to float all the time, jour après jour, heure après heure, when others may walk ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你知道当其他人可以行走，但你却只能 jour après jour, heure après heure 地被迫漂浮有多累吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But yes, it is frustrating. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但确实，这令人沮丧。我时常坐在那里，盯着着书架顶端的一本书，想着自己够不着它，多么不公平啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That it contained knowledge that I cared about, no one else, so why was I denied it ? And along would come some helpful soul who would pluck it from its place for me out of pity...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它承载着我珍视的知识，其他人都不在意，为什么我却被剥夺 ？然后总会有热心人出于怜悯，帮我从高处取过来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I told him I needed to stay busy, needed to keep my hands moving. I do not think he quite understood why I must stay so active.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我告诉他我需要让自己忙起来，需要让双手不停地动。我认为他不太理解我为何必须如此活跃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Oh, I was dusting all the chandeliers the other day in the Sanctum. Monsieur Loid begged me to stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！哦，前些天我在圣所里擦拭所有的吊灯，洛德先生恳求我停手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But it is like you said, non ? All inconveniences like ours come with a secret power. We must simply find them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但就像你说的，non ？所有像我们这样的不便之处都蕴藏着一种隐秘力量。我们只需去发现它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I know your frustration. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我懂你的沮丧。我时常坐在那里，盯着着书架顶端的一本书，想着自己够不着它，多么不公平啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui !! Oh, you do understand !! Par exemple -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！！哦，你确实明白 ！！Par exemple——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I still feel them, those twisted things that threatened to consume me, threatened to crush all hope and joie from my soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我仍然能感觉到它们，那些扭曲的东西威胁着要吞噬我，威胁着要粉碎我灵魂中的所有希望和欢乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To have a body that betrays you, that slows your spirit down. Even now, it is so strange. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 拥有一具背叛你的身体，它拖慢你的精神。即使是现在，这感觉也如此奇怪。血清改变了我，给了我飞翔的能力——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am ravie to be so mobile, to be able to reach anything I wish, do not mistake me. But it is still so exhausting !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很 ravie 能如此灵活自如，随心所欲到达任何我想去的地方，别误会我的意思。可这依然会疲惫不堪 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it is not their fault, for they are doing an act of kindness - I needed the help. And it is not their fault that I needed it. But oh, how frustrating it is to need that assistance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这不是他们的问题，因为他们是在行善——我也确实需要帮助。而我需要帮助也并非他们的错。但是，哦，需要这种帮助是多么令人沮丧啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is just... so nice to be able to speak of all this. I cannot properly put it into words. It is so rare to be able to discuss this kind of unseen, silent plague I suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 能倾诉这一切……真是太好了。我实在难以言表。能讨论这种无形无声的瘟疫、我所承受的折磨，实在太难得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I told him I needed to stay busy, needed to keep my hands moving. I do not think he quite understood why I must stay so active.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我告诉他我需要让自己忙起来，需要让双手不停地动。我认为他不太理解我为何必须如此活跃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I know your frustration. Oh, I know it well. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我懂你的沮丧。哦，我深有体会。我时常坐在那里，盯着着书架顶端的一本书，想着自己够不着它，多么不公平啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That it contained knowledge that I cared about, no one else, so why was I denied it ? And along would come some helpful soul who would pluck it from its place for me out of pity...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它承载着我珍视的知识，其他人都不在意，为什么我却被剥夺 ？然后总会有热心人出于怜悯，帮我从高处取过来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you know how tiring it is to have to float all the time, jour après jour, heure après heure, when others may walk ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你知道当其他人可以行走，但你却只能 jour après jour, heure après heure 地被迫漂浮有多累吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Always they hurt. Always. Even now, as I sit here, if I think of them, I feel the pain. But it is not always enough that I notice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它们还是很痛。一直都是。即使现在，我坐在这里，只要一想到它们，我就会感到疼痛。只是并不总是强烈到我会注意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I still feel them, those twisted things that threatened to consume me, threatened to crush all hope and joie from my soul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我仍然能感觉到它们，那些扭曲的东西威胁着要吞噬我，威胁着要粉碎我灵魂中的所有希望和欢乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like a tiny little abeille that sits upon my shoulder and stings me every day. Not enough to destroy, just enough to be a nuisance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像一只小 abeille 停驻在我的肩头，日日蜇我。虽不足以致命，却足以惹人烦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah, it just brings me happiness to know that someone here understands what it is like. It is so rare. This silent, unseen plague we suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊，知道这里有人能体会这种感受，我便感到无比欣慰。这实在太难得了。我们承受着这场无声无息的瘟疫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am ravie to be so mobile, to be able to reach anything I wish, do not mistake me. But it is still so exhausting !!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很 ravie 能如此灵活自如，随心所欲到达任何我想去的地方，别误会我的意思。可这依然会疲惫不堪 ！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Always they hurt. Always. Even now, as I sit here, if I think of them, I feel the pain. But it is not always enough that I notice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它们还是很痛。一直都是。即使现在，我坐在这里，只要一想到它们，我就会感到疼痛。只是并不总是强烈到我会注意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Like a tiny little abeille that sits upon us and stings us every day. Not enough to destroy us, just enough to bother us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就像一只小 abeille 停驻在我们身上，日日蜇我们。虽不足以致命，却足以让我们感到烦躁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nothing ! Nothing is wrong. I needed the help. But that is the root of it, I needed the help. And it is, as you said... frustrating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 没问题 ！没什么不对。我确实需要帮助。但这就是问题的根源——我需要帮助。正如你所说……这令人沮丧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! It is not their fault, for they are doing an act of kindness - I needed the help. And it is not their fault that I needed it. But oh, how frustrating it is to need that assistance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！这不是他们的问题，因为他们是在行善——我也确实需要帮助。而我需要帮助也并非他们的错。但是，哦，需要这种帮助是多么令人沮丧啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: As do I ! But in the same way, it makes us part of who we are, non ? Who are we to say what parts of us are the important ones, and what parts are not ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也是 ！但同样地，这也成为了我们自身的一部分，non ？我们凭什么说我们身上的哪些部分重要，哪些部分不重要呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! A tiny little thing, yellow and black, stripes, has a needle on its derrière... produces honey ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！一个小家伙，黄黑相间，身上有条纹， derrière 上还带根针……它还会产蜜 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lua saw fit to make you as you are, and Sol saw fit to make me as I am. We must have faith in their design, non ? Flawed as we may think it from our limited view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 月神认为应当将你塑造成现在的模样，而太阳神认为应当将我塑造成现在的模样。我们理应相信他们的安排，non ？纵使以我们有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The Luminaries saw fit to make us as we are. We must have faith in their design, non ? Flawed as we may think it from our limited view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 双耀神将我们塑造成如今这个样子，我们理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我们有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know our faiths are similar in shape, so I will say that... Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view. I would wonder if you could not consider the same of yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道我们的信仰形式相似，所以我想说……太阳神认为应当将我塑造成现在的模样。我理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。不知道你是不是也以同样方式看待你的信仰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will not speak of faith except to say that... flawed as we must think our forms from this limited view, we must... be at peace with what we are, non ? It is all we have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不想谈论信仰，只是想说……纵然我们从这有限的视角来看，难免认为自身存在缺陷，但我们必须……与自己和解，non ？这是我们所能拥有的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know our faiths are dissimilar in shape, so I will not speak where I am not knowledgeable. But I will simply say that Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view. I would wonder if you could not consider the same of yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道我们的信仰形式不同，所以我不会在不了解的情况下妄加评论。但我只是想说太阳神认为应当将我塑造成现在的模样。我理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。不知道你是不是也以同样方式看待你的信仰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know your faith is personal to you, so I will not pry. But I will simply say that Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view. I would wonder if you could not consider the same of yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道信仰是你的私事，所以我不会多问。但我只是想说太阳神认为应当将我塑造成现在的模样。我理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。不知道你是不是也以同样方式看待你的信仰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you adhere to the belief that none of us can know the true answer to the universe, and I laud and respect that. But I will simply say that Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你坚信我们无人能知晓宇宙的真谛，对此我深表赞赏与尊重。但我只想说，太阳神认为应当将我塑造成现在的模样。我理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you hold no faith of your own, and I respect that. But I will simply say that Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你没有自己的信仰，我尊重这一点。但我只想说，太阳神认为应当将我塑造成现在的模样。我理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will simply say that Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只想说，太阳神认为应当将我塑造成现在的模样。我理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sol saw fit to make us both as we are, and we must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as we may think it from our limited view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 太阳神将我们塑造成如今这个样子，我们理应相信他的安排，non ？纵使以我们有限的视角来看，这似乎也存在缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A bee, abeille ! Pff, it is all the same. Ha !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 蜜蜂，abeille ！呸，都一样。哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It flies about on little wings between flowers - wait. Non. You are playing with me, I know it !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它在花丛间展着小翅膀飞来飞去——等等。Non。你在耍我，我可看穿了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It may be a fool's errand, to try to find peace in the design of a universe whose machinations are likely uncaring, but it is a peace I find nonetheless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 试图从一个或许冷酷无情的宇宙机制中寻找安宁，或许是徒劳的，但我仍从中获得了这份宁静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It may be a fool's errand, to try to find peace in the design of a universe whose machinations are likely uncaring, but it is a peace I find nonetheless. I do wish for you the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 试图从一个或许冷酷无情的宇宙机制中寻找安宁，或许是徒劳的，但我仍从中获得了这份宁静。但愿你也能如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I admit you have brought a smile to my face, wolf. Though you tease me, it was a lovely distraction. Merci, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我承认你让我展露了笑容，狼。尽管你戏弄我，这却是个美好的分心。Merci，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I admit you have brought a smile to my face, wolf. Though you tease me, it was a lovely distraction. Merci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我承认你让我展露了笑容，狼。尽管你戏弄我，这却是个美好的分心。Merci。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But for now, I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过现在，我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This conversation has been a wonderful distraction ! Merci, mon cœur !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这番谈话真是美妙的消遣 ！Merci，mon cœur ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This conversation has been a wonderful distraction ! Merci !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这番谈话真是美妙的消遣 ！Merci ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But for now, I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过现在，我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, bonjour ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，bonjour ！我仔细想过了，oui……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，bonjour，mon cœur ！我仔细想过了，oui……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think... the devil is growing on me. Like lichen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得……我开始喜欢恶魔了。就像苔藓一样一点点蔓延开来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: S'il te plaît, make it stop - soon I will find myself laughing at his jokes. Then I will know I am truly lost !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: S'il te plaît，别再这样下去——再这么下去我怕连他的笑话都会逗笑自己。到那时，我就真的是堕落了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking of how Monsieur Loid is so frightened of speaking to le Cardinal's family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在想，洛德先生为什么那么害怕与主教的家人交谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And how we must break this impasse. This purgatoire in which we are trapped should not stand. It seems so needlessly painful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们必须打破这种僵局。我们现在陷入的这种炼狱不应该继续下去。这种痛苦似乎完全没有必要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour - I have given it some thought... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour——我仔细想过了……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have given it some thought... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，bonjour，mon cœur ！我仔细想过了……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! I have given it some thought... And I am truly loathe to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour——我仔细想过了……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour mon cœur ! I have given it some thought... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour mon cœur ！我仔细想过了……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, mon cœur ! And what are you afraid I will not like ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，mon cœur ！你怕我不喜欢什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! Oh ? And what are you afraid I will not like ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！哦 ？你怕我不喜欢什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I feel as though we need... a bastion of some kind, non ? Do you have any ideas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我感觉我们需要……某种意义上的堡垒，non ？你有什么想法吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe you may be right. The devil may be the missing piece we need. Ah, it pains me even to type the words !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信你说的或许是对的。恶魔或许正是我们需要的那块拼图。啊，光是打出这些字都让我感到痛苦 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think... I think - ah, Sol forgive me - that the devil's assistance may be required. I do not think Monsieur Loid will listen to us otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我想……我只是想想——啊，太阳神，请原谅我——我们或许需要恶魔的帮助。否则，我想洛德先生是不会听我们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil is powerful, and provides certain promises of strength should things go wrong, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔很有能力，而且在事情出错时总会用力量来引诱人，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... hate to admit it, but I think you may be right... Sol forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……很不愿意承认，但我认为你可能是对的……太阳神，请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Are you so sure ? If I can set aside my différences with the devil, certainly so can you, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你这么确定吗？如果连我都能放下与恶魔的 différences，你当然也能，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you think you can convince him to help us, though ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你觉得你能说服他帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会在这件事上帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会在这件事上帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会在这件事上帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I do not have to enjoy it, but it is un médicament we must swallow, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我也不喜欢这样，但我想，这是我们不得不吞下的 un médicament。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! That is... unfortunate. I do not know ? I do not think so... Can you think of another approach with the devil ? Or a way to try again ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！那真是……太可惜了。我不知道 ？我想不到……你能想到其他办法说服恶魔吗 ？或者再试一次 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is helping to protect the family of the man who turned him into protoframe against his will, and cast him into the past, robbing him of his memories...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​居然​在帮忙保护那个男人的家人，尽管那个男人违背了他的意愿将他改造成原型战甲、剥夺了他记忆并将他放逐到过去……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are right, I am... not surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对，我……确实不惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I will support your choice, as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我也会支持你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish you the best of luck. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 祝你好运。那家伙一向固执得要命。有时候，我觉得他就是喜欢唱反调 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think you have a special way of convincing him, where all others have failed, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得你一定有一套能说服他的特别方法，因为其他人都失败了，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I do. But I think you have a special way of convincing him, where all others have failed, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我知道。我觉得你一定有一套能说服他的特别方法，因为其他人都失败了，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, certainly I do. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我太知道了。那家伙一向固执得要命。有时候，我觉得他就是喜欢唱反调 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will speak to Lyon in the meanwhile, but my hopes are exceedingly low.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 同时我也会跟里昂沟通，但我并不抱太大希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have deeply misjudged this devil of ours...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我严重看错了我们这个恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I hope you are correct.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我希望你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. At least you are around to ensure we keep him from following through on his... baser instincts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。至少有你在，我们至少还能不让他顺着那些……原始本能乱来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? What do you mean ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？这是什么意思 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, he certainly does seem to favor you. Perhaps it is because you share a time and a place, where we do not ? Why else would he ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，他似乎真的更喜欢你。也许是因为你们共享同一时空，而我们却不是？不然他为什么会这样呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! That is not what I was implying, pardonne-moi ! Simply that he seems to favor you, so you may have his ear where all others he may ignore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！我不是那个意思，pardonne-moi ！我只是说他似乎更偏爱你，所以虽然他不理其他人，但他可能听​你​的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil is fickle ! C'est la vie, as they say !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔善变 ！正如人们所说的，C'est la vie ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I am not a fool to not see the part you played in ensuring this all came to pass !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也不是傻子，当然看得出你为了促成这一切所付出的努力 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I certainly have no idea what you mean ! I am not insinuating anything at all. I am a purely une innocente Sœur de Sol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我完全不明白你的意思 ！我并没有暗示什么。我只是一个单纯无辜的 Sœur de Sol。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would never imply that since the devil seems to favor you, perhaps he will listen to you where all others he seems to ignore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​绝不​会​暗示，​既然​恶魔​似乎​偏袒​你，​那么​他​或许​就​会​听​你​的话，​因为​他​根本​不​会​听​其他​人​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am simply happy that you are happy. And if the devil has somewhere to spend his... efforts... all the better, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你开心我很高兴。而且如果恶魔也有地方可以消耗他的……精力……那就更好了，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，merci，merci ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci, mon cœur !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，merci，merci，mon cœur ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！到时候我会做好准备，静候佳音 ！在此之前，merci，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！到时候我会做好准备，静候佳音 ！在此之前，merci。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There are always... nuances, oui ? Always reasons for acting one way or another. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 事情总会有……细微差别，oui ？每一种行为的背后都有其缘由。如果你说的是真的，我想我应该试着对他更友善一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There is always a pain we hide from those around us. Something we seek to shelter, for fear others will wield it. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 每个人都有一些不愿示人的痛苦吧。我们会小心将它保护起来，唯恐别人会利用它。如果你说的是真的，我想我应该对他好一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I suppose I am atop that list of late, non ? I suppose I should... consider his reasons, for why he is the way he is. Condemnation saves no souls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想必​我​算​是​这些​人​中​带头​指责​的​人​了​吧？​我​想​我​应该​……​想​想​他​变成​现在​这样​的​原因。​定罪​救​不​了​任何​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No one has ever denied the devil his wit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 从来没有人否认过恶魔的聪明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I cannot imagine the amount of love and loss one must suffer in all those years. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我无法想象一个人在那些年里要承受多少爱与失去。即便我亲眼所见，这一切仍然让我觉得难以置信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes I forget, when I speak to him, how many centuries he has lived. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有时和他交谈时，我会忘记他已经活了很多个世纪了。即便我亲眼目睹了这一切，也仍然觉得难以置信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And never during private moments. Non. Jamais.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而且在私下的时候绝对不会。Non。Jamais。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even more so for us all if you serve as a bit of un ange upon his shoulder to temper him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你能在他身边当个 un ange 让他冷静下来，这对我们所有人都是好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！到时候我会做好准备，静候佳音 ！直到那一天 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, what damage could that cause a soul ? I see why you would wish to find another who understood. And he, you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，那会对灵魂造成什么伤害呢？我明白你为什么会想找一个能理解你的人。而他，也找到了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To have lived so long, to have seen so much death - to have paid so much of it yourself ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 活了这么久，目睹了这么多死亡——其中不少还是自己亲手造成的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am simply glad the devil has someone to speak with who might seek to temper him. Un ange upon his shoulder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很高兴终于有人肯和恶魔交谈，或许还能让他有所收敛。你就像他肩上的 Un ange。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I fear there is a wickedness in him that cannot truly be cured. He enjoys it too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我担心他身上有一种无法真正治愈的邪恶。他太享受这种邪恶了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you are right... what is un ange without son diable ? He reminds us all of what we should strive to avoid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许你是对的……没有 son diable，un ange 又算什么呢？是他提醒了我们所有人，我们应该努力去避免的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! If and when you convince the devil to aid us in our mission, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！如果哪天你成功说服恶魔帮助我们完成任务，我随时待命！直到那一天！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have to tell you the silliest thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，bonjour，mon cœur ！我得告诉你一件特别傻的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! I have to tell you the silliest thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！我得告诉你一件特别傻的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I asked M'sieur Bird Trois what his birthday was, and he did not know ! How terribly sad !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我问鸟 Trois 先生他的生日是什么时候，他竟然不知道 ！真是太悲伤了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: None of the Cavia know their birthdays, which I suppose makes sense, given that they were born without the ability to speak or know the calendrier as we do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 科维兽都不知道自己的生日，我可以理解，因为他们不是一出生就能说话，也不像我们一样知道历法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So I thought, what a tragédie ! We must right this at once, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以我觉得，这真是个 tragédie ！我们必须立刻纠正这件事，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Neither had Monsieur Loid. The look on his face when I discovered this was of pure sorrow...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！洛伊德先生也没有。当我发现这一点时，他脸上满是悲伤……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: At first, I thought to check le Cardinal's records - perhaps he recorded when they were born, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 起初，我想查阅一下主教的记录——或许他记录了他们的出生日期，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: "Let ?" You say it as if it is up to me !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "让？"你这话说的好像这由我决定似的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It breaks my heart that he thinks it is his fault for not thinking of it first. It is not his fault, he does so much for so many...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他竟然认为是自己的错，说自己没有预先想到这一点，这让我心碎。这不是他的错，他为那么多人做了那么多事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We are all blessed to know the kindness of Monsieur Loid. The depth of the well he draws from knows no end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 能遇见洛德先生的善良，我们都是有福的。他的慷慨无私，如活泉一般，永不枯干。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But then I remembered... my conversations with M'sieur Tagfer, and the others, and I thought... that may not be so wise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我随即想起了……我和标弃先生以及其他人的对话，我想……这样做可能不太明智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But they seemed uninterested in finding records of their past. I know how painful it can be, to think of one's origins.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但他们似乎对寻找自己的过去毫无兴趣。我知道，思考自己的身世是多么痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know my own day of birth, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 毕竟我也不知道自己的生日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, that we are. That we all are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，是的。我们都很幸运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is a serious man, but I have seen him smile. There is humor in him, when one least expects it. One just has to be patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他是个严肃的人，但我见过他笑。他身上有种幽默感，总是在意想不到的时候流露出来。你只需要耐心一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: More reasons to weep for you and your minuscule copie. Yet more things we have in common !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 真替你和那小小的复制品感到惋惜。我们又多了些共同点 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not believe they are overrated at all ! We must celebrate those that are still with us, the same that we celebrate those who are gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不这么认为 ！理应给那些还在我们身边的人好好庆祝，离开的那些人也值得我们纪念。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Poignant ? I did not know you spoke any Gaullique ! Did you pick that up from me ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Poignan​t ？​我​竟然​不​知道​你​会​说​高卢语​ ！​你​是​从​我​这​儿学​的​吗 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now ! Come along ! Even if nothing ever comes of this, it is the thought that counts ! Au calendrier !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在 ！加入我们吧 ！就算最后什么结果都没有也没关系，心意最重要！Au calendrier！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now ! Come along, mon cœur ! Even if nothing ever comes of this, it is always the thought that counts ! Au calendrier !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在 ！加入我们吧，mon cœur ！就算最后什么结果都没有也没关系，心意最重要！Au calendrier！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pff ! All the other languages are always stealing the best parts of Gaullique and running away with it ! Times will never change !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 呸 ！其他语言总是窃取高卢语的精华，然后照搬不误 ！时代永远不会改变 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then you are smart ! Gaullique is one of the most beautiful languages to ever be, and I am glad to bring it to this futur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你真是聪明 ！高卢语是历史上最美丽的语言之一，我很高兴能把它带到未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wolf ! My wolf ! I have met Otak ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼 ！我的狼 ！我见到奥塔了 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have met Otak ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我见到奥塔了 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The face upon the back of Monsieur Necraloid ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 殁世械灵先生背上的那张脸 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wolf ! My wolf ! The face upon the back of Monsieur Necraloid ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼 ！我的狼 ！殁世械灵先生背上的那张脸 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He... introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在同一个对话中，他……向我介绍了三次，仿佛我们从未互相认识过一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I did. Though perhaps I wanted to weep for it. For he introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 喜欢。不过我当时有点想哭。因为在同一个对话中，他……向我介绍了三次，仿佛我们从未互相认识过一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why do you sound less than pleased that I met him ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么听上去你并不怎么高兴我见到他 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I would think so. A child's scrawl written on the back of an automaton. I found him nothing but sweet and charming !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我也这么觉得。一个潦草的孩子笔迹写在机器的背面。我觉得他真是可爱又迷人 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I found him nothing but sweet and charming ! But buried beneath a layer of humor, I felt great heartbreak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他非常可爱迷人！但在这层幽默之下，我却感到无比心痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Greeting me in the same unflinching, cheerful way he had the previous times. But he knew me as a Sœur de Sol !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​像​之前​一样，​毫​不​犹豫、​兴高​采烈​地​迎接​我。​不过​他​居然​认出​我​是​一​位​ S​œur de Sol ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But buried beneath the humor, there is great heartbreak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但幽默之下，却隐藏着巨大的伤痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will you tell me the story of poor Monsieur Otak ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能告诉我那个可怜的奥塔先生的故事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, he knew much of the Luminaries ! We talked at length of the "Ancient Religions" as he dubbed them, in the "days before the Orokin Empire."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 实际上，他对双耀神了解颇多 ！我们聊了很多，聊了那些他称之为"奥罗金帝国之前"的"古代宗教"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would hope they would show him kindness and patience. Mais par la grâce de Sol, go we all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望大家能对他保持友善和耐心。但愿我们都能蒙受太阳神的恩典。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would hope you would seek to be more kind with someone who is clearly infirme. But for the grace of Sol go we, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望你能对这位明显体弱多病的人更加友善。毕竟，我们最终都只能仰赖太阳神的恩典。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though he said much of that knowledge was lost now, deep in the archives, and very much forbidden. He swore me to secrecy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然他说很多这类知识现在都已遗失，深埋在档案馆里，而且是绝对禁止查阅的。他让我发誓保密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Such a fate could wait for any of us. Even you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这样的命运可能发生在任何人身上，包括你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He told me that he was deeply concerned that Executor Ballas - whoever he may be - might discover my sect of heretics and have me executed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他告诉我，他非常担心执行者 Ballas（虽然我不知道他是谁）可能会发现我的异端教派，并处决我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I am sorry for wasting more of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我真抱歉我浪费了更多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suspected... Well, he asked me where I was from, and when I told him, he laughed and said "no, that's impossible! And I should know, I'm -"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我当时也是这么想的……嗯，他问我来自哪里，当我告诉他之后，他笑了，说"不，这不可能！我应该知道，因为我——"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And then he... introduced himself to me again. And asked me if I was coming from the plaines with mineral samples...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后他……又向我做了自我介绍，并问我是不是带着矿物样本从平野过来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pauvre petit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pauvre petit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It shatters me into a million pieces to think there is nothing to be done for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想到对他无能为力，我的心都要碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only pray to the Luminaries that all that remains inside that shell is nothing but... but science and flickering lights.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能向双耀神祈祷，愿那外壳里剩下的只有……只有科学和闪烁的光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are not sure if the Cephalons contain souls - but I can only pray to the Luminaries that... that poor Otak does not suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你不确定中枢是否有灵魂——但我只能向双耀神祈祷……愿可怜的奥塔不要受苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only pray to the Luminaries that you are right and nothing remains inside that shell but... but science and flickering lights.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能向双耀神祈祷，愿你是对的，愿那外壳里剩下的只有……只有科学和闪烁的光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, Luminaries - what manner of hell have you made for him, to keep his soul trapped within that cage of science and flickering lights ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，双耀神——你们为他创造了何等的地狱，将他的灵魂囚禁在科学和闪烁光芒的牢笼之中 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并且没有灵魂被困在那破碎的躯壳里，只有等待着最终死去才能获得安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愿没有灵魂被困在那破碎的躯壳里，只有等待着最终死去才能获得安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并且没有灵魂被困在那破碎的躯壳里，只有等待着最终死去才能获得安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why leave him there, broken and waiting until he is allowed to die to be given peace? I can only pray... that if there is some kind of presence there -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么要把他留在那里，让他痛苦地等待死亡，直到他死去才能获得安宁？我只能祈祷……如果那里真的有某种存在——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Or if there is some kind of presence there, it is because he remains by choice as some manner of lonely vigil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或者，如果那里真的有他的存在，愿那是因为他选择留下来，以某种孤独的方式守望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Because if you are wrong, and a soul remains within that cage against its will ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因为如果你错了呢，有个灵魂是被迫困在那个牢笼里的呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is because he remains by choice as some kind of lonely vigil...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愿那是因为他自己选择留下来，作为一个孤独的守夜人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To think otherwise is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 否则，人便不免要质疑众神是否真的仁慈，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那就足以让人质疑众神的仁慈，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To think otherwise is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 否则，人便不免要质疑众神是否真的仁慈，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And then where would I be ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我又该置身何处呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgive me, I am... je suis mélancolique aujourd'hui.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请原谅我，我……je suis mélancolique aujourd'hui。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ha ! Merci. That is sure to stop these foolish tears of mine. You do know how to cheer silly little Marie, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！Merci。这下我肯定能止住这些傻眼泪了。你真会哄傻乎乎的小玛丽开心，Non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. You are quite right. They are. The world is full of no end of stories like that of Monsieur Otak, and many far worse than his. I should not weep over one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你说得对。确实如此。像奥塔先生这样的故事比比皆是，世上还有许多比他更悲惨的故事。我不该只为一个故事哭泣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. Well, I no longer wish to be. I am going to go do something more cheerful ! I think M'sieur Fibonacci's tank is due for a dusting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci。嗯，我不想再这样了。我要去做些更快乐的事情 ！我觉得斐波那契先生的鱼缸该除尘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yet here I sit, doing just that. Thank you for reminding me of my foolishness. Fie ! Silly little Marie. Well... I think M'sieur Fibonacci's tank is due for a dusting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然而，我却坐在这里，做着这样的事情。谢谢你提醒我有多愚蠢。呸 ！傻女孩玛丽。嗯……我想斐波那契先生的鱼缸该除尘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure, my wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的狼，À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci. Let us go, then, and make mischief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，merci，merci。那我们走吧，去胡闹一番。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci, my wolf. Let us go, then, and make mischief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的狼，merci，merci，merci。那我们走吧，去胡闹一番。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! May we speak for a moment ? It is about Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！我们可以聊一会儿吗 ？是关于里昂的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur ! May we speak for a moment? It is about Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mon cœur ！我们可以聊一会儿吗？是关于里昂的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! May we speak for a moment? It is about your dear sweet Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！我们可以聊一会儿吗？是关于你亲爱的里昂的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He says that he has told you the whole of it now, oui ? It nearly brings me to tears just to think of it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他说他已经把一切都告诉你了，Oui ？光是想想就让我几乎要哭了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You do so much just by listening. For being there when he feels able to speak. He is not broken - the cracks in him do not run so deep as to threaten the foundation. They are scars that are shallow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你光是倾听，就已经做得够多了。在他愿意开口的时候，你一直在他身边。他并没有崩溃——他内心的裂痕并不深，不会威胁到他的根基。那些只是浅浅的伤疤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, you understand. He is not some broken, empty thing. The cracks in him do not threaten the foundation. They are scars that are shallow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你明白。他并非残缺空洞。他身上的裂痕并不会动摇他的根基。它们只是浅浅的伤疤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you know, that yesterday, I found him sitting and reading a book of ancient philosophy to M'sieur Fibonacci ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你知道吗，昨天我发现他坐在那里，给斐波那契先生读一本古代哲学书 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. You do so much by listening. He is not some broken, empty thing. The cracks in him do not threaten the foundation. They are scars that are shallow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。你光是倾听，就已经做得够多了。他内心的裂痕并不深，不会威胁到他的根基。那些只是浅浅的伤疤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: M'sieur Fibonacci had been begging for someone to read it to him for ages, but everyone else refused ! Did not want to give him des munitions, ha !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 斐波那契先生求人给他读这卷书好久了，但所有人都拒绝了 ！他们不想给他 des munitions，哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon never would have dreamed of doing such a thing. Talking to others in such a way. He was enjoying himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​里昂​以前​从​不​会​做​这​种​事，​也​不​会​那样​和​别人​说话。​他​当时​是​真的​开心。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Lyon never would have dreamed of doing such a thing. Talking to others in such a way. He was enjoying himself, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​mon cœur，里昂​以前​从​不​会​做​这​种​事，​也​不​会​那样​和​别人​说话。​他​当时​是​真的​开心。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Our sweet Lyon never would have dreamed of doing such a thing. Talking to others in such a way. He was enjoying himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​亲爱​的​里昂​以前​从​不​会​做​这​种​事，​也​不​会​那样​和​别人​说话。​他​当时​是​真的​开心。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I know it is not either of the Luminaries that I have to thank at evening prayer for that. It is you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道，在晚祷时，我无需为此感谢那两位双耀神，而应该感谢的是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! And it is simply more proof that we are where we are meant to be. Here. With you. In this Sanctum. And together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！这更加证明了这是我们注定身处的地方。在这里。和你在一起。在这圣所里。我们在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It makes me realize how much of a tragédie it is that the devil refuses to aid our efforts in rebuilding the bridge between Monsieur Loid and the family above... I wonder if there is not something to be done about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这让我意识到，恶魔拒绝帮助我们重建洛德先生与楼上家族之间的桥梁，是多么令人悲哀的事啊……我想知道是否还有其他办法可以解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It makes me all the more eager to mend the bridge between Monsieur Loid and the family above ! Let us to work and be quick about it !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这让我更加渴望修复洛德先生和楼上家族之间的关系了 ！我们得赶紧行动起来 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It... makes me reconsider my decision to work with you on mending the efforts between Monsieur Loid and the family above.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这……让我重新考虑是否要与你一起，修复洛德先生与楼上家族之间的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ha ! I have fought with the devil over far less. And for all you have done to help the brother of my soul ? I would do it with joie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！我以前还为了更小的事与恶魔斗过。而你为了我的灵魂兄弟所做的一切 ？我定会欣然效劳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For all that you have done to help the brother of my soul ? While we may not agree on other matters - and may never see eye-to-eye, this ? This I shall do for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为了你为我的​灵魂​兄弟所做的一切 ？虽然我们可能在其他事情上意见不合——甚至可能永远无法达成共识，但在这件事上 ？我会帮你做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil does not know his match. Watch how I destroy his will beneath my own. Marie sera victorieuse !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔还不知道他面对的是什么样的对手。看我如何用我的意志摧毁他的意志。玛丽 sera victorieuse ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For now, however, I must go. À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过，现在我必须走了。À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! May we speak for a moment ? It is about Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！我们可以聊一会儿吗 ？是关于里昂的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He says that he has told you some of it now, oui ? I am glad he has begun to open up to you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他说他已经跟你说了一些了，Oui ？我很高兴他开始对你敞开心扉了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, qu'est-ce qu'il y a ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，qu'est-ce qu'il ya ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I feel as though I should be asking you that question, non ? You are the one who is now cavorting with him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得这个问题应该问你才对，non ？现在和他厮混的可是你啊 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know how you achieved what you did. But he has told us the truth of taking the sérum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道你是如何做到的，但他已经告诉我们注射血清的真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know how you achieved what you did. But he has told us the truth of taking the sérum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道你是如何做到的，但他已经告诉我们注射血清的真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I worry for him. I think he hurts himself more than he lets on, n'est-ce pas?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很担心他。我觉得他伤害自己的程度比他表现出来的要严重得多，n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I fear I must call him "our" devil now, non ? For he is not leaving any time soon. Ha !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕我现在得称他为"我们"的恶魔了，non ？因为他一时半会儿是不会离开的。哈 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am resisting the tentation to ask you toutes sortes de commérages.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我正在努力克制自己，不去问你 toutes sortes de commérages。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sol, it broke my heart. His voice did not falter when he spoke. Mais je l'ai vu dans ses yeux.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 天，这让我心碎。他说话的时候声音没有丝毫颤抖。Mais je l'ai vu dans ses yeux。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It breaks my heart. I hope his does not shatter in his chest some day. I do not know if he will survive it. I do not know if any of us will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这让我心如刀割。我希望他的心不会有一天在他胸口碎裂。我不知道他能否挺过去。我也不知道我们之中是否有谁能挺过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have done well in getting his help with Monsieur Loid. I did not think it could be done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能让他帮忙说服洛德先生，做得非常好。我原本以为这事不可能办到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There has been a change in him. Subtle, but it is there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他变了。虽然很细微，但他确实变了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Oh, Drifter. I do not know how to say this, so I will just come right out with it, instead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦！哦，漂泊者。我不知道该怎么说，所以我就直说了吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, I feel the same ! Mais je ne sais pas comment te l'écrire, je n'ose pas taper les mots ! I thought myself a fool to even think them !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，我也喜欢你 ！Mais je ne sais pas comment te l'écrire， je n'ose pas taper les mots ！光是想那种事，我就觉得自己像个傻瓜 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For that I know we have you to thank.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道这一切都要感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! You have made me so happy !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊！你太让我高兴了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know if he will welcome it, but he will always have friendship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道他是否会接受，但他永远都会拥有这份友谊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: If you are asking for a more... formal courtship, then oui ! Oui ! I would like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​如果​你​是​想​要​一​种​更……​正式​的​追求​关系，​那么​——oui ！​Ou​i！​我​愿意​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though I think I will never tire of shouting at him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然我觉得我永远不会厌倦对他大喊大叫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now I am the one teasing, do not worry. But, either way, je suis ravie ! And looking forward to learning these new...  romantiques customs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在​轮到​我​来​打趣​你​了，​别担心。​不过​无论​如何，​je suis ravie ！​也​很​期​待去​了解​这些​新​的​……​浪​漫习俗。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah ! I know when you are being wicked. Well. I look forward to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！​我​知道​你​什么​时候​在​开玩笑。​好​吧​——​我​很​期待。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Comme un gros chat de gouttière. I have grown accustomed to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Comme un gros chat de gouttière。我已经习惯了有他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! As am I. He grows a little less insufferable every day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！我也是。他每天都变得不那么讨人厌了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think I would be sad if he were gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果他走了，我想我会很难过的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Until then ? À la revoyure, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那就下次再说 ？ À la revoyure，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter. I have taken some time to think and to... calm myself. I have a strict rule regarding engaging in conversations while I am furieuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，​我​花​了​一些​时间​来​思​考……​也​让​自己​冷静​下来。​我​有​个​严格​的​规矩，​在​ f​urieu​x 时​绝不​与​人争论。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was... a dagger between the ribs you paid me, yesterday. I admit I fled in anger, oui, but also répulsion. Not at you, but at myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​昨天说​的话​就​像……用一把匕​首​捅​进​了​我​的​肋骨。​我​承认，​我​当时​逃开​是​因为​愤怒，​oui，​但​更​多​的​是​厌恶。​并非​对​你，​而​是​对​我​自己。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But before we continue, I must address one matter first - your own tone when speaking to me. I know you must think me a child. You are centuries old, if not more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​在​继续​之前，​我​必须​先​跟​你​说​一​件​事​——​你​对​我​说话​的​语气。​我​知道​你​一定​把​我​当成​孩子。​毕竟​你​已​有​几百​岁​了，​或许​你​活得​更久。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I spent much time thinking over your words. That this is not a holy war and that le Cardinal has been manipulative in his ways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​花​了​许多​时间​思​考​你​的话。​这​并​非​一​场​圣战，​而​星期日​主教​的​所作​所​为​或许​有​操纵​他​人​的​嫌疑。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You were... of course, correct in your question to ask me where in the scriptures of Sol it states that innocents are expendable. It does not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​……​当然​是​对​的，​你​问​我​在​太阳神​的​经文​里何处​写​着​可以​牺牲​无辜​的​人。​经文​里​并​没有​写。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Before we continue, I must address one matter first - your willingness to wield my faith against me in an argument, where you do not engage with faith yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在​我们​继续​之前，​我​必须​先​跟​你​谈​一​件​事​——​你​在​争论​中​利用​我​的​信仰​来​反驳​我，​而​你​自己​本身却​又​不​相信​这些​信仰。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... am sorry for fleeing our conversation yesterday. It was simply too much. I must ask you, though, before we continue - did you mean your words ? Or were you merely trying to manipulate my feelings to spare yourself an uncomfortable argument ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​……​很​抱歉​昨天​避开​了​我们​的​谈话。​那​一​刻​我​实​在​承受​不住。​ ​不过​在​我们​继续​之前，​我​必须​问​你​——​你​说​的​那些​话，​是​真心​的​吗 ？​ ​还是​你​只​是​想​操纵​我​的​情绪，​好​让​自己​避免​一​场​不​愉快​的​争论​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It appears we have come to an impasse, in regards to le Cardinal, oui ? You view him as a monstre, and I, a saint.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 看​起来​我们​在​关于​星期日​主教​的​问题​上​陷入​了​僵局，​ou​i ？​你​认为​他​是​个​ monnst​re，​而​我，​觉得​他​是​位​圣人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish to speak to you about your decision to side with Entrati only to get into my good graces, if you are willing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​和​你​谈谈​你​为了​讨好​我​而​选择站​在​英择​谛​那​一​边​这​件​事​，如果​你​愿意​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish to speak to you about your lie, now, if you are willing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​和​你​谈谈​你撒的谎，如果​你​愿意​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: How could I be surprised that you were so deadly precise with your aim ? To compare my words with that of the devil...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​怎会​对​你​的​精准​感到​意外​呢 ？​竟​将​我​的​言语，​与​那​恶魔的​相提​并​论……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have traveled through unknown dimensions, through the Void itself. Battled gods and angels. Who am I, to you, oui ? Just silly little Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​曾穿越​未知​的​维度，​踏入​虚​空​本身，​与​神明​和​天使​为​敌。​对​你​而言，​我​算​什么，​ou​i ？​不过​是​愚蠢​又​渺小​的​玛丽。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I believe... oui, you are correct. This is not a holy war. For there is no such thing. War is never holy, just, or righteous. Pain should never be the guiding light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还​有​我​觉得……o​ui，​你​是​对​的。​这​并​非圣战。​因为​根本​就​没有​所谓​的​圣战。​战争​从​不​神圣、​公正​或​正义，​痛苦​也​绝​不​该​成为​指引​之光。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: War is never holy, just, or righteous. Pain should never be the guiding light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 战争​从​不​神圣、​公正，​或​正义。​痛苦绝​不​该​成为​指引​之光。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: This was disingenuous, Drifter. Cruel, and ineffectual. It was an attempt to "win" a conversation, and it was not how one should comport oneself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，​你​这样​很​不​真诚。​残忍，​而且​毫​无意义。​那​只​是​想​在​争论​中​"取胜"​的​做法，​并​非​一​个​人​对​另​一​个​人​该​有​的​态度。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: However... I do not wish to leave things in such a way between us. You are a kind soul, and there is much between us that I do not want to leave soured.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过……​我​并不​希望​我们​就​这样​留着​这​件​事不​去​说​清楚。​你​有​着​善良​的​灵魂，​而​我们​之间​有​太​多​故事，​我​不​想​让​它们​因此​变得​苦涩。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Attempting to manipulate the situation in order to control my feelings is... disingenuous and cruel. I admit I am eager to hate you for it, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 试图​操纵局​势来​控制​我​的​情感​是​……​虚伪而​残忍​的。​我​承认​我​确实​很​想​因此​恨​你，​漂泊者。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would think myself someone whose mind and heart is open to the world and all those within it. And you succinctly, and with a single barbed arrow, proved me wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​一​向​以​为​自己​是​个心胸​开阔、​能​包容​世间​众生​的​人。​而​你​只用​一​句​锋利​的话，​就​证明​了​我​是​错​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: On one hand, I understand this. I sympathize. Both our tempers were raised. But on the other, I ask for you to regard me instead with more grace and tact than you have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 一​方面，​我​能​理解。​也​能​共情。​我们​当时​都​情绪​激动。​可​另​一​方面，​我​希望​你​今后​对​我​能​多​一些​体谅​和​分寸。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even what we do now - destroying the Murmure and fighting against all your many enemies - is not the path of the Luminaries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 就​连​我们​如今​所​做​的​——​摧毁低​语者，​与​无数​敌人​战斗​——​也​并​非双耀神​所​指引​的​道路。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Faith is not, nor should it ever be, a weapon to be used against another. It is a shield. A light in the darkness. A voice to guide the way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 信仰​不​是，​也​永远​不​该​成为​攻击​他​人​的​武器。​它​是​一​面​盾牌。​是​黑暗​中​的​光。​也​是​指引​前路​的​声音。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Before I face the - the enormity of that, I must explain myself regarding le Cardinal, s'il vous plaît.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在​我​面对​那​——​那​一切​的​沉重​之前，​我​必须​先​解释​一下​我​和​星期日​主教​之间​的​事，​s'​il vous plaît。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, I still wish to see Monsieur Loid united with those above. I wish to see solace brought to le Cardinal's remaining family, and you are the road to this !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的​确，​我​仍然​希望​能​看到​洛德​先生​与​那些​楼上​的​存在​重聚。​我​希望​星期日​主教​剩下​的​家人​能​得到​安慰，​而​你​正​是​通往​这​一切​的​道路​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: However... I do not wish to leave things in such a way between us. There is much between us that I do not want to leave soured.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不过……​我​并不​希望​我们​就​这样​留着​这​件​事不​去​说​清楚。​​我们​之间​有​太​多​故事，​我​不​想​让​它们​因此​变得​苦涩。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose I am here pour m'excuser - to say I am deeply sorry for being so foolishly entrenched. I hope you understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​我​是​来​ pour m'excuse​r ​的​——​为​自己​那​般​愚昧​固​执而​深感​抱歉。​希望​你​能​理解。​
