/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For I have lived on the streets. I have lived every day of my life in physical agonie. I have known heartbreak, I have known love, I have known fear and rejection. I have known life and loss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因为​我​曾流落​街头，​我​的​一​生​都​伴随着​肉体​的​痛苦。​我​体会​过心碎，​也​体会​过​爱情，​经历​过​恐惧​与​被​拒绝。​我​体验​过​新生，​也​见​过​失去。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Necessary as it may be to lift the sword, lest the world be overrun by their ilk, it is not to be venerated. And it is certainly not excusable when innocents are harmed in its wake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哪怕​举起利剑​是​必要​之举，​为了​不​让​这个​世界​沦陷于​它们​的​同类​之手，​这​也​不​该​被​颂扬。​更​不​该​以​此​为​借口​去​伤​及​无辜。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And for you to attempt to use it against me to simply "defeat" me? It was a cowardly tactic. But both our tempers were raised, and I will... forgive you, if you will forgive me, for words said in anger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而​你​竟试​图用​它​来​"击败"​我​ ？​那​是​懦夫​的​手段。​但​我们​当时​都​怒气​上头，​我​会……​原谅​你，​如果​你​也​愿意​原谅​我​那些​出于​愤怒​的​言语​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is hard for me, I think, to abandon my defense of le Cardinal... and it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想，​对​我​来​说放弃帮​星期日​主教​说话​是​那么​难……​以及​我​花​了​点​时间​才​弄明白​我​为什么​不​想​放弃​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, I understand... How many murders have been committed as "crimes of passion," oui ? Certainly as many children have been created in moments of them as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non​, ​我​明白……​有​多​少​谋杀​是​以​"激情​犯罪"​的​名义​犯​下​的，​ o​u​i ？​当然，​也​有​同样​多​的​孩子​是​在​那样​的​激情​时​刻​中​诞生​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you have become important to me, in such a short time... I have found our conversations so joyeuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并且​你​在​这么​短​的​时间​里​就​变得​对​我​如此​重要​……​我们​的​每​次​谈话​都​让​我​感到​无比 joye​ux。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, I still wish to see Monsieur Loid united with those above. I wish to see solace brought to le Cardinal's remaining family, and you are the road to this !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的​确，​我​仍然​希望​能​看到​洛德​先生​与​那些​楼上​的​存在​重聚。​我​希望​星期日​主教​剩下​的​家人​能​得到​安慰，​而​你​正​是​通往​这​一切​的​道路​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And if you truly believe yourself to so high above us all, than you will see nothing but the clouds in which you are lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后​如果​你​真以​为​自己​高​居众生​之​上，​那​你​眼中​所见​的​只会​是​将​你​吞没​的​云雾。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So... I will concede that le Cardinal is not justified in harming others in the name of a "greater good."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以……​我​承认​星期日​主教​以​"更​大​的​善"​为理由​去​伤害​他​人，​是​不​正​当​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply do not want you to think less of me if I were to confess to you the truth of it all. It seems so small and pathétique.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只是​不​想​让​你​因为​我​说​出​真相后​就​看轻​我。​这​一切​听​起来​太微​不​足道、​太 ​pathétique ​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am... disappointed. Hurt. But I... I forgive you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​有点……​失望。​被​伤到​了。​但是​我​……​我​原谅​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And there is much kindness you could still serve to do toward my Lyon and even toward the devil, I suppose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并且​我​想，​你​依然​可以​对​我​的​里昂，​甚至​对​那​位​恶魔，​施予​许多​善意……​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There is something to be said for being gracious when one "wins," you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​知道​吗，​一​个​人​​是​"赢​了"​之后也​要​能​保持​宽容。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For what "greater good" will be left, when nothing but shattered lives and hearts remain in his path ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当​他​的​道路​上​只​剩​下​支离的​生命​和​破碎​的​心时，​还能说什么"更​大​的​善" ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non. He is not my father. For my father abandoned me in the street as a child, and le Cardinal did nothing nearly so cruel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non。​他​不​是​我​的​父亲。​我​的​父亲​在​我​年​幼时​将​我​遗弃​街头，​而​星期日​主教​从​未​做​过​如此​残忍​的​事。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Many travesties have been committed in the heat of passion. Such is the way of things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 许多​悲剧​都​源于​一时​的​冲动，​这​就​是世事的​常态。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To... finish the conversation regarding le Cardinal, if we may - setting aside my heartbreak, s'il te plaît ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后……​接​着​聊完​我们​关于​星期日​主教​的​话题，​如果​可以​的​话​——先​不​用​管​我​的​难过，​s'​il vous plaî​t ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, how can I push you away, when you have confessed to me how you feel ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的​确，​我​怎么​能​在​你​跟​我​袒露​心意​之后​把​你​推开​呢​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, how can I push you away, when you have confessed to me how you feel about our dear Lyon ? You could bring him such peace... such solace...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的​确，​我​怎么​能​在​你​跟​我​袒露​了​你​对​我​亲爱​的​里昂​的​感觉​之后​把​你​推开​呢​ ？​你​能​为​他​带来​那样​的​平静……​那样​的​安慰……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, how can I push you away, when you seem set upon the devil ? I do not understand your tastes, but... it seems you are to be at our side, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 的​确，​当​你​似乎​执意​要​与​那个​恶魔​为​伍​时，​我​又​怎​能​将​你​推开​呢​ ？​我​不​明​白​你​的​喜好，​但​……​看来​你​是​要​站​在​我们​这​一​边​的，​对​吧 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not wish to lose you as a companion. Can we push this all to one side, and say that we may not agree, but that we can still continue on ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​不​希望​失去​你​这个​同伴。​我们​能​不​能​暂时​把​这​一切​放​在​一边，​虽然​我们​并不​完全​认同​彼此，​但​依然​可以​继续​走下​去​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I appreciate that more than you can know, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​想象​不​到​我​有​多​感激​你​能​说​这些​话，​谢谢​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose it would be obvious to you, non ? Someone who has lost their famille as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​对​你​来说​这​大概​是​一目​了然​的，​non ？​毕竟​你​也​失去​了​自己​的​ famil​le。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We shall see. I think in the end, I saw in him a bit of the father that abandoned me, as small and sad as that seems to me now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也​许吧。​我​想​归​根​结底，​是​因为​我​在​他​身上​看到​了​一些​我​那​遗​弃​我​的​父亲​的​影子，​虽然​如今​看​来​那个​想法​既​渺​小​又​可悲。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is hard for me, I think, to abandon my defense of le Cardinal... and it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想，​要​我​放弃​为​星期日​主教​辩护​这​件​事，​对​我​来说​很​难……​我​也​花​了​好​一​阵子​才​明白，​自己​为什么​始终放​不​下​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Can we push this all to one side, and say that we may not agree, but that we can still continue on ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们​能​不​能​暂时​把​这​一切​放​在​一边，​虽然​我们​并不​完全​认同​彼此，​但​依然​可以​继续​走下​去​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do forgive you for your lies, Drifter. We can continue to be friends and allies. But to lie to me the way you have, simply in an attempt to... what ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​原谅​你​的​那些​谎言​了，​漂泊者。​我们​依然​可以​继续​做​朋友、​做盟友。​ ​但是​你​那样​对​我​撒谎，​到底​是​……为了​什么​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is hard for me, I think, to abandon my défense of le Cardinal... and it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想，​要​我​放弃​为​星期日​主教​辩护​这​件​事，​对​我​来说​很​难……​我​也​花​了​好​一​阵子​才​明白，​自己​为什么​始终放​不​下​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, yes, well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​也​是，​好吧。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I accept your apology... as I also let my temper best me at several points.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​接受​你​的​道歉……​我​自己​也​有​几​次​被​情绪​左右过。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To think... that after all these years, that I could be pulled in by someone offering me such kindness ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​会​去​想……​这么​多​年​过去​了，​我​还​能​被​他​人​的​善意所​打动​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply do not want you to think less of me if I were to confess to you the truth of it all. It seems so small and pathétique.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只是​不​想​让​你​因为​我​说​出​真相后​就​看轻​我。​这​一切​听​起来​太微​不​足道、​太 ​pathétique ​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply do not want you to think less of me if I were to confess to you the truth of it all. It seems so small and pathétique.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​只是​不​想​让​你​因为​我​说​出​真相后​就​看轻​我。​这​一切​听​起来​太微​不​足道、​太 ​pathétique ​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Allow me to simply... explain, I think, why it is so hard for me to abandon my defense of le Cardinal. And why it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请​让​我​只​是​……​解释​一下​吧，​我​想。​解释​一下​为什么​对​我​来​说放弃​帮​星期日​主教​说话​是​那么​难。​以及​为什么​我​花​了​点​时间​才​弄明白​我​不​想​放弃​他。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Foolish little Marie... of course, he was not all that he seemed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愚蠢​的​小玛丽​啊……​当然​了，​他​完全​不​是​他​看​起来​的​那样。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bien. At least we have an accord.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bien。​至少​我们​达成​了​一致。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To climb into bed with me ? It is foul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是​为了​和​我​上床​吗 ？​真​是​卑劣。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To use me ? It is foul.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为了​利用​我​吗 ？​真​是​卑劣。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose it would be obvious to you, non ? Someone who has lost their famille as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​对​你​来说​这​大概​是​一目​了然​的，​non ？​毕竟​你​也​失去​了​自己​的​ famil​le。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We shall see. I think in the end, I saw in him a bit of the father that abandoned me, as small and sad as that seems to me now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也​许吧。​我​想​归​根​结底，​是​因为​我​在​他​身上​看到​了​一些​我​那​遗​弃​我​的​父亲​的​影子，​虽然​如今​看​来​那个​想法​既​渺​小​又​可悲。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je ne pense pas.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je ne pense pas。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So I must say I could never trust you with my heart. I would say I am sorry for such words, which I am certain must disappoint you -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以​我​必须​说，​我​永远​无法​将​我​的​心托​付​给​你。​我​也​该​为​这些​话感到​抱歉，​我​确信​它们​一定​让​你​失望​了​——​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suppose it would be obvious to you, non ? Someone who has lost their famille as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​想​对​你​来说​这​大概​是​一目​了然​的，​non ？​毕竟​你​也​失去​了​自己​的​ famil​le。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We shall see. I think in the end, I saw in him a bit of the father that abandoned me, as small and sad as that seems to me now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也​许吧。​我​想​归​根​结底，​是​因为​我​在​他​身上​看到​了​一些​我​那​遗​弃​我​的​父亲​的​影子，​虽然​如今​看​来​那个​想法​既​渺​小​又​可悲。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To think... that after all these years, that I could be pulled in by someone offering me such kindness ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​会​去​想……​这么​多​年​过去​了，​我​还​能​被​他​人​的​善意所​打动​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I fear I am not. I do hope this does not come as a surprise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​恐怕​我​并不​感到​抱歉。​希望​这​并​不​会​让​你​感到​意外。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To think... that after all these years, that I could be pulled in by someone offering me such kindness ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​会​去​想……​这么​多​年​过去​了，​我​还​能​被​他​人​的​善意所​打动​ ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Foolish little Marie... of course, he was not all that he seemed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愚蠢​的​小玛丽​啊……​当然​了，​他​完全​不​是​他​看​起来​的​那样。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: As for the matter of le Cardinal ? I suppose we shall remain parted on the topic. As we shall remain parted in our affections.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 至于​星期日​主教​的​事 ？​我​想​我们​在​这个​话题​上​终究​无法​达成​共识。​正如​我们​在感情上，​也​注定​要​分道​扬镳。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Foolish little Marie... of course, he was not all that he seemed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愚蠢​的​小玛丽​啊……​当然​了，​他​完全​不​是​他​看​起来​的​那样。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Au revoir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Au revoir。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you tell me this while you also confess your love to the brother of my soul ?! Do you think to play us both to be fools ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你​竟然​在​跟​我​灵魂​的​另​一​半，​我​的​灵魂​兄弟​的​同时​跟​我​说​这些​话 ？！​你​是​在​把​我们​两​个​人​当​傻子​耍​吗 ？！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you tell me this while you tarry with the devil ?! Do you think to play us both to be fools ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ​你​竟然​在​和​那个​恶魔​往来​的​同时​对​我​说​这些​ ？！​你​是​在​把​我们​两​个​​当​傻子​耍​吗 ？！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... Oh, mon cœur. Mon cœur ! Oh, how I feel the same ! But I did not dare speak the words, I did not dare write them to you - for I thought myself a fool for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​……哦，​mon c​œ​ur。​Mon c​œur ！​啊，​我​的​感觉​与​你​何其相同​ ！​只是​我​不敢​说​出口，​也​不​敢​写​给​你​——​因为​我​觉得​自己​这样​会​太​过​愚蠢。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, as you said, and so I now see plainly. I... am simply left to thank you for your patience once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​正如​你​所​说，​而​我​现在​也​看清​了。​我……​只​能​再次​感谢​你​对​我​的​耐心。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! You have made me so happy ! I wonder... what you intend to do with this statement... ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊​ ！​你​简直​让​我​太​幸福​了​ ！​我​在​想……​你​会​怎么​回应​我​的​这些​话​呢​…… ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: In my desperation to hold on to a father now gone, I nearly drove away a family still here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​一心​想​抓住​那​位​离开​我​​的​父亲，​却​差点​把​仍​在​身边​的​家人​推开。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think I am not the only one, non ? I... think I am now properly armed to help with the battle we face with those upstairs, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 还​有​我​在​想，​不​只​是​我​一​个​人​这样，​对​吧 ？​我……想​我​现在​已经​做​好​准备，​能​帮​上​忙去​对付​那些​楼上​的​家伙​了，​ou​i ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tu crois pouvoir débarquer ici depuis le futur et tous nous manipuler comme des marionnettes ?! Je te suggère de prendre cette machine, de te pencher et de te l'enfoncer fermement dans le derrière, espèce de sale pourriture répugnante et puante !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Tu crois pouvoir débarquer ici depuis le futur et tous nous manipuler comme des marionnettes ?! Je te suggère de prendre cette machine, de te pencher et de te l'enfoncer fermement dans le derrière, espèce de sale pourriture répugnante et puante !

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: A "couple ?" My dear wolf, I do believe times have changed since my era of fiancés and arranged marriages... I hardly doubt you are asking to wed !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: "情侣"​ ？​我​亲爱​的​狼，​我​觉得​时代确​实​变​了，​在​我​那​ ​les fiancé​s ​和​包办​婚姻​的​年代​可​不​是​这样​的​……​我​可​不​太​相信​你​这​是​在​求婚 ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, that is sensible. Quite sensible. I come from a time of formal courtship, oui ? Though I would be curious to know how times have changed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: O​ui，​很​有​道理，​非常​有​道理。​我​来自​一​个​讲究​正式​追求​的​年代，​你​知道​的​吧 ？​不过，​我​倒​是​很​好奇，​时代​如今​都​变成​什么样​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But if you are asking for a more... formal courtship, then oui ! Oui ! I would like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​如果​你​是​想​要​一​种​更……​正式​的​追求​关系，​那么​——oui ！​Ou​i！​我​愿意​ ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Until then ? À la revoyure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那就下次再说 ？ À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you tell me this while you also confess your love to the brother of my soul ?! Do you think to play us both to be fools ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后​你​竟然​在​跟​我​灵魂​的​另​一​半，​我​的​​灵魂​兄弟表白​的​同时​跟​我​说​这些​话 ？！​你​是​在​把​我们​两​个​人​当​傻子​耍​吗 ？！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And you tell me this while you tarry with the devil ?! Do you think to play us both to be fools ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后​你​竟然​在​和​那个​恶魔​往来​的​同时​对​我​说​这些​ ？！​你​是​在​把​我们​两​个​​当​傻子​耍​吗 ？！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦  !

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Hah ! I know when you are being wicked. Well. I look forward to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！​我​知道​你​什么​时候​在​开玩笑。​好​吧​——​我​很​期待。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Now I am the one teasing, do not worry. But, either way, je suis ravie! And looking forward to learning these new... romantique customs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 现在​轮到​我​来​打趣​你​了，​别担心。​不过​无论​如何，​je suis ravie ！​也​很​期​待去​了解​这些​新​的​……​浪​漫习俗。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I - oh my...
Until then ? À la revoyure, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那就下次再说 ？ À la revoyure，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tu crois pouvoir débarquer ici depuis le futur et tous nous manipuler comme des marionnettes ?! Je te suggère de prendre cette machine, de te pencher et de te l'enfoncer fermement dans le derrière, espèce de sale pourriture répugnante et puante !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Tu crois pouvoir débarquer ici depuis le futur et tous nous manipuler comme des marionnettes ?! Je te suggère de prendre cette machine, de te pencher et de te l'enfoncer fermement dans le derrière, espèce de sale pourriture répugnante et puante !

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would... I would point out that I do not think I need protection but - but also that I am recently proven wrong and - and that I am quite flattered by all this -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​……​我​想​说​我​并不​认为​自己​需要​被​保护，​但​——但​我​也​得​承认，​最近​发生​的​事证明​我​错​了，​而且​——​而且​这​一切​让​我​非常​受宠若​惊​——​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: - and that I did not think one could babble in written text and yet I am also proven wrong in that manner as well !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: ——​而且​我​原本​以​为​人​是​不​可能​在​文字里​也​结结​巴巴​的，​可​如今​看来，​这点​我​也​错得​离谱 ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you have a moment ? I would love to speak to you, if you have the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你有空吗 ？如果你有时间的话，我很想和你聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur ! Do you have a moment ? I would love to speak with you, if you can spare the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mon cœur ！你有空吗 ？如果你有时间的话，我很想和你聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you have a moment ? I would love to speak with you, if you can spare the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你有空吗 ？如果你有时间的话，我很想和你聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Dearest of my dearest ! Do you have the time to speak to me for a moment ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我最最亲爱的人 ！你现在有空跟我说几句话吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Tamer of devils ! Do you have a moment to speak to me ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 驯魔者 ！你现在有空跟我说句话吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, let me speak first, I will lose my nerve if I do not !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，让我先说，不然我会没勇气的 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think of how much time we have spent together. How little it has been, in the grand scheme of all of the years you have lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常想起我们在一起度过的时光。在你漫长的人生中，这段时光又是多么短暂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think of how much time we have spent together. How little it has been, in the grand scheme of all of the years you have lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常想起我们在一起度过的时光。在你漫长的人生中，这段时光又是多么短暂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have been such a good and kind friend. And ally the likes of which I could not even have possibly prayed for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你一直是我如此善良友好的朋友，也是我做梦都想不到的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, and I think you prefer it that way, non ? Ha ! I do not wish to picture the devil in that way - never mind ! That is not why I have come to speak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我想你更喜欢那样，不是吗 ？哈 ！我不想那样想象恶魔——算了 ！我来找你不是为了这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think of how much they have meant to me. How much they have changed me and the course of my life like a ship at sea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会想这些时光对我有多么重要。它们改变了我，改变了我的人生轨迹，就像一艘航行在大海上的船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think of how much they have meant to me. How much they have changed me and the course of my life like a ship at sea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会想这些时光对我有多么重要。它们改变了我，改变了我的人生轨迹，就像一艘航行在大海上的船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You spoke to me once that you... oh, I do not even know how to say the words. That you had feelings for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你曾经跟我说过……哦，我甚至不知道该怎么开口。你说过你喜欢我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You spoke to me once that you... oh, I do not even know how to say the words. That you had feelings for me. Yet I know you also have another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你曾经跟我说过……哦，我甚至不知道该怎么开口。你说过你喜欢我，但我知道还喜欢别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you spoke once of having feelings for me. Yet, now I see you off with another. I simply wished to tell you that I am happy for you !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你之前说过喜欢我。可是现在我却看到你和别人在一起。我只是想告诉你，我替你感到高兴 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I fear you are about to tell me words you will not be able to take back. And that will change things between us forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我担心你接下来要说的话。会让我们之间再也回不到从前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think to myself, is this what the Indifference wishes to destroy ? Is this what the Indifference consumes ? That power of others to influence others ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后我心想，那种可以影响他人的力量 ？就是虚空无情之物想要摧毁的吗 ？就是虚空无情之物所吞噬的吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think to myself, is this what the Indifference wishes to destroy ? Is this what the Indifference consumes ? That power of others to influence others ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后我心想，那种可以影响他人的力量 ？就是虚空无情之物想要摧毁的吗 ？就是虚空无情之物所吞噬的吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I harbor for you no ill will and nothing but joie for you both, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我对你们没有任何恶意，只有对你们俩的 joie，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have brought the brother of my soul such peace. You have convinced him we have a true enemy to fight - and given him hope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你给我的灵魂兄弟带来了如此的平安。你让他确信我们有一个真正的敌人需要对抗——并给了他希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You have brought the brother of my soul solace and some manner of peace where he had none before. I think your companionship has meant more to him than he can express.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你给我的灵魂兄弟带来了慰藉和安宁，这是他之前从未感受过的。我想，你的陪伴对他来说意义非凡，远超他所能表达。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: While we may never know the answer of what the Indifference truly is, we know that it does not matter. We must face it as the challenge it poses - which is real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们或许永远无法得知虚空无情之物的真相，但我们知道这并不重要。我们必须正视它所带来的挑战——而这挑战是真实存在的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I did not think our devil could be convinced to help Monsieur Loid and le Cardinal's family reconnect. I know his reasons are... dubious, perhaps, and I still do not fully trust him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我原以为我们这位恶魔不会答应帮助洛德先生和主教一家重归于好。我知道他的理由……或许有些可疑，而且我仍然无法完全信任他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I did not think our devil could be shown the error of his ways. That he could feel regret at all for the innocent lives he has spent. You proved me wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我原以为我们这位恶魔永远不会醒悟，永远不会对那些被他夺去生命的无辜者感到丝毫悔意。你证明我错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Whatever chains you keep our devil on, they are keeping him leashed. He seems more... tempered, than before. And you are to thank for this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 无论你用什么锁链束缚着我们的恶魔，它们都有效地控制住了他。他似乎比以前更……温和了。这一切都要感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The memories we have helped him retrieve seem to have tempered him. Perhaps remembering the grief for all those he lost has reminded him of those he could still lose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们帮助他找回的那些记忆似乎让他变得更加沉稳。或许，回忆起所有逝去亲人的悲痛，让他时刻铭记着未来可能失去的亲人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps it is his fondness for you that tempers him, I do not know. Whatever the reason, I know you are to thank for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许是他对你的喜爱让他变得温和，我不知道。但不管是什么原因，我知道这都要感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it grieves me, oh, how it grieves me to stop you before you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而我要在你说出口之前阻止你，这让我感到很难过，哦，真的无比难过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The gift to make each other laugh. To cry. To convince each other of truths or lies. To change each other's minds. To cheer each other when you are in pain. To hurt each other in folly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 彼此逗乐的礼物。彼此哭泣的礼物。彼此说服对方相信真话或谎言的礼物。彼此改变想法的礼物。在彼此痛苦时互相安慰的礼物。在愚蠢中互相伤害的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The gift to make each other laugh. To cry. To convince each other of truths or lies. To change each other's minds. To cheer each other when you are in pain. To hurt each other in folly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 彼此逗乐的礼物。彼此哭泣的礼物。彼此说服对方相信真话或谎言的礼物。彼此改变想法的礼物。在彼此痛苦时互相安慰的礼物。在愚蠢中互相伤害的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know how to say this without being cruel so I... will only say it simply.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道该怎么说才不会显得那么残酷，所以我……就简单地说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I understand. Of course, I understand ! How could I fault you for following your soul ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我明白。当然，我明白 ！我怎么能责怪你去追随自己的内心呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And what is the difference, when you are there to guide Lyon through the darkest hours, and hold him in his moments of pain and agonie ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这又有什么区别呢 ？当你陪伴里昂度过最黑暗的时刻，在他痛苦难耐的时候给予他支持和鼓励时 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The results are undoubtedly because you are to thank for them. Roathe is here, and he is protecting le Cardinal's family, because of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 毫无疑问，这一切都要感谢你。罗瑟之所以能在这里，保护主教的家人，都是因为你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I know our devil is not our enemy, oui ? It is the Indifference. And what does the Indifference teach us, if not to hold on to all that it rejects, all that it destroys ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​知道​我们​的​恶魔​不​是​敌人，​ou​i ？​虚空​无情​之​物​才​是。​而​虚空​无情​之物​又​教会​了​我们​什么​呢​ ？​难道​不​是​让​我们​紧紧​抓住​它​所​抵挡、​所​摧毁​的​一切​吗 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I know ! That is the point ! I am too scared to say... to say how much I have come to care for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我知道 ！这就是重点 ！我太害怕说出口……说出口我有多么在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know how to say this without being cruel so I... will only say it simply.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道该怎么说才不会显得那么残酷，所以我……就简单地说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To bring each other pleasure when you are in love. To bring each other agonie when you are lost to hatred. This is the gift of humanité - this is what the Indifference is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 相爱时彼此带来快乐，仇恨时彼此带来痛苦。这才是人性的馈赠——而虚空无情之物绝非如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To bring each other pleasure when you are in love. To bring each other agonie when you are lost to hatred. This is the gift of humanité - this is what the Indifference is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 相爱时彼此带来快乐，仇恨时彼此带来痛苦。这才是人性的馈赠——而虚空无情之物绝非如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I - oh ! Oh, mon cœur !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我——哦 ！哦，mon cœur ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I understand. Of course, I understand ! How could I fault you for following your soul ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我明白。当然，我明白 ！我怎么能责怪你去追随自己的内心呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I fear... you should simply just pursue the other. What you feel for me, I do not feel for you in return. Forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恐怕……你还是应该选择别人。你对我的喜欢，我无法以同样的方式回应。请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I - oh ! Oh, mon cœur !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我——哦 ！哦，mon cœur ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And that may very well be the case. I am not a jealous creature, but it is one thing to know that someone has captured your heart, when I do not know them -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 也许真是这样。我不是那种会嫉妒的人，但知道有人俘获了你的芳心，而我又不认识那个人，我或许还能接受——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What does the Indifference teach us, regardless of its origins, if not to hold on to all that it rejects, all that it destroys ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 不​管虚空​无情​之物​的​起源​是​什么，​它​能​教会​我们​什么​呢​ ？​难道​不​是​要​我们​紧紧​抓住​它​所​抵挡​的​一切、​它​所​摧毁​的​一切​吗 ？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think of how much time we have spent together. How little it has been, in the grand scheme of all of the years you have lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常想起我们在一起度过的时光。在你漫长的人生中，这段时光又是多么短暂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! Where did you learn that ?! Lyon ?! Oh, never mind! Oh, my wolf !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊 ！你从哪儿学来的 ？！是里昂教的吗 ？！哦，算了 ！哦，我的狼 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: What you feel for me, I do not feel for you in return. Forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你对我的喜欢，我对你并没有。请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is impure and it is imperfect but it is beautiful like the stars in the sky. A billion little dots that make a tapestry of an ocean of light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人性并不纯净，也不完美，但它像天上的繁星一样美丽。无数细小的光点组成了一片光的海洋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is impure and it is imperfect but it is beautiful like the stars in the sky. A billion little dots that make a tapestry of an ocean of light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人性并不纯净，也不完美，但它像天上的繁星一样美丽。无数细小的光点组成了一片光的海洋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... do not know what to say, except for I... I feel the same. Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……不知道该说什么，除了我……我也有同样的感觉。 Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But in little Marie, trust that you have an ally who shall stand beside you until the end, come what may.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是，请相信小玛丽，无论发生什么，她都会永远陪伴在你身边，直到生命的尽头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: May Sol bless you and your hearts. I merely count myself blessed to be amongst those you call friend !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愿太阳神保守你和你的爱人。能成为你们的朋友，我深感荣幸 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... do not know what to say, except for that I believe you. And that I... I feel the same. Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……不知道该说什么，除了我相信你……而且我……也喜欢你。 Mon cœur t'appartient depuis notre première rencontre。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is another matter when they are the brother of my soul, or the devil with whom I must contend on a daily basis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但如果是我的​灵魂​兄弟，或者是我每天都要对付的恶魔时，那我就无法接受了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think of how much time we have spent together. How little it has been, in the grand scheme of all of the years you have lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常想起我们在一起度过的时光。在你漫长的人生中，这段时光又是多么短暂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think of how much they have meant to me. How much they have changed me and the course of my life like a ship at sea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会想这些时光对我有多么重要。它们改变了我，改变了我的人生轨迹，就像一艘航行在大海上的船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think of how much time we have spent together. How little it has been, in the grand scheme of all of the years you have lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常想起我们在一起度过的时光。在你漫长的人生中，这段时光又是多么短暂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But in little Marie, trust that you have an ally who shall stand beside you until the end, come what may.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但是，请相信小玛丽，无论发生什么，她都会永远陪伴在你身边，直到生命的尽头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is all detail with no precision, oui ? Who cares where it comes from... it is what we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它充满细节却缺乏精确，oui ？它从哪里来并不重要……它就是我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is all detail with no précision, oui ? Who cares where it comes from... it is what we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它充满细节却缺乏 précision，oui ？它从哪里来并不重要……它就是我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think of how much time we have spent together. How little it has been, in the grand scheme of all of the years you have lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常想起我们在一起度过的时光。在你漫长的人生中，这段时光又是多么短暂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I merely count myself blessed to be amongst those you call friend !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 能成为你们的朋友，我深感荣幸 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And in little Marie, trust that you have a friend who shall stand beside you until the end, come what may.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而对于小玛丽，你要相信，无论发生什么，她都会永远陪伴在你身边，直到生命的尽头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think of how much time we have spent together. How little it has been, in the grand scheme of all of the years you have lived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我常常想起我们在一起度过的时光。在你漫长的人生中，这段时光又是多么短暂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I could be at peace, even rejoice, at the notion of sharing you with another - but with family or an enemy ? I think that is too much for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果是别人与我共享你，我或许会感到平静，甚至欣喜——但如果是与家人或敌人 ？我觉得这对我来说太难接受了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think of how much they have meant to me. How much they have changed me and the course of my life like a ship at sea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会想这些时光对我有多么重要。它们改变了我，改变了我的人生轨迹，就像一艘航行在大海上的船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think to myself, is this what the Indifference wishes to destroy ? Is this what the Indifference consumes ? That power of others to influence others ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后我心想，那种可以影响他人的力量 ？就是虚空无情之物想要摧毁的吗 ？就是虚空无情之物所吞噬的吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think of how much they have meant to me. How much they have changed me and the course of my life like a ship at sea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会想这些时光对我有多么重要。它们改变了我，改变了我的人生轨迹，就像一艘航行在大海上的船。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And that is what I am proud to share with you, my friend, my dearest friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这就是我最自豪能与你分享的，我的朋友，我最亲爱的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it is all these things that you share with me, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而这些也正是你与我之间所共享的部分，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And in little Marie, trust that you have a friend who shall stand beside you until the end, come what may.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而对于小玛丽，你要相信，无论发生什么，她都会永远陪伴在你身边，直到生命的尽头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think to myself, is this what the Indifference wishes to destroy ? Is this what the Indifference consumes ? That power of others to influence others ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后我心想，那种可以影响他人的力量 ？就是虚空无情之物想要摧毁的吗 ？就是虚空无情之物所吞噬的吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The gift to make each other laugh. To cry. To convince each other of truths or lies. To change each other's minds. To cheer each other when you are in pain. To hurt each other in folly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 彼此逗乐的礼物。彼此哭泣的礼物。彼此说服对方相信真话或谎言的礼物。彼此改变想法的礼物。在彼此痛苦时互相安慰的礼物。在愚蠢中互相伤害的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I think to myself, is this what the Indifference wishes to destroy ? Is this what the Indifference consumes ? That power of others to influence others ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后我心想，那种可以影响他人的力量 ？就是虚空无情之物想要摧毁的吗 ？就是虚空无情之物所吞噬的吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I will be honored to fight this beast, no matter what it may be, when that day comes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当那一天到来时，无论那野兽是什么，我都愿意与之战斗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not know how to say this, but I feel as though I must.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不知道该怎么表达，但我感觉我必须说出口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am sorry. It is simply how it must be. I expect you will find similar answers from the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很抱歉。事情就是这样。我想你就算从其他人那里也会得到类似的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The gift to make each other laugh. To cry. To convince each other of truths or lies. To change each other's minds. To cheer each other when you are in pain. To hurt each other in folly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 彼此逗乐的礼物。彼此哭泣的礼物。彼此说服对方相信真话或谎言的礼物。彼此改变想法的礼物。在彼此痛苦时互相安慰的礼物。在愚蠢中互相伤害的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To bring each other pleasure when you are in love. To bring each other agonie when you are lost to hatred. This is the gift of humanité - this is what the Indifference is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 相爱时彼此带来快乐，仇恨时彼此带来痛苦。这才是人性的馈赠——而虚空无情之物绝非如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The gift to make each other laugh. To cry. To convince each other of truths or lies. To change each other's minds. To cheer each other when you are in pain. To hurt each other in folly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 彼此逗乐的礼物。彼此哭泣的礼物。彼此说服对方相信真话或谎言的礼物。彼此改变想法的礼物。在彼此痛苦时互相安慰的礼物。在愚蠢中互相伤害的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vive l'amitié ! À bas l'indifférence ! Rah !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vive l'amitié ！À bas l'indifference！Rah ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者，Merci。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To bring each other pleasure when you are in love. To bring each other agonie when you are lost to hatred. This is the gift of humanité - this is what the Indifference is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 相爱时彼此带来快乐，仇恨时彼此带来痛苦。这才是人性的馈赠——而虚空无情之物绝非如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is impure and it is imperfect but it is beautiful like the stars in the sky. A billion little dots that make a tapestry of an ocean of light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人性并不纯净，也不完美，但它像天上的繁星一样美丽。无数细小的光点组成了一片光的海洋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To bring each other pleasure when you are in love. To bring each other agonie when you are lost to hatred. This is the gift of humanité - this is what the Indifference is not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 相爱时彼此带来快乐，仇恨时彼此带来痛苦。这才是人性的馈赠——而虚空无情之物绝非如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, je t'en prie !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，je t'en prie ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Mon cœur, I - I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Mon cœur，我——我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is impure and it is imperfect but it is beautiful like the stars in the sky. A billion little dots that make a tapestry of an ocean of light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人性并不纯净，也不完美，但它像天上的繁星一样美丽。无数细小的光点组成了一片光的海洋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is all detail with no précision, oui ? Who cares where it comes from... it is what we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它充满细节却缺乏 précision，oui ？它从哪里来并不重要……它就是我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is impure and it is imperfect but it is beautiful like the stars in the sky. A billion little dots that make a tapestry of an ocean of light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 人性并不纯净，也不完美，但它像天上的繁星一样美丽。无数细小的光点组成了一片光的海洋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is all detail with no precision, oui ? Who cares where it comes from... it is what we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它充满细节却缺乏精确，oui ？它从哪里来并不重要……它就是我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And it is all these things that you share with our devil, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而这些也正是你与恶魔之间所共享的部分，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is all detail with no précision, oui ? Who cares where it comes from... it is what we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 它充满细节却缺乏 précision，oui ？它从哪里来并不重要……它就是我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! The révolution will be one of companionship ! Of friendship ! Of the soul ! And let it start here !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！这场 révolution 是关于陪伴的 ！是关于友谊的 ！是关于灵魂的 ！就从这里开始 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! Mon cœur t'appartient depuis le premier moment de notre rencontre ! Je pouvais à peine réfléchir quand tu étais près de moi, j'avais l'impression d'avoir des papillons dans la tête !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！Mon cœur t'appartient depuis le premier moment de notre rencontre ！Je pouvais à peine réfléchir quand tu étais près de moi，j'avais l'impression d'avoir des papillons dans la tête ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And that is what you have with my dearest Lyon, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而这些也正是你与我最亲爱的里昂之间所共享的部分，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And that is what I am proud to share with you, my friend, my dearest friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这就是我最自豪能与你分享的，我的朋友，我最亲爱的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, my wolf. Je t'aime, je t'aime, je t'aime ! I shall shout it from the rooftops !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我的狼。Je t'aime，Je t'aime，Je t'aime ！我要在屋顶上大声说出来 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Nous tiendrons bon !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Nous tiendrons bon ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I will be honored to fight this beast, no matter what it may be, when that day comes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 当那一天到来时，无论那野兽是什么，我都愿意与之战斗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And is no wonder to me that others have come to feel the same about you ? How could they not ? How could others not love the stars in the sky the way I do ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 其他人也喜欢你，我一点也不觉得奇怪。他们怎么可能不这么想呢 ？其他人怎么可能不像我一样热爱天上的星星呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Vive l'amour ! À bas l'indifférence ! Rah !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Vive l'amour ！À bas l'indifference！Rah ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am not a jealous soul, mon cœur. And if they are important to you, and if you trust them, and they trust you ? Then I shall do the same, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: mon cœur，我不是那种会嫉妒的人。如果他对你很重要，如果你信任他，他也信任你，那么我也会这样做，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ha ! Non, I was not swearing at you, you silly wolf ! That was me being overcome with joie !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！Non，我没有骂你，你这只傻狼 ！那是我因为 joie 说不出话来 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, that was me being overcome with joie !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我几乎被 joie 淹没了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ha ! You are learning, oui ! I was simply overcome with joie !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈！你终于明白了，oui ！我几乎被 joie 淹没了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Best these matters be taken care of now. Before things... become complicated. I agree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这些事情最好现在就处理好，免得事情变得复杂。我同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I feel like Sol who has fallen in love with Lua for the first time. Who has fallen in love with the stars in the sky !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我感觉自己就像太阳神第一次爱上月神一样，爱上了天上的繁星 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I -
Oui, my wolf. Je t'aime, je t'aime, je t'aime ! I shall shout it from the rooftops !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我的狼。Je t'aime，Je t'aime，Je t'aime ！我要在屋顶上大声说出来 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! The révolution will be one of passion ! Of friendship ! Of the soul ! And let it start here !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！这场 révolution 是热血的 ！是友谊的 ！是灵魂的 ！就从这里开始 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Excuse-moi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Excusez-moi。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: We shall hold the line !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们一同坚守阵地 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! I am simply ravie !! I must go tell Lyon and brag to our devil !! And then you must come see me in the crypt, oui ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊！我简直太 ravie 了！！我得去告诉里昂，跟我们的恶魔炫耀一番 ！！然后你一定要来墓穴见我，oui ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: S'il te plaît ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: S'il te plaît ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! I am simply ravie !! I must go tell Lyon and brag to our devil !! And then you must come see me in the crypte, oui ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊！我简直太 ravie 了！！我得去告诉里昂，跟我们的恶魔炫耀一番 ！！然后你一定要来墓穴见我，oui ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wicked wolf, such a tease !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 坏狼，就会勾人 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do not tease me for long, wolf !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼，别一直撩我 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: S'il te plaît ?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: S'il te plaît ？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wicked wolf, such a tease !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 坏狼，就会勾人 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do not tease me for long, wolf !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼，别一直撩我 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Instead ? Then... I fear you must untangle the threads of your own heart first, Drifter. I cannot do this for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这样的话 ？那么……漂泊者，恐怕你必须先解开自己心中的纠结。我无法替你做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I simply pray that you do not lead Lyon astray or hurt him needlessly. He is a delicate thing, beneath that exterior of stone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只祈祷你不要误导里昂，也不要无谓地伤害他。他外表坚硬如石，内心却很脆弱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not wish Roathe suffering, for all that I needle him and lecture him. Do not cause him pain, if you can help it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我并不希望罗瑟受苦，虽然我总是批评他、训斥他。如果可以的话，请不要让他痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I do not wish to cause harm to others, and I will not be the "other woman" in someone's pain. If you feel stronger for me at the expense of someone else ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不想伤害他人，也不想成为别人痛苦中的"第三者"。如果你觉得为了我而牺牲别人的利益更有意义 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I recommend attending to that before speaking to me again, oui ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我建议你先处理好这件事再跟我说话，oui ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wolf ! My wolf ! I have met Otak ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼 ！我的狼 ！我见到奥塔了 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have met Otak ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我见到奥塔了 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Wolf ! My wolf ! The face upon the back of Monsieur Necraloid ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 狼 ！我的狼 ！殁世械灵先生背上的那张脸 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The face upon the back of Monsieur Necraloid ! I have finally met him !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 殁世械灵先生背上的那张脸 ！我终于见到他了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I did. Though perhaps I wanted to weep for it. For he introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 喜欢。不过我当时有点想哭。因为在同一个对话中，他……向我介绍了三次，仿佛我们从未互相认识过一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He... introduced himself to me thrice over in the same conversation, as though we had never been introduced.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 在同一个对话中，他……向我介绍了三次，仿佛我们从未互相认识过一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I found him nothing but sweet and charming ! But buried beneath a layer of humor, I felt great heartbreak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得他非常可爱迷人！但在这层幽默之下，我却感到无比心痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes, I would think so. A child's scrawl written on the back of an automaton. I found him nothing but sweet and charming !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，我也这么觉得。一个潦草的孩子笔迹写在机器的背面。我觉得他真是可爱又迷人 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why do you sound less than pleased that I met him ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么听上去你并不怎么高兴我见到他 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Greeting me in the same unflinching, cheerful way he had the previous times. But he knew me as a Sœur de Sol !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​像​之前​一样，​毫​不​犹豫、​兴高​采烈​地​迎接​我。​不过​他​居然​认出​我​是​一​位​ S​œur de Sol ！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will you tell me the story of poor Monsieur Otak ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你能告诉我那个可怜的奥塔先生的故事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But buried beneath the humor, there is great heartbreak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但幽默之下，却隐藏着巨大的伤痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Indeed, he knew much of the Luminaries ! We talked at length of the "Ancient Religions" as he dubbed them, in the "days before the Orokin Empire."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 实际上，他对双耀神了解颇多 ！我们聊了很多，聊了那些他称之为"奥罗金帝国之前"的"古代宗教"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would hope you would seek to be more kind with someone who is clearly infirme. Mais par la grâce de Sol, go we all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望你能对这位明显体弱多病的人更加友善。Mais par la grâce de 太阳神，指引我们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I would hope they would show him kindness and patience. Mais par la grâce de Sol, go we all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我希望大家能对他保持友善和耐心。 Mais par la grâce de 太阳神，指引我们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Though he said much of that knowledge was lost now, deep in the archives, and very much forbidden. He swore me to secrecy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 虽然他说很多这类知识现在都已遗失，深埋在档案馆里，而且是绝对禁止查阅的。他让我发誓保密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Such a fate could wait for any of us. Even you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 这样的命运可能发生在任何人身上，包括你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He told me that he was deeply concerned that Executor Ballas - whoever he may be - might discover my sect of heretics and have me executed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他告诉我，他非常担心执行者 Ballas（虽然我不知道他是谁）可能会发现我的异端教派，并处决我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I am sorry for wasting more of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我真抱歉我浪费了更多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I suspected... Well, he asked me where I was from, and when I told him, he laughed and said "no, that's impossible! And I should know, I'm -"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我当时也是这么想的……嗯，他问我来自哪里，当我告诉他之后，他笑了，说"不，这不可能！我应该知道，因为我——"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And then he... introduced himself to me again. And asked me if I was coming from the plains with mineral samples...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然后他……又向我做了自我介绍，并问我是不是带着矿物样本从平野过来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pauvre petit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pauvre petit……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It shatters me into a million pieces to think there is nothing to be done for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想到对他无能为力，我的心都要碎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, Luminaries - what manner of hell have you made for him, to keep his soul trapped within that cage of science and flickering lights?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，双耀神——你们为他创造了何等的地狱，将他的灵魂囚禁在科学和闪烁光芒的牢笼之中 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only pray to the Luminaries that you are right and nothing remains inside that shell but... but science and flickering lights.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能向双耀神祈祷，愿你是对的，愿那外壳里剩下的只有……只有科学和闪烁的光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I know you are not sure if the Cephalons contain souls - but I can only pray to the Luminaries that... that poor Otak does not suffer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我知道你不确定中枢是否有灵魂——但我只能向双耀神祈祷……愿可怜的奥塔不要受苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I can only pray to the Luminaries that all that remains inside that shell is nothing but... but science and flickering lights.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我只能向双耀神祈祷，愿那外壳里剩下的只有……只有科学和闪烁的光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Why leave him there, broken and waiting until he is allowed to die to be given peace? I can only pray... that if there is some kind of presence there -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 为什么要把他留在那里，让他痛苦地等待死亡，直到他死去才能获得安宁？我只能祈祷……如果那里真的有某种存在——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并且没有灵魂被困在那破碎的躯壳里，只有等待着最终死去才能获得安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: That no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愿没有灵魂被困在那破碎的躯壳里，只有等待着最终死去才能获得安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And no soul is trapped within that broken thing, waiting until it is allowed to finally die to be given peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 并且没有灵魂被困在那破碎的躯壳里，只有等待着最终死去才能获得安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is because he remains by choice as some kind of lonely vigil...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 愿那是因为他自己选择留下来，作为一个孤独的守夜人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Because if you are wrong, and a soul remains within that cage against its will ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 因为如果你错了呢，那个灵魂是被迫被困在那个牢笼里呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Or if there is some kind of presence there, it is because he remains by choice as some manner of lonely vigil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或者，如果那里真的有他的存在，愿那是因为他选择留下来，以某种孤独的方式守望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To think otherwise is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 否则，人便不免要质疑众神是否真的仁慈，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那就足以让人质疑众神的仁慈，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To think otherwise is enough to make one question the kindness of the gods, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 否则，人便不免要质疑众神是否真的仁慈，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And then where would I be ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那我又该置身何处呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Forgive me, I am... I am melancholy today.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 请原谅，我……我今天心情很低落。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci. Well, I no longer wish to be. I am going to go do something more cheerful ! I think M'sieur Fibonacci's tank is due for a dusting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci。嗯，我不想再这样了。我要去做些更快乐的事情 ！我觉得斐波那契先生的鱼缸该除尘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ha ! Merci. That is sure to stop these foolish tears of mine. You do know how to cheer silly little Marie, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哈 ！Merci。这下我肯定能止住这些傻眼泪了。你真会哄傻乎乎的小玛丽开心，Non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. You are quite right. They are. The world is full of no end of stories like that of Monsieur Otak, and many far worse than his. I should not weep over one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，你说得对。确实如此。像奥塔先生这样的故事比比皆是，世上还有许多比他更悲惨的故事。我不该只为一个故事哭泣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yet here I sit, doing just that. Thank you for reminding me of my foolishness. Fie! Silly little Marie. Well... I think M'sieur Fibonacci's tank is due for a dusting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 然而，我却坐在这里，做着这种事情。谢谢你提醒我有多愚蠢。呸！傻女孩玛丽。嗯……我想斐波那契先生的鱼缸该除尘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure, my wolf.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的狼，À la revoyure。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: À la revoyure !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: À la revoyure ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci. Let us go, then, and make mischief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，merci，merci。那我们走吧，去胡闹一番。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci, my wolf. Let us go, then, and make mischief.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我的狼，merci，merci，merci。那我们走吧，去胡闹一番。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have been thinking of how Monsieur Loid is so frightened of speaking to le Cardinal's family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我一直在想，洛德先生为什么那么害怕与主教的家人交谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And how we must break this impasse. This purgatoire in which we are trapped should not stand. It seems so needlessly painful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我们必须打破这种僵局。我们现在陷入的这种炼狱不应该继续下去。这种痛苦似乎完全没有必要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I feel as though we need... a bastion of some kind, non ? Do you have any ideas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我感觉我们需要……某种意义上的堡垒，non ？你有什么想法吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour ! Oh ? And what are you afraid I will not like ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour ！哦 ？你怕我不喜欢什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, mon cœur ! And what are you afraid I will not like ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，mon cœur ！你怕我不喜欢什么呢 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour mon cœur ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour mon cœur ！我仔细想过了，oui……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour mon cœur ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour mon cœur ！我仔细想过了，oui……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour - I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour——我仔细想过了，oui……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Bonjour, bonjour, mon cœur ! I have given it some thought, oui... and I am truly loath to admit it. It gives me no pleasure to say this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Bonjour，bonjour，mon cœur ！我仔细想过了，oui……但我真的不愿意承认。说出这些话让我一点也不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I think... I think - ah, Sol forgive me - that the devil's assistance may be required. I do not think Monsieur Loid will listen to us otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我想……我只是想想——啊，太阳神，请原谅我——我们或许需要恶魔的帮助。否则，我想洛德先生是不会听我们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I believe you may be right. The devil may be the missing piece we need. Ah, it pains me even to type the words !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我相信你说的或许是对的。恶魔或许正是我们需要的那块拼图。啊，光是打出这些字都让我感到痛苦 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Are you so sure ? If I can set aside my différences with the devil, certainly so can you, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你这么确定吗？如果连我都能放下与恶魔的 différences，你当然也能，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I... hate to admit it, but I think you may be right... Sol forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我……很不愿意承认，但我认为你可能是对的……太阳神，请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil is powerful, and provides certain promises of strength should things go wrong, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔很有能力，而且在事情出错时总会用力量来引诱人，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会在这件事上帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会在这件事上帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Will he give us his aid in this regard ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他会在这件事上帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Do you think you can convince him to help us, though ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你觉得你能说服他帮助我们吗 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I do not have to enjoy it, but it is un médicament we must swallow, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我也不喜欢这样，但我想，这是我们不得不吞下的 un médicament。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Then I will support your choice, as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么我也会支持你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are right, I am... not surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你说得对，我……确实不惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: He is helping to protect the family of the man who turned him into protoframe against his will, and cast him into the past, robbing him of his memories...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 他​居然​在帮忙保护那个男人的家人，尽管那个男人违背了他的意愿将他改造成原型战甲、剥夺了他记忆并将他放逐到过去……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! That is... unfortunate. I do not know ? I do not think so... Can you think of another approach with the devil ? Or a way to try again ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！那真是……太可惜了。我不知道 ？我想不到……你能想到其他办法说服恶魔吗 ？或者再试一次 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will speak to Lyon in the meanwhile, but my hopes are exceedingly low.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 同时我也会跟里昂沟通，但我并不抱太大希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, certainly I do. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我太知道了。那家伙一向固执得要命。有时候，我觉得他就是喜欢唱反调 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I do. But I think you have a special way of convincing him, where all others have failed, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我知道。我觉得你一定有一套能说服他的特别方法，因为其他人都失败了，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I think you have a special way of convincing him, where all others have failed, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我觉得你一定有一套能说服他的特别方法，因为其他人都失败了，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I wish you the best of luck. That devil can be obstinate at the best of times. Sometimes, I think he just enjoys being contrary !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 祝你好运。那家伙一向固执得要命。有时候，我觉得他就是喜欢唱反调 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui. At least you are around to ensure we keep him from following through on his... baser instincts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui。至少有你在，我们至少还能不让他顺着那些……原始本能乱来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I hope you are correct.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我希望你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I have deeply misjudged this devil of ours...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我严重看错了我们这个恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I am not a fool to not see the part you played in ensuring this all came to pass !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我也不是傻子，当然看得出你为了促成这一切所付出的努力 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: The devil is fickle ! C'est la vie, as they say !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 恶魔善变 ！正如人们所说的，C'est la vie ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, he certainly does seem to favor you. Perhaps it is because you share a time and a place, where we do not ? Why else would he ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，他似乎真的更喜欢你。也许是因为你们共享同一时空，而我们却不是？不然他为什么会这样呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ? What do you mean ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ？这是什么意思 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh ! That is not what I was implying, pardonne-moi ! Simply that he seems to favor you, so you may have his ear where all others he may ignore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦 ！我不是那个意思，pardonne-moi ！我只是说他似乎更偏爱你，所以虽然他不理其他人，但他可能听​你​的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I certainly have no idea what you mean ! I am not insinuating anything at all. I am a purely une innocente Sœur de Sol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我完全不明白你的意思 ！我并没有暗示什么。我只是一个单纯无辜的 Sœur de Sol。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！到时候我会做好准备，静候佳音 ！在此之前，merci。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then, merci, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！到时候我会做好准备，静候佳音 ！在此之前，merci，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，merci，merci ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Merci, merci, merci, mon cœur !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Merci，merci，merci，mon cœur ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am simply happy that you are happy. And if the devil has somewhere to spend his... efforts... all the better, non ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你开心我很高兴。而且如果恶魔也有地方可以消耗他的……精力……那就更好了，non ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would never imply that since the devil seems to favor you, perhaps he will listen to you where all others he seems to ignore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我​绝不​会​暗示，​既然​恶魔​似乎​偏袒​你，​那么​他​或许​就​会​听​你​的话，​因为​他​根本​不​会​听​其他​人​的话。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! When the time comes, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！到时候我会做好准备，静候佳音 ！直到那一天 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: No one has ever denied the devil his wit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 从来没有人否认过恶魔的聪明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I suppose I am atop that list of late, non ? I suppose I should... consider his reasons, for why he is the way he is. Condemnation saves no souls.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 想必​我​算​是​这些​人​中​带头​指责​的​人​了​吧？​我​想​我​应该​……​想​想​他​变成​现在​这样​的​原因。​定罪​救​不​了​任何​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There is always a pain we hide from those around us. Something we seek to shelter, for fear others will wield it. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 每个人都有一些不愿示人的痛苦吧。我们会小心将它保护起来，唯恐别人会利用它。如果你说的是真的，我想我应该对他好一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: There are always... nuances, oui ? Always reasons for acting one way or another. I suppose I should strive to be kinder to him, if what you say is true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 事情总会有……细微差别，oui ？每一种行为的背后都有其缘由。如果你说的是真的，我想我应该试着对他更友善一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I cannot imagine the amount of love and loss one must suffer in all those years. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我无法想象一个人在那些年里要承受多少爱与失去。即便我亲眼所见，这一切仍然让我觉得难以置信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Sometimes I forget, when I speak to him, how many centuries he has lived. It seems so unreal, even given all that I have seen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 有时和他交谈时，我会忘记他已经活了很多个世纪了。即便我亲眼目睹了这一切，也仍然觉得难以置信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Even more so for us all if you serve as a bit of un ange upon his shoulder to temper him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 如果你能在他身边当个 un ange 让他冷静下来，这对我们所有人都是好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And never during private moments. Non. Jamais.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 而且在私下的时候绝对不会。Non。Jamais。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, what damage could that cause a soul ? I see why you would wish to find another who understood. And he, you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，那会对灵魂造成什么伤害呢？我明白你为什么会想找一个能理解你的人。而他，也找到了你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: To have lived so long, to have seen so much death - to have paid so much of it yourself ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 活了这么久，目睹了这么多死亡——其中不少还是自己亲手造成的 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am simply glad the devil has someone to speak with who might seek to temper him. Un ange upon his shoulder.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我很高兴终于有人肯和恶魔交谈，或许还能让他有所收敛。你就像他肩上的 Un ange。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Perhaps you are right... what is un ange without son diable ? He reminds us all of what we should strive to avoid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 或许你是对的……没有 son diable，un ange 又算什么呢？是他提醒了我们所有人，我们应该努力去避免的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui, I fear there is a wickedness in him that cannot truly be cured. He enjoys it too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui，我担心他身上有一种无法真正治愈的邪恶。他太享受这种邪恶了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Well ! If and when you convince the devil to aid us in our mission, I will be ready and waiting ! Until then !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那么 ！如果哪天你成功说服恶魔帮助我们完成任务，我随时待命！直到那一天！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Pour toi, my wolf, anything. What is it ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！Pour toi，我的狼，一直都有。什么事 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! Pour toi, my friend, anything. What is it ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！Pour toi，我的朋友，一直都有。什么事 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, if I were any good at speaking with that devil, do you think I would always be screaming at him in Gaullique ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，你要真觉得我擅长和那个恶魔说话，那我怎么会一直用高卢语对他大喊大叫 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Non, if I were any good at speaking with that devil, do you think I would always be screaming at him in Gaullique ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Non，你要真觉得我擅长和那个恶魔说话，那我怎么会一直用高卢语对他大喊大叫 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pardonne-moi, I think you are on your own...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pardonne-moi，我想你只能靠自己了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will do what I can. For you, I will try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会尽我所能。为了你，我会努力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Pardonne-moi, I think you are on your own...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Pardonne-moi，我想你只能靠自己了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Drifter. I am being hounded by the devil. He annoys me to no end with those little fiends of his ! All in your name ! He says you simply wish to apologize on bent knee.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 漂泊者。我被那个恶魔缠上了。他带着他那些小恶魔不停来烦我 ！还说是替你说的 ！他说你跪着求我原谅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am being hounded by the devil. He annoys me to no end with those little fiends of his ! All in your name ! He says you wish to discuss my helping you in getting Monsieur Loid upstairs ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我被那个恶魔缠上了。他带着他那些小恶魔不停来烦我 ！还说是替你说的 ！他说你想谈谈让我帮你说服洛德先生上楼的事 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I am being hounded by the devil. He annoys me to no end with those little fiends of his ! All in your name ! He says you wish to discuss my commitment to le Cardinal once more ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我被那个恶魔缠上了。他带着他那些小恶魔不停来烦我 ！还说是替你说的 ！他说你想谈谈我对主教的坚持 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je vais le tuer ! Je savais que ce démon était rempli de la pire merde qui soit ! Je vais renvoyer ses conscrits d'où ils viennent par la peau des fesses !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je vais le tuer ！Je savais que ce démon était rempli de la pire merde qui soit ！Je vais renvoyer ses conscrits d'où ils viennent par la peau des fesses ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will not linger for long, as he did much convincing already in your absence. And as the devil is wont to be, he made quite a good case for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不会花太多时间谈这个，因为你不在的时候他已经说了不少有说服力的话了。而且，恶魔总是这样，他确实说得很有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I will not linger for long, as he did much convincing already in your absence. And as the devil is wont to be, he made quite a good case for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我不会花太多时间谈这个，因为你不在的时候他已经说了不少有说服力的话了。而且，恶魔总是这样，他确实说得很有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And why is that ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那你为什么要这样做 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And I admit I am... growing quite weary of being trapped down here with sans recours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我承认，我……越来越厌倦被困在这里，没有任何出路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But it was not his words, yet his cleverness you should thank. He sat me down with Monsieur Loid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但​你​应该​感谢​的​并非​他​的话，​而​是​他​的​机智。​他​让​我​和​洛德​先生​坐​下来谈。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: So, I say, very well. I will assist you. You will have my help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 所以，我说，好的。我会帮你。你会得到我的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: You are as bad as he is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你和他一样恶劣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: It was Loid's clarity of sight that allowed me to see through my own clouded lens. For Loid loves le Cardinal - his Albrecht - yet he sees him for all his flaws all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 正是洛德的清醒洞察力，让我得以透过自己蒙蔽的双眼看清真相。因为洛德深爱着主教——也就是他的阿尔布雷希特——但他同时也看清了他所有的缺点。
