/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Yes. He does. And yet can see him for all his flaws all the same. And it was that clarity of sight that allowed me to see through my own clouded lens.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 是的，他的确如此。然而他仍然能看清他所有的缺点。正是这种清醒的洞察力，让我得以透过自己蒙蔽的双眼看清真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: For what does it mean to love another, but to accept them for all the best and worst that they are, après tout ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 爱一个人意味着什么 ？不就是接受他的一切，无论对方的好坏，无论对方是怎样 ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oh, Drifter... my poor Drifter. You did not have to go to such lengths to find my forgiveness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 哦，漂泊者……我可怜的漂泊者。你不必费这么大劲去得到我的原谅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I would have given it to you had you but asked. You already have a place in my heart, you know ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 只要你开口，我肯定会原谅你的。你知道吗 ？你已经在我心里占有一席之地了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Oui ! And if you wish to be together with me, than I would like this as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Oui ！如果你也想和我在一起，那我也很愿意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: And that is your own fault, not mine ! But if you wish to be together with me, then I would like this as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 那都是你自己的错，不是我的 ！但如果你想和我在一起，那我也很愿意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Ah ! You have made me so happy !
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 啊！你太让我高兴了 ！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Je vais te jeter directement dans le Néant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: Je vais te jeter directement dans le Néant。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I fear you have already given your heart to the brother of my soul. I could not tear it from him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我恐怕你已经把心给了我的​灵魂​兄弟。我无法将它从他身上夺走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: But I fear you have already saddled yourself with the devil, non ? I will not meddle in his affairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 但我恐怕你已经和恶魔在一起了，不是吗？我不会碰他的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: I shall forgive you the previous errors you have made, but you must make up your mind in regards to your other affairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 我会原谅你之前犯下的错，但你也必须对你的其他事情做出决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.text: Certainly you understand, n'est pas ?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MarieRomance.zhText: 你当然明白，n'est pas ？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Minerva & Velimir, I assume?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我猜你们是米尼娃和维利米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Okay... Can we back up, please? What's going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 行了……我们能不能倒带一下？到底发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I get the feeling there are going to just end up being more and more as time goes on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我感觉随着时间的推移，类似的怪胎只会越来越多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can you two sort out whatever is happening and *then* come talk to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩能不能先把眼前事解决了*再*来找我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I am so extremely confused.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我现在真的超困惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hi?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你好？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why do I get the feeling I'm being interrogated?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为什么我感觉自己像是在被审问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well. Um. I'd rather if you didn't try to "game" the conversation with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯，我倒希望你不要试图在对话中玩什么"套路"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What do you have questions about? I'll help if I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你有什么问题？如果可以的话我会尽力帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Nah, sorry. I don't like your attitude, lady.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不，抱歉。女士，我不喜欢你的态度。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Okay, fine. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，行。什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And this is...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你是……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's... complicated?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这……有点复杂？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I... don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我……不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What the hell is this about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这到底是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Who's "she?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you let me explain, for two seconds, maybe you'd believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果你能给我两秒钟时间解释，或许你会相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I *don't* know what's happened to her! That's the literal Void's honest truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我*真不知道*她发生了什么事！千真万确。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: This is getting ridiculous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这太荒唐了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you saying you think I'm responsible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你是说你觉得我有责任吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The thing that's responsible for what's happened to her is a giant, unknowable Void god. You want to pick a fight with him? Be my guest and get in line.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 导致她现在这样的，是一个巨大、不可知的虚空之神。你想跟他斗吗？请便，去排队吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yes and no? Look, it's not like I shot her in the head. I didn't. Even when I had a chance to. ...Okay, there were the rockets, but that's different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有也没有？听着，我可没有对着她的头开枪。我没有。即便我有机会也没那样做。……好吧，是用过那些火箭，不过那是另外一回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What's happened to her is complicated, lady. And I don't appreciate your tone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 女士，发生在她身上的事很复杂。而且我不喜欢你这种语气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Short of it is - I don't have a beef with her, and I'm doing my best to hold shit together around here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 简单来说——我对她无怨无仇，而且我正在尽力维持这里的秩序。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'll help you if I can, but you're not giving me any reason to right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果我能的话我会帮你，但你现在还没有给我任何理由去这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So, lady? Can you not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，女士？你能不能别这样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So please, take it down a notch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，请你冷静一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I think she signed off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想她已经下线了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哎呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I get it. Double whammy with the military background.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我理解。加上军事背景，情况更复杂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm getting used to people attacking me lately. It's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我最近已经习惯了被别人攻击。没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well, it's not an excuse to act like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯，这并不能作为那种行为的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: None needed. Let's just work this out tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不用道歉。我们明天再解决这个问题吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: *You* don't. *She* does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: *你*不用道歉。是*她*应该道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Have you decided to be less of a bitch, "Minerva?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "米尼娃"，你决定要不那么婊了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can we... just drop the attitude? Please? I'm not your enemy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们能不能……不带着这种态度聊天？拜托了？我不是你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What in the ever-loving Void is your problem with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你特么到底对我有什么意见？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I just wish I had better answers for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 真希望当时能给你们更好的答复。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Is she always like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她一直都这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Lol. It's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。没事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Lol. Whoops. Forgot. Group chat. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。哎呀。忘了是群聊。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh. Um. Hi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦。嗯。嗨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Still getting used to this whole... past technology thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我还在适应这整个……过去的科技玩意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Just because you don't like my answer doesn't make it fake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你不喜欢我的回答，并不意味着它是虚假的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm not giving you non-answers. What you're asking me really has no *good* answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我没有给你含糊其辞的答案。你问我的问题真的没有*好的*答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I wonder why that is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你说这是为什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well, maybe if you weren't being so vicious, I'd be more willing to talk to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯，或许如果你没那么恶劣，我会更愿意和你说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And what's wrong with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这有什么问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You don't know the first thing about me, lady.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 女士，你对我一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: G'morning, Minerva. If that is your real name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 早上好，米尼娃。如果这是你的真名的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We've dropped the "quotes", I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 看来我们不再用"引号"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Now you're asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你终于会先问一下了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What is the problem I'm supposed to be solving?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我应该解决的是什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why should I help you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我为什么要帮你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And what does this have to do with Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这和鲁莎卡有什么关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can you back up and take a minute to explain to me why you care about Rusalka so much?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你能不能倒回去一下，花点时间解释一下为什么你这么在乎鲁莎卡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: For the first two, yeah. I don't actually really care two shits about why he went after Rusalka.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 对于前两点来说，你评估的很正确。我其实根本不在乎他为什么要对鲁莎卡下手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sure. Yeah. That's correct.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 当然。很正确。你分析得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I hate to break it to you, but we're probably stuck waiting until the Man in the Wall makes his next move.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不过我得告诉你，我们可能需要等到墙中人下一次出手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because then I'd have been no different than the Indifference. Than Scaldra. Than Entrati. I don't go around senselessly murdering people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为那样的话，我就和虚空无情之物、炽蛇军、英择谛没什么两样了。我不是无缘无故杀人的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because it wasn't really her making the choices that led her to that point. Just because I wouldn't kill her for it in the moment, doesn't mean I *care* enough to go out of my way to save her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为真正让她陷入那种境地的决定并不是她自己做的。就因为我当时不会因此杀了她，并不意味着我足够*在乎*去不惜一切代价救她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because I wasn't about to do Entrati's dirty work for him. If he wanted to kill the Indifference's new puppet, he could do it himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为我没打算替英择谛干他的脏活。如果他想除掉虚空无情之物的新傀儡，他可以自己动手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Which implies that I purposefully murder people. Which I don't. I mean. I do kill people. But it's different. You know what I mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这说明我是有目的地杀人。但我并非如此。我的意思是。我确实杀了人。但情况不一样。你懂我的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I didn't *know* her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我又不*认识*她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But just as I suspected, the old bastard only likes to shoot people he knows will get back up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但正如我所预料的，那个老混账只喜欢射杀那些他知道能够重新站起来的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can't exactly slap a tracking beacon on a demigod-god-thing, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，我们无法就这样给一个半神这样的存在放个追踪器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: His motivations are a bit lost on us at the moment, yeah. But it's nothing good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，他的动机，现在我们也有点摸不清楚。但肯定没什么好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's fine. I die a lot. I'm used to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没关系，我死过很多次，已经习惯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It doesn't really matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这并不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why are you so desperate to learn what happened to Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你为什么这么迫切想知道鲁莎卡发生了什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What'd she say...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她说的是什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Gonna guess that was rude language.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我猜她说的那些是粗话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you two... married?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩……是夫妻吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You two... raised... Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们两个……抚养了鲁莎卡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah, doesn't seem like you two are still together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，看起来你们已经不在一起了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That explains the arguing I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这样就解释了你们争吵的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你说谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Lol. Hi, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。嗨，维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm going to assume you mean Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我猜你指的是阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Duviri. It's complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那个地方叫双衍王境。这很复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah, it's a long story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，这是个很长的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm all right. Doing better since I came here, weirdly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我没事。说来也怪，自从来了这里，感觉好多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Just don't snap my spine when you do it, big guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 只要你抱的时候别把我的脊椎折断就行，大块头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'll never turn down a free hug.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我可不会拒绝免费的拥抱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can I ask you what the deal is between you two and Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我能问问，你们俩和鲁莎卡到底是什么关系吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Minerva still pissed at you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃还在生你的气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So... Are you and Minerva... A thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以……你跟米尼娃是……一对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That explains the arguing I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这样就解释了你们争吵的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah, doesn't seem like you two are still together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，看起来你们已经不在一起了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: This isn't your fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这不是你的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh...
I'm so sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um... How long have you two been together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯……你们俩在一起多久了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey Minerva, um... what's your favorite color?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，米尼娃，嗯……你最喜欢的颜色是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Minerva, can I ask you about Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，我可以问你关于鲁莎卡的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Minerva, can I ask you about you and Velimir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，我可以问你关于你和维利米尔的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Go get a drink?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 去喝一杯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: (And you do realize you can, y'know, go away, right?)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: （你知道你可以，你懂的，离开，对吧？）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'd like to ask you about you and Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想问一下你关于你和维利米尔的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'd like to hear the story of you and Rusalka from your point of view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想从你的角度听听你和鲁莎卡的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Nah... I'm good. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没……没事。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How long have you two been together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩在一起多久了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How did it fall apart between you two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩是怎么分手的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How did you two fall in love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩是怎么相爱的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How did you two meet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩是怎么认识的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm following.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. Let's say I have experience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯。可以说我有过类似的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did you tell Velimir any of this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你跟维利米尔说过这些吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did you tell Rusalka any of this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你跟鲁莎卡说过这些吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Uh... How did it fall apart between you two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃……你们俩是怎么分手的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃……你们俩是怎么相爱的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um... How long have you two been together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯……你们俩在一起多久了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um... How did it fall apart between you two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯……你们俩是怎么分手的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um... How did you two fall in love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯……你们俩是怎么相爱的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Nothing wrong with being the hero.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 成为英雄没什么不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You couldn't trust them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你不信任他们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Define "dead."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么定义"死亡"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We don't know if she's dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们还不知道她是不是确实死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm getting the feeling I'd make a pretty lousy spy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我感觉我会成为一个很差劲的间谍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How did it fall apart between you two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩是怎么分手的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I wish I could make some kind of promise about finding her. Or saving her. But I can't. And I won't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我真希望我能保证能找到她，或者救她。但我不能。也不会做出这种承诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Like I said, there's no knowing what's happened to her. Which means there's hope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 就像我说的，没人知道她发生了什么事。这也意味着还有希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah, well. Ease off the *verbal* toxic spores next time, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是啊，那，下次话里少带点有毒孢子，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "Apology" accepted?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 接受你的"道歉"了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Apology accepted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 接受你的道歉了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah, well. Ease off the *verbal* toxic spores next time, okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是啊，那，下次话里少带点有毒孢子，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So, Velimir. What's Rusalka's... deal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那个，维利米尔。鲁莎卡……是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So, Minerva. What's Rusalka's... deal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那个，米尼娃。鲁莎卡……是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm just curious how exactly she became such a military zealot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我就是好奇她怎么就成了一个军事狂热分子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well, she's... I'm wondering how she got to be who she is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯，她……我很好奇她是怎么变成现在这个样子的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well, she's... I'm wondering how she got to be who she is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯，她……我很好奇她是怎么变成现在这个样子的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm just curious how exactly she became such a military zealot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我就是好奇她怎么就成了一个军事狂热分子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Guys? I'm still here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 各位？我还在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Holy shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……我的天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I... feel like I should go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我……觉得我该下了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yep... I think I understand Rusalka a lot more now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好……我想我现在对鲁莎卡有更多的了解了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Should I just let you two talk? I feel like you both have a lot to sort out here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我是不是应该让你们俩单独谈谈？我觉得你们俩还有很多事情要解决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, so *that's* why she keeps her medals pinned to her - well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，所以这就是为什么她把奖章别在——好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not going to lie, I was pretty distracted by her "assets," so it worked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说实话，我被她的"胸器"深深吸引住了，所以这招奏效了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Guys? I'm still here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 各位？我还在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Holy shit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……我的天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I... feel like I should go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我……觉得我该下了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yep... I think I understand Rusalka a lot more now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好……我想我现在对鲁莎卡有更多的了解了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not sure how you're supposed to wear them, but pretty sure it's not like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不确定你们应该怎么戴它们，但我很确定不是那样戴的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not going to lie, I was pretty distracted by her "assets," so it worked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说实话，我被她的"胸器"深深吸引住了，所以这招奏效了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, so *that's* why she keeps her medals pinned to her - well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，所以这就是为什么她把奖章别在——好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Should I just let you two talk? I feel like you both have a lot to sort out here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我是不是应该让你们俩单独谈谈？我觉得你们俩还有很多事情要解决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Growing up in your household must have been a fascinating experience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 在你们家里长大一定是一段很有意思的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well, if she's a fishing lure, grab a Lanzo and call me a Cuthol, because I'm speared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，如果她是一个鱼饵，那就拿起一把兰佐鱼叉并叫我克苏尔，因为我被钓到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not sure how you're supposed to wear them, but pretty sure it's not like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不确定你们应该怎么戴它们，但我很确定不是那样戴的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Then grab a Lanzo and call me a Cuthol, because I'm speared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那就拿起一把兰佐鱼叉并叫我克苏尔，因为我被钓到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Growing up in your household must have been a fascinating experience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 在你们家里长大一定是一段很有意思的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How did she lose her arm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她是怎么失去手臂的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I wish I had met that version of her. I feel like we would have gotten along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我希望我遇到的是那个版本的她。我觉得我们会相处得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: People on different sides of a war tell each other stories to both be the heroes. Who knows how it would have gone if we'd met under different circumstances.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 战争中不同立场的人总是各说各故事塑造自己的英雄形象。要是我们在不同的情况下相遇，事情又会怎么发展呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: People on different sides of a war tell each other stories to both be the heroes. Who knows how it would have gone if we'd met under different circumstances.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 战争中不同立场的人总是各说各故事塑造自己的英雄形象。要是我们在不同的情况下相遇，事情又会怎么发展呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How did she lose her arm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她是怎么失去手臂的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I wish I had met that version of her. I feel like we would have gotten along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我希望我遇到的是那个版本的她。我觉得我们会相处得很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh. It was recent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦。原来是最近的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You didn't know...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你不知道……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well...?
... Depends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……看情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How'd you two get together in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩最初是怎么走到一起的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey Velimir. Can I ask *you* how you and Minerva got together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，维利米尔。我可以问*你*你和米尼娃是怎么在一起的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I asked Minerva, but... y'know...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我问过米尼娃了，但……你懂的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You can go [REDACT] yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你可以去 [屏蔽] 你自己了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... You're screwing with me, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ......你是在逗我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What kind of conference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么样的会议？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Wait wait wait wait wait. They have conferences for black ops international spies?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 等等，等等，等等。他们有黑色行动国际间谍会议？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Focus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 别打岔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 记住了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Like mother like daughter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有其母必有其女？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What was that again? I missed it. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么来着？我错过了。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I get the vibe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道那种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What's a skunk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 臭鼬是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Nope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I bet mine are worse. I spent centuries stuck in a pocket dimension by myself with nobody but storybook people who kept slaughtering me to interact with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我敢打赌我的情话更烂。几个世纪以来，我只身一人被困在一个狭窄的维度里，除了那些不断屠杀我的故事书里的人和我互动之外，谁也没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: They couldn't have been that bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没那么烂吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh yeah? Like what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，是吗？比如什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's a miracle I'm not still single, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说实话，我能脱单，还真是个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But, contrary to popular belief, I *choose* to be single.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但是，与普遍的看法相反，我*选择*单身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Seriously, why do you think I'm still single?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说真的，你觉得我为什么还是单身？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I think that was cute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我觉得挺可爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Ouch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……哎哟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That wasn't *that* bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也没*那么*烂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir. Seriously?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔。真的吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HORRIFIED>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: LMAO!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 笑死我了！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir. I'm both impressed and disappointed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔。我既感叹，又失望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did any of them work?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 其中有哪个有用吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir. I'm both impressed and disappointed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔。我既感叹，又失望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did it work?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这招有用吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You gotta do what you gotta do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 该做的事还是得做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Compared to the other things I've had to adjust to in my life? Not really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 与我人生中不得不适应的其他事情相比？这根本不算什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Kind of? But I've enjoyed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有点？但我还挺乐在其中的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I like having a place with walls and windows for a change. And not a ship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有时候我喜欢换个有墙有窗的地方。而不是生活在船上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The company. It's nice to feel like I belong somewhere for once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是因为陪伴。终于觉得自己属于某个地方，这感觉真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The food.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是因为食物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How'd you wind up getting mixed up with Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你怎么跟英择谛扯上关系的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I assume you came here looking for Rusalka and found Entrati instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我猜你来这里找鲁莎卡的，结果却碰上了英择谛？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Arthur can try it first. Cut it into a cube. Tell him it'll finally make us even.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 可以让亚瑟先试试。把它切成方块。告诉他这样我们就扯平了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Ew...
I am not volunteering to try it first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我可不想第一个尝试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么症？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And Entrati had just the injection for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而英择谛正好有治疗它的注射剂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's too late to stop him, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 现在阻止他已经太迟了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. Yeah, I think I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。是的，我想我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. Front row seat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。前排座位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well... I'm glad you're here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯……我很高兴你在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you so sure about that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你真的确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You can, can you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你，你能吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I don't know why I keep falling for this shit... I really don't...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道为什么我老是上这种当……我真的不知道……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I give up. I just. I give up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我放弃了。我真的。放弃了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You do you. But I think I'll be curled up in a dark place regretting my decisions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 随你便。我想我会去一个暗点的地方好好反省一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No. No. I'm out. I'm just out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不。不要。我真的不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I figured it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我猜是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: In how you became protoframes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是你怎么变成原型战甲的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can't tell which would be worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不知道哪个更糟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No clue. Entrati has experimented on animals in the past, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不知道。不过，英择谛之前用动物做过实验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You should probably go lay down now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你现在应该躺下休息了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Tell her what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 告诉她什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么症？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And Entrati had just the injection for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而英择谛正好有治疗它的注射剂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. Front row seat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。亲眼所见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well... I'm glad you're here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯……我很高兴你们在这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Still feel like you won?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还是觉得自己赢了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Lol. You okay over there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。你那边还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啥啊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you so sure about that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你真的确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You can, can you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你吗，你能吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm glad I missed out, I don't know if my eardrums could have taken it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还好我错过了这些，我的耳膜不知道受不受得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh yeah? Who told you that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊？谁告诉你的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I feel like I missed out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我感觉我错过了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I figured it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我猜是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Minerva? What was he referencing when he said "you've been through this a thousand times?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……米尼娃？他说"你们已经经历过无数次了"指的是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I feel like I'm going to say this a lot. But. Um. Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我觉得我经常要说这句话。但是，呃，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You should probably go lay down now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你现在应该躺下休息了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Tell her what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 告诉她什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And how do you feel about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那你对此有何感想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You suppose?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你觉得？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's starting to feel like my job. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我开始觉得这是我的工作了。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有什么我能帮得上忙的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Don't worry about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 别担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Still feel like you won?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还是觉得自己赢了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Lol. You okay over there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。你那边还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So. Yeah. About... what you said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那个。确实。关于……你说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Is that not how you actually feel?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这难道不是你的真实感受吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm glad I missed out, I don't know if my eardrums could have taken it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还好我错过了这些，我的耳膜不知道受不受得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh yeah? Who told you that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊？谁告诉你的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I feel like I missed out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我感觉我错过了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you say so. But going around helping people through their problems seems to be how we're going to beat this thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 随你怎么说。但到处帮助人们解决困难似乎是我们战胜这东西的方法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No, stop. Go back. You said Velimir is in love with the idea of being in love. I want to dig into that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不，打住。回到前面的话。你说维利米尔爱上了爱情这个概念。我想研究一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I guess. But I think you really need to cut Velimir some more slack. He's trying his best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想是吧。但我觉得你真的需要对维利米尔多一些宽容。他已经尽力了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's a little reductive. But. Maybe. Kind of. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这样说有点过于简单了。但是。也许。算是吧。是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ...Well, when you say it like that, it sounds ridiculous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……哎呀，你这么说，听起来就很荒谬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Do you honestly think that Velimir doesn't really love you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你真的认为维利米尔不是真正地爱你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You really think your whole marriage was based on a lie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你真的认为你们的婚姻是建立在谎言之上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why do you think that way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为什么你会这么认为？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So you think he's lying to himself, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以你觉得他这样是在自欺欺人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Minerva. Throw me a bone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃。给我一个提示好吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Minerva? What was he referencing when he said "you've been through this a thousand times?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……米尼娃？他说"你们已经经历过无数次了"指的是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I feel like I'm going to say this a lot. But. Um. Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我觉得我经常要说这句话。但是，呃，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So you think that... he's in love with the ideal of you, but not the real you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以你认为……他爱的是理想中的你，而不是真实的你？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And you think he put those beliefs onto you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你觉得他也对你有这些信念？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And how do you feel about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那你对此有何感想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You suppose?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你觉得？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's starting to feel like my job. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我开始觉得这是我的工作了。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有什么我能帮得上忙的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm sorry she treats you like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很抱歉她那样对你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Was she right...? Was that what you were going to say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她说得对吗……？这就是你要说的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's clear you still have feelings for her, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但很显然你仍然对她有感情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But it's not fair to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但这对你不公平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You think she's a better spy than you are?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你认为她是一个比你更优秀的间谍吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why were you going to crack a joke when you know it was going to make her mad?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 既然你知道这会让她生气，为什么还要开玩笑呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know you two have personal problems to sort out, but I've decided I don't want to get involved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道你们俩有私人问题要解决，但我决定不插手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey. Guys? I'm sick of dancing around the subject when it's all right here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿。伙计们？我已经烦了就着一个问题原地转圈了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can we just deal with this already, please?! Velimir feels like he's a burden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 拜托，我们能不能先解决一下这个问题？！维利米尔觉得自己是个负担。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can we just deal with this already, please?! Minerva thinks she's a bad wife.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 拜托，我们能不能先解决一下这个问题？！米尼娃觉得自己不是个好妻子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And, Minerva, it's clear you have feelings you haven't worked out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而且，米尼娃，很明显你还有情绪问题没有解决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And, Velimir, it's clear that you have feelings you haven't worked out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而且，维利米尔，很明显你还有情绪问题没有解决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know you two have a lot of messy feelings going on, and I really want to help you both get to the bottom of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道你们之间有很多错乱交织的情绪，我真的很想帮你们俩把它弄明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir, it's not fair to treat everything in your life like a joke, and make Minerva deal with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，你把你生活中的一切都当成玩笑，让米尼娃来处理，这不公平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Minerva, Velimir thinks he's the only one who has feelings in your relationship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，维利米尔认为他是你们的关系中唯一有感情的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Don't pick a fight, Minerva.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，别拱火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Don't pick a fight, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，别拱火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's not about the chat logs. Focus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 重点不在聊天记录。说重点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Okay, settle down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好的，冷静一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can you both stop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩个能停下来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Okay, settle down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好的，冷静一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can you both stop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩个能停下来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Okay, settle down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好的，冷静一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can you both stop?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩个能停下来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You said you're both here to find answers about Neci. But I don't think that's the only reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你说你们俩来这是为了寻找关于内奇的答案。但我认为这并非唯一的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. I get it. He's exhausting. She's exhausting. But you're both still here. Together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，我明白。他筋疲力尽。她也筋疲力尽。 但你们都还在这里。在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: NOPE! THAT'S IT! I'm DONE. The Indifference can have you two!!! [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不！我受够了！我不干了。你们俩去虚空无情之物哪儿吧！！！[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: BOTH OF YOU SHUT UP FOR ONE SECOND.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩都给我闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I don't think either of you have given up on what you had together when it was good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我认为你们都没有忘记你们在一起时的美好时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So. Give up, then. If that's what you want to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那就放弃吧。如果你们想这么做的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You don't need to attack him, Minerva.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，你没必要攻击他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He's trying to diffuse a tense situation in the way he feels the most comfortable, through humor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他试图用对他来说最舒服的方式来缓解紧张的局势，用幽默。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I give up. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不干了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Knock that off, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，别闹了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I understand why that gets exhausting. And why you might want him to take things seriously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我明白为什么这会让人精疲力竭。也理解你为什么希望他认真对待事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I can understand the impulse. If he can make people laugh, they might be able to connect easier. Or in this case, reconnect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我能理解这种冲动。如果他能让人们开怀大笑，他们可能会更容易建立关系。或者在这种情况下，重新建立关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But by using humor or being silly, he's trying to cut the wires to the ticking bomb. Not avoid it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但他用幽默或愚蠢的方式，是想切断定时炸弹的电线。而不是逃避。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It can feel belittling, after a while, when you feel like everything you say gets turned into a knock-knock joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 久而久之，当你觉得自己说的每一句话都变成了文字游戏时，你就会觉得自己被轻视了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But it can feel belittling, after a while, when you feel like everything you say gets turned into a knock-knock joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但久而久之，当你觉得自己说的每一句话都变成了文字游戏时，你就会觉得自己被轻视了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: By using humor or being silly, he's trying to cut the wires to the ticking bomb. Not avoid it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他用幽默或愚蠢的方式，是想切断定时炸弹的电线。而不是逃避。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And the loss of Rusalka, even though she was an adult who made her own choices, clearly hit you both hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 尽管鲁莎卡已经长大成人，做出了自己的选择。但失去她，显然对你们俩打击很大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I don't think either of you have really dealt with that. Together. Alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我觉得你们俩都没有真正对付这个情况。无论是在一起。还是一个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I think you *should.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而我认为你们*应该*这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah, okay, I see your point, Minerva. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好嘞，米尼娃，我明白你的意思了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know. But I need you to try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道。但我需要你试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Vel. This is one of those times where you should be serious for a little bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维尔。这个时候，你应该认真一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And Minerva, I need you to try to lighten up. Just a little. And try to let him cheer you up. Just a tiny bit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有米尼娃，我需要你试着放松一下。就一点点。试着让他使你开心起来。就一点点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And Minerva, I need you to cut him some serious slack. He's lost a lot, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有米尼娃，我需要你对他宽容一点。他也失去了很多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yep. Okay. Never mind. You're right, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧。好吧。算了。维利米尔，你说得对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Minerva.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Don't pick a fight, Minerva.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，别拱火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Don't pick a fight, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，别拱火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's not about the chat logs. Focus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 重点不在聊天记录。说重点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You said you're both here to find answers about Neci. But I don't think that's the only reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你说你们俩来这是为了寻找关于内奇的答案。但我认为这并非唯一的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. I get it. He's exhausting. She's exhausting. But you're both still here. Together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，我明白。他筋疲力尽。她也筋疲力尽。 但你们都还在这里。在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So. Give up, then. If that's what you want to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那就放弃吧。如果你们想这么做的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I don't think either of you have given up on what you had together when it was good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我认为你们都没有忘记你们在一起时的美好时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Do I want to ask how the date went? Or is this one of those moments where I don't want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我该不该问问你们的约会怎么样？还是这不是我想知道的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I've decided that you two can split a pizza and fix whatever it is you've got going on. I'd really rather not keep trying to sort this out. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我决定让你们俩分吃一个披萨，然后解决你们之间的问题。我真的不想再为这事费心了。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey, so... let's try this again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，那么……让我们再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You two holding up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩个还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No, because it's clear you two still care about each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不，因为很明显你们还在乎彼此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Is that what you want me to do, Minerva?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，你想让我这么做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Something tells me if you both didn't think there was hope, neither of you would never have entertained these conversations from the start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我的直觉告诉我，如果你们俩都不认为有希望，从一开始就不会进行这些对话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because you both had that spark for each other once. And if it existed before, it can exist again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为你们曾经擦出过火花。如果曾经有过，那应该可以再擦出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So, you're saying that you are?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，你是说你想放下？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I wasn't asking Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不是在问维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You two had something that drew you together. What was it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩有某种东西吸引着你们在一起。是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Tell me a story about the two of you working together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 给我讲讲你们俩一起工作的故事吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Wait. What did the chickens have to do with anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 等等。这一切跟那些鸡有什么关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: To each their own... I suppose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 每个人都有自己的想法……我想……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: O...kay, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好……吧，然后呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Very thoughtful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这真体贴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ....Right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……是吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um...
Are you two flirting, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们俩现在在打情骂俏吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: AaggghhhHH!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊啊啊啊！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm gonna just...show myself out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我……要走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah... who knows. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是啊……谁知道呢。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did she know you two had fallen apart?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她知道你们俩已经分开了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Could you tell if she was... y'know. "Him" yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你当时能分辨出她是不是……你知道。"他"了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What did you three talk about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们三个当时聊了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Her? Stressed? Hard to imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她？紧张？很难想象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Stressed about what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 紧张什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How'd you end things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们是怎么结束通话的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did you tell her you were coming to Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你告诉她你要来霍瓦尼亚了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Which was?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm sure she still knows that, no matter what's really happened to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我相信她依然知道的，不管她到底发生了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She was lucky to have you both as parents.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有你们这两位父母，她真是幸运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃哦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ...Snowman?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……雪人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, look at the time. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，你看时间。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We're doing dad jokes, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们现在在讲老爸笑话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I don't know, why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道，为什么这么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um...
Yeeeeah I'd rather go put holes in things, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，我宁愿去给东西打洞，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Lol. All right. Why did the snowman go to therapy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。好吧。雪人为什么要去做心理治疗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: *Groan.* You're fired.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: *无奈呻吟声。*你被开除了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: LOL.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 笑死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Gotcha...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 明白……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And that's supposed to look like a human?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那看上去应该像个人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I... need to go save the world. Or... fight evil... or... sort my socks... or something. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我……要去拯救世界了。或者……对抗邪恶势力……或者……收拾我的袜子……或者别的什么的。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'll bite. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想知道。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I want to build a snowman. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想堆一个雪人。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh. Neat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦。真不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Wait. But I need to know the answer!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……等一下。但我要知道答案！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Seriously?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不会吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Does Rusalka ever laugh? I mean, really laugh? Like - not evil laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 鲁莎卡会笑吗？我是说真的笑吗？不是那种邪恶的笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So has Rusalka always been... Um. How should I put this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那个，鲁莎卡一直以来都是这么……嗯，怎么说好呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I could picture that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我可以想象到那一幕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're kidding me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你在开玩笑吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 差不多吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You said it, not me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是你说的，我可没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did she ever laugh as a kid? Like, a normal laugh. Not an evil laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她小时候笑过吗？就像正常的笑一样。不是那种邪恶的笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I could picture that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我可以想象到那一幕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're kidding me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你在开玩笑吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh? What does she find funny? (Please no more dad jokes.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦？她觉得什么好笑？（请不要再讲老爸笑话了。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Probably for the best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也许那样最好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What went wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 出什么问题了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hold up. Cold War?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 等等。冷战？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Wait wait wait. Tooth camera?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 等等，等等。牙齿相机？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What ancient statues?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么古代雕像？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why were you after his tooth camera, exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你到底为什么要找他的牙齿相机？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Still stuck on the whole "tooth camera" thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还在纠结"牙齿相机"的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Okay then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You broke into a major museum to steal his tooth back... for a birthday gift?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你闯入一家大型博物馆，就为了把他的牙齿偷回来……当生日礼物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Probably for the best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也许那样最好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What went wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 出什么问题了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You two lovebirds have fun. I'm going to go wander off. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们这对儿玩得开心。我先去溜溜了。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But what if I want to pay him to be a tour guide?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但如果我想付钱请他当导游呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Even if we never get answers about Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 即使我们永远也得不到关于鲁莎卡的答案？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Really? Why's that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 真的吗？那是为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Um. Okay. Noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃。好吧。我记下了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What's... that supposed to mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那……那是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey... guys?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿。伙计们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I have good news and I have bad news. About Neci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。都是关于内奇的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I need you both not to get your hopes up. I have news about Neci, but it's... mixed. And inconclusive.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们先别太激动。我有内奇的消息了，不过……情况有些复杂。目前还没有定论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Fff... Actually, never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 唉……算了，没事。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I don't... know. I don't think so. But let me just tell you what I do know, and I'll let you two be the judges.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我……不确定。我觉得她可能不在了。我还是先把我知道的都告诉你们吧，剩下的你们自己判断。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So. The Indifference went to Duviri. and it... took Neci there with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那个，虚空无情之物进到双衍王境里了，然后……它还把内奇带到那里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Turns out this was kind of a growth moment for him? Not the point. Anyway-
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 结果这反而对他来说算是个成长的契机？但这不是重点。总之——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's the one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 就是那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Neci... took the throne. The Murmur - The Indifference's "army" for lack of a better word, invaded, and she took over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 内奇……坐上了王位。低语者——也就是虚空无情之物所谓的"军队"，抱歉我想不到更好的词来形容了。它们发起了入侵，然后她趁机掌控了局面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's what I wanted to talk to you about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我就是想跟你们聊聊这个事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I found these records. They were disjointed at first. But when I put them all together, I... got this message.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我发现了这些记录。虽然一开始乱七八糟的，但我把它们拼起来以后，我……发现了一条信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I was curious if it made any sense to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想知道，你们能看懂吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那条信息是这样的："当日月汇聚，迷途者终将寻得归途。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What? What does it mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么？那条信息是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's the other half, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这句话是另一半，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But we can't be sure it was her, like you said, Minerva. The Indifference knows what she knows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米尼娃，就像你说的，我们没法确定那还是她。虚空无情之物清楚她知道的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I don't know why the Indifference would tell you that...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道虚空无情之物为什么要告诉你们这个……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Even if she's still being held hostage by the Indifference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哪怕是她现在还被虚空无情之物挟持着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Even if it's a trick by the Indifference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哪怕这是虚空无情之物的诡计？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She could be willingly working with the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也有可能，她是自愿和虚空无情之物合作的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Drinks? Drinks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 喝一杯去？喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Good call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好主意

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Doing anything special today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 今天有什么特别活动吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Happy Birthday!! You must be excited.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 生日快乐！！你一定很激动吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you and Velimir going to get to spend time together today for your birthday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你今天会和维利米尔一起过生日吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Any plans for your birthday today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 今天你的生日有什么计划吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Am I allowed to wish you a happy birthday? Or does that fall under classified information?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我可以祝你生日快乐吗？还是那属于机密信息？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So, is today *actually* your birthday? Or just a fake date like your fake username and other spy stuff?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，今天*真是*你的生日吗？还是假的日期，像你的假用户名和其他间谍信息一样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Doing anything fun today for your birthday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 今天有什么有趣的生日活动吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey Velimir! Happy Birthday, big guy! Hope you get to enjoy some of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，维利米尔！生日快乐，大块头！希望你可以好好享受一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey V. Hope you have a good one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，大维。希望你过个好生日。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hey Velimir. Better keep your coat on for your birthday today! Wanna know why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，维利米尔。最好在你的生日上也穿上大衣别着凉！你知道为什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because you're just so.... COOL!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为你很……cool！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What was the wildest birthday you ever had?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你过的最狂野的生日是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Happy Birthday Velimir!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 生日快乐，维利米尔！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What's happened to her? I need answers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她怎么了？我需要答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Real answers. And none of this "it's hard to explain" bullshit the other ones are giving me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 真正的答案。而不是其他人给我的那些"很难解释"的废话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hah. Yeah. Right. Like you weren't undercutting me in Yalchesko.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈。是啊。对。说的好像你在亚尔切斯科没有干扰我似的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: VELIMIR. What is the POINT of using this asset if YOU JUST -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔。用这个用户名又有什么意义，如果你只是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: DAMN IT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 该死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sol above, I'm going to scream...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 太阳神在上，我要疯了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not a word, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，一句话也别说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: This is anything but a game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这根本不是什么套路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Your cooperation has been noted, "Drifter."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "漂泊者"，你的配合行为已经被记录。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you going to answer my questions? Yes or no?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你打算回答我的问题吗？是或否？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If that is your real name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果那是你的真名的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Like dealing with - whatever. Whatever. It doesn't matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 感觉就像在应对——算了。算了。不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: A mistake. I will give you some time to think it over and reconsider.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你犯了个错误。我会给你点时间好好想想，重新考虑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: VELIMIR
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sigh...
Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: One simple question answered, and we will be on our way:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 只需回答一个简单的问题，我们就会离开：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What has happened to Major Neci Rusalka?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 内奇·鲁莎卡少校到底发生了什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "COMPLICATED."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "复杂。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You "DON'T KNOW."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你"不知道。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Drifter. You and I will continue this tomorrow. Velimir. You. Me. A word. Offline.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者。我们明天再继续。维利米尔。你。我。单独谈话。离线。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: NOW.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 马上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I don't need YOU undercutting me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不需要你来干扰我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because they've told everyone the same line of shit. "We don't know what's happened to her, or if that's really her anymore."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为他对每个人都说一样的废话。"我们不知道她发生了什么事，也不知道她是否是原来的她。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I. Am going to just ignore that. "Drifter," I am simply going to cut right to the chase. I have no patience left for anything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我，决定不再追究这个了。"漂泊者"，我直接说正题。我已经没有耐心再处理其他事情了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir, were you about to disclose highly classified information?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，你是不是要泄露高度机密信息？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I don't buy it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我才不信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Major Neci Rusalka. And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 内奇·鲁莎卡少校。我相信你掌握着她的信息。关键信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We are here looking for the truth about Major Neci Rusalka. And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们来这里是为了寻找有关内奇·鲁莎卡少校的真相。我相信你掌握着她的信息。关键信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We are here looking for the truth about Major Neci Rusalka. And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们来这里是为了寻找有关内奇·鲁莎卡少校的真相。我相信你掌握着她的信息。关键信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我相信你掌握着她的信息。关键信息。
