/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did you or did you not have anything to do with what's happened to her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 发生在她身上的事跟你有没有关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you saying you're not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你是说你没有责任吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you think I'm just going to sit around here with my thumb up my ass -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果你以为我只会在这无所事事——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So you want me to just accept the fact that she's *gone.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以你想让我接受她已经*不见了*这个事实吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That we came all the way here to find her and she's *GONE.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们大老远来到这里找她，她却*不见了*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That our little neci is
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们的小内奇她

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Have you reconsidered being cooperative, "Drifter?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "漂泊者"，你想通要配合了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, you sweet thing, you haven't seen anything yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，你这可爱的家伙，你还没见识过更厉害的呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Aw, begging already. Too bad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊，这就求饶了。太糟糕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The problem I have is that *you* have information *I* need.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很简单，*你*手里的信息正是*我*要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Fine. You made your point. But if you want me to break out the lipstick, you're going to need to work for it, pipsqueak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧。你已经清楚表达了你的观点。但是如果你想看我描眉画眼，那你得努力了，小不点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And you want to give me the same fake non-answers as the rest of the so-called "Hex."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你也想要像所谓的"六人组"其他那些人那样，给我虚假的含糊其辞的答案吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And you're refusing to play ball.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那么你这是拒绝配合了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir. Are you disclosing highly classified information?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔。你在泄露高度机密信息吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Mm. I know your type. Lua, not another one of you bleeding heart mercenaries...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯。我知道你这种人。月神啊，不会又是另一个悲天悯人的雇佣兵吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: On overseas, private sector servers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还在海外私营部门的服务器上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Blast in, save the world, toss the coat over your shoulder while you walk out, "you wouldn't understand my pain," lonely loner types.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 冲进去，拯救世界，离开时把外套披在肩上，说着"你不会懂我的痛苦"，就是那种孤独的独行侠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Under an unregistered asset username?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 用一个未注册的资产用户名？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can we please focus? We aren't here to make friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们能不能集中注意力？我们不是来交朋友的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: With your real civilian name?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还用你的真实姓名？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If I have to explain it, you wouldn't understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果我必须解释的话，你也不会懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这已经不是第一次了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What were you two discussing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你们两个在讨论什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Drifter. Can we talk?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者。我们可以谈谈吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I was lectured about my so-called bedside manner.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有人刚刚训了我，说我所谓的待人接物有问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Believe it or not, it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 信不信由你，这是我的真名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Which is hysterical, all things considered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 结合实际情况来看，真是笑死人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Right to the chase. Good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 直奔主题。很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But that's not the point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但那不是重点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We're here in Höllvania with a problem to solve. And you can help me solve that problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们来到霍瓦尼亚是为了解决一个问题。而你能帮我解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So I need you - and this is me asking - to help me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以我需要你——这也是我在请求你——来帮助我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That is a very good question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是个非常好的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You don't have to want to help me for my sake. We have a common enemy. This "Man in the Wall."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你不需要为了我而帮助我。我们有一个共同的敌人。就是这个"墙中人"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: As far as I can figure, we're both interested in where he's gone, what he's after, and why he targeted Rusalka in the first place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 据我所知，我们都想知道他的去向、他的目的，以及为什么他一开始就盯上了鲁莎卡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Am I correct in that assessment?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我的评估还算正确吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The why isn't important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 原因并不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you aren't at least mildly interested in her well-being, why spare her life like we know you did? We heard the story.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果你对她的安危一点都不关心，为什么还像我们所知的那样放过她一命？我们都听说过那件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And why is that? You have no way of tracking him? It? Whatever it is? Or do you not know what it's really after?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为什么会这样呢？你没办法追踪他吗？它？不管它是什么？还是说你不知道它的真正目的是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So you're suggesting we sit. And wait. For it to... what. Pop its head up? And we play a round of Whack-A-Weasel?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以你是建议我们就这样坐着等。等它……干嘛？冒出头来？然后我们玩一轮打地鼠游戏吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What good would it do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这样做有什么好处呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Shut it, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 闭嘴，维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What do we need "friends" for?! We'll be out of here as soon as we know where we need to be to save Neci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们为什么需要"朋友"呢？！反正我们一旦弄清楚去哪里可以救内奇，就会立刻离开这。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And, what, we just go on with not knowing what's really happened to her?! Or if she's okay?! Or if she's really her anymore?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然后呢，我们就这样继续过不知道她究竟发生了什么的日子？！不知道她是否安好？！她还是原来的她吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How can you sit there and be OKAY with that, Velimir?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，你怎么能一副若无其事的样子坐在那里？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I've talked to Eleanor. She told me what she felt when she touched Neci's mind. Or what was left of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我和埃莉诺谈过了。她告诉我当她接触到内奇的思维时感觉到了什么。或者说，她心灵剩下的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The woman we raised. The woman we loved as our own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那个我们共同抚养的女人。我们视如己出的女人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Who knows what -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谁知道会发生什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And you want to talk about drinking with Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而你却还想谈谈和亚瑟喝酒的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Du-te dracu, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: Du-te dracu，维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Mitis Green. Manufactured in 1814 to be a pigment in the most beautiful of emerald shades.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 密提斯绿。1814 年制造出的，是最美丽的翡翠绿色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Seeing as our dear Velimir already gave away all of the classified information. Sure. Why not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 鉴于我们亲爱的维利米尔已经泄露了所有机密信息。当然可以。为什么不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It is also extremely toxic, as it contains a high quantity of arsenic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 它还具有极大的毒性，因为它含有大量的砷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You heard the story of how we adopted her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你听过我们收养她的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir told you how Neci wanted to join this religious fanatic cult masquerading as a mercenary outfit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔跟你提过，内奇想要加入这个伪装成雇佣兵组织的宗教狂热团体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did you know that on its own, arsenic has no taste or smell? It disappears perfectly undetectable into water, medicine...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你知道砷本身是无味无臭的吗？它能完美无痕地融入水、药物中……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And how I said no. How he said yes. And off she went.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我反对，他同意。然后她就走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Pizza.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 甚至是批萨中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What he probably didn't tell you, is the fact that I had just come back from a year-long black ops intel operation investigating Scaldra.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他可能没告诉你的是，我刚从一次为期一年的黑色行动情报任务中回来，调查的正是炽蛇军。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Did you want to talk to me about something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你有事想跟我说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I didn't just have "a suspicion" about them, I had FACTS. Binders and stacks of floppy disks of FACTS.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我对他们不只是"有怀疑"，我手上有确凿的证据。文件夹加软盘一大堆的证据。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: They're bought and sold for by some of the biggest corporations in this world. Ones whose corruption and greed run deep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他们被世界上最大的几个公司买来卖去。这些公司贪婪腐败透顶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well. What do you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那。你想知道什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We're talking "remake the world into their oligarchic dystopia" where us peasants live to serve them and rake the fields and kiss their golden feet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们说的是"将世界重塑成他们的寡头反乌托邦"，在那里，我们这些农民活着只为伺候他们，给他们锄地，亲吻他们金脚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you can imagine a hell like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果你能想象那样的地狱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well. Velimir told you some of it. I might as well tell you the rest from my side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯。维利米尔已经跟你说过一些了。我也来从我的角度说说剩下的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Anything else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有其他问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Especially as it has to do with Neci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 特别是和内奇有关的那部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Anything else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有其他问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Anything else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有其他问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Couldn't. Classified. And I mean *classified.* They'd want names. Dates. Photographs. Hard proof. Just telling them this was going on, wouldn't be good enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不能说。这是机密。我是说真正的*机密*。他们会想要名字。日期。照片。确凿的证据。光说这事正在发生是不够的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And worse yet? If I told them who in each government structure was being bought and sold? They'd want to go put a stop to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 更糟的是？如果我告诉他们每个政府机构中哪些人被收买？他们会想去阻止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: They'd want to *fix* it. To go be the hero.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他们会想去"纠正"它。成为英雄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: There is when it gets you killed. And look what happened to Neci. She's dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果这会害死你，那就不对了。看看内奇的下场吧。她死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's not that I didn't trust them. *They* didn't trust *me.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 并不是我不信任他们。而是*他们*不信任*我*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you sensing a pattern?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你察觉到其中的规律了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: When you have a relationship with someone who works in... this kind of industry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 当你和从事……这种行业的人建立关系时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know what she's not. She's not here. She's not safe. She's not herself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道她确实不什么。她确实不在这里。她确实不安全。她确实不再是她自己了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You need to trust the other person with more than your life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你需要托付给对方的不只是你的生命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Look, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 看，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You need to know that when they say "do this, and don't ask why, and don't ask details, just know everything depends on it, and I can't tell you anything more than that"?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你必须明白，当他们说"照做，不要问为什么，不要问细节，只知道一切都取决于此，我不能告诉你更多"时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm getting that sense, too. You poor thing. lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我也有同感。你真可怜，哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: They mean it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他们是认真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'll... throw you a bone. Tell you why he and I broke it off. From *my* side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我来……透露点内幕给你吧。说说我和他分手的原因。从*我的*角度来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The fact of the matter is, when I told Velimir and Neci - Not Scaldra. Not them. Anyone but them. Because of who is paying for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 事实是，当我告诉维利米尔和内奇时——不要选炽蛇军。千万别他们。除了他们以外谁都可以。因为知道背后是谁在出钱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I understood why Neci said that wasn't good enough. It wouldn't have been good enough for me at her age, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我理解为什么内奇说这还不够好。要是我在她那个年纪，也会觉得这不够好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But Velimir? That...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但维利米尔？那……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It was a stab in the back. One... that I couldn't forgive lightly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那简直是背后捅刀。我无法轻易原谅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And now knowing what it cost our little girl...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而现在，我已经知道我们的小女孩付出了什么代价……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I can't tell if it'd be worse if she were just dead. But her mind? Her soul? Or... worse?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道，她要是死了是不是反而好些。但要是她的思想？她的灵魂？或者……更糟的情况？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I didn't come here for hope.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我来这里不是为了寻找希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Good. And... that means I owe you an apology for how I've been treating you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很好。而且……这也意味着我需要为之前的态度向你道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But I do want to tell you I shouldn't have shot my mouth off at you from the start. We need to work together if we're going to find this Indifference and my Neci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但我确实想告诉你，一开始我不该对你说那些重话。如果我们要找到那个虚空无情之物和我的内奇，我们需要合作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You've got a soldier's head on your shoulders. And I shouldn't have dismissed that outright.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你有军人的头脑。我不该一开始就忽视这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Will do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Heh. Will do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呵。好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to go find that useless melted snowman before he's too drunk to drag back to his bunk or he starts shouting at the TVs again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那，不好意思，我现在得去找那个快化掉的没用雪人，得在他喝得烂醉如泥或开始骂电视前把他拖回去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What I wouldn't kill for some wine for this conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我愿意做任何事去换杯酒来配这场对话了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Please. Do continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can you be more specific? That's a broad question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你能具体点吗？这问题太宽泛了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I would challenge your assignment of the word zealot, though I understand from your point of view, and given your interaction with her, that is all you have to go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不太同意你用狂热分子这个词，尽管我理解从你的角度和你与她的互动来看，你只能这么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I raised her to live up to her full potential. What are you implying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我抚养她是为了让她充分发挥自己的潜力。你这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I believe that to Neci, at the time she joined Scaldra, it was a means to an end. She believed in the people around her, less than she had a firm adherence to the faith. Not like Vodyanoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我认为对于内奇来说，当时加入炽蛇军只是一种达到目的的手段。她信任她周围的人，而不是坚定地遵循某种信仰。不像维德诺伊那样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Ahem. Says the man who gave her a smoking problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 咳咳。这话说的，是谁让她染上了烟瘾的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She was always a woman of ambition. Ambition that I encouraged, fostered, and fed the fires of. Unlike *someone* who wished to freeze it over and keep her in some state of arrested childhood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她一直都是个有野心的女人。这种野心是我一直鼓励、培养并助长的。不像*某个人*希望冻结她的成长，让她永远停留在孩童状态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Very funny. You're so terribly clever. Allow me to applaud your overwhelming wit. At least I didn't give her a damn smoking problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 真好笑。你真是太聪明了。请让我为你的聪明才智鼓掌。至少我没有让她染上那该死的烟瘾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, yes. The *one* time you let her express herself without your insufferable handwringing  is the *one* time you choose not to listen to me, trust me, and let her go off and look what happened!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，是的。你*唯一*一次让她表达自己，没有你那让人受不了的焦虑的干扰，也是*唯一*一次你选择不听我的话，不信任我，让她自己去，结果看看发生了什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What Velimir is making crass jokes at - quite poorly - is that sometimes, as a woman, you have limited options as to how to approach a situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔所开的低俗玩笑——而且相当拙劣——的玩笑，是说有时候，作为一名女性，你在处理某种情况时的选择是有限的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She has ambition. You always held that against her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她有野心。而你总是因此责备她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And, if you were lucky enough to be born with certain... "assets" at your disposal, that can sometimes come in handy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而且，如果你足够幸运，生来就拥有一对"胸器"，这有时能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "Assets."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "胸器。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Maybe someday those words will bring back the dead. Until then? They're as useless to me as you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也许有一天这些话能让死者复活。在那之前？这些话对我来说和你一样没用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, yes. The *one* time you let her express herself without your insufferable handwringing  is the *one* time you choose not to listen to me, trust me, and let her go off and look what happened!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，是的。你*唯一*一次让她表达自己，没有你那让人受不了的焦虑的干扰，也是*唯一*一次你选择不听我的话，不信任我，让她自己去，结果看看发生了什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I did. Because she had every right to. And who knows how many times it saved her life. She was smart enough to know it didn't define her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我确实教了。因为她完全有权利这么做。而且谁知道这救了她多少次命。她很聪明，知道这并不定义她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What he's attempting to explain - poorly - is that sometimes, as a woman, you have limited options as to how to approach a situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他试图解释的是——虽然相当拙劣——是说有时候，作为一名女性，你在处理某种情况时的选择是有限的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Viciousness is like a knife. One must keep it polished. Clean. Sharp. Or it'll rust away, and the moment you need it, it'll be gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 恶毒就像一把刀。必须保持它光滑。干净。锋利。否则它会生锈，当你需要它时，它就派不上用场了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And, if you were lucky enough to be born with certain... "assets" at your disposal, that can sometimes come in handy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而且，如果你足够幸运，生来就拥有一对"胸器"，这有时能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Maybe someday those words will bring back the dead. Until then? They're as useless to me as you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也许有一天这些话能让死者复活。在那之前？这些话对我来说和你一样没用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You want to know what Neci was like before you met her? All right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你想知道你遇见内奇之前她是什么样的人？好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If I had a more deserving whetstone, I'd use it. As it stands, however?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果我有更合适的磨刀石，我当然会用。但就目前情况来看？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hah. Well. I'm not shocked. She was the best at what she did. I daresay she even eclipsed me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈。好吧。我并不惊讶。她是她领域中最出色的。我敢说她甚至比我还要出色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I did. Because she had every right to. And who knows how many times it saved her life. She was smart enough to know it didn't define her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我确实教了。因为她完全有权利这么做。而且谁知道这救了她多少次命。她很聪明，知道这并不定义她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Viciousness is like a knife. One must keep it polished. Clean. Sharp. Or it'll rust away, and the moment you need it, it'll be gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 恶毒就像一把刀。必须保持它光滑。干净。锋利。否则它会生锈，当你需要它时，它就派不上用场了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She was the absolute best in her career. The pinnacle of what it meant to be a spy, a soldier, a leader, and a woman in power.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她是她职业领域中绝对的佼佼者。她是间谍、士兵、领导者和掌权女性的典范。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I'd never been prouder than the day I realized she surpassed my gifts even at the height of my youth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 当我意识到她的天赋已经超越了年轻巅峰时期的我，我感到无比自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She earned the respect of her troops because she knew what leadership meant. Not barking orders from the back. But showing the people that you'd fight for them. With them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她赢得了部队的尊重，因为她知道领导意味着什么。不是在后面发号施令，而是向人们展示你愿意为他们而战。与他们并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Shiny objects. Like a lure flashing in the water, attracting all the nearest big, dumb fish. Prey for the taking. That's my little girl.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 闪亮的东西。就像水中闪烁的诱饵，吸引着所有近在咫尺的大笨鱼。触手可及的猎物。果然是我的好姑娘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If I had a more deserving whetstone, I'd use it. As it stands, however?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果我有更合适的磨刀石，我当然会用。但就目前情况来看？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She also knew sometimes the best way out of a situation was without a single bullet fired. She once defused an entire armed conflict between two warlord bands just southeast of here -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她也知道，有时候最好的解决办法是不用开枪的。她曾经用一句话就化解了东南边两个军阀团伙之间的武装冲突——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She purposefully told the second warlord that the first had taught her a phrase in his native tongue. She said it meant "I am honored to meet you." What she actually said was "You are a big stinking idiot."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她故意告诉第二个军阀，第一个军阀曾教过她一句他的母语。说这意味着"我很荣幸见到你"。她实际说的却是"你是个又蠢又臭的大傻瓜。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I feel it would have panned out all right, for one notable exception.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我觉得一切本来都会好的，除了一个明显的例外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Shiny objects. Like a lure flashing in the water, attracting all the nearest big, dumb fish. Prey for the taking. That's my little girl.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 闪亮的东西。就像水中闪烁的诱饵，吸引着所有近在咫尺的大笨鱼。触手可及的猎物。果然是我的好姑娘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: This of course turned into a shouting match between the two warlords, until they realized, during the course of their shouting match, that she had never spoken to the first warlord. She said it to them on purpose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这自然引发了两位军阀之间的一场争吵，直到他们在争吵过程中意识到，她从来没有和第一个军阀说过话。她是故意这么说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're making assumptions again, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，你又在做假设了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Smiling, my Neci gestured for them to sit at the table, and in their language, flawlessly, told them that they had more in common together than they did the rest of the world apart. That they were brothers. And sometimes, brothers fought. But brothers should never kill each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我的内奇微笑着示意他们坐到桌子旁，并用他们的语言流利地告诉他们，他们之间的共同点比其他人都多。他们是兄弟。兄弟有时会发生争执。但兄弟之间不应该互相残杀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why? This is more fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为什么？这样更有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: They settled the territory dispute within an hour. Those two men left as friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他们在一小时内解决了领土争端。那两个人离开时成了朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're making assumptions again, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，你又在做假设了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So. I don't know what you met. But that's my Neci. The one I raised. To be smarter than the world will ever credit her for - and to know exactly how to use that against them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以。我不知道你遇到了怎么样的她。但那是我的内奇。我养大的那个。她比任何人都要聪明——而且她知道怎样利用这一点来对付他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Best to keep whatever childish designs you have on our daughter to yourself in the future, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者，无论你对我们女儿有什么幼稚的想法，以后最好都只说给自己听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sigh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 唉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's hard to know how the winds of war would have taken you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很难知道战争的风向会把你带向何方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Best to keep whatever childish designs you have on our daughter to yourself in the future, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者，无论你对我们女儿有什么幼稚的想法，以后最好都只说给自己听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Excuse me?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你说什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Wise words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 精辟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hear, hear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没错，说得好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She - oh, Neci... oh, our little girl... no wonder she was so *angry* on the phone -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她——哦，内奇……哦，我们的小女孩……难怪她在电话里那么*生气*——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I doubt even Drifter can speak to the dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我甚至怀疑漂泊者能不能与死者对话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you're going to just sit there and divulge sensitive information *again,* Velimir, at least don't say where, please?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，如果你想坐在那里*再次*泄露敏感信息的话，至少别说出在哪里，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Seeing as the conference was about not doing this exact thing, and you'd be giving up the whereabouts of those in attendance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 由于那次的会议就是为了不要做这种事，而你会说出那些参会人员的行踪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Every industry has a conference... for better or worse. And they are all as equally boring no matter the line of work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 每个行业都有会议……无论好坏。而且不管什么行业，这些会议都一样无聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well, since Velimir's already broken protocol, might as well ruin the rest of it. "The International Cross-Cultural Leadership & Consulting Association."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，既然维利米尔已经破坏了协议，那就把剩下的都毁了吧。"国际跨文化领导与咨询协会。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well, since Velimir's already broken protocol, might as well ruin the rest of it. "The International Cross-Cultural Leadership & Consulting Association."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，既然维利米尔已经破坏了协议，那就把剩下的都毁了吧。"国际跨文化领导与咨询协会。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: A lady has to judge the quality of her suitor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 一个美女总要判断她追求者的品质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I was not. Your pickup lines were *terrible,* Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我没有。是你的搭讪台词 *太烂 *了，维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "I must have frostbite, because when I look at you, I feel tingly all over."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "我肯定是冻伤了，因为我看着你的时候，感觉浑身发麻。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Maybe. But Velimir has no excuse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也许吧。但维利米尔没什么借口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "You and I would make the perfect ice sculpture—cool and breathtaking."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "你和我能变成一对完美的冰雕——冷酷又让人窒息。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "You must be a ski slope baby, because I want to go down on you."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "你肯定是个滑雪坡，宝宝，因为我想滑到你身上。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No. No, they did not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没。都没用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Weirdly, that one was so terrible it made me laugh. Though I do think I actually did make that face, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 奇怪的是，那句烂到我都笑了。不过，我觉得我确实做了那样的表情，是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Weirdly, that one was so terrible it made me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 奇怪的是，那句烂到我都笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: His drinks, however, are much better than his pickup lines.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然而，他的调的酒比他的搭讪情话强多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And once he stopped panicking like a prepubescent school child at junior prom, he was actually vaguely charming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 一旦他不像青春期前的学生在初中毕业舞会上那样惊慌失措，他其实还是有点迷人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No. No, it did not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没。没用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I said vaguely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我说"有点"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I have a good instinct for things like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我在这方面有很强的直觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I hope you realize what you've done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我希望你能意识到自己做了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Techrot, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是科腐症状，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Mmhm. Best to just get a beer and watch the chaos unfold.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯哼。最好还是拿瓶啤酒看热闹吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Best to just get a beer and watch the chaos unfold.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 最好还是拿瓶啤酒看热闹吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But Entrati treated us better than many of the other "protoframes" we've met so far, I will give him that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但英择谛对我们比对迄今为止见过的许多其他原型战甲都要好，这一点我承认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He told us, quite bluntly, what it would do to us. Offered us the choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他很坦率地告诉我们，这对我们会有什么影响。给了我们一个选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No, he very conveniently left that part out. And by the time we recovered from our... treatment... you had arrived to Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没有，他非常巧妙地略过了那一部分。当我们从我们的……治疗……中恢复过来时，你已经到了霍瓦尼亚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And you know how things went from there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然后事情怎么发展的你都知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Always the best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 永远是最好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Glad to hear that. Starting to feel like this is where we're supposed to be, even if... it wasn't for Neci, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很高兴听你这么说。我开始觉得我们本就该在这里，即使……就算不是为了内奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But we'll see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不过，我们拭目以待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's enough, Velimir. Let's get you to bed to sleep this off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 够了，维利米尔。我扶你上床睡一觉吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Vel, I'm coming to get you. You should stop typing, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维尔，我来接你了。你现在就别打字了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I have a good instinct for things like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我在这方面有很强的直觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Techrot, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是科腐症状，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But Entrati treated us better than many of the other "protoframes" we've met so far, I will give him that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但英择谛对我们比对迄今为止见过的许多其他原型战甲都要好，这一点我承认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He told us, quite bluntly, what it would do to us. Offered us the choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他很坦率地告诉我们，这对我们会有什么影响。给了我们选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No, he very conveniently left that part out. And by the time we recovered from our... treatment... you had arrived to Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没错，他非常巧妙地略过了那部分。当我们从我们的……治疗……中恢复过来时，你已经到霍瓦尼亚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And you know how things went from there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然后事情怎么发展的你都知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Always the best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 眼见总是为实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Glad to hear that. Starting to feel like this is where we're supposed to be, even if... it wasn't for Neci, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很高兴听你这么说。我开始觉得我们本就该在这里，即使……就算不是为了内奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But we'll see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不过，我们拭目以待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, it happened. The entire first act of Soonerland.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，确实有过。唱的是《苏纳兰》的整个第一幕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not for those of us within earshot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 对我们这些听众可不太友好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's enough, Velimir. Let's get you to bed to sleep this off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 够了，维利米尔。上床睡一觉吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It was... something, that's for sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那确实……算点东西，这是肯定的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sigh. That was a long time ago, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 唉。维利米尔，那是很久以前的事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That was uncalled for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你至于吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Vel. Look, I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维尔。瞧，我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Vel, I'm coming to get you. You should stop typing, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维尔，我来接你了。你现在就别打字了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He isn't "over" our marriage. Over... me, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他还没有"放下"我们婚姻。也没有放下……我，我觉得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm sorry you keep having to be a witness to this. It isn't fair to dump all of it on your doorstep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很抱歉你要一直目睹这一切。把这一切都推到你眼前是不公平的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Do you want to know Sol's honest truth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你想知道这事的本质吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Doesn't make it right. You didn't ask for this. You certainly have your own nonsense to deal with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这不表示这是对的。这又不是你自找的。你肯定还有自己的琐碎事要处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I honestly don't know. I don't think so. The issue is... well?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说实话我不知道。我不这么认为。问题是……怎么说呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir is in love with the idea of love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔爱的是爱情这个概念。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir and I are meant to be grown-ass adults. We are supposed to be capable of dealing with our own issues.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔和我都是成年人了。我们应该有能力处理自己的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Do you want Sol's honest truth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你想知道这事的本质吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So, for unintentionally adding to the pile of your daily stressors, I apologize, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，漂泊者，对于无形中给你增加了日常压力，我深表歉意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He isn't "over" our marriage. Over... me, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他还没有"放下"我们婚姻。也没有放下……我，我觉得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But here's the part of himself he won't accept.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而这就是他不愿意接受的那部分自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And he never has been.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他爱的从来就不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: About yesterday, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者，昨天的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: About yesterday, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者，昨天的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Your cue to "eff" off.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你该"滚蛋"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No. I feel like it needs to be said:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不，我觉得有必要说一下：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I feel like this needs to be said:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我觉得有必要说一下：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You are not responsible for fixing everyone's problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你无需解决每个人的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you choose to carry that burden, it is... honorable. Noble. The mark of a leader. But it shouldn't be *expected* of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果你选择承起这个重担，这是……光荣的、高尚的。这是领导者的标志。但没有人应该*期望*你这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, it happened. The entire first act of Soonerland.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，确实有过。唱的是《苏纳兰》的整个第一幕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I shouldn't have written that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不该这么写的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know how exhausting it can be, trust me. To shoulder that weight and responsibility.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 相信我，我知道要肩负起这样的重担和责任有多累。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What I'm saying here, in short, is this -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 简而言之，我现在想说的是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not for those of us within earshot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 对我们这些听众可不太友好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The simple fact of the matter is, Velimir and I are adults.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 事实很简单，维利米尔和我都是成年人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No. The truth has nothing to do with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不，但这无关紧要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Don't feel obligated to "fix" whatever you feel is broken between Velimir and I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不要觉得你有义务"修复"维利米尔和我之间的任何裂痕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And you shouldn't be required, or expected, to fix everyone's problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而且不应该要求或期望你去解决每个人的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Some things are not your responsibility in this world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 在这个世界上，有些事情并不由你负责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Especially not for a pair of sad, old assholes like us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 特别是对我们这对可悲的老混蛋来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What? You want to make this poor person, who has plenty of their OWN problems to deal with, to play our therapist?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么？你想让这个本身就有很多问题要解决的可怜人扮演我们的治疗师？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It was... something, that's for sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那确实……算是有点东西，这是肯定的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Therapy sessions with a time-traveling victim of a catastrophe in space are the key to defeating a murderous, soul-sucking god of the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 接受一位穿越时空的太空灾难受害者的治疗，是战胜凶残、吸食灵魂的虚空之神的关键？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: What about it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I have been putting up with "his best" for years, dear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 亲爱的，我这么多年一直在忍受"他的尽力"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sigh. That was a long time ago, Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 唉。维利米尔，那是很久以前的事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It starts as charming. Funny. Why would anyone ever get frustrated with someone like that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 一开始很迷人。真有意思。为什么会有人对这样的人感到烦恼呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Then what is it? What were you going to say, Velimir? Let me guess. If it wasn't about asking for help, it was going to be a stupid joke at my expense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那你想说什么？维利米尔，你到底想说什么？让我猜猜。如果不是关于求助，那就是拿我开涮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're starting to make me wish I was back in Uyrtichesko.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你让我有点想回到乌尔切斯科了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I believe that he believes he loves me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我觉得他认为他是爱我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir is a serial optimist. He lies to himself about the state of the world around him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔是一个恒定的乐观主义者。他总是对周围世界的状况自欺欺人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because it never takes accountability.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为这样永远不用承担责任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That was uncalled for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你至于吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Vel. Look, I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维尔。瞧，我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm going to go for a walk. Need to clear my head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我要出去走走。需要理清一下头脑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Always trying to see the best in people, all the time, everywhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 无论何时何地，他总想看到人们最好的一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Never takes responsibility. Never faces conflict.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 从不承担责任。从不面对冲突。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Go on. Say it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 来吧。说呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He's a serial optimist. He lies to himself about the state of the world around him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他是一个恒定的乐观主义者。他总是对周围世界的状况自欺欺人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But that requires blinding himself to everything else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但这导致他对其他一切都视而不见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sometimes you don't need a laugh. Or a smile. You need someone willing to FACE the problem and help you FIX IT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有时候，你并不需要欢声笑语。或一个微笑。你需要的是一个愿意面对问题并帮你解决问题的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sorry. When you're trained to be secretive, it's a hard reflex to give up sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 抱歉。当你被训练得说话谨慎小心，有时候就很难改掉这个习惯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Otherwise his worldview would shatter. And he would have to face the fact that maybe, just maybe...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 否则他的世界观就会崩塌。然后他必然会面对这样一个事实：也许，只是也许……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Someone willing to help you CARRY IT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 一个愿意帮你分担的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为什么不？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: All the people in his life he believed were the amazing, unflinching, unstoppable moral forces he thought they were?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那些他一生认为是令人惊叹、坚定不移、勇往直前的道德楷模？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know you likely think I'm a bitch. But you're missing out on the decades of "his best" that I've had to clean up after.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道你可能觉得我挺贱的。但你没看到几十年来我不得不为"他的尽力"而善后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Go on. Won't be the first or last time you've made light of the situation at my expense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说吧。这不是你第一次，也不是最后一次用开我的玩笑来避重就轻了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Aren't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 并不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And the exhaustion that comes with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有这导致的疲劳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Fine. I'll say it for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好啊。那我替你说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He isn't "over" our marriage. Over... me, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他还没有"放下"我们婚姻。也没有放下……我，我觉得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm sorry you keep having to be a witness to this. It isn't fair to dump all of it on your doorstep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很抱歉你要一直目睹这一切。把这一切都推到你眼前是不公平的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "Why not talk this through with our new friend? I'm pretty sure the corner shrink got blown up last week, so it's not like we have any other option!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "为什么不和我们的新朋友聊聊这件事呢？我很清楚街角的心理医生上周被炸死了，所以我们别无选择！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Picture in your head what you think of when you think of a "good wife."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 想象一下你心目中的"好妻子"是什么样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Was that it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是你想说的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Do you want to know Sol's honest truth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你想知道这事的本质吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Doesn't make it right. You didn't ask for this. You certainly have your own nonsense to deal with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这不表示这是对的。这又不是你自找的。你当然还有自己的琐碎事要处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I honestly don't know. I don't think so. The issue is... well?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说实话我不知道。我不这么认为。问题是……怎么说呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not even talking a traditional, barefoot in the kitchen, pregnant wife.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我说的不是一个传统的，光脚在厨房，怀孕的妻子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是不是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir is in love with the idea of love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔爱的是爱情这个概念。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir and I are meant to be grown-ass adults. We are supposed to be capable of dealing with our own issues.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔和我都是成年人了。我们应该有能力处理自己的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Do you want Sol's honest truth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你想知道这事的本质吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm talking about what you'd consider what makes a "good" partner out of someone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我说的是你认为怎样的人才能成为"好"伴侣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: WELL?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的吧？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: So, for unintentionally adding to the pile of your daily stressors, I apologize, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，漂泊者，对于无形中给你增加了日常压力，我深表歉意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He isn't "over" our marriage. Over... me, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他还没有"放下"我们婚姻。也没有放下……我，我觉得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 现在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Screw this. I need some air. *Children.* The lot of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 去他妈的。我要透透气了。你们两都是*低龄儿*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And he never has been.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他爱的从来就不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But here's the part of himself he won't accept.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而这就是他不愿意接受的那部分自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You've met me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你见到我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Sigh.
What do YOU think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你怎么想呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I shouldn't have written that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不该这么写的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Can't say I blame you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我并不责怪你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How would you propose we do that, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那你建议我们怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're lying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Play a drunken round of "Would You Rather?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 醉醺醺地玩一轮"二选一游戏"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: WHAT THE F--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他妈的搞什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Or maybe you would like us to play "20 Questions?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 或者你想让我们玩"20 个问题"游戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: WHAT THE ACTUAL F--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这他妈到底要干嘛

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If we knew how to "get to the bottom of it," dear, I feel like we would be doing *just that.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 亲爱的，如果我们知道怎样"弄明白"，我想我们早就会*那么做*了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I suppose I shouldn't be surprised. I shouldn't be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我应该早料到的。早就该料到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I already read it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我已经读过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I figured one of you would be the adult. But here I am. Once more. The only one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我还以为你们中间会有一个成熟点的。结果还得是我来当大人。又一次。唯一一个大人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: This has NOTHING to do with how it went last time, and you KNOW it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这与上次的情况毫无关系，而且你心知肚明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh for f--
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，妈的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You don't? What kind of spy are you? Never mind...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你不读？你还算是间谍？算了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: THIS. This is precisely the problem! You can NEVER take ownership of your own issues!!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 就是这。这就是问题所在！你永远无法处理自己的问题！！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: OH YES well what did you THINK was going to happen?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是啊，你以为会发生什么呢？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Now you're just getting paranoid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 现在你又开始多疑偏执了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Stand up for ONCE and take something A LITTLE SERIOUSLY, will you?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你能不能就这么一次负点责任，认真面对事情吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Well whose fault is that, VELIMIR?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，就问你这是谁的错？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: YES. PARANOID.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。多疑偏执。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, yes. Take his side. Everyone *always* takes his side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦行。都站在他那边。所有人*永远*向着他说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yes. Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 行。好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The big, lovable idiot who can do no wrong, plagued by the vicious, overbearing hag of a wife.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他是个可爱的大傻瓜，不会做错任何事，唯独被恶毒霸道的老巫婆妻子所折磨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: MAYBE I WOULD IF I COULD TRUST IT'D GET DONE RIGHT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果我确信别人能做好，也许我会的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No one sees behind the curtain and all the work I have to do to hold his shit together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没人看到我们关起门后的生活，也没人看到我为他做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I wonder. The time traveler from space who has no idea what our culture is like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你告诉我。是不知道我们的文化是什么样，来自太空的时间旅行者吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: To keep everything from falling apart. To clean up after *his* messes, day after day after day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为了不让一切分崩离析。日复一日地收拾*他的*烂摊子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Despite what I've said, I... am sorry to make you feel like you're a burden. You're not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 尽管我是这么说，但我……很抱歉让你觉得你是个累赘。你不是累赘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Or the SPY. Whose JOB it was to navigate situations like this?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还是你这个间谍。间谍不就是负责处理这种情况的吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's "Ms." to you, now. Remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你现在应该叫"女士"。忘了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Maybe, BECAUSE I CAN.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 或许吧，因为我能做的更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I *do.* But that doesn't mean you're a burden. It means I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我*确实*这么想。但这并不意味着你是个累赘。这意味着我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No... It isn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不……我不想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It means I needed your help, Velimir. And that isn't easy for someone like me to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，这意味着我需要你的帮助。这对我这样的人来说可不容易说出口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: See?! It's like dealing with a child!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 看到没？！就像和孩子打交道一样！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And... I suppose I haven't, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想……我也没忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If you believe that was me "attacking him" then you have not been paying enough attention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果你认为我是在"攻击他"，那你就还没有足够用心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I'm tired of this nonsense. Thank you for... whatever this has been, but I have better things to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我厌倦了这些废话。无论如何……谢谢你，但我有更好的事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: As in, anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 比如说，任何事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I'm sick of living in a constant standup routine. Thank you for... whatever this has been, but I have better things to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而我厌倦了一直生活在单口相声中。无论如何……谢谢你，但我有更好的事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: As in, anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 比如说，任何事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yeah. Heh. It has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。呵。确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yes, dipshit, that's what they mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，混蛋，他就是这个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not the first time we've made it work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们又不是第一次苦中作乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Six weeks stranded on a deserted island with you with nothing but the burned out remains of our puddlejumper and whatever we could catch? How could I forget?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 和你一起在荒岛上困了六个星期，除了我们被烧毁的小飞机和能捡到的东西啥也不剩？我怎么会忘记？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Nearly dying of starvation and thirst before we were rescued by a random scuba expedition?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 在我们被一个偶然的潜水探险队救起之前，差点就饿死渴死了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I am *perfectly* cheerful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我是个*非常*快乐的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I cut him *plenty* of slack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我给了他*很多*宽容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Never had a better tan in my *life.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我*这辈子*，从来没美黑得这么彻底过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I - yes. Fine. Okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我——好吧。好的。没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You know what? Screw it. It's a date. For old time's sake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你知道吗？去他的。这就是约会。看在过去的份上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's obvious, anyway. You can read the chat logs. I have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 反正很明显。你可以读聊天记录。我已经读过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You don't? What kind of spy are you? Never mind...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你不读？你还算是间谍？算了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, yes. Take his side. Everyone *always* takes his side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦行。都站在他那边。所有人*永远*向着他说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yes. Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 行。好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The big, lovable idiot who can do no wrong, plagued by the vicious, overbearing hag of a wife.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他是个可爱的大傻瓜，不会做错任何事，唯独被恶毒霸道的老巫婆妻子所折磨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No one sees behind the curtain and all the work I have to do to hold his shit together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没人看到我们关起门后的生活，也没人看到我为他做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: To keep everything from falling apart. To clean up after *his* messes, day after day after day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为了不让一切分崩离析。日复一日地收拾*他的*烂摊子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No... It isn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不……我不想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And... I suppose I haven't, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想……我也没忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: How can I not? I let it all go to shit. It was my job to hold us together, and here we are. Neci is gone. We're in tatters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我怎么不是呢？我把一切都搞砸了。我的职责是把我们团结在一起，而现在我们却在这里。内奇没了。我们也支离破碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It was my job to take care of everything. But it was too much, and I *failed.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我的职责就是照顾好一切。但事情太多了，我*失败了*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We made this mess, dear. It's our job to decide whether or not we want to clean it up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 亲爱的，这烂摊子是我们造成的。我们的职责就是决定要不要收拾残局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I appreciate your valiant and stalwart efforts, Drifter, but you can feel free to stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者，我感谢你英勇顽强的努力，但你可以随时停止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I have to admit... despite the fact that I... was resistant to it at first?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不得不承认……尽管我……一开始很抗拒？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That it went very well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但进展非常顺利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And what, precisely, gave you that impression?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 究竟是什么给了你这样的印象？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's clear Velimir isn't over the whole affair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很显然，维利米尔还没放下整件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ... Sigh.
Aah, the sweet naïvety of youth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊，年轻时真是甜蜜又单纯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I... had been holding myself to impossible standards. Standards no one was clinging to but me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我……一直用不可能达到的标准要求自己。除了我自己，没人坚持的标准。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And in my focus of ensuring that the nuts and bolts of the relationship were attended to -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 在我专注于确保这个关系的具体细节都得到妥善处理时——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: All in the name of masking my own fears of inadequacy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这一切都是为了掩饰我对自己不足的恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We'd still be stuck in that place, if it weren't for that stupid story of being stuck on that deserted island.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果不是因为那个被困荒岛的愚蠢故事，我们现在还会停留在那个处境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir already told you. Alcohol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔已经告诉过你了。是酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I missed all the smoke signals that Velimir was sending me, buried within his humor and jokes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我却错过了维利米尔传递给我的所有信号弹，这些信号就藏在他的幽默和玩笑中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Those damn chickens! I'll never forget them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那些该死的鸡！我永远忘不了它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Are you quoting one of Amir's games?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你是在模仿阿米尔的某个游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I knew I shouldn't have left you in the mall unattended. Heh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我就知道不该把你一个人留在商场里。呵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The most romantic few weeks of my life, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想，那是我这辈子最浪漫的几周。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Just tell a damn story, you absolute ham.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你就讲个破故事吧，你个大笨蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's hard to describe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这很难描述。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But just the two of us? On the island, relying on each other to survive?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但当时不是只有我们俩个人在荒岛上相依为命吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I remember watching him spear fish and thinking to myself... that. That right there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我记得看着他用鱼叉钓鱼，心里想……那个人。就是那个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's the man I'm going to marry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那就是我要嫁的男人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: If I don't have to kill him and eat him to survive, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 当然了，前提是如果我不需要为了生存把他杀了然后吃掉他的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: He starts screaming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他开始尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh, hon... be reasonable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，亲爱的……理智点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hah! I suppose I am. Yes, that's a good thought. Very quick thinking of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈！我想我是的。是啊，这想法不错。你脑子转得好快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Which is the least of my concerns while I'm flying a burning plane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是我在驾驶燃烧的飞机时最不关心的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You know, now that I'm thinking about it, that would be a very prudent move.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你知道，现在我想一想，这将是一个非常谨慎的举动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The burning wreckage of our plane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们飞机燃烧的残骸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I should also work on my cold tolerance. Höllavnia is known for its...harsh climates.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我还应该锻炼自己的耐寒能力。霍瓦尼亚以……恶劣的气候闻名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It was the most romantic time of our lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那是我们一生中最浪漫的时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Ooh Drifter, come on now... lighten up. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，漂泊者，别这样……放松点。 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I think the best tan I've ever had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有我美黑得最好的一次了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Velimir. What do you say we take this chat offline?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 维利米尔，我们线下继续聊怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I can't help but wonder what Neci would think if she knew we were stuck here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我忍不住在想，如果内奇知道我们被困在这里会怎么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I can't help but wonder what Neci would think if she knew we were stuck here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我忍不住在想，如果内奇知道我们被困在这里会怎么想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Wouldn't blame her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不会怪她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She was perceptive. More than most. More than we'd trained her to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她很敏锐。比大多数人都敏锐。比我们把她训练得更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'd bet good money she knew. She could hear it. Even if we didn't know it at the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我敢打赌她肯定知道。她能听出来。即使我们当时还没意识到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It started off business. How she was handling command. She couldn't give us numbers, or details, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 从公事开始聊。聊她如何指挥。当然，她不能告诉我们数字或细节。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But all good hostage takers know how to make their captive birds sing on command.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但是所有厉害的绑架犯都知道如何让囚鸟按照命令唱歌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We weren't Scaldra. Nothing more than civvies, to the people on the other end of the line. So she couldn't be giving us classified intel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们又不是炽蛇军。对电话另一端的人来说，我们只不过是平民而已。所以她不可能给我们提供机密情报。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That doesn't mean anything about when, or how, this "Indifference" took her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这并不能说明这个"虚空无情之物"什么时候或如何，绑架了她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Or who was driving her body when we spoke to her that day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 或者那天我们和她通话时是谁在控制她的身体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Heh. Happens to the best of us. Especially when you're chasing a "fugitive."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呵。谁都会有这种情况，哪怕是最优秀的人。尤其是当你在追捕"逃犯"的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: A "fugitive."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 一个"逃犯"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Entrati. At the time, I figured it was "just" a local drug lord or resistance leader.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是英择谛。当时，我以为他"只是"当地的一个毒枭或反抗军领袖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I wonder if she had lost her arm yet at that point. No way to know, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道那时她是不是已经失去了手臂。也没法知道，我想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The way spies always end phone calls. By lying to each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 间谍结束通话的惯用方式——互相撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We told her we'd be going on a mission somewhere else, when we were planning on deploying into her locked-down city.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们告诉她我们要去其他地方执行任务，其实当时我们是在计划部署到她所在的封锁城市。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We ended the call the way spies always end phone calls. By lying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们按照间谍惯用的方式结束了通话——撒了谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: At least we did tell her one last truthful thing before we hung up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 至少在挂断电话之前，我们对她说了最后一句实话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "We'll always love you, no matter how far away you go."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "无论你走多远，我们都会永远爱你。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I hope you're right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我希望你是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's just something fun to do outside when it's snowed and the world's taken a moment to slow down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这只是一件下雪的时候，当整个世界都慢下来，在户外做的很有意思的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And "ball" is an easy shape to make with snow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而且"球"是一种用雪很容易做出来的形状。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Besides. They're cheery looking, when everything is cold and bleak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 此外，当一切变得寒冷又苍白时，它们却显得很愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Because he was picking his nose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为要挑个好鼻子挖鼻孔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You told that to the foreign delegation committee when we were in Cité de la Lumière.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们之前在光城的时候，你给外国代表团委员会讲过这个笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I was busy, but it doesn't mean I wasn't listening. You were my cover. And you almost blew it for me when I laughed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我当时很忙，但这并不代表我当时没听你说。你是我的掩护。你差点就把我的行动搞砸了，因为我当时大笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We did. And had to leave very quickly when the Rus showed up angry as a swarm of bees.
