/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没错。那时候俄人像一群蜜蜂一样愤怒地出现，我们不得不赶紧离开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Never got to finish that bottle of wine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 连那瓶酒还没来得及喝完

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Mm. Beggars and choosers and all that jazz. Count me in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯。有得选就不错了，还讲究什么。算我一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I was thinking about Neci again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我又开始想念内奇了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And the time I took her out shopping for Vel's birthday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有那次我带她出去给维利买生日礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And she got you the lighter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而她送了你打火机。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Nothing funnier than a little 12-year-old girl walking up to a counter, slapping a lighter onto a counter, and glaring at the man behind the desk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没有什么比一个 12 岁的小女孩走到柜台前，把打火机拍在柜台上，瞪着柜台后面的男人更有趣的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Before seriously demanding it be etched precisely the way SHE wanted it be done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然后她严肃要求按照她的方式进行雕刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And we'd bring her back some little bric-a-brac. Never mattered what it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们会给她带一些小玩意儿。不管是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But it was a piece of that story for her. A memory of it. And it was added to the collection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但对她来说，这是那段故事的一部分。一段回忆。它也被收进了她的收藏中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: She might not have been there, but it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她可能不在故事里，但东西在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're probably right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你可能是对的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're probably right. But that's the thing about stories, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你可能是对的。但这就是故事的意义，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Things come and go. But the stories never leave us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 事情来来去去。但故事永远不会离开我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I do. It was... an adventure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我记得。那可是……场冒险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Oh Lua, how could I forget?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，月神，我怎么能忘呢？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You were there trying to steal your father's Cold War tooth camera out of their storage facility. Which never happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你当时在那儿想从他们的储藏室里把你爸冷战时期的牙齿相机偷走。但这从来都没发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You were there trying to steal your father's Cold War tooth camera out of their storage facility.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你去那儿想从他们的储藏室里把你爸冷战时期的牙齿相机偷走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: While I had a 17 year old who was staring at all the ancient statues with the expression of "oh, maybe Paganism."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而我还带着个 17 岁的孩子，脸上露出"哦，也许是异教"的表情，盯着所有古代雕像看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thank you. He blames me, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢你。当然了，他怪我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I refused to cause a distraction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不想分散别人的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: While half the staff is ogling her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 同时，一半的工作人员都对她眉目传情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: C'est la vie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这就是生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The gods of Ancient Kemet. Bastet, Osiris, Ra, Thoth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 古代凯麦特的神。芭丝特、奥西里斯、拉、托特。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I could just see the gears turning in her head. "Maybe I'll join a cult."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我仿佛能看到她脑子里在想什么。"也许我会加入邪教。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We're an odd family, Velimir darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们是个奇怪的家庭，亲爱的维利米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But you're right. It was her choice to make. And I shouldn't have held her choice against you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但你是对的。这是她的选择。我不应该因为她的选择而责怪你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Sadly, he never did get the camera out from storage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 遗憾的是，他一直没能把相机从储藏室里拿出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And your father did approve of one choice you made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而你爸确实同意过你的一个选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I refused to cause a distraction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不想分散别人的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Marrying me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你娶我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Too bad we couldn't go back, just the two of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 可惜我们回不去了，就我们两个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hah! Oh, the visual there is killing me. But I'll pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈！哦，这画面真是要了我的命。不过我还是算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You poor thing, having to watch all this sappy nonsense go by. Go on, dear. Be free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你个可怜的家伙，不得不看着这些无聊的事情上演。去吧，亲爱的。你自由了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You know, I think I'm actually going to like it here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你知道么，我觉得我其实会喜欢上这儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It's nice to have like-minded individuals around to talk to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有志同道合的人在身边可以倾诉真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not every story has a happy ending, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者，不是每个故事都有好结局的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I think you'll get the answers you need, in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我认为你仍然最终会得到你所需要的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The ladies here are quite something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这儿的女士们真有点意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And sometimes, that's okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有时，这也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I can be at peace with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这样我就心安理得了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We're starting a book club.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们要开一个书友会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Without tears, we wouldn't know how to laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没有泪水，我们就不会懂得如何欢笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I just hope that... whatever she's become, whatever she really is -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我只是希望……不管她变成了什么，不管她到底是什么——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But even if we never get the answers we're looking for about Neci?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 即使我们永远得不到关于内奇的答案了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Without death, life would have no meaning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没有死亡，生命就没有意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Some part of her is still our little girl.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她身上有一部分仍然是我们的小女孩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And without a yesterday, we wouldn't appreciate a new tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而没有昨日，我们就不会珍惜崭新的明天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And that part, however small it might be, finds her own peace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 无论那部分多么渺小，也能找到属于自己的安宁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Also... thank you. For helping us remember why we really came here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有……谢谢你。帮助我们回忆起了我们来这里的初心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We'd tell you, but then we'd have to kill you.  ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们会告诉你，但之后我们就得杀了你。；）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It was about finding something we'd lost, deep down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是为了找回我们内心深处失去的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Not just Neci.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不仅仅是内奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: All things in life generally are. But thank you for the warning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 生活本就如此。但还是谢谢你的提醒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I agree. Bad news always comes first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 同意。总是要先听坏消息的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The one with the child dictator that kept killing you repeatedly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是那个有个小孩独裁者，一遍遍杀死你的地方？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Heh. That's my little girl.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呵，不愧是我的小女孩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Riddles and strange messages? You're speaking our language.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 破解谜语和奇怪的信息？我们很在行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Don't fall for it. If that thing's inside her head, it knows what she knows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 别上当。如果那东西已经入侵了她的意识，它会知道她所知道的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That we were actually... ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 确认彼此……依然是真正的自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home" was the responding half.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 暗语的下半部分，就是"当日月汇聚，迷途者终将寻得归途。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: *Her* half.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是*她*要对上的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: But why would it be trying to give us a sense of hope? Unless it was simply trying to hurt us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 可是它为什么要给我们一丝希望呢？除非它是想折磨我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Through false hope, perhaps? To cause us pain?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也许是想给我们一点虚假的希望？然后借此来加深我们的痛苦？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You're very right. Hearing that phrase, thinking she even *might* still be out there, isn't painful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你说得对。听到那句暗语，哪怕只是心里想想她*也许*还活着，并不会痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: I'm proud of her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我很为她自豪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why? What for? What does he have to gain from the two of us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 它为什么这么做？图什么？它能从我们身上得到什么好处？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Then she has one of the most powerful allies in the universe. In existence. She picked a side. So did we.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那么她就有了整个宇宙，甚至整个存在里最强大的盟友之一。她选好了自己的立场，我们也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Hopefully, we'll never have to point guns at each other. And if we do? Then we'll deal with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 希望永远不会有一天我们要把枪口对准彼此。但如果真有那么一天？那就面对它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: No, I think the message was real. And I think it was from our little girl. Telling us... she's still out there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，我觉得那条信息是真的。就是我们的小女孩发来的。她在告诉我们……她还活着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Telling us, in her own way, that she's "okay."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 用她自己的方式告诉我们，她"还好"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And that we can stop worrying about her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 让我们放心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: The curse and blessing of being a parent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为人父母，又甜又苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Now you're really speaking our language.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这下你说到我们心坎上了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That is a valid response, I agree. Heh. What do you both say to a few drinks?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是个很合理的回答，我赞成，呵。要不要去喝几杯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And... Drifter? Thank you. Again. For all that you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有……漂泊者？真的谢谢你。感谢你做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Eleanor and the rest of the ladies have promised me a "night I will definitely forget."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 埃莉诺和其他女士们向我保证，这将是一个"喝到断片的夜晚"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Birthdays stop being thrilling after a certain point, but I appreciate your optimism.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 一段时间以后生日就不再令人激动了，但我还是很欣赏你的乐观精神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: And I could not be more excited.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我简直不要太兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Casually commit international war crimes. Drinks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 随便犯些国际战争罪。以及喝酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: It would likely just end up with more bickering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 结果很可能只是更多的争吵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: You know. The usual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你知道的。很平常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: We are. And I'll leave the details up to your imagination. Where they belong.  ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们会。细节就留给你自己想象了。那才是它们该去的地方。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: That's classified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那是机密。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Heh. If this even *is* my birthday. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呵。如果这真的*是*我的生日的话。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: yeah. sorry. hi. i was probably the easy one to guess, huh? lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的。抱歉。嗨。我可能是更容易猜到的那个，对吧？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: hah! sorry, pal. velimir. and MomToxicated over here is minerva.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈！抱歉，伙计。我是维利米尔。那位 MomToxicated 是米尼娃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: MomToxicated over here is minerva.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那位 MomToxicated 是米尼娃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: M, be reasonable. process of elimination. how many of us freaks can there reasonably be on this system?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 米，理智点。用排除法。这个聊天系统上会有多少个像我们这样的怪胎？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: fear you'll be waiting a long time then, pal. hah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 伙计，那你可能要等很久了。哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: well, if *you're* confused, then we're all screwed. hah!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，如果连*你*都困惑的话，那我们就都完蛋了。哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: here's the short of it. M here has questions she wants answers to, and wants you to answer them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 简而言之，米有一些问题想要得到答案，她希望你能回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: seeing as you're the one we've come here to get answers from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为我们来这里就是为了向你寻求答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i for one hope so! the more the merrier, i say. s'like the old saying goes, the only difference between a cult and a religion is numbers, haha.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我倒是希望如此！我觉得，人越多越好。就像那句老话说的，邪教和宗教的唯一区别就是人数，哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: there. that better, M? that suit your "good cop/bad cop" gameplan more?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好了。米，这样可以了吧？这更符合你的"好警察/坏警察"套路吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: is that a saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这算是一句谚语吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i don't know. you get where i'm going. water's great, everybody in, as far as i'm concerned! well, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不太确定。你懂我的意思。我是这么看的，水很棒，大家一起下水吧！好吧，反正就这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: (i don't think we get to judge.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: （我觉得我们没资格评判。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: oh, here we go...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，又来了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: no reason to be like that. start with a "hi, how are ya?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没必要这样。可以先来一句"嗨，你好吗？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: sorry, pal. when M's got a target in sight, it's all about the Go Go Go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 对不起，伙计。当米锁定目标时，就只知道冲冲冲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i'm not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我没有干扰吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i was just thinking that maybe if we told our *new friend* here why we were looking for neci

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 飞越海洋，看不到陆地。只有我们俩个，坐着我们偷来的这架烂透了的小飞机

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: got it from this drug runner that M slipped some of his own supply to in his "herbal tea" right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是从一个毒品贩子那里偷来的，米在他的"草本茶"里撒了一些他自己的货，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: yeah well turns out drug runners don't make good plane mechanics cuz this thing bursts into flame halfway over open ocean
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不过，事实证明，毒品贩子当不成好的飞机机械师，因为这东西在公海上一会儿就着火了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: whep
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哎

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: awww... you never told me that... :-D
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哇……你从来没告诉过我…… :-D

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: we're going down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们开始坠落。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i'd probably eat my arm off before i'd resort to eating your, corpse though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 在吃你的尸体之前，我可能宁愿先把自己的胳膊吃掉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i start screaming
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我开始尖叫

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: for some reason there are chickens in the back of the plane?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不知道为什么，飞机后面有几只鸡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i mean, you're poisonous now, aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我的意思是，你现在有毒，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: whatever, there are chickens, and they are going NUTS.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不管怎么说，那里有鸡，而且它们都疯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: yeah so we crashed
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，然后我们坠毁了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i mean, it might be smart to spend time... building up a resistance to your toxin
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我的意思是，花点时间……增强对你的毒素的抵抗力，也许是明智之举

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but luckily minerva here saw a spot of land and we didn't end up drowning, obviously.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 幸运的是，米尼娃看到了一块陆地，显然我们最终没有淹死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: in... other ways...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不过……要用个别的方式……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: we wound up on this deserted island. maybe 500 feet wide, by a 100 feet long. no fresh water.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们落到一个荒岛上，大概有 500 英尺宽，100 英尺长。没有淡水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you know, just in case we get stranded together again and... worst comes to worst...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你知道，万一我们又被困在一起……最坏的情况……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: palm trees. sand. turquoise water.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 棕榈树、沙滩、碧蓝的海水。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: eating whatever we could catch. boiling salt water and praying for rain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 吃我们能捕到的任何东西。煮盐水，祈祷下雨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: we nearly starved to death. spent six weeks, surviving alone on that island together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们差点饿死。我们一起在那个岛上生存了六周。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: hahahaha sorry lil buddy, can't help it. it's too funny.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈哈哈，对不起，小伙计，我忍不住。太好笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you don't have to ask me twice :-3
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你不用再问我了 :-3

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i hope she'd be happy to see we'd settled our issues.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我希望她看到我们之间的问题解决了会很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: probably come back just to put us out of our misery.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 也许她会回来亲自动手杀了我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: the last time we spoke to her was on a secure line.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们上次和她通话是在一个加密线路上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and that weird lookin' little grease weasel of hers was probably listening in
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她那只长相怪异的小鼬鼠可能也在偷听

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: at that point we were still *technically* together, but things were going south, fast...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那时我们虽然*名义上*来说还在一起，但关系已经急转直下了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: she sounded like our little girl, if that's what you're asking. knew what to say and how to say it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果你是想问这个的话，她听起来确实像我们的小女孩。知道该说什么，还有怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but she sounded... stressed. you could hear it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但她听起来……很紧张。你可以听得出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i don't know how one finds a god and punches it in the [REDACTED] face but i'm gonna [REDACTED] try
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道怎么去找到一个神然后一拳打在它 [已屏蔽] 脸上，但我会 [已屏蔽] 尝试

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: barely even mentioned the freakin' monster toaster tv zombies. you'd think that would've come up more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 几乎没有提到可怕的烤面包机怪物电视僵尸。你可能会以为这些更值得一提。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: lol. hells no. city was under lockdown, remember? total covert ops, us sneaking in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。当然没有。还记得吗，当时城市被封锁了？我们完全是秘密行动，偷偷潜入。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and then we both told each other the biggest lie of all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然后我们对彼此撒了最大的谎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: we all said "don't worry, we'll be fine."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们都说"别担心，我们会没事的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: yeah. we did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是的，我们说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "You're our baby girl. And nothing will ever change that."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "你是我们的宝贝女儿。没有什么可以改变这一点。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: hey. hey drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿。嘿，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: why did the snowman go to therapy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 雪人为什么要去做心理治疗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: psh. missing out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 切。错过好东西了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: YEP.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: because he had a... TOTAL MELTDOWN
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为它……脑子化了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: oh, buddy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 噢，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: aaahahahhahaaaaa
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊哈哈哈哈啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: that is the saddest thing i've ever...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是我听过的最悲伤的事情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: think a ball of snow on top of a bigger ball of snow on top of a bigger ball of snow
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 想象一下，一个雪球堆在一个更大的雪球上，而这个更大的雪球再堆在一个比它还要大的雪球上

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ok ok ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好好好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: with two pieces of coal for eyes and a big 'ol carrot for a nose
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 用两块煤做眼睛，用一根大胡萝卜做鼻子

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: Why was the snowman looking through the carrots?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 为什么雪人要找胡萝卜？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i mean, yes? but no? it's not the point - it's a thing people do when -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我的意思是，应该是吧？但也不是？这不是重点——这是人们在某些时候会做的一件事——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: because -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 因为——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ah shit
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊该死

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: egh. on second thought, never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃。我又想了一下，算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: shit. i forget. damn it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 该死，我忘了。可恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: oh well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: HAH!! right!! thanks, M
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈！对！谢了，米

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i'd love to show you how. :-D
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我很乐意教你怎么堆。:-D

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: exactly!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 正是！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: eh, it'll come to me eventually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呃，我最后会想起来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: how'd you know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: SO. the JOKE.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，那个笑话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: why did the snowman go to therapy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 雪人为什么要去做心理治疗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: oh right! hahhaha. i forgot all about that trip. i thought you were too busy slipping poison into the chancellor's wine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦对！哈哈哈。我把那次旅行忘得一干二净的。我以为你光往总理的酒里下毒就忙不过来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: d'aaawwww
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 啊啊啊

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and if i remember correctly, we went to that place with the amazing escargot after, didn't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 如果我没记错的话，我们之后还去了那个地方试了神奇的蜗牛，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: well, Longshot McExtremelyBritannic and friends came up with a new batch of moonshine
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，特别不列颠尼克的远射先生和朋友们弄了一批新的自酿酒

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: not exactly a bottle of red worth my year's salary but hey. care to pick up where we left off?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这酒虽然没贵到要我一年的工资，但是嘿，这次要喝个痛快吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: neci loves to laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 内奇喜欢笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: evil?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 邪恶？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: the year you got me the necklace.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那年你送了我项链。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: why do you think i tell so many stories, buddy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 伙计，你以为我为什么会讲这么多故事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: takes after her mother, sure. but there's also so much joy in that one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 确实像她妈。但是她也充满了快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: got into the habit with her. she loved to hear them. always would want to know about whatever M and i were up to
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是我和她在一起时养成的习惯。她喜欢听这些。总想知道我和米在做什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but i'd tell her about This Thing or That Thing and So No Shit There We Were
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然后我就跟她讲这事那事，"还有什么‘不是吧，就这样了'"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and This Went SO WRONG
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有这事搞得一塌糊涂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and she'd sit there and laaaaaugh and laaaugh
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她就坐在那里笑啊笑

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you kidding me? all the time! neci loves to laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你在跟我开玩笑吗？她经常笑！内奇喜欢笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: takes after her mother, sure. but there's also so much joy in that one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 确实像她妈。但是她也充满了快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: nobody loves a good bad story quite like her
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没有人像她那样只喜欢听精彩的倒霉故事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: neci loves to laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 内奇喜欢笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: all in a dumpster now, i assume. not like the Indifference ran around with a suitcase full of random nonsense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想，这些可能全都被扔进垃圾箱了。虚空无情之物可不会带着装满杂物的箱子到处跑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i wonder if she still has any of it... or had rather. don't expect the Indifference carried around a suitcase
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我不知道她还有没有保留着这些东西……或者曾经保留过。不指望虚空无情之物会拿着行李箱

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: hey M, you remember that time we took neci to the ludston museum?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，米，你还记得那次我们带内奇去拉德斯顿博物馆吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: hey M, you remember that time we took neci to the ludston museum loool
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嘿，米，你还记得那次我们带内奇去拉德斯顿博物馆吗？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: she refused to push over a priceless artifact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她不想推倒一件无价之宝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: c'mon don't be so melodramatic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 拜托，别这么夸张。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i got pa a box of cigars instead. seemed to be just as happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，我就给爸爸买了一盒雪茄。他看起来一样高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: they were ogling you, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 他们也向你暗送秋波。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: yeeeah, so. my pa, Velimir Volkov I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是——啊，是这样的。我爸，就是维利米尔·沃尔科夫一世？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: spied for the Rus during the cold war, which was basically when Rus and Libertatia were extremely hostile toward each other
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 在冷战期间为俄国人做间谍，当时俄国和自由国彼此非常敌对

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but there wasn't any actual warfare. just threats, propaganda, spying, sabotage, assassinations, things like that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但并没有真正的战争。只是威胁、宣传、间谍、破坏、暗杀之类的事情

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: should've seen the whole scaldra shit coming, now that i think about it in retrospect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 现在回想起来，我早该想到会发生炽蛇军的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: pa defected to Libertatia, though. 'n here i am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不过，爸爸叛逃到了自由国。然后我就在这儿了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: um. M?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 嗯。米？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: pa wanted it back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 爸爸想要把它拿回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: right. so. say. you're a spy. and you're spying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 对。所以。就说。你是一个间谍。你在从事间谍活动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i know it's way too little and it's way too late, and i'll say it in person and i'll say it a thousand more times, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我知道这为时已晚也微不足道，我要亲口对你说，而且我要再说上一千遍，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: figured it'd be a nice birthday gift.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想那会是个很棒的生日礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and you get caught. with a camera. bad things happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 然后你被抓住了。带着相机。坏事发生了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i'm sorry i didn't trust you and your intel on scaldra when i should've. i knew that neci was looking to me for approval to stay or go, and...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我很抱歉当时没相信你和你有关炽蛇军的情报，尽管我本该这样做。我知道内奇在向我征求去留的意见，而且……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: so they got reaaal sneaky about where they could put recording devices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以他们在放置照相设备时变得非常谨慎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: my pa never really approved of anything i did, no matter what it was. i didn't want to be like that for her. i wanted to let her make her own choices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不管我做什么事，我爸都没真正同意过。我不想对她那样。我想让她自己做选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: why? is that not how they do things in the future?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么了？难道他们未来不会这么做吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and pa had this big gold tooth right front 'n center so they stuck an itty bitty camera in it
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而爸爸嘴的正前部有一颗大金牙，所以他们在里面装了一个小小的相机

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but i should've listened. so. i'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但我应该听你的。所以，我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: well, itty bitty is relative, it was still a flippin' camera in a tooth
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 好吧，小小的是相对的，它仍然是一个在牙齿里的该死的相机

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: oh yeah? what was that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦，有吗？是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: she refused to push over a priceless artifact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她不想推倒一件无价之宝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: HAH. that's true. he freaking LOVED you. any woman who can put down vodka shots like he can AND fix a truck in sub-zero weather?! SOLD.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。那倒是真的。他非常——喜欢——你。有哪个女人能像他一样喝得了伏特加，——还能——在零度以下的天气里修得了卡车？！就她了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i got pa a box of cigars instead. seemed to be just as happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，我就给爸爸买了一盒雪茄。他看起来一样高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: sucks we never did get that camera for him out of storage. would've made a great birthday gift for him. oh well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 很遗憾我们没能把那台相机从储藏室里拿出来给他，做个很棒的生日礼物。哦，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: worked out in the end. still got a great family vacation out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 事情最后圆满解决。我们还是和家人享受了一个美好的假期。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i could slip Arthur a fifty and pay him to pretend to be a tour guide. we could get drunk and pretend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我可以偷偷给亚瑟五十块钱，让他假装成导游。我们可以喝得酩酊大醉然后假装。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: (i'll float you the cash just for the laugh)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: （我会把钱给你，只为了让我们都开心一下）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: we raised her to be the best parts of both of us. tough. vicious. kind. resourceful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们把她培养成了我们两个人中最好的模样。坚强、狠毒、善良、足智多谋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but above all, she's a sols-damned *survivor*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但最重要的，她是一个坚强的*幸存者*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: so when you do cross paths with whatever is wearing her face next?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 所以，当你和下一张长得和她一样的脸擦肩而过时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you tell her this, from us:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你告诉她，这是我们给她的：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "于静寂歧路，追寻日蚀。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but also each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而是彼此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: seriously. i never thought of myself as the retiring type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 说真的，我从不认为自己是那种会退休养老的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but here? with these lovable idiots?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但在这里？和这些可爱的白痴们在一起？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and my beautiful, *incredibly* sexy wife? hard to not be happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还有我*尤物*般性感的妻子？很难不开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: yeah... neci's a grown woman. but whatever she is, whatever answers are out there...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 是啊……内奇已经长大了。但不管她是什么，不管有什么答案……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i think our part in that story ends here, lil buddy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想我们在这个故事里的角色到此结束了，小伙计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and that's fine by us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们也没意见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you got this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 你可以的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: what's up lil buddy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 怎么了，小伙计？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: do it the adult way. bad news first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 都是成年人了。先说坏消息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: bracing for the news, but it sounds like she's... not dead, at least?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我做好心理准备了，不过听你这么说……她起码还活着，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: wait. wait wait. that storybook dimension thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 等等，等等。你是说进到那个故事书里了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but was it really *her* though? or just that thing wearing her face?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 可那还是*她*吗？还是说是那个东西顶着她的脸？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: 1-800-spy-shit, you've come to the right place
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 1-800-间谍-热线，你算是找对人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: ....shit. M. SHIT.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: ……该死。米，糟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "于静寂歧路，追寻日蚀。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: it was our half of a code phrase. how we started each phone call so we knew we were on a secure line and everything was safe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这句话是我们俩这边的暗语。每次打电话前都会对这个暗语，来确认线路安全，万无一失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: what i told you to tell our lil girl if you saw her again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我之前跟你说过，要是再遇到了我们的小女孩，就告诉她那句话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you got it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没错……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: we had a code phrase. it was how we started each phone call so we knew we were on a secure line and everything was safe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们设了个暗语。每次打电话前都会对这个暗语，来确认线路安全，万无一失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse" was our half.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: "于静寂歧路，追寻日蚀"是我们俩的部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: is this painful?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这很痛苦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: is it false, though? is this painful?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这是假的吗？这很痛苦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: or is it some kind of peace, to know our little girl is still alive out there, somewhere?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 还是说，在知道了我们小女孩还活着，她就在某个地方后，其实生出了一丝平静。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: that despite all odds, she's still kicking ass and taking names?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哪怕是她经历了这么多之后，还在顽强的战斗，活得精彩？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: even if it isn't with us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 甚至哪怕不在我们的身边？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: that warms my big dumb heart, i don't know about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 光是想到这些，足以让我这颗迟钝的心，心头一热了。不知道你是不是也这么觉得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: 'n something tells me that's not what the so-called indifference is in the business of doing
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 而且我总觉得，那个所谓的虚空无情之物，不会干这种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: she's as tough as a bag of framing nails in a big 'ol block of cast titanium
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她可是像嵌在钛合金板上的钢钉一样坚韧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: and i'm betting yer "man in the wall" knew that, and that's why he took her in the first place
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我敢打赌，你们那个"墙中人"早就看出来了，所以才会带走她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: nah. she'll be fine. either she's already long gone, or they've got a mutual arrangement, or she's holding his ass hostage. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 放心吧，她不会有事的。她要不就是早就不在了，要么就是他们谈好了条件，或者其实是她绑走了那个东西。哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: we're small fry to that thing. which i say in the best way possible
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我们对它来说只是个小虾米。当然，我是往好处想的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: she's can take care of herself, though. that's how we raised her
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 她能照顾好自己。我们就是这样教导她的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: heh. like we ever could
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 呵，说的好像我们能做到似的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you ever want kids, drifter? eeeh, don't answer that. probably some void nonsense i don't wanna know about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 漂泊者，你有想过要孩子吗？呃，算了还是别回答了。估计你又要说什么虚空乱七八糟的东西，我可不想知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: well, it's not a happy-happy smile. it's a melancholy-happy smile? but
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 不过，这种感觉也不是单纯的开心，算是参杂着忧伤的欣慰吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: now yer talkin'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 这才对嘛

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: i'd like to go put back a few and tell some good stories about our lil girl
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 我想去好好喝几杯，给你讲讲我们小女孩的故事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: yeah. seriously, lil buddy. i don't know how we'll ever be able to repay you. but if the chance comes? we'll be there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 没错，小伙计，说真的，我都不知道该怎么报答你。但将来有机会的话，我们一定在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: you're family now, whether you like it or not. 8-)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 从今以后，不管你愿不愿意，我们就是一家人了。8-)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: oh yeah, totally. living in a hellscape and dealing with infested toasters and scaldra psychos.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哦有啊，当然。生活在地狱里，然后和被感染的烤面包机和炽蛇军的神经病们打交道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: it's a bucket o' laughs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 有说不完的笑料。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: aw thanks lil buddy. and i'll do my best. it helps to have friends around. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 噢谢啦小伙计。有朋友真好。：）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: thanks bud.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 谢谢哥们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: lol. yeah. why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 哈哈。嗯。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: LMAO. nice. dad approved. 8-)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 笑死我了。好。爹爹点了赞。8-）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: besides the one where i'm trapped in a time loop with a bunch of genetically mutated weirdos, as a genetically mutated weirdo,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 除了我和一群基因变异的怪人一起被困在时间循环中，自己也是一个基因变异的怪人，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: with my estranged wife, in a techno-apocalypse under siege by mercenary religious freakos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 和我分居的妻子，困在一个被雇佣兵宗教狂热分子围攻的科技天灾中

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: with my once-estranged wife who i'm now back together with, in a techno-apocalypse under siege by mercenary religious freakos
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 和我曾经分居的妻子，在一个被雇佣兵宗教狂热分子围攻的科技天灾中重归于好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: in a city that i came to looking for my adopted daughter who got hollowed out and used like a saturday morning cartoon puppet by an evil Void god,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 来到一座城市寻找我的养女，她被邪恶的虚空之神掏空，像周六早间动画片里的木偶一样被利用，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: but now i have no idea what's left of her, so i'm holed up in a decrepit dead mall serving drinks to shellshocked civvies and said list of previously mentioned genetically mutated weirdos?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 但现在我不知道她还残存什么，所以我就躲在一个破旧死寂的商场里，给被炮弹震晕的平民和之前提到的那群基因突变的怪人提供酒水？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: besides that one?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 除了这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: the one with the penguins.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 和企鹅的那一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.text: that was freakin' WILD.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/MinervaVelem.zhText: 那真是非常狂野。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How'd he react...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他有什么反应……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Wow. You actually listened to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哇。你真的听我说的做了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How'd it go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 结果怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: In the middle of something, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 在忙一些事，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What'd he say?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不知道？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sounds... uplifting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 听起来……挺令人振奋的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Wow. You actually listened to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哇。你真的听我说的做了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How'd it go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 结果怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: In the middle of something, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 在忙一些事，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How *did* you become a sniper, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 话说，你*是*怎么成为狙击手的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How'd he react...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他有什么反应……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sounds... uplifting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 听起来……挺令人振奋的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不知道？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Is he mad about the packing peanuts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他因为那些包装泡沫花生生气了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You've clearly done this before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你以前肯定做过这种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm impressed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我很佩服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And did you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你加入了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Happy Birthday, Quincy. Looking good as always.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐，昆西。你看起来一如既往的好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Happy Birthday! You feeling your age yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 生日快乐！你感觉到自己老了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey Quincy! I talked Arthur into giving you the night off for your birthday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿，昆西！我跟亚瑟说了，让他在你生日那天给你放假一晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Have a good shift tonight on your birthday, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，祝你在生日夜的值班愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Want to hit the clubs tonight for your birthday?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 今晚想去夜店庆祝你的生日吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How about we do a quiet night in for your birthday with the Hex?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我们晚上不出去就在这，和六人组一起庆祝你的生日怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey Q? Got a second? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿，昆？还有空吗？[征求是否同意多重伴侣关系]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想跟你说件事，我想先确定你能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对我来说重要的是，你不会觉得我在对你撒谎，或者对你不坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No! No. Arthur's alive. I just wanted to talk to you about something that I hope isn't an uncomfortable situation for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没！没有。亚瑟活着。我只是想跟你说点事，希望不会让你觉得尴尬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不想让你陷入一种你无法接受的情况。所以如果你拒绝，那也没关系。我希望你清楚这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我们之间的感情对我很重要——非常重要——而且它是真实的。我不希望你怀疑这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I wanted to talk to you about getting your consent before things went too far. I don't want you to be upset, and something we've never talked about before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想在事情还没到不可收拾的地步之前，跟你聊聊征求你的同意。我不想让你难过，而且这是我们以前从没谈过的话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I wanted to talk to you about getting your consent before things went too far. I don't want you to be upset, and something we've never talked about before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想在事情还没到不可收拾的地步之前，跟你聊聊征求你的同意。我不想让你难过，而且这是我们以前从没谈过的话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Of course I forgive you. You mean so much to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我当然原谅你了。你对我来说很重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... can't. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……不能。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Of course I forgive you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我当然原谅你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: At what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 什么失败？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh good, we're still going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦好吧，我们还在继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All right. I'm listening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我在听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You don't need to do this, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你没必要这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm walking away. I'm not playing this game. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我走了。我不玩这个游戏了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because you were willing to leave him to die, but he wasn't willing to leave you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是因为你情愿让他去死，但他却不愿意让你去死？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because you owed him your life, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为你现在欠他一条命？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh no...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 噢不……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And then the Techrot...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后是科腐者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I understand why you felt like you needed to protect yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我理解你为什么觉得需要保护自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sorry you feel like you have to go through life like that. But what happened before isn't my fault.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我很抱歉你觉得你必须这样生活。但之前发生的事并不是我的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was really expecting something more impressive than that. After my story, that's all you've got?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我本来还期待听到一些更加震撼的事情。听完我的故事，你就只有这些？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sorry, brb. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，马上回来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm... not exactly up on all my lingo. From the future, remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……不太熟悉这些现代用语。我是来自未来的，还记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Is that where you get all the fancy clothes? From doing things for people?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你所有的漂亮衣服？都是通过给人办事换来的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm *extremely* familiar with what that's like.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我对这运作方式*非常*熟悉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I thought you were going to teach me stuff I didn't know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我以为你会教我一些我不知道的东西呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Um... is that a hello?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯……这是在打招呼吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我尽量试试看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hah sorry, it's just how I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈，抱歉，我就是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, technically I was from Earth, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，严格来说我先是来自地球的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Functionally? Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 从功能上来说？是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: As opposed to non-space "space?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 难道还有假的太空吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah, actually. Statues to you everywhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 出名啊，其实到处都有你的雕像。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't think so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得不出名。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Um... is that a hello?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯……这是在打招呼吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You might have been for a while. But I'm from the *really far* future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 可能有一段时间你很出名。但我来自*非常遥远*的未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Your guess is as good as mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我和你一样对此毫无头绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I have no clue. The Orokin destroyed all the records of Ancient Earth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。奥罗金毁掉了所有古代地球的记录。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's... a long story. What did you want to talk about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这……说来话长。你想谈什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Assholes who thought they were gods and acted accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 一群以为自己是神的混蛋，还真摆出一副神的架子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... don't get you, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……不，不太明白你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you threatening me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是在威胁我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think I follow...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想我明白了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah, fine... I'll take you up on that deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 行，行……我接受你的提议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm fitting in fine...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我适应得挺好的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't need to know how to use a VCR. I'm trying to save people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不需要知道怎么使用录像机。我正在努力救人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... Okay, fine...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……好吧，我接受……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't need to be "one of them" to save them. Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不需要成为"他们中的一员"来救他们。不用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Teach... me... how to exist in this year? Or...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 教……我……怎么在这一年生存？还是……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Take me under your wing *how* exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 罩我？*怎么*个罩法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Pardon me while I try *desperately* not to laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我真*很难*忍住不去笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I appreciate that, but I don't think I need your help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我感激你的好意，但我并不认为我需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I admit the technology - or, um, lack thereof - is weirding me out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我承认这里的技术——或者说，嗯，技术的匮乏——让我有点不适应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Similar, but different... All warzones suck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 相似，但不同……所有战区都很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually... yes. And it was terrible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上……待过。而且还很糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's a toaster oven...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 什么是烤箱……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... see your point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……明白你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What do you want in exchange?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你想要什么作为交换？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Give me a little time to catch up. How can I help you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 给我点时间跟上节奏。有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I should've known it was going to come with a fee.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我就知道这是要收费的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Nope. I'm out. I don't work for you, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。我不干。昆西，我可不是给你打工的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... Fine. But don't make me regret this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……好吧。但别让我后悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Can... I ask what your problem is with Arthur?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……可以问一下你和亚瑟之间有什么过节吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's a lot of stress, being in charge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当领导真的很有压力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: He does like to brood...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他确实喜欢沉思……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's the second thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 第二件事是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Why *did* you stick around, when things started to get ugly here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当这里的情况开始变得糟糕时，你为什么*还*留在这里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know. Would you? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。你会这样做吗？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Does it mean anything? You flirting with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你在跟我调情？这是不是有什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I've decided I'm game if you are. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我决定好了，如果你愿意，我也没问题。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I've decided I can do without it, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我决定好了，我不需要，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Uh - I have to go find a good reason - like right now - brb -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 呃——我得去找个好理由——就现在——马上回来——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: We just met and you want to start flirting with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我们才刚认识，你就开始跟我调情了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Bit fast to start flirting with me, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这就开始跟我调情，你不觉得有点太快了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are... you flirting with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你……是在和我调情吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh, we're flirting now? lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦，我们是在调情？哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ...One point to Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……这一局算你昆西赢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Very different.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这完全两回事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: My life hasn't exactly been relaxing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我这辈子就没怎么放松过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know what you're talking about. I'm full of chill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道你在说什么。我超级放松的好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm certainly not going to turn it down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我当然不会拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... haven't really made up my mind yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……还没决定好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'd rather you didn't, honestly. No offense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说，还是不要这样比较好。不要见怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Fair. All right. Sure. Where's the harm with some fun banter? :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 公平。好吧。当然。开些玩笑有什么坏处？:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I've decided I can do without it, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想好了，我不需要，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll do my best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How do I earn it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我要怎么努力？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Wait. What's the k stand for?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 等一下。这个克代表什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I have better things to do than play your games, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我还有更重要的事要做，没空陪你玩这些游戏，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. No it isn't. I was hoping to be done with terrified civilians.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，确实不是。我本来希望不要再见到那些惊恐的无辜平民了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No, but this is unique in its own right. I won't pretend to be the expert.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，不过这里有它的特别之处。我不会假装自己是专家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Will you tell me about why you stayed here in exchange?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 作为交换，你能告诉我你为什么留在这里吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Maybe another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 或许下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Where're you from, originally?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你原本来自哪里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What brought you to Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 什么原因让你来到霍瓦尼亚？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I like you. And I'm *really* shitty at making friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我喜欢你。但我真的很不擅长交朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm trying to get to know you, and I... don't have any clue where else to start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我在试着了解你，而我……不知道该从哪里开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm... trying to make conversation?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……只是想找话题聊聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Why'd you end up joining a peacekeeping organization?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 为什么你最后会加入维和组织？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ICR?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 国危部？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I spent most of my life stuck in an alternate dimension filled with people who aren't real... but who *were* able to kill me for real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我一生大部分时间都被困在一个平行时空里，那里面充斥着虚构的人……但他们却*能够*真正杀死我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I've never had real friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我从来没有过真正的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't like playing games, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，我不喜欢玩游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sorry... what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对不起……什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Honestly? I see you as someone who could've been a model. Or running a business somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说？我看你完全可以当模特。或者在某个地方经营自己的生意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm just having a hard time trying to figure out why a "peacekeeping" group needs a *sniper.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只是搞不懂，为什么"维和"组织需要一名*狙击手*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You just seem like you're looking out for yourself first, right? Survival of the fittest? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你看起来是先考虑自己利益的类型，对吧？适者生存？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So why DID they have a sniper on staff?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么他们为什么要配备狙击手呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Thanks? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 谢谢？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you saying the ICR was for sale? What do you know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是说国危部可以出售？你知道些什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Did you go into the ICR feeling that way? Or did something happen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你去国危部的时候就是这么想的吗？还是中间发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I really don't want to talk about this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的不想谈这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No... I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不……我不懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I had a family once. They're all dead now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我曾经有过一个家庭。现在他们都死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Long and traumatic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 又长又充满创伤。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And not one I feel like talking about. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我并不想谈论这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't need this shit from you. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不需要你取的这破名。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I. Well. ... You're not wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我。嗯。……你没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey. I earned that space trauma.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿。那太空创伤的名号是我挣来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You wouldn't believe me if I told you, man.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 就算我告诉你，你也不会相信我，老兄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Can we back all the way up for a second. *Kitchen appliance?!*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我们能不能先倒带一下。*厨房电器？！*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's a toaster oven?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 什么是烤箱……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, I think you make a wonderfully sexy toaster oven hybrid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我觉得你就像个非常性感烤箱混血儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, I think you look okay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我觉得你看上去还不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Aoi? She seems so sweet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 碧？她看上去很温柔啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah... the cute ones will *wreck* you. And now you're at least 68% metal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的……那些可爱的人能*毁掉*你。你身体现在最少有 68% 是金属了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean... I'm the one that started it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实……是我先开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm not sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think I'd rather you didn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得还是不要这样比较好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Mmm...apocalypse sandwiches...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯……末日三明治……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sandwiches?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 三明治？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay, now what's a *blender?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，那么什么是"搅拌机"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... see your point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……明白你的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What do you want in exchange?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你想要什么作为交换？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I should've known it was going to come with a fee.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我就知道这是要收费的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Nope. I'm out. I don't work for you, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。我不干。昆西，我可不是给你打工的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... Fine. But don't make me regret this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……好吧。但别让我后悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. Pass. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sure Amir would tell me for free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定阿米尔会免费告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And you wouldn't just help me out because I'm your friend?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你就不能只因为我是你的朋友而帮助我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... see your point... Fine. I'll take the deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……明白你的意思了……好吧。我接受这笔交易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Wow. What a sociopathic view on life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哇。这是多么反社会的人生观啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yes. I'm playing. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我在开玩笑。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Space.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 太空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll do better next time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 下次我会做得更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... I didn't know this was a test.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……我都不知道这是一个测试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I honestly forgot. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说我忘了。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 习惯就好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's gorgeous. I'll show it to you sometime, maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 它很美。或许哪天我会带你去看看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Have any bad dreams lately? About dying? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 最近有没有做什么噩梦？比如关于死亡的？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Um... well, you're probably happier not knowing. It's...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯……其实，你不知道的话可能会更开心。这是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. It's... I feel like you know, deep down, it's personal. And unpleasant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不是。这……我感觉你心里清楚，这很私人。也很不愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: More space freak future shit. I know you know. And I'm trying to fix it. We can leave it there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 就是未来太空怪物的事。我知道你明白。我在努力解决。我们可以就此打住。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Where you grew up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你在哪里长大？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I honestly forgot. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我还真给忘了。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't need this shit from you. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不需要你取的这破名。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I. Well. ... You're not wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我。嗯。……你没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey. I earned that space trauma.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿。那太空创伤的名号是我挣来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Have fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 玩得开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Stay safe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 注意安全。
