/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Those *are* words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这些*都是*单词。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What am I missing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我错过了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ...Oh look, Arthur needs me for something. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……哦，看，亚瑟需要我去做一件事。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's up, Q?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 怎么了，昆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Entrati left me some books. I might be able to look it up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 英择谛给我留了一些书。我或许可以查查看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. You're right. I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对，你说得对。我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Is there anything you'd be willing to share?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你有什么是愿意分享的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I would if I knew what "greazy" meant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我会的，如果我知道"重磅"是什么意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Is everything a trade with you? [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是不是把一切都看成交易？[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I escaped a personal hell only to wind up in a system where the universe was overtaken by a madman bent on total domination.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我从自己的地狱逃离了出来，结果却落入一个星系，在那里，宇宙被一个一心想统治一切的疯子所占领。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The only place I've ever really known as home is a derelict ship trapped like a cork in a rift in dimensions, inhabited by ghosts and terrible memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我唯一真正称之为家的地方，是一艘像软木塞一样被困在维度裂缝中的废弃飞船，里面住着幽灵和可怕的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was trapped for untold centuries in an infinitely looping dimension where I was subject to torture and murder at the hands of a child despot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我在一个无限循环的维度里，被困了无数个世纪，在那里我遭到一个孩童暴君的折磨和杀害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I had to fight, largely on my own, to free the Origin System's brainwashed innocents to try to rise up and fight the two lunatics in charge of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我基本上是独自一人战斗，去解放始源星系中被洗脑的无辜者，并试图反抗那两个疯子领导者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: That was the first place I met the Indifference. It wouldn't be the last. But that was where the Man in the Wall took *everything* from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那是我第一次遇到虚空无情之物。那不会是最后一次。但正是在那里，墙中人夺走了我的*一切*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Who, by the way, was a creation of my own memories when the Void reached into my mind and pulled out fragments of a storybook.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 顺便说一句，这个暴君是虚空触碰我的脑海并从中提取出故事书片段创造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: One of whom is the brother of the thing that saved my life. Ultimately... we won. But I still remember the terror... the fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其中一个是救了我一命的那个人的弟弟。最后……我们赢了。但我仍然记得那种恐怖……那种恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How's that for "greazy?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这样够"重磅"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's definitely not the weirdest or worst thing I've dealt with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这绝对不是我遇到的最奇怪或最糟糕的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Add it to the pile of... "space trauma" I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我猜，就当是再添个……"太空创伤"吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I wish I could say things have changed much in the future. Been there. Done that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真希望能说未来有很大的改变。我也经历过这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's not a life I'm personally familiar with... but I understand you. And I respect it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我并不熟悉这样的生活……但我理解你。也尊重你的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't really buy into that kind of "winner take all" philosophy, personally. There has to be more to life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 就我个人而言，我不太认同那种"赢者通吃"的哲学。生活应该有更多的意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Things have just gotten more complicated, but the base problems are all the same. People are still people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 事情变得更复杂了，但根本问题还是那些。人还是那个样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But I also think there's more to you than just a guy hustling to get by.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但我也觉得你不只是为了生存而奋斗的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Takes a tough soul to do that day in and day out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 每天都这样做需要坚强的意志。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Like going out into the city and murdering things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 像是出去城里大开杀戒？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What do you suggest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你有什么建议吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't think you're really that deep, Quincy. Sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，我觉得你没那么有深度。抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, where we grew up - or at least the context of it - shapes who we become, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我们长大的地方——或者至少是那种成长环境——塑造了我们，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All right. Well. Do you have any family back home still?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧。那，你在家乡还有家人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那，有吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay. So. Do you have any siblings?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好的。那么。你有兄弟姐妹吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Got it. Skip to the point with you, is what you're saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 明白了。你的意思是，直接点说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But. You. Wait. What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但是。你。等等。什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You are *infuriating.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真让人*抓狂*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you messing with me...? I feel like you're messing with me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是在玩我吗……？我感觉你在玩我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Mine aren't. Well...not really? Mostly aren't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的不是。好吧……不一定？大部分都不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's complicated, but mine are replicated from blueprints. So they aren't the originals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这很复杂，但我的是根据蓝图复制的。所以它们不是原版。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh? What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦？怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You can handle yourself, you've made that clear. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你能照顾好你自己，这点已经很明显了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You're a smart guy. You can't figure it out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是个聪明人。自己想不出来吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What exactly about my warframes are you asking me about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你到底想问我关于我的战甲的什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm afraid I'm not following. But what do you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 恐怕我没听懂。不过你想知道什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You mean Transference? I know it's weird. But the warframes I have are... very different than the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是说传识？我知道这很奇怪。但我拥有的战甲……和六人组非常不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Quincy, don't worry... you're not a cheap ride. .... You're at *least* mid-grade. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，别担心……你不是便宜货……你至少是中档的。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well... I'd hardly describe *you* as a cheap ride, though... I would love to take you around the block a few times. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧……虽然我不会把你形容成廉价车……我倒是很想带你出去兜几圈。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't think I want to play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不太想玩了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oooh it's a game... I get it. I'm in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦，这是个游戏……我明白了。我加入。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: *Damn it.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: *可恶。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lies. I want a second opinion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 骗人。我还想听听别人怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I changed my mind. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我改变主意了。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Eh. I figured I'd try it out. Didn't like it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 呃。我想我应该试试。但我不喜欢它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Still trying to decide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 还在决定中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm not doing this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不想聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Um... yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯……是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey hey, easy - relax. I don't think that's going to happen to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿嘿，冷静点——放松。我不认为那种事那会发生在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Not so tough now, are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 现在不装硬气了，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Calm down, Quincy. You aren't going to turn into a zombie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，冷静点。你不会变成丧尸的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Your infestation has stopped progressing. I don't know if it's the fact that the year is looping, or the strain Entrati used.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你的感染已经停止了。我不确定是因为时间循环，还是因为英择谛用的那种病毒株。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because if I pop into your heads once and a while, you won't go insane. That's what Transference is *for.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为如果我偶尔进入你们的头脑，你们就不会发疯。这就是传识的*目的*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't have answers for what Entrati did. Why, or if it could get fixed, or what happens next. I'm doing the best I can here, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 关于英择谛的所作所为，我也没有答案。为什么，或者是否可以修复，或者接下来会发生什么。昆西，我在尽力了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I said don't know. And I mean that. But I think if you were going to get hollowed out like a festival gourd, it would've happened by now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我说了我不知道，真的不知道。不过我觉得如果你真会被掏空得像个节日南瓜，这事早该发生了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. I know it doesn't make anything better. And I know this is shit. All I'm *trying* to do is say I don't think you're going to get hollowed out like a festival gourd.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。我知道这不会让事情变得更好。我也知道这很糟糕。我只是*试图*告诉你，我不认为你会被掏空得像个节日南瓜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I can't fix what's been done to you. So I'm working with I have. And what I have is Transference and a time loop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我无法修复对你造成的伤害。所以我只能利用我所拥有的。而我所拥有的是传识和时间循环。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Turning you into a mindless warframe is the last thing I want, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，让你变成一个没有思想的战甲是我最不想看到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Why do you assume that's what I want to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你为什么认为这就是我想要做的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You really think I'd make that kind of effort? Have you seen my rigs? lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真以为我会费那劲？见过我的装备没？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh. Yeah. Kaithes. They sound similar to "horses" but they're... skeletal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦，对了，绝灵骥。它们听起来和"马"很像，但它们是……骨架的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Why, are you planning on sending them a bill?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 为什么，你打算给他们寄账单吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This particular nonsense? I think you can pin it on Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这个烂摊子？我觉得你可以怪英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This? I'd blame this on the Man in the Wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这个烂摊子？我会怪墙中人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It all starts with them, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是，一切都从他们开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It all starts with the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 一切都从奥罗金开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. But they are responsible for most of the problems you're dealing with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不是。但是你遇到的大多数问题都是他们造成的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I suspect, though I can't confirm, that it *all* starts with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我怀疑是，不过我无法证实，这*一切*都是从他们开始的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think, if you let me use Transference on you, I could take you into the future. I don't know how long it'd last, but it'd be something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得，如果你让我对你使用传识，我就能带你去未来。我不知道这能持续多久，但总归是个办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想是这样的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You would wear it well. But then again, pretty sure you'd wear anything well. ... And nothing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你戴着它肯定会很好看。不过话说回来，我相信你穿什么都好看……甚至不穿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do you mind knocking off the flirting? It's nothing personal, it's just - you're not my type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你能别再调情了吗？没别的意思，只是——你不是我的菜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: LOL. You wish. But I'm glad you're trying to look at the upsides.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。你倒是希望如此。不过我很高兴你能看到事情的积极面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's a horse?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 马是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm glad you're trying to look at the upsides.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴你能看到事情的积极面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm making this shit up as I go, Quincy. Your guess is as good as mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，我这是临时编的。你的猜测和我的一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. Pretty much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的。差不多是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Try to stay focused on the upsides. You seem pretty good at that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 尽量想想好的一面。你在这方面似乎很擅长。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... I've learned that home is relative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……我学会了家是可以变化的。
……不明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I have people who have become family to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我身边有些人已经成为了我的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... wish I could introduce you to Teshin. I don't think he'd understand half of what came out of your face, but you two would really get on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……真希望我能把你介绍给 Teshin。我不确定他能听懂你说的一半话，但你们俩肯定会合得来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I've had to learn that lesson... a few times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是啊。这个教训我也是吃过……几次亏才学会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't really know if I need to be taking advice from you. But thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的不知道我有没有必要听取你的建议。不过还是谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's it going to cost me...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我要付出什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't need a guide, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，我不需要向导。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Don't make me regret this... fine. I could use a hand figuring things out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 别让我后悔……好吧。我确实需要点帮助来搞清楚这些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't like the idea of owing you a favor. Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不喜欢欠你人情。免谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: We have Kaithes where I'm from. They sound similar, except... no hair. They're skeletal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我们那里有有绝灵骥。听起来很像，只是……没有毛。它们是骨架的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: They sound cute. And alive. Which is a nice change for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 它们听起来挺可爱的。而且是活的。这对我来说是个不错的变化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The future is weird. I don't know what to tell you. Especially my portion of it in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 未来很奇怪。我也不知道该怎么说。尤其是我在双衍王境的那部分经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Duviri is... Well, it's not real, so it's not a *real* undead "horse." It's an *imaginary* undead "horse," if that helps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 双衍王境是……嗯，它不是真实的，所以不是一个*真正*的亡灵"马"。它是*虚构*的亡灵"马"，如果这有帮助的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I really didn't know how to ask that question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真不知道怎么问这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Pretty sure you'd be *way angrier* if you weren't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定如果不是这样，你会*更生气*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Honestly, it's because I don't know what to tell you. I've been hunting for justice my whole life. And I don't want to get your hopes up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说，这是因为我不知道该告诉你什么。我一生都在追求正义。我不想让你抱太大希望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Entrati. The Orokin. The Indifference. Does it matter? It's about saving the universe, not getting revenge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 英择谛。奥罗金。虚空无情之物。这重要吗？我们是为了拯救宇宙，不是为了复仇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, the Orokin are to blame for a lot, but... we don't know who to blame for the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，奥罗金应该为很多事情负责，但是……我们不知道谁该为感染者的事情负责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Quincy? We okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西？我们之间还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey. Quincy. I'm sorry. I lost my temper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿，昆西。对不起。我发脾气了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I didn't like being accused of wanting to turn you into one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不喜欢被指责成想要把你变成一个玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I know. And I reacted poorly. And I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我知道。我的反应很糟糕。我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Nope. Never have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没有。从没有过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Wow. Ouch. That's harsh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哇哦。哎呀。太尖锐了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Thanks for asking so nicely, asshole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你问得这么客气，混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我先走了。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. I really don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没。我真没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you going to start laughing at me, Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你要开始嘲笑我了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I make my home wherever I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我在哪里，哪里就是家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. I really don't have anyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没有，我确实谁也没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you going to start laughing at me, Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你要开始嘲笑我了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我还好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I escaped a personal hell only to wind up in a dimension where the system was overtaken by a madman bent on total domination. "Home."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我从自己的地狱逃离了出来，结果却落入一个星系，在那里，宇宙被一个一心想统治一切的疯子所占领。"家。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The only place I've ever really known as home is a derelict ship trapped like a cork in a rift in dimensions, inhabited by ghosts and terrible memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我唯一真正称之为家的地方，是一艘像软木塞一样被困在维度裂缝中的废弃飞船，里面住着幽灵和可怕的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was trapped for untold centuries in an infinitely looping dimension where I was subject to torture and murder at the hands of a child despot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我在一个无限循环的维度里，被困了无数个世纪，在那里我遭到一个孩童暴君的折磨和杀害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I had to fight, largely on my own, to free the Origin System's brainwashed innocents to try to rise up and fight the two lunatics in charge of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我基本上是独自一人战斗，去解放始源星系中被洗脑的无辜者，并试图反抗那两个疯子领导者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: That was the first place I met the Indifference. It wouldn't be the last. But that was where the Man in the Wall took *everything* from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那是我第一次遇到虚空无情之物。那不会是最后一次。但正是在那里，墙中人夺走了我的*一切*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Who, by the way, was a creation of my own memories when the Void reached into my mind and pulled out fragments of a storybook.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 顺便说一句，这个暴君是虚空进入我的脑海并从中提取出故事书片段创造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I did. And they sent me back here, didn't they?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的。我救了。然后他们就把我送回这里了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Did you miss the part about the constant murder and imaginary people?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是不是漏掉没完没了的谋杀还有想象中的人的部分了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Key word there is "close." it's also haunted with ghosts and where the Man in the Wall made us...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那里的关键词是"接近"。那里也有鬼魂出没，还是墙中人让我们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... don't want to get into this, Quincy. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……不想多说这个，昆西。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No clue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sure they do. But it's not the same. I've never felt like I belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我确定他们会。但那不一样。我从未感受到过归属感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: They do. But they care about the kid, more. And I get it. That isn't my reality. It's fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们在乎。但他们更在乎那个孩子。我也明白。那不是我的现实。没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think that's you saying I'm welcome here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你是在说我在这里受欢迎？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Somebody has to stick around to keep you humble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 必须有人在你身边，让你收着点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sweet thing, huh? ;) I got promoted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，是吧？;) 我地位变高了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I sense you're about to ask for something...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我感觉你是不是有事要求我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Famalam, huh? I got promoted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 家人，是吧？我地位变高了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: For you, anything. What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 为你，做什么都行。需要我做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Wait. Are you just flattering me to ask me for something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 等等。你是在拍我马屁然后想求我办事吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was right. You *are* after something.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我说对了。你确实有所图。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You can just ask me for things, Quincy. You don't need the fake flattery.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你直接跟我说需要什么就好了。不需要那些虚情假意的奉承。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Of course. What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当然。你需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Wait. Are you just flattering me to ask me for something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 等等。你是在拍我马屁然后想求我办事吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Quincy. You want "realness" from me? I want it in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西。你希望我对你"真诚"？我也想要得到同样的回应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't like playing games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不喜欢玩游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Not worth fighting over... What do you want, Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没必要争论这个……昆西，你到底想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So did I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我也是这么想的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What're you *really* after, Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你*到底*想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: That's a terrible thing to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这么说真是太糟了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm not going to argue with you. What the hell do you want, Quincy? Just spit it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不想跟你争论。昆西，你到底想要什么？直说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I wish I could introduce you to Parvos Granum. You two would get along *great.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我能把你介绍给帕尔沃斯·格拉努。你们俩一定很*合得来*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because I don't like getting played, Quincy. If you want something from me, you ask for it. End of story. Keep it honest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为我不喜欢被人玩弄，昆西。如果你想从我这里得到什么，直说就是了。就这么简单。保持诚实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll see what I can do. If it helps.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我看看能做些什么。如果这有帮助的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I know a guy who thinks money is the answer to everything. You two would love each other. Parvos Granum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我认识一个人，他认为金钱是万能的。你们俩一定会相见恨晚。他叫帕尔沃斯·格拉努。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Garms?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 战衣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I really love getting insulted. It's my favorite thing in the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我可真喜欢被侮辱。这是世界上最让我开心的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... I look fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……我看起来很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's wrong with my clothes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的衣服有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah, but... here we are with you asking for something in exchange. ....Again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，但是……结果你又一次在这要求些什么回报。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah, but... here we are with you asking for something in exchange.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，但是……结果你在这要求些什么回报。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was wondering why everybody was looking at me funny...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我就说呢，为什么大家都用奇怪的眼神看着我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... I really have to find a way to get you and Parvos in a room together...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……我真的得想办法让你和帕尔沃斯凑一块……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You would *really* like Parvos Granum and the Corpus. Though they're a little too... structured for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你会*非常*喜欢帕尔沃斯·格拉努和 Corpus 的。虽然他们可能对你来说有点太……规矩了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And you won't help me out for free because we're friends?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 既然我们是朋友，你不免费帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: On it. I could use a new wardrobe, anyway. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好的，正好趁机换个新衣柜。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Will you help me try things on...? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你能帮我试穿一下吗……？ ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I changed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的，我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... Actually, no. That felt gross. Still no flirting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……其实，不是。这感觉真恶心。还是别调情了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I haven't made up my mind, I was just trying it on for size. ... Get it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我还没有决定，只是先试试看合不合适……明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Accepting that's the way the world works means being complicit in it. And I can't do that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 接受世界运转方式就意味着妥协。而我做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You should go into writing poetry, Quincy. I need that printed on a mug.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你应该去写诗。我要把它印在杯子上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我猜是吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey Quincy, I know you're not a huge fan of Amir and all, but... I have a favor to ask.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿昆西，我知道你不太喜欢阿米尔之类的，但是……我想请你帮个忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So if I needed to bribe you into doing something for me, how much would it cost?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那个，如果我要贿赂你帮我做件事，需要花多少钱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay, so... wait to hear me out before you make up your mind, ok? So...there's this game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，那么……等我把话说完再做决定，好吗？那个……有个游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So, Amir's trying to get the gang together to play this tabletop roleplaying game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，阿米尔想把大家聚在一起玩桌面角色扮演游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think it's a fun excuse to get everybody together and hang out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这是个让大家聚在一起放松一下的好理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's an excuse to chill, lay low, and maybe drink a few beers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 就当作借口放松一下、躲清闲、也许还能喝几瓶啤酒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Morale's low with the team, with everything going on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 团队的士气很低，是因为最近发生的这些事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So... it's a really dorky board game. Like *really dorky.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么……这是个非常蠢的桌游。真的*非常蠢*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: "Rolling dice and pretending to be mages," dorky.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: "掷骰子并假装自己是法师"这种蠢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hear me out. It's called Fables & Frontiers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 听我说完。这个游戏叫做寓言与边疆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You'll have to roll dice. But you don't have to do a voice or anything silly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你得掷骰子。但不用配音或做什么傻事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm trying not to judge a protoframe by its cover.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我尽量不以貌取人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No... but... I can make it worth your while?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不想……但是……如果我可以让它对你有好处呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And I'll pay you...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 而且我会给你钱……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And you can make fun of it in your head the entire time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 而且你可以一直在心里嘲笑它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Agghhhhh... fine...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 唉……行吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... don't think I like the idea of owing you a favor. Not over this. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……我觉得我不喜欢欠你人情。至少不是因为这个。算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You seem to be the guy to ask about this. Is there more music in this era besides On-lyne?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得问你准没错。除了线上时代之外，这个时代还有其他音乐吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What do you listen to for music, Quincy?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你听什么音乐？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I just need something else to listen to. It's just... not my thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只是需要听点别的。这个只是……不太合我胃口。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't think I'd want to do that for a living... too much pressure. Too public.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不认为我想那样谋生……压力太大了。太多曝光了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All those adoring fans? All those people wanting a piece of you? That'd be amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所有那些崇拜你的粉丝？所有那些想要一睹你风采的人们？那肯定很棒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I just wish I could tune them out. I don't know how Aoi stands them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只希望我能忽略他们。我不知道碧是怎么忍受他们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sounds like a good time. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 听起来挺不错。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I feel like I just signed myself up to get into trouble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我感觉我就是来给自己找麻烦的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean, there is a stage here in the mall...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 话说，商场里有个舞台的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't think I have *that* kind of magic trick. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不认为我有*那种*魔术招数。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What'd you say...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你说了什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What were you thinking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你当时在想什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yikes... sorry. Sorry. They're just not my thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哎呀……对不起。对不起。它们只是不是我的菜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I didn't realize you were so protective of her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我没意识到你这么护着她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... have friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……有朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I just wanted to ask you if you had music recommendations. Why are we fighting?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只是想问问你有没有音乐推荐。我们为什么要吵架呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sorry. I'm not trying to pretend I'm better than anybody. That stuff just drives me nuts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 抱歉。我并不想假装自己比别人优秀。那些东西真的让我受不了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Just calling it like I see it, buddy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 伙计，我只是说出我所看到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I feel like I just signed myself up to get into trouble.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我感觉我就是来给自己找麻烦的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sounds like a good time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 听起来挺不错。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure. But I thought we were going to trade? My war stories for your "why did you stick around in Höllvania and end up in the Hex" story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当然可以。但我以为我们是要交换故事的？我的战争故事换你"你为什么留在霍瓦尼亚并最终加入六人组"的故事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll tell you. But what's in it for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我会告诉你。但这对我有什么好处呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean. Sure. But it's a lot to get into at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是。当然可以。但一下子要讲的东西太多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean. Sure. But it's a lot to get into at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是。当然可以。但一下子要讲的东西太多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll tell you, gorgeous. But what's in it for me? ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 美人，我会告诉你。但这对我有什么好处呢？;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure. But I thought we were going to trade? My war stories for your "why did you stick around in Höllvania and end up in the Hex" story?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当然可以。但我以为我们是要交换故事的？我的战争故事换你"你为什么留在霍瓦尼亚并最终加入六人组"的故事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm not in the mood for this right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我现在没心情聊这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm not in the mood for this right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我现在没心情聊这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: When I wound up in the Origin System - things were... completely taken over by this psychopath Orokin and a Sentient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当我意外来到始源星系时——一切……都已经被这个有精神病的奥罗金人和一个 Sentient 完全接管了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Let's start at the beginning. With Ballas, the Orokin, and the Sentients.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我们从头开始吧。从 Ballas、奥罗金和 Sentient 开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: In short, the Orokin decided they were gods. They're enhanced humans who figured out how to live forever. Sentients were created by the Orokin to terraform another solar system, but then turned around and waged war on the Orokin Empire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 简而言之，奥罗金人自认为是神。他们是经过改造的人类，知道如何永生。Sentient 是奥罗金创造出来的，用来改造另一个太阳系的，但后来却反过来对奥罗金帝国发动了战争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The Orokin Empire were - are? - responsible for a lot of of the mess we're dealing with now. Either directly or indirectly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金帝国曾经——或者说现在——对我们现在面临的许多烂摊子都负有责任。无论是直接的还是间接的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Earth and the rest of the system was becoming uninhabitable. And they wanted to ensure the survival of the human race. So they decided to terraform a new solar system and its main planet, Tau.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 地球和星系的其余部分都变得不适合居住。而他们想要确保人类的延续。所以他们决定对一个名为 Tau 的新恒星系以及它的主星进行地球化改造。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: In order to do that, they created a synthetic race. The Sentients. And then the Sentients came back and waged war on the Orokin Empire about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 为了实现这一目标，他们创造了一个合成种族。Sentient。可后来 Sentient 反过来向奥罗金帝国发起了战争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Didn't give them the right to come back and start slaughtering innocents over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这并不能成为他们回来屠杀无辜者的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I hate the Orokin Empire as much as the next person. Trust me. But the Sentients aren't saints, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我和其他人一样憎恨奥罗金帝国。相信我。但 Sentient 也不是圣人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I try not to think too hard about how they get made, actually... but anyway. You're right. They shouldn't have been exploited. But they also shouldn't have waged war.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我其实不太愿意深究他们是如何被制造出来的……但无论如何。你说得对。他们不应该被剥削。但他们也不应该发动战争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: One of them named Erra - the brother to the Lotus who sent me here - teamed up with Ballas, chief asshole Orokin, and took over the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其中一个叫 Erra 的人——他是送我来这里的 Lotus 的弟弟——与奥罗金的混蛋首领 Ballas 联手，占领了始源星系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Created these veils that literally brainwashed people. Turned them all into mindless servants to "Narmer."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 制造了这些能真正给人们洗脑的面障。把他们全都变成了"合一众"的无脑仆从。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Little by little. One by one. One veil at a time. One city at a time. One planet at a time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 一点一点来。一个接一个。每次拆一个面障。每次救一座城市。每次救一颗星球。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I didn't do it alone. Even enemies like the Corpus or Grineer realized we all had a common foe. Even Erra's father helped me. Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我并不是孤军奋战。即使是 Corpus 或 Grineer 这样的敌人也意识到我们有一个共同的敌人。甚至 Erra 的父亲也帮助了我。他叫 Hunhow。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Some friendships have stayed strong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有些友情还是很坚固的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... The more things change, the more they stay the same...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……万变不离其宗……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: People are going to people. No matter how hard you wish they wouldn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 人总是会按照人的本性行事，无论你多么希望他们不这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No... it's not my first warzone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不……这不是我第一次在战区。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All warzones are different. But the looks in their eyes are the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 每个战区都不同。但他们的眼神却是相同的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll tell you. But what's in it for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我会告诉你。但这对我有什么好处呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean. Sure. But it's a lot to get into at once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是。当然可以。但一下子要讲的东西太多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm going to have to pass, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我还是不聊了，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好呀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm not in the mood for this right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我现在没心情聊这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So, as far as I can tell, kavats, which is what Kalymos is, evolved from your "cats" which are smaller.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么，据我所知，库娃，也就是卡利莫斯，是从体型较小的"猫"进化而来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think Kalymos had enough of Entrati's shit, honestly. Like a lot of people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说，我觉得卡利莫斯已经受够了英择谛的那些破事。就像很多人一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's possible? I mean, she's a kavat. They're always a *little* shifty, right? Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有这种可能？我的意思是，它毕竟是只库娃。它们总是有*那么点*狡猾的，对吧？哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean, "cats" are always a little shifty, right? Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，"猫"总是有那么点狡猾的，对吧？哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: If you were Entrati's pet, wouldn't you be over his shit, too?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果你是英择谛的宠物，你也会对他的所作所为感到不满吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean... Entrati has made animals with human intelligence before. But usually they talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是……英择谛以前也创造过具有人类智力的动物。但它们通常都会说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: They're called the Cavia. But I'm sure if Kalymos was one of them, she'd have let us know by now... right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 它们被称为科维兽。但我敢肯定，如果卡利莫斯是其中之一，她应该早就让我们知道了……对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think she's just as smart as we are. She's just playing it cool, and I'm not going to confront her about it because I like having a face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得她和我们一样聪明。她只是在装酷，我不打算去和她对峙，因为我还想保住我的脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sure if Kalymos was that intelligent, she'd have let us know by now... right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定，如果卡利莫斯有那么聪明，她应该早就让我们知道了……对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I love kavats, though. Smart, graceful. They love you because *they* choose to. Kubrows - dogs, sorry - are way more programmed to be that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不过，我喜欢库娃。聪明、优雅。它们爱你是因为它们选择爱你。库狛——不好意思，是狗——它们天生就是那样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm with you. I'm such a kubrow - sorry, dog - person, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我同意你的观点。我也是个爱库狛——不好意思，是爱狗——的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know. I know what it's like to be used and neglected. If she wants to stay? She has a warm bed and as many scritches from me as she wants.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。我知道被利用和被忽视是什么感觉。如果她想留下来？她可以有个温暖的床位，还有我随时给她挠痒痒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sage advice. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 明智的建议。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think you're asking me about Kalymos? Honestly, I'm not sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是在问我关于卡利莫斯的事吗？老实说，我也不太清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do you mean the fact that she's a giant cat monster, or her deal specifically?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是指她是只巨型猫怪物，还是她的具体情况？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: BRB, gotta go feed the giant freaky hairless cat monster. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 马上回来，得去喂那只巨大怪异的无毛猫怪物。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Did... you mean to click on Lettie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你……刚刚是想发给莱蒂吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You've lost me, Q. What're we talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你把我弄糊涂了，昆。我们在谈论什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Nope. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。我不干。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: *Sweet.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: *很好。*

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hah hah... yeah. I was... totally making a joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈……是。我……完全是在开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What were you *actually* going to ask me about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你*实际上*要问我什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Great. Um... What're we talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 太好了。嗯……我们在说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Nah. You're a classy rental. Or at least mid-grade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。你可是高档租车。或者至少是中档的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I have plenty of rides to choose from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我有很多座驾可以选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: There's... something of them left. It's hard to describe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们……还是有些东西留下了。很难形容。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't want to have this conversation. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不想讨论这个问题。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Memories, almost? Bits and pieces of a personality.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 像是记忆？还有些零星的性格。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: When I inhabit them, I can feel myself taking on... parts of who they used to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当我进入他们时，我能感觉到自己在吸收……他们曾经的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Mannerisms. The way they used to stand. Move. Things like that. It's strange.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们曾经的举止、站姿、动作。诸如此类。感觉很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Least weird part about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这已经是最不奇怪的部分了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lines like that are pretty blurry anyway, when you get down to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 仔细想想，这种界限本来就挺模糊的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: He's trying to save the world. The Origin System. Hell, the *universe.* It's going to require a little spilled milk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他在试图拯救世界。拯救始源星系。甚至，拯救*宇宙*。这过程难免会有点小牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Probably for the same reason he does everything - scientific curiosity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 可能他做每件事都是出于同一个原因——对科学的好奇心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You're asking me to try to guess why Entrati does anything? Might as well ask Eleanor to read your cards.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 让我猜英择谛的动机？还不如直接让埃莉诺帮你看塔罗牌呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I can only guess but... I'm betting he wanted to make sure I had warframes in this timeline that I could use.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只能猜测，但是……我赌他是想确保在这个时间线里有可以使用的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Just in case mine didn't come through or... something. He always has backup plans on backup plans.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 以防我的没能成功，或者……发生了什么。他总是有一套接一套的备用计划。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Could be worse. You're a sexy, badass, *sniper* with *super powers.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 也没那么糟吧。你可是个性感、厉害、拥有*超能力*的*狙击手*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What *did* happen to you in the army, anyway? You have this whole... "toy soldier" thing you keep bringing up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 话说你在军队底经历了什么？你总是提到那个"玩具士兵"的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's the protoframe equivalent of a sock on a doorknob?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 原型战甲的"请勿打扰"信号是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: .... No promises.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……我不敢保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lol. Yessir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。好的，先生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ...I've never wanted to use Transference more in my life...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……我这辈子第一次这么想用传识……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Awwuh... fine. You're seriously no fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 噢……好吧。你真的一点也不好玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All right. Gotta finally ask. What's up with the photography?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我终于得问一问了。你为什么这么喜欢摄影呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What did you want to do? Back before... all this happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你以前想做什么？在……这一切发生之前？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I just really love some of the pictures you've taken. They're gorgeous work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的很喜欢你拍的一些照片。它们拍得太美了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm just really curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只是真的很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was wondering where you picked it up from, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只是想知道你是从哪里学的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You just don't strike me as the photography type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 在我看来，你不像是一个玩摄影的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You should take my picture sometime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你有时间的话应该给我拍张照。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think that's... really cool, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得那......实际上真的很酷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You seem to be taking the whole "stuck here forever" thing well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你看起来很好地接受了"永远被困在这里"这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You haven't talked much about your family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你没怎么提过你的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do you still talk to them? We have phones. KIM.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你和她们还有保持联系吗？我们有电话、即时通。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do they at least know you're okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 她们至少知道你没事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You must miss them...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你一定很想念她们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: At least you all have each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 至少你们还彼此拥有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: They'll... settle. I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们会……适应的。我确信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do you need to talk it out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 需要倾诉一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: LOL. Sorry. Wasn't my intention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈，抱歉。我不是故意的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll try to avoid heavy subjects next time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 下次我会尽量避免聊沉重的话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: With or without clothes is your call. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 穿不穿衣服你说了算。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Not sure if you do many portraits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不知道你是不是经常拍人像照。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Mm. Still haven't decided yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯。还没有决定好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Just playing around. Still not into the flirting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 只是玩玩而已。我还是对调情没兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Decided I think I like this. Let's keep this up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 决定了，我想我会喜欢这样。让我们继续下去吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: BRB. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 马上回来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... am... so extremely lost right now, Quincy. What're you talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，我……现在……完全搞不懂。你在说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you telling me to stop flirting with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是叫我别再跟你调情了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You... want to give me dating advice... on the other Hex... for. A *another* fee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你……想给我关于六人组其他人的……约会建议。还要*再*收费？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's the fee *this* time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: *这次*的费用是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's the fee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 费用是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You... want to give me dating advice... on the other Hex... for. A price?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你……想给我关于六人组其他人的……约会建议……还要收费？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is such a bizarre and honestly gross situation. I'm out. And. Honestly? No more flirting. Done. We're done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这真是个离谱而且恶心的情况。我退出。而且。说实话？别再调情了。结束了。我们结束了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But the one I have feelings for is *you,* Quincy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但我喜欢的人是*你*，昆西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No, I mean I have *feelings* for you, not just an attraction to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，我的意思是我*喜欢*你，不仅仅是单纯的被你吸引。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I mean, you do make great eye candy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是啊。我是说，你确实很养眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Quincy, did you read what I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你看明白我说的话了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But you haven't used the first favor yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但你还没用掉第一个人情呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is making me nervous. No. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这让我有点紧张。不行。我不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Fine... I could use the help...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 很好……我接受帮助……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't... I don't think that's how that works... No. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不……我不觉得这样行得通……不。我不要了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay, fine. I can use the advice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，没问题。我接受建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey, Quincy - how're you holding up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿，昆西，你最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So. Have you and Amir settled your differences?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以，你和阿米尔的分歧解决了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Anything I can help with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I assume you're talking about Amir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我猜你说的是阿米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I thought you two were doing better, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我以为你们现在的关系变好了呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's going on between you two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你们俩怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, have you actually sat down and *talked* to him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你有没有真的坐下来跟他*谈过*呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You two are adults. Work it out between yourselves. I'm not your babysitter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你们都是成年人了。你们自己想办法吧，我不是你们的保姆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How can I help? Talk me through it. I'll even listen for free.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我能帮上什么忙？跟我讲讲吧。我甚至愿意免费听你倾诉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... What?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I take that as a no?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我就当这是个"没有"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I really don't know how to do the whole... people thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的不知道该如何……与人相处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: "Space trauma," remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 还记得"太空创伤"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, screw me for trying to care. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，真是自讨苦吃，居然试着去关心别人。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: He might think you still have problems with him. Even with what happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他可能觉得你还是对他有意见。尽管发生了那些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: For someone who teases me for not knowing how to navigate society... you don't do feelings much, do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对于一个总是嘲笑我不知道如何融入社会的人……你似乎也不太擅长处理情感，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I try to. If I can. Sometimes, it's easier than others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力。如果可以的话。有时候会比较容易。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I can't tell if you're making fun of me or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我搞不清楚你是不是在取笑我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's the only way I know how to really make a difference in the world. Because no matter how many times I shoot people, they just seem to keep coming back. So...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这是我所知道的唯一能真正改变世界的方法。因为无论我对人开多少次枪，那些人好像总能回来。所以……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yep. But Amir was showing me how copy machines work. You know how when you copy a copy it comes out a little worse?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有。但阿米尔向我展示过复印机的工作原理。你知道，复印件的效果会差一点吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually? Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说？有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Basically my thought process.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 基本上就是这个意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think you're still just a little harsh on him, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说，我认为你对他还是太严厉了一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: LOL. Noted. Secret's safe with me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈。我记住了。我会守口如瓶的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You're no fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真是没意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, I'm hoping that the people who care about him can help him through that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我希望关心他的人可以帮助他度过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Darkness?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 黑暗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Amir is a grown adult, Quincy. You don't need to constantly belittle him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，阿米尔是个成年人了。你没必要总是小看他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Would you ever be willing to talk to him about what you went through? It might help him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你愿意跟他谈谈你的经历吗？这也许能帮到他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, at least you've moved past making fun of him about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，至少你不再拿他的事情开玩笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I honestly think it might. Just try not to be *too* much of your usual self while you're talking to him. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的这么认为。只是和他谈话时尽量别*太*做平时的自己。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: On second thought... no, it might be patronizing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不过想了想……还是算了，可能会显得有点居高临下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, at least you've moved past making fun of him about it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，至少你不再拿他的事情开玩笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Would you ever be willing to talk to him about what you went through? It might help him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你愿意跟他谈谈你的经历吗？这也许能帮到他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I honestly think it might. Just try not to be *too* much of your usual self while you're talking to him. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的这么认为。只是和他谈话时尽量别*太*做平时的自己。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: On second thought... no, it might be patronizing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不过想了想……还是算了，可能会显得有点居高临下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So. What made you want to go into the army and become a sniper?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么，是什么原因让你选择参军并成为狙击手的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So... when're you going to tell me the story about how you ended up as one of the Hex?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么……你什么时候才能告诉我，你是如何加入六人组的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So... is now a good time to ask about how you ended up as one of the Hex?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么……现在是问你如何加入六人组的好时机吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Good. You?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 很好。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm suspicious, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我现在有些怀疑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Great. Are you going to answer my question? lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好得很。你会回答我的问题吗？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Is there another story you can tell me you *do* have time for?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有没有其他故事是你现在*有时间*讲的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you sure? I feel like I've heard that before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？我好像以前听过这话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Tomorrow it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那就明天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm just curious, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只是好奇，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: We don't have to talk about it, if you don't want to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果你不想谈，我们可以不谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: *More* favors?! What would this be now, four?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: *更多*的人情？！现在已经是多少个来着，四个了吧？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: *More* favors?! What would this be now, three?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: *更多*的人情？！现在已经是多少个来着，三个了吧？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Another favor? This makes two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 又一个人情？这就算两个了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What... kind of fee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 怎么……收费？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Didn't figure you for a statistics and math guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没想到你是个擅长统计和数学的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Doesn't mean the coin is magic, But it might mean it's weighted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这并不意味着硬币有魔力，但可能意味着它被做了手脚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, tomorrow it is, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，那就明天吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Really? I would've expected you to go into photography or something like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？我还以为你会去学摄影之类的专业。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The army pays for college here?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这里的军队会付大学学费？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure. We've gotten this far. What's the worst that can happen?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当然。我们都已经走到这一步了。最坏的情况还能是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. Pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I still can't quite figure out what you *are* going to use them for...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我还真猜不出你*要*用它们来做什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No, I just know this isn't going to go well for me later.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，我只知道这对我以后不会有什么好结果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You better not make me regret this later.... Fine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你最好别让我以后会后悔……好吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Did you want to study photography?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你当时想学摄影吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What did you want to study?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你当时想学什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Who screwed it up for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是谁搞砸了你的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What happened?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Did you get kicked out of the army?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你被踢出军队了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sounds like a story for another day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这听起来像是另一个故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What'd Arthur do...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟做了什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Why do you keep doing this? Seriously? Can't we just *talk?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你为什么总这样做？真的？我们就不能只是*聊聊*吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't charge you favors when I tell you things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我讲故事给你听，从不要求你回报。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But we're together, aren't we? Doesn't that change anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但我们是在一起的，不是吗？这难道不能改变什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But we're friends, aren't we? Doesn't that change anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但我们是朋友，不是吗？这难道不能改变什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do you ever wonder why the other Hex members aren't very close to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你有没有想过为什么其他的六人组成员和你不太亲近？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How could I say no to that? lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我怎么忍心说不在呢？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was about to step away, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我正要离开，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey regular trauma. What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿，普通创伤。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey. :)
Can't chat right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 现在没空聊，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure. Fire away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当然可以。问吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay, but it'll cost you. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 可以，但是你得给点好处。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Not at the moment. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 现在不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay, then I propose a trade. You tell me the story of how you joined the Hex? And I'll answer your questions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，那我提一个交易。你告诉我你是怎么加入六人组的？然后我就回答你的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay, then I propose a trade. You finally tell me the story of how you joined the Hex? And I'll answer your questions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，那我提一个交易。你最后告诉我你是怎么加入六人组的？然后我就回答你的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Right, but you still owe me that story of how you joined the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没错，但你还欠我一个关于你加入六人组的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All right. Deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I really hate it when you start playing these games. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的很讨厌你开始耍这些把戏。我不奉陪了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: If you don't want to tell me that story, I won't force it out of you. So I'll answer your questions, and you can just tell me when you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果你不想讲那个故事，我不会强迫你。我会回答你的问题，你什么时候想讲就什么时候讲吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What did you want to talk about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你想聊什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It made you who you are, so I appreciate hearing about it, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这些经历塑造了你，所以我还是很感激能听你讲这些的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Dangerous. And crowded. We were all packed in tight, and everybody was after what everyone else had.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 很危险。也很拥挤。我们都挤在一起，每个人都在追逐别人拥有的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Dangerous. But quiet. It wasn't the people we worried about - it was the *other* things that scared us more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 很危险。但很安静。我们担心的不是人——而是*其他*让我们更害怕的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Safe. But crowded. Even before the Zariman, we had almost no room to ourselves. But we were a community.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 安全。但很拥挤。即使在扎里曼号之前，我们几乎没有自己的空间。但我们是一个社区。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Safe and quiet. But I didn't really know anybody. We lived pretty remote from everyone else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 安静又安全。但其实我几乎不认识任何人。我们住得离其他人都挺远的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Anything but "posh" lol. It was the middle of nowhere. We worked the fields and grew crops.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 一点也不"上流"，哈哈。简直是无人区。我们种地，种庄稼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: My parents were rich. So. "Posh."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的父母很富有。所以。算是"社会上流"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I learned that everything can be gone in a second. So be grateful for what you have when you have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我学到了一切都可能会在一瞬间消失。所以当你拥有时，要心存感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Honestly? I miss it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说？我挺怀念的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I learned that life is about the people you have in it. Everything else is temporary at best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我学到了生命的意义在于你身边的人。其他的一切都不过是暂时的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I haven't been avoiding it on purpose. What do you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我没有故意回避这个话题。你想知道什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's because I am *so sick* of talking about Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这是因为我*厌倦*了谈论双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Honestly, I just haven't felt like talking about it with them. But I'll tell you. What do you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说，我只是不想和他们谈论这件事。但我会告诉你。你想知道什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And you think that if I really am avoiding talking about it this entire time, I'm going to tell *you* about it now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你如果觉得我一直在避免谈论这件事，我会现在告诉*你*吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It might be because I *hate* talking about Duviri. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 可能是因为我*讨厌*谈论双衍王境。我不说了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Everybody just wants to know all about it because it's weird and wacky. They don't care what it did to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 每个人都想知道这一切，因为它很怪异也很猎奇。他们不在乎这对我造成了什么影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't like talking about that place, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不喜欢谈论那个地方，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't like being poked at like I'm some kind of circus freak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不喜欢被当作马戏团怪胎那样戳来戳去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh gross, no. Thrax is just a kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦，不，太恶心了。士魂大帝只是个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No, it's fine. Thrax is just a kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不用，没事的。士魂大帝只是个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I've told you the basics. That's enough, isn't it?
