/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我已经把基本情况告诉你了，这还不够吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was trapped for untold centuries in an infinitely looping dimension where I was subject to torture and murder at the hands of a child despot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我在一个无限循环的维度里，被困了无数个世纪，在那里我遭到一个孩童暴君的折磨和杀害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. I don't care. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，我不在乎。我走了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Who, by the way, was a creation of my own memories when the Void reached into my mind and pulled out fragments of a storybook.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 顺便说一句，这个暴君是虚空触碰我的脑海并从中提取出故事书片段创造的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Dominus Thrax and I... used to be friends, long ago. When I was closer to his "age."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 士魂大帝和我……很久以前是朋友。那时我和他"年纪"相仿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I hate Dominus Thrax. And I think a part of me, somewhere deep down, always knew he was going to hurt me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我恨士魂大帝。我觉得我内心深处的某个部分一直都知道他会伤害我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: At first, he was the best friend a kid could have. He was the KING of the WORLD. And I was his best friend in the universe. He gave me everything I could ever want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 起初，他是孩子能有的最好的朋友。他是整个世界的王。而我是他宇宙中最好的朋友。他给了我想要的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was safe again like I was when I was a kid. And I had a *community* again. People around me who valued me. Cared about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我再次感到安全，就像小时候一样。我再次拥有了一个*社区*。我周围的人都很重视我。关心我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I felt safe for the first time in my *life.* I was surrounded by a community like I had when I was young, though - but this one cared about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我*有生以来*第一次感到安全。我身边有一个社区，就像我小时候那样——不过这个社区是真正在乎我的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I felt safe for the first time in my *life.* But unlike when I was a kid, I had a community. I had a society around me that valued me. Cared about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我*有生以来*第一次感到安全。但与小时候不同，我有了一个社区。我身边有一个重视我、关心我的社区。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I felt safe again, like when I was a kid. But unlike when I was a kid, I had a community. I had a society around me that valued me. Cared about me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我再次感到安全，就像小时候一样，但与小时候不同的是，我有了一个社区。我身边有一个重视我、关心我的社区。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I felt safe. I had a community around me. I felt valued. Cared for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我感到很安全。我身边有一个社区。我感到自己受到重视。受到关心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And Thrax was the avatar of all of that. But as I grew older, and changed... he didn't. I needed him less. But the little kid's storybook he was based on didn't evolve.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 而士魂大帝就是这一切的化身。但随着我长大，也开始逐渐改变……他却没有。我不再需要他了。但他所基于的那本小孩子的故事书并没有进化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: *Couldn't* evolve. I... wanted to leave Duviri. He didn't take that well, to say the least. And that's when the executions started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: *不能*进化。我……想离开双衍王境。至少可以说，他对此不太能接受。就在这时，处决开始了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All because one scared kid, imaginary or not, was afraid of being left alone in the dark by his best friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是因为一个害怕被他最好的朋友单独留在黑暗中的小孩，无论他是不是虚构的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All because of a storybook that the Void couldn't turn the page on like a CD on repeat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是因为一本书，而虚空无法翻到下一页，就像一张不断重复的 CD。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All because a spoiled brat of a king couldn't take "no" for an answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是因为一个被宠坏的小国王，无法接受"不"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I think he's as real as anyone else, even if he wasn't "born" in a conventional sense. As for a soul? Maybe? Yes? I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有吧。我觉得他和其他人一样真实，尽管他不是以传统方式"出生"的。至于灵魂？可能有？是吧？我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... honestly don't know. Strange things come in and out of the Void. It's possible there's a soul in there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……说实话，我不知道。虚空中总有奇怪的东西进进出出。那里有灵魂也说不定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. He's not *real.* He has emotions the same way characters in any book do. It's just all pretend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。他不是*真实*的。他的情感和书中的人物一样。这都是假装的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I honestly don't know. Life went a different way. It's impossible to say what I would or wouldn't have done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说，我不知道。生活轨迹发生了改变。没法说我会或不会做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I mean. He's not *real.* Once you finish a book, do you feel bad for it when you put it on a shelf?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯。我的意思是。他不是*真实的*。当你读完一本书，把它放在书架上时，你会为它感到难过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. I would've gone back. I still go back fairly frequently to Duviri, even after all he's done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不会。我会回去的。即使在他做了那些事之后，我仍然会经常回到双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Not if I can help it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果我可以避免，就不回去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I do. From time to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的，我会。不时地回去看看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because... I guess part of me understands. I was that scared kid, screaming in the dark. Begging not to be abandoned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为……我想我多少能理解一点。我曾是那个害怕的孩子，在黑暗中尖叫。乞求不被抛弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I honestly don't know. Maybe it's pity. Or maybe it's because in some sick way, it feels like home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老实说我不知道。可能是出于同情。或者可能是因为，从某种病态的角度来说，它让我感觉像家一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Teshin is trapped there. I feel bad abandoning him. Everybody else I care less about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: Teshin 被困在那里。我觉得丢下他过意不去。其他人我就没那么在乎了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: A mentor of mine. He fell into Duviri from the Origin System, and is a big part of the reason I escaped. He's trapped there, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的一位导师。他从始源星系落入双衍王境，是我逃脱的重要原因之一。不过他被困在那里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. You're not kidding.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的。你说得没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sorry. I'm not exactly *trying* to do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对不起。我并不是*故意*这么做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... get what you're saying, but I still have to disagree. Sorry. But thanks for the talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……明白你的意思，但我还是不同意。抱歉。不过还是谢谢你这次的谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah... yeah it does. Thanks, Quincy. I'll remember this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的……确实如此。昆西，谢谢你。我会记住这个的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's not a pleasant place for me to visit. Too many bad memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对我来说这不是一个令人愉快的地方。有太多不好的回忆了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't need it anymore. There's nothing of value, so why go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不再需要它了。那里没有什么值得的，为什么还要去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Major corpo? What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 大公司？你指的是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Corpo, meaning corporate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 公司，是企业的意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Why are you asking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你为什么这么问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Happy? I don't really know the guy, Q. We don't hang out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 幸福？昆，我真的不太了解那个人。我们又不来往。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't have time to get into this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我没空聊这个。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't have time to get into this, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我没空聊这个，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually, yes. Parvos Granum, the head of the Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实有。帕尔沃斯·格拉努，Corpus 的头儿

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think the people who say money doesn't buy happiness aren't being creative enough.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得那些说金钱买不到幸福的人缺乏创造力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Seems to be from what I can tell. He has some people who support him for more reasons than seemingly *just* the cash.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 据我所知似乎是这样的。有些人支持他的原因似乎不*只是*金钱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't think money can buy you happiness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不认为金钱能买到幸福。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: He has these sisters that he trains up to surround himself with. And I can tell he actually takes pride in them. Thinks of them as family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他训练这些姐妹们，让她们围绕在他身边。我可以看出他真的为她们感到骄傲。把她们当作家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: There's a lady, Vala Glarios. Was just one of his underlings, originally. But she went down with her ships, canons blazing, screaming defiance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有个女人，薇拉·格拉里斯。原本只是他的一个下属。她与她的船一起被击落，炮火轰鸣，怒吼着抗争到底

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: He opened up a pocket of the Void that he, well, it's a long story, not important. He saved her life. I think he honestly appreciates her. Values her. Thinks of her as a sister.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他打开了一个虚空口袋，嗯，这是一个很长的故事，不重要。他救了她的命。我觉得他真的很欣赏她。重视她。把她当作姐姐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And I think she looks at him like family in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想她也把他当作家人看待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's a little culty, honestly. But what're you going to do? That's how money is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说实话，这有点像邪教。但你能怎么办呢？钱就是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I really don't like how much you sound like this guy. There's more to life than money.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的不喜欢你听起来这么像那个家伙。生命中除了金钱还有更重要的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You two would definitely get along. Way too much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你们俩肯定会相处得很好。太像了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It doesn't mean he isn't a cutthroat and an asshole. I don't trust him as far as I can throw him, and his people are always getting in the way of my guns.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这并不意味着他不是一个冷酷无情的混蛋。我无论如何都不会相信他，他的人总是妨碍我的行动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I really don't agree with his position on strip-mining the universe. I prefer trying to help out the people who need it rather than focusing on pure greed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的不认同他对剥削宇宙的看法。我更喜欢帮助需要帮助的人，而不是单纯追求贪婪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: He's doing what he has to do to survive. I can respect that. Even if it usually means we're on opposite sides.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他为了生存做了他该做的事。我可以尊重这一点。即使这通常意味着我们站在对立面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: He only keeps people around him for as long as those people maintain value. I'm sure they'll be gone the moment they're a burden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他只会将那些对他有价值的人留在他身边。我敢肯定，一旦这些人成为累赘，他们马上就会被抛弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So you'd want to be rich for yourself?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以你想变富有是为了自己？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This all still just comes down to sheer greed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这一切归根到底还是纯粹的贪婪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So you'd want to be rich for other people?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以你想变富有是为了别人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我没时间，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah? What've you got for me today?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯？今天你有什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think so, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得有，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... honestly don't know, Q.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……其实不知道，昆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. This is just Void science.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，这只是虚空科学。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Having an existential crisis?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 在怀疑人生吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You okay?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Q?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Whatever you call it, whatever the explanation, I'm kind of living proof that consciousness exists without a body, yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不管你怎么称呼它，不管有什么解释，我有点像是没有身体也能存在意识的证明，是吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I still don't think there's a soul, Q. I think my body just takes a different form - matter turning to energy temporarily. Otherwise how would I get it back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆，我还是不认为有灵魂。我认为我的身体只是以不同的形式存在——暂时从物质转化为能量。否则我怎么能够恢复它呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Again, I don't *know* if there's a soul. You're jumping to conclusions. There's a lot about how all this "works" that we don't understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 再说一遍，我不*知道*是否有灵魂。你这是在妄下结论。关于这一切是如何"运作"的，我们还有很多不理解的地方

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do people tend to assume you aren't well read or something?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 人们通常会以为你不太爱读书吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What other kinds of books do you like to read?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你还喜欢看什么类型的书？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I've got a few tablets you can borrow if you want, from the Zariman. Science advanced a bit between now and my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果你想的话，我有几块从扎里曼号上带来的平板可以借给你。从现在到我的时代，科学进步了一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sorry if I ever treated you that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果我曾经这样对待过你，我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Have I ever treated you that way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我有这样对待过你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Just let me know if I step out of line. I give you full permission to smack me upside the head.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果我越界了，就告诉我。我允许你敲我的头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Can I just say that I'm glad we're together?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我能说我很高兴我们在一起吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Can I just say that I'm glad we're friends?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我能说我很高兴我们是朋友吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: LOL! That's hysterical.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈！太搞笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well? What'd you think? LOL
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯？你觉得怎么样？哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Do you still read romance stories now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你现在还在看言情小说吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: That's the best story I've literally ever heard. LOL
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这是我听过的最好的故事。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm suddenly suspicious....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我突然觉得不太对劲……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Aw. Thanks Q. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 啊。谢谢昆。 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But the one I have feelings for is *you,* Quincy...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但我喜欢的人是*你*，昆西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is such a bizarre and honestly gross situation. I'm out. And. Honestly? No more flirting. Done. We're done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这真是个离谱而且恶心的情况。我退出。而且。说实话？别再调情了。结束了。我们结束了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You... want to give me dating advice... on the other Hex... for. A price?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你……想给我关于六人组其他人的……约会建议……还要收费？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's the fee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 费用是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What's the fee *this* time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: *这次*的费用是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You... want to give me dating advice... on the other Hex... for. A *another* fee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你……想给我关于六人组其他人的……约会建议。还要*再*收费？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But you haven't used the other favor yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但你还没用掉第一个人情呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is making me nervous. No. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这让我有点紧张。不行。我不要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Fine... I could use the help...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 很好……我接受帮助……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't... I don't think that's how that works... No. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不……我不觉得这样行得通……不。我不要了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay, fine. I can use the advice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，没问题。我接受建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No, I mean I have *feelings* for you, not just an attraction to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，我的意思是我*喜欢*你，不仅仅是单纯的被你吸引。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I mean, you do make great eye candy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是啊。我是说，你确实很养眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Quincy, did you read what I said?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，你看明白我说的话了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The answer is still no. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 答案还是不要。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay...fine. I'm getting desperate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧……我接受。我越来越绝望了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's... not going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上……进展得不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's... not going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上……进展得不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's... not going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上……进展得不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's... not going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上……进展得不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's... not going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上……进展得不太好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's going great, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 实际上，挺好的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Quick question. How much social currency have I earned with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 简单问一下。我在你这里的积累了多少人情分？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey... Quincy? You like me now... right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿……昆西？你现在是喜欢我的……对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hey... sweetheart? You like me now, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿……亲爱的？你现在是喜欢我的……对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, okay... look. Amir's putting together this game of Fables & Frontiers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧……你看。阿米尔正在组织一场寓言与边疆游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm hoping I can convince you to change your mind about Amir's RPG game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我希望我能说服你改变对阿米尔的角色扮演游戏的看法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So, look... I know I asked you before, but things have changed with the team. This is about Amir and his F&F game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你看……我知道我之前问过你，但是团队的情况也变了。这是关于阿米尔和他的寓言与边疆游戏的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Amir's putting together a tabletop game, and it's an excuse for us all to hang out and be together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔正在组织一场桌游，这是我们大家一起出来玩的好机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You know. Laugh, hang out, drink, eat some snacks, have a good time. And it'd mean a lot to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你知道的。一起笑、一起玩、一起喝酒、一起吃零食，玩得开心。这对他来说意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I know the dorky shit isn't your speed, but I bet you'd have more fun than you think you would if you tried it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我知道这种宅男的东西不是你的菜，但我敢打赌如果你尝试一下，你会发现这比你想象的更有趣

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: (Don't tell him I said this but I think he looks up to you in secret.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: （别告诉他我这么说，但我认为他暗地里很尊敬你。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Can I talk you into trying it for one night? Then if you hate it, you can stop.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我可以说服你试一晚吗？如果你不喜欢它，你可以不玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lettie's playing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂会来玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Arthur's in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟会来玩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: LOL. Arthur's playing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈，亚瑟会玩的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Amir got the go-ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔得到了批准。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Nobody.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 谁也没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You're worrying me, what's going on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你这么说让我有点担心，出了什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Okay... What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧……你需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't deal well with being cornered. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不喜欢被逼到墙角的情况。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What the hell is your problem today? Fine. What do you want?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你今天到底有什么问题？好吧。你想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The only thing I like less than being cornered? Ultimatums. I'm out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 比被逼到墙角更让我讨厌的是什么？最后通牒。我不干了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Why do you want to hate me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你为什么想要恨我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you trying to get blackmail on me..?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是想勒索我吗……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What in the name of the Void is wrong with you? Why?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 虚空啊，你到底怎么了？为什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. Screw this. I'm out. If this ends our conversations, I don't care. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。去他的。我不干了。如果这会让我们没法再聊下去，我也无所谓。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Bullshit. You want to make you hate me. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 胡说。你就是想找理由恨我。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So this is about you having a story to use against me? Seriously?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以你这是想要一个可以用来对付我的故事吗？真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What? If you've decided you want to hate me, for whatever reason, that's your right. So. Ok.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 什么？如果你出于某种原因决定恨我，那是你的权利。所以。好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Maybe it's for blackmail. Maybe it's because you want to protect yourself. I don't know. I don't care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 也许是为了勒索，也许是因为你想保护自己。我不知道。我不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because at the end of the day? I don't control you. And you make your own decisions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为归根结底？我不能控制你。你得自己做决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because at the end of the day? I trust you. I guess more than you trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为归根结底？我信任你。我想比你信任我还要多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Either you're lying to me or to yourself. Which is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你要么在骗我，要么在骗你自己。到底是哪个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So this is *really* just about petty blackmail. I'm disappointed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以这*真的*只是些小打小闹的勒索。真让我失望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You push everybody away. Even now, even after everything, you're distant. You're doing this to push me away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你把所有人都推开。即使现在，即使经历了这一切，你还是疏远我。你这样做就是为了把我推开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Honesty is important to you, isn't it? Has been from the start. I've shown you honesty. So show me some in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 诚实对你来说很重要，不是吗？从一开始就是。我已经向你展示了诚实。所以请你也向我展示一些诚实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: There's more to you than you like to let people see. You want people to think you're cold. But you're not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你身上还有许多你不愿让别人看到的特质。你想让人们觉得你冷酷无情。但你不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You *know* how I feel about you. You know how much I care. And you ignored me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你明明*知道*我对你的感情。你知道我有多在乎你。但你却无视我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You've been hiding the real Quincy from me this entire time. And if you don't think I know that? You must think I'm an idiot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你一直在向我隐藏真正的昆西。如果你觉得我不知道？你一定以为我是傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know why you want to hate me, but it's clear that you *do.* So fine. Fine. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道你为什么想要恨我，但很明显你确实*想要恨我*。那好吧。好吧。我们开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So you think that if you have a genuine connection to someone... you're... in debt to them. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以你认为如果你和某人建立了关系……你就会……欠他们了。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You would make one *hell* of a Corpus commander. They'd love you. You'd have no problem crushing the Solari under your boot and collecting their limbs for debts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真的可以成为一名出色的 Corpus 指挥官。他们会喜欢你的。毫不犹豫地用靴子踩死索拉里斯人并收集他们的肢体来偿还债务，对你来说不成问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. You want to hate me so you can stay alone, because alone is *safe.* Because then nobody can hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不。你想恨我，这样你就可以独自一人，因为独自一人是*安全的*。因为那样就没人能伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because at the end of the day, I think you're just a scared, lonely little boy who has gone a long way on his looks and charm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为说到底，我认为你不过是一个害怕、孤独的小男孩，凭借自己的外表和魅力走到了今天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Fine. Fine! You want to hate me? Hate me. You want to know the worst thing I've ever done? I'll tell you. If it'll make you happy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧。好吧！你想恨我？那就恨我吧。你想知道我做过的最恶劣的事吗？我会告诉你的。如果这会让你开心的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't play games like this. I don't need this kind of shit in my life. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不玩这种游戏。我生活中不需要这种烂事。我退出。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You want to hate me? You want to drive me away? All right. I'll give you a reason to hate me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你想恨我？你想赶走我？好吧。我给你一个恨我的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Then we're done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那我们就完了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Whatever. You win. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 随便吧。你赢了。我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You're hiding. I know you are. You can play tough all you want. Play the ice man. But I know the truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你在掩饰。我知道你在掩饰。你可以装得再强硬，再冷酷无情。但我知道真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You really want to do this?! You want me to give you a reason to hate me? Fine. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真的想这么做吗？！你想让我给你一个恨我的理由？好啊。来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So you feel like if you let someone in far enough to see the real you, you... owe them? You're in debt to them? Is that it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是不是觉得如果你让某人足够深入地了解真正的你，你就会……欠他们了？觉得自己背了债？是这样的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You would make one *hell* of a Corpus commander. They'd love you. You'd have no problem crushing the Solari under your boot and collecting their limbs for debts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真的可以成为一名出色的 Corpus 指挥官。他们会喜欢你的。毫不犹豫地用靴子踩死索拉里斯人并收集他们的肢体来偿还债务，对你来说不成问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You would make one *hell* of a Corpus commander. They'd love you. You'd have no problem crushing the Solari under your boot and collecting their limbs for debts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真的可以成为一名出色的 Corpus 指挥官。他们会喜欢你的。毫不犹豫地用靴子踩死索拉里斯人并收集他们的肢体来偿还债务，对你来说不成问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So you think that if you have a genuine connection to someone... you're... in debt to them. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以你认为如果你和某人建立了关系……你就会……欠他们了。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You would make one *hell* of a Corpus commander. They'd love you. You'd have no problem crushing the Solari under your boot and collecting their limbs for debts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真的可以成为一名出色的 Corpus 指挥官。他们会喜欢你的。毫不犹豫地用靴子踩死索拉里斯人并收集他们的肢体来偿还债务，对你来说不成问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So you think that if you have a genuine connection to someone... you're... in debt to them. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以你认为如果你和某人建立了关系……你就会……欠他们了。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Too afraid to admit that he might actually have a *genuine connection* with someone because that means making himself *vulnerable.*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 太害怕承认他可能真的与某人建立了*真正的关系*，因为这意味着让自己变得*脆弱*。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't need to tell you a story to get you to hate me. I can get it done in two words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不需要讲一个故事让你恨我。我用三个字就可以做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't play games like this. I don't need this kind of shit in my life. I'm out. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不玩这种游戏。我生活中不需要这种烂事。我退出。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You want to hate me? You want to drive me away? All right. I'll give you a reason to hate me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你想恨我？你想赶走我？好吧。我给你一个恨我的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Grow. Up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 成。熟。点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Then we're done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那我们就完了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Whatever. You win. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 随便吧。你赢了。我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You want the story of the absolute worst thing I've ever done in my life? The most reprehensible and unforgivable thing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你想听我一生中最恶劣的事吗？最令人鄙视和最不可饶恕的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Here it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这就是真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And if that wasn't some part of my mind punishing me, over and over again, for what I'd done?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果那不是我内心因为我所做的事情一次又一次地惩罚我呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The thing that keeps me up at night, makes me stare at the ceiling and wonder if I didn't deserve all those executions in Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那些让我彻夜难眠、盯着天花板发呆的事情，让我怀疑自己是否真的该遭受双衍王境中所有那些处决？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I killed my parents.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我杀了我的父母。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I locked my parents up in a makeshift prison... and waited for them to die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我把我的父母关在一个临时的监狱里……等着他们死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I stood by and watched as my friends killed my parents.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我站在一旁，看着我的朋友们杀死了我的父母。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: When I was onboard the Zariman, and the Indifference arrived, it decided it wanted to perform a little experiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当我在扎里曼号上，虚空无情之物到来时，它决定做一个小实验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Could you really do the unthinkable? Make *parents* want to murder their own *children?*
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你真的能做出难以想象的事情吗？让*父母*想要杀死自己的*孩子*？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And... what would happen if you then armed the children with Void powers...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后……如果你给孩子们虚空的力量，会发生什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Would the children kill their own parents in self defense? Or would they let nature take its course? Would they rather rely on others to do the deed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 孩子们会为了自卫而杀死自己的父母吗？还是会任由事情发展？他们会依赖别人去做这件事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Or would they just... let their parents rip them to pieces like the blood-crazed creatures they'd been reduced to?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 还是只会……让他们的父母像那些疯狂嗜血怪物一样将他们撕碎？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And I spared some of my friends that fate that day in exchange. I don't know if I regret my choice or not. Sometimes I think I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 作为回报，那天我让一些朋友也摆脱了那种命运。我不知道我是否后悔我的选择。有时我觉得我后悔了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But then I remember the looks on the faces of those who chose to do the deed themselves and I think... no. There's a difference between cowardly and smart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但之后我想起了那些亲自动手的人脸上的表情，我觉得……不。懦弱和聪明之间是有区别的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sometimes I wonder if my choice was the cowardly one - letting my friends do the deed for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有时我会怀疑我的选择是不是懦弱的——我让朋友们替我动手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know if I regret not making it quick for them or not. Sometimes I do. Sometimes I think... no. I would have always given them that chance to snap out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道我是否后悔没有快点结束他们的生命。有时候我会后悔。有时候我又会想……不。我总想给他们机会清醒过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But then I realize that a quick death for them would've been a mercy for me. Watching them slowly die... as they screamed and foamed at the mouth and wore their limbs to bloody stumps in their desperate attempt to kill me...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但后来我意识到，让他们迅速死去对我来说反而是一种仁慈。看着他们慢慢死去……他们因为疯狂地想要杀死我，而尖叫、口吐白沫，将自己的四肢磨到血肉模糊……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sometimes I wonder if I was the coward. For locking them up and hoping they'd snap out of it. For watching themselves claw their hands to bone trying to escape their cage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有时我会想，我是不是懦夫。因为我把他们关起来，希望他们能清醒过来。因为我看着他们在笼子里挣扎，手指抓破到露出骨头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But then I remember all the kids who couldn't do it, and left their parents moldering in cages for however long it was until they got rescued. Watching them tear themselves to pieces like feral, mad animals. I don't know which is worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但后来我想起那些没能下手的孩子们，他们任由自己的父母在笼子里腐烂，直到被救出来。看着他们像疯狂的野兽一样把自己撕成碎片。我不知道哪个更糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sometimes I wonder what kind of monster a person has to be to kill their own parents. To look at their faces, twisted in anger and monstrous hunger and to end their lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有时候我会想，一个人得变成什么样的怪物才能杀死自己的父母。看着他们因愤怒和极度饥饿而扭曲的面孔，然后结束他们的生命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know if I regret killing them quickly. And not trying to save them like other people did. Or... letting someone else do the deed for me. Sometimes I think I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道自己是否后悔当初迅速杀了他们。没有像其他人那样试图拯救他们。或者……让别人替我动手。有时候我觉得我确实后悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is what it took from me that day. And that is what I will fight to keep alive. One idiot at a time, if I have to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这是那天它从我这里夺走的。也是我将要一次又一次地奋斗去保护的东西。如果必要的话，我会一次又一次地这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Because this connection? This is what the Indifference is trying to murder from the world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为这种关系？这正是虚空无情之物想要从这个世界上抹去的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: That's why I dedicate my life to doing exactly what you're afraid to do, Quincy. I let people in, when you shut people out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，这就是为什么我愿意拿命去做你不敢做的事。我向人敞开心扉，而你却将人推开。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But there is one where I did. Two, if you want to be exact. And in those two worlds... we can still make a difference for people. We can still help them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但有一个世界我活下来了。如果你要确切的说，有两个。在这两个世界里……我们仍然可以为人们带来改变。我们仍然可以帮助他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: But that's the thing about life, isn't it? You make choices. And you're always left wondering if you made the right ones. I do know this much - there's no world in which they survived the Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但这就是生活的意义，不是吗？你做出选择。你总是在怀疑，自己是否选对了。有一点我是确定的——无论在哪个世界，他们都不可能从虚空无情之物手上活下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Tah-dah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So. Do you hate me yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么。你现在恨我了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How was that? Or should I come kick you in the balls to top it off?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 感觉如何？还是我应该过来踢你的蛋蛋作为结束？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Which ones are you talking about?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你指哪些？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You're going to need to be a bit more specific.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你得说具体一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: BRB, one sec. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 稍等，马上回来。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Incarnons?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 灵化武器？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Primes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: Prime？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Shockingly, that doesn't narrow it down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 令人震惊的是，这并没有缩小范围。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Definitely incarnons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 绝对是灵化武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Everything's sci-fi when you come from the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当你来自未来时，一切都是科幻的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Incarnons are... weird. Even as my weapons go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 灵化武器是……很奇怪。哪怕是在我用的武器里也很特别。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Mine do. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的就这样。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Incarnons are Void-touched weapons. Melee and guns. They... react to energy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 灵化武器是接触过虚空的武器。有近战武器和枪械。它们……对能量有反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So, there's this guy on the Zariman. Named Cavalero. ... I suddenly have an overwhelming need to introduce you two.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是这样，扎里曼号上有个人。他叫卡瓦莱罗……我突然很想让你们认识一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Anyway. He started making these Void-touched weapons. Melee and guns. They react to energy. ...I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 话说回来。他开始制造这些接触过虚空的武器。近战武器和枪械。它们对能量有反应。……我猜的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, look. Just because I *use* Void power doesn't mean I always know how it all *works.* The weapons tap into the Void to do their transformation thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，你看。虽然我*使用*虚空的力量，但这并不意味着我完全懂它是怎么运作的。这些武器接入虚空进行变形。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean... I point the loud end away from my face. The rest I don't really have to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是……我会让枪口朝外，远离我的脸。其他的我不需要太在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Cavalero is one of the Holdfasts onboard the Zariman. A ghost, for lack of a better phrase. He's salty. In charge of the weaponry. Pretty much an asshole. You'd love him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 卡瓦莱罗是扎里曼号上的一名坚守者。一个幽灵，找不到更好的词来形容他。他脾气暴躁。负责管理武器。基本上是个讨厌鬼。你会喜欢他的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The Void... does a lot of weird... stuff. To a lot of things. It's... really hard to explain all the time. But you can think about it like...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 虚空……对很多东西都有一些奇怪的……作用。真的……很难每次都解释清楚。但你可以这么想……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: As far as I can tell, they feed off the energy of the enemies I kill with them. That's what lets them transform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 据我所知，它们能从我杀死的敌人那里吸取能量。这就是它们能够变形的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean I said "as far as I can tell." I just know that when I kill people with them in a certain way -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，我只是根据我所看到的说。我只知道当我以特定方式杀人时——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yes. My Void-powered weapons eat people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的。我的虚空武器会吃人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. I have no idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不行，我也不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I know how it works it's just hard to explain!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我知道它的工作原理，只是解释起来有点难！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah. I'm going to have to introduce you to Cavalero. "Void-fkery" is going to be the new name of his store...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯。我得介绍你认识卡瓦莱罗。"虚空邪术"将成为他的新店名……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Millenia of science and technological discoveries reduced to "Void-fkery."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 数千年的科学和技术成就被简化成了"虚空邪术"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I couldn't be happier. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不能更快乐了。 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know. I'm thinking I might have made the wrong choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。我在想我可能选错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It's by choice, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说实话，这是我的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... just... really suck at this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……只是……真的很不擅长这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I gotta go, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我得走了，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No, I think I should do this on my own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，我觉得这件事我应该自己来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How're you going to help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你要怎么帮？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: If you could talk to them, that'd be great...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果你能和他们谈谈，那就太好了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I actually think I should probably just do this on my own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我其实觉得这件事我应该自己来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You, actually...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实，是你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lettie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 莱蒂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Arthur.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿米尔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Eleanor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 埃莉诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually I - I'm sorry, I can't do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实，我——很抱歉，我做不了这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I.. just haven't been able to get over you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……只是还没能放下你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I would really love that. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我真的会很喜欢的。 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I changed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually I - I'm sorry, I can't do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实我——我很抱歉，我做不了这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually I - I'm sorry, I can't do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实我——我很抱歉，我做不了这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah... I have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的……我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I changed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually I - I'm sorry, I can't do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实我——我很抱歉，我做不了这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... don't know. I guess I was shy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……不知道。我想我太害羞了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I didn't know how to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该怎么说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah... I have feelings for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的……我喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Actually I - I'm sorry, I can't do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实我——我很抱歉，我做不了这个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I changed my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The Hex member I'm after is...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我在追的六人组成员是......

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Depends..? Is this going to end in a fight?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这要看情况……？这会以打架收场吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sure. I have time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当然。我有时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sorry, I can't right now. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，我现在不方便。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I would never leave you behind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我永远不会把你留下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All I can say is that I don't *want* to leave you behind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我只能说，我*不想*把你留下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh, boy. I... honestly don't know. I can't predict the future, ironically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦天哪。我……老实说我不知道。讽刺的是，我无法预测未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I might have to leave for a little while... but this is my home, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我可能得离开一阵子……但现在这里是我的家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't think I'll have a choice when it comes down to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得到最后我可能没得选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I sense mischief. I'm in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我感觉到有恶作剧要发生了。算我一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Uh oh. Yeah? What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦哦。是吗？有什么事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: BRB, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 马上回来，不好意思。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hells. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当然了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Won't that cause a mess?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那不会弄得一团糟吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What if Lettie's rats get into them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果莱蒂的小鼠跑进去怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No... That seams mean. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不……这好像有点过分了。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: All right, I'm in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我加入。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Eeh. Pass. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 呃。算了。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Uh oh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 出什么事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Like a "mouse?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 像"老鼠"那样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Let him continue.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [让他继续]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Skeek?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 滋？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What was that? I missed it. Lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那是什么？我没听到。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think that's spelled "squeak."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我认应该要这样写："吱"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm good, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 其实，我不想听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sorry. :(
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 对不起。:(

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sorry. Please continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 抱歉。请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think I can see where this is going...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我大概猜到会发生什么了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你后来怎么办了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is incredible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 真的假的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You didn't strike me as the pet rat kind of guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 在我看来，你不像是那种喜欢养小鼠的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is just. So cute.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这听起来太可爱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah? What's up? :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯？怎么了？:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I can't right now, sorry. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我现在不行，抱歉。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh, Quincy. lol
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哦，昆西。哈哈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm sure he was thrilled.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定他很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I love you too, Quincy. <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆西，我也爱你。 <RETRO_EMOJI_HEART>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I... oh. I'm sorry, I'm really not ready for this kind of commitment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……哦。对不起，我还没有准备好接受这样的承诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Ignore.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [无视]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Something blowing up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是有什么要炸了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What? What's up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 什么？有什么新鲜事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What?! What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 什么？！怎么了？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Was it about to eat him?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是那台机子想吃掉他吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I wonder who else he can imitate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想知道他还能模仿谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Somehow I'm not shocked he can do voices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不知道为什么，他能配音我一点也不吃惊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Maybe we can use this to prank Arthur. Or Viktor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 也许我们可以利用这一点来整蛊亚瑟。或者维克多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Did you say anything?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你当时有说什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think he's also just used to getting made fun of in general.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想他可能也习惯了平时被人取笑吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What'd you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: This is cute beyond words, right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 现在想想这画面可爱到不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Lol. This is seriously blowing your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 哈哈哈。看来这个真的震撼到你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Techrot are mostly speakers, it won't be too hard to - actually, that's a terrible idea. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 科腐者很多都是音响，应该不难拿来——那啥，这主意太烂了。算了当我没说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'll do the same. :)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我也会。:)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Shoot. Wait. Not literally. *You* could probably actually hit me from where you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 来吧。等等。我说不是让你真的动手。*你*可能真的能从你现在的位置打中我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Go for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Not sure what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不知道你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think I know what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想我知道你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Pink hair? Oh. Kaya?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 粉头发？噢。卡娅？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Hm... You sure Amir didn't just "Overclock" one of his desk toys?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯……你确定阿米尔没有"超频"他桌上的玩具吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think you're talking about "Ayatan Sculptures."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我想你说的是"阿耶檀识塑像"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No clue, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不知道，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Might be an "Ayatan Sculpture?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 可能是"阿耶檀识塑像"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I mean, it's not my fault. The future is just...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我是说，这不是我的错。未来只是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yes. Yes, it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的。没错，它是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, the long version is -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，详细来说就是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Well, the short version is -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好吧，长话短说就是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: In short? Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 简而言之呢？是的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I was going to say "space trauma," but that works.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我本来想说"太空创伤"的，不过这么说也行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Ayatan Sculptures are ancient Orokin artifacts that are associated with the ritual of Orokin "Continuity."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿耶檀识塑像是古老的奥罗金神器，与奥罗金"延续"的仪式有关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Ayatan Sculptures are used to store the favorite memories of the Orokin...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿耶檀识塑像是用来储存奥罗金最美好的回忆的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Which we... won't get into now, because that's a whole different can of evil worms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这个我们……现在就不讲了，因为那可是另一个麻烦的开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Continuity is the ritual that the Orokin would use to transfer their consciousness into another body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 延续是奥罗金人用来将他们的意识转移到另一个身体的仪式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: They thought they were gods. Their favorite memories were often ones of torture, whippings, massacres... executions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们自诩为神。他们最美好的回忆往往是关于酷刑、鞭打、屠杀……处决的场景。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: When you live forever, and you can just put your consciousness into another body whenever you want...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当你长生不老的时候，你可以随时把你的意识放到另一个身体里……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: If I got into every terrible thing the Orokin did we'd be here all year.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果我说完奥罗金做过的每一件坏事我们就得在这里待上一整年了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm summarizing a lot here, even trying to explain this much, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我大概总结了一下，可能解释得有点多，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Basically, Orokin were "immortal" because they could put their consciousness into other bodies permanently.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 基本上，奥罗金人是"不朽的"，因为他们可以将自己的意识永久地放入其他身体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: In short, to summarize, Ayatan Sculptures are used to store the favorite memories of the Orokin...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 总之，总结一下，阿耶檀识塑像是用来储存奥罗金最美好的回忆的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So, Ayatan Sculptures can be fitted with Ayatan Stars. If you do that, they move.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以，阿耶檀识塑像可以装上阿耶檀识之星。装上后，它们就会动起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: They would pick young and beautiful "Yuvans" as unwilling hosts, and use Kuva to destroy the original person's consciousness and override it with their own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们会挑选年轻漂亮的"青春之躯"作为被迫的宿主，用赤毒摧毁原主人的意识，用自己的意识取而代之。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: They also contain blueprints for Warframes. Many we're still discovering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 它们还包含了战甲的蓝图。很多我们还在探索中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The good news is, we have a use for them in the future. We melt them down and use them to upgrade our own weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 好消息是，它们在未来会派上用场。我们可以把它们熔化，用来升级我们的武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Ayatan Stars are filled with Aya.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿耶檀识之星充满了阿耶精华。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And Aya is like... Ordis called it "Memory Plasma" once. It stores just about anything in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 而阿耶精华就像……Ordis 曾称它为"记忆等离子体"。它几乎可以存储任何东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yeah, they... weren't great people, by and large.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，他们……总体来说，都不是什么好人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: When a whole society is built around telling you a thing is not only "okay," it's "revered," it sometimes is very difficult to see it for what it is in the moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 当整个社会都围绕着告诉你某件事不仅"没问题"，而且"备受尊崇"时，有时在当下很难看清它的本质。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: We're just getting started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我们才刚刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Come to think of it, you'd *really* like Varzia and Maroo. And they'd *really* like you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说起来，你一定会*非常*喜欢瓦奇娅和 Maroo。而他们也会*非常*喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Come to think of it, you'd *really* like Varzia and Maroo. And they'd *really* like you. Maybe a little too much. ;)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说起来，你一定会*非常*喜欢瓦奇娅和 Maroo。而他们也会*非常*喜欢你。可能有点过头了。;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It wasn't until that the Orokin executed Archimedean Margulis that the Tenno were motivated to turn on the Orokin. And it wasn't because of "Continuity" or the Yuvan Theater or any of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 直到奥罗金处决了哲士 Margulis，Tenno 才有了动机反抗奥罗金。而这并非因为"延续"或"青春厅堂"之类的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Think about it this way. Aya is like the actual tape in a VHS. The Ayatan Star is like once you've put the tape in a cassette.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这样想吧。阿耶精华就像录像系统中的磁带。阿耶檀识之星就像你把磁带放入录像带盒后的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And the Ayatan Sculpture is like the VHS player.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 阿耶檀识塑像就像是录像系统一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: The Orokin themselves. Like, an individual Orokin. And they used them to primarily store their favorite memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金他们自己。比如，一个奥罗金个体。他们主要用这些来存储自己最美好的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: No. Makes sense, though. Being on a roof for that long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没有。不过也是。毕竟你在屋顶上待了那么久。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 记得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I do. Lol. And I remember you getting into the spicy ones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 记得。哈哈。我还记得你特别喜欢劲爆的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I hope you didn't start a fight?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你们没有打架吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Flare?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是弗莱尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Minerva?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是米尼娃？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Kaya?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是卡娅？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... Lizzie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……是丽兹?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Velimir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是维利米尔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: How did Kaya react?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 卡娅听了这些是怎么反应的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Those are definitely words, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，每个字都认识但连起来看不懂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Sounds like Velimir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 听着像维利米尔会说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Our new friends. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是我们的新朋友。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: When can I borrow one?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我什么时候可以借一本？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You did that to yourself. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你这是自找的。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I can't tell if that means you're friends or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我都搞不清你们到底是不是朋友了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Are you both okay now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你们俩现在还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Just less Ludstonish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 只是少点拉德斯顿范儿而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I wasn't going to say it. :P
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我还没来得及说呢。:P

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Who do you think has a crush on who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你觉得谁对谁有好感？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Oh? I'm all ears.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 噢？我洗耳恭听。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: That... sounds like animal cruelty...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那……听起来像是虐待动物……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I think I follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我觉得我明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Bossman?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 老板？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Merking?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 殴打？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I'm... sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我……对不起？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So what're you implying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那你这是在暗示什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: A lot. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 很多次。怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I haven't exactly kept count.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我没有具体数过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: None, sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 没有，抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't get how it would be possible. Maybe the Infested part of you? Or Void... stuff?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我实在想不通这怎么可能。或许是你被感染的那部分？还是虚空……之类的东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: A ton of sense. And I believe you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 很有道理。我相信你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You mean the Origin System?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是说始源星系吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You mean Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是说双衍王境吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: You never talk much about Aoi.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你很少提起碧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: What do you make of Velimir?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你觉得维利米尔怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Yes. Yes, you are. And I've never even been there, and I know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的。没错，你就是。而我甚至都没去过那里，但我就是知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I wouldn't know, I only have you and Arthur to go by.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，我只能参考你和亚瑟的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: So. It's tomorrow. Am I going to get that "how you joined the Hex" conversation now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么。明天到了。我现在可以听听"你是怎么加入六人组"的故事了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: [Let it go.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: [算了吧。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: We're friends, Q. It's obvious you don't want to tell me what happened. You should be able to trust me with things like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆，我们是朋友。很显然你不想告诉我发生了什么。你应该信任我，把这些事情告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: We're dating, Q. It's obvious you don't want to tell me what happened. You should be able to trust me with things like this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 昆，我们在交往。很显然你不想告诉我发生了什么。你应该信任我，把这些事情告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I've been waiting for you to tell me for a while, and I've been patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我一直在等你开口，我也很有耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Just say you don't want to tell me. We all have secrets. Whatever happened, it's your business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 如果你不想说，就直说吧。我们都有秘密。无论发生了什么，那都是你的私事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Don't keep dragging me along saying you'll tell me, then don't. You don't like being played. Neither do I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 别一直拖着我说你会告诉我，然后又不说。你不喜欢被人玩弄。我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: Isn't that what trust means?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这不就是信任的意义吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I get it. You'll tell me when you're ready, and that's fine. And if "ready" is "never"? That's fine, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我明白了。你准备好了再告诉我，没关系。如果"准备好"意味着"永远不说"？那也没关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: For now. I guess. Is it okay with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 暂时这样吧。我想。你觉得可以吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: It just might mean we don't get past a certain point. But that's okay with me, if it's okay with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这可能意味着我们可能无法达到某个阶段。但如果你能接受，我也没问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I don't know. I'm making this up as I go. I'm not used to relationships. But I want to be with you, and I want you to trust me. But I also know you can't force that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。我只是边走边看。我不太习惯谈恋爱。但我想和你在一起，我希望你能信任我。但我也知道这种事不能强求

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: talked to the lil speedster like u said
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 按照你说的，跟那个小飞毛腿谈过了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: they dead, n i took that life
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们死了，而我夺走了那条生命

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so i told him about the nightmares i used to get. the ones like when i was a lil kid
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以我告诉他我以前做过的噩梦。就像我小时候做的那些

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: but i told him sorry that id been treating him like such a plumsack this whole time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我也向他道歉了，因为我一直把他当傻子一样对待

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n that face lives in my head
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那张脸一直留在我的脑海中

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: its 1 thing when ur in the heat of battle...some goon is coming at u with a gun or a knife or w/e...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 近身肉搏是一回事……一些暴徒拿着枪或刀向你冲过来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n how he feels like hes not really part of the group bc hes not a soldier
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他觉得自己好像不是团队的一部分，因为他不是士兵

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n that he belonged with us just as much as anybody does. n that i just got a way 'bout me, just like he's got a way 'bout him, n its just who we r, u know?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 还说了他和任何人一样是我们的一员。我就是这样的人，就像他也有他的个性，这就是我们，你明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: hey
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嘿

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: first he thought i was gonna punch him in the face lmao. but i took him up onto the roof n we sat down n we talked
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 一开始他以为我要揍他呢，笑死。但后来我把他带到屋顶上，我们坐下来谈了谈

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: fking shove it n let me talk, will u?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 妈的闭嘴，让我说完，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: told him bout how i know he gets those nightmares of his. how i know hes not ok
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我跟他说了我知道他常做那些噩梦。也知道他过的并不好

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: nothing at first
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 一开始什么也没说

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: just sort of sat there looking ashamed of himself
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 只是坐在那里，看上去很羞愧

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: probably figured i was gonna make fun of him
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 可能以为我会取笑他

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: which tbf was pretty tempting with how proper shook he looked
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 说实话，看到他那么慌张，确实让我很想这么做

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so... i told him bout the first time i had to kill somebody. about the first time i had 2 look down that sight n take a life
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以……我跟他讲了我第一次杀人的经历。第一次瞄准镜下看着一个人，然后夺走他的生命

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: another thing entirely when ur on a roof 300 yrds away n they dont even know ur there...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但当你在三百码外的屋顶上，而他们甚至不知道你在那里……完全是另一回事
