/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: bc somebody's gotta do this job RIGHT n if it's not gonna be u? it's gonna come down 2 me. like it always fkin' does
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为总得有人做这件事，如果不是你，那就只能是我了。就像以往那样

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: k. well. u made this easy 4 me. thkx
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 嗯，行吧。你倒是让我轻松了。谢谢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: yeah. i do. n once u listen 2 what i've got 2 say, maybe u'll FINALLY understand y
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不，我得做。等你听了我要说的，或许你最后会明白为什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: maybe once u hear what i've got 2 say, maybe u'll FINALLY understand
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 也许等你听了我要说的，你最后可能会明白为什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: i told u why i joined the army. how i wanted 2 make a better life 4 me and my fam
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我告诉过你我为什么加入军队。因为我想让我和我的家人过上更好的生活

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: never told u why i got into the army. i'll make it quick. it's simple. wanted 2 make a better life for me n my fam
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我从没告诉过你我为什么要加入军队。我快速说一下。原因很简单。我想让我和我的家人过上更好的生活

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n where i grew up? u don't get free opportunities 2 do that. nah, u gotta get out 2 do that
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 在我长大的地方？你没有免费的机会去实现这一点。不，你得出去找机会实现

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n the easiest way 4 someone like me 2 get out? army. they got bursaries - scholarships - 2 pay for soldiers to go to college
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 而对我这样的人来说，最简单的出路就是军队。军队提供奖学金——让士兵有机会上大学

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: come back home n set my family up real nice, make a difference the way that matters
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 回家后让我的家人过得更好，做些真正有意义的改变

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: but everything went tits up before i got that chance
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但在我有这个机会之前，一切都乱了套

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so i figured i'd go kill 4 them 4 a few years, n then i'd get a nice ride 2 business school. major in finance or maybe an MBA or somethin'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以我想，为他们杀几年人，然后我就能顺利进入商学院，主修金融或者读个工商管理硕士之类的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 那么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: doesn't take a genius 2 put it together that His Maj is the reason y things went wrong 4 me in my life. n why i've vowed 2 never let anyone in like that ever again
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不用是天才也能想明白，正是因为那位陛下，我的生活才出了问题。也是为什么我发誓再也不对任何人敞开心扉了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: and how everything went tits up before i got that chance
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 并且在我有这个机会之前，一切都乱了套

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: he's already commander, yeah? n i join fresh out of academy
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他当时已经是指挥官了，是吧？我则是刚从军校出来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: just by chance, random roll of the dice, i end up joinin' the same regiment as His Maj. 3rd battalion, crimson watch
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 就这么巧，通过一次偶然的机会，我加入了和陛下相同的团，第三营，赤色守望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: life ain't fair. no matter where u go. nepotism. favouritism. bigotry. everywhere. people looking down there nose at me bc of where i'm from
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 生活从来是不公平的。无论你去哪里。裙带关系。偏袒。偏见。到处都是。人们看不起我，因为我的出身

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n for a while i'm trying 2 play by the rules, be a good little soldier. but as I go on... i realize the deck is still stacked against me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 有一段时间，我都在努力遵守规则，做一个合格的小兵。但随着时间的推移……我意识到情况仍然对我不利

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: i wasn't stealing shit. wasn't breaking protocol. i was a good lil soldier. but if u've ever heard the phrase 'malicious compliance' u get my vibe
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我没有偷东西。没有违反规定。我是个好士兵。但如果你听过"恶意服从"这个词，那你就会明白我的行为了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so i... started 2 get stupid. started 2 do things i regret now. started 2 lash out in stupid ways. if they wanted 2 take from me? i'd take from them
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以我……开始变得愚蠢。开始做一些我现在后悔的事情。开始用愚蠢的方式反击。如果他们想从我这里拿走什么？我也会从他们那拿

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: bc if they weren't watching my back, why was i gonna watch theirs? so i was looking out for myself, and myself ONLY, read me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为如果他们不保护我，我为什么要保护他们？所以我只关心我自己，只有我自己，听明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: bc of who i am
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 因为我是谁

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: there wasn't a 2nd of my life that i was gonna spend going above or beyond for nobody, ever. i wanted 2 do my time n get out with my checks
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我一生中不会有一秒钟是浪费在为别人做额外的事上。我只想做完自己的工作然后拿到工资走人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: arthur n the rest of the troops r down on the field, n i have a split second 2 decide. i can give away my position 'n fire on the scrambling opps 2 give His Maj n company warning n time 2 get 2 safety
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 亚瑟和其他部队都在下面的战场上，我必须在一瞬间做出决定。其实我可以暴露我的位置，向那些突然出现的敌人开火，给陛下和其他人发出警告，争取时间让他们撤离到安全地带

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: but doing that puts me in real shit. guarantees those opps r comin' for my dumb arse real fast. so...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但这样做会让我处于极大的危险之中，可以肯定那些敌人会迅速朝我这里来。所以……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: nah, cuz. they knew i was there the whole time. they had the read on me from the start
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不是，老表。他们一直都知道我在那里。他们从一开始就盯上了我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: then it all went wrong. we're on a mission. n i'm on observation. i can see from my POV that the opps - the opposition - they suddenly start scrambling 4 us. they know we're there
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但后来一切都乱套了。我们正在执行一个任务。我当时在观察。从我的视角来看，我可以看到反对派——敌人——突然开始向我们发起攻击。他们知道我们在那里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: i go to leave the room where i've been hiding out n i turn a corner right into the business end of some opp's rifle
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我正要离开我藏身的房间，拐个弯就对上了一个敌人的枪口

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: i pack up my shit n radio that we've been compromised... figured His Maj and the others r toast anyway...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我收拾好我的东西，并用无线电报告我们的位置已经暴露……无论如何，我以为陛下和其他人已经凶多吉少了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: BLAP BLAP
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 砰砰

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: they drag my ass out 2 the street. shove me 2 my knees n shove a pistol 2 the back of my head
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们把我拖到街上，逼我跪下，把手枪顶在我的后脑勺上

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: YES
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: FK
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 操

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: i do the RIGHT FKIN THING BECAUSE I OWE HIM n i... i leave the army w/ him, n... n kiss that dream of college goodbye
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我选择了做正确的事，因为我欠他的，然后……我和他一起离开了军队，也就此和大学梦说再见了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so off i went 2 go join the ICR with him LIKE THE IDIOT THAT I WAS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以我当时像个傻瓜一样跟他一起去了国危部

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so when his ass GETS US INTO SERIOUS SHIT A FEW MONTHS LATER, n he's about to get DISCHARGED?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以几个月后当他让我们陷入大麻烦，而且在他快被开除的时候？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: 'i got us set up with this new position with a peacekeeping org. n they pay better, n up front. ur gonna be ok'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: "我已经为我们找好了一份新工作，是跟一个维和组织合作的。他们的薪水更高，而且是预付的。你会没事的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: that whole dream of mine of making a better life 4 me n my fam? gone. but arthur says 'naaaaah m8, it'll be ok'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我为自己和家人带来更好生活的梦想？没了。但是亚瑟说："没事的，伙计，一切都会好起来的。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n THAT WASN'T PART OF THE PLAN
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这不在我的计划里

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n now... now i got this mfer - this MFER - and now i have 2 CARE ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS 2 HIM
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 而现在……现在我得关心这个混蛋——这个该死的混蛋——现在我得管他的死活了

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: I GOTTA CHOOSE. do i fkin' tell the brass a bunch of lies? do i throw him under the bus like i did b4? or do i do the RIGHT THING
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我得做选择。我是不是该对上头撒一堆谎？我是不是该像之前那样背叛他？还是我该做正确的事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: don't u GET IT?! i was living my life 4 me n my fam. that's what mattered 2 me. the only thing that mattered 2 me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你难道不明白吗？！我过去只为我和我的家人而活。那是我最在乎的，是我唯一在乎的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: yeah N THEN THE TECHROT... things went to REAL hell, n that's... when he needed me even more than b4
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是的，然后是科腐者……一切变成了真正的地狱，那时……他比以往更需要我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so then the techrot showed up, n things went to REAL hell, n that's... when he needed me even more than b4
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后那个科腐者出现了……而一切变成了真正的地狱，那时……他比以往更需要我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: every time i let someone in, i end up their lil toy soldier...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 每次我让别人进入我的生活，我最终都变成了他们的小玩具士兵……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: so when u showed up... n stomped right in...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 所以当你出现……大摇大摆地进来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: but i can't just... walk away. that time's long gone, innit? couldn't walk away then... can't walk away now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但我不能就这样……走开。那个时候早就过去了，对吧？那时候没能走开……现在也走不开……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: kicked in the doors i'd bolted shut...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 踢开我紧锁的门……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n went 'nah, m8, u n me are gonna be 2gether now, that's the end of the story even though there's no good reason'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后说"不行，伙计，现在你和我得在一起了，故事到此为止，虽然没有什么好理由"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n went 'nah, i care about u even though there's no good reason'
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 然后说"不行，虽然没有什么好理由，但我还是关心你"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我他妈该怎么办？上一次发生这种事的时候……它毁了我的生活……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: ... thnx. that means a lot. doesn't mean its right, tho. n i'm sorry. i'm... scared, i think, deep down, that 'us' - whatever 'us' is? is gonna just ruin me again
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: ……谢谢。这对我很重要。但并不意味着它是正确的。对不起。我……我想在我内心深处，我……很害怕，"我们"这个词——不管"我们"意味着什么？只会再次毁了我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: i know. ur right. n... i'm sorry 4 that. i'm scared that doing this? 'us'? whatever that means? will just ruin me again
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我知道。你是对的。而且……我很抱歉。我害怕这样做？"我们"？无论这意味着什么？只会再次毁了我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 无论是你重置世界让我忘记你——你别说你做不到——还是你在事情变糟或你需要的时候逃到未来

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: but thats life, innit. life is... is like what u said about... 1 relationship at a time
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 但这就是生活，不是吗？生活就像你说的……一次一段关系

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: its fkin' arthur. fkin' His Maj rollin' out of nowhere 2 save me
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是他妈的亚瑟，他妈的陛下突然出现救了我

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: n i was SO FKIN' MAD at him 4 it. got up 2 my feet n told him off right there
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我当时气疯了。立马站起来对着他就是一顿骂

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 跟着我，我很乐意教你怎么做事 ;)

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 是，是。跟着我，你很快就会明白的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你是从太空来的。就是……真的太空。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: this neighborhood doesn't run on money anymore, get me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这个社区已经不靠钱运转了，懂我的意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: nah it runs on goods 'n services. what u got. what u got 2 trade. what u willing 2 do for ppl
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这里靠的是物资和服务。你有什么。你能拿什么来交换。你愿意为人们做什么

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: i do a little extra 4 them, i get a little extra on the side. just how this shit goes
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 我为他们多做一点，自己就能多得一点。就是这么回事

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: not shocked. i see the bling u strut around in. figured ur no stranger to the hustle of a warzone
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 不意外。看你那些扎眼的装饰。我就知道你对战区的生活不陌生

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.text: u don't wanna listen 2 me that's up 2 u, space. u made the deal
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 太空人，如果你不想听我的，那就随便你。这是你自己的选择

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 这正好带出我的观点。你有必要总是搞得像烟花一样四处爆炸吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 他们差点以为这里不止有怪物还有外星人

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 靠。等等。问个事儿——我在未来出名吗？真想知道

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 你不只是从太空来的，还是从未来来的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/QuincyRomanc.zhText: 看起来太阳底下无新事，对吧。真令人失望

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hey Roathe? Do you have a second? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嘿，罗瑟？你有空吗？ [征求是否同意多重伴侣关系]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想跟你说件事，我想先确定你能接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对我来说重要的是，你不会觉得我在对你撒谎，或者对你不坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不想让你陷入一种你无法接受的情况。所以如果你拒绝，那也没关系。我希望你清楚这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们之间的感情对我很重要——非常重要——而且它是真实的。我不希望你怀疑这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I take it you don't mind, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来你不介意吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You... do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你……知道？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They don't know Albrecht Entrati is still alive, no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对，​他们​不​知道​阿尔布雷​希特·​英择谛​还​活着。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't take orders from you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会听你指挥。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll see what I can do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我尽量试试看吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It didn't seem like a priority?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这件事似乎并不重要？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... just I didn't get around to this earlier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……只是之前没来得及做这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't remember... but we've been through this before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不记得了……但我们以前经历过这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What... kind of deal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么样的……提议？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Long story short, there's... the Infestation that seems to extend to the Protoframe serums...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 长话短说，Infestation 似乎已经蔓延到了原型战甲血清中……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah. Well. So. I have the ability to loop time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊。那个。是这样。我能够循环时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What kind of proposal could "the Devil of Tau" possibly have for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "Tau 之恶魔"究竟会向我提出什么样的提议呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I thought that it worked on the Protoframes in 1999 because of the year itself looping, but that's not the case.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我原以为它在 1999 年的原型战甲上能用，是因为年份本身是循环的，但事实并非如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you're saying you... just need to talk to someone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你的意思是，你……只是需要找人倾诉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm happy to help you if I can, I just don't really know how.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我能帮上忙，我很乐意，只是我不太清楚该怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So... why don't you go into the dark refractory on your own?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以……为什么你不自己进入深溯池呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The kid isn't an "it."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个孩子不是"它"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hello, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think it's... more to do with the Infestation itself? There's a talking guitar that kind of hinted at some of it. And you traveled here in a Helminth, didn't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得……这跟 Infestation 本身关系更大？有个会说话的吉他似乎暗示了这一点。而且你是乘坐 Helminth 来到这里的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You ran. But a lot of people run. It's about facing what happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你选择了逃避。但很多人都选择了逃避。关键在于能不能面对已经发生的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not going to mock you. You made the choice to fight another day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会嘲笑你。是你选择了继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hello, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know, and I'm not exactly here to continue taking abuse from you, Roathe. I didn't loop everyone just so I could catch flack from you over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我不知道，而且我来这里也不是为了继续挨你的骂。我把大家拉进循环，可不是为了让你来骂我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As far as I can guess? Our conversations aren't deep rooted. They're surface memories. What we uncovered in your past were... more part of your core memories, I guess?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 依我看，我们的对话并不深入，只是一些浅层记忆。而我们刚才挖出来的那些过去……我想，算是你核心记忆的一部分吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What exactly are you accusing me of?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你到底想把什么扣在我头上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I thought this was a deal. Now you're threatening me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我以为这是笔交易。现在你却在威胁我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe? Please stop and listen to me for a second.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟？请先停下来听我说一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do you need me to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​需要​我​做​什么？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm sorry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm the reason Ballas is dead. Don't make me clear my schedule.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Ballas 是我杀的。别逼我腾出时间来处理你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you want my help, this isn't a very good way of getting it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想让我帮忙，用这种态度可不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know you and I don't have much experience with each other - not really. But I'm here to help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道你我之间没什么交集——真的不多。但我来这里是为了帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think that's fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这很合理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're offering to help convince Loid to... talk to the Entrati family?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是说要帮忙说服洛德……去和英择谛家族谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can't convince Loid to do anything about it. He claims it'd be too painful for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我说服不了洛德做这件事。他说对他们来说会太痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what makes you so sure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你凭什么这么肯定？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He's close enough to one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他已经很接近是神了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't think he's real?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得他不真实吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if you don't think he's a god, what do you think he is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你觉得他不是神，那你觉得他是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you don't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你不这么觉得吗?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That thing is more powerful than anything I've ever been up against.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那东西比我遇到过的任何对手都更强大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do you think he is, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你觉得他是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Void and what we can make of it is dangerous and powerful - trust me, I know. But it has limits. You really think it's capable of manifesting something like that? That can create whole languages, fingers that can power ships that jump through the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空以及我们能利用它创造出来的东西既危险又强大——相信我，我深有体会。但它终究也有局限性。你真的以为它能够展现出这样的能力吗？能够创造完整的语言，拥有能够驱动飞船穿梭虚空的手指？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's... very tempting to believe that it's just a monster under our bed, Roathe. But I've seen this thing, face to "face," and I don't know how something like that just comes out of our minds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，说实话……把这当成床底下的怪物确实很诱人。但我亲眼见过那东西，面对"面"地见过，实在无法理解这种东西怎么可能只是我们脑子里的产物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Conceptual Embodiment cannot do what the Man in the Wall is capable of doing. While Entrati may have manifested that thing - and is responsible for bringing it here - I don't believe he is the original source of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 概念成形无法做到墙中人能做到的事。虽然英择谛可能显化了那东西——也对将它带到这里负责——但我认为他并不是那东西的最初来源。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I've seen things that come from the Void. Angels. Singing. Ghosts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我见过来自虚空的东西。天使。歌唱。鬼魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What're you saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wait. How are we to blame for this? Albrecht is the one to blame, he set it loose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等。这怎么能怪我们呢？该怪阿尔布雷希特才对，是他放出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll do that. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会的。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ponder mine, you may end up wanting to believe them when you're up against an anti-god.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 仔细想想我的观点，当你真的要面对一个反神的人时，你最终可能会想要相信它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: May I ask - how did you wind up back here? From... when, exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请问——你是怎么回到现在的？确切来说是……从哪一年回来的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I gathered you weren't put there by choice by Albrecht.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜你不是自愿让阿尔布雷希特安排你到那里去的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah. So you weren't put in the past by choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊。所以你并非自愿被放逐到过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... admit that I do, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，​我​承认​……​我​确实知道。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm trying to help guide you all through this process, and I screwed it up royally the last time. I'm trying again. "From the top" so to speak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我正在努力帮助大家适应这个过程，但上次我彻底搞砸了。这次我再试一次，可以说是"从头开始"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't really know how to explain this. I didn't ask for this ability to erase your minds, and I'm trying to navigate this ability as best I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真的不知道该怎么解释这一切。我也没想要拥有抹去你们记忆的能力，我现在只能尽力去驾驭这种能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have some experience with that, believe it or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 信不信由你，我在这方面有一些经验。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can, actually. But please, continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其实我可以想象。不过请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am trying to get you and the others to help me reunite Loid with the family upstairs and... I... couldn't...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想让你们帮帮我，让洛德和楼上的家族团聚，可是……我……做不到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, you see, you have this whole... thing about why you took the serum, and I... said the wrong things at the wrong times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那个，你看，你之前说你对注射那血清……有点敏感，而我……只是恰好在不该说的时候，说了不该说的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... am trying to win the hearts of one of you, and I... really... messed it up...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……只是想赢得你们其中一位的芳心，但我……真的……搞砸了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Marie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: With you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 跟你……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Marie...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You...
So... Wait. I'm confused. How and when did Entrati turn you into a protoframe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等……我听糊涂了。英择谛是怎么把你变成原型战甲的？又是什么时候发生的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You. Wait. You did what?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。等等。你做了什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He has... there's so much he's dealing with. And I don't know how to get through it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他……他要处理的事情太多了。我不知道该怎么帮他度过这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am trying to get you and the others to help me reunite Loid with the family upstairs and... I... couldn't...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想让你们帮帮我，让洛德和楼上的家族团聚，可是……我……做不到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have feelings for him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我喜欢他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She won't see Entrati for what he is. And I cannot get her to see the truth of it, no matter what I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她就是看不清英择谛的真面目。无论我做什么，都无法让她明白真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am trying to get you and the others to help me reunite Loid with the family upstairs and... I... couldn't...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想让你们帮帮我，让洛德和楼上的家族团聚，可是……我……做不到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have feelings for her...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我喜欢她……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, you see, you have this whole thing about why you took the serum, and I... kind of messed it up...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是这样的，你之前说过你为什么要注射血清，而我……好像搞砸了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess feelings.] This is... this is really embarrassing, but I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意] 这……这真的太尴尬了，但是我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道为什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did he bring you to the past?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他是如何把你带到过去的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did he make you into a protoframe in the first place?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他最初是如何把你变成原型战甲的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No, absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。不行，绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... won't fail? Loid will be reunited with the family? No matter what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……不会失败？洛德一定会和家族团聚的吧？无论如何？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can't. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... I agree. You have a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……我同意。成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No, absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。不行，绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... won't fail? Lyon and I won't struggle through our conversations?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……不会失败吧？我和里昂的谈话不会很艰难吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No, absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。不行，绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... won't fail? Marie will agree with me about Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……不会失败吧？玛丽会同意我对英择谛的看法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No, absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。不行，绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... won't fail? We'll be together? No matter what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​​……​不​会​失败​？​我们​会​在​一起​吧？​无论​发生什么？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can't. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... I agree. You have a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……我同意。成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No, absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。不行，绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... won't fail? Lyon and I will be together? No matter what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​​……​不​会​失败​？​里昂和我​会​在​一起的​吧？​无论​发生什么？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No, absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。不行，绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... won't fail? Marie and I will be together? No matter what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​​……​不​会​失败？​玛丽和我​会​在​一起​的吧？​无论​发生什么？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can't. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... I agree. You have a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……我同意。成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can't. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... I agree. You have a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……我同意。成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... I agree. You have a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……我同意。成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can't. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... I agree. You have a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……我同意。成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can't. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我做不到。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... I agree. You have a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……我同意。成交。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No, absolutely not!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。不行，绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... won't fail? We'll figure this out, you and I? No matter what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​​……​不​会​失败​？我们一定能想出办法的，不管发生什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Petros?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 彼得罗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do you think of the kids?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得他们的孩子怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They have their own... issues to focus on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们有各自的问题……需要关注。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Petros?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 彼得罗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, I haven't heard this before. Please, go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我以前没听过。请继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm talking to you, Roathe... because I want to be talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我跟你说话……是因为我想跟你说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I've heard this before, yes. But please tell it to me again anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，我之前听说过。但请你再说一遍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, I'm not changing my mind, Roathe. It's not that important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，罗瑟，我不会改变主意。这并不重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have. I... agree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我有。我……同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I never had much opportunity to interact with an Orokin. When... I wasn't fighting them, that is. You're fascinating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我几乎没什么和奥罗金人接触的机会。除了……和他们战斗。倒是你非常不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never mind. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 算了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I find you intriguing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你很有意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess feelings.] I think you know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意] 我想你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I never much dealt with the Orokin before the Zariman - and after, well... you've heard the gist I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对。在扎里曼之前，我没和奥罗金人打过交道——至于之后嘛……我想你大概已经听说了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I've had enough dealings with Orokin to know not to trust them as far as I can throw them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我跟奥罗金人打过不少交道，知道千万别相信他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't have any more love for your kind than the kid does, I'm sorry to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很遗憾，我对你们这类人并没有比那孩子更多的爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The worst of the Executors was Ballas.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 执行者中最坏的是 Ballas。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which one did you serve?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你侍奉的是哪一位？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 怎么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You'd have a hard time getting me to believe that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你很难让我相信这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why do you keep calling me "Usurper?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为什么老是叫我"篡位者"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You'd have a hard time getting me to believe that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你很难让我相信这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Like what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 比如什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not interested in hearing anything about Ballas' life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对 Ballas 的生平事迹不感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I'm sorry. I don't make arrangements with Orokin. Not then, not now, not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，抱歉。我不和奥罗金做任何交易。过去不做，现在不做，以后也不会做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I really hope you don't make me regret this, Roathe. Fine. Agreed. I need your help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我真希望你不会让我后悔。好吧，同意。我需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm getting along all right with Marie, so far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少到目前为止，我和玛丽相处得还不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, but he'll come around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对，​但​他​会​想​通​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't seem to like them very much. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你似乎不太喜欢他们。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon has... there's so much he's dealing with. And I don't know how to get through it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂他……要处理的事情太多了。我不知道该怎么帮他度过这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Marie won't see Entrati for what he is. And I cannot get her to see the truth of it, no matter what I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽就是看不清英择谛的真面目。无论我做什么，都无法让她明白真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, you see, you have this whole... thing about why you took the serum, and I... said the wrong things at the wrong times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那个，你看，你之前说你有注射那血清的……理由，而我……只是恰好在不该说的时候，说了不该说的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It might be a little embarrassing, but... I have feelings for one of you three.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然说出来有点尴尬，但是……我对你们三个中的一个有好感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am trying to get you and the others to help me reunite Loid with the family upstairs and... I... couldn't...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想让你们帮帮我，让洛德和楼上的家族团聚，可是……我……做不到……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I'm sorry. I don't make agreements with Orokin. Not then, not now, not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，抱歉。我不和奥罗金做任何交易。过去不做，现在不做，以后也不会做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I really hope you don't make me regret this, Roathe. Fine. Agreed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我真希望你不会让我后悔。好吧，同意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, Lyon... doesn't seem to talk much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对，里昂……似乎不太爱说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm getting on well with Marie. Why do you call her a sycophant?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我和玛丽相处得很好。你为什么说她是马屁精？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't seem to like them very much. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你似乎不太喜欢他们。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: ... You.
Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You behave and help me get Loid to go upstairs and reconcile with the family? And I'll help you sort out your memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你乖乖听话，帮我劝洛德上楼去和家族和解，我就帮你整理记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It doesn't mean you lack agency. It just means some things take a few more tries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这并不意味着你缺乏自主性，只是意味着有些事情需要多尝试几次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hope it doesn't upset you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 希望这不会让你不高兴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know if I upset him in some way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道我有没有在什么事上惹他生气吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Any clue on how I can get him to talk to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有什么办法能让他跟我说话吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She has brought it up a bit. She's convinced he can do no wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她稍微提过这件事。她坚信他永远不会犯错？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She's devoted to Entrati how, exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她究竟是怎么对英择谛如此忠诚的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you lying to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是在骗我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How do I fix it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我要怎么解决？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really? What did I do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？我做错什么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That does sound like hell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 听起来确实像是地狱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Repent because you're an Orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为你是奥罗金人而忏悔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Repent for what happened on Tau?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为 Tau 上发生的事情忏悔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Repent about what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 忏悔什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, and since we've been down this path before, I know exactly how it's going to end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，因为这种情况以前已经发生过了，所以我很清楚结局会是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you really think this is a good time to do this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真的认为现在是讨论这件事的好时机吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, what're you referencing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，你指的是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm expecting it. But are you ready to have it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我是在等着。但你准备好对话了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yeah. But you don't feel comfortable enough with me yet to have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是啊。但你觉得我们不够熟，所以不想跟我辩论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're too angry. Right now, you're convinced you took the coward's way out, but you don't remember any of the rest of what led up to that moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你太生气了。现在，你确信自己选择了懦夫的方式逃避，但你完全不记得导致那一刻发生的其他事情了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You trusted me with your stories once before - but you don't right now. So the conversations we need to have? You can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你以前信任我，跟我分享过你的故事——但现在你不信任我了。所以我们本该进行的对话？你做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Please stop lying to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请不要再骗我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That one might be hard. Does Lyon have any other requests that he'd like me to get... him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那件事可能有点难。里昂还有其他什么要求要我帮他办吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You sure you wouldn't prefer I just bring you some pastries? I've heard you like those.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定你不想让我给你带些糕点吗？我听说你喜欢吃糕点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Under the surface, I know you're, well, a raging inferno. And I know we need to get to a certain point before we can talk it through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道你内心深处就像一团熊熊燃烧的烈火。我也知道我们需要先达到某个阶段，才能好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And why would you trust me? All you know about me is that I... tampered with your memory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为什么要信任我？你对我的了解仅限于我……篡改了你的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So it's true. You'd sneak off into Gaule to steal chocolates? Looking like...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原来是真的。你会偷偷溜到高卢去偷巧克力？看起来像……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did you get them, exactly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么弄到它们的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We'll get there. But this takes time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们会找到真相的。但这需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll get there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会做到的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm trying. But you're not making it easy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我已经在努力了，但你一直把事情变复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You claimed you weren't angry at me for wiping your memories, but I know you're lying. Because... this isn't the first time I've done this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说你并不气我抹去了你的记忆，但我知道你在撒谎。因为……这已经不是我第一次这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because you loathe yourself over taking that serum willingly. You hate yourself, and that's making you furious - because you is all you have left.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为你痛恨自己竟然自愿注射了那种血清。你恨自己，这种恨意让你怒火中烧——因为你只剩下你自己了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You claimed you weren't angry at me for wiping your memories, but I can't imagine how you wouldn't be furious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说你并不气我抹去了你的记忆，但我无法想象，你怎么可能不愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You didn't lose anything worth keeping, just our conversations.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你并没有失去任何值得保留的记忆，只是失去了我们的对话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But not of everything - only of our conversations here. You still have everything else, even the ones we recovered in The Descendia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但并非所有——只是抹去了我们在此刻进行的对话。你其他所有记忆都还在，甚至包括我们在沉沦之地中恢复的那些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you brought back enough for Marie and Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你带回来的东西够玛丽和里昂吃吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you just stole the pastries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你就偷了那些糕点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fair point, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说的有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or, you could try being kind to them for the sake of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者，你也可以出于善意而善待他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So, just to be clear - you were being nice, because you hate them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以也就是——你对他们友好，是因为你讨厌他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I never thought about it that way, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我从来没有从这种角度想过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have a very hard time believing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很难相信这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't know what else to do. I didn't have other options.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道还能怎么办。我别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did. I didn't realize you'd... wind up in this state, half-remembering things. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。我没想到你会……变成这样，记忆有些模糊。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To be completely honest, Roathe? I... never thought it would actually matter that I could do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，说实话？我……从没想过我能这样做竟然会这么重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was curious to see what would happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What happened that changed things so drastically?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 究竟发生了什么，导致事情发生了如此巨大的变化？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: People don't change that much. He was always, deep down, capable of what he did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 人其实变化不大。从本质上讲，他一直都有能力做出他所做的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was curious to see what would happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't know what else to do. I didn't have other options.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道还能怎么办。我别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was curious to see what would happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To be completely honest, Roathe? I... never thought it would actually matter that I could do this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，说实话？我……从没想过我能这么做竟然会这么重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did. I didn't realize you'd... wind up in this state, half-remembering things. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。我没想到你会……变成这样，记忆有些模糊。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was curious to see what would happen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're Infested, now. And you share a connection to the Infested strains that were used to create all Protoframe serum batches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你现在是 Infested。而且你与用于制造所有原型战甲血清批次的感染菌株有着某种联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A talking guitar owes me some favors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一把会说话的吉他欠我一些人情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have heard it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我已经听过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have heard it, but please, go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我已经听过了，但请继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I haven't heard it, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其实，我还没听说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, I haven't heard the story, which... is actually part of why we're here. I know I missed opportunities the first time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我还没听过这个故事，而这……其实也是我们今天在这聊的原因之一。我知道我第一次错失了一些机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As far as I've been told - and she's not exactly entirely reliable, so take this with a grain of salt - the strains of Infestation for each of the batches of Protoframes can be influenced individually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 据我所知——而且她的话也不太可靠，所以听听就好——每批原型战甲的感染菌株都可以被单独影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're Infested, now. And you share a connection to the Infested strains that were used to create all Protoframe serum batches.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你现在是 Infested。而且你与用于制造所有原型战甲血清批次的感染菌株有着某种联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A talking guitar owes me some favors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一把会说话的吉他欠我一些人情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As each one sort of lives inside its own "continuity" or time. All the Infestation strains are connected, but they sort of live in... nodules. It's all very complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们各自都存在于自己的"连续性"或时间里。所有感染菌株都相互关联，但它们似乎也存在于……结节状的结构中。这一切都非常复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As far as I've been told - and she's not exactly entirely reliable, so take this with a grain of salt - the strains of Infestation for each of the batches of Protoframes can be influenced individually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 据我所知——而且她的话也不太可靠，所以听听就好——每批原型战甲的感染菌株都可以被单独影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So because I can loop time, I can loop Infestation "Batches" in a limited way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我可以循环时间，所以我可以在一定限度内循环感染者"批次"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have no idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你根本想象不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She rather takes the cake. Well... never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她才是真正的佼佼者。好吧……算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As each one sort of lives inside its own "continuity" or time. All the Infestation strains are connected, but they sort of live in... nodules. It's all very complicated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们各自都存在于自己的"连续性"或时间里。所有感染菌株都相互关联，但它们似乎也存在于……结节状的结构中。这一切都非常复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So because I can loop time, I can loop Infestation "Batches" in a limited way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我可以循环时间，所以我可以在一定限度内循环感染者"批次"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have no idea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你根本想象不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She rather takes the cake. Well... never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她才是真正的佼佼者。好吧……算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lizzie. She'd love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 丽兹，她会喜欢你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A talking guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一把会说话的吉他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lizzie. She'd love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 丽兹，她会喜欢你的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A talking guitar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一把会说话的吉他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're making this up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你在编故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How do you figure? Wasn't he responsible for her death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是怎么得出这个结论的？难道他不是害死她的凶手吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ballas was the one who had her executed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是 Ballas 下令处决了她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not going to start feeling bad for him, if that's what you're asking me to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你是想让我同情他，那我可不会这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because of the Tenno? Or because of what they did to her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是因为 Tenno 吗？还是因为他们对她所做的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You can romanticize what they had, but that doesn't excuse who he was. Ballas cannot be forgiven for everything he did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以美化他们之间的感情，但这并不能为他的人品开脱。Ballas 所做的一切，都不可饶恕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm glad that their love was real. That he was... complicated back then. And that Margulis wasn't just being played with the whole time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴他们的爱情是真挚的。他当时确实……很复杂。而且 Margulis 并非一直都被他玩弄于股掌之间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How so?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么这么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Too impersonal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太没有人情味了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What brings this up?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 怎么突然提起这个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which is worse? Being shot at, or having to watch your back?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哪一种更糟？被人开枪射击，还是不得不时刻提防背后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I like to know who my enemies are, clean and simple. Let them come at me guns blazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我喜欢清楚地知道谁是我的敌人，简单明了。让他们放马过来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Being shot at. I prefer being able to pull strings to get the job done. I can take my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 被人开枪射击。我更喜欢能暗中操纵来完成任务。这样我就能从容行事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wasn't that a bit dangerous?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那不是很危险吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That sounds amazing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 听起来太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did Marie and Lyon feel about you sneaking off?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽和里昂对你偷偷溜走这件事是什么看法？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're afraid to die?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你害怕死亡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You didn't, no. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，你没说服我。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You did, actually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确实做到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We never really quite settled on either side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们从未完全站到任何一方的立场上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't think he's real?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不信他是真实存在的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if you don't think he's a god, what do you think he is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你不认为他是神，那你觉得他是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you don't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而你却不这么认为？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know. And I don't think you possibly can, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。而且我觉得你也不可能知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think it was an entity that existed before Entrati interacted with it. He just gave it shape and form via Conceptual Embodiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为它是在英择谛接触它之前就已存在的实体。他只是通过概念成形赋予了它形态与形貌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I honestly... don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话……我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You really think that Entrati made a malignant Void god out of whole cloth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真的认为英择谛凭空捏造出了一个邪恶的虚空神？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That thing is more powerful than anything I've ever been up against.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那东西比我对抗过的任何东西都强大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do you think he is, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么你认为他是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Void and what we can make of it is dangerous and powerful - trust me, I know. But it has limits. You really think it's capable of manifesting something like that? That can create whole languages, fingers that can power ships that jump through the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空以及我们能利用它创造出来的东西既危险又强大——相信我，我深有体会。但它终究也有局限性。你真的以为它能够展现出这样的能力吗？能够创造完整的语言，拥有能够驱动飞船穿梭虚空的手指？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's... very tempting to believe that it's just a monster under our bed, Roathe. But I've seen this thing, face to "face," and I don't know how something like that just comes out of our minds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，说实话……把这当成床底下的怪物确实很诱人。但我亲眼见过那东西，面对"面"地见过，实在无法理解这种东西怎么可能只是我们脑子里的产物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Conceptual Embodiment cannot do what the Man in the Wall is capable of doing. While Entrati may have manifested that thing - and is responsible for bringing it here - I don't believe he is the original source of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 概念成形无法做到墙中人能做到的事。虽然英择谛可能显化了那东西——也对将它带到这里负责——但我认为他并不是那东西的最初来源。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I've seen things that come from the Void. Angels. Singing. Ghosts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我见过来自虚空的东西。天使。歌唱。鬼魂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What're you saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wait. How are we to blame for this? Albrecht is the one to blame, he set it loose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等。这怎么能怪我们呢？该怪阿尔布雷希特才对，是他放出来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We can't create things like that, Roathe - I told you. Conceptual Embodiment has its limits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我早就跟你说过——我们绝不可能创造那样的存在。概念成形自有其局限性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't blame us for this. We're not at fault for the damage that thing has caused.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别把这事怪到我们头上。那东西造成的破坏与我们无关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Walk me through your reasoning on how this would work. Most things that are created via Conceptual Embodiment from the Void can't leave it - at least not for long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请详细解释一下你的的推论依据。通过虚空概念成形诞生的存在，大多都无法脱离虚空——至少无法持久存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Right. Like Duviri, it shares a connection to this world via the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错。就像双衍王境，它通过扎里曼号与这个世界保持着联系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Like the Zariman, and the Holdfasts, and the Void Angels. The Void is everywhere on that ship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如扎里曼号、坚守者和虚空天使一样。在那艘飞船上虚空无处不在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. And?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。然后呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it's been to 1999. It's followed Albrecht everywhere. And me, too.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但它曾现身 1999 年。它如影随形地跟随阿尔布雷希特。也跟着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wait...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等一下……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you're postulating that anyone with enough Void exposure - or anyone who is a "battery" becomes another window for the Man in the Wall to peer through?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你的推论是，任何暴露于虚空足够久的人——或者任何成为"电池"的人，都会变成墙中人窥视世界的另一扇窗口？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But how did it get into Rusalka, I wonder?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我想不出来，它究竟是如何侵入鲁莎卡的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Major Neci Rusalka. She was in charge of the military force known as Scaldra in 1999, in Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 内奇·鲁莎卡少校。1999 年，她在霍瓦尼亚负责指挥一支名为炽蛇军的军事力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The long and short of it is that I should never, ever, allow you two to meet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 总而言之，我万万不能让你们俩见面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She was - or is - being possessed by the Indifference. It's sharing her mind, using her like a puppet. Or she let it in. We don't know. We also don't know if she's actually back in control.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她曾——或正在——被虚空无情之物附身。那力量正占据她的意识，像操纵傀儡一样控制着她。或者说她主动放任它入侵。我们不得而知。同样也无法确认她是否已重新夺回了掌控。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you think it's wearing all the faces of people it comes into contact with... because it doesn't have one of its own?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你认为它用着所有接触过的人的面容……因为它没有自己的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I believe the Man in the Wall is choosing to wear our faces because it can't comprehend what it's like to be human. It's too "big," otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为墙中人选择用我们的面容，是因为它无法理解人类的存在状态。否则它就太"宏大"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you implying that Albrecht made Neci the puppet of the Indifference on purpose?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是说阿尔布雷希特故意让内奇沦为虚空无情之物的傀儡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We don't know that any of this is true. Any of it. This is all just speculation. All of this could be complete lies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们无法证实这些推测。任何一点都不属实。这一切纯属猜测。所有这些都可能完全是谎言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If he ripped a hole through to the Void in 1999, and let it in on purpose... that would explain why Warframes worked there in the first place... same with your time - without the Deimos heart, that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果他在 1999 年撕开通往虚空的裂缝故意放任其侵入……这也能解释战甲为何能在那里使用……你的时空也是如此——当然，前提是没有火卫二上的那颗"心"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You seem a little intimidated by the kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好像有点被这孩子吓到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What happened between you and Nitokh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和尼托之间发生了什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you were planning to betray the Orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你原本计划背叛奥罗金人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which one did you view as being worse than the other?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这两种你认为哪一个更可怕？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So that kind of scheme wasn't normal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以那种手段居然不算正常？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you clearly never got far enough to make your attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你显然从未走到尝试的地步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What happened to your plan?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的计划后来怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure if that's what you should be taking away from this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不太确定……那是不是你该从这件事里得出的结论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is nice to feel needed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 被需要的感觉真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I didn't intend to hurt you like this, and I'm sorry that I did, if this taught you what it was like to be on the other side of the Orokin Empire, that's a valuable lesson.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我不是故意这样伤害你，对此我深感抱歉，但如果这件事让你体会到了奥罗金帝国另一边的感受，那也是一个宝贵的教训。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I never intended for this to hurt you the way that it is. You shouldn't have to apologize for the way that the Orokin society operated - you didn't build it. You were trying to salvage it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我从未想过这件事会以这种方式伤害你。你不必为奥罗金社会的运作方式道歉——它并非你一手缔造的，你只是试图挽救它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You wanted to replace the Emperors and the Executors with yourself, you mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的意思是，你想用自己取代皇帝和执行者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And who would that ruler be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那位统治者会是谁呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Great War?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那场大战？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Be honest with yourself, do you think you ever would have given up power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 扪心自问，你认为自己会放弃权力吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't think you ever would have given up power, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我不信你会甘愿放弃权力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You wanted to replace the Emperors and the Executors with yourself, you mean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的意思是，你想用自己取代皇帝和执行者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And who would that ruler be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那位统治者会是谁呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you were a little kinder to Marie and Lyon, they might be kinder to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你对玛丽和里昂友善一些，他们或许也会对你友善一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you not get along with him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和他关系不好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They mean well, even if they are going about it not in the best way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们的出发点是好的，即使他们用的方式并不完美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't you feel like you need to be forgiven for the things you've done?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不觉得你需要为你所做的事情寻求宽恕吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They're just trying to help you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们​只​是​想​帮助​你​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're leaving an important bullet off that list.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你还漏掉了一个重要的忏悔对象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're an Orokin. You've committed atrocities in war and by the nature of your society. You have a lot to atone for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是奥罗金人。在战争中犯下了滔天罪行，并且你的出身本身就是罪。你有很多需要赎罪的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't you at least recognize that you've done terrible things in your life?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道你一点也不觉得自己这辈子做过很多可怕的事情吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do think it's worth reflecting on our deeds that have harmed people and attempting to understand how to make them right. But I don't think those two are going about it the right way at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为反思我们伤害他人的行为并努力理解如何弥补是值得的。但我认为他们俩的做法完全不对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't believe in the need to forgive anyone other than yourself, in the end. If you're comfortable with the deeds you've done? So be it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说到底，我认为除了自己以外，没有必要原谅任何人。如果你能对自己做过的事释怀，那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You were born into a society where a lot of Orokin behavior was just... normal. Expected. It wasn't "wrong" to you. I'm not saying it makes it okay, just understandable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你出生在一个奥罗金的社会，在那种社会里，很多奥罗金人的行为都被视为……正常，理所当然。在你看来，这些行为并没有"错"。我并不是说这就能让这些行为变得合理，只是说这可以理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You were planning on overthrowing the Orokin. You knew they were corrupt, and you were trying to fix them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你原本计划推翻奥罗金人。你知道他们腐败堕落，你想改变他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your own people who you were about to betray.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你即将背叛的自己人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Sentients you slaughtered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些被你屠杀的 Sentient。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgiveness from others is important.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 得到他人的宽恕还是很重要的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You can change how you act in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以改变你未来的行事方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So I think that even if you were planning on reshaping it in your own image? You knew it had to change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以我觉得，即使你打算按照自己的想法重新塑造它，你也知道它必须改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. But the Sentients are a different situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不会。但 Sentient 的情况是不一样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。我会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How I feel about the lives I have to take is my own business. We're talking about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对于自己必须夺走的生命有何感受，那是我的私事。我们现在说的是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon seems to be contending with enough of his own problems, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂似乎已经够忙的了，你不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm sorry, you're doing what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不好意思，你要做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your context was different to ours, now. And what we see as cruel and terrible you were raised to see as just another part of how the world worked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你们所处的时代和我们现在的时代不同。而我们眼中的残酷和可怕，在你们从小接受的教育中，只是世界运转的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It still doesn't excuse everything you did - travesties are travesties and horrors are horrors. But you were trying.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这并不能为你的所作所为开脱——暴行就是暴行，恐怖事件就是恐怖事件。但你至少尝试过了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: From my point of view, you were at war and trying to navigate a society of sociopaths while planning to overthrow it all at the same time. And they labeled you a devil for it. I don't think that's fair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在我看来，你当时身处战乱之中，一边要周旋于一群反社会人格者组成的社会，一边还要计划推翻他们。结果他们却因此给你贴上恶魔的标签。我觉得这不公平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For running.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为你的逃避。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For failing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为你的失败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Does Lyon want your help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂需要你的帮助吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you think that makes things better for him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得这样对他来说会更好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You think Rell's sacrifice was for nothing?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你认为 Rell 的牺牲毫无意义吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Rell was the only thing holding that thing back, all those years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这么多年来，只有 Rell 才能阻止这件事发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's possible what you're saying is true. I just... don't know that it is. And I don't know that it isn't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说的或许是真的。我只是……不确定那个"它"是不是虚空无情之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was powerful before it got to Rell. He wouldn't have sacrificed himself like that without good reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在它找上 Rell 之前，它就已经非常强大了。如果没有充分的理由，他是不会那样牺牲自己的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How were you planning on overthrowing the Executors?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你本来打算怎么推翻执行者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm curious to know if you regret any of it, honestly. If you'd go back and change any of what you planned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很想知道你是否后悔过这些决定，说实话。如果你可以重来，你会不会改变你之前的计划？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm fascinated by the idea of what it would have been like to try to come up with a plan like that. It must have been a masterpiece.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很好奇，要想出这样一个计划会是怎样的感觉。那一定是项杰作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It might honestly be good to know, if you hid any of those weapons anywhere that are still accessible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 老实说，如果能知道你把那些武器藏在了可以找到的地方，或许是件好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm trying to get you to a place where you know why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想让你明白其中的缘由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm still sorry I broke your trust, Roathe. I wasn't trying to, believe it or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我还是很抱歉辜负了你的信任。信不信由你，我不是故意的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know. And I'm still so sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道。我还是感到非常抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What if your plan didn't work?
