/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你的计划失败了怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what were you going to do then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你之后打算怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What did you plan to do about Nitokh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你打算如何对付尼托？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is a lot buried in that sentence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这句话里蕴含着很多信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What kind of negotiations?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么样的谈判？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You told me everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你把一切都告诉我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then I won't push you to tell me more than you want to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那我就不会强迫你告诉我你不想说的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would have run, personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果是我我会跑路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You would have just accepted death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你就这样接受了死亡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What was phase two?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 第二阶段是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Killing Nitokh?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 杀了尼托？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And were you okay with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对此不介意吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not a terribly good idea to threaten you, if she wanted your loyalty.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果​她​想​要​你​的​忠诚，​就​不​应该​威胁​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And she was okay with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她对此并不介意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You both just knew you were out to kill each other?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你们俩早就知道彼此要杀了对方？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Business partners?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 商业伙伴？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Partners, how?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 伙伴，什么伙伴？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Did you care about her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你在乎她吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Did you love her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你爱过她吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Did you trust her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你信任她吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't regret what you did. You made your choices. There's no going back. Only forward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不要后悔你做过的事。你已经做出了选择，没有回头路，只能向前看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing we can do is make up for what we've done before is to look ahead with clear eyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为了弥补​我们​以前​所犯​的​错误，我们​唯​一​能​做​的​，​​就​是​目光​坚定​地​向​前看。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That was... vivid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那真是……生动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And yet you were sleeping with her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而你却和她发生了关系？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Noted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That wasn't going to be a problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那不会是个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you have those thoughts about all your lovers? Or just her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对所有恋人都有这种想法吗？还是只对她有？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No apology necessary. I'm just still shocked at how much you hated your own people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无​需道歉。​我​只是​仍然​震惊于​你​对​自己​的​同族​竟如此​憎恨。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How can both of those things be true at the same time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这两件事怎么可能同时成立呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That was... vivid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那真是……生动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Sorry. You aren't my type.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有，抱歉，你不是我喜欢的类型。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are. I just don't trust you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你有。只是我信任你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll take that to heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会记住的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wasn't planning on it, but thank you for the advice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本来就没打算这么做，不过谢谢你的建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You've never been in love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你从来没有恋爱过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么​意思？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you have those thoughts about all your lovers? Or just her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对所有恋人都有这种想法吗？还是只对她有？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wasn't planning on it, but thank you for the advice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本来就没打算这么做，不过谢谢你的建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll take that to heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会记住的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No apology necessary. I'm just still shocked at how much you hated your own people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无​需道歉。​我​只是​仍然​震惊于​你​对​自己​的​同族​竟如此​憎恨。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I never thought about Orokin board meetings, until right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这么一说，我在想奥罗金的高层会议是什么样的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't think I'd trust you with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得在这件事上我不能完全信任你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really? You'd... help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？你会……帮忙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其实是里昂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其实是玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess feelings.] ...Yes..
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意] ……有……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's none of your business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这不关你的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You've never been in love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你从来没有恋爱过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么​意思？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't seem surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你看起来似乎并不惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wasn't sure how you were going to react.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定你会有什么反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do. Just none of you are "it."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有的。只是"那个人"不是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do. My heart belongs to someone already, but these things take time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有的。我已经心有所属了，但这种事需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm already with someone, though. Wouldn't that be a problem for you? Or Marie and Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我已经有对象了。这对你来说不是问题吗？对玛丽和里昂来说也不是问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm already in a relationship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我已经在谈恋爱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's someone you wouldn't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是你不认识的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是里昂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's none of your business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这不关你的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know. Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do. And I hope it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱他们，我也希望他们也如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's none of your business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这不关你的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thanks. I guess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't need to take dating advice from an Orokin. Or any advice from from an Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不需要接受奥罗金人的恋爱建议。或者说，我不需要接受任何奥罗金人的建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You've never been in love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你从来没有恋爱过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't think I'd trust you with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这件事我不能完全信任你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really? You'd... help?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？你会……帮忙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't seem surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你看起来似乎并不惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wasn't sure how you were going to react.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定你会有什么反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't take orders from you, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我不会听你的命令。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I've been busy. I'll get on it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我最近很忙，我会尽快处理的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I've been kind of struggling with it, honestly... I keep dying, no matter how hard I try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我一直有点儿吃力……不管我多么努力，我总是失败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They don't seem pleasant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些记忆​看起来​并不​算愉快。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They don't seem pleasant. Are you sure we should keep going?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些记忆看起来不太愉快。你确定我们要继续下去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're piloting this ship. If you want to keep sailing it into the black hole, full speed ahead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是这艘船的驾驶员。如果你想继续驾驶它驶向黑洞，那就全速前进吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure you want to keep going, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你确定要继续下去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We are very different people, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，​我们​完全​不​一样。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was. Memory and apathy. I still can't remember... whole chunks of time, there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。记忆和麻木。我至今仍然记不起……大段大段的时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think it's better to know than to not know, but... we have to be prepared for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为知道总比不知道好，但是……我们必须做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sometimes I think things should stay buried for a reason.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有时候我觉得有些事应该永远埋藏起来是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's yours. It's time for us to go get it. How bad could it be? You're an Orokin, you've done worse things, certainly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那是你的记忆。我们该去把它拿回来了。能有多糟？你是奥罗金人，你肯定做过更糟糕的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or, you just enjoy talking to me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者，你只是喜欢和我聊天？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll try not to take that personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会尽量不往心里去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I look forward to our conversations, whether you do or not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论你是否期待我们的对话，我都期待着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I understand. It's a hard thing to accept, and you might want to, but can't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我理解。这很难接受，你可能想接受，但却做不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you... don't forgive me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你……不原谅我了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're going to just have to accept what happened and move on, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你只能接受已经发生的事情，然后继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think you can ever forgive me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得你能原谅我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm the one who should be asking for patience from you, Roathe. Not the other way around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，应该是我请求你耐心等待，而不是反过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're right. I would. It's time for us to go get it. How bad could it be? You're an Orokin, you've done worse things, certainly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说的对。我会去的。我们该去把它拿回来了。能有多糟？你是奥罗金人，你肯定做过更糟糕的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What could possibly be troubling you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有什么会困扰到你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ask away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Letting the Indifference destroy the Origin System - or anywhere else - doesn't help anyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 任由虚空无情之物摧毁始源星系——或者摧毁任何其他地方——对任何人都没有好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't obey Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我并不服从英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have my own reasons. And they're mine to keep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我有我自己的理由。而且这些理由我不会告诉任何人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why are you picking at this? What are you really trying to ask me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为什么老是纠缠这个问题？你到底想问我什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I haven't really thought that far in advance, to be honest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我真的还没考虑过那么远。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I intend to make him pay for making such a mess. He has a lot to atone for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一定会让他为造成的混乱付出代价。他有很多罪过需要弥补。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Assuming I survive, you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是说，假设我能活下来的话？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go where I'm needed, like I always do. Problems tend to find me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哪里需要我，我就去哪里，就像我一直以来做的那样。麻烦总是会找上门来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why are you trying so hard to make me angry?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为什么这么努力地想惹我生气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm just doing what I have to do to help people get out of the miserable situations they're in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是在做我该做的事，帮助人们摆脱他们所处的悲惨境地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have a place where I belong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我有属于我的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You don't know what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你根本不知道自己在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're no different than Albrecht. He's going through time causing all these problems. And you want to do that to whole dimensions?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和阿尔布雷希特没什么两样。他穿越时空，制造了这么多问题。而你竟然想对整个维度都这么做？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That's the problem with you Orokin. You think whole worlds are just yours to do with as you please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这就是你们奥罗金人的问题所在。你以为整个世界都只是你的私有财产，你可以随心所欲地支配它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm happy with what I'm doing. I'm helping people the way I want to be helping people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很喜欢我现在做的事情。我正在以我想要的方式帮助别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure if you can wrap your head around this, but try: I don't want to rule a universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道你能不能理解，但请试着想想：我不想统治一个宇宙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would make me no better than Albrecht. Or the Orokin. Rampaging around remaking the world in my image. I'm not interested in that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那样我就跟阿尔布雷希特或者奥罗金人没什么两样了，到处横行霸道，按照我的意愿重塑世界。我对那种事没兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm happy with what I'm doing. I'm helping people the way I want to be helping people.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很喜欢我现在做的事情。我正在以我想要的方式帮助别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure if you can wrap your head around this, but try: I don't want to rule a universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道你能不能理解，但请试着想想：我不想统治一个宇宙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would make me no better than Albrecht. Or the Orokin. Rampaging around remaking the world in my image. I'm not interested in that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那样我就跟阿尔布雷希特或者奥罗金人没什么两样了，到处横行霸道，按照我的意愿重塑世界。我对那种事没兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you think it's small to do what I do, sure. That's your opinion. What I've done has rewritten history.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你觉得我做的事渺小，那没问题。那是你的看法。但我所做的事已经改写了历史。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not small. Unseen. Let everyone run around drawing attention. I'll stay in the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是渺小。只是不显眼。让别人去吸引注意吧，我自会待在暗处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because helping people when they need it is how we are going to get out of this mess in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为在人们需要帮助的时候伸出援手，才是我们最终摆脱困境的办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because I'm doing what needs to be done. Nothing more, nothing less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我只是在做我该做的事。仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have you ever been in love, Roathe? Or cared about someone so strongly you would burn the universe down for them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你恋爱过吗？或者，你有没有那么深爱过一个人，以至于愿意为他毁灭整个宇宙？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You said you've never know what it's like to be loved. I don't think you understand how powerful it can be in changing how the world around you can work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说你从未体会过被爱的滋味。我想你永远不会明白，爱能有多么强大，它能改变你周围的世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Be patient. We have to deal with the Indifference, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 耐心点。我们首先要对付的是虚空无情之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Maybe, once all of this has blown over. But not right now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许等这一切风波过去之后吧。但现在还不是时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you think I'd choose you to do it with? Don't make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得我会选你一起做这件事吗？别逗我笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm just saying that you seem to be really mad about the idea of people no longer being miserable. And you seem to be taking that very personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说，你似乎对人们不再痛苦这件事非常生气，而且你好像把这件事看得太重了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The point I was trying to make was simply that if "the Indifference" feeds off a lack of emotions, having them might be the key to defeating it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想要表达的观点很简单：如果"虚空无情之物"源于情感的匮乏，那么拥有情感或许就是战胜它的关键。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think it's impossible for someone to love you? Or do you think you're not capable of feeling love for someone else? Or do you think it just hasn't happened yet?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得别人不可能爱你吗？还是你认为自己没有能力爱上别人？又或者你认为只是缘分未到？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He views people as more than simply expendable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他觉得人不只是可有可无的消耗品。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Gerivaine?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 格丽维娜？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I figured the Orokin wouldn't have a problem with sacrificing things they cared about. You all seemed extremely cutthroat with each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我原以为奥罗金人不会介意牺牲他们在乎的东西。你们看起来对彼此极其冷酷无情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How do you figure?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to offend you. I honestly don't remember much of Orokin society myself - I was on the outside of it, looking in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对不起，我不是有意冒犯你。老实说，我自己对奥罗金社会也没什么印象——我是局外人，只是旁观而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sorry if what I remember of Orokin society wasn't great. Mostly recorded statements barking orders at me out of speaker systems. That was before I was trapped in the Void...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我对奥罗金社会的记忆不太美好，请见谅。我记忆中大多是扬声器系统里传出的录音命令。那是在我被困于虚空之前的事了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I still wonder if this is the best idea...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​还​在​想​这​是​不​是​最好​的​想法……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If we manage to convince Loid to go upstairs, what do you plan on doing then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们成功说服洛德上楼，你接下来打算做什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am glad we managed to convince Loid to go upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴我们成功说服洛德上了楼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know you can't remember why we did it, but it was a good thing that we managed to get Loid upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道你可能不记得我们为什么要这么做了，但我们成功地让洛德上楼是件好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有，你为什么这么问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Stay away from the Cavia, Roathe. It makes me nervous.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，离科维兽远点。你这样让我总觉得不安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why are you spending so much time with the Cavia, Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你为何总花这么多时间在科维兽上？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He doesn't know who you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他不知道你是谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bird 3 loves everyone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 鸟三喜欢所有人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You like to surround yourself with people that make you feel smart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你喜欢和那些让你觉得自己很聪明的人在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He has keen observations on the people around him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他对周围的人观察力很敏锐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He's easy to manipulate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他很容易操纵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You can let it all go, you know. You can change. Even here, even now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道，你可以放下一切。你可以改变。即便是在这里，即便是现在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It must be an awful burden. Dealing with the expectations of your reputation wherever you go, even here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一定是一个沉重的负担。无论走到哪里，即使在这里，你都得承受人们对你恶名的期望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you implying that the rest of this is some kind of show you put on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的意思是说，剩下的部分都是你精心策划的一场表演吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pardon if this seems rude but... your life sounds like it's been a lonely one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果这话听起来冒犯了你，请见谅……听起来你的生活似乎很孤独。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're not accustomed to having many friends, are you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不太习惯有很多朋友，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You keep calling me "Usurper." Yet you're the one who was trying to overthrow the Orokin Empire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你老是叫我"篡位者"。可是，真正试图推翻奥罗金帝国的人却是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe, why do you keep calling me "Usurper?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你为什么老是叫我"篡位者"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You keep calling me "Usurper." Is that supposed to be an insult?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你一直叫我"篡位者"。这是在侮辱我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm just saying that it's kind of rich coming from you as an insult, when you're guilty of the same thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说，你这样称呼我来侮辱人，真是讽刺，因为你自己也犯了同样的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm just trying to figure out why you keep using it as a title for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想弄清楚你为什么一直给我起这个外号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So... you're insulting me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以……你是在侮辱我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Okay. So why keep using that as a title?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好​吧。​那​为什么​还​一直​叫​我​这个​外号？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Were all Orokin like you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所有奥罗金人都像你一样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I asked you nicely to call me something else, would you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我好好跟你说请你换个称呼，你会吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll put up with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我忍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Stop calling me Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别再叫我篡位者了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why haven't you just... killed everyone, Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你为什么不干脆……把所有人都杀了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I just don't understand why "The Devil of Tau" is content to sit in a crypt and twiddle his thumbs. Especially since we don't have any kind of deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我实在不明白，为什么"Tau 之恶魔"甘愿待在墓穴里无所事事。尤其是在我们之间没有任何交易的情况下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have the means. You have the strength. You've been vocal enough about your distaste for your situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你有手段，也有实力，你已经充分表达了对现状的不满。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I just don't understand why "The Devil of Tau" is content to sit in a crypt and twiddle his thumbs. Even with our deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我实在不明白，为什么"Tau 之恶魔"甘愿待在墓穴里无所事事。尤其是我们达成了交易之后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're Orokin. You clearly hate everyone around you. What's stopping you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是奥罗金人。很显然你憎恨周围的每一个人。是什么让你没这么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Even Marie and Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 连玛丽和里昂也算在内吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There's no other reason you're letting everyone live?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 除此之外，你没有其他让所有人都活下来的理由吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So, the only reason you've let everyone live is because it'd be pointless to kill them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，你放过所有人的唯一原因就是因为杀了他们毫无意义？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's okay to admit you're enjoying the company. People can do more than simply serve a utilitarian purpose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 承认自己享受与人相处的时光也无妨。人存在的意义远不止于提供实用价值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's okay to admit that we stave off the loneliness, even if we do annoy you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 承认我们能排解你的孤独感也无妨，虽然我们会惹你心烦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not having this conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不想继续这个话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What? Why...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？为什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She's fine. You don't know what you're talking about.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她没事。你根本不知道自己在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lost control of her circuitry? What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她​的​神经线路​出现​失控？你这话是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I'm not doing this. The Lotus saved my life. She's saved the Tenno's lives countless times. We owe everything to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我不会这么做。Lotus 救了我的命。她无数次拯救了 Tenno 的生命。我们的一切都归功于她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Shut up Roathe, I'm not doing this. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，闭嘴，我不和你聊了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know, I'm worried too. But she's done so much for us, and I can't turn my back on her. I have to support her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道，我也很担心。但她为我们做了那么多，我不能背弃她。我必须支持她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is asinine. No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这太蠢了。不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There's like... I don't know, a hundred of them. And one of me, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们大概有……我不知道，一百个吧。还有一个是我，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't even know where to start.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我甚至不知道该从哪里开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This isn't a game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这不是游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For the last time? No. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还要我说最后一次吗？不行。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're implying the Tenno are evil, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你现在是在暗示 Tenno 是邪恶的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What're you saying?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你在说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I'm done. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。我不想聊了。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe? Go to Hell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟？下地狱吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not going to call them into this mess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会把他们卷入这场混乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm alarmed at how much thought you've put into this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你在这件事上居然想了这么多，我都有点害怕了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Okay. Sure. Go ahead. I'll listen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好，没问题，请讲，我会听的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I'm done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不用了。我受够了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll... keep an eye on things. Okay? But I'm not going behind anyone's backs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会……密切关注事态发展。好吗？但我不会背着任何人做事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I really, really hate that I kind of agree with you here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真的非常讨厌我竟然在某种程度上同意你的观点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You realize I suffered just as much as the Tenno did, right?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道我承受的痛苦和 Tenno 一样多，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not betraying their trust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会背叛他们的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now I'm intrigued.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在我很好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sure. Ask away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，尽管问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not in the mood. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我没心情。[结束。]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're asking me this after telling me that story about Ballas and Margulis, and it's not about him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你跟我讲了 Ballas 和 Margulis 的故事之后，却问我这个问题，还说这不是在说他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Orokin who told me he has never known love just happens to ask me that question, and it's not about him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个​告诉​我​他​从​未​体验​过​爱情​的​奥罗金人​居然问​了​我​这个​问题，​还说这不是在说他？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Orokin who served an Executor as her concubine but then schemed to betray her asks me this and it's not about him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个​曾​做​过​执行者​的​男宠，​后来​却​密谋背叛​她​的​奥罗金人​居然问​我​这个​问题，还说这不是在说他？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: After what Albrecht did to you, and all this "can an Orokin be redeemed" business, and it's not about him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特对你做了那样的事，再加上你那些"奥罗金人能否得到救赎"的话题，还说这不是在说他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Okay, I'll play along. Do I believe that "everyone deserves to be loved?" Clearly this is a question about morality and value.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我就配合一下。我是否相信"每个人都值得被爱"？这显然是一个关于道德和价值观的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You really expect me to believe this is just a philosophical question?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真以为我会相信这只是个哲学问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Either speak plainly, or don't speak at all. If you're not going to tell me who this is really about, then I'm not going to waste my time talking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要么直说，要么就别说。如果你不打算告诉我这个问题到底是关于谁的，那我就不会浪费时间跟你谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. We'll play your little proverbial game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，咱们来玩你这套小游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Let him continue.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [让他继续]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Devil?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恶魔？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I mean...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我是说……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There have to be deeds that are evil purely on their own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有些行为本身就是纯粹的邪恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're saying one person needs a second person to be "evil?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的意思是说，一个人需要另一个人才能"作恶"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know if I agree with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不太确定我是否同意这种说法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Say you're right. Say you've convinced me, and good and evil are just... social constructs. What then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 假设你是对的。假设你说服了我，善恶只是……社会建构。那又会怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do think actions can be good or evil outside of their social context. Otherwise, why would so many of them be similar across vastly different societies?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为行为本身可以脱离其社会背景而具有善恶之分。否则，为什么在截然不同的社会中，许多行为会如此相似呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But for the sake of argument, keep going.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但为了方便讨论，我们继续下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's probably best we stop here. I don't see this going well. [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们最好就此打住。我觉得这个话题不会有好结果。[结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because they are incapable of love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为他们不具备爱的能力？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because they have no room in their heart for love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为他们的心中没有爱的位置？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because they don't deserve to be loved?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为他们不值得被爱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because we are trying to teach a lesson?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我们想给他们一个教训？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It's hard to reconcile the fact that someone is "evil" and also capable of love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很难理解一个人既是"邪恶的"，又是有爱的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That perhaps their "evil deeds" could still be redeemable through love?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许他们的"恶行"仍然可以通过爱来救赎？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That those who do "evil things" could still have value to someone else in this world, and therefore are not "pure evil?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些做了"坏事"的人，对世界上其他人来说仍然可能具有价值，因此他们并非"纯粹的恶人"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because love is the ultimate human emotion, and if we allow ourselves to think someone can be loved, it humanizes them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为爱是人类最深沉的情感，如果我们允许自己认为某人可以被爱，那就赋予了他们人性。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because evil has to look into the mirror and work to change itself. It has to be punished. And to love and be loved is the ultimate reward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为邪恶必须反省自身，努力改过自新。它必须受到惩罚。而爱与被爱，是最终的奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bits and pieces. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就一些片段。为什么这么问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was pretty young when we were put aboard the Zariman. And after that... well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很小的时候就被送上了扎里曼号。之后……嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Enough to know you all deserved to burn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 足以让我明白你们都罪有应得。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The... what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那是……什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I feel like I would remember that word if I'd heard it before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得要是我以前听过这个词，我应该会有印象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is this going to wind up being some terrible form of Orokin torture?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这​最​后​不​会​变成​某​种​极其​残酷​的​奥罗金酷刑​吧？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I feel like I would remember that word if I'd heard it before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得要是我以前听过这个词，我应该会有印象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't think you died. You just stole new bodies at the Yuvan Theatre.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不认为你们会死。你们只是在青春厅堂偷了新的肉体而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't think you died. You just stole new bodies at the Yuvan Theatre.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不认为你们会死。你们只是在青春厅堂偷了新的肉体而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I thought you had stolen humans to solve that problem. All you did was mock death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我以为你们已经通过偷走人类解决了这个问题。你所做的只是在嘲弄死亡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't think you died. You just stole new bodies at the Yuvan Theatre.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不认为你们会死。你们只是在青春厅堂偷了新的肉体而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 继续说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know enough about the practice to make a judgement call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对这种做法了解不够，无法做出判断。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do. I think it's disgusting what you all did. Everything written about the Yuvan Theatre says you stole children and wiped out their minds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对。我觉得你们的所作所为令人作呕。所有关于青春厅堂的记载都说你们拐走了孩子，还抹去了他们的意识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know enough about the practice to make a judgement call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对这种做法了解不够，无法做出判断。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do. I think it's disgusting what you all did. Everything written about the Yuvan Theatre says you stole children and wiped out their minds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对。我觉得你们的所作所为令人作呕。所有关于青春厅堂的记载都说你们拐走了孩子，还抹去了他们的意识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How could I not? You abducted children from their homes and wiped out their minds to replace them with their own!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我怎么可能不作呕？你们把孩子们从他们的家中掳走，抹去他们的记忆，换上你们自己的记忆！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 见过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It doesn't matter if I did or didn't, the accounts are clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我见没见过并不重要，记录写得很清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you telling me that you didn't abduct children for the Yuvan Theatre against their will?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是说你没有为了青春厅堂而违背儿童意愿绑架他们？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So what really happened at the Yuvan Theatre?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，青春厅堂究竟发生了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And how do you feel about this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你对此有何感想？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have you ever partaken in an unwilling sacrifice?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你有没有参与过违背他人意愿的献祭？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you asking to find out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这是想让我拿你做个示范？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I prefer chaos. Explosions. Gunfire. Loud noises. The more the merrier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我喜欢混乱。爆炸声。枪声。巨响。越多越好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Stealth. I prefer to take out my foe before they even know I'm there. I'd do it where they slept if I could.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 潜行。我喜欢在敌人察觉到我之前就解决掉他们。如果可以的话，我会在他们睡觉的地方动手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hate fighting. I wish I never had to do it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我讨厌战斗。我​一直都​希望​我​没​必要​去​战​斗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is a sick conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这话题简直让人作呕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll make do with whatever I can, honestly. I like to improvise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我会就地取材。我喜欢随机应变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A bow. Graceful and deadly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一把弓。优雅而致命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A blade. I like to get up close.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一把刀。我喜欢近距离接触。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Rifles and guns. Loud, but they get the job done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 步枪和各种枪械。声音大，但能完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'll make do with whatever I can, honestly. I like to improvise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我会就地取材。我喜欢随机应变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bow. Graceful and silent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 弓箭。优雅而无声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sniper rifle. One shot? One kill.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 狙击步枪。一枪毙命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Poison. I'm gone before they even know they're dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 毒药。我走的时候，他们甚至还没意识到自己已经死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Dagger. I like the intimacy of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 匕首。我喜欢它带来的贴身感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're making this sound like it's some kind of... artform.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这话说的好像这是某种……艺术形式似的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't like having to kill people, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我不喜欢杀人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what's your favorite?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你最喜欢哪个？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Even if the stories are false, they're still what you tell yourself about your formative years. They're still worth knowing.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm curious what it was like growing up as Orokin nobility.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm wondering what made "you." How you turned out like this.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your parents just shipped you off? For how long?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What about your parents?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Did you have any friends there?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe, wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Just hang on a second.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe, wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I truly love you. Whatever form you take. Whoever you choose to be. I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真的很爱你。无论你以何种形式出现。无论你选择成为谁。我都爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It won't take away the pain of the deeper memories, Roathe... just these surface ones. It won't solve the problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，这并不能消除深层记忆带来的痛苦……只能消除这些表面的痛苦。这解决不了问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure? You want me to... wipe your memories again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？你想让我……再次抹去你的记忆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, Roathe. Let's talk this through. Starting over again isn't going to solve this. We have to stop this pattern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，罗瑟。我们好好谈谈。重新开始解决不了问题。我们必须打破这种模式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It won't take away the pain of the deeper memories, Roathe... just these surface ones. It won't solve the problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，这并不能消除深层记忆带来的痛苦……只能消除这些表面的痛苦。这解决不了问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure? You want me to... wipe your memories again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？你想让我……再次抹去你的记忆？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, Roathe. Let's talk this through. Starting over again isn't going to solve this. We have to stop this pattern.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，罗瑟。我们好好谈谈。重新开始解决不了问题。我们必须打破这种模式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I swear I didn't know! And even if I did, it doesn't change who you are, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我发誓我真的不知道！就算我知道，也改变不了你的为人，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What?! Calm down. Let's talk this through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？！冷静点。我们来好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hate me if you want. But I'm not going to do anything until we solve this, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以恨我。但在此之前，我不会采取任何行动，直到我们解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I forgot. I'm sorry!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我忘了。对不起！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't mean to lie to you, I just didn't realize it was that big of a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不是故意要骗你的，只是没想到事情会这么严重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know I broke my promise to you. I'm sorry for that. But what you've discovered is important and you have to face that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道我违背了对你的承诺，我很抱歉。但你发现的事情很重要，你必须面对现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What?! Calm down. Let's talk this through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？！冷静点。我们来好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I swear I didn't know! And even if I did, it doesn't change how I feel about you, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我发誓我真的不知道！就算我知道，也改变不了我对你的喜欢，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hate me if you want. But I'm not going to do anything until we solve this, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以恨我。但在此之前，我不会采取任何行动，直到我们解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I forgot. I'm sorry!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我忘了。对不起！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't mean to lie to you, I just didn't realize it was that big of a deal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不是故意要骗你的，只是没想到事情会这么严重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know I broke my promise to you. I'm sorry for that. But we can face this together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道我违背了对你的承诺，我很抱歉。但我们可以一起面对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did what I did because it needed to happen. You couldn't hide from this any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我这么做是因为必须这么做。你再也无法逃避了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think of me what you will. But I know a spiral when I see one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你要怎么想我都行。但这种失控，我一眼就认出来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Be mad at me. Hate me if you want. But let's solve this, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以生我的气，恨我也没问题。但我们先来解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Calm down. Let's talk this through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 冷静点。我们来好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which is what...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是什么事……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I know what you're going to ask, and the answer is already no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。​我​知道​你​要​请​求​什么，​答案​就​是​不行。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did what I did because it needed to happen. You couldn't hide from this any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我这么做是因为必须这么做。你再也无法逃避了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think of me what you will. But I know a spiral when I see one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你要怎么想我都行。但这种失控，我一眼就认出来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Please. Calm down. We don't need to resort to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请你冷静，我们没必要走到那一步。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Be mad at me. Hate me if you want. But I'm not going to do anything until we solve this, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以生我的气，恨我也没问题。但在此之前，我不会采取任何行动，直到我们解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you want to choose to blaze a path on your own? For yourself? Do it. Don't apologize. But that is your path to choose, no one else's.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想选择走出一条属于自己的道路？为了你自己？那就去做吧。不要道歉。但那是你自己的选择，不是别人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you wish to seek forgiveness, you can. But you need to want it. You need to choose that path. No one else can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想寻求宽恕，你可以。但你必须真心想要宽恕。你必须自己选择这条路。没有人能替你做决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you want to choose to blaze a path on your own? For yourself? Do it. Don't apologize. But that is your path to choose, no one else's.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想选择走出一条属于自己的道路？为了你自己？那就去做吧。不要道歉。但那是你自己的选择，不是别人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you wish to seek forgiveness, you can. But you need to want it. You need to choose that path. No one else can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想寻求宽恕，你可以。但你必须真心想要宽恕。你必须自己选择这条路。没有人能替你做决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. Be angry. But use that anger for something worthwhile. Use it to shake loose all this hatred you have in you that you're pointing in the wrong direction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好，生气就生气。但要把这份愤怒用在有意义的事情上。用它把你内心所有指向错误方向的仇恨都释放出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Being angry isn't going to solve anything, Roathe. You're angry because you're scared to face what you did. And what you've become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，生气解决不了任何问题。你生气是因为你害怕面对你所做的一切，以及你变成了什么样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 周围人的意见或他们对你行为的看法定义不了你，唯一能定义你自己的，是你如何看待自己以及你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by your past, Roathe. You are defined by your future. And you still have a future to spend, unlike all the Orokin who died at the Night of the Naga Drums.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你的过去并不能定义你，你的未来才能定义你。而且，你还有美好的未来可以去体验，不像那些在长胴鼓之夜死去的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. Be angry. But use that anger for something worthwhile. Use it to shake loose all this hatred you have in you that you're pointing in the wrong direction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好，生气就生气。但要把这份愤怒用在有意义的事情上。用它把你内心所有指向错误方向的仇恨都释放出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Being angry isn't going to solve anything, Roathe. You're angry because you're scared to face what you did. And what you've become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，生气解决不了任何问题。你生气是因为你害怕面对你所做的一切，以及你变成了什么样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 周围人的意见或他们对你行为的看法定义不了你，唯一能定义你自己的，是你如何看待自己以及你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by your past, Roathe. You are defined by your future. And you still have a future to spend, unlike all the Orokin who died at the Night of the Naga Drums.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你的过去并不能定义你，你的未来才能定义你。而且，你还有美好的未来可以去体验，不像那些在长胴鼓之夜死去的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How much of your life have you spent hiding from the real you, Roathe? How much of your life have you spent hiding behind a mask, this facade?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你一生中究竟有多少时间是在隐藏真实的自己？你一生中究竟有多少时间是在面具、在伪装之后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know what it's like to always try to escape something you feel like you can never be free of. To try to run from something that will always follow you, no matter how far you go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道那种总是试图逃离却感觉永远无法摆脱的东西的滋味。试图逃离无论你跑多远都会如影随形的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Being angry isn't going to solve anything, Roathe. You're angry because you're scared to face what you did. And what you've become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，生气解决不了任何问题。你生气是因为你害怕面对你所做的一切，以及你变成了什么样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. Be angry. But use that anger for something worthwhile. Use it to shake loose all this hatred you have in you that you're pointing in the wrong direction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好，生气就生气。但要把这份愤怒用在有意义的事情上。用它把你内心所有指向错误方向的仇恨都释放出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I just wish I knew how to help you. I wish I knew what to say. It feels like you're torn in two directions. Which way do you want to go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我知道该怎么帮你。我真希望我知道该说些什么。现在你像是被两股力量撕扯着。你想往哪一边走呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're pointing it at yourself. You should be pointing it at the world that is blaming you for doing the best you could to save it from the Orokin Empire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​这是在把​矛头​指向​了​自己。​你​应该​指向​的​是​这个​世界，​你​尽​了​全力​去​拯救​它​免​遭奥罗金​帝国​的​蹂躏，​它​却​在​责怪​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're letting that anger tear you up inside. You could be using it to help you fight the people who are still destroying this world today. Here. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这是在让愤怒吞噬自己。你本可以利用它来对抗那些至今仍在破坏这个世界的人。就在此刻。就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实很简单：你是极少数的、在我们所知的在长胴鼓之夜幸存下来的奥罗金人之一。在我看来，那是一次战略性撤退。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，只有这件样才能定义你。你可以改变，也可以改变你周围的世界。我想问的只是，你至少愿意尝试一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The serum memory, that is different, Roathe. It won't work on them. It's buried deeper in your psyche. But the rest... that I can take away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，那个血清的记忆，是不一样的。这段记忆是抹不去的。因为它深埋在你潜意识深处。但其他的……我可以带走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 逃避真相是行不通的。我们最终只会回到原点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？但是……你很聪明，我感觉你会察觉到有些不对劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Being angry isn't going to solve anything, Roathe. You're angry because you're scared to face what you did. And what you've become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，生气解决不了任何问题。你生气是因为你害怕面对你所做的一切，以及你变成了什么样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. Be angry. But use that anger for something worthwhile. Use it to shake loose all this hatred you have in you that you're pointing in the wrong direction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好，生气就生气。但要把这份愤怒用在有意义的事情上。用它把你内心所有指向错误方向的仇恨都释放出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All I want to know is, have you decided how you feel about running away?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只想知道，你决定好不会再逃避了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're pointing it at yourself. You should be pointing it at the world that is blaming you for doing the best you could to save it from the Orokin Empire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​这是在把​矛头​指向​了​自己。​你​应该​指向​的​是​这个​世界，​你​尽​了​全力​去​拯救​它​免​遭奥罗金​帝国​的​蹂躏，​它​却​在​责怪​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're letting that anger tear you up inside. You could be using it to help you fight the people who are still destroying this world today. Here. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这是在让愤怒吞噬自己。你本可以利用它来对抗那些至今仍在破坏这个世界的人。就在此刻。就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How much of your life have you spent hiding from the real you, Roathe? How much of your life have you spent hiding behind a mask, this facade?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你一生中究竟有多少时间是在隐藏真实的自己？你一生中究竟有多少时间是在面具、在伪装之后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know what it's like to always try to escape something you feel like you can never be free of. To try to run from something that will always follow you, no matter how far you go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道那种总是试图逃离却感觉永远无法摆脱的东西的滋味。试图逃离无论你跑多远都会如影随形的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实很简单：你是极少数的、在我们所知的在长胴鼓之夜幸存下来的奥罗金人之一。在我看来，那是一次战略性撤退。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，只有这件样才能定义你。你可以改变，也可以改变你周围的世界。我想问的只是，你至少愿意尝试一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know what it's like to always try to escape something you feel like you can never be free of. To try to run from something that will always follow you, no matter how far you go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道那种总是试图逃离却感觉永远无法摆脱的东西的滋味。试图逃离无论你跑多远都会如影随形的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know. Nothing about any of this is fair. But nothing about life is fair, is it? But you're used to that. And you're used to making it work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道。这一切都不公平。但人生本来就不公平，不是吗？但你已经习惯了。你也习惯了想办法应对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I just wish I knew how to help you. I wish I knew what to say. It feels like you're torn in two directions. Which way do you want to go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我知道该怎么帮你。我真希望我知道该说些什么。现在你像是被两股力量撕扯着。你想往哪一边走呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Playing these games. Dancing on other people's strings. Doing what's expected. When it's expected. How it's expected. Fighting other people's wars. This is what is tearing you apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玩这些游戏。像个舞者一样被人摆布。做别人期望你做的事。在期望的时间做。以期望的方式做。替别人打仗。这一切正在撕裂你的内心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Trust. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 周围人的意见或他们对你行为的看法定义不了你，唯一能定义你自己的，是你如何看待自己以及你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by your past, Roathe. You are defined by your future. And you still have a future to spend, unlike all the Orokin who died at the Night of the Naga Drums.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你的过去并不能定义你，你的未来才能定义你。而且，你还有美好的未来可以去体验，不像那些在长胴鼓之夜死去的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不多不少，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 试着原谅自己，然后继续向前走？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by your past, Roathe. You are defined by your future. And you still have a future to spend, unlike all the Orokin who died at the Night of the Naga Drums.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你的过去并不能定义你，你的未来才能定义你。而且，你还有美好的未来可以去体验，不像那些在长胴鼓之夜死去的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know what it's like to always try to escape something you feel like you can never be free of. To try to run from something that will always follow you, no matter how far you go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道那种总是试图逃离却感觉永远无法摆脱的东西的滋味。试图逃离无论你跑多远都会如影随形的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know. Nothing about any of this is fair. But nothing about life is fair, is it? But you're used to that. And you're used to making it work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道。这一切都不公平。但人生本来就不公平，不是吗？但你已经习惯了。你也习惯了想办法应对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I just wish I knew how to help you. I wish I knew what to say. It feels like you're torn in two directions. Which way do you want to go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我知道该怎么帮你。我真希望我知道该说些什么。现在你像是被两股力量撕扯着。你想往哪一边走呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Playing these games. Dancing on other people's strings. Doing what's expected. When it's expected. How it's expected. Fighting other people's wars. This is what is tearing you apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玩这些游戏。像个舞者一样被人摆布。做别人期望你做的事。在期望的时间做。以期望的方式做。替别人打仗。这一切正在撕裂你的内心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Trust. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不多不少，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 试着原谅自己，然后继续向前走？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This hate. This rage. This desire to burn it all down. That thing inside you wanting out? That's you. The real you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这种仇恨，这种愤怒，这种想要彻底摧毁一切的渴望，你内心深处想要挣脱束缚的那股力量？那就是你，真正的你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But at a certain point we have to turn around and face it head on. At a certain point there is no more running from it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但到了某个时候，我们必须转身直面它。到了那个时候，我们就再也无法逃避了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实很简单：你是极少数的、在我们所知的在长胴鼓之夜幸存下来的奥罗金人之一。在我看来，那是一次战略性撤退。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，只有这件样才能定义你。你可以改变，也可以改变你周围的世界。我想问的只是，你至少愿意尝试一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Stop running.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不要再逃避了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because at a certain point what we need to do is realize that what we're running from?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为在那个时刻，我们需要意识到我们究竟在逃避什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不多不少，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 试着原谅自己，然后继续向前走？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This can be a moment of pain, or it can be a moment of clarity. To see yourself stripped free of the shackles of everything that was put on you against your will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这可能是痛苦的时刻，也可能是顿悟的时刻。你会感觉自己挣脱了所有强加于你的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have the opportunity to rebuild yourself into someone free of the corruption of the society of the empire you were born into.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你有机会重塑自我，摆脱你出生的帝国社会的腐败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那就是我们自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know. Only you can answer that question, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。罗瑟，只有你能回答这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is an opportunity to make yourself into who you knew you could always become without anyone else holding you back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是一个机会，让你成为那个你一直知道自己能够成为的样子，不再有任何人阻拦你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think of what is ahead of you. Not who and what you used to be, but who and what you can become. And what you can use with the future before you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想想你的未来。不是你过去是谁，也不是你曾经是什么样的人，而是你能成为什么样的人。以及你能利用未来做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……真的没有其他办法了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I know what you're going to ask, and the answer is already no.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我……会做的。我会抹去你的记忆。即使这也会抹去玛丽和里昂的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I refuse. I'll find another way to convince you to move forward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我拒绝。我会想其他办法说服你继续向前看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need some time to think this through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要一些时间仔细考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？但是……你很聪明，我感觉你会察觉到有些不对劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But... Roathe, I love you.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess Feelings.] Roathe? I... don't know if this is a good time, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意]罗瑟？我……不知道现在是不是合适的时机，但是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you don't?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你不这么觉得吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're implying that what I feel for her isn't real. You couldn't be farther from the truth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的意思是说我对她的感觉不是真的。你完全错了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you don't?

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have. I think you're right. I don't think it existed before Entrati interacted with it. He wanted to find a god... so the Void spat something out that's pretending to be one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我有。我觉得你是对的。在英择谛接触它之前，它并不存在。他想找到一位神……于是虚空吐出了某种伪装成神的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have. I think the answer is somewhere in between. It may not have been a god before, but it is now. I think Entrati blinked it into existence the moment he opened the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我有。我认为答案介于两者之间。它或许曾经不是神，但现在是了。英择谛在打开虚空的瞬间便凭空创造了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It simply cannot understand what we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它根本无法理解我们是什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And we've been feeding it fear ever since.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我们自那以后就不断在喂养这种恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Like how Rell both Exists and Doesn't now, the Indifference never was a god, yet now, always has been.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如 Rell 如今既存在又不存在，虚空无情之物从来都不是神，却又始终如一地存在着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You can try.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以试试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No use.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没用的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What I am trying to say, is that it wasn't a god before, but it is one now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想说的是，它以前不是神，但现在是了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A supreme being. Something that has total and unquestionable authority or power.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至高无上的存在。拥有绝对且无可置疑的权威或力量之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A superhuman entity or creature that has power over a particular aspect of creation or human fortune.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一种超自然的存在或生物，能够掌控造物或人类命运的特定方面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure. You go first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定。你先说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Correct, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，正是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, but I think we might be getting caught up on how we're both defining what a "god" is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，但我觉得我们可能陷入了对"神"这个概念的定义之争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What I don't understand, is what good this does us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不明白的是，这对我们有什么好处？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why bother?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 何必呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. I believe so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。我认为是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure. You go first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定。你先说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A superhuman entity or creature that has power over a particular aspect of creation or human fortune.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一种超自然的存在或生物，能够掌控造物或人类命运的特定方面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: An entity that is beyond our comprehension. A creature that exists in a dimension outside ours, and, therefore, does not exist "like us."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一个超越我们理解范畴的存在。一个存在于我们之外的维度中的生物，因此它并不"像我们一样"存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My hope is to send him back to where he came from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望把他送回他来的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know. And I don't think anyone can know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。而且我认为没有人会知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I don't think so. Persistence of matter, and all that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。我不这么认为。考虑到物质的不灭性之类的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, I think so. Otherwise, we'd be overrun, wouldn't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我认为会。否则，我们早就被他们的数量彻底淹没了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sincerely hope so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真心希望如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No clue, honestly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我真不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everything can be killed. Even the Indifference. Somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 万物皆可被消灭。连虚空无情之物也不例外。总会有办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We might not be able to kill it, but that doesn't mean we can't stop it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许我们无法杀死它，但这并不意味着我们无法阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. I believe so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。我认为是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Indifference is a god and always was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空无情之物是神，且永远都是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Indifference is not a god and it never was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空无情之物不是神，从来都不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Indifference became a god when Entrati opened the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当英择谛开启虚空时，虚空无情之物便成为了神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't know!
