/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We might not be able to kill it, but that doesn't mean we can't stop it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许我们无法杀死它，但这并不意味着我们无法阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Somehow, we'll kill it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，我们会杀死它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I don't know if we can kill it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我不知道我们能否杀死它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Honestly, what do you think about Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，你对玛丽怎么看？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How are you and Lyon getting on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和里昂相处得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How are things going with you and the "zealots?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和"狂热分子"的关系怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't tell them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我没有告诉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did they find out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们是怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You three are stuck together anyway. Entrati saw to that. So, no harm in making the best of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 反正你们三个注定形影不离。英择谛早就安排好了。所以，尽量享受这段时光也不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm glad. I think they honestly care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很欣慰。我觉得他们是真的关心你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did they find out?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们是怎么知道的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I didn't tell them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我没有告诉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Has anything changed because of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为这个改变了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did Lyon react?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂是什么反应？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Has anything changed because of it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为这个改变了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did Marie react?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽是什么反应？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think he also knows what it's like to be a product of your society and your context. He might sympathize more with your past than you think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想他也明白成为社会产物和环境产物是什么滋味。他对你过去的经历可能比你想象中更感同身受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am just simply glad you two have found any kind of friendship at all. Even if it is just a ceasefire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是单纯地为你们俩能建立任何形式的友谊而感到高兴。哪怕这只是暂时的休战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What about Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Especially after everything she's learned about Entrati. She knows that people can be more complicated than simple black and white.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是在她了解了英择谛的一切之后。她知道人的本性远比简单的非黑即白要复杂得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am just simply glad you two have found any kind of friendship at all. Even if it is just a ceasefire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是单纯地为你们俩能建立任何形式的友谊而感到高兴。哪怕这只是暂时的休战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What about Lyon?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What did you do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thanks for the rousing support.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 感谢​你​的​热情​支持。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is there anything you can do to help me with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有什么办法能帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is there anything you can do to help me with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有什么办法能帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thanks for the rousing support.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 感谢​你​的​热情​支持。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is there anything you can do to help me with that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有什么办法能帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thanks for the rousing support.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 感谢​你​的​热情​支持。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder how Albrecht will react when he gets back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真想知道阿尔布雷希特回来后有什么反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder how the Entrati family will react.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真想知道英择谛家族会有什么反应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What "reasons" do you have to want to see Loid and the Entrati family reunited?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你有什么"理由"想看到洛德和英择谛家族团聚？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think it's better if you all stay down here in secret. Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你们还是悄悄待在这里比较好。抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All right. Fine. Let's try to get Loid up those stairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。行。我们试试让洛德上楼吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What are your motivations, anyway? You never said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你到底有什么目的？你从来没说过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Would you blame her for not trusting you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你会怪她不信任你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why do you say that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为什么这么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why, because of the pain that would cause them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？因为这会给他们带来痛苦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why do you say that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为什么这么说？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why, because of the pain that would cause them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？因为这会给他们带来痛苦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have no clue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我完全不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Marie will help us, but Lyon won't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽会帮我们，但里昂不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon will help us, but Marie won't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂会帮我们，但玛丽不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon will help us, but I don't know about Marie yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂会帮我们，但玛丽的情况我还不清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Marie will help us, but I don't know about Lyon yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽会帮我们，但里昂的情况我还不清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They're both on board to help us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们俩都愿意来帮我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon won't help us. I don't know about Marie yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂不会帮我们。玛丽的情况我还不清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Marie won't help us. I don't know about Lyon yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽不会帮我们。里昂的情况我还不清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Neither of them will help us. ... Sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们俩都不会帮我们。……抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？但是……你很聪明，我感觉你会察觉到有些不对劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，这段记忆，是不一样的。这段记忆是抹不去的。因为它深埋在你潜意识深处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 逃避真相是行不通的。我们最终只会回到原点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I can't do this. I won't do this. We have to face down this situation together. Can't we just talk about this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行，我做不到，我不会这么做。我们必须一起面对这个问题。我们能不能好好谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... there's really no other way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……真的没有其他办法了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我……会做的。我会抹去你的记忆。即使这也会抹去玛丽和里昂的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I refuse. I'm sorry. We have to face this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我拒绝。对不起。我们必须面对现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did what I did because it needed to happen. You couldn't hide from this any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我这么做是因为必须这么做。你再也无法逃避了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Let's talk this through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们来好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hate me if you want. But I'm not going to do anything until we solve this, first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以恨我。但在此之前，我不会采取任何行动，直到我们解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think of me what you will. But I know a spiral when I've seen one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你要怎么想我都行。但这种失控，我一眼就认出来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you want to choose to blaze a path on your own? For yourself? Do it. Don't apologize. But that is your path to choose, no one else's.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想选择走出一条属于自己的道路？为了你自己？那就去做吧。不要道歉。但那是你自己的选择，不是别人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you wish to seek forgiveness, you can. But you need to want it. You need to choose that path. No one else can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想寻求宽恕，你可以。但你必须真心想要宽恕。你必须自己选择这条路。没有人能替你做决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 周围人的意见或他们对你行为的看法定义不了你，唯一能定义你自己的，是你如何看待自己以及你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by your past, Roathe. You are defined by your future. And you still have a future to spend, unlike all the Orokin who died at the Night of the Naga Drums.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你的过去并不能定义你，你的未来才能定义你。而且，你还有美好的未来可以去体验，不像那些在长胴鼓之夜死去的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实很简单：你是极少数的、在我们所知的在长胴鼓之夜幸存下来的奥罗金人之一。在我看来，那是一次战略性撤退。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，只有这件样才能定义你。你可以改变，也可以改变你周围的世界。我想问的只是，你至少愿意尝试一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're pointing it at yourself. You should be pointing it at the world that is blaming you for doing the best you could to save it from the Orokin Empire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​这是在把​矛头​指向​了​自己。​你​应该​指向​的​是​这个​世界，​你​尽​了​全力​去​拯救​它​免​遭奥罗金​帝国​的​蹂躏，​它​却​在​责怪​你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're letting that anger tear you up inside. You could be using it to help you fight the people who are still destroying this world today. Here. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这是在让愤怒吞噬自己。你本可以利用它来对抗那些至今仍在破坏这个世界的人。就在此刻。就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're letting that anger tear you up inside. You could be using it to help you fight the people who are still destroying this world today. Here. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这是在让愤怒吞噬自己。你本可以利用它来对抗那些至今仍在破坏这个世界的人。就在此刻。就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Being angry isn't going to solve anything, Roathe. You're angry because you're scared to face what you did. And what you've become.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，生气解决不了任何问题。你生气是因为你害怕面对你所做的一切，以及你变成了什么样的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. Be angry. But use that anger for something worthwhile. Use it to shake loose all this hatred you have in you that you're pointing in the wrong direction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好，生气就生气。但要把这份愤怒用在有意义的事情上。用它把你内心所有指向错误方向的仇恨都释放出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I just wish I knew how to help you. I wish I knew what to say. It feels like you're torn in two directions. Which way do you want to go?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我知道该怎么帮你。我真希望我知道该说些什么。现在你像是被两股力量撕扯着。你想往哪一边走呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不多不少，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 试着原谅自己，然后继续向前走？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 周围人的意见或他们对你行为的看法定义不了你，唯一能定义你自己的，是你如何看待自己以及你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实很简单：你是极少数的、在我们所知的在长胴鼓之夜幸存下来的奥罗金人之一。在我看来，那是一次战略性撤退。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，只有这件样才能定义你。你可以改变，也可以改变你周围的世界。我想问的只是，你至少愿意尝试一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不多不少，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 试着原谅自己，然后继续向前走？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which is what...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是什么事……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I know what you're going to ask, and the answer is already no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。​我​知道​你​要​请​求​什么，​答案​就​是​不行。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，这段记忆，是不一样的。这段记忆是抹不去的。因为它深埋在你潜意识深处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I refuse. I'll find another way to convince you to move forward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我拒绝。我会想其他办法说服你继续向前看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我……会做的。我会抹去你的记忆。即使这也会抹去玛丽和里昂的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need some time to think this through.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要一些时间仔细考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... there's really no other way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……真的没有其他办法了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I can't do this. I won't do this. We have to face down this situation together. Can't we just talk about this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行，我做不到，我不会这么做。我们必须一起面对这个问题。我们能不能好好谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？但是……你很聪明，我感觉你会察觉到有些不对劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 逃避真相是行不通的。我们最终只会回到原点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do you mean?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A little from column A, a little from column B?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 两边各占一点吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: None of this is about you, Roathe. It never has been.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一切都与你无关，罗瑟。从来都与你无关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I can't do this. I'm sorry. I can't do this to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我做不到。对不起，我不能这样对你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. I give in. I'll do what you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我妥协了，我照你说的做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know. But these things take time, and we need to wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道。但这些事情需要时间，我们需要等待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I changed my mind. I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我改变主意了。对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will. I'm getting there. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会的。我在努力着呢。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，这段记忆，是不一样的。这段记忆是抹不去的。因为它深埋在你潜意识深处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 逃避真相是行不通的。我们最终只会回到原点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你确定吗？但是……你很聪明，我感觉你会察觉到有些不对劲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Largely? If it weren't for me, you'd still be stuck chasing that pointy tail of yours, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很大程度上？要不是我，罗瑟，你现在还在追着你那条尖尾巴转呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Largely? If it weren't for me, you'd still be stuck chasing that pointy tail of yours, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很大程度上？要不是我，罗瑟，你现在还在追着你那条尖尾巴转呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I couldn't leave you chasing that pointy tail of yours forever. It was going to get sad.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不能让你永远追着你那条尖尾巴。那样太可怜了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I couldn't leave you chasing that pointy tail of yours forever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不能让你永远追着你那条尖尾巴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Typical.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​就​知道​你​会​这样。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wait. Why?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等。为什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You said you'd help if I helped you recovered your memories. And I did. That was our contract!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说过，如果我帮你恢复记忆，你也会帮忙。而我也做到了。这就是我们的交易！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wait. Why won't you help me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等。你为什么不肯帮我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I can't do this. I won't do this. We have to face down this situation together. Can't we just talk about this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行，我做不到，我不会这么做。我们必须一起面对这个问题。我们能不能好好谈谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... there's really no other way?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……真的没有其他办法了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is there any way I could change your mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有没有什么办法能让你改变主意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How do I get out of this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那我该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pardon me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are we talking about Loid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们是在说洛德的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is there any way I could change your mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我能怎么做来改变你的想法吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How do I get out of this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那我该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我……会做的。我会抹去你的记忆。即使这也会抹去玛丽和里昂的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I refuse. I'll find another way to convince you to move forward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我拒绝。我会想其他办法说服你继续向前看。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, it's fine. It's not that important to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不用了，没关系。这事对我来说没那么重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sadly, neither Marie or Lyon are going to be on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 遗憾的是，玛丽和里昂都不会参与其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure if Lyon is going to be on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定里昂是否会参与。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure if Marie is going to be on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定玛丽是否会参与。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure if Marie is going to be on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定玛丽是否会参与。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm not sure if Lyon is going to be on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不确定里昂是否会参与。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, it's fine. It's not that important to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不用了，没关系。这事对我来说没那么重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't believe either Marie or Lyon are going to be on board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为玛丽和里昂都不会参与其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That doesn't sound ominous at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这话听着挺瘆人啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess love.] I have something I should say, before you go too far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意] 在你走得太远之前，我有些话想说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome, Roathe. It's why I'm with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气，罗瑟。这就是我和你在一起的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess love.] I have something I should say, before you go too far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意] 在你走得太远之前，我有些话想说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But what if I like your threats?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但如果我喜欢你的威胁呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome, Roathe. It's what friends are for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，不客气。朋友就该这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thanks for what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Gratitude for what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 感激什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But what if I like your threats?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但如果我喜欢你的威胁呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess love.] I have something I should say, before we go too far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意] 在事情继续发展之前，我有些话想说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What's the next step with Loid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 关于洛德的下一步计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What's the next step with Loid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 关于洛德的下一步计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [Confess love.] I have something I should say, before we go too far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [表白心意] 在事情继续发展之前，我有些话想说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What's the next step with Loid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 关于洛德的下一步计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome, Roathe. It's what friends are for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，不客气。朋友就该这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What's the next step with Loid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 关于洛德的下一步计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome, Roathe. It's what friends are for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，不客气。朋友就该这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... am sorry. You're right. I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……很抱歉。你说得对。我不爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love all that you are. I love what you can become. I love what you choose to be. What you have been. All that you are capable of. I love you, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你的一切。我爱你未来的无限可能。我爱你选择的人生道路。我爱你的过去。我爱你的一切能力。我爱你，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't love you in spite of who you are, Roathe. I love you because of who you are. All of you. All the good and the evil you're capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我爱你不是因为你是谁，而是因为你就是你。我爱你的一切，包括你所有美好的品质和邪恶的一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never mind. I forgot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 算了，我忘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可能不相信我，但我……我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never mind. I forgot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 算了，我忘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可能不相信我，但我……我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love all that you are. I love what you can become. I love what you choose to be. What you have been. All that you are capable of. I love you, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你的一切。我爱你未来的无限可能。我爱你选择的人生道路。我爱你的过去。我爱你的一切能力。我爱你，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What's next for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你接下来的计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think you'll always call yourself that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得你会一直这样称呼自己吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What will it get me in return?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我能从中得到什么回报？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What will it get me in return?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我能从中得到什么回报？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're welcome, Roathe. It's what friends are for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，不客气。朋友就该这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... am sorry. You're right. I don't.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……很抱歉。你说得对。我不爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love all that you are. I love what you can become. I love what you choose to be. What you have been. All that you are capable of. I love you, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你的一切。我爱你未来的无限可能。我爱你选择的人生道路。我爱你的过去。我爱你的一切能力。我爱你，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't love you in spite of who you are, Roathe. I love you because of who you are. All of you. All the good and the evil you're capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我爱你不是因为你是谁，而是因为你就是你。我爱你的一切，包括你所有美好的品质和邪恶的一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可能不相信我，但我……我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可能不相信我，但我……我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go easy on him, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请对他手下留情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How will I know when you're done convincing him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我怎么知道你什么时候才说服他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love all that you are. I love what you can become. I love what you choose to be. What you have been. All that you are capable of. I love you, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你的一切。我爱你未来的无限可能。我爱你选择的人生道路。我爱你的过去。我爱你的一切能力。我爱你，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go easy on him, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请对他手下留情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How will I know when you're done convincing him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我怎么知道你什么时候才说服他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't love you in spite of who you are, Roathe. I love you because of who you are. All of you. All the good and the evil you're capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我爱你不是因为你是谁，而是因为你就是你。我爱你的一切，包括你所有美好的品质和邪恶的一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Any regrets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 后悔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What's next for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你接下来的计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I don't love you in spite of who you are, Roathe. I love you because of who you are. All of you. All the good and the evil you're capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，我爱你不是因为你是谁，而是因为你就是你。我爱你的一切，包括你所有美好的品质和邪恶的一面。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Right. Yes. Loid. How will I know when you're done convincing him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对。是的。洛德。我怎么知道你什么时候才说服他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Heh. Go easy on him, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 呵呵，请对他手下留情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go easy on him, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请对他手下留情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need the help...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要帮助……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need the help...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要帮助……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Great. I need the help...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。我需要帮助……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这么一说，感觉这一切都太恶心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: [End.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: [结束]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Great. I need the help...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。我需要帮助……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这么一说，感觉这一切都太恶心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Can we skip past the lectures?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说教的部分我们可以跳过吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对不起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You aren't exactly the easiest person to navigate speaking to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你并不是一个容易沟通的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I can't. I change my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我不能这样做。我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. I accept your help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我接受你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I can't. I change my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我不能这样做。我改变主意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. I accept your help.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我接受你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你是在虚张声势。我甚至觉得你根本没有想要什么的计划。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你究竟要收取什么？你从来没说过你希望从这笔交易中得到什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think you're bluffing. I don't even think you have a plan for what you want.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你是在虚张声势。我甚至觉得你根本没有想要什么的计划。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which is what, exactly? You never said what you wanted out of this contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你究竟要收取什么？你从来没说过你希望从这笔交易中得到什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。还是算了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would, yes. [Date Roathe.]
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我希望。[和罗瑟约会]

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may not believe me, but I care about you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可能不相信我，但我在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hate to sound utterly shallow and crass, but... have you looked in the mirror lately?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不想显得肤浅粗俗，但是……你最近照过镜子吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe. You may not believe me, but I... I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟。你可能不相信我，但我……我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I screwed it up last time. I couldn't run that risk again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我上次搞砸了，我不能再冒这个险了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I made the deal because I was desperate to get this right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我之所以达成这笔交易，是因为我迫切希望把这件事做好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What's the next step with Loid?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 关于洛德的下一步计划是什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go easy on him, please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请对他手下留情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How will I know when you're done convincing him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我怎么知道你什么时候才说服他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe. Taking the serum doesn't make you a coward. It makes you the only Orokin still standing. Embrace it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟。接受血清并不会让你变成懦夫。它只会让你成为唯一幸存的奥罗金人。接受这个事实吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Another chance to talk to you about your taking the serum. Roathe, it's time to stop running.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 再跟你谈谈你接受血清的事。罗瑟，别再逃避了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe. Taking the serum doesn't make you a coward. It's given you another chance at life. To make a real difference.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟。接受血清并不会让你变成懦夫。它给了你第二次生命，让你有机会真正改变人生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're pointing it at yourself. You should be pointing it at the world that is blaming you for doing the best you could to save it from the Orokin Empire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​这是在把​矛头​指向​了​自己。​你​应该​指向​的​是​这个​世界，​你​尽​了​全力​去​拯救​它​免​遭奥罗金​帝国​的​蹂躏，​它​却​在​责怪​你。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You're letting that anger tear you up inside. You could be using it to help you fight the people who are still destroying this world today. Here. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这是在让愤怒吞噬自己。你本可以利用它来对抗那些至今仍在破坏这个世界的人。就在此刻。就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by the opinions of those around you. Or what they think of your actions. You are defined only by what you believe of yourself and your choices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 周围人的意见或他们对你行为的看法定义不了你，你唯一能定义你自己的，是你如何看待自己以及你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are not defined by your past, Roathe. You are defined by your future. And you still have a future to spend, unlike all the Orokin who died on the Night of the Naga Drums.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，你的过去并不能定义你，你的未来才能定义你。而且，你还有美好的未来可以去体验，不像那些在长胴鼓之夜死去的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the simple fact of the matter is? You are one of the very few Orokin we know that survived the Night of the Naga drums. From my point of view? It was a strategic retreat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实很简单：你是极少数的、在我们所知的在长胴鼓之夜幸存下来的奥罗金人之一。在我看来，那是一次战略性撤退。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is the only thing that defines you, now. You can change. And you can change the world around you. I guess my only question is, will you at least try?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，只有这件样才能定义你。你可以改变，也可以改变你周围的世界。我想问的只是，你至少愿意尝试一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing more. Nothing less.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不多不少，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Try to forgive yourself and move forward?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 试着原谅自己，然后继续向前走？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm? What is it, darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？亲爱的，什么事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do go on. This sounds like it is going to be quite good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请继续。听起来很不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wait. By the Void, are you trying to tip-toe around the news that you have another partner?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等。我的天，你是想偷偷摸摸地隐瞒你有了另一个伴侣这件事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How much of a fool do you think I am? I already know, Drifter dear!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得我有多傻？亲爱的漂泊者，我早就知道了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If only you could hear me laughing in the Sanctum right now. Drifter, darling. Dear sweet Drifter. I am Orokin. Of course I do not mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要是你现在能在圣所里听到我的笑声就好了。漂泊者，亲爱的。我亲爱的可爱的漂泊者。我可是奥罗金人。我当然不介意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If only you could hear me laughing in the Sanctum right now. Drifter, darling. Dear sweet Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要是你现在能在圣所里听到我的笑声就好了。漂泊者，亲爱的。我亲爱的可爱的漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think what you will about my society and our penchant for enjoying the company of others in a way you may see as dismissive and belittling, we also understood what it was like to love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可以随意看待我的社会，以及我们享受与他人相处的方式，你可能会觉得这种方式轻蔑和贬低他人，但我们也懂得爱的滋味。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I knew the moment it happened. I have my methods. And no, I do not mind in the slightest. I am Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事情发生的那一刻我就知道了。我有自己的方法。而且，我一点也不介意。我可是奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No one understood love like the Orokin. And we knew that one could have room in the heart for more than one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有人比奥罗金人更懂得爱。我们知道，一颗心中可以容纳不止一个爱人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am merely disappointed that the zealots are likely too close-minded to join in the fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是感到失望，那些狂热分子可能太过思想封闭，无法参与到这场游戏中来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pah. On second thought, that is likely for the best. Can you imagine the nonsense that would cause?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唉。仔细想想，这或许是最好的结果。你能想象那会造成多大的混乱吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, regardless. If they make you happy, then enjoy them. But know that when you are with me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，不管怎样。如果让你快乐，那就和他一起享受吧。但你要知道，当我和你在一起的时候……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are mine and mine alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是我的，只属于我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Void-born anomaly. "The Drifter." The Usurper. Finally, we speak at last. Come. The Devil has a proposal to make...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空诞生的异类。"漂泊者"。篡位者。终于，我们开口了。来吧。本恶魔有个提议……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I really must commend you on your audacity! Truly, are you certain you are not an Orokin in disguise? Perhaps hiding your cerulean skin to keep from alerting the others?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真得佩服你的胆量！说真的，你确定你不是伪装起来的奥罗金人吗？或许你是为了不惊动其他人，隐藏了你蔚蓝色的皮肤？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now. Listen carefully. The two zealots have been so terribly and painstakingly drab in their repeated objurgation of me. I expect you to rise above such remedial behavior.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，仔细看着。那两个狂热分子反复地、煞有介事地辱骂我，真是令人难以忍受，也乏味至极。我希望你会有更高的层次，别跟他们一样做这种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: At least this will be interesting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少这会很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think, for that, I shall reward you. And make my end of the deal just a little bit sweeter for you. Such audacity is rare.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得，为此我会给你一点奖励，让我们这边的交易，对你来说更有利一些。你这种胆大妄为的人可不多见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not for free, my Void-addled Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但不是免费的，我这位被虚空弄傻的篡位者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You cannot. But I promise you... I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说服不了。但我向你保证……我可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And where you have failed to convince that disconsolate manservant? I promise you... I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你没能说服那位垂头丧气的男仆，我向你保证……我可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And so we finally come to my proposal: help me sort out the matter of my missing memories, and get to the "bottom" of it all - no pun intended.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，我们终于说到我的提议了：你帮我理清我缺失的记忆，找出这一切的"根源"——没有双关的意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I will ensure our heartsick servant walks up those stairs. And, in the meanwhile, I will seat peacefully... and be no danger to anyone. What say you? Do we have a deal?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会确保我们那位相思成疾的仆人走上那楼梯。与此同时，我也会安然无恙地坐着……不会对任何人构成威胁。你觉得怎么样？成交吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, good! You do in fact know my name! I was certain you must have overlooked it somehow, since you were clearly too busy slaughtering me repeatedly!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，太好了！原来你知道我的名字！我还以为你压根就没注意过，毕竟你当时忙着反复屠杀我呢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish. But fair warning:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。但我事先提醒一句：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good! Glad to see you aren't a fool. As they say:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好！很高兴你不是个傻瓜。正如俗话说：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Crossing a devil is worse than dealing with one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 得罪恶魔比与恶魔打交道更糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Both you'll come to regret, but only with one do you stand to benefit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然两者都会让你后悔，但只有其中一项会让你捞到好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you really have nothing more productive to do?! Or is playing round after round of "Pin the Horn on the Yaznak" really the best use of your time?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真的就没有点更有意义的事情去做吗？！还是说，一遍又一遍地玩"给亚兹纳克贴角"的游戏真的是你最好的消遣方式？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see my reputation precedes me. Good. It will save us some time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来我的名声在外。很好。这能节省我们一些时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I find it very hard to believe that all this - all this injustice I have suffered at your hands, all this peeling away of my psyche has not been purely out of spite at your behest!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很难相信——我遭受的所有这些不公正待遇，所有这些对我精神的摧残，竟然不是出于你刻意的驱使！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah! That is what you are, yes? The Tenno usurped the Origin System from the Orokin. And you, like a little imposter in the nest, have stolen into this world from your own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊！你就是这种人，对吧？Tenno 从奥罗金手中夺取了始源星系。而你，就像巢穴里的小冒牌货，从你自己的世界偷偷溜进了这个世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And there is no need for concern or excitement... yet. This is merely a business agreement between two individuals who stand to benefit each other greatly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 目前你无需担忧或兴奋……这仅仅是两个互惠互利的人之间的一项商业协议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: See that you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你最好做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And that makes you, on at least two counts, a Usurper by my measure. (And perhaps a third, if we count what the butler has told me of Duviri, but that is a debate for another time.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这样看来，至少从这两点来说，你都是个篡位者。（如果算上管家告诉我的关于双衍王境的那些事，或许还有第三点，但这又是另一个话题了。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have made that repeatedly and brutally clear, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你已经反复且毫不留情地表明了这一点，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have made that quite clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你已经说得很清楚了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We shall see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们等着瞧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now, the deal is simple, my charmingly lubricous and vaporous new "friend."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，这笔交易很简单，我这位迷人、不可靠、飘渺的新"朋友"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It didn't seem like -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这件事似乎——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh! I am so very sorry to have inconvenienced you, I did not realize the slots on your dance card were already booked!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦！那非常抱歉给你带来不便，我不知道你的舞会档期已经被预订了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It didn't seem like a priority?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这件事似乎并不重要？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really. I am astonished. Your manners are utterly atrocious, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是的。真令人大开眼界。漂泊者，你的教养简直糟糕透了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pardon? And how precisely is it that I have come to forget you rummaging through my mind like the Malium Bowl at a Naberus party!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？我究竟是如何忘记，就像纳贝流士派对上的马利姆碗一样在我脑海中翻来覆去的你呢！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Since you have already been bashing about inside my mind like a drunken razaliorn inside of a glassmaker's shop, I require your assistance in attempting to decode what it all means.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然你已经像喝醉的拉扎利翁在玻璃匠作坊里乱撞一样闯进了我的脑子里，我需要你的帮助来试着解读这一切到底意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You and the two zealots have already begun messing about inside my mind like a drunk razaliorn inside of a glassmaker's shop. I require your assistance in helping me decode what it all means.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和那两个狂热分子已经开始在我脑子里胡闹了，就像喝醉的拉扎利翁闯进玻璃匠作坊一样。我需要你们的帮助，帮我解读这一切到底意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When Albrecht drove the syringe into my neck and turned me into this - thing - he did something else, as well. Games between Orokin are one thing. This? This is something else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当阿尔布雷希特把注射器扎进我的脖子，把我变成现在这个——东西——的时候，他还做了另一件事。奥罗金人之间的游戏是一回事，而这？这又是另一回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you normally go mouling about in the memories of others, laying waste to their representations, without taking the opportunity to know them first?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是不是经常在别人的记忆里游荡，肆意破坏他们的形象，却连对方也不去了解一下？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I suppose there is nothing to be done about it now. You know the truth. I am laid bare to you, in all my abhorrent cowardice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我想现在也无能为力了。你知道真相。我的一切都暴露在你面前，而我那令人作呕的懦弱无能也暴露无遗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not only do I need your assistance in regaining my memories - but to add insult to injury, I seem unable to even find the means to discern their truth on my own!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不仅需要你的帮助来恢复我的记忆——更糟糕的是，我自己似乎无法找到辨别真相的方法！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. I could hazard a guess as to why you have summoned your Void-gifts to wipe our minds of recent events. How perfectly predictable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对。我大概能猜到你为何召唤虚空之力来抹去我们最近发生的记忆。真是意料之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He robbed me of much of my memories. I see that little... version of you, running about with all its traumatized Tenno friends. I see what the Lotus is helping it regain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他​夺走​了​我​太​多​的​记忆。​我​看到​那个​小小​的​……​你，​和​那些​同样​遭​受​创伤​的​ Tenno ​朋友们​一起​四处​逃窜。​我​看到​ Lotus ​正​在​帮助​它​找回​什么。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your manners are utterly atrocious!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的教养简直糟糕透了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I assume you have simply come here now to mock me. I request that you have your fill of it now so that we might move on from it uninterrupted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜你来这里就是为了嘲笑我。我希望你一次嘲笑个够，好让我们继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would rather not have to continually contend with this being underfoot like some diva's ornamentally bred yapping kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可不想整天像某些贵妇精心饲养、叫个不停的库狛，不断地忍受它碍事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh do not make this sound like I simply need to lay on some reclined sofa and speak through my "feelings."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，别把这说得好像我只需要躺在沙发上，倾诉我的"感受"就行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need someone to operate the machine at my behest, as I am currently incapable of doing so myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要有人替我操作这台机器，因为我目前自己无法操作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would do the deed myself, believe me - but I cannot! The blasted protoframe serum Albrecht poisoned me with removed any ability I have of operating the damnable contraption on my own!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我，我本来可以亲自去的——但我没法这样做！那个混账阿尔布雷希特给我注射的原型战甲血清，让我根本无法独自操作那台该死的装置！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I assure you, "it" very much is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我向你保证，它确实只是"它"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You seem alarmingly uncertain about this entire conversation, Drifter. Especially when it comes to the contents of my skull.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你似乎对整个谈话内容都不太确定，尤其是我脑袋里的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am also in need of someone to help me record my memories and assist me in reconciling them. A temporary assistant of sorts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我还需要有人帮我记录记忆，并帮助我整理它们。算是一个临时的助手吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And in addition, not only do I need your assistance in regaining my memories - but to add insult to injury, I seem unable to even find the means to discern their truth on my own!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 此外，我不仅需要你的帮助来恢复我的记忆——更糟糕的是，我自己似乎无法找到辨别真相的方法！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I would do the deed myself, believe me - but I cannot! The blasted protoframe serum Albrecht poisoned me with removed any ability I have of operating the damnable contraption on my own!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要知道，我本来可以亲自去的——但我没法这样做！那个混账阿尔布雷希特给我注射的原型战甲血清，让我根本无法独自操作那台该死的装置！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And yes. I did come here via a Helminth. That I engineered and grew myself, thank you. Now. You mean to tell me that you have... erased my memories?! Of what, our conversations together?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，我的确是通过一只 Helminth 来到这里的。那是我自己设计培育的，谢谢。现在，你是说你……抹去了我的记忆？！抹去了我们之间的对话？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And in return - you will have my solemn pledge that I will sit here... peacefully. I will pose no one any threat, of which I assure you... I am quite capable of being. I will do no harm to the zealots. Or to the butler. Or to Albrecht's Void-corrupted animals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 作为回报——我郑重承诺，我会安然地坐在这里……不会对任何人构成威胁，这一点我向你保证……我完全有能力做到。我不会伤害那些狂热分子，也不会伤害管家，更不会伤害阿尔布雷希特那些被虚空腐化的动物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fantastic. Another buzzing dolefly to dart around my ears and tell me I am in need of self-reflection and reptentance?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。又有一只嗡嗡叫的小苍蝇在我耳边飞来飞去，告诉我我需要反省和忏悔吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because I certainly have perfectly "fond" memories of you rendering me unto mincemeat for your own sanguinary entertainment. How is that meant to make any sense whatsoever?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我显然对你有"美好"的回忆，你为了满足你那嗜血的好玩念头，把我剁成肉酱。你觉得这说得通吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And more importantly, I will do no harm to Albrecht's twisted family that sits about like so much mutated flora above us - unwitting to our very presence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更​重要​的​是，​我​不​会​伤害阿尔布雷​希特​那​群​扭曲​的​家人，​他们​就​像​变异​的​植物​一样​在​坐​我们​头顶​上​空​——​也​完全​不​会​发现​我们​的​存在。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lucky me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可真幸运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Currently, what I am doing seems to be "mouldering in a crypt with a pair of gormless zealots and dolling out trinkets to war-traumatized children."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 目前，我所做的似乎是"与两个愚蠢的狂热分子一起在墓穴里腐烂，并向遭受战争创伤的儿童分发小饰品"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I plan to go about my business, Drifter, but the fact remains - you know too much about my past and what I've done. And we will have to simply... exist in this state.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我打算继续做我的事，不过事实摆在那儿——你对我过去的经历和所作所为了解得太多了。我们只能……以这种状态下相处下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I suppose that must be what they call it now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我猜现在他们肯定都管这叫"继续​战斗"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fantastic. Utterly marvelous. I am in the hands now of a lunatic who has the ability to wipe my memories clean at a whim! How adorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了！真是绝妙！我现在落入了一个疯子手里，一个能随心所欲抹去我记忆的疯子！真是太可爱了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Were you not paying attention? Really, reading comprehension these days... I was not threatening you, Usurper. Nor was I threatening anyone else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你没在听吗？现在的人的阅读理解能力真是……篡位者，我没有威胁你。我也没有威胁任何人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This ought to be grand. Please. Go right ahead; the proverbial theatre is yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一定会很精彩。请便，尽管去说吧；这出戏就交给你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Were you not paying attention? Really, reading comprehension these days... I am attempting to strike a deal with you, Usurper. I have a hard time believing you cannot follow along.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你没在听吗？现在的人的阅读理解能力真是……篡位者，我是在尝试和你达成协议。我难以相信你连这都搞不明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Try not to make this too unduly uncomfortable for me and I will promise that I shall try to do the same in return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请你尽量别让我太难堪，我保证也会以同样的礼数回敬你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. If what you say is true - and I suppose this tale is mad enough to be reality - I will attempt not to hold it against you that you know this deep and terrible truth of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。如果你说的是真的——而这荒诞的故事确实也足够真实——我会尽量不因为你知道了我内心深处这个可怕真相而怪你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was merely stating that should we reach a point where I am unable to reach my end goals, I may have no reason to sit quietly any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说，如果到了我无法实现最终目标的地步，我可能就没有理由再保持沉默了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If my proposal does not reach your standards, shall I sweeten it for you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我的提议不符合你的标准，我是否该改进一下？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I would request - if I may - that you would get your fill of whatever mocking you wish to levy in my direction so that we might move on from it uninterrupted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，如果可以的话，我希望你一次嘲笑个够，好让我们继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if you want mine, then I suggest - as I said - we come to an agreement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你也想让我帮你，那么我建议——就像我说的——我们达成协议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, no need for concern... or excitement. Yet. This is merely a business agreement between two individuals who stand to benefit each other greatly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，你暂时无需担忧……或兴奋……这仅仅是两个互惠互利的人之间的一项商业协议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And? Ah. I see. You are objecting to my "tone" is it? I am so terribly sorry. I did not realize you bristle so easily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然后呢？啊，我明白了。你是对我的"语气"有意见吗？我真是太抱歉了。我没想到你这么容易生气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It has come to my attention that there are a great many matters around Deimos where my assistance could be considered not only viable, but I dare say, crucial.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我注意到，在火卫二有很多事情，我的协助不仅可行，而且我敢说是至关重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you could have just heard me laugh! Thank you, Drifter, for very much not being tedious!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你能听到我刚才的笑声就好了！谢谢你，漂泊者，你一点都不无聊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Including, but not limited to, the reconciliation of one lovelorn butler and said estranged family who lives upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 包括但不限于：一位失恋的管家与住在楼上的疏远家庭重归于好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! I do have to respect your honesty, if nothing else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！至少，我必须尊重你的坦诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wonderful. It is good to know you are at least... agreeable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。很高兴知道你至少是……肯同意的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A family who, as I mentioned, has no idea that we are even down here. And has no knowledge of Albrecht's continued existence amongst the living, am I correct?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如我之前提到的，这个家庭根本不知道我们在这里。而且，他们也不知道阿尔布雷希特仍然活着，我说得对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What a delight that was! I think you and I will be friends, indeed. This was quite wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是太棒了！我想我们一定能成为好朋友。这简直太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize that your so-called "Indifference" isn't an actual "god," yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不明白你所谓的"虚空无情之物"并不是真正的"神"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, setting aside the harsh reality that any belief in a god or gods comes from idiots who cling to: One, a crushing need to clutch a stuffed animal when one faces the brutal horror of the finality of one's soul when it reaches death,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，先不说任何对神或众神的信仰都来自白痴的残酷现实，这些人执迷不悟是因为：第一，当一个人走向死亡时面对灵魂最终结局的残酷恐惧，他们迫切地需要紧紧抓住一个毛绒玩具，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everyone I speak to around this madhouse is entirely convinced that this "Man in the Wall" is some kind of literal and laughable god. An actual god. Even those two zealots seem to be entertaining the idea!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个疯人院里和我交谈过的每个人都完全相信这个"墙中人"是个货真价实、滑稽可笑的神，一个真正的神。就连那两个狂热分子似乎也在考虑这个想法！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Two, the anxiety one suffers when you realize there is no "Greater Power" out there laying out our lives in front of us and therefore we simply are responsible for our own actions and therefore, by extension,
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 第二，那种当你意识到并没有什么"更强大的力量"在我们前面安排我们的人生，因此我们只能为自己的行为负责时，所产生的焦虑，相关地，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Three, the righteous anger that accompanies the anxiety and horror, when all this leads to the epiphany that there is no "Hell" waiting for Devils, nor any "Heaven" waiting for Angels.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 第三，伴随着焦虑和恐惧而来的义愤，当所有这一切让你顿悟：并没有等候魔鬼的"地狱"，也没有守候天使的"天堂"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now, did I say those words? Do not be so quick to put words into my mouth, Oh Transient Usurper. I did not deny that the Indifference was "real." I denied that it was a God.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等，我说过这种话吗？别急着歪曲我的意思，哦，短暂的篡位者。我并没有否认虚空无情之物是"真实存在的"。我否认的是它是神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can disrobe this false deity for you in two simple words you should know and understand quite well:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只需两个你理应熟知且能深刻理解的词语，我就能为你揭穿这个虚假神明的真面目：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Absolutely not! First, there are no god or gods, the idea is absurd. Second, to think that Albrecht let loose a god of the Void? Even more laughable!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 绝不！首先，根本没有神，这种想法太荒谬了。其次，想想阿尔布雷希特竟然释放了一个虚空之神？就更可笑了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am assuming you are not an drooling zealot who clings to anger, horror, or anxiety. Operating on this assumption, I am going to move forward with the second argument I wish to present to you for the disrobement of "the Indifference's" Godhood:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我假设你并非那种沉溺于愤怒、恐惧或焦虑的狂热分子。在这个假设的基础上，我将继续阐述第二个论点，以揭穿"虚空无情之物"的神性：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Conceptual Embodiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 概念成形。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is nothing in the Void. That is why it is named the Void!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空中空无一物。正因如此，它才被称为虚空！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And when have I denied that, either? Indeed, it seems you have all managed to spin yourselves into quite a hysterical and needlessly egregious bit of tribulation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我什么时候否认过这一点？说真的，你们似乎都把自己卷入了一场毫无必要的歇斯底里和巨大的苦难之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Humanity is certainly nothing if not creative in the breadth and magnitude of new forms of suffering it can concoct for itself, is it not? You yourself have been witness to many a form of cruelty I am sure one could scare imagine was possible in the time of our dear zealots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 人类在发明创造各种新式苦难方面，真是五花八门，花样翻新，不是吗？你自己亲眼目睹了许多残酷暴行，我相信在咱们那群狂热分子的年代，人们根本想象不到这些暴行竟会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, you are so close to the truth and yet so quick to dismiss it. You think it is "tempting" to believe it is a creation of your own mind as it would be easier to dismiss it if it were so? No, I think it makes it far more dangerous to face a creation of our own making than a god.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，你离真相如此之近，却又如此轻易地否定它。你觉得相信它是自己脑海中的产物很"诱人"，因为这样更容易将其抛诸脑后？不，我认为面对自己创造的产物，远比面对神更危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I appreciate your humility, I challenge your limited understanding of the capability of human creativity - especially in regards to how it can devise new forms of suffering. Are you not in fact single-handedly responsible for conjuring your own universe from whole cloth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我欣赏你的谦逊，但我挑战你对人类创造力的有限理解——尤其是如何创造出新的苦难形式这方面。难道你不是凭空捏造出你自己的宇宙吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing that comes from the Void is that which we place within it - and what returns from it. It changes matter and energy - but it cannot create it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空中唯一存在的，是我们放入其中的，以及从中返回的。它能改变物质和能量——但它无法创造它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What I am saying is this: Albrecht might have been the one who originally saw his own hubris staring back at him as the face of a grinning god of destruction, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​是​说：​没错，​阿尔布雷​希特​可能​是​第一​个​意识​到​自己​的​傲慢，​如同​一​张​狞笑​的​毁灭​之神​的​脸，​凝视​着​自己​的​人。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht might have been the one who originally saw his own hubris staring back at him as the face of a grinning god of destruction, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特或许正是最初目睹自己狂妄自大如毁灭之神般狞笑着凝视着他的人，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: An external foe can be understood. Manipulated. Defeated. Or perhaps even negotiated with, if it comes to that. They have weaknesses that can be exploited. But an internal foe? One of our own making? That is far more insidious indeed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一个外部敌人可以被理解，被操纵，被击败。甚至必要时，还可以去和他谈判。他们有可以利用的弱点。但一个内部敌人呢？我们自己造出来的敌人呢？那可就阴险得多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You yourself have been witness to many a form of cruelty I am sure one could scare imagine was possible in the time of our dear zealots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你自己亲眼目睹了许多残酷暴行，我相信在咱们那群狂热分子的年代，人们根本想象不到这些暴行竟会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think, Drifter. These "Void Angels" of which you speak. These ghosts. Were they made of those already lost to the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想想吧，漂泊者。你说的这些"虚空天使"，这些幽灵，它们是不是从那些已经迷失在虚空里的人转化而来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you are all as equally to blame for continuing to roll this juba bug turd downhill for as long as you have, getting bigger with every scrap of feces it collects along the way!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可你们都难辞其咎，竟让这坨朱巴虫粪球一路从山坡往下滚了这么久，沿途每沾一丁点粪渣就越滚越大！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As a species, we are quite wondrous in our ability to feed our fears new ways to destroy ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 作为一个物种，我们有一种惊人的能力，那就是不断给恐惧输送素材，从而让想象创造出比现实更糟的自我毁灭场景。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They were merely echoes of energy being regurgitated like a colorful kutak to feed its children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们只不过是能量的回流，就像色彩斑斓的库塔克鸟通过反刍来喂养它的孩子们一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Allow me to simplify the discussion for you. I can disrobe this false deity for you in two simple words you should know and understand quite well:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 让我用更简洁的方式解释一下。只需两个你理应熟知且能深刻理解的词语，我就能为你揭穿这个虚假神明的真面目：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. I fear I must go. I will let you sit with this for a time and ponder my words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。恐怕我得走了。正好让你有时间，可以好好想想我的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because then we must fight our own demons. And humanity... never wins such wars, do we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为那样我们就必须对抗自己的恶魔。而人类……从来都赢不了这样的战争，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why do I suspect you already very well know the answer to this, my Usurper? What games are you playing at, by asking after such trivialities, if you have already picked over the pieces of my mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的篡位者，我怎么感觉你早就非常清楚这个问题的答案？如果你已经洞悉我的心思，为何还要追问这些琐事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, you may ask! It provides me an opportunity to expound on my own brilliance and complain about Albrecht's profound ability to be both brainlessly harefooted and yet somehow a supreme poltroon at precisely the same time!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，你可以问！这让我有机会炫耀自己的才华，并抱怨阿尔布雷希特这个既能无脑乱窜，又能在关键时刻表现得无与伦比的胆怯蠢货！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me. Am I correct in thinking you already have the answers you seek? You know already how I returned here with the zealots - from precisely whence we came. And likely a great deal more than that, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，我理解的没错吧？你已经找到了你想要的答案。你已经知道我是如何带着狂热分子回到这里的——确切地说，我们是从哪里来的。而且你可能知道的远不止这些，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are just as foul as Albrecht, meddling with the minds of those around you - thinking they are your toys to play with! So tell me. Why ask if you already have the answers, hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和阿尔布雷希特一样卑鄙，玩弄身边人的思想——把他们当成你的玩具！所以告诉我，既然你已经知道答案，为什么还要问呢？嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. No I very much was not. Now, here is something you must understand about the Orokin: We play - well... more correctly, played games with each other frequently. Games of all types. Political, psychological, sexual. It did not matter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我绝对不是。现在，关于奥罗金人，你必须明白一点：我们经常——更准确地说，是过去经常——互相玩游戏。各种各样的游戏。政治的、心理的、性方面的。什么都行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hah. And now I know that you are a liar as well as a memory-thief, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈。篡位者，现在我知道你不光是窃取记忆的贼，还是个骗子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are doing a rather poor job of it then, my Perennial Acquaintance. What ends are you attempting to reach that you have not already gained before?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的老相识，那你做得实在不怎么样啊。你究竟想追求什么呢，是以前没有实现过的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Through the use of Kuva and the Yuvan Theatre, we were fundamentally and functionally immortal. Can you comprehend how wholly and utterly tiring that becomes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 借助赤毒和青春厅堂，我们从根本上和实际上获得了永生。你能想象这有多么令人筋疲力竭吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then why come to ask me questions to which you already know the answer?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然你已经知道答案，为什么还要来问我这些问题呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now this, I find fascinating... did you "screw it up" with me, or did you "screw it up" with Lyon or Marie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在我​发现​这​很​有意思……​你​是​跟​我​"搞砸​了"，​还是​跟​里昂​或​玛丽​"搞砸​了"？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You had experience with an eternity of dying, as far as I hear tell of it. Which is far more interesting - and yet you still found reason to become numb to it all in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 据我所知，你曾体验过永无止境的死亡。这远比什么都有趣——然而，最终你却依然选择了麻木。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My point was thus - I am accustomed, quite accustomed in fact - to the machinations and the schemes we Orokin play on each other to amuse ourselves. It is simply how we pass the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是——事实上，我早已习惯，非常习惯——我们奥罗金人为了取乐而互相耍的各种阴谋诡计。这不过是我们消磨时间的方式而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. I see. We had an agreement, and you could not hold up your end of the bargain somehow, so you saw your prize fade from view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我明白了。我们之前达成了协议，但不知何故你没能履行你的承诺，所以你眼睁睁地看着你的奖赏从眼前消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there are lines that we do not cross. Actions that we do not take. I could go on in detail but I will not. I will summarize simply by stating that Albrecht broke them all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但有些底线我们不能逾越，有些事请我们不能做。我可以详细说说，但我不会。我简单地总结一下：阿尔布雷希特打破了所有这些底线。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Truly? Have you tried simply feeding him and watering him once a day and seeing if that does the trick? Very well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？你有没有试过每天给他喂点水和吃的，看看这样行不行？好吧……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you couldn't get that little puffball of purity to go along with you? I... am... hoping you do not go into any sort of career as a negotiator, my Perennial Acquaintance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟然没能让那个纯洁的小可爱同意？我的老相识，我……真……希望你不要从事谈判员之类的职业。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sit here and two things strike me immediately upon confirmation of my suspicion:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，证实了自己的猜想之后，我立刻想到两件事：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: HA! This is glorious! You truly have my attention, now... which one of us? Hm? Do tell... don't be shy. Perhaps we can make an... arrangement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！太棒了！你真的引起了我的注意……我们三个中的谁？嗯？快说……别害羞。或许我们可以……做个安排。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He abandoned me there, in some hideously ancient year, in some backwater wart on the arse of the Origin System! Do you know that Void-forsaken "Cathédrale" didn't even have electricity yet?! Electricity!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他把我丢在那儿，在某个极其古老的年代，在始源星系某个偏僻的犄角旮旯！你知道吗，那座被虚空遗弃的"大教堂"当时甚至连电都没有？！没有电啊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What about him gave you such trouble? Perhaps we could come to an arrangement?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他到底哪里让你这么烦恼？或许我们可以达成某种……协议？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But tell me, what about her gave you such trouble? Perhaps we could come to an... arrangement?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但告诉我，她到底哪里让你这么烦恼？或许我们可以达成某种……协议？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: HA! This is glorious! You truly have my attention, now... in what way? Hm? Do tell... don't be shy. Perhaps we can make an... arrangement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！太棒了！你真的引起了我的注意，那么……怎么搞砸了？嗯？快说……别害羞。或许我们可以……做个安排。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder... How many battles would I have struck clean from the field and done again, if I had such a power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道……如果我拥有这样的力量，我会从历史中抹去多少场战役，然后重新来过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sit here and two things strike me immediately upon confirmation of my suspicion:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，证实了自己的猜想之后，我立刻想到两件事：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you have any conceivable idea how hard it was to reverse engineer a Helminth with no electricity?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你能想象在没有电力的情况下对 Helminth 进行逆向工程有多难吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many minds would I have defiled if I had your gifts within my purview instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我拥有你这样的天赋，我会玷污多少人的心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder... How many battles would I have struck clean from the field and done again, if I had such a power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道……如果我拥有这样的力量，我会从历史中抹去多少场战役，然后重新来过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, I am struck by the immediate fury and anger at knowing that my mind has been trifled with not once but twice in recent history. But there is another emotion that comes to defeat the anger. One I do not quite yet understand.
