/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，得知我的思想在近期两次遭到戏弄，我当下感到无比愤怒。但还有另一种情绪压倒了愤怒，一种我目前还无法完全理解的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many minds would I have defiled if I had your gifts within my purview instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我拥有你这样的天赋，我会玷污多少人的心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know the details, as the memories are missing from my mind along with a great many others due to the transformation he forced upon me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道细节，因为他强行将我转化，导致我的许多记忆都消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes! Precisely! With samples of my own blood, no less! I did not start in the same year that we left, I'll tell you that much! By the Void, I am going to peel his flesh off with these new claws of mine the moment I see his stupid, smug face -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错！就是你猜的那样！而且还是用我自己的血！我告诉你，我可不是在我们离开的那一年就开始干这事的！以虚空之名，只要我一看到他那张愚蠢又自鸣得意的脸，我就要用我这双新长出来的利爪把他的皮肉撕下来——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would counsel simple patience instead, but... far be it from me to advise you to use a chisel when there is a laser pick sitting next to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本想建议你耐心等待，但是……既然旁边就有激光切割器，我又怎么会建议你用凿子呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: First: I am impressed! You took away all our memories so that you could have another attempt at winning his affections?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先：我真是佩服！你为了再一次赢得他的芳心，竟然抹去了我们所有的记忆？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: First: I am impressed! You took away all our memories so that you could have another attempt at winning her affections?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先：我真是佩服！你为了再一次赢得她的芳心，竟然抹去了我们所有的记忆？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh this is truly magical! You took away all our memories in an attempt to have another try at winning my affections?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，这可真是神奇呢！你竟然为了再次赢得我的芳心，夺走了我们所有的记忆？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I have flashes. Shattered bits and pieces of a golden hallway. A voice I recognized - but not a face. It was Albrecht, but not the one I knew.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我脑海中会闪过一些画面。破碎的金色走廊，残缺不全的影像。一个我熟悉的声音——却看不清脸。是阿尔布雷希特，但不是我认识的那个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Allow me a moment to control my temper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请稍等片刻，允许我控制一下我的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sit here and two things strike me immediately upon confirmation of my suspicion:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，证实了自己的猜想之后，我立刻想到两件事：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. I see. A noble endeavor, if I am being honest. One that I have attempted myself many, many times over. And failed equally so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我明白了。说实话，这的确是一件高尚的事。我自己也尝试过很多很多次，但都以失败告终。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A burning, searing pain. Like none other that I had ever known before. And a previous body of mine lost an arm and a leg in a blast in war, Drifter. I have been covered in burns too severe to have recovered from if not for Kuva. I have known agony.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还​有​灼烧般​的​剧痛，​前​所​未​有​的​痛。​漂泊者，​我​之前​的​身体​在​战争​爆炸​中​失去​了​一​条​胳膊​和​一​条腿。​我​全身​都​被​烧伤，​若非​赤毒​的​帮助，​我​根本​无法​痊愈。​我​曾​饱​受​疼痛​的​折磨。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thank you. We may proceed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。我们可以继续了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder... How many battles would I have struck clean from the field and done again, if I had such a power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道……如果我拥有这样的力量，我会从历史中抹去多少场战役，然后重新来过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sit here and two things strike me immediately upon confirmation of my suspicion:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，证实了自己的猜想之后，我立刻想到两件事：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is a conversation for another day. For I have a proposal for you. One I believe you will be far more interested in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这又是另一个话题了。因为我有一个提议，我相信你会对此更感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second: How inept must you be?! I am fairly certain that if you simply tried feeding and watering the Priest once a day you would have his undying love and adoration.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次：你得有多无能啊？！我相当肯定，如果你每天只喂神父吃饭喝水，你就会得到他永恒的爱戴和崇拜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second: Did you try limping in front of her? Feigning any kind of illness? Batting your eyes? Simply telling her that she looked nice? She does not seem terribly hard to woo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次：你有没有试过在她面前装出一瘸一拐？装病？抛媚眼？或者直接夸她漂亮？她看起来并不难追。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sit here and two things strike me immediately upon confirmation of my suspicion:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，证实了自己的猜想之后，我立刻想到两件事：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My body was being torn asunder and being remade. By force. I did not choose this. I do not know if it was the same for the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的身体被撕裂，又被重塑。这一切都是强加给我的。这不是我选择的。我不知道其他人是否也经历了同样的遭遇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I used samples of my own blood to reverse engineer a Helminth, by trial-and-error. It was not an easy task, with no access to any Orokin equipment. Or any equipment, for that matter, save what I could steal from the...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我利用自己的血液样本，通过反复试验，逆向工程了一种 Helminth。这并非易事，因为我没有任何奥罗金设备可以用。事实上，除了我能从……那里偷到的东西之外，我根本无法获得任何设备。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many minds would I have defiled if I had your gifts within my purview instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我拥有你这样的天赋，我会玷污多少人的心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder... How many battles would I have struck clean from the field and done again, if I had such a power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道……如果我拥有这样的力量，我会从历史中抹去多少场战役，然后重新来过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not get me wrong! I am rather impressed at how devious you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别误会！你的狡猾程度确实让我佩服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Third: I sit here and I am suddenly keenly overwhelmed by realizations upon confirmation of my suspicion:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 第三：我坐在这里，当我的怀疑得到证实后，突然间我强烈地感受到了一些事情：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder... How many battles would I have struck clean from the field and done again, if I had such a power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道……如果我拥有这样的力量，我会从历史中抹去多少场战役，然后重新来过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I remember cold stairs beneath me, as I was dropped upon them. Cathedral stairs, I know them to be now, as Lyon and Marie have told me the story from their recollections.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我记得当时我被扔到冰冷的楼梯上。现在我知道了那是教堂的楼梯，因为里昂和玛丽根据他们的回忆告诉我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not do them the favor of calling them "rudimentary" hospitals. Albrecht had used a Helminth to transport us to the past. How it had grown in the past I do not know, as it had to have been there already for us to arrive. It withered and died in the process - I suspected another could be used for a return trip.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会好心称它们为"简陋"的医院。阿尔布雷希特用一只 Helminth 把我们传送到了过去。​我​不​知道​它​在​过去​是​如何​生长​的​，因为它必须事先就在那里，我们才能到达那里。它在传送过程中就枯萎死去了——我猜想或许可以用另一只 Helminth 进行返程。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, I am struck by the immediate fury and anger at knowing that my mind has been trifled with not once but twice in recent history. But there is another emotion that comes to defeat the anger. One I do not quite yet understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，得知我的思想在近期两次遭到戏弄，我当下感到无比愤怒。但还有另一种情绪压倒了愤怒，一种我目前还无法完全理解的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many minds would I have defiled if I had your gifts within my purview instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我拥有你这样的天赋，我会玷污多少人的心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of uniting Albrecht's butler and the family, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次我一定会确保你成功地实现让阿尔布雷希特的管家和这个家族团聚的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not think I can condemn you, quite honestly. How many battles would I have struck clean from the field and done again, if I had such a power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我觉得我没资格谴责你。如果我拥有这样的力量，我会从历史中抹去多少场战役，然后重新来过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder... How many battles would I have struck clean from the field and done again, if I had such a power?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道……如果我拥有这样的力量，我会从历史中抹去多少场战役，然后重新来过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many minds would I have defiled if I had your gifts within my purview instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我拥有你这样的天赋，我会玷污多少人的心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht had brought me to their time, and to their foolish Cathedral. And placed me into their "care."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特把我带到了他们的时代，带到了他们那愚蠢的大教堂，并将我托付给了他们"照顾"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was correct. Though the process of creating one was... laborious and painstaking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的猜想是对的。虽然制作那东西的过程……十分繁琐费力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, I am struck by the immediate fury and anger at knowing that my mind has been trifled with not once but twice in recent history. But there is another emotion that comes to defeat the anger. One I do not quite yet understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，得知我的思想在近期两次遭到戏弄，我当下感到无比愤怒。但还有另一种情绪压倒了愤怒，一种我目前还无法完全理解的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我接下来的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many minds would I have defiled if I had your gifts within my purview instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我拥有你这样的天赋，我会玷污多少人的心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many minds would I have defiled if I had your gifts within my purview instead?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我拥有你这样的天赋，我会玷污多少人的心灵？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, I am struck by the immediate fury and anger at knowing that my mind has been trifled with not once but twice in recent history. But there is another emotion that comes to defeat the anger. One I do not quite yet understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，得知我的思想在近期两次遭到戏弄，我当下感到无比愤怒。但还有另一种情绪压倒了愤怒，一种我目前还无法完全理解的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You. Will. Owe. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。会。欠。我。一。个。人。情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm... no, upon second examination, Usurper - I do not think it is anger I feel upon learning that you have struck my mind of our previous conversations to try them anew -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯……不，仔细想来，篡位者——当我得知你让我想起我们以前的对话，只为重新尝试时，我认为我感受到的不是愤怒——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I am struck by the immediate fury and anger at knowing that my mind has been trifled with not once but twice in recent history. But there is another emotion that comes to defeat the anger. One I do not quite yet understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 得知我的思想在近期两次遭到戏弄，我当下感到无比愤怒。但还有另一种情绪压倒了愤怒，一种我目前还无法完全理解的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is a conversation for another day. For I have a proposal for you. One I believe you will be far more interested in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这又是另一个话题了。因为我有一个提议，我相信你会对此更感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not today. Not tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是今天。也不是明天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know what he told the two zealots, for what little you could piss on it. "Uriel, Heretic of Xata, in banishment, answer - can the Orokin ever be forgiven?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道他跟那两个狂热分子说了什么，虽然那点信息少得可怜。"Uriel，Xata 的异端者，在放逐中，作出回答吧——奥罗金能否得到宽恕？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A Helminth. How it had grown in the past I do not know, as it had to have been there already for us to arrive. It withered and died in the process - I suspected another could be used for a return trip.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 通过一只 Helminth。我不知道它在过去是如何生长的，因为我们到达时它肯定已经在那里了。而它在途中枯萎死去——我猜想或许可以用另一只来回程。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know the details, as the memories are missing from my mind along with a great many others due to the transformation he forced upon me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道细节，因为他强行将我转化，导致我的许多记忆都消失了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is a conversation for another day. For I have a proposal for you. One I believe you will be far more interested in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这又是另一个话题了。因为我有一个提议，我相信你会对此更感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you will owe the Devil a debt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你会欠恶魔一笔债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is a conversation for another day. For I have a proposal for you. One I believe you will be far more interested in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这又是另一个话题了。因为我有一个提议，我相信你会对此更感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I were conscious at the time he had said it, I would have laughed in his face. Namely, because I am not the one here who is clearly seeking forgiveness, am I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果当时我意识清醒，听到他说那番话，我一定会嘲笑他。因为很明显，现在寻求宽恕的并不是我，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was correct. Though the process of creating one was... laborious and painstaking, to say the bloody least! I used samples of my own blood to reverse engineer a Helminth, by damn trial-and-error!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的猜想是对的。不过，制作过程……说得委婉点，真是费时费力！我用自己的血样，通过反复试验，逆向工程制造出了 Helminth！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I have flashes. Shattered bits and pieces of a golden hallway. A voice I recognized - but not a face. It was Albrecht, but not the one I knew.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我脑海中会闪过一些画面。破碎的金色走廊，残缺不全的影像。一个我熟悉的声音——却看不清脸。是阿尔布雷希特，但不是我认识的那个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of seeing Lyon through his pain, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次，我一定会确保你成功帮助里昂度过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are we agreed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们说定了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is a conversation for another day. For I have a proposal for you. One I believe you will be far more interested in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这又是另一个话题了。因为我有一个提议，我相信你会对此更感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is a conversation for another day. For I have a proposal for you. One I believe you will be far more interested in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这又是另一个话题了。因为我有一个提议，我相信你会对此更感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He is the one who runs from his family, from his lover, from the fight he has started with this false god of his! I am not the damnable coward betwixt us!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他才是那个逃离家人、逃离爱人、逃离他与他那虚假之神之间挑起的争斗的人！我可不是我们中那个该死的懦夫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A burning, searing pain. Like none other that I had ever known before. And a previous body of mine lost an arm and a leg in a blast in war, Drifter. I have been covered in burns too severe to have recovered from if not for Kuva. I have known agony.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还​有​灼烧般​的​剧痛，​前​所​未​有​的​痛。​漂泊者，​我​之前​的​身体​在​战争​爆炸​中​失去​了​一​条​胳膊​和​一​条腿。​我​全身​都​被​烧伤，​若非​赤毒​的​帮助，​我​根本​无法​痊愈。​我​曾​饱​受​疼痛​的​折磨。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我接下来的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of ensuring Marie "sees the light" about Entrati, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次，我一定会确保你成功地让玛丽"看清"英择谛的真面目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of uniting us, when the time is right... and I do look forward to it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——我会确保你在时机成熟时实现团结我们的目标……我非常期待那一天的到来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Let us just say that I did not start the process in the same year that I left, hm? Well, we are here now. Albrecht, despite all his best efforts, did not manage to abandon me in that hellhole.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这么说吧，我并不是在离开那年才立刻开始这个过程，嗯？好吧，我们现在就到了这里。阿尔布雷希特尽管使尽浑身解数，最终还是没能把我从那个鬼地方丢掉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My body was being torn asunder and being remade. By force. I did not choose this. I do not know if it was the same for the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的身体被撕裂，又被重塑。这一切都是强加的。这不是我选择的。我不知道其他人是否也经历了同样的遭遇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You. Will. Owe. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。会。欠。我。一。个。人。情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我接下来的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The wise choice. The mundane choice, but the wise choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 明智的选择。虽然平凡，但却是明智的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you will have everything that must go along with it, whatever that is... yes. You will succeed. I will see to it personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而且你会拥有随之而来的一切，无论是什么……是的。你会成功。我会亲自确保这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of being together with your dear Father Lyon Allard when the time is right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——我会确保在合适的时机，你能够实现与里昂·阿拉德神父在一起的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of being together with "little Marie" when the time is right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——我会确保在合适的时机，你能够实现与"小玛丽"在一起的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我接下来的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yet I am surprised to not find him here. I was certain this would be where he would be hiding - with his lover. Or his family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我却很惊讶没在这里找到他。我原以为他和他的情人，或者和他的家人躲在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I remember cold stairs beneath me, as I was dropped upon them. Cathedral stairs, I know them to be now, as Lyon and Marie have told me the story from their recollections.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我记得当时我被扔到冰冷的楼梯上。现在我知道了那是教堂的楼梯，因为里昂和玛丽根据他们的回忆告诉我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not today. Not tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是今天。也不是明天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You. Will. Owe. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。会。欠。我。一。个。人。情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我接下来的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我接下来的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You. Will. Owe. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。会。欠。我。一。个。人。情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah. This has been an entertaining conversation, Usurper, but I must go. We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唉。篡位者，这次谈话真有趣，但我得走了。我们很快会再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, I will be quite ready to greet him when he returns. With a very sharp handshake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，他回来的时候，我会做好充分的准备迎接他。我会和他握手，而且要非常有力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht had brought me to their time, and to their foolish Cathedral. And placed me into their "care."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特把我带到了他们的时代，带到了他们那愚蠢的大教堂，并将我托付给了他们"照顾"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you will owe the Devil a debt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你会欠恶魔一笔债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are we agreed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们说定了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, I am struck by the immediate fury and anger at knowing that my mind has been trifled with not once but twice in recent history. But there is another emotion that comes to defeat the anger. One I do not quite yet understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，得知我的思想在近期两次遭到戏弄，我当下感到无比愤怒。但还有另一种情绪压倒了愤怒，一种我目前还无法完全理解的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of uniting Albrecht's butler and the family, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次我一定会确保你成功地实现让阿尔布雷希特的管家和这个家族团聚的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayal.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是背叛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is a conversation for another day. For I have a proposal for you. One I believe you will be far more interested in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这又是另一个话题了。因为我有一个提议，我相信你会对此更感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我接下来的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You. Will. Owe. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。会。欠。我。一。个。人。情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you will owe the Devil a debt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你会欠恶魔一笔债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not today. Not tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是今天。也不是明天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们说定了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 明智的选择。虽然平凡，但却是明智的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you will have everything that must go along with it, whatever that is... yes. You will succeed. I will see to it personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而且你会拥有随之而来的一切，无论是什么……是的。你会成功。我会亲自确保这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very good. Very good, indeed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 非常好。确实非常好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is almost tragic what's become of Euleria and Petros. We were never friends, mind. But they were still Orokin. And now there are precious few of us left. Though I suppose I should be careful what I say - who knows what I might devolve into, given enough time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 欧拉瑞娅和彼得罗的遭遇简直令人唏嘘。我们之间从来就不是朋友，这一点毋庸置疑。但他们毕竟是奥罗金人。如今，我们奥罗金人所剩无几。不过，我想我还是应该谨言慎行——谁知道假以时日，我会变成什么样呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I find it rather hysterical that Euleria and Petros really haven't the slightest clue that we are down here. Like rats, scurrying about under their feet. How have you and the children managed to keep this all a secret for so long?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得欧拉瑞娅和彼得罗竟然一点儿都没察觉到我们在这里，真是太滑稽了。我们就像老鼠一样，在他们脚下乱窜。你和孩子们是怎么把这一切瞒这么久的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The one I am least surprised to have survived is "Grandmother." (Imagine, giving away a perfectly good name like Dagath.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 最让我毫不意外的是，"祖母"居然还活着。（想想也是，竟然把 Dagath 这么好的名字送人了。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Although I am honestly far more surprised at "Grandmother" being unable to work it out. (Imagine, giving away a perfectly good name like Dagath.) I thought she had more nous in her than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我更惊讶的是"祖母"居然搞不清状况。（想想也是，居然把 Dagath 这么好的名字白白送人了。）我还以为她更聪明一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Although I am honestly far more surprised at "Grandmother" being unable to work it out. (Imagine, giving away a perfectly good name like Dagath.) I thought she had more sense in her than that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，我更惊讶的是"祖母"居然搞不清状况。（想想也是，居然把 Dagath 这么好的名字白白送人了。）我还以为她看得更清楚一些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm? Ah. The necraloid informed me, that you or the child stomped about helping them concoct false names for themselves, having forgotten their original ones. You know him as "Vilcor."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？啊。那个殁世械灵告诉我，你或者那个孩子四处乱窜，帮他们编造假名，因为他们忘记了自己原来的名字。你喊他叫"维尔科"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The boy is petulant, irritating, and egocentric. A perfect Orokin. "Kaelli," as she says she prefers to be called now, I find remarkably intelligent and nearly worth suffering the presence of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 男孩任性、烦人、以自我为中心，简直就是个典型的奥罗金人。"凯莉"（她现在更喜欢别人这么叫她），我觉得她非常聪明，几乎值得我忍受她的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I. This is absurd. I know we have been through all this before. And we've spoken of this already. Which is a matter I still find deeply troubling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我。这太荒谬了。我知道我们以前讨论过这些问题，也谈过这件事。但这件事还是让我觉得不安。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I knew him as Petros Vorten. Proud inventor of the Necramech Fleet. It is strange to think of how much time has passed for him, and how little time has passed - relatively speaking - for me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我认识他时，他叫彼得罗·沃顿，是自豪的殁世机甲舰队发明者。想到对他来说时间已经过去了那么久，而对我来说——相对而言——时间却过得那么快，真是令人感慨万千。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But how do you not already know this? Are you playing me for a fool, Usurper? Certainly we are simply... rehashing old ground, as it were?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你怎么会不知道这些呢？篡位者，你是在耍我吗？难道我们只是在……老调重弹吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, so I have heard from the necraloid. It seems they are still intent on tearing themselves apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我从殁世械灵那里听说了。看来他们仍然执意撕得四分五裂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, so I have heard from the necraloid. Though it seems they have fewer since you or the child worked to resolve them. They are at least not tearing themselves apart - literally - any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我从殁世械灵那里听说了。不过自从你或孩子努力解决这些问题后，他们的问题似乎减少了。至少他们不再像以前那样——字面意思上——互相撕裂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm? Ah. I knew him as Petros Vorten. Proud inventor of the Necramech Fleet. But the necraloid informed me they have forgotten their names. You might still know him only as "Father."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？啊。我以前认识他，他叫彼得罗·沃顿，是自豪的殁世机甲舰队发明者。但殁世械灵告诉我，他们都忘了自己的名字。你可能只知道他叫"父亲"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm? Ah. The necraloid informed me, that you or the child stomped about helping them concoct false names for themselves, having forgotten their original ones. You know him as "Vilcor." But I knew him as Petros Vorten. Proud inventor of the Necramech Fleet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？啊。那个殁世械灵告诉我，你或者那个孩子四处乱窜，帮他们编造假名，因为他们忘记了自己原来的名字。你喊他叫"维尔科"。但我认识他时，他叫彼得罗·沃顿。是自豪的殁世机甲舰队发明者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here I am, ready to launch into some twilight and wandering lecture on Orokin society, in thinking it might be vaguely of interest to you. And then I remind myself, you have very likely heard all this before, haven't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我正准备开始滔滔不绝地讲述奥罗金社会，想着或许你会有点兴趣。然后我又提醒自己，这些你很可能早就听过了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here I am, ready to launch into some twilight and wandering lecture on Orokin society, in thinking it might be vaguely of interest to you. And then I remind myself, that is not why you are here, is it, Drifter? You have another game to play...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我正准备开始滔滔不绝地讲述奥罗金社会，想着或许你会有点兴趣。然后我又提醒自己，你来找我不是为了这个，对吧漂泊者？你还有别的把戏要玩……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Would you prefer I simply played along? Or... is there some particular goal you are working toward by doing this? I am all rather baffled as to what you expect to gain by playing this cruel game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你希望我只是配合你吗？还是……你这么做另有目的？我实在不明白你玩这种残酷的游戏到底想得到什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you admit you're wasting my time. How fantastic! I am not some grizzled, doddery old man, telling the singular war saga for he cannot recall any others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你承认你是在浪费我的时间。太好了！我可不是什么满脸皱纹、老态龙钟的老人，因为记不起其他战争故事，所以只能反复讲述这唯一的故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have you reconsidered my proposal, by the by? My sitting here quietly, in exchange for helping you reconcile the butler and the infested abandoned Orokin outcasts upstairs? Reconciling the family would be the first step, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对​了，​你​有​没​有​重新​考虑​过​我​的​提议？​我​安静​地​坐​在​这里，​帮​你​调解​管家​和​楼上​那些​被​感染​的、​被​遗弃​的​ O​rokin 流放者​之间​的​矛盾？​调解​家庭​矛盾​是​第一步，​不过……​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which you may wish to work on resolving first, before we make any attempts at sending the butler up those stairs. Lest he become mincemeat in the process.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你最好先想办法解决这个问题，然后再考虑让管家上楼。免得他在这个过程中变成肉酱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have you reconsidered my proposal, by the by? My sitting here quietly, in exchange for helping you reconcile the butler and the infested abandoned Orokin outcasts upstairs?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对了，你有没有重新考虑过我的提议？我安静地坐在这里，帮你调解管家和楼上那些被感染的、被遗弃的奥罗金流放者之间的矛盾？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which is good, as we would have made little progress without you or the child completing that step first. I fear the butler would have been bound for mincemeat the moment we sent him up those stairs otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这也好，因为如果没有你或孩子先完成这一步，我们几乎不可能取得任何进展。否则，我担心我们一派管家上楼，他就会立刻被揍成肉酱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here I am, ready to launch into some twilight and wandering lecture on Orokin society, in thinking it might be vaguely of interest to you. And then I remind myself, you have very likely heard all this before, haven't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我正准备开始滔滔不绝地讲述奥罗金社会，想着或许你会有点兴趣。然后我又提醒自己，这些你很可能早就听过了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have asked an Orokin to speak. You know not what you have done. You will be here for an hour if you are not careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟然让一个奥罗金人开口说话。你根本不知道自己做了什么。要是一个不注意，你得在这里待上一个小时。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? And "pray" tell, why is that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？那么，"请问"这是为什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The reason I cannot recall this conversation stands in your damnable mirror!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我之所以记不起这段对话，就是因为你，看着你就像照镜子一样！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: One thing you must understand is that the butler and the Entrati family are, however far removed, still Orokin. They were born and raised by that society, for all its... many faults.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你必须明白一点，管家和英择谛家族虽然与奥罗金关系疏远，但他们终究还是奥罗金人。他们出生并成长于这个社会，尽管这个社会……存在诸多缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I suppose you may not have had much opportunity to interact with Orokin, have you, Drifter? The child lived a very different life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过漂泊者，我想你可能没多少机会和奥罗金人接触吧？毕竟那孩子过着和你截然不同的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. That's right. And we both know why, don't we? But you are going to be patient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，没错。我们都知道为什么，对吧？但你必须耐心等待。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Suit yourself. The door will not stay open for long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 随你便吧。但这扇门不会一直开着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And for all of its grievous sins, rank and order were never questioned. Not amongst the military - and not amongst the social structure. The Archimedeans obeyed the Orokin. The Orokin obeyed the Executors. The Executors obeyed the Emperors... well, at least in name.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管罪恶滔天，等级和秩序却从未受到质疑。无论是在军队中，还是在社会结构中，皆是如此。哲士服从奥罗金人，奥罗金人服从执行者，执行者服从皇帝……至少名义上如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: From what I hear tell, you veered at the point of the Zariman Ten Zero's tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 据我所知，你的人生就是在扎里曼 10-0 号悲剧发生时偏离了轨道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In the meanwhile, if you wish to "listen," I am happy to oblige. Simply, fair warning. You have asked an Orokin to speak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 与此同时，如果你想"听听"，我很乐意奉陪。不过，先提醒你一下，你请的是一位奥罗金人说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Know thy enemy, is it then? Or perhaps just curiosity to sit across the proverbial table from an impossibility?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 知己知彼，是吗？或者仅仅是出于好奇，想与一个不可能的人面对面交流？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wriggle all you want, fish. You swam to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 鱼儿，你想怎么挣扎都行，是你自己游到我这儿来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And even if you do not believe that somehow, even after all this time, traditions might inspire Loid to listen to me? Consider the fact that I can be... deeply convincing. I was the right hand to the worst of the Executors, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 即便你不相信，即便过了这么久，传统也许能让洛德听我的话？想想看，我可是很有说服力的。毕竟，我曾是那些最邪恶的执行者的得力助手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know not what you have done. You will be here for an hour if you are not careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你根本不知道自己做了什么。要是一个不注意，你得在这里待上一个小时。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you? Hm. We shall see how long I can keep this fish on the spear, then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这么觉得吗？嗯。那我们就看看我能把这条鱼叉住多久吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. I do. And here I thought you were going to do me the honor of letting me see it in writing. Ah, well...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我知道。我还以为你会好心写出来给我看呢。唉……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed I have. Ah, Ballas. It may shock you to know he was not the worst of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实如此。啊，Ballas。你或许会惊讶地发现，他并非他们中最恶劣的一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nor do I suspect I blame you. I thought they could be salvaged. Melted down, of sorts - reformed, recast, like gold.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我不会责怪你。我以为他们还能挽救。某种程度上来说，可以熔化——重塑，重铸，就像黄金一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Respectable. Wise, even. Had I the opportunity to interview and, perhaps even befriend, a Sentient? I would have done the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 令人尊敬，甚至睿智。如果我也有机会与一位 Sentient 生物交谈，甚至成为朋友，我也会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Another time, perhaps. As you, Usurper, must learn to savor these moments.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许改日再说吧。篡位者啊，你得学会珍惜这些时刻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wonderful! I am glad you finally have seen sense. Now we can finally make some progress.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了！我很高兴你终于醒悟了。现在我们终于可以取得一些进展了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I respect your opinion, and I do not fault you for it. Ballas was a cretin and he was a champion amongst the depraved, I will not argue with you over that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我尊重你的观点，也不会因此责怪你。Ballas 是个蠢货，但他确实是数一数二的堕落者，这一点我不会和你争论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I understand you have had personal dealings with Ballas, and I do not fault you for likely believing him to be the very worst the Seven Golden Lords had to offer up. And he was a champion amongst the depraved, I will not argue with you over that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​知道​你​曾​与​ Ballas ​有​过私下​接触，​所以​你​认为​他​是​七位​黄金之​主中​最​邪恶​的​一​个，​我​完全​理解。​他​的​确​是​数​一​数二​的​堕落者，​这​一​点​我​同意。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. Save the Executors. They were a lost cause. It may shock you to know Ballas was not the worst of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好​吧。​除了​那些​执行者。​他们​已经​没​救​了。​你​或许会​惊讶​地​发现，​Ballas ​还​不​是​他们​中​最​坏​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It provides a psychological benefit should you ever meet one - or even your former ally - upon the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你在战场上遇到他们——甚至是你的前盟友——这会给你带来心理上的好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, in fact, I did not witness the horror of this "Narmer" business that I have learned of from the butler and gleaned from the records on this POM-2 machine here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然事实上​我​并​没有​亲眼​目睹​这个​"合​一众"​事件​的​恐怖​之处，​只​从​管家​那里、​以及​从​这​台​石榴 2 代​机器​上​的​记录​中​了解​而​已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Executor Nitokh. Grand Regent Executor Nitokh, to be precise. The commander of all the military forces of the Orokin Empire. And the most vicious and deadly of the Seven Golden Lords.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 执行者尼托。准确地说，是摄政王执行者尼托。奥罗金帝国所有军队的统帅。也是黄金七人众中最凶残、最致命的一位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have heard me speak of her before. And, more importantly, a hint of what we were planning. But that is a story for another day. Executor Nitokh. Grand Regent Executor Nitokh, to be precise. Commander of all our military forces, and the most vicious and deadly of the Seven Golden Lords.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你以前听我提起过她。更重要的是，我还透露过我们的计划。不过，那是另一个故事了。执行者尼托。确切地说，是摄政王执行者尼托。我们所有军队的统帅，也是黄金七人众中最凶残、最致命的一位。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is even quite possible that he outpaced the Executors of old during this... "Narmer" business that I have heard about from the butler and read about on this POM-2 here.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 甚至很有可能，他在这场我从管家那里听说的、以及我在石榴 2 代中读到的"合一众"事件中，超越了过去那些执行者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not saying he was a saint. I am telling you the worst of the devils was just slightly outclassed by his peers. It is only the barest of hairs I split, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不是说他是圣人。我只是告诉你，即使是最邪恶的恶魔，也只是比他的同辈略逊一筹而已。篡位者，我这不过是吹毛求疵罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, if you wish to "listen," I am happy to oblige. Simply, fair warning. You have asked an Orokin to speak.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，如果你想"听听"，我很乐意奉陪。不过，先提醒你一下，你竟然让一个奥罗金人开口说话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: However, I also would suggest, that it is due to your very personal proximity to Ballas and very limited interactions with the other six Golden Lords that gives you this impression.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，我也认为，这或许是因为你与 Ballas 的私人关系非常密切，而与其他六位的互动却非常有限，才让你产生了这种印象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Golden Seven. Bah. Do you know what the best thing about gold is, Drifter? It can be endlessly melted down and repurposed into something better.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 黄金七人众？呸。漂泊者，你知道黄金最好的一点是什么吗？它可以无限熔化，然后重新制成更好的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But was Ballas the worst? To you, perhaps. And, perhaps his crimes in this era outpaced the Executors of old.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但 Ballas 是罪大恶极的吗？或许对你而言是。而且，或许他在这个时期的罪行比以前那些执行者还要严重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I believed - and in a way, still do - that the Orokin were salvageable. That we could have turned the Empire around. But the Executors? No. They had to be stopped. They were all the worst that humanity had to offer, by a matter of degrees.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我曾相信——某种程度上现在依然相信——奥罗金人还有救。我们本可以扭转帝国的颓势。但执行者呢？不，必须阻止他们。他们在每一种程度上，都是人类所能展现的最邪恶的化身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But if you had gazed upon the lakes of crimson and fields of bent and fragmented corpses, like so many discarded children's toys -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但如果你亲眼见过那片血红的湖泊，以及遍地弯曲破碎的尸体，就像许多被丢弃的儿童玩具——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And this is coming from me, Usurper. So allow me, this Devil of Tau himself, to assure you - as a connoisseur myself, that Ballas was not the worst amongst them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，这话是我说的。所以，请允许我，Tau 的恶魔本人，以一个行家的身份向你保证，Ballas 并非他们中最差的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you had seen the pure devastation Nitokh could wreak with barely even a moment's thought...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你亲眼目睹过尼托几乎不费吹灰之力就能造成的毁灭性破坏……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But such horrors are hard to feel unless they are witnessed. Such tragedy is not understood in numbers. I could go on at length about what I have seen, but to you, they will be simply that - stories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但除非亲眼目睹，否则很难体会到这种恐怖。这种悲剧无法用数字来衡量。我可以长篇大论地讲述我所见所闻，但对你而言，它们仅仅是故事而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To you, Ballas shall always be the far more present and horrifying malefactor. And such is to be expected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对你来说，Ballas 永远是那个更加真实、更加令人恐惧的恶棍。这也在情理之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah! That is what you are, yes? The Tenno usurped the Origin System from the Orokin. And you, like a little imposter in the nest, have stolen into this world from your own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊！你就是这种人，对吧？Tenno 从奥罗金手中夺取了始源星系。而你，就像巢穴里的小冒牌货，从你自己的世界偷偷溜进了这个世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you had gazed upon the lakes of crimson and fields of bent and fragmented corpses, like so many discarded children's toys -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但如果你亲眼见过那片血红的湖泊，以及遍地弯曲破碎的尸体，就像许多被丢弃的儿童玩具——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is much to him you do not know. There is already too much that has been said about that cretin. And more that is needing to be said, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你对他的了解还远远不够。关于那个蠢货，已经说得够多了。而我担心还有更多的话不得不说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And that makes you, on at least two counts, a Usurper by my measure. (And perhaps a third, if we count what the butler has told me of Duviri, but that is a debate for another time.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这样看来，至少从这两点来说，你都是个篡位者。（如果算上管家告诉我的关于双衍王境的那些事，或许还有第三点，但这又是另一个话题了。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't distract me, Usurper. I understand you may have a hard time believing me, but if you had gazed upon the lakes of crimson and fields of bent and fragmented corpses, like so many discarded children's toys -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，别打岔。我知道你可能很难相信我，但如果你亲眼见过那片血红的湖泊，以及遍地弯曲破碎的尸体，就像许多被丢弃的儿童玩具——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, yes. Well, I suppose you will just have to sit through stories of my life, instead. How droll.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，是的。好吧，看来你只能听我讲讲我的人生故事了。真滑稽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is a... very long story. One that I do not have time for at the moment. The butler is looming. And I despise being loomed over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那说来话长，我现在没时间细说。管家就在旁边，我最讨厌被人盯着。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Terribly rude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 非常无礼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们很快会再聊的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们很快会再聊的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of seeing Lyon through his pain, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次，我一定会确保你成功帮助里昂度过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How goes progress on your end, my Usurper? I busily pull strings and levers in your favor, though my influence may be unseen and unfelt thus far.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的篡位者，你那边进展如何？我一直在积极为你施展各种关系和手段，虽然我的影响力至今可能不为人知，也感觉不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I find it so terribly fascinating that you schemed with me to... arrange my own path. The devil deals in his own flesh, as it were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟然和我合谋……来安排我的道路，这让我觉得无比着迷。恶魔也以己身为筹码，真是讽刺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer. Where I might have proved a barrier of resistance before, regarding your... romantic goals? Now, I shall be as docile as a snow terrisk. Hmm. Unless that is not what you desire. You can be the decider of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉​我，​对于​我​的​提议，​你​已经​改变​主意​了。​以前，​我​或许会​成为​你​……恋爱​计划​中​的​一​道​阻碍？​现在，​我​会​像​雪​地​里​的​野兽​一样​温顺。​嗯，​除非​你​并不​想​要​这样。​这​由​你​来​决定。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer. I can solve this Marie problem for you. Ensure that you navigate to your romantic goals with her with ease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，对于我的提议，你已经改变主意了。我可以帮你解决玛丽的问题，确保你和她之间的恋爱关系进展顺利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer. I can solve this Lyon problem for you. Ensure that you navigate to your romantic goals with him with ease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，对于我的提议，你已经改变主意了。我可以帮你解决里昂的问题，确保你和他之间的恋爱关系进展顺利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer. Where I might have proved a barrier of resistance before, regarding my... taking of the serum? I will prove as docile as a snow terrisk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，对于我的提议，你已经改变主意了。之前我或许会成为你抗拒的障碍，比如我注射血清这件事？现在我会像雪地里的野兽一样温顺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer. Where I might have proved a barrier of resistance before, reuniting the butler and his family? I will prove as docile as a snow terrisk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，对于我的提议，你已经改变主意了。以前我或许会成为阻碍，让管家和他的家族团聚？现在我会像雪地里的野兽一样温顺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer - I can solve this Marie problem for you. Ensure that you navigate your conversations with her with ease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，对于我的提议，你已经改变主意了——我可以帮你解决玛丽的问题。确保你和她沟通起来得心应手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me that you have changed your mind regarding my offer - I can solve this Lyon problem for you. Ensure that you navigate your conversations with him with ease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，对于我的提议，你已经改变主意了——我可以帮你解决里昂的问题。确保你和他沟通起来得心应手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot help but think that you are lingering in these conversations of ours for a reason, Usurper. And that it might be something I can help you with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我不禁在想，你之所以一直参与我们的谈话，肯定是有原因的。或许我能帮上你的忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is an odd challenge from my perspective, to only be operating with part of my memories intact and knowing you hold the other half of the deck in your hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从我的角度来看，这是一种奇怪的挑战，我只能带着不完整的记忆行动，而你却掌握着剩下那半副牌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But all this... milling about that you are doing? It is merely wasting time. So come now. Say the word. And your problem will be solved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但​你​这样​磨磨​蹭蹭​的​……​纯粹​是​在​浪费​时间。​所以，​别犹豫​了，​把​那​句​话​说​出来，​你​的​问题​就​解决​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me what you're after, and let us come to an agreement. All this... milling about is merely wasting time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我你的目的，然后我们达成一致。这样磨磨蹭蹭只会浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So I shall just carry on, then, for lack of anything better to do. "How goes it with our little floating sycophant, by the by? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you." Bah. What a farce.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然也没什么更好的事可做，我就继续吧。"对了，我们那个会飘的小马屁精怎么样了？我猜神父还是没有和你说话吧" 呸。真是荒唐可笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me, have you changed your mind on my offer? This will be your last chance, Usurper. I am a patient devil, but I do not like to be left about to hold doors open like a fool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我，对于我的提议，你已经改变主意了。篡位者，这是你最后的机会。我这人耐心十足，但我可不喜欢像个傻瓜一样被人闲着没事干，一直开着门。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How goes your progress so far with our little floating sycophant? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你和我们那个会飘的小马屁精进展如何？我猜神父还是没有和你说话吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish. Fair warning, this was your last opportunity. You are on your own, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。不过我得提醒你，这是你最后的机会了。现在，一切都得靠你自己了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "So far." Intriguing. And we really are all just retracing our steps, like courtiers echoing the moves of a dance? Again and again, doomed to repeat ourselves?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "至少到目前为止"。真耐人寻味。难道我们真的都在原地踏步，就像朝臣们重复着舞步一样？一遍又一遍，注定要​自​我​重复？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose you would know, wouldn't you? Interesting that it is so predictable. Nice to know even someone as shattered as he is, can still be counted upon now and then.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想你应该知道吧？真有意思，一切都这么容易预料。很高兴知道，即使像他这样心力交瘁的人，偶尔还是能让人放心的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't you already know? Mm. Perhaps you did not make it that far. Or you did not think to ask the first or twenty-thousandth time through this little romp.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道还不知道吗？嗯。或许你还没了解得那么深。或者，在这段小小的循环中，不管是重复一遍还是两万遍，你都没想过去问。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh. And one more thing, before I forget?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，还有一件事，我差点忘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... appear to have forgotten what it was you were after. Blame your meddling with my memories. What was it again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……好像忘了你想要什么。都怪你篡改了我的记忆。到底是什么来着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How you have truly sold your soul to the devil and twice over... making an arrangement to ensure I take you to my bed? Or are you after my heart, Usurper? Mm. We shall see. But in time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟然真的将灵魂出卖给恶魔，而且还出卖了两次……精心算计就为了确保我会将你带上我的床？还是说，篡位者，你想要的是我的心？嗯，我们拭目以待。以后总会知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When the time comes, I shall ensure your path is clear to woo our little floating sycophant, Usurper. Consider it dealt with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，等时机成熟，我定会为你扫清障碍，好去让你追求我们那个漂在空中的小马屁精。就当这件事已经办妥了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When the time comes, I shall ensure your path is clear to woo the poor shattered priest, Usurper. Consider it dealt with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，等时机成熟，我定会为你扫清障碍，好去让你追求我们那个可怜兮兮、心灰意冷的神父。就当这件事已经办妥了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When the time comes, I shall remember this. Should we have a further disagreement about my memories, we shall not repeat your previous mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 时机成熟时，我会记住这一点。如果我们以后再对我的记忆产生分歧，我们绝不会重蹈覆辙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider your issue with Lyon and his horrors dealt with, Usurper. When the time comes, I shall handle it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，就当你与里昂及其恐惧之间的问题已经办妥了。时机成熟时，我会亲自处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider your issue with Marie and her sycophantic adoration of Entrati dealt with. When the time comes, I shall handle it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就当你对玛丽以及她对英择谛的谄媚崇拜的问题已经办妥了。等时机成熟，我会亲自处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When the time comes, I will ensure that little butler walks up those stairs. Consider it dealt with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等时机成熟，我定会确保那小管家走上那几级台阶。就当这件事已经办妥了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would counsel simple patience instead, but... far be it from me to advise you to use a chisel when there is a laser pick sitting next to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本想建议你耐心等待，但是……既然旁边就有激光切割器，我又怎么会建议你用凿子呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. I see. A noble endeavor, if I am being honest. One that I have attempted myself many, many times over. And failed equally so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我明白了。说实话，这的确是一件高尚的事。我自己也尝试过很多很多次，但都以失败告终。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. I see. I offered you an arrangement, and you could not hold up your end of the bargain somehow, so you saw your prize fade from view.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我明白了。我给你开出了条件，但你却没能履行承诺，所以眼睁睁地看着你的奖赏从眼前消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish. I warn you, this decision of yours cannot be undone without consequences.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。但我警告你，你的这个决定无法逆转，而且后果不堪设想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When he does speak, it generally falls into two categories - horrifically inane or horrifically insane.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他说话的话通常分两种——要么极其愚蠢，要么极其疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm? Have you escaped it thus far? I am so terribly envious of you. It won't be long before you are caught up in the blast radius however, so it's best you have fair warning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？你到现在还没被波及到吗？我真是太羡慕你了。不过，你很快也会被卷入冲击范围，所以最好提前做好心理准备。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My poor Drifter. Have you forgotten how strictly we Orokin rejected any sense of holy deities? The only thing we worshiped was ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可怜的漂泊者。你难道忘了我们奥罗金人是如何彻底摒弃一切神圣神祇的吗？我们唯一崇拜的只有我们自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are we truly all doomed to repeat ourselves, like courtiers echoing the moves of a dance?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: ​难道我们就​像​朝臣们​重复​着​舞步​一样？​一​遍​又​一遍，​注定​要​自​我​重复？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not so very long ago, I trusted you with a horrible truth. Now I cannot remember why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不久前，我向你坦白了一个可怕的真相。如今，我却想不起为什么了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think I am also starting to understand why you have wiped our minds clean. Seeing all your failed attempts and endeavors... why not strike the board and try again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我渐渐明白你为什么要抹去我们的记忆了。看到你所有失败的尝试和努力……为什么不重头再来呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Seeing in frustration that you could no longer convince her of the simple truth of things, you resorted to that which was - using this... gift of yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你沮丧地发现你再也无法让她相信事情的真相，于是你诉诸于唯一可行的办法——利用你的这份……天赋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not appreciate you fouling my mind to fix your mistakes, Drifter. However, that you are attempting to do it for my sake is... I suppose, somehow, acceptable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我不赞同你为了弥补自己的错误而扰乱我的心智。但是，你这么做是为了我……我想，某种程度上来说，这也可以接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So, knowing you could no longer achieve that which was previously in your grasp, you resorted to that which was - using this... gift of yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，当你知道自己再也无法做到以前能做到的事，你就转而利用你所拥有的……天赋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is always a flip of the coin which one you're liable to get, and I can never decide which one I prefer more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 总是像抛硬币一样，看你最终会得到哪一个，我永远也无法决定我更喜欢哪一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That woman is interminable in her unwavering and obsessive dedication for Albrecht. I would say the butler should be worried, but I honestly firmly believe it is an innocent devotion. And this is coming from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那个女人对阿尔布雷希特的忠诚和痴迷简直没完没了。我觉得管家应该担心，但我真心相信这是一种纯粹的爱。这话可是我说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Those two zealots cannot go two minutes without "Sol" this or "Lua" that or without trying to bless the piss pot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这两个狂热分子每分每秒都离不开"太阳神"这个"月神"那个，连尿壶都要祝福一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am amused by your optimism. Heroes. That's all you people are, I swear. Bags of meat and bone inflated and operated purely by optimism and hope. It's enough to make your teeth rot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的乐观真是让我哭笑不得。英雄。我发誓，你们这些人不过是些空洞的血肉之躯，靠着乐观和希望活着。真是让人笑得牙疼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, you misunderstand me. In a way, I find it comforting. It means that even when you strip us down to our bare components, we are still the same. We cannot change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，你误会我的意思了。某种程度上，我觉得这很令人欣慰。这意味着，即使你把我们剥离到最基本的组成部分，我们依然是原来的我们。我们无法改变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are both the one soul I may have ever hoped to trust... and the reason I now cannot recall why I had dared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你们俩也许是我唯一想要信任的灵魂……也是我现在想不起来当初为什么敢于信任你们的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But to quote the little floating sycophant? C'est la vie. How goes it with her, by the by? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但用那个会飘的小马屁精的话来说？C'est la vie。对了，她最近怎么样了？我猜神父还是没有和你说话吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am so pleased you have come around and we can finally move forward! I thought we were going to be trapped going about in circles like that for centuries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真高兴你终于想通了，我们终于可以继续了！我还以为我们会像这样原地打转几个世纪呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hysterically enough? I still prefer him over the sister. At least he can be reasoned with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说来也怪，我还是更喜欢他而不是那个修女。至少他还能讲道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She simply is just that mind-numbingly sanctimonious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她简直就是个令人麻木的伪善者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which I will have you know, they still used in that damn cathedral! Actual -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我跟你说，他们居然还在那破教堂里用那玩意儿！真的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Understand what that makes you to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你明白你对我来说意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: First: I am impressed! You took away all our memories so that you could have another attempt at winning his affections?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先：我真是佩服！你为了再一次赢得他的芳心，竟然抹去了我们所有的记忆？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh this is truly magical! You took away all our memories in an attempt to have another try at winning my affections?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，这可真是神奇呢！你竟然为了再次赢得我的芳心，夺走了我们所有的记忆？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: First: I am impressed! You took away all our memories so that you could have another attempt at winning her affections?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先：我真是佩服！你为了再一次赢得她的芳心，竟然抹去了我们所有的记忆？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Although you would be the expert in such things, wouldn't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然你在这方面应该是专家，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never mind. Never mind! It is done with. It is over.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 算了，算了！事情已经过去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh. And one more thing, before I forget?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，还有一件事，我差点忘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of ensuring Marie "sees the light" about Entrati, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次，我一定会确保你成功地让玛丽"看清"英择谛的真面目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of resolving my conscience and these memories, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次，我一定会确保你成功地解决我的良心问题，以及接受我的这些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How very Orokin of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是太像奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of uniting Albrecht's butler and the family, no matter what, this time around.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——无论如何，这一次我一定会确保你成功地实现让阿尔布雷希特的管家和这个家族团聚的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh yes, actually. You mortally offended him, the moment you stepped in here. I just haven't had the heart to tell you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，有的，的确有。你一踏进这里，就彻底惹恼了他。我只是不忍心告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely. I'm unsure if one of those primitive kaithes kicked her in the head as a child, or if she is truly that sorely lacking for father figures, I do not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正是如此。我不确定她小时候是不是被某个原始的绝灵骥踢过头，还是她真的那么缺乏父爱，我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As a bit of a father figure, perhaps. Or a holy one. I am unsure if one of those primitive kaithes of their time kicked her in the head as a child, or if she was severely lacking for mentors, I do not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许有点像父亲一样。或者像个圣人。我不确定她小时候是不是被当时那些原始的绝灵骥踢过头，还是她严重缺乏导师，我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The point I am making, is that they are very keen to explain to me, at length, how I am quite horrible and that I should go about repenting and apologizing for everything I have ever done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的意思是，他们非常热衷于向我详细解释我有多么糟糕，我应该忏悔并为我做过的一切道歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That leads me in the direction of a debate I think you are expecting to have, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你是想把我引向那场你早就等着的辩论……不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That leads me in the direction of a debate I think you are very much expecting to have... and win, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你是想把我引向那场你早就等着、而且自认能赢的辩论……不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not so very long ago, I trusted you with a horrible truth. Now I cannot remember why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不久前，我向你坦白了一个可怕的真相。如今，我却想不起为什么了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will pretend to be none the wiser in front of the zealots for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以为了你在那些狂热分子面前装作一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How I desperately wish for her to wake up to the truth of Albrecht's lies. They are sitting all around her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我多么希望她能醒悟过来，看清阿尔布雷希特的谎言。那些谎言就在她身边。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are both the one soul I may have ever hoped to trust... and the reason I now cannot recall why I had dared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是我唯一想要信任的灵魂……也是我现在想不起来当初为什么敢于信任你的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But mark my words, Drifter: You. Will. Owe. Me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但漂泊者，记住我的话：你。欠。我。一。个。人。情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of being together with your dear Father Lyon Allard when the time is right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——我会确保在合适的时机，你能够实现与里昂·阿拉德神父在一起的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of uniting us, when the time is right... and I do look forward to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——我会确保你在时机成熟时实现团结我们的目标……我非常期待那一天的到来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, more importantly - I will ensure that you will succeed in your goal of being together with "little Marie" when the time is right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是——我会确保在合适的时机，你能够实现与"小玛丽"在一起的目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now that we have that sorted and out of the way, how goes your progress so far with our little floating sycophant? I take it the priest is still not speaking to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然这件事已经解决了，你和我们那个会飘的小马屁精进展如何？我猜神父还是没有和你说话吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, why would I be? I have heard Lyon appreciates the kind of strange chocolate they had in his year. I've heard it calms his visions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我为什么要那样？我听说里昂很喜欢他们年代吃到的那种奇特的巧克力。我听说那种巧克力能让他平静下来，不再出现幻觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: With chocolates. You bribe him by bringing him chocolates, Usurper. I have heard it calms his visions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 用巧克力贿赂他。篡位者，你用巧克力贿赂他。我听说这能平息他的幻觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have heard it is customary for people in his time to present priests a box of chocolates as a gift. Besides, I have heard chocolate calms his visions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我听说在他那个时代，人们习惯送神父一盒巧克力作为礼物。此外，我还听说巧克力能平息他的幻象。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider this, if you will - if she can stare the truth dead in the face and still deny it with Albrecht? She is fully capable of doing the same with far more dangerous things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不妨想想——如果她已经看到了关于阿尔布雷希特的真相，却仍然否认，那么她完全有能力在更危险的事情上也这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And why would they know the first thing about that? No, my Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们怎么可能知道这些？我的篡位者，不是呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you, now?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在呢，你知道了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do not get to decide when this conversation ends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你无权决定这场对话何时结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My memories may be lacking, Drifter - but my intelligence is not. Do not play me for a fool.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我的记忆或许残缺，但我的智慧丝毫不减。别把我当傻子耍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Understand what that makes you to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你明白你对我来说意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not today. Not tomorrow. But you will owe the Devil a debt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是今天。也不是明天。但你会欠恶魔一笔债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah! I can almost hear them now, screaming and shouting at me about how I am "corrupting you against them."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 呸！我仿佛都能听到他们冲我大喊大叫，说我"挑拨离间，让你背叛他们"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And a hell, it has been!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可不嘛，就是地狱！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! I shall make you a list! It is exhaustive and yet nonspecific, always shifting from unknowable evils to seemingly unfathomable corruption!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！​我​应该​给​你​列​个​清单！​冗长​又​含糊​不清，​总是​从​不​可知​的​罪恶​到​看似​深不​可测​的​腐败​之间​来​回​变换！​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do not know what it is like, to have those zealots hovering over your shoulder at all hours, screaming and lecturing at you about how you must repent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不知道那种感觉，那些狂热分子时刻在你身后徘徊，对你大喊大叫，说你必须忏悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know we are at the limit, I can feel the strain of my mind fighting against me. You are doing the best you can to help me regain my memories. And for that, I am grateful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道我们已经到了极限，我能感觉到我的大脑在与我抗争。你已经尽力帮助我恢复记忆了，对此我感激不尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We have just begun to unlock the barest drips and drabs of what was locked away from me. I do not know what Albrecht told them of my crimes, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们才刚刚揭开我失落记忆的只言片语。漂泊者，我不知道阿尔布雷希特跟他们说了我的哪些罪行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We have just begun to scratch the surface of what was locked away from me. I do not know what Albrecht told them of my crimes, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们才刚刚揭开失我落记忆的冰山一角。漂泊者，我不知道阿尔布雷希特跟他们说了我的哪些罪行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know what Albrecht told them of my crimes, for they are hidden even from me. The truth is hidden in my memories, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道阿尔布雷希特向他们说了我的哪些罪行，因为连我自己都不知道。漂泊者，真相就藏在我的记忆里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not so very long ago, I trusted you with a horrible truth. Now I cannot remember why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不久前，我向你坦白了一个可怕的真相。如今，我却想不起为什么了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well if you aren't going to be tedious, Drifter, why would I waste my time with you? I already have the zealots, and I'm seemingly required to spend time with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，既然你不会让我感到厌烦，那我为什么要浪费时间在你身上？我已经有狂热分子要应付了，而且我似乎还得花时间跟他们待在一起。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, so she told you. Of course she did. Well, it is hardly my fault! Those damnable treats were the only good thing about that backwater hellhole of a city.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，原来她告诉你了。她当然会说这事。好吧，这可不是我的错！那些该死的零食可是那个偏僻鬼地方唯一的好东西了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need to know what was taken away from me, Drifter. I need to know what Albrecht robbed from me when he forced this serum upon me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我需要知道我失去了什么。我需要知道阿尔布雷希特强迫我注射这种血清时，他从我身上夺走了什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need to know what Albrecht robbed from me when he forced this serum upon me. I need to know what is locked away inside my head, Drifter. Whenever it isn't an inconvenience for you, of course...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要知道阿尔布雷希特强迫我注射这种血清时，他从我身上夺走了什么。漂泊者，我需要知道我的脑子里究竟封存着什么。当然，前提是你有时间的话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are both the one soul I may have ever hoped to trust... and the reason I now cannot recall why I had dared.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是我唯一想要信任的灵魂……也是我现在想不起来当初为什么敢于信任你的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And why would I be angry, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我为什么会生气？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Tampered with my memory." Like I am some Ayatan Sculpture being toyed with as a prank. You did more than just tamper with my memory. You struck it clean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "篡改了我的记忆。"就好像我是一个被当成玩物摆弄的阿耶檀识塑像一样。你做的远不止篡改我的记忆，你是把它彻底抹去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Good sport. Blasted chocolates were the only good thing about that backwater hellhole of a city.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈哈！好样的。那座偏僻鬼地方唯一的好处就是巧克力了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Understand what that makes you to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你明白你对我来说意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Before you ask, it's a story best told by Marie, lest I have the zealots screaming and ranting at me again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在你问之前，我得说，这个故事最好由玛丽来讲述，免得那些狂热分子又对我大喊大叫、咆哮不休。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, with the blue skin, tail, infested flesh, and all. It is astonishing what a cloak, hat and a mask can do for you.
