/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，连蓝色的皮肤、尾巴、被感染的血肉全都在。一件斗篷、一顶帽子和一个面具就能糊弄过去了，真是不可思议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was easy enough. Besides - as a "protoframe" and a battle-trained Orokin elite, I think I am capable enough to take some pastries from a market without alerting the authorities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这很容易。再说，作为一个"原型战甲"和身经百战的奥罗金精英，我觉得我完全有能力不引起当局的注意从市场上顺手拿些糕点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Promises to the devil... a dangerous thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 向恶魔保证……是一件危险的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I am a patient devil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我正好是耐心的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: See that you do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你最好做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course not! Where would the fun in that be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那当然了！不然还有什么乐趣可言？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How wonderfully charming! And I am hardly even surprised! And what do I even care if that is the truth or not?! And besides which -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是太有趣了！我一点也不觉得意外！至于这是真是假，我又何必在意呢？！而且——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wrong! Breathtakingly, beautifully, blissfully wrong! Do not speak to me as though you know the intricacies of a rage I think you can so clearly not even begin to comprehend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 错！错得离谱，错得不能再错，错得近乎极致！别跟我装作你了解那种愤怒，我觉得你根本就无法理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not dare to speak to me of what is valuable in my mind and what is not, Drifter. It is not yours over which to claim ownership.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你竟敢对我指手画脚，告诉我什么有价值什么没价值。这并非你的私有物，你无权据为己有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They shout and yell at me about sin and how I am in need of repenting enough, without adding "lying about my side of the story yet again" to the pile.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们对我大喊大叫，已经指责过我犯了罪，需要好好忏悔，不用再把"我又一次撒谎编造故事"也算进去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Humans are quick to dismiss those they wish not to see. Besides - as a "protoframe" and a battle-trained Orokin elite, I think I am capable enough to take some pastries from a market without alerting the authorities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 人类总是轻易地将他们不想见到的人拒之门外。再说，作为一个"原型战甲"和身经百战的奥罗金精英，我觉得我完全有能力不引起当局的注意从市场上顺手拿些糕点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, with the blue skin, tail, infested flesh, and all. It is astonishing what a cloak, hat and a mask can do for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，连蓝色的皮肤、尾巴、被感染的血肉全都在。一件斗篷、一顶帽子和一个面具就能糊弄过去了，真是不可思议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah. You expected me to, what, take enough just for myself and leave them without? Why, simply because I do not enjoy their company and wish to rid myself of them?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊。你以为我会怎样？只拿走自己需要的量，不留给他们？就因为我不喜欢和他们待在一起，想摆脱他们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everything on that planet was going to shortly belong to the Orokin Empire. It was mine by right, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那颗星球上的一切很快都将属于奥罗金帝国。反正按理说，那本来就是我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You think that my dislike of them somehow necessitates that I also be cruel to them. Because I am a devil, and, therefore, prone to such acts, is the reasoning that follows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你认为我厌恶他们就必然意味着我要残忍对待他们。因为你是恶魔，所以才会做出这种事，这就是你接下来的逻辑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Besides, I had no money. What did you expect me to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 再说，我身无分文。你指望我能怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How utterly disappointing. Shallow acts like that are reserved for the extremely dull and the schoolyard bully.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是令人失望透顶。这种肤浅的行为只有极其无趣的人和校园恶霸才会做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I know you stampede your way through ships and take whatever it is you need or want - do not bat your innocent eyes at me, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我还知道你横冲直撞地闯入飞船，夺取你需要或想要的一切——篡位者，不要用你那无辜的眼神对我眨眼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hate them. Yet I have to coexist with them. I do not wish them to be deprived of a silly pastry. It is a pastry. Why worsen matters so needlessly?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我讨厌他们。但我不得不和他们共存。我不希望他们连一块小小的糕点都吃不到。它只是一块糕点而已。何必让事情变得更糟呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fantastic. Another one who is incapable of conceding a point. As if the zealots weren't enough, screaming at me at all hours, begging me to repent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是棒极了。又一个死不认输的人。好像那些狂热分子还不够似的，整天对我大喊大叫，求我忏悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, try having them buzzing about your ears all hours of every day and night cursing your name and crying at you to repent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 行，那你试试让他们日夜不停地在你耳边嗡嗡叫，诅咒你的名字，哭喊着让你忏悔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely. What is so hard to understand? And I can tell you are being sarcastic, Usurper. But worry not, it amuses me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正是如此。这有什么难理解的？篡位者，我知道你是在讽刺我。不过别担心，我觉得挺有意思的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thank you. Finally, someone who can admit when they can concede! If only those two zealots could do the same, I wouldn't have them screaming at me at all hours, begging me to repent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。终于有人能承认自己该让步了！要是那两个狂热分子也能这样就好了，他们就不会整天对我大喊大叫，求我忏悔了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is at least better than the rancid, endless preaching the zealots do - constantly cursing and crying at me to repent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少比狂热分子没完没了的腐臭说教要好——他们不断地骂我，喊着要我悔改。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are quite welcome. What a relief, to have someone who can change their viewpoint. If only those two zealots could do the same, I wouldn't have them screaming at me at all hours, begging me to repent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。能遇到一个愿意改变观点的人真是太好了。要是那两个狂热分子也能这样就好了，他们就不会整天对我大喊大叫，求我忏悔了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know they were in love, once.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道吗，他们曾经相爱过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Meddling with all our minds... all for the sake of what? Accomplishing some... invisible to-do list? Or is this all in the name of defeating your conjured so-called "god?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​操纵​我们​的​思想……​这​一切​究竟​是​为了​什么？​是​为了​完成​某​个……​看​不见​的​任务​清单​吗？​还是​这​一切​都​是​为了​打败​你们​臆造​出来​的​所谓​的​"神"？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Meddling with all our minds... all for the sake of lust? Love? What is it? What would you call it? I suppose I am simply wondering if it was worth it. Or I suppose you do not know yet, as your dividends have not yet been paid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你操纵我们所有人的思想……这一切仅仅是为了欲望？爱？还是什么？你会如何称呼它？我只是在想，这一切是否值得。或许你还不知道，因为你的回报尚未到来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or is it even worse than that, and you were simply curious to see what might happen? And you are simply sitting there, plucking the legs off insects? We have sorted out the "what" behind your actions. Now I am attempting to interrogate the "why."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者更糟的是，你只是出于好奇想看看会发生什么？你只是坐在那里，拔掉昆虫的腿？我们已经弄清楚了你做了"什么"。现在，我想探究你"为什么"这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose it is oddly romantic, if a titch... dystopic, to go to such lengths to win the heart (and/or body) of your intended.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想，为了赢得心上人的心（和/或身体）而采取如此极端的做法，这种浪漫虽然有点……反乌托邦，但也颇为奇特。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is true! I can almost hear you scoff from the Sanctum. But Ballas and Margulis were very much in love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没​错！​我​仿佛​都​能​在圣所里听到​你​嗤之​以鼻​的​声音​了。​但​ Ballas ​和​ Margulis ​曾经​是​真心​相爱​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ballas and Margulis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Ballas 和 Margulis。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or is it worse than that, and you were simply curious to see what might happen? And you are simply sitting there, plucking the legs off insects? We have sorted out the "what" behind your actions. Now I am attempting to interrogate the "why."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者更糟的是，你只是出于好奇想看看会发生什么？你只是坐在那里，拔掉昆虫的腿？我们已经弄清楚了你做了"什么"。现在，我想探究你"为什么"这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I fear you only knew Ballas long after things went... terribly awry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恐怕你是在事情变得……非常糟糕之后才认识 Ballas 的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can almost hear you scoff from the Sanctum. But it is true.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我仿佛都能在圣所里听到你嗤之以鼻的声音。但这是真的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You mentioned before that you had "screwed it up," or somehow matters with the zealots became to snarled up to untangle. So you really truly thought this was the best option before you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你之前说把我们之间的事"搞砸了"，或者说和那些狂热分子之间的事情纠缠不清，难以解决。所以你真的认为这是你当时最好的选择吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, yes. Well, you likely have not had to contend with another protoframe whose memories are... split apart, in such a fashion as mine. In such a way, I suppose I am mildly sympathetic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，行。好吧，你可能没遇到过像我这样记忆支离破碎的原型战甲。从这个角度来说，我大概能稍微理解你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Aaah, I see... used to doing this devoid of all consequences. Well, you likely have not had to contend with another protoframe whose memories are... split apart, in such a fashion as mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，我明白了……习惯了这种不用承担后果的行为。你可能没遇到过像我这样记忆支离破碎的原型战甲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, so you are of the Orokin Empire after all. How wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，原来你也是奥罗金帝国的人啊。太好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You mentioned before that you had "screwed it up" between us, or somehow matters with the zealots became to snarled up to untangle. So you really truly thought this was the best option before you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​之前​说​过​你​把​我们​之间​的​关系​"搞砸​了"，​或者​说​和​那些​狂热​分子​之间​的​事情​纠缠​不清，​难以​解决。​所以​你​真的​认为​这​是​你​当时​最​好​的​选择​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would chastise you for what you have done in the name of getting what you want, but I am struck that the Orokin have been known to do far worse if not more creative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本想斥责你为了达到目所做的一切，但我惊讶地发现，奥罗金人做过更糟糕甚至更有"创意"的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And thus, I am beginning to understand how you came to "screw up" in the first place, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，篡位者，我开始明白你当初是怎么"搞砸"的了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, so you are of the Orokin Empire after all. How wonderful. I have a hard time thinking you've done this in the name of "love."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，原来你也是奥罗金帝国的人啊。真是太好了。我很难相信你会以"爱"的名义做这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Aaah, I see... used to doing this devoid of all consequences. Well, you likely have not had to contend with another protoframe whose memories are... split apart, in such a fashion as mine. In such a way, I suppose I am mildly sympathetic. And all in the name of "love."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，我明白了……习惯了这种不用承担后果的行为。你可能没遇到过像我这样记忆支离破碎的原型战甲。从这个角度来说，我大概能稍微理解你。而这一切都是以"爱"的名义做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, yes. Well, you likely have not had to contend with another protoframe whose memories are... split apart, in such a fashion as mine. In such a way, I suppose I am mildly sympathetic. And all in the name of "love."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，行。好吧，你可能没遇到过像我这样记忆支离破碎的原型战甲。从这个角度来说，我大概能稍微理解你。而这一切都是以"爱"的名义做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You did, of course. Or rather, the children. The Tenno. Sometimes, I wonder if it was inevitable, what happened. Or if he could have been convinced to change his course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，是你。或者更确切地说，是孩子们做的。Tenno。有时候，我会想，这一切的发生真的是不可避免的吗。或者，他是否有可能被说服改变自己的道路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps you are right. Or perhaps we are all, in the end, raw jewels. We have our flaws, our characteristics. Veins here, blemishes there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许你是对的。又或许，归根结底，我们都是未经雕琢的宝石。我们都有缺点，都有各自的特点。这里有纹路，那里有瑕疵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would counsel sitting quietly with ones mistakes and accepting defeat for what it is, personally. But I do not have the Void-given gift of looping pockets if time and erasing minds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我建议大家静下心来面对自己的错误，坦然接受失败，但我没有虚空赋予的那种穿越时空、抹除记忆的能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would counsel sitting quietly with ones mistakes and accepting defeat for what it is, but that would make me quite the raging hypocrite, wouldn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我建议大家静下心来面对自己的错误，坦然接受失败，但这岂不是会让我变成一个彻头彻尾的伪君子吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have I told you the story of Ballas and Margulis? I am relying on you to be honest with me, as I have absolutely no way of knowing the truth otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我跟你讲过 Ballas 和 Margulis 的故事吗？我希望你能对我诚实，否则我根本无从得知真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But the Orokin have always had a strange way of expressing their emotions, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我想，奥罗金人表达情感的方式一向都很奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And thus, I am beginning to understand how you came to "screw up" in the first place, Usurper. I have a hard time thinking you've done this in the name of "love."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来，篡位者，我开始明白你当初是怎么"搞砸"的了。我很难相信你是以"爱"的名义做这一切的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would chastise you for what you have done in the name of so-called "love" but I am struck that the Orokin have been known to do far worse if not more creative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本想斥责你以所谓的"爱"的名义所做的一切，但我惊讶地发现，奥罗金人做过更糟糕甚至更有"创意"的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I like to believe that we are all in the end, raw jewels. We have our flaws, our characteristics. Veins here, blemishes there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我更愿意相信我们都是未经雕琢的宝石。我们都有缺点，都有各自的特点。这里有纹路，那里有瑕疵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And we may be faceted certain ways to either catch the light and set into elaborate works of art... or sharpened into weapons... or shattered into dust.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们或许会被雕琢出某些特质，要么捕捉光芒，制成精美的艺术品……要么被磨砺成武器……要么化为尘埃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How... exactly does this work, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，这到底……是怎么运作的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And who is to say that I would not have made good use of the Void-given gift of looping pockets of time and erasing minds?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁又能说我不会好好利用虚空赋予我的循环时间和抹除记忆的能力呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And how I despise that, let me tell you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我多么憎恶这一点，让我来告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would counsel sitting quietly with ones mistakes and accepting defeat for what it is, personally. But I do not have the Void-given gift of looping pockets if time and erasing minds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我建议大家静下心来面对自己的错误，坦然接受失败，但我没有虚空赋予的那种穿越时空、抹除记忆的能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would counsel sitting quietly with ones mistakes and accepting defeat for what it is, but that would make me quite the raging hypocrite, wouldn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我建议大家静下心来面对自己的错误，坦然接受失败，但这岂不是会让我变成一个彻头彻尾的伪君子吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps that is a naïve belief, and we are all indeed immutable. You would know better than I, or so I hear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许这是一种天真的想法，我们或许真的都是一成不变的。你肯定比我更清楚这一点，至少我是这么听说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How... exactly does this work, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，这到底……是怎么运作的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And who is to say that I would not have made good use of the Void-given gift of looping pockets of time and erasing minds?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁又能说我不会好好利用虚空赋予我的循环时间和抹除记忆的能力呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you have me telling this all out of order. Allow me to start properly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你让我把事情顺序搞乱了。让我从头开始讲吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Either you are attempting to appeal to my ego, which I commend you for, or you are simply extremely uninspired with your day. Which, as someone who has also enjoyed countless cycles of life, I nearly sympathize with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要么你是想讨好我的自尊心，这一点我得佩服你；要么你只是对今天的生活极其提不起劲。作为同样经历过无数人生轮回的人，我几乎能感同身受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fascinating. You are either lying, or I still have stones you have yet left unturned. Which may be the reason you are here once more rereading fields already ploughed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真有意思。要么你在撒谎，要么我还有你没挖出来的秘密。或许这就是你再次来到这里，重读那些已被翻阅过的篇章的原因吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, little by little, you are nearly convincing me to forgive you for this mess you've made.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，你一点一点地，快要说服我原谅你造成的这一切混乱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Long before the Zariman Ten Zero launched, and the Tenno were even a blip on the proverbial screen, Margulis the Archimedean and Ballas met during the opening of a new domed conservatory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 远在扎里曼 10-0 号启航之前，甚至连 Tenno 都还未出现在人们的视野里时，哲士 Margulis 和 Ballas 在一个新穹顶温室的开幕式上相遇了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The universe has certainly become stranger since I left it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 自从我离开之后，宇宙的确变得更加奇异了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then I shall not tire you by recounting the saga yet again, and I shall leave you to find other amusements with the rest of your day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么我就不再赘述这个故事，以免让你感到厌烦，也好让你在剩下的时间里寻找其他乐子吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Were I not the subject of your amusement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果​我​不​是​你​的​消遣​对​象​就​好​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But? Regardless...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但是？不管怎样……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……明白了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ballas was there for the sake of ceremony - we do love our pomp and circumstance, of course - and Margulis was desperately attempting not to be noticed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Ballas 到场只是为了参加仪式——我们当然喜欢盛大的场面和隆重的仪式——而 Margulis 则拼命地想不引人注目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ballas and Margulis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Ballas 和 Margulis。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The universe has certainly become stranger since I left it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 自从我离开之后，宇宙的确变得更加奇异了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Something you must understand, my Usurper, is that Ballas had no reason to associate with her. No reason at all, unless his infatuation were genuine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的篡位者，你必须明白一点，Ballas 根本没有理由和她来往。绝对没有理由，除非他是真的爱上她了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And "she" is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would chastise you for what you have done in the name of getting what you want, but I am struck that the Orokin have been known to do far worse if not more creative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本想斥责你为了达到目所做的一切，但我惊讶地发现，奥罗金人做过更糟糕甚至更有"创意"的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was not just lust, for he could have whomever he wished - and did, quite often. If he wanted her, he could have simply had her and been done with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这不仅仅是欲望，因为他想要谁就能得到谁——而且他经常这么做。如果他想要她，他完全可以轻易得到她，然后就此结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And "she" is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "她"是谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Regardless. All this, in the name of "love?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，这一切，都打着"爱"的旗号？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He was an Executor. One of the most powerful of the Seven, in fact. He could have summoned her to his bedchambers and she would have been there without a second thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他是执行者。是七人众之一。事实上，还是其中最有权势的一位。他完全可以把她召到他的寝宫，而她也会毫不犹豫地赴约。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would chastise you for what you have done in the name of so-called "love" but I am struck that the Orokin have been known to do far worse if not more creative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本想斥责你以所谓的"爱"的名义所做的一切，但我惊讶地发现，奥罗金人做过更糟糕甚至更有"创意"的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is not what he did. Ballas took one look at her that evening, and... he was stricken, Drifter. Positively and absolutely beside himself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但他并没有那样做。漂泊者，那天晚上，Ballas 只看了她一眼……他就彻底沦陷了。整个人都乱了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I had never seen anything like it. It was as though no one else in the room even existed, save for Margulis. He seemed even... somehow too shy to speak to her. Him! Ballas!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我从未见过这样的场面。仿佛房间里除了 Margulis 之外，其他人都不存在似的。他甚至……害羞得连话都不敢说。你敢信！这居然是 Ballas！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I swear on whatever remains of my honor! And what reason would I have to lie? What do I care of your opinion of the validity of their relationship?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我以我仅存的荣誉发誓！我有什么理由撒谎？我才不在乎你对他们关系的真实性有什么看法！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I swear on whatever remains of my honor I am not! And what reason would I have to lie? What do I care of your opinion of the validity of their relationship?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我以我仅存的荣誉发誓，我没有！我有什么理由撒谎？我才不在乎你对他们关系的真实性有什么看法！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It simply saddens me that you lot would so quickly simplify something that is decidedly far more complicated than you would have it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 让我感到难过的是，你竟然这么快就简化一件远比你们想象的复杂得多的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They were in love, whether you wish to believe it or not. Ballas eshewed all class rules and tradition to take as his lover - and his sole romantic companion - an Archimedean.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论你信不信，他们确实相爱了。Ballas 不顾一切阶级规则和传统，迎娶了一位哲士，作为他的爱人——也作为他唯一的爱侣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Only true love could have sent a man so spectacularly mad as it sent him, when it all went so very wrong...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只有真爱才能让一个男人如此疯狂，尤其是在一切走向崩坏时……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: First, let us assume all you know is correct, and that his actions there were purely of his own accord. Let us assume that there were no other political maneuverings or blackmail or anything else being done behind the scenes that may have forced his hand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先，我们假设你所知道的一切都是正确的，并且他在那里的行为完全是出于他自己的意愿。我们假设没有任何其他政治操纵、勒索或其他幕后因素迫使他采取这种行动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Even if that were to be the case, and Ballas called for her execution entirely without influence, consider that it was already too late. The betrayal he felt had already cleaved him in two.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 即便真是如此，即便 Ballas 完全没有受到任何影响就下令处死她，也要想想，一切都为时已晚。他感受到的背叛已经让他痛苦不堪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: His heart and his mind were already broken.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他的心和精神早已破碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not asking you to have anything of the sort! Ballas deserves nothing but whatever piss you can spare to spend on wherever you buried his corpse - if he even has a grave.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我并不是要你那样！哪怕一滴你能省出来撒在你埋他尸体地方的尿，Ballas 都配不上——如果他真的有坟墓的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In a way, both. And in a way, neither. He was driven to madness that day, when he called for her execution. In fact, I would not be surprised if some part of him did not entirely recall doing the deed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 某种程度上，两者都是。某种程度上，两者也不是。那天他下令处死她时，他已经彻底疯了。事实上，如果他内心深处对这件事的记忆有所缺失，我也不会感到惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am merely stating that on the day he called for her execution, he was a madman. I would not be surprised if some part of him did not entirely recall doing the deed, after the fact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说，在他下令处决她的那天，他已经是个疯子了。事后看来，如果他对自己所做的事情有些记忆模糊，我也不会感到惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ballas loved Margulis. With his whole person, completely - entirely devoted to her. He would have sacrificed anything and everything for her. His soul, his body, the Orokin Empire. Anything you could possibly dream of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Ballas 深爱着 Margulis。他倾尽所有，全心全意地爱着她。他愿意为她牺牲一切。他的灵魂，他的肉体，奥罗金帝国。任何你能想象到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No cost was too great. No morals worth sacrificing. If you had handed him a newborn babe and told him Margulis wished its brains dashed out upon the rocks, it would be dead before you finished your sentence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不惜任何代价。不惜牺牲任何道德。就算你递给他一个刚出生的婴儿，告诉他 Margulis 希望婴儿的脑浆摔在石头上，在你话还没说完之前，婴儿就已经死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He would have burned the Origin System to ashes and rebuilt it in her image, Usurper... but herein lies the tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他本会将始源星系烧成灰烬，然后按照她的形象重建它，篡位者……但悲剧就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Margulis? Aah, Margulis. Dear, sweet, darling Margulis... she still had a conscience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Margulis？啊，Margulis。亲爱的、甜美的、可爱的 Margulis……她仍然有良知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And when she saw the poor Tenno, the poor, Void-torn children...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当她看到那些可怜的 Tenno，那些可怜的、被虚空撕裂的孩子们……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Something in her life was more important than Ballas. Something in her life was worth sacrificing her life for... that was not him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她生命中有比 Ballas 更重要的东西。她生命中有值得她为之牺牲的东西……而那却不是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That was not her love for him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也不是她对他的爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And he knew this, my sweet Drifter. He knew this from the moment she laid her eyes on them. And it was driven home when her "mad animals" ensured they were the last she ever saw. Or at least that was what the rumors were amongst us Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我亲爱的漂泊者，而他明白这一点。从她第一眼看到他们起，他就明白了。而当她那些"疯狂的野兽"成了她最后看到的画面时，这一点更是彻底印证了他的想法。至少，在我们奥罗金人之间，流传着这样的传言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Can you imagine the joy amongst the Orokin? Seeing Ballas' precious Archimedean's Void-torn, rabid brats burn out her eyes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你能想象奥罗金人看到 Ballas 珍爱的哲士，被虚空撕裂、被狂暴的幼崽们烧瞎双眼时的喜悦吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I think, it was before then, at the precise moment Margulis fought to save the Tenno that Ballas's heart shattered into a thousand pieces, and never recovered.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但​我​认为，​正​是​在​那​之前，​在​ Margulis ​奋力​拯​救 Tenno ​的​那​一​刻，​Ballas ​的​心碎成​了​无​数片，​再​也​没有​恢复​过来。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For he knew he had been supplanted in her own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为他知道，自己在她心里已经被取代了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose for that reason, I pitied him. But the rest of what followed? A love story for the ages... and how it ended in such a broken tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想正是因为这个原因，我才同情他。但之后发生的事呢？一段足以载入史册的爱情故事……最终却以如此令人心碎的悲剧收场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you could have seen how they would smile at each other...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望你能看到他们彼此对视时那种笑容……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nor was I attempting to equate the two, Usurper. I was simply stating that a man could be loved but also capable of terrible things. Ah, well...  No hope for the rest of us depraved fools, I suppose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我并没有试图将两者相提并论。我只是想说，一个人既可以被爱，也可以做出可怕的事情。唉……看来我们这些堕落的傻瓜也无药可救了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed. Sometimes it brings me peace to think that if even that lord of depravity can find a companion, there is hope for the rest of us, hm? Ha!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实如此。有时候想到，如果连那位堕落之王都能找到伴侣，我们其他人还有希望，这便让我感到一丝慰藉，嗯？哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But, I have taken enough of your time for the day. Off with you, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 今天我已经占用你太多时间了。你现在就可以走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know you've likely heard this before, and I find today I do not care - I do not have the patience.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道你可能听过这话，可今天我不在乎——我实在没那个耐心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think what caused the fall of the Orokin Empire was too many layers of glass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为导致奥罗金帝国覆灭的原因在于那层层叠叠的隔离，人们始终无法看清帝国内部的情况。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Imagine a society built upon the knowledge that you are, for all intents and purposes, forever safe. Protected. Even from the great spectre of death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想象一个建立在这样的认知之上的社会：无论从任何意义上说，你都永远是安全的。受到保护的。即使面对死亡的巨大阴影。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Where nothing can harm you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那里没有任何东西能伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely. Too removed from the danger and reality of the thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实如此。距离危险和现实太远了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It leads to a kind of tedium that begins to invent its own danger, Usurper. Politics. Court intrigue. Suddenly we were concocting masterful new ways to endanger ourselves, since we had replaced the old.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这会导致一种无聊，开始编织出自己的危险，篡位者。政治。宫廷阴谋。我们突然间又想出了新的妙招来置自身于险境——毕竟，旧的那些招数早已被淘汰了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There were precious few interesting or pleasant parts about my... forced sojourn to "Gaule." The food being one of them. The second, however... were the storms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我被迫滞留"高卢"的这段日子里，鲜有有趣或是愉悦的片段。食物算是其中之一。然而第二件……便是那些风暴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! I am not certain I have a preference, being fully schooled in the art of both, I'm afraid. Which do you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！说实话我难以抉择——这两种滋味我都尝遍了。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thunderstorms the likes of which I had never witnessed in all my years as an Orokin. They shook the very earth, rattled the windows in their wooden panes. I could hear them even down in the dusty crypt where they kept us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在我作为奥罗金人的漫长岁月里，从未见过如此惊人的雷暴。它们撼动大地，震得木窗哐当作响。即便在尘封墓穴深处——他们囚禁我们的地方——我也能听见它们的轰鸣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When they would roll through the city, I would climb up into the bell tower to get as close as I possibly could. I wished to feel the electricity in the air - the pelting rain on my skin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 每当雷暴席卷城市，我就会爬上钟楼，尽可能地靠近。我渴望感受空气中的电流——倾盆大雨打在皮肤上的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see your point, and I have to agree there is a certain simplicity to be enjoyed in that. Hard to mistake an enemy for anything else when they have a gun pointed at your face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我明白你的意思，不得不承认这种简单性确实有其可取之处。当敌人把枪口抵在你脸上时，你很难把他们认作其他什么东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, delicious, isn't it? A careful plan, artfully laid out, coming to fruition? Watching all the pieces fall into place... it is very much fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，妙不可言，不是吗？精心策划的布局，巧妙铺陈的计谋，最终水到渠成？看着所有棋子各就各位……实在妙趣横生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which was precisely the point of the endeavor! I cannot describe what it was like to feel such raw power. No, it was more than that; it was real power. I gazed up into those swirling, darkened clouds flashing with furious bolts of lightning and I saw what my ancestors had so desperately sought to harness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这正是冒险的意义所在！那种原始力量的震撼难以言表。不，远不止于此——那是真实的力量。我凝视着翻腾的乌云间肆虐的闪电，终于见识到祖先们毕生追寻却未能驾驭的力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You write those words as though I spared it even the briefest of thoughts. They did not follow me, if that is what you are asking. The Priest little cared if I killed myself by bolt of lightning, I am sure. As for Marie? She was likely too busy worshipping her false idols. Sol or Albrecht, take your pick.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你写的这些话，就好像我想过似的。如果你问的是他们有没有追来，他们没有。神父大概根本不在乎我被雷电击中而死。至于玛丽？她多半正忙着膜拜她的虚假偶像们。太阳神还是阿尔布雷希特，随你挑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Moreover, I knew my presence there could also kill me, and that there would be no Kuva nearby to revive me. Further still, that the sacred Kuva would not work on my warped and twisted form.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更何况我深知身处此地可能丧命，而附近没有赤毒能让我复活。更重要的是，神圣的赤毒对我这副扭曲变形的躯体毫无作用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was! I cannot describe what it was like to feel such raw power. No, it was more than that; it was real power. I gazed up into those swirling, darkened clouds flashing with furious bolts of lightning and I saw what my ancestors had so desperately sought to harness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实如此！那种原始力量的震撼难以言表。不，远不止于此——那是真实的力量。我凝视着翻腾的乌云间肆虐的闪电，终于见识到祖先们毕生追寻却未能驾驭的力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But to feel such raw power? No, it was more than that; it was real power. I gazed up into those swirling, darkened clouds flashing with furious bolts of lightning and I saw what my ancestors had so desperately sought to harness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但感受那般原始的力量？不，远不止于此——那是真实的力量。我凝视着翻腾的乌云间肆虐的闪电，终于见识到祖先们毕生追寻却未能驾驭的力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I find, however, like all things in life, moderation and a mix of both is where the answer to success lies. To become too glutted on one risks abandoning the other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而我发现，就像生活中的一切事物，适度与兼容并蓄才是成功的真谛。如果过度沉溺于其中一方，就有可能放弃另一方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It terrified me. I felt fear, Drifter. Fear. For the first time in... centuries, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我感到恐惧。漂泊者，是恐惧。这恐怕是我……几个世纪以来的第一次？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is how we create creatures such as Ballas and Nitokh I am afraid. The Manipulator and the Blood Queen. Bah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恐怕正是如此，我们才造就了 Ballas 和尼托这样的存在。操纵者与血之女王。呸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I came here to speak about storms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我来这里是为了谈谈风暴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, it seems so! Quite keenly, I might add. And this was a discovery to me in that moment. I do not fear what comes after death, Drifter. I simply do not yet wish for my life to end. I am not done living it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，还真是这样！而且相当强烈，我得说。那一刻我才发现这个事实。我并不是畏惧死后的世界，漂泊者。只是还没有准备好结束生命。我的旅程尚未终结。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I climbed atop the stone baluster beside the gnarled gargoyle and held my arms out wide at my sides, and... I laughed. I laughed into the storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爬上那个合成兽像边上的石栏杆，张开双臂，然后……我笑了。我对着风暴放声大笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which was a revelation in and of itself. I climbed atop the stone baluster beside the gnarled gargoyle and held my arms out wide at my sides, and... I laughed. I laughed into the storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这本身就是个惊人的发现。我爬上那个合成兽像边上的石栏杆，张开双臂，然后……我笑了。我对着风暴放声大笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I suddenly knew that I do not fear what comes after death, Drifter. I simply do not yet wish for my life to end. I am not done living it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我突然明白，我并不是畏惧死后的世界，漂泊者。只是还没有准备好结束生命。我的旅程尚未终结。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Despite it all. Despite the desolation of Tau. Despite the destruction of the Orokin Empire I knew was now inevitable. Despite the perversion of my body into... this mess. Despite being thrown into the past and abandoned to my own devices.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 纵使经历了一切。纵使 Tau 已成荒芜。纵使奥罗金帝国的覆灭已成定局。纵使我的躯体被扭曲成……这般模样。纵使被抛回过去，任凭命运摆布。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I knew I would find a way back here. To this time. To this place. To where Albrecht had left all his most precious things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道终会找到归途。回到这个时代。回到这个地方。回到阿尔布雷希特珍藏所有至宝的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because I am not done living my life. But by the Void, I am going to ensure he is done living his.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我的人生尚未终结。但以虚空之名，我一定会确保他的人生就此终结。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fantastic. I am glad my former self was so wonderfully convincing. And I am hopeful you are being honest and not lying to me in an attempt to "shut me up." But, I have no choice but to believe you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太棒了。我很高兴过去的自己如此令人信服。我也希望你是在坦诚相待，而不是为了"让我闭嘴"而对我撒谎。不过，我别无选择，只能相信你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Either way, I am certain we will find other ways to amuse ourselves than to be lost in wandering and circular debates about the finer points of Conceptual Embodiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论如何，我相信我们一定能找到其他消遣方式，而不是沉溺于关于概念成形细枝末节的漫无目的的争论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I, for one, am grateful to be spared a second round.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少我很庆幸自己免于再经历第二轮折磨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. Tell me. Did I manage to convince you last time we did this that your "Indifference" is merely a collection of cobbled-together children's toys, or did you end all this still believing it is some "great unknowable entity from the Void."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。告诉我。上次我们这样讨论时，我是否成功说服你相信你的"虚空无情之物"不过是拼凑而成的儿童玩具，还是你最终还是坚信它是什么"来自虚空的伟大未知存在"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If there's one thing in this world that I despise, it's chasing my tail. And that metaphor used to be far more proverbial than it is now, I just realized.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要是说这世间有我最厌恶之事，那就是徒劳无功。我突然意识到，这个比喻如今已远不如从前那样脍炙人口了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So, before we continue, I would like to just make sure that I have everything straight. You believe that the Indifference is some Horrible Unknowable Entity from the Void, leaking into our reality because of Albrecht's mistakes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，在我们继续之前，我想确认下我的理解是否正确。你认为虚空无情之物是某种来自虚空的可怕未知存在，因阿尔布雷希特的错误而渗入我们的现实？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everyone I speak to around this madhouse is entirely convinced that this "Man in the Wall" is some kind of literal and laughable god. An actual god. Even those two zealots seem to be entertaining the idea!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个疯人院里和我交谈过的每个人都完全相信这个"墙中人"是个货真价实、滑稽可笑的神。一个真正的神。就连那两个狂热分子似乎也在接受这种说法！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Allow me to phrase my question thusly, before we spin ourselves around and we end up once more chasing our tails. Which... is a metaphor that I just now realize used to be far more proverbial than it is now, but I digress.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请允许我如此表述问题，免得我们原地打转，徒劳无功。这……我突然意识到这个比喻如今​已​远​不​如​从​前​那样​脍炙​人口​了，不过我扯远了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah! Well, then it seems I still have work to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊！好吧，那么看来我还有些工作要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you believe that the entity that you now call the Indifference existed prior to Albrecht's dealings with it? Or do you believe he created it when he first interacted with the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你认为那个如今被称你为虚空无情之物的存在，是在阿尔布雷希特与之接触之前就已存在？还是你认为他在第一次与虚空接触时就创造了它？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now, did I say those words? Do not be so quick to put words into my mouth, Oh Transient Usurper. I did not deny that the Indifference was "real." I denied that it was a God.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 等等，我说过这种话吗？别急着歪曲我的意思，哦，短暂的篡位者。我并没有否认虚空无情之物是"真实存在的"。我否认的是它是神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can disrobe this false deity for you in two simple words you should know and understand quite well:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只需两个你理应熟知且能深刻理解的词语，我就能为你揭穿这个虚假神明的真面目：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Absolutely not! First, there are no god or gods, the idea is absurd. Second, to think that Albrecht let loose a god of the Void? Even more laughable!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 绝不！首先，根本没有神，这种想法太荒谬了。其次，想想阿尔布雷希特竟然释放了一个虚空之神？就更可笑了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Conceptual Embodiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 概念成形。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is nothing in the Void. That is why it is named the Void!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空中空无一物。正因如此，它才被称为虚空！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But before we continue, I would like to just make sure that I have everything straight. You believe that the Indifference is some Horrible Unknowable Entity from the Void, leaking into our reality because of Albrecht's mistakes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过在我们继续之前，我想确认下我的理解是否正确。你认为虚空无情之物是某种来自虚空的可怕未知存在，因阿尔布雷希特的错误而渗入我们的现实？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes! I can! It is so painfully obvious what is happening, and so utterly laughable that you have all convinced yourself that there is some great beast scraping at the window, when it is but a tree branch in the wind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 能！我当然能！事情的真相如此显而易见，你们竟都坚信窗外有巨兽啃咬窗框，实际上不过是风中摇曳的树枝罢了，这样荒谬至极的错觉实在可笑至极。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not you, too. I had such high hopes. It is so painfully obvious what is happening, and so utterly laughable that you have all convinced yourself that there is some great beast scraping at the window, when it is but a tree branch in the wind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别你也这样。我曾对你寄予厚望。事情的真相如此显而易见，你们竟都坚信窗外有巨兽啃咬窗框，实际上不过是风中摇曳的树枝罢了，这样荒谬至极的错觉实在可笑至极。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is so painfully obvious what is happening, and so utterly laughable that you have all convinced yourself that there is some great beast scraping at the window, when it is but a tree branch in the wind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事情的真相如此显而易见，你们竟都坚信窗外有巨兽啃咬窗框，实际上不过是风中摇曳的树枝罢了，这样荒谬至极的错觉实在可笑至极。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes! I do! It is so painfully obvious that is what is happening and so utterly laughable that you have all convinced yourself that there is some great beast scraping at the window, when it is but a tree branch in the wind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的！我确信如此！事情的真相如此显而易见，你们竟都坚信窗外有巨兽啃咬窗框，实际上不过是风中摇曳的树枝罢了，这样荒谬至极的错觉实在可笑至极。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And when have I denied that, either? Indeed, it seems you have all managed to spin yourselves into quite a hysterical and needlessly egregious bit of tribulation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我什么时候否认过这一点？说真的，你们似乎都把自己卷入了一场毫无必要的歇斯底里和巨大的苦难之中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am disappointed that you held the line, I find your honesty extremely refreshing. And I am glad to not be wasting my time as we go forward. I am certain we'll find other ways to amuse ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然你坚持立场令我失望，但你的坦率却让我倍感清新。至少往后不必再浪费时间了。相信我们一定能找到其他的消遣方式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Only now, due to the influence of the Void, you have all fed it so much fear and power that it has, like a feedback loop, balled itself up into this... Thing. This Man in the Wall.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如今，在虚空的影响下，你们所有人向它倾注了过多的恐惧与力量，以至于它如同反馈回路般，把自己扭曲成了这个……东西。墙中人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Humanity is certainly nothing if not creative in the breadth and magnitude of new forms of suffering it can concoct for itself, is it not? You yourself have been witness to many a form of cruelty I am sure one could scare imagine was possible in the time of our dear zealots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 人类在发明创造各种新式苦难方面，真是五花八门，花样翻新，不是吗？你自己亲眼目睹了许多残酷暴行，我相信在咱们那群狂热分子的年代，人们根本想象不到这些暴行竟会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, you are so close to the truth and yet so quick to dismiss it. You think it is "tempting" to believe it is a creation of your own mind as it would be easier to dismiss it if it were so? No, I think it makes it far more dangerous to face a creation of our own making than a god.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，你离真相如此之近，却又如此轻易地否定它。你觉得相信它是自己脑海中的产物很"诱人"，因为这样更容易将其抛诸脑后？不，我认为面对自己创造的产物，远比面对神更危险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I appreciate your humility, I challenge your limited understanding of the capability of human creativity - especially in regards to how it can devise new forms of suffering. Are you not in fact single-handedly responsible for conjuring your own universe from whole cloth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我欣赏你的谦逊，但我挑战你对人类创造力的有限理解——尤其是如何创造出新的苦难形式这方面。难道你不是凭空捏造出你自己的宇宙吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing that comes from the Void is that which we place within it - and what returns from it. It changes matter and energy - but it cannot create it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空中唯一存在的，是我们放入其中的，以及从中返回的。它能改变物质和能量——但它无法创造它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I, for one, am grateful to be spared a second round of wandering and circular debates on the finer points of Conceptual Embodiment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少我庆幸自己免于再次陷入关于概念成形的细枝末节，不必再经历那场漫无目的的循环辩论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht may have started this nonsense, but all of you are responsible for stoking the fire until it became an inferno. The Indifference never existed. Until, suddenly, it did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特或许是这场闹剧的始作俑者，但你们所有人都在火上浇油，直至烈焰吞噬一切。虚空无情之物本不存在。直到某天，它突然出现了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What I am saying is this: Albrecht might have been the one who originally saw his own hubris staring back at him as the face of a grinning god of destruction, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我是说：阿尔布雷希特或许正是最初目睹自己狂妄自大如毁灭之神般狞笑着凝视着他的人，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht might have been the one who originally saw his own hubris staring back at him as the face of a grinning god of destruction, yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特或许正是最初目睹自己狂妄自大如毁灭之神般狞笑着凝视着他的人，没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: An external foe can be understood. Manipulated. Defeated. Or perhaps even negotiated with, if it comes to that. They have weaknesses that can be exploited. But an internal foe? One of our own making? That is far more insidious indeed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一个外部敌人可以被理解，被操纵，被击败。甚至必要时，还可以去和他谈判。他们有可以利用的弱点。但一个内部敌人呢？我们自己造出来的敌人呢？那可就阴险得多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You yourself have been witness to many a form of cruelty I am sure one could scare imagine was possible in the time of our dear zealots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你自己亲眼目睹了许多残酷暴行，我相信在咱们那群狂热分子的年代，人们根本想象不到这些暴行竟会发生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think, Drifter. These "Void Angels" of which you speak. These ghosts. Were they made of those already lost to the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想想吧，漂泊者。你说的这些"虚空天使"，这些幽灵，它们是不是从那些已经消失在虚空的人转化而来？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though it does mean more time to be preached at by the zealots... bah. Choices, choices, choices...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然​这​意​味​着​要​多​花​时间​听狂​热​分子们​说​教……唉。​选择​选择​选择……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you are all to blame for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而你们都难辞其咎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you are all as equally to blame for continuing to roll this juba bug turd downhill for as long as you have, getting bigger with every scrap of feces it collects along the way!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可你们都难辞其咎，竟让这坨朱巴虫粪球一路从山坡往下滚了这么久，沿途每沾一丁点粪渣就越滚越大！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As a species, we are quite wondrous in our ability to feed our fears new ways to destroy ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 作为一个物种，我们有一种惊人的能力，那就是不断给恐惧输送素材，从而让想象创造出比现实更糟的自我毁灭场景。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They were merely echoes of energy being regurgitated like a colorful kutak to feed its children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们只不过是能量的回流，就像色彩斑斓的库塔克鸟通过反刍来喂养它的孩子们一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Allow me to simplify the discussion for you. I can disrobe this false deity for you in two simple words you should know and understand quite well:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 让我用更简洁的方式解释一下。只需两个你理应熟知且能深刻理解的词语，我就能为你揭穿这个虚假神明的真面目：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because then we must fight our own demons. And humanity... never wins such wars, do we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为那样我们就必须对抗自己的恶魔。而人类……从来都赢不了这样的战争，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Says the one who created an entire alternate dimension single-handedly? Please, Drifter... use your imagination like you once did so long ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这话从你这个凭一己之力开辟了平行时空的人嘴里说出的？拜托，漂泊者……像很久以前那样发挥你的想象力吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not reprimanding you! This thing was already long in the works before you ever entered the picture. Albrecht saw to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不是在责备你！这事在你出现之前就酝酿已久了。是阿尔布雷希特搞的鬼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Conceptual Embodiment works like thus - when interacting with the Void, or in proximity to the Void, powerful emotions and thoughts can manifest physically. We both know this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 概念成形的原理如下——当与虚空互动或接近虚空时，强烈的情感与思绪可具现为实体形态。我们都心知肚明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He saw his own reflection and knew true fear. And so began the first spark that lit the fire that threatens to burn it all down. You all simply keep throwing more fuel into it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他看见了自己的倒影，感受到了真正的恐惧。于是，那第一缕火花就此点燃，燃起了一场足以焚毁万物的烈火。而你们，却只是不断往火中添柴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely. Where the Void goes, Conceptual Embodiment can follow. And only there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正是如此。虚空所至之处，概念成形便能追随。也仅限于此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Where the Void goes, Conceptual Embodiment can follow. And only there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空所至之处，概念成形便能追随。也仅限于此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The damnable fingers. We took those cursed fingers, in a desperate and mad attempt to reach Tau, and we Orokin found a way to replicate them, didn't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些该死的手指。我们曾用那些被诅咒的手指，在绝望而疯狂的尝试中试图触及 Tau，而我们奥罗金人找到了复制它们的方法，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. You now see it. The damnable fingers. We took those cursed fingers, in a desperate and mad attempt to reach Tau, and we Orokin found a way to replicate them, didn't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。你现在看见了。那些该死的手指。我们曾用那些被诅咒的手指，在绝望而疯狂的尝试中试图触及 Tau，而我们奥罗金人找到了复制它们的方法，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Little bits of the Void, everywhere you go... A network of trenches and tunnels for that thing to pop up wherever it may like. And worse still?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空的碎片，无处不在……沟渠与隧道交织成网任那东西可以在任何角落出现。更糟的是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Tenno. And you. All of you, Void-touched. And all of you, haunted by that thing, for wherever you go, it can follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Tenno。还有你。你们所有人，都被虚空侵蚀。你们所有人，都被那东西纠缠，因为无论你们走到哪里，它都能尾随而至。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And likely anyone who has interacted with it for any length of time. Entrati himself. His butler. The Cavia. Myself, the zealots, by our proximity to this Sanctum. The list goes on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 任何与它接触过一段时间的人恐怕都难逃厄运。英择谛本人。他的管家。科维兽。我本人，还有狂热分子们，都因为靠近这座圣所而沾染。名单还会增加。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which would explain why it cannot wear its own face, wouldn't it? It can only appear as those it is tormenting, to those it is attempting to torment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这就能解释它为何无法显现自身面容了吧？它只能以正在折磨之人的形态，向那些它试图折磨的对象显现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In fact it only seems to wear the face of architecture when it is struggling to show itself as something Larger and Other. When it is desperate to appeal to some sense of Grandiosity and Godhood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，当它竭力展现某种宏大而异质的存在时，会显现建筑形态的面容。当它极力试图唤起某种宏伟感和神性时，它才会如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are absolutely no fun, Usurper. But how does she involve our... Indifference, precisely?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是毫无乐趣可言，篡位者。但她究竟如何牵扯到我们的……虚空无情之物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She does sound like a deliciously formidable individual. And a complete delight. But that is neither here nor there for the moment. You say the Indifference has taken over her mind? And this began in your little furlough into the past?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 听起来她确实是个令人着迷的强悍任务。简直妙不可言。但眼下这些都无关紧要。你说虚空无情之物已经占据了她的意识？而这一切始于你那段短暂的过去之旅？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, silly thing. Because it is only mimicking that which created it. It is not a whole entity - it is only a toy made out of mismatched parts of whatever fears and dread and suffering it has been fed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，傻瓜。因为它只是在模仿创造它的存在。它并非完整实体——它只是由各种恐惧、惊骇与苦难的残片拼凑而成的玩物，这些残片正是它被喂养的养料。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, silly thing. It is only mimicking that which created it. It is not a whole entity - it is only a toy made out of mismatched parts of whatever fears and dread and suffering it has been fed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，傻瓜。它只是在模仿创造它的存在。它并非完整实体——它只是由各种恐惧、惊骇与苦难的残片拼凑而成的玩物，这些残片正是它被喂养的养料。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, if what we know of the Void holds true, then one of two things occurred: Either, she happened into some instance of the Void in 1999 of her own doing (which I find deeply improbable, but not impossible), or...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们对虚空的认知成立，那么只有两种可能：要么她于 1999 年因自身行为误入虚空（我认为这种可能性极低，但并非不可能），要么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah. I see I am going to make no progress today. That is fine, you are deeply entrenched in this propaganda you have been fed. Albrecht is a deeply convincing cult leader, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊。看来今日无进展可言。没事，你已被灌输的宣传牢牢禁锢。我担心阿尔布雷希特是个极具说服力的邪教领袖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Our dear Albrecht was meddling again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们亲爱的阿尔布雷希特又在插手干预了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am merely sitting here reading tea leaves with the best of them, Usurper. Far be it from me to insinuate that Albrecht purposefully ripped open a hole into the Void in Höllvania and let the Indifference in, in order to give it an avatar of its own...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不过是和那些算命先生一样坐在这揣测玄机罢了，篡位者。我可不敢暗示阿尔布雷希特是故意在霍瓦尼亚撕开虚空之门，让虚空无情之物侵入，好为它创造一个化身……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course! I am merely sitting here reading tea leaves with the best of them, Usurper. Far be it from me to insinuate that Albrecht purposefully ripped open a hole into the Void in Höllvania and let the Indifference in, in order to give it an avatar of its own...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！我不过是和那些算命先生一样坐在这揣测玄机罢了，篡位者。我可不敢暗示阿尔布雷希特是故意在霍瓦尼亚撕开虚空之门，让虚空无情之物侵入，好为它创造一个化身……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You see? Never trust a scientist. They are willing to do anything in the name of muddling about. But then again, I am simply sitting here reading tea leaves with the best of them, Usurper. This is all simple postulation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 明白了吗？永远别相信科学家。他们总以胡乱尝试为名，不择手段。不过话说回来，我只不过是和那些算命先生一样坐在这揣测玄机罢了，篡位者。这一切都只是简单的推测。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do hope that I at least gave you something to think on. For now, however, I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望至少能给你一些值得思考的东西。不过现在，我必须得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It just seems to me, as a tactician and a man who is quite accustomed to strategizing for war...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在我看来，作为一名战术家，一个对战争谋划相当熟悉的人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Far be it from me to insinuate that Albrecht purposefully ripped open a hole into the Void in Höllvania and let the Indifference in, in order to give it an avatar of its own! It just seems to me, as a tactician and a man who is quite accustomed to strategizing for war...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可不敢暗示阿尔布雷希特是故意在霍瓦尼亚撕开虚空之门，让虚空无情之物侵入，好为它创造一个化身！在我看来，作为一名战术家，一个对战争谋划相当熟悉的人……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That the first step to defeating a faceless opponent who can be anywhere, anyone, and anywhen? Is to narrow it down to as few options as possible...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要击败那个无处不在，随时随地能以任何形象出现的无形对手，第一步是什么？是将可能性尽可能缩小到最少……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And to ensure those options can bleed out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 并确保这些可能性会逐渐消亡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wonderful food for thought. But! For now, I must go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是发人深省。但是！现在我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I strove so hard to travel back here only to realize that... my people are now dead. I would have been executed with the rest of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我费尽周折才回到这里，却发现……我的族人都死了。如果我当时也在对话，我也会和他们一起被处决。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Quiet, you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你，闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would ensure that all the Executors and the Emperors would be... removed, and I would take over as Interim Executor until a new system could be put into place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会确保所有执行者和皇帝都被……罢免，我将担任临时执行者，直到新的制度建立起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In just a few short years from my perception, thousands have passed in "reality" - where the Empire has fallen and my people have all died.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在我看来，短短几年内，现实中已经过去了数千年——帝国覆灭，我的人民全部死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Tenno would have slaughtered me with all the rest on the night of the Naga Drums. I would have likely died, attempting to save Nitokh's life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在长胴鼓之夜，我本该和其他人一起被 Tenno 屠杀殆尽。我可能也会为了救尼托而牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: At the time, I was fully convinced I would. But now, it hardly matters, does it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当时我深信自己会做到。但现在看来，这似乎已经无关紧要了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: However long that would take, I do not know, but it would be better than what followed in the wake of the Great War, wouldn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道这需要多长时间，但这总比那场大战之后的情况要好，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder what became of her? The records do not even mention her name... all the horrors committed in her name, all the deaths, all the travesties... and I may be the only one who knows of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道她后来怎么样了？记录里甚至没有提到她的名字……所有以她的名义犯下的暴行，所有的死亡，所有的丑恶行径……也许只有我知道这些事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. That and whatever might be unlocked in the future from the Tenno's head via that Dark Refractory. But that is hardly my problem to solve.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，通过深溯池，将来可能会从 Tenno 的脑袋里解锁更多信息。但这并非我需要解决的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I watched a gaggle of school-aged, Void-ravaged children remotely pilot Infested machines of war, that had once been soldiers, that were now remade into grotesque, beautiful, and murderous works of art, destroy entire battalions of soldiers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我亲眼目睹一群学龄儿童，他们饱受虚空之苦，远程操控着被感染的战争机器。这些机器曾经是士兵，现在被改造成了怪诞、美丽而又嗜杀的艺术品，摧毁了整营的士兵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很多事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. We both were. Although I believe Nitokh was planning to betray me, and I was also planning on betraying Nitokh. You know how it is with us Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我们俩都是。虽然我相信尼托计划背叛我，而我也计划背叛尼托。你知道的，我们奥罗金人就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have come to discover that they destroyed my Empire. An Empire that ruled the entire Origin System. And were about to wipe out the rebellion on Tau.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得知他们摧毁了我的帝国。一个统治整个始源星系的帝国。而且他们当时正准备剿灭 Tau 上的叛乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everything happened between Nitokh and I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尼托和我之间发生过太多事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everyone always scheming against everyone else. Just another day of the week, really.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 每个人都在暗中算计别人。这就是我们的日常。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And they did it in a night.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们居然花了一个晚上就做到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Everything and more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 甚至还有更多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Betrayals between one Orokin and another were quite common. But to betray the whole of the Empire? That manner of treason was worthy of not only execution by Jade Light, but the Cephalon Program.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金人之间的背叛司空见惯。但背叛整个帝国？这种叛国罪行不仅应由翠玉之光处决，更应用中枢计划处罚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wouldn't you be?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道你不觉得可怕吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And that is all I wish to say on that subject at the moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我暂时不想多说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot express what we were risking by attempting to murder the Executors - let alone all the Orokin, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我无法表达我们试图谋杀执行者们所冒的风险有多大，更不用说所有奥罗金人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nihil's Cephalon Program, by far. The Glassmaker's creations are...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 毫无疑问，无刹的中枢计划。玻璃匠的作品都……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Orokin Empire's existence balanced on the blade of a dagger, Usurper. It hummed on the very brink of destruction at all times. Only one thing kept it operational:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金帝国的存亡如同一把匕首，岌岌可危，它时刻徘徊在毁灭的边缘。只有一件事能维持它的运转：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Jade Light is quick to those without the armor or shields to survive a single blast. It is a merciful death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 翠玉之光对那些没有盔甲或护盾，无法抵挡一次爆炸的人来说，死的太快了。这是一种仁慈的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Societal norms.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 社会规范。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Cephalons, when converted from a willing subject, can be painless, and even performed non-destructively. However... when used punitively?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而中枢，如果是由自愿者转化而来，则可以做到无痛，甚至做到无损。但是……如果用于惩罚呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: One simply did not rise up and murder the Orokin! It was just not done, Drifter! Unthinkable! Positively gauche!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁都不会起来屠杀奥罗金人！漂泊者，这绝对不行！不可思议！简直是愚蠢至极！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Memories are sacred to the Orokin, Drifter. They are all we are, in the end. Our bodies are temporary. Our faces, our voices, our blood, all mutable. All can be changed like fashion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，对奥罗金人来说，记忆是神圣的。归根结底，记忆就是我们的一切。我们的肉体是暂时的。我们的容貌、声音、血液，一切都会改变。一切都可以像时尚一样随意更换。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which also made it comically easy to do, in the end. As I'm sure your Tenno duplicate learned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也​正​因为​如此，​最后​这种事​做​起来​反而​容易​得​可笑。​我​相信​你​的​ Tenno ​分身​肯定​深​有​体会。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which may likely be, by the by, why I am so deeply and utterly irritated with you for meddling with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 顺便一提，也许这正是我这么生气的原因，因为你干涉了这些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are correct, quite obviously! Albrecht met me in that hallway before Nitokh and I had the time to spring our trap for the Executors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说得对，这显而易见！在我和尼托设下陷阱准备对付执行者后，阿尔布雷希特就在那条走廊里遇到了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, clearly not. I was forcibly turned into this... thing by Albrecht before Nitokh and I had time to spring our trap for the Executors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对，显然没有。在我和尼托设下陷阱准备对付执行者后，我就被阿尔布雷希特强行变成了这种……东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know quite well what happened to our plan, don't you?! Albrecht met me in that hallway before Nitokh and I had the time to spring our trap for the Executors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你很清楚我们的计划出了什么问题，对吧？！在我和尼托设下陷阱准备对付执行者后，阿尔布雷希特就在那条走廊里遇到了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And offered me the protoframe serum. And... well... we both know what happened next.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然后​他​给​了​我​原型​战甲​血清。​之后……​嗯……​我们​都​知道​接​下来​发生​了​什么。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: One moment, I remember standing in a great golden hallway, the next, screaming in agony in some backwater hellhole in "Gaule."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我记得前一刻还站在一条金色的大厅里，下一刻就痛苦地尖叫着，身处"高卢"某个偏僻的地狱般的地方。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He offered me the protoframe serum, and we both know what happened next!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然后​他​给​了​我​原型​战甲​血清。​​我们​都​知道​接​下来​发生​了​什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A matter which I still am. Furious. Over. I. Why?! Why did I confess this to you?! Why do you know this?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对于这件事我至今仍然很生气。为什么？！我为什么要向你坦白？！你怎么会知道？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nitokh must have abandoned the plan once I went missing. Likely, she pinned the whole treasonous affair on me as a convenient scapegoat.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我失踪后，尼托肯定放弃了那个计划。很有可能，她把整个叛国事件都栽赃给了我，让我成了方便的替罪羊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah! No. Never mind. I am going now, before I break this damnable computer in a fit of rage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 呸！算了。我得走了，免得一时冲动把这该死的电脑砸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It explains all the records I am finding in the records calling me a "coward." Of course they would think me a coward - they think I ran! Pah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这解释了我查阅的记录中所有称我为"懦夫"的说法。他们当然会认为我是懦夫——他们以为我逃跑了！呸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is nice to know that I was so very crucial to the plan, however, that it had to be scuttled entirely once I was gone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 得知我对这个计划至关重要，我感到很欣慰；然而，我离开后，这个计划却不得不彻底取消。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You find your worth where you like, Drifter, and let me find mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你想在哪里找到自己的价值就在哪里找吧，而我的价值让我自己去找。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You see? You understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你看？你能明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have come to realize that it does not matter if I would have surrendered power or not, though in the time I was convinced I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我已经明白了，我当时是否会交出权力，其实根本无关紧要，尽管那时的我深信自己会这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was forcibly turned into this... thing by Albrecht before Nitokh and I had time to spring our trap for the Executors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在我和尼托设下陷阱准备对付执行者后，我就被阿尔布雷希特强行变成了这种……东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How much did Past Roathe tell you of his dealings with Executor Nitokh? Bah. Attempting to reconcile all this: that the former me trusted you with such personal information... only to have you strike it clean from my mind?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 之前的罗瑟究竟跟你说过多少他和执行者尼托之间的交易？唉。我在尽力调和这一切：过去的我竟然信任你，把这些私人信息告诉你……结果你却把它们从我的记忆中彻底抹去？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have heard me mention Executor Nitokh before. And my... dealings with her. You must try to understand that the Orokin Empire was not entirely evil.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你之前听我提起过执行者尼托，以及我和她之间的……来往。你必须明白，奥罗金帝国并非全然邪恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It burns a hole in me. That I could have told you everything, all of it - laid it all bare, down to the deepest part of me, and you... wiped it all clean again. Like I was nothing more than a little plaything to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我的心好痛。我曾经把一切都告诉你，所有的一切——毫无保留地袒露心扉，直抵我内心最深处，而你……却把我的一切都抹去了。就好像我只不过是你的一个玩物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It breaks my heart that its devastation and depravity is all that it shall be remembered for. Yes, there was plenty of it, I am not arguing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 令我痛心的是，人们最终只会记住它带来的破坏和堕落。没错，它的破坏和堕落确实罄竹难书，这一点我并不否认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose it is only fair. That is how we Orokin treated humanity, isn't it? The Yuvan Theatre? Parading beautiful flesh around and choosing our new selves at will, torturing each other with games for sick amusement as we saw fit...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想，这也算是报应吧。我们奥罗金人就是这样对待人类的，不是吗？青春厅堂？炫耀美丽的肉体，随意选择新的自我，用病态的游戏互相折磨，只为取乐……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it was also capable of such beauty. Such joy. Such love. Such scientific and artistic advancements. Look at what we were capable of achieving!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但它也创造了如此的美学，如此的欢乐，如此的爱，如此多的科学和艺术成就。看看我们曾经取得的成就吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hate it. I hate it so very, very much.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我讨厌这样。我非常非常讨厌这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So when Nitokh summoned me to her side and told me she wished to murder all the Orokin? I immediately agreed. I wished to cut off the head of the poisoned serpent. I wished to replace it with a more benign system. A more benign ruler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，当尼托召我到她身边，告诉我她想杀光所有奥罗金人时，我立刻同意了。我渴望斩断这条毒蛇的头颅，我渴望用一个更仁慈的制度，一个更仁慈的统治者来取代它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why yes, of course!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Myself, of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然是我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Orokin Empire was not entirely evil. It breaks my heart that its devastation and depravity is all that it shall be remembered for. Yes, there was plenty of it, I am not arguing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金帝国并非全然邪恶。令我痛心的是，人们最终只会记住它带来的破坏和堕落。没错，它的破坏和堕落确实罄竹难书，这一点我并不否认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If only the others could have seen it that way. If only Nitokh had seen it that way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果其他人也能这样想就好了。如果尼托也能这样想就好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would ensure that all the Executors and the Emperors would be... removed, and I would take over as Interim Executor until a new system could be put into place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会确保所有执行者和皇帝都被……罢免，我将担任临时执行者，直到新的制度建立起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it was also capable of such beauty. Such joy. Such love. Such scientific and artistic advancements. Look at what we were capable of achieving!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但它也创造了如此的美学，如此的欢乐，如此的爱，如此多的科学和艺术成就。看看我们曾经取得的成就吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Orokin Empire was not entirely evil. It breaks my heart that its devastation and depravity is all that it shall be remembered for. Yes, there was plenty of it, I am not arguing that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金帝国并非全然邪恶。令我痛心的是，人们最终只会记住它带来的破坏和堕落。没错，它的破坏和堕落确实罄竹难书，这一点我并不否认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: However long that would take, I do not know, but it would be better than what followed in the wake of the Great War, wouldn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道这需要多长时间，但这总比那场大战之后的情况要好，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So when Nitokh summoned me to her side and told me she wished to murder all the Orokin? I immediately agreed. I wished to cut off the head of the poisoned serpent. I wished to replace it with a more benign system. A more benign ruler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，当尼托召我到她身边，告诉我她想杀光所有奥罗金人时，我立刻同意了。我渴望斩断这条毒蛇的头颅，我渴望用一个更仁慈的制度，一个更仁慈的统治者来取代它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You call it the "Old War" now. It is hardly "Old" to me, it only happened a few years ago in my recollection of events.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就是你现在称为"远古之战"的那场战役。但对我来说，它根本算不上"远古"，在我记忆中，它仿佛就发生在几年前。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. I do not know. It hardly matters anymore, does it? But at the time, I was fully convinced I would.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我不知道。现在这似乎已经不重要了，不是吗？但当时，我坚信我会的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why yes, of course! And don't pretend as though you haven't heard this before, I am certain you have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！​别装作​不​知道，​你​肯定​听过。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Myself, of course. And don't pretend as though you haven't heard this before, I am certain you have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然是我自己！​别装作​不​知道，​你​肯定​听过。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Time travel is funny like that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 时间旅行就是这么奇妙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you finally speaking with our dear Lyon? Or is he still giving you the cold shoulder? Honestly, you might be better off keeping a safe distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你终于跟我们亲爱的里昂说上话了吗？还是他依然没理你？说实话，你最好还是跟他保持距离。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what of their kindness toward me, Usurper? I am what I am. And have been for many centuries. I do not expect to change simply because they demand it now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，他们对我的恩情又算什么？我就是我，几个世纪以来一直如此。我不会因为他们现在的要求就改变自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would "get along" with him better if he strove to understand a little more about who I am and from whence I hail. I am what I am. And have been for many centuries. I do not expect to change simply because they demand it now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果他能努力来多了解我，了解我的出身，我们或许能相处得更好。我就是我，几个世纪以来一直如此。我不会因为他们现在的要求就改变自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is Albrecht's fault I'm like this! It's his fault I'm trapped here with them, not mine! I had nothing to do with this hideous arrangement!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 都是阿尔布雷希特的错，我才会变成这样！我​跟​他们​一起​困​在​这里，都是他的错，不是我的错！这可怕的安排跟我一点关系都没有！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I may have taken that serum willingly - but I know I did not sign up to be harangued at all hours by those two ingrates.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我或许是自愿注射了那瓶血清——但我知道我可不会自愿被那两个忘恩负义的人无时无刻骚扰。
