/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They can register their complaints with their precious "Cardinal," not me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们可以向他们尊贵的"主教"投诉，而不是向我投诉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Help." Yes. "Help." Pardon me for finding their style of "help" deeply "unhelpful."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "帮助。"​ 可​不​是​嘛。​"帮助。"​ 不​好意思，​我​觉得​他们​这​种​"帮助"​的​方式​实​在​"无济于​事"。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, that is the tragedy of it all. They honestly do believe they are trying to do "good."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，这就是整件事的悲剧所在。他们真心相信自己是在做好事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgiven by whom? You? Them? The butler? Albrecht? Or "the gods?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 被谁宽恕？你？他们？管家？阿尔布雷希特？还是"神明"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed I would find it more "helpful" if they were to switch my wine for a caustic astringent, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，事实上，如果他们把我的酒换成一种腐蚀性的收敛剂，我会觉得更有"帮助"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what do you think? Do you think I am in need of some "great redemption?" Some "holy forgiveness?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那​你​觉得​呢？​你​认为​我​需要​某​种​"伟大​的​救赎"​吗？​需要​某​种​"神圣​的​宽恕"​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would at least be more efficient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少这样效率会更高。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pray tell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请告诉我是谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Orokin society I will not apologize for, as I was not its creator. Merely a denizen of it. And if you are to blame all those who take part in a system that they were guilty of simply being born into, you would condemn billions in your haughty self-righteousness. As for the rest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会为奥罗金社会道歉，因为我并非它的缔造者，而只是其中的一员。如果你要指责所有身处这个体制中的人，那么你那出于傲慢的自以为是，将会定罪数十亿人。至于其他人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what if I have? I cannot change them now. What is the point in feeling guilt?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就算我真的做了又怎样？现在也无法改变了。内疚又有什么用呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though betwixt the two of them, I prefer the priest, I must admit. He listens to reason. He may just come around to the fact the Indifference is not a real god.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，我得承认，在这他俩之间，我更喜欢那位神父。他能听进去道理。他或许最终会明白，虚空无情之物并非真正的神。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was war. And it is the nature of war to kill those you fight against in great numbers. Do you weep for the Grineer or the "Corpus" you kill?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那是战争。而战争的本质就是大量杀戮敌人。你会为被你杀死的 Grineer 或 Corpus 哭泣吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In fact, I might yet convince him to see through the whole of his religion - fancy that. A man who sees fanciful and bloody hallucinations, but also sense and logic. What a rarity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，我或许还能说服他彻底看穿他的宗教——真是不可思议。一个既能看到奇幻血腥的幻觉，又能保持理智和逻辑的人。真是罕见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. I see. It is not the action but the methodology you object to. I hereby retract my previous approval and replace it with consternation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我明白了。你反对的不是行为本身，而是方法。我在此撤回我之前的赞同，取而代之的是震惊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have never lost one night's sleep to any guilt over betraying my own people, Usurper. Believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我从未因背叛自己的人民而彻夜难眠，相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why? So that I am left alone? So that I am not some... anathema? Some social pariah?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？就为了让我一个人待着？就为了让我不至于成为什么……异类？什么社会弃儿？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Learning from one's mistakes is key, yes. But one does not need to feel "guilt" to understand "failure."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从错误中吸取教训固然重要，但理解"失败"并不需要感到"内疚"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not apologize for the Orokin Empire, as I was not its creator, merely a denizen of it. But neither will I take any blame for planning to tear it down around me. We deserved what we received, and worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会为奥罗金帝国道歉，因为我并非它的缔造者，而只是其中的一员。但我也不会为策划摧毁它而承担任何责任。我们罪有应得，甚至该受更重的惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Every situation is a "different situation," Usurper. Context is always key. And you are simply looking at the "Old War" with the clarity of hindsight.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，每一种情况都是"不一样的情况"。背景永远是关键。而你只不过是用马后炮的眼光看待那场"远古之战"罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then I feel an immense pity for you, Usurper, and I suggest you either come to accept that which you are tasked with doing, or retire from this life and take up farming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，我对你，篡位者，深感同情。我建议你要么接受你所肩负的使命，要么就此隐退种田去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. I love when you so clearly display I have pressed your buttons, it is so wonderfully delicious. You deflect the conversation poorly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。我就喜欢你这么明显地表现出我触碰到了你的痛点，真是妙不可言。你拙劣地转移了话题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Look at me, Usurper. See what I am. An Orokin, removed from their empire.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，看看我。看看我是什么人。一个被逐出帝国的奥罗金人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what is the point of forgiveness, in the end? From whom should I strive to be forgiven? Others? So that I am not some anathema?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还有，宽恕的意义何在？我应该努力获得谁的宽恕？其他人吗？这样我才不会成为众矢之的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And that is precisely what I was seeking to help him with! I am only trying to help him through some of his uncertainty regarding the Indifference and what Entrati told him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而这正是我想要帮助他的地方！关于虚空无情之物以及英择谛告诉他的事情，我只是想帮他理清一些的疑惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Absolutely nothing of harm, regardless of what the annoying floating gnat might tell you. I am only trying to help him through some of his uncertainty regarding what the Indifference and what Entrati told him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然​都是​些​无害​的​事，​不​用​管​那​只​烦人​的​飞​虫​是怎么​说的。​我​只​是​想​帮​他​解惑，​让​他​明白虚空​无情​之物​和​英择​谛告诉​他​的​那些​话​到​底​是​什么​意思。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If there is a single thing I feel guilt for? It is that the Tenno were responsible for finally burning it all down, and not me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果说我有什么愧疚的话，那就是最终毁掉这一切的是 Tenno，而不是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you are to judge all peoples' actions of the past with all the information you have in the future, you will find yourself incessantly mortified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你用未来掌握的所有信息去评判人们过去的行为，你将会感到无比羞愧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though it would be a shame. It is glorious fun to watch you work. Not terribly efficient - but wonderfully flashy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然那样就太可惜了。看你做事真是赏心悦目。效率不算很高，但绝对精彩炫目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I suppose spending centuries by yourself with no one to talk to but the invented creations of your storybook mind does limits one's opportunities to sharpen one's social weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我想，独自一人度过几个世纪，除了用自己童话般的想象力所创造的人物之外，没有人可以交谈，这确实会限制一个人磨练社交能力的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was "the Devil of Tau" in my own time. And here, I am already "the devil" to all who meet me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我以前是"Tau 之恶魔"。而在这里，对于所有见到我的人来说，我已然成了"恶魔"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Entrati told him his "visions" were not the product of Lua but of the Indifference. This is leading him into a bit of a "crisis of faith."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 英择谛告诉他，他的"异象"并非来自月神，而是来自虚空无情之物。这让他陷入了某种"信仰危机"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How charming to know that the concept of nuance and subtlety is not dead after all. Yes, you are quite right. I am a product of another time, another era, another society.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是令人欣慰啊，原来"分寸"与"细微"的概念还没有消亡。是的，你说得对。我是另一个时期、另一个时代、另一个社会的产物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Accept what has happened in the past and move on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 接受过去发生的一切，然后继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You make the battlefield "fun" if nothing else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就算别的什么都没做，至少你让战场变得"有趣"了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Go spar with the Priest, you both need the practice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 去和神父切磋一下，你们俩都需要练习。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht saw fit to ensure the moniker was permanent.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特认为有必要确保这个绰号永久保留下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: However, I am attempting to convince him that this is not the case, and neither "god" sent them, as there are no "gods." He is simply unwell.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而，​我​正试图​让​他​相信​事实​并​非​如此，​也​不​是​来自于​"神"，​因为​根本​没有​"神"。​他​只​是​生病​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I could recognize the cruelty and the travesties of my people for what they were, however. There were lows to which many of my kind sank that even I could not stomach.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而，我能认清我族人的残忍和暴行。我的许多同胞堕落到的地步，连我都无法忍受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I knew I liked you for a reason, Usurper. Finally! Someone who appreciates me! It only took... how many centuries?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我就知道我喜欢你是有原因的。终于！有人欣赏我了！这花了……多少个世纪啊？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here is my advice to you: kill all guilt in your heart over your actions, like I have. Drive a blade into its chest until it is dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我给你的建议是：像我一样，把对自己行为的所有愧疚都杀掉。用刀刺入它的胸膛，直到它死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But such matters are... complex. And I appreciate that you can see that. Bah. The butler is giving me a look. I need to exit this conversation. We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这类事情……很复杂。我很感激你能明白这一点。唉。管家正瞪着我。我得结束这次谈话了。我们很快会再谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah. The butler is giving me a look. I need to exit this conversation. We shall speak again soon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唉。管家正瞪着我。我得结束这次谈话了。我们很快再聊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Guilt is nothing but a traitor in the night who will rob you of all you hold dear. It does you nothing but harm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 内疚就像黑夜里的叛徒，会夺走你珍视的一切。它只会给你带来伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He has not refused to listen. He has not told me to stop talking. I would, if he told me to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他并没有拒绝倾听，也没有叫我停止说话。如果他叫我停下，我会照做的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is it better for the religiously-inclined to manipulate him simply because they can? To point at his hallucinations and call them "visions" instead of helping him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道有宗教倾向的人就可以去操纵他吗？只是把他的幻觉称为"异象"，而不是去帮助他？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It angers me to see those around Lyon use and manipulate him, whether or not they even realize they are doing it. All in the name of "religion" and "belief."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看到里昂身边的人利用和操纵他，无论这些人是否意识到这一点，我都感到愤怒。这一切都打着"宗教"和"信仰"的旗号。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have been reading the accounts of what happened. This... "Red Veil" could have tried to retrieve that Tenno from inside his Harrow for all those centuries. But they did not. They let him wither away and die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一直在阅读相关的历史记载。这个……"血色面纱"本可以尝试在几个世纪里将那位 Tenno 从他的 Harrow 体内救出。但他们没有。他们任由他枯萎死去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why? In the name of standing guard against some... theoretical "God of the Void."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？为了防范某个……理论上的"虚空之神"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. He was protecting against something. But who knows how much worse he made matters? Who knows how much of himself and his fear and dread he fed it, for all those centuries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，他是在防范某种东西。但谁知道他把事情搞得这么糟糕？谁知道几个世纪以来，他究竟在滋养了多少自己的恐惧和恐慌？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or he was the only thing feeding it, all those years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者说，这么多年来，它唯一的食物来源就是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Conceptual embodiment only manifests what it is given to create with. And the Void can only work with the cloth it is given to sew from.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 概念成形只能显现其所拥有的创造素材。虚空也只能利用其所拥有的素材进行创作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How much did that one Tenno pour into its existence alone, I wonder? He was a veritable feast of Agony, Pain, Betrayal, Sadness... Loneliness...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想知道，那个 Tenno 究竟为它的存在倾注了多少心血？他简直就是痛苦、折磨、背叛、悲伤……以及孤独的化身……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the numbness that must come with the thousands of years he spent alone in that place, speaking into the Nothingness. What follows with that, if not Indifference?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还有，他在那地方独自待了数千年，对着虚无说话，必然会变得麻木。在那之后，还能剩下什么？除了虚空无情之物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So are children's nightmares. They are the most powerful creatures in the universe to a six-year-old. But to an adult, they are nothing but a puff of lint caught in a vent that drifted too close to the light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孩子的噩梦也是一样。在六岁孩子眼里，那是宇宙中最强大的怪物。但对成年人来说，它们只不过是一缕飘到通风口的灰尘，只是太靠近光而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not think I could ask for anything more than for you to simply admit you do not know for certain what we are dealing with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我所能要求的，不过是希望你承认你并不确定我们究竟在面对什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We make mountains out of specks of dust simply because we must have a reason to be miserable and destroy ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们总是把尘埃夸成高山，只因为我们需要理由去痛苦，去毁灭自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is a gloriously wonderful place to start. And an admirable trait for any person to own: the simple ability to just say... "I do not know."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这​是​一​个​绝妙​的​开始。​而且，​能够​坦然​地​说​"我​不​知道"​也​是​每​个​人​都​应该​具备​的​一​种​优秀​品质。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Humanity at a glance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这就是人类。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If we Orokin could have mustered that once in a while, we might have survived.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们奥罗金人偶尔也能做到这一点，我们或许就能活下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why ask me this? What are you attempting to learn, Drifter? You are not asking after the location of munitions, certainly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​为什么​问​我​这个​问题？​漂泊者，​你​想​知道​什么？​你肯定不​是​在​问军需​的​下落吧。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why? Planning on going back in time and beating your younger self's record? In need of advice on how to overthrow a totalitarian government? Seeking the location of buried munitions that could detonate whole planets?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么这么问？你是打算回到过去打破指挥官创下的纪录？需要推翻极权政府的建议？寻找那个埋藏着的、足以引爆整个星球的军需？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why would I trust you? Why did I trust you?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我为什么要信任你？我当初为什么会信任你？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or are you merely making idle conversation?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者你只是在闲聊？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why! Why you, of all people?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么！为什么偏偏是你？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have forgiven you for doing the deed. I simply wish I remembered why - why! Why you, of all people?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我已经原谅了你做的那件事。我只是希望我能记起为什么——为什么！为什么偏偏是你？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All I regret is that it never came to fruition. I regret the wasted time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我唯一后悔的是它最终未能实现。我后悔浪费了时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And a masterpiece it was, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，那的确是一部杰作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Practical. But so many of the places where I "hid" my supplies have likely... wandered in the many, many years that have passed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很实际的想法。但是，很多我以前"藏"东西的地方，很可能在漫长的岁月中早已漂移变迁了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, you likely believed there would not be consequences to your actions. But regardless, we should carry on with this silly conversation where we retread our previous selves and simply get on with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，你可能认为自己的行为不会有任何后果。但不管怎样，我们还是应该继续这场愚蠢的对话，重复一遍，然后继续过我们自己的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, yes. I suppose we should carry on with this silly conversation where we retread our previous conversations once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，是的。我想我们应该继续这场愚蠢的对话，把我们之前的话题再重复一遍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And many of the locations were secret even to me. The plan was beyond intricate. Layers upon layers upon layers deep.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 许多地点甚至连我自己都不知道。计划极其复杂，层层叠叠，错综复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: By retreading the same pointless conversations about why I wanted to murder people who are long since dead and dust? At least it is the pragmatic approach.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道要一遍又一遍地重复那些毫无意义的对话，讨论我为什么要杀害那些早就化成灰的人吗？至少这是一种务实的做法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What was your question again? Ah! Yes. "How was I planning on overthrowing the Executors?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你刚才问的是什么来着？啊！对了。"我打算怎么推翻那些执行者？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The plan was beyond intricate. Layers upon layers upon layers deep. Assassins who would kill the assassins of other assassins should the first assassin fail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个计划极其复杂，层层叠叠，层数不胜数。如果第一个刺客失败，其他刺客还会杀死他们手下的刺客。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Assassins who would kill the assassins of other assassins should the first assassin fail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果第一个刺客失败，那么其他刺客就会把剩下的刺客杀死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么​问​这个？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bombs laid in multiple buildings, whole ships and an entire moon rigged to detonate with stolen explosives. A solar rail ready to fall out of orbit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很多建筑、整艘飞船甚至整颗卫星上都布满了炸弹，这些炸弹都已安装完毕，准备用偷来的炸药引爆。一条星际航道也随时可能脱离轨道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And all of it rigged to look like a "Great Sentient Disaster" when the time came. Nitokh and I would declare the Empire in a state of emergency once the Executors and Emperors were... dealt with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一切都被精心策划，以便在时机成熟时伪装成一场"巨大的 Sentient 灾难"。一旦那些执行者和皇帝被……解决掉，我和尼托就会宣布帝国进入紧急状态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was one of the many thousands of possible outcomes for which I had a plan.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是我预想的成千上万种可能结果之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There were a thousand possible outcomes to what we had planned. For each variable in play, a possible variant of a path was created.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们原先的计划有上千种可能的结果。对于每一个可能影响结果的变量，我们都设计了一条可能的路径。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If we failed spectacularly, I would have simply eaten the end of a Lex and called it a day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们彻底失败了，我就会吞"雷克斯"自杀，然后结束这一天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And for each one, I had laid out a result. And for each one, I knew what I intended to do. Many were similar in the broad strokes of things, but were dissimilar in the details.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对于每一条路径，我都预先设定了结果。对于每一条路径，我都清楚自己打算怎么做。许多路径在总体上相似，但在细节上却截然不同。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was a complex matter of some... great negotiation between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是一件非常复杂的事情，需要我们之间进行一番……谈判。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What have I told you before about it? Because I find I do not yet trust you enough to tell you outright.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我之前跟你说过什么？因为我觉得我还不够信任你，所以不敢直接告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No point crying over spilled Kuva, and all that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为洒出来的赤毒哭泣毫无意义。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If we failed spectacularly, I would have simply eaten the end of a Lex and called it a day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们彻底失败了，我就会吞"雷克斯"自杀，然后结束这一天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If it was a middling success, which was the most likely, cleanup would be required to ensure all loose strings were "dealt with." Naturally, of course, I was one of those strings. And I had steps to ensure that I was still too valuable in the short term to be snipped with the rest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果这次行动只是取得中等程度的成功（最​有​可能​的​结果），那么就需要进行善后工作，确保所有遗留问题都得到解决。当然，我自然也是其中之一。而且我已经采取了一些措施，以确保在短期内我仍然具有足够的价值，不会被像其他成员一样轻易放弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Every kind you can imagine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你能想到的各种谈判。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then there is no point in my repeating myself now, is there? Indeed, there is hardly a point to this conversation at all. Have a lovely rest of your day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那我再重复一遍也没用了，对吧？事实上，这场谈话根本毫无意义。祝你今天余下的时间愉快。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And run to where, my Usurper? Not all of us have pocket dimensions to escape to when we are in a panic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的篡位者，那你跑到哪里去？不是每个人在慌乱时都能躲进什么口袋维度的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would have had little other choice, would I? Nowhere to go, nowhere to hide.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我别无选择，不是吗？无处可去，无处可藏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If the situation was a rousing success, I would have gone forward with phase two of the plan.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果是大获成功的情况，我就会继续推进计划的第二阶段。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Centuries beneath the sands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 沙子下还埋藏了数百年呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. I shall say that it was a complex matter of some... great negotiation between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。我得说，这的确是一件非常复杂的事情，需要我们之间进行一番……谈判。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nitokh had made it painfully clear that if we failed, I would be the public sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尼托曾痛苦地表示，如果我们失败了，我将成为公众的牺牲品。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Murdering Nitokh, of course. Hardly a surprising twist. She knew herself it was likely to happen, and taunted me with it quite regularly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，杀了尼托。这几乎算不上什么意外。她自己也知道这很可能会发生，而且经常拿这件事来嘲讽我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was one of her many partners, you understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我是她众多伙伴之一，你应该明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you know, I was one of her many playthings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道的，我是她众多玩物之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: One thing you must understand about Orokin is that we were always scheming against each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 关于奥罗金人，你必须明白的一点是，我们总是互相算计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I once believed us to be partners. In politics, in intrigue, in bed...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我曾以为我们是伙伴。在政治上，在阴谋上，在床上……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hardly. But one thing you must understand about Orokin is that we were always scheming against each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然介意。只是你必须明白，奥罗金人一直以来都在互相算计。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I knew that Nitokh would kill me without hesitation at any point if it might even possibly aid her in the pursuit of her goals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道，只要杀了我有可能帮助尼托实现目标，她随时都会毫不犹豫地杀了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think she enjoyed the challenge, Usurper. The sense of danger. The thrill of knowing she was sleeping with someone who wanted her dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我觉得她很享受这种挑战。那种危险感。那种知道自己正和一个想要她命的人睡的刺激感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would like to pretend that we were the first Orokin to find themselves in such a situation, but it was not even that uncommon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我倒想假装我们是第一个陷入这种境地的奥罗金人，但其实这种情况并不算罕见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely! But it is hardly a surprising twist. She saw it coming as well, and taunted me with it quite regularly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错！这几乎算不上什么意外。她自己也知道这很可能会发生，而且经常拿这件事来嘲讽我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely! It is almost as though you have heard this before. But it is hardly a surprising twist. She taunted me with it quite regularly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正是！说得你好像以前就听过这句话似的。但这几乎算不上什么意外，而且她经常也拿这件事来嘲讽我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are adorable. Yes, in a manner of speaking, we were business partners. But we were also partners in many other more important ways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真可爱。是的，从某种意义上说，我们是商业伙伴。但我们在很多其他更重要的方面也是伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In war. In politics. In intrigue. In bed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在战争上。在政治上。在阴谋上。在床上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did not believe us to be equals, of course. She was an Executor. The Great Nitokh. But I thought myself First Amongst Her Lessers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我当然不认为我们是平等的。她是执行者，伟大的尼托。但我自认为在她手下之中，我是排第一的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yet she knew that I was sharpening my knives behind her back and eagerly awaiting the moment where I would remove her head from her shoulders.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而她也知道，我在她背后磨刀，热切地盼望着砍下她的头颅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The longer I live the more I realize we may not have been a species designed for immortality.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我活得越久，就越觉得我们人类或许并非天生就适合永生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I wonder if I am misremembering. I wonder if "partner" is too strong a word for what we really were.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我怀疑我可能记错了。我怀疑用"伙伴"这个词来形容我们之间的关系是否太过强烈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What I fool I was...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真蠢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You could say we had a... complex relationship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可以说，我们的关系……很复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But, yes. You could say that Nitokh and I had a... complex relationship.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但是，没错。可以说，我和尼托的关系……很复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She was the Great Nitokh after all. An Executor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 毕竟她是伟大的尼托，是一位执行者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Void, no! If she drunkenly wandered out an airlock one afternoon it would have solved a great deal of my damnable problems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空啊，当然不！如果她哪天下午喝醉了从气闸里溜出去，就能解决我很多该死的麻烦事了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Void, no! Never trust an Orokin, Drifter. Including me. Especially me! Love us, hate us, adore us, despise us - but never, ever trust us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空啊，当然不！漂泊者，永远不要相信奥罗金人。包括我。尤其不要相信我！爱我们，恨我们，崇拜我们，鄙视我们都好——但永远，永远不要相信我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I absolutely, positively despised her, and I would have adored nothing more than to slowly, carefully, gently peel her blue skin off her body with my bare hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我绝对、肯定地憎恨她，我最渴望的就是用我的双手慢慢地、小心翼翼地、轻轻地把她身上的蓝色皮肤剥下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What an impertinent question! I think I adore you for asking it. You know, I think I did love her, just a little. I have honestly not even stopped to ponder that until right this moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是个冒昧的问题！不过，你这么问，我反而觉得你很可爱。你知道吗，我想我的确喜欢过她，虽然只是一点点。说实话，现在，我才真正认真思考过这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We are prone to fits of restlessness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们容易出现躁动不安的情绪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, I think I was just the slightest bit infatuated with her. What a curious realization...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我想我当时确实有点迷恋她。多么奇妙的发现啊……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may be right. Living in the past is dangerous, for we saddle ourselves with regret and shame and nothing else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说的或许有道理。沉湎过去很危险，因为我们只会背负悔恨和羞愧，别无其他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may be right. Living in the past is dangerous, for we saddle ourselves with regret and shame and nothing else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说的或许有道理。沉湎过去很危险，因为我们只会背负悔恨和羞愧，别无其他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Picturing it in my mind was the only thing that allowed me to suffer through many of my... mandatory evenings in her bed. I apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只有在脑海中想象那个画面，我才能忍受那些……被迫在她床上度过的夜晚。我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The fact that you believe those two things are mutually exclusive is positively adorable. I hope you have the opportunity to experience an evening with such an "acquaintance" someday, it is fairly magical.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你居然认为这两件事互不相容，真是太可爱了。我希望你有一天能有机会和这样一位"熟人"共度一个夜晚，那感觉相当奇妙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must understand, it was also clouded over with the deepest and most extremely overwhelming hatred as well. I despised her in the same breath and I would have adored nothing more than to slowly, carefully, gently peel her blue skin off her body with my bare hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你必须明白，那份憎恨也深深地、无比强烈地笼罩着我。我恨她入骨，恨不得立刻用我的双手，慢慢地、小心翼翼地、温柔地将她那青紫的皮肤剥下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, yes. I get the sense I am not precisely winning you over with my "devilish charm," am I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，没​错。我感觉我的"迷人魅力"似乎并没有真正打动你，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What point is there, reliving our past deeds, our past failures and regrets? We cannot change them - even with this gift of time travel, it is only a path to madness to attempt to "redo" that which has been "done."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 重温过去的所作所为、过去的失败和遗憾有什么意义呢？我们无法改变它们——即使拥有穿越时空的能力，试图"重做"已经"做过"的事情也只会走向疯狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But neither can we forget the misdeeds of our former selves, for we risk becoming nothing but madmen and despots, belligerent creatures who see no fault within ourselves and only within others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但是我们也不能忘记我们过去犯下的罪行，因为我们有可能会变成疯子和暴君，变成好战的生物，看不到自己的错误，只看到别人的错误。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply recommend that you do not make such relationships a permanent affair. It becomes wildly unhealthy for both parties. It usually ends in murder for one or both of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我强烈建议你不要让这种关系发展成长期关系。这对双方都非常有害，而且通常会导致其中一人或两人丧命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, although, it will never be a problem with you, will it? You have your eye set far closer to home with that mad priest, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，​不过，​这​对​你​来​说​永远​不​会​是​个​问题，​对​吧？​​你​更​关注​的​是​那个疯神父，不是吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, although, it will never be a problem with you, will it? You have your eye set far closer to home with Marie in our little "arrangement."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，​不过，​这​对​你​来​说​永远​不​会​是​个​问题，​对​吧？​在​我们​的​小​"安排"​里，​你​更​关注​的​是​和​玛丽​在​一起​的​事情。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply thought I should give you the fair warning, seeing as we have our little... arrangement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​觉得​应该​事先​提醒​你​一下，​毕竟​我们​之间​有​这么​点……​安排。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply thought I should give you the fair warning, seeing as you have made your... interests known.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得既然你已经表明了你的兴趣，就应该事先提醒你一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, although, it will never be a problem with you, will it? You have your eye set far closer to home with that mad priest, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，​不过，​这​对​你​来​说​永远​不​会​是​个​问题，​对​吧？​​你​更​关注​的​是​那个疯神父，不是吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, although, it will never be a problem with you, will it? You have your eye set far closer to home with Marie, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，​不过，​这​对​你​来​说​永远​不​会​是​个​问题，​对​吧？​你​更​关注​的​是​和​玛丽​在​一起​的​事情，不是吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I am what I am. I am who I am. I walk the path I have chosen and I am past the point of wishing to apologize for myself. I will not change what I am to suit the opinions of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我就是我。我走我选择的路，我早已过了向别人道歉的阶段。我不会为了迎合别人的看法而改变自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This was a trait I saw in many of the poorest of the Executors and the Emperors - blind faith in only their own faultless and guiltless selves. I despised them for it and vowed I would never share such egotistical hubris.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在众多最差劲的执行者和皇帝身上都看到了这种特质——盲目地相信自己完美无瑕、毫无罪责。我为此鄙视他们，并发誓我永远不会拥有如此自负的狂妄。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I only ever truly dabbled with partners of the physical sense, Drifter. I never had emotional ones. None that were ever mutual, at any rate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我真正有过的只是肉体上的伴侣，从未有过情感上的伴侣。至少，从未有过双向奔赴的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The fact that you have never experienced such a thing makes you exceedingly lucky, Usurper. I do not recommend finding yourself in such an arrangement, it usually ends in murder for one or both of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，你从未经历过这种事，真是幸运至极。我劝你最好别让自己陷入这种境地，通常情况下，这会导致你们其中一人或两人丧命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Picturing it in my mind was the only thing that allowed me to sit through many a long meeting. I apologize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只有在脑海中想象画面，我才能坚持参加许多漫长的会议。我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He is handsome enough. But he looks as though if a flower wilts he might declare it is the end of it all and throw himself from the nearest tower.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他是挺帅的，但看起来好像只要一朵花凋谢，他就会觉得是世界末日来了，然后从最近的塔楼跳下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She is quite beautiful, I cannot say that I blame you. Though I do not think I could withstand the self-righteous piety, personally.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她的确很漂亮，我不能怪你。不过就我个人而言，我恐怕无法忍受她那种自以为是的虔诚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It does have me wondering which one of us has caught your eye, if any.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我不禁想知道，我们之中，有没有谁引起你注意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your loss, but you do have quite the array of options to choose from, don't you? I am certain you will find someone to... amuse yourself with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那是你的损失，不过你有很多选择，不是吗？我相信你肯定能找到人陪你消遣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thank you for reminding me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你提醒我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did not hate all of them. Only some of them. The ones in power. And that was why it was so terribly doomed in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我并非憎恨所有人，只憎恨其中一部分人，那些掌权者。正因如此，最终才导致了如此可怕的结局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But! Suit yourself. Let me know if I can be of any assistance. I am deeply entertained by the notion of watching you and the zealot embroil yourself in all sorts of needless emotional entanglements.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过！你喜欢就好。如果我能帮上什么忙，尽管告诉我。我非常乐于看到你和那个狂热分子陷入各种毫无必要的感情纠葛中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How lovely to know that all sense of good taste and class has not fled this system after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很高兴看到，良好的品味和格调并没有完全从这个星系中消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. Wise. Although that does beg the question, have I happened to catch your eye, Drifter? If you think it concerns me that you are wrapped up with another, it does not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，明智。不过漂泊者，这确实引出了一个问题，我有没有引起你的注意？如果你认为我会在意你和别人在一起，那你就错了，我并不在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. Wise. Although that does beg the question, have I happened to catch your eye, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，明智。不过漂泊者，这确实引出了一个问题，我有没有引起你的注意？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Must I spell it out for you? Very well. I have never been in love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道我还要跟你说清楚吗？好吧。我从未恋爱过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For all of our advances, for all the work we did to save humanity - we never solved the greatest issue that plagued us in our hearts. The greatest flaw that ate at our souls like an atrous cancer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管我们取得了所有进步，尽管我们为拯救人类做了那么​多工作——但我们始终未能解决困扰我们内心的最大问题，那个像癌症一样啃噬我们灵魂的最大缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: See that you do. You seem like you are doing your best to live a good life, Drifter. To be a "good" person. I would hate to see you wind up like the Orokin. We were defined by our excess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你最好记住。漂泊者，看来你正在努力过上好日子，努力做一个"好"人。我真不希望你落得像奥罗金人那样的下场。我们奥罗金人就是被自己的放纵所定义的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Quite welcome. You seem like you are doing your best to live a good life, Drifter. To be a "good" person. I would hate to see you wind up like the Orokin. We were defined by our excess.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。漂泊者，看来你正在努力过上好日子，努力做一个"好"人。我真不希望你落得像奥罗金人那样的下场。我们奥罗金人就是被自己的放纵所定义的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I only ever truly dabbled with partners of the physical sense, Drifter. I never had emotional ones. None that were ever mutual, at any rate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，我真正有过的只是肉体上的伴侣，从未有过情感上的伴侣。至少，从未有过双向奔赴的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pathetic, isn't it? All the advances in the universe and we still could not manage to figure out how to organize ourselves without wasting hours of everyone's lives gathered around a table talking past each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是可悲，不是吗？宇宙发展了这么多技术，我们却仍然无法想出如何组织起来，而不是浪费大家宝贵的时间围坐在桌旁，各说各话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, now that we know which target you have aimed your bow at, that gives us something to work toward, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然我们知道你用弓箭瞄准了哪个目标，那我们就有了努力的方向，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or do you not have an inclination toward "protoframes?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还是你对"原型战甲"没兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do seem to have an inclination toward "protoframes," after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 毕竟，你看起来似乎对"原型战甲"情有独钟。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And before you start typing up a furious rebuttal and angrily denounce my person for encouraging any sort of unfaithfulness on your part, give me one moment to explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在你开始愤怒地反驳并谴责我怂恿你做出任何不忠行为之前，请给我一点时间解释一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How sad is that? I know. No, I have not been. Never mutually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很可悲对吗？我知道。不，我没有过这样的恋爱。从来没有过双向的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Has it ever been a one-sided affair? Oh, most certainly. But that is not a romance, is it? That is a tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这段感情曾经是不是单方面的付出？哦，当然。但这并非浪漫爱情，对吗？那是一场悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bureaucracy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 官僚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is an existence that tends to come to define you by its loneliness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，这种生活往往会被孤独塑造。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Probably wise. Mundane, but wise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许是明智的想法。平凡却明智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course! Best case, you distract one of them from their seemingly intractable goal of harassing me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！最好的结果是，你可以分散他们其中一个人的注意力，让他不再以骚扰我为目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When one lives for as long as we do, one comes to understand that some hearts can hold affection for many more than one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 活得久了，就会明白有些人的心可以同时爱上不止一个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You think me a devil now? My reputation has only improved in this far-flung future, my Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你只是现在觉得我是恶魔？我的篡位者啊，在遥远的未来，我这名声只会越来越响亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing in the world stagnates human greatness quite like the adherence to systems and paperwork at all costs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 要​说​世界​上​人​类​伟​大成​就​的​最​大​阻碍，​就​是​不​惜​一切​代价​地​墨​守​成规​和​拘泥于​文书​工作。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Must I spell it out for you? Very well. I have never been in love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道我还要跟你说清楚吗？好吧。我从未恋爱过。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose I will just have to sit back and watch it all fall apart on its own. Or, you succeed and one of them becomes too distracted from their seemingly intractable cause of harassing me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我只能坐等事情自己黄了。或者，你成功了，他们中的一个会因此分心，​不​再​以​骚扰​我​为​目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Worst case, it all ends terribly and I am provided with hours of free entertainment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 最坏的情况是，一切都以糟糕的方式结束，但我却能获得几个小时的免费娱乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think you are the first person I have ever come across who wants to "dance with the devil of Tau?" Hardly. It simply remains to be seen how genuine your interest is, or if it is merely over after you spend a night or two scratching your itch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你以为你是第一个想"与 Tau 之恶魔共舞"的人吗？当然不是。关键在于你的兴趣究竟是真心的，还是仅仅在满足了一两晚的欲望之后就销声匿迹了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How you wound me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你伤透了我的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? And which one of us have caught your fancy? Or is it someone else, some"when" else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？你对我们中的哪一个感兴趣？还是另有其人，或者说，是其他"时候"的人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You might be surprised. We Orokin were notorious for multiple partners, yes, but it was merely for the physical affection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你或许会感到惊讶。我们奥罗金人的确以拥有多个伴侣而臭名昭著，但这仅仅是为了满足肉体上的欲望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you love them? And is it mutual?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你爱他吗？他也爱你吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is just simply another way of being, for those who experience life in such a fashion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对于那些以这种方式体验生活的人来说，这只是另一种存在方式而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What? Why?! Do you really have so little respect for yourself? Or do you have a penchant for collecting sad, miserable things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？为什么？！你真的这么不尊重自己吗？还是你喜欢收集那些令人悲伤、凄凉的东西？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why am I not surprised? With that thing... bobbing in your field of view all the time, it is hardly any wonder. A miracle anyone around here gets any work done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一点也不惊讶。那玩意儿……整天在你眼前晃来晃去，难怪。这儿的人居然还能干活，简直是个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fair enough. But that is neither a "no" nor a "yes" so I shall leave this box neither checked nor stricken out, but circled.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。但这既不是"否"也不是"是"，所以我将这个方框既不勾选也不划掉，而是圈起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wrap your mind around that and you might understand why few wished to linger at my side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 仔细想想，你或许就能明白为什么很少有人愿意留在我身边了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah. But we have wandered far off topic. A conversation for another day. I must go for now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唉。我们好像跑题太远了。改天再聊吧。我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How sad is that? I know. No, I have not been. Never mutually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很可悲对吗？我知道。不，我没有过这样的恋爱。从来没有过双向的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Has it ever been a one-sided affair? Oh, most certainly. But that is not a romance, is it? That is a tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这段感情曾经是不是单方面的付出？哦，当然。但这并非浪漫爱情，对吗？那是一场悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A bridge we will cross when we come to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 到时候再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那种痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When one lives for as long as we do, one comes to understand that some hearts can hold affection for many more than one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 活得久了，就会明白有些人的心可以同时爱上不止一个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am simply stating that if you were to have feelings in your heart for more than one individual at a time, that I would not fault you for it, that is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说，如果你同时对不止一个人有好感，我不会因此责怪你，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He is handsome enough, I suppose. But he looks as though if a flower wilts he might declare it is the end of it all and throw himself from the nearest tower.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得他是挺帅的，但看起来好像只要一朵花凋谢，他就会觉得是世界末日来了，然后从最近的塔楼跳下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, I wish you all the best of luck. I couldn't stand her self-righteous and never-ceasing piety. Then again, she views me as nothing but a reprobate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，祝你好运。我实在受不了她那自以为是、没完没了的虔诚。不过话说回来，她也把我当成一个无赖。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, isn't this just utterly delicious...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，真让人开心呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: An intriguing response.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一个耐人寻味的回答。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You think me a devil now? My reputation has only improved in this far-flung future, my Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你只是现在觉得我是恶魔？我的篡位者啊，在遥远的未来，我这名声只会越来越响亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Either way, I win.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论怎样，我都能得到好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The agony.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那种折磨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is just simply another way of being, for those who experience life in such a fashion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对于那些以这种方式体验生活的人来说，这只是另一种存在方式而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Just an idle fancy, then? Ah, what it means to be alive. Enjoy it while you can, I say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只是一时的幻想吗？啊，活着真好。我说，趁现在还能享受，就好好享受吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Follow where your heart may lead you, Drifter. If there is one thing I might regret in all my years, I believe it is the fact that I never shared it with another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，随心所欲吧。如果说我这辈子有什么遗憾的话，我想那就是我从未与人分享过这份爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was not prying for the sake of simple gossip, I merely wished to give you a piece of advice. (Though I do adore me some gossip, mind.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我并非为了八卦而打探你的隐私，只是想给你一些建议。（不过说实话，我确实很喜欢八卦。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But! Suit yourself. Let me know if I can be of any assistance. I am deeply entertained by the notion of watching you and the zealot embroil yourself in all sorts of needless emotional entanglements.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过！你喜欢就好。如果我能帮上什么忙，尽管告诉我。我非常乐于看到你和那个狂热分子陷入各种毫无必要的感情纠葛中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And not in the endearing way, either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而且​用​的方式​还​不​是​那​种​讨人​喜欢​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How lovely to know that all sense of good taste and class has not fled this system after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很高兴看到，良好的品味和格调并没有完全从这个星系中消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wrap your mind around that and you might understand why few wished to linger at my side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 仔细想想，你或许就能明白为什么很少有人愿意留在我身边了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In the meanwhile, I am flattered by the compliment, intrigued by the prospect, and look forward to the continued... hunt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 与此同时，我对这份赞美感到受宠若惊，对前景感到好奇，并期待着继续……追寻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Horrors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那种可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fair enough. I merely wished to give you a piece of advice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我只是想给你个建议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was not prying for the sake of simple gossip, I merely wished to give you a piece of advice. (Though I do adore me some gossip, mind.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我并非为了八卦而打探你的隐私，只是想给你一些建议。（不过说实话，我确实很喜欢八卦。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose I would only have one piece of advice for you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​想​我​只​能​给​你​一​个​建议。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are welcome. "I guess."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。"也许吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, now that we know which target you have aimed your bow at, that gives us something to work toward, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然我们知道你用弓箭瞄准了哪个目标，那我们就有了努力的方向，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Horrors, I say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我说的，就是可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Suit yourself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 随你便。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't mention it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不客气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never mutually.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有过两情相悦的恋爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Probably wise. Mundane, but wise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许是明智的想法。平凡却明智。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course! Best case, you distract one of them from their seemingly intractable goal of harassing me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！最好的结果是，你可以分散他们其中一个人的注意力，让他不再以骚扰我为目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Has it ever been a one-sided affair? Oh, most certainly. But that is not a romance, is it? That is a tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这段感情曾经是不是单方面的付出？哦，当然。但这并非浪漫爱情，对吗？那是一场悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose I will just have to sit back and watch it all fall apart on its own. Or, you succeed and one of them becomes too distracted from their seemingly intractable cause of harassing me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我只能坐等事情自己黄了。或者，你成功了，他们中的一个会因此分心，​不​再​以​骚扰​我​为​目标。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Worst case, it all ends terribly and I am provided with hours of free entertainment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 最坏的情况是，一切都以糟糕的方式结束，但我却能获得几个小时的免费娱乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think you are the first person I have ever come across who wants to "dance with the devil of Tau?" Hardly. It simply remains to be seen how genuine your interest is, or if it is merely over after you spend a night or two scratching your itch.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你以为你是第一个想"与 Tau 之恶魔共舞"的人吗？当然不是。关键在于你的兴趣究竟是真心的，还是仅仅在满足了一两晚的欲望之后就销声匿迹了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You think me a devil now? My reputation has only improved in this far-flung future, my Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你只是现在觉得我是恶魔？我的篡位者啊，在遥远的未来，我这名声只会越来越响亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A bridge we will cross when we come to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 到时候再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Wrap your mind around that and you might understand why few wished to linger at my side.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 仔细想想，你或许就能明白为什么很少有人愿意留在我身边了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Either way, I win.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论怎样，我都能得到好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In the meanwhile, I am flattered by the compliment, intrigued by the prospect, and look forward to the continued... hunt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 与此同时，我对这份赞美感到受宠若惊，对前景感到好奇，并期待着继续……追寻。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How you wound me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你伤透了我的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The pain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如此痛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The agony.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如此折磨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Horrors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如此可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Horrors, I say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我跟你说，可怕至极。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have yet to make any progress in the Descendia in uncovering my memories. If you wish me to hold up my end of the bargain, you should work toward holding up yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你至今仍未在沉沦之地中取得任何进展，未能找回我的记忆。如果你希望我履行承诺，你也应该努力履行你的承诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are flagging in your progress in helping me uncover my memories. If you expect to uphold your end of the bargain, I expect you to continue your work in the Descendia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你在帮助我找回记忆方面进展缓慢。如果你想履行约定，我希望你继续在沉沦之地工作。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We are making good progress in overturning these stones in my mind. Albrecht did quite the number on me when he injected that serum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们正在努力寻找我脑海中的东西。阿尔布雷希特给我注射那种血清时，我感觉自己受到了很大的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It pulls at me, day and night. This constant nagging knowledge that not only did I trust you with all my deepest secrets, not only did you betray that trust and took all that away from me and now I cannot remember why...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这种挥之不去的念头，它日夜折磨着我、始终萦绕着我：不仅是我把所有最深的秘密都告诉了你，不只是你背叛了这份信任，抹去了一切，而现在我却想不起为什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, you do not. And it makes no difference to me what you do with your day. I am merely saying that if you want that scrawny little butler to walk up those stairs, you have a job to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，你当然不会。你一天做什么对我来说无关紧要。我只是想说，如果你想让那个瘦弱的小管家走上楼梯，你就得做好自己的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: See that you do. It makes no difference to me what you do with your day. I am merely saying that if you want that scrawny little butler to walk up those stairs, you have a job to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请务必处理。你一天做什么对我来说无关紧要。我只是想说，如果你想让那个瘦弱的小管家走上楼梯，你就得做好自己的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. They are not. What were you expecting from the "Devil of Tau," memories of a sunny afternoon in the park, reclining on a blanket and eating grapes from platter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对，​它们​并不愉快。​你​对​"Ta​u ​之​恶魔"​抱​有​什么​期​待？​是​阳光​明媚​的​午后，​在​公园​里躺​在​毯子​上，​吃​着​盘子​里​的​葡萄​的​美好​回忆​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not know what he took from me until I have it all back. Of course we should keep going! Those memories are mine, Drifter. They make up who I am, who I was. They are they very fabric of my being.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只有我找回一切，我才会知道他从我这里夺走了什么。当然，我们应该继续！漂泊者，那些记忆是我的。它们构成了现在的我，我曾经的模样。它们是我存在的根本。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not only am I starting to forgive you for the act of taking those memories away from me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不仅开始原谅你抹去我那些回忆的行为……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not only have I forgiven you for the act of taking those memories away from me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不仅原谅了你抹去我那些回忆的行为……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you do not care? Then neither do I. I have my own matters to attend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你不在乎？那我也不在乎。我还有自己的事情要处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you do not care? Then neither do I. I have my own matters to attend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你不在乎？那我也不在乎。我还有自己的事情要处理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hear nothing but tales of you overcoming the Narmer. Defeating hordes of Grineer soldiers. Defeating waves of Murmur at every turn. Yet I have managed to confound you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我听闻的尽是你战胜合一众、击败成群的 Grineer 士兵、一路击退低语者的英勇事迹。我的事竟然能让你束手无策？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My poor Usurper, I fear what we are going to find buried in the annals of my mind will be only blood, gore, and failure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可怜的篡位者，我担心我们在我记忆深处发现的，只有鲜血、残暴和失败。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: From what I have gleaned from the others regarding your time in Duviri, you were once similarly afflicted, were you not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从其他人的描述中，我了解到你在双衍王境期间也曾有过类似的困扰，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I am starting to find myself wishing to trust you again. Again! Knowing full well what you have done. Knowing you are liable to simply betray me once more!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而且我发现自己又想信任你了。再一次！明明知道你都做了些什么。明明知道你很可能会再次背叛我！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I find myself sitting in that crypt and I stand from that chair and I think to myself "I wonder if Drifter is about and if they wish to speak."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我发现自己坐在那间墓穴里，我从椅子上站起来，心想："不知道漂泊者是否在附近，他是否愿意谈谈。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Assuming that you are not lying to me? I admit that is rather flattering. Adorable. Extremely sad. But flattering.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 假设你没骗我？我承认这真是让我受宠若惊。可爱。极其悲哀。但确实让我受宠若惊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not know what he took from me until I have it all back. Of course we should keep going! Those memories are mine, Drifter. They make up who I am, who I was. They are the very fabric of my being.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只有我找回一切，我才会知道他从我这里夺走了什么。当然，我们应该继续！漂泊者，那些记忆是我的。它们构成了现在的我，我曾经的模样。它们是我存在的根本。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That may be, but it was hardly the point I was making. Which you are avoiding having to concede. Very well. If, in theory, you had lost memories - would you seek to regain them if you could?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是这样，但这并非我想表达的重点。而你却在回避承认这一点。好吧。假设你真的失去了记忆——如果可以的话，你会想方设法找回它们吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you had the opportunity to regain your lost memories, would you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果给你一次机会找回失去的记忆，你会去找吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How utterly pathetic is that? How low have I been brought? Me?! An Orokin?! Roathe! The Devil of Tau! So restless, so intellectually starved, so desperate for any kind of stimulation that I am here, speaking with you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这真是太可悲了！我竟然沦落到如此地步？我？！一个奥罗金人？！罗瑟！Tau 之恶魔！我如此躁动不安，如此想知道，如此渴望任何形式的刺激，以至于我才会在这里，与你交谈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well said, Drifter. I will not know the magnitude of what was taken from me until I have it all back. Those memories make up who I am, who I was. They are the very fabric of my being.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，说得好。只有找回一切，我才能真正体会到失去的一切有多么珍贵。那些记忆构成了现在的我，塑造了过去的我。它们是我生命中不可分割的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Prepared, precisely, how? Do you believe I will collapse like some feeble house of cards once I learn the terrible truth of some grotesque war crime?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 准备？​确切​来​说，​怎么​准备？​你​以​为​我​一旦​得​知​某些​骇人​听闻​的​战争​罪行​的​真相，​就​会​像​摇摇​欲坠​的​纸牌​屋​一样​轰然​倒塌​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are we not then doomed to repeat our previous mistakes? Never learning, never evolving, forever living in blissful ignorance of our former selves?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，我们岂不是注定要重蹈覆辙，永远不吸取教训，永远不进步，永远活在对过去的自己浑然不觉的幸福之中吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps I would, if I did not know you had muddled about in my skull with a fork.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我不知道你曾用叉子在我脑子里乱捣鼓，或许我会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps you should. You were the one who muddled about in my skull with a fork, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许你应该这么做。毕竟，是你拿着叉子在我脑子里乱捣鼓的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then I am so terribly glad I was not rendered unto a drooling idiot when you muddled about in my skull with a fork.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，我真是太庆幸了，当你用叉子在我脑袋里乱捣乱的时候，我没有变成一个流着口水的白痴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Believe me, I can imagine every possible thing I could have done to the Sentients, Orokin, or any combination thereof and there is little that would render me shocked or horrified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我，我可以想象我对 Sentient、对奥罗金，或对两者所能做的一切事情，没什么能让我感到震惊或恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. I may have just made a case against my own argument for most people, I realize.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我意识到，我刚才可能反而反驳了自己的论点，这对大多数人来说可能并不成立。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hear, hear! I will hardly collapse like some feeble house of cards once I learn the terrible truth of some grotesque war crime.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说得对！我绝不会因为得​知​某些​骇人​听闻​的​战争​罪行​的​真相，​就​会​像​摇摇​欲坠​的​纸牌​屋​一样​轰然​倒塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I said I forgave you. And I am attempting to adhere to that which I promised you. It is simply that words do not sometimes make a thing true. And saying one forgives someone is very nice in theory but sometimes emotions have a hard time following fact.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我说过我原谅你了。我也在努力遵守我对你的承诺。只是有时候言语并不能代表一切。说原谅一个人在理论上很美好，但有时情感上很难做到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really, this is all quite irritating. I want to converse with you. But I also want to throttle you for having befouled my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是太烦人了。我想和你谈谈，但同时又想掐死你，因为你玷污了我的思想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can remember enough to know that I could ask for "forgiveness" at the altar of the Luminaries for the next two thousand years and have it never granted.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我记得的一切足以让我确信，就算我在接下来的两千年里向双耀神祈求"宽恕"，也永远不会被宽恕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would prefer to learn all the facts myself and judge the situation from there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我更倾向于自己了解所有事实，然后根据事实做出判断。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I can imagine every possible thing I could have done to the Sentients, Orokin, or any combination thereof and there is little that would render me shocked or horrified.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以想象我对 Sentient、对奥罗金，或对两者所能做的一切事情，没什么能让我感到震惊或恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, what is waiting for me at the bottom of my mind does not scare me. I merely wish to reclaim that which was wrongfully taken from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我内心深处等待着我的并不会让我感到恐惧。我只想拿回那些被不公正地夺走的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, what is waiting for me at the bottom of my mind does not scare me. I merely wish to reclaim that which was wrongfully taken from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以我内心深处等待着我的并不会让我感到恐惧。我只想拿回那些被不公正地夺走的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am trying my damnable and level best, Usurper. For there is something about you that has captured my attention. You are fascinating. And that is a rare thing in my world.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我已经尽力了，因为你身上有某种特质深深吸引了我。你魅力非凡，这在我的世界里实属罕见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mmhm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯哼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you said. It is time for us to retake that which is mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如​你​所​说，​是​时候​夺​回属于​我​的​记忆​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So be patient with me, if you can, while I try to reconcile all this.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，如果可以的话，请耐心等待，让我努力理清这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I appreciate the concern, nonetheless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我仍然感谢你的关心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How kind of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That recognition is appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这份认可令人感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Can you answer a question for me, Usurper? It has been troubling me for some time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，你能回答我一个问题吗？这个问题困扰我很久了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I could rattle off the list, but I fear we would be here all afternoon. No, my line of questioning in this regard is over one particular topic specifically. Today, at least.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可以一股脑儿地把所有问题都列出来，但这样的话我担心我们会在这儿待一下午。不，我今天的问题只针对一个特定主题。至少今天是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why are you doing all this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为什么要做这一切？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I am not speaking about you meddling with my memories. I mean "all this" in a broader sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我说的不是你篡改我的记忆，我指的是更广义上的"这一切"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You seem to be set upon running about this universe behind Albrecht with a mop bucket. Look at your work with his butler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你似乎铁了心要跟在阿尔布雷希特后面，拎着拖把桶到处跑。看看你跟他管家干的那些事儿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You seem to be set upon running about this universe behind Albrecht with a mop bucket.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你似乎铁了心要跟在阿尔布雷希特后面，拎着拖把桶到处跑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It just strikes me as odd that someone so... wondrously and wildly malapert would be so otherwise obedient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 只是让我觉得奇怪的是，一个平时如此……古怪又疯狂的人，竟然会在其他方面如此服从。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It does seem that you have your own itches to scratch in the meanwhile - and I applaud you for it, I am hardly judging you. It just strikes me as odd that someone so... wondrously and wildly malapert would be so otherwise obedient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看起来你这段时间也有自己的事情要忙——我对此表示赞赏，我绝无评判的意思。只是让我觉得奇怪的是，一个平时如此……无礼又无耻的人，竟然会在其他方面如此服从。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, I see. Simply a temporary service you are providing until the situation with "the Indifference" is dealt with. And what do you plan to do then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，我明白了。这只是你提供的临时服务，直到"虚空无情之物"问题得到解决为止。那么之后你打算怎么做呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Truly? It seems that from where I sit. He snaps his fingers and you heel and sit at his ankles like a trained kubrow. He even whispers the name "Tau" and you lot scramble to recall every possible detail of the place that you have lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的吗？从我的角度来看，似乎确实如此。他打了个响指，你便像训练有素的库狛一样，乖乖地跪坐在他的脚踝旁。他甚至低声念出"Tau"这个名字，你们便开始拼命回忆失去的那个地方的每一个记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So mysterious, so inscrutable! And such a load of drover shit. If you do not simply wish to admit the fact that you are at his beck and call, so be it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是神秘，难以捉摸！还是一派胡言。如果你不愿意承认自己对他言听计从，那就随你便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because from where I sit, it seems he snaps his fingers and you heel and sit at his ankles like a trained kubrow. He even whispers the name "Tau" and you lot scramble to recall every possible detail of the place that you have lost.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为在我看来，他只要打了个响指，你便像训练有素的库狛一样，乖乖地跪坐在他的脚踝旁。他甚至低声念出"Tau"这个名字，你们便开始拼命回忆失去的那个地方的每一个记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah! So you admit you are an idiot! How refreshing. I adore when fools place their lack of wit right out in the open, it makes my task of manipulating them all the easier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊！你居然承认自己是白痴！真是耳目一新。我最喜欢看傻瓜们毫不掩饰自己的愚蠢，这样我操纵他们就容易多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah! So it is base, primal revenge you are after! Glorious. A rabid animal, ready to gnaw at the bones of those who have wronged you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊！原来你追求的是卑劣、原始的复仇！太棒了。你就像一头狂暴的野兽，准备啃噬那些伤害过你的人的骨头。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, I see. Listlessness masked with nobility. You do not know where you belong, where you should stay, so you cloak yourself in this veneer of "righteousness sacrifice" and do the bidding of others?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，我明白了。虚伪的冷漠披着高贵的外衣。你不知道自己属于哪里，应该留在哪里，所以才用这层"正义的牺牲"来伪装自己，听命于人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because I cannot for the life of me fathom why you, an entity that has, as near as I can figure, come from another version of reality entirely, are set upon running amok through time and space, "Playing Therapist."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为​我​无论​如何​也​无法​理解，​你，​一​个​据​我​所​知来自​完全​另​一​个​现实​版本​的​实体，​为什么​执意​要​在​时间​和​空间​中​横​冲​直​撞，​"扮演心理​治疗师"。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, which gets to the meat of it! Why do you insist on wandering about time and space "Playing Therapist?" You, who are an entity that has, near as I can figure, come from another version of reality entirely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，这才是问题的关键！你为什么非要游荡在时空之中"扮演心理治疗师"呢？据我推测，你来自完全不同的现实版本。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Astute. Yes, very well, I will get to the heart of what I am asking more directly. I was attempting to goad you into anger to see if it would prompt a more honest response.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 精明。好的，我会更直接地切入正题。我之前故意激怒你，只是想看看你能不能说出更诚实的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are like a kubrow who has finally caught a kaithe. You do not know what to do now you have your teeth in its leg.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你就像一只终于抓到绝灵骥的库狛，现在你的牙齿咬住了它的腿，却不知道该怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: One of the simplest and oldest of all human motivations. And, therefore, one of the easiest to understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是人类最简单、最古老的动机之一，因此也是最容易理解的动机之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Never officially a soldier, yet in your tone I hear the weariness of the most battle-hardened of them all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然你从未正式当过兵，但从你的语气中，我听出了身经百战的老兵的疲惫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How utterly tragic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是太可悲了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I were you, I would be back in Duviri attempting to discover what other holes in the fabric of the Void I could punch through! Imagine the possibilities! Imagine the worlds, ripe for the taking!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我是你，我会回到双衍王境，尝试探索虚空结构中还有哪些漏洞可以突破！想想那该有多大的可能性！想想那些唾手可得的世界！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I suppose this will have to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但​我​想，​这样​也​够​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. From one to another, out of respect, I will get to the heart of what I am asking more directly. I was attempting to goad you into anger to see if it would prompt a more honest response.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。出于尊重，我会更直接地切入正题。我之前故意激怒你，只是想看看你能不能说出更诚实的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do tell! Is it this Höllvania? Or perhaps Duviri? Or perhaps your crashed Orbiter on what remains of Earth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那就告诉我！是这个霍瓦尼亚吗？还是双衍王境？又或者是你坠毁在地球残骸上的轨道飞行器？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then tell me all about where your home is! Is it this Höllvania? Or perhaps Duviri? Or perhaps your crashed Orbiter on what remains of Earth?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那就告诉我你的家乡在哪里吧！是这个霍瓦尼亚吗？还是双衍王境？又或者是你坠毁在地球残骸上的轨道飞行器？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And why shouldn't we? We are the superior creations, are we not? Albrecht is doing as he likes, and you have no problem going around cleaning up after him! Why shouldn't I have the right to do the same? What makes his quest "justified" and mine not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们为什么不应该这样做？我们才是更高级的造物，不是吗？阿尔布雷希特随心所欲，你也乐意替他收拾残局！我为什么就没有权利这样做？怎么他追求的就是"正义"，而我的就不是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And why shouldn't we? We are the superior creations, are we not? Albrecht is doing as he likes, rampaging through time, infecting mass populi with a disease he barely understands, all in the name of "defeating a so-called god."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们为什么不应该这样做呢？我们才是更高级的造物，不是吗？阿尔布雷希特随心所欲，在时间长河中横冲直撞，用一种他几乎不了解的疾病感染大众，这一切都是为了"打败一个所谓的神"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot for the life of me fathom why you, an entity that has, as near as I can figure, come from another version of reality entirely, are set upon running amok through time and space, "Playing Therapist."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: ​我​无论​如何​也​无法​理解，​你，​一​个​据​我​所​知来自​完全​另​一​个​现实​版本​的​实体，​为什么​执意​要​在​时间​和​空间​中​横​冲​直​撞，​"扮演心理​治疗师"。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But look at you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但看看你！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You, who have powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有我从未听说过其他生物拥有的力量？循环时间，创造口袋维度。然而你却在这里……修复人际关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You, who have powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships. (And collecting a few of your own.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有我从未听说过其他生物拥有的力量？循环时间，创造口袋维度。然而你却在这里……修复人际关系（同时也收获了一些属于你的关系）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You, who have powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有我从未听说过其他生物拥有的力量？循环时间，创造口袋维度。然而你却在这里……修复人际关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You, who have powers that I have never heard of being possessed by another being? Looping time itself. Creating pocket dimensions. Yet you are here... mending relationships. (And collecting a few of your own.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有我从未听说过其他生物拥有的力量？循环时间，创造口袋维度。然而你却在这里……修复人际关系（同时也收获了一些属于你的关系）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am simply flabbergasted. I cannot comprehend it. Why? Why, when by all rights you could be ruling some universe somewhere?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我着实震惊。我无法理解。为什么？为什么？你明明完全可以统治某个宇宙啊！
