/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am simply flabbergasted. I cannot comprehend it. Why? Why, when by all rights you could be ruling some universe somewhere?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我着实震惊。我无法理解。为什么？为什么？你明明完全可以统治某个宇宙啊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But why? That is what I do not understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但为什么呢？我不明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you would rather be... what? Small?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你甘心……这样？渺小？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But why? That is what I do not understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但为什么呢？我不明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you would rather be... what? Small?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你甘心……这样？渺小？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is precisely my point! Let us go and rewrite history, then! Not sit about here trying to convince everyone to hold hands and sing songs!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这正是我要说的！那就让我们去改写历史吧！而不是坐在这里试图说服大家手拉手唱歌！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, I see, you prefer to be the quiet assassin in the shadows is it? Strike when you are least suspected? No. I do not think so. I think you are simply spinning your wheels.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，我明白了，你喜欢做潜伏在暗处的安静刺客，是吗？在最不引人怀疑的时候出手？不，我不这么认为。我觉得你只是在白费力气。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mmhm. Running errands for strangers until they worship you like some local hero? Or convincing them all to hold hands and sing songs? Pardon me while I go retch into Fibonacci's tank.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯哼。替陌生人跑腿直到他们把你当成当地英雄一样崇拜？还是说服他们手拉手唱歌？恕我先去斐波那契的鱼缸里吐一吐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what you are "doing" seems to be running about convincing everyone to hold hands and sing songs in between bouts of incredible shows of violence. The violence makes sense. The rest is nauseating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而你"做"的似乎是到处游说大家手拉手唱歌，同时穿插着令人瞠目结舌的暴力表演。暴力本身还说得通，但其他的一切都令人作呕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you are going to insist that we are going to save the universe from this "Indifference" by holding hands and singing songs pardon me while I go retch into Fibonacci's tank.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你坚持认为我们要通过手拉手唱歌来从"虚空无情之物"手中将宇宙救出来，那恕我直言，我要去斐波那契的鱼缸里吐一吐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know not what you do or why you do it, you are simply doing what you are told. Another self-important henchmen of a self-important Orokin. Shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不知道自己在做什么，也不知道为什么这么做，你只是奉命行事。又一个自以为是的奥罗金人的爪牙。真丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, I have not. And if you are going to insist that we are going to save the universe from this "Indifference" by holding hands and singing songs pardon me while I go retch into Fibonacci's tank.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我没有。如果你坚持认为我们要通过手拉手唱歌来从"虚空无情之物"手中将宇宙救出来，那恕我直言，我要去斐波那契的鱼缸里吐一吐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fine. Fine! I will bide my time, as you say. Play these... foolish games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好，好！我会按你说的，耐心等待时机。玩这些……愚蠢的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because misery loves company? Perhaps. Or, because I am simply confused that you are running about wasting your time when there is real work that we could be doing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为同病相怜？或许吧。又或许，我只是不明白，明明有真正的事情要做，你却在这里浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: More proof that this thing is a figment of your imagination! What kind of real god or "anti-god" would ever be defeated by the "kindness of human emotions!" Ha!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这更加证明了这东西是你凭空想象出来的！什么样的真神或"反神"会被"人类情感的善良"打败呢！哈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose we still have work to do, as you say. I simply cannot fathom such... childish things have purpose to them. But, then again, here I sit on this end of things, and you are the one with keys to the universe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我们还有很多事要做，正如你所说。我实在无法理解这种……幼稚的事情竟然有意义。不过话说回来，我只是局外人，而你才是掌握宇宙钥匙的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fair point. Why would you ever pick someone so detestable as the Devil of Tau?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说得有道理。你又怎么会选择像 Tau 之恶魔那样令人憎恶的人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But now I am convinced you know not what you do or why you do it, and that you are simply doing what you are told. Another self-important henchmen of a self-important Orokin. Shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但现在我确信你不知道自己在做什么，也不知道为什么这么做，你只是奉命行事。又一个自以为是的奥罗金人的爪牙。真丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Stop speaking about subjects of which you know absolutely nothing, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，别对你一无所知的事情妄加评论。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Until then I shall merely go back to annoying the floating botfly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在此之前，我只能继续去烦那只漂浮的牛虻了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really the more you tell me about these insane theories of yours the more you convince me that I am right. You all have built a strawman of your own insanity and this thing is just feeding off your own insecurities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你越是跟我讲你那些荒谬的理论，我就越觉得我是对的。你们都用自己的疯狂臆造了一个稻草人，而这个稻草人不过是在利用你们自身的不安全感罢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you all simply shut your eyes long enough and ignored it, I guarantee it would go away on its own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你们都闭上眼睛足够长的时间，不去理会它，我保证它会自行消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It at least passes the time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少可以打发点时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht was always a problem from the very beginning. Him and all this business with the Void. I think he was given Gerivaine in hopes having a family might simply settle him down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特从一开始就是个麻烦。他还有他跟虚空的一切纠葛。我觉得把格丽维娜给他，是希望有个家庭能让他安定下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think instead it simply made things worse. Once he had children he viewed them as an extra set of hands. Accomplices in his mad experiments.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这反而让事情变得更糟。有了孩子之后，他就把他们当成额外的帮手，他疯狂实验的帮凶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Expendable. Like all things in his life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可有可无。就像他生命中的所有事情一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well, I will concede that he will murder anyone and anything in his life with the coldness of any Executor. But he will not do it without purpose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，我承认他会像任何执行者一样冷酷无情地杀害他生命中的任何人和物。但他不会无缘无故地这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A name that may have been lost to the annals of time... Albrecht Entrati's wife, Usurper. The mother of his children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一个可能已被历史遗忘的名字……阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的妻子，篡位者。他孩子们的母亲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know, now that I reflect on it, it was his dispassionate nature that made him so deeply dangerous in our time. He was capable of sacrificing anything in the name of seeing his goals met. Anything at all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道吗，现在我回想起来，正是他冷酷无情的本性让他在我们这个时代是如此的危险。以实现自己的目标为名义，他可以牺牲一切。什么都可以。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there you go, likely playing me for the fool again - as odds are quite high that you already knew this information, now that the butler is reconnected with them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你又来了，很可能又把我当傻子耍了——因为管家现在已经和他们重新联系上了，你很可能已经知道这些信息了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The ones who sit so blissfully unawares of our existence down in this mouldering Sanctum. Which I still find so utterly priceless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们安然无恙地坐在这破败圣所深处，还有那些对我们的存在浑然不知的人们。我至今仍觉得这非常可笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are very eager to assume much about which you know nothing, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂流者，你对自己一无所知的事情，总是急于猜测。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I will not get into yet another argument about this with you. I am not in the mood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我不想再和你争论这个了。我没心情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or does your skin have a blue twinge that I missed? Were you an Orokin? If so, I extend my deepest and most sincere apologies!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者你的皮肤上是不是有我没注意到的蓝色痕迹？你是奥罗金人吗？如果是的话，我致以最深切和最诚挚的歉意！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It might be a common misconception that all we Orokin did was backstab and murder each other. There was plenty of that, don't misunderstand me. We were nigh immortal, we had little else to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 人们或许普遍误解我们奥罗金人只会互相背叛和残杀。没错，这种事确实不少，别误会我的意思。我们几乎是不死的，除此之外也没什么事可做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But we were also a deeply passionate people. No one made art in the way that the Orokin did. No one composed music, or theatre, or poetry, the likes that we composed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我们也是一个深深充满激情的民族。没有人像奥罗金人那样创作艺术。没有人像我们那样创作音乐、戏剧或诗歌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Apology accepted. This time. I deal with this kind of disrespect enough from everyone else around here. As fascinating as you are, I am not everyone's pincushion. I have better ways to spend my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 道歉我接受了。这就这一次。我​受够​了​这里​所有​人​的​这​种​不尊重。​就​算​你​很​迷人，​我​也​不​是​你们​的​活靶子。​我​有​更​好​的​方式​过​生活。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And no one loved as deeply as we did, when our hearts fell for another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当我们的心爱上另一个人时，没有人比我们爱得更深。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Where was I? Ah yes. Our impassive Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我刚才说到哪里了？啊，对。我们那冷漠的英择谛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A warning. I deal with this kind of disrespect enough from everyone else around here. As fascinating as you are, I am not everyone's pincushion. I have better ways to spend my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 警告你。我受够了这里所有人的这种不尊重。就算你很迷人，我也不是你们的活靶子。我有更好的方式过生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All save Albrecht. Everything he did, everyone he interacted with, it was as though he viewed it through a section of his beloved seriglass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 除了阿尔布雷希特。他所做的每一件事，和他互动的每一个人，都像是他透过自己心爱的玻璃窗的一部分来观察的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Removed. Detached. Uninterested. Unimpacted. Even when Gerivaine died and he was left to raise his little welp of a daughter on his own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 疏离。冷漠。漠不关心。无动于衷。即使在格丽维娜去世时，留下他独自抚养他那可怜的小女儿，他也依旧如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who, by rights, was likely destined to accomplish more than he ever did. I cannot wait to see what's become of her and the rest of the Entrati ilk. In all their... Infested glory.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 按理说，她很可能预期要取得比他以往任何时候都要多的成就。我迫不及待地想看看她和英择谛家族最终的下场。看看他们所有的…… Infested 辉煌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who, by rights, was likely destined to accomplish more than he ever did. If she didn't wind up infested and rooted to the spot. What a waste.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 按理说，她很可能预期要取得比他以往任何时候都要多的成就。如果她没被感染，也可以离开的话。太可惜了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, very likely not. I was curious, do you happen to have Albrecht's forwarding address?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，很可能不是。我很好奇，你恰好有阿尔布雷希特的转寄地址吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have not yet decided. Perhaps I will start lopping off their limbs and preserving them in liquid. You wouldn't happen to have Albrecht's forwarding address, would you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我还没想好。或许我会开始砍掉他们的四肢，然后把它们泡在液体里保存起来。你不会刚好有阿尔布雷希特的转寄地址吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you say. And yet I stand there like a fool, guarding them, listening to them talk on the subject of the reunion as though I remember it happening. Do you know how awkward that is?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说得轻松。而我却像个傻瓜一样站在那里，守着他们，听他们谈论重聚的话题，就好像我记得那件事发生似的。你知道这有多尴尬吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know how awkward it is, having to stand there and pretend that I remember the reunion happening?! When I cannot for the life of me recall it?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道有多尴尬吗？我明明什么都想不起来，却还要站在那里假装记得团聚发生过？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is like standing at a gala when someone comes up to you and clearly knows who you are, yet you have no recollection of them in the slightest, but are forced to continue the conversation as if you do!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这就像你站在一个盛大的晚会现场，有人朝你走过来，清楚地知道你是谁，可你对这个人一点印象都没有，却不得不装作记得，而且还要继续交谈！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was thinking once I was upstairs, I would start lopping off his family's limbs and start mailing them to him in jars, one at a time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我当时想，等我上了楼，我就要开始砍掉他家人的四肢，然后把它们装进很多罐子里，一个接一个地寄给阿尔布雷希特。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you have even the slightest recognition of the kind of hell you have placed me in?! Any at all?! It is misery standing up there like that, and it is all your fault!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你就一点都不知道你让我陷入了怎样的地狱般的境地吗？！哪怕一丝一毫？！站在那儿简直是煎熬，而这一切都是你的错！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Calm yourself! Can no one around here take a joke?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你冷静点！这里没人开得了玩笑吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah, enough of this. I need a drink.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唉，够了。我得喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who would mail them for me, at any rate?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论如何，哪来的人帮我寄出去呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To avoid as little misunderstanding as possible in this situation, I will avoid my usual verbosity and simply say this:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为了尽可能避免误解，我将避免冗长的叙述，简单来说：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm? Well, I find them some of the most unequivocally sad and pathetic creations I have ever met in all of the Void-damned Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？好吧，我觉得他们是我在整个天杀的始源星系中见过的最悲惨、最可怜的造物之一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lab animals. Lab animals, Albrecht! You threw animals into the damn Void and then when they came out yabbering in your made-up children's language you told your butler to euthanize them?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 实验动物。阿尔布雷希特，实验动物！你把动物扔进天杀的虚空，然后当他们出来用你编造的儿童语言叽叽喳喳的时候，你竟然让你的管家对它们实施安乐死？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Always leaving everyone else to do his dirty work. But I digress. You are asking me about why I sit and talk to them. Especially the bird. It is simple. But I think I would like you to guess. I want to see if you can work it out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 总是把脏活累活都留给别人干。不过，我扯远了。你问我为什么坐下来和他们说话，尤其是那只鸟。原因很简单。但我想让你猜猜看。我想看看你能不能猜出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. In a way, that is precisely it. He does not know who I am. He knows nothing of the "Devil of Tau." And he... moreover, does not care.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错。某种程度上来说，正是如此。他不知道我是谁。他对"Tau 之恶魔"一无所知。而且他……也毫不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He does. He is quite charming in his gormless innocence. But what you are saying, in a slightly kinder and more round-about way, is that no one else could love me, is that it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实如此。他那傻乎乎的天真劲儿挺讨人喜欢的。但你这是在换个更委婉、更绕口的方式说，除了他，没人会爱我，是这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you understood how misguided you are. How very far from the mark your arrow flies... but you are not alone in your opinion of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望你能明白你错得有多离谱，你的箭射得离目标有多偏……但你并非唯一一个这样看待我的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He does. And his observations are quite useful, but nothing I could not have reached myself within a few moments of my own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实如此。他的观察很有价值，但这些观点我自己也能在几分钟内得出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you understood how misguided you are. How very far from the mark your arrow flies... but you are not alone in your opinion of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望你能明白你错得有多离谱，你的箭射得离目标有多偏……但你并非唯一一个这样看待我的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So I must rely on the idiotic bird for company? But you are close enough to the truth I suppose I will give you... a passing grade.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以我只能靠这只笨鸟作伴了？不过你说的也算接近真相了，我想我就给你……及格分吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not alone in the slightest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 绝对不止你一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What you are saying in a slightly kinder and more round-about way is that you believe I am using the large talking bird for my own ends? Is that it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​委婉​一点​的​意思​是，​你​认为​我​利用​那​只​聒噪​大鸟​达到​自己​的​目的？​是​这样​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not alone in the slightest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 绝对不止你一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To him, I am not Roathe. I am not Orokin. I am not a criminal. Or a traitor. Or a coward. I can simply be... myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对​他​来说，​我​不​是​罗瑟，​我​不​是​奥罗金​人，​我​不​是​罪犯，​也​不​是​叛徒，​更​不​是​懦夫。​我​只​是​我​自己。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. But you are not alone in your opinion of me. Not alone in the slightest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我没有。但你并非唯一一个这样看待我的人。真是一点也不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not think I can describe to you what a simple and rare relief it is...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我无法向你描述那种简单而又难得的解脱感……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Were it so simple, and all this were some great façade that I could change out like some masquerade visage! No, Usurper. This is who I am, down to each rotten bone of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果​事情​真​那么​简单​就​好​了，​如果​这​一切​都​只​是​我​可以​像​换面​具​一样，​可以​随意​更换​的​华丽​外衣​就​好​了！​不，​篡位者。​但​这​才​是​真正​的​我，​彻头​彻尾​的​腐朽。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Were it so simple, Usurper. You make it all sound so tempting. Can I? Perhaps... Perhaps it is not to late, even for a sad, tragic devil such as I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，如果真有那么简单就好了。你说的听起来太诱人了。我能吗？或许……或许还不算太晚，即使对我这样一个悲惨的恶魔来说也是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But that is not to say that I do not relish the opportunity to lay it all down for an hour's time and simply enjoy a conversation with someone who is none the wiser to all the terrible crimes I have committed in my day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管如此，能在上一两个小时里，放下我过去的一切，与一个不知我罪行的人交谈……这样的时光，我很珍惜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is exhausting, Usurper. And would that I could set down the persona like some masquerade visage and never pick it up again. But this is who I am, down to each rotten bone of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，这真的很累。我真希望能够像摘掉面具一样，卸下这副伪装，永远不再穿上。但这才是真正的我，彻头彻尾的腐朽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is this nothing but a great façade I wear? Or is it burrowed deep to the rotten bone of me? I do not yet know. All I can say is that I still enjoy the opportunity to lay it all down for an hour's time when I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这难道这只是我精心伪装的面具吗？还是早已深埋在我腐朽的骨子里？我尚不清楚。我只能说，只要有机会，我仍然很享受放下一切、放松身心的时光。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I set the burden aside and sit with someone who is none the wiser to my terrible crimes and talk with the giant charmingly gormless bird and find myself... at peace. For the first time in a long time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我放下心中的重担，与那只巨大而又憨态可掬、不知情的鸟坐在一起交谈，然后发现自己……很平静。是这么久以来的第一次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps there is hope to what you say. Or perhaps I am fooling myself. And it is just a moment's respite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许你说的话是有希望的。又或许我只是在自欺欺人。而这，不过是片刻的喘息而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will admit that it has been. At least what I can recall of it. Would it shock you to know that I have never once been in love? But it is all of my on doing, Usurper. I am not here to garner your sympathy or your pity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我承认确实如此。至少就我现在能记得的。如果我告诉你我从未真正恋爱过，你会不会感到震惊？但是篡位者，这都是我咎由自取。我来这里不是为了博取你的同情或怜悯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It has been. Long and lonely. But it is all of my on doing, Usurper. I am not here to garner your sympathy or your pity.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实​如此。​漫长​而​孤独。​但是​篡位者，​这​都​是​我​咎由​自取。​我​来​这里​并​非为了​博取​你​的​同情​或​怜悯。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will admit that it has been. At least what I can recall of it. Would it shock you to know that I have never once been in love? Not mutually, at any rate. Perhaps it would not. We have likely been through all this before, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我承认确实如此。至少就我现在能记得的。如果我告诉你我从未真正恋爱过，你会不会感到震惊？至少从未有过双向恋爱。也许​这​不​会​让​你​感到​震惊。毕竟，我们可能以前也经历过这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, it has been. Or at least, what I can recall of it. Or is that what you took from me, Usurper? That we were lovers, that I confessed my love to you, and you did not feel the same?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，的确如此。或者至少，我能回忆起的部分是这样。又或者说，篡位者，你曾经抹去过的记忆？我们曾是恋人，我曾向你表白，而你却没有同样的感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who knows? Perhaps I had friends and I simply cannot remember them because Entrati muddled about in my head and took away my recollections of them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁​知道​呢？​说​不定​我​曾经​有​过​朋友，​只是​因为​英择​谛​在​我​搅乱​了​我​的​脑子，​夺走​了​我​对​他们​的​记忆，​所以​我​才​想​不​起​他们​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who knows? Perhaps I had friends and I simply cannot remember them because you and I were friends before you put an end to that, hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁知道呢？说不定我曾经有朋友，只是记不清了。你我曾经是朋友，而你却抹去了这段记忆，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or was it vice versa? You fell madly in love with the Devil Himself, but his heart remained cold to you. Distraught, you did the only thing you could--you tore his mind to shreds!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还是反过来？你疯狂地爱上了恶魔本尊，但他的心却对你冷若冰霜。你痛苦万分，做了你唯一能做的事——把他的记忆撕成碎片！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For all the good that seems to have done me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这似乎并没有给我带来任何好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Whatever poor opinions you have formed of me I deserve. And you are certainly not alone in holding them. Not alone in the slightest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对我产生的任何负面看法都是我咎由自取。而且，你并非唯一一个这样看待我的人。绝对不止你一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder, is that what you took from me, Usurper? That we were lovers, that I confessed my love to you, and you did not feel the same?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​想​知道，​篡位者，​那​是​不​是​你​曾经​抹去​的​记忆？​我们​曾​是​恋人，​我​曾​向​你​表白，​而​你​却​没有​同样​的​感觉？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah. But what is the point in sitting about and waxing poetic?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唉。但坐在这扯这些又有什么意义呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But who am I kidding?! We know why you did it, don't we? And it wasn't for love of me. It wasn't even for love at all. I am simply waxing poetic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我这在骗谁呢？！我们都知道你为什么这么做，不是吗？根本不是因为爱我。根本就不是出于爱。我只是在感慨几句而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But who am I kidding?! We know why you did it, don't we? And it wasn't for love of me. But for love of another. I am simply waxing poetic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我这在骗谁呢？！我们都知道你为什么这么做，不是吗？根本不是因为爱我。而是为了爱别人。我只是在感慨几句而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So tragic, indeed... I almost want the details, but I feel as though that is jumping to the end of the book before we are ready.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是悲哀……我好想知道细节，但我又觉得那样就等于在我们还没准备好之前就跳到书的结尾。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I am not here to garner your sympathy or your pity. All of this is my own doing. Whatever poor opinions you have formed of me I deserve. And you are certainly not alone in holding them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我来这里不是为了博取你们的同情或怜悯。这一切都是我咎由自取。你们对我产生的任何负面看法，都是我咎由自取。而且，但你并非唯一一个这样看待我的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not alone in the slightest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是一点也不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely. What is your point?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错。你想表达什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Hardly! You are extremely patient if you think I have been so casually insulting you to your face for days, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！​才​不​是​！​要​是​你​觉得​我​已经​连续​几​天​当面​如此​随意​地​侮​辱​你，​那​你​真​是​太​有​耐心​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, that is what you are, yes? The Tenno usurped the Origin System from the Orokin. And you, like a little imposter in the nest, have stolen into this world from your own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，你就是这种人，对吧？Tenno 从奥罗金手中夺取了始源星系。而你，就像巢穴里的小冒牌货，从你自己的世界偷偷溜进了这个世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! An insult? You are extremely patient if you think I have been so casually deriding you to your face for days, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！侮辱？​要​是​你​觉得​我​已经​连续​几​天​当面​如此​随意​地​侮​辱​你，​那​你​真​是​太​有​耐心​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And that makes you, on at least two counts, a Usurper by my measure. (And perhaps a third, if we count what the butler has told me of Duviri, but that is a debate for another time.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这样看来，至少从这两点来说，你都是个篡位者。（如果算上管家告诉我的关于双衍王境的那些事，或许还有第三点，但这又是另一个话题了。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because it is exactly that - a title. An honorific. You have accomplished that which I aspired to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为它的确只是一个外号，一个荣誉称号。你已经实现了我一直以来的愿望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly when it is so painfully clear you have so much power in this situation that is hardly unilateral, hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是在这种情况下，你明显拥有巨大的能力，而这种能力几乎并非单方面的，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly when I know you could simply use your Void-given powers to step through a wall and put a few bullets into the back of my head anytime you wished.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是我知道你可以随时利用虚空赋予你的力量穿墙而过，然后朝我的后脑勺开几枪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly when I know you could simply use your Void-given powers to step through a wall and put a few bullets into the back of my head anytime you wished.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是我知道你可以随时利用虚空赋予你的力量穿墙而过，然后朝我的后脑勺开几枪。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly when it is so painfully clear you have so much power in this situation that is hardly unilateral, hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是在这种情况下，你明显拥有巨大的能力，而这种能力几乎并非单方面的，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The title is merely expression of my mild admiration. Even if it is one that is suitably sarcastic to suit my needs, yes, I will give you that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个外号仅仅表达了我淡淡的赞赏。哪怕它带有恰到好处的讽刺意味来满足我的需要。是的，这点我承认。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not in the mood to make an enemy of you, Usurper. No. It is not an insult. It is only through your own lack of due diligence that you have not come to realize the large portion of my past that aligns with yours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我没心情与你为敌。不，这不是侮辱。只是因为你的疏忽大意，才没意识到我的过去与你的经历有很多相似之处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not in the mood to make an enemy of you, Usurper. No. If anything, it is an honorific. You have done that which I aspired to. Nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我没心情与你为敌。不，这充其量只是一种尊称。你已经做到了我一直渴望做的事，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was bent on overthrowing the Orokin, same as your child Tenno duplicate and their ilk. I was simply arrested from the timeline before I had my chance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一心想要推翻奥罗金政权，就像你的那个 Tenno 复制体和他的同伙一样。只是在我有机会推翻之前，就被从时间线中抹去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm...
Ha! I could almost hear the sigh from the Sanctum. Were they all like me? No. They were vastly inferior. And far more infuriating, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！我仿佛在圣所里都能听到叹息。他们都和我一样吗？不。他们远不如我。而且恐怕更令人恼火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm... no. But I do appreciate the show of proper etiquette. You must earn your titles from me, Usurper. You know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯……不会。但我很欣赏你展现出的礼貌。篡位者，你得凭本事从我这儿赢回去称呼。你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. You had no choice in the matter regardless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。无论如何，你对此别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Really, you make this too much fun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真的，你这样让这件事变得更有趣了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Dear me. Is that a real question, or a request?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 天哪。这是个疑问，还是个请求？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pardon me while I take a moment to collect my thoughts before I begin this conversation from a place fueled entirely by rage and spite.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请允许我花点时间整理一下思绪，以免这段对话由愤怒和怨恨驱动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps I am hoping you will wise up and change your mind. And the odds of that goes down dramatically if I have gone about slaughtering everyone in the vicinity, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许我希望你能幡然醒悟，改变主意。如果我把附近所有人都屠杀殆尽，那么成功的几率就会急剧下降，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because there is still the mystery of why I trusted you enough to tell you so very much, only to have you betray that trust, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我至今仍搞不懂，我为何如此信任你，告诉你那么多事，而你却背叛了这份信任，篡位者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I am pleased that you recognize that I have it within my grasp to turn this place into a slaughterhouse quite easily.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴你意识到，我完全有能力轻而易举地把这里变成屠宰场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is still work to be done, Usurper. I cannot very well have your assistance recovering all my memories if I go about murdering everyone in the vicinity, now can I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我还有事情要做。如果我把附近所有人都杀光，你又怎么能帮我恢复所有记忆呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because there is still the mystery of why I trusted you enough to tell you so very much, only to have you betray that trust, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为我至今仍搞不懂，我为何如此信任你，告诉你那么多事，而你却背叛了这份信任，篡位者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As I am trying very hard not to immediately prove your point correct.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我正在努力克制自己，不立刻证明你的观点是正确的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Besides, it would accomplish nothing to do so, now would it? If there is only one thing that you learn from war, it is that murder accomplishes shockingly little in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 此外，这样做也于事无补吧？战争教会我们的一件事就是，杀戮最终带来的收益少得惊人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the odds of that goes down dramatically if I have gone about slaughtering everyone in the vicinity, doesn't it? If there is only one thing that you learn from war, it is that murder accomplishes shockingly little in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我把附近所有人都屠杀殆尽，那么成功的几率就会急剧下降，不是吗？战争教会我们的一件事就是，杀戮最终带来的收益少得惊人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it would accomplish nothing to do so, now would it? If there is only one thing that you learn from war, it is that murder accomplishes shockingly little in the end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这样做也于事无补吧？战争教会我们的一件事就是，杀戮最终带来的收益少得惊人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am sympathetic toward your hatred toward the Orokin. Believe me. Most Orokin despised the Orokin. I am not unaware of our crimes. Of the travesties we committed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我理解你对奥罗金人的憎恨。相信我，大多数奥罗金人都鄙视其余人。我并非不了解我们犯下的罪行，我们犯下的种种暴行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As delightful as it might be to entertain the desire to commit a little of it from time to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管偶尔也会忍不住想去这么干，其实这样做也挺让人愉快的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As delightful as it might be to entertain the desire to commit a little of it from time to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管偶尔也会忍不住想去这么干，其实这样做也挺让人愉快的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Yuvan theatre alone would be reason enough to burn our society to the ground. But you condemn a whole people - of which you were a product, might I add, my Usurper - with one broad stroke!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 单单是青春厅堂这件事就足以让我们的社会彻底毁灭。但你却一概而论，怪罪整个民族——顺便一提，你也是这个民族的产物，我的篡位者！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know nothing of all the kind souls who toiled and died within those golden walls. The sagas written of those lives that have been lost to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对那些曾在金碧辉煌的建筑内辛勤劳作、最终逝去的善良灵魂一无所知。那些关于他们的传奇故事，如今已湮没在历史长河中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am fairly certain if you came down to the crypt and found two bloody smears where the zealots used to stand, I would get quite the earful for it, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我相当肯定，如果你来到墓穴，发现狂热分子曾经站立的地方有两处血迹，我肯定会被狠狠训斥一顿，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you are going to attempt to make some coy insinuation, Usurper, just come out and say it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，如果你想故弄玄虚地暗示什么，那就直接说出来吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would be pointless to kill them. Wouldn't it? Are you attempting to convince me otherwise? Usurper, I am impressed - I never figured you for such a devious monster!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 杀了他们毫无意义，不是吗？你是想说服我改变想法吗？篡位者，我真是佩服你——我万万没想到你居然是这么阴险狡诈的家伙！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The rivers of tears that have been shed for the tragedies that will forever go unsung, simply because they go unknown to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 仅仅因为它们从未为你所知，那些悲剧所流下的泪水汇成了河流，将永远无人传唱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: From you, or the butler, or the Tenno, or the Tenno's terrifying "Mother." Ugh. That one. That one troubles me. A topic for another time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可能是你，也可能是管家，或者是那个Tenno，又或者是 Tenno 那可怕的"母亲"。唉，那个人。那个人让我很烦。以后再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hear your child duplicate weep the name Adis.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我听到你那个孩子一遍遍地哭喊着阿迪斯的名字。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Adis was one of millions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿迪斯只是芸芸众生中的一个。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Their name is unique to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他​的​名字​对​你​来说​是​独特​的。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Joy?" Is that what this is? I never realized I was such a masochist. Hm. Or is it simply the sensation of my body rotting away, and the feeling of you all "growing on me?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "享受？"这就是享受吗？我从未意识到自己竟然如此受虐。嗯。或者，这仅仅是我身体逐渐腐烂的感觉，以及你们所有人"渐渐融入我的生活"的感觉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not press your luck, Usurper. "Enjoyable" is a bit of a stretch. It is more that you are growing on me. Like mould.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，别得寸进尺。"享受"说得有点夸张了。更确切地说，你只是渐渐融入我的生活罢了。就像霉菌一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is somewhat enjoyable to have someone to talk to. Even if you lot are, as you said, grating from time to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有​人​可以​聊天​还是​挺​让​人​享受​的。​即使​你们​有时候​确实像​你​说​的​那样，​挺​让​人​心烦。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Loneliness? Bah. The only thing you stave off is whatever sanity is attempting to return to my life. If you are attempting to imply that you lot are "growing on me" do you know what else does that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孤独？呸。你们唯一阻止的，就是我生活中那一点点正在恢复的理智。如果你想暗示你们这帮人"渐渐融入我的生活"，你知道还有什么也像你们这样的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But not to the stars.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但​对于​星系来​说​不​是。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Like mould.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就像霉菌一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mould.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是霉菌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Paint my kind in crimson all you wish. Melt Orokin gold and call us monsters. We deserve every ounce of vitriol you can spare for us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 随便你，尽管将我们族人染成血红吧。熔化奥罗金黄金，称我们为怪物吧。我们罪有应得，你可以尽情地对我们恶语相向。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will admit you are... growing on me. Like mould.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得承认，你……就像霉菌一样，渐渐融入我的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But do not dare believe for one second that it was all we were capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但千万不要以为我们就只有那点本事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you wish to exterminate all Orokin? Walk up the stairs. You have a few surviving examples who cannot escape your wrath. Start with "Grandmother."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想彻底消灭所有奥罗金人？那就走上楼梯。你会看到一些幸存的奥罗金人，他们逃不出你的魔爪。就从"祖母"开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is another reason why I have not gone on some mad, bloodlust-driven, hideous rampage, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我不去做出那些疯狂、嗜血、骇人听闻的暴行，其实还有另一个原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She has seen the most of our ilk, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 毕竟，她见识过的我们这类人最多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have yet to see the conclusion of the little drama between our dear butler and Albrecht's estranged family upstairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我还没看到我们亲爱的管家和楼上阿尔布雷希特疏远的家人之间的小插曲的结局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have a personal investment in all this, don't forget, whether or not we have an arrangement. I plan to make sure that when Albrecht first steps foot back in this Sanctum, the first face he sees?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别忘了，无论我们是否达成交易，我在这件事上都投入了个人利益。我想要保证当阿尔布雷希特踏入这圣所时，他看到的第一张脸是——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Will be mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply cannot yet make up my mind if I will be surrounded by the corpses of his loved ones or not when he does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是还没决定好，当他死去的时候，我要不要让他亲人的尸体也倒在我周围。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Decisions, decisions...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这可怎么选呢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Riddle me this, Usurper: If it came to it, do you think you could best your Tenno counterpart in a fight to the death?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，请回答我这个问题：如果真的到了生死之战，你觉得你能击败你的另一个自己——Tenno 吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not attempting to be crass. I am being quite serious, you realize. This is a purely pragmatic conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我没有在冒犯你。你应该明白，我是认真的。这只是就事论事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because I am not sure if you have noticed, but "the Lotus" is not only a Sentient - one responsible for putting Lua in the Void I might add -  but she has also quantifiably lost control of her circuitry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为​不​知​你​有​没​有​注意​到，​"Lo​t​us"​不仅​是​ Sentient​——​她​更​是​把​月​球​送入​虚空​的​人​——​而且​她​的​神经线路​也​明显​出现​失控。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't I? Pay attention! Look around! How many months did she spend standing on the edge of a cliff, holding an antiquated pager, humming to herself? Staring off into the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道吗？注意！看看周围！她究竟花了多少岁月站在悬崖边，拿着老式寻呼机，自己哼着歌？凝视着虚空？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How many months did she spend standing on the edge of a cliff, holding an antiquated pager, humming to herself? Staring off into the Void?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她究竟花了多少岁月站在悬崖边，拿着老式寻呼机，自己哼着歌？凝视着虚空？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not unsympathetic. I understand what it is like. You owe her a great deal. I am not telling you to kill her, I am telling you to stop allowing her to influence those around you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我并非冷漠无情。我理解你的感受。你欠她太多了。我不是要你杀了她，我是要你别再让她影响你身边的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish. But when this all comes crashing down around you? Do not come crawling to me for assistance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。但当这一切崩塌的时候，别来找我帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And now she is just... looming? In the darkness? Sending your child self deeper and deeper into their memories, for what? A way home simply because Albrecht snapped his fingers and whispered the magic word?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而现在她只是……在黑暗中潜伏着？将你童年的自我一步步送入记忆深处，为了什么？仅仅因为阿尔布雷希特打了个响指，说了句魔法词，她就能找到回家的路？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not unsympathetic. I understand what it is like. You owe her a great deal. I am not telling you to kill her, I am telling you to stop allowing her to influence those around you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我并非冷漠无情。我理解你的感受。你欠她太多了。我不是要你杀了她，我是要你别再让她影响你身边的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't you find it suspicious? Don't you find it dangerous? It's a trap. She is being manipulated. Either by Albrecht or by this so-called "Indifference." She is a broken program. Her precepts are malfunctioning.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不觉得可疑吗？你不觉得危险吗？这是个陷阱。她被人操纵了。要么是阿尔布雷希特在操纵，要么是这个所谓的"虚空无情之物"在操纵。她就像一个坏掉的程序。她的枢律失灵了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When she was standing there on the edge of the cliff, holding an antiquated pager, humming to herself? Staring off into the Void? Did you not think she might jump?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当她站在悬崖边，拿着老式寻呼机，自己哼着歌，凝视着虚空时，你难道没想过她会跳下去吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not think she means you harm. I think she is merely being used. But when the time comes, you may need to defend yourself. Or you may need to put them down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不认为她有意伤害你，我觉得她只是被人利用了。但一旦时机到了，你或许需要自卫，你或许需要亲手除掉她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And while it is (hopefully) likely that you will see the sense in avoiding some sort of second round of the Lotus becoming problematic, her feral child army will not. So I will ask again:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然你（但愿如此）很可能明白避免 Lotus 再次失控的必要性，但她那群野性未驯的孩子却不会。所以我再问一遍：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who do you think would win, if the terrible day came, and you had to fight with all your resources? You and all you have, against all the Tenno and the Lotus?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果那可怕的一天真的到来，你必须动用一切资源去应战，你觉得谁会赢？是你和你拥有的一切，还是 Tenno 与 Lotus 全部的力量？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it a silly game if you must, then! A theoretical played by children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你非要把它当成一个愚蠢的游戏，那就当成小孩子玩的理论游戏吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then it is a very good thing you are speaking to "The Devil of Tau." There is a reason I am known as a strategist. Let us begin at the very top: Numbers. You are horribly outclassed in that field.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，你能跟"Tau 之恶魔"对话真是太好了。我之所以被称为战略家是有原因的。让我们从最根本的层面开始：数字。你在这一方面远远落后于他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perfect. We have established the very first rule of laying out the battlefield: numbers. Obviously, you are horribly outclassed by sheer volume.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 完美。我们已经确立了战场布局的第一条规则：数量。显然，你在数量上完全处于劣势。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are correct. It is not. And it may come down to life or death someday. You versus your little... miniature version. And their pack of feral companions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说得对，这不是游戏。而且，这或许会演变成生死之战。你将对抗你的……迷你版自己，以及他那群野性十足的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: However, if rumor of your "personal activities" and paramour amongst protoframes in other timelines could be... leveraged, perhaps those resources could be summoned somehow. Helminths will need to be specially researched and bred for this purpose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过嘛，如果你那些关于"私人活动"以及在其他时间线里与原型战甲之间的"绯闻"能被……利用一下，或许就能以某种方式调动那些资源。为此，需要对 Helminth 进行专门的研究和培育……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have heard tell of your interactions with other protoframes in other timelines. Perhaps those resources could be summoned somehow. Helminths will need to be specifically researched and bred for this purpose...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我曾听闻你在其他时间线里与其他原型战甲之间的互动。或许我们可以以某种方式调动那些资源。为此，需要对 Helminth 进行专门的研究和培育……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Feral companions who, by the by, have already proven to be violent, unruly, and been known to cruelly cast out their own for differing too far from their own opinions of normalcy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 顺便一提，这些野性同伴已经被证明是充满暴力且桀骜不驯的，而且众所周知，他们会因为同伴与他们对"正常"的定义相差太远而残酷地驱逐他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not even know if that is possible, but it provided us passage here, so I do not see why not...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我甚至不知道这是否可行，但它为我们提供了通往这里的通道，所以我认为没有理由不行……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, not evil. I do not believe in "evil," Usurper. I never have, and I never will. I believe that the Tenno are wonderfully and beautifully human, like everyone else. Simply human. And moreover? They are children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，不，不是邪恶。我不相信"邪恶"。我过去不相信，将来也不会相信。我相信 Tenno 和其他人一样，都是奇妙又美丽的人类。他们只是普通人。而且，他们还是孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That the time may come, some terrible day, that you must be prepared to do the unthinkable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许有一天，在某个可怕的日子里，你必须做好准备，去做那些难以想象的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Run from the conversation if you like, but you know every word of this is the truth. You simply do not wish to accept it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你想逃避就逃避吧，但你很清楚我说的每一个字都是真的。你只是不愿意接受而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah! So you admit there is a mess. That is progress. May I at least make my case?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊！所以你承认这是场混乱。这算是一种进步。那我至少可以阐述一下我的观点吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I am alarmed by how much you clearly have not. May I at least make my case?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你在这件事上居然没想那么多，我才害怕呢。我能至少阐述一下我的观点吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Children who have been tasked with facing horrors and committing atrocities the likes of which I have seen break grown hardened Orokin warriors whose time has spanned hundreds of years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这些孩子被迫面对恐怖，犯下暴行，而我亲眼目睹，这种暴行甚至击垮了那些历经数百年磨砺的、意志坚定的奥罗金战士。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Tenno are wonderfully and beautifully human, like everyone else. Simply human. And moreover? They are children.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Tenno 和其他人一样，都是奇妙又美丽的人类。他们只是普通人。而且，他们还是孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am already there, Usurper. I am already there.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​早​就​下​了，​篡位者。​我​已经​在​地狱​里​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have seen Dax - Golden, Elite Dax! - drop their sacred, gilt swords and flee from the battlefield that the Tenno waded into with their Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我亲眼见过禁卫——黄金精英禁卫！——在 Tenno 驾驶着战甲冲入战场时，丢下他们神圣的镀金宝剑，转身逃离。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And lo, so am I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我也是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Their perceived cocoon of Infested shelter protected their bodies but not their minds. They are not to blame for the way they are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们自以为那些 Infested 的茧能保护他们的肉体，却保护不了他们的心智。他们变成现在这个样子，并不是他们的错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thank you. That the time may come, some terrible day, that you must be prepared to do the unthinkable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢。或许有一天，在某个可怕的日子里，你必须做好准备，去做那些难以想象的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tormented by the Void... forced to murder or witness the deaths of their own parents... subjected to war... having their memories stolen... lost to cryosleep for centuries...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们饱受虚空折磨……被迫杀害或亲眼目睹父母死亡……饱受战争蹂躏……记忆被窃取……被冷冻睡眠数个世纪……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That they are not raving lunatics entirely is miraculous, Usurper. I am not saying that it will go wrong. I am merely saying that it could. And that you must have a plan in place for if that day were to come to pass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，他们居然没有完全变成疯子，这简直是个奇迹。我不是说事情一定会出错，我只是说有可能出错。所以你必须做好准备，以防万一。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is no harm in being prepared for the worst. There is all the harm in the world in not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未雨绸缪并无坏处，而不做好准备才是最大的坏处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And who is to say I am not having these same conversations with them, hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁又能说我没有和他们进行同样的对话呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nor was I suggesting you do otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我从来也没说要你做相反的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course! That is all a devil could ask, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！这正是恶魔能奢求的全部了，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. It is just the sensation of sanity returning to your brain after all these years. You'll get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。这只是多年后大脑恢复理智的感觉而已。你会习惯的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sleep well, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，睡个好觉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have a philosophical question for you, Usurper. And before you leap to any conclusions about who I am referencing, be it myself, or Ballas, or Void forbid Albrecht, it is purely a thought experiment. Shall we play?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我有个哲学问题想问你。在你对我指的是谁做出任何结论之前，无论我指的是我自己，Ballas、或者是虚空禁止的阿尔布雷希特，这纯粹是个思想实验。我们来玩玩吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The question is simple, but vast: Do you believe that everyone deserves to be loved?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个问题很简单，但意义深远：你是否相信每个人都值得被爱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真可惜。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good! The question is simple, but vast: Do you believe that everyone deserves to be loved?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好！这个问题很简单，但意义深远：你是否相信每个人都值得被爱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not want to be caught up in the specifics. It drags the whole thing down into minutia. "Well, you see, this person did this, and that person did that, which negates this," and then we are all on the stand in this little tentamen of ours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不想纠缠于细节。那样会把整件事拖入琐碎的争论中。"你看，这个人做了这个，那个人做了那个，这就否定了这个，"然后我们所有人都会在这个小小的争论圈子里站在被告席上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thank you! Removing the names from this little tentamen makes it all the more palatable. Otherwise you get caught up in the specifics and we will get nowhere.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢！把名字去掉，就更容易让人接受了。不然你会纠结于细节，我们就什么也谈不上了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And neither shall I you, simple as that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那​我​也​不​浪费​时间​跟​你​谈​了，就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. The question is as I stated it. Does everyone deserve to be loved?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。问题正如我所说：每个人都值得被爱吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And yes, precisely. No one questions if the righteous hero deserves to love and be loved. That is never thrown up for debate in our great fables, is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，正是如此。没有人质疑正义的英雄是否值得爱与被爱。在我们的伟大寓言故事中，这个问题从未被摆上台面讨论，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No one questions if the righteous hero deserves to love and be loved. That is never thrown up for debate in our great fables, is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有人质疑正义的英雄是否值得爱与被爱。在我们的伟大寓言故事中，这个问题从未被摆上台面讨论，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Only the Cur. The Villain. The Monster. The Morally Destitute Destroyer of Worlds.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 除了坏人。反派。怪物。道德沦丧的世界毁灭者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Play along, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，配合一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I propose the following statement; that the only thing that makes these creatures morally outcast, is that they have others by which to morally outcast them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我提出以下观点：这些生物之所以在道德上被排斥，唯一的原因是它们有其他生物可以借此在道德上排斥它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If an individual were to commit "evil deeds" in a vacuum, as a single person without any others around to judge them, there would be no one to judge them evil, now would there?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果一个人在与世隔绝的环境中，作为一个孤立无援的人，没有任何其他人在周围评判他，那么就不会有人评判他是邪恶的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If a bastard burns down a forest and no one is around to hear him, does it make a sound? The only measure we have to judge "Good" and "Evil" deeds are the deeds of others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果一个混蛋烧毁了一片森林，周围却没有人听到，那这事能算数吗？我们评判"善"与"恶"的唯一标准，就是他人的行为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But yes, since you insisted on bringing it up, The Devil! The ultimate of all evils!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，既然你坚持要提，那就是说恶魔吧！万恶之源！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All the most horrifying acts a person can commit require at least a second person to commit them. A single person, in a vacuum, can do nothing that is condemnable. Destroy an uninhabited planet? Oh, woe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一个人所能犯下的所有最骇人听闻的罪行，至少都需要另一个人来成立。一个人，孤立地待着，是做不出任何值得谴责的事的。毁灭一颗无人居住的星球？哦，真是可怕呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. Think about it. All the most horrifying acts a person can commit require at least a second person to commit them. A single person, in a vacuum, can do nothing that is condemnable. Destroy an uninhabited planet? Oh, woe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错。想想看。一个人所能犯下的所有最骇人听闻的罪行，至少都需要另一个人来成立。一个人，孤立地待着，是做不出任何值得谴责的事的。毁灭一颗无人居住的星球？哦，真是可怕呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And without a society around to waggle their finger at them and say "you should not have done that terrible deed," however would we know that act was so horrifying to begin with? We would not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而，如果没有社会对他们指手画脚，说"你不应该做那样可怕的事情"，我们又怎能知道那件事有多么骇人听闻呢？我们根本不会知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is merely a measuring stick used by society to judge your actions against those of others, as I said.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如我所说，它只不过是社会用来衡量你和他人行为的标尺而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very good. If we can say that "evil" is not a state of being but a social construct, then we can agree that all the tales of Great Villainy are therefore, in turn, social constructs. Fables.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。如果我们说"邪恶"不是一种存在状态，而是一种社会建构，那么我们就可以认同，所有关于大恶人的故事，反过来也都是社会建构，都是寓言故事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why is it then, that in all great fables, those who commit Greatest Evils are left to rot alone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，为什么在所有伟大的寓言故事中，那些犯下滔天罪行的人最终都被遗弃，独自腐烂呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sometimes, yes, they are shown to be some inhuman evil, incapable of love. But why? I would propose that all great fables exist to teach a lesson, do they not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有时候，他们确实被描绘成某种非人般的邪恶，不具备爱的能力。但为什么呢？我认为所有伟大的寓言故事都是为了传授某种教训，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Sometimes, yes, they are shown to be too preoccupied with their Great Evils to belittle themselves with such so-called "Trivial Things." But why? All great fables exist to teach a lesson, do they not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有时候，他们的确会表现得过于专注于自己的罪恶，以至于无暇顾及这些所谓的"琐事"。但这是为什么呢？所有伟大的寓言故事都是为了传授某种教训，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, now you are simply parroting my words back to me, Usurper. We have already decided that "deserve" is relative. Think. All great fables exist to teach a lesson, do they not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，你现在只不过是在鹦鹉学舌地重复我的话，篡位者。我们已经决定了"值得"是相对的。想想吧。所有伟大的寓言故事都是为了传授某种教训，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if we were to show a Great Evil living peacefully, happily, wonderfully in love... well... what kind of lesson would that teach?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们展现一个邪恶之人过着和平、幸福、美好的爱情生活……那么……这会给我们带来什么样的教训呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Such would be my theory, yes! All great fables exist to teach a lesson, do they not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的理论正是如此！所有伟大的寓言故事都是为了传授某种教训，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You sound like the zealots. "Redemption." But you are knocking at the door of the truth. Because you are implying that the two cannot exist at the same time in our world, and that is true, isn't it? Love and evil cannot be allowed to co-exist in society.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你听起来像个狂热分子。"救赎。"但你正在叩响真理之门。因为你的意思是，爱与恶在我们的世界里无法同时存在，而这不正是事实吗？爱与恶不能在社会中共存。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are close but not quite there. Yes, but take it a step farther. What would it mean if a person who is capable of evil deeds were still to be loved by another? What would that do to society?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你已经很接近答案了，但还差一点。是的，但请更进一步思考。如果一个作恶多端的人仍然被他人所爱，这意味着什么？这会对社会造成什么影响？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely! These two things do not want to live together in our minds, do they? When I told you the story of Ballas and Margulis, it was hard to accept that their love for each other was once real, wasn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错！这两件事在我们脑海里是无法共存的，对吧？当我给你讲 Ballas 和 Margulis 的故事时，你很难相信他们曾经真心相爱，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely! These two things do not want to live together in our minds, do they? If I were to tell you that Ballas and Margulis were once very much in love before it all went wrong, would you believe me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错！这两件事在我们脑海里根本无法共存，对吧？如果我告诉你， Ballas 和 Margulis 在一切变糟之前曾经非常相爱，你会相信吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Without delving into the specifics and veering too far from my own rule of keeping things purely philosophical - they are a common point of reference for us both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不去深入探讨细节，也不偏离我一贯坚持的纯粹哲学原则——他们是我们两人的共同参照点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When I told you the story of Ballas and Margulis, it was hard to accept that their love for each other was once real, wasn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当我跟你讲 Ballas 和 Margulis 的故事时，你很难相信他们曾经真的相爱，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I were to tell you that Ballas and Margulis were once very much in love before it all went wrong, would you believe me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我告诉你，Ballas 和 Margulis 在一切变糟之前曾经非常相爱，你会相信我吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It goes without question that Ballas was capable of some of the most purest forms of cruelty that humanity has ever known. And yet, he knew love. Mutual love.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 毫无疑问，Ballas 能够做出人类历史上最纯粹、最残忍的事情。然而，他也懂得爱。相互的爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is a fact, though you may wish to deny it now, Ballas and Margulis loved each other deeply. It simply went terribly wrong.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是事实，虽然你现在可能想否认，但 Ballas 和 Margulis 曾经深爱着彼此。只是结局非常糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But we must scrub that story clean of their love. We must say it did not exist. We must say it was not real, that it was a fallacy. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我们必须彻底抹去他们爱情故事中的痕迹。我们必须说它根本不存在。我们必须说它不是真的，那只是个谎言。为什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I have done all this work for nothing. Shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我说了这么多，全都白费了。真丢人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very good, Usurper. Very good. Exactly that. Great Evil must always be "other" and we must never, ever sympathize with it. If we allow it to feel love, and be loved? I think all the world might crumble around us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好，篡位者。很好。正是如此。邪恶之源必须永远是"他者"，我们绝不能同情他。如果我们允许他感受爱，允许他被爱呢？我想整个世界都会在我们周围崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very good, Usurper. Very good. Exactly that. We must hold Great Evil to task. If we allow it to feel love, and be loved? I think all the world might crumble around us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好，篡位者。很好。正是如此。我们必须追究邪恶之人的责任。如果我们允许他感受爱，并被爱呢？我想整个世界都会在我们周围崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And wherever would we be, then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，​我们​又​会​变成​什么样​呢？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How much do you recall of your days in the Empire, Usurper? It seems fragmented at best. Not that I am one to judge, mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，你对你在帝国的日子还有多少记忆？充其量也只能说是零碎的记忆。当然，我不是有意去妄加评判。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. It just strikes me as strange that so few records of our society and our culture exist in full. I know there was little love for us after the fall, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。令我感到奇怪的是，我们社会和文化的完整记录竟然如此之少。我知道在帝国覆灭之后，我们不受待见，只是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is quite fair. However, you are missing whole swaths of our history and cultural records. I know there was little love for us after the fall, but...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这很公平。但是，你忽略了我们历史和文化的很大一部分。我知道在帝国覆灭之后，我们不受待见，只是……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not even any mention on what happened to the Cryoleums?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 完全​没​人​提到​过低​温冢​的​事吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not even any mention on what happened to the Cryoleums?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 完全​没​人​提到​过低​温冢​的​事吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps it is because I have spent the last... too many years trapped in a crypt with these two zealots but it is shocking to me that absolutely no record of how the Orokin dealt with their dead have survived over the millennia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是因为我过去……太多年都和这两个狂热分子被困在墓穴里，但令我震惊的是，数千年来，奥罗金人如何处理死者的记录竟然完全没有留存下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Shockingly? No. Perhaps it is because I have spent the last... too many years trapped in a crypt with these two zealots but it is shocking to me that absolutely no record of how the Orokin dealt with their dead have survived over the millennia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 令人震惊的是？不会。也许是因为我过去……太多年都和这两个狂热分子被困在墓穴里，但令我震惊的是，数千年来，奥罗金人如何处理死者的记录竟然完全没有留存下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perhaps it is because I have spent the last... too many years trapped in a crypt with these two zealots but it is shocking to me that absolutely no record of how the Orokin dealt with their dead have survived over the millennia.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是因为我过去……太多年都和这两个狂热分子被困在墓穴里，但令我震惊的是，数千年来，奥罗金人如何处理死者的记录竟然完全没有留存下来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, but what about everyone else who was "close" but "not quite important enough?" The Archimedeans? Or the lower-ranked Orokin? There were always tiers within tiers. Even if the ceilings were glass, they existed. Believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，但那些"关系密切"但"不够重要"的人呢？哲士呢？地位较低的奥罗金人呢？等级制度中总是存在着层层嵌套。即使天花板是透明的，它们也确实存在。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider all those who were "close" but "not quite important enough." The Archimedeans. The lower-ranked Orokin. There were always tiers within tiers. Even if the ceilings were glass, they existed. Believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想想那些"关系密切"但"不够重要"的人呢？哲士呢？地位较低的奥罗金人呢？等级制度中总是存在着层层嵌套。即使天花板是透明的，它们也确实存在。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, but what about everyone else who was "close" but "not quite important enough?" The Archimedeans? Or the lower-ranked Orokin? There were always tiers within tiers. Even if the ceilings were glass, they existed. Believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，但那些"关系密切"但"不够重要"的人呢？哲士呢？地位较低的奥罗金人呢？等级制度中总是存在着层层嵌套。即使天花板是透明的，它们也确实存在。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed we did. At every possible turn. But not all were spared, were they? What about those who were "close" but "not important enough?" The Archimedeans? The lesser-ranked Orokin?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 的确如此。我们是无所不用其极。但并非所有人都幸免于难，不是吗？那些"关系密切"但"不够重要"的人呢？哲士呢？地位较低的奥罗金人呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, but what about everyone else who was "close" but "not quite important enough?" The Archimedeans? Or the lower-ranked Orokin? There were always tiers within tiers. Even if the ceilings were glass, they existed. Believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，但那些"关系密切"但"不够重要"的人呢？哲士呢？地位较低的奥罗金人呢？等级制度中总是存在着层层嵌套。即使天花板是透明的，它们也确实存在。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider all those who were "close" but "not quite important enough." The Archimedeans. The lower-ranked Orokin. There were always tiers within tiers. Even if the ceilings were glass, they existed. Believe me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想想那些"关系密切"但"不够重要"的人呢？哲士呢？地位较低的奥罗金人呢？等级制度中总是存在着层层嵌套。即使天花板是透明的，它们也确实存在。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not all were so lucky as to be gifted new flesh each time their old form burned low. But I am certain you find the Yuvan Theatre a disgusting practice, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 并非所有人都那么幸运，每次旧躯体燃尽都能获得新生。但我确信你觉得青春厅堂的这种做法令人作呕，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not all were so lucky as to be gifted new flesh each time their old form burned low. But I am certain you find the Yuvan Theatre a disgusting practice, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 并非所有人都那么幸运，每次旧躯体燃尽都能获得新生。但我确信你觉得青春厅堂的这种做法令人作呕，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not all were so lucky as to be gifted new flesh each time their old form burned low. Clearly, you believe the Yuvan Theatre a disgusting practice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 并非所有人都那么幸运，每次旧躯体燃尽都能获得新生。显然，你觉得青春厅堂的这种做法令人作呕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yet you just said only shards of our history and cultural records remain. And where are all these things recorded? More importantly, who has written all these things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而你刚才说，我们的历史和文化记录只剩下零星碎片。那么，这些记载都在哪里？更重要的是，这些记载是谁写的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Everything written about the Yuvan Theatre says." Where are all these things recorded? More importantly, who has written all these things?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "所有关于青春厅堂的记载都说……"这些记载都在哪里？更重要的是，这些记载是谁写的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And how do you know all this? Did you witness a Yuvan Theatre yourself?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你是怎么知道这一切的？你亲眼见过青春厅堂吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Withholding judgement until you have all the information? Egads, Usurper! You sound intelligent! What a rarity!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在掌握所有信息之前暂不下结论？我的天哪，篡位者！听起来你真聪明！真是难得一见！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They are stories told by those who have a distinct interest in rendering every aspect of the Orokin in as disastrous and evil a light as possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些都是某些别有用心之人编写的故事，他们刻意把奥罗金的每一面都描绘成灾难与邪恶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Withholding judgement until you have all the information? Egads, Usurper! You sound intelligent! What a rarity!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在掌握所有信息之前暂不下结论？我的天哪，篡位者！听起来你真聪明！真是难得一见！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Allow me to shift the lens of history for you then, if I may. Consider where the accounts of the Yuvan Theatre that you may have heard originate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，请允许我为你转换一下历史的视角。请思考一下你可能听说过的关于青春厅堂的那些说法源自何处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For those who tear down all the support structures of the very society of the Origin System and send it reeling into utter chaos must give those who rely upon that society a good reason for doing so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些摧毁始源星系社会所有支撑结构、并使其陷入彻底混乱的人，必须给那些依赖该社会的人一个合理的理由。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then you are relying on second-hand stories. Consider where are these accounts are written. More importantly, consider who has written them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么你就是在依赖二手信息。想想这些记录出自哪里。更重要的是，想想是谁写的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Liar.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！骗子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are they? Consider where are these accounts are written. More importantly, consider who has written all these accounts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是如此吗？想想这些记录都写在哪里。更重要的是，想想这些记录都是谁写的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider life for the average human on a relay, Usurper. One far away from the trials and tribulations of the Tenno. One who cared nothing for the Great War.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，想想一个普通人在中继站中的生活吧。他远离 Tenno 的种种磨难，对那场大战漠不关心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are relying on second-hand stories. Consider where are these accounts are written. More importantly, consider who has written them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你就是在依赖二手信息。想想这些记录出自哪里。更重要的是，想想是谁写的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When the Orokin fell, their lives were pitched into pure hell in the power vacuum that followed. Explanations had to be concocted. Effigies had to be made and burned. We had to be made the monsters in the dark.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 奥罗金陨落后，随之而来的权力真空让他们的生活陷入了彻底的地狱。他们不得不编造各种解释，制作并焚烧人偶，把其他人塑造成黑暗中的怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, that is entirely correct.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没错，我没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I just want you to consider your sources, is all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想提醒你注意一下信息来源。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To say that we did not take sacrifices against their will is incorrect. We did. But it is not the whole truth. These things are rarely so simple and they are never so black and white.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说我们没有违背他们的意愿牺牲他们是不对的。因为我们确实这样做了。但这并非全部真相。事情很少如此简单，也从来都不是非黑即白的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because it is not the whole truth. These things are rarely so simple and never so black and white. The world is grey, Usurper. Lines are not so easily drawn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为这并非全部真相。事情很少如此简单，也绝非非黑即白。篡位者，世界是灰色的，界限并非如此泾渭分明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The world is grey, Usurper. Lines are not so easily drawn.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，世界是灰色的，界限并非如此泾渭分明。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The practice did not start in such a shameful way. It was seen as the highest honor, at first. To give yourself up so that the Empire would continue unbroken. Unbent. So that the work could continue.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这种做法最初并非如此可耻。起初，它被视为至高无上的荣誉。为了帝国的延续，甘愿献出自己，坚不可摧，只为让帝国得以继续运转。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nor did it start with the young. It started with those who simply had more years to spend. But then those who offered themselves became... younger and younger. Devotion is a powerful drug.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这并非始于年轻人，而是始于那些拥有更多时间的人。但后来，那些献身奉献的人却越来越年轻。奉献是一种强大的精神力量。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I saw something similar with those signing up for the war. Lying about their age on paperwork to "fight the good fight." Little did they know they were setting a dangerous precedent for those who would unwillingly come after.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在报名参战的人身上也看到过类似的情况。他们在报名表上谎报年龄，说是为了"打一场正义的仗"。他们却浑然不知，自己正在为后来那些被迫参战的人树立一个危险的先例。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As somewhere along the line, some Executor realized that it could be used as a... punitive measure. That certain cities or... whole planets could be kept in line if the threat of the Yuvan Theatre were used. If the collection of sacrifice were wielded in a particularly heavy-handed way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不知从何时起，某个执行者意识到，这可以作为一种……惩罚手段。如果​把​青春厅堂​作为​一​种​威胁，某些城市甚至……整个星球都能被控制。如果以特别强硬的方式征收祭品，情况就更是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not lie to you. I have. And you can think me a monster for it all you like. But when your entire society is built upon hundreds of years of the normalization of something, it is very hard to turn your back to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会对你撒谎。我参与过。你可以把我当成怪物。当你的整个社会建立在数百年来对某种事物习以为常的基础上时，很难完全否定它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. Mixed. On one hand, I have partaken in the Theatre many times myself. I would be the ultimate hypocrite to condemn it. When your entire society is built upon hundreds of years of the normalization of something, it is very hard to turn your back to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，感觉很复杂。一方面，我自己也多次参与过厅堂的事情。如果我谴责它，那我就太虚伪了。当你的整个社会建立在数百年来对某种事物习以为常的基础上时，很难完全否定它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Even when in retrospect, or in a moment of clarity, it is so very clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 即使在事后回想，或者在清醒的瞬间，这一点也十分清楚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: On the other hand, in a vacuum, or in retrospect, the horror of the deed becomes quite clear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 另一方面，不管是抽离开来看，还是事后再回头看，这种行为的恐怖就十分明显了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No one should live forever, Usurper. And the Theatre is proof of why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，没有人应该永生。而这厅堂就是个例证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which is your favorite way to kill, Usurper?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，你最喜欢用哪种方式杀人？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I find myself waxing philosophical as of late and I am simply curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 最近我发现自己经常会思考一些哲学问题，我只是单纯地好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Hardly. Although... going a few rounds with you would be quite fun. No, I find myself waxing philosophical as of late and I am simply curious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！不是。不过……跟你打几局应该挺有意思的。不，最近我发现自己经常会思考一些哲学问题，我只是单纯地好奇。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For numbers, you and I are likely matched I figure. Lethality, mm... I would not want to place a wager, nor am I particularly interested in a proverbial sword-measuring contest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 论人数，我觉得你我差不多。至于杀伤力嘛……我可不想打赌，也对这种比拼剑术的比赛没什么兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Killer to killer. Which do you prefer? Do you prefer something up close and personal? Do you prefer stealth, or the chaos of the battlefield?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 杀手对杀手，你更喜欢哪种？你喜欢近身肉搏吗？你喜欢潜行，还是喜欢战场上的混乱？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh my poor, poor Usurper, if you could have only just heard me laugh...
