/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，我可怜的篡位者，如果你能听到我刚才的笑声……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then, shoo.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，走吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A battle-worn soldier like myself. I am unsurprised, given what I know of your record. So much blood follows you wherever you go. First Duviri, then "Narmer," this Höllvania. Now this business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 像我一样身经百战的老兵。鉴于我对你过往的了解，我并不感到意外。你走到哪里，哪里就有鲜血。先是双衍王境，然后是"合一众"，接着是霍瓦尼亚，现在又是这出闹剧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, an assassin amongst us! So very useful yet so very unappreciated. I have always likened assassins to talented butlers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，我们中间竟然藏着一位刺客！如此有用，却又如此不被赏识。我一直觉得刺客就像技艺高超的管家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You miserable, destitute creature. I hope for your sake you are lying to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这个可怜的、一无所有的家伙。为了你自己着想，我希望你是在骗我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who knows what else, or since, or what you have forgotten in the meanwhile. Death is your art and you paint the worlds in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谁知道还有什么，或者之后发生了什么，或者你这段时间里忘记了什么。死亡是你的艺术，你用它描绘世界。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When they do their jobs exceptionally well, they always go unnoticed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当他们把工作做得非常出色时，往往不为人知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So! What is your favorite brush? Let us dig in.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么！你最喜欢的画笔是什么？让我们来深入探讨一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So. Dagger? Poison? Bow?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，是匕首？毒药？还是弓箭？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Otherwise that may be the saddest thing I have ever heard in all my years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 否则，那可能是我这么多年来听过的最悲伤的事情了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am sitting here picturing you rampaging through the battlefield with a medic's bench. Tearing through soldiers with tire strapped to a bent piece of pipe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，想象着你扛着医疗椅在战场上横冲直撞，用绑在弯曲管道上的轮胎撕碎士兵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To wield a bow in the heat of battle takes resolve a clarity of mind like few can muster. And, of course, steady hands.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在激烈的战斗中挥舞弓箭，需要极强的意志力和清晰的头脑，这几乎是人人都难以企及的。当然，还需要一双稳健的手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, careful. Do not get me too excited, Usurper. How I would love to see you dancing through the battlefield, weapons in hand, sprays of blood like the petals of a flower blooming wide...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，小心点。别让我太兴奋，篡位者。我多么想看到你手持武器，在战场上翩翩起舞，鲜血如盛开的花瓣般飞溅……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They have been the workhorse of any war since the moment they were invented for a reason, Usurper. It is, however, difficult to deny that when they reach their intended target, they complete their objective.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，它们自发明之日起就一直是战争的主力军，这绝非偶然。然而，不可否认的是，当它们射中预定目标时，便能完成其使命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am sitting here picturing you assassinating someone with a piece of cutlery or a chair leg. Snuffing out someone's life with the tieback of a curtain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，想象着你用刀叉或椅子腿刺杀某人，用窗帘的系带夺走某人的生命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The hunter's way. Unadvanced but elegant in its simplicity. Sometimes the easiest and oldest methods are at their hearts the most effective.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 猎人之道。看似简单，实则精妙。有时，最简单、最古老的方法，其本质才是最有效的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A little impersonal and clinical for my tastes, but I cannot judge it for its efficiency. There is something to be said for the calm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对我来说，这有点冷冰冰的，缺乏人情味，但我不能就效率问题来评判它。这份平静自有其可取之处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The sinister apothecary, hm? Brewing tinctures and tipping vials into the glasses of the unsuspecting? Or lacing one's knives and bullets with venom so that the slightest glancing blow on the field becomes a fatal one?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阴险的药剂师？调制酊剂，然后把药瓶里的药水倒入毫无戒心的人的杯子里？或者在刀和子弹里掺入毒液，让战场上哪怕最轻微的擦伤都变成致命一击？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, careful. Do not get me too excited, Usurper. How intriguing, the image of waking up one night with you lurking in the shadows, a dagger poised, ready to strike...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，小心点。别让我太兴奋，篡位者。多么诱人啊，想象一下，某天夜里醒来，你潜伏在阴影里，匕首已就位，随时准备出手……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The silence of it all is to be appreciated. The nocking of an arrow, drawing it taut, the anticipation of release... then sweet, sweet death when it finds its mark?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一切都如此静谧，值得细细品味。搭箭、拉弓、等待释放……然后，当箭矢命中目标，带来甜蜜的死亡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate the desire for the personal touch. To watch as the limbs of your victim fall away as you end their lives. To see their lifeless forms crumple before you. To know that was you who did it, and no one else.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我欣赏这种亲力亲为的渴望。看着受害者的四肢在你终结他们生命时逐渐消散。看着他们毫无生气的躯体在你面前瘫倒。知道这一切都是你亲手完成的，而不是别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Messy, noisy, extravagantly expensive. But so very, very good at killing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 混乱、大声、价格极其昂贵。但杀伤力却非常非常强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The silence of it all is to be appreciated. The nocking of an arrow, drawing it taut, the anticipation of release... then sweet, sweet death when it finds its mark?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一切都如此静谧，值得细细品味。搭箭、拉弓、等待释放……然后，当箭矢命中目标，带来甜蜜的死亡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In the seemingly implacable clamor of the field of war, the sniper must find their breath like the tide of the ocean. Breath in, breath out, and take a life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在看似永无止境的战场喧嚣中，狙击手必须像潮汐般找到呼吸的节奏。吸气，呼气，然后夺走一条生命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have seen whole battalions rendered to sludge from a single cut on a single soldier's arm. A toxin that spread from the blood to the lungs to the lungs of another can destroy countries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我曾亲眼目睹，仅仅一个士兵手臂上的一个小伤口，就导致整个营的士兵化为灰烬。一种毒素从血液扩散到肺部，再扩散到另一个人的肺部，足以摧毁一个国家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate the desire for the personal touch. To stare into the eyes of another and watch them go glassy and dim as the light fades and the warmth flees their body.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我欣赏这种对亲自动手的渴望。凝视着另一个人的眼睛，看着它们变得空洞黯淡，随着光线渐暗，身体的温度也随之消逝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... cannot decide if this makes you more or less terrifying, Usurper. I think I will settle on more. Either way, I find it amusing and striking in its own right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……无法决定这究竟是让你更可怕还是更不可怕，篡位者。我想我还是倾向于认为你更可怕。无论如何，我觉得这本身就很有趣，也很引人注目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I... cannot decide if this makes you more or less terrifying, Usurper. I think I will settle on more. Either way, I find it amusing and striking in its own right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我……无法决定这究竟是让你更可怕还是更不可怕，篡位者。我想我还是倾向于认为你更可怕。无论如何，我觉得这本身就很有趣，也很引人注目。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What a beautiful moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一刻多么美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is a certain kind of beauty in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它有一种独特的美感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is beauty in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其中蕴含着美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Death at such a scale? There is beauty in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如此大规模的死亡？其中也蕴含着美。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What a beautiful moment.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一刻多么美好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Because it is. And you know it. In fact, half of your existence is quite literally based on the concept of killing as an artform!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因为这就是艺术。而且你也心知肚明。实际上，你存在的另一半，从字面上讲，都是建立在将杀戮视为一种艺术形式这一概念之上的！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? Really? Let us take a moment to examine that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？真的吗？让我们花点时间来仔细分析一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It has changed, recently. And that bothers me to no end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 已经变了。这让我非常困扰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see these "schools" the Tenno wield, and that you borrow by proxy. Let alone the teachings of the Dax. How they would drone on and on endlessly on comms, no matter how many times we told them it was a restricted channel.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​见​过​ Tenno ​使用​的​那些​"学派"，​而​你​只​是​间接​地​借用​了​它们。​更别​提禁​卫​的​教导​了。​无论​我们​告诉​他们​多​少​次​这​是​禁播​频道，​他们​都​会​没​完没​了​地​在​通讯​频道里​说​个​不​停。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tell me something, and please answer me honestly. Because lying in this moment does both of us a disservice but particularly yourself:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 告诉我一些事情，请务必诚实回答。因为此时此刻说谎对我们双方都没有好处，尤其对你自身而言更是如此：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I never hear one of them tell me that "I am a blade" and that "I exist to strike" again, I will die happy, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我再也不用听他们对我说"我是一把刀"和"我存在的意义就是出击"，那么我死而无憾了，篡位者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have you ever sought to outfit yourself with a weapon or a Warframe that is customized to your own personal tastes? Perhaps with painted uniquely, or a look that you find suits your mood better?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是否曾经想过为自己打造一件符合个人喜好的武器或战甲？比如，为其涂装独一无二的图案，或者选择一种更符合你心情的外观？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I used to favor the sword as a weapon. Elegant. Fast. I could move through the field and cut through my foes at arm's reach. Crimson upon a silvered blade, flashing in the glow of a blue star.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我过去最喜欢用剑。优雅，迅捷。我可以穿梭于战场，在触手可及的范围内斩杀敌人。银色的剑刃就着猩红，在蓝色的星辰下闪耀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I assume so. Or perhaps because of my missing memories. I do not know what other reasons could be to blame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想应该是这样。或许是因为我缺失了一些记忆。我不知道还有什么其他原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Humanity has always looked at "murder" as a sin, but "killing" as an art. Have you never thought of that as odd? To wield a blade and fell an enemy in combat is to be seen as a nigh transcendent being.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 人类历来视"谋杀"为罪恶，却视"杀戮"为艺术。你难道从未觉得这很奇怪吗？挥舞利刃，在战斗中击败敌人，被视为近乎超凡脱俗的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But now? Now I wish to taste the blood on my teeth. Feel it gush underneath my claws. I wish to sink my fingers deep into flesh and bone and rip it to pieces.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但现在呢？现在我只想尝尝牙齿上的血腥味，感受鲜血在利爪下喷涌而出。我只想把手指深深插入血肉和骨骼，将它们撕成碎片。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To kill a man with a sharpened piece of metal in an alley is to be a coward and a degenerate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在小巷里用磨尖的金属片杀人，是懦夫和堕落的行为。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate your honesty. Now, I will not argue that you very likely do not enjoy murder in cold blood, and the slaughter of an innocent life is not something you take delight in (although perhaps you do and your previous statement was a lie, and how delectable would that be to reveal, however that is not what we are here to discuss).
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很欣赏你的坦诚。当然，我不会否认你很可能并不享受冷血的谋杀，杀害无辜生命也不是你会感到愉悦的事情（尽管也许之前的说法是谎言，而你真的享受，如果能揭穿这一点该是多么令人兴奋啊，但这并非我们今天要讨论的重点）。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will ask you take a long hard moment to think. I have seen your Tenno friends rampaging around this place befitted like multi-colored arena-circus nightmares. Like a feral animal had fallen into an artist's pigment pots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请你花点时间好好想想。我亲眼看到你的那些 Tenno 朋友在这里横冲直撞，就像一群五彩斑斓的马戏团噩梦，就像野兽掉进了艺术家的颜料罐里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I want to drink deep the ichor as I snap sinew and feel the body rend beneath me into nothing more than sanguineous shrapnel. Peel it apart like sweet fruit as the marrow flows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想痛饮那鲜血，同时折断筋腱，感受身躯在我身下撕裂成血淋淋的碎片。像剥开甜美的果实一样，将它层层剥开，让骨髓流淌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What is the difference? "Honor?" Who decides what is honorable and what is not? The loser? Or the winner? Or is it simply the existence of enough tradition that declares what is honorable and what is not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 区别在哪儿？"荣誉"？谁来决定什么是荣誉，什么是不荣誉？是失败者？还是胜利者？或者仅仅是因为存在足够多的传统，才足以界定什么是荣誉，什么是不荣誉？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Assuming however that is not the case, and you are simply killing because "you have to" as you said, then why, pray tell, would you spend time outfitting your weapons of death in a personalized fashion?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但假设情况并非如此，你只是像你所说的那样因为"不得不"而杀人，那么请问，你为什么要花时间以个性化的方式装饰你的杀人武器呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have never felt compelled to do the same? Not once? I swear to you that I will not think less of you for admitting so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你从未感到过必须这样做吗？一次也没有？我向你保证，即使你承认这一点，我也不会因此而看不起你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why care for how you might appear to others on the field of death? Certainly not so that others might identify your corpse. There is no mistaking you anywhere. No, because if you must be a killer, my dear Usurper, I wager you wish to do it in style.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么要在意自己在死亡战场上的形象？当然不是为了方便别人辨认你的尸体。你这副模样，谁都认得出来。不，因为如果你非要当杀人犯，我亲爱的篡位者，我敢打赌，你肯定想做得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, I am aware! I am aware. I am not going to do any of these things, mind you. Neither am I going to burn this whole place down around me, which I salivate to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我知道！我知道。但我不会做这些事，请注意。我也不会把周围的一切都烧成灰烬，尽管我很想这么做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No! No it is not! Nor is it normal for me to salivate at the idea of burning this whole place to the ground around me!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不！绝对不！想到要把周围的一切都烧成灰烬，我就流口水，这也不正常！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well, let us follow that line of reasoning to its end. Killing with enough practice makes it honorable? So, you are saying, if I am like the Dax, and I simply couch my murder in enough pomp and circumstance, it makes it Art?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好，我们就顺着这个思路推演下去。杀人练得足够多就能变得光荣？所以你的意思是，如果我像禁卫那样，只要把谋杀包装得足够隆重隆重，就能把它变成艺术？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All such lines are arbitrarily drawn. And the sooner we all come to understand that, the faster we can come to agreement on which battles are the important ones to fight and which ones are not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所有这些界限都是人为划定的。我们越早明白这一点，就能越快达成共识，比如哪些仗值得打、哪些仗不值得打。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And what is that, if not enjoyment of the deed, I ask?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那如果这种行为不是享受，那又是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Uriel must be to blame. While I admit I had leanings of such destructive and bloodthirsty thoughts before, they were not nearly so catastrophic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一定是 Uriel 的错。虽然我承认以前也有过类似的毁灭性和嗜血的想法，但远没有现在这么可怕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now we are toeing the line into ritual and religion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在我们正在游走在仪式和宗教的边缘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Deciding if a killing was done honorably is like trying to decide which is worse, death by fire or death by drowning. Both are miserable ways to die.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 判断一次杀戮是否光荣，就好比判断死于火刑还是溺水更惨。两者都是极其痛苦的死法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not get me wrong! I am not judging you. You are making the best of your situation! Death has made you her dance partner in this great charade of life, and you are helpless but to heed her call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别误会！我不是在评判你。你已经尽力做到最好了！死神让你成为她在这场人生闹剧中的舞伴，你除了听从她的召唤，别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And certainly not so... apocalyptic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，也远没有那么……末日味。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: At least there is honesty in the simple, easy death of a knife in the back. There is nothing pious about it. Nothing ostentatious or overburdened. It is done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少，用刀捅死这种简单直接的死法还比较真诚。它不带任何虔诚，也不张扬或矫揉造作。就这样结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And all roads lead to the grave, so what is the point in nitpicking? We have far more important problems to solve.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 反正​殊途同归，​何必斤​斤计较？​我们​还​有​更​重要​的​问题​需要​解决。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Would you have laid down your weapons, how many more would be dead beside you, I wonder? No, why not take a little pride in your work? A little pleasure in the art of it all? What is the alternative, I ask you? Madness? Oblivion?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你放下武器，我不知道会有多少人会死在你身边。不，为什么不为自己的工作感到一丝自豪？为什么不享受一下这其中的乐趣？我问你，你还能选择什么？疯狂？遗忘？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is there not art in that?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道这其中就没有艺术性吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have seen too many go that way and found the end of a noose waiting for them. No. I say, do what thou wilt, Usurper. For life has certainty done what it wilt unto you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我见过太多人走上这条路，最终落得个绞刑架的下场。不，我说，篡位者，随你便吧。因为生活终究会按照它自己的意愿，把你塑造成现在的模样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper. I feel we are nearly there. A few days more, and the pieces of my mind will nearly be complete. We will nearly reach that point where we "last left off," I believe. It is a strange thing to reflect upon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者。我觉得我们快要好了。再过几天，我的记忆就差不多完整了。我相信，我们很快就能回到"上次中断的地方"。回想起来，这真是一件奇妙的事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper, I am pleased to tell you that your work in the Dark Refractory is complete, and you may stop unearthing my memories.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我很高兴地告诉你，你在深溯池中的工作已经完成，你可以停止挖掘我的记忆了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper, while there is still some work to be done in the Dark Refractory when it comes to recovering my memories, I am happy to announce that I think I am done with the whole bloody business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，虽然在深溯池中恢复我的记忆还剩一些工作，但我很高兴地宣布，我认为我已经彻底结束了这该死的整个事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper, while you have honestly been...remiss in beginning any work at all at the Dark Refractory, I am happy to announce that I think I am done with the whole bloody business.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，虽然你确实……一事无成，在深溯池那里没有开始任何工作，但我很高兴地宣布，我认为我已经彻底结束了这该死的整个事件。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We can quit this task of dallying about inside my mind and putting us all through such fictional flagellation, yes? (Even if the priest does enjoy such a thing.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们可以停止在我脑海里喋喋不休，让大家都经历这种虚构的折磨了吗？（即使那位神父确实乐在其中。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We can stop dallying about inside my mind and putting us all through such fictional flagellation, yes? (Even if the priest does enjoy such a thing.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们可以停止在我脑海里喋喋不休，让大家都经历这种虚构的折磨了吗？（即使那位神父确实乐在其中。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper, I have a difficult request to put before you. One that brings me no pleasure to bring to you. I know at the very least you are desirous of me, and I would hope there is a place in your heart that has warmed to me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我有一个难以启齿的请求。这个请求绝非我乐意之举。我知道你至少对我有所求，也希望你心中对我留有一丝好感……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper, I have a difficult request to put before you. One that brings me no pleasure to bring to you. But first, I will ask... have we become friends? Is there some place in your heart that has come to think fondly of me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我有一个难以启齿的请求，一个我并不乐意提出的请求。但首先，我想问……我们成了朋友吗？你心中是否对我产生了一丝好感？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You can forget all about it, now. I am certain you have better things to do with your day than such fictional flagellation, yes? (Even if the priest does enjoy such a thing.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你现在可以把这件事忘得一干二净了。我相信你今天肯定有比这种虚构的鞭笞更有意义的事情要做，对吧？（即使那位神父真的喜欢这种事。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While you may believe you are owed both thanks and apologies for what transpired, my asking you to wipe my memories and beginning again, I believe it merely makes us "even" for all the pain that I have suffered as a result.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然你可能认为对于发生的一切，我应该向你表示感谢和道歉，但我要求你抹去我的记忆并重新开始，我认为这只是让我们"扯平"了我因此遭受的所有痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It feels so empty, all this tail chasing. I suppose only you would know. Well. Let us see it through, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 感觉好空虚，整天都在追逐记忆的尾巴。我想只有你才能体会。好吧，让我们坚持下去，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In fact, I would firmly insist we do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，我坚决要求我们这样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then what I will ask you, I do from a place of warmth of my own heart as well, Usurper. And understand I do so knowing what it means to us both.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，篡位者，我接下来要请你做的事，也是出于我内心的善意。而我也明白，这对我们双方意味着什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if we do not, I suppose you have a solution to that, hm? Well, tomorrow is another day, and perhaps it shall feel like yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们做不到，我想你应该有解决办法吧？好吧，明天又是新的一天，也许感觉就像昨天一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. I suppose I would have. And I suppose I was right. Well, tomorrow is another day, and perhaps it shall feel like yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我想我会那样做。而且我想我是对的。好吧，明天又是新的一天，也许感觉就像昨天一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if we do not, i suppose you have a solution to that, hm? Well, tomorrow is another day, and perhaps it shall feel like yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我们做不到，我想你应该有解决办法吧？好吧，明天又是新的一天，也许感觉就像昨天一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. There is such an overwhelming sense of dread that accompanies it. Well. Tomorrow is another day, and perhaps it shall feel like yesterday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。随之而来的是一种难以承受的恐惧感。唉。明天又是新的一天，或许感觉就像昨天一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need you to use your gifts over my Protoframe mind and wipe it clean of our interactions before it is too late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要你运用你的天赋，在我的原型战甲意识中彻底清除我们之间的互动痕迹，以免为时过晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I -

Fascinating... While I hate to take this moment to delve into the specifics, and I apologize for the brashness of the following question, as it is terribly gauche and boorish, it does have a deep impact on what I am about to request of you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真有趣……虽然我不想借此机会深入探讨细节，而且对于接下来这个问题的冒昧和粗鲁，我深表歉意，但这确实对我接下来要向你提出的请求有着深远的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And whether you choose to believe it, I have come to think of you the same way. I genuinely have come to enjoy our talks.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论你是否相信，我已经开始这样看待你了。我真心喜欢我们之间的谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fantastic! What wonderful news. It will make my request all the easier for you to complete!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太棒了！真是个好消息。这下你就能更轻松地完成我的请求了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not at all! Not in the slightest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 完全不是！一点儿也不是。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing! Nothing at all. I am content with what we have found. This archaeological dig has yielded its results, and I have decided I have wasted enough of your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有！​什么​也​没有。​我​对​我们​目前​的​发现​很​满意。​这​次​考古挖掘​已经​取得​了​成果，​我​觉得​我​已经​浪费​了​你​太​多​时间​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am quite certain you will not need any more assistance from me in that regard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我非常确定你在这方面不需要我再提供任何帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am quite certain you will not need any more assistance from me in that regard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我非常确定你在这方面不需要我再提供任何帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nothing! Nothing at all. I am content with what we have found. This archaeological dig has yielded its results, and I have decided I have wasted enough of your time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有！​什么​也​没有。​我​对​我们​目前​的​发现​很​满意。​这​次​考古挖掘​已经​取得​了​成果，​我​觉得​我​已经​浪费​了​你​太​多​时间​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not at all! Not in the slightest. I simply think that we have gone far enough, and we needn't go any farther! You can stop here, call it a day's work, and leave me be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 完全不是！一点也不是。我觉得我们已经走得够远了，没必要再继续下去了！你可以到此为止，结束今天的工作，让我一个人待着吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fantastic! What wonderful news. It will make my request all the easier for you to complete!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太棒了！真是个好消息。这下你就能更轻松地完成我的请求了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My dear Usurper... I am taken aback, I do not know what to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我亲爱的篡位者……我很惊讶，不知该说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is your... infatuation with me one of casual interest, passing fancy, physical attraction, or perhaps the love of a springtime youth? Or...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对我的迷恋，是泛泛的兴趣、一时兴起的迷恋、肉体上的吸引，还是青春期的懵懂爱恋？又或者……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would say that I will miss them, but they will not end, not precisely, if you complete my request.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想说我会想念这些谈话，但如果你满足我的请求，这一切就不会结束，至少不会完全结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I need you to use your gifts over my Protoframe mind and wipe it clean of all of this nonsense. Before it is too late. Before you baulk, I know you have this gift. Simply punch the floor or the table or whatever it is you have to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我需要你运用你的天赋，清除我原型战甲记忆中所有这些乱七八糟的东西。趁现在还来得及。我知道你有这种天赋，别犹豫。只要捶下地板、桌子或做其他任何你需要做的事就行了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You needn't keep digging up memories from me to get the butler to go upstairs, I am certain! It will be quite all right.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不用继续帮我找回记忆才能让管家上楼，我敢肯定这点！一切都会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply think that we have gone far enough. You can stop here, call it a day's work, and leave me be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得我们已经走得够远了。你可以到此为止，结束今天的工作，让我一个人待着吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Strike my mind clean. Let us go no farther.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 彻底清除我的记忆。我们到此为止吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Whatever gives you that impression?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是什么让你产生这种印象？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Whatever is giving you the impression that something is wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是什么让你觉得出了什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply think that we have gone far enough, and we needn't go any farther! You can stop here, call it a day's work, and leave me be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得我们已经走得够远了，没必要再继续下去了！你可以到此为止，结束今天的工作，让我一个人待着吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Whatever gives you that impression?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是什么让你产生这种印象？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Whatever is giving you the impression that something is wrong?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是什么让你觉得出了什么问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then why not trade dueling my imaginary body for the real one? I am certain we could find somewhere to spar in real life if you wish to do that instead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那为什么不放弃与我虚拟身体的较量，转而与我真实的身体进行实战呢？我相信，如果你想的话，我们肯定能找到地方在现实生活中切磋一番。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think I care?! Those two zealots would be none the wiser. Like idiot fish in a tank (no offense to Fibonacci) they would go on blissfully unawares.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你以为我会在乎吗？！那两个狂热分子根本不会察觉。就像鱼缸里的傻鱼一样（无意冒犯斐波那契），他们会继续浑然不觉地快乐生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Something horrible awaits me, Usurper. Some terrible realization on the crest of that hill. I can feel it gathering like storm clouds in my mind. I can see its sickly yellow glow upon the horizon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，可怕的事情正在等着我。山顶之上，我将领悟到某种可怕的真相。我能感觉到它像暴风雨前的乌云一样在我脑海中聚集。我能看到地平线上那病态的黄色光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Those are words I have never...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我从未听过这些话……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Memories that I know I do not wish to recall. Corpses of the dead I desperately wish to remain buried in my mind. Please. I beg you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些我明知不愿回忆的记忆。那些逝者的尸骸，我多么希望它们永远埋葬在我的脑海深处。求求你，我恳求你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Suddenly all that I came here to say, all that I came here to beg you for falls away like sand through my fingers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 突然间，我来这里想要说的一切，我来这里想要恳求你的一切，都像指缝间的沙子一样消散了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am trying to spare you the labor and pain of traversing the Dark Refractory on my accord. I am merely trying to be gracious, Usurper. Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​这样​做​是​为了​让​你​免​去​独​自穿​越​深​溯池​的​辛劳​和​痛苦。​我​只​是​想​对​你​宽容​一些，​篡位者。​拜托​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see! Is this not simply typical?! Derided for being cruel. Mocked for being "the Devil." Immured and castigated for being Orokin. But when I am being "nice" it is cause for suspicion?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我明白了！这难道不是典型的套路吗？！因为残忍而被嘲笑，因为是"恶魔"而被讥讽，因为是奥罗金人而被囚禁和谴责。但当我表现得"友善"时，却成了被怀疑的理由？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Vow it. Give me your word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 发誓。向我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am trying to spare you the labor and pain of traversing the Dark Refractory on my accord. I am merely trying to be gracious, Usurper. Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我​这样​做​是​为了​让​你​免​去​独​自穿​越​深​溯池​的​辛劳​和​痛苦。​我​只​是​想​对​你​宽容​一些，​篡位者。​拜托​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see! Is this not simply typical?! Derided for being cruel. Mocked for being "the Devil." Immured and castigated for being Orokin. But when I am being "nice" it is cause for suspicion?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我明白了！这难道不是典型的套路吗？！因为残忍而被嘲笑，因为是"恶魔"而被讥讽，因为是奥罗金人而被囚禁和谴责。但当我表现得"友善"时，却成了被怀疑的理由？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Vow it. Give me your word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 发誓。向我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Clear away all my recollection of our conversations and put us back at the beginning before it is too late. We might begin again, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 清除我所有关于我们对话的记忆，趁一切还来得及，让我们回到最初。我们或许可以重新开始，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Trite and unimportant.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 平庸且无关紧要了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think I care?! Those two zealots would be none the wiser. Like idiot fish in a tank (no offense to Fibonacci) they would go on blissfully unawares.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你以为我会在乎吗？！那两个狂热分子根本不会察觉。就像鱼缸里的傻鱼一样（无意冒犯斐波那契），他们会继续浑然不觉地快乐生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see no path forward but one where I must be honest. I... I know something horrible awaits me, Usurper. Some terrible realization on the crest of that hill. I can feel it gathering like storm clouds in my mind. I can see its sickly yellow glow upon the horizon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 坦白说，我看不到任何出路。篡位者，可怕的事情正在等着我。山顶之上，我将领悟到某种可怕的真相。我能感觉到它像暴风雨前的乌云一样在我脑海中聚集。我能看到地平线上那病态的黄色光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well... But I am trusting you, Usurper. And I do not do kindly when whatever limited trust I extend in this world is proven to be done in error.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧……但我信任你，篡位者。而我那为数不多的信任，若被证明是错付，我绝不会善罢甘休。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well... But I am trusting you, Usurper. And I do not do kindly when whatever limited trust I extend in this world is proven to be done in error.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧……但我信任你，篡位者。而我那为数不多的信任，若被证明是错付，我绝不会善罢甘休。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Think of it, endless evergreen experiences with me. I will never tire of it. You may argue with me to your heart's content! I will fall for you over and over again as though we had never met.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想​想​看，​和​我​在​一起，​将​会​拥有​无穷​无尽​的​美好​回忆。​我​永远​不​会​厌倦。​你​可以​尽情地​和​我​争论！​我​会​一​次​又​一​次​地为​你​倾倒，​仿佛​我们​之前​从​未​相遇。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Something horrible awaits me, Usurper. Some terrible realization on the crest of that hill. I can feel it gathering like storm clouds in my mind. I can see its sickly yellow glow upon the horizon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，可怕的事情正在等着我。山顶之上，我将领悟到某种可怕的真相。我能感觉到它像暴风雨前的乌云一样在我脑海中聚集。我能看到地平线上那病态的黄色光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Memories that I know I do not wish to recall. Corpses of the dead I desperately wish to remain buried in my mind. Please. I beg you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些我明知不愿回忆的记忆。那些逝者的尸骸，我多么希望它们永远埋葬在我的脑海深处。求求你，我恳求你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot win. I simply cannot win. Very well! You wish to know the truth?! Here it is!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我赢不了。我根本赢不了。好吧！你想知道真相？！真相就是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not dare accuse me of cowardice! You, who hid yourself away in a storybook world for countless centuries, afraid to face reality!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟敢指责我是懦夫！你，才是躲在童话世界里无数个世纪，不敢面对现实的人！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you should be! Now, I shall ask kindly again, will you never set foot into the Dark Refractory on my account? Please?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你就该道歉！现在，我再恳求你，请你务必，为了我，停止穿越深溯池的任务好吗？拜托了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not dare accuse me of cowardice! You, who hid yourself away in a storybook world for countless centuries, afraid to face reality!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟敢指责我是懦夫！你，才是躲在童话世界里无数个世纪，不敢面对现实的人！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot win. I simply cannot win. Very well! You wish to know the truth?! Here it is!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我赢不了。我根本赢不了。好吧！你想知道真相？！真相就是：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you should be! Now, I shall ask again, will you please, kindly, ever so kindly, stop your task of traversing the Dark Refractory on my account? Please?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你就该道歉！现在，我再说一遍，恳求你，请你务必，为了我，停止穿越深溯池的任务好吗？拜托了？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then this whole conversation was simply to placate me? You are a sycophant of the worst order, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，你跟我说的这些只是为了哄我？篡位者，你还真是那种最恶劣的马屁精。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Something horrible awaits me, Usurper. Some terrible realization on the crest of that hill. I can feel it gathering like storm clouds in my mind. I can see its sickly yellow glow upon the horizon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，可怕的事情正在等着我。山顶之上，我将领悟到某种可怕的真相。我能感觉到它像暴风雨前的乌云一样在我脑海中聚集。我能看到地平线上那病态的黄色光芒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Please. I am begging you. Use your gifts. Clean the slate. Take this all away from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 求求你，我恳求你，用你的天赋，让我重新开始，把这一切都从我身边带走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Memories that I know I do not wish to recall. Corpses of the dead I desperately wish to remain buried in my mind. I had come here to beg you to use your powers to wipe my mind of all of this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有些记忆，我知道自己不想再回忆。那些死者的尸体，我多么希望它们永远埋葬在我的记忆深处。我来到这里，恳求你用你的力量，将这一切从我的记忆中抹去……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Clear away all my recollection of our conversations and put us back at the beginning before it is too late. We might begin again, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 清除我所有关于我们对话的记忆，趁一切还来得及，让我们回到最初。我们或许可以重新开始，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Something horrible awaits me, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，可怕的事情正在等着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well, on we go! Let us see what lies over that horizon together!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好，那我们继续下去！让我们一起看看地平线那边有什么吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well, on we go! Let us see what lies over that horizon together!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好，那我们继续下去！让我们一起看看地平线那边有什么吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You would have made a brilliant Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你倒是挺适合当奥罗金人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Memories that I know I do not wish to recall. Corpses of the dead I desperately wish to remain buried in my mind. I need you to stop. You do not understand how imperative this is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些我明知自己不想回忆的记忆。那些死者的尸体，我多么希望它们永远埋葬在我的脑海里。我需要你停下来。你不明白这有多么重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To clear away all my recollection of our conversations and put us back at the beginning before it was too late. Now, I am laughing at the foolishness of it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 抹去我对我们对话的所有记忆，趁一切还来得及，让我们回到最初。现在，我只能嘲笑这一切的愚蠢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Memories that I know I do not wish to recall. Corpses of the dead I desperately wish to remain buried in my mind. I need you never to reach that final floor. You do not understand how imperative this is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些我明知自己不想回忆的记忆。那些死者的尸体，我多么希望它们永远埋葬在我的脑海里。我希望你永远不要到达最后一层。你不明白这有多么重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: See that you keep it, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，一定要保证好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: See that you keep it, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，一定要保证好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We must stop before it is too late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们必须趁还来得及之前阻止这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Together." What a laughable concept. All my centuries of life, and do you see how many friends I have around me? Do you see how many companions have lasted by my side?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "一起。"多么可笑的概念。我活了这么多年，你看看我身边有多少朋友？你看看有多少伙伴一直陪伴在我身边？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Vow it. Give me your word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 发誓。向我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And trying to hide my tears from the prying eyes of those around me in the Sanctum...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我努力不让圣所里周围人的窥视目光捕捉到我的泪水……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Together." What a laughable concept. All my centuries of life, and do you see how many friends I have around me? Do you see how many companions have lasted by my side?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "一起。"多么可笑的概念。我活了这么多年，你看看我身边有多少朋友？你看看有多少伙伴一直陪伴在我身边？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And lo, I will undoubtedly ask you to do it again! It is almost as though you are accustomed to living in perpetual spirals and loops of time!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 瞧，我肯定还会再请你做一遍！你好像已经习惯了生活在永恒的时间漩涡和循环中！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Vow it. Give me your word.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 发誓。向我保证。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know how many turned their backs and walked from me? And those that didn't are dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道有多少人背弃我离我而去吗？那些没有离开的人都死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know how many turned their backs and walked from me? And those that didn't are dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道有多少人背弃我离我而去吗？那些没有离开的人都死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is how you exist, isn't it?! So allow me to join you in this purgatory! Just do not send me to hell instead, Usurper. Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这就是你的存在方式，不是吗？！那就让我和你一起待在这炼狱里吧！只是别把我送入地狱，篡位者。求你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Together." What a laughable concept. All my centuries of life, and do you see how many friends I have around me? Do you see how many companions have lasted by my side?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "一起。"多么可笑的概念。我活了这么多年，你看看我身边有多少朋友？你看看有多少伙伴一直陪伴在我身边？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Together." What a laughable concept. All my centuries of life, and do you see how many friends I have around me? Do you see how many companions have lasted by my side?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "一起。"多么可笑的概念。我活了这么多年，你看看我身边有多少朋友？你看看有多少伙伴一直陪伴在我身边？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your naïvety is charming. If too cloyingly sweet. We shall see how long it lasts, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​的​天真​很​可爱，​只是​可​爱​得​过​分​了。​我们​走​着​瞧，​篡位者，​这​天​真能​持续​多久。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then this whole conversation was simply to placate me? You are a sycophant of the worst order, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，你跟我说的这些只是为了哄我？篡位者，你还真是那种最恶劣的马屁精。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it does not matter now. Because if you took away my memories of our conversations together, I would... I would lose this, as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但现在这一切都不重要了。因为如果你抹去我与我们交谈的记忆，我……我也会失去这一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you think I care?! Those two zealots would have been none the wiser. Like idiot fish in a tank (no offense to Fibonacci) they would go on blissfully unawares.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你以为我会在乎吗？！那两个狂热分子根本不会察觉。就像鱼缸里的傻鱼一样（无意冒犯斐波那契），他们会继续浑然不觉地快乐生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your naïvety is charming. If too cloyingly sweet. We shall see how long it lasts, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​的​天真​很​可爱，​只是​可​爱​得​过​分​了。​我们​走​着​瞧，​篡位者，​这​天​真能​持续​多久。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then this whole conversation was simply to placate me? You are a sycophant of the worst order, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，你跟我说的这些只是为了哄我？篡位者，你还真是那种最恶劣的马屁精。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know how many turned their backs and walked from me? And those that didn't are dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道有多少人背弃我离我而去吗？那些没有离开的人都死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know how many turned their backs and walked from me? And those that didn't are dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道有多少人背弃我离我而去吗？那些没有离开的人都死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You would have made a brilliant Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你倒是挺适合当奥罗金人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I do not know what waits for me. Perhaps you will despise me when it is revealed to us. Perhaps I will despise myself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道等待我的是什么。或许当真相大白时，你会鄙视我。或许我会鄙视我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Friend." What a laughable concept. All my centuries of life, and do you see how many friends I have around me? Do you see how many companions have lasted by my side?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "朋友。"多么可笑的概念。我活了这么多年，你看看我身边有多少朋友？你看看有多少伙伴一直陪伴在我身边？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You would have made a brilliant Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你倒是挺适合当奥罗金人的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your naïvety is charming. If too cloyingly sweet. We shall see how long it lasts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​的​天真​很​可爱，​只是​可​爱​得​过​分​了。​我们​走​着​瞧，​这​天​真能​持续​多久。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your naïvety is charming. If too cloyingly sweet. We shall see how long it lasts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​的​天真​很​可爱，​只是​可​爱​得​过​分​了。​我们​走​着​瞧，​这​天​真能​持续​多久。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thank you, Usurper. Thank you. And I am certain I will be most foully angry at you when I realize what you have done. But in my soul, I shall forever be in your debt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你，篡位者。谢谢你。我知道，当未来的我意识到你所做的一切时，我一定会对你怒不可遏。但在我内心深处，我将永远感激你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yet I would rather greet oblivion itself with the knowledge that love could possibly have been mine, then spend one more day without it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我宁愿带着曾经拥有过爱情的认知迎接遗忘，也不愿再过一天没有爱情的日子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you know how many turned their backs and walked from me? And those that didn't are dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道有多少人背弃我离我而去吗？那些没有离开的人都死了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Thank you, Usurper. Thank you. And I am certain I will be most foully angry at you when I realize what you have done. But in my soul, I shall forever be in your debt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 谢谢你，篡位者。谢谢你。我知道，当未来的我意识到你所做的一切时，我一定会对你怒不可遏。但在我内心深处，我将永远感激你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your naïvety is charming. If too cloyingly sweet. We shall see how long it lasts, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你​的​天真​很​可爱，​只是​可​爱​得​过​分​了。​我们​走​着​瞧，​篡位者，​这​天​真能​持续​多久。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Come what may, no matter how I may fight you... thank you, Usurper. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论发生什么，无论我如何与你吵……谢谢你，篡位者。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm? An interesting question. What was it "like?" I honestly do not recall much of it. And the stars and sculptures that contained those memories have likely long since turned to dust or rendered to Endo by now, I assume.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？有趣的问题。是"怎样"的？说实话，我记不太清了。而且，那些承载着记忆的阿耶檀识之星和塑像，我想现在大概早已化为尘埃，或者被烧成内融核心了吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I fear I can only recall the briefest images of it, as it was so very long ago. Much of it I wonder if I did not imagine it as if in a dream, or as though I am assigning imagery to the events I have read in a history book.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恐怕我只能回忆起一些零星的片段，因为那已经是很久以前的事了。很多时候，我甚至怀疑自己是不是在做梦，或者只是在把历史书上的情节想象出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ergo, what I can recall is likely to be terribly unreliable, I admit. Why do you ask?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因此，我承认，我的记忆很可能非常不可靠。你为什么这么问？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was bundled off to what the zealots would call a "boarding school" at a young age, like all Orokin youth destined for greatness. There I was tested and trained for proclivities and aptitudes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我小时候就被送往狂热分子所谓的"寄宿学校"，就像所有注定要成就伟业的奥罗金青年一样。在那里，我接受了各种倾向和天赋的测试和训练。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I agree, the lies we tell ourselves are often more important than the truth. A wonderful insight, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认同，我们对自己撒的谎往往比真相更重要。篡位者，真是精辟的见解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Attempting to discern where precisely I went "wrong" are you? I see! How amusing. I do not know as you will find much in my childhood to give you the answers you seek.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你是试图找出我究竟"做错了"什么？我明白了！真有趣。不过恐怕你在我的童年里，未必能找到你想要的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My entire young life. I do not think I ever saw the two who spawned me ever again. Perhaps at the ceremony when I as announced as top of ranking class?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的整个青春岁月。我想我再也没见过我的两位父母。或许是在宣布我获得班级第一名的典礼上见过？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think the opinion would differ wildly depending on to whom you were speaking. When I first arrived, the beatings I received from the older boys were swift and the lessons were brutally efficient.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为这个问题会因人而异，看法也可能大相径庭。我刚到的时候，那些高年级的男生打我毫不留情，教训也极其残酷有效。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I believe that was the first time they ever saw fit to lay claim to me. I do not pay it much mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我相信那是他们第一次声称拥有我的所有权。我并不太在意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I am, in all things, a quick study. And I learned that if I wished to excel in that particular avenue of Archimedea, I had best apply creative techniques lest I be caught up with the dregs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我学习能力很强，什么事都能很快上手。我明白，如果我想在科研的这个特定领域有所建树，最好运用创造性的技巧，以免沦为平庸之辈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not remember much of my parents. While some Orokin were keen to raise their own spawn, mine were not. They were eager enough to be rid of me and to move on with their own lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对父母的记忆不多。虽然有些奥罗金人热衷于抚养自己的后代，但我的父母却并非如此。他们急于摆脱我，开始他们自己的生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My poor Usurper, it was the Headmaster himself who brought a bottle of Kuva and one of the servant boys when things went too far with one of the new initiates one evening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可怜的篡位者，当晚那些新生把事情闹得太过火，是校长亲自带来一瓶赤毒和一个男仆来收场的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tradition is a powerful tool, Usurper. A powerful and dangerous tool that can be used to keep many a sane man locked into insane ways of thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，传统是一件强大的工具。一件强大而危险的工具，它能让许多理智的人陷入疯狂的思维模式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Quite the opposite. Because of my lack of familial attachments, I had more time to dedicate to the militaristic strategies that seemed archaic and antiquated to my peers.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恰恰相反。由于缺乏家庭牵绊，我有更多的时间投入到那些在同龄人看来古老过时的军事战略中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tradition is a powerful tool. A powerful and dangerous tool that can be used to keep many a sane man locked into insane ways of thinking.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 传统是一件强大的工具。一件强大而危险的工具，它能让许多理智的人陷入疯狂的思维模式。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was the Headmaster himself who brought a bottle of Kuva and one of the servant boys when things went too far with one of the new initiates one evening.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当晚那些新生把事情闹得太过火，是校长亲自带来一瓶赤毒和一个男仆来收场的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Little did they know how much that would come to my aid in the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们当时并不知道，这件事日后会对我帮助有多大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. I kept to myself. I learned that fear is an easy thing to create and wield in others, but it is a delicate lacy ice that is melted with any exposure to light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我一直独来独往。我明白，恐惧很容易制造，也容易被他人利用，但它就像一层脆弱的冰，一遇阳光就会融化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Little did my peers know how much the studies would do to aid me in the future. But if you are asking as to a net win or loss?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的同龄人当时并不知道这些学习经历会在未来对我的帮助有多大。但如果你问的是最终是得是失呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. I have. But such is the way of things when you live the life of a devil, is it not? Even then, I was seen as either the powerless second-hand and the concubine or the bloody warlord and the rampaging monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的。但这就是恶魔生活的必然结果，不是吗？即使在那时，人们要么把我视为无权无势的二流货色和男宠，要么把我视为嗜血的军阀和横冲直撞的怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Monsters must be kept in the dark. And if I was to maintain an aura of danger around me, then I would have to stay alone.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 怪物必须被关在黑暗中。如果我要一直保持危险的气场，那就只能独来独往。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. I do not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，我不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was never welcome amongst those above my station or those below. And I had no peers to speak of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我既不受高位人欢迎，也不受底下的人欢迎。而且，我也没有真正意义上的同辈人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose we shall see. Won't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我们很快就会知道了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter, pardon the quick interruption. But there has been an incident I fear you must attend to.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，请原谅我突然打断你。但恐怕你必须去处理一件突发事件。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As amusing as it is for me, it will undermine all our efforts here in the Sanctum if we allow it to go unchecked.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我觉得这很有趣，但如果我们不加以制止，它将破坏我们在圣所里所做的一切努力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, I do not know the details precisely. Only that I was called to break up a screaming match between Marie and Tagfer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不太清楚具体细节，只知道我被叫去制止玛丽和标弃之间的激烈争吵。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bird Three was inconsolable and would not tell me the nature of the conversation, and Loid did not witness it. Only Fibonacci would tell me that it had "something to do with Entrati."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 鸟三伤心欲绝，不肯告诉我谈话的内容，洛德也没有亲眼目睹发生了什么。只有斐波那契告诉我，这"跟英择谛有关"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know how her sycophancy can be in regards to "le Cardinal." I am not surprised it finally came to a head with Tagfer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道她对"主教"有多谄媚。所以，事情最终在标弃那里爆发，我一点也不意外。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would contend with this myself, however the floating botfly hardly listens to my words of wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本想亲自应对这种情况，然而，那只漂浮的牛虻却根本不听我的劝告。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Best of luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All through this madness, since the moment my memories vanished, I have felt this... clawing. This tearing at my chest, at my skin, like some great beast as been desperate to get free of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在这场疯狂之中，自从我的记忆消失的那一刻起，我就一直感到这种……撕扯。这种感觉撕扯着我的胸膛，我的皮肤，就像某种巨大的野兽拼命想要挣脱我的束缚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: At first, I assumed it to be Uriel. Why would it not? Another mind, another shattered, broken, forsaken soul. Condemned for deeds he did not choose to commit.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 起初，我以为是 Uriel。怎么不是呢？另一个心灵，另一个破碎、残缺、被遗弃的灵魂。他因并非自己选择犯下的罪行而受谴责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Maligned, misunderstood, anathema. Cast down from the heavens and left to rot. Kindred spirits, indeed!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 遭人诋毁，被人误解，被人唾弃。从天上被贬下，任其腐朽。我们真是让我惺惺相惜啊！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know this not our first time through this. I remember being here once before. And I know it may not be our last. I continually ask you to stop here and begin again, and it means the world to me that you do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道这一切不是我们的第一次经历了。我记得之前也发展到这里。我也知道这或许不会是最后一次。我一直恳求你停下来，重新开始，而你真的这么做了，这对我意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know this not our first time through this. I remember being here once before. And I know it may not be our last. I continually ask you to stop here and begin again, and it means the world to me that you do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道这一切不是我们的第一次经历了。我记得之前也发展到这里。我也知道这或许不会是最后一次。我一直恳求你停下来，重新开始，而你真的这么做了，这对我意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know this not our first time through this. I remember being here once before. And I know it may not be our last. I continually ask you to stop here and begin again, and it means the world to me that you do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道这一切不是我们的第一次经历了。我记得之前也发展到这里。我也知道这或许不会是最后一次。我一直恳求你停下来，重新开始，而你真的这么做了，这对我意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must commend you, Usurper, for doing as I asked and going no farther into the Dark Refractory and my memories in The Descendia. Regardless of no promise between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我必须称赞你，因为你听从了我的要求，没有进一步深入深溯池，也没有触及我在沉沦之地中的记忆。尽管我们之间没有任何约定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Darling, I must commend you for keeping your word and going no farther in The Descendia and the Dark Refractory and not recovering the final memories of mine. It means the world to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我必须称赞你信守承诺，没有继续深入沉沦之地和深溯池，也没有找回我最后的记忆。这对我意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Darling, I must commend you for doing as I asked and going no farther into the Dark Refractory and my memories in The Descendia. It means the world to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我必须称赞你听从了我的请求，没有继续深入深溯池，也没有触及我在沉沦之地中的记忆。这对我意义重大。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must commend you, Usurper, for keeping your word and going no farther in The Descendia and the Dark Refractory and not recovering the final memories of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我必须称赞你信守承诺，没有继续深入沉沦之地和深溯池，也没有找回我最后的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must commend you, Usurper, for doing as I asked and going no farther into the Dark Refractory and my memories in The Descendia. Regardless of no promise between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，我必须称赞你，因为你听从了我的要求，没有进一步深入深溯池，也没有触及我在沉沦之地中的记忆。尽管我们之间没有任何约定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When the conscripts came, three energies twisted up within my own, the fourth was not so surprising then. This great horrible thing that yearned to split me apart like the crust of the planets to spill forth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当那些征召者到来时，我体内三种能量交织在一起，第四种能量的出现也就不足为奇了。这股巨大而可怕的力量渴望将我撕裂，如同行星的地壳倾泻而出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That I have found such a place in your heart that you keep me in such a purgatorial state? Thank you, my pet. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我竟然在你心中占据了如此重要的位置，以至于你让我一直处于这种炼狱般的境地？谢谢你，我的宠物。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I remember your promise to me. And that I have found such friendship with you, that you keep me in such a purgatorial state? Thank you, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我记得你对我的承诺。而我竟然与你建立了如此深厚的友谊，以至于你让我一直处于这种炼狱般的境地？谢谢你，我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And that I have found such friendship with you, that you keep me in such a purgatorial state? Thank you, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我竟然与你建立了如此深厚的友谊，以至于你让我一直处于这种炼狱般的境地？谢谢你，我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I still feel it gnawing away at the back of my mind, it is like a kubrow barking at the end of a leash. Manageable. Trainable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然这件事仍然让我耿耿于怀，但它就像一只被拴着的库狛，吠叫着，可以被控制，可以被训练。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I still feel it gnawing away at the back of my mind, it is like a kubrow barking at the end of a leash. Manageable. Trainable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然这件事仍然让我耿耿于怀，但它就像一只被拴着的库狛，吠叫着，可以被控制，可以被训练。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What would be one more?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 再多一个又怎样？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I still feel it gnawing away at the back of my mind, it is like a kubrow barking at the end of a leash. Manageable. Trainable.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I still feel it gnawing away at the back of my mind, it is like a kubrow barking at the end of a leash. Manageable. Trainable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然这件事仍然让我耿耿于怀，但它就像一只被拴着的库狛，吠叫着，可以被控制，可以被训练。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it was not Uriel, was it? It was not Uriel that made my skin crawl and made me want to rip my face from my skull.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但那不是因为 Uriel，对吧？让我毛骨悚然、恨不得把自己的脸从头骨上撕下来的，不是 Uriel。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was the decision I made to put him there within me. Willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而是我自愿决定把他放在我身体里的决定。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not take any more of your day, my darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我不会再占用你宝贵的时间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not take any more of your day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会再占用你宝贵的时间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not take any more of your day, my darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我不会再占用你宝贵的时间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not take any more of your day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会再占用你宝贵的时间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And now I remember, Drifter darling. I remember how desperately I begged you to be free of them. And how you vowed you would do so. And you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱​的​漂泊者，​我​现在​想​起来​了。​我​记得​我​曾经​那么​拼命​地求​你​帮忙​摆脱​它们。​你​也​发誓​你​会​做到。​而​你​也​做​到​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And now I remember, Drifter darling. Now I remember what I asked and what you refused to do. I asked you to wipe my mind clear of these thoughts, and you said no. Yet here we are, regardless. Are we not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱​的​漂泊者，​我​现在​想​起来​了。现在我想起来了，我曾请求你做什么，而你却拒绝了。我请求你帮我清除这些记忆，你却拒绝了。然而，我们最终还是走到这一步，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And now I remember. I remember how desperately I begged you to be free of them. And how you vowed you would do so. And you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: ​我​现在​想​起来​了。​我​记得​我​曾经​那么​拼命​地求​你​帮忙​摆脱​它们。​你​也​发誓​你​会​做到。​而​你​也​做​到​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And now I remember. Now I remember what I asked and what you refused to do. I asked you to wipe my mind clear of these thoughts, and you said no. Yet here we are, regardless. Are we not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: ​我​现在​想​起来​了。现在我想起来了，我曾请求你做什么，而你却拒绝了。我请求你帮我清除这些记忆，你却拒绝了。然而，我们最终还是走到这一步，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I should have known. I should have known not to trust you, you Void-born anomaly! Did you know what lay in wait for me there?! Did you somehow know the truth of it when I did not?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我早该知道的。我早该知道不该相信你，你这个虚空的异类！你知道等着我的真相是什么？！你知道真相，而我却一无所知？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You gave me your word. Your word! But now I find that you are nothing but a liar!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你曾向我许诺，你曾许诺！但现在我发现你不过是个骗子！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And here we are, once more, back where we began. Treading once more upon the corpses of our past. No better than where we were before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们又一次回到了原点，再次踏上了过去的尸骸。我们和以前一样，并没有变得更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For reasons entirely free of my own pleading, it seems! Yet I recall the agony of my choice to take that serum all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来这结果并不是因为我求来的！但我仍然记得当初选择注射血清时的痛苦。
