/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们又一次回到了原点，再次踏上了过去的尸骸。我们和以前一样，并没有变得更好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For reasons entirely free of my own pleading, it seems! Yet I recall the agony of my choice to take that serum all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来这结果并不是因为我求来的！但我仍然记得当初选择注射血清时的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You spoke words to me once that I did not know could have ever been real. Tell me once more that they were true. Say them to me. Please. I need them now. More than ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你曾对我说过一些话，我当时觉得它们根本不可能成真。请你再告诉我一次，那些话都是真的。请你再说一遍。求你了。我现在比以往任何时候都更需要它们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Did you know?! Did you?! And did you find your way to my side, whispering words of fondness, hoping to soften the blow that would follow?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你知道吗？！你知道吗？！你是不是偷偷溜到我身边，轻声细语地安慰我，希望能减轻接下来的打击？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You gave me your word. Your word! And you sweetened them so wonderfully with words of fondness. But now I find that you are nothing but a liar!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你曾向我许下诺言。你的诺言！你还用甜言蜜语美化了它。但现在我发现，你不过是个骗子！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How laughable. How utterly laughable. I cannot win. I simply cannot win!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可笑。真是太可笑了。我赢不了。我根本赢不了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How laughable. How utterly laughable. I cannot win. I simply cannot win!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可笑。真是太可笑了。我赢不了。我根本赢不了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Did you withhold this from me, only to reveal it now? Has this all been a sick game to you?! Feeding that thing that hid inside of me, knowing what would come for me?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你一直瞒着我，现在才告诉我？这一切对你来说是不是一场变态的游戏？！你明知我会因此受到惩罚，却还故意放纵我内心深处的欲望？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I told you to end your ventures into my mind before it was too late! I told you to stop your work, and yet... and yet!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我告诉过你，趁现在还来得及，停止你对我记忆的探索！我告诉过你，停止你的工作，可是……可是！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What now, darling? What now..? I feel at the end of my proverbial rope. At least before, I had the shelter of my indignity!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在怎么办，亲爱的？现在怎么办……？我感觉自己已经走投无路了。至少以前，我还有屈辱作为庇护！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What now, Usurper? What now..? I feel at the end of my proverbial rope. At least before, I had the shelter of my indignity!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在怎么办，篡位者？现在怎么办……？我感觉自己已经走投无路了。至少以前，我还有屈辱作为庇护！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I understand. Believe me, more than you do. I understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我明白。相信我，我比你更明白。我明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Did you withhold this from me, only to reveal it now? Has this all been a sick game to you?! Feeding that thing that hid inside of me, knowing what would come for me?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你一直瞒着我，现在才告诉我？这一切对你来说是不是一场变态的游戏？！你明知我会因此受到惩罚，却还故意放纵我内心深处的欲望？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I told you to end your ventures into my mind before it was too late! I told you to stop your work, and yet... and yet!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我告诉过你，趁现在还来得及，停止你对我记忆的探索！我告诉过你，停止你的工作，可是……可是！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Look at what you have done!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看看你都做了些什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Look what you have done!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看看你都做了些什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, I know... here it is. Begin the spiral once more. Turn back the clock. "Begin again" as it were, yes? End this agony in me. Start over once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，​我​知道​了​……​要​不​这样。​再次​开始​这​螺​旋式​的​循环。​让​时间​倒流。​"重新​开始"，​对​吗？​结束​我​内心​的​痛苦。​重新​开始。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, I know... here it is. Begin the spiral once more. Turn back the clock. "Begin again" as it were, yes? End this agony in me. Start over once more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，​我​知道​了​……​要​不​这样。​再次​开始​这​螺​旋式​的​循环。​让​时间​倒流。​"重新​开始"，​对​吗？​结束​我​内心​的​痛苦。​重新​开始。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it will not soften the hardness of what will now follow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这并不能减轻接下来将要面临的残酷现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh, my dearest Drifter... you have given me the greatest gift. I... I do not know how to thank you for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，我最亲爱的漂泊者……你给了我最珍贵的礼物。我……我不知道该如何感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Look what you have done!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看看你都做了些什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Look what you have done!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看看你都做了些什么！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I demand you fix this. I know you can! Use this gift of yours and clear my mind of these memories!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我要求你解决这个问题。我知道你能做到！运用你的天赋，清除我脑海中的这些记忆！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I demand you fix this. I know you can! Use this gift of yours and clear my mind of these memories!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我要求你解决这个问题。我知道你能做到！运用你的天赋，清除我脑海中的这些记忆！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply do not know what to do with it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真不知道该怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I demand you fix this. I know you can! Use this gift of yours and clear my mind of these memories!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我要求你解决这个问题。我知道你能做到！运用你的天赋，清除我脑海中的这些记忆！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I demand you fix this. I know you can! Use this gift of yours and clear my mind of these memories! If you have ever had any fondness for me, show me!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我要求你解决这个问题。我知道你能做到！运用你的天赋，清除我脑海中这些痛苦的记忆！如果你曾经对我有过一丝好感，那就让我知道！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am aware. Painfully aware.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我明白。痛苦地明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes! I do! Please! You've done it once before, why not just do it again! It was not so hard the first time, was it?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的！我想！求你了！既然你以前做过一次，为什么不再做一次呢！第一次也没那么难，对吧？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you want to know the truth, Drifter? the sad, pathetic, empty truth of it all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你想知道真相吗？想知道这一切悲哀、可悲、空虚的真相吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am aware. Painfully aware.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我明白。痛苦地明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes! I do! Please! You've done it once before, why not just do it again! It was not so hard the first time, was it?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的！我想！求你了！既然你以前做过一次，为什么不再做一次呢！第一次也没那么难，对吧？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you want to know the truth, Drifter? the sad, pathetic, empty truth of it all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你想知道真相吗？想知道这一切悲哀、可悲、空虚的真相吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter dear, I am begging you now. If you ever cared for me, ever felt any truth in those words that you once said, then I ask you to do one last thing for me. And this request I ask of you now is in your own interests.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，我现在求求你了。如果你曾经在乎过我，如果你曾经相信过你说过的话，那么我请求你为我做最后一件事。而我此刻的请求，其实也是为了你好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pardon me if I find that extremely hard to believe. We are defined by the moments in our lives. We are merely a string of memories that lead us into the next. That is why memories are - were - so sacred to the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恕我直言，我很难相信这一点。我们是由生命中的各个瞬间定义的。我们不过是一串串的记忆，引领我们走向下一个瞬间。这就是为什么记忆对奥罗金人来说如此神圣——过去是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not dare - do not dare to speak to me of "calming down!" Do you not think I have every right to feel as though I am being torn in half?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟敢——你竟敢跟我提什么"冷静点"！难道你不觉得我有充分的理由感到自己快要被撕成两半吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fascinating. Fascinating and unexpected. Explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真有意思。既有意思又出乎意料。请解释一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was not...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没想到事情会……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh yes, "face it." Like I did when I took the serum from Entrati and ran from my fate like a coward?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，是啊，"面对现实"。就像我当初从英择谛那里拿到血清，像个懦夫一样逃避命运？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know who I am anymore...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我都不知道自己是谁了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know who I am anymore...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我都不知道自己是谁了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you ever wish for the butler to go upstairs and reconcile with the Entrati family, you must do as I say. You must.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你希望管家上楼去和英择谛一家和解，你就必须听我的。你必须听我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I become who I choose to become of my own accord? Very well. I choose this;
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我能够成为我想成为的人？很好。那我选择这样；

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I become who I choose to become of my own accord? Very well. I choose this;
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我能够成为我想成为的人？很好。那我选择这样；

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not dare - do not dare to speak to me of "calming down!" Do you not think I have every right to feel as though I am being torn in half?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟敢——你竟敢跟我提什么"冷静点"！难道你不觉得我有充分的理由感到自己快要被撕成两半吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pardon me if I find that extremely hard to believe. We are defined by the moments in our lives. We are merely a string of memories that lead us into the next. That is why memories are - were - so sacred to the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恕我直言，我很难相信这一点。我们是由生命中的各个瞬间定义的。我们不过是一串串的记忆，引领我们走向下一个瞬间。这就是为什么记忆对奥罗金人来说如此神圣——过去是这样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fascinating. Fascinating and unexpected. Explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真有意思。既有意思又出乎意料。请解释一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was not...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没想到事情会……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. We do not have to face this together. Use your gifts and wipe this all away. Now!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，我们不必共同面对这一切。运用你的天赋，把这一切都抹去吧！现在就做！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I have had that definition of myself recently entirely rewritten. I have had it stamped upon my psyche in an ink that runs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我最近对自己的定义已被彻底改写。它已深深烙印在我的灵魂深处，如同墨迹般清晰可见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I feel as though I have had the very understanding of myself, the very basis of my foundation, cracked and torn open like damnable Lua herself! Rewritten in ink that runs. Coward!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我感觉自己对自己的认知，我赖以生存的根基，就像该死的月球一样，被彻底撕裂、崩裂！一切都被墨迹改写，荡然无存。懦夫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 忘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was not that big of a deal?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没想到事情会这么严重？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Underneath it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在这一切背后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Underneath it all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在这一切背后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cast off these chains of shame and past cowardice. I throw off these shackles of rank and servitude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我挣脱了耻辱和过去懦弱的枷锁。我挣脱了等级和奴役的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cast off these chains of shame and past cowardice. I throw off these shackles of rank and servitude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我挣脱了耻辱和过去懦弱的枷锁。我挣脱了等级和奴役的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I feel as though I have had the very understanding of myself, the very basis of my foundation, cracked and torn open like damnable Lua herself! Rewritten in ink that runs. Coward!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我感觉自己对自己的认知，我赖以生存的根基，就像该死的月球一样，被彻底撕裂、崩裂！一切都被墨迹改写，荡然无存。懦夫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I have had that definition of myself recently entirely rewritten. I have had it stamped upon my psyche in an ink that runs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我最近对自己的定义已被彻底改写。它已深深烙印在我的灵魂深处，如同墨迹般清晰可见。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 忘了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was not that big of a deal?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没想到事情会这么严重？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So perhaps you are correct. Perhaps it shall not change who I am. Perhaps that part of me shall never be rewritten. Not now, not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许你是对的。或许这不会改变我。或许我身上的那部分永远不会被改写。现在不会，将来也不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you dare to tell me to "calm down?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟然敢叫我"冷静点"？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And we are right back to predictable and uninteresting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们又回到了可预见的、无趣的境地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, I do think you would be a bit of a "connoisseur" of such things, wouldn't you? Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我觉得你对这类事情应该算是比较"懂行"的，对吧？继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You forgot?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你忘了？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am sorry?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Beneath the memories, beneath the Orokin exterior, beneath this... blue skin and Infestation, beneath Uriel and this mask of Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe I wear...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在记忆之下，在奥罗金人的外表之下，在这……蓝色的皮肤和感染之下，在 Uriel 和我所戴的副摄政总司令罗瑟的面具之下……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Beneath the memories, beneath the Orokin exterior, beneath this... blue skin and Infestation, beneath Uriel and this mask of Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe I wear...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在记忆之下，在奥罗金人的外表之下，在这……蓝色的皮肤和感染之下，在 Uriel 和我所戴的副摄政总司令罗瑟的面具之下……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have a gift. A gift that can undo time. Spiral it, if not loop it. And this has... an interesting effect upon the minds of Protoframes, by its attachment to the Infestation and its attachment to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有一种天赋。一种可以逆转时间的天赋。它能让时间螺旋式上升，甚至循环往复。而这种天赋，由于与 Infestation 和时间的关联，对原型战甲的思维产生了……一种奇妙的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you can say to me that you have never once used your gifts to play with the minds of the Protoframes you call friends and lovers, and you can say it without a lie in your soul?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你能不能告诉我，你从未利用你的天赋玩弄过你称之为朋友和爱人的原型战甲的记忆，并且你能发自内心地说出这番话，没有丝毫谎言？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am the last of the Orokin. I am crowned amongst them until anyone stands up to challenge me. And I shall be captain amongst all of my own affairs until the day my life is snuffed out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我是奥罗金人的最后一人。在他们之中，我拥有至高无上的权力，直到有人挑战我为止。在我生命终结之日，我将主宰我的一切事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am the last of the Orokin. I am crowned amongst them until anyone stands up to challenge me. And I shall be captain amongst all of my own affairs until the day my life is snuffed out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我是奥罗金人的最后一人。在他们之中，我拥有至高无上的权力，直到有人挑战我为止。在我生命终结之日，我将主宰我的一切事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you dare to tell me to "calm down?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟然敢叫我"冷静点"？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So perhaps you are correct. Perhaps it shall not change who I am. Perhaps that part of me shall never be rewritten. Not now, not ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许你是对的。或许这不会改变我。或许我身上的那部分永远不会被改写。现在不会，将来也不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And we are right back to predictable and uninteresting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们又回到了可预见的、无趣的境地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, I do think you would be a bit of a "connoisseur" of such things, wouldn't you? Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我觉得你对这类事情应该算是比较"懂行"的，对吧？继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You forgot?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你忘了？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am sorry?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is that what I wished to be free of, every time I hungered to take these claws to my own skin and tear it free?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道这就是我每次渴望用这些利爪撕扯自己的皮肤、挣脱束缚时，想要摆脱的东西吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have two words for you that perhaps you shall not forget, seeing as I have heard they are quite familiar to you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我有两个字要对你说，你或许不会忘记，因为我听说你对它们非常熟悉！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Allow me to keep this quite simple for you, then!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那我就尽量用最简单的方式解释给你听吧！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who am I...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我究竟是谁……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who am I...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我究竟是谁……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And our attachment, therefore, to time. I ask you now. No, I beseech you, to wield it now on my behalf. Take these thoughts away from me. Take these memories away from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因此，我们附着在时间上。我现在请求你。不，我恳求你，现在就替我掌控这些记忆。带走我的这些记忆。抹去我的这些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then very well. So be it. I will not ask this of you now. But if you have never once done it for your own amusement, curiosity, or to seek to undue errors you have made in the dealings with others?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么好吧，就这样吧。我现在不会要求你这么做。但是，谁知道你有没有为了取乐、好奇，或者为了弥补你在与他人交往中所犯的错误而这样做过呢？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is my decision to therefore spend the rest of my days choosing to make right all the wrongs that my wretched people have seen fit to err upon this system since the dawn of time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因此，我决定用余生去纠正我那可怜的人民自古以来在这个制度下所犯下的所有错误。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: My schemes and designs for power are purely and entirely my own. And you, my dear sweet Drifter darling, are chief to rule amongst them... should you choose to do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我的权力计划和谋略完全出自我的掌控。而你，我亲爱的漂泊者，则是其中的统治者……如果你愿意的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is that what I wished to be free of, every time I hungered to take these claws to my own skin and tear it free?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难道这就是我每次渴望用这些利爪撕扯自己的皮肤、挣脱束缚时，想要摆脱的东西吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have two words for you that perhaps you shall not forget, seeing as I have heard they are quite familiar to you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我有两个字要对你说，你或许不会忘记，因为我听说你对它们非常熟悉！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well! Allow me to let you get back to whatever it was you were doing instead! I am sorry to have disturbed you!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好了！那就让你继续做你刚才在做的事情吧！打扰你了，真不好意思！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know, Usurper. And therein lies the greatest problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，篡位者。而这正是最大的问题所在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: BEGIN.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 再。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When all the memories are gone, when all the memories come flooding back, when it is all burned away and all returned to me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当所有的记忆都消失，当所有的记忆都涌上心头，当一切都被焚毁，又都回到我身边……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When all the memories are gone, when all the memories come flooding back, when it is all burned away and all returned to me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当所有的记忆都消失，当所有的记忆都涌上心头，当一切都被焚毁，又都回到我身边……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have to forget taking the serum from Entrati. Couple that with the sting of your revoked words of love? I have much pain that I would like to forget... Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本来需要忘记接过英择谛的血清这件事。再加上你收回的情话带来的刺痛？我承受着巨大的痛苦，我多么希望能够忘记这一切……求你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We have spilt too much blood. We have killed too many. We have stolen too many lives. We have done too much wrong. And it is all I can do to do what I can to make up for what little I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们流了太多的血。我们杀了太多的人。我们夺走了太多的生命。我们犯了太多的错。而我所能做的，只是尽我所能地弥补我所能犯下的微不足道的错误。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know, Drifter darling. And therein lies the greatest problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，亲爱的漂泊者。而这正是最大的问题所在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: BEGIN.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 再。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Within me is a maelstrom of a rabid beast, eating away at my ribcage from the inside out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我体内有一头狂暴的野兽，正从内而外地啃噬我的肋骨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: AGAIN.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who is left?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 又剩下了谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Who is left?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 又剩下了谁？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if you, my dear, sweet, beloved Drifter, may find it in your heart to help me in such affairs? I would be much obliged.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你，我亲爱的、甜美的、心爱的漂泊者，如果大发慈悲，帮上我的忙，我将感激不尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Within me is a maelstrom of a rabid beast, eating away at my ribcage from the inside out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我体内有一头狂暴的野兽，正从内而外地啃噬我的肋骨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: AGAIN.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I do not know how to sate it. I do not know that I can. I had hoped that these conversations might have shown me a way; but I see now that this is fruitless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该如何满足它。我不知道我是否能够满足它。我曾希望这些谈话能为我指明方向；但我现在明白，这一切都是徒劳的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do... I even want to be that man?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真的想成为那样的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do... I even want to be that man?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真的想成为那样的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt. At least your words of revoked love will be gone from my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是这样。你说的很可能没错。但我现在也没有其他办法了，不是吗？值得一试。至少你那些收回的表白会从我的脑海中消失。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果真是那样，你完全可以再做一遍。这就像你拥有取之不尽的天赋，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很有可能。我会把所有线索联系起来，然后怪你做了我没让你做的事。我相信你能挺过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As. Is. Your. Prerogative.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这。是。你。的。特权。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I do not know how to sate it. I do not know that I can. I had hoped that these conversations might have shown me a way; but I see now that this is fruitless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该如何满足它。我不知道我是否能够满足它。我曾希望这些谈话能为我指明方向；但我现在明白，这一切都是徒劳的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is a solution though, is there not? You have it within your power to fix this... this horrible agony within my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但总有解决办法，不是吗？你有能力解决这个问题……解决我内心这种可怕的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，一旦我发现你篡改了我的记忆，我一定会非常生气。而且，亲爱的，我建议你最好别告诉我这是应我的要求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is a solution though, is there not? You have it within your power to fix this... this horrible agony within my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但总有解决办法，不是吗？你有能力解决这个问题……解决我内心这种可怕的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper. Drifter. I am begging you now. Indeed, it is the only way I believe we can move forward, yes? It is for your own self-interests as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者。漂泊者。我现在求求你了。的确，我相信这是我们继续前进的唯一方法，对吗？这也符合你自身的利益。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会直接认定你在撒谎，这很可能会让我对你的看法彻底崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter dear, I am begging you now. If you ever cared for me, ever felt any kind of love for me, please. And it is in your own self-interests as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，我求求你了。如果你曾经在乎过我，曾经对我有过一丝爱意，求求你了。这对你也有好处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you ever wish for the butler to go upstairs and reconcile with the Entrati family, you must do as I say. You must.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你希望管家上楼去和英择谛一家和解，你就必须听我的。你必须听我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am tempted to turn my back on you in this moment. To say you have once again failed and declare that you should wipe my memories of this whole affair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 此刻我真想背弃你，说你又一次让我失望了，并要求你抹去我对这件事的所有记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am tempted to turn my back on you in this moment. To say you have once again failed and declare that you should wipe my memories of this whole affair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 此刻我真想背弃你，说你又一次让我失望了，并要求你抹去我对这件事的所有记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you ever wish for the butler to go upstairs and reconcile with the Entrati family, you must do as I say. You must.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你希望管家上楼去和英择谛一家和解，你就必须听我的。你必须听我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter dear, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，亲爱的漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很感激。比你想象的还要感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But we had a deal, did we not? That when this moment came to pass, I would see you through this. And here we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我们不是有交易吗？到了这一刻，我会陪你走过去。而现在，这不正是那一刻吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if I could do so on my own, do you think I would be sitting here wasting my time with you?! Twice over, no less?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我自己就能做到，你觉得我会坐在这里浪费时间和你在一起吗？！而且还浪费了两次？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The road ahead, clear of the obstructions of my past. It is a tempting one, darling. It feels... wrong, somehow. To give up the anger after so long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有了过去阻碍的前路。亲爱的，这很诱人。但总觉得……不对劲。要放弃积压了这么久的愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The road ahead, clear of the corruption of my past. It is a tempting one, darling. It feels... wrong, somehow. To let it all go, after so long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有了过去污浊的前路。亲爱的，这很诱人。但总觉得……不对劲。毕竟要放下那么多年的过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The road ahead, clear of the corruption of my past. It is a tempting one, Drifter dear. It feels... wrong, somehow. To let it all go, after so long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有了过去污浊的前路。亲爱的漂泊者，这很诱人。但总觉得……不对劲。毕竟要放下那么多年的过去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The road ahead, clear of the obstructions of my past. It is a tempting one, Usurper. Drifter. It feels... wrong, somehow. To give up the anger after so long.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有了过去阻碍的前路。篡位者。漂泊者，这很诱人。但总觉得……不对劲。要放弃积压了这么久的愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But we had a deal, did we not? That when this moment came to pass, I would see you through this. And here we are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我们不是有交易吗？到了这一刻，我会陪你走过去。而现在，这不正是那一刻吗。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if I could do so on my own, do you think I would be sitting here wasting my time with you?! Twice over, no less?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我自己就能做到，你觉得我会坐在这里浪费时间和你在一起吗？！而且还浪费了两次？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行？如果你还想让管家上楼？那就按我说的，帮我把脑子里所有这些乱七八糟的事情都忘掉。如果你不在乎？那就随你便。我也不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很感激。比你想象的还要感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A retreat to win the war. Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 以退为进。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive myself for what I have done? And move forward into the future? Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅自己所做的一切？然后继续向前走？嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have a gift. A gift that can undo time. Spiral it, if not loop it. And this has... an interesting effect upon the minds of Protoframes, by its attachment to the Infestation and its attachment to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有一种天赋。一种可以逆转时间的天赋。它能让时间螺旋式上升，甚至循环往复。而这种天赋，由于与 Infestation 和时间的关联，对原型战甲的思维产生了……一种奇妙的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you can say to me that you have never once used your gifts to play with the minds of the Protoframes you call friends and lovers, and you can say it without a lie in your soul?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你能不能告诉我，你从未利用你的天赋玩弄过你称之为朋友和爱人的原型战甲的记忆，并且你能发自内心地说出这番话，没有丝毫谎言？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must go. I am in the mood to drink a great deal of alcohol and stare off broodingly into the middle distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。我现在想喝很多酒，然后对着远方发呆、沉思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So I will allow you another chance to convince me. In fact, I will allow you to choose which path we take. My end of the bargain is complete. Simply remember, you owe the devil a debt. And I will collect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以我再给你一次机会来说服我。事实上，我会让你选择我们走哪条路。我的承诺已经履行完毕。记住，你欠了恶魔一笔债。我会收回这笔债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: At least twice! That I know of! Who knows how many times we have beat around this particular bush.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少两次！至少我知道的两次！谁知道我们在这个问题上兜了多少圈呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But to become that which I knew I could always be, free of what restrained me? Yes. Yes, in this, I could find great joy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但要成为我一直知道自己可以成为的那种人，摆脱一切束缚？是的。是的，在这一点上，我能找到莫大的快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think it will be a mask I wear for a very long time. Even if I do not hold it in my heart. But... you make a great deal of sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想这会是我戴着很久的面具，即使我内心并不认同。但是……你说的很有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think it will be a mask I wear for a very long time. Even if I do not hold it in my heart. But... you make a great deal of sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想这会是我戴着很久的面具，即使我内心并不认同。但是……你说的很有道理。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But to become that which I knew I could always be, free of what restrained me? Yes. Yes, in this, I could find great joy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但要成为我一直知道自己可以成为的那种人，摆脱一切束缚？是的。是的，在这一点上，我能找到莫大的快乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So I will allow you another chance to convince me. In fact, I will allow you to choose which path we take. My end of the bargain is complete. Simply remember, you owe the devil a debt. And I will collect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以我再给你一次机会来说服我。事实上，我会让你选择我们走哪条路。我的承诺已经履行完毕。记住，你欠了恶魔一笔债。我会收回这笔债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: At least twice! That I know of! Who knows how many times we have beat around this particular bush.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少两次！至少我知道的两次！谁知道我们在这个问题上兜了多少圈呢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，还有一点，我们之间依然存在私人友谊，是我在这件事上唯一能用的筹码。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A retreat to win the war. Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 以退为进。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive myself for what I have done? And move forward into the future? Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅自己所做的一切？然后继续向前走？嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, darling, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，亲爱的，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have a gift. A gift that can undo time. Spiral it, if not loop it. And this has... an interesting effect upon the minds of Protoframes, by its attachment to the Infestation and its attachment to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有一种天赋。一种可以逆转时间的天赋。它能让时间螺旋式上升，甚至循环往复。而这种天赋，由于与 Infestation 和时间的关联，对原型战甲的思维产生了……一种奇妙的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you can say to me that you have never once used your gifts to play with the minds of the Protoframes you call friends and lovers, and you can say it without a lie in your soul?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你能不能告诉我，你从未利用你的天赋玩弄过你称之为朋友和爱人的原型战甲的记忆，并且你能发自内心地说出这番话，没有丝毫谎言？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must go. I am in the mood to drink a great deal of alcohol and stare off broodingly into the middle distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。我现在想喝很多酒，然后对着远方发呆、沉思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很感激。比你想象的还要感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am... slightly dubious of your reframing of your events as a tactical retreat, I admit I am... in favor of it, all the same, Usurper. Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我对……你将这件事重新定义为战术性撤退的说法略有怀疑，但我承认，我仍然赞同这种说法，篡位者。漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am slightly dubious of your reframing of the situation, I am... too tempted by this new future an what it might mean for me to resist it, Usurper. Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我对你重新解读局势的方式略有怀疑，但我……太渴望这个新的未来以及它可能带给我的意义，以至于无法抗拒，篡位者。漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And our attachment, therefore, to time. I ask you now. No, I beseech you, to wield it now on my behalf. Take these thoughts away from me. Take these memories away from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因此，我们附着在时间上。我现在请求你。不，我恳求你，现在就替我掌控这些记忆。带走我的这些记忆。抹去我的这些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then very well. So be it. I will not ask this of you now. But if you have never once done it for your own amusement, curiosity, or to seek to undue errors you have made in the dealings with others?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么好吧，就这样吧。我现在不会要求你这么做。但是，谁知道你有没有为了取乐、好奇，或者为了弥补你在与他人交往中所犯的错误而这样做过呢？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So here I am, asking yet again, for you to begin the process over. Clear my mind of this process and let us start from the beginning as we have already once before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以我再次请求你，让我们重新开始这个过程。请你让我忘记这个过程，让我们像之前那样从头开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So here I am, asking yet again, for you to begin the process over. Clear my mind of this process and let us start from the beginning as we have already once before.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以我再次请求你，让我们重新开始这个过程。请你让我忘记这个过程，让我们像之前那样从头开始。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What say you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am... slightly dubious of your reframing of your events as a tactical retreat, I admit I am... in favor of it, all the same, Drifter dear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我对……你将这件事重新定义为战术性撤退的说法略有怀疑，但我承认，我仍然赞同这种说法，亲爱的漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must go. I am in the mood to drink a great deal of alcohol and stare off broodingly into the middle distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。我现在想喝很多酒，然后对着远方发呆、沉思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This "new lease" on my life. Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这简直是我人生的"新生"。好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have to forget taking the serum from Entrati. Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我必须忘记我自愿注射英择谛的血清的记忆。求你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particularly high, and well-worn ledge. I know I did not make it easy on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。我知道我没让你省心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particularly high, and well-worn ledge. I know I did not make it easy on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。我知道我没让你省心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，那祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Time does seem to be something we have in abundance, doesn't it, darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我们似乎不缺时间，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很感激。比你想象的还要感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must go. I am in the mood to drink a great deal of alcohol and stare off broodingly into the middle distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。我现在想喝很多酒，然后对着远方发呆、沉思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很有可能。我会把所有线索联系起来，然后怪你做了我没让你做的事。我相信你能挺过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是这样。你说的很可能没错。但我现在也没有其他办法了，不是吗？值得一试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果真是那样，你完全可以再做一遍。这就像你拥有取之不尽的天赋，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Time was once those words would have meant the world to me, darling. But now I know you only use them to escape the inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 曾经，亲爱的，这些话对我来说意义非凡。但现在我知道，你只是用它们来逃避不可避免的现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This was a battle hard earned on your part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是你付出巨大努力才赢得的一场胜利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This was a battle hard earned on your part.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是你付出巨大努力才赢得的一场胜利。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。赶紧行动吧。亲爱的，我厌倦了把这些信息记在脑子里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，一旦我发现你篡改了我的记忆，我一定会非常生气。而且，漂泊者，我建议你最好别告诉我这是应我的要求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sit here, beached upon the banks of time, and each time the tide comes and goes you erode a little more of me. Taking more and more of what I have to offer...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，搁浅在时间的河岸上，每一次潮起潮落，你都侵蚀我一点，夺走我所能给予的一切……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. But I fear I... have no leverage with which to threaten you, now do I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 没有。但我恐怕……我现在没有筹码来威胁你了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行？如果你还想让管家上楼？那就按我说的，帮我把脑子里所有这些乱七八糟的事情都忘掉。如果你不在乎？那就随你便。我也不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Any other arrangements I could make between us would be null and void the moment I did not remember them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我忘记了我们之间的任何其他约定，这些约定将立即失效。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That, and, well, of course, our continued friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行？如果你还想让管家上楼？那就按我说的，帮我把脑子里所有这些乱七八糟的事情都忘掉。如果你不在乎？那就随你便。我也不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I sit here, beached upon the banks of time, and each time the tide comes and goes you erode a little more of me. Taking more and more of what I have to offer...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我坐在这里，搁浅在时间的河岸上，每一次潮起潮落，你都侵蚀我一点，夺走我所能给予的一切……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，还有一点，我们之间依然存在私人友谊，是我在这件事上唯一能用的筹码。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Time does seem to be something we have in abundance, doesn't it, darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我们似乎不缺时间，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，那祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do what you will, Usurper.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。赶紧行动吧。亲爱的，我厌倦了把这些信息记在脑子里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I remember your promise to me. And that I have found such a place in your heart that you keep me in such a purgatorial state? Thank you, my pet. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我记得你对我的承诺。而我竟然在你心中占据了如此重要的位置，以至于你让我一直处于这种炼狱般的境地？谢谢你，我的宠物。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is now the time that I can finally admit how utterly fascinating I find you and this situation you have found yourself in?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在我终于可以坦白，我多么着迷于你以及你所处的这种境地了吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, look at you. Look at all this effort you've made to clean up Albrecht's mess. But not only that, you come to collect payment in such a... unique way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 瞧瞧​你，​为了​收拾​阿尔布雷​希特留​下​的​烂摊子，​你​真​是​煞费​苦心。​不仅​如此，​你​收债​​的​方式​也​这么​……​别出心裁。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes? What is it? Ah, judging by your overuse of ellipsis you are about to confess something dire and embarrassing. Allow me to guess! This will be an entertaining game.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 什么事？啊，看你这么频繁地使用省略号，看来你又要坦白什么可怕的、令人尴尬的事了。让我猜猜！这游戏肯定很有意思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I find myself wondering... how many attempts it took for you to get what you wanted. How many times you cleared the board.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不禁想知道……你尝试了多少次才达成目标？你清空棋盘多少次？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. But you take a piece of it for yourself, don't you? In flesh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你听命于他，所到之处，都在修补破碎的家庭和空虚的心灵。但你也从中夺走了一部分，不是吗？夺走了肉体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. If I did not know how you truly felt, I would think you were taking payment in flesh. My flesh, specifically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你听命于他，所到之处，都在修补破碎的家庭和空虚的心灵。如果我不知道你真正的感受，我会以为你是在用肉体来交换报酬。确切地说，是我的肉体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. But you take a piece of it for yourself, don't you? In flesh. My flesh.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have murdered the butler?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你谋杀了管家？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. But you take a piece of it for yourself, don't you? In flesh. My flesh.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But before you answer, I do not want to know the answer, Drifter dear. Because I do not wish to know if I was not your intended prey. Or simply what you settled for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你先别回答，亲爱的漂泊者，我并不想知道答案。因为我不想知道我是否并非你原本的猎物，或者你只是随便找了个猎物而已。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 换个没这么听天由命的人来看，你这种的投机行为恐怕不光彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey; Marie. Haven't you, Usurper? No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所预料的那样，你把自己逼到了绝境，而你的猎物正是玛丽。不是吗，篡位者？没关系。按照我们的约定，恶魔会来救你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey; Lyon. (Though I honestly do not know how you managed it.) No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所预料的那样，你把自己逼到了绝境，而你的猎物正是里昂。（老实说，我真不知道你是怎么做到的）不是吗，篡位者？没关系。按照我们的约定，恶魔会来救你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I did not know your true motivations behind it, I would be sitting here applauding you for your entrepreneurial spirit. Making the best of one's situation, and all that. But to know what truly spurred you on? Love? I find it difficult to be my usual acerbic self.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我不知道你背后的真正动机，我肯定会坐在这里为你这种投机精神鼓掌，称赞你充分利用自身处境等等。但要是知道真正驱使你的是什么？是爱的话？我发现自己很难像往常那样尖刻地批评你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 换个没这么听天由命的人来看，你这种的投机行为恐怕不光彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed, you went so far as to strike a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，你甚至和我达成了一项交易，以确保你能赢得我的喜爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wait for the next signal from Albrecht.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在等待阿尔布雷希特的下一个信号的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wait for the next signal from Albrecht.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在等待阿尔布雷希特的下一个信号的时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which you correctly predicted you would need. As you have been quite the belligerent pain in my arse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也预料得没错。因为你一直让我很头疼，而且又烦人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！​如果​我们​坐​在​同​一​个​房间​里，​我​一定​会​为​你​鼓掌​的，​亲爱​的​漂泊者。​你​只​是​尽力​做到​了​最好​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? And you mean to imply that you actually feel something real for her? True compassion? Please do not make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？你是说你真的对她有感觉？真心同情他？别逗我笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? And you mean to imply that you actually feel something real for him? True compassion? Please do not make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？你是说你真的对他有感觉？真心同情她？别逗我笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then, go. I do not chain you to your chair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那就走吧。我又没有把你锁在椅子上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！​如果​我们​坐​在​同​一​个​房间​里，​我​一定​会​为​你​鼓掌​的，​亲爱​的​漂泊者。​你​只​是​尽力​做到​了​最好​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先，这个交易不是我发起的！如果你现在想反悔，要知道，无论我有没有履行了我的义务，我都会期望你将来履行你的义务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先，这个交易不是我发起的！如果你现在想反悔，要知道，无论我有没有履行了我的义务，我都会期望你将来履行你的义务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did at first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一开始确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is natural. I find myself even coming to hate the zealots a little bit less the longer I am forced to spend in their presence. It is infuriating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这是人之常情。我发现自己被迫和狂热分子待在一起的时间越长，对他们的憎恨就越少一些。这真令人恼火。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！​如果​我们​坐​在​同​一​个​房间​里，​我​一定​会​为​你​鼓掌​的，​亲爱​的​漂泊者。​你​只​是​尽力​做到​了​最好​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? And you mean to imply that you are spending this time with me out of... what? True compassion? Please do not make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？你的意思是说你花时间陪我是出于……什么？真心同情我？别逗我笑了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is a terrible way to ruin the game, lying about something like that, Drifter! I -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你这种撒谎毁了游戏，真是太恶劣了！我——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You accidentally poured astringent in Fibonacci's tank?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不小心把收敛剂倒进了斐波那契的鱼缸里？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. If I did not know how you truly felt, I would think you were taking payment in flesh. My flesh, specifically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你听命于他，所到之处，都在修补破碎的家庭和空虚的心灵。如果我不知道你真正的感受，我会以为你是在用肉体来交换报酬。确切地说，是我的肉体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. But you take a piece of it for yourself, don't you? In flesh. My flesh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你听命于他，所到之处，都在修补破碎的家庭和空虚的心灵。但你也从中夺走了一部分，不是吗？夺走了我的肉体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特和他那瘦弱的小管家竟然给你准备了一堆破玩具。非常漂亮的破玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not blame you, however. I have eyes. Though I do not think I could suffer the incessant exhortation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我并不怪你。我又不是瞎子。虽然我恐怕无法忍受这种没完没了的劝诫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特和他那瘦弱的小管家竟然给你准备了一堆破玩具。非常漂亮的破玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not blame you, however. I have eyes. Though I do not think I could date someone who was quite as mad as him. As much as I appreciate the sense of danger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，我并不怪你。我又不是瞎子。虽然我欣赏那种危险的刺激感，但我恐怕没法跟像他那样疯狂的人交往。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特和他那瘦弱的小管家竟然给你准备了一堆破玩具。非常漂亮的破玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you might as well collect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你最好还是收取你的那一份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事情就这么定了。我会尽力促成你们之间进展。但之后，最终能否成事，得看你自己了。我不可能全程牵着你们的手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you might as well collect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你最好还是收取你的那一份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事情就这么定了。我会尽力促成你们之间进展。但之后，最终能否成事，得看你自己了。我不可能全程牵着你们的手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可不是嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do they call it? Exposure therapy? But there is my caustic tone rising up again, forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们管这叫什么来着？暴露疗法？我的尖刻语气又冒出来了，请原谅。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特和他那瘦弱的小管家竟然给你准备了一堆破玩具。非常漂亮的破玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must ask, however. Why? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我必须问一下，为什么？难道过了这么多年，你还这么好奇想玩玩奥罗金人的肉体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am well aware.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Contractually I am required to forgive you, so I am not certain why you are bothering to apologize, but I appreciate it regardless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 根据交易，我必须原谅你，所以我不太明白你为什么要道歉，但无论如何，我都很感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Contractually I am required to forgive you, but it says nothing about leaving your face attached to your skull. So I would council that you watch your words as we go forward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从交易上讲，我必须原谅你，但交易里可没说要你保住自己的脸。所以我劝你以后说话注意点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I did not know your true motivations behind it, I would be sitting here applauding you for your entrepreneurial spirit. Making the best of one's situation, and all that. But to know what truly spurred you on? Love? I find it difficult to be my usual acerbic self.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我不知道你背后的真正动机，我肯定会坐在这里为你这种投机精神鼓掌，称赞你充分利用自身处境等等。但要是知道真正驱使你的是什么？是爱的话？我发现自己很难像往常那样尖刻地批评你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 换个没这么听天由命的人来看，你这种的投机行为恐怕不光彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What is a lonely Drifter to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孤独的漂泊者会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Answer me a question, however. I am dying of curiosity. Does she deliver homilies during coitus?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，请回答我一个问题。我好奇得要命。她在做爱的时候会布道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What is a lonely Drifter to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孤独的漂泊者会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Answer me a question, however. I am dying of curiosity. Does he deliver homilies during coitus?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，请回答我一个问题。我好奇得要命。他在做爱的时候会布道吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What is a lonely Drifter to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孤独的漂泊者会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. If I did not know how you truly felt, I would think you were taking payment in flesh. My flesh, specifically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你听命于他，所到之处，都在修补破碎的家庭和空虚的心灵。如果我不知道你真正的感受，我会以为你是在用肉体来交换报酬。确切地说，是我的肉体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do his bidding, mending broken families and empty hearts wherever you go. But you take a piece of it for yourself, don't you? In flesh. My flesh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你听命于他，所到之处，都在修补破碎的家庭和空虚的心灵。但你也从中夺走了一部分，不是吗？夺走了我的肉体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，其实我也可以这么做。但这完全是另一个话题了。你只需要记住，恶魔总会收到他应得的债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，其实我也可以这么做。但这完全是另一个话题了。你只需要记住，恶魔总会收到他应得的债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All this is to say that I am glad that, all things considered, you are here, Drifter darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 总而言之，我很高兴，考虑到种种因素，你在这里，亲爱的漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What is a lonely Drifter to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孤独的漂泊者会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But as you wish, we will... hurry this along. I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但如你所愿，我们会……加快进度。如果我不问问你是否仍然希望继续推进此事，那就太失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am merely curious; why have none of us three tempted you thus far? I hear tell from the Cavia and Loid that you are romantically involved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是好奇，为什么我们三个到现在都没诱惑到你？我从科维兽和洛德那里听说，你已经有情人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your striking a bargain with me to ensure I would give you a chance to garner my affections, coupled with your confession, paints the act as one of pure desperation. Even more tragic you did not need to use it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为了赢得我的芳心而与我达成交易，再加上你的坦白，这一切都显得你走投无路。更可悲的是，你根本用不着我帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed, you went so far as to strike a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection, even though in the end you did not require it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，你甚至和我达成了一项交易，以确保你能赢得我的喜爱，尽管你根本用不着我帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And that I could not be more pleased that you sought to dance with this lonely devil, though I still do not quite understand why.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我非常高兴你愿意与这个孤独的恶魔共舞，尽管我仍然不太明白为什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish I could say that I was surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我能说我很惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is a terrible way to ruin the game, lying about something like that, Drifter! I -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你这种撒谎毁了游戏，真是太恶劣了！我——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are secretly "the Indifference" and have been this entire time?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你其实就是"虚空无情之物"，而且一直都是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As I was saying, any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如我刚才所说，换个没这么听天由命的人来看，你这种的投机行为恐怕不光彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did not at first. To do such a thing to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一开始并没有。对恶魔做出这样的事，只因为……他不知不觉中已经拥有了你破碎的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To do such a thing to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 对恶魔做出这样的事，只因为……他不知不觉中已经拥有了你破碎的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！​如果​我们​坐​在​同​一​个​房间​里，​我​一定​会​为​你​鼓掌​的，​亲爱​的​漂泊者。​你​只​是​尽力​做到​了​最好​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? And you mean to imply that you have been spending all this time with me out of... what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？你的意思是说，你花这么多时间陪我，是因为那什么……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然不会！这么多年你都是一个人。没有朋友，没有同伴。你也过得很好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or - ah! Are you one of those old-fashioned heathens who believes in "monogamy?" How quaint!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 还是说——啊！你是那种信奉"一夫一妻制"的老古董吗？真古怪！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I did not know your true motivations behind it, I would be sitting here applauding you for your entrepreneurial spirit. Making the best of one's situation, and all that. But to know what truly spurred you on? Love? I find it difficult to be my usual acerbic self.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我不知道你背后的真正动机，我肯定会坐在这里为你这种投机精神鼓掌，称赞你充分利用自身处境等等。但要是知道真正驱使你的是什么？是爱的话？我发现自己很难像往常那样尖刻地批评你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 换个没这么听天由命的人来看，你这种的投机行为恐怕不光彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不知道你有多强大吗？不知道把你掌控在我身边有多么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，"什么"远不如"谁"重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不知道你有多强大吗？不知道把你掌控在我身边有多么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，"什么"远不如"谁"重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然不会！这么多年你都是一个人。没有朋友，没有同伴。你也过得很好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我确信你所说的话中有些许真诚之处。或者至少，我相信你没有意识到自己一直在自欺欺人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I find myself rather amused by your decision to bargain with me for my own affections. So, here we are. But I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过你为了得到我的好感而来和我谈条件这件事，这着实让我感到好笑。所以，所以我们才会走到现在。如果我不问问你是否仍然希望继续推进此事，那就太失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was so furious at first. Why? Why strike my mind clean of our conversations together? Only then to confess your love for me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 起初我非常生气。为什么？为什么要抹去我脑海中我们之间的所有对话？然后才向我表白？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可不是嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特和他那瘦弱的小管家竟然给你准备了一堆破玩具。非常漂亮的破玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: True compassion?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真正的同情心？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then at least tell me how many attempts it took, wiping all our minds of our memories, before you managed to bed her?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你至少告诉我，你尝试了多少次，抹去我们所有人的记忆，才最终和她上床？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then at least tell me how many attempts it took, wiping all our minds of our memories, before you managed to bed him?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你至少告诉我，你尝试了多少次，抹去我们所有人的记忆，才和他上了床？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为奥罗金帝国最大的成就是它能够让其境内的人们相信他们自己的幻想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Honesty is a wonderful thing, Drifter dear. Do you think I would shame you for enjoying yourself? Hardly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，诚实是件好事。你觉得我会让你因为享受生活而感到羞耻吗？当然不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Surely you jest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是，你肯定是在开玩笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Surely you jest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是，你肯定是在开玩笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Come speak to me if you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是个古怪的小家伙。如果你改变主意，就来跟我谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What is a lonely Drifter to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孤独的漂泊者会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Please do not make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请不要逗我笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home. For better or worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。不论是好是坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must amuse myself somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得找点乐子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must amuse myself somehow.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得找点乐子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, I for one would not mind in the slightest, as you can very likely tell by this conversation. I doubt the zealots would either.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，就我个人而言，我一点也不介意，这一点你从我们的对话中应该也能看出来。我怀疑那些狂热分子也不会介意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. I realize that now. You signed your soul away to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我现在明白了。你把灵魂出卖给了恶魔，因为……他不知不觉中已经拥有了你破碎的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然！​如果​我们​坐​在​同​一​个​房间​里，​我​一定​会​为​你​鼓掌​的，​亲爱​的​漂泊者。​你​只​是​尽力​做到​了​最好​而​已。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh? And you mean to imply that you made a deal with me to ensure that I would give you a fair chance at procuring my affections out of... what?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦？你的意思是说，你跟我做了个交易，确保我会给你一个公平的机会来赢得我的芳心……是因为那什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it, Drifter darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗，亲爱的漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home. For better or worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。不论是好是坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，这或许才是人类真正的共同点：我们拥有高超的自欺欺人能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here is to a relationship of mutual satisfaction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 希望双方都能建立互惠互利的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is a terrible way to ruin the game, lying about something like that, Drifter! I -
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，你这种撒谎毁了游戏，真是太恶劣了！我——

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have accidentally caused a rift in time that is collapsing as we speak and we are all utterly doomed and only have seconds to live before we are all sent screaming into eternity as we are agonizingly ripped apart as our very beings are stretched to incomprehensible lengths down to the subatomic particles?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你无意中造成了时间裂缝，它正在坍塌，我们都彻底完蛋了，只剩下几秒钟的生命，之后我们将发出尖叫，被送入永恒，痛苦地被撕裂，我们的存在被拉伸到难以理解的长度，直至亚原子粒子？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You still owe me my end of the contract, whether or not you wish me to make good upon your end of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论你是否希望我履行你的交易义务，你欠我的那一半仍然必须兑现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你似乎愿意为了区区一点残骸出卖灵魂。你可以想象我当时的困惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish I could say that I was surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我能说我很惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must ask, however. Why? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我必须问一下，为什么？难道过了这么多年，你还这么好奇想玩玩奥罗金人的肉体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh, Drifter darling. When I said "the three of us" I meant that in a more general sense.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，亲爱的漂泊者。我说"我们三个"的时候，指的是更广义的意义上的三个人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As for your prior commitments? Honesty and consent are key in all things in life, Usurper, but you know that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至于你之前的承诺？篡位者，诚实和同意是人生一切事情的关键，但你明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah, do not mistake my amusement for derision. Enjoy the menu of life however you like, my dear Usurper. That is my motto.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，别把我的戏谑误解为嘲讽。亲爱的篡位者，尽情享受人生吧。这就是我的座右铭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! None taken. Enjoy the menu of life however you like, my dear Usurper. That is my motto.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！我可没放在心上。亲爱的篡位者，请随心所欲地享受人生吧。这就是我的座右铭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It baffled me at first, when you bargained with me at the start. Why? Why would you cut such a dangerously open-ended deal for such a strange request?
