/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一开始你跟我讨价还价的时候，我还感到很困惑。为什么？为什么你会为了一个如此奇怪的要求，提出如此危险且毫无悬念的交易？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可不是嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Albrecht and his scrawny little butler saw fit to saddle you with a collection of broken toys. Very attractive broken toys.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特和他那瘦弱的小管家竟然给你准备了一堆破玩具。非常漂亮的破玩具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: True compassion?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真正的同情心？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a floating "Sister of Sol" to annoy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠他债的朋友的恶魔。好了，恕我失陪了？我得去烦一下那个漂浮的"太阳神​修女"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a mad priest to annoy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠他债的朋友的恶魔。好了，恕我失陪了？我得去烦一下那个疯神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是为了避免承认自己需要改变时那种可怕的羞耻感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter... my poor, sweet, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者……我可怜的、可爱的漂泊者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter... my poor, sweet, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者……我可怜的、可爱的漂泊者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the devil will always collect his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恶魔总会得到他应得的那份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I could not be more glad that you did, however.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，​我​真​是​很​庆幸​你​这么​做​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然不会！这么多年你都是一个人。没有朋友，没有同伴。你也过得很好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well played.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are too much fun to irritate. I must amuse myself somehow, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可太有意思了，我不想惹你生气。毕竟，我总得找点乐子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well played.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are too much fun to irritate. I must amuse myself somehow, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可太有意思了，我不想惹你生气。毕竟，我总得找点乐子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is a bit of a surprise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这有点出乎意料。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was not referring to myself specifically.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我指的并非我自己。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am hardly going to be the one to sit here and judge you for it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我绝不会坐在这里评判你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What is a lonely Drifter to do?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 孤独的漂泊者会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Please do not make me laugh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请不要逗我笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅我。请原谅我。我当时并不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅我。请原谅我。我当时并不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have been left down here in this replica crypt with these two zealots for a little too long, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恐怕我和这两个狂热分子被留在这个仿制的墓穴里太久了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Delicious, but odd, Drifter darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是个古怪的小家伙。美味可口，但又有点怪异，亲爱的漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You could have approached me to say something, Drifter darling... but I know I am not precisely the most affable of creatures at times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，你本可以来找我谈谈的……但我知道我有时并不是个特别和蔼可亲的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot stand you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我简直无法忍受你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am merely saying, you may have more options than you think. But like any battle, they are won and lost on the approach.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想说，你可能比你想象的有更多选择。但就像任何一场战斗一样，胜负取决于策略。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你似乎愿意为了区区一点残骸出卖灵魂。你可以想象我当时的困惑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish I could say that I was surprised.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真希望我能说我很惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you are trying to back out of the contract because you did not need to use your end of it, do not bother. It will not work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你因为不需要履行交易义务而试图解除交易，那就别费劲了。这样做行不通。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am a bit of an expert on the subject, as you well know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所知，我对这个领域略有研究。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not that I would know anything on the topic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在这方面可是一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I give up. What were you going to say to me, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我放弃了。你本来想跟我说什么，漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must ask, however. Why? Why make such an outrageous deal? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我必须问一下，为什么？为什么要达成这么荒谬的交易？难道过了这么多年，你还这么好奇想玩玩奥罗金人的肉体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home. For better or worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。不论是好是坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我确信你所说的话中有些许真诚之处。或者至少，我相信你没有意识到自己一直在自欺欺人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. If you wish to court the Devil of Tau, I am hardly one to say no. And I, of course, am not bothered by your previous romantic engagement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。如果你想来追求 Tau 之恶魔，我自然不会拒绝。而且，我当然不会介意你之前的恋情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I could not be more glad that you did, however.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，​我​真​是​很​庆幸​你​这么​做​了。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course not! All those centuries by yourself. No friends. No companions. You are enjoying yourself!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然不会！这么多年你都是一个人。没有朋友，没有同伴。你也过得很好！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If this is what you wish, then of course my answer is yes. A very eager yes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你希望如此，那么我的回答当然是我愿意。我非常愿意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it, Drifter darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗，亲爱的漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为奥罗金帝国最大的成就是它能够让其境内的人们相信他们自己的幻想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Honesty is a wonderful thing, Drifter dear. Do you think I would shame you for enjoying yourself? Hardly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，诚实是件好事。你觉得我会让你因为享受生活而感到羞耻吗？当然不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Surely you jest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是，你肯定是在开玩笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. Happens to the best of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，这种情况谁都有可能遇到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，这或许才是人类真正的共同点：我们拥有高超的自欺欺人能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here is to a relationship of mutual satisfaction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 希望双方都能建立互惠互利的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home. For better or worse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。不论是好是坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我确信你所说的话中有些许真诚之处。或者至少，我相信你没有意识到自己一直在自欺欺人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh, my sweet Drifter. My dear, sweet, darling, Drifter... I do not know if you have noticed, but?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，我亲爱的漂泊者。我亲爱的、甜美的、宝贝的漂泊者……我不知道你有没有注意到，但是？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well! This is a bit of a surprise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯！这有点出乎我的意料。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是为了避免承认自己需要改变时那种可怕的羞耻感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter... my poor, sweet, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者……我可怜的、可爱的漂泊者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it, Drifter darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗，亲爱的漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It reminds me a little bit of home.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这让我想起了家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am glad we are agreed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很高兴我们达成了一致。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Surely you jest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，你肯定是在开玩笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为奥罗金帝国最大的成就是它能够让其境内的人们相信他们自己的幻想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot stand you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我简直无法忍受你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You could have approached me to say something, Drifter darling... but I know I am not precisely the most affable of creatures at times.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，你本可以来找我谈谈的……但我知道我有时并不是个特别和蔼可亲的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Honesty is a wonderful thing, Drifter dear. Do you think I would shame you for enjoying yourself? Hardly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，诚实是件好事。你觉得我会让你因为享受生活而感到羞耻吗？当然不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅我。请原谅我。我当时并不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But why make such an arrangement, unless...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但为什么要做这样的交易呢？除非……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，这或许才是人类真正的共同点：我们拥有高超的自欺欺人能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you wish to court the Devil of Tau, I am hardly one to say no.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你想来追求 Tau 之恶魔，我自然不会拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here is to a relationship of mutual satisfaction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 希望双方都能建立互惠互利的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am a bit of an expert on the subject, as you well know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所知，我对这个领域略有研究。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not that I would know anything on the topic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在这方面可是一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是为了避免承认自己需要改变时那种可怕的羞耻感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You signed your soul away to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你把灵魂出卖给了恶魔，因为……他不知不觉中已经拥有了你破碎的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am a bit of an expert on the subject, as you well know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所知，我对这个领域略有研究。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not that I would know anything about the topic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在这方面可是一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter... my poor, sweet, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者……我可怜的、可爱的漂泊者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅我。请原谅我。我当时并不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it, Drifter darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗，亲爱的漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion. How baffled I was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你似乎愿意为了区区一点残骸出卖灵魂。你可以想象我当时的困惑。我真是百思不得其解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now? Now that I know the truth? Drifter, my Drifter... I could not be more glad that you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在？现在我知道了真相？漂泊者，我的漂泊者……我无比庆幸你这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, I hate to inform you, that while I am perfectly comfortable "sharing," the zealots... are very likely not. I recommend sorting out your current situation before pursuing ours any further.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很遗憾地告诉你，虽然我很乐意"分享"，但那些狂热分子……很可能不愿意。我建议你先理顺自己目前的情况，再考虑我们之间的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Believe me, no one is more disappointed than I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我，没有人比我更失望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To say something like that to me, when I must watch you in the arms of the zealots?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我眼睁睁地看着你被狂热分子拥在怀中，你竟然还能对我说出这样的话？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Knowing that they can have you, but their covetous, selfish ways will not let me share in the balm of such kindness?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 明明他们可以拥有你，却因为他们那种贪婪自私的做法，让我连这份善意的抚慰都无法触及？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What have I ever done to you to deserve such cold cruelty...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我究竟做错了什么，要遭受你如此冷酷无情的对待……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I know you hate Ballas. I know you hate the Orokin. But really, Usurper...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道你恨 Ballas，我知道你恨奥罗金人。但是，篡位者，说真的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To think... they would all call me a devil....
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想想看……他们都叫我恶魔……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The issue is far more in your current dalliance with the zealot whom you amuse yourself with. I hardly think they will take kindly to our "sharing" you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 问题更多在于你目前与那个狂热分子的暧昧关系，你只是和他寻欢作乐而已。我估计他不会乐意我们"分享"你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Devil of Tau," "evil soulless cretin," "puerile beast," etcetera, etcetera.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "Tau 之恶魔"、"邪恶的无魂恶人"、"幼稚的野兽"等等，等等。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You get the idea. I recommend choosing in this instance, I am afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你明白我的意思。恐怕在这种情况下，我建议你做出选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Unfortunately, there is one who will. And we both know who it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 遗憾的是，有一个人会拒绝。而且我们都知道是谁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I certainly do not mind "sharing" you, the zealot will. I fear in this instance, you will have to choose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我当然不介意"分享"你，但那个狂热分子肯定介意。恐怕这次你必须做出选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Trust me. In some situations, a compromise cannot be negotiated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我，有些情况下，妥协并非能够协商得来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Trust me. In some situations, a compromise cannot be negotiated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我，有些情况下，妥协并非能够协商得来的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We struck a deal, Drifter. Are you content with where you left things with Lyon? Seems to me like the poor bastard is just as distraught as ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们达成协议了，漂泊者。你自己对和里昂之间的结果满意吗？在我看来，那可怜的混蛋还是像往常一样心烦意乱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We struck a deal, Drifter. Are you content with where you left things with Marie and her opinions of Albrecht? Seems to me like the little floating sycophant is just as steadfast as ever.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们达成协议了，漂泊者。你对玛丽的态度，以及她对阿尔布雷希特的看法感到满意吗？在我看来，那个飘来飘去的谄媚之徒依然如故地坚定不移。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We struck a deal, Drifter. And while it seems you did not need me to help you with Marie after all, just know that the devil always collects his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们达成协议了，漂泊者。虽然看来你终究不需要我帮你对付玛丽，但记住，恶魔总会讨回它的债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What an astonishing question. I have wondered that myself many times since my transformation into this Infested amalgam.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是个惊人的问题。自从我变成这具融合感染体以来，我自己也反复思考过这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We struck a deal, Drifter. And while it seems you did not need me to help you with Lyon after all, just know that the devil always collects his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们达成协议了，漂泊者。虽然看来你终究不需要我帮你对付里昂，但记住，恶魔总会讨回它的债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will come for what is owed to me, whether or not you needed to use your end of the contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论你是否履行协议，我都将讨回应得之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I find myself thinking of her more frequently now that my memories are fully returned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但如今记忆完全恢复，我发现自己想起她的次数越来越频繁。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, then I shall solve this problem for you and soon enough, I shall come for what is owed to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，我就替你解决这个问题吧。很快，我便会来取回应得的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You might as well avail yourself of it. I will come for what is owed to me, whether or not you use your end of the contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不如利用这个机会。无论你是否履行协议，我都将讨回应得之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, then I shall solve this problem for you and soon enough, I shall come for what is owed to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么，我就替你解决这个问题吧。很快，我便会来取回应得的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You might as well avail yourself of it. I will come for what is owed to me, whether or not you use your end of the contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你不如利用这个机会。无论你是否履行协议，我都将讨回应得之物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must understand how deeply complex and... harmful my relationship with that woman truly was. It is hard to describe precisely how much I adored her. And how much I despised her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你必须明白，我和那个女人的关系究竟有多么复杂……多么有害。很难确切描述我有多么爱她，又多么恨她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不知道你有多强大吗？不知道把你掌控在我身边有多么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，"什么"远不如"谁"重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: More importantly, how much she made me despise every part of myself down to the very essence of myself. Yet without her, I would not exist. I would not be the man I am.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 更重要的是，她让我憎恶自己的一切，直至灵魂深处。然而没有她，我就不存在。我就不会成为现在的我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不知道你有多强大吗？不知道把你掌控在我身边有多么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，"什么"远不如"谁"重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，"什么"远不如"谁"重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不知道你有多强大吗？不知道把你掌控在我身边有多么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She made me. She broke me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她成就了我。她也摧毁了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly. So what say you? Do you want my help with Lyon or not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。那么你意下如何？要不要我帮你处理里昂的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly. So what say you? Do you want my help with Marie or not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。那么你意下如何？要不要我帮你处理玛丽的事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I loved her. I wanted her dead.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱过她。我恨不得她死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠债的朋友的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Such are the complexities of life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 生活就是如此复杂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish. Just remember, the only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 随你便。但记住，唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠着债的朋友的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish. Just remember, the only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 随你便。但记住，唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠着债的朋友的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Without her, I would not be what I am. I learned all that I know from her. She took raw clay and shaped it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果没有她，就不会有今天的我。我所知的一切皆源于她。她将未经雕琢的泥土，塑造成了现在的我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hope this does not spur feelings of jealousy in you. That is not my intention. I am simply trying to provide an explanation of how much harm she caused me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望这不会引起你的嫉妒。那并非本意，我只是想解释一下她给我带来了多少伤害。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yet how much I, in the same breath, owe her. Without her, I would not be what I am. I learned all that I know from her. She took raw clay and shaped it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 然而，我同样欠她太多。如果没有她，就不会有今天的我。我所知的一切皆源于她。她将未经雕琢的泥土，塑造成了现在的我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it done. Just remember, the only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说定了。但记住，唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠债的朋友的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it done. Just remember, the only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you with debts to pay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说定了。但记住，唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠债的朋友的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That isn't quite accurate. I am. I no longer love her. I no longer care if she suffers a brutal death at my hands. But I find myself overwhelmingly curious to know how her story ended.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这话不太准确。我确实放下了。我不再爱她了。我不再在乎她是否会死于我的残暴之手。但我发现自己强烈地想知道她的故事最终如何收场。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is hard to think that someone with such a taste for blood and death would be so quiet for all these centuries.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很难想象一个如此嗜血好杀的人，竟能在这几个世纪里保持如此沉寂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then you can empathize as to why I am curious to know what became of her. Simply because I wish to know how her story ended. If it even has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么你就能理解我为何好奇她的下落。仅仅是因为我想知道她的故事如何收场。如果真的有结局的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is difficult to rid yourself of those who have been such a key player in your own tale. No matter how venomous they are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些在你人生故事中扮演过关键角色的人，无论他们多么恶毒，都很难从你生命里彻底抹去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If she is still alive, she has not been lying in wait of her own accord.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果她还活着，就不是自愿在暗处埋伏的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is for the sake of the past that I find myself curious to know what became of her. Simply because I wish to know how her story ended. If it even has.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正因这段过往，我才好奇她的下落。仅仅是因为我想知道她的故事如何收场。如果真的有结局的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Pardon me, as you are the one who brought her up. You really are quite confounding, Drifter dear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 抱歉，是你先提起的。亲爱的漂泊者，你这人真是让人费解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will say this, however: If she is still alive?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，我要说的是：如果她还活着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may find yourself praying for Ballas to return.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你可能会发现自己开始祈祷 Ballas 能回归。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have you thought any more about my argument regarding your "Indifference?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你有没有再考虑过，我关于你的"虚空无情之物"的观点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Can I convince you to consider my position once more? Or are your views on the topic immutable?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我能否说服你重新考虑我的立场？还是你对这个话题的观点已成定局？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To quote the zealots, "c'est la vie."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 照狂热分子的话说，"C'est la vie"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would not have expected you to have such a delicate trigger, Drifter darling. But to quote the zealots, "c'est la vie."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我真没想到你会如此敏感，亲爱的漂泊者。不过照狂热分子的话说，"C'est la vie"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hate you Eternalism types. You use it as an excuse for everything. Once an Archimedean thinks they've wrapped their heads around it, off they go.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我恨死你们这些永恒论者了。你们总拿它当万事万物的借口。哲士一旦自以为参透了它，就立刻逃之夭夭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "I didn't forget to water your office plant like I promised, it's simply experiencing a different Eternalism branch parallel to ours."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "我没忘记按承诺给你办公室的绿植浇水，它只是正经历着与我们平行的另一条永恒论分支。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do not sound terribly philosophical today but I will give it a go, nonetheless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你今天听起来不太像在谈论哲学，但我还是要试一试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To quote the zealots, "c'est la vie."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 照狂热分子的话说，"C'est la vie"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Glorious! Finally, progress is made. Sound the trumpets, ring the bells, someone finally sees sense!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太棒了！终于有进展了。吹响号角，敲响钟声，终于有人清醒了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It makes me want to scream. Can you simply commit to something for once in your miserable lives?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这简直让人抓狂！你们这群可怜虫，能不能在可悲的人生里至少坚持做成一件事？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is not as though I have anything better to be doing with my time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 反正我也没什么更好的事情可做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Let us begin at the top, shall we? How would you define what a "god" is?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们从头开始讨论如何？你如何定义"神"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I had no doubt you would come around, Drifter darling. You already had shown to be of discerning taste already.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我从不怀疑你会转变观点，亲爱的漂泊者。你早已展现出独到的见识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I had no doubt you would come around, Drifter. I am quite convincing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我从不怀疑你会转变观点，漂泊者。我的说服力向来很强。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see. It was fashioned into a "god" from the Void by Albrecht. And now we have a "god" on the loose. How charming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 明白了。它是阿尔布雷希特从虚空中塑成的"神"。现在我们竟有个"神"在四处游荡。多美妙啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now, if only we could find a way to convince all the other lunatics around the asylum...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，要是我们能找到办法说服精神病院里其他疯子就好了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you believe that your Indifference is one of these supreme beings?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而你认为你那虚空无情之物正是这样的至高存在？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And this Indifference of yours is a supreme entity or creature? And it wields power over an aspect of... Indifference. Of uncaring?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而你所说的虚空无情之物，就​是​这​种​至高​无上​的​存在​或​生物？它掌控着…………某种力量？是无情？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now who is a coward? Very well. Allow me to simplify matters and cut right to the chase:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在谁是懦夫？很好。容我直截了当地问：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then let me simplify matters and cut right to the chase: Do you believe a "god" can die?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么让我直截了当地问吧：你认为"神"会死亡吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A fair point. How would you define a "god?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 言之有理。你如何定义"神"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do you believe a "god" can die?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你认为"神"会死吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What good does it do us? All the good in the world! Of course, you are the one who has always fought alone. You have never been subjected to the tactics of an army.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这对我们有什么好处？这世间所有的好处！当然，你向来孤军奋战。从未经历过军队作战的策略。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why bother? You poor thing. Of course, you are the one who has always fought alone. You have never been subjected to the tactics of an army.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 何必呢？你这可怜的家伙。当然，你向来孤军奋战。从未经历过军队作战的策略。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Can a "god," by any means, cease to exist?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "神"是否可能以任何形式消亡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Enough of this going about in circles. Allow me to simply cut to the chase:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别再兜圈子了。容我直截了当地问：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Knowing thy enemy is key. Now, I have a question for you. Do you believe this creature can be killed?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 知己知彼，百战不殆。现在，我有个问题要问你。你认为这生物能被杀死吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now who is a coward? Very well. Allow me to simplify matters and cut right to the chase:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在谁是懦夫？那好。容我直截了当地问：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And this Indifference of yours is a supreme entity or creature? And it wields power over an aspect of... Indifference. Of uncaring?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而你所说的虚空无情之物，就​是​这​种​至高​无上​的​存在​或​生物？它掌控着…………某种力量？是无情？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Aaah, I see. Now there's the rub. Yes, our definitions did not match. Insomuch as this "Indifference" is an entity as you describe it? Yes. We are agreed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，我明白了。问题就在这里。是的，我们的定义并不一致。既然你所描述的这种"虚空无情之物"是一种实体，没错。我们达成共识了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Disappointing. But allow me to ask you this and cut to the chase:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 令人失望。但容我直截了当地问：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Disappointing. I would have thought you more clever than that. But allow me to ask you this and cut to the chase:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 令人失望。我还以为你比这更聪明些。但容我直截了当地问：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Peacemongers. Why must there always be a peacemonger.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 和平主义者。为什么总要有个和平主义者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Therefore, you imply in your modest ignorance, that we are all groping about in the darkness.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因此，你以谦逊的无知暗示，我们都在黑暗中摸索前行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Oh, grand. You think "gods" cannot die!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哦，太好了。你认为"神"不会死！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And your logic is... that gods can die because... "gods" are like pobbers?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的逻辑是……神会死亡因为……"神"就像泡博？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, yes, that is obvious, but stick with me, Drifter. I need you to focus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这答案显而易见，但听我说，漂泊者。我需要你保持专注。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We simply had a mismatch of shorthand terminology. How amusing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们只是在缩略语上出现了一点误解。真有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There are only two choices before you.  Either you believe this thing can die, and it is therefore not a "god,"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你面前只有两个选择。要么你相信这东西会死亡，因此它并非"神"，

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If none of us can know if a "god" can die, and this Indifference is one of them, then why do we bother to fight it at all?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然我们无人知晓"神"能否死亡，而这虚空无情之物正是其中之一，那么何必费心与它抗争？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Void on high I think I am dealing with an idiot.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空在上，我觉得自己是在和一个白痴打交道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Enough of this going about in circles. Allow me to simply cut to the chase: Can a "god", by any means, cease to exist?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别再兜圈子了。容我直截了当地问："神"是否可能以任何形式消亡？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I suppose "dreadful eldritch horror from beyond our comprehension" is far too many syllables to banter about, to be fair. Allow me to cut to the chase, then:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说实话，"超乎我们理解范畴的可怕诡异恐怖"这样冗长的词句实在不适合闲聊。容我直截了当地问：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or you believe it cannot be defeated, and it does not matter what you want to call it, for we are merely waiting to for it to consume us all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或者你认定信它不可战胜，管它叫什么都无所谓，因为我们终将被它吞噬殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think I am going to slit my throat with my own tail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得我要用自己的尾巴割断喉咙了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Somehow."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "总会有办法。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have wielded all my best arguments on you, and I have begun to fear they are all for naught. So I shall simply ask you one last time, and I shall pray that sanity shall prevail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我已向你倾尽所有最有力的论据，现在却开始担心这一切终将徒劳。所以我只想最后问你一次，并祈愿理智终将胜出。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No wonder the butler always looks so exhausted. He is always dealing with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难怪管家总是显得如此疲惫不堪。他整天都在应付你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do hope you are as good at concocting solutions "on the fly" as the others say you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望你真的像其他人说的那样擅长临场应变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. Because stuffing its fingers in a jar and then replicating them has gone so well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哼。把它的手指塞进罐子里再复制出来，这招不是挺管用的嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I beg you to remember all that I have said to you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我请你记住我对你说过的一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Otherwise, it seems we are all operating on a little "faith."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 否则看来我们全靠着一点"信念"在行动了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But perhaps it is not a poor solution.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过倒也不是最差的办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Is the Indifference a "god?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虚空无情之物是"神"吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Somehow."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "不管怎样。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think I am going to slit my throat with my own tail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得我要用自己的尾巴割断喉咙了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. Because stuffing its fingers in a jar and then replicating them has gone so well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哼。把它的手指塞进罐子里再复制出来，这招不是挺管用的嘛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do hope you are as good at concocting solutions "on the fly" as the others say you are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望你真的像其他人说的那样擅长临场应变。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No wonder the butler always looks so exhausted. He is always dealing with you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难怪管家总是显得如此疲惫不堪。他整天都在应付你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But perhaps it is not a poor solution.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过倒也不是最差的办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Otherwise, it seems we are all operating on a little "faith."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 否则看来我们全靠着一点"信念"在行动了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do I think about Marie? Besides attempting to convince you to let her join us for a night or two, Drifter dear? (I jest. I jest.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对玛丽怎么看？除了想说服你让她跟我们住上一两晚，亲爱的漂泊者？（开玩笑的。开玩笑的。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What do I think about Marie? Besides attempting to convince you to let me join in for a night or two? (I jest. I jest.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对玛丽怎么看？除了想说服你让我加入一两晚之外？（开玩笑的。开玩笑的。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: However did you manage to convince her to change her mind on Albrecht's purity? Quite the "miracle worker" you are. Perhaps they should not be worshipping Sol and Lua, but you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你究竟是如何说服她改变对阿尔布雷希特纯洁性的看法？你可真是个"奇迹制造者"。或许他们不该崇拜太阳神和月神，而该崇拜你才对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I did not know of her upbringing until recently. She never told me her story until she told it to you. You have bridged some manner of gap between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 直到最近我才知道她的成长经历。她从未向我提起过自己的故事，直到她向你倾诉。你弥合了我们之间某种隔阂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I never knew that she is still in daily pain. She hides it as though it is not there. She did not speak of it until she told you. You have bridged some manner of gap between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我从未意识到她每日都在忍受着痛苦。她却将痛苦隐藏得仿佛不存在一般。直到她向你倾诉，才提起这件事。你已某种方式弥合了我们之间的隔阂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The same as per usual. I am spending every waking moment attempting not to peel my own face off with my claws out of a desperate desire to drown her out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一如往常。我每时每刻都在竭力克制自己，不让自己为压过她那声音的绝望而用爪子撕下自己的脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Better now that I have someone with whom to vent my frustrations upon. But in all seriousness, tensions between us are much improved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在好多了，毕竟有人能让我发泄不满。但说真的，我们之间的紧张关系确实缓和多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not the one who is "getting on" with Lyon, now am I? Ha! Pardon the awful joke. I cannot help myself, and you made that far too easy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我可没跟里昂"打得火热"，对吧？哈！抱歉开了个糟糕的玩笑。我实在忍不住，你把这梗铺得太明显了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Better than it seems you and he have managed. How have you bungled it with him? All he needed was someone to listen to him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 比​你们​俩表面上​的​相处​看​起来​要​好​得​多。你到底怎么搞砸了？他需要的不过是个愿意倾听的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tensions between us are much improved, particularly since you have given him the confidence to speak of what has been ailing him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们之间的紧张关系确实缓和多了，特别是自从你让他有信心说出自己一直困扰的事情之后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tensions between us are much improved, particularly since you have given him the confidence to speak of what has been ailing him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们之间的紧张关系确实缓和多了，特别是自从你让他有信心说出自己一直困扰的事情之后。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The same as per usual. I am spending every waking moment attempting not to peel my own face off with my claws out of a desperate desire to drown him out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一如往常。我每时每刻都在竭力克制自己，不让自己为压过他那声音的绝望而用爪子撕下自己的脸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I find myself, more and more, wondering that although I cannot use the Dark Refractory to recover my memories as I am now a Protoframe...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我时常在想，尽管身为原型战甲，我无法借助深溯池来恢复记忆……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I admit I am finding them, little by little, slightly more tolerable. I think my recent revelations might have something to do with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我承认自己正渐渐觉得他们稍微好相处些了。我想这或许与我最近的发现有关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I admit I am finding them, little by little, slightly more tolerable. I think largely because, little by little, they are giving up on me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我承认自己正渐渐觉得他们稍微好相处些了。我想这主要因为他们也在一点点放弃我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wonder if she realizes that my goading has turned from honest annoyance into teasing in good fun?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道她有没有意识到，我的挑衅已从真诚的恼怒转变为愉快的戏谑？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must admit I do not blame you in the slightest. And not simply because she is gorgeous. I have eyes. That woman has more compassion in her than I would have expected to survive to her age.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我必须承认，我一点也不怪你。而且不仅仅是因为她美得惊人。我又不是瞎子。那位女士身上蕴藏的慈悲心，远超我对她这个年纪的预期。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Bah. It is that kind of language that led to the rise of the Orokin Empire. That is a mistake this System should never make twice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 呸。正是这种言论导致了奥罗金帝国的崛起。这个星系绝不能重蹈覆辙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To think her family threw her onto the streets. Her. Marie. That Marie. The one with more compassion in her than should be possible?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想到她的家人竟将她抛弃在街头。她。玛丽。那个玛丽。那个心怀超乎寻常慈悲的人？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I admit I am one of the fools she speaks of, who cannot wrap their minds around living in such a way, day in and day out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我承认自己正是她所说的愚人之一，无法理解有人竟能日复一日地如此生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They know my... secret. The truth of my taking of the serum willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们知道我的……秘密。知道我自愿注射血清的真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I commend you for braving that poor madman. He needs the company. And the compassion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我佩服你敢于面对那个可怜的疯子。他需要陪伴。也需要同情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yet you shut him out. Shame on you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 可你却将他拒之门外。真该死。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He spoke to me of the Tenno child he had been hearing. And how he does not hear him any longer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他向我提起那个他一直听见的 Tenno 小孩。以及他如今已听不见那声音了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I knew shockingly little of what had been done to him. It was not until he told you, that he had the willingness to tell me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我对他遭受的一切竟知之甚少。直到他向你倾诉后，他才终于愿意告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: ...if that does not yet preclude me from drowning myself in it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: ……但这未必能阻止我沉溺其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expected them to greet my penitence with mockery, with jeers of "finally, he sees the light" or "we told you so." Anything but. They have hardly made mention of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本以为他们会用嘲讽来回应我的忏悔，用"终于醒悟了"或"早该如此"之类的讥诮来嘲弄我。结果却恰恰相反。他们几乎没提过这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I tease. I am growing oddly fond of them, despite my renewed commitment to shut out their criticism of my decisions in life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 开个玩笑。尽管我重新下决心要屏蔽他们对我人生抉择的批评，却莫名地对他们越来越喜欢了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I hope so. It is too much fun to pester her. Watching her grow angry and shout at me in her native tongue is my new favorite sport.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我希望如此。捉弄她实在太有趣了。看着她火冒三丈地用母语朝我吼叫，成了我最近最爱的消遣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot describe to you my desire to use a Helminth to travel back in time to murder her entire family. Slowly. But she would likely object to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我无法向你描述自己多么渴望用 Helminth 穿越回过去杀光她全家。要慢慢杀。但她大概会反对吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How can she maintain such composure? Let alone compassion? I think I would have gone as mad as the priest in her condition.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她怎么还能保持如此镇定？更别说心存怜悯了？换作是我，恐怕早就像那位神父一样发疯了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But in all seriousness, tensions between us are much improved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但说真的，我们之间的紧张关系确实缓和多了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expect the voice will haunt him in his waking nightmares, all the same. That poor man will always question the line between reality and fiction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想那声音仍会在他清醒的噩梦中萦绕不去。那个可怜人将永远在现实与虚构的界限间徘徊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot describe to you my desire to use a Helminth to travel back in time to murder his parents. Slowly. But I fear he might object to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我无法向你描述自己多么渴望用 Helminth 穿越回过去杀死他的父母。要慢慢杀。但我怕他会反对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am glad they have not. I do not want my nose rubbed in it like a pup who has messed the carpet. I have enough to dwell on as it is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 幸好他们没有这么做。我可不想被当成弄脏地毯的小狗般被当面羞辱。眼下我已经够烦心了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Another reason matters are improved between us? They know my secret. The truth of my taking the serum willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们之间关系改善的另一个原因？他们知道了我的秘密。知道我自愿注射血清的真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Revenge killings are likely frowned upon by Sol, etcetera, etcetera.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 复仇杀人很可能遭到太阳神的谴责之类什么的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nor was I claiming that you did, Drifter darling. I told them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我也没有说是你干的，亲爱的漂泊者。是我告诉他们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I told them, Drifter darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，我告诉他们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Another reason matters are improved between us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们之间关系改善的另一个原因？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Revenge killings are likely frowned upon by Lua, etcetera, etcetera.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 复仇杀人很可能遭到月神的谴责之类什么的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Precisely. No sense in making enemies of one's new housemates. That was exactly why I kept stealing those pastries back in Gaule.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说得对。没必要和新室友结仇。这就是当年我在高卢老偷点心的原因。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Despite my best efforts, yes. And it boggles the mind. Yet here are, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管我尽了最大努力，是的。这实在令人费解。然而，事实就是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But the other reason why relations have improved between us?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我们之间关系改善的另一个原因？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. Perhaps I will attempt to replicate the recipe here. But, either way, I will do what I can to keep the peace. Well. Mostly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。或许我该试着在这里复刻那个配方。不过无论如何，我会尽力维持和平。好吧。大部分时候。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I told them, Drifter darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，我告诉他们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nor was I claiming that you did, Drifter darling. I told them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我也没有说是你干的，亲爱的漂泊者。是我告诉他们的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is just another thing for which I must make amends. They would learn the truth eventually, regardless. Better they hear it from my own lips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这不过是另一件我必须弥补的事。真相终究会传到他们耳中，与其如此，不如让我亲口来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have nothing to be ashamed of. It seemed pointless to hide it. They would learn the truth somehow, soon enough. Better they hear it from my own lips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我没什么可羞愧的。隐瞒似乎毫无意义。真相迟早会传到他们耳中。不如让我亲口来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They would learn the truth eventually, regardless. Better they hear it from my own lips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真相终究会传到他们耳中，与其如此，不如让我亲口来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will do what I can not to ruin everything for you, hm? Well. Naught that can't be repaired. Can't make your days too dull, you might go mad like the priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会尽力不毁了你的一切，嗯？好吧。反正不是无法挽回的事。不能让你的日子太无趣，否则你可能会像神父那样发疯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Can't make your days too dull, you might go mad like the priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不能让你的日子太无趣，否则你可能会像神父那样发疯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is just another thing for which I must make amends. They would learn the truth eventually, regardless. Better they hear it from my own lips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这不过是另一件我必须弥补的事。真相终究会传到他们耳中，与其如此，不如让我亲口来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have nothing to be ashamed of. It seemed pointless to hide it. They would learn the truth somehow, soon enough. Better they hear it from my own lips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我没什么可羞愧的。隐瞒似乎毫无意义。真相迟早会传到他们耳中。不如让我亲口来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They would learn the truth eventually, regardless. Better they hear it from my own lips.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真相终究会传到他们耳中，与其如此，不如让我亲口来说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expected them to greet my shame with mockery, with jeers of "finally, the devil is brought low." Anything but. They have hardly made mention of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本以为他们会用嘲讽来迎接我的耻辱，用"恶魔终于被击垮了"讥诮来嘲弄我。结果却恰恰相反。他们几乎没提过这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not how I would have expected. When I was reading silently by myself one evening, a few nights later, he approached on his own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 出乎我的意料。有天晚上我一个人静静看书的时候，他主动走了过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly Lyon. I think he understands the difficulty of facing down the past and the decisions we have made. See: eyepatch, if you will pardon the pun.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是里昂。我想他理解直面过去和我们做出的决定有多么艰难。请原谅这个双关语，看看那眼罩吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He sat down beside me and told me of how he has questioned his faith ever since Entrati gave him the serum. How he was ashamed of his questioning. How he regretted taking the serum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他坐在我旁边，告诉我自从英择谛给他注射血清后，他就一直在质疑自己的信仰。他为这份质疑感到羞愧，更后悔当初注射了血清。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expected them to greet my shame with mockery, with jeers of "finally, the devil is brought low." Anything but. They have hardly made mention of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本以为他们会用嘲讽来迎接我的耻辱，用"恶魔终于被击垮了"讥诮来嘲弄我。结果却恰恰相反。他们几乎没提过这件事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not how I would have expected. She said nothing. Instead, she simply... hugged me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 出乎我的意料。她什么也没说。她只是……抱住了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Most importantly, how he wished he could forget it all. And that perhaps, on some deeper level, we were all the same, the three of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 最重要的是，他多么希望能够忘掉这一切。也许在更深层面上，我们三人其实都一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly Marie. I think she understands that continually confronting me over matters of the past will do no good.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是玛丽。我想她明白，一再就过去的事与我争执没有益处。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Roathe of Old would have used the opportunity to remove her kidneys from her body, but I found I no longer had the desire to do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 昔日的罗瑟本会趁机摘除她的肾脏，但我发现自己已经不再有这种想法了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It took every ounce of willpower not to remove her kidneys from her body. But she meant only to offer me simple comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我竭尽全力控制才没有去摘除她的肾脏。但她只是想给我一点安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She meant only to offer me simple comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她只是想给我一点安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I shook his hand. And I thanked him as a friend. I am an Orokin, but I am not a monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我与他握手。以朋友的身份向他表示感谢。我是奥罗金人，但我不是怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When I told her the truth that we learned, she said nothing. Instead, she simply... hugged me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当我把真相告诉她时，她什么也没说。她只是……抱住了我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For once in my miserable life, I accepted the simple offer of comfort for what it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在我凄惨的一生中，第一次坦然接受了这份简单的安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was a simple way of telling me that perhaps she did not care nearly as much as I did. And that she was sorry for all the pain I had put myself through over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她只是用这样一种简单的方式告诉我，或许她根本没有我这么在乎这件事。同时她为我因此承受的痛苦感到抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am afraid you are likely right. He was dealt a terrible hand by fate, and he has done all he can to withstand it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恐怕你说的没错。命运给他发了手烂牌，而他已竭尽全力去抗争了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think in the end it will prove to be more than that. Even if I despise that fact. I cannot help but be trapped with them, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为最终它会证明远不止于此。即便我厌恶这个事实。毕竟，我终究无法摆脱与他们纠缠的命运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Since then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 自那以后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When I was reading silently by myself one evening, a few nights later, he approached on his own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 有天晚上我一个人静静看书的时候，他主动走了过来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I embraced her in return, of course. I am an Orokin, but I am not a monster.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我当然也回抱了她。我是奥罗金人，但我不是怪物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That priest. If I will end on a single note, I will let it be this: his resilience is somehow as endless as time itself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那位神父。如果要我以一句话作结，那就是：他的韧性如同时间本身般无穷无尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He has barely made mention of any of it. Which I am deeply grateful for. I expected jeers and mockery. "Finally, the devil is brought low." Anything but. They have gone on as though little has changed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他几乎没提过这件事。对此我深表感激。我本以为会听到嘲笑和讥讽。"恶魔终于被击垮了"。结果却恰恰相反。他们照常生活，仿佛没什么变化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Roathe of Old would have used the opportunity to remove her kidneys from her body, but I found I no longer had the desire to do so.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 昔日的罗瑟本会趁机摘除她的肾脏，但我发现自己已经不再有这种想法了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It took every ounce of willpower not to remove her kidneys from her body. But she meant only to offer me simple comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我竭尽全力控制才没有去摘除她的肾脏。但她只是想给我一点安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She meant only to offer me simple comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她只是想给我一点安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Indeed. And I have you to thank for that, don't I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 确实如此。这都要感谢你，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think in the end it will prove to be more than that. Even if I despise that fact. I cannot help but be trapped with them, after all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为最终它会证明远不止于此。即便我厌恶这个事实。毕竟，我终究无法摆脱与他们纠缠的命运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He sat down beside me and told me of how he has questioned his faith ever since Entrati gave him the serum. How he was ashamed of his questioning. How he regretted taking the serum.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他坐在我旁边，告诉我自从英择谛给他注射血清后，他就一直在质疑自己的信仰。他为这份质疑感到羞愧，更后悔当初注射了血清。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Since then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 自那以后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For a man who has shattered, he has yet to fall apart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一个已经支离破碎的人，却始终没有彻底崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For once in my miserable life, I accepted the simple offer of comfort for what it was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在我凄惨的一生中，第一次坦然接受了这份简单的安慰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was a simple way of telling me that perhaps she did not care nearly as much as I did. And that she was sorry for all the pain I had put myself through over it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她只是用这样一种简单的方式告诉我，或许她根本没有我这么在乎这件事。同时她为我因此承受的痛苦感到抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Since then?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 自那以后？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That Sister of Sol. If I will end on a single note, I will let it be this: her kindness is somehow as endless as time itself.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那位太阳神​修女。如果要我以一句话作结，那就是：她的仁慈如同时间本身般无穷无尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Most importantly, how he wished he could forget it all. And that perhaps, on some deeper level, we were all the same, the three of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 最重要的是，他多么希望能够忘掉这一切。也许在更深层面上，我们三人其实都一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They have barely made mention of any of it. Which I am deeply grateful for. I expected jeers and mockery. "Finally, the devil is brought low." Anything but. They have gone on as though little has changed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们几乎没提过这件事。对此我深表感激。我本以为会听到嘲笑和讥讽。"恶魔终于被击垮了"。结果却恰恰相反。他们照常生活，仿佛没什么变化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They have barely made mention of any of it. Which I am deeply grateful for. I expected jeers and mockery. "Finally, the devil is brought low." Anything but. They have gone on as though little has changed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们几乎没提过这件事。对此我深表感激。我本以为会听到嘲笑和讥讽。"恶魔终于被击垮了"。结果却恰恰相反。他们照常生活，仿佛没什么变化。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The forgiveness and compassion she will extend to others comes with no conditions.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她给予他人的宽恕与仁慈是毫无条件的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I think there is a lesson in that for all of us. Be kind to him, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这其中蕴含着对我们所有人的启示。漂泊者，对他好些吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I think there is a lesson in that for all of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这其中蕴含着对我们所有人的启示。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I think there is a lesson in that for all of us. Be gentle to her, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这其中蕴含着对我们所有人的启示。漂泊者，对她温柔些吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I think there is a lesson in that for all of us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得这其中蕴含着对我们所有人的启示。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have been thinking on this matter of the butler and Albrecht's family upstairs. And how much I am looking forward to "reuniting them."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一直在思考管家和楼上阿尔布雷希特一家的事。多么期待他们"团聚"啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have been thinking on this matter of the butler and Albrecht's family upstairs. And how much I am looking forward to reuniting them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一直在思考管家和楼上阿尔布雷希特一家的事。多么期待他们团聚啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have been thinking over this whole situation with the butler and the family upstairs. It is entirely untenable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一直在思考管家和楼上阿尔布雷希特一家之间的事。这种局面完全无法容忍。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot remain trapped down here in secret. If I am to wield my influence upon the world, I must be able to work in public.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不能永远被困在这秘密之地。如果我对世界施加影响，就必须能在公开场合行事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If I am to be any manner of asset, or if I am to be of any kind of use to anyone, I cannot do it trapped down here in secret.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果我要成为某种助力，或对任何人有任何用处，就不能被困在这秘密之地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with both the zealots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过恐怕没什么用，毕竟你和那两个狂热分子都搞砸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过恐怕没什么用，毕竟你和玛丽的事搞砸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过恐怕没什么用，毕竟你和里昂的事搞砸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The zealots are eager as well, if for very different reasons than mine. Well done in convincing them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 狂热分子们同样也很热情，只是他们的理由与我截然不同。说服得真好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Marie is eager as well, if for a different reason than mine. Now we just wait to see if you can convince Lyon. Try not to bungle that up, if you can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽同样也很热情，只是理由与我的截然不同。现在只等看你能不能说服里昂。如果可以的话，尽量别搞砸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Lyon is eager as well, if for a different reason than mine. Now we just wait to see if you can convince Marie. Try not to bungle that up, if you can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 里昂同样也很热情，只是理由与我的截然不同。现在只等看你能不能说服玛丽。如果可以的话，尽量别搞砸了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Besides which, Albrecht's family likely has resources and access to items I will need. Do you see what I'm getting at?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 况且，阿尔布雷​希特一​家很可能拥有我需要的资源和物品。你明白我的意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You know me. Always an inspirational source of motivation. But you know, if you get discouraged, you could always... what is the phrase?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你了解我的。我永远是激励人心的动力源泉。不过，如果你感到气馁，你大可以……那句话怎么说来着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing them to help, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我或许能在这方面帮上忙，没错。而且激励他们给你第二次机会说服他们帮忙，也正合我意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing her to help, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我或许能在这方面帮上忙，没错。而且激励他们给你第二次机会说服她帮忙，也正合我意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing him to help, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想我或许能在这方面帮上忙，没错。而且激励他们给你第二次机会说服他帮忙，也正合我意。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "When?" Ha! I doubt that bastard will ever set foot in this place again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "回来？"哈！我怀疑那混蛋再也不会踏进这地方半步了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We will not have long to wait until we find out, I hope. I am more curious how they will react to my insistence that they accept my protection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 希望我们很快就会知道答案。我更想知道他们会如何回应我坚持要他们接受我保护的要求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Several. First, I am tired of mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好几个。首先，我厌倦了像动物园里的动物一样，在这座复刻的墓穴里腐烂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Begin again?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "再来？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在这座复刻的墓穴里腐烂，活像被关在动物园的动物，这种日子越来越没意思了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在这座复刻的墓穴里腐烂，活像被关在动物园的动物，这种日子越来越没意思了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在这座复刻的墓穴里腐烂，活像被关在动物园的动物，这种日子越来越没意思了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Euleria is no fool. She will know my motivation for doing so. I doubt she will accept it without some level of unease.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 欧拉瑞娅可不是傻人。她会明白我这么做的动机。我不认为她能毫无戒心地接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are an immense waste of time. How wonderful for you that you can repeat it at will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你简直是浪费时间的无底洞。真为你高兴，你还能随心所欲地重复这种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I realize now that this was a mistake. You are an immense waste of time. How wonderful for you that you can repeat it at will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我现在意识到这是个错误。你简直是在浪费我的时间。真为你高兴，你还能随心所欲地重复这种事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with them. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我对他们能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。你要明白，我的能力也有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Marie. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在玛丽的事情上能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。你要明白，我的能力也有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Lyon. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在里昂的事情上能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。你要明白，我的能力也有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, Drifter. I think Albrecht has quit this place and his family once and for all. I doubt he will ever lay eyes on his daughter again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，漂泊者。我认为阿尔布雷希特已经永远离开了这个地方和他的家人。我怀疑他再也不会见到他的女儿了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No, Drifter darling. I think Albrecht has quit this place and his family once and for all. I doubt he will ever lay eyes on his daughter again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，亲爱的漂泊者。我认为阿尔布雷希特已经永远离开了这个地方和他的家人。我怀疑他再也不会见到他的女儿了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, what better way to get my revenge against Albrecht? Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，还有什么比这更好的方式来报复阿尔布雷希特？没错，我自愿注射了血清，但把我扔到过去的人是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, it strikes me as a kind of penance to pay, to protect Deimos and the Entrati family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，我认为这是一种赎罪行为，为了保护火卫二和英择谛家族免受阿尔布雷希特债务到期时可能降临的灾祸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is now your only recourse at this point should you ever wish to change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你以后想改变主意，你只能重置时间了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The stubborn creature is not so immutable as it seems. Finally!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这个顽固的家伙并不像看起来那样不可改变。终于！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am glad to see I can temper your wanton stubbornness, Drifter darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很高兴看到我能磨平你那任性的倔强，亲爱的漂泊者。
