/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们得一个一个地来。先从两人中比较理性的那位开始吧，也就是神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Several. First, I am tired of mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好几个。首先，我厌倦了像动物园里的动物一样，在这座复刻的墓穴里腐烂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course not! She would see through me clear as day. Nor would I try to hide what would be so obvious to read to someone as clever as her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然不会！她一眼就能看穿我。况且，对于她这样聪明的人，我也不会刻意隐瞒那些显而易见的事情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He is the one who destroyed my memories and ensured I would have no one other than you to turn to retrieve them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是他摧毁了我的记忆，还确保除了你之外再无人能帮我找回那些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The family will need protection. I should be standing guard. I cannot do that when I am locked in the basement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 家族需要保护。我本该守卫着他们。但被锁在地下室里，这根本办不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And it is best for their sake that he never does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而为了他们好，最好他永远都不要再见到她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But you likely know that as well as I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但你很可能和我一样清楚这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, what better way to get my revenge against Albrecht? Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，还有什么比这更好的方式来报复阿尔布雷希特？没错，我自愿注射了血清，但把我扔到过去的人是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Second, it strikes me as a kind of penance to pay, to protect Deimos and the Entrati family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 其次，我认为这是一种赎罪行为，为了保护火卫二和英择谛家族免受阿尔布雷希特债务到期时可能降临的灾祸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She knows that she would need me to protect Deimos and the rest of her family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她知道，当阿尔布雷希特的债务到期时，她需要我保护火卫二以及她的家人免受可能降临的灾祸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: She would know I was there to get revenge against Albrecht. Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她会知道我是来向阿尔布雷希特报仇的。没错，我自愿注射了血清，但把我扔到过去的人是他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And while, yes, you turned out to be more... delicious than I would have thought you to be, Drifter dear, how was that a guarantee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然，没错，你比我想象中更……令人心动，亲爱的漂泊者，但谁又能保证呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会保护火卫二。我会保护虚空之心。更重要的是，我会保护阿尔布雷希特的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes, Drifter darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话，管它是不是"神"呢？虚空无情之物终将前来索取应得之物。亲爱的漂泊者，而当那一天到来时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话，管它是不是"神"呢？虚空无情之物终将前来索取应得之物。而当那一天到来时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The question simply remains, will the other two aid us in our endeavor? This will take a coordinated effort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 问题依然是，另外两人会不会协助我们的行动？这需要我们齐心协力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会保护火卫二。我会保护虚空之心。更重要的是，我会保护阿尔布雷希特的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In a roundabout way, yes. For you see, I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 说来话长，但答案是肯定的。因为你要知道，我会保护火卫二。我会保护虚空之心。更重要的是，我会保护阿尔布雷希特的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Likely because he fears what he would bring back with him. Although it is far too late for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。很可能是因为他害怕自己会带回什么。尽管为时已晚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He is the one who destroyed my memories and ensured I would have no one other than you to turn to retrieve them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是他摧毁了我的记忆，还确保除了你之外再无人能帮我找回那些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The family will need protection. I should be standing guard. I cannot do that when I am locked in the basement.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 家族需要保护。我本该守卫着他们。但被锁在地下室里，这根本办不到。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The family will need protection. And they are all a bit "rooted to the spot" as it were, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 家庭需要保护。而且他们都像被"钉在原地"似的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But it will be worth the risk. She has no other means of protecting Deimos. Or her family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这风险值得承担。她没有其他方式能保护火卫二。或是保护她的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 直到他亲眼看着我杀掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 直到他亲眼看着我杀掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会保护火卫二。我会保护虚空之心。更重要的是，我会保护阿尔布雷希特的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words. The day Albrecht returns?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话。阿尔布雷希特回来的那一天？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There will be Hell to pay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那将是地狱般的报应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words. The day Albrecht returns?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话。阿尔布雷希特回来的那一天？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话，管它是不是"神"呢？虚空无情之物终将前来索取应得之物。而当那一天到来时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话，管它是不是"神"呢？虚空无情之物终将前来索取应得之物。亲爱的漂泊者，而当那一天到来时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会保护火卫二。我会保护虚空之心。更重要的是，我会保护阿尔布雷希特的家人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And while, yes, you turned out to be more... delicious than I would have thought you to be, Drifter dear, how was that a guarantee?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然，没错，你比我想象中更……令人心动，亲爱的漂泊者，但谁又能保证呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话，管它是不是"神"呢？虚空无情之物终将前来索取应得之物。而当那一天到来时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes, Drifter darling?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话，管它是不是"神"呢？虚空无情之物终将前来索取应得之物。亲爱的漂泊者，而当那一天到来时？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 直到他亲眼看着我杀掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not sure what I was expecting...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道自己到底在期待什么……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did you manage to bungle things with the priest?! He's the logical one of the two!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你居然把神父的事搞砸了？！他明明是两人中最理性的人！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course you managed to bungle things with her. Of course, you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你当然搞砸了和她的关系。果然如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How did you manage to bungle things with the priest?! He's the logical one of the two!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你居然把神父的事搞砸了？！他明明是两人中最理性的人！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Of course you managed to bungle things with her. Of course, you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你当然搞砸了和她的关系。果然如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How in the name of the Void did you manage to bungle it with the both of them?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你到底是怎么把他们两个的事都搞砸的？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 直到他亲眼看着我杀掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. Well, it is a start. Try not to bungle things up with Marie in the meanwhile, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。好吧，这算是个开始。不过在此期间别搞砸了和玛丽的事，明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Hm. Well, it is a start. Try not to bungle things up with Lyon in the meanwhile, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。好吧，这算是个开始。不过在此期间别搞砸了和里昂的事，明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fantastic. Now the work can begin. But this will take time. I recommend patience. If such a thing is possible.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太棒了。现在可以开始工作了。不过这需要时间。我建议保持耐心。如果这可能的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。我会尽我所能帮你收拾残局。但你要明白，我的能力有限。扫清障碍和实际完成工作是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。我会尽我所能帮你收拾残局。但你要明白，我的能力有限。扫清障碍和实际完成工作是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。我会尽我所能帮你收拾残局。但你要明白，我的能力有限。扫清障碍和实际完成工作是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mark my words. The day Albrecht returns?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住我的话。阿尔布雷希特回来的那一天？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There will be Hell to pay.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那将是地狱般的报应。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。我会尽我所能帮你收拾残局。但你要明白，我的能力有限。扫清障碍和实际完成工作是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。我会尽我所能帮你收拾残局。但你要明白，我的能力有限。扫清障碍和实际完成工作是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Simply try not to botch things with Marie while I work on convincing Lyon to give you a second chance to explain yourself. Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你只要努力别把和玛丽的事搞砸，我来想办法说服里昂再给你一次解释的机会。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Simply try not to botch things with the priest while I work on convincing Marie to give you a second chance to explain yourself. Yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你只要努力别把和神父的事搞砸，我来想办法说服玛丽再给你一次解释的机会。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们得一个一个地来。先从两人中比较理性的那位开始吧，也就是神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have not quite managed to understand what you have been doing with your time. You have neither failed, nor succeeded in convincing either of the zealots yet, it seems.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我一直都不太明白你究竟在忙些什么。看起来你既没有失败，但也没成功说服那两个狂热分子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You fool! What have you done?! Why, why go and delve into caverns where you are not welcome?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这个蠢人！你都做了些什么？！为什么，为什么要擅闯那些不欢迎你的洞穴？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I demand you fix this. This is your fault. I can feel it, clawing at me, tearing at me. Like some great beast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我要求你解决这个问题。这是你的错。我能感觉到，这些记忆就像一头巨大的野兽，在撕咬着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Rid me of this. Rid me of this plague. Clear my mind of these memories. I know you can. Use this gift that you have and end it all. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 让我摆脱这一切。让我摆脱这场瘟疫。清除我脑海中的这些记忆。我知道你能做到。运用你拥有的天赋，结束这一切。现在就结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很有可能。我会把所有线索联系起来，然后怪你做了我没让你做的事。我相信你能挺过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是这样。你说的很可能没错。但我现在也没有其他办法了，不是吗？值得一试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果真是那样，你完全可以再做一遍。这就像你拥有取之不尽的天赋，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，一旦我发现你篡改了我的记忆，我一定会非常生气。而且，亲爱的，我建议你最好别告诉我这是应我的要求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会直接认定你在撒谎，这很可能会让我对你的看法彻底崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行？如果你还想让管家上楼？那就按我说的，帮我把脑子里所有这些乱七八糟的事情都忘掉。如果你不在乎？那就随你便。我也不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，还有一点，我们之间依然存在私人友谊，是我在这件事上唯一能用的筹码。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What say you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. Get to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好，去做吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not dare - do not dare to speak to me of "calming down!" Do you not think I have every right to feel as though I am being torn in half?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟敢——你竟敢跟我提什么"冷静点"！难道你不觉得我有充分的理由感到自己快要被撕成两半吗？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Fascinating. Fascinating and unexpected. Explain.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真有意思。既有意思又出乎意料。请解释一下。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I feel as though I have had the very understanding of myself, the very basis of my foundation, cracked and torn open like damnable Lua herself! Rewritten in ink that runs. Coward!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我感觉自己对自己的认知，我赖以生存的根基，就像该死的月球一样，被彻底撕裂、崩裂！一切都被墨迹改写，荡然无存。懦夫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And you dare to tell me to "calm down?!"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟然敢叫我"冷静点"？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, I do think you would be a bit of a "connoisseur" of such things, wouldn't you? Go on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我觉得你对这类事情应该算是比较"懂行"的，对吧？继续。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must go. I am in the mood to drink a great deal of alcohol and stare off broodingly into the middle distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。我现在想喝很多酒，然后对着远方发呆、沉思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很感激。比你想象的还要感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know, Usurper. And therein lies the greatest problem.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道，篡位者。而这正是最大的问题所在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Within me is a malestrom of a rabid beast, eating away at my ribcage from the inside out.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我体内有一头狂暴的野兽，正从内而外地啃噬我的肋骨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I do not know how to sate it. I do not know that I can. I had hoped that these conversations might have shown me a way; but I see now that this is fruitless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该如何满足它。我不知道我是否能够满足它。我曾希望这些谈话能为我指明方向；但我现在明白，这一切都是徒劳的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is a solution though, is there not? You have it within your power to fix this... this horrible agony within my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但总有解决办法，不是吗？你有能力解决这个问题……解决我内心这种可怕的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Usurper. Drifter. I am begging you now. Indeed, it is the only way I believe we can move forward, yes? It is for your own self-interests as well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者。漂泊者。我现在求求你了。的确，我相信这是我们继续前进的唯一方法，对吗？这也符合你自身的利益。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you ever wish for the butler to go upstairs and reconcile with the Entrati family, you must do as I say. You must.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你希望管家上楼去和英择谛一家和解，你就必须听我的。你必须听我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A retreat to win the war. Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 以退为进。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive myself for what I have done? And move forward into the future? Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅自己所做的一切？然后继续向前走？嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have a gift. A gift that can undo time. Spiral it, if not loop it. And this has... an interesting effect upon the minds of Protoframes, by its attachment to the Infestation and its attachment to time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你拥有一种天赋。一种可以逆转时间的天赋。它能让时间螺旋式上升，甚至循环往复。而这种天赋，由于与 Infestation 和时间的关联，对原型战甲的思维产生了……一种奇妙的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: If you can say to me that you have never once used your gifts to play with the minds of the Protoframes you call friends and lovers, and you can say it without a lie in your soul?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那你能不能告诉我，你从未利用你的天赋玩弄过你称之为朋友和爱人的原型战甲的记忆，并且你能发自内心地说出这番话，没有丝毫谎言？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And our attachment, therefore, to time. I ask you now. No, I beseech you, to wield it now on my behalf. Take these thoughts away from me. Take these memories away from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 因此，我们附着在时间上。我现在请求你。不，我恳求你，现在就替我掌控这些记忆。带走我的这些记忆。抹去我的这些记忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Then very well. So be it. I will not ask this of you now. But if you have never once done it for your own amusement, curiosity, or to seek to undue errors you have made in the dealings with others?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那么好吧，就这样吧。我现在不会要求你这么做。但是，谁知道你有没有为了取乐、好奇，或者为了弥补你在与他人交往中所犯的错误而这样做过呢？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have to forget taking the serum from Entrati. Please.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我必须忘记我自愿注射英择谛的血清的记忆。求你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。赶紧行动吧。我厌倦了把这些信息记在脑子里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Time does seem to be something we have in abundance, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们似乎不缺时间，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What say you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，还有一点，我们之间依然存在私人友谊，是我在这件事上唯一能用的筹码。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行？如果你还想让管家上楼？那就按我说的，帮我把脑子里所有这些乱七八糟的事情都忘掉。如果你不在乎？那就随你便。我也不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会直接认定你在撒谎，这很可能会让我对你的看法彻底崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，一旦我发现你篡改了我的记忆，我一定会非常生气。而且，漂泊者，我建议你最好别告诉我这是应我的要求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果真是那样，你完全可以再做一遍。这就像你拥有取之不尽的天赋，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是这样。你说的很可能没错。但我现在也没有其他办法了，不是吗？值得一试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am... slightly dubious of your reframing of your events as a tactical retreat, I admit I am... in favor of it, all the same, Usurper. Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我对……你将这件事重新定义为战术性撤退的说法略有怀疑，但我承认，我仍然赞同这种说法，篡位者。漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am slightly dubious of your reframing of the situation, I am... too tempted by this new future an what it might mean for me to resist it, Usurper. Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我对你重新解读局势的方式略有怀疑，但我……太渴望这个新的未来以及它可能带给我的意义，以至于无法抗拒，篡位者。漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This "new lease" on my life. Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这简直是我人生的"新生"。好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。谢谢你，漂泊者，在我无数次徘徊的危崖边将我拉回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很感激。比你想象的还要感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must go. I am in the mood to drink a great deal of alcohol and stare off broodingly into the middle distance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我得走了。我现在想喝很多酒，然后对着远方发呆、沉思。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很有可能。我会把所有线索联系起来，然后怪你做了我没让你做的事。我相信你能挺过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And here we are, twiddling our thumbs. Either you truly have nothing better to do, Usurper, or you have all that you want from me. Which is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们现在在这里无所事事。篡位者，要么你真的无所事事，要么你已经从我这里得到了你想要的一切。到底是哪种情况？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You fool! What have you done?! Why, why go and delve into caverns where you are not welcome?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你这个蠢人！你都做了些什么？！为什么，为什么要擅闯那些不欢迎你的洞穴？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Have you made up your mind yet? I am a patient devil, but I have my limits. Will you wipe my mind clean of these memories, or do you wish to let me linger on?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你决定好了吗？我这人耐心得很，但也是有限度的。你会抹去我脑海中的这些记忆，还是想让我继续陷入其中？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here we are, and here we shall remain. In this Purgatory. I hope you enjoy it here, as I do not think we shall ever go a step farther.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们现在身处此情此景，也将永远停留于此。在这炼狱之中。我希望你们能享受这里的一切，因为我想我们再也无法离开这里了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: May I ask precisely what it is you are waiting for? I sit here with my recollection of events still perfectly intact. You gave me your word that you would clear them from my mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 请问你究竟在等什么？我坐在这里，对发生的一切记忆依然清晰。你曾向我保证，你会把它们从我的记忆中抹去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A new day dawns, and I find myself planning for the future for the first time in... a long time. Thinking on what this means for me, for what I want, for how I wish to reshape my environment to suit me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 新的一天来临，我发现自己很久以来第一次开始规划未来。我思考着这对我意味着什么，我想要什么，以及我希望如何改造我的环境以适应我的需求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A new day dawns, and I find myself planning for the future for the first time in... a long time. Thinking on how I could reshape this world around me. On how I could wield what I know. What I am. How I could make better use of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 新的一天来临，我发现自己很久以来第一次开始规划未来。我思考着如何重塑我周围的世界，如何运用我的知识和能力，如何更好地发挥我的优势。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I demand you fix this. This is your fault. I can feel it, clawing at me, tearing at me. Like some great beast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我要求你解决这个问题。这是你的错。我能感觉到，这些记忆就像一头巨大的野兽，在撕咬着我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论你想要什么，现在都别想得到。你最好就此作罢，让我彻底忘记我们之间这段荒唐的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，无论你想要什么，现在都别想得到。你最好就此作罢，让我彻底忘记我们之间这段荒唐的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is quite clear, you needn't worry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一点很清楚，你不必担心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Rid me of this. Rid me of this plague. Clear my mind of these memories. I know you can. Use this gift that you have and end it all. Now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 让我摆脱这一切。让我摆脱这场瘟疫。清除我脑海中的这些记忆。我知道你能做到。运用你拥有的天赋，结束这一切。现在就结束。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你执意如此，那这将是你唯一的出路。如果你不在乎，那我也不在乎。随你便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Even if it means we are trapped forever in this impasse? You poor, sad Usurper... very well. Purgatory is an improvement over Hell for a devil, is it not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 即使这意味着我们将永远被困在这个僵局中？你这可怜的、悲哀的篡位者……好吧。对恶魔来说，炼狱总比地狱好，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。赶紧行动吧。我厌倦了把这些信息记在脑子里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though, what does it matter to you? You have all that you wish to cut from my empty corpse. My ribs are bare and bleached.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，这对你又有什么关系呢？你还想从我空荡荡的尸体上割下什么呢。我的肋骨光秃秃的，已经褪色了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Tragic, isn't it? Knowing that the dregs of Entrati's family will never know that the butler molders down here, wringing his hands in grief? All alone?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是悲剧，不是吗？英择谛家族的那些渣滓永远不会知道，管家就这么孤零零地躺在这里，双手紧紧地绞在一起，悲痛欲绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. Very well. I am a patient devil, but the waters of that well can be exhausted over time, trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，好吧。我这个人很有耐心，但相信我，耐心也是有限度的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see. As simple as that, is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我明白了。就这么轻易改变了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. See that you do. I am a patient devil, but the waters of that well can be exhausted over time, trust me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。请你一定要这么做。我这人很有耐心，但相信我，时间长了，井里的水也会干涸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due largely to your help, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，如果我还不承认这很大程度上要归功于你的帮助，那就太失礼了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due largely to your help, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，如果我还不承认这很大程度上要归功于你的帮助，那就太失礼了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due to your help, Usurper. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，如果我不感谢你的帮助，那就太失礼了。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due to your help, darling. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，如果我不感谢你的帮助，那就太失礼了。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And do not concern yourself with bothering the zealots to whine in my ear hoping to convince me to show you mercy. It will not work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别费心去烦那些狂热分子，让他们在我耳边哀求，指望我能对你发慈悲。这没用的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know whom the zealots will be more disappointed at; you or I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道狂热分子们会更对谁失望：是你还是我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 也许是这样。你说的很可能没错。但我现在也没有其他办法了，不是吗？值得一试。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果真是那样，你完全可以再做一遍。这就像你拥有取之不尽的天赋，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很有可能。我会把所有线索联系起来，然后怪你做了我没让你做的事。我相信你能挺过难关。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You can also say farewell to our other contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也可以和我们之前的另一笔交易说再见了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I was rather looking forward to watching him shake in terror as he crawled up those stairs in shame.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我倒挺期待看到他羞愧地爬上楼梯，浑身颤抖的样子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But what does it matter to you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但这跟你有什么关系呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm. Yes. Well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯。好吧。那么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not push your luck, Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，别得寸进尺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How... quaint.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真……古朴。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，一旦我发现你篡改了我的记忆，我一定会非常生气。而且，亲爱的，我建议你最好别告诉我这是应我的要求。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Naught.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 完全没有。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, yes, well. I know how much you enjoy this "pointy tail"  of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，是的。我知道你很喜欢我这条"尖尾巴"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Mm, yes, well. I know how much you enjoy this "pointy tail"  of mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，是的。我知道你很喜欢我这条"尖尾巴"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply wished to express my gratitude. Not linger on it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是想表达我的感激之情，并不想过多赘述。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now that we have that done, I believe we have something else to discuss, do we not?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 既然这件事已经办妥，我想我们还有其他事情要讨论，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会直接认定你在撒谎，这很可能会让我对你的看法彻底崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Don't be so bitter, just because you realize now that you have been outplayed. I offered you the terms of the contract without ever spelling out my end of things. Or did you fail to notice?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别这么愤愤不平，就算你现在意识到自己被我耍了也一样。我当初就把交易条款都告诉你了，却从未明确说明我的条件。难道你没注意到吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I offered you the terms of the contract without ever spelling out my end of things. Or did you fail to notice?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我向你提供了交易条款，但从未明确说明我的义务。难道你没注意到吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "I am in need of someone to help me record my memories and assist me in reconciling them. A temporary assistant of sorts."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "我还需要有人帮我记录记忆，并帮助我整理它们。算是一个临时的助手吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，无论你想要什么，现在都别想得到了。你最好就此作罢，让我彻底忘记我们之间这段荒唐的经历。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I simply said what you would have out of the arrangement. I never said what you had to do, or why, to get them. And you blindly agreed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我只是告诉你能从这项安排中得到什么。我从没说过你必须做什么，也没说过为什么要这样做才能得到它们。而你却盲目地同意了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While you met the first criteria, "recording my memories," you failed spectacularly at the latter, "assist me in reconciling them."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然你满足了第一个标准"记录我的记忆"，但你在第二个标准"帮助我整理它们"上却彻底失败了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你执意如此，那这将是你唯一的出路。如果你不在乎，那我也不在乎。随你便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Each time we speak I cannot help but wonder if the shores we tread are familiar or foreign to you. If I am merely repeating myself, or if I hold some new surprise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 每次我们交谈，我都会忍不住想，我们踏上的这片土地，对你来说是熟悉还是陌生？我只是在重复自己说过的话，还是会给你带来新的惊喜？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You upheld your end of our contract. We have now come to the penultimate point where we must arrange the particulars of how we will lay out our method of attack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你履行了交易义务。现在我们来到了倒数第二个阶段，必须敲定我们进攻策略的具体细节。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不行？如果你还想让管家上楼？那就按我说的，帮我把脑子里所有这些乱七八糟的事情都忘掉。如果你不在乎？那就随你便。我也不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I would hardly say they are reconciled, would you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很难说已经跟这些记忆和解了，你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours, "Drifter darling."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧，无论你想要什么，现在都别想得到。你最好就此作罢，让我彻底忘记我们之间这段荒唐的经历。"亲爱的漂泊者"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And do not concern yourself with bothering the zealots to whine in my ear hoping to convince me to show you mercy. It will not work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别费心去烦那些狂热分子，让他们在我耳边哀求，指望我能对你发慈悲。这没用的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Either way, I'd rather you not tell me. I hate when I am too overtly predictable. Regardless, you have helped me resolve a matter keenly important to my own self.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 总之，我宁愿你别告诉我。我讨厌自己太容易被人猜到。不过，你确实帮我解决了一个对我来说非常重要的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This battle must be waged on three fronts. All must work in concert for this war to be won.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这场战役必须在三个战线上同时展开。所有人必须齐心协力，才能赢得这场战争。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，还有一点，我们之间依然存在私人友谊，是我在这件事上唯一能用的筹码。就这么简单。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You did not meet your end of the bargain, so I shall not meet mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你没有履行你的承诺，所以我也不会履行我的承诺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如果你执意如此，那这将是你唯一的出路。如果你不在乎，那我也不在乎。随你便吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I slept better last night than I have in so very long. I would say "longer than I can remember," but that would be a joke in very poor taste.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 昨晚我睡得比以往任何时候都好。要说"好到我都记不清有多久了"，那可就太没品了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What say you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. And I am no longer in the mood to assist you in such matters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不用，我已经没有心情在这些事情上帮你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The same way you found yourself mired in it in the first place.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就像你当初发现自己深陷其中时那样做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And do not concern yourself with bothering the zealots to whine in my ear hoping to convince me to show you mercy. It will not work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 别费心去烦那些狂热分子，让他们在我耳边哀求，指望我能对你发慈悲。这没用的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So in turn, I shall now help you. The butler. Do you wish to still reunite him with Albrecht's family upstairs?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以，现在轮到我来帮你了。那个管家。你还想让他和楼上的阿尔布雷希特一家团聚吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The butler. Reuniting him with Albrecht's family. You still wish to do this, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 管家。让他与阿尔布雷希特的家人团聚。你还想这么做，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes. Do try to keep up. I assume you still wish to reunite him Albrecht's family upstairs, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是​的。​请​尽量​跟​上。​我​猜​你​仍然​想​让​他​和​楼上​的​阿尔布雷​希特一​家​团聚，​对​吗？​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or perhaps a new methodology is required. I am not here to assist you in such matters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许需要另一种新的方法。不过我不想在这方面为你提供帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. And I am no longer in the mood to assist you in such matters.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不用，我已经没有心情在这些事情上帮你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I think you know how. But in case you've forgotten, allow me to remind you... what is the phrase?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想你知道怎么做。但要是你忘了，让我提醒你一下……那句话怎么说来着？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Begin again."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "再来！"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Good. Get to it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好，去做吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do all this work, you come all this way, and now you decide it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你付出了这么多努力，走了这么远的路，现在你却决定……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How in the name of the Void did you manage to bungle it with the both of them?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你到底是怎么把他们两个的事都搞砸的？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do all this work, you come all this way, and now you decide it...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你付出了这么多努力，走了这么远的路，现在你却决定……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How in the name of the Void did you manage to bungle it with the both of them?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你到底是怎么把他们两个的事都搞砸的？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are confounding. Utterly and maddeningly perplexing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是令人费解，完全令人困惑，简直让人抓狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed. But this will take time. The butler is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。需要的时候我会全力支持你。但这需要时间。那个管家是个固执的傻瓜，我们需要协同作战才能说服他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。必要时我会支持你，但你要记住，我们需要那两个狂热分子与我通力合作，才能说服管家走上楼梯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。必要时我会支持你，但你要记住，我们需要那两个狂热分子与我通力合作，才能说服管家走上楼梯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。必要时我会支持你，但你要记住，我们需要那两个狂热分子与我通力合作，才能说服管家走上楼梯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。我会尽我所能帮你收拾残局。但你要明白，我的能力有限。扫清障碍和实际完成工作是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 太好了。必要时我会支持你，但你要记住，我们需要那两个狂热分子与我通力合作，才能说服管家走上楼梯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are confounding. Utterly and maddeningly perplexing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是令人费解，完全令人困惑，简直让人抓狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have nothing left to do but throw up my hands and walk away, lest I pull out my hair in frustration.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我除了表示愤怒、转身离开之外别无他法，否则我真要气得抓狂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. And do not think I have forgotten our arrangement. I promised you that I would clean up this mess for you, and I shall. As you predicted, you needed it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很好。别以为我忘了我们的交易。我答应过你我会帮你收拾残局，我一定会做到。正如你所料，你确实需要帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好的。我会尽我所能帮你收拾残局。但你要明白，我的能力有限。扫清障碍和实际完成工作是两回事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well done securing the support of the zealots. Marie and Lyon will be invaluable, as much as I am loath to admit it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 干得漂亮，你成功争取到狂热分子的支持。玛丽和里昂将会发挥至关重要的作用，尽管我不太愿意承认这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack. I recommend treading with caution and doing all you can to ensure you have the support of both zealots when the time comes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他是个顽固的傻子，我们需要协同作战才能对付他。我建议你谨慎行事，尽一切可能确保时机成熟时能得到那两个狂热分子的支持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他是个顽固的傻子，我们需要协同作战才能对付他。我建议你谨慎行事，尽一切可能确保时机成熟时能得到那两个狂热分子的支持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I have nothing left to do but throw up my hands and walk away, lest I pull out my hair in frustration.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我除了表示愤怒、转身离开之外别无他法，否则我真要气得抓狂了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I shall clear the way and ensure that all shall fall neatly into place. Expect conversations with the zealots in the next few days. Ah. And remember?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我会扫清障碍，确保一切井然有序。预计未来几天会跟那些狂热分子对话。啊，还记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In the meanwhile, I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在此期间，我建议大家保持耐心。时机成熟时，我们会再次讨论这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may have the support of Marie already, and while Lyon is therefore likely to follow suit, be careful. And furthermore, this will take time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你或许已经得到了玛丽的支持，里昂也很有可能跟着加入，但务必谨慎。此外，这需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You may have the support of Lyon already, but Marie will require more careful navigation, I fear. And furthermore, this will take time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你或许已经得到了里昂的支持，玛丽也很有可能跟着加入，但务必谨慎。此外，这需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Furthermore, this will take time.

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Furthermore, this will take time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 此外，这需要时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You owe the devil a debt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你欠恶魔一笔债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I counsel patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time. So in the meanwhile?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我建议大家耐心等待。时机成熟时，我们会再次讨论这个问题。那么，在此期间呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I counsel patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time. So in the meanwhile?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我建议大家耐心等待。时机成熟时，我们会再次讨论这个问题。那么，在此期间呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do your best not to bungle it up with Lyon. Though I suppose if you do, we all know how you will solve it, don't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽量别把里昂的事搞砸了。不过我想，万一搞砸了，我们都知道你会怎么解决，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do your best not to bungle it up with Marie. Though I suppose if you do, we all know how you will solve it, don't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽量别把玛丽的事搞砸了。不过我想，万一搞砸了，我们都知道你会怎么解决，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do your best not to bungle it up with the other two. Though I suppose if you do, we all know how you will solve it, don't we?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽量别把他俩的事搞砸了。不过我想，万一搞砸了，我们都知道你会怎么解决，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do your best not to bungle it up with Marie, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽量别把玛丽的事搞砸了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do your best not to bungle it up with Lyon, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽量别把里昂的事搞砸了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do your best not to bungle it up with the other two, yes?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽量别把这两个人的事搞砸了，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It is time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是时候了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. But it is the scrawny butler that should be worried about what the day holds, not you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。不过，真正应该担心今天会发生什么事的，是那个瘦弱的管家，而不是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. But it is the scrawny butler that should be worried about what the day holds, not you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。不过，真正应该担心今天会发生什么事的，是那个瘦弱的管家，而不是你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. But no, there is nothing foreboding in it, I fear. But I do have a confession to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。但恐怕并没有什么不祥之兆。不过，我确实有件事要坦白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. No, sadly we are without any threats today. However, I do have a confession to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。可惜的是，我们今天没有任何威胁。不过，我确实有件事要坦白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. But no, there is nothing foreboding in it, I fear. A simple admission that I am overdue in thanking you for all your help, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。不过，恐怕没什么不祥之兆。我只是想表达一下，亲爱的，我早就该好好感谢你一直以来的帮助了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. No, sadly we are without any threats today. You are simply receiving an admission of my gratitude for all your help, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。不，可惜的是，今天我们没有任何威胁。亲爱的，我只是在表达我对你所有帮助的感激之情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. But no, there is nothing foreboding in it, I fear. A simple admission that I am overdue in thanking you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。不过，恐怕没什么不祥之兆。我只是想表达一下，我早就该好好感谢你了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ha! Well, it is a terribly ominous statement, I admit. No, sadly we are without any threats today. You are simply receiving an admission of my gratitude.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 哈！好吧，我承认，这话听起来确实很瘆人。不，可惜的是，今天我们没有任何威胁。我只是在表达我对你的感激之情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You spoke of your love for me, not long ago. I must ask... does this still stand true? I want to give you the opportunity to have changed your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不久前，你还说你爱我。我必须问……这份爱意现在还不变吗？我想给你一个改变主意的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You spoke of your love for me, not long ago. I must ask... does this still stand true? I want to give you the opportunity to have changed your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不久前，你还说你爱我。我必须问……这份爱意现在还不变吗？我想给你一个改变主意的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I would be remiss if I did not take a moment to say, before we go too far forward with the whole butler matter, that I admit I have a confession to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，在我们继续推进管家这件事之前，我若不先承认自己有件事必须坦白，那就未免失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I would be remiss if I did not take a moment to say, before we go too far forward with the whole butler matter, that I admit I have a confession to make.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，在我们继续推进管家这件事之前，我若不先承认自己有件事必须坦白，那就未免失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though if you are also looking for thanks in helping me retrieve my memories and reconciling them, consider me entirely brimming with commendations for you for your assistance, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，关于你帮助我找回并接受记忆的事，如果你想要我的道谢，那么亲爱的，我对你的帮助感激不尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I would be remiss if I did not also thank you for both retrieving my memories and assisting me in reconciling them, darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，亲爱的，如果我不感谢你帮我找回记忆并帮助我接受这些记忆，那就太失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though if you are also looking for thanks in helping me retrieve my memories and reconciling them, consider me entirely brimming with commendations for you for your assistance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，关于你帮助我找回并接受记忆的事，如果你想要我的道谢，那么，我对你的帮助感激不尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Though I would be remiss if I did not also thank you for both retrieving my memories and assisting me in reconciling them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过，如果我不感谢你帮我找回记忆并帮助我接受这些记忆，那就太失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly before I go and make a fool of myself. Not that you have not already seen the worst of me as of late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是我还没出丑之前。当然，最近你也已经见识过我最糟糕的一面了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly in light of the fact that you have convinced me to embrace my past and ignore all that which others say of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是考虑到你已经说服我接受我的过去，并忽略别人对我的所有评价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Suddenly I am the one with the overwhelming sensation of dread. You do have a knack for turning the tables unexpectedly, my dear. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 突然间，我感到一阵强烈的恐惧。亲爱的，你真有本事，总能出人意料地扭转局面。到底是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: With me. Yes. Companions. I am not used to such a thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在一起。是的。同伴。我不习惯这样的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Suddenly I am the one with the overwhelming sensation of dread. Careful, my dear. You play a dangerous game. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 突然间，我感到一阵强烈的恐惧。小心点，亲爱的。你在玩火。是什么把戏？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I enjoy making them! That is why we get along so very well. And that is precisely what I am here to say in short.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而且我很喜欢威胁人！这就是我们相处得如此融洽的原因。简而言之，这就是我今天想说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Friends. Yes. I suppose that is what we are now, isn't it? What an odd thought.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 朋友。是的。我想我们现在就是朋友了，不是吗？真是个奇怪的想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For assisting me in both retrieving my memories and assisting me in reconciling them, of course. What else? It is not as though you have been bustling about folding my laundry.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，是你帮助我找回记忆，也帮助我接受这些记忆。还有什么呢？你又不是一直在忙着叠我的衣服。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Must you make me spell it out? Very well. But do not expect me to be effusive with plaudits. You are praised well enough by others. You needn't have more of it from me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 非得我解释清楚吗？好吧。不过别指望我会对你赞不绝口。别人已经夸得够多了，我没必要再多说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And I enjoy making them! That is why we get along so very well. And that is precisely what I am here to say in short.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而且我很喜欢威胁人！这就是我们相处得如此融洽的原因。简而言之，这就是我今天想说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You spoke of your love for me, not long ago. I must ask... does this still stand true? I want to give you the opportunity to have changed your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不久前，你还说你爱我。我必须问……这份爱意现在还不变吗？我想给你一个改变主意的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You spoke of your love for me, not long ago. I must ask... does this still stand true? I want to give you the opportunity to have changed your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不久前，你还说你爱我。我必须问……这份爱意现在还不变吗？我想给你一个改变主意的机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This Devil is not accustomed to having "companions."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恶魔不习惯有"同伴"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider me entirely brimming with commendations for you for your assistance in both retrieving my memories and assisting me in reconciling them, and let us move on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我由衷地感谢你帮助我找回记忆并帮助我接受这些记忆，让我们继续前进吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This Devil is not accustomed to such a thing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恶魔不习惯有这种东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not needlessly seek praise, Drifter. It is unbecoming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，别无谓地寻求表扬，这有失身份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider me entirely brimming with commendations for you for your assistance in both retrieving my memories and assisting me in reconciling them, and let us move on.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我由衷地感谢你帮助我找回记忆并帮助我接受这些记忆，让我们继续前进吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly before I go and make a fool of myself. Not that you have not already seen the worst of me as of late.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是我还没出丑之前。当然，最近你也已经见识过我最糟糕的一面了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Particularly in light of the fact that you have convinced me to embrace my past and ignore all that which others say of me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尤其是考虑到你已经说服我接受我的过去，并忽略别人对我的所有评价。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Suddenly I am the one with the overwhelming sensation of dread. You do have a knack for turning the tables unexpectedly, my dear. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 突然间，我感到一阵强烈的恐惧。亲爱的，你真有本事，总能出人意料地扭转局面。到底是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, you are likely right not to tarry with pleasantries. On to the next thing. We have much work to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是​的，​你​说​的​没错，​不​该​在​客套话​上​浪费​时间。​我们​直接​进入​正题​吧，​还​有​很多​事情​要​做。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Suddenly I am the one with the overwhelming sensation of dread. You do have a knack for turning the tables unexpectedly, my dear. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 突然间，我感到一阵强烈的恐惧。亲爱的，你真有本事，总能出人意料地扭转局面。到底是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are right not to tarry with pleasantries. On to the next thing. We have much work to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: ​你​说​的​没错，​不​该​在​客套话​上​浪费​时间。​我们​直接​进入​正题​吧，​还​有​很多​事情​要​做。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are a dangerous creature to call yourself friends with the Devil. But I would be glad to call you one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟敢自称是恶魔的朋友，真是个危险的家伙。但我很乐意称你为恶魔的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, you are likely right not to tarry with pleasantries. On to the next thing. We have much work to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是​的，​你​说​的​没错，​不​该​在​客套话​上​浪费​时间。​我们​直接​进入​正题​吧，​还​有​很多​事情​要​做。​

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Friends. Yes. I suppose that is what we are now, isn't it? What an odd thought. I admit I am not accustomed to having them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 朋友。是的。我想我们现在就是朋友了，不是吗？真是个奇怪的想法。我承认我不习惯有朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not pretend that this does not wound me particularly deep. It seems a fall from a greater height does indeed hurt more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会假装这件事没有深深地刺痛我。看来从更高的地方摔下来确实更疼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know what to say. I am, for once, without words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该说什么。我，破天荒地，竟无言以对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am agog... stunned. And without words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我惊呆了……震惊了。说不出话来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are worse than Bird Three sometimes, I swear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我发誓，有时候你比鸟三还糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But what I do with who I am? And what change I am capable of? That is a new road to walk. And I have you to thank for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我该如何面对真实的自己？我又能做出怎样的改变？这是一条全新的道路。而这一切，都要感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are worse than Bird Three, I swear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我发誓，你比鸟三还糟糕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must be joking. Darling, are you drunk? You have convinced me to embrace my past and ignore all that which others say of me, and now you tell me you love me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你一定是在开玩笑吧。亲爱的，你喝醉了吗？你让我接受我的过去，无视别人对我的所有评价，现在你又告诉我你爱我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Just imagine what we could do together, you and I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一想到你和我能一起做的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And by "we" I mean "me."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这里的"我们"指的是"我"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And by "we" I mean "me."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这里的"我们"指的是"我"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But, there is no time to dwell on pleasantries I am afraid. We have much work to do. And by "we" I mean "me."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恐怕没有时间闲聊了。我们还有很多工作要做。这里的"我们"指的是"我"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I fear I cannot continue this one-sided farce. I hope you understand.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恐怕我无法继续这场单方面的闹剧了。希望你能理解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Save for these:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住这些话：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you well? You must not be well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？你肯定是生病了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Origin System would fall before us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 始源星系会在我们面前覆灭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know, short of remaining here. And this excites me more than I can put into words. My next chapter remains unwritten.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 除了留在这里，我不知道还能做什么。这种感觉让我无比激动，难以言表。我的下一篇章，尚未书写。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Yes, I think so. I have a new quarry and a new mission in life, but I am still myself. I am still Roathe. And my deeds are still my own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是的，我想我会这样。我有了新的目标和新的使命，但我还是我自己。我还是罗瑟。我的行为依然由我掌控。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就这些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Do not needlessly seek favors, Drifter. It is unbecoming.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者，别无谓地寻求好处，这有失身份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You are a dangerous creature to call yourself friends with the Devil. But I would be glad to call you one.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你竟敢自称是恶魔的朋友，真是个危险的家伙。但我很乐意称你为恶魔的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I will not pretend that this does not wound me particularly deep. It seems a fall from a greater height does indeed hurt more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会假装这件事没有深深地刺痛我。看来从更高的地方摔下来确实更疼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know what to say. I am, for once, without words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该说什么。我，破天荒地，竟无言以对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am agog... stunned. And without words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我惊呆了……震惊了。说不出话来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must be joking. Darling, are you drunk? You have convinced me to embrace my past and ignore all that which others say of me, and now you tell me you love me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你一定是在开玩笑吧。亲爱的，你喝醉了吗？你让我接受我的过去，无视别人对我的所有评价，现在你又告诉我你爱我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But what I do with who I am? And what change I am capable of? That is a new road to walk. And I have you to thank for that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我该如何面对真实的自己？我又能做出怎样的改变？这是一条全新的道路。而这一切，都要感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I cannot continue this farce. With you or the butler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我无法继续这场闹剧了。无论是和你，还是和管家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Save for these:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住这些话：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you well? You must not be well.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你还好吗？你肯定是生病了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not going to hurt him, darling! I am merely going to use my words, I swear it. Though from the way I am certain he will tell it, it will be the worst of abuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我不会伤害他！我只会用言语表达，我发誓。虽然​我​知道​他​跟​你​说​的​时候，​这​会​是​对​他​最​恶毒​的​辱骂​。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expect the butler will be cross once I am done convincing him. You will be the first to know, I am sure. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我估计等我说服他之后，管家会很生气。我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not going to hurt him! I am merely going to use my words, I swear it. Though from the way I am certain he will tell it, it will be the worst of abuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会伤害他！我只会用言语表达，我发誓。虽然我知道他会那样说，但我预感这会是对他最恶毒的辱骂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expect the butler will be cross once I am done convincing him. You will be the first to know, I am sure. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我估计等我说服他之后，管家会很生气。我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In a way I think I have never loved another in all my years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从某种意义上说，我觉得这么多年来我从未真正爱过别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They will linger as they always do. I am still myself. I am still Roathe. You did not magically wipe away all thoughts of doubt in my head with a simple conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 跟往常一样，那些后悔还是会挥之不去。我还是我自己。我还是罗瑟。你不可能通过一次简单的谈话就神奇地抹去我脑海中所有的疑虑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know, short of remaining here. And this excites me more than I can put into words. My next chapter remains unwritten.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 除了留在这里，我不知道还能做什么。这种感觉让我无比激动，难以言表。我的下一篇章，尚未书写。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain you will be the first to know. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is going to be quite the spectacle either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，这场面肯定很精彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain you will be the first to know. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is going to be quite the spectacle either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，这场面肯定很精彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now... let us invent some new sins together.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在……让我们一起来创造一些新的罪行吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I have a sense of self I have not felt in ages. A surety that I have not known perhaps in my entire life. And that I can thank you for.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我找回了久违的自我认同感，一种或许是我一生中从未感受过的确定感。而这一切，我都要感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In a way I think I have never loved another in all my years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从某种意义上说，我觉得这么多年来我从未真正爱过别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Just imagine what we could do together, you and I...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 想到你和我能一起做的事……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am quite desperate to stand from this desk and rush off to invent new sins together but I am reminded that in war, the battle must come first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我非常想离开这张桌子，冲出去和你一起发明新的罪恶，但我提醒自己，在战争中，战斗必须先于一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Origin System would fall before us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 始源星系会在我们面前覆灭。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And there is a battle before us. We must finish this matter with the butler. Then I can ravish and adore you to my heart's content.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 摆在我们面前的还有一场战斗。我们必须先解决掉管家这件事。之后，我才能尽情地宠爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ahem. I am sorry. Where were we? Loid. Yes. Loid. The butler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 咳。抱歉。我们刚才说到哪儿了？洛德。是的。洛德。那个管家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expect the butler will be cross once I am done convincing him. You will be the first to know, I am sure, my love. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我估计等我说服他之后，管家会很生气。亲爱的，我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not going to hurt him, my love! I am merely going to use my words, I swear it. Though from the way I am certain he will tell it, it will be the worst of abuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的，我不会伤害他！我只会用言语表达，我发誓。虽然我知道他会那样说，但我预感这会是对他最恶毒的辱骂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is going to be quite the spectacle either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，这场面肯定很精彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain you will be the first to know. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know what to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am, for once, without words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我此刻竟无言以对。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Save for these:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住这些话：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In a way I think I have never loved another in all my years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从某种意义上说，我觉得这么多年来我从未真正爱过别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I. I am desperate to stand from this desk and rush off to invent new sins together but I am reminded that in war, the battle must come first.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我。我现在非常想离开这张桌子，冲出去和你一起发明新的罪恶，但我提醒自己，在战争中，战斗必须先于一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not know what to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不知道该说什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am, for once, without words.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一次，我，无话可说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Save for these:
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 记住这些话：

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I love you.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In a way I think I have never loved another in all my years.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从某种意义上说，我觉得这么多年来我从未真正爱过别人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain you will be the first to know. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not going to hurt him! I am merely going to use my words, I swear it. Though from the way I am certain he will tell it, it will be the worst of abuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会伤害他！我只会用言语表达，我发誓。虽然我知道他会那样说，但我预感这会是对他最恶毒的辱骂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is going to be quite the spectacle either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，这场面肯定很精彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ah. Yes. Before I get too... distracted. I did want to tell you that I have not forgotten about how much work we have left to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 啊，对了。在我跑题之前，我想告诉你，我并没有忘记我们还有多少事要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And by "we" I mean "me." The butler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而我所说的"我们"指的是"我"。还有管家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in traversing through the poor priest's tales of woe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保你能顺利听完那位可怜神父的悲惨故事？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in convincing Marie that Albrecht was not as infallible as she believed him to be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保你能说服玛丽，让她相信阿尔布雷希特并非像她认为的那样完美无缺。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering Lyon's affection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保你能赢得里昂的喜爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering Marie's affection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保你能赢得玛丽的喜爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter darling. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，亲爱的漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保你能赢得我的喜爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you content with how you left things with him? Or would you like me to prod him into another conversation with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对你们之间目前的状况满意吗？还是你想让我促成你们再次交谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Are you content with how you left things with her? Or would you like me to prod her into another conversation with you?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你对你们之间目前的状况满意吗？还是你想让我促成你们再次交谈？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保那个瘦弱的管家无论如何都会上楼。
