/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保那个瘦弱的管家无论如何都会上楼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Greetings, Drifter. I have come to settle our contract. You struck a bargain with me to ensure that the scrawny butler would go upstairs, one way or another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你好，漂泊者。我是来履行我们之间的约定的。你和我达成了协议，确保那个瘦弱的管家无论如何都会上楼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey: Lyon. (Though I honestly do not know how you managed it.) No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所预料的那样，你把自己逼到了绝境，而你的猎物正是里昂。（老实说，我真不知道你是怎么做到的）不是吗？没关系。按照我们的约定，恶魔会来救你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey: Marie. Haven't you? No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所预料的那样，你把自己逼到了绝境，而你的猎物正是玛丽。不是吗？没关系。按照我们的约定，恶魔会来救你。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Which you correctly predicted you would need. As you have been quite the belligerent pain in my arse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也预料得没错。因为你一直让我很头疼，而且又烦人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It seems Lyon is the remaining holdout.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来里昂是唯一一个仍然坚持己见的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It seems Marie is the remaining holdout.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来玛丽是唯一一个仍然坚持己见的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have managed to bungle it up with both myself and Lyon. Fantastic. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你居然把我跟里昂的事都搞砸了。真是太棒了。不过，我可以保证我会配合你，尽管我可能不太情愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You have managed to bungle it up with both myself and Marie. Fantastic. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你居然把我跟玛丽的事都搞砸了。真是太棒了。不过，我可以保证我会配合你，尽管我可能不太情愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How have you managed to bungle it with the both of them?! Very well. No point in whining about it now, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你怎么能把他们俩的事都搞砸了？！好吧，现在抱怨也没用了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It seems you have entirely botched it, haven't you? My oh my, this is quite laughable. Well, I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来你彻底搞砸了，是吧？我的天哪，这真是太可笑了。不过，我可以保证我会配合你，尽管我可能不太情愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 祝你好运。你只有这一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 祝你好运。你只有这一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is only so much strong-arming I can do in this regard. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在这方面能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: There is only so much strong-arming I can do in this regard. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在这方面能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with the other two. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我对另外两个人能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。你要明白，我的能力也有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先，这个交易不是我发起的！如果你现在想反悔，要知道，无论我有没有履行了我的义务，我都会期望你将来履行你的义务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not the one who made the contract in the first place! And if you are considering backing out of it now, know that I will still expect you to hold up your end in the future, regardless of if I complete mine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 首先，这个交易不是我发起的！如果你现在想反悔，要知道，无论我有没有履行了我的义务，我都会期望你将来履行你的义务。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Contractually I am required to forgive you, but it says nothing about leaving your face attached to your skull. So I would counsel that you watch your words as we go forward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从交易上讲，我必须原谅你，但交易里可没说要你保住自己的脸。所以我劝你以后说话注意点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Contractually I am required to forgive you, so I am not certain why you are bothering to apologize, but I appreciate it regardless.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 根据交易，我必须原谅你，所以我不太明白你为什么要道歉，但无论如何，我都很感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am well aware.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 祝你好运。你和他只有这一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 祝你好运。你和她只有这一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们得一个一个地来。先从两人中比较理性的那位开始吧，也就是神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事情就这么定了。我会尽力促成你们之间进展。但之后，最终能否成事，得看你自己了。我不可能全程牵着你们的手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you might as well collect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你最好还是收取你的那一份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it done. I shall see what I can do to quicken matters betwixt you. But after that, it is up to you to seal the deal, as it were. I cannot hold your hands the entire way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事情就这么定了。我会尽力促成你们之间进展。但之后，最终能否成事，得看你自己了。我不可能全程牵着你们的手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you might as well collect.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你最好还是收取你的那一份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But as you wish, we will... hurry this along. I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但如你所愿，我们会……加快进度。如果我不问问你是否仍然希望继续推进此事，那就太失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Lyon. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在里昂的事情上能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with Marie. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在玛丽的事情上能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But there is only so much strong-arming I can do with the other two. Understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但我对另外两个人能采取的强制手段毕竟有限。你要明白，我的能力也有限。扫清障碍和完成工作是两码事。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，其实我也可以这么做。但这完全是另一个话题了。你只需要记住，恶魔总会收到他应得的债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well. I could. But that is an entirely different conversation. Simply remember that the devil always collects his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 嗯，其实我也可以这么做。但这完全是另一个话题了。你只需要记住，恶魔总会收到他应得的债。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As I was saying, any other individual with a less pursuivant view on life might find your own... entrepreneurial behavior in a less than favorable light.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如我刚才所说，换个没这么听天由命的人来看，你这种的投机行为恐怕不光彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 祝你好运。你只有这一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I wish you the best of luck. You will only have this one attempt.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 祝你好运。你只有这一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们得一个一个地来。先从两人中比较理性的那位开始吧，也就是神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But I find myself rather amused by your decision to bargain with me for my own affections. So, here we are. But I would be remiss if I did not ask if this is something you still wished to move forward with?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过你为了得到我的好感而来和我谈条件这件事，这着实让我感到好笑。所以，所以我们才会走到现在。如果我不问问你是否仍然希望继续推进此事，那就太失职了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，"什么"远不如"谁"重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不知道你有多强大吗？不知道把你掌控在我身边有多么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The "what" is not nearly as important as the "who," Usurper.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 篡位者，"什么"远不如"谁"重要。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You do realize how powerful you are, yes? And how important having you in my pocket could be?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你难道不知道你有多强大吗？不知道把你掌控在我身边有多么重要吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Come speak to me if you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是个古怪的小家伙。如果你改变主意，就来跟我谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我猜这就是以前所谓的"空白支票"吧？而且你是心甘情愿地签的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You still owe me my end of the contract, whether or not you wish me to make good upon your end of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论你是否希望我履行你的交易义务，你欠我的那一半仍然必须兑现。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And the devil will always collect his due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 恶魔总会得到他应得的那份。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a mad priest to annoy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠他债的朋友的恶魔。好了，恕我失陪了？我得去烦一下那个疯神父。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The only thing more dangerous than a devil... is a devil with friends like you who owe him. Now, if you'll excuse me? I have a floating "Sister of Sol" to annoy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 唯一比恶魔更可怕的……就是有你这种欠他债的朋友的恶魔。好了，恕我失陪了？我得去烦一下那个漂浮的"太阳神​修女"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What a remarkably odd little creature you are. Delicious, but odd, Drifter darling.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你真是个古怪的小家伙。美味可口，但又有点怪异，亲爱的漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I must ask, however. Why? Why make such an outrageous deal? Are you so curious to taste Orokin flesh after so many centuries?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不过我必须问一下，为什么？为什么要达成这么荒谬的交易？难道过了这么多年，你还这么好奇想玩玩奥罗金人的肉体吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain there is a degree of something unfeigned to what you say. Or at the very least, I believe you do not know your own self-delusion.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我确信你所说的话中有些许真诚之处。或者至少，我相信你没有意识到自己一直在自欺欺人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Excuse me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你说什么？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I believe the greatest achievement of the Orokin Empire was its ability to convince those within it to believe their own conceits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我认为奥罗金帝国最大的成就是它能够让其境内的人们相信他们自己的幻想。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Honesty is a wonderful thing, Drifter dear. Do you think I would shame you for enjoying yourself? Hardly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 亲爱的漂泊者，诚实是件好事。你觉得我会让你因为享受生活而感到羞耻吗？当然不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Surely you jest?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不是，你肯定是在开玩笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In fact, perhaps that is the true connective tissue of the human race: our masterful ability to look in the mirror and deceive ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事实上，这或许才是人类真正的共同点：我们拥有高超的自欺欺人能力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Here is to a relationship of mutual satisfaction.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 希望双方都能建立互惠互利的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But why make such an arrangement, unless...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但为什么要做这样的交易呢？除非……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All in the name of avoiding the terrible shame of admitting when we need to change.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这一切都是为了避免承认自己需要改变时那种可怕的羞耻感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not that I would know anything about the topic.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我在这方面可是一无所知。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am a bit of an expert on the subject, as you well know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 正如你所知，我对这个领域略有研究。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You signed your soul away to the devil himself because... he unknowingly already held your broken heart.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你把灵魂出卖给了恶魔，因为……他不知不觉中已经拥有了你破碎的心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Drifter... my poor, sweet, Drifter...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 漂泊者……我可怜的、可爱的漂泊者……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive me. Please, forgive me. I did not know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅我。请原谅我。我当时并不知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You must also understand that, until now, my love was a commodity that no one had sought to claim. Not in any meaningful way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你也必须明白，直到现在，我的爱一直是一种无人想要占有的东西。至少没有人真正想要占有它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So you seemed willing to sell your soul for a single bit of salvage. You can imagine my confusion. How baffled I was.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 所以你似乎愿意为了区区一点残骸出卖灵魂。你可以想象我当时的困惑。我真是百思不得其解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now? Now that I know the truth? Drifter, my Drifter... I could not be more glad that you did.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在？现在我知道了真相？漂泊者，我的漂泊者……我无比庆幸你这么做了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The future awaits us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 未来在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For together, what we are capable of boggles the mind, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们齐心协力所能取得的成就，简直令人难以置信，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For I cannot wait to see what we might together wreak upon this Origin System... and countless others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我迫不及待地想看看我们能一起给这个始源星系……以及无数其他星系带来怎样的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It seems I am the only remaining holdout? Well, that makes things simple enough. I can ensure that you have my cooperation, as reticent as it may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 看来我是唯一一个还不肯妥协的人？那事情就简单多了。我可以保证我会配合你，尽管我有些不太情愿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Consider it done.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 事情就这么定了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Well, I hate to inform you, that while I am perfectly comfortable "sharing," the zealots... are very likely not. I recommend sorting out your current situation before pursuing ours any further.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 很遗憾地告诉你，虽然我很乐意"分享"，但那些狂热分子……很可能不愿意。我建议你先理顺自己目前的情况，再考虑我们之间的关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Believe me, no one is more disappointed than I.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 相信我，没有人比我更失望。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nary a moment to breathe, eh? Yes, you are right, of course. We have much work to do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 连喘口气的时间都没有，对吧？没错，你说得对。我们还有很多事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And by "we" I mean "me."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这里的"我们"指的是"我"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am not going to hurt him! I am merely going to use my words, I swear it. Though from the way I am certain he will tell it, it will be the worst of abuses.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我不会伤害他！我只会用言语表达，我发誓。虽然我知道他会那样说，但我预感这会是对他最恶毒的辱骂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I am certain you will be the first to know. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I expect the butler will be cross once I am done convincing him. You will be the first to know, I am sure. He will be unable to contain his whinging.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我估计等我说服他之后，管家会很生气。我敢肯定你会是第一个知道的。他肯定会忍不住抱怨个不停。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This is going to be quite the spectacle either way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不管怎样，这场面肯定很精彩。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Enough! Enough. I relent! Call off your attack zealots. They are worse than rabid kubrodons! Blasted creatures follow me everywhere I go. I cannot even get any sleep!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 够了！够了！我认输了！别让狂热分子来弄我了！他们比疯库狛顿还可怕！这些该死的家伙，我走到哪儿他们就跟到哪。我连觉都没法睡！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: What?! What is it you want?!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 是什么？！你想要什么？！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is why you convinced them to bother me day and night? For that? One last ditch effort to convince me to listen to your pathetic argument?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这就是你唆使他们日夜骚扰我的原因？就为了这个？想做最后的挣扎，让我听听你那可笑的论点？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Your failure is pathetic. Not once over but twice, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你的失败真是可悲。而且不是一次，而是两次。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I do not recommend running for public office.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我觉得你最好不要去竞选公职。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A retreat to win the war. Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 以退为进。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Forgive myself for what I have done? And move forward into the future? Hm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 原谅自己所做的一切？然后继续向前走？嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am... slightly dubious of your reframing of your events as a tactical retreat, I admit I am... in favor of it, all the same, Drifter dear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我对……你将这件事重新定义为战术性撤退的说法略有怀疑，但我承认，我仍然赞同这种说法，亲爱的漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: While I am slightly dubious of your reframing of the situation, I am... too tempted by this new future and what it might mean for me to resist it, Drifter dear.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然我对你重新解读局势的方式略有怀疑，但我……太渴望这个新的未来以及它可能带给我的意义，以至于无法抗拒，亲爱的漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Late as it may be, it has... been effective, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。虽然来得有点晚，但它确实有效。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: This "new lease" on my life. Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Late as it may be, it has... been effective, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这简直是我人生的"新生"。好吧。我承认也接受你的观点。虽然来得有点晚，但它确实有效。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I appreciate it. More than you might know.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我很感激。比你想象的还要感激。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Now, I believe we may move onto our next battle in the war, yes? The butler.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 现在，我想我们可以进入战争的下一个阶段了，对吧？那就是管家。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I, for one, cannot wait.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我本人已经迫不及待了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Expansion to new horizons was our only option now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如今，向新的领域扩张是我们唯一的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: It was Scarne, testy, cerebral and acerbic, who had first mooted the Plan back in the days before the War. "We must fly the nest, for the nest is on fire."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：早在战前，脾气暴躁、思维缜密、言辞尖刻的斯卡恩就率先提出了这个计划。"我们必须离开巢穴，因为巢穴已经着火了。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Through over-exploitation and reckless experiment, we had fouled the System beyond hope of regeneration.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 由于过度开发和鲁莽的实验，我们已将星系破坏殆尽，使其无法再生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The dread of a Sentient return was so strong in him that he could only imagine retreat to islands within the Void-sea.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他心中对 Sentient 回归的恐惧是如此强烈，以至于他只能想象退守到虚空之海中的岛屿。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: PUNISHMENT
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：惩罚

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How little credit we gave the Sentients for courage.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们是多么低估了 Sentient 的勇气啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They willingly endured the Void's scalding fire purely for the chance to punish us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们甘愿承受虚空的灼热烈焰，仅仅是为了有机会惩罚我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He, too, inaugurated the cowardly Towers in the Void.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他也参与了虚空中那些懦弱之塔的落成典礼。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I found myself petitioned for opinions. As strategist, I was expected to comprehend the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 结果大家都来找我征求意见。作为战略家，我必须了解敌人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: DIVISION
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：分开

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We had no word from our people stranded in Tau, and no way to know whether their signals were being jammed or they had been entirely obliterated.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们与被困在 Tau 的同胞没有任何联系，也无法得知他们的信号是被干扰了还是彻底中断了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Sentients could have destroyed the Solar Rail Terminus above Tau at any time, yet the Rail was still active.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Sentient 随时都可能摧毁 Tau 星球上空的星际航道终点站，然而轨道还在运行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: After the first Sentient invasion of the System and the disastrous Orokin riposte, a curious silence reigned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：在 Sentient 首次入侵星系以及 Orokin 的灾难性反击之后，一片奇异的寂静笼罩着一切。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Why? What did they gain from leaving the gate open?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为什么？他们敞开大门能得到什么好处？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Were they united in their aggression, or did some yet hope for peaceful coexistence?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们是团结一致地采取侵略行动，还是其中仍有人抱有和平共处的希望？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As one, the Seven bade me become a Devil with a trident of warheads, a sower with a satchel of rampant radiation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 七人众合谋，命令我化身为手持三叉戟的恶魔，成为狂暴辐射的播种者。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How had we tamed the Infestation in our ancestors' time? Rip open the atom's heart like a rosebud, of course!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们的祖先是如何驯服 Infestation 的？当然是像撕开玫瑰花蕾一样撕开原子的核心！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Monstrosity and excess had served us admirably in the past. I was expected to apply them as war-tactics.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：过去，残暴和放纵曾为我们带来辉煌的战果。我被要求将它们运用到战争策略中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That was the day we learned the Sentients were not only capable of nullifying our technology, but also of commandeering it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就在那天，我们得知，Sentient 不仅能够摧毁我们的科技，还能将其据为己用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The flock of wicked little leveller-drones we sent out came winging merrily back to us still heavy with bombs, chortling in unknown syllables, detonating in the midst of the very motherships that dispatched them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们派出的那群邪恶低等无人机欢快地飞回我们身边，身上还带着沉重的炸弹，发出不知名的音节，在派遣它们的母舰中间爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: FIRE
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：火

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Many refused the data outright and deemed them errors, or lies, or Cephalon conspiracies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 许多人断然拒绝接受真实数据，认为它们是错误、是谎言，或是中枢的阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: The losses were absurd.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：损失惨重，令人难以置信。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: LOSS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：战败

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Raised and glutted on Orokin subterfuge, it was easy for them to reject the truth now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们从小就对奥罗金人的诡计耳濡目染，如今轻易地拒绝接受真相。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: From that moment forth, they lived in a fantasy engineered for their comfort.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 从那一刻起，他们便活在一个为他们精心编织的幻想世界里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We were winning; the Sentients were in retreat; all who thought otherwise were traitors.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们胜利在望；Sentient 节节败退；所有持相反观点的人都是叛徒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And how long before those worm-ships were themselves replaced by some new monstrosity?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而那些蠕虫状的飞船，又会多久被某种新的怪物所取代？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was insanity. How could I strategize around the behaviour of Sentient crab-ships, when no sooner had my tactics been perfected than the crab-ships were replaced by worm-ships?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这简直是疯了。我刚完善了针对 Sentient 的螃蟹飞船的战术，螃蟹飞船就被蠕虫飞船取代了，我该如何制定应对策略呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Many of the Sentients evolved between encounters, so we could never be sure that we would face the same foe twice. But others remained in consistent form, as if they had reached some plateau long ago.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：许多 Sentient 在每次遭遇战之间都会进化，所以我们永远无法确定下一次面对的还是不是同一种敌人。但也有一些 Sentient 保持着稳定的形态，仿佛它们很久以前就达到了某种巅峰状态。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: ADAPTATION
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：适应性

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Perfected killers, they brought the same cold horror that a shark does.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们是完美的杀手，带来的冷酷恐怖与鲨鱼如出一辙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All we could do was go backward. Progress had been fatal. Old traditions, time-hallowed paths of honor and discipline, were owed their due.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们所能做的只有倒退。先进科技反而是致命的。古老的传统，那些历经岁月洗礼的荣誉与纪律之路，理应得到应有的尊重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Alone, in private, I turned that weapon on myself. Oh, how I bled.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 独自一人时，我私下里用这把武器刺向了自己。哦，我流了多少血啊。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: I was effortlessly expert with many of our weapons, but I excelled in the use of one: the lie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：我精通我们许多武器，但我最擅长的是这一种：谎言。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: LIES
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：谎言

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I brandished it most often against my own troops. I whipped them to the bone with lies of duty and discipline.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我最常用它来对付自己的部下。我用关于责任和纪律的谎言把他们鞭笞得筋疲力尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I smothered them with the lie that the war could be won. I pierced them with the lie of my favour, my most esteemed regard for them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我用战争可以取胜的谎言淹没了他们。我用对他们的宠爱和最崇高的敬意的谎言刺穿了他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Rostig. Something wrong in the cloning process, they said. What else could make a Grineer stay at his turret while burning alive? Even a rat understands self-preservation!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗斯蒂格。他们说，是克隆过程出了问题。还有什么能让一个 Grineer 士兵在被活活烧死的情况下还坚守炮塔？就连老鼠都懂得自保！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Traivon. I watched you hurl your Railjack into Praghasa's maw. Distracted, feeding greedily on you and your men, she never noticed my own ship speeding away.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：特雷文。我亲眼看着你驾驶着你的航道星舰冲进了布拉喀萨的巨口。她当时正忙着贪婪地吞噬你和你的部下，根本没注意到我的飞船已经疾驰而去。你为了你的上级献出了生命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: No. Your "defect" placed you above them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 不，是你的"缺陷"反倒让你比他们更优秀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: SACRIFICE
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：牺牲

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I remember your last salute. The fading. Then I blinked open the eyes that had been yours, and saw my gutted corpse dead in the mud.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我记得你最后一次敬礼。那道逐渐消逝的身影。然后我睁开了曾属于你的眼睛，看到自己被开膛破肚的尸体躺在泥泞里。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: You laid down your life for your superior officer. I felt your selflessness like a slap in the face.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你为了你的上级献出了生命。你的无私仿佛一记耳光打在我脸上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Maryna. You gave me your body. Together, in that trench, we drank Kuva. My hands shook and my gashed throat leaked, but I kept enough drops down for it to take.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 玛丽娜，你把你的身体给了我。在那条战壕里，我们一起喝下赤毒。我的手颤抖着，被割破的喉咙鲜血直流，但我还是努力咽下了几滴，让它发挥作用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: At least our defeat shall be beautiful. Memorable.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 至少我们的失败会很壮烈，令人难忘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: But against all expectations, they prevailed. Soon stories of outrageously improbable heroism filtered back from the Front.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但出乎所有人意料的是，他们最终取得了胜利。很快，那些匪夷所思的英雄事迹就从前线传了回来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The war was all but lost; the Sentients were unvanquishable; let us, then, create these strange and surreal warriors and arm them with weapons of ancient pedigree.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 战争已经几乎败了；Sentient 不可战胜；那么，让我们创造这些奇异而超现实的战士，并为他们配备古老血统的武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: At first, the Warframes seemed more of an artistic statement than a legitimate weapon.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：起初，战甲看起来更像是一种艺术表达，而不是一种真正的武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: WARFRAMES
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：战甲

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Warframes had appeared from the sky, angel-like, liberating captives and devastating Sentient strongholds. Even alone they were miracles; in groups, they were gods.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 战甲如同天使般从天而降，解救俘虏，摧毁 Sentient 的据点。即使单独行动，它们也堪称奇迹；成群结队时，它们更是神一般的存在。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Little wonder, then, that they were seen as mere propaganda.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 难怪它们会被视为纯粹的宣传工具。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Or perhaps she thought they would abandon the scorched, polluted remains of the Origin System and leave her to raise a new kingdom of her own.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 或许她以为他们会抛弃始源星系那片焦土和污染的残骸，让她得以建立属于自己的新王国。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: "Peace?"
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录："和平？"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Regardless, peace would not be tolerated. So we set to work to undermine it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 无论如何，和平是无法容忍的。所以我们开始着手破坏和平。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: TREASON
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：叛国

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Her voice was broken glass grinding in my ears.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她的声音如同碎玻璃般刺耳。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Executor Nitokh was displeased. She had expected a glorious escalation, battle after battle, ending in the climactic ecstasy of the Orokin's demise.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 执行者尼托很不高兴。她原本期待的是一场辉煌的升级，一场接一场的战斗，最终以奥罗金人覆灭的狂喜告终。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: After which she would emerge from hiding and… well, there I am left to speculate. Perhaps she expected to be invited into the Sentients' confidence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 之后她便会从藏身处现身……嗯，后面的我只能猜测了。或许她希望能够获得 Sentient 的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ballas was obliged to decide, and earn the scathing enmity of whichever cadre he did not side with.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Ballas 不得不做出抉择，而无论他选择站在哪一边，都将招致另外一群人的强烈仇恨。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I found, to my utter glee, that he was now the rose caught between two thickets of thorns.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 令我欣喜若狂的是，我发现他现在就像一朵被夹在两丛荆棘之间的玫瑰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For reasons I cannot guess, he chose peace; it was four to three, and so the ravening Sentients were suddenly allies and friends.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 出于我无法揣测的原因，他选择了和平；最终票数为四比三，于是，那些曾经的豺狼虎豹 Sentient 突然变成了盟友和朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "One way or another, he shall come around," Nitokh promised, even as I was dispatched to seek out malcontents among the garrisoned Dax.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "无论如何，他都会改变主意的，"尼托承诺道，与此同时，我被派去寻找深藏在禁卫中的不满分子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: DIPLOMACY
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：外交

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Among the Seven Executors, Ballas had styled himself first among equals.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在七人众执行者中，Ballas 自诩为平等者中的第一人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ever the diplomat, ever the honey-voiced persuader, he resolved the grudges and disputes of the others.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他一向擅长外交，总能用甜言蜜语劝服众人，化解其他人之间的怨恨和争端。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The warmonger faction, headed by Nitokh, pulled one way. The pacifists, under Scarne, pulled another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 以尼托为首的主战派朝着一个方向努力，而以斯卡恩为首的主和派则朝着另一个方向努力。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Her madness was seductive because it was obvious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：她的疯狂之所以具有诱惑力，是因为它明目张胆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: All our senses had been glutted to numbness centuries ago. Yet she was still, in her way, fresh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 几个世纪前，我们所有的感官都麻木不仁。然而，她依然以她独特的方式，鲜活如初。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Out Tormis went and back Tormis came, carrying wondrous bejewelled memories of a new System and new worlds to settle.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 托尔米斯出发了，又回来了，带来了对新星系和待殖民新世界的奇妙而珍贵的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Leap in, her eyes said to me, gleaming with the joy of some colossal cosmic joke.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 跳进去吧，她的眼睛闪烁着某种宇宙级玩笑般的喜悦，对我说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: One always knew where one stood with her - right on the precipice of the great abyss.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 你总能清楚地知道自己和她在一起的处境——就在深渊的边缘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Through her demented visions I could escape the long, bleak stagnation of Orokin existence.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 透过她疯狂的幻象，我得以逃离奥罗金人漫长而黯淡的停滞生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Eternal. Limitless in her hunger. She summoned me to her bath one evening. I strode across the mingling puddles of perfumed water and blood and stood dutifully to attention.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 永恒不灭，她的贪婪无止境。一天晚上，她叫我去她浴室。我迈着大步走过香水和鲜血交织的水洼，恭敬地立正站好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "I'm bored, Roathe. Let's kill all the other Orokin and take over."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "罗瑟，我无聊死了。咱们把其他奥罗金人都杀了，然后接管吧。"

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: NITOKH
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：尼托

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Roathe the bloody-handed. Roathe the ogre fattened on the bodies of his men. Spendthrift of lives.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 罗瑟，那个双手沾满鲜血的家伙。罗瑟，那个靠着手下尸体养肥的食人魔。挥霍无度，浪费生命。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: I understood from the start - both on the battlefield and in the bedchamber - the path to victory through seeming submission.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：我从一开始就明白——无论是在战场上还是在闺房里——看似顺从才是取胜之道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: As if I battled only for the battle’s sake! No. The Orokin Empire must end.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们还以为我只是为了打仗而打仗！不。奥罗金帝国必须终结。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Not even Nitokh knew my true heart. She thought I aspired to rule alongside her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就连尼托也不知道我的真实想法。她一直以为我渴望与她一同统治。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: SUBMISSION
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：顺服

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Where the enemy finds you yielding, there you can be sure he will push; and so you may easily trip him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 敌人一旦发现你有所退让，对方就会乘胜追击；而这正是你轻易绊倒对方的绝佳机会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: "Lackey," they called me. "Lapdog." Nitokh thought herself in control. How subtly I guided her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "走狗"，他们叫我"走狗"。尼托自以为一切尽在掌握。其实正是我巧妙地引导了她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: For that to happen, the war must continue. Only defeat, absolute and irrevocable, would topple those seven golden gargoyles.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为了实现这一点，战争必须继续。只有彻底的、不可逆转的失败，才能推翻那七座金色合成兽像。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In that pale, outstretched hand… a syringe. Glittering with freedom… with another chance… with another life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 在那只苍白、伸向我的手中……握着的是一支注射器。它闪耀着自由的光芒……闪耀着另一次机会……闪耀着新生。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Coward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：懦夫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I took it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我接过了它。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: OBLIVION
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：遗忘

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: That is what they called me, isn't it? I've read the history books scattered about this dusty hall. A lie. They did not know the truth. That I was ripped away from my time before I could complete my work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们都这么叫我，不是吗？我读了那些散落在这座布满灰尘的大厅里的历史书。这是谎言。他们不知道真相。我在完成我的工作之前，就被强行从属于我的时代里夺走了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Coward.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 懦夫。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I remember now. He approached me, in the Golden Halls. He wore a face I did not know. But that is not so very unusual for our kind. I knew his voice. I knew the way he moved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我现在想起来了。他在金碧辉煌的大厅里向我走来。他戴着一张我不认识的面具。但这对于我们这类人来说并不算什么稀奇事。我认得他的声音。我认得他的举止。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Coward!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 懦夫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: He asked me a single question. Did I truly believe that I could ever be forgiven for burning it all to ash?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他只问了我一个问题。我真的相信在我把一切都烧成灰烬之后，我能得到宽恕吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: COWARD!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 懦夫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: COWARD!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 懦夫！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: When the Sentients completed the Solar Rail to Tau, there was no grand ceremony. It simply began to work.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：当 Sentient 建成通往 Tau 的星际航道时，并没有举行盛大的仪式。它只是默默地开始运行。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Ceremony was hastily created, of course, for no true Orokin can blow his nose without observing some pomp and circumstance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当然，仪式很快就被创造出来，因为没有哪个真正的奥罗金人会不讲究到忽略一些礼节和仪式就去擤鼻涕。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: A great fuss was made over the First Transport to make the Crossing.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 第一批穿越过去的运输队引起了很大的轰动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was Executor Tormis’s stately cruiser, and in the choice of Tormis as expeditionary could be read a collective rebuke to Executor Tuvul for the grotesque mishap of the Zariman Ten Zero.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那是执行者托尔米斯的庄严巡洋舰，选择由托尔米斯率领远征军舰，可以视为对执行者涂沃在扎里曼 10-0 号事件中犯下的骇人听闻的罪行的一种集体谴责。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Sentient attack that followed rather spoiled the mood.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 随后发生的 Sentient 攻击破坏了气氛。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: CONNECTION
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：连接

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Within days a flotilla of colonist ships had departed, eager to set foot on the virgin shore.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 几天之内，一支殖民船队又出发了，渴望踏上这片处女地。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: OROKIN
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：奥罗金

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: For so long the Orokin Empire had no enemies. Its military existed merely to pursue petty grudges, house against house, Executor against Executor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：长久以来，奥罗金帝国没有敌人。它的军队存在仅仅是为了追究琐碎的恩怨，家族之间互相残杀，执行者之间互相征战。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: When the Sentients attacked, we knew a unity long denied to us. The Dax drew their swords against something other than an insolent peasant or a larcenous trader.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当 Sentient 发动攻击时，我们才感受到了久违的团结。禁卫拔刀相向的不再是傲慢的农民或偷窃的商人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Emperors, the deathless titular rulers of the Empire whose power was vested in the Executors, lurched awake on their dusty golden thrones.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而那些名义上的帝国统治者、实权却掌握在执行者手中的皇帝们，从布满灰尘的金色王座上猛然惊醒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: War, magnificent war! At last, the Empire meant something. Defined by an extinction more imminent than the Sun’s eventual death, we drank deep of the nectar of life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 战争，辉煌的战争！帝国终于有了意义。在比太阳消亡更迫在眉睫的灭绝威胁下，我们尽情畅饮了生命的甘露。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Gilderglass Enchantress rose out of Ceres fog on lethal wings, a galleon laden heavy with drones and silver-armored myrmidons.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "镀金玻璃魔女号"从谷神星的迷雾中升起，展开致命的双翼，这艘帆船战舰满载着无人机和身披银甲的密尔弥多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Circuitry fine as mist formed a delicate lace beneath their translucent plating.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 如薄雾细密的电路，在它们半透明的甲壳下交织成精致的蕾丝纹路。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: We did not expect to lose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：我们没想到会输。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Sentients made sure we saw the outcome. They sang, and our technology failed. Our warriors struggled and suffocated inside their shining suits.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些 Sentient 让我们亲眼目睹了这一切。它们歌唱，而我们的科技却被打败了。我们的战士在闪亮的战甲中挣扎窒息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: HUBRIS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：傲慢

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The crew of the Gilderglass Enchantress roasted alive as she swan-dived engineless through the skies of Tau, a complex and costly firework.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: "镀金玻璃魔女号"失去动力、俯冲穿过 Tau 的天空上，她的船员被活活烧死，这是一场复杂而昂贵的烟火秀。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So vast she was that she barely cleared the edges of the Solar Rail.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 她体型如此庞大，只能勉强通过星际航道的边缘。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: After the Sentients' first expeditionary strike, we had prepared a punitive counterblast.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们没想到会输。在 Sentient 的第一次远征打击之后，我们已经准备好了惩罚性的反击。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We fancied we were coming up with new and titillating ways to dispatch a far inferior foe.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们自以为想出了新颖刺激的方法来对付远逊于自己的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How we flattered ourselves. In truth we innovated desperately, knowing ourselves outmatched by our protean enemies.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 真是太自作多情了。事实上，我们只是在绝望中摸索，因为我们深知自己根本不是这些变化莫测的敌人的对手。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Now, I remember the developments of martial Archimedea were, at first, presented as entertainments.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：现在，我记得武术科研的发展最初是以娱乐的形式呈现的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: INVENTION
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：发明

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They tore through us like swarming children devouring their bloated mother.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们像一群孩子吞噬臃肿的母亲一样，将我们撕碎。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Desiccated, crushed between the pages of time, we had simply been out-evolved.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们干瘪枯萎，被时间的篇章挤压，最终被淘汰出局。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Like debauched roués watching criminals put to death in an arena-circus.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 就像一群放荡不羁的浪荡子在竞技场马戏团里观看罪犯被处死一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They were cells in the body of a sprawling, malevolent mass.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们只是庞大而邪恶的群体中的细胞。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The Sentients had been given a mandate to evolve, and their only model for the endpoint of such evolution was us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: Sentient 被赋予的使命是不断进化，而它们进化终点的唯一范本，就是我们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: We did not think of the Sentients as a ‘them' so much as an ‘it'.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：我们并没把那些 Sentient 视为"它们"，而更像是是一整个"它"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: SENTIENCE
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：Sentient

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They were returning to the Origin System not just to obliterate the Orokin, but to replace them and ultimately… perfect them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 它们返回始源星系不仅是为了消灭奥罗金人，更是为了取代他们，并最终……完善他们。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We were, I think, too conditioned by our experiences with the Infestation - a hive-mind of quite a different order.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我想，我们太容易受到 Infestation 的影响了——那是一种截然不同的群体意识。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: We faced legions hurled at us with no more regard for their individual lives than corpuscles have.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 我们面对的是成群结队的敌人，它们的个体生命就像是微不足道的细胞一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was easily done. I was too glorious a figure to be suspected.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 这很容易就能做到。我当时的声望太高，没人会怀疑我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Among the Seven I was - so I was told - considered Nitokh's plaything and concubine.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：在七人众之中，据我所知——我被视为尼托的玩物和男宠。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The blood of better men dappled me like medals. In secret I amassed weapons for Nitokh.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些比我强的人，他们的鲜血像勋章一样洒在我身上。我暗中为尼托积攒武器。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: COMMISSION
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：委任

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: In the early days of the War they appointed me Vice Regent Grand Carnus at her goading, thinking it a jest.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 战争初期，在她的撺掇下，他们任命我为副摄政王总司令，还以为这只是个玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: How quickly their laughter turned to solemn applause as I brought home the news of one victory after another.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 当我带回一场场胜利的消息时，他们的笑声很快变成了庄严的掌声。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was always the standard they still bore, glittering in its Orokin gold, and smeared in dappled crimson.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 吸引我的总是他们高举的旗帜，闪耀着奥罗金的金色光芒，点缀着斑驳的深红色。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: Nothing quite speaks to the pomposity with which we creatures treat the carnage of war quite as succinctly as the bannermen.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：要说最能反映我们人类是如何以自大的姿态对待战争屠戮的，那非旗手莫属。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Laughable though that is.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 尽管这听起来很荒谬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: I always ensured it stood proud upon the field before I departed.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 每次离开前，我都会确保它骄傲地矗立在战场上。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: STANDARD
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：旗帜

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Those who must be protected at all costs - and followed without question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 那些必须不惜一切代价保护——且不得有丝毫质疑的追随之人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: And who may be threatened, I might add, to follow orders that no sane soldier would ever complete, lest they somehow come to suffer some more terrible fate.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 而且，我还要补充一点，他们可能被威胁，被迫执行任何理智的士兵都不会执行的命令，否则他们将遭受更可怕的命运。尽管这听起来很荒谬。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: It was always their forms my eye was drawn to amongst the rest, though their mangled bodies were no different from any other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 虽然他们残缺的躯体与其他尸体并无二致，但我的目光总是会被他们的身形所吸引。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Childhood friends now in charge of legions of Dax, of Grineer, null-matter cells, self-replicating carcinators, primitive biodrone blade-spiders, canisters of low-tech troops.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 儿时的朋友如今统领着成群的禁卫、Grineer，他们是无质细胞、自我复制的致癌体、原始的生物无人机刃蛛、低科技士兵罐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Transcript: I recall them now. Coteries of laughing Orokin youth.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 文字记录：我现在想起来了。一群群欢笑的奥罗金青年。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Nobility clad in the as-yet-unspoiled raiments of command.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 身着尚未被玷污的、象征着统治者的贵族服饰。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Golden boys and girls with ravening devils at their beck.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一群黄金天子骄子，身边簇拥着一群如狼似虎的恶徒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: Their arrogance trickles like stinging sweat into my mind. They drank and sang, boasting of the times to come.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 他们的傲慢如同刺痛的汗水，渗入我的脑海。他们饮酒歌唱，吹嘘着未来的辉煌。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: VM: COMMANDERS
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 语音留言：统领

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: They would make names for themselves. Raise their families high in honor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 炫耀他们终将扬名立万。要让他们的家族荣耀加身。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: So many of them fell. Not even their bodies were returned.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 但他们中的许多人都牺牲了。甚至连遗体都没能找回。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: To prevent the enemy from gleaning our secrets, they were Kuva-jolted to liquefy upon death.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 为了防止敌人窃取我们的机密，他们都被会被赤毒震击，这样他们死后会化为液体。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.text: The hope of a generation turned to an oily puddle, sloshed through by Grineer boots.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/RoatheRomanc.zhText: 一代人的希望化作一滩油腻的水坑，被 Grineer 的靴子踩踏殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: For someone who seems pretty neutral to me, he does like to talk a lot...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 尽管他对我看起来挺中立的，他确实话挺多的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: Seems really... REALLY into robots. And games. And technology. He's definitely the most curious about me of the bunch. He seems sweet, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 似乎对机器人真的……非常感兴趣。还有游戏和科技。他无疑是这群人中最对我感兴趣的。不过他看起来很友善。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: Not sure what to get him in the store, yet. Though... tech seems the obvious answer.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我还没确定要在商店里买什么给他，不过……科技产品似乎是个明显的答案。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: I think we're pretty friendly now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我觉得我们现在关系不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: He wants to know everything about the future he can. Doesn't like to be made fun of, but seems to have a great sense of humor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 他想尽办法了解关于未来的一切。不喜欢被人取笑，但似乎很有幽默感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: Buying things from the store that have anything to do with tech or games seems to be the easy choice.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 从商店购买任何与科技或游戏相关的东西似乎是个简单的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: I think it's safe to say he likes me, and it's mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我想可以肯定地说他喜欢我，而且这种感觉是相互的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: There's something else going on with him, I think, underneath the surface. I don't know if he's okay with everything that's happened to him recently...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我觉得他的内心深处还有些事情。我不知道他是否能接受最近发生在他身上的一切事情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: Sometimes the easy answer is the right answer, he just really loves gifts that have to do with tech and games.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 有时候简单的答案就是正确的答案，他真的很喜欢与科技和游戏相关的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: He trusts me now, and it's mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 他现在信任我了，而我也信任他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: His recent traumas seem to be weighing on him. I hope I can help him through it, or get support from the rest of the team.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 他最近的创伤似乎让他承受了很大压力。我希望我能帮助他渡过这个难关，或者从团队其他成员那里得到支持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: We're close now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我们的关系很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: He wears his heart on his sleeve. Which makes him honest and genuine. But also easily wounded. I have to keep that in mind.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 他是个感情外露的人，这让他显得既真诚又诚恳。但也很容易受到伤害。我得记住这一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: I did it! I actually did it! I got all the Hex to play F&F!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我做到了！我真的做到了！我让所有六人组成员都来玩《寓言与边疆》了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: We're best friends. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... he's got my back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我们是最好的朋友。我知道无论我在哪里，去哪里，做什么……他都会支持我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: Although we're best friends now, I don't think romance will ever be an option between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 虽然我们现在是最好的朋友，但我认为我们之间永远不会发展成恋人关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: Amir told me he loves me. And I love him in return. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... not even the Indifference can touch that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 阿米尔告诉我他爱我。我也爱他。我知道，无论我身在何处，去往何方，做什么……连虚空无情之物都无法撼动到这份感情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: We're dating. But I think we're still in a situation where I could mess things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我们在交往。但我觉得我们现在的情况，我还是有可能把事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: I seem to have really messed things up with him. I don't think romance is an option anymore, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我好像真的把和他的关系搞砸了。很遗憾，我觉得恋爱关系不再是我们之间的一种选择了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.text: I think he might go out with me now if I asked him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Amir.zhText: 我觉得如果我现在开口问的话……他可能会跟我出去约会的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: Seems to be the most approachable of the Hex, even if we're still pretty neutral towards each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 她似乎是团队中最平易近人的，尽管我们之间的关系还算中立。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: She seems to like to play around more than the others, even Amir.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 她似乎比其他人，甚至是阿米尔，更爱玩乐。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: Not sure what to send her yet - On-lyne stuff is obvious. But what else?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 还不确定送她什么好——线上时代的东西是一个明显的选择。但还有什么别的吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I think I called her boring...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我好像说过她很无聊……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I think we're pretty friendly, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我觉得我们现在关系不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: She seems pretty willing to talk about a lot, but I think there's more under the surface I haven't scratched yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 她似乎很愿意谈论很多事情，但我觉得她还有很多没说的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: Buying her On-lyne stuff is the obvious choice in the store, but she has almost everything already. Maybe other audio gear?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 在商店里买她喜欢的线上时代的东西是显而易见的选择，但她几乎已经什么都有了。也许其他的音响设备？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I think Aoi might actually like me. <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我觉得碧可能真的喜欢我。<RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPYHAND>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I wonder what else I could buy her that she likes? She is the team mechanic. Maybe something to do with bikes? Spare parts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我在想还能买什么她会喜欢的东西？她是团队的机械师，也许跟摩托车有关的东西？备用零件？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I think she's worried people see her as shallow or dumb.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我觉得她担心别人认为她肤浅或愚蠢。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: Maybe I shouldn't have called her a manic pixie?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 也许我不该叫她"古灵精怪的小仙女"？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I think I've earned Aoi's trust. I have to be careful not to break it, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我想我已经赢得了碧的信任。不过，我必须小心不要辜负她的信任。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: She's starting to tell me more personal things, and ask about deeper things in exchange.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 她开始跟我分享更多私事，也开始问一些更深入的问题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I wonder what else I could buy her that she likes? She is the team mechanic. Maybe something to do with... these "atomicycles?" Do they have spare parts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我在想还能买什么她会喜欢的东西？她是团队的机械师，也许跟这些"原子摩托车"有关的东西？他们有备用零件吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I think she would go out with me if I asked...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我觉得如果我开口问的话……她会跟我出去约会的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: Aoi and I are close now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 现在碧和我的关系很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: She cares so much about everyone around her, and takes that as a point of pride.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 她非常关心身边的每一个人，并引以为傲。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I wonder what else I could buy her that she likes? She is the team mechanic. Maybe something to do with... these "atomicycles?" I wonder if something else could be usable as parts... And what do "atomicycles" run on, again?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我在想还能买什么她会喜欢的东西？她是团队机械师。她是团队的机械师，也许跟这些……"原子摩托车"有关的东西？我在想还有什么东西可以用作零件……对了，"原子摩托车"是用什么驱动的？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I think she would go out with me if I asked...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我觉得如果我开口问的话……她会跟我出去约会的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: We're best friends. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... she's got my back. <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我们是最好的朋友。我知道无论我在哪里，去哪里，做什么……她都会支持我。<RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: Although we're best friends now, I don't think romance will ever be an option between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 虽然我们现在是最好的朋友，但我认为我们之间永远不会发展成恋人关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: Aoi told me she loves me. And I love her in return. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... not even the Indifference can touch that. <RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 碧告诉我她爱我。我也爱她。我知道，无论我身在何处，去往何方，做什么……连虚空无情之物都无法撼动这份感情。<RETRO_EMOJI_SMITTEN>

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: We're dating. But I think we're still in a situation where I could mess things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我们在交往。但我觉得我们现在的情况，我还是有可能把事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.text: I seem to have really messed things up with her. I don't think romance is an option anymore, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/AoiN.zhText: 我好像真的把和她的关系搞砸了。很遗憾，我觉得恋爱关系不再是我们之间的一种选择了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Seems to feel rather neutral towards me. Doesn't know what to do with me yet. Feeling is mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 似乎对我没什么感觉。还不知道该怎么对待我。我对他的感觉也是一样。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Seems standoffish. Doesn't like to talk about his personal life.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 看起来有些冷淡。不喜欢谈论他的私生活。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Not sure what to send him for gifts yet... practical things? Maybe?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 还没决定送他什么礼物……实用的东西？也许吧？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: We're starting to get more friendly. Progress!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我们开始变得更友好了。有进步！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: He seems to like to cook. Maybe items that help him make food would be good gifts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 他似乎很喜欢做饭。或许送他一些厨房用具会是不错的礼物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Still reluctant to talk about his personal life, but seems to want to know a lot about Duviri...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 他仍然不愿谈论他的私生活，但似乎很想了解双衍王境……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Now he's starting to warm up a bit. I think he might actually *like* me. (Still doesn't seem to know what to do if I joke with him, though.)
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 现在他开始有点热络起来。我觉得他可能真的喜欢我。（不过，如果我跟他开玩笑他似乎还不知道该如回应。）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Opening up more about his life, finally. Being honest about my intentions - that I'm trying to get to know him - seems to go a long way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 他终于开始多谈一些自己的生活。坦诚地告诉他我想要更了解他，这似乎很有效。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: He seems to like to cook. Maybe items that help him make food would be good gifts?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 他似乎很喜欢做饭。或许送他一些厨房用具会是不错的礼物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: I think he's really starting to trust me now. I have to decide if I can trust him with the real story of Duviri, though...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我觉得他现在真的开始信任我了。但我还在犹豫是否应该把双衍王境的真实故事告诉他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: He seems to like to cook. Maybe items that help him make food would be good gifts? And maybe something that'll help wake up the whole Hex at 5:00am...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 他似乎很喜欢烹饪。或许送他一些厨房用具会是不错的礼物？或许还可以送一些能在清晨五点叫醒整个六人组的东西……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: I can now really push on him when he's being stubborn into telling me more. Unfortunately, that seems to go both ways, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 现在，当他固执地不愿多说时，我能更强势地逼他说更多了。但遗憾的是，他好像也会用这种方式对我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: We're now really close. I have to decide how much to tell him and how much I want to withhold. And I think he'll know, deep down, if I do.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我们现在的关系已经非常亲密了。我得决定告诉他多少，以及我想保留多少。我想如果我这么做，他内心深处会明白的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: I think he'd tell me anything now, if I asked. But I feel like if I betray that trust, it'll end very poorly.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我觉得现在只要我问，他什么都会告诉我。但我感觉如果我背叛了这份信任，后果会很严重。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: I feel like he would go out with me if I asked. Well. Carefully.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我觉得如果我开口问的话，他会跟我出去约会的。嗯，小心点儿问的话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: We're best friends. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... he's got my back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我们是最好的朋友。我知道无论我在哪里，去哪里，做什么……他都会支持我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Although we're best friends now, I don't think romance will ever be an option between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 虽然我们现在是最好的朋友，但我认为我们之间永远不会发展成恋人关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: Arthur told me he loves me. And I love him in return. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... not even the Indifference can touch that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 亚瑟告诉我他爱我。我也爱他。我知道，无论我身在何处，去往何方，做什么……连虚空无情之物都无法撼动到这份感情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: We're dating. But I think we're still in a situation where I could mess things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我们在交往。但我觉得我们现在的情况，我还是有可能把事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.text: I seem to have really messed things up with him. I don't think romance is an option anymore, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Arth.zhText: 我好像真的把和他的关系搞砸了。很遗憾，我觉得恋爱关系不再是我们之间的一种选择了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: Eleanor and I are still trying to figure out how we feel about each other. We're pretty neutral at this point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我和埃莉诺还在尝试弄清楚我们对彼此的感受。目前我们的关系还算中立。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: She used to be a journalist, I think. Maybe gifts that had to do with that, she might like?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 她好像以前是一名记者。也许她会喜欢与这个行业相关的礼物？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: She seems to think conversations are a chess match. I think it's about... keeping it going for as long as possible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 她似乎把对话当作棋局。我认为重点是……尽量让对话继续下去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: We're pretty friendly now. She's starting to warm up to me.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我们现在关系很好。她开始对我熟络起来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: I think little things like pads, pencils, pens - things she can take notes on, that remind her of her journalism days, might be nice gifts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我觉得像便笺本、铅笔、钢笔之类的小东西——她可以用来记笔记，可以让她回忆起当记者的日子，可能会是不错的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: She likes to talk about the past. About her feelings, about things she feels and sees. The longer I keep her talking, the more she seems to enjoy it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 她喜欢谈论过去。谈论她的感受，谈论她感受到和看到的事物。我越是让她多说些，她似乎越是享受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: I think she likes me now!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我觉得她现在喜欢上我了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: She has a playful side to her I wasn't expecting. She likes to be challenged a little bit, here and there, and pushed on topics in unexpected ways.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 她有我意想不到的调皮一面。她喜欢时不时地被挑战，以及在讨论话题时被以意想不到的方式推动。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: I think she misses contact with nature, as well as her old journalism career. I wonder if I can get her anything to help with that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我觉得她很怀念与大自然的接触，也怀念她以前的记者工作。我在想是否能找些什么东西来在这件事上帮助她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: She's starting to trust me. And it's mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 她开始信任我了。我对她也是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: The weight of being infested hits her the hardest. She's really worried she's a "monster" or will become one. I have to decide how much I want to help or hinder that mindset.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 被感染的重担对她打击最大。她真的很担心自己是一个"怪物"，或者会变成一个。我需要决定我愿意在多大程度上帮助或干预这种想法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: Eleanor and I are close, now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 现在，埃莉诺和我的关系很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: Everything is on the table between us, now. I think of the bunch, she is the most... philosophical. Yet somehow the most primal, in the same way. It's an interesting balance.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 现在，我们之间一切都摊开来说了。我觉得，在这些人当中，她是最……有哲理性的。然而，在某种程度上，她也可能是最原始的。这是一种有趣的平衡。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: I think she might go out with me now if I asked...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我觉得如果我现在开口问的话……她可能会跟我出去约会的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: We're best friends. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... she's got my back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我们是最好的朋友。我知道无论我在哪里，去哪里，做什么……她都会支持我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: Although we're best friends now, I don't think romance will ever be an option between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 虽然我们现在是最好的朋友，但我认为我们之间永远不会发展成恋人关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: Eleanor told me she loves me. And I love her in return. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... not even the Indifference can touch that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 埃莉诺告诉我她爱我。我也爱她。我知道，无论我身在何处，去往何方，做什么……连虚空无情之物都无法撼动这份感情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: We're dating. But I think we're still in a situation where I could mess things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我们在交往。但我觉得我们现在的情况，我还是有可能把事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.text: I seem to have really messed things up with her. I don't think romance is an option anymore, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Elea.zhText: 我好像真的把和她的关系搞砸了。很遗憾，我觉得恋爱关系不再是我们之间的一种选择了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.text: I opened a scroll and now I'm cursed. I'm pretty sure it doesn't actually do anything, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.zhText: 我打开了一张卷轴，现在我被诅咒了。不过，我觉得这诅咒实际上没什么大不了的。
