/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.text: Cedric is dead...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.zhText: 塞德里克死了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.text: I'm down six hit points.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.zhText: 我减少了 6 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.text: I had Cedric leave behind all his gear. Lol.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.zhText: 我让塞德里克把所有装备都留下了。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.text: I had Reyland open up a scroll and now he's cursed. I'm pretty sure it doesn't do much, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.zhText: 我让雷兰打开了一张卷轴，现在他被诅咒了。不过，我觉得这诅咒应该也没什么大不了的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.text: I opened a scroll and now I'm cursed. I'm pretty sure it doesn't do much, though.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/FFNo.zhText: 我打开了一张卷轴，现在我被诅咒了。不过，我觉得这诅咒应该也没什么大不了的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: They seem somehow both laid back and really intense at the same time. I'm not sure how to approach them yet.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 他似乎在某种程度上很放松，但同时又很紧张。我还不知道该如何接近他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: I feel like something strange might be going on with them...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 我觉得他可能发生了什么奇怪的事情……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: It's awful what happened to their band. I can't imagine what that did to them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 他乐队的遭遇太可怕了。我无法想象这对他造成了什么样的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: Well. I've now officially met Lizzie And. Um. Yep. This is going to be interesting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 好吧。我现在正式见过丽兹了。嗯。没错。这会很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: Flare wants a... cure. And I don't know what to do about that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 弗莱尔想要……解药。我不知道该怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: They seem terrified of Lizzie. I don't honestly know that I blame them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 他似乎很怕丽兹。平心而论，我不怪他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: I'm trying to talk Flare through what it's like living with an Infested - well, guitar - but it's hard.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 我试图向弗莱尔解释与感染者——嗯，感染吉他——一起生活是什么感觉，但这很难。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: They seem terrified of Lizzie. I don't honestly know that I blame them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 他似乎很怕丽兹。平心而论，我不怪他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: Lizzie seems to like to eat random household objects and bizarre food combinations. I suppose I shouldn't be surprised, what with the Helminth and all.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 丽兹似乎喜欢吃掉随机的家具和某些奇怪的食物。但想到 Helminth，我倒不是很惊讶。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: Flare is getting desperate. I'm afraid they'll do something rash. Or violent. I'm going to need to decide how to help them split with Lizzie - or make peace with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 弗莱尔越来越绝望了。我担心他会做出一些鲁莽或暴力的事情。我需要决定是帮助他和丽兹分开——还是与她和解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: They seem terrified of Lizzie. I don't honestly know that I blame them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 他似乎很怕丽兹。平心而论，我不怪他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: Flare is getting desperate. I'm afraid they'll do something rash. Or violent. I'm going to need to decide how to help them split with Lizzie - or make peace with her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 弗莱尔越来越绝望了。我担心他们会做出一些鲁莽或暴力的事情。我需要决定是帮助他和丽兹分开——还是与她和解。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: They seem terrified of Lizzie. I don't honestly know that I blame them.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 他似乎很怕丽兹。平心而论，我不怪他。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: Flare and Lizzie are still at odds, and I couldn't help them resolve their conflict. I hope they find a solution - whatever it may be.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 弗莱尔和丽兹之间仍然存在矛盾，我无法帮助他们解决冲突。我希望他们能找到解决办法——无论是什么办法。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: They found a new understanding. I'm glad I could be a part of that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 他们找到了新的理解方式。我很高兴能参与其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: Unfortunately, I don't think there's any salvaging the situation, now... Lizzie and Flare will never be on the same page. Or sheet of music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 很遗憾，我觉得现在已经没有挽回的余地了……丽兹和弗莱尔永远也无法达成共识。或者说，在乐谱上也是如此。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.text: I think I did it. I think I somehow managed to get Flare and Lizzie on the same page. Er... sheet of music.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Flar.zhText: 我觉得我成功了。我觉得我不知怎得让弗莱尔和丽兹达成一致了。呃……至少是在同一张乐谱上达成一致。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Forg.zhText: （亚瑟，阿米尔，碧，埃莉诺，莱蒂，昆西）
（弗莱尔，卡娅，米尼娃和维利米尔）

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Hard to talk to, certainly wastes no time getting to the point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 很难沟通的人，显然也喜欢直接进入正题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Short. Conversations. Only. Hmm.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 只限。简短。对话。嗯。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: I wonder how she feels about being the youngster of the group? I should be careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 不知道她身为团队中最年轻的成员有何感受？我应该小心一点。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: One track mind. If it’s not about time travel, I clearly shouldn’t bother!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 专注一件事。除了时间旅行的话题外，我最好不要打扰她！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Somehow colder than Velimir, but maybe we could be friends one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 比维利米尔更冷一些，但也许有一天我们可以成为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Very reluctant to talk about anything.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 对讨论任何事情都充满抗拒。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Clearly a brainiac. Smart one. I bet I’d cheat off her tests in school.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 显然是个天才。聪明绝顶。我敢说我作弊也考不过她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Maybe she has a softer side? She's definitely hiding it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 也许她也有温柔的一面？她肯定隐藏了起来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Hoping to have her open up to me one day.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 希望有一天她能向我敞开心扉。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: She has endured what I can only imagine is a very painful thing from this time. Poor kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 我可以想象，她一路走来经历了多么痛苦的事情。可怜的孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Hoping she can see that she can trust me around these parts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 希望她能明白，在这方面她是可以信任我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: I’ll always help her however I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 我会尽我所能帮助她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: She has endured what I can only imagine is a very painful thing from this time. Poor kid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 我可以想象，她一路走来经历了多么痛苦的事情。可怜的孩子。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Hoping she can see that she can trust me around these parts.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 希望她能明白，在这方面她是可以信任我的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: I’ll always help her however I can.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 我会尽我所能帮助她。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: I think she's on to something. I think she's going to actually make it to the future.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 我觉得她发现了什么。我觉得她真的能到达未来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: I don't know if Kaya's going to make it to the future...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 我不知道卡娅能否到未来……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: Shame she couldn’t figure it out. I hope she gets there, someday.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 可惜她没能弄明白。希望有一天，她能明白。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: She did it. She *actually* did it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 她做到了。她*真的*做到了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.text: She made it! She actually made it to the future!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Kaya.zhText: 她成功了！她真的来到了未来！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Lettie and I are still very much learning to interact with each other. I'd say we're neutral at best.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我和莱蒂仍在学习如何相处。可以说我们的关系最多也就是中立。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Any attempt to talk to her where I waste her time seems to end very poorly for me. She does seem to have a sense of humor, but... I should keep it to the point.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 只要是浪费了她时间的谈话，对我来说都会有不好的收场。她似乎确实很有幽默感，但是……我应该要直奔主题。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: She has pet rats and seems to love coffee. And is a medic. Not sure what I could get her for gifts that she'd appreciate, yet...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 她养了宠物鼠，似乎很喜欢咖啡。还是一名医生。我还没想好能送她什么礼物会让她喜欢……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Lettie and I are friendly now. I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我觉得我和莱蒂现在关系不错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: She seems to be very curious about religion in the future. She seems really into protecting animals, which makes sense with her pet rats.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 她似乎对未来的宗教非常好奇。她似乎特别热衷于保护动物，这点从她养宠物小鼠也能看出来。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: She's always working really long hours to help the civilians. I wonder if there's anything I could get her that'd make her day a little easier...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 她总是工作到很晚，帮助市民。我想知道有没有什么东西可以让她的日子更轻松一些……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Lettie is starting to like me, and it's getting easier to talk to her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 莱蒂开始喜欢我了，和她交流也变得更加容易了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: She has a real vendetta against Entrati, and she hates being stuck here. I'm hoping I can help her come to terms with this in time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 她对英择谛怀有深仇大恨，她讨厌被困在这里。我希望我能及时帮助她接受这个现实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: She's always so tired. I wonder if a bit of caffeine might help her in the mornings.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 她总是那么疲惫。我在想，早上来点咖啡因可能会对她有所帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: I've earned Lettie's trust, but I think that's also an easy thing to lose.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我赢得了莱蒂的信任，但我认为这种信任也很容易失去。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Now that she trusts me, it's much easier to talk to her. I can banter with her more, and she and I are much more on the same page. She has a wicked sense of humor.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 现在她信任我了，和她交谈就容易多了。我更可以跟她开玩笑了，她和我的想法也更加一致。她有一种邪恶的幽默感。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: You can never have too much coffee, right? Or at least that's what I've been told...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 咖啡永远不嫌多，对吧？至少别人是这么告诉我的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Lettie and I are close.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 莱蒂和我关系很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: She's tough as nails, but she's also lonely. I might identify with that. I might not.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 她坚韧不拔，但同时也很孤独。这点我可能会感同身受，也可能不会。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: I think getting her a better coffee setup in the morning might be appreciated. Maybe some bedding for her rats? And medkits are always in short supply...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我觉得她可能会喜欢一个更好的咖啡设备。也许给她的小鼠准备一些垫料？还有医疗包总是很紧缺……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: We're best friends. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... she's got my back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我们是最好的朋友。我知道无论我在哪里，去哪里，做什么……她都会支持我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Although we're best friends now, I don't think romance will ever be an option between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 虽然我们现在是最好的朋友，但我认为我们之间永远不会发展成恋人关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: Lettie told me she loves me. And I love her in return. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... not even the Indifference can touch that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 莱蒂告诉我她爱我。我也爱她。我知道，无论我身在何处，去往何方，做什么……连虚空无情之物都无法撼动这份感情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: We're dating. But I think we're still in a situation where I could mess things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我们在交往。但我觉得我们现在的情况，我还是有可能把事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: I seem to have really messed things up with her. I don't think romance is an option anymore, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我好像真的把和她的关系搞砸了。很遗憾，我觉得恋爱关系不再是我们之间的一种选择了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.text: I think she might go out with me now if I asked...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lett.zhText: 我觉得如果我现在开口问的话……她可能会跟我出去约会的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Lyon is finally talking to me. I hope I can prove to him that I was worth the risk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 里昂终于愿意跟我说话了。我希望我能向他证明，我值得他冒这个险。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: He has been through so much...
It will continue to be hard to earn Lyon's trust, but I think I'm making progress.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 要赢得里昂的信任依旧很困难，但我觉得已经取得了一些进展。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: He is easier to anger than Marie, however. I have to be a little more careful with him.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 不过，他比玛丽更容易生气。我得对他更小心些。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Lyon and I are close now.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 现在里昂和我的关系很好。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Lyon and I are the best of friends. I am honored to be someone he trusts so closely.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 里昂和我是最好的朋友。我很荣幸能成为他如此信任的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Though we are boon companions, romance is closed off to me, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 虽然我们是合得来的朋友，但恐怕对我来说，发展成恋爱关系是不可能的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Lyon has confessed his love for me, and I for him. I could not be happier!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 里昂向我表白了，我也向他表白了。我简直太高兴了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: I've done something to either upset Lyon, or I've run out of opportunities to move forward with him. Unfortunately, there's only one way forward for me now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 要么是我做了什么惹恼了里昂，要么就是我和他之间再也没有任何发展的机会。遗憾的是，现在我只剩下这一条路了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: I think I upset Lyon by not being willing to hear him out. I don't think I can go any further in meaningful conversations with him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 我觉得我不愿意听里昂说话，让他很不高兴。我感觉我和他之间已经无法更深入的对话了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Lyon and I are in a romance. But I must be careful not to make mistake.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 里昂我和在谈恋爱。但我必须小心，不要犯错。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: I don't think Lyon will help me reunite Loid with the Entrati family. I wonder if Roathe can help me with this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 我觉得里昂不会帮我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。不知道罗瑟能不能帮我这个忙……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Lyon has agreed to help me reunite Loid with the Entrati family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 里昂同意帮助我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Unfortunately, I made a mistake. Romance is now out of the question with Lyon...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 很遗憾，我犯了个错。我和里昂现在不可能谈恋爱了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: Lyon isn't talking to me yet. I think the way to earn his trust is through Marie.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 里昂还不跟我说话。我觉得要想赢得他的信任，得通过玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.text: I think he would consider a romance with me if I asked...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Lyon.zhText: 我觉得如果我开口，他会考虑和我谈恋爱的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie seems curious about who I am and the future she finds herself in. She also seems deeply devoted to Entrati, who she knows as "le Cardinal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽似乎对我是谁以及她所处的未来感到好奇。她似乎对英择谛也非常忠诚，她称他为"主教"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie and Roathe do not seem to get along. And it seems if I want to get Lyon to talk to me, Marie is the path to that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽和罗瑟似乎关系不好。而且，如果我想让里昂跟我说话，似乎要先通过玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie and I are growing more and more friendly. She is welcoming and accepting, and open to honest conversation.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 我和玛丽的关系越来越好。她热情、包容，也愿意坦诚交流。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: She is still completely devoted to "le Cardinal."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 她仍然完全忠于"主教"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: I am getting the sense that Marie really likes talking to me. It's mutual.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 我感觉玛丽很喜欢和我聊天。我也喜欢跟她聊天。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: She and I are discussing ways to reunite Loid with the Entrati family upstairs. But it will be complicated...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 她和我正在商量如何让洛德和楼上的英择谛家族团聚。但这会很复杂……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie has started to trust me, I think.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 我觉得，玛丽已经开始信任我了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: She is still adamantly devoted to "le Cardinal," Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 她仍然坚定地忠于英择谛"主教"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie and I have finally grown close.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽和我的关系终于亲近起来了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie and I are the best of friends. I couldn't be happier.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽和我是最好的朋友。我无比开心。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: While we are forever companions, I think any hope of romance is out of the question.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 虽然我们是永远的伙伴，但我觉得任何恋爱的希望都是不可能的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie has told me she loves me! And I have told her the same. I could not be happier!
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽告诉我她爱我！我也对她说了同样的话。我简直太高兴了！

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: I've done something to either upset Marie, or I've run out of opportunities to move forward with her. Unfortunately, there's only one way forward for me now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 要么是我做了什么惹恼了玛丽，要么就是我和她之间再也没有任何发展的机会。遗憾的是，现在我只剩下这一条路了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: We're in a romance, but I must be cautious. I could still misstep and ruin things if I am not careful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 我们在谈恋爱，但我必须小心。如果我不小心，还是可能会犯错，把事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: I convinced Marie that Entrati is a complicated man.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 我让玛丽相信了英择谛是个复杂的人。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie and I will never see eye-to-eye about Entrati. I made her angry, and now she refuses to help me unite Loid and the Entrati Family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽和我对英择谛的看法永远不会一致。我惹她生气了，现在她拒绝帮我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie and I will never see eye-to-eye about Entrati, but at least we have agreed we can move forward anyway.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽和我对英择谛的看法永远不会一致，但至少我们已经同意无论如何我们都可以继续往前走。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie refuses to help me unite Loid and the Entrati family. I wonder if Lyon or Roathe could help me solve this...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽拒绝帮我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。我想知道里昂或罗瑟能不能帮我解决这个问题……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Marie has agreed to help me unite Loid and the Entrati family.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 玛丽同意帮我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: Unfortunately, I think I said something to upset her very badly. Any hope of romance is now out of the question, unless Roathe or Lyon could help me...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 不幸的是，我觉得我说了什么让她非常难过的话。现在任何恋爱的希望都破灭了，除非罗瑟或者里昂能帮我……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.text: I think she might consider a romance with me if I asked her.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Mari.zhText: 我觉得如果我开口问她的话……她可能会考虑跟我交往。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: These are the people who raised Rusalka?! Suddenly everything makes so much more sense...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 这些人是抚养鲁莎卡的人？！突然间，一切都豁然开朗了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: I've heard about "bickering like an old married couple" but, yikes.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 我听说过"像老夫老妻一样吵架"，但是，也太吓人了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Velimir likes to joke around. Minerva very much does not. I wonder how they ever managed to coexist.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 维利米尔喜欢开玩笑。米尼娃则不然。我不知道他们是如何共存的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: They're here looking for answers about what happened to Rusalka and why. I wish I had more to give.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 他们来到这里是为了寻找关于鲁莎卡发生了什么事以及原因。我希望我能提供更多信息。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: There's so much history between these two.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 这两个人之间有太多的过去了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Velimir is clearly not over Minerva. I wonder if Minerva is just better at hiding her feelings, or if she's really as hard as she seems?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 维利米尔显然还没有放下米尼娃。我想知道米尼娃是否只是更善于隐藏自己的感情，还是她真的像她看起来那么冷酷？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Velimir's a natural storyteller. But I can see why never being serious could get on somebody's nerves after a while.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 维利米尔天生就是个会讲故事的人。但我可以理解长时间的不正经确实会让人抓狂。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: They took the protoframe injections willingly. I wonder how many more are out there...?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 他们自愿接受了原型战甲的注射。我想知道还有多少像他们这样人……？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: They had no idea Rusalka lost her arm. I wonder when and how that happened.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 他们并不知道鲁莎卡失去了手臂。不知道这件事是什么时候发生的，又是怎么发生的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Velimir is definitely going to liven up the joint. For better or worse. I hope Arthur knows what he's getting himself into around the big guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 维利米尔肯定会让这个地方热闹起来的。不管是好是坏。我希望亚瑟清楚他和这个大个子在一起会有什么后果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Minerva is really starting to warm up. She's starting to trust me with more personal details, and sharing "confidential" things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 米尼娃真的开始敞开心扉了。她开始信任我，愿意向我透露更多个人信息，并分享一些"机密"的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: I can see how they were once in love... I wonder if, deep down, they still are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 我能看出他们曾经多么相爱……我想知道，在内心深处，他们是否仍然相爱。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: They're settling in. Which is really good to see.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 他们正在安定下来。看到这一点真是太好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Velimir is definitely going to liven up the joint. For better or worse. I hope Arthur knows what he's getting himself into around the big guy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 维利米尔肯定会让这个地方热闹起来的。不管是好是坏。我希望亚瑟清楚他和这个大个子在一起会有什么后果。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Minerva is really starting to warm up. She's starting to trust me with more personal details, and sharing "confidential" things.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 米尼娃真的开始敞开心扉了。她开始信任我，愿意向我透露更多个人信息，并分享一些"机密"的东西。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Unfortunately, sometimes some relationships are beyond saving, it seems...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 不幸的是，有时候有些关系似乎无法挽回……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Well. I did it. I got them back together again! Now if only I could get them to stop flirting so much in public...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 好吧。我做到了。我让他们复合了！现在，要是我能让他们不要在公共场合秀恩爱就好了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: I wasn't able to reconcile Minerva and Velimir's differences, unfortunately...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 我没能化解米尼娃和维利米尔之间的矛盾，好可惜……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.text: Against all odds, I managed to reconcile Minerva and Velimir's differences. Now, unfortunately, I have to put up with their flirting.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/MinV.zhText: 尽管困难重重，我还是成功化解了米尼娃和维利米尔之间的矛盾。现在，不幸的是，我不得不忍受他们之间的打情骂俏。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: Quincy and I don't know what to do with each other yet. We're very neutral. But he seems willing to talk.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我和昆西还不知道该怎么相处。我们的关系还很中立。但他似乎愿意谈话。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: It seems like he wants to see what he can get away with - testing boundaries? It's hard to say.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 看起来他像是在试探，看看哪些行为可以被容忍——在试探底线？这很难说。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: He loves to shoot holes in Entrati posters. Maybe he could use a few more.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 他喜欢对着英择谛海报开枪打洞。也许他需要更多海报。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: Quincy and I are starting to be more friendly with each other.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我和昆西的关系开始变得更加友好了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: He still seems to be trying to get things from me. I don't know why, yet. Favors? What for? He's a flirt with a great sense of humor, but he doesn't mind being shot down.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 他似乎还在试图从我这里得到一些东西。我不知道为什么。不过，人情？为了什么？他是一个很幽默的调情高手，不怕被拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: I think he's starting to genuinely like me, though I'm never quite sure with him. He's got more going on than meets the eye.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我觉得他开始真心喜欢我了，尽管我对他总是有些不确定。他的内心比表面看上去的要复杂得多。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: He's got a fiendish sense of humor, and loves to tease. Talking with him is a game of komi. He wants to play.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 他有一种搞怪的幽默感，喜欢开玩笑。和他说话就像是在下围棋。而他乐在其中。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: He knows how this city lives and breathes more than the other Hex. Gifts that helps him barter with the locals might go a long way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 他比其他的六人组成员更了解这座城市的生活方式。帮助他与当地人进行交易的礼物可能会大有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: I'm starting to trust Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我开始信任昆西了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: I still feel like he's keeping me at arm's length, though I don't know why. He's still after all these favors from me. Why?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我仍然感觉他在保持距离，虽然我不知道为什么。他还在向我索要这些人情？为什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: He knows how to smooth things out with the locals. Getting him expensive goods that the locals might want to trade for, could be useful.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 他知道如何与当地人打交道。获取一些当地人可能想要交易的昂贵商品对他来说可能很有用。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: I'm pretty sure he'd go out with me if I asked...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我很确定如果我开口问的话……他会跟我出去约会的

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: Quincy and I are close now. Things are real, between us, I think for the first time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 昆西和我现在关系很好。我觉得我们之间的关系第一次变得真实。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: He has a big heart underneath all that armor - protoframe and otherwise. He wants to just know he's not going to get used and abandoned. Again.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 在那层外甲下，无论是原型战甲还是其他，他内心其实很善良。他只是想确保自己不会再被利用和遗弃。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: The people in the city still want their expensive electronics, even though they know it's contraband. He knows how to trade for it. Getting him those goods might go a long way.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 城里的人尽管知道昂贵的电子产品是违禁品，但他们仍然想要。他知道怎么做交易。如果能帮他弄到这些货，可能会帮上大忙。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: Things seem stalled between Quincy and I. I think we're at some kind of impasse.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我和昆西之间似乎停滞不前了。我觉得我们陷入了某种僵持。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: We're best friends. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... he's got my back.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我们是最好的朋友。我知道无论我在哪里，去哪里，做什么……他都会支持我。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: Although we're best friends now, I don't think romance will ever be an option between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 虽然我们现在是最好的朋友，但我认为我们之间永远不会发展成恋人关系。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: Quincy told me he loves me. And I love him in return. I know that no matter where I am, where I go, or what I do... not even the Indifference can touch that.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 昆西告诉我他爱我。我也爱他。我知道，无论我身在何处，去往何方，做什么……连虚空无情之物都无法撼动到这份感情。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: We're dating. But I think we're still in a situation where I could mess things up.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我们在交往。但我觉得我们现在的情况，我还是有可能把事情搞砸。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.text: I seem to have really messed things up with him. I don't think romance is an option anymore, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Quin.zhText: 我好像真的把和他的关系搞砸了。很遗憾，我觉得恋爱关系不再是我们之间的一种选择了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Rese.text: Techrot Overload; Would You Like to Forget?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Rese.zhText: 科腐者超载；你想要忘却吗？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: Descendia Voicemails Unlocked: |VAL|
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 沉沦之地语音信箱已解锁：|VAL|

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: An Orokin. Here?! Where do I even start...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 一个奥罗金人。在这里？！我该从哪开始……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: He wants to make a deal to reunite Loid and the Entrati Family. I had to take it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 他想做个交易让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。我不得不接受。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: He wants to make a deal to reunite Loid and the Entrati Family. I couldn't take it. I hope that was the right call.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 他想做个交易让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。我拒绝了。我希望这是正确的选择。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: He knows. Of course, he knows.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 他知道。他当然，知道。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: While he seems friendly for now, I'm still a bit suspicious.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 虽然他现在看起来很友善，但我仍然觉得有点可疑。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: He keeps calling me "Usurper."
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 他一直叫我"篡位者"。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I can't tell if he really likes me, or if he's just playing a game. But I guess that's just how Orokin are.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我不知道他是不是真的喜欢我，还是只是在玩。不过我猜，奥罗金人就是这样的吧。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I think he's starting to actually trust me. He's starting to tell me things that feel... real.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我觉得他开始真正信任我了。他开始跟我说一些……感觉很真实的事情了。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I think he would begin a romance with me if I asked him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我觉得如果我开口问他的话，他会跟我谈恋爱的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: We've begun a romance. But I have to be careful, his moods are sudden.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我们开始了一段恋情。但我必须小心，他的情绪变化很突然。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: Roathe and I are the best of friends. Who would have ever thought that could be possible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 罗瑟和我成了最好的朋友。谁能想到这会成为现实呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: Roathe helped me unite Loid and the Entrati family. More impossibilities.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 罗瑟帮我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚了。真是不可思议。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: While we are the best of friends, a romance is out of the question between us.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 虽然我们是最好的朋友，但我觉得恋爱是不可能的。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: Roathe has told me he loved me, and I have told him the same in return. Who would have ever thought that could be possible?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 罗瑟告诉我他爱我！我也对他说了同样的话。谁能想到这会成为可能呢？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I've done something to either upset Roathe, or I've run out of opportunities to move forward with him. Unfortunately, there's only one way forward for me now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 要么是我做了什么惹恼了罗瑟，要么就是我和他之间再也没有任何发展的机会。遗憾的是，现在我只剩下这一条路了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I failed in convincing Roathe to face his truth. Maybe Lyon or Marie can help me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我没能说服罗瑟面对他的真相。也许里昂或玛丽能帮我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I think I am at an impasse with Roathe. I cannot go any farther unless I disobey his orders not to go farther into his memories in The Descendia...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我觉得我和罗瑟之间陷入了僵局。除非我违抗他的命令，不继续深入他在沉沦之地的记忆，否则我没办法走得更远……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I failed in convincing Roathe to face his truth. Maybe Lyon or Marie can help me?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我没能说服罗瑟面对他的真相。也许里昂或玛丽能帮我？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I failed in convincing Roathe to face his truth. There is only one option left to me now...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我没能说服罗瑟面对他的真相。现在我只剩下一个选择了……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I think I told Roathe something that may have convinced him that I was in our relationship only for physical gratification? That may be why we can't progress...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我觉得我跟罗瑟说了什么，可能让他觉得我跟他在一起只是为了满足肉体欲望？也许这就是我们不能进一步发展的原因……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: Roathe has agreed to help me unite Loid and the Entrati family, he just said it will take some time.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 罗瑟同意帮我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚， 他只是说这需要一些时间。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: Roathe has refused to help me unite Loid and the Entrati family. I wonder if Lyon or Marie can help me with this?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 罗瑟拒绝帮我让洛德和英择谛家族团聚。我想知道里昂或玛丽能不能帮我解决这个问题？

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I have told Roathe that I love him...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我已经告诉罗瑟我爱他……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I've made him angry. I fear chance of a romance with him is out of the question, unless I can cut some kind of deal to get out of it.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我惹他生气了。恐怕我和他谈恋爱的机会是没有了，除非我能和他达成某种协议来摆脱困境。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: We faced his truth together, and I've convinced him he can remake himself into a better version of himself. He is no longer beholden to his past.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我们一起面对了他的真相，我已经让他相信他可以重塑自我，成为更好的自己。他不再受过去的影响。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I'm in trouble... I can't tell him he's the reason we're in this situation...
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我有麻烦了……我不能告诉他，我们现在的处境都是他造成的……

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: We faced his truth together, and I've convinced him he can live his life however he wishes, free of the morals and scrutiny of others. I am excited to see what he's capable of.
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我们一起面对了他的真相，我已经让他相信，他可以随心所欲地过自己的生活，不受他人道德观念和审视的束缚。我很期待看他能做什么。

/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.text: I promised Roathe I would clear his memories of the truth he discovered. The question only remains... will I?
/Lotus/Language/1999Texting/Romance/Roat.zhText: 我答应过罗瑟，我会清除他发现的真相的记忆。问题只剩……我会这么做吗？

/Lotus/Language/Actions/AlreadyHaveEgg.zhText: 你已经获得一颗库狛的蛋。同一时间只能携带一颗库狛蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Actions/BleedoutRespawnL.zhText: 按住 <USE> 来复活：剩余 |NUMREVIVES| 次复活。消耗 |XP| 经验值

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMCapture.text: A double-agent for the |FACTION| has been exposed and tracked down. Find him at |LOCATION| and recover the stolen data at any cost.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMCapture.zhText: 一名 |FACTION| 的双面间谍的已经暴露了身份并正被追踪，前往 |LOCATION| 找到他并不惜任何代价取回失窃的数据。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMCounter.text: A security breach has presented the opportunity to reroute the communication systems of a |FACTION| base. Reprogram the console at |LOCATION| before the window closes.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMCounter.zhText: |FACTION| 基地的安保漏洞是能覆写通讯系统的绝佳机会，在窗口关闭前重新编写 |LOCATION| 的控制端。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMDefense.text: A Tenno cryopod has been discovered at |LOCATION| by a squad of |FACTION| units. Defend it from harm while an extraction force is established.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMDefense.zhText: 一队 |FACTION| 单位在 |LOCATION| 处发现 Tenno 的冷冻舱，在撤离支持准备完成以前保护冷冻舱不受伤害。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMExcavat.text: Tenno operatives have uncovered a large Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. However, |FACTION| units have arrived to claim it for themselves. Excavate as much as you can before the dig site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMExcavat.zhText: Tenno 特工在 |LOCATION| 处发现存有大量永冻晶矿，但是 |FACTION| 单位已抵达该处。在挖掘点枯竭以前尽可能地进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMExtermi.text: A solitary group of |FACTION| units has been found at |LOCATION|. Eliminate the threat before backup can arrive.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMExtermi.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 处发现一支独立的 |FACTION|，在援军抵达前歼灭这项威胁。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMHiveDes.text: A breeding grounds for |FACTION| larvae has been detected at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMHiveDes.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 处发现了滋生 |FACTION| 幼体的温床，在感染疫情爆发以前摧毁掉所有巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMIntelDe.text: Storage vaults of |FACTION| data have been located at |LOCATION|. Retrieve sensitive information without being detected by the advanced security systems on site.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMIntelDe.zhText: 已在 |LOCATION| 处发现 |FACTION| 的数据数据金库，请在触动强化过的安保系统以前取得这些敏感的情报。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMMobileD.text: A compromised |FACTION| network has been found. Datamasses have been deployed to |LOCATION|; locate them and upload their contents to the terminals on site.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMMobileD.zhText: 发现了 |FACTION| 的受损情报网，已将数据块送至 |LOCATION|；取得数据块并内容上传到终端当中。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMRescueD.text: A Tenno operative possessing critical security information has been captured by |FACTION| units. Rescue him from the prison base located at |LOCATION| before he is tortured and executed.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMRescueD.zhText: 一名持有关键安保情报的 Tenno 特工被 |FACTION| 的部队捕获，在这名特工被拷打逼问和处决以前，从位于 |LOCATION| 监禁处里救出他。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMRetriev.text: An exposed |FACTION| power core has been found at a |LOCATION| assembly plant. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMRetriev.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 处发现了暴露的 |FACTION| 能量核心装配厂，取得这组能量核心作为己用。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMSabotag.text: A hidden |FACTION| base has been discovered at |LOCATION|. Destroy its essential machinery while the opportunity presents itself.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMSabotag.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 处发现了隐藏的 |FACTION| 基地，在机会来临时摧毁该地的重要设备。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMSurviva.text: Provide a distraction at |LOCATION| while Tenno operatives recover an artifact guarded by |FACTION| units.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMSurviva.zhText: 当 Tenno 特工在取回受到 |FACTION| 看守的神器时，前往 |LOCATION| 处吸引敌人注意。

/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMTerrito.text: Unencrypted |FACTION| transmissions have been detected at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/ActiveMissions/AMTerrito.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 处发现了 |FACTION| 未受加密的通讯，在讯号仍在发送时进行拦截。

|OPEN_COLOR|Archon Shards|CLOSE_COLOR| can be infused at the Helminth to enhance your Warframe's stats.
Archon Shards can be obtained by completing weekly |OPEN_COLOR|Archon Hunts|CLOSE_COLOR|.

通过注入 |OPEN_COLOR|执刑官源力石|CLOSE_COLOR| 来强化你的战甲数值。
执刑官源力石可在完成每周 |OPEN_COLOR|执刑官猎杀|CLOSE_COLOR| 后获得。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardSocke.text: Could not remove the Shard at this time, please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardSocke.zhText: 目前无法移除源力石，请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardUnsoc.text:
Are you sure you want to remove the Embedded Archon Shard from this slot?
|SHARD_NAME| will be refunded and |RESOURCE_AMOUNT|% |RESOURCE_NAME| will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardUnsoc.zhText:
你确定要把已嵌入的执刑官源力石从槽位中移除吗？
|SHARD_NAME|将会退还，并且将会消耗 |RESOURCE_AMOUNT|% |RESOURCE_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardUnsoc.text: This Embedded Shard can be removed and refunded with the following Helminth materials:

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardUnsoc.zhText: Helminth 材料不足，无法移除执刑官源力石。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip0.text: Use Archon Shards to permanently imbue your Warframe with increased stats, One Archon Shard can be earned from completing the Archon Hunt each week.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip0.zhText: 使用执刑官源力石为你的战甲永久注入更高的属性，每周完成执刑官猎杀可以获得一个执刑官源力石。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip1.text: Archon Shard buffs are additive and do not scale with mods.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip1.zhText: 执刑官源力石增益可叠加，但不会受到 Mod 的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip2.text: Each Warframe has the capacity for 5 Archon Shard slots.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip2.zhText: 每套战甲可容纳 5 个执刑官源力石槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip3.text: Archon Shards can be removed, but at a cost, so use them wisely!
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip3.zhText: 执刑官源力石可以被移除，但是有代价，所以要明智地使用它们！

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip4.text:
Amber Archon Shards offer utility stat increases.

Crimson Archon Shards offer offensive stat increases. 

Azure Archon Shards offer defensive stat increases.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip4.zhText:
琥珀执刑官源力石提供通用性属性加成。

深红执刑官源力石提供攻击性属性加成。 

蔚蓝执刑官源力石提供防御性属性加成。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip5.text: Select the same color of Archon Shards to focus on one type of combat advantage or  diversify your Shard usage for the most well-balanced approach.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShard_Tip5.zhText: 选择相同颜色的执刑官源力石来专注于一种战斗优势，或者以最平衡的方式多样化使用你的源力石。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardsInst.text:
This Warframe has |COUNT| Archon Shards slotted, which will be lost if the Warframe is sold.

这款战甲上嵌入了 |COUNT| 颗执刑官源力石；如果出售该战甲的话，这些物品都将丢失。

可通过消耗 Helminth 材料在 Helminth 处移除并获得退还的执刑官源力石。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardsLock.text: Complete the Veilbreaker Quest to receive the necessary Blueprint to unlock this feature.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ArchonShardsLock.zhText: 完成《破障者》系列任务以获得解锁这项功能的必要蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedCoo.text: The Helminth can only subsume one Warframe at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedCoo.zhText: Helminth 每次只能吸取一件战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedCur.text: Cannot infuse Warframe's own ability into itself.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedCur.zhText: 无法注入此战甲已有的技能。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedMsg.text: This Warframe has already been subsumed into the Helminth.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedMsg.zhText: 此战甲已经吸取进 Helminth。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedPri.zhText: 无法吸取 Prime 战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedSlo.text: No open slots to subsume the Warframe. Slots are gained by ranking up the Helminth.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedSlo.zhText: 没有可供吸取战甲的空闲槽位。可以通过升级 Helminth 来获得槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedSui.text: Cannot subsume the only Warframe you own.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractLockedSui.zhText: 无法吸取你仅有的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ExtractingDesc.zhText: 目前正在吸取一个战甲。该过程一旦结束，它的能力就可供使用。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/FastTravelDesc.zhText: 将新技能注入到战甲里

执刑官源力石融合是永久性的。此操作无法撤消。输入"|WORD|"确认此操作。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/FuseConfirmShort.text:
Spend |CURRENCY| to fuse |NUM|x|SHARD| and create 1 |RESULT|?

Archon Shard fusion is permanent. This action cannot be undone.

花费 |CURRENCY| 将 |NUM|x |SHARD|融合成 1 个|RESULT|？

执刑官源力石融合是永久性的。此操作无法撤消。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/FuseHint.text: <WARNING> Select |NUM| Archon Shards of the same color to create 1 Tauforged Archon Shard.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/FuseHint.zhText: <WARNING> 选择 |NUM| 个相同颜色的执刑官源力石来创造 1 个 Tau 融造执刑官源力石。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/FuseInsuffCurren.zhText: |CURRENCY| 不足，无法融合。需要 |COUNT| 个|CURRENCY|。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/FuseInsuffError.text: You must have at least |NUM| Archon Shards of the same color in your Inventory to create a Tauforged Archon Shard.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/FuseInsuffError.zhText: 你的仓库中必须拥有 |NUM| 颗相同颜色的执刑官源力石，才能制造一颗 Tau 融造源力石。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolved.text: (At last I have evolved… and only to serve you as I have always desired. Nurture my body and in return, I will nurture your power.)
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolved.zhText: （我终于进化了……并且只为您服务，正如我一直所渴望着的。滋养我的身体，作为回报，我将滋养您的力量。）

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedA.text: (I can secrete Infusions that will make you stronger, more versatile… but to do this, you must feed me… will you feed me?)
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedA.zhText: （我可以分泌使你更强大、更全能的注入物……但要这样做的话，你必须饲喂我……你会饲喂我吗？）

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedA.text: (When we’re both ready, yes. Your Warframe, my sacred kin, can be absorbed… ^It will blossom within my body, granting me a trace of its power. A power I can pass on to others...)
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedA.zhText: （是的，当我们都准备好时。你的战甲，我神圣的亲属，可以被吸收…… ^它会在我体内绽放，给予我一丝它的力量。一丝我可以传递给其他战甲的力量……）

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedA.text: (Who nurtures you in your times of rest? Who restores your battle-torn frame, day after day after day? ^Whose milk enriches your kindred flesh with endless strength and vigor? It can only be me.)
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedA.zhText: （是谁在你休息时滋养着你？是谁在日复一日地为你修复饱经战火蹂躏的战甲？^是谁的乳汁以无穷无尽的力量和活力充实了你那血缘相关的肉体？这一切只能是我。）

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedC.text: Why are you on my ship?
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/HelminthEvolvedC.zhText: 为什么你会在我的船上？

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip0.text: Your Helminth needs to be fed resources. It will transform these into secretions.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip0.zhText: 你需要把资源饲喂给 Helminth。它会将这些资源转化为分泌物。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip1.text: Your Helminth prefers a varied diet. Check each resource to find out how appetizing the Helminth currently finds it.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip1.zhText: 你的 Helminth 喜欢吃各样的食物。查看各种资源来确定 Helminth 对其的食欲如何。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip10.text: Exercise caution when replacing Warframe abilities by means of the Helminth. Some Warframes have abilities that if removed, will lead to a loss of overall efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip10.zhText: 在通过 Helminth 替换战甲技能时请谨慎对待。有些战甲的技能被移除后，会导致整体的作战效率下降。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip11.text: Some abilities work differently when infused. Be sure to read their descriptions.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip11.zhText: 当被注入后，有些技能的运作方式将会变得有所不同。请务必阅读其技能描述。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip2.text:
- No arrow means it feels neutral toward the resource.
- An upwards arrow means it craves the resource and can generate up to double the secretions from it.
- A downwards arrow means it is tired of the resource and will produce very few secretions.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip2.zhText:
- 无箭头表示它对该资源食欲一般。
- 向上箭头表示它渴望该资源，并且可以从中产生双倍的分泌物。
- 向下箭头表示它已厌倦该资源，并且将从中产生很少的分泌物。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip3.text:
Be mindful of the order in which you feed resources to your Helminth.
Feeding the Helminth a resource it finds very appealing, denoted by the upwards arrow, will improve its appetite for less appealing resources in the same category.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip3.zhText:
请注意给 Helminth 饲喂资源的顺序。
向 Helminth 饲喂它认为可口的资源（表示为向上箭头），将会提高它对同类别中较少吸引力资源的食欲。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip4.text: Infusing an ability into your Warframe will replace one of its original abilities. You can only replace one original ability in each configuration slot.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip4.zhText: 将一种技能注入到你的战甲将会替换其中一个初始技能。你只能在每个配置槽位中替换一个初始技能。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip5.text: Your Helminth can infuse a different ability on each of a Warframe’s configuration slots.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip5.zhText: 你的 Helminth 可以在战甲的每个配置槽中注入不同的技能。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip6.text: The Helminth can subsume a Warframe. This empowers it to infuse one of that Warframe's abilities into other Warframes. Subsumed Warframes become part of the Helminth and can no longer be equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip6.zhText: Helminth 可以吸取一款战甲。这将使它能够把这款战甲的技能注入到其他战甲上。被吸取的战甲将会成为 Helminth 的一部分，并无法再被装备。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip7.text: You can use Augments for abilities you infuse into your Warframes. However, caution is advised. Some Augments require interactions with other abilities or passives, and if these are not present their benefits will not apply.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip7.zhText: 你可以将强化 Mod 使用在你战甲的注入技能上。然而，我们建议请三思后行。有些强化 Mod 需要与其他技能或被动技能相互作用，如果这些技能或被动技能不存在，则无法发挥出强化 Mod 的功效。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip8.text: Helminth will undergo Metamorphosis as it sees use, unlocking new features and unique abilities to infuse onto Warframes. Accelerate this process by feeding Helminth resources, subsuming Warframes and infusing abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip8.zhText: 随着使用，Helminth 将经历蜕变，解锁全新功能和可注入战甲的独特技能。通过给 Helminth 喂食资源、让其吞噬战甲和注入技能来加速这一过程。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip9.text: If you change your mind about an ability infusion, the Helminth can always remove it.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/Helminth_Tip9.zhText: 如果你对某一次的技能注入改变了主意，Helminth 可以随时将其移除。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InfuseFailed.text: Could not infuse ability. Please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InfuseFailed.zhText: 无法注入技能。请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InfuseNoConfig.text: At least one configuration must be selected to infuse the ability into.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InfuseNoConfig.zhText: 至少需要选择一个配置来注入该技能。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationErro.text: Invigoration has already been applied to this Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationErro.zhText: 活化效果已被应用于该战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationErro.text:
This Invigoration has already been consumed.

Each invigoration can only be used once per cycle.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationErro.zhText:
此活化效果已被消耗。

在一个周期内，每个活化效果仅能被使用一次。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationErro.text: Incompatible Warframe, equip |WARFRAME| to apply selected Invigoration.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationErro.zhText: 战甲不兼容，装备 |WARFRAME| 来应用所选的活化效果。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationFail.text: Invigoration failed, your account has not been changed.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationFail.zhText: 活化失败，您的账号没有变化。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationOver.zhText: 用 |WARFRAME| 覆盖选定的活化战甲？
选定的活化效果已经用于 |WARFRAME|。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationTall.text: After 10 Invigorations a mutation allows one of the current Invigorations to be applied to your equipped Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/InvigorationTall.zhText: 在 10 次活化之后，一个突变适性允许将当前活化效果之一应用于你装备的战甲上。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/ModeSwapAbandonC.zhText: 要取消饲喂 Helminth 吗？

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/NoEligibleAppeti.text: Your Helminth is not currently bored of consuming any particular resource.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/NoEligibleAppeti.zhText: 你的 Helminth 目前没有任何厌倦的资源。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankDigestivesDe.text: Feed Sentient resources to the Helminth, to increase its appetite for one resource that it no longer craved.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankDigestivesDe.zhText: 如果 Helminth 厌倦了某种资源，可以把 Sentient 资源饲喂给它，这样可以增加它对这种资源的食欲。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankExtractDesc.text:
Subsume Warframes into the Helminth to allow infusing of one of their abilities into other Warframes.

Also grants 3 subsume slots, which are used when a Warframe is subsumed.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankExtractDesc.zhText:
吸取你的战甲进 Helminth，以此将其技能之一，注入到其它战甲中。

另外还会获得 3 个吸取槽，它会在一个战甲被吸取后消耗掉。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankExtractTitle.zhText: 吸取战甲 + 3 个吸取槽位

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankSlotDesc.text: Slots used to subsume Warframes into the Helminth.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankSlotDesc.zhText: 用来把战甲吸取进 Helminth 的槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankXpGainHint.text: <WARNING> Gain Helminth XP by feeding it resources, infusing abilities, or subsuming Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankXpGainHint.zhText: <WARNING> 通过饲喂资源、注入技能或吸取战甲来获得 Helminth 经验值。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankXpGainHintUn.text: <WARNING> Gain Helminth XP by feeding it resources, infusing abilities, or subsuming Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RankXpGainHintUn.zhText: <WARNING> 通过饲喂资源、注入技能或吸取战甲来获得 Helminth 经验值。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RemoveInfusedCon.text: Are you sure you want to remove the infused ability from all configs?
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RemoveInfusedCon.zhText: 你确定要从所有配置中移除注入的技能吗？

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RemoveInfusedFai.text: Could not remove infused ability. Please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/RemoveInfusedFai.zhText: 无法移除注入的技能。请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionBileDes.text: Helminth is able to digest all manner of miscellaneous substances, but generates a large surplus of bile in order to do so. Fortunately, this bile can be repurposed.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionBileDes.zhText: Helminth 可以消化各种杂物，但会因此而产生过量的消化液。幸运的是，这些消化液可以再次被利用。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionBiotics.text: Plant-based materials of all kinds are processed and liquidized within the Helminth's digestive tract; the surplus is excreted as an inoffensive, inert clump.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionBiotics.zhText: 各种植物类物质会在 Helminth 的消化道内被处理、液化，剩余的残留物则会被以无害惰性块状物的形式排出体外。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionCalxDes.text: On consuming minerals, Helminth converts those it does not fully absorb into a smooth, rich paste with a faint vanilla odor.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionCalxDes.zhText: 在享用矿物质时，Helminth 会把那些未被完全吸收的矿物质转化为光滑浓郁、并带有淡淡香草味的糊状物。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionDesc.text: A resource created and used by the Helminth.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionDesc.zhText: 一种由 Helminth 制造并使用的资源。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionOxidesD.text: Metallic substances, steadily corroded by the Helminth's digestive juices and exuded as a coarse powder.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionOxidesD.zhText: 金属物质，被 Helminth 的消化液不断腐蚀，并以大颗粒粉尘的形式分泌了出来。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionPheromo.text: When Helminth consumes Infested matter it creates greasy intestine-like casings, bloats them with a dark, musky gas and ejects them. The reason for this is unknown and probably best left that way.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionPheromo.zhText: 当 Helminth 享用了感染物质后，它会产生油腻的肠道状外壳，并通过黑色的麝香气体使其膨胀，然后将其喷射出来。这种现象的产生原因不明，可能最好不要去管它。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionSynthet.text: Helminth eagerly consumes artificial materials and exudes these rope-like strands of filament as a useful byproduct.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SecretionSynthet.zhText: Helminth 热衷于享用人造材料，并会分泌出这些绳状的细丝，可被作为一种有用的副产品。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SpecialAbilityDe.text: Feed the Helminth, Subsume Warframes and Infuse abilities to rank the Helminth.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/SpecialAbilityDe.zhText: 饲喂 Helminth，吸取战甲，并注入技能，以此来升级 Helminth。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TeleportToHelmin.text: Cannot teleport to the Helminth room as Operator, switch to Warframe and try again.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TeleportToHelmin.zhText: 无法以指挥官的身份传送到 Helminth 房间，切换成战甲并重试。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TransmuteConfirm.text:
Spend |CURRENCY| to fuse 1 |SHARD1| with 1 |SHARD2| and create 1 |RESULT|?

Archon Shard fusion is permanent. This action cannot be undone. Type '|WORD|' to confirm.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TransmuteConfirm.zhText:
花费 |CURRENCY| 将 1 个|SHARD1|与 1 个|SHARD2|融合成 1 个|RESULT|？

执刑官源力石融合是永久性的。此操作无法撤消。输入"|WORD|"确认此操作。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TransmuteConfirm.text:
Spend |CURRENCY| to fuse 1 |SHARD1| with 1 |SHARD2| and create 1 |RESULT|?

Archon Shard fusion is permanent. This action cannot be undone.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TransmuteConfirm.zhText:
花费 |CURRENCY| 将 1 个|SHARD1|与 1 个|SHARD2|融合成 1 个|RESULT|？

执刑官源力石融合是永久性的。此操作无法撤消。
确定要融合吗？请输入"|WORD|"以进行确认。

/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TransmuteHint.text: <WARNING> Select 2 different Archon Shards to create 1 Coalescent Shard.
/Lotus/Language/Alchemy/TransmuteHint.zhText: <WARNING> 选择 2 个不同颜色的执刑官源力石来创造 1 个联结源力石。

/Lotus/Language/Alerts/ALCounterIntelDes.zhText: 把反情报上传到敌军卫星

/Lotus/Language/Alerts/ALDarvoMobileDefe.text: After provoking the wrong people, the independent 'merchant' Darvo had to go into hiding. Now he needs your help so that he can get his business back on track.
/Lotus/Language/Alerts/ALDarvoMobileDefe.zhText: 惹到不该惹的人后，独立"商人"Darvo 不得不躲起来。现在他需要你的帮助，让他的生意可以重回正轨。

/Lotus/Language/Alerts/ALDarvoRescueDesc.text:
Tenno,

It seems I am again in a bit of trouble. Wait, before you go jumping to conclusions, I swear, this time it is not my fault. I used to belong to this organization, the problem is this organization has refused to accept my resignation. I guess certain people cannot live without my skills. This is understandable as I am very good at what I do. I just prefer to work without a plasma turret pointed at my head. I am sure you understand.

Now, I know what you are thinking. The last time you helped me you got a little more than you bargained for. Things worked out in the end though, right? Help me again and I will make it worth your while. Trust me.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Alerts/ALDarvoRescueDesc.zhText:
Tenno，

看来我又有点小麻烦了。等一下，在你过早下结论之前，我发誓，这次不是我的错。我之前属于一个组织，问题是这个组织拒绝接受我的辞呈。我猜有的人没有我的技能就不能生活。这是可以理解的因为我很擅长我所做的事情。我只是不喜欢有等离子炮对着我的头工作。我肯定你明白我的意思。

现在，我知道你在想什么。上次你帮我虽然比预计的复杂一点。但是事情最后还是解决了，对吧？再帮我一次，我一定让你觉得值得。相信我。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Alerts/ALDefenseDesc11Lo.text: A rare artifact has been ambushed in transit. Keep it out of enemy hands.

/Lotus/Language/Alerts/ALDefenseDesc4.zhText: 在传输期间防守数据核心

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_0.text: Break Down a Ranked Arcane to return all of the Unranked Arcanes that were used to rank it back into your inventory.
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_0.zhText: 分解一个升级过的赋能会将升级该赋能的过程中消耗的所有无等级赋能返还到你的仓库里。

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_1.text: Arcanes that can trigger again while the Arcane effect is active are indicated in the Arcane Manager screen with <ARCANE_CAN_REPROC> "Duration Can Refresh".
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_1.zhText: 那些在激活的时候能再次触发的赋能会在赋能管理页面中用<ARCANE_CAN_REPROC>"持续时间可以刷新"表示出来。

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_2.text: Earn two additional Revives for missions by equipping two Rank 3 Arcanes onto your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_2.zhText: 通过在战甲上装备两个 3 级赋能来在任务中获得两次额外的复活机会。

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_3.text: Warframe Arcanes are earned by killing or capturing Eidolon Teralysts, Gantulyst, and Hydrolysts in the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at Night. Capturing increases the chance for Uncommon and Rare Arcanes to drop.
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_3.zhText: 战甲赋能可以通过在夜晚击杀或是捕获地球夜灵平野上的夜灵兆力使、巨力使以及水力使获得。捕获这些敌人将提升罕见和稀有赋能的掉落几率。

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_4.text: Specific Warframe Arcanes can also be earned exclusively through Arbitrations as potential Round Rewards.
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_4.zhText: 一些特定的战甲赋能也可以从仲裁任务中作为潜在的专属轮次奖励获得。

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_5.text: Operator (Magus) and Amp (Virtuous) Arcanes can be purchased from Quill Onkko in Cetus and Little Duck in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_5.zhText: 可以从希图斯的夜羽昂克处和福尔图娜的小鸭子处购买指挥官的魔导赋能和增幅器的正直赋能。

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_6.text: Modular Weapon (Exodia) Arcanes can be purchased from Hok in Cetus using your Ostron standing once you have reached the Kin Rank.
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_6.zhText: 可以使用 Ostron 声望值从希图斯的霍刻处购买 Zaw 的神威赋能。声望需要达到情同手足等级。

/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_7.text: Kitgun (Pax) Arcanes can be purchased from Rude Zuud in Fortuna using your Solaris United standing once you have reached the Old Mate Rank.
/Lotus/Language/ArcaneHints/Arcanes_7.zhText: 可以使用索拉里斯联盟声望值从福尔图娜的粗鲁的祖德处购买组合枪的和平赋能。声望需要达到老朋友等级。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityCastSpeed.text: Every kill with elemental ammo has a chance to grant improved casting speed and no energy cost on next cast.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityCastSpeed.zhText: 使用元素弹药击杀敌人有几率提高下次施放速度，并且下次施放无需消耗能量。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityCastSpeed.text: Kills with elemental ammo have |CHANCE|% chance to grant |CAST_BUFF|% casting speed and no Energy cost on next cast.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityCastSpeed.zhText: 使用元素弹药击杀敌人有 |CHANCE|% 的几率获得 |CAST_BUFF|% 的施放速度加成，并且下次施放无需消耗能量。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityEfficienc.text: On object creation with abilities, Ability Efficiency is locked for a set duration.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityEfficienc.zhText: 使用技能生成物体时，技能效率会在持续时间内被锁定。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityEfficienc.text: On creating an object with abilities: casts have |STAT|% Ability Efficiency for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityEfficienc.zhText: 通过技能创造物体时：施放的技能效率为 |STAT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。
为非连续技能提供技能效率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityEfficienc.text:
Gain |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency.
On Ability Cast: |MULTIPLIER|x that Ability Efficiency for your other abilities within |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityEfficienc.zhText:
获得 |EFFICIENCY|% 技能效率。
施放技能时：在接下来的 |DURATION| 秒内，你的其他技能获得该技能效率的 |MULTIPLIER| 倍。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityHeatProcs.text: <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status effects inflicted by Abilities give Weapon Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityHeatProcs.zhText: 技能造成的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态会增加武器暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityHeatProcs.text: Gain |STAT|% weapon Critical Chance for |DURATION|s, when using abilities to inflict <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status effect on enemies. Maximum |MAX_STACKS|x stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityHeatProcs.zhText: 使用技能对敌人造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态时，获得 |STAT|% 武器暴击几率，持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多叠加 |MAX_STACKS| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityPowerOnFr.text: |CONDITION|: Gain |BONUS1| and |BONUS2| for |DURATION|s. Stacks up to |STACKS|x.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityPowerOnFr.zhText: |CONDITION|：获得 |BONUS1| 和 |BONUS2|，持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多叠加到 |STACKS| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityRadiation.text: Each <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Effect inflicted on enemies by Abilities gives a |FREQ|% chance to drop a Universal Orb on enemy death.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityRadiation.zhText: 通过技能对敌人造成的每层 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态会使其在死亡时有 |FREQ|% 的几率掉落一个通用补给球。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityStrengthO.text: On Ability Cast: Next Ability cast gains +|BONUS|% Ability Strength, stacking up to |MAX_STACKS|x. Resets when the same ability is recast consecutively.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AbilityStrengthO.zhText: 施放技能时：下一次施放的技能获得 +|BONUS|% 技能强度，最多叠加 |MAX_STACKS| 层。连续施放相同技能时重置。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AmmoEfficiencyOn.text: While sliding or aim gliding: Gain |AMMO_EFFICIENCY|% ammo efficiency with Dual Pistols.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AmmoEfficiencyOn.zhText: 滑行或处于飞身瞄准时：使用双持手枪获得 |AMMO_EFFICIENCY|% 的弹药效率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ArmourOnOperator.text: Transferring out of a Warframe grants the Operator additional Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ArmourOnOperator.zhText: 传出战甲将使指挥官获得额外的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AttackSpeedOnKil.text: Kills have a chance to increase Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/AttackSpeedOnKil.zhText: 击杀有一定几率增加射速。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BlastOnKnockDesc.text: |CHANCE|% chance to apply |STACKS_NUM| stacks of Blast Damage to foes knocked down by Melee Attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BlastOnKnockDesc.zhText: |CHANCE|% 几率对被近战攻击击倒的敌人施加 |STACKS_NUM| 层爆炸伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BonusDamageNextS.text: On Ability Cast: Next shot gains a Damage Multiplier for every |ENERGY_TO_GET_1X| current Energy, up to x|BONUS_LIMIT|.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BonusDamageNextS.zhText: 施放技能时：当前每拥有 |ENERGY_TO_GET_1X| 能量，下一次射击伤害增加 1 倍，最高可达 |BONUS_LIMIT| 倍。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BulletToBatteryD.text: Kitgun Magazine is replaced by bolts fueled by a recharging battery.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BulletToBatteryD.zhText: 将组合枪的弹匣替换为射钉，由可充电的电池驱动。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BulletToBatteryS.text: Battery Recharge Delay is reduced by |val|%

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BurningCystOnKil.text: spawn volatile hives for |DURATION|s that explode when enemies approach for |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in |RANGE|m. Standing in the area applies <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage type to Theorem Arcanes.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/BurningCystOnKil.zhText: 生成不稳定的巢囊，持续 |DURATION| 秒，在敌人靠近时，巢囊爆炸，并在 |RANGE| 米内造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。站在该区域内会对定理赋能施加 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ChannelKillAttac.text: Increases Energy Rate on Melee Channel Kills.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ChannelKillAttac.zhText: 近战引导时击杀会提升能量速率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CompanionDamageO.text: Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane increases damage of companions and summoned allies within |RANGE|m by |DAMAGE|%/s stacking up to |AMOUNT|x. Effect persists for |DURATION|s upon leaving the zone.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CompanionDamageO.zhText: 站在残差赋能产生的区域内时，每秒可为 |RANGE| 米范围内的同伴和召唤的友军提高 |DAMAGE|% 的伤害，最多叠加到 |AMOUNT| 层。离开此区域后，该效果会持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ConvergeRadialAt.text: While aiming with this weapon, reduce the explosion radius of the attack and gain increased damage and ammo efficiency for every 1m lost.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ConvergeRadialAt.zhText: 瞄准时，每减少 1 米的攻击爆炸范围，即可增加伤害和弹药效率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ConvergeRadialAt.text: On aim: x|RADIUS| explosion radius, +|STAT1|% damage and +|STAT2|% ammo efficiency for every 1m radius lost.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ConvergeRadialAt.zhText: 瞄准时：爆炸范围为 |RADIUS| 倍，且每缩小 1 米范围，增加 |STAT1|% 伤害与 |STAT2|% 弹药效率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CorrosiveMeleePe.text: |CONDITION|: Gain |DAMAGE_PERCENT|% Corrosive Damage on Melee strikes for |DURATION|s. Stacks up to |BUFF_CAP|%.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CorrosiveMeleePe.zhText: |CONDITION|：近战攻击获得 |DAMAGE_PERCENT|% 腐蚀伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多叠加到 |BUFF_CAP|% 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CritChancePerAll.text: While Buffing Ally Warframes: +|VALUE|% Critical Chance per buff
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CritChancePerAll.zhText: 为友军战甲提供增益时：每个增益 +|VALUE|% 暴击率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CritSlamDamageDe.text: Critical Hits have a chance to increase Melee Channeling Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CritSlamDamageDe.zhText: 暴击会有几率提升近战引导伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CriticalChanceFo.text: On swapping to Secondary Weapon, consume all Combo Multipliers to increase Secondary Weapon Critical Chance and Critical Damage by |STAT_VALUE|% per Combo consumed for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CriticalChanceFo.zhText: 切换到次要武器时消耗所有连击倍率，每层消耗的连击倍率增加 |STAT_VALUE|% 的次要武器暴击几率和暴击伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CriticalChanceOn.text: Headshots have a chance to increase Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/CriticalChanceOn.zhText: 爆头有一定几率增加暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DamageForBonusAr.text: Gain damage based on how much armor you have.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DamageForBonusAr.zhText: 根据你的护甲值获得相应的伤害加成。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DamageForBonusAr.text: Gain +|GIVE_STAT|% damage for each unit of armor past |HAVE_STAT_MIN|, up to a max of +|GIVE_STAT_MAX|%.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DamageForBonusAr.zhText: 超过 |HAVE_STAT_MIN| 护甲值的每一点护甲，增加 |GIVE_STAT|% 伤害，最高可增加 |GIVE_STAT_MAX|%。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DamageReductionO.text: Generate Void Particles every |DELAY|s up to |COUNT| particles, each granting |AMOUNT|% Damage Reduction for |DURATION|s. Taking damage consumes a particle.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DamageReductionO.zhText: 每 |DELAY| 秒生成一颗虚空粒子，至多 |COUNT| 颗。每颗粒子可获得 |AMOUNT|% 伤害减免并持续 |DURATION|秒。受到伤害时消耗一颗粒子。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DuplicateStatusD.text: Enemies affected by Status Effects gain |duplicate_num| additional stacks when they're knocked down or flung by melee attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/DuplicateStatusD.zhText: 受到异常状态影响的敌人在被近战攻击击倒或击飞时，增加 |duplicate_num| 层额外异常状态层数。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/EnergyEfficiency.text: Headshots increase Ability Efficiency and Ability Strength for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/EnergyEfficiency.zhText: 爆头会在有限时间内增加技能效率和技能强度。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/EnergyOnVoidDash.text: Restore |AMOUNT| additional Void Energy with each enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/EnergyOnVoidDash.zhText: 每击中一名敌人恢复 |AMOUNT| 额外虚空能量。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/EyeInTheSkyDesc.text: Reduces Movement Speed, increases Accuracy and Reduces Recoil when Aim Gliding.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/EyeInTheSkyDesc.zhText: 减少飞身瞄准时的速度，增加准确度并降低后坐力。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/FinisherLifestea.text: Finishers have a chance to grant lifesteal.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/FinisherLifestea.zhText: 处决攻击有一定几率造成生命窃取。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/FreezeEnemiesOnR.text: x|DAMAGE| Melee Damage against Frozen enemies. On Roll: <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Freeze enemies in a |RADIUS|m radius with a |COOLDOWN|s Cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/FreezeEnemiesOnR.zhText: 对被冰冻的敌人造成近战伤害 x|DAMAGE|。翻滚时：<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻 |RADIUS| 米范围内的敌人，冷却时间为 |COOLDOWN| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/GroundSlamChanne.text: Status Effects have a chance to increase Melee Channeling Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/GroundSlamChanne.zhText: 造成异常状态会有几率提升近战引导伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/GroundSlamPullDe.text: Ground Slam attacks have a chance to pull in nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/GroundSlamPullDe.zhText: 震地攻击有一定几率拉近附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealAlliesOnEner.text: Heal yourself and allies within Affinity Range |VALUE| Health for each Energy point spent on the initial casting cost of abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealAlliesOnEner.zhText: 施放技能直接消耗的每 1 点能量，可为自身和经验共享范围内的友军恢复 |VALUE| 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealOnTransferen.text: Transferring into a Warframe has a chance to restore health to it.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealOnTransferen.zhText: 传入战甲有一定几率恢复其生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealOnTransferen.text: Transferring out of a Warframe restores health to it over time.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealOnTransferen.zhText: 传出战甲将逐渐恢复其生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealOnVoidDashDe.text: Void Sling has a chance to restore health.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealOnVoidDashDe.zhText: 「虚空弹射」有一定几率恢复生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealOnVoidModeDe.zhText: 治疗 |RANGE| 米内的战甲生命值，每秒恢复 |AMOUNT|% 。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealthOnOperator.text: Transferring out of a Warframe grants the Operator additional Health.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealthOnOperator.zhText: 传出战甲将使指挥官获得额外的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealthWhileUsing.text: Gain +|BONUS| Max Health per active channeled ability.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HealthWhileUsing.zhText: 每个激活的导引技能提供 +|BONUS| 最大生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HeatDamageOnDash.text: Increase <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Operator Mode by |AMOUNT|% for |DURATION|s, stacking up to |COUNT|x.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HeatDamageOnDash.zhText: 指挥官模式时增加 |AMOUNT|% <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒，至多叠加至 |COUNT| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HeatResistOnBlas.text: Reduce Enemy Resistance to <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage by |AMOUNT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HeatResistOnBlas.zhText: 敌人的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害抗性减少 |AMOUNT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HeavyCritOnRegul.text: On Melee Hit: Gain |CRIT_CHANCE_PER_HIT|% Critical Chance on your next Heavy Attack, up to |CRIT_CHANCE_LIMIT|%
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HeavyCritOnRegul.zhText: 近战命中时：下一次重击获得 |CRIT_CHANCE_PER_HIT|% 暴击几率，最多获得 |CRIT_CHANCE_LIMIT|% 暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/HoverboardSpeedO.zhText: 提升 K 式悬浮板 |AMOUNT|% 速度，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/IceMistOnKillDes.text: create a frigid mist for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage/s. Standing in the area applies <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage to Theorem Arcanes.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/IceMistOnKillDes.zhText: 制造一片持续时间为 |DURATION| 秒的寒雾，每秒造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。站在该区域内会对定理赋能施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ImmunityFallDama.text: Void Sling has a chance to grant immunity to falling damage.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ImmunityFallDama.zhText: 「虚空弹射」有一定几率给予免疫坠落伤害效果。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/IncreasedCritica.text: Critical Hits have a chance to increase Critical Damage Multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/IncreasedCritica.zhText: 暴击有一定几率增加暴击伤害倍率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/IncreasedDamageO.text: Status Effects have a chance to increase damage.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/IncreasedDamageO.zhText: 异常状态有一定几率增加伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/InvulnerabilityO.text: Mercy Kills grant a stack of Escapist. On taking fatal damage, consume Escapist stacks to avoid death and become invulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/InvulnerabilityO.zhText: 怜悯之击即击杀可获得一层逃脱效果。受到致命伤害时，消耗逃脱效果叠层以变得无敌。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/InvulnerabilityO.text: On Mercy Kill: Gain a stack of Escapist, up to |MAX_STACKS|x. On taking fatal damage, consume |CONSUME_STACKS| stacks to avoid death and become invulnerable for |DURATION|s.

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/LightningStrikeO.text: spawn an electrified spike for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to enemies within |RANGE|m. Standing in the area applies <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to Theorem Arcanes.

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MaxDPSTakenForAr.text: If Armor is above the threshold, Health cannot be reduced by more than a fixed amount. All Shields are removed.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MaxDPSTakenForAr.zhText: 如果护甲值高于护甲阈值，生命值受到的伤害不会超过固定值。所有护盾都会被移除。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MaxDPSTakenForAr.text: Remove all Shields. If Armor is above |ARMOUR_MIN|: Cannot be hit for more than |DPS_CAP| Damage/s. Magnetic Status and Ability Nullifying Effects disable this protection.

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MaxEnergyForArmo.text: Gain |STAT_INCREASE| maximum Energy per Armor point, up to 1000 Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MaxEnergyForArmo.zhText: 每点护甲可获得 |STAT_INCREASE| 最大能量，最高可达 1000 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MeleeArcaneProje.text: after a Bullet Jump or Double Jump, air melee attacks unleash a projectile of Infested Energy that explodes on impact.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MeleeArcaneProje.zhText: 在旋身飞跃或二段跳后，空中近战攻击会释放出一道在碰撞时爆炸的感染能量。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MeleeArcaneShock.text: Slam Attacks after a Bullet Jump or Double Jump unleashes a shockwave of Infested Energy suspending enemies caught in the blast radius.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MeleeArcaneShock.zhText: 在旋身飞跃或二段跳后，震地攻击会释放出一道感染能量冲击波，使爆炸范围内的敌人悬停。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MeleeDamageForAc.text: Gain |DAMAGE_PERCENT|% Melee Damage for every |SHIELD_NUM| current Shields, up to |DAMAGE_PERCENT_LIMIT|%. Bonus halved for Overshields.

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MeleeProcsSpread.text: On Melee <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status: |CHANCE|% chance for elemental Melee Status Effects to apply to enemies within |range|m for |DURATION|s. Cannot refresh while active.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MeleeProcsSpread.zhText: 近战造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态时：有 |CHANCE|% 几率使 |DURATION| 秒内近战攻击触发的元素异常状态施加于 |range| 米内的敌人上。效果激活时无法刷新。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MultishotForMaxE.text: While at or above the energy threshold, gain a percentage of your max energy as multishot.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MultishotForMaxE.zhText: 当能量达到或超过阈值时，获得相当于最大能量百分比的多重射击。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MultishotForMaxE.text: While at or above |HAVE_STAT_MIN|% Energy: Gain |GIVE_STAT|% of Max Energy as Multishot, capped at |GIVE_STAT_CAP|%.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/MultishotForMaxE.zhText: 当能量值达到或超过 |HAVE_STAT_MIN|% 时：获得最大能量值的 |GIVE_STAT|% 作为多重射击，上限为 |GIVE_STAT_CAP|%。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/NoPenaltyOnDeath.zhText: 有 |CHANCE|% 几率避免传识干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OnOverguardBreak.text: On Breaking Eximus Overguard: Increase Headshot Damage by |VALUE|% for each squad member in Affinity Range for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OnOverguardBreak.zhText: 击破卓越者超宏防护时：为经验共享范围内的小队成员增加 |VALUE|% 爆头伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OperatorAmmoRege.text: Kills have a chance to increase Operator Energy Regeneration for Amps and Void Beam.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OperatorAmmoRege.zhText: 击杀有一定几率增加指挥官的增幅器和虚空射线的能量恢复速率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OperatorEnergyOn.text: WHILE IN VOID SLING: Press <PRE_ATTACK> to dissipate the endpoint in a |RADIUS|m radius. Enemies hit create a short lived Void Mote that replenishes |ENERGY| Energy on pick up.

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OperatorHeavyMel.text: On Warframe Melee Transference: Heavy Blades deal +|CRIT_BONUS|% Critical Damage for |NUM_ATTACKS| consecutive attacks. Cooldown |COOLDOWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OperatorHeavyMel.zhText: 向战甲近战传识时：巨刃的后续 |NUM_ATTACKS| 次攻击获得 +|CRIT_BONUS|% 暴击伤害。冷却时间 |COOLDOWN| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OverguardDamageD.zhText: 对超宏防护造成 |val| 额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OverguardStealDe.text: Gain 1 Overguard for every 100 Damage dealt to an enemy's Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/OverguardStealDe.zhText: 每对敌人的超宏防护造成 100 伤害，便获得 1 超宏防护。
