/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/PullEnemiesOnMel.text: Kill an enemy affected by <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Status for a |SPAWN_CHANCE|% chance to pull in enemies within |RANGE|m radius
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/PullEnemiesOnMel.zhText: 击杀受到 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力异常状态影响的敌人时有 |SPAWN_CHANCE|% 几率将半径 |RANGE| 米内的敌人拉近。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/PullOnTransferen.text: Enemies within |DISTANCE|m are pulled towards Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/PullOnTransferen.zhText: 距离 |DISTANCE| 米内的敌人被拉向战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/RadialDamageOnMa.text: On hitting enemies afflicted by |STACKS| stacks of <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation: Deal |DAMAGE|% of the hit damage to enemies within |RADIUS|m.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/RadialDamageOnMa.zhText: 命中受到 |STACKS| 层 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射影响的敌人时：对 |RADIUS| 米范围内的敌人造成 |DAMAGE|% 的命中伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ReplayLightCritH.text: On Base Critical Hits: |CHANCE|% chance for your attack to strike a second time
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ReplayLightCritH.zhText: 基础暴击命中时：有 |CHANCE|% 几率施加第二次攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ReverseOnDashDes.text: Use again within |DURATION|s, to return the Operator to their original position at no energy cost. Restores |AMOUNT| Health. |COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ReverseOnDashDes.zhText: 在 |DURATION| 秒内再次使用来不消耗能量的将指挥官传回原先的位置。恢复 |AMOUNT| 生命值。|COOLDOWN| 秒冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/RobotStunOnBlast.text: Stun robotic enemies for |DURATION|s, which then discharge <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage dealing |HEALTH|% of their Max Health to anyone within |DISTANCE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/RobotStunOnBlast.zhText: 晕眩机器类敌人 |DURATION| 秒，接着依照各机器类敌人最大生命值的 |HEALTH|% 对 |DISTANCE| 米内的敌人造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/SeekerProjOnHead.text: |NUM| projectiles burst from the target and seek the heads of nearby enemies.

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ShieldMaxForAbil.zhText: 技能强度提升护盾最大值。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ShieldMaxForAbil.text: |GIVE_STAT|% of Ability Strength modifiers are also applied to Max Shields.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ShieldMaxForAbil.zhText: |GIVE_STAT|% 的技能强度调整值也会应用于最大护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/SpeedOnVoidDashD.text: Void Sling has a chance to increase Sprint Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/SpeedOnVoidDashD.zhText: 「虚空弹射」有一定几率增加冲刺速度。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/SplitStatusProcs.text: If an enemy has |STACKS| stacks of a combined Status Effect, inflicting the same Status Effect again has a |CHANCE|% chance to inflict one of the base Status Effects it is composed of.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/SplitStatusProcs.zhText: 如果敌人身上叠加了 |STACKS| 层复合异常状态，再次造成相同的异常状态有 |CHANCE|% 的几率施加组成该异常状态的基础异常状态之一。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/StatusChanceOnHe.text: Headshots have a chance to increase Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/StatusChanceOnHe.zhText: 爆头有一定几率增加触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/StatusProjectile.text: Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane creates a globe that orbits the player every |TICK|s. Globes will persist for |DURATION|s upon leaving the zone.

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/TetherMineOnDash.text: Drop a mine that tethers up to |COUNT| enemies in |RANGE|m for |DELAY|s.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/TetherMineOnDash.zhText: 扔下一枚地雷，能在 |RANGE| 米范围内最多束缚 |COUNT| 个敌人，持续 |DELAY| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ToxicBloodOnKill.text: create pool of toxic blood for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage/s. Standing in the area applies the <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage to Theorem Arcanes.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/ToxicBloodOnKill.zhText: 制造持续时间为 |DURATION| 秒的毒性血池，每秒造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。站在该区域内会对定理赋能施加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/VoidToElectricDa.zhText: 将 |NUM|% <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害转换成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/VoidToHeatDamage.zhText: 将 |NUM|% <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害转换成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/VoidToPunctureDa.zhText: 将 |NUM|% <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害转换成 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/VoidToViralDamag.zhText: 将 |NUM|% <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害转换成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/WeaponDamageOnRe.text: Standing in a zone created by a Residual Arcane increases weapon damage by |DAMAGE|%/s stacking up to |AMOUNT|x. Effect persists for |DURATION|s upon leaving the zone.
/Lotus/Language/Arcanes/WeaponDamageOnRe.zhText: 站在残差赋能产生的区域内时，武器伤害每秒提高 |DAMAGE|%，最多叠加到 |AMOUNT| 层。离开此区域后，该效果会持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.text: Advanced Movement
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.zhText: 进阶移动技巧

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.text:
MOBILITY IS A WEAPON

Become airborne with <JUMP> to open up new attack possibilities. You can aim and fire your weapons while in the air!

Press <JUMP> twice to execute a Double Jump to reach new heights.

Mobility opens up new melee combos. Tap <MELEE> after jumping to perform an aerial attack.

Aim down and tap <MELEE> after jumping to perform a ground slam.

Advanced lateral dodges can be done while aiming and tapping {DODGE_CONTROLS} to dodge in the direction of your movement.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.zhText:
机动性即为武器

使用 <JUMP> 跃向空中获得新的攻击手段。你可以在空中朝敌人瞄准及开火！

在空中时可以按下 <JUMP> 进行二段跳以提升高度

空中机动性也使近战有了新的攻击方式。跳起后轻按 <MELEE> 施展空中挥砍。

跳起后在空中视角朝下并轻按 <MELEE> 来施展震地攻击。

进阶的侧身闪躲动作，可在瞄准同时轻按 {DODGE_CONTROLS} 来朝你的移动方向进行闪躲。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.text:
ATTACK FROM EVERY ANGLE

Crouch with <PRE_CROUCH>

To slide - sprint for a moment with <MOVE_Z_UP>, then release and hold <PRE_CROUCH>

You are harder to hit from this angle and still free to attack with your weapons!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.zhText:
从任何角度发动攻击

使用 <PRE_CROUCH> 蹲下

滑行——按下 <MOVE_Z_UP> 冲刺一小段时间后，放开冲刺并按住 <PRE_CROUCH>

滑行会降低敌人命中你的几率，而你仍可以使用你的武器进行攻击！

VERTICAL TRAVERSAL

Execute a Bullet Jump by crouching or sliding and tapping <JUMP>

Slow your fall during a jump by holding <AIM_WEAPON> to trigger an Aim Glide. Lay down a barrage of gun fire while you are leaping!

All of your movement states allow unrestricted freedom to flow into a full attack. An experienced Tenno can run, slide, leap and ground strike in a single, fluid motion.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.zhText:
垂直飞越

在蹲下或滑行时轻按 <JUMP> 来使出「旋身飞跃」

所有动作状态中皆可不受限制进行攻击，经验丰富的 Tenno 可以轻易地一次完成奔跑、滑行并翻身跃起的流畅动作。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.text:
DEFY GRAVITY

Tenno can use walls to traverse the combat space.

To initiate a Wall Dash, <JUMP> into a wall or vertical surface and continue tapping <JUMP> to keep dashing.

Tenno can latch onto a wall by executing a Wall Latch maneuver. To perform this jump into a wall and hold <AIM_WEAPON>.

To disengage and leap from the wall, simply press <JUMP>
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.zhText:
抛开地心引力

Tenno 能利用壁面来飞越战场。

要进行壁面蹬冲，需向着墙壁 <JUMP> 或与壁面垂直并不断轻按 <JUMP> 来持续蹬墙。

Tenno 能以「壁面攀附」动作来停在墙上，跳到墙上并按住 <AIM_WEAPON> 就能顺利攀附。

要解除攀附或跳开，只需按下 <JUMP>

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.text:
TRAIN IN THE WAY

A Tenno Master can run along the wall, unload a barrage of bullets onto an unsuspecting patrol and slice the last enemy in half with his blade.

Try this Wall Dash melee combo:

Wall Dash along a wall (Tap <JUMP>).

Aim at target. 

Tap <MELEE> to leap from the wall and strike!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AdvancedTraining.zhText:
正确的训练

一名 Tenno 大师能飞檐走壁、朝着毫无警觉的巡逻兵洒下一片弹幕，并以他的刀刃将最后一名斩成两段。

试试看这套壁面蹬冲与近战的组合：

沿着墙使出「壁面蹬冲」（轻按 <JUMP>）。

瞄准目标。

轻按 <MELEE> ，从墙上跃下进行突击！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AridFearBody.text:
RE: Secret Grineer Colony.

How do we hide it? The Tenno, with their eyeless slag, will squeeze it from our Scouts! They already know our methods from their Capture missions. Data-viruses distributed among our flock will not hold them off. Hiding the Grineer base and collecting our fees requires escalation.

My plan is simple. Gather our Scouts and Navigators and launch them in to the Void. This has two benefits: the Betrayers will be hard-pressed to assemble the coordinate data and if they do, they will place themselves at great risk aboard a conventional craft within the Void's storm.

If the board approves I will divide our flock into three groups and begin. It pains me to help the Dogs in this way, but as always, profit numbs the feeling.

Alad V
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AridFearBody.zhText:
RE：秘密 Grineer 殖民地

我们怎样藏起它呢？ Tenno 靠着他们那些瞎眼的人渣从我们的斥候拷问出来。他们早已在捕获任务中知道我们的手法。在我们部队中分发的资料病毒阻挡不了他们。藏起 Grineer 基地并收取我们的服务费再向上汇报。

我的计划很简单：集合斥候和导航，把它们发射进虚空里。好处有二：叛徒们要大费周章地组合坐标资料，而且如果他们这样做，他们在虚空风暴里搭乘传统太空船会置身在高风险中。

如果议会批准，我会把部队分为三组并行动。要帮那些狗实在令我痛苦，但是利益压住了这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AridFearComplete.text:
MY QUEENS -

They found us. Why did the Corpus think they could hide in the Void? Despite their heritage they seem blind to the Tenno's connection to that place. I know you are sour on mysticism but I'm beginning to turn my view on it.

Every time we tear a Tenno corpse from its metal womb we find nothing to explain their power. Our Warframe engineers gesture wildly about nanotechnology, how reactive dissolution hides the answers. What if a Warframe is merely a lightning rod? A conduit for these demons of the Void? Consider how it could change our plan.

For now I await the Tenno's invasion of our Settlements. I have brought with me some reinforcements and your messages of encouragement to rile up the troops.

VOR
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AridFearComplete.zhText:
我的女皇们 -

他们发现我们了。Corpus 怎么会以为他们能躲藏在虚空之中？尽管他们总是对于那里与 Tenno 之间的关联性视而不见。我知道您已对于这些超自然的事情感到厌烦，但我现在得表达出我的观点。

每当我们将 Tenno 从他们的冷冻舱中找出并摧毁，我们仍无法解释出他们的力量为何。我们的战甲工程师们疯狂的广泛研究纳米技术，为了解出隐藏于其后的答案是什么。如果战甲仅仅只是一种避雷针呢？一种将虚空里的恶魔引导至此的管道？请您深思一下这会给我们的计划带来何种改变。

现在，我在等待 Tenno 入侵我们的殖民地。我带来了一些增援部队，以及您的鼓舞信息来振奋军心。

沃尔

/Lotus/Language/Archive/AridFearEscalati.text: We've decoded a segment - we are zeroing in on the Grineer Settlement. The Corpus are anxious to preserve their contract with the Grineer - they have dispatched new tools to the next segment of Capture targets...
/Lotus/Language/Archive/AridFearEscalati.zhText: 我们已完成部分信息译码 - 我们在 Grineer 驻扎地上信用破产了。Corpus 正急于能与 Grineer 保持合约关系 - 他们已经将新的工具派给下一位捕获目标的所在端点…

/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt3.text:
KNOW YOUR BLADE

Tap <MELEE> to seamlessly integrate melee strikes into combat.

Tenno can tap <MELEE> while running, jumping, and sliding to perform a variety of devastating attacks.  

When a stance mod is applied to a weapon, a variety of deadly melee combos become available.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt3.zhText:
通晓刀剑之道

轻按 <MELEE> 让近战攻击无缝融入战斗中。

Tenno 可以在奔跑、跳跃与滑行时轻按 <MELEE> 来使出各种毁灭性的攻击。

在武器上装备架式 Mod，更能施展各种致命的连击。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt4.text:
MASTER THE SHADOWS

If an enemy is unaware of you, you will see a Stealth Attack prompt for increased damage.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt4.zhText:
精通暗袭

从后方接近敌人时，若没有被敌人察觉，你会看到一个可以进行潜行攻击提示，以此造成大量伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt5.text:

/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt6.text:
GATHER YOUR RESOURCES

During missions you will collect a variety of resources. Some, like ammunition, are used only during the mission. Others, like resources, are used to expand your arsenal using the Foundry.

Supplemental gear, like healing kits, can be equipped in the Arsenal. Hold {MINI_INVENTORY} to activate gear during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt6.zhText:
搜集资源

在任务中你将搜集到各种资源：弹药类只限于任务中使用；其它资源则能用于飞船上的铸造厂以扩展你的军械库。

辅助物品类如医疗套件，可以在军械库中装备，在任务期间按住 {MINI_INVENTORY} 激活道具盘来使用物品。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt7.text:
SEEK MASTERY

Your Warframe and Weapons all gain Affinity and rise in Rank when you use them. This increases their capacity for more powerful upgrades and ultimately brings a Tenno increased Mastery.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/BasicTrainingPt7.zhText:
精益求精

随着使用，你的战甲及武器将会提升等级，获得更多的 Mod 容量空间来为其装备更加强大的 Mod，并获得「精通段位经验」。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/CivilianRaidedDi.text:
736.173

Distress Transmission Log

"Come in, come in. Can anyone hear me?... This is Lord Vetmar. The Royal Trade Convoy has been attacked. It's the Grineer. I don't know how this is possible but it's the damn Grineer. They're attacking us with our own ships. The Rodin is firing on us. If you hear this you must warn the Earth Colonies. They've boarded the flagship but the bridge is still secure, can't say for how long... is anybody getting this? Hello? What was that. They're breaching. Get on the ..." [transmission ended]
/Lotus/Language/Archive/CivilianRaidedDi.zhText:
736.173

遇难通讯记录

"呼叫，呼叫，有人听到我的声音吗？这里是 Lord Vetmar。皇家贸易运输舰遭受到 Grineer 的攻击，我不知道这一切怎么发生的，这该死的Grineer！他们用我们的船攻击我们，Rodin 正对我们射击。如果你听到，一定要向地球殖民地发出警告。他们已登入旗舰，但舰桥还健在，不知道能持续多久……有任何人收到这讯号嘛？哈啰？那是什么！他们突破了！快登上……"[通讯结束]

/Lotus/Language/Archive/CivilianRaidedRe.text:
736.015

The Grineer are nothing but junk raiders. How is it possible that they were able to overtake an entire freighter convoy. I've dealt with these Grineer before. Little more than scavengers, subsisting off the space junk that happens to float by their decrepit colonies. They do not have the soldiers or the ships to take out a freighter like the Rodin. At most they've been able to pull off small raids on broken down merchant vessels. No, this was not the work of the Grineer. Which one of those treacherous outer colonies has conspired against us this time?
I need answers as soon as possible. The upcoming trade mission to the Martian colonies must go smoothly.

Lord Vetmar
/Lotus/Language/Archive/CivilianRaidedRe.zhText:
736.015

Grineer不过就是一堆破烂突击兵，怎么可能压制住整个运输舰队，我曾经怀疑这些Grineer，不过就是些拾荒者，他们的旧殖民地依靠太空垃圾维持生活，并没有足够的士兵或船只去占领我们的舰队像是Rodin，顶多只能靠小型突击部队伏击商船，不对，这并不是Grineer的行为模式，还是哪个殖民地在这时间密谋背叛我们？
我需要尽快找到答案，即将要出发的火星殖民地交易舰队必须要顺利进行。

Lord Vetmar

/Lotus/Language/Archive/CivilianRaidedSu.text:
736.012

Survivor account: Rodin Freighter 

They struck during the night cycle. I woke to hear the massive thunder of one of their anchor mines tearing into our hull, then screaming. They tore through our security like they weren't there. Every one of them as big as the biggest man I've ever seen. I never seen anything like it.

Those of us who survived the initial strike were captured and taken to the loading bay. We thought maybe they'll hold us here for ransom. We were so naive. That's when he came in. They said his name was Captain Vor, he was even bigger than the others and even they seemed to fear him. For reasons I will never know, he picked me out of the crowd. I was taken to the command room and told to watch. I wasn't prepared for what came next.

They just opened the external bay doors. Everyone single one of those people, hundreds of men, women and children disappeared in an instant. Sucked out into nothingness. Then, just as quickly, they took placed me in an escape pod. As they closed the door, Vor looked me right in the eye and said "The message you will deliver to Earth's colonies is one simple word: 'SUBMIT'" 

Jon Murvin, Junior Pilot
/Lotus/Language/Archive/CivilianRaidedSu.zhText:
736.012

最后的幸存者:Rodin号船员

他们在夜间发动突袭，我醒来听到巨大声响与机械声，一个强登舱正在凿穿我们的船体，敌人通过我们的防御系统就如同他们不存在一样，他们每一个人都比我看过体型最大的人来的巨大，我从来没看过任何东西像他们一样。

在首次突袭存活下来的人被捕获并带往卸货区，我们认为他们带我们到这边是有原因的，我们太天真了，来了一个自称为沃尔上尉的人，甚至比其他人来的高大，且其他人似乎也畏惧他，不知道什么原因他在人群中选中我。我被带往控制室并要我仔细观赏，我并未准备好接下来要发生的事情。

他们直居打开外部舱门，让那数百名的男人，女人及孩童是立刻消失，都被吸出化成虚无，接着他们将我置于逃生舱中并关上舱门，沃尔看这个我眼睛说"你会带给地球殖民第一个简单的信息:"服从！"

Jon Murvin，Junio​​r Pilot

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt1.text:
STRENGTH IN NUMBERS

From the Pause Menu, navigate to COMMUNICATION and then CLAN. From here you will be able to start your own clan or learn about clans.

Once you select to start your own clan, you can choose a name and if it's available, your clan will be created!

There are many tiers of Clan sizes to suit your preference, whether you want to be a part of a vast, 1000-member Moon Clan or a tight-knit Ghost Clan of 10 members.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt1.zhText:
人多势众

在主选单点选「通讯」按钮，再点选「氏族」按钮。在这里你可以创建你的氏族或了解氏族的相关资讯。

当你选择创建自己的氏族就得为氏族取名，若名称可以使用，你的氏族就创建完成了！

无论你想要创建的是规模庞大达千人的月亮氏族，或是组织严密仅有十名人员的幽灵氏族，这里都有各种不同阶层的氏族规模以满足你的需求。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt2.text:
BUILD YOUR FORTRESS

When you first join or create a Warframe clan you will be given a blueprint for a Dojo Key. You can forge this key in your Foundry.

You will be able to access your Dojo through the Clan Page in the Pause Menu, by pressing ENTER CLAN DOJO.

If you see a door with glowing red outlines, this is an open node. You can interact with this door to bring up a menu that will let you choose a room to start constructing at this node.

With construction projects comes costs. When a room or decoration is under construction, members must donate their resources to see their projects completed.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt2.zhText:
建造你的要塞

当你第一次加入或创建一个 Warframe 氏族时，你会收到一张道场钥匙的蓝图。你可以在铸造厂锻造这把钥匙。

到你的虚空钥匙列表中寻找你的氏族钥匙，然后到虚空钥匙界面右下角点击"使用"按钮。

如果你看到一扇门的边框是红色在发光的，这就是一个开放节点。你可以跟这扇门互动使其弹出一个选单让你选择一个房间，开始在这个节点建造。

建造项目需要成本。在房间或装饰部分正在建造时，氏族成员必须捐出他们的资源才能使项目完成。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt3.text:
RESEARCH NEW TECHNOLOGY

Some weapons and Warframes can only be created through research in Clan Tech Labs.

In order to craft these items you must first construct an Oracle.

Once completed you will be able to create Laboratories that focus on Tenno, Grineer, Corpus or Infested technology.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt3.zhText:
研究新技术

有些战甲和武器只能通过氏族的技术研究室来制造。

为了制造这些物品，你必须先建造一个启示研究室。

一旦建造完成，你就可以创建一个致力于 Tenno、Grineer、Corpus 或 Infested 技术的的实验室。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt4.text:
FOR HONOR, FOR GLORY

Care for some friendly competition Tenno? Often you will find special events occurring that will require the attention of all your clan members.

The Lotus rewards those clans that have shown exemplary skill with emblems for all members of the clan, or trophies of vanquished enemies for your clan's Dojo.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt4.zhText:
为了荣誉，为了荣耀

Tenno，喜欢参加一些友好的竞赛吗？通常，你会发现一些特殊活动需要全体氏族成员的关注。

Lotus 奖励那些展现出模范技能的氏族，所有氏族成员将会得到徽章，或者氏族的道场会得到征服敌人的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt5.text:
SHARING IS CARING

Building a Trading Post in your Dojo allows clan members (and invitees) to exchange tradeable items, such as Mods and Relics in the Dojo. Trades are taxed and the Clan may increase the taxation rate to line their coffers.

You will find the Trading Post in the Decorations section.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt5.zhText:
分享即是关爱

在您的道场中建造一个交易机来允许氏族成员（和受邀者）交换可交易的物品，比如道场中的 Mod 和遗物。交易是要征收交易税的，氏族或许可以通过提高税率来充实他们的金库。

您将能够在装饰区找到交易机。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt6.text:
BUILD YOUR EMPIRE

There are many decorative rooms, game-play spaces and majestic areas you can build to bring honor to your clan. There are meeting halls, dueling rooms, obstacle courses and more.

The Tenno are constantly expanding the possibilities of what they can build!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt6.zhText:
建立你的帝国

氏族中可以选择建造各式装饰空间、游憩空间和宏伟的区域来荣耀你的氏族，比如交谊厅、决斗房、障碍训练场等。

Tenno 会不断拓展建设的可能性！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt7.text:
MOON CLAN / GHOST CLAN

Clan tiers are a method to organize clans by size while keeping it possible to run a full dojo for any size of clan.

Ghost - 10
Shadow - 30
Storm - 100
Mountain - 300
Moon -1000

There are separate leader boards for each clan tier, and clans will only compete against other clans in the same tier. A clan’s tier is raised when it builds the appropriate sized clan Barracks and these must be built in order from smallest tier to the largest.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ClanTrainingPt7.zhText:
月亮氏族 / 幽灵氏族

氏族规模是一种按照氏族人数多少编组氏族的方法，它同时保持任何规模的氏族都能运行完整道场的可能。

幽灵 - 10
暗影 - 30
风暴 - 100
山脉 - 300 
月亮 - 1000

每个氏族规模都有单独的排行榜，氏族只与同规模的其它氏族竞争。当一个氏族建立适当大小的氏族营房时，它的规模就会被扩大并且这些必须按照从最小到最大的规模建立。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.text:
TEST YOUR SKILLS

Conclaves have been established as an area for Tenno to duel each other in friendly battle. Matches of 1vs1, 1vs2, and 2vs2 can be played.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.zhText:
测试你的身手

武形秘仪是为了使Tenno们能进行的友善武艺切磋而设置。决斗方式分为一对一，一对二，二对一，以及二对二几种模式。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.text:
MEASURE YOUR OPPONENTS

Your Conclave Rating will determine which arena/opponents you can duel.

Your total is determined by the level of your weapons, your Warframe and by which Mods you have equipped.

Check your Arsenal stats in the lower right to see the Conclave ratings. Adding Mods on a weapon or Warframe will affect the Conclave Rating, and the stronger the Mod is the higher your Conclave Rating will be.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.zhText:
衡量你的对手

你的战力值将会决定你能使用哪些场地以及和什么等级的对手决斗。

你的总分取决于身上装备的武器，战甲以及所使用的 Mod。

从军械库右下角的状态接口可得知你的战力值。战力值会因武器以及战甲上装备了 Mod 而受影响，当装备的 Mod 越强，你的战力值也会越高。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.text:
FIND CONCLAVES

There are many Conclaves in the Origin System. Each Conclave has its own Rating which determines the Tenno that may duel there.

Conclave arenas have health, energy, and ammo pickups distributed in them. Best 2 out of 3 matches will determine the winning side, but you may choose to continue dueling after the battle has ended.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.zhText:
武形秘仪的进行地点

始源星系里充满了多个秘仪竞技场。每个竞技场有不同的战力值，代表不同的Tenno将会在那里等待挑战者的到来。

武形秘仪场地中四处设有生命，能量，以及弹药补给可供使用。以三战两胜的方式分出赢家，分出胜负之后还是可以选择继续切磋。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.text:
NEW WAYS WILL EMERGE

The Conclaves are a foundation for Tenno to battle each other. More opportunities to test yourselves will come.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ConclaveTraining.zhText:
新的秘仪内容还在后头

秘仪竞技场是Tenno间相互切磋的基础场所。更多试炼自己身手的方式还会接着到来。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/CorpusGeneral.text:
The Corpus is a Merchant Cult, built on the foundation of salvaged technology and Robotics. 

They scavenge the outer systems, greedy for the Old War salvage. Their most sought after of all - the Tenno and their WARFRAME armor.

Those captured are treated as salvage; meticulously dissected, integrated. The remains are sold to the highest bidder.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/CorpusGeneral.zhText:
Corpus 是以打捞和机器人技术为基础的商人崇拜组织。

他们在星系外围贪婪地打捞远古之战留下的抢手遗物 - Tenno 以及战甲。

被他们俘虏的人会受到非人道的对待; 经过仔细的解剖再组合，其它剩余的部分则出售给出价最高的人。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt1.text:
KNOW YOUR LIMITATIONS
Tenno, enemies you face have a variety of defenses.

SHIELDS protect enemies and can regenerate over time. You must destroy it completely before you can damage an enemy's health. 

ARMOR is worn by enemies to reduce damage to their health. Prepare yourself to do high armor damage as you explore your Arsenal.

HEALTH is how your enemies survive. Destroying all of their health will ensure their demise.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt1.zhText:
了解自己的极限
Tenno，你所面对的敌人有着各种不同的防御类型。

护盾保护敌人也能随时间恢复。想要伤害敌人的生命值必须先把护盾摧毁。

护甲是敌人为了降低生命值受伤害而装备的。在军械库里做好高护甲伤害的准备。

生命值是你的敌人生存的必备条件。消灭敌人所有的生命值就能让他们倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt2.text:
STRIKE TRUE AND LAST
Physical damage is made up of three parts: 

IMPACT <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>, PUNCTURE <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>, and SLASH <DT_SLASH_COLOR>

Weapons tend to be a blend of these types. They can be Modded to specialize further. Use these wisely against Shielded and Armored enemies. 

Weapons can perform Critical Strikes for increased damage. Look for Mods that enhance these effects!

Each Damage Type has a chance to put a lasting Status Effect on your enemies, making them vulnerable! If this happens, you will see the Damage Type symbol on your Hud like this: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>
/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt2.zhText:
精准打击并持续作战
物理伤害分为三种：

冲击 <DT_IMPACT>，穿刺 <DT_PUNCTURE> 和切割 <DT_SLASH>

武器大部分都拥有这三种伤害。这些伤害可以借由装备 Mod 获得更多的提升。好好使用它们来对抗护盾值以及护甲值高的敌人。

武器可以借由暴击来造成更高的伤害。找出这方面的 Mod 来强化这个效果吧！

每种伤害对敌人都有几率引发短暂持续的异常状态来弱化敌人！一旦触发这个异常状态，你将会看见伤害图标在敌人的血量条下方出现，比如这种图标：<DT_SLASH>

/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt3.text:
BEND THE ELEMENTS
Elemental damage can be applied in addition to physical damage. There are four primary elemental Damage Types:

<DT_FIRE_COLOR>HEAT Damage will burn and scorch foes.

<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>ELECTRICITY Damage is capable of stunning and damaging enemies.

<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>COLD Damage will slow down and freeze enemies while increasing the Critical Damage they take.

<DT_POISON_COLOR>TOXIN Damage is effective at damaging an enemy's Health!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt3.zhText:
混合元素
在物理伤害之后还能加上元素伤害。共有四种基础的元素伤害：

<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害能对敌人造成烧伤以及炽灼。

<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害能造成晕眩以及伤害敌人。

<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害可以减缓敌人的速度并增加他们受到的暴击伤害。

<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害可以有效地削弱敌人的生命值！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt4.text:
KNOW YOUR ENEMY
Each enemy faction has different elemental weaknesses and resistances. Use the Codex Scanner or the Star Chart nodes to learn more about enemy weaknesses to specific Damage Types.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt4.zhText:
了解你的敌人
不同派系的敌人拥有不一样的元素弱点和抗性。使用资料库扫描器或查看星图节点，来了解更多关于敌人对特定伤害类型的弱点信息。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt5.text:
COMBINE ATTACKS FOR GREATER FORMS
A Tenno Master may go even further, combining the four primary elemental Damage Types to create secondary ones.

<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR> BLAST (<DT_FIRE_COLOR> + <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>)
<DT_RADIATION_COLOR> RADIATION (<DT_FIRE_COLOR> + <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>)
<DT_GAS_COLOR> GAS (<DT_FIRE_COLOR> + <DT_POISON_COLOR>)
<DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR> MAGNETIC (<DT_FREEZE_COLOR> + <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>)
<DT_VIRAL_COLOR> VIRAL (<DT_FREEZE_COLOR> + <DT_POISON_COLOR>)
<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR> CORROSIVE (<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> + <DT_POISON_COLOR>)

Use Mods to extend and mutate the damage potential of your most powerful weapons!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/DamageModelPt5.zhText:
结合不同元素伤害来产生更好的效果
一位 Tenno 高手可以变得更强，结合四种基础元素伤害来产生新的元素伤害。

<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR> 爆炸 （<DT_FIRE_COLOR> + <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>）
<DT_RADIATION_COLOR> 辐射 （<DT_FIRE_COLOR> + <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>）
<DT_GAS_COLOR> 毒气 （<DT_FIRE_COLOR> + <DT_POISON_COLOR>）
<DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR> 磁力 （<DT_FREEZE_COLOR> + <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>）
<DT_VIRAL_COLOR> 病毒（<DT_FREEZE_COLOR> + <DT_POISON_COLOR>）
<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR> 腐蚀 （<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> + <DT_POISON_COLOR>）

使用 Mod 来强化以及变异元素来激发出你武器的最强潜力！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/Directive.text:
Directive

Do you hear that my Tenno? The silence of tyrants who fell by your blade? Your sacrifice is complete and you should rest. The cryo-chamber will wipe away the unpleasantness of what has passed. When you are called to wake, it must be because the system is once again out of balance. Perform your duties then, as you have now. 

Until we meet again,
Lotus
/Lotus/Language/Archive/Directive.zhText:
指示

我的 Tenno，你听见了吗？那败在你剑下的暴君之寂静？你的牺牲已完成，而你也应获得你该有的安息。低温冷冻舱能抹去所有过往的痛苦记忆。当你再次被唤醒时，那必定是星系再次失衡的时刻。届时请你履行你应尽的职责，如同现在一样。

直至我们再次相见，
Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Archive/FomorianDestroye.text: Our coordinated attacks have worked... this time. There may be other Fomorians coming. We need to destroy them or suffer resource shortages in the future.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/FomorianDestroye.zhText: 这次…我们的合作攻击产生效果了。之后可能还会有其它巨人舰队到来，我们必须消灭他们，不然未来将会面临资源缺乏的窘境。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.text:
FASHION YOUR STEEL
The Foundry is the key to creating the most powerful items in the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.zhText:
建造你的武装
铸造厂是创造始源星系中最强大物品的关键。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.text:
STUDY THE COMPONENTS
Using the Foundry requires Blueprints (found in the market and on missions) and Resources which are dropped by the enemies you kill. 

Enter the battlefield to collect resources, and use them in the Foundry!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.zhText:
研究组件
使用铸造厂需要蓝图 （可以在商店和任务中找到） 和从你杀死的敌人身上掉落的资源。

投入战场收集资源，到铸造厂中使用它们！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.text:
SEEK THE WEAPONS
Warframes are rare and extremely powerful - building one in the Foundry may require you to assemble multiple parts. Clan research may be involved.

The Origin System is home to many things that require numerous blueprints to complete. The hunt is on, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.zhText:
寻找武器
战甲是稀有且极其强大的 — 在铸造厂制作一件可能需要你组装多个部件。氏族研究也可能被涉及。

始源星系是需要大量蓝图制作来完成的家。狩猎开始了，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.text:
KNOW THE DESIGNS
Building in the Foundry begins by having the necessary resources and blueprints.

Builds in progress can be rushed, and any item can be built more than once. Keep in mind you can build more than one item at a time.

Take note of the required build time, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.zhText:
了解设计
在铸造厂中的建造是从持有必要的资源和蓝图开始的。

建造过程中可以加速，任何东西都可以多于一次地被建造. 请记住，你可以一次建造多于一种物品.

注意所需的建造时间，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.text:
BUILD YOUR FUTURE
Explore the Origin System to find all the resources to build a variety of items.

Advanced players may use the Foundry to craft Titan Extractors, a drone capable of securing resources outside of your missions.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/FoundryTrainingP.zhText:
建造您的未来
探索始源星系来找到建造各种物品的所有资源。

高级玩家可以使用铸造厂建造泰坦采集机 ，一架能够在你的任务之余收集资源的无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/FusionMoa.text:
The Prototype

It works! They said it could not be done, that the Void salvage was only good for a museum! 

Now we have functional prototype of Orokin energy beams installed in our Robotics! While I am horribly burned and limbless it was worth it in the service of our great enterprise!

Due to the valuable nature of these Robotics I have added a secondary defense system that triggers when the Moa is critically damaged.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/FusionMoa.zhText:
原型机

成功了！人们都说虚空物资打捞顶多只能增加博物馆的收藏，说这不可能完成。

但现在我们终于将奥罗金能量光束的原型机成功安装在我们的机器人上了！虽然我遭受了可怕的灼伤并截了肢，但能为我们伟大的企业服务，这一切都值得！

由于这些机器人的价值性，我在上面加装了会在恐鸟受到严重损伤时启动的第二层防御系统。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/Grace1.text:
THE TOMB

Dad and I picked up a big Rubedo ore deposit on scan today so we risked the fuel and touched down on an abandoned Orbiter. I couldn't believe what we found - an old Orokin Chamber in the ice! Dad was angry, that the salvage was probably worth ten thousand credits but we weren't going to touch a thing. He made me swear not to tell anyone about what we saw.

My Dad said these Chambers are just tombs for the ancient Tenno soldiers but when I pushed my face up to the cryo's glass I felt something. Some people think they'll come back one day, but Dad said that was delusional. Tenno are just magic and fantasy to him. It made him sad to say that though. With the Grineer army uniting the colonies by force Dad says the only light left in his life is me. He's such a sap!

After what I saw today, count me in with the delusional ones! I think the Tenno are real, alive and I'm going to keep their secret. I wiped the salvage coordinates for the log - we'll have to look elsewhere for Rubedo.

.Grace Koan
/Lotus/Language/Archive/Grace1.zhText:
古墓

今天，我和爸爸在扫描时发现了一处大型的红化结晶矿床，于是我们冒着燃料不足的风险，降落在一个废弃的生态轨道飞行器上。我简直不敢相信我们发现了什么——冰层里有一个老旧的奥罗金冷冻舱！爸爸很生气，因为那残骸估计值一万现金，但是我们碰都不敢碰。他让我发誓，绝不把我们看到的一切告诉任何人。

我爸爸说这些冷冻舱不过是远古 Tenno 士兵的坟墓，但当我把脸贴近冷冻舱的玻璃时，我感觉到了一些东西。有些人认为他们总有一天会回来，但爸爸说那是妄想。对他来说，Tenno 只不过是魔法与幻想。不过，他说这话时显得很伤感。随着 Grineer 军队用武力统一各殖民地，爸爸说我成了他生命中仅存的希望。他真是个大傻瓜！

在看过今天的发现后，我也加入了那些爱妄想的人！我认为 Tenno 是真实存在的，还活着，而我会守住这个秘密。我已经从日志里删除了那处回收坐标——我们得去别处寻找红化结晶。

.Grace Koan

/Lotus/Language/Archive/GradivusDilemmaC.text:
Tenno,

I have intercepted a message from the Corpus Board to Alad V. They have grown tired of bankrolling Alad V's war effort and have withdrawn their funding. This has left Alad with no other option than retreat. Sargas Ruk is already readying his victory speech. This battle is over.

You have all done well. Those of you who supported the Grineer have given me the time I needed to locate our sleeping comrades. A recovery team is already travelling to retrieve their cryopods. Those that supported The Corpus have slowed Grineer aggression. Though the Grineer ultimately emerged victorious, they did so at great cost.

The time for partnerships with these warlords has ended. We are no longer forced to support them in their petty conflicts. We must return to our stated goal of bringing balance to the Origin System.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/Archive/GradivusDilemmaC.zhText:
Tenno,

I have intercepted a message from the Corpus Board to阿拉德 V. They have grown tired of bankrolling阿拉德 V's war effort and have withdrawn their funding. This has left Alad with no other option than retreat. Sargas Ruk is already readying his victory speech. This battle is over.

You have all done well. Those of you who supported the Grineer have given me the time I needed to locate our sleeping comrades. A recovery team is already travelling to retrieve their cryopods. Those that supported The Corpus have slowed Grineer aggression. Though the Grineer ultimately emerged victorious, they did so at great cost.

The time for partnerships with these warlords has ended. We are no longer forced to support them in their petty conflicts. We must return to our stated goal of bringing balance to the solar system.

The Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Archive/GradivusDilemmaL.text:
Tenno,

We have a situation developing. Alad V and his Corpus troops were on the verge of capturing a long lost group of Tenno still locked in cryo stasis. Things escalated quickly when Sargas Ruk of the Grineer discovered the plan and demanded the frames for himself. Alad V refused and so Ruk ordered his territory confiscated. Fighting broke out a short time ago. At this point either side could win and only we can tip the balance.

Tenno, I cannot in good conscience tell you who to support in this conflict. If you choose to fight for Sargas Ruk, you can save the sleeping Tenno but the Grineer will grow even stronger. Fight for the Corpus and weaken Grineer supremacy but our comrades fall to the mercy of Alad V. 

Choose wisely.

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/Archive/GradivusDilemmaL.zhText:
Tenno,

We have a situation developing.阿拉德 V and his Corpus troops were on the verge of capturing a long lost group of Tenno still locked in cryo stasis. Things escalated quickly when Sargas Ruk of the Grineer discovered the plan and demanded the frames for himself.阿拉德 V refused and so Ruk ordered his territory confiscated. Fighting broke out a short time ago. At this point either side could win and only we can tip the balance.

Tenno, I cannot in good conscience tell you who to support in this conflict. If you choose to fight for Sargas Ruk, you can save the sleeping Tenno but the Grineer will grow even stronger. Fight for the Corpus and weaken Grineer supremacy but our comrades fall to the mercy of阿拉德 V. 

Choose wisely.

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerAlt.text:
From the chaos of the Collapse, they emerged. Violent hordes of decaying clones, overflowing from their toxic womb. They flood the Origin System, swallowing colonies whole.

The twin Queens, the SISTERS, have devised a plan to transform the scattered colonies into an Empire across the planets.

The Sisters have sent their most trusted brood on a vital quest - the TENNO, hidden and asleep, must never awake.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerAlt.zhText:
From the chaos of the Collapse，they emerged. Violent hordes of decaying clones，overflowing from their toxic womb. They flood the Origin System，swallowing colonies whole.

The twin Queens，the SISTERS，have devised a plan to transform the scattered colonies into an Empire across the planets.

The Sisters have sent their most trusted brood on a vital quest - the TENNO，hidden and asleep，must never awake.

/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerGeneral.text: The Grineer are the most dangerous threat in an Age, and the reason for your awakening.. Details are scarce on their origin, but they seemingly emerged from out of nowhere and started a campaign of domination. Ruled by a mysterious pair of Twin Queens who respond to any threat with absolute force, they have completely swallowed existing colonies and threaten many others. Where did they come from? What is the source of their power? These are questions you need to answer Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerGeneral.zhText: The Grineer are the most dangerous threat in an Age，and the reason for your awakening.. Details are scarce on their origin，but they seemingly emerged from out of nowhere and started a campaign of domination. Ruled by a mysterious pair of Twin Queens who respond to any threat with absolute force，they have completely swallowed existing colonies and threaten many others. Where did they come from? What is the source of their power? These are questions you need to answer Tenno.

/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerRaidsClon.text:
736.020

My Queens,

The strike on the trade convoy was a success. Our fleet has increased two fold. Our cloning facilities are growing soldiers faster than ever before. These ships will carry those soldiers into battle.
Earth's colonies grow weak as we grow strong. Our power is surging. Where will you have us strike first?

General Sargas Ruk
/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerRaidsClon.zhText:
736.020

My Queens,

The strike on the trade convoy was a success. Our fleet has increased two fold. Our cloning facilities are growing soldiers faster than ever before. These ships will carry those soldiers into battle.
Earth's colonies grow weak as we grow strong. Our power is surging. Where will you have us strike first?

General Sargas Ruk

/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerRaidsMist.text:
729.242

Gript Seev ,

Disposal of the Unfit has become tiresome. The less damaged ones can be used to soften a ship before a full raid but the truly unfit are good for little more than target practice. We can no longer afford to waste protein on these mistakes and we need more soldiers to fill our new ships.
I am sending you new analysis on Orokin cloning techniques. I expect to see better results from you than last time. You are not the only Grower in the Grineer army.

General Sargas Ruk
/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerRaidsMist.zhText:
729.242

Gript Seev ，

Disposal of the Unfit has become tiresome. The less damaged ones can be used to soften a ship before a full raid but the truly unfit are good for little more than target practice. We can no longer afford to waste protein on these mistakes and we need more soldiers to fill our new ships.
I am sending you new analysis on奥罗金cloning techniques. I expect to see better results from you than last time. You are not the only Grower in the Grineer army.

General Sargas Ruk

/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerRaidsSucc.text:
736.012

General Ruk,

We have captured the Rodin. Resistance was pathetic and we made an example of those too weak to die in battle. The strongest specimens have been taken to the lab for inclusion in our gene pool. With this new freighter thousands more troops can now be carried into battle and the colonies around earth are one step closer to submission.

Captain Vor
/Lotus/Language/Archive/GrineerRaidsSucc.zhText:
736.012

General Ruk，

We have captured the Rodin. Resistance was pathetic and we made an example of those too weak to die in battle. The strongest specimens have been taken to the lab for inclusion in our gene pool. With this new freighter thousands more troops can now be carried into battle and the colonies around earth are one step closer to submission.

Captain Vor

/Lotus/Language/Archive/InfestationGener.text:
INFESTATION describes both a disease and its victims - a metamorphic affliction without cure. Living organisms are consumed and merged into rabid amalgamations.

Individuals are violent and animalistic yet the larger whole exhibits signs of coordination, with multiple swarms converging on ships and colonies.

Its origins are uncertain but there is historical evidence of a similar outbreak before The Collapse.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/InfestationGener.zhText:
以身受变异折磨所苦且永远无法治愈而言，INFESTATION 同时代表着疾病，以及深受此疾患所苦的受害者。它们的肉体活生生被摧毁，最终与陷入疯狂。

INFESTATION 的个体既暴力且充满兽性，然而当它们群体出没时，却展现出了相互协调的迹象。INFESATION 成群集结在多艘船舰与数座殖民地上。

其起源已不可考，但在"大崩毁"发生前，历史上曾有过类似疫情爆发的轨迹。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt1.text:
ALWAYS BE READY

Tap <MELEE> at any time to perform all Melee Strikes, Combos, and Special Attacks. 

Performing a Melee Strike instantly equips the Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt1.zhText:
随时备战

任何时间点击 <MELEE> 以施展所有近战攻击、连段，和特殊攻击。

施展近战攻击能立即装备近战武器。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt2.text:
PARRY THEIR ATTACKS

Face incoming attacks with a melee weapon equipped to AUTO BLOCK.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt2.zhText:
招架他们的攻击

装备近战武器时面向攻击来袭方向会自动格挡。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt3.text:
NEVER STOP MOVING

SLIDE ATTACK
Tap <MELEE> while sliding to perform a slide attack.

AERIAL ATTACK
Tap <MELEE> while airborne to strike with an aerial attack.

SLAM ATTACK
While airborne, aim at targets on the ground and tap <MELEE> to perform a slam attack that damages and/or knocks down surrounding enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt3.zhText:
永不停止移动

滑行斩击
滑行时轻按 <MELEE> 以施展滑行斩击。

空中挥砍
滞空时轻按 <MELEE> 以施展空中挥砍。

震地攻击
滞空时瞄准地面上的敌人并轻按 <MELEE> 以施展震地攻击，可对地面的敌人造成伤害或击倒。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt4.text:
LINK IT ALL TOGETHER

Equip a STANCE MOD on your melee weapon to unlock a variety of deadly melee combos.

Crimson Dervish can be equipped on single bladed weapons, like the Skana, and allows the user to trigger combos by pressing the correct button sequence. 

One of the attacks unique to Crimson Dervish is the Twisting Flurry. It is a three-strike attack that can be triggered by pressing <MELEE> , <MELEE> , <MELEE>

View available combos from the mod screen in your arsenal or from the menu while in a mission.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt4.zhText:
融会贯通

在近战武器上装备架式 Mod 能进一步解锁各种致命的近战连击。

赤红狂舞可装备在单手剑武器上——比如说空刃——让使用者凭借操作正确的按键顺序来发动连击。

飞燕乱舞是赤红狂舞独特的招式之一。这套连段可以通过以下按键顺序触发： <MELEE>，<MELEE>，<MELEE>

你可以在军械库中的 Mod 界面或是任务中的菜单随时查看连击动作。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt5.text:
HEAVY ATTACK

Equip your melee weapon and tap <MELEE_CHANNEL> to HEAVY ATTACK, dealing high damage that is enhanced by your Combo Multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/MeleeTrainingPt5.zhText:
重击

装备近战武器，点击<MELEE_CHANNEL>来进行重击。可以造成很高的伤害，并通过连击倍率来提升伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt1.text:
UNLOCK YOUR POWER
A Tenno improves their Arsenal with special upgrades called Mods.

There are hundreds of Mods that can be found and combined to enhance your weapons and augment your Warframe.

It is up to you to decide how you will combine these Mods to suit your fighting style.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt1.zhText:
发现装备的潜能
Tenno 使用被称作 Mod 的特殊强化道具来提升他们的军械库。

你能寻找并组合上百种 Mod 来提升你的武器或增强你的战甲。

如何妥善组合这些 Mod 来配合你的战斗风格，一切由你决定。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt2.text:
SEEK THE OLD WAYS

Installing a Mod is done in the Upgrade section of the Arsenal. 

Use the AUTO-EQUIP feature until you become familiar with the Mod system.

Mods are collected in many ways - most can be found as loot dropped by specific enemies. 

The Codex and Codex Scanner allow you to scan enemies and learn about which Mods they might be carrying.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt2.zhText:
知悉古老的强化方式

安装 Mod 是在「军械库」的「升级」中完成的。

在完全熟悉 Mod 系统之前，你可以试着使用「自动安装」的功能。

Mod 能以各种方式来搜集——大多数能够从特定敌人身上掉落的战利品中找到。

「资料库」和「扫描器」让你可以扫描敌人并了解他们可能携带哪些 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt3.text:
KNOW YOUR MOD

NAME - Check the Codex for a list of what is possible!

DRAIN - This is the capacity cost for equipping this Mod.

POLARITY - In the upgrade screen you will see that Mod Slots will often be attuned to a specific Polarity. Matching Mods to Slot Polarities significantly reduce the drain, while Mods that do not match will increase the drain.

FUSION - You can increase the level of a Mod through Fusion. This will increase both its effectiveness and drain.

ITEM - This determines the type of item this Mod can be installed in. It may refer to a broad range of weapon types or a specific weapon.

UPGRADE - Describes the effect this Mod has on your item. Statistical benefits will rise if you apply Fusion to the Mod.

RARITY - Rarity is identified by the color of the frame on the Mod. Golden Mods are the rarest kind, Silver Mods are uncommon and Bronze Mods are the most common variety.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt3.zhText:
了解你的 Mod

名称 － 到「资料库」看看有哪些可用的 Mod ！

消耗 － 装备时所需要的消耗的 Mod 容量。

极性 － 在「升级」画面中，你会发现某些 Mod 插槽会符合特定的极性。放置符合插槽极性的 Mod 会降低消耗，反之则会增加消耗。

融铸 － 你可以通过「融铸」来提升 Mod 的等级，这同时会增加此 Mod 的效果和消耗。

类型 － 这将决定这个 Mod 可以安装在什么物品上。它可能是指一个范围广泛的武器类型或特定武器类型。

强化内容 － 说明这个 Mod 对这项装备的影响。当你通过「融铸」来升级 Mod 时，强化内容的数值将会提升。

稀有度 － 表示这个 Mod 在这个世界上有多稀有。稀有度可以从 Mod 的外框来辨别。金色 Mod 为最稀有的种类，银色 Mod 为罕见，而铜色 Mod 为最常见的种类。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt4.text:
DRAIN
Each mod has a value attributed to Drain, which indicates the capacity cost to equip the mod onto your weapons or Warframe.

As your gear increases in power, your mod capacity also increases, allowing you to equip additional mods to your loadout.

POLARITY
Warframe and weapon mod slots are sometimes attuned to a specific polarity, which is visible in the Upgrade screen of the Arsenal.

On the mod upgrade, polarity is indicated by a symbol next to the Drain amount. Matching mods to slots with the same polarity will reduce the drain amount, while mods that do not match slot polarity will increase the drain.

FUSION
Collecting a Mod is just the first step. All Mods can be upgraded through a process called Endo Fusion. Endo, a fusion energy, reacts with Mods to increase their rank, giving you more power!

To acquire Endo, you can dissolve Duplicate Mods into Endo, play missions for Endo drops, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt4.zhText:
消耗
每张 Mod 都有一个消耗数值，用来表示将该 Mod 装备在你的武器或战甲上所消耗的 Mod 容量。

装备等级提升，Mod 容量也会随之提升，让你能在配置中装上额外的 Mod。

极性
在军械库的配备界面中，可以注意到战甲和武器的 Mod 槽位中有时候会拥有特定的极性。

在 Mod 配备界面中，表示极性的符号就在消耗值旁。极性符号与槽位一致时可以让消耗值降低，反之则会使消耗值上升。

融铸
收集 Mod 只是第一步。所有 Mod 都能通过一种名为"融铸内融核心"的方式来升级。内融核心是一股融合能量，它能与 Mod 发生反应，从而提升 Mod 的等级，为你带来更多力量！

要获取内融核心，你可以把重复的 Mod 分解转换为内融核心、进行任务来获取掉落的内融核心，或是通过其它方式！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt5.text:
PLAN YOUR PATH

When a Tenno has learned enough, they begin to bend the rules of the system by augmenting their gear with Orokin technology...

Orokin Catalysts and Reactors increase the Mod capacity of Weapons and Warframes respectively.

Forma allows a Tenno to modify the polarity of a Mod slot in their item. In this way they optimize their Mod configuration for even greater power.

Auras are special Warframe Mods, designed to help your entire team and actually boost your Mod capacity!

To reach perfection, a Tenno must meditate on the depths of the Mods system.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/ModsTrainingPt5.zhText:
规划你的配置

当一名 Tenno 对使用的装备已有足够认识时，会通过以奥罗金技术来强化装备的方式来改变装备系统的规则……

奥罗金催化剂和反应堆可以分别提高武器和战甲的 Mod 容量 。

Forma 可以让 Tenno 调整他们装备中一格 Mod 槽位的极性。以这种方式来优化 Mod 配置来发挥更大的作用。

光环是特殊的战甲 Mod，用于帮助你的整个团队并提高你的 Mod 容量！

一名 Tenno 必须深入探究 Mod 系统的深处，才能达到完美的境界。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/OrokinVaultsDesc.text:
Our incursions into The Void have proven that Orokin ships are full of powerful secrets. The Orokin Derelict ships, the ones that could not escape into the Void, are no different. 

Hidden deep within the hulls of The Derelicts, the Orokin created Vaults to seal away their treasures.

As The Derelicts were explored, four different types of Vaults were found. And after much trial and error, a way was found to break them open. 

By using Ferrite to corrupt the keys that grant access to The Void, ‘Vault keys' were forged. They are a burden to carry, and no single Tenno can bear more than one. Such is the risk of attempting entry. 

The danger within the Orokin Vaults may be greater still... but their secrets must be revealed.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/Archive/OrokinVaultsDesc.zhText:
我们对虚空的深入探索已经证明，奥罗金人的舰船之中隐藏着强大的秘密。那些未能逃入虚空的奥罗金遗迹船，同样如此。

在遗迹船深处的船体之内，奥罗金人建造了宝库，将他们的珍宝封存其中。

随着遗迹船逐渐被探索，人们发现了四种不同类型的宝库。而在无数次尝试与失败之后，终于有人找到了开启它们的方法。

通过使用铁氧体腐化那些赋予进入虚空权限的钥匙，"宝库钥匙"被锻造了出来。携带它们是一种负担，没有任何一名 Tenno 能承受一把以上的重量。这便是试图踏入宝库所必须承担的风险。

而中的危险，奥罗金宝库或许更加可怕……但它们的秘密，必须被揭露。

莲（Lotus）

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SentinelTraining.text:
BATTLE COMPANION

Sentinels aid Tenno on the battlefield by reinforcing many areas of support. Sentinels can be built in the Foundry or purchased in the Market.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SentinelTraining.zhText:
一同战斗的伙伴

守护在战场上可以提供 Tenno 各种协助。守护可以从商店以白金购买，也可以从商店购买蓝图再利用铸造厂制作。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SentinelTraining.text:
USE HARMONY IN YOUR ATTACKS

Sentinels can offer support in many ways, including Stealth, Damage, Crowd Control, and picking up Loot!
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SentinelTraining.zhText:
缓和激烈战斗

不同的守护能提供各种协助，包含隐身、伤害、群体控制和拾取战利品！

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SentinelTraining.text:
PASS ON YOUR EXPERIENCES

Sentinels can be modified to suit your needs - equipping precepts will customize your Sentinels behavior.

The order which you equip determines the priority, from top left to bottom right.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SentinelTraining.zhText:
善用 Mod 装备

可以调整守护装备的 Mod 来应对不同需要－装备 Mod 的顺序可调整守护的行动。

守护的技能指令 Mod 安装顺序会影响技能发动先后，从左上到右下表示着高到低的顺序。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SlingStoneBody.text:
We have just learned that the Grineer Empire is preparing a major offensive against the Corpus. The Sisters have grown impatient with the Corpus monopoly on manufacturing supplies. Their aim is to destroy resource stockpiles throughout Corpus space in order to force the arrogant Corpus back to the bargaining table. The Grineer are deploying new FOMORIAN class ships, poised to strike the Corpus within days.

As much as we'd like to see the Corpus suffer we cannot allow such a growth in Grineer influence to go unchecked. We must work together to destroy the Fomorian ships as they appear or we will suffer resource shortages that will curtail our war effort. We must uphold the balance of this conflict.

Tenno, you must coordinate your attacks - their engineers will be repairing these ships throughout our assault. This is not a standard sabotage mission. You will need to inject a chemical agent harvested from the Infestation to destabilize the Fomorian reactors. With enough corruption the Fomorian reactors will implode and take the monstrous ship with it.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SlingStoneBody.zhText:
我们刚刚得知 Grineer 帝国正准备发起一场对 Corpus 的主要进攻。姐妹们对于 Corpus 在制造补给品上的垄断变得越来越没有耐性。他们的目标是通过消灭 Corpus 在各地的资源储备迫使嚣张的 Corpus 低下头来重新寻求谈判。Grineer 正在部署新的巨人战舰级飞船，准备在几天之内悄然向 Corpus 发起进攻。

虽然我们想看到 Corpus 受到重挫，但是我们不能让 Grineer 的影响力肆意泛滥。我们必须并肩作战，在巨人战舰出现的时候将它们摧毁，不然我们就会遭遇资源短缺从而削弱我们的战斗力。我们必须维持这场冲突的平衡。

Tenno，你们必须相互配合组织进攻 - 他们的工程师会在我们进攻的过程中不断修理这些飞船。这不是一场普通的破坏任务。你们要通过把一个从 Infestation 那里获得的化学试剂添加到巨人战舰反应堆里产生破坏效果。足够的损坏会引发巨人战舰反应堆内爆，从而摧毁飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SlingStoneVictor.text:
Honorable Board

I'm proud to report that Sling-Stone was a success! The Fomorian ships have been reduced to radioactive scraps drifting through the system... 

The Betrayers did our work for us. Billions saved in potential damages. I just dangled some Mod technology in front of their noses and let their homicidal nature do the rest. Too easy!

The Grineer have returned to the bargaining table but something in their tone irks me. I've dispatched scouts to Pluto - I suspect the Grineer may have held a few Fomorians in reserve.

Alad V
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SlingStoneVictor.zhText:
Honorable Board

I'm proud to report that Sling-Stone was a success! The Fomorian ships have been reduced to radioactive scraps drifting through the system… 

The Betrayers did our work for us. Billions saved in potential damages. I just dangled some Mod technology in front of their noses and let their homicidal nature do the rest. Too easy!

The Grineer have returned to the bargaining table but something in their tone irks me. I've dispatched scouts to Pluto - I suspect the Grineer may have held a few Fomorians in reserve.

阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.text: Solar Rails are colossal Orokin devices that distort the Void and allow players to reach otherwise inaccessible regions of space, known as Dark Sectors. Clans and Alliances can deploy Solar Rails to control these areas on the Star Chart, collecting tributes from players who access areas within their territory.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.zhText: 星际航道是巨大的奥罗金设备，通过扭曲虚空让玩家进入其他方式无法接近的太空领域，称之为黑暗战区。氏族和联盟可以布署星际航道来控制这些星图上的地区，从进入他们领土的玩家手中征收税费。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.text: Once an Oracle has been built, Clans are able to construct Orokin Labs in their Dojos. Clan Warlords and Tacticians can research blueprints and construct Solar Rails from the terminals located inside the Orokin Lab. Small clans can unite to form Alliances, and are able to construct an Alliance Solar Rail. All clans within the Alliance may contribute toward the research and construction of the Solar Rail.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.zhText: 一旦启示研究室被建成，氏族就可以在他们的道场中建造奥罗金实验室。氏族的将军们和战术家们可以研究蓝图以及在位于奥罗金实验室内部的终端建造星际航道。小型氏族可以团结成为联盟，并能建造一个联盟星际航道。所有联盟内的氏族都可以为研究以及建造星际航道做出贡献。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.text:
Researching a Solar Rail blueprint requires resource contributions from clan members. The resources required scales with the size of the Clan. Once research is complete, construction on the Solar Rail can begin. The resource requirements of a Solar Rail however, do not scale with the size of the clan, so it is imperative for small clans to form an Alliance to expedite the construction process.

A schema is required to be applied to a Solar Rail before it can be deployed. The schemas can be accessed independently from the Solar Rails via one of the consoles near the entrance to the Orokin Lab. From this console you can design the layout of your Solar Rail.

Tacticians and Warlords will be able to build the rooms and place defense systems within the schema, while other clan members will be able to contribute to their cost. The schema is complete once the Power Core room has been constructed. It can then be applied to Solar Rail that is ready to be deployed, or can override an existing Solar Rail's layout.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.zhText:
研究星际航道的蓝图需要氏族成员们共同捐献资源，而需要的资源数量与氏族规模呈正比。一旦研究完成，即可开始建造星际航道。建造星际航道同样需要资源，但需求数量不受氏族规模所影响。因此小型氏族最好组成联盟来加快建造过程。

在设置星际航道前需要先拥有航道架构。航道架构可以独自从奥罗金实验室入口附近的星际航道控制面板处取得。您可以在这个控制面板中调整自己的星际航道设置。

军师与军阀阶级能在航道架构中进行规划与设置防御系统，其他阶级的成员则可以捐献资源。当航道的能量核心室建造完成，此座航道架构即可应用于星际航道的设置，或用于覆盖现有的航道设置。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.text: Once construction has been completed, clans and Alliances are able to deploy their Solar Rails on specified Dark Sectors of the Star Chart. The Clan or Alliance controlling the Solar Rail will be able to specify a tribute, collecting a percentage of any resources or credits collected by players using the Solar Rail.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.zhText: 一旦建造完成，氏族和联盟就可以在星图上特定的黑暗战区架设他们的星际航道。控制着星际航道的氏族或联盟将可以设置费用，按百分比征收使用星际航道的玩家们收集的资源或现金。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.text:
If another clan already controls a Dark Sector, ownership can be contested by deploying a Solar Rail into their territory. Deploying a second Solar Rail within close proximity of another causes interference with the Void-Disruption Technology used to reach the Dark Sectors. This prevents other Tenno from accessing these regions of space while both Solar Rails are active.

When conflict over Solar Rails controlled by rival Clans or Alliances arises, Tenno have the opportunity to fight for either side by undertaking missions. Missions played for one side cause damage to the opposing Solar Rail. Clans may offer Battle Pay to those who side with them to gain additional support.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.zhText:
如果其他氏族已先行占有黑暗战区，可以在对方的领地中设置星际航道来争夺其拥有权。在另一座星际航道附近设置航道，会以虚空崩解技术来进行干扰并打开前往黑暗站区的道路。当两座星际航道同时在运作中时，会使其他Tenno无法进入进入这些区域。

当在对手氏族或联盟的星际航道上发生冲突时，Tenno此时可以为其中一方战斗，使对手的航道受到伤害。氏族或联盟可以提供战争赏金来使支持者获得更多支持。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.text:
Those supporting the challenger will attack the solar rail, while those supporting the defender will try and stop them. All battles take place in the Defending Solar Rail as designed by the defending clan.

The Mods used by Tenno and equipped on their weapons will initially be locked. As you gain experience by defeating the forces on the opposing side, your Mods will unlock allowing you to become more powerful as the battle progresses. The goal is to destroy the Power Core if you are supporting the Challenger, or defend it if you are supporting the Defenders.

Each victory for the Challenger will damage the Defending Solar Rail. It is destroyed if its health reaches zero before the timer expires. There can be only one rail on a node, if the Defending Solar Rail survives the challenge, then the Challenging Solar Rail will succumb to energy interference and implode.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.zhText:
支持挑战者方的人要攻击防守方的航道，而防守方的支持者则必须试着阻止对方的进攻。战斗进行地点在防守方氏族所设计的星际航道防御战中。

在战斗开始时，身上及武器上所安装的 Mod 是锁住的。击杀对方势力时会取得经验值，随着战斗进展您可以解锁更多 Mod 来强化自身。支持挑战者方的的最终任务目标是摧毁能量核心，而支持防守方的则必须阻挡对方进攻。

挑战者方每一次的进攻胜利都会对防守方航道造成伤害，如果在冲突时间结束前使防守方航道的完整度归零，防守方的航道就会被破坏。一个黑暗战区只能有一座航道存在，如果防守方的航道在冲突战争后仍然完好，挑战者方的星际航道会因为本身能量干扰而崩解、毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.text: The clan that controls the surviving Solar Rail takes control of that Dark Sector, and begin collecting tribute from other Tenno who access it.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SolarRailTrainin.zhText: 一旦一条星际航道受到严重损伤时，它会被毁坏，由控制存留下的那条星际航道的氏族接管黑暗地带，并开始向进入的其他Tenno征收费用。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SynthesisTrainin.text:
Cephalon Simaris is building a digital oasis called Sanctuary. Simaris requires Tenno to hunt down and ‘convert' special targets in a process called ‘Synthesis'. In exchange, Simaris promises enlightenment to his hunters.

Visit him in a Relay to learn which type of target he is interested in collecting. Over time, Simaris will choose new targets for the Sanctuary.

The tools of the hunt are your Synthesis Scanner and Kinetic Siphon gear. Equip these before embarking on your missions. Hunt where the target is normally found, avoiding closed mission types like Defense and Interception.
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SynthesisTrainin.zhText:
中枢 Simaris 正在建设一座叫做圣殿的数字绿洲。Simaris 要求 Tenno 使用一种叫做「结合仪式」的方法追踪并「转化」特殊的目标。作为交换，Simaris 承诺会给予他的猎手一些启示作为回报。

通过去中继站拜访他，来了解他对收集哪些目标感兴趣。随着时间的推移，Simaris 会为圣殿挑选新的目标。

狩猎所用的工具为结合扫描器和动能吸收陷阱。在你着手进行任务前携带上它们。寻找这些目标通常会出现的地方进行狩猎，避免进行那些具有封闭式空间的任务类型，例如防御和拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Archive/SynthesisTrainin.text:
Simaris will inform you if he detects a Synthesis target in your mission area. Now the hunt begins! Equip your Synthesis Scanner and track the faint glowing signatures to its hiding spot.

Upon reaching the target you will use the Synthesis Scanner to analyze specific points on it. But beware! The Synthesis causes dangerous side-effects, increasingly adding risk to completing the Synthesis.

If the target is aware of you it may attack or try to escape. This will make scanning its points especially difficult. Effective Tenno will often deploy Kinetic Siphons to temporarily immobilize the target to complete their hunt.

Are you ready for the hunt, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Archive/SynthesisTrainin.zhText:
若 Simaris 侦测到目标出现在任务区域内，他会通知你。现在狩猎开始了！装备好结合扫描器并循着发出微光的信号，找到目标的藏身地点。

当接近目标后，使用结合扫描器来分析目标的特定点。但请注意！结合扫描会产生危险的副作用，增加完成结合仪式的风险性。

如果目标发现你，可能会开始攻击或试着逃跑。这会使扫描目标身上的特定点更加困难。追求效率的 Tenno 通常会设置动能吸收陷阱来暂时拖住目标，以便顺利完成狩猎任务。

Tenno，准备好进行狩猎了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Archive/VorLore.text:
My Queens, you were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR
/Lotus/Language/Archive/VorLore.zhText:
我尊敬的女皇们，你们是正确的，Tenno 的威胁千真万确。我们找到一个 Tenno 漂浮在地球附近，但莲（Lotus）事先料到了我们的行动。就在我们要抓住 Tenno 之前，莲（Lotus）解除了冷冻睡眠，并派来一支 Tenno 小队破坏了我们的攻势。

他们逃跑了。我们正在追踪。只要将这个 Tenno 与大部队分开，就应该很容易干掉。我们已经击碎了其战甲外甲，并且如此突然地解除冷冻将对其记忆力造成损伤。

由于未能完成任务，我们不胜惶恐地等待应得的惩罚。

——沃尔

/Lotus/Language/Archive/VorsMessage.text:
THE TOMB

Picked up a big Rubedo ore deposit on scan today. Risked the fuel and touched down on an abandoned Eco Orbiter. Couldn't believe what we found - an Orokin Chamber in the ice! Thousand years old? Salvage like this is worth more than water, but Dad said we weren't going to touch a thing. Made me swear to forget we ever saw it.

They say these chambers are just tombs for 'Tenno'. Just dead soldiers from the war before. Buried in their Warframe armor. When I pushed my face against the glass I felt something. I didn't say anything to Dad though, Tenno are just magic and fantasy. False hope.

Things are getting desperate with the Grineer army now. If I had one wish, it'd be that the Tenno were real. For my part, I'm going to make sure the Grineer never find this place. I wiped the coordinates from the log - we'll have to look elsewhere for Rubedo.

.Grace Koan
/Lotus/Language/Archive/VorsMessage.zhText:
古墓

今天扫描时发现了一处大型的红化结晶矿床。我们冒着燃料不足的风险降落在一个废弃的生态轨道飞行器上。简直不敢相信我们发现了什么——冰层里有一个老旧的奥罗金冷冻舱！有上千年历史了吗？回收这种东西可远比水要值钱，但是爸爸说我们不能碰任何东西。他让我发誓要忘记我们见过它。

据说这些冷冻舱只是 "Tenno" 的坟墓。不过是之前战争中的士兵。他们穿着战甲被埋葬在这里。但当我把脸贴近冷冻舱的玻璃时，我感觉到了一些东西。但我什么都没跟爸爸说，Tenno 只不过是魔法与幻想。是虚假的希望。

如今面对 Grineer 军队，形式已经岌岌可危。如果我可以许愿，我希望 Tenno 是真实存在的。至于我，我会确保 Grineer 永远找不到那个地方。我已经从日志里删除了坐标——我们得去别处寻找红化结晶。

.Grace Koan

|PLAYER_NAME|,

For you, a gift of her blueprint is too small a reward, I would also like you to have this Riven. May its mysteries unlock many new planes of possibility for you.

I thank you again, Tenno, your fearlessness will never be forgotten.

Cephalon Suda
/Lotus/Language/BardQuest/BardQuestRiven.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

看来我们都渴望着知识。在 Sentient Hunhow 试图从我的记录中腐化她之前，Octavia 的力量就已经在你掌控之中。对你而言，以她的蓝图做奖励实在太微不足道了，因此我希望你可以收下这张裂罅 Mod。愿它的神秘能为你解锁众多新的可能性。

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.text:
Tenno -

Do not ask me where I have been. The things I have seen. The carnage. Destruction. Never, in all my years… Are we truly doomed?

Forgive me. I will speak no more on it. When I return, promptly upon my next scheduled visit, all will be as it should. I shall ensure it. 

Graciously, 
Baro Ki'Teer.
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.zhText:
Tenno——

别问我去了哪里。我看到的一切。屠杀。毁灭。在我漫长的岁月里，从未想过……我们真的注定要灭亡了吗？

请原谅我。我不会再多说。等我下次按计划如期归来时，一切都会恢复如初。我保证。 

此致敬礼， 
Baro Ki'Teer。

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.text:
Tenno– 

Where… am I? The sky is so bright. What is happening to me? Is it happening again? The lights in the sky. The Relay. The Tenno. Familiar, yet not. How strange it feels to return. I think I must see you. 

Uneasily, 
Ki-Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.zhText:
Tenno—— 

我在……哪里？天空如此明亮。我这是怎么了？又发生这种事了吗？天上的光芒。中继站。Tenno。既熟悉，又陌生。重返故地感觉真奇怪。我想我必须见见你。 

心神不宁地，
Ki-Teer

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.text:
Tenno– 

I must admit, I did not expect to find myself back once more. Based on the signs, I was certain that– well, no matter. I am at the Relay for trade, if you wish to bring me more paltry ahem precious ducats. 

Cordially, 
Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.zhText:
Tenno—— 

我必须承认，我没想到自己竟然又回来了。根据那些迹象，我原本确信——算了。我在中继站等待交易，如果你想再给我带来点微不足道的——咳咳，珍贵的杜卡德金币的话。 

此致， 
Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.text:
Tenno– 

The familiar routine of returning to the Relay– how I have missed it. The length of time between my visits may be predictable for you but is… rather less so, for me. I have seen more than a single lifetime can hold. And I'm passing the savings on to you! 

Restoratively, 
Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.zhText:
Tenno—— 

回到中继站的那种熟悉感——我真是太想念它了。我两次造访之间的时间间隔对你们来说或许是可预见的，但是……对我来说并非如此。我所见识过的，远非一辈子可以容纳。现在，我要把这些好东西都给你！ 

恢复健康的， 
Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.text:
Tenno– 

Within the Void, all things are probable. The many sights I have seen may have already come to pass, or none. I am left with only one question: out of so many paths to ruin, which one is yours? 

In parting, 
Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.zhText:
Tenno—— 

在虚空中，一切皆有可能。我见过的种种景象或许已经成真，又或许从未发生。我只剩下一个疑问：在通往毁灭的众多道路中，那一条是属于你的？ 

就此别过， 
Ki-Teer

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.text: What places have you been to?

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/2026Hallow.zhText: 那些地方后来怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.text:
Tenno -

I'm dreadfully sorry to have missed our previous appointments. My ship's Void Drive has given me no end of trouble. By my calculations I have been gone twice as long as usual. Quite unsettling, even for a seasoned trader such as myself.

I'm certain you've been missing my Void goods of the highest quality, but I beg your patience yet further, for I must perform maintenance on my ship after such an extensive trip. I shall see you again at my next scheduled visit.

Graciously,
Baro Ki'Teer

P.S. When I emerged from the Void, this was here, as though it had been all along. This "portrait"... I cannot bring myself to destroy it, nor to sell it. Please, take it from me. Truth be told I am glad to be rid of it.
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.zhText:
Tenno——

非常抱歉错过了我们之前的约定。我飞船的虚空引擎出了不少麻烦。据我估算，我离开的时间比平常多了一倍。即便是像我这样经验丰富的商人，也感到很不安。

我相信你一定很想念我那些高品质的虚空商品，但我恳请你再耐心等待一下，因为在经历了如此漫长的旅程后，我必须先对我的飞船进行检修。我们会在下次的约定之日再见。

敬上，
Baro Ki'Teer

附言：当我从虚空出来时，这东西就在这里，仿佛它一直都在。这幅"画像"……我实在不忍心毁掉它，也不忍出售它。请你将它带走吧。老实说，我很庆幸能摆脱它。

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.text:
Tenno -

For so long, I have waited. But no more. I implore you to hurry. I do not know how long I have. New treasures will be yours, but beware. You must come NOW.

…Forgive my impatience, Tenno. I must see you. Fear nothing untoward. All will be well.

Gratefully,
Ki-Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.zhText:
Tenno——

我等了很久。但不能再等了。我恳求你快点。我不知道我还能等多久。新的宝藏将属于你，但要小心。你必须现在就来。

……请原谅我的急切，Tenno。我必须见到你。不要害怕会有什么不好的事。一切都会好起来的。

感激敬上，
Ki-Teer

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.text:
Tenno -

Come to the Relay! Come and browse my wondrous wares. Shining like the stars that beckoned us ever onward… drifting away.
Come to the Relay. Before it's too late.

Hastily,
Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.zhText:
Tenno——

来中继站吧！来浏览我那些奇妙的商品吧。它们如星辰般闪耀，指引我们不断前行……却也渐行渐远。
快到中继站来。趁一切还来得及之前。

匆忙敬上，
Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.text:
Tenno -

Spectacular finds from the Void can be yours. Acquire them. Fill your hold and empty mine. These items will surely stand you in good stead when all is dust. Come to the Relay. See cosmic dust changing hands.

Avidly,
Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.zhText:
Tenno——

来自虚空的奇珍异宝即将属于你。去获取它们吧。填满你的仓库，清空我的货架。当一切化为尘埃时，这些物品定会助你一臂之力。来中继站吧。见证宇宙尘埃的易手。

热切敬上，
Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.text:
Tenno -

Come to the Relay. Or do not. Buy, for all the good it will do. The inevitable comes closer still. I thank you for listening to my tale. Hereafter, I think I shall not see you again. Live well.

Wearily,
Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/BaroHalloween/HalloweenI.zhText:
Tenno——

来中继站吧。或者不来也行。买吧，反正也没有什么用。必然之事正在逼近。感谢你倾听我的故事。从今往后，我想我不会再与你相见。保重。

疲惫敬上，
Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/Bios/TestBio.text:
TARGET: Ava Izar

Ava's political career exploded when she launched "Ava's Children", a charity program to feed starving off-world orphans. During the airing of her (now legendary) "Plea for the Forgotten" Ava's tear-duct implants malfunctioned. Stunned audiences mistook this as an emotional display and the donations poured in. Ava won hearts and minds for the Grineer Empire.

Now, under her direct supervision, the charity program produces the majority of Grineer combat munitions. "Ava's Children" live shortened lives in orbital labor camps.

"Children are our future."
/Lotus/Language/Bios/TestBio.zhText:
目标: 艾娃 依泽

艾娃的政治生涯在她的那个叫"艾娃的儿童"的救助外星饥饿孤儿慈善项目上马后就灸手可热起来了。在一个题为"被遗忘者的恳求"（已经脍灸人口）的演讲期间，艾娃的植入泪腺发生故障。目瞪口呆的听众以为这是情感的抒发，然后大量的捐款涌入。艾娃从此在 Grineer 帝国深得人心。

目前，在她的直接监督下，Grineer 绝大多数的军火都由这个慈善项目负责生产。而"艾娃的儿童"则被关进轨道劳改所渡过短暂的余生。

"儿童是我们的未来。"

/Lotus/Language/Bios/TestBioB.text:
TARGET: Sargas Ruk

Sargas Ruk claims to be a self-made man. He rose from humble beginnings as a Grineer Freighter hand to the rank of Fleet Minister. Ruk's appointment was a surprise to those that knew him. He had little education, a 'denied' reproduction rating, and one of the lowest intellect scores seen in ambulatory Grineer. Yet, Ruk has an uncanny ability to influence those around him - incredible given his speech is nearly incomprehensible (he has an enormous tongue deformity).

Perhaps Ruk's inexplicable rise to power has its origins in his humbler days. He worked Orokin recovery missions for the fleet. Ruk's detractors insist he has Orokin technology that weakens will. To date, 100% of these accusations have been withdrawn.

(No quote available)
/Lotus/Language/Bios/TestBioB.zhText:
目标: Sargas Ruk

Sargas Ruk 自称是一个白手起家的人，他从 Grineer 货船开始一路晋升为舰队大使。认识 Ruk 的人对于这个任命都感觉奇怪: 他接受很少的教育、"拒绝参加"繁殖评级、而且智力分数是一般 Grineer 中最低，而且他的说话几乎无法理解（他有畸形的舌头）。

Ruk 能够莫名奇妙地晋级的原因或许和他早年参与回收奥罗金神器的工作有关。Ruk 的批评者坚持认为他拥有能够削弱周围的人的意志的奥罗金科技。到目前为止，这些指控 100% 被撤回。

（无可引述）

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/WraithReapAbilityA.zhText: 受「死亡收割」影响敌人被击杀后生成的暗影数量，暗影会追击附近的敌人

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/WrathfulAdvanceBuf.text: Increased Melee Critical Chance after teleporting
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/WrathfulAdvanceBuf.zhText: 传送后，增加近战暴击几率

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/XataStrikeBuffDesc.text: Increase Energy Regeneration when striking enemies with Alternate Fire.
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/XataStrikeBuffDesc.zhText: 使用次要射击命中敌人时增加能量恢复率

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/YareliBoardAbility.text: Increased Secondary Reload Speed and Fire Rate after healing Merulina
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/YareliBoardAbility.zhText: 「浪漪珊瑚」受到治疗时，增加次要武器的装填速度和射速

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/YareliDisksAbility.text: Accumulated Damage from Aquablades. Recast to release damage in a thrown Aquablade
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/YareliDisksAbility.zhText: 「水形之刃」造成的伤害会被累积起来，再次施放技能掷出刀刃以释放伤害

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZenistarBuffDesc.text: Floating disk released on Heavy Attack. Duration scales with Combo Count
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZenistarBuffDesc.zhText: 重击释放悬浮的圆盘。持续时间随连击数而变化

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZenithBuffDesc.text: Infinite Punch Through after deploying Alternate Fire disk
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZenithBuffDesc.zhText: 发射次要射击圆盘后，获得无限穿透

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZephyrBurstAbility.text: Increased Secondary Damage for each enemy hit by Airburst
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZephyrBurstAbility.zhText: 「空爆」每击中一个敌人，增加次要武器的伤害

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZephyrTailWindAbil.text: Increased Tail Wind Damage for each enemy hit. Resets upon touching the ground for 2 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZephyrTailWindAbil.zhText: 「顺风」每击中一个敌人都会增加其造成的伤害，在落地 2 秒后重置

/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZephyrTurbulenceAb.text: Increased Movement Speed and Projectile Speed from nearby Turbulence
/Lotus/Language/Buffs/ZephyrTurbulenceAb.zhText: 附近有激活的「疾风湍流」技能时，增加移动速度与投射物速度

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999CaliberChick.text: Unleash your inner arcade hero. Inspired by the legendary duo Jillian and Lillian, these outfits bring their unstoppable energy and fearless fashion straight to Drifter and Operator. It’s nostalgia, reloaded!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999CaliberChick.zhText: 释放你内心的街机英雄。这些服装灵感来自传奇二人组吉利安和莉莉安，将她们不可阻挡的能量和大胆的时尚直接带给了漂泊者和指挥官。这就是重新燃起的怀旧感！

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesAntivi.text: The information superhighway can be a scary place, especially with a Technocyte Coda watching your every move. Get peace of mind with this set of Antivirus Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesAntivi.zhText: 信息高速公路可能是一个危机四伏的地方，尤其是当科技细胞终幕者监视着你的一举一动时。使用这套杀毒 Mod，让你高枕无忧。
终幕者杀毒 Mod 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesComple.text: Fight back against Technocyte Coda threats with this complete collection of Antivirus and Potency mods.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesComple.zhText: 利用这套完整的杀毒和效价 Mod 来反击科技细胞终幕者的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesCosmet.text: Embody Scaldra and their chilling, charismatic leaders with this collection of cosmetic and decorative items.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesCosmet.zhText: 通过这一系列自定义装饰物来体现炽蛇军及其令人不寒而栗、魅力十足的领导者。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesGeminS.text:
Get back in the action with this collection of Gemini Skins from Techrot Encore.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesGeminS.zhText:
通过《科腐者安可》的这组双子外观重新投入行动。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesPotenc.text: Taking on a Technocyte Coda is a breeze with the assortment of Potency Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesPotenc.zhText: 借助各种效价 Mod，对抗科技细胞终幕者是轻而易举的事。
终幕者效价 Mod 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesWeapon.text: Take the fight to Scaldra with their own fearsome weapons. Quality personally assured by Viktor Vodyanoi.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999EchoesWeapon.zhText: 用炽蛇军自己的可怕武器反击他们。维克多·维德诺伊亲自保证品质。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999FloofBundleD.text: Transformed once again, this time into an adorable collection of soft toys, the Hex are waiting to come home with you!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999FloofBundleD.zhText: 再次变身，这次是变成了一系列可爱的玩偶，六人组正等着和你一起回家！

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999OperatorCosm.text: Dare to define the cutting edge. Transform Drifter and Operator into pioneers of goth, grunge, and athletic chic, proving that science isn't the only frontier for Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/1999OperatorCosm.zhText: 敢于定义前沿。让漂泊者和指挥官变身为哥特风、颓废风和运动风时尚的先驱，证明科学并不是霍瓦尼亚的唯一前沿。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/2025SupporterPac.text: Take on the dangers of the Origin System in style with the Pyra Opula Syandana and Sugatra. Back it up with the deadly Redeemer gunblade and High Noon Stance.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/2025SupporterPac.zhText: 使用缤纷珮菈披饰和坠饰，潇洒地应对始源星系的危险。更有致命的救赎者枪刃和正午架式助你一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/2026Q1BattlekitD.text: Take on the dangers of the Origin System with the thundering power of the Fulmin rifle and shot-enhancing Split Chamber Mod. Do it all in style with the dazzling Opula Ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/2026Q1BattlekitD.zhText: 手持威力震天的雷霆步枪，搭配增强射击效果的分裂膛室 Mod，直面始源星系的险境。身披耀眼的缤纷幻纹，以非凡姿态纵横战场。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/2026Q3BattlekitD.text: Take on the dangers of the Origin System with the Glaxion's frigid firepower and chilling Photon Overcharge Mod, while shimmering in the Opula Armor Set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/2026Q3BattlekitD.zhText: 身穿熠熠生辉的缤纷护甲套装，凭借冷冻光束步枪的冰冷火力和令人不寒而栗的光子过载 Mod，直面始源星系的险境。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/2026Q3BattlekitP.zhText: 缤纷冷冻光束步枪套装

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AOTZMarketBundle.text: Declare your devotion to the Zariman with this Glyph and Sigil for your profile.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AOTZMarketBundle.zhText: 将这些浮印和纹章加入你的个人档案中，向扎里曼表达你的忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ActionFigureVFXB.text: A bundle of Visual Effects themed items used to decorate your Personal Quarters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ActionFigureVFXB.zhText: 一组视觉特效为主题的道具，用来装饰你的私人房间。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ActionGlyphsBund.text: Show off your style, with this action packed collection of Warframe glyphs.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ActionGlyphsBund.zhText: 用这款充满动感的战甲浮印组合包展现你的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorAth.text: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorAth.zhText: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的独家服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。适用于漂泊者与指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorGot.text: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorGot.zhText: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。适用于漂泊者与指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorGru.text: Keep it real on the streets with this collection of thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorGru.zhText: 穿上这套灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.text: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.zhText: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.text: Sneak behind enemy lines with this collection of scavenged Grineer Lancer armor. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.zhText: 使用这套 Grineer 枪兵护甲组合包深入敌后。为漂泊者量身定制。
漂泊者 Grineer 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.text: Have the Operator or Drifter embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.zhText: 让指挥官或漂泊者穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.text: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own. Now it can be the Drifter or Operator's too.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.zhText: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有自身的风格。现在，漂泊者或指挥官也可以拥有同样的风采。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.text: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.zhText: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。
漂泊者独孤游侠组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.text: A full pressure suit inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.zhText: 一款以千纸鹤为灵感的密闭服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.text: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn's Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AdultOperatorSui.zhText: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。
漂泊者凯勒套服组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AlchemistItemsBu.text: Lavos the Transmuter emerges from the seething smoke, the forgotten master of a much-misunderstood art. Includes the Lavos Warframe, Cordatus alternate helmet, Transmutation Probe decoration, Vitam Syandana, and Cedo Shotgun. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AlchemistItemsBu.zhText: 炼制术师 Lavos 从翻腾的烟雾中出现，他是被人遗忘的大师，掌握一门被人误解的艺术。包括 Lavos 战甲、明智替换头盔、炼制探头装饰、命脉披饰，以及塞多霰弹枪。还包括 3 天经验值和现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Anniversary11Gly.text: A bundle featuring glyphs from Community Artist DarikaArt.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Anniversary11Gly.zhText: 组合包内含由社区艺术家 DarikaArt 设计的浮印。
十一周年玩家社区浮印组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.text:
INSTANTLY REINFORCE YOUR ARSENAL!

Venture into the dark Void of the Zariman with a fully reinforced Arsenal! Add new Weapons, Customizations, Boosters and more to your Arsenal for a limited time, including the evolving Tenno badge of honor, the Vasero Sekhara, and the striking Hespar Scythe.

Pack Includes:
- Vasero Sekhara
- Hespar Heavy Scythe
- Galeforce Dawn Stance Mod
- Zariman Glyph*
- Zariman Sigil*
- 7-Day Resource Booster
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster

One per account. Items marked with a * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.zhText:
即刻强化你的军械库！

携带完全强化过的军械库进入「扎里曼号」的幽暗虚空！在限定的时间内，将全新的武器、自定义装饰、加成物品，以及更多精彩物品添加到你的军械库，其中包括可进化的星种饰冠和引人注目的暮斩镰刀。

组合包内含：
- 星种饰冠
- 暮斩重型镰刀
- 狂风压境架式 Mod
- 扎里曼浮印*
- 扎里曼纹章*
- 7 天资源数量加成
- 7 天资源掉落几率加成

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 “*” 的物品仅能在限定时间内，通过这个组合包获取。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.text: Angels of the Zariman Emergence Pack
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.zhText: 《扎里曼的天使》初露锋芒组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.text:
UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL!
