Venture into the dark Void of the Zariman with a fully reinforced Arsenal! Unleash electric fury as the newest Warframe, Gyre; unlock a bounty of new Customizations with Voidshell Warframe Skins; and master brand-new Weapons as you bring light to the dark and deadly Zariman.

Pack Includes:
- Vasero Sekhara
- Hespar Heavy Scythe
- Galeforce Dawn Stance Mod
- Zariman Glyph*
- Zariman Sigil*
- 7-Day Resource Booster
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster
- 500 Platinum
- Gyre Warframe
- Gyre Automaton Helmet
- Gyratory Sphere Decoration
- Triodic Syandana
- Alternox Rifle
- Saryn Voidshell Skin
- Volt Voidshell Skin
- Rhino Voidshell Skin
- 18 Material Structures

One per account. Items marked with a * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.zhText:
即刻强化你的军械库！

携带完全强化过的军械库进入「扎里曼号」的幽暗虚空！化身为最新的战甲 Gyre 来释放狂电之怒；通过虚空之壳战甲外观解锁大量全新的自定义装饰；并驾驭全新的武器来为幽暗致命的「扎里曼号」带来希望之光。

组合包内含：
- 星种饰冠
- 暮斩重型镰刀
- 狂风压境架式 Mod
- 扎里曼浮印*
- 扎里曼纹章*
- 7 天资源数量加成
- 7 天资源掉落几率加成
- 500 白金
- Gyre 战甲
- Gyre 姬械头盔
- 回旋球装饰 
- 三重披饰
- 电幻步枪
- Saryn 虚空之壳外观
- Volt 虚空之壳外观
- Rhino 虚空之壳外观
- 18 材料结构

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 “*” 的物品仅能在限定时间内，通过这个组合包获取。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.text: Angels of the Zariman Chrysalith Pack
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AotZSupporterPac.zhText: 《扎里曼的天使》羽化之穹组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AshDeluxeIISkinB.text: Extend the hand of death with the cold grace of Ash Shroud. Features the Ash Shroud Skin, Cremata Syandana, and Causta Bow Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AshDeluxeIISkinB.zhText: 通过 Ash 裹尸布的优雅寒意来伸出死亡之手。内含 Ash 裹尸布外观、焚烬披饰，以及灼蚀之弓外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AtlasDeluxeSkinB.text: Shake the earth with this collection of deluxe items for Atlas that includes the Atlas Karst Skin, Tecton Sparring Skin and Stratum Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AtlasDeluxeSkinB.zhText: 通过这个华丽外观组合包来撼动大地吧，此组合包内含  Atlas 岩溶外观、 地构搏击外观和地层披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AvionicsLavanBun.text: This Avionics Bundle showcases the House Lavan range of Avionics.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AvionicsLavanBun.zhText: 该航电设备组合包展示了 Lavan 学派的系列航电产品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AvionicsVidarBun.text: This Avionics Bundle showcases the House Vidar range of Avionics.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AvionicsVidarBun.zhText: 该航电设备组合包展示了 Vidar 学派的系列航电产品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AvionicsZektiBun.text: This Avionics Bundle showcases the House Zetki range of Avionics.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/AvionicsZektiBun.zhText: 该航电设备组合包展示了 Zetki 学派的系列航电产品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BansheeDeluxe2Se.text: An eerily twisted set of accessories for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BansheeDeluxe2Se.zhText: 一套守护宠物诡异扭曲的配件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BansheeDeluxe2Sk.text: Lament the spirits of the dead, and for those whose time is now here. The veil between worlds is fallen, and Banshee Threnodia strides forth in all her gaunt glory.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BansheeDeluxe2Sk.zhText: 悼念亡灵，也为那些大限将至之人悲鸣。两界之间的帷幕已然落下，Banshee 挽歌以她那枯槁而威严的姿态昂然现身。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BansheeVoidshell.text:
Adorn Banshee in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Banshee Voidshell Skin and the Sonar Ripples material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BansheeVoidshell.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Banshee 虚空之壳外观以及声纳涟漪材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BardBundleDesc.text: Feel the rhythm with the Octavia Warframe, Cadenza helmet, Tenora rifle and Pandero pistol. Includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BardBundleDesc.zhText: 装备 Octavia 战甲、华彩乐章头盔、双簧管步枪、以及手鼓手枪来感受韵律。内含 3 天经验及现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BaruukDeluxeIISk.text: Transcend the chaos of battle. Baruuk Shaoshi's mystic runes show him the path to peace.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BaruukDeluxeIISk.zhText: 超越战火的混乱。Baruuk 少室的神秘符文为他指明了通往和平的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BaruukDeluxeSkin.text: Baruuk Doan is the calm center of a chaotic storm. This collection includes the Baruuk Doan Skin, Harmatt Sparring Skin, and Khinn Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BaruukDeluxeSkin.zhText: Baruuk 铃僧代表着混乱风暴中心的那份平静。组合包内含 Baruuk 铃僧外观、沙寂搏击外观和经行披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BillowingArmourB.text: The preferred armor set of those who call both the mists of morning and the fog of war home. A perfect complement to the Cumulus Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BillowingArmourB.zhText: 那些称清晨迷雾和战争烟云为家的人的首选护甲套装。这是对积云披饰的一个完美诠释。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BillowingSkinsBu.text: A cosmetic collection as ethereal as a misted mountain and as striking as a thunderclap. Contains the Stratus Pistol Skin, Cumulus Syandana and Cirrus Armor Set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BillowingSkinsBu.zhText: 一个像薄雾笼罩的山一样空灵，像雷霆之击一样震耳的外观组合包。其中包括云海手枪外观，积云披饰和卷云护甲套装。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BrokenFrameItems.text: Xaku arrives from the Void as a strange and enigmatic new force. Includes the Xaku Warframe, Kintsu alternate helmet, Artifex Syandana, and Quassus Warfan. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/BrokenFrameItems.zhText: Xaku，一股来自虚空的奇特神秘力量。该组合包内含 Xaku 战甲、金缮替换头盔、工艺披饰、威震武扇。此外也包含 3 天经验值和现金加成.。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CLWTattooMegaBun.text: Enjoy an eclectic variety of expressive designs. The Multiform Visage Ink Bundle includes Gneissic Visage Ink and all the designs from the Cloned Flesh, Taxmen, and Devotion Visage Ink Collections. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CLWTattooMegaBun.zhText: 享受不拘一格且富有表现力的样式。多样面部纹身墨水组合包内含漂泊者的片麻岩面部纹身墨水，以及来自复制肉体、税务官，挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包中的所有面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。
多样面部纹身墨水组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CalibanBundleDes.text: Adapt to overcome any threat with Caliban, the perfect fusion of Sentient and Warframe capabilities. This collection includes the Caliban Warframe, the Caliban Cranion Helmet, Venato scythe, Neurovyre Syandana and Sporavyre Sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CalibanBundleDes.zhText: Sentient 和战甲功能的完美融合，用 Caliban 适应并克服任何威胁。该组合包内含 Caliban 战甲、Caliban 锐颅头盔、脉纹镰刀、灵噬披饰和孢噬坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CalibanDeluxeSki.text: Venture boldly into the Otherworld with Caliban Orfeo. His collection includes the Caliban Orfeo Skin, Seighe Venato Skin, Heurodis Ephemera, and Heurodis Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CalibanDeluxeSki.zhText: 通过 Caliban 奥菲欧勇闯异世界。他的组合包内含 Caliban 奥菲欧外观、见战脉纹外观和尤丽迪茜幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ChromaDeluxeBund.text: This regal collection contains the Chroma Dynasty Skin, Heavy Blade Dominion Skin and Eminence Sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ChromaDeluxeBund.zhText: 这款帝王般的组合包包含了 Chroma 王朝外观、君权巨刃外观以及显贵坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CitrineDeluxeBun.text: Light the flame of eternal love with Citrine Aphrodita.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CitrineDeluxeBun.zhText: 用 Citrine 美神点燃永恒之爱的火焰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CitrineItemsBund.text: Seize fractal power. This pack includes the Citrine Warframe, Steflos and Corufell weapons, Citrine Sigil, Alumeti Sugatra, Citrine Kalite Helmet, and the Belric and Rania Reunited Ship Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CitrineItemsBund.zhText: 掌控分形的力量。这个组合包内含 Citrine 战甲、石晶之花和闪劫武器、Citrine 纹章、矾茂坠饰、Citrine 盐烁头盔，以及贝里克与拉尼娅团聚飞船装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ComicGlyphsBundl.text: Add to your collection with these halftone glyphs.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ComicGlyphsBundl.zhText: 将这些半色调浮印加入到你的收藏当中。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting various Warframes, created by Community Artists CalamityDeath, Kirdy, Ritens, UpsideDownSmore, and StudioCyen.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.zhText: 一组突出展示各种战甲的浮印，由社区艺术家 CalamityDeath、Kirdy、Ritens、UpsideDownSmore 和 StudioCyen 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting various Warframes, created by Community Artists Zarionis, Veroz, LeoDoodling, ibumuc, and Endquar.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.zhText: 一组突出展示各种战甲的浮印，由社区艺术家 Zarionis、Veroz、LeoDoodling、ibumuc 和 Endquar 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting various Warframes, created by Community Artists MuraCasardis, Finlaena, CleoNaturin, SpaceWaifu, and VoliOsnowong.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.zhText: 一组突出显示各种战甲的浮印，由社区艺术家 MuraCasardis、Finlaena、CleoNaturin、SpaceWaifu 和 VoliOsnowong 创作。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting various Warframes, created by Community Artists Pyrah, Disfusional, irisillych, and Dyana Smythe.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.zhText: 一组突出展示各种战甲的浮印，由社区艺术家 Pyrah、Disfusional、irisillych 和 Dyana Smythe 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting various Warframes, created by Community Artists AesopYOLIAN, RoboMythos, TBGKaru, RoyalPrat, and Shiro_Kosh_a.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.zhText: 一款浮印组合包，突显了多款战甲的风采，由社区艺术家 AesopYOLIAN、RoboMythos、TBGKaru、RoyalPrat，和 Shiro_Kosh_a 创作。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting various Warframes, created by Community Artists Darika W, FrostyNovaPrime, IzedaDatori, Pertti Lancer, and Shivecu.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphBu.zhText: 一组突出展示各种战甲的浮印，由社区艺术家 Darika W、FrostyNovaPrime、IzedaDatori、Pertti Lancer 和 Shivecu 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphsB.text: A series of infested On-lyne glyphs by Community Artist death_ma666ots.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphsB.zhText: 一系列线上时代感染浮印，由社区艺术家 death_ma666ots 创作。
线上时代感染社区浮印组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphsB.text: A series of Radiant On-lyne glyphs by Community Artist death_ma666ots.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphsB.zhText: 一系列线上时代光辉浮印，由社区艺术家 death_ma666ots 创作。
线上时代光辉社区浮印组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphsB.text: A collection of radiant and infested On-lyne glyphs by Community Artist death_ma666ots.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CommunityGlyphsB.zhText: 一系列线上时代光辉和感染浮印，由社区艺术家 death_ma666ots 创作。
线上时代社区浮印组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CompleteBoosterB.text: Accelerate your game to new heights with four 30-Day Boosters. Earn 2x as much Affinity, Credits and Resources.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CompleteBoosterB.zhText: 通过这四个 30 天加成，来将你的游戏加速到全新的高度。这些物品可让你获得双倍经验值、现金和资源数量。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CompleteStarterS.text: Expand your Arsenal with more slots for your Warframes, Weapons and Companions.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CompleteStarterS.zhText: 为你的战甲、武器和同伴扩充军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CompleteUpgradBu.text: Take your Warframe and Weapons to the peak of their power with the Complete Upgrade Bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CompleteUpgradBu.zhText: 通过完整升级组合包，让你的战甲和武器达到威力之巅。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ConclaveSunMoonO.text: These pulsating ornaments are an ode to your dedication to The Conclave. Display them proudly in your ship.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ConclaveSunMoonO.zhText: 这些持续脉动着的装饰品是用来歌颂你对武形秘议的奉献。自豪地在你的飞船里展示它们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ConclaveSunMoonO.text: Sun And Moon Oro Decorations Bundle
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ConclaveSunMoonO.zhText: 日月 Oro 装饰品组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CorpusHighArmorB.text: Newly discovered composites are what makes this striking armor set possible.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CorpusHighArmorB.zhText: 最新发现的复合材料使制作这套惊人的护甲成为可能。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CorpusWeaponBund.text: Arca weapons represent the bleeding-edge of Corpus research and fabrication. This bundle includes the Arca Titron hammer, Arca Plasmor shotgun, Arca Scisco scoped pistol, and the Arca armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CorpusWeaponBund.zhText: 弧电系列的武器代表着 Corpus 尖端的研究成果和制造工艺。这款组合包内包含弧电振子锤、弧电离子霰弹枪、带瞄准镜的弧电探知者手枪和弧电护甲套装。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CrpDeadlockItems.text: Profit from the latest in Corpus combat innovations. Contains the Stahlta rifle, Stropha gunblade and Shi Armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CrpDeadlockItems.zhText: 得益于最新的 Corpus 战斗创新。包含钢刃步枪 、诡计之刃，以及死逝护甲套装。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CrpIndexItemPack.text: Master market forces with this collection of Corpus items. Includes the electrified Ohma Melee Weapon, Quaro Armor Set, Quaro Sugatra, and Sovereign Outcast Stance.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/CrpIndexItemPack.zhText: 用这组 Corpus 物品组合包掌控市场力量。其中包含带电的欧玛近战武器、求知护甲套装、求知坠饰和至尊浪人架式。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Cyte09ItemsBundl.text: Take aim as the sharpshooter Warframe, Cyte-09, along with his signature Weapons and Customizations.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Cyte09ItemsBundl.zhText: 以神枪手战甲 Cyte-09 的身份瞄准目标，并配备其标志性武器和自定义装备。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Cyte09SupPackDes.text:
Take aim as the sharpshooter Warframe, Cyte-09, along with his signature Weapons and Customizations. 

This bundle may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Cyte09SupPackDes.zhText:
以神枪手战甲 Cyte-09 的身份瞄准目标，并配备其标志性武器和自定义装备。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DagathItemsBundl.text: Gaze into the mirror that accuses. This collection includes the Dagath Warframe, her Dorrclave weapon, the Dagath Ganceann Helmet, and Aumen Kaithe Gear.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DagathItemsBundl.zhText: 凝视控诉之镜。该组合包内含 Dagath 战甲、她的怒斩武器、Dagath 无首头盔，以及金兆绝灵骥装备。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DanteChroniclesP.text:
Bring the power of the Warframe chronicler, Dante, to your Arsenal along with a devastating Incarnon Melee Weapon and his signature Customizations! 

This pack features:
<MINI_ARROW> Dante Collection
        Dante Warframe
        Dante Cantist Helmet
        Oranist Armor
        Rencowl Syandana
        Ruvox Melee Weapon
        Noctua's Paragrimm
<MINI_ARROW> Extras
        Observant Vitreum
        Dante's Delight Glyph
        Dante's Noctua Sigil
        125 Platinum

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DanteChroniclesP.zhText:
将 Warframe 编年史学家 Dante 的力量、毁灭性的灵化近战武器，以及他标志性的自定义装饰带入你的军械库！ 

此组合包内含：
<MINI_ARROW>- Dante 系列物品
        Dante 战甲
        Dante 撰诗者头盔
        奥哲护甲
        富思披饰
        古声近战武器
        夜枭的幽幽鹰
<MINI_ARROW>额外物品
        洞察魔瞳
        Dante 的喜悦浮印
        Dante 的夜枭纹章
        125 白金

每个账号仅限购买一次此组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DanteItemsBundle.text: Write a new chapter for the keeper of history. His collection includes the Dante Warframe, Dante Cantist Helmet, Rencowl Syandana, Oranist Armor, Ruvox Melee Weapon, and Noctua's Paragrimm Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DanteItemsBundle.zhText: 为历史的守护者谱写新的篇章。他的组合包内含 Dante 战甲、Dante 撰诗者头盔、富思披饰、奥哲护甲、古声近战武器以及夜枭的幽幽鹰装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DaybreakArmourBu.text: Dazzle friends and enemies alike, with this armor’s solar brilliance.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DaybreakArmourBu.zhText: 这套护甲的太阳光辉让朋友和敌人都为之眩目。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DeimosItemBundle.text: You are pestilence and plague with the Deimos Infested Bundle. Includes the Zymos Pistol, Keratinos Claws, and Sordario Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DeimosItemBundle.zhText: 通过火卫二感染组合包来成为最致命的肆虐瘟疫。包括邪莫斯手枪、卡提努之爪和心瘤披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DeimosItemBundle.text: New weapons have emerged from the seething horror of the Infestation, each bringing a fresh, living aspect to their power. Featuring the bile-loaded Catabolyst Pistol, Proboscis Cernos Bow, Pulmonars Nunchaku, and the devastating Bubonico Arm Cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DeimosItemBundle.zhText: 全新的武器已从感染者恐怖的攻击浪潮中浮现，每一把武器都带来了崭新的气象。拥有胆汁装填的异化者（手枪类武器）、刺吸西诺斯（弓类武器）、感染连枷（ 双截棍类武器）和毁灭性的横痃重炮（手炮类武器）。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DesertCamoSkinBu.text: A desert camouflage skin pack for your Grineer arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DesertCamoSkinBu.zhText: 为你呈现 Grineer 军械库的沙漠迷彩外观包。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DesignerGlyphBun.text: A collection of glyphs created by artists in the Warframe community.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DesignerGlyphBun.zhText: 一组来自 Warframe 社区的艺术家创作的浮印。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DevilsTriadFloof.text: Bring home the familiar faces of the Devil’s Triad - whether friends or enemies, now cuddly for your convenience!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DevilsTriadFloof.zhText: 把《恶魔三重奏》中熟悉的面孔带回家——无论是朋友还是敌人，现在都变成了适合拥抱的可爱玩偶！
软萌三重奏玩偶组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DiscordNitroSary.text: Saryn Nitro Bundle - Free With Discord Nitro
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DiscordNitroSary.zhText: Saryn Nitro 组合包— Discord Nitro 用户免费获得

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DiscordNitroSary.text:
Get free perks every month with Discord Nitro! Claim the Saryn Nitro Bundle and get instant access to: 
- Saryn Warframe with Warframe Slot 
- Saryn Orphid Skin 
- Dual Swords Cyskis Skin 
- Melia Sugatra 
- Embolist Armor Bundle 
- Samia Syandana 
- Saryn Noggle Statue 
- 7-Day Resource Drop Chance Booster 
- Scrolling Ship Decoration
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DiscordNitroSary.zhText:
通过 DISCORD NITRO 来获得每月的额外奖励！取得 Saryn Nitro 组合包来立即获取：
- Saryn 战甲（自带 战甲槽位）
- Saryn 兰花外观
- 双剑赛斯克外观
- 栋之坠饰 
- 安柏勒斯 护甲组合包
- 眉纹天蚕蛾披饰
- Saryn 摇头娃娃 
- 7 天资源掉落几率加成
- 滚动式飞船装饰

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DraperyHorseAcce.text: Dress your Kaithe as Rakhali, Dagath's noble steed. This collection includes the Aumen Chamfron, Saddle, and Tail.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DraperyHorseAcce.zhText: 把你的绝灵骥打扮成 Dagath 的高贵骏马拉卡里。其中包含金兆马盔、马鞍和马尾。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuvArmourBundleD.text: Stride into the fray with fractal elegance.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuvArmourBundleD.zhText: 以变幻的优雅之姿阔步迈入战场。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriBundleFabl.text: Dress just like the hero described in the famous storybook, Tales of Duviri. The Fabled Warrior Pack includes the Aesopex Armor, Gabrai Kavat Armor, Drifter Loneryder Suit, Lonesome Shawzin, and Only Beyond Vistagraph.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriBundleFabl.zhText: 照着著名的《双衍王境故事集》中的英雄形象来着装。传奇战士组合包内含伊索派斯护甲、伽勃利库娃护甲套服、漂泊者独孤游侠套服、孤寂三线琴和唯有彼方景幕。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriCommunityA.text: A Duviri-themed pack featuring a Glyph and Display made by community artists.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriCommunityA.zhText: 一个双衍王境主题组合包，内含一个由社区艺术家制作的浮印和展示图。
双衍王境社区艺术组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriHorseBundl.text: In Tales of Duviri, good riders ensure their Kaithes are well-appointed. The Steed's Regalia Pack includes distinctive tails, chamfrons, and a saddle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriHorseBundl.zhText: 在《双衍王境故事集》中，优秀的骑手确保他们的绝灵骥装备精良。华服骏马组合包内含独特的马尾、马盔和马鞍。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriHorseBundl.text: Tales of Duviri tells of Aetigo Kaithes that roamed verdant plains. The Grassland Steed Pack brings that aesthetic to life.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriHorseBundl.zhText: 《双衍王境故事集》中讲述了漫游在青翠平原上的因理绝灵骥。草原骏马组合包将这种美学带到了现实生活中。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriHorseBundl.text: Tales of Duviri tells of Psyacus Kaithes that inspired fear in the faint of heart. The Outland Steed Pack embodies a courageous aesthetic.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriHorseBundl.zhText: 《双衍王境故事集》中讲述了使胆小者恐惧的心道绝灵骥。外域骏马组合包体现了一种勇敢的美学。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriWeaponsBun.text: Strike your enemies down with weapons that are just as elegant as they are powerful. The Heavy Strike Melee Bundle includes the Azothane, Syam, Edun, and Sampotes melee weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/DuviriWeaponsBun.zhText: 用优雅而强大的武器痛击你的敌人。猛力重击近战组合包内含溶灵尊、业珀、雷石祭和三宝聚近战武器。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberDeluxeIISki.text: Kindle Ember's elemental fire in its most refined form yet. Includes Ember Pyraxis Skin, Volca Syandana and Flamethrower Plazm Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberDeluxeIISki.zhText: Ember 的元素之火以其最精炼的形式点燃。内含 Ember 燃烬外观，熔焰披饰，以及火焰喷射器炎浆外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberDeluxeSkinB.text: Rise from the ashes with this flamboyant collection. Includes Ember Vermillion Skin, Nusku Pistol Skin and Bennu Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberDeluxeSkinB.zhText: 用这款火焰般的组合包从灰烬中再生。包含了 Ember 朱红外观，努斯库手枪外观和班努鸟披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberHeirloomPac.text:
Embody the legacy of the Origin System's brightest flame with the Ember Heirloom Sear Collection. Featuring a suite of Customizations imbued with the earth-shattering power of volcanoes and molten magma.  

This Collection features:

- Ember Heirloom Skin
- Ember Heirloom Signa
- Ember Heirloom Glyph
- Ember Heirloom Sigil
- Ember Heirloom Color Palette
- Ember Heirloom Prex
- 425 Platinum

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberHeirloomPac.zhText:
通过 Ember 传家宝灼热组合包展现始源星系最耀眼火焰的传承。包含一套充满火山和熔岩震撼力量的自定义装饰。 

组合包内含：

- Ember 传家宝外观
- Ember 传家宝头环
- Ember 传家宝浮印
- Ember 传家宝纹章
- Ember 传家宝调色盘
- Ember 传家宝 Prex 卡牌
- 425 白金

该组合包每个账号仅限购买一次。
Ember 传家宝灼热组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberVoidshellBu.text:
Adorn Ember in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Ember Voidshell Skin and Phenaureus Bark material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EmberVoidshellBu.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Ember 虚空之壳外观以及樟子松树皮材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EncoreCompSupPac.text:
Strike a dangerous chord with the Encore Complete Collection! The newest Warframe, Temple, takes center stage along with new Gemini Skins and much more! Add it all to your Arsenal instantly with the Encore Complete Collection.

This collection features all contents from both the Encore Temple Bundle and Encore Gemini Collection.

This collection may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EncoreCompSupPac.zhText:
通过安可完整组合包来拨动危险的弦！全新的战甲 Temple 和全新的双子外观等更多精彩内容重磅登场！立即将安可完整组合包的全部内容添加到你的军械库中。

此组合包内含安可 Temple 组合包和安可双子组合包的所有内容。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EncoreGeminiSupP.text:
Embolden the Hex's virtuous cause by adding this suite of Protoframe Gemini Skins and corresponding Gemini Emotes to your Arsenal.

This Collection includes:

- Flare Gemini Skin + Flare Gemini Emote
- Velimir Gemini Skin + Velimir Gemini Emote
- Minerva Gemini Skin + Minerva Gemini Emote
- Kaya Gemini Skin + Kaya Gemini Emote
- 475 Platinum

This collection may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EncoreGeminiSupP.zhText:
通过将这套原型战甲双子外观及和相应的双子表情动作添加至你的军械库，以壮大六人组的正义事业。

该组合包内含：

- 弗莱尔双子外观 + 弗莱尔双子表情动作
- 维利米尔双子外观 + 维利米尔双子表情动作
- 米尼娃双子外观 + 米尼娃双子表情动作
- 卡娅双子外观 + 卡娅双子表情动作
- 475 白金

每个账号只能购买该组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EntratiStorySkip.text: Buy this pack with platinum? Believe it or not, straight to Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EntratiStorySkip.zhText: 用白金购买这个组合包？信不信由你，直面英择谛。
英择谛故事跳过组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EpicWeaponSkinBu.text: Claim first blood with Unreal Tournament weapon skins for Ogris, Drakgoon, and Stahlta.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EpicWeaponSkinBu.zhText: 使用食人女魔、龙骑兵和钢刃步枪的虚幻竞技场外观赢得第一滴血。
虚幻竞技场外观组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EquinoxDeluxeSki.text: Kill with contrast using this signature collection for Equinox. This collection includes the Equinox Antonym Skin, Astreos Sword and Shield Skin and Circadian Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EquinoxDeluxeSki.zhText: 使用这个 Equinox 标志性组合包来利用其昼夜面来击杀敌人吧。其中包括 Equinox 悖异外观，星辰剑盾外观和节律披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialColdMod.text: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialColdMod.zhText: 这个套组的武器 Mod 让你可立即以 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！
冰冻伤害 Mod 基础组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialCritMod.text: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons' Critical Chance. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialCritMod.zhText: 这个套组的武器 Mod 可以让你立即提高武器的暴击几率。也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落，以及其它方式来获取这个组合包内的所有物品！
暴击几率 Mod 基础组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialDamageM.text: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons' Base Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialDamageM.zhText: 这个套组的武器 Mod 让你可立即提升武器的基础伤害。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！
基础伤害 Mod 基础组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialElectri.text: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialElectri.zhText: 这个套组的武器 Mod 让你可立即以 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！
电击伤害 Mod 基础组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialHeatMod.text: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialHeatMod.zhText: 这个套组的武器 Mod 让你可立即以 <DT_HEAT>火焰伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！
火焰伤害 Mod 基础组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialParazon.text: A Bundle featuring new Mods for your Parazon that give perks to Hacking or performing 'Mercy' kills on enemies. Purchased Mods are unranked.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialParazon.zhText: 这份组合包包含了全新的灭骸之刃 Mod，在入侵或对敌人使用"怜悯之击"时提供额外加成。所购买的 Mod 是无等级的。
基础灭骸之刃 Mod 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialToxinMo.text: This set of Weapon Mods gives you instant access to upgrading your Weapons with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Everything in this pack can also be earned from mission rewards, enemy drops, and more!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EssentialToxinMo.zhText: 这个套组的武器 Mod 让你可立即以 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害升级你的武器。这个组合包的所有东西也可以通过任务奖励、敌人掉落等方式来获取！
毒素伤害 Mod 基础组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenBooster.text: A cache containing various 7 Day Boosters
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenBooster.zhText: 一个内含各种 7 天加成器的储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenExilusP.zhText: 一个内含 3 个特殊功能槽连接器的储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenFormaPa.zhText: 一个内含 3 个 FORMA 的储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenFusionP.text: A cache containing a large amount of Endo
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenFusionP.zhText: 一个内含大量内融核心的储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenKuvaPac.text: A cache containing a large amount of Kuva
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenKuvaPac.zhText: 一个内含大量赤毒的储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenMeleeRi.text: A cache containing 3 Melee Riven Mods
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenMeleeRi.zhText: 一个内含 3 张近战裂罅 Mod 的储藏箱
近战裂罅 Mod 储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenRifleRi.text: A cache containing 3 Rifle Riven Mods
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenRifleRi.zhText: 一个内含 3 张步枪裂罅 Mod 的储藏箱
步枪裂罅 Mod 储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenSeconda.text: A cache containing 3 Pistol Riven Mods
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenSeconda.zhText: 一个内含 3 张手枪裂罅 Mod 的储藏箱
手枪裂罅 Mod 储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/EvergreenWeaponS.zhText: 一个内含 4 个武器槽位的储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburDeluxeO.text: The System is yours with this Excalibur Zato-inspired cosmetic collection for your Operator. Includes Zato Oculus, Zato Earpiece and Zato Facial Accessory for your Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburDeluxeO.zhText: 当你的指挥官装备这个由 Excalibur 盲侠启发的涂装组合包，这个星系是属于你的了。其中包括：盲侠眼饰、盲侠耳饰和盲侠脸部装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburDeluxeS.text:
Wander the world, beholden to none. The Excalibur Zato Collection includes the Excalibur Zato Skin, Zato Sugatra and the Oku Nikana Skin.

Includes Excalibur Zato Agile and Noble animation sets.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburDeluxeS.zhText:
只身一人，流浪天涯。Excalibur 盲侠组合包内含 Excalibur 盲侠外观、盲侠坠饰和大奥侍刃外观。

也包括 Excalibur 盲侠迅捷和尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburJadeBun.text:
Get instant access to Xbox-exclusive Customizations and adorn your Arsenal with a new Warframe Skin, Weapon Skin and much more!

Bundle Includes:
- Excalibur Jade Skin
- Excalibur Jade Noggle
- Tonkor Jade Skin (includes Tonkor Grenade Launcher)
- Liset Jade Skin
- Jade Daedalus Armor Set
- Capala Jade Sigil
- 7-Day Affinity Booster

Only one per account, available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburJadeBun.zhText:
即刻获取 Xbox 平台专属的自定义装饰，并通过全新的战甲外观、武器外观，以及更多精彩内容来装点你的军械库！

组合包内含：
- Excalibur 翡翠外观
- 翡翠 Excalibur 摇头娃娃
- 征服榴炮翡翠外观（包含征服榴炮）
- Liset 翡翠外观
- 翡翠代达罗斯护甲组合包
- 卡帕拉翡翠纹章
- 7 天经验值加成

 本组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburVoidshe.text:
Adorn Excalibur in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Excalibur Voidshell Skin and Lunaro Striker material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ExcaliburVoidshe.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Excalibu 虚空之壳外观以及皎月先锋材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FollieSupPackDes.text: Make art your weapon, with the shadowgrapher Follie
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FollieSupPackDes.zhText: 通过绘影者 Follie 将艺术与你的武器完美融合

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FortunaMegaBundl.text: This massive bundle combines the Garuda Collection and the Orb Vallis Survival Collection. Includes the Garuda Warframe, Nagantaka Crossbow, Garuda Bathory Helmet, Suparna Syandana, Battacor Rifle, Ocucor Pistol and Kreska Ice Pick. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters, and the timed bundle-exclusive Bloodshed Sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FortunaMegaBundl.zhText: 这个大型组合包结合了 Garuda 组合包以及奥布山谷生存组合包。其包含 Garuda 战甲、噬蛇弩、Garuda 巴托里头盔、金鹏披饰、武使之力步枪、视使之触手枪，以及直镐冰镐。同时也包含了 3 天经验值加成和现金加成以及限时组合包限定的血光纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FortunaTwoWeapon.text: Make their power yours with this Corpus-developed weapon collection. Includes the Exergis Shotgun, Plinx Revolver, Galvacord Whip and Flox Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FortunaTwoWeapon.zhText: 通过使用这个 Corpus 研发的武器组合包，将他们的力量化为己用。包括晶能放射器霰弹枪，漫射者左轮手枪，电流刺索鞭子和弗洛克斯披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FrostDeluxeBundl.text: This icy bundle contains the Frost Harka Skin and the Longsword Frysta Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FrostDeluxeBundl.zhText: 这套冰凉的组合包包含了 Frost 寒地牛怪外观和长剑凝冰外观

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FrostVoidshellBu.text:
Adorn Frost in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Frost Voidshell Skin and Cryosleeper material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FrostVoidshellBu.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Frost 虚空之壳外观以及低温眠者材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FurisArmourPackD.text: Streamlined decorative armor in the style of the Furis and Sybaris.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/FurisArmourPackD.zhText: 流线的装饰性护甲，与盗贼和席芭莉丝有着同样的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaraDeluxeSkinBu.text: Dazzle with this scintillating collection of deluxe Gara items. Features the Gara Kaleida Skin, Glistor Syandana, and Rephrax Longsword Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaraDeluxeSkinBu.zhText: 这件 Gara 华丽组合包的闪亮物品令人眼花缭乱。内含 Gara 斑斓外观、闪亮披饰，以及折光长剑外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GarudaBundleDesc.text: Death's maiden draws near with this collection of bloody Garuda items. This grisly collection includes the Garuda Warframe, Nagantaka Crossbow, Garuda Bathory Helmet, and Suparna Syandana. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters, and the timed bundle-exclusive Bloodshed Sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GarudaBundleDesc.zhText: 这款血淋淋 Garuda 道具的组合包使得死亡之赤红少女越来越靠近。这款恐怖的组合包内含 Garuda 战甲、噬蛇弩、Garuda 巴托里头盔，以及金鹏披饰。内含 3 天经验值加成和现金加成以及限时组合包限定的血光纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GarudaDeluxeSkin.text: Commence the sacred butchery with this striking skin collection. Includes the Garuda Hinsa Warframe Skin, Verta Warfan Skin and Dessicata Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GarudaDeluxeSkin.zhText: 用这套惊人的外观组合包开启神圣的残杀。组合包中包含 Garuda 残暴战甲外观、冰绿武扇外观，以及枯骨披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussBundleDesc.text: Accelerate past the redline with Gauss. This collection includes the Gauss Warframe, Gauss Mag Helmet, Altra Syandana, Acceltra rapid-fire rocket launcher, and Akarius secondary rocket launchers. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussBundleDesc.zhText: 通过 Gauss 加速至超越赤线。此组合包内含 Gauss、Gauss 磁力头盔、阿尔特拉披饰、迅发电浆炮速射火箭发射器，和阿利乌榴弹发射器。另包括 3 天经验值加成和现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussDeluxeHorse.text: Give your Kaithe Gauss Kresnik's singeing style. This collection includes the Aethon Chamfron, Saddle, and Tail.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussDeluxeHorse.zhText: 赋予你的绝灵骥如 Gauss 火神般的焦燃风格。该组合包内含神驱马盔、马鞍和马尾。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussDeluxeSkinB.text: Go full throttle with Gauss Kresnik. His fiery collection includes the Gauss Kresnik Skin, Bolide Syandana, and Acceltra Caduceus Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussDeluxeSkinB.zhText: 用 Gauss 火神全速前进。他那火一般的组合包内含 Gauss 火神外观、火流星披饰以及迅发电浆炮 双蛇外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussGrendalDelu.text: [PH] Gundam Gauss and Grendel deluxe bundle description
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GaussGrendalDelu.zhText: [PH] Gundam Gauss and Grendel deluxe bundle description

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GeminiHexCompSup.text:
The complete value for Tenno. Take aim as the sharpshooter Warframe, Cyte-09, and instantly add all the Gemini Skins to your Arsenal!

This Collection features all contents from both the Cyte-09 Bullseye Bundle and 1999 Gemini Oath Collection.

This collection may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GeminiHexCompSup.zhText:
Tenno 的全套大礼包。以神枪手战甲 Cyte-09 的身份瞄准目标，并立即将所有双子外观添加到你的军械库！

此组合包内含 Cyte-09 靶心组合包和《1999》双子誓言组合包的所有内容。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GeminiSkins1999B.text:
Embody the six members of The Hex with this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GeminiSkins1999B.zhText:
通过这组原型战甲双子外观化身为六人组的六名成员。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GeminiSkinsSupPa.text:
Assemble the Hex in your Arsenal instantly thanks to this complete suite of Protoframe Gemini Skins and corresponding Gemini Emotes.

This collection may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GeminiSkinsSupPa.zhText:
借助这套完整的原型战甲双子外观和相应的双子表情动作，立即在你的军械库中召唤六人组。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GlamrockSupPackD.text:
Bring the house down by adding Temple's ruinous riffs, plus their signature Weapons and Customizations, to your Arsenal.

This bundle may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GlamrockSupPackD.zhText:
将 Temple 的毁灭之音，以及他的标志性武器和自定义装饰，加入你的军械库中。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GlassBundleDesc.text: Shatter the enemy with the crystalline power of Gara and her signature items. This collection includes the Gara Warframe, Astilla rifle, Fusilai throwing knives, Volnus hammer, Hyalus Syandana, Gara Virago Helmet, and 3-day credit and Affinity boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GlassBundleDesc.zhText: 以 Gara 的水晶之力与带有她个人标志的装备来击溃敌人。这份组合包内装有 Gara 战甲、碎裂者步枪、齐射玻刃飞刀、创伤战锤、玻质披饰、Gara 悍妇头盔与 3 日现金及经验值加成道具。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GlyphsEssentialB.text: Show off the damage essentials with this Glyph bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GlyphsEssentialB.zhText: 用这个浮印组合包来展现伤害的本质。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrendelBundleDes.text: It's all you can eat with this collection for the gallant gourmand. Includes Grendel Warframe, Glutt Helmet, Masseter Greatsword, Sumbha Syandana and 3-day Credit and Affinity Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrendelBundleDes.zhText: 对豪爽美食家而言，这是一个能让你大饱口福的饕餮盛宴系列。组合包包含 Grendel 战甲、暴食头盔、咀嚼巨剑、苏姆婆披饰，3 天现金加成和 3天经验值加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrendelVoidshell.text:
Adorn Grendel in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Grendel Voidshell Skin and Everted Yogwun material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrendelVoidshell.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Grendel 虚空之壳外观以及外翻约格温材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrimoireModsBund.text: A bundle featuring new Mods for Tome weapons like the Grimoire. These Mods enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrimoireModsBund.zhText: 该组合包内含魔典等典籍武器的全新 Mod。这些 Mod 可提升战甲技能并鼓励策略战斗。
基础典籍 Mod 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrineerVHArmourB.text: Grineer plate, trophies from battle on the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrineerVHArmourB.zhText: Grineer 装甲板，来自夜灵平野的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrineerVHItemsBu.text: Make a devastating entrance with the Maggor Assault Pack. Includes the Quartakk quad-barrelled assault rifle and hard-hitting Stubba submachine gun, with matching Maggor armor and syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrineerVHItemsBu.zhText: 以玛戈侵袭组合包创造破口。内装有夸塔克四管突击步枪、强而有力的史度巴冲锋枪，并配有玛戈护甲与玛戈披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrnAmphisArmourB.text: Repurposed paramilitary dress, for a fast response to any situation.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrnAmphisArmourB.zhText: 重新设计的准军事服装，以快速应对任何情况。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrnAmphisItemsBu.text: Plan for a fast response. Collection includes the Quatz Pistol, Galvanik Armor, Amphatz Kubrow Armor, Amphix Kavat Armor, Amphor Syandana, and a bonus Amphis Staff.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrnAmphisItemsBu.zhText: 准备好快速反击。收藏包内含夸兹手枪、电激护甲、 安斐库狛护甲、安费斯库娃护甲、 双耳披饰和一个额外附赠的双头蛇长棍。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrnGhoulSawBundl.text: Rip, tear, and rend with the nightmarish Ghoulsaw and Butcher's Revelry Stance.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GrnGhoulSawBundl.zhText: 用噩梦般的尸鬼电锯和屠戮盛宴架式来体验撕碎敌人的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GyreDeluxeArmour.zhText: Gyre 电涡幽灵的标志性护甲套装。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GyreDeluxeSkinBu.text: Gyre crackles to life in this collection themed around archaic experimental technology.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GyreDeluxeSkinBu.zhText: 在这个以古老的实验技术为主题的组合包中，Gyre 充满了活力。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GyreItemsBundleD.text: The conductive path to Gyre’s core. This collection includes the Gyre Warframe, Gyre Automaton Helmet, Alternox Rifle, Triodic Syandana, and Gyratory Sphere Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/GyreItemsBundleD.zhText: 通往 Gyre 核心的传导之路。该组合包内含 Gyre 战甲、Gyre 姬械头盔、电幻步枪、三重披饰，以及回旋球装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HODMarketBundleD.text: Relive the glories of Deimos with this specially selected assortment of cosmetics.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HODMarketBundleD.zhText: 通过这套精选的自定义装饰，重温惊惧之心的辉煌。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Arm.text: Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies by cladding your Warframe in this ancient battle attire.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Arm.zhText: 在你的战甲上包覆这个古老的战斗装束，能将恐惧深深地烙近到敌人的内心之中。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Arm.text: Vetala Day of the Dead Armor Bundle
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Arm.zhText: 维塔拉亡灵节护甲组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Bat.text: Spread your wings and hunt through the night. This collection contains chiropteran cosmetics for both you and your Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Bat.zhText: 展翅翱翔，彻夜狩猎。这款组合包内含了适用于你与守护的蝙蝠外观装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Com.text: Enjoy every cosmetic from Day of the Dead V.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Com.zhText: 尽情享受亡灵节 V 中的每一款装饰品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Com.text: Day of the Dead V: Complete Collection
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Com.zhText: 亡灵节 V：完整组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Sen.text: A deliciously nightmarish set of accessories for your Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Sen.zhText: 一款诱人而可怕的守护配件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Wea.text: Morbidly festive weapon skins for your Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Wea.zhText: 为你的军械库提供毛骨悚然的节日武器外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Wea.text: Day of the Dead V: Weapon Skin Pack
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2023Wea.zhText: 亡灵节 V：武器外观包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Cer.text: Celebrate the departed with this ancient battle attire.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Cer.zhText: 通过这套古老的战斗服装观来纪念逝者。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Cer.text: Ceramica Day of the Dead Armor Bundle
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Cer.zhText: 陶瓷亡灵节护甲组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Com.text: Enjoy every cosmetic from Day of the Dead VI.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Com.zhText: 尽情享受亡灵节 VI 中的每一款装饰品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Com.text: Day of the Dead VI: Complete Collection
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2024Com.zhText: 亡灵节 VI：完整组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2025Com.text: A brightly painted skull and festive candles adorn this set of accessories for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Halloween2025Com.zhText: 色彩鲜艳的骷髅和节日蜡烛装饰在这套守护宠物配饰上。
小骷髅守护配件组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HarkonarSkinBund.text: A collection of Harkonar styled skins, forged by the leading Grineer weapon manufacturer. Contains skins for the Grinlok, Javlok, Kohm and Marelok.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HarkonarSkinBund.zhText: 哈库那风格外观的组合包，由头号 Grineer 武器制造商铸造。包含给葛恩火枪，燃焰标枪，寇恩热能枪和玛瑞火枪的外观。
哈库那武器外观组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HarrowDeluxeSkin.text: A shattered being bound by void and will. Includes the Harrow Reliquary Skin, Renuntio Speargun Skin and Etheria Armor Set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HarrowDeluxeSkin.zhText: 一个被虚空及其意志束缚的破碎者。包含 Harrow 圣骨匣外观，弃绝标枪外观及以希利亚护甲套装。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HelminthBundleDe.text: Helminth hungers to make you stronger. Welcome Helminth into your Orbiter with this bundle and you will be able to replace Warframe Abilities and Invigorate Warframes with temporary buffs.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HelminthBundleDe.zhText: Helminth 迫切地想让你变得更强大。使用这个组合包以欢迎 Helminth 入驻你的轨道飞行器，届时你可以切换战甲的技能，通过临时加成唤起战甲的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HildrynBundleDes.text:
Load up with Hildryn and several iconic additions for this stolid Warframe: the robust Surator Syandana, the intimidating Asuron Helmet and the distinctive Larkspur Archgun. Includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters as well as an Archgun Gravimag device.
NOTE: To deploy an Archgun equipped with a Gravimag, you will require an Archgun Deployer obtained from the Profit-Taker missions in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HildrynBundleDes.zhText:
装备上 Hildryn 以及与这款高冷的战甲相关的标志性物品：稳固的雪瑞达披饰、威风的阿苏伦头盔以及独特的翠雀曲翼枪械。此组合包还包含了3天经验和现金加成以及曲翼枪械重力磁抵器。
请注意：为了装备配载了重力磁抵器的曲翼枪械，您需要从福尔图娜的利润收割者任务中获取一个曲翼枪械设置器。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HildrynDeluxeBun.text: Hildryn arises anew, re-forged in the fires of finest smith-craft. Add splendor to her saga with this collection of deluxe items. Includes the Hildryn Einheri Skin, Blodgard Heavy Blade Skin and the Brising Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HildrynDeluxeBun.zhText: Hildryn 在工匠之火中淬炼重生。用这款华丽组合包为她的传奇故事增光添彩。内含 Hildryn 英灵外观、血卫巨刃外观，以及煦珀披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HorseCrownBundle.text: Each Kaithe Coronet in the Steed's Resolve Pack reflects a Duviri Mood Spiral. Express your Kaithe's moods just as Dominus Thrax expresses himself through Duviri's ever-changing sky.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HorseCrownBundle.zhText: 坚定骏马组合包中每个绝灵骥马冠都反映了一个双衍王境的心情复眠螺旋。就像士魂大帝通过双衍王境千变万化的天空表达自己一样，来将你绝灵骥的心情表现出来。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.text: Customize your K-Drive with Ventkids scrawl art designed by the Pobbers.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.zhText: 以 Pobbers 所设计的这款通风小子涂鸦艺术来自定你的 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.text: Customize your K-Drive with Ventkids scrawl art designed by the Pobbers.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.zhText: 以 Pobbers 所设计的这款通风小子涂鸦艺术来自定你的 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.text: Customize your K-Drive with Ventkids scrawl art designed by the Kubrodons.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.zhText: 以 Kubrodons 所设计的这款通风小子涂鸦艺术来自定你的 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.text: Customize your K-Drive with Ventkids scrawl art designed by the Kubrodons.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HoverboardSticke.zhText: 以 Kubrodons 所设计的这款通风小子涂鸦艺术来自定你的 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HydroidDeluxeSki.text:
Enter the fray in your swashbuckling finest with the Rakkam Collection. Includes the Hydroid Rakkam Skin, Carcinus Speargun Skin, and Scyph Diriga Skin and accessories for your sentinel. 

Also includes the Burangara Longcoat Auxiliary attachment for Hydroid.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/HydroidDeluxeSki.zhText:
通过逐波组合包，以最强声势进入战场。内含 Hydroid 逐波外观、海神标枪外观、蜇刺电气浮囊外观，以及你的守护配件。

还包含 Hydroid 的踏浪长衣特殊配件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IcebladeNarinSup.text: Embody the spirit of the winter's storm. Narin's piercing rapier dances amidst the howling blizzard, flying on swift wings to bring protection and devastation.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IcebladeNarinSup.zhText: 化身为冬日风暴之灵。Narin 锋利的细剑在呼啸的暴风雪之中舞动，剑气冲霄，即带来庇护，也带来毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InarosDeluxeSkin.text: Ascend the throne and become Inaros Ramses with this collection. Includes the mighty Inaros Ramses Skin, the crescent Kopesh Longsword Skin and the Scarab Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InarosDeluxeSkin.zhText: 登上王座并使用这款组合包成为 Inaros 拉美西斯。内含气势磅礴的 Inaros 拉美西斯外观、月牙形的镰刀长剑外观以及圣甲虫披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InarosLegacyBund.text: Honor Inaros with items reminiscent of his desert home. This bundle includes the Sands of Mars Ephemera, King Inaros Glyph, and Inaros Sarcophagus Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InarosLegacyBund.zhText: 通过令人联想到 Inaros 沙漠家园的物品向他致敬。该组合包内含火星之沙幻纹、Inaros 神王浮印和 Inaros 石棺装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamANoggle.text: A collection of Noggle Statues representing the brokers from the Anyocorp Reclamation Unit.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamANoggle.zhText: 一组代表了安尤企业回收部队经纪人们的摇头娃娃。
安尤企业回收部队摇头娃娃包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamBNoggle.text: A collection of Noggle Statues representing the brokers from the Anyocorp Trading Group.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamBNoggle.zhText: 一组代表了安尤企业贸易组经纪人们的摇头娃娃。
安尤企业贸易组摇头娃娃包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamCNoggle.text: A collection of Noggle Statues representing the brokers from the Claims Investigation team at Anyocorp.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamCNoggle.zhText: 一组代表了安尤企业索赔调查队经纪人们的摇头娃娃。
安尤企业索赔调查队摇头娃娃包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamDNoggle.text: A collection of Noggle Statues representing the brokers from the Investor Relations department of Anyocorp.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IndexTeamDNoggle.zhText: 一组代表了安尤企业投资人关系部经纪人们的摇头娃娃。
安尤企业投资人关系部摇头娃娃包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Inf1999ArmourBun.text: Get the look of Techrot without catching a nasty, life-destroying infection.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Inf1999ArmourBun.zhText: 科腐者风格的外观，但没有那令人厌恶的致命感染。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InfNightwaveSent.text: Give any sentinel a flair of Infestation with this pack. Contains Chitoid Sentinel Mask, Chitoid Sentinel Wings, and Chitoid Sentinel Tail.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InfNightwaveSent.zhText: 通过这件组合包，给任意守护带来一丝感染者的气息。内含几丁质守护面具、几丁质守护飞翼，以及几丁质守护尾部。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InitiateIIIConso.text:
Boost your Arsenal instantly with the new Ember Starter Pack, including a Warframe, Customizations and many more powerful items. Light the Origin System aflame with Ember's Abilities and Essential Heat Damage Mods. Get the Ember Starter Pack and burn away the opposition today!

Pack Includes:
- Ember Warframe
- Ember Phoenix Helmet
- Nikana Weapon
- Essential Heat Damage Mod Bundle

One per account. Available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InitiateIIIConso.zhText:
通过全新的 Ember 入门组合包立即增强你的军械库，组合包内含一款战甲、自定义装饰，以及更多强力物品！用 Ember 的技能和基础火焰伤害 Mod 来点燃整个始源星系。立即获取 Ember 入门组合包并将对手烧成灰烬！

组合包内含：
- Ember 战甲
- Ember 凤凰头盔
- 侍刃武器
- 火焰伤害 Mod 基础组合包

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InitiateIIIPCPac.text:
Boost your Arsenal instantly with the new Ember Starter Pack, including a Warframe, Platinum, Customizations and many more powerful items. Light the Origin System aflame with Ember's Abilities and Essential Heat Damage Mods. Get the Ember Starter Pack and burn away the opposition today!

Pack Includes:
Ember Warframe
Ember Phoenix Helmet
Nikana Weapon
Essential Heat Damage Mod Bundle
200 Platinum

One per account. Available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/InitiateIIIPCPac.zhText:
通过全新的 Ember 入门组合包立即增强你的军械库，组合包内含一款战甲、白金、自定义装饰，以及更多强力物品。用 Ember 的技能和基础火焰伤害 Mod 来点燃整个始源星系。今天就获取 Ember 入门组合包并将对手烧成灰烬！

组合包内含：
Ember 战甲
Ember 凤凰头盔
侍刃武器
火焰伤害 Mod 基础组合包
200 白金

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IvaraDeluxeSkinB.text: Take aim with this striking collection of Ivara Skathi items. Includes the Ivara Skathi Skin, Dali Ballistica Skin and the Thiazi Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/IvaraDeluxeSkinB.zhText: 穿戴好这套引人注目的 Ivara 冬之女神组合包中的装饰， 蓄势待发。组合包内含 Ivara 冬之女神外观，达利 布里斯提卡外观以及夏基披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JS2CompleteSupPa.text: Confront the legacy of a doomed future. Is there room for harmony in the present?
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JS2CompleteSupPa.zhText: 直面未来注定毁灭的宿命。当下是否还存在和平共处的空间？

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JS2GeminiSkinsSu.text:
Fight an eternal battle for the future with Vena, the blood-loving fanatic, and Ryoku, the cool and calculating killer. Two bitter rivals brought together in this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins. 

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JS2GeminiSkinsSu.zhText:
与嗜血狂热者维纳和冷静狡黠的杀手忍力一同，为未来展开一场永恒之战。这两位宿敌将在这组原型战甲双子外观中并肩作战。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JS2SiriusOrionSu.text: What might have been becomes reality with Sirius & Orion. Assume the full might of dueling dark futures and follow the stars to constellations of combined power.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JS2SiriusOrionSu.zhText: 在 Sirius 与 Orion 的交汇处，曾经的可能化为现实。感受两股黑暗未来交锋的磅礴之力，追随星辰，探寻众星的融合之力。
众星 Sirius & Orion 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeAxaArmourBun.text:
Show your Xbox One allegiance with the all-new Prestige Pack X!
Gear up with this exclusive set of Jade Axa Armor, the next-generation armor for your Warframe.

Prestige Pack X includes:
- Jade Axa Chest Plate
- Jade Axa Shoulder Plates
- Jade Axa Leg Plates
- 170 Platinum

This Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeAxaArmourBun.zhText:
用全新的荣耀威望包 X 来展现你的 Xbox One 忠诚！
用这个专属的 Warfrrame 次世代护甲套装－翡翠 AXA 护甲来武装自己。

荣耀威望包 X 内含：
- 翡翠 AXA 胸甲
- 翡翠 AXA 肩甲
- 翡翠 AXA 腿甲
- 170 白金

这个组合包在限定时间内每个账号仅限购买一次。
专属的荣耀威望包 X

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeItemsBundleD.text: Life and death meet in Jade. Her collection includes the Jade Warframe, Jade Aureolt Helmet, Motetique Signa, Harmony scythe, Cantare throwing blades, Evensong bow, and Jade Ophanim Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeItemsBundleD.zhText: 生与死在 Jade 身上交汇。她的组合包内含 Jade 战甲、Jade 圣环头盔、圣歌头环、和谐镰刀、歌颂投掷刀刃、晚祷弓箭，和 Jade 座天使装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeShadowsSupPa.text:
Pierce through suffocating darkness by adding the radiant songstress Warframe, Jade, along with her signature Customizations to your Arsenal!

This pack features:

- Jade Warframe
- Motetique Signa
- Jade Aureolt Helmet
- Terror Landing Craft Skin
- Jade In Action Glyph
- Jade Ophanim Sigil 
- Light & Shadow Color Palette
- 275 Platinum

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeShadowsSupPa.zhText:
将光芒四射的女歌手战甲 Jade 连同她的标志性自定义装饰添加到你的军械库中，冲破令人窒息的黑暗！

此组合包内含：

- Jade 战甲
- 圣歌头环
- Jade 圣环头盔
- 恐怖登陆艇外观
- Jade 战斗姿态浮印
- Jade 座天使纹章
- 光与影调色盘
- 275 白金

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeWeaponsBundl.text: Arm yourself with Jade's entire signature weapon collection.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/JadeWeaponsBundl.zhText: 通过 Jade 的整套标志性武器组合包来武装自己。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KavatColorPackHy.text: Degenerate a kavat into a furless Hyekka by altering its DNA structure.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KavatColorPackHy.zhText: 借由调整其 DNA 架构将库娃蜕化为一头无毛鬣猫。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KavatColourPackD.text: The Orokin engineered this DNA structure to make their Kavats embody the season of renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KavatColourPackD.zhText: 奥罗金设计了这种 DNA 结构，让他们的库娃体现季节的更新。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KavatColourPackD.text: Bring ‘The Tales of Duviri’ back to the Origin System with this Kexat skin for your Kavat.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KavatColourPackD.zhText: 将《双衍王境故事集》中的可娃带回始源星系作为库娃外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KhoraBundleDesc.text: Crack the whip and release the Kavat with this vicious collection. Includes the Khora Warframe, Dual Keres swords, Hystrix quill gun, Kerata Syandana, and the Khora Delphi helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KhoraBundleDesc.zhText: 用这款凶恶的组合包来制造鞭击并释放出库娃。里面包括了 Khora 战甲、凯瑞斯双刀、豪猪飞镖枪、聚集披饰、和 Khora 德尔斐头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KhoraDeluxeSkinB.text:
Embody the galaxy’s most dangerous flora with the Urushu Collection. Includes the Khora Urushu Skin, the Veratria Blade and Whip Skin, the Pulchranopsis Syandana, and the Maculatia Skin for Venari or your other favorite Kavat.

Includes Khora Urushu Agile and Noble animation sets.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KhoraDeluxeSkinB.zhText:
漆花组合包涵盖了星系内最危险的植物。内含 Khora 漆花外观、藜芦剑鞭外观，秀兰披饰，以及适用于薇娜丽或其他你喜欢的库娃的毒参外观。

内含 Khora 漆花迅捷站姿和 Khora 漆花尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KintsukuroiSkinB.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, these battle-scarred weapons have been transformed into objects of beauty. Contains skins for the Braton, Paris, Kunai, Lato, Aklato, Skana and Bo.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KintsukuroiSkinB.zhText: 利用金色合金修复后，这些战痕累累的武器已经转化为优美的物件。组合包中包含布莱顿、帕里斯、苦无、拉托、空刃和玻之武杖的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KoumeiItemsBundl.text: Seize your destiny with the dice-maiden. Her collection includes the Koumei Warframe, her Orihime Helmet, Amanata, Higasa weapons, Buyoh and Rolling Fates Emotes, the Koumei Ito Glyph and Sigil, and the Koumei Engimono Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KoumeiItemsBundl.zhText: 通过掷骰巫女掌握自己的命运。她的组合包内含 Koumei 战甲、织姬头盔、天薙刀、晴日伞武器、日本舞和命运掷骰表情动作、Koumei 提线浮印和纹章，以及 Koumei 祈运坛装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowColourPack.text: The Orokin engineered this DNA structure to make their Kubrows embody the season of renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowColourPack.zhText: 奥罗金设计了这种 DNA 结构，让他们的库狛体现季节的更新。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowColourPack.text: Euleria Entrati commissioned this unique Kubrow DNA segment to manifest a creature from the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowColourPack.zhText: 欧拉瑞娅·英择谛定制了这个独特的库狛 DNA 模块来实体化《双衍王境故事集》中的一种生物。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowColourPack.text: Albrecht Entrati conducted a peculiar experiment aimed at disguising biology as machinery. The results formed this Gene-Masking Kit.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowColourPack.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛进行了一项奇特的实验，其目的在于将生物伪装成机械。结果形成了这个基因伪装包。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowKavatConte.text: Raise a prize-winning companion with this fur-patterning for Kubrow and Kavat. Contains both the Heino Kubrow Fur Pattern and Deaeira Kavat Fur Pattern. [Tenno's Best Friend Contest winners]
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KubrowKavatConte.zhText: 用这款毛皮花纹来培育一只足以赢得选美大奖的库狛和库娃吧。此组合包同时包含海诺库狛毛皮花纹和狄尔拉库娃毛皮花纹。[Tenno 之友比赛冠军]

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KullervoDeluxeBu.text: Transform the captive Warframe’s burden of blame into a smoldering mark of pride with this collection of Apostate skins and items.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KullervoDeluxeBu.zhText: 使用叛徒外观和物品组合包，将被囚禁战甲背负的自责转化为骄傲的燃烧印记。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KuvaArmorPackDes.text: A full set of Kuva Armor.

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KuvaMegaBundleDe.text: Become Grineer royalty with this complete set of Kuva weapons and armor. Includes the Zarr cannon, Kesheg halberd, Twin Rogga pistols, as well as the fearsome Kuva Armor, Kuva Cloak and Kuva Cord. This bundle also features four Kuva landing craft skins and Kuva Kubrow and Kavat Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/KuvaMegaBundleDe.zhText: 以这组赤毒武器和护甲组来效忠 Grineer。组合包内含沙皇火炮、怯薛长戟、双子罗格手枪，以及可怕的赤毒护甲、赤毒斗篷和赤毒绳结。同时附送四款赤毒登陆艇外观、库狛和库娃专用的赤毒护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2021AnewBundl.text: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Start Anew Bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2021AnewBundl.zhText: 以万象更新组合包庆贺农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2021Blessings.text: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Blessing & Fortune Bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2021Blessings.zhText: 以福禄双全组合包庆贺农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2021LuminousB.text: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the Luminous Brilliance Bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2021LuminousB.zhText: 以璀璨光华组合包庆贺农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleADe.text: Lunar Renewal is upon us! Celebrate the ancient festival of returning life with this selection of special items.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleADe.zhText: 虎年新春到！通过一系列精选的特殊物品来庆祝这一古老的节日。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleBDe.text: Lunar Renewal is upon us! Celebrate the ancient festival of returning life with this hoard of splendid treats.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleBDe.zhText: 虎年新春到！通过各种好物来庆祝这一古老的节日。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleCDe.text: Lunar Renewal is upon us! Celebrate the ancient festival of returning life with this set of exquisite treasures.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleCDe.zhText: 虎年新春到！通过这套奇珍异宝来庆祝这一古老的节日。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleDDe.text: Bring in the blessings of a new lunar year with this custom theme, background and sigil!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2022BundleDDe.zhText: 通过这款包含了自定义界面主题、背景以及纹章的组合包带来新春祝福！

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleADe.text: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. The contents of this bundle are imbued with peace and comfort.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleADe.zhText: 辞旧迎新！时尚地欢庆新年。愿这个组合包中的内容为你带来平安与健康。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleBDe.text: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. Good fortune is sure to come your way as you make use of the items in this bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleBDe.zhText: 辞旧迎新！时尚地庆祝新年。当你使用这个组合包中的物品时，好运就会降临。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleCDe.text: The year begins anew! Enjoy the festivities with style. This bundle makes for a spectacular celebration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleCDe.zhText: 辞旧迎新！时尚地欢庆新年。让这个组合包为你带来一场盛大的庆典。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleDDe.text: Welcome the blessings of Lunar Renewal with a new Sigil and a Custom UI Theme and Background.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2023BundleDDe.zhText: 通过全新的纹章和自定义界面主题以及背景来迎接农历新年的祝福。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024BundleADe.text: Invite good fortune with the Chroma Zunlong Floof and Nukor Lunaeus Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024BundleADe.zhText: 让 Chroma 尊龙玩偶和努寇微波枪岁朝外观为你带来好运。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024BundleBDe.text: Ring in prosperity with the Lunar Renewal UI theme, Dual Swords Lunaeus Skin, Baochun Sugatra, and Lunar Renewal Soar Sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024BundleBDe.zhText: 用新春界面主题、双剑岁朝外观，报春坠饰以及新春龙翔纹章来迎接繁荣兴盛。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024BundleCDe.text: Celebrate the year of the dragon with the Chroma Zunlong Skin and its complimentary Ephemera, Emote, Ogris Skin, Sentinel Skin, and Sentinel Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024BundleCDe.zhText: 用 Chroma 尊龙外观以及其附赠的幻纹、表情动作、食人女魔外观、守护外观，和守护护甲来欢庆龙年。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024SentinelS.text: Prepare your Sentinel for a dance of Lunar Renewal revelry.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2024SentinelS.zhText: 装扮守护，共舞新春华章。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2025BundleADe.text: Invite good fortune with the Lunar Renewal UI theme, Hespar Lunaeus Skin, Cordmade Sugatra, Mirage Nuwa Floof, and Lunar Renewal Snake Sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2025BundleADe.zhText: 通过新春界面主题、暮斩岁朝外观、编绳坠饰、Mirage 女娲玩偶以及新春腾蛇纹章，来祈求好运！

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2025BundleBDe.text: Ring in prosperity with the Mirage Nuwa Skin and its complimentary Ephemera, Boltor Skin, Kavat Armor, and Floof.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2025BundleBDe.zhText: 使用 Mirage 女娲外观及其配套的幻纹、螺钉步枪外观、库娃护甲和玩偶来喜迎蛇年。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2025BundleCDe.text: Celebrate the year of the snake with everything in both the Smoky Quartz Bundle and the Pink Topaz Bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2025BundleCDe.zhText: 通过烟晶组合包和粉红托帕组合包中的所有物品来庆祝蛇年。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2026BundleADe.text: Celebrate the Year of the Horse in style with this equine collection.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2026BundleADe.zhText: 用这款与午马有关的组合包欢庆新春。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2026BundleBDe.text: Kindle the ghostly light of wrath with the Dagath Yfari Collection. The sight of her spectral cavalry strikes fear into the hearts of those with ill intent.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2026BundleBDe.zhText: 通过 Dagath 伊法里组合包点燃愤怒的幽灵之光。她那幽灵般的骑兵，会让那些怀有恶意的人心生恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2026BundleCDe.text: This complete collection of Lunar Renewal skins and items is everything you need to rejoice in the turning of another year.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LNY2026BundleCDe.zhText: 这一整套新春外观与物品组合包，包含了庆祝新一年到来所需的全部物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LichHunterBundle.text: Get a taste of The Old Blood with this exclusive, one-time purchase, of Kuva Lich items. Includes a full set of Requiem Mods, the Radiant Requiem Relic Pack, Kuva Warframe Armor, and an assortment of Kuva Lich themed color pallets.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LichHunterBundle.zhText: 通过这个关于赤毒玄骸物品的专属一次性购买来呷一口《远古之血》。包含有全套安魂 Mod、光辉安魂遗物组合包、赤毒战甲护甲以及各种赤毒玄骸主题调色盘。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LimboDeluxeSkinB.text: Standing in the doorway between one world and another, be sure to cut a memorable figure. This bundle includes the Limina Limbo Skin, Tarock Thrown Weapon Skin, Interga Sugatra and the Sidereal Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LimboDeluxeSkinB.zhText: 矗立于世界之间的出入口，务必得有一身让人难以忘怀的装扮。这款组合包内含 Limbo 阈限外观、投掷武器 塔罗外观、英特喀坠饰与恒星披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LimboVoidshellBu.text:
Adorn Limbo in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Limbo Voidshell Skin and Lotus Pattern material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LimboVoidshellBu.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Limbo 虚空之壳外观以及 Lotus 花纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login5PackDesc.text: A cache containing 25,000 Credits and 1,000 Endo.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login5PackDesc.zhText: 一个内装有 25,000 现金和 1,000 内融核心的储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login750PackDesc.text: A cache containing the Guiding Rose Glyph, an Exilus Adapter and a 3 Day Affinity Booster.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login750PackDesc.zhText: 内含指路玫瑰浮印、一个特殊功能槽连接器和3天经验值加成的储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login850PackDesc.text: A cache containing 3 Riven Mods with slots.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login850PackDesc.zhText: 内装有 3 张裂罅 Mod 的储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login950PackDesc.text: A cache containing the Lustrous Major Glyph, an Orokin Reactor and a 7 Day Credit Booster.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/Login950PackDesc.zhText: 内含光耀卓越浮印，一个奥罗金反应堆和 7 天现金加成的储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LoginPackGDesc.text: A cache containing the Spectral Tide Glyph, an Orokin Reactor and a Forma Bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LoginPackGDesc.zhText: 内含光谱浪潮浮印、一个奥罗金反应堆和 一个 Forma 组合包的储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LokiVoidshellBun.text:
Adorn Loki in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Loki Voidshell Skin and the Murkray Scales material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LokiVoidshellBun.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Loki 虚空之壳外观以及阴暗鳐鳞纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LycanCompleteBun.text: Make your enemies fear you as they fear the dark. This bundle includes accessories inspired by The Wild Hunt of Naberus.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/LycanCompleteBun.zhText: 让敌人像害怕黑暗一样害怕你。此组合包内含受纳贝流士狂猎启发的配件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MagDeluxeSkinBun.text: Breathe new life into Mag with this collection of signature items. Includes the lavish Mag Pneuma Skin, Maruta Tonfa Skin, and the Vasa Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MagDeluxeSkinBun.zhText: 用这组标志性道具为 Mag 注入新的活力。包括了华贵的 Mag 元气外观、暴风拐刃外观，以及瓦萨披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MagVoidshellBund.text:
Adorn Mag in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mag Voidshell Skin and Soma Waves material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MagVoidshellBund.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mag 虚空之壳外观以及胞体振波材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MashedGlyphBundl.text: A collection of glyphs, using captured frames from the 100 Days of Warframe video by MASHED.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MashedGlyphBundl.zhText: 一套浮印组合包，取材自 MASHED 制作的《百日 Warframe》视频。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MemeGlyphBundleA.text: Spread some Tenno culture with this collection of wacky glyphs.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MemeGlyphBundleA.zhText: 用这一系列的古怪浮印来传播一些 Tenno 文化。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MemeGlyphBundleB.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting the very serious history of Warframe, created by Community artist Searyn.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MemeGlyphBundleB.zhText: 一组凸显《Warframe》严肃历史的浮印，由社区艺术家 Searyn 创作。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MemeGlyphBundleC.text: A bundle of glyphs highlighting the very serious history of Warframe, created by Community artist ibumuc.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MemeGlyphBundleC.zhText: 一组凸显《Warframe》严肃历史的浮印，由社区艺术家 ibumuc 创作。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaDeluxeSkinBu.text: Become a fortress of style with this collection of deluxe items that includes the Mesa Presidio Skin, Perla Dual Pistol Skin, and the Constella Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaDeluxeSkinBu.zhText: 用这款组合包中的华丽物品让自己成为一座边塞吧！组合包的内容包括：Mesa 边塞外观，珍珠双持手枪外观和群集披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaHeirloomPack.text: Saunter into the fray and send outlaws to their graves with the Mesa Heirloom Collection. Let her Regulators echo a ballad beneath the high-noon sun.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaHeirloomPack.zhText: 使用 Mesa 传家宝组合包，从容踏入战场，将亡命之徒送入黄泉。让她的监察者双枪在正午烈日下奏响一曲传奇。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaVoidshellBun.text:
Adorn Mesa in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mesa Voidshell Skin and Eris Surface material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaVoidshellBun.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mesa 虚空之壳外观以及阋神星表面材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaVoltDeluxeSk.text: Explore the realms of Sentient design with these skins for Volt and Mesa, showing them as they would have appeared if the Sentients had created them.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MesaVoltDeluxeSk.zhText: 通过这些为 Volt 和 Mesa 打造的外观来探索 Sentient 的设计领域，该组合包展示了他们若是由 Sentient 创造将会拥有的样貌。
Sentient 视界华丽外观组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MirageVoidshellB.text:
Adorn Mirage in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mirage Voidshell Skin and Amarast Facets material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MirageVoidshellB.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mirage 虚空之壳外观以及多面紫苋石材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MoonWarfanBundle.text: Arm yourself with the Vericres warfan and matching Renayla sugatra for a look that honors the lunar cycle.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MoonWarfanBundle.zhText: 使用真月武扇来武装自己，并配上莲月坠饰来打造一个纪念月亮周期的造型。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MotorcycleSkins1.text: Never have a boring ride with this fleet of stylish Atomicycle liveries.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/MotorcycleSkins1.zhText: 有了这些时尚的原子摩托车外观涂装，旅途从此不再无趣。
原子摩托车外观涂装组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NecramechEssenti.text: Fine tune your Necramech Loadouts for battle and plan to take on any foe with a selection of essential Necramech Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NecramechEssenti.zhText: 为战斗微调你的殁世机甲装备，并准备好使用一系列基础殁世机甲 Mod 来对付任何敌人。
殁世机甲基础 Mod 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NekrosDeluxeSkin.text: Break free of the underworld with this haunting collection. Includes Nekros Irkalla Skin, Nekros Irkalla Binds, Thanatos Scythe Skin and the Thanatos Sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NekrosDeluxeSkin.zhText: 用这款鬼魅的组合包挣脱地府的藩篱。包含了Nekros 伊卡拉外观，Nekros 伊卡拉枷锁，萨那托斯镰刀外观和萨那托斯坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NekrosVoidshellB.text:
Adorn Nekros in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Nekros Voidshell Skin and the Necrotic Stitch material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NekrosVoidshellB.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Nekros 虚空之壳外观以及腐生锐纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NewPlayerXPArmou.text: Augment your look with this subtle and sturdy armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NewPlayerXPArmou.zhText: 用这套精巧而坚固的护甲套装来提升你的造型。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NewPlayerXPCosme.text: Jump into the future with the high-tech style of the Oscira Collection. Includes the Oscira Armor, Sugatra, and Syandana. Plus, Oscira skins for Pistol, Rifle, Staff, Thrown Weapon, Bow, and Longsword.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NewPlayerXPCosme.zhText: 装备这款高科技风格的奥斯拉组合包来迎接未来。其中包括奥斯拉护甲、坠饰和披饰。除此以外，还有适用于手枪、步枪、棍棒武器、投掷武器、弓类武器，以及长剑的奥斯拉外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NezhaDeluxeBundl.text: Embody the grace of a falling star, and the terror of its impact, with this celestial collection for Nezha. Includes the Nezha Empyrean skin, Buzhou Syandana and Teng Dagger Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NezhaDeluxeBundl.zhText: 以这天空的组合包，体现 Nezha 流星般的优雅和其冲击的可怕力量。包括了 Nezha 九霄外观、不周披饰和飞腾匕首外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NidusBundleDesc.text: Succumb to the Infestation with the Nidus Warframe, Hema rifle, Hirudo fist-weapons, and the Thorac Syandana. Includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NidusBundleDesc.zhText: 通过 Nidus 战甲、血肢步枪、 蚂蟥拳套武器，以及胸廓披饰来屈服在感染者面前吧。内含 3 天经验值加成和现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NidusDeluxeSkinB.text: Everything you need to become the ultimate terror. Includes the unholy Nidus Phryke Skin, Deimos Claw Skin, Nosos Syandana, Helminth Charger Metus Skin and Metus Kubrow Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NidusDeluxeSkinB.zhText: 这里有着成为终极恐惧所需的一切。包括了不洁的 Nidus 恐惧神外观、德莫斯双爪外观、恶疾披饰、Helminth 疾冲者米图斯外观和米图斯库狛护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NidusVoidshellBu.text:
Adorn Nidus in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Nidus Voidshell Skin and Petrified Isos material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NidusVoidshellBu.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Nidus 虚空之壳外观以及石化修复凝液材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NightwaveGlyphsB.text: Two glyphs for your profile, featuring Caliban Orfeo and Protea Caladrius in action.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NightwaveGlyphsB.zhText: 两款个人档案浮印，呈现 Caliban 奥菲欧与 Protea 医官鸟的战斗姿态。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NightwaveGlyphsB.text: Tempestuous Time in Action Glyph Bundle
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NightwaveGlyphsB.zhText: 狂暴时刻战斗姿态浮印组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NightwaveOperato.text: Augment your reality with these Cephalon-inspired cosmetics.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NightwaveOperato.zhText: 用这些受中枢启发的装饰来增强你的真实性。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.text:
Get two Nintendo Switch-exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum and more with the Esteem Pack! Includes: Guandao (Melee Weapon), Guandao Opal Skin, Excalibur Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum 

The Esteem Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.zhText:
通过「钦佩崇敬包」获取两件 Nintendo Switch 专属外观、超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容！其中包括：关刀（近战武器）、关刀 蛋白石外观、 Excalibur 蛋白石外观、 3 天现金和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包」。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.text:
Get two Nintendo Switch-exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum and more with the Esteem Pack II! Includes: Twin Grakatas (Secondary Weapon), Twin Grakatas Opal Skin, Volt Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack II may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.zhText:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 II」获取两件 Nintendo Switch 专属外观、超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容！其中包括：双子葛拉卡达（次要武器）、双子葛拉卡达 蛋白石外观、Volt 蛋白石外观、 3 天现金和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 II」。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.text:
Get two Nintendo Switch-exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum and more with the Esteem Pack III! Includes: Corinth (Primary Weapon), Corinth Opal Skin, Mag Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack III may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.zhText:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 III」获取两件 Nintendo Switch 专属外观、超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容！其中包括：科林斯（主要武器）、科林斯 蛋白石外观、Mag 蛋白石外观、 3 天现金和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 III」。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.text:
Get two Nintendo Switch™ - exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum, and more with the Esteem Pack IV! Includes: Fragor (Melee Weapon), Fragor Opal Skin, Frost Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack IV may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.zhText:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 IV 」获取两件 Nintendo Switch™ 专属外观、超值折扣白金以及更多精采内容！其中包括：重击巨锤（近战武器）、重击巨锤 蛋白石外观、Frost 蛋白石外观、 3 天现金和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 IV 」。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.text:
Get two Nintendo Switch™ - exclusive Skins, discounted Platinum, and more with the Esteem Pack V! Includes: Aklato (Secondary Weapon), Lato & Aklato Opal Skin, Loki Opal Skin, 3-Day Credit & Affinity Boosters, and 170 Platinum.

The Esteem Pack V may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NintendoSkinPack.zhText:
通过「钦佩崇敬包 V」获取两件 Nintendo Switch™ 专属外观、超值折扣白金以及更多精采内容！其中包括：拉托双枪（次要武器）、拉托和拉托双枪 蛋白石外观、Loki 蛋白石外观、 3 天现金和经验值加成，以及 170 白金。

每个账号仅可在限定时间内购买一次「钦佩崇敬包 V」。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NokkoSupPackDesc.text: Grow strong with Nokko, brave defender of the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NokkoSupPackDesc.zhText: 与深矿的勇敢捍卫者 Nokko 一起成长。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NoraGlyphsBundle.text: Add to your collection with these Nora Night glyphs.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NoraGlyphsBundle.zhText: 将这些诺拉·夜浮印加入到你的收藏当中。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NovaDeluxeAoando.text: Infuse your style with the grace of drifting sakura petals. This bundle includes Nova Aozakura’s signature accessories.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NovaDeluxeAoando.zhText: 让飘舞的樱花花瓣为你的风格增添优雅气息。此组合包内含 Nova 蓝樱的标志性配件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NovaDeluxeIISkin.text: Harness the reactive power of Nova Atomica. Features the Nova Atomica Skin, Alamos Sniper Skin, and Radia Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NovaDeluxeIISkin.zhText: 驾驭 Nova 原子姬的反应能量吧。这款组合包内含 Nova 原子姬外观、阿拉莫斯狙击枪外观，以及乐光披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NovaVoidshellBun.text:
Adorn Nova in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Nova Voidshell Skin and Pearlescent Plastid material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NovaVoidshellBun.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Nova 虚空之壳外观以及珠光质体材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NyxDeluxeSkinBun.text: Take control with this decadent collection of deluxe Nyx gear. Featuring the Nyx Pasithea Skin, Nyx Enthra Syandana, and the Hecaton Shotgun Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/NyxDeluxeSkinBun.zhText: 通过这款颓废的 Nyx 华丽装备来占据主导吧。独具特色的 Nyx 幻觉女神外观、Nyx 迷醉披饰和百臂巨人霰弹枪外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OctaviaDeluxeSki.text: Everything for a virtuoso performance: Octavia’s Maestra skin, Verismo Syandana and the Boltor Bravura Skin. Also includes the Horos Collection of synthetic mandachord notes: the score to war, with a danceable beat.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OctaviaDeluxeSki.zhText: 所有的一切都是为了艺术大师的演奏：Octavia 音乐名家外观、写实歌剧披饰以及螺钉步枪炫技外观。还包括了舞韵曼达和弦琴曲调：舞曲风格的战争配乐。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.text: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked, it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Operator armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews. Fitted for the Operator and the Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.zhText: 当冷却液废气或是合成液破裂时，这时所有人都得停工，除了危难技术人员必须留下。依福尔图娜敢死维修工所仿制。适用于指挥官与漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.text: Operator armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat. Fitted for the Operator and the Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.zhText: 指挥官套服的灵感源自那些必须在酷热条件下工作的索拉里斯人。适用于指挥官与漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.text: Inspired by the seers of old; constructed to withstand ravages to both body and mind.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.zhText: 受到年迈预言家们的启发；被制作用来抵御对身体和精神的摧残。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.text: A complete set of armor honoring the monastic legacy of the Quills.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.zhText: 一套完整的护甲，尊崇着夜羽的修士传统。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.text: A complete set of armor, crafted with surety of purpose and clarity of vision.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.zhText: 一套完整的护甲，以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.text: Armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.zhText: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.text: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. Lightweight and practical armor designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorArmourBu.zhText: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的护甲，专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorDrifterD.text: Commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis with Dex suits for the Operator and Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorDrifterD.zhText: 为指挥官和漂泊者准备的 Dex 套服，以纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来的周年纪念日。
指挥官和漂泊者 Dex 套服

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairEcho.text: Celebrate the hairstyles of 1999 and beyond with this assortment of looks for the Operator and Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairEcho.zhText: 通过这一系列适合指挥官和漂泊者的发型来致敬 1999 年及之后的经典发型。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairGemi.text: The future might be doomed, but style doesn't have to be with this collection featuring Ryoku and Vena's hairstyles for the Operator and Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairGemi.zhText: 未来或许注定黯淡，但造型不必遵从这些，本组合包内含忍力和维纳为指挥官和漂泊者设计的发型。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairGemi.text: Be in style whether the year ends in ‘99 or otherwise, with this collection of looks for the Operator and Drifter featuring the signature hairstyles of the 1999 Hex, Roundtable, and Devil’s Triad Protoframes.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairGemi.zhText: 无论这一年是否以 1999 年结束，都能让你保持时尚，这套为指挥官和漂泊者设计的造型系列，以 1999 年六人组、老圆桌和恶魔三重奏原型战甲的标志性发型为特色。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairGemi.text: Adopt the gothic style of the Devil’s Triad with this assortment of hairstyles for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairGemi.zhText: 为漂泊者和指挥官提供一系列哥特式发型，展现恶魔三重奏的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairHexB.text: Never let a bad hair day get in the way of fighting Scaldra with this assortment of hairstyles for the Operator and Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairHexB.zhText: 有了这一系列适合指挥官和漂泊者的发型，再也不会因为糟糕的发型而妨碍你与炽蛇军的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairIsle.text: Everybody will know your name with this assortment of looks for the Operator and Drifter, featuring familiar hairstyles from the regulars of the Round Table Pub.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairIsle.zhText: 有了这套指挥官和漂泊者的造型，每个人都会知道你的名字，以老圆桌酒吧常客们熟悉的发型为特色。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairMisc.text: You're only as good as your last haircut - make it a great one with this ultimate collection of looks for the Operator and Drifter featuring all standard hairstyles.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorHairMisc.zhText: 你的形象取决于你最近一次的发型——通过这套为指挥官和漂泊者准备的终极造型组合包，打造一个完美的发型，其中包含所有标准发型。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorNightSui.text: Nora's got the goods for you lucky Dreamers with this stylish collection.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorNightSui.zhText: 诺拉通过这个时尚的组合包为你们这些幸运的梦回者准备了好物。
午夜电波指挥官组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorQuarters.text:
A bundle of multiple Vignettes used to decorate your Personal Quarters.

Also includes 14 Warframe Articula.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorQuarters.zhText:
一份装有多组装饰景观的组合包，可用于装饰个人房间。

同时包含 14 组战甲可动式模型。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitCalD.text: Venture boldly forth, clad in the auspices of one who shows courage in the face of death.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitCalD.zhText: 穿上无畏死亡的勇气之士的铠甲，英勇向前。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitDemo.text: This blood-red battledress embodies the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury. Fitted for both Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitDemo.zhText: 这件血红色的战斗服完美体现了奥罗金的极致风格和奢华。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitInfe.text: Become like Arlo’s devoted with this Operator cosmetics collection. Includes the Emissary Suit, Emissary Greaves, Emissary Hood, and Emissary Sleeves.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitInfe.zhText: 用这套指挥官装饰来装扮成 Arlo 的信徒。内含使徒套装，使徒绑腿，使徒头罩和使徒袖件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitNBun.text: Operator Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
