/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitNBun.zhText: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitNigh.text: Slide into this biker attire of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitNigh.zhText: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。
凯恩壳原子摩托车礼服

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitOBun.text: Armor modeled on the K-drive gear favored by Boon, leader of the canny and cunning Kubrodon Ventkids.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorSuitOBun.zhText: 依谨慎又灵巧的库狛顿领导人阿布最喜爱的 K 式悬浮板装备所仿制的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorUmbraBun.text: Howl all you want with this collection of Umbra themed Operator gear. This collection includes the Umbra Hooded Scarf, Umbra Blindfold, Umbra Diadem, and Umbra Earpiece.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OperatorUmbraBun.zhText: 以这组 Umbra 主题的指挥官装备尽情嚎叫吧。这个组合包包括了，Umbra 连帽围巾、Umbra 眼罩、Umbra 头冠和 Umbra 耳饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OpulaArmourBundl.text: Dazzle the eye with the iridescent flames of this armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OpulaArmourBundl.zhText: 护甲套装上闪耀着绚丽的火焰光芒，定会令你目不转睛。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OraxiaArmourBund.text: The chitinous spines of Oraxia’s armor lend a menacing aspect to any Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OraxiaArmourBund.zhText: Oraxia 护甲上的甲壳尖刺为所有 Tenno 增添了威胁气息。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OraxiaItemsBundl.text: Emerge from the shadows as Oraxia, the Mistress of Fear.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OraxiaItemsBundl.zhText: 化身为恐惧女王 Oraxia，从阴影中现身。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OraxiaSupPackDes.text: Stalk your prey through the floating islands of Duviri with the new Oraxia Bundle! Featuring the deadly hunter Oraxia, as well as her signature Weapons and Customizations.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OraxiaSupPackDes.zhText: 通过全新的 Oraxia 组合包，在双衍王境的漂浮岛屿上追踪你的猎物！内含致命猎手 Oraxia，以及她的标志性武器和自定义装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OstronRugBundleD.text: A collection of fine Ostron rugs.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OstronRugBundleD.zhText: 精美的 OSTRON 小地毯收藏组合。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OstronShipDecoPa.text: A distinctive collection of Orbiter adornments celebrating the industry of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OstronShipDecoPa.zhText: 一套别具特色的轨道飞行器装饰物，赞颂了希图斯的工业实力。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/OstronShipDecoPa.text: A beautiful collection of Orbiter adornments made by Ostron craftspeople.

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ProteaItemsBundl.zhText: 适应性与灵活性的化身。其中包括 Protea 战甲、遥测替换头盔、面甲替换头盔、逐电冲锋枪和铃鼓披饰。此外还包括了 3 天经验值和现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ProteaVoidshellB.text:
Adorn Protea in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Protea Voidshell Skin and Circuit Effect material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ProteaVoidshellB.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Protea 虚空之壳外观以及电路效果材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ProtovyreCosmeti.text: Adorn your Warframe with the Sentient-inspired Protovyre Armor, Syandana and Ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ProtovyreCosmeti.zhText: 用以 Sentient 为灵感的源噬护甲、披饰和幻纹来装饰你的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/QorvexDeluxeSkin.text: Drive off the presence of evil. Qorvex Basilica's monstrous shape strikes terror into those who would terrorize others.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/QorvexDeluxeSkin.zhText: 驱散邪恶。Qorvex 圣殿以他的骇人身姿令那些企图恐吓他人之徒不寒而栗。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/QorvexItemsBundl.text: Summon a guardian with the strength to face Albrecht’s Laboratories. This collection includes the Qorvex Warframe, Qorvex Raxpart Helmet, Portcull Syandana, and Mandonel Archgun.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/QorvexItemsBundl.zhText: 召唤一位有实力面对阿尔布雷希特实验室的守护者。该组合包内含 Qorvex 战甲、Qorvex 壁垒头盔、吊闸披饰和辐光弩炮曲翼枪械。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackArmourBu.text: The hardened Sigma Series Armor was recognized battle dress for Old War Railjack crews.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackArmourBu.zhText: 这套身经百战的西格玛系列护甲是远古之战中公认的航道星舰舰员战斗着装。
西格玛系列护甲组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackArmourPi.text: This massive bundle includes the full Sigma Series cosmetic range: Armor Set, Kavat Armor Set, Syandana, Sugatra and Parazon Skin. Also contains the Zundi Pistol Skin, Quellor rifle and Pennant two-handed Nikana. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackArmourPi.zhText: 这个丰富的组合包内含完整的西格玛系列装饰：护甲套装、库娃护甲套装、披饰、坠饰以及灭骸之刃外观。还包括尊谛手枪外观、压制者步枪以及尖幡双手侍刃。此外还包括了 3 天经验值和现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackBundleDe.text: Instantly take command of the Railjack with this bundle that includes a Railjack, 4 Crew Member Slots and the Nautilus Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackBundleDe.zhText: 立即通过这款组合包来掌控航道星舰，组合包内含一艘航道星舰、鹦鹉螺守护以及 4 个舰员槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackInstantA.text:
Tenno to battle stations! Instantly board your Railjack and set sail for the Proxima with this pack, featuring a fully-built Railjack, Railjack Skin and more.

- 250 Platinum
- Railjack
- Sungem Railjack Skin
- 4 Crew Slots
- 7-Day Resource Booster

Limited-time offer. Only one per account. Purchasing this pack will automatically complete the Archwing and Rising Tide Quest prerequisites needed to play Railjack. Both Quests can be replayed from the Codex aboard your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackInstantA.zhText:
Tenno 进入战位！通过这个组合包，即刻登上你的航道星舰，并启程前往比邻星域，这个组合包内含一艘完全打造好的航道星舰，航道星舰外观，以及更多精彩内容。

- 250 白金
- 航道星舰
- 耀阳航道星舰外观
- 4 个舰员槽位
- 7 天资源数量加成

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅限购买一次。购买这款组合包将自动完成《曲翼》和《澎湃狂潮》系列任务（游玩航道星舰任务所需要的前置条件）。你也可以通过轨道飞行器上的资料库来重玩这两个系列任务。
航道星舰即时成品组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackStarterB.text: Secure your Railjack, instantly completing all build stages of the Rising Tide quest. This pack includes a Railjack, 4 Crew Member Slots, and 4 Component & Armament Slots.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackStarterB.zhText: 保护好你的航道星舰，即刻完成《澎湃狂潮》系列任务的所有建造阶段。该组合包内含一个航道星舰，4 个舰员槽位，和 4 个部件和军备槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackVoidrigB.text: Everything a Tenno needs to enter the fray in The New War. Instantly bolster your arsenal with the firepower of a Railjack and a Voidrig Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RailjackVoidrigB.zhText: 拥有 Tenno 加入《新纪之战》所需的一切物品。立即通过航道星舰和虚空锐将殁世机甲的火力来增强你的军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RequiemRelicOmni.text: A cluster of 6 Requiem Eterna relics
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RequiemRelicOmni.zhText: 一组六个安魂永恒遗物

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RequiemRelicPack.text: 4 Radiant Requiem Relics, one of each type: I, II, III, and IV.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RequiemRelicPack.zhText: 4 个光辉安魂遗物，每类各有一个：I，II，III 和 IV。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantArmorBun.text: Make Revenant whole with his signature armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantArmorBun.zhText: 用 Revenant 标志性的护甲来让他看起来更有整体性。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantBundleDe.text: Enthrall hordes of enemies with the Revenant Collection. Includes the Revenant Warframe, the Revenant Vania Helmet, the Vetala Armor for Warframes, the Kasha Kavat Armor as well as the Phantasma Shotgun.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantBundleDe.zhText: 用 Revenant 组合包奴役成群的敌人。包括了 Revenant 战甲、Revenant 瓦尼亚头盔、维塔拉护甲、卡莎库娃护甲以及幻离子霰弹枪。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeBu.text: Dwell in the eternal twilight with Revenant’s haunting Mephisto collection.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeBu.zhText: 通过 Revenant 令人不安的梅菲斯特组合包栖身九界间的永恒黄昏中。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeBu.text:
Dwell in the eternal twilight with Revenant’s haunting Mephisto collection.

Includes Revenant Mephisto Skin, Revenant Mephisto Helmet, and Orison Two-Handed Nikana Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeBu.zhText:
通过 Revenant 令人不安的梅菲斯特组合包栖身九界间的永恒黄昏中。

包括 Revenant 梅菲斯特外观、Revenant 梅菲斯特头盔和神祈双手侍刃外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeOp.text: Take on a touch of the devil with these Revenant Mephisto Operator accessories.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeOp.zhText: 通过这些 Revenant 梅菲斯特指挥官配件来感受一丝恶魔的气息。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeOp.text:
Take on a touch of the devil with these Revenant Mephisto Operator accessories.

Includes the Revenant Mephisto Diadem, and Revenant Mephisto Mask.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RevenantDeluxeOp.zhText:
通过这些 Revenant 梅菲斯特指挥官配件来感受一丝恶魔的气息。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RhinoHeirloomPac.text:
Summon the primordial legacy of the beast with the Rhino Heirloom Steel Collection. Featuring Customizations girded with living iron capable of withstanding any storm.

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RhinoHeirloomPac.zhText:
通过 Rhino 传家宝钢之组合包召唤出野兽的原始传承。以能够抵御任何风暴的活铁自定义装饰为特色。

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。
Rhino 传家宝钢之组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RhinoVoidshellBu.text:

穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Rhino 虚空之壳外观以及钛光泽材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RoyalSteedBundle.text: The Royal Steed Pack is worthy of a king. It contains everything from both the Grassland and Outland Steed Packs. It also includes the Steed's Regalia Pack.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/RoyalSteedBundle.zhText: 皇家骏马组合包配得起王的名号。它包含了草原骏马组合包和外域骏马组合包的所有内容。也包含了华服骏马组合包的内容。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SanctumPackDesc.text:

This pack features:

-350 Platinum
-Ekhein Hammer
-Kalymos Kavat Gene-Masking Kit
-Envine Signa
-Necramite
-Albrecht 1999 Display
-Albrecht Jahu Display

配得上英择谛家族的镀金收藏。

此组合包内含：

-350 白金

-卡利莫斯库娃基因伪装包

此组合包每个账号仅可购买一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SarynVoidshellBu.text:
Adorn Saryn in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Saryn Voidshell Skin and the Spore Print material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SarynVoidshellBu.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Saryn 虚空之壳外观以及孢子印痕材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SentNewWarArmour.text: Once the latest in Sentient defensive technology, now an embellishment for any Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SentNewWarArmour.zhText: 它曾经是 Sentient 防御技术的最新成果，如今已成为所有 Tenno 的点缀。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SentientSentinel.text: Give your Sentinel the appearance of a Kerulyst, diminutive Sentients that evolved to become robust laborers in the Tau System.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SentientSentinel.zhText: 让你的守护拥有怪力使的外观，这些小型的 Sentient 已经进化成了 Tau 星系中坚韧的劳力。
怪力使守护外观组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SevagothDeluxeSk.text: Turn legend into reality. This collection includes Sevagoth Glaukus, his loyal companion Bosun Gillychap, a custom Tombstone, and the Cirriped Epitaph Skin. It also features Sevagoth's Lullaby, a custom song that plays for Sevagoth's Shadow in combat and can be played on the Somachord in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SevagothDeluxeSk.zhText: 把传说变为现实。该组合包内含 Sevagoth 格劳克斯、他的忠实同伴水手长吉利鱼、一个可自定义的墓碑、以及葬铭蔓足外观。它还包括 Sevagoth 的安眠曲——一首在战斗中为 Sevagoth 的幽影播放的自定歌曲，该曲目也可在轨道飞行器中使用身心和弦琴播放。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ShipDecoBundleEn.text: Give your space an air of scholarly sophistication.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ShipDecoBundleEn.zhText: 为你的空间增添学术的精致气息。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ShrineMaidenSupP.text:
Re-weave the strands of fate by adding the dice-maiden Warframe, Koumei, along with her signature Customizations to your Arsenal!

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ShrineMaidenSupP.zhText:
通过将掷骰巫女战甲 Koumei 连同她的标志性自定义装饰添加到你的军械库，重新编织命运之线！

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SistersOfParvosC.text: Sisters of Parvos Community Art Pack
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SistersOfParvosC.zhText: 《帕尔沃斯的姐妹们》社区艺术组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SistersOfParvosS.text:
Fight back against the Corpus with the Sisters of Parvos Waverider Pack! Use the new Kompressa Pistol to wash enemies away in a flood of high-pressured water, plus get discounted Platinum and more instantly.

- 100 Platinum
- Kompressa Pistol
- Merulina Syandana
- Merulina Domestik Drone
- Yareli Aquablade Sigil

Limited-time offer. Only one per account.

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/StyanaxCosmeticB.text: The accouterments of an experienced warrior. This collection includes the Styanax Synmora Helmet, Styanax Agogean Helmet, Lanex Syandana, Styanax Voidshell Skin with Fieldron Form material structure, and Tharros & Axios Decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/StyanaxCosmeticB.zhText: 一位经验丰富的勇士的精美装备。这款组合包内含 Styanax 步兵团头盔、Styanax 极训头盔、阵兵披饰、Styanax 虚空之壳外观和电磁力场装置形式材质结构以及豪勇 & 崇敬装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SyndicateArmourP.zhText: 轻盈且又低调。血色面纱刺客的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SyndicateArmourP.text: Pieced together from salvage, this ad hoc armor set is signature to the Grineer renegades of Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SyndicateArmourP.zhText: 这套特别的护甲由残骸拼接打造而成，是钢铁防线 Grineer 反叛者的标志性护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SyndicateArmourP.text: Repurposed and reliable, strap on Solaris armor and everything's green.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/SyndicateArmourP.zhText: 可靠且经过改造，穿上索拉里斯护甲，你就能一路畅通无阻。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TC2025DigitalPac.text:
Instantly add this year's exclusive TennoCon items to your Arsenal, available now only for a limited time!

Keep in mind that with access to Baro's TennoCon 2025 Relay, you'll also be able to trade Ducats for every item Baro has ever sold.

The TennoCon 2025 Digital Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TC2025DigitalPac.zhText:
即刻将今年专属的 TennoCon 物品添加到你的军械库，仅当下限时发售！

请记住，拥有访问 Baro 的 TennoCon 2025 中继站的权限，你可以使用杜卡德金币交易 Baro 出售过的所有物品。

TennoCon 2025 虚拟礼包为限时发售，每个账号仅限购买一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TC2026DigitalPac.text: Instantly add this year's exclusive TennoCon items to your Arsenal, available now only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TC2026DigitalPac.zhText: 即刻将今年专属的 TennoCon 物品添加到你的军械库，仅限时发售！

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TNWMarketBundleD.text: Recall the New War with cosmetics that invoke Narmer and Archons.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TNWMarketBundleD.zhText: 通过那些唤起合一众和执刑官的自定义装饰来回忆新纪之战。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TOPCommunityDisp.text: A bundle containing displays of Marie, Lyon, and Roathe. Together, they form the Devil's Triad.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TOPCommunityDisp.zhText: 包含玛丽、里昂和罗瑟展示图的组合包。三者共同构成恶魔三重奏。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TOPCompletePackD.text: Face harrowing memories of war and seek redemption - or retribution - in answer to the question: Can the Orokin ever be forgiven?
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TOPCompletePackD.zhText: 面对战争的痛苦回忆，寻求救赎——或者复仇——只需以回答以下问题：奥罗金能否得到宽恕？

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TOPGeminiSkinsPa.text:
Deepen the bonds of camaraderie between the three unlikely companions of the Devil's Triad with this collection of Protoframe Gemini Skins.

Each skin can switch between Warframe and Protoframe appearances by activating the corresponding Gemini Emote.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TOPGeminiSkinsPa.zhText:
通过这组原型战甲双子外观，加深恶魔三重奏中三位看似不可能的伙伴之间的友谊。

每款外观都可以通过使用相应的双子表情动作在战甲和原型战甲外观之间切换。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleCorp.text: Invest in self-expression. The Taxmen Visage Ink Collection includes Airlock, Collateral, Dividend, Futures, and Hull Breach Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleCorp.zhText: 投资于自我表达。税务官面部纹身墨水组合包包含气闸、抵押、红利、期货和船裂面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。
税务官面部纹身墨水组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleDuvi.text:
Embrace the spirit of discovery. The Curiosity Visage Ink Collection includes Academe, Circuit, Kiai, and Verula Ink designs.
*Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleDuvi.zhText:
拥抱探索精神。好奇心面部纹身墨水组合包内含学院、无尽回廊、气合和维鲁拉面部纹身图案。
*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。
好奇心面部纹身墨水组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleDuvi.text:
The Tales of Duviri storybook finds expression in these designs. The Paradox Visage Ink Collection includes Sharpshooter, Heavy Striker, Manipura, and Aru Visage Ink.
*Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleDuvi.zhText:
《双衍王境故事集》中的故事在这些设计中得到了体现。悖论面部纹身墨水组合包内含神射手、猛力重击者、宝石和存在面部纹身墨水。
*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。
悖论面部纹身墨水组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleGrin.text: Set yourself apart. The Cloned Flesh Visage Ink Collection includes Bulwark, Exome, Helix, Hunter, and Siege Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleGrin.zhText: 让自己与众不同。复制肉体面部纹身墨水组合包包括堡垒、外显子、螺旋、猎人和攻城面部纹身图案。 *面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。
复制肉体面部纹身墨水组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleLove.text: Wear your heart on your sleeve. The Devotion Visage Ink Collection includes Affections, Amorous, Cherub, and Eros Struck Visage Ink designs. *Visage Ink can only be applied to Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TattooBundleLove.zhText: 敞开你的心扉。挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包包括爱意、风情之花、小天使和爱神秋波面部纹身图案。*面部纹身墨水只适用于漂泊者。
挚爱面部纹身墨水组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TauAntiqueWeapon.text:
Unlock the secrets of the ancient focus schools and unleash their ultimate power, the Tauron Strike. Contains all the resources you need to acquire a Tektolyst Artifact weapon from Marie Leroux, in La Cathédrale.

(La Cathédrale unlocks upon completion of The Old Peace quest.)
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TauAntiqueWeapon.zhText:
揭开远古专精学派的秘密，释放其终极力量——Tauron 打击。该组合包内含从位于大教堂的玛丽·勒鲁处获取工匠使文物武器所需的所有资源。

（完成《旧日和平》系列任务后即可解锁大教堂。）
工匠使文物获取组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TauDaxWeaponSkin.text: Take up the distinctive arms of the Dax of Tau with this collection of weapon skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TauDaxWeaponSkin.zhText: 通过这套武器外观，体验 Tau 禁卫的独特武器。
Tau 禁卫军备外观组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TekeluWeaponBund.text: Forged by masters from the Tekelu School of weaponsmiths, these skins feature intricate designs of an unmatched quality.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TekeluWeaponBund.zhText: 由提奇鲁宗派的武器工匠大师们所铸造，这套华丽的外观有着品质无与伦比的复杂设计。
提奇鲁外观组合包 III
提奇鲁外观组合包 II

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TempestarriSuppo.text:
Discover a gruesome new playstyle with the Tempestarii Supporter Pack! This pack has everything you need to awaken your inner shadow, including discounted Platinum and more.

- 350 Platinum
- Sevagoth Warframe
- Vithil Syandana
- Lucifuge Helmet
- 30-Day Affinity Booster
- Forma Bundle

Limited-time offer. Only one per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TempestarriSuppo.zhText:
通过风暴使者支援包来探索令人毛骨悚然的全新玩法！这个组合包拥有让你的内在阴影觉醒所需要的一切，包括超值折扣白金，以及更多精彩内容。

- 350 白金
- Sevagoth 战甲
- 威丝披饰
- 避光头盔
- 30 天经验值加成
- Forma 组合包

限时发售。每个账号仅限购买一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TempleItemsBundl.text: Never let the music be silenced with Temple.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TempleItemsBundl.zhText: 永远不要让 Temple 的音乐沉寂。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TenYearAnniversa.zhText: 十周年玩家社区艺术品组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TenYearAnniversa.text: An anniversary-themed collection featuring a Glyph and two Displays made by community artists to celebrate 10 Years of Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TenYearAnniversa.zhText: 一个周年纪念主题的组合包，内含一个浮印和两个由社区艺术家制作的展示图，以此庆祝 Warframe 的十周年纪念。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TennokaiModsBund.text: Recall the ancient art of Tennokai with these Melee Weapon Mods. Everything in this pack can also be earned from Alchemy Missions in Albrecht's Laboratories on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TennokaiModsBund.zhText: 通过这些近战武器 Mod，重温古老的 Tenno 气解之艺。本组合包中的所有物品都可以从火卫二上阿尔布雷希特的实验室中的元素转换任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TheNewWarSupport.text:
UPGRADE YOUR ARSENAL TO FIGHT THE NEW WAR!

For a limited time, instantly add a Weapon, Customizations, Boosters and more to your Arsenal to repel the Sentient invasion and fight The New War. Evolve your look with the new Protovyre Ephemera, which will unlock additional Customizations as you play.

Pack Includes:
- Protovyre Ephemera
- Redeemer
- Ravurex Gunblade Skin*
- Narmer Color Palette*
- 7-Day Affinity Booster
- 7-Day Credit Booster
- Archon Nira Glyph*
- Archon Nira Sigil*

One per account. Items marked with * will be exclusive to this pack for a limited time.

升级你的军械库来应对《新纪之战》！

在限定的时间内，即刻把一件武器、自定义装饰、加成，以及更多精彩物品添加到你的军械库，以击退 Sentient 的入侵，并应对《新纪之战》。使用全新的源噬装备升级你的外观，该物品将在你游玩时解锁额外的自定义装饰。

组合包内含：
- 源噬幻纹

- 合一众调色盘*

每个账号仅限购买一次。标注 "*" 的物品仅能在限定时间内，通过这个组合包获取。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TigrisPetArmourB.zhText: 包含幼发拉底库狛与库娃宠物护甲，以猛虎霰弹枪令人生畏的锋利外观为蓝本。
幼发拉底宠物护甲组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TitaniaDeluxeIIS.text: Assume the lethal form of a lustrous midnight. This collection includes the Titania Donann skin, Titania's Moyturan Wings, the Aerospri Dex Pixia Skin, the Hawth Diwata Skin, and the Raylta Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TitaniaDeluxeIIS.zhText: 化身为皎洁之夜的致命形态。该组合包内含 Titania 大地女神外观、Titania 莫伊图兰翅膀、 Dex 妖精空灵外观、仙女赤爪外观，以及星翼披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TitaniaDeluxeSki.text: The trappings of royalty. Includes the deluxe Titania Empress Skin, Hawkmoth skin for the Dex Pixia exalted weapon, the Mot Skin for the Diwata sword, Titania's Heartwood Armor Set and the Dendrite Gunblade Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TitaniaDeluxeSki.zhText: 来自皇室的诱惑。此组合包内含 Titania 女皇华丽外观、显赫武器 DEX 妖精的天蛾外观、仙女长剑的莫特外观、Titania 的赤木护甲套装，以及树突枪刃外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnArmourCurveBun.text: Broad swooping curves are the essence of the Nidina armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnArmourCurveBun.zhText: 宽阔的曲线是尼迪纳护甲套装的精髓。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnCeramicArmourB.text: Harden any look with this ultra sleek composite ceramic armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnCeramicArmourB.zhText: 以这套线条极为优美的复合陶瓷护甲来强化任何造型。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnCeramicItemsBu.text: Strike a bold pose with the Ceramica skin collection. Contains the Pandero Ceramica Skin, Ceramica Tonfa Skin, and Ceramica Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnCeramicItemsBu.zhText: 由陶瓷外观所打造出的大胆姿态。内含手鼓陶瓷外观、陶瓷拐刃外观，以及陶瓷护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnDeimosSupporte.text: Seemingly infused with mystical power, the chosen Armor of graceful warriors.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnDeimosSupporte.zhText: 似乎被注入了神秘的力量，这是优雅的战士们所选择的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnGuandaoBundleD.text: Crimson ribbons tie this elegant collection of Tenno weapons together. This bundle features the Mozi Syandana, Guandao polearm, and Zakti pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnGuandaoBundleD.zhText: 绯红的缎带将这组优美的 Tenno 武器联系起来。这个组合包内含墨子披饰、关刀长柄武器和毒芽手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnHvArmourBundle.text: Styled to match the Baza submachine gun and the Cassowar polearm, this armor gives a regal look to any Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnHvArmourBundle.zhText: 这套护甲的设计风格跟苍鹰冲锋枪及鹤鸵长戟相配，赋予任何 Tenno 一股威严感。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnHvItemsBundleD.text: Stalk enemies with this deadly collection. Includes the Baza submachine gun, Cassowar polearm, and Syrinx armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/TnHvItemsBundleD.zhText: 用这款致命的组合包来袭击你的敌人。内含苍鹰冲锋枪、鹤鸵长戟和鸣管护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/UmbraArmorBundle.text: The signature armor of Excalibur Umbra.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/UmbraArmorBundle.zhText: Excalibur Umbra 的标志性护甲

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/UmbraCosmeticsBu.text: Cast a long shadow with these Umbra and Dax items. This collection includes the Umbra Armor for Warframes, Umbra Kavat Armor, Umbra Kubrow Armor, as well as the Nikana Dax Skin, Orvius Dax Skin, Dax Syandana and Dax Portrait decoration.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/UmbraCosmeticsBu.zhText: 用这些 Umbra 和禁卫物品来投下一层深远的暗影。这个组合包含有用于战甲的 Umbra 护甲，Umbra 库娃护甲，Umbra 库狛护甲，以及禁卫侍刃外观，禁卫战刃外观，禁卫披饰和禁卫肖像装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/UrielSupPackDesc.text: Call down brimstone-laced devastation and take command of demonic servitors with Uriel, the Heretic of Xata.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/UrielSupPackDesc.zhText: 与 Xata 的异端者 Uriel 一起，召唤硫磺带来的毁灭性灾难，并指挥恶魔的仆从。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VTEosArmourBundl.text: A full set of decorative armor for a stylish Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VTEosArmourBundl.zhText: 为时髦 Tenno 打造的整套装饰性护甲。
曙光女神 Prime 护甲套装

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ValkyrDeluxeBund.text: Fear and awe will be seen in your enemies' eyes when they behold the great berserker. Her collection includes the Valkyr Carnivex Skin, Dreyric Fist Skin, and Alastorn Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ValkyrDeluxeBund.zhText: 当伟大的狂战士出现时，你将从敌人的眼中看到恐惧和敬畏。这款组合包内含 Valkyr 行刑者外观、沁血拳套外观，以及魔使护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ValkyrHeirloomPa.text: Valkyr rises in majesty, casting off her legacy of torment in the Valkyr Heirloom Collection! Heirloom Customizations signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/ValkyrHeirloomPa.zhText: Valkyr 的崛起威风凛凛，在 Valkyr 传家宝组合包中摆脱了她苦难的过往。传家宝外观象征着时间的流逝和 Tenno 的付出。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VaubanDeluxeSkin.text: Reinforce allies with this ingenious warrior. Contains the Vauban Citadel Skin, the Mortier Heavy Blade Skin, and the Marquis Sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VaubanDeluxeSkin.zhText: 用这个灵巧的战士增援盟友。包含 Vauban 城塞外观，莫迪尔巨刃外观和侯爵坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VaubanHeirloomPa.text: Refine the legacy of a genius tactician with this collection of bold Heirloom items.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VaubanHeirloomPa.zhText: 通过这一系列大胆的传家宝物品，传承天才战术家的传奇。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VeilbreakerCommu.text: A collection of a Glyph and Display created by artists in the Warframe Community.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VeilbreakerCommu.zhText: 一组来自 Warframe 社区艺术家创作的浮印和展示图。
《破障者》社区艺术作品组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VeilbreakerSuppo.text:
Stand by your brothers in arms and defend the defenseless with the items in this pack. Inspire courage with the For My Brothers Glyph, Kahl’s Fortitude Sigil, and Ascension Speargun Skin. Arm yourself with the powerful Slaytra, Afentis, and Aegrit Weapons. 

This pack features:

- 350 Platinum
- Slaytra Machete
- Afentis Speargun
- Ascension Speargun Skin
- Aegrit Thrown Weapon
- Fog of War Ephemera
- Kahl's Fortitude Sigil
- For My Brothers Glyph
- Noggle Statue - Kahl-175
- 7-Day Affinity Booster
- 7-Day Credit Booster

This pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VeilbreakerSuppo.zhText:
与你的兄弟并肩作战，使用这个组合包中的物品来保护手无寸铁之人。通过“为了我的兄弟们”浮印、Kahl 之刚毅纹章，以及飞升标枪外观来由内而发激发勇气；并使用强大的武器屠煞、圣英和骇敌来武装自己。

组合包内含：

- 350 白金
- 屠煞砍刀
- 圣英标枪
- 飞升标枪外观
- 骇敌投掷武器
- 战争迷雾幻纹
- Kahl 之刚毅纹章
- 为了我的兄弟们浮印
- Kahl-175 摇头娃娃
- 7 天经验值加成
- 7 天现金加成

此组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VeilbreakerVoids.text:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Excalibur Voidshell Skin, Nova Voidshell Skin, Wukong Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VeilbreakerVoids.zhText:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Excalibur 虚空之壳外观、Nova 虚空之壳外观、Wukong 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VentersGlyphBund.text: A collection of Glyphs from renowned fantasy artist, Pete Venters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VentersGlyphBund.zhText: 来自著名梦幻作品艺术家 Pete Venters 的浮印系列。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VenusCrpWeaponBu.text: Up your chances of making it on the Vallis with this collection of experimental Corpus weaponry: the Battacor Rifle, Ocucor Pistol and Kreska Ice Pick.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VenusCrpWeaponBu.zhText: 用这个 Corpus 实验性武器组合包来增加你在山谷上生存下来的几率：武使之力步枪、视使之触手枪，以及直镐冰镐。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentIII.text:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mag Voidshell Skin, Frost Voidshell Skin, Grendel Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentIII.zhText:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mag 虚空之壳外观、Frost 虚空之壳外观、Grendel 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentIVB.text:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Limbo Voidshell Skin and Mesa Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentIVB.zhText:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Limbo 虚空之壳外观、Mesa 虚空之壳外观、以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentVBu.text:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Mirage Voidshell Skin, Nidus Voidshell Skin and Protea Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentVBu.zhText:
充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Mirage 虚空之壳外观、Nidus 虚空之壳外观，和 Protea 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentVIB.text: Make the most of the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Banshee Voidshell Skin, Loki Voidshell Skin, Nekros Voidshell Skin, and each skin’s matching material structure.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidAdornmentVIB.zhText: 充分利用「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时所产生的变形材料，该组合包内含 Banshee 虚空之壳外观、Loki 虚空之壳外观、Nekros 虚空之壳外观，以及每个外观的配套材质结构。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidThraxWeaponB.text: Claim the Void-touched Weapons wielded by Thrax Centurion and Legatus as your own.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoidThraxWeaponB.zhText: 将凶魂百夫长和凶魂副将含有虚空之力的武器据为己有。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltDeluxeRaijin.text: Claim attire forged to conquer the storm. This bundle includes Volt Raijin’s signature accessories.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltDeluxeRaijin.zhText: 获取为征服风暴而打造的装束。此组合包内含 Volt 雷帝的标志性配件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltDeluxeSkinBu.text: Charge up Volt with this collection of items that includes the Volt Proto Skin, Diode Hammer Skin, and Cathode Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltDeluxeSkinBu.zhText: 使用这款道具组合包将 Volt 充满电能，包括了 Volt 原型外观、二极管战锤外观和阴极披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltNovaSumoDelu.text:
Sprint into action with the electrifying Volt Raijin Skin and antimatter-adorning Nova Aozakura Skin by adding both to your Arsenal today!

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltNovaSumoDelu.zhText:
今天就将带电的 Volt 雷帝外观和反物质 Nova 蓝樱外观添加到你的军械库中，一起冲锋陷阵！

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltRaijinNovaAo.text: Beauty meets chaos. This collection includes accessories for both Volt Raijin and Nova Aozakura.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltRaijinNovaAo.zhText: 美感与混沌的交融。此组合包内含 Volt 雷帝和 Nova 蓝樱的配件。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltRaijinNovaAo.text: Embody the fury of the storm and the grace of sakura petals that float upon the water. This collection includes both Volt Raijin and Nova Aozakura.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltRaijinNovaAo.zhText: 体现风暴的狂怒和樱花花瓣漂浮在水面上的优雅。该组合包内含 Volt 雷帝和 Nova 蓝樱。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltVoidshellBun.text:
Adorn Volt in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Volt Voidshell Skin and the Crimzian Opulence material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VoltVoidshellBun.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Volt 虚空之壳外观以及奢华绯红石材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VorunaDeluxeSkin.text: Invoke Voruna Medeina, the forest goddess. Her savagery is a blessing to those who hunger for justice.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VorunaDeluxeSkin.zhText: 祈求森林女神 Voruna 梅迪娜的庇佑。她的狂野对渴望正义的人来说是一种祝福。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VorunaVoidshellB.text:
Adorn Voruna in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Voruna Voidshell Skin and Rough Cryotic material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/VorunaVoidshellB.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Voruna 虚空之壳外观以及永冻晶矿糙纹材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WarStoriesBundle.text:
Recall buried battlefield memories with this collection of ancient mementos. Some things ought never be forgotten.

The Klebrik Scaffold, Granmu Prism and Lohrin Brace are Amp components that can be assembled within the Quill cave.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WarStoriesBundle.zhText:
通过这套古老的纪念品唤起尘封已久的战场记忆。有些事永远不应被遗忘。

克莱布里克支架、格兰姆棱镜和洛林曲柄均为增幅器部件，可以在希图斯的夜羽洞穴内进行组装。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WeaponStarterPac.text:
Outfit your Arsenal with a powerful Primary Weapon and Max Rank Mod! 

This pack may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WeaponStarterPac.zhText:
用强大的主要武器和最大等级 Mod 来强化你的军械库！ 

每个账号只能购买此组合包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WispBundleDesc.text: Creation and destruction intermingle in this ethereal bundle for Wisp. Contains Wisp, her signature Fulmin lightning rifle, Sirocco Kavat Armor, the alternate Gaoth Helmet as well as 3-day credit and affinity boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WispBundleDesc.zhText: 创造和毁灭在这飘渺的组合包中交织在一起。此组合包内含 Wisp、她的独特雷霆闪电步枪、西洛可库娃护甲、轻风替换头盔，以及 3 天现金和经验值加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WispDeluxeSkinBu.text: Natural and preternatural combine in Wisp Somnium. This collection includes the Wisp Somnium Skin, Subvolv Syandana, and Privolv Fulmin Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WispDeluxeSkinBu.zhText: Wisp 星梦是自然与超自然的结合体。该组合包包括 Wisp 星梦外观、月阳披饰和月阴雷霆外观。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WitWGlyphBundleD.text: A bundle featuring a Man in the Wall and Albrecht Entrati Glyph from Community Artists SirEnarion & death_ma666ots
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WitWGlyphBundleD.zhText: 组合包内含由社区艺术家 SirEnarion 和 death_ma666ots 设计的墙中人和阿尔布雷希特·英择谛浮印。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WitWGlyphBundleN.text: Whispers in the Walls Community Glyph Bundle

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfArmourBundle.text: The signature battle armor of the only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfArmourBundle.zhText: 能逃脱出土星六号最高戒备监狱的唯一可怕狂人的标志性战斗护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfFrameBundleD.text: Revere the relentless hunting shadow. This pack includes the Voruna Warframe, Sarofang and Perigale weapons, Voruna's Anukas Helmet and Voidshell Skin with Rough Cryotic material structure, the Okuri Tails Ephemera, and the Lua's Pack Mural.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfFrameBundleD.zhText: 敬畏无情的暗影猎手。该组合包内含：Voruna 战甲、沙罗之牙和月面狂风武器、Voruna 冥魂头盔和带有永冻晶矿糙纹材质结构的虚空之壳外观、狼妖尾幻纹，以及月之狼群壁画。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfGlyphBundleD.text: A pair of glyphs depicting the Wolf of Saturn Six.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfGlyphBundleD.zhText: 描绘着土星六号之狼的一对浮印

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfGlyphBundleN.text: Wolf of Saturn Six Glyph Bundle
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfGlyphBundleN.zhText: 土星六号之狼浮印组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfHeadStauteBu.text: The Yuvan Clerisy commissioned these golden statues to honor Lua's guardian pack. They are now yours to cherish. The collection includes the Steadfast Dynar Bust, Steadfast Raksh Bust, Steadfast Lycath Bust, and Steadfast Ulfrun Bust.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WolfHeadStauteBu.zhText: 青春仪使团委托制作了这些金色雕像来纪念守护月球的狼群。它们现在交给你来珍藏。该组合包内含坚韧的戴拿半身铜像、坚韧的亚克什半身铜像、坚韧的莱卡斯半身铜像和坚韧的乌尔佛伦半身铜像。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WraithItemsBundl.text: Put the fear of the Void into your foes with Sevagoth, the reaper of souls. Collection includes Sevagoth, Sevagoth Lucifuge helmet, Epitaph sidearm, Vithil Syandana and 3 day Affinity and Credit boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WraithItemsBundl.zhText: 化身为灵魂收割者 Sevagoth 来把你的敌人带入虚空的恐惧中。该组合包内含 Sevagoth 战甲、Sevagoth 避光头盔、葬铭次要武器、威丝披饰和三天经验值与现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongDeluxeSkin.text: A collection of Immortal Wukong items, including Wukong Samadhi Skin, Meteor Whip Skin, and the Subhuti Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongDeluxeSkin.zhText: Wukong 不朽物品组合包，包含 Wukong 三摩提外观 、流星鞭外观，以及须菩提披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongDeluxeSupP.text: Embark upon an epic journey with this collection of skins and items for Wukong Qitian.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongDeluxeSupP.zhText: 与这套 Wukong 齐天大圣外观及物品组合包一同踏上史诗之旅。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongSunMoonBun.text: The greatest journey begins with a single step. Prepare your arsenal for Wukong Qitian with this bundle containing the original forms of the Wukong Warframe and Sun & Moon dual blades.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongSunMoonBun.zhText: 千里之行始于足下。通过这款包含 Wukong 战甲原始版本以及赤阳 & 幽月双刀的组合包为迎接齐天大圣做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongVoidshellB.text:
Adorn Wukong in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Wukong Voidshell Skin and Rubedo Impression material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/WukongVoidshellB.zhText:
穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料，该组合包内含 Wukong 虚空之壳外观以及红色印象材质结构。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/XGPGrakataBundle.text:
Twin Grakatas Jade Bundle includes:

- 100,000 Credits
- 75 Platinum
- Twin Grakatas
- Twin Grakatas Jade Skin
- Clem Jade Emblem
- 7-Day Affinity Booster

Twin Grakatas Jade Bundle may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/XGPGrakataBundle.zhText:
双子葛拉卡达翡翠组合包内含：

- 100,000 游戏现金
- 75 白金
- 双子葛拉卡达
- 双子葛拉卡达翡翠外观
- Clem 翡翠徽章
- 7 天经验值加成

双子葛拉卡达翡翠组合包为限时发售，每个账号仅可购买一次。
双子葛拉卡达翡翠组合包

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/XakuDeluxePotBun.text: Decorate your Orbiter with a complete set of Gallixware ceramics. Each piece was handcrafted by the esteemed Orokin artist, Bren Terrasiam. The bundle includes three vases, a plate, a bowl, and an amphora.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/XakuDeluxePotBun.zhText: 用一整套高力士陶瓷装饰你的轨道飞行器。每件作品均由受人尊敬的奥罗金艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆手工制作而成。该组合包内含三个花瓶、一个盘子、一个碗和一个双耳瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Bundles/XakuLotusDeluxeS.text:
The Void reimagines broken Orokin treasures. In these manifestations of Xaku's memories, remnants of warfare meet fragments of artistry. The collection includes Xaku Kagura, Lotus Amaga, the Lohk's Embrace Ephemera, Xaku and Lotus Mended Glyphs, and Gallixware ceramic decorations for your Orbiter.

Complete The New War Quest to unlock Lotus customization.
/Lotus/Language/Bundles/XakuLotusDeluxeS.zhText:

/Lotus/Language/Champions/ChampionsGrine.text: Not much is known about the mysterious Zura. She appeared in the fighting pits with her Hyekka and carved a bloody path through her opposition. The crowd always roars with pleasure when Zura steps into the fighting pits.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/ChampionsGrine.zhText: 关于神秘的 Zura 没有太多的资料。她和她的鬣猫出现在角斗场，在对抗她的人之中杀出一条血路。当她步入决斗场的时候人群总会有欢呼声。
一位无所畏惧的灵活斗士。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/ChampionsGrine.text: The sole survivor of a frontier battalion that was eradicated by a lone Tenno, when Garesh eventually returned to civilization, he was tried as a deserter and sentenced to death by Rathuum. To everyone's surprise he killed all his Executioners and was granted a pardon on the condition that he himself become an Executioner. Garesh yearns for the day when he can punish a Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/ChampionsGrine.zhText: 作为在边境营地被一名单枪匹马的 Tenno 连根拔起后唯一的幸存者，当加雷什重返文明世界时，死亡角斗场将他审判为逃兵并处以死刑。出乎所有人意料的是，他杀死了所有行刑者，并且被准许成为一名行刑者以免除死罪。加雷什渴望着有朝一日可以对 Tenno 动手处决。
一位擅长狡猾和欺骗的斗士。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/ChampionsGrine.text: Olka Harkonar hails from the Harkonar Production Zone. She is one of the few nobles not satisfied by simply watching her weapons wreak havoc, she needed to join the fray. So Olka Harkonar became an Executioner of Rathuum, vowing to prove the might of Harkonar weapons and armor with every judgement she made.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/ChampionsGrine.zhText: 奥卡·哈库那出身于哈库那生产区。她是为数不多的贵族之一，仅仅看着她的武器肆虐一切并不能让她得到满足，她需要亲身参与进来。因此她成为了死亡角斗场的行刑者，誓言要通过她每次的行刑来证明哈库那武器与护甲的威力。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerEnginee.text: A cunning combatant that uses machinery to assist him.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerEnginee.zhText: 一位使用机器来辅助他的狡猾斗士。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerEnginee.text: Reth was once a simple labourer working in the shipyards on Ceres. He often wondered how lethal the equipment he worked with could be if he only made minor tweaks to its design. After a series of escalated killings his handiwork was discovered by his superiors. Rather than risk being captured, Reth fled to Kela, where he now field tests his latest machinations in the service of Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerEnginee.zhText: 莱斯过去曾经是一名在谷神星造船厂工作的劳工。他对于手中用于劳务的装备如经过微调改造后，能够有多致命感到十分好奇。经过一系列不断加剧的杀戮行为，他的杰作终于被上级发现。与其冒险被抓，莱斯转向投奔 Kela，莱斯现在服侍着死亡角斗场并在他在麾下测试最新的阴谋诡计。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHeavyDe.text: A resilient combatant who relishes pain.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHeavyDe.zhText: 一名以享受痛苦为乐的好战者。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHeavyLo.text:
Dhurnam loved to hurt things. As a Grineer officer, he inflicted pain at any possible opportunity. So when he heard about Tyl Regor's experimental body augmentations, he clamored to become a subject. He didn't care about side effects, anything to become stronger.

The experiment left him sluggish and unresponsive. Weak of voice, he whispered for death. Instead, Regor ordered him beaten. The pain brought Dhurnam to life. He became a beast, eviscerating the unfortunate things sent to hurt him. Regor was pleased.

But the experiment was only a partial success. Without pain, Dhurnam grew weak again. Unfit for regular duty, the pits of Rathuum became his new home. The only place where he could find the steady diet of torment and suffering needed to survive.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHeavyLo.zhText:
身为一名 Grineer 军官，热爱伤害事物的杜纳姆握有任何得以造成痛苦的机会。因此当他得知泰尔·雷工要增加实验体时，杜纳姆吵着也要成为一名受测者。他毫不在乎副作用，亦或是变得更强壮这件事情。
 
这场实验使他变得呆滞而迟钝，声音微弱的他低语着死亡。然而雷工下令让人殴打他，这份痛楚带给了杜纳姆新生。杜纳姆成为了一头野兽，抽出那些伤害他的不幸者的内脏，这令雷工感到十分满意。
 
但实验仅取得了部份成功，缺乏痛楚的杜纳姆再次变得虚弱。由于无法常态性值勤，死亡角斗场的死斗场成为了他的新归宿。那里是他得以找到稳定的折磨粮食与生存下去的痛楚的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHellion.text: Highly maneuverable combatant with devastating attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHellion.zhText: 拥有毁灭性攻击力的高机动斗士。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHellion.text: In return for a substantial donation to his campaign, Vay Hek consigned one of his most vicious clones to Kela’s service. Vay Molta has become a crowd favorite with her modified Jat Kittag.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerHellion.zhText: 作为在竞选活动中获得大量物质捐赠的酬谢，韦·海克委托了他克隆人中最险恶的一名亲信为 Kela 效命。在成功改造喷射战锤之后，Vay Molta 俨然成为众人眼中的闪亮之星。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerMedicDe.text: Heals his team with advanced medical technology.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerMedicDe.zhText: 拥有先进的治疗技术来治愈他的团队。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerMedicLo.text: Once a medical officer under Sargas Ruk, Thul failed to save the life of one of his favoured officers. Thul was "reassigned" to service under Kela as an Executioner of Rathuum. He has managed to survive under the protection of his allies, who value his medical skills.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerMedicLo.zhText: 过去曾在 Sargas Ruk 手下任职医官时，图尔未能成功挽回 Sargas Ruk 所钟爱的成员性命，图尔的职务因此被「重新分配」到 Kela 麾下，成为一名死亡角斗场的行刑者。他依靠盟军的庇护生存下来，因为他们非常看重他的医疗技术。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerSoldier.text: An experienced veteran, trained and disciplined.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerSoldier.zhText: 一位富有经验的老兵，训练有素且严守纪律。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerSoldier.text: Nok led a decorated career in service to Captain Vor, tasked with routing out any weak or anarchic influences within the ranks of the Grineer Army. After many years of loyal service, the degenerative effects that plague all Grineer began taking their toll on Nok. With Vor's blessing, Nok was granted leave to spend his remaining days punishing Grineer in the court of Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GrineerSoldier.zhText: 效命于上尉沃尔时，诺克带领着一支粉饰太平的职业。诺克被指派去销毁任何虚弱或是阵线受无政府意识煽动影响的 Grineer 军队。历经长年的忠诚服务后，一直以来困扰且重创了全体 Grineer 的基因衰退问题也降临到诺克身上。在沃尔的庇护之下，诺克被批准纳入死亡角斗场麾下，在惩处 Grineer 中度过余生。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/GruntDroneDesc.text: Delivers the final judgement of Executioner Nok.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/GruntDroneDesc.zhText: 负责给行刑者诺克递交最终裁定。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/NightwatchLead.text: A frontline warrior who protects his allies.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/NightwatchLead.zhText: 一位保护他同盟的前线战士。

/Lotus/Language/Champions/NightwatchLead.text: Gorth was a distinguished commander of the Nightwatch Corps but when he unwittingly killed a close ally of Lech Kril for stealing supplies, he faced political fallout that destroyed his career. Exiled from military service, Gorth now seeks to redeem his honor as an Executioner of Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/Champions/NightwatchLead.zhText: 高斯是一名杰出的夜巡者指挥官。然而当他无意间杀死一名正在行窃补给品的 Lech Kril 亲信后，他面临到政治生涯宣告结束的后果。他从服役的军队中被流放，如今高斯借由成为死亡角斗场的行刑者，意图挽回他的荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Changyou/VaubanIntroBody.text:
Pupil,

With the fall of the Orokin many Warframes were lost, their parts scattered throughout the system. Vauban is one such Warframe but through tireless searching the blueprints for him are now mine. I want to share these blueprints but only with the most promising Tenno. I will watch you and if I feel your skills have grown, I will reward you with a part.

The anxious pupil will ask, "what test must I pass?", but this Tenno would not be ready. Exercise all your skills so that you are prepared for any challenge, only then will you be rewarded.

-Teshin
/Lotus/Language/Changyou/VaubanIntroBody.zhText:
我的弟子，
随着奥罗金的陨落，很多战甲都陷入了遗失之谜。他们的部件散落在整个太阳系中，工程统帅就是他们其中之一。通过孜孜不倦的搜寻，这些蓝图已经被我找到。我希望能跟所有积极进取的天诺战士分享这些图纸。我会随时考察你，一旦我觉得你的能力有所增长，我会将他们作为奖励送给你。

性急的弟子可能会问，“我要通过怎样的考验才能获得图纸？”如果你这样问，那就证明你还没准备好。你必须精进你所有的技能才能应对无处不在的挑战。也只有这样的天诺战士才有资格获得图纸。

泰辛

/Lotus/Language/Changyou/VaubanKilledVor.text:
Pupil,

I see you understand that a Tenno cannot become a master warrior without first becoming a master of the armory. With this Vauban Systems blueprint you are one step closer to true mastery.

-Teshin
/Lotus/Language/Changyou/VaubanKilledVor.zhText:
我的弟子，
也许你并不知道，你已经通过了一次测试，这个工程统帅设计图是你的奖励。

在你的道路上继续努力吧，少年。

泰辛
战斗的工具：工程统帅设计图

/Lotus/Language/Changyou/VaubanPolarized.text:
Pupil,

I see you understand that a Tenno cannot become a master warrior without first becoming a master of the armory. With this Vauban Systems blueprint you are one step closer to true mastery.

-Teshin
/Lotus/Language/Changyou/VaubanPolarized.zhText:
我的弟子，
看来你已经明白了，如果不成为一个懂得精进装备的巧匠，任何一个天诺战士都很难成为一个能真正主宰战斗的圣者。拿着这个工程统帅系统蓝图吧，你离真正的大师又近了一步。

泰辛

/Lotus/Language/Clan/MOTDAndClanInfoTitl.zhText: 本 |TIER| 给氏族内 |NUM| 位成员的每日信息：

/Lotus/Language/Clan/MarooClanAdvertiseD.text:
Hey, |PLAYER_NAME|.

Word is you're the smooth talker in charge of bringing in new recruits for |CLAN_NAME|.

Imagine how many more recruits you could get if I used my connections to advertise for you!

You could get the message out to every lone Tenno in the System. Hype up your Clan to all the hopeful newbies and rootless veterans out there just looking for a place to belong. Maybe even tempt a few rival Clan members to jump ship!

Good news. I can get your Clan's recruitment message out there for a modest fee.

Interested? Great. Get your recruitment message written, and come see me at the Bazaar.

Maroo
/Lotus/Language/Clan/MarooClanAdvertiseD.zhText:
嘿，|PLAYER_NAME|。

据说你是为 |CLAN_NAME| 招选新成员的负责人。

想象一下，如果我用我的人脉为你做广告，你还能招到多少人！

你可以将信息传达给系统中的每一名没有组织的 Tenno。向所有满怀希望的新手和无根漂泊的老兵宣传你的氏族，他们都在寻找一个属于自己的地方。也有可能会引发一些来自敌对氏族成员的跳槽！

有个好消息。你只需交给我点东西我就可以帮你们氏族扩散招募信息。

有兴趣吗？太棒了。把你的招聘信息写好，来集市找我。

Maroo

/Lotus/Language/Clan/MarooClanSearchDesc.text:
Hey there, steelcheeks.

I got word you're running solo out there. Not affiliated to any of the Clans.

You do know there's hundreds of Clans that would love to have you, right?

Well, your pal Maroo's put her networking skills at your disposal.

See for yourself! All kinds of Clans, big and small, all puttin' recruitment calls out.

You can browse them at your leisure right there in your Orbiter. Or come and see me at the Bazaar.

Remember - where there's a demand, there's money to be made. And right now, YOU are in demand, |PLAYER_NAME|.

Maroo
/Lotus/Language/Clan/MarooClanSearchDesc.zhText:
哈喽，铁蛋儿。

我听说你是个独行侠。不隶属于任何氏族。

你肯定知道有数百个氏族想要你，对吧？

好吧，你的朋友 Maroo 已经将她的联络技能交赋给你了。

你自己看看！各式各样、大大小小的氏族，都在招募呢。

你可以在你的轨道飞行器上任意浏览它们。或者也可以来集市找我。

记住——哪里有需求，哪里就有钱赚。而现在，|PLAYER_NAME|，你很抢手。

Maroo

/Lotus/Language/Clan/RejectedFromClan.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Unfortunately, |CLAN_NAME| has not accepted your membership application at this time.

Please do not be downhearted, and do apply to other Clans. After all, there are so many Clans out there, you are bound to find one that is right for you!

And you will always have Ordis, of course.

Your loyal Cephalon,

Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Clan/RejectedFromClan.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

很遗憾， |CLAN_NAME| 未接受您的申请。

请不要灰心，向其它氏族发出申请。毕竟，有这么多的氏族，您一定会找到最适合您的！

您忠诚的中枢，

Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Clan/RoleDescription_Her.zhText: 成员可以编辑并发布每日信息。

/Lotus/Language/Clan/ViewInWorldStateScr.zhText: 于世界状态画面中浏览

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/AcridDesc.text: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/AcridDesc.zhText: （英文：ACRID）阿克里德可以射出注满强酸的刺针。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/AltEnergyRifleD.text: Energy Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/AltEnergyRifleD.zhText: 这是一把移除了Corpus 防护装置的能源步枪。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/BioComponentDes.text:
This living mass can produce weaponized toxins for weaponry.

Location: Clan Research (Bio Lab in the Dojo) and Infested Outbreak Invasion Rewards
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/BioComponentDes.zhText:
此生体聚合物可以制造出可供武器使用的毒素。 

获取地点：生物实验室（氏族道场）和 Infested 爆发奖励

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/BioFragmentDesc.text:
These samples could advance our knowledge of biological research.

Location: Eris and Deimos
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/BioFragmentDesc.zhText:
这些样本有助于使我们的生物研究水平更进一步。

获取地点：阋神星和火卫二。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/ChemComponentDe.text:
Detonite injectors are the basis for explosive and incendiary weapons.

Location: Clan Research (Chem Lab in the Dojo) and Grineer Invasion Rewards
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/ChemComponentDe.zhText:
爆燃喷射器是爆炸和燃烧类武器的基础。

获取地点：化学实验室（氏族道场）和 Grineer 入侵任务奖励

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/ChemFragmentDes.text:
Researching the Detonite traces within could advance our weapon technology.

Location: Venus, Earth, Lua, Ceres, Saturn, Sedna, and the Kuva Fortress
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/ChemFragmentDes.zhText:
对爆燃安瓿内的残留物进行研究，可推动我们的武器技术。

获取地点：金星，地球，月球，谷神星，土星，赛德娜和赤毒要塞。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpHeavyRifleDe.text: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpHeavyRifleDe.zhText: （英文：SUPRA）苏普拉是把重型激光枪，可在很短的时间内启动。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpLaserRifleDe.text: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpLaserRifleDe.zhText: （英文：FLUX RIFLE）一把已卸除了 Corpus 安全装置的激光步枪。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/EnergyComponent.text:
ClanTech weaponized containment field to contain superheated substances.

Location: Clan Research (Energy Lab in the Dojo) and Corpus Invasion Rewards
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/EnergyComponent.zhText:
氏族技术人员利用能量包围力场控制高热能物质以利于武器化。

获取地点：（道场中）能源实验室的氏族研究和 Corpus 入侵任务奖励

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/EnergyFragmentD.text:
This destroyed Fieldron could further research into super-heated containment fields.

Location: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune, and Pluto
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/EnergyFragmentD.zhText:
借由损坏的电磁力场装置可促进有关高热能物质能量包围力场方面的研究。

获取地点：金星，火星，木星，欧罗巴，海王星和冥王星。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/FlameThrowerDes.text: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/FlameThrowerDes.zhText: （英文：IGNIS）伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/GrenadeLauncher.text: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/GrenadeLauncher.zhText: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/ProdDesc.text: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/ProdDesc.zhText: （英文：PROVA）普罗沃是一把能对目标造成强大电击伤害的近战武器。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/RailgunDesc.text: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/RailgunDesc.zhText: （英文：LANKA）兰卡使用电磁加速射出高速子弹。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/RocketLauncherD.zhText: （英文：OGRIS）食人女魔能发射满载易爆物的炮弹。

/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/SpectraCorpusLa.text: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.
/Lotus/Language/ClanTech/SpectraCorpusLa.zhText: （英文：SPECTRA）虽然它原本设计给太空中的工程师，光谱切割器的集中激光对有机和合成敌人也非常有效。

/Lotus/Language/Codex/EmberLongDesc.text:
Three figures waited behind a simple table. Their attention on a single chair, bathed in light. An old woman's voice from the shadow: 'Send her in'. Across the room a security officer, stern and plain, opened the door. The outline of a young woman appeared at the door. She hesitated, but only for an instant, then crossed the room and sat.

There was a gasp as the light hit her face. Her right eye was bright and blinking, but her left was a greasy slit. Her skin had been burned moon-white. Her mouth was a sagging gash without lips or expression. Her military beret was pulled snug over a scarred and hairless scalp.

The old voice: 'Your name is Kaleen.' Kaleen nodded. 'You were the principal investigator of the Zariman?' Kaleen's voice was a jagged whisper, a rigid face. 'Yes.'

Kaleen coughed, straightened: 'The Zariman was lost making the fold from Saturn to the Outer gates. Mechanical failure. I notified families and filed a report with the inspectors. Nothing ever returns from the fold, so I closed the case.'

'But you reopened the case, days later.'

'I didn't believe it myself until I stepped aboard the ship. It was completely intact, full environmental, as if it had never left.'

'And the crew was gone.'

'Not exactly.' Kaleen hesitated. 'We thought it was empty but we began to find...' Her face twitched at remembered pain, 'We began to find children hiding in the ship.'

'And that is when you violated procedure?'

Kaleen bowed her head, a tear welling in her sightless eye. 'They were children. They were afraid. They needed comfort.'

'So you broke quarantine and this happened to you.'

There was silence as Kaleen touched her face, 'So what have you done with them?'

The old woman gestured for the officer to take Kaleen away. The meeting was over. When Kaleen reached the door she twisted out of his grip and shot back, 'Why would you do that? Why would you put children on a military ship?'

'We didn't. That would violate procedure.'
/Lotus/Language/Codex/EmberLongDesc.zhText:
三道人影在一张简单的桌子后方等待着，他们的目光停留在一张沐浴于光照中的椅子上。一个苍老女人的声音从阴影中传来: "送她进来。"一个警卫穿过房间，神情严肃而直接的打开了舱门，一名年轻女子的轮廓出现在门后。她迟疑了一下子，但只有一瞬间，旋即走过房间坐了下来。

当光线打在她的脸上时，周围倒抽一口气而响起了一阵惊呼。她的右眼明亮闪烁，但左眼却有着一道沾满油污的伤痕，她的皮肤被烧到裸露，露出了惨白的皮层，她的嘴上没有类似嘴唇的东西，看起来像是一个下垂的裂缝。她的军用贝雷帽盖住了她伤痕累累，毛发全无的头皮。

那苍老的声音说:"你的名字是 Kaleen。"Kaleen 点了点头。"你是「扎里曼号」的主要事故调查员？""是的。"Kaleen 的声音听起来像是锯齿般沙哑的声音，神情僵硬。

Kaleen 咳了一声并清清喉咙，"「扎里曼号」在从土星到外环闸口的折越间失踪了，是机械故障。我已经通知了所有船员的家人，也递交了一份报告给监察员。没有任何东西从折越中出来，所以我结了案。"

"但你在几天后却重启了调查。"

"在我踏进那艘船之前我也不敢相信。那艘船完好如初，就好像它从未消失过一样。"

"但是船员都消失了。"

"并不完全是。"Kaleen 犹豫着，然后接着说："我们本来也以为船上是空的，直到我们陆续发现………"她的脸因为那个痛苦的回忆而抽蓄着，"我们陆续发现一些孩子还躲在那艘船上。"

"于是你就违反了操作规程？"

Kaleen 垂下来头，泪水从她那只失明的眼睛夺眶而出，"他们只是孩子啊，他们很害怕，需要有人安慰。"

"所以你违反了隔离规定，导致你现在变成这个样子。"

当 Kaleen 触摸她的脸庞时，气氛瞬间陷入一片死寂。"你对他们做了什么？"

苍老的女人用手势示意警卫把 Kaleen 带走，本次会谈结束了。Kaleen 被带到门前时，她挣脱了警卫的束缚，并回头大喊："你们为什么要这么做？为什么要把孩子放在军舰上？"

"我们并没有这么做。那会违反规定。"

/Lotus/Language/Codex/ExcaliburLongDesc.text:
The Sentients had won. They had turned our weapons, our technology, against us. The more advanced we became, the greater our losses. The war was over unless we found a new way. In our desperation we turned to the Void. The blinding night, the hellspace where our science and reason failed.

We took the twisted few that had returned from that place. We built a frame around them, a conduit of their affliction. Gave them the weapons of the old ways. Gun and blade. A new warrior, a new code was born. These rejects, these Tenno, became our saviors. Warrior-Gods cast in steel and fury striking our enemies in a way they could never comprehend.

Excalibur was the first.

-Orokin 'Warframe' Archives
/Lotus/Language/Codex/ExcaliburLongDesc.zhText:
Sentient 取得了胜利。他们将我们的武器，科技反过来对付我们。我们的成果越先进，输的就越凄惨。除非我们能找到新的出路，不然战争就已宣告结束。在绝望之际我们转向了虚空——那里是漆黑不见的夜晚，是虚无的地狱，我们的科学与推理在那里全然失效。

我们接收了从那里归来稀少而扭曲的生物。在他们的身上铸造了外装甲，提供宣泄苦痛的管道，给予他们古老形式的武器，枪械与刀具。一种全新的战士，新的法则诞生了。这些被遗弃者，这些 Tenno，成为了我们的救世主。这些钢铁铸成，宛如神一般的战士，对我们的敌人以他们前所未见的方式施予狂怒的打击。

Excalibur 正是首位战士。

- 奥罗金「战甲」档案

/Lotus/Language/Codex/LeekterLongDesc.text:
Vay Hek,

Releasing the Grustrag Three? Tell me this rumor is a lie. Tell me you have not forgotten what those defects cost me. Traitors must be eradicated but you think they can be rehabilitated? Arrogance. If it were up to me, Grustrag and everyone in it would be ash. No Doctor can cure disloyalty.

The responsibility for this mistake is yours alone. Trust me, you will bleed regret.

Ruk
/Lotus/Language/Codex/LeekterLongDesc.zhText:
韦·海克，

放出Grustrag三霸？告诉我这谣言不是真的。告诉我你还记得这些瑕疵品使我损失多少弟兄？叛徒必须要根除才行，而你却认为这三人能恢复成常人一样？太傲慢了。如果是我来处理，我会将Grustrag三霸还有其他所有叛徒化为灰烬。不忠不义是无药可救的。

这项错误的责任你得自行承担。相信我，你会后悔不已。

Ruk

/Lotus/Language/Codex/MagPrimeLongDesc.text:
Warframe Archive - Debrief excerpt:

We sat strapped in, safeties off, waiting for the punch. Waiting for death. Through my filthy porthole I saw stars among the outlines of the other Splinter ships queuing for the Solar Rail. It would soon grip us with an incomprehensible power and cast us through the void into the mouth of our enemy.

I watched the ships one-by-one bending and gone. Each crammed with zero-tech soldiers sucking stale air, white knuckling their percussion rifles. Each filled with a desperation that comes from extinction. Our ship would be the last to cross the gap. Our ship had special cargo.

It was essentially empty. Just ten men, like me, strapped in with the best zero-tech suits and weapons the empire could build... and "it". "It" stood in the aisle, a slender and eyeless metal form. A Tenno inside its Warframe. Vaguely human, vaguely feminine. Was this armor or some ornate carapace for the monster that lived inside? I strained against the harness as the ship yawed for final approach. I could see the Tenno standing there freely. Solemn and gold-gleaming, oblivious to the inertial force.

I had been, until then, a Tenno denier. They were ghosts, propaganda, twisted casualties of the void era. Not possibly real. Yet here it was in the flesh. The Empire, in their desperation, was going to turn the demons loose and hope for the best. Who did we fear more, the enemy or this monster? We had our safeties off, could we trust it? Then it didn't matter anymore. The punch came - and our windows became blinding. When we could see again our ship was somewhere else, shattered and dead in an instant.

My lungs were flattened, eyes full of death. Ship debris glittered like a night snow. The alien blue star was dark and blinding beyond us. The countless articulating worm-ships of our enemy, ringed in glowing discs, undulating and heat-bursting the surviving soldiers like me. This is where I died. I was caught in R-disc, sweeping over my right side and setting my blood on fire. My vision flattened, the hearing muffled and buzzed. I could feel the side of my face going slack and wet.

I was in a dying dream. I saw a bright spot blurring and weaving toward me. I felt a tug toward it from the metal clasps on my suit. It reached me, rising up - a gleaming metal beast, a plume of golden wings rising and unfolding behind it. An angel. It snatched me from my death. I could feel my lungs fill as it wrapped me in its wings. Its Void Shield shimmered blue, strained under the enemy beams. I felt a sudden tug of acceleration. I closed my eyes and held on like a child.

I awoke on the floor, the sting of crisping flesh on my face and side. It was standing over me, the wings gone. I heard the cracking of weapons echoing down the corridor. Maybe the mission would be saved, but I was dying and so I waved my hand to send it away. I felt a pistol thrust in my hand as I was heaved to my feet. The angel had saved me, pulled me from hell, but it would not pity me. I was to die on my feet, by its side. I turned my good side toward the gunfire and raised the gun. It nodded, its outstretched metal hand surging and pulsing in ancient shapes as blue shimmered around me. It turned, drawing its blade and together we surged headlong into the hailstorm of death and fire that awaited us.
/Lotus/Language/Codex/MagPrimeLongDesc.zhText:
战甲档案 - 问讯摘录：

我们坐着并被金属带扣住，关上了枪的保险，等待着传送，也等待着死亡的来临。透过肮脏的舷窗，我从其他分队船舰列队进入星际轨道的轮廓间看到了星辰。它很快就会用无止尽的力量吞噬我们，并借由虚空将我们扔进敌人的嘴中。

我看着这些船舰一艘接着一艘弯曲，然后消失，每艘船上都载满了呼吸着混浊空气的低科技士兵。他们脸色苍白地紧握撞击式步枪，每个人脸上都写着来自灭亡的绝望。我们的船会是最后跨越那道裂口的，因为船上载着特别的货物。

实际上船内空荡荡的，只有十个人，像我一样被束缚在只有帝国才能建造出的一流零式科技装甲与武器上…

而"它"呢，站立在通道中。一个身材曼妙，没有眼部的金属外型，一名着装了战甲的Tenno。似乎是个人类，还隐约散发出女性的气息。这套该称为防具还是华丽盔甲的东西里头住的是怪物吗？当船舰逐渐偏向最终航线时，我紧张地靠着挽具，我能看到那名Tenno不受拘束的站在那里，庄严并散发金光，丝毫不受惯性影响。

在那之前我一直以来都是个Tenno否定者。我认为他们都是鬼魅，是宣传，是虚空时代扭曲的伤亡者，不可能是真的。然而，它们现在活生生站在我眼前。这座帝国在深陷绝望之际，一股脑让这些恶魔倾巢而出，以期会有一丝好的结果。到底是谁比较可怕，是敌人还是这些怪物呢？我们把枪的保险关了，我们能信任它吗？然而一切都不再重要，灾难降临了-窗户变得炫目而难以见物，当我们的视力恢复时，我们的船舰已经身处某个地方了，震撼与灭亡在顷刻间蜂拥而来。

我的肺部被压得喘不过气，眼中所见尽是死亡。船舰的残骸如夜晚的雪一般闪耀着，天蓝色的外星球漆黑得几乎令我们伸手不见五指，敌方数不清的虫型战舰连接在一起，对和我一样幸存的士兵发出环形炙热的圆盘，波形攻击与热能冲击。这就是我死去的地方了，我被环形圆盘击中，它横扫过我的身体右侧，我感到体内的血液被烧得沸腾，视力丧失，耳边只能听到低鸣和嗡嗡作响的声音，我能感觉到我的脸庞湿润而松垮。

我做了一场关于死亡的梦。我看见一个模糊的亮点迂回地靠近我，接着意识到制服上的金属钩环被猛力一拉。它伸手抓住我，缓缓升起-一个微光闪亮的金属怪物，向上展开了它背后的一对金色羽翼。它宛如天使，将我从死亡中拯救而出。当它用羽翼包覆住我的时候，我再次感受到的肺部的脉动，再度充满了空气。它的虚空护盾闪烁着蓝色的微光，阻绝了敌人的激光攻击。突然间我感到一阵猛力加速，我像个孩子般被抱住，阖上了双眼。

我醒来时发现自己躺在地板上，脆化的皮肉刺痛了我的脸颊与侧身。它站在我面前，翅膀已经消失了。我听见火力交锋的声响在走廊回荡，或许任务还有机会达成，但我就快要死了，所以我挥了挥手跟它道别。在我奋力搬动我的双脚时，一把手枪被塞进我的手里。这名天使救了我，把我从地狱中拉了回来，但是它并不会因此怜悯我。我的脚已经废了，无法再站立，于是我把身体没有受伤的那一边朝向交火的方向，然后举起手枪。它点点头，张开金属的手，汹涌崩腾着的远古气息，就和当时环绕我的蓝色微光一样。它转过身去，拔出剑，我们一起投身那等待着我们，由死亡和火焰交织的风暴之中。
