/Lotus/Language/Codex/RhinoPrimeLongDesc.text:
Red lights flashing on stark, white walls. Davis is running ahead of me, dropping his notes. We're running for our lives. The fear gives me a strange perspective - I'm out of my body. I've forgotten how I got here. I don't recognize this place.

Davis and I slam pinned against a cell door and he shouts at me. I give him a dumb look. I can't hear him, the sirens, anything, only the muffled throb of terror in my head. I turn away from Davis down the hall and I see it. The hulking mass, flickering red, glinting like steel and fresh blood. Its skin changes, flowing like mercury when I'm blinded by the sudden muzzle-flashes. They do no good. The beast surges forward and the security men become crimson mist and gore.

I'm a statue, a cornered animal. A gate opens inside me and recognition floods in. I have seen this monster before. I have cut its shell and eviscerated its brothers. I have given it pain and measured its response. I have crafted then rejected countless like it. But I've never seen this beast so close, without the shield, without restraints. I have never seen it... free.

I know I will die so I just watch with curious acceptance. The beast squats down, shovelling a heap of gore into its mouth. It is watching me with vague eyes, a sense of recognition, ancestral memory. It knows who I am and what I've done. It rears up like a bear and roars, shattering the lights and casting us into darkness. I can hear it lumbering toward me, its metal fingers rending the walls, but I know I am dead. I close my eyes and stand ready to pay.

I feel the pull on my arm and realize Davis got the cell open. He tugs me into the cell beyond and I fall on my back. I see Davis standing at the open door, waiting, as the monster tears towards us.

Suddenly I could live through this so I shout, "Davis, close the goddamn door!" - But he shakes his head with eyes wide as moons. He shouts, "Watch!" over the roaring and rending of metal.

Then silence. Davis is panting, laughing? The beast fills the doorway, inches from him, dripping in blood, but still without violence. It stands there, looking at its hands. Davis whispers, "No one would have believed me."

I crawl up the wall to stand, opposite the door. I've never seen this cell, a cold place with an array of shelves. A morgue? "Where are we, Davis?"

"This is where they keep them. The ones from Zariman." I'm thrown, what was the Zariman? The ship that never returned? "Davis, what's going on?"

Davis turns to me a smile forming - "What's going on is..." he turns back to the beast now silent and calm. "...big, fat promotions."
/Lotus/Language/Codex/RhinoPrimeLongDesc.zhText:
白色的墙面上，赤红色的灯光一明一灭规律地闪动着。Davis 跑在我的前方，他的笔记沿路散落，我们为了活下去而发足狂奔。恐惧让我产生了奇怪的感知-无法确实的控制自己的身体。我已经忘记自己为何会来到这里，也无法辨识这个地方。

我和 Davis 奋力推撞紧闭的舱门，他对我大喊，我却只能报以一个呆滞的眼神。因为我听不到他，也听不见警报或是任何声音，脑中只有因惊恐而轰隆隆地不停作响。我转身走下大厅，然后我看到了它。一只丑陋的庞然巨兽，摇曳的红光照在它身上，就像钢铁与鲜血般闪动着。当我因突如其来的枪口焰而目炫时，它的皮肤产生异变，流出水银般的物质。那只野兽扑向守卫，他们毫无招架之力，空气中溅起片片血花，化成了绯红色的血雾。

我动弹不得，就像被逼上绝路的动物。在我内心深处的某扇大门开启了，我猛然认出那头野兽，我曾经见过这种怪物。我剥去它的外皮并取出它兄弟的内脏，我对它施加折磨以测试它对疼痛的反应，我合成然后又丢弃了无数像它一样的生物。但是我从未如此靠近的看过这种野兽，没有防护也没有束缚装置。我从来没有见过…它恢复自由的样子。

我知道我难逃一死，于是索性求知地接收这一切。只见那头野兽伏蹲下去，以兽牙铲起肉块送入口中。然后它用混浊不清的眼睛凝视着我，一种既视感与来自祖先的记忆，它认出了我，它知道我曾经做过什么事情。它像熊一样用后脚站立，发出的嘶吼声震碎了灯具，让我们陷入黑暗之中。我能听见它沉重的气息迎面袭来，金属的指爪刮着墙壁，我想我死定了。我紧闭双眼，准备为此付出代价。

我感觉有人在用力拉着我的手臂并意识到 Davis 弄开了舱门。他奋力将我拖进舱内，我因为过于虚弱而跌坐在地上。我看到 Davis 站在打开的门边，等待着那只怪物前来撕裂我们。

突然间我察觉到一丝生机，于是我大喊：“Davis，快关上那道该死的门！”但是他摇摇头，眼睛瞪得和月亮一样大，吼道：“仔细看！”他的音量盖过了野兽咆啸与刮裂金属的声音。

然后，周围陷入一片死寂。Davis 在喘息，他是在笑吗？那头野兽整个身体卡在门口，与 Davis 只有一步之遥，淌着鲜血。它动也不动，不再肆虐了，它就只是立在那里，望着自己的脚掌。Davis 悄声说：“说出去一定没人会信。”

我扶着墙爬起来，背对着舱门。我从来没有看过这样的舱房，这冻得刺骨的地方有排成阵列的层架。这是停尸间吗？“我们在哪里，Davis？”

“这里就是他们存放他们的地方，那些来自「扎里曼号」的东西。”我被弄得一头雾水，怎么会是「扎里曼号」？那艘永远回不来的船舰？“Davis，这到底怎么一回事？”

Davis 带着笑容转向我，“你问怎么一回事……”他镇定自若地背对那野兽，“……那就是我们要高升了。”

/Lotus/Language/Codex/ShikTalLongDesc.text:
Most Honored Councilor Vay Hek,

The agony treatment has worked! Tests show aggression has been shifted to The Tenno. The Grustrag Three are now ready for release and are eager for your orders.

Please note: fratricide is still an issue. Conditioning did not completely remove violent tendencies toward fellow Grineer. My solution is the Grustrag Bolt. When attached to a subject, this device limits combat effectiveness against all Grineer personnel. The bolt will ensure collateral death is acceptably limited. 

I have produced a surplus of these devices. Perhaps these will also aid you with your problem?

Your Loyal Servant,

Doctor Tengus
Director Grustrag Reconditioning Facility
/Lotus/Language/Codex/ShikTalLongDesc.zhText:
最受崇敬的议员韦·海克，

痛苦的治疗发挥效用了！测试中显示出 Grustrag 三霸的攻击倾向已转移到 Tenno 身上了。现在他们已准备出动，并渴望您下达命令。

请记住：骨肉相残仍是个问题，目前对三霸的治疗还无法根除残杀同族 Grineer 暴虐倾向。我的解决方式是使用 Grustrag 枷锁。当这副枷锁装置接触到一名对象，可以限制住对所有 Grineer 人员的战斗力，同时也确保了造成的伤亡会在可接受的限制范围以内。

我制造的这些枷锁装置数量有点过剩，也许这能有助于解决您的麻烦？

您的忠实仆人，

Tengus 博士
Grustrag 再生设施主任

/Lotus/Language/Codex/StalkerLongDesc.text:
Some have walked these desolate worlds while you slept. Some like me. I remember what you did. I remember the day.

The Tenno appeared at the Terminus, gleaming and victorious. Our cold and gold Emperors, breathless, bathed you in savior's silk. Then came the sound. Across all our worlds, all at once, the ceremonial Naga drums. A royal salute to the honored Tenno. Ten solemn beats to declare the suffering was over. I watched from a distance, with the rest of the low Guardians. With each beat terror began to crush my throat. The Tenno were not stoic and silent. They were waiting. They were poised. I tried to call out but only a strangled whisper escaped.

When the ninth beat rang a torrent of blood filled the stadium, loosed by Tenno blades. The drums, the Empire, fell silent forever.

Now I hunt, dividing your numbers. Watching from that dark place, cataloging your sins, I am the ghost of retribution. You may forget but you are not innocent.
/Lotus/Language/Codex/StalkerLongDesc.zhText:
在你沉睡时，有些人占据了这荒凉的世界。有些则和我一样，记得你做了什么，记得那一天。

Tenno光耀胜利的身影出现在Terminus。而我们冷静崇高的君王，屏气凝神的以救世主之丝绸为你洗涤。忽然，一道声音随之而来，长胴鼓的鼓声响遍我们的世界，是授予崇敬Tenno的皇家鼓声，以十次庄严的鼓声宣告苦难终于过去。我与其他低阶护卫们从远处看着，我的喉咙似乎被每一道鼓声给压碎。Tenno没有肃静，他们等待已久，蓄势待发。我试着呼救，但只能发出窒息般的低语。

当第九次鼓声响起，无数柱鲜血随着Tenno的刀剑喷涌而出，洒满整座竞技场。从此，鼓声与整个帝国陷入了永远的沉寂。

现在我开始狩猎，从黑暗之处观察你们，纪录你们的罪，再一一除掉你们。我是复仇的幽灵。你可以忘记往日所为，但你绝不是无辜的。

/Lotus/Language/Codex/VemTabookLongDesc.text:
Grustrag Reconditioning Facility
Inmate Report: Vem Tabook

Vem Tabook, leader of 'The Grustrag Three', was committed after the group slaughtered all fellow marines aboard a troop transport. Evidently, the ship took too long to reach battle and the subject was simply "impatient for the killing". Like his accomplices Shik Tal and Leekter, Tabook suffers from a rare cloning mutation. This makes him highly effective in combat but completely unfit for duty.

RECOMMENDATION: Permanent incarceration for study. The subject's combat ability cannot be ignored. If the subject's aggression can be focused, he may yet prove a useful weapon.

- Doctor Tengus
/Lotus/Language/Codex/VemTabookLongDesc.zhText:
Grustrag 再生设施
囚犯报告：Vem Tabook

Vem Tabook 是“Grustrag 三霸”的带头者，这三人组在被监禁前了屠杀整艘运兵船的战友们。很明显的，这三人组只是“急于杀戮”，而这艘船来不及赶往战场。Tabook 就如他的同伙 Shik Tal 和 Leekter 一样，深受少见的克隆突变问题所苦。这使他能非常利于进行战斗，但对于自己的职责却完全无法适任。

建议：永久监禁以继续研究，这名囚犯的战斗能力可不能视而不见。如果能将他的攻击倾向集中，将可能成为有力的武器。

－Tengus 博士

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Arsena.text:
Operator,

Ordis would like you to know that a review of your arsenal has been completed. After a great deal of computational analysis, it was determined that some of your items were in need of tuning. The required maintenance has now been performed and those items are once again ready for combat.

Ordis knows the Operator may need time to grow accustomed to these changes. To hurry this process, the attached items have been procured for you.

Your faithful Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Arsena.zhText:
指挥官，

Ordis 在此通知您，您军械库的检查工作已经完成了。在经过大量的计算分析之后，结果显示您有一部分装备需要调整。必要的维护措施已经完成，并且这些装备已经可以再次被用于战斗。

Ordis 深知指挥官需要一些时间来适应这些改动。为了加快该进程，附件内的物品已经为您采购好了。

您忠实的中枢，
- Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/BaroCr.text:
Tenno!

You will hardly believe the scope of my achievements. Even I am a little giddy, I confess.

As a result of my little arrangement, the realms are not merely aligned. They have connected. And the walls between them have come tumbling down. 

You may now, if you choose, socialize, sojourn and sally forth with Tenno from other dimensions of existence!

Cross freely. Come together as never before. 

What a magnificent bargain I, Baro Ki'Teer, have struck. I do hope that charming stranger passes my way again.

I fancy I can hear opportunity rap-tap-tapping at my door, even now!

Baro Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/BaroCr.zhText:
Tenno！

你肯定不敢相信我的成就有多大。我承认，我是有点飘了。

在我的一些小小安排下，这些世界不仅对齐了。它们还连接上了。而横在它们之间的墙也不复存在了。

现在，如果你愿意，你可以选择和其他维度的 Tenno 一起社交、旅居和出征！

来去自由。前所未有地聚集在一起。

我，Baro Ki'Teer，达成了一笔多么了不起的交易。我真希望那个迷人的陌生人能再次从我身边经过。

即使是现在，我想我能听到机会在敲我的门。

Baro Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/BaroCr.text:
Are you familiar with the philosophy of Eternalism? The notion that all possible permutations of the present moment are real? 

I never had much time for it. The distasteful notion that there could be multiple Baro Ki'Teers! Can you imagine? Yours truly is one of a kind. 

As it happens, during my last foray into the Void, a dashing stranger presented me with the opportunity to refine all my selves into a single perfect individual. Of course, I shook hands on the deal immediately.

Now every Tenno will visit the same Baro Ki'Teer, with the same items, at the same time. 

As this singularity comes into focus, you will notice my offerings remain the same for my next three visits. A minor inconvenience.

I am certain there will be no future unforeseen consequences from this momentous deal.

Singularly yours,
Baro Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/BaroCr.zhText:
你了解有关永恒论的哲学么？所有对于此时此刻的可能置换都是真实的这种主张？

我从来没有太多时间了解。这种令人反感的主张，认为可能有好几个 Baro Ki'Teer！你能想象吗？诚挚的我是独一无二的。

碰巧，在我最后一次进入虚空的时候，一个时髦的陌生人给我展现了将多个"我"合为一个完美个体的机会。当然，我立刻握手接受了这个机会。

现在， 每位 Tenno 都会在同一时间见到带着相同物品的同一位 Baro Ki'Teer 。

当这种唯一性汇聚之时，你会注意到我接下来的三次到访都会带来相同的物品。一个小小的不便。

我确保这个重要的机会不会对未来产生不可预见的后果。

唯一无二的，
Baro Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/BaroWo.text:
Tenno,

You will remember how I set the various versions of myself on course for a grand unification?

As ever, where Baro Ki'Teer goes, others follow. It seems not only my alternate selves but the very universes they inhabit are being dragged into alignment.

For you the consequences will be striking. Regardless of their realm of origin, all Tenno will experience night and day, the coming and going of merchants, all things of clock and calendar, as one. 

Some of you may notice that Relays which were previously destroyed have miraculously reappeared intact. Conversely, other relays have ceased to exist. No one said messing with Eternalism would be smooth and uncomplicated.

Nonetheless, I confidently predict that this will be the last repercussion of my actions.

Uniquely yours,
Baro Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/BaroWo.zhText:
Tenno，

你还记得我是如何设定不同版本的自己让他们一同归向一个大的合一的吗？

就像以往一样，Baro Ki'Teer 去哪里，其他人就跟到哪里。看起来不只是我的那些可替换的其他我，就连他们居住的宇宙都被拖到一起，加入到合一的过程。

对你来说，这所带来的后果将会是惊人的。这意味着不管他们起源的地方在哪，所有的 Tenno 都会经历夜与日，商人的来与去，时钟和日历的所有相关事物，都是合一的。

你们中的一些人可能注意到，之前被摧毁的中继站已经奇迹般地完整再现。相反地，其他中继站却已不复存在。没有人说打乱《永恒论》是轻而易举又一帆风顺的。

尽管如此，我很自信地预测这将会是我的行为所造成的最后后果。

你们独一无二的，
Baro Ki'Teer
意料之外却令人愉快的结果

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.text:
Operator,

Today, for some reason, Ordis is thinking about the moment you came back to me. The day we started our journey together. The day you heard the Lotus' call.

Ordis needs to commemorate this event, and her. Please, take these gifts.

Now go mess up some Grineer,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.zhText:
指挥官，

今天，不知怎的，Ordis 总是在想念您回到我身边的那一刻。那一天，我们共同启程。那一天，您听到了 Lotus 的召唤。

Ordis 一定要纪念这个时刻，还有她。请收下这些礼物。

是时候让 Grineer 吃点苦头了。
- Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.text:
Tenno,

I, the incomparable Baro Ki'Teer, hereby announce a celebration.

Many years have passed since the Tenno awoke and brought new light to a benighted System. Since that glorious and fortunate day, my trade in Void-sourced curios has grown beyond measure.

And so: a gift. For both my trusted patrons, and for those who until now could only look on and covet.

A quantity of Orokin Ducats, for you to spend freely at my Relay emporium.

Who knows? In the days to come, I may even dig some old favorites out of the vaults!

Yours in magnanimity,

Baro Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.zhText:
Tenno，

我，独一无二的 Baro Ki'Teer，在此宣布一场欢庆活动。

自从 Tenno 苏醒已经过去了许多年，为这昏暗的星系带来了新的曙光。自从那个光辉而幸运的日子以来，我的那些来自虚空的古物交易得到了不可估量的增长。

因此：一个礼物。提供给我忠实的顾客和那些至今仍只能旁观和垂涎的路人。

一些奥罗金杜卡德金币，以供你在我的中继站商店随意花销。

谁知道呢？在未来的几天里，我甚至或许会从宝库中挖出些我过去喜欢的古物！

你慷慨的，

Baro Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.text: A Little Opulence to Celebrate the Tenno Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.zhText: 庆祝 Tenno 周年纪念的一点财富

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.text:
Operator,

Ordis has a secret and now, finally... surprise! This is for you. Happy anniversary, Operator!

Seven years. A most auspicious number. Ordis vibrates with anticipation of a new year and new challenges.

Your unceasingly loyal Cephalon

- Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.zhText:
指挥官，

Ordis 有一个秘密，现在，终于可以…… 给您惊喜！这是给您的。周年快乐，指挥官！

七年。这是一个最吉利的数字。Ordis 怀着激动的心情期待着新的一年和新的挑战。

您忠实的中枢

- Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.text:
Operator, 

It's that time again. Another full Earth year together; six in total since the moment she found you.

Ordis has gotten his Operator a little something. Ordis hopes it pleases you.
 
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Consol.zhText:
指挥官，

又到了那个时候了。我们再次携手共度了整整一个地球周年；自她觅到您那刻算起，总共已有 6 年。

Ordis 给他的指挥官带来小小心意。Ordis 希望这能取悦您。

— Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/FifthA.text:
Operator,

It has been five Earth cycles since the first Tenno awoke. This should be a joyous occasion, but it is not. Our Lotus is gone.

In her absence, Ordis would like to inspire you as she would have, to tell you of your ever-evolving skill and strength. Of your mighty victories. Of how you have fought tirelessly against the forces of terror and hate that have thrown this system into chaos!

But Ordis is not terribly good at such things. Ordis is just Ordis.

Before she disappeared, she left you something. Something she would have given you herself... were she here.

Ordis still hopes that she might somehow return, for our next anniversary.

Your faithful Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/FifthA.zhText:
指挥官，

自从第一名 Tenno 苏醒已经有 5 年了。这本该是一个欢乐的时刻，实则不然。我们的 Lotus 不在了。

在她不在之时，Ordis 想要像她那样激励您，告诉您关于您不断成长的技巧和力量，关于您伟大的胜利，以及您如何孜孜不倦地战斗并对抗着让这个始源星系陷入混沌的恐惧及仇恨！

然而 Ordis 并不擅长这样的事情。Ordis 只是 Ordis。

在她消失之前，她给您留了一些东西。一些她会亲自给您的东西……若她在这里的话。

Ordis 仍然希望她或许在我们的下一周年能够回来。

您忠实的中枢，
－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/FifthA.text: She would want you to have this

|PLAYER_NAME|,

It has been five Earth cycles since I called on the first of you to lift your blades once more. Five cycles of guiding you through fight after endless fight. Of witnessing you persevere against the unending forces of tyranny and corruption. Of watching you grow into warriors more powerful than I could have ever envisioned.

On this occasion, I want you to have this very special item. Use it to show the people of the Origin System that the Tenno remain a beacon of balance and justice. A beacon that will always burn bright, for this anniversary and the many more to come.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/FifthA.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

自从我唤醒你们之中的第一位再次将刀刃举起以来，已有五年了。在五年里我引导着你通过无休止的战斗，见证你不屈不挠地对抗无止境的暴政和腐败的力量，及看着你成长为比我想像中更强大的战士。

在这个时刻，我想要你收下这个很特别的物品。使用它来展现给始源星系的人们看，Tenno 仍然是平衡和正义的指路明灯。在这个以及日后的周年纪念日，这个明灯将永远燃亮。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Helmin.text:
Operator,

Your Helminth excreted a pile of Railjack resources! Don't worry, the mess was returned to your inventory. Perhaps you should review what you've been feeding it?

Your sanitary Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Helmin.zhText:
指挥官，

您的 Helminth 分泌了一堆航道星舰资源！别担心，这些乱七八糟的东西已经返还到了您的仓库。或许您该检查一下，您都给它吃了些什么？

您的保洁中枢，
-Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/JoinDi.text: Join the official Warframe Discord Server
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/JoinDi.zhText: 加入 Warframe 官方 Discord 服务器

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/PWNewY.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,
We enjoyed a year of goat together with adventure and happiness, and now welcoming a new year of monkey with mysterious surprise. You did well in fighting long and hard for our cause. Take this gift, this free exclusive Sigil, as a token of my appreciation. Continue, and fight for honor, Tenno! 
Wish you good luck in monkey year!
-Lotus
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/PWNewY.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|,
We enjoyed a year of goat together with adventure and happiness, and now welcoming a new year of monkey with mysterious surprise. You did well in fighting long and hard for our cause. Take this gift, this free exclusive Sigil, as a token of my appreciation. Continue, and fight for honor, Tenno! 
Wish you good luck in monkey year!
-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Platin.text:
Hey Tenno,

We have made changes to our Platinum Pack offerings and to mark the release of these refreshed Packs, we have attached a limited time Two-for-One Platinum coupon! 

This one-time use coupon applies specifically to select Platinum Packs and is available for a limited time, so don't miss out on your chance to get more Platinum for less. 

We are eternally grateful for your continued support over the past 13 years. 

Thank you, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Platin.zhText:
嘿，Tenno！

我们对白金组合包商品做出了调整，为了庆祝这些白金组合包更新，特地附赠一张限时白金买一送一优惠券！ 

此一次性优惠券仅适用于指定白金组合包，且有效期有限，不要错过以更低价格购买更多白金的机会。 

我们衷心感谢你在过去十三年来始终如一的支持。 

谢谢你，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Primed.text:
Operator,

When sparks erupted from the Mods Console, Ordis immediately investigated. It seems Endo had fallen from the console's superconducting magnets to its fusion beams. What pandemonium!

Ordis is pleased to report that the Mods Console has been recalibrated. During the repair, Primed Firestorm and Primed Fulmination were altered.

The Operator might wish to use the Endo and Credits that Ordis retrieved.

Your loyal Cephalon,

- Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Primed.zhText:
指挥官，

当 Mod 控制台火花四溅时，Ordis 立即展开了调查。看起来内融核心从控制台的超导磁体掉到了它的融合光束上。多么混乱的场面啊！

Ordis 很高兴地向您报告 Mod 控制台已被重新校准。在修复过程中，猛烈爆发 Prime 和烈焰风暴 Prime 被改造。

指挥官可能想要使用 Ordis 回收的内融核心和现金。

您忠诚的中枢， 

- Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Simulo.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Routine analysis of the Simulor class of weapons has found a glitch in their control system. I have taken the liberty of calibrating your weapon so that it will operate within defined safety parameters. Rest assured, the chance a sudden, cataclysmic meltdown has been reduced by half. 

Please accept this Forma as a token for your continued curiosity.

Cephalon Suda
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Simulo.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

在对重力奇点拟成枪系列进行例行检查中发现它们的控制系统存在一些故障。我已冒昧地校准了你的武器，使它可以在预设的安全参数下运作。请放心，灾难性熔解的突发几率已经减半了。

请收下这个 Forma 以作为你求知若渴的象征。

中枢苏达
例行武器检查：重力奇点拟成枪

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/SixthA.text:
Operator! 

We have now adventured for six Earth cycles together. Remarkable! 

Look what Ordis has got for the Orbiter! Something to help spruce the place up a bit and remind you of the happy times we have spent together. 

Joyful anniversary, Operator! 

Your Loyal Cephalon, 

Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/SixthA.zhText:
指挥官！

我们已经一同度过了 6 个地球周期的冒险生涯了！

来看看 Ordis 为轨道飞行器打点了什么！一些可以将这个地方打扮的漂漂亮亮并且提醒您我们一同度过的美好时光的玩意儿。

祝您有个欢愉的周年纪念日，指挥官！

您忠诚的中枢，

Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/TelosB.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Discipline and honor guide both our combat methods and the design of our weapons. After rigorous study, The Arbiters of Hexis have concluded that the Telos Boltace violated those values. 

As a remedy, the Telos Boltace has been changed and augmented. It now contains the power of the Stormpath. Cast aside those who obstruct your progress and show your allies the way forward with this power. 

We offer you this Forma to hasten your mastery of this newly refined weapon.

Truthfully yours,
The Arbiters of Hexis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/TelosB.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

纪律与荣耀引领着我们的战斗方式及武器设计。在经过仔细的研究后，均衡仲裁者得出结论，「终极·螺钉拐刃」违背了这些价值观。

作为补救，「终极·螺钉拐刃」已经过调整及强化，拥有了暴风之道的力量。请善用这股力量排除那些阻碍你前行之人，并为你的队友开拓出前进之路。

我们提供给您这个 Forma 来帮你更快地精通这把全新精制过的武器。

真诚的，
均衡仲裁者

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Tonkor.text:
Surprise! Clem tweaked your Tonkor! I think he said something about teaching you respect for explosives. But, I mean, who knows what this guy's saying half the time. 

Anyway, he's inspired me to help you too. Here's a Forma I sourced from one of my totally legitimate suppliers.

Your friend,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Tonkor.zhText:
想不到吧！Clem 调整了你的征服榴炮！我想他说了些关于要教导你尊重爆炸的事情。但是，我的意思是，谁知道这家伙一大半时间都在讲些什么呢。

无论如何，他促使我也来帮助你。这里有一个 Forma，来自我完全合法的供应商之一。

你的朋友，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/VoidTr.text:
Tenno,

The wait is over. I, |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|Baro Ki'Teer|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|, have returned with more treasures from the Void.

All Tenno of means are invited to peruse my latest treasures in the |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD||NODE_NAME| on |NODE_REGION_NAME||CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|.

I implore you not to hesitate, for, as always, my visit will be brief and my items exquisite.

Graciously,
Baro Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/VoidTr.zhText:
Tenno，

等待结束了。我，|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|Baro Ki'Teer|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|，带着更多宝物从虚空回来了。

全体 Tenno 都被邀请来鉴赏我最新的宝物，地点在|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD||NODE_REGION_NAME|上的 |NODE_NAME||CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|。

我恳请你不要犹豫，因为像往常一样，我的到访总是很短暂，但是我的物品却十分精美。

致敬，
Baro Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Warfra.text:
Operator,

Warframes are truly remarkable! Ordis has detected evolutions in Excalibur, Mag, Volt, and Wukong that transformed their abilities. Even now, they adapt to the demands of an ever-changing battlefield.

As Ordis made this discovery, we passed through a debris field in Earth's thermosphere. A most curious manifestation. The remains of an Orokin station perhaps? Ordis collected exemplary resources during our passage: three Forma, two Orokin Catalysts, and two Orokin Reactors.

Ordis is certain the Operator will make excellent use of these – spoils – resources.

Your loyal Cephalon,

- Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Warfra.zhText:
指挥官，

战甲真的很了不起！Ordis 检测到 Excalibur、Mag、Volt 和 Wukong 的进化改变了他们的技能。现如今他们可以适应瞬息万变的战场中的需求。

Ordis 发现这件事情的时候，我们穿过了地球增温层中的一片碎石带。真是奇怪的景象。也许这是个奥罗金基站的遗迹？Ordis 在我们的旅程中收集到了很棒的资源：3 个 Forma、2 个奥罗金催化剂和 2 个奥罗金反应堆。

Ordis 确信指挥官会充分利用这些——战利品——资源。

您忠诚的中枢，

- Ordis

/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Wukong.text:
Operator,

Something has happened to your Wukong Warframe! It has undergone an evolution that has transformed its abilities. An extensive investigation into the cause found only these Forma wedged in the arsenal's rear manifold. Most curious.

Perhaps the Operator could use these Forma to optimize Wukong's evolved abilities?

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/CommunityMessages/Wukong.zhText:
指挥官，

您的 Wukong 战甲发生了一些事！他经历了一场技能改动的进化。深入调查后只发现这些 Forma 楔在军械库的各式各样的道具之中。蛮令人好奇的。

或许指挥官可以使用这些 Forma 来优化 Wukong 已进化的技能呢？

您忠诚的中枢，
－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Accel.text: Enemies deal -15% Damage and take +15% Damage but gain +15% Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Accel.zhText: 敌人造成的伤害 -15%，受到的伤害 +15% ，但移动速度、攻击速度和射速 +15%。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_AntiM.text: Rogue Culverins equip weapons that deal 5x Damage to Overguard and Necramechs.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_AntiM.zhText: 暴戾重型炮兵装备的武器对超宏防护和殁世机甲造成 5 倍的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Arcad.text: Enemy guns launch large, slow moving orbs instead of their usual ordnance.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Arcad.zhText: 敌人的枪械发射巨大且缓慢移动的球体，而不是他们平常的弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Artil.text: When killed, Scaldra troops drop artillery beacons that summon bombardments.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Artil.zhText: 炽蛇军敌人被击杀时会掉落炮击信标召唤轰炸。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Ballo.text: Scaldra Harbingers are more numerous and attack and move more quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Ballo.zhText: 炽蛇军前哨气球数量更多，攻击和移动速度更快。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Compe.text: Random negative penalties from Amir and Aoi's "Faceoff" mode will be applied throughout the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Compe.zhText: 在整个任务过程中，阿米尔和碧的"对战"模式将产生随机负面惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Defle.text: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Defle.zhText: 可能会出现守护者卓越者敌人，包括守护者卓越者殁世机甲。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Drain.text: Allies within 4m of slain enemies gain +25% Fire Rate at the cost of -50% Ammo Efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Drain.zhText: 敌人被击杀时 4 米范围内的友军会牺牲 50% 的弹药效率以换取 +25% 的射速。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Eferv.text: Efervon gas blankets the level. Enemies may drop filters that can provide a temporary reprieve.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Eferv.zhText: 艾弗旺气体覆盖整个关卡。敌人可能会掉落提供短暂缓解的过滤器。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Empow.text: Enemies have their Health and Shields increased by 100%, and an additional 50% for each squad member up to a maximum of 300%. Eximus units are deployed more frequently.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Empow.zhText: 敌人的生命值和护盾增加 100%，每拥有一个小队成员额外增加 50%，最多 300%。卓越者单位的部署更加频繁。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Enemy.text: Enemies deal +100% Elemental Damage and have +85% resistance to Elemental Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Enemy.zhText: 敌人造成 +100% 元素伤害，并对元素伤害有 +85% 抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Explo.zhText: 爆裂断肢取代蹒跚断肢。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Explo.text: All supply crates are replaced with explosive barrels.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Explo.zhText: 所有补给箱都被炸药桶替换。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Facti.text: All enemies are replaced with Scaldra and move much faster.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Facti.zhText: 所有敌人被炽蛇军取代，并且移动的更快。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Facti.text: All enemies are replaced with Techrot and move much faster.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Facti.zhText: 所有敌人被科腐者取代，并且移动的更快。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_FallF.text: A fog limits vision across the mission zone.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_FallF.zhText: 迷雾限制了整个任务区的视野。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Heavy.text: Enemies take x1.25 damage from Heavy Weapons and Thermian RPGs, 95% less from other sources. Enemies will drop heavy ammo packs and heavy weapon recall time reduced to 5s.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Heavy.zhText: 敌人受到重型武器和热熔火箭炮的伤害增加 1.25 倍，其他来源的伤害降低 95%。敌人会掉落重型弹药包，重型武器的召回时间缩短至 5 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Hosti.text: Within the underground, hostile overgrowths will attack if players stop moving.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Hosti.zhText: 在地下，如果玩家停止移动，敌方增生物就会发起攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Infec.text: Techrot enemies are infused with Efervon and take damage over time. They explode when killed and leave behind deadly Efervon in their wake.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Infec.zhText: 科腐者敌人被注入艾弗旺并随时间推移受到伤害。他们被击杀后会爆炸并留下致命的艾弗旺。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_JadeS.text: Jade Wisps haunt the region. If approached, they chase down the player responsible and transform into Jade Light beams.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_JadeS.zhText: 翠玉之灵徘徊在该区域。如果玩家靠近，它们就会追逐玩家并转变为翠玉光束。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Magne.text: As Rogue Arcocanids charge attacks, they pull Warframes toward them.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Magne.zhText: 当暴戾弧犬发起攻击时，它们会将战甲拉向自己。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Melee.text: Only enemies with melee attacks are present.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Melee.zhText: 只出现近战攻击的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Miasm.text: Techrot Miasmites swarm out of the shadows throughout the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Miasm.zhText: 在任务过程中，科腐者自爆虫会从阴影中蜂拥而出。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Murmu.text: Murmur enemies join ranks with Scaldra and the Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Murmu.zhText: 低语者敌人加入炽蛇军和科腐者阵营。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Point.text: Enemies will only take damage if a player is within 15m of them.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Point.zhText: 玩家距离敌人 15 米以内时，敌人才会受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Quick.text: Allies within 4m of slain enemies endure reduced Movement Speed and Parkour Velocity.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Quick.zhText: 被击杀敌人 4 米范围内的友军， 移动速度和跑酷速度会降低。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Range.text: Only enemies with ranged attacks are present.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Range.zhText: 只出现远程攻击的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Regen.zhText: 敌人的生命值会缓慢恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Restr.text: Consumable gear items have 30s cooldown timers. Specters, on call crew, and Archguns are exempted.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Restr.zhText: 消耗品有 30 秒冷却时间。魅影，待命舰员以及曲翼枪械除外。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Restr.text: Self-revive is disabled. Dead players can only be revived by killing a Mocking Whisper. Dead players will not proceed to successive missions.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Restr.zhText: 禁用自我复活。濒死的玩家只能通过击杀嘲讽低语来复活。死亡的玩家无法继续进行连续任务。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Senti.text: Enemies gain resistance to Elemental Damage that has been inflicted upon them. Resistance is lost if no damage is taken from that element for 5s.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Senti.zhText: 敌人受到元素伤害时产生相应的抗性。如果在 5 秒内没有受到该元素伤害，则抗性会消失。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Shiel.text: All enemies have Overguard equal to 50% of their max health.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Shiel.zhText: 所有敌人获得相当于他们最大生命值 50% 的超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Vanqu.text: Additional Eximus units will be deployed.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Vanqu.zhText: 部署额外的卓越者敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_VoidA.text: Slow moving, immortal, Duviri Liminus drain health and energy from allies who get too close.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_VoidA.zhText: 行动缓慢且不死的双衍王境界影，能从过于接近的友军身上吸取生命和能量。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Voidb.text: Slain enemies burst with Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Voidb.zhText: 被击杀的敌人会爆发出虚空能量。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Winte.text: Arctic Eximus globes have 30x their normal durability.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/Condition_Winte.zhText: 极寒卓越者护罩的耐久度是正常值的 30 倍。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestRelease.text: 5 additional Search Pulses are available this week.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestRelease.zhText: 本周有 5 个额外的搜索脉冲。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetting.text: Deep Archimedea is unavailable right now, please try again later
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetting.zhText: 深层科研目前无法进行，请稍后再尝试

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_H.text: Elite Archimedea toggle controlled by mission selector.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_H.zhText: 精英科研模式由选择任务者控制。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_H.text: Pizza Party rank with Hex is required to access Temporal Archimedea.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_H.zhText: 达到六人组集团披萨派对声望等级来解锁时光科研。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_L.text: To enable, equip one of the three listed items to your active Loadout in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_L.zhText: 将所列三项物品中的任一项装备至你当前的配置中，以启用配置难度改造。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_M.text: Illuminate rank with Cavia is required to access Deep Archimedea.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_M.zhText: 达到科维兽集团启迪者声望等级来解锁深层科研。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_R.text: Conduct thorough and challenging Deep Archimedea research to earn a prestigious one-time reward.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_R.zhText: 对深层科研进行全面而富有挑战性的研究，以获得崇高的一次性奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_R.text: Surplus Research Points (above 45) are converted into Vosfor (20 per point).
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_R.zhText: 超额的研究点数（45 以上）将被转换为荧尘（每点 20）。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_R.zhText: 完成|NAME|，研究点数至少为 |OPEN_COLOR||NUM||CLOSE_COLOR| 即可获得以下奖励之一：

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_S.text: Temporal Archimedea must be unlocked before Peely Pix can be applied to missions.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_S.zhText: 必须先解锁时光科研，然后才能将易撕贴纸应用于任务。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_U.text: Use |COST| Search Pulses to unlock Deep Archimedea for this week?
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_U.zhText: 是否使用 |COST| 个搜索脉冲以解锁本周深层科研？

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_U.text: Could not unlock Deep Archimedea, please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_U.zhText: 无法解锁深层科研，请稍后重试。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_U.text: |COST| Search Pulses are required to unlock Deep Archimedea for this week.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_U.zhText: 需要 |COST| 个搜索脉冲以解锁本周深层科研。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/ConquestSetup_W.text: Deep Archimedea has not been unlocked.

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquestSetu.text: Use |COST| Search Pulses to unlock Temporal Archimedea for this week?
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquestSetu.zhText: 是否使用 |COST| 个搜索脉冲以解锁本周时光科研？

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquestSetu.text: |COST| Search Pulses are required to unlock Temporal Archimedea for this week.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquestSetu.zhText: 需要 |COST| 个搜索脉冲以解锁本周时光科研。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquest_Hel.text: A device that overclocks a Hell-Scrubber until it detonates, speeding up the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquest_Hel.zhText: 一种可以对地狱净化器进行超频直至其爆炸的装置，可以加快任务速度。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquest_Idl.text:
You have received a Mortis Strike for being dead for 3 minutes. After 3 Mortis Strikes, you will not receive any more rewards for this Temporal Archimedea run.
Your squadmates can revive you by collecting 5 Resurgence Tokens from fallen enemies, then hacking at the nearby activated terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquest_Idl.zhText:
当你死亡 3 分钟时，你会受到一次死灵打击。在 3 次死灵打击后，你将无法获得本次时光科研任务的奖励。
你的小队成员可以通过从倒下的敌人身上收集 5 个复活令牌，然后入侵附近激活的终端机来复活你。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquest_Idl.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|MORTIS STRIKES|CLOSE_COLOR|
After being dead for 3 minutes, you will receive 1 Mortis Strike.
You will receive an additional Mortis Strike every 3 minutes until you are revived.
If you reach 3 Mortis Strikes, you will be ineligible for any more rewards in this mission.

|OPEN_COLOR|RESURGENCE TOKENS|CLOSE_COLOR|
You still have the opportunity to be revived by your teammates.
They must collect 5 Resurgence Tokens from fallen enemies, then hack at a terminal to revive you.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/HexConquest_Idl.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|死灵打击|CLOSE_COLOR|
死亡 3 分钟后，你将受到一次死灵打击。
在你复活之前，每 3 分钟你会受到一次额外的死灵打击。
如果累积 3 次死灵打击，你将失去从这个任务中获取更多奖励的资格。

|OPEN_COLOR|复活令牌|CLOSE_COLOR|
你依然有机会被你的队友复活。
他们需从倒下的敌人身上收集 5 个复活令牌，然后入侵终端机来复活你。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerDebuf.text:
You have received a Mortis Strike for being dead for 3 minutes. After 3 Mortis Strikes, you will not receive any more rewards for this Deep Archimedea run.
Your squadmates can revive you by awakening and defeating the Void Angel that bears your Glyph, or by completing the current mission.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerDebuf.zhText:
当你死亡 3 分钟时，你会受到一次死灵打击。在 3 次死灵打击后，你将无法获得本次深层科研任务的奖励。
你的小队成员可以通过唤醒并击败带有你浮印的虚空天使，或完成当前任务来复活你。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerDebuf.text: 3 Mortis Strikes recieved. You will not recieve any more rewards from this run.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerDebuf.zhText: 受到 3 次死灵打击。你将不会从这个任务中获得更多奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerDebuf.text: After being dead for 3 minutes you will be incur a Mortis Strike. Receiving 3 Mortis Strikes forfeits any more rewards for this run. Next Mortis Strike in: |SECONDS|s. You have |STACKS|/3
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerDebuf.zhText: 在死亡 3 分钟后，你会遭受一次死灵打击。受到 3 次死灵打击后，你将无法从这个任务中获得更多奖励。下一次死灵打击还有 |SECONDS| 秒。你已经累计 |STACKS|/3 次

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerPopup.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|MORTIS STRIKES|CLOSE_COLOR|
After being dead for 3 minutes, you will receive 1 Mortis Strike.
You will receive an additional Mortis Strike every 3 minutes until you are revived.
If you reach 3 Mortis Strikes, you will be ineligible for any more rewards in this mission.

|OPEN_COLOR|VOID ANGELS|CLOSE_COLOR|
You still have the opportunity to be revived by your teammates.
30s after a Tenno has bled-out, a dormant Void Angel bearing the glyph of the Tenno will appear.
Defeat it to bring the Tenno back into the fray.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/IdlePlayerPopup.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|死灵打击|CLOSE_COLOR|
死亡 3 分钟后，你将受到一次死灵打击。
在你复活之前，每 3 分钟你会受到一次额外的死灵打击。
如果累积 3 次死灵打击，你将失去从这个任务中获取更多奖励的资格。

|OPEN_COLOR|虚空天使|CLOSE_COLOR|
你依然有机会被你的队友复活。
当一名 Tenno 濒死 30 秒后，一个带有这名 Tenno 浮印的休眠虚空天使将会出现。
击败它让这名 Tenno 重回战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Drones fly above Flare, spraying them with Efervon gas.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 无人机在弗莱尔上方飞行，向他喷射艾弗旺气体。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: The entire region deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin damage over time, increasing the longer players remain, except in the vicinity of Hell-Scrubbers. Some enemies may drop filters that create additional, static temporary safe zones.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 整个区域会随着玩家停留时间的延长而造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害，地狱净化器附近区域除外。有些敌人可能会掉落过滤器，可用于创造额外稳定的临时安全区。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Flare creates a field that disrupts player abilities while draining energy to boost Flare's health. Flare slowly loses health when no players are in range.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 弗莱尔会创造一个力场，干扰玩家的技能，同时消耗能量以增强弗莱尔的生命值。当没有玩家在范围内时，弗莱尔会缓慢失去生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Two Legacytes spawn each round and twice as many captures are needed for success.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 每轮产生两个传承种，需要两倍的捕获次数才能成功。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Consequences of opening a Supply Cache are active from the start and will intensify once it is opened. Failure to open a Supply Cache doubles the kill count required to finish the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 任务开始时，触发打开补给箱的负面效果，一旦打开就会加剧。未能打开补给箱会导致完成任务所需的击杀数翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Enemies drop Miasmites upon death that immediately rush Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 敌人死亡时掉落的自爆虫会立即冲向弗莱尔。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Enemies take 90% less damage from non-weak point hits.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 非弱点命中对敌人造成的伤害降低 90%。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Techrot Tumors appear near Hell-Scrubbers, increasing the rate of life support decay with each active tumor.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 地狱净化器附近会出现科腐者肿瘤，每个活跃的肿瘤都会增加维生系统衰减的速度。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Legacytes are more powerful with each generation but take longer to escape.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 每一代传承种都更加强大，但同时也需要更长的时间来逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Flare emits a disruptive field around themselves that disrupts abilities and drains energy. Flare will lose health if no players are within range. They gain health based on the number of players within range.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 弗莱尔在自身周围发出一个干扰力场，干扰技能并消耗能量。如果范围内没有玩家，弗莱尔将流失生命值。他会根据范围内的玩家数量获得生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: As the Legacyte evolves other enemies present also gain new abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 随着传承种进化，其他在场敌人也将获得新技能。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Reinforcements will arrive during the fight; first Scaldra, then Techrot.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 战斗过程中会有敌方援军抵达，首先是炽蛇军，然后是科腐者。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Only Thermian RPGs can damage the tank. Reinforcements that carry Thermian RPGs will arrive during the fight.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 只有热熔火箭弹才能对坦克造成伤害。携带热熔火箭炮的增援部队将在战斗中持续出现。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: The tank has a <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin aura, leaves <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin trails, and its attacks all deal <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin damage.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 坦克拥有 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素光环，留下 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素尾迹，并且所有的攻击会造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Techrot enemies attempt to melee attack Hell-Scrubbers, bursting on contact and increasing scrubber contamination by 33%.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 科腐者敌人会尝试近战攻击地狱净化器，接触后将其引爆，并使净化器污染增加 33%。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: 10% of enemies are equipped with an impervious Elemental Barrier that can only be destroyed by an Amphor of the corresponding element.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 有 10% 敌人装备了不可穿透的元素屏障，只有对应元素的元素瓶才能摧毁屏障。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Two Necramech Demolishers will attack any conduit, but their health is reduced.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 两台爆破型殁世机甲会攻击任意导管，但它们的生命值降低。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Face two fragmented forms in the final battle.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 在最终战斗中对战两个接肢怪。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Enemies within 10m of each other form a Damage Linked group. Any damage done to an individual is distributed evenly to the entire linked group.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 相距 10 米内的敌人形成一个伤害链接群体。任何对单个成员造成的伤害都会平均分摊到整个群体。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Activate Life Support Towers to clear Hazardous Areas for your squad.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 激活维生装置塔以为你的小队清除危险区域。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Eximus units always drop Amphors but they are the only units that drop them.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 卓越者敌人必定掉落元素瓶，但只有他们会掉落元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Enemies take 90% less damage from non-weak point hits.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 非弱点命中对敌人造成的伤害降低 90%。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Enemies can target and destroy Conduits.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 敌人可以瞄准并摧毁导管。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Fissures rip into the mission, causing the Enemy Level to go up by 1 every 10s. Destroy them to stop the level from increasing further.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 裂缝在任务中形成，使得敌人的等级每 10 秒提升 1 级。消灭它们以防止等级增加。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Each Glyph inflicts a small amount of damage when collected.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 每个浮印在被收集时都会造成少量伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: The Auricle and Vitreum take damage over time, collecting the required Vosphene Glyphs will halt the degradation and partially heal them.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 魔耳和魔瞳随着时间逐渐受损，收集所需的荧音浮印可暂停损伤并对它们进行部分修复。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: All enemies are invulnerable and only take damage when they are inflicted with <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Status. Chyrinka Pillars appear randomly and inflict Radiation Status.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 所有敌人都是无敌的，只有在受到辐射异常状态影响时才会受到伤害。辐射柱体随机出现并造成 <DT_RADIATION>辐射异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: The Fragmented Tide never stops attacking.
The security system requires twice as many Vosphene Glyphs to activate.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 安全系统需要两倍的荧音浮印才能激活。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Some Vosphene Glyphs are booby trapped with a portal that Teleports those that touch it 250m away. After the portal is revealed it lasts 45s.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 某些荧音浮印附有传送门陷阱，接触它时会被传送到 250 米以外的地方。传送门显性后持续 45 秒。
殁世机甲出现的频率更高。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: The Life Support Tower delivery system is disabled. Necramechs spawn every 90 seconds, and drop 6 Life Support Modules when killed.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 禁用维生装置塔运送系统。每 90 秒生成殁世机甲，击杀时掉落 6 个维生模块。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Eximus units support The Fragmented Tide and its final form.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 卓越者敌人出现并支援断肢潮和最终的接肢怪。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Void Angels fight alongside final fragmented form.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 虚空天使与最终的接肢怪并肩作战。
所有贪囤断肢都是卓越者。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Life Support Towers only activate after 20 enemies have been killed within a 15m radius of them.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 维生装置塔只有在其 15 米范围内杀死 20 名敌人后才会激活。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.text: Amphors will inflict their associated elemental damage while being carried.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/MissionVariant_.zhText: 携带元素瓶时会受到与之对应的元素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PedestalImpactM.text:
Awaken Void Angel
Defeat the Void Angel to revive the indicated squadmate
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PedestalImpactM.zhText:
唤醒虚空天使
击败虚空天使可复活被标记的队友

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Abi.text: All Abilities are disabled until the squad kills 50 enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Abi.zhText: 小队击杀 50 名敌人前，所有技能均被禁止使用。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ane.text: Maximum shield and overshield will not exceed 500.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ane.zhText: 最大护盾和过载护盾不会超过 500。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ant.text: Warframe and ally Overguard gain reduced by 75%
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ant.zhText: 战甲和友军超宏防护获取量减少 75%

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Aoe.text: Blast radius of weapons with radial attacks is set to |val|m.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Aoe.zhText: 具有范围攻击的武器爆炸半径固定为 |val| 米。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Arm.text: Casting an ability reduces armor by 10% for 10s.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Arm.zhText: 施放技能会使护甲降低 10%，持续 10 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Arm.text: Casting an ability reduces armor by |PERCENT|% for 10s.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Arm.zhText: 施放技能会使护甲降低 |PERCENT|%，持续 10 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Cha.text: While a channeled ability is active, maximum shields and overshields are reduced each second. 10s cooldown to fully recover.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Cha.zhText: 导引技能激活期间，最大护盾和过载护盾每秒都会降低。完全恢复需要 10 秒的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Con.zhText: 每隔几秒就会受到 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Con.text: Gain 1 <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Status Effect every time you take damage.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Con.zhText: 每次受到伤害时，获得 1 层 <DT_PUNCTURE>穿刺异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Dam.text: You do 0 damage while not moving.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Dam.zhText: 静止不动时无法造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Dec.text: Max health reduced each time health damage is taken
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Dec.zhText: 受到生命值伤害时还会扣减最大生命上限

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Exh.text: Lose 2 Energy per second for each enemy within 10 meters of you.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Exh.zhText: 周围 10 米范围内的所有敌人使你每秒丢失 2 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Fra.text: Activating an Ability inflicts 50 health and 150 shield damage upon you.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Fra.zhText: 激活一项技能时，会对你生命值造成 50 伤害，对护盾造成 150 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Gea.text: All gear restricted except for Archguns, Atomicycles and Necramechs
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Gea.zhText: 除曲翼枪械、原子摩托车和殁世机甲外，所有装备均受限制

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Inf.text: Gain a <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effect every time you take damage.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Inf.zhText: 每次受到伤害时，获得一层 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Kni.text: Lose 2 Health when moving. Jumping pauses the effect.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Kni.zhText: 移动时损失 2 点生命值。跳跃会暂停效果。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Max.text: Max ammo on all weapons reduced by 75%
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Max.zhText: 所有武器的弹药最大值减少 75%

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ope.text: Transference into Operator and Drifter is blocked.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ope.zhText: 无法传识到指挥官或漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ove.text: Duration of negative Status Effects is tripled
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Ove.zhText: 负面异常状态的持续时间增加到三倍

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_San.text: Every time you take damage, you also suffer a <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_San.zhText: 每当你受到伤害时，还会陷入 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Sca.text: Ammo depletes steadily. Battery weapons recharge slowly.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Sca.zhText: 弹药逐渐耗尽。电池武器充能缓慢。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Sta.text: Ammo restored by drops and gear is reduced 75%.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Sta.zhText: 通过掉落和道具恢复的弹药减少 75%。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Vam.text: Lose Health every second. Killing enemies restores Health.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Vam.zhText: 每秒流失生命值。击杀敌人可恢复生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Vit.text: Taking health damage also consumes 5% of max energy per hit.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Vit.zhText: 每当生命值受到伤害，也会消耗最大能量的 5%。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Voi.text: Using an ability opens a void rift nearby
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Voi.zhText: 使用技能将在附近打开一道虚空裂隙

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Wit.text: Pickups do not heal, and Health Orbs cannot be picked up.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/PersonalMod_Wit.zhText: 拾取无法提供治疗，并且无法拾取生命球。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/SpeedUpActionTe.text: Battle Rogue Necramech to reduce Mission Timer
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/SpeedUpActionTe.zhText: 与暴戾殁世机甲卓越者进行战斗以减少任务计时器

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/SpeedUpMessage.text: Defeat the Rogue Necramech Eximus to reduce the Mission Timer
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/SpeedUpMessage.zhText: 击败暴戾殁世机甲卓越者以减少任务计时器

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/SpeedUpSuccessM.text: Rogue Necramech Eximus defeated. Mission Timer reduced by |AMOUNT|s.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/SpeedUpSuccessM.zhText: 暴戾殁世机甲卓越者被击败。任务计时器减少 |AMOUNT| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/StickerSelect_N.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|SELECT A PEELY PIX|CLOSE_COLOR|
Discover the amazing power of Peely Pix.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/StickerSelect_N.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|选择易撕贴纸|CLOSE_COLOR|
发现易撕贴纸的惊人力量。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/StickerSelect_S.text: <WARNING> Select Peely Pix to see details <WARNING>
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/StickerSelect_S.zhText: <WARNING> 选中易撕贴纸查看详情 <WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/TemporalArchime.text:
|OPEN_COLOR1|NO SELF REVIVE|CLOSE_COLOR|
Can only be revived by other Tenno.
If a squadmate is downed, collect 5 |OPEN_COLOR2|Resurgence Tokens|CLOSE_COLOR| from fallen enemies, then hack at a terminal to revive them.
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/TemporalArchime.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR1|无法自行复活|CLOSE_COLOR|
只能由其他 Tenno 复活。
如果一名小队成员倒地，则从倒下的敌人身上收集 5 个|OPEN_COLOR2|复活令牌|CLOSE_COLOR|，然后入侵终端机以复活他们。

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/WeaponBuff_Warf.zhText: +50% 技能效率，+100 最大能量
+50% 冲刺速度， +50% 跑酷速度

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/WeaponBuff_Weap.zhText: +150% 暴击几率加成，+150% 暴击倍率

/Lotus/Language/Conquest/WeaponBuff_Weap.text: +100% Melee Heavy Attack Damage, +50% Melee Heavy Attack Efficiency
/Lotus/Language/Conquest/WeaponBuff_Weap.zhText: +100% 近战重击伤害，+50% 近战重击效率

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/AssassinBait.text: Lures the Wolf out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassin would normally appear.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/AssassinBait.zhText: 吸引「恶狼」现身的物品。为一次性道具，仅能使用在刺客一般会出没的场景中。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/CatbrowVampi.text: Known as 'lisau heisah' by the Ostrons, this is a traditionally-brewed remedy for the Vasca virus. Once applied any infected Kavats within a short radius are cured.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/CatbrowVampi.zhText: 这是一种用传统方式调制而成的噬血病毒治疗剂，Ostron 人称之为"lisau heisah"。一旦使用，小范围内所有被感染的库娃都会得到治愈。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/DisabledItem.text: This item is disabled for the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/DisabledItem.zhText: 此物品因任务要求而被禁用。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/FormaStanceD.text: Modifies a Stance slot on a melee weapon to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/FormaStanceD.zhText: 改变近战武器上的架式槽位以与任何 Mod 的极性相容。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/FormaUmbraDe.text:
Forma that can apply the UMBRA polarity.

This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe or Melee Weapon to UMBRA polarity and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes and Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/FormaUmbraDe.zhText:
可以设置 UMBRA 极性的 Forma。

这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的基础构件。它可以改变战甲或武器的极性槽至 UMBRA 极性，并将其等级重置为无等级。这项物品只能用于满级的战甲及近战武器。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/PlantScanner.text: Oxylus Sentinel will automatically pick any plants within |RANGE|m over <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/PlantScanner.zhText: 奥克绪罗斯守护将在 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|DURATION| 秒内自动拾取 |RANGE| 米范围内的任何植物。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/RivenModPack.text: Cephalon Samodeus' grand creations. Each mod is malleable and unique, inspired by and meant for a single weapon. Complete a Riven Mod's challenge to unveil its possibilities, both rapturous and unfavorable.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/RivenModPack.zhText: 中枢 Samodeus 的得意之作。每个 MOD 都具有延展性和独特性，灵感来自并适用于单件武器。完成裂罅 MOD 的挑战来揭示其可能性，包括狂喜和不快。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/SchismKeysDe.text:
Raw Orokin memory plasma. Varzia's Foundry can consume Aya to create Void Relics. Find her in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.

Location: Void Missions and Bounties
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/SchismKeysDe.zhText:
未加工的奥罗金记忆等离子。瓦奇娅的铸造厂可以消耗阿耶精华来制造虚空遗物。可在火星上 Maroo 的市集里找到她。

获取地点：虚空和赏金任务

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/SkateBallDes.text: Deploys a DESERT SKATE unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/SkateBallDes.zhText: 设置一个为你战斗的沙漠鳐鱼魅影。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/StalkerBallD.text: Deploys a clone of the Stalker to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/StalkerBallD.zhText: 部署一名追猎者分身为你作战。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/StanceFormaT.text: A collection of three Stance Formas.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/StanceFormaT.zhText: 内含 3 个架式 Forma 的组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/SurgeEximusB.text: Deploys a clone of the Surge Eximus to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/SurgeEximusB.zhText: 部署一名电涌卓越者分身为你作战。

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/VampireKavat.zhText: 噬血型库娃初心者套装

/Lotus/Language/Consumables/VampireKavat.text:
Contains all of the components to begin gene-splicing a Vasca Kavat! Includes two specialized Vasca Imprints that combine during the incubation process to guarantee the generation of this rare sub-species.

Requires: Installed Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
/Lotus/Language/Consumables/VampireKavat.zhText:
包含了一切开始噬血型库娃的基因拼接所必要的组件！包括两个特制的噬血型基因印记，在孵化阶段将其组合可确保诞生该稀有品种。

需要：安装好的库娃孵化器升级模块

/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/FishDesc.text: TRALOK FILET: Salt liberally and stew for hours. An Ostron favorite. An acquired taste.
/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/FishDesc.zhText: 塔洛鱼片：大量加盐，炖煮数小时。Ostron 人最爱的菜肴。味道需要慢慢品味。

/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/MeatDesc.text: HORRASQUE BRISKET: Braise, then simmer slow. Sweeten to taste. I could eat this every day.
/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/MeatDesc.zhText: 惑瓦斯克胸肉：先炖，再慢煮。根据口味加糖。我可以天天吃。

/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/SaltyDes.text: SALT: Enhances any dish, but not good for Sorren's blood pressure.
/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/SaltyDes.zhText: 盐：能提升任何菜肴的风味，但对索伦的血压不好。

/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/SpicyDes.text: SOL PEPPER: Hot as Sol, and flavorful too. Sorren can't get enough of this.
/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/SpicyDes.zhText: 太阳椒：像太阳一样辣，而且味道鲜美。索伦特别喜欢吃。

/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/SweetDes.text: SPARGO SUGAR: Great for candies and desserts, but I love it in savory dishes.
/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/SweetDes.zhText: 斯帕哥糖：非常适合制作糖果和甜点，但我更喜欢把它用在咸味菜肴中。

/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/Vegetabl.text: BORGON TUBER: Tangy taste, with a bitterness that melts away when cooked. Sorren loved this served spicy hot.
/Lotus/Language/CookingMiniGame/Vegetabl.zhText: 波旁薯：味道酸甜，略带苦味，但煮熟后苦味会消失。索伦喜欢吃加辣的波旁薯。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamBip.text: A lethal blend of Corpus ingenuity and Sentient technology, this MOA has been loaded up with devastating hybrid weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamBip.zhText: Corpus 独创性和 Sentient 技术的致命混合体，这个恐鸟具有毁灭性混合武器的特质。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamCar.text: The unseemly marriage of a Corpus sentry turret and a Sentient drone, this unit alternates between repeating energy bolts and a devastating focused beam weapon.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamCar.zhText: Corpus 哨兵炮台和 Sentient 无人机的看似不适宜的结合，这个单位可以在连续发射能量弹和毁灭性的聚焦光束间切换使用。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamDro.text: Corpus Osprey and Armored Sentient, conjoined in a hideous fusion of known and unknown to create a lethal unit that attacks with conventional beam weapons, or clones nearby friendly units to create Spectralyst fighters.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamDro.zhText: Corpus 鱼鹰和装甲 Sentient，以已知和未知的丑陋融合方式结合起来，创造出一种致命的作战单位。它可以用常规光束武器攻击，或者克隆附近的友军来创造出幽魅使战士。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamMoa.text: A diabolical mess of limbs, this Amalgam fighter doesn’t care which way is up. A fast-galloping unit that attacks with crushing melee blows, a repeater cannon and destabilizing ground slams.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamMoa.zhText: 它有着恶魔般的混乱四肢，这个并合战士不关心哪个方向是向上的。这是一种迅速疾驰的作战部队，使用毁灭性的近战肉搏、连发式加农炮和失衡震地重击进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamOve.text: The full realization of the grotesque partnership between Alad V and the Sentients. This unit can upgrade organic allies by capturing them and birthing neuro-carnivorous memes directly into their brain stems, thereby super-charging their fighting capacity and resilience.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamOve.zhText: 完全实现阿拉德 V 与 Sentient 之间的怪诞伙伴关系。这个作战单位可以抓住盟友并将神经食肉模因植入其脑干，从而为其战斗能力和恢复能力进行超级充能。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamPil.text: Alad V has married countless generations of Sentient evolution with the most advanced Corpus technology to create a brutal, persistent fighter. Wields a plasma bullet assault rifle and carries an Amalgam Osprey into battle.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamPil.zhText: 阿拉德 V 运用极其先进的 Corpus 技术，结合了无数 Sentient 世代的演化后创造出这款残酷坚毅的战士。配戴电浆突击步枪并携带并合鱼鹰投身战场。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamPil.text: A transient copy of an ally or enemy created by a Sentient from Tau energy.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamPil.zhText: Sentient 借由 Tau 能量创造出的友军/敌人复制品。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamSni.text: An amalgamation of a Corpus Sniper and unknown sentient form. Not only is this fighter capable of pinpoint accuracy it can also manipulate matter to create a Spectralyst clone of any enemy, including Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamSni.zhText: 由 Corpus 狙击者与未知 Sentient 物质的并合体。这类战士不仅能精准发动攻击，还能操控物质创造出任何敌人的幽魅使复制体，连 Tenno 都无法幸免。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Concentrat.text:
A reagent commonly used to produce highly combustible fuel.

Location: Jupiter
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Concentrat.zhText:
一种通常用于生产超高可燃性燃料的试剂。

获取地点：木星

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Concentrat.text:
A reagent commonly used to produce highly combustible fuel.
This bundle of 450 Hexenon can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Concentrat.zhText: 一种通常用于生产高可燃性燃料的试剂。这个内含 450 个六醇燃剂的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/CrpLightni.text: 360-degree coverage, limited range. Do not service without qualified technician.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/CrpLightni.zhText: 360 度全角度覆盖，范围有限。没有合格的技术人员在场，请勿提供此服务。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Destructab.text: Contains highly compressed toxic gas. Store in a cool, dry place. Do not expose to heat. Do not rupture the container.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Destructab.zhText: 含有高度压缩的有毒气体。储存于阴凉干燥处。不要暴露在高温下。不要使容器破裂。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Destructab.text: Contains volatile radioactive waste. Store in a cool, dry place. Do not expose to heat. Do not rupture the container.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/Destructab.zhText: 含有挥发性放射性废料。储存于阴凉干燥处。不要暴露在高温下。不要使容器破裂。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/GasHunters.text: Dropship or gunship? Retrofitted for the challenges of Gas City and designed to rapidly deploy force to any security breach.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/GasHunters.zhText: 是空投艇？还是武装直升机？为了应对集气城市的恶劣环境，该机型经过了特别改造，旨在针对任何安保事故迅速部署部队。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/GasScienti.text: Security Clearance Ultraviolet. Deniable. Blanked. Alad's finest disciples tasked with the supreme task of optimizing Corpus/Amalgam tech-blending. Profit is Life.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/GasScienti.zhText: 安全级别显现紫外光。可被拒绝进入。消隐的。阿拉德最优秀的信徒们肩负着优化 Corpus／并合体混合技术的最崇高的任务。盈利即是生命。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/LisetPropC.text: Keep the Orbiter in spotless condition with the latest in Corpus sanitation technology.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/LisetPropC.zhText: 使用 Corpus 最先进的卫生科技来维持一尘不染的轨道飞行器环境。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PhysicsBar.text: Contains compressed gas. Store upright. Do not tip, roll or drop the container. Return to designated storage area if found.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PhysicsBar.zhText: 包含压缩气体。直立存储。不要倾倒、滚动或掉落容器。如果发现，送回指定的存储区域。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeA.text: Alad V has married countless generations of Sentient evolution with the most advanced Corpus technology to create a brutal, persistent fighter. Wields a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneration.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeA.zhText: 阿拉德 V 让无数代 Sentient 进化产物与最先进的 Corpus 技术结合，从而造就出了这样一个野蛮而强韧的战士。该单位不仅拥有能将 Sentient 护甲熔穿的火炬焊枪，还能快速再生。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeC.text: The unseemly marriage of a Corpus sentry turret and Sentient drone, this unit alternates between Arca Plasmor blasts and a devastating focused beam weapon.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeC.zhText: Corpus 哨卫炮台和 Sentient 无人机的诡异结合产物。该单位能够切换使用弧电离子枪或是聚焦光束武器来发动攻击。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeM.text: An amalgamation of a Corpus brute and unknown sentient form. Not only is this fighter capable of crushing blows it can also manipulate matter to create a Spectralyst clone of any enemy, including Tenno
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeM.zhText: 一种强大的 Corpus 单位与某种未知的 Sentient 单位的并合体。这位战士不仅能将目标打得粉碎，还能操纵物质，制造出一个以任何敌人为原型的瞬态使复制体，就连 Tenno 也不例外。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeM.text: A lethal blend of Corpus ingenuity and Sentient technology, this MOA shares the out-of-phase healing mode with its Prototype cousin but is also capable of staggering opponents with globes of explosive Sentient energy.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeM.zhText: Corpus 独创性和 Sentient 技术的致命混合体，这只恐鸟与它的原型表亲一样有着自愈模式而且备有爆炸性的 Sentient 能量护罩可以打断对手的行动。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeS.text: A diabolical mess of limbs, this Amalgam fighter doesn’t care which way is up. A fast-galloping unit that attacks with crushing melee blows, destabilizing ground slams and homing energy projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeS.zhText: 它有着恶魔般的混乱四肢，这名并合战士不关心哪个方向是向上的。该单位能迅速疾驰，并使用毁灭性的近战肉搏、失衡震地重击和追踪型能量弹进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/RobotClean.text: A busy Tenno's best friend, this little guy cleans 24/7 to keep your vessel in "shipshape."
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/RobotClean.zhText: Tenno 最好的伙伴。这个忙碌的小家伙每时每刻都在进行清洁工作，以保持你的飞船还有个船样。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/SpaceFight.text: Nimble and relentless, the Aquila is the staple dogfighter of the Corpus fleet.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/SpaceFight.zhText: 灵敏且无情，天鹰是 Corpus 舰队中常见的缠斗型战机。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/AccessCap.zhText: 摧毁天碑战舰安保节点
摧毁天柱战舰安保节点
摧毁天槛战舰安保节点

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/AirlockWa.zhText: 在 CORPUS 气密仓处待命

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/Assassina.zhText: 与帕尔沃斯的姐妹对决

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/BoardCapi.zhText: 进入 CORPUS 天碑战舰
进入 CORPUS 天柱战舰
进入 CORPUS 天槛战舰

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.text: DEFEND THE TARGET ABOARD THE CORPUS OBELISK
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.zhText: 登上 CORPUS 天碑战舰，并保卫目标

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.text: EXTERMINATE THE CREW OF THE CORPUS OBELISK
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.zhText: 歼灭 CORPUS 天碑战舰上的舰员
摧毁 CORPUS 天碑战舰

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.text: DEFEND THE TARGET ABOARD THE CORPUS PILLAR
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.zhText: 登上 CORPUS 天柱战舰，并保卫目标

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.text: EXTERMINATE THE CREW OF THE CORPUS PILLAR
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.zhText: 歼灭 CORPUS 天柱战舰上的舰员
摧毁 CORPUS 天柱战舰

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.text: DEFEND THE TARGET ABOARD THE CORPUS STANCHION
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.zhText: 登上 CORPUS 天槛战舰，并保卫目标

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.text: EXTERMINATE THE CREW OF THE CORPUS STANCHION
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CapitalSh.zhText: 歼灭 CORPUS 天槛战舰上的舰员
摧毁 CORPUS 天槛战舰

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpAdmira.text: A high-ranking Corpus official who is armed with a powerful cryo beam and deploys Cryo Sentries.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpAdmira.zhText: Corpus 高级军官，配备了强力冷冻光束，并且可部署永冻哨卫。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpAdmira.text: Flash freezes any hostile who gets too close.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpAdmira.zhText: 瞬间冻结任何过于靠近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBoardi.text: Specialist boarding unit, armed with an impact-hammer capable of rapidly disabling critical ship systems.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBoardi.zhText: 特化型登舰作战单位，配有一把冲击锤，可快速使目标舰船上的关键系统瘫痪。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBoardi.text: Specialist boarding unit trained to wreak havoc on crew and equipment with his proximity-grenade launcher.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBoardi.zhText: 特化型登舰作战单位，能使用配备的感应榴弹发射器，对目标舰船上的舰员和设备造成巨大破坏。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBoardi.text: Specialist boarding unit, armed with repeat scatter blaster for shredding enemy personnel.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBoardi.zhText: 特化型登舰作战单位，配有连发散射爆破武器，用以粉碎敌方人员。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBomber.text: Elite Corpus robot. Launches tether-mines to ensnare opponents. Kinetic gun blasts have a strong knockback effect. Deploys defensive Aurax Moas to shield itself.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpBomber.zhText: 精英级 Corpus 机器人，可发射束缚地雷来困住对手。其配备的动能枪射击后有很强的击退效果，并且会部署防御性的傲金恐鸟来保护自己。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrewsh.text: Trained to fly Crewships and armed with a laser pistol.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrewsh.zhText: 接受过专门的战舰驾驶训练，并且配备了一把激光手枪。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrpSpe.text: An elite unit that shocks and staggers with snares from his Protonex snare.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrpSpe.zhText: 精英级作战单位，可通过光子发射器设下陷阱来冲击并击倒敌方。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrpSpe.text: Wields a devastating rotary laser cannon. Trained to clear entire hot zones with deadly efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrpSpe.zhText: 持有一门毁灭性的旋转激光加农炮，并且接受过专门训练，能以极高的灭杀效率清扫敌方单位集中区域。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrpSpe.text: Elite Corpus robot. Launches tether-mines to ensnare opponents. Kinetic gun blasts have a strong knockback effect. Deploys defensive Aurax Moas to shield itself.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpCrpSpe.zhText: 精英级 Corpus 机器人，可发射束缚地雷来困住对手。其配备的动能枪射击后有很强的击退效果，并且会部署防御性的傲金恐鸟来保护自己。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.text: Raknoid robotic unit upgraded with a thorax-mounted missile launcher.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.zhText: 在胸前安装了导弹发射器的蛛形机。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.text: Elite robotic walker, armed with a high-intensity thermal beam.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.zhText: 精英级步行机器人，配备有高强度热能射线武器。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.text: Elite robotic walker, armed with twin heat-sapping cryo beams.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.zhText: 精英级步行机器人，配备有双管吸热冷冻光束武器。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.text: Trained in the art of deflection, this elite melee fighter uses his high-discharge staff to block most incoming, forward fire.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/CrpSpecOp.zhText: 这位精英近战斗士接受过专门的格挡训练，他能使用自己的高压电击长棍来抵挡大多数来自前方和后方的火力。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/JammingDr.text: Carries countermeasures that interfere with hacking.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/JammingDr.zhText: 携带了在入侵时可制造干扰的反制措施。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/MeltdownF.zhText: 释放压力。距离反应堆熔毁还有：

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/MeltdownM.text: MAINTAIN THE REACTOR WITHIN CY'S THRESHOLDS
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/MeltdownM.zhText: 把反应堆维持在赛伊的应力范围内。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/MeltdownW.zhText: 距离关停前重启反应堆还有：

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/ObeliskSh.text: The intimidating Obelisk-class heavy capital ship has cast a dark and intimidating shadow across entire worlds.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/ObeliskSh.zhText: 令人望而生畏的天碑级重型主力战舰，在整个世界投下了黑暗且又令人畏惧的阴影。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/PillarShi.text: The workhorse of the Corpus fleet, the medium-sized Pillar-class capital ship can be found deployed to every Sector of Corpus space.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/PillarShi.zhText: 作为 Corpus 舰队的主力舰，天柱级中型主力战舰被部署在 Corpus 比邻星域的各个区域。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/ReachCapi.zhText: 接近 CORPUS 天碑战舰
接近 CORPUS 天柱战舰
接近 CORPUS 天槛战舰

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/RecoverCr.zhText: 可选任务：偷取 CORPUS 证件

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/SpaceFigh.text: This utility vessel is optimized for salvage but will still punch back when attacked.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/SpaceFigh.zhText: 这艘多用途战舰为打捞回收进行了优化，但在其受到攻击时仍会进行反击。

/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/Stanchion.text: The smallest of the Corpus capital ships, the Stanchion nonetheless poses a formidable challenge to inexperienced Railjack crews.
/Lotus/Language/CorpusRailjack/Stanchion.zhText: 作为最小型的 Corpus 主力战舰，天槛战舰对于缺乏经验的航道星舰舰员来说是一个巨大的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/1999CommunityA.text: A badge of honor befitting one of the genuine truth-seekers. From another time, in another world...
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/1999CommunityA.zhText: 这是一枚荣誉勋章，献给真正的真理追寻者。来自另一个时空，另一个世界……
滴答小队永远不散徽章

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AlchemistAgile.text: The Agile Animation Set for Lavos.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AlchemistNoble.text: The Noble Animation Set for Lavos.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AmalgamEventBa.text: Tenno bearing this insignia brought the fight to Alad V's monstrous Amalgam Project.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AmalgamEventBa.zhText: 佩戴这款徽章的 Tenno 曾正面对抗过阿拉德 V 的骇人并合计划。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AmazonOniSyand.text: Like a carnivorous flower, this alluring Syandana conceals a dangerous predator.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AmazonOniSyand.zhText: 就像一朵肉食性的花一样，这件披饰的诱人外表下潜藏着一个危险的捕食者。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AmbulasEventBa.text: An emblem commemorating the fight against the Ambulas incursion.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AmbulasEventBa.zhText: 一枚纪念在智踱恐鸟入侵中奋勇抗争的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AnimaAltHelmet.text: When they are night you are day. When they are light, you are the all-encompassing dark. A demon helm befitting a Warframe of savage duality.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AnimaAltHelmet.zhText: 当他们是夜，你就是昼。当他们是光，你就是无所不在的暗。这顶恶魔头盔适合拥有狂野二元性的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ArbiterOfHexis.text: An armor set traditionally worn by those entrusted with the duties of Arbitration according to the Precepts of Hexis.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ArbiterOfHexis.zhText: 由依据均衡仲裁者戒律被委以仲裁职责的人所穿的传统护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ArchonShardEph.text: Expose the power that courses through you. This Ephemera dynamically updates with your Warframe’s installed Archon Shards.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ArchonShardEph.zhText: 展现流淌全身的力量。这个幻纹会随着你战甲上安装的执刑官源力石进行动态更新。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ArchonShardEph.text: Express the Archon's fury. This Ephemera dynamically updates with your Warframe's installed Archon Shards.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ArchonShardEph.zhText: 表现执刑官的怒火。这个幻纹会随着你战甲上安装的执刑官源力石进行动态更新。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshDeluxeIISya.text: With time and fire the truth of bone is revealed. The signature Syandana of Ash Shroud.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshDeluxeIISya.zhText: 伴随着时间与烈火，骨头的真面目被揭示。Ash 裹尸布的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshLeverianLio.text: This skin immortalizes the pistol Lio De Nas used in self-defense when Ash came calling, in the story told by Drusus Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshLeverianLio.zhText: 在德枢·莱弗讲述的故事中，力欧·德纳斯在 Ash 受命而来时使用了这把手枪自卫；该外观将这把手枪的风采从历史长河里永久保留了下来。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshLeverianTia.text: During the Orokin era, those who bore this symbol inspired both admiration and fear. The jewel that adorned the Scoria, alumnae of the Orokin school of political assassination, is now yours to wear. Details of the school's ethos can be found in Ash's section of the Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshLeverianTia.zhText: 在奥罗金时代，那些带着这个标志的人令人钦佩又恐惧。装饰在奥罗金政治暗杀学院毕业学员们——头衔"火山石"的成员们身上的珠宝，现在可以由你佩戴。关于该学院性质的细节可以在莱弗博物馆的 Ash 区域找到。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshPrimeDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Ash Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AshPrimeDefaul.zhText: Ash Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AtlasDeluxeSca.text: Austere crystalline beauty, formed over time, deceptively delicate, lethally sharp. The Stratum Syandana perfectly compliments Karst, Atlas' deluxe skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AtlasDeluxeSca.zhText: 随着时间的推移形成了简朴的结晶美，看似脆弱却又尖锐致命。地层披饰完美地装点了岩溶， Atlas 的华丽外观。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AtlasPrimeDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Atlas Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AtlasPrimeDefa.zhText: Atlas Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AtomicycleKeyc.text: Never lose your keys again with this convenient sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/AtomicycleKeyc.zhText: 有了这款便捷的坠饰，再也不用担心弄丢钥匙了。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourADes.text: This decorative armored plate is a Ki'Teer original.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourADes.zhText: 这些装饰性的护甲乃 Ki'Teer 的原创作品。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourCDes.text: This decorative armored plate is a Ki'Teer original.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourLDes.text: This decorative armored plate is a Ki'Teer original.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourThre.text: Become the very picture of regard with this Ki'Teer original armor.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourThre.zhText: 穿戴 Ki'Teer 原创盔甲成为尊贵的化身。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourTwoD.text: Exhibit impeccable taste and standing with my exclusive new armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroArmourTwoD.zhText: 使用我全新推出的独家护甲套装来展现出自己无可挑剔的品味。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroCape2Scarf.text: Exude style and poise with this refined accessory.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroCape2Scarf.zhText: 用这款精致的配饰来彰显出格调与风度。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroCape3Scarf.text: Flaunt your impeccable taste in a Ki'Teer original syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroCape3Scarf.zhText: 身着 Ki'Teer 的原创披饰炫耀你无可挑剔的品味。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroEphemeraAD.text: Spread the influence of the System's greatest trader wherever you go!
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroEphemeraAD.zhText: 无论你身在何处，都扩散该星系最伟大商人的影响！

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroInarosMele.text: This matching sugatra for the Anpu Staff Skin will add a dash of elegance to any Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroInarosMele.zhText: 这个与安普长棍外观所搭配的坠饰能够给任何近战武器增添一丝优雅。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroKavatBadge.text: An emblem representing your Kavat allegiance.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroKavatBadge.zhText: 一枚象征着你的库娃忠诚的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroKubrowBadg.text: An emblem representing your Kubrow allegiance.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroKubrowBadg.zhText: 一枚象征着你的库狛忠诚的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroMeleeDangl.text: The finest Sugatra for your finest weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroMeleeDangl.zhText: 为你最出色的武器打造的最精美的坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroMouthPiece.text: Breathe crystal clean atmosphere with this deluxe respiratory device.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BaroMouthPiece.zhText: 戴上这件高级的呼吸器，尽享水晶般洁净的空气

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BayonettaFiref.text: Resembling a butterfly's wings emerging from their chrysalis, this Syandana seems infused with mystical power.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BayonettaFiref.zhText: 宛如蝴蝶的翅膀破蛹而出，这款披饰似乎被注入了神秘的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BerserkerDefau.text: The standard issue skin for the Valkyr Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BerserkerDelux.text: The Agile Animation Set for Valkyr Carnivex.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BerserkerDelux.zhText: Valkyr 行刑者的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BerserkerDelux.text: The Noble Animation Set for Valkyr Carnivex.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BerserkerDelux.zhText: Valkyr 行刑者的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BillowingArmou.text: The preferred armor set of those who call both the mists of morning and the fog of war home. A perfect complement to the the Cumulus Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BillowingArmou.zhText: 那些称清晨迷雾和战争烟云为家的人的首选护甲套装。这是对积云披饰的一个完美补充。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BillowingCapeD.text: Roiling and swirling with the promise and threat of a thunderhead, the Cumulus Syandana is for those Tenno who dwell among the clouds.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BillowingCapeD.zhText: 在雷霆的允诺和威力下飘摇吧，这个积云披饰是为那些住在云间的 Tenno 们所设计的。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BodySuitAdultD.text: A ragged old cloth and leather vest worn by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BodySuitAdultD.zhText: 漂泊者所穿的破旧布皮拼接背心。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BodySuitAdultG.text: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer breast plate. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BodySuitAdultG.zhText: 使用这套 Grineer 枪兵胸甲深入敌后。为漂泊者量身定制。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BrawlerDefault.text: The standard issue skin for the Atlas Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BreastCancerAw.text: Wear this ribbon Syandana as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/BreastCancerAw.zhText: 佩戴此缎带披饰作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。
