/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CNY2021EmblemD.text: Celebrate the New Lunar Year with the power of the noble ox.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CNY2021EmblemD.zhText: 以神牛之力，庆贺农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CNY2022EmblemD.text: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the strength of the tiger.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CNY2022EmblemD.zhText: 以猛虎之势庆贺农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CNY2023EmblemD.text: Celebrate Lunar Renewal with the kind heart of the gentle rabbit.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CNY2023EmblemD.zhText: 怀揣兔兔的温良之心庆祝农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CalibanDeluxeE.text: Carry the spirits of the Otherworld with you.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CalibanDeluxeE.zhText: 与黄泉归来的灵魂作伴。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksA.text: This covert rifle skin is bestowed upon new initiates into the Scoria order as proof they have completed their training.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksA.zhText: 这款步枪的隐形外观是授予新加入火山石组织的成员的，以证明他们已完成训练。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksB.text: Distribute justice just like the Caliber Chicks with this Rifle skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksB.zhText: 像这款步枪皮肤的主人火力女兵一样伸张正义。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksC.text: President King Corgi acknowledges your unending dedication to thwarting Anna Ki and the G.O.B.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksC.zhText: 金·柯基总统对你为阻止安娜·基和混沌起源的不懈努力表示认可。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksI.text: Distribute freedom just like the Caliber Chicks with this Flamethrower skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksI.zhText: 像这款火焰喷射器外观的主人火力女兵一样伸张正义。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksS.text: Protect your shoulders with Killian approved gear.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CaliberChicksS.zhText: 穿上基利安推荐的装备，保护你的肩部。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/CatbrowArmorCD.text: Accentuate the Kavat's sleek profile with this enchanting decorative armor.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/DrippyKeychain.zhText: 用这款炫酷的滴答坠饰展现你的时尚品味。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/DuelistAgileAn.text: The Agile Animation Set for Narin.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/DuelistNobleAn.text: The Noble Animation Set for Narin.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/DuviriArmourDe.text: Stride into the fray with fractal elegance.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/DuviriArmourDe.zhText: 以变幻的优雅之姿阔步迈入战场。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ESGrnSugatraDe.text: Fashioned by frontline grunts, this military-grade weapon embellishment was built to withstand the stresses of combat.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ESGrnSugatraDe.zhText: 由前线步兵所塑造的这件军事级武器装饰是以耐受战斗中的各种应力为前提所打造而成。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EightClawEvent.text: Show your dedication to Operation: Eight Claw with this emblem.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EightClawEvent.zhText: 用这个徽章来展示你对《行动代号：八爪》做出的贡献。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ElixisLatronAr.text: Inspired by the design of the iconic Tenno weapon, this armor set has been cast in shimmering bronze.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ElixisLatronAr.zhText: 灵感来自于标志性的 Tenno 武器设计，这个护甲套装以微光闪烁的青铜铸造。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ElixisPistolSk.text: Give your pistol a formidable dose of old world class with this bronzed pistol skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ElixisPistolSk.zhText: 这款古铜色的手枪外观为你的手枪提供了浓浓的怀旧风格。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmberDefaultSk.text: The standard issue skin for the Ember Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmberDeluxeBSy.text: Ember's Fourth Law of Thermodynamics: look good doing it.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmberDeluxeBSy.zhText: Ember 的热力学第四定律：做起来要好看点。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmberDeluxeSca.text: The signature syandana of Ember Vermillion.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmberDeluxeSca.zhText: Ember 朱红的标志性披饰

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmberPrimeDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Ember Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmberPrimeDefa.zhText: Ember Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmbolistMeleeD.text: A disgusting little nib of flesh to infest the hilt of any Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmbolistMeleeD.zhText: 一小段能感染任何近战武器握柄的恶心肉须。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanKavatA.text: Old-War-era battle-shell for shipboard mascots, service animals and attack beasts.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanKavatA.zhText: 远古之战时期的护甲，用于舰载吉祥物，服务类动物和具有攻击性的野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentAc.text: Customize your Sentinels to give them the deep-sea look of the Nautilus with this cosmetics bundle. Includes Wings, Mask and Tail. Does not include Nautilus Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentAc.zhText: 通过这件装饰组合包来自定义你的守护，让他们具有深海鹦鹉螺外观。组合包内含守护飞翼、面具，以及尾部，但不包含鹦鹉螺守护本体。
鹦鹉螺守护装饰组合包

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.text: Equip yourself with the efficient, deadly Nautilus Sentinel, the ideal companion for Railjack voyages. The Nautilus can repair shipboard hazards independently and haul enemies together for ease of targeting. Includes Wings, Mask and Tail cosmetic accessories.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.zhText: 为你自己装备高效且又致命的鹦鹉螺守护，它是航道星舰航行的理想同伴。鹦鹉螺可以自行修复舰上的安全隐患，并把敌人拖到一处以便于瞄准。组合包内含守护飞翼、面具，以及尾部装饰配件。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.text: Aglow with life, the Nautilus watches for shipboard hazards.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.zhText: 焕发着璀璨生机的鹦鹉螺监视着战舰上的险情。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.text: Rear-mounted Void fins keep the Nautilus stable.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.zhText: 后置的虚空鳍片让鹦鹉螺保持稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.text: Void-optimized wing attachments keep the Nautilus buoyant.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EmpyreanSentin.zhText: 虚空优化的飞翼附件让鹦鹉螺保持浮力。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EntratiEventEm.text: Tenno who bear this insignia resisted the Murmur during Operation Gargoyle's Cry.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EntratiEventEm.zhText: 佩戴此佩章的 Tenno 在《合成兽像的悲鸣》行动中抵抗了低语者。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EntratiKavatPa.text: Give your Kavat the look of Albrecht Entrati’s loyal companion, Kalymos.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EntratiKavatPa.zhText: 让你的库娃看起来像卡利莫斯，它是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛忠实的同伴。
卡利莫斯库娃基因伪装包

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EntratiKavatSk.text: Give your Kavat the look of Albrecht Entrati’s loyal companion, Kalymos.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EntratiKavatSk.zhText: 让你的库娃看起来像卡利莫斯，它是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛忠实的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EpochOperation.text: Bear the visage of the Eris killer as an emblem of your dedication to Epoch Operation: Taubound.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EpochOperation.zhText: 将《纪元行动：奔赴 Tau 星系》中获得的阋神星杀手身份以徽章的形式展现。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EpochOperation.text: Proclaim your participation in the death of Eris and Epoch Operation: Taubound with this sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EpochOperation.zhText: 通过这个纹章宣告你参与了阋神星之死和《纪元行动：奔赴 Tau 星系》。
奔赴 Tau 星系纹章

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxDayUnlo.text: This item lets you use Equinox's Day agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxDayUnlo.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Equinox 白昼面的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxDayUnlo.text: This item lets you use Equinox's Day noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxDayUnlo.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Equinox 白昼面的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxDeluxeS.text: Rise and fall, ebb and flow, peace and war. A signature Syandana for Equinox.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxDeluxeS.zhText: 盛衰兴废，潮起潮落，玉帛干戈。Equinox 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxNightUn.text: This item lets you use Equinox's Night agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxNightUn.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Equinox 黑夜面的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxNightUn.text: This item lets you use Equinox's Night noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxNightUn.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Equinox 黑夜面的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxPrimeDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Equinox Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EquinoxPrimeDe.zhText: Equinox Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EsteemExcalibu.text: An elite helmet for the Excalibur Warframe.
An elite skin for the Excalibur Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EsteemLexSkinD.text: An elite skin for the Lex.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EsteemOrthosSk.text: An elite skin for the Orthos.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EsteemOrthosSk.zhText: 欧特鲁斯 玛瑙外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EsteemTigrisSk.text: An elite skin for the Tigris.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EventSigilZorb.text: Show your dedication to the truth of Aspirant Zorba with this sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EventSigilZorb.zhText: 用这个纹章来展示你对见习仲裁者左巴真理的忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroArcaAr.text: For no discernable reason, this armor produces a distinct feeling of unease in enemies, as well as the wearer.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroArcaAr.zhText: 这套护甲莫名其妙地让敌人与配戴者都感到一种强烈的不安。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroArmorA.text: An unnervingly familiar shoulder plate that calls to mind the regalia of a doomed court.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroArmorA.zhText: 一个令人回想起就不寒而栗的肩甲，让人联想到一个注定覆灭的宫廷的礼服。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroSekhar.text: This forbidding sekhara marks the wearer as one touched by echoes of the future.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroSekhar.zhText: 这个威严的饰冠，代表着佩戴者已被未来的回响所触动。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroSugatr.text: This intricately knotted sugatra may have adorned the weapons of the Queen's Guard in a not-so-distant future.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/EvilBaroSugatr.zhText: 这种精巧的绳结坠饰或许会在不久的将来成为女皇护卫的武器上的装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExcaliburDelux.text: The skull of a monstrous Kubrodon Incarnadine was made into this, Excalibur Zato's prize shoulder plate. The story behind the taking of this particular trophy remains a mystery.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExcaliburDelux.zhText: 这个骇人的血红库狛顿头骨作为战利品被制成了 Excalibur 盲侠的肩甲。这个战利品背后的故事仍然是个谜。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExcaliburDelux.text: This meditation-bead Sugatra is a signature adornment of Excalibur Zato.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExcaliburDelux.zhText: 这款冥想珠串坠饰是 Excalibur 盲侠的标志性饰物。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExcaliburUmbra.text: Umbra Therion helmet for the Excalibur Warframe
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExcaliburUmbra.zhText: 给 Excalibur 使用的 Umbra 野兽头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExilisSentinel.text: Investigate in style with this bronzed Elixis skin for the Helios.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExilisSentinel.zhText: 为赫利俄斯披上这款古铜色外观，在调查时尽显风采。
赫利俄斯 镀铜外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExtraOperatorS.text: Open up an enticing array of radical new artificial skin colors using Refacia. Includes imitation Orokin Blue!
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ExtraOperatorS.zhText: 使用瑞翡霞肤颜包开启一系列柔美动人的全新仿真肤色，比如仿奥罗金蓝！

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FairyDefaultSk.text: The standard issue skin for the Titania Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralCatbrowPa.text: A kavat pattern ideal for the nighttime hunt.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralCatbrowPa.zhText: 一种适合夜间狩猎的库娃花纹。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralCatbrowPa.text: A kavat pattern ideal for the nighttime hunt.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralCatbrowPa.zhText: 一种适合夜间狩猎的库娃花纹。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralKubrowPac.text: First silence, then the snapping of a twig, then death.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralKubrowPac.zhText: 先是寂静无声，后是树枝折断的声音，再后就是死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralKubrowPat.text: First silence, then the snapping of a twig, then death.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FeralKubrowPat.zhText: 先是寂静无声，后是树枝折断的声音，再后就是死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FocusSchoolFac.text: Represent your Focus School with this distinctive facial paint.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FocusSchoolFac.zhText: 用这款独特的脸部彩绘，展现你所属专精学派的风采。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FrostDefaultSk.text: The standard issue skin for the Frost Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FrostDeluxeGre.text: Brandish this mythical frozen blade, the signature weapon of Frost Harka.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FrostDeluxeGre.zhText: 舞动这柄神秘的冰洁之刃，是 Frost 寒地牛怪外观的标志性武器。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FrostPrimeDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Frost Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FrostPrimeDefa.zhText: Frost Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FrumentariusAg.text: The Agile Animation Set for Cyte-09.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FrumentariusNo.text: The Noble Animation Set for Cyte-09.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FurisArmourDes.text: Streamlined decorative armor in the style of the Furis and Sybaris.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/FurisArmourDes.zhText: 流线的装饰性护甲，与盗贼和席芭莉丝有着同样的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraDeluxeSyan.text: Panes of polished glass complete this elegant Syandana. Like Gara herself, it is less fragile than it looks.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraDeluxeSyan.zhText: 抛光的玻璃让这件优雅的披饰更加完美。就像 Gara 她本人一样，它并不像看上去的那样脆弱。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraPrimeDefau.text: The standard issue skin for the Gara Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraPrimeDefau.zhText: Gara Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraUnlockAgil.text: This item lets you use Gara's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraUnlockAgil.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Gara 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraUnlockNobl.text: This item lets you use Gara's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaraUnlockNobl.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Gara 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaAgileAni.text: The Agile Animation Set for Garuda.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaAltHelmD.text: What was once myth is now real, hand outstretched to claim that which runs within you. An alternate helmet for Garuda.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaAltHelmD.zhText: 昔日的传说已成为现实，敞开双手接受真实的自己吧。Garuda 的替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaCapeDesc.text: Flows like grace. Flows like blood. An asymmetrical, stain-resistant Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaCapeDesc.zhText: 飘姿秀逸、淌若鲜血。一款可防渍的非对称披饰

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaNobleAni.text: The Noble Animation Set for Garuda.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaUnlockAg.text: This item lets you use Garuda's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaUnlockAg.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Garuda 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaUnlockNo.text: This item lets you use Garuda's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GarudaUnlockNo.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Garuda 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GausLeverianAl.text: In this skin, your Sentinel will be indistinguishable from the air sentries that guarded the ancient tower of Altra, as described by Drusus Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GausLeverianAl.zhText: 装备这款外观后，你的守护将与德枢·莱弗所描述的守卫在古老阿尔特拉塔的空中哨兵难以区分。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaussDeluxeSya.text: Gauss Kresnik’s signature Syandana proves he can stand the heat.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GaussDeluxeSya.zhText: Gauss 火神的标志性披饰证明他可以承受住高温的考验。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GeodeAgileAnim.text: The Agile Animation Set for Citrine.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GeodeNobleAnim.text: The Noble Animation Set for Citrine.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GlassDefaultSk.text: The standard issue skin for the Gara Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GlassmakerEmbl.text: An emblem commemorating your grim descent into the madness of the Glassmaker.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GlassmakerEmbl.zhText: 一枚纪念你冷酷坠入玻璃匠疯狂深渊的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrendelArchwin.text: This alternative look for any Archwing is modeled on the exo-sac levitators that the glutton Karissh used to support his additional grafted-on stomachs.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrendelArchwin.zhText: 这款能让任何曲翼装备的替代外观，是仿照饕餮之徒卡里什用来支撑其额外植入的胃部外囊悬浮器而设计的。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrineerVHArmou.text: Grineer plate, trophies from battle on the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrineerVHArmou.zhText: Grineer 装甲板，来自夜灵平野的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrineerVHCapeD.text: Victory over the Grineer, draped across your shoulders.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrineerVHCapeD.zhText: 战胜 Grineer 的象征，披挂在你的肩膀。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisArmou.text: Repurposed paramilitary dress, for a fast response to any situation.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisArmou.zhText: 重新设计的准军事服装，以快速应对任何情况。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisKavat.text: A sleek, molded bodyglove, enhanced with piezo-electric detailing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisKavat.zhText: 一个光滑的、模式化的连体服，有着压电式的细节增强。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisKubro.text: A sleek, molded bodyglove, enhanced with piezo-electric detailing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisKubro.zhText: 一个光滑的、模式化的连体服，有着压电式的细节增强。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisScarf.text: A syandana assembled from the scavenged internals of some unidentified mechanism, it is still dusty from the desert where it was found.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnAmphisScarf.zhText: 这是一个由一些未被识别的机械内部残骸组装而成的披饰，它依然沾染着从它被发现之地带来的沙砾。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnFaceMaskArm.text: Cobbled together from vanquished Grineer, this Steel Meridian armor sends a clear message to the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnFaceMaskArm.zhText: 由击败的 Grineer 拼凑而成，这具钢铁防线的护甲向敌人送去了清晰的警示。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnHoodedCapeD.text: Once worn by an elegant Elder Queen, before time and disease left her body mangled and disfigured.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnHoodedCapeD.zhText: 在身体被时间与疾病给折磨到残破不堪以前，优雅的大女皇曾穿着这件斗篷。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnQueenScarfD.text: Symbolizing the corrupting power of the Grineer Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnQueenScarfD.zhText: 象征了 Grineer 双子女皇的腐化力量。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnQueensMelee.text: Ripped from the blade of a fallen Kuva Guardian.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnQueensMelee.zhText: 取自于战败赤毒守卫者的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnSteelMeridi.text: Pieced together from salvage, this ad hoc armor set is signature to the Grineer renegades of Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnSteelMeridi.zhText: 这套特别的护甲由残骸拼接打造而成，是钢铁防线 Grineer 反叛者的标志性护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnStrapsScarf.text: Fashioned with spare field components this cloak is an example of rarely seen creativity within the Grineer ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GrnStrapsScarf.zhText: 这件由备用的战备零件打造而成的斗篷可是 Grinneer 兵队中罕见的创造性的例证之一。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GyreAgileAnims.text: The Agile Animation Set for Gyre.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GyreDeluxeArmo.text: Experimental Vortengeist technology spawned many curious calibrators and dispersion probes.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GyreDeluxeArmo.zhText: 实验性的电涡幽灵技术催生了许多令人好奇的校准器和色散探头。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/GyreNobleAnims.text: The Noble Animation Set for Gyre.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Excali.text: Floppy locks, for a classic 90s Emo look.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Excali.zhText: 随性飘逸的发型，呈现经典的 90 年代 Emo 风格。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999FrostD.text: Casual. Cool. Velimir's signature hairstyle is no muss, no fuss.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999FrostD.zhText: 维利米尔的标志性发型简洁利落。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Harrow.text: Hair is vanity. Lyon’s signature style is the ultimate in low maintenance.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Harrow.zhText: 头发不过是虚荣的象征。里昂的标志性发型堪称极致的免打理之选。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999LoidDe.text: The elegant, well-maintained tresses of a gentleman's gentleman.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999LoidDe.zhText: 优雅且精心打理，尽显绅士风范的秀发。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999MagDes.text: Aoi's daring, angular cut, the apex of street style.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999MagDes.zhText: 碧的大胆、棱角分明的发型，是街头风格的巅峰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999NovaDe.text: The messy bun of a genius with far more important things to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999NovaDe.zhText: 天才的凌乱丸子头，因为有更重要的事要操心。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999NyxDes.text: Eleanor's signature flowing locks, tightly bound up.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999NyxDes.zhText: 埃莉诺的标志性飘逸长发，紧紧束起。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Quincy.text: Braids and beads embody the marksman's pride.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Quincy.zhText: 发辫和珠饰彰显射手的骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Rusalk.text: Major Rusalka's splendid hair, carefully plaited to keep it from entangling in her mechanical arm.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Rusalk.zhText: 鲁莎卡少校的美丽秀发，被精心编织起来，以免缠住她的机械臂。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999SarynD.text: Stay stylish even during the worst of international incidents.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999SarynD.zhText: 即使在最严重的国际事件中，也要保持时尚。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Temple.text: Blow their minds with Flare’s signature hairstyle.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Temple.zhText: 用弗莱尔的标志性发型让他们大吃一惊。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999Trinit.zhText: 莱蒂的经典复古庞巴杜发型。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999UrielD.text: Only the most elite of Orokin could afford the time, and expense, of this intricate beaded style.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999UrielD.zhText: 只有奥罗金最精英阶层才能负担起得起这种复杂串珠风格所需的时间和费用。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999VoltDe.text: For that 'couldn't sleep, too wired' look.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999VoltDe.zhText: 打造"睡不着，太亢奋"的造型。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999WispDe.text: The wispy tresses of Marie’s signature style are rarely seen, but no less intricate for it.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Hair1999WispDe.zhText: 玛丽标志性的飘逸长发很少见，但即便如此，其精致程度也毫不逊色。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Halloween2023D.zhText: 一件令人毛骨悚然的节庆风格披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HarrowDeluxeAr.text: As melancholy and beautiful as the glow of a distant sun, Etheria Armor is the suitable accoutrement for a traveler between worlds who is resident of none. A signature set of armor for Harrow Reliquary.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HarrowDeluxeAr.zhText: 如一个遥远太阳的光芒般抑郁且漂亮，以希利亚护甲是一个穿梭于世界之间并居无定所的旅人最合适的装备。Harrow 圣骨匣的一套标志性护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HelminthPetPat.text: A degenerated strain of the Helminth Charger.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HelminthPetPat.zhText: 一种退化的 Helminth 疾冲者品种
Helminth 退化样式 花纹

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeA.text: A master-crafted weapon, forged in fire for the hands of heroes - yet worthy of a goddess. Bestow this skin upon any Heavy Blade weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeA.zhText: 一件大师级武器，为英雄之手于火中锻造而成——但也配得上一介女神。此外观可授予任何巨刃武器使用。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeB.text: A Balefire Charger skin to match the Hildryn Einheri skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeB.zhText: 与 Hildryn 英灵外观相配的野火充能外观。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeH.text: Descend from on high as the legend that Hildryn truly is. A skin that ensures her legend will echo down the ages. Strength and glory!
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeH.zhText: 像真正传说中的 Hildryn 一样从高处降临。一款确保她的传奇故事能在岁月中回响的外观。传承着力量与荣耀！

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeS.text: Descend from on high as the legend that Hildryn truly is. A skin that ensures her legend will echo down the ages. Strength and glory!
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeS.zhText: 像真正传说中的 Hildryn 一样从高处降临。一款确保她的传奇故事能在岁月中回响的外观。传承着力量与荣耀！

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeS.text: The sun rises on the victor and sets upon the vanquished. This is how your legend is made. Adorn yourself with this exquisite syandana, worthy of the sun herself.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HildrynDeluxeS.zhText: 太阳在胜利者上升起，在被征服者身上落下。这就是你传说的诞生之处。用这个精致的披饰装点自己，无愧于太阳本身。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HoodAdultDesc.text: A ragged old cloth hood and leather mask worn by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HoodAdultDesc.zhText: 漂泊者所穿的破旧布制头罩和皮制面具。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HoodAdultGrine.text: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer face shield and hood. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HoodAdultGrine.zhText: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵面罩和兜帽深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HopliteAgileAn.text: The Agile Animation Set for Styanax.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HopliteNobleAn.text: The Noble Animation Set for Styanax.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HydroidDefault.text: The standard issue skin for the Hydroid Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HydroidPrimeDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Hydroid Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/HydroidPrimeDe.zhText: Hydroid Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IceSpikeCapeDe.text: Jagged, crystalline spikes crown a shroud of snowy mist in this ice themed syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IceSpikeCapeDe.zhText: 在这款以冰为主题的披饰中，参差不齐的冰晶尖刺外笼罩着一层雪雾。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InarosDeluxeSc.text: The signature syandana of Inaros Ramses.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InarosDeluxeSc.zhText: Inaros 拉美西斯的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Inf1999ArmourD.text: Get the look of Techrot without catching a nasty, life-destroying infection.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Inf1999ArmourD.zhText: 科腐者风格的外观，但没有那令人厌恶的致命感染。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfBatCapeDesc.text: Bring forth the look of your inner beast.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfBatMaskDesc.text: A deliciously nightmarish mask for your Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfBatMaskDesc.zhText: 一款诱人而可怕的守护面具。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfBatTailDesc.text: A deliciously nightmarish tail for your Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfBatTailDesc.zhText: 一款诱人而可怕的守护尾部。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfBatWingsDes.text: Deliciously nightmarish wings for your Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfBatWingsDes.zhText: 诱人而可怕的守护飞翼。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfCoralSyanda.text: Pulsing with a bioluminescent glow, this syandana is eye-catchingly contagious.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfCoralSyanda.zhText: 散发着律动般的生物冷光，这款披饰有着引人注目的感染力。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfEmbolistArm.text: Calcified flesh creates forms of grotesque beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfEmbolistArm.zhText: 钙化的肉体创造出了怪异的美感。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfEmbolistArm.text: Calcified flesh creates forms of grotesque beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfEmbolistArm.zhText: 钙化的肉体创造出了怪异的美感。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfEmbolistArm.zhText: 钙化的肉体创造出了怪异的美感。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfGrnWolfShou.text: Nothing strikes fear into your enemies like the fusion of beast and Infestation draped upon your shoulder.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfGrnWolfShou.zhText: 没有什么比肩上野兽与感染者的融合更能让你敌人感到恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfMembraneCap.text: Chitin, cartilage and nectar. This Infested Syandana once twitched with unsettling life.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfMembraneCap.zhText: 几丁质、软骨组织，以及花蜜。这件感染披饰曾经发出让人不安的抖动。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfNightwaveMa.text: A mask attachment for your Sentinel pet.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfNightwaveTa.text: A stylish tail attachment for your Sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfNightwaveTa.zhText: 守护宠物的时髦尾部配件。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfNightwaveWi.text: A pair of wings for your Sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfNightwaveWi.zhText: 给守护宠物的一对飞翼。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfScarfRibCag.text: A sinuous spine of Infested anatomy.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfScarfRibCag.zhText: 感染者解剖后的弯曲脊椎。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfShellSugatr.text: This Infested sugatra is a benign cellular growth self-protected by chitinous plates.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfShellSugatr.zhText: 这件感染坠饰是一个被几丁质甲壳所包裹的良性细胞组织。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfTentacleSca.text: A crown of bone spawns a mass of writhing, meaty, Infested tentacles.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfTentacleSca.zhText: 一件骨盔上恣意生长着扭曲、多肉的感染触手。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestationDef.text: The standard issue skin for the Nidus Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedCritte.text: The natural pattern of the Deimos Vulpaphyla.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedCritte.zhText: 火卫二狐帕菲拉的天然花纹。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedMeleeD.text: Fashion elites across the system are discovering the sophisticated style of benign mutalist growths. Equip this undulating sugatra and find out what you're missing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedMeleeD.zhText: 时尚精英们正在星系中持续发掘良性异融主义的复杂成长方式。装备这个波状的坠饰，看看你还缺少什么。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedPredat.text: The natural pattern of the Deimos Predasite.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedPredat.zhText: 火卫二扑猎达赛的天然花纹。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedShould.text: A benign Infestation existing symbiotically with its host.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InfestedShould.zhText: 与宿主共生的良性感染组织。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InkblotAgileAn.text: The Agile Animation Set for Follie.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/InkblotNobleAn.text: The Noble Animation Set for Follie.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameAgile.text: The Agile Animation Set for Hildryn.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameAltHe.text: The battle-visage of a formidable warrior. Inscrutable as a monolith, implacable as a hammer-blow.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameAltHe.zhText: 一位强大战士的战斗面貌。像巨石一般不可思议，像锤击一样毫不宽容。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameNoble.text: The Noble Animation Set for Hildryn.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameUnloc.text: This item lets you use Hildryn's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameUnloc.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Hildryn 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameUnloc.text: This item lets you use Hildryn's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IronFrameUnloc.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Hildryn 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ItzalArmourDes.text: Take to the skies with this Itzal Archwing inspired armor.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ItzalArmourDes.zhText: 让这款受刺影曲翼启发的护甲伴你冲上云霄。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IvaraDeluxeSca.text: The signature syandana of Ivara Skathi.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IvaraDeluxeSca.zhText: Ivara 冬之女神的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IvaraPrimeDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Ivara Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/IvaraPrimeDefa.zhText: Ivara Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeAxaArmourC.text: Next-generation chest plate for your Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeAxaArmourL.text: Next-generation leg plates for your Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeCarrierDes.text: A next-generation skin for the Carrier.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeDethcubeDe.text: A next-generation skin for the Dethcube.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeDethcubeDe.zhText: 死亡魔方的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeDethcubeNa.zhText: 死亡魔方 翡翠外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeEmblemDesc.text: An emblem available to clan members who kept Jade's Volatile Motes out of the hands of Parvos Granum in Operation: Belly of the Beast.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeEmblemDesc.zhText: 一枚颁发给在《行动代号：兽之腹》中，成功阻止了 Jade 的不稳定微粒落入帕尔沃斯·格拉努之手的氏族成员的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeInfestedWi.text: A pair of next-generation wings for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeInfestedWi.zhText: 一对适合你守护的次世代飞翼。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeLightEphem.text: Pay tribute to Jade and mark the battle of Operation Belly of the Beast with this transcendent Ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeLightEphem.zhText: 用个超凡的幻纹来向 Jade 致敬，并纪念《行动代号：兽之腹》的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeLightEphem.text: An even more radiant evolution of the Aspirus Ephemera, created with vestiges over Jade's volatile motes.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeLightEphem.zhText: 由 Jade 不稳定微粒留下的痕迹所形成，是追梦幻纹更加耀眼的进化版本。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeLightEphem.text: The pinnacle version of this ephemera, signifying victory over Parvos Granum’s forces in Operation Belly of the Beast.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeLightEphem.zhText: 这是此幻纹的巅峰版本，象征着在《行动代号：兽之腹》中战胜帕尔沃斯·格拉努的军队。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeMeleeDangl.text: This exclusive sugatra is crisscrossed with an inlay of glowing jade.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeMeleeDangl.zhText: 这件专属的坠饰上交错镶嵌着发光的翡翠。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadePatikaMele.text: A cross of jade-green arcs elegantly across this Tenno styled sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadePatikaMele.zhText: 一个优雅地披挂在 Tenno 上具有交错翡翠弧光的坠饰

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeTonkorDesc.text: A next-generation skin for the Tonkor.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JadeTonkorDesc.zhText: 征服榴炮的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JaviExecutionH.text: The transmuter Javi was honored with this ceremonial hood on the day of his execution, in recognition of his Archimedean status.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/JaviExecutionH.zhText: 炼制术师哈维在他的行刑当日被赐予了这顶仪式头罩，以体现他的哲士地位。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourACUn.text: Attach this unit to remain cool in hot environments.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourACUn.zhText: 佩戴这个装置以在炎热的环境中保持凉爽。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourACUn.text: Attach this unit to remain cool in hot environments.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourACUn.zhText: 佩戴这个装置以在炎热的环境中保持凉爽。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourArid.text: This armor conjures up memories of red sand and dry wind.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourArid.zhText: 这款护甲唤起红沙和干风的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourArid.text: A soft protective layer is an advantage during long marches through cold, heat, and underbrush.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourArid.zhText: 在严寒、酷暑和灌木丛中行军时，柔软的保护层会是一个优势。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourCorp.text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourCorp.zhText: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourDama.zhText: 破碎是英勇过去的真实写照。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourStan.text: A venturous adaptation of traditional Grineer armor.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourStan.zhText: 一款大胆改装的传统 Grineer 护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourWint.text: This armor's thickness protects against the cold wind's bite.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlArmourWint.zhText: 这个护甲的厚度足以抵御寒风的侵袭。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchAD.text: Even one-eyed warriors will see clearly when they look through the lens of fortitude.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchAD.zhText: 即使是独眼战士，透过坚毅的镜片也能看得一清二楚。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchBD.text: An eye-guard for one who knows that those who demand fealty do not always deserve it.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchBD.zhText: 给那些懂得此道理的人的一款护眼，道理就是那些要求效忠的人并不是总值得效忠。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchCD.text: Show the grit of a resourceful warrior.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchCD.zhText: 展现一位足智多谋的战士的勇气。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchDD.text: A mask for those who like to settle things up close and personal.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlEyepatchDD.zhText: 适合那些喜欢私下动手解决事情之人的面具。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetCorp.text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetCorp.zhText: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetDama.zhText: 破碎是英勇过去的真实写照。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetHood.text: Those who fight in varied environments appreciate the versatility of this hooded helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetHood.zhText: 那些在不同环境中战斗的人喜欢这款连帽头盔的多功能性。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetKuva.text: A helmet for those who aren’t afraid to earn their place.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetKuva.zhText: 为那些不惜一切代价赢得一席之地的人准备的头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetMush.text: This helmet’s flat design is well-suited for sabotage.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetMush.zhText: 这款头盔的扁平化设计非常适合破坏活动。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetPith.text: Harsh environments have roughened this helmet’s surface.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetPith.zhText: 恶劣的环境使这顶头盔的表面变得粗糙。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetStan.text: A common helmet unifies Grineer brothers in arms.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetStan.zhText: 一顶共同的头盔让武装的 Grineer 兄弟们团结一心。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetWate.text: This helmet conjures up memories of red sand and dry wind.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KahlHelmetWate.zhText: 这顶头盔唤起红沙和干风的回忆。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KavatColorPack.text: Surviving records state the Deaeira Kavat strain was developed and much-favored by the Orokin. [Tenno's Best Friend Contest winner]
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KavatColorPack.zhText: 现存的记录表明，狄尔拉库娃种族是由奥罗金培育的，并深受其喜爱。[Tenno之友比赛冠军]
狄尔拉库娃基因伪装包

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraAgileAnim.text: The Agile Animation Set for Khora.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraDeluxeSya.text: The beauty of the orchid paired with the elegance of Tenno design. A signature Syandana for Khora.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraDeluxeSya.zhText: 兰花的美丽与 Tenno 设计的典雅相辅相成。Khora 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraNobleAnim.text: The Noble Animation Set for Khora.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraUnlockAgi.text: This item lets you use Khora's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraUnlockAgi.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Khora 的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraUnlockNob.text: This item lets you use Khora's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KhoraUnlockNob.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Khora 的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KiTeerSignaDes.text: This signa is a Ki'Teer original, the crowning glory of any collection.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KiTeerSignaDes.zhText: 这款 Ki'Teer 原创的头环，是他最耀眼的藏品。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroAkla.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, this battle-scarred Aklato has been transformed into an object of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroAkla.zhText: 用金色合金修复后，这把战痕累累的拉托双枪已经转化为一件优美的物件。
拉托双枪 金继外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroKuna.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, this battle-scarred Kunai has been transformed into an object of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroKuna.zhText: 用金色合金修复后，这把战痕累累的苦无已经转化为一件优美的物件。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroLato.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, this battle-scarred Lato has been transformed into an object of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroLato.zhText: 用金色合金修复后，这把战痕累累的拉托已经转化为一件优美的物件。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroPari.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, this battle-scarred Paris has been transformed into an object of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroPari.zhText: 用金色合金修复后，这把战痕累累的帕里斯已经转化为一件优美的物件。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroSkan.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, this battle-scarred Skana has been transformed into an object of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroSkan.zhText: 用金色合金修复后，这把战痕累累的空刃已经转化为一件优美的物件。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroStaf.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, this battle-scarred Bo has been transformed into an object of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroStaf.zhText: 用金色合金修复后，这把战痕累累的玻之武杖已经转化为一件优美的物件。
玻之武杖 金继外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroiBra.text: Repaired with golden-alloys, this battle-scarred Braton has been transformed into an object of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KintsukuroiBra.zhText: 用金色合金修复后，这把战痕累累的布莱顿已经转化为一件优美的物件。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KoumeiAgileAni.text: The Agile Animation Set for Koumei.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KoumeiNobleAni.text: The Noble Animation Set for Koumei.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowArmorGrn.text: Drahks are outfitted with this armor for the Queens' royal prisoner hunts.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowArmorGrn.zhText: 爪喀需穿戴上这套护甲来参与女皇的皇家猎囚活动。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowArmorPri.text: A bold set of Kubrow armor coated in delicate Prisma crystals.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowArmorPri.zhText: 一组崭新大胆、用精致棱晶制成的库狛护甲。
棱晶 洛斯塔姆库狛护甲

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowArmorUmb.text: Armor for a beast as loyal as any Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowArmorUmb.zhText: 跟任何禁卫一样忠诚的野兽所使用的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowColorPac.text: Fur pattern matching your Kubrow's Heino ancestors, from a gene-line preserved by Kubrow master Skvirl. [Tenno's Best Friend Contest winner]
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowColorPac.zhText: 与库狛的海诺祖先匹配的毛皮花纹，来自库狛大师 Skvirl 保存下来的一个基因序列 。[Tenno 之友比赛冠军]

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowPetPatte.text: The final evolution of the Helminth Charger.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KubrowPetPatte.zhText: Helminth 疾冲者的最终进化。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KullervoDeluxe.text: Once chains of binding guilt, now twisted into a defiant ornament. The signature Syandana of Kullervo Apostate.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KullervoDeluxe.zhText: 曾是束缚罪孽的锁链，如今扭曲成一个象征反抗的装饰物。这是 Kullervo 叛徒的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KuvaLichArmour.text: Grineer shoulder plates forged for a reborn Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KuvaLichArmour.zhText: 为一个重生的赤毒玄骸打造的 Grineer 肩甲

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KuvaLichArmour.text: A Grineer chest plate forged for a reborn Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KuvaLichArmour.zhText: 为一个重生的赤毒玄骸打造的 Grineer 胸甲

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KuvaLichArmour.text: Grineer leg plates forged for a reborn Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/KuvaLichArmour.zhText: 为一个重生的赤毒玄骸打造的 Grineer 腿甲

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNY2025KavatAr.text: Prepare your Kavat for a dance of Lunar Renewal revelry.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNY2025KavatAr.zhText: 准备好你的库娃，共舞迎新春。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNYBirdSugatra.text: In this Sugatra, the graceful embrace of two birds is a symbolic expression of renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNYBirdSugatra.zhText: 这件坠饰中两只优雅相拥的鸟恭贺着新春的到来。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNYCarpSugatra.text: A weapon decoration in the form of two circling carp.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNYCarpSugatra.zhText: 配备这款充满好运气息的近战武器饰物，共贺农历新春。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNYSnakeMeleeD.text: In this Sugatra, the elegant serpent weaves itself through gold like a sacred cord.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LNYSnakeMeleeD.zhText: 在这件坠饰中，优雅的灵蛇如同神圣的绳索盘绕在金饰上。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LasBackpackMed.text: Be prepared no matter where with everything you need for the long haul, including Drippy, the K.O.L. virtual assistant. "No need for waterworks, Drippy is here to help!"
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LasBackpackMed.zhText: 无论身在何处，都要准备好应对长期发展所需的一切，包括即时网虚拟助手滴答。"无需费力，滴答助你一臂之力！"
即时网滴答助攻战术披饰

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LasNightwaveCa.text: Only the most highly trained - or highly reckless - Scaldra dare to wear this portable Efervon container.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LasNightwaveCa.zhText: 只有训练有素——或者极其鲁莽——的炽蛇军才敢佩戴这种便携式艾弗旺容器。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LaurelHaloCrow.text: Radiate beauty with this laurel crown.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LaurelHaloCrow.zhText: 佩戴这顶月桂花冠，散发美丽光芒。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LavosAltHelmet.text: An alternate helmet for Lavos, emblematic of the master transmuter's search for wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LavosAltHelmet.zhText: Lavos 的替换头盔，象征着大师级炼制术师对智慧的追寻。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LavosDefaultSk.text: The standard issue skin for the Lavos Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LavosHelmetDes.text: The standard issue helmet for the Lavos Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LegacyHaloBadg.text: An emblem to honor all those who raised a blade in the mayhem of the Trials Missions.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LegacyHaloBadg.zhText: 一个尊荣在试炼任务的乱战中做出贡献者的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LeggingsAdultD.text: Ragged leather pants and boots worn by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LeggingsAdultD.zhText: 漂泊者所穿的破旧皮裤和靴子。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LeggingsAdultG.text: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer pants and boots. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LeggingsAdultG.zhText: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵裤装和靴子深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LichKillerBadg.text: The emblem of one who has bested an inhuman adversary born of the Old Blood: a Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LichKillerBadg.zhText: 获得此徽章者，战胜了诞生于《远古之血》的无人性对手：赤毒玄骸

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LimboDeluxeCap.text: A Syandana that dances upon the eddies of battle and void-currents alike.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LimboDeluxeCap.zhText: 一款在战场及虚空流电的旋涡上舞动的披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LimboDeluxeDan.text: This Sugatra has been seen adorning the weapons of myths and monsters alike, its provenance unknown.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LimboDeluxeDan.zhText: 这个坠饰曾作为装饰见于鬼怪传说中的武器上，然而其起源依然未知。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LimboPrimeDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Limbo Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LimboPrimeDefa.zhText: Limbo Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LisetScarfDesc.text: Take to the stars with this sleek Syandana. Strapping in feels just like home.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LisetScarfDesc.zhText: 带着这款柔滑的披饰前往各种行星。戴着它会有种如家的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LisetSkinRelay.text: A Liset pattern to celebrate the reconstruction of our lost relay.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LisetSkinRelay.zhText: 一个用以庆祝重建我们原来失去的中继站的 Liset 外观。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LokiDefaultSki.text: The standard issue skin for the Loki Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LokiPrimeDefau.text: The standard issue skin for the Loki Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/LokiPrimeDefau.zhText: Loki Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Lunar2022Kubro.text: Prepare your Kubrow for the dance of Lunar Renewal revelry with this ancient lion costume.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Lunar2022Kubro.zhText: 穿上这套古老的舞狮服装，让你的库狛准备好为迎接农历新年的狂欢献舞一曲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MaduraiArmourC.text: A badge sported by adherents of the Madurai School.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MaduraiArmourC.zhText: 一枚 Madurai 学派信徒所佩戴的胸章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MaduraiBadgeIt.text: A prestigious emblem for Tenno of the Madurai School.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MaduraiBadgeIt.zhText: 一枚赋予 Madurai 学派 Tenno 的声望徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MagDefaultSkin.text: The standard issue skin for the Mag Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MagDeluxeScarf.zhText: Mag 元气的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MagPrimeDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Mag Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MagPrimeDefaul.zhText: Mag Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MagicianDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Limbo Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MechEventEmble.text: An emblem for veterans of the Operation: Orphix Venom.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MechEventEmble.zhText: 授予《行动代号：奥影之毒》老兵的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MesaDeluxeSyan.text: Venture into uncharted territory with Mesa Presidio’s signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MesaDeluxeSyan.zhText: 佩戴 Mesa 边塞的标志性披饰前去未知的领域冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MesaPrimeDefau.text: The standard issue skin for the Mesa Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MesaPrimeDefau.zhText: Mesa Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Mirage Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeAg.text: The Agile Animation Set for Mirage Oneiro.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeHe.text: With this Harlequin-inspired helm, Mirage always has the last laugh.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeHe.zhText: 头戴这件灵感来自丑角的头盔，Mirage 总能笑到最后。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeNo.text: The Noble Animation Set for Mirage Oneiro.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeSk.text: Dance through dark dreams with this mischievous, Harlequin-inspired deluxe skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeSk.zhText: 身着这件灵感来自丑角的淘气豪华外观，来在黑暗梦境中翩翩起舞。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeSk.text:
Dance through dark dreams with this mischievous, Harlequin-inspired deluxe skin.

Includes Mirage Oneiro Agile and Noble animation sets.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MirageDeluxeSk.zhText:
身着这件灵感来自丑角的淘气豪华外观，来在黑暗梦境中翩翩起舞。

包含 Mirage 梦神迅捷站姿和尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MiragePrimeDef.text: The standard issue skin for the Mirage Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MiragePrimeDef.zhText: Mirage Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MixerKyroptera.text: An elite version of the Kyroptera Syandana.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MonkeyKingDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Wukong Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MoonWarfanSuga.text: A sugatra inspired by the moon’s elegance.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/MoonWarfanSuga.zhText: 灵感源自于月亮优雅外表的坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NLokaArmorDesc.text: Orchid patterns and flowing organic lines are signature to New Lokan armor.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NLokaArmorDesc.zhText: 兰花图案和流畅的有机线条是新世间护甲的标志。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NaberusEphemer.text: Spread the membranous wings of night with this haunting Ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NaberusEphemer.zhText: 用这款阴魂不散的幻纹来展开夜之翅膜。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NaramonArmourC.text: A badge sported by adherents of the Naramon School.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NaramonArmourC.zhText: 一枚 Naramon 学派信徒所佩戴的胸章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NaramonBadgeIt.text: A prestigious emblem for Tenno of the Naramon School.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NaramonBadgeIt.zhText: 一枚赋予 Naramon 学派 Tenno 的声望徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NecraArmorADes.text: From the depths of Deimos comes a shoulder plate hand-forged by the creator of the Necramechs.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NecraArmorADes.zhText: 来自火卫二的深处的肩甲，由殁世机甲的创造者手工锻造而成。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NecraArmorCDes.text: From the depths of Deimos comes a chest plate hand-forged by the creator of the Necramechs.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NecraArmorCDes.zhText: 来自火卫二的深处的胸甲，由殁世机甲的创造者手工锻造而成。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NecraArmorLDes.text: From the depths of Deimos comes a knee plate hand-forged by the creator of the Necramechs.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NecraArmorLDes.zhText: 来自火卫二的深处的膝甲，由殁世机甲的创造者手工锻造而成。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NefSyandanaDes.text: Flaunt wealth and prosperity with a constant stream of financial data.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NefSyandanaDes.zhText: 用这股持续不断的财政数据流来炫耀财富与昌盛。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NekrosDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Nekros Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NekrosDeluxeDa.text: The signature binds of Nekros Irkalla.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NekrosDeluxeDa.zhText: Nekros 伊卡拉的标志性枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NekrosDeluxeMe.text: The signature sugatra of Nekros Irkalla.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NekrosDeluxeMe.zhText: Nekros 伊卡拉的标志性坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NekrosPrimeDef.text: The standard issue skin for the Nekros Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NekrosPrimeDef.zhText: Nekros Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewPlayerXPArm.text: Augment your look with this subtle and sturdy armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewPlayerXPArm.zhText: 用这套精巧而坚固的护甲套装来提升你的造型。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewPlayerXPSug.text: This Sugatra catches the eye with its pale blue lights and metallic surfaces.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewPlayerXPSug.zhText: 这款坠饰可通过其淡蓝色的幽光和金属表面来引人注目。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewPlayerXPSya.text: An arcing syandana with refined highlights and distinctive technical elements.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewPlayerXPSya.zhText: 一款具有精致亮点与独特科技元素的弧形披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewWarGunblade.text: A gunblade skin inspired by the mighty Sentient Murex.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NewWarGunblade.zhText: 一款灵感来自于强大的 Sentient 骨螺战舰的枪刃外观。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NexusCatbrowPa.text: Customize a Kavat’s fur color with these isolated DNA sequences.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NexusCatbrowPa.zhText: 以这些分离的 DNA 序列来自定义库娃的毛色。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NexusCatbrowSk.text: A unique fur pattern for your Kavat.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NexusCatbrowSk.zhText: 给库娃使用的独特花纹。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/NezhaAlt2Helme.zhText: 给 Nezha 使用的头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.zhText: Sevagoth 格劳克斯幽影的标志性幽影之爪。
Sevagoth 格劳克斯幽影之爪

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.text: The signature helmet of Sevagoth Glaukus' Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.zhText: Sevagoth 格劳克斯幽影的标志性头盔。
Sevagoth 格劳克斯幽影头盔

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.text: Rail agents told of the legendary battle between Sevagoth Glaukus and Hydroid Rakkam. Agents looked on as the pair disappeared into the Void, locked in combat. Nobody knows how much of the old railer's tale is true.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.zhText: 航道特工讲述了 Sevagoth 格劳克斯和 Hydroid 逐波之间的传说战斗。特工们眼睁睁地看着两人在战斗中消失在虚空中。没人知道老航道特工的故事有多少是真的。
Sevagoth 格劳克斯幽影外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.text:
Rail agents told of the legendary battle between Sevagoth Glaukus and Hydroid Rakkam. Agents looked on as the pair disappeared into the Void, locked in combat. Nobody knows how much of the old railer's tale is true.

This skin features a custom Tombstone and Sevagoth's Lullaby, a custom song that plays for Sevagoth's Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.zhText:
航道特工讲述了 Sevagoth 格劳克斯和 Hydroid 逐波之间的传说战斗。特工们眼睁睁地看着两人在战斗中消失在虚空中。没人知道老航道特工的故事有多少是真的。

该外观包含一个可自定义的墓碑，以及一首为 Sevagoth 的幽影播放的自定义歌曲——Sevagoth 的安眠曲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.text: A weapon forged in the depths.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SevagothDeluxe.zhText: 一把锻造自深渊的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShadowgrapherE.text: Show your dedication to Operation: Atramentum with this emblem.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShadowgrapherE.zhText: 用这个徽章来展示你对《行动代号：墨痕》做出的贡献。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShadowgrapherE.text: Keep the memory of the Shadowgrapher and Operation: Atramentum close with this sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShadowgrapherE.zhText: 使用这个纹章铭记《绘影者》和《行动代号：墨痕》中的精彩回忆。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShieldFrameCap.text: A Syandana with kick, as robust as Hildryn herself.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShieldFrameCap.zhText: 够带劲的披饰，像 Hildryn 一样强壮。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorADe.text: Honor the Tenno legacy with this finely crafted set of training armor, as worn during the annual Origin System ceremonial games.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorADe.zhText: 通过这件精心打造的训练护甲来纪念 Tenno 的传统，就像一年一度的始源星系庆典中穿戴的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorBun.text: Honor the Tenno legacy with this finely crafted set of training armor, as worn during the annual Origin System ceremonial games.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorBun.zhText: 通过这件精心打造的训练护甲来纪念 Tenno 的传统，就像一年一度的始源星系庆典中穿戴的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorCDe.text: Honor the Tenno legacy with this finely crafted set of training armor, as worn during the annual Origin System ceremonial games.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorCDe.zhText: 通过这件精心打造的训练护甲来纪念 Tenno 的传统，就像一年一度的始源星系庆典中穿戴的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorLDe.text: Honor the Tenno legacy with this finely crafted set of training armor, as worn during the annual Origin System ceremonial games.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiArmorLDe.zhText: 通过这件精心打造的训练护甲来纪念 Tenno 的传统，就像一年一度的始源星系庆典中穿戴的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiLongswor.text: Give any longsword the appearance of a masterwork training weapon. A surface of lacquered wood and gold leaf may conceal a hard-biting edge.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ShinaiLongswor.zhText: 赋予任意一把长剑大师级的训练武器外观。漆木和金箔的表面下可能潜藏着锋利的剑刃。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SiriusOrionAgi.text: The Agile Animation Set for Sirius & Orion.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SiriusOrionNob.text: The Noble Animation Set for Sirius & Orion.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SkirtAdultCDes.text: Rugged gear, worn ragged by The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SkirtAdultCDes.zhText: 坚固的装备，已被漂泊者穿得破破烂烂。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SkirtAdultGrin.text: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer gear. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SkirtAdultGrin.zhText: 通过这件搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵装备深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SleevesAdultDe.text: Ragged sleeves and leather gloves worn by The Drifter
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SleevesAdultDe.zhText: 漂泊者所穿的破旧袖件和皮制手套。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SleevesAdultGr.text: Sneak behind enemy lines with this scavenged Grineer Lancer shoulder armor and gloves. Fitted for The Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SleevesAdultGr.zhText: 通过这些搜集来的 Grineer 枪兵肩甲和手套深入敌后。已为漂泊者量身修改。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SmokeEphemeraD.text: Emerge from the fog of war unscathed.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SmokeEphemeraD.zhText: 毫发无伤地从战争迷雾中现身。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SnowEphemeraDe.text: Become the heart of the winter, beneath a cloud of falling snow.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SnowEphemeraDe.zhText: 在一片雪花飘落的云朵下化作冬日之心。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolarisUnitedA.text: Repurposed and reliable, strap on Solaris armor and everything's green.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolarisUnitedA.zhText: 可靠且经过改造，穿上索拉里斯护甲，你就能一路畅通无阻。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolsticeFurisA.text: Avia Armor that has been adorned with a festive design.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolsticeFurisA.zhText: 装饰着节庆风格的飞空护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolsticeGrnHoo.text: A Kuva Cloak that has been adorned with a festive design.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolsticeGrnHoo.zhText: 装饰着节庆风格的赤毒斗篷。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolsticeU17Tno.text: An Izvara Syandana that has been adorned with a festive design.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SolsticeU17Tno.zhText: 一件拥有节庆独特设计的自在披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StalkerMedalDe.text: Before he became the Stalker, the Low Guardian Sorren was awarded this mark of valor and loyalty by his Orokin masters. Now, it is yours to claim in acknowledgment of the Orokin's downfall.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StalkerMedalDe.zhText: 低阶守卫索伦在成为追猎者之前，曾被他的奥罗金主人授予这个象征英勇和忠诚的标志。如今你可以认领它，来纪念奥罗金的覆灭。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StalkerShipDel.text: Transform your Landing Craft into a perfect match for Stalker’s.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StalkerShipDel.zhText: 将你的登陆艇改造成与追猎者完美匹配的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StalkerShoulde.text: Sport the grim tokens of one who hunts across worlds.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StalkerShoulde.zhText: 佩戴星际猎人的冷血标记。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryAklatoSk.text: Pay homage to the constellations with this brilliant Aklato skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryAklatoSk.zhText: 用这光辉的拉托双枪外观来向众星致敬。
拉托双枪 夜景外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryBratonSk.text: Pay homage to the constellations with this brilliant Braton skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryBratonSk.zhText: 用这光辉的布莱顿外观来向众星致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryKunaiSki.text: Pay homage to the constellations with this brilliant Kunai skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryKunaiSki.zhText: 用这光辉的苦无外观来向众星致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryLatoSkin.text: Pay homage to the constellations with this brilliant Lato skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryLatoSkin.zhText: 用这光辉的拉托外观来向众星致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryParisSki.text: Pay homage to the constellations with this brilliant Paris skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryParisSki.zhText: 用这光辉的帕里斯外观来向众星致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarrySkanaSki.text: Pay homage to the constellations with this brilliant Skana skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarrySkanaSki.zhText: 用这光辉的空刃外观来向众星致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryStaffSki.text: Pay homage to the constellations with this brilliant Bo skin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/StarryStaffSki.zhText: 用这光辉的玻之武杖外观来向众星致敬。
玻之武杖 夜景外观

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Sugotchi1999Me.text: Outfit your weapons with 1999’s hottest toy.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Sugotchi1999Me.zhText: 用 1999 年最热门的玩具来装点你的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SundialArmorDe.text: Guide your style with this complete Lodestar armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/SundialArmorDe.zhText: 用这完整的一套北极星护甲来指引你的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TC2025ScarfDes.text: This flowing cape transitions into its tattered Void-swept form when the TennoCon Riftguard Emote is used. Created to celebrate ten years of TennoCon in 2025.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TC2025ScarfDes.zhText: 使用 TennoCon 裂隙护卫表情动作时，这件飘逸的斗篷会化为残破的虚空侵蚀形态。为庆祝 2025 年 TennoCon 十周年而创作。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TC2025ScarfEvo.text: This Void-swept cape transitions into its normal form when the TennoCon Riftguard Emote is used. Created to celebrate the tenth anniversary of Tennocon.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TC2025ScarfEvo.zhText: 使用 TennoCon 裂隙护卫表情动作时，这件被虚空侵蚀的斗篷会化为正常形态。为庆祝 TennoCon 十周年而创作。
TennoCon 裂隙护卫披饰（虚空侵蚀）

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TatsuSkullEphe.text: Surround yourself with the echoes of the fallen - earned on the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TatsuSkullEphe.zhText: 亡者的余音在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TempleAgileAni.text: The Agile Animation Set for Temple.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TempleNobleAni.text: The Noble Animation Set for Temple.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TenYearAnniver.text: An emblem to commemorate ten years of Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TenYearAnniver.zhText: Warframe 十周年纪念的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TenguDefaultSk.text: The standard issue skin for the Zephyr Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TenguDeluxeAgi.text: The Agile Animation Set for Zephyr Harrier.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TenguDeluxeNob.text: The Noble Animation Set for Zephyr Harrier.

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TennoCon2022Me.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TennoCon2022Me.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2017Sc.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2017.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2017Sc.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2017 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2018Ar.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2018.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2018Ar.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2018 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2019Ar.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2019.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2019Ar.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2019 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2020Sc.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2020.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2020Sc.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2020 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2021Ar.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2021.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2021Ar.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2021 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2021Ep.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2021.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2021Ep.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2021 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2022Ar.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2022Ar.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2023Sc.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2023.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2023Sc.zhText: 赐予那些参与 TennoCon 2023 欢庆的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2024Sc.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2024.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2024Sc.zhText: 授予那些参与 TennoCon 2024 欢庆的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2025Ba.text: Remember the very first TennoCon with this replica bandana facial accessory for the Operator. Created to celebrate ten years of TennoCon in 2025.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennocon2025Ba.zhText: 用这款为指挥官设计的复刻版头巾脸部装饰来纪念首届 TennoCon。为庆祝 2025 年 TennoCon 十周年而创作。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennogen10Year.text: Show your support for TennoGen Artists with this emblem.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/Tennogen10Year.zhText: 用这个徽章来表达你对 TennoGen 艺术家的支持。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ThanotechSenti.text: Necraloids insist upon using archaic but reliable Entrati technology, in preference to anything more modern.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ThanotechSenti.zhText: 殁世械灵坚持采用古老且可靠的英择谛技术，而不是任何更先进的技术。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ThanotechSenti.text: Necraloids take pride in keeping their medallion-embossed collars as clean and polished as they did when they were living servants.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ThanotechSenti.zhText: 殁世械灵引以为傲的是，他们的浮雕勋章项圈始终保持干净光洁，就像他们还活着的时候一样。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ThanotechSenti.text: All Necraloids can hover and maneuver with perfect poise.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/ThanotechSenti.zhText: 所有的殁世械灵都能以完美的姿态进行悬停和机动。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TileableTextur.text:
Hombask's material structures are imbued with the Zariman spirit of discovery and innovation.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TileableTextur.zhText:
霍姆巴斯的材质结构充满了「扎里曼号」探索、创新和友爱的精神。

材质结构为虚空之壳外观的专属物品。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TitaniaAltHelm.text: Muse. Mother. Queen. Rally your court with this alternate helm for Titania.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TitaniaAltHelm.zhText: 沉思。母亲。女王。用这件 Titania 的替换头盔提振士气。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TitaniaDeluxeI.text: A glowing syandana of the deadly night.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TitaniaDeluxeI.zhText: 一件致命之夜的发光披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TitaniaPrimeDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Titania Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TitaniaPrimeDe.zhText: Titania Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnAlchemistSya.text: Lavos' signature Syandana has been engineered for life in the lab and the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnAlchemistSya.zhText: Lavos 的标志性披饰经过精心设计，适用于实验室和战场的日常使用。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnBoltorKubrow.text: This Kubrow armor is believed to have been forged by the same Tenno weaponsmith who created the Boltor.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnBoltorKubrow.zhText: 这套库狛护甲据传是由创作出螺钉步枪的 Tenno 武器匠铸造的。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnBrokenFrameS.text: This techno-organic syandana fits over the shoulder, producing a unique, spiked silhouette.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnBrokenFrameS.zhText: 这件有机科技披饰与肩部贴合，勾勒出独特且又突出的轮廓。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnCeramicArmou.text: Harden any look with this ultra sleek composite ceramic armor.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnCeramicArmou.zhText: 以这套线条极为优美的复合陶瓷护甲来强化任何造型。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnConcreteFram.text: Qorvex's signature Syandana looks like stone but remains as light as it is stylish.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnConcreteFram.zhText: Qorvex 的标志性披饰看起来像石头，但却轻巧时尚。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnCurveArmourD.text: Broad swooping curves are the essence of the Nidina armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnCurveArmourD.zhText: 宽阔的曲线是尼迪纳护甲套装的精髓。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnGuandaoScarf.text: Windswept ribbons of crimson evoke the war-kites of ancient earth.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnGuandaoScarf.zhText: 迎风飘扬的绯红缎带唤起了对古老地球的战争风筝的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnHvArmourDesc.text: Styled to match the Baza submachine gun and the Cassowar polearm, this armor gives a regal look to any Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnHvArmourDesc.zhText: 这套护甲的设计风格跟苍鹰冲锋枪及鹤鸵长戟相配，赋予任何 Tenno 一股威严感。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnIceArmorDesc.text: Declare your cold fury and icy determination.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnIceArmorDesc.zhText: 展现你冷酷的怒火与冰冷的决心。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLargeCapeDes.text: This flowing Tenno cape is supported by an intricately sculpted brooch.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLargeCapeDes.zhText: 这款流畅的 Tenno 披饰由雕刻复杂的饰针支撑着。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLargeCapeTwi.text: Draw attention with the bold geometric patterns in this exclusive Broca Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLargeCapeTwi.zhText: 用这件专属的布洛卡披饰上大块的几何图案来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLefaucheuxSy.text: Tenno design at its finest. This classic syandana was inspired by the elegant drapery of the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLefaucheuxSy.zhText: Tenno 设计的杰出代表。这款经典披饰的灵感来自于奥罗金的优雅帷幔。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLotusRapierS.text: Unsheath your sword like a lotus in bloom.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnLotusRapierS.zhText: 如莲花绽放般抽出你的剑。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnMilitaryDual.text: One of the very first dual swords designed exclusively for Tenno use, thought to be commissioned by the House of Stavika.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnMilitaryDual.zhText: 最早专为 Tenno 设计的其中一对双剑，被认为是受斯塔维卡家族委托制造的。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnOctaviaDelux.text: Make a breathtaking entrance with the syncopated design of the Verismo Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnOctaviaDelux.zhText: 佩戴这款切分音设计的写实歌剧披饰来进行一次惊心动魄的登场。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnOdaliskSyand.text: A confident warrior strides into battle, but the truly brazen announce their presence with an ostentatious flourish. The Rhoptron is Protea's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnOdaliskSyand.zhText: 一位自信的勇士会大踏步迈入战斗，但真正的无耻之徒会以更浮夸的举动来宣告他们的存在。铃鼓是 Protea 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnOniSyandanaD.text: A most curious syandana, and one favored by the gallant gourmand, Grendel.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnOniSyandanaD.zhText: 一款造型别致的披饰，深受豪爽美食家 Grendel 的青睐。

/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnPagemasterAr.text: Armor reminiscent of gilded vellum pages.
/Lotus/Language/Cosmetics/TnPagemasterAr.zhText: 让人回想起镀金羊皮纸的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_CONN.zhText: 到问题诊断服务器的连接已丢失。

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_ENTE.text: Please tell us what you were doing when you encountered the problem.
/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_ENTE.zhText: 请告诉我们，在遇到这个问题的时候，您在执行什么操作。

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_ENTE.text: Please tell us what you were doing when you encountered the error.
/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_ENTE.zhText: 请告诉我们，在遇到这个错误的时候，你在执行什么操作。

抱歉，Tenno，Warframe 遇到了一个错误因而需要关闭。

你可以通过上报游戏崩溃来帮助我们的团队修复这个问题。
