Could not connect to the crash reporting server and no crash information was sent.

Contact support or post in our forums if you require additional assistance.
/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.zhText:
无法连接到崩溃报告服务器。游戏崩溃信息没有发送成功。

如果你需要额外的技术支持，请联系客服或把问题发布在我们的论坛上。

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.text: Good news! This issue has been resolved and the fix will be included with one of our upcoming updates. We appreciate your patience.
/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.zhText: 好消息！这个问题已得到解决，并且此修复程序将包含在我们即将发布的一个更新中。感谢您的耐心等候。

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.text: Thank you! We appreciate your patience and help in resolving this issue.
/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.zhText: 谢谢您！我们非常感谢您的耐心等候，以及协助我们解决这一问题。

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.text: For more information about this crash please see:
/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.zhText: 有关此崩溃的详细信息，请查看：

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.text: Please include the following bug number when contacting support:
/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_OUTR.zhText: 联系客服人员时，请附上下面的错误编号：

/Lotus/Language/CrashHandler/STRING_SUBM.zhText: 将问题提交至跟踪服务器……

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_1.zhText: 从贫苦的农家中招募而来。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_10.text: Impressed a visiting Arbiter with his insight when still young.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_10.zhText: 年轻时就因他的见解给来访的仲裁者留下了深刻印象。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_11.text: Trained in Preceptory of Hexis from boyhood.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_11.zhText: 从小就接受均衡仲裁者的戒律训练。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_12.text: Memorized the entire Dissertation on the Seven Principles.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_12.zhText: 已将《七项原则》里的所有论述背得滚瓜烂熟。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_13.text: Encountered a Tenno in his youth and believed himself blessed.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_13.zhText: 在他年轻的时候遇到了 Tenno，他相信自己是有福的。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_14.text: Rescued from Grineer attack by a Tenno; obsessed with them ever since.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_14.zhText: 被 Tenno 从 Grineer 的攻击中解救出来，从那以后就一直对他们着迷。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_15.text: Grew up immersed in legends of the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_15.zhText: 从小沉浸在 Tenno 的传说里。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_16.text: Believed by the Scholars of Hexis to be a reincarnated Arbiter of former times.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_16.zhText: 被均衡仲裁者的学者们认为是转生的前世仲裁者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_18.text: Placed in the care of the Arbiters of Hexis by his family when they could not afford to feed him.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_18.zhText: 在家人无力养活他的情况下，将他交由均衡仲裁者照顾。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_19.text: Attempted a pilgrimage across the entire System.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_19.zhText: 试图参拜漫游整个星系。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_2.text: Amazed the Scholars of Hexis by translating texts from an unknown language.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_2.zhText: 通过翻译不明语言的文本，让均衡仲裁者的学者们感到了震惊。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_20.text: Born under a supposedly auspicious stellar configuration.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_20.zhText: 出生在一个据称是祥瑞的恒星构造下。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_3.text: Condemned his own family as "impure" and abandoned them.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_3.zhText: 以"不纯洁"为由责备他自己的家人，并抛弃了他们。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_4.text: Travelled from settlement to settlement acting as an impartial judge.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_4.zhText: 曾作为一名公正的法官穿梭在定居点之间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_5.text: Reported disturbingly accurate dreams of the Orokin Era.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_5.zhText: 描述过奥罗金时代的梦境，精准的令人不安。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_6.text: Was rendered unconscious for three days after touching a 'shiny rock' that proved to be an Ayatan Star.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_6.zhText: 在触摸到一块被证明是阿耶檀识之星的"亮晶晶石头"后，昏迷了三天。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_7.text: Changed his name and renounced his entire former life to join the Arbiters.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_7.zhText: 改名换姓，放弃了以前的生活，加入仲裁者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_8.text: Presided over an Arbitration that left him haunted for the rest of his days.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_8.zhText: 主持过一场困扰他终生的仲裁。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_9.text: Was forced to reveal a Truth that humbled and degraded him.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_AH_M_9.zhText: 被迫揭露了一个让他感到自惭失色的真相。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_11.text: Fascinated from childhood with how things work.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_11.zhText: 从小就对事物的运作方式着迷。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_14.text: Discovered dormant in cryopod by salvage team.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_14.zhText: 休眠于冷冻舱中，由抢救队伍发现。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_15.text: Found wandering the Orb Vallis with apparent total memory loss.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_15.zhText: 被发现在奥布山谷徘徊，并且明显记忆完全丧失。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_16.text: Attempted to Cephalize self with disastrous results.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_16.zhText: 试图中枢化自己，结果以失败告终。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_17.text: Always related more to machines than to people.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_17.zhText: 与机器的关系总是比与人的关系要更密切。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_19.text: Relay worker, critically injured during Fomorian attack.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_19.zhText: 中继站工人，在巨人战舰攻击期间受重伤。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_2.text: Former Corpus technician; sustained brain injury during Tenno assault.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_2.zhText: 过去是 Corpus 技师，在 Tenno 的袭击中脑部受到了损伤。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_20.text: Attacked and left for dead by Grineer troops during raid.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_20.zhText: 在突袭中被 Grineer 部队攻击而奄奄一息，但侥幸留下了一条命。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_3.text: Suffered synaptic damage attempting to access the Weave unshielded.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_3.zhText: 试图以未屏蔽的方式进入织网，而遭受到了突触伤害。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_6.text: Former archaeologist, critically injured by Orokin Tower defence system.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_6.zhText: 过去是考古学家，被奥罗金塔的防御系统所重伤。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_7.text: Anthropologist forced to retire after unknown virus infection.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_7.zhText: 在感染不明病毒后被迫退休的人类学家。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_CS_F_9.zhText: 过去是相位烯能源实验室助理。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_NL_F_17.zhText: 过去是行星环境改造代理人。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_NL_F_19.zhText: 过去是 Corpus 工程师。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_PS_M_11.zhText: 在 Corpus 文化中长大。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_PS_M_12.zhText: 被剥夺了家族财产的继承权。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_PS_M_15.zhText: 因在指数之场投机而倾家荡产。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_PS_M_18.zhText: 过去是充满抱负的财务顾问。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_PS_M_6.zhText: 遵循道德的贸易爱好者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_13.zhText: 非官方的殖民地安全执法者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_16.zhText: 过去是六醇燃气平台的工人。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_17.text: Captured and imprisoned by Grineer; freed in Red Veil raid.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_17.zhText: 被 Grineer 捕获并囚禁，在血色面纱突袭中被释放。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_18.zhText: 自我激化的"星系防御者"。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_19.zhText: 过去是殖民地民兵成员。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_2.zhText: 过去是自由职业的沙漠刺客。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_3.zhText: 顽固不化的私法治安员。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_4.text: Suspected of assassinating mutliple Corpus oligarchs.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_4.zhText: 涉嫌暗杀多名 Corpus 执政者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_5.text: Suspected of assassinating multiple Grineer officers.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_5.zhText: 涉嫌暗杀多名 Grineer 军官。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_6.zhText: 在 Grineer 的袭击中成了孤儿。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_7.text: Family believed to be in debt bondage on Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_7.zhText: 他的家人据信是被债务困在了福尔图娜。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_9.text: Mistakenly targeted for assassination by Grineer; survived.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_RV_M_9.zhText: 被 Grineer 误认为是暗杀目标，死里逃生。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_1.text: Billeted among the Arid regiments of Mars.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_1.zhText: 曾在火星的沙漠军团驻扎过。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_11.text: Accidentally exposed to reactor runoff while in gestation tube.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_11.zhText: 在培养管里的时候不小心被暴露到了反应堆泄露中。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_12.text: Assigned to Tusk patrol on the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_12.zhText: 被分配到了夜灵平野的巨牙巡逻队。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_13.text: Assigned to Ceres within hours of being initially decanted.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_13.zhText: 在导出后的数小时内被分配到了谷神星。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_14.text: Served on security detail in the Saturn conflict zone.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_14.zhText: 在土星纷争区域担任安保人员。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_15.text: Cloned from a partially thawed gene batch following damage to storage system.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_15.zhText: 在存储系统受损后从部分解冻的基因批次中克隆而来。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_16.text: "Defective" genes deliberately introduced by unknown saboteur.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_16.zhText: 拥有由不明破坏者故意引入的"缺陷"基因。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_17.text: Assigned to Kuva Fortress as honor guard; demoted in 3 days for insubordination.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_17.zhText: 被分配到了赤毒要塞的仪仗队；随后在三天内因不服从命令而被降级。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_18.text: Cloned from gene templates recovered from bunker archive.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_18.zhText: 由从地堡档案中回收的基因模板克隆而来。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_19.text: Bred in high-security tube batch beneath the waters of Uranus.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_19.zhText: 繁殖于天王星水下的高安全性试管批次。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_2.text: One of many Grineer troops bred on Sedna within earshot of the Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_2.zhText: 是在塞德娜死亡角斗场附近被繁育出来的众多 Grineer 部队中的一员。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_20.text: Decanted from tube in the thick forests of Earth.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_20.zhText: 从地球密林中的试管内导出。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_3.text: Judged possibly defective shortly after decanting and considered for extermination.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_3.zhText: 导出后不久就被认定为可能有缺陷，并被考虑予以销毁。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_4.text: Decanted from salvaged tube by Steel Meridian sympathiser; partly indoctrinated; forcibly recovered by Grineer troops.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_4.zhText: 被充满同情心的钢铁防线成员从抢救到的试管里导出，但已受到了部分洗脑。后来被 Grineer 部队强行追回。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_5.text: Cloned from supposedly prime officer stock later discovered to have been sourced via Darvo Bek.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_5.zhText: 据说是从首要军官的库存中克隆而来，后来发现是通过 Darvo Bek 采购的。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_6.text: Aced Officer training; showed no initial sign of resisting Queens command.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_6.zhText: 出色通过了军官培训；初期没有表现出违抗女皇命令的迹象。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_7.text: Stood guard over Kuva Fortress tissue dissolution and nutrient paste preparation facility.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_7.zhText: 过去守卫着赤毒要塞的组织溶解和营养膏制备设施。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_8.text: Bred in amniotic cloning tube later found to have been compromised by Tenno incursion.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_8.zhText: 繁殖于受到了 Tenno 入侵影响的羊膜克隆试管。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_9.text: Completed multiple tours of duty with no outward sign of defectiveness.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H1_SM_F_9.zhText: 完成了多次使命，没有任何关于缺陷的外在迹象。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_1.text: Had to choose between Truth and Love, and chose Truth.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_1.zhText: 不得不在真理和爱之间做出选择，他最终选择了真理。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_10.text: Discovered that a person in whom he had placed complete trust was unworthy of it, and never fully recovered.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_10.zhText: 发现一个他完全信任的人原来不值得信任，并在此后一蹶不振。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_11.text: Almost died from a fever in which he suffered nightmarish hallucinations.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_11.zhText: 差点死于一场带给他噩梦般幻觉的发烧。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_12.text: Is beginning to grow weary of the fight to purge the System.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_12.zhText: 对净化星系的战斗开始感到厌倦。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_13.text: Refused a settled Seat of Judgement in favor of a life of travel, bringing Arbitration to the System.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_13.zhText: 拒绝了一份安定的审判席位，而是选择了终身旅行，来把仲裁引入到星系。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_14.text: Condemned an innocent after hearing false testimony and has never forgiven himself.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_14.zhText: 在听了伪证后而判了一个无辜者有罪，他从未原谅自己。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_15.text: Spent a month living beside a waterfall and living off raw Murkray liver, the better to hear the voice of Truth within.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_15.zhText: 曾花了一整个月住在瀑布边，并以阴暗鳐肝脏为食，只为了能更好地听到本质真理的声音。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_16.text: Has spent years in the Hexis archive, reading nothing but sacred texts, living on only bread and fermented hoffka.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_16.zhText: 在均衡仲裁者档案馆里呆了许多年，只读圣典，仅靠面包和发酵的霍夫卡度日。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_2.text: Spent his life in pursuit of a holy vision, but has not yet achieved it.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_2.zhText: 穷尽一生追求神圣的愿景，但尚未实现。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_3.text: Entered an Orokin ruin and was never the same again.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_3.zhText: 他进入过一处奥罗金遗迹，之后就再也变不回曾经的自己了。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_4.text: Was forced to pass sentence on his own beloved mentor, and sometimes doubts the rightness of his actions.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_4.zhText: 被迫对自己心爱的导师进行了宣判，有时会怀疑自己行为的正确性。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_5.text: Went missing from the Preceptory and was discovered five years later, delirious and raving, wearing only animal skins.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_5.zhText: 从均衡仲裁者中失踪，五年后被发现，神志不清，胡言乱语，只穿兽皮。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_6.text: Defended his Preceptory against the Infestation along with the rest of the initiates. Was the sole survivor.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_6.zhText: 曾与其他新入会的同修一起抵抗感染者的入侵并保卫圣所。只有他自己幸存了下来。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_7.text: Believes he has been chosen for some great duty and is waiting for the Universe to tell him what it is.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_7.zhText: 深信自己被选中履行某些重要职责，并且一直在等待宇宙告知他要做什么。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_8.text: Accidentally tore a page of the Pronouncements of Hexis while taking his initiatory oath and has lived with crushing guilt ever since.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_8.zhText: 在入团宣誓时，不小心撕掉了一页《均衡宣言》；此后一直内心充满愧疚地生活着。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_9.text: Joined the Arbiters of Hexis with seven companions but was the only one to persist through all of the trials of full initiation.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_AH_M_9.zhText: 和七个同伴一起加入了均衡仲裁者，但他是唯一在入团试炼中坚持下来的人。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_1.text: Volunteered for Cephalon Suda's brain augmentation program.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_1.zhText: 志愿参加了中枢苏达的脑力增强计划。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_10.text: Contacted by Cephalon Suda and offered researcher role.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_10.zhText: 由中枢苏达亲自联系并受邀出任研究员。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_11.text: Received bodily and mental augmentation from Cephalon Suda.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_11.zhText: 从中枢苏达那里获得了的身体和精神上的强化。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_12.text: Offered services to Cephalon Suda in exchange for augmentation.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_12.zhText: 效忠于中枢苏达以获得强化。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_13.text: Fitted with brainstem datalink in the Suda hub.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_13.zhText: 在中枢苏达集团中配备有脑干数据链。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_14.text: Selected for Cephalon Suda operative duty and offered augmentation package; accepted.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_14.zhText: 被选为了中枢苏达的特工并被提供了强化礼包，她选择接受了这一提议。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_15.text: Enrolled in Cephalon Suda's field operative program.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_15.zhText: 参与了中枢苏达的现场特派员项目。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_16.text: Invited to Cephalon Suda's knowledge-sharing seminars, and soon affiliated.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_16.zhText: 曾受邀参加了中枢苏达的知识共享研讨会，随后不久就加入了该集团。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_2.text: Impressed Cephalon Suda by making contact with her remotely through the Weave, and was recruited.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_2.zhText: 通过在织网里远程与中枢苏达取得了联系，而给中枢苏达留下了深刻的印象；随后就被中枢苏达招募了。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_3.text: Rapidly promoted from Cephalon Suda Junior Info Scout to full Operative and duly augmented.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_3.zhText: 她在中枢苏达集团中，迅速从初级侦察员晋升为了正式特工，并得到了适当的强化。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_4.text: Solved complex puzzles planted by Cephalon Suda as a recruitment tool; was duly contacted, recruited and augmented.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_4.zhText: 解出了中枢苏达设置为招募考验的复杂谜题，随后被适时联系、招募，并获得了强化。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_5.text: Accepted near-total physical reconstruction as a benefit of affiliation to Cephalon Suda.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_5.zhText: 作为中枢苏达集团成员的福利，她接受了几乎全部的身体重建。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_6.text: Recruited by Cephalon Suda due to 'intriguing, possibly unique cerebral qualities'.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_6.zhText: 因为"耐人寻味，甚至可能拥有独特的脑力素质"的原因，被中枢苏达亲自招募进了集团。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_7.text: Selected for recruitment by Cephalon Suda, seemingly at random, as a 'control exercise'.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_7.zhText: 由中枢苏达亲自招募，看起来是作为"控制变量组"的一次随机实验。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_8.text: Recruited by Cephalon Suda as an 'ordinary Operative'; true rank and capabilities classified.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_8.zhText: 被中枢苏达招募为了"普通特工"，她真实的职责和集团等级是保密信息。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_9.text: Bequeathed own remains to Cephalon Suda for study, in exchange for Syndicate membership privileges.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_CS_F_9.zhText: 将自己身体存留下的部分捐赠给了中枢苏达做研究，来换取在集团内的特权。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_1.text: Joined New Loka after mental breakdown.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_1.zhText: 精神崩溃后加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_10.zhText: 在经历了预示梦后改变了信仰。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_11.zhText: 在一场仪式通过草药获得启示后加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_12.text: Joined New Loka after political awakening.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_12.zhText: 政治意识觉醒后加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_13.text: Joined New Loka after pollutant contamination.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_13.zhText: 被污染后加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_14.text: Initiated into New Loka after renouncing family.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_14.zhText: 与家人断绝关系后加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_15.text: Initiated into New Loka following severe disillusionment.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_15.zhText: 在重度失意后加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_16.text: Affiliated to New Loka after visiting Earth.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_16.zhText: 前往地球参观后，加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_2.text: Affiliated to New Loka following religious epiphany.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_2.zhText: 受到了宗教启迪后，加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_3.text: Credits New Loka for recovery from critical illness.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_3.zhText: 她非常感激新世间治好了自己的重疾。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_4.text: Personally selected for initiation by Priestess Amaryn.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_4.zhText: 由新世间领袖 Amaryn 亲自挑选入会。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_5.text: Joined New Loka in gratitude for rescue from prison.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_5.zhText: 出于感激，从监狱中被解救出来后加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_6.text: Defected to New Loka from rival Syndicate.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_6.zhText: 从敌对集团叛逃进了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_7.text: Joined New Loka to recover from addiction.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_7.zhText: 出于希望戒断药瘾的原因加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_8.text: Infiltrated New Loka as a spy and converted.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_8.zhText: 以间谍的身份渗透进了新世间，随后得到了感化。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_9.text: Joined New Loka when partner did.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_NL_F_9.zhText: 随着同伴一起加入了新世间。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_1.zhText: 被佩兰数列的猎头所招募。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_10.text: Selected for Perrin Sequence by algorithm.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_10.zhText: 被佩兰数列通过算法选中。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_11.text: Enlisted with Perrin Sequence on a friend's recommendation.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_11.zhText: 在一位朋友的引荐下加入了佩兰数列。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_12.text: Covertly recruited into Perrin Sequence by infiltrator agent.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_12.zhText: 被潜入的特工秘密招入到佩兰数列。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_14.text: Accidentally recruited into Perrin Sequence and opted to remain.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_14.zhText: 意外地被招入进佩兰数列并选择留下。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_15.text: Attended Perrin Sequence seminars and joined soon thereafter.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_15.zhText: 出席了佩兰数列研讨会并在不久后加入。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_16.text: Followed parents into the Perrin Sequence.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_16.zhText: 跟随父母加入到佩兰数列。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_2.text: Joined Perrin Sequence out of a sincere wish to help others.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_2.zhText: 出于帮助他人的真挚愿望而加入了佩兰数列。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_3.text: Joined Perrin Sequence hoping to broker peace.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_3.zhText: 出于希望能够促成和平的愿望，加入了佩兰数列。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_4.text: Joined Perrin; swore to dismantle the Corpus and all their schemes.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_4.zhText: 加入了佩兰数列，并且誓要消灭 Corpus 和他们的阴谋诡计。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_5.zhText: 对 Corpus 的过度剥削感到惊恐。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_6.text: Renounced greed after spending time in a Perrin Sequence facility.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_6.zhText: 在佩兰数列的设施里呆了一段时间后，戒掉了贪婪。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_7.zhText: 全身心地接受了佩兰数列的价值观。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_8.text: Received mentoring from a Perrin Sequence grandee.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_8.zhText: 从佩兰数列的大人物那里得到了指导。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_9.text: Rejected by Perrin Sequence, but persisted and was eventually accepted.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_PS_M_9.zhText: 被佩兰数列拒绝，但因为坚持不懈最终被接纳。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_1.text: Attracted Red Veil's attention with graffiti campaign.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_1.zhText: 以涂鸦运动吸引了血色面纱的注意。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_10.text: Carried out attacks in the Red Veil's name, hoping to be noticed, until they recruited him.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_10.zhText: 以血色面纱的名义进行攻击，并希望受到关注，直到他们招募他加入。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_11.text: Was trapped in a bombed-out ruin with a Red Veil member, who persuaded him to join.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_11.zhText: 和一名血色面纱成员困在一个被炸毁的废墟里，并被说服加入。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_12.text: Pledged loyalty to Red Veil the moment they made contact.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_12.zhText: 刚接触到血色面纱就对其誓死效忠。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_13.text: Recruited by Red Veil in the belief that they could make use of his aggression.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_13.zhText: 被血色面纱招募，他们认为可以利用他的攻击性。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_14.text: Joined Red Veil in a group blood pact.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_14.zhText: 因为群血契约加入了血色面纱。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_15.text: Made contact with Red Veil through highly encrypted data channels.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_15.zhText: 通过高度加密的数据渠道与血色面纱取得联系。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_16.text: Carried out high-profile assassination in the belief Red Veil would notice and approve. They did.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_16.zhText: 坚信血色面纱会注意自己进行的高调暗杀，并被批准加入。结果确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_2.text: Saved the life of a comrade who proved to be a Red Veil adherent and sponsored his recruitment.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_2.zhText: 曾经救了战友一命，后来发现那位战友是血色面纱的信徒，并且那位战友随后资助了他的加入。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_3.text: Recruited by Palladino directly, after a 'chiming whisper' had told her his name.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_3.zhText: 在一阵"低声细语"把他的名字告知 Palladino 后，他被 Palladino 直接招募进了血色面纱。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_4.text: Made contact with Red Veil when he discovered one of their hidden arms caches.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_4.zhText: 以找到一个军火库储藏箱为契机，与血色面纱取得了联系。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_5.text: Shared a prison block with a Red Veil member, who recruited him after they were both freed.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_5.zhText: 曾经和一名血色面纱成员是同牢房的狱友，在他们出狱后，被这名成员招募进了血色面纱。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_6.text: Passed his Red Veil initiation with ease.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_6.zhText: 轻松通过了血色面纱的入会仪式。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_7.text: Drew the Red Veil's attention with his appetite for causing carnage.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_7.zhText: 由于他喜好杀戮而引起了血色面纱的注意。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_8.text: Identified by the Red Veil as a loose cannon and brought into the Syndicate in the hope of stabilizing him.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_8.zhText: 血色面纱觉得他是个我行我素的人，便把他带入集团，希望他能有所约束。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_9.text: Joined the Red Veil to pursue a personal vendetta.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_RV_M_9.zhText: 加入血色面纱是为了个人恩怨。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_1.text: Killed commanding officer, went on the run, and eventually took sanctuary with Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_1.zhText: 杀死了自己的长官并逃了出来，最终受到了钢铁防线的庇护。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_10.text: Made covert contact with Steel Meridian and was broken out along with fellow sympathizers.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_10.zhText: 与钢铁防线进行了秘密接触，随后与其他同情钢铁防线的伙伴们被一起拯救了出来。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_11.text: Refused to execute a captive, was imprisoned for insubordination, overpowered guard, and escaped.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_11.zhText: 拒绝处死俘虏，因不服从命令而被关押，在制服守卫后逃跑。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_12.text: Challenged superior officer to single combat; won the bout, stole a weapon, shot several guards, and escaped in the ensuing chaos.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_12.zhText: 挑战上级军官并胜出，随后偷取了一件武器，并射杀了几名警卫，随之在混乱中逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_13.text: Was mistakenly believed to be a Steel Meridian spy and brutally interrogated; later escaped and joined Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_13.zhText: 曾被误认为是钢铁防线的间谍，并受到残酷的审讯；之后逃了出来并加入钢铁防线。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_14.text: Accidentally destroyed barracks during routine grenade practice. Joined Steel Meridian out of self-preservation.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_14.zhText: 在例行的手榴弹练习中意外地摧毁了兵营。出于自保而加入钢铁防线。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_15.text: Made a breakout pact with a fellow Queen-resistant Grineer. Both survived the escape.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_15.zhText: 与一个对抗女皇的 Grineer 同伙达成协议突围。二人一起逃出生天。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_16.text: Made a breakout pact with a fellow Queen-resistant Grineer. Her co-conspirator was killed in the escape.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_16.zhText: 与一个对抗女皇的 Grineer 同伙达成协议突围。但她的同伙在逃跑中被击杀。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_2.text: Hijacked a Grineer crewship and defected to Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_2.zhText: 劫持了一艘 Grineer 战舰并投靠了钢铁防线。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_3.text: Came to the aid of a beleaguered Tenno operative and was told of the existence of Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_3.zhText: 帮助了一位陷入困境的 Tenno 特工，还听说了钢铁防线的存在。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_4.text: While imprisoned and awaiting execution for treason, was broken out by a mysterious savior figure known only as 'Clem'.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_4.zhText: 当她在被关在监狱里等着被以叛变的罪名处死之际，被一名仅知道名字叫做"Clem"的神秘英雄所救。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_5.text: Surrendered to Tenno operatives during raid on a Grineer facility and was allowed to affiliate to Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_5.zhText: 在一次针对 Grineer 设施进行的突袭行动中，她向 Tenno 投了降，并被允许加入钢铁防线。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_6.text: Escaped Grineer camp; lived a feral wilderness existence for several years before making contact with Steel Meridian.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_6.zhText: 逃离了 Grineer 营地之后，曾在荒野中生活了几年。直到后来与钢铁防线的成员产生了接触。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_7.text: Tried to destroy command center along with self and unexpectedly survived.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_7.zhText: 试图通过自杀的方式摧毁指挥中心，但意外地幸存了下来。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_8.text: Escaped from Grineer Galleon on a Ramsled, boarded a Corpus ship, and lived secretly in the duct system for several months.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_8.zhText: 驾驶着一艘冲锋艇从Grineer 帆船战舰上逃了出来，随后登上了一艘 Corpus 飞船，并秘密地在管道系统中生活了几个月。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_9.text: Lived among a pack of Kubrows as a respected equal.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H2_SM_F_9.zhText: 与一群库狛一起生活并被视为同类。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_1.text: Bellows in empty rooms to test the acoustics.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_1.zhText: 会在空荡的房间里大声喊话，来测试传音效果。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_10.text: Fasts on bread and water when the urge takes him.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_10.zhText: 兴起时会开始禁食，只吃面包和水。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_11.text: Enjoys luxury but feels guilty about it.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_11.zhText: 享受奢侈生活，但对此感到内疚。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_12.text: Has seen too much unkindness to want to practice it himself.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_12.zhText: 见过了太多黑暗面，并决定自己不会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_13.text: Sleeps on the bare floor, refusing even a bedroll.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_13.zhText: 睡在光秃秃的地板上，甚至不用铺盖卷。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_14.zhText: 他认为自己什么工作都能做，无论职位贵贱。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_15.text: Passionately interested in hearing the stories others have to tell.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_15.zhText: 对聆听他人不吐不快的故事充满热情。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_16.text: Chants versicles along to the throb of a ship's engines.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_16.zhText: 会伴随着战舰引擎声吟诵诗句。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_17.text: Hopes to one day die gloriously in the defense of Truth.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_17.zhText: 希望自己有一天能在捍卫真理的过程中光荣牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_2.zhText: 迷恋上了阿耶檀识塑像。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_3.text: Has a combined dread of, and yearning for, the Void.

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_4.text: Sincerely believes that "the truth will out" no matter how long it takes.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_4.zhText: 发自内心地相信：无论多久，"真相终会大白"。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_5.text: Scorns any form of pretence or affectation.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_5.zhText: 鄙视任何形式的伪装或装腔作势。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_7.text: Prays for the souls of those he has killed, and never forgets their names, once he has learned them.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_7.zhText: 会为被他杀死的灵魂祈祷，一旦他知道了他们的名字，就永远不会忘记。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_8.text: Hopes to be given access to the Leverian, the better to understand the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_8.zhText: 希望能进入莱弗博物馆，以更好地了解 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_9.text: Despises the Infestation above all other enemies.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_AH_M_9.zhText: 蔑视感染者，更甚于其他所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_11.zhText: 痴迷于英择谛虚空理论。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_13.text: Hopes to broaden experience of other cultures.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_13.zhText: 希望有更多关于其他文化的体验。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_14.zhText: 对奥罗金的历史非常感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_2.zhText: 希望自己能去研究机器学习。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_3.text: Keenly interested in human death rituals.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_3.zhText: 对人类的死亡仪式非常感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_5.zhText: 喜欢拆卸物品作为消遣。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_6.zhText: 偶尔会遇到回忆闪现问题。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_7.text: Exponent of the Foxx-Webb theory of synthetic positivism.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_7.zhText: 福克斯—韦伯综合实证主义理论的拥护者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_9.text: Hopes to deepen understanding of xenobiology.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_CS_F_9.zhText: 希望能加深对外空生物学的认识。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_10.zhText: 自告奋勇作为援助工作者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_13.zhText: 参与了田园生活的宣传活动。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_15.text: Suspected of multiple counts of property damage.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_15.zhText: 涉嫌多起损害他人财产的罪行。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_16.zhText: 参与了噬血型库娃的治疗。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_17.text: Hopes to be chosen for missionary work.

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_18.text: Compiling a thesis on Tenno rehabilitation.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_18.zhText: 撰写了有关 Tenno 康复的论文。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_5.zhText: 志愿担任种子银行的监管者。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_NL_F_6.zhText: 档案保管人和民俗学家。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_1.text: Secretly watches tournaments on The Index.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_1.zhText: 会在指数之场里暗中观赛。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_11.text: Repeatedly destitute due to massive charity donations.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_11.zhText: 由于大量的慈善捐款而屡屡陷入贫困。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_12.zhText: Mycona 文化研究方面的学生。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_13.zhText: 是一位灵敏的 K 式悬浮板选手。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_15.text: Keen to associate with other factions.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_15.zhText: 热衷于和其他派系交往。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_16.text: May have covertly breached system to rewrite own service record.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_16.zhText: 可能暗中侵入系统，重写了自己的服务记录。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_17.text: Received the Zeltrum Beacon medal in honor of service to Perrin.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_17.zhText: 被授予了 Zeltrum 烽火勋章，以表彰其对佩兰数列做出的贡献。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_18.text: May have buried a trove of wealth somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_18.zhText: 可能将大量财富埋在了某个地方。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_2.text: Dreads meeting former spouse, who is a Corpus member.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_2.zhText: 害怕见到身为 Corpus 成员的前任配偶。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_3.text: Was terrified by stories of Parvos Granum as a child.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_3.zhText: 小时候被帕尔沃斯·格拉努的故事吓坏了。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_4.text: Hopes to meet Ergo Glast and thank him personally.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_4.zhText: 希望能见到 Ergo Glast 并亲自感谢他。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_5.text: Has a phobia of contracting the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_5.zhText: 很害怕自己会被感染者传染。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_6.zhText: 已经资助了几次越狱行动。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_7.text: Buys up Solaris debt bonds from Ticker when finances allow.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_7.zhText: 在资金允许的情况下，会从 Ticker 那里购买索拉里斯债务债券。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_8.text: Had appearance completely altered in order to escape previous life.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_8.zhText: 为了逃避过去的生活，彻底改变了外貌。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_PS_M_9.zhText: 会不停地查看股票价格。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_1.zhText: 会收集远古之战的纪念品。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_11.zhText: 会花很长时间敲打火石。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_13.text: Hunts his own food when possible.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_13.zhText: 尽可能地自己猎取食物。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_14.zhText: 是一名业余武器设计师。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_15.text: Likes to carve bones in his spare time.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_15.zhText: 业余时间喜欢雕刻骨头。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_16.text: Often experiments with his own pain threshold.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_16.zhText: 经常利用自己的痛苦阈值进行实验。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_17.zhText: 遭受周期性失去意识的困扰。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_2.text: Believes he is being personally hunted by the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_2.zhText: 他坚信自己正在被 Grineer 追杀。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_3.text: Has deleted almost all of his own records.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_3.zhText: 几乎删除了关于他自己的所有记录。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_4.text: Claims to have done more to purify the System than any Red Veil member in the last five years.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_4.zhText: 他声称在过去五年里，他在净化星系方面所做的工作，比任何血色面纱的成员都要多。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_5.text: Insists that he is working on 'something big' which he will unveil when the time is right.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_5.zhText: 他坚称自己正在做一件"大事"，时机到了自会揭晓。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_8.text: Believes Parvos Granum is offering a bounty for his head.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_RV_M_8.zhText: 深信帕尔沃斯·格拉努正在悬赏他的人头。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_1.text: Does not like to be around mirrors.

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_10.text: Finds it difficult to respect anyone she could easily defeat.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_10.zhText: 她发现很难尊重自己的任何手下败将。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_11.text: Has a weakness for Ostron Chimurr.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_11.zhText: 对 Ostron 的赤穆茶饮品情有独钟。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_12.text: Intends to leave any possessions to the Ventkids of Fortuna upon her death.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_12.zhText: 打算在她死后将所有财产留给福尔图娜的通风小子。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_13.zhText: 偶尔和 Maroo 一起下围棋。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_14.text: Offered to serve as Ticker's full-time bodyguard but was told she did not need one.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_14.zhText: 曾向 Ticker 表示自己愿意担任她的全职保镖，但随后被 Ticker 告知她没这个需求。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_15.text: Has attempted several times to learn the Shawzin. Is on her third.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_15.zhText: 尝试过好几次学习演奏三线琴。现在是她第三次学习了。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_16.text: Carries the teeth of her tube-brother in her chest pouch.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_16.zhText: 把她同试管培育的兄弟的牙齿放在胸前口袋中贴身携带。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_18.text: Appears to believe that machines have souls.

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_2.text: Is planning to make contact with and liberate others like herself.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_2.zhText: 正考虑与其他像她一样的人取得联系，并让他们获得自由。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_3.text: When alone in quarters, listens to Skeg music played extremely loudly.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_3.zhText: 当宿舍里只有她一个人的时候，会把管道乐的音乐放得特别大声。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_4.text: Feels guilty for having attempted to destroy the Silver Grove.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_4.zhText: 因企图摧毁落银树庭而感到内疚。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_5.text: Is convinced she knows the date of her own death.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_5.zhText: 深信她知道自己的死亡日期。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_6.zhText: 会雕刻抽象的木制雕塑。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_7.text: Can be overheard counting the hours until her next fight.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_7.zhText: 能够听到她对下一场战斗倒计时的声音。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_8.text: Likes the smell of industrial chemicals.
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/H3_SM_F_8.zhText: 喜欢工业化学品的气味。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_1.text: 60 days hard labor on the Orb Vallis

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_11.text: 3 years hard labor on the Orb Vallis

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_13.zhText: 3 年重劳役-福尔图娜污水池

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_14.text: Total bodily repossession and permanent brain-shelving. Debt passed to dependents
/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_14.zhText: 全身索回以及永久大脑回柜。债务由家眷继承。

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_15.text: 10 years hard labor on the Orb Vallis

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_17.zhText: 10 年重劳役-福尔图娜污水池

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/P_3.zhText: 福尔图娜坑洞苦役 60 天

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/R_68_F.zhText: 工伤事故：被野生动物打伤

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/R_68_M.zhText: 工伤事故：被野生动物打伤

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/R_76_F.zhText: 最好的朋友大脑被回柜

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/R_76_M.zhText: 最好的朋友大脑被回柜

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/R_8_F.zhText: 有好声望的神殿捐赠者

/Lotus/Language/CrewMember/R_8_M.zhText: 有好声望的神殿捐赠者

/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/AuraHea.text: Killing an enemy heals all nearby allies by |VAL| over |DURATION|s
/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/AuraHea.zhText: 击杀敌人后为附近所有友军恢复 |VAL| 生命值，持续 |DURATION| 秒

/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/HealerT.text:
Heal all teammates for |VAL| Health when this crew member drops below |HEALTH|% Health. 
Cooldown: |COOLDOWN|m
/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/HealerT.zhText:
此舰员生命值低于 |HEALTH|% 时将为所有队友恢复 |VAL| 生命值。
冷却时间：|COOLDOWN| 分钟

/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/LethalS.text: Activates a protective shield when taking near lethal damage. |COOLDOWN|s cooldown
/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/LethalS.zhText: 受到致命伤害时激活防护罩。冷却时间 |COOLDOWN| 秒

/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/LowHeal.text: Increase Critical Damage Multiplier by |VAL|% while Health is below |HEALTH|%
/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/LowHeal.zhText: 生命值低于 |HEALTH|% 时增加 |VAL|% 暴击伤害倍率

/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/RepairB.text: Gain |VAL|% Movement Speed for |DURATION|s after repairing
/Lotus/Language/CrewMemberTraits/RepairB.zhText: 维修后获得 |VAL|% 移动速度，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/DefaultEngines_.zhText: 标准配置的西格玛系列引擎。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesClanA_De.zhText: 升级配置的西格玛系列引擎。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesClanB_De.text: A more refined version of the standard Sigma Series engine.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesClanB_De.zhText: 更加精密配置的西格玛系列引擎。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesClanC_De.text: A fully optimized version of the Sigma Series engine.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesClanC_De.zhText: 完全优化配置的西格玛系列引擎。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesLavanA_D.text: Lavan Engines touted the best boost speeds, but struggled to compete at top speeds.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesLavanA_D.zhText: Lavan 引擎被热捧为助推加速最好的引擎，但在最高速度上却表现一般。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesVidarA_D.text: Vidar Engines were best in class for top speed, at the expense of Boost performance.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesVidarA_D.zhText: Vidar 引擎以助推性能为代价，换取了最高速度等级中的最卓越地位。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesZektiA_D.text: Zetki Engines were solid performers in all categories but stood out in none.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/EnginesZektiA_D.zhText: Zetki 引擎各方面的表现都很优异，但没有特别突出的地方。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsA_.zhText: 升级配置的西格玛系列装甲。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsB_.text: More refined quality of the Sigma Series plating.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsB_.zhText: 拥有更加精密配置的西格玛系列装甲。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsC_.text: Highest quality of the Sigma Series plating.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsC_.zhText: 拥有最高精密配置的西格玛系列装甲。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsDe.zhText: 标准配置的西格玛系列装甲。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsLa.text: Lavan focused their efforts on superior Hull composition, at the cost of Armor integrity.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsLa.zhText: Lavan 学派着重于构造卓越的舰体，但也随之牺牲了护甲的完整性。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsVi.text: Vidar designed their plating to have the highest possible Armor strength, Hull reinforcement was less of a priority.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsVi.zhText: Vidar 学派设计的装甲能提供最大限度的护甲强度，舰体强化则不在优先考虑的范围内。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsZe.text: Plating from House Zetki struck a balance between Armor strength and Hull fitness.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/HullMaterialsZe.zhText: Zetki 学派的装甲在护甲和舰体的强度之间取得了绝妙平衡。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_AutoCannonD.text: Rapid-fire autocannon: launches high-velocity projectiles, puncturing and shredding the armor of enemy ships.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_AutoCannonD.zhText: 速射自动火炮：发射高速投射物，刺穿并粉碎敌舰的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_BeamWeaponD.text: Photon lance: two focused beams instantly sear enemy ships, often engulfing them in flame.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_BeamWeaponD.zhText: 光子喷枪：两束高密度激光在转瞬间灼烧敌舰，常常将敌舰吞没在火焰中。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_BlasterDesc.text: Rapid-fire toxin cannon: damages enemy vessels with a toxic sludge that can penetrate hulls and cause crews to become confused, turning on their allies.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_BlasterDesc.zhText: 速射毒素炮：发射毒素粘液来损坏敌方舰船，这种粘液能穿透船体，让敌方船员陷入混乱、自相残杀。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_BlasterShot.text: Ice wave generator: slams enemy ships with waves of frozen particulate freezing enemy propulsion systems and slowing them to a standstill.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_BlasterShot.zhText: 冰浪发生器：通过发射冰冷微粒所形成的波浪来打击敌舰，这种攻击能冻结敌舰的推进系统，使其动弹不得。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_EMPMissileL.text: Arc Weapon: discharges a massive stream of Incendiary energy, latching and frying up to 3 enemy vessels.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_EMPMissileL.zhText: 电弧武器：释放出一道强大的燃烧能量，轰击灼烧至多 3 艘敌舰。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_ElectricTet.text: Electrical pulse projector: emits a volley of wide charged arcs that can knock out enemy systems.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_ElectricTet.zhText: 电脉冲投射炮台：发出一连串大范围的电弧，可击溃敌方系统。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_GatlingLase.text: Rapid-fire laser cannon: burns targets with instantaneous beams. Fire rate builds with continuous use.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_GatlingLase.zhText: 速射激光炮台：用瞬时光束使目标燃烧。持续使用该武器会提高射速。

/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_IceSniperDe.text: Ship-mounted ice driver: delivers heavy icicle bombardment, causing severe damage to enemy weak points.
/Lotus/Language/CrewShip/Wpn_IceSniperDe.zhText: 舰载驱冰炮台：可提供猛烈的冰柱轰炸，对敌方的弱点造成沉重打击。

/Lotus/Language/Currency/FusionPointsDes.text: Concentrated energy used to Fuse and upgrade Mods. Can be found in missions, Dissolved from Mods, or Extracted from Ayatans.
/Lotus/Language/Currency/FusionPointsDes.zhText: 可用于融铸 Mod 的精纯能量。可以通过完成任务、分解 Mod，或是从阿耶檀识塑像中提取获得。

/Lotus/Language/Currency/GranumBucksDesc.text: A corrupted decryption key dating back to the founding of the city of Corposium. Millions of these Holokeys were lost to the Void when Parvos Granum's flagship was bombed. Strongly desired by Ergo Glast.
/Lotus/Language/Currency/GranumBucksDesc.zhText: 一把堕落解密钥匙，起源可以追溯到 Corposium 之城建立的时期。当帕尔沃斯·格拉努的旗舰被炸毁时，数以百万计这样的全息密钥就失落在了虚空中。Ergo Glast 对这件物品情有独钟。

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AFKFarmW.text:
Hello |PLAYER_NAME|,

We have received data that shows you have been idling in missions for excessive periods of time, which suggests AFK farming is occurring on your account. Please note that any automated play of the game that removes the human element is not permitted in Warframe.

Should we continue to receive in-game reports showing you are AFK farming or data that is not explicable through any other means, you risk having your account suspended.

Thank you for your cooperation,
Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AFKFarmW.zhText:
您好 |PLAYER_NAME|，

我们收到的数据显示，您在任务中的很长时间没有任何人为参与的迹象。这表明您的账号在通过无人参与的挂机来刷取资源。请注意，玩家不得以任何非人工的方式，在 Warframe 中自动进行游戏。

如果我们继续收到举报，您的账号挂机自动刷取资源，或是账号内有无法以任何方式合理解释的数据，那么您的账号可能会被封禁。

感谢您的理解与配合。
Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AccountN.text:
We endeavour to keep Warframe open and welcoming for all users. As a result, some players may find their public account name being changed if we receive complaints from other players (including circumstances where such names made it past the filters we have in place). Names related to politics, religion, sex or hate are best avoided, as they do not reflect the tone of the Warframe community.

With regards to your account name, we have received a number of complaints from other players about it. Upon further review, your name was deemed offensive by the community standards and it is necessary to change it.

Since we do understand the inconvenience this can cause, we are offering a free name change to any affected players. Please submit a support ticket listing a few options for the new name you would like to use. We will do our best to fulfill the name change request as quickly as possible.

Thank you for your understanding,

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AccountN.zhText:
我们努力在 Warframe 营造开放和欢迎所有用户的游戏氛围。因此，如果我们收到其他玩家的投诉（内容涉及游戏内名字超过我们已经有的筛选标准）有些玩家就可能会发现他们的公共账号名字被更改。与政治、宗教、性爱或者仇恨相关的名字请尽量避免使用，因为它们不符合这个游戏的基调，而且很容易冒犯其他用户。

关于您的用户名，我们收到投诉；经过进一步的复审，需要您修改名字。

我们理解这会给您带来不便，因此我们为所有受此影响的玩家免费修改名字。请您在收到这个通知后的一周内提交一张 Warframe 客服问题单，并详细地写出您想要使用的新名字，我们会尽早满足您的更改需求。

感谢您的理解，

Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AccountN.text:
We endeavor to keep Warframe open and welcoming for all users. As a result, some players may find their public account name being changed if we receive complaints from other players (including circumstances where such names made it past the filters we have in place). Names related to politics, religion, sex or hate are best avoided, as they do not reflect the tone of the Warframe community.

With regards to your account name, we have received a number of complaints from other players about it. Upon further review, your name was deemed offensive by the community standards and it was, therefore, necessary to change it.

Since you willingly violated our Terms of Use by creating an offensive User ID, it will be your responsibility to adjust your account name. Should your newly chosen alias violate our Terms of Use or EULA again, please be aware that this may result in the suspension of your account.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation,

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AccountN.zhText:
我们致力于保证 Warframe 对所有用户都是开放而友好的。因此，一些玩家可能会发现他们的游戏昵称被修改，由于我们收到了来自其他玩家的投诉（包括了某些情况下，该名称被现有的过滤器漏过）。与政治、宗教、性或者仇恨言论相关的名称请尽量避免使用，因为这些不是 Warframe 社区所反映出来的声音。

关于您的游戏昵称，我们收到了多条来自其他玩家的投诉。经过进一步的审核，您的游戏昵称就玩家社区的标准而言是冒犯性的。因此，有必要进行修改。

由于您创建了冒犯性的用户 ID，因而您已经违反了《使用条款》，您有责任调整您的游戏昵称。如果您新选择的用户名再次违反《使用条款》，那么您的账号可能被封禁。

感谢您的理解与合作。

Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AfkSpeci.text:
We have received reports of you being AFK. Please note that the community frowns on this behavior and we ask that if you intend to go AFK, that you refrain from playing in public missions. If we continue to receive reports of you being AFK, you risk having your account suspended.

Thank you for your cooperation,

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AfkSpeci.zhText:
我们收到玩家举报指出您在任务中有挂机行为。这个举报包含您没有在任务中参与的证据。

请注意这项行为是 Warframe 所不乐见的。我们想提醒您：如果您想挂机，请您跟好友连线进行私人游戏，不要在公开任务里挂机。否则，就有被再次举报的风险，因为有些玩家是会积极举报AFK 玩家的。也请您注意，不要让其他队友误以为您是在 AFK。

同时，我们也想提醒您：如果我们继续收到您在任务中挂机的举报，您的账号是有可能会被封禁的。

若您对此有任何进一步的问题或疑虑，请您到 Warframe 官网的客服专区联系我们，并附上证据截屏。

感谢您的合作。

Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AutoBanW.text:
Hello, |PLAYER_NAME|,

Our system has detected instances of abnormal results and/or account activity, and this resulted in a two-week trading suspension being placed upon your account due to the fact that you ran cheating software while playing Warframe.

The suspension was only temporary as a sign of good faith, yet this is a one-time-only chance, and we repeat: ONE-TIME-ONLY CHANCE. If we find you running similar programs while playing the game from here on, you will be suspended permanently from access to the game.

Please note that running software that has the potential to manipulate memory while Warframe is open can get your account automatically banned and if it happens again we won't be able to help you, and your account will remain suspended.

Any cheat software, even if not meant for Warframe, has the potential to manipulate the computer's memory and you SHOULD NOT run anything suspicious while playing Warframe.

We apologize for the inconvenience and hope that you can appreciate the importance of keeping Warframe fair.

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/AutoBanW.zhText:
您好，|PLAYER_NAME|，

我们的系统侦测到了一些异常结果和/或账号活动。由于您在游玩 Warframe 使用修改器，您的账号将暂时被限制交易，为期 2 周。

出于对您的信任，这次封禁处罚只是暂时的，然而这样的机会仅有一次；再次强调，这样的机会仅有一次。从现在起，如果我们再次发现您在游玩游戏时运行了类似的程序，您将遭到永久封禁。

请注意，若您在 Warframe 运行时使用能够操纵电脑内存的软件，您的账号可能会被自动封禁。若此情况再次发生，我们无法为您提供任何帮助，且您的账号会维持封禁状态。

任何修改器，即便不是给 Warframe 使用的，都有可能用于操纵电脑内存，因此您不应该在游玩 Warframe 时执行任何外挂软件或修改器。

对此造成的不便我们深表歉意，并希望您能体会 Warframe 致力维持游戏公平的重要性。

Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/ClanEmbl.text:
Hello, |PLAYER_NAME|,

We endeavor to keep Warframe open and welcoming for all users. As a result, some players may find their public clan emblem removed if we receive complaints from other players (including circumstances where such emblems made it past the screening system we have in place).

Emblems related to politics, religion, sex, or hate are best avoided, as they do not reflect the tone of the Warframe community. Copyrighted images that DE does not have the right to use are also problematic, and it is necessary to remove these when they are found. Finally, please note that we don't accept AI-generated content in the game.

As such it was necessary to remove your Emblem.

Since we do understand the inconvenience this can cause, we are offering a free emblem change to any affected players. Please submit a support ticket with an alternative emblem. We will do our best to fulfill the emblem change request as quickly as possible.

Thank you for your understanding.
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/ClanEmbl.zhText:
您好 |PLAYER_NAME|，

我们努力在 Warframe 营造开放和欢迎所有用户的游戏氛围。因此，如果我们收到其他玩家的投诉（包括某些徽章通过了我们现有的审核系统的情况），有些玩家就可能会发现他们的公共氏族徽章被移除。

与政治、宗教、性爱或者仇恨相关的徽章请尽量避免使用，因为它们不符合 Warframe 玩家社区的基调。DE 无权使用的受版权保护图像也会造成一些问题，如果发现此类情况，该徽章将被移除。最后，请注意，我们不接受游戏中出现 AI 生成的内容。

因此，我们不得不移除您的徽章。

我们理解这会给您带来不便，因此我们为所有受此影响的玩家免费修改徽章。请您提交一张客服问题单，并附上一个可供替换的徽章，我们会尽快处理您的更改徽章请求。

感谢您的理解。

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/Compromi.text: This option is not available while your account is in a compromised state. Please contact Warframe Support to resolve this situation and secure your account.
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/Compromi.zhText: 当您的账号是被盗状态时，此选项不可用。请联系 Warframe 客服团队来进一步处理这个情况，并保护您的账号信息。

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/ConsoleA.text:
Hello |PLAYER_NAME|,

We have noticed that you have been using a number of alt accounts to make purchases of Platinum and then sending this Platinum to your main account. When making purchases they must be made using YOUR Console's Store on the game account the purchases are intended to be used for.

If you wish to have alternate accounts there should be little to no interaction between them - the trading system is intended only for equitable trades between players and is not intended for the mass transfer of Platinum between accounts.

Your alt accounts have been suspended and if we continue to see such activity all of your accounts face suspension from access to Warframe.

Thank you for your understanding.

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/ConsoleA.zhText:
您好 |PLAYER_NAME|，

我们注意到您一直使用多个备用账号购买白金，并将所购买的白金转移至您的主要账号中。在进行购买时，您必须在相应游戏账号的主机商店进行购买，以便将购买的物品用于相应的游戏账号。

如果您希望拥有备用账号，那么您的多个账号之间绝对不应该有任何互动。交易系统设立的目的是为了让玩家之间能进行公平公正的交易，而不是被用来在多个账号之间转移物品或白金。

您的备用账号已经被封禁，如果今后我们再次发现这种行为，那么您的所有账号都将会受到封禁。

感谢您的理解。
Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/Creating.text:
We have received reports that you have been creating alternate accounts for the purpose of harassing other players in the game. Please note that this activity is prohibited and you will find that your troll account has been banned. If we find that you have created more accounts for this purpose, or that you are continuing to harass your fellow players, you risk having your main account banned as well.

Thank you for your cooperation,

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/Creating.zhText:
我们收到玩家回报指出您创立了多个用于骚扰他人的账号。请注意这项行为是被禁止的，您会发现用来恶搞他人的账号已被禁用。若我们发现您创立更多用于此用途的账号，或继续骚扰您的队友，您的主要账号将会一并被禁用。

感谢您的合作。

Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/DarvoSup.text:
A mysterious organization, known only by the name "Support," wanted me to pass along a message. They say the information you provided has been useful in restoring balance to the Origin System. They wanted me to thank you personally and pass this token of their appreciation.

Your loyal friend,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/DarvoSup.zhText:
一个神秘的组织，仅以"客服"之名为人所知，他们希望我传达一条信息。他们说，你提供的情报为始源星系的平衡作出了贡献。他们想要以个人的名义向你表示感谢，并将这代表他们感激的象征送给你。

好吧，朋友，我虽然不清楚这些人是谁，但是似乎他们非常有实力。如果我是你，我一定会和他们站在同一阵线。

你忠实的朋友， 
Darvo

You made comments in the chat that violate community rules. As a result, restrictions have been placed on your account. For further information, please contact Support directly.

Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/ReportPl.zhText:
Tenno，

我们发现您在聊天中发表了违反社区守则的评论。您这样做导致的结果是：您的账号因此受到了一些限制。请直接联系 Warframe 客服团队来进一步了解更多信息。

谢谢您的理解与配合。

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/ReportPl.text:
Tenno,

Thanks to a report you filed, we were able to take action against a player who was violating our rules. Thank you for keeping our Warframe Community the best place it can be for everyone.

We all lift together.
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/ReportPl.zhText:
Tenno，

因为您提交的这一举报，我们得以根据您提供的信息来对违反了游戏守则的玩家采取措施。非常感谢您为将 Warframe 游戏社区建设成一个欢迎所有玩家的和谐社区而付出的努力。

与君共勉。

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/Spamming.text:
We have received reports from other players stating you have been spamming the chat. Activity of this nature is not welcome in the Warframe community. If we continue to receive reports of you spamming the chat, your ability to chat or your account itself will be suspended.

Thank you for your cooperation,

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/Spamming.zhText:
我们收到报告指出您在频道中刷屏。Warframe 对于这类行为是采取零容忍政策。

同时，我们也想提醒您：如果我们继续收到您在聊天中刷屏的报告，您的聊天权限是有可能被撤销的，甚至您的账号是有可能会被封禁的。

感谢您的合作。

Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/TradeBan.text:
We have received reports from other players stating that you have misled them during a trade. The reports included screenshots of your conversation during the trade and there is no doubt that your intention was to mislead. The trading system is designed to allow players a way to barter and trade with one another in good faith, and intentionally misleading your fellow players is most dishonourable conduct. As such, your trading privileges have been revoked. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact Support.

Thank you for your understanding,

Warframe Support Team
/Lotus/Language/CustomerSupport/TradeBan.zhText:
我们收到玩家举报指您出在交易中有误导/诈骗的行为。根据举报的交易对话截图内容显示，您确实具有误导/诈骗的意图。交易系统是为了玩家彼此能以物易物及诚挚交易而设计的。滥用交易系统企图误导玩家的行为是不道德的，因此您的交易权限已被撤销。

若您对此项指控有任何进一步的问题或疑虑，请您到 Warframe 官网的客服专区联系我们，并附上证据截屏。

感谢您的理解。

Warframe 客服团队

/Lotus/Language/DagathUpdate/DefixioHunt.text:
The Syndicates need your help to complete a mission. 

Acquire Abyssal Beacons from any Syndicate enclave. 

Which Syndicate you support is entirely your choice.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/DagathUpdate/DefixioHunt.zhText:
集团需要你的帮助来完成任务。 

请从任意集团据点中获取深渊信标。 

你支持哪个集团完全取决于你的选择。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DanteUnboun.text: Tenno. Please. The Leverian desperately needs your help. Come see me in DANTE'S LEVERIAN, as soon as possible.
/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DanteUnboun.zhText: Tenno。拜托了。莱弗博物馆迫切需要你的帮助。请尽快来 DANTE 的莱弗博物馆见我。

/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DanteUnboun.text: I have made a tremendous mistake…
/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DanteUnboun.zhText: 我犯了一个天大的错误……

/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DisruptionL.text: These greedy little Murmur tricksters love to steal Conduit Dockets and other coveted items from Albrecht's labs.
/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DisruptionL.zhText: 这些贪婪的低语者小调皮鬼喜欢从阿尔布雷希特的实验室偷取导管文卷和其他珍贵的物品。

/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/LoidDisrupt.text:
Tenno,

I have only just now learned of my old friend Drusus Leverian's predicament. I believe I can help you help him. Albrecht's old Conduit network has everything Drusus will need.

Access the Conduits in the ARMATUS node of Deimos or through the Sanctum Anatomica.

Come see me afterward, I may even be able to help you recover his trusted colleague, the Warframe Dante.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/LoidDisrupt.zhText:
Tenno，

我刚刚得知我的老朋友德枢·莱弗所处的困境。我相信我能帮你去帮他。阿尔布雷希特的旧导管网络拥有德枢所需的一切。

你可以在火卫二上的卫城区节点，或者通过解剖圣所，来访问导管装置。

之后就来找我，说不定我还能帮你找回他信赖的伙伴——Dante 战甲。

洛德

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.text: |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|'s Solar Rail will fall. It is only a matter of time.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.zhText: |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|的星际航道会被取代的，只是时间早晚罢了。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.text: |NODE_NAME| belongs to |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING|. We are the only true stewards of this rail.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.zhText: |NODE_NAME|是属于|CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING|的。我们才是这个航道的管理者。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.text: The damage is almost complete. Keep fighting.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.zhText: 已经成功造成伤害了，继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.text: I am encountering resistance. Hold the line.
This is a mobile defense mission. Deliver the payload to |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|'s rail control terminal. We will destroy it from within.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.zhText: 这是一个移动防御任务。将这些负载数据传递到|CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|的航道控制终端机里，我们会从中把它破坏掉。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.text: Our strategy for this attack is Mobile Defense. Take the payload and deliver it to a control terminal.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.zhText: Our strategy for this attack is Mobile Defense. Take the payload and deliver it to a control terminal.

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.text: You have reached the terminal. Administer the payload and prepare for defense.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.zhText: 你已经抵达了终端机的所在位置，输入这些负载数据并做好防御的准备。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.text: Destination reached, drop in the payload and get ready to defend.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileDe.zhText: 抵达目的地，输入这些负载数据并做好防御的准备。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileHa.text: This one is down. Keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileHa.zhText: 这边完成了，继续进行任务。
完成。去找到下一个终端机。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileOb.text: Payload succesfully delivered. |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| appreciates what you have done for us today |PLAYER_NAME|. Now get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileOb.zhText: 负载数据传输完成，|CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 非常感谢 |PLAYER_NAME| 的协助，现在尽速前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileOb.text: It's done, their rail won't be able to take much more of this. |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| will not forget your contribution here today, |PLAYER_NAME|. Now seek extraction.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/RailMobileOb.zhText: 完成了，他们的航道将难以维持下去。|CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING|不会忘记今日此处你所成就的一切，|PLAYER_NAME|。现在寻往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageGoal.text: You are working for |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING|. Destroy the reactor and we will reward you for your efforts.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageGoal.zhText: 你正在为 |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 氏族效力。破坏反应堆，然后我们将会为你所作出的努力而奖励你。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageGoal.text: The Tenno of |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| are grateful for your attacks on this rail.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageGoal.zhText: |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 的Tenno十分感谢你对这个航道的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageMiss.text: Welcome fellow Tenno. This is a sabotage mission. Damage |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|'s rail by destroying the nearby reactor.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageMiss.zhText: 欢迎你，我们的Tenno同伴。这是一个破坏任务。通过摧毁 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| 的航道附近的反应堆来使其受损。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageMiss.text: Find and destroy the nearby reactor. Be on guard for Specters from clan |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageMiss.zhText: 找到并破坏附近的反应堆。注意那些来自 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| 氏族的魅影。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageMiss.text: The reactor is our target. Destroy it and loosen clan |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|'s grip on this Dark Sector.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageMiss.zhText: 我们的目标是反应堆。破坏它并借此来削弱 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| 对这个黑暗地带的控制。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageObje.zhText: 目标已破坏。前往撤离点，|PLAYER_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageObje.text: Mission accomplished. Thank you |PLAYER_NAME|. Now find extraction.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageObje.zhText: 任务完成。感谢你，|PLAYER_NAME|。现在去寻找撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageObje.text: You found the reactor, now destroy it to send a message to |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|: |NODE_NAME| does not belong to them for long.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/SabotageObje.zhText: 你找到了反应堆，现在破坏它来向 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| 发出一条消息: |NODE_NAME| 并不长久地属于他们。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.text: |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| will remember this day. Thank you |PLAYER_NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.zhText: |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 将会铭记这一天。感谢你，|PLAYER_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.text: Thank you for supporting |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING|. We must control this Dark Sector!
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.zhText: 感谢你帮助 |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING|。我们必然要控制这个黑暗地带！

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.text: I see you're supporting us |PLAYER_NAME|. |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| honors you.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.zhText: 我看到了你正在帮助我们，|PLAYER_NAME|。|CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 会因此而给予你荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.text: We must defeat |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|. Thank you for siding with |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING|.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordSuppo.zhText: 我们必须打败 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|。感谢你与 |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 站在同一边。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.text: How dare you oppose |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|?! We will defend this Sector with everything we've got.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.zhText: 你竟敢与 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| 相抗争？！我们将尽我们所拥有的一切来守住这一地区。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.text: This betrayal will not go unanswered. This Dark Sector belongs to |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|!
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.zhText: 你的这次背叛将会得到报应。这个黑暗地带属于 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|！

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.text: You really think |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| should own this Dark Sector?
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.zhText: 你真的认为 |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 应该拥有这个黑暗地带吗？

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.text: Tenno or not, we will crush |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| for opposing us here.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.zhText: 不管你们是不是Tenno，我们都将因 |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 在这一区域反抗我们而击垮它。
|CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 将会为这次的侵略而感到后悔！

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.text: |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| will not forgot what your actions here today |PLAYER_NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.zhText: |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| 不会忘记你今天在这的所作所为，|PLAYER_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.text: You are wasting your time |PLAYER_NAME|. |NODE_NAME| belongs to |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.zhText: 你在浪费你的时间，|PLAYER_NAME|。|NODE_NAME| 属于 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|。

/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.text: Know this. |CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| will never take |NODE_NAME| from |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING|. This is our rail.
/Lotus/Language/DarkSectors/WarlordTaunt.zhText: 记住。|CLAN_NAME_SUPPORTING| 永远无法从 |CLAN_NAME_ATTACKING| 这夺走 |NODE_NAME| 。这是我们的航道。

/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.text: The victim and beneficiary of Parvos Granum's research into Specter Particle Theory, this is all that remains of the Protea Warframe who sacrificed herself to keep Granum safe in a pocket realm beyond time.
/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.zhText: Protea 既是帕尔沃斯·格拉努的"魅影粒子理论"研究的受益者，也是受害者。在完成了自我牺牲，并将格拉努安全地封存在一个超越时间的口袋空间后，这是这个战甲所残存下来的全部痕迹，仅此而已。
Protea 魅影

/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.text: Build the Xoris in the Foundry
/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.zhText: 在铸造厂里制作驱魔之刃
入侵 CORPUS 系统

/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.text: A power struggle within the Corpus elite has erupted. Seeking control, Nef Anyo looks to the past... to the very origins of the Corpus itself.
/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.zhText: Corpus 内部爆发了一场始于 Corpus 精英之间的权力斗争。为了夺取控制权的奈富·安尤着眼于过去……追溯到了 Corpus 自身的起源。

/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.text: DETONATE THE XORIS WHILE PROTEA REWINDS!
/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.zhText: 在 PROTEA 回溯时引爆驱魔之刃！
进入格拉努虚空

/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.text:
Outworlder,

The progress you've made in reconstructing Protea is incredible. I'm pleased to tell you that in being able to study Parvos' Warframe more closely I've made a discovery that you may find useful.

I certainly hope so.

Yours,

The Business
/Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQ.zhText:
异世者，

你在重塑 Protea 的工程中取得了惊人的进展。在此，我很荣幸地告知你：在对帕尔沃斯的战甲进行了更加深入的研究之后，我有了一个新发现，而这个发现或许可以帮到你。

这也是我的殷切期望。

你的朋友，

操盘手
奇异之物
拦截司库
回到福尔图娜
