/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/AcceltraDeluxe2Sk.text: Gauss Moto's signature Acceltra rifle skin embodies the philosophy of hitting hard and fast, leaving enemies in the dust.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/AcceltraDeluxe2Sk.zhText: Gauss 摩托的标志性迅发电浆炮步枪外观体现了快速猛击、将敌人远远甩在身后的理念。
迅发电浆炮 氮速外观

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeBHel.zhText: Banshee 挽歌的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeBSki.text: Banshee Threnodia's stark visage is an inexorable omen of death. Her mournful apparition brings despair to the wicked, her song the dirge of defeat.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeBSki.zhText: Banshee 挽歌的冷峻面容，是死亡的无情预兆。她哀伤的身影给恶人带来绝望，她的歌声是失败的哀乐。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeGlyp.text: Cadaverous beauty calls to souls in the dead of night. A glyph for your profile created by community artist Mischka.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeGlyp.zhText: 死寂之美在深夜里呼唤着灵魂。这是由社区艺术家 Mischka 为你个人档案创作的浮印。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.text: An eerily twisted mask attachment for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.zhText: 守护宠物诡异扭曲的面具配件。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.text: An eerily twisted skin for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.zhText: 守护宠物诡异扭曲的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.text: An eerily twisted tail attachment for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.zhText: 守护宠物诡异扭曲的尾部配件。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.text: Eerily twisted wing attachments for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BansheeDeluxeSent.zhText: 守护宠物诡异扭曲的飞翼附件。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIIAux.zhText: Baruuk 少室的标志性仪式披肩。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIICro.text: The dignified drape of Baruuk Shaoshi's signature signa is the mark of a warrior committed to defending peace - by any means necessary.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIICro.zhText: Baruuk 少室标志性头环的庄严图案，象征着一位不惜一切代价致力于捍卫和平的战士。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIIEph.text: Encircled by harmonious energy, the shifting balance of conflict reveals itself in Baruuk Shaoshi's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIIEph.zhText: 在和谐能量的环绕下，冲突的微妙平衡在 Baruuk 少室的标志性幻纹中显露出来。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIIHel.zhText: Baruuk 少室的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIIMac.text: Baruuk Shaoshi's signature Sword & Shield skin evokes the ancient arms carried by sacred guardians, those who embraced the balance between defense and attack.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIIMac.zhText: Baruuk 少室的标志性剑盾外观让人联想起古代神圣守护者所持的武器，他们秉持着攻守平衡的理念。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIISki.text: Fear the gaze of Baruuk Shaoshi's mystic eye. His martial mastery, honed over long ages of defending sacred ground, is once again brought to bear against all enemies of peace.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/BaruukDeluxeIISki.zhText: 畏惧 Baruuk 少室那神秘的目光吧。他世代守护圣地所磨练出的武艺，如今再次被用来对抗一切威胁和平的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/CalibanDeluxeBowS.text: This bow skin is haunted by the spirits of the dead trapped within, and hungers to create more.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/CalibanDeluxeBowS.zhText: 这副弓箭外观被困在其中的亡魂所萦绕，渴求着制造更多亡魂。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYEp.text: Bring forth the fiery steeds of Dagath Yfari’s signature ephemera to follow in your footsteps.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYEp.zhText: 让 Dagath 伊法里的标志性幻纹中那些炽热的骏马追随你的脚步。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYHe.zhText: Dagath 伊法里的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYHo.text: The Tales of Duviri tell of the Gynfas Kaithe visiting homes on a moonless night. To deny it entry is to invite dire misfortune. A fitting steed for Dagath Yfari.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYHo.zhText: 《双衍王境故事集》讲述了画布绝灵骥会在无月之夜造访各家各户。将它拒之门外会招致可怕的厄运。它是 Dagath 伊法里的最佳坐骑。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYHo.text: The macabre light of the Gynfas Kaithe’s tail has haunted many a moor and battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYHo.zhText: 画布绝灵骥尾巴上那阴森的光芒，曾萦绕许多荒野和战场。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYSk.text: Dagath Yfari alights with ghostly flames. Her phantom cavalry also assumes a new and macabre aspect, their haunting visitation betiding woe for those who unwisely turn them away.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/DagathDeluxeLNYSk.zhText: Dagath 伊法里全身燃起幽灵般的火焰。她的幽灵骑兵也呈现出一种新的、阴森恐怖的面貌，他们阴森的造访预示着那些不明智地拒绝他们的人将遭受厄运。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIIArmo.text: Vast speeds require state-of-the-art plating. Gauss Moto's signature chestplate.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIIArmo.zhText: 极致的速度，需要最先进的护甲。Gauss 摩托的标志性胸甲。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIIBund.text: Kick into high gear with the Gauss Moto Collection. The Saint of Altra enters a new era.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIIBund.zhText: Gauss 摩托系列，助你火力全开。阿尔特拉圣者步入全新时代。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIICrow.text: No speedster's look would be complete without Gauss Moto's signature signa.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIICrow.zhText: 没有 Gauss 摩托的标志性头环，任何极速战士的造型都不算完整。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIIHelm.zhText: Gauss 摩托的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIILets.text: Grendel Turbis drops in for a race.

Grendel Turbis drops in for a race.

Equip this emote using the Gear Wheel tab in your Arsenal. This emote can be used by any Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIILets.zhText:
Grendel 暴坦空降赛场。

可在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项卡中装备此表情动作。此表情动作可由任意战甲使用。
提速表情动作（Grendel 助阵）

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISigi.text: This sigil won't just buff out.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISigi.zhText: 这枚纹章不会轻易被抹去。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISigi.text: High speed movement can leave its mark. Gauss Moto's signature sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISigi.zhText: 高速疾行，必会留下痕迹。Gauss 摩托的标志性纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISkin.text: Become a kinetic blur with the turbocharged Gauss Moto. What cannot be hit cannot be killed.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISkin.zhText: 化作动能残影，驾驭涡轮增压的 Gauss 摩托系列。无法被击中的存在，就无法被消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISyan.text: Sleekly aerodynamic, Gauss Moto's signature syandana is made for speed.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussDeluxeIISyan.zhText: Gauss 摩托的标志性流线型空气动力学披饰，专为极速而生。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussGrendelDelux.text: Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis: keep this inseparable odd couple together forever.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GaussGrendelDelux.zhText: Gauss 摩托和 Grendel 暴坦：让这对形影不离的奇特组合永远在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIAr.text: How much armor is too much armor? With Grendel Turbis' signature chestplate, more is more.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIAr.zhText: 多少护甲才算过量？对于 Grendel 暴坦的标志性胸甲来说，越多越好。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIBu.text: Gain new appreciation for mastication with the Grendel Turbis collection. Those who see what lies within his gaping maw rarely live to tell the tale.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIBu.zhText: 通过 Grendel 暴坦系列，重新领略咀嚼的真谛。能亲眼目睹他巨口深处的人，鲜少能活下来讲述这段经历。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIEm.text: Gauss Moto drops in to kick it real quick.

Gauss Moto drops in to kick it real quick.

Equip this emote using the Gear Wheel tab in your Arsenal. This emote can be used by any Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIEm.zhText:
Guass 极速登场。

可在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项卡中装备此表情动作。此表情动作可由任意战甲使用。
超能抛接表情动作（Gauss 助阵）

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIEp.text: The ground trembles to herald your arrival. Grendel Turbis' signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIEp.zhText: 大地震颤，宣告你的到来。Grendel 暴坦的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIIHe.zhText: Grendel 暴坦的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIISi.text: Prey cannot hide from the piercing gaze of Grendel Turbis' signature signa.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIISi.zhText: 猎物无法躲避 Grendel 暴坦标志性头环那穿透一切的目光。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIISk.text: Beware the howling maw. The imposing silhouette of Grendel Turbis inspires gnawing dread with the opening of his ventral hatch.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIISk.zhText: 当心那张咆哮的巨口。Grendel 暴坦威压十足的身影在开启腹部舱门之际，会唤起噬骨般的恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIISy.text: Be prepared for anything from a firefight to a midnight snack with Grendel Turbis' signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/GrendelDeluxeIISy.zhText: 佩戴 Grendel 暴坦的标志性披饰，无论是战场交锋还是午夜加餐，都要随时做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeBundle.text: Master the art of transmutation with this collection of skins and items for Lavos Khymia.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeBundle.zhText: 掌握炼制术之奥秘——Lavos 点金外观与装备组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeCrownD.text: Keep the light of knowledge always in view with Lavos Khymia's signature signa.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeCrownD.zhText: 通过 Lavos 点金的标志性头环，始终照亮知识之光。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeEpheme.text: Ethereal serpents slither in your caustic wake with Lavos Khymia’s signature Ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeEpheme.zhText: 通过 Lavos 点金标志性的幻纹，空灵的蛇影将在你留下的腐蚀性尾迹中蜿蜒爬行。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeHelmet.zhText: Lavos 点金的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeShotgu.text: Prescribe enemies a lethal dose with Lavos Khymia’s signature shotgun skin.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeShotgu.zhText: 通过 Lavos 点金的标志性的霰弹枪外观，对敌人施以致命的打击。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeSigilD.text: The touch of alchemy leaves its mark, permeating the entire body. Lavos Khymia's signature sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeSigilD.zhText: 炼金术的触感留下了痕迹，渗透到了整个身体。Lavos 点金的标志性纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeSkinDe.text: The master of transmutation embraces the process that made him, imbued with the volatile quintessence of alchemy.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeSkinDe.zhText: 炼制术的大师拥抱造就自身的过程，浸透着炼金术那易变的精髓。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeSyanda.text: Many a specimen has felt the sting of this wearable apparatus. Lavos Khymia’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/LavosDeluxeSyanda.zhText: 许多实验对象都曾感受到这件可穿戴设备的刺痛。Lavos 点金的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/MasseterDeluxeGre.text: Carve through the toughest of meat with Grendel Turbis' signature heavy blade skin.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/MasseterDeluxeGre.zhText: 通过 Grendel 暴坦的标志性巨刃外观，轻松斩开最坚韧的血肉。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/PagemasterDeluxeG.text: The dark feathers of Dante Tytonis' Exalted Tome lift arcane secrets to the skies.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/PagemasterDeluxeG.zhText: Dante 夜鹰的显赫典籍夜枭上那深色羽毛，将玄奥的秘密高高托举入云霄。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/PagemasterDeluxeH.zhText: Dante 夜鹰的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/PagemasterDeluxeS.text: Knowledge glides on dark wings, silent and sure. Dante Tytonis knows wisdom is power.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/PagemasterDeluxeS.zhText: 知识乘着黑暗的翅膀，悄无声息却坚定地飞翔。Dante 夜鹰深知智慧即力量。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/PagemasterDeluxeW.text: Death soars swiftly closer with Dante Tytonis' signature feathered warfan skin.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/PagemasterDeluxeW.zhText: Dante 夜鹰标志性的羽毛武扇外观，让死亡的阴霾步步紧逼。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ProteaDeluxeGlaiv.text: Eliminate your adversaries with fluid grace.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ProteaDeluxeGlaiv.zhText: 以行云流水般的优雅姿态消灭你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeArchG.text: The Mandonel archgun, chiseled from the same ancient stone as Qorvex Basilica.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeArchG.zhText: 辐光弩炮曲翼枪械，由与 Qorvex 圣殿一样的古老石头雕刻而成。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeEphem.text: Beckon Qorvex Basilica's fluttering fellows to your side with his signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeEphem.zhText: 通过他的标志性幻纹，将 Qorvex 圣殿里那些翩翩起舞的伙伴们召唤到你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeHelme.zhText: Qorvex 圣殿的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeSkinD.text: Avert the gaze of evildoers with the intricately carved spires of Qorvex Basilica. His grim shadow is a symbol of protection for his allies.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeSkinD.zhText: Qorvex 圣殿那精雕细琢的尖顶，足以让恶徒们望而却步。他那阴沉的背影象征着对盟友的庇护。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeSyand.text: Qorvex Basilica's signature syandana perches on your shoulders, keeping a sharp eye over all.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/QorvexDeluxeSyand.zhText: Qorvex 圣殿的标志性披饰栖息在你的肩膀上，锐利的目光俯瞰一切。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/VorunaDeluxeArmAr.text: Default armor set for the Voruna Medeina Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/VorunaDeluxeArmAr.zhText: Voruna 梅迪娜外观的默认护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/VorunaDeluxeEphem.text: The wolf-tail plume of Voruna Medeina’s signature ephemera displays the refined nature of an inner beast.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/VorunaDeluxeEphem.zhText: Voruna 梅迪娜的标志性幻纹中的狼尾羽展现了内在野兽的精致本性。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/VorunaDeluxeHelme.zhText: Voruna 梅迪娜的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/VorunaDeluxeSkinD.text: Voruna appears as a glorious forest goddess, loyal wolves comprising her graceful armor. The savage huntress is also a protector of the innocent, revered by those unjustly hunted.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/VorunaDeluxeSkinD.zhText: Voruna 是一位荣耀的森林女神，忠诚的狼群构成了她优雅的盔甲。这位凶猛的女猎手同时也是无辜者的守护者，受到那些遭受不公正猎杀者的敬仰。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBDual.text: Wukong Qitian’s signature skin for the Sun & Moon features expert ornamentation fit for a king, a far cry from the austere origins of the blades.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBDual.zhText: Wukong 齐天大圣的赤阳 & 幽月标志性外观，具有尽显王者气度的精美装饰，与刀刃的朴素起源相去甚远。
天地赤阳 & 幽月外观

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBGlyp.zhText: 描绘着 Wukong 齐天大圣外观的浮印。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBGlyp.text: Born from stone, now immortalized by it in this profile glyph.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBGlyp.zhText: 从石头中诞生，如今通过这个个人档案浮印而永垂不朽。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBHelm.zhText: Wukong 齐天大圣的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBKata.text: Wukong Qitian’s signature Nikana skin, for use with a single blade.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBKata.zhText: Wukong 齐天大圣的标志性侍刃外观，专为单刃设计。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBSigi.text: Show due respect for Wukong Qitian’s power and cunning with this sigil.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBSigi.zhText: 用这个纹章来表达对 Wukong 齐天大圣的力量和狡黠的尊重。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBSkin.text: Trickster, warrior, king. Wukong Qitian emerges supreme to claim his rightful title.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBSkin.zhText: 七十二变者、斗战者、大圣。Wukong 齐天大圣傲立巅峰，夺得了属于他的王者称号。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBStaf.text: Iron Staff skin to match the Wukong Qitian Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBStaf.zhText: 搭配 Wukong 齐天大圣外观的定海神针外观。
Wukong 齐天大圣定海神针外观

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBSuga.text: Wukong Qitian’s signature sugatra bestows dignity and poise upon any weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/WukongDeluxeBSuga.zhText: Wukong 齐天大圣的标志性坠饰，赋予所有武器尊贵和优雅。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ZephyrQTCCDeluxeB.text: Fly high with this bundle that uplifts both Zephyr and the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ZephyrQTCCDeluxeB.zhText: 通过这个组合包翱翔天际，同时鼓舞 Zephyr 和征服癌症活动的士气。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ZephyrQTCCDeluxeH.text: The standard helmet for Zephyr Conquera.

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ZephyrQTCCDeluxeS.text: An elegant skin for Zephyr with roseate accents, worn in support of the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ZephyrQTCCDeluxeS.zhText: 带有玫瑰色点缀的优雅 Zephyr 外观，用于支持征服癌症活动。

/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ZephyrQTCCDeluxeS.text: The wind uplifts this winglike syandana, as it does all who partake in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Language/Deluxe/ZephyrQTCCDeluxeS.zhText: 风吹动着这件翼状披饰，就像它吹动着所有参加征服癌症活动的人一样。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Loot Radar marks the loot around you in the mini-map, including Mods, Resources, Syndicate Medallions, and more! Try out Thief's Wit or other Mods with Loot Radar to see for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 「寻物雷达」会在迷你地图中标记你周围的物资，包括 Mod、资源、集团奖章等等！尝试用「盗贼天赋」或其他带有「寻物雷达」的 Mod，亲眼验证一下。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Warframes and Weapons have 3 Appearance and Mod Config Slots to easily swap between builds and cosmetics! 3 additional slots can be purchased with Platinum for even more options.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 战甲和武器有 3 个外观和 Mod 配置槽位，可以轻松地在配置和装饰之间切换！可以使用白金购买 3 个额外的槽位以获得更多选择。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Increasing your Mastery Rank also unlocks an additional trade per day for every Rank earned.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 精通段位会随着每一阶的提升而解锁额外一次的每日交易次数。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Check for MOA Cabinet Spawners on Corpus Outpost missions. Hacking their Cabinets will deploy an allied Shockwave MOA for your team.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 查看 Corpus 前哨站任务中生成恐鸟的储藏柜，入侵它们的储藏柜可以为你的队伍部署一只友军震荡恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Mastery Rank points are earned by ranking up Warframes, Weapons, Companions, and more! Expand your Arsenal and level up equipment to progress towards your next Mastery Test.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 段位经验可以通过升级战甲、武器、同伴以及更多途径来获取！扩展你的军械库并将装备升级以更接近下一阶的段位考试。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Visit The Index on Neptune to invest and potentially earn large sums of Credits by facing off against Nef Anyo's Brokers.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 访问海王星上的指数之场进行投资，通过与奈富·安尤的经纪们对峙有可能获得大量现金。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Share bug reports on the official Warframe Forums at forums.warframe.com! The more detail you can provide, including screenshots or video, the better.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在《Warframe》官方论坛：forums.warframe.com 上分享错误报告！你能提供的细节（包括截图或视频）越多越好。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: See where Resources can be found by selecting the Resources Drones button in the Star Chart. Zoom into a planet and hover over the Extractor icon to see what Resources are available. Planets with completed nodes can have Extractors deployed on them for passive Resource generation.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过星图中的「资源无人机」按钮，查看可以找到资源的地点。放大一个星球并将鼠标悬停在「采集机」图标上以查看可采集的资源。可以在解锁所有节点的星球上部署「采集机」以收获被动资源。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Grineer Blunts are great at blocking bullets. Level the battlefield by using them to your advantage as cover against the onslaught.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Grineer 的便携掩体能够很好地阻挡子弹。利用它们作为掩护，平衡战局并在敌军猛攻时获得优势。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Helios can use Synthesis Scanners charges to scan enemies if there are no Codex Scanners in your Gear Wheel.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 如果你的携带装备轮盘中没有资料库扫描器的话，守护「赫利俄斯」可以使用「结合扫描器」的充能数来扫描敌人。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Visit Cephalon Simaris in the Relays to purchase a Sol-Battery Widget to give your Synthesis Scanner infinite charges.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 造访中继站的中枢 Simaris 来购买「太阳能电池改造器」，从而使你的结合扫描器拥有无限扫描次数。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Life Support Capsules in Survival missions restore 30% Life Support and modules dropped by enemies restore 5%. Maximize the return on Capsules by activating them only when Life Support is below 70%
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在生存任务中，维生装置能恢复 30% 的生命维持水平，同时敌人掉落的小型维生模块则只能恢复 5%。只在生命维持水平低于 70% 的情况下使用维生装置，这样就能最大化发挥维生装置的功效。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Different enemy Factions have their own damage Vulnerabilities and Resistances. Check the Mission Node before embarking to see which damage types to bring for maximum damage!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 不同的敌人派系有各自的伤害弱点和伤害抗性。在开始之前查看任务节点，看看造成最大伤害的伤害类型是什么！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Use Forma to add or change a Polarity of your choice to Max Rank equipments. Doing so will reduce Mod capacity drain and reset the item to Rank 0.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用 Forma 为满级装备添加或更改你想要的极性。这样做会减少 Mod 容量消耗并将该装备重置为 0 级。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Test Warframes and Weapons against scanned enemies in the Simulacrum. Gain access by purchasing a Simulacrum Access Key from Cephalon Simaris in the Relays.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在「幻影装置」中使用已扫描的敌人来测试战甲和武器。解锁此处需要购买一个「幻影装置存取密钥」，该密钥通过中继站内的中枢 Simaris 获取！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: You can practice upcoming Mastery Rank tests and re-play completed ones by visiting Cephalon Simaris' Sanctuary in the Relays.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 你可以在中继站里通过中枢 Simaris 的「圣殿」来练习即将到来的精通段位测试并重玩已完成的测试。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Visit www.warframe.com/droptables for a comprehensive list of in-game drop tables.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 访问 www.warframe.com/droptables 以获取一份完整的游戏内物品掉落表。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: You can Fast Travel to many Points of Interest in Relays, Clan Dojos, and Open Landscape Hubs by using the Gear Wheel or Pause Menu and selecting your destination.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过使用携带装备轮盘或打开暂停菜单选择你的目的地，你可以「快速移动」到中继站、氏族道场和开放世界中的多个兴趣点位置。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Pledge loyalty to a Syndicate via the Syndicate Segment in your Orbiter to earn 15% of Affinity as Standing with them. Take note of which Syndicates are hostile towards you, as they may send Death Squads after you in Missions!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过轨道飞行器中的集团模块向集团宣誓效忠，从而将获得经验值的 15% 转化为集团声望。要留意哪些集团对你怀有敌意，因为他们可能会在任务中派遣死亡小队追捕你！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: If an Excavator in an Excavation mission is close to being destroyed, bring it a Power Cell to restore its Shields.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 如果在挖掘任务中「挖掘机」处于被毁坏的边缘，给它送去一个「能量电池」就能使其护盾复原。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The location of Baro Ki'Teer's next visit will be marked in your Star Chart when he is close to arriving. You'll also receive an inbox message when he arrives that indicates which Relay he's visiting.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Baro Ki‘Teer 下次到访的位置会在他即将抵达时标记在你的星图中。你也会在他抵达时收到一条收件箱信息，通知你他这次到访的中继站。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Void Trader Kiosk is always available in the Relays to exchange Prime Parts and Blueprints for Ducats and will display a countdown timer for Baro Ki'Teer's next visit.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在中继站中，虚空商人交易站可随时提供将 Prime 部件和蓝图兑换成杜卡德金币的服务，并且会显示 Baro Ki'Teer 下次来访的倒计时。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Void Trader, Baro Ki'Teer, appears every two weeks with special wares. A kiosk in the Relays will allow you to exchange your spare Prime parts for Ducats, which he will gladly trade for unique cosmetics and other exclusive items.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 虚空商人，Baro Ki‘Teer，每两周会带着他的特别货物来访。你可以在各中继站的交易台用多余的 Prime 部件换取杜卡德金币，他非常乐意用独树一格的装饰与各种独有的道具与你交换金币。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Keep a lookout for bright blue Cephalon Fragments in-mission. Scanning them will unveil pieces of Cephalon Ordis' memory in your Codex.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在任务中睁大眼睛注意亮蓝色的中枢碎片。扫描这些碎片将在你的资料库中解锁 Ordis 的记忆片段。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Cephalon Fragments and Somachord Tones are automatically marked in your Minimap when using Loot Radar mods such as Thief's Wit.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用寻物雷达 Mod （比如盗贼天赋）时，中枢碎片以及身心和弦琴音调会自动标记在你的小地图上。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Vector-Thread Widget for Synthesis Scanners will reduce the amount of time required to complete a scan. Combine this with the Cross-Matrix Widget for a chance at double the scans.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 「结合扫描器」的「矢量线程改造器」能降低完成扫描所需的时间。结合使用「交叉矩阵改造器」则能以一定几率让一次扫描算作两次扫描。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Increase your Focus Point gains by leveraging Stealth Kill Affinity Bonuses, or playing Sanctuary Onslaught missions for the guaranteed Convergence Boost at the start of each Zone.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过利用隐秘击杀经验值加成来获取更多的专精点数，或是游玩圣殿突袭任务以在每个区域开始时必获得汇聚增益。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Install a Focus Lens on a max-Rank Warframe, Weapon, or other equipment in your Arsenal to earn Focus Points. Install Lenses from different Schools across your loadout to gain Focus in multiple Schools at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在你军械库中满级的战甲、武器或其他装备上安装专精晶体以获得专精点数。在你的装备中安装不同学派的专精晶体，以同时获得多个学派的专精。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment can be acquired by purchasing it from the in-game Market, researching the Blueprint in your Clan Dojo, or by killing Hyekka Masters.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 「库娃孵化器升级模块」可以通过在游戏内商店购买、在氏族场道场研究蓝图或者击杀鬣猫驯兽师获得。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Upgrade your Kavat with the Sharpened Claws Mod and sunder enemy armor with each attack. Combine this with the Swipe Mod to strike several enemies at once.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 用「磨锋之爪」Mod 升级你的库娃，每一次攻击都可撕开敌人的护甲。将其与「挥击」Mod 结合起来以同时打击数个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Feral Kavats wander around missions located on Deimos and can be scanned for a chance at Kavat Genetic Codes. Collect 10 to incubate a Kavat Companion with the Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment installed in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 野生的库娃游荡在火卫二的任务中，对其扫描即有机会获取「库娃基因密码」。集满 10 个后，就可以用安装在轨道飞行器上的「库娃孵化器升级模块」来孵化一个库娃同伴！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Squad Shield, Health, Energy, and Ammo Restores can be a life-saver for you and your squad! Equip them onto your Gear Wheel before going into missions.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 团队护盾、生命值、能量和弹药补给会成为你和你团队的救命之物！在执行任务之前将它们装备到你的携带装备轮盘上。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Unlock new Landing Crafts to earn their specialized Air Support Charge. You can equip your Air Support of choice via the Landing Craft category in your Orbiter Menu and call them in using Air Support Charges from your Gear wheel. Air Support Charges can be crafted in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 解锁全新的登陆艇以获取独特的「空中支援呼叫器」效果。你可以通过轨道飞行器选单中的登陆艇类别来装备想要的空中支援，并在携带装备轮盘中使用它。「空中支援呼叫器」可以在铸造厂中制造。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Abilities that stun, slow, or put enemies to sleep can make them easier to scan. This is especially useful on slippery targets, such as Feral Kavats.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 眩晕、缓速或使敌人沉睡的技能会让他们更容易扫描。尤其是对狡猾的目标特别有效，例如野生的库娃。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Heliocor melee weapon automatically scans targets it kills if you have Codex or Synthesis Scanners equipped on your Gear Wheel. You can purchase the blueprint from Cephalon Simaris in the Relays.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 如果你的携带装备轮盘上装有「资料库扫描器」或「结合扫描器」，近战武器赫利俄光锤会自动扫描它杀死的目标。你可以从中继站的中枢 Simaris 处购买其蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Equip the Glyph Prism to your Gear Wheel to display your selected Glyph in-mission.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 将浮印光谱装备到你的携带装备轮盘上，在任务中显示你所选的浮印。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Grineer Forest missions located on Earth have a day/night cycle that changes every four hours. Vegetation also shifts between Sunlight and Moonlight variants that can be scanned for Antitoxins and Apothics.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 地球上的 Grineer 森林任务拥有每 4 个小时改变一次的昼夜周期。植物也会在日光和月光变体之间转换，对它们进行扫描以制作解毒剂和药剂。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Link an item in chat using [ square brackets ] and typing in the name. Fellow Tenno will be able to click on the Link to view the item details.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在聊天中使用 [ 方括号 ] 链接一个物品，并输入其名称。其他 Tenno 伙伴便能点开链接查看物品详情。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Complete Junctions to unlock Quests, challenges, rewards, and other secrets hidden across the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 完成接合点来解锁系列任务、成就、奖励以及其他隐藏在始源星系的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Save big, Tenno! Visit Darvo's store in the Relays to see what deals he has to offer.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 省超多，Tenno！到中继站拜访 Darvo 的商店来看看他提供了哪一些优惠。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Invasion missions can reward unique Resources, Weapon Parts, and more! Ensure you have completed the required amount of missions indicated in the Invasion Screen. Rewards are delivered via Inbox message once the Invasion is complete.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 入侵任务可以奖励独特的资源、武器部件等等！确保你已完成入侵界面中指示的所需数量的任务。入侵完成后，奖励将通过收件箱信息发送。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Adjust your HUD Scale setting in the Interface Options to increase or decrease the visibility of damage numbers, Health and Shield Stats, Weapon Stats, Minimap, and more.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在界面选项中调整你的界面元素尺寸设置以增加或减少伤害数字、生命值和护盾值、武器数据源、小地图等的可见度。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Sliding and rolling in very quick succession is a great way to increase your mobility when needed. Tack on bullet jumping at peak momentum and Aim Glide to achieve maximum distance.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 快速地连续滑行和翻滚是在需要时增加机动性的好方法。在旋身飞跃达到最高动量时加上飞身瞄准来达到最大距离。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Loadout Slots allow you to save your current Loadout for easy access in the future. Earn new Loadout Slots through Mastery Rank progression! Select the Loadout name to open your Loadout Menu, where you can favourite, rename, and view all current Saved Loadouts.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 配置槽位可以保存当前的配置，方便以后快速使用。通过提升精通段位来获得新的配置槽位！选择配置名称以打开你的配置菜单，你可以在其中设置最爱、重命名，和查看所有当前已保存的配置。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: When playing Solo you can pause the game by opening the Menu, with the exception of  Open Landscape missions.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在单人模式下你可以打开菜单暂停游戏，但开放世界任务除外。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Plan for Spy and Rescue missions by crafting and equipping Ciphers onto your Gear wheel. Ciphers can be used after beginning a terminal hack to instantly complete hacking.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 为间谍和救援任务做好计划，制造并装备「破解器」到你的「携带装备轮盘」中。开始入侵终端后可以使用「破解器」立即完成入侵。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: You can sell extra or unwanted equipment, blueprints, and more via the Inventory category of your Equipment sub-menu.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 你可以通过装备子菜单中的「仓库」类别出售额外或不需要的装备、蓝图等。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Hover over Prime parts in the Fissure reward selection screen to see their Ducat Value.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 把鼠标悬停在裂缝奖励选择界面的 Prime 部件上来查看它们的杜卡德金币价值。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Acquire Dragon Key blueprints in the Orokin Lab of your Clan Dojo. After building them in your Foundry, you can equip these Keys in your Gear Wheel to unlock Orokin Vaults, but be wary as each equipped Key comes with its own debilitating debuff.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在氏族道场的奥罗金实验室中获取「龙钥蓝图」。在铸造厂将其制造完成后，你可以将这些钥匙装备在你的携带装备轮盘中以解锁奥罗金宝库，但要小心，因为每把装备好的钥匙都有其自带的削弱减益效果。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Transmutation Cores remove the credit cost in transmutation and guarantees the Polarity of the resulting Mod. Visit Cephalon Simaris in the Relay to purchase them with Standing.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 转换核心可以省下转换时的费用，而且可以保证转出 Mod 的极性。拜访位于中继站的中枢 Simaris 用它的声望来购买转换核心。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The official Warframe Companion App allows you to claim and deploy Extractors, use your Foundry, manage Companions, refine Void Relics, get the latest Warframe news, and much more from your mobile device. Download the App in the App Store or Google Play.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Warframe 官方助手应用可以让你在移动设备上领取和部署提取器，使用你的铸造厂，管理同伴，精炼虚空遗物，获得最新的 Warframe 新闻等等更多内容。在 App Store 或 Google Play 下载该应用程序。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: There are dedicated Chat tabs for Recruiting, Questions, and Trading that can be enabled/disabled in your Chat Options. Use these tabs to find a Squad or Clan, to ask for help, or to Trade with other Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在你的聊天选项中，有专门用于招募、提问、交易的聊天标签，可以对其启用/禁用。使用这些选项卡可以找到小队或氏族以寻求帮助，或者与其他 Tenno 进行交易。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Completing Junctions grants you 1,000 Mastery points each!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 完成每个接合点可获得 1000「精通段位」点数！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Stealth kills grant an Affinity Bonus, with successive kills in a short time span increasing this bonus. An icon will appear in your HUD when triggered, displaying the Affinity Bonus and time remaining.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 隐秘击杀可获得经验值加成，短时间内的连续隐秘击杀会增加此加成。触发时，你的界面中会出现一个图标，显示经验值加成和剩余持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Codex and Synthesis Scanners highlight enemies through walls, which can be used to get an edge in missions that require a stealthy approach.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 「资料库扫描器」和「结合扫描器」可穿透过墙壁标示敌人，可以在隐秘击杀的任务中使用它们来获得优势。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Exchange duplicate Mods for Endo or Credits in the Mod Segment of your Orbiter. The rarer the Mod, the better the returns!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在轨道飞行器的 Mod 工作台将重复的 Mod 换成内融核心或现金。Mod 越稀有，回报就越好！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Earn Prime Parts and Blueprints from Void Relics by opening them in Void Fissure Missions.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过在虚空裂缝任务中打开虚空遗物获得 Prime 部件蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Opening a Relic by collecting 10 Reactant in Void Fissure missions will grant you a Corruption buff! The buff and its duration is indicated in the HUD upon triggering alongside a glowing Corruption effect on the buffed equipment.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在虚空裂缝任务中收集 10 个「反应物」可以打开一个虚空遗物，里面会给你一个堕落增益！触发时，增益及其持续时间会在界面中显示，同时在受加成影响的装备上会出现发光的堕落化效果。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Relic drop locations can be found in the second tab while hovering over the Relic in your Void Relics menu. You can also search for specific Relics using the Universe tab in your Codex.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 将鼠标悬停在虚空遗物菜单中的遗物上方时，可以在第二个选项卡中找到遗物掉落位置。你还可以使用资料库中的"总览"选项卡搜索特定遗物。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Equip Loot Radar mods to help find Resource Caches that spawn in certain Sabotage and Exterminate missions or Bounties. When looking for Resource Caches, listen for their distinctive high-pitched chime to find their location.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 装备「寻物雷达」Mod 有助于在特定的破坏、歼灭或者赏金任务中找到生成的资源储藏箱。寻找资源储藏箱时，注意听它们独特的高音铃声来辨别它们的位置。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Void Traces are used in the refinement of Void Relics to alter the drop chances of its rewards. Earn Traces in Void Fissure and Railjack Void Storm missions.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 虚空光体可用于精炼虚空遗物以改变其奖励的掉落几率。可以在虚空裂缝和虚空风暴任务中获得虚空光体。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Void Trace capacity starts at 100 and increases by 50 for each Mastery Rank. For example, Mastery Rank 9 has a Void Trace cap of 550!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 「虚空光体」容量从 100 开始，每升一级精通段位增加 50 容量。比如精通段位等级 9 的「虚空光体」容量上限是 550！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Grineer Prosecutors are highly vulnerable to <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage that matches their aura.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Grineer 判官极易受到与其光环相匹配的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰、<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻、<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Maximize the Focus Points earned from Focus Lenses by installing them on your most-used Equipment.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过将专精点数安装在你最常使用的装备上，来最大化从专精晶体获得的专精点数。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Focus Lenses can be equipped on maximum rank Warframes, Weapons, Archwings, Arch-Guns, Arch-Melees, Necramechs, K-Drives, and Gilded Amps to convert Affinity on that equipment into Focus.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 专精晶体可以装备在满级的战甲、武器、曲翼、曲翼枪械、曲翼近战武器、殁世机甲、K 式悬浮板和已镀金的增幅器上，以将这些装备上的经验值转化为专精。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Staying within Shared Affinity Range (50 meters) of your squad is a great way to get Affinity for Equipment or Focus Points.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 待在小队的共享经验值范围（50 米）内是获得装备经验值或专精点数的好方法。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Fosfor Gear items acquired from Nakak in Cetus can be used to temporarily increase your Shared Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 从希图斯的娜卡处获得的磷光装备可用于短暂扩大你的共享经验值范围。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Your daily maximum on earning Focus Points increases with your Mastery Rank. Each Rank increases the daily maximum by an additional 5,000.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 每天可获得的专精点数上限随着精通段位升高而增加。每个段位增加 5000 每日上限。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Zenurik Focus School contains several ways to help you cast Warframe abilities as often as possible. Consider Zenurik for overall improved Energy reserves.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Zenurik 专精学派包含多种方法来帮助你尽可能频繁地施放战甲技能。要全面提高能量储备，可以考虑 Zenurik 。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Vazarin Focus School's Mending Unity passive affects the range of Warframe abilities that scale off Affinity Range, such as Trinity's Blessing, Citrine's Preserving Shell, and Harrow's Covenant and Penance.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Vazarin 专精学派「愈合团结」被动技能会影响战甲技能的范围，这些技能都是受经验共享范围影响的技能，例如 Trinity 的「祝福」、Citrine 的「封存护壳」、Harrow 的「庇佑圣约」和「苦行加护」。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Vazarin Focus School provides a variety of ways to protect your allies, Companions, and Defense objectives. Consider Vazarin for improved protection of your squad and other priority targets.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Vazarin 专精学派提供多种方式来保护你的友军、同伴和防御目标。要更好地保护你的小队和其他优先目标，可以考虑 Vazarin。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Grineer Heavy Gunners and Corpus Techs are equipped with weapons that have a high rate of fire. Stay on the move and weave around obstacles to evade their attacks, or roll to reduce damage taken by 75%
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Grineer 重型机枪手和 Corpus 技师具备高射速的武器，保持移动及绕开障碍物，以躲避他们的袭击；或翻滚以降 75% 受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Abilities like Mag's Pull or the Vazarin Focus School's Void Snare can group enemies up tightly. Consider using a Weapon with Punch Through to make even better use of these abilities.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 像 Mag 的「吸引」或 Vazarin 学派的「虚空陷落」这样的技能可以将敌人紧紧地聚集在一起。可以考虑使用具有穿透效果的武器以更好地发挥这些技能的作用。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Madurai Focus School increases the damage potential of Operator and Warframe in a variety of ways. Consider Madurai to take your offense tactics to another level.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Madurai 专精学派以多种方式增强指挥官和战甲的伤害潜力。可以考虑使用 Madurai 将你的进攻战术提升到另一个层次。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Naramon Focus School excels in and amplifies Melee combat while incapacitating enemies, leaving them vulnerable to deadly follow-up attacks. Consider Naramon for an up close and personal approach.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Naramon 专精学派擅长并增强近战战斗，同时使敌人失去行动能力，使他们容易受到致命的后续攻击。若想体会其近距离和个性化的战斗模式，可以考虑 Naramon。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Unlocking Focus School Way-Bound passives allow you to use them across any active Focus School.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 解锁专精学派绑定状态的被动技能可以让你在任何激活中的专精学派使用它们。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Unairu Focus School prioritizes defenses by bolstering your own and stripping enemies of theirs. Consider Unairu for a balance between an offensive and defensive approach.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Unairu 专精学派将防御视为重点，加强自己防御的同时削弱敌人的防御。若想在进攻和防守方法之间取得平衡，可以考虑 Unairu。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Eidolon Shards can be converted into Focus Points beyond the daily maximum by using the "Focus Conversion" option in a selected Focus Tree.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过在选定的专精技能树中使用"专精转化"选项，可以将夜灵碎片转化为每日上限之外的专精点数。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Focus Convergence Orbs massively increase Focus Points earned for a limited time and earn you a bonus 5,000 Focus for your equipped Focus School upon pickup! Cephalon Simaris guarantees a Focus Convergence Orb at the start of every Sanctuary Onslaught wave after the first.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 拾取专精球会为你装备的专精学派增加 5000 专精，并在有限时间内大幅增加获得的专精点数！在圣殿突袭波次中，中枢 Simaris 在第一波后的每一波开始时都会保证有一个专精球。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Corpus Candidates can spawn after the completion of The War Within and Call of the Tempestarii Quests. Offer a Zenith Granum Crown to enter the Granum Void and reach Rank 1 to spawn a Candidate. Downing a Candidate shows a preview of the Tenet Weapon that the created Sister of Parvos will reward you. Finish the Candidate to spawn your Sister!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Corpus 候选者可以在完成《内战》和《风暴的呼唤》系列任务后生成。提供一枚顶级格拉努硬币以进入格拉努虚空，达到等级 1 以生成一名候选者。打倒候选者会显示将创造的帕尔沃斯姐妹信条武器奖励的预览。解决掉候选者，以生成你的帕尔沃斯姐妹！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Missions on nodes that are under the Influence of your Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos will be subject to a Reward Tax. All of your stolen rewards will be returned to you upon Vanquishing or Converting your foe.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在赤毒玄骸或帕尔沃斯的姐妹们影响范围内的节点上的任务必须缴纳奖励税。在击杀或感化对手后，所有被偷走的奖励会被归还。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Whether you defeat Kuva Thralls and Liches on your own Lich's nodes of influence, or on a separate planet with a friend, you will still earn Requiem Murmur progress.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 无论你是在自己的赤毒玄骸所占领节点上或是与朋友在一个别的的星球上击败赤毒奴仆和玄骸，你仍然会获得安魂密语的进展。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Railjack missions are designed for everyone to take on a different role. Be the pilot, gunner, engineer, or even go board enemy ships! Unlock your own Railjack by completing the Rising Tide quest.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 航道星舰任务旨在让每个人都能扮演不同的角色。成为飞行员、炮手、工程师，甚至登上敌舰！完成《澎湃狂潮》系列任务来解锁你自己的航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Open Landscape areas such as The Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis, and Cambion Drift contain Bounties that give rewards for each Stage completed. Complete the bonus objective in the Bounty Stage to receive an extra reward!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 夜灵平野、奥布山谷和魔胎之境等开放世界内有赏金任务，每完成一个阶段都会给予奖励。完成赏金阶段的额外目标以获得额外奖励！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Ores and Gems are acquired via mining. Various mining tools can be acquired from Old Man Suumbat in Cetus and Smokefinger in Fortuna to drill into resource deposits found around the Open Landscapes.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 矿石和宝石是通过采矿获得的。从希图斯的老者 Suumbat 和福尔图娜的烟指处可以获得各种采矿工具，以钻探在开放世界周围发现的资源矿藏。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Conserve Wildlife in Open Landscapes by purchasing specialized gear from The Business, Master Teasonai, or Son. Use your Tranq Rifle to subdue the animal and earn Tags. The sneakier your capture, the more Tags you'll earn.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 从操盘手、提松奈大师或"儿子"处购买专门的装备，来在开放世界中保育野生动物。使用麻醉步枪制服动物并获得标签。捕捉的过程越隐秘，你获得的标签就越多。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Fish can be caught in various lakes, rivers, and oceans in Open Landscapes. Visit any of their Hubs to acquire specialized spears from the designated fishing vendor. Once you have a catch, you can have Vendors cut it up for resources, turn it into a Trophy, or even provide it for Standing.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在开放世界的各种湖泊、河流和海洋中可捕获鱼类。访问那里的中心城镇，从指定的钓鱼商人那里获得专用的鱼叉。一旦抓到鱼，你就可以让钓鱼商人将其切割以获取资源、将其变成奖杯，甚至用来换取声望。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: There are many secrets hidden within the Origin System, progress through Quests to uncover and access new nodes and locations!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 始源星系中隐藏着许多秘密，在系列任务中取得进展来发现和访问新的节点和地点！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Grappling Hook attacks can be countered quickly by cutting the rope, or rolling / bullet jumping to pull your foe towards you. Act fast, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 抓钩攻击可以通过切断绳索或滚动/旋身飞跃将敌人拉向你来进行快速反击。快行动吧，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Citrine and her signature weapons, Steflos and Corufell, can be obtained from the Tyana Pass Node on Mars, which is unlocked after completing the Heart of Deimos quest.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Citrine 和她的标志性武器石晶之花和闪劫可以从火星上的 Tyana Pass 节点获得，该节点在完成《惊惧之心》系列任务后解锁。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Mastery Rank 30 and above players can activate their True Master's Font blessing in a Relay once every 24 hours. There are a variety of Blessings to choose from to bestow onto all players in that Relay instance.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 精通段位等级 30 和以上的玩家，每 24 小时可以在中继站中激活他们的至崇宗师祝福之泉。可以从多种祝福中来选择，以授予该中继站里的所有玩家。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: In order to Rank up with a Syndicate and unlock more offerings for purchase you must reach the maximum possible amount of Standing for the current Rank and sacrifice the requested items.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 为了在集团中升级声望等级并解锁更多可供购买的商品，你必须获得当前声望等级的最大数量，并贡献需要的物品来提升集团声望等级。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Syndicate Medallions can be found throughout Syndicate Alert missions and can be traded in for Standing in Relays. Standing from Syndicate Medallions and Alerts can be redeemed even if you have hit your daily cap.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 集团奖章可以在整个集团警报任务中找到，并且可以在中继站中用于换取声望。即使你已达到每日声望上限，来自集团奖章和集团警报任务的声望仍可以被兑换。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Many Warframes can be acquired via Assassination missions. Once you have earned the individual Blueprints, they can be completed in your Foundry!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 许多战甲可以通过「刺杀」任务获得。一旦你获得了单独的蓝图，就可以在你的铸造厂中制造它们！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Your Parazon is upgradable with Mods that can benefit both hacking and Mercy kills.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 你的灭骸之刃可以通过 Mod 来升级，可同时增强入侵和怜悯之击的效益。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Add an Aura Mod to your Warframe or a Stance Mod to your Melee Weapon to increase their Mod capacity. Matching Polarities doubles the amount!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 为你的战甲添加一个光环 Mod 或为你的近战武器添加一个架式 Mod 以增加它们的 Mod 容量。匹配的极性会使 Mod 容量翻倍！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Exilus Warframe Adapters unlock an additional Mod slot where you can equip Exilus Mods on your Warframe. You can obtain blueprints from Cephalon Simaris in the Relays or purchase them fully-built with Platinum from the in-game Market.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 战甲特殊功能槽连接器可解锁一个额外的 Mod 槽位，让你可以在你的战甲上安装特殊功能 Mod。你可以在中继站中的中枢 Simaris 那里获得蓝图，或者从游戏内商店用白金购买已经造好的战甲特殊功能槽连接器。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Exilus Weapon Adapters unlock an additional Mod slot where you can equip Exilus Mods on your Primary or Secondary weapon. You can obtain blueprints from Syndicates and Requiem Relics, or purchase them fully-built with Platinum from the in-game Market.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 武器特殊功能槽连接器可解锁一个额外的 Mod 槽位，让你可以在你的主要或次要武器上安装特殊功能 Mod。你可以从集团或安魂遗物那里获得蓝图，或者从游戏内商店用白金购买已经造好的武器特殊功能槽连接器。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Your equipped Warframe (The Progenitor) used when creating a Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos impacts abilities your foe will have. The Element type of their Tenet or Kuva Weapon is determined by the Progenitor Warframe as well!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 你在创造赤毒玄骸或帕尔沃斯的姐妹们时所装备的战甲（源身）会影响你的对手所拥有的技能。他们的信条或赤毒武器的元素类型也由这个源身战甲决定！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Grineer Drahk Masters can disarm you. If they’ve relieved you of your weapon in battle, look for the yellow marker to recover it.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: Grineer 爪喀驯兽师能卸除你的装备！如果他们在战斗中解除了你的武器，寻找黄色的标记来重获它！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Punch Through allows a projectile to travel through an obstacle to hit an enemy. Try using it to hit enemies crouching behind cover or using shields!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 穿透能让一个投射物穿过障碍物击中敌人。尝试用它来击中蹲在掩体后面或使用盾牌的敌人！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Keep an eye out for Ghoul Purge, Thermia Fractures, Fomorian Sabotage, and Razorback Armada events in the Star Chart. They appear periodically for a short time and have their own unique rewards!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 留意星图导航中的尸鬼净化、热美亚裂缝、破坏巨人舰队和利刃豺狼舰队事件。它们会定期短暂地出现，并有其独特的奖励！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Travel quickly through the Plains of Eidolon, Orb Vallis, and Cambion Drift by using Blinkpads! Teleport between locations by interacting with a Blinkpad or opening your map and selecting a Blinkpad location.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用「传送台」快速穿越夜灵平野、奥布山谷和魔胎之境！通过与「传送台」互动或打开地图并选择一个「传送台」位置，在不同位置之间进行传送。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Nora Night presents daily, weekly, and elite weekly Acts for Nightwave. Complete Acts to increase your Nightwave Rank and obtain rewards, including Nightwave Creds used to to purchase goods from the Cred Offerings store.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 诺拉·夜会为《午夜电波》主持每日、每周和每周精英行动。完成行动以提高你的《午夜电波》等级并获得奖励，包括用于购买午夜电波商店商品的午夜电波兑换币。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Orbiters can be decorated! Access full customization via the Orbiter category in your Equipment Menu. Avid decorators should try out the Advanced Mode in the Decoration screen for even more placement and positioning options.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 轨道飞行器是可以装饰的！通过「装备」菜单中的「轨道飞行器」类别来进行全面的自定义。热衷于装饰的人可以尝试装饰界面中的「高级模式」以获得更多放置和设置选项。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Clan Dojos are home to research labs which contain blueprints for Weapons, Warframes, and more! Build Labs in your Clan Dojo to see what research is available.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 氏族道场是研究实验室的所在地，其中包含武器、战甲、及更多道具的蓝图！在你的氏族道场中建造实验室，看看有哪些研究可以被研发。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Earn Clan Affinity by completing research and first-time builds for specific rooms or decorations. Build an Ascension Altar to perform an Ascension Ceremony for ranking up the Clan after obtaining enough Clan Affinity.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过完成研究以及首次建造特定房间或装饰来获得氏族经验值。获得足够的氏族经验值后，建造晋升祭坛来进行晋升仪式以提升氏族的等级。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Ascension Ceremonies in a Clan Dojo last for 72 hours. Clan members who visit during this time can claim Endo by interacting with the Ascension Altar.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 氏族道场的晋升仪式持续 72 小时。在此期间访问的氏族成员可以通过与晋升祭坛互动来获得内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Change the appearance of rooms in your Clan Dojo using Polychromes. You can research colors for Polychromes in the back of the Tenno Lab. Hunt down specific enemies to collect pigments to contribute to a specific color's research.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用彩像仪更改氏族道场中房间的外观。你可以在 Tenno 实验室的后方研究彩像仪的颜色。追捕特定的敌人以收集颜料，为特定颜色的研究做出贡献。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Somachord tones can be found on all over the Origin System once you have unlocked your Personal Quarters. Scanning Somachord tones unlocks songs that can be played via the Somachord in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 一旦你解锁了你的个人房间，就可以在整个始源星系中找到身心和弦琴音调。扫描身心和弦琴音调可解锁相应歌曲，并可通过轨道飞行器中的身心和弦琴播放。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Oxium Ospreys have a guaranteed drop of Oxium when destroyed. They are also capable of self-destructing and will leave nothing behind if they do, so attack them quickly!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 摧毁奥席金属鱼鹰能保证掉落奥席金属。它们也具有自我摧毁的能力，而且一旦启动便会消灭一切，所以尽快攻击它们！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Hijack objectives draw power from your Shields, or directly from your Health for shieldless Warframes like Nidus or Inaros. Bring a loadout with a high Shield Capacity or use Squad Shield Restores to power the objective for longer.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 劫持目标会从你的护盾中汲取能量，或者直接从无护盾的战甲（如 Nidus 或 Inaros）的生命值中汲取能量。装备具有高护盾容量的配置或使用团队护盾补给以延长目标的运作时间。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Visit Cephalon Simaris in the Relays to be given a Synthesis Target. Search for them in missions where that enemy type spawns. Successful Scans earn you and allies within Affinity Range Standing with Cephalon Simaris. Talk to Cephalon Simaris after completing all scans for further rewards.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 访问中继站的中枢 Simaris 以获得结合仪式目标。在生成该敌人类型的任务中搜寻他们。成功的扫描会让你和经验共享的范围的友军获得中枢 Simaris 的声望。完成所有扫描后与中枢 Simaris 交谈以获得更多奖励。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Obtain parts to build your own K-Drive from the Ventkids in Fortuna. Built K-Drives can have Mods installed to improve tricks, combat, and mobility!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 从福尔图娜的通风小子处获取零件来打造你自己的 K 式悬浮板。制造出来的 K 式悬浮板可以安装 Mod 来改善特技、战斗和机动性！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Create your own Modular Weapons such as Amps, Kitguns, and Zaws by purchasing components from Vendors in Cetus, Fortuna, and the Necralisk. Combine various components to build a weapon that is truly your own!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 从希图斯、福尔图娜和殁世幽都的商人处购买组件，来打造你自己的模块化武器，例如增幅器、组合枪和 Zaw。利用不同组件进行组装，打造出真正属于你自己的武器！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Riven Mods are specialized Mods that offer randomized Stats for a specific Weapon. Stats can be re-rolled using Kuva until you find a combination of your liking.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 裂罅 Mod 是专门为特定武器提供随机属性数值的 Mod。可以使用赤毒重新循环，直到找到一组你满意的属性数值。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: If an Interception point is being captured by an enemy, look for nearby enemies hacking terminals. Knocking down or eliminating these enemies can stop the capture.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 如果指挥点被敌人占领，请寻找附近正在入侵终端的敌人。击倒或消灭这些敌人可以阻止他们占领。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Circulus and Yuvarium Nodes on Lua are Conjunction Survival missions, which can reward blueprints and components for Voruna and her signature weapons, Perigale and Sarofang.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 月球上的 Circulus 和 Yuvarium 节点为联结生存任务，其奖励为 Voruna 和她的标志性武器月面狂风和沙罗之牙的蓝图和组件。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Use the Helminth to replace one of your Warframe's abilities, access Invigorations, or install Archon Shards! The Helminth can be unlocked with a Helminth Segment, obtainable from Son in The Necralisk or from the in-game Market with Platinum.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 通过 Helminth 来为你的战甲替换其中一个技能、获得「活化」效果，或是安装执刑官源力石！Helminth 可以通过「Helminth 模块」来解锁，你可以从殁世幽都中"儿子"处获得或是在游戏内商店使用白金购买。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Rolling into Corpus defense grid lasers will let you avoid being knocked down if timed perfectly!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 如果你的时机把握得准确，可以在 Corpus 防御激光网格中翻滚以避免被击倒！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Eximus units have an additional defense mechanism called Overguard, granting them a unique Health buffer (indicated by the teal effect around their health bar) and granting immunity to Crowd Control effects until destroyed. Look out for their bright Auras which indicate their Eximus type and ability.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 卓越者单位具有一个名为超宏防护的额外防御机制，为他们提供独特的生命加成条（由他们生命值周围的蓝绿色效果表示）并在加成条被摧毁前为他们提供免疫群体控制的效果。留意他们的明亮光环，这表明了他们的卓越者类型和能力。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Companions will become incapacitated when they run out of health, resting until they are ready to return to battle. Some can even be revived by you and your allies to accelerate their return!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 当同伴的生命值耗尽时，他们会变得失去战斗能力，进入休息状态直到可以返回战斗。有些甚至可以被你和你的队友复活以加速他们的归队！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Each Companion has its own Precept Mods which provides them with their own unique abilities. Earn new Companions to gain more options to tackle different challenges.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 每个同伴都有自己的指令 Mod，这为他们提供了自己独特的能力。获得新的同伴以获得更多选择来应对不同的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Equip your weapons with Elemental Mods to grant them Heat, Cold, Electricity, or Toxin damage. These elements can also be combined together with a weapon's base Elemental Damage or with other Elemental Mods to create entirely new damage types!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 为你的武器装备元素 Mod 以赋予它们火焰、冰冻、电击或毒素伤害。这些元素也可以与武器的基础元素伤害或其他元素 Mod 组合在一起，创造出全新的伤害类型！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Ayatan Sculptures can be found randomly hidden around mission maps, while Ayatan Stars can be found in containers and lockers. Speak to Maroo in her Bazaar on Mars once a week for an Ayatan Treasure Hunt with a guaranteed Ayatan Sculpture to retrieve!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 「阿耶檀识塑像」随机隐藏在任务地图四处，而「阿耶檀识之星」可以在容器和储物柜中找到。每周在火星市集与 Maroo 交谈一次，进行一次必定有阿耶檀识塑像可取的宝物狩猎！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Upgrade Ayatan Sculptures with Ayatan Stars using the Ayatan Sculpture category found in the Mod Segment in your Orbiter. They can be exchanged with Maroo in her Bazaar on Mars for Endo, traded with other players, or used as a decoration in your Orbiter or Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在你轨道飞行器上的 Mod 模块找到「阿耶檀识塑像」类别，使用阿耶檀识之星升级阿耶檀识塑像。它们可以用于在火星上 Maroo 的市集交换内融核心，与其他玩家交易，或作为你轨道飞行器或氏族道场中的装饰品。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: There are many Quests to complete with an abundance of rewards including unique Warframes, Weapons, and Missions. To see all Quests and their requirements, check out the Quest section in the Codex.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 许多系列任务完成后可获得丰厚的奖励，包括独特的战甲、武器和任务解锁。要查看所有系列任务和它们的前置条件，请查看资料库中的「系列任务」区块。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: There are different breeds of Kubrow, Kavat, Predasite, and Vulpaphyla -- each with their own Precept Mods, which provide unique abilities to the Companion!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 不同品种的库狛、库娃、扑猎达赛和狐帕菲拉——每一种都有自己的指令 Mod，为此同伴提供独特的技能！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: The Duviri Paradox Quest is available to all players, new and experienced! Start your journey through Duviri by beginning the Quest via the Codex.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 《双衍悖论》系列任务对所有玩家开放，无论新手还是老手！通过资料库开始任务，开启你的双衍王境之旅。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Kuva Larvlings can spawn in missions with Grineer over level 20 after completing The War Within. Downing a Larvling shows a preview of the Kuva Weapon that the created Kuva Lich will reward you. Finish the Larvling to spawn your Lich!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在完成《内战》后，赤毒幼体可以在超过 20 级的 Grineer 任务中生成。击倒幼体可预览其创造的赤毒玄骸的武器奖励。处决此幼体以生成你的玄骸！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Just short of your next Mastery Rank? Check out the Market for new blueprints and weapons, available for Credits!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 距离你的下一个精通段位还差一点？前往商店查看新的蓝图和武器，都可以使用现金购买！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Customize your HUD colors, enemy and ally highlighting, enable subtitles, and more in the Accessibility Options.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在无障碍选项中自定义你的界面元素颜色、敌人和友方高亮显示、启用字幕还有更多功能。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Warframes gain a brief period of invulnerability when their shields expire. The more shields you have upon Shield Break, the longer the invulnerability!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 当护盾失效时，战甲会获得一段短暂的无敌状态。护盾击破时你拥有的护盾越多，无敌状态的时间就越长！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Hover over Equipment's stats in the Arsenal to learn more about that stat's function. Stats marked with a diamond have secondary stats which appear on hover.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 将鼠标悬停在军械库中的装备属性数值上，以了解有关该数据功能的更多信息。标有菱形的属性数值可在悬停时显示辅助属性数值。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Ammo Mutation Mods convert a portion of the Primary, Secondary, and Heavy ammo pickups into the type noted on the Mod.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 「弹药转换」Mod 将一部分拾取的主要、次要和重型弹药转换为 Mod 上注明的特定弹药。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Increase the speed of slow-firing weapons with Fire Rate Mods such as Speed Trigger.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用「灵敏扳机」等射速 Mod 来提高慢射速武器的速度。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Some Warframe abilities can buff you and your allies. Try using Volt's Speed or Valkyr's Warcry near allies to give them the effects too!
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 一些战甲技能可以增强你和你的友军。尝试在友军附近使用 Volt 的「加速」或 Valkyr 的「咆啸」来给他们带来加成！

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Reload your weapons whenever you are on the move to prepare you for the next encounter.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 移动时别忘了装填武器，为下次交战做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Be careful how close you are to your enemy when you fire an explosive! <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage will stagger or even knock you down if you are too close to the detonation.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 发射爆炸物时要小心与敌人的距离！如果你离爆炸太近，<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害会让你失衡甚至被击倒。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Roll or backflip to shake off enemies that attach to your Warframe, such as Latchers or Maggots.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 翻滚或后空翻以甩掉附在你战甲上的敌人，例如粘子炸弹或蛆虫。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Scanning an unalerted enemy with your Codex Scanner will yield 2 Codex Scans.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用资料库扫描器成功扫描到尚未警觉的敌人将可获得两次的扫描数。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Void Death Orbs favor Prime Warframes and will grant a one-time burst of Energy when approached.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 虚空中的「死亡宝珠」偏好 Prime 版战甲，Prime 版战甲靠近时会给予一次性爆发的能量。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Warframes have 4 Revives per mission. Equipping a Rank 3 or higher Warframe Arcane grants an additional Revive up to a total of 6 per mission.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 每次任务中战甲有 4 次复活次数。装备等级 3 或更高等级的战甲赋能可以获得额外的复活次数，最高达到每个任务 6 次。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Argon Crystals begin decaying 24 hours after from when you acquire them and each day at GMT 00:00. Use them to craft items that require them as soon as possible before they disappear from your inventory.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 氩结晶在获取 24 小时后开始衰退，并且在每天的格林尼治时间 00：00 点进行衰退结算。趁它们消失之前，尽早用于制作物品吧。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Completing a Codex Entry unlocks information about an enemy's strengths, weaknesses, and other valuable information. Get the edge over your opponents by scanning often.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 完成资料库写入的动作可以解开敌人的优势、弱点与其他富有价值的资讯。多多扫描，知己知彼，百战百胜。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Assassination Missions offer a higher drop chance of rare resources as well as unique blueprints as reward when you kill your target.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 刺杀任务有更高几率掉落稀有资源，目标刺杀成功时也会奖励独特蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Increase the amount of Mods you can equip on a Warframe or Weapon by upgrading it with an Orokin Reactor or Catalyst to double its Modding Capacity.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用「奥罗金反应堆」或「奥罗金催化剂」来增加你战甲或武器上的 Mod 容量，使其获得双倍 Mod 容量。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Enemies can still hear the sound of your guns when you're invisible. They will return fire based on the sound's location. Try using a silent weapon or noise reducing Mods to avoid drawing attention.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 当你隐身时，敌人仍然可以听到你的枪声。他们会根据声音的位置进行还击。尝试使用无声武器或降噪 Mod 以避免引起他们的注意。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Mark rare Resources, Ayatan Sculptures, Kurias, or anything interesting with your "Place Marker" binding to inform teammates of their location.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 用你的"放置标记"按键绑定标记稀有资源、阿耶檀识塑像、库利亚猫神器或任何你想标记的物品，来告知队友它们的位置。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: If you receive a transmission from an Assassin like Stalker while in-mission, mark your position or group up with your squad to take them on together.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 如果你在任务中收到了来自比如追猎者这样的刺客的通讯，标记下你的位置或与你的小队会合一起对付他们。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Stay within 50 meters of your squadmates and objectives for maximum Affinity sharing. The number of Tenno within your Affinity Range is indicated by the number underneath the Affinity icon <AFFINITY_SHARE> in your HUD.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 为了最大化共享经验值，停留在与你的队友和目标距离 50 米以内的范围。在你的经验值范围之内的 Tenno 数，是由你的游戏界面经验值图标 <AFFINITY_SHARE> 下面的数字显示。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Use the Recruiting Chat Channel or switch your Matchmaking to Public to find a squad that can help you tackle missions.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 使用「招募/组队」频道或将你的匹配模式切换为公开来找到一个可以帮助你完成任务的小队。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Trade with your fellow Tenno at a Trading Post in a Clan Dojo or by visiting Maroo's Bazaar on Mars.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 在氏族道场中的交易亭可以与你的 Tenno 伙伴交易，或是拜访位于火星的 Maroo 的市集。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Multiple Tenno can revive a squadmate or Ally at the same time for a speedier recovery.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 多名 Tenno 可以同时复活一名队友或同伴，以加快复活速度。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: You can crawl to cover while bleeding out! Move to a spot where your squad can revive you safely.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 出血濒死之际，你依然可以挣扎爬行至掩蔽物后！尽快移动到队友能安全复活你的位置。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Aura Mod effects stack across squadmates. Coordinate Loadouts with your squad for maximum results. Aura Mods equipped by your squad can be seen by hovering over their name in the pause Menu.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 光环 Mod 的效果会在小队成员之间叠加。与你的小队成员协调配置以获得最佳效果。你的小队成员装备的光环 Mod 可以通过在暂停游戏时，将鼠标悬停在成员的名字上看到。

/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.text: Death Marks can be found on your Profile in-game. Squading up with Tenno with the same Mark will yield you a higher chance of the Assassin spawning. Players can also summon any Assassin with the use of their Beacon in-mission.
/Lotus/Language/DesignCouncilTips/DC_Tip.zhText: 你可以在游戏内的个人档案中找到死亡标记。与其他被标上同样死亡标记的伙伴组队会增加刺客的出现几率。玩家还可以在任务中使用相应的信标来召唤任何刺客。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo2Intro.text: A Tenno must be a master of all their weapons. Prove yourself with your Primary Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo2Intro.zhText: 一名 Tenno 必须精通自己的各种武器。展示你对主要武器的掌握吧。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo3Intro.text: Prove your ability with a sidearm. Eliminate all targets.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo3Intro.zhText: 证明你对次要武器的能耐，剿灭所有目标。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo4Intro.text: Show me that you know of the old ways. Eliminate all targets using your Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo4Intro.zhText: 展现你的传统技法，用近战武器击杀所有目标。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo5Intro.text: You have proven your skills with weapons Tenno, but what of your endurance? Can you survive this onslaught?
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo5Intro.zhText: Tenno，你已经表现出你使用各种武器的能力，但你的耐久力又如何呢？你可以于这场猛攻中存活下来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo6Intro.text: Tenno are more than just fighters. Prove your intellect by hacking these terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo6Intro.zhText: Tenno 不能单单只是一介武夫。入侵系统解锁来证明自己头脑也不差。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo7Intro.text: Time to test your marksmanship. Track and shoot all targets.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo7Intro.zhText: 是时候测试你的枪法了。射击所有目标物。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo8Intro.text: Your Warframe is a weapon. Prove you have mastered its power.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo8Intro.zhText: 你的战甲也是一件武器强有力的武器。像我证明你能够 100% 释放战甲的威力。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo9Intro.text: Now we will test your agility. Shoot the targets to create your path.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_Dojo9Intro.zhText: 现在我们要测试你的敏捷度。请朝目标射击，清出一条路。

/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_DojoSuccess.text: A formidable performance. This test is now complete.
/Lotus/Language/Dojo/Trans_DojoSuccess.zhText: 测试完成，你的表现太出色了。

/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/DojoColorNotR.zhText: 在 Tenno 实验室中研究该颜色来解锁。
