/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/GenericSkybox.zhText: 相关房间的可替换背景。

/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_0.text: Add color to Dojo rooms with Polychrome Dyes.
/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_0.zhText: 使用彩像仪染料为道场房间增添色彩。

/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_1.text: While researching a Dye, specific Enemies will start to drop Pigment for all Clan members.
/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_1.zhText: 在研究染料时，特定敌人会开始为该氏族所有成员掉落颜料。

/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_2.text: See which Enemies will drop a Pigment in the Tenno Lab.
/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_2.zhText: 可以在 Tenno 实验室中查看哪些敌人会掉落颜料。

/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_3.text: Clan members can fund a Dye's research by the contributing necessary Pigment in the Tenno Lab.
/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_3.zhText: 氏族成员可以通过在 Tenno 实验室捐献必要的颜料来资助染料的研究。

/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_4.text: To apply a Polychrome Dye, place a Polychrome Decoration in the Dojo using the Decorations menu.
/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/Hint_4.zhText: 要应用彩像仪染料，请在道场中使用装饰菜单来放置彩像仪。

/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/PaintBotChang.text: Changes saved. Fully fund Polychrome construction for changes to be applied.
/Lotus/Language/DojoPaints/PaintBotChang.zhText: 更改已保存。请为彩像仪建设提供充足的资金，以便应用更改。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/AbortMissionConfi.text: Leave Duviri: You will keep all resources, rewards, and Intrinsics obtained up to your last earned Decree. Are you sure you want to leave Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/AbortMissionConfi.zhText: 离开双衍王境：你将保留截至上次获得王令时所有获得的资源、奖励和内源之力。你确定要离开双衍王境吗？

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/AbortMissionConfi.text: Leave The Circuit: You will keep all progress and rewards earned up to the last Stage you completed. Are you sure you want to leave The Circuit?
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/AbortMissionConfi.zhText: 离开无尽回廊：你将保留最后完成阶段之前获得的所有进度和奖励。确定要离开无尽回廊吗？

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/AreYouSure.text: Are you sure you want to install an Incarnon Genesis on |NAME|?
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/AreYouSure.zhText: 确定要在 |NAME| 上安装灵化之源吗？

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/BoonTutorialText.text: Press |CALLOUT| to view and select a Decree.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/BoonTutorialText.zhText: 按下 |CALLOUT| 以查看并选择一个王令。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/CaveCombatGoal.text: PURGE THE DARKENED AREAS OF LIMINUS

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/ConfirmCustomizat.text:
Accept |TYPE| appearance and continue?
This can be changed later.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/ConfirmCustomizat.zhText:
确认|TYPE|的外观并继续？
这稍后也可以更改。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DefaultRewardText.zhText: 活动完成。奖励： |INTRINSICS| 内源之力 |BOONS| 王令。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.text: Intrinsics are permanent upgrades for your Drifter and apply to every Duviri visit.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.zhText: 内源之力是对你的漂泊者的永久性升级，适用于每次的双衍王境之旅。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.text: Intrinsic Points can be earned in The Circuit or by completing objectives, encounters, and more throughout the Duviri landscape.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.zhText: 内源之力点数可通过无尽回廊，或在双衍王境世界中完成任务目标、打败敌人以及更多活动中获得。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.text: Intrinsic Points cannot be reallocated once invested, so make your choices carefully!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.zhText: 内源之力点数一经投入则无法更改，请慎重选择！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.text: Each Intrinsic rank gained rewards 1,500 Mastery points for a total of 60k after completing all classes.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.zhText: 每提升一个内源之力等级奖励 1,500 段位经验，所有等级提升至最高可获得累计 60,000 段位经验。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.text: Overguard grants Drifter and Warframe additional Health protection and Knockdown immunity as long as there is an amount remaining.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.zhText: 只要数量有剩余，超宏防护就会为漂泊者和战甲提供额外生命值的保护，和击倒免疫。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.text: Perform a Precise Parry by timing a Melee block at the exact moment an enemy is attacking. Doing so allows you to perform a Finisher on them by Melee attacking while they are vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.zhText: 在即将遭受敌人攻击的时刻施展格挡来精确地招架攻击。以此让敌人陷入破绽，这时对敌人进行近战攻击即可处决敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.text: Drifter's Restorative ability restores 100 Health and clears Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterHints/Drif.zhText: 漂泊者的「恢复药剂」技能可以恢复 100 生命值并清除异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 提高漂泊者的战斗能力。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Each Decree you acquire grants +10% Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 你获得的每个王令可提供 +10% 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: In Duviri, using an Ability increases damage by 150% for 3s.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中，使用技能时伤害提高 150%，持续 3 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: In Duviri, Restorative boosts movement speed for 5s.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中，获得恢复效果时移动速度提高，持续 5 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Unlock Transference Surge, the ability to briefly summon a Warframe in Duviri by pressing <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_4> when transference bar is full.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 解锁传识暴涨，在双衍王境中传识条已满时按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_4>，获得短暂召唤一个战甲的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Unlock Transference Surge, the ability to briefly summon a Warframe in Duviri by holding <POWER_MENU> then pressing <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_4> when transference bar is full.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 解锁传识暴涨，在双衍王境中传识条已满时按住 <POWER_MENU> 然后按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_4>，获得短暂召唤一个战甲的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: In Duviri, Drifter Power Strike cooldown is reduced by 30%.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中，漂泊者强力攻击冷却时间减少 30%。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: In Duviri, Drifter Ability cooldown is reduced by 20%.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中，漂泊者技能冷却时间减少 20%。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: In Duviri, the Guiding Hand ability will expose a Weak Point on enemies for 10s. Hitting a Weak Point will deal 3x damage.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中，「引领之手」技能会暴露敌人的弱点 10 秒。击中一个弱点可造成 3 倍伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: In Duviri, weapon critical hit chance increases by +20%, additively.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中，武器暴击几率增加 20%，按加法计算。
将传识暴涨的持续时间增加 50%。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Drifter deals +25% damage. In the Origin System, both Drifter and Operator receive this boost.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 漂泊者造成 +25% 的伤害。在始源星系中，漂泊者和指挥官都可获得这个加成。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Rank up the Riding Intrinsic to acquire the Summon Kaithe ability
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 升级骑术内源之力以获得召唤绝灵骥技能

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Boost the Drifter’s powers of survival.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 提高漂泊者的生存能力。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Each Decree you acquire grants +25 Max Health to Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 你获得的每个王令都会为漂泊者的最大生命值增加 25。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Fatal damage leaves you at 20% Health and invulnerable for 3s, 200s cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 受到致命伤害时保留 20% 生命值并获得 3 秒无敌，冷却时间 200 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Selecting a Decree fully restores Health and Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 选择王令时完全恢复生命值和能量。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: One additional Revive is available in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中获得一次额外复活机会。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Parry grants +25 Health. Precise Parry grants +50 Health.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 招架可获得 +25 生命值。精确招架可获得 +50 生命值。
漂泊者的最大生命值额外 +50% 。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: On precise Parry, gain extra charge for Transference Surge.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在精确招架时，获得额外的传识暴涨充能。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Landing a headshot restores +10 Health/s for 5s.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 造成爆头时每秒恢复 10 生命值，持续 5 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: One additional Revive is available in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在双衍王境中获得一次额外复活机会。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Gain +5 Health/s as Drifter. In the Origin System, both Drifter and Operator receive this boost.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 作为漂泊者每秒恢复 +5 生命值。在始源星系中，漂泊者和指挥官都可获得这个加成。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Mount a Kaithe to Fast Travel to a mounted Drifter
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 骑上一匹绝灵骥，以便快速移动至已装备绝灵骥的漂泊者的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Fast Travel unavailable at this time.
Give the Drifter better luck and more options.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 为漂泊者提升运气并提供更多选择。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Decree selections offer one additional option.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 王令选择中提供额外的选项。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: An unlikely ally will occasionally appear in Teshin's Cave as a playable Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 一个不太可能的盟友偶尔会作为一个可玩战甲出现在 Teshin 的洞穴中。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Gain two additional weapon choices in Teshin’s Cave.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在 Teshin 的洞穴中获得两个额外的武器选择。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Gain a free Decree when you enter Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 当你进入双衍王境时获得免费的王令。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text:
Gain one additional Warframe option in Teshin's Cave.
Preview Duviri loadouts from the Origin System Star Chart.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在 Teshin 的洞穴中获得一个额外的战甲选择。从始源星系星图中预览双衍王境配置。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Discard offered Decrees and get a new selection, up to 3 times per Duviri visit.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 放弃所提供的王令以获得全新的选择，每次访问双衍王境最多可以更换 3 次。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Gain two additional weapon choices in Teshin’s Cave.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在 Teshin 的洞穴中获得两个额外的武器选择。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Gain one additional Warframe option in Teshin's Cave.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 在 Teshin 的洞穴中获得一个额外的战甲选择。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Acrithis's stock now includes one Arcane per day.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 言录使的商店现在每天包含一个赋能。
按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_0> 召唤你的绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Use the map to fast travel to other Drifters.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 使用地图快速前往其他漂泊者的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Hold <POWER_MENU> then tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_0> to summon your Kaithe.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 按住 <POWER_MENU> 再按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_0> 召唤你的绝灵骥。
点击 <IOS_DUVIRI_ABILITY_1> 召唤你的绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Increased resistance to being dismounted by an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 受敌人影响而下马的抗性提升。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: While riding a Kaithe, press <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_2> to command your Kaithe to stomp, knocking enemies back and reducing their armor.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 乘骑绝灵骥时，按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_2> 来命令你的绝灵骥踩踏，将敌人击退并降低其护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: While riding a Kaithe, hold <POWER_MENU> then tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_2> to command your Kaithe to stomp, knocking enemies back and reducing their armor.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 乘骑绝灵骥时，按住 <POWER_MENU> 再按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_2> 来命令你的绝灵骥踩踏，将敌人击退并降低其护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: While riding a Kaithe, press <IOS_DUVIRI_ABILITY_3> to command your Kaithe to stomp, knocking enemies back and reducing their armor.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 乘骑绝灵骥时，点击 <IOS_DUVIRI_ABILITY_3> 来命令你的绝灵骥踩踏，将敌人击退并降低其护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Use the advanced map to fast travel to central Duviri locations and Materliths <DUVIRI_TP>
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 使用进阶地图快速移动至双衍王境中心位置和母石雕像 <DUVIRI_TP>

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Plants and rocks are marked on the map when you ride your Kaithe.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 当你骑着绝灵骥时，地图上植物和岩石会被标记。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: While riding a Kaithe, press <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_3> to dismount and gain 150 Overguard. 150s cooldown between uses.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 乘骑绝灵骥时，按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_3> 下马并获得 150 超宏防护值。冷却时间为 150 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: While riding a Kaithe, hold <POWER_MENU> then tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_3> to dismount and gain 150 Overguard. 150s cooldown between uses.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 乘骑绝灵骥时，按住 <POWER_MENU> 再按下 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_MENU_3> 下马并获得 150 超宏防护值。冷却时间为 150 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: While riding a Kaithe, press <IOS_DUVIRI_ABILITY_4> to dismount and gain 150 Overguard. 150s cooldown between uses.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 乘骑绝灵骥时，点击 <IOS_DUVIRI_ABILITY_4> 下马并获得 150 超宏防护值。冷却时间为 150 秒。
减少冲刺之间的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.text: Receive Kaithe Summon for Origin System Open World missions.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterIntrinsics.zhText: 获得在始源星系的开放世界任务中召唤绝灵骥的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterPuzzleTrac.text: [PH] Find hidden Tabulators and plug them into Datum Aggregators
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterPuzzleTrac.zhText: [PH] Find hidden Tabulators and plug them into Datum Aggregators

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterWeaponPurc.text:
How would you like to purchase this weapon?

Platinum unlocks both the Drifter-compatible and Warframe-compatible weapons. Pathos Clamps unlock the Drifter-compatible weapon and a blueprint for the Warframe-compatible weapon, which you will have to build in the Origin System outside of Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DrifterWeaponPurc.zhText:
你想如何购买这把武器？

使用白金可解锁漂泊者和战甲都适用的武器。 使用苦栓可解锁漂泊者适用的武器还有战甲适用的武器蓝图，你需要在双衍王境之外的始源星系中用这些蓝图铸造武器。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriCircuitStee.text: Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be used to cycle Riven Mods or build rare blueprints.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriCircuitStee.zhText: 赤毒是 Grineer 女皇梦寐以求的一种非常罕见的红色液体。它可以用来循环裂罅 Mod 或者制造稀有蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriCollectible.zhText: 已找到双衍王境的失落岛屿

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriCrateItemDe.text:
Dominus Thrax showed his generosity when he decreed that every Duviri citizen should receive an allotment of Curax.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriCrateItemDe.zhText:
士魂大帝下令每个双衍王境的公民都应该获得士魂供粮的配额，这显示了他的慷慨。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonDropI.text:
The manifestation of Thrax's malevolence that shapes the Orowyrms' outbursts.

Location: Rewarded upon defeating the Orowyrm in Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonDropI.zhText:
士魂大帝恶念的显化之物，塑造了奥金魇龙的情绪爆发。

获取地点：在双衍王境击败奥金魇龙后获得的奖励

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonObjec.text: Use the Orvius to grapple to the Orowyrm.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonObjec.zhText: 使用灵枢来钩住奥金魇龙

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonObjec.text: Attack the Orowyrm's orbs to gain a speed boost.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonObjec.zhText: 攻击奥金魇龙的火球以获得速度加成

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonObjec.text: Traverse to the Orowyrm's head to enter Transference range.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriDragonObjec.zhText: 爬至奥金魇龙的头部以进入传识范围。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriEndlessItem.text:
Its power lies in its potential.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriEndlessItem.zhText:
它的力量在于它的潜能。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriEnemyDropIt.text:
A whisper of the fallen.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriEnemyDropIt.zhText:
亡者的低语。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishAItemDe.text: Some theorize that Duviri stands upon the shell of a giant Inaak. Naturally, some wonder what the giant Inaak stands upon. The answer, of course, is other Inaaks, all the way down.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishAItemDe.zhText: 有些理论认为，双衍王境坐落在一只巨大的载世龟壳上。自然而然地，一些人会想知道巨大的载世龟是站在什么之上的。答案当然是其他载世龟，一个接一个叠到底部。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishBItemDe.text: The Golden Maw finds Xirans exceptionally delicious.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishBItemDe.zhText: 黄金喉兽发现息壤鲳特别美味。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishCItemDe.text: Haav prefer to swim near the surface. Duviri citizens often mistake them for logs, which can be startling when Haav show their fangs.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishCItemDe.zhText: 浮伤鱼喜欢在靠近水面的地方游。双衍王境的公民经常把它们误认为木头，当浮伤鱼露出它们的尖牙时，可能会让人大吃一惊。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishDItemDe.text: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishDItemDe.zhText: 纳土鲉已经进化出收紧尾部肌肉的能力，并把它的尾巴当成一种可怕的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishEItemDe.text: The Seonn's ability to flare its neck and hood makes it impossible for most predators to swallow, but the Golden Maw can overcome its defense.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFishEItemDe.zhText: 精灵鱼的颈部和头鳍可以伸展，让大多数的捕食者无法吞咽，但是黄金喉兽可以攻克它的防御。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
MNEMONIC ADJUTANT
Memory is meaning.

Train yourself to replay your experiences in your mind, as if you were attuned to an Ayatan framework. You will soon find that you are able to disengage the experience from its emotional context. Even in the case of intense, troubling emotions, familiarity can bring habituation and thus, objectivity.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
记忆辅助器
记忆便是意义所在。

就像和阿耶檀识框架进行频率同步一样，训练在自己的脑中重现经历。很快你会发现自己能够将经历从其情感背景抽离出来。即使是从强烈、令人不安的情感中，足够熟练就可以习惯，从而得到客观事实。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
QUADRA TABULATOR
As it alternates between displays, this apparatus reminds us of the importance of shifting perspective. 

A child in the nursery cries because a monstrous face is leering at him, but all he has to do is shift his perspective, and he sees it was nothing but a heap of clothes. We may think we are in eternal love. Oh, how quickly we find it was nothing of the sort!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
方形制表器
通过交替切换展示内容，这个装置揭示了转换视角的重要性。 

比如一个幼儿园的孩子被一张窥视着他的可怕面孔吓哭了，但只要他改变视角，就会发现那不过是堆衣服而已。我们可能以为我们在永恒的爱之中，哦，然而我们很快就会发现根本不是那么回事！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
PROXIMAL VITALIZER
Through contact, energy is transferred.

Learn the ways in which your mind instinctively associates an emotion with a phenomenon, based on prior experience. Once you are adept at this, you will recognize when emotions are arising because of prior association, rather than because they have any business doing so.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
近距离活化器
通过接触，能量得以传输。

了解大脑本能地，基于先前的经验，将情绪与现象联系起来的方式。一旦你掌握了这一点，你就会区分出哪些情绪的产生是因为先前的经历，而不是自发于当下。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
SPECTRAL TABULATOR
Apply the lessons of this device in your analysis of your emotional states.

When turbulent emotions assail you, focus on the details. Learn to identify the discrete elements of your experience. In this way you will find the hidden order in the midst of your personal chaos, just as a prism discovers the hidden colors in white light.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
光谱制表器
将这个装置的经验教训，应用到你自己情绪状态的分析中。

当动荡的情绪袭击你时，要关注它的细节。学会识别你自身经历中不相关联的元素。这样，你就会在你个人的混乱中找到隐藏的秩序，就像用棱镜在白光中发现隐藏的色彩一样。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
OMNIPOTENTIAL SCREEN
Wise is the eye that closes without thought, upon sight of the blinding Sun.

It is sometimes necessary simply to close yourself off from an emotion and process it later. Like a scientist placing a specimen into a container, lock your emotion away. If necessary, place something between you and the emotion - an activity, a mantra, even sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
万能屏
智者是在看到耀眼的太阳时不假思索地闭上眼睛。

有时只需要简单地让自己远离一种情绪，以后再处理它。把你的情绪锁起来，就像科学家将标本放入容器中一样。如有必要，在你和情绪之间放置一些东西——一项活动、一句咒语、甚至睡眠。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
DATUM AGGREGATOR
We are all receptacles of data.

In time, your life experiences will make you into a complete person, a worthy servant of the Orokin Empire. But they can only do this if you accept them, incorporating them into your psyche. To divide parts of yourself off is to be a nation at war with itself.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
数据聚合器
我们都是数据的容器。

迟早，你的生活经历将使你成为一个完整的人，一个奥罗金帝国忠实的仆从。但只有你接受这些经历、将它们融为你心灵的一部分时，它们才能做到这点。把自己的一部分分割出去，就像是一个与自己内战的国家。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
GYROTIC TRANSFORMER
All entities contain fathomless power of which they are ignorant.

There is not one emotion that you cannot use positively, given sufficient discipline. Anger can drive you. Fear can make you alert. Even guilt is useful, for it proves you have failed to live up to your own moral standards. Practice listening to your emotions and putting them to use. You are the master, not they.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
陀螺转换器
所有个体都潜藏着不可估量的力量，只是他们并未意识到。

只要足够自律，每一种情绪都可以得到积极的运用。愤怒能够驱使你前进。恐惧能够使你保持警觉。即使是负罪感也有其用处，它证明了你没有达到自己的道德标准。练习倾听自己的情绪并加以利用。你是主人，它们不是。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.text:
OBLIVIATING ENTANGLEMENT
The hollow ruin, though death for the soldier, is life for the creeping ivy.

Strange though it may seem, the mind's tendency to forget is not necessarily a weakness. The body has its excretory system, whereby we dispose of what we do not need; so too does the mind. Allow yourself to forget that which is useless to your emotional development.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipPuzzleM.zhText:
遗忘纠缠器
荒芜的废墟对于士兵来说意味着死亡，但对于爬满墙壁的常春藤而言却意味着生命。

虽然看起来很奇怪，但大脑的遗忘倾向不一定是一种弱点。身体有排泄系统，我们可以通过排泄系统排出不需要的东西；大脑也是如此。让自己忘记那些对情感发育无用的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipbookPuz.text: At least two of you are required to open The Paragrimm's Hutch.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFlipbookPuz.zhText: 至少需要两人才能打开幽幽鹰的储存柜。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFractalItem.text:
Rune Marrow erupts from Duviri’s core.

Location: The Undercroft in Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriFractalItem.zhText:
密印髓质从双衍王境的核心中喷出。

获取地点：双衍王境地穴

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKavatDesc.text: Kexats hunt Paragrimms and Rablits and love to be pampered.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKavatDesc.zhText: 可娃猎杀幽幽鹰与兔纸，并且喜欢被人宠爱。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip1.text: Place stones near other stones to shore up your position and create capture opportunities.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip1.zhText: 在其他棋子附近放置棋子以巩固你的地盘并创造吃子机会。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip2.text: Loosely connected clusters of stones offer flexibility, but they also leave you more vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip2.zhText: 松散连接的棋形提供了灵活性，但也会让你更加容易受到攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip3.text: Start at the center of the board to give yourself plenty of room to respond to your opponent.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip3.zhText: 从棋盘的中心落子开局，给自己留出足够的空间来应对对手。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip4.text: Focus on large captures as you approach the end of the match.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip4.zhText: 当棋局接近尾声时，把注意力集中在大规模吃子上。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip5.text: You can strategically sacrifice stones to create capture opportunities.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip5.zhText: 你可以有策略地舍棋以创造吃子机会。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip6.text: Connected stones are your strongest defense.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip6.zhText: 相连的棋子可以提供最强的防御。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip7.text: Cast a wide net in the early game to limit your opponent's maneuverability.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip7.zhText: 在游戏前期大范围布局，以限制对手的活动范围。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip8.text: Be efficient with your moves. Do not place a stone until you must.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip8.zhText: 走棋要精准高效，不要轻率落子。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip9.text: Do your best to accomplish more than one strategic goal with each stone you place.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKomiTip9.zhText: 落子时，尽可能地实现多个战略目标。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKubrowDesc.text: Krubies are fiercely loyal. They do not hesitate to risk their own safety for the good of their pack.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKubrowDesc.zhText: 库贝非常忠诚。它们会毫不犹豫地为了自己的族群而舍弃个体的安危。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ow.zhText: 所有遗失的典籍都已归还！
找到幽幽鹰遗失的典籍

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ro.text:
The sky could not hold him
In cupped hands we caught him

Death will not hold him
Open-armed lies this grave

This world could not hold him
And so we are without him

Stranger. Father. Scholar.
In our hearts
We hold you
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ro.zhText:
天空承载不了他
我们伸出双手捧着他

死亡禁锢不住他
这座坟墓张开双臂等候他

这个世界容不下他
因此他不在我们中间

陌生人。父亲。儒者。
我们在心里
装着你

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Within the mirror of self
Beyond the portal of becoming 
Exists no thing
Which thine own self 
Didst not bring
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
以镜鉴己
越过自我实现之门
存留者无他
唯有心中羁绊
自缚其中

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
With her
We learned
No life
Is too little
To be lost
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
和她一起
我们学到了
生命
即使再渺小
也不能失去

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Govio lies here
Or so we hope

Slain by his other
Or so we hope

In the chalky halls
Of Academe

May what lies here
Never rise
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
哥维奥长眠于此
或许只是我们希望如此

被另一个他杀死
或许只是我们希望如此

在学院岛上
白垩的大厅里

愿这里埋葬的
不再苏醒

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Mother Opa of the Calaventi
As bitter as her wine was sweet
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
卡拉文蒂的母亲奥帕
刻薄如她的酒般醇甜

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Hogo, ventured swampward
Returned bountiful
From his innards
A cornucopia
Of new life
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
霍鼓，
沼泽冒险
满载而归
他的內腑
是新生命的
丰饶之源

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Leem, corpse-warden of Necropolis
A poor bed
For a life lived
Among the dead
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
利姆，大墓岛的看守者
在死人中度过了一生
却只换来寒酸的坟墓

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Caxa, sculptor
You added to the world
By taking from it
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
凯刻萨，雕塑家
通过向世界索取
你已为世界加添

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Qig. Thief. 
Fed to the Cyst.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
齐格。小偷。 
被喂给了包囊。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Vana. Heard the song 
Of the Golden Hive

She does not lie here
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
瓦娜，曾听过
金蜂巢的旋律

她未在此长眠

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Jinn. Five nights hung
Upon the Inversion Tree
What she saw
Driven to recount

Jinn. Five nights hung
Upon the Inversion Tree
Went to her end
Chattering

Recount not
What was relayed
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
尽娘。挂在倒置树上
五个夜晚
她之所见
使她重述

尽娘。挂在倒置树上
五个夜晚
喃喃自语地
到了她的尽头

她之所述
勿再重述

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Ula
Loved the rainbow eels
Died
Of a broken heart

She sings with them now
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
乌拉
热爱虹鳗
死于心碎

如今她与它们同唱

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Yimi
Heeded not the warnings
Of the Lorn shrines

Haunted to her death
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
伊米
置孤魂岛圣坛之警告
于不顾

终被鬼魔缠身至死

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Roon. Forever curious
Escaped in the night
With Scholar's Landing

Remembered here
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
鲁恩。始终好奇
在夜色中遁走
携儒临地离去

被铭记于此

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Pol
Lingered too long
In Stitcher's Gulch

Returned to us
Bound
Within himself
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
波尔
在缝合机峡谷
流连忘返过久

虽回到我们中间
却被缝在自己里面

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
She beheld that which
Brooks no beholding

She surrendered her eyes
In the wake of her mind.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
她看到了那些
不忍看到的事物

在心智崩溃的驱使下
她挖掉了双眼

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
Velkk
A joy to all.

The best of us.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
瓦尔克

为所有人带来欢乐。

我们中的佼佼者。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.text:
With a well-meant word
This kind soul
Drew a King's ire

Lacking a punishment
That befit his rage
That King did invent death

Where we shall all go
This soul went first
Drawing us behind
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Ti.zhText:
只因良言善意
这善良的人
激怒了国王

没有什么惩罚
能平息他的怒气
国王就创造了死亡

我们都要去的那地
此人先去一步
我们紧随其后

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervo/Tr.zhText: 找到所有丢失的随行物品

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervoDro.text:
Kullervo's fury incarnate. Acrithis will trade this prized artifact for certain items from her collection.

Location: Earned by confronting Kullervo and defeating the Orowyrm in the same Duviri mission during the Fear, Anger, or Sorrow spiral
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriKullervoDro.zhText:
Kullervo 的愤怒化身。可以用这件珍贵的神器与言录使换取她收藏的某些物品。 

获取地点：在恐惧、愤怒或悲伤复眠螺旋中对抗 Kullervo 并在同一个双衍王境任务中打败奥金魇龙

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: While mounted on a Kaithe, |CROUCH| then <JUMP> to take flight!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 当骑乘绝灵骥时，|CROUCH| 然后按下 <JUMP> 可快速弹跳起飞！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: While flying a Kaithe, |FLY_UP| to ascend, |FLY_DOWN| to descend, and |RUN| to increase speed.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 在飞行绝灵骥时，|FLY_UP| 上升、|FLY_DOWN| 下降，或|RUN| 进行加速。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: If you see a target <DUVIRI_INTERRUPTABLE> above an enemy, that enemy is about to cast a powerful ability. Shoot them with <PRE_ATTACK> to interrupt the attack!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 如果敌人上方出现一个 <DUVIRI_INTERRUPTABLE> 标记，则表示他们即将施放强力技能。按下 <PRE_ATTACK> 对他们进行射击来打断他们！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Kaithe can be summoned while airborne to immediately begin flying.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 可以在空中召唤绝灵骥立即开始飞行。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Select one of the three Warframes available in The Circuit each week. Progress through the reward track to earn the Warframe's components for building in your Foundry!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 每周从无尽回廊中可用的三个战甲中选择一个。通过在奖励路线上取得进展获得此战甲的组件，以便在你的铸造厂中进行铸造！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Completing Side Objectives in The Duviri Experience rewards Decrees and Drifter Intrinsics. Make use of them before tackling your next challenge in Duviri!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 完成双衍历程中的支线目标会奖励王令和漂泊者内源之力。在进行下一个双衍王境的挑战之前利用它们！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Each Drifter Intrinsic unlocked gives 1,500 Mastery Rank Points.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 每个解锁的漂泊者内源之力提供 1500 精通段位点数。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Weapons and Warframe Abilities can be used in Teshin's Cave, giving you the opportunity to test your selections before heading out into Duviri!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 武器和战甲技能在 Teshin 的洞穴中时可以使用，在踏出洞穴前往双衍王境之前测试你选择的装备！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Drifter's Restorative ability both heals and removes any Status Effects on you.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 漂泊者的恢复能力既可以恢复生命值，也可以移除你身上的任何异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Earn the Courtly Shawzin Skin by completing each of the 12 Shawzin songs found across Duviri on the Virtuoso difficulty.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 在大师难度下，完成在双衍王境发现的 12 首三线琴歌曲中的每一首，即可获得典雅三线琴外观。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Acrithis sells many wares including rare items in exchange for Duviri resources. She can be found in the Dormizone and the Duviri Landscape.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 言录使出售很多种商品，包括耗费双衍王境资源的稀有物品。可以在居住舱和双衍王境开放世界中找到她。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Decrees apply to both Drifter and Warframes in the Undercroft. Try picking Decrees that benefit both!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 王令适用于漂泊者和地穴中的战甲。尝试选择对两者都有利的王令！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: While mounted on a Kaithe, |ROLL| to dash. This maneuver is useful for dodging projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 当骑乘绝灵骥时，|ROLL| 进行猛冲。这个动作对于躲避投射物很有用。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Collect three Decree Fragments in The Circuit to gain an extra Decree! Each Stage has 3 to collect, with collected Decree Fragments carrying over into the next stage.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 在无尽回廊中收集三个王令碎片以获得一个额外的王令！每个阶段可收集 3 个，收集到的王令碎片可携带到下一阶段。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Circuit Progress earned per stage in The Circuit increases incrementally up to Stage 5, with a once daily bonus after Stage 4. The longer you stay the more you earn, but remember enemy difficulty also increases!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 无尽回廊中每个阶段获得的无尽回廊进度会逐渐增加，直到第 5 阶段，在第 4 阶段之后每天都会获得一次奖励。停留的时间越长，你获得的收益就越多，但请记住，敌人的难度也会随之增加！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Keep an eye out for Lost Islands of Duviri Fragments, which have a faint golden glow and hum. Each one collected awards Drifter Intrinsics and progress towards The Lost Islands of Duviri Codex Entries!
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 留意双衍王境的失落岛屿碎片，它们会发出淡淡的金色光芒并伴随着嗡嗡声。每收集到一个奖励都会获得漂泊者内源之力并促进双衍王境的失落岛屿资料库条目的进度！

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: Parrying makes enemies vulnerable to Finishers. To Parry, use <AIM_WEAPON> with your melee weapon as an enemy is about to strike. Approach the target and |MELEE| to perform a Finisher.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 招架让敌人容易受到处决。要进行招架，请在敌人即将发动攻击时使用近战武器按下 <AIM_WEAPON>。然后接近目标并|MELEE| 来进行处决。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: When an enemy's hands glow <DUVIRI_UNBLOCKABLE>, that enemy is about to use an attack that can't be blocked or parried. Be sure to move out of the way.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 当敌人的手部出现发光标志 <DUVIRI_UNBLOCKABLE> 时，代表该敌人即将使用无法被格挡或招架的攻击。一定要躲开。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: While blocking <AIM_WEAPON>, |MELEE_CHANNEL| to use your melee weapon's Power Strike.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 在格挡 <AIM_WEAPON> 时，|MELEE_CHANNEL| 以使用近战武器的强力攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: |CAMERA_LOCK| while wielding your melee weapon to lock onto an enemy in front of you, |CAMERA_LOCK| again to release the lock.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 使用近战武器时 |CAMERA_LOCK| 锁定前方敌人。再次 |CAMERA_LOCK| 解除锁定。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: |SWITCH_WEAPON| to switch between your melee and ranged weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: |SWITCH_WEAPON| 可切换近战或远程武器。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: When reloading the Sirocco pistol, |RELOAD| in the reticle window to over-charge your next shot.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 重新装填「赤风」手枪时，在准星窗口中按下 |RELOAD| 为下一枪进行超载充能。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.text: New sets of Warframes and Warframe weapons become available to you every time Duviri's Spiral changes.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriLoadingTips.zhText: 每次双衍王境的复眠螺旋发生变化时，都会有新的战甲和战甲武器供你选择。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriMushroomIte.text:
Duviri citizens plagued by nightmares seek Tasoma, because its stalks can be crushed to create juice that invites pleasant dreams. Unfortunately, it is difficult to forage Tasoma as it only grows in caves.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriMushroomIte.zhText:
被噩梦缠身的双衍王境公民们找寻塔苏摩，因为将它的茎压榨后可以制成带来美梦的果汁。但遗憾的是，塔苏摩只生长于洞穴，因此很难被找到。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriMushroomSee.text: A Tasoma fungal spore, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriMushroomSee.zhText: 一种塔苏摩真菌孢子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriOwlDesc.text: Duviri citizens long to understand the Paragrimm’s mysterious, haunting cries, for therein lies much wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriOwlDesc.zhText: 双衍王境的公民渴望理解幽幽鹰那神秘、萦绕的啼声，其中蕴含着丰富的智慧。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantAItemD.text:
Duviri citizens harvest Kovnik leaves to blend invigorating teas.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantAItemD.zhText:
双衍王境的公民们采集福烁草叶子来调配提神茶。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantASeedD.text: A Kovnik plant seed, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantASeedD.zhText: 福烁草植物种子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantBItemD.text:
Duviri citizens have been known to mash Eevani leaves into a paste that alleviates the discomfort caused by fresh wounds.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantBItemD.zhText:
据说双衍王境的居民会把延凡草的叶子捣碎成糊状，来缓解新伤口引起的不适。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantBSeedD.text: An Eevani plant seed, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantBSeedD.zhText: 延凡草植物种子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantCItemD.text:
The water that courses through Connla Sprouts tastes sweet and refreshing.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantCItemD.zhText:
流经慧泉嫩芽的水尝起来甜美清新。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantCSeedD.text: A Connla Sprout plant seed, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantCSeedD.zhText: 慧泉嫩芽植物种子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantDItemD.text:
The warm light of the Yao Shrub glows even within cold dark places.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantDItemD.zhText:
瑶丛即使在寒冷阴暗的地方也能散发温暖的光亮。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantDSeedD.text: A Yao Shrub plant seed, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantDSeedD.zhText: 瑶丛植物种子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantEItemD.text:
It is traditionally held that to see Silphsela floating in the air heralds an imminent change in the sky.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantEItemD.zhText:
传统上认为，看到日精灵瘦果漂浮在空中预示着天空即将发生变化。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantESeedD.text: A Sun Silph plant seed, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantESeedD.zhText: 日精灵植物种子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantFItemD.text:
Dracroot is a staple of the Wyrmling’s diet.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantFItemD.zhText:
龙旋根是魇龙幼体的主食。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantFSeedD.text: A Dracroot plant seed, suitable for growing in the Dormizone’s garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantFSeedD.zhText: 龙旋根植物种子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantGItemD.text:
Ueymag meat is said to be delicious. Just mind the barbs.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantGItemD.zhText:
据说肉麦的肉很好吃。但需小心其倒刺。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantGSeedD.text: A Ueymag plant seed, suitable for growing in the Dormizone's garden.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPlantGSeedD.zhText: 肉麦植物种子，适合在居住舱的花园中种植。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriProcessedIt.text:
Thrax warriors use the heavy liquid drawn from Saggen Wells to polish their weapons.

Location: Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriProcessedIt.zhText:
士魂大帝的战士们使用从慧珠之泉提取出来的重质液体来擦拭他们的武器。

获取地点：双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPuzzleCurre.text:
A token celebrating the successful solution of a Duviri Enigma.

Location: Earned by completing Enigmas in The Duviri Experience
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriPuzzleCurre.zhText:
庆祝成功破解双衍王境奥理的纪念物。

获取地点：在双衍历程中完成奥理

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Drift.text:
Hold <AIM_WEAPON> to aim
Tap <IOS_SHOOT> to shoot
Automated attacks are disabled as a Drifter
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Drift.zhText:
按住 <AIM_WEAPON> 瞄准
点击 <IOS_SHOOT> 射击
作为漂泊者时自动攻击会被禁用

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Horse.zhText:
|INPUT_RUN| 飞奔
|INPUT_JUMP| 跳跃
|INPUT_JUMP|（在空中时）二段跳

|INPUT_RUN|（按住）飞奔
|INPUT_JUMP| 跳跃
|INPUT_JUMP|（在空中时）二段跳

|INPUT_UP| 上升
|INPUT_DOWN| 下降
|INPUT_ROLL| 翻滚

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Horse.text:
Hold to |INPUT_UP| Ascend
Hold to |INPUT_DOWN| Descend
Tap |INPUT_ROLL| Roll
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Horse.zhText:
按住 |INPUT_UP| 上升
按住 |INPUT_DOWN| 下降
轻按 |INPUT_ROLL| 翻滚

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: |MELEE| 进行近战攻击
击中禁卫 |COUNT| 次
按住 |INPUT| 以进行格挡。
格挡 |COUNT| 次攻击

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Press <MELEE> on a parried enemy to perform a counter attack
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 按下 <MELEE> 对格挡的敌人进行反击

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Defeat the enemies using what you learned.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 用你学到的技巧打败敌人。
击败 |COUNT| 个禁卫

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Enemies can also break your block. Tap |INPUT| to dodge when you see |ICON| attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 敌人也可以击破你的格挡。当你面临带有 |ICON| 的攻击时，轻按 |INPUT| 进行闪避。
闪避 |COUNT| 次攻击
按下 |INPUT| 以恢复生命值
恢复生命值
击破禁卫的格挡 |COUNT| 次

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Break enemy block with <SECONDARY_FIRE> Heavy Strike
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 使用 <SECONDARY_FIRE> 重击击破敌人的格挡

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Break enemy block with |INPUT| Heavy Strike
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 使用 |INPUT| 重击击破敌人的格挡

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Enemies have Special Abilities that can be interrupted by using your |INPUT| quick shot when you see |ICON| attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 当你面临带有 |ICON| 的攻击时，可以使用 |INPUT| 快速射击来打断敌人的特殊技能。
打断 |COUNT| 次特殊技能

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: |INPUT| to lock on to an enemy
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: |INPUT| 锁定一个敌人
锁定禁卫敌人

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Look at the Enemy and |INPUT| when it appears to lock on
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 注视敌人并在其可锁定时 |INPUT| 以锁定

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text:
If you time it well, you can parry enemy attacks. 
Press |INPUT| right before the enemy hits you.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText:
如果你把握好时机，你可以招架敌人的攻击。 
在敌人快击中你的时候按下 |INPUT|。
招架 |COUNT| 次攻击

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Reflect incoming projectiles by pressing |INPUT| right before impact.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 在来袭的投射物到达之际按下 |INPUT| 以将其反弹回去。
反弹投射物

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Each Drifter weapon has a different Power Strike. Hold |INPUT| and |MELEE_CHANNEL|.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 每件漂泊者武器都有不同的强力攻击。按住 |INPUT| 和 |MELEE_CHANNEL|。
使用强力攻击

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: |INPUT| to change locked on targets, |INPUT_2| to lock onto an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: |INPUT| 以更改已锁定的目标，|INPUT_2| 以锁定一个敌人。
切换目标 |COUNT| 次

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.text: Swipe left or right to change locked on targets, |INPUT| to lock onto an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Melee.zhText: 向两侧滑动以更改已锁定的目标，|INPUT| 以锁定一个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Stage.text:
|FLY_UP| to climb, |FLY_DOWN| to dive
Press |INPUT_SHOOT| to breathe fire
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Stage.zhText:
|FLY_UP| 上升，|FLY_DOWN| 俯冲
按下 |INPUT_SHOOT| 喷火

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Stage.text:
<MOVE_Z:INVERT=1> + <LOOK_Y> to climb and dive
Press <PRE_ATTACK> to breathe fire
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Stage.zhText:
<MOVE_Z:INVERT=1> + <LOOK_Y> 上升和俯冲
按下 <PRE_ATTACK> 喷火

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Stage.text:
<MOVE_Z> + <LOOK_Y> to climb and dive
Press <PRE_ATTACK> to breathe fire
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Stage.zhText:
<MOVE_Z> + <LOOK_Y> 上升和俯冲
按下 <PRE_ATTACK> 喷火

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/DuviriQuest/Stage.text:
|FLY_UP| to climb, |FLY_DOWN| to dive

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/QuestCompleteRewa.text:
Persuading the Zariman's own resident archivist to allow me access to your residence was not easy. A fearsome entity called Melica, she insisted I needed a ‘pass' prepared by my ‘teacher'.

In case we have not already spoken: I am Acrithis, archivist of Duviri. And I believe I know who you are. Better, perhaps, than you do.

As a token of trust, I enclose this curious blueprint. The blades are modelled on Master Teshin's, but weighted for Warframe use. Clearly they are meant for you.

Acrithis
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/QuestCompleteRewa.zhText:
说服「扎里曼号」的本地档案管理员，允许我进入你的住所并不容易。有一个叫梅丽卡的可怕存在，她坚称我需要由我的"老师"准备好一张"通行证"才能进入。

如果我们还未交谈过：我是双衍王境的档案管理员——言录使。我相信我知道你是谁，或许，比你自己，更清楚。

作为信任的象征，我附上了这张奇特的蓝图。这些刀刃仿照了 Teshin 大师的设计，但重量更适合战甲使用。显然，它们是为你准备的。

言录使

/Lotus/Language/Duviri/QuestCompleteRewa.text: TESTING… DRIFTER CAN YOU READ THIS?
/Lotus/Language/Duviri/QuestCompleteRewa.zhText: 测试中……漂泊者，你看得到这个信息吗？

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/Eidolonium.text:
A gas found solely on the Plains of Eidolon, refined to its purest form. 

Location: Plains of Eidolon Bounties on Earth
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/Eidolonium.zhText:
一种只能在夜灵平野上找到的气体，已被精炼到了最纯粹的状态。

获取地点：夜灵平野赏金任务（地球）

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/ForestRode.text: ‘Nature's janitor'. The Kuaka is a ravenous, ill-tempered omnivore and distant cousin to the Pobber. They feed on vermin and pests that threaten the young of other species, keeping the Plains in balance.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/ForestRode.zhText: "大自然的清洁工"。库阿卡是一种贪婪且脾气暴躁的杂食动物，是泡博的远亲。它们以威胁其他物种幼崽的害虫和害兽为食，从而维持着平野的生态平衡。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/ForestRode.text:
The sinew from the Kuaka's spinal claws can be tanned to make resilient and flexible leather.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/ForestRode.zhText:
从库阿卡的脊爪上取得的肌腱，可以晒制成既强韧且具弹性的皮革。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/FruitTreeD.text: A hardy Plains tree, and a source of nutrition for animals with the jaw strength to break through the tough skin of its fruit.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/FruitTreeD.zhText: 一种在平野生长的坚韧树木。只有那些拥有强壮颚部的动物，才能以其果实为食，因为只有它们才能咬穿那些果实的坚硬外壳。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GenericPlu.text: They're the squeezy little fellas from the Plains of Eidolon! Take them home today!
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GenericPlu.zhText: 来自夜灵平野的抱抱小家伙！今天就把它们带回家吧！

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GhoulHuntC.zhText: 用葛克度给处理器蓄能

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrineerThu.text: Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrineerThu.zhText: Grineer 移动型防御平台。气动震地、高降落入口，以及宽口径大炮，传送着一封相同简单的信息：boom。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrineerThu.text: The largest version of the Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrineerThu.zhText: 最大型的 Grineer 移动型防御平台。气动震地、高降落入口，以及宽口径大炮，传送着一封相同简单的信息：boom。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrineerThu.text: An upsized version of the Grineer mobile defense platform. Pneumatic groundpounders, high-drop entrances and wide-bore cannons deliver the same simple message: boom.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrineerThu.zhText: 加大型的 Grineer 移动型防御平台。气动震地、高降落入口，以及宽口径大炮，传送着一封相同简单的信息：boom。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrokdrulCo.text: A supply of Grokdrul, a chemical used in Grineer manufacturing.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrokdrulCo.zhText: 一份葛克度补给。用作 Grineer 工业的一种化学材料。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrokdrulDe.text:
A noxious mix of polysaccharides and long-chain polymers, Grokdrul is a standard chemical used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/GrokdrulDe.zhText:
多醣类与长链聚合物的有毒混合物，葛克度是标准的 Grineer 工业化学材料。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/HijackEsco.zhText: 护送无人机到安全位置

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/IraditeCon.zhText: 一个富含伊莱体的矿脉.

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/IraditeDes.text:
A mineral valuable to the Ostrons.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/IraditeDes.zhText:
一种对 Ostron 人很有价值的矿物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/LephantisS.text:
Torn from the bile duct of a fallen Hemocyte.

Location: Hemocytes found in Plague Star event Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/LephantisS.zhText:
从死亡的免疫血胞体胆管上剥落的物质。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）上的瘟疫之星活动赏金任务中的免疫血胞体

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/MissionEnd.zhText: 未获得 <REPUTATION>。已达到每日上限。
未获得 <REPUTATION>。已达到最大上限。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/NistlepodC.text: The poisonous nectar cradled in the Nistlebrush's central cavity lures unwary wildlife into the killing grip of its reflex-fired thorn-pods.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/NistlepodC.zhText: 尼蒐丛的中央腔室所产生出的剧毒花蜜，其散发出的气味能吸引那些无知的野生动物进入带有棘刺的反射捕猎囊中。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/NistlepodD.text:
Used by the Nistlebrush to trap and kill prey.

Location: Plains of Eidolon on Earth
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/NistlepodD.zhText:
尼蒐丛用它来困住并杀死猎物。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/OstronSeaB.text: An avian of ridiculous appearance found along coastal regions and around large bodies of water. Mergoo circle and squawk at the sight of marine predators. Many an Ostron fisher owes their life to these odd little birds. Killing one is considered very bad luck.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/OstronSeaB.zhText: 在沿海地区和大片水域周围发现的一种有着荒谬外表的鸟类。Mergoo 在看到海洋掠食者时会绕圈飞并发出嘎嘎声。多亏了这些奇怪的小鸟许多 Ostron 渔民保住了性命。杀一只是会被认为是凶兆。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/PlushyThum.text: A well-loved Thumper Floof, once owned by the Grineer known as Gral.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/PlushyThum.zhText: 一件备受喜爱的重击者玩偶，曾被称为格拉尔的 Grineer 所拥有。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/PlushyVamp.zhText: 奥斯蒂亚噬血型库娃玩偶
拿非尔噬血型库娃玩偶

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/RareVampir.zhText: 拿非尔噬血型库娃标签

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/ResourceTh.zhText: 防卫重甲金库的控制台

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientCo.zhText: 转换成卓越的 Sentient 核心

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientCo.text: Converts Intact Sentient Cores into Exceptional Sentient Cores.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientCo.zhText: 将完整的 SENTIENT 核心转换成卓越的 SENTIENT 核心

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: One of the rarest, most valuable Eidolon shards. Flawless.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 最稀有、最有价值的夜灵碎片之一。毫无瑕疵。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus or to unbind Way-bound focus nodes.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 通过捕获在夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获得专精点数，或解锁绑定的专精节点。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: A shard of unmatched beauty and power.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 拥有无与伦比的美与力量的碎片。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: Rare shard gained from capturing the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night. Use it to gain Focus.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 通过捕获在夜间中徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 所取得的稀有碎片。可用于获取专精点数。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: The most prized part of an Eidolon. Jewelry created from an Eidolon shard is most prized in Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 夜灵最具价值的部位。用夜灵碎片制造的首饰在希图斯中价值不斐。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: Shard gained from the Sentients roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 从夜间徘徊于地球夜灵平野的 Sentient 身上所取得的碎片。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: Combine multiple Rivens to create a new, different Riven.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 将多个裂罅 MOD 组合起来创造出一个新的不同的裂罅 MOD。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.text: An Eidolon Shard synthesized from Sanctuary study.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/SentientSh.zhText: 通过圣殿研究而合成的夜灵碎片。

/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/VampireKav.text: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected Kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.
/Lotus/Language/EidolonPlains/VampireKav.zhText: 噬血病毒菌株是一种通过感染的库娃的唾液，来传播的共生血源性病毒。其存在的目的仅仅是为了通过使宿主越来越依赖于血液的摄入，从而让自身在族群中传播的速度越来越快。随着时间的流逝，受噬血型病毒感染的库娃将会失去自我意识，变得越来越狡猾、暴力和贪婪。
