/Lotus/Language/Emotes/ThousandDaysEmotM.zhText:
授予具有毫不动摇的决心的 Tenno。

可在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项卡中装备此表情动作。

/Lotus/Language/Emotes/ThousandDaysEmote.text: Awarded to Tenno who have shown unyielding dedication.
/Lotus/Language/Emotes/ThousandDaysEmote.zhText: 授予具有毫不动摇的决心的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Emotes/WolfRageMarketDes.text:
Summon the pack. 

Equip this emote using the Gear Wheel tab in your Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Emotes/WolfRageMarketDes.zhText:
召唤狼群。

可在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项卡中装备此表情动作。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AncientTankDesc.text: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AncientTankDesc.zhText: 一个古老的野兽，拥有沉重的连枷和可怕的力量来使用它达到毁灭性的效果。它笨重的身体掩盖了惊人的速度，这是鞭击奔跳者通过将手臂猛撞到地面并将自身投入战场来实现的。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AristocratManage.text: One of Parvos' favored, keeper of the tokens of his esteem.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AristocratManage.zhText: 帕尔沃斯的宠臣之一，掌管着象征他尊严的代币。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloFollowerDesc.text: Touched by the hand of Arlo they come to spread his healing word. Rejoice.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloFollowerDesc.zhText: 他们被 Arlo 之手所触动来到这里传播他的治愈之道。喜悦。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotDualSw.text: Attacking with blade and gun, this Zealot spreads the ‘message' with a hive of toxic, explosive pustules that grow on his back when he is attacked.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotDualSw.zhText: 这名狂热者使用刀刃与枪械攻击目标。而在受到攻击时，他会通过背上的一个带有引爆式毒液脓疱的巢囊来传播“消息”。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotGunDes.text: This Zealot targets potential converts with a spray of toxic sludge.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotGunDes.zhText: 这名狂热者会使用剧毒软泥喷雾来感化那些潜在的信徒。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotSwordD.text: From Arlo the promise of a new life, a new form and a new word: death.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotSwordD.zhText: 来自 Arlo 的对新生的承诺，一个新的形态和话语：死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AscensionCannonM.text: Launches slow-moving, high-charged orbs of electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/AscensionCannonM.zhText: 发射缓慢移动的高能量电球。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BirdOfPreyDesc.text: A bird of prey that feeds on fish and kuakas.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BirdOfPreyDesc.zhText: 一种以鱼类和库阿卡为食的鸟类

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BirdOfPreyScaven.text: This species of Condroc survives by scavenging from carcasses found on the plains.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BirdOfPreyScaven.zhText: 这种秃鹰以在平野上食腐维生。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BrachCarrierDesc.text: Sentient servitors ejected from an Orphix, these entities boost their master's pulse field by placing Serenex Resonators.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/BrachCarrierDesc.zhText: 从奥影母艇弹出的 Sentient 侍从，这些实体通过放置共鸣者来增强它们主人的脉冲场。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamAHeavyDesc.text: Ved Xol was nominated to become the head of the Loan Reclamation Division at Anyo Corp. after demonstrating ruthless aptitude within The Index. He has obtained favorable results with his team on many occasions, and is a firm favorite amongst corporate backers.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamAHeavyDesc.zhText: 通过在《指数之场》展现出残酷无情的天资，Ved Xol 被提名成为安尤企业的贷款回收部负责人。他与他的队伍多次获得了备受赞许的成果，因此在企业的资助人间有着坚实的拥护。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamARifleDesc.text: The younger brother of Ved Xol displayed no aptitude for business. Instead, his enthusiasm for violence and conflict have helped him quickly climb corporate ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamARifleDesc.zhText: Ved Xol 的弟弟对家族产业毫无兴致。不过，他对暴力和冲突的热情是他在企业中向上爬升的资本。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamASkateDesc.text: Pelna Cade is a skilled technician who graduated with the Xol brothers. Remaining close friends with the family following their military service together, he now works for them to keep the robotics in their service in peak condition.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamASkateDesc.zhText: Pelna Cade 是一名技艺高超的技术员，与 Xol 兄弟一起毕业。他跟随 Xol 家族一同进入军旅，并一直是亲密的伙伴。现在他的工作是让队伍中的机器人时刻保有巅峰状态。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamAZanukaDes.text: The Loan Reclamation Division worked closely with Alad V on several ventures during his tenure on the Corpus Board of Directors. Despite his involuntary retirement, it is speculated that the Xol Brothers still undertake assignments on his behalf. These robots, based on Alad V's own patented designs were delivered as payment for services rendered and only serve to strengthen such suspicions.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamAZanukaDes.zhText: 在阿拉德 V 就任 Corpus 董事会期间，贷款回收部门曾与之有过数次紧密的合作。尽管他已经非自愿地退出了，传言 Xol 兄弟仍然为他经手任务。这些根据阿拉德 V 专利设计的机器人被送来作为工作的酬劳，这样的情形更加重了人们的猜忌。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBDisruptor.text: A young and ambitious Anyo Corp. employee, Jad has demonstrated remarkable aptitude for micromanaging machinery. He was promoted to the Robotic Technology Division where he leads the design of new robotics to be utilized by other divisions of Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBDisruptor.zhText: 一名年轻有为的安尤企业员工，Jad 展示出了对机械的惊人微操作天赋。他被提拔到机器人技术部门，在那里他领导设计了新型的机器人供安尤企业的其他部门使用。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBHyenaDesc.text: Affectionately known as "Azoth" the Hyena Hg is the latest version of Hyena to be produced at Anyo Corp. This model has been optimized to process Index Points with lethal efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBHyenaDesc.zhText: 被亲切地冠以"水银"之名，「鬣狗 汞」是由安尤企业制造的最新型鬣狗机器人。这一型号被优化来处理指数点数，拥有致命的效率。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBOspreyDes.text: The Index marks the debut of the X-series of the Raptor. This version of armored Osprey doubles as both a mobile accounting system and security detail for the brokers employed by Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBOspreyDes.zhText: 《指数之场》见证了 X 系列鱼鹰的首次亮相。这一系列的重甲鱼鹰兼具了移动会计系统和安保的功能，为安尤企业的雇员提供服务。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBRiotMoaDe.text: A heavily modified model of Denial Bursas, designed for the secure transferral of offline funds. This armored robot protects the financial interests of Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamBRiotMoaDe.zhText: 一台高度改装的守护金流恐鸟，被设计用来保全离线的资金转运。这台带有护甲的机器人保护着安尤企业的经济利益。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCDeception.text: Jen specialises in corporate espionage and uses the information she gathers to facilitate sudden downturns for her opponents.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCDeception.zhText: Jen 专长于商业间谍行动，并利用获得的信息协助她令对手陷入突发的经济低迷。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCHackerDes.text: A digital virtuoso, Derim is a capable hacker who applies his trade laundering funds traded through The Index.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCHackerDes.zhText: 一位电子世界的大师，Derim 是一名黑客高手，他通过《指数之场》将洗黑钱得来的资金交易出去。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCMoaDesc.text: The Multi-Weapon Assault Moa is equipped with a number of weapons to assist the brokers employed by Zenith Galactical with their endeavors.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCMoaDesc.zhText: 这架装备多种武器的突击恐鸟可以协助由至高银河公司雇佣的掮客，完成他们的事业。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCStealthDe.text: Tia supports her allies by providing them with effective exit strategies when a deal takes a turn for the worse. These strategies often leave the other party with significant medical fees.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamCStealthDe.zhText: 当生意变糟时，Tia 通过提供有效的退出策略来支援她的友军。她的策略往往使得对手方面临巨大的医疗费用。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterADe.text: As the Chief Officer of the Investor Relations department, Armis pressures investors into accepting Nef Anyo's invitation to The Index. He's also adept at leveraging investor debt to make maximum profit for Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterADe.zhText: 身为投资人关系部门的总监，Armis 逼迫投资人接受奈富·安尤的邀请进入指数之场。同时他也很擅于利用投资人的债务来为安尤企业创造最大利益。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterBDe.text: A senior Analysts, Dru addresses all complaints received from colonists in person - with a high-grade, rubedo-lined laser cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterBDe.zhText: Dru 是一名高级分析师。他亲自解决所有来自个殖民地的投诉——用最高端的红晶激光炮。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterCDe.text: More than just a broker, Rana is a hostile customer relations specialist. When Investors refuse to pay their debts, they can look forward to a visit from her.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDBusterCDe.zhText: Rana 不只是一名经纪人，更是恶性客户关系领域的专家。当投资人拒绝清还债务时，Rana 就会登门拜访他们。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDOspreyDes.text: Designed to execute the 002 Eradication Protocol, this Osprey identifies high-risk brokers and administers injury.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CCTeamDOspreyDes.zhText: 被设计用来执行 002 肃清协议，这架鱼鹰可以辨识高风险的经纪人和控管伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CarrusPilotDesc.text: A specialist in synthetic metallurgy protected by a large shield wall. This Corpus Tech brandishes a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneration. Summons a Mine Osprey.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CarrusPilotDesc.zhText: 合成冶金专家，由大型盾牆保护。这名 Corpus 技师挥舞着一把火炬焊枪，足以融化 Sentient 装甲，能够快速再生。可以召唤地雷鱼鹰。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ColonistChargerD.text: Spawned the body of a creature killed by infested, these charges are fast with weak claw attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ColonistChargerD.zhText: 从被感染者杀死的生物尸体中产生，这些怪物行动迅速，使用较弱的爪击。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ColonistDesc.text: Many generations ago, in search of a life free from the corrupting influence of greed, the Mycona split from the Corpus. Life was difficult for the new colony, but they proved resourceful by surviving where no one thought possible, among the Infestation. Now, they earn their living harvesting the biological products of the Infested and trading with outsiders. Contact with Mycona is limited, but those that trade with them speak of a strange force capable of pacifying the otherwise ravenous Infested horde. The Myconians call this force, the Triuna.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ColonistDesc.zhText: 数个世代以前，为了追寻不被贪欲腐化的生活，Mycona 人从 Corpus 中分离了出来。起初，新殖民地的生活艰辛，但他们身处感染之中，从不可能的逆境中存活了下来，证明了自身的才智。如今，他们通过获取感染者的生物制品，并与外人贸易谋生。尽管与 Mycona 的联系十分有限，但同他们交易的人都说，Mycona 人拥有一种奇怪的力量，可以使得原本贪食不厌的感染兽群平静下来。那些 Mycona 人将这种力量称之为，圣脉。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorpusEliteShiel.text: The Arbiters of Hexis created this drone to put Tenno to the test in Arbitrations.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorpusEliteShiel.zhText: 由均衡仲裁者所制作的无人机，使 Tenno 在裁决中受到考验。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedBeastMa.text: He came in search of Void treasure, the Orokin Neural Sentry had other plans.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedBeastMa.zhText: 他来寻求虚空的宝藏，奥罗金的神经哨卫却另有打算。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedCombatK.text: The Orokin Neural Sentry commands this beast now.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedCombatK.zhText: 奥罗金神经哨卫现已控制这只野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedPowerCa.text: [PH] A Corrupted Lancer carrying a power cell
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedPowerCa.zhText: [PH] A Corrupted Lancer carrying a power cell

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CrpInterrupterDe.text: Using the latest in Corpus weapons technology, this Crewman absorbs damage, until it unleashes it all in a powerful shockwave. The Derivator unit is mounted on the back.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CrpInterrupterDe.zhText: 使用了最新的 Corpus 武器技术，这种船员可持续吸收伤害并一次性将受到的伤害以强大的冲击波形式释放出来。引能单位安装在该船员的背部。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CryoDiscDroneDes.text: Energy Orb pulses AoE Cold Damage after detonation
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/CryoDiscDroneDes.zhText: 在爆炸后能量球会释放冰冻范围伤害

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DisruptionDemoli.text: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DisruptionDemoli.zhText: 爆破型是具有单一目的的爆炸性敌人：不惜任何代价破坏受损导管。这是阿拉德 V 完整的导管安全套装的一部分！

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipAmbulasD.text: Reinforced Condor used to transport elite personnel into conflict zone.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipAmbulasD.zhText: 将精英部队投送至纷争区域的强化秃鹫飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipCorpusDe.text: Aerial transport that delivers Corpus Reinforcements to strategic locations.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipCorpusDe.zhText: 将 Corpus 的援军运送到战略要地的空中运输艇。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipGrineerD.text: In and out under extreme duress, the Firbolg handles lightning-fast infiltrations/extractions and lazy picket duty with equal aplomb.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/DropshipGrineerD.zhText: 内外都处于极度的胁迫，不论是闪电般快速的潜入/撤离任务还是慵懒的纠察巡逻，巨牙博格都以同样的泰然来面对。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAlarmDron.text: Identifies potential threats and calls in reinforcements.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAlarmDron.zhText: 能够识别潜在的威胁并呼叫增援。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAutoMorta.text: A long-range battery that fires destructive ordnance.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAutoMorta.zhText: 一种远距离炮台，射出毁灭性的弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAutoTurre.text: Fires armor-shattering shells at a rapid rate.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonAutoTurre.zhText: 快速地射出粉碎护甲的弹头。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonGrineerBo.text: Retrofitted for Plains operations, the Tusk-variant Ogma IDs targets at range, hammers out missile volleys on approach and finishes the job with a rain of explosives.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonGrineerBo.zhText: 改装后被用于平野的行动任务。这艘巨牙变体型号欧格玛可在远距离辨识目标，在接近时齐射出大量导弹，以弹如雨下的爆破攻击完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonMortarBom.text: This Bombard's portable, back-mounted mortar allows the Grineer to rain destruction anywhere on the plains.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonMortarBom.zhText: 这名轰击者佩戴的便携式、背扛迫击炮使 Grineer 能在平野的任何一处降下毁灭性伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonSkiffPilo.text: Hardy and quick-thinking, as formidable outside his Dargyn as in.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonSkiffPilo.zhText: 身板强壮而又思维敏捷，不论在轻型艇内还是外，他都是令人敬畏的战斗力。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntD.text: One of the faceless Grineer ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntD.zhText: Grineer 众多不知名军衔中的一员。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntD.text: Fires a devastating heat ray and self destructs.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntD.zhText: 放射出具有破坏性的热射线并会自爆。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntL.text: Born in a tube, raised among numberless thousands, the typical Grineer trooper dies forgotten. A copy of a copy of a copy, they may not be the pinnacle of evolution but what they lack in intelligence they make up for in numbers. Occasionally, however, one genetic aberration will prove itself to be superior, and elevated to the rank of Commander.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipGruntL.zhText: 从试管中出生，和成千上万的芸芸众生一起被养大，他是那种典型的 Grineer 士兵，死后默默无闻。作为复制体的复制的复制，他们也许不是进化的巅峰，但他们智力的不足被数量所弥补。只不过，偶尔一个基因变异会使其变得出众，并被拔擢为指挥官军衔。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipPilotD.text: A rugged career pilot, bred to survive on the Plains.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipPilotD.zhText: 一名粗犷强健的职业飞行员，生来就是为了在平野上存活。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipPilotL.text: Aerial Commanders share a bond with their machines: equal parts mechanic, driver and soldier. For fast deployment and quick eradication of hostiles, a Skiff team can execute a three-angle assault, raining down hellfire before the enemy knows they're dead.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipPilotL.zhText: 空中指挥官与他们的机器紧密联结：既是零件技工，也是驾驶员，更是士兵。一支轻型艇小队可以执行三角夹击，进行快速的部署和歼敌，在敌人们意识到死期将至前就可降下地狱之火。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSkiffD.text: Armed with a high-velocity rapid-fire cannon, this armored skiff tears up targets and terrain alike.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSkiffD.zhText: 装备有高速速射火炮，这种装甲轻型艇可以一视同仁地将目标和地形撕裂。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSniper.text: Agile and quick-witted, as patient as she is cunning.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSniper.zhText: 灵活而又机敏，她不但狡猾多谋，同时也富有耐心。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSniper.text: The most difficult thing a Grineer sniper will ever have to survive... is testing. With a 98% mortality rate, those that make it through go on to become some of the most feared units in the Grineer forces. The Recon Commander is the cream of this elite batch.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVipSniper.zhText: 一名 Grineer 狙击手最难存活的……就是筛选测试。死亡率高达 98%，那些通过测试的人是 Grineer 军中最令人畏惧的部队。而侦查指挥官则又是精英中的精英。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVomvalyst.text: A Grineer device meant to lure in Vomvalyst and trap their energy.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EidolonVomvalyst.zhText: 一种能吸引轰击使用并捕集它们能量的Grineer装置。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EliteShieldLance.text: Carries an impenetrable shield and fires grenades.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/EliteShieldLance.zhText: 携带一面坚不可摧的盾牌，并会发射榴弹。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ForestRodentScav.text: This species of Kuaka likes to decorate its nest with debris and oddities.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ForestRodentScav.zhText: 这种库阿卡喜欢用碎石和奇怪的小东西来装饰巢穴。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerBigDropsh.text: The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary cannon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerBigDropsh.zhText: 博寇是巨牙舰队的骄傲，是进行地面作战的理想平台。装备有大容量的旋转火炮，并密布装甲，且拥有足够的空间容纳一整个排，博寇具有强大的自持能力，足以定期地降下火雨，并投送一队又一队的人员。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerWorkerADe.text: Oversees the tasks performed by other drudges.

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerWorkerBDe.text: Proficient with tools used for smelting.

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrineerWorkerCDe.text: Proficient with tools used for grinding.

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrnAntiWarframeD.text: The Worm Queen's early presence aboard the Zariman has aided her troops' defenses. Through Reliquary tampering, The Worm Queen has bestowed these troopers with a miniature Kuva Trokar to disrupt transference.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrnAntiWarframeD.zhText: 蠕虫女皇在「扎里曼号」上的及早出现协助了她的部队做好防御。通过破坏圣物装置，蠕虫女皇赐予了这些骑兵一个微型赤毒锐针来干扰传识。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrnAntiWarframeL.text: These Lances emit an aura that interrupts transference and is only vulnerable to Void Damage. Given to the Kuva Trokarians by the Worm Queen herself.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/GrnAntiWarframeL.zhText: 这些长矛可发出一种能中断传识的光环，并且只会受到虚空伤害。由蠕虫女皇亲自赐予赤毒锐兵。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InfectedProtecto.text: Heavy melee unit that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InfectedProtecto.zhText: 重型近战单位，通过超宏防护保护其友军，或减少 Tenno 造成的伤害

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InfestedJetpackD.text: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InfestedJetpackD.zhText: 一个感染者喷气伞兵，不死飞行者通过高速撞击来攻击对手。当它被杀死时，它会恢复到一种茧的状态。如果它没有被彻底摧毁，不死飞行者将以生命值全满的状态浮现。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InterferenceDron.text: Thwarts enemy scans with advanced signal jamming hardware.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/InterferenceDron.zhText: 阻挠性敌人用先进的阻塞信号的硬件来扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/JetpackHeavyMari.text: Highly mobile and heavily armored, this unit spreads mayhem with his modified Tonkor.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/JetpackHeavyMari.zhText: 具有高机动性和重型护甲，这种单位用他改造过的征服榴炮散播混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuakaForestRoden.text: A timid rodent that is easily frightened.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuakaForestRoden.zhText: 一种容易受到惊吓的胆小啮齿动物。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuvaBailiffDesc.text: The finest Bailiff clones are chosen to serve in the Queen’s Fortress.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuvaBailiffDesc.zhText: 最优秀的执法员克隆人被选中在女皇要塞中服役。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuvaLarvlingDesc.text: Spiked with "The Old Blood". This Larvling seeks death by Tenno, and rebirth as a Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/KuvaLarvlingDesc.zhText: 在接受了"远古之血"的改造后，这只幼体渴望被 Tenno 杀死，然后转生成为一个赤毒玄骸。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/MicroHyenaDesc.text: Compact robots that hunt with relentless zeal.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/MicroHyenaDesc.zhText: 以冷酷无情的狂热进行追猎的机器人

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchBailif.text: Swings a Jat Kittag as he runs down his foes.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchBailif.zhText: 他挥舞着喷射战锤撞翻敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchBombar.text: Brings devastation with a modified Ogris.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchBombar.zhText: 用一把改造过的食人女魔带来毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchBombar.text: Brings devastation with a modified Ogris.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchBombar.zhText: 用一把改造过的食人女魔带来毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchFlameb.text: Assailing enemies with the Twin Basolk, this combatant closes in on its target with teleportation technology.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchFlameb.zhText: 这名挥舞双子巴萨克短斧袭击对手的斗士会以传送技术切入、逼近目标。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchGrinee.text: Leads a pack of Hyekka into battle.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchGrinee.zhText: 率领着鬣猫群突入战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchLancer.text: These mobile infantry make up the core of the Nightwatch Corps.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchLancer.zhText: 这些机动步兵组成了夜巡者部队的核心战力。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchManicG.zhText: 迅速，残酷并且完全无可预估。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchPowerC.text: Sporting the visceral Ripkas, this unit is a specialist in close quarter combat.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchPowerC.zhText: 手持血肉淋淋的锐卡斯电锯，这种单位可谓近身作战之佼佼者。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchSeeker.text: Distracts prey with rollers while taking aim with a high-calibre Marelok.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchSeeker.zhText: 驱使滚子干扰猎物，同时以一管大口径玛瑞火枪实施瞄准。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchShield.text: Blocks hostile gunfire with a reinforced Brunt.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/NightwatchShield.zhText: 配备一面强化的「冲击」大盾以格挡敌方火力。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/OrphixAvatarDesc.text: These massive Sentients emit pulses that disable machinery, and deploy lesser Sentients that help to boost the pulse field. They have recently learned to disable Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/OrphixAvatarDesc.zhText: 这些巨大的 Sentient 发出使机械装置失效的脉冲，并部署较小的 Sentient 以帮助增强脉冲场。它们最近学会了使战甲失效的方法。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/OrphixRepeaterDe.text: A mindless relay unit, this lesser Sentient's only function is to amplify and spread an Orphix pulse field.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/OrphixRepeaterDe.zhText: 一个无意识的中继装置，这个相对较小的 Sentient 的唯一功能就是放大和传播奥影母艇的脉冲场。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/PurgatoryGhostDe.text: Energy released when an Errant Specter is defeated. Used to charge the Xoris glaive.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/PurgatoryGhostDe.zhText: 击败游荡魅影时所释放出来的能量。用于给「驱魔之刃」充能。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/PurgatoryWarrior.text: The ghostly minions of Parvos Granum within his timeless prison-realm.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/PurgatoryWarrior.zhText: 处于帕尔沃斯·格拉努那永恒监禁领域内的幽灵随从。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/RopalolystDesc.text:
"Known and unknowable. This thing has haunted my life, waking and asleep, ever since I made that accursed bargain. A parasite at the core of my city. It drains my wealth, my power, my reactors… and my dignity.

This will not stand. I will see that horrendous thing destroyed.

I will be free."

Alad V
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/RopalolystDesc.zhText:
" 已知而不可知。自从我做了那项可憎的协议后，这件事情便日复一日、夜复一夜的困扰着我的人生。犹如我城市核心中的寄生虫，蚕食鲸吞掉我的财务、权利、反应炉，以及我的……身份。

这不会得逞的，我会亲眼见证那可怕的东西被摧毁。

我终将获得自由之身。"

阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientAerolyst.text: A support unit can heal fellow Sentients. Canisters located near this units center of mass appear weaker than the surrounding carapace.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientAerolyst.zhText: 可以对 Sentient 同伴进行治疗的辅助单位。围绕在这个单位质心周围的罐状容器看起来要比周围的外壳更脆弱。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientBrachiol.text: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientBrachiol.zhText: 可以俯冲下来近战攻击的飞行单位。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientDolichol.text: A high-order Sentient that bifurcates its body, creating a portal it uses to summon reinforcements and projectiles. Armed with twin cannons.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientDolichol.zhText: 高阶 Sentient，能把它的身体分叉，变成用来召唤援军和炮弹的传送门。装备有双管火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientEidolonG.text: These ethereal Sentients attack with both a sonic barrage and a thunderous homing orb.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientEidolonG.zhText: 这些有灵性的 Sentient 通过音爆弹幕和轰隆作响的追踪球体进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientGruntAlt.text: A fledgling Battalyst deployed before it had a chance to fully develop.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientGruntAlt.zhText: 一个幼年的武装使，它在完全成长好之前就被编入军队了。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientMeleeGru.text: A fledgling Conculyst deployed before it had a chance to fully develop.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientMeleeGru.zhText: 一个幼年的震荡使，它在完全成长好之前就被编入军队了。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientOrtholys.text: This lightweight Sentient mounts itself to solid ground in order to deploy massive long range cannons.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientOrtholys.zhText: 这种轻型的 Sentient 可将自身固定在地面上，以部署大型远程火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientSymbiliy.text: Frontline shock trooper that uses its large shield arm to block incoming damage.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientSymbiliy.zhText: 前线突击部队，使用其强如盾牌的手臂阻挡受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaDetecto.text: An officer who can disable Perception-affecting abilities from Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaDetecto.zhText: 一名可以禁用战甲感知技能的军官。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaLaserDe.text: An officer who can disable Damaging abilities from Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaLaserDe.zhText: 一名可以禁用战甲伤害技能的军官。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaShieldD.text: An officer who can disable Supporting and Debilitating abilities from Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaShieldD.zhText: 一名可以禁用战甲辅助及削弱敌军技能的军官。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaTeslaDe.text: An officer who can disable Mobility abilities from Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCombaTeslaDe.zhText: 一名可以禁用战甲移动技能的军官。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanDesc.text: A common employee of the Corpus Armada.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanDesc.zhText: Corpus 舰队中的一名普通雇员。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanElite.text: A security specialist who is deployed in response to high-level threats.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanElite.zhText: 一名负责应对高危事态的安保专员。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanNulli.text: Engages a field that disables Warframe powers.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanNulli.zhText: 该单位能产生一个让战甲能力失效的力场。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanSnipe.text: A crewman specialized in long-ranged firearms.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanSnipe.zhText: 一名擅长使用远程枪械武器的船员。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanTechD.text: A specialist who dispatches a Shield Osprey when threatened.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipCrewmanTechD.zhText: 一名特种战斗员，在陷入危险时便会部署护盾鱼鹰。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMachinistHam.text: A specialist Crewman who wields a massive torque-wrench.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMachinistHam.zhText: 一名挥舞着一个巨型扳手的特种船员。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaDeraDesc.text: A Moa equipped with a modified Dera rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaDeraDesc.zhText: 一只装备了改造过的德拉步枪的恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaDiscDesc.text: A Moa equipped with a Disc Launcher.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaDiscDesc.zhText: 一只装备了圆盘发射器的恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaDualCanno.text: A Moa equipped with Twin Rocket Launchers.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaDualCanno.zhText: 一只装备了双子火箭发射器的恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaGlaxionDe.text: A Moa equipped with a modified Glaxion rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaGlaxionDe.zhText: 一只装备了改造过的冷冻光束步枪的恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaGlaxionNa.zhText: 朱诺冷冻光束步枪恐鸟

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipMoaOpticorNa.zhText: 朱诺奥堤克光子枪恐鸟

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipOspreyMineDe.text: Lobs explosive orbs that detonate after several seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipOspreyMineDe.zhText: 该单位能投射出会在数秒后爆炸的球体。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipOspreyOxiumD.text: Charges a target and self-destructs when threatened.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipOspreyOxiumD.zhText: 该单位在陷入危险时会冲向目标并自爆。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipOspreyShield.text: Recharges the shields of nearby allies.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ShipOspreyShield.zhText: 该单位可以给周围友军的护盾充能。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SimarisAllyDesc.text: An entity derived from The Sanctuary to fight for Simaris.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SimarisAllyDesc.zhText: 一个来自圣殿、为 Simaris 战斗的个体。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/StalkerDesc.text: An ally from an unknown time and place. Stalker is a powerful force within the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/StalkerDesc.zhText: 一位来自未知时间和地点的盟友。追猎者是潜伏在暗处的强大力量。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SteelMeridianCol.text: Grineer defectors in search of a better, more peaceful life.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/SteelMeridianCol.zhText: 寻求更美好、更和平生活的 Grineer 叛逃者。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/TargetTestMoaDes.text: Facilitates weapon testing for the Jackal.

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystBigDesc.text: A massive, lumbering, brute of an Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystBigDesc.zhText: 一种巨大、笨重且强力的的夜灵。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystDesc.text: An ancient Eidolon, searching for its lost brethren. Trying to make itself whole.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystDesc.zhText: 一个远古夜灵，寻找着它失去的同胞。试图回归完整。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystRainDesc.text: The energy contained within this Eidolon is powerful enough to alter the local weather system.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystRainDesc.zhText: 这个夜灵所具有的强大能量足以改变周围的天气系统。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/VenusHeavyEliteS.text: A seasoned combatant specializing in sub-zero warfare.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/VenusHeavyEliteS.zhText: 一名老练的战斗人员，擅长在零度以下作战。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/VomvalystDesc.text: A lost soul. Part energy, part physical shell, these Sentient remnants seem to have a symbiotic relationship with the much larger Eidolons.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/VomvalystDesc.zhText: 一个迷路的灵魂。一部分是能量，一部分是实体外壳，这些 Sentient 的残余似乎和某一个更庞大的夜灵有着共生关系。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/VomvalystFragmen.text: A lost soul. Part energy, part physical shell
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/VomvalystFragmen.zhText: 失落的灵魂。一部分是能量，一部分是实体。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WeaveDecodeDesc.text: A subordinate loyal to the Zealoid Prelate, the Bastion renders regular Infested invulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WeaveDecodeDesc.zhText: 作为忠于狂热主教的下属，护卫使得普通的感染者无懈可击。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WeaveMutalistDes.text: Wreathed in an obfuscating black cloud the Zealoid Prelate brings Arlo's word with fire, blood and loyal Bastions who spring to his aid.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WeaveMutalistDes.zhText: 缭绕在一团黑色的迷云中，狂热主教将战火、鲜血以及有求于他的忠实护卫们带到 Arlo 的世界。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WolfGangsterDesc.text: Broken out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen by the Wolf, this fugitive is a loyal member of his pack.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WolfGangsterDesc.zhText: 通过恶狼逃出来的土星六号最高戒备监狱的逃犯，这名逃亡者是他的一名忠实成员。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WolfStalkerDesc.text: The only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/WolfStalkerDesc.zhText: 唯一能逃脱出土星六号最高戒备监狱的可怕狂人。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ZarVoidAngelDesc.text: Often found cocooned on the walls of the Zariman, the Void Angels were once human-like manifestations of people who died in the aftermath of the Zariman disaster. Over time they succumbed to the Void's song, and transformed into these angel-like creatures. They do not like to be disturbed.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ZarVoidAngelDesc.zhText: 虚空天使通常会藏身茧中出现在「扎里曼号」的墙壁上，他们是「扎里曼号」上逝去之人的类人显化者。随着时间的流逝，这些使者的灵魂屈服于了虚空的歌声，并转化成了这些天使般的生物。他们不喜欢被打扰。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ZarVoidAngelEndl.text: These Void Angels are desperate to feed on the Reliquary Drive's energy.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ZarVoidAngelEndl.zhText: 这些虚空天使不顾一切地以圣物装置的能量为食。

/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ZarVoidAngelEthe.text: The form a Void Angel reverts to when it retreats into the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Enemies/ZarVoidAngelEthe.zhText: 虚空天使撤回虚空后会回退成这种状态。

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/BlitzLeader.text: Defends itself with a radial Blast Attack
/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/BlitzLeader.zhText: 利用放射爆炸攻击防御自身

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/ElecDamageL.text: Converts damage dealt by nearby allies to <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage.
/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/ElecDamageL.zhText: 将周围友军造成的伤害转换为 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/FireDamageL.text: Converts damage dealt by nearby allies to <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage.
/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/FireDamageL.zhText: 将周围友军造成的伤害转换为 <DT_FIRE>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/GuardianLea.text: Recharges the shields of nearby allies

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/IceDamageLe.text: Converts damage dealt by nearby allies to <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage.
/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/IceDamageLe.zhText: 将周围友军造成的伤害转换为 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻伤害。

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/JadeLightLe.text: This powerful Eximus unit targets foes with a devastating beam of Jade light. Parvos Granum desperately seeks more Volatile Jade Motes to perfect this technology.
/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/JadeLightLe.zhText: 这种强大的卓越者单位会用毁灭性的翠玉之光攻击敌人。帕尔沃斯·格拉努迫切地寻求更多 Jade 的不稳定微粒来完善这项技术。

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/LeechLeader.zhText: 生命吸收武器，增加生命

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/PoisonDamag.text: Converts damage dealt by nearby allies to <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage.
/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/PoisonDamag.zhText: 将周围友军造成的伤害转换为 <DT_POISON>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/EnemyLeaders/VoltEximusL.text: This speedy Eximus unit targets foes with a triple strike of devastating <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electric Damage. Created by an unusual spatiotemporal event.

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/ArchonShardInbox.zhText: 基于执刑官源力石的研究成果

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/ArchonShardSegme.text:
Tenno,

As I adjust to the era in which I have awakened, I note with alarm the reappearance of 'Archons', a foe we have not seen since the Sentient War.

Several Archon Shards were retrieved from the battlefields. The Orokin demanded Albrecht Entrati explore the potential inherent in them, a task he immediately delegated to me.

The Necraloid has shown me some examples of Kermerros's work with Shards. Impressive. I believe I can improve upon it, however.

You may acquire the relevant Segment from the Cavia at your convenience.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/ArchonShardSegme.zhText:
Tenno，

当我努力适应我所醒来的这个时代时，我惊讶地注意到"执刑官"的重现，这可是自 Sentient 战争以来我们再也没有见到过的敌人。

一些执刑官源力石从战场上被缴获。奥罗金命令阿尔布雷希特·英择谛去研究它们的内在潜能，而他迅速地把这个任务分派给了我。

殁世械灵向我展示了克梅罗斯对源力石的一些应用。令人印象非常深刻。但我相信我可以进一步完善它。

你可以在方便的时候从科维兽那里获取相关模块。

洛德

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultEnergyD.zhText: 周围 10 米范围内的所有敌人使你每秒丢失 2 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultEximusB.text: Extra Eximus units have been summoned to the battle.
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultEximusB.zhText: 额外的卓越者单位已被召唤参加战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultMovemen.text: Lose 2 Health when moving. Jumping pauses the effect.
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultMovemen.zhText: 移动时损失 2 点生命值。跳跃会暂停效果。

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultNerfDes.text:
The following restrictions apply to all Netracell missions:

|NERFS|
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultNerfDes.zhText:
以下限制适用于所有衰退室任务：

|NERFS|

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultRewards.text: Inside the Netracells you may find:
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultRewards.zhText: 在衰退室里你可能会找到：

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultThunder.text: High-current electricity targets the bearer every few seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultThunder.zhText: 携带者每隔几秒会被强电流锁定并电击。

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultTitle.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的衰退室

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultVampiri.text: Lose Health every second. Killing enemies restores Health.
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultVampiri.zhText: 每秒流失生命值。击杀敌人可恢复生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultVoidImp.text: Slain enemies explode with Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultVoidImp.zhText: 被击杀的敌人会爆炸发出虚空能量。

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsAllBur.zhText: 小队必须取得四个钥符

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsAllPla.text: All players must carry at least 1 Keyglyph
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsAllPla.zhText: 所有玩家必须携带至少 1 个钥符

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsDroneS.text: Find and destroy the Necramite Drone to continue
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsDroneS.zhText: 寻找并摧毁殁世微灵无人机以继续任务

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsHackSe.zhText: 使用终端机来确定位置（可选）

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsKeyReq.text: The correct Keyglyph is required to open the vault
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsKeyReq.zhText: 打开宝库需要正确的钥符

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsKillEn.text: Kill Enemies to Lower the Security Level and Open the Netracell Doors
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsKillEn.zhText: 击杀敌人以降低防卫等级并打开衰退室大门

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsKillEn.text: Eliminate Enemies to Lower Security Level
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsKillEn.zhText: 消灭敌人以降低防卫等级

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsNearTe.text: The squad must pick up all four Keyglyphs to exit the Anchorhold
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsNearTe.zhText: 小队必须取得全部四个钥符才能离开安全所

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsSearch.zhText: 衰退室搜索范围已缩小

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsStealR.zhText: 找到石榴 2 代电路板

/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsVaultD.text: [PH] VAULT DOOR OPEN, DEACTIVATING SECURITY SYSTEMS
/Lotus/Language/Entrati/VoidVaultsVaultD.zhText: [PH] VAULT DOOR OPEN, DEACTIVATING SECURITY SYSTEMS

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: A vortex of clinical destruction, it hurls explosive charges, intent upon dismembering opponents as it was itself dismembered.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 一个毁灭性的漩涡，发射爆炸物来肢解对手，就像肢解自己一样。
在 30 秒内启动 2 个导管

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: To conquer the Murmur you must first master the art of multi-tasking. Activate 2 Conduits within 30s of each other twice.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 想要征服低语者，你必须先精通一心多用的艺术。在 30 秒内启动 2 个导管两次。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Lohk Surges are inescapable reminders that the Void has leaked into the labs. The only path forward is to embrace them.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 虚空泉脉不可避免地提醒我们，虚空已经渗入实验室。唯一的出路就是接受它们。
使用电击元素瓶击中 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Could painful electric shocks have a positive impact on the demeanor of our adversaries? Only one way to find out.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 痛苦的电击是否会对我们敌人的态度产生积极影响？只有一种方法可以找出答案。
使用火焰元素瓶击中 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Fire, it can create and it can destroy. Today, we test the destructive power of fire.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 火，它能够创造，也能够毁灭。今天，我们来测试火的毁灭力量。
使用冰冻元素瓶击中 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Someday, in the very distant future, our universe will cool completely and experience ‘heat death'. In the meantime, use Cold Amphors to speed things along for our enemy.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 在非常遥远的未来，我们的宇宙将会完全冷却并经历"热寂"。在此期间，使用冰冻元素瓶来加速我们敌人的未来。
使用毒素元素瓶击中 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: If The Mumur is so interested in Alchemy, then they shall experience the reactions first hand. Starting with elemental Toxin.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 如果低语者对元素转换如此感兴趣，那么它们将亲身体验这些反应。从毒素元素开始。
收集 |COUNT| 个低语者之眼

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The many eyes of the Indifference peer at us from beyond. Expose them, and take them out.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 虚空无情之物的许多双眼睛从远处凝视着我们。暴露它们，然后把它们带走。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Defeat the Mocking or Scathing Whisper
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 击败嘲讽低语或尖刻低语

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Papa wrote of the uncanny, the doppelganger, the whisper self. Find your dark Whisper and conquer it.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 爸爸曾写过关于怪异、二重身、低语的自我。找到你内心的黑暗低语并征服它。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Collect Vosphene Glyphs to active |COUNT| defenses
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 收集荧音浮印以激活 |COUNT| 次防御力量

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The visual and auditory sensors are crucial to our survival. Test the Auricle and Vitreum's advanced defenses.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 视觉和听觉传感器对我们的生存至关重要。测试魔耳和魔瞳的高级防御能力。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The Murmur has made themselves all too comfortable in Papa's laboratory. Time to make them uncomfortable. Destroy everything not bolted down. Leave them nothing of import.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 低语者在爸爸的实验室里过得太自在了。是时候让他们不舒服了。摧毁所有没有固定的东西。不要给它们留下任何重要的东西。
摧毁 |COUNT| 个爆破型殁世机甲的四肢

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Papa's Necramech Demolishers are formidable, yet, I theorize their limbs are vulnerable. Prove my theory, destroy Necramech Demolisher limbs.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 爸爸的爆破型殁世机甲虽然强大，但我猜测它们的四肢存在弱点。去验证我的理论，摧毁爆破型殁世机甲的四肢。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Interrupt a Demolisher's charge by rolling
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 通过翻滚来打断爆破型敌人的冲锋。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Interrupt a Demolisher's charge attack by rolling into them. Use their momentum against them. Huzzah!
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 通过翻滚冲向爆破型敌人，打断他们的冲锋。以它们的冲劲反制它们。耶！
杀死 |COUNT| 个飞行的低语者敌人

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: We shall not stand idly by while The Murmur hurls violence on us from above. Take out their airborne units.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 当低语者从上空侵犯我们时，我们不会袖手旁观。干掉它们的空中部队。
消灭 |COUNT| 名低语者敌人

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The Murmur grows ever louder and we need silence to concentrate. Go now, quiet them down. For good.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 低语者越来越吵闹，我们需要安静才能集中注意力。去吧，让他们闭嘴。永久地。
用硫酸泼向 |COUNT| 名敌人

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Experiment time! What happens when Vitriol comes into contact with our enemies? I await your results.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 实验时间！当硫酸与我们的敌人接触时会发生什么？我等着你们的结果。
消灭 |COUNT| 名暴戾虚空锐将

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The time is long overdue to show those insubordinate Rogue Voidrigs who runs things around here. Dismantle a few of them.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 早该让那些不听话的暴戾虚空锐将看看到底是谁掌控这一地方。把他们大卸八块。
找到 |COUNT| 个低语者石棺

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Murmur Sarcophages, stockpiles for their creeping takeover of Papa's Laboratories. Raid the Sarcophages, leave those things nothing of value.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 低语者石棺，是它们悄悄控制爸爸实验室的储藏点。洗劫这些石棺，不留下任何有价值的东西。
爆破型殁世机甲在距离导管 40 米以外处于无敌状态

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Be wary, the Papa's advanced security protocols have been triggered. Necramech Demolishers will be invulnerable until 40m from their target Conduit.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 请小心，爸爸的高级安全协议已被触发。爆破型殁世机甲在距离导管 40 米以外是不会受到伤害的。
摧毁 |COUNT| 个重型炮兵的弱点

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The Rogue Culverin. A formidable fighter of Papa’s own design; yet I have seen its schematics and I believe it has several vulnerabilities. Test my theory, locate its weak points and destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 暴戾重型炮兵。爸爸自己设计的一个强大战士；但我看过它的设计图，我认为它有几个弱点。验证下我的理论，找出它的弱点并摧毁它们。
在 6 分钟内完成赏金任务

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Get in. Get out. No time for lollygagging. Speed is of the essence.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 进入任务。完成离开。没空浪费时间。速度至关重要。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Find a terminal and deploy your personal Necramech. Perhaps your shining example will teach manners to those rogue marauders out in the labs.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 找到一台终端机并部署你自己的殁世机甲。也许你的光辉榜样能教会实验室里那些暴戾掠夺者什么是礼仪。
文卷将于 20 秒后消失

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The Paranoia Protocol; Papa's Dockets disappear after lying on the ground for 20 consecutive seconds. Do not delay.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 疑虑协议：爸爸的文卷在地面上放置满 20 秒后会消失。不要拖延。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
Tenno,

Your efforts in assisting me with the Deep Archimedea program have been nothing short of spectacular.

In the name of science, you have endured conditions and thwarted foes that would daunt the strongest.

In recognition of your work, it is my honor to award you the Archimedean Eye Sumdali, representative of the Cosmos which gazes back at us, even as we gaze into it.

Necraloid
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
Tenno，

你在协助我进行深层科研项目上的努力简直令人惊叹。

以科学的名义，你们忍受了严峻的条件，挫败了最强大的敌人。

为了表彰你的工作，我很荣幸地授予你阿基米德之眼船徽，它代表着宇宙，就像我们凝视着它一样，宇宙也在回望着我们。

殁世械灵
超越耀金奖章更进一步

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: This game mode is intended to be very challenging, and tuned around full squads. Be sure to prepare accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 这种游戏模式极具挑战性，并根据完整小队进行调整。请确保做好相应准备。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Recovered Entrati Artifact donated to Drusus Leverian
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 已将回收的英择谛神器捐赠给德枢·莱弗

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: This mocking phantom emerges to persecute the one who unwisely looked into its book, cutting deeply with hatred and blows alike. The book it arose from is its one vulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 这个嘲讽幻影会显现并纠缠草率地翻看这本书的人，通过仇恨和猛击造成伤害。产生它的那本书是它的唯一弱点。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Looking too deeply into Albrecht's lost grimoires may cause a void-born duplicate to appear, seething with contempt for the one who let it loose and hurling its wrath from afar. It cannot be banished until the book that gave rise to it is destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 对阿尔布雷希特的遗失魔典研究过深，可能会导致出现一个从虚空诞生的副本，对释放它的人充满蔑视，它的愤怒从远端汹涌而至。除非产生它的那本魔典被摧毁，否则无法驱逐它。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: The Cry went up, and did not go unanswered
Defeat the Fragmented Tide's unified forms to collect curses and feed them to the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle in your clan dojo.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 击败断肢潮的统一体，收集诅咒，并将其喂给你氏族道场中的警戒形态合成兽像。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Contribution status changed while you were making a selection. Please try again.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 贡献状态在你选择时有了更新。请再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: A Terrible Threat - and a Tremendous Opportunity

The Murmur continues to scrape deeper into our realm of existence. Having devised a solution to detect such whispers, Fibonacci won't allow such trespassing to threaten our system.

This Operation relies on Tenno across the Origin System to construct an invisible ‘living defense' against the growing Murmur threat. Players must have completed the Whispers in the Walls Quest to participate!

How to play:

To join this living defense, or ‘Murmur Telemetry Chorus,' you must hunt down the power source that'll continuously power your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle.

1. Go to your Dojo and build the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle from your Dojo Decorations. Only one Gargoyle can be built per Dojo, so if you don't see it in your Decoration list, your Clan Members may have already placed it!

2. Play Effervo on Deimos to earn Operation rewards. Players must successfully defeat both the Void Angel and the Assassination Target in-mission to earn one of the following:
  • Curse of Knowing (The Fragmented Suzerain)
  • Curse of Seeing (The Fragmented Anchorite)
  • Curse of Hearing (The Fragmented Zelator)

Earn 1 Curse per Normal Path mission, or double of the same Curse on Steel Path.

Successfully defeating the Assassination Target also rewards Grotesque Splinters. 

3. Return to your Dojo and feed the Curses to your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle every week to contribute to a Clan Trophy. Contribute Curses each week to hit the Cap and improve your Clan Scoring -- resulting in better Trophies at the end!

4. Visit the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle to exchange Grotesque Splinters for various Operation rewards!
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
低语者继续深入侵蚀我们存在的领域。斐波那契已经设计出一种检测这些低语者的方法，决不允许这样的侵入威胁我们的星系。

这项行动需要始源星系中的 Tenno 们共同建立一道看不见的"活跃的防御工事"，以应对日益增长的低语者威胁。玩家必须完成《墙中低语》系列任务才能参与！

如何游玩：

要加入这种活跃的防御工事，或称为"低语者遥测合声"，你需要找到可以为警戒形态合成兽像持续供能的能量源。

1. 前往道场并从道场装饰中建造警戒形态合成兽像。每个道场只能建造一尊合成兽像，如果你在装饰列表中看不到它，可能是你的氏族成员已经放置了它！

2. 在火卫二恶涌上游玩来获取行动奖励。玩家必须在任务中成功击败虚空天使和刺杀目标来获取以下物品之一：
  • 认知诅咒（接肢宗主）
  • 视觉诅咒（接肢隐士）
  • 听觉诅咒（接肢信徒）

每完成一次普通任务，可获得 1 个诅咒，或者在钢铁之路上获得两倍同样的诅咒。

成功击败刺杀目标还将奖励怪异碎片。 

3. 返回你的道场，每周向你的警戒形态合成兽像喂食诅咒，以助于氏族奖杯的贡献。每周贡献诅咒以达到上限，并提高氏族分数——从而在最后获得更好的奖杯！

4. 拜访警戒形态合成兽像，用怪异碎片换取各种行动奖励！
行动代号：合成兽像的悲鸣

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Complete the Whispers in the Walls quest to learn more.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 完成《墙中低语》系列任务以了解更多。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: You can exchange Grotesque Splinters with a Vigile Jahu Gargoyle in any Dojo
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 你可以在任意道场中通过警戒形态合成兽像交换怪异碎片

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Join a clan to fight alongside your fellow Tenno against The Murmur!
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 加入氏族，与你的 Tenno 同伴一起对抗低语者！

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: You have helped Loid in his work with the Cavia, though much remains to do.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 虽然仍有很多事情需要完成，你帮助洛德完成了与科维兽的合作。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Your work with the Cavia makes steady progress, despite fomenting disagreements.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 尽管存在分歧，但你与卡科维兽的合作取得了稳步进展。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Despite the chaos and tragedy in the Labs, your vigilant attention to duty has not faltered.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 尽管实验室发生了混乱和悲剧，但你对职责的警惕性丝毫没有减弱。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Your patience is bearing fruit, even as looming disaster threatens.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 尽管灾难迫在眉睫，但你们的耐心正在结出硕果。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: You, Loid and the Cavia have achieved a breakthrough. None of you will ever be quite the same again.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 你、洛德和科维兽已经取得了突破。你们谁都不会和以前一样了。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Animals sent into the Void by Albrecht Entrati, the three surviving Cavia came back changed forever. They gained human intelligence, but could speak only incoherent Voidtongue until the Jahu Gargoyle made them intelligible. Despite what Albrecht did to them, they have resolved to assist his chosen Operator.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 这三只仅存的科维兽是被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛送入虚空的动物，它们在回来时已经被彻底改变了。它们获得了人类的智力，但只能讲出无法理解的虚空语，直到形态合成兽像将它们的话变得可理解。尽管阿尔布雷希特曾经这么对待它们，但它们还是决定协助他所选择的指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: This lumbering fragment, unconcerned with self-preservation, is liable to rupture violently when in proximity to its target.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 这个笨重的断肢舍弃自我保护，一旦接近目标，就会剧烈爆裂。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: In its calcified chaos, the Indifference is disjointed even from itself.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 在虚空无情之物僵化的混沌之中，它甚至与自身都分离了。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: These sundered limbs have only partly fused. Lumbering, mindless horror is the result.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 这些断裂的肢体只有部分融合。结果就是变成了蹒跚而行、毫无知觉的恐怖存在。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 在极少数情况下，低语者断肢会组合成一个整体。这种情况下会产生一个强大的怪物。它可能有三种不同的形态：宗主级、信徒级和隐士级，而第四种形态的"接肢至尊"则是其中最可怕的。作为虚空无情之物的使者，它们固定着时间丝线，而它们奇异的主人则必须沿着时间丝线才能前进。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Albrecht Entrati was unsure whether this awkward composite was the result of the Indifference’s incomplete understanding of human anatomy, or an attempt at creative rearrangement thereof.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛不确定这个笨拙的复合体是虚空无情之物对人体结构不完全了解的结果，还是对人体结构进行创造性重新排列的尝试。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: A gilded chair upholstered with the finest silk. The perfect spot to sit and contemplate the Universe and beyond.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 一把镀金的椅子，上面铺着上好的丝绸。这是坐下来沉思宇宙和外宇宙的绝佳位置。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: An unorthodox chair of Albrecht Entrati’s own design.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛自己设计的一把另类椅子。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Curl up on the same chaise lounge that Albrecht Entrati’s favorite pet, Kalymos, once did.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 蜷缩在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛最喜欢的宠物卡利莫斯曾经呆过的躺椅上。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Cast an aura of sophistication with this Entrati Chandelier.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 用这款英择谛吊灯营造出精致的氛围。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: An elegant Candelabra that once adorned the secret laboratories of Albrecht Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 曾经装饰过阿尔布雷希特·英择谛秘密实验室的优雅烛台。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: A grand, gilded Candelabra originally found in the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s labs.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 最初在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛实验室深处发现的宏伟镀金烛台。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Create a timeless look with this wall sconce, plucked from the depths of Albrecht Entrati’s Deimos laboratory.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 这款壁灯取自阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的火卫二实验室深处，打造出永恒的外观。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Relax and ponder the unknown with this Entrati Settee.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 使用这款英择谛沙发椅放松并思考未知。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: A deeply complex machine of unknown function.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 功能未知、极其复杂的机器。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Designed and built by Albrecht Entrati, the precise purpose of this machine is as much of an enigma as the man himself.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 这台机器由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计和制造，其确切用途与他本人一样是个谜。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Used by Albrecht Entrati to chart a temporal path to eras unknown.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛用此绘制通向未知时代的时间路径。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Relax, as Albrecht Entrati must have, with this timeless ottoman.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 踏上这款经久不衰的脚凳放松身心，就像阿尔布雷希特·英择谛所做的一样。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: A sophisticated stool. Perfect for lab work and deep concentration.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 一把精致的凳子。非常适合实验室工作和深度专注。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
Regularly inflicts damage. Rate and amount of damage increases with each stack.
Every 60s another stack is added. Cleared when the boss is defeated.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
定期造成伤害。每层增加伤害频率和伤害量。
每隔 60 秒叠加一层。在头目被击败后层数清零。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: An experimental melee Necramech, a variant on the Tombjockey class, built for Albrecht Entrati by his son-in-law. It now fights alongside the very Murmur foes it was meant to repel.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的女婿所建造的一款实验性近战殁世机甲，古墓骑师级的变体。现在，它却加入了原本要对抗的低语者势力。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: An experimental Necramech, optimized for ranged combat, built for Albrecht Entrati by his son-in-law. It now fights alongside the very Murmur foes it was meant to repel.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的女婿所建造的一款实验性殁世机甲，针对远程战斗进行了优化。现在，它却加入了原本要对抗的低语者势力。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: A robust, if primitive, war-engine initially developed by Albrecht Entrati's son-in-law to fight in the Old War and now repurposed as a laboratory guardian. Confused as to who its true master is, it now sides with the Murmur, contradicting its original precepts.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 一种原始却强大的战争机器，由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的女婿研制开发，最初是为了投入到远古之战中。现在被改装成了实验室守护者。由于搞不清谁是它真正的主人，它现在与低语者统一阵线，违背了自己最初的信条。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Brutally cut from the Indifference in order to protect the greater whole, its three hands bestow the Void’s twisted blessing upon its allies, so long as they remain attached.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 为了保护更大的整体，它被残忍地从虚空无情之物中切割出来；只要它的三只手与友军保持连接，它便会将虚空扭曲的祝福赐予友军。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
Executor Ballas is now known to have colluded with Hunhow during the Old War in an attempt to betray the Tenno to the Sentients.

Executor Ballas is now known to have survived the collapse of the Orokin Empire. 

Significant Sentient forces are now known to have amassed, undetected, at the periphery of the Origin System during the span of time since the Old War.

Executor Ballas has now manipulated The Lotus for his own ends, compelling her to resume her Sentient identity, NATAH, in order to use her as proxy commander of the Sentient forces.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

Ballas has led the Sentients in a renewed attack on the Origin System. ERRA, the brother of Natah, is acting as joint commander. 

The factions of the Origin System have formed an alliance against this common foe.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno’s personal timeline has been disrupted. Knowing he cannot kill the Tenno, Ballas has opted to imprison them within their own history. The Tenno will be unable to escape this loop without the paradoxical intervention of an outside force.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
已确认，执行者 Ballas 在远古之战期间与 Hunhow 勾结，意图将 Tenno 出卖给 Sentient。

已验证，Ballas 在 Orokin 帝国崩溃后存活下来。

从远古之战结束至今，已侦测到大量 Sentient 部队在始源星系外围集结，但此前未被发现。

执行者 Ballas 目前正利用 Lotus，操控她恢复原本的 Sentient 身份——NATAH。此举旨在将她作为 Sentient 力量的代理指挥官，以满足其个人私欲。

** 重大进展 **

Ballas 领导 Sentient 对始源星系再次发起进攻。Natah 的弟弟 ERRA 担任联合指挥官。

始源星系内的各派系已联合起来，共同抵抗外敌。

** 重大进展 **

Tenno 的个人时间线遭到破坏。由于 Ballas 知晓自己无法杀死 Tenno，因此选择将他们囚禁于自我历史循环之中。除非有外部悖论力量的干预，否则 Tenno 将无法逃脱此循环。

持续监测中。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
The Zariman vessel, adrift for an unknown time within the Void, now acts as a containment field for unrealized possibilities.

One such possibility is an alternate version of the TENNO. This individual escaped into the Void on their own initiative, rather than being rescued and taken into the Origin System as the Tenno were. Within the Void they established a realm, ‘Duviri’, in which to live.

This individual, the DRIFTER, has now entered the Origin System.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

Ballas has established himself as ruler of the Origin System. 

Through his ‘Narmer’ cult, all citizens have been forced to wear headpieces that distort perceived reality. Ballas is thus able to dictate exactly what the wearer experiences.

Erra continues to act as Ballas’s enforcer, using composite creatures called ARCHONS as muscle.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

With the assistance of Hunhow and the Stalker, the Drifter has fought back against Ballas, destroying the Archons.

The Tenno has been freed from their recursive timeline and now coexists with the Drifter. 

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

Ballas is dead. The Lotus, now free from Ballas’s conditioning, has chosen a preferred primary name and form.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
「扎里曼号」飞船在虚空中漂流了不知多久，现在它成为了未实现可能性的封存区域。

观察到的一种可能性为 TENNO 不同的实体版本。此实体主动逃入虚空，而非像 Tenno 那样被救援并转移至始源星系。该实体在虚空中创建了名为“双衍王境”的领域，并居住其中。

该名为漂泊者的个体现已进入始源星系。

** 重大进展 **

Ballas 已成为始源星系的统治者。 

通过其领导的“合一众”邪教，所有公民被强制佩戴扭曲现实的面障，使 Ballas 能够精确控制其精神。

Erra 继续作为 Ballas 的执行者，利用名为执刑官的复合生物作为其武力支持。

** 重大进展 **

漂泊者在 Hunhow 和追猎者的协助下对 Ballas 发起反击，并成功摧毁执刑官。

Tenno 从递归时间线中获得解放，并与漂泊者共存。

** 重大进展 **

Ballas 已被消灭。Lotus 现已摆脱 Ballas 的控制，并选择其偏好的主要名称和形态。

持续监测中。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
** CRITICAL DEVELOPMENT **

In a deranged attempt to transport himself and his cult to Tau, Ballas opened portals between the Void and conventional reality on an unprecedented scale. 

This has attracted the attention of THE INDIFFERENCE, whose freedom of action appears to have drastically increased.

The threat posed by THE INDIFFERENCE is now at a critical level.

The Laboratories have come under fresh assault from the Murmur. Unless the Sleeper is awoken, Albrecht Entrati’s legacy will perish.

** CONCLUSION **

Contacting The Necraloid.

Activating the Kalymos Sequence.

Awaiting the Chosen Operator.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
** 关键进展 **

Ballas 以前所未有的规模开启了虚空与传统现实间的通道，目的是将自身及其邪教组织传送至 Tau 星系。

此行为引起了虚空无情之物的关注，其活动范围和自由度似乎显著增加。

目前，虚空无情之物构成的威胁已达危急水平。

实验室遭遇低语者攻击。若未能唤醒沉睡者，阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的传承面临消亡风险。

** 结论 **

联系殁世械灵；

启动卡里莫斯数列；

等待被选中的指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
The Laboratories are sealed.

Our task: watch for the chosen OPERATOR.

** KNOWN DATA **

- The Operator is a TENNO.

- A TENNO was a specialist warrior in service to the Orokin, the masters of the Origin System.

- The TENNO piloted WARFRAMES, suits of sophisticated battle armor.

- They fought alongside the DAX, augmented human warriors who were more numerous and less effective than the Tenno.

- TENNO existed to battle the SENTIENTS, evolving machines hostile to the Orokin and their way of life.

** COMPLICATIONS **

- The Orokin Empire fell. Only artifacts remain.

- The war with the Sentients, the ‘Old War’, is long over.

- No Tenno have been seen for generations.

** Conclusion **

Watch. Wait. Report.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
实验室已被封锁。

我们的任务：寻找被选中的指挥官。

** 已知数据 **

- 指挥官是 TENNO。

- TENNO 作为特殊战士，为统治始源星系的 Orokin 效力。

- TENNO 操纵着 WARFRAME 战甲——精细复杂的战斗护甲。

- 他们与禁卫并肩作战，这些强化后的人类战士虽然人数比 Tenno 多，但效率远不及 Tenno。

- TENNO 的存在是为了对抗 SENTIENT，它们是敌视 Orokin 及其生活方式的不断进化的机器。

** 复杂情况 **

- Orokin 帝国已经覆灭。只有神器留存。

- 与 Sentient 之间的战争——“远古之战”，早已结束。

- 几个世代以来都没有看到过 Tenno。

 ** 结论 **

寻找。等待。报告。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
A suitable Tenno candidate has been found.

The reawakened Tenno is being guided by THE LOTUS, the same entity who led the Tenno at the end of the Old War. 

THE LOTUS is known to be a former SENTIENT previously named NATAH. She was captured and converted to her current state during the Old War by EXECUTOR BALLAS, a high-ranking Orokin. 

EXECUTOR BALLAS is theorized to have modeled the appearance and persona of THE LOTUS upon his deceased lover MARGULIS, an Archimedean scientist executed for her devotion to the Tenno.

THE LOTUS appears to be just as devoted to the Tenno as Margulis was. She has not, however, divulged the secret of her Sentient origin to them.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
已找到合适的 Tenno 候选者。

再次被唤醒的 Tenno 受到 LOTUS 的引导，与在远古之战结束时领导 Tenno 的是同一个体。

已知 LOTUS 曾经是名为 NATAH 的 SENTIENT。在远古之战期间，她被高阶 Orokin 执行者 BALLAS 捕获并变成如今的状态。 

据推测，执行者 BALLAS 以他已故的爱人 MARGULIS 为原型为 LOTUS 塑造了外貌和性格，MARGULIS 是哲士科学家，因对 Tenno 的忠诚而被处决。

LOTUS 似乎就像 Margulis 一样对 Tenno 保持忠诚。然而，她并没有向他们透露她曾是 Sentient 的秘密。

继续监视。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
Tenno candidate has engaged with several hostile forces. 

The GRINEER are degraded descendants of the cloned worker force that once served the Orokin. They are brutal combatants concerned only with the amassing of power and territory. Left unchecked, they slaughter, enslave and plunder civilians.

The CORPUS are a merchant cult devoted to profit. They make extensive use of robotics. They exploit civilians economically and violently protect their ‘investments’.

The INFESTATION is a biomechanical plague, apparently controlled by one or more hive minds. It corrupts organic and mechanical targets, converting them into mutated servants. 

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
Tenno 候选者与多个敌对势力交战。 

GRINEER 是曾为 Orokin 服务的克隆工人的退化后代。他们是凶残的好战者，只关心如何扩张权力和领土。如果不加以制止，他们肆无忌惮的屠杀、奴役和掠夺平民。

CORPUS 是一群追求利益的商人崇拜组织。他们广泛使用机器人。他们在经济上剥削平民，用暴力保护他们的“投资”。

INFESTATION 是生物力学的瘟疫，显然是被一个或多个蜂群思维控制着。它腐化有机物和机械目标，把它们转化为变异的仆人。 

继续监视。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
The Tenno has discovered abandoned Orokin towers within The Void. These towers were intended to act as sanctuaries from Sentient attack during the Old War, since the Void is intensely damaging to Sentients.

** SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION **

Much of Orokin society was dependent upon the Void. It was used as a shortcut through space and as a source of energy. Its full potential was first theorized by Albrecht Entrati within these very laboratories.

It is Albrecht Entrati whom this device serves.

It is Albrecht Entrati who has instructed us to locate the chosen Operator.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno has encountered the Entrati Family on Deimos. The Family remains unaware of the existence of these laboratories. The Necraloid is an exception. Its memory is, however, suppressed until the activation of the Kalymos Sequence.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
Tenno 在虚空中发现了被遗弃的 Orokin 塔。因为虚空会对 Sentient 造成极大伤害，这些塔在远古之战期间作为避难所来防止 Sentient 的攻击。

** 补充信息 **

Orokin 社会的大部分都依赖于虚空。它被用作穿越空间的捷径和以及能源来源。它的可能性理论最早是由阿尔布雷希特·英择谛在这些实验室里提出的。

这个装置是为阿尔布雷希特·英择谛建造的。

阿尔布雷希特·英择谛指示我们找到被选中的指挥官。

** 重大进展 **

Tenno 在火卫二遇到了英择谛家族。这个家族仍然不知道这些实验室的存在。但殁世械灵例除外。不过，它的记忆是被抑制的，直到卡利莫斯数列被激活。

继续监视。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno subject has learned of the Lotus’s Sentient nature, including her original name, NATAH. 

A Dax, TESHIN, has presented himself as a rival mentor, claiming that the Lotus cannot be trusted.

The Tenno has encountered Natah’s ‘father’, the Sentient war-leader HUNHOW, whose remains lie beneath the oceans of Uranus. HUNHOW had expected Natah to destroy the Tenno in accordance with her original mandate.

The Lotus continues to reject her Sentient nature and seems concerned to retain the Tenno’s trust.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
** 重大进展 **

Tenno 候选人已经得知 Lotus 本质是 Sentient，包括她的原名——NATAH。 

禁卫 TESHIN 以另一种导师的身份出现，声称 Lotus 不可信。

Tenno 遇到了 Natah 的“父亲”——Sentient 的战争领袖 HUNHOW，他的遗骸沉没在天王星的海底。HUNHOW 曾期望 Natah 会按照她最初命令摧毁 Tenno。

 Lotus 拒绝接受她的 Sentient 本性，似乎想要保住 Tenno 的信任。

持续监测中。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
Since awakening, the Tenno has been pursued by THE STALKER. 

Appearance and combat capability suggest THE STALKER is a surviving Low Guardian, a former protector of the Orokin.

Evidence implies that the Orokin Empire fell at the hands of the Tenno themselves. THE STALKER’s motive may therefore be revenge.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

HUNHOW and THE STALKER are working together. THE STALKER has been sent to find THE RESERVOIR, a place believed to conceal the Tenno’s gravest secret, and which could be used to destroy them all at a stroke.

The Tenno has set off in pursuit, aided by the Corpus technocrat Alad V.

** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Reservoir has been located. It is on the moon, ‘Lua’, previously believed destroyed, but in fact concealed within the Void.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
自从觉醒以来，Tenno 一直被追猎者追踪。 

从外表和战斗能力来看，追猎者是一名幸存的低阶护卫，曾是 Orokin 的保护者。

有证据表明 Orokin 帝国覆灭于 Tenno 之手。因此，追猎者的动机可能是复仇。

** 重大进展 **

HUNHOW 和追猎者联手了。追猎者被派去寻找被认为隐藏着 Tenno 的最大秘密的地方——储梦池，如果找到的话就可以一举摧毁所有 Tenno。

Tenno 在 Corpus 技术专家 Alad V 的协助下，出发去追击。

** 重大进展 **

储梦池已经被找到。它在月球上，“Lua”——曾被认为已经被毁灭，但实际上隐藏在虚空之中。

持续监测中。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
** SIGNIFICANT DEVELOPMENT **

The Tenno has discovered the truth of their identity. They are a human child, one of many kept within Cryopods on Lua in the Reservoir.

These children were passengers on the Zariman Ten-Zero, the colony ship bound for Tau and lost to the Void. When recovered, they were found to have developed parahuman abilities.

Despite Margulis’s protests, they were placed into a state of lucid dreaming and used as Warframe pilots.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
** 重大进展 **

Tenno 发现了自己身份的真相。他们原是人类儿童，是被关在月球储能池冷冻舱里的众多儿童之一。

这些孩子曾乘坐「扎里曼 10-0 号」殖民飞船，该飞船原定前往 Tau 星系，但在虚空中偏离了航道。当这些孩子被救援后，人们发现他们已获得超越普通人类的能力。

尽管 Margulis 曾反对，他们仍被置入清醒梦境，并被用作战甲的操作者。

持续监测中。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
The Tenno has encountered the Grineer Queens, the semi-mythical leaders of the Grineer.

The Elder Queen, aged and diseased, had planned to transfer her mind into the Tenno’s young body. This process, ‘Continuity’, was common among the Orokin Elites and was used to extend their lifespans indefinitely.

Teshin Dax helped the Tenno to resist the Elder Queen, who has now been eliminated. Only the younger ‘Worm Queen’ remains.

The Tenno has recovered much of their lost training. Suitability to fulfill the role of CHOSEN OPERATOR has exponentially increased.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
Tenno 遇见了 Grineer 具有传奇色彩的领袖——Grineer 双子女皇。

年迈且多病的年长女皇企图将其意识转移到 Tenno 年轻的身体中。这一过程，称为“延续”，在 Orokin 精英中颇为普遍，用以实现生命的无限延长。

禁卫 Teshin 已协助 Tenno 抵抗年长女皇，其已被成功消灭。目前，仅剩较年轻的“蠕虫女皇”存活。

Tenno 已重获其大部分遗失的训练。作为“被选中的指挥官”，其能力已显著提升。

持续监测中。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text:
The Tenno has been made aware of Rell, a fellow Tenno who was outcast by his peers.

Rell had voluntarily assumed the duty of keeping the Origin System safe from a Void-based entity referred to as ‘The Man In The Wall’.

With Rell’s death, that responsibility has now transferred to the Tenno.

** CRITICAL DEVELOPMENT **

‘The Man in the Wall’ is identical with the entity known to us as ‘The Indifference’.

Albrecht Entrati is ultimately responsible for attracting its attention to the Origin System.

Albrecht Entrati may be ultimately responsible for its existence.

Parameter confirmed. The Tenno is the Chosen Operator. We await the correct moment to activate the Kalymos Sequence.

Continuing to monitor.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText:
Tenno 对 Rell 的存在已有所察觉，Rell 是一名被同伴遗弃的 Tenno。

Rell 自愿承担了保护始源星系不受虚空实体“墙中人”侵袭的职责。

随着 Rell 的逝世，这项责任已转移至其他 Tenno 承担。

** 关键进展 **

“墙中人”与已知的“虚空无情之物”实体相同。

阿尔布雷希特·英择谛被确认为导致“墙中人”关注始源星系的最终责任方。

阿尔布雷希特·英择谛可能对其存在负有根本责任。

已确定相关参数。Tenno 被确认为选中的指挥官。当前正等待启动卡里莫斯数列的适宜时机。

持续监测中。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Select a file to view its contents.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 选择一个文件以查看其内容。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.text: Clings to the cliffs and walls, hurling masonry on anything unfortunate enough to be traveling below.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGenera.zhText: 依附在悬崖和墙壁上，向任何不幸在下面经过的东西投掷石块。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: Avian status: overstimulated. Sedative recommended. Revival process ongoing. Subject Sent into Void by A.Entrati on Mission 3-1
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 鸟类状态：过度兴奋。建议使用镇静剂。正在进行复苏处理。个体曾被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛派往虚空执行 3-1 号任务。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: Loid has had strange dreams and desperately needs to show you something.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 洛德做了一些奇怪的梦，急需给你看一些东西。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: Open your Arsenal and equip the Grimoire
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 打开军械库并装备魔典

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: Norg status: fully alert. Brain function: exceptional. Monitoring nutrients. Subject Sent into Void by A.Entrati on Mission 3-1
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 诺格状态：完全警戒。大脑功能：卓越。正在监测营养状况。个体曾被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛派往虚空执行 3-1 号任务。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: A curious blueprint found in the memory banks of Albrecht Entrati's Pom-2.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 在阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的石榴 2 代电脑系统记忆中发现的奇特蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: Use <SECONDARY_FIRE> when the reticle meter is full to unleash the Grimoire's Voltaic Orb
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 准星仪表充满时，使用 <SECONDARY_FIRE> 来释放魔典的电弧球

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text:
Tenno, the Warframe Qorvex was designed by my Albrecht's own hand, to protect the chosen Operator from the hazards of his laboratory. This design is yours by right.

I intend to keep the promise I made to him. When the time is right and the equipment repaired, I will assist you to travel back to the past, to the pivotal year of 1999. 

Perhaps, between us, we may change history.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText:
Tenno，Qorvex 战甲是由我的阿尔布雷希特亲手设计的，用来保护被选中的指挥官免受他实验室的危害。这个设计理应属于你。

我打算履行我对他的承诺。一旦时机成熟，设备修复，我将协助你回到过去，回到关键的 1999 年。

也许，我们两个，可以改变历史。

洛德

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: A vision of the past promised a bleak future, but the unexpected assistance of the Cavia offered a precious second chance. With a memory of love holding the Indifference at bay, Loid prepares to send you back... and perhaps this time, you will not be late.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 过去的景象预示了一个黯淡的未来，但来自科维兽的意外帮助提供了宝贵的第二次机会。在爱的记忆阻止了虚空无情之物的同时，洛德准备把你送回去……或许这一次，你不会迟到。
