/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: Connect the Grimoire to the Gargoyle
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 将魔典连接到合成兽像

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: Discover the source of the sound

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 拿起阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的魔典
按下 <MENU_SELECT> 来播放下一个视频
前往阿尔布雷希特的石榴 2 代电脑

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: What did he say to you, right before he left?
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 他走之前对你说了什么？

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text: …that this was no way to remember me.
Cervulite status: extreme depression. No substitute mate available. Species extinction: imminent. Subject Sent into Void by A.Entrati on Mission 3-1
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText: 石鹿状态：极度抑郁。无替代配偶。物种灭绝：即将发生。个体曾被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛派往虚空执行 3-1 号任务。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text:
Chosen Operator. A friendly suggestion: you could do so much more with those Melee weapons of yours. I donate my wisdom on both tool and technique. Listen well.

TENNOKAI, a fighting technique fusing Void and Beastial instinct. Raw power.  While I have never used Tennokai, I understand it perfectly. Somewhat of a mind mastery. Enough so that lost materials pertaining to Tennokai have been stored just out of my reach in the Sanctum.

Tools. Papa was not one to rest, use this segment to unlock more potential for your Arsenal. The Arcane was an art and science that Papa studied well - the convexity of my bowl a magnifying glass on his research, and now your gain.

Install this segment, acquire Melee Arcanes, find Tennokai Modules, and observe the results: the swift deletion of your foes.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText:
被选中的指挥官。友情提示：你能用你的近战武器做多更多的事情。我把我对于工具和技术上的智慧贡献给你。听好了。

TENNO 气解，一种融合了虚空与兽性本能的战斗技巧。原始的力量。虽然我从未使用过 Tenno 气解，但我却对其了如指掌。某种程度上，我是个心灵大师。以至于与 Tenno 气解相关的丢失资料被放在我够不着的圣所。

工具。爸爸是个闲不住的人，用这个模块来为你的军械库释放更多潜力。赋能是爸爸研究得很透彻的一门艺术和科学——我的鱼缸凸面是他研究的放大镜，现在成了你的收获。

安装这个模块，获取近战赋能，找到 Tenno 气解模块，然后观察结果：迅速消灭你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.text:
Tenno,

Please meet me at the Necralisk as soon as you are able. This cannot wait.

Discretion is paramount. Tell nobody.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiQuest/.zhText:
Tenno，

请尽快到殁世幽都与我会面。此事不能等待。

谨慎至关重要。不要告诉任何人。

洛德

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.text: We need to study the Infestation more closely.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.zhText: 我们得更深入研究这些感染。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.text: Studying the insides of the Deimos specimens is the only way to track what's happening to the ecosystem.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.zhText: 研究火卫二内部的样本，这是追踪生态系统发生了什么的唯一方法。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.text: Excessive predation is causing wild imbalances. Let's fix that.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.zhText: 过度捕食会造成严重的失衡。让我们来解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.text: The more we have, the more we can reconstruct.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.zhText: 我们掌握的越多，我们能够重建的就越完整。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.text: Let’s find out how degraded these specimens have become.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.zhText: 让我们来看看这些样本的降解程度。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.text: This many specimens in one area is too many, even for Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.zhText: 即便是火卫二，在一个区域境内有这么多样本，也实在是太多了。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.text: We need to understand how the lifeforms of Deimos feed, especially on one another.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/DaughterTas.zhText: 我们需要了解火卫二生命体是如何进食的，尤其是同类相食。
研究营养物质的吸收速率

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.text: We’re lacking a few key supplies. Nothing major, but it’s best to be prepared.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.zhText: 我们还缺少一些关键补给品。不是什么大问题，但最好还是做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.text: Adaptability is the key to facing off against any kind of hazard.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.zhText: 适应性是面对任何危险的关键。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.text: The more raw materials I have, the more I can experiment.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.zhText: 我拥有的原材料越多，我可以做的实验就更多。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.text: Try to minimise the risk to yourself. No sense in dying with full pockets.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.zhText: 尽量不要让自己涉险，不要有钱没命花。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.text: Stocks are always running low. I could swear something’s making off with them.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.zhText: 库存一直不足。我可以发誓，肯定有什么东西把它们卷跑了。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.text: Got to beat the environment into subjugation. Especially here.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.zhText: 必须得用武力征服环境。尤其是在这里。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.text: Nobody can do good work without adequate resources, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskD.zhText: Tenno，没有足够的资源，谁都无法把工作做好。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/FatherTaskN.zhText: 定位火卫二特产资源的坐标

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: A pinch of this, a dab of that.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 捏一捏这个，抹一抹那个。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: We use what we can to do what we must.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 我们尽己所能来完成使命。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: The damage is severe, but reversible.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 损害是严重的，但仍然可以恢复原状。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Healing is so often a messy process.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 治疗通常是个很麻烦的过程。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: The remedy is from the same source as the harm.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 解药和毒药本是同根生。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: We have a long road ahead of us.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 我们还有很长的路要走。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: A little at a time is better than nothing at all.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 积少成多，好过无所事事

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: It’s always worth doing what we can.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 全力以赴总是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Concoct Orokin balm
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 调制奥罗金香脂

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Brew memory tincture
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 酿造记忆酊剂

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Prepare restorative draught
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 准备复原汤药

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Improvise mental enhancer
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 即兴智力强化

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Replicate ancient recipe
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 复制古时配方

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Blend traditional medicines
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 混合传统药物

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Follow Grandmother's instructions
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 遵照"祖母"的指示

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Distil secret preparation
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 秘密预备提取

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Do tell me what my troublesome kin have been up to.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 一定要告诉我，我那些喜欢惹麻烦的亲戚做了什么。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: I always have time to listen to a polite Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 对一位彬彬有礼的 Tenno，我随时洗耳恭听。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: I'm not asking you to spy for me. Just hoping for a chat between friends.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 我不是要你替我刺探消息。只是想和你像朋友一样进行对话。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Honestly. Sometimes one wants to just bang their heads together.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 老实说，有时候我真想对他们来点暴力手段，让他们消停点。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: You bring an outsider's perspective to these matters. I value that.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 你为这些问题提供了作为局外人的观点。我很看重这点。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: You've been a very busy little Tenno, I see. Why not tell Grandmother all about it?
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 小 Tenno，我能看出来你最近很忙。为什么不和"祖母"聊聊这些呢？

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: If I am to help them, I must know all their doings. I’m sure you understand.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 如果要我帮助他们，我必须知道他们的所作所为。我相信你能理解的。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Discuss latest family gossip
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 闲话最近的家长里短

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Recount your adventures
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 讲述你的探险经历

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Have discreet conversation
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 言辞谨慎地对话

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Divulge family plots and plans
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 泄露家族阴谋与计划

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Trade Entrati intrigue
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 交换英择谛的阴谋

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Report on Deimos happenings
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 汇报火卫二发生的事件

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.text: Update information channels
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/Grandmother.zhText: 更新信息渠道

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.text: Loid says drilling into the ground is boring! It's not! It's fun!
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.zhText: 洛德说钻探地底很无聊！并不是的！这很有趣！

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.text: HI FUTURE OTAK! USE THIS BIT TO TELL THEM WHAT TO DO. THANKS! OTAK
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.zhText: "你好，未来的奥塔！使用这一小部分来告诉他们该做些什么。谢谢你！奥塔"

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.text: Always take the proper precautions when you are using your mining equipment!
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.zhText: 在使用采矿设备时，请始终采取适当的防护措施！

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.text: All those precious resources are just lying there waiting to be collected! That can't be right.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.zhText: 所有那些宝贵的资源都躺在那里，等待着被收集！那是不对的。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.text: Get on out there, pal! You'll be hacking up chunks in a jiffy!
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.zhText: 前往那里，朋友！很快你就会收获颇丰！

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.text: This looks great! I'd come along with you if I could! Go team us!
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.zhText: 这看起来很棒！如果可以的话，我真想与你们一同前往！加油！

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.text: Just leave the hole there. Don’t bother filling it in again. They don't need us to do that.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/OtakTaskDes.zhText: 把孔留在那儿就好了。不必再费事把它填上。他们不需要我们这样做。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Counteracts the myriad effects of the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 抵消感染带来的种种影响。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Helps restore the sense of self.

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 驱散火卫二的精神"迷雾"。
扭转熵环境产生的影响。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Slows the progress of the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 减缓体内被感染侵蚀的进度。
排出体内的生物机械污染物。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Puts back a little of what Deimos has taken away.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 复原一些火卫二夺走的东西。
重新平衡体内的神经化学比率。
重新建立断开的突触传递。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Assists with mental and emotional reconnection.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 有助于心理和情感的重新连接。
解决血清素严重失衡的问题。
恢复精神和身体的稳定。
应对缓慢丧失自我的现象。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Helps the system recover its natural balance.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 协助系统恢复其天然平衡。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Safeguards and fortifies the limbic system.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 保护和强化脑边缘系统。
通过刺激感染细胞来使其自毁。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Arrests further growth of Infested tissue.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 阻止感染组织进一步生长。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Assists in the healing of scars.
Purges metal splinters and foreign bodies.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 清除体内的金属碎片和异物。
修复、恢复以及注入活力。
恢复被感染者侵染的四肢的血液循环。
对扑猎达赛咬伤处消毒。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Purges spore-related growths from the recipient.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 把与孢子有关的增生从宿主中清除。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Regrows tissue lost to the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 使因感染而损失的组织重新生长。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.text: Soothes the physical and emotional pain of the Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/RemedyDesc_.zhText: 缓解英择谛受到的身心创伤。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.text: Long-term study means we need to catch some designated specimens and prep them for re-release.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.zhText: 长期研究意味着我们需要捕捉一些指定的样本，并让它们为重回自然做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.text: Breeding programs can't proceed without sufficient specimen variation.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.zhText: 没有足够的样本差异，繁殖计划就无法进行。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.text: Everything feeds on something. We need more information.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.zhText: 万物都处于食物链中。我们需要更多的信息。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.text: If our research is to be truly groundbreaking, we'll need plenty more of it in these key areas.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.zhText: 如果我们的研究要取得真正的突破，那么在这些关键领域，我们还需要进行更多研究。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.text: Our relationship depends on mutual respect. Don't let your skills go rusty.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.zhText: 我们的关系基于相互尊重。不要让你的技能生疏了。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.text: It’s not pleasant, but we can learn a lot by taking samples from sedated specimens.
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskDesc.zhText: 这并不令人愉快，但是我们可以通过从被镇静的样本中取样来了解到很多东西。

/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskName.text: Bag and tag the Deimos fauna
/Lotus/Language/EntratiTasks/SonTaskName.zhText: 猎获并标记火卫二动物群
调查捕食者—被捕食者之间的动态关系
扩展可用的生物识别数据

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/AshGeminiEpheme.text: Obscure the identity of the killer within with this translucent ephemera. The mark of a Scoria assassin.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/AshGeminiEpheme.zhText: 用这种半透明的幻纹掩盖凶手的身份。这是火山石组织刺客的标志。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/BaroEvilEphemer.text: This ephemera is an endless source of sinister style.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/BaroEvilEphemer.zhText: This ephemera is an endless source of sinister style.

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/BaroEvilEphemer.text: Those in the vicinity of this ephemera claim to hear baneful whispers, but surely these are fanciful tales.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/BaroEvilEphemer.zhText: 据说靠近幻纹的人们能听到邪恶的低语，但这显然是些虚幻的传闻。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CitrineDeluxeEp.text: Leave lingering sparks in the hearts of all you encounter with Citrine Aphrodita’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CitrineDeluxeEp.zhText: Citrine 美神的标志性幻纹将在你遇到的所有人心中留下挥之不去的火花。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Conquera2022Eph.text: Wear this floral Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Conquera2022Eph.zhText: 佩戴此花艺幻纹作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Conquera2026Eph.text: Wear this streaming ephemera as a symbol of support of the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation Quest.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Conquera2026Eph.zhText: 佩戴这款流光幻纹，表达你对玛嘉烈公主癌症基金慈善活动的支持。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/ConqueraEphemer.text: Wear this Ribbon Ephemera as a symbol of support in the Quest to Conquer Cancer.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/ConqueraEphemer.zhText: 佩戴此缎带幻纹作为支持「征服癌症活动」的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.text: Information flows like live current through this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的、信息若电流般流淌的幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.text: A blazingly regal Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的炽烈尊贵幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.text: An icily imperious Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冰冷傲慢幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.text: Hatch venomous plots in this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的、生出恶毒阴谋的幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.text: A magnetically compelling Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的磁性引力幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.text: A radiant Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的辐射幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.text: A striking Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/CorpusLichEphem.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冲击幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/DexEphemeraDesc.text: Commemorate 12 cycles since the Tenno first awoke with this graceful ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/DexEphemeraDesc.zhText: 通过这款优雅的幻纹纪念 Tenno 首次苏醒以来的 12 个周期。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/GarudaCrewEphem.text: Bathe in the life essence of your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/GarudaCrewEphem.zhText: 在敌人的生命精华中徜徉。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraAn.text: Forewarn that fury awaits anyone who challenges your Kaithe and its rider.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraAn.zhText: 事先警告，对于任何挑战你的绝灵骥和它的骑手的人，愤怒在等待着他们。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraFe.text: A skilled rider repurposes the Void’s mark for their Kaithe.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraFe.zhText: 一位熟练的骑手将虚空的印记重新应用在他的绝灵骥上。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraFl.text: Joy blossoms in the Myrthen Coronet.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraFl.zhText: 欢乐在欢馨马冠中开花。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraSn.text: The Enverve Coronet elegantly expresses a bitter emotion.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraSn.zhText: 激妒马冠优雅地传达了一种苦涩的情感。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraTe.text: The Wistfall Coronet depicts melancholy’s beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/HorseEphemeraTe.zhText: 忧泣马冠展示了忧郁之美。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"Time will show the way, And I'll mend the heart you've broken"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"年华流逝，我将愈合你心上的伤口"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"Please stay
Don't put out the flame and run away"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"请留在我身边
留下情热的火焰"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"In this heart break
I'll be here fighting for you"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"遍体鳞伤
依然为你而战"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"With a flicker of hope on the darkest of days
Now it feels like the end is near"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"在最黑暗的日子里，仍怀揣着一丝希望
现在感觉结局已经临近"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"I thought I could take
More than I really can"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"我以为我可以承受
比实际的更多"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"Baby 'til you come back with something
I know I'll never let it go"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"宝贝，除非你带点什么回来
我知道我永远不会放手"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"I'm getting stronger but I still feel the pain"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"纵然身强体壮，心痛却无处隐藏"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.text:
"I keep thinking I see you
And there's nobody there"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InfestedLichEph.zhText:
"总幻想和你重逢
到头来只是一场空"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InkEphemeraADes.text: A fresh coating of ink marks the first step taken on the road to understanding the truth of the Shadowgrapher.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InkEphemeraADes.zhText: 新的墨水涂层标志着我们踏上了揭开绘影者真相的第一步。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InkEphemeraBDes.text: To see truth in the shapes created by this ephemera is a mark of increased understanding.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InkEphemeraBDes.zhText: 能从幻纹所构成的形态中洞察真相，正是理解力日益深厚的标志。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InkEphemeraCDes.text: Celebrate the completion of Follie's Shadowgraph during Operation: Atramentum with a festive collection of balloons.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/InkEphemeraCDes.zhText: 通过这套节日气球的幻纹，在《行动代号：墨痕》中庆祝 Follie 的绘影图的完成。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/LNY2023Ephemera.text: Flourish out of the muddiness of war.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/LNY2023Ephemera.zhText: 在战争的泥沼中繁茂生长。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/LNY2024Ephemera.text: A dragon’s spirit graces your path.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/LNY2024Ephemera.zhText: 祥龙之气为你的道路增光添彩。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/LNY2025Ephemera.text: Step lightly with stones that could mend the very fabric of the heavens.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/LNY2025Ephemera.zhText: 随着轻盈的脚步踏出能够修补天空的五色石。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/NightwaveDigita.text: Embrace the look of 1999's most cutting-edge video game technology with this wireframe-themed Ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/NightwaveDigita.zhText: 通过这款以数字线战甲为主题的幻纹，你将领略到 1999 年最前沿电子游戏技术的风采。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/NokkoEphemeraDe.text: Baby sprods just love to have fun! Three bounce around your feet with Nokko’s signature ephemera, a playful reminder of the future of the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/NokkoEphemeraDe.zhText: 菌宝就是喜欢玩耍！Nokko 的标志性幻纹会在你脚边蹦蹦跳跳，调皮地提醒你深矿的未来。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/OpulaEphemeraDe.text: Surround yourself with the dancing light of full spectrum flames.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/OpulaEphemeraDe.zhText: 让自己沉浸在全光谱火焰的舞动光芒之中。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/PeachBlossomEph.text: Surround your Warframe with softly falling peach blossoms, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/PeachBlossomEph.zhText: 用轻柔的桃花包围你的战甲，用以庆贺新春佳节。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/ProteaDeluxeEph.text: Distinguish yourself with the essence of nobility.

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Tennocon2026Eph.text: Emulating the colossus of Hull, this ephemera is a reminder of the Tenno's past conflicts.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Tennocon2026Eph.zhText: 效仿舰体的宏观之形，这个幻纹唤起了 Tenno 对昔日冲突的追忆。

/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Twitch2023Ephem.text: Evoke the awe and beauty of solar winds with this delicate ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Ephemera/Twitch2023Ephem.zhText: 通过这款精致的幻纹，唤起太阳风暴的浩瀚与美丽。

/Lotus/Language/Episodes/AntiSerumInject.text: Allows access to Infested Derelicts that have been rerouted to populated areas by Zealots.
/Lotus/Language/Episodes/AntiSerumInject.zhText: 进入感染者遗迹的权限，其已经被狂热者改道至人口稠密区域。

/Lotus/Language/Episodes/AntiSerumInject.text: Obtain by completing Outbreak Missions on this planet.
/Lotus/Language/Episodes/AntiSerumInject.zhText: 完成此星球上的爆发任务以获取。

/Lotus/Language/Episodes/BoosterWeeklyDe.zhText: [PH] Receive 15,000 Reputation when completing Weekly acts.

/Lotus/Language/Episodes/DerelictCodesBo.text:
Dreamer, you’ve been up to your neck in Infested, and, baby, with the way you’ve been hitting back, Nora thinks you’re itching to dive in even deeper.

We got more derelicts moving fast, you game?

Until next time,
Nora
/Lotus/Language/Episodes/DerelictCodesBo.zhText:
梦回者，你已经因为感染者的事忙得不可开交了， 还有， 宝贝，以你反击的方式，诺拉觉得你迫不及待想探究得更深。

我们还有更多的遗迹船在快速移动， 你要应战吗？

下次再会，
－诺拉

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Mi.text: Enemy forces have obtained detailed information on some of the Lotus' artifacts. Stop them before they get away!
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Mi.zhText: 敌军已经取得了一些 Lotus 神器的详细信息。在他们逃离之前阻止他们！

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Mi.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

The Grineer think their might entitles them to take anything they want, but not today, not while you continue to stand against them.

Take this Dex Raksaka Armor, and wear it as a symbol of your resolve.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Mi.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Grineer 以为他们的力量能让一切都垂手可得，但是他们不会如愿的，尤其是在你对抗他们的时候。

收下这个 Dex 守护者护甲，并穿上它来以表你的决心。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Mi.text: Gift of the Lotus - Dex Raksaka Armor
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Mi.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 - Dex 守护者护甲

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Ms.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

It has been eight cycles since the Lotus called the first of you to wake. To mark the occasion Ordis commissioned gifts for you. Items the Lotus would want you to have. Each gift exudes nostalgia for battles past and for those we have lost along the way.

Ordis only has one slight problem… the gifts have been stolen!

You can recover your gifts? Can you not? Operator?

Perhaps this Rhino Dex Skin will strike fear into the hearts of our enemies.

Your terribly embarrased Cephalon,
Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Ms.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

自从 Lotus 召唤你们中的第一个人醒来，已经过去了八个周期。为了纪念这个日子，Ordis 为您准备了礼物。这是 Lotus 希望你们拥有的物品。每件礼物都包含着对过往战斗，以及对一路上失去之人的怀念之情。

只是 Ordis 现在有一个小小的问题……那些礼物已经被偷走了！

您能找回您的礼物，对吧？难道您做不到吗？指挥官？

也许这件 Rhino Dex 外观能让我们的敌人从内心深处感受到恐惧。

您已陷入重度尴尬境地的中枢，
Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Ms.text: Gifts of the Lotus - Your 8th Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2021Ms.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 - 你的八周年纪念

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2022Ms.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|

My child, nine cycles ago I called for the first of you to wake and restore balance in The Origin System. 

You have been through so much since then. You forged friendships and alliances. Watched evil rise and fall, and rise again. 

There have been dark times where my voice could not reach you, and yet you fought on, undeterred by fear. Unrelenting in your quest to bring order and peace to the Origin System.

Take this Wisp Dex Skin as my gift to you. Use it as we move into the future together.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2022Ms.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|

我的孩子，九年以前我第一次唤醒了你，来恢复始源星系的平衡。 

自那以后你经历了很多，你拥有了友谊与盟友，见证了罪恶的崛起与衰亡，以及卷土重来。 

我们曾经历过一些至暗时刻，我的声音无法传递到你身边。但你没有被恐惧所击溃，仍就奋勇战斗。坚持不懈地为始源星系带来秩序与和平。

收下这个 Wisp Dex 外观吧，就当是我送给你的礼物。让我们携手共进。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2022Ms.text: Gifts of the Lotus - Your 9th Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2022Ms.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 - 你的十周年纪念

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2023Ms.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|

My child, ten cycles have passed since I awoke the first of you to become the Origin System's guardians.

You have been valiant both in the outer battle and in the inner, standing fast against tyranny and greed, while uncovering the mystery of your true nature.

I shall be by your side as you prepare to confront a new danger. A shadow from the past, entangled with the roots of your Tenno power.

Take this Dex Suit as an adornment for your true selves. For like me, you are more than one.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2023Ms.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|

我的孩子，从我第一次唤醒你们成为始源星系的守护者以来，已经过去了十年。

无论是在外部作战还是在内心的斗争中，你都英勇无畏，坚决反对暴政和贪婪，同时揭露了你真实本性的奥秘。

当你准备面对新的危险时，我会在你身边。这是一场来自过去的阴霾，与你的 Tenno 力量的根源深深交织在一起。

把这件 Dex 套服作为你展现真实自我的装饰吧。因为和我一样，你不是孤身一人。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2023Ms.text: Gifts of the Lotus - Your 10th Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2023Ms.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 - 你的十周年纪念

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2024Ms.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|

This message marks the 11th Earth cycle that has passed since I called the first of you to wake.

To honor this milestone, allow me to bestow this Dex Nikana upon you.

Tenno, for all these years your fight has been relentless. Yet, our enemies are unceasing in their brutality. Their strength only grows.

Your strength must also grow.

Throughout the coming days and weeks, I will alert you to items that have been taken by our foes. They are yours, by right. Recover them and become even stronger.

These too, are my gifts to you.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2024Ms.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|

这条信息标志着自我唤醒你们中的第一个以来，已经过去了 11 个地球周期。

为了纪念这个里程碑，让我将这把 Dex 侍刃赠予你。

Tenno，这些年来你的斗争从未停歇。尽管如此，我们的敌人在他们的残暴中从未停息。他们的力量在不断增长。

你的力量也必须同样增长。

在接下来的几天和几周里，我会提醒你哪些物品被我们的敌人夺走了。它们理应属于你。找回它们，使自己变得更强大。

这些也是我送给你的礼物。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2024Ms.text: Gifts of the Lotus - Your 11th Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2024Ms.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 - 你的十一周年纪念

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2025Ms.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|

The Earth has circled Sol twelve times since I first called you to wake, and The Origin System needs you now more than ever.

In commemoration, I give you this Dex Laurus Ephemera. Wear it with pride.

To ready you for what lies ahead, I am scanning the system for Tenno gear stolen by our enemies. Respond to Alerts to recover these items.

Look out for each other, Tenno.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2025Ms.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|

从我第一次召唤你醒来到现在，地球已经围绕太阳转了十二圈了，而现在始源星系比从前任何时候都更需要你。

出于纪念，我将这个 Dex 月桂幻纹送给你。请骄傲地戴上它。

为了让你准备好面对接下来的挑战，我正在扫描整个星系，检测出被敌人盗取的 Tenno 的装备。参与警报任务，找回这些物品。

愿与 Tenno 共勉。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2025Ms.text: Gifts of the Lotus - Your 12th Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2025Ms.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 - 你的十二周年纪念

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2026Ms.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|

It has been thirteen cycles since I called upon the first Tenno to wake. When I think on all we have achieved together in that time, I consider this an auspicious number.
But there is yet more to be done.

To mark this anniversary, I will alert you to items scattered throughout the system. Add them to your arsenal, and keep up the fight.

We must honor the past, even as we work to safeguard the future.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2026Ms.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|

自从我唤醒第一位 Tenno 以来，已经过去了十三年。回想我们共同取得的成就，我认为这是一个吉祥的数字。
但还有更多的事情要做。

为了纪念这个周年，我会提醒你注意散落在星系各处的物品。将它们添加到你的军械库中，继续战斗。

我们必须铭记过去，同时也要努力守护未来。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2026Ms.text: Gifts of the Lotus - Your 13th Anniversary
/Lotus/Language/Events/Anniversary2026Ms.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 - 你的十三周年纪念

/Lotus/Language/Events/GalleonRobberyEve.text:
Vay Hek needs the instigators of a Ghoul rebellion captured before they cause havoc. 

Loadout Override: VOLATILE OGRIS
/Lotus/Language/Events/GalleonRobberyEve.zhText:
韦·海克需要在尸鬼叛乱的煽动者酿成大祸之前将其抓获。 

配置覆写：易爆食人女魔

/Lotus/Language/Events/GalleonRobberyInt.text:
Tenno, you wretched maggots. My Ghouls have betrayed me. Stolen galleons and weapon parts. They aim to attack me AND YOU. So… We both have a problem.

My solution: you. You capture the instigators. Use my favorite instrument of explosive violence: the Ogris. In return, you keep what they stole, and we both crush an enemy. 

Take it or leave it.
/Lotus/Language/Events/GalleonRobberyInt.zhText:
Tenno，你这可恶的蛆虫。我的尸鬼背叛了我。偷走了帆船战舰和武器部件。他们的目标是攻击我和你。所以……我们俩都有麻烦了。

我的解决办法：就是你。你去捕获煽动者。用我最喜欢的暴力武器：食人女魔。作为回报，你留着他们偷走的东西，然后我们就都能消灭共同的敌人了。

要不要随你便。

/Lotus/Language/Events/HalloweenNaberusD.zhText: 拜访"女儿"来获取纳贝流士特别款待！

/Lotus/Language/Events/LavosRecipeHelpTe.text: Lavos' main and component blueprints can be purchased from Father in the Necralisk (Deimos). Players can access this hub after completing The Heart of Deimos quest.

/Lotus/Language/Events/MechEventTrophyDe.text: Members of this clan fought bravely and with honor during Operation Orphix Venom.
/Lotus/Language/Events/MechEventTrophyDe.zhText: 该氏族的成员在《行动代号：奥影之毒》中勇敢并光荣地战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Events/MechSurvivalEvent.text: Harvested from the debris left by fallen Orphix Sentients, Phasic Cells seem to be key to pulse function. These components can be traded with Father in the Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Events/MechSurvivalEvent.zhText: 从战败的 Sentient 奥影母艇残骸中收集而来，相位电池似乎是脉冲功能的关键。在殁世幽都中，可以与"父亲"交易这些组件。

/Lotus/Language/Events/MissionPrereq.text: Speak with Little Duck for a briefing about the Operation.
/Lotus/Language/Events/MissionPrereq.zhText: 与小鸭子对话来获得此次行动的作战简报。

/Lotus/Language/Events/OperationsCredits.text: Battle pay for Tenno fighting in Operation Scarlet Spear.
/Lotus/Language/Events/OperationsCredits.zhText: 为在《行动代号：猩红之矛》中作战的 Tenno 准备的报酬。

/Lotus/Language/Events/PoolNoodleDesc.text: Boop enemies with this vicious tube of embarrassment that can be used with any hammer and celebrate Dog Days all year round. WARNING: Not a floatation device.
/Lotus/Language/Events/PoolNoodleDesc.zhText: 用这根令人死得不体面的泡沫条暴揍敌人，可与任意锤类武器搭配使用，让你全年畅享三伏天。警告：此物不是浮具。

/Lotus/Language/Events/PrimeVaultTraderD.text: Trade with Varzia Dax to get Vault Relics and Prime Gear.
/Lotus/Language/Events/PrimeVaultTraderD.zhText: 与禁卫瓦奇娅交易以获取宝库中的遗物和 Prime 装备。

/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearEventEnd.text:
That's the end of that. Not a Murex on scan. 'Ol Erra finally ran out of steam, 'least for the next little while.

Whatever comes next, we'll see the end of that too.
/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearEventEnd.zhText:
到此为止了。没有一艘骨螺战舰被侦测到。老 Erra 终于无力进攻了，至少是接下来的一小会儿。

无论接下来发生了什么，我们都将再次看到结局。

/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearEventOpe.text: The Flotilla's orbiting Earth, Hotshot. See ya there.
/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearEventOpe.zhText: 大佬，舰队正在绕地球航行。在那儿见。

/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearWaveEndB.text: Hotshot! You sent those Murex packing. Ol' Erra ain't gonna be none too pleased. He'll mount another offensive, but 'til that happens, here's a token of my esteem.
/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearWaveEndB.zhText: 大佬！你让那些骨螺战舰卷铺盖回家了。老 Erra 当然不会太高兴了。他将发起另一场进攻，但等到那时候再说吧，收下这个，作为我对你的崇高敬意。

/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearWaveEndB.text: Unfortunately we did not repel the Wave in time. Still, you deserve this for your valiant attempt...
/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearWaveEndB.zhText: 很遗憾，我们没有及时击退这次进攻波次。尽管如此，这是由于你的英勇尝试而应得的奖励……

/Lotus/Language/Events/ScarSpearWaveEndT.text: SCARLET SPEAR: Battle won - for now

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.text: OpLink Reinforcements can be purchased to heal active OpLinks in the Flotilla.
/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.zhText: 可购买联动作战信标强化装置来修复舰队中启用中的联动作战信标。

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.text: Longer Missions give more Scarlet Credits for each Condrix or Murex defeated.
/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.zhText: 任务进行时间越长，则每次击败谍影登陆舰或骨螺战舰时可获得更多猩红代币。

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.text: Defeat all Murex in your Flotilla Wave for bonus Scarlet Credits!
/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.zhText: 在舰队波次中击败所有骨螺战舰来获得额外奖励的猩红代币！

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.text: Earn 3 ranks of Murex or Condrix Emblems by reaching accumulated points for your Flotilla.
/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.zhText: 在你的舰队达到相应的累积分数，来获取 3 个级别的骨螺战舰或谍影徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.text: Operation Emblems can be earned by collecting 10, 30, or 50 thousand cumulative points.
/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.zhText: 累积获得 1 万、3 万和 5 万分来获得相应的行动徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.text: The more OpLinks your Squad deploys, the faster your Kill Code progress will be!
/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTip.zhText: 你的小队部署的联动作战信标越多，你的销毁代码传输进度就越快！

/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTut.text:
1. Welcome to Operation Scarlet Spear. Your Operation begins with you running missions for your Flotilla.
2. Fight in Space (Murex Raid) or on Ground (Ground Assault). Check the Flotilla to see where firepower is needed!
3. Ground Assaults are needed to send Kill Codes. Murex Raids are needed to Receive Kill Codes and drive Murex away.
4. Ground Assaults require you to fight Condrix and Sentients off in waves and use your OpLink to scan the wounded Condrix.
5. Murex Raids require you to receive enough Kill Codes via Oplink to drive away the Murex.
6. Every Kill Code sent (Earth) and received (Space) gives you Scarlet Credits. The longer you stay in one mission, the more Scarlet Credits you earn per Kill Code.
7. Your OpLink health is not restored between stages. Once destroyed, it cannot be deployed again in that mission.
8. The Flotilla shows how many Murex have been driven away, up to a max of 100 per Wave. After this, you receive bonus Scarlet Credits based on your score for that finished Flotilla.
9. Every Murex Wave gives you an opportunity to rally and earn points, and Scarlet Credits - whether playing alone or in a Squad, work together!
/Lotus/Language/Events/SquadLinkEventTut.zhText:
1. 欢迎参加《行动代号：猩红之矛》。在本次行动开始后，你需要为自己的「舰队」完成各种任务。
2. 在太空（骨螺战舰突袭）亦或是地面（地面强袭）与敌人战斗。检查「舰队」状态，寻找需要火力支援的战场！
3. 通过「地面强袭」任务来发送「销毁代码」。而「骨螺战舰突袭」任务则需要接收「销毁代码」来驱离「骨螺战舰」。
4.「地面强袭」任务需要你击败多个波次的「谍影登陆舰」和 Sentient 敌人，然后使用你的「联动作战信标」来扫描受损的「谍影登陆舰」。
5.「骨螺战舰突袭」任务需要你通过「联动作战信标」接收足够多的「销毁代码」来驱离「骨螺战舰」。
6. 每个被发送（地面）和接收（太空）的「销毁代码」都会让你获得「猩红代币」。在同一任务中坚持得越久，每个「销毁代码」所奖励的「猩红代币」就会越多。
7.「联动作战信标」的生命值不会在单一任务的各个阶段期间恢复。一旦遭到摧毁，它将无法在当前任务中再次被部署。
8.「舰队」大厅中会显示被驱离的「骨螺战舰」数量，每个攻击波次最多有 100 艘。当整个「舰队」的作战结束后，根据你的分数，你会得到额外的「猩红代币」奖励。
9. 每个「骨螺战舰」攻击波次都是你召集伙伴赚取点数以及「猩红代币」的机会（无论是单人还是小队），共同协作吧！

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothBootADesc.text: Synthetic fibers and a molded foam insole were the basis for what was once a robust and comfortable combat boot. Now, it's a home for tiny aquatic organisms.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothBootADesc.zhText: 合成纤维与注塑泡沫制成了的鞋垫，曾经它是一只强韧、舒适的战斗靴。如今，它是小型水生生物体的家。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothBootBDesc.text: While the Vallis coolant has kept this finely engineered Corpus tactical boot remarkably well preserved, it is, nonetheless, entirely worthless.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothBootBDesc.zhText: 虽然山谷冷却液将这精心设计的 Corpus 战靴保持得完好无缺，但它，仍没有一丝价值。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishADesc.text: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishADesc.zhText: 从它侧腹的发光腺体中释放出电流将它的猎物击晕。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishAPart.text:
Harvested by the Ostron as a catalyst used in their synthetics.

Source: Cut from Charc Eels via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Charc Eels in the Plains of Eidolon lake at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishAPart.zhText:
被 Ostron 收割来作为合成反应的催化剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从查克鳗中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野湖泊中捕捉查克鳗。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishBDesc.text: A predatory fish that is attracted to the scent of blood.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishBDesc.zhText: 一种被血的气味吸引的捕食鱼类。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishBPart.text:
Used in Ostron remedies to purify toxins.

Source: Cut from Goopolla fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Goopolla in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothCommonFishBPart.zhText:
在 Ostron 中的偏方被用来净化毒素。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从古泊拉鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中捕捉古泊拉。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothRareFishADesc.text: A cunning hunter that hides within the mud at the bottom of the ocean and ambushes passing prey.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothRareFishADesc.zhText: 一个狡猾的猎手，躲藏在湖底的泥中，伏击路过的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothRareFishAPartIt.text:
An ingredient used in Ostron cooking and medicine.

Source: Cut from Murkray fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Murkray in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots at any time of day using Murkray Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothRareFishAPartIt.zhText:
Ostron 用来烹饪和制药的材料。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从阴暗鳐鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋鱼点中使用阴暗鳐鱼饵捕捉阴暗鳐。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothRareFishBaitADe.text:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Murkrays, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during both day and night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothRareFishBaitADe.zhText:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引阴暗鳐的材料所组成。这种鱼无论日夜皆只能在海洋鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishADe.text: While rarely venturing from the deepest waters of the plains, the Sharrac is a fearsome predator who will prey on unwary Ostrons swimming alone.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishADe.zhText: 尽管很少从深水中冒险游出，鲨客是可怕的捕食者，会捕食单独游泳的粗心 Ostron 人。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishAPa.text:
These will often adorn ceremonial garb or as a reagent for synthetics.

Source: Cut from Sharrac fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Sharrac in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishAPa.zhText:
这些常常用来装点仪式装束，或者被用来做合成的反应物。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从鲨客鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中使用黄昏鱼饵捕捉鲨客。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishBDe.text: A crustacean that hunts during the twilight hours.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishBDe.zhText: 一种甲壳纲动物，在黄昏时分捕猎。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishBPa.text:
Ground into a powder this substance can makes fires burn hotter for a brief amount of time.

Source: Cut from Karkina fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Karkina in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishBPa.zhText:
将这种物质磨成粉末可以短暂使得火烧得更旺。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从卡其那鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野海洋中使用黄昏鱼饵捕捉卡其那。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishBai.text:
This bait attracts predatory fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during either day or night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Sharrac and Karkina in the ocean.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/BothUncommonFishBai.zhText:
这种鱼饵可以吸引白天或晚上活跃的捕食者鱼类。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。吸引海洋中的鲨客和卡其那。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishAnoscopic.zhText: 回声环绕者微孔视觉感应器

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishAnoscopic.text:
A small camera that records visual data with extremely high definition.

Source: Dismantled from Echowinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Echowinder in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishAnoscopic.zhText:
能以极高清晰度纪录影像数据的小型摄影机。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从回声环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉回声环绕者。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishExaBrainI.text:
A small, electronic brain capable of processing a billion giga-threads per second.

Source: Dismantled from Scrubber servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Scrubber in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishExaBrainI.zhText:
每秒能处理十亿吉字节线程的小型电子脑。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从洗涤者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉洗涤者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishMuonBatte.text:
A small, atomic power source.

Source: Dismantled from Brickie servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Brickie in Orb Vallis ponds and rivers during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishMuonBatte.zhText:
一个小型、原子能的能源。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从砖瓦匠伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘和河流中捕捉砖瓦匠。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishParralelB.zhText: 污泥绕环者并联生物二极体

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishParralelB.text:
Controls the electrical flow throughout the circuitry within robotic organisms.

Source: Dismantled from Mirewinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Mirewinder in Orb Vallis caves during any weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishParralelB.zhText:
控制生化机器人体内电路系统的电流。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从污泥环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴中捕捉污泥环绕者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishRotoblade.text:
A machine element used to propel robotic organisms through coolant.

Source: Dismantled from Eye-Eye servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Eye-Eye in Orb Vallis ponds during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishRotoblade.zhText:
一种可以让生化机器人在冷却液中推进的机器组件。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从目－目伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉目－目。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishThermalLa.text:
A weapon that discharges lasers over short distances.

Source: Dismantled from Kriller servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Kriller in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishThermalLa.zhText:
一把能发射短距离激光的武器。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从磷虾杀手伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉磷虾杀手。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishVenedoCas.text:
A strong, metallic case that is resistant to fluctuations in environmental temperature.

Source: Dismantled from Sapcaddy servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Sapcaddy in the Orb Vallis lake during Cold weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/CorpusFishVenedoCas.zhText:
一个坚固、金属制的箱子，能抵抗环境温度的波动。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从液集者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷湖泊中捕捉液集者。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishADesc.text: Its gaping maw allows it to scoop up smaller fish as it swims by them.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishADesc.zhText: 它张大的嘴使得它游过其他小鱼时可以一口将之吞下。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishAPartI.text:
The bones of the Mawfish are carved by the Ostron to produce ornaments and tools.

Source: Cut from Mawfish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Mawfish in the Plains of Eidolon lake during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishAPartI.zhText:
喉鱼的骨骼被 Ostron 人用来制作吊饰和工具。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从喉鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野湖泊中捕捉喉鱼。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishBDesc.text: A poisonous fish protected by a hardened carapace around its skull.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishBDesc.zhText: 一种有毒的鱼，被其头骨外的坚硬外壳保护。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishBPartI.text:
The poison is used to cure leather and as a reagent to produce an embalming fluid.

Source: Cut from Khut-Khut fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Khut-Khut in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishBPartI.zhText:
毒素被 Ostron 人用来加工皮革，以及作为制造一种防腐液的反应剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从库特-库特鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉库特-库特。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishCDesc.text: This slow fish meanders through the waters and is often preyed upon by larger predators.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishCDesc.zhText: 这种缓慢地鱼在水体间游荡，时常被更大的捕食者捕食。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishCPartI.text:
Once cleaned and tanned this organ can be turned into a durable leather.

Source: Cut from Yogwun fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Yogwun in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayCommonFishCPartI.zhText:
一旦经过清洗和鞣制后，这种器官可以变成耐用的皮革。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从约格温鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉约格温。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishADes.text: Strong, predatory fish with eyes that can pierce the darkest shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishADes.zhText: 强壮的捕食者，视力优异，足以看透最暗的阴影。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishAPar.text:
The Ostron boil these into a jelly which forms a strong adhesive when it dries.

Source: Cut from Tralok fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Tralok in the Plains of Eidolon ocean during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishAPar.zhText:
Ostron 人将其煮成胶状，干燥后便成为一种强力的粘合剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从塔洛鱼中切割获取。在白天的夜灵平野海洋中捕捉塔洛。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishBDes.text: Displays blood-spattered pattern on its scales and has its ribs exposed through open cavities along both flanks. When predators approach it lies still at the bottom of the sand banks, disguised as a carcass in hopes of being ignored.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishBDes.zhText: 它的鱼鳞上有着血溅的纹样，其肋骨通过空腔暴露在两侧。当捕食者接近时，它一动不动地躺在沙岸底部，伪装成尸体，寄希望于被忽视。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishBPar.text:
The horn of the Mortus Lungfish is ground down into a powder and used by the Ostrons in herbal remedies.

Source: Cut from Mortus Lungfish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Mortus Lungfish in Plains of Eidolon ponds at any time of day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DayUncommonFishBPar.zhText:
Ostron 的人们将摩图斯肺鱼的角碾碎成粉末状后用于草药之中。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从摩图斯肺鱼中切割获取。在任何时候的夜灵平野池塘中捕捉摩图斯肺鱼。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosGenericFishBa.text: [PH] Used to attract Cryptosuctus, Barbisteo, Kymaeros and Amniophysi
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosGenericFishBa.zhText: [PH] Used to attract Cryptosuctus, Barbisteo, Kymaeros and Amniophysi

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosInfestedFishB.text:
A chunk of the wyrm Fass, collected after his explosive death in the Cambion Drift. Used to attract Glutinox on the surface during Vome, Ostimyr at surface hotspots during Fass, and Vitreospina in caves during Fass/Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Vome is active
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosInfestedFishB.zhText:
属于蛟龙"混乱"的一大块东西，是在他爆炸死亡后收集的。可以用来吸引"秩序"期间地面中的狍鸮胶蛳、"混乱"期间地面鱼点中的奥斯蒂剑鱼，以及"秩序"/"混乱"期间洞穴中的璃化脊鳎。

获取地点："秩序"活跃时的火卫二魔胎之境

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosInfestedFishB.text:
Matter from the body of the Wyrm Fass, purged of toxins, and rendered usefully. Used to attract Aquapulmo and Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots, Aquapulmo only during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosInfestedFishB.zhText:
来自于蛟龙"混乱"身上的物质，清除了毒素后变得有用了。可以用来吸引魔胎之境地面鱼点中的水肺和须腔棘鱼、"秩序"期间的水肺。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosOrokinFishBai.text:
A gobbet of raw flesh, fallen from the wyrm Vome in her death spasm. Used to attract Chondricord and Duriod in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Fass is active
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosOrokinFishBai.zhText:
在蛟龙"秩序"的死亡痉挛时，从她身上掉下来的一块生肉。可以用来吸引"秩序"/"混乱"期间魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中的骨锥琼鲷和韧铠灵鲷。

获取地点："混乱"活跃时的火卫二魔胎之境

/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosOrokinFishBai.text:
The flesh of Vome, refined, and ready for use. Used to attract Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/DiemosOrokinFishBai.zhText:
"秩序"的肉，经过提炼且随时可用。可以用来吸引"秩序"期间魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中的独角米索鳎。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/EidolonFishMeatItem.text:
Used as a source of food and to create bait for predatory fish.

Source: Cut from all Plains of Eidolon Fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/EidolonFishMeatItem.zhText:
被用作食物来源，并制作捕食者鱼类的诱饵。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从各种夜灵平野鱼类中切割获取。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/EidolonFishOilItemD.text:
Used to create absolvents that purify gems.

Source: Cut from all Plains of Eidolon Fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/EidolonFishOilItemD.zhText:
被用来制造净化宝石的溶剂。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从各种夜灵平野鱼类中切割获取。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/EidolonFishScalesIt.text:
A material used in tailoring clothes and cultivating synthetics.

Source: Cut from all Plains of Eidolon Fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/EidolonFishScalesIt.zhText:
这种材料被用来裁制衣物和培育合成物。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从各种夜灵平野鱼类中切割获取。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishBaitDesc.text:
This bait attracts fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during the day.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Mawfish and Charc Eels in the lake; Khut-Khut, Yogwun, and Mortus Lungfish in ponds; and Goopolla and Tralok in the ocean.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishBaitDesc.zhText:
这种诱饵可以吸引白天在夜灵平野活动的鱼类。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。吸引湖中的喉鱼和查克鳗；池塘中的库特-库特、约格温和摩图斯肺鱼；以及海洋中的古泊拉和塔洛。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishMemFoilI.text: An electro-fibre that forms the nervous system of these robotic entities. They are used to persist and transmit data between mechanical elements.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishMemFoilI.zhText: 一种电镀纤维，组成了这些机械个体的神经系统。它们被用来在机械装置间保存并传输数据。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishNanobloo.text: A liquid filled with self-replicating nanites that service and maintain robotic organisms.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishNanobloo.zhText: 充满了自我复制的纳米机器人的液体，用于维持机械有机体的运转。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishScrapIte.text:
A sample of sprockets, gyros and wires.

Source: Dismantled from all Orb Vallis servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/GenericFishScrapIte.zhText:
链轮、陀螺仪与电线的样品。 

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从伺服鱼中拆解获取。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/HolidayBootDesc.text: You're catching a lot of these. Are you stocking up?
/Lotus/Language/Fish/HolidayBootDesc.zhText: 你捕获了很多这玩意。你是在囤货吗？

/Lotus/Language/Fish/InfSpearFishingSpea.text:
Plumb the depths with this crafty fishing spear that's barely detectable to Infested and hybrid/Orokin fish. Due to its Infested aspect, it's one of the only known things that can pass through exocrine. 

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/InfSpearFishingSpea.zhText:
用这把狡黠的鱼叉来探索深渊，感染者和感染者/奥罗金混种鱼类几乎无法察觉它。由于它的感染属性，它是已知的少数几种可以穿过外分泌液的鱼叉。 

从殁世幽都的"女儿"处获得。这根鱼叉对魔胎之境的鱼类最有效。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/InfSpearFishingSpea.text:
Plumb the depths with this crafty fishing spear that's barely detectable to Infested and hybrid/Orokin fish. Due to its Infested aspect, it's one of the only known things that can pass through exocrine. 

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/InfSpearFishingSpea.zhText:
用这把狡黠的鱼叉来探索深渊，感染者和感染者/奥罗金混种鱼类几乎无法察觉它。由于它的感染属性，它是已知的少数几种可以穿过外分泌液的鱼叉。 

从殁世幽都的"女儿"处获得。这根鱼叉对魔胎之境的鱼类最有效。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightLegendaryFishA.text: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightLegendaryFishA.zhText: 盖拉佩德是一种以死鱼残骸为生的食腐动物。它与瑟拉姆甲虫形成了一种共生关系，甲虫将盖拉佩德摄入的毒素析出并以之为食。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightLegendaryFishA.text:
This thick shell is used by Ostrons to manufacture tools and weapons.

Source: Cut from Glappid fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Glappid in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at Night using Glappid Bait. Also drops from Thumper Bulls in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightLegendaryFishA.zhText:
这种厚壳被 Ostron 人用来制作工具和武器。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从盖拉佩德鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野海洋中使用盖拉佩德鱼饵捕捉盖拉佩德。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightLegendaryFishB.text:
This bait is composed of exotic materials that are known to attract the elusive Glappid, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon ocean hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightLegendaryFishB.zhText:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引神出鬼没的盖拉佩德的奇特材料所组成，这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野的海洋鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishADesc.text: This fish inhabits the shallows and feeds of crabs and other small crustaceans. When threatened it forces air into its brain to give it the impression of being much bigger than it normally is.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishADesc.zhText: 这种鱼栖息在浅水，以螃蟹及其他小型甲壳类为食。当受到威胁时，它会将空气挤入脑部，令其看起来比正常要大得多。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishAPartI.text:
An Ostron delicacy.

Source: Cut from Norg fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Norg in the Plains of Eidolon lake at Night using Norg Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishAPartI.zhText:
一种 Ostron 珍馐。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从诺格鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野湖泊中使用诺格鱼饵捕捉诺格。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBDesc.text: A grotesque crustacean that produces a potent, paralyzing toxin from its tentacles.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBDesc.zhText: 一种怪异的甲壳动物，能从其触须中产生强力的瘫痪毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBPartI.text:
Ostrons extract the toxin and apply it to their weapons when hunting animals.

Source: Cut from Cuthol fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Cuthol in Plains of Eidolon pond hotspots at Night. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBPartI.zhText:
Ostron 人从中提取毒素，并将之用于狩猎。

获取途径：通过希图斯（地球）的渔人海露从克苏尔鱼中切割获取。在夜晚的夜灵平野池塘鱼点中捕捉克苏尔。此外它还会从夜灵平野重击者身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBaitAD.text:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Norg, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon lake hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBaitAD.zhText:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引诺格的材料所组成。这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野中的湖泊鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBaitBD.text:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Cuthols, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon pond hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
/Lotus/Language/Fish/NightRareFishBaitBD.zhText:
这种鱼饵是由已知能吸引克苏尔的材料所组成。这种鱼只能在夜间夜灵平野中的池塘鱼点中寻获。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/OrokinFishEcosynthA.text:
A processing unit that efficiently monitors environmental data.

Source: Dismantled from Synathid servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Synathid in Orb Vallis cave hotspots during any weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/OrokinFishEcosynthA.zhText:
一个有效地监控环境数据的处理组件。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从海龙伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴鱼点中捕捉海龙。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/OrokinFishEntroplas.text:
A solvent that reconstitutes waste product from the Weeping Towers into degenerated matter.

Source: Dismantled from Tromyzon servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Tromyzon in Orb Vallis Pond Hotspots during Cold weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/OrokinFishEntroplas.zhText:
一种将渗流之塔的废弃物重建为简并物质的溶剂。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从多目鳗伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉多目鳗。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/OrokinFishSaganModu.text:
A device used to reconstruct degenerated matter into Orokin bio-material.

Source: Dismantled from Charamote servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Charamote in Orb Vallis cave hotspots during any weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/OrokinFishSaganModu.zhText:
一个用于将简并物质重建为奥罗金生物材料的装置。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从重筑虾伺服鱼中拆解获取。在任何天气下的奥布山谷洞穴鱼点中捕捉重筑虾。此外它还会从奥布山谷剥削者圆蛛身上掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/OstronFishOneDesc.text: Prized by the Ostrons, the scales of this river dwelling fish are a key ingredient in Skin Stew.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/OstronFishOneDesc.zhText: 为 Ostron 人所珍视，这种河鱼的鱼鳞是肉皮炖的关键素材。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/SolarisFishDissipat.text:
Discharges excess heat and energy through the casing.

Source: Dismantled from Tink servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Tink in Orb Vallis ponds during Cold weather.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/SolarisFishDissipat.zhText:
经由外壳释放多余的热量和能量。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从修补机伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘中捕捉修补机。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/SolarisFishLatheCoo.zhText: 长型环绕者车床凝聚剂

/Lotus/Language/Fish/SolarisFishLatheCoo.text:
A liquid that mixes with coolant fluid to produce a resilient gel that repairs leaks.

Source: Dismantled from Longwinder servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Longwinder in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during Warm weather.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/SolarisFishLatheCoo.zhText:
混合了冷却液，产生出一种有弹性的凝胶，用于修复裂缝。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从长型环绕者伺服鱼中拆解获取。在温暖的奥布山谷湖泊鱼点中捕捉长型环绕者。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/SolarisFishNeuralRe.text:
Interprets signals from other mechanical organisms.

Source: Dismantled from Recaster servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Recaster in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during Cold weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Fish/SolarisFishNeuralRe.zhText:
用于理解来自另一个机械有机体的讯号。

获取途径：通过福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手从续播机伺服鱼中拆解获取。在寒冷的奥布山谷池塘鱼点中捕捉续播机。此外它还会从奥布山谷资源储藏箱中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Fish/SpearFishingSpearBD.text:
This fishing spear features a slender blade to puncture armored plates and carapaces. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Tralok
/Lotus/Language/Fish/SpearFishingSpearBD.zhText:
这把鱼叉有着细长的刃，可以穿透护甲板和外壳。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
塔洛

/Lotus/Language/Fish/SpearFishingSpearCD.text:
This fishing spear has multiple blades that allow it to pierce the hides of scaly fish. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Glappid
Khut-Khut
Mawfish
Mortus Lungfish
Norg
/Lotus/Language/Fish/SpearFishingSpearCD.zhText:
这把鱼叉有着多道刀刃，可以穿透有鳞鱼的外皮。

从希图斯（地球）的渔人海露处获得。这根鱼叉对以下夜灵平野的鱼类最有效：
盖拉佩德
库特-库特
喉鱼
摩图斯肺鱼
诺格

/Lotus/Language/Fish/SpearFishingSpearDe.text:
The barbed prongs on this fishing spear make it easier to catch fish with smooth skin. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Charc Eel
Cuthol
Goopolla
Murkray
Sharrac
Yogwun

/Lotus/Language/FiveFates/CalibanGiveawa.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

The Warframe Caliban was created for one purpose: to destroy you.

He is an aberrant amalgamation of Warframe and Sentient. I fear his true potential is far greater than we yet know.

How relieved I am that his creator no longer controls him.

Today, I give you the chance to bring balance to this beast. I place Caliban in your domain.

Master his abilities. Discover his potential. Restore his honor.

|LOTUS_NAME|

|PLAYER_NAME|，

战甲 Caliban 的诞生只有一个目的：毁灭你们。

他是战甲和 Sentient 的异常混合体。我担心他的真正潜力远超我们所知道的。

当得知他的创造者不再能控制他时，我如释重负。

今天，我将机会交给你，去平衡调整这个怪物。我把 Caliban 交到你的手中。

掌握他的能力。发掘他的潜力。恢复他的荣耀。

|LOTUS_NAME|
Caliban 的力量现在属于你
