/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseChaosR.zhText: 愈合浪潮能瞬间复活倒地的同伴，但有 |CHANCE|% 几率对其造成持续 |MULT| 秒的 <DT_VIRAL>病毒及<DT_MAGNETIC>磁力状态。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseCloakH.text: Void Mode starts healing at +|HEAL| Health per second, increasing by |ACCEL| per second up to a maximum of |MAX|.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseCloakH.zhText: 在虚空模式中，每秒恢复 +|HEAL| 生命值并每秒提升 |ACCEL| 恢复速率，最多可提升至每秒恢复 |MAX| 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseCloakH.text: When Void Regen reaches its maximum, it is applied to squad members within Affinity Range for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseCloakH.zhText: 当「虚空再生」达到最高恢复速率时，会作用于经验共享范围内的小队成员，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseCloakS.text: Void Mode creates a shield that grows up to |RADIUS|m over |DURATION|s. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseCloakS.zhText: 虚空模式将创造一个 |DURATION| 秒内可增长至 |RADIUS| 米的护罩。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseDashIm.text: Allies hit by Void Sling are granted immunity from damage for |INVULN|s and healed |PERCENT|% over |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseDashIm.zhText: 「虚空弹射」触及的友军获得 |INVULN| 秒无敌并于 |DURATION| 秒内恢复 |PERCENT|% 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseDashSh.text: Void Sling no longer displaces enemies, instead it emits a shockwave |RADIUS|m wide and travels |DISTANCE|m stunning any enemy it hits.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseDashSh.zhText: 「虚空弹射」不再撞开敌人，而将释放一道 |RADIUS| 米宽的震荡波，震荡波将移动 |DISTANCE| 米并震晕被击中的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseHealth.text: Increases Operator Health and Armor by |PERCENT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseHealth.zhText: 指挥官的生命和护甲增加 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseHealth.text: Operator Health Regeneration is increased by |INCREASE|/s, and is doubled while controlling the Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseHealth.zhText: 指挥官每秒生命恢复速度增加 |INCREASE|，控制战甲时恢复速度翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseInstan.text: The first |COUNT| revives are instantaneous. Additional revives are |PERCENT|% faster.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseInstan.zhText: 前 |COUNT| 次复活可瞬间完成。后续的复活速度提高 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseResidu.text: Mending Tides grants the ability to revive fallen allies instantly, up to |COUNT| times for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseResidu.zhText: 愈合浪潮能在任务期间内，瞬间复活倒地的同伴 |COUNT| 次。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseResidu.text: Mending Tides mirrors |PCT|% of damage taken back to attackers for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseResidu.zhText: 愈合浪潮能在任务中，将攻击者造成的 |PCT|% 伤害反弹回去。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseResidu.text: Mending Tides increases Affinity Range from kills that are shared among allies by |RADIUS|m for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseResidu.zhText: 愈合浪潮能在任务期间，将击杀的经验分享范围延长 |RADIUS| 米。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusFreeAbilityCa.text: Allows Abilities to be cast without using Energy or Shields but requires |COOLDOWN|s to recharge.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusFreeAbilityCa.zhText: 每 |COOLDOWN| 秒可以不消耗能量或护盾施放技能一次。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusLensePopUpTex.text: Equip focus lenses to charge Tauron Strike significantly faster
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusLensePopUpTex.zhText: 装备专精晶体，可显著加快 Tauron 打击的充能速度

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerAbilityC.text: Reduces the cooldown on Void Pulse.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerAbilityC.zhText: 减少虚能脉冲的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveBu.text: Void Pulse inflicts the target with an aura for |DURATION|s causing passing bullets to seek them out and deal |MULT|x Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveBu.zhText: 虚能脉冲让目标产生吸引子弹的力场，持续 |DURATION| 秒并可造成 |MULT| 倍伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveEn.text: Void Pulse will leave a field that replenishes |AMOUNT| Energy/s to allies standing within it for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveEn.zhText: 虚能脉冲会留下持续 |DURATION| 秒的力场，为待在范围内的同伴每秒恢复 |AMOUNT| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveLa.text: Void Pulse creates a |RADIUS|m aura around the player for |DURATION|s that lashes out at enemies with harmful Void energy, dealing |DAMAGE| Damage/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveLa.zhText: 虚能脉冲在玩家周围产生持续 |DURATION| 秒、范围 |RADIUS| 米的虚空能量光环来攻击敌人，造成每秒 |DAMAGE| 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveXR.text: Void Pulse allows the player to see enemies through walls and displays them on the Minimap for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerActiveXR.zhText: 虚能脉冲能让玩家透过墙壁看见敌人，并将敌人标记在同伴的小地图上，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerBaseDesc.text: Release |COUNT| pulses of Void energy over |DURATION|s that suspend and incapacitate enemies within a |RADIUS|m, |FOV| degree cone for |STASIS|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerBaseDesc.zhText: 持续 |DURATION| 秒并释放|COUNT| 次强大的虚空能量脉冲来瘫痪敌人 |STASIS| 秒，有效距离 |RADIUS| 米，扇形范围 |FOV| 度。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerBlastBur.text: Void Blast creates a surge of electricity, zapping enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DAMAGE|% Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerBlastBur.zhText: 虚空爆裂产生一次电流激增，电击 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人，造成 |DAMAGE|% 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerBlastSlo.text: Second Ability emits a radial burst slowing any enemy it touches by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerBlastSlo.zhText: 第二技能发射一道范围爆破，任何被触及到的敌人会被减速 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerChaosAll.text: Void Pulse has a |CHANCE|% chance to increase Speed by |SPEED_PCT|% for |DURATION|s but reduce Shields by |SHIELD_PCT|% for nearby allies.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerChaosAll.zhText: 虚能脉冲有 |CHANCE|% 几率增加附近同伴 |SPEED_PCT|% 移动速度，持续 |DURATION| 秒；但减少他们 |SHIELD_PCT|% 的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerChaosSel.text: Void Pulse has a |CHANCE|% chance to increase Speed by |SPEED_PCT|% for |DURATION|s but reduce Shields by |SHIELD_PCT|% for the player.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerChaosSel.zhText: 虚能脉冲有 |CHANCE|% 几率增加自己 |SPEED_PCT|% 移动速度，持续 |DURATION| 秒；但减少 |SHIELD_PCT|% 的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerCloakPul.text: Void Mode pulls enemies within |RADIUS|m towards the Operator, and costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerCloakPul.zhText: 虚空模式将 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人拉向指挥官，此技能现每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerCloakSta.text: Void Mode emits a pulse that deals |DAMAGE| Damage/s over |RADIUS|m, and costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerCloakSta.zhText: 虚空模式放射出一道脉冲，造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害，半径 |RADIUS| 米，并每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerDashBubb.text: First Ability creates a well of energy for |DURATION|s. Allies passing through the well gain |REGEN| Energy/s for |BUFFTIME|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerDashBubb.zhText: 第一技能制造一个持续 |DURATION| 秒的能量区域。通过其中的友军获得每秒 |REGEN| 能量恢复，持续 |BUFFTIME| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerDashElec.text: Manifests ball lightning after a Void Sling that travels slowly and zaps enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DAMAGE| Damage. Costs |ENERGY| Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerDashElec.zhText: 「虚空弹射」结束后产生一个球形闪电，缓慢地移动并电击 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人，造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerEnergyOv.text: Energy pickups grant |PERCENT|% additional Energy over |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerEnergyOv.zhText: 能量拾取物在 |DURATION| 秒内给予 |PERCENT|% 额外能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerPowerFie.text: Use your first Ability inside a Wellspring to increase its size, boost its duration by |DURATION|s, and grant |POWER|% Ability Strength to those inside.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerPowerFie.zhText: 在一个「能量源泉」的范围内使用你的第一技能来增加它的尺寸，延长其持续时间 |DURATION| 秒，并且使能量源泉内的友军获得 |POWER|% 技能强度。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerResidual.text: Void Pulse increases Warframe Ability Efficiency by |PCT|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerResidual.zhText: 虚能脉冲会在任务中增加战甲的技能效率 |PCT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerResidual.text: Void Pulse replenishes |RESTORE| Energy/s for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerResidual.zhText: 虚能脉冲会在任务期间内每秒为你补充 |RESTORE| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerResidual.text: Void Pulse causes Energy Orbs to restore Energy to allies within |RADIUS|m for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerResidual.zhText: 虚能脉冲会在任务中使能量球能恢复 |RADIUS| 米内同伴的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerSlowHead.text: Precision head shot damage increased by |PERCENT|% on enemies afflicted with Temporal Drag.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerSlowHead.zhText: 对受到「时缓牵制」影响的敌人造成的精准爆头射击伤害提升 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefundInboxBo.text:
Operator,

Ordis commends your studiousness. The symbiosis between you and your Warframe is – deadly – admirable! Changes have been made to diagnostics data to reflect that synergy.

Please reassess your Focus Schools, to ensure that future battle calculations remain accurate.

|XP_HEADER||WAYBOUND_HEADER||CAPACITY_HEADER|

It seems there are Focus Lenses here as well! My sensors are abuzz. Ordis gets such a charge from the Operator's success.

Your loyal Cephalon,

Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefundInboxBo.zhText:
指挥官，

Ordis 向您的勤奋致敬。您与战甲之间的共生关系是——致命的——多么令人钦佩！我对诊断数据做出了修改以反映这种协同作用。

请重新对您的专精学派进行评估，以确保未来的战力计算保持准确。

|XP_HEADER||WAYBOUND_HEADER||CAPACITY_HEADER|

似乎这里也有专精晶体！我的传感器在嗡嗡作响。Ordis 对指挥官取得的成功感到非常高兴！

您忠诚的中枢，
Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefund_Capaci.text: The Quills have also sent Radiant Eidolon Shards. They were certain you would need these for coming battles.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefund_Capaci.zhText: 夜羽也送来了光辉的夜灵碎片。他们确信您在接下来的战斗中会用到这些物品。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefund_Waybou.text: Finally, a surprise to assist in your training, Operator! The Quills have sent you Brilliant Eidolon Shards.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefund_Waybou.zhText: 指挥官，最后有一项惊喜来协助您训练！夜羽给您送来了闪亮的夜灵碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefund_XPHead.text:
To assist the assessment, Ordis has calculated the enthusiasm you demonstrate for each of the Five Great Tenno Schools. Allow me to represent this data numerically:
|AP_ATTACK||AP_DEFENSE||AP_TACTIC||AP_POWER||AP_WARD|
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusRefund_XPHead.zhText:
为了协助评估，Ordis 统计了您对五大 Tenno 学派的热情。请允许我用数字表示这些数据：
|AP_ATTACK||AP_DEFENSE||AP_TACTIC||AP_POWER||AP_WARD|

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticAbility.text: Reduces the cooldown on Mind Spike.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticAbility.zhText: 减少心灵尖刺的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveA.text: Mind Spike grants allies |PCT|% increased Critical Chance with Melee Weapons for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveA.zhText: 心灵尖刺能在 |DURATION| 秒内增加同伴的近战武器暴击几率 |PCT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveA.text: Mind Spike grants invisibility to allies for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveA.zhText: 心灵尖刺能使同伴隐身 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveC.text: Transfer to Operator with |THRESHOLD|x Combo Multiplier to increase AMP damage by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveC.zhText: 拥有 |THRESHOLD|x 连击倍率时传识到指挥官可使增幅器伤害提高 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveE.text: Mind Spike has a |CHANCE|% chance to disarm enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveE.zhText: 心灵尖刺有 |CHANCE|% 几率使敌人缴械。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveF.text: Mind Spike opens up enemies to Finishers, and increases Finisher Damage taken by |PCT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveF.zhText: 心灵尖刺使敌人能被进行终结攻击，并增加处决伤害 |PCT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveS.text: Performing a Slam as Operator switches to Warframe and grants double Combo gain for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticActiveS.zhText: 作为指挥官施展震地攻击时，会切换到战甲并在 |DURATION| 秒内获得双倍连击增益。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticBaseDes.text: Unleash |COUNT| bursts of psychic energy over |DURATION|s that inflict Confusion on enemies within a |RADIUS|m, |FOV| degree cone.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticBaseDes.zhText: 持续|DURATION| 秒释放出 |COUNT| 次心灵能量来使敌人进入混乱状态，有效距离 |RADIUS| 米，扇形范围|FOV| 度。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticBlastCo.text: Void Blast has a |CHANCE|% chance of confusing enemies for |DURATION|s, causing them to be unable to distinguish friend from foe.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticBlastCo.zhText: 虚空爆裂有 |CHANCE|% 的几率使敌人陷入混乱，使他们无法分辨敌我，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticChaosMe.text: Mind Spike grants |COUNT| charges of Trauma. Melee attacks consume a charge of Trauma to inflict Critical Damage. Player's will lose |DRAIN| Health/s while they have Trauma charges active.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticChaosMe.zhText: 心灵尖刺获得 |COUNT| 个创痛充能。使用近战攻击时会消耗一个创痛充能来对敌人造成暴击。玩家在拥有创痛充能时将会每秒减少 |DRAIN| 点生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticChaosSh.text: Reduces the distance travelled by Mind Spike to |RADIUS|m, but increases its size to |FOV| degrees.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticChaosSh.zhText: 心灵尖刺的有效距离减少至 |RADIUS| 米，但增加扇形角度至|FOV| 度。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticCloakMe.text: Void Mode increases Critical Chance of melee attacks by up to |CRIT|% over |BUILDUP|s. This chance gradually decreases over |DEGRADE|s when the Operator leaves Void Mode. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticCloakMe.zhText: 虚空模式可以在 |BUILDUP| 秒内积累 |CRIT|% 的近战暴击几率。指挥官离开虚空模式后暴击几率会在 |DEGRADE| 秒内逐渐降低。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticCloakRe.text: Void Mode reveals enemies within |RANGE|m through walls. This range gradually decreases over |DEGRADE|s when the Operator leaves Void Mode. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticCloakRe.zhText: 虚空模式可以透过墙壁显示 |RANGE| 米内的敌人。指挥官离开虚空模式后此距离会在 |DEGRADE| 秒内逐渐降低。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticDashFin.text: Void Sling no longer displaces enemies, instead it will open them up to Finishers and increase Finisher Damage taken by |DAMAGE|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticDashFin.zhText: 「虚空弹射」不再撞开敌人，而将使敌人可被终结，并增加 |DAMAGE|% 的处决伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticDashSpe.zhText: 增加「虚空弹射」|PERCENT|% 的速度。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticDashWav.text: Creates a wave while dashing, increasing the Damage by |DAMAGE|% and the area of effect around the Operator by |RADIUS|m.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticDashWav.zhText: 冲刺期间产生一道波浪，增加 |DAMAGE|% 的伤害，增加指挥官身边的影响范围 |RADIUS| 米。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticMeleeCo.text: Melee Combo Counter now decays while out of combat by |AMOUNT| every few seconds, instead of depleting completely.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticMeleeCo.zhText: 脱离战斗后每隔几秒，近战连击数衰减 |AMOUNT|，而非完全归零。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticMeleeXp.text: Kills from Melee Attacks grant |PERCENT|% more Melee Affinity.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticMeleeXp.zhText: 近战击杀获得额外 |PERCENT|% 的近战武器经验值。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticMoveSpe.zhText: 增加指挥官的移动速度 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticResidua.text: Mind Spike grants |DURATION|s of invisibility when inflicting Critical Damage with a Melee Weapon for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticResidua.zhText: 在任务期间内若使用近战武器造成暴击，心灵尖刺将会使你隐身 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticResidua.text: Mind Spike grants |CHANCE|% increased Critical Chance with Melee Weapons for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticResidua.zhText: 心灵尖刺会在任务期间内增加你近战武器的暴击几率 |CHANCE|% 。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticResidua.text: Mind Spike grants |PCT|% increased Affinity from killing enemies with Melee Weapons for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusTacticResidua.zhText: 心灵尖刺会在任务期间内增加你近战武器击杀的敌人经验值 |PCT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardAbilityCo.text: Reduces the cooldown on Basilisk Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardAbilityCo.zhText: 降低蛇妖炽燃的冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveAll.text: Allies targeted by Basilisk Flare gain |PCT|% increased Armor for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveAll.zhText: 被蛇妖炽燃照射到同伴可于 |DURATION| 秒内提升护甲 |PCT|% 。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveCle.text: |PCT|% chance to clear Transference Static on kill while Reinforced Return is active.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveCle.zhText: 「强化回归」激活时，击杀敌人有 |PCT|% 概率清除传识干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveInv.text: Warframe is invulnerable for |DURATION|s after Operator is downed. Tap <USE> as Operator falls to bring the Warframe to the Operator’s location.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveInv.zhText: 指挥官被击败后，战甲进入无敌状态 |DURATION| 秒。指挥官被击败时按 <USE> 将战甲召唤到指挥官的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveKno.text: Gain immunity to slow, stagger, and knockdown effects for |DURATION|s after transferring between Operator or Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveKno.zhText: 在指挥官或战甲之间传识可获得 |DURATION| 秒免疫减速，失衡和击倒效果。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveMag.text: Use your first Ability to create a |RADIUS|m radius field that lasts for |DURATION|s and disables the shields of any enemy that enters it.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveMag.zhText: 使用你的第一技能来创造一个半径 |RADIUS| 米的力场，持续 |DURATION| 秒，消除所有力场内敌人的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActivePet.text: Enemies petrified by Basilisk Flare suffer |PCT|% reduced Armor for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActivePet.zhText: 遭到蛇妖炽燃石化的敌人会于 |DURATION| 秒内降低 |PCT|% 护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActivePet.text: Enemies petrified by Basilisk Flare continue to take |DOT| Damage/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActivePet.zhText: 遭到蛇妖炽燃石化的敌人会持续受到每秒 |DOT| 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActivePet.text: Petrified enemies sustain |DAMAGE| Damage/s from Basilisk Flare.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActivePet.zhText: 蛇妖炽燃会让石化中的敌人遭受每秒 |DAMAGE| 的额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardArmourBuf.text: Increases Armor for Warframe and Operator by |VALUE|.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardArmourBuf.zhText: 增加战甲和指挥官 |VALUE| 护甲

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBaseDesc.text: Unleash a ray of petrifying energy for |DURATION|s that turns enemies into stone for |FREEZE_DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBaseDesc.zhText: 持续 |DURATION| 秒射出一道石化能量射线，将敌人转化为石头 |FREEZE_DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBlastBull.text: Enemies hit by Void Blast are affected by Magnetize for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBlastBull.zhText: 被虚空爆裂击中的敌人将吸引子弹，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBlastDama.text: Void Blast has a |CHANCE|% chance to summon a Wisp when it damages an enemy. The Wisp can be picked up by allies to increase Operator Damage by |DAMAGE|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBlastDama.zhText: 虚空爆裂对一名敌人造成伤害时，将有 |CHANCE|% 的几率召唤一个虚灵。此虚灵可以被友军捡起以增加指挥官 |DAMAGE|% 的伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBlastDisa.text: Enemies hit by Void Blast have a |CHANCE|% chance to be disarmed.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardBlastDisa.zhText: 被虚空爆裂击中的敌人有 |CHANCE|% 的几率被缴械。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardChaosHall.text: Basilisk Flare ends with an eruption of flames blanketing a |RADIUS|m radius area for |DURATION|s, dealing |DAMAGE| Damage/s to enemies. The player has a |CHANCE|% chance to be inflicted with <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Status if they are caught in the eruption.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardChaosHall.zhText: 蛇妖炽燃施展后会随之爆发出范围 |RADIUS| 米、持续 |DURATION| 秒的火焰笼罩区域，对敌人造成每秒 |DAMAGE| 伤害。若玩家未能在火焰爆发前避开，将有 |CHANCE|% 几率受到<DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀影响。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardChaosPetr.text: Reduces Speed by |DEBUFF|%, but petrifies enemies |BUFF|% faster.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardChaosPetr.zhText: 降低移动速度 |DEBUFF|%，但敌人的石化速度加快 |BUFF|% 。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardCloakAlly.text: Void Mode now renders allies within |RADIUS|m invisible. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s per ally cloaked.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardCloakAlly.zhText: 虚空模式现使 |RADIUS| 米内的友军隐身。每遮蔽一名友军，此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardCloakRedu.text: Void Mode reduces damage taken by invisible allies within |RADIUS|m by |PERCENT|%. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardCloakRedu.zhText: 虚空模式使 |RADIUS| 米内的隐身友军减伤 |PERCENT|% 。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardDashReduc.text: Using Void Sling through an enemy will reduce their Armor by |PERCENT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardDashReduc.zhText: 使用「虚空弹射」穿过敌人，降低其 |PERCENT|% 的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardDashReduc.text: Using Void Sling through an enemy will reduce their Damage by |PERCENT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardDashReduc.zhText: 使用「虚空弹射」穿过敌人，降低其 |PERCENT|% 的输出伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardReflectDa.text: |PERCENT|% Damage taken is returned to the attacker.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardReflectDa.zhText: |PERCENT|% 的伤害会返还给攻击者。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualM.text: Attacks with Melee Weapons reduce the armor of an enemy by |PCT|% for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualM.zhText: 手持近战武器攻击敌人时可于 |DURATION| 秒内降低护甲 |PCT|% 。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualP.text: Basilisk Flare grants a |CHANCE|% chance to petrify enemies for |DURATION|s when struck with Melee Weapons for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualP.zhText: 蛇妖炽燃能在任务期间内，以 |CHANCE|% 的几率将对你使用近战攻击的敌人石化 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualS.text: During Last Gasp, Operator Damage is increased by |BASE|% plus an additional |PCT|% per second.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualS.zhText: 在「弥留之际」期间，指挥官伤害增加 |BASE|% 且每秒增加 |PCT|% 额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualS.text: Revive your Warframe by transferring to Operator and killing 3 enemies before |DURATION|s elapse and the Revive Meter begins to drain.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualS.zhText: 通过传识成指挥官，并在复活计量表耗尽之前于 |DURATION| 秒内击杀 3 个敌人来复活你的战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualS.text: Basilisk Flare grants |PCT|% bonus Armor for the duration of the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardResidualS.zhText: 蛇妖炽燃能在任务期间内获得 |PCT|% 额外护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/GenericSet.zhText: 最大生命值和多重射击

/Lotus/Language/Focus/GenericTauBattleUp.zhText: 战甲最大生命值和多重射击

/Lotus/Language/Focus/GhostWaveDesc.text: Second Ability emits a Void wave lasting |LIFETIME|s that drenches enemies with Void Contamination making them |PERCENT|% more vulnerable to Operator Damage for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/GhostWaveDesc.zhText: 第二技能可发射出一道持续 |LIFETIME| 秒的虚空冲击波来将虚空污染浸透敌人，他们在 |DURATION| 秒内受到的指挥官伤害增加 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/GhostlyTouchDesc.text: Killing an enemy affected by Contamination Wave makes all affected enemies |PERCENT|% more vulnerable, while also making the effect last |DURATION|s longer. Maximum |STACKS| stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/GhostlyTouchDesc.zhText: 击杀一名受「污染震波」影响的敌人会使其他所有受影响的敌人受到的伤害再额外增加 |PERCENT|%，并且也会使污染效果多持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多可叠加 |STACKS| 次。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/GreaterLensDesc.text: A Greater Lens that channels Affinity into Focus for one of the five Tenno Ways.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/GreaterLensDesc.zhText: 一颗将经验值转换为五项 Tenno 之道专精的高级晶体。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_HealRecei.zhText: 被治疗时获得额外生命值

/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.text: Instantly maxes out Energy for the entire team.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.zhText: 立即将全队的能量恢复至全满

/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.text: Instantly maxes out Health for the entire team.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.zhText: 立即将全队的生命恢复至全满

/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.text: Instantly maxes out Shield for the entire team.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.zhText: 立即将全队的护盾恢复至全满

/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.text: Instantly maxes out Stamina for the entire team.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/Guardian_InstantMa.zhText: 立即将全队的耐力恢复至全满

/Lotus/Language/Focus/LiftHitDamageDesc.text: Additional |PERCENT|% Weapon Damage per Lifted enemy attacked by Operator. Lasts for |DURATION|s, stacks up to |STACKS|x.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/LiftHitDamageDesc.zhText: 攻击被「虚空悬浮」浮空的敌人，每个敌人可使指挥官获得 |PERCENT|% 额外武器伤害。持续 |DURATION| 秒，最多可叠加 |STACKS| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/LiftHitWaveDesc.text: First Ability creates a |WIDTH|m wide shockwave lasting |DURATION|s, that inflicts Lift Status on all enemies it touches.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/LiftHitWaveDesc.zhText: 第一技能发射宽 |WIDTH| 米的冲击波，持续 |DURATION| 秒，冲击波触及的敌人将被悬空。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/MaduraiUltimateDes.text: Summon forth Thara from the Void and fire the great bow into the air, blanketing the area with a rain of explosive arrows for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/MaduraiUltimateDes.zhText: 从虚空中召唤出狂勇，将巨弓射向空中，用爆炸箭雨覆盖区域，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/MaduraiUltimateDes.text: Fire the great bow Thara into the air and blanket the area with explosive arrows.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/MaduraiUltimateDes.zhText: 将巨弓狂勇射向空中，用爆炸箭矢覆盖该区域。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/MaduraiUltimateDes.text: +25% Primary and Secondary Damage and +25% Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/MaduraiUltimateDes.zhText: 主要武器伤害和次要武器伤害增加 25%，射速增加 25%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/MagneticExtensionD.text: Void Sling out of a Magnetic Flare to refresh its duration and increase its radius by |PERCENT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/MagneticExtensionD.zhText: 使用「虚空弹射」脱离「磁耀力场」的范围来刷新它的持续时间，并为其提升 |PERCENT|% 范围。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/NoFreeSlots.text: You have no free Focus Slots. To install this Focus you must increase your Mastery Rank or uninstall a Focus.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/NoFreeSlots.zhText: 专精槽位不足；欲使用此项专精技能，您必须提升您的精通段位，或者先解除一项专精技能。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorAttackUlti.text: On dealing damage to enemies, cause arrows to rain upon them.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorAttackUlti.zhText: 对敌人造成伤害时，使箭雨落在他们身上。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorPowerUltim.text: Spectral pages grant increased ability strength, duration and casting speed.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorPowerUltim.zhText: 幻影书页可提升技能强度、持续时间和施放速度。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorTacticUlti.text: Spectral blades strike additional enemies with each Melee hit.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorTacticUlti.zhText: 每次近战击中，幻影之刃都会攻击额外的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorWardUltima.text: Increased Armor after picking up an Armor Mote. Taking damage consumes a stack.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/OperatorWardUltima.zhText: 拾取一个护甲微粒后护甲增加。受到伤害会消耗一个叠层。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/OstronLensDesc.text: An enhanced Greater Lens that has been infused with Breath of the Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/OstronLensDesc.zhText: 一颗注入了夜灵之息的强化高级晶体。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerLensOstronCon.zhText: 夜灵 Zenurik 晶体转换

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerLensOstronCon.text: Turns any Eidolon Lens into an Eidolon Zenurik Lens.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerLensOstronCon.zhText: 可将任一夜灵晶体转换成夜灵 Zenurik 晶体

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerTauBattleUpgr.text: Warframe Ability Strength and Energy Max
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerTauBattleUpgr.zhText: 战甲技能强度和能量最大值

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateBlind.text: Spectral pages also fire off beams that blind enemies within |VALUE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateBlind.zhText: 幻影书页还会发射光束，使 |VALUE| 米范围内的敌人失明。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateBuffU.text: Ability strength, duration, and cast speed granted by spectral pages increased by |PERCENT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateBuffU.zhText: 幻影书页赋予的技能强度、持续时间和施放速度增加 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateChain.text: Enemies struck by the Tauron Strike fire off smaller beams at other enemies within |VALUE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateChain.zhText: 被 Tauron 打击命中的敌人会向 |VALUE| 米范围内的其他敌人发射较小的光束。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateDesc.text: Summon forth Lorak from the Void and conjure its ruinous spells, calling forth a beam of energy from within. Enemies pierced by the beam have a |PERCENT|% chance to drop Energy Orbs if killed within 10s.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateDesc.zhText: 从虚空中召唤落书，施展其毁灭性的法术，从书内射出一道能量光束。被光束穿透的敌人若在 10 秒内被杀死，则有 |PERCENT|% 的几率会掉落能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateDescT.text: Summon the ruinous grimoire Lorak and call forth a piercing beam of energy.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateDescT.zhText: 召唤毁灭性的魔典落书，并唤出一道穿透性的能量光束。
增加 25% 技能强度和 25% 最大能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateNumbe.text: Create |AMOUNT| spectral pages granting an additional 10% Cast Speed, Ability Strength, Duration, and 100 bonus Energy per page.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/PowerUltimateNumbe.zhText: 创建 |AMOUNT| 张幻影书页，每页额外提供 10% 施放速度、技能强度、持续时间和 100 点额外能量。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/ProjectionExecutio.text: Second Ability increases the width of the next Void Sling by |RADIUS|% and enemies hit are vulnerable to Finishers, taking |DAMAGE|% more finisher damage.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/ProjectionExecutio.zhText: 第二技能增加 |RADIUS|% 下次施放「虚空弹射」的宽度，被击中的敌人会更容易受到处决攻击，他们受到的处决伤害将提升 |DAMAGE|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/ProjectionStretchD.text: Increases maximum Void Sling distance by |val|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/ProjectionStretchD.zhText: 增加 |val|% 虚空弹射的最大距离。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/ProtectiveProjecti.text: Allies touched by Void Sling are granted immunity from damage for |INVULN|s and healed |PERCENT|% over |DURATION|s for |ENERGY| energy cost.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/ProtectiveProjecti.zhText: 「虚空弹射」触及的友军获得 |INVULN| 秒无敌并消耗 |ENERGY| 能量于 |DURATION| 秒内恢复 |PERCENT|% 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/SonicDissipationDe.text: Second Ability Launches a projectile that spins up a vortex trap on impact, or tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> again to detonate in-flight. Trap lasts |DURATION|s. Void Sling through trapped enemies to grant allies within Affinity Range |AMOUNT| Health.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/SonicDissipationDe.zhText: 第二技能发射一个可在撞击时产生漩涡陷阱的投射物，或是再次轻按 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> 来在飞行中引爆它，陷阱会持续 |DURATION| 秒。对被困的敌人进行「虚空弹射」可为经验共享范围内的友军提供 |AMOUNT| 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/SunderingDissipati.text: Second Ability launches an energy bomb that explodes with a |RADIUS|m radius, stripping |PERCENT|% of enemy armor. Tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> again to detonate in-flight.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/SunderingDissipati.zhText: 第二技能发射一枚爆炸半径 |RADIUS| 米的能量爆弹，削减敌人 |PERCENT|% 护甲。再次使用 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> 可在爆弹飞行过程中引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/SurgingStormDesc.text: On dealing damage, fire an arrow at an enemy with |COOLDOWN|s cooldown between arrows. 30s duration.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/SurgingStormDesc.zhText: 造成伤害时，向敌人射出一支箭，箭矢之间的冷却时间为 |COOLDOWN| 秒，持续时间 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticLensOstronCo.zhText: 夜灵 Naramon 晶体转换

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticLensOstronCo.text: Turns any Eidolon Lens into an Eidolon Naramon Lens.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticLensOstronCo.zhText: 可将任一夜灵晶体转换成夜灵 Naramon 晶体

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticTauBattleUpg.text: Warframe Melee Damage and Critical Chance
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticTauBattleUpg.zhText: 战甲近战伤害和暴击几率

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDesc.text: Summon forth Vexoric from the Void and swing the colossal sword, unleashing a wave of devastating energy. Gain +|COMBO| Melee Combo from each enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDesc.zhText: 从虚空中召唤断命，挥舞巨剑，释放毁灭性的能量波。每次击中敌人，获得 |COMBO| 近战连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDesc.text: Draw the colossal sword Vexoric and unleash a wave of devastating energy.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDesc.zhText: 拔出巨剑断命，释放出毁灭性的能量波。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDesc.text: +25% Increased Melee Damage and +25% Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDesc.zhText: 近战伤害增加 25%，暴击几率增加 25%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDoub.text: Spectral weapons have a |VALUE|% chance to attack the same enemy a second time.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateDoub.zhText: 幻影武器有 |VALUE|% 的几率再次攻击同一个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateNumb.text: Summon |NUM_SWORDS| spectral swords that are copies of equipped melee weapon. Melee attacks will simultaneously trigger spectral attacks on any enemies within 10m for 30s. Spectral sword hits increase Combo Count and grant extra Tauron Strike Charge. Spectral swords are granted to all players in Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateNumb.zhText: 召唤 |NUM_SWORDS| 把与当前装备的近战武器相同的幻影之刃。进行近战攻击时，幻影之刃同时对 10 米范围内的所有敌人进行同步攻击，持续 30 秒。幻影之刃的攻击会增加连击数，并提供额外的 Tauron 打击充能。经验共享范围内的玩家都会获得幻影之刃。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateRang.text: Increase the range of spectral melee attacks to |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateRang.zhText: 幻影近战攻击的范围增加到 |RANGE| 米。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateSize.text: Tauron Strike slash size is increased by |VALUE|%.
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TacticUltimateSize.zhText: Tauron 打击的切割范围增加 |VALUE|%。

/Lotus/Language/Focus/Tactician_PickupIn.zhText: 掉落物的拾取数量为两倍

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TauronStrikeCharge.zhText: 获得 Tauron 打击充能

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TauronStrikeFocusB.text: Defeat enemies to earn bonus Focus and Tauron Strike Charges for |SEC|s
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TauronStrikeFocusB.zhText: 击杀敌人可获得额外专精和 Tauron 打击充能，持续 |SEC| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Focus/TauronStrikeFocusC.text: Daily focus cap reached. Bonus Tauron Strike Charges for |SEC|s
/Lotus/Language/Focus/TauronStrikeFocusC.zhText: 已达到每日专精上限。额外 Tauron 打击充能，持续 |SEC| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Focus/ThunderClapDesc.text: Increase Rain of Arrows radius to |RADIUS|m.

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. 

At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
起初，我除了遗忘带来的安逸，什么也不想要。我毫无念想地漂浮在忘忧草浴中，仿佛进入了第二次孕育。不见世事，不发一言。我的脑海中偶尔会闪过游离的光线，照亮了那残留在我头骨内的洞穴壁画。 

在感知的尽头，我隐约认出了一个模糊的轮廓，那是洛德，隔水相望，如同慈母般低声吟唱。我的舌头太过污浊，无法诵出那歌谣。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
Too craven to chase death, I awaited it. The father of fears, and yet I was still afraid. 

The currents whispered coward. I clenched my body into a fist as a foetus must and blinded myself afresh.
 
Stark pain smoked the juice of my living tomb. Why did the saga not end by itself? Why must I still act?
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
我太过怯懦不敢追逐死亡，所以我等待着它的降临。它是一切恐惧的根源，然而我依然害怕。

水流低语着懦夫。我如同胎儿一般将身体蜷缩成拳，再次让自己坠入黑暗。

我在这个活体坟墓里，剧烈的疼痛随着血雾扩散。为什么这个传说没有自己终结？我为什么还要采取行动？

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
Steeped in solitude, I found I could no longer endure my own company. 

Disgust did the work of courage. I tore the mundane membrane, slid weak and mucosal into Loid's embrace.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
独自浸泡着，我发现自己再也无法忍受孤身一人。 

厌恶让我鼓起了勇气。我撕开世俗的隔膜，虚弱而粘滑地投进了洛德的怀抱。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
Loid nursed me then, tending first to the uprooted ruin of my eyes, then to the mouth whose grin no longer hid behind flesh. 

The agony bit deep, but it was clean. Blameless love bled up from me. 

I had decided to live.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
那时，洛德照料我，先是照料我那如同被完全摧毁的眼睛，然后是那张不再能隐藏在皮肉下微笑的嘴。

那剧痛虽深，但我痛得纯粹。无可指摘的爱从我身上涌现。

我决定活下去。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
I felt no certainty as I donned clothes rough and strange to the touch of newgrown skin. I had none of the selfless zeal of the soldier. 

The same cursed question still pursued me as it had before: was I, even now, trapped in the rictus of the Wall?
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
当我穿上的那些粗糙且陌生的衣物，它们与新生的皮肤摩擦时，我并没有感到任何确定。我没有军人那种无私的热忱。 

那个该死的问题依然困扰着我，就像以前一样：即便到了现在，我是否仍被墙中的邪笑所困？

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
The apparatus of logic would never yield an answer. Only resolute action remained. If I must be a demon, let me be an honest one. Let me prove my nature by what I do next. 

Purpose. Let me leave such blazing footprints behind me as no unclean thing would dare to walk in.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
逻辑装置永远不会给出答案。剩下的就只有坚决行动。如果我注定成为恶魔，就让我做一个诚实的恶魔吧。让我用接下来的行动来证明我的本性。

目的。在我的身后留下如此炽热的脚印，让任何不洁之物都不敢跟随。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Albrecht's Notes - The Aftermath
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 后续

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. 

The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
我用多种科维兽试图消灭对手。

这个原理足够简单，尽管事后回想起来我讨厌自己的天真。我的人性被腐蚀性的虚空揭开，而现在又隔着鸿沟对我笑，对我所有肆无忌惮的恶意和狭隘了如指掌。作为回应，我决定将非人的思想投入到虚空。让虚空去拙劣地模仿它们。野性的接近将迫使它经历一场屈辱的退化。至少我是怎么认为的。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
The majority of the Cavia merely died. I gave the Void living beings and it sent me back bedraggled cadavers. The dead lay stacked in pyramids around my deserted lab. I was nothing but a failed priest.

But a glass splinter of stubbornness still stuck in me. And so, I persisted. The correct combination of creatures would work.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
大多数科维兽只是死了。我给虚空送去鲜活的生命，它却还我一具具肮脏的尸体。尸体在我被遗弃的实验室周围堆成了金字塔。我不过是一个失败的牧师。

但一丝倔强如玻璃碎片般刺在我心里。所以，我继续尝试。正确的生物组合会起作用。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
I realized my error as I sweated by visionary nestawood cinders, beside Loid who curled pale and sick from chewing too much of the root. The catalyst was uniqueness. That attribute was what caught the interest of the bland and undifferentiated Void. 

It was not necessary to explore queasy debates about the Oro; animal minds simply lacked the full distinction of a singular persona. My Kalymos, I was sure, was an exception, but I would not sacrifice that loyal being.

Perhaps I should have. The sin I was to commit was worse.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
当我在致幻的巢木余烬旁汗流不止时，我意识到自己的错误，而洛德因咀嚼太多的树根，脸色苍白而病态地蜷缩成一团。独特性是催化因素。正是这一属性吸引了那个单调且一体化的虚空。

探讨关于奥魂那些令人不适的议题是没有必要的；动物思维并不具备单一人格的完整区分。我确信我的卡利莫斯是个例外，但我不会牺牲那个忠诚的生命。

或许我早就该那么做了。我即将犯下的罪孽更加严重。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
The very last breeding pair of Cervulites was smuggled to me, causing Loid no small inconvenience. A species on the brink of extinction. Here was the uniqueness the Void sought. I was certain to the pit of my entrails.

I loaded the pair on to their Seriglass bridal barge, along with an expendable avian and a Norg for mental ballast. Fish, fowl and beast. A facile equilibrium.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
最后一对用于繁殖的石鹿被偷运到我这里——这一行径让洛德颇为困扰。这是一个濒临灭绝的物种。正是虚空所追寻的独特性。我深信不疑。

我将这对动物装载到它们的玻璃窗婚船上，连同一只可供牺牲的鸟类和一条用于维持心理平衡的诺格。鱼、禽和兽构成了一个简易的平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
They did not die, save one. They came back changed. Witnesses. Pilgrims, even, chanting freakish praise to the one beyond the wall.

I knew, then, that my gambit had lost. So long as I worked through scapegoats, my guilt would only deepen. I must atone for what I had done through my own blood.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
他们并没有死，除了一个。他们变了样回来了。成为了见证者。甚至可以说是朝圣者，对着墙外的那个存在吟唱着怪异的赞歌。

我那时明白了，我的策略已经失败了。只要我继续使用替罪羊，我的罪恶感就会愈发深重。我必须用自己的血来赎罪。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
Standard laboratory hygiene would have been to dispose of them. But some instinct stayed my hand. The Voidtongue was an enigma to me, but another - more habituated to the Void than I - might one day unravel it. Through the imposition of form upon the formless they could, perhaps, glean some meaning. 

I assigned the Cavia to Loid, for I could not bear to look upon them. Not yet.

Loid is, at heart, a good and kind man - better than I deserve. And completely oblivious to his own true worth.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
根据标准的实验室卫生流程，它们必须被丢弃。但某种本能却让我停了下来。虚空语对我来说是一个谜，但另一个比我更适应虚空的人也许有一天会解开它。通过对无形施加形态，他们或许能够领悟出某些意义。 

我把科维兽交给了洛德，因为我不忍直视它们。暂时还不行。

洛德骨子里是一个忠顺纯良的人——优秀到不应留在我身边。他完全没有察觉到自己的真实价值。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Albrecht's Notes - The Cavia
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 科维兽

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders.

But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
在双衍王境， 我每天都在我女儿的声音中醒来。起初，我因良心的责备而退缩。我无法面对我所抛弃的女儿，哪怕只是表面上的。于是我改头换面成为一位师长，告诫少年国王注意他王境之外的威胁。

但随着时光流逝，我开始认出欧拉瑞娅创造的那些古怪角色及其目的。我听到了那些声音，那是我最初在她孩童时代房间的漆黑中召唤出来的，不求任何回报，只为了她的喜悦。她不仅保留了这份我曾认为微不足道的礼物，还把它变成了一种治愈的工具。不仅如此：它还成为了一个堡垒。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Despite my legacy of neglect, despite my shoddy example, my needs, my demands, my daughter had triumphed in my absence. Her confidence, her warmth, shamed me. I had fled from the horror, but she? She had stood alongside the most vulnerable, those with the most to lose, and told them a different story.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 尽管有我留下的忽视，尽管我的不良榜样、我的需要、我的要求，我的女儿却在我缺席的情况下取得了胜利。她的自信，她的温暖，让我感到羞愧。我从恐惧中逃离，而她呢？她与那些最脆弱的，可能失去最多的人站在一起，给他们讲述了一个不同的故事。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
I did not perceive the significance of Euleria's stance at first. Her concern for the children was not merely pastoral attentiveness. It was a direct strike against the Indifference. She was teaching the weak to be strong in the very places where those cold fingers would reach, and through her act of compassion, spitting in the face of alienation and despair.

Could I do less?
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
起初我没有意识到欧拉瑞娅的态度有何意义。她对孩子们的关心远不止牧师般的关怀。这是对虚空无情之物的直接打击。她在那些虚空无情之物将要触及的地方教导着弱者变得坚强，并通过她的怜悯之举，唾弃疏远和绝望。

我怎能不去做更多？

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
Shame is an inert state, but fertile. It primes the mind, bolstering it for repentance.

I had thought to make a difference in Duviri. But Duviri had made a difference in me. My own daughter's creations, reverberating and growing in the womb of the Void, had shown me another path than that of the indulgent coward. I was neither helpless nor irredeemable. Like she had, I could fight.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
羞愧是一种不变的状态，却极富生机。它预备心灵，并加固心灵促使悔改。

我曾以为能为双衍王境带来改变。然而，是双衍王境改变了我。我自己女儿的创造，在虚空的子宫中回荡成长，向我展示了另一条道路，不同于纵容懦夫的路。我既不是无助的，也不是无可救药的。就像她一样，我也能战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
I took inspiration from Euleria's example. To the people of Duviri I bequeathed a legacy of cautionary stories. In them I spoke of fears that an infinity of spirals would not, could not, erase.

I slipped away from those lands, silent and unnoticed. From their joys, their sadnesses. From the celebration in my honor. In her, they already had all they needed. My work, I now understood, must proceed from a different point.

I would confront the phantom of myself, and deny it to the teeth.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
我从欧拉瑞娅的行为中受到了启发。对于双衍王境的人民，我留下了一系列警世故事。在这些故事中，我讲述了即使是无尽螺旋也无法抹去的恐惧。

我悄无声息地离开了那片土地。离开了他们的喜悦、悲伤。离开了为我举办的庆典。因为有了她，他们已经拥有了所需的一切。我现在明白，我的工作必须从一个不同的角度着手。

我会直面自己的幻影，咬牙否认。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Albrecht's Notes - Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than mere health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 我在瘟疫之年的居民中穿行，如同一个救世主，双手充满治愈之力。对于那些自愿者，我带去的不仅仅是健康。他们的身体已经做好了准备；只需要从我自己的时代带来的 Helminth 注入，就能实现转化的炼金术。他们已经成为了部分战甲，仍保有自由意志，同时得到了增强，适应虚空，能力出众。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Their humanity may not last. My deliverance may yet consume them, the human swallowed up in the sacred beast. And if my wayward disciples turn on me, what words of comfort shall I have beyond: this is the bargain we have made. Through our sacrifice, history will be saved.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 他们的人性可能不会长久。我所带来的拯救可能还会吞噬他们，人类被神圣的野兽所吞噬。如果我那些不守规矩的门徒背叛了我，除了：这是我们之间的协议，我还有什么安慰的言语。通过我们的牺牲，历史将被拯救。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: As their loyal doctor, I have taken repeated samples from them. The sight of their Technocyte-riddled cells mutating gave me fresh visions. I could take this material, work with it, forge new creations. Eagerly I brought the samples back to Deimos and began to cultivate them.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 作为他们的忠实医生，我反复地从他们身上取样。他们那些被 Technocyte 填满并发生突变的细胞给了我新的灵感。我可以利用这些材料，加以研究，打造出新的生物。我急切地将样本带回火卫二，并开始培养它们。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: It was Loid who pointed out the singular attributes of the Grey Strain. How it stimulates growth to monstrous dimensions. Many thoughts converged in me then. What if, through precise biochemical engineering, I could create the equivalents of Warframes, yet built to a titanic scale? Surely such a legion could stand against the Adversary... assuming, of course, that an Operator could be found.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 是洛德指出了灰种的独特属性，关于它如何增殖成庞然大物。当时有许多想法在我心中涌现。如果我能通过精确的生化工程创造出能与战甲比肩的造物，但却拥有巨人般的躯体呢？这样的军团无疑能与对手抗衡……当然，得先找到一位指挥官才行。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Not long after, the first of my Vessels took form. A giant to battle giants, merging the humanity of the man Arthur, the anatomical perfection of Ballas's Warframes, and the titanic potency of the Grey Strain. My saviors.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 不久之后，我的第一个承载体成型了。这是一个巨人，用来对抗巨人，融合了亚瑟的人性、Ballas 创造的完美战甲结构，以及灰种的巨人力量。是我的救星。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Albrecht's Notes - The Vessels
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 承载体

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text:
All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path.


As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task.

I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives.

The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn.

The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning.

Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText:
一切已准备就绪。洛德会按照命令行事，尽管他的眼神在无声地恳求我选择另一条道路。


在我等待着最后一次穿越到过去，我在思索，一个科学家在'赦免'这样一个灵性问题上能发挥什么作用。在灵魂的炼金术中，即使是悔改也必然是一项经过计算的任务。

我将修复我所破坏的，不多也不少。天平必须保持平衡。在这样巨大的忏悔面前，我不会关心任何一边上可能落下的尘埃，那些琐碎人生的尘埃。

古代建筑师用血液混合砂浆，以安抚最古老的土地神灵。我们本应如此明智。然而，现在学习还不算晚。

沙子落下，循环闭合。我回到了一切的起点。

任由那些无知人们对每个热切计划表示轻蔑吧；
交易已成，命运已定。我出于尘土，也归于尘土

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.text: Albrecht's Notes - We End as we Began
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/AlbrectLoreFra.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 我出于尘土，也归于尘土

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/ArchaicWeapons.text: The Old War found humanity facing a technologically superior force, and their own weapons were turned against them. Melee and ballistic weapons, inspired by primitive counterparts, became part of the Tenno arsenal to circumvent the Sentient interference of more technologically-involved weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/ArchaicWeapons.zhText: 远古之战中人类发现敌对力量拥有科技的优势，而人类的武器被用来反噬自己。受到原始武器的启发，近战与弹道武器被纳入了 Tenno 的武器库之中，来避开 Sentient 对高科技武器的干扰作用。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CaliberChicksS.zhText: 《火力女兵 2》原声带，可通过轨道飞行器中的身心和弦琴欣赏。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CelestialClash.text: Jade Shadows: Constellations music to enjoy from the Somachord in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CelestialClash.zhText: 《Jade 之影：众星》的音乐，可通过轨道飞行器中的身心和弦琴欣赏。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Ceres1Desc.text: Ceres is the extreme example of the Grineer's utilitarian ignorance of the natural landscape. Their expanding shipyard operations pollute and shroud the planet in smog and industrial waste as they manufacture machines of war. These foundries are scattered across the Origin System, giving them near-limitless reach with their fleets.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Ceres1Desc.zhText: 谷神星是 Grineer 对自然景观的功利主义与无知体现的极端案例。当他们生产战争机器时，其不断扩增的造船事业造成了严重污染，使得整座星球笼罩在一片废气之中。这些铸造厂四散于始源星系，使他们的舰队有着近乎无止尽的拓展空间。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Citizens1Desc.text: While the major warring factions combat each other across the Origin System, non-militant organizations and civilian merchants populate the many regional Tenno Relays. Travelling merchant collectors that offer rare goods, mentors that offer training and knowledge, and convictional syndicates that preach their own rituals and doctrine.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Citizens1Desc.zhText: 当几个主要的交战派系在始源星系中彼此交火争战之际，非军方组织与民间商人汇集到众多地区性的 Tenno 中继站中。这些移民中有着出售稀世珍宝的旅行贸易收藏家、提供训练与知识的导师们，也有宣扬自己仪式与教义的信仰集团。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Corpus1Desc.text: Lead by innovatory and elusive industrialists, and claiming to be descendants of Orokin lineage, the Corpus are dedicated to the accumulation of wealth. This elite ruling class operates an insular trade organization using humans and robotics for labour and security, and have been condemned by the Seven as a merchant cult.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Corpus1Desc.zhText: 由一群创新且难以捉模的企业家们所领导，他们自认是奥罗金血脉的后裔，并致力于累积财富。这个精英统治阶级利用人类与机器人提供劳力与安全防护，运作着一个独立的贸易组织。这个组织因此被七人众定罪为商业邪教。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusCrew1Des.text: Predominantly a merchant guild, Corpus labour and security forces are composed mostly of purpose-bred humanoid crewmen, and animal-like robots; both equally indoctrinated into a ritualized and propagandist devotion to labour and work.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusCrew1Des.zhText: 主体为一个商人公会，为求温饱的人类船员、类动物形态的机器人所组成了劳动力与保安部队。而两者皆被程序化洗脑，宣扬着献身于劳务和工作的理念。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 当你能满足欲望，他人会，蜂拥追随。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.text: We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusGreedRel.zhText: 我们是欲望的化身。我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们，是， Corpus。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusWeapons1.text: Weapons research and manufacturing is a large component of Corpus industry. Their designs are clean and precisely engineered, and they are the largest supplier of energy-based weapons in the Origin System. These cunning profiteers prefer to avoid conflict in times of war, dealing arms indiscriminately to any side that can afford the price.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/CorpusWeapons1.zhText: 武器研究及生产是 Corpus 工业领域的一大部分。他们的设计十分简洁并且极其精密，同时他们还是始源星系内最大的能量武器供应商。这群狡诈的奸商更愿意在战时躲避直接交火，然后在有利益可乘之际，一视同仁地向任何付得起钱的人贩卖军火。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Dojo1Desc.text: Newly awakened, and with no permanent location to call home, Tenno warriors have aligned to construct secret temples of their own. The architecture within is distinctly Tenno in origin, but these hidden palaces of bonding, training and meditation are undeniably influenced by Orokin architecture.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Dojo1Desc.zhText: 才刚苏醒的 Tenno 战士们，没有能称为家的永久居所，他们必须合力建造属于自己的秘密圣殿。道场的内部架构原本具有鲜明的 Tenno 风格。但不可否认地，这座进行联络、训练及冥想的秘密殿堂，受到了不少奥罗金建筑架构的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetADesc.text:
I am naturally curious. I can hardly help it. And so I set this down for any that follow in my footsteps, who wonder - as I have - about our home. 

Today, Duviri is a mere scattering of islands, set about the Palace as if they had spilled forth from it. But in the dawning time, when the Kingdom was new, it was a Kingdom worthy of the name.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetADesc.zhText:
我天性好奇，几乎不能自已。因此，我为了那些跟随我脚步的人，为了那些像我一样，想要了解我们家园的人写下了这些话。 

今天，双衍王境只是一座座散布在王宫周围的岛屿，仿佛它们是从王宫里溢出来的。但在最开始，当王境刚成立时，它是一个名副其实的王境。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetADesc.text:
From horizon to horizon lay island after island, each one different, bearing distinctive color and life. 

I have flown on Kaithe-back until the Archarbor was lost to sight, and then on again, and have been unable to number the lands over which I flew. Every one of them raised its banners to Thrax.

Nothing remains of those islands now. Not a tree, not a leaf, not a grain of sand.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetADesc.zhText:
连绵的地平线上坐落着一座又一座岛屿，每座都不相同，承载着独特的色彩和生命。 

我骑在绝灵骥的背上飞行，直到言录书院消失在视线中，然后又继续飞行，无法数清我飞过了多少土地。每片土地都竖起旗帜向士魂大帝致敬。

那些岛屿现在什么也没有留下。没有一棵树，没有一片叶，连一粒沙也没有。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetADesc.text:
It seems some of the Lost Islands were smashed by Thrax the King, as a child might smash a toy. Others have been obliterated by hazards unknown; the Void is an ocean, it is said, and monsters dwell in its depths. But the vast majority of the islands have simply fallen to the Void's creeping encroachment, as the tides wear away at the land. 

I dream of a Lost Island returning one happy day, or an entirely new island appearing, birthed from the Void. But this place has not changed in so long, except for the worse, and there is no reason for hope. One day, I am sure, the Void will engulf us all.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetADesc.zhText:
似乎有些失落的岛屿被士魂大帝摧毁了，就像是孩子把玩具弄坏了。其他的则是被未知的灾害摧毁了；据说，虚空是一片海洋，怪物就住在它的深处。但是绝大多数的岛屿只是单纯的被渗透进来的虚空所占领，就像是潮汐侵蚀大地一般。 

我梦想着某一天失落的岛屿能够回归，或者一整座新的岛屿从虚空中诞生。但是这个地方已经很久没有变化了，除了变得更糟之外，也没有希望可言。我确信有一天，虚空会把我们所有人都吞没。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetAName.text: We Are Not What We Were

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetBDesc.text: When Duviri came into being there were many islands whose contents were - to put it bluntly- horrific. The Execution Cyst, the Golden Hive, the Inversion Tree, Stitcher's Gulch and the Bountiful Swamp were all notorious, but each met a natural end, engulfed by the Void. Lorn was exiled deliberately.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetBDesc.zhText: 双衍王境诞生之初，许多岛屿上的事物……恕我直言，实在令人毛骨悚然。「处决包囊」「黄金蜂巢」「逆位之树」「缝合机峡谷」与「丰饶沼泽」无不恶名远扬，但最终都被虚空吞没，走向消亡。唯独孤魂岛，是被人为放逐的。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetBDesc.text:
The Island of Lorn was a desolate, bleak outcrop where ghosts would scream accusations against anyone who came close enough to hear. Shunned by all, it was ultimately severed from Duviri and set adrift in the Void, where it can still occasionally be heard screaming to this day. 

Islands are usually unmoored or otherwise destroyed by command of the King. Here, though, it was the local citizenry who rose up and cast the offending island out, smashing the bridges with their tools and dragging it away using ropes and flying Kaithes.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetBDesc.zhText:
孤魂岛是一个荒凉、荒芜的露出来的岛屿，那里的幽灵对任何接近到足够听到它们声音的人尖声指责。所有人都避而远之，它最终从双衍王境上分割开来，在虚空中漂泊，时至今日仍能偶尔听到它的尖叫声。 

通常来说，岛屿会被大帝的命令移位或者摧毁。但这个岛屿不同，当地居民起义并驱逐了这座冒犯的岛屿，他们用工具砸毁桥梁，用绳索和飞行的绝灵骥将其拖走。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetBDesc.text: Lorn was notable for its curious shrines, many of which were dismantled and their component stones taken from the island by royal order. One comes across them occasionally, and it is possible - though not advisable - to reassemble them. To do so risks a local outbreak of ghosts, an offense punishable by death should the Dax catch you at it.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetBDesc.zhText: 孤魂岛以其奇特的圣坛而闻名，其中许多奉圣令拆除并将它们的组成石头从岛上带走。偶尔会遇到这些石头，尽管重新组装它们是有可能的，但并不建议这样做。这样做有可能会引发当地鬼魂爆发的风险，如果被禁卫发现，这是可以处以死刑的。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetCDesc.text:
In all the ages of Thrax's reign, only two strangers have ever been known to come to Duviri. 

One was the monk, Teshin, who fell from the sky into the lake on the island we now call Hermit's Landing. Seemingly lifeless, he was dragged ashore by Mathila who nursed his return to health. I have never known a constitution to match his; yet unlike us, he has… deteriorated… with the passing of time.

The other stranger came far earlier in Thrax's reign, before even the Bleeding Earth.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetCDesc.zhText:
在士魂大帝统治的所有时代当中，真要说起来，也只有两个陌生人来到过双衍王境。 

一位是个叫做 Teshin 的僧侣，他从天而降掉进了岛上的湖中，我们现在称那里为"隐临岛"。玛蒂拉把看上去毫无生命迹象的他拖上了岸，并照料他一直到他康复。我不知道谁有哪一种体质能跟他的体质相提并论；但他和我们不同，他，随着时间的流逝，状况已经越来越差。

另一个陌生人，在士魂大帝的统治早期就在这里了，甚至要早于"大地泣血"的时代。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetCDesc.text:
The stranger had haunted eyes and a downcast mien, and spoke of the Wall and the worlds beyond. He wore his hair like looped snakes, and his voice carried an accent unlike any in Duviri. 

With the King's permission, he constructed a great laboratory of light-smoking mirrors and Void-lanthorns, which he claimed was the match of one he had once owned in a former life. The island where it stood was known as Scholar's Landing.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetCDesc.zhText:
那个陌生人有着阴郁的眼神、低落的神情，但他却总喜欢谈论"墙"和墙那边的世界。他会把头发像蛇一样盘起来，并且有着一口和双衍王境里谁也不一样的口音。 

在大帝的许可下，他建造了一座巨大的实验室，里面有冒着烟雾的镜子和虚空灯笼——那些东西据他所说，这是和他之前的生活中拥有的那盏灯笼配对的。那座实验室所矗立的岛屿被称作"儒临地"。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetCDesc.text:
The time would come, the stranger said, when Duviri would be needed. There was a work of repentance to be done, and he could not do it alone. What he meant by this I cannot say; and cannot now ask, for Scholar's Landing vanished overnight. 

But I shall watch, and wait, and hope.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetCDesc.zhText:
陌生人说，需要双衍王境的时候会到的。悔改的工作要做，而他一个人做不完。他的意思我不知道；我现在也不能问，因为"儒临地"一夜之间就消失了。 

但是我会观察、等候、盼望。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetDDesc.text: The Necropolis Island was once one of the largest in Duviri, and the strangest. It appeared to be a sprawling burial ground, littered with gravestones, wooden crosses, sarcophagi and ornate tombs. But those who broke into these places found that there were no bodies to loot. Not a cadaver, not a skull, not even a tooth.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetDDesc.zhText: 大墓岛曾经是双衍王境最大的岛屿之一，也是最奇怪的岛屿之一。它似乎是一个庞大的墓地，散落着墓碑、木制十字架、石棺和华丽的坟墓。但那些胆大妄为闯入这些地方的人却发现，这里没有尸体可以掠夺。没有尸体，没有头骨，甚至连颗牙齿也没有。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetDDesc.text:
Instead, each coffin contained a simulacrum of the human form, in various stages of decay. Entire skeletons carved out of wood. Corpses of rotting straw stuffed into old clothes. Mouldering faces sculpted in crumbling clay. Little bones laboriously whittled down from large bones. 

I have never been able to make any sense of it.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetDDesc.zhText:
取而代之的是，每个棺材都包含一个处于不同腐烂程度的模拟物。整副骨架都是用木头雕刻而成的。腐烂的稻草尸体被塞进旧衣服里。用开裂的粘土雕刻出腐烂的面孔。小骨头是从大骨头上费力地雕刻出来的。 

我一直无法理解它。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetDDesc.text:
The Doll Mausoleum did not even attempt to imitate an authentic burial structure. It was built to far too small a scale. The cavities within it were tiny, each one holding a coffin that contained a miniature human figure. These were of all genders, often with brightly coloured hair, all wearing odd one-piece hooded suits of black leather.

Thrax was known to visit the Mausoleum, alone. I do not know what he did there. 

Now the place is lost to the Void. A mystery that shall remain so, forever. Isn’t that maddening?
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetDDesc.zhText:
人偶陵墓甚至没有尝试模仿真实的墓葬结构。它的建造规模太小了。它里面的洞窟很小，每个洞窟都装有一个棺材，里面有一个微型人偶。这些人偶有着各种性别，通常是头发颜色鲜艳，都穿着奇怪的黑色皮革连体连帽套服。

众所周知，士魂大帝经常独自一人前往陵墓。我不知道他在那里做了什么。 

如今这个地方已经消失在虚空之中。成为一个永远的谜。这不是很令人抓狂吗？

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetEDesc.text:
The island of Manipura was Duviri's vineyard. The Calaventi merchant sisterhood had villas there. Their tenant farmers raised succulent grapes to be turned into wine, which was taken as a tribute to be shared among the Dax. 

Tribute day was a great celebration in the Dax barracks, as the veiled Yaskutai would pour bowl after bowl of wine, comrades would show old wounds and tell tall tales of how they were come by, and old songs would be sung late into the night.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetEDesc.zhText:
宝石之岛是双衍王境的葡萄园。卡拉文蒂商人姐妹会在那里拥有别墅。她们的佃农种植多汁的葡萄酿造葡萄酒，作为贡品供禁卫享用。 

进贡日在禁卫军营是一个盛大的庆祝活动，蒙着面纱的管家会一碗一碗地倒酒，战友们会露出旧伤并大谈特谈他们是怎么受伤的，并在深夜里唱着老歌。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetEDesc.text:
The Calaventi were proud. They considered themselves reflections of the ‘true' Orokin, and though they bent the knee to Thrax, they did not respect him. 

With his changeable moods and his short stature, Thrax was - they whispered - merely an upstart, an imitator. 

It was the servants who alerted Thrax to their masters' insolence. If they expected to be rewarded for this, more fool them.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetEDesc.zhText:
卡拉文蒂姐妹非常骄傲。她们认为自己才是"真正的"奥罗金化身，即便她们要向士魂大帝屈膝，也并不尊重他。 

"他喜怒无常，身材矮小，士魂大帝"——她们窃窃私语道——"只是一个暴发户，一个模仿者。" 

是仆人们提醒士魂大帝他们主人的傲慢无礼。如果他们奢望能因此得到回报，那他们更是傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetEDesc.text:
A terrible Orowyrm was sent to, and I quote, 'trample the Calaventi sisterhood as they trample their grapes'. With no warning, the Orowyrm burst through the island from beneath, shattering it to fragments.

If the Dax of Duviri resent the loss of their wine-tribute, they know better than to speak of it.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetEDesc.zhText:
一条恐怖的奥金魇龙，如我引述，被派去"践踏卡拉文蒂姐妹，就像她们践踏葡萄一样"。突如其来，奥金魇龙从下方冲破了岛屿，将其撞成碎片。

即便双衍王境的禁卫对失去他们的葡萄酒贡品感到不满，他们也知道最好不要说出来。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetFDesc.text: For Lake Verula to be lost and forgotten is a lasting bitterness to me. There was a time when it was Duviri's festival spot. On the anniversary of Thrax's coronation, the citizenry would build ceremonial floating islands. On these they would drift, sing, play music and light fragrant lanterns in honor of Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetFDesc.zhText: 维鲁拉湖的消失和被遗忘对我来说是一种非常漫长的痛苦。曾经有一段时间，这里是双衍王境的节日胜地。在士魂大帝的加冕周年纪念日中，国民们会建造仪式性的浮岛。他们会在上面漂浮、唱歌、演奏音乐并点亮芬芳的灯笼以纪念士魂大帝。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetFDesc.text:
Attracted by the music, the rainbow eels would rise from the lake bed, poke their iridescent heads above the water, and sing. 

Luscinia had a school of them that followed her across the lake and floundered on the shore when she disembarked, as if they yearned to remain with her.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetFDesc.zhText:
被音乐所吸引，虹鳗会从湖床上升起，它们将色彩斑斓的脑袋探出水面，然后唱歌。 

有一群虹鳗跟着路西尼娅穿过湖，当她下船时它们会在岸上费力挣扎，就好像它们渴望和她在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetFDesc.text:
We could not know that down on the lake bed, a portal to the Undercroft had formed. Predatory creatures writhed in. They were golden, slender, with massive fanged bivalve maws. And they were ravenous. They devoured the rainbow eels, and then they devoured each other until only a handful were left.

Lake Verula had no more magic after that. Thrax ordered the lake drained, but the golden maws merely burrowed into Duviri's crust, where to this day they can sometimes be found plundering our pools.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetFDesc.zhText:
我们并不知道的事情是，在湖床上，早就已经形成了通往地穴的入口。掠食性生物扭动着进入这里。它们是金色的、细长的，长着巨大外壳的喉兽。而且它们非常贪婪。它们狼吞虎咽地吃掉了虹鳗，然后又互相吞噬，直到只剩下几条。

维鲁拉湖在那之后没剩下多少魔力了。士魂大帝下令排干湖水，但金色的喉兽只是钻进了双衍王境的地壳中，直到今天，它们还时不时会在那里掠夺我们的水池。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetGDesc.text:
The island was called Cornucopia, for its fecundity. The soil, dark and rich, yielded tubers and greens that shimmered with life. Wagons laden with tribute would go tottering up to the Palace in procession. 

All this was, of course, the will of the King; for what is a kingdom without its peasants? Thus had he created the islands, and thus they remained, day after indolent day. 

Then, on a morning like any other, Farmer Hovrel drove his spade into the earth and brought up blood.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetGDesc.zhText:
这座岛因为物产丰富被叫做丰饶岛。深色肥沃的土壤长出了闪闪发光的块茎和绿色植物。满载贡品的马车会列队摇摇晃晃地驶向王宫。 

当然，这一切都是大帝的旨意；没有农民的王境算什么？他就这样创造了这些岛屿，它们就这样日复一日地留了下来。 

然后，在一个和往常一样的早晨，农夫霍夫雷尔把他的铲子插进土里时，鲜血涌了上来。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetGDesc.text:
Blood welled up from the gash like crimson oil. As Hovrel looked on, stupefied, the rivulet reached the road and… began to pool. The shocked cries of other farmers rang out as their furrows, too, began to fill with blood.

The stuff was dark, almost black. It had a heavy metallic odor suffused with grave spices. One venturesome soul tasted it. His eyes instantly became pitch-orbs, his voice a smoky whisper.

Panic ensued. Was this a curse? The judgment of Dominus Thrax?
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetGDesc.zhText:
鲜血像深红色的油一样从伤口涌出。霍夫雷尔目瞪口呆地看着，鲜血的溪流到了马路上……开始汇集。其他农民的惊叫声响起，他们新挖的犁沟也开始流血。

这东西很暗，几乎是黑色的。它有一种浓重的金属气味，弥漫着浓郁的香料味。一个敢于冒险的人尝试了它的滋味。他的眼睛立刻变成了黑色的球形，他的声音变成像烟雾一样的低语。

恐慌接踵而至。这是诅咒吗？是士魂大帝的审判吗？

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetGDesc.text:
The Dax came swiftly, the roads were barricaded, and Cornucopia was isolated from Duviri. 

Later that day, a great Orowyrm shattered the bridges. The island was set adrift, inhabitants and all. The last sight I had of them was a row of wide-eyed, pleading faces watching me steadily as they vanished into the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetGDesc.zhText:
禁卫来得很快，封锁了道路，将丰饶岛与双衍王境隔绝开来。 

那天晚些时候，一只巨大的奥金魇龙摧毁了桥梁。整座岛屿连同它的居民一起漂流了起来。我最后一次看到他们时，是一排睁大眼睛、恳求的脸，在他们消失在虚空中时一直看着我。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetHDesc.text:
There was a time when the children of Duviri were educated. 

Upon the island of Academe, within its chalky caves, in rough-hewn classrooms lit by burning blue gas, sages taught them everything they would need to know. They learned of the Seven Principles, the geometries, the primords, the harmonics and resonances, the sacred stories, and most importantly, the unquestionable benignity of Dominus Thrax.

And then, not long after the Rain of Chains, the first of the Hollow Children appeared.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetHDesc.zhText:
曾经的日子里，双衍王境的孩子们是可以上学的。 

在学院岛上，有一个洞口多孔的山谷。在粉白色的洞穴里，在通过燃烧蓝色气体来照亮的简陋教室里，圣人会教给他们一切他们需要知道的关于现实的本质、七大原则、几何学、原基学、谐波和共振、神圣的故事，最重要的是，士魂大帝不容置疑的仁慈。

"锁链之雨"发生后不久，第一个空洞之子出现了。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetHDesc.text:
They joined the others for class, sitting at the back, silent and attentive. Their eyes were a deep and lustrous black, their mouths fixed in a constant grin. None of the sages saw them enter or leave. 

The Hollow Children did not speak, nor did they participate in class in any way, except to giggle unnervingly when the subject of the Void was mentioned.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetHDesc.zhText:
他们和其他人一起上课，坐在后面，沉默而专心。他们的眼睛是深邃而有光泽的黑色，嘴巴总是咧着嘴笑。没有一个圣人看见过他们的出入。 

空洞之子没有说话，也没有以任何方式参与课堂，除了在提到虚空这个话题时发出令人不安的咯咯笑。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetHDesc.text:
When adults came to collect their children, they noticed an additional oddity. Among the Hollow Children were exact duplicates of themselves when they were younger. Each day there were more of them.

Thrax ordered the island destroyed, but when Lodun descended from the sky to ravage it, the Orowyrm found it had broken free of its own accord. 

Thrax did not give the order to pursue.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetHDesc.zhText:
大人来接他们的孩子时，注意到了一个额外的奇怪之处。在这些空洞之子中，有的是大人们年轻时的复制品。他们的数量每天都在增多。

士魂大帝下令摧毁该岛，但当隆沌从天而降要毁灭它时，这条奥金魇龙发现其已经自行脱离了。 

士魂大帝没有下达追击的命令。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetIDesc.text: How I loved the Galleria. It was an island of simple beauty, where white statues rose out of the ground as if they had grown there. They were classical in their features, masked in due propriety, each bearing an instrument or an emblem of their craft. I gave them names: the Scribe, the Scryer, the Shawzinist.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetIDesc.zhText: 我多么喜欢艺术回廊。这是一座朴素而美丽的岛屿，白色的雕像拔地而起，就好像它们长在那里一样。他们有着古典的特征，装扮得体，每个人都佩戴着代表他们自己手艺的乐器或标志。我给他们起了名字：作家、占卜师、三线琴家。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetIDesc.text:
On days when the mist of Thrax’s sorrow hung among the marble columns a sober chill seemed to drape the Galleria. One could not wish for a better spot to cool a burning head. This kingdom is often mad, but this was a space for sanity.

That peace was shattered one morning as I drove my carriage there. I witnessed a vast form break up from the ground and clumsily probe the area around it.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetIDesc.zhText:
在士魂大帝的悲伤迷雾笼罩在大理石柱之间的日子里，一股严肃的寒意似乎覆在艺术回廊上，人们再也找不到比这更适合冷静思绪的地方了。这个王境经常是疯狂的，但这是一个理智的空间。

一天早上，当我驾着马车去那里时，那种平静被打破了。我目睹了一个巨大的身影从地面上冒出来，笨拙地探查着它周围的区域。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetIDesc.text:
I took the thing for a gigantic worm or slug, until one of my escorting Dax pointed out the colossal fingernail on its 'head'. 

We turned on our heel and made for the Palace, where I gave Dominus Thrax the best account I could of what I had seen. On hearing that a single monstrous finger had burst up through the green sward, Thrax took terrible fright. 

Despite my entreaties, he sacrificed the entire island before any more of the entity could emerge.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetIDesc.zhText:
我以为那东西是一条巨大的蠕虫或鼻涕虫，直到我的一名护送禁卫指出它"头"上的巨大指甲。 

我们转过身前去王宫，在那里我向士魂大帝尽可能地描述了我所看到的一切。当听到一只巨大的手指从绿色的草地上冒出来，士魂大帝吓了一跳。 

尽管我恳求，他还是决定在任何实体出现之前牺牲了整个岛屿。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetJDesc.text:
In the splendid lands on this side of the Wall lives happy Mathila; and she has two children. 

She also had a husband, in her yesterdays. When I have attempted to talk to her about him she has simply frozen, like a rat before a snake. 

His name was Garmi, and he was keeper of the Seriglass Lighthouse on Watcher's Island.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetJDesc.zhText:
在「墙」这一边的锦绣大地上，住着快乐的玛蒂拉和她的两个孩子。 

从前，她还有过一位丈夫。可每当我谈起她丈夫时，她都会像老鼠撞见了蛇一般，瞬间僵住。 

她的丈夫名叫加尔米，曾是守望者之岛上玻璃灯塔的守护人。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetJDesc.text:
The lighthouse served no true purpose, yet he kept its lamp burning, beaming out into the Void as if to call travelers home.

Now… before his death, Garmi confided in me that he felt his role was important; he was keeping ‘it' at bay. 

Void Storms were not unknown in Duviri, but the storm I shall speak of was unlike others. It hung in a red veil across the sky. There was a great sound like tearing metal, and all at once a pelting rain fell. Not water, but broken metal chains, in lengths and coils and great rattling whipstrands.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetJDesc.zhText:
灯塔其实没有什么真正的用途，然而他让灯火一直亮着，向虚空发出光芒，仿佛在召唤旅行者回家。

然后……加尔米在去世之前，曾向我吐露，他觉得自己的角色有重要的意义；他一直在牵制"它"。

虚空风暴在双衍王境并不为人所知，但我要说的风暴与其他不同。它就像血色的面纱一样悬挂在天空之中。突然传来一声割裂金属的巨响，紧接着倾盆大雨如注。不是雨水，而是断裂的金属链，长短不一、盘绕纠缠，发出震耳欲聋的响声。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetJDesc.text:
The falling chains shattered roofs and windows, slashed through screaming livestock, and maimed the fools who had not come in from the streets.

I found Garmi's log in the toppled ruin of the lighthouse. With admirable presence of mind, he describes a form steadily approaching out of the Void. A monstrous hand, possessed of only three fingers and a thumb.

With the lighthouse gone, Watcher's Island crumbled and was gone too within three spirals.

Garmi has no grave nor memorial, as if he had never lived. But I remember, And so, I record.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/DuviriSetJDesc.zhText:
坠落的链条砸碎了屋顶和窗户，砍断了尖叫的牲畜，伤残了那些没有从街上进来的傻瓜。

我在已经倒塌的灯塔废墟当中寻找到了加尔米的日志。他以令人钦佩的镇定自若，描述出了他看到一个形态从虚空中缓缓逼近的情景。一只巨大的手，但却只有三根手指和一根拇指。

随着灯塔的消失，守望者之岛也崩溃并消失了，仅在三个循环内。

加尔米没有坟墓，也没有纪念馆，仿佛他从未存在过一样。但是我记得， 正因此，我记录下来。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Earth1Desc.text: Earth has been long abandoned due to its toxic atmosphere. It is now overgrown with mutated jungle structures that have devoured most of the prior signs of civilization. Infestation and roaming wildlife still inhabit its surface but anything of value was stripped by scavengers generations ago.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/Earth1Desc.zhText: 地球因其剧毒大气层已被遗弃许久。如今，疯长的突变植物丛林将过过去文明的痕迹吞噬殆尽。只有感染者和四处游荡的野生动物仍居住在地表面上，但一切有价值东西都在几个世代前被拾荒者掠夺得一干二净。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EarthSettlemen.text: Like most living organisms, the Grineer require water to survive. Beneath Earth's towering forest canopy are rich reserves of fresh water that the Grineer have fought hard to maintain for many years. Evidence of their long-standing occupation is found among their many outposts that have been taken hold by giant roots, moss, and other layers of vegetation over time.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EarthSettlemen.zhText: 正如同大多数生物体，Grineer 也需要水才能生存。在地球那高耸的森林下方，有着 Grineer 竭力保护多年的足量净水资源。有证据表明，在对地球长期的统治中，他们许多前线据点都被巨型的根茎，苔藓类植物或其他多层植被植物所侵蚀。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: Plains of Eidolon
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 夜灵平野

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: The site of the final battle between the Unum's champion, Gara, and the colossal Sentient that wished to claim the Tower's regenerative qualities for itself. Today the remains of the Sentient, diminished and confused, wander the Plains - seeking a cohesion the Ostrons hope it shall never find.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 这里是乌努母神的战士，Gara，与妄图夺取高塔治愈能力的巨大 Sentient 决战的场所。如今这些 Sentient 的残骸已经变得衰退而混乱，在平野上徘徊——寻求再次的凝聚，而 Ostron 但愿这永远不会成真。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: Ancient History
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 古老的历史

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text:
Many questions remain: what is the true history of Cetus? Who is the Unum and for how long has she been one with the living Tower? What is her relationship to the Quills and what hidden purpose do they serve? The Archivist, Onkko, preserved much of the old folklore but how much of that is true?

If there is any kind of scheme to the unfolding of things, some end-point in sight, then one thing is certain: the arrival of the Tenno in Cetus is no accident.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText:
许多问题仍然存疑：希图斯真正的历史是如何的？谁又是乌努母神，她又与那座活着的塔共存了多久？她和夜羽的关系是如何的，而夜羽们又是为了什么样隐藏的目的而工作？档案保管人，昂克，保存了大量民俗知识，但其中又有多少是真实的？

假如说，事物的演变蕴含着阴谋，视野有着终点，那么有一件事是确定的：Tenno 来到希图斯绝不是偶然。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: The Tower's Flesh
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 塔内的肉

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text:
"Khanung! Khanung! Clear Ingress Four-Two-Seven-Five! Shock charges have been affixed! Evacuate five hundred meters boomward! Prepare to make fire! Prepare to make fire!"

The Unum specifies which part of her Temple-body may be harvested, and when. In this manner her body eternally replenishes, providing her people with flesh to sell, Temple-kuva to refine and oils with which to make remarkable unguents. On occasion, nestled within the substrata of her being, a rare discovery awaits: forgotten technology. Proto-essence. Things which lure travelers from across the system, and so are a bounty for her people.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText:
"当心！当心！清空入口4-2-7-5！冲击载荷已经附着！疏散爆破方向五百米内！准备好点火！准备好点火！"

乌努母神详细列举了她哪部分的神殿身躯可以被收割，以及何时收割。以这种方式，她的身躯可以永续地再度补充，使得她的子民有肉可以贩卖，有神殿赤毒可以精炼，有油脂可以制作非凡的药膏。偶尔，在她的基质下裹挟着稀有的发现：失落的科技。原初精华。这些东西诱惑着全星系的旅行者们，也因此成为了她的子民的宝物。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: Ostron Patois
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: Ostron 的俚语

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text:
Swazdo-lah - a common greeting
Sho-lah - 'farewell'
Surah - 'friend'
Dah-dap - 'thank-you'
Ai yo - a common exclamation. Could be thought of as 'oh my'
Lok heb - 'hail'
Chut! - 'silence!' (request for)
Kruna metta - an imploration. 'please'.
Khanung! - a warning
Utz - a universal emphatic, appended to the end of a descriptor ("I am happy utz.") 'Very'
Doh-ga - Urgency. 'hurry'
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText:
Swazdo-lah - 常用问候语
Sho-lah - "再见"
Surah - "朋友"
Dah-dap - "谢谢你"
Ai yo - 常用惊叹词。可以被理解为"（哎呦，）我的天呐"
Lok heb - "打招呼"
Chut！- "安静！"（征求语气）
Kruna metta - 表示恳求。"请"。
Khanung！- 表示警告。
Utz - 表示通用的语气加强，置于形容词之后。（"我高兴 utz"。）"非常"
Doh-ga - 表示紧急。"赶快"

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: Tools of Harvest
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 收割工具

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text:
The Unum gives of herself, decreeing what parts of her Temple-body may be harvested for the good of Cetus. Drillers, climbing great scaffolds, punch cavities into the Temple wall which are then packed with mighty shock charges. The call ‘prepare to make fire!' echoes across the rooftops, and all know to clear the streets and alleys boomward of the harvest. The detonations rupture the sacred flesh, freeing great blanketpieces which are, in turn, pulled free and rolled down via the use of long billhooks. It is then the duty of agile balloon drop-drivers to deliver this bounty to the butchers below.

Flensers: those who carve up the Temple's flesh.

Eruptors: those who lay shock charges along chosen lines, and ‘make fire', loosening the carved flesh for removal by balloon.

Retrievers: those who wring all oil from scrubs at the end of a shift.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText:
乌努母神献出了自己，决定了她哪部分的神殿身躯是可以为了希图斯而收割的。钻工们爬上巨大的脚手架，把神殿的墙壁凿除孔洞，然后在其中填满强力的冲击载荷。"准备好点火！"的呼号响彻屋顶，所有人都知道要撤出爆破方向的街道和小巷。爆炸物割开了神圣的肉，使得大块毯状的肉松动，随后被钩镰拉扯下，并滚落。接下来就是灵巧的气球空投手的工作，将这份宝物送到下方的屠户手中。

剥皮手：这些人切开神殿的肉。

爆破手：这些人将冲击载荷安置在选好的线路上，并且"点火"，使得切开的肉松动，好让气球挪走。

回收手：这些人负责在每一班结束时拧出所有的油脂。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: Grineer Excavations
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: Grineer 的挖掘

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: Perhaps it is a by-product of the Sentient's body being scattered across the Plains. It may be that the Tower is here for this very reason. Or, perhaps, it's just chance… but the Plains are mineral- and resource-rich. So much so that the Grineer risk Ostron retaliation, the wrath of the Tenno and the rage of the Eidolon itself to mine this place.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 也许这是 Sentient 的身躯四散在平野的副产品。也许这可能是高塔坐落在这里的原因。或者，也许，只是巧合……但是平野有着丰富的矿物和资源。因此冒着被 Ostron 人报复、激怒 Tenno 和惹怒夜灵的风险，Grineer 在这里进行着采矿。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: Amps
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 增幅器

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: The Eidolon is no common beast of the Plains, and cannot be laid low with the tools of an everyday hunter. These ‘amps' focus the user's will into a killing beam, capable of eventually bringing one of these giant monstrosities down.
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 夜灵并非平野中一般的野兽，寻常猎人的工具难以使其屈服。这些"增幅器"，能将操控者的意志聚焦成致命的光束，最终得以将这种庞然大物击倒。

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text: The Quills of Cetus
/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.zhText: 希图斯的夜羽

/Lotus/Language/Fragments/EidolonFragmen.text:
