-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.zhText:
Tenno，

敌军已经取得了一些 Lotus 神器的细节信息。你的勇气和坚不可摧的意志再次被召唤来回收这些珍贵的物品，这样可以保证今年年度庆典继续进行！

-Lotus
Lotus 的馈赠 - 被窃取！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Corpus greed knows no bounds. On the anniversary of the first Tenno being called to wake, they plotted to take what was ours. But your cunning and skill halted them in their tracks.

Please, take a copy of this Dex Furis, it is my gift to you.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Corpus 的贪欲没有止尽。就在第一位 Tenno 被唤醒的纪念日上，Corpus 谋划着偷走属于我们的东西。但是你的智谋和高超技巧阻止了他们阴谋的脚步。

请收下这份 Dex 盗贼双枪的复制品，这是我送给你的礼物。

-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

The Infested were no match for your resilience and strength! You fought bravely to prevent them from consuming what is ours.

Please take this Dex Dakra as both gift and reward.

 -The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

感染者完全不是你坚韧意志和力量的对手！你勇敢地战斗，阻止了它们吞噬属于我们的东西。

请收下这对 Dex 达克拉双剑，是既是任务的奖励也是我送出的礼物。

 -Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

During this anniversary, a sacred time for all Tenno, the Grineer sought to steal from us. You thwarted their plot with honor and skill. 

This Dex Sybaris is yours. When you use it, remember that moment when my voice first called you to wake from you cryopod and restore balance in the Origin System.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

就在这个属于全体 Tenno 的神圣纪念日上，Grineer 妄图窃取我们。你用荣耀与技巧挫败了他们的图谋。

这把 Dex 席芭莉丝属于你。当你使用它时，请回想起我的声音第一次将你从冷冻舱唤醒的时刻，并时刻为了恢复始源星系的平衡而战。

-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Even against the countless hordes of the Void’s corrupted you have emerged victoriously.

Take this Dex Nouchali Syandana and wear it with pride. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Anniversary2017.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

即便是面对无数虚空堕落者的大军，你也得胜而还。

收下这件 Dex 延药睡莲披饰，并自豪地佩戴吧。

-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/AwakenedSurvey1.zhText: "……有一只手，牵着我登上「扎里曼号」。"

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/AwakenedSurvey3.text: "... they paid for what they did."

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Beginner_Growth.text:
Tenno,

You have restored valuable Orbiter Segments that will help you as your strength increases. 

There is much you might have forgotten while you were asleep. I recommend you explore the Training section of your Codex console. It contains information about your Foundry and Mods. 

Vor’s platoon attacked Cetus in their efforts to capture you. Now we must support our Ostron allies who live there. As soon as you are ready, let us take the fight to the Grineer. Should you become strong enough, you may even confront Vay Hek himself, the commander of Earth’s Grineer forces.

I am counting on you, Tenno.

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Beginner_Growth.zhText:
Tenno，

你已恢复了宝贵的轨道飞行器模块，随着你实力的提升，它会帮助你。

在沉睡的日子里，你可能忘记了很多事情。我建议你探索资料库控制台的“训练”部分。它包含着与军械库和各种 Mod 相关的信息。 

沃尔的部队为了抓捕你攻击了希图斯。现在我们必须支援居住在那里的 Ostron 同胞们。如果你准备好了，就让我们向 Grineer 发起战斗吧。如果你变得足够强大，你或许还能与地球的 Grineer 指挥官韦·海克本人一决高下。

Tenno，一切就拜托你了。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BossAladV_Invas.text:
The dogs claim victory. Do they really think I am defeated? They are nothing more than squatters on my property. Let them get comfortable. Let them be distracted by the disgusting needs of their replicated flesh. Meanwhile, my forces get ever closer to perfection. Arrogance and complacency will be their downfall.

Tenno, know that your support in this fight will ensure my eventual victory. It is only a matter of time. I have awarded you a bonus commensurate with your effort. I will not forget what you have done for me.
-Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BossAladV_Invas.zhText:
丧家犬也能自称胜利者，他们真的以为我被打败了？他们不过是我地产上的侵占者。就让他们开心去吧，让他们忙于自身复制肉体的恶心需求。而在此同时，我的部队将更趋于完美。骄傲与自满将会使他们垮台。

Tenno，你的协助将确保我在这场战争中获得最终的胜利，而这不过只是时间的问题。我已经以等值的奖励来回报你的付出，我不会忘记你为我所做的一切。
－阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BossAladV_Invas.text:
You have cut down countless Grineer. Rabid dogs that will never again threaten us, but what of the others? Take this Prova Vandal, continue your work. We have much left to accomplish.
-Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BossAladV_Invas.zhText:
你斩倒了无数名 Grineer。这群疯狗将永远无法再胁迫我们，但还有其它疯狗呢？收下这把普罗沃·破坏者，继续你的工作。眼下还有不少事情等着我们完成呢。
－阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BossAladV_Invas.text:
You have assisted me beyond measure. Please accept this Detron shotgun as a token of my appreciation.
-Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BossAladV_Invas.zhText:
你对我的助力已无法衡量，请收下这把德特昂霰弹作为我感激的象征。
－阿拉德 V
不过是战争中的一小场战役

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BountyRewardAll.text:
Congratulations, you've completed this bounty. Your contribution will help keep Alad V's horde at bay.

There are four new types of Infested and four bounties, when you complete all of them I will award you with a new target.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BountyRewardAll.zhText:
可喜可贺，你完成了悬赏目标。你的付出将使阿拉德 V 陷入困兽之斗。

四项悬赏奖励对应四种新形态的感染者，当你全数完成时我会再下达新的目标。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BountyRewardMot.zhText: 悬赏目标达成：病变虫母

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BountyRewardSwa.zhText: 悬赏目标达成：异融胞群恐鸟

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BountyRewardTar.zhText: 悬赏目标达成：异融焦油恐鸟

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BrandedMessage.text: The Grineer have attached a corruption device called the Grustrag Bolt to your Warframe. It will cripple your powers when you attempt to fight against them. However, you can remove the device by crafting the attached blueprint. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BrandedMessage.zhText: Grineer 在你的战甲上安装了一个被称为 Grustrag 枷锁的侵蚀装置。当你尝试去对抗他们的时候，它会严重削弱你的能量。然而，你可以通过锻造蓝图来摆脱这个装置。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BreedingGrounds.text:
Tenno,

Alad V has been driven back into hiding and |CLAN_NAME| played a critical role in this victory. To celebrate your heroic achievements, I present |CLAN_NAME| with this trophy. May you continue to protect the balance. 

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/BreedingGrounds.zhText:
Tenno，

阿拉德 V 被逼退隐藏 |CLAN_NAME| 在这次的胜利中起了决定性的作用。为了表扬你们的英勇事迹，我授予 |CLAN_NAME| 这个奖杯. 希望你们继续为维护平衡而努力. 

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CanadaDayJuly4t.text:
Friends, 

I'm not sure why but for some reason I feel like celebrating, and Tenno, I want you to celebrate with me. 

To get you in the mood, I'm giving away a Red, White and Blue Color Picker, deck yourself out. Next, since you can't have a party without fireworks, I'm giving you some of those too. 

Oh, and I almost forgot, due to a shipping error in my favor, I just came into an unusually large quantity of Abra Paris Skins. Take one, on me. 

Have fun, 
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CanadaDayJuly4t.zhText:
朋友们，

我不知道为什么，但是我想庆祝，Tenno，我希望你和我一起庆祝。

为了让你有庆祝的心情，我送你一个红、白、蓝色的色盘，好好打扮打扮吧。另外，聚会怎么能没有烟火呢，我再给你一些烟花。

哦，我差点忘了，因为运输问题，我手里有大量的磨蚀外观－帕里斯。带上一个，我送你，不用给钱。

玩得开心， 
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ChallengeInboxD.text: You have completed a significant Challenge, Tenno. You have earned this reward.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ChallengeInboxD.zhText: 你已经完成了一个具有重大意义的挑战，Tenno。你赢得了这个奖励。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisLot.text:
Tenno,

We must hurry. Since the time of the Orokin, the engineered forests of Earth have repelled any attempt to cut them down. Now The Grineer, lead by Councilor Vay Hek have developed something called the Cicero Toxin. With it they plan to poison Earth's forests and so they can exploit the land beneath it. We will not let this happen.

You need to find an antidote to this toxin. I believe the key ingredients lie within the very forests the Grineer want to destroy. Go to Earth and use your scanners and search out these ingredients. Then return to your Foundry to craft an anti-toxin. When you have the antidote, take it back to Earth and neutralize as much Cicero Toxin as you can.

You will need to work together to find the most effective antidote. The best formulation for the anti-toxin remains unclear.

Be careful, this is no nature walk, Vay Hek will do everything he can to stop us.

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisLot.zhText:
Tenno，

我们必须抓紧时间。从奥罗金出现之后，地球上经他们改良的树木可以抵挡所有砍伐。现在，Grineer 的头目韦·海克议员研发出了一种名为西塞罗的毒素。他们计划利用这种毒素毒害地球上的森林以挖掘地下资源。我们决不会让这种事情发生。

你必须找到对抗这种毒素的解药。我相信组成解药的关键材料位于 Grineer 想要毁灭的森林中。前往地球用你的扫描器找出这些材料。带回到铸造厂研发出解毒剂。研发完成后回到地球，尽可能地用它们中和西塞罗毒素。

你们需要团队合作找到最有效的解药。至于最有效的解毒剂配方目前还不清楚。

小心，这可不是去野外郊游，韦·海克会使用各种手段来阻止我们。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.text:
Tenno,

The efforts of |CLAN_NAME| during the Cicero Crisis went far beyond expectation. To celebrate your heroic achievements, I present |CLAN_NAME| with this trophy. May you continue to protect the balance. 

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.zhText:
Tenno，

在西塞罗危机期间，|CLAN_NAME|的努力远远超过了预期。为了表彰你们的英勇作为，我将这个奖杯授予|CLAN_NAME|。希望你们再接再厉维持秩序平衡。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.text:
It is done. Our mission has been accomplished. The Grineer have abandoned the last of Cicero Toxin, leaving the forests of central Earth relatively unscathed. You have all fought bravely and it is now time to celebrate our victory.

As recognition for your participation in this mission you have been awarded the Cicero Crisis emblem.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.zhText:
结束了。我们的任务完成了。Grineer放弃了最后的西塞罗毒素，地球中部的森林几乎未受损伤。你们在战斗中都很勇敢，现在是庆祝我们胜利的时刻。

作为参加这次任务的嘉奖，你们会被授予西塞罗徽章。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.text:
It is done. Our mission has been accomplished. The Grineer have abandoned the last of Cicero Toxin, leaving the forests of central Earth relatively unscathed. You have all fought bravely and it is now time to celebrate our victory.

As recognition for your participation in this mission you have been awarded the Cicero Crisis emblem.

Also, as a reward for your tireless effort, you will receive a collection of Toxin Mods that have been developed by researching the Cicero Toxin.

Finally, for going above and beyond the call of duty, I am bestowing upon you these Twin Vipers Wraith. Take them and continue our fight.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.zhText:
结束了。我们的任务完成了。Grineer放弃了最后的西塞罗毒素，地球中部的森林几乎未受损伤。你们在战斗中都很勇敢，现在是庆祝我们胜利的时刻。

作为参加这次任务的嘉奖，你们会被授予西塞罗奖章。

另外，作为对你们不懈努力的奖励，你们将获得一组用西塞罗毒素研发出的毒素 MOD。

最后，对于你们超出职责范围的努力，我授予你们这对幽灵双子蝰蛇。带上它们继续我们的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.text:
It is done. Our mission has been accomplished. The Grineer have abandoned the last of Cicero Toxin, leaving the forests of central Earth relatively unscathed. You have all fought bravely and it is now time to celebrate our victory.

As recognition for your participation in this mission you have been awarded the Cicero Crisis emblem.

Also, as a reward for your tireless effort, you will receive a collection of Toxin Mods that have been developed by researching the Cicero Toxin.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisRew.zhText:
结束了。我们的任务完成了。Grineer放弃了最后的西塞罗毒素，地球中部的森林几乎未受损伤。你们在战斗中都很勇敢，现在是庆祝我们胜利的时刻。

作为参加这次任务的嘉奖，你们会被授予西塞罗徽章。

另外，作为对你们不懈努力的奖励，你们将获得一组用西塞罗毒素研发出的毒素 MOD。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisVay.text:
People of the Grineer,

Earth is the jewel in our crown yet so much of it remains unexploited. Its forests have been invaded by overgrown Orokin engineered super-weeds. When we cut them down, they grow back. We build our bases, they overtake them. We have tried to work within the forests, we have tried to tame the forests, our capitulation has become weakness. 

The Cicero Toxin will break these forests and impose our will on the landscape. My scientist have pinpointed a chemical weakness that is common to ninety percent of the vegetation in the central region. Over the next several days we will exploit that weakness causing our enemy to wilt and decay. We will finally settle what is rightfully ours.

Your Greatness,
Councilor Vay Hek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CiceroCrisisVay.zhText:
Grineer的子民们，

地球是我们的掌上之珠，拥有大量未开发的地区。被奥罗金改造的超级杂草过度繁衍，侵害了地球上的树林。这些杂草被砍之后，又重新长出。我们所建的基地也被它们完全覆盖。我们尝试从树林内部下手，希望能够制服它们，但最终也只能放弃让它成了我们的软肋。

西塞罗毒素能够破坏这些树林让我们能实现控制地表的愿望。我的科学研究员准确地找到一个化学弱点，它适用于生长在中心地区百分之九十的植物。接下来的几天，我们会从弱点下手让我们的敌人枯萎腐烂。最终我们会得到我们应得的。

英明伟大的，
韦·海克议员

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
|CLAN_NAME|,

Your legend is growing. Steel Meridian recognizes your heroic efforts to protect those that cannot protect themselves, and we awarded you with a statue to memorialize this achievement.

As a further testament to your victory and unity, the members of |CLAN_NAME| have earned the right to manufacture Ignis Wraith Blueprints in your Dojo, a distinctive honor. The Ignis Wraith is a prized weapon among our ranks, but even more coveted is the means to build it. 

Use this privilege wisely, |PLAYER_NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
|CLAN_NAME|，

你的传说日渐传开。钢铁防线认可你为了保护那些不能保护自己的人做出的英勇贡献，为了纪念这个成就，我们将这座雕像奖励给你。

作为对你们胜利和团结的进一步证明，|CLAN_NAME|氏族的成员赢得了一项特殊的荣誉：在你们的道场中制造「伊格尼斯·亡魂蓝图」的权利。「伊格尼斯·亡魂」是我们的队伍中一把珍贵的武器，然而更令人羡慕的是建造它的方式。

明智地使用这项特权，|PLAYER_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Reverence Paid
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：致敬

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Steel Meridian recognizes your role in supporting |CLAN_NAME| and its coordinated efforts aiding the Kavor Defectors. Please accept this gift as a symbol of our gratitude.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

钢铁防线认可你在支持 |CLAN_NAME| 氏族及其在帮助 Kavor 叛逃者的的行动中的所付出的努力。请接受这份礼物，以此代表我们对你的感激之情。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Recognition
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：表彰

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
|CLAN_NAME|, 

You are furious warriors. You fought selflessly for the Kavor, bled with them when no one else would. 

Steel Meridian recognizes your sacrifice. The Ignis Wraith is a prized weapon among our ranks, given only to our best fighters. The members of |CLAN_NAME| have earned the right to carry it into battle and it is an honor for us to give one to each of you.

|PLAYER_NAME|, we salute you.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
|CLAN_NAME|，
 
你们是狂猛的战士。你们无私地为 Kavor 而战，在他人不愿相助时无怨流血。
 
钢铁防线认可你们的牺牲。这把伊格尼斯·亡魂是我们队伍中的一件奖励武器，只发给最优秀的斗士。|CLAN_NAME| 的成员赢得了在战场上使用它的权力，能够将它送到你们每一个手上也是我们的荣幸。
 
|PLAYER_NAME|，向你致敬。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Our Salute
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：来自我们的敬礼

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
Tenno,

The Kavor Defectors will never forget the compassion shown by |CLAN_NAME| in their support. Let this trophy stand as a reminder of your victory.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
Tenno，

Kavor 叛逃者永远不会忘记 |CLAN_NAME| 氏族在他们的支持中所表现出的怜悯。让这座奖杯成为对你胜利的提醒。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: In Tribute
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：赞赏

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
Tenno,

Time is running out, so I'll keep this quick. The Infestation has overrun a convoy of allied ships and forced the surviving crew into emergency safe rooms. They're holding on for now, but without your support, they'll die on those ships.

Before you go, you should know something; the crew is Grineer. But not just any Grineer, they're Kavor Defectors, pacifists who deserted Sargas Ruk's army when they could no longer bring themselves to kill for him. They don't want to fight anymore, not for the Grineer, and not for Steel Meridian. All they desire is a peaceful life, but that won't come easy; Sargas Ruk is hot on their trail and desperate to make an example of them.

The Kavor need evacuation, will you answer this call?

Cressa Tal
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
Tenno，

时间不多了，所以我长话短说。感染者正在盟友的护卫舰上肆虐，迫使残存的船员逃入紧急安全密室中。暂时他们还可以坚持，但是如果没有你的支援，他们会死在那些船上。

在你出发之前，有些事情你要知道：那些船员是 Grineer。但他们不是随处可见的那种 Grineer，他们是 Kavor 叛逃者，是逃离了 Sargas Ruk 军队的和平主义者，因为他们无法接受自己再为 Ruk 杀戮。他们不想再争斗，不为 Grineer，也不为钢铁防线。他们想要的不过是和平的生活，然而这将得来不易：Sargas Ruk 正紧紧地追赶，想要杀鸡儆猴。

Kavor 人需要撤离，你愿意回应这个号召吗？

Cressa Tal

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Emergency Evacuation
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：紧急撤离

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: Evacuate Kavor Defectors from their Infested ships
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 从感染者飞船上撤离 Kavor 叛逃者

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: Evacuate Kavor Defectors from their Infested ships
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 从感染者飞船上撤离 Kavor 叛逃者

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: Evacuate Kavor Defectors from their Infested ships
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 从感染者飞船上撤离 Kavor 叛逃者

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Mild Infestation
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：轻度感染

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Extreme Infestation
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：危重感染

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Aggressive Infestation
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：侵蚀感染

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
Don’t stop now Tenno. You’re fighting hard but this is not an easy battle, and there’s still so many Kavor who need to be pulled from those ships.

To aid their rescue, I have sent the Tenno clans a series blueprints. These items will help you keep the Kavor, and any other civilians alive.

Cressa Tal
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
请不要就此止步， Tenno。你已经奋力而战，但这并不是一场轻松的战斗，还有许许多多的 Kavor 人需要逃离所在的飞船。

为了协助这场救援，我已经向 Tenno 氏族送去了一系列蓝图。这些道具可以帮助你保全 Kavor 和其他平民的性命。

Cressa Tal

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: Don’t Stop
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：切勿止步

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
The survivors you pulled out of that Infested mess know that Tenno don’t usually risk your lives for Grineer, this means much to them. To strengthen your spirits in the coming battles, the Kavor have sent you this gift.

Cressa Tal
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
你从感染者混乱中营救出来的幸存者们知道， Tenno 一般不会为了 Grineer 冒生命危险，因此这对他们来说意义深远。为了巩固你迎接后续战斗的意志，Kavor 送给你这份礼物。

Cressa Tal

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: The Kavor are Rooting for You
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：Kavor 正为你支援

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text:
Tenno,

The Kavor are more than gracious for your help, they know they’d be dead without you. As a small token of their gratitude, they wanted you to have this gift.

Cressa Tal
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText:
Tenno，

Kavor 对你的帮助感激不尽，他们明白若没有你，必定凶多吉少。作为感激的小小象征，他们想把这个送给你。

Cressa Tal

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT: The Kavor Salute You
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛：Kavor 向你致敬

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: Cressa Tal
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: Cressa Tal

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.text: THE PACIFISM DEFECT
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ColonistRescueE.zhText: 和平者之叛

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ConfirmAbandonD.text: Are you sure you want to abandon this synthesis task?
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ConfirmAbandonD.zhText: 确定要放弃这项结合仪式任务吗？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusJupiterEv.text:
Tenno,

Between us we have three problems. 

Alad stole your people. He cut them to pieces, welded them into his freak Zanuka. You need to stop him before he makes more but you don't know where he is. This is your problem.

For me, Alad V is a con and an imposter. Still, if Zanuka is brought to full production he will become the richest and most powerful member of the Corpus Board. He could become Chairman. That is my problem. 

I have sent my forces to Jupiter to capture the criminal but Alad is using that damned infestation as a biological weapon. Every last ship has been overrun by those monsters. This is now your problem. Wipe those ships clean and I will reveal Alad V's location. With that information, you can make the rest of our problems go away. Deal?

-Frohd Bek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusJupiterEv.zhText:
Tenno，

你我之间的三个烦恼。

阿拉德偷走了你的人，不仅把他们大卸八块，还用他们的遗骸焊接成怪物 Zanuka。你当然想尽快阻止他，以避免更多悲剧的发生，但是你不知道他的藏身之处。这是你的烦恼。

对我来说，阿拉德 V 是个诡计多端的骗子。但不管怎么说，如果 Zanuka 被大量生产，他将会成为 Corpus 董事会里最有钱有权的董事。甚至还可能成为主席，这是我的烦恼。

我已经派我的军队到木星上抓捕罪犯，但是阿拉德正在把该死的感染者用作生化武器。我的每艘舰艇上都布满了这些怪物。我认为这是你现在该烦恼的事。清除舰艇上所有的怪物，我就告诉你阿拉德的藏身之处，有了这条信息，你我的烦恼就都没了，是不是？

-Frohd Bek

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusTauntA.text: Hmmm... An amazing specimen. The Warframe parts alone will double my quarterly results. Prepare the Autopsy-Bots!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusTauntA.zhText: 嗯……令人惊异的标本。单是战甲部分已能填满两份季度报告。快给我准备验尸机器人 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusTauntB.text: Why are you destroying profits in this way?! Its fiscally irresponsible to continue this assault!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusTauntB.zhText: 你这种做法将会切断我们的利润来源，为什么要这样？ ！继续攻击的话，将威胁到我们的财政收入！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusTauntC.text: I understand your impulse for justice but this is very bad for profit.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CorpusTauntC.zhText: 我明白你伸张正义的冲动，但这会严重影响我们的利润。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CroyticFrontCla.text:
Tenno,

More than most, the members of |CLAN_NAME| fought hard to secure the Cryotic we needed to obtain information about Archwing technology. To commemorate your efforts I am awarding |CLAN_NAME| with this trophy.

May you continue to protect the balance.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CroyticFrontCla.zhText:
Tenno，

绝大多数|CLAN_NAME|的氏族成员都一直致力于确保永冻晶矿，这是我们需要获得有关于曲翼的关键技术资讯。为纪念你们的付出，我将以这份战利品来奖励|CLAN_NAME|。

希望你能继续维护一切的平衡。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontEve.text:
Tenno,

The first shipments of cryotically frozen Oasis Jelly's are arriving now. Orders are coming from as far away as Sedna. I smell a new fad for the system's well-to-do.

Well, you lived up to your end of the bargain and I always live up to mine. Your Lotus has been sent several ancient datamasses detailing project Archwing. Developed during the old wars to fight the Sentients, the prototypes never reached full production. A shame since things might have turned out differently if they had. I'm sure your Lotus will fill you in soon. Needless to say, you have some work ahead of you.

Last but not least, now that we're on such good terms I must make a proper introduction. My name is Baro Ki'Teer a trader of rare and beautiful antiquities. Consider it a privilege, few learn my real name.

Baro Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontEve.zhText:
Tenno，

第一艘满载冷冻绿洲水母的货船已经抵达了。订单则都来自于遥远的赛德娜。我闻到了能在星系中掀起潮流的味道。

最后你完成了你的交易条件，而我也总是言而有信。你的 Lotus 已寄出多个有关于曲翼细节的数据块。曲翼在远古之战时与 Sentient 战斗的期间进行开发，但原型一直无法达到量产的水准。可惜，如果他们能做到的话，事情发展肯定会截然不同。我相信你的 Lotus 之后很快就会把详情都告诉你。不用说，你还有一堆工作等着你。

最后，但也不是很重要的是，现在情况还不错，我必须做个适当的自我介绍。我的名字是 Baro Ki'Teer，一个喜爱稀有与美妙古物的商人。你得深思一下这份特权，鲜少有人能知道我真正的名字。

Baro Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontInt.text:
I do hope you will forgive my concealed identity but dealing in these unsavory circles demands unusual discretion. 

I'm such a big fan of the Tenno, you've accomplished so much and with such rudimentary equipment. That's why I'm concerned about the coming Balor Fomorians. I think we both know your Warframes are simply not sophisticated enough to stop them. 

But I can help you... for a price.

You see, I have an appetite for the rare and extraordinary and I've recently learned of a fine substance known as Cryotic. If you are willing, I will supply the necessary equipment and coordinates for its extraction. We can even split the spoils, I only require half of all cryotic you acquire. In return, I will enlighten you with what I know about technology that could defeat this Balor threat. 
I must say, some of you display the inklings of good taste, if our partnership is a success perhaps we will get to know each other better.

Regards,
Your New Associate
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontInt.zhText:
我希望你们能原谅我隐瞒身份，但是跟这些令人厌恶的圈子打交道需要格外谨慎。

Tenno 我很崇拜你们，你们竟然用这么简陋的武器取得了这么多胜利。这也是为什么我担心即将到来的巴罗尔巨人战舰。我想咱们都清楚要阻挡他们，你们的战甲根本不够尖端。

我可以帮助你们…但是有个条件。

你们看，我对珍稀物品很有兴趣，我最近了解到一种叫永冻晶矿的精美物质。如果你们愿意的话，我可以提供提取这种物质的必要器具和坐标。作为回报，我可以把我所知道的如何击退巴罗尔威胁的相关技术告诉你们。为了让这个交易更诱人，我甚至愿意给你们当中那些表现卓越的额外奖金。
我必须说，你们当中有些人已经展现出不错的品位。如果咱们合作成功，也许我们可以对彼此有更多了解。

问好，
你们的新伙伴

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontNod.text:
Tenno,

The first shipments of cryotically frozen Oasis Jelly's are arriving now. Orders are coming from as far away as Sedna. I smell a new fad for the system's well-to-do.

Well, you lived up to your end of the bargain and I always live up to mine. Your Lotus has been sent several ancient datamasses detailing project Archwing. Developed during the old wars to fight the Sentients, the prototypes never reached full production. A shame since things might have turned out differently if they had. I'm sure your Lotus will fill you in soon. Needless to say, you have some work ahead of you.

Now that we are on such good terms I must make a proper introduction. My name is Baro Ki'Teer, a trader of rare and beautiful antiquities. Consider it a privilege. Those that still know my true name are few and far between. 

Baro Ki'Teer
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontNod.zhText:
Tenno，

第一批满载冷冻绿洲水母的货船已经抵达了。遥远的订单甚至远到赛德娜。我闻到了能在星系中掀起潮流的味道。

既然，你完成了你的交易条件，而我也总是言而有信。你的 Lotus 已寄出多个有关于曲翼细节的数据块。曲翼在远古之战时与 Sentient 战斗的期间进行开发，但原型一直无法达到量产的水准。可惜，如果他们能做到的话，事情发展可能会截然不同。我相信你的 Lotus 之后很快一定会把详情都告诉你。不用说，还有一堆工作等着你。

现在情况还不错，我必须做个适当的自我介绍。我的名字是 Baro Ki'Teer，一个喜爱稀有与美妙古物的商人。把这当作为一份特权。因为能知道我真正名字的人真是少之又少。

Baro Ki'Teer

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontNod.text:
Tenno,

A new dig site has been revealed on Europa. Come prepared for cold. 

As for our ‘New Associate', I am still suspicious of this individual's motivations but my intel points to their offer being legitimate. As such we should continue our campaign.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontNod.zhText:
Tenno，

新的挖掘地点已发现在欧罗巴上。前往并准备好面对寒冷。

至于我们的 ‘新伙伴'，我仍然怀疑此人的动机，但我的情报指出他们的提议是合理的。因此我们应该继续我们的作战。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontRew.text:
Tenno, have you ever tasted the Martian Oasis Jellyfish? 

Silly me, I doubt you've had the rare pleasure of feeling their delicious barbs gently electrify your palate. I suppose you're also blissfully ignorant of how easily the creature spoils during transportation. A dreadful dilemma! Should those with the means to sample this delicacy suffer the indignity of a trip to Mars? I say no. That's why your cryotic is so important. Cryotic can instantly freeze the little darlings, inducing stasis and preserving their subtle flavorings for enjoyment anywhere in the system. Tenno, I hope you see now how important this work is.

And don't think I haven't noticed how diligent you've been. I've decided to recognize your efforts with a token of appreciation. I do hope my gift brings some semblance of joy, you seem altogether too serious.

Now, if there was only a way to convince the little Jelly's to breed more, they seem to be harder and harder to catch these days.

With Gratitude and Thanks,
Your New Associate
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontRew.zhText:
Tenno，你有没有尝过火星绿洲水母的滋味？

啊，我真傻，我怀疑你能否体会到美味倒钩住你味蕾的感觉。我想你这算是幸运的无知，这些生物在运输过程中极容易腐败。可怕的困境！这些美味佳肴应该在火星之旅运输时受到这般污辱吗？我会说不。这就是为什么你的永冻晶矿是如此重要。永冻晶矿可以瞬间冻住这些小宝贝，造成冷冻并保留其微妙的香味，让人在星系中的任何角落都能享用。Tenno，我希望你能了解这份工作有多种重要。

别以为我没注意到你有多勤奋。我已经决定以一份感激的象征来认可你的努力。我希望这份礼物能带来些欢乐的假象，总之你看起来有点太严肃了。

现在，如果有种方法能说服这些小水母多生一点就好了，它们要撑过这几天看来似乎是越来越困难了。

伴随着感激与感谢，
你们的新伙伴

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontRew.text:
This new supply of cryotic is a great start to my venture. I encourage you to keep excavating.

Here, take this emblem and display it proudly. I do believe it will become the fashion statement of the solar cycle once my project is complete.

In the meantime, I've transmitted the co-ordinates of a potentially more lucrative excavation site located in Phobos to you. You seem to have the hang of things now, perhaps you'll fare better there.

Regards,
Your New Associate
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontRew.zhText:
这一轮永冻晶矿的新补给对我的风险事业来说是一个很好的开始。我鼓励你继续挖掘下去。

来，拿上这徽章并骄傲地展示它。我相信当我的计划完成时，它定会成为太阳系圈的时尚象征。

与此同时，我向你发送了一个位于火卫一的更有潜在价值的挖掘地点的坐标。看起来你已经掌握了技巧，也许你在那会进展得更好。

问好，
你们的新伙伴

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontRew.text:
Congratulations, you've just reach a new personal milestone in cryotic excavation but I can't help but thinking, ‘Tenno, you can do better'. To help, I am donating these old Ice Mods I have lying around. Perhaps with them you can achieve even greater extraction efficiency?

Speaking of ice, my latest intel shows the presence of some remarkable cryotic deposits located in Europa. I've sent the co-ordinates your way. It may be a little chilly there -- and the locals probably won't be welcoming you with open arms -- but this will certainly be the most rewarding site... All in a day's work, right Tenno?

Keenly Awaiting Improved Performance,
Your New Associate
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/CryoticFrontRew.zhText:
恭喜，你在挖掘永冻晶矿上已经到达了一个新的个人里程碑，但我不住地想，"Tenno，你可以做得更好"。为了协助你们，我赠与你这些我随处放置的老旧的冰属性 MOD。或许有了它们，你甚至能够达到一个更高的挖掘效率？

说到冰，我的最新情报显示了一些位于引人注目的永冻晶矿矿床存在于欧罗巴。我已经把坐标送到你那了。那里可能会有些冷——并且当地人可能不会张开双臂欢迎你——但这无疑是最有价值的挖矿地点了… 这对你来说不算什么，对吧 Tenno？

热衷地等待着你更好的表现，
你们的新伙伴

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DailySimarisTas.text: I have decided to expand your role.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DailySimarisTas.zhText: 我已决定扩大自己所扮演的角色。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoDealNyxNem.text: Tenno, you ever drink Ganymede Geyser Water? One of my suppliers brought a case to the store yesterday. "Have a sip," he says, "we'll look over my items," he says. Next thing I remember, I wake up with a headache surrounded by crates and crates of something called the NYX NEMESIS SKIN? Well, I hope this item is of interest to you Tenno, because I bought a lot of it. You check the market for a Darvo Deal. I'm going back to bed.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoDealNyxNem.zhText: Tenno，你有没有尝过木卫三的间歇泉水？昨天我的一位供货商带了这种水到店里。"尝一口吧，" 他说道，"然后我们再来看看我的商品……"。 接下来我记得的事情，就是我头痛得醒了过来，旁边有一堆箱子，而且箱子上写着什么 NYX 复仇者外观？嗯，我希望你对这商品有兴趣，Tenno。 因为我已经买了不少。你去商店看看 Darvo 特惠吧。 我要回床上睡了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.text:
Friends!

You did it, you got that freak off my back. Well, some of you did and some of you didn't quite make it, but I won't hold that against any of you. What matters is I can now come out of hiding and that means more deals for everyone.

To celebrate this occasion I have put together the Super Charge Pack. It is everything you need to take your Warframe to the next level, including boosters, an Orokin Reactor and Catalyst, Forma and even extra Warframe and weapon slots. Because there is no longer a price on my head you all get half price on this deal. That's right 50% off this amazing pack.

I'm not done yet either, keep an eye out for more deals over the next couple of days.

-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.zhText:
朋友们！

你们做到了，你们帮我把那个怪胎解决了。嗯，你们中间有些人做到了，有些人没太做到，不过我不会怪你们。重要的是，我现在不用躲躲藏藏，这代表每个人有更多优惠。

为了庆祝这次的胜利，我准备了超级充电组合包。这里包含了强化战甲要用到的所有东西，包括一个反应堆，一个催化剂还有一个 Forma。我实在是太开心了，因为我不用把脑袋系在裤腰带上了，所以我决定把价格砍掉一半。没错，这么好的精品包现在只要半价。

这还不算完，这几天多留意还有更多优惠好礼。

-Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.text:
My friends,

I have a small favor to ask of you. No, no, favor is the wrong word. You don't get paid for favors but for this I can pay you. Not in advance of course, but when you are done there will be plenty to go around. Hell, once this is done, I'll be able to offer you my deals again. 

Let me get to the point. There's a ship. A ship I own but am not in currently in possession of. All you need to do is sneak onto this ship and take care of a something for me. Nothing major, I know you can handle the work. I'll explain when you're on board. 

What do you say, will you help your old friend Darvo out?

Oh and by the way, I'd appreciate it if you keep this between you and me. There is no reason for the Lotus to know about this little arrangement.

-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.zhText:
我的朋友们，

我想请你帮个小忙。不，不，帮忙这个说法不对。帮忙是不收钱的但是这个忙我会付你钱。当然不是提前给钱，你做完这件事的时候我会给你很多。该死的，一旦这事结束，我就可以再提供我的交易了。

言归正传，有一艘飞船。这个飞船是我的但是还没到手。你要做的就是悄悄登上飞船帮我处理点事。不是什么大事，我知道你肯定能做到。等你上了飞船我会告诉你要到底要做什么。

怎么样，你会帮帮你的老朋友 Darvo 吗？

噢，另外，如果你不把这事说出去我会很感激你。这种小事没必要让 Lotus 知道。

-Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.text:
Friends,

I am hearing a very troubling rumor. Apparently, some of you feel that I took advantage of the Tenno. That I should have warned you I was luring a very dangerous assassin to your location so that you could kill him for me. But friends, had I warned you, you may not have helped and where would that leave me? You want me back in business don't you?

Look, let me make it up to you. Courtesy of your hard work I have a very special bundle for you. A Nekros Warframe, the Carrier Sentinel, a Soma rifle and the ever deadly Ether Reaper. All at half the usual market prices. Come on Tenno, tell me a deal like that isn't worth a little risk?

-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.zhText:
朋友们，

我听到一个令人不安的谣言。很显然，你们中的有些人觉得我利用了 Tenno。也许我一开始就该告诉你们，我只是先把一个危险的刺客引到你们身边，这样你们好帮我消灭他。但是朋友们，请你们替我想想，如果我当初这样跟你们说，你们可能就不帮我了，那我可怎么办？你们也想让我重新开张，不是吗？

来，让我来补偿你们。为了回报你们的帮助我为你们准备了这个很特别的组合包。里面有一个 Nekros 战甲，一个 搬运者守护，一把月神步枪和致命的苍穹死神。全部以市场价的一半出售。快来吧，Tenno，像这样的优惠，难道还不值得冒点风险吗？

-Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.text: Let me make it up to you

Tenno,

I have one more deal for you. What do you think of a pack containing the Dread bow, Despair throwing blades and a Hate scythe? The Tenno who helped me out will know firsthand just how destructive these weapons can be. Last time I offered this pack I got myself into a little bit of hot water. Now, thanks to your efforts, the pressure is off and this time I can offer this deal at half price.

As for me, I am running out of stock but I have a hot tip on some new product. Don't worry though Tenno, I have learned my lesson. Everything will be above board from now on. Trust me.

So long for now,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoThanksgivi.zhText:
Tenno，

我还有一个优惠是专门给你的。你觉得一个有恐惧弓、绝望投掷刀刃和憎恨镰刀的礼包怎么样？那些帮助我的 Tenno 亲身体会过这些武器的破坏性有多大。上次我提供这些礼包的时候，给自己惹上一点小麻烦。这次，多亏了你们的帮助，才让我摆脱了困境。所以我决定半价出售这些礼包。

现在呢，我手头上的存货虽然所剩不多，但是我可以偷偷告诉你我还有一些新货。别担心 Tenno，我吸取教训了。从现在开始我不骗人了。相信我。

我先撤了，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoTotallyLeg.text:
Friends,

Smell that? That's the final shipment of unsold merchandise going up in flames. Let's see the Grineer try to pin this on me now. Maybe, if they put the same effort into securing their shipments as they do into chasing legitimate merchants halfway around the system, they wouldn't have this problem.

Me, I think I might have inhaled one too many flaming Grakatas, so I'm going to go lie down for a bit.

Pleasure doing business with you Tenno,

-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoTotallyLeg.zhText:
朋友们，
 
闻到没？那是最后一批滞销货物着火的味道。我们瞧瞧这次 Grineer 还怎么归罪于我。也许，于其跨半个星系千里追杀合法商人，他们应该花同样的精力去保护货物，那样问题原本就不会发生。
 
我，我觉得我可能吸入了太多着火的葛拉卡达，所以我要躺下休息一会儿了。
 
很高兴和你们做生意，Tenno。
 
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoTotallyLeg.text:
Friends,

I've gone and done it again, this time, I've pissed-off the Grineer with another awesome deal. Why do they hate my deals so much? Is it because they were born in a tube? Probably. But it could also be that they think I've stolen their stuff.

That means I've got to get rid of everything, fast. Each day I'll have a new deal, and anything you don't buy, I'm burning to an unrecognizable crisp. It's a fire sale! 

Darvo's Fire Sale: Buy it, or I burn it.

Your pal,
-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvoTotallyLeg.zhText:
朋友们，
 
我又做了件傻事，这次，我超赞的生意把 Grineer 惹毛了。为什么他们要如此痛恨我的生意呢？是不是因为他们从试管里出生？也许吧，不过也有可能是因为觉得我偷了他们的东西。
 
那意味着我必须把所有东西赶紧甩卖掉。每天我都会推出一个新的优惠，凡是你们没有买走的，我必须将其付之一炬。这会是一次火爆的折扣！
 
Darvo 的火爆折扣：赶紧购买，不然我就点火啦！
 
你们的老伙计，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvosTotallyLe.text:
Friends, 

I've done it again, I've ticked off the entire Corpus board with my amazing deals. They're so upset they make up lies, like, "Darvo's merchandise is our merchandise!" 

To which I say, "You can't prove anything."

So, to ensure they can't prove anything, I'm having a liquidation sale. Everyday a new deal. It all has to go. Act quick because any stock that's left when the Corpus troops come knocking is getting dumped into space. Got it? Good.

Darvo's Totally Legit sale: You pick the best, I'm flushing the rest.

Happy Shopping, 
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DarvosTotallyLe.zhText:
朋友们，

我又惹上事了，我提供的惊人折扣把整个 Corpus 董事会都激怒了。他们愤愤不平，以至于编造各种谎言抹黑我，说什么"Darvo 的商品是偷我们的！"

对此我只有一句话的回应："你们没有证据呀。"

因此为了确保他们不会抓住我的把柄，我要进行一次清仓大甩卖。每天都会有新的折扣，而且必须统统卖完。赶紧行动，要不然当 Corpus 士兵敲开我的门时，剩下的货都会被扔进太空里了。懂我的意思了？很好。

Darvo 的"完全合法"特卖即将到来：你挑走最好的，我处理剩下的。

祝购物愉快，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DenOfKubrow_Wee.text:
Tenno, 

Our spies report that a huge cache of Strun Wraith shotguns has been uncovered on Earth. The Grineer have tried to seize the guns but were pushed back by a vicious colony of feral kubrow.

Go to Earth and secure the weapons before the Grineer can return with a larger force. 

Resistance from the colony will be fierce, so I have sent you a Kubrow Starter Kit. Nurture this creature, as a Tenno can always use a companion to watch their back. 

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DenOfKubrow_Wee.zhText:
Tenno，

我方间谍回报指出，地球上侦查到大量的斯特朗·亡魂霰弹枪库存。Grineer 原意图占有这批军火，却被一个兇恶的野生库狛群落所击退。

在 Grineer 重新整备，以更强大的武力重返前抢先前往地球，确保这些枪械安然无恙。

库狛群的抵抗将会非常激烈，因此我配送了一组库狛入门包给你。培育这只生物吧，身为 Tenno，历以来都能善用同伴掩护自己。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DenOfKubrow_Wee.text:
Tenno, 

During your conflict with feral kubrow on Earth, I was able to extract a unique genetic mutation from the wild beasts. I have sent you a sample of this genetic code so that you may imbue your own kubrow with the new pattern. 

Also, to aid in maturing your companion, I have enabled global Resources, Affinity and Drop Chances at double the rate for all Tenno. Make use of this gift while it lasts.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DenOfKubrow_Wee.zhText:
Tenno，

正当你与野生库狛在地球交战之际，我已成功地从这些野兽中提取出独特的突变基因。我寄送了一份基因代码的样本给你，如此一来你便可以将自己的库狛注入新的花纹。

此外，为了协助你的同伴成长，我已经对全体 Tenno 启用了全域型的资源，经验与战利品掉落几率双倍加成。在有限时间内善用这份赠礼吧。

- Lotus
库狛的巢穴: 后续发展

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DexDakraWeaponM.text:
Tenno,

It has been nearly two Earth cycles since I woke you. Since that time, the Tenno have grown in number and once more become a formidable presence in our System. Your perseverance and dedication to our cause has not gone unrecognized.

You bring honor to us all through your efforts,

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DexDakraWeaponM.zhText:
Tenno，

自我唤醒你以来已经过了近两个地球周期的时间了。从那一刻开始，Tenno 的数量便持续增长，并在我们的星系中再次成为了强大的存在。你坚忍不拔的意志和为了我们目标的牺牲奉献的精神从未被忽视。

你所做的一切努力成果皆荣耀了我们。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DexDakraWeaponT.zhText: 我们已经一同走了这么远

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DexFurisWeaponM.text:
Tenno,

It has been one Earth cycle since I called the first Tenno to wake from cryostasis. Since that day countless more have joined our fold. In that time much has changed. As our enemies grew stronger you mastered new Warframes. When they plotted for power, you toppled tyrants. When they hunted us, you showed them what it meant to challenge the Tenno.

To honor your performance I am awarding you.

Your guide,
The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/DexFurisWeaponM.zhText:
Tenno，

自从我把第一位 Tenno 从低温催眠中唤醒，到现在已经过了一个地球周期。从那天起，不计其数的同伴加入到我们当中。那段时间发生了太多变化。由于我们的敌人越来越强，你驾驭了更多的新战甲。当他们密谋专制时，你推翻暴君。当他们追捕我们时，你让他们看到了挑战 Tenno 的下场。

为了表彰你的表现，现在我将奖励你。

你的引导者，
Lotus
我们已经走过漫漫长路

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Diorama1Body.text:
After centuries of sleep you are awake. Your Warframe armor is weak. Your skills all but forgotten.

A Grineer General, Vor, stands over you...
"You are mine, Tenno!"
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Diorama1Body.zhText:
经过数百年的睡眠，你醒了。你的战甲装甲薄弱，你几乎忘记了你的技能。

一位 Grineer 将军，沃尔，站在你前面……
"你是我的，Tenno！"

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodex.text:
My bags are packed, I'm all set to leave. I can't believe I'll be working with one of my childhood heroes, Archimedean Margulis! On comms she said she needed the best Infestation biologist there was… I think my knees almost gave out!

As I log this, I'm looking out the stained plastic of my field tent into the dead-yellow sky of Earth. I smell the vague sulphur and toxins leaking through the seals, yet somehow I'm going to miss this place. Leaving her feels like I'm giving up on my dream. My dream to see green and blue return to this sick and dying mother of us all.

But I'm frustrated with my lack of progress. I've tried everything to accelerate the ailing vegetation, to guide and nurture the soil, but nothing comes of it. I need a change. Now I have that opportunity… and thanks to Margulis, I'm relieved I won't be drafted into some Orokin War Project.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodex.zhText:
我的包都收拾好了，正准备离开。我简直不能相信我要会与我童年的英雄一起合作，哲士 Margulis！在通讯中，她说她需要最好的感染生物学家是……我觉得我的腿都快软了！

当我记录这些时，正透过那脏脏的帐篷向外看着，地球那死黄色的天空。我隐约闻到硫磺和毒素通过密封钻进帐篷，但不知何故，我会怀念这个地方。离开她就像是我要放弃我的梦想。我梦想看到蓝天与绿地返回我们这殃殃垂死的地球母亲。

但是，我因没有进展而沮丧。我已竭尽所能来促进日渐衰败的植物的生长，引导和滋养土壤，但是没有什么成效。我需要改变。现在我有这个机会……多亏了 Margulis，我安心了，我不会被征入什么奥罗金的战争项目中去。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodex.text:
My childhood dream has become a nightmare. I don't blame Margulis, she's as much a victim as the children we're working with. At first, the project seemed therapeutic and nurturing. I was myself. But now… Transference therapy is being turned into a weapon. Now I build these vile weapons called "Warframes" all for one purpose: death. I've become everything I hate.

I long for the discomfort of my damp tent. The sick, aimless trees… the barren soil… I know I left my soul behind back there. 

Titania is the next Warframe I've been commanded to build, but in secret I've been siphoning resources from the project. I have an idea. A way back to that wounded land I call home. A way for me to forget this war and remember what I was.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodex.zhText:
我童年的梦想已经变成噩梦。我不怪 Margulis， 她和那些和我们一起工作的的孩子一样是受害者。起初，项目似乎是有疗效的，我还是我自己。但是现在……传识疗法正在变成一种武器。现在，我正在铸造这些被称为"战甲"的卑鄙武器，一切都为了一个目的：屠戮。我已经变成我讨厌的一切。

我想念我那令人难受的潮湿帐篷。那腐朽，漫无方向的树木……贫瘠的土壤……我知道我把我的灵魂留在了那里。

Titania 是下一个我被命令去建造的战甲，但是我一直在私下从这个项目抽取资源。我有个主意。一种让我可以回到那片，我称之为家的，受伤的土地的方法。一种让我可以忘记这场战争，回想起我过去是什么的样子方法。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodex.text:
Ballas is beyond pleased… but when I look at what I've built… at Titania, I feel sick creep up my throat. I hate her, a killer made by a healer. No more. I'm going back to where I belong, no matter the cost. I'm going back to the trees to find myself again.

These past weeks, I've been secretly testing Transference on myself. I can only survive short bursts - linking to Titania the way only Tenno can stand. I've never felt anything like it. A tortured presence, like an evil ink, staining my mind. But… it worked. I'm going to use this wrong to make right.

I'll stowaway with Earth-bound cargo. Just my Apothics and these slapdash Somatics I've stolen. By nightfall I'll be home again in my tent under those bitter, acid skies. This time I'm going to fix it. I will seed a mighty forest, stronger than history… and by my will, use it to bring life.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FairyQuestCodex.zhText:
Ballas 喜出望外……但是当我看到我建造的 Titania 时……我心中作呕直至咽喉。我厌恶她，一位治疗者建造的杀手。到此为止了。我要回到我归属的地方，不管付出什么代价。我要回到树林中重新寻找自我。

过去几周，我一直偷偷地在我自己身上测试传识。我只能承受短时间的冲击——用只有 Tenno 可以忍受的方式连接到 Titania。我从未有过这样的感受。备受折磨的存在着，就像是一种邪恶的墨水正在玷污我的思想。但是……它起作用了。我要用这种错误的方式来把事情扳正。

我将通过开往地球的货船偷渡。随身只带着我的药剂和偷来的简陋活体连接器。待傍晚时我就能回到家中、再次回到那在酸苦天空下的帐篷里。这一次，我要修复它。我会种一片大森林，比以往都强悍……并按照我的意愿，用它带来生命。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfitEven.text:
|CLAN_NAME|

Nef Anyo's Bursas army is a shadow of what it could have been. |CLAN_NAME|'s efforts were no small part of this victory. Take this trophy, you earned it.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfitEven.zhText:
|CLAN_NAME|

奈富·安尤的金流恐鸟军队可能会是个隐忧。本次胜方 |CLAN_NAME| 的付出有着举足轻重的地位，收下这座奖杯吧，这是你应得的。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Any.text: Show the void you trust its might will, purchase a Void Offering today.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Any.zhText: 相信虚空之力，也许就能得到救赎，今天就买下虚空捐献吧。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Lot.text:
Tenno,

Nef Anyo has made a fortune bilking the system's gullible, but he is more than a simple con man, he's using his wealth to bankroll a new line of assault robots called the Bursa. You must stop him before the Bursa becomes a threat to us all.

Your mission is to bankrupt Nef Anyo.

Use one of Nef's own Void Offerings to draw the Bursa out for collection. They will not take an Offering from a Tenno, instead stun them and force the transaction by hacking into their mobile banking systems. Timing is everything, the Bursa must be destroyed during the critical ‘verifying' stage. Botch the timing and you will lose your Offering. Do this correctly and you will walk away with your Offering and a healthy chunk of Nef Anyo's credits too.

Bursas have been deployed in Corpus-occupied regions of Pluto, Neptune, and Europa, with reports of sporadic appearances in Jupiter, Mars, and Venus. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Lot.zhText:
Tenno，

奈富·安尤在星系中从一些毫无戒心的人身上骗取了大笔财富，但他不仅是个单纯的骗子，他还运用他的财富为制造名为「金流恐鸟」的新突击机器提供资金。你必须在金流恐鸟成为我们的威胁之前阻止他。

你的任务就是让奈富·安尤破产。

用奈富的虚空捐献之一吸引收集捐献的金流恐鸟。击晕它并通过入侵它们的移动银行系统强制执行交易，这样它们就不会从 Tenno 身上取走虚空捐献。勿失良机，必须在关键的「验证阶段」摧毁掉金流恐鸟。若操作失误则会失去你的虚空捐献。成功消灭金流恐鸟，你就能带着你的虚空捐献和奈富·安尤的一笔数目客观的现金安然离去。

金流恐鸟已经被部署在 Corpus占领的冥王星，海王星和欧罗巴，也有报告显示它们分散出现在木星，火星和金星。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

You have taken out a Bursa and made the first strike against Nef Anyo's finances. Take this emblem and wear it to show your dedication to the cause. 

Fight on.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你已经摧毁了一个 Bursa 也对奈富·安尤的财政进行了第一次打击。拿着这个徽章，戴上它以展示你对这个行动的贡献。

继续战斗。

- Lotus
变造利益行动: 徽章

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Nef Anyo has still not caught on to our scheme. Take these mods and keep fighting. We must bankrupt Anyo before he becomes an even greater threat.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

奈富·安尤还没理解我们的计划。拿上这些继续战斗。我们必须在安尤成为更大的威胁之前让他破产。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.text: Operation False Profit: Mods for Your Fight
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.zhText: 变造利益行动：作战用的 MOD 奖励

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

Nef Anyo's bank account is deflating rapidly and Tenno like you are the reason. 

You have been in this fight for the long haul. To celebrate your dedication I am giving you a weapon to continue your fight with. Wield it with pride Tenno.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

奈富·安尤的银行账户正在迅速紧缩，这正是像你这样的 Tenno 共同奋战的结果。

你在这次行动中长期奋战。为了表彰你一直以来的贡献，我奖励你这把武器。在今后的战斗中带着骄傲使用它 Tenno。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.text: Operation False Profit: A Celebration of Your Dedication
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Rew.zhText: 变造利益行动: 表彰你的贡献

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Too.text: Draw out and hack Bursas to bankrupt Nef Anyo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FalseProfit_Too.zhText: 吸引并入侵 Bursa 让奈富·安尤破产

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FebDarvoDealBOG.text:
Friends,

My competition hates my half-priced deals so much, they've threatened to slap me with an injunction! And by injunction I mean severe bodily harm. So, until further notice, my half-priced deals are cancelled.

Meanwhile, in totally unrelated news, I'm happy to announce "Darvo's Two-for-One Mod Packs!" For a limited time, grab any Mod Pack and receive a second Mod Pack for free! This deal is that crazy.

You see what happens when they try to stop a master merchant? Better deals for everyone.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FebDarvoDealBOG.zhText:
朋友们，

我的生意对手对我的半价特惠已有不少怨言，他们开始以禁止令来威胁我！这边的禁止令是指严重的人身伤害。所以，在我下次知会你们以前，我的半价特惠得暂告一段落啦。

另外，我还有个完全不相关的消息，在此我高兴地宣布"Darvo 的 Mod 包买一送一！" 在限定时间内购买一个 Mod 包，你将会免费获得一个 Mod 包，这个优惠就这么疯狂！

你知道当他们阻止生意高手时会发生什么了吧？我会把更超值的优惠提供给大家。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.text:
Vay Hek is making his move. We have just detected a Balor Fomorian traveling on an interception course with a Relay. The beast moves slowly but if we allow it to get within firing range, it will surely obliterate our new relay. We need to destroy it before that happens.

Intelligence reports state that the Balor Fomorian's power core emits a thick energy field composed of deadly omega radiation. In order to break through the field you will need to craft this Fomorian Disruptor. It will allow you to safely approach the core and when activated it will temporarily disrupt the core allowing you to inflict damage.

Take note Tenno, the Disruptor is forged using Omega Isotopes. These are a by-product of a Fomorian's core and only appear on planets when a Fomorian nears.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.zhText:
韦·海克有所动作了。就在刚才我们侦测到一艘巴罗尔巨人战舰航行在截击中继站的航道上。虽然这头野兽移动的十分缓慢，但如果让他们进入射程范围，他们一定会消灭我方的新中继站。我们必须在这一切发生前摧毁他们。

情报指出巴罗尔巨人战舰的能量核心会发出一道由致命的奥米伽辐射所构成的强大能量力场。为了破坏这道力场并通过它，你需要制造这枚巨人战舰干扰器，它可以让你安全的接近核心，并在启动时短暂瘫痪核心的运作，以便使你对敌人造成伤害。

Tenno，要注意的是，干扰器是由短周期的奥米伽同位素所锻造的，这些同位素是打造巨人战舰时产生的附属品，所以它们只会出现在巨人战舰所在星球的邻近地区。

Lotus
全员出动: 迎战巨人战舰

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.text:
Tenno,

The members of your clan fought hard to drive back Vay Hek's Fomorian assault. To commemorate your efforts I am awarding |CLAN_NAME| with this trophy.

May you continue to protect the balance.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.zhText:
Tenno，

你的氏族成员努力奋战击退了韦·海克的巨人舰突袭。为了纪念你们的努力，我把这个奖杯奖励给|CLAN_NAME|。

愿你们继续维护平衡。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.text:
Tenno,

The Fomorians are not invincible, this is proof. Savor this victory for today knowing that we must always be prepared for tomorrow.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.zhText:
Tenno，

巨人战舰并不是无敌的，这就是证据。今天赢得的这场胜利，让我们知道永远都需要为明天做好准备。

－Lotus
毁灭之眼: |HUB_NAME| 目前安全了

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.text:
Tenno,

You stared a Balor in the eye and made it blink. You flew into the belly of the beast and struck where it hurts. You have done your part, but I urge you to not rest. Instead, take this reward and use it to finish this fight.

The Lotus

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.zhText:
Tenno，

你无畏直视着巴罗尔的眼睛，使它畏惧眨眼。你也窜入了这头野兽的体内并给予它迎头一击。你完成你的工作了，但我极力建议你不要停下脚步。相反的，收下这些奖励并善用它，了结这场战斗。

Lotus

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.text: Eyes of Blight: This Fight Isn’t Over
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomorianRevenge.zhText: 毁灭之眼: 这场战斗尚未止息

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomoroianReveng.text:
Councilor Vay Hek, 

Your Fomorian assault on the Tenno has been an abject failure. You have exhausted our entire Balor fleet and yet the Tenno still raid our ships and still gather in their relays. Are you even aware of the resources you have squandered? Do you understand how much Oxium goes into a single Fomorian? We put great faith in your abilities Councilor but we now see that faith was misplaced. 

Perhaps Tyl Regor will prove a more competent replacement.

We await your penance.

Your Queens
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FomoroianReveng.zhText:
韦·海克议员，

你的巨人战舰攻击行动对 Tenno 最终以悲惨失败坐收。你已经完全耗尽了我们的巴罗尔舰队，不只如此，Tenno 仍在袭击我们的船舰并在他们的中继站继续集结。你到底有没有搞清楚你浪费掉多少资源？你知道一艘巨人战舰要花掉多少奥席金属吗？我们十足信任你的能力，议员，但现在看来这份信任根本寄託错人了。

或许泰尔·雷工会提供更为合适的接替人选。

我们等着你来赎罪。

你的女皇
毀灭之眼: 拦截到的信息

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FormaGiftMessag.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

You have fought long and hard for our cause - learning to master many Warframes and Weapons in your Arsenal. Take this gift of Forma as a token of my appreciation for your willingness to bend the will of your equipment to suit your needs on the battlefield. 

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FormaGiftMessag.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你努力学习如何熟练军械库中众多战甲与武器，为了我们的基业辛苦奋战良久，请收下 Forma 作为礼物，以表达我对你愿意致力穿上战场所需装备的意志的感谢之情。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FourthAnniversa.text:
Tenno,

For four Earth cycles you have been awake! This year you proved yourselves even more valiant by protecting our precious Dex items. To commemorate this momentous occasion and celebrate your heroic efforts, I’ve commissioned this Dex Nouchalis Syandana.

Wear it with pride, Tenno.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FourthAnniversa.zhText:
Tenno，

自从你醒来，已经过了四个地球周期！今年，你通过保护珍贵的 Dex 物品愈加证明了你的勇敢。为了纪念这个重要的时刻，并表扬你的英勇作为，我定制了这件 Dex 延药睡莲披饰。

自豪地穿戴它吧，Tenno。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Free_Master_Sig.text: Enjoy your free 'Mastery' Sigil: A Sigil that dynamically changes icon based on Mastery rank!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Free_Master_Sig.zhText: 好好享用您的免费"精通段位"纹章；这是一枚会随时根据段位阶级而改变图样的纹章！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FreedomRewardsI.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Congratulations on attaining two Mastery Ranks! In honor of your performance, you've been rewarded with 100 Platinum. Use this gift to further our cause.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/FreedomRewardsI.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

恭喜你获得二段精通段位！出于对你的表现的敬意，我们已经授予你100白金的奖励。用这个礼物来促进我们使命的完成吧。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GasCityParticip.text:
You have lived up to your end of the bargain, now I will live up to mine. Themisto, that is where you will find Alad V. Cowering behind his pet, doing unspeakable things to you and yours.Do me a favor, don't go easy on him. He hasn't earned your pity.

Our arrangement has been fruitful Tenno. Take this gift as a symbol of my appreciation. Maybe we can scratch each other's backs again someday.

-Frohd Bek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GasCityParticip.zhText:
你遵守了你的诺言，那我也兑现我的承诺。Themisto，就是阿拉德 V的藏身之处。他躲在自己宠物的身后，对你和你的人做着不可告人的勾当。帮我个忙，千万不能轻易放过他。他做的事换不得你的半点同情。

我们的合作卓有成效啊，Tenno。就把这个情报当作我对你的感激吧。说不定今后我们还机会互相帮助。

-Frohd Bek

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GenericEventRew.text:
You went above the call of duty today, Tenno. The skill you displayed will inspire your fellow warriors. 

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GenericEventRew.zhText:
你今天超额完成了任务，Tenno。你所展现出来的技巧将鼓舞你的战士同伴们。

- Lotus
和平者之叛：奖励已送达

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GenericGiftDesc.text:
Attention Tenno,

Our scouts have just returned, and brought troubling reports with them. There is something coming Tenno... something big, and we need to prepare ourselves. I have marked several high risk missions for you on the Star Chart. These missions may be dangerous, but will also offer bountiful rewards. Venture out and claim these items of power. You will need them in the days to come.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GenericGiftDesc.zhText:
请注意Tenno，

我们的侦察兵们刚刚已经回来了，并且带来了令人不安的报告。要出事了Tenno，很大的事，我们需要预备好自己。我已经在星图上为你标出来了一些高危任务。这些任务有可能很危险，但是同样的，也会有丰厚的奖赏。勇敢的出击并领取这些强大的战利品吧。你会在未来的日子里面用到它们的。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GenericTacAlert.text:
You went above the call of duty today, Tenno. The skill you displayed will inspire your fellow warriors. Wear this, so that they will know what has been achieved here today.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GenericTacAlert.zhText:
你今天甘冒危险超越本职，Tenno。你今天所展现的这些能力会激励你的战友。戴上这个，他们就知道今天在这里取得的胜利。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemComplete.text:
That was fantastic Tenno, you really came through for Clem and I. Come see us in the relay, so we can thank you in person. 

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemComplete.zhText:
太棒了，Tenno！你真的安然救出了 Clem。快来中继站找我，好让我亲自感谢你。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemDesc.text: Darvo needs your help again. Save one of his best contractors from Grineer execution.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemDesc.zhText: Darvo 再次需要你的协助，从 Grineer 的刑罚中拯救出他最好的承包商。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemHelpText.text: <MINI_ARROW> Talk to Darvo in any Relay
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemHelpText.zhText: <MINI_ARROW> 与任意中继站中的 Darvo 对话

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemIntroInb.text:
Friend,

There’s something I need to ask you… in person. Come see me on a relay and we’ll talk.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemIntroInb.zhText:
好友，

我有些事情⋯⋯想亲自问你。来中继站找我，我们再来好好谈谈。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemObjectiv.zhText: 找回 Clem 的葛拉卡达

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemObjectiv.text: Go see Darvo in his shop
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemObjectiv.zhText: 到 Darvo 的商店见他
帮助 Darvo 取得古物

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemPickUpGr.zhText: 捡起 CLEM 的双子葛拉卡达

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemPullQuot.text: "He's a special guy, you know. Little weird but a hell of a fighter." -Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemPullQuot.zhText: "他是个特别的家伙，你懂的。有点古怪，但是个铁铮铮的汉子。" －Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GetClemWeeklyOb.zhText: 帮助 Clem 取回古物

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GiftingMessageB.text:
You may now send gifts through the Marketplace!

1. Choose an item you want to gift.
2. Select the new 'Gift' button beside the Purchase button.
3. Choose a recipient from Friends/Clan/Recents lists (or enter an Alias in the box).
4. You can enter a short message to accompany the gift or leave it blank.
5. After confirmation and successful delivery the appropriate Platinum will be deducted.

If delivery fails you will not be charged! Keep in mind you can't send a Gift to a recipient if it's restricted for them to purchase themselves (Mastery Rank Locked, Already Owned, Quest locked).

Happy Gifting, Tenno!

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GiftingMessageB.zhText:
你可以在商店里送礼啦！

1. 选择一个你想要送出的礼物。
2. 选择购买按钮旁边新的"礼物"按钮。
3. 从你的好友/ 氏族/最近的玩家列表里选择一个接收人（或者在框中输入一个玩家名）。
4. 你可以输入一条简短的赠言和礼物一起送出或者留白。
5. 确认且礼物成功送出后，相应的白金会被扣除。

如果礼物没有成功送出，你的账号就不会被扣款！请注意，你不能将接收人被限制购买的物品当作礼物送出 （例如：精通段位锁定，已经拥有，系列任务锁定） 。

开心地送礼吧 ，Tenno！

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal1Details.text: The Corpus have deployed millions of Orokin fused Moas in Europa. All Tenno must work together to eradicate this threat...
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal1Details.zhText: We've uncovered a secret armada of new Moas is overtaking Europa. We need to destroy this armada before they overtake the other systems…

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal1DetailsB.text: If we wipe out this entire force in time, their point of origin will be revealed. We suspect a valuable Relic may be of use to us.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal1DetailsB.zhText: If we wipe out this entire force their point of origin will be revealed. We suspect a valuable Relic may be of use to us.

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal2Details.text: The Grineer have deployed millions of cloaking spy drones! We must destroy these quickly before they undermine our ability to strike undetected.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal2Details.zhText: Grineer 已经设置了数百万架隐形间谍无人机！在它们危及到我们的匿踪出击能力之前我们必须得尽速摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal2DetailsB.text: If we can irradicate enough of these drones it may reveal a hidden weapons cache. Did the Grineer hijack a Corpus weapons shipment?
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Goal2DetailsB.zhText: 如果我们能摧毁足够的无人机，可能会发现一个隐藏的武器箱。难道 Grineer 劫持了 Corpus 的武器货船？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestDesc.text: Ordis is determined to help a fellow Cephalon overcome a ship wide infestation.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestDesc.zhText: Ordis 决意帮助一具中枢同伴压制一艘遭到广域性感染的船舰。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestIntro.text:
CEPHALON STRANDED. SHIP IMMOBILIZED. POWER FAILING. EXTINCTION EVENT.
Please help me! Assemble this communication endpoint to establish contact.

CEPHALON JORDAS
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestIntro.zhText:
中枢受困，船舰停滞，动力丧失，发生毁灭事件。
请求协助！请装置通讯端点建立联系。

中枢 JORDAS
呼叫中枢全员：第44条枢律

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestObjEx.text: Craft Potent Pherliac Pods in Foundry
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestObjEx.zhText: 在铸造厂中建造强化的费洛髂荚囊

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestObjOb.zhText: 采集巨兽身上的费洛髂荚囊

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestObjTe.text: Test the Pherliac Pods on Infested
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestObjTe.zhText: 对感染者测试费洛髂荚囊的效用

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestPoten.text:
THE PHERLIAC PODS ARE STRONG BUT NEED TO BE STRONGER. EXPOSE THEM TO ARGON CRYSTAL USING THIS BLUEPRINT.

How quickly can you make this happen?

JORDAS
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestPoten.zhText:
虽然费洛髂荚囊已十分有效，但效能必须更强大才行。使用这份蓝图让费洛髂荚囊曝露于氩结晶的辐射之下。

你能加紧脚步尽快完成吗？

JORDAS
紧急需求：费洛髂的效用

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestPullQ.text: "Jordas, my Operator is kind and compassionate, not motivated by selfish rewards! By the 44th precept, we will come for you!"
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemQuestPullQ.zhText: "Jordas，我们的指挥官为人仁慈而富同情心，并非自私地为了报酬才出手相救的！基于第 44 条枢律，我们会前去协助你！"

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemRaidResear.text:
Tenno,

Jordas wasn't lying about one thing, the crew of that Corpus ship had been working on anti-Infestation technology before they were all killed. If you can collect enough examples of this technology we should be able to use it to help take down the Golem.

A blueprint for crafting an ‘Antiserum Injector' has been added to your Clan Dojo's energy lab. 

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemRaidResear.zhText:
Tenno， 

Jordas 有件事情倒是没说谎，Corpus 舰上的船员在他们全数罹难前曾进行过反制感染技术的研究。如果你能从这些技术中收集到足够的实验案例，我们应该可以利用这些技术来杀死魔像。

一张可打造「抗血清注射器」的蓝图已被增加至你氏族道场的能源实验室中。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemRaidReward.text:
Tenno,

Where others failed, you were victorious. The Jordas Golem has been destroyed and with that another one of this system's tragic creatures has been laid to rest. 

Take these items as symbols of your accomplishment, may they aid you in overcoming future adversity. 

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemRaidReward.zhText:
Tenno， 

你的胜利伴随着其他人的失败。Jordas 魔像已被毁灭，这座星系另一名可悲的生物终于得到安息。

收下这些作为你建功象征的物品，它们或许能协助你克服日后的逆境。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemTauntA.text: (We were countless. Consume us. Be reborn.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemTauntA.zhText: （我们无穷无尽。与我为一。重获新生。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemTauntB.text: (Why do you destroy us? We are your flesh.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemTauntB.zhText: （为什么你要摧毁我们？我们是你的血肉。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemTauntC.text: (We embrace you. Why do you defile us?)
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GolemTauntC.zhText: （我们拥抱你。为什么你要反抗我们？）

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GrineerOceanDes.zhText: 摧毁 Grineer 海底研究设施。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GrineerOceanSab.text: Destroy or steal cloning research from the hidden Grineer labs on Uranus.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GrineerOceanSab.zhText: 破坏或是窃取藏于天王星的 Grineer 实验室的克隆研究成果。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/GrineerOceanSte.zhText: 窃取 Grineer 的研究成果。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HallowedNightma.text:
You've made your choice in unsealing the treasure, but ready yourself Tenno, you'll now have to take on the Jack-O-Naught.

- Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HallowedNightma.zhText:
你已经做了解封财宝的决定，但是预备好你自己 Tenno，你现在将不得不对付南瓜巨兽。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HarvesterkMessa.text: Thank you for volunteering for the Zanuka Project, you will make a fine addition to my collection.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HarvesterkMessa.zhText: 感谢你自愿参加 Zanuka 研究，你将会加入我的收藏之中。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HarvesterkMessa.text: Thank you for your continued interest in the Zanuka Project. A member of our staff will assist you shortly...
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HarvesterkMessa.zhText: 感谢你持续关注 Zanuka 研究。我们的一名工作人员将在短期内为你提供帮助…

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HeatFissuresEve.text: Seal fractures across the Orb Vallis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HeatFissuresGoo.text: BONUS: Double credits and resources from Orb Vallis missions
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HeatFissuresGoo.zhText: 额外奖励：奥布山谷任务的双倍现金和资源加成

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HeatFissuresMed.zhText: 裂缝状态：间歇性控制中

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HeatFissuresMed.text: BONUS: Double credits from Orb Vallis missions
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HeatFissuresMed.zhText: 额外奖励：奥布山谷任务的双倍现金

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventLotusI.text:
Tenno, we have a problem.

Alad V has developed a way to direct the spread of the Infestation. Using these newly engineered "Hive" organisms, the Infestation is able to corrupt a new ship or colony almost instantly. There are also disturbing reports coming in that the virus has evolved. It is now capable of absorbing and corrupting non-organic beings. Not even the robotic soldiers of the Corpus are safe now. The only way to stop the spread is to destroy these hives.

We have just received word of a massive outbreak near Eris. An entire fleet of Corpus ships has been exposed to this new bioplague. Alad V is almost certainly responsible. If Alad V's hives are allowed to gain a strategic foothold here, the Infested will become unstoppable. They will overrun the system in a matter of days. If we don't put an end to this now, the Corpus, the Grineer, the Tenno...we could all fall in the wake of this horrible scourge. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventLotusI.zhText:
Tenno，我们遇到一个难题。

阿拉德 V 开发了一个可以引导感染者扩散的新方法。利用这些新设计的"巢囊"生物体，感染者几乎在一瞬间就能让一艘新飞船或者一片殖民地腐烂。除此之外，还有令人担心的报告说这种病毒已经进化。它现在能吸收和破坏非有机体。就连 Corpus 的机器人士兵也不安全了。阻止这种扩散的唯一方法只有破坏这些巢囊。

我们刚刚收到消息称阋神星附近有大规模战争爆发。一整支 Corpus 舰队的飞船都暴露在这种新的生物瘟疫中。几乎可以肯定阿拉德 V 是要负责的。如果阿拉德 V 的巢囊在那里能取得一个战略立足点的话，感染者就会变得势不可挡。他们在几天之内就会在星系中泛滥。如果我们现在不阻止这些，Corpus、Grineer、Tenno……我们都会在这场可怕的灾难后倒下。

- Lotus
阿拉德 V 的回归

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventReward.text: You have made solid progress against Alad V's hives. The threat is still very real and you have much work to do. Take this emblem and wear it with pride while you fight.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventReward.zhText: 在与阿拉德 V 的巢囊对抗中，你踏出了可靠的一步。但威胁仍然存在，你还有很多的事要去做。拿上这个徽章，并在战斗中自豪地穿戴着它。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventReward.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, you have gone the distance. While there are still pockets of strong resistance, the Infestation is no longer a serious threat and Alad V is retreating... for now. 

Please take this Prova Vandal, you have earned it. 

You have done your part but I wonder how much further can you take this fight? Your fellow Tenno will be watching.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventReward.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，你坚持到了最后。尽管还有一些强烈的抵抗，但感染者已不再是一个严重的威胁，并且阿拉德 V 已经撤退了……至少现在是这样。

请收下这个普罗沃·破坏者，这是你应得的。

你做了你应做的部分，但我在想你还能战斗多久？你的 Tenno 同伴会看到的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventReward.text: The end is in sight, we nearly have Alad V's hives under control. Take these mods, use them to finish the job.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HiveEventReward.zhText: 尾声已经接近，我们快将阿拉德 V 的巢囊控制住了。收下这些 MOD，用它们来完成这次的工作。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HyenaTacAlertCo.text:
Tenno,

Frohd Bek continues to pursue his advanced Hyena program. We have just learned that a massive order of the elemental Fire Hyena model has just finished production. You must enter this facility and destroy these machines before they can be sent to the front lines.

Take note, this is not another straight forward extermination. This facility is equipped with a new type of sensor, capable of detecting large signatures of Void energy generated by more advanced Warframes. Any signs of a threat, the entire facility will be evacuated. To escape detection equip low powered frames and weapons.

I am counting on you Tenno.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HyenaTacAlertCo.zhText:
Tenno，

Frohd Bek 不断地推行着他的进阶鬣狗计划。我们先前了解到大量的火属性鬣狗机型的订单已完成了生产。你必须进入设施，并在那些机器被送往前线之前破坏它们。

要注意，这并不是又一个直截了当的歼灭任务。这个设施装备了一种新型的传感器，能够检测到从高级战甲身上产生出来的大量虚空能量。一旦发现任何有威胁的迹象，整个设施都将被疏散。为了躲避侦测，装备那些低强度的战甲和武器。

我相信你，Tenno。

－Lotus
战术警报: 鬣狗生产设施

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HyenaTacAlertRe.text:
Well done Tenno,

The Corpus will not easily recover from this loss. The cost of these machines should set them back significantly. However, I fear we may have infuriated Frohd Bek. This will have unforeseen consequences in the future. 

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HyenaTacAlertRe.zhText:
Tenno，做得好，

Corpus 将难以从这次损失中恢复过来。相信这些机器的价值足以给他们造成相当大的花费。但是，我恐怕我们触怒了 Frohd Bek。这可能在将来带来难以预料的后果。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HyenaTacAlertTo.text: Infiltrate the production facility and destroy Hyena NG machines.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/HyenaTacAlertTo.zhText: 潜入生产设施并破坏鬣狗型机器人。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IAVQConclusionB.text:
By destroying Alad V's lab ship you have destroyed his ability to make new infested. Now you need to go after the man himself. He's on the run and it's up to you to track him down. Use the attached tracker to find him.

Good luck Tenno,
Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IAVQConclusionB.zhText:
破坏阿拉德 V 实验船舰的同时也摧毁了他制造新一波感染的能力。现在你必须紧追在后，由你来追踪这个亡命之徒。使用这台附挂式追踪器找到他。

祝你好运，Tenno。
Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IAVQConclusionT.zhText: 零号病患: 任务完成

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IAVQDescription.text: Find Alad V's laboratory and put a stop to his madness.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IAVQDescription.zhText: 找到阿拉德 V 的实验室并制止他的疯狂行径。
