/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQCompleteMess.text:
My Queens,

It is my shame to report that Tenno interference has caused a breach of our Infested testing lab on M Prime. Acting immediately, I ordered the destruction of the facility which has contained the outbreak. Tragically, I believe the Tenno have stolen spores with the intent to use the plague against us. 

I will act at once to develop a counter-measure, I will not allow this unethical behaviour by the Tenno to threaten our glorious cause.

For the Queens,
Doctor Tengus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQCompleteMess.zhText:
我的女皇，

向您报告，我们坐落于 M-Prime 的感染者实验室因为 Tenno 的干扰行为而被破坏，这实为我的耻辱。我已立即采取行动，下令销毁控制疫病散播的装置。不幸的是，我坚信 Tenno 已经偷走了孢子并意图对我们采取瘟疫攻击。

我会立刻展开应对计划，我不允许 Tenno 借由这种不道德的行为来威胁我们的崇高理想。

为了女皇，
Tengus 博士
拦截到的信息: 隔离崩溃

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQCompleteRewa.text:
Tenno,

The Cascade explosion worked and the asteroid has been purged of Infestation, but I'm afraid this new threat cannot be so easily contained. Doctor Tengus' experiments with this plague are grossly irresponsible and have threatened the entire system. All that is needed is an infected ship to reach a populated area and we'll be unable to contain its spread. There's no controlling it, the Grineer will be in just as much peril as we are. 

To prepare you for this new fight I have sent you something that should prove effective against this menace. Let us hope you will not need to use it.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQCompleteRewa.zhText:
Tenno，

串级引爆已使小行星上的感染者全数灭绝，但我担心新的威胁并没有那么容易控制住。Tengus 博士对这种瘟疫的实验是极不负责任的，它已危及整个星系。只要被感染的船舰抵达居民居住地，我们就无法阻止感染的扩散。到那时，局势将无法挽回，Grineer 也将难以幸免。 

为了让你准备好迎接这场新战斗，我已为你准备了一些能有效对抗这种威胁的道具。希望你永远不会用上它们。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQDescription.text: Intercepted Grineer communications reveal that Grineer have been experimenting with some sort of bio weapon. You must investigate.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQDescription.zhText: 拦截到的 Grineer 通讯显示，Grineer一直在试验某种生化武器，你必须调查清楚。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQFireModMessa.text:
Tenno,

This is from one of Doctor Tengus's reports:

"The additional test Marines have arrived. The specimens tore through the previous batch much faster than predicted. It should be noted that Marines who survived the longest were using fire based weapons."

The Infested are vulnerable to fire. I have sent a fire damage mod for you to install on your Melee Weapon. It should aid you in your coming mission.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQFireModMessa.zhText:
Tenno，

这是 Tengus 博士的其中一份报告：

"额外的测试陆战队已经抵达了。样本撕碎前一批的速度比预期中快得多。值得注意的是，存活最久的陆战队所使用的武器都和火有关。"

感染者容易受到火焰伤害。我已经配送了一张增加火焰伤害的 Mod 让你安装到近战武器上。它应该会对你接下来的任务有帮助。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQFireModMessa.text: We will use this to our advantage
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQFireModMessa.zhText: 我们将利用这个来提升我方优势。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQIntroMessage.text:
Tenno,

We have intercepted an alarming transmission. The Grineer have obtained samples of the Infestation that once ravaged the Orokin. A scientist named Dr. Tengus intends to integrate the samples into his bioweapon research.

The Grineer believe they can control the Infestation. They are mistaken.

We must investigate the laboratory on Mercury immediately. Hurry to M Prime.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IIQIntroMessage.zhText:
Tenno，

我们截获了一条令人震惊的通讯。Grineer 获得了曾经侵略奥罗金的感染者样本。一名叫 Tengus 博士的科学家打算将这些样本整合到他的生化武器研究中。

Grineer 认为他们可以控制感染者。他们想错了。

我们必须立即调查水星上的实验室。请速速前往 M Prime。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IceLeaderEventC.text:
Tenno,

You've helped the Red Veil in the past, now we want to return the favor. Our spies have discovered that a large batch of Corpus Arctic Eximus are massing for training around the polar region of Mars. With so many Arctic Eximus gathered in one place you have the perfect opportunity to strike a crippling blow against the Corpus field command.

Go to Mars and take out as many of the Arctic Eximus as possible, we will offer you what we can from the spoils. 

- Cantis of the Red Veil Resistance
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IceLeaderEventC.zhText:
Tenno，

过去你帮助过血色面纱，现在我们想回馈你。我们的间谍发现了大量的 Corpus 极地卓越者在环绕火星的极地集结训练。这个有众多极地卓越者聚集的地方，是你对 Corpus 战地指挥发出致命一击的绝好机会。

去火星，尽可能多地消灭极地卓越者，我们会从战利品中为你提供我们能够提供的物品。

－血色面纱反抗军，Cantis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IceLeaderEventT.text: Execute a first strike against the new Corpus Arctic Eximus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IceLeaderEventT.zhText: 对新型 Corpus 极寒卓越者进行首次进攻

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IceLeaderReward.text:
Tenno,

You sent the Corpus a message today! They'll be watching their backs from now on. Let them get nervous, let them know they can't hide, we're watching and we have the Tenno by our side. 

We found these among their supply crates, The Corpus were using them to speed up their troop training. I figure you might have a use for it.

- Cantis of the Red Veil Resistance
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IceLeaderReward.zhText:
Tenno， 

你今天发送的 Corpus 的消息！他们会从现在看他们的背影。让他们感到紧张，让他们知道他们不能隐瞒，我们看，我们有天皇在我们身边。

我们发现这些方面的补给箱中，胼用他们加快部队训练。我想，你可能有一个使用它。

－血色面纱反抗军

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.text:
Tenno,

The locations of numerous high-profile Corpus war criminals have been revealed within the vicinity of Europa. Regrettably, this information has come at a great price; our operatives were discovered at the conclusion of their infiltration mission and executed by the enemy. These agents are now expecting an attack and have recruited mercenary snipers to protect them. You must arrive at their location undetected and bring these criminals to justice. Don't let any of them escape.

Good luck,

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.zhText:
Tenno，

The locations of numerous high-profile Corpus war criminals have been revealed within the vicinity of Europa. Regrettably，this information has come at a great price; our operatives were discovered at the conclusion of their infiltration mission and executed by the enemy. These agents are now expecting an attack and have recruited mercenary snipers to protect them. You must arrive at their location undetected and bring these criminals to justice. Don't let any of them escape.

Good luck，

- The Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.text:
Well done, Tenno. You have brought an end to the treachery of many Corpus war criminals. The sacrifices made by our scouts have not been in vain. Take this as a reward for your assistance today, hopefully this will help in some way.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.zhText:
Well done，Tenno. You have brought an end to the treachery of many Corpus war criminals. The sacrifices made by our scouts have not been in vain. Take this as a reward for your assistance today，hopefully this will help in some way.

- The Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.text:
Your efforts are commendable, but we can still use your help. Take this to assist you on your next mission.

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.zhText:
你的努力是值得称颂的，我们仍然需要你的帮助。带上这个，它可以在下一个任务中帮到你。

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.text:
Tenno,

I am impressed with your progress |PLAYER_NAME| but there are many VIP agents remaining. Take this item, I hope it will help you in your attack.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IcePlanetCaptur.zhText:
Tenno，

I am impressed with your progress |PLAYER_NAME| but there are many VIP agents remaining. Take this item，I hope it will help you in your attack.

- The Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexDrawingABo.text: A drawing by the Myconian Neewa.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexDrawingABo.zhText: 由 Mycona 人 Neewa 所绘制的图像。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexDrawingBBo.text: A drawing by the Myconian Neewa.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexDrawingBBo.zhText: 由 Mycona 人 Neewa 所绘制的图像。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexDrawingCBo.text: A drawing by the Myconian Neewa.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexDrawingCBo.zhText: 由 Mycona 人 Neewa 所绘制的图像。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventBonus.text:
You don’t stop do you, Tenno. I like that. And just seeing you take all those credits from Nef, it warms my heart. 

Here, I have one last gift for you.

Enjoy,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventBonus.zhText:
你不会就此收手的吧，Tenno。我就喜欢这样。光是看着你从奈富那里夺走那些现金，我的心里就暖暖的。

接着，我还有最后一份礼物给你。

请尽情享受，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventCommu.text:
Friends,

Have you seen this crap? Nef Anyo just created another scheme to milk suckers out of their credits. He calls it: The Index, but really, it's just wagering and bloodsport. Thing is Tenno, I like wagering and bloodsports are sort of your deal. 

You get what I'm getting at? You go to this index and fight against Nef's brokers. You'll win credits. I'll win credits. We'll all win credits. Except for Nef, he's going to lose a lot of credits. Just thinking about that makes me happy.

Your friend, 
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventCommu.zhText:
朋友们，

你以前看过这种东西吗？奈富·安尤刚刚用他们的钱制造了另一个烂计划。他称呼这个为：指数之场，但说真的，这只是赌博和血腥运动的游戏而已。其实，我喜欢赌博和血腥运动，这应该也合你的胃口。

你听懂我说的是什么了吗？你到指数之场去然后对抗奈富的经纪。你会赢得现金。我也同样会获得现金。这样我们双赢了。当然奈富除外，他会输掉大量的现金。光想想就让我高兴坏了。

你的朋友，
Dravo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventInter.text:
Oh, Tenno, I tell you, this is getting good. We’re on a roll and I don’t want it to stop. 

Here, take this, consider it good luck charm from your old pal, Darvo.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventInter.zhText:
噢，Tenno，我得告诉你，我们渐入佳境。现在运气超好，我可不想停下来。

拿着这个，就当是老朋友 Darvo 送你的幸运护身符。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventRewar.text:
We did it, Tenno, we hit the big time. I'm going to cash-out now but if you want to keep "investing", go ahead. You can never have too many credits, that's what I always say.

I'm giving you a little token of my appreciation. After all the credits you've earned me, it's the least I can do.

-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexEventRewar.zhText:
我们成功了，Tenno，大成功！我准备提现走人了，不过要是你还想"投资"，请自便。我总是这么说：不会有人嫌钱多。

我会送给你一份礼物以表感激。你帮我挣了那么多钱，我所做的实在微不足道。

－Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestCureH.text:
Tenno, 

You made the right choice. Neewa is recovering well with many opportunities in front of her. Rest well, knowing that you helped her escape an early death in some darkened Infested freighter. The Myconians are safe too. A contingent of specters will now protect them from the Infested. They will adapt to this new reality, and no more children will have this affliction forced upon them.

As agreed, the Myconians have sent you their Old War relic.

I'll give the final word to Neewa. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestCureH.zhText:
Tenno，

你做出了明智的选择。在 Neewa 面前，她因许多机缘而良好复原着。好好休息吧，仅需知道你在某艘黑暗的感染者货轮中拯救了 Neewa 免于早夭的命运。Mycona 人也安全了，如今有一只魅影小队保护着他们远离感染者的威胁。他们会适应新现况的，不再有孩子会被强加这种苦难了。

依照约定，Mycona 人寄给了你他们远古战争的遗物。

我会给 Neewa 留下最后一句话。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestDescr.text: Nef Anyo has stolen the children of the Mycona Colony and it is up to you to get them back. You must challenge Nef on The Index and beat him at his own game. But Tenno, beware, not all is as it seems.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestDescr.zhText: 奈富·安尤偷走了 Mycona 殖民地的孩子们，全靠你去解救他们了。你需要在指数之场中挑战 奈富，在他自己的游戏中击败他。但是注意了，Tenno，并不是一切都如看起来那么单纯。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestErgoR.text: Ergo Glast, Founder and President of the Perrin Sequence would like to meet with you to discuss an urgent matter that is of concern to the Tenno. Come to our Relay office at your earliest convenience.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestErgoR.zhText: Ergo Glast，佩兰数列的总裁与创始人希望与您会晤，讨论有关 Tenno 的紧急议题。请您方便时请尽快前来我们中继站的办公室。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestErgoR.text: Urgent Meeting Request: President Ergo Glast
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestErgoR.zhText: 紧急会议邀请：Ergo Glast 总裁

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestHelpT.text:
<MINI_ARROW> <QUEST> The War Within Quest
<MINI_ARROW> Talk to Ergo Glast in Perrin Sequence room in any Relay
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestHelpT.zhText:
<MINI_ARROW> <QUEST>《内战》系列任务
<MINI_ARROW> 在任意中继站的佩兰数列房间与 Ergo Glast 交谈

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestLetHe.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

The choice you gave Neewa had a profound effect on her but I'll let her explain that in her own words.

On behalf of Perrin Sequence and the people of Mycona Colony, I offer you our sincere gratitude. Without you, Mycona would no longer exist. To celebrate your selfless deed, the Myconians have sent you their prized Old War relic. It is their sincere hope you use it to protect others as you have protected them.

Yours Truly,
Ergo Glast
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestLetHe.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你给予 Neewa 的选择对她产生了深远的影响，但我会让她以自己的话来说明。

我仅代表佩兰数列与 Mycona 殖民地的人民向你致上诚挚的谢意。没有你，Mycona 将不复存在。为赞美你无私的作为，Mycona 人送给你他们珍贵的远古战争遗物。他们真诚期盼你能像保护他们一样，善用这份遗物保护他人。

诚挚的，
Ergo Glast

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.text:
Tenno, here is the drawing my operative was able to smuggle out of Neewa's cell. Just in case you need to be reminded of who you are helping.

-Ergo Glast
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.zhText:
Tenno，这是我的特工从 Neewa 的牢房中偷带出来的绘画，以防还要提醒你在帮助谁。

－Ergo Glast

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.text:
My Corpus operative on the inside was able to get a message from Neewa. She is defiant but scared, for herself, but even more so for her people. Our only choice is to continue at the Index. It sickens me to think we are literally gambling for their futures, but this is the only way to get at Nef. 

Ergo Glast
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.zhText:
我在 Corpus 内部的特工成功得到关于 Neewa 的消息。她正反抗着，但是被吓坏了。我们唯一的选择就是在指数之场上继续奋战。光是想到我们简直是拿着他们的未来在做赌注这点就令我十分厌恶，但这是我们唯一贴近的奈富的方法。

Ergo Glast
另一则来自 Neewa 的消息

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.text:
We got a tip that Neewa was on a Corpus ship. Our operatives attempted a raid, but all they found was this message. I was reluctant to share this fact, until now, as I feared the judgment you'd pass on their traditions. Neewa proudly carries an ancestral burden for the prosperity of her colony. I hope you can understand this without judgment.

Ergo Glast
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.zhText:
我们收到 Neewa 在某艘 Corpus 船舰上的密报。我方特工本来试图突袭的，但他们发现了这则消息。直到现在我仍不愿分享实情，因为我害怕你的判断继承了他们传统的价值观。Neewa 傲然背负着来自祖辈要让其殖民地昌盛的重担，我希望你能不加思索的理解这点。

Ergo Glast

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.text: We also found this in the data vault. The good news is that Neewa’s still alive.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestNeewa.zhText: 我们同时在数据库中找到了这个。好消息是 Neewa 还活着。
更多来自 Neewa 的谢意

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestPullQ.text: "We must exercise caution, don't come on too strong, or he will back off. We need to, as they say, ‘hustle' him."
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestPullQ.zhText: 我们必须小心行事，不要打草惊蛇，不然他会退缩。我们需要，用黑话说，"哄哄他"。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestSendH.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

On behalf of Perrin Sequence and the people of Mycona Colony, I offer you our sincere gratitude. Without you, Mycona would no longer exist. To celebrate your selfless deed, the Myconians have sent you their prized Old War relic. It is their sincere hope you use it to protect others as you have protected them.

I hope this message from Neewa communicates how truly grateful they all are.

Yours Truly,
Ergo Glast
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestSendH.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

我仅代表佩兰数列与 Mycona 殖民地的人民为你致以诚挚的谢意。没有你 Mycona 将不复存在。为赞美你无私的作为，Mycona 人送给你他们珍贵的远古战争遗物。他们真诚期盼你能像保护他们一样，善用这份遗物保护他人。

我希望这则来自 Neewa 的信息能传达出他们诚挚的感激。

诚挚的， 
Ergo Glast

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestStage.zhText: 协助保护 Mycona 殖民地

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestStage.text: Challenge Nef Anyo on The Index
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestStage.zhText: 在指数之场挑战奈富·安尤

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexQuestStage.text: Find the source of Nef’s cheats

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialA.text: So Tenno, you think you have what it takes to be a broker on The Index? Allow me educate you.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialA.zhText: 所以说 Tenno，你觉得你拥有在《指数之场》做经纪人的本事吗？请让我来教导你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialB.text: When you kill a Broker, they will drop an Index Point. Scramble, it's your job to pick it up before the other team does.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialB.zhText: 当你击倒一名经纪时，他们会掉落一个指数点数。赶紧去抢，你的任务是在对手捡起它之前捷足先登。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialC.text: You may hold any number of index points, but know that they're worthless until you've deposited them in the Bank. We call this Capitalization.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialC.zhText: 你可以持有任意数量的指数点数，不过点数在你存入银行之前是没有价值的。我们管存入银行叫作资本化得分。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialD.text: But if you die on the way to the bank, you'll drop all your points, leaving them vulnerable to all.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialD.zhText: 但如果你在去银行的路上被击杀了，你将会掉落所有的点数，任由他人分享。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialE.text: You see, The Index is a game of risk and reward. Hold too many points and you risk rewarding the other team. Tenno, you best make peace with the Void, The Index is about to begin.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/IndexTutorialE.zhText: 你瞧，《指数之场》是一项风险和收益并存的游戏。持有太多点数你就要冒着被其他队伍渔翁得利的危险。Tenno，你最好向虚空求得和解。《指数之场》即将开始。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedCorpusH.text:
I suppose I should thank you Tenno.

I know, you must think I'm crazy. After all, you wiped out my first assault and destroyed the vast majority of my hives. My venture should be in shambles but there's always a silver lining, look what you've left me with! I now command the most fierce and evolved Infested in the system. They are quite something and you should be proud because in a way, you were their coach.

Our numbers are small but we're growing, changing. The next time you see us you are in for quite a surprise.

Until we meet again,
Alad V.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedCorpusH.zhText:
我想我应该谢谢你，Tenno。

我知道你一定觉得我疯了。最后，你不但横扫了我的第一次攻击，还消灭了我的大多数巢囊。虽然我的冒险行动步履蹒跚，但是还有一线希望，看看你给我留下了什么！现在，我指挥着星系中最凶猛和进化最快的感染者。它们已经相当不错，而且从某种程度来说，你们应该感到自豪，因为你们是他们的教练。

虽然我们现在数量很少，但是我们还在不断增长，不断变化。下次你再看到我们的时候你会有不小的惊喜。

直到我们再次相见，
阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedCorpusH.text: Alad V is threatening the entire sector with his Infested Hives, take them out.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedCorpusH.zhText: 阿拉德 V 正在用他的感染巢囊威胁这一整个地区，解决他们。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedIncurSu.text:
My scans show that we are winning, the strength of the Infested waning. Your undying fight tells me that you put the safety of this system above all else. I urge you to keep going, with an enemy this virulent, every little bit counts.

I have sent you something to aid in this ongoing battle.

Thank you Tenno,
The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedIncurSu.zhText:
我的扫描结果显示感染者的力量正在衰退，我们获胜了。你不朽的斗志向我诉说你将这个星系的安全看得比什么都重要。我期许你在面对致命的敌人时，以至于每一分每一秒，都能继续保持这个信念。

我发送了一些在这场进行中的战斗对你有帮助的东西。

Tenno，谢谢你。
Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedIncursi.text:
Tenno, 

Alad V's infested ships are slamming into populated centers all around the system. He's using these ships like spore pods to spread his Mutalist plague. Everyone is affected.Equally concerning are the new strains of Infested he's using in his attack. 

There are two courses of action. First, we must extinguish each Infestation at its source. I will be issuing Bounties, so that we can cut down as many of these new Infested as possible. Pay attention to your Navigation Console for updates. 

Secondly, we need to deal with the source of the problem. I have sent you details of a mission to locate Alad V and destroy his lab.

Left unchecked this plague will spread out of control. You must start immediately, there is little time to waste.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedIncursi.zhText:
Tenno，

阿拉德 V 被感染的船舰已大举入侵星系各处的殖民中心，他打算利用这些船舰以类孢子荚的方式来散播他的异融型瘟疫。众人将无一倖免。同样危急的还有他把全新品种的感染者用在攻击上。

行动有两个阶段。首先，我们必须全数歼灭感染源的感染者。我会发出悬赏奖励，以便我们能够尽量减少这些新型感染者的数量。记得要更新你的导航控制台。

其次，我们需要处理问题的源头。我已经将阿拉德 V 的定位与破坏他实验室的详细任务细节发送给你了。

任由传染发生将会导致这场瘟疫失控蔓延。你必须即刻动身，一分一秒都不能浪费。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedIncursi.text: Do take a moment to review this announcement, I suspect you will find it most exciting.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InfestedIncursi.zhText: 一定要花点时间来检视这则公告，我想你会发现更多令人振奋的消息。
欢迎来到你崭新的帝国。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InvasionEventCl.text:
Our two houses have worked well together. May this statue always serve as a reminder of the ties between |CLAN_NAME| and The Corpus.
-Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InvasionEventCl.zhText:
我们双方的合作十分良好，希望这座雕像能永久作为 |CLAN_NAME| 和 Corpus 之间联系的纪念。
－阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InvasionEventCl.text:
I know the Tenno of |CLAN_NAME|, you seek glory, not riches. You live and die for Victory.

Take this statue. It celebrates your glory. It honors your victory.

-Sargas Ruk
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/InvasionEventCl.zhText:
我了解 |CLAN_NAME| 的各位 Tenno，你们不为利益、只追求荣耀。生死皆为寻求胜利。

收下这座雕像，让它为你庆祝你的荣耀、彰显你的胜利。

－Sargas Ruk

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.text: Bring me the defectors ship’s coordinates to the relay.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.zhText: 把叛逃者舰艇的坐标给我带到中继站来。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.text: Hand over the defectors to us in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.zhText: 在中继站把叛逃者交给我们。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.text: Bring the the coordinates of the defectors ship to us in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.zhText: 把叛逃者舰艇的坐标给我们带回到中继站里来。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.text: Bring the the coordinates of the defectors ship to us in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.zhText: 把叛逃者舰艇的坐标给我们带回到中继站里来。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.text: Bring the coordinates of the defectors ship to us in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.zhText: 把叛逃者舰艇的坐标给我们带回到中继站里来。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.text: Show the Defectors a New Purity
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.zhText: 给叛逃者展现一个纯净新生

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.text: Bring the coordinates of the defectors ship to us in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventBadgeF.zhText: 把叛逃者舰艇的坐标给我们带回到中继站里来。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventCommun.text:
Listen up, Tenno. I don't care if you support Steel Meridian or not, I need your help. 

An entire company of Grineer defectors was just captured by Kela De Thaym.

Now they face Rathuum, Trial by combat. Of course, the fight's rigged, a show of force to Grineer everywhere, meant to scare off future defectors. But there's a way we can turn this thing back on Kela, an obscure rule. All you need to do, Tenno, is take their place in the arena and defeat the Grineer champions. You game?
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventCommun.zhText:
听着，Tenno。我不管你支不支持钢铁防线，我需要你的帮助。

一整个团的 Grineer 逃兵被 Kela De Thaym 捕获了。

现在他们要面对死亡角斗场，审判的战斗。当然这场战斗是被非法操控的，是给每个地方 Grineer 的力量展示秀，同样也是吓唬未来的逃兵。但有一个方法可以反转 Kela 的这件事情，一个模糊的规则。Tenno，你要做的就是在竞技场上取代他们并且击败 Grineer 的冠军。你愿意加入这场游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventInteri.zhText: 更加纯净的命运在等待着

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventInteri.text:
Kela is growing nervous. She never expected you to get this far. Grineer everywhere can see that the Executioners are not invincible.

You can win this. You can set the defectors free.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventInteri.zhText:
Kela 越来越紧张。她从来没想到你能做到这样。每个地方的 Grineer 都可以看出行刑者不是无敌的了。

你能成功的。你能够解放叛逃者的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventInteri.text: The look on Kela's face when you won was priceless. Your defense is working and the trial is moving to the next phase. Keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventInteri.zhText: 你胜利的时候 Kela 脸上的表情是无价的。你的防御正在起作用，审判也正在往下个阶段推进。继续保持。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventReward.text: Your Cephalon has been given her location.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventReward.zhText: 她的位置已给到你的中枢

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventReward.text:
Tenno,

Together you have ended Kela's savage executions, and no matter which fate you decided for the defectors, know that balance has been restored for now. Let this trophy stand in tribute to your victory.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventReward.zhText:
Tenno，

你们齐心终结了 Kela 残忍的处决之举，无论你决定叛逃者的命运为何，谨记此刻平衡已然恢复。就让这只奖杯见证并向你们的成就致敬。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventToolti.text: Fight for the Steel Meridian in Rathuum
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KelaEventToolti.zhText: 在死亡角斗场中为钢铁防线而战斗

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuest3.zhText: 在战斗中保护你的库狛

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestCode.text: You are Tenno, you deserve a Kubrow by your side.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestCode.zhText: 你是 Tenno，你应要有一只库狛伴随。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestHint.text: Incubate and mature a Kubrow using the Incubator
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestHint.zhText: 使用孵化器来孵化一只库狛并让它长大

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestInbo.text:
Dr. Intehb,

You have had the Orokin Incubator Segment for months and still you’ve produced nothing but genetic rejects. You promised me a Kubrow worthy of an Orokin prince, not a misshapen ball of hair and teeth. 

At great expense, I have procured another batch of eggs from the forests of Earth. They will reach your facility on Elara shortly. Do not waste these as you did the last ones.

I will have a Kubrow of my own. If you are not up to the task, I will find someone who is.

Frohd Bek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestInbo.zhText:
Intehb博士，

你已经持有奥罗金孵化器模块几个月了，而你还是没能从那些次级基因中做出什么。你曾向我承诺一只库狛跟一个奥罗金贵族有同等的价值，而不是这些有奇形怪状毛发和牙齿的球状物

我已花费高额的代价，从地球上的森林收购了另一批蛋来。它们短期内就会抵达你在 Elara 上的设施。别像上次一样浪费掉它们。

我将会拥有我自己的库狛。如果你无法完成任务，我将唯你是问。

Frohd Bek

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestInbo.text: INTERCEPTED CORPUS MESSAGE: Where is my Kubrow?
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/KubrowQuestInbo.zhText: 拦截到的 CORPUS 信息:我的库狛在哪？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQDesc.text:
The Limbo Theorem quest cannot be completed without an Archwing

Piece together the Limbo Theorem to uncover its source
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQDesc.zhText:
Limbo 定理任务必须具备曲翼才能完成

通过拼凑 Limbo 定理来揭露其起源

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.text: Check your Inbox for a message and a blueprint
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.zhText: 查收你收件箱中的一条信息和一张蓝图。
复原 Limbo 机体蓝图

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.text: Gather Proof Fragments and craft the Limbo Chassis Theorem
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.zhText: 收集数学证明片段并铸造出 Limbo 机体定理。
复原 Limbo 头部神经光元蓝图

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.text: Gather Proof Fragments and craft the Limbo Neuroptics Theorem
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.zhText: 收集数学证明片段并铸造出 Limbo 头部神经光元定理。
复原 Limbo 系统蓝图

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.text: Gather Proof Fragments and craft the Limbo Systems Theorem
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LimboQMissionOb.zhText: 收集数学证明片段并铸造出 Limbo 系统定理。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LiquidationComp.text:
Friends, 

We've reached the final deal, and not a moment too soon either. My spies tell the Corpus are surging their forces to hunt for smugglers and stolen shipments. I wish them good luck with that, smugglers are just the worst. 

Though I do hope they stay safe, I hear there's a lot of newly armed Tenno running about. It would be a shame if they ran into one of them... a shame.

Your loyal merchant, 
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LiquidationComp.zhText:
朋友们，

时不我待，这将是本次特卖的最终商品。我的眼线回报，Corpus 正在加紧力量打击走私客和货物偷盗。祝他们好运，走私商最差劲了。

尽管我真心地希望他们平安，不过我听说有许多新晋武装的 Tenno 在那里徘徊，要是他们一不小心撞见 Tenno 可就惨了……惨了

你们忠诚的供应商，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusArnE.text: The death of Arn Etina means the Corpus mineral pipeline has been severed. Robotics production will be disrupted for weeks.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusArnE.zhText: Arn Etina 的死亡意味着 Corpus 矿业生产线的中断。这将会妨碍机器人生产至少几个星期。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusHyen.text: Robotics with a pack mentality – the Corpus are beginning to raise all defenses. The Hyena model is their deadliest yet.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusHyen.zhText: 拥有集团意志的机器人——Corpus 已经始开始进入警戒状态。而鬣狗型是他们现时最致命的机器兽。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusJack.text: Seeing The Jackal in action is grim – it's clear the Corpus are capable of producing robotics beyond which we imagined.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusJack.zhText: 遇到豺狼就会使任务变得困难——看来 Corpus 已能够生产出超乎我们想象的机械了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusRapt.text: The Raptor is the most recent heavy weapon prototype developed by the Corpus. You must destroy it before they can begin full scale production.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusRapt.zhText: 猛禽是Corpus最新开发的重型武器原型，在它量产前摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusSgtN.text: The death of Sergeant Nef Anyo should weaken the Corpus Research and Development operations for some time.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusCorpusSgtN.zhText: 奈富·安尤中士的死在短期内应该能削弱 Corpus 的研发能力。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.text: Excellent, the corruption process has begun. You must defend this position to ensure the Grineer do not destroy this fuel cell before it spreads through the ship.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.zhText: 太棒了！污染程序已经开始，你必须在此防御，保证 Grineer 不会破坏这个燃料槽直到它扩散到整艘船为止。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.text: Corruption process is complete. Good work Tenno. Get to extraction where I will record your contribution to the operation!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.zhText: 污染程序已经完成，做得好 Tenno，去脱离点，我会计算并记录你所做的贡献！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.text: Destroying a single reactor will not be enough to take down a Fomorian. We will need to poison the well... coordinated teams will corrupt its fuel supply. This will require gear harvested from Infestation tissues. I will route you to an injector point...
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.zhText: 摧毁单一反应堆不足以解决一艘巨人战舰，我们需要污染燃料池……协作队伍将污染燃料供应点，这需要来自感染组织的原件，我会引导你到注射地点……

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.text: There it is! You should be able to inject the corruptor you brought using the attached console.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.zhText: 就是这里！你可以从附属控制台注射带来的污染物。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.text: These Fomorians are massive, keep searching. You will need to locate a fuel cell and inject the corrupting agent. I hope you have a corruptor with you.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.zhText: 这些巨人战舰非常巨大，继续寻找，你必须找到燃料池并将污染物投入，我希望你有带到污染物。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.text: Remember, if you are coordinating with other Tenno the Alpha/Beta mixtures are more potent, but a single Tenno cannot equip them at once.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusFormorianE.zhText: 记住！你与其他 Tenno 一起将 Alpha/Beta 混和会造成更大的破坏，但一个 Tenno 不能拿超过一个污染物。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerCap.text: The defeat of Grineer Captain Vor opens up other regions for the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerCap.zhText: Grineer 上尉沃尔的败亡为 Tenno 开辟了前往其他地区的管道。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerCou.text: The death of Counciler Vay Hek will bring all Grineer deployments to a halt.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerCou.zhText: 韦·海克议员的死将会停止所有 Grineer 部署。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerGen.text: Eliminating a Grineer General will render the Saturn region helplessly unorganized.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerGen.zhText: 除掉 Grineer 将军能够让整个土星区域的 Grineer 组织彻底地崩溃。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerSni.text: Kela de Thaym's death will no doubt cause ripples of dissension amongst the inner circles of Grineer nobility.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerSni.zhText: Kela de Thaym 的死，毫无疑问会在 Grineer 的贵族圈内造成一连串的纠纷。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerTyl.text: Tyl Regor was no ordinary Grineer – he was the leader in Cloning. The self-proclaimed father of future Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusGrineerTyl.zhText: 泰尔·雷工不是普通的 Grineer——他是克隆的领导者。自称为未来 Grineer 的父亲。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusInfestedJ3.text: That Golem was the most complex species of Infested we've encountered. Their ability to overtake multiple species is growing.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/LotusInfestedJ3.zhText: 那个魔像是我们遇到过的感染者当中最复杂的品种。他们同化其他种族的能力正在增长。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Lotus_InvasionR.text: Tenno, the Corpus have successfully halted the Grineer invasion of Mars, and Alad V is rewarding his supporters with new Corpus weapon technology. This outcome means that our captured Tenno brethren remain at the mercy of Alad V, however, your loyalty to your comrades throughout this battle makes you worthy of reward. Tenno spies have returned intel allowing us to reverse-engineer the Detron weapon. I'm delivering these blueprints to you now.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Lotus_InvasionR.zhText: Tenno，Corpus 已成功阻止了 Grineer 对火星的入侵，阿拉德 V 正用全新的 Corpus 武器技术来奖励他的支持者。这一结果意味着我们被俘的 Tenno 同胞仍处于阿拉德 V 的掌控之下，然而，你在整个战斗中对战友的忠诚使你值得获得奖励。Tenno 间谍们已带回情报，使我们能够对德特昂武器进行逆向工程。我现在将这些蓝图交给你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Lotus_InvasionR.text:
Tenno, the Grineer have crushed the Corpus resistance and Sargas Ruk's units are now occupying positions on Mars. Your choice to allow the sacrifice of fellow Tenno must not have been easy. Fortunately, it never came to that and I have dispatched a team to recover our sleeping comrades. Though they are still a threat, take comfort in the fact that your efforts have slowed the pace of Grineer progress.

You shall be rewarded for your fortitude. During the invasion, Tenno agents recovered Brakk weapon blueprints which I am delivering to you now.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Lotus_InvasionR.zhText:
Tenno，Grineer 已击溃了 Corpus 的抵抗，而此时 Saragas Ruk 的军队已占据火星的各个据点。牺牲 Tenno 同伴的抉择想必让你不太好过。幸运的是，那并未成真，同时我已调派一支队伍去回收我们沉睡中的战友们。即便他们仍是一股威胁，但你所付出的辛劳已减缓 Grineer 扩张的步伐，希望能让你聊以慰藉。

你刚毅坚忍的表现，应当给予奖励。我现在将把 Tenno 特攻入侵期间所还原的 Brakk 武器蓝图投寄给你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MacheteBlueprin.text:
Tenno,

Our operatives have uncovered a hidden cache containing weapon data of Grineer origins. Use their secrets against them.

-Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MacheteBlueprin.zhText:
Tenno，

我们的特工发现了一个隐藏的缓存，里面包含了 Grineer 起源的武器数据. 用他们的秘密对付他们。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuest1.zhText: 寻找 Mirage 战甲头部神经光元

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuest2.zhText: 寻找 Mirage 战甲系统

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuest3.zhText: 寻找 Mirage 战甲机体

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.text: Solve the riddle from the Inbox message
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.zhText: 解开收件箱信息中的谜语

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.text: Craft the Mirage Neuroptics with your blueprint
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.zhText: 用蓝图制造 Mirage 头部神经光元

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.text: Craft the Mirage Systems with your blueprint
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.zhText: 用蓝图制造 Mirage 系统

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.text: Craft the Mirage Chassis with your blueprint
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestHint.zhText: 用蓝图制造 Mirage 机体

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.text:
Operator, 

Unfortunately, the nature of the Orokin Artifact you just crafted is a mystery to me. I simply cannot fathom its use. All I can tell you is that it was inscribed with the following nonsense:

Three parts, three acts, three riddles for thee - 
to revive the one wielding fantasy
Ancient gods so cruel, once ruled from on high
Can you name their peak where the land meets the sky?

Nothing in my database that sheds light on its meaning. You'd think the Orokin would have something better to do than scribble nursery rhymes on things. Oh well, I suppose not everything you craft can be of use.

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.zhText:
指挥官，

很不幸，您制造出来的那个奥罗金人工制品的本质对我来说是个谜。我只是无法理解它的用途。所有我知道的仅仅是它上面写着的这些毫无意义的话语：

为汝准备了三个部件，三幕演出，三道谜题－
为了复活那位运用幻想之人
残忍的上古神明，一度在高处统治着
你能说出他们的顶峰，那个大地与天空接壤之地的名字吗？

我的数据库中没有任何东西能帮助解释这段话的含义。您可能会想那些奥罗金人一定有比滥写童谣更有意义的事去做。噢，好吧，我想不是每样您制造的东西都会有用。

Ordis，船的中枢

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.text:
Operator, 

To think, Ordis thought that mess of words was nothing but the scrawling of some long dead hack. You saw more. Now you have the Neuroptics for a whole new class of Warframe. Very impressive Operator. 

Exciting news. Ordis found more writing on the inside of Mirage's Neuroptics:

To build the one you think witty,
seek the nymph who sang oh so pretty.
She lured him in with her song and a grin,
his wife must've thought it a pity.

I have no idea what that means, though if I had to describe its literary merit I might use another word that rhymes with "witty".

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.zhText:
指挥官，

回想起来，Ordis 曾觉得那堆话语只不过是某些死了很久的三流写手所编出的胡言乱语。但您却看到了更多。现在您拥有了一个全新职阶的战甲的头部神经光元。十分令人钦佩，指挥官。

好消息是，Ordis 在 Mirage 的头部神经光元的内部发现了更多的文字:

为了建造那位你所想的诙谐之人，
去寻找那位拥有魅力歌喉的仙女。
她以美丽的歌曲与笑容将他化为俘虏，
他的妻子一定觉得可惜。

我完全不知道它的意思，尽管如此，假如让我评价它的文学价值，我也许会使用一个与"诙谐"同韵的词。

Ordis，船的中枢
被隐藏的信息: 又一个谜题？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.text:
Operator,

It is as if the person writing these messages wanted Mirage to be found. Within the newly crafted Mirage Systems, Ordis found this:

One more act before your prize is caught.
An ancient sea creature, take a whirl or not?
Look for the monster that swallowed sailors of yore.
Make a mistake and you're sunk. Nothing more.

That's the worst one yet! Though, Ordis must admit, they are clearly referencing something. Operator, you appear to be good at this sort of thing, can you find the final blueprint?

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.zhText:
指挥官，

看起来写下这些信息的人希望 Mirage 被找到。在新建造的 Mirage 系统上，Ordis 发现了这串文字:

离你的奖赏仅剩一步之遥。
一个古老的海洋生物，它也许会旋转？
寻找那吞噬昔时水手的怪物。
任何失误都将使你葬身于海底。

这可真是至今为止最棘手的了！不过，Ordis 必须承认，那些文字很明显指出了什么。指挥官，您似乎很擅长解决这类谜题，您能否找到最后的蓝图呢？

Ordis，船的中枢
被隐藏的信息: 接近真相

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.text:
Operator,

You have done it! Mirage's Chassis is complete. You have all three parts, the only thing you have left to acquire is the Warframe blueprint.

Predictably I found something else inscribed on the Chassis:

Three acts complete, the end draws near,
soon Mirage will cause enemy fear.
A memory lost, to be reborn,
this new warrior rises, duty-sworn.

My theory, whoever wrote these wielded Mirage so deftly that nobody dared criticize her poetry.

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.zhText:
指挥官，

您做到了！Mirage 的机体已经完成了。您现在拥有全部的三个部件，现在您只需要取得这个战甲的蓝图。

我发现机体上果不出所料地写着一些另外的信息: 

三幕表演完成了，结局正在靠近，
很快 Mirage 将会使敌人感到畏惧。
失去记忆，以获新生，
全新的战士即将崛起，向其使命起誓。

指挥官您何时会把这个战甲加入你的军械库？

Ordis，船的中枢

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.text: A hidden message: The end is here
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MirageQuestInbo.zhText: 被隐藏的信息: 结局

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MovemberMessage.text:
Get your Moframes ready, Tenno! 
Last year, Tenno from all over the world, helped raise over $11,000 to support Men's Health issues by decorating their Warframes with mustaches in support of Movember.
This year, we're calling upon Tenno worldwide once again, and have provided all Tenno worldwide with the first of 5 in-game moustaches to help raise awareness for Men's Health during Movember! 
To sport your fancy new Mouth Brow, go to -- Arsenal > Appearance > Attachments > Auxiliary -- to equip.
Want to unlock the other awesome crumb-catching styles?Join us in supporting Men's Health during Movember by donating to the cause at www.warframe.com/movember.
As we reach our community donation goals, more in-game cookie dusters will be unlocked.You can only sport these babies throughout the month of November, 2015-- so support the Mo's!
Happy growing, Tenno!
#Moframe!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/MovemberMessage.zhText:
Tenno，准备好你的胡甲啰！

就在去年11月，来自全世界的 Tenno 通过在 Warframe 上装饰胡子来响应关注男性健康的胡子月活动，其捐赠金额超过了美金 $11，000 元。

今年，我们再次号召世界各地的 Tenno，并于一开始就在游戏中提供了五种胡子款式，协助各位 Tenno 对于胡子月关心男性健康的议题有更多认识。

炫耀你花俏的新胡子，前往「军械库」＞「外观」＞「配件」＞「特殊配件」来装备它们。

还想要解锁其他酷炫醒目的造型吗？欢迎在胡子月活动期间拜访以下网址，一同加入我们支持关注男性健康的行列：www.warframe.com/movember

一旦我们达成预定的慈善捐赠目标，游戏中将解锁更多有趣的胡型。你只能在十一月期间炫耀这些小玩意儿——所以，快去支持胡子月活动吧！

开开心心留胡子，Tenno！
#胡甲！#Moframe！

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/NightmareRaidRe.text: Bravery in the Pursuit of Justice

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/OctDarvoDeal1Bo.text:
So Tenno, word has it you've been working with a certain Baro Ki'Teer What? The name doesn't ring a bell? He had you searching all over for Cryotic. I guess maybe he wouldn't tell you his name, he does that. He thinks it makes him seem mysterious, it doesn't. Plenty of people know his name. Either way, I hope he lived up to his end of the bargain, not everyone is as trustworthy as your friend Darvo.

Wait, did someone say bargain? I did!

Here we go, for one day only, the Atterax is half price. Use this bladed motorized whip to give the Grineer a taste of their own medicine. Or, if you're like me, you might find it handy for snaking out the plumbing in your ship. It's up to you.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/OctDarvoDeal1Bo.zhText:
Tenno，听说你之前在和一个叫什么 Baro' Ki Teer 的人合作？什么？这个名字听起来不耳熟？他让你满世界找永冻晶矿。我猜他可能没告诉你他的名字，他那个人就是这个样子。他以为这样他看起来更神秘，其实不然。很多人已经知道他的名字了。不管怎样，我希望他遵守了他的诺言。因为不是每个人都像你的朋友 Darvo 这样值得信任。

等等，刚才是不是有人说了诺言这两个字？我说的！

好啦，我们言归正传。阿特拉克斯半价，只有一天。用这个电动式刀片鞭让 Grineer 尝尝自食其果的滋味。或者，如果你像我这样，你可能会发现这个鞭子可以用来疏通飞船的管道。随你怎么用。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/OctDarvoDeal2Bo.text:
Tenno, 

I guess I was curious, I paid Baro Ki'Teer a crate full of prime blue prints and two argon crystals just so I could sample his so called "delicacy". Those Oasis Jelly fish caused my throat to swell up for three days. Damn near killed me. What a rip-off.

But you know what's not a rip-off? My new bundle. Here's what you get: the Hydroid Warframe, the Nami Skyla blades, Triton Helmet, Para Carrier Sentinel and all it's fancy parts. Hell, I'll even throw in credit and affinity boosters, just because. 

Now that's money well spent.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/OctDarvoDeal2Bo.zhText:
Tenno，

我猜我只是好奇，我给了 Baro' Ki Teer 满满一箱 Prime 蓝图和两个氩结晶，只是为了尝尝他所谓的"美味"。那些绿洲水母让我的喉咙肿了三天。差点要了我的命。简直是敲诈！

但是你猜什么不是敲诈？我的新组合包。你可以获得: Hydroid 战甲，海波斯库拉对剑，海之信使头盔，鹦鹉搬运者守护和它所有的部件。该死，我连现金和经验值加成也扔进来，只因为。

现在，这钱花得值。
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/OctDarvoDeal3Bo.text:
Oh and let me guess, Baro Ki'Teer wouldn't even show you his face, figures. He thinks he's too good for you and me with his swanky clothes and exotic foods that taste like mud. Well you know what Tenno, when you buy from him that's what you're paying for. When you buy from Darvo, you get nothing but deals.

Allow me to provide a simple illustration. Today only, at 50% off I'm offering you the Amprex electricity rifle. 10,000 volts of shut your elitist face. I never wanted to go to his stupid party anyway.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/OctDarvoDeal3Bo.zhText:
来，让我猜猜，Baro' Ki Teer 不会露面，更不用说他的身材。他以为他那时髦的装扮和吃起来像烂泥巴一样的外国货对咱俩来说太好了。你觉得怎么样 Tenno，你从他那买东西的时候，得到的就是些这。可是你从 Darvo 这买东西的时候，得到的全是优惠。

让我简单地说一下。只有今天，我半价卖给你安培克斯电击步枪。让这 10,000 伏的好货色堵住你的嘴。反正，我从来没想与他为伍。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PS4ThirdAnniver.text:
Tenno,

For three Earth cycles you have been awake, fighting valiantly against all oppressors. Your bravery and unbreakable will has not been taken for granted.

As tribute to you and your achievements, please accept these gifts. They are a small gesture of my gratitude for all you have done for this System. 

Thank you, Tenno.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PS4ThirdAnniver.zhText:
Tenno，

在过去的三个地球周期，你不只是时刻保持清醒，还英勇地对抗所有压迫者。你的勇敢和坚定的意志并没有被视为理所当然。

作为对你和你的成就致以的敬意，请收下这些礼物。这是我为你对这个星系所做的一切的一点感激之情。

谢谢你，Tenno。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PS4_Exclusive_S.text:
Tenno, 

Warframe on PS4 has completed its first trip around the Sun! We recently celebrated our 1-year anniversary and have one last gift to share with you, a free exclusive Sigil designed by your fellow Tenno timbob90210! 

Thank you for playing Warframe, Tenno, here's to another great year!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PS4_Exclusive_S.zhText:
Tenno，

Warframe 已经在 PS4 上完成了绕行太阳一年的旅程！我们近期已举办了一周年庆，并在最后与您分享这份礼物，一枚由你们的 Tenno 伙伴 timbob90210 所设计的免费独家纹章！

感谢您游玩 Warframe，Tenno，从现在起迎接美好的另一年！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PSIVGiftMessage.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

You have fought long and hard for our cause. Take this gift as a token of my appreciation. 

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PSIVGiftMessage.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

由于我们的目标，你历经了长久的苦战。请收下这份礼物以代表我的谢意。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PlagueStarInstr.text:
Konzu has a problem, a massive Infested Boil has broken through Earth's atmosphere, crashing down outside Cetus. As the boil grows, it spawns rabid Infested putting all life on the plains in jeopardy.

How to play:

Visit Konzu and initiate the Plague Star bounty
1. Head out onto the plains and find a Toxin Canister hidden within one of the Grineer caves
2. Take the canister to a mixing machine and defend the machine while it mixes 
3. Deposit the mixed toxin into a drone
4. Escort the drone to the boil
5. Kill off the Infested released from the boil. 

The Toxin can be augmented in two ways:
1. Eidolon Phylaxis can be created from a blueprint purchased from Nakak, and increases toxin lethality
2. Infested Catalyst is made in the Bio Lab in your clan's dojo, and causes the boil to spawn a massive Hemocyte

You must have Eidolon Phylaxis and Infested Catalyst in your inventory to run the Advanced and Steel Path Bounties.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PlagueStarInstr.zhText:
孔尊遇到了麻烦，一个巨大的感染疖瘤突破了地球的大气层，坠落在希图斯外。随着疖瘤的生长，它产生了狂暴的感染者怪物，使得平野上的生命受到了严重威胁。

如何行动：

造访孔尊并开始瘟疫之星赏金任务
1. 前往平野并找到一个埋藏在 Grineer 把守的洞穴中的毒素罐
2. 携带着毒素罐前往混合器，并在毒素进行混合时防守机器
3. 将混合后的毒素放在一架无人机上
4. 护送无人机前往疖瘤
5. 杀死疖瘤释放出来的感染者

毒素有 2 种方式增强：
1. 夜灵抗体可以通过娜卡处买来的蓝图进行制作，可以增加毒素的杀伤力
2. Infested 催化剂可以通过氏族道场的生物实验室进行制造，可以诱使疖瘤创造一个巨型的免疫血胞体

你的仓库中必须同时拥有夜灵抗体和 Infested 催化剂才能进行进阶赏金任务和钢铁之路赏金任务。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventClan.text:
Tenno,

The members of |CLAN_NAME| fought hard to destroy Vay Hek's Void Keys and Torsion Beam Generators. The fight is over. The void has been secured. 

More importantly, with the information you secured we are that much closer to deploying Archwings.

To commemorate your efforts I am awarding |CLAN_NAME| with this trophy.

May you continue to protect the balance.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventClan.zhText:
Tenno，

|CLAN_NAME| 的成员努力奋战消灭了韦·海克的虚空传送门钥匙和扭转光束发生器。战斗结束。虚空得到了保障。

更重要的是，有了你所保护的资讯，我们离部署曲翼又更近一步了。

为纪念你们的付出，我将以这份战利品来奖励|CLAN_NAME|。

希望你能继续守护一切的平衡。

Lotus
摧毁传送门行动: 恭喜

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventConc.text:
Tenno,

It is done. By destroying the Grineer's supply of void keys you have ensured that they can no longer access the void at will.

More importantly, due to your tireless exploration we have recovered enough uncorrupted Archwing data to attempt reconstruction of the Orokin prototype. This will take time, I will keep you informed of my progress.

Many of you took great personal risk by repeatedly exposing yourself to Vay Hek's unstable Void Keys. With the keys destroyed, you will find that the effects from exposure will dissipate quickly.

Despite our victory today, we must remain vigilant. The Balor Fomorians are nearly complete and our fight is far from over.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventConc.zhText:
Tenno，

任务完成。在摧毁了 Grineer 的虚空之钥的支持后，已可确保他们无法再随心所欲前往虚空了。

更重要的是，由于你努力不懈的搜索，我们已经回收到了足够且未被腐化的曲翼数据。有了这些数据我们得以尝试奥罗金原型的重建工作。这需要点时间，我会随时与你保持信息同步。

你个人冒着极大风险反复暴露在韦·海克的虚空之钥之下，随着钥匙被摧毁，暴露的影响很快就会消散。

纵然今日取得了胜利，我们仍应保持紧觉。巴罗尔巨人战舰即将完工，战斗一触即发。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventIntr.text:
Tenno,

We have reviewed Baro Ki'Teer's Archwing datamass, much of it is corrupt but what little it does reveal is invaluable. We now know that more information exists and we must look for it in Orokin Derelicts locked in the void. 

Our mission is urgent. The Grineer have also learned about the Archwing technology and they are determined to destroy all traces of it before we find it. To do this, Vay Hek is using Void Keys and Torsion Beam Generators to force open Orokin portals. 

We must destroy his access to these portals. Our ability to recover Archwing fragments depends on it.

Careful Tenno. Vay Hek is using unstable keys. Cumulative exposure to the keys will have detrimental effects on your health, shields and abilities. Proceed accordingly. 

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventIntr.zhText:
Tenno，

我们已调查过 Baro Ki'Teer 的曲翼数据块，其中有很大的部分是损坏的，但完整保存的那一小部分则显示出这份资料的宝贵之处。现在我们得知还有更多资讯存在，我们必须到被封锁在虚空里面的奥罗金遗迹中找到它。

我们的任务非常紧迫。Grineer 也已经了解关于曲翼的技术，而他们打算在我们发现之前就消灭掉所有线索。为了完成目的，韦·海克使用了虚空传送门钥匙以及扭转光线发生器来强制开启奥罗金的传送门。

我们必须摧毁他的传送门。能否取得曲翼的片段数据就看这次行动了。

请小心，Tenno。韦·海克使用的钥匙很不稳定。持续接触到这些钥匙将会对你的生命值，护盾以及能量产生负面影响。据此行动。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventRewa.text:
Tenno,

Your first strikes against the Grineer are already forcing them to rally reinforcements. Fortunately, Void Keys are much harder to come by than Grineer clones. With effort we can destroy their entire stock of keys.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventRewa.zhText:
Tenno，

你对 Grineer 的第一次进攻已经迫使他们集结增援部队。幸运的是，获得虚空传送门钥匙比获得 Grineer 克隆人要容易得多。我们可以努力毁灭他们所有的钥匙。

Lotus
摧毁传送门行动: 继续战斗

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventRewa.text:
Tenno,

You have gone above and beyond. The Grineer are on the defense. Their supply of void keys is dwindling. 

To recognize your sacrifice I am giving you this weapon. Use it to defend the balance.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventRewa.zhText:
Tenno，

你表现突出。Grineer 在防守。他们虚空传送门钥匙的供应在不断减少。

为了你所做的牺牲，我要奖给你这把武器。用它维护平衡。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventRewa.text: Operation Gate Crash: Recognizing Your Sacrifice
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventRewa.zhText: 摧毁传送门行动:认可你的牺牲

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/PortalEventRewa.text:

I am impressed with your progress |PLAYER_NAME| but exposure to the void keys has left you vulnerable. Take these mods, I hope they will help you in your attack.

我对你的任务进度很满意|PLAYER_NAME| 但长期接触这些虚空传送门钥匙让你变得很脆弱。收下这些 MOD，我希望它们能在你下一次出击时派上用场。
