－Lotus
神圣意志：利刃豺狼的毁灭

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectFriendly.text:
People of the Origin System,

With the blessing of your credits and the power of the Void's sacred energy I have built a creature stronger than any other. Yes my children, the Void has made my new Razorback prototype impervious to evil and I will prove it. I am calling on all Tenno, heathen Corpus and Grineer to come to my lab and try to defeat my Razorback. 

And when you fail, the whole system will see the Void works its power through me. And then they will know that the only path to salvation is to Give Unto The Void.

The Void be the word and the word be Profit,
Nef Anyo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectFriendly.zhText:
始源星系的人民，

我用你们所给金钱带来的祝福和虚空那神圣的能量建造了史上最强大的生物。是的我的孩子，我将会证明虚空让我的利刃豺狼原型不会受到恶魔的影响。我在此呼吁全体 Tenno，以及没有信仰的 Corpus 和 Grineer 来到我的实验室并尝试击败我的利刃豺狼。

当你失败的时候，整个星系将会看到我拥有着虚空的力量。之后他们便会知道唯一的救赎就是向虚空进献。

当虚空为圣言时，此圣言即象征利润，
奈富·安尤

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectFriendly.text:
Mission accomplished Tenno. You showed the whole system that Nef is a charlatan by turning his own technology against him. 

I have just located a second prototype, you must destroy it before they can enter mass production. Take this reward and use it to bolster yourself for the next fight. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectFriendly.zhText:
任务完成了 Tenno。你用奈富自己的科技来对抗他并且给整个星系展示了他是一名骗子。

我刚刚定位了第二个原型，你必须在它进入量产之前破坏掉。收下这份奖励，用这份奖励加强你自己来应付下一次的战斗。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.text:
Formidable work. The Black Seeds are now in hiding and the Juggernaut Behemoth has been destroyed. Still, I fear some of its spores have made it into the wild, my fleet has been put on alert, I suggest you do the same.

And with that our partnership comes to a close. Good luck Tenno.

Frohd Bek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.zhText:
真是令人敬畏的表现。现阶段黑色种源已藏匿起来，躲避风头，而重装巨兽也被毁灭了。不过，我担心它部分的孢子已经流入荒野，因此我的舰队一直保持着警戒状态，我建议你也应比照办理。

那么我们的合作关系就到此止了。祝你好运，Tenno。

Frohd Bek
黑色种源天谴：分道扬镳

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.text:
Tenno,

Surely you've heard of the Black Seed? These so-called Corpus who are uninterested in profit and who solely apply themselves to undermining the will of The Board? These fanatics have raided Alad V's Mutalist labs, stealing never before released Juggernaut spores with the intention of unleashing them on my facilities.

Will you help me stop the spread of the new Infested? We will provide the location of Black Seed operatives to you. 

Good luck,
Frohd Bek

Oh, one more thing, to avoid the accidental release of Juggernaut spores, you must only use Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.zhText:
Tenno，

你肯定听过黑色种源的对吧？这些所谓无心于谋取利润、完全致力在破坏理事会愿景的 Corpus 们。这群狂热分子先前还突击了阿拉德 V 的异融者实验室，盗取了从未面世的巨兽孢子，企图将这些怪物放到我的设施中。

你能协助我阻止新型感染者的蔓延吗？我会提供黑色种源特工地点的情报给你。

愿你一切顺利，
Frohd Bek

对了，还有件事。你必须只使用近战武器，以避免巨兽的孢子意外释出。
战术警报：黑色种源天谴

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.text:
A little bend and they always break. The Black Seed has just admitted to growing a Juggernaut to maturity. You must destroy this abomination before it spreads any further.

Watch out Tenno... my scans show this one is big. Make sure you bring a lot of firepower.

Frohd Bek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.zhText:
就在刚才黑色种源坦言他们在我的驱逐舰上放了一只巨兽。你必须在这头该死的生物进一步传播瘟疫前宰了它。

当心，Tenno……我的扫描结果显示它可是一只庞然大物。你最好多准备点火力。

Frohd Bek
黑色种源天谴：探明巨兽

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.text:
Those Black Seed Operatives were small change but they coughed up the bigger coins. Go to Jupiter and bring us their Commanders, and take this <CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD| as a down payment for services rendered.

Frohd Bek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.zhText:
这些黑色种源特工本身没什么价值，但是他们吐露出了很可观的情报。前往木星，将他们的指挥官带来给我们。收下这份 <CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD| 头期款作为本次的劳务费吧。

Frohd Bek
黑色种源天谴：指挥官所在位置

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.text:
And so we move up the chain of command, from Commanders to Lieutenants. These fanatics have fled to Eris, bring them to us, they will know where the Juggernaut spores are hidden.

Frohd Bek
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.zhText:
因此，我们将指挥系统由指挥官提升至中尉阶级。把这些逃向欧罗巴星球的狂热分子带回来，他们知道巨兽的孢子藏在何处。

Frohd Bek

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.text: Black Seed Scourge: Fanatics near Eris
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectMutalist.zhText: 黑色种源天谴：阋神星的狂热分子

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
Tenno,

We have recovered vital information from the messages you intercepted. Take this with my thanks. 

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
Tenno，

我们已经从你拦截的信息中取得了重要的资讯。请收下我的感谢与谢礼。

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
Tenno,

You have quelled this new threat from the Grineer. Take this with my gratitude.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
Tenno，

你阻止了来自 Grineer 的新威胁。请收下我的感激与谢礼。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
Well done Tenno,

Your efforts have surely setback the machinations of the Grineer. Take this as a token of my thanks.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
做得好 Tenno，

你的付出已确实使 Grineer 的阴谋受挫。请收下我的感谢与谢礼。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
Tenno,

The Nightwatch Corps. are back. A lone survivor from a massacre near Ceres has revealed that they have set up base there. We need to know what they're up to. 

Travel to Ceres and intercept their communications. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
Tenno，

夜巡者部队回来了。据一位仅存的来自谷神星附近的大屠杀幸存者透露，他们在那里建立了基地。我们需要知道他们的目的是什么。

前往谷神星并拦截他们的通讯。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
Our last raid on the Nightwatch's galleon revealed a vast storehouse of supplies. 

Proceed to the coordinates and weaken the Nightwatch by stealing as many of their supplies as possible.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
上次我们对夜巡者帆船舰队的袭击暴露了他们的巨型补给品仓库。

接下来，到达这些坐标并通过偷取尽量多的补给品来削弱夜巡者部队。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text: Tactical Alert: Long Shadow - Mission 4 Success
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText: 战术警报：暗夜长影 - 任务 4 胜利

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
The Nightwatch Corps. are back. A lone survivor from a massacre near Ceres has revealed that they have set up base there. We need to know what they’re up to. 

Travel to Ceres and intercept their communications.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
夜巡者部队回来了。据一位仅存的来自谷神星附近的大屠杀幸存者透露，他们在那里建立了基地。我们需要知道他们的目的是什么。

前往谷神星并拦截他们的通讯。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text: Tactical Alert: Long Shadow - Mission 1 Success
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText: 战术警报：暗夜长影 - 任务 1 胜利

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
Well done, Tenno. You sent the Nightwatch Corps. a message they won't soon forget.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
干得好，Tenno。你给夜巡者部队留了条他们难以忘记的消息。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
A Nightwatch controlled Galleon has been spotted orbiting Mars. 

Provide cover while a lone Tenno operative raids the ship for intel and supplies.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
一艘夜巡者部队的飞船被发现在火星轨道上。

掩护一名要单独盗取这艘船舰上情报和资源的 Tenno 特工。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text: Tactical Alert: Long Shadow - Mission 3 Success
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText: 战术警报：暗夜长影 - 任务 3 胜利

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text:
The information you intercepted from Nightwatch communications shows they have acquired a Warframe cryopod. 

Head to the target location and defend the cryopod until it can be safely extracted.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText:
从夜巡者部队通讯中拦截到的信息指出他们获得了一具战甲冷冻舱。

前往目标地点并防守冷冻舱直到能够安全撤离为止。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.text: Tactical Alert: Long Shadow - Mission 2 Success
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectNightwat.zhText: 战术警报：暗夜长影 - 任务 2 胜利

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectPanaceaT.text:
Tenno,

The second defector is undergoing interrogation right now but all signs lead me to believe this is an honest defection. I have spoken with Steel Meridian and they have agreed to take both defectors into their fold.

You did a good thing today Tenno, take this emblem as a sign of my appreciation.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectPanaceaT.zhText:
Tenno，

第二名叛逃者正在进行审问，但目前的种种迹象使我相信他是名诚实的叛逃者。我已经与钢铁防线联络，他们同意让这两名叛逃者加入他们。

你今天做了件好事，Tenno，请收下这枚徽章以示我的感谢之意。

－Lotus
战术警报：紧急逃生－任务完成

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectPanaceaT.text:
Tenno,

Every so often, mutations in the Grineer genetic code produce individuals who refuse to fall in line with their superiors. Most are destroyed but some escape. One such individual has just contacted us from a training facility for a new type of Grineer fighter. Unfortunately, his message was intercepted and this defector is now fighting for his life. Defend this fighter until we can muster a proper extraction.

Go now Tenno, anyone strong enough to turn their back on the Grineer is worth saving.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectPanaceaT.zhText:
Tenno，

几乎每隔一段时间，就会出现从 Grineer 遗传密码所诞生，但却拒绝与他们的长官站在同一阵线上的个体。这些人绝大多数都遭到销毁，但还是有人成功逃脱。不久前这样的个体——一名新型士兵从训练设施与我们联系上。很不幸地，他发出的信息被拦截了，此刻他正为了生存下去而奋战着。全力保护这名士兵，直到我们调度到合适的撤离点。

即刻动身，Tenno，任何强壮到足以背叛 Grineer 的生命都值得挽救。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectPanaceaT.text:
Tenno,

Thanks to you, the defector is being debriefed and is providing us with important information about Grineer unit training. 

He has led us to an accomplice who is trying to escape a secondary facility. I need you to bring this defector to me as well. 

Please take this reward for your efforts.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectPanaceaT.zhText:
Tenno，

多亏了你，这名叛逃者正在接受盘查，他提供了我方有关 Grineer 部队训练的许多宝贵信息。

他会带领我们找到一位正试图由次级设施中逃脱的共犯。我要你把这名叛逃者也带回来见我。

有鉴于你的付出，请收下这份奖励。

－Lotus
战术警报：紧急逃生－任务成功

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text:
Tenno,

I've cracked it. Hunhow was using a tricky frequency, but not tricky enough. 

Now it's time to stalk them. Search nodes throughout the Origin System, if an Acolyte is present, I'll decode its signal and then you can teach it a lesson. Once one is found, I'll blow the whistle so that we can take the fight to them.

Careful, though, Tenno. These Acolytes have a thick skin, it's going to take a significant force to take one down for good.

Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText:
Tenno，

我成功破解了。Hunhow 使用了一组狡猾的频率，但他还差得远呢。

追踪他们的时刻到了。搜索始源星系中的节点，如果追随者出现，我会破译它们的频率，你可以给他们好好上一课。一旦有所发现，我就会泄漏他们的行踪好让你和他们大战一番。

Tenno，小心一点。这些追随者有着厚实的皮肤，需要强而有力攻击才能击败他们。

阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: The Hunt is On
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债: 追捕开始了

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text:
You're making progress, Tenno. But... now that you've witnessed the supernatural fortitude these creatures possess, you must realize that you have inflicted a mere scratch.

Take these items and continue the hunt. The Acolytes are still out there, hiding, waiting for their chance to dispatch me. It will surely take the combined force of all your brethren to put an end to them.

Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText:
你已经有了进展， Tenno。但……现在你也看到这些生物有着超越自然般得坚韧，你应该也意识到你对他们造成的仅仅只是刮痕而已。

收下这些物品然后继续狩猎。追随者仍然在活跃着，躲藏着，等待着杀死我的机会。与你的战友一起集结成联合力量来给他们画上终结符。

阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: Keep Up the Hunt
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债：继续狩猎

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: Now We’re Really Even
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债：现在我们真的互不相欠了

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text:
This was found on one of the Acolytes... consider your favor paid in full.

-Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText:
这是在一位追随者身上找到的……看在你们全力付出的份上。

－阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: Now We’re Even
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债: 现在我们互不相欠了

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text:
I'll admit it, you got me out of a sticky situation back there, so let's just call it even, shall we.

-Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText:
我得承认，你把我从那棘手的困境中拯救出来了，所以我们之间就算扯平了吧？

－阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Shadow Debt: Endurance
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债：挑战

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Our contract is complete.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 我们的合约完成了

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: Now We’re Even
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债: 现在我们互不相欠了

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Operation continues until all Acolytes defeated.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 继续行动直到击败所有追随者

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: It seems you have filed a fraudulent report regarding the death of all Acolytes...
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 看来你已提出了一份关于所有追随者的伪造死亡报告……

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: Outstanding Payment
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债：出色的报酬

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Cloaking Data Found
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 已找到隐形数据

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Acolyte Confrontations
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 对抗追随者

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Waves Defeated
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 波次完成

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Alad V Rescued
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债：继续狩猎

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: It’s time for you to pay back your favor.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 是时候偿还你的恩情了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: My Favor!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债: 我的恩情！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Shadow Debt
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Recover cloaking data from enemy vaults.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 从敌人资料库中寻回隐形的数据

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Hunt down and defeat the Acolytes.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 狩猎并且击败追随者们。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Hold out against endless waves of Acolyte forces.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 抵挡住无尽的追随者力量的进攻。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: Defend Alad V from Acolyte attack.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 防御追随者对阿拉德 V 的进攻。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text:
|CLAN_NAME|,

Don't think your efforts went unnoticed Tenno. Perhaps you lot could work for me someday?

-Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText:
|CLAN_NAME|，

不要以为你的努力没被注意到，Tenno。或许未来你 们可以为我工作？

－阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.text: SHADOW DEBT: A Notable Effort
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectSinister.zhText: 影子之债: 值得注意的努力

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.text:
You got all of them Nightwatch, right? Yeah, I know you did. 

Here’s that little something I promised. But just so you know, after this we’re square, so don’t go thinking I’m in your debt or nothing.

Cya, Tin Suit.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.zhText:
你搞定所有的夜巡者了，没错吧？对，我知道你办到了。

这是我先前承诺的小东西。但先声明，在这之后我们就扯平了，所以別认为我还欠你人情或者毫无回报。

再见啰，锡装人。
战术警报：暗蚀计划——任务完成

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.text:
Tenno,

Tensions between the Grineer and Corpus have flared unexpectedly and the area around Mars has become a hot zone. In the midst of all this I have intercepted this bizarre distress signal: 

"Help. Need extraction. Will trade for treasure."

The signal has since gone dark but I suspect whoever sent it knows more about what is going on here. Find the source of the signal.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.zhText:
Tenno，

Grineer 与 Corpus 紧绷的局势在火星区域意外擦枪走火，爆发冲突，该处已成为危险地带。在这一切陷入混乱中我收到一则古怪的求救信号：

"求救。需要撤离，会献上珍宝。"

求救讯号自此便消声蹑迹了，但我怀疑这则信号不论是由谁所发送，他都知情那里到底发生了什么事情。前去寻获这则讯号的源头。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.text:
Thanks for the assist, Tin Suit.

Okay, I admit it, I started this whole thing. Got the Corpus thinking the Grineer were ripping them off. The Corpus accuse Grineer and the next thing you know everything's gone bullets, blood and laser cannons. And while they're busy shooting each other, I'm free to take whatever I want.

Great plan right? It was… until the Nightwatch Corps showed up. Next thing I know, I'm in lockup and nobody's taking bribes. That is, until you lot come along.

So look, I've already sent you a little something for your trouble but if you could find it within your heart to send those Nightwatch fellas packin', then maybe I got a little something else for you too. Deal?

Maroo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.zhText:
感谢你的协助，锡装人。

好吧，我承认，这一切是我招惹起事端的。就我了解 Corpus 认为 Grineer 想对他们敲竹杠，于是 Corpus 与 Grineer 对质 ，接下来的事情你就知道啦，子弹啊、鲜血、激光炮满天飞。正当他们忙于相互交火之际，我也因此得以随心所欲地顺手牵羊。

很了不起的计划，对吧？本来是这样没错啦⋯⋯直到夜巡者部队现身。接下来我所知道的事情就是我被囚禁在看守所中，而且没人接受贿落。就是这样了，直到你前来搭救。

所以你看，为了补偿对你造成的麻烦，我已经寄了些东西给你聊表心意。不过若你还愿意让那些夜巡者的家伙们卷铺盖滚蛋的话，搞不好我还有点好东西可以给你。成交？

Maroo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.text: Tactical Alert: Project Undermine - Target Rescued
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.zhText: 战术警报：暗蚀计划——营救目标

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.text:
Tenno,

I decoded the following message from the data you found:

"The interloper has been arrested but refuses to reveal the location of the missing blueprints. Should I apply the pain sequence? -Gorth, Nightwatch Corps"

It appears, this prisoner does not have much time. You must bring them to me.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.zhText:
Tenno，

我从你寻找到的资料中解读出了以下信息：

"入侵者已遭到逮补，但坚绝透露失踪蓝图的下落。我应当执行苦痛程序吗？－高斯，夜巡者部队"

事情明朗了，这名囚犯所剩时间不多，你必须将他带来见我。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.text: Tactical Alert: Project Undermine - Situation Update
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProjectUndermin.zhText: 战术警报：暗蚀计划－最新情势

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProspectorIntro.text:
Tenno,

Councilor Vay Hek is vulnerable. The failure of Project Tethra was so devastating that he has been forced into hiding. This is our chance, I need you to find Hek and take him out. 

Hek has consolidated his remaining shipbuilding on Ceres. To protect the operation, he's sent in his personal guardsmen, deadly Prosecutor class fighters. Ever paranoid, Hek has each Prosecutor carry a locator beacon so he can track them at all times. His paranoia will be his undoing. Collect enough locator beacons and you can use this Frequency Triangulator to determine his whereabouts.

Do not assume this will be easy. Not only are the Prosecutors viscious melee fighters but reconnaissance shows their auras create a new type of shield barrier, impervious to most types of damage. Getting through those shields will be difficult. You will need to experiment to find their weaknesses. 

Go to Ceres, defeat the Prosecutors to locate Vay Hek, and then take the fight to his doorstep. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ProspectorIntro.zhText:
Tenno

韦·海克议员现在十分虚弱。泰特拉计划的重大失败迫使他躲藏起来。这是我们的好机会，我要你追查海克的下落并且把他除掉。

海克已经完成了他位于谷神星剩余造船厂的强化作业。他派出他的私人卫队——致命的判官级斗士——来保护生产作业。身为偏执狂的他，在每一位判官身上都安装了定位信标，以便随时追踪他们。这份偏执将成为他致命的弱点，一旦收集到足够的定位信标，你就可以使用这台三角频率定位仪来确认他的坐标。

切勿低估本次行动的难度。不仅因为判官是兇猛的近战斗士，根据情报显示，他们的光环会生成一道能阻绝多数攻击类型的新型护盾障壁。这些护盾非常难以穿透，你得试着找出他们的弱点。

前往谷神星击败判官并揪出韦·海克，在他的跟前大闹一场吧。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q10E1.text:
A long-time Tenno sympathizer has tipped us off to the location of a strain of experimental Grineer DNA containing technocyte.

The informant, a Grineer geneticist, requires the DNA samples for clandestine work being done to ensure Orokin technology can never be adapted for Grineer use. He knows that if his people harness the ancient technology, the Origin System is in grave danger.

Intercept this Grineer research vessel and extract each of the canisters containing the modified DNA. It is in our best interests that he is able to continue his work.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q10E1.zhText:
一名长期的 Tenno 支持者把一株包含了科技细胞的实验性 Grineer DNA 的位置告诉我们。

这名线人是 Grineer 遗传学家，他需要这个 DNA 样本进行秘密工作，以确保 Grineer 永远不能适应并使用奥罗金技术。他认定如果他的同胞能够驾驭这种古代技术，将会威胁整个始源星系。

拦截这艘 Grineer 研究船并夺取每一个 DNA 容器。使他的工作能持续下去，这将为我们带来助益。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q10E1End.text: Good work. Our informant can now continue his research. We have adapted some of his work on Grineer technology for you to use.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q10E1End.zhText: 干得好。我们的线人现在可以继续他的研究了。我们改良了一些 Grineer 技术供你使用。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q10E1Intro.text: The canisters containing the DNA are scattered throughout the ship. Security is high... stay alert, and eliminate all those in your way.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q10E1Intro.zhText: 载有 DNA 的容器散落在船中。这里守卫森严……保持警觉，并消灭所有妨碍你的人。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q11E1.text:
Known best for the robotic proxies that serve them, the Corpus have spent centuries perfecting their autonomous companions. More recently, Orokin artifact discoveries have led to significant advancements in the field of biomechanical engineering and robotics.

A Corpus biomech engineering firm called "Substrata" has been at the forefront of these breakthroughs. Their newest venture is an exceptionally lethal quad-robot nicknamed "The Jackal," which has become problematic for our cells in the field.

Infiltrate Subtrata's manufacturing ship and put a halt to production by destroying the vessel.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q11E1.zhText:
Corpus 花了几个世纪完善他们的机器人，并以这些机器人为自己代劳而闻名。最近发现的奥罗金神器让他们在生物工程学和机器人技术领域取得重大进展。

取得这些重大突破的就是"Substrata"，一家 Corpus 旗下的生物机器人工程公司。他们最新的研究是"豺狼"，一台无比致命的四足机器人，这机器人为我们的前线人员带来不少问题。

潜入并破坏 Substrata 的生产船以制止"豺狼"的生产。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q11E2.text: There is one last item to take care of. This Substrata ship houses the original prototype of ‘The Jackal'. Isolate the quad-robot's position and take it down. In addition to sabotaging their work, this will be good test of your skill.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q11E2.zhText: 还有一项任务。这艘船上载有"豺狼"的原始原型，找出这台四足机器人并除掉它。除了破坏他们的研究成果外，这也是对你技巧的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q11E2End.text: You have bought us much needed time. It will take them awhile to rebuild from this hit. Unfortunately, Substrata produced a number of units that are in active duty. This will not be the last time you encounter "The Jackal."
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q11E2End.zhText: 你为我们争取了不少时间。这下他们需要不少时间才能修复损失。不幸的是，Substrata 已经生产了好几台并投入服务。你往后的任务仍然有机会对上"Jackal"。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E1.text:
Rumors have surfaced of a human trafficking ring operating in the Inner District targeting one of our civilian colonies. The true nature of the activities is unknown, though it appears to be Grineer in origin. 

Infiltrate the cargo-freighter implicated in the allegations and collect intel on the ring.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E1.zhText:
谣言指有人口贩子正对我们的平民殖民地虎视眈眈。我们未能确定这些活动的真正性质，但看起来像是 Grineer 发动的。

潜入这艘可疑的货机并收集他们的情报。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E2.text:
An ex-Corpus blackmarket trader named "Ang" has been identified as a key player in the ring's activities. Ang has been abducting the people of the exposed colony and supplying them to the Grineer in exchange for safe passage through the district for his questionable goods. 

Intercept Ang's trade ship and interrogate him for more information.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E2.zhText:
一位名为"Ang"的黑市商人曾经为 Corpus 效命，他已被确定为人贩活动中的关键成员。Ang 一直绑架殖民地人民并提供给 Grineer 以确保他能带着可疑货物安全通过。

拦截 Ang 的贸易船并审问他以获取更多情报。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E3.text:
Ang: "I never asked Vor about the cargo, but the look in her eyes spoke volumes... there was a hunger there. I left well enough alone."

A disgustingly gargantuan woman, Co Vor terrorized her way through the Grineer upper chain of command. Devouring everyone who stood in her way, she found herself as Consul of the Inner District. Tipping the scales at over 1700 pounds, Vor became the spokesperson for a custom line of Grineer body augmentations for the morbidly obese. The augmentations are designed to hide excess flesh. Without it, Vor would be completely immobile.

Get aboard Vor's ship and find out what is going on.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E3.zhText:
Ang："我从没问过沃尔关于货物的事情，但她眼神意味深长……那里发生了饥荒。我早就不管了。"

一个令人讨厌的巨型女人，沃尔的副官利用 Grineer 高层施展她的恐怖手段。吞噬掉所有挡路的人后，她自封为内政领事。基于超过 1700 磅的体重，沃尔成为一个为肥胖症而设的 Grineer 肉体增强产品的客户代言人。这个增强产品用于隐藏多余的肥肉。没有它，沃尔会完全陷入被动。

登上沃尔的船看看到底是怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E4.text:
According to logs found on Vor's ship, a Grineer scientist was brought in to conduct research on an acquisition of Technocyte discovered on a derelict vessel. This exposed the crew to unknown properties, leading to an epidemic of cannibalism. With their human cargo depleted, Vor and her crew turned on each other.

Vor and the scientist escaped to a ship on the outer perimeter of her district. Infiltrate the ship and bring it down. We need to make certain that whatever it is they unleashed stops here.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E4.zhText:
根据在沃尔的船只上找到的航行日志，一名 Grineer 科学家被带到了一艘废弃的船只上进行科技细胞的研究。这却让船员们进入奇怪状态，导致他们开始啃食人肉。当他们的奴隶储备被吃光之后，沃尔和他的船员们把目光转向了昔日的同伴。

沃尔和那名科学家逃到了一艘在她的控制区域之外的船只。渗透进那艘船并获取资料。我们需要搞清楚他们究竟放出了什么东西。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E4End.text: We mourn the loss of our people. Thanks to you they did not die in vain. We now know that Technocyte has detrimental effects on Grineer physiology.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q1E4End.zhText: 我们为我们的人民哀悼。多亏了你，他们没有白死。现在我们知道了科技细胞对 Grineer 生理上的有害影响。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q2E1.text:
For years, the Corpus elite have embedded credit chips under their skin as a sign of rank and privilege. Now they have come to realize the chips are toxic.

A Corpus Deacon named "Solma" has begun a campaign to redesign the credit currency. He hopes to preserve Corpus customs while reducing the alarming decline of Corpus leadership. If Solma is successful, it could devalue our reserves and restrict our ability to purchase arms on the free-market.

Infiltrate one of Solma's freighters and collect Intel on his plan.

Solma: "We must forge a new path for our collective..."
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q2E1.zhText:
多年来 Corpus 精英部队都会在皮下植入硬币以示其优越和地位。现在他们终于意识到这些硬币含有毒性。

一名名为 Solma 的 Corpus 执事已经开始重新设计那些硬币。他希望在这个 Corpus 习俗得以保留之余可以令 Corpus 那令人担忧的领导人员消耗得以延缓。如果他取得成功，我们的储备将会贬值而我们在自由市场上购买武器时也会受到约制。

渗透 Solma 的一架运输机并收集其计划的资料。

Solma: "我们必须为我们的同伴开出一条新的出路……"

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q2E2.text:
It seems Solma's campaign has some very vocal opponents within his counsel. The majority see it as an affront to strict Corpus doctrine. In their opinion, those who perish as a result of the toxicity are sacrificing themselves to maintain a tradition that has existed for centuries.

Eliminating Solma is our best chance at preventing the campaign from gaining support. Get aboard his ship and dispatch him.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q2E2.zhText:
看起来 Solma 的计划有着非常多的反对者。多数人认为这在侮辱 Corpus 的信条。在他们看来，他们宁愿就算中一种会致死的毒也要继续保持一种已经延续了几个世纪的传统。

消灭 Solma 是使他无法获得群众支持的最好方法。登上他的船，让他永远消失。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q2E2End.text: Well done. With no one to champion the proposed redesign, we have effectively secured our reserves. We will continue to keep a close eye on this.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q2E2End.zhText: 做得好。现在没有一个人会提出重新设计硬币，我们能保证我们的储备了。我们将继续密切关注这件事。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q3E1.text:
For centuries, the Infestation have been viewed as a mindless, impenetrable mystery with no apparent motivation. Like a pestilence, they descend from unknown origins and wreak havoc. New information suggests that there might be more to the Infestation than meets the eye.

Our operatives have intercepted a communication from a Grineer artifact researcher named Vay Hek. He alludes to a potentially ground-breaking artifact discovery that could shed light on the Infestation.

Infiltrate the Grineer research facility and acquire additional intel on Hek's work.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q3E1.zhText:
几个世纪以来，感染者被视为一种令人费解的谜，没有任何关于此病的起源。就像瘟疫一样，没有起源，在大地上肆虐。新的信息显示，可能有更多肉眼无法察觉的感染存在。

我们的情报人员已经截获了一条来自一个 Grineer 工作研究员韦·海克的信息。他提到了一个潜在的、突破性的研究可能能够解释这种感染。

潜入到 Grineer 的研究设施并获得他们的研究成果。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q3E2.text:
It seems Hek and his team were able to extract information from the artifact which has lead them to a derelict Orokin ship. Information is vague, but we did intercept the following distress call from Hek originating from the vessel:

Hek: "We are overrun! They move with such purpose, almost like they are protecting something. It's as if they share a massive meta-consciousness... a hive mind of sorts. If this is true, can we assume the existence of an overseer?"

Get aboard the ship and eliminate the Infestation threat and extract Hek safely. We need to interrogate him.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q3E2.zhText:
看起来海克和他的团队能够从一艘废弃的奥罗金太空船上收集信息。信息模糊不清，但是我们确实拦截到了海克和他的团队从太空船上发来的求救信号: 

Hek："我们都透支了！它们的行动看起来有目的性，就像在保护着什么东西一样。就好像它们拥有一个巨大的共同意识……像一种蜂群思维，无数个个体只有一个意识操纵。如果那是真的，我们岂不是可以假设它们有一个首脑？"

登上那艘船，清除所有感染威胁，并将海克安全带出。我们需要询问他。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q3E2End.text: Unfortunately Hek is of no use to us. He is babbling incoherently about an "unfathomably horrible creature" that appeared and laid waste to his entire crew. It is clear he saw something very disturbing. Let us hope he recovers his senses.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q3E2End.zhText: 很可惜的是海克对于我们来说没有用。他只是一直在胡言乱语什么"令人捉摸不透的可怕生物"出现然后毁灭了他的整个船队。很明显他看到了一些令人不安的东西。我希望他能够恢复理智。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q4E1.text:
For many years, the Corpus have maintained a small set of patched-up Solar Rails. Created by the Orokin millennia ago, the rails allowed cheap and speedy interplanetary travel. A recent discovery of a two-sided rail sharing Pluto's orbit has shaken Corpus doctrine to its core.

Interestingly, one of the rails is aimed out of the Origin System to an unknown destination. If the Corpus are successful at activating the rail, it could have significant consequences for the Origin System as a whole.

Infiltrate the Corpus research vessel orbiting Pluto and gather more intel. Whatever exists on the other side should be ours to discover.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q4E1.zhText:
许多年来，Corpus 一直在维护一条小型的将就能用的太阳系航道。而几千年前由奥罗金创造的航道却能够实现廉价且快速的星际旅行。最近在冥王星发现的一个双向航道正在动摇 Corpus 学说的基础。

有趣的是，有趣的是，一条航道通向始源星系中一个未知的终点。如果 Corpus 成功的激活了航道，很有可能会对始源星系产生重大影响。

渗透到 Corpus 的冥王星研究船中并收集他们的资料。不管那条航道的终点是什么，都应该由我们来发现。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q4E2.text:
Evidence unearthed at a Corpus excavation site on a Plutonian moon points to the existence of an Orokin artifact aboard a derelict ship. This could be the key to re-enabling the rail. A Corpus research vessel is en route.

Intercept the ship and acquire the artifact before it leaves in Corpus hands.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q4E2.zhText:
Corpus 在发掘场发现的证据指向冥王星卫星轨道上的一艘废弃的奥罗金飞船上的一个奥罗金制品。这可能是启动航道的关键。一个获取了制品的 Corpus 研究船正在回程的路上。

在制品被送走之前拦截飞船并取得那个制品。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q4E2End.text: Excellent work. Our researchers have determined the artifact to be a key-pass. Unfortunately, it's only one piece to the puzzle. There are several more of these scattered throughout the Origin System. We have several of our best operatives working on this. Stay tuned, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q4E2End.zhText: 干得好。我们的研究人员已经确认这件神器是个关键。但不幸的是这只是拼图中的一块而已，还有更多神器散落在整座始源星系中。我们有几名最优秀的特工正在调查这件事情，保持关注，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E1.text:
We have received a distress call from one of our operatives following a lead on an abandoned artifact excavation site. The operative was tailing a Corpus security force that had been spotted coming and going from the site. Upon arrival at the site, he was overwhelmed by Infestation.

Infiltrate the facility and extract our brother.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E1.zhText:
我们收到了去探索一个废弃奥罗金制品挖掘地点的特工的求救信号。他发现了 Corpus 保安部队在此地来来往往。在他到达这个地点时，他被感染者侵害了。

潜入设施并拯救我们的兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E1End.text: Lotus: "It looks like someone beat us to it, as the ship is littered with dead Ravor soldiers and no sign of the Technocyte. I hate to say this, but I'm almost certain this is the work of Warframes. Not much of a surprise, as we are aware of the existence of rogue cells of opportunistic Tenno. We've acquired coordinates to a Corpus ship we believe to have received the Technocyte."
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E1End.zhText: Lotus："看起来有人抢先了一步，船上到处都是士兵的尸体，但却没有迹象表明这和科技细胞有关。我讨厌这么说，但是这个肯定是战甲干的。并不令人惊讶，我早就意识到会有游手好闲投机取巧的 Tenno。我们认为有一个船已经收到了科技细胞，现在我们已经拦截了其坐标。"

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E2.text:
Tenno Operative: "You came just in time! From what I could gather, the Corpus security force was sent in to extract their team of scientific advisors who were using the site for research on the Infestation. Things got of hand and the Infestation infection quickly spread. The team was extracted to safety on a nearby Corpus research vessel."

Infiltrate the research vessel and find out what you can about their work on the Infested.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E2.zhText:
Tenno 特工: "你来的真是时候！从我收集到的资料中发现，Corpus 保安部队被发送到研究员处以研究病毒。事态失控，感染迅速蔓延，研究团队被带到附近一艘 Corpus 研究船以保证安全。"

潜入研究船并看看你能不能干扰他们的工作。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E3.text:
The Corpus are on the brink of isolating the DNA that causes the infection and are in the process of developing it for use as a biological weapon. The original samples containing the infection have been sent to a Corpus production facility for manufacturing.

It is imperative you infiltrate the site and destroy every last sample.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E3.zhText:
Corpus 即将找到造成感染的 DNA 并准备以此发展成生物武器。一个原始样本已送交 Corpus 生产设施准备量产。

潜入这个生产设施准并摧毁每一个样本。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E3End.text: Good work. You have eliminated the threat of a potentially devastating biological weapon.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q5E3End.zhText: 做得好！你已经消除了毁灭性生物武器的潜在威胁。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q6E1.text:
Grineer Fleet Minister Cras Skelk has lived under the suspicion of possessing Orokin technology that weakens the will. Many accusations come from his detractors, and those that have experienced his power first hand. Here is what we know of the target: 

Skelk claims to be a self-made man. He rose from humble beginnings as a Grineer Freighter hand to the rank of Fleet Minister. Skelk's appointment was a surprise to those that knew him. He had little education, a 'denied' reproduction rating, and one of the lowest intellect scores seen in ambulatory Grineer. Yet, Skelk has an uncanny ability to influence those around him - incredible given his speech is nearly incomprehensible (he has an enormous tongue deformity). Perhaps Skelk's inexplicable rise to power has its origins in his humbler days. He worked Orokin recovery missions for the fleet. Could this be where he acquired Orokin Technology?

If Skelk truly does possess the ways of the ancients, there is no telling what else he has acquired. Infiltrate his ship and take him down.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q6E1.zhText:
Grineer 舰队长 Cras Skelk 被认为掌握奥罗金技术。有许多的指责来自他的反对者和他那经验丰富的手下。这有一些我们所知道的指责信息: 

Skelk 声称自己是白手起家的人。他从一个小人物成为一个 Grineer 舰队长。认识他的人都说他的就职是一个意外。他几乎没受过教育，生殖评级为"拒绝"，并且是全国智力最低的 Grineer 之一。然而，Skelk 有一种不可思议的能力来影响他周围的人-他的演讲令人难以理解。（他有一个巨大的畸形舌头）。也许他令人费解的掌权来源于他的 Orikin 技术？他在 Orikin 恢复舰队工作，也许正是这使他获得了奥罗金技术？

如果 Skelk 获得了了古人的技术，我们不知道他还获得了些什么。潜入他的船，抹去 Skelk 这个名字。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q6E1End.text: With Skelk gone, we can only hope that he did not pass along his knowledge of Orokin technology.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q6E1End.zhText: 随着 Skelk 的死去，我们只能希望他没有把他的奥罗金技术知识传出去。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E1.text:
For centuries Grineer cloning technology has been controlled by the Corpus, who have locked the Grineer into financial dependence for grafts and antidotes. Recently, the Grineer have begun experimenting with their own tech; a dangerous proposition.

It is in our best interests to ensure that the Corpus control all aspects of cloning tech. To allow the Grineer to control their own tech is tantamount to extinction for our people.

Infiltrate this Grineer research facility and destroy all traces of the cloning tech.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E1.zhText:
几个世纪以来，Grineer 的克隆技术一直被 Corpus 所掌控，并垄断了 Grineer 需要的的移植与修复技术。最近，Grineer 开始尝试自己的技术；一个危险的决定。

如果我们使 Corpus 控制克隆技术，才能维护我们的利益。一旦 Grineer 自己控制了自己的克隆技术，对于我们的人民来说是灭顶之灾。

潜入 Grineer 的克隆研究设施并摧毁所有克隆技术。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E1Intro.text: There looks to be several locations on this facility containing cloning tech. Expect heavy resistance from the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E1Intro.zhText: 看起来还有几个设施包含着他们目前的研究成果。希望 Grineer 人民会强烈抵制这件事。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E2.text:
Further intel suggests a disgruntled ex-Corpus scientific advisor named "Ayeri" has been providing the Grineer with classified cloning technology in exchange for Rubedo. We cannot allow this to continue.

Get aboard Ayeri's vessel and eliminate him.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E2.zhText:
进一步的资料显示一个叫"Ayeri"的 Corpus 科学顾问将要把分类克隆技术交给 Grineer 以换取红化结晶。我们不能让它继续下去.

登上 Ayeri 的船并消灭他。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E2End.text: With Ayeri gone, we have put a dent in Grineer plans to control their very own destiny.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q7E2End.zhText: 随着 Ayeri 的死去，我们已经大大削弱了 Grineer 控制自己命运的能力。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q8E1.text:
A long withstanding Corpus institution of economic propaganda, The Merchantry Temple for Exceptional Progeny (MTEP) breeds and feeds children Corpus economic doctrine. From the moment a child displays exceptional economic acumen, they are abducted and sent to the institution located on Mars... no questions asked.

A top Corpus executive named Beld Imoro has recently been appointed as Directorate of Curricula Development at the temple. Notorious for his ruthless business practices, Imoro will have unlimited access to these impressionable young minds. We need to ensure that these children are never subjected to his poison.

Infiltrate the ship carrying Beld to his new appointment and eliminate him.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q8E1.zhText:
杰出后裔商业圣堂（MTEP）是一间长期接受 Corpus 经济宣传的机构，以经济主义培育 Corpus 的孩子。当有孩子展现出优秀的经济天分，毫无疑问地… 这些孩子将会被强制送往位于火星的机构。

一位名叫 Beld Imoro 的 Corpus 高阶主管，最近任命于这所圣堂的课程发展董事会。Imoro 因残忍无情的生意手段而声名狼藉，而他将拥有无限的权限来影响孩子的纯洁心灵。我们要确保这些孩子永远不会受到他的摧残。

潜入载着 Beld 前往任职地点的船，然后消灭他。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q8E1End.text: Great work. School’s out... for now.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q8E1End.zhText: 干得好，放假了……暂时性的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q8E1Intro.text: Beld has had countless threats against his life. As a result, he now travels with a large security team comprised of robotic proxies. Tread carefully.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q8E1Intro.zhText: Beld 的一生中遭遇过无数险难，因此他现在都与一群由机械代理人所组成的安保队伍同行，请谨慎行事。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q9E1.text:
"Ava's Children", a long-respected Grineer charity program to feed starving off-world orphans, has come to our attention through an anonymous tip. Here is what we know:

A Grineer noble named Ava Izar started the program as a political podium. During the airing of her (now legendary) "Plea for the Forgotten" Ava's tear-duct implants malfunctioned. Stunned audiences mistook this as an emotional display, winning her the hearts and minds of the Grineer people. Now, under her direct supervision, the "charity program" operates as a front for child labor, producing the majority of Grineer munitions. The children, including Tenno, live shortened lives in orbital labor camps.

Infiltrate the ship carrying Izar to a political rally and eliminate her.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q9E1.zhText:
一个匿名的提示让我们开始留意这个救助外星饥饿孤儿的慈善项目"艾娃的儿童"，我们所知如下: 

身为一名 Grineer 贵族，艾娃 依泽通过这个计划登上政治舞台。在一个题为 "被遗忘者的恳求" （已经脍灸人口）的演讲期间，艾娃的植入泪腺发生故障。被迷惑的听众以为这是情感的抒发。艾娃从此便在 Grineer 帝国深得人心。在她的直接监督下，这个"慈善项目"暗中以这些孤儿作为童工生产 Grineer 绝大多数的军火。而孤儿们，包括 Tenno 在内，则留在轨道劳工营内渡过短暂的余生。

依泽正乘搭这艘船前往一个政治集会，潜入并解决她。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q9E1End.text: Great work. With Izar gone, the program has dismantled. Our children will no longer suffer for the Grineer cause.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Q9E1End.zhText: 干得不错！依泽已死，那个项目已然瓦解。我们的孩子将不再为 Grineer 而受苦了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/QuestCommitment.text:
|QUEST| requires several hours to complete. You will be able to pause the game, and your progress will be saved between missions.

Prepare wisely. Loadout access will be limited and regular Warframe activities will not be available until this quest is completed!

|QUEST| contains sequences of violence, frightening situations involving teens, and depictions of emotional abuse. It is intended for mature audiences.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/QuestCommitment.zhText:
《|QUEST|》可能需要几个小时才能完成。在此期间你将能够暂停游戏（但无法退出系列任务），并且你的进度也会在任务之间保存。

请充分做好准备。在完成此系列任务前，更换装备将会受到限制，并且无法进行一般的《Warframe》活动！

《|QUEST|》包含暴力场面、涉及青少年的惊险情节以及对情感虐待的描述内容。本系列任务是为成熟的观众所设计的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/QuestMessage.text: For completing this quest, you have been awarded <CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/QuestPromptInde.zhText: 你会帮助 Neewa 的人吗？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RaidRewardInbox.text:
Tenno,

We lost much during Vay Hek's assault on our Relays but we never lost our will to fight. Today, you risked all to show Councilor Vay Hek just how strong our resolve is. Today, you overcame all odds to show a criminal Tenno justice.

Take this Sevati Sekhara and wear it proudly. It is a symbol of your bravery and resolve.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RaidRewardInbox.zhText:
Tenno，

在韦·海克对我们中继站的攻击行动中，我们损失惨重，但我们永远不会失去战斗的意志。今天，你身历险境，排除万难，向韦·海克议员展现了我们的决心及 Tenno 的正义。

收下这纯洁饰冠，并骄傲地戴上它。这是你勇敢与决心的象征。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RaidRewardInbox.text: Bravery in the Pursuit of Justice

右舷吊舱已加固。很快，第五维度认知的几何体就将进行自我组装。她会活过来。你将拥有自己的战舰。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RazorbackArmada.text:
Nef Anyo is making his move. A fleet of transports carrying mammoth Razorbacks will soon converge on one of our relays. If any of these Razorbacks board the relay, the destruction will be total.

Early strikes have failed. Each Razorback is locked in a vault protected by a new cryptographic algorithm. I have designed a unique cipher to defeat this security, but it requires Cryptographic ALU; a resource found only in Archwing missions near Jupiter and Neptune. 

Hurry, build the cipher and destroy every last Razorback. We must never lose another relay.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RazorbackArmada.zhText:
奈富·安尤正在行动。一支运输舰队携带着巨型的利刃豺狼，很快就要在我们的一座中继站汇合。若是让一只利刃豺狼登陆中继站，后果将是毁灭性的。

先前的进攻已经失败。每一只利刃豺狼都被锁进了由新型密码算法保护的保险库中。我设计了一种独特的解码器来破解这种防护，但是还需要密码的算数逻辑单元；这种材料只能在木星和海王星上的曲翼任务获得。

抓紧，制作解码器并摧毁每一只利刃豺狼。我们决不能让又一座中继站失守。

－Lotus
全员警戒：利刃豺狼舰队迫近

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RazorbackArmada.text:
Tenno,

Nef Anyo's armada has been repelled, our relay is safe from the threat of attack. This surely won't be the last we hear of his Razorbacks, however. Stay vigilant for their return.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RazorbackArmada.zhText:
Tenno，

奈富·安尤的舰队已被击退，我们的中继所暂时脱离威胁了。然而这肯定不会是我们最后一次听到利刃豺狼的消息。对方势必会再度来犯，随时保持警戒。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RazorbackArmada.text:
Tenno,

You have proven your valor in battle today, but the machines are countless and do not rest. Take this reward and use it to continue the fight!

The Lotus

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RazorbackArmada.zhText:
Tenno，

今天你证明了你战斗时的英勇，不过这些机器无穷无尽，且不会停歇。收下这份奖励，并用它继续战斗吧！

Lotus

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventComm.text:
Tenno,

Our enemies tried to break us but failed. Thanks to you our brothers and sisters are home and ready to fight again. We are stronger than ever and we will not forget what you have done for us. 

The Corpus and Grineer now know taking on the Red Veil means taking on the Tenno. They can't be happy about our alliance and I have no doubt they will come after us again. When this happens, can we count on your support?

Forever in your debt,
Cantis
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventComm.zhText:
Tenno，

我们的敌人试图分裂我们，但是他们最终以失败告终。多亏了你们，我们的兄弟姐妹们才能重返家园，并已做好随时战斗的准备。我们绝对不会忘记你们为我们所做的一切。

Corpus 和Grineer 现在知道跟血色面纱做对就意味者与Tenno为敌，他们看到我们互相结盟一定不会高兴，我深信他们一定会再来对付我们。当他们再来的时候，我们还能从你们那里得到帮助吗？

永远欠你人情的，
Cantis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventInGa.text:
Earn enough points and the Red Veil will commemorate your efforts with an emblem and even a special Syandana.

Prison Locations:
Mars - Vallis
Eris - Brugia
Neptune – Nereid
Saturn - Numa
Uranus - Mab
Ceres - Cinxia
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventInGa.zhText:
赢取足够的点数，血色面纱会用徽章和一个特别的披饰来犒赏你的付出。

监狱地点:
火星 - 红谷号
阋神星 - Brugia
海王星 – Nereid
土星 - Numa
天王星 - Mab
谷神星 - Cinxia

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventRewa.text:
Tenno,

We are in your debt. The hostages you saved would have been doomed without you. Take this emblem. It shows your solidarity with the Red Veil movement. 

Remember, there are still many more operatives out there and we're counting on you to bring them home.

Cantis
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventRewa.zhText:
Tenno，

我们十分感激你。如果没有你，那些被你拯救的人质都将难逃一死。拿着这个徽章。它显示了你们在血色面纱活动中的团结。

记住，还有许许多多的特工在那，我们希望你能把他们带回家。

Cantis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventRewa.text:
Tenno,

You have brought so many of our comrades home. We never thought we would see them again, yet here they are, thanks to you. Take this Rakta Syandana, it is one of the highest honors bestowed on our operatives. The Red Veil would be proud to see you wear it |PLAYER_NAME|.

Keep up the fight Tenno,

Cantis
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventRewa.zhText:
Tenno，

你带回了许多我们的特工回家，我们从没想过会再次看到他们，真是多亏了你。我替特工们赠予你这件绯红披饰，这是我们最高荣耀的象征，|PLAYER_NAME| 当你穿上它时，血色面纱的各位会感到无比的骄傲。

继续努力战斗吧 Tenno。

Cantis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventStag.text:
Tenno,

This is Cantis of the Red Veil Resistance and I am asking for your help. You fight the Grineer and Corpus and so do we, that makes us allies. We aren't as strong as you and we don't have your weapons but we've pissed off those bastards just the same. Now they're coming after us, systematically capturing our comrades and holding them hostage. Using our brothers and sisters as pawns against us. Tenno, will you help us bring them home?

If you are going to do this, you must strike quickly and quietly. If you are seen, the enemy will execute the hostage before you can rescue them. Please, do not give them this chance. 

We can't offer you much but we do have large cache of Specter blueprints. Bring home our people and we will share these with you. Those who go above and beyond will receive a special token of our appreciation.

Thank you Tenno,

Cantis
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RescueEventStag.zhText:
Tenno，

这是血色面纱反抗军的 Cantis，我请求你们的协助，我们和你一样与Grineer 及 Corpus交战，这让我们结盟，我们并不像你们一样强大也没有你们的军火，但我们一样讨厌那些杂种，现在他们正在追捕我们，有组织的捕获组织成员使其成为人质，利用我们的兄弟姊妹来对付我们，Tenno，你可以帮助我们带他们回家吗？

如果你要做这件事情，你必须非常小心注意，如果被发现，他们会在你找到人质之前就将人质处决，请不要让他们有机会。

我们没法给你太多，但我们暗藏很多魅影蓝图，带特工们回家，我们会分享这些给你。那些表现突出的，我们还准备了特殊礼物以表达感谢之意。

谢谢你 Tenno，

Cantis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ResourceBooster.text:
Operator,

I have just learned that you are affected by a product recall. It turns out that the company who produces your ‘Resource Drop Chance Boosters', has discovered that solar flares were interfering with the booster's proper operation. They wanted to let you know that they are deeply regretful for this oversight and have credited your account with <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|AMOUNT| as compensation.

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ResourceBooster.zhText:
Operator，

我刚刚得知您受到产品回收的影响。原来是生产""资源掉落加成道具""的公司，发现太阳闪焰干扰了加成道具的运作。他们希望能让您知道，他们对这个疏忽实在深感遗憾，并将 <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|AMOUNT| 的白金置入您的账号作为补偿。

Ordis，船的中枢

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RoboticTauntA.zhText: 检测到微不足道的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RoboticTauntB.zhText: 威胁级别升级。分类: 微不足道。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RoboticTauntC.text: Prototype engagement test: Ready. Tenno destruction analytics: Recording.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/RoboticTauntC.zhText: 原型实战测试: 就绪。Tenno 歼灭分析: 开始录制。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SargasRuk_Invas.text:
He runs like a coward. He watches his profits crumble. Grineer feast atop the broken heaps of his defeated children. There was never any other fate. There was only ever one outcome. He knows what comes next.

You made the right choice. You became Grineer. You have earned your rewards.

And I, I will remember how you have served me.

-Sargas Ruk
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SargasRuk_Invas.zhText:
他如无胆鼠辈一般的落荒逃跑。他目睹了自己利益高塔的崩毁。而 Grineer 在他那些遭击毁儿女们的残骸丘堆上，飨宴作乐。不会有其他的命运。也是一直以来唯一的结果。他应当清楚了解接下来的事。

你做了正确的决定。你成了 Grineer 的一员。你已为自己争取到应得的奖励。

而我，我将记得你是如何地为我效力。

-Sargas Ruk

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SargasRuk_Invas.text:
You did not have to fight like you did. You chose to support us. You chose to serve us. Take this weapon, it will make you strong like us.
-Sargas Ruk
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SargasRuk_Invas.zhText:
你本无需如此奋战。而你选择协助我们。你选择为我们效力。带上这把武器，它会让你像我们一般的强悍。
-Sargas Ruk

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SargasRuk_Invas.text:
The way you fight, we cannot grow this in a test tube. You are a true warrior. I need more warriors like you. Continue to fight for me, there is more where this came from.
-Sargas Ruk
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SargasRuk_Invas.zhText:
那浴血奋战的格调，可是无法从实验槽培养出来的。你是个货真价实的战士。我需要更多像你这般的战将。继续为我而战，将来还有更多的机会。
-Sargas Ruk

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_Ba.text:
Tenno,

You have made a tough choice and followed through with decisive action. Wear this emblem to memorialize this battle.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_Ba.zhText:
Tenno，

你已经做出了艰难的决定，并果决的行动完成了本次任务。佩戴上这枚徽章以纪念本次战斗。

-The Lotus
雷工的复制人: 徽章

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.text:
Tenno,

What can I say? You tried to keep me from my cure but I won and you lost. I cannot blame you for your lack of support, my previous projects may have seemed "too aggressive" toward you. Can we put that behind us? 

I want us to be friends, let bygones be bygones. As a gesture of my goodwill I will give you the same bonus I gave my supporters, because who knows Tenno, you may still prove useful.

Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.zhText:
Tenno，

我还能说什么呢？你企图让我无法治愈；但是我赢了，你输了。我不能怪你们不帮助我，毕竟我之前的计划或许是「太过冒险」了一点。然而，我们可以让这些不愉快成为过去了吗？

希望我们能既往不咎，交个朋友。为了表示我的善意，我赠送你一份礼物，就跟我给予支持者的奖励相同。毕竟，谁知道呢 Tenno，或许你仍然能证明自己有用处的。

阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.text:
My path to good health is much clearer now. I must thank you for your unwavering support during these troubled times. I always knew the Tenno were warriors of principle but your vigor surprises even me. After that time I tried to capture and dissect you, I thought you might still be holding a grudge. Instead you rallied to support a sick man. Truly, the Tenno are saints. 

Or did you have another reason for supporting me? Here's your bonus. It's good to know your price, Tenno.

Alad V
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.zhText:
我的痊愈之路此刻已经更加明朗了，我必须感谢你在这乱世中对我的鼎力相助。一直以来，我都知道 Tenno 是群有原则的战士们，但你的气度依旧让我相当吃惊。在我试图捕捉并解剖你之后，我本以为或许你仍怀恨在心，但你没有。相反的，你反而愿意协助一位病人。Tenno，你们是圣人，真的。

还是说你们是为了另一个理由支援我的？这是你的奖励。对于瞭解你的价码来说很有帮助，Tenno。

阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.text:
The Void's capacity for forgiveness is as vast as its capacity for giving.

Tenno, you went against The Void and sided with its enemy. It's fortunate then, that The Void sees promise in you. It knows you are lost and wants me to give you something to help you find your way.

Remember this generosity the next time you are asked to make a choice.

With sincerity,
Nef Anyo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.zhText:
虚空宽恕的容量正如祂所能赐予大众的一样广大辽阔。

Tenno，你违背了虚空，立足于祂的对立面。然而幸运的是，虚空对你尚有期许。祂知晓你迷失了，并要求我赠送你一些东西来协助你寻回正途。

谨记这份慷慨，下一回便是你回应抉择的时刻。

诚挚的 
奈富·安尤

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.text:
Tenno, listen closely and you will hear the Void singing your praises. Through its divine will, that impure wretch has been defeated and a mighty blow was delivered to Tyl Regor and his unbelieving Dogs. 

For your efforts The Void has bestowed upon you a mighty weapon, but this weapon comes with a warning; what The Void gives, The Void may also take away. 

Do you understand Tenno?

With sincerity,
Nef Anyo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_En.zhText:
Tenno，仔细聆听，你会听到虚空正歌颂着你的礼赞。通过其神圣的意志，那不洁的恶徒已被击溃，泰尔·雷工与他无信仰的狗们皆受到了震撼痛击。

有鉴于你的付出，虚空赐予了你一把强大的武器。但这把武器同时也代表着一份警告——虚空所赐予，虚空亦得索回。

你明白了吗，Tenno？

诚挚的 
奈富·安尤

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_In.text:
Tenno, 

These intercepted transmissions promise the opportunity to strike at the heart of Tyl Regor's secret cloning labs but this opportunity comes with a difficult choice. 

Alad V thinks these labs contain a cure for the Infestation that riddles his body and he wants us to find it. Nef Anyo hates Alad and will do anything to keep him from becoming strong again, including destroying the cure he seeks. Both are offering to lead us to the labs.

You must decide which is the lesser of two evils. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_In.zhText:
Tenno，

这些拦截到的传输装置是个重挫泰尔·雷工隐密的克隆实验室中心的大好机会，但这份机会同时也伴随着一个艰难的抉择。

阿拉德 V 认为这些实验室中有着能让他的身体摆脱感染者干扰的治愈方法，希望我们能找出来。然而因奈富·安尤非常厌恶阿拉德，并且尽全力地阻止阿拉德再次强盛，这也包括了破坏他所追寻的治愈疗法。两者都能指引我们前往实验室。

你必须自行决定，两害取其轻。

-The Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_In.text: Intercepted Transmissions: Alad V vs Nef Anyo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_In.zhText: 拦截到的传送装置:阿拉德 V vs 奈富·安尤

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_Ty.text:
Poor Alad, thinks he's won ‘cause he's done the smash ‘n take with my science, but you'll just trade mutalist skin for manic; it'll be Alad the Tubeman then. Will that make me your Daddy, Alad?

And what of the other twits, Neffy and you lizardmen. Think you took but you gave… gave a gift of driven hate. So when my Tubemen come for you, look them in the eye, admire it, you made that hate.

Is this over? No... just beginning.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_Ty.zhText:
可悲的阿拉德，还以为大肆破坏，夺走了我的科学就是赢了，但你也只能使那层异融者的外貌，变成我的狂躁士兵而已；那么阿拉德变成克隆人，那我不成为你爹地了吗，阿拉德？

还有那群蠢蛋，小奈富和你们蜥蜴人。想想你夺去，但却留给我的……给我的那份驱动仇恨的礼物。当我的克隆人找上门时，看着他们的眼睛，仔细欣赏，你所造就的恨意。

结束了吗？ 不……这才刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SealabsEvent_Ty.text: This is all over then, is it?

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamDesc.text: The Sentient Hunhow seeks to destroy the Tenno by exploiting long forgotten secrets.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamDesc.zhText: Sentient Hunhow 企图发掘一些被长久遗忘的秘密来毁灭 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamFini.text:
Operator,

I am sorry, the Stalker, he suppressed my systems, I tried to warn you, but could only watch as he attacked. 

I'M SO ECSTATIC…relieved you survived. 

By the way, after the fight I found this broken sword in the lower chambers. I almost tossed it out the airlock, but I figured you might want it. It has been added to your inventory along with this sigil the Lotus left for you. 

Glad to have you back,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamFini.zhText:
指挥官，

我很抱歉，追猎者他……他压制了我的系统，我想要警告您的，但只能眼睁睁地看着您被他攻击。

我实在是太开心……我是说……我很庆幸您活了下来。

对了，我在下层大厅发现了这把破碎的剑。我差点就把它扔出气闸了，但突然想到您可能会想留着。这把剑和 Lotus 给您的纹章已经放到您的仓库里了。

真高兴您回来了，
－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamHelp.zhText:
<MINI_ARROW> <QUEST>《Natah》系列任务
<MINI_ARROW> 天王星：海王星接合点

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamMiss.text: Place the Operator in the Somatic Link
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamMiss.zhText: 把指挥官放入活体连接器

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamStar.text:
Tenno,

The Sentient has not been silenced. I have seen something and you are in danger.

When you are ready, we will face it together.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamStar.zhText:
Tenno，

Sentient 并没有沉默。我看见了一些东西，你正处于危险之中。

当你准备好，我们将共同进退。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SecondDreamStop.text: GET TO THE VOID CONTROL ROOM

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestCo.text:
Tenno,

The tomb is sealed, at least for now. Good work.

There's one more thing, when you were sealing the tomb Tyl Regor salvaged several things from the Sentient there. Use this Exilus to fortify your Warframe against what comes next. If you need more, Simaris has synthesized blueprints.

I fear Regor has more of the old technologies now. You may want to seek him out when you are ready to face him. He's become more dangerous than ever before.

-Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestCo.zhText:
Tenno，

目前至少已经将古墓封印住了，做得漂亮。

还有件事情，考虑到你所封印的古墓有着泰尔·雷工从 Sentient 那里抢救回数件物品，使用这个特殊功能槽连接器来强化你的战甲，以应对下一回威胁。若特殊功能槽连接器数量不够，中枢 Simaris 已经进行结合仪式并制造出蓝图了。

我十分担忧此刻雷工已经取得了更多古老的科技。当你整备完毕后便可以出发前去追查他的下落，当心他已成为了比过去任何一刻都要更为强大的存在。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestDe.text: Strange drones have appeared in the Origin System, help the Lotus find out what they are and who sent them.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestDe.zhText: 行迹诡异的无人机出没于始源星系，协助 Lotus 追查出它们究竟是什么，又是谁派它们来的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestHe.text: <MINI_ARROW> Play missions on Uranus until you encounter strange drones
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestHe.zhText: <MINI_ARROW> 在天王星上进行任务，直到遇见行迹诡异的无人机。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestIn.text:
Sgt. Scur-

You want to know why they are here? Cause I found it! The tomb! They should all be dead… trapped inside - but these ones are not, why? 

Be brave, Scur, for your brothers, sick and twisted in the tubes! New ideas are within our reach that could cure us all. Send the Draga to reinforce the location we discussed.

Scur, if you saw too many words I'm sorry, I forgot who I was writing to, so assuming you just read the big letters...

SEND DRAGA-KILL TENNO-HELP BROTHERS
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestIn.zhText:
Scur 中士——

你想知道为什么他们在这里吗？因为是我发现的！我找到古墓了！它们本应该全都死光的……本该被困死在里面——但是这些家伙居然没死，为什么呢？

要坚强，Scur，为了你的弟兄，为了试管中病痛扭曲的形体！这些唾手可得的全新概念可以治愈我们所有人，派遣疏浚兵增援我们所谈及的地点。

Scur，若让你看了太多字，我很抱歉，我都忘了是写给谁的了，就当你只会读最简单的吧……

派疏浚兵来——杀 TENNO——帮兄弟
拦截到的信息：泰尔·雷工

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.text: Track down Tyl Regor's Sergeant to learn the location of the tomb.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.zhText: 追查泰尔·雷工的中士习得知识的古墓地点。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.text: Find and scan the mysterious new drones.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.zhText: 找到并扫描神秘的新型无人机。
协助 Teshin 揭露真相。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.text: Guard the bomb until it detonates and seals the tomb.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.zhText: 守护炸弹直到成功引爆并封印住古墓。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.text: Keep Tyl Regor from entering the tomb.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestOb.zhText: 阻止泰尔·雷工进入古墓。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestPu.text: "The Lotus blossom has snapped shut, her true nature revealed. Now we shall see if codependence can be broken. Let us begin to unravel her long-hidden truth." -Teshin
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SentientQuestPu.zhText: "绽放的 Lotus 骤然阖起花瓣，其本性已然显露。此刻我们将一同见证彼此的互信基础是否因此裂解，让我们解开她深埋许久的真相吧。"－Teshin

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventE.text: Tethra's Doom - Hijack Fomorian Shield Cores
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventE.zhText: 泰斯拉末日 - 劫持巨人战舰护盾核心

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventE.text: Steal a Fomorian Shield Core so it can be destroyed safely. (Requires a Tethra Shield Cipher)
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventE.zhText: 盗取一个巨人战舰护盾核心并安全销毁。（需要一个泰斯拉护盾破解器）

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventH.text: Tethra's Doom - Hijack Fomorian Power Cores
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventH.zhText: 泰斯拉末日- 劫持巨人战舰核心

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventH.text: Steal a Fomorian Power Core so it can be destroyed safely. (Requires a Tethra Cipher)
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventH.zhText: 盗取巨人战舰能量核心并把它安全地销毁。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventI.text: Intercept Data Fragments to craft a Tethra Cipher.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventI.zhText: 拦截数据碎片来建造一个泰斯拉破解器。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventS.text:
Tenno

We must move quickly. We have learned the nature of Project Tethra, Vay Hek is rebuilding the Fomorian Fleet. His aim is nothing less than complete domination of the Origin System. Thousands of these monstrous ships are in production. The Grineer will become unstoppable if they are completed. We must not let this happen.

Our goal is to cripple these ships before they can be deployed. To do this we are going to target the Fomorian Power Cores, their most vital component. This will be easier said than done. The cores are heavily guarded and their precise location is a tightly kept secret. 

First we must find the cores. The Grineer are coordinating construction using a highly sophisticated encrypted communication system. To defeat this encryption intercept multiple Data Fragments and then combine them using the Tethra Cipher Blueprint I have sent you. When you have located a core, I will give you further instructions.

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventS.zhText:
Tenno

我们必须迅速采取行动。我们已经了解到泰特拉计划的性质，韦·海克正在重建巨人舰队。他的目的无外乎霸占始源星系的完整控制权。成千上万的可怕舰艇都在生产中。Grineer 如果完成生产的话，他们将变得无法阻挡。我们决不能让这种事发生。

我们的目标是在这些舰艇能够被部署之前削弱它们。要做到这点，我们要把他们最重要的组件巨人战舰能量核心作为攻击目标。说来容易，做起来难。这些核心戒备森严，而且它们的确切位置是严格保密的。

首先，我们要找到这些核心。Grineer 正在用一个高度复杂的加密通信系统协调建造细节。入侵这个密码系统，要拦截多个数据碎片，然后用我发给你们的泰斯拉破解器蓝图将它们组合在一起。当你找到一个核心时，我会给你进一步的指示。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventS.text:
We have a problem. Our analysis of Vay Hek's broadcast has revealed the existence of a second type of Fomorian Core. While we have been chasing Power Cores, Vay Hek successfully armed many of his ships with Shield Cores. He already has a head start, we cannot waste anymore time. 

I have provided you with a modified Tethra Shield Cipher Blueprint. It will let you locate these new cores. 

Beware, Vay Hek is ready for us now. He has seen our strategies and had a chance to evolve his own. This mission will not be easy. 

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventS.zhText:
我们遇到一个问题。我们对韦·海克的广播进行分析，发现还存在第二种巨人战舰核心。在我们追逐能量核心的同时，韦·海克成功地用护盾核心武装了他的很多舰艇。他已经有一个良好的开端，我们不能再浪费时间。

我已经为你提供了一个改良版的泰斯拉护盾破解器蓝图。它会帮你定位这些新核心。

小心，韦·海克现在对我们有所准备。他已经看到我们的战略，也有机会发展他自己的战略。这个任务不会简单。

Lotus
泰斯拉末日 - 情势异变

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventS.text:
Excellent, you have located a Fomorian Power Core. The Grineer are in the process of transporting it for installation. This is our chance to strike but this is also where things get tricky. We cannot destroy the core on the planet. The fallout from such an explosion would create a wasteland lasting for generations. Instead we must hijack the core and escort it to an waiting ship. From there it will be taken to space for destruction. 

This mission is risky. If the core ruptures there will be nowhere to run and death will be certain. 

Good luck Tenno,
Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ShipyardsEventS.zhText:
太好了，你已经找到了巨人战舰能量核心的坐标。Grineer正在把它运往安装的地方。这是我们进攻的绝佳机会，但是与此同时，这也是事情变得棘手的地方。我们不能在这个星球上摧毁核心。因为爆炸产生的尘埃会世世代代存留下去。所以，我们必须劫持核心，并把它护送到待命的舰艇上。这艘舰艇会把它载到太空并销毁。

这个任务相当危险。如果核心在中途被毁，没有任何办法可以逃生，一切都会被摧毁殆尽。

Tenno 祝你好运，
Lotus
泰斯拉末日 - 第二阶段

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SkateTacAlertCo.text:
Tenno,

Our operatives have discovered an unusually rich Cryotic deposit in a remote region of the Phobos desert. Curiously, intelligence reveals that the Grineer base at this location is patrolled entirely by aerial Hellion troops rather than standard ground infantry. The Cryotic may have had unforeseen effects on the local wildlife. Proceed with caution.

Note that this will not be a standard excavation mission. As we encountered before, this base is equipped with sensors capable of detecting large signatures of Void energy generated by more advanced Warframes and weapons. With this radar in place, and the entire Grineer battalion capable of flight, their forces would overwhelm you in a matter of moments. Slip in under the radar Tenno, and recover that Cryotic...at any cost.

Good luck,

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SkateTacAlertCo.zhText:
我们的特工在火卫一的偏远地区发现了储备异常丰富的永冻晶矿矿床。奇怪的是，情报显示在这个地区的 Grineer 基地的巡逻是由航空恶徒部队全面执行的而不是标准的陆战队。永冻晶矿可能对当地的野生动植物造成过不可预见的影响。所以行事要格外谨慎。

请注意，这不是一个普通的的挖掘任务。正如我们之前遇到的，这个基地配备了感应器。这些感应器能够检测到从高级的战甲和武器上生成的大量虚空能量。在适当的位置放置了这种雷达，再加上整个Grineer 部队都可以飞行，他们的军队在弹指一挥间就可以打败你。Tenno，从雷达下面潜入，不惜任何代价找到永冻晶矿…

祝你好运，

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SkateTacAlertRe.text: Your efforts are commendable, but we can still use your help. Take this to assist you on your next mission.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SkateTacAlertRe.zhText: 你的努力是值得称颂的，我们仍然需要你的帮助。带上这个，它可以在下一个任务中帮到你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SkateTacAlertRe.text:
Well done, Tenno. You have kept this vital resource out of the hands of the enemy. With most of our resources funneled into Project Archwing, I cannot offer you much for your service. Hopefully this will help in some way.

- Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SkateTacAlertRe.zhText:
干得好，Tenno。你成功地从敌人的手中守住了这至关重要的资源。在我们的资源大部分都投入到曲翼计划中的情况下，我无法给予你太多东西。希望这个能在某些方面上帮到你。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestConclus.text: The disappearance of the Arcane Machine has created a new mystery in the Origin System. Meanwhile, the Grineer have stopped hunting for Maroo and she has decided to go her own way.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestConclus.zhText: 秘奥机器的消失给始源星系制造了一个新的谜团。同时，Grineer 停止了对 Maroo 的追捕，她决定离开走自己的路。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestDescrip.text: Once the severity of the Grineer capture order was made clear to her, Maroo was more than willing to accept our offer of protective custody. In exchange she will aid us in locating the Arcane Codices.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestDescrip.zhText: 一旦 Maroo 认清到 Grineer 捕获命令的严重性后，她宁可接受我方所提供的保护性监禁。作为条件交换，她将协助我们定位秘奥法典。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestMarooDe.text:
Once the severity of the Grineer capture order was made clear to her, Maroo was more than willing to accept our offer of protective custody. In exchange she will aid us in locating the Arcane Codices. 

The following is an excerpt from our debriefing with Maroo.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestMarooDe.zhText:
一旦 Maroo 认清 Grineer 捕获命令的严重性后，她宁可接受我方所提供的保护性监禁。作为条件交换，她将协助我们定位秘奥法典。

以下摘录自我们对 Maroo 的任务情报。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestMission.zhText: 把 Maroo 带去见 Lotus
收回 Maroo 的秘奧法典
取得 Grineer 的秘奧法典
取得 Grineer 的秘奧法典

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestMission.text: Take the remaining Corpus Arcane Codices
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestMission.zhText: 取得那些剩下的 Corpus 秘奧法典
取得 Corpus 的秘奧法典

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestMission.text: Upload the Arcane Codices into Arcane Machine
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestMission.zhText: 将那些秘奧法典上传到秘奥机器

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestObjInbo.zhText: 阅读泰尔·雷工拦截的信息

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestOpening.text:
The rat Maroo takes us for fools. Find her, we must recover the new Arcane Codex before she sells it to the Corpus. If she no longer has the codes, you may use any extraction techniques necessary to learn their whereabouts. This interrogation can be her punishment, she need not survive.

You are commanded,
Tyl Regor
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestOpening.zhText:
Maroo 这鼠辈摆了我们一道。找到她，我们必须在她把新秘奥法典出售给 Corpus 前先行收回。如果法典已经不在她身上了，你可以使用任何必要手段拷问出他们的下落。这份审问正好可以当作她的惩罚，弄死了也无妨。

任由你发落，
泰尔·雷工

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestOpening.text: INTERCEPTED MESSAGE: Grineer Commander Tyl Regor
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestOpening.zhText: 拦截到的信息: Grineer 指挥官泰尔·雷工

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestOvervie.text: Find the thief Maroo and uncover the secrets of the Arcane Codices.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/SpyQuestOvervie.zhText: 找到小偷 Maroo 揭开那些秘奧法典的秘密

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashIntro.text:
Tenno,

A storm is brewing in the Origin System. The Grineer are massing troops and supplies while the Corpus stockpile gear and reinforce their strongholds. Even the Infested appear to be spreading at an alarming rate. With the major factions jockeying for power, it's our job to make sure that none of them get the upper hand. We will attack them strategically, sowing confusion in their ranks to keep them from achieving their goals. The balance must be maintained.

Over the next seven day cycles I will be alerting you to key Tactical Alerts throughout the system. Fight with determination and I will use the spoils to keep you supplied.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashIntro.zhText:
Tenno，

现在始源星系正酝酿着一场风暴。Grineer 正在集结部队与物资，Corpus 也在储存装备和加强据点的防御。甚至连 Infested 以惊人的速度在蔓延。而我们的工作就是与各大派系争斗，以确保没有任何一方能取得优势。在战略上，我们要攻击他们，并在他们之中种下混乱的种子以防任何一方达成他们的目标。必须维持住平衡。

在未来七天的周期之中，我会提醒你去参与整个星系中的战术警报。以决心去战斗吧，而我也会提供战利品来给予你充份的补给。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashRewar.text:
Tenno, 

Frantic communications show the enemy felt your first strike but there is still much more to be done.

I have attached an item that should help with your efforts. Keep fighting and I will supply you again.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashRewar.zhText:
Tenno，

这些狂乱的通讯内容已显示出，敌人已经对你的第一次攻击有强烈的感受，但仍有很多必须去完成的工作。

我已经附上了一项道具，对于你的努力应该能有所帮助。继续战斗，我会继续提供你补给的。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashRewar.text:
Tenno,

Your strikes are proving effective. The enemy is becoming confused and disorganized.

Take this reward and keep pressing the attack.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashRewar.zhText:
Tenno，

你的攻击被证实为是有效的。敌人现在正感到困惑及逐渐瓦解中。

收下这份奖励并持续进行攻击。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashRewar.text:
Your attacks are having a cumulative effect. The enemy is being stripped of the valuable resources they need to mount an offensive. Resources we will use to further our cause.

I have included another item to keep you strong. Put it to good use, this fight is just beginning.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/StormCrashRewar.zhText:
你的数次攻击已经累积出了效果。敌人已被夺去了安排进攻时所需要的宝贵资源。我们将会利用这些资源来促进完成我们的目的。

我已经附上了另一项道具来让你更加强大。善用它，这场战斗才刚开始。

Lotus
