/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertHallowe.text:
Tenno,

We lost contact for a moment… were you sleeping? Nightmares? Perhaps this will help you overcome your fear.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertHallowe.zhText:
Tenno，

我们暂时失去了一小段时间的联络……你刚刚睡着了吗？做了场噩梦？也许这能帮助你克服恐惧。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertHallowe.text:
Tenno,

This sigil shows you faced your fear and conquered your nightmares.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertHallowe.zhText:
Tenno，

这枚纹章证明了你勇于面对自身的恐惧，克服了自己的梦魇。

－Lotus
万圣噩梦 - 时间挑战

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertNinjaVa.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

You have honored The Conclave with your strength and perseverance. Please, take this reward as a token of your dedication.

-Teshin
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertNinjaVa.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你以力量与毅力荣耀了武形秘仪。来，请收下这份奖励以作为你对武形秘仪的奉献象征。

－Teshin
急速锋刃：武形秘仪奖励

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertNinjaVa.text:
Razor sharp Nikana clash with bullet fast Hikou in this amped-up deathmatch variant.

Win (Place in top 3) = 3 Points. Loss = 1 Point.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertNinjaVa.zhText:
锋利的侍刃与急速的飞扬在这场激昂的变种死斗战中相遇。

胜利（名列前3）= 3分。失败 = 1分。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertSnowbal.text:
Operator, alert! 

Ordis awoke from deep-diagnostic scans to find this item had been placed beside the central-heating exhaust vent. Surrounding it was a pile of melting snowballs and note that reads; 

"Merry Solstice to all, and to all a good fight." 

The notion that some shady individual is slinking through the exhaust system while we rest disturbs Ordis immensely. Shall I devise a way to vaporize this mysterious gifter should they return?

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertSnowbal.zhText:
指挥官，有警报！

从深度诊断扫描中醒来的 Ordis 发现这个东西被放在了中央暖气排出口的旁边。周围是一堆融化了的雪球，上面还有笔记写着：

"祝大家冬至快乐，并祝大家有个愉快的战斗。"

有个可疑的家伙趁我们休息的时候鬼鬼祟祟地在排气系统里穿过，这个想法让 Ordis 产生了极度不安。要我想一个方法在这位神秘送礼者回来时来蒸发掉他吗？

－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertSnowbal.text: A frosty skirmish of snowballs and minty melee mayhem.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertSnowbal.zhText: 一场冰冷的雪球小争斗和带有薄荷香味的近战骚乱。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertValenti.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Your dedication to The Conclave is matched only by your devotion to your Tenno brothers and sisters. Let this award be a symbol of your commitment to our cause.

- Teshin
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertValenti.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，
 
你对武形秘仪的投入之深，仅有你对 Tenno 兄弟姐妹的爱能与之匹敌。让这份奖励作为你献身我们事业的象征。
 
－Teshin
爱心 & 弓箭：武形秘仪奖励

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertValenti.text:
Kill with kindness in this special variant that mixes passion with precision.

Win (Place in top 3) = 3 Points. Loss = 1 Point.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlertValenti.zhText:
在这场混合着热切的爱与精准的特殊变体战斗中，心怀爱意地去厮杀吧。
 
胜利（名列前 3）= 3 分。失败 = 1 分。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Blacko.text:
Tenno,

My contact has informed me of a convoy of abandoned merchant vessels drifting in dead space. Seems like such a waste of good product to just leave it floating there when it could be on my shelves instead.

Reactivate the navigation consoles, and I can reroute them to a... secure location. After I take down the inventory of each ship, we can share the dividends, minus my usual finder's fee of course.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Blacko.zhText:
Tenno，

我的线人通知我一支被遗弃的商船护航队在太空中漂流。原本可以放上我货架的好商品就这么白白地漂浮在那实在是太浪费了。

重新运转船上的导航控制台，我可以把它们送到… 一个安全的地方。等我拿下每艘船上的仓库，咱们就可以分摊报酬了，当然了，减去我平时的中间人费。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Blacko.text:
Tenno!

You amaze me! My crew has been able to salvage everything on those ships, thanks to your work clearing out the hostiles.

Take this as a token of my gratitude... Just don't ask where I got it from.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Blacko.zhText:
Tenno！

你真是令我惊叹！多亏了你清理掉这些敌人，我的船员们可以来打捞回收那些船舰上的好东西了。

请带上这些礼物以聊表我的感谢之意……不过可别问我从哪弄到手的。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Blacko.text:
Tenno!

I see you made it out in one piece! That is good to hear. After a cursory review of the ship's inventory I think I may have found something that will piqué your interest. Please, take this for all the work you did.

Until next time,

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Blacko.zhText:
Tenno！

我看到你不仅做到了，还没受伤！这可是好消息。经过对船上库存的粗略审查，我觉得我可能找到了你会有兴趣的东西。来，为了你所作的努力，带上这个。

直到下次，

Darvo
将废弃商用船重新设定导航。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Overta.text:
Tenno, 

In the wake of recent Fomorian attacks, The Corpus are salvaging their crashed ships for anything of value. Tenno spies within the operation have identified a rover containing their most valuable finds. Your job is to hijack this rover and escort it to a safe extraction point.

Be warned, our spies also report that The Corpus are using new combatants in the field. These new enemies will surely complicate your mission.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Overta.zhText:
Tenno，

近期巨人战舰袭击后，Corpus 正在打捞他们坠毁的船舰，寻找是否有任何值钱的东西。深入敌营核心的 Tenno 间谍已经确认一台漫游者号装有寻获的贵重物品。你的任务是劫持漫游者号并安全地护送到撤离点。

注意，我方间谍同时也回报 Corpus 在这个地区采用了全新的作战单位。这批新型的敌人势必会使你的任务更加棘手。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Overta.text:
Mission accomplished Tenno. We have the rover and thanks to your bravery in battle, the rover’s precious cargo is undamaged. 

In return for your effort I have sent you a small share of the spoils.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Overta.zhText:
Tenno，任务完成。漫游者号到手了，多亏了你在战斗中的英勇表现，其中装载的贵重货物完好如初。

作为你努力付出的回报，我寄送了一小部分的战利品给你。

- Lotus
战术警报完成: 奇袭

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Shipya.text:
Tenno, 

We have received the coordinates of a factory developing artificial genomes for Tyl Regor. Our intel suggests that these genomes can restore broken links in the Grineer DNA sequence, allowing them to produce stronger clones in greater quantities.

This cannot be allowed to happen. Assault his forces at the factory, and intercept any intel that can tell us more about his experiments.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Shipya.zhText:
Tenno，

我们收到了泰尔·雷工正在研发人造基因组的工厂坐标了。我方情报指出这些基因组可以复原 Grineer DNA 序列中断开的链结，让他们得以生产出更大量更强壮的克隆人。

不能容许这种事情发生。攻击他在工厂的部队，并拦截任何能够透露给我们关于他实验的情报。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Shipya.text:
Mission complete, Tenno. We have setback the Grineer's plans here, and have gathered vital information.

I will call upon you again, once we have analyzed the data and formulated a strategy to deal with Tyl Regor.

Take this token as a reward for your actions today.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TacAlert_Shipya.zhText:
任务完成，Tenno。我们在这里挫败了 Grineer 的计划，并掌握到极为重要的信息。

一旦我们信息分析完毕并拟定出对付泰尔·雷工的战略时我会再次号召你。

请收下这份作为你今日行动的奖励。

- Lotus
战术警报完成: 凤凰拦截行动
战术警报: 凤凰拦截行动

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TenguEventInGam.text: OPERATION: Destroy Oxium Ospreys to retrieve rare Oxium alloy.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TenguEventInGam.zhText: 行动：消灭奥席金属鱼鹰获取稀有奥席金属合金。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TenguEventInbox.text:
Tenno,

Weeks ago we received intel about a Corpus raid on a little-known independent research facility near Eris. The Corpus made off with a scientific jackpot, the formulation of a rediscovered experimental Orokin alloy called Oxium. This lighter than air alloy has already been deployed in a new drone dubbed the Oxium Osprey which forgoes its support role in favor of dynamic attacks. 

With this new drone The Corpus think they have gained the upper hand but we will use this development to our own ends. Oxium could be the cornerstone of new Warframe design but first we need to research its properties. Go into the field, take out the new Ospreys and bring back the Oxium. You will be rewarded for your efforts.

-Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TenguEventInbox.zhText:
Tenno，

几周前，我们收到一个有关 Corpus 突袭阋神星附近一个鲜为人知的独立研究机构的情报。Corpus 偷走了一个科研成果，这是一个被称为奥席金属，重新发现实验奥罗金合金配方。这种比空气还轻的合金，已经被应用在一个被称为奥席金属鱼鹰的新型无人机上，它的角色从辅助转变为动态攻击。

有了这个新型无人机，Corpus 认为他们已经占得了先机，但是我们将使用这个技术来满足我们自己的需要。奥席金属可以成为新型战甲设计的房角石，但是首先我们需要研究它的属性。到战场上去吧，除掉这种新型的鱼鹰，把奥席金属带回来。你的努力会为你带来奖赏。

-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TenguEventRewar.text:
Tenno,

With your contribution we have already begun researching new Warframe possibilities. The research is ongoing but so far the results have been exciting. You will be updated further when concrete progress has been achieved. 

In the meantime, take this reward which is active immediately and continue to maintain the balance.

-Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TenguEventRewar.zhText:
Tenno，

有了你的贡献，我们已经开始研发战甲的更多可能性。这项研发是持续进行的，但是到目前为止的研发结果让人期待。当取得进一步的进展时，你会被告知。

与此同时，带上这个立即生效的奖励继续维护平衡吧。

-Lotus
奥席金属间谍行动：已完成

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennoBaumIntroI.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Endless war has brought destruction on the Origin System and its people. But none have been more affected than the System's children. We must heal their wounds, but we can only do so by working together. Tenno, put down your blade—it's time to lead by example. Show the people of this system your giving spirit so that they may do the same.

Any generosity you show to your fellow Tenno will be recognized and matched as gift to the System's children. You have already done so much to help, but any extra that you can give will go towards those in need. 

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennoBaumIntroI.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

无休止的战争使始源星系系和其中的人民遭到了毁灭，但受伤最深的莫过于孩子们。唯有共同合作，我们才能治愈他们的伤痛。Tenno，放下手中的利刃——是时候以身作则了。向星系中的其他人展示你的奉献精神，以让他们追随你的脚步。

你所展现的慷慨会被铭记，并成为星系中孩子们的礼物。你已经足够乐善好施，但每多奉献出一些，都会让更多的人获得帮助。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennoRecognitio.text:
Thanks for being a fan, using Facebook, appreciating Warframe and combining these virtues into successfully participating in our Tenno Recognition program! 

It is through your support that the Tenno enjoy a thriving community. 

As a token of our appreciation, please find the exclusive Abra Paris Skin available in your inventory.

We programmed it to appreciate being used.

Thank you for saving the Origin System, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennoRecognitio.zhText:
感谢您喜欢 Warframe、使用 Facebook 成为我们的粉丝，并且把这些美德结合起来成功地参与了我们的 Tenno 表扬项目！

正是因为您的支持，Tenno 才会有繁荣的玩家社区。

为了表达我们对您的感激，您会在仓库中找到限定版的帕里斯磨蚀外观。

我们编写了它的程序以感谢你的使用。

感谢你拯救始源星系，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier1I.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

I am elated with the Tenno's willingness to give. In recognition of that generosity, please take this gift. 

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier1I.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

我很高兴看到 Tenno 乐于奉献。为了铭记那份慷慨，请收下这份礼物。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier2I.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

Whispers of Tenno generosity have begun to echo through the Origin System. Others are rushing to thank you. They offer you this gift.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier2I.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Tenno 的慷慨传言已经开始响遍始源星系。有些人急切地想要感谢你。他们给了你这份礼物。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier3I.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

You’re an inspiration to those who suffered under the Grineer heel. Your actions have helped the System’s children in ways you could not imagine—here is another token of appreciation.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier3I.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你鼓舞了那些被 Grineer 压迫的人。你的行为以他们不敢想象的方式帮助了星系中的孩子们——收下这象征感激的礼物吧。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier4I.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

If only you could hear the praises they are singing for you. The Tenno have brought such joy to the System's children and their families. 

They offer you this in thanks.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier4I.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

如果你可以听到他们是如何颂唱对你的赞美就好了。Tenno 为星系中的孩子和他们的家庭带去了欢乐。

他们怀着感恩的心为你准备了这个。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier5I.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

Can you feel that, Tenno? A moment of peace has fallen upon the Origin System. The Grineer will strike again, but this time of giving has provided the children with a moment of respite. I always had great expectations of you, Tenno, but this goes beyond what I could have dreamed. This token cannot stand up against the generosity you have displayed, but I hope it shows my appreciation nonetheless. 

Your generosity will be honored for years to come.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TennobaumTier5I.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Tenno 的慷慨传言已经开始响遍始源星系。有些人急切地想要感谢你。他们给了你这份礼物。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TethrasDoomClan.text:
Tenno of |CLAN_NAME|,

The exceptional efforts of |CLAN_NAME| in thwarting Councilor Vay Hek have not gone unnoticed. Take this trophy and display it with pride, you earned it.

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TethrasDoomClan.zhText:
Tenno of |CLAN_NAME|，

The exceptional efforts of |CLAN_NAME| in thwarting Councilor Vay Hek have not gone unnoticed. Take this trophy and display it with pride，you earned it.

Lotus
泰斯拉的末日 - 氏族奖励

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TethrasDoomRewa.text:
Tenno,

Councilor Vay Hek has suffered a major setback. Just days ago he was preparing a fleet for certain domination, now he's scrambling to launch just a handful of Fomorians.

Do not let this victory go to your head Tenno. Vay Hek still poses a very real danger. He is still capable of launching enough Fomorians to be a credible threat. When he does, you will have to face them in the field. I am already preparing for the day that battle comes.

In the meantime, I would like to thank you for your efforts with this emblem. You have proven yet again that when the Tenno work together, we are unstoppable.

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TethrasDoomRewa.zhText:
Tenno，

议员 Vay Hek 遭遇了重大挫折。就在几天前，他还正筹备一支足以称霸的舰队，如今却只能仓促派出寥寥数艘巨人战舰。

Tenno，切勿因这场胜利而得意忘形。Vay Hek 依然构成着切实的威胁。他仍有能力派出足够数量的巨人战舰，形成真正的威胁。一旦他这么做，你们就必须在战场上与之交锋。我已为那场战役的到来做好了准备。

与此同时，我要感谢你们为这枚徽章所付出的努力。你们再次证明，当 Tenno 团结一致时，我们将势不可挡。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TethrasDoomRewa.text:
Tenno,

Councilor Vay Hek has suffered a major setback. Just days ago he was preparing a fleet for certain domination, now he's scrambling to launch just a handful of Fomorians.

Do not let this victory go to your head Tenno. Vay Hek still poses a very real danger. He is still capable of launching enough Fomorians to be a credible threat. When he does, you will have to face them in the field. I am already preparing for the day that battle comes.

In the meantime, I would like to thank you for your efforts with this emblem. You have proven yet again that when the Tenno work together, we are unstoppable.

Due to your dedication I have also awarded you with the four attached mods. Use them wisely.

Lotus

议员 Vay Hek 遭遇了重大挫折。就在几天前，他还正筹备一支足以称霸的舰队，如今却只能仓促派出寥寥数艘巨人战舰。

Tenno，切勿因这场胜利而得意忘形。Vay Hek 依然构成着切实的威胁。他仍有能力派出足够数量的巨人战舰，形成真正的威胁。一旦他这么做，你们就必须在战场上与之交锋。我已为那场战役的到来做好了准备。

与此同时，我要感谢你们为这枚徽章所付出的努力。你们再次证明，当 Tenno 团结一致时，我们将势不可挡。

鉴于你的付出，我也将随信附上的四款 mod 赠予你。请善加利用。

Lotus

Councilor Vay Hek has suffered a major setback. Just days ago he was preparing a fleet for certain domination, now he's scrambling to launch just a handful of Fomorians.

Do not let this victory go to your head Tenno. Vay Hek still poses a very real danger. He is still capable of launching enough Fomorians to be a credible threat. When he does, you will have to face them in the field. I am already preparing for the day that battle comes.

In the meantime I would like to thank you for your efforts with this emblem. You have proven yet again that when the Tenno work together, we are unstoppable.

Due to your dedication and exemplary performance, I have also awarded you with the four attached mods and a Gorgon Wraith. Use them wisely.

Lotus

议员 Vay Hek 遭遇了重大挫折。就在几天前，他还正筹备一支足以称霸的舰队，如今却只能仓促派出寥寥数艘巨人战舰。

鉴于你的付出，我也将随信附上的四款 mod 和蛇发女妖·亡魂赠予你。请善加利用。

Lotus

Councilor Vay Hek has suffered a major setback. Just days ago he was preparing a fleet for certain domination, now he's scrambling to launch just a handful of Fomorians.

Do not let this victory go to your head Tenno. Vay Hek still poses a very real danger. He is still capable of launching enough Fomorians to be a credible threat. When he does, you will have to face them in the field. I am already preparing for the day that battle comes.

Due to your dedication and exemplary performance, I have also awarded you with the four attached mods and a Gorgon Wraith. Use them wisely.

Finally, even amongst a group of warriors as fine as the Tenno, |PLAYER_NAME|, you stand out. Through your valiant fighting, you have distinguished yourself as one of our best. To honor your performance I am awarding you with this Quantum Emblem. Wear it with pride.

Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TethrasDoomRewa.zhText:

议员 Vay Hek 遭遇了重大挫折。就在几天前，他还正筹备一支足以称霸的舰队，如今却只能仓促派出寥寥数艘巨人战舰。

鉴于你的付出，我也将随信附上的四款 mod 和蛇发女妖·亡魂赠予你。请善加利用。

最后，即便在 Tenno 这样一支精英战士队伍中，|PLAYER_NAME|，你依然脱颖而出。凭借你英勇的战斗表现，你已跻身于我们最优秀的战士之列。为表彰你的卓越表现，我特此授予你这枚量子徽章。请自豪地佩戴它。

Lotus
泰斯拉的末日 - 胜利

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThanksForRemind.zhText: 我会继续踏上狩猎之途。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThirdAnniversar.text:
Tenno,

For three Earth cycles you have been awake, fighting valiantly against all oppressors. Your bravery and unbreakable will has not been taken for granted.

As tribute to you and your achievements, I have forged these Dex Sybaris rifles for you. Additionally, you will also find that the Dex Dakra and Dex Furis have been added to your inventory. This is just a small gesture of my gratitude for all you have done for this system. 
Thank you Tenno.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThirdAnniversar.zhText:
Tenno，

自从你醒来已经经过了三个地球周期，这期间你奋勇地对抗着所有的敌人。你的英勇与坚定的意志我们都看在眼里。

为了对你和你所达成的成就表示敬意，我已为你铸造了这些 DEX 席芭莉丝步枪来帮助你。此外，你还会发现 DEX 达克拉双剑与 DEX 盗贼 已经新增至你的武器库了。这是我为了感谢你对这个星系所作的一切而献上的小礼物。
感谢你 Tenno。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsBon.text:
It is evident that you will never stop honing your skill. For you know that a dull blade threatens its owner most of all.

Keep fighting, pupil.

Teshin
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsBon.zhText:
很明显你不会停止磨练你的技能。因为你深知，钝刀可是对主人最重要的威胁。

继续战斗吧，门徒。

Teshin

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsInt.text:
Pupil,

I have been watching you fight. Your rifle aims true, your pistols shoot straight, but your blade, your blade has become dull. Like a plow that has turned a thousand fields, you are blind to the edge you have lost.

Perhaps you think I'm wrong? Well, if you have something to prove, gather only your Melee Weapon and fight the missions chosen for you. These battles will be the whetstone that makes you sharp again. 

Succeed and you will be rewarded.

Teshin
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsInt.zhText:
门徒，

我一直从旁观察着你的战斗。你的步枪技术货真价实，手枪射击弹如雨下，但是你的刀刃……好比一把耕田了上千回的犁头般黯淡无光。你已陷入盲目，丧失了自身的优势。

或许你心有不服？好吧，若你想证明的话，身上仅携带近战武器前去挑战指派给你的任务吧。

取得胜利，你将赢得奖励。

Teshin

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.text:
You have only begun to scrape the rust from your sword. 

Keep practicing.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.zhText:
你仅仅只是开始将刀上的锈迹刮除了而已。

坚持练习。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.text: ONE THOUSAND CUTS: A good start
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.zhText: 千刀万剐：一个好的开头

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.text:
A sharp blade that misses, hasn’t cut a thing.

Stay focused.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.zhText:
锋利的刀刃错过了许多，只是还没有切过任何一样东西。

保持专注。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.text: ONE THOUSAND CUTS: Watch your enemy
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.zhText: 千刀万剐：注意你的敌人

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.text:
Pupil, 

Your blade is well honed. Your strikes cut deep. Take these rewards and use them in your progression so that you may never lose your edge.

I have provided one more challenge. Accept it, if you wish to become the sharpest of all.

Teshin
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ThousandCutsRew.zhText:
门徒，

你的刀刃已然磨亮，你的斩击刀刀见骨。收下这份奖励并在未来的旅途中善用它们，那么你永远不会丧失优势。

我提供了更多难题，如果你希冀成为最锋利的存在，那就接受挑战吧！

Teshin

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindDea.text:
Tenno,

Friends do things for each other and Tenno you have done so much for me. What kind of friend would I be if I did not extend my best deals to you? Things are a little bit hairy for me right now but that does not mean you are out of luck, I have had some of my closest associates setup these deals on my behalf. 

Now, I know you have a sword but do you have a great sword? If not then check out the Galatine, a true Great Sword. Nobody is going to mess with you if you have this thing, I swear. For today only, half off the usual market price.

Stick around. There are more deals where that came from.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindDea.zhText:
Tenno，

朋友之间要互相帮助，Tenno 你为我做了这么多. 如果不给你最优惠的价格，我还算什么朋友？现在虽然我的事情有点毛，但是这不意味着你也不走运，我最要好的几个同伴代表我准备了这些优惠。

现在，我知道你有一把剑，但是你有一把好剑吗？如果没有的话，看看这把迦伦提恩，一把真正的好剑。有了它没人敢惹你，我发誓。只限今天，市场价的一半。

别走远. 还有更多优惠。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindDea.text:
Tenno,

Things have been so crazy for me that I almost forgot to tell you about today's deal. Lately, it would seem that you are my knight in shining armor, so I am going to offer you the Paladin Bundle. You get the Oberon Warframe, Magistar Mace, Stug Gel Gun and Karak Automatic Rifle all at half off the usual market price. Pretty good, no?

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindDea.zhText:
Tenno，

我的事情太疯狂，我差点忘了告诉你今天的优惠。最近，你看起来似乎是我的穿着闪亮盔甲的骑士，所以我要为你提供圣骑士组合包. 你能拥有 Oberon 战甲，执法者钉锤，史特克凝胶枪和卡拉克自动步枪，全部只要市场价的一半。很便宜，不是吗？

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindDea.text:
Tenno,

All this time I have spent in incarceration recently really had me thinking about Earth. The lush, sprawling, overgrown, genetically mutated, super forests can be really scenic this time of year. I am not the only one thinking this way, forest inspired gear is very fashionable right now and guess what? I have the market cornered. So let's talk deals.

Here we go, today's deal is The Forest-Camo Skin Pack. Stylish skins for 13 of your favorite weapons all at half-price. This is the real-deal too, there will be no cheap knock-offs for Darvo's friends. What do you say?

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindDea.zhText:
Tenno，

最近我在监禁期间的所有时间，真的让我好好地思考了一下地球。郁郁葱葱，肆意扩张，杂草丛生，基因改造的超级森林，每年的这个时候风景会很优美。不只我一个人这样想，森林风的装备现在很流行，你猜怎么？我垄断着市场。所以我们谈谈优惠。

言归正传，今天的优惠是森林迷彩外观包。13 款你最喜欢武器的时尚外观全部半价。这也是大优惠，Darvo 不会卖朋友廉价仿冒品。你觉得怎么样？

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindGra.text:
Tenno,

It is good to be free. There is no way that neck breathing control freak is going to tell me what to do. I am my own man.

Speaking of Frohd Bek, I think you may be wondering about something he said. Usually information of this nature is very, very expensive but I am in your debt so I will pass this along at no charge.

Here is what I know. My father is scared, very scared. The Corpus are losing control of long held planets and the Grineer just keep pushing. Now they are working on something called Project Tethra. Old wheezy does not know what it is but he knows enough to be worried. Maybe your Lotus can make some sense of this information? Either way, it is not my problem. They are all just going to try and kill each other anyway. The most you can try and do is make some profit out of the whole situation, right?

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindGra.zhText:
Tenno，

自由真好. 那个控制欲强得要控制我呼吸的变态想告诉我要做什么是不可能的. 我自己做主.

说到Frohd Bek，我想你可能想弄明白他说的一些话. 通常情况下，这种性质的信息是非常，非常昂贵的，但是我欠你的，所以我就免费告诉你。

下面就是我所知道的. 我父亲害怕，很害怕. Corpus 正对他们长期持有的星球失去控制，Grineer 又持续施压. 现在他们在研究一个叫做泰特拉的计划. Old wheezy不知道这是什么但是他所知道的足以让他担心. 也许你的 Lotus 能理解这个信息的意思？不管哪种方式，这不是我的问题. 反正他们就是要试图去杀死对方. 你能尝试和去做的最多也就是在这种局面下赚点钱，对吧？

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindMes.text:
Tenno,

It seems I am again in a bit of trouble. Wait, before you go jumping to conclusions, I swear, this time it is not my fault. I used to belong to this organization, the problem is this organization has refused to accept my resignation. I guess certain people cannot live without my skills. This is understandable as I am very good at what I do. I just prefer to work without a plasma turret pointed at my head. I am sure you understand.

Now, I know what you are thinking. The last time you helped me you got a little more than you bargained for. Things worked out in the end though, right? Help me again and I will make it worth your while. Trust me.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TiesThatBindMes.zhText:
Tenno，

看来我又有点小麻烦了。等一下，在你过早下结论之前，我发誓，这次不是我的错。我之前属于一个组织，问题是这个组织拒绝接收我的辞呈。我猜有的人没有我的技能就不能生活。这是可以理解的因为我很擅长我所做的事情。我只是不喜欢有等离子炮对着我的头工作。我肯定你明白我的意思。

现在，我知道你在想什么。上次你帮我虽然比预计复杂一点。但是事情最后还是解决了，对吧？再帮我一次，我一定让你觉得值得。相信我。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TreasureHuntWee.zhText: 每周阿耶檀识宝物狩猎

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TurnInDailySima.zhText: <SIMARIS> 我已完成此次结合仪式。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TwitchPrimeInbo.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

You'll never believe this. I found the most peculiar Void Rift. The signals I'm getting from this thing are just unexplainable, it's like they aren't even from this system. But that's not even the crazy part...

I scanned a freaking FROST PRIME WARFRAME and a PRIME SYANDANA. Just sitting there waiting to be taken. FOR FREE.

I tried to pilot my ship into the Rift but there's some sort of ‘fourth-dimensional wall' that's blocking my passage. I can't go in, but you're special. Maybe you can retrieve those sweet, sweet, Prime items.

Your friend,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/TwitchPrimeInbo.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你永远不会相信这个的。我发现了最奇特的虚空裂缝。从中取得的信号根本无法解释，仿佛这裂缝根本不是来自这个星系。但这还不是最疯狂的部分……

我竟然扫描到一个 FROST PRIME 战甲和一件 PRIME 披饰。它们静静地在那里待人取走，而且不要钱！

我试图将船驶入那条裂缝，但似乎有一种"四次元墙"挡住了我的去路。我没法进去，但你是特别的。或许你可以取得那些甜美的，悦人的 Prime 物品。

你的朋友，
Darvo
我发现一些疯狂的东西

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.text: Today's deal, the Buzlok rifle at 50% off the usual market price.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.zhText: 本日特惠，巴兹火枪，市价五折。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.text: Today’s deal, the Penta grenade launcher at half off the usual market price.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.zhText: 本日特惠，潘塔榴弹发射器，只要平时市价的一半价格。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.text: Today only, the Illiac Armor Bundle for half what you would usually pay.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.zhText: 本日限定，Illiac 捆绑包，比你平常买的还便宜一半价格。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.text: One day only, the Kubrow Starter Kit at %50 off.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.zhText: 只有一天，库狛初心者套装五折优惠。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.text: Buy the Stay Frosty Pack for half price, today only.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.zhText: 半价购买停滞冷冻包，本日限定。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.text: Another day another deal. Today only, buy Harkonar Armor Set for half the usual price.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/Update15DarvoDe.zhText: 卖一天算一天。只限今天，用半价买下这套哈库那护甲套装吧。
别泄漏给我的竞争对手…
这些优惠只有你能知道

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ValentinesVaria.text: Kill with kindness in this special variant that mixes passion with precision.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/ValentinesVaria.zhText: 在这场混合着热切的爱与精准的特殊变体战斗中，心怀爱意地去厮杀吧。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorRewardInboxM.text:
Your triumph over Captain Vor was impressive, but your journey has only just begun.

Our enemies are abundant and their strength continues to grow. Your skills are formidable but the outlying planet regions are fraught with peril. Skill alone will not keep you alive. Accept this gift of <CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|. The Market contains powerful weapons and items that will serve you well. Expand your Arsenal and fight to restore the balance within this System. 

-Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorRewardInboxM.zhText:
你在对付沃尔上尉的战斗中取得的胜利令人印象深刻，但是你的征途才刚刚开始。

我们的敌人数量众多，他们的实力持续增长。你的技能是难以对付的，但是外围行星地区充满了危险。只有技能不足以让你活命。接受这个礼物<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|。商店里强大的武器和物品可以助你一臂之力。扩充你的军械库为了维护星系平衡而战。

-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntA.text: I am sworn protector of this system. Leave now or pay with your head!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntA.zhText: 我誓死保卫这个星系。你是选择离开还是葬身此地？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntB.text: I've sent word to the ruling Sisters. Reinforcements will be arriving soon.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntB.zhText: 我已向邻近星系通报。增援部队很快就会抵达。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntC.text: Are you still alive? I suppose it is better this way. I have room for one more head in my collection!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntC.zhText: 你还活着啊？这样最好，反正我的人头收藏室还能再容下一个！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntD.text: I look forward to meeting you.

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntE.text: Time to had another Tenno head to my collection.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntE.zhText: 可以再收藏一颗 Tenno 的头了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntF.text: You look weak. Nervous. I hope that expression comes out for my trophy case.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorTauntF.zhText: 你看起来紧张，虚弱。我想你是看到我的这收藏箱才露出这副表情的吧。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrize3.zhText: 确定铸造厂模块的位置

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrize4.zhText: 袭击 Corpus 的资源储藏处

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrize4Objec.zhText: 突袭 CORPUS 的资源储藏箱

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrize5Codex.zhText: 建造移除装置并获得导航模块

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.text:
Vor,

You have disobeyed a direct order by attempting to capture a Tenno marked for termination. Now that Tenno is roaming the system.

You were once our paramour but our patience is now dry. We have no interest in your Ascaris Bolt. Do not disappoint us again. Find and destroy the Tenno, then bring us it's husk for proof.

As you have been ordered,
Your Queens
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.zhText:
沃尔，

你公然违令，擅自捕捉被下令要处死的 Tenno，结果现在那名 Tenno 在星系中为所欲为。

你曾经拥有我们的宠爱，但现在我们将不再宽容。我们对你的蛔虫装置毫无兴趣。别再让我们失望。找到并消灭 Tenno，将他的外壳带回来以证明你的忠诚。

奉命行事，
你的女皇们
撷取到的 Grineer 信息: 违反命令

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.text:
Vor! 

The Tenno you were ordered to eliminate has broken free of your Ascaris Bolt. Do not think that our former liaisons grant you immunity. This failure disappoints us deeply. Effective immediately, you are stripped of your title and we are recalling your Elite Guard. 

Perhaps you need to learn personally, the threat these Tenno pose.

Your Queens
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.zhText:
沃尔！ 

我们命令你消灭的  Tenno 已经摆脱你的蛔虫装置。别以为我们之前的情分能给你免罪。你这次失败让我们非常失望。现在我们要剥夺你的头衔，并召回你的精英卫队。

或许你该亲自去体会，那些  Tenno 所带来的威胁。

你的女皇们

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.text: INTERCEPTED GRINEER MESSAGE: Your Final Disappointment
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.zhText: 截取到的 Grineer 信息:你最终又令我们失望

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.text:
Effective immediately. The destruction of the Tenno threat is our foremost priority. Failure to destroy a Tenno onsight will result in termination. 

As you have been ordered,
Your Queens
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.zhText:
消灭 Tenno的威胁 是我们目前的当务之急。而失败将会导致我们的灭亡。即刻生效。

现在你们已经收到命令了，
你们的女皇们

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.text: INTERCEPTED GRINEER MESSAGE: Attention All Grineer
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/VorsPrizeInboxP.zhText: 截取到的 Grineer 信息 : 所有 Grineer 注意

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarOnCorpusDesc.text: Community Goal: Kill Corpus Crewmen of all types to unlock a Double Credits weekend in March!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarOnCorpusDesc.zhText: 社区目标：击杀所有类型的 Corpus 船员来解锁在 3 月的双倍现金周末！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarOnGrineerDes.text: Community Goal: Kill Grineer Lancers of all types to unlock a Double Affinity weekend in March!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarOnGrineerDes.zhText: 社区目标：击杀所有类型的 Grineer 枪兵来解锁在 3 月的双倍经验周末！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarOnInfestedDe.text: Community Goal: Kill Infested Chargers to unlock a Double Resource weekend in March!
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarOnInfestedDe.zhText: 社区目标：击杀 Infested 疾冲者来解锁在 3 月的双倍资源周末！

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithin6.zhText: 追踪 Teshin 到小行星地带

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithin7.zhText: 潜入 Grineer 的小行星要塞

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinAWEndM.text: Boarding the Kuva Fortress will restrict mission access. Commit?
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinAWEndM.zhText: 登陆赤毒要塞会限制任务的进入。确认吗？

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinFinalI.text:
On an icy mountaintop a child, cold and scared met an old man, the prisoner of a poison oath. For the child, a frozen death would have been a peaceful end. Instead, they fought on and found a fire within themselves, a way to light the path ahead.

The old man was a traitor. He deserved death, but the child was wise and merciful, and freed him from his burden. With that, the child left the cradle behind and they became more than a Tenno, they became themselves.

Tenno, if you can find a way to forgive this old man’s deception, to trust him again, then he will forever be in your service.

Teshin Dax
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinFinalI.zhText:
在冰封的山顶，冻僵又受伤的孩子遇到了一位老人——一位被毒誓束缚的囚徒。对孩子来说，冻死也许是一个平和安详的终局。然而他不懈抗争，发现了存于自身的火种，发现了点亮前路的光芒。

这位老人曾是背叛者。他应该受到死亡的惩罚，但孩子聪慧而且仁慈，将他从重负中解脱。从此之后，孩子离开了摇篮，他成为了比 Tenno 更强的存在，他成为了他自己。

Tenno，如果你能够宽恕这位老人的欺骗，能够再次信任他，那么他也将毕生效命于你。

Teshin 禁卫

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinGiveIn.text:
Tenno,


Something has happened on Lua and my Sentries have become unresponsive. I need you to investigate immediately.


-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinGiveIn.zhText:
Tenno，


月球上发生了不明事件，而我的哨兵变得无法回应。我需要你立刻前往调查。


- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinQuestD.text: A disturbance in the Somatic Link prompts the Lotus to send operatives back to the Tenno Reservoir.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinQuestD.zhText: 活体连接的干扰迫使 Lotus 派遣特工回到 Tenno 储梦池。

<MINI_ARROW> Neptune: Pluto Junction
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WarWithinQuestH.zhText:
<MINI_ARROW> <QUEST>《第二场梦》系列任务
<MINI_ARROW> 海王星：冥王星接合点

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WelcomeBackInbo.text:
Tenno,

Welcome back. In your absence, chaos has brewed unchecked. The System needs you now more than ever. Take this Affinity Booster and use it to grow even stronger.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/WelcomeBackInbo.zhText:
Tenno，

欢迎回来。在你离开时，混乱不断。现在，星系比任何时候都更需要你。带上这个经验值加成，用它变得更加强大。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XB1SecondAnnive.text:
Tenno, 

Two Earth Cycles have now passed. You've fought to bring balance between the Corpus and Grineer factions, consumed by power and technology. You've repressed further mutation brought by the Infested. You've developed unimaginable power, skills and abilities through combat.

Through all your efforts, you've brought us honor.

Take these gifts, brave Tenno, as a reminder of your contributions to the Origin System.

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XB1SecondAnnive.zhText:
Tenno，

时间已经过了两个地球年周期，你奋力战斗，维持了执着于权力与科技的 Corpus 和 Grineer 派系之间的力量平衡。同时你也成功抑制了由感染者所影响的进一步变异。你已身经百战，成就不可思议的力量、技巧和能力。

借由你的努力，你为我们带来荣耀。

勇敢的 Tenno，收下这份礼物，这是你对始源星系所做贡献的铭记。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert1Desc.text:
Tenno,

The Grineer command have been impressed with the carnage your Kubrows have unleashed on the battlefield. Desiring the same power for themselves, they have ordered their Drahk Masters to earth to capture feral Kubrows and crossbreed them with their Drahk beasts. Do not let them complete their mission. Go to Earth and eliminate the Drahk Masters.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert1Desc.zhText:
Tenno，

Grineer 指挥官对你的库狛在战场上的凶猛表现留下了深刻的印象。由于渴望这样的力量能为他们效力，因此他们派出爪喀驯兽师到地球捕捉野生库狛，并欲与 Grineer 的爪喀野兽杂交繁殖。不能让他们完成任务，前往地球，歼灭爪喀驯兽师。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert1Rewar.text:
Well done Tenno,

Your efforts have surely setback the machinations of the Grineer. Take this as a token of my thanks. 

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert1Rewar.zhText:
做得好 Tenno，

你的付出已确实使 Grineer 的阴谋受挫。请收下我的感谢与谢礼。

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert2Desc.text:
Tenno,

We have just received word that the Grineer have captured specimens of a rare and deadly species of Serberis, a reptile indigenous to Earth. Extracting a toxin from their mouth glands, they have been able to use the poison to make the whips of Scorpion soldiers even more lethal. You must meet this new threat head on and eliminate them.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert2Desc.zhText:
Tenno，

我们收到消息指出，Grineer 成功捕获到原生于地球，稀有而致命并被称之为""地狱守门者""的爬虫类样本。萃取出它们口中分泌的毒素后，Grineer 便能在天蝎士兵的鞭子上喂毒，使他们更为致命。你必须正面迎击这起新威胁并歼灭他们。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert2Rewar.text:
Tenno,

You have quelled this new threat from the Grineer. Take this with my gratitude. 

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert2Rewar.zhText:
Tenno，

你阻止了来自 Grineer 的新威胁。请收下我的感激与谢礼。

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert3Desc.text:
You have learned well, Tenno. Through countless assaults into enemy space, you have wreaked havoc among our foes. But our enemy has learned as much about us as we have about them. They are adapting. Their newest trick? Speed. Using lightweight aura mods, specialized Grineer can now match your speed and cover large distances with ease. I am telling you this because you will encounter these soldiers on your next mission. There is an emergency broadcast that I need intercepted immediately. The Grineer will try and stop you. You will show them that it takes more than speed to defeat the Tenno.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert3Desc.zhText:
你学得很快，Tenno。经过深入敌营战斗无数回，你在我们的敌人间已经肆虐无阻。但敌方尽可能的学习了解我们，就跟我们学习他们一样。他们正在适应中，而最新的花招是什么呢？答案是速度。使用轻量化光环 MOD 特化过的 Grineer 现在跟得上你的脚步，长程行军也是轻而易举。我告诉你是因为下个任务你将会遭遇这些士兵。有一条我需要你立刻进行拦截的紧急广播，这些 Grineer 会试着阻止你。你会向他们展示这点速度可不足以击败 Tenno。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert3Rewar.text:
Tenno,

We have recovered vital information from the messages you intercepted. Take this with my thanks. 

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

- The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert3Rewar.zhText:
Tenno，

我们已经从你拦截的信息中取得了重要的资讯。请收下我的感谢与谢礼。

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert4Desc.text:
Tenno,

The Archwing Project has been a great success. Their agility and firepower has put fear back in the enemy. In response, The Corpus have dispatched Rangers to repair the damage we inflicted on their ships. Kill them before they can make these ships combat ready once more. 

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert4Desc.zhText:
Tenno，

曲翼计划取得了卓越性的成功，它们的迅捷与火力让敌人回到恐惧之中。由于我们对 Corpus 的船舰造成损伤，他们只好派出突击队进行修复工程。在他们的船舰重新回到备战状态前做掉他们。

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert4Rewar.text:
Tenno,

You have struck the Corpus a crippling blow this day. Accept this with my thanks.

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert4Rewar.zhText:
Tenno，

你给予了 Corpus 沉重的打击。请收下我的感谢与谢礼。

<CREDITS>|CREDIT_REWARD|

－Lotus

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert4ToolT.text: Exterminate the forces repairing the Corpus Fleet.
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/XmasAlert4ToolT.zhText: 歼灭 Corpus 船舰的修复队。

/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/u18CodeRedempti.text:
Tenno,

This package just came into the shop for you. I almost tossed it thinking it was some sort of unwanted solicitation but then I peeked inside, there's some good stuff in here!

Do you know who sent it? All it says is, "Thanks for your interest!" I wonder what that means?

Oh well. Enjoy,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/G1Quests/u18CodeRedempti.zhText:
Tenno，

这份包裹是为了你刚进货的。我差点以为是什么没人要的商品，刚想要把它给扔了。还好我偷偷瞄了一眼，里面有些好东西呢！

你知道这是谁寄来的吗？上面唯一的消息说："感谢你的关心！"我正奇怪这是什么意思？

好吧。总之，请享用吧。
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteAreaCast.text: The Orokin named Alad V is our target, but we'll fight you if you wish.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteAreaCast.zhText: 那位名叫阿拉德 V 的奥罗金是我们的目标，但如果你要挡道的话我们也会连你一起干掉。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteAreaCast.text: He seeks only profit. He uses you.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteAreaCast.zhText: 他只是为了谋取利益，他在利用你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteAreaCast.text: This Orokin seeks to profit from our demise.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteAreaCast.zhText: 这位奥罗金企图从我们的灭亡中谋取利益。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteControlT.text: This one has caused much suffering and yet you protect him... why?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteControlT.zhText: 这家伙造成很大的苦难，如今你还要护着他……为什么？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteControlT.text: You have lost your way Tenno, I will help you find it.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteControlT.zhText: 你已经迷失方向了 Tenno，我会帮你找回你应走的道路。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteControlT.text: You are not the one we seek.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteControlT.zhText: 你不是我们要寻找的目标。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteDuellist.text: |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|, your arrogance will be your demise.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteDuellist.zhText: |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|，你会因为自身的傲慢终将灭亡。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteDuellist.text: |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|, your Lotus will watch you perish.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteDuellist.zhText: |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|，你的 Lotus 会亲眼目睹你的毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteHeavyDef.text: Do not rest, Tenno, you are not safe.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteHeavyDef.zhText: 疲于应对吧，Tenno，你还没有脱险。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteHeavyTau.text: We will not tolerate this disturbance.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteHeavyTau.zhText: 我们绝不容许受到干扰。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteHeavyTau.text: We will not abide this insurrection.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteHeavyTau.zhText: 我们无法容忍这起叛乱。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteRogueDef.text: We will return. We will complete this judgement.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteRogueDef.zhText: 我们将回归。我们将完成这场审判。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteRogueTau.text: Our fight is not with you Tenno.
I see you are still their servants.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteRogueTau.zhText: 我看你仍是他们的奴仆。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteStrikerD.text: We will yet find a way.

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteStrikerT.text: It is not time for your trial yet.
Virtue gives us the strength of a thousand Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/AcolyteStrikerT.zhText: 美德赐予我们的力量足以媲美千名 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt1.zhText: 攻击系统分类: 战火。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt2.zhText: 攻击系统结论：焚毁敌人。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt3.text: Incursion probability: Negligent. Tenno Mortality Probability: Inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt3.zhText: 侵入概率: 忽略不计。Tenno 死亡概率: 不可避免。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt4.text: Enemy Amplitude: Paltry. Threat Level: Null.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt4.zhText: 敌人强度: 微不足道。威胁级别: 无。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt5.text: Enemy Proximity: Immediate. Defensive Systems Employed: Calcitration.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ambulas_Taunt5.zhText: 敌人接近: 立即。防御系统启动: 踢击。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt1.text: Is this a gathering of the freaks?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt1.zhText: 这是一个怪胎的聚会吗？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt2.text: Orokin secrets cannot remain secret forever... start talking!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt2.zhText: 奥罗金无法永远保有它的秘密……开始传开了！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt3.text: From pods you have come, in caskets you will go!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt3.zhText: 你原自冷冻舱苏醒，终将踏向另一具棺材。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt4.text: Fashion victims about to become murder victims!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt4.zhText: 这名时尚的受害者，即将成为一件惨案的受害者！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt5.text: This is your final warning, |PLAYER_NAME|. Leave this system at once.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt5.zhText: 这是你的最后警告 |PLAYER_NAME|。立即滚出这个星系。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt6.text: I grow tired of waiting, |PLAYER_NAME|. Will you face me?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt6.zhText: 我厌倦了等待，|PLAYER_NAME|。你敢面对我吗？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt7.text: That |PLAYER_WARFRAME| will look great hanging on my wall.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt7.zhText: 你的 |PLAYER_WARFRAME| 若挂在我的墙上应该很好看。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt9.text: You call that skill? Clan |CLAN_NAME| should be ashamed.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Anyo_Taunt9.zhText: 你将这称为技术？|CLAN_NAME|氏族应该感到羞耻。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_ClanInsult.text: So happy I can add more |CLAN_NAME| notches to my belt!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_ClanInsult.zhText: 很高兴我能把更多 |CLAN_NAME|的标记画在皮带上 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_Introducti.text: Should we do introductions? I am |ENEMY_NAME|. My |ENEMY_WEAPON| is looking forward to meeting you.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_Introducti.zhText: 我们应该做个自我介绍么？我是 |ENEMY_NAME|。我的 |ENEMY_WEAPON|期待与你见面。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_MultipleCl.text: What is this? |CLAN_NAME|? |CLAN_NAMEB|? I should have known the The Tenno clans were uniting!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_MultipleCl.zhText: 这是什么？ |CLAN_NAME| 吗？|CLAN_NAMEB| 吗？我应该知道 Tenno 氏族都团结起来了 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_TwoPlayerI.text: |PLAYER_NAME|, are you sure |PLAYER_NAMEB| will be there for you when you fall?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_TwoPlayerI.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME|， 你确定 |PLAYER_NAMEB| 在你倒下的时候会来救你？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_WarframeIn.text: I will crush you and your |PLAYER_WARFRAME| Warframe!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_WarframeIn.zhText: 我将把你和你的 |PLAYER_WARFRAME| 一起粉碎！！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_WeaponInsu.text: You think your puny |PLAYER_WEAPON| scares me, |PLAYER_NAME|? Rank |PLAYER_WEAPON_RANK| is pathetic!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_WeaponInsu.zhText: 你认为你那瘦小的 |PLAYER_WEAPON| 会让我害怕 |PLAYER_NAME| 吗？等级 |PLAYER_WEAPON_RANK|真是悲哀 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_WeaponModI.text: A |PLAYER_WEAPON| with only |PLAYER_WEAPON_MODCOUNT|? I do not think |PLAYER_NAME| will last long!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Boss_WeaponModI.zhText: 一把 |PLAYER_WEAPON| 与仅仅 |PLAYER_WEAPON_MODCOUNT| 个？我不觉得 |PLAYER_NAME| 会站着多久 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp1.text: Master |PLAYER_NAME|... my code is to kill. I hope this pleases you.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp1.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 主人… 我的设定指令是杀戮，我希望这能取悦你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp2.text: Master |PLAYER_NAME|, you gave me life. I am honored to repay you in death.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp2.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 主人，你给予我生命，我很荣幸能以死亡来报答你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp3.text: Master |PLAYER_NAME|, I am ready. Let us begin our destruction, together
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp3.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 主人，我准备好了，让我们一同启程，迎向灭亡。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp4.text: I am enemy to all but you, Master |PLAYER_NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp4.zhText: 我是所有人的敌人，除了你，|PLAYER_NAME| 主人。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp5.text: When I initialized my circuits this morning my first thought was - I wonder who |PLAYER_NAME| will have me to kill today?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp5.zhText: 当我今天早上将我的回路初始化时，我首先想到的是——不知道 |PLAYER_NAME| 今天会命令我先杀谁？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp6.text: Master |PLAYER_NAME|, I am ready for the hunt. Lead me.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/DethCubeChirp6.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 主人，我已经准备好狩猎了，带领我吧。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt1.text: (We were countless. Consume us. Be reborn.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt1.zhText: （我们无穷无尽。与我为一。重获新生。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt2.text: (Why do you destroy us? We are your flesh.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt2.zhText: （为什么你要毁灭我们？我们是你的血肉。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt3.text: (We embrace you. Why do you defile us?)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt3.zhText: （我们拥抱你。为什么你要反抗我们？）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt4.text: (Unburden yourself from this mortal coil, |PLAYER_NAME|. Join us.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Golem_Taunt4.zhText: （从这尘世的烦恼中脱离，|PLAYER_NAME|。加入我们吧。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt1.text: All those who oppose Grineer policy and expansion shall fall!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt1.zhText: 所有反对 Grineer 政策扩张的人都应该下地狱 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt2.text: This system is far too small both you and I, |PLAYER_NAME|. One of us has to go, and it isn't me.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt2.zhText: 这个星系对于你和我来说太小了，|PLAYER_NAME|。我们中的一个必须跪下，但那不是我。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt3.text: Grineer foreign policy begins and ends at the tip of my |ENEMY_WEAPON|!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt3.zhText: Grineer 的外交政策在我 |ENEMY_WEAPON| 的前面开始和结束！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt4.text: oh look! It says here you are next on my hit-list, |PLAYER_NAME|!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt4.zhText: 哦，看看 ！它说你就是列表上的下一个击杀目标，|PLAYER_NAME| ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt5.text: You think I'm ugly? Well, wait 'til I'm through with you, |PLAYER_NAME|!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt5.zhText: 你觉得我长得丑吗？那么，等着我打穿你，|PLAYER_NAME| ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt6.text: What I lack in diplomacy, I make up for in limb severing ferocity!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt6.zhText: 虽然我缺乏外交手腕，但是我砍掉四肢的水平一流！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt7.text: Can't we all just get along? Come give your old Uncle Hek a hug, |PLAYER_NAME|!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt7.zhText: 难道我们不能好好相处？过来给你的叔叔海克一个拥抱，|PLAYER_NAME| ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt8.text: I see you have come pre-equipped with you very own body bag, |PLAYER_NAME|!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hek_Taunt8.zhText: 在我看来你已套好你的尸袋，|PLAYER_NAME| ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaDeath01.text: Hyena destroyed, our circuits demand revenge.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaDeath01.zhText: 有鬣狗被摧毁了，我们的电子回路需要复仇。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaDeath02.zhText: 有鬣狗倒下，加强狩猎行动。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaDeath03.text: Hyena disabled, the pack grows weak.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaDeath03.zhText: 有鬣狗无法行动，鬣狗群变弱了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt1.text: The Pack calls for your death.

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt2.text: The Pack says: 'kill the weakest first'.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt2.zhText: 鬣狗群:'先把最弱的给杀了'。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt3.text: The Pack says: 'pick them off one by one'
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt3.zhText: 鬣狗群:'把他们一个接一个解决掉'。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt4.text: The Pack is designed to enjoy this, it is in its circuits.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt4.zhText: 鬣狗群的电子回路正是为了享受猎杀而设计的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt5.text: The Pack sings when you die.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt5.zhText: 鬣狗群会在你死亡时高歌。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt6.text: Our circuits are happiest when inflicting pain
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/HyenaNew_Taunt6.zhText: 我们的电子回路会在造成他人痛苦时感到愉悦。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_AppoachTa.text: The Pack grows excited, we have been waiting for this.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_AppoachTa.zhText: 鬣狗群很兴奋，我们已经等候许久了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_Taunt1.zhText: 敌人机动类别: 缓慢。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_Taunt2.text: Enemy acumen: Inane. Threat Level: Reduced.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_Taunt2.zhText: 敌人智力: 愚蠢。威胁级别: 已降低。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_Taunt3.zhText: 攻击系统类别: 狩猎。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_Taunt4.zhText: 攻击系统结论: 解剖敌人。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_Taunt5.text: Enemy Proximity: Immediate. Defensive Systems Employed: Dismemberment.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Hyena_Taunt5.zhText: 敌人接近: 立即。防御系统启动: 分割。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt1.zhText: 检测到微不足道的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt2.text: Enemy Analysis: Organic. Threat Level: Impotent.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt2.zhText: 敌人分析: 有机。威胁级别: 无能。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt3.zhText: 威胁级别升级。分类: 少得可怜。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt4.text: Prototype engagement test: Ready. Tenno destruction analytics: Recording.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt4.zhText: 原型参与测试: 就绪。Tenno 歼灭分析: 录制。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt5.text: Kill chamber sealed. There is no place to hide.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt5.zhText: 密闭的行刑室。没有藏身之处。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt6.zhText: 测算错误。需要采取更严厉的措施消除威胁。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt7.text: Auto-repair in process. Combat precepts halted.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt7.zhText: 正在进行自动修复。中止战斗指令。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt8.zhText: 这些可悲的有机体生物需要灭菌处理。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Jackal_Taunt9.zhText: 系统已瓦解。调整置信区间。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt1.text: Tenno, in my domain... No matter... They shan't survive long...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt1.zhText: Tenno，在我的领域……不过没关系……他们活不长……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt2.text: The Tenno lives... This interests me... I must learn more...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt2.zhText: Tenno 还活着……这使我很感兴趣……我必须学习更多……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt3.text: This Tenno... It continues to mock me with its insolence...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt3.zhText: 这个 Tenno……他在用他的傲慢无礼嘲笑我……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt4.text: Be warned... I will not abide your intrusion, Tenno...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt4.zhText: 我警告你……我不能再忍受你的侵入，Tenno……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt5.text: I know your name, |PLAYER_NAME|... There is little you can hide from me... Run... While you can...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt5.zhText: 我知道你的名字，|PLAYER_NAME|……你没有什么能瞒得过我……跑吧……尽你最大的能力……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt6.text: You have forced my hand |PLAYER_NAME|... Know that it was Kela de Thaym who ended your existence...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt6.zhText: 是你逼我动手的，|PLAYER_NAME|……记住是 Kela de Thaym 终结了你的生命……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt7.zhText: 来吧，|PLAYER_NAME|……你的终结在等待着你……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt8.text: First... I will kill you, |PLAYER_NAME|... Then... I will eradicate every last member of |CLAN_NAME|!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt8.zhText: 首先……我要杀了你 |PLAYER_NAME|……然后……我要抹除所有 |CLAN_NAME|剩余的成员！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt9.text: The Sisters... They will reward me well... When I present your head to them...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kela_Taunt9.zhText: 我的姐妹们……她们会奖励我……当我把你的头带给她们的时候……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt1.text: Beneath those suits exists flesh. Flesh bleeds. |PLAYER_NAME| bleeds.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt1.zhText: 在那些护甲下是鲜嫩的肉。肉在流着鲜血。|PLAYER_NAME|的鲜血。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt10.text: Trust me when I say you won’t feel a thing.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt10.zhText: 相信我，你会死得毫无感觉。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt11.text: You ever get hammered in that suit?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt11.zhText: 你在那护甲里试过被锤子抡的感觉么？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt2.text: I forgot my nails... I guess |PLAYER_NAME| will have to do!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt2.zhText: 哦我忘了剪指甲…我估计这得交给 |PLAYER_NAME|来做了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt3.text: Does that second-skin peel away just as easy as the first?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt3.zhText: 下面那层皮会和上面这层"皮"剥起来一样简单么？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt4.text: Grineer immortality begins with the strike of my hammer!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt4.zhText: Grineer的昌盛将由我这一锤缔造！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt5.text: I have seen and conquered many clans. |CLAN_NAME| will be next!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt5.zhText: 我见过并征服了许多氏族。|CLAN_NAME|将是下一个 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt6.text: I am Lech Kril. My hammer awaits your skull.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt6.zhText: 我是 Lech Kril。我的战锤在等着你的脑袋。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt7.text: The sound of hammer shattering ice is pure auditory perfection!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt7.zhText: 锤子击打冰面的声音真是纯净完美！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt8.text: And I will strike down upon |PLAYER_NAME| with great vengeance and furious anger!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt8.zhText: 然后我会连同刻骨的仇恨和疯狂的怒火一并将 |PLAYER_NAME|击败。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt9.text: Hold still and I’ll make this quick.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Kril_Taunt9.zhText: 给我等着，我很快就弄死你。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisCombat.text: (Unburden yourself from this mortal coil, |PLAYER_NAME|. Join us.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisCombat.zhText: （从这尘世的烦恼中脱离，|PLAYER_NAME|。加入我们吧。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisCombat.text: (We were countless. Consume us. Be reborn.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisCombat.zhText: （我们无穷无尽。与我为一。重获新生。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisCombat.text: (We embrace you. Why do you defile us?)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisCombat.zhText: （我们拥抱你。为什么你要反抗我们？）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisInGame.text: (We were countless. Consume us. Be reborn.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisInGame.zhText: （我们无穷无尽。与我为一。重获新生。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisInGame.text: (Why do you destroy us? We are your flesh.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisInGame.zhText: （为什么你要摧毁我们？我们是你的血肉。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisInGame.text: (We embrace you. Why do you defile us?)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/LephantisInGame.zhText: （我们拥抱你。为什么你要反抗我们？）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Lephantis_Taunt.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Lephantis_Taunt.zhText: 你弱小的 Tenno 技能对我是没用的！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Lephantis_Taunt.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Lephantis_Taunt.zhText: 你弱小的 Tenno 技能对我是没用的！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Lephantis_Taunt.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Lephantis_Taunt.zhText: 你弱小的 Tenno 技能对我是没用的！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt1.text: (Revoke the frailities of flesh. Let us in.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt1.zhText: （放弃肉身的弱点。让我们同在。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt2.text: (We are the vessel through which immortality is achieved. Assimilate, |PLAYER_NAME|.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt2.zhText: （我们是借以实现不朽的容器。同化吧，|PLAYER_NAME|。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt3.text: (Through the coalescence of flesh and universal will, we will exist as one.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt3.zhText: （通过肉体和普遍意志的聚结，我们同化为一。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt4.text: (Tenuous is your human spirit, |PLAYER_NAME|. Let us be your salvation.)
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Phorid_Taunt4.zhText: （你的人性是脆弱的，|PLAYER_NAME|。让我们救赎你。）

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Razorback_Taunt.text: |PLAYER_NAME| Detected: May the Void take mercy upon you

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Razorback_Taunt.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 的胜利概率： 微乎叵测

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt1.text: You shall suffer as we have, |PLAYER_NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt1.zhText: 你必须经受我们的苦痛，|PLAYER_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt2.text: Your little dress-up party ends here, |CLAN_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt2.zhText: 你们小小的打扮宴会将在这里结束，|CLAN_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt3.text: We should accessorize your suit with some holes... bullet holes.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt3.zhText: 我们应该用孔洞给你的护甲一些装饰……弹孔。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt4.text: You realize we haven't celebrated Halloween in about a millenia, right?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt4.zhText: 你意识到我们在千年中还没庆祝过万圣节，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt5.text: You have violated the dress code of this vessel. Failure to comply is punishable by death.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt5.zhText: 你违反了对这艘船的着装规范。未能遵守会被判处死刑。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt6.text: Take the 'Warfra' out of Warframe and what are you left with? You got it, 'me'!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt6.zhText: 把你的外壳脱掉，你还剩下什么？你答对了，'我' ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Regor_Taunt8.zhText: Grineer 的支配地位是不可避免的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt1.zhText: Grineer 的完美是不可避免的 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt2.zhText: Grineer 的主导地位将占上风 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt3.text: You are in the presence of Grineer perfection!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt3.zhText: 你挡在了 Grineer 的完美之路上 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt5.text: Grineer immortality begins with the shedding of flesh.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt5.zhText: 抛弃肉体是 Grineer 不朽的开端。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt6.text: |PLAYER_WARFRAME|? Your pretentious suits are no match for my power!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt6.zhText: |PLAYER_WARFRAME|？你狂妄的外壳比不上我的力量 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Ruk_Taunt8.zhText: Grineer 的主导地位将占上风 ！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/SargasRuk_Taunt.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/SargasRuk_Taunt.zhText: 你弱小的 Tenno 技能对我是没用的！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/SargasRuk_Taunt.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/SargasRuk_Taunt.zhText: 你弱小的 Tenno 技能对我是没用的！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/SargasRuk_Taunt.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/SargasRuk_Taunt.zhText: 你弱小的 Tenno 技能对我是没用的！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntDe.text: I... have failed... this one will remain... unpunished...
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntDe.zhText: 我……失败了……这名罪人……依然逍遥法外……

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntEs.text: You may have survived for now, |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|, but your time WILL come!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntEs.zhText: 你可能暂时逃离了死劫，|LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|，但你的死期终究会到来！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntEs.text: You are stronger than I realized, |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|. No matter, this is only a temporary setback.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntEs.zhText: 你比我预料的要厉害，|LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|。没关系，这次挫折只是暂时的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntEs.text: |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME| you are a more worthy opponent than I expected. You punishment will have to wait.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntEs.zhText: |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME| 你是个超乎预期的可敬对手，对于你的审判需得往后推迟。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.zhText: 你的 TENNO 技能对我毫无作用！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.text: |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME|, you can't run from your past.
|LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME| there is no place to hide.
The murder of |BOSS_TAG| will not go unpunished.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.zhText: 杀害 |BOSS_TAG| 之人绝不允许逍遥法外。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.text: The blood of |BOSS_TAG| is on your hands. Did you really think there would be no repercussions?
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.zhText: |BOSS_TAG| 的鲜血就在你手中。你真的认为不会遭受报应？

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.text: There is no salvation for your crime against |BOSS_TAG|.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.zhText: 你杀害 |BOSS_TAG| 的罪行不可饶恕。
对你的判罚即是… 死罪！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntIn.text: You shall not leave this place!

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntTa.text: It is done. |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME| is no more.
Justice is served. |LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME| has been executed.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntTa.zhText: 正义获得了伸张，|LOCAL_PLAYER_NAME| 已被处刑。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntTa.text: It is done. This Tenno is no more.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Stalker_TauntTa.zhText: 结束了。这名 Tenno 不再存在了。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt1.text: You hide behind that |PLAYER_WARFRAME| Warframe. Face me like a true warrior!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt1.zhText: 別躲在 |PLAYER_WARFRAME| 之后，像一个真正的勇士和我战斗！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt10.text: I am waiting... You are no match for me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt10.zhText: 我在等待……你不配和我一战！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt12.text: Your |PLAYER_WARFRAME| Warframe makes you slow and clumsy.

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt13.text: I am waiting... You are no match for me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt13.zhText: 我在等待……你不配和我一战！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt15.zhText: Grineer 的支配地位是不可避免的。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt17.text: This is your final warning |PLAYER_NAME|. Leave this system at once.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt17.zhText: 这是你的最后警告 |PLAYER_NAME|。立即滚出这个星系。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt2.text: You just signed your death warrant, |PLAYER_NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt2.zhText: 你已经签署了你的死亡证明，|PLAYER_NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt3.text: You call yourself a Warrior? Show some honor.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt3.zhText: 你自称战士？证明给我看。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt5.text: Your |PLAYER_WEAPON| isn't nearly powerful enough to defeat me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt5.zhText: 你的 |PLAYER_WEAPON| 並没有强大到足以打败我！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt6.text: You call that skill? Clan |CLAN_NAME| should be ashamed.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt6.zhText: 你说那叫技术？ |CLAN_NAME| 氏族应该感到羞耻。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt7.text: Your |PLAYER_WEAPON| will make a nice trophy
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt7.zhText: 你的 |PLAYER_WEAPON|将是一个很好的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt8.text: Your |PLAYER_WARFRAME| Warframe is no match for my advanced Orokin weaponry!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt8.zhText: 你的 |PLAYER_WARFRAME| 敌不过我先进的奥罗金武器！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt9.text: That |PLAYER_WARFRAME| will look great hanging on my wall.
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_Taunt9.zhText: 你那|PLAYER_WARFRAME|挂在我的墙上应该很好看。

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_TauntIneffe.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!
/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_TauntIneffe.zhText: 你弱小的 Tenno 技能对我是没用的！

/Lotus/Language/G1Taunts/Vor_TauntIneffe.text: Your puny Tenno power is useless against me!

/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDevourerDesc.text:
Vay Hek's personal favorite, the Devourer is a maximal terror unit. Draped in shreds of the diapause bag that birthed it, this gap-mawed monstrosity barrels toward prey with furious intensity.

Wrist-mounted hooks are welded to elbow joints and hyperpowered by a myotechnological winch system for maximum impact-and-pull.
/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDevourerDesc.zhText:
身为韦·海克最爱的作战单位，吞噬者是极为恐怖的存在。那些孕育出他们的休眠袋，现已化为残片，悬挂在他们身上。这种长着血盆大口的怪物会以自己的身体为武器，向猎物发起猛烈冲锋。

配备在他们腰部的钩爪机关已与其肘关节焊死，并且搭配了由肌肉控制的绞索驱动系统，使其冲击与牵引力均可达到极致。

/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDrillDesc.text:
Known colloquially as the 'drill sergeant', the Auger is fast-grown into its enhancements. As with all Ghouls, no regard is given to the proper development of its higher functions.

Cantilevered leg augments propel the unit toward the fray at speed, while over- and under-mounted extendable drill carriages magnify both reach and penetrating power.
/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDrillDesc.zhText:
被俗称为"钻头中士"，钻孔者快速地长入它的增幅装备。同其他所有尸鬼一样，并没有人在意它高级功能的正常发育。

悬臂式的腿部增强装置可以快速地将该单位推入战斗，而上下悬挂的可延展钻头车放大了攻击范围和穿透力。

/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDrillVipDesc.text: Whether through aberrant cognition or sheer brutality one specimen always moves to the front of each pack. It is from this individual that the other units take their lead.
/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDrillVipDesc.zhText: 不管是因为异常的认知能力还是单纯的残暴，总有一个样本会移动到每一群尸鬼的前列。其他的单位以这个样本为引领。

/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulExpiredDesc.text: The Expired are Ghouls who have succumbed to malnutrition or environmental poisoning during the early stages of development. Their backup nervous systems continue to drive them forward, however, making them ideal suicide troops.
/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulExpiredDesc.zhText: 除役者是在早期发育阶段营养不良或者受环境毒素影响的尸鬼。它们备用的神经系统继续驱使着它们前进，因此，它们是理想的自杀部队。

/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulRescueTargetDe.text: Why this emaciated monstrosity chose to abandon its pack remains to be seen.
/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulRescueTargetDe.zhText: 为何这只瘦弱的怪物选择了抛弃它的群落还有待研究。

/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulSawmanDesc.text: So named for its terrifying leer, the Rictus (AKA 'the Sawman') lives to divide and conquer its foes - literally.
/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulSawmanDesc.zhText: 因它恐怖的邪笑而得名，裂嘴者（也就是"电锯兵"）生来就是为了将敌人分而治之——字面意义上的分而治之。

/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulSawmanVipDesc.text: This specimen shows evidence of advanced cognitive abilities and greater, if rudimentary, situational analysis. Cold blooded and ruthless, it is easy to see how this specimen led its pack so ably.
/Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulSawmanVipDesc.zhText: 这个样本显示出了高级的认知能力，以及更强的、尽管初等的情景分析能力。冷血而又无情，可以轻易地明白这个样本是如何巧妙地引导它的群落的。

/Lotus/Language/Game/IntroScroll.text:
They were called TENNO. Warriors of blade and gun - masters of the WARFRAME armor. Those that survived the Old War were left drifting among the ruins.



Now they are needed once more. The GRINEER, with their vast armies, are spreading throughout the Origin System.



A call echoes across the stars - as a menace approaches...

他们被称为 TENNO，驾驭名为战甲的超级装甲，身负枪与剑的战士。这些从远古之战中生还的战士正在废墟中漂流。现在他们再次被召唤。



现在他们再次被召唤。GRINEER，与他们庞大的军队正在蔓延到整个始源星系。



一个跨越星际的召唤——威胁已经迫近……

/Lotus/Language/Game/KubrowDenLongDesc.text: Fiercely guarded by their owners, the Kubrow den is capable of housing an entire pack of the feral creatures. Once disturbed, these animals will whip themselves into a frenzy attacking anything they deem a threat.

/Lotus/Language/Game/KubrowLongDesc.text: After the fall of the Orokin, these former pets were left to fend for themselves. Only the most vicious survived, evolving into deadly pack hunters that now pervade every inch of Earth's dense forest. Intensely territorial, the Kubrow will attack any creature unlucky enough to cross their path.
/Lotus/Language/Game/KubrowLongDesc.zhText: 奥罗金帝国衰败后，这些曾经的宠物沦落到自己照顾自己. 它们中只有最恶毒的存活下来，演变成致命的群居狩猎野兽. 现在它们遍布于地球茂密森林中的每一寸土地中. 这片土地因此变得紧张起来，库狛会袭击任何运气不好遇到它们的生物.

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialAffinity1.text: Along with more power, levels unlock slots for 'Mods' to customize your arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialAffinity1.zhText: 除了更多的能力外，升级也会为"Mod"解锁更多槽位，来自定义你的军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialBoostersEnd.text: Collect all of the Artifacts to give your squad the edge in combat.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialBoostersEnd.zhText: 收集所有的神器可以在战斗中为你的队伍带来优势。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialBoostersInt.text: These are the Artifacts of the Orokin War. Each provides unique boosts to you and your teammates during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialBoostersInt.zhText: 这些都是奥罗金战争神器。每个神器都有独特的功能，可以在任务期间强化你和你的队友。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialBoostersPla.text: Each player may chose an Artifact from their collection before the mission begins.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialBoostersPla.zhText: 在任务开始之前，每个玩家可从他们的收藏中选择装备一个神器。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryComp.text: Search ships and defeat enemies to obtain Components. The components found are influenced by the Region of space you are in.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryComp.zhText: 搜索太空船和击杀敌人均可获得组件。不同的组件可以在不同的星球上找到。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryEnd.text: The Foundry is key to owning the most powerful weapons and artifacts that exist!
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryEnd.zhText: 工坊是获取最强武器及神器的关键！

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryIntr.text: This is the Foundry. Here you will build powerful new items to expand your arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryIntr.zhText: 这里是工坊。你可以在这里制造强力的物品以补充你的军械库。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryReqs.text: To build an item requires a Blueprint and its Components. While there are Blueprints in the Market, most are hidden throughout the system.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialFoundryReqs.zhText: 制造物品需要蓝图和组件。虽然在商店中可以买到一些蓝图，但大多数则是隐藏在这个世界中。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialHealth1.text:
Health does not recharge.
Touch the healing sphere...
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialHealth1.zhText:
血量不会自动恢复。
靠近这个恢复球……

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialLonggun.zhText: 你的第二个武器: 长枪。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialRank.text: Complete missions and level up weapons to qualify for higher ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialRank.zhText: 完成任务和提升武器的等级将有资格获得更高的段位。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialShields.text: Shields absorb most Damage Types before Health is affected.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialShields.zhText: 在你的血量受损前，大多数伤害都会先被护盾吸收。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartAl.text: Completing a region activates its real-time alerts. This is key to attacking high-value targets.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartAl.zhText: 完成一个区域即可激活该地区的实时警报。这是击杀高价值目标的关键。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartEn.text: You begin at Earth's E Prime, your only way in to the system. It is time for the Tenno to return.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartEn.zhText: 你将从地球的 E Prime 启程，这是你进入星系的唯一方式。是时候让 Tenno 归来了。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartIn.text: Welcome Tenno. This is the 'Origin' system and you... are its ward.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartIn.zhText: 欢迎您，Tenno。这里是始源星系，而你……是其守卫。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartNe.text: Our enemies control the ancient Solar Rail network. Complete missions to unlock new regions!
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartNe.zhText: 我们的敌人控制了古代的太阳系航道网络，完成任务以开启新的地区！

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartOn.text: You control how I connect you with other Tenno agents. You may freely join other agents, restrict it to your contacts, or go in alone.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialStarchartOn.zhText: 您可以选择如何与其他的 Tenno 特工联网。您可以加入网络上的其他特工，也可以将网络限制于联系簿中的特工，亦或您可以选择单独行动。

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialSwitch.text:
Use <NEXT_INV> to switch weapons.
Destroy these targets!
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialSwitch.zhText:
使用<NEXT_INV> 来切换武器。
摧毁这些目标！

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialTest.text: Complete the trial to join us!
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialTest.zhText: 完成试炼便可加入我们 ！

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialWarframeAct.text: Use <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_0> to activate the first power.
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialWarframeAct.zhText: 使用<ACTIVATE_ABILITY_0> 来激活第一个能力。

Abilities require Energy.
Absorb this Energy Orb...
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialWarframeEne.zhText:
能力需要能量。
吸收这个能量球……

/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialWarframePow.text: Warframe Power TEMPORARILY unlocked. Use the Arsenal to upgrade weapons and unlock powers as you level up...
/Lotus/Language/Game/TutorialWarframePow.zhText: 战甲的能力暂时解除锁定。升级后，您可以进入军械库进行武器的升级和能力的解锁。

/Lotus/Language/Game/UltraRareCorpusLoot.zhText: 强化 Corpus 存储容器

/Lotus/Language/Game/UltraRareGrineerLoo.zhText: 强化 Grineer 存储容器

/Lotus/Language/Game/VayHekDroneDesc.zhText: 给予 Grineer 力量，同时削弱 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Game/VorTwoDesc.text:
I was cut in half, destroyed, but through its Janus Key, the Void called to me. It brought me here and here I was reborn.

–Vor
/Lotus/Language/Game/VorTwoDesc.zhText:
我被一刀两半而摧毁了，然而，借由雅努斯之钥，虚空呼唤了我，将我引领至此并就此重生。

-沃尔

/Lotus/Language/Game/WardenLeaderDesc.text: Life leech weapon, increased speed, weak to stealth takedowns
/Lotus/Language/Game/WardenLeaderDesc.zhText: 生命吸取武器，速度提升，对偷袭没有防备

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/AnnihilationDe.text:
Fight against seven other Tenno in this free-for-all arena.

Annihilate the Oro, by collecting it to gain a point.

Beware that if another enemy annihilates the Oro, they will gain the point instead.

The Tenno with the most points at the end of the match is declared the winner.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/AnnihilationDe.zhText:
在任何人都可以参与赛事的竞技场中击败其余七名 Tenno 吧！

借由收集奥金之魂来消灭它，并可获得一分。

需注意的是，奥金之魂若是由其他敌人所消灭的，那么将由他们得到该分数。

比赛结束时将宣布得分最高的 Tenno 为优胜者。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/AssassinationD.text: Assassination contracts mark high priority targets around the system. Hunt down and eliminate these enemies, then head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/AssassinationD.zhText: 刺杀合同标记着星系间需优先处理的目标。追捕并消灭这些敌人，随后前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntAmmoD.text:
Your Ammo depletes steadily.
Battery weapons recharge slowly.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntAmmoD.zhText:
你的弹药逐渐耗尽。
电池武器充能缓慢。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntDamag.text: Take damage when you cast Abilities.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntDamag.zhText: 当你施放技能时会受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntDista.text:
Take damage as you move.
Land jumps for a brief reprieve from this curse.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntDista.zhText:
移动时受到伤害。
跳跃来短暂缓解该诅咒。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntKeyIt.text:
The Syndicates need help finishing a doomed mission to recover Orokin Era Defixios from a Galleon of Grineer raiders adrift in the Abyssal Zone, near Ceres. Defixios are known to contain Vainthorns.

Obtained from Syndicate Offerings via the Syndicates panel in the Orbiter, or in any Relay.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntKeyIt.zhText:
集团需要帮助来完成一项注定失败的任务，即从漂流在谷神星附近深渊区域的一艘 Grineer 帆船战舰上找到奥罗金时代的咒言板。据了解，咒言板中有浮华荆棘。

通过轨道飞行器上的集团界面或任意中继站中的集团声望奖励获得。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntLight.text:
Your light source dims steadily.
Melee kill enemies to brighten it.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntLight.zhText:
你的光源逐渐变暗。
近战击杀敌人使其变亮。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntObj.text: Find a Defixio and Bring it to Extraction
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntObj.zhText: 找到咒言板并将其带到撤离点

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntVampi.text:
Your Health drains steadily.
Kill enemies to restore Health.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CacheHuntVampi.zhText:
你的生命值在逐渐耗尽。
击杀敌人来恢复生命值。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CaptureCephalo.text:
Tenno pit their prowess and techniques against one another, as two teams fight each other in an attempt to capture the opposing team's Cephalon, while protecting their own.

A Tenno must make their way into the opposing team's territory, and run into the opposing Cephalon to capture it. If the opposition defeat the Tenno before they can capture it, the Cephalon will be dropped. For a short time, the Cephalon will remain where it was dropped and will be returned if an opponent runs over it, or picked up if an ally runs over it.

Bringing an opponent's Cephalon to your own Cephalon will capture it, and award your team a point.

The first team to gain three points, or the team with the highest amount of points when time runs out wins the match.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CaptureCephalo.zhText:
Tenno 借由两个队伍互相争夺及防守中枢的方式，来互相对抗，磨练彼此的实力与技术。

一名 Tenno 必须进入敌队区域并抢夺中枢。如果在抢夺途中被对手击败，中枢将会原地掉落于并维持一小段时间，此时如果对手碰到中枢，中枢将会回到对方基地。若由己方人员碰到，将会捡起中枢。

将对方的中枢带回己方的中枢所在地，即可为你的队伍取得一分。

而最先获得三分，或是在时间内取得最多分数的队伍将会赢得这场比赛。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CaptureDesc.text:
The location of an enemy VIP has been discovered. Track them down and then capture them. Watch out, as these enemies would rather run from combat than fight. If they see you, they will run towards the nearest extraction point. Defeat them before they can escape.

Once a target is downed, press <USE> to capture these targets and teleport them to a waiting holding facility.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/CaptureDesc.zhText:
探测到一名敌方 VIP 的位置了。追猎并捕获他们。须留意的是，这些敌人宁可逃跑也不愿正面迎战。因此当他们察觉你时，他们会逃向最近的撤离点。在他们逃跑前击倒他们。

一旦目标倒下，轻按 <USE> 即可捕获这些目标并将他们传送至等候收容所。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ConclaveDesc.text:
Compete against other Tenno individually or in pairs. In order to hold fair competition, Tenno can only compete against other Tenno of similar Conclave Rating. Every piece of gear has its own Conclave Rating, based on its power. A Tenno's Conclave Rating is based on the sum ratings of their gear.

Different conclave missions around the system have different conclave score requirements. This allows Tenno to compete against other Tenno with the same level of gear.

In conclave matches, Tenno will spawn in with no energy. The maps will spawn health orbs, energy orbs and ammo packs at various points around the mission to aid Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ConclaveDesc.zhText:
与其他 Tenno 单独比赛或组队对抗。为了维护公平竞争的原则，Tenno 仅能与战力值相仿的 Tenno 竞赛。每一件装备基于它的力量都有所属的战力值，Tenno 的总战力值则是他们身上装备战力值的总数。

星系中有着各种不同的竞技场任务，分数要求也不尽相同。如此一来 Tenno 才能与装备等级一致的对手相互竞争。

在竞技场比赛中，Tenno 初始重生时能量是归零的。该地图任务附近各个地方都会生出生命球，能量球与弹药包来协助 Tenno。
