/Lotus/Language/GameModes/DeceptionDesc.text: Enter the enemy ship, and hack their navigation console to redirect their path. At the start of deception missions, a datamass will spawn next to the Tenno. It can be picked up with the <USE> key, but will prevent the carrier from using their Primary Weapon. Take the datamass through the mission and place it in the enemy navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/DeceptionDesc.zhText: 进入敌方的船舰，入侵他们的导航控制台来重新定位航道。欺骗任务开始之际，会有一枚数据块重生在 Tenno 身旁。使用<USE>键即可捡起数据块，但此时他们将被迫仅能使用次要武器。带着数据块进行任务，将它置入指定的敌方导航控制台中。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/DefenseDesc.text: Defend an important target against waves of enemy units. If the defense target is destroyed, the mission automatically fails. Every 5 waves choose to stay and fight or extract from the mission.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/DefenseDesc.zhText: 在敌方单位一波波来袭的攻势中守住一个重要的目标。若目标遭到摧毁，任务即会自动失败。每防御住五波攻势便能撤退，亦可选择留下继续奋战。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavationDesc.text:
At the start of the mission, objective markers will appear showing the location of Excavators. 

Travel to these points, and use Power Cores to activate the Excavators. Defend the Excavator until it can unearth what it was looking for. Up to three excavators can be activated at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavationDesc.zhText:
任务开始时会出现一个目标标记，这个标记显示出挖掘机即将出现的位置。

前往标记点所在位置，并使用能量核心启动挖掘机，最多可以同时启动三台挖掘机，在挖掘机挖出任何东西前保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavationHalt.text: A HALTED EXCAVATOR NEEDS A <POWER_CELL> POWER CELL
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavationHalt.zhText: 停止运作的挖掘机需要一个 <POWER_CELL> 能量电池

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavationHint.text: Bring fuel cells from fallen enemies to the excavator
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavationHint.zhText: 将来自倒下敌人的燃料电池带到挖掘机上

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavatorOutOf.text:
EXCAVATOR IS OUT OF POWER
FIND A FUEL CELL TO POWER IT BACK UP
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExcavatorOutOf.zhText:
挖掘机能量耗尽
找到燃料电池使其重新启动

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExterminateDes.text: Enter the level and kill every enemy you encounter. Leave no one standing.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/ExterminateDes.zhText: 进入该地区并歼灭你所发现的任何敌人。别留下活口。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/HijackDesc.text:
Hijack an enemy transport and escort it to extraction. Guard the vehicle from enemies as it moves along a path. 

In order to make the target move, Tenno must stand next to the cart and use energy from their shields to power it. As the shields drain, the cart will move along the path towards extraction. The more Tenno giving shield power, the faster the transport moves. The transport will lose health over time, so speed is critical to ensuring success.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/HijackDesc.zhText:
劫持一台敌方的运输装置并护送到撤离点。当它沿着路线移动时，守护载具以免它受到敌方炮火攻击。

为了使目标移动，Tenno 必须紧跟着运输车，利用来自护盾的能量推动它。护盾消耗之际，运输车也会按照路线前进撤离点。越多名 Tenno 提供护盾的能量，运输装置的速度就越快。运输装置的生命值会随着时间的消逝而降低，因此速度乃是确保任务成功的关键。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/HiveSabotageDe.text:
These Sabotage missions are set in an infested Hive. There are three major Hives around the level, however each of these are invincible at first. Growing near the Hives are 5 Tumor Nodes that have to be located and destroyed. Once the Tumors are all destroyed, the Hive will become vulnerable to attacks.

After a Hive is destroyed, it will activate one of six different traps that will trigger for the remainder of the mission. Once all three have been destroyed, Tenno will have to reach extraction with three traps active.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/HiveSabotageDe.zhText:
这是感染者占领地区特有的清巢任务。关卡中有三个主要的巢囊，但是这些巢囊无法直接摧毁，需要找出并破坏掉巢囊附近的五个瘤结。当所有的瘤结都被破坏掉后，即可伤害到巢囊。

巢囊被破坏后，会随机激活六种陷阱之中的其中一种，并激活任务的下个部分。当破坏掉所有的巢囊，Tenno 必须闯过三种陷阱以抵达撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/InterceptionDe.text:
Use enemy relay stations to intercept and decode important enemy transmissions.

Interception missions have 4 relay points. Standing beside these relay stations will begin to capture the point. The enemy will spawn endlessly and attempt to take and hold their own points. 

When you capture a point, it will start decoding a message. The more points you hold, the faster the decoding will occur. When you fully decode a message, you will have the option of leaving or staying to decode another. The more messages you decode, the tougher the enemies will become.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/InterceptionDe.zhText:
使用敌人的中继站来拦截并解密重要的敌方广播。

拦截任务中有四个中继点。站在中继点上即可进行占领。敌人将会源源不绝地出没并试图夺回且保有他们的中继点。

当你们占领了一处中继点，它将会启动信息解密作业。你们所占有的中继点越多，解密的动作就越快。而当你们将信息完全解密时，你们将面临撤退或是留下来解密另一道信息的抉择。解密的信息越多，遭遇的敌人也会随之变强。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/InvasionDesc.text:
The Corpus and Grineer are fighting for control of this planet. Choose one faction to represent in the conflict. Your faction will fight with you as you exterminate the enemy forces.

This mission can be repeated until one faction has completely taken control. If enough missions for the same faction are completed, they may see fit to grant you battle pay. Battle Pay can only be earned for a single faction.

Information for progress of the conflict can be found on the Star Chart. Once a faction wins enough battles, the conflict will end.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/InvasionDesc.zhText:
Corpus 与 Grineer 正在争夺这颗星球的控制权。你要选择一方派系来代表他们出征。当你歼灭敌方势力时，你所选择的派系会与你一同作战。

这类任务可以重复执行，直到某一方派系成功夺取了控制权为止。若你完成所选派系的足量任务后，他们将会斟酌给予你战酬。只能获得一方派系的战酬。

冲突进展可以在星际航图上获得信息。一旦某一方派系获得了一定的胜战数，冲突便会结束。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/LunaroDesc.text:
Lunaro is an ancient ball-sport, once played both as training and recreation by Tenno of old.

Sun and Moon form teams of up to three players. Using an Arcata scoop, players try to hurl the ball - known as a Lunaro - through the opposing team's goal. Teams defend their own goal by intercepting the Lunaro when passed or shot at the goal. Lunaro is a contact sport and players are free to forcefully knock the Lunaro out of another player's Arcata. 

After a goal, the scoring team must leave the opposition's zone before they can take possession of the Lunaro again. Lunaro consists of two 5-minute periods. The team with the highest score at the end of the second period is declared the winner.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/LunaroDesc.zhText:
月动球是一项古老的球类运动，旧时代的 Tenno 曾用它进行训练和娱乐。

太阳队与月亮队最多由 3 名球员组成。球员通过使用阿卡塔球柄掷出月动球，使球穿过对手的球门。防守球门的队伍可以在对手传球或者射门时进行拦截。月动球是一项身体接触型运动，球员们被允许将月动球从另一名选手的阿卡塔中强行击出。

进球得分后，得分队伍必须离开对手的区域才能再一次持球。月动球包含了 2 个 5 分钟的上下半场。下半场结束时分数更高的队伍成为胜利者。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/MobileDefenseD.text:
In Mobile Defense missions, Tenno must find and defend multiple consoles while the Lotus hacks into enemy systems. A datamass will spawn, and the Tenno must carry it to one of the nearby targets.

Take the datamass to one of the targets, place it in the console by pressing <USE>, then defend the target. When the timer is completed, pick up the datamass and move to the next target. When all the targets have been defended, head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/MobileDefenseD.zhText:
在移动防御任务中，Tenno 必须找出数个控制面板，并在 Lotus 入侵敌方系统时进行防守。完成后会取得一枚数据块，Tenno 必须将它携带至另一个目标处。

将数据块带至其中一个目标控制面板，并按下 <USE> 放置进去并开始进行防守。倒数结束后，拾起数据块并移动至下一个目标。当所有目标都已防守完成后，即可前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RailjackDesc.text:
The Railjack is a restored Orokin warship. Captain your own ship by completing the Rising Tide quest, or join another player's crew via navigation once you have completed The Archwing quest. Your ship can be upgraded and restocked in your Clan Dojo's Dry Dock.

Railjack missions take place in deep space against hostile Fighters, Crewships, and Platforms. Use the Railjack's multiple weapons and Archwing mode to complete your objectives. More tools become available as players earn Intrinsics, personal skill points that are tied to Affinity gains during Railjack missions.

The Railjack can be set on fire by enemy attacks, and running out of hull integrity results in a hull breach, which must be sealed to prevent mission failure! Each crew member is given an Omni Tool to repair hazards, accessible from the gear wheel.

Many features of the Railjack use resources found in space - craft them into useful Payloads using the Forge at the back of your ship, either between or during missions.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RailjackDesc.zhText:
「航道星舰」是一艘经过修复的奥罗金战舰。通过完成《澎湃狂潮》系列任务来统率你自己的战舰，或是在完成《曲翼》系列任务后通过星图导航来加入另一位玩家的舰组。你的战舰可以在氏族道场的干船坞内进行升级和补充。

航道星舰任务是在深空中应对敌方的战斗机、战舰，以及作战平台。使用航道星舰搭载的多种武器和曲翼模式来完成你的任务目标。随着获得「内源之力」，一种获取于航道星舰任务且与经验值相关联的个人技能点数，玩家可以接触到更多工具。

在敌人的攻击下，航道星舰会燃起大火，并且在舰体完整性耗尽后会出现舰体缺口，缺口必须被密封以避免任务失败！每位舰员在携带装备轮盘里都有一个「万用工具」来在事故中进行维修。

航道星舰的许多功能都要用到太空中发现的资源 — 在任务中或任务间歇期间，使用在你星舰尾部的「锻造厂」来把它们制成有用的「载荷」。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RecoveryDesc.text:
When a Tenno is defeated by the Zanuka hunter, they are immediately taken to the Recovery mission. Tenno will start the level with no Weapons or Warframe Abilities, and will have to search through the level for their missing gear.

With no weapons, Tenno can only use their fists for attacking so using Stealth attacks can be an effective method of taking enemies down.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RecoveryDesc.zhText:
当 Tenno 遭到 Zanuka 捕获，会立刻进入重整态势任务。Tenno 在任务开始时会失去所有武器和战甲的技能，需要搜索整个关卡来找回失去的装备与能力。

由于没有武器，Tenno 只能利用拳脚来进行攻击，因此以偷袭来击倒敌人是非常有效的方法。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RecurringGhoul.text: Help Konzu rid the plains of Grineer Ghouls
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RecurringGhoul.zhText: 帮助孔尊消灭平野上的 Grineer 尸鬼

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RescueDesc.text:
A valuable ally has been captured by the enemy. Infiltrate their stronghold and search for the prison. Once there, hack the door and free the prisoner. Be warned, the prison cell has been rigged with a killswitch. If the Wardens detect an intrusion they will start an execution sequence. Failure to rescue the hostage before that sequence finishes will result in their termination.

Once the prisoner is free, they will begin to follow the Tenno. Protect them and get them to extraction

Tenno can choose to give the Rescue target a weapon to help defend themselves. Walk up to the target and press <USE> to give them your Secondary Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/RescueDesc.zhText:
一名珍贵的盟友遭到敌方捕获，渗透进敌方据点并搜索监狱。到达后入侵监狱大门并解救俘虏。请注意，牢房设有处决机关，如果典狱长侦测到入侵者，他们将会启动处决程序。若没有抢在处决程序执行完毕以前救出人质将会导致人质死亡。

当囚犯被救出后，囚犯会紧紧跟随着 Tenno。保护好他们并会护送他们前往撤离点。

Tenno 可以靠近救援目标并按下 <USE> 将次要武器交给救援目标作为自卫武器。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/SabotageDesc.text: Infiltrate the enemy hold, and cripple their operation by striking at vulnerable points. The Minimap will lead you to the target. Once it has been destroyed, get to extraction as fast as possible.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/SabotageDesc.zhText: 渗透进敌方据点内部，破坏重要的设备来瘫痪敌方运作。小地图会引导你往目标前进，当目标被摧毁后，尽速前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/SpyDesc.text:
This is an espionage mission. Tenno must search through enemy ships and outposts to find Data Vaults containing crucial Intel. 

The Data Vaults are guarded by a myriad of security measures, from laser traps to Sensor Drones. Tenno should attempt to extract the Intel without being detected. If the enemy detects any intrusion, Tenno will only have a short time to retrieve the Intel before it is destroyed. 

Most missions will contain multiple Data Vaults, the number of successful extractions required changes by mission.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/SpyDesc.zhText:
这是一份间谍行动。Tenno 必须通过敌方船舰与前哨站寻找敌人资料金库中收藏的关键情报。

资料金库门禁森严，从激光陷阱到感应无人机有着层层关卡。Tenno 要试着神不知鬼不觉的提取情报。若敌方侦测到维安出现漏洞，则在情报被摧毁前 Tenno 仅有极短的时间能回收它。

多数任务中都有数个资料金库，成功提取的数量需求将随任务而异动。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/SurvivalDesc.text:
The enemy has cut off life-support systems. The Lotus is able to drop in small life support reserves periodically, these will be marked on the Minimap. To maintain life support Tenno must activate these as they appear. 

Enemies themselves have a chance to drop smaller tanks of life-support. These will help keep the life-support levels up between the larger canister drops. If life support runs out Tenno will begin to suffocate and take damage. At this point the only options are extraction or death.

The longer Tenno survive, the more rewards they will receive but the tougher the enemies will become.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/SurvivalDesc.zhText:
敌人已经切断了维生系统。为了维持住生命系统，Tenno 必须利用 Lotus 定期给予的小型维生装置，这些胶囊的所在地点会标记于小地图上。

敌人也有几率掉落微型生命维持包，对于维生系统的延续有些许帮助。如果维生系统归零，Tenno 将会开始窒息并受到伤害，此时唯一的选择只有尽速撤离或…死亡。

Tenno 生存越久就能获得越多奖励，但敌人也会更加强大。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/TeamAnnihilati.text:
Join three team mates and battle against an opposing team of four players.

Defeating your enemies will cause them to drop an Oro.

Either yourself or a team mate can annihilate the Oro by collecting it, granting your team a point.

Other enemies can deny your team the point, if they are able to annihilate the Oro dropped by their fallen team mate.

The team with the most points at the end of the match is declared the winner.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/TeamAnnihilati.zhText:
加入三名队友的行列，组成与敌队四人战斗抗衡的团队。

击倒你的敌人，他们会掉落一颗奥金之魂。

无论是你自己或是队友，都可以借由收集奥金之魂来消灭它，并为队上获得一分。

若敌人有能力夺回他们倒地队友所掉落的奥金之魂，他们也可以阻止你们的队伍得分。

比赛结束时将宣布得分最高的队伍为优胜者。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/TestKeyDesc.text: [DEV_ONLY] This Key is used for Test purposes only. It will use data defined inside 'kk' in Global Overrides.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/TestKeyDesc.zhText: [DEV_ONLY] This Key is used for Test purposes only. It will use data defined inside 'kk' in Global Overrides.

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/TrialDesc.text:
Trials are deadly challenges that will allow up to eight Tenno to work together to overcome the greatest threats in the Origin System.

Tenno will be expected to survive unique traps, and solve elaborate puzzles before facing off against exceptionally powerful opponents.

The rewards for completing a trial are among the most exotic in the system, but are only attainable once per day.
/Lotus/Language/GameModes/TrialDesc.zhText:
试炼任务是个致命的挑战，由八名 Tenno 共同合作，克服始源星系所面临的最大威胁。

期望 Tenno 能在面对异常强悍的敌人之前，闯过数个独特的陷阱与复杂的谜题。

完成试炼的奖励是星系中最特別的，但每天只能取得一次。

/Lotus/Language/GameModes/VoidArmageddon.zhText: 击杀 |COUNT| 名贪婪虚空天使

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/EmberDesc.text:
Ember is a nightmare for light-armored targets.
Ember can super-heat the air which opens up surprising crowd-control possibilities.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/EmberDesc.zhText:
Ember 是轻型装甲敌人的噩梦。
Ember 可以使空气升温至过热状态，从而带来惊人的群体控制。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ExcaliburDesc.text:
Excalibur is well balanced for beginner players.
It features devastating blade attacks.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ExcaliburDesc.zhText:
Excalibur 是新手玩家的首选。
他拥有毁灭性的刀锋攻击。

You can switch back to your firearms by holding <NEXT_INV>

再次按住 <NEXT_INV> 即可切换回枪械。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Revive your allies when they go down; they can't revive themselves! Any Tenno who perishes leaves a pillar where they died, requiring 3 allies to put themselves in danger to bring them back.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 当你的友军倒下时，务必将他们复活；他们无法自行复活！任何阵亡的 Tenno 都会在死亡地点留下一个柱体，需要 3 名友军冒着生命危险才能将他们复活。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Cryobells refresh with the weekly reset on Sundays at 11:59pm UTC. You can hold up to 6, so make sure to pick all 3 of them up before they refresh!
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 冰珠铃会在协调世界时间每周日晚上 11:59 分重置时刷新。你最多可以持有 6 个，所以一定要在刷新前拾取全部 3 个！

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Remember to check your Personal Bind! Attempting a Cryobell with a Personal Bind that weakens your Warframe choice can be quite difficult.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 记得检查你的个人羁绊！如果个人羁绊削弱了你选择的战甲，尝试使用冰珠铃可能会相当困难。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Riven Splicers are guaranteed rewards from The Icebind. They are rewarded once the mission is completed, expect them upon extraction.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 裂罅熔接器是冰封羁绊任务必定获得的奖励。任务完成后发放，撤离时即可获得。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Try playing a support frame! Healing, restoring Shields, giving damage resistance, Overguard, or Overshields are all great ways to ensure survival in this challenging game mode.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 试试辅助型战甲！治疗、恢复护盾、提供伤伤害抗性、超宏防护或过载护盾都是确保在这个高难度游戏模式中生存下来的绝佳方法。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Failing a side objective fails the entire mission. If you don't think you can complete a side objective, you can always choose to skip it.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 支线目标失败会导致整个任务失败。如果你觉得自己无法完成某个支线目标，你可以选择跳过它。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Many side objectives require staying in one place for a period of time. Clear out any dangers before starting them!
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 许多支线目标需要在原地停留一段时间。开始之前，请务必清除所有危险！

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Area of Effect weapons deal less damage to the Indomitable Ice side objective. Pull out a precision weapon to charge crystals faster. Try communicating which crystal you're focusing on to help out your team.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 范围影响武器对「坚韧冰晶」支线目标造成的伤害较低。使用精准武器可以更快地为冰晶充能。尝试与队友沟通你正在攻击的冰晶来协助团队。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Cryothermia's Cryo Core drains health rapidly, increasing the longer it is held. Pass it amongst each other to keep its damage low.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 极寒热美亚的冰核会迅速消耗生命值，持有时间越长消耗越多。互相传递，来保持它的低伤害。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Lockbox requires everyone to obtain a Cypher from killing enemies before bringing them to the Lockbox. Once it has began, hold onto your Cypher and stay nearby to maintain progress.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 保险箱需要所有玩家先通过击杀敌人获得破解器，然后将他们带到保险箱处。一旦开始，请紧握你的破解器并待在附近以保持进度。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: Signal Chain can go through obstacles, even floors! Carefully place yourself to give a little wiggle room for survival.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 信号链可以穿过障碍物，甚至是地板！小心地摆好站位，来给自己留出一些生存的回旋空间。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: If you need to move during Signal Chain, use Transference to leave your Warframe in the chain while you move around!
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 如果在信号链期间需要移动，可以使用传识功能，在你移动时将你的战甲留在信号链中！

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.text: The area around an Entropy Orb pulses with intense damage, except for a safe zone. The safe zone moves, so keep an eye out for where you need to be standing next!
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/IcebindLoadingT.zhText: 熵球周围区域会脉冲强烈的伤害，但安全区域除外。安全区域会移动，所以要留意你接下来应该站在哪里！

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/LevelUpDesc.text:
Warframes and weaponry Level Up as you use them!
Leveling up increases power and unlocks Mod slots for your weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/LevelUpDesc.zhText:
战甲和武器会随着您的不断使用而升级！
升级将会提升武器的各种能力并解锁 MOD 插槽。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/LokiDesc.text:
For the advanced player, Loki offers a variety of unique tools to reconfigure the battlefield.
While lacking direct damage abilities, Loki gives creative players the edge in combat.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/LokiDesc.zhText:
Loki 适合高级玩家。虽然缺乏直接输出的能力，但 Loki 拥有多种独特的技能来扰乱战场。
具有创造力的 Loki 玩家将会是战场中不可忽视的力量。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/LootDesc.text:
Be on the look out for upgrades!
Destroy supply crates and search open containers.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/LootDesc.zhText:
多留意并寻找升级物品！
它们多半藏在可破坏的补给箱，或者没锁上的储物柜内。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/MAGDesc.text:
Control of magnetic forces gives Mag the edge in one-on-one combat.
Mastering Mag grants a devastating attack that can reverse the tide of any battle.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/MAGDesc.zhText:
Mag 所拥有的磁力控制使其能够在一对一的战斗中游刃有余。
如能够熟练控制 Mag，他的攻击将能扭转战场形势。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/MistDesc.text:
Ash is great for players looking for a stealthier approach to combat.
Lethal abilities are complemented by powers of distraction.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/MistDesc.zhText:
Ash 适合喜欢潜行战斗的玩家。
其技能可在分散敌人注意力的同时给予致命打击。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_0.text: Fusion increases the rank of mods, giving them more impressive stat modifications. This consumes Endo and Credits.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_0.zhText: 融铸可提升 Mod 的等级，使其获得更强大的属性改善。此操作会消耗内融核心和现金。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_1.text: Endo can be found by running missions. It can also be created by Dissolving duplicate or unwanted mods.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_1.zhText: 可以通过执行任务获得内融核心。也可以通过分解重复或不需要的 Mod 来获得。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_10.text: Dissolving Riven Mods will return 75% of the Endo invested into it.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_10.zhText: 分解裂罅 MOD 可以返还 75% 的已投入内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_2.text: Increasing the rank increases a mod’s Capacity Cost. The system will warn you if a higher rank will make a mod configuration too costly for its item.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_2.zhText: 提升等级会增加 Mod 的容量消耗。如果更高的等级导致物品的 Mod 配置超出容量，系统会发出警告。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_3.text: Endo can also be extracted from Ayatan Treasures. Visit Maroo’s bazaar and talk to Maroo to have her extract Endo from your Ayatans.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_3.zhText: 内融核心也可以从阿耶檀识宝物中提取。访问 Maroo 的集市并与 Maroo 交谈，让她从你的阿耶檀识中提取内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_4.text: Sell duplicate or unwanted mods to earn Credits.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_4.zhText: 出售重复或不需要的 Mod 来获取现金。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_5.text: The rarity of Mods being transmuted will increase the odds of producing a rare Mod.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_5.zhText: 在转换中，MOD 的稀有性会提升制造出稀有MOD 的可能性。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_6.text: You can sell Ayatan Sculptures for <FUSION_POINTS> to Maroo in her Bazaar on Mars.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_6.zhText: 你可以在 Maroo 的市集中向 Maroo 出售阿耶檀识塑像来获得<FUSION_POINTS>内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_7.text: Maroo will sometimes have information on where to find Ayatan Treasures.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_7.zhText: Maroo 偶尔会有阿耶檀识塑像方位的信息。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_8.text: The polarity of Mods being transmuted will influence the polarity of the Mod you receive.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_8.zhText: 转换时， MOD 的极性也会影响到获得 MOD 的极性。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_9.text: The item compatibility of Mods being transmuted will influence the item compatibility of the Mod you receive.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModBench_9.zhText: 被用来转换的 MOD 的道具相容性，会影响获得 MOD 的相容性。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModsDesc.text:
Search for rare Mods dropped by downed enemies.
Apply Mods in the Arsenal screen to increase the power of your weaponry or add stunning new effects!
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/ModsDesc.zhText:
搜索隐藏在任务中的罕见 MOD！
您可以在军械库中应用 MOD 来提升武器的威力或增加特效！

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Mods_FusionEner.text: Rare Mods require more energy to rank up. They also provide more energy when fused.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Mods_FusionEner.zhText: 稀有 Mod 需要更多能量来升级。在被用来融铸的同时也提供更多的能量。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Mods_MiddleClic.text: Use |CALLOUT| to select all Mods in a stack.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Mods_MiddleClic.zhText: 用 |CALLOUT| 集体选中所有的 MOD。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/RhinoDesc.text:
A must-have for defensive players, the Rhino is the heaviest Warframe.
The Rhino's charge is devastating.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/RhinoDesc.zhText:
Rhino 是拥有高防御力的重型战甲。
同时 Rhino 的冲锋技能也十分强大。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/SlideDesc.text: Press <CROUCH> while sprinting to perform a Slide Maneuver.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/SlideDesc.zhText: 在助推期间按下<CROUCH> 可以完成滑行机动。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/SlideDesc_ALT.text: Hold <HOLD_CROUCH> while sprinting to perform a Slide Maneuver.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/SlideDesc_ALT.zhText: 在助推期间按住 <HOLD_CROUCH> 可以完成滑行机动。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/TrinityDesc.text:
Trinity is great for players who prefer a supportive role.
Warframes with healing technology are rare, making Trinity a great equalizer when the odds are stacked against a group of Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/TrinityDesc.zhText:
Trinity 非常适合那些喜欢辅助角色的玩家。
拥有治愈能力的 Trinity 能为队伍在劣势之下扭转局势。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_0.text: Mods are items that can be installed on Warframes, weapons, companions, and some vehicles to improve their function and lethality. There are hundreds of mods and nearly limitless possible combinations.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_0.zhText: Mod 是可以安装在战甲、武器、同伴和一些载具上的物品，用于增强其功能和杀伤力。Mod 有数百种，组合可能性几乎无限。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_1.text: Mods are usually found in missions, but they can also be purchased from Vendors, the Orbiter's Market and through trading in Maroo's Bazaar.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_1.zhText: Mod 通常在任务中找到，但也可以从商人、轨道飞行器商店以及通过在 Maroo 的市集交易购得。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_2.text: Drag compatible Mods from the bottom menu to the desired mod slots
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_2.zhText: 从底部菜单拖动相容的 Mod 到想放置的 Mod 槽位。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_3.text: A Mod can be equipped on multiple Weapons simultaneously.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_3.zhText: 一个 Mod 可以同时装备在多把武器上。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_4.text: Fusion increases the Rank of a mod. This will increase the mods effectiveness and Capacity Cost.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_4.zhText: 融铸可提高 Mod 的等级。此操作将提升 Mod 的效果和容量消耗。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_5.text: Fusion level is indicated by the blue dots at the bottom of a mod.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_5.zhText: Mod 底部的蓝色点代表其融铸等级。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_6.text: Mod rarity is identified by the color of the Mod. Bronze mods are the most common, Silver uncommon, while Gold is most rare.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_6.zhText: Mod 的稀有度通过 Mod 的颜色来区分。铜色 Mod 最常见，银色 Mod 为罕见，而金色 Mod 最为稀有。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_7.text: The Mods Workbench allows you to manage your mods. Use the MODS button for quick access or walk over to the Mods bench in the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/UpgradeCards_7.zhText: 你可以在 Mod 工作台管理你的 Mod。在快速移动轮盘中选择 Mod 按钮，或直接前往轨道飞行器中的 Mod 工作台。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_AurasA.text: Aura Mods add to your total Mod capacity.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_AurasA.zhText: 光环 MOD 可以增加战甲的 MOD 容量。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Capaci.text: Capacity is the larger of a Weapon's Rank and your Mastery Rank, and is doubled if an Orokin Reactor or Catalyst is installed.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Capaci.zhText: MOD 容量会随着装备等级和您的段位增加，安装奥罗金反应堆或催化剂后能够让 MOD 容量翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Capcit.text: Double a Weapon’s Capacity by installing an Orokin Catalyst, or a Warframe’s by installing an Orokin Reactor. These upgrades are permanent for the item being upgraded.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Capcit.zhText: 安装奥罗金催化剂可使武器容量翻倍，安装奥罗金反应堆可使战甲容量翻倍。此类升级对于所升级的物品是永久性的。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_ColdDa.text: <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage slows and freezes enemies while making them vulnerable to Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_ColdDa.zhText: <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害会减缓和冻结敌人，同时使他们容易受到暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Damage.text: Hover over any elemental Damage Type in the Arsenal to learn about its combat effects.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Damage.zhText: 将鼠标悬停在军械库中的任意元素伤害类型上，以了解其战斗效果。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Differ.text: Factions are resistant and vulnerable to various elements. View Suggested Damage when selecting a mission, and plan accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Differ.zhText: 派系对各种元素具有抗性且易伤。选择任务时查看建议的伤害类型，并以此制定计划。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Electr.text: <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage is capable of stunning and damaging enemies.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Electr.zhText: <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害可以击晕并伤害敌人。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Elemen.text: Use mods to combine primary elemental Damage Types on a weapon or Warframe in order to create secondary Damage Types. For instance, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold plus <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat creates <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast damage.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Elemen.zhText: 使用 Mod 将武器或战甲上的主要元素伤害类型组合起来，以创造次要伤害类型。例如，<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻加上 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰可产生 <DT_BLAST_COLOR>爆炸伤害。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_FireDa.text: <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage will burn and scorch foes.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_FireDa.zhText: <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害会燃烧并烧焦敌人。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Forma.text: Use Forma (under ACTIONS) to give a Slot a Polarity of your choice. This will reset the item's Rank to 0.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Forma.zhText: 使用 Forma（在"指令"下）来为槽位赋予你所选的极性。此操作会将物品的等级重置为 0。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Immort.text: Each Kuva Lich requires a unique order and combination of Requiem mods to properly defeat them. Enter occupied nodes and use Mercy Finishers on Thralls to gain hints.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Immort.zhText: 每一名赤毒玄骸都需要通过一系列特定排序与组合的安魂 Mod 才能完全击败他们。进入被占据的星图节点，并在奴仆身上使用怜悯之击来获得提示。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Immort.text: When the correct combination is used to defeat a Kuva Lich, each of the equipped Requiem mods lose a charge.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Immort.zhText: 当使用正确的组合击败赤毒玄骸时，每张装备的安魂 Mod 都会消耗一个使用点数。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Immort.text: The top three mod slots are for Requiem mods, used to defeat Kuva Liches and Sisters of Parvos. Earn these mods from Requiem Relics found in Kuva Siphon and Flood missions.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Immort.zhText: 最上面的三个 Mod 槽位是留给安魂 Mod 的，它们是用来击败赤毒玄骸和帕尔沃斯的姐妹们的。通过赤毒虹吸器任务和赤毒洪潮任务获取安魂遗物，并以此获得这些安魂 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_KnifeH.text: Hacking opportunities can be found across almost any mission, from infiltrating spy vaults to overriding security lockdowns.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_KnifeH.zhText: 从渗透间谍金库到解除安全锁定，入侵机会几乎可以在所有任务中找到。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_KnifeM.text: Mercies can sometimes be performed on enemies at low health. A red Parazon marker will flash above enemies open to a Mercy.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_KnifeM.zhText: 有时可以对生命值较低的敌人施展怜悯之击。可以被怜悯之击的敌人头上会有一个红色灭骸之刃标记在闪烁。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_KnifeP.text: Parazon is a wrist weapon used for Hacking terminals and performing Mercy Finishers.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_KnifeP.zhText: 灭骸之刃是一种夹腕式武器，被用于入侵终端和施展怜悯之击。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_MatchP.text: If the polarity of the Mod and the slot you install it on match, the capacity cost of the Mod will be halved.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_MatchP.zhText: 如果 Mod 的极性与安装槽位​​符号相符，能使消耗的 Mod 容量减半。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_ModTut.text: Press <MENU_RTRIGGER1> to view the Mod tutorial.

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_OrderO.text: Precept Mods alter a companion's behavior and tactics. Install them in the order they should be prioritized, starting from the upper-left.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_OrderO.zhText: 指令 Mod 会改变同伴的行为和战术。请按优先级顺序安装它们，从左上角开始依次排列。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Stance.text: Stance Mods unlock the ability to perform advanced combos.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Stance.zhText: 用来解锁进行高级连段技巧的架式 MOD

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Stance.text: Stance Mods add to your total Mod capacity.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_Stance.zhText: 架式 MOD 可以增加武器的 MOD 容量。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_ToxinD.text: <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage is effective at damaging an enemy's Health.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/Upgrades_ToxinD.zhText: <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害对于直接伤害敌人的生命值非常有效。

/Lotus/Language/GameTips/VoltDesc.text:
Volt can create and harness electrical elements.
This is a high-damage Warframe perfect for players who want a potent alternative to gun-play.
/Lotus/Language/GameTips/VoltDesc.zhText:
Volt 可以创造和驾驭雷电。
这副战甲拥有强大的输出能力，对于寻求枪械以外作战方式的玩家来说是完美的选择

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/ConsentDeniedError.text: You must agree to the Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service to create an account.
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/ConsentDeniedError.zhText: 您必须同意《隐私政策》和《服务条款》才能创建账号。

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/ConsentPrivacyPolic.text: I acknowledge that my personal data will be processed as described in the |PRIVACY|
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/ConsentPrivacyPolic.zhText: 我确认已知悉我的个人数据将按照 |PRIVACY| 中的描述进行处理

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/ConsentTransferDeni.text: You must agree to the Privacy Policy, Terms of Service and Transfer of Data
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/ConsentTransferDeni.zhText: 您必须同意《隐私政策》、《使用条款》，以及《数据传输协议》。

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/DataTransferConsent.text:
Warframe is a product offered by Digital Extremes, a Canadian company who will process your data outside of |AREA| for the purposes set out in our |PRIVACY|.
Please note that there are risks in such a transfer including your data being subject to differing legal regimes which may not afford it the same level of protection as that available in the country in which you are located.
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/DataTransferConsent.zhText:
《Warframe》是 Digital Extremes 旗下的产品，这家公司位于加拿大，并且会在|AREA|管辖以外的区域，按照《|PRIVACY|》中规定的宗旨来处理您的数据。
请注意，此类数据转移存在风险，包括您的数据将受到不同法律制度的约束，这些法律制度可能无法提供与您目前居住国家的法律制度相等的保障。

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_EULAUpdated.zhText: 我们已经更新了我们的|EULA|。

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_EULA_Agree.text: I have read and agree to the updated EULA
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_EULA_Agree.zhText: 我已阅读并同意已更新的《最终用户许可协议》

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_Info.text: We respect your privacy, Tenno! We'd love to reach out from time to time about Warframe, but it's up to you...
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_Info.zhText: Tenno，我们尊重您的隐私！我们乐于不时向您推送《Warframe》的相关消息，但这完全取决于您的意愿……

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_MoreInfo.text: You can always change your mind in your |ACCOUNT|. Learn more about our |PRIVACY|.
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_MoreInfo.zhText: 您可以随时在您的|ACCOUNT|中更改您的选择。了解更多关于我们的|PRIVACY|。

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_PrivacyPolicyU.text: We have updated our |PRIVACY|. If you would like to change any of your privacy preferences, you can do so in your |ACCOUNT|.
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_PrivacyPolicyU.zhText: 我们已经更新了我们的 |PRIVACY|。如果你想对你的隐私偏好进行任何更改，你可以在你的 |ACCOUNT| 中进行更改。

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_Privacy_Agree.text: I have read and agree to the updated Privacy Policy
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_Privacy_Agree.zhText: 我已阅读并同意已更新的《隐私政策》

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_Prompt.text: Keep letting me know about major Warframe news and sales through emails and ads.
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/GDPR_Prompt.zhText: 请继续通过电子邮件和广告通知我关于《Warframe》的重大新闻和优惠活动。

/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/IOS_AccountRenameTi.text: Enter new alias (We suggest using something other than your full name)
/Lotus/Language/Gdpr/IOS_AccountRenameTi.zhText: 请输入新的昵称（我们建议使用您的全名以外的别名）

/Lotus/Language/Gems/DeimosCommonGemADes.zhText:

/Lotus/Language/Gems/DeimosCommonGemBCut.text:

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

火卫二上殁世幽都的奥塔出售的蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/GaraInboxBody.text:
Tenno,

You now have Gara's base Blueprint, but to build any Warframe, you must also acquire additional component Blueprints.

The components are Chassis, Systems, and Neuroptics. Complete Bounties for Konzu to earn them for Gara.

To build Gara in your Foundry, you also require Resources like Iradite and Grokdrul, which must be gathered on the Plains of Eidolon.

Be aware that building any Warframe is a long-term project. You are always free to fight on other fronts while you gather Blueprints and Resources, and build your strength to face the Plains' most ardent foes.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/GaraInboxBody.zhText:
Tenno，

你现在拥有了 Gara 的基础蓝图，但要制作任何战甲，你还必须获得额外的组件蓝图。

这些组件包括机体、系统以及头部神经光元。完成孔尊的赏金任务能获得 Gara 的这些组件。

要在铸造厂中制作 Gara，你还必须要在夜灵平野上收集伊莱体和葛克度等资源。

请注意，制作任何战甲都是一项长期项目。在收集蓝图和资源的同时，你还可以在其他战线上自由作战，增强力量来应对平野上最强大的敌人们。

- Lotus

/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/QuillsVisitIn.text:
From the immeasurable skein of fate, woven unseen from infinite collisions between choice and outcome, action and reaction, cause and effect, a single object has been delivered into my possession.

And, soon, from my possession to yours.

You come to Cetus. You find a door like no other. You show that door your true self. That door opens. Behind that door, I await you. From my possession to yours sweeps this single object, this impossible product of infinite choices - a singular thing intended solely for you.

To Cetus. To the door.
/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/QuillsVisitIn.zhText:
从命运千丝万缕的牵制里，看不见在选择与结果、行动与回应、因与果之间无止境交错中的痕迹，一个单一的物品已被托付到我保管中。

而且，即将，我所拥有的都会到你手上。

你来到希图斯。你找到那扇独一无二的门。你向那扇门展示你最真的自我。那门开启了。在门后，我静候你。

你从我的手上席卷这单一物品，这具有无穷可能的不可思议产物——一个专门为你而设的物品。

到希图斯。到那扇门。

/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/QuillsVisitIn.text: A Gift From A Past That Is Yet To Be
/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/QuillsVisitIn.zhText: 一份来自尚未成为过去的礼物。

/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/RivenInboxBod.text:
Tenno,

I see you have already learned the secret of Gara's brilliance. Nevertheless, another pulse revealed a second more faint signal. This Riven. Take it and amplify your might. Protect Cetus, in Gara's name.

-The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/GlassQuest/RivenInboxBod.zhText:
Tenno，

我看到你已经习得了 Gara 光辉的秘密了。然而，另一个脉冲显示了第二道更微弱的讯号。这张裂罅 MOD。接收它并增强你的力量。以 Gara 之名保护希图斯。

-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPackADe.text:
Exalt in your first impression. The Risen Heirloom Collection includes a Sigil, Glyph, Emote, and Color Palette that celebrate ten years of Tenno valor.

Pack Includes:
- Ten Year Accolade
- Deca Heirloom Sigil
- Deca Heirloom Glyph
- Deca Heirloom Emote
- Deca Heirloom Color Palette
- 800 Platinum
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPackADe.zhText:
提升你的第一印象。崛起传家宝组合包内含纹章、浮印、表情动作和调色盘，以庆祝 Tenno 英勇的十年。

组合包内含：
- 十周年纪念奖章
- 十字传家宝纹章
- 十字传家宝浮印
- 十字传家宝表情动作
- 十字传家宝调色盘
- 800 白金

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPackBDe.text:
Honor these venerated Warframes who have fought alongside the Tenno since the dawn of their awakening. The Celestial Heirloom Collection includes the Frost Heirloom Skin, Mag Heirloom Skin, their matching Signas, as well as Regal Aya.

Pack Includes:
- Ten Year Accolade
- Frost Heirloom Skin
- Frost Heirloom Signa
- Mag Heirloom Skin
- Mag Heirloom Signa
- Regal Aya x 6
- 800 Platinum
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPackBDe.zhText:
向这些令人尊敬的战甲致敬，他们是自 Tenno 觉醒之初就与其并肩作战的战甲。天体传家宝组合包内含 Frost 传家宝外观、Mag 传家宝外观、与之搭配的头环，以及御品阿耶精华。

组合包内含： 
- 十周年纪念奖章
- Frost 传家宝外观
- Frost 传家宝头环
- Mag 传家宝外观
- Mag 传家宝头环
- 御品阿耶精华 x 6
- 800 白金

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPackCDe.text:
Honor the ancient bond between Warframes and the Tenno. The Zenith Heirloom Collection combines the Risen and Celestial Heirloom Collections.

Pack Includes:
- Ten Year Accolade
- Frost Heirloom Skin
- Frost Heirloom Signa
- Mag Heirloom Skin
- Mag Heirloom Signa
- Regal Aya x 6
- Deca Heirloom Sigil
- Deca Heirloom Glyph
- Deca Heirloom Emote
- Deca Heirloom Color Palette
- 2100 Platinum
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPackCDe.zhText:
纪念战甲和 Tenno 之间自古至今的联系。顶级传家宝组合包将崛起、天体两款传家宝组合包合二为一。

 组合包内含：
- 十周年纪念奖章
- Frost 传家宝外观
- Frost 传家宝头环
- Mag 传家宝外观
- Mag 传家宝头环
- 御品阿耶精华 x 6
- 十字传家宝纹章
- 十字传家宝浮印
- 十字传家宝表情动作
- 十字传家宝调色盘
- 2100 白金

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPackEmb.text: Honor the ancient bond between the Tenno and the Warframe, Ember. This collection includes Ember Heirloom, her matching Signa, Glyph, Sigil and Color Palette, as well as her Prex Card.

Ember 传家宝焦痕组合包

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPlatinu.text:
Hi Tenno,

We have added more Platinum to your account!

The amount of Platinum in Heirloom Packs has increased, so everyone who purchased an Heirloom Pack before the change has been given additional Platinum retroactively. The increased Platinum in your account is what you were owed. It's yours to spend!

Thank you for ten years of Warframe.

The Warframe Team
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/HeirloomPlatinu.zhText:
Tenno 你好，

我们已向你的账号添加了更多白金！

传家宝组合包中的白金数量增加了，因此在更新前购买传家宝组合包的所有玩家都获得了额外白金补偿。你账号中增加的白金是你应得的。可以放心使用这些白金！

感谢你十年来对 Warframe 的支持。

Warframe 团队

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/RhinoHeirloomHe.zhText: Rhino 传家宝的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/RhinoHeirloomSk.text: Heirloom skins signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno. Rhino arises in might, his legacy girded with living iron.
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/RhinoHeirloomSk.zhText: 传家宝外观象征着时间的流逝和 Tenno 的付出。Rhino 威风凛凛地屹立着，他的传奇就是钢铁般的生命。

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardEmberH.text: A legacy immortalized in the beauty of molten rock and volcanic fire.
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardEmberH.zhText: 在熔岩和火山之火的美丽中不朽的传承。
Ember 传家宝 Prex 卡牌

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardMesaHe.zhText: Mesa 传家宝 Prex 卡牌

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardRhinoH.text: A legacy girded with living iron.

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardRhinoH.zhText: Rhino 传家宝 Prex 卡牌

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardValkyr.text: A regal legacy born from torment.
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardValkyr.zhText: 在苦难中诞生的尊贵传承。
Valkyr 传家宝 Prex 卡牌

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/TarotCardVauban.zhText: Vauban 传家宝 Prex 卡牌

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomA.zhText: Vauban 传家宝的标志性大衣。

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomA.text: Vauban Heirloom’s signature overcoat without sleeves.
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomA.zhText: Vauban 传家宝的标志性无袖大衣。

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomC.text: Vauban Heirloom’s signa, fashioned from coils of living energy.
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomC.zhText: Vauban 传家宝的标志性头环，由缠绕的活力能量锻造而成。

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomH.zhText: Vauban 传家宝的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomS.text: Honor Vauban's legacy of ingenuity in bold style. Heirloom skins signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Heirloom/VaubanHeirloomS.zhText: 以大胆风格向 Vauban 的匠心独运致敬。传家宝外观象征着时间的流转以及 Tenno 的奉献。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_0.text: Complete Stage 4 in the Circuit to earn an additional 50 Circuit Progress once per day.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_0.zhText: 完成无尽回廊的第 4 阶段，来赢取每天额外获得 50 无尽回廊进度。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_1.text: The Equipment available in The Circuit rotates every 2 hours with new Spirals.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_1.zhText: 无尽回廊中的可选装备伴随新的复眠螺旋每 2 小时轮换一次。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_2.text: Gear and Companions are not available in Duviri. Choose and alter builds to make them best-suited for the trials of the Undercroft.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_2.zhText: 物品和同伴在双衍王境中不可用。为了最适应地穴的试炼，选择你的装备搭配或改编。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_3.text: Invest in the Opportunity Intrinsic to increase the number of Decree and Equipment Choices available in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_3.zhText: 在「机遇」内源之力中投入点数，增加双衍王境中王令和装备的选择数量。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_4.text: Rune Marrow is found only in the Undercroft. Destroy Runic Compact containers to unearth this Resource.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_4.zhText: 密印髓质只能在地穴中找到。摧毁密印骨盒的容器以发掘此资源。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_5.text: Each Circuit Stage spawns 3 Decree Fragments which are identifiable by their blue glow. Collect 3 Fragments to unlock an extra Decree and other rewards.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_5.zhText: 无尽回廊的每个阶段会生成 3 个王令碎片，可以通过它们发出的蓝光来识别。收集 3 个碎片来解锁一个额外的王令和其他奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_6.text: Preview the Mission Type of the next Stage of the Circuit in the Stage Completion Screen. Use this knowledge to decide whether to Extract, or take on the challenges of the upcoming Stage.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_6.zhText: 在阶段完成界面中预览无尽回廊下一阶段的任务类型。使用这些信息来决定是撤离，还是接受下一阶段的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_7.text: The more Stages you complete in one run, the more Circuit Progress you will earn per Stage up until a cap. Total Circuit Progress earned per Stage is capped after Stage 5.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_7.zhText: 在单个任务中完成的阶段越多，每个阶段你获得的无尽回廊进度就越多，直到到达上限。第 5 阶段后，每个阶段获得的无尽回廊总进度会达到上限。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_8.text: Operator Transference is available in the Undercroft. Those with the Operator unlocked have full access to Operator Abilities, Amps, Focus Gains, and more in the Circuit.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_8.zhText: 地穴中可使用指挥官传识。在无尽回廊中，已解锁指挥官的玩家可以访问指挥官技能、增幅器、专精获取等内容。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_9.text: Energy Pickups spawn at certain locations across Undercroft Tiles. Search them out for an added boost to your Energy pool.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/DuviriEndless_9.zhText: 能量拾取物会在遍布地穴场景的特定位置生成。搜寻它们以为你的能量池加成。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/HeliocorRecipeHint.text: Blueprint can be found among the offerings extended by Cephalon Simaris.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/HeliocorRecipeHint.zhText: 蓝图可在中枢 Simaris 提供的物品中找到。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquestTutoria.text:
Albrecht's |OPEN_COLOR|Deep Archimedea|CLOSE_COLOR| was his project to discover how to defeat The Murmur. Help Necraloid to continue Albrecht's ongoing work by running a preselected set of |OPEN_COLOR|3 missions|CLOSE_COLOR|, consecutively and without breaks, under extremely challenging conditions.

Each week Deep Archimedea must be |OPEN_COLOR|Unlocked|CLOSE_COLOR| by using |OPEN_COLOR|2 Search Pulses|CLOSE_COLOR|. These are the same Search Pulses that locate Netracells.

With every new week, Necraloid alters the experiment, adding a new set of missions, each with their own |OPEN_COLOR|Risk Variables|CLOSE_COLOR| and |OPEN_COLOR|Deviations|CLOSE_COLOR|. Study these carefully to prepare for what is to be endured.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquestTutoria.zhText:
阿尔布雷希特的|OPEN_COLOR|深层科研|CLOSE_COLOR|是他探索如何击败低语者的项目。帮助殁世械灵继续阿尔布雷希特未完成的工作，在极具挑战性的条件下，连续完成一组预先选定的|OPEN_COLOR| 3 个任务|CLOSE_COLOR|，且不得中断。

每周的深层科研需使用|OPEN_COLOR| 2 个搜索脉冲|CLOSE_COLOR|来|OPEN_COLOR|解锁|CLOSE_COLOR|，这些搜索脉冲也是用于定位衰退室的。

每新的一周，殁世械灵都会改变试验设置，加入新的任务组，每组任务都带有各自的|OPEN_COLOR|风险变量|CLOSE_COLOR|和|OPEN_COLOR|偏差|CLOSE_COLOR|。仔细研究这些，为即将面临的挑战做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquestTutoria.text:
Necraloid also selects |OPEN_COLOR|Loadout|CLOSE_COLOR| items that he wishes to study. Equip these to receive extra |OPEN_COLOR|Research Points|CLOSE_COLOR|. 

|OPEN_COLOR|Personal Modifiers|CLOSE_COLOR| offer the opportunity for brave Tenno to take extra risks in return for |OPEN_COLOR|Research Points|CLOSE_COLOR|.

The more |OPEN_COLOR|Research Points|CLOSE_COLOR| earned, the greater the |OPEN_COLOR|Reward Pools|CLOSE_COLOR| that are unlocked.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquestTutoria.zhText:
殁世械灵还挑选了他想研究的|OPEN_COLOR|配置|CLOSE_COLOR|物品。装备这些物品可以获得额外的|OPEN_COLOR|研究点数|CLOSE_COLOR|。 

|OPEN_COLOR|个人难度改造|CLOSE_COLOR|为勇敢的 Tenno 提供了一个机会，以额外的风险换取|OPEN_COLOR|研究点数|CLOSE_COLOR|。

获得的|OPEN_COLOR|研究点数|CLOSE_COLOR|越多，解锁的|OPEN_COLOR|奖励池|CLOSE_COLOR|就越大。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquestTutoria.text:
Pay special attention to Deep Archimedea's restrictions. |OPEN_COLOR|Void Angels|CLOSE_COLOR| prevent self-revival and must be defeated to bring a bled-out Tenno back to the fray.

When you have mastered Deep Archimedea, it will be time to move onto |OPEN_COLOR|Elite Archimedea|CLOSE_COLOR|. The ultimate test.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquestTutoria.zhText:
请特别留意深层科研的限制条件。|OPEN_COLOR|虚空天使|CLOSE_COLOR|会阻止自我复活，只有将其击败才能让濒死的 Tenno 重回战斗。

当你精通了深层科研，就意味着可以挑战|OPEN_COLOR|精英科研|CLOSE_COLOR|了。这是终极的考验。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_0.text: Unlocking Deep Archimedea for the week consumes 2 out of 5 of your weekly Netracell Search Pulses.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_0.zhText: 解锁本周的深层科研会消耗你每周 5 个衰退室搜索脉冲中的 2 个。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_1.text: Attempt Deep Archimedea as many times as you need. Additional attempts do not cost Search Pulses.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_1.zhText: 可以根据需要多次尝试深层科研。额外的尝试不会消耗搜寻脉冲。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_2.text: All squad members must be Illuminate (Rank 5) with the Cavia to participate in the Deep Archimedea challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_2.zhText: 所有小队成员都必须达到科维兽启迪者（等级 5）才能参加深层科研挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_3.text: All three Deep Archimedea missions must be played consecutively. Consider your loadout carefully to account for all challenges.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_3.zhText: 所有三个深层科研任务必须依序完成。慎重选择你的配置以面对所有的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_4.text: Each Individual Parameters equipped will increase your Research Points granting you more rewards upon completion.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_4.zhText: 安装的每个个别参数都会增加你的研究点数，让你在完成时获得更多的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_5.text: To unlock Elite Archimedea permanently, complete Deep Archimedea once with all Individual Parameters applied.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_5.zhText: 要永久解锁精英科研，需要启用全部个人参数并完成一次深层科研任务。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_6.text: Individual Parameters only apply to yourself when selected, and only affect your own Research Points. Elite Archimedea mission modifiers are shared by all players in the squad, and add to everybody's Research Points if selected.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_6.zhText: 选定的个人参数只对你生效，并且只影响你自己的研究点数。精英科研任务的难度改造是小队共享的，选中后可为所有人增加研究点数。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_7.text: Additional rewards can be earned on subsequent Deep Archimedea runs if you achieve a higher tier of Research Points.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_7.zhText: 如果你获得更高级别的研究点数，则可以在后续的深层科研游玩中获得额外奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_8.text: Staying downed for too long risks forfeiture of rewards, and each Revive of a fallen squadmate makes the Void Angels stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_8.zhText: 倒地时间过长有可能失去奖励，而每一次复活倒地的队友都会让虚空天使变得更加强大。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_9.text: Individual Parameters may require careful planning to build a squad capable of handling the challenge. Deep Archimedea is best played with friends, so plan loadouts accordingly!
/Lotus/Language/Hints/LabConquest_9.zhText: 个别参数可能需要谨慎规划，以组建一个能面对挑战的小队。深层科研最适合与朋友们一起游玩，共同规划配置！

/Lotus/Language/Hints/MirageQuest_1.text:
Solve the following riddle and go to its indicated location;

Three parts, three acts, three riddles for thee - 
to revive the one wielding fantasy
Ancient gods so cruel, once ruled from on high
Can you name their peak where the land meets the sky?
/Lotus/Language/Hints/MirageQuest_1.zhText:
解开下面的谜语，并前往它所指示的位置；

为汝准备了三个部件，三幕演出，三道谜题——
为了复活那位运用幻想之人
残忍的上古神明，一度在高处统治着
你能说出它们的顶峰，那个大地与天空接壤之地的名字吗？

/Lotus/Language/Hints/MirageQuest_2.text:
Solve the following riddle and go to its indicated location;

To build the one you think witty,
seek the nymph who sang oh so pretty.
She lured him in with her song and a grin,
his wife must’ve thought it a pity.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/MirageQuest_2.zhText:
解开下面的谜语，并前往它所指示的位置；

为了建造那位你所想的诙谐之人，
去寻找那位拥有美丽歌喉的仙女。
他以美丽的各区域笑容将他化为俘虏，
他的妻子一定觉得可惜。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/MirageQuest_3.text:
Solve the following riddle and go to its indicated location;

One more act before your prize is caught.
An ancient sea creature, take a whirl or not?
Look for the monster that swallowed sailors of yore.
Make a mistake and you’re sunk. Nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/MirageQuest_3.zhText:
解开下面的谜语，并前往它所指示的位置；

离你的奖赏仅剩一步之遥。
一个古老的海洋生物，它也许会旋转？
寻找那吞噬昔时水手的怪物。
任何失误都将使你葬身于海底。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnDrainAvaila.text: Visit the Arsenal regularly to keep your Mods up to date. Remember that you can melt down spare copies of Mods to gain Endo for rank-ups.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnDrainAvaila.zhText: 定期访问军械库，保持你的 Mod 更新。记住，你可以分解多余的 Mod 来获取内融核心，从而用于提升等级。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGenericWith.text: Don't forget to use consumables from the Gear wheel if you have them. Blueprints are available in the Market under the Gear section.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGenericWith.zhText: 如果有消耗品，别忘了使用携带装备轮盘里的物品。这些消耗品蓝图可以在游戏内商店的「携带装备」部分找到。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGenericWith.text: With the right upgrades, a Companion can restore both your Health and Shields as well as fight alongside you.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGenericWith.zhText: 通过适当的配置强化后，同伴可以恢复你的生命值和护盾，并与你并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_0.text: Remember to keep moving in combat. Enemies are especially bad at hitting Warframes during parkour maneuvers.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_0.zhText: 记住在战斗中保持移动。在跑酷过程中的战甲会让敌人难以命中。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_1.text: Your melee weapon can deflect enemy projectiles if you have it in hand and face the incoming attack.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_1.zhText: 如果你手持近战武器并面向来袭的攻击，它可以格挡敌人的投射物。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_2.text: Take cover sooner rather than later. Your Shields recover much faster from minor damage than they do after being fully depleted.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_2.zhText: 尽早寻找掩护。你的护盾在受到轻微伤害后恢复的速度比完全耗尽后快得多。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_3.text: Do a barrel roll! During a Roll you are harder to hit and take less damage.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnGeneric_3.zhText: 来个桶滚！在翻滚时，你更难被击中，受到的伤害也更小。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnHealth.text: You can increase your Warframe's survivability by installing and ranking up the Vitality Mod in the Upgrades section of the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnHealth.zhText: 你可以通过在军械库的「升级」部分安装和升级生命力 Mod 来提高你战甲的生存能力。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnMelee.text: Install and rank up the Pressure Point Mod on your melee weapon to significantly increase your melee damage.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnMelee.zhText: 在你的近战武器上安装并升级压迫点 Mod，以显著增强你的近战伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnNoAura.text: Installing an Aura Mod will increase your Modding Capacity in addition to its other effects.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnNoAura.zhText: 安装光环 Mod 除了会获得其他效果外，还会增加你的 Mod 容量。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnNoSuitMods.text: You can increase your Warframe's offensive and defensive power by installing Mods in the Upgrades section of the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnNoSuitMods.zhText: 你可以通过在军械库的「升级」部分安装 Mod 来增加战甲的攻击力和防御力。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnPrimaryRifl.text: Install and rank up the Serration Mod on your primary weapon to significantly increase your firepower.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnPrimaryRifl.zhText: 在你的主要武器上安装并升级膛线 Mod，以显著增强你的火力。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnPrimaryShot.text: Install and rank up the Point Blank Mod on your primary weapon to significantly increase your firepower.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnPrimaryShot.zhText: 在你的主要武器上安装并升级抵近射击 Mod，以显著增强你的火力。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnSecondary.text: Install and rank up the Hornet Strike Mod on your secondary weapon to significantly increase your firepower.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnSecondary.zhText: 在你的次要武器上安装并升级黄蜂螫刺 Mod，以显著增强你的火力。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnShield.text: You can increase your Warframe's survivability by installing and ranking up the Redirection Mod in the Upgrades section of the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnShield.zhText: 你可以通过在军械库的「升级」部分安装和升级蓄能重划 Mod 来提高你战甲的生存能力。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnSuitLevel.text: Earn Affinity to increase your Warframe's Rank, improving its base stats as well as its Abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/RespawnSuitLevel.zhText: 获得经验值来提高战甲的精通段位，强化其基础数值和技能。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|Temporal Archimedea|CLOSE_COLOR| is Kaya Velasco's ongoing project to find and repair weaknesses in the 1999 time loop. Help her by running a preselected set of |OPEN_COLOR|3 missions|CLOSE_COLOR|, consecutively and without breaks, under extremely challenging conditions. Velimir and Minerva will assist you.

Each week Temporal Archimedea must be |OPEN_COLOR|Unlocked|CLOSE_COLOR| by using |OPEN_COLOR|2 Search Pulses|CLOSE_COLOR|. These are the same Search Pulses that locate Netracells.

With every new week, Kaya alters the experiment, adding a new set of missions, each with their own |OPEN_COLOR|Risk Variables|CLOSE_COLOR| and |OPEN_COLOR|Deviations|CLOSE_COLOR|. Study these carefully to prepare for what is to be endured.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|时光科研|CLOSE_COLOR|是卡娅·维拉斯科正在进行的项目，旨在找到并修复 1999 时间循环中的弱点。帮助她在极具挑战性的条件下，连续完成一组预先选定的|OPEN_COLOR| 3 个任务|CLOSE_COLOR|，且不得中断。期间维利米尔和米尼娃将会协助你。

每周的时光科研需使用|OPEN_COLOR| 2 个搜索脉冲|CLOSE_COLOR|来|OPEN_COLOR|解锁|CLOSE_COLOR|，这些搜索脉冲也是用于定位衰退室的。

每新的一周，卡娅都会改变试验设置，加入新的任务组，每组任务都带有各自的|OPEN_COLOR|风险变量|CLOSE_COLOR|和|OPEN_COLOR|偏差|CLOSE_COLOR|。仔细研究这些，为即将面临的挑战做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text:
Kaya also selects |OPEN_COLOR|Loadout|CLOSE_COLOR| items that she wishes to study. Equip these to receive extra |OPEN_COLOR|Research Points|CLOSE_COLOR|.

Apply |OPEN_COLOR|Peely Pix|CLOSE_COLOR| to missions to give yourself additional beneficial effects. Peely Pix are collectible stickers with three tiers of strength.

|OPEN_COLOR|Personal Modifiers|CLOSE_COLOR| offer the opportunity for brave Tenno to take extra risks in return for |OPEN_COLOR|Research Points|CLOSE_COLOR|.

The more |OPEN_COLOR|Research Points|CLOSE_COLOR| earned, the greater the |OPEN_COLOR|Reward Pools|CLOSE_COLOR| that are unlocked.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText:
卡娅还挑选了她想研究的|OPEN_COLOR|配置|CLOSE_COLOR|物品。装备这些物品可以获得额外的|OPEN_COLOR|研究点数|CLOSE_COLOR|。 

应用|OPEN_COLOR|易撕贴纸|CLOSE_COLOR|可为你带来额外的加成效果。易撕贴纸是可收集的贴纸，具有三个强度等级。

|OPEN_COLOR|个人难度改造|CLOSE_COLOR|为勇敢的 Tenno 提供了一个机会，以额外的风险换取|OPEN_COLOR|研究点数|CLOSE_COLOR|。

获得的|OPEN_COLOR|研究点数|CLOSE_COLOR|越多，解锁的|OPEN_COLOR|奖励池|CLOSE_COLOR|就越大。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text:
Pay special attention to Temporal Archimedea's restrictions. Fallen Tenno cannot self-revive. To bring a bled-out Tenno back to the fray, a squadmate must collect 5 |OPEN_COLOR|Resurgence Tokens|CLOSE_COLOR| from defeated enemies and breach a console.

When you have mastered Temporal Archimedea, it will be time to move onto |OPEN_COLOR|Elite Temporal Archimedea|CLOSE_COLOR|. The ultimate test.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText:
请特别留意时光科研的限制条件。倒地的 Tenno 无法自我复活。队友必须从被击败的敌人身上收集 5 个|OPEN_COLOR|复活令牌|CLOSE_COLOR|，然后破解控制台，才能将倒地出血的 Tenno 带回战场。

当你精通了时光科研，就意味着可以挑战|OPEN_COLOR|精英时光科研|CLOSE_COLOR|了。这是终极的考验。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: Unlocking Temporal Archimedea for the week consumes 2 out of 5 of your weekly Netracell Search Pulses.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 解锁本周的时光科研会消耗你每周 5 个衰退室搜索脉冲中的 2 个。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: Attempt Temporal Archimedea as many times as you need. Additional attempts do not cost Search Pulses.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 可以根据需要多次尝试时光科研。额外的尝试不会消耗搜寻脉冲。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: All squad members must be at Pizza Party (Rank 5) with the Hex to participate in the Temporal Archimedea challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 所有小队成员都必须达到披萨派对（等级 5）才能参加时光科研挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: All three Temporal Archimedea missions must be played consecutively. Consider your loadout carefully to account for all challenges.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 所有三个时光科研任务必须依序完成。慎重选择你的配置以面对所有的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: Each Individual Parameters equipped will increase your Research Points granting you more rewards upon completion.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 安装的每个个别参数都会增加你的研究点数，让你在完成时获得更多的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: To unlock Elite Temporal Archimedea permanently, complete Temporal Archimedea once with all Individual Parameters applied.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 要永久解锁精英时光科研，需要启用全部个人参数并完成一次时光科研任务。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: Individual Parameters only apply to yourself when selected, and only affect your own Research Points. Elite Temporal Archimedea mission modifiers are shared by all players in the squad, and add to everybody's Research Points if selected.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 选定的个人参数只对你生效，并且只影响你自己的研究点数。精英时光科研任务的难度改造是小队共享的，选中后可为所有人增加研究点数。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: Additional rewards can be earned on subsequent Temporal Archimedea runs if you achieve a higher tier of Research Points.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 如果你获得更高级别的研究点数，则可以在后续的时光科研游玩中获得额外奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: If a squadmate is downed, collect 5 |OPEN_COLOR|Resurgence Tokens|CLOSE_COLOR| from fallen enemies, then hack at a terminal to revive them.
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 如果一名小队成员倒地，则从倒下的敌人身上收集 5 个|OPEN_COLOR|复活令牌|CLOSE_COLOR|，然后入侵终端机以复活他们。

/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.text: Individual Parameters may require careful planning to build a squad capable of handling the challenge. Temporal Archimedea is best played with friends, so plan loadouts accordingly!
/Lotus/Language/Hints/TemporalArchimedea.zhText: 个别参数可能需要谨慎规划，以组建一个能面对挑战的小队。时光科研最适合与朋友们一起游玩，共同规划配置！

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseBodySki.text: Aetigo Kaithes are a native species of Duviri's southernmost island. Their emerald eyes once reflected the verdant plains they roamed, but when the island was reduced to ash, their eyes faded to nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseBodySki.zhText: 因理绝灵骥是双衍王境最南端岛屿的本地物种。它们祖母绿色的眼眸曾经映照着它们踏过的青翠平原，但当岛屿化为灰烬之时，它们的眼睛也随之消逝。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseBodySki.text: Psyacus Kaithes inspire fear in the faint of heart. Common wisdom among Duviri citizens holds that those who mount the Psyacus Kaithe must be either courageous or heartless.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseBodySki.zhText: 心道绝灵骥会在懦夫的心中唤起恐惧。双衍王境的民众普遍认为，那些骑上心道绝灵骥的人要么勇敢，要么无情。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseBodySki.text: It is said that the great Dominus Thrax prefers Histornam Kaithes above all other breeds. It was on the back of a Histornam Kaithe that Thrax himself learned to ride.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseBodySki.zhText: 有言说伟大的士魂大帝最喜史源绝灵骥，胜于其他的所有品种。正是在一匹史源的背上，士魂大帝本人学会了骑乘。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetA.text: The might of the Kaithe rider is expressed through the Sviari Chamfron's sharp horns.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetA.zhText: 绝灵骥骑手的力量表现在瑞豚马盔的锋利之角上。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetB.text: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetB.zhText: 勇角马盔的弯角让人想起塔牧羊，据说它的快乐会带来好运。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetC.text: The Irdeni Chamfron is reminiscent of the ever-changing hues in Duviri’s sky.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetC.zhText: 复斓马盔让人想起双衍王境中千变万化的色调。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetD.text: The Kheyur Chamfron befits any formal occasion.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseHelmetD.zhText: 华金马盔适合任何正式场合。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseSaddleA.text: The Dovin Saddle's deep curve and lightweight structure make for strong balance and gentle communication with the Kaithe.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseSaddleA.zhText: 迹语石马鞍深沉的曲线和轻巧的结构使得绝灵骥兼具良好的平衡性和易于与骑手交流。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseSaddleB.text: The Vaidurian Saddle’s comfortable and sturdy design is ideal for those long hours riding Kaithes.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseSaddleB.zhText: 猫睛石马鞍舒适坚固的设计非常适合长时间骑乘绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseSaddleC.text: Style and comfort meet in the Sohseki Saddle. Its padding provides stability and protection during jumps.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseSaddleC.zhText: 杀生石马鞍兼具酷炫与舒适的特性。它的填充物在跳跃过程中具备很好的稳定性和保护性。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailADe.text: The Caersid Tail bespeaks the spirit of the vengeful warrior.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailADe.zhText: 战坞马尾彰显着复仇战士的精神。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailBDe.text: A Kaithe with the Heoro Tail evokes glory.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailBDe.zhText: 拥有荣英马尾的绝灵骥召唤出荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailCDe.text: Adorn the movements of an elegant Kaithe with the Velific Tail.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailCDe.zhText: 用灵现马尾装饰优雅的绝灵骥的动作。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDDe.text: Bones laid bare in the Aebolg Tail are a reminder to appreciate the gift of life.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDDe.zhText: 骨棘马尾上裸露的骨头提醒着人们珍惜生命的馈赠。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDef.text: The Aetigo Kaithe came into being with this dignified tail.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDef.zhText: 因理绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条气派的尾巴。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDef.text: The Psyacus Kaithe came into being with this tapered tail.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDef.zhText: 心道绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条锥形尾巴。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDef.text: The Histornam Kaithe came into being with this regal tail.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseTailDef.zhText: 史源绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条华丽的尾巴。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseWingsAD.text: Outstretched wings reveal the path to celestial planes.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzHorseWingsAD.zhText: 展开的双翼揭示了通往天外位面之径。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzSummonDesc.text: Summon and instantly mount a Kaithe while in free roam missions.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/ErsatzSummonDesc.zhText: 在自由漫游任务中召唤并立即骑上绝灵骥。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/GaussDeluxeHorseHe.text: Fan the flames of fortitude with the Aethon Chamfron.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/GaussDeluxeHorseHe.zhText: 用神驱马盔扇起坚韧的火焰。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/GaussDeluxeHorseSa.text: The Aethon Saddle's flames don't burn the skilled rider.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/GaussDeluxeHorseSa.zhText: 神驱马鞍上的火焰并不会灼伤熟练的骑手。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/GaussDeluxeHorseTa.text: The Aethon Tail is a good companion piece to the rider of fleet-footed fire.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/GaussDeluxeHorseTa.zhText: 神驱马尾是迅猛骑手的好搭档配件。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseHelmetDrapery.text: Beware the fearsome yet elegant curves of the Aumen Chamfron's horns.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseHelmetDrapery.zhText: 当心金兆马鞍锐利的角及其可怖而优雅的弧度。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseSaddleDrapery.text: Stylish spikes bely the true comfort of the Aumen Saddle.
/Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseSaddleDrapery.zhText: 金兆马鞍虽有时髦尖刺，实则舒适无比。

/Lotus/Language/Horse/HorseTailDraperyDe.text: A grand tail for a magnificent beast.

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGe.text: Gonna blaze for a stretch, need a whole lotta grunt.
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGe.zhText: 点燃起来跑上一段，轰鸣声永远不嫌多。

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGe.text: Killer profile. Stay level and bomb no landin’s. Lord a tha board!
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGe.zhText: 酷得要死的外形。保持水平，永不落地。滑板之王！

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGe.text: Scrawl art designed by the Ventkids to customize your K-Drive.
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGe.zhText: 由通风小子设计的涂鸦艺术，可以用于自定你的 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGr.text: Tap and hold Grind in the air to execute a |RADIUS|m radius Slam Shockwave that deals |DAMAGE| damage.
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardGr.zhText: 在空中点击并按住卡杆，来放出一道 |RADIUS| 米范围的震地冲击波造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.text: Infested tissue and transformed bone, fashioned into a willing servitor.
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.zhText: 感染的组织以及转化的骨骼，被改造成为一个心甘情愿的仆人。

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.text: The pulse and kick of organic power, tamed to the rider’s art.
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.zhText: 有机动力的脉动和震荡，被骑手的技艺所驯服。

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.text: Adorn your mount with these sturdy horns, to warn others out of your path.
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.zhText: 用这些坚固的角来点缀你的坐骑，以警告他人不要挡道。

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.text: Infested vapors may bring a noisome stench, but they also bring great power.
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardIn.zhText: 感染蒸汽可能会带来令人讨厌的臭味，但也会带来强大的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardMa.zhText: 将最大特技组合数提升到 |VALUE|

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardPa.zhText: 组装 K 式悬浮板

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardSe.zhText: 选择一块 K 式悬浮板

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardSt.text: Officially-licensed Baro Ki'Teer K-Drive Scrawl! Get yours today, kids!
/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardSt.zhText: 官方授权的 Baro Ki'Teer K 式悬浮板涂鸦！孩子们，今天就来获取吧！
蓝色 KI'TEER 游猎 K 式悬浮板涂鸦

/Lotus/Language/Hoverboards/HoverboardSt.text: Officially-licensed Baro Ki'Teer K-Drive Scrawl! Get yours today, kids!

/Lotus/Language/IRC/CETUS_MOTD.text: Swazdo-lah, Tenno! Welcome to Cetus, unique among the stars! Explore the bustling market for all your practical needs! If you're looking for adventure on the Plains of Eidolon speak to Konzu. Stay a while, and come back anytime on your journeys across the Rails.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/CETUS_MOTD.zhText: Tenno，Swazdo—lah（你好）！欢迎来到众星间独一无二的希图斯！探索繁华的市集来满足你的实际需求！如果你寻求夜灵平野的冒险的话，去跟孔尊谈谈吧。请在这里驻足片刻，你可以随时在穿梭航道的旅途中回来看看。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/CONSOLE_T_MOTD.text:
- Trading is done within the Dojo at a Trading Post or in Maroo's Bazaar.
- You can invite non-members of your clan to your Dojo to trade.
- Not all items can be Traded. Set up shop in Maroo's Bazaar to see what you can offer and buy!
- In order to trade you must achieve Mastery Rank 2 and enable TennoGuard 2FA in Account Management on www.warframe.com.
- Please refrain from trading item redemption codes.

Note: We do not enforce trades for promises, clan membership, and other favors. Trade for items only.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/CONSOLE_T_MOTD.zhText:
:trading:欢迎来到交易频道，Tenno:trading:

－严禁 RMT（现实金钱交易）行为，这将导致账号被封禁。
－严禁账号买卖/分享行为，这将导致账号被封禁。
－交易可通过氏族道场中的交易机或 Maroo 的市集（位于火星）来进行。
－您可以邀请非氏族成员的玩家到您的道场进行交易。
－不是所有的道具都可以进行交易。
－要进行交易，您必须达到精通段位 2，并在 www.warframe.com 的账号管理界面开启 TennoGuard 双重验证。
－请不要交易商品兑换码。
－在频道中贴出道具链接：输入括号[]，并在括号间输入道具名称，会自动跳出相关道具可供选择。
－希望您能在交易时多多注意，在确保交易无误后再进行确认，避免出现交易中给您带来的不便以及误会。

请注意：我们并未强制玩家履行交易承诺、氏族会籍或是赠与等交易行为。交易内容只限于游戏内的道具。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/ChannelBan.zhText: 您使用该频道的权限已被暂停。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/DEIMOS_MOTD.text: Welcome, Tenno, to the hallowed Necralisk... what remains of it. Here you will find safe haven from the Infestation that ravages Deimos. The Entrati family are more approachable than they look, and will co-operate with you in the interests of mutual survival. Not everything you will see is as it seems, for the Necralisk holds potent secrets for those with the means to find them...
/Lotus/Language/IRC/DEIMOS_MOTD.zhText: Tenno，欢迎你来到神圣的殁世幽都……的遗迹。这里是你安全的避风港，让你远离肆虐火卫二的感染者。英择谛家族比他们看起来更平易近人，他们会为了彼此的生存与你合作。你所看到的并不一定就是真实的情况，因为殁世幽都蕴藏着巨大的秘密，就看你能不能找出它们……

/Lotus/Language/IRC/D_MOTD.text:
Honorable Design Council, welcome to your private channel. 
We gather here to discuss Warframe. Recruiting here is discouraged for connectivity reasons. 
Note: We at [DE] speak English and we'd prefer English discussion so we can participate.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/D_MOTD.zhText:
光荣的设计委员，欢迎来到您的私人频道。
我们齐聚在此，共同探讨《Warframe》。出于网络连接的考虑，请勿在此进行招募。
请注意：我们在 [DE] 使用英语，所以我们更希望各位能用英语来交流，以便我们能参与其中。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Abuse.text: Please be respectful and constructive in your feedback. Abuse will not be tolerated.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Abuse.zhText: 请在反馈问题时有礼貌并具有建设性。辱骂是不能被容忍的。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Recruiting.text: Someone in the recruiting :recruiting: channel might be willing to help you.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Recruiting.zhText: 招募 :recruiting: 频道的人也许乐意帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Spam.text: Simmer down there Otto von Spamalot.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Spam.zhText: 请冷静下来，奥托-冯-刷屏先生/女士。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Topic.text: That is not an appropriate topic for our space-ninja game.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_Topic.zhText: 对于我们这款太空忍者游戏而言，这不是一个合适的话题。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_TradeEULA.text: This trade would be in violation of the EULA. Trading for Discounts, Favors, non-Warframe items or Real-World Currency is prohibited.

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_UsePrivateMess.zhText: 请在"私信"中继续讨论。谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_UseRegion.text: Please use :region: Region Chat to discuss topics of this nature.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/Flush_UseRegion.zhText: 请在 :region: 区域频道来讨论这些话题。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/G_MOTD.text:
Welcome, Tenno.
Be respectful.
No profanity.
No spamming.
Only Recruit in "Recruiting" Channel.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/G_MOTD.zhText:
:region:欢迎来到区域频道，Tenno:region:
《来自频管的温馨提醒：珍爱账号，远离老司机。》

/Lotus/Language/IRC/HOLLVANIAMALL_MOTD.text: Höllvania Central Mall was abandoned following the Techrot outbreak. Arthur Nightingale and the Hex have turned it into a combination of command center, living quarters and emergency shelter.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/HOLLVANIAMALL_MOTD.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚中央商场在科腐者爆发后被废弃。亚瑟·南丁格尔和六人组将这里改造成了指挥中心、生活区和紧急避难所的结合体。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/HUNHOW_MOTD.text: Pontis Tower, once a secret development laboratory for the Sentient project, is now home to Stalker's family. Respectful Tenno may converse with Hunhow, and will find both Vena and Ryoku are eager for allies in their Railjack Skirmishes.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/HUNHOW_MOTD.zhText: 渡界之塔曾是 Sentient 计划的秘密研发实验室，如今是追猎者一家的居所。尊敬的 Tenno 可以与 Hunhow 交谈，并且会发现维纳和忍力都渴望在他们的航道星舰前哨战中获得盟友。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/H_MOTD.text: Welcome to the Relay! Explore and meet with fellow Tenno. Mastery Rank 3 or higher players can access Syndicate rewards. Stay tuned for Baro Ki'Teer visits with unique items!
/Lotus/Language/IRC/H_MOTD.zhText: 欢迎来到中继站！在此探索并与 Tenno 伙伴相会。精通段位达 3 等或是更高阶的玩家可以取得集团奖励。请持续关注 Baro Ki'Teer 的来访，以及他带来稀有道具！

/Lotus/Language/IRC/PRAGHASA_MOTD.text: Behold Praghasa, the dread Sentient Mothership! Join other Tenno in feeding her Moonflesh as fuel for the return journey to Tau!
/Lotus/Language/IRC/PRAGHASA_MOTD.zhText: 看哪——「布拉喀萨」——恐怖的 Sentient 母舰！与其他 Tenno 一同将月华脯投入她的腹中作为燃料，为返回 Tau 星系的旅程提供动力！

/Lotus/Language/IRC/Q_MOTD.text:
Ask your questions about Warframe here and get answers from the community!

Please be respectful and only use this channel to ask or answer Warframe questions.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/Q_MOTD.zhText:
在这里提出与 Warframe 相关的问题，通过玩家社区来获得答案！

请秉持尊重他人的原则，并且不要在该频道内讨论与 Warframe 无关的问题。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/R_MOTD.text: Recruit for a Squad or Clan here!
/Lotus/Language/IRC/R_MOTD.zhText:
:recruiting:欢迎来到组队招募频道，Tenno:recruiting:

－可在此进行组队或为氏族招新。
－此频道的玩家 ID 列表预设为隐藏状态，发言后即显示于玩家列表中。
－无须担心您的发言无人看到，因为很可能这时其他玩家还在隐藏状态。
－严禁发布代练及 RMT（现实金钱交易）等违反游戏使用条款的信息。
－请勿刷屏，发送过多的重复或类似的内容。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/SOLARISUNITED_MOTD.text: Howzit, Outworlder! Welcome to Fortuna, nerve-center of Nef Anyo's attempts to terraform Venus and home to the Solaris rig jockeys who make it all happen. Talk to the local reprobates for all your quasi-legal needs! If you're looking to hit the Orb Vallis talk to Eudico. Fortuna: it ain't much, but it's home... provided you can handle all the noise comin' from the vents.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/SOLARISUNITED_MOTD.zhText: 你好，异世者！欢迎来到福尔图娜，这里是奈富·安尤试图地球化金星的神经中枢，也是让这一切成为可能的索拉里斯技工的家园。如果你有任何差不多合法的需求，就和当地的不法分子谈谈吧！如果你想要去奥布山谷，就和 Eudico 谈谈。福尔图娜：她虽然不那么完美，但毕竟是家……只要你能忍受从通风管里传来的各种噪音的话。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/ServerBan.text: Your access to in-game chat has been suspended.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/ServerBan.zhText: 您已被暂停使用游戏内的聊天系统。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/ServerShutdown.text: The chat server has been taken offline for maintenance.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/ServerShutdown.zhText: 聊天服务器正在进行离线维护。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/TENNOCON_MOTD.text: This Relay is abuzz with speculation. All staff are under orders to keep the Drydock clear. Tenno have special permission to gather here and await whatever is coming.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/TENNOCON_MOTD.zhText: 这个中继站里充满了各种猜测。所有工作人员都接到命令，确保干船坞畅通无阻。Tenno 获得了特别许可，可以聚集在这里，等待即将到来的事情发生。
