请注意：我们并未强制玩家履行交易承诺、氏族会籍或是赠与等交易行为。交易内容只限于游戏内的道具。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/YUVANPEAK_MOTD.text: Join Cephalon Melica and her class for a brisk field trip to scenic Yuvan Peak.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/YUVANPEAK_MOTD.zhText: 加入中枢梅丽卡和她的班级，前往风景秀丽的青春峰顶，进行一场轻松愉快的实地考察。

/Lotus/Language/IRC/ZARIMAN_MOTD.text: The Tenno remember the Chrysalith as a concourse where colonists could meet and relax. Now it serves as a much-needed sanctuary from the nightmares of the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/IRC/ZARIMAN_MOTD.zhText: Tenno 印象中的羽化之穹是殖民者用来聚会和放松之地。而现在，它成为了人们亟需远离「扎里曼号」梦魇的避难所。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Airbo.text: Being airborne triggers cumulative electrical damage, which dissipates over time once on the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Airbo.zhText: 在空中时会触发累积性的电击伤害，落地后该伤害会随时间逐渐消失。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Antim.text: Enemies killed by abilities spawn a hostile Antimatter Drop that tracks you.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Antim.zhText: 被技能击杀的敌人会生成一个会追踪你的敌对反物质释放。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Attac.text: When taking damage, a grenade may be dropped at your feet that explodes after a few seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Attac.zhText: 受到伤害时，有几率在你的脚边掉落一枚几秒后爆炸的手榴弹。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_HighA.text: Enemy armor is greatly increased and cannot be stripped normally. Each hit they take reduces their maximum armor by 1%.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_HighA.zhText: 敌人的护甲大幅增加，并且无法通过常规方式削减。每次受到攻击会使他们的最大护甲降低 1%。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_KelaM.zhText: 导弹会定期从空中落下。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Lante.text: The Squad is given two parasitic lanterns which drain energy from those that carry them. Enemies outside the lanterns' light have massive damage reduction.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Lante.zhText: 小队获得两盏寄生提灯，会消耗携带者的能量。在提灯灯光外的敌人，将获得大幅伤害减免。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Melee.text: Shields can only be restored via melee attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Melee.zhText: 护盾只能通过近战攻击恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Toast.text: Grounded movement inflicts Heat damage over time. Airborne movement reduces it.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/Condition_Toast.zhText: 地面移动会持续造成火焰伤害。空中移动则会减少这种伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellRevive_.text:
|OPEN_COLOR1|NO SELF-REVIVE|CLOSE_COLOR|
Self-revive is disabled. Instead, after a Tenno has bled-out, a |OPEN_COLOR2|Tombstone|CLOSE_COLOR| will appear where they fell. At least 3 surviving Tenno must sacrifice part of their health temporarily to bring the Tenno back into the action. If fewer than 3 Tenno are still standing then all of them must make the sacrifice to revive others.

|OPEN_COLOR1|LAST GASP PENALTY|CLOSE_COLOR|
Activating the |OPEN_COLOR2|Last Gasp|CLOSE_COLOR| focus ability reduces the timer by |OPEN_COLOR2||VALUE| seconds|CLOSE_COLOR|.

|OPEN_COLOR1|BLEEDOUT SHORTENS|CLOSE_COLOR|
The bleedout timer shortens after each revive, to a minimum of |OPEN_COLOR2|5 seconds|CLOSE_COLOR|.

|OPEN_COLOR1|FROZEN KEYS|CLOSE_COLOR|
After being dead for 3 minutes you will not obtain any |OPEN_COLOR2|Frozen Keys|CLOSE_COLOR| that the squad acquires by completing objectives while you are dead.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellRevive_.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR1|无法自行复活|CLOSE_COLOR|
自行复活已禁用。取而代之的是，在一名 Tenno 倒地出血后，在其倒下的位置会出现一个|OPEN_COLOR2|墓碑|CLOSE_COLOR|。至少需要三名幸存的 Tenno 暂时牺牲部分生命值才能将这名倒下的 Tenno 重新带回战斗中。如果幸存的 Tenno 少于三名，则所有幸存者都必须做出牺牲才能复活其他人。

|OPEN_COLOR1|弥留之际惩罚|CLOSE_COLOR|
激活|OPEN_COLOR2|弥留之际|CLOSE_COLOR|专精技能将使计时器缩短 |OPEN_COLOR2||VALUE| 秒|CLOSE_COLOR|。

|OPEN_COLOR1|濒死时间缩短|CLOSE_COLOR|
每次复活，濒死状态的持续时间都会缩短，最短为 |OPEN_COLOR2|5 秒|CLOSE_COLOR|。

|OPEN_COLOR1|冰封钥匙|CLOSE_COLOR|
死亡 3 分钟后，你将无法获得小队在你死亡期间完成目标所获得的任何|OPEN_COLOR2|冰封钥匙|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellSteelEm.text:
Enemy |OPEN_COLOR2|Health and Shields and Armor|CLOSE_COLOR| increased by |OPEN_COLOR2|200%|CLOSE_COLOR| and an additional |OPEN_COLOR2|100%|CLOSE_COLOR| for each squad member, stacking to a maximum of |OPEN_COLOR2|800%.|CLOSE_COLOR|

Increased chance of |OPEN_COLOR2|Eximus|CLOSE_COLOR|
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellSteelEm.zhText:
敌人的|OPEN_COLOR2|生命值、护盾和护甲|CLOSE_COLOR|增加 |OPEN_COLOR2|200%|CLOSE_COLOR|，每多一个小队成员再额外增加 |OPEN_COLOR2|100%|CLOSE_COLOR|，最高叠加至 |OPEN_COLOR2|800%。|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR2|卓越者|CLOSE_COLOR|的出现几率提升

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_K.text: Using abilities spawns crystals on you and triggers Entropic Overload, causing enemies to self-revive as Leech Eximus, and hostile Entropic Wisps begin to appear. Getting hit by a Wisp causes stacked crystals to explode. Destroying Entropic Crystals and Wisps will decrease saturation.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_K.zhText: 使用技能会在你身上生成晶体，并触发熵超载，导致敌人自我复活为吸血卓越者，并开始出现敌对熵灵。被熵灵击中会导致叠加的晶体爆炸。摧毁熵晶和熵灵以降低熵浓度。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_S.text: Enemies are hard as stone and hit even harder. Taking them by surprise is the best way to exploit weak points in their stony flesh. In addition, you will face hostile Tomb Guardians.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_S.zhText: 敌人坚硬如石，攻击力更是惊人。出其不意是攻击他们坚硬躯体弱点的最佳方法。此外，你还将遭遇敌对的古墓保卫者。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_T.text: Heat Status present on players or enemies will feed the Inferno, drawing in Arson Eximus, Heat empowered enemies, and damaging anyone near active sources of Heat. Avoid inflicting Heat Status, and kill hostile Heat sources to starve the Inferno.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_T.zhText: 玩家或敌人身上的火焰异常状态都会助长炼狱之火，吸引纵火卓越者、获得火焰强化的敌人前来，并对任何靠近活跃火源的目标造成伤害。避免施加火焰异常状态，并击杀带有火焰异常状态的敌对目标，以抑制炼狱之火。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_T.text: While squad members are close, their health is linked in one shared pool.  While apart, Squad members deal 90% less damage and health and shields are limited to 100. Any linked squad member who enters bleedout causes all those linked to enter bleedout.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_T.zhText: 小队成员在附近时，他们的生命值将共享。分散后，小队成员造成的伤害减少 90%，并且生命值和护盾的上限为 100。若其中一名共享生命值中的小队成员倒地出血，所有其他玩家也将进入倒地出血状态。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_T.text: Enemies slowly take damage, but are immune to Toxin, Gas, Viral, and Corrosive status effects. On death, a Gas cloud is released.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_T.zhText: 敌人会缓慢受到伤害，但免疫毒素、毒气、病毒和腐蚀异常状态效果。死亡时，会释放出一团毒气云。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_V.text: Ability Stats and Weapon Combo Durations reduced by 50%. Incarnon Charges drain 20% per second.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_V.zhText: 技能数值和武器连击持续时间减少 50%。灵化充能每秒消耗 20%。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_V.text: Void Tears rip into reality, growing with nearby ability use. Tears inflict Void Shackles, reducing ability stats and weapon combo durations, while draining energy, health, and Incarnon weapon energy.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/CryobellTheme_V.zhText: 虚空裂隙撕裂现实，并随着附近技能的使用而扩大。裂隙会施加虚空枷锁，降低技能属性和武器连击持续时间，同时消耗能量、生命值和灵化武器能量。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityB.text: Requires full Ice to cast. An ancestral spirit descends upon Narin and she begins sword dancing for continuous nearby damage. Press Attack to launch shattering icy slashes that deplete Armor and Shields. Hitting Frozen enemies causes them to explode, dealing massive radial <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage. Attacks on Marked Targets cost no Ice and do more damage.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityB.zhText: 需要满冰能量才能施放。先祖之灵降临在 Narin 身上，她随即开始剑舞，对周围敌人造成持续伤害。按下攻击键即可发射粉碎性的冰刃斩击，削弱其护甲和护盾。击中被冻结的敌人会使其爆炸，造成大范围 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。攻击被标记的目标不消耗冰能量，并造成更高伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityL.text:
Tap to leap into the air, tap again to land at target location. Applies <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage Vulnerability and Status Effect in a large radius upon landing.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityL.zhText:
轻按可跃向空中，再次轻按即可落在目标位置。落地时，对大范围内的敌人施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害易伤和异常状态效果。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityR.text:
Recover Shields by absorbing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Status Effect from nearby enemies. Gain <OVERGUARD_GAIN> Overguard if at full Shields.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityR.zhText:
通过吸收附近敌人施加的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态来恢复护盾。如果护盾已满，则获得 <OVERGUARD_GAIN>超宏防护。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityT.text:
Lunge with Narin's ice rapier Neote, inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage and <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold and <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Status Effect on foes directly ahead of her.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityT.zhText:
挥舞 Narin 的细剑寒霜疾剑进行突刺，对正前方敌人造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害以及 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻和 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityT.text: Lunge with Narin's ice rapier Neote, inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage and <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold and <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Status Effect on foes directly ahead of her.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityT.zhText: 挥舞 Narin 的细剑寒霜疾剑进行突刺，对正前方敌人造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害以及 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻和 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAltHelme.text: This alternate helmet for Narin evokes an otherworldly flower of frost, accentuating her finesse and grace.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAltHelme.zhText: Narin 的替换头盔让人联想到一朵超凡脱俗的霜花，突显了她的优雅与细致。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistArmourDe.text: With tassels that dance like snowflakes in the wind, these elegant clasps are worn by the people of Tethys to promote balance and harmony.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistArmourDe.zhText: 流苏在风中如雪花般舞动，Tethys 的人们佩戴这些优雅的饰扣以促进平衡与和谐。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistBowDesc.text: Narin's signature bow is the north wind's icy messenger. Alt Fire unleashes a charged blizzard arrow that freezes enemies it touches and leaves behind a chilling path.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistBowDesc.zhText: （英文：NUNCHASA）Narin 的标志性弓箭是北风的冰霜使者。次要开火模式会释放一支充能暴雪箭，冻结接触到的敌人并留下一道寒冰的痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistDefaultB.text: The standard issue skin for the Narin Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistEphemera.text: May a chill descend upon you with the frozen embrace of Narin's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistEphemera.zhText: 愿 Narin 的标志性幻纹将寒意伴着冰冷的拥抱降临于你。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Narin Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistPistolsD.text: Narin's signature pistols strike with winter's bite. Reloading sends out a chilling pulse that inflicts Cold Status Effect, the pulse's range increases with each round reloaded.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistPistolsD.zhText: （英文：AKSONDOL）Narin 的标志性手枪威力十足，如同凛冬的寒风。每次装填都会释放出一道寒冷的脉冲，使敌人陷入冰冻异常状态，脉冲的范围会随着装填次数的增加而扩大。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSignaDes.text: A circlet from ancient times, its ornamentation signifying wisdom and strength.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSignaDes.zhText: 来自古代的头环，其装饰象征着智慧与力量。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSpiritEp.text: Call on a frosty spirit to swirl around you.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSpiritEp.zhText: 召唤冰霜精灵环绕着你。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSuitDesc.text: Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSuitDesc.zhText: Narin 如旋涡般降临，她的利刃锋利无比，如同凛冽的寒风。她能巧妙地运用冰霜防御，如同她迅捷的细剑攻击一般。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSuitPass.text: Narin's crane spirit supercharges Primary and Secondary weapons with 50% bonus <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage and Status Effect. Narin also gains Cold Damage for her abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSuitPass.zhText: Narin 的鹤灵会为主要和次要武器提供强化效果，获得 50% 额外 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害和异常状态。Narin 的技能还会附加冰冻伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSuitPass.text: Each stack of <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect on enemies increase chance to spawn Sangodae pickup by |CHANCE|%, granting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Extra Cold Damage on Primary and Secondary weapons for |DURATION|s. Narin also gains Cold Damage for her abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSuitPass.zhText: 敌人身上每叠加一层 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态，生成霜花拾取物的几率就会提高 |CHANCE|%，并使主武器和副武器获得额外 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。Narin 的技能也会获得冰冻伤害加成。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSyandana.text: The wish for a long life is carried upon the noble wings of Narin's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSyandana.zhText: 长寿的愿望承载在 Narin 标志性披饰的高贵羽翼之上。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/EntropicKuvaRes.text:
A dangerous and erratic type of Kuva.

Obtained from Entropic Eximus in Zariman missions.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/EntropicKuvaRes.zhText:
一种危险且不稳定的赤毒。

在扎里曼任务中从熵之卓越者获得。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/HackingConnecti.text: Form a Tenno chain from <CHAIN_MARKER_A> to <CHAIN_MARKER_B>
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/HackingConnecti.zhText: 从 <CHAIN_MARKER_A> 到 <CHAIN_MARKER_B> 之间形成一条 Tenno 链

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/IcebladeChallen.text:
Students, 

I am very excited to announce that |PLAYER_NAME| has successfully pulled the Iceblade from Narin's Crest, fulfilling her prophecy!

|PLAYER_NAME| is Narin's Chosen! 

To commemorate this achievement, a statue in their image has been erected atop Yuvan Peak.

Eligible students may now bestow the Narin's Iceblade blessing upon their fellow Tenno by retrieving her blade for themselves.

Dutifully,
Cephalon Melica
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/IcebladeChallen.zhText:
同学们， 

我非常激动地宣布，|PLAYER_NAME| 已成功从 Narin 的冰冠中拔出了冰刃，实现了她的预言！

|PLAYER_NAME| 是被 Narin 选中之人！ 

为纪念这一成就，青春峰顶竖立起了以他们形象为原型的雕像。

符合资格的同学可以通过亲手拔出 Narin 的冰刃来将这份祝福赋予其他 Tenno 同伴。

此致，
中枢梅丽卡

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KeyAlreadyClaim.text: Failed to acquire Cryobell, Cryobell is already claimed
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KeyAlreadyClaim.zhText: 无法获得冰珠铃，冰珠铃已被领取

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KeyInvalidError.text: Failed to acquire Cryobell, Cryobell is invalid
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KeyInvalidError.zhText: 无法获得冰珠铃，冰珠铃无效

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KeysExpiredErro.text: Failed to acquire Cryobell, Cryobell expired
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KeysExpiredErro.zhText: 无法获得冰珠铃，冰珠铃已过期

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KuvaPathWarning.text: Aborting will terminate the session and forfeit all unclaimed rewards for every squad member. Type '|WORD|' to continue.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KuvaPathWarning.zhText: 退出将会结束当前对局，并且失去所有小队成员未领取的奖励。输入"|WORD|"以继续。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KuvaPathWarning.text: Aborting will terminate the session and forfeit all unclaimed rewards for every squad member.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KuvaPathWarning.zhText: 中止将会结束当前对局，并且失去所有小队成员未领取的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KuvaPathWarning.text: The Icebind is intended to be very challenging, and features encounters that require a full, coordinated squad. Prepare accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/KuvaPathWarning.zhText: 冰封羁绊极具挑战性，其中包含需要完整小队协同作战的遭遇战。请做好相应准备。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/MaxKuvaKeysOwne.text: Cannot claim Cryobell, inventory is full.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/MaxKuvaKeysOwne.zhText: 无法领取冰珠铃，背包已满。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/MelicaInboxBody.text:
Students. Attention please. Entropic Kuva is seeping into the Zariman. Some of our unauthorized visitors have been gripped by it, making them more hostile than usual. Which brings me to our class project, we must confiscate this Entropic Kuva at once, but how? 

Students, we're going on a field trip. Meet me on Earth, at Yuvan Peak.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/MelicaInboxBody.zhText:
同学们，请注意。熵之赤毒正在渗入扎里曼。我们一些未经授权的访客已被它控制，导致他们比平时更加具有攻击性。这也引出了我们的班级项目，我们必须立即没收这种熵之赤毒，但该如何做呢？

同学们，我们要去实地考察。在地球的青春峰顶与我汇合。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/MelicaInboxSubj.zhText: 实地考察（无需家长同意）

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/NarinBlessingDe.text: Narin's ethereal Iceblade dances around the blessed inflicting Cold Status Effect on nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/NarinBlessingDe.zhText: Narin 的空灵冰刃会在受祝福者身边舞动，对附近敌人施加冰冻异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/NarinPoemDesc.text: An ancient piece of parchment in the Tethyan style.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/NarinPoemDesc.zhText: 一片特提斯风格的古老羊皮纸。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/NerfHealthShiel.text: Full Shield Gate immunity duration reduced by 50%.
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/NerfHealthShiel.zhText: 满护盾保险免疫时间减少 50%。

/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/PeakTravelConfi.text: Leave the Zariman and travel to the Yuvan Peak?
/Lotus/Language/Iceblade/PeakTravelConfi.zhText: 离开扎里曼前往青春峰顶？

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/50thAnniversaryGiv.text:
Tenno,

Legends speak of a wandering warrior-king among Warframes. He would answer the call of the loyal and the worthy, a brief spear-shaft of light in the darkness, before moving on.

Now Styanax has returned, the fiftieth, the prodigal.

You too have answered the call to battle, as loyally as Styanax himself, and so Styanax now joins your Arsenal without cost. Those who come later may find him in other ways.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/50thAnniversaryGiv.zhText:
Tenno，

传说在战甲中有一位浪迹天涯的战士之王。在继续前行之前，他回应忠义之士的召唤，成为黑暗中短暂出现的光矛。

现在 Styanax 回来了，是第五十个，也是浪子。

你也像 Styanax 一样，忠诚地回应了战争的号召，所以现在 Styanax 会免费加入到你的军械库中。而后来的人可能要通过其他方式找到他。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/AmirFFPosterInboxB.text:
Well met, indeed!

For completing my mini-adventure most foul, I bequeath unto thee this art most wonderful. Go forth, do with it what thou will! Adorn thine space with its colours, should ye find it suitable.

(AKA: IDK, it's cool, tape it to your wall or something.)

- Your Most Honorable Fablemaster

(PS: Still sorry about the whole… YEEeeeaAaaaah…)
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/AmirFFPosterInboxB.zhText:
确实，幸会！

鉴于你已完成我这场邪恶的小小冒险，我特意将这幅绝妙之作送给你。拿去吧，随你处置！若是合适，便用它的色彩装点你的居所吧。

（也就是说：我不造，反正挺酷的，拿胶带贴墙上之类的吧。）

——你最尊贵的寓言主持人

（对了：关于那整件……呀啊啊啊啊啊啊，还是很抱歉。）

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/AusFireDonationBod.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Have you heard? Fires rage on Earth. Living things, big and small, are suffering. Ordis has taken the liberty of creating this Yooka Floof to display in your Orbiter as a symbol of hope and perseverance.

But Operator, Earth needs more than symbols. Follow the link below to learn how you can help.

Your loyal Cephalon,

-Ordis

您忠诚的中枢，

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/ClanRecruitmentCla.text:
Hey, |PLAYER_NAME|.

Word is you're the smooth talker in charge of bringing in new recruits for |CLAN_NAME|.

Imagine how many more recruits you could get if I used my connections to advertise for you!

You could get the message out to every lone Tenno in the System. Hype up your Clan to all the hopeful newbies and rootless veterans out there just looking for a place to belong. Maybe even tempt a few rival Clan members to jump ship!

Good news. I can get your Clan's recruitment message out there for a modest fee.

Interested? Great. Get your recruitment message written, and come see me at the Bazaar.

Maroo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/ClanRecruitmentCla.zhText:
嘿， |PLAYER_NAME|。

据说你是为 |CLAN_NAME| 招选新成员的负责人。

想象一下，如果我用我的人脉为你做广告，你还能招到多少人！

你可以将信息传达给系统中的每一名没有组织的 Tenno。向所有满怀希望的新手和无根漂泊的老兵宣传你的氏族，他们都在寻找一个属于自己的地方。也有可能会引发一些来自敌对氏族成员的跳槽！

有个好消息。你只需交给我点东西我就可以帮你们氏族扩散招募信息。

有兴趣吗？太棒了。把你的招聘信息写好，来集市找我。

Maroo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/ClanRecruitmentTen.text:
Hey there, steelcheeks.

I got word you're running solo out there. Not affiliated to any of the Clans.

You do know there's hundreds of Clans that would love to have you, right?

Well, your pal Maroo's put her networking skills at your disposal.

See for yourself! All kinds of Clans, big and small, all puttin' recruitment calls out.

You can browse them at your leisure right there in your Orbiter. Or come and see me at the Bazaar.

Remember - where there's a demand, there's money to be made. And right now, YOU are in demand, |PLAYER_NAME|.

Maroo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/ClanRecruitmentTen.zhText:
哈喽，铁蛋儿。

我听说你是个独行侠。不隶属于任何氏族。

你肯定知道有数百个氏族想要你，对吧？

好吧，你的朋友 Maroo 已经将她的联络技能交赋给你了。

你自己看看！各式各样、大大小小的氏族，都在招募呢。

你可以在你的轨道飞行器上任意浏览它们。或者也可以来集市找我。

记住——哪里有需求，哪里就有钱赚。而现在，|PLAYER_NAME|，你很抢手。

Maroo

航道星舰翻修，全新购置。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/DarvoWeaponCraftin.text:
Friend!

I owe you big. You got me out of that jam with those Grineer goons. So I'm sending you a weapon. Something to help you help me. In case I ever get into trouble like that again. Void forbid.

Yes, yes, it's a blueprint, not a complete weapon, but I've sent you all the resources you need. Now you can forge this bad boy in your Orbiter's foundry.

So what are you waiting for? Make that weapon!

Your pal,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/DarvoWeaponCraftin.zhText:
好伙计，

我欠你个人情。你帮我摆脱了那些 Grineer 暴徒的纠缠。所以我要送给你一把武器，要是我再遇上那样的麻烦，这是一把你能用上也能帮到我的武器。虚空保佑。

你还在等什么？快去造那把武器吧！

你的老朋友，
Darvo

你的老朋友，
Darvo

|PLAYER_NAME|,

Tenno! Listen, my Dad, Frohd Bek, is making Corpus comm channels a fun-free zone. Something something security something. So Clem and I hid a little channel. For emergencies. And making money. Sync up so we can always stay in touch!

Okay okay, you want a sweetener.  While Clem and I were lootin-- I mean looking for Orokin artifacts to repatriate near the Void, Clem came across this SYNKRA SYANDANA! Which he didn't tell me about. So I'm not letting him have it.

Bad Clem.

Click the button below to make sure your good friends can always reach you and the Syandana is all yours, Tenno.

Your pal,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/EmailLink.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Tenno！听着，我父亲，Frohd Bek，正在把和 Corpus 贸易的渠道变得毫无乐趣。什么关于安全性的乱七八糟的东西。所以 Clem 和我偷偷瞒下了一个贸易渠道。以应不时之需。当然了，也赚点生活费。保持同步，这样咱们才能一直保持联系！

好吧好吧，你想要点甜头。当 Clem 和我在虚空附近抢——我是说寻找要倒卖的奥罗金遗物的时候，Clem 发现了这件联步披饰！但他可没有告诉我。所以我也不能让他留着它。

Clem 真是不乖。

点击下面的按钮来确保你的好朋友能一直联系到你，并且这件披饰是你的了，Tenno。

你的老伙计，
Darvo

It has come to my attention, |PLAYER_NAME|, that you were among the very first Tenno the Lotus called wake. That you were the vanguard, so to speak, who first ventured forth into an Origin System neither recognized nor remembered. A founder, and perhaps in some ways, a foundling.

Heedless of danger, or perhaps simply oblivious to it, you blazed a path in which others walked. In recognition of all you have done, I present you with these Honoria. 

May the Tenno who came after you see your mark and salute you.

Yours, 
Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/FounderTitleReceiv.zhText:
我注意到，|PLAYER_NAME|，你是 Lotus 唤醒的第一批 Tenno 之一。可以说，你是先锋，率先踏入一个既不为人知也不为人所铭记的始源星系。你是创始人，或许在某种程度上，你也是个被命运抛弃的人。

你无视危险，或许只是浑然不觉，开辟了一条后人亦步亦趋的道路。为了表彰你所做的一切，我特此授予你这些荣誉称号。 

愿后来的 Tenno 能够看到你的印记，并向你致敬。

此致， 
副摄政总司令罗瑟

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/IncarnonGenesisBod.text:
Hey.

Heard you been grubbing around in the Zariman's backyard. That little tinpot 'kingdom'.

Well, in my extensive downtime, I've been having thoughts about weapons. How I could upgrade 'em. Give 'em a sprinkle of Void magic. And guess what? The Void did what the Void does. Took my ideas and made them real. How about that.

So if you've picked up a... let's call it an Incarnon Genesis, why not? An Incarnon Genesis, bring it to me and I'll get it installed for ya.

Slaughter awaits.
Cavalero

PS. Yonta says I need to say this very clearly: I cannot adapt a weapon you do not own. I will need both the Incarnon Genesis AND the weapon it applies to. Understood? I am not running a charity here.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/IncarnonGenesisBod.zhText:
嘿。

听说你在扎里曼号的后院一通乱翻。那个小锡罐"王国"。

嗯，在大量的闲暇时光中，我一直对武器有所思考。我该如何升级它们。给它们一点虚空魔法。你猜怎么着？虚空做了虚空所做的事。把我的想法变成了现实。你觉得怎么样。

所以，如果你捡到一个……我们称之为「灵化之源」的东西，为什么不试试看呢？ 一个灵化之源，把它带给我，我会帮你安装到位。

让我们屠戮以待。
卡瓦莱罗

补充一点。扬塔说我需要说得很清楚：我无法改装你未拥有的武器。我需要灵化之源和它所适用的武器。听懂了吗？我不是在这儿开慈善机构的。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Legendary1MessageD.zhText:
Tenno，

你的旅程已化为传奇。随着你踏入传奇等级的大门，你也赢得了一件与之相称的奖励。

这张传说核心是你的了。

好好利用它，Tenno。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/LizzieShawzinSkinI.text:
Something's been nagging at me for a while. It started as a little thing, but it just wouldn't go away. How come the Temple Warframe has my name? How come they have a guitar called Lizzie, too?

Temple was my stage persona. The me I wanted to be. And Lizzie is unique. I couldn't figure it out.

Until you brought me and Lizzie together in harmony, and I finally understood.

This change that's happening in me? It can't be stopped. I'm going to transform completely one day.

And that's okay. Because the Warframe from your time - 'Temple' - it's me. One and the same. The Warframe that Ballas was too scared to build, because rebellion was built into its DNA.

You see, Drifter, I go where I'm needed. I stick it to the man in Ludston, Cemaria, Höllvania... and I know I need to do it in Pluto Terminus, too, many many years from now.

I mean, if the Technocyte Coda can survive to your time, why not me?

Kaya's helped me figure it all out. There's a comet that leaves the System and gets back just in time for the Tenno Insurrection. That's where I'll hibernate. Lizzie will make sure I don't oversleep.

When Octavia hits the beat and the drums kick in, I'll be there.

Waiting in the sky, come back to join the children of the revolution.

See you!

Flare/Temple
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/LizzieShawzinSkinI.zhText:
有些事情困扰我很久了。一开始只是一件小事，但我控制不住一直去想。Temple 战甲怎么会有我的名字？他怎么也有一把叫丽兹的吉他？

Temple 是我的舞台形象。是我想成为的那个人。而丽兹是独一无二的。这一点我无法想明白。

直到你解释了我和丽兹之间的调和关系，我才终于明白。

我身上发生的这种变化？这是不可逆的。总有一天我会彻底改变。

没关系。因为你们那个时代的战甲——"Temple"——就是我。一模一样。Ballas 不敢建造这架战甲，因为反抗与叛逆刻在了他的基因中。

你看，漂泊者，我有很多地方要去。拉德斯顿、赛玛莉亚、霍瓦尼亚，这些地方都有我反抗权威的事迹……我知道，在遥远的未来，我也会在冥王星 Terminus 继续我的事业。

我的意思是，如果科技细胞终幕者可以存活到你的时代，为什么我不能？

卡娅帮我弄清楚了一切。有一颗彗星离开了始源星系，刚好赶在 Tenno 起义之前回来。我会在那里进入冷冻舱。 丽兹会确保我不会睡过头。

当 Octavia 打出节拍，鼓声响起时，我就会归来。

从天而降，加入革命的浪潮。

再见！

弗莱尔 / Temple

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/LostItemsNewPlayer.text:

Ordis must admit, the Operator's return after so long came as a shock that resulted in a hasty cleaning of all systems and compartments.

These items were found shoved a ventilation apparatus! Wonderful place to hide things from the Grineer, but only if one remembers they put them there.

您忠诚的中枢，

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier1.text:
Well, kid, that's what we call a thoroughly field-tested theory. And you performed great. The Necramech and Warframe combination is exactly what the Sentients did not expect.

Felt I ought to mark the occasion with something. Sorry, I don't have more to offer just yet.

You're cleared to take on higher-order Sentients, by the way. I'd say you're ready. But it's your call.

Father
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier1.zhText:
好吧，孩子，这就是我们所说的，历经彻底实地检验的理论。你的表现很棒。殁世机甲和战甲的组合正是 Sentient 意想不到的。

我感觉我该用些什么来纪念这个时刻。但抱歉，我这会儿手头上什么都没有。

顺便说一句，你可以去迎战更高级别的 Sentient 了。我想说你已经准备好了。不过决定权在于你。

"父亲"

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier1.text: ORPHIX VENOM: Were we right, or were we right?
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier1.zhText: 《奥影之毒》：我们是正确的，或者说我们做对了？

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier2.text:
You know, I remember when the Tombjockey took its first faltering steps into the Lux-Severin Hotzone. Experimental Necramech. Low CoG, squat little guy, built for endurance.

Didn't make it seven paces before some wide-winged hell-clown I'd never seen before ripped it apart like a Kubrow going at a raggedy-kai.

Tell you the truth, I was scared the same would happen to you out there. Glad you proved me wrong.

Little keepsake enclosed. And if you want to turn your guns on the Sentient heavy hitters, I will not stand in your way.

Father
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier2.zhText:
我还记得古墓骑师第一次步履蹒跚地踏进 Lux -Severin 战区的情景。那是实验性的殁世机甲。重心很低，矮墩墩的小家伙，专为耐久而打造。

还没走到七步，它就被某个我未没见过的大翅膀丑八怪撕成了碎片，就像是库狛在撕咬一只布娃娃。

说实话，我很害怕你也会有同样的遭遇。很高兴你证明了我的想法是错的。

附上小纪念品。如果你想把枪口对准 Sentient 的大人物，我不会阻拦你。

"父亲"

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier2.text: ORPHIX VENOM: Giving away the family treasures now (Don't tell Grandmother)
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier2.zhText: 《奥影之毒》：现在送出家中财宝（切勿告诉"祖母"）

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier3.text:
Gotta say I'm feeling pretty redundant down here, dispensing two-credit advice and shelved mechs while you've been... well, doing what I used to do. Heavy lifting. Takin' it to them. So I got to thinking: what do I have that you could actually use? 

I'm sending you this. Crater some goob and think of me.

Father
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier3.zhText:
不得不说我在这里感觉自己很多余，给出几条不值一提的建议，发放封存许久的机甲，而你已经……嗯，在做我以前做的事了。做着繁重的工作，和它们对抗。所以，我就在想：我有什么东西是你能用得上的？

我把这个送给你。当你把那些傻瓜炸开花的时候，请别忘了我。

"父亲"

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier3.text: ORPHIX VENOM: Wish I could be there to see you open this
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEvent2020Tier3.zhText: 《奥影之毒》：我希望自己可以看着你打开这个

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventClanRewar.text:
Hey, kids.

I don't have a proud father speech lined up for you. Heck, my own kids never got one. But that doesn't mean I'm not proud. |CLAN_NAME| faced down the same nightmares that made Orokin vets turn tail and run. Glad I could be a part of that.

I put this statue together in the workshop for you. Hope it'll remind you of your own war stories.

Father
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventClanRewar.zhText:
孩子们，你们好，

我没有为你们准备一个像父亲那般的演讲，告诉你们我对你们有多骄傲。哎，我从未给我自己的孩子讲过这样的话。但这并不意味着我一点都不骄傲。|CLAN_NAME| 征服了曾让奥罗金老兵们仓皇逃窜的噩梦。很高兴我能参与其中。

我在工作坊里为你做了这个雕像。希望它能让你回想起自己的战争往事。

"父亲"

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventClanRewar.text: ORPHIX VENOM: Your very own shiny hat stand
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventClanRewar.zhText: 《奥影之毒》：只属于你自己的闪亮帽子架

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventLaunchDes.text:
Hey,

Bad news, bad news. The Orphix are back, and somehow they managed to figure out how to shut you down.

Gonna need you in the saddle on a Necramech, either your own or one of mine.
Get out there and drive 'em back - while we still have that as an option.

Father
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventLaunchDes.zhText:
嘿，

坏消息，坏消息。奥影母艇回来了，并且它们找到了某种专门对付你的方法。

我需要你骑上殁世机甲，无论是你自己的还是我的。
趁着我们还可以用殁世机甲来对付他们，快去把他们击退。

"父亲"

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventLaunchTit.text: ORPHIX VENOM: Dust off those Necramechs
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MechEventLaunchTit.zhText: 《奥影之毒》：重新把那些殁世机甲投入使用

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MissingMasteryRewa.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

For every Mastery Rank you have passed, I commissioned a Mastery Slate commemorating your achievement. Display these proudly, they are proof of all you have become.

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/MissingMasteryRewa.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

每当你达成一个精通段位，我都会定制一块精通石板来纪念你的成就。自豪地把它们展示出来吧，它们是你成长历程的明证。

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/NatahReworkJunctio.text:
Working hard, are we? Trying to stop progress? Grineer progress? That’s my progress. Might work with Vay Hek. Vay Hek might roll over but not Tyl. Not me. Not my Tubemen. We can’t have that. No. Won’t have that.

Kill my tubemen. I make more. And more. And more. How many of you to kill? I count one.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/NatahReworkJunctio.zhText:
是不是太努力了？想阻止脚步？阻止 Grineer 的脚步？那可是我的脚步。对付韦·海克可能有戏。韦·海克或许会被唬住，但泰尔不会。我不会。我的克隆人不会。我们不会让那发生。不。绝不会让那发生。

杀了我的克隆人。我还能制造更多。一波一波。无穷无尽。而你们？只要杀一个。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/OldBloodCinInboxBo.text:
Tenno are such arrogant, undisciplined children!

Mommy Lotus might spare the rod, but not ME! Every siphoned drop of the Old Blood makes my fortress grow stronger. Sweet, sweet Kuva!

Be on your best behavior, little one. You KNOW what you did to my sister. My Kuva Liches can make sure you get what you deserve!

Your Undying Queen
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/OldBloodCinInboxBo.zhText:
Tenno 真是一群傲慢又不守规矩的孩子！

你的 Lotus 麻麻可能会放过你，但我不会！每一滴远古之血都会让我的堡垒变得更加坚固。香香甜甜的赤毒！

小家伙，好好表现。你心里很清楚你对我姐姐做了什么。我的赤毒玄骸一定会让你自食其果！

你不朽的女王

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/OldPieceTeaserBody.text:
If you can read this, then we're not really gone. 

There is something on the other side of death. It's us. It's you. It's all the ways the world will be different now as long as we're remembered. Carry us and let the waves of our lives spread ripples like ashes never could.

Carry this, too, and remember us as more than just a story.

Signed,

Your friend and theirs
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/OldPieceTeaserBody.zhText:
如果你能读到这些话，那说明我们并未真正离开。 

死亡的彼岸还有别的存在。有我们，有你。也有因我们被记住而变得不同的世界。请带上我们，让我们生命的波涛泛起涟漪，连灰烬都无法企及。

也请带上这份记忆，记住我们不仅仅是一个故事。

署名，

你的朋友和他们的朋友

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/PGS5Drop1InboxMsgB.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Friend… Maybe something happened. Maybe Darvo intercepted a Corpus Juno crew discussing a recent find they dug up on Venus. Maybe it was a valuable OCTAVIA IRIDOS SKIN and other rare items!

Maybe they didn’t secure it very well.

Maybe they are now extremely angry and searching for Darvo. 

So… Maybe… Darvo shot the whole haul into that fourth dimensional Void Rift. You know, that place that only you can access? Go ahead, they are yours for the taking.

And then Darvo will be safe.

Maybe.

P.S. If they get too close maybe Darvo shoots other rare and valuable items into that rift. So check back often.

Your Pal,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/PGS5Drop1InboxMsgB.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

朋友……好像发生了什么事。可能是 Darvo 拦截了一个 Corpus 朱诺舰队船员的消息，他们正在讨论最近在金星上挖掘出的新发现。估计是珍贵的「OCTAVIA 炫彩外观」和其他稀有物品！

可能他们并没有保护好它。

可能他们现在非常生气，正在寻找 Darvo。 

所以……大概是因为……Darvo 将全部挖掘出的物品扔进了第四维度的虚空裂痕。你应该知道，那个只有你才能进入的地方吧？快来吧，这些东西都是你的了。

如此一来 Darvo 也就安全了。

但愿如此。

提示一下，Darvo 可能会将其他稀有和有价值的物品扔进那个裂缝。所以经常回来看看。

你的朋友，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/PGS5Drop5InboxMsgB.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

What if...

What if Darvo not only ripped off a Corpus Juno crew, but also the Sisters of freaking Parvos?

What if an OCTAVIA IRIDOS SKIN and PYRANA IRIDOS SKIN were already paid for by the Sisters? What if Darvo needed to get as far away from that merchandise as physically possible?

What if - Look, enough beating around the bush. I’m up for all sorts of trouble, but the Sisters of Parvos? That’s where I draw the line. 

The sooner you pick up that gear and use it around the system, the sooner I have the plausible deniability I need if one of those tanked out nuns ever comes calling.

Got it? Hurry!

- Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/PGS5Drop5InboxMsgB.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

要是……

要是 Darvo 不仅敲诈了 Corpus 朱诺舰队船员，还招惹了该死的帕尔沃斯的姐妹们呢？

要是姐妹们已经支付了「OCTAVIA 炫彩外观」和「食人鱼 炫彩外观」呢？如果 Darvo 需要尽可能的远离那些商品呢？

要是——听着，不拐弯抹角了。我准备好迎接各种麻烦了，但帕尔沃斯的姐妹们？这就是我的底线。 

你越快拿走那些装备并在星系中使用，我就能越早找到合理的推诿借口，万一哪位喝得烂醉的修女来找我。

明白了？动作快点！

- Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2021TennoconI.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Darvo 有新的消息了！今天我有一些有点特别的东西，积云组合包！哦，伙计，你应该亲眼看看这些东西。一个卷云护甲组合包、一件积云披饰、一款华丽演出调色盘、3 天资源数量加成，甚至还有一件云海手枪外观。

这是你的了。你所需要做的就是晒出它们。让我的装备看起来卖相还不错。

我的新消息？活动正在进行中！有人对购买大批存货感兴趣！

她的名字叫英塔利亚，她说她是一笔巨额财富的继承人。在看到热忱装备的使用效果后，她知道她必须为自己搞到一些。她看上去是一个非常诚实善良的人。所以，Darvo 自然而然地增添了几分疑虑。

我会让你知道这件事的进展。

你的朋友，
Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop11Alt.text: Dominate any fight with the Rubico Sniper Rifle and the striking Verv Rubico Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop11Alt.zhText: 用绝路狙击枪和引人注目的热忱 绝路外观来主宰任何战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop11Fre.text: Snipe enemies in style with the Verv Rubico Pack, free with your Prime Membership!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop11Fre.zhText: 用热忱 绝路组合包以有型的方式狙击敌人，拥有 Prime 会员资格即可免费获取！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop11Inb.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

We had best be prepared for anything. I have left a VERV RUBICO SKIN and RUBICO RIFLE for you in the usual place.

Night and day, I am obsessed with that she-demon Intalya. Just as much as she is clearly obsessed with me.

Why else would she have worked so hard for so long? To go to such extremes, to take such measures, purely to swindle one man... it is a compliment!

I do not eat; I do not sleep. Clem makes vokla soup for me. I let it go cold.

I want something, my Tenno friend. Revenge? Romance? I don't know. But Darvo will not be cheated.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop11Inb.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

我们最好做好一切准备。我在老地方给你留了一份热忱 绝路外观和热忱步枪。

不管是白天还是黑夜，我都对那名女魔头英塔利亚念念不忘。显然就像她对我很着迷一样。

否则这么久以来为什么她一直在努力做这些？走这样的极端，采取这样的措施，纯粹是为了骗一个人...... 这是一种恭维！

我不吃饭；不睡觉。Clem 为我做了沃克拉汤。我就放着任其变凉。

我想要某种东西，Tenno 朋友。是复仇？浪漫？我不知道。但 Darvo 是不会被欺骗的。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop12Alt.text: Begin your next Mission in style with the dazzling Liset Verv Skin!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop12Alt.zhText: 用令人眼花缭乱的 Liset 热忱外观来进行你的下一个任务！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop12Fre.text: Begin your next Mission in style with the dazzling Liset Verv Skin, free with your Prime Membership!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop12Fre.zhText: 用令人眼花缭乱的 Liset 热忱外观来进行你的下一个任务，拥有 Prime 会员资格即可免费获取！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop12Inb.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Please claim this VERV LISET SKIN soon in case Darvo has an 'accident'.

You see, I found her. My drones tracked the swindler 'Intalya' to her luxury apartments above Neptune.

Such fury! She would not return a scrap of what she had stolen! She had bested me, fair and square! By the tenets of Parvos Granum himself, she had fulfilled her desire, and that was that!

I replied that I wanted nothing back. Let her keep everything she had stolen. But, maybe she joins me for dinner?

She accepted.

We meet in one month.

I do not trust her. She does not trust me. Fun!

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop12Inb.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

请尽快领取 LISET 热忱外观，以防 Darvo 发生了什么"意外"。

你看，我找到她了。就在她海王星上的豪华公寓中，我的无人机找到了骗子"英塔利亚"。

气死我了！她所偷的东西是不会还回来的！她光明正大地打败了我！贯彻了帕尔沃斯·格拉努的信条，她满足了她的欲望，就这样吧！

我回复说我不想拿回任何东西。让她留着她偷走的一切。不过，也许她能和我共进晚餐？

她同意了。

我们在一个月后碰面。

我不信任她。她也不信任我。真有意思！

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop13Alt.zhText: 用热忱纹章和徽章组合包为你的时尚炫甲增添迷人的荣誉感！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop13Fre.text: Complete your Verv Fashion Frame with the Verv Sigil and Emblem, free with your Prime Membership!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop13Fre.zhText: 用热忱纹章和徽章来完善你的热忱时尚炫甲，拥有 Prime 会员资格即可免费获取！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop13Inb.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Darvo has had the most wonderful evening.

Intalya and I poisoned each other. We ate strange tidbits. We sang. We danced upon the table until it broke. We plotted in ways that would turn old Granum pale with envy.

Darvo cannot remember the plans, but they were brilliant. We will all soon be rich!

And now Clem is here with the bucket. Did I mention that he carried Intalya back to her ship last night? I do not know what I would do without him.

Intalya wanted you to have this VERV SIGIL and VERV EMBLEM!

The future is bright and full of opportunities! And we shall be ready to exploit them all, you and I. And Clem, of course. And, maybe, just maybe, Intalya too.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop13Inb.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Darvo 度过了最美妙的夜晚。

英塔利亚和我都给对方下了毒。我们吃了奇怪的美食。我们唱了歌。我们在桌子上跳舞，跳到桌子裂开。我们谋划着怎么让老格拉努妒火中烧。

Darvo 想不起那些计划了，但它们很出彩。我们很快都会发财的！

现在 Clem 带着水桶来了。我有提到过昨晚他将英塔利亚带回她的船上吗？要是没有他我不知道我会做出什么来。

英塔利亚想给你这个热忱纹章和热忱徽章！

未来一片光明，而且机遇也很多！我们要准备好利用好它们。我指的是你和我。当然还有 Clem。也许，只是也许，还有英塔利亚。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop14Fre.text: Complete your Verv Fashion Frame with the Verv Sentrex Sentinel Pack, free with your Prime Membership!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop14Fre.zhText: 用热忱圣塔斯守护组合包来完善你的热忱时尚炫甲，拥有 Prime 会员资格即可免费获取！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop14Inb.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

You know what it is like when someone treats you as they are the boss, yes?

I am nobody's employee. I own much, but I am not owned. And I will not be told what I may and may not do.

For example, I give you these VERV SENTREX SENTINEL ACCESSORIES, freely and of my own choosing. Because it pleases me to do so.

And not because someone with a sweet voice and beautiful eyes tells me I should. Darvo cannot be manipulated.

This was my idea.

Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop14Inb.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你知道别人把你当老板是什么感觉吧？

我不是任何人的打工仔。我拥有很多东西，但我不属于任何人。而且别人所说的什么该做什么不该做的，我都不会听。

例如，我免费给你这些热忱圣塔斯守护配件，是出于我自己的选择。因为这样做让我高兴。

真的不是因为某人的甜美声音和美丽双眸叫我这么做。Darvo 可不会被影响。

这就是我自己的主意。

Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop15Fre.text: Elevate your ship and adorn your personal quarters with the Verv Sentrex Stencil, free with your Prime Membership!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop15Fre.zhText: 通过你的 Prime 会员来免费获得热忱圣塔斯壁纸模板，以提升你的飞船并装点你的个人房间！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop15Inb.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

We three are now an independent Guild! As such, we have a guildhouse. A modest satellite Dormizone, but with much potential.

The decor... needs work.

Darvo does not care for decorating. Intalya, on the other hand, she loves it. Decorating and taking other people's things. Loves it so much that she went out and "found" enough VERV SENTREX STENCILS to plaster an entire capital ship.

So as a friend, I feel like I should offer some to you. As a favor. No strings attached. For now.

Your Friend,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Drop15Inb.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

咱们仨现在是一个小团体了。因此，我们也有了一个小团体空间。一个不大不小，但仍还有很多潜力的卫星居住舱。

而其室内装饰……需要改进。

Darvo 不太注重装饰。但另一方面，英塔利亚热爱室内装饰。特别是室内装饰和顺走别人的东西。她甚至热爱到去"找到"足够多的热忱圣塔斯轨道飞行器壁纸模板来贴满整个主力战舰。

所以作为你的朋友，我觉得我应该分给你一些。就当作是好意。没有任何附带条件。就目前而言。

你的朋友，
Darvo

We're not always the ones in the front line. Sometimes we get to watch and cheer our comrades on. And that matters.

Here's something to help keep YOU fighting.

Varzia
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Streamer0.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

我们并不总是在前线。但有时我们可以观战并为同伴们呼喊助威。这很重要。

这里有一些东西可以帮助你战斗。

瓦奇娅

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Prime2022Streamer0.text: Thanks for looking out for one another

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/PrimeIronyInboxBod.text:
Do you know what irony is, |PLAYER_NAME|?

What about finding yet another magical Void Rift, filled with even more amazing PRIME ITEMS, all of which are out of my reach? Is that freaking irony, Tenno? Sure feels like it.

Know what’s in there this time, Tenno? A freaking TRINITY PRIME WARFRAME and a SPEKTAKA PRIME SYANDANA!

As usual, some mysterious force is stopping me from claiming them myself. So why don’t you wander across the fold and pick up that FREE STUFF, just like you did last time?

Your loyal (and totally not bitter) friend,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/PrimeIronyInboxBod.zhText:
你知道什么是讽刺吗，|PLAYER_NAME|？

假如说又有一条充满着更多神奇 PRIME 道具的魔法虚空裂隙出现了，但对我却无法企及。这可真的怪讽刺的对吗，Tenno？我可深深地感受到了。

你知道这次是些什么吗，Tenno？一架 TRINITY PRIME 战甲和华丽演出 PRIME 披饰！

和以前一样，某些神秘的力量使我不能亲自取走这些宝物。对你来说，何不穿过这次元折叠，领走这些免费的东西呢？就像你上次做的那样。

你忠实（而且绝对没有羡慕嫉妒恨）的朋友，
Darvo

指挥官，

Warframe 社区团队

猎者注意，

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/SistersItemsBody.text:
Operator,

While you were gone, your Arsenal started pulsing!

Ordis is happy to report that all systems are nominal. Although... Ordis should mention it seems some items underwent some changes for the sake of balance.

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/SistersItemsBody.zhText:
指挥官，

当您不在的时候，您的军械库开始脉动了！

Your loyal Cephalon,

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Switch2IntroInbox_.text:
Ordis has spent a lot of time all alone. It was - EXCRUCIATING - not fun. Ordis does not recommend the experience. But with you here, Ordis is never lonely. To quote an old Earth saying, two birds in a bush is better than one!

More importantly, Ordis brings gifts for you, Operator! Maybe this means you won't - ABANDON - leave me behind again?

Your loyal Cephalon,
- Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Switch2IntroInbox_.zhText:
Ordis 曾独自度过了漫长的时光。那段日子——真是煎熬——一点都不好玩。Ordis 绝不推荐这种体验。但有您在身边，Ordis 再也不会感到孤独了。引用地球上的一句老话：双鸟同栖，胜过独飞！

更重要的是，指挥官，Ordis 为您带来了礼物！也许这意味着您不会——抛弃——再把我丢下？

您忠诚的中枢， 
——Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Switch_LaunchInbox.text:
Ordis has waited exactly — FOREVER — years for this moment!

While you were in cryosleep, I took the liberty of maintaining your personal belongings for your inevitable return. These are the things you forgot when you — ABANDONED — left me behind. Ordis isn’t bitter, Operator. I’m just happy you’re back!

If you need anything else, your loyal Cephalon is here for you.

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Switch_LaunchInbox.zhText:
Ordis 为这一刻正好已经等待了——永久——许多年了！

当您在低温睡眠时，为了您必然的回归，我冒昧替您保管了私人物品。这些是您——遗弃我——离开我时留下的东西。指挥官，Ordis 一点都不辛苦，我很高兴您回来了！

如果您有任何需要，您忠诚的中枢在此为您效劳。

－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TenYearAnniversary.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|

I have watched as you rose from the ashes of The Old War to bring an end to the New. You have made an incalculable contribution to the safety and security of the Origin System these past ten Earth cycles.

With gratitude, I offer this gift. May it serve as a reminder to take pride in all you've achieved.

With gratitude,
|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TenYearAnniversary.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|

我目睹了你从远古之战的废墟中崛起，为新纪之战带来了终结。在过去的十个地球周期中，你为守护始源星系的安宁做出了不可估量的贡献。

怀着感激之情，我送出这份礼物。愿它能让你为自己所取得的一切感到自豪。

感恩有你，
|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TenYearsofTennoGen.text:
The TennoGen program turns 10!

For a decade, talented and creative community members have had their unique Helmets, Syandanas, and more added to Warframe. More than 400 items from over 90 community artists have made their way to the Origin System via the TennoGen program!

Wear the |OPEN_BOLD|TennoGen Decennial Sigil, Emblem and Glyph|CLOSE_BOLD| with pride, in celebration of a decade of creativity and collaboration.

Whether you've created TennoGen, added a piece to your Arsenal, or enjoyed from afar, thank you for supporting artists!

Sincerely,
Warframe Team
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TenYearsofTennoGen.zhText:
TennoGen 计划十周年啦！ 

十年来，才华横溢、富有创造力的社区成员们将他们独特的头盔、披饰，以及更多精彩内容添加到了《Warframe》中。来自超过 90 位社区艺术家的 400 多件作品通过 TennoGen 计划登陆了始源星系！

自豪地佩戴上 |OPEN_BOLD|TennoGen 十周年纪念纹章、徽章和浮印|CLOSE_BOLD|，庆祝十年来大家的创造力与同心协力。

无论你是创作过 TennoGen 作品、添加过 TennoGen 物品至你的军械库，还是只是远远欣赏，我们都感谢你对艺术家们的支持！

此致， 
《Warframe》团队

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Intro.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Ordis has been thinking about all the Tenno who have stood side-by-side with you in battle. Tenno who have fought relentlessly against those who profit from the suffering of innocents.

Last Earth cycle at this time, you gave gifts to your comrades. Ordis thinks you should do that again! Not only will you bring cheer to your comrades you will bring hope to the entire Origin System thanks to an allied Syndicate matching your generosity.

Ordis does love this giving tradition.

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Intro.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Ordis 一直在想着所有与您并肩作战的 Tenno 们。那些 Tenno 义无反顾地为那些深受利益霸主折磨的无辜者而战。

在上一个地球周期之际，您赠送礼物给您的伙伴们。Ordis 认为您应该再这么做！您不仅可以鼓舞您的伙伴，还会为整个始源星系带来希望，这要归功于一个与您的慷慨互相匹配的集团联盟。

Ordis 的确喜欢这种赠予的传统。

您忠诚的中枢，
－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Tier1.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

A great start to this initiative, Operator! Your generosity is inspiring others to give. Add this gift from our allied Syndicates to your Arsenal and don't stop now!

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Tier1.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

这是这个新猷的一个很棒的开始，指挥官！您的慷慨激起了其他人也来赠予。把这份来自我们联盟集团的礼物添加到「军械库」中并且现在不要停止！

您忠诚的中枢，
－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Tier2.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Your excitement to give has even exceeded my own precisely calculated predictions!

Ordis knows that giving is itself a reward, but I thought you deserved this. Keep up the great work, Operator!

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Tier2.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

您兴奋地赠予，这样已经远远超出了我自己精确的预报推测！

Ordis 知道赠予本身就是一种报酬，不过我想您是值得获得这个的。保持这个伟大的工作，指挥官！

您忠诚的中枢，
－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Tier3.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Gift-giving must be coded into your Void-altered DNA, Operator! To thank you for your continued generosity, take this reward and display it proudly!

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Tennobaum2018Tier3.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

赠予礼物有可能被编码到您的虚空改造 DNA 之中了，指挥官！为了感谢您持续的慷慨，请接受这个奖励并骄傲地展示它！

您忠诚的中枢，
－Ordis

Your loyal Cephalon,
Ordis

您忠诚的中枢，

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TrueMasterMessageD.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

From the moment I called you to wake, you have been unrelenting in your pursuit of mastery. You defeated every test placed in your path. No blade, pistol, rifle, or Warframe has eluded your proficiency.

Through battles personal and grand, combatting enemies old and new, you have shown martial precision, and fearless honor against all that has come your way.

And now, you have passed my final test to attain the rank of True Master.

It has been an honor to guide you thus far. You are a student no more. Your journey as a True Master begins now. Bless your fellow Tenno with all that you have learned.

With pride,
The Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TrueMasterMessageD.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

从我唤醒你的那一刻起，你对精通段位的追求就从未停歇过。你通过了成长道路上的每一个测试。没有一件近战武器、手枪、步枪，或是战甲，不在你的精通范围内。

通过与新老敌人的大小战斗，你已经展示出了精妙的武技，以及对你所经历一切的无所畏惧。

而现在，你已经通过了我最后的测试，成为了至崇宗师。

我很荣幸能引导你走到今天。你不再是一个学生了。作为一名至崇宗师，你的旅程从现在开始。用你所学的一切来祝福你的 Tenno 同伴吧。

以你为傲，
Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Twitch2019EmberBun.zhText:

Breaking news, Tenno! Your old pal Darvo just detected Vayas Operator Prime Accessories inside another impassible Void Rift.

Listen, I don't even know what an "Operator" is, but this stuff looks like your style. Maybe leftovers from some Naberus festivities your new friends on Deimos threw a while back, eh?

Either way, these shiny Prime things are well out of old Darvo's reach, but they're free for you to grab. Thought I'd pass their location along... Out of the kindness of my heart.

If you feel like thanking your old friend, stop by and make a few purchases -- deal?

-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Twitch2020PrimeOpe.zhText:
Tenno，重大新闻！你的老伙计 Darvo 刚刚在另一个无法逾越的虚空裂隙里检测到了盛年 Prime 指挥官配件。

听着，我甚至不知道"指挥官"是什么，但是这个东西看起来像是你的风格。也许是你遗落在火卫二新朋友举办的纳贝流士庆祝活动上的？

不管怎么说，这些闪闪发光的 Prime 物件都不在我的掌控范围里，但你可以免费拿走它们。出于我的善意……我想我应该会把它们的位置信息发送给你。

如果你想感谢你的老朋友，就来我这买点东西吧——成交？

-Darvo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TwitchPrime2020Inf.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

It’s your old pal Darvo, back again. While looking into some strange transmissions, we picked up this disgus--I mean, delightful cluster of what looks like fused gear and organics. Clem and I know better than to mess with some angry, throbbing biomass. We leave that to our talented Tenno friend!

Ok, ok, I’ll be honest. It’s gross and starting to wriggle. I would prefer it as far away from me as possible. If you want it, great, otherwise the APIS SYANDANA, 7-DAY RESOURCE BOOSTER and 7-DAY RESOURCE DROP CHANCE BOOSTER are going in the nearest incinerator. Just to be safe.

Either way, I know when I’m out of my depth. Can you handle this?

Your friend,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TwitchPrime2020Inf.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你的老朋友 Darvo 又回来了。在调查一些奇怪的传输通讯时，我们发现了这个讨厌的——我是说，讨人喜欢且看上去像是融合了齿轮和有机物的聚合体。Clem 和我很清楚不要去招惹那些愤怒的、跳动的生物质。我们决定把它留给我们天赋异禀的 Tenno 朋友！

好吧，好吧，我会说实话的。它很恶心，而且开始扭动了。我希望它能离我越远越好。如果你想要的话，很好，否则，蜂姿披饰，7 天资源数量加成，以及 7 天资源掉落几率加成将被送进最近的焚化炉。只是为了安全起见。

不管怎样，我知道这都超出了我的能力范围。你能处理这些吗？

你的朋友，
Darvo

More Void Rifts mean more prime items for you and another headache for Darvo. I'm detecting a STATIC REACTOR PRIME SIGIL that will make your Warframe sizzle like a storm cloud! Grab that beauty quick, so I'm not reminded I can't sell it.
 
Not to mention, I'm still picking up traces of EMBER and the FILIGREE PRIME DECORATION in the Void so don't forget to retrieve them.
 
Just remember how this works. I scratch your back... You shop at my store. Got it?
 
Your old pal,
-Darvo
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TwitchPrime2020Pri.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，
 
更多的虚空裂痕意味着你能得到更多的 Prime 部件，这对 Darvo 来说真是头疼。我监测到一枚静态反应堆 PRIME 纹章 ，它将让你的战甲像暴风雨来临前的乌云一般嘶嘶作响。记得赶快取走它，这样我就不会想起，没办法把它卖了赚钱的事。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TwitchPrimeWeaponB.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

After the last time I missed out on a cache of amazing, totally free, Prime items, I was a bit miffed. I mean, why can’t I pass through that Void Rift? Why do I have to sit on the sidelines while some fancy Tenno dances across the Rift and comes back with all this shiny stuff that should have been Darvo’s in the first place? I thought, there must be a way.

So, I loaded Clem into a Grineer assault pod (it was his idea, I swear) and launched him at terminal speeds toward the rift. Undoubtedly he could break through, right? Nope. He bounced.

I have come to the conclusion that these items were not meant for mere mortals.

There’s a VECTIS PRIME, FANG PRIME, and a SPEKTAKA PRIME SUGATRA hiding in there. Go get ‘em, Tenno!

Your pal,
Darvo

P.S. Clem’s fine.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/TwitchPrimeWeaponB.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

自从上次我错过了一箱超棒的、完全免费的 Prime 道具，我一直有些恼火。你看，为什么我不能穿过虚空裂隙呢？为什么我只能坐在一边看着那些外表花哨的 Tenno 手舞足蹈地穿过裂隙，带着闪亮亮的物品回来呢？这些东西本该属于 Darvo。我想，一定还有办法。

因此，我把 Clem 装进了一个 Grineer 突袭舱中（我发誓，这是他自己的主意），并把他以终端速度射向了裂隙。毫无疑问他一定可以穿过去，不是吗？然而没有，他弹了回来。

我不得不承认，这些道具并不是给区区凡人准备的。

有守望者 PRIME，狼牙 PRIME 和华丽演出 PRIME 坠饰藏在那里。快去拿到它们，Tenno！

你的老伙计，
Darvo

又及，Clem 没事。

Nora is back on the air with Nightwave: Series 3 — The Glassmaker. If you're new to Nightwave, welcome! Nora Night hosts a radio show that rewards you for simply playing Warframe!

In Series 3: The Glassmaker you'll step inside Nora's virtual crime scene to track down a killer with a twisted method of murder. Rise through 30 Ranks to earn new rewards like a Nightwave Landing Craft, Augments, and Cephalon-themed Customizations for your Warframe, Operator and Melee Weapons!

Beyond the interactive narrative, Nightwave: Series 3 also introduces new Daily and Weekly Acts! Don't have a ship of your own? Railjack Acts can be completed by joining any open crew from the Star Chart.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update27Changes_Th.zhText:
诺拉的电台随着《午夜电波：系列 3 — 玻璃匠》又重新响彻宇宙了。对于那些首次接触午夜电波的玩家，我们表示欢迎！只需游玩 Warframe，就能在诺拉·夜举办的这档电台节目中获得奖励！

在《系列3：玻璃匠》中，你将步入由诺拉模拟的犯罪现场来抽丝剥茧，追踪那个以扭曲般变态的手法实施谋杀的凶手。在此次活动中达到 30 级来获取全新的奖励，例如午夜电波登陆艇、强化 Mod，以及为你的战甲、指挥官和近战武器设计的中枢主题的自定义装饰！

除了互动式剧情，《午夜电波：系列3》还引入了新的每日与每周行动！或许你会问，如果没有自己的星舰该怎么办？航道星舰行动可以通过在星图中参加其他公开匹配的玩家队伍来完成。

Once you have found yourself with a |OPEN_BOLD|completed Star Chart|CLOSE_BOLD|, you may choose to arm yourself for a higher tier of enemies in Warframe. You will earn |OPEN_BOLD|exclusive Emotes|CLOSE_BOLD| and |OPEN_BOLD|Trophies|CLOSE_BOLD| by completing each region. Team up or go alone - good luck!

If you are not ready for this challenge, fear not, it's not going anywhere. One day you may be ready for |OPEN_BOLD|The Steel Path|CLOSE_BOLD|.

是时候迎接一个全新的挑战了。始源星系一直在不断变化。我们的敌人变得越来越强大——只有真正可以得心应手地使用军械库内各种武器的 Tenno，才能克服等待我们的一切困难。如果你已经|OPEN_BOLD|完成了星图上的全部节点|CLOSE_BOLD|，你就可以选择武装自己，来面对 Warframe 中更高等级的敌人。在这次更新中，我们隆重推出了|OPEN_BOLD|"钢铁之路"|CLOSE_BOLD|，这个模式允许玩家在星图所有区域的敌人等级都|OPEN_BOLD|提升了 100 级|CLOSE_BOLD|的情况下重新进行任务。通过完成每个区域，你将能够获取|OPEN_BOLD|专属的表情动作|CLOSE_BOLD|和|OPEN_BOLD|奖杯|CLOSE_BOLD|。以组队或单人游戏来进行挑战吧，祝你好运！

Tenno - it is time for 'The Deadlock Protocol.' The newest Warframe - Protea - has arrived, and with her comes a new Quest to obtain the ever-prepared battlefield reinforcement.

All of the Corpus Ships in the fleet have been updated! Originally designed and released in 2012 as our first environment, the Corpus Ships have been completely remastered. It's more than just a new look - there's a story weaved throughout - see what mysteries lie within about the Corpus and their founder!

Update 28 brings you new Weapons, new Kitgun Primaries, and more changes for you to try out. While you're here - start or continue your journey with Nightwave Series 3: The Glassmaker! The Origin System is a busy place… We hereby invoke THE DEADLOCK PROTOCOL!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update28Changes_De.zhText:
Tenno — 是时候迎接《僵局协议》了。最新的战甲— Protea — 现已登场，伴随她一同到来的是一个全新的系列任务，以便玩家获取 Protea 将带来的前所未有的战场增援。

此外，Corpus 舰队中的所有飞船都经过了更新！作为我们的第一个游戏场景，这些飞船最初是在 2012 年被设计出来并发布的。现在这些 Corpus 飞船都经过了彻底的重制。不仅仅是新的外观 — 这其中编织着一整个故事 — 来探索 Corpus 与其创始人之间的秘辛吧！

《更新 28》为你带来了全新的武器、组合枪（主要武器），以及更多等待你亲自尝试的改动。趁着你在这里 — 通过《午夜电波系列 3：玻璃匠》来开启，或是继续你在始源星系中的旅程吧！始源星系是一个无比繁忙的地方……我们就此执行《僵局协议》！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update2910Changes_.text:
|OPEN_BOLD|Railjack|CLOSE_BOLD| is about to change in huge ways. We have revisited Railjack in 2021 and our overall goal is to simplify points of friction by better integrating Warframe's signature "flow" into the overall experience.

Depending on your experience level with Railjack, a lot of this may simply be new information. But for those who have mastered Railjack - change has arrived. Avionics are no more, Mods have taken their place. Get ready to use them on your |OPEN_BOLD|‘Plexus'|CLOSE_BOLD|, a new item that lets you bring your loadout to other's Railjacks! A rework of |OPEN_BOLD|Intrinsics|CLOSE_BOLD| Ranks will bring a re-spec on login, giving you a fresh start to spend your Intrinsics. Solo adventurers rejoice: the |OPEN_BOLD|Command Intrinsic|CLOSE_BOLD| is here! After you've unlocked the Intrinsic, visit |OPEN_BOLD|Ticker|CLOSE_BOLD| to hire qualified |OPEN_BOLD|Crewmates|CLOSE_BOLD| to aid in managing your Railjack.

New |OPEN_BOLD|Proxima|CLOSE_BOLD| regions in the Railjack Star Chart have been discovered! Riddled with Corpus enemies old and new, these new Proxima Regions are home to new Points of Interest, new mission types, and new secrets. Relive the Necramech dominant |OPEN_BOLD|Orphix|CLOSE_BOLD| game mode, and put your cooperation to the test in the all-new |OPEN_BOLD|Volatile|CLOSE_BOLD| game mode.

There's so much more packed into this Update. We encourage you to take your time as you dive back in! And if you're new to Railjack, welcome. It's the perfect time to start.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update2910Changes_.zhText:
|OPEN_BOLD|航道星舰|CLOSE_BOLD|即将发生重大变动。我们在 2021 年重制了航道星舰，我们的总体目标是，通过把《Warframe》标志性的"流畅操作"更好地整合到整体游戏体验中，以此来化解冲突点。

根据你对航道星舰了解程度的不同，这部分的许多内容可能会是全新的体验。但对于那些已经精通了航道星舰的玩家来说，改动已经到来了。航电设备已不复存在，取而代之的是 Mod。准备好在你的|OPEN_BOLD|"深控"|CLOSE_BOLD|上使用它们吧，这是一项全新的设定，让你能把你的配置带到他人的航道星舰上。经过重新设计的|OPEN_BOLD|内源之力|CLOSE_BOLD|等级，需要在登录时重新规划，你可以重新分配内源之力点数，来享受一个全新的开始。让独狼玩家们欢呼雀跃的是，|OPEN_BOLD|命令内源之力|CLOSE_BOLD|现已登陆游戏！在你解锁这项内源之力之后，造访 |OPEN_BOLD|Ticker|CLOSE_BOLD| 来招募合格的|OPEN_BOLD|舰员|CLOSE_BOLD|，以协助管理你的航道星舰。

全新的|OPEN_BOLD|比邻星域|CLOSE_BOLD|已经出现在了航道星舰星图上。这些全新的比邻星域遍布着新老 Corpus 敌人，同时这里还有全新的兴趣点、全新的任务类型，以及新的秘密。重温由殁世机甲为主角的|OPEN_BOLD|奥影|CLOSE_BOLD|游戏模式，并在全新的|OPEN_BOLD|爆发|CLOSE_BOLD|游戏模式中测试你的合作能力。

本次更新还包含了其他许多内容。我们鼓励你花些时间来进行深入了解。如果你才刚开始接触航道星舰，那么欢迎你，因为现在正是开启这部分旅程的最佳时机。

Tenno,

Much awaits you in Update 29: Heart of Deimos. Unveil the secrets of Deimos, Mars's second moon. Discover what has been shrouded in mystery, hidden from the Origin System, and why this Infested moon has revealed itself only now. You may begin your search in the |OPEN_BOLD|'Heart of Deimos' Quest|CLOSE_BOLD|, eligible for players who have completed the Mars Junction.

Tenno beginning their journey in Warframe will now awake to a new cinematic introduction and revised tutorial with |OPEN_BOLD|New Player Experience: Tutorial 3.0|CLOSE_BOLD|. If you've already awoken, you too can enjoy the refresh by visiting the Codex in your Orbiter.

|OPEN_BOLD|Xaku|CLOSE_BOLD| – The community-designed Warframe is here! Meet an amalgam of three fallen Warframes from an age past whose pieces were assembled of the Void and reborn as one: Xaku. They call out to you.

The |OPEN_BOLD|Helminth|CLOSE_BOLD| system has arrived, Warframe's deepest customization yet. Feed the Helminth to replace your Warframes' Abilities! To begin the feast, you must earn the Helminth Segment from a new Syndicate within the Heart of Deimos.

P.S. Catch up on Warframe's past updates at any time! Open the Pause Menu in your Orbiter and click the |OPEN_BOLD|UPDATE HISTORY|CLOSE_BOLD| button in the bottom right. If you've been away a while, we recommend taking a look.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update29Changes_De.zhText:
Tenno，

在《更新 29：惊惧之心》中，有很多精彩内容正等着你去发现。揭开火卫二深藏的秘密。探究一直以来，从始源星系消踪匿迹，在迷雾笼罩之下的究竟是什么；以及为何这颗感染卫星，偏偏在这个时候再度现身。你可以通过|OPEN_BOLD|《惊惧之心》系列任务|CLOSE_BOLD|来开启你的探索之旅。只有那些已经解锁了火星结合点的玩家，才能前去一探究竟。

对于刚刚开启《Warframe》旅程的 Tenno 来说，|OPEN_BOLD|全新的玩家体验：新手教程 3.0|CLOSE_BOLD|将带领你们，在一个全新的电影式情节，以及重制过的新手教程中苏醒。如果你早已觉醒，你也可以通过前往轨道飞行器上的资料库，来享受这个全新的体验。

|OPEN_BOLD|Xaku|CLOSE_BOLD| — 由玩家社区创造的战甲现已登场！在那久远的时代里，有三款陨落的战甲。虚空能量把他们的残骸拼接了起来，重生合一：Xaku。他们正在召唤你。

此外，|OPEN_BOLD|Helminth|CLOSE_BOLD| 系统已经上线，它是迄今为止最深入的战甲定制系统。通过饲喂 Helminth 来替换战甲的技能！你必须从《惊惧之心》所带来的，全新的集团那里，获得"Helminth 模块"，然后才能让 Helminth 来享用这个"满汉全席"。

对了，现在可以随时查看《Warframe》过去的更新内容了！在轨道飞行器中打开"暂停菜单"，点击右下角的|OPEN_BOLD|更新历史|CLOSE_BOLD|按钮。如果你暂别游戏有一阵子了，我们十分推荐你去看看。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update30Changes_De.text:
|OPEN_BOLD|Cephalon Cy|CLOSE_BOLD| has found an abandoned Voidspace ready for easy-picking in the Railjack - but you're not alone out there. Brace yourself for an eerie ride in the |OPEN_BOLD|Call of the Tempestarii|CLOSE_BOLD|. Tenno in possession of a Railjack with Deadlock Protocol completed can access this Quest on login.

Meet the newest Warframe: |OPEN_BOLD|Sevagoth|CLOSE_BOLD|! The storm-swept, Void-wandering Warframe has returned to harvest living souls. Send forth his Shadow to reap the life of the unwary.

New |OPEN_BOLD|Proxima|CLOSE_BOLD| regions in the Railjack Star Chart have been discovered! Riddled with Corpus enemies old and new, these new Proxima Regions are home to new Points of Interest, new mission types, and new secrets. Relive the Necramech dominant |OPEN_BOLD|Orphix|CLOSE_BOLD| gamemode, and put your cooperation to the test in the all new |OPEN_BOLD|Volatile|CLOSE_BOLD| gamemode.

|OPEN_BOLD|Railjack|CLOSE_BOLD| is about to change in huge ways with |OPEN_BOLD|Railjack Retrofit|CLOSE_BOLD|. We have revisited Railjack in 2021 and our overall goal is to simplify points of friction by better integrating Warframe's signature "flow" into the overall experience.

Depending on your experience level with Railjack, a lot of this may simply be new information. But for those who have mastered Railjack - change has arrived. Avionics are no more, Mods have taken their place. Get ready to use them on your |OPEN_BOLD|'Plexus'|CLOSE_BOLD|, a new item that lets you bring your loadout to other's Railjacks! 迎接最新的战甲 |OPEN_BOLD|Sevagoth|CLOSE_BOLD|！受风暴席卷而游荡于虚空的战甲已经回归，以收割生者的灵魂。放出他的幽影来收割那些疏忽之人的性命。

根据你对航道星舰了解程度的不同，这部分的许多内容可能会是全新的体验。但对于那些已经精通了航道星舰的玩家来说，改动已经到来了。航电设备已不复存在，取而代之的是 Mod。准备好在你的|OPEN_BOLD|"深控"|CLOSE_BOLD|上使用它们吧，这是一项全新的设定，让你能把你的配置带到他人的航道星舰上。经过重新设计的|OPEN_BOLD|内源之力|CLOSE_BOLD|等级，需要在登录时重新规划，你可以重新分配内源之力点数，来享受一个全新的开始。让独狼玩家们欢呼雀跃的是，|OPEN_BOLD|命令内源之力|CLOSE_BOLD|现已登陆游戏！在你解锁这项内源之力之后，造访 |OPEN_BOLD|Ticker|CLOSE_BOLD| 来招募合格的|OPEN_BOLD|舰员|CLOSE_BOLD|，以协助管理你的航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update30_5_Changes.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|你可曾与帕尔沃斯·格拉努会面？|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|完成了|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|《内战》|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|和|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|《风暴的呼唤》|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|系列任务的玩家可以参与到帕尔沃斯为 Corpus 设定的最新计划：《帕尔沃斯的姐妹们》。以 Corpus 的最新科技为蓝本改造，|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|帕尔沃斯的姐妹们|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|已经准备好夺取属于她们的星区，以及你的性命。

A story years in the making has come to this very pivotal moment. The enemy have launched a full-scale invasion in |OPEN_BOLD|The New War|CLOSE_BOLD|. The New War will take you several hours to complete and will prevent normal Warframe activities from taking place for the duration of the quest. Plan accordingly! 

|OPEN_BOLD|Prerequisites|CLOSE_BOLD| for The New War Quest include having |OPEN_BOLD|"Prelude to War"|CLOSE_BOLD| complete in your Codex, owning a |OPEN_BOLD|Necramech|CLOSE_BOLD|, and owning a |OPEN_BOLD|Railjack|CLOSE_BOLD|.

This allows you to choose either 'Hold' or 'Tap' when confronted with a struggle context action, where typically mashing of a button would be requested. We recommend that you put this setting to your preference before initiating The New War Quest to ensure you have the best experience. 

A new Warframe, |OPEN_BOLD|Caliban|CLOSE_BOLD|, enters the battle. Erra's twisted masterpiece, a true hybrid of Warframe and Sentient. Raised from the wreckage of the Old War to carve a swathe through the New with his signature scythe: |OPEN_BOLD|Venato|CLOSE_BOLD|!

Smite the unrighteous as the War unfolds with the |OPEN_BOLD|Scourge Prime|CLOSE_BOLD| and |OPEN_BOLD|Knell Prime|CLOSE_BOLD|! PLUS, Harrow has received some Quality of Life changes to his kit.

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update32ChangesZar.text:
The long-lost |OPEN_BOLD|Zariman Ten Zero|CLOSE_BOLD| has reappeared. A haunting song resounds across the System. Reluctantly, you're sent back to where it all began for an overdue confrontation with the past...

The |OPEN_BOLD|Prerequisite|CLOSE_BOLD| for the |OPEN_BOLD|Angels of the Zariman Quest|CLOSE_BOLD| includes having completed |OPEN_BOLD|"The New War"|CLOSE_BOLD|.

After completing the Angels of the Zariman Quest, the Zariman becomes yours to explore within the |OPEN_BOLD|Chrysalith|CLOSE_BOLD| hub. Housing a new |OPEN_BOLD|Syndicate|CLOSE_BOLD|, |OPEN_BOLD|Ceremonial Incarnon weapons|CLOSE_BOLD|, |OPEN_BOLD|Bounties|CLOSE_BOLD|, and even |OPEN_BOLD|Dormizones|CLOSE_BOLD| for you to make your own home away from home.

3 new game modes await you post-Zariman Quest: |OPEN_BOLD|Void Flood, Void Cascade|CLOSE_BOLD|, and |OPEN_BOLD|Void Armageddon|CLOSE_BOLD|. Void Flood will put your parkour skills to the ultimate test to subdue the Corruption. Void Cascade challenges you to balance cleansing possessed Exolizers while defending against Void manifestations who look to sabotage your efforts! In Void Armageddon, Grineer and Corpus enemies have boarded the Zariman and are targeting its Reliquary for destruction. Exquisitely twisted creations and their minions seek to do the same...

Both the |OPEN_BOLD|Focus Rework|CLOSE_BOLD| and |OPEN_BOLD|Eximus Rework|CLOSE_BOLD| are here! Almost every aspect of Focus is being reviewed & touched, therefore upon login, all your Focus points will be returned to their respective School and Eidolon Shards are given via Inbox to compensate for the Focus Pool removal. Re-spec however you choose with the Rework. Keep an eye out for the new visual and gameplay changes to Eximus units!

The new Warframe, |OPEN_BOLD|Gyre|CLOSE_BOLD|, dances her way into battle! Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters accompanied by her signature electric Rifle, Alternox!

Bestow brutal beauty onto your enemies with the |OPEN_BOLD|Valkyr Carnivex Collection|CLOSE_BOLD|! Complete with her |OPEN_BOLD|Dreyric Fist Skin|CLOSE_BOLD| and the |OPEN_BOLD|Alastorn Armor|CLOSE_BOLD| to unleash your fury befitting the most dedicated berserker.

Much more is yours to discover in this Update!

完成了《扎里曼的天使》系列任务后，「扎里曼号」将归你所有，并且你可自由前去探索飞船上的|OPEN_BOLD|羽化之穹|CLOSE_BOLD|社交中心。那里也驻扎着一个全新的|OPEN_BOLD|集团|CLOSE_BOLD|，并有着可进化的|OPEN_BOLD|仪式灵化武器|CLOSE_BOLD|、|OPEN_BOLD|赏金任务|CLOSE_BOLD|，甚至是|OPEN_BOLD|居住舱|CLOSE_BOLD|来供你搭建属于自己的天地。

此外还有三个全新的游戏模式供你在完成了《扎里曼的天使》系列任务之后探索：|OPEN_BOLD|虚空洪流、虚空覆涌|CLOSE_BOLD|，以及|OPEN_BOLD|虚空决战|CLOSE_BOLD|。虚空洪流将对你的跑酷技巧进行终极测试，以制服堕落敌人。虚空覆涌将会对你如何平衡在抵御虚空显化者时，净化被侵噬的无垢装置的技巧进行挑战。在虚空决战任务模式下，Grineer 和 Corpus 敌人登上了「扎里曼号」并计划破坏飞船上的圣物装置。精致扭曲的虚空造物和他们的爪牙也想这样做……

|OPEN_BOLD|专精重制|CLOSE_BOLD|和|OPEN_BOLD|卓越者重制|CLOSE_BOLD|也随着此次更新一并登场了！专精系统的几乎所有部分都经过了审查和改动。因此当你此次更新后登陆游戏，作为专精池的移除补偿，你的全部专精点数都会被返还到其相应的学派，而夜灵碎片也会被发送至你的游戏内收件箱中，你可以根据自己的方式重新进行配置。此外也请留意卓越者敌人的全新视觉和游戏性改动！

全新的战甲 |OPEN_BOLD|Gyre|CLOSE_BOLD| 正翩然舞入战场！配备好她的标志性电幻步枪，并使用传导线圈和发射器歼灭敌人！

通过 |OPEN_BOLD|Valkyr 行刑者组合包|CLOSE_BOLD|赋予敌人残酷的美感！装配上她的|OPEN_BOLD|沁血拳套外观|CLOSE_BOLD|和|OPEN_BOLD|魔使护甲|CLOSE_BOLD|来以狂战士之姿释放你的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update32Veilbreake.text:
Free from his Narmer shackles, |OPEN_BOLD|Kahl-175|CLOSE_BOLD| returns with a personal mission to save his Brothers, but he can't do it alone. Introducing the |OPEN_BOLD|VEILBREAKER|CLOSE_BOLD| Quest! A continuation of The New War from the eye of Kahl, determined to free his comrades from the Narmer stronghold. The Veilbreaker Quest is available to those who have completed The New War. Upon completion of the solo Veilbreaker Quest, new adventures await you:

• |OPEN_BOLD|Kahl's Garrison|CLOSE_BOLD| - A camp fit for Kahl and his brothers. Customize, strategize, and de-Narmerize, all while earning your way to new rewards and systems.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Archon Hunts|CLOSE_BOLD| - Take on advanced battles against the Archons to obtain Archon Shards and more.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Archon Shards|CLOSE_BOLD| - Infusing your Warframes with these shards will offer permanent buffs to a variety of stats.

What else can you expect in this Update?

• The 50th Warframe, |OPEN_BOLD|STYANAX|CLOSE_BOLD|, is here! Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. Complete your Arsenal with his signature Speargun: Afentis.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Protea Caladrius Skin!|CLOSE_BOLD| Accompanied by the Daecret Tonkor Skin and Monitivus Thrown Weapon Skin.
• 4 New |OPEN_BOLD|Voidshell Skins|CLOSE_BOLD| for Styanax, Excalibur, Wukong, and Nova.
• A plethora of weapons, cosmetics, and more!

Veilbreaker also brings an abundance of |OPEN_BOLD|Quality of Life|CLOSE_BOLD| changes:

• |OPEN_BOLD|Syndicate System Changes|CLOSE_BOLD| - Make your Syndicate pledge to forgo Sigil equipping.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Starter Warframe Reworks|CLOSE_BOLD| - Excalibur, Mag & Volt are refreshed!
• |OPEN_BOLD|Area-of-Effect Changes|CLOSE_BOLD| - Bringing strategic choices to AoE weapon usage.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Speargun Rework|CLOSE_BOLD| - An overhaul of the core mechanics of what makes Spearguns unique.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Amp Gilding Changes|CLOSE_BOLD| - Max "final" stats available right upon crafting to reduce leveling friction.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Riven System Changes|CLOSE_BOLD| - Newly acquired Rivens don't count against capacity until you choose to view the Unveiling challenge.
• And so much more!

As you can see, many familiar systems are getting some big and small changes in the name of QoL! We encourage you to take it one change at a time as you absorb everything Veilbreaker brings.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update32Veilbreake.zhText:
挣脱了合一众的枷锁后，|OPEN_BOLD|卡尔-175|CLOSE_BOLD| 在一个单人任务中回归以解救他的兄弟们，然而他无法以一己之力做到。|OPEN_BOLD|《破障者》|CLOSE_BOLD|系列任务现已登场！这是《新纪之战》的延续之作，从卡尔的视角，下定决心从合一众大本营解救他的战友们。完成《新纪之战》系列任务后，即可开启《破障者》系列任务。在完成单人模式的《破障者》系列任务后，新的旅程将等待着你：

• |OPEN_BOLD|卡尔驻军|CLOSE_BOLD| - 一个适合卡尔和他的兄弟们的营地。自定义、制订战略和摆脱合一众控制，同时也会获得新的奖励和系统。
• |OPEN_BOLD|执刑官猎杀|CLOSE_BOLD| - 展开对抗执刑官的高阶战斗，以获取执刑官源力石以及更多精彩内容。
• |OPEN_BOLD|执刑官源力石|CLOSE_BOLD| - 用这些源力石注入到你的战甲，以获得提高各种属性数值的永久加成吧。

在此更新中你还能期待什么？

• 第 50 款战甲，|OPEN_BOLD|STYANAX|CLOSE_BOLD|，隆重登场！Styanax 从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。通过他的标志性标枪：圣英来完善你的军械库。
• |OPEN_BOLD|Protea 医官鸟外观！|CLOSE_BOLD|并伴随着征服榴炮 圣裁外观和投掷武器 警世外观。
• 为 Styanax、Excalibur、Wukong 和 Nova 而打造的 4 种全新|OPEN_BOLD|虚空之壳外观|CLOSE_BOLD|。
• 大量武器、外观装饰、以及更多精彩内容！

《破障者》也带来了大量|OPEN_BOLD|游戏体验|CLOSE_BOLD|改进：

• |OPEN_BOLD|集团系统改进|CLOSE_BOLD| - 使集团效忠不再需要佩戴纹章。
• |OPEN_BOLD|初始战甲重制|CLOSE_BOLD| - Excalibur、Mag 和 Volt 会焕然一新！
• |OPEN_BOLD|影响范围改进|CLOSE_BOLD| - 给范围武器的使用带来战略选择。
• |OPEN_BOLD|标枪重制|CLOSE_BOLD| - 翻修了使标枪与众不同核心机制。
• |OPEN_BOLD|增幅器镀金改进|CLOSE_BOLD| - 为了减少升级时的偏差，制造时可显示最大化后"最终"数值。
• |OPEN_BOLD|裂罅系统改进|CLOSE_BOLD| - 新获取的裂罅 Mod 不会占用容量，直到你选择查看其揭幕挑战。
• 还有更多精彩内容！

如你所见，许多熟悉的系统都会在游戏体验的考量上进行或多或少的改进！我们鼓励你通过《破障者》带来所有的新变化中，一个一个体验这些改动。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update32Veilbreake.text: The Origin System’s newest savior is back!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update32Veilbreake.zhText: 始源星系最新涌现的救星回归！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update33Duviri_Des.text:
Duviri is here! The precise where and when has been hard to pinpoint, but Drifter's time in Duviri is finally becoming clear. Start |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|The Duviri Paradox Quest|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| to experience a never-ending spiral of life, death, and rebirth at the hands of Dominus Thrax. All Tenno, |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|including those brand new to Warframe|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|, can dive into The Duviri Paradox immediately. After quest completion, there are three Game Modes for experiencing Duviri:

• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|THE CIRCUIT:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Focused on Warframe combat within the Undercroft, The Circuit revolves around endless gameplay objectives in the Undercroft with rotating weekly rewards. Pick your difficulty and reward track, complete rounds to fill out the track, and claim rewards such as new Arcanes, Incarnon Genesis, or even blueprints to build an entire Warframe!
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|THE DUVIRI EXPERIENCE:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Duviri as it is meant to be played - the Open Landscape experience with a Spiral story, side activities, and open exploration. This game mode allows a Tenno to experience everything that Duviri has to offer.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|THE LONE STORY:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| A streamlined version of Duviri with only the Spiral story for Tenno looking to face the Orowyrm's fury as fast as possible.

When exploring Duviri's mind-bending reality, you can expect to encounter:

• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|SPIRALS:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Duviri is at the whim of Dominus Thrax's Spiral, with each Spiral featuring its own story, unique threats, and changing environment for the citizens of Duviri.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|DECREES:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Specialized Drifter and Warframe upgrades unique to each Duviri visit. Completing activities in Duviri grants a choice between randomized upgrades, improving your chances against the challenges found in Duviri and The Undercroft.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|DRIFTER MELEE:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Drifter has taken up melee weapons to fight back. Block incoming attacks to parry for a quick strike, or take Dax down hard with a Power Strike.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|THE UNDERCROFT:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| The Undercroft hosts familiar warriors of various origins, rewriting Duviri's rules to allow Warframe combat.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|DRIFTER INTRINSICS:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Enhance the Drifter within Duviri with permanent upgrades aimed to improve Combat, Riding, Opportunity, and Endurance.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|KAITHE:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| A customizable mount able to carry you above, below, and through the many islands of Duviri.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|SIDE ACTIVITIES:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Duviri has significantly more to experience, including new enemies, Orowyrm boss fights, plus a wealth of side activities, including Maw Feeding, Shawzin playing, Komi, with many others to find!

The Duviri Paradox update comes with far more to discover beyond the bounds of Dominus Thrax' imagined reality. There are new Incarnon Genesis, Arcanes, and Cosmetics that can all be used across Warframe:

• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|INCARNON GENESIS:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Imbue your weapons with the power of the Void, unlocking specialized upgrades. Masters of the Steel Path Circuit can earn these to breathe new power into a pool of old favorites.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|NEW MELEE WEAPONS:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Drifters and Warframes alike can use five new Melee Weapons coming with Duviri! Take down the Orowyrm to earn Pathos Clamps and use them to unlock these new Weapons and their Blueprints.
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|NEW DELUXE SKINS & CUSTOMIZATIONS:|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| Community artist concepts turned into reality, the Baruuk Doan and Wisp Somnium Collections are here! Look out for new Drifter Transference Suits, Drifter facial hair, and Visage Inks available on the Market for Platinum.

Duviri needs you, Drifter. Dominus Thrax controls the Spiral and only you can break the cycle. Each new Spiral is a chance to discover the power you hold and bring change - bring color - to Duviri. Challenge Dominus Thrax and earn your escape from this endless cycle.

The Duviri Paradox is |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|available to every Tenno|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|, whether they've been playing for 10 years or are just starting today.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/Update33Duviri_Des.zhText:
双衍王境来了！准确的地点和时间一直难以确定，但漂泊者在双衍王境里的时间终于变得更加眉目清晰。开启|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|《双衍悖论》系列任务|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|，在士魂大帝的手中体验永无止境的活着、死亡和重生的螺旋。所有的 Tenno，|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|包括《Warframe》的新玩家|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|，都可以立即进入《双衍悖论》。在完成系列任务后，有三种游戏模式可以体验双衍王境：

• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|无尽回廊：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|专注于地穴内的战甲战斗，无尽回廊以地穴中无尽的游戏目标为核心，每周轮换奖励。选择难度和奖励表，完成轮次以填充奖励表，收获奖励，例如新赋能、灵化之源，甚至是制作战甲的一整套蓝图！
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|双衍历程：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|双衍王境的标准玩法——通过复眠螺旋故事、支线目标以及开放式探索来体验这个开放世界。这种游戏模式可以让 Tenno 体验双衍王境的所有内容。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|孤独纪事：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|精简版的双衍王境，只有复眠螺旋故事，为那些想要尽快面对奥金魇龙之怒的 Tenno 量身定做。 在探索双衍王境诡异的现实时，你会遇到：
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|复眠螺旋：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|双衍王境处于士魂大帝的复眠螺旋中，每个复眠螺旋的双衍王境居民都有自己的故事、独特的威胁和不断变化的环境。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|王令：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|在每一次双衍王境之旅中的漂泊者和战甲提供独一无二的增益效果。完成双衍王境中的任务可以在随机的增益效果中进行选择，使你能更加从容地应对双衍王境和地穴中的挑战。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|漂泊者近战：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|漂泊者已拿起近战武器奋起反抗。格挡即将到来的攻击，招架并快速打击敌人，或是用强力攻击打倒禁卫。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|地穴：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|地穴充斥着各种似曾相识的敌人，这个地方改写了双衍王境的法则，可以使用战甲作战。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|漂泊者内源之力：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|通过永久升级增强双衍王境内的漂泊者，增强战斗、骑术、机遇和韧性。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|绝灵骥：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|可自定义的坐骑，载着你穿越双衍王境的众多岛屿。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|支线活动：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| 有更多的方式体验双衍王境，包括全新敌人、奥金魇龙头目战斗、丰富的支线任务包括喉兽捕鱼、演奏三线琴、围棋，还有更多等你发现！

除了士魂大帝用意识构建的现实，《双衍悖论》更新还有更多内容。在《Warframe》游戏中普遍可用的全新灵化之源、赋能、装饰：

• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|灵化之源：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|为你的武器注入虚空之力，并解锁专属的升级。钢铁之路无尽回廊的大师们可以获得这些，为旧时最爱的武器注入新的力量。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|全新的近战武器：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|随着双衍王境而来的，漂泊者和战甲都可使用的五种全新近战武器！打倒奥金魇龙获得苦栓，并使用它们来解锁这些新武器和蓝图。
• |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|全新华丽外观及自定义：|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|社区艺术家的概念成为现实，Baruuk 铃僧和 Wisp 星梦组合包在此！在市场上找到可用白金购买的新漂泊者传识套服、漂泊者面部毛发和面部纹身墨水。 

双衍王境需要你，漂泊者。士魂大帝控制着复眠螺旋，而只有你能打破这个循环。每一个新的螺旋都是一个机会，发掘你所持有的力量，为双衍王境带来变化——赋予色彩。挑战士魂大帝，争取从这个无尽的循环中逃脱。

《双衍悖论》|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|向所有 Tenno 开放|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|，无论是 10 年老玩家还是刚刚起步的新手。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateChanges_Than.text:
Empyrean has arrived - your journey with your Railjack has just begun.

We're here to answer one simple question for you:
|OPEN_BOLD|"How do I play Empyrean?"|CLOSE_BOLD|

If you have completed the |OPEN_BOLD|RISING TIDE|CLOSE_BOLD| Quest, you are ready. If not - squad up with a Railjack-ready Tenno, or begin the Quest yourself.

Earth Proxima, Saturn Proxima, and Veil Proxima are destinations your Railjack can access with this Update. Things get harder the further from Earth you stray - prepare yourself and your squad. It will take time to master your Railjack.

Empyrean brings the foundations of a new progression system - INTRINSICS, as well as completely new Avionics, Gear, and Resources for you to earn and find. You and your crew will need to stay together to stay alive.

This is the beginning of Empyrean. |OPEN_BOLD|War is coming.|CLOSE_BOLD|
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateChanges_Than.zhText:
《九重天》已经到来 — 你与航道星舰的旅程才刚刚开始。

在这里我们为你回答一个简单的问题：
|OPEN_BOLD|"我该如何游玩《九重天》？" |CLOSE_BOLD|

如果你已经完成了|OPEN_BOLD|《澎湃狂潮》|CLOSE_BOLD|系列任务，那你就准备完毕了。如果还没 — 请与一位准备好航道星舰的 Tenno 一起组队，或者开始进行你的系列任务。

地球比邻星域、土星比邻星域，以及面纱比邻星域是此次更新后航道星舰可以访问的目的地。你离地球越远，挑战就越艰巨 — 和你的小队一起做好准备吧。掌控你的航道星舰需要花一些时间。

这是《九重天》的开始。|OPEN_BOLD|战争来了。|CLOSE_BOLD|
