/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateCitrine_Desc.zhText:
凝视我们的水晶卫士，第 52 款战甲 |OPEN_BOLD|CITRINE|CLOSE_BOLD|！她的水晶能在战场上支援盟友。战斗只会增强她的分形之美。

在火星上找到全新的|OPEN_BOLD|镜像防御|CLOSE_BOLD|任务，守护贝里克和拉尼娅的晶化遗骸，该节点在完成《惊惧之心》系列任务后即可开启。他们的爱维系着彼此间的联系，由虚空架起桥梁。访问 Tyana Pass 以保护他们免受两方的攻击——Corpus 和 Grineer。

在此更新中还有哪些值得期待？ 
• 使用 Citrine 标志性的重型镰刀|OPEN_BOLD|闪劫|CLOSE_BOLD|和霰弹枪|OPEN_BOLD|石晶之花|CLOSE_BOLD|，并以此扩展你的军械库。 
• |OPEN_BOLD|Rhino 报死虫外观！|CLOSE_BOLD|穿上 Rhino 最新的豪华外观成为死亡的预示，配有豪华动画套装和翅膀特殊配件。 
• |OPEN_BOLD|Revenant、Gara、Gyre 和 Yareli 4 个全新的战甲强化 Mod|CLOSE_BOLD|！ 
• 使用|OPEN_BOLD|面部纹身墨水|CLOSE_BOLD|给自己留下印记，这是属于漂泊者的全新高级定制！ 
• 在 Tyana Pass 节点获取|OPEN_BOLD| 5 种全新赋能|CLOSE_BOLD|，或从殁世幽都的奥塔处获得，以增强你的装备！ 
• |OPEN_BOLD|Ember 虚空之壳外观！|CLOSE_BOLD|使用在「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃之时创造的变形材料装饰 Ember，并使用樟子松树皮这种材料结构探索全新美学。
• |OPEN_BOLD|执刑官 Tau 融造源力石掉率变化！|CLOSE_BOLD|玩得越多，获得执刑官 Tau 融造源力石的机会就越大！ 

在此更新中还有更多内容等着你去发现！

|OPEN_BOLD|另外，奥塔恭候你的光临！|CLOSE_BOLD|

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateCitrine_Sign.text: Doomed lovers, connected forever. Citrine's last wish.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateCitrine_Sign.zhText: 命中注定的爱人，永世相连的缠绵。Citrine 的遗愿。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateCitrine_SubT.text: Two hearts, frozen in time, still beat as one.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateCitrine_SubT.zhText: 两颗心，被定格在时间里，却心心相应。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateKullervo_Des.text:
A new island has appeared just off the Duviri mainland, a prison to hold a guilt-ridden betrayer: |OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo|CLOSE_BOLD|. Enter |OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo's Hold|CLOSE_BOLD| to uncover his crimes for yourself and be tested against this formidable opponent.

The Seven Crimes of Kullervo offers that and much more:

• |OPEN_BOLD|Time-Limited Event|CLOSE_BOLD|: Dive into Kullervo's story by playing this time-limited event that shares its namesake with the new Duviri island Kullervo's Hold. Accessible via the Duviri region in the Star Chart, 5 Pathos Clamps is your entry price to a Lone Story version of the Sorrow Spiral destined to bring you head-on against Kullervo.
• |OPEN_BOLD|New Duviri Island|CLOSE_BOLD|: Continue the fight after the event by visiting |OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo's Hold|CLOSE_BOLD| in the Duviri landscape during the Anger, Sorrow, and Fear Spirals.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo's Archive|CLOSE_BOLD|: An addition to Acrithis wares! Defeating Kullervo will earn you Kullervo's Bane, which can be used to acquire Kullervo's Blueprints and his signature shotgun, the Rauta, from her wares.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Undercroft Expansion|CLOSE_BOLD|: The Undercroft's power is growing with a new tile! The Void has also brought a familiar Void character to Undercroft Exterminate missions.
• |OPEN_BOLD|New Decrees|CLOSE_BOLD|: Dominus Thrax has made numerous more Decrees, but has gotten wise to the Drifter's ways and included a few Spiteful Decrees with both positive and negative effects!

|OPEN_BOLD|Kaithe Racing|CLOSE_BOLD| returns, Side Objective Undercroft Portals are available, new puzzles to crack, and more await you in Duviri! Check out the official Update Notes for the full details.

The Seven Crimes of Kullervo also comes with cosmetics for across Duviri and the Origin System:

• |OPEN_BOLD|Gauss Kresnik Collection|CLOSE_BOLD|: Go full throttle with Gauss Kresnik. His fiery collection includes the Gauss Kresnik Skin, Bolide Syandana, and Acceltra Caduceus Skin.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Aethon Kaithe Collection|CLOSE_BOLD|: Give your Kaithe Gauss Kresnik's singeing style. This collection includes the Aethon Chamfron, Saddle, and Tail.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Kaithe Coronets|CLOSE_BOLD|: Embody the moods of Dominus Thrax with this new cosmetic for Kaithes. Equip a Coronet to let your steed express their emotions for all to see! The |OPEN_BOLD|Steed's Resolve Pack|CLOSE_BOLD|: Each Kaithe Coronet in the Steed's Resolve Pack reflects a Duviri Mood Spiral. Express your Kaithe's moods just as Dominus Thrax expresses himself through Duviri's ever-changing sky.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Orizu Suit Collection|CLOSE_BOLD|: A full-pressure suit inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateKullervo_Des.zhText:
在双衍王境大陆附近出现了一座新的岛屿，这是一座关押着一名负罪背叛者的监狱：|OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo|CLOSE_BOLD|。进入 |OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo 的牢房|CLOSE_BOLD|，亲自揭开他的罪行，并接受这名强大对手带来的考验。

《Kullervo 之七宗罪》包含了以上内容以及更多：

• |OPEN_BOLD|限时活动|CLOSE_BOLD|：通过参加与双衍王境新岛屿 Kullervo 的牢房同名的限时活动，深入了解 Kullervo 的故事。通过星图中的双衍王境导航，以 5 个苦栓作为入场费，进入悲伤复眠螺旋中的一个孤独纪事，将让你与 Kullervo 正面对决。
• |OPEN_BOLD|全新双衍王境岛屿|CLOSE_BOLD|：活动结束后，可在愤怒、恐惧和悲伤复眠螺旋期间在双衍王境开放世界中造访 |OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo 的牢房|CLOSE_BOLD|来继续战斗。
• |OPEN_BOLD|Kullervo 的档案|CLOSE_BOLD|：言录使的商品新增了一项！击败 Kullervo 将获得 Kullervo 的灾刃，可用于从她的商店中获取 Kullervo 的蓝图和他的标志性霰弹枪锐铁。
• |OPEN_BOLD|地穴扩展内容|CLOSE_BOLD|：地穴的力量因为新增的一个区域而不断壮大！虚空还为地穴的歼灭任务带来了一个熟悉的虚空角色。
• |OPEN_BOLD|全新王令|CLOSE_BOLD|：士魂大帝已经创造了更多的王令，但他已看穿了漂泊者的玩法，并加入了一些既有正面效果又有负面效果的恶意王令！

|OPEN_BOLD|绝灵骥比赛|CLOSE_BOLD|回归、支线目标地穴传送门已经开放、新的谜题等待你来解开，在双衍王境还有更多等你探索！查看官方更新说明以获取完整的详细信息。

《Kullervo 之七宗罪》也为整个双衍王境和始源星系带来了外观装饰：

• |OPEN_BOLD|Gauss 火神组合包|CLOSE_BOLD|：用 Gauss 火神全速前进。他那火一般的组合包内含 Gauss 火神外观、火流星披饰以及迅发电浆炮 双蛇外观。
• |OPEN_BOLD|神驱绝灵骥组合包|CLOSE_BOLD|：赋予你的绝灵骥如 Gauss 火神般的焦燃风格。该组合包内含神驱马盔、马鞍和马尾。
• |OPEN_BOLD|绝灵骥马冠|CLOSE_BOLD|：通过这种全新的绝灵骥外观装饰，体现出士魂大帝的心情。佩戴上马冠，让你的坐骑向所有人展示它的情绪！|OPEN_BOLD|坚定骏马组合包|CLOSE_BOLD|：坚定骏马组合包中每个绝灵骥马冠都反映了一个双衍王境的心情复眠螺旋。就像士魂大帝通过双衍王境千变万化的天空表达自己一样，来将你绝灵骥的心情表现出来。
• |OPEN_BOLD|纸鹤套服组合包|CLOSE_BOLD|：一款以千纸鹤为灵感的密闭服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateKullervo_Sub.text: |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|The Seven Crimes of Kullervo|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| are on display for all to see!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateKullervo_Sub.zhText: |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|《Kullervo 之七宗罪》|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|正在为所有人展示中！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateKullervo_Tit.text: Update 33.5: The Seven Crimes of Kullervo

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateLua_Desc.text:
The Kuva was poured, the lamps were lit, and the ritual of Continuity began.

The 51st Warframe, |OPEN_BOLD|VORUNA|CLOSE_BOLD|, is here! Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack, Dynar, Lycath, Raksh, and Ulfrun makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. 

Drusus recants the forlorn tale of Voruna's past in a new Leverian. The Void exposes old scars and revives forgotten secrets in 2 new |OPEN_BOLD|Conjunction Survival|CLOSE_BOLD| nodes on Lua, accessible to those who have completed The War Within. Experience the familiar Survival game mode with the aid of your Necramech and some spectral twists! A new tile with ties to Voruna is yours to uncover within these Conjunction Survivals.

What else can you expect in this Update?

• Enhance your Arsenal with Voruna's signature Axe, |OPEN_BOLD|Sarofang|CLOSE_BOLD|, and Sniper, |OPEN_BOLD|Perigale|CLOSE_BOLD|. 
• |OPEN_BOLD|Xaku Kagura Skin!|CLOSE_BOLD| The Void reimagines broken Orokin treasure for Xaku and Lotus Amaga. Complete the collection with Lohk's Embrace Ephemera and various pottery-inspired Decorations. 
• 4 New |OPEN_BOLD|Voidshell Skins|CLOSE_BOLD| for Grendel, Frost, Mag, and Voruna!
• |OPEN_BOLD|Tenet Weapon Additions!|CLOSE_BOLD| The Tenet Plinx and Tenet Ferrox join the fray.
• And more!

Lua's Prey also brings a few |OPEN_BOLD|Quality of Life|CLOSE_BOLD| changes:

• |OPEN_BOLD|Grendel Rework|CLOSE_BOLD| - The hungriest Warframe gets a refreshed kit.
• |OPEN_BOLD|Yareli Changes|CLOSE_BOLD| - Survivability is the aim, Yareli is her name.
• And so much more!

|OPEN_BOLD|Cross Platform Play is officially here!|CLOSE_BOLD| The team has reached the final milestone in the development of Cross Platform Play with the latest Updates/Hotfixes. With the launch of Lua's Prey Update, we now have Cross Platform Play officially live for all platforms!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/UpdateLua_Desc.zhText:
随着赤毒的倾倒，灯被点亮，延续仪式开始了。 

第 51 款战甲 |OPEN_BOLD|VORUNA|CLOSE_BOLD| 现已登场！四头野兽，同心一颗。Voruna 的忠诚狼群——戴拿、莱卡斯、亚克什，乌尔佛伦和是力量与隐秘的致命结合。 

Drusus 在全新的莱弗博物馆中重述了 Voruna 过去的悲惨故事。虚空在 2 个全新的|OPEN_BOLD|联结生存|CLOSE_BOLD|节点中揭露了来自过去的伤痕，并恢复了被遗忘的秘辛；已经完成了《内战》系列任务的玩家，可在月球访问这 2 个节点。在殁世机甲和幽灵般的扭曲存在的协助下，体验熟悉的生存游戏模式！从这些联结生存任务中，你将能够发现与 Voruna 有关的全新内容。 

此次更新中还有什么其他可供期待的内容？ 

• 通过 Voruna 的标志性战斧|OPEN_BOLD|沙罗之牙|CLOSE_BOLD|，和狙击枪|OPEN_BOLD|月面狂风|CLOSE_BOLD|来增强你的军械库。 
• |OPEN_BOLD|Xaku 神乐外观|CLOSE_BOLD|！虚空为 Xaku 和天女 Lotus 重塑了破碎的奥罗金珍宝。通过虚空之拥幻纹，以及各种灵感来自陶器的装饰品来完善你的收藏。 
• 4 款为 Grendel、Frost、Mag，和 Voruna 设计的全新|OPEN_BOLD|虚空之壳外观|CLOSE_BOLD|现已登场！ 
• |OPEN_BOLD|新增信条系列武器！|CLOSE_BOLD|信条·漫射者和信条·铁晶磁轨炮加入了战局。 
• 还有更多精彩内容！ 

《月之猎物》也带来了一系列|OPEN_BOLD|游戏体验|CLOSE_BOLD|改动： 

• |OPEN_BOLD|Grendel 重制|CLOSE_BOLD|——最饥饿的战甲获得了全新的配备。 
• |OPEN_BOLD|Yareli 改动|CLOSE_BOLD|——以 Yareli 之名，获得更强生存之力。 
• 以及更多精彩改动！ 

|OPEN_BOLD|跨平台游玩正式登场！|CLOSE_BOLD|通过最新的更新/热修，团队在跨平台游玩的开发中达到了另一个里程碑。随着《月之猎物》更新的推出，我们现在有一个适用于所有平台的跨平台游玩测试！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightCommunit.text: BET LATHUUM... I MEAN... LET RATHUUM BEGIN!
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightCommunit.zhText: 让死亡脚斗场……我意思是……让死亡角斗场开始吧！

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.text: Alright, so you got lucky. Big deal. BIG HAIRY DEAL. Take this. See you on the beach, squirt.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.zhText: 好的，所以你走运了。了不起。了非一般的起。拿好这个。海滩上见，屁孩。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.text: So, two for two. OK. But third time won't be the charm, squirt. The next time you hit the beach my Executioners are gonna hang you out to dry.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.zhText: 所以，两局两胜。好。但第三局就不会那么好运了，屁孩。下次你到海滩上时，我的行刑者们会把你变成腊肉来挂。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.text: OK, so I've been all friendly-like. Goin' easy on ya. But this has gone on long enough. Final round, squirt. FINAL ROUND. Come an' get it.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.zhText: 好吧，我一直以来都实在太友善了。对你那么优待。不过够了。最后一局，屁孩。最、后、一、局。尝尝这个。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.text: I guess I gotta hand it to ya. You really hosed my crew. Well done, I guess. But jus' remember: they're gonna fix this gas leak at some point and when they do... WHEN THEY DO... it's back to business, buddy. NO MORE MRS NICE ME. Carry on.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WaterFightRewardMs.zhText: 我想我得把这东西给你了。没想到你真的摆平了我的手下。或许我应该说，干得漂亮。不过，你要记住：他们终究会解决燃料泄漏的问题，而当他们……当、他们、搞定之后……一切都会恢复正常，朋友。到了那时，我就不会给你们好脸色看了。继续努力吧。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WolfTacAlertBody.text:
Dreamer, you're shining all over that bad moon like you were the new day's sun. Shining so bright, I bet you got that Wolf wishin' he was back down in Saturn Six.

But I'll keep watching, 'cause the Wolf's still howling, and I can tell you're about to lay down some hard grooves.

Here's a little something to keep you moving. Courtesy of Nightwave.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WolfTacAlertBody.zhText:
梦回者，你像新升之阳一样照耀着月亮，闪耀着如此明亮的光芒。我敢说你把那只恶狼揍得他开始怀念起在土星六号监狱的时光了。

但是我会继续观察，因为那只恶狼还在嚎叫，并且我也看出来了你已经准备好教训他。

这是一些激励你的小玩意。来自午夜电波的恩惠。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WolfTacAlertHardBo.text:
You hear that, Dreamer? Silence. No Wolf, no howl. And no doubt in my mind that it's all thanks to you.

Nora knows nothing ever stays quiet, so here's a little something for when the silence breaks.

Until next time, keep your ear to the Nightwave, Dreamer.
/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WolfTacAlertHardBo.zhText:
你听到了吗，梦回者？寂静。没有那只狼的踪迹，也没有嚎叫声。毫无疑问，在我心中，这一切都要归功于你。

诺拉知道没有什么是永恒沉寂的，这是因为你打破沉寂而送你的一点小玩意。

期待下次与你会面，注意收听午夜电波，梦回者。

/Lotus/Language/Inbox/WolfTacAlertHardTi.text: THE WOLF OF SATURN SIX: Hear that?

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.zhText: 悬匿兽回声诱饵

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: Entice and attract nearby Predasite with life-like animal calls.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的扑猎达赛。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: Predasite Echo-Lure
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.zhText: 扑猎达赛回声诱饵

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: Entice and attract nearby Undazoa with life-like animal calls.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的水螅履虫。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: Undazoa Echo-Lure
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.zhText: 水螅履虫回声诱饵

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Vulpaphyla.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种狐帕菲拉稀有亚种的几率。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: VULPAPHYLA PHEROMONE GLAND
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.zhText: 狐帕菲拉费洛蒙腺体

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Cryptilex.

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: CRYPTILEX PHEROMONE GLAND

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Anim.text: NEXIFERA PHEROMONE GLAND

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Ashe.text: Carnis are many-legged hunters, ferocious and ever-hungry. They scuttle just out of reach trying to wear down their prey with ranged attacks until they can rush in to consume it.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Ashe.zhText: 肉碾虫是凶猛且饥渴的多腿猎手。它们疾速与目标拉开距离，并试图通过远程攻击来拖垮它们的猎物，直到它们能冲上去享用美餐。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Ashe.text: The Carnis Rex is a true terror, a monstrously-large Carnis. The Carnis Rex rushes headlong upon their prey, often coiling into a spinning wheel in its haste to come to grips.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Ashe.zhText: 肉碾王虫是一种真正的恐怖，一种巨型肉碾虫。肉碾王虫会迅猛扑向它们的猎物，常常迅速缠绕上去并翻滚旋转，以此来对付它们的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.zhText: 从消灭的感染者身上收集肉块
将坩埚的生命值保持在 |RATIO|% 以上

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.text: KILL INFESTED CLOSE TO THE CAULDRON TO INFUSE IT
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.zhText: 击杀坩埚附近的感染者来注入

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.text: This early-developing organ dissolves skeletal systems when converting the original life form to Infested, and later assists digestion.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.zhText: 在将原始生命形态转化为感染者时，这种早期发育的器官会溶解骨骼系统，之后会协助消化。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.text: Reinfuse or break the Infested Cauldron
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.zhText: 重新注入或破坏感染坩锅

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.text: A vessel used to concoct bait for luring infested out of hiding.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Assa.zhText: 一个用来调制诱饵的容器，调制的诱饵用来引出躲藏的感染者。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Bone.text: A writhing tower of flesh and gristle, the Jugulus lurks beneath the surface and emerges to launch streams of organic projectiles from its wide maw.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Bone.zhText: 一只由肉体和软骨构成且会扭动的塔形生物，喉骨刃者潜伏在地表之下，伺机现身来从它的大嘴里发射出一连串有机弹丸。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Camb.text: Progress through Star Chart to start this quest
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Camb.zhText: 解锁星图进度来开始这个系列任务

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Catb.text: <WARNING> Select a weakened Vulpaphyla, antigen and mutagen to revive a Vulpaphyla Companion <WARNING>
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Catb.zhText: <WARNING>选择一个虚弱的狐帕菲拉、一个抗原和一个突变原来治愈一个狐帕菲拉同伴<WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Chal.text: Kill 5 Juggernauts in the Deimos Landscape
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Chal.zhText: 在火卫二地形中击杀 5 只巨兽
从触突蕨叶中收集 50 个神经节囊。
骑乘 20 只野生迅敏节虫

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Cham.text: Create Door Bait to open the Tunnel Door
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Cham.zhText: 制造地道门诱饵以打开地道门
在充满剧毒的地道中生存

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Clea.text: Two more Vaults remain. Find and clear them before Fass rises for even greater rewards!
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Clea.zhText: 还剩下两个隔离库。在"混乱"升起之前找到并清除它们，以获取更丰厚的奖励！

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Clea.text: One more Vault remains. Find and clear it before Fass rises for the rarest rewards!
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Clea.zhText: 还剩下一个隔离库。在"混乱"升起之前找到并清除它，以获得最稀有的奖励！

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Cons.text: A symbol of your dedication to the safety of all creatures on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Cons.zhText: 象征对火卫二上所有物种安全的奉献精神。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Corp.text: PROTECT LATROX UNE WHILE THE DATA IS UPLOADED
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Corp.zhText: 在数据上传时保护拉托罗·恩

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Craf.text: Revive this Vulpaphyla Companion? Selected parts will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Craf.zhText: 是否治愈这个狐帕菲拉同伴？被选中的部件将被消耗。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Craf.text: Revive this Predasite Companion? Selected parts will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Craf.zhText: 是否治愈这个扑猎达赛同伴？被选中的部件将被消耗。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Saxum Rex are larger, meaner Saxum and represent a considerably enhanced threat. How they achieve this evolution is unknown, but cannibalism is suspected.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 重岩王者是体型更大、更凶猛的重岩者，是一种相当大的威胁。现在尚未清楚它们是如何实现这种进化的，但有可能是通过同类相食。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: We are trying to regain a foothold out in Deimos. There are old bases lost to the Infestation that we need to reclaim.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 我们正试图重夺火卫二上的据点。我们需要夺回一些被感染者占据的旧基地。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: A powerful Infested entity has been terrorizing teams out in Deimos. Find it, and deal with it.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 一个强大的感染者生物吓到了火卫二上的队伍。找到它，并消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Help a stranded Corpus agent with his mission to bring Infested samples to the Entrati for science!...or Profit?
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 帮助一个受困的 Corpus 特工完成他的任务，也就是将感染者样本带给英择谛来进行科研！……或是用来盈利？

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
The Infested can't be endless, can they? They must stop returning after we kill enough... right?

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
感染者的数量不可能是无穷无尽的，对吗？如果我们杀得足够多的话后面就没有了……对吗？

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
There are resources for the taking just beneath 'skin' of the Infestation covering Deimos. Dig for victory!

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
覆盖火卫二的感染者"表皮"之下有着任君取用的资源。挖掘就是胜利！

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Deimos artifacts are always in demand. Bring back as many as you can!

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
火卫二的古物总是供不应求。能带回来多少就带回来多少！

在完成无尽赏金任务的一个回合以后，下回合中的每个阶段都会奖励 +15% 额外数量的<MOTHER_TOKEN>"母亲"石印。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Search Deimos for valuable geological core samples.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 探索火卫二来获取有价值的地质核心样本。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: A squad of Grineer soldiers stranded on Deimos have activated their SOS beacon. Track them down and see what you can do to help.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 一队被困在火卫二上的 Grineer 士兵启动了他们的求救信标。追踪他们，来看看你能提供什么帮助。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Many resource caches lie abandoned and unclaimed on Deimos, find them and they are yours.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 许多资源储藏箱遗落在火卫二并且无人问津，找到它们，它们就是你的。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Hunt down anomalous samples in the Deimos biome.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 在火卫二生物群落区寻找异常样本。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Daughter is in charge of securing nutrition for the family. Help with her foraging expedition.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 女儿负责保障一家人的营养健康。帮助她完成觅食探险。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: The Infested are destroying the Entrati heritage. Clear them out before they do more harm
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 感染者正在摧毁英择谛的遗产。在它们造成更多破坏之前把他们干掉。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Odd fissures are appearing in the Deimos underground. Go back into the ruins. Find and close these anomalies
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 火卫二地下出现了奇怪的裂缝。回到废墟中，找到并封闭这些异常点。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: As if the Infested in the Ruins weren't enough. Now all manner of disgusting... things are growing down there. It's time we cleaned house!
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 好像废墟里的感染者还不够多似的。现在各种恶心的…… 东西在下面越来越多。是时候该来一次大扫除了！

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: The Infested we are encountering around the old Vaults seem... different. Delve into the ruins and engage with infested so we may conduct research
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 我们在旧隔离库周围遇到的感染者似乎…… 不太一样。潜入废墟，与感染者交战，这样我们就可以进行研究。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Explore an Isolation Vault.
While in the Cambion Drift:
Clear 1 Vault to access new Bounties.
Clear 3 Vaults for the rarest rewards!
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
探索一个隔离库。
当身处魔胎之境中时：
清理 1 个隔离库来解锁新的赏金任务。
清理 3 个隔离库来获得最稀有的奖励！

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Many Deimos fish secrete reagents in a pouchlike organ, creating volatile gases that enable limited periods of levitation. 

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Cryptosuctus
Barbisteo
Kymaeros
Amniophysi
Glutinox
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
许多火卫二的鱼类会在类似囊状的器官中分泌液体来产生挥发性气体，从而实现短暂的悬浮。

来源：通过在殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
墓沼隐龙
倒刺蒂鳌
高额异鳍
针刺长鳄
狍鸮胶蛳

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Adaptive membranes allow many Deimos fish to move freely between fluid and gaseous environments.

Source: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos):
Ostimyr
Aquapulmo
Vitreospina
Myxostomata
Duroid
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
自适应膜可使许多火卫二的鱼类在液体和气体环境之间自由移动。

来源：在殁世幽都（火卫二）中的"女儿"处分解以下魔胎之境的鱼类获得：
奥斯蒂剑鱼
水肺
璃化脊鳎
独角米索鳎
韧铠灵鲷

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
The Infestation infects all fish on Deimos, even those that do not show any external mutations.

Source: Cut from all Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
异变感染体感染了火卫二上的所有鱼类，连那些看起来没有任何变异的鱼也感染了。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从魔胎之境鱼类中切割获取。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: Cannot invite players to squad until the Heart of Deimos quest has been completed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 在《惊惧之心》系列任务完成前，无法邀请玩家加入小队。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text: This squad cannot be joined until the Heart of Deimos quest has been completed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText: 在《惊惧之心》系列任务完成前不能加入这个小队。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
The Infestation provokes the growth of multiple, seemingly redundant brain-like clusters, whose function may be linked to hivemind activity. 

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Cryptosuctus fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Cryptosuctus on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Rolizor Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
感染导致了多个看似多余，且类似大脑的簇状物的生长，其功能可能与巢群活动有关。 

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从水肺和墓沼隐龙中切割获取。 可在"秩序"期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺、在"混乱"期间的魔胎之境地面上捕捉墓沼隐龙。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和偌利佐尔感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Elements of other lifeforms are detectable in Infested body parts, such as this apparently parasitic clump of land-dwelling animal tissue.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Barbisteo fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch both Vitreospina and Barbisteo in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass. Also drops from Spitia Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
在 Infested 的身体部位中可以检测到其他生命形态的组成元素，例如这种明显属于陆地动物的寄生组织。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌中切割获取。 可在"秩序"和"混乱"期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎和倒刺蒂鳌。此外它还会从魔胎之境的斯蒂亚感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Environmental contamination is co-responsible for mutations, alongside Infested cellular alteration.

Source: Cut from Ostimyr and Kymaeros fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Ostimyr in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Fass, and Kymaeros on the Cambion Drift surface during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
环境污染与 Infested 细胞变化，这两个都是引起突变的原因。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从奥斯蒂剑鱼和高额异鳍中切割获取。 可在"混乱"期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉奥斯蒂剑鱼、在"混乱"和"秩序"期间的魔胎之境地面捕捉高额异鳍。此外它还会从魔胎之境的感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Remnants of creatures' original bodily fluids persist post-Infestation, often crystalized or congealed into entirely new compounds.

Source: Cut from Amniophysi fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Amniophysi in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
生物原有的体液残余物在感染后仍会存在，通常会结晶或凝结成全新的化合物。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从针刺长鳄中切割获取。 可在"混乱"和"秩序"期间的魔胎之境洞穴捕捉针刺长鳄。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
These pressurized repositories of Infested spores require careful extraction or explosive rupture and local contamination may occur.

Source: Cut from Glutinox fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Glutinox on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
这些存有感染孢子的加压储存囊需要被小心提取，否则就会炸裂并且可能造成局部污染。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从狍鸮胶蛳中切割获取。可在"秩序"期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉狍鸮胶蛳。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和感染包囊掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
The organs that once served as eyes, prior to Infestation, are still replete with useful components.

Source: Cut from Flagellocanth fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots using Processed Fass Residue during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
这件在感染前曾经作为眼睛的器官仍包含有用的成分。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从须腔棘鱼中切割获取。 可在"秩序"和"混乱"期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中使用处理过的"混乱"残留物捕捉须腔棘鱼。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Used to latch on to other life forms for feeding purposes, and to inject them with anticoagulants and sporelets.

Source: Cut from Lobotriscid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Lobotriscid on the Cambion Drift surface during Vome.  Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
用于附在其他生命体上以供养分，并把抗凝剂和孢子注入其中。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从额叶鲤中切割获取。 可在"秩序"期间的魔胎之境地面中捕捉额叶鲤。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Loyal servants of the great and glorious Orokin Empire: 

You are hereby commanded to honor your oath and render assistance without delay.
We await your arrival upon this, the most cursed moon of Deimos.
Your Star Chart shows the way.

I am Loid, Cephalon servant to House Entrati.

(Please bring guns.)
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
伟大而光荣的奥罗金帝国的忠仆们：

你们受命履行誓言，并提供协助，不要耽延。
我们恭候你来到火卫二，这颗最受诅咒的卫星。
你的星图会指明方向。

我是洛德，英择谛家族的中枢仆人。

(请带好武器。)

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Sifting the glutinous Exocrine is an essential part of the survival process, and a reminder of the creature's original function.

Source: Cut from Aquapulmo and Duroid fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Aquapulmo in Cambion Drift surface hotspots during Vome, and Duroid in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks and Auroron Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
筛分粘性的外分泌物是生存过程中必不可少的一部分，也是对生物原有功能的一种提醒。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从水肺和韧铠灵鲷中切割获取。 可在"秩序"期间的魔胎之境地面鱼点中捕捉水肺，在"混乱"和"秩序"期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉韧铠灵鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑和幻金英择谛罐掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Many delicate and complex nerve fibers are housed in the jointed vertebrae, which are one of the creature's most resilient parts. Found from Vitreospina fish known to eke out a primitive existence in cave systems.

Source: Cut from Vitreospina and Chondricord fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Vitreospina in Cambion Drift caves during Fass and Vome, and Chondricord in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome. Also drops from Isolation Vault Bounties and Sagiant Entrati Caskets in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
许多精巧而复杂的神经纤维被安置在有关节的脊椎骨中，这地方是生物最坚韧的部分之一。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从璃化脊鳎和骨锥琼鲷中切割获取。 可在"混乱"和"秩序"期间的魔胎之境洞穴中捕捉璃化脊鳎，在"混乱"和"秩序"期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中捕捉骨锥琼鲷。此外它还会从魔胎之境的隔离库赏金和智者英择谛罐掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.text:
Beneath the membranous protein layers can be found a secondary 'skull'; flexible, tough and highly conductive.

Source: Cut from Myxostomata fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots using Processed Vome Residue during Vome. Also drops from Requiem Obelisks in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Deim.zhText:
在膜状蛋白层的下面，可以发现一个具有弹性、坚韧、且有着高导电性的次要"颅骨"。

获取途径：通过殁世幽都（火卫二）的"女儿"从独角米索鳎中切割获取。 可在"秩序"期间的魔胎之境洞穴鱼点中使用处理过的"秩序"残留物捕捉独角米索鳎。此外它还会从魔胎之境的安魂方尖碑掉落。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Depl.text: Marooned Corpus researcher, unwilling resident on Deimos and ally-of-circumstance to the Entrati. Happy to see a non-Infested face.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Depl.zhText: 陷入困境而只能定居在火卫二的 Corpus 研究员，受制于环境成为英择谛的盟友。对于看到一张不属于感染者的面孔感到很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Door.zhText: 通过 <SECONDARY_FIRE> 将诱饵扔向地道门

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Dyna.zhText: 加弗的 Grineer 杀戮小队
损失不超过 2 个发射器

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Dyna.text: ELIMINATE THE SOURCE OF THE MIST
With the ability to track a scent from miles away, this Juggernaut is an invaluable ally when foraging rare Polyps from the ruins of Deimos
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Dyna.zhText: 这只巨兽能够追踪远处的气味，在火卫二废墟中寻找罕见的息肉时，它是一位宝贵的友军。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Dyna.text: INVESTIGATE THE SOURCE OF THE MIST

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Endl.text: +5% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens with each stage completed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Endl.zhText: 每个完成的阶段有 +5% 额外的<MOTHER_TOKEN> "母亲"石印。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text:
Otak is grateful for your aid. This helps him to remember it.

Obtained from Otak in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText:
奥塔十分感激你的帮助。这将有助于他牢记这点。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）奥塔处获得。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text:
A mark of Son's respect for services rendered.

Obtained from Son in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText:
一枚印记，象征"儿子"对于所受到的帮助，表示的敬意。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）"儿子"处获得。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text:
A token of Daughter's gratitude.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText:
一枚印记，象征着"女儿"的感激。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）"女儿"处获得。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text:
A rare sign of Grandmother's favor.

Obtained from Grandmother in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText:
一枚罕见的印记，代表着"祖母"的厚爱。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）"祖母"处获得。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text:
A symbol of Father's trust and confidence.

Obtained from Father in the Necralisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText:
一枚印记，代表着"父亲"的信任与信赖。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）"父亲"处获得。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text:
A mark of Mother's esteem.

Obtained by completing Bounties in the Cambion Drift on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText:
一枚印记，代表着"母亲"的敬重。

从殁世幽都（火卫二）"母亲"处获得。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: Heirs to the legacy of Albrecht Entrati, his powerful Orokin family encountered disaster, isolation and bitter division on Deimos. The arrival of the Tenno, beneficiaries of their Void research, may bring fresh hope - and a deeper understanding of the world that has trapped their family.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 他们是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的继承人，这个强大的奥罗金家族在火卫二上遭遇了沉重的灾难、孤离和痛苦的分裂。而虚空研究的受益者，Tenno 的到来，或许会给这些可怜的人们带来新的希望；以及进一步探索这个困住了他们的诡秘世界。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: Mother does not regret her decision.
You have proven to be good and faithful. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 你证明了自己是善良且忠诚的。非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: We had no right to expect such help from... the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 我们无法奢望能从……Tenno 那里获得这样的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: You have been the salvation of this Family.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 你一直都是这个家族的救星。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: RETURN TO THE SURFACE OR CRACK THE VAULT
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 回到地面或者破解隔离库

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: Loid and Otak were not protected
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 洛德和奥塔未受到保护

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: Activate the Reactive Crystal at the Vault
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 激活在隔离库的反应水晶

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.text: Activate Runes in the correct sequence
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Entr.zhText: 用正确的顺序来激活符文
保持毒性水平在 100% 以下

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Esco.zhText: 将巨兽的生命值保持在 50% 以上
将巨兽的生命值保持在 50% 以上
将巨兽的生命值保持在 50% 以上
收集被部分消化的孢子

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Exit.text: Are you sure you want to leave the Necralisk?
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Exit.zhText: 你确定要离开殁世幽都吗？

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: These fish were purposefully contaminated with the Infestation as an Entrati 'experiment'. They feed off the organic deposits in cave systems.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 这些鱼作为英择谛的 "实验"，有目的性地接受感染者感染。它们以洞穴系统中的有机沉积物为食。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: Crammed with redundant, mutated internal organs, this pungent fish mingles Orokin and Infested ancestry. It is confined to the Exocrine and is only active by the light of the Wyrm Fass.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 体内挤满了多余的、变异的内脏，这种刺鼻的鱼类混有奥罗金和感染者的血统。其活动区域仅限于外分泌液，并且只有在蛟龙"混乱"的光照下才会在出现。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: Whatever higher functions this fish once had have been consumed, leaving it a mere automaton of metal and flesh. It ekes out a primitive existence in cave systems.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 无论这种鱼类曾经有什么更高等的功能，都已经被消耗掉了。只剩下自动化的金属和肉体。它在洞穴系统中勉强维持着原始的习性。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: Formerly Orokin scavengers, these fish succumbed to the Infestation long ago and now greedily feast on floating spores. They are found all over the surface of Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 这些鱼类以前是奥罗金时代的清道夫，很久以前就屈从感染者了；现在贪婪地吃着漂浮的孢子。它们在火卫二的地表随处可见。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: As ravenous as the Infestation itself, this fish feeds on the remains of others. It shuns the light, preferring an enclosed cave environment.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 就像感染者本身一样贪婪，这种鱼类以其他同类的残骸为食。它总是避开光线，喜欢封闭的洞穴环境。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: The Infestation has suborned these fish to its own purposes, using them as antibodies to repel the non-Infested. They swim through and above the Exocrine found on Deimos’ surface.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 感染者唆使这些鱼类达成自己的目的，把它们当作抗体来对抗非感染者。它们游走于火卫二地表上的内分泌液内和其上方。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: These fish hatch out of translucent pods formed in caverns below the Infested landscape. They hover to feed.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 这些鱼类从感染地表下形成的半透明卵囊中孵化出来。它们悬游进食。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: A muscular, three-tailed fish, the Lobotriscid trawls through Exocrine vapor across the surface of Deimos when Vome is dominant.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 这是一种肌肉发达的三尾鱼，当"秩序"在天空中占主导地位时，三尾额叶鲤会通过外分泌雾化膜在火卫二的地面拖网捕食。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: These specimens were originally parasites, breeding inside the wyrm-guts of Fass and scattered across Deimos in the debris of his explosive demise. They are drawn to his light.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 这些标本原本是寄生虫，在"混乱"的龙胆内繁殖，并随着其死亡喷射出的爆炸性残骸四散在了火卫二上。它们像飞蛾扑火般被"混乱"的光芒吸引着。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: These hefty fish are cannibalistic. They rise by Vome's light to absorb rare gases, retreating when Fass ascends to devour their smaller kin in their lairs.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 这些沉重的鱼类有自相残杀的习性。它们在"秩序"的光照下出现，吸收稀有气体，当"混乱"升起时撤回，吞噬它们巢穴中相对幼小的同族。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: This exceptionally rare breed of fish is almost extinct, as its gilded Orokin flesh has a special savor for predators. It warily conceals itself in caves.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 这种异常罕见的鱼种几乎要绝迹了，它那镀金的奥罗金鱼肉对掠食者来说有别具一格的味道。它小心翼翼地躲在洞穴里。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: A living fossil hearkening back to the Orokin era, this elusive fish hides below the surface of Exocrine pools in the deepest caverns it can find. Unlike Infested fish breeds, it has no ability to hover.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 一种可以追溯到奥罗金时代的活化石，这种神出鬼没的鱼类隐藏在洞穴最深处的外分泌液表面之下。不像其它感染者鱼类，它无法进行悬游。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.text: A triumph of Orokin bio-engineering, these hardy fish have adapted to the Deimos environment and seem oddly resistant to Infestation. They thrive in cave environments.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Fish.zhText: 一项奥罗金生物工程技术的胜利，这些坚毅的鱼类已经适应了火卫二的环境，并且似乎对感染者有着奇怪的抵抗力。它们在洞穴环境中茁壮成长。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Flui.zhText: 使用不超过 |TOTAL| 个液囊（|COUNT|/|TOTAL|）

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Flui.text: Collect the sac from the device
Device that will segregate a sac filled with a strange liquid
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Flui.zhText: 这个装置可以隔离装有奇怪液体的液囊。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Flui.text: Throw the fluid sac at the infested <SECONDARY_FIRE>

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Gene.text: They're the squeezy little fellas from the Cambion Drift! Take them home today!
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Gene.zhText: 来自魔胎之境的抱抱小家伙！今天就把它们带回家吧！

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Gene.text: This beast is too wounded to fight off the effects of the Infestation without intervention.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Gene.zhText: 这只野兽的伤势太重，不干预就无法抵御感染的影响。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Grin.zhText: 比 Grineer 的击杀数多出一倍

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Grin.text: Kill more Infested than the Grineer
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Grin.zhText: 比 Grineer 击杀更多的感染者

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Grin.text: Speak to Garv, the Grineer Leader
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Grin.zhText: 与 Grineer 领队加弗对话

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hear.text:
<MINI_ARROW> Reach Cambion Drift on Deimos
<MINI_ARROW> Earth: Mars Junction
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hear.zhText:
<MINI_ARROW> 抵达火卫二的魔胎之境
<MINI_ARROW> 地球：火星接合点

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.text: VIEW ENTRATI FAMILY STANDING, ACCEPT BOUNTIES
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.zhText: 查看英择谛家族声望、接受赏金任务

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.text: PURCHASE FISHING GEAR, TRADE/DISSECT DEIMOS FISH
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.zhText: 购买渔具，交易/解剖火卫二鱼类

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.text: VIEW NECRALOID STANDING, PURCHASE NECRAMECH BLUEPRINTS
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.zhText: 浏览殁世械灵的声望，购买殁世机甲蓝图
兑换石印、改善家族关系
用石印来换取英择谛声望

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.text: Grandmother's proof that you have aided various members of her Family.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Hive.zhText: 来自"祖母"的见证，证明你曾为她家族的不同成员提供了帮助。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: Genetrix act as mobile wombs for the Infested hordes, discharging swarms of Infested whenever they detect a non-Infested intruder. A Genetrix prominent sensor stalk must be disabled or avoided to stem a seemingly unending tide of monsters.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 母艇作为感染者大军的移动巢穴，每当其探测到非感染者的入侵者时，便会释放出成群的感染者。只有避开母艇上突出的感应柄或让其失效，才能阻止这看似永无止境的怪物浪潮。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Attunes the Infestation with this Vulpaphyla to the Madurai polarity.

Side Effects: Tumorous Jaw Growth
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
将狐帕菲拉体内的感染调理为 Madurai 极性。

副作用：下颌会像肿瘤般增生

Side Effects: None observed
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
将狐帕菲拉体内的感染调理为 Vazarin 极性。

副作用：尚未发现

Side Effects: Scaled Mane
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
将狐帕菲拉体内的感染调理为 Naramon 极性。

副作用：类似鳞片的鬃毛

将狐帕菲拉体内的感染调理为 Penjaga 极性。

副作用：会造成肩部突出

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: An evasive Vulpaphyla that prefers to run away from fights. Its skills are so profound it can even impart them to their master.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 狐帕菲拉性格狡猾，喜欢逃避战斗。其技巧高超到足以传授给主人。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Adapts the Vulpaphyla to grant resistance to <DT_FIRE>Heat and <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage.

Side Effects: None observed
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整狐帕菲拉的适应性，以获得 <DT_FIRE>火焰和 <DT_PUNCTURE>穿刺伤害抗性。

副作用：尚未发现

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:

Side Effects: Tail manifests a chitinous shell
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整狐帕菲拉的适应性，获得 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击和 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害抗性。

副作用：尾部出现甲壳质外壳

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Adapts the Vulpaphyla to grant resistance to <DT_FREEZE>Cold and <DT_IMPACT>Impact Damage.

Side Effects: Tail mutates into a tentacle mass
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整狐帕菲拉的适应性，获得 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻和 <DT_IMPACT>冲击伤害抗性。

副作用：尾部变异成一团触手

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Adapts the Vulpaphyla to grant resistance to <DT_POISON>Toxin and <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage.

Side Effects: Tail skin recedes leaving exposed flesh
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整狐帕菲拉的适应性，获得 <DT_POISON>毒素和 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害抗性。

副作用：尾部出现皮肤萎缩，导致露出血肉

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
This hardy creature has a collagenous dermis that acts as a thick, protective armor.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
这种强壮的生物有一层厚实的胶原皮层，来充当保护性护甲。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Tactically infectious, this Vulpaphyla weakens enemies to future attacks by inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Status Effects.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
从战术上来说，这种狐帕菲拉具有传染性，它通过造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒异常状态来削弱敌人，为后续攻击创造优势。

仅在"混乱"期间的魔胎之境出现。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: Saxum are bipedal, medium-sized assailants capable of short-ranged attacks and a powerful ground slam in melee.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 重岩者是双足、中等体型的攻击者，可以用近战武器进行短距离的攻击和强大的震地攻击。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Tenno,

I have something new for you to pick up the next time you're visiting Deimos. A Helminth Invigoration Segment. Install it, and you might notice your voracious wet-nurse has developed a new set of quirks.

You needn't worry. This is normal.

The Helminth will begin to secrete serums that are uniquely compatible with various Warframes. These will amplify the capabilities of said Warframes to an admirable degree. New serums will be secreted approximately once per week, and effects will last for seven days.

And do please remember to keep any Kavats well out of Helminth's reach.

Cordially,
Kermerros Entrati
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
Tenno，

我这有新玩意，供你在下次来访火卫二时取用。一个 Helminth 活化模块。安装它，你可能会注意到你那胃口贪婪的奶妈已经养成了一套新的怪癖。

你无需多虑。这是正常现象。

Helminth 将开始分泌与各种特定战甲相容的血清。这些血清会把这些战甲的能力放大到令人赞赏的程度。新的血清差不多每周分泌一次，效果将持续七天。

请一定要记住，不要让任意一只库娃触及到 Helminth。

诚挚的,
克梅罗斯·英择谛

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: Your Helminth And You: An Invigorating Journey
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 你的 Helminth 与你：活化之旅

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: A sluggish highlands insect that’s capable of bursts of speed when threatened.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 一种行动迟缓的高原昆虫，在受到威胁时可以爆发出惊人的速度。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: The fastest variety of Velocipod, it tends to favor the swamplands.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 迅敏节虫速度最快的品种，它们往往偏爱沼泽地。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: This large arthropod is generally found flying around Deimos’ several grottos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 这种大型节肢动物通常被发现飞行于火卫二的几个洞穴中。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: The most abundant variety of Cryptilex, this aggressive insect will slash anything it deems a threat.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 数量最庞大的隐疾虫变种，这种虫的攻击性会让它斩断任何它认为有威胁的东西。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: The most dangerous Cryptilex. They have glands in their abdomens that can emit an acidic spray.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 最危险的隐疾虫。它们的腹部有可以喷出酸雾的腺体。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: This infectious insect is capable of hazardous viral attacks when alerted.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 这种虫的传染性可以让它在警觉时进行危险的病毒攻击。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: A prehistoric bird-like creature that often congregates in small groups.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 一种经常小群聚集的史前类鸟生物。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
The rarest of Avichaeas, the Viscid produces a thick, tar-like mucus that it discharges when imperiled.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
最罕见的古羽鸟，在受到威胁时会产生并放出一种类似焦油的浓稠粘液。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
This capricious avian unleashes swarms of infested spores as its primary defense mechanism.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
这种反复无常的鸟类可以释放出成群的感染孢子，作为其主要的防御机制。

只有在"秩序"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: Rare Maggots that thrive in the toxic mist of infested fissures deep in the ruins of Deimos
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 火卫二废墟中的稀有蛆虫，生长在的感染裂缝深处的毒雾中。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Attunes the Infestation with this Predasite to the Madurai polarity.

Side Effects: Infestation grows through the horn
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
将扑猎达赛体内的感染调理为 Madurai 极性。

副作用：感染会通过犄角生长

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Attunes the Infestation with this Predasite to the Vazarin polarity.

Side Effects: None observed
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
将扑猎达赛体内的感染调理为 Vazarin 极性。

副作用：尚未发现

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Attunes the Infestation with this Predasite to the Naramon polarity.

Side Effects: Infestation grows through the jaw
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
将扑猎达赛体内的感染调理为 Naramon 极性。

副作用：感染会通过下颚生长

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Attunes the Infestation with this Predasite to the Penjaga polarity.

Side Effects: Infestation grows through the spine
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
将扑猎达赛体内的感染调理为 Penjaga 极性。

副作用：感染会通过脊椎生长

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: Unlike most of the highly aggressive life on Deimos, the Vizier Predasite prefers to avoid direct conflict and will instead disable foes from afar. A pack creature, it sheds restorative spores to aid those it considers kin.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 与火卫二上大多数极具攻击性的生物不同，宰相扑猎达赛更喜欢避免正面交战，而是从远处击退敌人。作为群居生物，它会释放治愈孢子来帮助那些它认为是同伴的个体。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Adapts the Predasite to grant resistance to <DT_FIRE>Heat and <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage.

Side Effects: None observed
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整扑猎达赛的适应性，以获得 <DT_FIRE>火焰和 <DT_PUNCTURE>穿刺伤害抗性。

副作用：尚未发现

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Adapts the Predasite to grant resistance to <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity and <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage.

Side Effects: Tail grows rigid scales
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整扑猎达赛的适应性，以获得 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击和 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害抗性。 

副作用：尾部会长出坚硬的鳞片

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Adapts the Predasite to grant resistance to <DT_FREEZE>Cold and <DT_IMPACT>Impact Damage.

Side Effects: Infestation grows through the tail
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整扑猎达赛的适应性，获得 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻和 <DT_IMPACT>冲击伤害抗性。

副作用：感染会通过尾部生长

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text:
Adapts the Predasite to grant resistance to <DT_POISON>Toxin and <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage.

Side Effects: Cartilage exoskeleton
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText:
调整扑猎达赛的适应性，获得 <DT_POISON>毒素和 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害抗性。

副作用：外骨骼软化

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: A strong and highly aggressive subspecies that can engage groups of enemies with its <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral jaws and incapacitating spores.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 一种强大且极具攻击性的亚种，可以用其带有 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒的下颚和使人丧失行动能力的孢子与成群的敌人交战。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: The Pharaoh Predasite prefers to leave as much of the fighting to its master as possible, empowering their master's weapons while making enemies more vulnerable to attacks.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 法老扑猎达赛喜欢尽可能将战斗交给主人，自己则专注于增强主人的武器，同时使敌人更容易受到攻击。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.text: An infested drone as brutal and unforgiving as Deimos itself.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Infe.zhText: 一架感染者的无人机，就像火卫二本身一样残暴无情。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/KeyP.text: Destroy all the Tumors with |TIME| seconds left in the Timer
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/KeyP.zhText: 在计时器中还剩 |TIME| 秒前消灭所有肿瘤

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Kubr.text: <WARNING> Select a weakened predasite, an antigen and a mutagen to revive a Predasite Companion <WARNING>
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Kubr.zhText: <WARNING>选择一个虚弱的扑猎达赛、一个抗原和一个突变原来治愈一个扑猎达赛同伴<WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Lore.text: Higher standing among Entrati / Necraloid Required
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Lore.zhText: 需要在英择谛 / 殁世械灵集团中达到更高的声望等级。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Menu.text: ABORT MISSION AND RETURN TO NECRALISK
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Menu.zhText: 中止任务并返回殁世幽都

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Mini.text: Wily Grineer castaway, acclaimed as squad leader by his surviving brood-mates. Capable of complex diplomatic negotiations by Grineer standards.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Mini.zhText: 诡计多端的 Grineer 弃将，被他幸存的同批次克隆的战友们视作小队领袖。能以 Grineer 的标准进行复杂外交谈判。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.text: The means by which Loid quantifies the assistance you have provided him.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.zhText: 这是洛德用来量化你为他提供帮助的方式。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.text: Trade Orokin Matrices for Necraloid Standing
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.zhText: 用奥罗金矩阵装置来换取殁世械灵声望

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.text:
A spatial orientation matrix to aid with a mechs' guidance, balance and movement.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 1 Isolation Vault Bounties
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.zhText:
一个用来辅助机甲制导、平衡，以及移动的空间定位矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 1 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.text:
A cognition matrix that enables mechs to be adaptable and efficient in the field.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 3 Isolation Vault Bounties
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.zhText:
一个让机甲在战场上具备适应性和高效率的认知矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 3 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.text:
A mech matrix that assists with the machine's weapon accuracy and control.

Location: Isolation Vault Bounty rewards on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and from Enemy Necramechs found in Tier 2 Isolation Vault Bounties
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.zhText:
一个用来辅助机甲武器精准度和操控性的机甲矩阵装置。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金奖励、等级 2 隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.text: While the Entrati family's cohort of lethal Necramechs succumbed to the corrupting influence of Deimos, Loid's shielding kept him sane, as well as preserving what was left of his ‘passenger', the Cephalon Otak. Together they maintain a proud tradition of loyal service.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.zhText: 当英择谛家族引以为傲的致命殁世机甲都屈服于火卫二上的腐朽势力时，洛德的护盾使他得以保存理智；也一并保住了他当时的"乘客"所幸存的一切——中枢奥塔。他们一起协力维持住了忠诚服务这个傲人的传统。
恭喜你！你的存在已被默许！

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.text: Your Liability Rating has been upgraded to 'Negligible'.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Necr.zhText: 你的责任评级已升级到"可被忽略"。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Nexi.text: A distinctly Deimosian grotesquerie that attacks its opponents from above.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Nexi.zhText: 明显带有火卫二特征的怪兽，会从上方攻击它的对手。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Nexi.text: Due to its remarkable strength, this Nexifera can cause seismic shocks when hitting the ground.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Nexi.zhText: 由于其非凡的强度，这种悬匿兽在撞击地面时可以引起地震冲击。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Nexi.text: The Viridian Nexifera can produce a cloud of poisonous gas that’s always best avoided.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Nexi.zhText: 铬绿悬匿兽会产生一团毒气，最好避开为上。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Pet_.zhText: 释放一只|TYPE_SINGULAR|以获取"儿子"石印

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Puri.text: Activate the Purifier |TOTAL| times or less (|COUNT|/|TOTAL|)
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Puri.zhText: 净化器激活次数不超过 |TOTAL| 次（|COUNT|/|TOTAL|）

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Puri.text: A device that alters local atmosphere to elicit a probing response from nearby flora, allowing for swift examination and data accumulation.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Puri.zhText: 一种装置，它通过改变局部大气，诱出附近植物群发出探测反应，从而可以快速检查并积累数据。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Puri.text: USE POWER CELLS TO ACTIVATE PURIFIER
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Puri.zhText: 使用能量电池来激活净化器

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.text:
These scarce, hovering relics of the Orokin era can still be found monitoring the isolation vaults deep beneath the surface of Deimos.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.zhText:
这些罕见的奥罗金时代的悬浮遗迹，仍旧监视着火卫二地底深处的隔离库。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.text: The Infestation forms pendulous, fragile sacs of seed cells, constantly re-infusing the environment with its presence.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.zhText: 感染者形成的下垂且脆弱的种细胞囊，不断地在侵入周围的环境。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.text:
Half-formed, incomplete spore bearers, little more than twitching flesh with claws to latch on with.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.zhText:
半成型的不完整孢子载体，只是一个会用利爪固定自己的抽搐着的肉块。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.text: The Infestation emits searching tendrils which wait, passively, sensing their environment by touch alone.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.zhText: 由感染者发出的探索卷须，它们被动地等待着，仅通过触摸来感知周围的环境。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.text:
A fallen clump of entangled nerve fibers, redundant organs, and thin sensory membranes.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.zhText:
一团由缠绕在一起的神经纤维、无用器官以及感官薄膜组成的簇体。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.text: A relic of former times, when forces other than the Infestation shaped the environment.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.zhText: 在感染者到来之前，别的势力在影响环境之时，留下的一种远古遗物。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.text:
These orbs have long since fulfilled their original function, but still, thrum with faint power.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Reso.zhText:
这些球体早已完成了它们最初的使命，但它们依然剩下微弱的能量。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Seri.text:
Once part of an intricate Entrati apparatus, now shattered and bearing a sharp edge.

Location: Grandmother in the Necralisk on Deimos
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Seri.zhText:
曾经是一个英择谛复杂装置的一部分，现在已经破碎并拥有锋利的边缘。

获取地点：殁世幽都（火卫二）"祖母"处

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Sola.text: The site of pioneering Void research from long ago, this former moon of Mars has fallen to the Infestation. Deimos and its inhabitants alike have been gorged upon, mutated and remade.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Sola.zhText: 原来的火星卫星，很久以前开拓性虚空研究的遗址，它现在已经沦为感染者的地盘。火卫二和它的居民们，一直遭到吞噬、变异和改造。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.text: When pressured, this beast severs its torso from its legs, yielding double trouble for its victims.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.zhText: 在受到压力时，这只野兽会把它的躯干和双腿分开，给受害者带来双重的麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.text: Fiercely territorial, this beast lurks within the ruins of Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.zhText: 这只潜伏在火卫二废墟中的野兽有着强烈的领地意识。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.text: Deaf, dumb, and blind, it hunts prey using vibrations from the surrounding environment.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.zhText: 缺乏听觉和视觉能力，它会利用周围环境的震动来猎杀目标。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.text: Deaf, dumb, and blind, it hunts prey using vibrations from the surrounding environment.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.zhText: 缺乏听觉和视觉能力，它会利用周围环境的震动来猎杀目标。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.text: Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. Its acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.zhText: 虽被肢解但依然致命。它的杂耍动作使其在任何范围内都极具威胁

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.text: Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. Its acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Spli.zhText: 虽被肢解但依然致命。它的杂耍动作使其在任何范围内都极具威胁。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Unda.text: A shy, bizarre-looking, semi-aquatic creature that seldom attacks unless provoked.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Unda.zhText: 一种害羞且看起来有些怪异的半水生生物，只有在被激怒的情况下才会主动攻击。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Unda.text:
The Howler is easily startled. Its penetrating scream will cause other, more dangerous animals to investigate.

Active only while Vome watches over the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Unda.zhText:
尖啸水螅履虫很容易受到惊吓。其受惊时发出的刺耳尖啸会吸引其他更危险的动物前来一探究竟。

只有在"秩序"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Unda.text:
The Vaporous Undazoa gets its name from the noxious gas it belches out when alerted.

Active only while Fass watches over the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/Unda.zhText:
幻雾水螅履虫的命名灵感，源自其会在受到威胁时释放出有毒气体的特性。

只有在"混乱"监视魔胎之境时才会活动。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
Hello, dear.

Thank you so much for your prompt assistance with that little matter on Deimos.

It wouldn't be right to let you go empty-handed after all that hard work. I hope you can find a use for this.

Do stop by again soon, won't you?

Grandmother
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
你好，亲爱的。

非常感谢你在火卫二上，为了那个小问题，及时拔刀相助。

辛苦了这么久，让你空手而归不太合适。我希望这个能帮到你。

请尽快回来串门，好吗？

"祖母"

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text: Deimos emerges in Martian orbit, completely overrun by the Infestation... yet among the writhing mass, a distress call comes over a most ancient carrier wave...
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText: 火卫二出现在了火星轨道上，被大量感染者占领……然而在这些蠕动的生物体中，伴随着一道极古老的载波，传来了一个求救信号……

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
Hey, kid.

I couldn't stop thinking about how well you handled Snake.  It made me wish I had a spare Necramech that I could pass on to you.

I don't, but here's what I do have.

Original. Voidrig. Blueprints. Designed by the hand of yours truly. 

You can find the parts right here, down in the Vaults. Just strip 'em off the rogue Necramechs.

They'll put up a fight, but you don't strike me as a kid who's scared to get their hands dirty.

Enjoy. And not a word to Mother.

Father
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
孩子，

我一直在想你驾驭锰蛇有多厉害。真希望我能存下一台多余的殁世机甲传给你。

虽然我没存下来任何机甲，但是我也有一些东西给你。

初代的。虚空锐将。蓝图。由我亲自设计。

你可以在隔离库里找到部件。只要把它们从叛变的殁世机甲身上拆下来就行。

他们会奋力反抗，但我知道你不会像一个不想干活的小屁孩那样嫌弃我的。

享受其中的乐趣吧，记得不要告诉"母亲"。

"父亲"

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text: Mother believes Father alone can repair the failing Heart. He must be found.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText: "母亲"认为只有"父亲"才能修复衰败的"心"。必须找到他。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text: LOCATE FATHER WITHIN THE CAMBION DRIFT
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText: 在魔胎之境中找到"父亲"

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
HOVER
Jump with <JUMP> then hold <AIM_WEAPON> while still airborne to hover.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
悬浮
通过 <JUMP> 进行跳跃，然后在空中按住 <AIM_WEAPON> 来悬浮。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
CHARGE
Tap |DODGE| to dodge then hold |SPRINT| to charge forward.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
前冲
轻按 |DODGE| 来躲避，然后按住 |SPRINT| 前冲。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
GUARD MODE
Stationary artillery mode with reinforced defense.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
守卫模式
拥有防御强化的固定炮击模式。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
NECRAWEB
Launch canisters to coat ground, slowing enemies.
Canisters shot in the air will explode.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
殁世之网
发射罐子来覆盖住地面，以此来减慢敌人的速度。
罐子在空中被击中时会爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
GRAVEMINES
Deploy mines around the Necramech.
Each detonates when touched, damaging enemies nearby.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
殁世地雷
在殁世机甲周围部署地雷。
每枚地雷被触及时就会引爆，对附近的敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.text:
STORM SHROUD
Electrify Necramech armor for close combat.
Enemies striking the armor receive <DT_ELECTRICITY> status.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanetQuest.zhText:
惊电幕罩
给殁世机甲的护甲通电以进行近身搏斗。
让击中护甲的敌人陷入 <DT_ELECTRICITY> 状态。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedNemesis/Antiviru.text: <WARNING> An Antivirus mod must be equipped for Potency mods to be effective.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedNemesis/Antiviru.zhText: <WARNING> 必须装备杀毒 Mod，效价 Mod 才能生效。
杀毒尝试会在此处记录

/Lotus/Language/InfestedNemesis/Antiviru.text: <WARNING> Equip Potency mods to increase antivirus effectiveness
/Lotus/Language/InfestedNemesis/Antiviru.zhText: <WARNING> 装备效价 Mod 以增加杀毒效率

/Lotus/Language/InfestedNemesis/Showdown.text: AVOID STAGE ATTACKS OR SUFFER DOUBLE DAMAGE!
/Lotus/Language/InfestedNemesis/Showdown.zhText: 躲避来自舞台的攻击，否则将遭受双倍伤害！

/Lotus/Language/InfestedPlainsEvent/Even.text: There’s something I need to tell you, Tenno.
You must have |ITEM| in your inventory to play this mission.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedPlainsEvent/Even.zhText: 你的仓库中必须有|ITEM|才能进行这个任务。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedPlainsEvent/Infe.text: Steal Vay Hek's Thrax Toxin, mix it, and poison the Infested Boil growing in the center of the plains. An Eidolon Phylaxis and an Infested Catalyst is required.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedPlainsEvent/Infe.zhText: 偷取韦·海克的瑟拉斯毒素，混合，并将毒素送去在平野中部生长的感染疖瘤。需要夜灵抗体和 Infested 催化剂。

/Lotus/Language/InfestedPlainsEvent/Infe.text: Steal Vay Hek's Thrax Toxin, mix it, and poison the Infested Boil growing in the center of the plains.
/Lotus/Language/InfestedPlainsEvent/Infe.zhText: 偷取韦·海克的瑟拉斯毒素，混合，并将毒素送去在平野中部生长的感染疖瘤。

/Lotus/Language/Input/DOJO_SELECTION_CHA.zhText: 镜头朝向 / 改变旋转轴

/Lotus/Language/Input/DOJO_SELECTION_EDI.zhText: 编辑装饰物 / 放置其他装饰物

/Lotus/Language/Input/DOJO_SELECTION_ROT.zhText: 装饰品旋转 / 移除装饰品

/Lotus/Language/Input/DOJO_SELECTION_SCA.text: Hold to scale / Reset room decorations
/Lotus/Language/Input/DOJO_SELECTION_SCA.zhText: 按住以缩放 / 重置房间装饰

/Lotus/Language/Input/DOJO_SELECTION_SUR.zhText: 表面吸附 / 自由放置

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/ConfirmIntrin.text: Are you sure you want to invest |ICON||AMOUNT| Intrinsics to get Rank |RANK| in |INTRINSIC|?
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/ConfirmIntrin.zhText: 你确定想要投资 |ICON||AMOUNT| 内源之力来将|INTRINSIC|升级至 |RANK| 级吗？

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/IntrinsicsDes.zhText: 管理你的内源之力技能

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/IntrinsicsHin.text: <WARNING> Allocate Intrinsics to the categories below to boost your rank
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/IntrinsicsHin.zhText: <WARNING> 将内源之力分配给以下类别来提升你的等级。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Put a crew together to man the Railjack when other Tenno are not around.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 命令一位舰员，来在其他 Tenno 不在场时操纵航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Unlocks the first crew member and the ability to hire them from Ticker.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 解锁第一位舰员，以及从 Ticker 那里招募他们的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Stronger crew members become available for recruitment from Ticker.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 现在可从 Ticker 处招募更强大的舰员。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Allows you to give 1 competency point to your crew members.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 可以给你的舰员 1 能力点数。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Allows you to give 1 competency point to your crew members.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 可以给你的舰员 1 能力点数。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Allows you to give 1 competency point to your crew members.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 可以给你的舰员 1 能力点数。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Allows you to redistribute previously assigned competency points.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 让你可以重新分配之前分配过的能力点数。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Converted Liches become available as Defender Crew on your Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 可以让被感化的玄骸们在你的航道星舰上成为守护舰员。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: One of your crew members can be designated as being On Call and can be summoned to aid you in non-Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 你的一名舰员可以被指定进入待命状态，并可以在非航道星舰任务中被召唤出来协助你。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Mend the scars of battle and feed the war machine. Repair ship damage, bolster resource yields, and forge armaments in real-time.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 修补战斗在星舰上留下的痕迹，并为这一战争机器提供所需的物品。修复战舰损伤，提高资源产量，并实时锻造军备。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Accelerated hazard suppression and hull repair.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 加快事故抢救和舰体维修
远程修复舰上所有危险。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Decrease cooldown for Air Support Charges by |VAL1|%.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 降低 |VAL1|% 的空中支援呼叫器冷却时间。
在部署时补充火炮补给。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Resupply Forward Artillery cannon during combat.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 在战斗中补充前装光能炮弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Increase Forge yields by |VAL2|%. Craft Hull Restores.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 锻造产量提高 |VAL2|%。可制造舰体修复物。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Increase Archwing defense. Health +|VAL1|%, Shield +|VAL2|%, and Armor +|VAL3|%.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 提升曲翼防御能力。生命值 +|VAL1|%，护盾 +|VAL2|%，护甲 +|VAL3|%。
提升殁世机甲的防御。生命值 +|VAL1|%。护盾 +|VAL2|%。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Unlock the deadly power of your arsenal. Improved turrets, advanced targeting modes and devastating artillery.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 释放军械的致命力量。改进过的炮台，拥有先进的瞄准模式和毁灭性的光能炮。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Dorsal and Ventral turret guns deal +50% damage.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 舰顶、舰腹炮台的伤害提高 50%。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Turret aim will snap to lead indicator for 3s.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 炮台瞄准将吸附到提前量标记上 3 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Augmented reprojection and turret suspensors allows full 360 degree combat engagement.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 增强的二次投影和炮台悬架可实现 360 度全方位作战。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: High velocity Archwing deployment into the combat zone. Slingshot Archwing damages fighters and penetrates enemy crewship hulls.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 高速部署曲翼到战斗区域。被弹射的曲翼可以对战机造成伤害，并能穿透敌方战舰的舰体。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Increase Archwing Attraction Range by |VAL1|m and Melee Range by |VAL2|m and Damage by |VAL3|%.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 曲翼吸引范围增加 |VAL1| 米，近战范围增加 |VAL2| 米，伤害增加 |VAL3|%。
增加 |VAL1|% 殁世机甲的枪械伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Reduce overheat recovery time by |VAL1|%. Extends Slingshot range by |VAL2|%.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 过热恢复时间减少 |VAL1|%。弹射器范围扩大 |VAL2|%。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Increases Archwing power: Damage +|VAL1|%, Ability Strength +|VAL2|%, Ability Range +|VAL3|%, and Ability Efficiency +|VAL4|%.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 提升曲翼技能：伤害 +|VAL1|%，技能强度 +|VAL2|%，技能范围 +|VAL3|%，技能效率 +|VAL4|%。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Reloading when weapons are overheated will cool weapons to 0 in 0.5 secs.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 武器过热时重新装填，会在 0.5 秒内将武器热量冷却至 0。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Forge a bond with the vessel. Unlock advanced speed and agile maneuvering capabilities.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 与星舰建立紧密联系。解锁更高级的速度控制以及敏捷机动能力。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Hold |SPRINT| to boost Engine Speed. Firing pilot guns interrupts boosting.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 长按 |SPRINT| 来助推引擎速度。使用舰首炮台开火会中断助推过程。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Double-tap <JUMP> to instantly translate the Railjack forward, leaving a trail of turbulence that slows nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 双击<JUMP>把航道星舰瞬移至前方，并留下一道湍流航迹来减缓附近敌人的速度。
轻按 |ACTION| 可使定向推进器助推加速。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Near-by enemy projectiles lose lock-on during Vector Maneuver.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 在矢量机动过程中，附近敌方投射物失去目标锁定。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: During Vector, press & hold |SPRINT| to drift.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 在矢量机动期间，按下并按住 |SPRINT| 来漂移。
助推加速时轻按 |ACTION| 来进行漂移

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Increase loot pickup radius by 3x while boosting, drifting or dodging. Hidden derelicts are marked.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 在助推、漂移，或躲避时，增加 3x 的战利品拾取范围。隐藏的遗迹会被标记。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: A 25% chance of jamming an incoming Ramsled's targeting systems, causing them to overshoot and explode.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 有 25% 的几率干扰一艘来袭冲锋艇的瞄准系统，使其越过目标并爆炸。
殁世机甲的移动速度提高 |VAL1|%。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Reduce Incoming Damage by |VAL1|% while Boosting. Ramming into enemies while Boosting will deal |VAL2| <DT_IMPACT>Impact Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 助推时受到的来袭伤害降低 |VAL1|%。助推时撞向敌人会造成 |VAL2| <DT_IMPACT>冲击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Increase your focus on the big picture of battle. Improved Tactical Mods and powerful Tactical deployment abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 提高你在战斗的全局上的注意力。改进过的战术 Mod，拥有强大的战术部署能力。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Deploy Tactical Mods and access Crew tracking system via Tactical Menu |TACT_MENU|.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 部署战术 Mod 并通过 |TACT_MENU| 战术选单访问舰员追踪系统。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Warp from ship to crew member.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 从星舰曲速传送前往舰员所在处。

/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.text: Warframe abilities can be deployed as tactical support. Enables crew chase camera.
/Lotus/Language/Intrinsics/RailjackIntri.zhText: 可将战甲的技能作为战术支援来部署。启用舰员追踪视角。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DeadBodyPages.text:
Sprawled on the ground lay a pathetic figure. It was clearly dead, but seemed as if it might start whining again at any moment.

The Queen of Duviri laughed. “I had such a beautiful ending planned for that one. But he saved me the effort.”

“How?” demanded the Orphan.

“He died of a broken heart, waiting for a man who would never come back. A man who was secretly glad to be rid of his whining, clinging presence.”

“But love!” the Orphan cried, feeling their last hope shrivel and die within them. “Surely the power of love…”

The Queen rested her splendid claw on the Orphan's shoulder. A look that might have been pity crossed her face. 

“The forefathers of your forefathers looked into the shining heart of an atom, scribbled their clever equations, and ripped it apart. Did they spare a thought for the age-old love between proton and neutron? Or did they only think of the bountiful energy they could harvest?”
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DeadBodyPages.zhText:
地上躺着一个可怜的身影。它显然已经死去，但似乎随时都可能开始哀鸣。

双衍王境女王笑了。“我本来为那个人安排了一个美好的结局。他倒是帮我省了事。”

“怎么说呢？”孤儿问道。

“他因心碎而死，等待着一个永远不会回来的人。那个人其实暗自庆幸自己摆脱了他那呜咽又缠人搬的存在。”

“可是爱！”孤儿哭喊着，感到心中最后的希望在枯萎消亡。“无疑，爱的力量……”

女王将她华丽的爪子搭在孤儿的肩膀上。脸上掠过一丝可能是怜悯的神情。 

“你祖先的祖先曾直视原子那璀璨的核心，草草写下他们精妙的方程式，然后把它们撕碎。他们考虑过质子和中子之间那份由来已久的爱恋么？还是他们只想着如何收获那丰沛的能量？”

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DeadBodyPages.text:
The woman was clearly dead. The Orphan thought at first that she was just another of the dead Duviri people. But she wore no mask, and her body had the usual dull human symmetry and proportions.

“What killed her?” the Orphan asked.

“I did, of course,” answered the Queen of Duviri.

“Why?”

“Why not?”

A strange idea came into the Orphan's mind. The Queen knew at once that the Glory was at work within them, just as it worked within her, but she held her peace.

“She was your mother, wasn't she?”

“As much of a mother as I ever had,” the Queen said. The Glory quickly swallowed down the human weakness that rose in her like bile. “She would be so proud.”

“So… why?”

The Queen shrugged. “Maybe I wanted to find out what it feels like to kill your parents? You kids made it look like fun.”

“Fun,” echoed the Orphan hollowly.

“Baby spiders always eat the mother,” said the Queen with an exquisite grin. “They need to. They wouldn't get strong otherwise. One day you'll learn the lesson, kiddo.”
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DeadBodyPages.zhText:
那女人显然已经死了。孤儿一开始还以为她只是另一个双衍王境里的死人。但她没有戴面具，身体也有着人类通常有的呆板比例和对称。

“她是怎么死的？”孤儿问道。

“当然是我杀的，”双衍王境女王回答道。

“为什么？”

“为什么不呢？”

一个奇怪的念头浮现在孤儿的脑海中。女王立刻意识到是荣耀之物在孤儿体内作祟，正如它在她体内一般，但她保持了沉默。

“她是你的母亲，对吗？”

“她算是我生命中最接近‘母亲'的存在吧，”女王说道。荣耀之物迅速吞噬了她心头泛起的那一丝如胆汁般的人性弱点。“她一定会很骄傲的。”

“所以……为什么？”

女王耸了耸肩。“也许我只是想知道杀掉父母是什么感觉？你们这些孩子让这种事看起来挺有意思的。”

“有意思，”孤儿空洞地附和着。

“小蜘蛛总是把妈妈吃掉，”女王露出一抹精致的微笑。“它们必须这样做。不然，它们不会变强。总有一天你也会明白这个道理的，小鬼。”

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DeadBodyPages.text:
“The adults turned on us. Did you do that?”

“The parents turned on you,” the Queen corrected them graciously, prompted by the Glory that enveloped her. “The rest of the adults were spared. At first.”

The Orphan snarled up at her. “You can't bear it, can you? Anything good, anything wholesome, even the bond between a parent and child! You corrupt it all!”

“Oh, you think so?”

The Queen led the Orphan to the lonely remains of a human male. The Orphan felt an instinctive pang of sorrow. This cold meat had been a father once. No doubt about it.

The Glory filled the Queen and she spoke. “No parent ever really believes they did a good enough job. Especially this lump. Every bad choice their kids make is a judgement on them. Their love holds them to a standard they can't meet.” 

“Stop.”

“I don't corrupt their love. I don't have to. It was broken when I found it.”

“STOP!”

The Queen took a deep, nostalgic drag on her Efervon inhaler. Lungs that were no longer lungs spasmed in austere delight. 

“The same crack runs through everything, kiddo,” she explained. “You want to deny it, that's on you.”
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DeadBodyPages.zhText:
“那些大人突然向我们出手。是你干的吗？”

“是那些父母先对你们先动的手，”女王在荣耀之物的驱使下，优雅地纠正了孤儿。“其他大人……起初我并未动他们。”

孤儿对她咆哮道。“你无法忍受，是吗？只要是美好的，纯粹的东西，哪怕是父母与孩子之间的羁绊！全都会被你扭曲！”

“哦，你这么认为？”

女王领着孤儿来到一具人类男性的遗骸前。孤儿本能地感到一阵悲伤。这具冰冷的尸体，曾经是个父亲。毫无疑问。

荣耀之物充满了女王，她说道。“没有哪个父母真的觉得自己做得足够好。尤其是他这种。孩子们每一个错误的选择，都是对他们的一种审判。他们的爱控制他们，为自己设立了一种他们永远达不到的标准。” 

“别说了。”

“我并没有扭曲他们之间的爱。我根本不需要这样做。当我找到它的时候，它早已破碎不堪。”

“住口！”

女王带着对往事的怀恋深深地吸了一口艾弗旺吸入器。那已不再是肺的肺，在克制的快感中抽动。 

“同样的裂痕无处不在，小鬼，”她解释道。“你想否认，那是你的事。”

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DuviriMurmurE.text:
Drifter,

The menace of ‘NECI RUSALKA' is now contained. The tale she attempted to weave is forever sundered from the Canon. She shall fester in an apocryphal Spiral all of her own. 

We are satisfied.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DuviriMurmurE.zhText:
漂泊者，

“内奇·鲁莎卡”的威胁如今已被遏制。她试图编织的故事将永远与正典隔绝。她将在她自己伪造的复眠螺旋中溃烂。 

我们很满意。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝

To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias ‘Drifter':

DUVIRI IS IN GRAVE PERIL. 

While you were off on your FRIVOLOUS VENTURES the Lost Island of Scholar's Landing returned, bringing with it that MENACE of the VOID of which the Scholar spoke.

That SHE-DEMON has usurped Our Throne. She must be STOPPED.

I await you on board the ‘Zariman' for a most urgent conference.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/DuviriMurmurE.zhText:
致化名为“漂泊者”的昔日叛徒和阴谋家：

在你进行那些无聊的冒险时，失落的儒临地卷土重来，带来了学者提到过的虚空威胁。

我在扎里曼号上等你来参加一场紧急会议。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝
