/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.text:
THE FIRST THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. An envious little girl, who watched as the whole world had more than she did. All the nice things, all the expensive things. And so she took what she didn't have.

And along came a spider who told her that everyone in the world would always have more than she did. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she clung to her favorite toy and filled her life with her family and told the spider to GO! AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.zhText:
第一根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个嫉妒的小女孩，眼睁睁地看着全世界的人都拥有得比她多，所有美好的、昂贵的东西。于是她拿走了自己没有的。

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她世界上总会有人拥有得比她多。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把这一切都吃掉。

然而，她紧紧抓住自己最爱的玩具，用家人填满自己的生活，并让蜘蛛滚——开——！

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.text:
THE SECOND THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. A frightened little girl, who ran and hid and was so afraid of everything around her. But most of all, she was afraid to die. 

And along came a spider who told her that everything we love in this world withers and dies. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she hid her fear away in the arms of strangers and told the spider to GO! AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.zhText:
第二根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个害怕的小女孩，她四处奔跑、躲藏，对周围的一切都很害怕。不过她最害怕的是死亡。 

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她我们在这个世界上所爱的一切都会枯萎并死去。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把这一切都吃掉。

然而，她把恐惧藏在陌生人的怀抱里，并让蜘蛛滚——开——！

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.text:
THE THIRD THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. A sad little girl, who watched as the world went wrong. Watched as people fought. As people lied. A sad little girl who watched as her parents grew farther and farther apart.

And along came a spider who told her that everything in the world always ended in sadness. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her. 

But she turned away from the sadness and filled her life with faith and told the spider to GO! AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.zhText:
第三根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个悲伤的小女孩，眼睁睁地看着世界变得一团糟。看着人们争吵，看着人们撒谎。一个悲伤的小女孩眼睁睁地看着她的父母越来越疏远。

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她世上的一切都以悲伤告终。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把这一切都吃掉。 

然而，她回避了悲伤，用信心充实了自己的生活，并让蜘蛛滚——开——！

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.text:
THE FOURTH THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. A joyful little girl, whose life was filled with meaning and happiness. She filled her world with dolls on strings and made them dance.

And along came a spider who told her that everything was a lie, and all her happiness was a shallow pane of glass. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she turned away from the joy and filled her life with war and told the spider to GO! AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.zhText:
第四根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个快乐的小女孩，她的生活充满了幸福和意义。她用提线玩偶装满了她的世界，让它们翩翩起舞。

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她一切都是谎言，她所有的幸福都只是一层薄薄的玻璃。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把这一切都吃掉。

于是，她远离了快乐，用战争填满了自己的生活，并让蜘蛛滚——开——！

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.text:
THE LAST THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. An angry little girl, whose life was filled with fury and rage. She hurt and maimed and was hurt and maimed in return.

And along came a spider who told her that everything in the world always ended in anger. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she turned away… and realized she had nothing else to fill her life with.

The spider smiled… and he ate her all up.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.zhText:
最后一根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个愤怒的小女孩，她的生活充满了怒气和愤恨。她伤害别人，让别人受伤，而别人也伤害她，让她受伤。

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她世上的一切都以愤怒告终。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把一切都吃掉。

她转身离去……却意识到没有其他东西可以填满自己的生活。

蜘蛛笑了……然后吃掉了她。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.text: For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverFra.zhText: 当日月汇聚，迷途者终将寻得归途。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverOra.text: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar's Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverOra.zhText: 作为阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的侍从，她必须保护儒临地。然而，长年的与世隔绝使她很容易被内奇·鲁莎卡的低语操控。如今，她为一位新主人效忠，胆敢踏足这座岛屿的人都会遭到她的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverQue.text:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias ‘Drifter':

That profane monstrosity of which the Scholar spoke has sought to claim our throne. It wears a face and puppets a body that knows you.

We have confined it in the Apocrypha, the realm of Untold Stories, but you now have a duty to keep it there.

If it gains sufficient power, its story will supplant ours!

Seek its heretical tale, ‘The Triumph of Dust'. Sever it from the true tales of Duviri.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverQue.zhText:
致化名为“漂泊者”的昔日叛徒和阴谋家：

那位学者所言的亵渎之物正企图夺取我们的王座。它戴着一张假面，操纵着一个了解你的躯体。

我们把它囚禁在伪典，那些不为人知的故事里，但你现在有责任让它留在那里。

如果它获得足够的力量，它的故事将会取代我们的！

寻找它的异端故事，“尘埃的胜利”。把它和双衍王境的真实故事分开。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverQue.text: A Missive From His Majesty DOMINUS THRAX

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverSpi.text: These aggressive and explosive Scuttlers have one purpose to fulfil in their short lives; protect their mother.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverSpi.zhText: 这些具有攻击性且易爆的急行蛛在它们短暂的一生中只有一个目标：保护它们的母亲。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverSpi.text: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverSpi.zhText: 儒临地守护者所生的蜘蛛幼崽。虽然它们对母亲来说弥足珍贵，但生命却异常短暂，只能通过狩猎来维系彼此的羁绊。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/JunctionRewor.text:
Operator,

Have you noticed a disturbance in the solar rails? It appears ALL Junctions have been recalibrated! Ordis is unsure of how, or why, this happened.

For reasons that are equally unknown, but perhaps related, the following items have appeared in your inventory.

Ordis is certain the Operator earned these somewhere along the line.

Your Faithful Cephalon,
Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/JunctionRewor.zhText:
指挥官，

您注意到星际航道出现干扰了吗？看来所有接合点都被重新校准了！Ordis 不确定这究竟是如何发生的，亦或为何发生。

出于同样未知但或许相关的原因，以下物品已出现在您的仓库中。

Ordis 确信指挥官在某个环节中获得了这些物品。

您忠实的中枢，
Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/MITWPatrolsWi.text: Defeat the Murmur Guarding the Treasure
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/MITWPatrolsWi.zhText: 打败守卫宝物的低语者

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/RusalkaHatDes.text: Neci Rusalka’s distinctive Scaldra hat, received as part of a mysterious communication.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/RusalkaHatDes.zhText: 鲁莎卡少校独特的炽蛇军帽，在一次神秘通信中获得。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/RusalkaHatNam.zhText: 鲁莎卡少校的帽子纪念品

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/RusalkaMedals.text: Medals for valor awarded to Neci Rusalka, received as part of a mysterious communication.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/RusalkaMedals.zhText: 内奇·鲁莎卡的英勇勋章，在一次神秘通信中获得。
鲁莎卡少校的勋章纪念品

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/ShrineAssembl.zhText: 驱逐低语者并取回精华

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/SignaLockedPo.text: LOCKED: The Signa are unlocked by community progress. Spend Dominus Aureus obtained from Operation Eight Claw missions to help the community unlock these items.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/SignaLockedPo.zhText: 锁定中：头环是通过玩家社区进度解锁的。使用从《行动代号：八爪》中获取的大帝金币，来帮助玩家社区解锁这些物品。

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/VorHardModeAc.zhText: 与雅努斯沃尔上尉交战

/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/VorHardModeDe.text: Captain Vor has now unlocked the full potential of his Janus Key. Fortified and empowered, he is a deadly foe indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/VorHardModeDe.zhText: 沃尔上尉如今已释放出他那把雅努斯之钥的全部潜能。他已然得到强化，必将是一位致命的对手。

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/GolemAss.text: Access this assassination mission by completing the Jordas Precept quest.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/GolemAss.zhText: 完成《Jordas 枢律》系列任务以开通此暗杀任务。

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/Invisibi.text: A semi-transparent look when this Warframe is cloaked. Does not alter enemy perception.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/Invisibi.zhText: 当此战甲披上这件斗篷时呈现半透明外观。但并不会影响敌人的感知。

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/Invisibi.text: An alternate, opaque glow, for when this Warframe is cloaked. Does not alter enemy perception.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/Invisibi.zhText: 当此战甲披上这件斗篷时呈现不透明光芒。但并不会影响敌人的感知。

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/ModsTran.text: Install this segment to enable the Mod Transmutation function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/ModsTran.zhText: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器的 MOD 终端上以启用 Mod 转换功能。

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.text: Show Rhino Palatine's Iron Skin look when the ability is triggered.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.zhText: 使用技能时展现 Rhino 伯爵的「钢化皮肤」外观。
伯爵钢化皮肤特效覆盖

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.text: Show Rhino Deathwatch's Iron Skin look when the ability is triggered.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.zhText: 使用技能时展现 Rhino 报死虫的「钢化皮肤」外观。
报死虫钢化皮肤特效覆盖

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.text: Show Rhino Heirloom's Iron Skin look when the ability is triggered.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.zhText: 使用技能时展现 Rhino 传家宝的「钢化皮肤」外观。
传家宝钢化皮肤特效覆盖

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.text: Rhino's appearance will not change when the ability is triggered.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.zhText: 触发技能后，Rhino 的外观不会发生改变。
隐藏钢化皮肤特效覆盖

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.text: Show Rhino Prime's Iron Skin look when the ability is triggered.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/RhinoIro.zhText: 使用技能时展现 Rhino Prime 的「钢化皮肤」外观。
Prime 钢化皮肤特效覆盖

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/XakuBrok.text: Xaku will constantly remain in skeletal form.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/XakuBrok.zhText: Xaku 将始终保持骨骼形态。

/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/XakuBrok.text: Xaku will constantly remain in corporeal form.
/Lotus/Language/ItemDescription/XakuBrok.zhText: Xaku 将始终保持实体形态。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AHAkboltoDesc.text: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AHAkboltoDesc.zhText: （英文：TELOS AKBOLTO）对均衡仲裁者来说，这对手枪不单只是寻常的武器，它们是真相与纪律的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AHBoltaceDesc.text: Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AHBoltaceDesc.zhText: （英文：TELOS BOLTACE）旋转式攻击会释放「暴风之道」，如同风暴般的破坏将其路径的任何敌人猛力甩出。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AHBoltorDesc.text: Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AHBoltorDesc.zhText: （英文：TELOS BOLTOR）用这把均衡仲裁者锻造的螺钉步枪降下审判。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AHScarfDesc.text: With every enemy struck down the Telos Syandana glows stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AHScarfDesc.zhText: 随着每击倒一位敌人 ，终极披饰的光芒将愈加闪耀。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AcolyteNoggleBundl.text: A collection of Noggle Statues depicting the followers of the Stalker.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AcolyteNoggleBundl.zhText: 一个包含追猎者的追随者的摇头娃娃包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AcolyteStalkerMios.text: A unique skin for the Lacera used by the Stalker's Acolyte, Mania.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AcolyteStalkerMios.zhText: 悲痛之刃的独特外观，由追猎者的躁狂追随者使用。
悲痛之刃 轻蔑外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/ActuatorDesc.text: Synthetic tensor components. Used in the manufacture of Corpus Robotics.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ActuatorDesc.zhText: 人工张量组件。用于 Corpus 机器人生产。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AdvancedResourceDr.text:
Deploy the Extractor on a planet to collect large amounts of resources.

Must be emptied regularly for maximum efficiency and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AdvancedResourceDr.zhText:
在一个星球上部署采集机来收集大量资源。

必须定期清理，才能达到最高效率并防止损坏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AdvancedUcResource.text:
The Distilling Extractor Prime has an increased chance of acquiring uncommon and rare resources.

Deploy this Extractor on a planet to collect large amounts of resources. It must be emptied regularly and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AdvancedUcResource.zhText:
精粹采集机 PRIME 增加获得稀有资源的几率。

部署采集机在星球收集大量资源 ，它必须定期清理并检查是否有损坏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AdventurerKubrowDe.text: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AdventurerKubrowDe.zhText: 一个可靠的伙伴，为他们的 Tenno 主人找到补给并削弱敌人的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AffinityBoosterDes.text: Doubles the rate at which you earn affinity. Upgrade your weapons and Warframes faster.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AffinityBoosterDes.zhText: 提升你的 Tenno 武器和装备经验。当启用后你获得的经验值增加一倍。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AggressionEventCor.text: An insignia marking Tenno who aligned with the Corpus during the Gradivus Dilemma.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AggressionEventCor.zhText: 该徽章代表 Tenno 与 Corpus 在荧惑困境中一同作战。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AggressionEventGri.text: An insignia marking Tenno who aligned with the Grineer during the Gradivus Dilemma.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AggressionEventGri.zhText: 该徽章代表 Tenno 与 Grineer 在荧惑困境中一同作战。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboAutoPistolDe.text: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboAutoPistolDe.zhText: （英文：AFURIS）双手各装备一把盗贼手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且换弹的速度增长。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboBoltoDesc.text: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboBoltoDesc.zhText: （英文：AKBOLTO）双手各装备一把螺钉手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且需两倍的换弹时间。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboHandCannonsD.text: A Bronco equipped in each hand.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboPistolDesc.text: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：AKLATO）每只手持一把拉托，双倍弹匣和射速，但双倍装填时间，且精度更差。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboSomaPistolsD.text: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboSomaPistolsD.zhText: （英文：AKSOMATI ）月神步枪的强大威力被凝聚在这对优雅的手枪当中。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboViperPistolD.text: A Viper equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboViperPistolD.zhText: （英文：TWIN VIPERS）每只手持一把蝰蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AklexDesc.text: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AklexDesc.zhText: （英文：AKLEX）以雷克斯双枪的两只大口径枪管朝敌人开火，但精准度和装填时间会受到负面影响。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AkmagnusDesc.text: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AkmagnusDesc.zhText: （英文：AKMAGNUS）和一把麦格努斯相比有双倍弹药和双倍后坐力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlertiumDesc.text:
Each vial is produced by the painstaking expression of billions of rare, ocean-vent dwelling microorganisms.

Location: Nightwave Cred Offerings
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlertiumDesc.zhText:
每一小瓶是由数十亿罕见的，栖息于海底喷管附近的微生物所制造的。

获取地点：午夜电波的贡品

/Lotus/Language/Items/AllianceEmblemDesc.text: An insignia that projects a holographic image of your alliance emblem. Requires a Warlord in the clan that created the alliance to upload an image of the alliance emblem.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AllianceEmblemDesc.zhText: 一个投射全息图像的联盟徽章。需要您氏族中创建联盟的将军上传图像作为联盟徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlloyPlateDesc.text:
Carbon steel plates used to reinforce Grineer armor.

Location: Venus, Phobos, Ceres, Jupiter, Pluto, and Sedna.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlloyPlateDesc.zhText:
用于强化 Grineer 护甲的碳钢板。

获取地点：金星，火卫一，谷神星，木星，冥王星和赛德娜。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlloyPlateStoreOve.text:
Carbon steel plates used to reinforce Grineer armor.
This bundle of 1500 Alloy Plates can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlloyPlateStoreOve.zhText:
用于强化 Grineer 护甲的碳钢板。
这个内含1，500个合金板的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlphaCorruptorDesc.text: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Beta counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Beta Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlphaCorruptorDesc.zhText: 这污染物单独时属于惰性，当与 BETA 污染物混合时会产生极高的效果，适当的混合会破坏巨人战舰反应堆的平衡，比 STABLE 污染物来的迅速，这个不稳定的物品不能同时间与 BETA 污染物一起携带，推荐给 Tenno 合作团队。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.text: A unique set of arrows, compatible with any bow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.zhText: 一组独一无二，适用于全弓类武器的箭矢。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.text: A unique set of arrows, compatible with any bow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.zhText: 一组独一无二，适用于全弓类武器的箭矢。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.text: A unique set of arrows, compatible with any bow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.zhText: 一组独一无二，适用于全弓类武器的箭矢。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.text: A collection of unique arrows, compatible with any bow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AlternateArrowSkin.zhText: 一套独一无二，适用于全弓类武器的箭矢组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AmberStarBlueprint.text: A permanent blueprint that creates an AYATAN AMBER STAR.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AmberStarBlueprint.zhText: 一张用于制造阿耶檀识琥珀星的永久蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AmbulasDataFragmen.text:
Used to locate the Ambulas production facility.

This resource is dropped from Ambulas Units.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AmbulasDataFragmen.zhText:
用来定位量产智踱恐鸟的设施。

该资源由智踱恐鸟单位掉落。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AncientHealerBallD.text: Deploys an ANCIENT PROTECTOR EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AncientHealerBallD.zhText: 设置一个为你战斗的远古守护卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AnkyrosPrimeDesc.text: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AnkyrosPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：ANKYROS PRIME）甲龙双拳的奥罗金版本，在各方面素质都远超其后继者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AntiMatterAgileAni.text: The Agile Animation Set for Nova.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AntiMatterNobleAni.text: The Noble Animation Set for Nova.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AntlerBowDesc.text: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AntlerBowDesc.zhText: （英文：CERNOS）这把冲击力强大的西诺斯长弓十分擅长猎杀高护盾的敌人，让人回想起古代长弓的设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/April2015ScarfDesc.text: A Tenno Syandana evocative of winged night creatures.
/Lotus/Language/Items/April2015ScarfDesc.zhText: 一件 Tenno 披饰，令人联想到有翅膀的夜之生物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArbitersHexisProfi.text: A glyph of the Arbiters of Hexis

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcDroneDesc.text: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcDroneDesc.zhText: 电气浮囊会电击附近的敌人，并针对远处的威胁目标进行攻击。使用「金工火枪」狙击步枪与「精算射击」、「电弧线圈」与「电光脉冲」等独特技能。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcTrapStoreItemDe.text: Sentinel will zap up to |TARGETS| enemies within |RANGE|m, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage with a |PROC|% Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcTrapStoreItemDe.zhText: 守护会以迅雷不及掩耳的速度攻击 |RANGE| 米内的 |TARGETS| 名敌人，造成 |DAMAGE|<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害，并有 |PROC|% 的几率附加负面状态。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneAshAltHelmet.text: This helmet is worn by Ash, and adds Energy Capacity, with a reduction to Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneAshAltHelmet.zhText: 这顶头盔是由 Ash 所装备，可增加能量上限，但会减少移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneBansheeAltHe.text: This helmet is worn by Banshee, and adds Ability Efficiency, but reduces duration of Aim Glide and Wall Latch.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneBansheeAltHe.zhText: 这顶头盔由 Banshee 佩戴，它能提升技能效率，但会减少飞身瞄准与壁面攀附的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneBansheeAltHe.text: This helmet is worn by Banshee, and grants Max Energy Boost, with a reduction to Health.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneBansheeAltHe.zhText: 这顶头盔是由 Banshee 所装备，可增加能量上限，但会减少生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneEmberAltHelm.text: This helmet is worn by Ember, and adds Health, with a reduction to Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneEmberAltHelm.zhText: 这顶头盔是由 Ember 所装备，可增加生命值，但会减少移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneEmberAltHelm.text: This helmet is worn by Ember, and reduces Shields in order to boost Energy Capacity.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneEmberAltHelm.zhText: 这顶头盔是由 Ember 所装备，可增加能量上限，但会减少护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneExcaliburAlt.text: This helmet is worn by Excalibur, and adds Ability Strength, with a reduction to Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneExcaliburAlt.zhText: 这顶头盔由 Excalibur 佩戴，它能提升技能强度，但会降低护甲。
潘德拉冈 秘奥头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneExcaliburAlt.text: This helmet is worn by Excalibur, increases Shields at the expense of Health.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneExcaliburAlt.zhText: 这顶头盔是由 Excalibur 所装备，可增加护盾，但会减少生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneExodiaHelpTe.text: This Arcane can be purchased from Hok in Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcaneExodiaHelpTe.zhText: 该赋能可以从希图斯的霍刻处购买。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcataSkinADesc.text: A stylized arcata skin for Lunaro.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcataSkinADesc.zhText: 给月动球使用的风格化阿卡塔外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcataSugatraDesc.text: [PH] The traditional sugatra for Lunaro for generations.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcataSugatraDesc.zhText: [PH] The traditional sugatra for Lunaro for generations.

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchAxeDesc.text: This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchAxeDesc.zhText: （英文：ONORIX）这把激光刀刃的战斧能轻易突破船只的防御和保卫船只的武装力量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchBurstGunDesc.text: Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchBurstGunDesc.zhText: （英文：CYNGAS）释放出致命般精准的爆发性混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchCannonDesc.text: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchCannonDesc.zhText: （英文：CORVAS）充能完毕后，这台高射加农炮能击发出毁灭性的炮击。完美地击落快速移动的拦截机。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchHammerDesc.text: Using Archwing's jets for thrust, this massive hammer crushes anything in its path.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchHammerDesc.zhText: 利用了曲翼的喷射推动力，这把巨大的铁锤能击碎其挥舞路径中的任何物体。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchHeavyPistolsDe.text: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchHeavyPistolsDe.zhText: （英文：DUAL DECURION）什长双枪是专门为了在真空的太空之下战斗，能急速发射双道高精准弹幕的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchHookSwordDesc.text: Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchHookSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：AGKUZA）用这柄强大的钩状刀刃撕裂来袭的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchLongRifleDesc.text: Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchLongRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：PHAEDRA）借由这把菲德菈——月神最年长的姊妹——纵横太空尽情毁灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchMachinegunDesc.text: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchMachinegunDesc.zhText: （英文：IMPERATOR）能在太空中开火的长射程步枪，凯旋将军的多用性使得它成为在太空作战时理想的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchRailgunDesc.text: When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchRailgunDesc.zhText: （英文：VELOCITUS）当充能完成后，极速电磁步枪的磁化枪管能将金属子弹加速至极限，使其轻易的摧毁装甲，贯穿船身。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchRocketCrossbow.text: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchRocketCrossbow.zhText: （英文：FLUCTUS）一把能射出致命等离子波来击溃敌人的曲翼能量武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchScytheDesc.text: Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchScytheDesc.zhText: （英文：KASZAS）拿起这把曲翼镰刀，化身为死亡天使。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchSwordDesc.text: Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：VERITUX）零重力的太空将这把大到难以想象的巨剑变成了敏捷的毁灭工具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchSwordShieldDes.text: Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchSwordShieldDes.zhText: （英文：CENTAUR）部分为剑，部分为盾，半人马剑盾专擅于突进敌军炮火之中。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchWingNavCodeDes.text: Archive detailing the locations of hidden Archwing technology
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArchWingNavCodeDes.zhText: 详细记录曲翼科技隐藏地点的档案

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcherBundleDesc.text: Hunt down your prey with this collection of lethal gear. Includes the Ivara Warframe, Rubico sniper rifle, Lacera sword-whip and the explosive Talon throwing darts. Enhance progression with 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcherBundleDesc.zhText: 用这组致命的装备追捕你的猎物。道具包中包含 Ivara 战甲、绝路狙击枪、悲痛之刃剑鞭以及装载了爆破物的鹰爪飞镖。外加能协助你加快游戏进度的3天经验与现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcherBundleFeatur.text: Hunt down your prey with this collection of lethal gear.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArcherBundleFeatur.zhText: 用这组致命的装备追捕你的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArgonCrystalDesc.text:
A Void based radioactive resource that decays every day it is out of the Void.

Location: Missions in the Void
/Lotus/Language/Items/ArgonCrystalDesc.zhText:
一种来自虚空的放射性资源，离开虚空后将每天衰变。

获取地点：虚空中的任务

/Lotus/Language/Items/AristeasMagicianHe.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Limbo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AristeasMagicianHe.zhText: Limbo 的独特样式替换头盔

拥护者摇头娃娃组合包

/Lotus/Language/Items/ArtilleryBarrageAb.text: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AshAltHelmet2Desc.text: Locust Helmet for the Ash Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AshDeluxeBundleDes.text: Become Ash Koga, with this striking skin bundle. Includes the Ash Koga Warframe Skin and the Nikana Ryu Skin.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AshNikanaSkinDesc.text: Hardened in the crucible of conflict, this is Ash Koga's signature Nikana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AshNikanaSkinDesc.zhText: 经由纷争的熔炉淬火，这是甲贺 Ash 的标志性侍刃。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AspNobleAnimsDesc.text: The Noble Animation Set for Saryn.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AssassinBaitBDesc.text: Lures the Zanuka Hunter out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassin would normally appear.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AssassinBaitBDesc.zhText: 吸引「Zanuka 猎犬」现身的物品。为一次性道具，仅能使用在刺客一般会出没的场景中。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AssassinBaitCDesc.text: Lures the Grustrag Three out of hiding. One-time use gear item that can only be used in locations where the assassins would normally appear.

/Lotus/Language/Items/AsymmetricBowDesc.text: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AsymmetricBowDesc.zhText: （英文：DAIKYU）大久和弓需要相当程度的施力才能开弓，但每次射击同时也提供了更强的威力与更远的射程。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AttackLensDesc.text: Converts 2% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Madurai Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AttackLensDesc.zhText: 将 2% 超额的经验值转化为 Madurai 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AuraFormaThreePack.text: A collection of three Omni Formas.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AuraFormaThreePack.zhText: 内含 3 个全能 Forma 的组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AutoCrossBowDesc.text: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AutoCrossBowDesc.zhText: （英文：BALLISTICA）这把布里斯提卡连弩采用独特的双击发装置，可在四连发或蓄力使用精准的致命射击之间选择。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AutoPistolDesc.text: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AutoPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：FURIS）盗贼是一把自动手枪，这小东西拥有极高的射速。

/Lotus/Language/Items/AutoShotgunDesc.text: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.
/Lotus/Language/Items/AutoShotgunDesc.zhText: （英文：BOAR）野猪有着较低的精度和大后坐力，但可以全自动发射载弹。最适宜近距离使用。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroArrowDesc.zhText: 荣誉之箭，对任何弓而言都是最佳的赞美。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroBadgeDesc.text: Stand apart from the crowd with this Ki'Teer original.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroBadgeDesc.zhText: 在人群中以这件 Ki'Teer 的原型脱颖而出。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroCapeDesc.text: Walk the cutting edge of fashion with this exclusive Ki'Teer original.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroCapeDesc.zhText: 搭配 Ki'teer 原创的独占披饰，行于时尚的锐利锋缘。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroPetMaskDesc.text: A mask designed to match the one worn by Baro Ki'Teer, for your Sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroPetMaskDesc.zhText: 一张基于 Baro Ki'teer 穿戴款式所设计的面具，适用于守护。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroPetTailDesc.text: A statement piece for any Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroPetTailDesc.zhText: 一个任何守护都可以使用的吸引眼球的时尚部件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroPetWingsDesc.text: Soar to new heights of luxury with these angular Sentinel wings.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BaroPetWingsDesc.zhText: 用这些棱角分明的守护飞翼飙升至一个奢华的新高度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BasicResourceDrone.text:
Deploy the Extractor on a planet to collect resources.

Must be emptied regularly for maximum efficiency and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BasicResourceDrone.zhText:
在一个星球上部署采集机来收集资源。

必须定期清理，才能达到最高效率并防止损坏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BasicSolarRailDesc.text: Constructing a Solar Rail allows travel to previously inaccessible locations. All Tenno who use the rail pay tribute to the Clan who built it.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BasicSolarRailDesc.zhText: 建造 Solar Rail 前往以前无法进入的地点。所有使用轨道的 Tenno 该向建造它的氏族致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BasicSolarRailName.zhText: 星际航道 - 航道名称

/Lotus/Language/Items/BasicUcResourceDro.text:
The Distilling Extractor has an increased chance of acquiring uncommon and rare resources.

Deploy this Extractor on a planet to collect resources. It must be emptied regularly and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BasicUcResourceDro.zhText:
精粹采集机增加获得稀有资源的几率。

将采集机部署到一个星球上收集资源。采集机必须定期清理和检查以防止损坏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BatEphemeraDesc.text:
A warrior walks, alone in crowds
Companion to moon and mist and bat
With a vision grim the mind enshrouds
This fearsome, deathborne aristocrat.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BatEphemeraDesc.zhText:
孤傲的战士，独行于族群
唯有月雾蝠，常伴其左右
眼神若冰霜，内心亦朦胧
化身为恐惧，死亡之贵族

/Lotus/Language/Items/BeaconDesc.text: One part of a long lost mathematical proof.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BeaconDesc.zhText: 一部分遗失多年的数学证明片段

/Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponDesc.text: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponDesc.zhText: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerAgileAnim.text: The Agile Animation Set for Valkyr.

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerDeluxeDes.text:
Before Alad V, before the experiments, there was Gersemi Valkyr. 

*Valkyr not included.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerDeluxeDes.zhText:
远在阿拉德 V 发迹与他那场实验之前，这世界上一度存在着璀璨 Valkyr。

＊本商品不含 Valkyr 战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerDeluxeFea.text: Before Alad V, before the experiments, there was Gersemi Valkyr.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerDeluxeFea.zhText: 远在阿拉德 V 发迹与他那场实验之前，这世界上一度存在着璀璨 Valkyr。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerDeluxeHel.zhText: Valkyr 璀璨的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerMeleeDesc.text: These talons emerge when Valkyr unleashes her Hysteria.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerMeleeDesc.zhText: 这些利爪将于 Valkyr 解放她的狂化爆发力量时显现。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerNobleAnim.text: The Noble Animation Set for Valkyr.

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerPackDesc.text: Get the new Warframe bundled with boosters and the latest in close-combat weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerPackDesc.zhText: 取得最新的战甲和近战武器以及加速器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerTubesDesc.text: Remnants of the bonds that restrained the original Valkyr during her time in 'the lab'. A reminder to never forget the torment.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BerserkerTubesDesc.zhText: "实验室"时期束缚 VALKYR 的枷锁残骸，提醒她永远记得那些折磨。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BetaCorruptorDesc.text: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Alpha counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Alpha Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BetaCorruptorDesc.zhText: 这污染物单独时属于惰性，当与 ALPHA 污染物混合时会产生极高的效果，适当的混合会破坏巨人战舰反应堆的平衡，比 STABLE 污染物来的迅速，这个不稳定的物品不能同时间与 ALPHA 污染物一起携带，推荐给 Tenno 合作团队。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BigBoyAbilityDesc.text: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BigBoyAbilityDesc.zhText: 发射出一枚能造成大规模爆炸的慢速导弹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BioFragmentStoreOv.text:
These samples could advance our knowledge of biological research.
This bundle of 1 Mutagen Sample can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BioFragmentStoreOv.zhText:
这些样本有助令我们的生物研究水平更进一步。
本组合包内含一份样本突变原，可用在铸造厂中建造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlackoutOrthosDesc.text: The Void's corrupting energy has scarred this Orthos, leaving it permanently out of phase with conventional space.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlackoutOrthosDesc.zhText: 虚空的堕落能量让这把欧特鲁斯伤痕累累，使它拥有完全迥异的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlackoutOrthosName.zhText: 相位外观 欧特鲁斯

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlankTraitPrintDes.text:
Copies the dominant genes of a pet onto the template. 
This can then be used to increase the chances that traits from the original pet will carry across to a newborn clone.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlankTraitPrintDes.zhText:
把一只宠物的显性基因复制到模板上。
这块模板随后可以被用来增加原宠物将性状带给新生克隆体的几率。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BleedingKeyBluepri.text: Blueprint required to craft the Bleeding Dragon Key. Health is greatly reduced while key is equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BleedingKeyBluepri.zhText: 制作残血龙钥的需求蓝图。装备该钥匙，生命会极大的降低。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueAntitoxinBluep.text: Fuses the extracts from both Moonlight and Sunlight variations of Jadeleaf and Dragonlily to create a potent antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueAntitoxinBluep.zhText: 将月光以及日光种类的玉叶和龙百合的萃取物融合所提炼出的强效解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueAntitoxinDesc.text: This is an extremely effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueAntitoxinDesc.zhText: 这是一个非常有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkyShipDesc.text: This blade-like landing craft is armed with Carpet Bomb air-support.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkyShipDesc.zhText: 这艘像刀刃一样的登陆艇装备了地毯式轰炸空中支援系统。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinBundleD.text: A collection of unique skins for the Scimitar landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinBundleD.zhText: 一套包含 Scimitar 登陆艇独特外观的组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinDeluxeD.text: A unique skin for the Scimitar landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinDeluxeD.zhText: Scimitar 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinPrimeTr.text: A unique skin for the Scimitar landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinPrimeTr.zhText: Scimitar 登陆舰的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinSoundDe.text: A unique skin for the Scimitar landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinSoundDe.zhText: Scimitar 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinSplashD.text: A unique skin for the Scimitar landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinSplashD.zhText: Scimitar 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinStalker.text: Cast the Stalker's caustic shadow across the Scimitar with this skin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BlueSkySkinStalker.zhText: 以这套追猎者的散焦阴影外观投影在 Scimitar 的船身。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BoPrimeDesc.text: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：BO PRIME）一把经典奥罗金兵器，使用它以优雅的战姿横扫战场。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BoarPrimeDesc.text: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BoarPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：BOAR PRIME）Tenno 工艺设计的绝佳案例之一，野猪 Prime 能提供更快的射速、更大的弹匣容量，以及更高的子弹伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltoRifleDesc.text: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltoRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：BOLTOR）螺钉步枪所发射出的的慢速重型螺钉足以将敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltonfaDesc.text: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltonfaDesc.zhText: （英文：BOLTACE）一对设计成与满身尖刺为造型的螺钉步枪相辅相成的拐刃，有着令人生畏的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltorBundleDesc.text: Featuring the Boltace tonfa, Boltor rifle, and the Bolto pistol, this bundle contains enough weaponry to shatter the heaviest Grineer armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltorBundleDesc.zhText: 内含螺钉拐刃，螺钉步枪与螺钉手枪。这份组合包装有足以痛宰护甲最厚重 Grineer 的武力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltorPrimeDesc.text: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BoltorPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：BOLTOR PRIME）射出由奥罗金设计、更快更尖锐的螺钉。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BossNavCodeDesc.text: Coordinate used to locate the Lephantis.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BossNavCodeDesc.zhText: 用来定位雷凡魔像的坐标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BountyHunterBadgeD.text: The holographic interface on this emblem will update to display the rank achieved through exemplary dedication to Tactical Alerts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BountyHunterBadgeD.zhText: 这个徽章上的全息界面会随着你在战术警报中的楷模表现不断更新显示你所达到的级别。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BowModConvertAmmoD.text: Converts Secondary ammo pickups to |PERCENT|% of Ammo Pick Up.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BowModConvertAmmoD.zhText: 将拾取的次要武器弹药转换为 |PERCENT|% 弹药拾取。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrandRemovalItemDe.text: Safely disengages the Grustrag Bolt from a Warframe
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrandRemovalItemDe.zhText: 安全地将 Grustrag 枷锁从你的战甲上移除。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldAkbolt.text: Custom edition of the Akbolto forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldAkbolt.zhText: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版螺钉双枪。
螺钉双枪 镀金外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldBoltoD.text: Custom edition of the Bolto forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldBoltoD.zhText: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版螺钉手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldBoltoN.zhText: 螺钉手枪 镀金外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldBundle.text: Features custom Ormolu skins of the Daikyu, Akbolto, Bolto and Tipedo as well as an Kyroptera Ormolu Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldBundle.zhText: 特点为大久和弓、提佩多、螺钉双枪与手枪的镀金外观订制版，以及一件镀金蝙蝠披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldDaikyu.text: Custom edition of the Daikyu forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldDaikyu.zhText: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版大久和弓。
大久和弓 镀金外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldScarfD.text: Custom edition of the Kyroptera Syandana forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldScarfD.zhText: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版蝙蝠披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldTipedo.text: Custom edition of the Tipedo forged by Tenno artisans.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassAndGoldTipedo.zhText: 经由 Tenno 工匠所打造的订制版提佩多。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassKnucklesDesc.text: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrassKnucklesDesc.zhText: （英文：KOGAKE）这些覆盖物装在使用者的手脚上，能让他们进行激烈又危险的肉搏战而不受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BratonPrimeDesc.text: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BratonPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：BRATON PRIME）一把经典的  奥罗金兵器，布莱顿 Prime 比起标准版，强化了伤害能力以及更大的弹匣。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerAgileAnimsD.text: The Agile Animation Set for Atlas.

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerAltHelmetDe.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Atlas.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerAltHelmetDe.zhText: Atlas 的独特样式替换头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerAltTwoHelme.text: An alternative helmet for the Atlas Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerAltTwoHelme.zhText: Atlas 的独特样式替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerBundleDesc.text: Crush enemies between a rock and a hard place with this assortment of heavy hitting items. Includes the Atlas Warframe, the Sonicor blaster, the Convectrix laser rifle and the jagged Tekko gauntlets. Enhance progression with 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerBundleDesc.zhText: 以各式各样的狠角色使敌人在举步维艰中灰飞烟灭。内含有 Altas 战甲、超音波冲击枪、导热聚焦激光枪，以及锯齿状的铁钩手甲。还有能协助你加快进度，为期 3 天的经验与现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerBundleFeatu.text: Crush enemies between a rock and a hard place.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerBundleFeatu.zhText: 使敌人在举步维艰中灰飞烟灭。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Atlas Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerKnucklesDes.text: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerKnucklesDes.zhText: （英文：TEKKO）这对铁拳的攻击能撕穿敌人，是 Atlas 的标志性武器。在被 Atlas 使用时，它们的触发几率会提升。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerNobleAnimsD.text: The Noble Animation Set for Atlas.

/Lotus/Language/Items/BroncoPrimeDesc.text: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BroncoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：BRONCO PRIME）加入罕见的奥罗金合金，野马 Prime 是一把高效能武器，以射速为代价，提高装弹量和伤害力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BroncoSpectreBluep.text: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BroncoSpectreBluep.zhText: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.

/Lotus/Language/Items/BronzeSpectreDesc.text: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BronzeSpectreDesc.zhText: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BunnyEarsDesc.text: A stylish accessory for your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BunnyEarsDesc.zhText: 给你的战甲一件时尚的饰品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BurstLaserPistolSt.text: Fires a small burst of lasers.

/Lotus/Language/Items/BurstPistolDesc.text: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BurstPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：SICARUS）暗杀者是三发点射手枪，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Items/BurstRifleDesc.text: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
/Lotus/Language/Items/BurstRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：BURSTON）伯斯顿是三发点射步枪，在机枪的杀伤力和半自动的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CSHeliocorDesc.text: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CSHeliocorDesc.zhText: （英文：SYNOID HELIOCOR）这柄智能的锤子吸收被重击击杀的敌人，并将他们改组为友军。这把武器造成的任何致死攻击也会进行一次资料库扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CSReconnasorDesc.text: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CSReconnasorDesc.zhText: （英文：SYNOID GAMMACOR）由中枢苏达所设置，过去曾作为数据分析仪器，但现在已转为专用于自卫的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CSScarfDesc.text: The Synoid Syandana glows more brightly with every scan performed.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CSScarfDesc.zhText: 枢议披饰会在每一次成功的扫描后更加光亮。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CSSimulorDesc.text: Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CSSimulorDesc.zhText: 中枢苏达的自定义改造重力奇点拟成枪，仅只是为了满足她的好奇心所打造。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CameraDesc.text: Deploys a short-lived remote camera that overrides your Warframe optics
/Lotus/Language/Items/CameraDesc.zhText: 设置一个短暂存在的遥控镜头，取代战甲的视角

/Lotus/Language/Items/CandyCaneScytheDes.text: Celebrate the festive season by unleashing sweet minty death on all your favorite foes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CandyCaneScytheDes.zhText: 借由让所有你最喜爱的敌人们喷发出甜美薄荷味的死亡来庆祝这次节日。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CandyCaneScytheNam.zhText: 薄荷口味拐杖糖镰刀外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/CandyCaneScythePac.text: Dress up your Ether Reaper, Hate or Reaper Prime with the festive Spearmint Scythe skin!
/Lotus/Language/Items/CandyCaneScythePac.zhText: 用圣诞薄荷口味拐杖糖镰刀外观装扮你的苍穹死神、憎恨或收割者Prime吧！

/Lotus/Language/Items/CapturedLichTokenD.text: A token symbolizing a converted Kuva Lich. Can be traded to other players for control of said Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CapturedLichTokenD.zhText: 象征着被感化的赤毒玄骸的印记。可以把该赤毒玄骸的控制权交易给其他玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CarrierDefaultSkin.text: The standard issue skin for the Carrier Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CarrierDefaultSkin.zhText: 搬运者的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CarrierPrimaryPrec.text: Carrier will attack the first visible enemy within |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CarrierPrimaryPrec.zhText: 搬运者会攻击 |RANGE| 米范围内的第一名可视敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CarrierPrimeDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Carrier Prime Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CarrierPrimeDefaul.zhText: 搬运者 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CarrierSentinelDes.text: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusDazzlePackDe.text: These bold patterns are designed to confuse the optical processing of both robotic and organic enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusDazzlePackDe.zhText: 这些粗线条的样式设计是为了混淆机器人敌人和有机敌人的光学信息处理用的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusFencerArmorS.text: Derived from Corpus protective technology, the Dendra decorative armor provides a unique look for any Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusFencerArmorS.zhText: 起源于 Corpus 的防护技术，登德拉护甲提供给任何战甲一个独特的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusHandCannonDe.text: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusHandCannonDe.zhText: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusHandRocketLa.text: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusHandRocketLa.zhText: （英文：ANGSTRUM）能够同时发射若干火箭的安格斯壮是一个手持的毁灭工具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusLaserPistolD.text: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusLaserPistolD.zhText: （英文：SPECTRA）原先是为在外太空中进行建设所设计，光谱切割器集中的激光光束在面对有机物和合成物质特别有效。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusMinigunDesc.text: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusMinigunDesc.zhText: （英文：CESTRA）小巧而致命的锡斯特，以越来越快的射速释放能量弹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusPolearmDesc.text: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusPolearmDesc.zhText: （英文：SERRO）能源锯的开发目的原是用以报废淘汰船只，但在赛德娜地区的反抗份子发现它也能用来作为优良的武器使用时，它很快就被禁止使用。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusProfileIconA.zhText: 阿拉德 V 的浮印

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusProfileIconC.text: A glyph of a Corpus Crewman.

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusProfileIconM.text: A glyph of a Corpus MOA

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusProfileIconO.text: A glyph of a Corpus Osprey

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusProfileIconP.text: A collection of glyphs featuring the personnel affiliated with the Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusProfileIconP.zhText: Corpus 相关人员的浮印合集

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusPunchKickWea.text: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusPunchKickWea.zhText: （英文：OBEX）奥比克斯战斗系统能强化 Tenno 的近身肉搏能力，给予目标致命伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusUMPDesc.text: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusUMPDesc.zhText: （英文：TETRA）借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidBadgeDes.text: An insignia awarded to the Tenno who proved themselves during Arid Fear event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidBadgeDes.zhText: 颁发给在沙漠恐惧事件中证明自己的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidCipherDe.text: A cipher used to decode Corpus intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidCipherDe.zhText: 一种用来破解Corpus 电脑密码的解码器。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidDatamass.text: A Corpus datamass containing encrypted intel. Crafting component required to create a CORPUS VOID KEY
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidDatamass.zhText: 一个内含加密情报的 Corpus 数据块。制造CORPUS 虚空钥匙组件所必要的组件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidKeyDesc.text: Corpus Scouts are hiding in the Void. Use this key to find their ships and hunt them down!
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusVoidKeyDesc.zhText: Corpus 侦查员隐藏在虚空中。使用此钥匙可以找到他们的船舰来进行追捕！

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusWhipDesc.text: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusWhipDesc.zhText: （英文：LECTA）一半电击器一半鞭子。这条 Corpus 的勒克塔会对接触到的任何东西发出致命电击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CorruptedLancerBal.text: Deploys a CORRUPTED LANCER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CorruptedLancerBal.zhText: 设置一个为你战斗的堕落枪兵卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CosmeticEnhancerDe.text: Infuse an item with Arcane enhancements
/Lotus/Language/Items/CosmeticEnhancerDe.zhText: 以赋能来强化一项道具

/Lotus/Language/Items/CosmeticUnenhancer.text: Remove an Arcane installed in a helmet or syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CosmeticUnenhancer.zhText: 移除头盔或披饰上的赋能。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CowgirlNobleAnimsD.text: The Noble Animation Set for Mesa.

/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBoosterDesc.text: Doubles the amount of credits you get from pickups and mission rewards.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBoosterDesc.zhText: 将你从拾取和任务奖励中获得的现金数量加倍。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBundleADesc.text: By purchasing this item you can directly exchange <PLATINUM_CREDITS> 25 Platinum for <CREDITS> 50,000 Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBundleADesc.zhText: 通过购买这项道具，你可以直接以<PLATINUM_CREDITS> 25 白金 来兑换<CREDITS> 50,000 现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBundleBDesc.text: By purchasing this item you can directly exchange <PLATINUM_CREDITS> 60 Platinum for <CREDITS> 25,000 Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBundleBDesc.zhText: 通过购买这项道具，你可以直接以<PLATINUM_CREDITS> 60 白金 来兑换<CREDITS> 25,000 现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBundleCDesc.text: By purchasing this item you can directly exchange <PLATINUM_CREDITS> 45 Platinum for <CREDITS> 175,000 Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditBundleCDesc.zhText: 通过购买这项道具，你可以直接以<PLATINUM_CREDITS> 45 白金 来兑换<CREDITS> 175,000 现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditChipLargeDes.text: Give unto The Void a generous 100,000 credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditChipLargeDes.zhText: 献给虚空的一大笔 100，000 元现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditChipMediumDe.zhText: 献给虚空的 10，000 元现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CreditChipSmallDes.zhText: 献给虚空的 1,000 元现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrimsonDervishDesc.zhText: 有如旋风般的强烈攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CronusPrimeDesc.text: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CronusPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：DAKRA PRIME）达克拉 Prime 是一把由 Tenno 锻造的武器，在奥罗金时代被制作出来，并且以其速度，威力跟多目标打击的能力著名。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CronusSwordDesc.text: A strong blade forged using ceramic.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CronusSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：CRONUS）一把用陶瓷打造的强大长剑。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrossBoltDesc.text: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrossBoltDesc.zhText: （英文：BOLTO）螺钉手枪连射速度缓慢，大型的螺钉能把敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrowdDispersionSto.text: Unleashes a |RANGE|m radial knockdown when multiple enemies are nearby, dealing |DAMAGE| Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrowdDispersionSto.zhText: 当周围有复数名敌人时，释放出一道半径 |RANGE| 米的击倒震波，并造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAirPistolArrayD.text: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAirPistolArrayD.zhText: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAladScarfDesc.text: An opulent display of privilege for the Corpus elite becomes a trophy for the Tenno who fight them.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAladScarfDesc.zhText: 一组特別赐给 Corpus 精英华贵展示品，如今成为与之对抗的 Tenno 的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgDesc.text: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgDesc.zhText: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpCircleArmourBun.text: Energize your look with the full set of Porta decorative armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpCircleArmourBun.zhText: 用这套装饰护甲来为你的造型注入活力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpElectroMagDesc.text: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpElectroMagDesc.zhText: （英文：STATICOR）将强大的静电势能射向不幸的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpFreezeRayRifleD.text: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpFreezeRayRifleD.zhText: （英文：GLAXION）发射出一道能暂停分子振动的光子束，造成痛苦的瞬间冻结。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpFreezeRaySnowfl.text: A unique customization for the Glaxion.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpFreezeRaySnowfl.zhText: 冷冻光束步枪的独特自定义外观。
冷冻光束步枪 极地外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoArmArmo.text: This mechanized decorative armor is emblematic of the Corpus design aesthetic.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoArmArmo.zhText: 这种机械化风格的装饰护甲象征了 Corpus 的设计美感。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoArmourB.text: This set of mechanized decorative armor is emblematic of the Corpus design aesthetic.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoArmourB.zhText: 这种机械化风格的装饰护甲象征了 Corpus 的设计美感。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoChestAr.text: This mechanized decorative armor is emblematic of the Corpus design aesthetic.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoChestAr.zhText: 这种机械化风格的装饰护甲象征了 Corpus 的设计美感。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoLegArmo.text: This mechanized decorative armor is emblematic of the Corpus design aesthetic.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpIndexTwoLegArmo.zhText: 这种机械化风格的装饰护甲象征了 Corpus 的设计美感。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpShockRifleDesc.text: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpShockRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：QUANTA）这个武器原本是设计用来在大型小行星上协助挖掘矿物，但现在已更改为应用于军事用途上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpSplitLaserDesc.text: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CrpSplitLaserDesc.zhText: （英文：CONVECTRIX）当双道激光汇聚在目标上时，便会产生回路，将敌人给炸熟。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CryoticDesc.text:
Usually found in extreme sub-zero environments, Cryotic instantly freezes anything it contacts.

Location: Excavation Missions on Venus, Earth, Phobos, Europa, and Neptune
/Lotus/Language/Items/CryoticDesc.zhText:
通常在零度以下的极端环境中可以找到，永冻晶矿可以立即冰冻任何与它接触的东西。

获取地点：金星，地球，火卫一，欧罗巴和海王星上的挖掘任务

/Lotus/Language/Items/CustomizationSlotU.text: additional appearance config slot for this item
/Lotus/Language/Items/CustomizationSlotU.zhText: 为这件物品解锁额外的外观配置槽位

/Lotus/Language/Items/CustomizationSlotU.text: Unlocks an additional appearance config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CustomizationSlotU.zhText: 为这个物品解锁 1 个额外的外观配置槽位，最多 3 个额外槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Items/CutlassPoignardDes.text: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.
/Lotus/Language/Items/CutlassPoignardDes.zhText: （英文：NAMI SKYLA）像暴风雨的汹涌和破坏力一样，精通海波斯库拉对剑的人可以使用这两把不同的武器完成流畅的进攻。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DaedalusArmorSetDe.text: Take your look to the next level with a full set of Daedalus decorative armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DaedalusArmorSetDe.zhText: 用代达罗斯装饰护甲把你的造型提升到一个全新的境界。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DaggerAxeSkinDesc.text: Replaces the edges of the Scindo with multiple Rubedo blades.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DaggerAxeSkinDesc.zhText: 使用多重红化结晶刀片来替换分裂斩斧的边缘部分。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DaggerAxeSkinName.zhText: 分裂斩斧 戈刃外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/DaggerStanceBDesc.zhText: 旋转打击，不断上升的连段。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DamageDebuffKeyDes.text:
Damage is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DamageDebuffKeyDes.zhText:
装备该钥匙，伤害会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DamanPrimeSugatraD.text: A rare jewel from the old empire. Daman Sugatra Prime is crafted from some of the most scarce resources in the System.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DamanPrimeSugatraD.zhText: 一个来自古老帝国的稀有珠宝，达曼 Prime 坠饰是用星系中最罕见的资源所制造的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DangerRoomKeyDesc.text:
Grants access to the Simulacrum.

In the Simulacrum you can face mimeographs of enemies you have fully researched with the Codex.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DangerRoomKeyDesc.zhText:
授权使用幻影装置

在幻影装置中你可以迎战已经调查完毕并写入数据库的敌方单位复制品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DarkDaggerDesc.text: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DarkDaggerDesc.zhText: （英文：DARK DAGGER）这把用黑暗金属锻造的短刃武器，在有限的范围内可以快速出招。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DarkSwordDaggerHyb.text: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DarkSwordDaggerHyb.zhText: （英文：DARK SPLIT-SWORD）能作为强大破坏力的重剑使用，或以近战双持架式将武器化为两把凶残的刀刃。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DarkSwordDesc.text: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DarkSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：DARK SWORD）一把使用暗黑金属制作的长剑，每次攻击都会附带<DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DataFragmentStoreO.text:
Intercepted encrypted fragment of Grineer communications.
This bundle of 1 Tethra Data Fragment can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DataFragmentStoreO.zhText:
被拦截的 Grineer 通讯加密片段信息。
这个内含1个泰斯拉片段信息的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DecreeAgileAnimsDe.text: The Agile Animation Set for Banshee.

/Lotus/Language/Items/DecreeDeluxeArmArm.zhText: 与 Banshee 女高音外观配套的肩甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DecreeNobleAnimsDe.text: The Noble Animation Set for Banshee.

/Lotus/Language/Items/DefenseEventDesc.text: Nothing helps getting through Defense waves like a Dethcube. Also included are some customization options and an affinity booster to make your weekend even better.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DefenseEventDesc.zhText: 没有什么能比的上死亡魔方在防御战中提供的帮助。此外，这个特惠还包含了一些自定义外观与经验值加成，让你的周末更加美满。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DefenseEventName.zhText: 死亡魔方周末活动特惠

/Lotus/Language/Items/DefenseLensDesc.text: Converts 2% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Vazarin Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DefenseLensDesc.zhText: 将 2% 超额的经验值转化为 Vazarin 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DemolitionArchwing.text:
This bundle offers unparalleled opportunity for maximum destruction.

It includes the Elytron Archwing, perfect for the demolition specialist, and comes outfitted with the powerful Onorix axe and Corvas cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DemolitionArchwing.zhText:
为达到最高的破坏力，这个组合包提供了前所未有的一个机会。

内含的鞘翅曲翼，完美地专精于破坏，并配备了强悍的奥努里克斯战斧与黑鸦加农炮。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DemolitionArchwing.text: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DemolitionArchwing.zhText: （英文：ELYTRON）这种重型曲翼只为了一个目的而被设计出来：破坏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DemolitionArchwing.text: This bundle offers unparalleled opportunity for maximum destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DemolitionArchwing.zhText: 为达到最高的破坏力，这个组合包提供了前所未有的一个机会。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DemolitionDefaultA.text: Default skin for the Elytron Archwing.

/Lotus/Language/Items/DeraVandalDesc.text: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DeraVandalDesc.zhText: （英文：DERA VANDAL）这把是定制化版本的德拉步枪，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubeDefaultSki.text: The standard issue skin for the Dethcube Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubeDefaultSki.zhText: 死亡魔方的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubePowerSuitS.text: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubePowerSuitS.zhText: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubePrimeDefau.zhText: 死亡魔方 Prime 外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubePrimeDefau.text: The standard issue skin for the Dethcube Prime Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubePrimeDefau.zhText: 死亡魔方 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DethMachineRifleDe.text: Standard issue weaponry signature to Dethcube.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DethMachineRifleDe.zhText: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE）死亡魔方标准武器

/Lotus/Language/Items/DethcubeCarbuncleS.text: The Carabus skin customization for the Dethcube Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DethcubeCarbuncleS.zhText: 死亡魔方守护的 Carabus 外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DevourerAgileAnims.text: The Agile Animation Set for Grendel.

/Lotus/Language/Items/DevourerNobleAnims.text: The Noble Animation Set for Grendel.

/Lotus/Language/Items/DexDakraDesc.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DexDakraDesc.zhText: （英文：DEX DAKRA）这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份周年纪念礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DexFurisDesc.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DexFurisDesc.zhText: （英文：DEX FURIS）这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份周年纪念礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DexTheThirdDesc.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DexTheThirdDesc.zhText: （英文：DEX SYBARIS）这是 Lotus 为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的 Tenno 所准备的一份 3 周年纪念礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DinoSpikeDesc.text: Once worn exclusively by Orokin Judiciary, the Yamako Syandana is a symbol of wisdom and authority.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DinoSpikeDesc.zhText: 山越披饰是一种传统的 Tenno 服饰。曾经只有奥罗金的法官才能穿戴，山越披饰是智慧和权威的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DistillPointsDesc.text: Loid uses devices in Albrecht's Laboratory to reduce Arcanes to Vosfor, a potent powder for alchemical processes. Speak to Loid to trade Vosfor for Arcanes he has stored in the laboratory.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DistillPointsDesc.zhText: 洛德使用阿尔布雷希特实验室中的装置将赋能分解成荧尘，这是一种用于转换的强效粉末。与洛德对话，用荧尘交换他存放在实验室中的赋能。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnDefaultSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Djinn Sentinel.

/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnDeluxeComplet.text: Become wrapped in mystery with complete set of Gazal skins and armor. Includes bonus Djinn Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnDeluxeComplet.zhText: 用一整套加扎勒外观和护甲来变得神秘，包含额外的引灵守护。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnPrimaryPrecep.text: Djinn will attack the first visible enemy within |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnPrimaryPrecep.zhText: 引灵会攻击 |RANGE| 米范围内的第一名可视敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnPrimeDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Djinn Prime Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnPrimeDefaultS.zhText: 引灵 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnSecondaryPrec.text: Lures enemies near so it can cover them in an acidic burst.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnSecondaryPrec.zhText: 引诱敌人接近将一阵酸液爆破覆盖其上

/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnSentinelDesc.text: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DjinnSentinelDesc.zhText: 以「重击者」和「致命诱惑」为预设指令，引灵是一个战斗守护，还配备了毒镖武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DojoKeyDescription.text: Unlocks access to your Clan's Dojo
/Lotus/Language/Items/DojoKeyDescription.zhText: 解开进入氏族道场的权限

/Lotus/Language/Items/DoubleAffinityPack.text: Dual Ether and the dual-wielded Afuris in one special weekend package. Add in a bonus Affinity Booster to double the speed of leveling them up.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DoubleAffinityPack.zhText: 苍穹双剑以及双持盗贼双枪就在这特别的周末组合包中！附带的经验值加成道具让您的升级速度倍增！

/Lotus/Language/Items/DragonKatanaDesc.text: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DragonKatanaDesc.zhText: （英文：DRAGON NIKANA）龙之侍刃是以古代 Tenno 特制的钢铁所铸成。这是大师的武器，只有武艺修为能与之相配的 Tenno 能使用它。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DragonPackDesc.text: Get the Chroma Warframe and the latest weaponry to hit the market, along with boosters to level your new gear faster!
/Lotus/Language/Items/DragonPackDesc.zhText: 取得 Chroma 战甲与最新上市的武器，组合包内含加成道具使您的装备升级更加快速！

/Lotus/Language/Items/DrakeRifleDesc.text: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DrakeRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：TIBERON）由大师级枪械制造工匠打造的这把 Tenno 三连发步枪可以迅速精确地击倒目标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualAxeDesc.text: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualAxeDesc.zhText: （英文：DUAL ZOREN）双手各为轴心挥砍。高攻速且能同时攻击多目标。高暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualCorpusMinigunD.text: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualCorpusMinigunD.zhText: （英文：DUAL CESTRA）双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualDaggerAxeSkinD.text: Replaces the edges of the Dual Zoren with multiple Rubedo blades.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualDaggerAxeSkinD.zhText: 使用多个红化结晶刀片替换佐伦双斧的边缘。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualDaggerAxeSkinN.zhText: 佐伦双斧 戈刃外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualDaggerDesc.text: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualDaggerDesc.zhText: （英文：FANG）这对纤细的短剑有着增强的攻速并且能发动旋风般的多重攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualDaggerStanceAD.text: Strong, focused attacks with multi-hit spins.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualDaggerStanceAD.zhText: 强劲，多段命中的旋转集中攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualEtherDaggerDes.text: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualEtherDaggerDes.zhText: （英文：ETHER DAGGERS）为了强化其对单体攻击而减短苍穹刀身的长度的苍穹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualEtherSwordDesc.text: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualEtherSwordDesc.zhText: 迅速而精准。正因为苍穹双剑干净利落的斩击，使得 Tenno 认为它是「净化」受到感染的盟友时更慈悲的武器。苍穹双剑一次能击中复数敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualHeatSwordDesc.text: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualHeatSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：DUAL HEAT SWORDS）每只手紧握一把烈焰之剑，双倍加强敌人在炽热中消亡的速度。能同时攻击多个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualKamasDesc.text: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualKamasDesc.zhText: （英文：DUAL KAMAS）两手各挥舞一把短柄战镰产生野蛮的<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害来对抗敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualShortSwordDesc.text: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualShortSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：DUAL SKANA）每只手拿一把较短的空刃。能同时攻击多个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualSwordStanceBDe.text: Multi-angle strikes and deadly thrust attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualSwordStanceBDe.zhText: 多重角度攻击和致命刺击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DualVastosDesc.text: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Language/Items/DualVastosDesc.zhText: （英文：AKVASTO）双手各持一把瓦斯托左轮手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/DusklightSarraceni.zhText: 从尘光瓶子草中萃取出的精华物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EMPPushAbilityDesc.text: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EMPPushAbilityDesc.zhText: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EdoPrimeChestPlate.text: This golden decorative armor honors master warriors long since forgotten.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EdoPrimeChestPlate.zhText: 这套金饰护甲将荣耀带给了那些被遗忘已久的战斗大师。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EdoPrimeKneePlates.text: This golden decorative armor honors master warriors long since forgotten.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EdoPrimeKneePlates.zhText: 这套金饰护甲将荣耀带给了那些被遗忘已久的战斗大师。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EdoPrimeShoulderPl.text: This golden decorative armor honors master warriors long since forgotten.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EdoPrimeShoulderPl.zhText: 这套金饰护甲将荣耀带给了那些被遗忘已久的战斗大师。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EggHatcherDesc.text: This device facilitates the growth of a Kubrow or Kavat clone, from birth to adolescence.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EggHatcherDesc.zhText: 这个装置能让库狛克隆体或库娃克隆体从出生成长至幼年时期。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ElectricPackDesc.text: Get Volt and all his favorite gear.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ElectricPackDesc.zhText: 获得 Volt 和他的御用装备。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EliteAlertBadgeDes.text: A symbol of survival. Worn by those who have entered Arbitration and lived.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EliteAlertBadgeDes.zhText: 幸存的标志。由那些经历仲裁并存活之人佩戴。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ElitiumDesc.text:
Awarded by the Arbiters of Hexis to the few Tenno capable of surviving Arbitration.

Location: Arbitration Missions
/Lotus/Language/Items/ElitiumDesc.zhText:
由均衡仲裁者授予少数能从仲裁中幸存的 Tenno。

获取地点：仲裁任务

/Lotus/Language/Items/EnergyRifleDesc.text: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EnergyRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：DERA）德拉是一把射出高热电浆的连发步枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EnergyScarfDesc.text: A traditional Tenno garment, this Syandana is woven from ancient, Orokin synthetic thread.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EnergyScarfDesc.zhText: 传统 Tenno 服装，这条披饰源自远古时期，由奥罗金合成纤维所编织而成。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EosArmorSetDesc.text: Make a bold statement with a full set of Eos decorative armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EosArmorSetDesc.zhText: 大胆保证内有全套的曙光女神装饰护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EquinoxDayNobleAni.text: The Day Noble Animation Set for Equinox.

/Lotus/Language/Items/EquinoxNightNobleA.text: The Night Noble Animation Set for Equinox.

/Lotus/Language/Items/EquinoxNobleAnimsD.text: The Noble Animation Set for Equinox.

/Lotus/Language/Items/ErosionCapeDesc.text: Evokes stone scarred but not destroyed by the sea's tireless onslaught.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ErosionCapeDesc.zhText: 让人联想起那被不休海潮冲刷得伤痕累累却又没有破裂的巨石。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EtherScytheDesc.text: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EtherScytheDesc.zhText: （英文：ETHER REAPER）采用与苍穹之剑相同材质来锻造刀身，让苍穹镰刀迅速的为受害者献上死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Items/EtherSwordDesc.text: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/EtherSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：ETHER SWORD）苍穹之剑的斩切非常锐利，是一把精准的刀刃，被认为是 Tenno 用来清除受感染伙伴的慈悲武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcaliburUmbraSekh.text: A symbol held sacred by a shadowy order of Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcaliburUmbraSekh.zhText: 被遵循暗影之道的 Tenno 视为神圣的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcaliburXboneHelm.zhText: Excalibur 战甲的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcaliburXbonePack.text:
Show your power and mystique with the Xbox One Exclusive Warframe®: Prestige Pack I.

Emanating with the colors of Xbox One, the Exclusive Jade Excalibur Skin will make your allegiance clear on the field of battle. 

Also included is Platinum to super charge your arsenal.

This Pack includes:
- 170 Platinum
- Xbox One Exclusive Excalibur Jade Skin*

* SKIN ONLY, Excalibur Warframe not included.

This item may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcaliburXbonePack.zhText:
用 Xbox One 限定版的 Warframe®: 荣耀威望包 I 展现你的神秘和力量。让 Xbox One 的颜色迸发，限定版 碧玉 Excalibur 外观会在战场上明确地展现你的忠诚。

组合包中还包含扩充军械库的白金。

这个组合包中包含:
- 170 白金
- Xbox One 限定版 Excalibur 翡翠外观*

* 只含外观，Excalibur 战甲不包含在其中。

每个账号只限购买这个物品一次。
荣耀威望包 I - 限定版

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcaliburXboneSkin.zhText: Excalibur 战甲的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcavationEventBad.text: Awarded to Tenno for their contribution to the Cryotic Front event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ExcavationEventBad.zhText: 奖励给那些在永冻晶矿前线活动中做出贡献的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExhaustTrailAbilit.text: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ExhaustTrailAbilit.zhText: 将曲翼推进器核心中的气体排出，混淆并使敌方导弹引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExhaustTrailAugmen.text: Core Vent Augment: <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage ignites exhaust fumes for |DURATION|s. Enemies passing through the flames take |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ExhaustTrailAugmen.zhText: 核心通气强化:<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害会将废气点燃 |DURATION| 秒，穿过其中的敌人会受到 |DAMAGE| <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ExtinguishedKeyBlu.text: Blueprint required to craft the Extinguished Dragon Key. Damage is greatly reduced while key is equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ExtinguishedKeyBlu.zhText: 制作熄灭龙钥的需求蓝图。装备该钥匙，伤害会极大的降低。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FairyAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Titania.

/Lotus/Language/Items/FairyAltHelmetDesc.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Titania.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FairyAltHelmetDesc.zhText: Titania 的独特样式替换用头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FairyNobleAnimsDes.text: The Noble Animation Set for Titania.

/Lotus/Language/Items/FalseProfitAccesso.text: A sigil and an emblem commemorating the Tenno's victory over Nef Anyo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FalseProfitAccesso.zhText: 纹章和徽章各一枚以纪念 Tenno 战胜奈富·安尤。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FalseProfitEventBa.text: An emblem awarded to all those who helped foil the machinations of Nef Anyo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FalseProfitEventBa.zhText: 一枚徽章奖励给所有同心协力破坏奈富·安尤阴谋的勇士们。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FalseProfitEventMo.text: A collection of Mods that apply bonus <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FalseProfitEventMo.zhText: 一组包含额外<DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击伤害的 MOD。
变造利益行动 Mod 包

/Lotus/Language/Items/FangPrimeDesc.text: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FangPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：FANG PRIME）一组来自奥罗金时代的仪式匕首，狼牙 Prime 的攻击使刀片猛烈共振，这使得它们能够轻易刺穿坚硬材质如护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FemaleS2HelmetPack.text: A series 2 helmet for Banshee, Ember, Nyx, Mag, Saryn, Trinity and Nova!
/Lotus/Language/Items/FemaleS2HelmetPack.zhText: Banshee，Ember，Nyx，Mag，Saryn，Trinity 和 Nova 的第二系列头盔！

/Lotus/Language/Items/FemaleSuitPackBDes.text: Unlock Saryn, Banshee and Nyx Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FemaleSuitPackBDes.zhText: 解锁 Saryn、 Banshee 和 Nyx 三副战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FemaleSuitPackDesc.text: Unlock Mag, Trinity, and Ember Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FemaleSuitPackDesc.zhText: 解锁 Mag、 Trinity 和 Ember 三副战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FerriteDesc.text:
Alloy pellets used in Grineer manufacturing.

Location: Mercury, Earth, Lua, Neptune, and the Void
/Lotus/Language/Items/FerriteDesc.zhText:
Grineer 在制造过程中使用的合金块。

获取地点：水星，地球，月球，海王星和虚空

/Lotus/Language/Items/FerriteStoreOverri.text:
Alloy pellets used in Grineer manufacturing.
This bundle of 3,000 Ferrite can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FerriteStoreOverri.zhText:
Grineer 在制造过程中使用的合金块。
这个内含 3,000 个铁氧体的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FinSwordDesc.text: An enigmatic blade of unknown origin. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FinSwordDesc.zhText: 一把来源不明的神秘长剑。具有极高的暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FireFlyScarfDesc.text: This wing-like syandana invokes the beauty and agility of the Ceresean Butterfly Sparrow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FireFlyScarfDesc.zhText: 这件翼状般的披饰呼应着自谷神蝶雀的美丽与轻灵。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FireShieldAbilityD.text: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
/Lotus/Language/Items/FireShieldAbilityD.zhText: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FireShieldAugmentA.text: Energy Shell Augment: Energy Shell applies to allies within |val|m.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FireShieldAugmentA.zhText: 能量护罩强化：能量护罩能作用在 |val| 米范围内的队友身上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FireSigilDesc.text: Show the burning passion in your heart.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FireSigilDesc.zhText: 展现出你内心中燃烧的激情。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FireworksCrateDesc.text: Want a more spectacular fireworks display to show your patriotism? Celebrate in style with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FireworksCrateDesc.zhText: 想要以更壮观的烟火表演来展现你的爱国精神吗？以这个仅限一次使用的道具来庆祝吧。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FireworksSingleDes.text: Celebrate the holiday with fireworks! Light up the sky with this single use consumable item.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FireworksSingleDes.zhText: 用烟火来欢庆假日！以这个仅限一次使用的道具来点亮整片天空吧。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FistDesc.text: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FistDesc.zhText: （英文：FURAX）这动力拳套较大部分近战武器距离更短，但在近战中表现更为优秀。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FistStanceADesc.text: Fast, multi-hit strikes with powerful finishers.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FistStanceADesc.zhText: 快速，多次命中的打击与强力的处决攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FistStanceBDesc.zhText: 有条不紊的近距离组合攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FistStanceCDesc.zhText: 快速的打击与强烈猛击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FiveShotSniperRifl.text: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FiveShotSniperRifl.zhText: （英文：RUBICO）以这把长距离转轮式步枪彻底探清敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FlameScarfDesc.text: During the Orokin Era, only the most fierce warriors were permitted to wear this flaming Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FlameScarfDesc.zhText: 在奥罗金时代，只有最凶猛的战士们才被准许穿戴这件火焰般的披饰

/Lotus/Language/Items/FlareCounterMeasur.text: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FlareCounterMeasur.zhText: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FlowerPowerPolearm.text: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FlowerPowerPolearm.zhText: （英文：TONBO）在远古之战中最黑暗的那几天中，许多 Tenno 仅能靠着蜻蛉薙生还下来。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FomorianNegatorDes.text: When activated, it disrupts a Fomorian core's Omega energy field, making it vulnerable. Also shields Tenno from Omega radiation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FomorianNegatorDes.zhText: 启动时它会破坏巨人战舰核心的奥米伽能量力场，使其变得脆弱易损。并为暴露在奥米伽辐射中的 Tenno 提供庇护。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FomorianRevengeMod.text: A series of Mods awarded to players who contributed to the Eyes of Blight event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FomorianRevengeMod.zhText: 一系列 MOD 给予在毁灭之眼事件付出心力的玩家。
毁灭之眼 Mod 组合包

/Lotus/Language/Items/FomorianRevengeSki.text: Includes the FLUCTUS RAHK SKIN and the EYES OF BLIGHT EMBLEM.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FomorianRevengeSki.zhText: 内含拉克巨浪外观与毁灭之眼徽章

/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsEasterEgg.text: Mark the path to a new season with a trail of decorative eggs - only for a limited time!
/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsEasterEgg.zhText: 布置装饰性蛋来标记通往新季节的道路-只在限定的时间内！

/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsEidolonDe.text: Move as the Eidolons and burn the ground coldly with footsteps of shimmering Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsEidolonDe.zhText: 像夜灵般移步，以闪烁的虚空能量，无情地践踏并焚烧地面。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsElectrica.text: Your Warframe leaves crackling footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsElectrica.zhText: 让战甲在身后留下劈啪作响的足迹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsHeatDesc.text: Your Warframe leaves flaming footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsHeatDesc.zhText: 让战甲在身后留下火焰般的足迹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsIceDesc.text: Your Warframe leaves icy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsIceDesc.zhText: 让战甲在身后留下结冰的足迹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsMapleDesc.text: Leave a trail of fireflies and forest leaves in your wake.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsMapleDesc.zhText: 在你身后留下一道萤火虫和树叶的足迹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsPetalsDes.text: Your Warframe leaves grassy footprints in its wake.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FootstepsPetalsDes.zhText: 让战甲在身后留下绿意盎然的足迹。
