/Lotus/Language/Items/FormaDesc.text: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FormaDesc.zhText: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FormaOmniDesc.text:
Modifies any slot to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.

*Umbra Polarity not included.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FormaOmniDesc.zhText:
改变任何槽位以与任何 Mod 极性兼容。

*不包括 Umbra 极性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FormaPackDesc.zhText: 内含 3 个 Forma 的组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeDisci.text: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Disciple within the Tenno ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeDisci.zhText: 这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的门徒阶级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeGrand.text: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Grand Master within the Tenno ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeGrand.zhText: 这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的大宗师阶级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeHunte.text: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Hunter within the Tenno ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeHunte.zhText: 这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的巡猎者阶级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeMaste.text: This emblem signifies the wearer as being a Master within the Tenno ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FoundersBadgeMaste.zhText: 这枚徽章代表着佩戴者是 Tenno 中的大师阶级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FrostDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Frost 寒地牛怪的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/FrostDeluxeSuitDes.text: From winter's forest a dark warrior emerges to protect his flock.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FrostDeluxeSuitDes.zhText: 为了保护他的族群，一位暗影战士从严冬的森林中浮现。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FrostPrimeImmortal.text: The Immortal skin for the Frost Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/FrostleafExtractDe.zhText: 从霜叶中萃取出的精华物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FuraxWraithDesc.text: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FuraxWraithDesc.zhText: （英文：FURAX WRAITH）这些亡魂手套已经在力量上得到了强化。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FurisVekeskBluepri.text: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FurisVekeskBluepri.zhText: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.

/Lotus/Language/Items/FurtiveKubrowDesc.text: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.
/Lotus/Language/Items/FurtiveKubrowDesc.zhText: 一个隐秘的伙伴，以惊人的爆炸力量出其不意地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/FusionPartDesc.text: Consumed in the fusion process to power up existing Mods.

/Lotus/Language/Items/GLAPistolDesc.text: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GLAPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：MARELOK）玛瑞火枪因为后坐力高而缺乏准度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GLARifleDesc.text: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GLARifleDesc.zhText: （英文：GRINLOK）凭借极高的精确度，葛恩火枪这把杠杆作用连发步枪可以轻而易举地找到任何目标的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GalliumDesc.text:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.

Location: Mars and Uranus
/Lotus/Language/Items/GalliumDesc.zhText:
用于微电子和能量武器的软金属。

获取地点：火星和天王星

/Lotus/Language/Items/GalliumStoreOverri.text:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.
This bundle of 1 Gallium can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GalliumStoreOverri.zhText:
用于微电子和能量武器的软金属。
这个内含1个镓的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GearHuntingOnly.text: This item will be automatically available from the Gear Menu while tracking animals.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GearHuntingOnly.zhText: 在追踪动物时，该物品会自动在携带装备菜单中显示。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GearMutuallyExclus.zhText: 当目前正装备着|ITEMA| 时无法装备|ITEMB|！

/Lotus/Language/Items/GearTackleboxOnly.text: This item will be automatically available from the Gear Menu while fishing.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GearTackleboxOnly.zhText: 该道具在钓鱼时于道具菜单自动可用。

/Lotus/Language/Items/Gear_HeavyWeaponNo.text: Must have a heavy weapon equipped to use summon. Heavy weapons can be equipped in the Vehicles mode of the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/Gear_HeavyWeaponNo.zhText: 必须拥有重型武器才能使用召唤。重型武器可于军械库的载具模式中进行装备。

/Lotus/Language/Items/Gear_MechQuestRequ.text: You must complete The War Within to awaken the ability to use Necramechs.
/Lotus/Language/Items/Gear_MechQuestRequ.zhText: 你必须要完成《内战》系列任务才能解锁使用殁世机甲的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericControllerC.text: A cursor style when using controller.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericControllerC.zhText: 使用控制器时的指针样式。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericLensOstronB.text: Transforms a Greater Lens into an Eidolon Lens.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericLensOstronB.zhText: 将高级晶体转换为夜灵晶体

/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericMouseCursor.text: A cursor style when using mouse.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericMouseCursor.zhText: 使用鼠标时的指针样式。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericOperatorDri.text: A fashionable accessory for your Operator or Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericOperatorDri.zhText: 给指挥官或漂泊者使用的时尚配件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GenericSuitCustomi.zhText: 选择要进行赋能的道具

/Lotus/Language/Items/GhostAbilityAugmen.text: When Ghost invisibility is broken, Shade's owner is granted +|DAMAGE|% Weapon Damage for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GhostAbilityAugmen.zhText: 当幽灵的隐身破除时，阴影的拥有者将获得 +|DAMAGE|% 武器伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GhostAbilityDesc.text: Cloaks owner when enemies are within |RANGE|m. The cloak is disrupted if owner attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GhostAbilityDesc.zhText: 当敌人靠近至 |RANGE| 米范围内时自动隐匿主人，若攻击将会中断隐匿。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GhostBrushExtractD.zhText: 从鬼影之拂中萃取出的精华物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GlaiveStanceBDesc.zhText: 周身环绕的切斩与甩击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GlassAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Gara.

/Lotus/Language/Items/GlassNobleAnimsDes.text: The Noble Animation Set for Gara.

/Lotus/Language/Items/GlyphBundleADesc.zhText: 内含一套浮印的组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GoldSpectreDesc.text: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GoldSpectreDesc.zhText: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GolemRaidBadgeDesc.text: A fragment of the Jordas Golem worn as a trophy by those who defeated him.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GolemRaidBadgeDesc.zhText: 将 Jordas 魔像的碎片佩戴在身上，作为击败他的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GolemTrialsDesc.text:
Jordas lied to us, he wasn't the last of his kind and now a new much larger Golem looms. Destroy this menace before it reproduces any further.

This is a key for a TRIAL mission, work with up to 8 Tenno in order to solve problems and defeat the enemy. This mission can be initiated from Eris.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GolemTrialsDesc.zhText:
Jordas 欺骗我们，他并不是唯一被感染的中枢而现在有一具更巨大的新魔像隐约现形。在此一威胁进一步复制繁殖之前摧毁它。

这是一把试炼任务的钥匙，最多可与八名 Tenno 合作抵御敌人，突破挑战。此任务可从阋神星加入。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GoodStuffDropChanc.text: Doubles the chance to drop good items.

/Lotus/Language/Items/GorgonWraithDesc.text: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GorgonWraithDesc.zhText: （英文：GORGON WRAITH）蛇发女妖·亡魂是其前身的强大变体，以它独特的风格为特色。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreatSwordDesc.text: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreatSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：GRAM）这把名为格拉姆的大剑以其强大的斩击力令人闻风丧胆，需要巨力才可挥舞自如。其攻击可以击中多名敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterAttackLensD.text: Converts 3% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Madurai Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterAttackLensD.zhText: 将 3% 超额的经验值转化为 Madurai 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterDefenseLens.text: Converts 3% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Vazarin Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterDefenseLens.zhText: 将 3% 超额的经验值转化为 Vazarin 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterPowerLensDe.text: Converts 3% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Zenurik Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterPowerLensDe.zhText: 将 3% 超额的经验值转化为 Zenurik 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterRandomProje.text: Contains a Greater Relic Pack, featuring 6 Random Relics, two guaranteed Rare Relics and 20 Void Traces.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterRandomProje.zhText: 包含一个优异遗物包，内含6个随机遗物，2个保证是稀有，并且带有20个虚空光体。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterRandomProje.text: 6 Random Relics, two guaranteed Rare. What secrets exist within them?
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterRandomProje.zhText: 6个随机遗物，2个保证是稀有。在其里面有什么秘密呢？

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterTacticLensD.text: Converts 3% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Naramon Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterTacticLensD.zhText: 将 3% 超额的经验值转化为 Naramon 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterWardLensDes.text: Converts 3% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Unairu Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GreaterWardLensDes.zhText: 将 3% 超额的经验值转化为 Unairu 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrendelHelmetKeyNa.zhText: Grendel 头部神经光元定位装置

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrendelKeyDesc.text: Reveals sites on Europa likely to contain Grendel part blueprints.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrendelKeyDesc.zhText: 揭示了欧罗巴上可能有 Grendel 部件蓝图的节点。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerAkimboPisto.text: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerAkimboPisto.zhText: （英文：TWIN GREMLINS）这把 Grineer 随身武器被设计成一对，虽然开火速度较慢，但有更强大的火力和准确性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerAssaultRifl.text: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerAssaultRifl.zhText: （英文：GRAKATA）装备了巨大弹匣，拥有非凡的射速。葛拉卡达是 Grineer 枪兵的首选。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoGorgonD.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Gorgon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoGorgonD.zhText: 给蛇发女妖使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoGorgonN.zhText: 蛇发女妖 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoGrakata.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Grakata.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoGrakata.zhText: 给葛拉卡达使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。
葛拉卡达 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoGremlin.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Gremlins.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoGremlin.zhText: 给小精灵使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。
双子小精灵 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoKrakenD.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Kraken.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoKrakenD.zhText: 给北海巨妖使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoKrakenN.zhText: 北海巨妖 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoSkinBun.text: A desert camouflage skin pack for your Grineer arsenal. Contains 7 weapon skins.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoSkinBun.zhText: 为你呈现 Grineer 军械库的沙漠迷彩外观包。包含七个武器外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoSobekDe.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Sobek.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoSobekDe.zhText: 给鳄神使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoSobekNa.zhText: 鳄神 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoTwinVip.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Twin Vipers.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoTwinVip.zhText: 给双子蝰蛇使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。
双子蝰蛇 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoViperDe.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Viper.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoViperDe.zhText: 给蝰蛇使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoViperNa.zhText: 蝰蛇 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoVulkarD.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Vulkar.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoVulkarD.zhText: 给金工火神使用的沙漠伪装迷彩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCamoVulkarN.zhText: 金工火神 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerChampionsPr.text: A collection of glyphs featuring the Executioners of the Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerChampionsPr.zhText: 一款以死亡角斗场行刑者为特色的浮印包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCombatKnife.text: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCombatKnife.zhText: （英文：SHEEV）专为近身战斗设计，希芙的等离子刀刃能轻而易举切开肉体与护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCordMeleeDa.text: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Tantu Sugatra is based on a Grineer design.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCordMeleeDa.zhText: 由Grineer 设计的坦图坠饰能展现出使用者的武术技巧与技术。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarre.text: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarre.zhText: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDualCleaver.text: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDualCleaver.zhText: （英文：DUAL CLEAVERS）双持野蛮刀刃来屠宰你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerFlakCannonD.text: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerFlakCannonD.zhText: （英文：DRAKGOON）龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射的高热弹片。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerFlyingDrone.text: Fitted with cloaking technology, this Grineer observation drone collects battlefield information and supports tactical deployments.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerFlyingDrone.zhText: Grineer 无人侦察机佣有隐形技术，用来收集战场信息和支援战术部署。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerGooGunDesc.text: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerGooGunDesc.zhText: （英文：STUG）史特克凝胶枪能发射出一种粘稠、有毒的爆炸混合物。且具有多种发射模式，在各种情况下都能造成最大伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHandCannonD.text: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHandCannonD.zhText: （英文：BRAKK）简单但威力强大，半自动布拉克手枪小型的枪身中却拥有强大的冲击火力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHeavyHammer.text: This variation of the Hammer has 5% faster Swing Speed, but -1s Combo Duration.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHeavyHammer.zhText: 这个重锤的变种可将挥动速度提高 5%，但同时会将连击持续时间减少 1 秒。
布洛克外观 重击巨锤

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHeavyPistol.text: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHeavyPistol.zhText: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerJetPolearmD.text: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerJetPolearmD.zhText: （英文：JAT KITTAG）Grineer 所制造的喷射动力锤能造成粉碎性的打击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerLightPistol.text: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerLightPistol.zhText: （英文：VIPER）Grineer 军械库中小巧轻便的代名词。蝰蛇是一把弹匣容量细小的全自动手枪，其精简化的弹匣为其带来高射速及惊人的重新装填速度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerM16RifleDes.text: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerM16RifleDes.zhText: （英文：KARAK）结实、可靠又致命。卡拉克是很多Grineer小队的一把标准配置步枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerMacheteDesc.text: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerMacheteDesc.zhText: （英文：MACHETE）Grineer 制造的一把凶猛近战兵器，多数由精锐力量携带。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerMicrowavePi.text: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerMicrowavePi.zhText: （英文：NUKOR）创造并聚焦一个高频率的微波场，从内部将目标确确实实地烤熟。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerPackDesc.text: Use the Grineer's power and brutality against them with this special assault package.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerPackDesc.zhText: 利用这特殊突击组合包把 Grineer 的力量与残暴施与对方。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerProfileIcon.text: A collection of glyphs featuring the military personnel of the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerProfileIcon.zhText: Grineer 军事人员的浮印总集。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerSawbladeGun.text: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerSawbladeGun.zhText: （英文：MITER）米特尔发射高速锯片，撕裂任何不幸在其路径上的人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerSniperRifle.text: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerSniperRifle.zhText: （英文：VULKAR）Grineer 为其精锐部队制造，金工火神是一把毁灭性的远程兵器。在正确的使用者手中它能在目标进入攻击距离之前将其迅速放倒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerStaffDesc.text: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerStaffDesc.zhText: （英文：AMPHIS）以 Grineer 材料制成，设计为海军陆战队使用，双头蛇是一把为了附带电击伤害而接受了大幅改造的传统棍棒武器——跳跃攻击附带电击伤害。可以同时打击多个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerTrialsDesc.text:
Vay Hek's Fomorian assault on our Relays was devastating but he failed to break us. Now we take the fight back to him. Now we exact justice.

This is a key for a TRIAL mission that has been designed to be challenging for 8-players, and can be initiated from Earth.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerTrialsDesc.zhText:
虽然韦·海克的巨人战舰对我方中继站的袭击造成了毁灭性的伤害，但他并未因此击倒我们。现在该是以牙还牙的时候了，就在此刻，我们实践正义。

这是一把可以加入地球上试炼任务的钥匙。该任务极富挑战性、专为八名玩家组成的团队所设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerTurbineArmo.text: This prototype Grineer Exo-Armor was destined to be worn by Grineer generals until it was stolen and repurposed by Tenno agents. Wear it as a sign of defiance.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerTurbineArmo.zhText: 这套 Grineer 的外部护甲原型本应由 Grineer 将军穿戴，直到它被 Tenno 特工偷走并另作用途。穿上这套护甲以作为反抗的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerTurbineSyan.text: A syandana of Grineer design. Matches the Harkonar Armor Set.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerTurbineSyan.zhText: 由 Grineer 设计的披饰。与哈库那护甲套装配套。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnAntiAirGunDesc.text: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnAntiAirGunDesc.zhText: （英文：GRATTLER）这把毁灭性的曲翼火炮能发射爆裂弹来击碎你的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnArchHandDesc.text: Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat. Designed by the infamous Tyl Regor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnArchHandDesc.zhText: （英文：KNUX）为曲翼近距离作战所制的镓合金动力拳套。由恶名昭彰的泰尔·雷工设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnArchHandFeature.text: Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnArchHandFeature.zhText: 为曲翼近距离作战所制的镓合金动力拳套。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnBannerCapeDesc.text: Add insult to injury by mocking the Grineer with their own banner.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnBannerCapeDesc.zhText: 借 Grineer 自己的旗帜来嘲弄、羞辱他们。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnBoomerangDesc.text: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnBoomerangDesc.zhText: （英文：HALIKAR）这个Grineer 喷射动力飞锤，其冲击足以解除被击中者的武装，且投掷后总是能回到使用者手上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnDualFireAxeDesc.text: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnDualFireAxeDesc.zhText: （英文：TWIN BASOLK）这对棘手凶恶的小型短斧斩铁如泥，断钢如削肉。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnFlameSpearPartD.text: Used in the construction of Javloks

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnGorgSniperRifle.text: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnGorgSniperRifle.zhText: （英文：BUZLOK）标记目标，并射出密集的弹幕，巴兹火枪的制导子弹永远能够找到敌人。被标记的敌人更容易遭到暴击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnGrenadeLauncher.text: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnGrenadeLauncher.zhText: （英文：TONKOR）以这把 Grineer 榴弹发射器对敌人猛烈射出暴乱与破坏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnHarpoonGunDesc.text: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnHarpoonGunDesc.zhText: （英文：HARPAK）以这把爆裂鱼叉枪卷起敌人，或将他们钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnHeatGunDesc.text: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnHeatGunDesc.zhText: （英文：ATOMOS）这把粒子加农炮能产生由超高温等离子体凝聚而成的射线。而这种射线可以用来冶炼矿石，也可以将敌人化为熔渣。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnMeleeDangleDesc.text: Only Grineer who have proven their strength in combat can brandish these.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnMeleeDangleDesc.zhText: 唯有在战斗中证明了自身实力的 Grineer 才能挥舞炫耀这件坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnSeaLabEventBadg.text: An emblem awarded the Tenno who fought to destroy Tyl Regor's cloning labs.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnSeaLabEventBadg.zhText: 这枚徽章是颁发给成功打击破坏了泰尔·雷工的克隆实验室的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnSeaLabEventWeap.text: Determined by the winning side of the Operation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnSeaLabEventWeap.zhText: 奖励将由获胜的行动方来决定。
德拉·破坏者 vs.卡拉克·亡魂

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnSparkRifleDesc.text: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnSparkRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：KOHM ）寇恩热能枪在每一次高速连续的射击时都会额外击发出一发能量弹，使其更具杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTorpedoPistolDe.text: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTorpedoPistolDe.zhText: （英文：KULSTAR）使用这把手持集束火箭发射器，对敌人投以地狱之火。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTridentDesc.text: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTridentDesc.zhText: （英文：SYDON）这柄沉重的 Grineer 三叉戟能造成极致的毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTubeScarfDesc.text: A prototype destined for one of Tyl Regor’s experiments, this syandana has been repurposed for Tenno Agents.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTubeScarfDesc.zhText: 原为泰尔·雷工众多实验之一的预定原型，这件披饰现已易主为 Tenno 特工所使用。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoAckBru.text: This camouflage pattern was employed by one of the most lethally efficient Grineer corps.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoAckBru.zhText: 这种迷彩样式曾受到 Grineer 中一支最强大而致命的部队所青睐。
认知 & 冲击 夜巡者外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoBundle.text: This bundle of weapon skins suits the Ack & Brunt, Ogris and Nukor. They have been modeled after the camouflage employed by the Nightwatch Corps, an elite squadron in the Grineer Military.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoBundle.zhText: 这份武器外观组合包适用于认知 & 冲击，食人女魔与努寇微波枪。自从 Grineer 最精锐的夜巡者部队用采了迷彩涂装之后，此外观即成了争相仿效的样式。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoFeatur.text: A bundle of weapon skins fashioned after the camouflage employed by an elite Grineer Corps
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoFeatur.zhText: 根据 Grineer 精英军团所采用的迷彩而制的一组武器外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoNukorD.text: This camouflage pattern was employed by one of the most lethally efficient Grineer corps.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoNukorD.zhText: 这种迷彩样式曾受到 Grineer 中一支最强大而致命的部队所青睐。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoNukorN.zhText: 努寇微波枪 夜巡者外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoOgrisD.text: This camouflage pattern was employed by one of the most lethally efficient Grineer corps.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoOgrisD.zhText: 这种迷彩样式曾受到 Grineer 中一支最强大而致命的部队所青睐。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnUrbanCamoOgrisN.zhText: 食人女魔 夜巡者外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnWhipDesc.text: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnWhipDesc.zhText: （英文：ATTERAX）擅长将皮肤从骨头上剥下的多刃鞭。在极端情况下，不听话的 Grineer 可以用阿特拉克斯判处死刑。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnWindUpPistolDes.text: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GrnWindUpPistolDes.zhText: （英文：KOHMAK）像稍大的寇恩热能枪，这把手持霰弹枪连续射击时都会加倍射出能量弹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GuardKubrowDesc.text: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GuardKubrowDesc.zhText: 强大的守护者，专注于通过加强防御和驱赶攻击者来保护其主人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GuardianStoreItemD.text: Boosts owner's shield by |BOOST|% when it runs out.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GuardianStoreItemD.zhText: 在主人护盾耗尽时为其补充|BOOST|% 护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GuideOfTheLotusArm.text: An ornate set of shoulder armor worn by the Guides of the Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GuideOfTheLotusArm.zhText: 由 Lotus 的向导身着的一套华丽肩甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GunbladeStanceADes.text: Bullets spray between wicked slash attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GunbladeStanceADes.zhText: 在连续的凶狠斩击之间开火射击

/Lotus/Language/Items/GunbladeStanceBDes.zhText: 枪火与刀锋交织的华丽漫舞。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GunslingerAltHelme.text: A uniquely-styled alternate helmet for Mesa.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GunslingerAltHelme.zhText: Mesa 的独特样式替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GunslingerBundleDe.text: Get shooting with Mesa and her favorite weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GunslingerBundleDe.zhText: 用 Mesa 与她最钟爱的武器痛快射击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GunslingerHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Mesa Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/GusokuArmorSetDesc.text: The Edo decorative armor set rekindles faint memories of warriors long forgotten.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GusokuArmorSetDesc.zhText: 这套装饰性的江户护甲组重新点亮了战士被遗忘的模糊记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeShipDesc.text: Featuring Sentry Gun air-support, this stylish landing craft is an asset in any battle.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeShipDesc.zhText: 装备有自动炮台的空中支援系统，这艘时尚的登陆艇在任何战斗中都是实用的座驾。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeSkinIfrit.text: A unique skin for the Xiphos landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeSkinIfrit.zhText: Xiphos 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeSkinNekro.text: A unique skin for the Xiphos landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeSkinNekro.zhText: Xiphos 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeSkinPrime.text: A unique skin for the Xiphos landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/GyroscopeSkinPrime.zhText: Xiphos 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweeShipSceneD.text: Redecorate your Orbiter’s interior with these ghoulish decorations.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweeShipSceneD.zhText: 用这些可怖的装饰重新布置你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAklatoDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Aklato.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAklatoDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的拉托双枪节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAklatoNam.text: Aklato Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAkvastoDe.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Akvasto.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAkvastoDe.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的瓦斯托双枪节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAkvastoNa.text: Akvasto Day of the Dead Skin
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAkvastoNa.zhText: 瓦斯托双枪亡灵节外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAmprexDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Amprex.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAmprexDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的安培克斯节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAmprexNam.text: Amprex Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAngstrumD.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Angstrum.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAngstrumD.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的安格斯壮节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenAngstrumN.text: Angstrum Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenArchSword.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Veritux.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenArchSword.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的真理巨剑节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenArchSword.text: Veritux Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenArmourDes.text: Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies by cladding your Warframe in this ancient battle attire.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenArmourDes.zhText: 在您的战甲上包覆这个古老的战斗装束，能将恐惧深深地烙近到敌人的内心之中。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBoltorDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Boltor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBoltorDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的螺钉步枪节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBoltorNam.text: Boltor Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBratonDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Braton.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBratonDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的布莱顿节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBratonNam.text: Braton Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBuzlokDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Buzlok.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBuzlokDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的巴兹火枪节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenBuzlokNam.text: Buzlok Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDarkDagge.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Dark Dagger.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDarkDagge.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的暗黑匕首节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDarkDagge.text: Dark Dagger Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDarkSword.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Dark Sword.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDarkSword.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的暗黑长剑节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDarkSword.text: Dark Sword Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDragonNik.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Dragon Nikana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDragonNik.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的龙之侍刃节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDragonNik.text: Dragon Nikana Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDualZoren.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Dual Zoren.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDualZoren.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的佐伦双斧节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenDualZoren.text: Dual Zoren Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenFireFlySc.text: An Igaro Syandana adorned with a morbidly festive design.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenFireFlySc.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的伊卡洛披饰节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenFireFlySc.text: Igaro Day of the Dead Syandana
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenFireFlySc.zhText: 伊卡洛 亡灵节披饰

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGalatineD.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Galatine.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGalatineD.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的迦伦提恩节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGalatineN.text: Galatine Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGlaiveDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Glaive.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGlaiveDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的战刃节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGlaiveNam.text: Glaive Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGlaxionDe.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Glaxion.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGlaxionDe.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的冷冻光束步枪节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGlaxionNa.text: Glaxion Day of the Dead Skin
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGlaxionNa.zhText: 冷冻光束步枪亡灵节外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGorgonDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Gorgon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGorgonDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的蛇发女妖节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGorgonNam.text: Gorgon Day of the Dead Skin

/Lotus/Language/Items/HalloweenGrinlokDe.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Grinlok.

/Lotus/Language/Items/HammerDesc.text: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

/Lotus/Language/Items/HammerStanceADesc.text: Methodical strikes and high impact combos.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HammerStanceADesc.zhText: 流畅打击和高冲击的连段。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HammerStanceBDesc.text: Aerial attacks with Crowd Control combos.

/Lotus/Language/Items/HandCannonDesc.text: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HandCannonDesc.zhText: （英文：BRONCO）野马是可以单手操作的小型霰弹枪。在近距离有效但弹匣容量较少。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HarlequinDefaultHe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Mirage Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/HarlequinNobleAnim.text: The Noble Animation Set for Mirage.

/Lotus/Language/Items/HarlequinPistolsDe.text: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HarlequinPistolsDe.zhText: （英文：AKZANI）作为 Mirage 的精选武器，这些高射速的双手枪将为您带来一场致命的演出。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeadshotStoreItemD.text: Sentinel charges a powerful shot and fires at the first enemy within |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeadshotStoreItemD.zhText: 守护在蓄能后，朝 |RANGE| 米范围内的第一名敌人击发强力射击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HealthBuff.zhText: 提升生命值与治愈效果

/Lotus/Language/Items/HealthDebuffKeyDes.text:
Health is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HealthDebuffKeyDes.zhText:
装备该钥匙，生命会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeatDaggerDesc.text: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeatDaggerDesc.zhText: （英文：HEAT DAGGER）这把短剑攻击范围有限，但挥动速度快，同时可以造成火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeatSwordDesc.text: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeatSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：HEAT SWORD）其强力的刀刃能对敌人造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyAxeDesc.text: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyAxeDesc.zhText: （英文：SCINDO）分裂斩斧是由 Tenno 精心设计的重型战斧。减少速度和灵活性加强重量，破坏性的攻击能够一次杀伤多个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyPistolDesc.text: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：LEX）雷克斯是大火力的手枪，射速和弹匣容量都很低，但每发伤害很高。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleDesc.text: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyWeaponCatalys.text:
Allows archwing guns to be deployed in terrestrial zones. Install this device on archwing guns to compensate for atmospheric and gravitational forces not experienced in space.
NOTE: Deployment requires gear obtained from the Profit-Taker mission in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyWeaponCatalys.zhText:
允许曲翼枪械在陆地区域使用。陆地环境中存在着太空环境所没有的大气压力与重力，在曲翼枪械上安装这个装置就能抵消上述差异所带来的绝大部分影响。
注意：在部署时需要用到福尔图娜的利润收割者任务中取得的道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyWeaponSummonD.text: Deploy the selected archwing gun in any atmospheric environment using this gear item.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyWeaponSummonD.zhText: 使用此装备道具来在任何大气环境下使用选定的曲翼枪械。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekKeyDesc.text: Raid Earth and Assassinate Councilor Vay Hek
/Lotus/Language/Items/HekKeyDesc.zhText: 一个奥罗金遗迹中的刺杀任务

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeADesc.text: Locator beacon broadcasting on the delta frequency
/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeADesc.zhText: 持续发送出 Delta 频率的信标定位装置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeBDesc.text: Locator beacon broadcasting on the gamma frequency
/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeBDesc.zhText: 持续发送出 Gamma 频率的信标定位装置

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeCDesc.text: Locator beacon broadcasting on the kappa frequency

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeDDesc.text: Locator beacon broadcasting on the Omega frequency

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeDesc.zhText: 用来定位韦·海克的坐标

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeKeyDesc.text: Locate Vay Hek by analyzing the frequency output of a set of his beacons
/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeKeyDesc.zhText: 通过分析韦·海克发出的一组信标的输出频率来定位他

/Lotus/Language/Items/HekNavCodeKeyName.zhText: 韦·海克坐标频率三角仪

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosDefaultSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Helios Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosDefaultSkinD.zhText: 赫利俄斯的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosGlaiveWeapon.text: Causes the Helios Sentinel to attack enemy targets using pieces of itself.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosGlaiveWeapon.zhText: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR）赫利俄斯用自己身上的部件攻击目标敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosPrimeDefault.zhText: 赫利俄斯 Prime 外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosPrimeDefault.text: The standard issue skin for the Helios Prime Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosPrimeDefault.zhText: 赫利俄斯 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HelminthChargerTra.text: The Helminth Charger rushes an enemy, dealing |DAMAGE| Damage to all in its path. It gains +|BUFF|% Melee Damage, Max Health and Armor for every enemy hit for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HelminthChargerTra.zhText: Helminth 疾冲者冲向敌人，对其行径路线上的所有敌人造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。每击中一个敌人，它就会获得 +|BUFF|% 近战伤害、最大生命值和护甲，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HenruSyandanaDesc.text: In the Orokin era, only the Tenno were permitted to wear the Henru Syandana
/Lotus/Language/Items/HenruSyandanaDesc.zhText: 在奥罗金时代，只有 Tenno 才被允许穿上 HENRU 披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HindDesc.text: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HindDesc.zhText: （英文：HIND）由 Grineer 突击部队使用的强力中阶步枪，雌鹿一次射击就是五连发。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HiveSabotageEventB.text: Awarded to Tenno for the contributions they made during the Breeding Grounds event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HiveSabotageEventB.zhText: 赠与 Tenno 以奖励他们在清巢行动徽章中做出的贡献。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HobbledKeyBlueprin.text: Blueprint required to craft the Hobbled Dragon Key. Speed is greatly reduced while key is equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HobbledKeyBlueprin.zhText: 制作蹒跚龙钥的需求蓝图。装备该钥匙，速度会极大的降低。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HolidayFrostSkinDe.text: A festive skin for the Frost Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/HolidayMirageSkinD.text: A festive skin for the Mirage Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/HolidayScarfDesc.text: A festive variation of the Imperator Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HolidayScarfDesc.zhText: 一条改款节庆版的凯旋将军披饰

/Lotus/Language/Items/HolsterSeriesOnePa.text: A collection of alternate styles for holstering and drawing a range of Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HolsterSeriesOnePa.zhText: 一套替换部分近战武器收起和拔出风格的收藏组合。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HornSkullScarfDefa.text: Used for festive ceremonies, this Syandana was often worn during social gatherings.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HornSkullScarfDefa.zhText: 这件披饰经常在节日庆典时的社交场合中穿戴。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HornSkullScarfDesc.text: The Rakta Syandana is awarded by the Red Veil for exemplary valor. This honor is rarely given to outsiders.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HornSkullScarfDesc.zhText: 绯红披饰是来自血色面纱象征英勇典范的奖赏，这项荣誉鲜少给予外来者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HoverboardSummonBo.text: Summons a K-Drive for use during free roam missions
/Lotus/Language/Items/HoverboardSummonBo.zhText: 在自由漫游任务中召唤 K 式悬浮板使用

/Lotus/Language/Items/HunterKubrowDesc.text: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HunterKubrowDesc.zhText: 由奥罗金培育，用于战斗。这头武术野兽的使命是制造混乱，击倒最凶猛的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HunterToolDesc.text: Specialized trap for attracting and slowing the movement of synthesis targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HunterToolDesc.zhText: 用以吸引或减缓结合目标移动速度的特制陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HuntingBowDesc.text: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HuntingBowDesc.zhText: （英文：PARIS）以世界最古老的武器设计为基础，Tenno 所制作的武器不论隐匿行动和交火接战均可使用。帕里斯可利用磁场蓄力，其射出的箭矢足以将敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HuntsmanSomaSkinDe.text: This unique casing for the Soma was crafted from the oldest trees on Earth, and entwined in golden trimming.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HuntsmanSomaSkinDe.zhText: 以地球上最古老的树木为材料，专为月神制作的独特枪身，并以缠绕于枪身上的黄金为润饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HydroidAltHelmetDe.text: An alternative helmet for the Hydroid Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/HydroidAltHelmetDe.zhText: Hydroid 的独特样式替换头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Items/HydroidDefaultHelm.text: The standard issue helmet for the Hydroid Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/IAHGamesBratonDesc.zhText: IAHGames 专属的布莱顿外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/IceBallisticEnhanc.text: The Frost Ballistic Enhancer increases your ballistic weapon damage by a small percentage. The extra damage is frost damage, which is effective against robotics.
/Lotus/Language/Items/IceBallisticEnhanc.zhText: 冰冻射弹强化器稍微增加您的射弹武器伤害。额外的冰冻伤害对机器人很有效。

/Lotus/Language/Items/IceEventModPackDes.text: A collection of Mods that increase Status Chance and apply <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/IceEventModPackDes.zhText: 一些可以提高触发几率并造成<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害的 MOD。

/Lotus/Language/Items/IceHammerDesc.text: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.
/Lotus/Language/Items/IceHammerDesc.zhText: （英文：SIBEAR）冰移可以碾碎山峰，这把冰锤的效果也是一样。

/Lotus/Language/Items/IceMeleeDangleDesc.text: A crystallized companion to the Sibear hammer.
/Lotus/Language/Items/IceMeleeDangleDesc.zhText: 一具搭配西伯利亚战锤的水晶配件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/IctusPackDesc.text: A bundle containing the HELIOS Sentinel and the ICTUS range of cosmetic upgrades for your Sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Items/IctusPackDesc.zhText: 内含赫利俄斯以及让你守护外观升级的扬音装饰配件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ImmortalSkinBundle.text: This bundle contains Immortal Warframe skins for Ash, Banshee, Excalibur, Frost, Loki, Mag, Nyx and Rhino.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ImmortalSkinBundle.zhText: 包含 Ash、Banshee、Excalibur、Frost、Loki、Mag、Nyx 和 Rhino 的不朽战甲外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ImperatorSyandanaD.text: Before the fall, the Imperator Syandana was bestowed upon only the highest-ranking Orokin commanders.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ImperatorSyandanaD.zhText: 在奥罗金帝国衰败之前，只有最高阶的奥罗金将领才能被授予凯旋将军披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ImperatorVandalDes.text: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ImperatorVandalDes.zhText: （英文：IMPERATOR VANDAL）这款为 Tenno 量身打造的凯旋将军·破坏者带有蓝绿色的金属质感，枪管上还有 Lotus 的铭刻。

/Lotus/Language/Items/IncendiaryBallisti.text: The Incendiary Ballistic Enhancer increases your ballistic weapon damage by a small percentage. The extra damage is incendiary damage, which is effective against flesh.
/Lotus/Language/Items/IncendiaryBallisti.zhText: 燃烧射弹强化器稍微增加您的射弹武器伤害。额外的伤害是火焰伤害，对肉体很有效。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfCrpShockSwarmRi.text: A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfCrpShockSwarmRi.zhText: （英文：MUTALIST QUANTA）这是一个 Corpus 科技与感染生物的奇特组合，这把自动步枪也能发射出一种带有辐射性的可通过空气传播的感染物质。为了全面了解这把武器的潜在能力，还需要更多的实地测试。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfEmbolistArmourB.text: Calcified flesh creates forms of grotesque beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfEmbolistArmourB.zhText: 钙化的肉体创造出了怪异的美感。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfEmbolistComplet.text: This collection of unnatural, malformed, Infested growths contains; the Caustacyst Scythe, the Embolist pistol, Tentacyst accessory for Melee Weapons and the Embolist armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfEmbolistComplet.zhText: 这个非自然、畸形的感染生长物组合包包括了：灼蚀变体镰、安柏勒斯手枪、囊须坠饰和安柏勒斯护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfEmbolistComplet.text: A collection of unnatural, malformed, Infested growths.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfEmbolistComplet.zhText: 一套非自然、畸形的感染生长物珍藏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfProximityStarsD.text: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfProximityStarsD.zhText: （英文：POX）受到冲击时，这些充满脓水和气体的溃烂脓包会剧烈地爆开。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfQuantaInfestedA.text: A unique skin for the Paracyst.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfQuantaInfestedA.zhText: 附肢寄生者的独特外观。
附肢寄生者 斑纹外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfQuantaRifleDesc.text: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfQuantaRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：PARACYST）被感染生物体完全包覆，这种形态的量子切割器会射出类似器质性的附肢尖叉。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertDisease.text: Awarded to Tenno who participated in the Mutalist Incursions event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertDisease.zhText: 颁发给参与异融者侵入活动的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertNaniteM.text: Awarded to Tenno who participated in the Mutalist Incursions event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertNaniteM.zhText: 颁发给参与异融者侵入活动的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertPussAnc.text: Awarded to Tenno who participated in the Mutalist Incursions event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertPussAnc.zhText: 颁发给参与异融者侵入活动的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertSlowBom.text: Awarded to Tenno who participated in the Mutalist Incursions event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfTacAlertSlowBom.zhText: 颁发给参与异融者侵入活动的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestationAgileAn.text: The Agile Animation Set for Nidus.

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestationEventBa.text: An emblem awarded to the Tenno who hunted down Alad V.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestationEventBa.zhText: 徽章颁发给追捕阿拉德 V 的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestationNobleAn.text: The Noble Animation Set for Nidus.

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedAladAssass.text: Put an end to Alad V and his Mutalist experiments
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedAladAssass.zhText: 突袭阿拉德 V 的研究船，终结他的异融者实验。
异融阿拉德 V 刺杀

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedAladNavCod.text:
These coordinates can be used to track Mutalist Alad V.

Location: Infestation Outbreaks Invasion Rewards, Hyf and Terrorem (Deimos), and Resource Caches found in Naeglar (Eris) and Formido (Deimos)
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedAladNavCod.zhText:
这些坐标可用于追踪异融阿拉德 V。

获取地点：感染者爆发入侵奖励、Hyf 和 Terrorem（火卫二）、Naeglar（阋神星）和 Formido（火卫二）中的资源储藏箱
异融阿拉德 V 导航坐标

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedBaitBallDe.text: Creates 50x Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedBaitBallDe.zhText: 制造 50个 费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedBowDesc.text: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedBowDesc.zhText: （英文：MUTALIST CERNOS）受到感染者的侵蚀后，这把弓的箭矢能够在击中的任何表面散播病毒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedDartPistol.text: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedDartPistol.zhText: （英文：TYSIS）啐沫者手枪借由喷吐出具有腐蚀性的毒镖，将受害者由内而外地侵蚀殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedEventClanI.text:
This refined toxin catalyst has been formulated to reinforce the Thrax Toxin and maximize damage to the Infested boil in Plague Star bounties.

Location: Bio Lab in Clan Dojo
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedEventClanI.zhText:
这种精制毒素催化剂的配方，可强化瑟拉斯毒素，并在《瘟疫之星》赏金任务中最大限度地提高对感染疖瘤产生的伤害。

获取地点：氏族道场的生物实验室

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedEventIngre.text:
Sentient immunity to the Infestation is exploited with this refined phylaxis. Formulated specifically to combat Infested boils in Plague Star bounties.

Location: Nakak's Operational Supply in Cetus
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedEventIngre.zhText:
利用 Sentient 对感染者的免疫力所制作的精制抗体。专为对付《瘟疫之星》赏金任务中的侵染疖瘤而配制。

获取地点：希图斯上娜卡处的行动补给

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedFinsArmorS.text: This selection of decorative armor is made out of infested carapace and grafted onto the host.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedFinsArmorS.zhText: 这种装饰性的护甲由感染者的硬壳制成并将其直接移植到使用者身上。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedFinsScarfD.text: An infested syandana made from living tissue. Matches the Iliac Armor Set.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedFinsScarfD.zhText: 一个用活体组织制造出的感染披饰。与髂骨护甲组合配套。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedIncursions.text: A series of Mods awarded to players who contributed to the Mutalist Incursions event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedIncursions.zhText: 一系列 MOD 给予在异融者入侵事件中付出心力的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedIrradiated.text: Creates 50x Potent Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedIrradiated.zhText: 制造 50 个强效费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedKubrowDesc.text: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedKubrowDesc.zhText: 库狛与感染者的实验性混合体。可使用蛆虫和其他感染者的能力造成伤害并控制战场。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedLexDesc.text: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedLexDesc.zhText: （英文：DUAL TOXOCYST）对敌人造成爆头射击会刺激这把生物武器，能迅速发射毒素弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedPistolDesc.text: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：EMBOLIST）活生生的武器，被感染的安柏勒斯手枪用酸性有毒气体杀死受害者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedRifleDesc.text: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive energy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：SYNAPSE）由生化反应驱动，被感染的突触生化枪通过一束稳定的<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀能量炙烤目标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedShotgunDes.text: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedShotgunDes.zhText: （英文：PHAGE）射出七道持续性的生化能量，侵蚀任何物质的表面，使其寿命枯竭。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedTipedoDesc.text: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedTipedoDesc.zhText: （英文：LESION）能造成严重伤害的一把武器。如果病变尝到了血的味道，其就会变得很有活力，攻击速度加快的同时会增加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedWhipDesc.text: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage with attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InfestedWhipDesc.zhText: （英文：SCOLIAC）这条脊椎节鞭是由一只令人生厌的寄生虫增生出肌腱与骨头而成形。攻击时能造成会让心脏停止跳动的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipDesc.text: This insect-like landing craft features Med-Tower air-support.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipDesc.zhText: 这架虫型的登陆艇装置了治愈塔，可支援空中作战。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinCamo.text: A unique skin for the Mantis landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinCamo.zhText: Mantis 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinExot.text: A unique skin for the Mantis landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinExot.zhText: Mantis 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinNaut.text: A unique skin for the Mantis landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinNaut.zhText: Mantis 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinPrim.text: A unique skin for the Mantis landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InsectShipSkinPrim.zhText: Mantis 登陆艇的独特外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InstrumentPackDesc.text: A themed instrument pack for Octavia's Mandachord.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InstrumentPackDesc.zhText: 一个为 Octavia 的曼达和弦琴准备的主题乐器包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InternCapeDesc.text: A flowing ribbon of silken fabric, crowned with a star.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InternCapeDesc.zhText: 这条丝质的光滑丝带上点缀着一粒星辰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/InvestigatorStoreI.text: Helios Sentinel will scan objects and enemies within |RANGE|m over |DURATION|s. This consumes Codex Scanner charges.
/Lotus/Language/Items/InvestigatorStoreI.zhText: 赫利俄斯守护会消耗资料库扫描器，来扫描 |RANGE| 米范围内的物件及敌人，耗时 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/IronPhoenixDesc.text: Fast cutting attacks with puncture finish.
/Lotus/Language/Items/IronPhoenixDesc.zhText: 快速切割攻击用穿刺完结。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ItemDropOnAssistSt.text: Dethcube drops an Energy Orb after assisting in <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ASSISTS| kills.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ItemDropOnAssistSt.zhText: 死亡魔方协助击杀 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|ASSISTS| 次后，将掉落一个能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ItemVacuumStoreIte.text: Increases Ammo Capacity by |CAPACITY|% and converts Ammo Pickups into ammo for equipped weapons after |DELAY|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ItemVacuumStoreIte.zhText: 提升弹药携带量 |CAPACITY|% 并在捡取弹药后的 |DELAY| 秒将其转换为目前使用中的武器弹药类型。

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeAgileAnimsDesc.text: The Agile Animation Set for Nyx.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeAltHelmetDesc.text: Menticide Helmet for the Nyx Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeColorPickerDes.text: Unlocks additional color options for Warframe customization.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeColorPickerDes.zhText: 解锁更多用于战甲的自定义色彩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeDaedalusChestP.text: A next-generation breastplate for your Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeDaedalusKneePl.text: Next-generation leg plates for your Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeDaedalusShould.text: Next-generation shoulder plates for your Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeDefaultHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nyx Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeDualHeatSwords.text: A next-generation skin for the Dual Heat Swords.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeDualHeatSwords.zhText: 烈焰双剑的次世代外观。
烈焰双剑 翡翠外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeHeatDaggerDesc.text: A next-generation skin for the Heat Dagger.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeHeatDaggerDesc.zhText: 烈焰匕首的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeHeatDaggerName.zhText: 烈焰匕首 翡翠外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeHeatSwordDesc.text: A next-generation skin for the Heat Sword.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeHeatSwordDesc.zhText: 烈焰长剑的次世代外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeHeatSwordName.zhText: 烈焰长剑 翡翠外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeImperatorSyand.zhText: 凯旋将军 翡翠披饰

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeNobleAnimsDesc.text: The Noble Animation Set for Nyx.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadePackDesc.text: Get Nyx and all her favorite gear.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JadePackDesc.zhText: 获得 Nyx 和她的御用装备。

/Lotus/Language/Items/JadeStealthArchwin.text: A unique skin for the Itzal Archwing.

/Lotus/Language/Items/JawSwordDesc.text: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JawSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：JAW SWORD）拥有锯齿状的刀刃，能够施以强力斩击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/JingleKnucklesSkin.text: Jingle all the way with this festive skin for any fist weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JingleKnucklesSkin.zhText: 在所有拳套上使用这个节庆外观来一路响叮当吧！

/Lotus/Language/Items/JuggernautPartDesc.text:
A grizzly trophy extracted from the corpse of a Juggernaut.

Location: Drops from Juggernauts (non-endless Infested Missions) and Deimos Juggernauts (Cambion Drift on Deimos)
/Lotus/Language/Items/JuggernautPartDesc.zhText:
从巨兽尸体中取出的斑白战利品。

获取地点：巨兽（非无尽 Infested 任务）、火卫二巨兽（火卫二魔胎之境）

/Lotus/Language/Items/JungleEventBadgeDe.text: An emblem awarded to all those who helped destroy the Grineer toxin during the Cicero Crisis.
/Lotus/Language/Items/JungleEventBadgeDe.zhText: 一枚徽章，颁发给所有在西塞罗危机中帮助消灭 Grineer 毒素的勇士。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KarakWraithDesc.text: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KarakWraithDesc.zhText: （英文：KARAK WRAITH）有别于 Grineer 制式的突击步枪，卡拉克·亡魂有着独一无二的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KatanaDesc.text: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KatanaDesc.zhText: （英文：NIKANA）利用远古技艺重铸失传的 Tenno 刀刃，使侍刃武士刀重新展现。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KatanaStanceADesc.zhText: 强力弧斩附带疯狂的连段。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KatanaStanceCDesc.text: Reverse grip style emphasizing slashing and impaling strikes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KatanaStanceCDesc.zhText: 反握的持刀风格，强调其猛烈的斩击以及刺击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatBaseColorPack.text: Change a kavat's coat coloration to match that of the Adarza or Smeeta Kavat species.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatBaseColorPack.zhText: 改变库娃的外表颜色和花纹来配合镜像型库娃或者笑面型库娃的种类特征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatColorPackKres.text: Customize a Kavat’s fur color with these isolated DNA sequences.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatColorPackKres.zhText: 使用这些独立的基因序列来自定义库娃的皮毛外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatColorPackNesy.text: Customize a Kavat’s fur color with these isolated DNA sequences.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatColorPackNesy.zhText: 使用这些独立的基因序列来自定义库娃的皮毛外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatColourDesc.text: Splices the genes in your pet Kavat to change the color of its fur.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatColourDesc.zhText: 通过基因拼接来改变库娃毛皮的颜色。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatStarterKitDes.text:
Contains all of the components to begin gene-splicing a Kavat!

Requires: Installed Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
/Lotus/Language/Items/KavatStarterKitDes.zhText:
包含了一切开始库娃的基因拼接所必要的组件！

需要：安装好的库娃孵化器升级模块

/Lotus/Language/Items/KazBaroCapeDesc.text: Define style with this crystalline cape.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KazBaroCapeDesc.zhText: 用这款水晶般的披风定义你的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KazInfestedScarfDe.text: This malignant growth hangs elegantly on the shoulders of any Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KazInfestedScarfDe.zhText: 这恶性生长之物可以优雅地披挂于任何 Tenno 的肩膀。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KazeruPrimeSugatra.text: Arcing bolts of electricity highlight this golden chain Sugatra.

通过在死亡角斗场中获得胜利来赚取的点数。

通过在 Nakki、Yam、Vodyanoi（赛德娜）的死亡角斗场竞技场任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KelaEventBadgeDesc.zhText: 颁发给挺身对抗 Kela De Thaym 与旗下行刑者之人的奖章。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KelaEventDogTagDes.text: To be delivered to Steel Meridian or chosen Syndicate in the relay.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KelaEventDogTagDes.zhText: 请至中继站钢铁防线或所选集团处领取。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowArmorBaroDes.text: Fashioned for the most refined breed of Kubrow.

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowArmorStalker.text: Pakal style armor, fashioned for a Kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowArmorStalker.zhText: 库狛适用的帕卡尔风格护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowArmorTrinity.text: Kubrow armor in the style of Trinity Strega.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowArmorTrinity.zhText: Trinity 黑魔女风格的库狛护甲

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowArmorXmasDes.text: A festive hat for your Kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowArmorXmasDes.zhText: 给你的库狛一顶节庆帽子。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowBaseColorPac.text: Provides basic masking options for a Kubrow's innate DNA structure, allowing coat color customization.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowBaseColorPac.zhText: 提供给库狛的天生 DNA 结构用的基础版遮蔽选项，让你能自定义库狛的颜色。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowChargePrecep.text: The kubrow charges at a target, dragging them and dealing |DAMAGE|% damage to all in its path.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowChargePrecep.zhText: 库狛朝前冲去攻击一名敌人，拉住对方并对行径路线中的敌人造成 |DAMAGE|% 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowCloakPrecept.text: The kubrow cloaks itself and its master to stalk down its prey when they are within |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowCloakPrecept.zhText: 当距离敌人|RANGE| 米范围内时，库狛与其主人一起进入潜行状态以悄悄接近猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowCollarDesc.text: A common adornment used to distinguish a Kubrow that is loyal to its master.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowCollarDesc.zhText: 一个常见的装饰用以区分库狛是忠于何人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackBol.text: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Doveran Kubrow ancestors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackBol.zhText: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其道维然祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackLot.text: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Averal Kubrow ancestors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackLot.zhText: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其挨维奥祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackNex.text: This tool modifies the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and alter the fur pattern to this unique style.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackNex.zhText: 这件工具能够改变库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹转变为这种独特的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackPri.text: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow’s innate DNA structure and coloration of its purebred Kavasa Kubrow ancestors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackPri.zhText: 这份工具内含有能改造库狛与生俱来的 DNA 结构，并使其毛色与库狛祖先喀婆萨相吻合的全部遗传基因。
喀婆萨 Prime 基因伪装包

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackRei.text: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and allows a Tenno to customize its fur pattern.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackRei.zhText: 这个工具提供了改造库狛 DNA 结构所需的全部基因信息，并让 Tenno 能自定库狛的毛皮花纹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackSpe.text: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Telmatian Kubrow ancestors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackSpe.zhText: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其大麦町祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackStr.text: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Savenga Kubrow ancestors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackStr.zhText: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其赛凡咖祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackTig.text: This tool provides all of the genetic information to mask a Kubrow's innate DNA structure and match the fur pattern of its Tigrol Kubrow ancestors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColorPackTig.zhText: 这个工具包含了改造库狛 DNA 结构并使其毛皮花纹与其虎古尔祖先相匹配所需的全部基因信息。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColourDesc.text: Splices the genes in your pet Kubrow to change the color of its fur.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowColourDesc.zhText: 借由基因拼接来改变库狛毛皮的颜色。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDNAStabilize.text: Contains 6 DNA Stabilizers to maintain the health of a Kubrow or Kavat.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDNAStabilize.zhText: 内装有 6 份 DNA 稳定剂，可用于稳定库狛与库娃的生命迹象。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDesc.text: Descendants of the canine that have evolved into a Monotreme species, and lay eggs instead of giving birth. These animals can be domesticated to become loyal and protective companions to their master.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDesc.zhText: 这种犬科动物的后裔已经演化为单孔目物种，并以产卵取代生育。这种动物能被驯化为能守护主人的忠诚伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDigPreceptDe.text: The kubrow sniffs out buried objects and digs them up.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDigPreceptDe.zhText: 库狛嗅出被埋藏的道具并挖掘出来。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDisarmPrecep.text: The kubrow roars, causing enemies within |RANGE|m to stumble and drop their weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowDisarmPrecep.zhText: 库狛发出咆哮声，使 |RANGE| 米范围内的敌人踉跄并丢下武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowEggDesc.text:
This egg is used to transplant the genetic code of a Kubrow onto a Kubrow clone.

Location: Kubrow Dens found in Grineer Forests on Earth
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowEggDesc.zhText:
这个蛋是用来将库狛的遗传密码转移到库狛克隆体上。

获取地点：Grineer 森林（地球）中的库狛兽穴

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowFearPreceptD.text: The kubrow cries out with a blood-curdling howl that strikes fear into |COUNT| enemies within |RANGE|m for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowFearPreceptD.zhText: 库狛发出令人毛骨悚然的嚎叫，对 |RANGE| 米范围的|COUNT| 名敌人心中烙下长达|DURATION| 秒的恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowFinisherModD.text: The Kubrow rushes at |COUNT| enemies within |RANGE|m, dealing damage and knocking them over.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowFinisherModD.zhText: 库狛冲向 |RANGE| 米范围内的 |COUNT| 个敌人，造成伤害并将其击倒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowFinisherPrec.text: The kubrow savagely overwhelms its prey.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowFinisherPrec.zhText: 库狛凶狠的压倒它的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowGrabPreceptD.text: Helminth Charger whips a proboscis out at an enemy within |RANGE|m, pulling them back and dealing |DAMAGE| damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowGrabPreceptD.zhText: Helminth 疾冲者将长吻抽向一名在 |RANGE|米内的敌人，把他们拉回并且造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowHunterAttack.text: The kubrow bites its prey with crushing force.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowHunterAttack.zhText: 库狛以粉碎般的力量咬碎它的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowLootPreceptD.text: Kubrow has |CHANCE|% chance to scavenge additional loot from a fallen enemy or containers within |RANGE|m, every |COOLDOWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowLootPreceptD.zhText: 库狛有 |CHANCE|% 的几率在|RANGE|米之内倒地的敌人或容器中挖掘出额外的战利品，每 |COOLDOWN| 秒冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowPackLeaderMo.text: Heal your Companion with Melee hits. Excess healing grants Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowPackLeaderMo.zhText: 用近战攻击治愈你的同伴。额外的治疗会给予超宏防护。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowPetCollarPri.text: A collar used to honor especially loyal Kubrows in the Orokin era.

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowShieldPrecep.text: The kubrow comes to the defense of its master, replenishing both of their shields by |BOOST|% of its maximum shields and adding its shield regeneration rate to its master's for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowShieldPrecep.zhText: 库狛会保护它的主人，它会用自己最大护盾的 |BOOST|% 来为自己和主人恢复护盾，并将其护盾恢复速度加到其主人身上，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowStarterKitDe.text:
Contains all of the components to begin gene-splicing a Kubrow!

Requires: Installed Incubator Segment
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowStarterKitDe.zhText:
包含了一切开始库狛的基因拼接所必要的组件！

需要：安装好的孵化器模块

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowThiefPrecept.text: |val|% chance for the pet to pry open a locked locker.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowThiefPrecept.zhText: 宠物有 |val|% 的机会打开锁住的储物柜。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowVipChasePrec.text: The kubrow hunts for Eximus units protected by Overguard within |RANGE|m and deals +300% Damage against Overguard.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KubrowVipChasePrec.zhText: 库狛会在 |RANGE| 米范围内搜寻受到超宏防护保护的卓越者单位，并对超宏防护造成 +300% 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KunaiDesc.text: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KunaiDesc.zhText: （英文：KUNAI）苦无以投掷用匕首替代传统次要武器的非静音攻击。暗杀首选。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaDesc.text:
Kuva is an exceedingly rare red fluid coveted by the Grineer Queens. It can be obtained in Kuva Missions, and is used to Cycle Rivens or build rare blueprints.

Location: Kuva Siphon Missions and Taveuni (Kuva Fortress)
/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaDesc.zhText:
赤毒是 Grineer 女皇梦寐以求的一种非常罕见的红色液体。它可以从赤毒任务中获得，用来循环裂罅 Mod 或者制造稀有蓝图。

获取地点：赤毒虹吸任务、Taveuni（赤毒要塞）

/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaFireEphemeraDe.text: A fiery ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.

/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaLightningEphem.text: A shocking ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.

/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaMagneticEpheme.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的磁力幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaToxinEphemeraD.text: An ephemera of toxic miasma seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaToxinEphemeraD.zhText: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的毒性瘴气幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaTricksterEphem.text: The energy of the trickster Warframes is embodied in this colorful ephemera, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Language/Items/KuvaTricksterEphem.zhText: 战甲骗术的能量包含在这个多彩的幻纹里，从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LargeTeamAmmoDesc.text: Restores 3x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LargeTeamAmmoDesc.zhText: 每 15 秒恢复 3 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LargeTeamAmmoPackD.zhText: 制造 10 个团队弹药补给（大型）

/Lotus/Language/Items/LargeTeamEnergyDes.text: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 100 Energy every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LargeTeamEnergyDes.zhText: 恢复全团队的能量。每次脉冲恢复 100 点能量。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LasriaGrnForestExc.zhText: [PH] Coordinates compiled from Seismic Data obtained from Corpus Scout Ship

/Lotus/Language/Items/LatoPrimeDesc.text: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

/Lotus/Language/Items/LatoTeknaBlueprint.zhText: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.

/Lotus/Language/Items/LeaderBadgeMountai.zhText: 表示佩戴者此时是山脉氏族中最高阶级的战士。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LeaderBadgeShadowD.text: Designates the wearer as the highest ranking soldier amongst Shadow-Tier Clans this era.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LeaderBadgeShadowD.zhText: 表示佩戴者此时是暗影氏族中最高阶级的战士。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LeaderBadgeStormDe.text: Designates the wearer as the highest ranking soldier amongst Storm-Tier Clans this era.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LeaderBadgeStormDe.zhText: 表示佩戴者此时是风暴氏族中最高阶级的战士。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LegendaryFusionPar.text: Consumed in the fusion process to power up existing Mods. A single Legendary Core will instantly fuse a Mod to its maximum capacity without credit cost.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LegendaryFusionPar.zhText: 在融铸升级过程中用来让现有的 Mod 升级。一枚传说核心能立即将 Mod 升级至最高等级，且不需消耗现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LexHammerBlueprint.text: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LexHammerBlueprint.zhText: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.

/Lotus/Language/Items/LiDaggerDesc.text: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LiDaggerDesc.zhText: （英文：SPIRA）彤红缎带的残影，是这款投掷匕首刃下大多数受害者最后看到的影像。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LibrarianHeliosDes.text: The Cephalon Simaris skin for the Helios sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LibrarianHeliosDes.zhText: 给赫利俄斯使用的中枢 Simaris 外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LibrarianHeliosNam.zhText: 赫利俄斯 Simaris 外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerDesc.text: Synthesize a genetic data of the target and uploads it to the Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerDesc.zhText: 结合目标的基因数据并将其上传至圣殿。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerDoub.text: Chance for each scan with the Synthesis Scanner to count as two scans.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerDoub.zhText: 每次以结合扫描器执行扫描时，有几率进行二次扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerEnem.text: Synthesis Scanner will now show target enemy weaknesses and resistances.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerEnem.zhText: 结合扫描器将显示目标敌人的弱点和抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerScan.text: Reduces the time required to scan a target with the Synthesis Scanner.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LibraryScannerScan.zhText: 降低结合扫描器扫描目标所需的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LightGlaiveDesc.text: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LightGlaiveDesc.zhText: （英文：GLAIVE）在第一个 Tenno 的时代，战刃是一件奇怪而强大的武器。这多刀刃圆盘不单可用于近身战，更可如回力镖般使用，在一定距离外把敌人一分为二。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LightningSheathBas.text: The Nikana will cause the energy within the Gemini Sheath to flow like the current of river.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LightningSheathBas.zhText: 侍刃会因为装备上双子刀鞘而使能量如河水般流动。
侍刃 霜巨人双子刀鞘

/Lotus/Language/Items/LightningSheathDes.text:
The energy flowing within this sheath changes to match the blade within it. The Nikana will cause the energy to flow like the current of a river, while the Dragon Nikana causes the sheath to rage with molten fury.

This skin requires a Nikana or a Dragon Nikana to use.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LightningSheathDes.zhText:
流动于刀鞘周围的能量会顺应武器的类型而改变。与「侍刃」一同装备时其刀鞘上的能量将如河水般流动，若与「龙之侍刃」一起装备则使刀鞘燃起炙烈的熔岩火花。

这项外观道具需要与「侍刃」或「龙之侍刃」搭配使用。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LightningSheathDra.text: Dragon Nikana causes the Gemini Sheath to rage with molten fury.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LightningSheathDra.zhText: 龙之侍刃会因为装备上双子刀鞘而燃起炙烈的火光。
侍刃 火巨人双子刀鞘

/Lotus/Language/Items/LimboAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Limbo.

/Lotus/Language/Items/LimboBeaconDesc.text: This signal is transmitting a seemingly random set of equations, but each one resolves into the same vector value. The coordinates have been downloaded to the Navigation Console.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LimboBeaconDesc.zhText: 这个信号乍看之下是在发送随机方程组，但每个都能解得相同的向量值。解析出来坐标都已经被下载到导航控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LongSwordDesc.text: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LongSwordDesc.zhText: （英文：SKANA）Tenno 在各种武器之中，最先精通的是空刃。其朴素的刀刃在他们手中是无比的强大。对Tenno 来说，这是他们战斗的基础以及文化的支柱。

/Lotus/Language/Items/LooterStoreItemDes.text: Emits a pulse wave to break open Loot Crates within |RANGE|m.

/Lotus/Language/Items/LotusPointMeleeDan.text: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Suraka Sugatra uses an ancient Tenno ceremonial design.
/Lotus/Language/Items/LotusPointMeleeDan.zhText: 苏瑞卡坠饰使用一种古老的 Tenno 礼俗设计来彰显其格斗技巧与师范般的武艺。
