/Lotus/Language/Items/MagicianHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Limbo Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/MagnumDesc.text: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MagnumDesc.zhText: （英文：MAGNUS）多功能麦格努斯左轮手枪对于任何 Tenno 来说都是一把能置对手于死地的手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MaleS2HelmetPackDe.text: A series 2 helmet for Excalibur, Frost, Loki, Rhino, Ash, Vauban, and Volt Warframes!
/Lotus/Language/Items/MaleS2HelmetPackDe.zhText: Excalibur，Frost，Loki，Rhino，Ash，Vauban，和 Volt的第二系列头盔！

/Lotus/Language/Items/ManticoreAxeSkinDe.text: A Heavy Axe variation that grants additional damage but with a decrease in swing speed.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ManticoreAxeSkinDe.zhText: 一把降低挥动速度而提高每次挥动所造成之伤害的变种重型斧头。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ManticoreAxeSkinNa.zhText: 分裂斩斧 蝎尾狮外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/MapMarkerDesc.text: A persistent waypoint marker for use with the world map. Coordinate your squad and track places of importance!
/Lotus/Language/Items/MapMarkerDesc.zhText: 一种使用在世界地图中的持久性标记点。协调你的队伍并追踪一些重要的位置！

/Lotus/Language/Items/MarineProfileIconD.text: A glyph of a Grineer Lancer

/Lotus/Language/Items/MeleeDanglePackDes.text: Accent your melee arsenal with this collection of sugatras.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MeleeDanglePackDes.zhText: 利用这组坠饰组合包让你的近战武器更具特色。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MeleeModStealthLet.text: Melee attacks from stealth are always lethal
/Lotus/Language/Items/MeleeModStealthLet.zhText: 隐秘攻击可造成致命伤害

/Lotus/Language/Items/MeleePetDesc.text: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MeleePetDesc.zhText: 赫利俄斯拥有独特的「侦查」指令并以「分离」作为武器，这位多功能的守护既是致命的守护者，又是资料库的自动扫描器。扫描功能须在身上携带扫描器，且扫描器有可使用的扫描次数才能触发。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MiosDesc.text: This bone-forged sword includes a tendon-whip to distract and maim the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MiosDesc.zhText: （英文：MIOS）这把由骨头锻造的刀包含了肌腱皮鞭用以混淆与残害敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MiosStanceADesc.zhText: 迅如闪电的鞭笞，致命般的砍击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MireInfestedSwordD.text: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MireInfestedSwordD.zhText: （英文：MIRE）米尔感染之剑是一柄来自「大瘟疫」时期的残暴武器。不仅能切开敌人，更能在其伤口染上神经剧毒。此外，米尔在震地攻击时会造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MirrorCatbrowDesc.text: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MirrorCatbrowDesc.zhText: 凶猛而致命的库娃因其战斗力而备受推崇，它能增加暴击几率并惩罚那些胆敢攻击它的人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MisaPrimeSyandanaD.text: Discovered in the vaults of a drifting derelict, this Syandana was worn by Temple Guardians before the fall of the Orokin Empire
/Lotus/Language/Items/MisaPrimeSyandanaD.zhText: 这件披饰是在漂流的遗迹宝库中被发现，在奥罗金帝国灭亡之前是由神庙守卫所穿戴。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MissileVolleyAbili.text: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.

/Lotus/Language/Items/MoaBallDesc.text: Deploys a MOA EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MoaBallDesc.zhText: 设置一个为你战斗的恐鸟卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ModCrpHandCannonDe.text: Fires short bursts of heat seeking projectiles
/Lotus/Language/Items/ModCrpHandCannonDe.zhText: 以短促击发模式射出热追踪子弹

/Lotus/Language/Items/ModCrpShieldWeapon.text: Deploys to provide cover for allies
/Lotus/Language/Items/ModCrpShieldWeapon.zhText: 设置并为盟友提供掩蔽

/Lotus/Language/Items/ModCrpSwarmCannonD.text: Fires a cluster of swarming projectiles

/Lotus/Language/Items/ModDropChanceBoost.text: Doubles the chance that enemies will drop Mods, Endo, and Arcanes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ModDropChanceBoost.zhText: 敌人掉落 Mod、内融核心和赋能的几率增加一倍。
7 天 Mod 掉落几率加成
30 天 Mod 掉落几率加成
3 天 Mod 掉落几率加成

/Lotus/Language/Items/ModFuserDesc.text: Consume 4 mods to generate a new random artifact.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ModFuserDesc.zhText: 消耗四张 Mod 来合成出一张新的 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ModSlotUnlocker.text: additional mod config slot for this item
/Lotus/Language/Items/ModSlotUnlocker.zhText: 为这件物品解锁额外的 MOD 配置槽位

/Lotus/Language/Items/ModSlotUnlockerDes.text: Unlocks an additional mod config slot for this item, up to a maximum of 3 extra slots.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ModSlotUnlockerDes.zhText: 为这个物品解锁 1 个额外的 Mod 配置槽位，最多 3 个额外槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MonkeyKingAgileAni.text: The Agile Animation Set for Wukong.

/Lotus/Language/Items/MonkeyKingBundleDe.text: Challenge your enemies with this bundle, featuring the Wukong Warframe and Sydon trident.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MonkeyKingBundleDe.zhText: 以这组合包来对你的敌人发出挑战，内含 Wukong 战甲和恶龙三叉戟。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MonkeyKingHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Wukong Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/MonkeyKingNobleAni.text: The Noble Animation Set for Wukong.

/Lotus/Language/Items/MonkeyKingStaffDes.text: A unique staff wielded by the Wukong Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MonkeyKingStaffDes.zhText: Wukong 所持有的独特长棍。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MorphicDesc.text:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto
/Lotus/Language/Items/MorphicDesc.zhText:
非晶态的固体。可能是奥罗金技术。

获取地点：水星，火星，火卫一，欧罗巴和冥王星

/Lotus/Language/Items/MorphicStoreOverri.text:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.
This bundle of 1 Morphic can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MorphicStoreOverri.zhText:
非晶态的固体。可能是奥罗金技术。
这个内含1个非晶态合金的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MoustacheDesc.text: A stylish moustache for your Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/MutalistIncursions.text: Awarded to Tenno who participated in the Mutalist Incursions event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MutalistIncursions.zhText: 颁赠给参予了异融者入侵事件的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/MysticFusionPartDe.text: Consumed in the fusion process to power up existing Mods. A single Mystic Core will instantly fuse a Mod to its maximum capacity without credit cost.
/Lotus/Language/Items/MysticFusionPartDe.zhText: 在合成中用来强化现有的 MOD。神秘核心可以立刻将 MOD 提升至最高级，且不需要消耗现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NLCastanasDesc.text: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NLCastanasDesc.zhText: （英文：SANCTI CASTANAS ）这种能遥控引爆的电击陷阱是新世间的信徒用来保护他们的寺庙与圣殿的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NLMagistarDesc.text: Each charged attack turns the enemy’s pain into a healing pulse that washes over allies. Also, creates resistance to Status Effects when held.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NLMagistarDesc.zhText: （英文：SANCTI MAGISTAR）蓄力攻击将敌人的伤痛转化成波及战友的治愈脉冲。除此之外，持取时将产生对异常状态的抵抗力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NLScarfDesc.text: The Sancti Syandana pulses every time the Tenno uses an ability and continues to strengthen with each ability used.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NLScarfDesc.zhText: 圣洁披饰会在 Tenno 每次使用技能的时候发出脉冲，并在每次使用技能时继续加强效果。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NLTigrisDesc.text: Echo nature's violent beauty with this special Tigris.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NLTigrisDesc.zhText: （英文：SANCTI TIGRIS）这把特制猛虎呼应了大自然的暴戾之美。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NamiSoloDesc.text: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NamiSoloDesc.zhText: （英文：NAMI SOLO）唤起对地球上的海洋的记忆，这把精美的弯刀是一件致命的艺术品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NanosporesDesc.text:
Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.

Location: Saturn, Neptune, Eris, and Deimos
/Lotus/Language/Items/NanosporesDesc.zhText:
纤维状的科技细胞肿瘤。请谨慎处理感染者组织。

获取地点：土星，海王星，阋神星和火卫二

/Lotus/Language/Items/NanosporesStoreOve.text:
Fibrous technocyte tumour. Handle Infested tissue with caution.
This bundle of 3,000 Nano Spores can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NanosporesStoreOve.zhText:
纤维状的科技细胞肿瘤。请警慎处理感染者组织。
这个内含 3,000 个纳米孢子的捆绑包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NavCodeDesc.text:
Coordinate used to locate lost ships.

Location: Dropped from Storage Containers
/Lotus/Language/Items/NavCodeDesc.zhText:
用来找到失踪飞船的坐标。

获取地点：可在储存容器中获得

/Lotus/Language/Items/NecroAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Nekros.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NecroDefaultHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nekros Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NecroFeaturedDescr.text: Explore your dark side with the new Nekros Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NecroFeaturedDescr.zhText: 让新的 NEKROS 战甲探索你的黑暗面。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NecroNobleAnimsDes.text: The Noble Animation Set for Nekros.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NecroScarfDesc.text: Only Nekros is permitted to wear the Mortos Binds.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NecroScarfDesc.zhText: 仅有 Nekros 有资格穿戴上这件死亡枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NekrosAltHelm2Desc.text: Strike fear into enemies with this alternate helmet for Nekros.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NekrosAltHelm2Desc.zhText: 通过这件 Nekros 的替换头盔来把恐惧深深地烙印在敌人心中。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NekrosAraknidHelme.text: The Raknis helmet provides a terrifying visage for your Nekros Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NekrosAraknidHelme.zhText: 这只古墓头盔赋予你的 Nekros 战甲一个恐怖的面貌。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NekrosCalacaGlyphN.text: Nekros Day of the Dead Glyph

/Lotus/Language/Items/NemesisNyxBundleDe.text: Become the Nemesis. Combine the mind control and psychic attacks of Nyx with her armored prototype skin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NemesisNyxBundleDe.zhText: 结合 Nyx 的原型装甲和心灵控制能力与精神攻击，化身为复仇者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NeuralSensorBluepr.text: A permanent blueprint that creates a NEURAL SENSOR
/Lotus/Language/Items/NeuralSensorBluepr.zhText: 可以打造一颗神经传感器的永久性蓝图

/Lotus/Language/Items/NeuralSensorDesc.text:
Implanted neural-link for controlling augmentations. Grineer design.

Location: Jupiter
/Lotus/Language/Items/NeuralSensorDesc.zhText:
植入式的神经连接，用于控制各类扩增强化系统，由 Grineer 设计。

获取地点：木星。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NeuralSensorStoreO.text:
Implanted neural-link for controlling augmentations. Grineer design.
This bundle of 1 Neural Sensor can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NeuralSensorStoreO.zhText:
植入神经控制扩增系统的链接，由 Grineer 设计。
这个内含1个神经传感器的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NeurodeBlueprintDe.text: A permanent blueprint that creates a NEURODE
/Lotus/Language/Items/NeurodeBlueprintDe.zhText: 可以打造一个神经元的永久性蓝图

/Lotus/Language/Items/NeurodeDesc.text:
Biotech sensor organ harvested from Infested entities.

Location: Earth, Lua, Eris, and Deimos
/Lotus/Language/Items/NeurodeDesc.zhText:
从感染者身上收集的生物感应器官。

获取地点：地球，月球，阋神星和火卫二

/Lotus/Language/Items/NeurodeStoreOverri.text:
Biotech sensor organ harvested from Infested entities.
This bundle of 1 Neurode can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NeurodeStoreOverri.zhText:
从感染者身上收集的生物感应器官。
这个内含1个神经元的组合包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NewLokaProfileIcon.text: A glyph of the New Loka

/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoArmorSetD.text: This highly decorated armor was once worn by the personal guards of an Orokin Emperor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoArmorSetD.zhText: 这种高度装饰的护甲曾经由一位奥罗金皇帝的个人护卫队所穿戴。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoArmorSetN.zhText: 超瓷材 Prime 护甲套装

/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoChestArmo.text: Decorative chest armor for a stylish Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoChestArmo.zhText: 为时髦 Tenno 打造的装饰性胸甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoHelmetDes.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nyx Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoMeleeDesc.text: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoMeleeDesc.zhText: （英文：SCINDO PRIME）一把古老的刑具，只有那些最受奥罗金尊重的敌人才能享有被分裂斩斧 Prime 斩首的荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoSecondary.text: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoSecondary.zhText: （英文：HIKOU PRIME）如同任何子弹一样致命，且不会引起噪音或骚动。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoSugatraDe.text: A prized relic from the Orokin era. These ornaments decorated the weapons of their military vanguard.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NextPromoSugatraDe.zhText: 来自奥罗金时代的珍贵遗物。这些饰品被用来装饰他们的先锋部队的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NezhaAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Nezha.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NezhaBundleDesc.text: Serve the Lotus with this bundle, containing Nezha Warframe and Shaku nunchakus.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NezhaBundleDesc.zhText: 以这份组合包服侍 Lotus，内含 Nezha 战甲及双节尺棍。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NezhaHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nezha Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NezhaNobleAnimsDes.text: The Noble Animation Set for Nezha.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NightCommonSampleD.text: A sample taken from a threshcone at night.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NightCommonSampleD.zhText: 黑夜期间所采集的去壳毬果样本。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NightRareSampleDes.text: A sample taken from a jadeleaf at night.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NightRareSampleDes.zhText: 黑夜期间所采集的玉叶样本。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NightUnCommonSampl.text: A sample taken from a dragonlily at night.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NightUnCommonSampl.zhText: 黑夜期间所采集的龙百合样本。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NightmareGrineerTr.text:
Vay Hek's Fomorian assault on our Relays was devastating but he failed to break us. Now we take the fight back to him. Now we exact justice.

This is a key for the Nightmare Mode of a TRIAL mission that has been designed to be very challenging for 8-players, and can be initiated from Earth.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NightmareGrineerTr.zhText:
虽然韦·海克的巨人战舰对我方中继站的袭击造成了毁灭性的伤害，但他并未因此击倒我们。现在该是以牙还牙的时候了，就在此刻，我们实践正义。

这是一把可以加入地球上试炼任务噩梦模式的钥匙。该任务极富挑战性、专为八名玩家组成的团队所设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NightmareRaidSekha.text: Created as a meditation on the ever expanding ribbon of energy that runs through the universe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NightmareRaidSekha.zhText: 以冥想创造出能澈悟宇宙，持续发散的带状能量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NightwatchWeaponSk.text: A collection of skins ripped from the weapons of the brutal Nightwatch Corps.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NightwatchWeaponSk.zhText: 来自残酷的夜巡者部队所使用武器外观的组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NinjaAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Ash.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NinjaAltHelmetDesc.text: Scorpion Helmet for the Ash Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NinjaDefaultHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Ash Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NinjaDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Ash 甲贺的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/NinjaDeluxeSuitDes.text: Emerge from the dark smoke of battle as a new vision of the master spy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NinjaDeluxeSuitDes.zhText: 以间谍大师的全新幻象，于战斗的暗涌尘烟之中浮现。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NinjaNobleAnimsDes.text: The Noble Animation Set for Ash.

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoStanceInstalledD.text: Equip Stance Mods on your Melee Weapons using the Arsenal to unlock devastating combos! Find Stance Mods in the world by killing enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoStanceInstalledD.zhText: 在军械库为你的近战武器安装架式MOD来解锁杀伤力强大的连击招式！借由击败敌人来寻找世界上的架式 MOD。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraInfestedCredsD.text: Used to purchase Nightwave's Cred Offerings. Nightwave Creds from past Series can be kept as souvenirs or sold for <CREDITS>Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraInfestedCredsD.zhText: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraIntermissionTw.text: Used to purchase Nightwave's Cred Offerings. Nightwave Creds from past Series can be kept as souvenirs or sold for <CREDITS>Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraIntermissionTw.zhText: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraSeasonThreeCre.text: Used to purchase Nightwave's Cred Offerings. Nightwave Creds from past Series can be kept as souvenirs or sold for <CREDITS>Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraSeasonThreeCre.zhText: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraShipDesc.text: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraShipDesc.zhText: 一款向海盗 DJ 诺拉·夜 的永恒漫游之家致敬的登陆艇型号。时刻保持强大与敏锐吧，梦回者。午夜电波的空中支援系统能够释放强力声波，它能摧毁弱小的敌人，同时也能让强大的敌人陷入眩晕。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraWolfCredsDesc.text: Used to purchase Nightwave's Cred Offerings. Nightwave Creds from past Series can be kept as souvenirs or sold for <CREDITS>Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraWolfCredsDesc.zhText: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraWolfTwoCredsDe.text: Used to purchase Nightwave's Cred Offerings. Nightwave Creds from past Series can be kept as souvenirs or sold for <CREDITS>Credits.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoraWolfTwoCredsDe.zhText: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。

/Lotus/Language/Items/NoruPrimeSyandanaD.text: A relic from another time, this syandana is a highly ornamental and prized garment.
/Lotus/Language/Items/NoruPrimeSyandanaD.zhText: 来自于其他时代的遗物，这条披饰是一种极具观赏性的珍贵服装。

用全新的 Prestige 道具包 IV 随时随地展示你的 Xbox One 光荣和骄傲！

这个道具包用限定版的凯旋将军翡翠披饰让所有的 Xbox One 玩家展示他们对战场的控制。

Prestige 道具 IV 包含：
- Xbox One 限定版 凯旋将军 翡翠披饰
- 170 白金

每个帐户只能在限定的时间内购买这个道具包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackFourNa.zhText: 限定版 Prestige 道具包 IV

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackSevenD.text:
Show your Xbox One allegiance with the all-new Prestige Pack VII!

Gear-up and stand out in the Origin System with the Exclusive Jade Daedalus Armor Collection! Plus, give your Arsenal a boost with bonus Platinum!

Prestige Pack VII includes:
- Jade Daedalus Chest Plate
- Jade Daedalus Shoulder Plates 
- Jade Daedalus Knee Plates
- 170 Platinum

This Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackSevenD.zhText:
用全新的荣耀威望道具包 VI 随时随地展示你的 Xbox One 光荣和骄傲！

带着这套限定版翡翠代达罗斯护甲，整装上阵并鹤立于整个太阳系！此外，道具包中包含的白金得允你进一步扩充军械库！

荣耀威望道具包 VII 包含：
- 翡翠代达罗斯胸甲
- 翡翠代达罗斯肩甲
- 翡翠代达罗斯护膝
- 170 白金

每个帐号只能在限定的时间内购买这个道具包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackSevenN.zhText: 限定版荣耀威望道具包 VII

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackSixBan.text: Now Available for a Limited Time

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackSixDes.text:
Show your Xbox One allegiance with the all-new Prestige Pack VI!

Run into battle, Tenno! Inflict a fiery heat upon your enemies with the Jade-skinned Heat Sword and Heat Dagger. Plus, give your Arsenal a boost with the included Platinum!

Prestige Pack VI includes:
- Xbox One Exclusive Heat Sword Jade Skin (includes Heat Sword)
- Xbox One Exclusive Heat Dagger Jade Skin (includes Heat Dagger)
- Heat Sword Jade Skin may also be applied to Dual Heat Sword (weapon not included)
- 170 Platinum

This Pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackSixDes.zhText:
用全新的荣耀威望道具包 VI 随时随地展示你的 Xbox One 光荣和骄傲！

冲入战场吧，Tenno！使用翡翠外观烈焰长剑和翡翠外观烈焰匕首来给你的敌人造成炽热伤害。此外，用道具包中包含的白金来扩充你的军械库！

荣耀威望道具包 VI 包含：
- Xbox One 限定版烈焰长剑翡翠外观（包含武器烈焰长剑）
- Xbox One 限定版烈焰匕首翡翠外观（包含武器烈焰匕首）
- 烈焰长剑翡翠外观也可以用于烈焰双剑（武器不包含在内）
- 170 白金

每个账号只能在限定的时间内购买这个道具包一次。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackSixNam.zhText: 限定版荣耀威望道具包 VI

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackThreeB.text: Take Xbox One pride and allegiance into the unknown with the all-new Prestige Pack III!
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackThreeB.zhText: 快以这组全新登场的荣耀威望包 III，引领 Xbox One 骄傲而忠诚的踏入未知领域吧！

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackThreeD.text:
Take Xbox One pride and allegiance into the unknown with the all-new Prestige Pack III!

This Pack lets any Xbox One player illuminate the darkness of space with an exclusive Itzal Archwing skin and Liset skin.

Prestige Pack III includes:
- Xbox One exclusive Jade Itzal Archwing skin (Does not include Archwing)
- Xbox One exclusive Jade Liset skin
- 170 Platinum 

This pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackThreeD.zhText:
快以这组全新登场的荣耀威望包 III，引领 Xbox One 骄傲而忠诚的踏入未知领域吧！

组合包内独家的 Itzal Archwing 外观与 Liset 外观，得以让每一位 Xbox One 玩家点亮漆黑的苍穹。

荣耀威望包 III 内含物品：
－Xbox One 独家翡翠 Itzal Archwing 外观（不含 Archwing 本体）
－Xbox One 独家翡翠外观 Liset
－170 点白金

此组合包商品限期贩卖，同一帐户仅限购买一组。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackTwoBan.text: Show your power and mystique with Prestige Pack II
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackTwoBan.zhText: 用Prestige 包 II 展现你的神秘和力量

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackTwoDes.text:
Show your power and mystique with Prestige Pack II. The Latron and Dual Kamas equipped with exclusive skin that emanates colors of the Xbox One will make your allegiance clear in the field of battle. Also included is Platinum to supercharge your arsenal.

This Pack includes:
- 170 Platinum
- Xbox One Exclusive Jade Latron Skin (includes Latron rifle)
- Xbox One Exclusive Jade Dual Kamas Skin (includes Dual Kamas)
This item may only be purchased once per account.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrestigePackTwoDes.zhText:
用Prestige 包 II 展现你的神秘和力量。为拉特昂和双短柄战镰装备上发出 Xbox One 颜色的限定外观，可以在战场上明确表现你的效忠。道具包中还包含扩充军械库的白金。

这个包中包含:
- 170白金
- Xbox One 限定版翡翠外观 拉特昂 (包含拉特昂)
- Xbox One 限定版翡翠外观 双短柄战镰 (包含双短柄战镰)
每个帐户只限购买这个物品一次。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PriestAgileAnimsDe.text: The Agile Animation Set for Harrow.

/Lotus/Language/Items/PriestNobleAnimsDe.text: The Noble Animation Set for Harrow.

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeBucksDesc.text: Currency exchanged for Prime components and used to purchase items from the Void Trader.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeBucksDesc.zhText: 由Prime部件兑换的货币，可用于在虚空商人处购买商品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeBurstLaserPis.text: Shade Prime’s signature weapon fires laser bursts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeBurstLaserPis.zhText: 阴影 Prime 的标志性武器会发射激光束。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeBurstonDesc.text: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeBurstonDesc.zhText: （英文：BURSTON PRIME）一度以为随着岁月流逝而失去踪迹，尝试研发伯斯顿 Prime 但从没能够复制出往日的威力以及操控性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeCarrierSentin.text: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeCarrierSentin.zhText: 这架华丽的守护是呈现奥罗金晚期工艺与风格极佳的范例。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeDefaultArchwi.text: Default skin for the Odonata Prime Archwing.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeDefaultArchwi.zhText: 陨蜓 Prime 曲翼的默认外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeDualBroncosDe.text: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeDualBroncosDe.zhText: （英文：AKBRONCO PRIME）同时使用这两把相辅相成的奥罗金手枪 ，以更高的元素触发几率，来对目标造成更大的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeFlameScarfDes.text: A ceremonial version of the Pyra that drapes the entire back in a cape of flames.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeFlameScarfDes.zhText: 庆典版的珮菈，一条披挂在背部的火焰披风。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeGlaiveDesc.text: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeGlaiveDesc.zhText: （英文：GLAIVE PRIME）战刃 Prime 在奥罗金时代是一把致命和优美的武器，其刀刃在近距离战斗时也与对远距离敌人掷出时一样有效。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeLaserRifleSto.zhText: （英文：PRIME LASER RIFLE）一把激光步枪 Prime。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeLexDesc.text: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeLexDesc.zhText: （英文：LEX PRIME）雷克斯 Prime 是一把强大且精准的手枪，虽然有着射速慢和弹匣小的缺点，但在远距离作战时非常出色。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeLisetShipDesc.text: The finest in Orokin personal transportation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeLisetShipDesc.zhText: 奥罗金最好的个人交通工具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeNikanaDesc.text: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeNikanaDesc.zhText: （英文：NIKANA PRIME）远在奥罗金帝国灭亡之前即存在的古老刀刃。以失落的技术所锻冶之刀锋，至今仍比当代各型侍刃来的锐利。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimePolearmDesc.text: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimePolearmDesc.zhText: （英文：ORTHOS PRIME）作为上古奥罗金的军用武器，欧特鲁斯 Prime 由最纯净的红化结晶制成，因而极其轻盈。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeScarfDDesc.text: An ancient Syandana worn during Tenno purification meditation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeScarfDDesc.zhText: Tenno 在仲裁仪式时所佩戴的一件古老的披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSentinelMaskN.zhText: 脉涌 Prime 守护面具

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSentinelShotg.text: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Prime Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSentinelShotg.zhText: （英文：SWEEPER PRIME）搬运者 PRIME的标准武器，使用霰弹枪子弹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSentinelTailN.zhText: 脉涌 Prime 守护尾部

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSentinelWings.zhText: 脉涌 Prime 守护飞翼

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSicarusDesc.text: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSicarusDesc.zhText: （英文：SICARUS PRIME）暗杀者 PRIME 是一把快速点射的装饰性武器，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSomaDesc.text: Known for taking down whole squads with its single massive magazine, few weapons were as feared as the Prime Soma.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeSomaDesc.zhText: （英文：SOMA PRIME）以威猛的火力成功掠倒整支队伍而闻名，仅有少数武器能像月神 Prime 一样令人闻之丧胆。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeVastoDesc.text: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeVastoDesc.zhText: （英文：VASTO PRIME）这把优雅的速射左轮手枪，正是奥罗金卓越工艺设计的体现。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeVectisDesc.text: Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrimeVectisDesc.zhText: （英文：VECTIS PRIME）曾经一度认为已被消灭殆尽；这把新发现的守望者 Prime 还原了 Tenno 的武之传统。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaArchSwordDes.text: A rare object of beauty, this Archwing sword has been sheathed in prisma crystal and baptized in the Void’s energy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaArchSwordDes.zhText: （英文：PRISMA VERITUX）这把曲翼之剑包覆在棱晶之中且沐浴着虚空的能量，成为了稀有而美丽的存在。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaArrowDesc.text: Forged from hardened prisma crystal, these extravagant arrows make a bold statement.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaArrowDesc.zhText: 以硬化的棱晶铸成，这些奢华的箭矢构成了鲜明大胆的展现。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaBurstLaserPi.text: Fires a small burst of lasers.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaBurstLaserPi.zhText: （英文：PRISMA BURST LASER）点射一小束激光。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaCleaversDesc.text: Blades of energized prisma crystal make these ornamental cleavers cut as sharply as they look.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaCleaversDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA DUAL CLEAVERS）这双经过装饰的刀刃充满了棱晶的能量，使得这副双刀的切砍如同它的外表一般锐利。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaCorpusUMPDes.text: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaCorpusUMPDes.zhText: （英文：PRISMA TETRA）在浸泡过虚空能量与棱晶后，这把单纯的特拉能量步枪成为了威吓与风格的指标。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaExcaliburBun.text: Let Excalibur stand apart with skin and helmets forged from the purest prisma crystal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaExcaliburBun.zhText: 这套由纯净的棱晶锻造而成的外观与头盔，能令 Excalibur 与众不同。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaFishTailName.zhText: 棱晶 锦鲤守护尾部

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaGorgonDesc.text: Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaGorgonDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA GORGON）装饰了虚空的硬化棱晶，使这把蛇发女妖因她的美丽与增强的机能变得更具价值。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaGrakataDesc.text: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaGrakataDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA GRAKATA）这把突击步枪镀上了一层纯净的棱晶，此种稀有元素赋予它闪耀动人的光泽。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaJetWingsName.zhText: 棱晶 喷射动力守护飞翼

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaMacheteDesc.text: The addition of Prisma Crystal allows this otherwise barbaric weapon to elegantly hack through any foe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaMacheteDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA MACHETE）这把原本野蛮的武器在融入棱晶后能优雅的斩杀任何敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaMechHeadMask.zhText: 棱晶 机甲头部守护面具

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaSentinelAcce.text: An ordinary Sentinel becomes extraordinary with striking prisma accessories.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaSentinelAcce.zhText: 以抢眼的棱晶系列配件让普通的守护变得非凡耀人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaSentinelDesc.text: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaSentinelDesc.zhText: 虚空中的一种稀有珍宝。怎有如此美丽宝物竟是为潜行锻造？

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaSkanaDesc.text: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaSkanaDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA SKANA）这把空刃是由原生棱晶所锻造而成，并注入了虚空能量，千锤百炼下其纯净的刀锋即便是最致命的敌人都能大卸八块。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaYamakoScarfD.text: Forged by Orokin era artisans, this exquisite syandana is finished by bathing its prisma crystal in pure Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrismaYamakoScarfD.zhText: 由奥罗金时代的工匠所制造，这条精致的披饰是浸泡在充满虚空能量的棱晶中才完成的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProcAbsorbStoreIte.text: Sentinel prevents Status Effects from applying to its owner once every <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProcAbsorbStoreIte.zhText: 每 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN| 秒，守护将防止其拥有者受到异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectSinisterBad.text: An insignia dropped by an Acolyte of the Stalker.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectSinisterBad.zhText: 一名追猎者的追随者所掉落的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectSinisterPha.text: Rewards for completing Phase One of Shadow Debt
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectSinisterPha.zhText: 完成「影子之债」第一阶段任务的奖励
奥罗金催化剂  &  追随者纹章

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectSinisterPha.text: Rewards for completing Phase Two of Shadow Debt
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectSinisterPha.zhText: 完成「影子之债」第二阶段任务的奖励
奥罗金反应堆  &  追随者徽章

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectionDescript.text: An artifact containing Orokin secrets. It can only be opened through the power of the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProjectionDescript.zhText: 一个包含着奥罗金秘密的神器。它只能通过虚空之力来打开。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PromoParisDesc.text: With it's constantly shifting finish of polished cloud-stone, the Paris Abra Skin is sure to impress.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PromoParisDesc.zhText: 有着不断变化的抛过光的陨石涂饰，帕里斯磨蚀外观一定会让人印象深刻。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProtectAbilityDesc.text: Engulfs a target ally in an impregnable stasis field, preventing damage and slowing player bleedout.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProtectAbilityDesc.zhText: 把队友包裹在一个力场中，隔绝一切伤害并延长倒地救援的时限。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProtoExcaliburSuit.text:
Discovering the precise nature of this recently uncovered armored prototype has proved elusive. Initial attempts at dating point to ancient origins, perhaps even predating Orokin Empire. 

*Excalibur not included.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProtoExcaliburSuit.zhText:
揭示这个最近发现的装甲原型的确切性质已被证实是十分困难的。测定年代的初步尝试表明，它的起源可能要追溯到奥罗金帝国以前。

*本商品不含 Excalibur 战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PrototypeRaidSekha.text: Those who risked everything to exact justice for the Tenno are honored with this Sekhara.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PrototypeRaidSekha.zhText: 以这顶饰冠来荣耀那些为了 Tenno 而身陷险境，实践正义之人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ProvaVandalDesc.text: A customized version of the vicious Prova, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ProvaVandalDesc.zhText: （英文：PROVA VANDAL）这是凶恶的普罗沃的定制化版本，拥有金属质感及莲花徽记。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PumpkinheadDesc.text: This mask is tied to an ancient legend from a forgotten era.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PumpkinheadDesc.zhText: 这副面具与一个被人所遗忘年代的古老传说息息相关。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PunchKickStanceADe.text: Lightning fast hit chains and hard-hitting combos.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PunchKickStanceADe.zhText: 闪电般迅速的连击和重击组合。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PunctureGlaiveDesc.text: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PunctureGlaiveDesc.zhText: （英文：CERATA）由于接触到感染者变得疯狂而扭曲，这把战刃在能熟练的 Tenno 手中会成为绝对的掠食者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PurpleAntitoxinBlu.text: Fuses the extracts from Moonlight Threshcones to create a mild antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PurpleAntitoxinBlu.zhText: 将月光去壳毬果的萃取物融合所提炼出的温和解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PurpleAntitoxinDes.text: This is a mildly effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PurpleAntitoxinDes.zhText: 这是一个轻度有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PvPLoadoutSlotItem.text: Grants an extra Conclave loadout slot
/Lotus/Language/Items/PvPLoadoutSlotItem.zhText: 获得额外的武形秘仪配置槽位

/Lotus/Language/Items/PvPMeleeStanceDesc.zhText: 为武形秘仪设计的战斗形式。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PvpRepBadgeDesc.text: The holographic interface on this emblem will update to display the rank achieved through exemplary dedication to Conclave Alerts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PvpRepBadgeDesc.zhText: 通过堪称典范般的全心投入武形秘仪任务，这个徽章上的全息影像接口会更新显示出所达到的阶级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/PyraSugatraDesc.text: During the height of the Old War, Tenno raiders used these flaming sugatras to intimidate and distract enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/PyraSugatraDesc.zhText: 在上古之战高峰期间，Tenno 的突袭者会使用这些火焰般的坠饰来威吓并使敌人分心。

/Lotus/Language/Items/QuadShotgunDesc.text: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
/Lotus/Language/Items/QuadShotgunDesc.zhText: （英文：HEK）海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。

/Lotus/Language/Items/QuantaVandalDesc.text: A customized version of the Quanta, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/QuantaVandalDesc.zhText: （英文：QUANTA VANDAL）这把是定制化版本的量子切割器，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RVBallisticaDesc.text: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RVBallisticaDesc.zhText: （英文：RAKTA BALLISTICA）这把经过改造的布里斯提卡是血色面纱的刺客用来解决高度优先目标的首选武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RVCernosDesc.text: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RVCernosDesc.zhText: （英文：RAKTA CERNOS）一把精巧的刺杀工具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RVDarkDaggerDesc.text: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RVDarkDaggerDesc.zhText: （英文：RAKTA DARK DAGGER）隐蔽入侵：持取时降低自身可见度。紧接着挥出自信一击：击中被辐射的目标可以恢复护盾并产生过载护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RVScarfDesc.text: This Asita Rakta Syandana ignites a jet of flames that burns brighter with each stealth takedown.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RVScarfDesc.zhText: 隐士绯红披饰会在每次的暗杀燃起火焰，并且愈燃愈亮。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RadialBlastAbility.text: Boosting this ability increases the damage dealt and the area of effect.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RadialBlastAbility.zhText: 提升此能力会增加伤害和影响范围。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RadialBlastAbility.text: Warframe punches the ground, dealing high damage to enemies in a small radius.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RadialBlastAbility.zhText: 战甲震击地面，在小范围内对敌人造成大量伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RadialHealAbilityD.text: Provides a small healing effect for allies in a large radius.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RadialHealAbilityD.zhText: 对大范围内的友军实施一次轻度治疗。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RandomKeyDesc.text: 5 Random Void Keys, one guaranteed Rare Key. What secret missions exist within the Void?
/Lotus/Language/Items/RandomKeyDesc.zhText: 5 枚随机虚空钥匙，包含了一枚稀有钥匙。虚空中存在着怎样的秘密任务？

/Lotus/Language/Items/RandomProjectionDe.text:
Receive 5 random Relics or Aya, a currency used to purchase Varzia's offerings. You are guaranteed at least one Rare Relic or Aya from this pack. What secrets exist within them?

Note: Does not include Requiem Relics.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RandomProjectionDe.zhText:
获取 5 个随机遗物或者阿耶精华（阿耶精华是一种用于购买瓦奇娅商品的货币）。此组合包中保证有至少一件稀有遗物或者阿耶精华。其中隐藏着什么秘密？

注：不包含安魂遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RangerAgileAnimsDe.text: The Agile Animation Set for Ivara.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RangerAltHelmetDes.text: An homage to hunters of the ancient past.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RangerHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Ivara Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RangerNobleAnimsDe.text: The Noble Animation Set for Ivara.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RangerQuiverHoldTo.zhText: 轻按 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_0> 切换箭矢类型

/Lotus/Language/Items/RapierBundleDesc.text: This bundle includes the Destreza rapier, Vulpine Mask stance and a 7-day Affinity Booster.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RapierBundleDesc.zhText: 这份组合包内包含了技巧细剑、狡狐诈面架式，以及7日的经验值加成道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RareFusionPackDesc.text: Roll the dice to get a 5 pack of randomly upgraded Fusion Cores, with one guaranteed RARE.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RareFusionPackDesc.zhText: 摇骰子来随机获得5张升级过的融合核心MOD，其中一张保证是稀有等级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RareUpgradePackDes.text: Roll the dice to get a 5 pack of mods, with one guaranteed Rare.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RareUpgradePackDes.zhText: 摇骰子来获得5张MOD，其中一张为稀有。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorMeleeDangleDe.text: Expressing the martial finesse and skill of its master, the Uru Sugatra complements the Uru Syandana used in the Tenno Absolution Ceremony.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorMeleeDangleDe.zhText: 展现了师范般的武术修为与技艺，这条乌鲁坠饰与乌鲁披饰是使用在 Tenno 赦免仪式上的一对饰品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorScarfDesc.text: The Syandana is a traditional Tenno garment. This variation was often worn during the Tenno Absolution Ceremony.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorScarfDesc.zhText: 这件披饰是一种传统的 Tenno 服装，通常只有在 Tenno 的仪式上才会穿戴。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorbackCipherDes.text: Used to bypass security systems that protect the Razorback's holding cell.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorbackCipherDes.zhText: 用来绕开保护利刃豺狼收容室的安保系统。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorbackCipherPar.text:
Excess circuitry disposed of during the Razorback manufacturing process, these components only appear in the vicinity of high level outer-orbit Corpus facilities after a Razorback Armada has been launched.

Location: Corpus Archwing units on Jupiter and Neptune when a Razorback Armada is active
/Lotus/Language/Items/RazorbackCipherPar.zhText:
制造利刃豺狼过程中的多余回路。在利刃豺狼舰队上阵后，这些组件只会出现在高等的 Corpus 外环设施之中。

获取地点：利刃豺狼舰队活动期间木星和海王星上的 Corpus 曲翼单位

/Lotus/Language/Items/ReaperPrimeDesc.text: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ReaperPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：REAPER PRIME）收割者 Prime 是一把装饰用镰刀，带有以回火工艺处理过的红化结晶锻造的刀刃。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ReconnasorDesc.text: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ReconnasorDesc.zhText: （英文：GAMMACOR）原为使矿物迅速蒸发以便于分析作业而设计，然而使用者却发现它强大的光束对于终结敌人也同样有效。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RedAntitoxinBluepr.text: Fuses the extracts from Sunlight Threshcones to create a mild antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RedAntitoxinBluepr.zhText: 将日光去壳毬果的萃取物融合所提炼出的温和解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RedAntitoxinDesc.text: This is a mildly effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RedAntitoxinDesc.zhText: 这是一个轻度有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RedVeilProfileIcon.text: A glyph of the Red Veil

/Lotus/Language/Items/RegenStoreItemDesc.text: Sentinel recovery time reduced by |TIMEREDUCTION|s. Revives with |IMMUNETIME|s of invulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RegenStoreItemDesc.zhText: 守护恢复时间减少 |TIMEREDUCTION| 秒。复活时具有 |IMMUNETIME| 秒的无敌状态。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RegorAxeShieldDesc.text: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RegorAxeShieldDesc.zhText: 这对特制的战斧与盾牌正是泰尔·雷工用来消除"阻碍"的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RenownBoosterDesc.text: News of your deeds and actions spread faster with this active. Your progress towards player renown level-ups is doubled.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RenownBoosterDesc.zhText: 启动时会增加你事迹和行动的消息传播速度。玩家的名声会以两倍速度增加。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RepeatingCrossbowD.text: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RepeatingCrossbowD.zhText: （英文：ZHUGE）这把毁灭性的自动连弩是古代地球军武与 Tenno 工艺完美结合的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RescueEventBadgeDe.text: Awarded for the safe return of Red Veil Operatives during the Specters of Liberty operation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RescueEventBadgeDe.zhText: 来自魅影解放战中安全带回血色面纱特工的奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ResourceAmountBoos.text: Doubles the amount of resources you get from pickups.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ResourceAmountBoos.zhText: 使用者所拾取的资源数量增加一倍。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ResourceDropChance.text: Doubles the chance of resource drops.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ResourceDropChance.zhText: 资源掉落的几率增加一倍

/Lotus/Language/Items/RespawnSelfStoreIt.text: Energy Orbs reduce Sentinel Recovery timer by |TIME|s. Djinn recovers with |OVERSHIELDS| Overshields per Energy Orb collected. Djinn's max Overshields increase by |OVERSHIELDCAP|.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RespawnSelfStoreIt.zhText: 能量球可减少 |TIME| 秒守护恢复倒计时。每收集一个能量球，引灵会恢复 |OVERSHIELDS| 过载护盾。引灵的最大过载护盾增加 |OVERSHIELDCAP|。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ResurrectAbilityDe.text: Revives all allies who have been knocked down, and resurrects any allies who have died.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ResurrectAbilityDe.zhText: 救援所有倒地的队友，并复活已经死亡的队友。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ResurrectionUpgrad.text: An automatic self-revive if the player would have otherwise died.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RetrieverKubrowDes.text: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RetrieverKubrowDes.zhText: 一个聪明的伙伴，经过训练可以从敌人手中夺取武器和战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RetrieverKubrowPri.text: The genetic code of a Chesa Kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RetrieverKubrowPri.zhText: 寻猎型库狛的基因代码。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RevengeStoreItemDe.text: Sentinel will not attack an enemy unless that enemy has attacked the Sentinel's master within |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RevengeStoreItemDe.zhText: 除非敌人在 |RANGE| 米范围内攻击其主人，否则守护不会攻击敌人

/Lotus/Language/Items/ReviveBoosterDesc.text: Grants 4 free revives per match when active.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ReviveBoosterDesc.zhText: 启动时每场游戏完结后都会补充4次免费复活。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RevivePlayerStoreI.text: Sentinel incapacitates itself to revive its downed owner to |PERCENT|% health and shields in <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|TIME|s. Sentinel Recovery timer increases by |PENALTY|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RevivePlayerStoreI.zhText: 守护使自己失去战斗能力，在 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|TIME| 秒内复活其倒地的主人，使其恢复 |PERCENT|% 的生命值和护盾。守护恢复倒计时增加 |PENALTY| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Rhino.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoAltHelmet2Des.text: Vanguard Helmet for the Rhino Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoAltHelmetDesc.text: Thrak Helmet for the Rhino Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDefaultHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Rhino Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeDesc.text: Pay homage to warriors of a more chivalrous time with this skin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeDesc.zhText: 以这套外观向拥有着骑士时代风范的战士们致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeHammerD.text: Transform any Hammer weapon with this forged steel skin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeHammerD.zhText: 将任何战锤类武器改变为锻钢的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Rhino 伯爵的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeScarfDe.text: A Syandana fit for a knight.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeScarfDe.zhText: 能匹配上一名骑士的披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeSkinBun.text: Become the embodiment of vigilance. This pack features the Rhino Palatine Skin with matching Jat Kittag Palatine Skin and Palatine Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoDeluxeSkinBun.zhText: 变成警戒之化身。这套组合包内含有 Rhino 伯爵外观，并与战锤 伯爵外观及伯爵披饰搭配成套。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoNobleAnimsDes.text: The Noble Animation Set for Rhino.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoPrimeHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Rhino Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoSuitPackDesc.text: Unlock Rhino and his favorite gear.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RhinoSuitPackDesc.zhText: 解锁 Rhino 及其御用装备。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RifleDesc.text: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RifleDesc.zhText: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RifleModConvertAmm.text: Converts Secondary ammo pickups to |PERCENT|% of Ammo Pick Up.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RifleModConvertAmm.zhText: 将拾取的次要武器弹药转换为 |PERCENT|% 弹药拾取。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RobotPoorAimBuffDe.zhText: Corpus 敌人瞄准精度下降

/Lotus/Language/Items/RoboticsPackDesc.text: All 3 types of robotics for one low price.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RoboticsPackDesc.zhText: 以低价获得所有3种机器人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RocketCrossbowVorS.text: A unique skin for the Fluctus.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RollerBallDesc.text: Deploys a ROLLER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RollerBallDesc.zhText: 设置一个为你战斗的滚子卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RollerProfileIconD.text: A glyph of a Grineer Roller

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoDesc.text:
A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy.

Location: Earth, Lua, Phobos, Europa, Pluto, Sedna, and the Void
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoDesc.zhText:
锯齿状的结晶矿。放出辐射能量。

获取地点：地球，月球，火卫一，欧罗巴，冥王星，赛德娜和虚空

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinDrakgoon.text: This Drakgoon has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinDrakgoon.zhText: 这把龙骑兵装饰着一层美丽的红化结晶电镀。
龙骑兵 电镀红晶外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinGalatine.text: This Galatine has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinGalatine.zhText: 这把迦伦提恩以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。
迦伦提恩 电镀红晶外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinHelmetDe.text: This helmet has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinHelmetDe.zhText: 这顶头盔以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinRhinoDes.text: This Rhino Warframe has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinRhinoDes.zhText: 这套 Rhino 战甲以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinTwinVipe.text: These Twin Vipers have been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinTwinVipe.zhText: 这对双子蝰蛇以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。
双子蝰蛇 电镀红晶外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinViperDes.text: This Viper has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinViperDes.zhText: 这把蝰蛇以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinViperNam.zhText: 蝰蛇 电镀红晶外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinYamakoSy.text: This syandana has been adorned with a fine layer of Rubedo plating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoSkinYamakoSy.zhText: 这件披饰以镀上一层薄薄的红化结晶作为装饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoStoreOverrid.text:
A jagged crystalline ore. Gives off radiant energy.
This bundle of 450 Rubedo can be used for crafting items in your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/Items/RubedoStoreOverrid.zhText:
锯齿状的结晶矿。放出辐射能量。
这个内含 450 个红化结晶的捆绑包可以用来在铸造厂中制造道具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RuksClawExtractDes.zhText: 从 Ruk 之爪中萃取出的精华物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/RunnerAgileAnimsDe.text: The Agile Animation Set for Gauss.

/Lotus/Language/Items/RunnerNobleAnimsDe.text: The Noble Animation Set for Gauss.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SMHekDesc.text: Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SMHekDesc.zhText: （英文：VAYKOR HEK）在反抗拼搏的烈焰中铸造，造就这把成为自由解放之力的散弹枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SMMarelokDesc.text: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SMMarelokDesc.zhText: （英文：VAYKOR MARELOK）取自于战败的 Grineer 指挥官，并经过重构来提升作战效率和可靠性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SMScarfDesc.text: The Vaykor Syandana flares up whenever the Tenno takes damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SMScarfDesc.zhText: 勇气披饰会在 Tenno 受到伤害时燃烧起来。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SMSydonDesc.text: Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SMSydonDesc.zhText: （英文：Vaykor Sydon）正义会让人失明。每一次被格挡的攻击会为致盲充能，当充满时用格挡+重击来释放它。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWAnthroMagHelmetD.text: A helmet for the Mag Warframe, designed by Pior.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWAnthroMagHelmetD.zhText: Mag 战甲的头盔，由 Pior 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWArresterVoltHelm.text: A helmet for the Volt Warframe, designed by Rekkou.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWArresterVoltHelm.zhText: Volt 战甲的头盔，由 Rekkou 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWArturiusExcalibu.text: A helmet for the Excalibur Warframe, designed by [k a z].
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWArturiusExcalibu.zhText: Excalibur 战甲的头盔，由 [k a z] 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWClaymireGalatine.text: A skin for the Galatine greatsword, designed by novadragon01.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWClaymireGalatine.zhText: 迦伦提恩的外观，由 novadragon01 设计。
迦伦提恩 感染外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWInductionMagHelm.text: A helmet for the Mag Warframe, designed by Pior.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWInductionMagHelm.zhText: Mag 战甲的头盔，由 Pior 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWInfestedDualSkan.text: A skin for the Dual Skana sword, designed by Dencio Aggression.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWInfestedDualSkan.zhText: 空刃双刀的外观，由 Dencio Aggression 设计。
空刃双刀 感染外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWInfestedSkanaSki.text: A skin for the Skana sword, designed by Dencio Aggression.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWInfestedSkanaSki.zhText: 空刃的外观，由 Dencio Aggression 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWIsurusExcaliburH.text: A helmet for the Excalibur Warframe, designed by Coridium.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWIsurusExcaliburH.zhText: Excalibur 战甲的头盔，由 Coridium 设计。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWMagestyOrthosSki.text: A skin for the Orthos polearm, designed by prosetisen.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SWMagestyOrthosSki.zhText: 欧特鲁斯的外观，由 prosetisen 设计。
欧特鲁斯 威严外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/SWNoxiousHammerJat.text: A skin for the Jat Kittag mace, designed by Clyptic.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SandmanAgileAnimsD.text: The Agile Animation Set for Inaros.
