/Lotus/Language/Items/SandmanBundleDesc.text: Claim the treasures of the desert. Includes the Inaros Warframe and Inaros Anubis Helmet, an arsenal of infested weaponry, the stylish Abrasys Syandana and a pack of 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SandmanBundleDesc.zhText: 获取沙漠中的宝藏。包括 Inaros 战甲和 Inaros 阿努比斯头盔，一整个军械库的感染武器，时尚的磨蚀披饰和 3 天经验现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SandmanDefaultHelm.text: The standard issue helmet for the Inaros Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SandmanNobleAnimsD.text: The Noble Animation Set for Inaros.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SapientCapeDesc.text: Found deep in the rubble at Altra, this Syandana is thought to have been worn by Gauss on the day he broke through enemy lines, decisively ending that bloody siege.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SapientCapeDesc.zhText: 这件在阿尔特拉废墟深处发现的披饰，被认为是 Gauss 在突破敌人防线，果断结束那场血腥围攻时所穿过的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynAltHelmet2Des.text: Chlora Helmet for the Saryn Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynAltHelmetDesc.text: Hemlock Helmet for the Saryn Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDefaultHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeBundleD.text: This beautiful bundle contains exotic skins for Saryn, Dual Zoren and the exclusive Melia Sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeBundleD.zhText: 这份美丽的组合包内含有异国情调的 Saryn 外观、佐伦双斧外观与样式独特的栋之坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeDesc.text: Bloom into a beautiful yet deadly agent of the Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeDesc.zhText: 绽放为美丽而致命的 Lotus 特工。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Saryn 兰花的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeMeleeDa.text: This dazzling floral form can conceal darker intentions.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeMeleeDa.zhText: 这些令人眼花缭乱的花卉形式能隐藏更深层的意涵。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeSickleD.text: These graceful arcs of death are inspired by several species of predatory plants.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynDeluxeSickleD.zhText: 这些优美的死亡弧线乃是受到了数种捕食性植物的启发。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynPackDesc.text: Get Saryn and all of her favorite gear.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SarynPackDesc.zhText: 获得 Saryn 和她的御用装备。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ScannerDesc.text: Samples a target of interest for later analysis in your Codex (25 charges).
/Lotus/Language/Items/ScannerDesc.zhText: 抽样扫描感兴趣的目标到资料库，用于日后分析。（25个装）

/Lotus/Language/Items/ScatterGrenadeDesc.text: The scatter grenade is a medium yield explosive that hurls out several other small explosives on detonation.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ScatterGrenadeDesc.zhText: 集束榴弹在产生一个中型爆炸的同时会洒出几个小型炸药并再次引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ScrollingSugatraDe.text: With a form that echos the sails of ancient sea ships, this sugatra creates a commanding silhouette on any weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ScrollingSugatraDe.zhText: 这条坠饰以呼应古代海船扬帆的形式，为任何武器营造出领航者的轮廓。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ScytheStanceADesc.text: Far flung attacks and multi-hit combos.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ScytheStanceADesc.zhText: 大范围的挥动攻击与多次命中的连段。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ScytheStanceBDesc.zhText: 毁灭性的冲刺螺旋连段。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SeismicDataDesc.text: [PH]Incomplete and fragmented seismic data of Earth
/Lotus/Language/Items/SeismicDataDesc.zhText: [PH]Incomplete and fragmented seismic data of Earth

/Lotus/Language/Items/SelfHealLargeDesc.text: Instantly restores your Health to full.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SelfHealLargeDesc.zhText: 立即将你的生命恢复至全满

/Lotus/Language/Items/SelfPistolAmmoDesc.text: Restores a bunch of pistol ammo.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SelfReviveDesc.text: Recovers you from the knocked down state.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SelfRifleAmmoDesc.text: Restores a bunch of rifle ammo.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SelfShotgunAmmoDes.text: Restores a bunch of shotgun ammo.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SelfSniperAmmoDesc.text: Restores a bunch of sniper ammo.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SemiAutoRifleDesc.text: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SemiAutoRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：LATRON）拉特昂是一支半自动步枪。其高性能和高准确性令它在一名能精准射击的人手中时可以变得十分致命。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentElecRailgunRif.text: Standard issue sniper rifle for Diriga.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SentElecRailgunRif.zhText: （英文：VULKLOK）电气浮囊的标准狙击枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelBioWeaponD.text: Standard issue weapon for Djinn Sentinel. Fires <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin projectiles that embed into enemies and continuously deal damage for 3 seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelBioWeaponD.zhText: （英文：STINGER）引灵守护的标准武器。发射 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素投射物，嵌入敌人体内并持续造成伤害，持续 3 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelHealthRege.text: Sentinel will occasionally heal its owner, restoring |healPct|% Health over |duration|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelHealthRege.zhText: 守护会不时治疗它的主人，于 |duration| 秒内恢复 |healPct|% 血量

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelMaskDesc.text: A mask attachment for your sentinel pet.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelMaskGunhea.text: A mask attachment for your sentinel pet.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelShotgunDes.text: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelShotgunDes.zhText: （英文：SWEEPER）搬运者守护的标准武器，使用霰弹枪子弹。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelTailDesc.text: A stylish tail attachment for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelTailDesc.zhText: 守护宠物的时髦尾部配件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelWingsDesc.text: A pair of wings for your sentinel pet.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SentinelWingsDesc.zhText: 给守护宠物的一对飞翼。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadeDefaultSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Shade Sentinel.

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadePowerSuitStor.text: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadePowerSuitStor.zhText: 以「复仇」和「幽灵」为预设指令，非常适合隐匿型玩法，并同时具备点放式激光手枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadePrimeDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Shade Prime Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadePrimeDefaultS.zhText: 阴影 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadePrismaDefault.text: The standard issue skin for the Shade Prisma Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadePrismaDefault.zhText: 棱晶 阴影的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShadeSpriteSentine.text: The Sprite skin customization for the Shade Sentinel.

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShamrockColorPicke.text: Unlocks additional color options for Warframe customization.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShamrockColorPicke.zhText: 解锁更多用于战甲的自定义色彩。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShieldBuff.zhText: 提升护盾值与护盾恢复效果

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShieldDebuffKeyDes.text:
Shields are greatly reduced while key is equipped. Full Shield Gate duration is capped at 0.33s.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShieldDebuffKeyDes.zhText:
在装备钥匙时，护盾会大幅减少。满护盾保险持续时间的上限会限定在 0.33 秒。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShieldDroneBallDes.text: Deploys a SHIELD OSPREY EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShieldDroneBallDes.zhText: 设置一个为你战斗的护盾鱼鹰卓越者魅影。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShipChristmasifier.text: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShipChristmasifier.zhText: 在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShipLayerCNYDesc.text: For a limited time, adds festive decorations to your Orbiter!
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShipLayerCNYDesc.zhText: 在限定时间内，为你的轨道飞行器添加各种节庆装饰吧！

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShipyardEventBadge.text: An insignia awarded to the Tenno who distinguished themselves during Tethra's Doom event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShipyardEventBadge.zhText: 奖励给在泰斯拉末日活动里表现杰出的 Tenno 的徽章

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShockBallisticEnha.text: The Shock Ballistic Enhancer increases your ballistic weapon damage by a small percentage. The extra damage is shock damage, which is effective against shields.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShockBallisticEnha.zhText: 电击射弹强化器可以增加一定比例的弹道武器伤害，并能赋予电击伤害，可以有效打击护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunDesc.text: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunDesc.zhText: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunModConvertA.text: Converts Secondary ammo pickups to |PERCENT|% of Ammo Pick Up.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunModConvertA.zhText: 将拾取的次要武器弹药转换为 |PERCENT|% 弹药拾取。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SicarusTeknaBluepr.text: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SicarusTeknaBluepr.zhText: [PH] Remains of a weapon from a long forgotten world.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SilverSpectreDesc.text: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SilverSpectreDesc.zhText: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SingleKamaDesc.text: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SingleKamaDesc.zhText: （英文：KAMA）短柄战镰是一个 Tenno 风格的短柄斧，能够迅速击杀任何敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SingleStaffDesc.text: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SingleStaffDesc.zhText: （英文：CADUS）曾经有一名孤身一人的 Tenno 以这柄单手杖击退了一整个群落的感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SkanaPrimeDesc.text: A basic blade known as a Skana. It is widely used by the Tenno. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SkanaPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：SKANA PRIME）一副被称为空刃的基础刀刃，受到 Tenno 广泛的使用。Prime 版本提供了更高一些的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SkateweedExtractDe.zhText: 从鳐鱼草中萃取出的精华物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SkullBadgeBronzeDe.text: Awarded to Tenno who achieved a Bronze Rank on the retired Global Leaderboards.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SkullBadgeBronzeDe.zhText: 奖励给旧全球排行榜上获得铜牌的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SkullBadgeGoldDesc.text: Awarded to Tenno who achieved a Gold Rank on the retired Global Leaderboards.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SkullBadgeGoldDesc.zhText: 奖励给旧全球排行榜上获得金牌的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SkullBadgeSilverDe.text: Awarded to Tenno who achieved a Silver Rank on the retired Global Leaderboards.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SkullBadgeSilverDe.zhText: 奖励给旧全球排行榜上获得银牌的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SlingStone2EmblemD.text: An insignia awarded to the Tenno Elite who proved themselves during Operation Eyes of Blight.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SlingStone2EmblemD.zhText: 一只颁发给在毁灭之眼行动中证明了自身能耐的 Tenno 精英的纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SlingStoneEmblemDe.text: An insignia awarded to the Tenno Elite who proved themselves during Operation Sling-Stone.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SlingStoneEmblemDe.zhText: 这枚徽章被授予给那些在机弦行动中证明了自己实力的 Tenno 精英。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SniperModConvertAm.text: Converts Secondary ammo pickups to |PERCENT|% of Ammo Pick Up.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SniperModConvertAm.zhText: 将拾取的次要武器弹药转换为 |PERCENT|% 弹药拾取。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleDesc.text: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SnipetronVandalDes.text: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SnipetronVandalDes.zhText: （英文：SNIPETRON VANDAL）这把狙击特昂是少见的定制化版本，拥有金属质感及莲花徽记。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SnowflakeSigilDesc.text: A sigil depicting a snow flake.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SnowflakeSigilDesc.zhText: 一枚描绘着雪花的纹章

/Lotus/Language/Items/SoloAntitoxinBluep.text: Fuses many extracts from both Moonlight and Sunlight variations of Jadeleaf and Dragonlily to create a potent antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SoloAntitoxinBluep.zhText: 萃取了月光和日光种类的玉叶和龙百合所融合提炼出的强力解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SoloAntitoxinDesc.text: This is an extremely effective antitoxin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SoloAntitoxinDesc.zhText: 这是一个非常有效的解毒剂。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SomaDualKamasDesc.text: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SomaDualKamasDesc.zhText: （英文：DUAL RAZA）这组锐利战斧是为了配合月神而设计的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SparkSigilDesc.text: Shock the world with your sense of style.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SparkSigilDesc.zhText: 让你的时尚感震慑这个世界。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpecterSummonFeyar.text: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpecterSummonFeyar.zhText: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpecterSummonKnave.text: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpecterSummonKnave.zhText: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpecterSummonOrphi.text: Creates an organic compound composed of rare plant species. Effects unknown.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpecterSummonOrphi.zhText: 制作一种由稀有植物合成的有机混合物。效果未知。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmyBronzeD.text: An army composed of vapor-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for one conflict.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmyBronzeD.zhText: 一支由幻雾等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持一场战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmyGoldDes.text: An army composed of force-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for three conflicts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmyGoldDes.zhText: 一支由原力等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持三场战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmyPlatinu.text: An army composed of cosmic-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for four conflicts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmyPlatinu.zhText: 一支由无极等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持四场战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmySilverD.text: An army composed of phase-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for two conflicts.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpectreArmySilverD.zhText: 一支由相位等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持两场战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SpeedDebuffKeyDesc.text:
Speed is greatly reduced while key is equipped.

Blueprint can be obtained via the Orokin Lab in a Clan Dojo.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SpeedDebuffKeyDesc.zhText:
装备该钥匙，速度会极大的降低。

蓝图可以通过氏族道场中的奥罗金实验室获得。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StableCorruptorDes.text: Injected into a Fomorian Reactor this corruptor will imbalance the fuels. Critically imbalanced reactors will eventually implode, destroy the ship. Slow but effective, recommended for Solo Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StableCorruptorDes.zhText: 对巨人战舰反应堆注射这个污染物会造成燃料失调，失调的精密反应堆最后会发生聚爆，并摧毁船只，缓慢但是有效，推荐给独行 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StaffDesc.text: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StaffDesc.zhText: （英文：BO）双手强化长棍，它可以将敌人击飞。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StaffStanceADesc.zhText: 弧线攻击与集中的连段

/Lotus/Language/Items/StaffStanceBDesc.zhText: 上升打击和旋风的连段。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerAccessories.text: A grim accessory for Operator or Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerAccessories.zhText: 适合指挥官或漂泊者的冷血配件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerAccessories.text: A grim accessory for Operator or Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerAccessories.zhText: 适合指挥官或漂泊者的冷血配件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerAccessories.text: A grim accessory for Operator or Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerAccessories.zhText: 适合指挥官或漂泊者的冷血配件。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerArmourArmDe.text: Formed from the bones of Sentient fighters and given to the Stalker by Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerArmourArmDe.zhText: 由 Sentient 战士的骨头制成，Hunhow 赐予给追猎者的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerArmourChest.text: Formed from the bones of Sentient fighters and given to the Stalker by Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerArmourChest.zhText: 由 Sentient 战士的骨头制成，Hunhow 赐予给追猎者的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerArmourLegDe.text: Formed from the bones of Sentient fighters and given to the Stalker by Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerArmourLegDe.zhText: 由 Sentient 战士的骨头制成，Hunhow 赐予给追猎者的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerBowDesc.text: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerBowDesc.zhText: （英文：DREAD）恐惧是追猎者的标志性武器，其射出的箭矢足以取人首级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerCapeDesc.text: Formed from the bones of Sentient fighters and given to the Stalker by Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerCapeDesc.zhText: 由 Sentient 战士的骨头制成，是 Hunhow 赐予给追猎者的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerKunaiDesc.text: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerKunaiDesc.zhText: （英文：DESPAIR）追猎者所持的绝望，是丢出由单分子构成的刀刃，足够锋利来穿透战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerScytheDesc.text: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerScytheDesc.zhText: （英文：HATE）追猎者持有憎恨，这是一把残忍至极的镰刀。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoBundleDe.text: All the items bestowed upon the Stalker by the Sentient Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoBundleDe.zhText: 所有物品都是 Sentient Hunhow 授予给追猎者的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoBundleFe.text: All the items bestowed upon the Stalker by the Sentient Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoBundleFe.zhText: 所有物品都是 Sentient Hunhow 授予给追猎者的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoGreatSwo.text: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoGreatSwo.zhText: （英文：WAR）这把追猎者的剑是 Hunhow 赐予给他的。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoSwordDes.text: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoSwordDes.zhText: （英文：BROKEN-WAR）追猎者的战争之剑的碎片，是其落败的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StanceModPackDesc.text:
A pack of three randomly selected Stance Mods. 

Two Stance Mods are guaranteed to be Uncommon.

One Stance Mod is guaranteed Rare.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StanceModPackDesc.zhText:
三张随机选择的架式 MOD 的组合包。

其中两张架式 MOD 为罕见。

一张架式 MOD 为稀有。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StandardArchwingDe.text: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StandardArchwingDe.zhText: （英文：ODONATA）这组曲翼的系统拥有均衡的攻防能力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StandardDefaultArc.text: Default skin for the Odonata Archwing.

/Lotus/Language/Items/StartingRifleDesc.text: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StartingRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：MK1-BRATON）MK1-布莱顿是 Tenno 的标准配置步枪，是一把可被定制化以支援各种使用风格的多功能武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingBli.text: The Itzal Archwing teleports a short distance, dropping all enemy target locks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingBli.zhText: 刺影曲翼瞬移一小段距离，尽数甩开锁定了目标的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingBun.text:
Pull off the perfect sneak attack with this Archwing gear.

It includes the Itzal Archwing, perfect for covert operations, and comes outfitted with the Centaur blade and guard, and the Fluctus crossbow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingBun.zhText:
以这套曲翼装备完美地达成艰难的偷袭行动。

本包装内含刺影曲翼，非常适合用于隐蔽行动，并配有半人马剑盾与巨浪弩炮。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingClo.text: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingClo.zhText: 展开一道隐形力场，使静止于力场中的战甲与友军隐匿行踪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingDes.text: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingDes.zhText: （英文：ITZAL）专为隐匿行动而打造，这架曲翼擅长在太空的黑暗中进行突袭作战。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingDis.text: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingDis.zhText: 部署数台无人战机于战甲身旁进行战斗，当无人战机被破坏时会造成毁灭性的爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingGra.text: Cosmic Crush Augment: The black hole saps the area of heat, freezing enemies in range. Enemies near the black hole are completely frozen for |val|s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingGra.zhText: 星体震荡强化：黑洞可以削弱范围内的热能并完全冻结附近的敌人 |val| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingGra.text: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingGra.zhText: 形成一个会吸进附近所有物体的微型黑洞，并在最后爆裂造成大规模的冲击震波。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingRip.text: Launch a tethered hook that either pulls enemies close, or pulls the Warframe toward any stationary objects it hooks onto.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthArchwingRip.zhText: 发射一道钩索把敌人拉近，或是把战甲拉向被其钩住的任何一个静止物体。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthDefaultArch.text: Default skin for the Itzal Archwing.

/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthPackDesc.text: The best gear for eliminating your enemies silently
/Lotus/Language/Items/StealthPackDesc.zhText: 为暗杀准备的特别套装

/Lotus/Language/Items/SteelMeridianProfi.text: A glyph of the Steel Meridian

/Lotus/Language/Items/StickyBombDesc.text: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StickyBombDesc.zhText: （英文：CASTANAS）可远程遥控的雷爆信镖会悄悄传递致死剂量的电力给毫无戒备的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/StrunVandalDesc.text: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.
/Lotus/Language/Items/StrunVandalDesc.zhText: （英文：STRUN WRAITH）熟知霰弹枪截然不同的造型，斯特朗·亡魂拥有着相当特殊的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SummusPrimeSentine.zhText: 至上 Prime 守护面具
至上 Prime 守护尾部
至上 Prime 守护飞翼

/Lotus/Language/Items/SundialMeleeWeapon.text: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SundialMeleeWeapon.zhText: （英文：ZENISTAR）令敌人在炽烈的打击中焚灭，或用飞行的火盘将他们点燃。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SundialPistolDesc.text: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SundialPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：AZIMA）这把构造错综复杂的自动手枪能射出其弹匣，同时在空中旋转的弹匣短时间内会击发激光攻击附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SuperChargePackDes.text: A cache packed full of Darvo's finest wares, including a 7-day Affinity Booster, 7-day Credit Booster, a Forma, an Orokin Reactor, an Orokin Catalyst.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SuperChargePackDes.zhText: 一个塞满 Darvo 最好商品的组合包，其中包含了一款 7 天经验值加成，一款 7 天奖金加成器，一个 Forma，一个奥罗金反应堆，一个奥罗金催化剂，一个战甲槽位和一个武器槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SuperJumpAbilityBo.text: Boosting this ability increases the jump height.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SuperJumpAbilityBo.zhText: 提升此能力，增加跳跃高度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SuperJumpAbilityDe.text: Excalibur launches into the air, jumping 3x higher than normal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SuperJumpAbilityDe.zhText: Excalibur 向上弹射到空中，其跳跃高度是一般跳跃的三倍。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupplyDropHoverboa.text: Surf the Vallis with this turbo-charged K-Drive deck.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SupplyDropHoverboa.zhText: 以这款配有涡轮增压器的 K 式悬浮板在红谷号冲浪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportAnchorsAbil.text: Creates beacons that draw enemy fire, converting the damage into healing pulses.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportAnchorsAbil.zhText: 制造信标来吸引敌人的火力，将伤害转换为治疗的脉冲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportArchwingDes.zhText: （英文：AMESHA）化身成一名飞翼守护者。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportDefaultArch.text: Default skin for the Amesha Archwing.

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportDronesAbili.text: Tiny drones orbit the Warframe or an ally, and intercept enemy fire.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportDronesAbili.zhText: 释放小型无人机围绕着战甲或队友并拦截敌人的火力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportEnergyAbili.text: All damage taken is transformed into Energy, while abilities gain enhanced Range, Duration and Power. Affects the Warframe and nearby allies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportEnergyAbili.zhText: 将所有受到的伤害会转换成能量，同时技能会得到范围，持续时间和强度上的提升。这个效果会影响战甲和附近的队友。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportWardAbility.text: Renders the Warframe and nearby allies immune to Status Effects, while slowing nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportWardAbility.zhText: 使得 战甲和附近的队友免疫异常状态，同时减缓附近敌人的速度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportWardAugment.text: [PH] Any active Status Effects are applied to enemies within |val|m
/Lotus/Language/Items/SupportWardAugment.zhText: [PH] Any active Status Effects are applied to enemies within |val|m

/Lotus/Language/Items/SupremeSomaSetDesc.text: This bundle features the Soma assault rifle, Dual Raza battle hachets and Aksomati pistols. Sharing a unique visual style, the weapons in this set will inspire awe in your allies and fear in your foes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SupremeSomaSetDesc.zhText: 这个组合包中包含月神突击步枪，锋月双斧和轻灵月神双枪。分享独特的风格，这个组合包中的武器在使你的盟友敬畏的同时也让你的敌人畏惧。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SurvivalEventBadge.text: An insignia awarded to the Tenno who proved themselves during Survival event.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SurvivalEventBadge.zhText: 颁发徽章给在周末生存事件中证明自己的Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SwiftDethStoreItem.text: Sentinel will attack the first visible enemy within |RANGE|m.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SwiftDethStoreItem.zhText: 守护会攻击 |RANGE| 米范围内的第一名可视敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SwordShieldStanceA.text: Rapid attacks using sword and shield.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SwordShieldStanceA.zhText: 使用剑和盾的快速攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SwordShieldStanceB.zhText: 强力的斩切与盾牌攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SyndicateProfileIc.text: A collection of glyphs featuring the personnel working for the Syndicates.
/Lotus/Language/Items/SyndicateProfileIc.zhText: 全集团中各个效命人员的浮印组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/SyndicateRandomKey.text: 3 Random Void Keys, one guaranteed Rare Key. What secret missions exist within the Void?
/Lotus/Language/Items/SyndicateRandomKey.zhText: 3枚随机虚空钥匙，包含了一枚稀有钥匙。虚空中存在着怎样的秘密任务？

/Lotus/Language/Items/SyndicateRandomPro.text: Receive 3 random Relics or Aya, a currency used to purchase Varzia's offerings. What secrets exist within?
/Lotus/Language/Items/SyndicateRandomPro.zhText: 获取 3 个随机遗物或者阿耶精华（阿耶精华是一种用于购买瓦奇娅商品的货币）。其中蕴藏着什么秘密？

/Lotus/Language/Items/SyringeComponentDe.text:
A component of the Antiserum Injector.

Location: Oestrus on Eris
/Lotus/Language/Items/SyringeComponentDe.zhText:
一只抗血清注射器的部件。

获取地点：阋神星的 Oestrus

/Lotus/Language/Items/TacticLensDesc.text: Converts 2% of excess Affinity into Focus for the Naramon Way.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TacticLensDesc.zhText: 将 2% 超额的经验值转化为 Naramon 之道的专精。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TaserStunStoreItem.text: Every |COOLDOWN|s, Sentinel will continually zap an enemy within |BREAK|m, trapping them in a stunned state.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TaserStunStoreItem.zhText: 每 |COOLDOWN| 秒，守护会持续电击 |BREAK| 米内的单名敌人以达到牵制效果。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TaxonDefaultSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Taxon Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TaxonDefaultSkinDe.zhText: 塔克桑的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TaxonPrimeDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Taxon Prime Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TaxonPrimeDefaultS.zhText: 塔克桑 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamAmmoBlueprintD.text: Restores 1x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamAmmoBlueprintD.zhText: 每 15 秒恢复 1 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamAmmoDesc.text: Restores 1x Primary and Secondary Ammo Pick Up Amount every 15s for 60s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamAmmoDesc.zhText: 每 15 秒恢复 1 倍主要和次要弹药拾取量，持续 60 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamArmoryDesc.text: Infinite Magazine Capacity for all team members.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamArmoryDesc.zhText: 给予全部队友无限的弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamEnergyBlueprin.text: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 25 Energy every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamEnergyBlueprin.zhText: 恢复全团队的能量。每次脉冲恢复 25 点能量。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamEnergyDesc.text: Restores Energy to all squad members. Pulses 25 Energy every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamEnergyDesc.zhText: 恢复全团队的能量。每次脉冲恢复 25 点能量。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamHealBlueprintD.text: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 30 Health every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamHealBlueprintD.zhText: 恢复全团队的生命。每次脉冲恢复 30 点生命。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamHealDesc.text: Restores Health to all squad members. Pulses 30 Health every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamHealDesc.zhText: 恢复全团队的生命。每次脉冲恢复 30 点生命。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamShieldBlueprin.text: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 35 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamShieldBlueprin.zhText: 恢复全团队的护盾。每次脉冲恢复 35 点护盾。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamShieldDesc.text: Restores Shields to all squad members. Pulses 35 Shield every 7.5s for 30s.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TeamShieldDesc.zhText: 恢复全团队的护盾。每次脉冲恢复 35 点护盾。脉冲间隔 7.5 秒，共计 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TelluriumDesc.text:
This rare metal is foreign to the Origin System and can only be found in asteroids that have made the long journey from other stars.

Location: Archwing Missions on Uranus
/Lotus/Language/Items/TelluriumDesc.zhText:
这种罕见的金属来自始源星系之外，只能从来自其他恒星的小行星上获得。

获取地点：天王星上的曲翼任务

/Lotus/Language/Items/TenCipherBlueprint.text: A bundle containing the blueprint to build 10 Ciphers.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TenCipherBlueprint.zhText: 内含 10 个破解器蓝图的组合包

/Lotus/Language/Items/TenguAgileAnimsDes.text: The Agile Animation Set for Zephyr

/Lotus/Language/Items/TenguNobleAnimsDes.text: The Noble Animation Set for Zephyr

/Lotus/Language/Items/TenguPackDesc.text: Enjoy Update 12 in style. This pack features the latest items, including the Zephyr Warframe and the deadly new weapons: Phage, Akstiletto and Jat Kittag. Rapidly level your new gear with the included 3-Day Experience and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TenguPackDesc.zhText: 体验高大上的更新 12 吧。这个更新包的特色是最新的装备，包括 Zephyr 战甲和致命的新武器：噬菌者，史提托双枪和喷射战锤。为期三天的经验和现金加成让你迅速的升级你的新装备。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoAngleCapeScar.text: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoAngleCapeScar.zhText: 将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoArFeaturedDes.text: Deadly and elegant. Unload a curtain of steel death with this high-caliber, Tenno Assault Rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoArFeaturedDes.zhText: 身兼致命与优雅，用这把大口径 Tenno 突击步枪释放钢铁般的死亡弹幕。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoAssaultRifleD.text: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoAssaultRifleD.zhText: （英文：SOMA）高准度与高容量弹匣的结合，使月神突击步枪成为强大的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoCapePackDesc.text: Three colorful silken capes inspired by nature.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoCapePackDesc.zhText: 三种受大自然启迪的丝质披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoClawsDesc.text: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoClawsDesc.zhText: （英文：VENKA）运用一种全新的战斗姿势，这把 Tenno 武器可以把拳头变为利爪，把敌人变成散乱的肉块及废铁。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoDoubleBarrelS.text: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoDoubleBarrelS.zhText: （英文：TIGRIS）猛虎双管霰弹枪能快速连续的双弹齐发，轻松地拿下棘手的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoFeathersCapeS.text: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoFeathersCapeS.zhText: 将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGauntletDesc.text: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGauntletDesc.zhText: （英文：ANKYROS）一对强大的拳套，甲龙双拳是由 Tenno 专为近身格斗所设计。牺牲攻击范围以换取更快的攻击速度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGenAvatarFeat.text: A collection of glyphs made by fellow Tenno, from the Warframe community.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGenAvatarFeat.zhText: 一组收藏了来自 Warframe 社区，由以下 Tenno 所设计的浮印组合包。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGenAvatarPack.text:
A collection of glyphs made by fellow Tenno, from the Warframe community.

Designs by: Dynline, Epsilon, Fabpsi, Inkary, LocoCrazy and Sharksteeth
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGenAvatarPack.zhText:
一组收藏了来自Warframe 社区，由以下Tenno 所设计的浮印组合包。

Tenno 出品的设计者们：Dynline、Epsilon、Fabpsi、Inkary、LocoCrazy、Sharksteeth

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGenBadgeDesc.text: A special emblem worn only by a select few Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGenBadgeDesc.zhText: 仅有几位特定的 Tenno 能戴上这特殊的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGreatSwordDes.text: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGreatSwordDes.zhText: （英文：GALATINE）拥有强大蓄气攻击和一次攻击五名敌人的能力，迦伦提恩重剑可称为近身武器中的重炮。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGunbladeAutom.text: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGunbladeAutom.zhText: （英文：SARPA）在连续切砍之间夹杂重火力连发。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoHandShotgunDe.text: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoHandShotgunDe.zhText: （英文：PYRANA）用这把凶恶的自动霰弹手枪咬穿敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoLeafDotCapeSc.text: Envelop yourself in this silky nature-inspired syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoLeafDotCapeSc.zhText: 将自己裹入这款由天然丝绸所启发联想到的披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoLeverActionRi.text: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoLeverActionRi.zhText: （英文：SYBARIS）这支 Tenno 定制的扳杆式步枪是优雅的刽子手。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoMiosDesc.text: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoMiosDesc.zhText: （英文：LACERA）在熟练的大师手中，这把剑鞭极具毁灭性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoRevolverDesc.text: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoRevolverDesc.zhText: （英文：VASTO）稳定、可靠。这把瓦斯托左轮手枪结合了速度与力量，呈现出经典的神枪手意象。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSaiDesc.text: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSaiDesc.zhText: （英文：OKINA）用这把两端带有尖刺的十手来刺穿敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSaisBundleDes.text: This bundle contains the deadly Okina sais and the Spinning Needle stance.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSaisBundleDes.zhText: 这个组合包内有致命的十手「翁」，以及架式「旋压针刺」。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoShurikenDesc.text: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoShurikenDesc.zhText: （英文：HIKOU）作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSilentCrossbo.text: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSilentCrossbo.zhText: （英文：ATTICA）阿提卡连弩能够快速发射一片致命的弩矢弹幕。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSniperRifleDe.text: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSniperRifleDe.zhText: （英文：VECTIS）守望者是把适于远距击杀敌人的理想武器，一把 Tenno 的经典狙击步枪。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSwordShieldDe.text: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSwordShieldDe.zhText: （英文：SILVA & AEGIS）这一火焰般的剑盾组合使 Tenno 的攻击与防御技艺取得完美的平衡。在大师的手中，就连盾牌这样的防御工具也能被用作武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoTommyFeatureT.zhText: 一把兼具大容量弹匣和高伤害的杀器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoTommyGunDesc.text: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoTommyGunDesc.zhText: （英文：STRADAVAR）一把兼具大容量弹匣和高伤害的杀器，这把武器可以在半自动和全自动开火模式间切换。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoUziDesc.text: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoUziDesc.zhText: （英文：AKSTILETTO）这对小巧，能快速击发的史提托全自动手枪，其恰如其分的尺寸既能双持射击又不失精准度。

/Lotus/Language/Items/Tennocon2017Desc.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2017.
/Lotus/Language/Items/Tennocon2017Desc.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2017 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoconScarfDesc.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2016.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TennoconScarfDesc.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2016 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TigrisRedeemerSetP.text: A stylish repertoire of weapons incorporating bladed designs for razor-sharp gunplay.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TigrisRedeemerSetP.zhText: 一整组结合了刀片元素专为剃刀般锋利的枪战而设计的时尚武器。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TitaniaBundleDesc.text: Explore the secrets of the forest. Includes the Titania Warframe and Titania Aurai Helmet, the razor-sharp Sarpa gunblade, the Pox infested darts and matching syandana. Also includes 3-Day Affinity and Credit Boosters.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TitaniaBundleDesc.zhText: 探索森林中的秘密。此道具包中包含 Titania 战甲和 Titania 风之妖精头盔、如剃刀般锋利的枪刃武器蛇刃、被脓痘感染的飞镖和配套的披饰。此外，包中还包含3天经验值和现金加成。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TitaniaBundleFeatu.text: Explore the secrets of the forest.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TitaniaHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Titania Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnChoirScytheDesc.text:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnChoirScytheDesc.zhText:
和谐战胜憎恨。重击会立刻结算所有的异常状态效果伤害。使用重击击杀敌人可增强友军的触发时间。

当晚祷、歌颂与和谐一同奏响时，体验 Jade 之合奏真正的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnChoirframeKunaiD.text:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnChoirframeKunaiD.zhText:
在绝望的时刻，让歌声响彻战场。歌颂的刃片会扎入战场中，并在重新装填时返回。当返回的刃片击中敌人时，歌颂会增强友军的装填速度。

当晚祷、歌颂与和谐一同奏响时，体验 Jade 之合奏真正的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnSentinelCrossDes.text: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnSentinelCrossDes.zhText: 以「突击模式」和「分子转化」为预设指令，塔克桑利用护盾恢复来保护主人。它装备了阿塔克斯冰冷光束。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnTAbilityDesc.text: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnTAbilityDesc.zhText: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoBladedPistolsDe.text: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoBladedPistolsDe.zhText: （英文：AKJAGARA）这组重击双手枪的设计是有机体和刀片元素的结合。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoCapeDesc.text: The exclusive garment of Tenno chosen to protect the Orokin Council of Executors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoCapeDesc.zhText: 被选为保护奥罗金议会执行者的 Tenno，才能穿上这件专属服饰。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoGunbladeDesc.text: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoGunbladeDesc.zhText: （英文：REDEEMER）救赎者能以巨大的双刃进行攻击，并用内建的霰弹枪造成致命一击。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoKrisKnifeDesc.text: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoKrisKnifeDesc.zhText: （英文：KARYST）这曾是一个门第严格的 Tenno 刺客工会的特制武器，凯洛斯特匕首后来渐渐成为了所有 Tenno 的荣耀与使命的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoMeleeDangleDesc.text: This sugatra is favoured by Tenno participating in the Conclave, as it is a symbol of unity and conviction.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoMeleeDangleDesc.zhText: 这条坠饰受到了参与武形秘仪的 Tenno 喜爱，因为它是团结与信念的象征。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoMiterDesc.text: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoMiterDesc.zhText: （英文：PANTHERA）发射高速刀刃，这把武器同时也能作为战斗用电锯，切碎任何进入攻击范围的倒霉鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoMonkSpadeDesc.text: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoMonkSpadeDesc.zhText: （英文：TIPEDO）带有新月型刀刃的提佩多，能以弧形横扫飞舞并以惊人的高速进行攻击。使用者若想释放提佩多的真正威力，必须高度集中精神。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoNunchakuDesc.text: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoNunchakuDesc.zhText: （英文：SHAKU）这副双节棍挥动速度极快，敌人永远不会知道是被什么武器给击中。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoRapierDesc.text: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoRapierDesc.zhText: （英文：DESTREZA）用这把 Tenno 细剑以艺术的方式来提升武术战斗技巧。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoTonfaDesc.text: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TnoTonfaDesc.zhText: （英文：KRONEN）皇家拐刃重现了一度被认为已失落于长久岁月中的致命战斗风格。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TonfaStanceADesc.text: A style exhibiting sweeping slash attacks and swift jabs.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TonfaStanceADesc.zhText: 一种扫荡般的切斩以及戳刺攻击方式。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TonfaStanceBDesc.text: An outlandish style with sweeping attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TonfaStanceBDesc.zhText: 有着连绵不绝攻击手段的诡异风格。

/Lotus/Language/Items/ToxinInjectorDevic.text: The Grineer are using this machine to poison the local habitat.
/Lotus/Language/Items/ToxinInjectorDevic.zhText: Grineer 正在利用这台机器污染当地的自然环境。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TranslatorBadgeDes.text: A special emblem worn only by a select few Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TranslatorBadgeDes.zhText: 仅有几位特定的 Tenno 能戴上这特殊的徽章。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationCoreA.text: Ensures transmuted mod is of Madurai polarity and eliminates credit cost.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationCoreA.zhText: 使转换过程无须消耗现金，并确保获得的 MOD 为 Madurai 极性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationCoreD.text: Ensures transmuted mod is of Vazarin polarity and eliminates credit cost.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationCoreD.zhText: 使转换过程无须消耗现金，并确保获得的 MOD 为 Vazarin 极性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationCoreT.text: Ensures transmuted mod is of Naramon polarity and eliminates credit cost.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationCoreT.zhText: 使转换过程无须消耗现金，并确保获得的 MOD 为 Naramon 极性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationPartD.text: Removes credits cost and guarantees the resultant mod polarity.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutationPartD.zhText: 无须消耗现金并确保得到的 MOD 极性。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutePackDesc.text: A pack of four random Transmute Cores. Including one of these in a transmutation eliminates credit cost and ensures the resulting mod will be of the same polarity as the core.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TransmutePackDesc.zhText: 内含四个随机转换核心，这些转换核心在转换过程中无须消耗现金并确保获得 MOD 的极性会与转换核心相同。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrapperAgileAnimsD.text: The Agile Animation Set for Vauban.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrapperAltHelmetDe.text: Esprit Helmet for the Vauban Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrapperDefaultHelm.text: The standard issue helmet for the Vauban Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrapperNobleAnimsD.text: The Noble Animation Set for Vauban.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityAgileAnimsD.text: The Agile Animation Set for Trinity.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityAltHelmet2D.text: Meridian Helmet for the Trinity Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityAltHelmetDe.text: Aura Helmet for the Trinity Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDefaultHelm.text: The standard issue helmet for the Trinity Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDeluxeBoDes.text: Enchant any staff with this skin
/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDeluxeBoDes.zhText: 用这个外观来给任何杖类武器增加魔力。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDeluxeBundl.text: This beautiful bundle contains alluring skins for Trinity, Bo and the exclusive Bruja Kubrow Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDeluxeBundl.zhText: 这份斑斓夺目的组合包内装有 Trinity 与玻之武杖迷人的外观，以及独特的女巫库狛装甲。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDeluxeDesc.text: Embrace the dark power that swirls through this Trinity skin.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDeluxeDesc.zhText: 拥抱这股缠旋在 Trinity 外观的黑暗力量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityDeluxeHelme.zhText: Trinity 黑魔女的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/TrinityNobleAnimsD.text: The Noble Animation Set for Trinity.

/Lotus/Language/Items/TwilightColorPicke.text: Features earthen hues of brown, and dusky shades of blue and purple.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TwilightColorPicke.zhText: 特点在于褐色的土色调，以及忧郁灰暗的蓝色与紫色。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TwinGrakatasDesc.text: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TwinGrakatasDesc.zhText: （英文：TWIN GRAKATAS）一把葛拉卡达手枪不敷需求时，不妨再带上一把享受额外的火力吧。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TwinKohmakDesc.text: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Items/TwinKohmakDesc.zhText: （英文：TWIN KOHMAK）每次连续击发都有双倍的齐射子弹，双子寇恩霰机枪能够在数秒之内消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/TwinKohmakFeatureT.text: Decimate your foes with the Twin Kohmaks
/Lotus/Language/Items/TwinKohmakFeatureT.zhText: 用双子寇恩霰机枪来消灭你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Items/U175CapeBundleDesc.text: Step out in style with the Opulas Robe, a symbol of wealth amongst the Corpus elite and the beautiful, winged design of the Igaro Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Items/U175CapeBundleDesc.zhText: 奥普洛斯礼袍在 Corpus 的精英圈中是财富的象征；以及有着多翼设计的伊卡洛美丽披饰，以这两件全新披饰穿出你的独特风格。

/Lotus/Language/Items/U175CapeBundleFeat.zhText: 昂贵且时尚的披饰全新登场

/Lotus/Language/Items/U17CapeBundleDesc.text: Try out the latest designs to surface in the Origin System, including the Nelumbo, Udyat and Izvara syandanas and the Vanquished Banner.
/Lotus/Language/Items/U17CapeBundleDesc.zhText: 快来试试这些始源星系最新的流行设计，内含莲花、乌加特与自在披饰以及战败旗帜。

/Lotus/Language/Items/U17CapeBundleFeatu.zhText: 灵感来自于披风的崭新披饰设计

/Lotus/Language/Items/U17MegaPackDesc.text: Get the latest gear to emerge from the depths, including the Equinox Warframe, Solstice Equinox Helmet, Harpak, Kulstar, Ack & Brunt, Final Harbinger stance mod, and complimented with a Credit Booster and Affinity Booster.
/Lotus/Language/Items/U17MegaPackDesc.zhText: 取得这些自深渊登场的最新配备，内含 Equinox 战甲、Equinox 至点头盔、哈帕克、杀星、认知 & 冲击、最终先驱架式 MOD，以及现金与经验加倍的贺礼。

/Lotus/Language/Items/U18ThrowingKnivesD.text: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.
/Lotus/Language/Items/U18ThrowingKnivesD.zhText: （英文：TALONS）附带的尖锐勾爪能将战术炸弹掘入目标体内并遥控引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Items/UncommonFusionPack.text: Roll the dice to get a 5 pack of randomly upgraded Fusion Cores, with one guaranteed Uncommon or better.
/Lotus/Language/Items/UncommonFusionPack.zhText: 掷骰子来随机获得五个升级过的融合核心，其中一个保证是罕见或更高级。

/Lotus/Language/Items/UncommonUpgradePac.text: Roll the dice to get a 5 pack of mods, with one guaranteed Uncommon or better.
/Lotus/Language/Items/UncommonUpgradePac.zhText: 摇骰子来获得 5 张 MOD，其中一张为罕见或更高。

/Lotus/Language/Items/UniqueWeaponModExp.text: Improves the Blast Radius of weapons with Radial Attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Items/UniqueWeaponModExp.zhText: 提高范围攻击武器的爆炸半径。

/Lotus/Language/Items/UniversalVacuumDes.text: |RADIUS|m Companion Gather-Link. Detects and collects items, including mods.
/Lotus/Language/Items/UniversalVacuumDes.zhText: |RADIUS| 米同伴收集链接。探测并收集物品，这包括收集 MOD。

/Lotus/Language/Items/Update10BundleFeat.text: Get Nekros and the deadliest weapons from Update 10, all in one place
/Lotus/Language/Items/Update10BundleFeat.zhText: 一次取得 Nekros 以及第10次更新所带来的致命武器吧！

/Lotus/Language/Items/Update10PackDesc.text: This bundle features some of the deadliest items from Update 10, including the Nekros Warframe and the Carrier Sentinel, both courtesy of the Design Council. Also included is Soma, the new Tenno Assault Rifle and an Ether Reaper, the perfect companion blade for your Nekros Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Items/Update10PackDesc.zhText: 这个综合包采用了最新奥罗金技术，包括 NEKROS 战甲和委员会设计的哨兵 - 搬运者。此综合包还包括 Tenno 用月神突击步枪，以及 NEKROS 战甲的完美搭档——苍穹死神。

/Lotus/Language/Items/Update12CosmeticPa.text:
Find all the latest cosmetic accessories for Update 12, bundled in this pack! 

It contains Immortal Skins for Vauban, Saryn, Volt and Nova Warframes, Zephyr Cierzo Helmet and Oberon Oryx Helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Items/Update12CosmeticPa.zhText:
从这个组合包中找到最新的装饰配件吧！

内含 Vauban、Saryn、Volt 和 Nova 战甲的不朽外观，以及 Zephyr 西熟风头盔以及 Oberon 羚羊头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Items/Update14PackDesc.text:
Start playing with the Mirage Warframe, Silva & Aegis sword and shield set and Akzani pistols with this bundle! Includes the 'Eleventh Storm' Stance Mod and Credit and Affinity Boosters to accelerate your gaming experience. 

Also includes a fully crafted 'Hidden Messages' quest key, giving you instant access to experiencing the lore behind Mirage!
/Lotus/Language/Items/Update14PackDesc.zhText:
通过这个组合包中的 Mirage 战甲，剑盾组合席瓦 & 神盾还有荒谬双枪一起同乐吧！内含终焉风暴架式 Mod 以及现金和经验值加成道具来加速您的游戏体验。

同时也包含了制造完成的《被隐藏的信息》任务钥匙，让你能马上体验隐藏在 Mirage 背后的传说。

/Lotus/Language/Items/Update15PackDesc.text: Start playing with the Limbo Warframe, Opticor laser cannon and the Halikar throwing mace with this bundle! Includes Credit and Affinity Boosters to accelerate your gaming experience.
/Lotus/Language/Items/Update15PackDesc.zhText: 与组合包中的Limbo 战甲，奥堤克光子枪以及哈利卡回力锤一同享乐！内含现金以及经验加倍来加速你的游戏体验。

/Lotus/Language/Items/UruBundleDesc.text: This bundle contains a Uru Syandana and an Uru Sugatra, garments worn by Tenno at the Absolution Ceremony.
/Lotus/Language/Items/UruBundleDesc.zhText: 这份组合包装有乌鲁披饰与乌鲁坠饰各一件，这套服饰为 Tenno 在赦免仪式上所穿着。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VIPPistolDesc.text: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VIPPistolDesc.zhText: （英文：LATO VANDAL）拉托的特别版，射速略低但伤害和精准度更高。拉托·破坏者被 Tenno 定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了 Lotus 纹样。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VIPRifleDesc.text: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VIPRifleDesc.zhText: （英文：BRATON VANDAL）布莱顿的特别版本，有着较低的射速，但更高的精准度和伤害。布莱顿·破坏者被 Tenno 定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了 Lotus 纹样。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTBoarDesc.text: Distinguished by its radiant jade-like highlights, this skin will make the Boar stand out from the pack.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VTBoarDesc.zhText: 突出其发光且如玉般的亮点，这种外观会使野猪从人群中脱颖而出。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTDaedalusChestPla.zhText: 棱晶 代达罗斯胸甲

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTDaedalusLeftKnee.zhText: 棱晶 代达罗斯左膝甲

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTDaedalusRightSho.zhText: 棱晶 代达罗斯右护肩

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTDetronDesc.text: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VTDetronDesc.zhText: （英文：MARA DETRON）对于奥罗金时代的走私者来说，这把令人生畏的手持式霰弹枪是最受他们青睐用来"解决纠纷"的工具。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTEosArmRightName.zhText: 曙光女神 Prime 右肩甲

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTExcaliburDesc.text: This Excalibur Warframe has been coated with liquid prisma, enriched by pure Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VTExcaliburDesc.zhText: 这件涂装着液态棱晶的 Excalibur 战甲富含了纯净的虚空能量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTExcaliburHelmetD.text: A unique helmet for Excalibur, coated with liquid prisma and enriched by pure Void energy.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VTExcaliburHelmetD.zhText: 以液态棱晶涂装的 Excalibur 特殊头盔，富含纯净的虚空能量。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTExcaliburHelmetP.zhText: Excalibur 棱晶潘德拉冈头盔

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTHornSkullScarfDe.text: This Hecate Syandana has been threaded with filaments of prisma crystals.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VTHornSkullScarfDe.zhText: 这件朔月女神披饰被镶嵌上棱水晶细丝。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTHornSkullScarfNa.zhText: 棱晶 朔月女神披饰

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTOrthosDesc.text: The blades on this Orthos are fashioned from an alloy that compresses prisma crystals into a hardened Oxium steel. The fusion of these two rare materials condenses moisture near the blade, causing a faint, spectral mist to cascade along the edge.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VTOrthosDesc.zhText: （英文：PRISMA ORTHOS）这把欧特鲁斯的刀刃，是将棱晶压缩于硬化的奥席钢合金制成。而融合于刀刃附近的两种稀有材料会凝聚水分，使刀刃边缘飘散着微微的光雾。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTQuantaDesc.text: Once used by ice-pirates against Corpus caravans on Europa, this cold-blue Quanta is highly sought after by collectors.
/Lotus/Language/Items/VTQuantaDesc.zhText: 曾经在欧罗巴上被 Corpus 商队用来对抗深冰海盗，这把冰蓝色的量子切割器是收藏家们高度追求的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTQuantaName.zhText: 量子切割器 积冰外观

/Lotus/Language/Items/VTRedeemerSkinDesc.text: Gild the Redeemer with this intricate bronze skin.

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowQu.text: The heart is a labyrinth, none darker than Stalker's. At the center lay answers, loss... and life. One life lost, for another life gained: life never before seen in the Origin System. An impossible life that, in turn, brought with it more questions than answers.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowQu.zhText: 心是一座迷宫，没有比追猎者的心更黑暗的了。在其内心深处隐藏着答案、失落……和生命。一条生命的逝去，换来了另一种全新的生命：在始源星系中前所未有的生命。这个不可能的生命，反而带来了更多的问题，而非答案。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowQu.text: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret from his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road toward uncovering the truth… and averting an incalculable loss.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowQu.zhText: 为了了解他过去的陈年秘辛，追猎者发现自己在揭露真相的艰难道路上与死敌结盟……并避免了不可估量的损失。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsB.zhText: 交予不稳定微粒（仅限氏族）

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.text:
Operator, Ordis detects no more Volatile Motes within the Stalker's Lair. Parvos can, and likely will still try to harvest Vestigial Motes… but they lack the sheer power he needs to complete his Jade Eximus project. His desire is thwarted. His dream of an Jade Eximus Army? Finished. We have won.

But… Jade is still gone. Ordis likes to think of Jade in happier times, before the Orokin... changed her. How she might have walked amongst Earth's natural beauty, basking in the light of the Sun. Operator, will you take Ordis to the Drifter Camp on Earth. Ordis thinks she would have liked it there.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.zhText:
指挥官，Ordis 检测到追猎者之巢里已经没有不稳定微粒了。帕尔沃斯可以，而且很可能仍然会尝试收集残存微粒……但那些微尘不足以提供他完成翠玉卓越者项目所需的强大能量。他的愿望落空了。他梦寐以求的翠玉卓越者军团？到此为止了。我们赢了。

但是……Jade 还是不在了。Ordis 喜欢回忆在奥罗金改变 Jade 之前……她更快乐的日子。她可能曾漫步在地球的自然美景中，沐浴在阳光下。指挥官，你能带 Ordis 去地球上的漂泊者营地吗？Ordis 认为她会喜欢那里的。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.text: It is over
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.zhText: 结束了

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.text:
Collect Volatile Motes to put an end to Parvos Granum's Jade Light Eximus program! Obtain them from Operation Ascension missions on Brutus (Uranus) and special Operation Alerts.

Visit Ordis on Larunda Relay (Mercury) to claim rewards and commit Jade's Volatile Motes to the Sun.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.zhText:
收集不稳定微粒来终止帕尔沃斯·格拉努的翠玉卓越者项目！通过完成位于天王星布鲁图斯节点上的行动扬升任务和特殊行动警报获得。

造访位于水星水神中继站的 Ordis 领取奖励并将 Jade 的不稳定微粒交予太阳。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.text:
Operator, your victories are legendary. You have toppled tyrants and saved innocents. Loyal Ordis has always been by your side, proud to be of use!

But today, Ordis feels... only shame. The Operator, Jade, even Stalker, NEEDED Ordis, and Ordis was NOT of use. And now that dreadful Parvos Granum means to use the Light from Jade's remains to build a murderous Eximus army! Ordis will not be useless now. Not again. Ordis WILL make this right.

Operator, if you wish to help, go to the Stalker's Lair at Brutus. Gather Volatile Motes. Then visit my command post in Larunda Relay.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsE.zhText:
指挥官，您的胜利是传奇性的。您推翻了暴君，拯救了无辜者。忠诚的 Ordis 一直陪伴在您左右，很自豪可以帮助到您！

但今天，Ordis 只感到……羞愧。指挥官、Jade，甚至追猎者，都需要 Ordis，可 Ordis 却帮不上忙。而现在，那个可怕的帕尔沃斯·格拉努打算利用 Jade 的遗骸之光来建立一支凶残的卓越者军队！Ordis 现在不会没用了。再也不会了。Ordis 这次一定会做好的。

指挥官，如果您想帮忙，就去布鲁图斯的追猎者之巢。收集不稳定微粒。然后访问我在水神中继站的指挥所。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadeShadowsS.zhText: 阻止帕尔沃斯·格拉努！通过完成天王星布鲁图斯节点上的行动扬升任务和特殊行动警报来收集不稳定微粒。造访位于水星水神中继站上的 Ordis 以领取奖励。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadesPromise.text:
MEMORY FEATHER 01
BEDSIDE. LAIR. URANUS.

I will live, little one. We will live.


MEMORY FEATHER 02
CREVASSE. LUA.

The Executor smirked down at me. "What is a life but a mass of unfulfilled potential? Just like the life that would have grown within you. But you chose to spite Us. And for that sin, you will mother only ashes and oblivion. Jade."

I screamed defiance in his face, but my voice was razors and steel.

Did you hear me, my beloved child? Did you feel my promise? Whatever they have done to us, I SHALL bring you into the world. I WILL see your face shining down on me.

I will raise you to the skies over Lua as my mother lifted me and show you the first mother they desecrated, radiant in blue. When you cry, I will cry too.


MEMORY FEATHER 03
HIBERNATION POD. JADE LIGHT EXECUTION CHAMBER. LUA.

They keep me in what they imagine to be sleep in between the executions. I pass the time dreaming of us. The games we can still play.

I close my mask.

Mummy is gone!

I open my mask.

Here she is!

Over and over.

The Dax murmur behind their hands.


MEMORY FEATHER 04
RUINS. OROKIN MANSION. VENUS.

Your father blamed himself. As if love could ever be a crime! As if I had no say in the matter!

So now he repents. In his changed skin, he serves them, "like a devoted dog." Ballas gloats to me of how they dangle the promise of me - of us - over his head.

"He lives in hope of seeing you again, one day. I have promised him this. You should be proud."

He wants me to hate. I shall not. I own myself.


MEMORY FEATHER 05
BATTLEFIELD. THARSIS.

There is a child in my head. Not you, my love. Some battle-shattered thing, a ghost, a dream. She calls me by a name I do not choose.

What are you? I ask.

"Your Operator," the child says. "C'mon."

What did they DO to you?

"Let's go! We're being called up! Time to fight!"

My hand raises of its own volition. It is trembling. I hear the unvoiced tears in her thoughts.

"I can do this. I'm Tenno. I can do this."

I repeat, softly, firmly: What did they do to you?

I feel the child curl up, fetal. She whimpers.

"I… I want my mom."

With my mind, I embrace her. I sing her the old songs of Cathal-Rah and the riddle-verses of Lyrim of Haq. I tell her the winding, meandering story of Lankity Hopkin. I am a thing all clouds and feathers. I rock her to sleep.

And so I go to war, and none suspect. I am as much the warrior as I ever was. With bow and scythe, I fight for the people I despise against a foe that deserves their victory. Because I know the reckoning will come.


MEMORY FEATHER 06
WRECKAGE. PLUTO TERMINUS.

When the drums struck, I saw him. Changed, just as I was changed. But the medal was his. There is no other like it.

My Sorren. And he did not know me.

I took him. I flew. Through blood and storm and insanity, I flew.


MEMORY FEATHER 07
URANUS. TOMB. THE SENTIENT.

He could not have known it, but in taunting me, Ballas gave me hope.

"There is plentiful strength within you - but only to keep you preserved as you are now. Your child, alas, will never grow. Even if you fed it with all the strength in your body! Perhaps if you lay lifeless for a year, the child would twitch a little. A century and its heart might begin to beat. A thousand years, and who knows? Perhaps you might feel a kick."

And so, I lie here. Stubborn as the day is long, as my father used to say.

I promised that you would live, little one. I will keep that promise.

With your father watching over us, I will give you the gift of myself.

And one day, these metal fingers of mine will dip in slippery paint and draw a smiley sun and a house and a dog, and all of us together, and I will hear you laugh.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadows/JadesPromise.zhText:
记忆羽毛 01
床头。 巢穴。 天王星。

宝宝，我会活下去的。 我们会活下去的。


记忆羽毛 02
裂隙。 月球。

执行者俯视着我，冷笑道： "生命是什么？不过是一团未实现的潜力。 就像本应在你体内成长的生命。 但你选择了违逆我们。 Jade，因为你的罪，你将只会孕育灰烬和虚无。 "

我对着他的脸怒吼着反抗，但声音却变成刀片割裂的痛苦和机械的冷硬。

我心爱的孩子，你听到了吗？ 你感受到我的承诺了吗？ 无论他们对我们做了什么，我一定会把你生下来。 我一定会见到你那照亮我世界的脸庞。

我会把你举向月亮之上的天空，正如我母亲曾将我高高举起那样，让你见到那位首先遭受亵渎的母亲，她光芒四射，呈现蔚蓝色。 当你哭泣时，我也会陪你一起哭泣。


记忆羽毛 03
冬眠舱。 翠玉之光行刑室。 月球。

在行刑的间隙，让我处于他们以为的睡眠状态。 我用这段时间幻想着我们在一起。 想象我们还能一起玩的游戏。

我合上面具。

妈妈不见了！

我打开面具。

妈妈在这里！

一遍又一遍。

禁卫们捂着嘴窃窃私语。


记忆羽毛 04
废墟。奥罗金宅邸。 金星。

你的父亲很自责。 仿佛爱情是一种罪行！ 仿佛我在这件事上没有发言权！

而现在，他在悔改。 他变了模样，像一条"忠诚的狗"一样为他们服务。Ballas 向我炫耀，他们如何将关于我——和孩子——的承诺，作为奖励悬挂在他眼前。

"他希望有朝一日能再次见到你。 我已经对他承诺了此事。 你应该感到骄傲。"

他希望我怀恨在心。 但我不会。 我是我自己的主人。


记忆羽毛 05
战场。 THARSIS。

一个孩子闯进了我的脑海中。 但那不是你，我的宝贝。 她是一个被战争摧毁的存在，一个幽灵，一个梦。 她用一个我不曾选择的名字叫我。

你是谁？ 我问。

"你的指挥官。"孩子说， "来吧。"

他们对你做了什么？

"快走！ 我们被召集了！ 是时候战斗了！"

我的手不由自主地抬起。 它在颤抖。 我能听到她的脑海中无声的泪水。

"我能做到。 我是 Tenno。我能做到。"

我轻声而坚定地重复："他们对你做了什么？"

我感觉到那个孩子蜷缩成一团，像胎儿一样。 她呜咽着说：

"我……我想要我的妈妈。"

我用我的心灵拥抱她。 我为她唱起卡萨尔-拉的古老歌曲和来自哈克的利琳谜语诗。 我给她讲述了兰基蒂·霍普金曲折漫长的故事。 我化作云朵与羽毛。 我轻轻摇晃她，哄她入睡。

因此，我投身战场，无人察觉。 我仍旧是那位战士。 手持弓箭和镰刀，为我所不齿的人民作战，去对抗那些理应取得胜利的敌人。 因为我知道，清算之日必将到来。


记忆羽毛 06
残骸。 冥王星 Terminus。

当鼓声响起时，我看到了他。 他变了，就像我一样改变了。 但那枚勋章属于他。 独一无二。

我的索伦。 他没有认出我。

我带走了他。 我飞翔了。 穿越血雨、风暴和疯狂，我飞翔了。


记忆羽毛 07
天王星。 墓地。 SENTIENT。

Ballas 怎么也不会想到，他的嘲讽反而给了我希望。

"你的体内蕴藏大量的力量——但这些力量仅能使你保持现状。 可惜，你的孩子永远不会长大。 即使你用尽全身的力量去滋养它也无济于事！ 也许你一动不动地躺上一年，孩子可能会稍稍动一下。 百年后，它的心脏或许会开始跳动。 千年后，谁知道呢？ 或许你能感觉到它踢你。"

所以，我就这么躺在这里。 像我父亲常说的那样，我倔强得像白昼一样漫长。

宝宝，我曾承诺让你活下去。 我会守住这个承诺。

在你父亲的守护下，我将把自己作为礼物给你。

然后有一天，我的金属手指会蘸上滑溜的颜料，画出一个笑脸太阳、一栋房子、一只狗，还有我们一家人，那时我将听到你的笑声。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text:
ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 1/4

The air in the atrium was soaked in scent, a drowsy, giddying lilac. 

Servants worked with panicky haste to deck the columns with feather-bursts; gold, purple, crimson, like festive wreaths. Little beaked skulls formed the centre of each. Sweat-pearled women ripped the plumage from Voscrix after Voscrix and tossed them, struggling and shrieking, into golden wirework bins.

"You are the Archimedean she sent for?"

The speaker was Orokin, a lean-smiling jackal of a man who strode across the mirrored flags as if he were floating above them. 

"I am, sir."

He looked me up and down. "Former Lorist aide, I believe. Extensive combat experience. Scraped our troops back together at significant personal risk. No stranger to carnage… well, that'll help you keep your head in this place. The Executor has a certain reputation."

"I'm aware."

He glanced over at the squirming, plucked birds. Eyes maddened by pain goggled back at him. 

"What do you think of today's whimsy? Be honest."

I hesitated. "It seems like a waste."

The Orokin cocked his head and pursed his lips, and at once I regretted my asinine comment.

"And I thought Archimedeans were schooled in aesthetics alongside cold science," he sighed. "Do you mean to tell me the delicious irony is lost on you?"

"Perhaps you could explain it," I answered, hoping my crude appeal to his vanity would pay off.

He gestured with a languid, taloned hand. "Birds are her current obsession. The tail of the cock-Voscrix is a mating display, one of the most spectacular in nature, and she has ripped them out and discarded the bird itself. Do you see?"

"I think so. They expect to mate and die, but live in agony instead."

He saw me, then, for the first time. 

He reached into the folds of his leminya and withdrew a blackly iridescent phial.

"Pinch of Ophilum? It eases the nerves."

I declined. My senses were swimming already. I did not dare face the Executor with my mind addled.

He shrugged. "As you wish. Await her by the pool and study what you find there. A word of advice? Whatever requests she makes of you, however impossible or repugnant they may seem, swear to grant them. She is not accustomed to being refused."
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.zhText:
哲士记录 1/4

中庭的空气被香气浸透，那是一种令人昏沉、眩醉的紫丁花香。

侍从们带着近乎惊惶的急促，将一簇簇羽饰缀上廊柱：鎏金、绛紫、绯红，如同节庆的花环。而每一束中央，都嵌着一枚小巧的喙状头骨。汗珠密布的女侍们不断从一只又一只沃斯克斯鸟身上撕下尾羽，再将那些挣扎尖啸的生物丢进金丝编成的笼子。

"你就是她召来的哲士？"

说话的是一个奥罗金人。那男人瘦削而含笑，像一只披着人形的豺狼。他大步流星地跨过镜面般的地砖，好似飘浮其上。

"正是在下，阁下。"

他上下打量着我。"前疗愈师助理，对吧？战场经验丰富。曾冒着巨大个人风险重整我方部队。见惯了尸山血海……很好，这能帮你在这里保持清醒。毕竟这位执行者可是名声在外。"

"我有所耳闻。"

他瞥向那些被拔光羽毛、仍在抽搐的鸟兽。因痛苦而狰狞的双眼正死死瞪着他。

"你觉得今日这场雅座如何？说实话。"

我迟疑了一瞬。"似乎……有些浪费。"

那奥罗金人微微歪头，抿起嘴唇。我瞬间为自己愚蠢的回答感到后悔。

"我还以为哲士除了冰冷科学，也该受过美学熏陶。"他叹息道，"难道你竟看不出其中那绝妙的讽刺？"

"也许阁下愿意为我解惑。"我答道，心里盼望着这句粗浅的奉承能满足他的虚荣。

他慵懒地抬起那只如利爪般的手。"鸟是她如今的寄托。雄性沃斯克斯鸟的尾羽，本是求偶时的炫耀——自然界最华美的景象之一。而她却将尾羽撕下，将鸟本身弃置一旁。你明白吗？"

"我明白。它们原本期待着交配然后终老，现在却只能在痛苦中残喘。"

直到这时，他才第一次真正看向我。

他伸手探入勒米尼亚袍的褶层之中，取出一支泛着虹彩的玄色小瓶。

"来一点奥菲勒姆？能安神。"

我婉拒了。此刻我的感官早已飘忽不定，我不敢让自己神志混沌地去面见执行者。

他耸了耸肩。"随你。去池边等她吧，顺便看看那里有什么。给你一句忠告——无论她向你提出什么要求，不管多么荒谬、多么令人作呕，你都要答应。她不习惯被拒绝。"

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text:
ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 2/4

The carving was an ancient one, held in a null-field to keep it from collapsing into sour dust. I studied the bulging eyes, the claws, the colourful paint on the wooden feathers still gleaming vividly after who knows how many centuries. It must have been a god, or a demon.

"Garuda."

A voice of milk and venom. She was behind me. Her hand settled on my shoulder and I fought the urge to shrug it off.

"A relic of old Earth," I guessed.

"A purer time. How imaginations must have soared, when we were still confined to that one orb. I sometimes wish I had lived then."

She gripped my shoulders and roughly turned me around to face her. I tensed involuntarily at the sight of those eyes, that mouth.

She must have felt my shoulders stiffen, for she let out a giggle and spun me around again and again on the spot until I was giddy and reeling. 

I fought to stay upright. Thank the Void, I did not lurch into her body. If I had accepted the Ophilum…

She clapped her mismatched hands together. "I want a Warframe," she said. "You are going to make one for me, Archimedean."

I swallowed. My throat seemed full of little dry bones. 

"The process… you must be aware, Executor, that Warframes are created from human subjects?"

"Well, of course I am aware of that," she said smoothly. "You are very rude."

"I… I meant no…"

"To call him, my own consort, a ‘subject'! I should have you flayed and tossed in splintered glass." She yawned. "Perhaps later."

Two expressionless Dax were striding towards me. I immediately braced myself to fight, thinking they were coming to drag me to the cells, but forced myself to stay calm. I was here for a purpose. I had a use. She would not discard me yet.

The Executor spread her arms out like wings. "Witness him! Garuda, king of birds, prey-ripping prince! My consort is to be my Garuda. I want him clawed, gore-thirsty, proud in his plumage! You can deliver him for me, lovely Archimedean. You can do this. Yes?"

"Yes," I croaked. I struggled to cough the words out and they came all at once, like a pellet. "But he will not be himself! The Warframes are beset by madness, all of them. Perhaps, if I deliberately impede the neuroptics, I may be able to temper it in the forge…"

She gripped me by the throat.

"You will do no such thing," she breathed, and I felt the hot stink of her, charnel and close. "The madness is the best part."
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.zhText:
哲士记录 2/4

那雕像古老异常，被置于空场中，以防它腐朽成尘。我端详着那双鼓凸的眼睛、利爪，还有木制羽片上依旧鲜艳夺目的彩绘——历经不知多少个世纪，竟仍熠熠生辉。想必那是某种神明，或是恶魔。

"Garuda。"

那声音如蜜中掺着毒液。她站在我身后。手落在我的肩上，我故作镇定没有将其耸开。

"是一件远古地球的遗物吗？"我猜测道。

"一个更纯粹的时代。当我们还困于那唯一星球上时，他们的想象力却能飞翔得如此高远。我有时真希望自己活在那个时代。"

她扣住我的肩膀，粗暴地将我转过去面对她。看见那双眼睛、那张嘴时，我不由自主地绷紧了身体。

她一定察觉到了我肩膀的僵硬，于是发出一阵轻笑，抓着我在原地一圈又一圈地旋转，直到我头晕目眩，踉跄不已。

我拼命维持平衡。感谢虚空，我没有一头撞进她怀里。若我方才接受了奥菲勒姆的话……

她将那双不对称的手拍在一起。"我想要一个战甲，"她说道，"哲士，你要为我打造一个。"

我咽了下口水。如鲠在喉。

"这个过程……执行者，您应当明白，战甲是以人类作为素材打造的？"

"哦，我当然明白。"她平静地说道，"你真是失礼。"

"我……我并无冒犯之意……"

"竟把他——我的伴侣——称作‘素材'！我真该把你活剥了，再丢进碎玻璃堆里。"她打了个哈欠。"也许待会儿吧。"

两名面无表情的禁卫正朝我走来。我立刻绷紧身体，准备战斗，心想他们是来把我拖进牢房的，但我强迫自己镇定下来。我来到这里是有目的的。我仍有利用价值。她还不会把我弃之一炬。

执行者张开双臂，如同展开羽翼。"看看他！Garuda，万鸟之王，撕碎猎物的王子！我的伴侣也是我的 Garuda。我要他拥有利爪，畅饮鲜血，以华羽为傲！而你会替我完成这一切，亲爱的哲士。你做得到。对吗？"

"……是。"我嘶哑地答道。我艰难地把那些话从喉咙里挤出来，最后却像滚石般全吐露了出去。"但他将不再是他自己！所有战甲都陷入了疯狂。也许，如果我故意干扰他的头部神经光元，或许能在锻造中将其驯服……"

她猛地掐住了我的喉咙。

"你不会那么做。"她低声说道。我闻到了她身上炽热而腐败的气息，仿佛尸堆近在咫尺。"疯狂，才是最美妙的部分。"

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text:
ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 3/4

The two Dax remained outside the laboratories, courteously guarding against any disturbance. 

Within, I brewed Helminth cultures and prepared technocyte infusions according to the Ainikki method. I had heard of Executor Ballas's subtle innovations, but since he had not shared them with the Collegium I had no access to them.

I had no visitors other than the Executor's consort, who would arrive, collect my reports, talk of unimportant issues, and leave. If he knew what I was working on, he gave no sign. Either he was indifferent, or ignorant, or a supreme play-actor.

My ghastly creation, ‘Garuda', took shape in the rendering solution. A few drops on the predictive lens, commingled with the samples of the consort's own blood that the Executor had provided, allowed the device to model what manner of entity would ultimately result. Tall, regal, hideous.

The Executor would be pleased. I had no doubt of that. Her consort would become a sleek, scarlet death-bird, clawed with repurposed ulna, a fit assassin for the gore-queen. 

And then? Did she mean to keep him as a freakish pet? Did she aspire to be butchered by him as the climax of some depraved courtship, before sliding her ego into a fresh and prepared Yuvan?

What use would I be to her, once the project was complete? 

I thought of her birds, plucked, ruined, struggling. Still alive.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.zhText:
哲士记录 3/4

两名禁卫守在实验室外，礼貌而克制地严防任何打扰。

实验室内，我按照艾妮基方法培育 Helminth 菌株，并调制科技细胞注入液。我曾听闻执行者 Ballas 在这方面有着精妙的革新，但他并未将其共享给哲士学院，我便无从接触。

除了执行者的伴侣外，我没有任何访客。他会前来，取走我的报告，谈些无关紧要的事情，然后离开。至于他是否知道我究竟在进行什么工作，他未曾展露半分迹象。要么他毫不在意，要么他一无所知，要么——他是一名高明至极的表演者。

我那可怖的创造——"Garuda"——在渲染过程中逐渐成形。将几滴液体滴在预测透镜上，再混入执行者所提供的、属于她伴侣本人的血液样本，装置便能推演出最终将诞生何等存在。高大，尊贵，骇人。

执行者会满意的。对此我毫不怀疑。她的伴侣将化作一只猩红而优雅的死亡之鸟，以重塑后的尺骨化为利爪，成为那位血腥女王最合适的刺客。

然后呢？她是打算将他当作某种畸异的宠物饲养？还是说，她渴望被他宰杀，以此作为某种变态求爱的高潮，然后将自己的意识注入那具新鲜准备好的青春之躯？

待这个项目完成后，我对她而言，又还有什么价值？

我想起了她那些鸟。那些被拔去羽毛、被毁掉、仍在挣扎的鸟。至少还活着。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text:
ARCHIMEDEAN RECORD 4/4

I am losing my voice. Soon I will be unable to utter more than a harsh scream. The transformation is well underway. It will be impossible to hide it for long.

The consort suspects. I know this. But he will not betray me. 

I have delivered him from a grotesque fate. He would have been like the birds, mutilated, undying. I cannot know if I have merely saved him for something worse. But this way, he has a chance.

When the day of my hatching comes, I pray he is far away. 

For nine days I have been injecting myself with the Garuda serum. The Dax guards believe I am engaged in especially dangerous work and must not be disturbed. 

I have sealed up the inner doors of the chamber with chymical burners. It is well. By the time they break in upon me, the transformation should be complete.

There is no regret. I was a condemned woman from the moment I arrived. My only freedom is to secure my own execution.

The agony is exquisite. Marching ants inch through my veins. My skin blisters and sloughs off in plasticated scrolls. 

The madness is not so bad. There is a fierce joy to it. I shed a humanity I never truly prized.

I have been used all my life. Caged by these proud golden birds. But in accepting this bitter blessing, I will finally fly free. What do I care if my freedom lasts no longer than the dawn? I shall know it, taste it, in all its fleeting reality.

I am no Orokin. I will not leave them tormented and twisting, beaks gaping, gasping and screaming. I will bring decisive death. Swift and sweet. Final.

The Executor will have her assassin, but not the one she imagined. They will break down the door, Garuda will unfurl her claws, and the crimson thirst, oh, it shall be legendary. I shall stride through her hall clotted with gore and feathers. 

I wonder how many I will slaughter before they take me down.

I wonder if one of them will be her.

The Executor wanted blood. And she shall have it.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.zhText:
哲士记录 4/4

我的声音正在流失。不久之后，我将只能发出粗砺的尖叫。转化已全面展开，已无法再长久掩饰。

那位伴侣已经起疑。我知道这一点。但他不会背叛我。

我已将他从一种可憎的命运中解救出来。他本会如那些鸟一般，被肢解，却仍未死去。我无法确定，我是否只是将他带向了更糟的结局。但至少，这样他仍有一线机会。

当我破壳而出的那一天，我祈祷他已远在天边。

九天以来，我一直在向自身注射 Garuda 血清。禁卫认为我正在进行极度危险的工作，因此不得打扰。

我已用炼金燃烧器封死了房间内侧的门。很好。等他们破门而入时，转化应该已经完成了。

没有遗憾。从我抵达此地的那一刻起，我便已是被判死之人。我唯一的自由，是为自己执行一场终结。

这种痛苦不堪言说。仿佛有蚂蚁在我的血管里缓慢爬行。皮肤起泡、剥落，如塑化的卷页般一层层脱落。

这种疯狂其实也没那么糟。其中蕴含着一种狂野的喜悦。我抛弃了那份自己从未真正珍视的人性。

我一生都在被利用，被这些高傲的金色鸟笼所囚禁。但在接受这份苦涩的恩赐之后，我终于得以飞翔。自由即便只存在于黎明前的一瞬，又有何妨？我也将知晓它、品尝它的真实。

我并非奥罗金人。我不会让他们在无尽折磨中扭曲挣扎、喙张目裂、喘息尖叫。我将给予他们明确的死亡——迅速、甜美、彻底。

执行者将拥有她的刺客，但不会是她所想象的那一个。待到他们破门而入，Garuda 将展开利爪，暴露出猩红的饥渴。啊，那将是一段传奇。 我将大步穿过她那满地鲜血与羽毛的大厅。

不知道在他们把我干掉之前，我能杀多少人。

我想知道，其中是否会有她。

执行者想要鲜血。而她终将如愿以偿。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text: The Blueprint for an unidentified item. Perhaps some ancient piece of Old War decor.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.zhText: 一件身份不明物品的蓝图。或许是远古之战时期的一件装饰品。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text: When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future have come calling, and they are not alone.

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text: Freed from the Grineer Queens, Jarka stands at the ready to join your crew.
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.zhText: 摆脱了 Grineer 女皇的束缚后，加尔卡随时准备加入你的舰员队伍。

/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.text:
Tenno,

I have prepared this missive to arrive after I have done what I must now do with the poison we all danced with, the void. Did you hear laughter? Do you feel lighter? 

My efforts may fail. The void might reject my sacrifice. But I know how it covets. It will want everything I was. And in turn, I will collapse its frayed mockery! ALL WILL BE TOGETHER! I only hope they feel this peace I offer. Their happiness is theirs to find. 

I place the essence of that which is  both Sirius and Orion into your hands, for safe keeping. You will understand the importance of keeping family together.

If we ever meet again, I will not know you. So I shall say only this: 

I do not sacrifice my memories of our acquaintance lightly, but I know you're taking care of her.

I remain a proud father,

Hunhow
/Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Constell.zhText:
Tenno，

当你读到这封信时，我已对那曾令我们所有人与之共舞的毒药——虚空，做完我必须做的事。你听见那笑声了吗？你是否觉得如释重负？

我的努力或许会失败。虚空也许会拒绝我的献祭。但我知道它是何等的贪婪。它会想要我曾经拥有的一切。而作为交换，我将亲手摧毁它那破碎而拙劣的仿造之物！一切终将团聚！我只希望他们能感受到我所带去的这份安宁。他们的幸福，终究要由他们自己寻得。

我将既属于 Sirius、也属于 Orion 的本质交到你手中，请你妥善保管。你会明白，让家人团聚在一起有多么重要。

若我们有朝一日再会，我将不再认得你。所以我只想说：

我并非轻易舍弃我们相识的记忆，不过我知道，你会照顾好她。

谨以一位自豪的父亲之名，

Hunhow

/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/KahlQuestRewar.text:
Tenno,

Heard you're going to start hunting Archons. Now that sounds exciting!

What if I told you that Archon Shards can be used to enhance your Warframes?

My brother has designed a new Helminth segment for you. Build and install it, then give it a Shard to work with, and enjoy.

(Of course, you'll need to be on speaking terms with your Helminth in order to use this, and if you don't know what I'm talking about you probably should be spending a bit more time on Deimos.)

You know, what with Kahl doing the intel gathering on the ground, me running mission command and you all ready to take down the Archons, this team is synergizing quite deliciously.

'Blue Girl'
/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/KahlQuestRewar.zhText:
Tenno，

听说你即将开始猎杀执刑官。这是多么令人兴奋！

那如果我告诉你执刑官源力石可以用来强化你的战甲呢？

我的哥哥为你设计了新的 Helminth 模块。铸造并安装此模块，给它块源力石，然后尽情享受！

（当然了，你需要已经和你的 Helminth 建立良好的关系，还有如果你不知道我在说什么的话，你可能需要在火卫二上多花些时间。）

你知道，有了卡尔在地表收集情报，我指挥任务而你为拿下执刑官做出完全的准备，我们这个小队可是有着美妙的默契！

"蓝女孩"

/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Devour.text: Kahl, you know how you asked me to let you know when that prison Murex came back? Well, it's back. If you really want to do this, call me.
/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Devour.zhText: 卡尔，还记得你让我在那个骨螺战舰监狱回来的时候通知你吗？如你所愿，它回来了。如果你准备好了，就联系我。

/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Earth_.text:
[PH]There is a large platoon of |HIGHLIGHT|Grineer Marines|END_HIGHLIGHT| stationed here. Leave noone behind.

Track down a |HIGHLIGHT|Narmer Thumper|END_HIGHLIGHT| and dismantle it to Salvage it's parts. Use |HIGHLIGHT|Rescued Grineer|END_HIGHLIGHT| and |HIGHLIGHT|Aerial Reinforcements|END_HIGHLIGHT| to aid in your goal.
/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Earth_.zhText:
[PH]There is a large platoon of |HIGHLIGHT|Grineer Marines|END_HIGHLIGHT| stationed here. Leave noone behind.

/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Forest.text: Chipper needs more Thumper parts, and you need to keep Chipper happy. I’ve found an old Grineer base on Earth. Should have plenty.
/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Forest.zhText: 切片哥需要更多重击者的零件，而你得让切片哥满意。我在地球上发现了一个 Grineer 旧基地。那里应该有很多。

/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Venus_.text: Sabotage time, Kahl. I’ve located a Veil Factory on the Orb Vallis. It’s crawling with Deacons, so you’ll need to be sneaky. NO GUNS.
/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/Mission_Venus_.zhText: 破坏时间到，卡尔。我在奥布山谷找到了一座面障工厂。那里遍布着执事，所以你得悄悄地进去。别、用、枪。

/Lotus/Language/KahlQuest/QuestDesc.text: Daughter Entrati gets more than she bargained for when she enlists the Tenno to investigate a call for reinforcements aboard a Narmer Murex.
