/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/InboxBandConver.text:
Hey |PLAYER_NAME|,

What a show! What do you say to MERGING OUR FECUND CELLS and forming a Supergroup? I bet we could really EVISCERATE the charts!

I've already got some new track ideas to ACHIEVE TOTAL SYSTEM DOMINANCE!

|LICH_NAME_UPPER|
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/InboxBandConver.zhText:
嘿 |PLAYER_NAME|，

真是一场精彩的演出！你觉得靠我们俩的艺术细胞能组成一个轰动组合吗？说不好我们真的可以摧毁排行榜！

我已经想到几个编曲点子了！我们在始源星系的霸榜能力肯定无人能敌！

|LICH_NAME_UPPER|

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/InboxKuvaConver.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

You have bested me. Sullied in the eyes of my Queens I am Grineer no longer. I serve you now.

You will help me reclaim the honor I have lost.

Our work begins,
|LICH_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/InboxKuvaConver.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你打败了我。在女皇的眼里，我已经不再是 Grineer 了。我现在效忠于你。

你会帮助我夺回失去的荣耀。

让我们展开合作吧，
|LICH_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/InboxSisterConv.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Notice is hereby given in accordance with the provisions of our association that a partnership be formed forthwith.

The partnership exists between |PLAYER_NAME| (Party A) and |LICH_NAME| (myself, Party B) by mutual consent.

It is hereby formalized that Party B sever all ties, now and in perpetuity, with the body known as The Corpus Board (Party C), and any and all associations with Parvos Granum (Party D). Party B avows they will no longer be associated with the conduct of any Corpus business and that Party B divests themselves of any and all outstanding obligations relating to Parties C and D.

The terms of this agreement are effective immediately.

Signed,
|LICH_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/InboxSisterConv.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

据我方团体规定，特此通知立即建立合作伙伴关系。

经双方同意，|PLAYER_NAME|（甲方）与 |LICH_NAME|（我，乙方）之间产生合作关系。

特此正式声明，乙方正式断绝与名为"Corpus 董事会"的实体（丙方），以及与帕尔沃斯·格拉努（丁方）的一切联系。乙方承诺将不再参与开展任何 Corpus 业务，并放弃与丙方和丁方有关的一切未尽义务。

本协议条款立即生效。

签名，
|LICH_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichAvalanc.text: A protective sphere of ice and snow.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichAvalanc.zhText: 一个用来防御的球形冰罩。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichBulletA.text: Anchors enemies within a magnetic orb, redirecting all projectiles to the orb’s center.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichBulletA.zhText: 将敌人固定在一个磁性球体上，并将所有的投掷弹药火力重新导向至这一球体的中心。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichChargeA.text: Charges forward, knocking down anything in the way.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichChargeA.zhText: 勇往直前，并扫荡掉路上遇到的一切阻碍。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichCrushAb.text: Magnetizes the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichCrushAb.zhText: 磁化附近的敌军的骨头，导致它们自我崩坏。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichDecoyAb.text: Lich deploys a holographic copy of themselves.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichDecoyAb.zhText: 赤毒玄骸可以部署一个他们自身的全息影像。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichExplosi.text: Releases a miasma of airborne disease.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichExplosi.zhText: 释放一种通过空气传播疾病的瘴气。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichFireBla.text: A shockwave of plasma that forms a ring of fire.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichFireBla.zhText: 通过一道等离子冲击波来形成一个火环。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichFireEru.text: Pillars of flame to erupt from the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichFireEru.zhText: 从地面喷泻出熊熊火柱。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichGrapple.text: A grappling hook capable of leashing targets and pulling them close.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichGrapple.zhText: 一个可以钩住目标并将其拉近的钩索。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichIceSpik.text: A wave of razor-sharp, crystallized ice.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichIceSpik.zhText: 一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichIcicleS.text: Freezes foes with an icy blast.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichIcicleS.zhText: 通过一道结冰爆裂来冻结敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichIronSki.text: The Lich summons a layer of hardened skin, blunting incoming damage.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichIronSki.zhText: 赤毒玄骸召唤出一层硬化皮肤来减弱受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichLightni.text: Shocks foes with a beam of lightning.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichLightni.zhText: 通过一束闪电来电击敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichMolecul.text: Primes foes with anti-matter and then detonates them.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichMolecul.zhText: 用反物质侵入敌人，然后将他们引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichPullAbi.text: Magnetic force pulls-in foes, stunning them.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichPullAbi.zhText: 用磁力吸近敌人，并击倒他们。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichRadialD.text: A wave of energy that disrupts projectile weapons of enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichRadialD.zhText: 一道可以解除敌人的射击武器的能量波。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichRhinoSt.text: A stomp with enough force to disrupt time, tumbling nearby enemies into stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichRhinoSt.zhText: 强力践踏以扰乱时间秩序，并使周围的敌人陷入停滞状态。

/Lotus/Language/Kingpins/KuvaLichSmiteAb.text: Focuses energy into an enemy until they burst forth with projectiles.

/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv.zhText: 铸造大师贝里克的的晶化遗骸。

/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv.text:
During the Old War, Belric, Rania and their guardian Warframe Citrine were the last line of defense against a Sentient onslaught upon a strategically important planetoid. In the absence of any eyewitnesses, what happened in those final moments is a matter of speculation and colorful myth. 

What is known? A bio-bomb released the Infestation upon the planetoid, halting the Sentient advance and creating a heavily mutated environment. As for Belric and Rania, the evidence suggests they were turned to crystal by Citrine. In her final moments, the Warframe chose not to flee but to use the last of her energy to preserve the pair, together, in one final embrace.
/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv.zhText:
在远古之战时期，一颗具有重要战略目的的小行星上，贝里克、拉尼娅和守护他们的战甲 Citrine 组成了抵御 Sentient 猛攻最后的防线。但在缺少目击者的当下，最终时刻发生的往事成为了猜测和五彩缤纷的神话故事。

已知的事实呢？由一颗生物炸弹带来的感染物质在小行星上被释放，暂且阻止了 Sentient 的前进，并创造出一片严重变异的环境。至于贝里克和拉尼娅，有证据表明他们被 Citrine 变成了水晶。战甲 Citrine 在最后的时刻，并没有选择逃跑，转而用她最后的能量封存了这对情侣，赐以最终之拥的形态。

/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv.text: The crystalized remains of the celebrated Void engineer, Rania.
/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv.zhText: 著名虚空工程师拉尼娅的晶化遗骸。

/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv.text:
In an event that has become the stuff of legend, Rania, along with her former husband Belric, were transmuted into crystal by their sworn protector; the Warframe Citrine. A merciful end, that saved them from a much worse fate.

Their crystals remained together until the recent past. Smugglers discovered they exhibited some very curious properties; when separated, Rania's crystal remains connected to Belric's crystal via a Void tunnel. How? Perhaps in their final moments, intense emotions deformed the Void substrata, connecting them forever. 

Doomed lovers, connected forever. Citrine's last wish.
/Lotus/Language/LastWish/DoubleDefenseAv.zhText:
在一个已经成为传奇的事件中，拉尼娅和她的前夫贝里克被他们的誓约守护者——Citrine 战甲凝结成了水晶。这是一个仁慈的结局，让他们幸免于更悲惨的命运。

直到不久前，他们的水晶还连在一起。走私者发现它们展示出一些非常奇特的特性；分开后，拉尼娅的水晶仍然通过一个虚空通道与贝里克的水晶相连。怎么会呢？也许在他们二人的最后时刻，强烈的情感让虚空的质基变形，从而将他们永远地连在一起。

命中注定的爱人，永世相连的缠绵。Citrine 的遗愿。

Cheat-software detected...

Quit all cheat-software to continue with the update.

Running cheat-software while playing Warframe will result in automatic account suspension.

检测到作弊工具………

Network caches may be deployed by your network administrator to accelerate the update process.

They should be allowed unless you are having problems updating; disabling may make updating slower.

您的网络管理员可能会部署网络缓存以加速更新过程。

Aggressive download makes the update process use multiple parallel connections.

It should be enabled unless you are having problems updating (typically caused by slow or unreliable internet connections).
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_AGGRESS.zhText:
多线程下载模式在更新过程使用若干互相平行的连接。

除非遇到更新问题（如不稳定或缓慢的互联网连接），否则建议启动此功能。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_BULK_DO.text:
Bulk download makes fresh installs take much less time.

It should be enabled unless you are having problems installing.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_BULK_DO.zhText:
批量下载能让全新安装游戏花费更少的时间。

除非您在安装游戏时遇到问题，否则建议应启动本功能。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_DEBUG_D.zhText: 基本验证会降低性能，并且可能与外部软件（覆盖等）不兼容。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_DEBUG_D.text:
Slow Validation will severely reduce performance and will likely crash if any external software is injected.

Please disable all overlays and recording software when using Slow Validation.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_DEBUG_D.zhText:
如果添加任何外部软件，慢速验证将严重降低性能并可能崩溃。

使用慢速验证时，请禁用所有覆盖和录制软件。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_DX12_DR.text: DirectX 12 Rendering is experimental and may be unstable!
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_DX12_DR.zhText: DirectX 12 渲染是实验性质的，可能会不稳定！

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_LAUNCH_.text: Graphics API Validation is currently enabled! Remember to disable overlays and streaming software before playing.

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_OLD_DRI.text:
Older drivers will probably run SLOWER and reduce quality.

DirectX 11 should be left used unless you are experiencing driver-crashes.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/CONFIRM_OLD_DRI.zhText:
过时的驱动很可能运行缓慢并且降低品质。

除非您遇到驱动程序崩溃的情况，否则 DirectX 11 应该是被启用的。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.text: They were called Tenno. Warriors of blade and gun: masters of the Warframe armor. Those that survived the old war were left drifting among the ruins. Now they are needed once more.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.zhText: 他们被称为 Tenno ，驾驭名为战甲的超级装甲，身负枪与剑的战士。这些从远古之战中生还的战士正在废墟中漂流。现在他们再次被召唤。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.text: The Grineer, with their vast armies, are spreading throughout the Origin System. A call echoes across the stars summoning the Tenno to an ancient place. They summon you.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.zhText: Grineer，与他们庞大的军队正在蔓延到整个始源星系。一个跨越星际的召唤正呼叫着 Tenno 前往一处古老之地。他们正在召唤你。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.text: Allow the Lotus to guide you. She has rescued you from your cryostasis chamber and given you a chance to survive. The Grineer will find you; you must be prepared. The Lotus will teach you the ways of the Warframes and the secrets to unlocking their powers.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.zhText: 让 Lotus 引导你。她已把你从冷冻舱里救出来，并给了你一个活下去的机会。Grineer 会找到你；你必须做好准备。Lotus 会教你战甲的使用方法，以及解锁他们力量的秘诀。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.text:
Lean on your fellow Tenno for guidance.

Form Squads to complete your Missions, join a Clan to share in their knowledge and resources, and explore helpful guides to aid you in this massive world. Before long, you will become an unstoppable force in the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/INTRO_STORY_TEX.zhText:
向你的 Tenno 同伴寻求指导。

组建小队完成你的任务，加入氏族共享他们的知识和资源，并探索实用指南，助你在这个浩瀚的世界里前行。不久之后，你将成为始源星系中一股不可阻挡的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB1_DESC.text: Atop the Yuvan Peak, where the Tenno mastered their Void powers, an icy monolith rises. Use its power to beat back a new threat: the Entropic Eximus. Then engage in new six-player Missions and aid Cephalon Melica by taking control of the newest Warframe, Narin.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB1_DESC.zhText: 在 Tenno 掌握虚空之力的青春峰顶，一座冰冷的巨石拔地而起。利用它的力量击退新的威胁：熵之卓越者。随后，参与全新的六人任务，并通过操控最新战甲 Narin 来协助中枢梅丽卡。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB2_ALTDESC.text: Watch for all-new weekly Missions featuring Kahl-175, coming soon.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB2_ALTDESC.zhText: 敬请关注即将推出的以卡尔-175 为特色的全新每周任务。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB2_DESC.text: New worlds and possibilities await beyond the limits of the Origin System in Warframe: Tau. Begin your preparations for the journey ahead with Epoch Operation: Taubound (live until November 17) and a new, permanent Tau Prologue Quest available in your Codex.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB2_DESC.zhText: 在《Warframe：Tau》中，始源星系之外的全新世界和无限可能正等待着你。参与《纪元行动：奔赴 Tau 星系》（活动持续至美东冬令时间 11 月 17 日）并开启全新的永久《Tau 序章》系列任务（可在你的资料库中找到），为即将到来的旅程做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB2_TITLE.zhText: 为前往 Tau 星系做好准备

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB3_DESC.text: Lament the spirits of the dead with the Banshee Threnodia Collection, featuring a Warframe Skin and the Gast Sentinel attachments in the Market.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB3_DESC.zhText: 通过 Banshee 挽歌组合包来悼念亡灵吧！该组合包可在游戏内商店获得，内含一款战甲外观和惊怵守护配件。

/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB4_DESC.text: Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes. Find her as part of the new Narin Warframe Bundle on the in-game Market.
/Lotus/Language/Launcher/TAB4_DESC.zhText: Narin 如旋涡般降临，她的利刃锋利无比，如同凛冽的寒风。她能巧妙地运用冰霜防御，如同她迅捷的细剑攻击一般。你可以在游戏内商店全新的 Narin 战甲组合包中找到她。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/Loadout_IllegalS.text: Swap not allowed. Target Config does not support same Helminth ability
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/Loadout_IllegalS.zhText: 无法切换。目标配置不支持相同的 Helminth 技能

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/MapPanel_AvailCa.text: This weapon has an unused mod capacity of |NUM|. Use the Arsenal to equip additional mods, or rank up existing mods, to make this weapon as effective as possible.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/MapPanel_AvailCa.zhText: 这个武器的未使用 Mod 容量为 |NUM|。使用军械库装备其他 Mod，或升级现有 Mod，以使武器达到最佳效果。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/NoModsWarning.text: None of your Mods are compatible with this weapon. Visit the Mods menu in your Codex to see a full list of Mods and where you can get them.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/NoModsWarning.zhText: 你的所有 Mod 都与该武器不兼容。请访问资料库中的 Mod 菜单，查看完整的 Mod 列表以及获取的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/OperatorScreenIn.text: Operator menu currently in use by another player.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/OperatorScreenIn.zhText: 指挥官菜单当前正被其他玩家使用。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/OrionScytheInnat.text: Slam attacks grant |value|% Critical Chance per enemy hit for |duration|s stacking up to |limit|x.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/OrionScytheInnat.zhText: 震地攻击每次击中敌人都会获得 |value|% 暴击几率，持续 |duration| 秒，最多可叠加 |limit| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/RandomizeConfirm.text: Are you sure you want to randomize?
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/RandomizeConfirm.zhText: 是否确定要使用随机配置？

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/ResetConfirm.text: Are you sure you want to reset to default?
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/ResetConfirm.zhText: 确实要重置为默认值吗？

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/SiriusScytheInna.text: Slam attacks grant |value|% Status Chance per enemy hit for |duration|s stacking up to |limit|x.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/SiriusScytheInna.zhText: 震地攻击每次击中敌人都会获得 |value|% 触发几率，持续 |duration| 秒，最多可叠加 |limit| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/Spectres_Hint1.text: To create a custom Specter, simply equip a desired Loadout in the Arsenal, the Foundry will copy your active Warframe Loadout when a Specter Blueprint is started.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/Spectres_Hint1.zhText: 要制造自定义魅影，只需在军械库中装备心仪的配置，铸造厂会在魅影蓝图开始制造时复制你当前使用的战甲配置。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/Spectres_Hint2.text: Add built Specters to the Gear Wheel in the Arsenal's Gear menu. Deploy them using the Gear Wheel while in missions.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/Spectres_Hint2.zhText: 在军械库的携带装备轮盘中添加已制造的魅影。在执行任务时使用携带装备轮盘部署它们。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/TnBayonetMeleeKi.text:
Polarization, Exilus Unlock and Lens Installation are reflected on the Primary Slot as well.

Melee kills give 100% Rifle Ammo Efficiency for your next 4 shots, stacking up to 16x.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/TnBayonetMeleeKi.zhText:
极化、特殊功能槽位解锁和专精安装也会反映在主要槽位上。

近战击杀会使你的下 4 发步枪弹药效率提升 100%，最多可叠加 16 层。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/TnBayonetRifleHe.text:
Polarization, Exilus Unlock and Lens Installation are reflected on the Melee Slot as well.

Headshots grant +250% Melee Damage for next 2 Melee Attacks, stacking up to 16x.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/TnBayonetRifleHe.zhText:
极化、特殊功能槽位解锁和专精安装也会反映在近战槽位上。

爆头可使接下来的 2 次近战攻击伤害提高 250%，最多可叠加 16 层。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_19.text: Alternate Fire swarms enemies with mites, inflicting them with <DT_IMPACT_COLOR> Impact and <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Status Effects. If the targeted enemy is open to Mercy Kills perform a ranged finisher instead. Perform a Mercy Kill to gain +100% Damage and +100% Multishot.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_19.zhText: 次要射击使感染螨虫攻击敌人，造成 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击和 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力异常状态。射击能被怜悯之击攻击的敌人则可远程处决。进行怜悯之击可获得 +100% 伤害和 +100% 多重射击。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_19.text: Enemies damaged by the Coda Dual Torxica spread three spores on death, which will inflict <DT_FREEZE>Cold Status Chance. Additional shots to infected enemies inflict x1.5 damage.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_19.zhText: 被终幕·孢蚀双枪伤害的敌人死亡时会传播三个孢子，造成 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻异常状态。对被感染的敌人的后续射击会造成 1.5 倍伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_AX.text: Hip-fired shots have +60% Ammo Efficiency. Aimed Headshots have +400% Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_AX.zhText: 腰射时 +60% 弹药效率。瞄准爆头时 +400% 暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ac.text: +25% Reload Speed while Sprinting. Bonus doubled when wielded by Gauss
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ac.zhText: 冲刺时，增加 25% 装填速度。被 Gauss 持有时效果加倍

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ac.text: Blocking absorbs up to 4 hits of Elemental Damage, and applies 17.5% of that Damage to the next attack
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ac.zhText: 格挡最多可吸收 4 次元素伤害，并将该伤害的 17.5% 应用于下一次攻击

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ac.text: Shots apply a guaranteed <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ac.zhText: 每一发都必定造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ae.text: Alternate Fire shoots an explosive projectile that deals <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast Damage in 7m radius
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ae.zhText: 次要射击发射爆炸投射物，在周围 7 米范围内造成 <DT_BLAST_COLOR>爆炸伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Af.text: Alternate Fire throws speargun. If no enemy is hit, buffs nearby allies with increased Reload Speed, Fire Rate, and Ammo Maximum, plus -50% Recoil. Killing an enemy within this area maintains these buffs for 40 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Af.zhText: 次要射击投掷标枪。如果没有击中敌人，则会为附近的友军增加装填速度、射速和弹药最大值，并减少 50% 后坐力。杀死该区域内的敌人可使这些增益保持 40 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ak.text: +50% Reload Speed while Sprinting. Bonus doubled when wielded by Gauss
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ak.zhText: 冲刺时增加 50% 装填速度。被 Gauss 持有时效果加倍

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Al.text: Alternate Fire rapidly expends Magazine in single burst
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Al.zhText: 次要射击以单次点射快速射空弹匣。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Al.text: Alternate Fire launches a sphere that pulses for 10 seconds before exploding. +20% Multishot when wielded by Gyre
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Al.zhText: 次要射击发射一个球体，脉冲 10 秒后爆炸。Grye 持有时，+20% 多重射击

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Am.text: Alternate Fire switches between Auto and Charge firing modes
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Am.zhText: 次要射击可在自动和充能开火模式间切换

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.text: Fires 6 missiles, each inflicting one of the secondary elemental damage types. Striking Nokko's mushrooms increases their pulse rate. Multishot is converted to damage instead of more projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.zhText: 发射 6 枚导弹，每枚造成一种次要元素伤害。攻击 Nokko 的蘑菇会提高其脉动频率。多重射击会转化为伤害，而不是更多投射物。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.text: Hits increase Critical Chance and Status Chance by 4% for 2 seconds. Stacks up to 5x
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.zhText: 击中时提高 4% 暴击几率和触发几率，持续 2 秒。最多叠加 5 层。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.text: Melee Kills grant the next Slam Attack +250% Damage and +2m Range, stacking up to 5x. Slam Attacks apply <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.zhText: 近战击杀为下次震地攻击增加 250% 伤害和 2 米范围，最多叠加 5 层。震地攻击触发 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.text: Heavy Attack shoots a glaive that ricochets once
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.zhText: 重击会射出一把在敌人身上跳弹一次的战刃

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.text: Highlights enemies near reticle while aiming. Alternate Fire switches between Auto and Semi firing modes
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.zhText: 瞄准时，突显准星附近的敌人。次要射击可以在全自动与半自动射击模式之间进行切换。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.text: Heavy Attack launches projectiles dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ar.zhText: 重击发射弹射物，造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_As.text: +80 Ammo Maximum when wielded by Gara
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_As.zhText: Gara 持有时，+80 弹药最大值

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_At.text: Weak Point kills remove Recoil and increase Fire Rate and Ammo Efficiency by 100% for 8 seconds. Alternate Fire rapidly expends Magazine in single burst
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_At.zhText: 弱点击杀可消除后坐力并增加 100% 射速和弹药效率，持续 8 秒。次要射击以单次连发快速射空弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_At.text: Weak Point kills remove Recoil and increase Fire Rate and Ammo Efficiency by 100% for 12 seconds. Alternate Fire rapidly expends Magazine in single burst
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_At.zhText: 弱点击杀可消除后坐力并增加 100% 射速和弹药效率，持续 12 秒。次要射击以单次连发快速射空弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Az.text: Alternate Fire launches Magazine as an automated turret, shooting nearby enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Az.zhText: 次要射击将射出整个弹匣，并将其变为一个自动炮台，攻击附近的敌人

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Az.text: Melee attacks while Blocking release a shockwave dealing 85 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in a 10m radius, staggering enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Az.zhText: 在格挡时进行近战攻击释放冲击波，在周围 10 米内造成 85 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，并使敌人失衡

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ba.text: Fully depleting Magazine causes three radial pulses, staggering enemies and healing the user for 100 Health per enemy. Alternate Fire shoots two 9m beams that chain between enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ba.zhText: 完全耗尽弹匣会产生 3 个放射脉冲波，使敌人失衡，并按照受伤害的敌人数量治疗玩家，每伤害一个敌人恢复 100 生命值。次要射击发射两束 9 米光束，将敌人锁在一起

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ba.text: Kills with Primary Fire charge up Alternate Fire, which fires a powerful <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation beam
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ba.zhText: 使用主要射击击杀敌人时，可为次要射击充能，后者可发射威力强大的 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射光束

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Bl.text: Gain Affinity to fill the Red Veil meter and trigger a 25m <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral explosion, restoring 25% Energy and increasing Movement Speed by +10% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Bl.zhText: 获得经验值以填充血色面纱计量条，并触发一个 25 米范围的 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒爆炸，恢复 25% 能量并且增加 10% 移动速度，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Br.text: Interact with fallen enemies to extract a Health Orb from organic enemies, or Energy Orb from robotic enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Br.zhText: 与倒下的敌人互动，从有机敌人身上提取生命球，或从机械敌人身上提取能量球。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Bu.text: Alternate Fire shoots a burst of 3 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral explosives
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Bu.zhText: 次要射击发射 3 枚 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒爆炸物

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Bu.text: Alternate Fire shoots a tracer round that marks the enemy and grant +50% Critical Chance. Subsequent Primary Fire shots home in on traced target
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Bu.zhText: 次要射击发射一枚标记敌人的曳光弹，并增加 50% 暴击几率。随后的主要射击会自动锁定被标记的敌人

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ca.text: Cantare's blades have a 300% Critical Chance when they return upon reload. Strike enemies with returning blades to activate Cantare Chorale, a buff that increases Reload Speed by 20% for allies.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ca.zhText: 当歌颂的刃片在重新装填时返回，其暴击几率为 300%。使用返回的刃片击中敌人将激活"歌颂赞美诗"，此增益为友军增加 20% 装填速度。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ca.text: Throws a <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive grenade when reloading. Reloading from an empty magazine throws a larger grenade with increased Damage, Critical Chance and Status Chance
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ca.zhText: 装填时会投掷一个 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀手榴弹。从空弹匣重新装填时，会投掷一枚更巨威力的手榴弹，且伤害、暴击几率和触发几率都会增加

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ca.text: Heavy attacks throw a wave of bile that applies <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR> Corrosive Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ca.zhText: 重击会掷出一滩酸液并造成 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ce.text: Alternate Fire launches a bouncing glaive with guaranteed Status Chance. Primary Fire deals 60% additional Damage for each Status Effect on the target. Converts Secondary Ammo Pickups to 50% of Shotgun Ammo when wielded by Lavos
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ce.zhText: 次要射击发射一把必定触发异常状态的弹跳型战刃。主要射击对目标身上的每个异常状态造成 60% 的额外伤害。Lavos 持有时，将拾取的次要武器弹药转化为 50% 的霰弹枪弹药

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ce.text: Deals x1.5 Damage on headshots. Alternate Fire switches between vertical and horizontal arrow spread
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ce.zhText: 爆头造成 1.5 倍伤害。次要射击可在箭矢的垂直扩散和水平扩散之间切换

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Aerial attacks throw shield, knocking down enemies. Sword's first strike causes enemies to sleep for 2 seconds when wielded by Baruuk
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 空中攻击投掷盾牌，击倒敌人。Baruuk 持有时，剑的首次攻击会使敌人沉睡 2 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Heavy attacks throw a wave of bile that applies <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR> Corrosive Damage, faster than the standard Caustacyst.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 重击会掷出一滩酸液并造成 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。 比普通灼蚀变体镰更快。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Attacks spawn allied Miasmites that last for 7 seconds, that will explode in a larger area than the normal Pathocyst
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 攻击会生成友方自爆虫，持续 7 秒，其爆炸范围比普通病囊飞刃更大

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Primary Fire converges beams when held, while Alternate Fire oscillates beams in an arc
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 按住主要射击键可汇聚光束，而次要射击键则可使光束以弧线向左右移动

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Alternate Fire shoots an airburst round that detonates after traveling 20m in mid-air
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 次要射击发射一枚在空中飞行 20 米后爆炸的空爆弹

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Alternate Fire shoots an airburst round that detonates manually. Use Alternate Fire input to trigger explosion in mid-air
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 次要射击发射可在空中手动引爆的空爆弹。再次按下次要射击键在空中触发爆炸

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Kills with Primary Fire charge up Alternate Fire, which shoots three grenades that explode upon impact or manual detonation. <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast explosion leaves <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage area for 11 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 使用主要射击击杀敌人，可为次要射击充能。次要射击会发射三枚手榴弹，可在撞击时爆炸或被手动引爆。<DT_BLAST_COLOR>引爆后，它们会留下一片区域，在 11 秒内造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.text: Heavy Attacks launches projectiles that deals <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. Heavy Attack speed increased by 20% when wielded by Citrine
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Co.zhText: 重击发射的投射物可造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。Citrine 持有时，重击速度增加 20%

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Cy.text: Alternate Fire rapidly expends Magazine in a single accurate burst with no ricochet or homing
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Cy.zhText: 次要射击会在一次精准点射时快速射空弹匣，不会跳弹或追踪

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Da.text: Weak Point hits have +250% Critical Chance
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Da.zhText: 命中弱点时有 +250% 暴击几率

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_De.text: Melee Combo Multiplier increases for every 11 hits. Max Combo Multiplier is 11x
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_De.zhText: 每 11 次命中就会增加近战连击倍率。最高连击倍率为 11x

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.text: +20% Heavy Attack Efficiency when wielded by Khora
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.zhText: Khora 持有时，重击效率增加 20%

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.text: Headshot grants +150% Fire Rate, +100% Ammo Efficiency and +100% <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage for 3 seconds.  <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin will combine with Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.zhText: 爆头增加 150% 射速、100% 弹药效率和 100% <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害，持续 3 秒。<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素和 Mod 效果组合。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.text: Airborne Melee Slide Attack will boost movement speed, landing cancels the effect
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.zhText: 在空中进行近战滑行攻击会增加移动速度，落地则会取消该效果

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.text: Alternate Fire unleashes a blizzard arrow that instantly freezes enemies it hits, while leaving behind a frozen trail that inflicts a guaranteed <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect once per second when touched. Direct hits grant a single charge while Weak Point hits provide double.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.zhText: 次要射击会释放出一支暴风雪箭，瞬间冻结击中的敌人，同时留下一条冰冻轨迹；敌人触碰到该轨迹时，每秒必定会造成一次 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态。直接命中可获得一层充能，命中弱点时则可获得双倍充能。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.text: Reloading creates a chilling pulse that inflicts <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect. Each round replaced inflicts an additional stack while increasing the pulse's radius by 1m.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Du.zhText: 重新装填弹药会产生一道寒冷的脉冲，造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态。每次装填，冰冻异常状态就叠加一层，同时脉冲范围半径增加 1 米。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ed.text: Heavy Attack throws weapon, striking enemies and exploding with <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast Damage in a 5m radius
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ed.zhText: 重击会投掷武器，击中敌人并在 5 米范围内爆炸，造成 <DT_BLAST_COLOR>爆炸伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ek.text: Heavy Attacks grants +80% Damage and +20% Attack Speed for 8s
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ek.zhText: 重击可增加 +80% 近战伤害和 +20% 攻击速度，持续 8 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_En.text: Gain Affinity to fill the Cephalon Suda meter and trigger a 25m <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic explosion, restoring 25% Energy and increasing Energy Max by +25% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_En.zhText: 获得经验值以填充中枢苏达计量条，并触发一个 25 米范围的 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力爆炸，恢复 25% 生命值并且增加 25% 最大能量，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ep.text: +20% Headshot Damage when wielded by Sevagoth
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ep.zhText: Sevagoth 持有时，增加 20% 爆头伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Eu.text: Alternate Fire shoots a widespread buckshot
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Eu.zhText: 次要射击发射一枚大型鹿弹

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ev.text: Damage dealt by Evensong's arrows applies 7 stacks of Puncture Status, which reduces the target's damage output by 100% and increases their Critical Chance of damage taken by 35%. Kills with Evensong activate Evensong Devotion, a buff that increases Multishot by 35% for allies.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ev.zhText: 晚祷的箭矢造成的伤害附加 7 层穿刺异常状态，使目标的伤害输出降低 100%，并使其受到伤害的暴击几率提高 35%。使用晚祷杀敌人将激活"晚祷灵修"，此增益为友军增加 35% 多重射击。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ex.text: Alternate Fire launches a freezing grenade that will completely freeze enemies with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and leave a freezing zone that will continue to apply <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status for |DURATION| seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ex.zhText: 次要射击发射冻结榴弹，它会以 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态完全冻结敌人，并留下一个在 |DURATION| 秒内持续施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态的冻结区域。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fe.text: Headshots charge Incarnon Form. Alternate Fire transforms weapon into Incarnon Form of semi-automatic dual pistols
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fe.zhText: 爆头时为灵化充能。次要射击将武器转换为半自动双持手枪的灵化形态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fe.text: Alternate Fire throws speargun, pulling in enemies within 10m every 2 seconds and dealing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fe.zhText: 次要射击投掷标枪来拖近 10 米内的敌人，每 2 秒造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fu.text: Alternate Fire switches between Semi and Auto firing modes. Semi mode deals an <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effect to enemies at close range. Switch speed is doubled when wielded by Wisp
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fu.zhText: 次要射击可以在半自动和全自动模式之间切换。半自动模式可在近距离对敌人造成 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态。Wisp 持有时，切换速度加倍。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fu.text: Knives gain +50% Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Fu.zhText: Gara 持有时，飞刀的投射物速度增加 50%

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ga.text: Kills adds 50 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage to the next cast of Fatal Attraction by a Djinn Sentinel, up to 500 Damage. On Fatal Attraction activation, gains +25% <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ga.zhText: 击杀会给引灵下一次施放的致命诱惑增加 50 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害，最高可达 500。当致命诱惑激活时，获得 25% <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.text: Alternate Fire releases a voltaic orb that travels slowly then explodes after 6 seconds, shocking an enemy every second within 6m. Shock will chain to 2 additional enemies within 6m.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.zhText: 次要射击发射一颗缓慢飞行的电弧球，并在 6 秒后爆炸，每秒电击 6 米内的一名敌人。电击会连锁影响 6 米内的另外 2 名敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.text: Gain 10% Final Critical Chance for each unique Status Effect on the target
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.zhText: 目标身上每存在一种独特的异常状态，最终暴击几率提高 10%

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.text: After inflicting a Critical Hit, next shot has a |PROC_CHANCE|% chance of adding |STATUS_NUM| Status Effects
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.zhText: 造成暴击后，下一次射击有 |PROC_CHANCE|% 的几率附加 |STATUS_NUM| 个异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.text: After inflicting a Status Effect, next shot has a 15% chance to have a Critical Chance of 300%
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Gr.zhText: 造成一种异常状态后，下一次射击有 15% 的几率获得 300% 的暴击几率

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.text: Alternate Fire splits the gun into separate rifles, auto-targeting up to 4 targets at once while consuming more ammo per shot.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.zhText: 次要射击将枪械分成多把独立的步枪，一次最多可自动瞄准 4 个目标，但每次射击消耗的弹药更多。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.text: 50% chance to disarm enemies when thrown
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.zhText: 投掷时，有 50% 几率解除敌人武装

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.text: Heavy Attacks condense all Status Effects that deal damage over time into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills activate Harmonic Resonance, a buff that increases Status Duration by 30% for allies.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.zhText: 重击会立刻结算所有的异常状态效果伤害。重击击杀将激活"和谐共鸣"，此增益为友军增加 30% 异常状态持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.text: Alternate Fire shoots a harpoon, pulling enemies closer and knocking them down
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ha.zhText: 次要射击投掷一柄鱼叉，拉近敌人并将其击倒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_He.text: Kills with this weapon perform a Codex Scan on the target. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_He.zhText: 使用此武器进行击杀会对目标进行资料库扫描。需携带足够的资料库扫描器且有可用的扫描次数

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_He.text: Drains up to 5% of Warframe's Health to reload. Headshots with this weapon have 5% Life Steal
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_He.zhText: 装填时最多消耗 5% 战甲生命值。使用此武器爆头可获得 5% 生命窃取

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hi.text: Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hi.zhText: （英文：HIGASA）瞄准可形成一面盾牌，阻挡敌方武器的射击。击杀和阻挡射击将为次要射击充能，以释放光束。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hi.text: Alternative Fire switches between Burst and Semi firing modes
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hi.zhText: 次要射击可在点射和半自动射击模式间切换

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hi.text: Critical Hits have 5% Life Steal and increases maximum Health by 5% for 15s. Stacks up to 25%
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hi.zhText: 暴击有 5% 的生命窃取效果，并使最大生命值提高 5%，持续 15 秒。最多叠加至 25%

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hy.text: Alternate Fire switches between <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity and <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effects that scale based on Weapon Damage. Headshots have an 8% chance to instantly refill Magazine when wielded by Khora
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Hy.zhText: 次要射击可在 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素、 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰、 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击和 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻四种元素之间切换，效果会按照武器伤害变化。Khora 持有时，爆头有 8% 的几率立即装填弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_In.text: Alt fire sprays ink that will stain enemies. Shooting ink stained foes with Enkaus draws ink back into the weapon to reload and dissolves enemies when their health drops below 35%. When wielded by Follie, foes are also inflicted with Inkblot.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_In.zhText: 次要射击会喷出墨汁，浸染敌人。使用绘墨射击被墨汁浸染的敌人时，墨汁会被吸回武器而重新装弹，并且当敌人的生命值低于 35% 时，敌人会被溶解。当通过 Follie 使用绘墨时，敌人也会受到墨蚀效果影响。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_In.text: Heavy Attack with 5x or more Combo Multiplier to transform weapon into Incarnon Form, increasing Range and Attack Speed. In Incarnon Form, Aerial Attacks while Aim Gliding launch <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage projectiles, and Finishers increase Damage Reduction by 10% up to 4 times
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_In.zhText: 当连击倍率达到 5x 或更多时，重击可以将武器转换为灵化形态，增加范围和攻击速度。在灵化形态下，飞身瞄准时的空中攻击会发射带有 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害的投射物，处决攻击会使伤害减免增加 10%，最多可叠加 4 层

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ja.text: Slam attacks deal <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast Damage and launch enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ja.zhText: 震地攻击造成 <DT_BLAST_COLOR>爆炸伤害并弹开敌人

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ja.text: Alternate Fire throws speargun, consuming Magazine to cause a <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat explosion. Damage increased by 20% for each round in Magazine when thrown
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ja.zhText: 次要射击将掷出标枪，消耗整个弹匣造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰爆炸。投掷时，弹匣内剩余的每发弹药都将提升 20% 伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ju.text: Alternate Fire charges up a burst of Buckshot, each pellet always inflicts <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosion status on hits
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ju.zhText: 次要射击蓄力发射霰弹，每颗子弹命中时都会造成 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ju.text: Gain Affinity to fill the Steel Meridian meter and trigger a 25m <DT_BLAST_COLOR>Blast explosion, restoring 25% Health and increasing Armor by +15% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ju.zhText: 获得经验值以填充钢铁防线计量条，并触发一个 25 米范围的 <DT_BLAST_COLOR>爆炸，恢复 25% 生命值并且增加 15% 护甲，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ke.text: Heavy Attack with 12x Combo Multiplier to grant +2.8m Range to all Melee attacks for 180 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ke.zhText: 当连击倍率达到 12x 时，重击可以在 180 秒内使所有近战攻击的范围增加 2.8 米

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Kn.text: Headshots grant 100% Ammo Efficiency for 2 seconds, as well as 0.5x Critical Damage and 20% Status Chance that stacks up to 3 times. Doubled Magazine size when wielded by Harrow
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Kn.zhText: 爆头后增加 100% 弹药效率，持续 2 秒，以及 0.5 倍暴击伤害和 20% 触发几率，最多可叠加 3 层。Harrow 持有时，弹匣容量翻倍

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ko.text: Max Zoom has -75% Fire Rate, but causes a 3.5m <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral explosion. Converts Secondary Ammo Pickups to 100% of Sniper Ammo
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ko.zhText: 变焦最大倍率时射速 -75%，但可造成 3.5 米范围的 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒爆炸。将拾取的次要武器弹药转换为 100% 的狙击枪弹药

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Kr.text: +10% Parkour Velocity when wielding this weapon
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Kr.zhText: 持有此武器时 +10% 跑酷速度

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.text: Alternate Fire manually detonates torpedoes in mid-air
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.zhText: 次要射击可在半空中引爆榴弹

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.text: Alternate Fire manually detonates explosive arrow in mid-air
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.zhText: 次要射击可在半空中引爆箭矢
直接击中时，增加 50% 爆头伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.text: Alternate Fire shoots four barrels simultaneously
Alternate Fire switches between Auto, Burst, and Semi firing modes
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.zhText: 次要射击可在全自动，点射和半自动模式间切换

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.text: Uses Auto firing mode when hip-firing, and Burst firing mode when aiming
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ku.zhText: 腰射时为全自动射击模式，瞄准时为点射模式

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_La.text: Headshots charge Incarnon Form. Alternate Fire transforms weapon into Incarnon Form of automatic rifle that shoots explosives
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_La.zhText: 爆头时为灵化充能。次要射击将武器转换为全自动步枪的灵化形态，可发射爆炸物

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_La.text: Alternate Fire switches between a Held chaining beam and a Charge explosive that pierces enemies and explodes on surfaces. +300 Ammo Maximum when wielded by Hildryn
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_La.zhText: 次要射击可在连锁光束和充能爆破之间切换。充能爆破模式会穿透敌人，并在接触地形表面时爆炸。Hildryn 持有时，增加 300 最大弹药值

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Le.text: Converts Secondary Ammo Pickups to 50% of Arrow Ammo
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Le.zhText: 将拾取的次要武器弹药转换为 50% 的箭矢。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Le.text: Melee Status Effects grant +15% Attack Speed and +100% <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage for 6 seconds.  <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin will combine with Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Le.zhText: 近战造成异常状态时增加 15% 攻击速度和 100% <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害，持续 6 秒。<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素和 Mod 效果组合。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.text: Hits have a 4% chance to grant +100% Ammo Efficiency for 4s
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.zhText: 击中有 4% 几率获得 +100% 弹药效率，持续 4 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.text: Alternate Fire charges up a glob of explosive Efervon gel which Staggers and <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrodes enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.zhText: 次要射击蓄力发射一团爆炸性艾弗旺凝胶，可使敌人失衡并造成 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀状态。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.text: Immune to crowd control effects during Heavy Attacks when wielded by Grendel
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.zhText: Grendel 持有时，在重击期间免疫群体控制效果

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.text: Kills with Primary Fire charge up Alternate Fire, which shoots a charged explosion that damages and Lifts enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ma.zhText: 使用主要射击击杀敌人为次要射击充能，次要射击可引发爆炸，伤害并炸飞敌人

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Me.text: Receives 6x physical damage from mods and a different bonus based on the prevalent physical damage type. Impact has +40% Attack Speed, Puncture has +1.5m Range, and Slash has +100% Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Me.zhText: 在 Mod 的影响下，获得 6 倍物理伤害。并根据常见的物理伤害类型获得不同的加成。冲击可增加 40% 攻击速度，穿刺可增加 1.5 米范围，而切割可增加 100% 触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Mi.zhText: 震地攻击会造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Mo.text: Kills with Primary Fire charge up Alternate Fire, which shoots a bouncing projectile that explodes after traveling 14m
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Mo.zhText: 使用主要射击击杀敌人为次要射击充能，次要射击发射一枚弹跳弹药，在飞行 14 米后爆炸

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Mu.text: Alternate Fire shoots up to three floating Infested masses that can combine. Firing through mass adds +100% <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage for each mass fired. Mass explodes after 9 seconds, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Mu.zhText: 次要射击可发射漂浮的感染团块，但最多只能合并其中三个团块。每穿过一个团块的射击都会增加 100% <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。团块在 9 秒后爆炸，造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Na.text: Alternate Fire rapidly expends Magazine in single burst. Headshot kills increase speed of next Reload by 50%. +1m Punch Through when wielded by Garuda
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Na.zhText: 次要射击以单次点射快速射空弹匣。爆头击杀后，下一次装填的速度增加 50%。Garuda 持有时，+1 米穿透

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_No.text: There is no restriction on the number of Tome Mods you can equip on Noctua.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_No.zhText: 夜枭可以装备的典籍 Mod 数量不受限制。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Oc.text: Kills generate up to 4 energy tendrils that lock onto enemies near reticle. Tendrils reset on Reload.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Oc.zhText: 击杀会产生最多 4 条能量卷须，以锁定准星附近的敌人。卷须在重新装填时重置。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_On.text: Headshots charge Incarnon Form. Alternate Fire transforms weapon into Incarnon Form of an arm cannon.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_On.zhText: 爆头时为灵化充能。次要射击将武器转换为手炮的灵化形态.

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Or.text: Hold Melee Throw briefly to suspend enemy in mid-air for 3 seconds before exploding, inflicting damage and a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Or.zhText: 短暂按住近战投掷可使敌人悬停在半空中 3 秒，然后爆炸，造成伤害和 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.text: Alternate Fire rapidly expends Magazine in single burst. Killing an enemy with Alternate Fire headshot increases speed of next Reload when wielded by Octavia
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.zhText: 次要射击以单次点射快速射空弹匣。Octavia 持有时，使用次要射击爆头击杀一名敌人会增加下一次装填的速度

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.text: Melee Slam inflicts a <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.zhText: 近战震波攻击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.text: Alternate Fire launches a floating sawblade, dealing continuous <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.zhText: 次要射击发射一个悬浮锯片，持续造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.text: Attacks spawn allied Maggots that last for 7 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.zhText: 攻击时，产生蛆虫作为友军，持续 7 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.text: Every pellet that hits increases the wielder's Melee Combo Count. Melee Combo Duration increased by 7 seconds when wielded by Kullervo
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pa.zhText: 每个击中的子弹都会增加持枪者的近战连击数。Kullervo 持有时，近战连击持续时间可增加 7 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pe.text: Heavy Attack kills grant +50% Attack Speed for up to 46 seconds, scaling with Combo Count
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pe.zhText: 重击击杀提供 +50% 攻击速度，最多持续 46 秒，此效果根据连击数变化

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pe.text: Alternate Fire manually detonates all grenades
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pe.zhText: 次要射击可手动引爆所有榴弹

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pe.text: Landing a Headshot Kill or 4 Headshots in one burst grants +100% Ammo Efficiency for 4 seconds. +24 Ammo Maximum when wielded by Voruna
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pe.zhText: 一次爆头击杀或在一次点射中 4 次爆头，增加 100% 弹药效率，持续 4 秒。Voruna 持有时，+24 弹药最大值

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ph.text: Alternate Fire charges a plasma bomb that releases 5 seeking projectiles on explosion. +4 Magazine Size when wielded by Revenant
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ph.zhText: 次要射击充能一个等离子炸弹，在爆炸时释放 5 个追踪投射物。Revenant 持有时，+4 弹匣容量

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ph.text: Headshots charge Incarnon Form. Alternate Fire transforms weapon into Incarnon Form of automatic heavy weapon
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ph.zhText: 爆头时为灵化充能。次要射击将武器转换为全自动重型武器的灵化形态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pr.text: Heavy Attack with 5x or more Combo Multiplier to transform weapon into Incarnon Form, increasing Range and Attack Speed
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pr.zhText: 当连击倍率达到 5x 或更多时，重击可以将武器转换为灵化形态，增加范围和攻击速度

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pr.text: Gain additional Status Chance per enemy hit with Slam attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pr.zhText: 使用震地攻击击中敌人时，每次击中敌人都会获得额外的触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pr.text: Enemies killed by Charged Shots become spectral allies for 7 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pr.zhText: 被蓄力射击杀死的敌人会成为魅影友军，持续 7 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pu.zhText: 自带 9 秒连击持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pu.text: Enemies killed by direct hits explode into lingering <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas clouds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pu.zhText: 直接命中击杀的敌人会爆炸并形成萦绕的 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气云

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pu.text: Gain Affinity to fill the New Loka meter and trigger a 25m <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive explosion, restoring 25% Health and increasing Max Health by +25% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Pu.zhText: 获得经验值以填充新世间计量条，并触发一个 25 米范围的 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀爆炸，恢复 25% 生命值并且增加 25% 最大生命值，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Py.text: Three kills within 2 seconds will summon a second Pyrana Prime for 6 seconds, granting doubled Magazine Size and +40% Fire Rate
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Py.zhText: 在 2 秒内击杀 3 次将召唤第二把食人鱼 Prime，持续 6 秒，弹匣容量加倍，射速 +40%

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.text: Alternate Fire launches energy cubes that explode after 8 seconds, or when hitting enemies. Shoot a cube to cause chain detonation with x4 Damage Bonus and 6m Radius
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.zhText: 次要射击发射能量方块，能量方块会在 8 秒后或命中敌人时爆炸。射击方块可引发连锁爆炸，造成 4 倍伤害加成，爆炸范围为 6 米

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.text: Heavy Attack throws daggers that deal guaranteed <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. The daggers are more accurate when wielded by Xaku
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.zhText: 重击投掷匕首必定触发 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。Xaku 持有时，匕首更加精准

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.text: Uses Auto firing mode when hip-firing, and Burst firing mode when aiming. Reloading from empty deals an <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status Effect to nearby enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.zhText: 腰射时为全自动射击模式，瞄准时为点射模式。从空弹匣重新装填时会对周围敌人造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.text: Alternate Fire charges a short range <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold blast capable of piercing enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Qu.zhText: 次要射击可以充能并发射能够穿透敌人的短距离 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻冲击波

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ra.text: When equipped, reduces enemy detection range by 25% for 30 seconds. Damage to enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Effect leeches 5% of the damage as shields
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ra.zhText: 装备时，敌人探测范围减少 25%，持续 30 秒。当敌人受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态影响时，对其造成的伤害中的 5% 会转化为护盾

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Re.text: Perfect reload grants a <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Magazine with shots that deal +25% Damage with guaranteed Status.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Re.zhText: 完美装填可使下一弹匣具有 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，射击增加 25% 伤害且必定触发异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ri.text: Reloading warps the Riot-848's bullets back into the pistol, causing a small explosion at their points of origin.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ri.zhText: 重新装填会使暴乱-848 的子弹重新回到手枪中，并在子弹起始点引发小型爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ru.text: Heavy Attack with 6x or more Combo Multiplier to transform weapon into Incarnon Form. Increases Range and converts all <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Damage to <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture at the cost of Max Attack Speed. In Incarnon Form, Heavy Slam attacks impale nearby enemies for 1s per Combo Multiplier.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ru.zhText: 当连击倍率达到 6x 或更多时，重击可以将武器转换为灵化形态。增加范围并以牺牲最高攻击速度为代价，将所有 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击伤害转化为 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺。在灵化形态下，每一个连击倍率会使重型震地攻击刺穿附近的敌人1 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_SM.text:
Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata and receive a blessing. 
Roll 1 for +|CRIT_CHANCE|% Final Critical Chance. 
Roll 2 for +|STATUS_CHANCE|% Final Status Chance. 
Roll 3 for +|STATUS_DAMAGE_AMOUNT|% Final Status Damage. 
Roll 4 for +|RANGE|m Range. 
Roll 5 for +|SPEED|% Attack Speed. 
Roll 6 for all blessings at once.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_SM.zhText:
天薙刀每命中 30 次，即可掷一次 Koumei 的骰子并获得祝福。 
掷出 1 可增加 |CRIT_CHANCE|% 最终暴击几率。 
掷出 2 可增加 |STATUS_CHANCE|% 最终触发几率。 
掷出 3 可增加 |STATUS_DAMAGE_AMOUNT|% 最终异常状态伤害。 
掷出 4 可增加 |RANGE| 米范围。 
掷出 5 可增加 |SPEED|% 攻击速度。 
掷出 6 则一次性赋予所有增益。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sa.text: Slam Attacks release eight explosions in a 40m line. Heavy Slam Attack release four explosions in a wide forward angle
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sa.zhText: 震地攻击在 40 米的直线上释放八次爆炸。重型震地攻击则在前方广角范围释放四次爆炸

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sa.text: Heavy Attack heals self and Allies within 15m for 5% of the damage done. Grants 20% Status Effect resistance while equipped
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sa.zhText: 重击可以根据造成伤害量的 5% 来治疗自己和 15 米范围内的友军。装备时，增加 20% 异常状态抗性

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sa.text: Heavy Slam Attack with Combo Multiplier of 8x or more to create a vortex that pulls in Lifted enemies. Only 5x Combo Multiplier needed when wielded by Voruna
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sa.zhText: 当连击倍率达到 8x 或更多时，重型震地攻击会产生一个漩涡，将被举起的敌人卷入其中。Voruna 持有时，只需要 5x 的连击倍率就能召唤漩涡

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sc.text: Alternate Fire throws speargun. Enemies within 14m of impact gain Bullet Attractors on their heads for 3 seconds. Effect pulses periodically for 20 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sc.zhText: 次要射击投掷标枪。落点 14 米范围内的敌人头上会产生子弹吸引效果，持续 3 秒。该效果会在 20 秒里定时重复

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sc.text: Alternate Fire lobs a webbed snare that damages, paralyzes, and groups up to 8 enemies within 15m. The number of enemies afflicted is multiplied with Multishot.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sc.zhText: 次要射击抛射出一张蛛网，对 15 米范围内的最多 8 名敌人造成伤害、麻痹和聚集。多重射击会使受影响的敌人数量成倍增加。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.text: Enemies killed drop up to 4x more Credits, scaling with Mastery Rank
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.zhText: 被击杀的敌人掉落多达 4 倍的现金，该效果根据精通段位而变化

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.text: Alternate Fire manually detonates all grenades. Gain Affinity to fill the Perrin Sequence meter and trigger a 25m <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation explosion, restoring 25% Shields and increasing Max Shield Capacity by +50% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.zhText: 次要射击可手动引爆所有榴弹。获得经验值以填充佩兰数列计量条，则会触发一个 25 米范围的 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射爆炸，恢复 25% 护盾并且增加 50% 最大护盾容量，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.text: Kills with Primary Fire charge up Alternate Fire, which targets up to 5 enemies with the reticle. Fire after lock-on to deploy homing explosive projectiles
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.zhText: 使用主要射击击杀敌人为次要射击充能，该模式可以在准星内锁定最多 5 个敌人。在锁定后射击会发射追踪型爆炸投射物

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.text: Gain Affinity to fill the Perrin Sequence meter and trigger a 25m <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation explosion, restoring 25% Shields and increasing Max Shield Capacity by +50% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Se.zhText: 获得经验值以填充佩兰数列计量条，并触发一个 25 米范围的 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射爆炸，恢复 25% 护盾并且增加 50% 最大护盾容量，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sh.text: Depleting Magazine creates a 20m explosion around the user, causing 100 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Damage and resetting Damage Adaptation on Sentients
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sh.zhText: 耗尽弹匣时，使用者周围会产生一个 20 米范围的爆炸，造成 100 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击伤害，并重置 Sentient 的伤害适应性

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.text: Heavy Attack grants +50% Status Chance for 4 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.zhText: 重击使触发几率 +50%，持续 4 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.text: Aerial attacks throw shield, making enemies vulnerable to Finishers
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.zhText: 空中攻击会投掷护盾，使敌人容易受到处决攻击

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.text: Blocking absorbs a charge that increase Critical Chance and Status Chance of next hit by +15%. Stacks up to 4 times
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.zhText: 格挡会吸收一次来袭的攻击，使下一次攻击的暴击几率和触发几率增加 15%。最多可叠加 4 层

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.text: Three or more nearby orbs can combine to create a vortex that pulls items and deals damage before exploding 20 seconds later. Shots fired through vortex gain increased <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage, Critical Chance and Critical Damage. Alternate Fire detonates all orbs
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Si.zhText: 当有三个或以上的球体靠近时，它们可以合并成一个旋涡，吸附物品并造成伤害，然后在 20 秒后爆炸。穿过旋涡的子弹，其 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害、暴击几率和暴击伤害都会增加。次要射击可引爆所有球体。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sk.text: Finishers turn the wielder invisible for 5 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sk.zhText: 处决攻击使持有者隐形 5 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sl.text: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects inflicted by Melee have +100% Status Duration
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sl.zhText: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>近战攻击造成的 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态，具有 +100% 异常状态持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.text: Alternate Fire charges a <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation explosive, consuming 20 ammo
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.zhText: 次要射击发射 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射爆炸，消耗 20 弹药

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.text: Projectile lasts 50% longer for each enemy hit. +40% Projectile Speed when wielded by Citrine
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.zhText: 每击中一个敌人，投射物的持续时间就会延长 50%。Citrine 持有时，+40% 投射物速度

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.text: Alternate Fire switches between Auto and Semi firing modes
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.zhText: 次要射击可在自动和半自动射击模式间切换

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.text:
Primary Fire shoots blobs that can combine up to 10 times, increasing damage and exploding. Alternate Fire charges a larger blob, consuming up to 10 ammo.

Alternate Fire activates Incarnon Form if the Incarnon Genesis is installed.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_St.zhText:
主要射击发射泡状物，这些泡状物可最多合并 10 个，从而增加伤害并爆炸。次要射击发射一个更大的泡状物，最多消耗 10 弹药。

如果安装了灵化，则次要射击将激活灵化形态。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sy.text: Heavy Attack launches shockwaves dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in a straight line
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sy.zhText: 重击发射冲击波，造成直线的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sy.text: Fatal strikes with this weapon perform a Codex Scan. Enemies killed by Heavy Attacks are recomposed as spectral allies for 30 seconds if their Codex entry is completed
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sy.zhText: 对一个敌人致死攻击同时也会进行资料库扫描。被重击击杀的敌人如果已被写入资料库，他们则会被改组为魅影友军，持续 30秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sy.text: Three or more nearby orbs can combine to create a vortex that pulls items and deals damage before exploding 20 seconds later. Shots fired through vortex gain increased <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage, Critical Chance and Critical Damage. Alternate Fire detonates all orbs. Gain Affinity to fill the Cephalon Suda meter and trigger a 25m <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic explosion, restoring 25% Energy and increasing Energy Max by +25% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Sy.zhText: 当有三个或以上的球体靠近时，它们可以合并成一个旋涡，吸附物品并造成伤害，然后在 20 秒后爆炸。穿过旋涡的子弹，其 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害、暴击几率和暴击伤害都会增加。次要射击可引爆所有球体。获得经验值以填充中枢苏达计量条，则会触发一个 25 米的 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力爆炸，恢复 25% 能量并且增加 25% 最大能量，持续 30 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ta.text: Heavy Attack hits in a wide area, inflicting <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Status Effect
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ta.zhText: 重击造成范围伤害，造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ta.text: Melee kills produce up to 5 charges that release on slide attack, homing and stunning enemies with <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage. Can store up to 9 charges when wielded by Revenant
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ta.zhText: 近战击杀产生最多 5 次充能，这些充能会在滑行攻击时释放，追踪并眩晕敌人，造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。 Revenant 持有时，可储存最多 9 次充能

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: +6% Status Chance when wielded by Atlas
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: Atlas 持有时，+6% 触发几率

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: +20% Parkour Velocity while equipped. Slide Attacks pull and stagger nearby enemies within 14m, and the next Slide Attack will Lift nearby enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 装备时，增加 20% 跑酷速度。滑行攻击拉近 14 米范围内的敌人并使他们失衡，下一次滑行攻击会附近的敌人浮空

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Heavy Attack shoots a projectile that travels 40m through enemies
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 重击会发射一个可穿越过敌人，飞行距离为 40 米的投射物

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Target up to 8 enemies by aiming, then fire to release 2 shots at each target. Reloads 10% of Magazine per second while holstered
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 瞄准时最多可以锁定 8 个敌人，随后开火可向每个目标发射 2 发子弹。当武器被收起时，每秒自动装填 10% 弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Aim to guide mid-air rockets. Reloads 10% of Magazine per second while holstered
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 瞄准以控制半空中的火箭。当武器被收起时，每秒自动装填 10% 弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Slam Attacks release three explosions in a 15m line. Heavy Slam Attacks release three explosions in a wide forward angle
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 震地攻击在 15 米的直线上释放三次爆炸。重型震地攻击则在前方广角范围释放三次爆炸

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Alternate Fire throws speargun, pulling in enemies within 10m every 2 seconds and dealing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage. Reloads 33% of Magazine per second while holstered
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 次要射击投掷标枪来拖近 10 米内的敌人，每 2 秒造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。当武器被收起时，每秒自动装填 33% 弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Heavy Slide Attack releases an energy disk that ricochets and travels further based on Combo Multiplier. Combo Duration paused while holstered
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 滑行重击释放一个能量盘，根据连击倍率，该圆盘会跳弹并飞得更远。当武器被收起时，暂停连击持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Blocking enemy attack has a 20% chance to increase block angle by 5 degrees. Stacks up to 5 times. Combo Duration paused while holstered
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 格挡敌人攻击有 20% 几率使格挡角度增加 5 度。最多可叠加 5 层。当武器被收起时，暂停连击持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Alternate Fire charges a shot that pulls in enemies within 6m before exploding
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 次要射击发射一颗充能子弹，在爆炸之前拉近 6 米范围内的敌人

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Landing a headshot increases Reload Speed by +25% for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 2 times
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 爆头时，增加 25% 装填速度，持续 4 秒。最多可叠加 2 层

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Alternate Fire launches explosive, consuming entire Magazine to increase damage dealt
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 次要射击发射爆炸物，消耗整个弹匣以增加造成的伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.text: Alternate Fire charges a single Charge shot that uses 10 ammo. 20% chance to instantly refill Magazine upon Alternate Fire headshot when wielded by Octavia
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Te.zhText: 次要射击可消耗 10 发弹药进行一次充能射击。Octavia 持有时，使用次要射击爆头有 20% 几率立即装填弹匣

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Th.text: Heavy Attack with 6x or more Combo Multiplier to transform weapon into Incarnon Form. Attacks embed Void shards in enemies. Each time a new shard is created, existing shards deal 75% of weapon damage to embedded foes.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Th.zhText: 当连击倍率达到 6 倍或更高时，重击可将武器转化为灵化形态。攻击会将虚空碎片嵌入敌人体内。每次生成新的碎片时，现有碎片都会对嵌入的敌人造成 75% 的武器伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ti.text: Alternate Fire switches between Burst, Semi, and Auto firing modes
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ti.zhText: 次要射击可在点射、半自动和全自动模式间切换

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Tn.text: After 10 kills, gains +50% Follow Through and +100% Status Chance for the next 10 attacks. Gain 6 health per active Status Effect on struck enemies when wielded by Dagath
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Tn.zhText: 完成 10 次击杀后，接下来的 10 次攻击增加 50% 伤害穿透系数和 100% 触发几率。Dagath 持有时，每击中一个带有异常状态的敌人可以恢复 6 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_To.text: Increasing Combo Multiplier grants +4% <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage for 15s. Stacks up to 30 times
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_To.zhText: 增加连击倍率可获得 4% <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，持续 15 秒。最多可叠加 30 层
震地攻击可造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Tr.text: Kills with Primary Fire charge up Alternate Fire, which releases a bouncing projectile that explodes on contact
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Tr.zhText: 使用主要射击击杀敌人为次要射击充能，次要射击发射一枚触碰即爆的弹跳投射物

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Tr.text: Gain Affinity to fill the Arbiters of Hexis meter and trigger a 25m <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas explosion, restoring 25% Health and increasing Parkour Velocity by +25% for 30 seconds
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Tr.zhText: 获得经验值以填充均衡仲裁者计量条，并触发一个 25 米范围的 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气爆炸，恢复 25% 生命值并且增加 25% 跑酷速度，持续 30 秒

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Va.text: Creates a conductive area around the target, with a chance to spawn up to 3 lightning strikes on random nearby targets. Strike damage scales with mods.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Va.zhText: 在目标周围创建一个导电区域，有几率对附近随机目标施放最多 3 次闪电打击。打击伤害随 Mod 效果提升。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Va.text: Block attacks to store Blind Charges. At 15 charges, a Heavy Attack while blocking will blind nearby enemies. +50% knockdown resistance while equipped
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Va.zhText: 格挡攻击为致盲充能。充能 15 次后，在格挡时进行重击将致盲附近的敌人。装备时，增加 50% 击倒抗性

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.text: +50% Reload Speed when Magazine is emptied. Innate 20% Ammo Efficiency. Gains an additional +20% Ammo Efficiency when wielded by Protea
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.zhText: 弹匣清空时，增加 50% 装填速度。自带 20% 弹药效率。Protea 持有时，增加额外 20% 弹药效率

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.text: +50% Additional Combo Count Chance when wielded by Caliban
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.zhText: Caliban 持有时，增加 50% 额外连击数几率

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.text: On Status Effect: Inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. +50% Additional Combo Count Chance when wielded by Caliban
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.zhText: 触发异常状态时：造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态。Caliban 持有时，增加 50% 额外连击数几率
自带 13x 最大连击倍率

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.text: Aiming activates a laser sight that highlights enemy Weak Points and grants +40% Critical Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ve.zhText: 瞄准会激活激光瞄准器，突出显示敌人的弱点并增加 40% 的暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Vi.text: Aerial Attack during Aim Glide launches projectile that glasses enemies for 7 seconds. Slam Attacks fires projectile that shatters glassed enemies. Innate 10 second Combo Duration
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Vi.zhText: 处于飞身瞄准时的空中攻击会发射投射物，使敌人玻璃化 7 秒。震地攻击发射可击碎玻璃化敌人的投射物。自带 10 秒连击持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Vo.text: +100% radial Slam Attack damage when wielded by Gara
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Vo.zhText: Gara 持有时，增加 100% 震地攻击范围伤害

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Wr.text: Gain additional Critical Chance per enemy hit with Slam attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Wr.zhText: 使用震地攻击击中敌人时，每次击中敌人都会获得额外的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Xo.text: Infinite Combo Duration. In the Granum Void, Charged Throw explosions convert Errant Specters into Specter Particle charges. Detonating with three charges increases explosion size, freeing prisoners and increasing Void timer
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Xo.zhText: 无限连击持续时间。在格拉努虚空中，蓄力投掷的爆炸会将游荡魅影转化为魅影粒子充能。当有三次充能引爆时，增加爆炸范围，释放囚犯并增加虚空计时

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Za.text: <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas clouds stagger enemies, making them vulnerable to Finishers
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Za.zhText: <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气云使敌人失衡，并使他们更易受到处决攻击

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Za.text: Alternate Fire switches between Cannon and Barrage firing modes
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Za.zhText: 次要射击可在发射炮弹和弹幕开火模式间切换

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ze.text: Heavy Attack shoots a floating disk, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in a 4m radius. Disk lasts for 10 seconds, increased by Combo Multiplier
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ze.zhText: 重击发射一个悬浮的圆盘，对 4 米范围内造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。圆盘持续 10 秒，并会随着连击倍率延长存续时间

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ze.text: Alternate Fire launches disk that highlights enemy heads within 20m. While active, weapon becomes semi-automatic and has infinite Punch Through. Resets on Reload
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Ze.zhText: 次要射击发射圆盘，突显 20 米内的敌人头部。在此效果下，武器变为半自动并具有无限穿透。重新装填后重置该效果。

/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Zh.text: +50% Reload Speed when Magazine is emptied
/Lotus/Language/Loadout/WeaponPassive_Zh.zhText: 弹匣清空时，增加 50% 装填速度

/Lotus/Language/Locations/CeresDesc.text: The Grineer have expanded their empire into this region.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/CeresDesc.zhText: Grineer 把他们的帝国扩展到了这里。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/DojoDesc.text: Your clan is building a hidden fortress on the periphery of the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/DojoDesc.zhText: 你的氏族已经于始源星系的外环建造了一座隐匿的堡垒。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/EarthDesc.text: A desolate, ruined world. Home of the oppressive Grineer Empire.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/EarthDesc.zhText: Grineer 帝国的根据地，一个只剩下颓垣败瓦的荒芜世界。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/ErisDesc.text: Rapid Corpus expansion has led them to build outposts in this far flung sector of the system.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/ErisDesc.zhText: Corpus 迅速发展，使他们在这个偏远的星系建立前哨基地。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/EuropaDesc.text: This deep space outpost is traditionally home to The Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/EuropaDesc.zhText: Corpus 的据点正被 Infested 慢慢侵占而去。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/GlassmakerBoss.text: Use this key to enter Nihil's Oubliette and fight him again. Requires Nihil's Oubliette to be placed in the Orbiter. Victories against Nihil will consume the key and unlock one of his lost treasures.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/GlassmakerBoss.zhText: 使用此密钥来进入无刹的密牢，并再次与他展开战斗。在此之前，需要先将"无刹的密牢"放置在轨道飞行器上。胜利击败无刹将会消耗此密钥，并解锁他其中的一件失落宝物。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/JupiterDesc.text: Once overrun by the Infestation, The Corpus are now exploiting Jupiter for its vast deposits of rare gases.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/JupiterDesc.zhText: Infestation 被赶出之后，Corpus 现在为了木星的大量稀有气体在此进行开发。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/MarsDesc.text: Corpus salvage ships pick through the fragments of Orokin Derelicts here.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/MarsDesc.zhText: Corpus 打捞船在这里采集奥罗金遗迹的碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/MercuryDesc.text: The only remaining Orokin Towers are hidden here. The Grineer patrol this area to prevent Tenno incursion.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/MercuryDesc.zhText: 只剩下奥罗金塔被隐藏在这里。Grineer 巡逻这个地区，以防止 Tenno 侵入。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/NemesisShowdow.zhText: 科技细胞终幕者演唱会

/Lotus/Language/Locations/NeptuneDesc.text: Home of the Corpus and site of their indoctrination temples. Warframe and Robotics R&D hidden here.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/NeptuneDesc.zhText: Corpus 的根据地、洗脑教育圣堂所在之处。关于战甲和机器人的各种研发都在此处秘密进行。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/PhobosDesc.text: The Grineer have occupied the abandoned settlements here.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/PhobosDesc.zhText: Grineer 已经占据这里废弃的殖民地。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/PlutoDesc.text: The shattered Outer Terminus of the Solar Rail Network is located here. The Corpus work to rebuild it.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/PlutoDesc.zhText: 太阳系航道网的外总站残骸位于此处。Corpus 正在尝试重建它。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationDe.text: Join us in the relay at 2pm EST for a special community event!
/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationDe.zhText: 在美东夏令时间下午 2 点造访中继站，来参加一场特别的玩家社区活动！

/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationTe.zhText: Baro 的 TennoCon 中继站

/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationTe.text: Unite with fellow Tenno across the Origin System for TennoCon 2026! Visit Baro Ki'Teer and shop his entire inventory of goods for a limited time. Only TennoCon 2026 Digital Pack holders may enter.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationTe.zhText: 与整个始源星系的 Tenno 伙伴一起参与到 TennoCon 2026 来！在限定时间内拜访 Baro Ki'Teer，购买他的所有商品。只有持有 TennoCon 2026 虚拟礼包的玩家可以参与。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationTe.text: The time has finally come! Join us for TennoLive 2026 as we unveil Warframe's next big chapter. Open to all Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/RelayStationTe.zhText: 时机终于到来！欢迎参加《TennoLive 2026》，揭秘《Warframe》的下一个重要篇章。面向所有 Tenno 开放。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/SaturnDesc.text: A Grineer stronghold with well-protected shipping lanes and training orbiters for their Elite troops.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/SaturnDesc.zhText: 这是 Grineer 的一个据点！每条航道都有惊人的防御力量，精英部队更是拥有训练飞船来强化他们的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/SednaDesc.text: The Grineer have expanded their empire into this region.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/SednaDesc.zhText: Grineer 把他们的帝国扩展到了这里。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/UranusDesc.text: Remote Grineer bases focus on research and development of bio-modification and gene repair.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/UranusDesc.zhText: 在遥远的 Grineer 基地里，Grineer 正在全力研究著生物改造和基因修复。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/VenusDesc.text: The Corpus have focused their manufacturing facilities in this area.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/VenusDesc.zhText: Corpus 将他们的生产设备集中于这个区域。

/Lotus/Language/Locations/VoidDesc.text: Ancient Orokin places are hidden here.
/Lotus/Language/Locations/VoidDesc.zhText: 上古奥罗金地点隐藏于此。

/Lotus/Language/Login/AndroidLoginCancel.text: Login cancelled, no account was selected or an error occurred.
/Lotus/Language/Login/AndroidLoginCancel.zhText: 登录已取消，未选择账号或发生错误。

/Lotus/Language/Login/BindingNoCredentia.text: To link an account with no specified email address, add an email and password through |MANAGEMENT|
/Lotus/Language/Login/BindingNoCredentia.zhText: 要绑定没有电子邮箱的账号，请通过|MANAGEMENT|添加电子邮箱和密码

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicAuthFailed.text: Error: EE03. There was an issue signing in with Epic. Please try relaunching the game.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicAuthFailed.zhText: 错误：EE03。使用 Epic 登录时出现问题。请尝试重新启动游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicBindingRequire.text: Epic account binding cannot be completed on unprotected accounts. Please go to warframe.com and enable Two-Factor Authentication on your account to allow binding.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicBindingRequire.zhText: Epic 账号绑定无法在未受保护的账号上进行。请前往 warframe.com 并在您的账号上开启双重验证以进行绑定。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicBindingSuccess.zhText: 已成功绑定 Epic 账号

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicCreateBindingT.text: You will create a |OPEN_BOLD|New Warframe|CLOSE_BOLD| account linked to your Epic account |OPEN_BOLD||EPIC_ACCOUNT||CLOSE_BOLD|. The link |OPEN_BOLD|cannot be undone|CLOSE_BOLD|.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicCreateBindingT.zhText: 此过程将创建一个用于与您的 Epic 账号 |OPEN_BOLD||EPIC_ACCOUNT||CLOSE_BOLD| 绑定的|OPEN_BOLD|新 Warframe|CLOSE_BOLD| 账号。一旦绑定|OPEN_BOLD|将无法撤销|CLOSE_BOLD|。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicExistingBindin.text:
Login to the |OPEN_BOLD|Warframe|CLOSE_BOLD| account you want to link to your Epic account |OPEN_BOLD||EPIC_ACCOUNT||CLOSE_BOLD|. Make sure you are linking the correct accounts, as the link |OPEN_BOLD|cannot be undone|CLOSE_BOLD|. 
Two-Factor Authentication required.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicExistingBindin.zhText:
登录您想要与您的 Epic 账号 |OPEN_BOLD||EPIC_ACCOUNT||CLOSE_BOLD| 绑定的 |OPEN_BOLD|Warframe|CLOSE_BOLD| 账号。请确认您绑定的是正确的账号，一旦绑定|OPEN_BOLD|将无法撤销|CLOSE_BOLD|。 
需要先启用双重验证。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicGenericAccount.text: Error: EE04. There was an issue with creating your Warframe account. Please try again.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicGenericAccount.zhText: 错误：EE04。创建您的 Warframe 账号时出现问题。请重试。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicGenericExistin.text: Error: EE05. There was an issue with binding your Epic and Warframe account. Please try again.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicGenericExistin.zhText: 错误：EE05。将您的 Epic 和 Warframe 账号绑定时出现问题。请重试。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.text: Error: EE08. Your Warframe account already has a Epic account bounded
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.zhText: 错误：EE08。您的 Warframe 账号已绑定 Epic 账号

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.text: Error: EE02. We are unable to create your Warframe account. Your Epic account is already linked to a different Warframe account.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.zhText: 错误：EE02。我们无法为您创建 Warframe 账号。您的 Epic 账号已绑定到其它 Warframe 账号。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.text: Error: EE07. We are unable to link your Warframe account to this Epic account. Your Epic account is already bounded to a different Warframe account.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.zhText: 错误：EE07。我们无法将您的 Warframe 账号绑定到此 Epic 账号。您的 Epic 账号已绑定到其它 Warframe 账号。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.text: Error: EE06. We are unable to link your Warframe account to this Epic account. Your account already has a different Epic Account linked.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdAlreadyBound.zhText: 错误：EE06。我们无法将您的 Warframe 账号绑定到此 Epic 账号。您的账号已绑定到其它 Epic 账号。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdMismatch.text: Error: EE09. Purchase attempt failed. This Epic account does not match the Epic account bound to this Warframe account.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicIdMismatch.zhText: 错误：EE09。购买尝试失败。当前 Epic 账号与绑定至此 Warframe 账号上的 Epic 账号不匹配。

/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicNoAccountFound.text: You can bind your existing Warframe account or create a new Warframe Account to start your journey.
/Lotus/Language/Login/EpicNoAccountFound.zhText: 您可以绑定现有的 Warframe 账号，也可以创建一个新的 Warframe 账号来开始您的旅程。

/Lotus/Language/Login/LoginBalanceRectif.text: Your account balance has been rectified. Login again to continue.
/Lotus/Language/Login/LoginBalanceRectif.zhText: 您的账号余额已恢复正常。请重新登录以继续游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Login/LoginFailedNegativ.text: Your account access has been restricted due to a negative premium currency balance (|NEGATIVE_CURRENCIES|). Please contact support for assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Login/LoginFailedNegativ.zhText: 您的账号因高级货币余额为负（|NEGATIVE_CURRENCIES|）已被限制访问。请联系客服寻求帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Login/LoginFailedNegativ.text: Your account access has been restricted due to a negative premium currency balance on another platform (|NEGATIVE_CURRENCIES|). Please contact support for assistance.

/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/DOpenCin0070.zhText: 你说的"是我"，这是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/PostQuestInb.text:
Tenno,

None of us could hear the Device that was calling from the abyss of history. The Daughter of Hunhow heard it, and almost succumbed to its call. She raised her voice in song to drown it out, and that we did hear.

I should have known she was waiting for you.

You answered a call and in a way, found an answer. For me. The time is almost right to finish the Kalymos Sequence. 

I will soon be able to send you to the city-state of Höllvania, in the plague year of 1999 - a most perilous time. Without your equipment, you would surely perish. 

Luckily, the Vessels have a connection to Albrecht's "volunteers" that I believe I can exploit. You will not arrive unarmed, nor unarmored. 

We won't be late! 

Loid
/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/PostQuestInb.zhText:
Tenno，

我们无人能听见那来自历史深渊的装置的呼唤。但 Hunhow 的女儿听到了，差点被其吸引。她用歌声掩盖了呼唤，而我们听见了她的声音。

我早该知道她在等你。

你回应了那个呼唤，也以某种方式，为我，找到了答案。完成卡利莫斯序列的时刻快要到了。 

我很快就能把你送到霍瓦尼亚市了，那是瘟疫肆虐的 1999 年，那是一个极其险恶的时代。如果没有你的装备，你肯定会丧命。 

幸运的是，承载者与阿尔布雷希特的"志愿者"有某种联系，我相信我可以利用这一点。你到达时，你将不会手无寸铁，也不会身无铠甲。 

我们不会晚！ 

洛德

/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/QuestComplet.text: The link to the past is forged, but time is running out. While Loid works tirelessly and the Lotus keeps her lonely vigil, step by step the Indifference draws closer to its coveted prey.
/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/QuestComplet.zhText: 通往过去的联系已建立，但时间所剩无几。当洛德在不知疲倦地工作时，Lotus 仍独自守望，而虚空无情之物正一步步逼近它所垂涎的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/QuestDesc.text: A strange call comes from beyond and must not go unanswered.
/Lotus/Language/LotusEaters/QuestDesc.zhText: 奇异的呼唤从远方传来，不能置之不理。
