/Lotus/Language/Menu/MainMenu_ReferedPla.text:
Welcome Tenno!

We need your help to fight the Grineer and reclaim the Origin System! Your friend referral has given you an extra advantage. I have added a 7-day Affinity Booster to your Arsenal. This will double the rate that you earn Affinity in the game, helping you upgrade your weapons and Warframes faster.

Your first mission is at the E Prime node on Earth, found on your Star Chart. That will be the only mission available to you until you successfully complete it. As you complete more missions, you will soon unlock new regions of space to explore.

Be diligent, Tenno!

The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/Menu/MainMenu_ReferedPla.zhText:
Tenno，欢迎！

我们需要你的协助来对抗 Grineer，解放始源星系！由于你的好友的引荐，你已经获得额外的优势了。我已经添加了一个 7 天经验值加成到你的军械库。这将让你在游戏内以双倍的速率来获取经验，帮助你以更快的速度提升你的武器和战甲。

你的第一项任务是位于地球的 E Prime 节点，你可以在星图导航上找到它。在成功完成这项任务后，你才可以进行其它任务，而在完成更多任务后，你就可以解锁新的星区并进行探索。

加油努力吧，Tenno！

Lotus

/Lotus/Language/Menu/MeleeUpdateChanges_.text:
Tenno - your favorite melee weapon probably feels a little different today. Today we bring you Phase 1 of 2019's melee upgrade - we hope you love all the gorgeous new visual effects, streamlined combat, and high fidelity hit reactions!

|OPEN_COLOR|Here's what you can expect:|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|Let The Gun & Blade Flow|CLOSE_COLOR|
Swap between your gun and melee at the press of a button, no holstering required! Combos can be executed and resumed between movement and more. Blocking is now automatic in melee mode when aiming at an attacking enemy. Your stance combos may have changed, check out the Stance interface!

|OPEN_COLOR|Death From Above|CLOSE_COLOR|
A Tenno is a master of aerial tactics - now you can better target enemies on the ground with deadly and responsive aimed ground slams. 

|OPEN_COLOR|Effects Upgrades|CLOSE_COLOR|
We've done a complete overhaul of all Melee Effects! Hit animations, elemental effects and slam attacks: making melee look as good as it feels!

|OPEN_COLOR|More to Come|CLOSE_COLOR|
Fundamentally, we aim to upgrade Melee. This is Phase 1.

No one knows the power of their Arsenal better than the Tenno - your adaptability and skill with the blade will be tested, and as we continue these changes, we rely on your feedback!
/Lotus/Language/Menu/MeleeUpdateChanges_.zhText:
Tenno - 你最喜欢的近战武器今天可能会有点不同。今天我们给你带来了 2019 年近战升级的第一阶段 - 我们希望你喜欢这些华丽的新版视觉特效，流畅战斗和高真实度的击中反馈！

|OPEN_COLOR|这是你能够期待到的是：|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|让枪与刃流动起来|CLOSE_COLOR|
只需按一下按键，即可在枪和近战之间切换，无需进行收枪操作！连击可以在移动和其它的行动之间进行和继续。在近战模式中瞄准攻击你的敌人时，格挡是会自动触发的。你的架式组合可能进行了更改，记得查看架式界面来了解！

|OPEN_COLOR|死从天降|CLOSE_COLOR|
Tenno 是空中战术的大师 - 现在你可以更好地瞄准地面上的敌人，发起致命且灵敏的震地攻击。

|OPEN_COLOR|特效升级|CLOSE_COLOR|
我们对所有近战特效进行了彻底的翻修！击中动画，元素特效和震地攻击：让近战看起来和感觉上一样好！

|OPEN_COLOR|更多精彩内容即将到来|CLOSE_COLOR|
根本上来说，我们的目的是升级近战设定。这是第一阶段。

没有人比 Tenno 更了解他们军械库中的力量 - 你的适应性和用刃技能将得到测试，并且我们也会继续进行改动，不过这就要依靠你的反馈了！

/Lotus/Language/Menu/ToxicityAutoMessage.text:
Operator, 

Ordis has noticed that the odorous fur ball you call |PET_NAME| has been neglected for quite some time.

A well-cared-for pet will be a strong and loyal ally in battle. A neglected one… much less so. A DNA Stabilizer and a little attention will go a long way.

Your loyal Cephalon,
Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Menu/ToxicityAutoMessage.zhText:
指挥官，

Ordis 发现您那只叫作 |PET_NAME| 的臭毛球已经被冷落一段时间了。

被精心照顾的宠物会成为您在战斗中强大且忠心的盟友。可一个无人照顾的……就不是这么回事了。一个 DNA 稳定剂外加一点点的关心会大有帮助。

您忠诚的中枢， 
-Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Menu/ToxicityAutoStasisM.text:
Operator,

Due to a period of extended neglect, |PET_NAME| has been placed in stasis.

You may revive the odorous fur ball at your convenience.

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Menu/ToxicityAutoStasisM.zhText:
指挥官，

由于长时间的无人照管，|PET_NAME| 已被放入冷冻睡眠舱。

您可以在任何时候取出那只香香的毛球。

－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Menu/ToxicityDeathMessag.text:
Operator,

Terrible news, |PET_NAME| has died. Internal deterioration caused by lack of DNA Stabilization eventually turned fatal. 

Ordis has taken the liberty of ejecting its remains into space. The incubator is now free, should you wish to raise another pet. Ordis hopes you will.

Ordis, Ship's Cephalon
/Lotus/Language/Menu/ToxicityDeathMessag.zhText:
指挥官，

可怕的消息，|PET_NAME|死了。由于缺乏DNA 稳定性而引起基因恶化，最终导致死亡。

Ordis 已经将遗体自由弹射送入太空。如果您想要再养其它宠物，现在孵化器已经有空位了。Ordis 希望您会的。

Ordis，船的中枢

/Lotus/Language/Menu/UpdateChanges_Thank.text:
|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|UPDATE 24|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|
|OPEN_BOLD|FORTUNA IS HERE!|CLOSE_BOLD|

It's been one year since we added our first open world - |OPEN_COLOR|Plains of Eidolon.|CLOSE_COLOR| Our second world is ready: |OPEN_COLOR|Orb Vallis|CLOSE_COLOR|.

Entering |OPEN_COLOR|Orb Vallis|CLOSE_COLOR| requires you first to visit |OPEN_COLOR|Fortuna|CLOSE_COLOR| - a town full of new characters, new content, and new problems to solve! To do this - you'll first have to reach Venus!

Reach Venus!? Our veteran Tenno have had Venus unlocked for years - it's time to go back. Maybe you've played long enough to remember our first 'planet' procedural tileset on Venus and the excitement at the time.

New players might only be making their way there now - with determination and cooperation, you'll master the challenges of |OPEN_COLOR|Orb Vallis|CLOSE_COLOR| in no time.

Enjoy the efforts of all of us at Digital Extremes delivered here in Fortuna. Your patience, support, excitement, and feedback has made this update possible. We dedicate it to you.

Stay warm on your K-Drives, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Menu/UpdateChanges_Thank.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|更新 24|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR|
|OPEN_BOLD|福尔图娜来了！|CLOSE_BOLD|

自我们推出的第一个开放世界－ |OPEN_COLOR|夜灵平野。|CLOSE_COLOR| 至今已有一年了，而现在第二个世界正等着你： |OPEN_COLOR|奥布山谷|CLOSE_COLOR|。

要进入 |OPEN_COLOR|奥布山谷|CLOSE_COLOR| 必须先探访 |OPEN_COLOR|福尔图娜|CLOSE_COLOR| - 一座充满了新角色、新内容和新麻烦任务要解决的城市！为此——你必须先抵达金星！

抵达金星了？当然，我们的 Tenno 老手们早在多年前就解锁了金星——是时候重访旧地了。也许你玩得够久，知道我们是何时在金星推出「星球」地形，在当时那可真是个开创性的决定。现在我们 Digital Extremes 全员再次倾尽全力推出了福尔图娜。

新进玩家们得自行努力——靠着毅力与合作，你便能战胜 |OPEN_COLOR|奥布山谷|CLOSE_COLOR| 中的各种挑战。

请享受 Digital Extremes 全体成员在福尔图娜更新中努力制作的内容。你的耐心、支持、激动以及回馈让这一切得以实现，在此献上本更新。

玩 K 式悬浮板时注意保暖喔，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Menu/UpdateChanges_Thank.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|We all lift together.|CLOSE_COLOR|
- DE and the Warframe Team
/Lotus/Language/Menu/UpdateChanges_Thank.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|我们共度时艰。|CLOSE_COLOR|
- DE 以及 Warframe 团队

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.text:
Operator,

Enemies from all factions are targeting supply shipments meant for our 6th Cycle Celebration. We cannot allow them to take these from us. The Lotus would want you to have them.

- Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.zhText:
指挥官，

所有派系的敌军都瞄上了我们第 6 届周期庆典的补给物资。我们绝不能允许它们从我们这抢走这些物资。Lotus 希望你能收下它们。

- Ordis
Lotus 的馈赠 - 被窃取！

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Corpus greed was true to form, but you continue to fight for truth and honor.

Please, take a copy of this Dex Furis, as my gift to you.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Corpus 为了利益战斗，而你是为真理和荣誉而战。

请收下这把 Dex 盗贼作为我为你送上的礼物。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

The Infested were no match for your resilience and strength. You have learned much.

Please enjoy this Dex Dakra.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

强悍如 Infested 也无法与你的坚韧和力量比肩。你成长了许多。

请好好享受这对 Dex 达克拉双剑。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

As long as The Grineer stand for tyranny, you will fight for justice. 

Use this Dex Sybaris to bring justice to the entire system.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

只要 Grineer 仍推行暴政，你就会为正义而战。 

使用这把 Dex 席芭莉丝来为整个星系伸张正义。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

On this, the anniversary of your awakening, the countless hordes of the Void’s corrupted could not stand against you.

Wear this Dex Nouchali Syandana with pride and also take this Kavat Genetic Code..

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

在这纪念你苏醒的神圣日子里，即便是面对无数虚空堕落者的大军，你也全胜而归。

自豪地穿戴上这件 Dex 延药睡莲披饰，并带上这张库娃遗传密码。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|, 

Another Grineer Defector has been brought to safety. 

Take this Excalibur Dex Skin and Omni Forma. They are yours. 

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2019.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|， 

又一个 Grineer 叛逃者已被安全救出。 

收下这个 Excalibur Dex 外观和全能 Forma。它们都属于你了。 

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 — Dex 浮印

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.text:
You did not think Ordis had forgotten the date, did you? Ordis would do no such thing! This is the month of our seventh anniversary together!

Every week the rails are alive with chatter of strange new items appearing. Ordis expects exciting (and profitable) things to happen this month!

Happy 7th anniversary, Operator. Ordis chose this for you, just for the occasion, and cannot wait to see you in it.

Your loyal Cephalon,

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.zhText:
您不会认为 Ordis 真的忘记这个日子了，对吧？Ordis 怎么会做出如此之事！这个月是我们在一起的七周年纪念。

每个星期，航道都会处于忙碌状态，许多新奇事物也会随之出现。Ordis 期待这个月能有一些激动人心（并且有利可图）的事情发生！

七周年纪念快乐，指挥官。Ordis 只是为了应景而替您做出了选择，并且迫不及待地想看到您穿上它。

您忠诚的中枢，

— Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Your resilience knows no bounds. Please, take this Excalibur Dex Noggle and this Smoking Body Ephemera, as my gifts to you. 

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

你的确坚韧不拔。请收下这个 Excalibur Dex 摇头娃娃和烟雾之躯幻纹，作为我送给你的礼物。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

This Liset Dex Skin is yours. Display it proudly as you swoop into the next battle.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

这个 Liset Dex 外观是你的了。在下次俯冲进战场时，自豪地展示它吧。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

The Infested were no match for your fierce tenacity. Please enjoy this Dex Glyph. 

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2020.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

强悍如 Infested 也无法与你的坚韧和力量比肩。请好好享受这个 Dex 浮印。 

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.text: Gift of the Lotus – Rhino Dex Skin
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 — Rhino Dex 外观

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.text: Gift of the Lotus – Wisp Dex Skin and Companion Slots
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.zhText: Lotus 的馈赠 — Wisp Dex 外观和同伴槽位

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

You have proven yourself relentless in the face of the unceasing Infested horde.

Wear this Dex Rhino Skin to show our enemies you will never give up.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你在无休无止来袭的 Infested 大军面前，证明了自己对敌人的毫不留情。

穿上这款 Rhino Dex 外观来让你的对手知道你决不会放弃。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Your recent actions have caused uproar in AnyoCorp. The Index is in chaos.

There has been talk of a 'clash of giants' and 'legends colliding'.

What this means I am unsure. But any blow struck against the Corpus is a step forward for us. 

This Wisp Dex Skin seems an appropriate reward, along with some additional Companion capacity.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2022.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你近期的行动在安尤企业引起了轩然大波。《指数之场》也因此陷入混乱。

人们在谈论"巨人之战"和"传奇交锋"。

这意味着什么，我不确定。然而，对 Corpus 造成的任何打击对我们来说都是向前迈进一步。

这款 Wisp Dex 外观似乎是一个合适的奖励，另外还有一些额外的同伴槽位。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Your strength is truly remarkable. Please take the Operator and Drifter Dex Suits in celebration of how far you have come.

Many battles lie ahead, but we will face them together.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你的力量十分惊人，为了纪念你的成就，请收下这件指挥官与漂泊者 Dex 套服。

斗争尚未结束，但我们会一同面对。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

As long as The Grineer stand for tyranny, you will fight for justice.

Take this Excalibur Dex Skin, and wear it as a symbol of your resolve.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

只要 Grineer 仍推行暴政，你就会为正义而战。 

收下这个 Excalibur Dex 外观，并穿上它来以表你的决心。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Corpus greed was true to form, but you continue to fight for truth and honor.

Please take this Excalibur Dex Noggle as my gift to you.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

Corpus 为了利益战斗，而你是为真理和荣誉而战。

请收下这尊 Excalibur Dex 摇头娃娃，作为我为你送上的礼物。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Your resilience knows no bounds. Please take this Exilus Weapon Adapter as my gift to you. 

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

你的确坚韧不拔。请收下这个武器特殊功能槽连接器，作为我送给你的礼物。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

The Corpus were no match for your fierce tenacity. Please enjoy this Umbra Forma Blueprint.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

强悍如 Corpus 也无法与你的坚韧和力量比肩。请好好享受这个 Umbra Forma 蓝图。 

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

This Wisp Dex Skin is rightfully yours. Wear it proudly.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

这款 Wisp Dex 外观理应属于你。自豪地穿上它。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

On this, the anniversary of your awakening, the countless hordes of the Void's corrupted could not stand against you.

Wear this Dex Nouchali Syandana with pride.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

在这纪念你苏醒的神圣日子里，即便是面对无数虚空堕落者的大军，你也全胜而归。

自豪地穿戴上这件 Dex 延药睡莲披饰吧。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Once more, you have shown the Grineer the repercussions of their cruelty.

Take the Dex Raksaka Armor set and these Kavat Genetic Codes. They are yours.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2024.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

你再一次让 Grineer 见识到了他们残忍行为造成的后果。

收下 Dex 守护者护甲和库娃遗传密码。它们是你的了。

|LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Messages/Anniversary2025.text:

/Lotus/Language/Messages/DisruptionEvent.text:
Operators,

|CLAN_NAME| inflicted maximum disruption to Alad V's Amalgam laboratory. In doing so you robbed him of resources and strained relations with his Sentient partners.

Ordis has taken the liberty of commissioning this statue. Surely it will become the focal point of whatever room you place it in.

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Messages/DisruptionEvent.zhText:
指挥官，

|CLAN_NAME| 对阿拉德 V 的并合实验室造成了极大的破坏。您这样做剥夺了他的资源，并使他与 Sentient 合伙人的关系紧张起来了。

Ordis 已经铸造好了这座雕像。无论您把它放在哪个房间，它都会成为焦点。

您忠诚的中枢，
-Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Messages/EidolonCollecti.text:
You have searched long and hard to find all my fish. Yet, your success was always known. Will you discover the secrets within them, the layer hidden? To honor your achievement, The Quills bestow this statuette upon you.

-Onkko
/Lotus/Language/Messages/EidolonCollecti.zhText:
你历经万难找到了我所有的鱼。然而，你的成功一直为人所知。你可以发现其中更深的奥秘吗，那隐藏的一层？为了纪念你的成就，夜羽授予你这尊雕像。

——昂克

/Lotus/Language/Messages/ExtractionRequi.text: Complete Bounty objectives to unlock extraction
/Lotus/Language/Messages/ExtractionRequi.zhText: 完成赏金目标来解锁撤离点

/Lotus/Language/Messages/GalleonRobbery2.text:
Regret not, maggot. The galleon you raided was headed to an Ostron Floating Market near Earth. The Ghouls would have slaughtered every last one of those filthy peasants. And I know that would make you SAD.

More instigators hide in the shadows. Bring them to me before they become a problem for you. 

For motivation, take this blueprint. It uses parts you will recover while capturing Ghouls.
/Lotus/Language/Messages/GalleonRobbery2.zhText:
不要后悔，蛆虫。你袭击的那艘帆船战舰是前往地球附近 Ostron 的浮空市集。尸鬼会把那些肮脏的贱民一个不留地屠杀干净。我知道那会让你很难过。

还有更多的煽动者隐藏在暗处。在他们成为你的麻烦之前把他们带到我这里来。 

以这个蓝图为动力吧。它需要的部件你会在捕获尸鬼时找到。

/Lotus/Language/Messages/GalleonRobbery2.text:
Your hunger for weapons is pathetically reliable. Have another blueprint, you ravenous worm.

The instigator Ghouls run, but they still scheme. Fill their rotting hearts with regret, and their flesh with shrapnel.
/Lotus/Language/Messages/GalleonRobbery2.zhText:
你对武器的渴求可悲得一如既往。再来一张蓝图吧，你这贪婪的蠕虫。

煽动者尸鬼逃跑了，但他们仍在密谋。要让他们腐烂的心充满悔恨，让他们的血肉充斥弹片。

/Lotus/Language/Messages/GalleonRobbery2.text:
The last of the Ghoul galleons has been located. Your final chance to take what you need. After that our partnership is dust. 

So long, maggots.
/Lotus/Language/Messages/GalleonRobbery2.zhText:
最后一艘尸鬼帆船战舰已经找到了。这是你获得想要物品的最后机会。在那之后，我们的合作关系将烟消云散。 

再见了，蛆虫。

/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.text:
You're getting the hang of it. We just wanted to send you a little something by way of encouragement. Don't let up. 

- Eudico
/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.zhText:
你找到诀窍了。我们只想送你点东西来作为鼓励。不要松懈了。

－Eudico

/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.text: VALLIS FRACTURES: A Token of Appreciation

You're doing good work, Sparky. At the current rate Smokefinger charts a plateau in seismic activity before long. That's good news for Fortuna. Keep it up. 

- Eudico
/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.zhText:
你作得很好，小火花。按照目前的速度，烟指不久后就可以预测到地震活动趋于稳定了。对福尔图娜来说这是好消息。保持下去。

－Eudico

/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.text: VALLIS FRACTURES: I Think It's Working
/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.zhText: 山谷裂缝：我认为这样有效

/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.text:
The Vallis is more stable these days, thanks to the work you're doing. But we've still got fractures erupting every day, and until Nef concedes the threat we have to take care of ourselves. Find them. Seal them. We're counting on you. 

- Eudico
/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.zhText:
山谷在这些日子更加的稳定了，感谢你所作的一切。但是我们每天还是会有裂缝在爆发，并且直到奈富承认这个威胁之前，我们得照顾好自己。找出它们。封印它们。我们就靠你了。

－Eudico

/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.text:
I clock 75-plus fractures sealed. I shudder to think what state we'd be in if we didn't have you helping us out like this. Kids are shutting down sound in their racks, knowing you're out there. Thank you. 

- Eudico
/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.zhText:
我数到超过 75 个裂缝已被封印。如果没有你这样帮助我们，我不敢想象我们会处于什么样的状态。在得知有你在外为我们奋斗后，孩子们也就睡得更安心了。感谢你。

－Eudico

/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.text:
Sparky, what can I say? You're doing singly what none of us could have done together. Fortuna still lives thanks to your efforts in sealing those fractures. But we're not resting. Not 'til Nef shuts down thermia extraction entirely. 

Thank you. From every rig jockey in the place. We owe you. 

- Eudico
/Lotus/Language/Messages/OrbHeistEventRe.zhText:
小火花，我还能讲什么呢？你正单人匹马做我们联手都无法完成的事。多得你封闭裂缝的努力，福尔图娜才能健在。但我们可不会休息。直到奈富要完全关闭热美亚萃取为止。

谢谢。来自这里的每一个技工。我们欠你的。

— Eudico

/Lotus/Language/Messages/PriestQuestHarr.text: With Rell at peace we will rebuild in his honor. We will do what we have always done: take the outcasts, the ones that don’t fit in, and prepare them. Thank you to you and your great Queen for setting Rell to rest. Take this offering, it’s the thing of greatest value I can give you.
/Lotus/Language/Messages/PriestQuestHarr.zhText: 随着 Rell 得以安息，我们将以他为荣耀来重建。我们还会延续过去我们一直做的事：收留被遗弃者、那些无法合群的人，并为他们准备容身之所。感谢你和你伟大的女王让 Rell 得以安息。收下这份礼物，这是我能给你的最有价值的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Messages/PriestQuestRive.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

With the clarity that Rell’s passing has given me, I now see that you have already communed with the Warframe Rell called Harrow. 

In this light, a secondary offering must be made. Take this Riven. May it provide you with strength in your battle for those who cannot protect themselves.

Faithfully yours,
Palladino
/Lotus/Language/Messages/PriestQuestRive.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|

通过 Rell 的去世给我的启示，我现在可以看到你已经与被 Rell 称之为 Harrow 的战甲联系紧密。

由此看来，还应该有另一份礼物。请收下这裂罅。希望在你为弱小者而战时，这可以为你增添力量。

敬上，
Palladino

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Aim_Glid.zhText: 跳跃并按住 |AIM_ICON| 以飞身瞄准

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Arsenal_.text: Each Warframe and weapon has a mod capacity that grows with rank. Match polarities to reduce drain and optimize your build to make every point count.
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Arsenal_.zhText: 每个战甲和武器都有 Mod 容量，容量会随着等级的提升而增加。匹配极性会降低容量消耗，优化你的配置，让每一点都物尽其用。

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Arsenal_.text: Visit the Arsenal to equip new Warframes, Weapons and Mods to enhance your loadout
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Arsenal_.zhText: 前往军械库来装备新的战甲、武器和 Mod，以增强你的配置

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Bullet_J.text: Start Running then HOLD and RELEASE |BTN_ICON| to Bullet Jump
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Bullet_J.zhText: 开始冲刺，然后按住并放开 |BTN_ICON| 进行旋身飞跃

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Crafting.text: Craft stronger Weapons at the Foundry using Blueprints and Materials you've collected
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Crafting.zhText: 使用收集的蓝图和材料在铸造厂制造更强大的武器

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Energy_U.text:
Abilities need energy to activate
It can be picked up from fallen enemies
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Energy_U.zhText:
技能需要能量来激活
可以从被击杀的敌人身上拾取能量球

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Manual_F.text: Hold <IOS_ADS> to aim and shoot manually with <IOS_SHOOT>
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Manual_F.zhText: 按住 <IOS_ADS> 即可使用 <IOS_SHOOT> 手动瞄准和射击

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Mastery_.text: PROGRESS ON MASTERY RANKS TO UNLOCK NEW BENEFITS
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Mastery_.zhText: 提升精通段位以解锁新福利

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Mastery_.text: TRY COMPLETING MASTERY RANK TESTS WHEN YOU HAVE ENOUGH MASTERY POINTS
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Mastery_.zhText: 当你拥有足够的精通点数时，可尝试完成精通段位测试

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Mod_Fusi.zhText: 增强 MOD 以变得更强

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Mod_Fusi.text: CHOOSE FUSION TO ENHANCE SELECTED MOD
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Mod_Fusi.zhText: 选择融铸来增强所选 MOD

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Movement.text: Hold and Release <IOS_BULLET_JUMPING> to execute slides, jumps and climbing with ease
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Movement.zhText: 按住并松开 <IOS_BULLET_JUMPING> 即可轻松进行滑行、跳跃与攀爬

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Scanning.text: Equip Scanner from Gear Wheel <IOS_GEAR> to Scan Objects with <SCAN>
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Scanning.zhText: 从 <IOS_GEAR> 携带装备轮盘装备扫描器来通过 <SCAN> 扫描目标

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Stealth_.text: Hold <IOS_CROUCH> to sneak behind enemies and press <IOS_USE> when shown to Stealth Attack
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Stealth_.zhText: 按住 <IOS_CROUCH> 潜入敌人身后，按下 <IOS_USE> 进行偷袭

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Stealth_.text: While STANDING STILL Hold <IOS_BULLET_JUMPING> to sneak and press <IOS_USE> when shown to Stealth Attack
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Stealth_.zhText: 站立时按住 <IOS_BULLET_JUMPING> 进入潜行，出现偷袭提示时按下 <IOS_USE> 可发动偷袭

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_WeaponWi.text:
TAP <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_BOW> TO SWITCH WEAPON
HOLD + DRAG <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_BOW> TO SET AUTOMATIONS
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_WeaponWi.zhText:
点击 <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_BOW> 切换武器
按住 + 拖动 <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_BOW> 设置自动化操作

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_WeaponWi.text:
TAP <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_RIFLE> TO SWITCH WEAPON
HOLD + DRAG <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_RIFLE> TO SET AUTOMATIONS
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_WeaponWi.zhText:
点击 <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_RIFLE> 切换武器
按住 + 拖动 <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_RIFLE> 设置自动化操作

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Weapon_A.text: HOLD + DRAG <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_BOW> to set Weapon Automation
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Tutorial_Weapon_A.zhText: 按住 + 拖动 <IOS_WEAPON_WIDGET_BOW> 以设置武器自动化

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Unified_Movement_.text: Mobile optimized, via a single multi-function button
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/Unified_Movement_.zhText: 移动优化，通过单个多功能按钮即可操作

/Lotus/Language/Mobile/VoltAutoInputProf.text: This custom mobile behavior profile changes how Volt plays on mobile devices. Master Volt's electric abilities to destructive perfection.
/Lotus/Language/Mobile/VoltAutoInputProf.zhText: 这个自定义移动行为配置文件会改变 Volt 在移动设备上的操作方式。驾驭 Volt 的电击技能，将其破坏力发挥到极致。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ChangeQuestErro.zhText: 完成《老师》系列任务即可重玩其他任务。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/DissolveMods.text:
ENDO is the unique fuel that enhances mods.

Create Endo by dissolving unwanted mods. Select the duplicate |MOD| mods and then select DISSOLVE.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/DissolveMods.zhText:
内融核心是增强 Mod 的独特燃料。

通过分解不需要的 Mod 来获取内融核心。选择重复的|MOD| Mod，然后选择"分解"。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/EquipElectric.text:
Drag the |MOD| mod onto a slot at the top to give the weapon <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electric damage.

Notice the polarity symbol in the upper right corner of some mod slots. Matching polarities will reduce the cost of equipping that mod.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/EquipElectric.zhText:
将|MOD| Mod 拖到顶部的槽位中，即可赋予武器 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

请注意某些 Mod 槽位右上角的极性符号。匹配极性可以降低装备该 Mod 的成本。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/EquipHealth.text:
Mods can also be installed on a Warframe.

Equip |MOD| to increase your Warframe's Health.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/EquipHealth.zhText:
Mod 还可以安装在战甲上。

装备|MOD|来增加你的战甲生命值。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/EquipMagnetic.text:
Equipping mods with different primary elements will create secondary elements.

Equip |MOD| to combine <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electric and create <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic damage.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/EquipMagnetic.zhText:
装备具有不同主要元素的 Mod 会创造次要元素。

装备|MOD|可将 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻与 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击结合起来并创造 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力伤害。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/Fusion.text:
Fuse a mod with Endo to increase its rank.

Select a mod and then select FUSION.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/Fusion.zhText:
将 Mod 与内融核心融铸以提高其等级。

选择一个 Mod，然后选择融铸。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/FusionHint.text: Select a Mod to upgrade via Fusion
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/FusionHint.zhText: 选择要使用融铸来升级的 Mod

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestDesc.text: Corpus incursions into Grineer territory lead to showdown with a forgotten rival.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestDesc.zhText: Corpus 入侵 Grineer 领土，却引发与一位被遗忘的劲敌的对决。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestPostQue.text:
Tenno,

You have learned much in a short period, but your work has barely started.

I have word from Venus. The people of Fortuna suffer under a corrupt, despotic preacher named Nef Anyo. They require a champion capable of fighting Corpus. Use the Venus Junction to bypass faction blockades.

When you get to Fortuna, find a gentleman who goes by the moniker, The Business. He is trustworthy.

Your Lotus has graciously offered me residence in the relay. Come see me, when you wish to learn more.

Teshin
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestPostQue.zhText:
Tenno，

你在短时间内学到了很多，但你的挑战才刚刚开始。
 
我收到来自金星的消息。福尔图娜的人民正遭受着一个名叫奈富·安尤的腐败独裁宣讲者的迫害。他们需要一位能够对抗 Corpus 的勇士。请使用金星接合点来绕过敌方派系的封锁。
 
当你到达福尔图娜时，找到一位名号为"操盘手"的绅士。他可以信赖。
 
你的莲（Lotus）慷慨地邀请我安顿在中继站。如果你想了解更多信息，随时来找我。

Teshin

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestRewardM.text: An assortment of mods Teshin acquired during his untold years wandering the Origin System waiting for the Tenno to return.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestRewardM.zhText: Teshin 在漫长的岁月中游荡于始源星系，等待 Tenno 的归来，期间收集了各种各样的 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestRifleDe.text: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestRifleDe.zhText: （英文：THORNBAK）这是 Teshin 在始源星系流浪多年期间收集的一把坚固的点射步枪，年代久远且来历不明。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3A.zhText: 在你的战甲上选择"升级"

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3A.text: Equip the Cryo Rounds Mod with Stormbringer
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3A.zhText: 将低温弹头 Mod 与暴风使者一同装备

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3E.text: Exit the Arsenal and return to Teshin
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3E.zhText: 离开军械库并返回 Teshin 处

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3L.zhText: 带着 Mod 模块逃脱

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3O.text: Upgrade the Thornbak Rifle with an Electric Mod
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3O.zhText: 使用电击 Mod 升级棘背步枪

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3O.text: Upgrade the Thornbak to Deal Magnetic Damage
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/ModQuestStage3O.zhText: 升级棘背以使其造成磁力伤害

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/NewFeature_Ayat.text:
Admire any discovered Ayatan treasures here. Empower them with Ayatan Stars to increase their value and bring them to life. 

Sculptures and Stars can both be traded for Endo after you have completed the Stolen Dreams quest.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/NewFeature_Ayat.zhText:
在这里欣赏你所发现的阿耶檀识宝物。用阿耶檀识之星赋予它们力量，提升它们的价值，并让它们焕发新生。 

阿耶檀识宝物和阿耶檀识之星都可以在完成《被偷走的梦》系列任务后，用来兑换内融核心。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/NewFeature_Sell.text: Excess copies of Mods can be sold for Credits. The value increases with both Mod rank and rarity.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/NewFeature_Sell.zhText: 多余的 Mod 可以出售来换取游戏现金。Mod 的等级和稀有度越高，价值也就越高。

/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/NewFeature_Tran.text: Test your luck by Transmuting 4 unwanted Mods into an unpredictable new result. The Mod you receive will favor the type and rarity of the Mods you sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/ModQuest/NewFeature_Tran.zhText: 通过将 4 个不需要的 Mod 转换成意想不到的新结果来试试你的运气。你获得的 Mod 将根据你投入 Mod 的类型和稀有度而定。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/DisarmDesc.text: Enemies lose their firearms and can only engage in Melee combat. Enemies without firearms are knocked down instead.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/DisarmDesc.zhText: 敌人会失去其枪支并只能进行近战。无枪支的敌人则会被击倒。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/KnockdownDesc.text: Enemies fall to the ground, opening them up to Melee Ground Finishers.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/KnockdownDesc.zhText: 敌人会倒地，成为近战倒地处决的目标。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/LiftedDesc.text: Certain Melee attacks and other abilities can suspend enemies in the air, leaving them temporarily undefended.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/LiftedDesc.zhText: 特定的近战攻击和技能可以使敌人悬浮在空中，使他们暂时处于不设防的状态。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/OverguardDesc.text: Overguard grants additional Health protection and Knockdown immunity as long as an amount remains.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/OverguardDesc.zhText: 只要数量有剩余，超宏防护就会提供额外生命值保护，和击倒免疫。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/OvershieldDesc.text: Overshields are additional Shields that stack on top of regular Shields. They do not regenerate after they are expended.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/OvershieldDesc.zhText: 过载护盾是常规护盾之上的额外护盾。它们消耗后不会再生。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/PerfectHeavyMele.text:
Recall the art of Tennokai. You will occasionally have opportunities to perform faster Heavy Attacks with no cost to your Combo Counter.

Curses activate when failing to kill a target with a Tennokai attack, and reset your Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/PerfectHeavyMele.zhText:
唤醒 Tenno 气解之术。你将偶尔有机遇不消耗连击数，并使出更快的重击。

当未能使用 Tenno 气解攻击击杀目标时，将触发诅咒效果，并重置你的连击数。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/PerfectHeavyMele.text: Recall the art of Tennokai. You will occasionally have opportunities to perform faster Heavy Attacks with no cost to your Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/PerfectHeavyMele.zhText: 唤醒 Tenno 气解之术。你将偶尔有机遇不消耗连击数，并使出更快的重击。

/Lotus/Language/ModTips/SleepDesc.text: Enemies become unable to perform actions and are vulnerable to Melee Finishers.
/Lotus/Language/ModTips/SleepDesc.zhText: 敌人无法进行任何动作，易受到近战处决。

/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalEightModDes.text:
To cosmic forms from tangent planes

We end as we began
/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalEightModDes.zhText:
对于从相切位面演化出的宇宙来说

我们的结局又回到了开始

/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalFiveModDesc.text:
In luminous space blackened stars

They gaze, accuse, deny
/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalFiveModDesc.zhText:

它们凝视、指责、否认

To cosmic madness laws submit

Though stalwart minds entreat

但那些坚定之人却前去乞求

From brooding gulfs are we beheld

By that which bears no name

其源头为无名之物

Carrion hordes trill their profane

Accord with eldritch plans
/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalSevenModDes.zhText:

吟唱着古老的计划

/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalSixModDesc.text:
Roiling, moaning, this realm of ours

In madness lost shall die
/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalSixModDesc.zhText:
我们的世界，沸腾着，呻吟着

在癫狂之中，等待迷失者的只有死亡

/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalThreeModDes.text:
Corporeal laws are unwrit

As suns and love retreat
/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalThreeModDes.zhText:
定律归零

太阳和爱退缩

/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalTwoModDesc.text:
Its heralds are the stars it fells

The sky and Earth aflame
/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalTwoModDesc.zhText:
掉落的星辰是它到来的先兆

天地燃烧

/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalWildcardMod.text:
Through endless faces, countless forms, a multitude unfolds.

(Mimics any Requiem Mod)
/Lotus/Language/Mods/ImmortalWildcardMod.zhText:

/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponIncreasedProj.text: [PH] Projectile size increased by |val1|. |val2| for semi-auto. |val3| punch through.
/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponIncreasedProj.zhText: [PH] Projectile size increased by |val1|. |val2| for semi-auto. |val3| punch through.

/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponMagneticOnImp.text: <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effects have |val|% chance to apply a <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Status Effect (x2 when Fire Rate is below |FIRERATE|)
/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponMagneticOnImp.zhText: <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态有 |val|% 的几率施加一层 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力异常状态（射速低于 |FIRERATE| 时 x2）。

/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponMeleeArmorSha.zhText: <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击伤害将减少敌人 |STAT1| 点护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponPunctureStatu.text: [PH] Hitting an enemy through another enemy applies |val1|% of the first target's status effects into the second.
/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponPunctureStatu.zhText: [PH] Hitting an enemy through another enemy applies |val1|% of the first target's status effects into the second.

/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponSpreadFreezeP.text: On <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect: |val1|% chance to spread that status to other enemies within |val2|m.
/Lotus/Language/Mods/WeaponSpreadFreezeP.zhText: 触发 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态时：有 |val1|% 几率将此状态传播给 |val2| 米内的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Mods/XataStrikeDesc.text: Alternate Fire grants |VALUE| Energy Regen/s for |DURATION|s for each enemy hit. Stacks up to |STACK| times.
/Lotus/Language/Mods/XataStrikeDesc.zhText: 次要射击每击中一个敌人就会提供每秒 |VALUE| 能量恢复，持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多可叠加 |STACK| 次。

/Lotus/Language/ModularArchwing/ModularA.text: [PH] Construct the Archwing? Selected parts will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/ModularArchwing/ModularA.zhText: [PH] Construct the Archwing? Selected parts will be consumed.

/Lotus/Language/ModularArchwing/ModularA.text: [PH] <WARNING> Select a Model, Core and Gear to construct a Moa Companion <WARNING>
/Lotus/Language/ModularArchwing/ModularA.zhText: [PH] <WARNING> Select a Model, Core and Gear to construct a Moa Companion <WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/BackgroundEr.text: Failed to connect to server. You were logged out.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/BackgroundEr.zhText: 无法连接到服务器。您已被登出。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/MissionKeyPr.text: Owner of the |MISSION_NAME| mission key left the squad.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/MissionKeyPr.zhText: |MISSION_NAME| 任务钥匙的持有人离开了小队。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/MissionNeedM.text: You must have |ITEM| in your inventory to play this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/MissionNeedM.zhText: 你的仓库中必须有|ITEM|才能进行这个任务。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/MissionNeedM.text: All squad members must have |ITEM| in their inventory to play this mission. |PLAYER_NAME| currently does not meet these requirements.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/MissionNeedM.zhText: 小队全体成员都必须在他们的仓库中有|ITEM|才能进行这个任务。|PLAYER_NAME| 目前尚不符合这些要求。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/NetworkError.text: Unable to connect to the internet. Please check your settings.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/NetworkError.zhText: 无法连接到网络。请检查设置。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.text: Unable to join Maroo's Bazaar due to mismatched Cross Platform Save status of squad members. Cross Save enabled accounts can only trade with each other.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.zhText: 由于小队成员的跨平台存档的状态不匹配，无法进入 Maroo 的市集。只有开启跨平台存档的账号可以互相交易。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.text: Unable to join; |LOCATION| instance is reserved for Cross Platform players (enable Cross Platform Play to join).
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.zhText: 无法加入；|LOCATION| 已预留给跨平台的玩家。（请开启跨平台游玩来加入）。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.text: Unable to join; |LOCATION| instance is reserved for players on another platform.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.zhText: 无法加入； |LOCATION| 已预留给另一个平台上的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.text: Could not add |NAME| as friend because they play on a different platform.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.zhText: 无法添加 |NAME| 为好友，因为他/她在不同的平台上游玩。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.text: Could not add to Clan because user plays on a different platform.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.zhText: 无法添加到氏族，因为该玩家在不同的平台上游玩。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.text: This user belongs to another platform and your Clan has not enabled Cross Platform Membership.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.zhText: 该玩家属于另一个平台，你的氏族尚未开启跨平台成员选项。

/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.text: Could not join because of the platform restrictions. Consider enabling Cross Platform Play.
/Lotus/Language/Multiplayer/SocialOverla.zhText: 由于平台限制无法加入游戏。可以考虑开启跨平台游玩。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalAmar.zhText: <SHARD_RED_SIMPLE>深红执刑官 Tau 融造源力石
深红执刑官 Tau 融造源力石

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalBore.zhText: <SHARD_BLUE_SIMPLE>蔚蓝执刑官 Tau 融造源力石
蔚蓝执刑官 Tau 融造源力石

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalDesc.text: A source of anti-entropic radiation ideal for empowering synthetic lifeforms, most notably Archons and Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalDesc.zhText: 一种反熵辐射来源，用于强化合成生命体，尤其是执刑官和战甲。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalGree.zhText: <SHARD_GREEN_SIMPLE>翡翠执刑官 Tau 融造源力石
翡翠执刑官 Tau 融造源力石

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalMyth.text: Tauforged status increases the overall power of an Archon Shard.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalMyth.zhText: Tau 融造状态增加执刑官源力石的整体力量。
执刑官 Tau 融造源力石

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalNira.zhText: <SHARD_YELLOW_SIMPLE>琥珀执刑官 Tau 融造源力石
琥珀执刑官 Tau 融造源力石

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalOran.zhText: <SHARD_ORANGE_SIMPLE>黄玉执刑官 Tau 融造源力石
黄玉执刑官 Tau 融造源力石

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonCrystalViol.zhText: <SHARD_VIOLET_SIMPLE>紫晶执刑官 Tau 融造源力石
紫晶执刑官 Tau 融造源力石

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonSummonMimic.text: Find and Defeat the Sentient Mimics
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/ArchonSummonMimic.zhText: 找到并击败 Sentient 拟态者

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerAridMinigun.zhText: 合一众沙漠重型机枪手

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBossLancerD.text: A battle-hardened Grineer Lancer now fully assimilated into the Narmer cult, mind and body alike.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBossLancerD.zhText: 身经百战的 Grineer 枪兵，从肉体到思想都已完全融入了合一众。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyAssas.text: Narmer are all fired up. They just promoted a cultist to Commander rank. Go and demote him to dead.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyAssas.zhText: 合一众已被激怒。他们刚刚将一名信徒晋升为了指挥官。去把他降职至地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyExter.text: Narmer numbers are rising. They're planning something big. Cut them down before they march on Cetus again.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyExter.zhText: 合一众的人数正在增加。他们在谋划一件大事。在他们再次向希图斯进军之前解决他们。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyLiber.text: Narmer are recruiting by force. They've taken one of our own and are planning a veiling ceremony. Stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyLiber.zhText: 合一众正在强制招募教众。我们的人被他们掳走了，并且他们正在计划进行仪式来强戴面障。阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyRecla.text: Narmer are pushed to the limit. If we raid their resources, we can push them right off the Plains.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyRecla.zhText: 合一众已经被逼到了绝境。如果我们能夺取他们的资源，就能把他们赶出平野。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyResou.text:
An adaptive Sentient base component responsible for communication flows. Used extensively in the Narmer invasion. A valuable commodity for both The Quills and Vox Solaris.

Location: Narmer Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon (Earth) and Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyResou.zhText:
一种用于 Sentient 通讯流的适应性基本组件。在合一众入侵时被广泛使用。对夜羽和索拉里斯之声来说都是一种很有价值的商品。

获取地点：夜灵平野（地球）和奥布山谷（金星）中的合一众赏金任务

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.text: A new Narmer Raknoid overseer is in place, acting as a veil comms relay. Take it out, and we weaken their grip.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.zhText: 一个全新的合一众蛛形机监工已经就位，并负责面障的通信传输。摧毁它，我们就能削弱他们的控制。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.text: Narmer are on a recruitment drive. If we don't kick back hard, they'll entrench.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.zhText: 合一众正在大规模地进行招募行动。如果我们不能狠厉出击，那他们就会借此再度站稳脚跟。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.text: There's a new Narmer operations drone on the field. We get that thing's datamass, we learn their next move.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.zhText: 战场上出现了一架全新的合一众行动无人机。如果我们能得到它的数据块，就能知道合一众接下来的作战计划。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.text: Narmer cultists have staked out a mineral field so they can manufacture Veils. We need to stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerBountyVenus.zhText: 合一众已经将一处矿区划为他们的地盘，以便制造面障。我们必须阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerCorpusGlaxi.zhText: 合一众冷冻光束步枪恐鸟

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerCorpusRange.zhText: 合一众德特昂突击队员

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerCorpusSnipe.zhText: 合一众狙击手突击队员

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerDefenseDron.text: A Narmer surveillance and deployment drone used for planning tactical assaults on a selected area.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerDefenseDron.zhText: 一架合一众监视和部署无人机，用于规划对选定区域的战术强袭。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerDescription.text: The Narmer Veil is in full control.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerDescription.zhText: 已被合一众面障完全控制。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerEncounterCa.text: Supplies dispatched to Narmer agents in the field.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerEncounterCa.zhText: 派发给战地中合一众特工的补给。
拦截合一众的空投物资

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerGrineerBigD.text: This Bolkor is under the command of Narmer agents.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerGrineerBigD.zhText: 这艘博寇由合一众特工指挥。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerGrineerDrop.text: This Firbolg is under the command of Narmer agents.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerGrineerDrop.zhText: 这艘博格由合一众特工指挥。

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerRoboticsDes.text: Under the control of the Narmer.

/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerSpecOpsRakn.text: A spiderlike robot produced by Narmer converts from the Corpus, and used as a veil transmission relay.
/Lotus/Language/Narmer/NarmerSpecOpsRakn.zhText: 这个蛛型机器人由皈依合一众的 Corpus 制造，负责面障的通信传输。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/KahlSyndic.text: Complete one Break Narmer mission to unlock the Archon Hunt
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/KahlSyndic.zhText: 完成一个「击溃合一众」任务以解锁执刑官猎杀

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOArtifact.text: Raid the conduits on |LOCATION| where Narmer keep their sacred regalia and artifacts. They may provide clues to Narmer's ultimate objectives.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOArtifact.zhText: 袭击 |LOCATION| 上的导管，那里保存着合一众的神圣饰物和神器。它们可能会有关于合一众终极目标的线索。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOAssassin.text: Once Archon |BOSS_NAME|'s exact location is established, you are to eliminate them and their Deacon retinue. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOAssassin.zhText: 一旦确定了执刑官|BOSS_NAME|的位置，你要去消灭他们和他们执事随从。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOAssassin.text: Our prior activities will have pinpointed Archon |BOSS_NAME|. It only remains for you to end the threat.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOAssassin.zhText: 我们之前的行动可以定位到执刑官|BOSS_NAME|的位置。你剩下的工作就是解决这个威胁。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOAssassin.text: Assuming success in your previous missions, we will have tracked Archon |BOSS_NAME| to their current lair. Destroy the Archon and their complement of Deacons.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOAssassin.zhText: 如果你成功完成之前的任务，那么我们将会追踪到执刑官|BOSS_NAME|的老巢。击杀执刑官和他们的执事随从。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOCaptureD.text: Pazuul is promoting and executing Narmer members seemingly at random. Capture his latest candidate at |LOCATION| for interrogation.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOCaptureD.zhText: 帕祖似乎正在随意提拔和处决合一众成员。前往 |LOCATION| 并捕获他的最新人选来进行审问。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SODefenseD.text: Narrowing down Archon |BOSS_NAME|'s location from the data you garnered will require a specialist Operative. Keep them alive while they scan.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SODefenseD.zhText: 要从获取的数据中缩小执刑官|BOSS_NAME|位置的范围，则需要一名专业特工。在他们扫描时保护好他们。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOExcavate.text: Pazuul is demanding Archon |BOSS_NAME| provide him with massive amounts of Cryotic in holy tribute. Exhaust the veins, starve the Archon out, and he will be forced to act.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOExcavate.zhText: 帕祖要求执刑官|BOSS_NAME|为他提供大量的永冻晶矿作为神圣贡品。耗尽矿物，将执刑官逼出局，那么他将不得不采取行动。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOExtermin.text: Archon |BOSS_NAME| is deploying troops at |LOCATION| in the belief they will all ascend to Tau in a holy massacre. Break their ranks.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOExtermin.zhText: 执刑官|BOSS_NAME|正在 |LOCATION| 部署军队，他们坚信着在一场神圣屠杀中将得以升上 Tau 星系。瓦解他们的军队。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOIntelDes.text: We cannot tell if Pazuul is receiving visions from Tau as he claims, or if his mind is disturbed. Analysis of data from |LOCATION| may give us an insight.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOIntelDes.zhText: 我们无法判断帕祖是否如他所说的那样从 Tau 星系那里接收到异象，或者他的思想是否受到干扰。|LOCATION| 处的数据分析也许可以给我们提供线索。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOMobileDe.text: Pazuul has transferred Archon |BOSS_NAME|'s data to a vulnerable network. His motives are mystifying as always, but we cannot pass up this opportunity.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOMobileDe.zhText: 帕祖将执刑官|BOSS_NAME|的数据传送到容易受到攻击的网络。他的动机一如既往地令人费解，但我们不能错过这个机会。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SORescueDe.text: A former disciple of Archon |BOSS_NAME|, has torn off their veil and turned apostate. They may help us to understand Pazuul.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SORescueDe.zhText: 执刑官|BOSS_NAME|的前任门徒，揭下了面障并成为了叛教者。他也许能帮助我们去了解帕祖。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOSabotage.text: Narmer industrial production in |LOCATION| is in overdrive, causing severe environmental damage. Whatever Pazuul's warped visions are inspiring him to do now, end it.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOSabotage.zhText: 合一众在 |LOCATION| 的工业生产处于过度生产状态，严重破坏环境。不管帕祖扭曲的愿景在激励着他做什么，阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOSurvival.text: Mount a co-ordinated Tenno raid on a Narmer site in |LOCATION|. This should buy us time to study Pazuul's response.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOSurvival.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 的一处合一众据点与 Tenno 合作展开一场突袭。这样应该会给我们争取到时间去研究帕祖的回应。

/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOTerritor.text: Pazuul's messages blend prophecy with fragments of religious text and apparent gibberish. Intercept his encrypted comms on |LOCATION| so we can make sense of them.
/Lotus/Language/NarmerSorties/SOTerritor.zhText: 帕祖的信息将预言与宗教的只言片语、浅显的胡言乱语糅杂在一起。在 |LOCATION| 上拦截他的加密通讯，以便我们理解它们。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.text:
The damaged remains of a Necramech supporting frame.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift, and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.zhText:
殁世机甲支撑框架的残骸，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
损坏的殁世机甲 外壳

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.text:
An engine designed for use in a Necramech. Unfortunately, it's damaged.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.zhText:
为殁世机甲设计的引擎。遗憾的是，它处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
损坏的殁世机甲 引擎

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.text:
A modular component for a Necramech. It's damaged and in need of repair.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.zhText:
殁世机甲的模块组件。它处于损坏状态，需要修复。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
损坏的殁世机甲 机舱

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.text:
A broken weapon system intended for a Necramech.

Location: Enemy Necramechs found in Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechPar.zhText:
为殁世机甲设计的武器系统，处于损坏状态。

获取地点：魔胎之境（火卫二）隔离库赏金中的殁世机甲敌人、完成《内战》系列任务后从殁世幽都（火卫二）洛德处购得
损坏的殁世机甲 武器舱

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/DamagedMechWea.text:
The damaged barrel of a heavy-duty Necramech weapon.

Location: Isolation Vault and Arcana Isolation Vault Bounties on the Cambion Drift (Deimos), and purchased from Loid in the Necralisk (Deimos) after completing The War Within quest

重型殁世机甲武器的枪管，处于损坏状态。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechGra.text: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechGra.zhText: 刺穿并抓住一个目标来吸取他们的生命值。再次使用该技能来把受害者用力掷出，以对他们和撞击点附近的任何人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechMin.text: Launch a pattern of charged mines all around you. Each mine detonates in a violent blast when touched, damaging enemies in a three-meter radius.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechMin.zhText: 在周围布下一圈带电地雷。每个地雷在被碰触时都会产生剧烈爆炸，并对周围半径 3 米内的敌人产生伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechOil.text: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechOil.zhText: 抛出一罐引力液体来制造一片宽阔的泥沼，在泥沼上行进的敌人会大大减速。此外，也可以将罐子射向半空来制造烈焰。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechRep.text: Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechRep.zhText: 通过一道强力光束将周围的敌人扫入火线并将他们悬空。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechRio.text: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechRio.zhText: 举起骨骸寡妇的盾牌，以阻挡前方来袭的伤害，并将该伤害反弹给攻击者。在技能激活时，通过「室女之吻」来打击敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechSho.text: Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechSho.zhText: 将殁世机甲笼罩在一道强力电场中，以大幅提升近战时的生存能力。击中这一电场罩的敌人会为他们的无礼付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechSwo.zhText: 召唤毁天灭地的显赫武器。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechTur.text: Take a stationary stance to deploy maximum firepower and gain increased structural integrity for a time.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EntratiMechTur.zhText: 采取静止姿态来部署最大火力，并在一段时间内获得结构完整性的提升。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EvilBaroMausol.text: This Mausolon skin eschews Entrati's design in favor of an even more ominous one of unknown provenance.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/EvilBaroMausol.zhText: 这款惩戒者外观摒弃了英择谛的设计，转而采用了一种来历不明、更加不祥的设计。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechEventCorte.text: Bring a touch of the Necralisk to this Archwing weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechEventCorte.zhText: 为这件曲翼武器带来一丝殁世幽都的气息。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechEventMauso.text: Bring a touch of the Necralisk to this Archwing weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechEventMauso.zhText: 为这件曲翼武器带来一丝殁世幽都的气息。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechEventMorgh.text: Bring a touch of the Necralisk to this Archwing weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechEventMorgh.zhText: 为这件曲翼武器带来一丝殁世幽都的气息。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechD.text: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechD.zhText: （英文：VOIDRIG）虽然外表不怎么光鲜亮丽，但却能出色地完成工作。凭借其电能护甲，这款粗糙且整装待发的机甲能够携带大量爆炸物，让战场上的敌人陷入苦战。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechE.text: The pinnacle of Entrati weapons design: dual energy mortars that fire with such devastating power that the Necramech must first be locked into a braced, stationary turret mode.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechE.zhText: （英文：ARQUEBEX）英择谛武器设计的巅峰之作：双能追击炮的毁灭威力之大，使得殁世机甲必须将自身锁定在稳定的炮塔模式下来使用该武器。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechE.text: A titanic blade modeled after some of the very oldest swords, this weapon was designed to slice through massed enemy troops in a single stroke.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechE.zhText: （英文：IRONBRIDE）一把灵感源自最古老刀剑的巨大利刃，这把武器是为了一次性击穿大量敌人而设计的。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechM.text: The Necramech's graspers can deliver a powerful punch.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechM.zhText: 殁世机甲的抓钳可以提供强力猛击。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/NechroTechSumm.text: Summon a Necramech to the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/NechroTechSumm.zhText: 召唤一架殁世机甲到战场上。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/NecramechHelme.text: Bear down on the enemy with this alternative Necramech helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/NecramechHelme.zhText: 戴上这件殁世机甲的替换头盔来压制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/NecramechHelme.text: Venture into the unknown with the alternative Necramech helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/NecramechHelme.zhText: 戴上殁世机甲的替换头盔进入未知领域探险。

/Lotus/Language/Necromech/ThanoTechMechD.text: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.
/Lotus/Language/Necromech/ThanoTechMechD.zhText: （英文：BONEWIDOW）这架慑人的殁世机甲，是为了纪念英择谛的女族长而设计的，这是一个强健的前线战士。相较于护盾强度，骨骸寡妇在护甲和生命值上更占优势。她可以抓起敌人并将其猛掷出去，或是部署一个重型盾牌来进行个人防御，又或是以巨大的战刃在敌军中杀出一条血路。

Tenno：代表远古战士的不朽精锐。

世世代代，你长眠于此，无人唤醒你。

直到如今。

/Lotus/Language/NewWar/NewWarQuestComple.text:
The Lotus is reborn!

Narmer is all but decimated, its scattered adherents now rallying in the name of their lost martyr.

The tenuous alliance against a common enemy has crumbled leaving the Origin system struggling to recover.

Now the Tenno face new questions... the paradox of the Drifter's origins and the threads binding them to a nameless Void entity...
/Lotus/Language/NewWar/NewWarQuestComple.zhText:
Lotus 已重获新生！

合一众被摧毁殆尽，它散落的追随者现在以他们逝去殉道者的名义团结了起来。

对抗共同敌人的松散联盟已经瓦解，始源星系也难以恢复。

现在 Tenno 面临着新的问题……漂泊者起源的悖论，和他们与无名虚空实体之间的联系……

/Lotus/Language/NewWar/NewWarQuestDesc.text:
The Sentient armada has emerged from the Veil Proxima in shocking numbers.

At their head, Natah, once the trusted guide 'Lotus', now seemingly in thrall to Ballas and her brother Erra.

Across worlds and space, the Tenno and their unlikely alliance launch a final assault to take the Sentient mothership... where Natah awaits.
/Lotus/Language/NewWar/NewWarQuestDesc.zhText:
Sentient 舰队正以惊人的数量从面纱比邻星域中涌现。

领军的 Natah，曾是我们倍受信赖的向导 "Lotus"。而她现在似乎已被其亲弟 Erra，以及 Ballas 奴役。

横跨整个星系，Tenno 与他们意想不到的盟友，发动了最终强袭以攻占 Sentient 母舰。而 Natah……亦在舰中严阵以待。

/Lotus/Language/NewWar/RewardsMessageBod.text:
My child... my friend.

What was done, is done. Ballas is no more. We have both woken from that nightmare at last.

New dangers, new choices await us now. Few will be simple. Each moment unfolds into a thousand-petalled bloom of possibilities.

And each one, we will face together.

For now, rest. Dream of who we were, and of who we have become.

Nothing I could give could repay what you have done for me. But these items may assist you on your onward journey.

|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/NewWar/RewardsMessageBod.zhText:
我的孩子……我的挚友。

过去已尘埃落定。Ballas 也不复存在。我们终于能从那场噩梦中醒来了。

新的危险和抉择正等着我们。道阻且长，但每一个瞬间都能绽放出千万的可能性。

此后的每一刻，我们都将共同面对。

现在，好好休息吧。回想着我们的本质，而我们又成为了什么。

虽然我所能给予的一切都不足以报答你对我的付出。但或许这些物品能在旅途中帮到你。

|LOTUS_NAME|
