/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 如何进行

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Shake the hand of a fellow Tenno using the Handshake Emote.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用握手表情来与 Tenno 同伴握手。
紧紧握手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Equip the Handshake Emote to your Emote Wheel by going to the Arsenal and selecting ‘Emotes' under the Gear tab. Select an Emote slot and the Handshake Emote to equip it. Use <MINI_INVENTORY_HOLD> to bring up the Emote wheel and perform the emote with another Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 前往军械库，在装备栏中选择"表情动作"，将握手表情装备到你的表情动作选单上。选择一个表情动作槽位来装备握手表情。使用 <MINI_INVENTORY_HOLD> 调出表情动作选单，并与另一名 Tenno 一起合作该表情动作。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Equip the Handshake Emote to your Emote Wheel by going to the Arsenal and selecting ‘Emotes' under the Gear tab. Select an Emote slot and the Handshake Emote to equip it. Use <MINI_INVENTORY_TOGGLE> to bring up the Emote wheel and perform the emote with another Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 前往军械库，在装备栏中选择"表情动作"，将握手表情装备到你的表情动作选单上。选择一个表情动作槽位来装备握手表情。使用 <MINI_INVENTORY_TOGGLE> 调出表情动作选单，并与另一名 Tenno 一起合作该表情动作。
飞身瞄准时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人
滑翔者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: To Aim Glide, hold down the Aim button <AIM_WEAPON> while in midair.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在空中按住瞄准键<AIM_WEAPON>即可进行飞身瞄准。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Customize a piece of Equipment's colors.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 自定义一件装备的颜色。
艺术家

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Customize Equipment using the Appearance menu in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在军械库中使用外观菜单自定义装备。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Install an Augment Mod on your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在你的战甲上安装一个技能强化 Mod。
战甲强化

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Augment Mods can be obtained from Syndicate and Nightwave Offerings. Go to the Arsenal, select the Upgrade tab and equip an Augment Mod.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 强化 Mod 可以从集团和午夜电波商品中获得。前往军械库，选择升级选项并装备一个强化 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Claim an item from your Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从铸造厂中领取一件物品。
制造者之触

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: After an item finishes building, visit your Foundry and select the completed item to claim it.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在物品完成铸造后，访问你的铸造厂并选择已完成的物品来领取它。
旋身飞跃 |COUNT| 次。
蹦弹

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: To Bullet Jump, hold down the <HOLD_CROUCH>Crouch button, then tap <JUMP>Jump.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 按住<HOLD_CROUCH>下蹲键，再按<JUMP>跳跃键即可进行旋身飞跃。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Take a screenshot in any Captura scene.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任意 Captura 场景中截取屏幕截图。
取个标题

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Captura is found in the Arsenal under the Warframe's Appearance tab. Select the camera icon to the right of the screen to open Captura.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: Captura 可以在军械库中战甲外观选项下找到。选择屏幕右侧的相机图标以打开 Captura。
扫描 |COUNT| 次物件或敌人。
研究者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Equip a scanner to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal, then activate it in a mission to equip it. While equipped, aim at enemies and hold <PRE_ATTACK> to scan them. You can buy Scanner charges from the Market or Cephalon Semaris.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在军械库将扫描器添加到携带装备轮盘，然后在任务中启用它。装备时，瞄准敌人并按住<PRE_ATTACK>进行扫描。你可以从商店或中枢 Simaris 那里购买扫描器。
拾取 |COUNT| 现金。
储蓄者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only credits dropped by enemies and containers count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有敌人和容器掉落的现金才会被计入。
收集 |COUNT| 个资源
收集者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Collect resources by defeating enemies and completing missions. Be sure to also check storage containers and destructible objects to maximize your resource hunt.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过击败敌人和完成任务来收集资源。确保检查存储容器和可破坏的目标，以最大限度地猎取资源。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a Mission with only a Melee Weapon equipped
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 仅装备近战武器来完成一场任务
剑客

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Primary and Secondary Weapons. With only your Melee Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 访问你的军械库来更改你的配置，取消装备你的主要和次要武器。仅装备近战武器，前往你轨道飞行器上的星图导航开始并完成任何任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a Mission with only a Primary Weapon equipped
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 仅装备主要武器来完成一场任务
枪不释手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Melee and Secondary Weapons. With only your Primary Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 访问你的军械库来更改你的配置，取消装备你的近战和次要武器。仅装备主要武器，前往你轨道飞行器上的星图导航开始并完成任何任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a Mission with only a Secondary Weapon equipped
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 仅装备次要武器来完成一场任务
随身火力

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Melee and Primary Weapons. With only your Secondary Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 访问你的军械库来更改你的配置，取消装备你的近战和主要武器。仅装备次要武器，前往你轨道飞行器上的星图导航开始并完成任何任务。
完成一场任务。
特务

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start or join missions from the Navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始或加入任务。
使用震地攻击击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
死从天降

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The final hit must be from a Melee ground slam.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 最后一击必须来自近战震地攻击。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Deploy an Air Support Charge in a Mission
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任务中部署一个空中支援呼叫器
天降神兵

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Air Support Charges can be crafted after installing the Landing Craft Foundry Segment. This Segment can be Researched in the Clan Dojo, or found in the Market. Once Charges are crafted in the Foundry, equip them to the Gear Wheel via the Gear tab in the Arsenal. To deploy them, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and select the Air Support Charge.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 安装登陆艇铸造厂模块后，即可制造空中支援呼叫器。这个模块可以在氏族道场中研究，或是在游戏内商店中找到。呼叫器在铸造厂制造完成后，可在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项卡中装备。要部署它，在任务中打开携带装备轮盘并选择空中支援呼叫器。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Deploy a Glyph while on a mission.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任务中设置一枚浮印。
涂鸦

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Equip a Glyph Prism to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal. To deploy it, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and select the Glyph Prism.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在军械库装备浮印光谱到携带装备轮盘。要部署它，在任务中打开携带装备轮盘并选择浮印光谱。
部署一个魅影
二重身

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Specter Blueprints can be obtained from Rescue missions, as well as various other sources. Craft a Specter in the Foundry, and then equip them to the Gear Wheel via the Gear tab in the Arsenal. To deploy them, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and select the Specter.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 魅影蓝图可通过救援任务等其他多种来源获得。在铸造厂制造魅影，然后在军械库的携带装备轮盘选项卡中装备。要部署它，在任务中打开携带装备轮盘并选择魅影。
为莱弗博物馆进行捐赠
赞助者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Select a Leverian to visit via the Leverian tab in the Codex. Once inside, visit the donation box near the entrance to donate Credits.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过资料库的莱弗博物馆标签页选择要参观的莱弗博物馆。进入后，前往入口附近的捐款箱可以捐赠现金。
在双衍王境喂饱喉兽
我还要吃

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Look for glowing circles near bodies of water while out exploring in The Duviri Experience. Catch at least 10 fish to satisfy the Maw's hunger.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在双衍历程中外出探索时，寻找水体附近的发光圆圈。捕获至少 10 条鱼来满足喉兽的饥饿。
在双衍王境中援救动物
援助之手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Look for wild animals in need of rescue out in The Duviri Experience. Koral will announce if one is nearby. Try to sneak up on them, but if detected, be ready for a fight!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在双衍历程中寻找需要援救的野生动物。如果有动物在附近，小珊瑚会告诉你。尝试偷偷接近它们，但如果被发现，请做好战斗准备！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Hijack a Crewship from the enemy
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 劫持一艘敌方战舰
没收

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start a Railjack mission and destroy enemy fighters until a Crewship enters the sector. Approach it with your Archwing and enter it to hijack it from the enemy. The front section of the ship has a pilot seat which gives you access to the ship’s controls and weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 开始一个航道星舰任务并摧毁敌方战斗机群，一直到一艘战舰进入该星域。使用你的 Archwing 靠近、入侵并劫持它。敌人战舰的头部有一个飞行驾驶位，使用它能够登入该船的控制和武器系统。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Interact with your Kubrow or Kavat
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 与你的库狛或库娃互动
忠心不二

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: While onboard your Orbiter, approach your Kubrow or Kavat while it is walking around and press the interact button to pet it.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 位于轨道飞行器上时，当你的库狛或库娃四处走动时接近它并按下互动按钮来抚摸它。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| enemies while riding a K-Drive, Kaithe, Velocipod, or Atomicycle.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 骑乘 K 式悬浮板、绝灵骥、迅敏节虫或原子摩托车时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
惊险骑手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can equip your Secondary weapon while riding a K-Drive (or other vehicle) by pressing <SWITCH_GUN>. K-Drives are earned from the Vox Solaris Quest. Equip your K-Drive (or vehicle of choice) to the Gear Wheel, and then deploy it in Open Landscape missions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 骑乘 K 式悬浮板（或其他载具）时，按下<SWITCH_GUN>即可装备你的次要武器。K 式悬浮板可以通过《索拉里斯之声》系列任务获得。将你的 K 式悬浮板（或所选载具）装备到携带装备轮盘上，即可在开放世界任务中部署。
使用技能击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
力量展现

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally injured or killed with Abilities are counted.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自用技能击杀的敌人才会被计入。
使用<DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
引爆者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage must be present. Blast Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_FREEZE>.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害。爆炸伤害由 <DT_FIRE> 和 <DT_FREEZE> 组合而成。
使用<DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
熔毁

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_CORROSIVE>Corrosive Damage must be present. Corrosive Damage is formed by combining <DT_ELECTRICITY> and <DT_POISON>.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀伤害。腐蚀伤害由 <DT_ELECTRICITY> 和 <DT_POISON> 组合而成。
使用<DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
短路

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage must be present.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害。
处决击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
处刑者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Execute melee finishers on vulnerable enemies by sneaking upon them. Some Warframe abilities can also blind or stun enemies to enable finishers. Finishers on prone enemies do not count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过潜行对毫无防备的敌人实施近战处决。某些战甲技能也可以致盲或眩晕敌人以进行处决。处决俯卧的敌人不会被计入。
使用<DT_FIRE>火焰伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
纵火犯

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage must be present.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_FIRE>火焰伤害。
使用<DT_FREEZE>冰冻伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
极度冷冻

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage must be present.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻伤害。
使用<DT_GAS>毒气伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
生化危害

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_GAS>Gas Damage must be present. Gas Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_POISON>.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_GAS>毒气伤害。毒气伤害由 <DT_FIRE> 和 <DT_POISON> 组合而成。
爆头击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
老练射手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The final hit must be on the head.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 最后一击必须要击中头部。
使用<DT_MAGNETIC>磁力伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
吸引力

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_MAGNETIC>Magnetic Damage must be present. Magnetic Damage is formed by combining <DT_ELECTRICITY> and <DT_FREEZE>.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_MAGNETIC>磁力伤害。磁力伤害由 <DT_ELECTRICITY> 和 <DT_FREEZE> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用近战武器击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
剑舞

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Melee weapon count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用近战武器击杀的敌人才会被计入。
使用<DT_POISON>毒素伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
投毒者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage must be present.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_POISON>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Primary Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用主要武器击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
撂倒他们

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Primary weapon count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用主要武器击杀的敌人才会被计入。
使用<DT_RADIATION>辐射伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
核反应器

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Damage must be present. Radiation Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_ELECTRICITY>.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_RADIATION>辐射伤害。辐射伤害由 <DT_FIRE> 和 <DT_ELECTRICITY> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Secondary Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用次要武器击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
小兵大功

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Secondary weapon count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用次要武器击杀的敌人才会被计入。
使用<DT_VIRAL>病毒伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
疯狂散毒

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage must be present. Viral Damage is formed by combining <DT_FREEZE> and <DT_POISON>.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_VIRAL>病毒伤害。病毒伤害由 <DT_FREEZE> 和 <DT_POISON> 组合而成。
击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
开枪警告

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally injured or killed are counted.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自击杀的敌人才会被计入。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill a Kuva Thrall or Hound
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 击杀一个赤毒奴仆或猎犬
沉寂

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: While having an active Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos, start a mission on a planet that is controlled by them to defeat and Mercy Kill a Kuva Thrall or Hound of theirs respectively.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 当你拥有了一名已激活的赤毒玄骸或是帕尔沃斯的姐妹，前往被他们控制的星球上进行任务，击败他们，并对他们的赤毒奴仆或猎犬实施怜悯之击。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Clear a node influenced by a Kuva Lich or a Sister of Parvos
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 清除一个受到赤毒玄骸或者帕尔沃斯的姐妹影响的节点
解放

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start a mission on a planet that is controlled by a Kuva Lich or a Sister of Parvos and complete it to remove their influence.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在赤毒玄骸或帕尔沃斯的姐妹们控制的星球上开始一个任务，并完成它以消除他们的影响力。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Sell any item in your Inventory for Credits.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 出售仓库中的任意物品以获取现金。
清算

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Open the pause menu and select Equipment > Inventory, from there you can pick the items you wish to sell for Credits.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 打开暂停菜单并选择装备 > 仓库，从那里你可以选择要出售的物品以获得现金。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Revive a fellow Tenno or a Companion.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 复活一名 Tenno 或一个同伴。
治疗圣手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Approach a downed ally and interact with the revive prompt.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 接近倒下的队友并与复活提示互动。
对一名敌人施展怜悯之击
不施怜悯

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: When damaging Heavy Units such as Grineer Heavy Gunners, reduce their health to the threshold indicated on their HP bar to make them susceptible to a Mercy Kill. Inflicting the <DT_IMPACT>Impact Status Effect on them will increase the health threshold and make it easier to put them into the Mercy state.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 当对重型单位（例如 Grineer 重型机枪手）产生伤害时，把他们的生命值降低到其血条上标识的阈值以下，以使他们更容易受到怜悯之击的攻击。对他们施加 <DT_IMPACT>冲击异常状态会使他们的血条阈值升高，并使他们更容易进入可被怜悯之击攻击的状态。
打开 |COUNT| 个储物柜。
盗窃癖

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Approach Lockers in missions and Interact with them.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任务中靠近并打开储物柜。
拾取 |COUNT| 个能量球。
激励

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Energy Orbs frequently drop from enemies and containers.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 能量球经常会从敌人和容器中掉落。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Find |COUNT| Syndicate Medallions. You can search by yourself or with a squad.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 找到 |COUNT| 集团奖章。可以自己搜索，也可以组队搜索。
狩猎开始

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start a mission from the Syndicate tab in Navigation once you have pledged to a Syndicate. Syndicate Medallions are manual pick-ups that can be found throughout the mission. Loot Radar Mods such as Animal Instinct and Thief's Wit can help locate them via the minimap
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 效忠一个集团后，从星图导航中的集团标签页下开始任务。在任务中可以找到并手动拾取集团奖章。使用寻物雷达 Mod，比如动物本能和盗贼天赋，能为你在小地图中标记它们。
拾取 |COUNT| 个 Mod。
闪闪发亮

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Mods frequently drop from enemies when they are killed.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 击杀敌人时经常会掉落 Mod。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Find and pilot a Fallen Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 找到并驾驶一个倒下的殁世机甲。
重赋生机

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Fallen Necramechs are only found on the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有在"混乱"占据主导地位时，才可以在魔胎之境找到倒下的殁世机甲。
标记 |COUNT| 个 Mod 或资源。
交流者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Point directly at a Mod or Resource and press your Place Marker key <SHOW_SECRET_1>.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 将准星直接指向一个 Mod 或资源，然后按下放置标记键<SHOW_SECRET_1>。
使用 |COUNT| 个表情动作。
善于表达之人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Emotes can be assigned on the Gear Tab in the Arsenal. To play an Emote, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and then swap to the Emotes Wheel.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在军械库的装备栏设置表情动作。要使用表情动作，请在任务期间打开携带装备轮盘，然后切换到表情动作选单。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Play a game of Frame Fighter, Happy Zephyr, or Wyrmius
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从"战甲霸王"、"快乐的 Zephyr"，或是"蛟龙巡航机"中任意游玩一个游戏
童心未泯

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Activate a Requiem Obelisk on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在火卫二激活一座安魂方尖碑。
远古方尖碑

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Broken Obelisks are found across the Cambion Drift. Charge an Obelisk by using your Operator's Void energy on its core.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 可以在魔胎之境找到破碎的方尖碑。使用指挥官的虚空能量来为方尖碑的核心充能。
访问双衍王境中的言录使
致礼如初

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Look for Acrithis' Cart out in The Duviri Experience. She is guaranteed to make an appearance in the King's Palace after defeating an Orowyrm.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在《双衍历程》中寻找言录使的推车。击败奥金魇龙后，她一定会出现在王宫。
滑行时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
加速者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: To Slide, start moving, then hold <HOLD_CROUCH>Crouch.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 移动时按住 <HOLD_CROUCH> 下蹲键即可滑行。
入侵 |COUNT| 个控制台。
黑客

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Interact with a console and then complete the hacking minigame. Using ciphers counts!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 与控制台互动，然后完成入侵小游戏。使用破解器也会被计入！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| enemies using a Necramech while hovering.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用殁世机甲在空中悬浮时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
留在空中

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: You can use your own Necramech, or you can temporarily commandeer a Necramech on the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 你可以使用自己的殁世机甲，或者在"混乱"占据主导地位时，临时征用魔胎之境中的殁世机甲。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Suspend 5 or more enemies in the air at once with a Heavy Slam Melee Attack
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用一次重击震地近战攻击让 5 个或以上敌人同时浮空
深度冲击

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Perform a Heavy Slam attack with your Melee weapon by jumping at pressing <MELEE_CHANNEL> while aiming at the ground when surrounded by a group of enemies.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 当被一群敌人包围时，跳起并按下<MELEE_CHANNEL>瞄准地面，来使用你的近战武器进行重型震地攻击。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| Drones or Ospreys with your Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用近战武器击杀 |COUNT| 架无人机或鱼鹰。
拍打者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The final hit on Drones and Ospreys must be from your Melee weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 对无人机或鱼鹰的最后一击必须来自你的近战武器。
在你的轨道飞行器中放置 1 个装饰物。
自得其乐

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Open the Quick Access wheel and select Decorate, or navigate to the Decorate menu under Pause > Equipment > Orbiter enter Decoration Mode. Decorations can be found in the Market, or from various vendors across the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 打开快速移动轮盘并选择装饰，或者通过依次点击暂停 > 装备 > 轨道飞行器下的装饰菜单来进入装饰模式。装饰可以在游戏内商店找到，或者从始源星系各地的商人那里购买。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Successfully defend an Excavator without allowing it to run out of power.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 成功防御挖掘机并且不让挖掘机耗尽能量。
源源不断

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Select any Excavation mission in Navigation. Find a dig site and defend the Excavator. Keep it powered by bringing Power Cells to it dropped from killed Power Carrier enemies.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图中选择任意挖掘任务。找到挖掘地点并保护挖掘机。使用击杀能量运送者后掉落的能量电池来维持挖掘机的电力。
完成 |COUNT| 次 Mod 转换
以旧换新

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Transmuting is the act of merging four Mods at the Mod Segment in your Orbiter to receive a new random Mod.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 转换是在你的轨道飞行器里的 Mod 工作台中合并四张 Mod 以获取一张随机新 Mod 的操作。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Pierce and kill 2 or more enemies in a single Bow shot.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在单次弓箭射击中射穿并杀死 2 名以上的敌人。
一石二鸟

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Bow weapon count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用弓箭武器击杀的敌人才会被计入。
参观一处特色道场
随便看看

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: At the bottom left of the Star Chart, players can visit their own or Featured Dojos. Featured Dojos are the winners of the quarterly Featured Dojo Contests.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图的左下方，玩家可以进入自己的道场或是参观特色道场。这些特色道场都是季度特色道场大赛的胜出者们。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Get a kill with your Primary, Secondary, and Melee weapons within 10 seconds.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在 10 秒内使用你的主要、次要，和近战武器各击杀一名敌人。
整个军械库

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Each weapon type (Primary, Secondary, and Melee) must have killed an enemy within that time limit. Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Primary, Secondary, and Melee will count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 每种武器类型（主要武器、次要武器和近战武器）都必须在规定时间内击杀一名敌人。只有你亲自使用主要武器、次要武器和近战武器击杀或击伤的敌人才会被计入。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a game of Komi in Duviri
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在双衍王境里完成一场围棋对局
你的回合

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Look for Komi boards while out exploring in The Duviri Experience. Your opponent is crafty, so be sure to read the rules well!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在双衍历程中探索的时候寻找围棋棋盘。你的对手很狡猾，所以一定要好好阅读规则！
击败奥金魇龙
野兽杀手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The Orowyrm is the final encounter at the end of The Duviri Experience or The Lone Story missions in Duviri. Use a combination of Drifter and Warframe combat to triumph over the beast!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 奥金魇龙是双衍王境中，双衍历程或是孤独纪事任务末尾的最终敌人。使用漂泊者和战甲结合战斗来战胜这只野兽！
在 5 秒内击杀 20 名敌人。
大杀特杀
在 5 秒内击杀 20 名敌人。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Clear a Railjack Boarding Party without your Warframe taking damage
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在战甲没有受到伤害的情况下清除一批登上航道星舰的敌人。
完美无瑕

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Railjack Boarding Parties occur when a Ramsled successfully lands on your Railjack. To avoid taking damage, take cover and use long range or explosive weapons. You can also consider using a stealth Warframe to avoid enemy detection.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 当冲锋艇成功登陆你的航道星舰时，就会出现登舰敌人。为了避免受到伤害，请找好掩体并使用远程武器或爆炸武器。你还可以考虑使用隐形战甲来避免被敌人发现。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Bow.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用主要弓箭击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
弓箭进攻

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Bow count. Eligible weapons can be found in the primary Bow/Crossbow category in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用主要弓箭击杀的敌人才会被计入。符合条件的武器可以在军械库的主要弓箭/十字弓分类中找到。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Catch |COUNT| Rare Fish in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在夜灵平野捕捉 |COUNT| 条稀有鱼。
地球渔者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Murkray, Norg, Cuthol, and Glappid are considered to be rare fish. Hai-Luk in Cetus can supply you with fishing equipment. Equip your purchased Fishing Spear to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and then activate it while on the Plains. Use Bait in the correct water sources to find Rare Fish. Time of day can change how often certain fish appear, and some only appear at day or night.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 阴暗鳐、诺格、克苏尔，和盖拉佩德都属于稀有鱼类。希图斯的渔人海露可以为你提供捕鱼装备。在军械库中将你购买的鱼叉装备到携带装备轮盘，然后在平原上激活即可使用。在正确的水域使用鱼饵来寻找稀有鱼类。 一天中的不同时段会影响某些鱼类的出现频率，有些鱼类只在白天或夜晚出现。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Catch |COUNT| Rare Servofish in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在奥布山谷捕捉 |COUNT| 条稀有伺服鱼。
金星渔者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Synathid, Tromyzon, and Charamote are considered to be rare fish. The Business in Fortuna can supply you with fishing equipment. Add a Shock Spear to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and then activate it while in the Orb Vallis. Use Bait in the correct water sources in the correct weather conditions to find Rare Fish.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 海龙、多目鳗、和重筑虾都属于稀有鱼类。福尔图娜中的操盘手可以为你提供捕鱼装备。在军械库中将电击鱼叉装备到携带装备轮盘，然后在奥布山谷上激活即可使用。在正确的天气条件下和正确的水域使用鱼饵来寻找稀有鱼类。
收集 |COUNT| 个资源
收集者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Collect resources by defeating enemies and completing missions. Be sure to also check storage containers and destructible objects to maximize your resource hunt.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过击败敌人和完成任务来收集资源。确保检查存储容器和可破坏的目标，以最大限度地猎取资源。
从双衍王境收集 |COUNT| 个资源
收集者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Earn resources in Duviri by destroying plants and containers, defeating enemies and completing objectives or optional Anecdotes.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在双衍王境中通过破坏植物和容器、击败敌人和完成目标或是可选秘闻来获得资源。
完成 |COUNT| 项刺杀任务。
刺客

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Nightmare missions spawn on planets once have completed all of the planet's nodes. Available Nightmare missions can be found in the Alert tab in the Navigation menu.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 一旦星球上的所有节点都完成，噩梦任务就会出现。可玩的噩梦任务在导航菜单的警报标签中找到。
完成 |COUNT| 项捕获任务。
狱吏

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Capture.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是捕获。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Help Clem with his weekly mission.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 帮助 Clem 完成他的周常任务。
好朋友

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Darvo can be found in any Relay using the Fast Travel options in the pause menu. Select the "Does Clem need my help?" dialogue option after completing the A Man of Few Words quest.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用暂停菜单中的快速移动选项，即可在任意中继站中找到 Darvo。完成《沉默寡言的男人》系列任务后，选择「Clem 需要我的协助吗？」对话选项。
在中断任务中完成 |COUNT| 个导管
别搞砸了

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start a Disruption mission from Navigation, scavenge Conduit Keys (Dockets on Deimos) from elite enemies, (Amalgams on Jupiter, Eximus and Gruzzlings on Deimos, and heavy units or Eximus units elsewhere) then carry them to the matching Conduit to activate and defend it from an incoming Demolisher or Demolyst.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图导航处开启一场中断任务，从精英敌人身上（木星的并合系敌人、火卫二的贪囤断肢或星图上的重型和卓越者单位）搜取导管钥匙（火卫二上的文卷），并把它们带到对应的导管处来启动导管并保护其免受来袭的爆破型单位或爆破使的破坏。
完成 |COUNT| 项歼灭任务。
排除者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Extermination.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是歼灭。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| Invasion missions of any type.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成 |COUNT| 项任何类型的入侵任务。
入侵者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Active Invasion missions can be found in the Invasions Tab of the Navigation menu. Support a side in the chosen Invasion for 3 missions to earn the listed Battle Pay.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 进行中的入侵任务可以在导航菜单的入侵标签中找到。在所选的入侵任务中支持一方并完成 3 个任务，即可获得列出的战区报酬。
完成 |COUNT| 个赤毒虹吸器任务
无需惧怕死神

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kuva Siphon missions appear on planets near the Kuva Fortress. Once you have located the Kuva Siphon in the mission, destroy the Kuva Clouds heading for the Siphon. The Kuva Siphon will point towards active Clouds. Kuva Clouds are vulnerable to the Operator's attacks and Void Sling.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 赤毒虹吸任务出现在赤毒要塞附近的星球上。在任务中找到赤毒虹吸器后，摧毁接近虹吸器的赤毒云雾。赤毒虹吸器会指向活跃中的赤毒云雾。赤毒云雾容易受到指挥官的攻击或虚空弹射的攻击。
完成 |COUNT| 项移动防御任务。
保护者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Mobile Defense.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是移动防御。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| Nightmare missions of any type.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成 |COUNT| 项任何类型的噩梦任务。
声之眠者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Nightmare missions spawn on planets once have completed all of the planet's nodes. Available Nightmare missions can be found in the Alert tab in the Navigation menu.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 一旦星球上的所有节点都完成，噩梦任务就会出现。可玩的噩梦任务在导航菜单的警报标签中找到。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Play Ollie's Crash Course and complete a race
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 游玩《奥利的极速赛道》并完成一场比赛
哎哟喂！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Go to the Höllvania Central Mall and find the Atomicycle arcade machines to play Ollie's Crash Course.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 前往霍瓦尼亚中央商场找到原子摩托车街机来游玩《奥利的极速赛道》。
完成 |COUNT| 项救援任务。
救援者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Rescue.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是救援。
完成 |COUNT| 项破坏任务。
破坏者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Sabotage.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是破坏。
完成 |COUNT| 次突击。
突击专家

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Select the Sortie from the World State panel in Navigation. You must finish all three missions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图的世界状态面板中选择突击任务。你必须完成所有三项任务。
完成 |COUNT| 项间谍任务。
特工

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Spy.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是间谍。
完成 |COUNT| 项集团任务。
支持者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Syndicate missions become available once you haved Pledged to a Syndicate via the segment in your Base of Operations. Syndicate Pledging is unlocked upon reaching Mastery Rank 3. Use the Syndicate tab in the Navigation Menu to find active Syndicate missions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在你的行动基地中，通过集团模块向集团宣誓效忠，即可解锁集团任务。集团效忠功能在达到精通段位 3 时解锁。使用星图导航中的集团标签页下寻找进行中的任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Look for Ayatan Treasures for Maroo in Maroo's Bazaar.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在 Maroo 的市集寻找 Maroo 的阿耶檀识宝物。
动像者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Visit Maroo in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars. Ask her about Ayatan Treasures and she will send you on a mission to retrieve one. You can socket Ayatan Stars into Sculptures by clicking the Ayatan Treasures button in the Mods workbench. Stars are uncommon items found in containers, while Sculptures are hidden items to search out during missions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在火星上 Maroo 的市集里拜访 Maroo。向她询问有关阿耶檀识宝物的情况，她会派你去完成一场取回宝物的任务。你可以在 Mod 操作台中的阿耶檀识宝物按钮，来将阿耶檀识之星插入到塑像中。阿耶檀识之星是罕见物品，可通过开启任务中的容器获得。而塑像则是需要在任务中专门寻找的隐藏物品。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a K-Drive race in Orb Vallis on Venus or in Cambion Drift on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在金星的奥布山谷或是火卫二的魔胎之境完成一场 K 式悬浮板比赛。
上板时刻

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Locate active K-Drive races in the Orb Vallis or Cambion Drift by jumping on your K-Drive and checking your Map to see their marked locations. Start a race by interacting with a Ventkid or Grandmother and driving through the first gate. Complete a race by successfully driving through each gate in the allotted time.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过跳上你的 K 式悬浮板来找到奥布山谷或是魔胎之境中的 K 式悬浮板比赛，并从你的地图中查看标记的位置。与通风小子或"祖母"互动并通过第一道门来开始比赛。在规定的时间内成功通过每道门完成一场比赛。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Destroy a Crewship with Forward Artillery
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用前装光能炮来摧毁一艘战舰
前瞻思想

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start a Railjack mission and destroy enemy fighters until a Crewship enters the sector. Head to the Forward Artillery located on the bridge behind the Navigation console.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 开始一个航道星舰任务并摧毁敌方战斗机群，一直到一艘战舰进入该星域。前往位于导航控制台后面舰桥上的前装光能炮。
完成 |COUNT| 场虚空决战任务。
永恒守卫

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Armageddon mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Oro Works node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 此游戏模式节点可通过星图上的「扎里曼 10-0 号」进入。从轨道飞行器的星图导航控制台开始虚空决战任务，或通过「扎里曼号」上羽化之穹的任务选择电梯选择奥金工场节点。
向 Helminth 饲喂任意资源。
喂饱野兽

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Obtain the Helminth Segment Blueprint from Son in the Necralisk after reaching Rank 3 with the Entrati. Feed resources to fuel various Secretions, which are then consumed by engaging with the Helminth system. Reset the Helminth's appetite for certain resources by feeding it items from the Sentient Appetite category.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 达到英择谛声望等级 3 后，可以从殁世幽都的"儿子"处获得 Helminth 模块蓝图。饲喂资源以产生各种分泌物，这些会在使用 Helminth 系统时被消耗掉。饲喂 Sentient 资源可以重置 Helminth 对特定资源的食欲。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Play a Shawzin song activity in Duviri
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在双衍王境进行一次演奏三线琴歌曲的活动
精准调音

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Look for Shawzin music areas while out exploring the Duviri Paradox. Each location has a different song to play!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 探索《双衍悖论》的同时寻找三线琴音乐区。每个地点都有不同的歌曲可供弹奏！
镀金 |COUNT| 个模块物品
镀金爱好者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Open one of each era/tier of Relic (Lith, Meso, Neo, Axi) |COUNT|.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 开启每个类型 |COUNT| 的遗物（古纪、前纪、中纪、后纪）。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Open one of each era/tier of Relic (|Req_VoidT1|, |Req_VoidT2|, |Req_VoidT3|, |Req_VoidT4|, |Req_VoidT5|) |COUNT|.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 打开每个纪元/等级的遗物（|Req_VoidT1|，|Req_VoidT2|，|Req_VoidT3|，|Req_VoidT4|，|Req_VoidT5|）|COUNT|。
收藏家
古纪
前纪
中纪
后纪
安魂

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start Void Fissure missions from Navigation and make sure you equip a Relic. Unlock the Relic by picking up Reactant dropped from killed enemies.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 可以从星图进行虚空裂缝任务，并确保你装备了遗物。通过捡起被击杀的敌人掉落的反应物来解开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete The Perita Rebellion with |COUNT| or more orders completed.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成佩里塔叛乱，并且完成至少 |COUNT| 个命令。
身经百战

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Unlock The Perita Rebellion after completing The Old Peace quest. Gain access to this mission using The Dark Refractory sub-menu on the Navigation Console.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《旧日和平》系列任务后即可解锁"佩里塔叛乱"。使用导航控制台上的深溯池子菜单即可进入此任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Activate the Incarnon Form of any Incarnon weapon in-mission |COUNT| times
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任务中激活任意灵化武器的灵化形态 |COUNT| 次
仪式的进化

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Incarnon Weapons can be obtained via Cavalero in the Chyrsalith, or by installing Incarnon Genesis Adapters earned through Steel Path Circuit. Build progress by landing headshots with guns or building Combo Counter with melee, then use <SECONDARY_FIRE> to evolve the weapon into its Incarnon form.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 灵化武器可以通过羽化之穹的卡瓦莱罗获得，或者通过安装从钢铁之路无尽回廊获得的灵化之源连接器获得。通过枪械爆头击杀或使用近战累积连击数来提升进度，接着使用<SECONDARY_FIRE>即可让武器进化为灵化形态。
收集 |COUNT| 种不同类型的资源。
资源清道夫

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Various Planets drop different resources. Use the "Resource Drones" toggle in the Navigation menu to view what resources drop on each Planet.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 不同的星球会掉落不同的资源。使用导航菜单中的"资源无人机"切换选项来查看每个星球会掉落的资源。
完成一次执刑官猎杀。
执刑官猎杀者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: This game mode is accessed from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or by visiting Kahl's Garrison in the Drifter's Camp. Archon Hunts are a set of three missions with the following restrictions; no self-revives, no use of deployable allies, and Squad Restores have a long cooldown. To begin the Hunt, you need a Rank 30 Warframe or a Warframe that has been polarized at least once if you are Mastery Rank 30 (or higher). Prepare your Arsenal to take on challenging enemies (level 130 and higher).  Completing the first two missions will bring you to the third and final Assassination mission, where you will face the currently active Archon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 这个游戏模式可以从轨道飞行器的导航控制台或漂流者营地的卡尔驻军访问。执刑官猎杀是一组的三个任务，有以下任务限制：不能自我复活，不能使用可部署的盟友，而且团队补给有很长的冷却时间。要开始猎杀，你需要一个等级 30 的战甲，或者如果你是精通段位 30（或更高）则需要一个至少极化过一次的战甲。准备好你的军械库，来迎接颇具挑战性的敌人（130 级及更高级别）。完成前两个任务将带你进入第三个也是最后一个刺杀任务，在那里你将面对当前活跃的执刑官。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a run of Deep Archimedea or Temporal Archimedea
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成一次深层科研或时光科研
自愿受试者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text:
Deep Archimedea can be accessed by speaking to the Necraloid in the Sanctum Anatomica after reaching Rank 5 with the Cavia. 
Temporal Archimedea can be accessed by speaking to Kaya in the Höllvania Central Mall after reaching Rank 5 with the Hex.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText:
达到科维兽声望等级 5 时，通过与解剖圣所中的殁世械灵交谈来开始深层科研。 
达到六人组声望等级 5 时，通过与霍瓦尼亚中央商场中的卡娅交谈来开始时光科研。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| Nightmare missions of any type.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成 |COUNT| 项任何类型的噩梦任务。
暗夜之恐

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from the Navigation console. Each planet will have one active Nightmare once you unlock all mission nodes on that planet.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。一旦你解锁了该星球上的所有任务节点，每个星球都会有一个可进行的噩梦任务。
完成 |COUNT| 次突击。
突击行家

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Select the Sortie from the World State panel in Navigation. You must finish all three missions, on three different days.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图的世界状态面板中选择突击任务。你必须在三天不同的时间完成所有三项任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a Spy mission using your Operator. Your Warframe cannot leave spawn room
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用你的指挥官完成一个间谍任务。你的战甲不能离开初始房间
偷偷摸摸
完成 |COUNT| 场不同的钢铁之路任务。
罕迹之路

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Switch to Steel Path mode on the right side of the Navigation screen.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图导航界面的右侧切换到钢铁之路模式。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| successful Conversions in the Alchemy game mode.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在元素转换游戏模式中完成 |COUNT| 次成功转换。
小菜一碟，亲爱的

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Gain access to the Alchemy mission on Cambire, Deimos after completing The Whispers in the Walls quest. Kill enemies to drop Amphors. Throw Amphors with a matching element type on the Crucible. Once the Crucible is full, maintain correct pressure by shooting distressed pipes to keep the gauge in the ideal window.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《墙中低语》任务后，即可在火卫二的异化区开启元素转换任务。击杀敌人将掉落元素瓶。将元素瓶投入相应元素的转换坩埚。坩埚装满后，射击损坏的管道以将压力表读数维持在理想范围内。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Defeat the Orowyrm in Steel Path
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在钢铁之路中击败奥金魇龙
精英野兽杀手

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The Orowyrm is the final encounter at the end of The Duviri Experience or The Lone Story missions in Duviri. Use a combination of Drifter and Warframe combat to triumph over the beast!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 奥金魇龙是双衍王境中，双衍历程或是孤独纪事任务末尾的最终敌人。使用漂泊者和战甲结合战斗来战胜这只野兽！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| Zones of Elite Sanctuary Onslaught.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成 |COUNT| 个精英级圣殿突袭区域。
精英测试对象

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start Elite Sanctuary Onslaught from the World State panel in Navigation after completing The New Strange quest. The 8 zones do not need to be completed in a single session
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《新疑谜团》系列任务后，即可在星图的世界状态面板中开始精英级圣殿突袭。不需要在单场任务中完成 8 个区域。
完成 |COUNT| 场虚空决战回合。
永恒守卫

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Armageddon mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Oro Works node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 此游戏模式节点可通过星图上的「扎里曼 10-0 号」进入。从轨道飞行器的星图导航控制台开始虚空决战任务，或通过「扎里曼号」上羽化之穹的任务选择电梯选择奥金工场节点。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete an Extermination mission with only level 30 or higher enemies without triggering alarms.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成一场 30 级或更高等级敌人的歼灭任务并且没有触发警报。
寂静歼灭

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from Navigation. The mission type must be Exterminate, and the starting level must be higher than 30.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是歼灭，并且起始等级必须高于 30。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Defeat |COUNT| Void Angels in the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在扎里曼号上击杀 |COUNT| 个虚空天使。
堕落天使

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Void Angels can be defeated in Void Armageddon missions after three waves of defending Exodampers or by waking dormant ones found throughout the other Zariman missions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在虚空决战任务中，虚空天使可以在经历三波保卫抑制装置后被击败，或通过唤醒其他扎里曼号任务中发现的休眠天使将其击败。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Finish a Capture mission in less than 90 seconds
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在 90 秒内完成一个捕获任务
极速战士

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Visit your Arsenal and equip a fast Warframe like Volt or Gauss, then go to the Navigation console and select a Capture node from the Star Chart. Chase and subdue your Capture target then complete the mission as fast as possible.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 前往军械库并装备如 Volt 或 Gauss 这样的高速战甲，然后前往导航控制台，从星图中选定一个捕获节点。追随并制服你的捕获目标，然后尽可能地快速完成任务。
明智之选

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a Defense mission reaching at least Wave 12.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成一场至少 12 波的防御任务。
防御

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from Navigation. Complete at least 12 waves in a single session before extracting from the mission.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从星图导航控制台开始新任务。在撤离之前，必须在单场任务中完成至少 12 波次的防御。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Defend both Mirror Defense objectives 3 times each in a single mission.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在单次任务中防御两个镜像防御目标各 3 次。
魔镜，魔镜

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Mirror Defense missions are available at Tyana Pass on Mars and Munio on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 镜像防御任务可在火星上的 Tyana Pass 和火卫二上的墓垒找到。
击杀利润收割者。
利润收割者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Take down the Profit-Taker via Heist missions in the Orb Vallis. Heists become unlocked once reaching Old Mate with the Solaris United. Venture to the backroom of Fortuna and speak to Eudico to start the briefing.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过奥布山谷的抢劫任务击败利润收割者。与索拉里斯联盟的声望达到"老朋友"等级后即可解锁抢劫任务。前往福尔图娜的密室与 Eudico 交谈以开始任务简报。
完成一项突击任务
突击任务

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a Survival mission reaching at least 20 minutes.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成一场至少 20 分钟的生存任务。
生存

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start new missions from Navigation. 20 minutes must be survived in a single session before extracting from the mission.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从星图导航控制台开始新任务。在撤离之前，必须在单场任务中存活 20 分钟。
在沉沦之地中击败罗瑟。
勇往直下

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Unlock The Descendia after completing The Old Peace quest. Gain access to this mission using The Dark Refractory sub-menu on the Navigation Console.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《旧日和平》系列任务后即可解锁"沉沦之地"。使用导航控制台上的深溯池子菜单即可进入此任务。
在虚空洪流中封闭 |COUNT| 个裂口
制高点

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Flood mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Everview Arc node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 此游戏模式节点可通过星图上的「扎里曼 10-0 号」进入。从轨道飞行器的星图导航控制台开始虚空洪流任务，或通过「扎里曼号」上羽化之穹的任务选择电梯选择永视弧域节点。
从深矿中收集 |COUNT| 个蘑菇。
满载而归

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Mushroom patches can be found in Deepmines Bounties, identified by their purple glow. Gain access to Deepmines Bounties by visiting Nightcap in the bowels of Fortuna after completing The New War quest.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 蘑菇丛可以在深矿赏金任务中找到，它们会发出紫色的光芒。完成《新纪之战》系列任务后，前往福尔图娜深处的气密舱里的夜帽，即可进入深矿赏金任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Win 3 wagers in a row in one match of The Index.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在《指数之场》的一场比赛中连续赢得 3 场投注。
日间商人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The Index is found in the Neptune region of the Star Chart.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 可在星图上的海王星区域找到指数之场。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| Enemies on The Steel Path.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在钢铁之路击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
寒冰玄铁

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally injured or killed during missions played on Steel Path mode are counted.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你在钢铁之路模式中亲自击杀的敌人才会被计入。
击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
杀戮

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally injured or killed are counted.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自击杀的敌人才会被计入。
击杀 |COUNT| 名卓越者。
卓越处刑者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Identify Eximus enemies in missions by their names and glowing auras.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任务中可通过名称和光环特效来识别卓越者敌人。
击杀剥削者圆蛛
唯利是图

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The Exploiter Orb is a Corpus Raknoid boss that roams the Orb Vallis. To fight her, you must first collect Diluted Thermia from the Orb Vallis Thermia Fractures Event. This monthly event requires you to close fractures on the Orb Vallis on Venus and can be accessed from your Navigation console on your Orbiter when active. A single Diluted Thermia is required to unlock Deck 12 to start the battle, which is located in the cave northeast of Harindi Crater.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 剥削者圆蛛是游荡在奥布山谷的一个 Corpus 蛛形机头目。要与她一决胜负，你必须先从奥布山谷的热美亚裂缝活动中收集稀释的热美亚。这个每月一次的活动进行时，你可以从你的轨道飞行器中的导航控制台来访问，该活动需要你先封闭金星上奥布山谷的裂缝。12 号甲板位于哈云滴陨石坑东北部的洞穴处，你需要一个稀释的热美亚来解锁 12 号甲板从而开始战斗。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill or Capture an Eidolon Hydrolyst.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 击杀或捕获一个夜灵水力使。
水力使猎人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Venture to the Plains of Eidolon during the night, and capture the Teralyst and Gantulyst to be able to summon the Hydrolyst. Capture Eidolons using charged Eidolon Lures. Place the rewarded Brilliant Eidolon Shards at the Gara Toht Lake shrine to summon the next Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在夜晚前往夜灵平野，捕获兆力使和巨力使后，即可召唤水力使。使用充能完毕的夜灵诱饵来捕获夜灵。将获得的闪亮的夜灵碎片放置于戛拉托特湖神龛，即可召唤下一个夜灵。
击败蝠力使
凌空高飞

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The Ropalolyst is a gigantic Sentient boss that resides on Jupiter. Start the Ropalolyst Assassination mission on Jupiter and use your Operator attacks and the environment to take the Ropalolyst down.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 蝠力使是位于木星中的巨大 Sentient 头目。在木星上开始蝠力使刺杀任务，使用你的指挥官进行攻击并利用环境来拿下蝠力使。
击败一名落银树庭魅影。
树庭守护者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Craft Apothics in the Foundry and add them to your Gear Wheel. Play forest missions on Earth and offer your Apothic to the Silver Grove to summon a Specter.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在铸造厂制作药剂并将它们添加到携带装备轮盘。在地球森林场景进行任务，并将药剂献给落银树庭来召唤一个魅影。
击败一辆 H-09 艾弗旺坦克
坦克破灭

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The H-09 Efervon Tank can be found on the Victory Plaza node in Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: H-09 艾弗旺坦克位于霍瓦尼亚的凯旋广场节点。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill a Tusk Thumper Doma in the Plains of Eidolon
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在夜灵平野上击杀一个巨牙重击者朵玛
无律之行

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Tusk Thumpers Doma are the Elite version of the Tusk Thumper field boss. They spawn in high level Bounties or on the Steel Path during daytime in the Plains of Eidolon. Defeat them by shooting their vulnerable leg plates and the weak points behind those.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 巨牙重击者朵玛是野外头目巨牙重击者的精英版。它们在夜灵平野白天的高等级赏金任务或钢铁之路模式中生成。通过击中它们脆弱的腿甲及腿甲下的弱点来打败它们。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Survive for over 20 minutes in Kuva Survival.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在赤毒生存任务中生存超过 20 分钟。
屏住你的呼吸

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Must be completed at the location Taveuni on the Kuva Fortress in a single session.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 必须在赤毒要塞 Taveuni 节点的单场任务中完成这一挑战。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| Halls of Ascension on Lua.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成 |COUNT| 间月球上的晋升大厅。
上行

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Halls of Ascension are puzzle rooms exclusive to missions on Lua. Complete them to earn Drift Mods.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 晋升大厅是月球任务专属的解谜房间。完成后可获得窜升系列 Mod。
在双衍王境中完成 3 个谜题
谜惑不解

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Collect Enigma Gyrum by completing puzzles in The Duviri Experience. Look for pillars with blue letters for the code to each puzzle.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过完成双衍历程中的谜题来收集奥理刻珠。寻找带有蓝色字母的柱子来找到每个谜题的代码。
完成 |COUNT| 项航道星舰任务
精英探险家

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: While in Navigation, use the Railjack button on the top right to switch to the Railjack Proximas. Complete the specified number of non-Free Flight Proxima missions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图导航中，使用右上角的航道星舰按钮切换到航道星舰比邻星域。完成指定数量的非自由航行比邻星任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| enemies using a Necramech without getting destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用殁世机甲击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人并且不被摧毁。
机甲崛起

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Summon your owned Necramech in eligible missions using the Necramech Summon on your Gear Wheel. If you do not own a Necramech, you can commandeer a Necramech using Transference (after The War Within quest) in the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在符合条件的任务中，使用携带装备轮盘上的召唤殁世机甲来召唤你拥有的殁世机甲。如果你尚未拥有殁世机甲，你可以在魔胎之境当"混乱"占据主导地位时，使用传识（需要完成《内战》系列任务）来征用殁世机甲。
完成一场织屿人双衍王境任务。
蜘蛛狩猎

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The Isleweaver mission can be found in the Duviri navigation menu after completing both The Duviri Paradox and The Hex quests.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《双衍悖论》和《六人组》系列任务后，即可在双衍王境导航菜单中找到《织屿人》任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete a Spy mission with 3 manual console hacks and no alarms
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成一个间谍任务，并在任务中手动入侵三个控制台且没有触发警报
机器干扰
消灭 |COUNT| 名隔离库殁世机甲守卫。
终结者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Visit Mother in the Necralisk on Deimos and select any Isolation Vault Bounty. Defeat the Necramechs that appear in Stage 3.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 造访位于火卫二殁世幽都的"母亲"并选择任意隔离库赏金任务。击败在第 3 阶段出现的殁世机甲。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Exchange 10 Riven Slivers for a Riven Mod
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 用 10 个裂罅碎块换取一张裂罅 Mod
聚沙成卡

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Visit Palladino in Iron Wake on Earth to exchange Riven Slivers for a veiled Riven Mod. Riven Slivers can be earned from Requiem Relics, Railjack missions, and Eximus enemies in the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 造访位于地球「钢铁守望」要塞的 Palladino，用裂罅碎块换取未揭开的裂罅 Mod 。裂罅碎块可以从安魂遗物、航道星舰任务以及钢铁之路中的卓越者敌人处获得。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Free one Captured Solaris using a Granum Crown.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用一枚格拉努硬币来解救一名索拉里斯人质。
自由的代价

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Enter any Corpus Ship node to find a Captured Solaris. Granum Crowns are dropped from Treasurers when defeated.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 前往任意有 Corpus飞船的任务节点寻找索拉里斯人质。击败司库后会掉落格拉努硬币。
完成一次衰退室。
来自过去的宝藏

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Enter the Anchorhold by talking to Tagfer in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos. Access to Netracells requires completion of The Whispers in the Walls quest.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 要进入安全所，请前往火卫二的解剖圣所与标弃交谈。进入衰退室需要先完成《墙中低语》系列任务。
解开 |COUNT| 个遗物
解开遗物

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start Void Fissure missions from Navigation and make sure you equip a Relic. Unlock the Relic by picking up Reactant dropped by slain enemies.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 可以从星图进行虚空裂缝任务，记得确保你装备了遗物。通过捡起被杀死的敌人掉落的反应物来解开遗物。
完成一场仲裁任务
关键仲裁者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Arbitration Alerts become available upon completing the Pluto to Eris junction in the Star Chart.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 仲裁警报任务在完成星图中冥王星到阋神星的接合点后开放。
在扎里曼号完成 |COUNT| 次赏金任务。
扎里曼赏金猎人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Select and begin a Bounty by talking to Quinn in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 登录「扎里曼号」，通过与羽化之穹中的奎因交谈来选择并开始赏金任务。
完成 |COUNT| 场虚空洪流任务。
制高点

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: This game mode node is accessed from the Zariman Ten Zero on the Star Chart. Start the Void Flood mission from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or select the Everview Arc node from the mission select elevator located in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 此游戏模式节点可通过星图上的「扎里曼 10-0 号」进入。从轨道飞行器的星图导航控制台开始虚空洪流任务，或通过「扎里曼号」上羽化之穹的任务选择电梯选择永视弧域节点。
驾驭绝灵骥飞行 |COUNT| 米
马上漫游

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Your Kaithe can be summoned in Duviri. With the Drifter Intrinsic "Equestrian Bond", Kaithes can also be summoned in any Landscape using the Gear Wheel!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 你的绝灵骥可以在双衍王境里召唤。拥有漂泊者内源之力"意念合一"后，也可以通过携带装备轮盘在任何开放世界中召唤绝灵骥！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Collect |COUNT| Decrees in a single Duviri session, or run of The Circuit.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在单次双衍王境进程或无尽回廊中收集 |COUNT| 个王令。
我的王令

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Collect Decrees in Duviri Spirals by completing main objectives and optional Anecdotes in a single session. Collect Decrees in The Circuit by completing Stages and collecting Decree Fragments hidden throughout the mission.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过在单次进程中完成主要目标和可选秘闻来收集双衍王境复眠螺旋中的王令。在无尽回廊中，通过完成各个阶段，或在期间通过搜集隐藏在各处的王令碎片来获得王令。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete an Isolation Vault Bounty Mission in the Cambion Drift on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在火卫二的魔胎之境中完成一个隔离库赏金任务。
宝库强袭者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Begin the Bounty by either talking to Mother in the Necralisk or finding her in the Cambion Drift on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 与殁世幽都的"母亲"交谈或在火卫二的魔胎之境中找到她来开始赏金任务。
使用曲翼枪械击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人
重型火炮

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Enter either an Archwing mission or equip one of your Archguns with a Gravimag to use it in normal missions. To access an Archgun during non-Archwing missions, equip the Archgun Deployer to your Gear Wheel to summon it.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 进入一场曲翼任务，或是为你的曲翼枪械装备重力磁抵器以在普通的任务中使用该武器。想要在非曲翼任务期间使用曲翼枪械，请将曲翼枪械设置器装备到携带装备轮盘中以召唤该武器。
使用殁世机甲击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
殁世者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Summon your owned Necramech in eligible missions using the Necramech Summon on your Gear Wheel. If you do not own a Necramech, you can commandeer a Necramech using Transference (after The War Within quest) in the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在符合条件的任务中，使用携带装备轮盘上的召唤殁世机甲来召唤你拥有的殁世机甲。如果你尚未拥有殁世机甲，你可以在魔胎之境当"混乱"占据主导地位时，使用传识（需要完成《内战》系列任务）来征用殁世机甲。
爆头击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
这不是警告射击

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The final hit must be on the head.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 最后一击必须要击中头部。
击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
这不是警告射击

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally injured or killed are counted.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自击杀的敌人才会被计入。
击杀 |COUNT| 名卓越者。
卓越歼灭者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Identify Eximus enemies in missions by their names and glowing auras.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任务中通过名称和光环特效来识别卓越者敌人。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill a Tusk Thumper in the Plains of Eidolon
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在夜灵平野上击杀一个巨牙重击者
巨牙重击

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Tusk Thumpers are field bosses that spawn during daytime in the Plains of Eidolon. Defeat them by shooting their vulnerable leg plates and the weak points behind those.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 巨牙重击者是在夜灵平野白天生成的野外头目。通过击中他们脆弱的腿甲及腿甲下的弱点来打败他们。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Gain a total of |COUNT| Standing across all Syndicate factions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 获得 |COUNT| 任意集团的声望。
忠心耿耿

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Gain Standing by completing Syndicate-specific missions or pledging your allegiance to a Faction Syndicate and playing regular missions. Complete Bounties and trade with Merchants to gain Standing with town hub Syndicates.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过完成集团特定任务、或效忠派系集团并游玩常规任务来获取声望。完成赏金任务并与商人进行交易，以获取城镇集团的声望。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Plunder one of Alad V's secret laboratories on Jupiter.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在木星上扫荡一座阿拉德 V 的秘密实验室。
疯狂实验室

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Explore the Corpus Gas City tileset in a mission on Jupiter to find a locked orange door, behind it is one of Alad V's laboratories. A series of tasks must be performed to get inside the inner chamber. Once inside take everything you see!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在木星上探索 Corpus 集气城市场景，以找到一扇上锁的橙色大门。阿拉德 V 实验室的其中一间就在那扇门后面，你需要通过完成一系列任务以进入这扇门。一旦进去就拿走你看到的一切！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Mine |COUNT| Rare Gems or Ore in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在夜灵平野中开采到 |COUNT| 次稀有宝石或矿石。
地球矿工

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The vendor Old Man Suumbaat in Cetus can supply you with mining equipment. Add a mining tool to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and activate it while on the Plains. Look for glowing minerals on rocks and carefully drill each weak point.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 希图斯的老者松巴可以为你提供采矿装备。在军械库装备一件采矿工具到携带装备轮盘，并在平野启用它。寻找岩石上发光的矿物质，并仔细钻探每一个薄弱点。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Mine |COUNT| Rare Gems or Ore in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在奥布山谷中开采到 |COUNT| 次稀有宝石或矿石。
金星矿工

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: The vendor Smokefinger in Fortuna can supply you with mining equipment. Add a mining tool to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and activate it while on the Orb Vallis. Look for glowing minerals on rocks and carefully drill each weak point.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 福尔图娜的烟指可以为你提供采矿装备。在军械库装备一件采矿工具到携带装备轮盘，并在奥布山谷启用它。寻找岩石上发光的矿物质，并仔细钻探每一个薄弱点。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Collect |COUNT| Vome or Fass Residue in the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在魔胎之境中收集 |COUNT| 个"秩序"或"混乱"的残留物。
日日夜夜

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Enter the Cambion Drift on Deimos in Navigation. Scour the landscape for areas glowing in orange (Vome) or blue (Fass), there you will find Residue deposits. Destroy them to obtain Residue, and earn progress once you have safely extracted from the Cambion Drift.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从星图导航中前往火卫二的魔胎之境。在地图中寻找发出橙色光芒（"秩序"）或是蓝色光芒（"混乱"）的区域，并从中发现"秩序"或"混乱"残留物沉积。摧毁它们以获得相应的残留物，并从魔胎之境安全撤离后获得进度。
打开 |COUNT| 个储物柜。
盗窃癖

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Approach Lockers in missions and Interact with them.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在任务中靠近并打开储物柜。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| different Perfect Animal Captures in Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在奥布山谷完成 |COUNT| 个不同动物的完美捕获。
保育者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Conservation requires the Tranq Rifle and Echo-Lures, which can be obtained from The Business in Fortuna. Equip these items to your Gear Wheel via the Arsenal. Once in the Orb Vallis, equip the Tranq Rifle or Echo-lure and check the Advanced Map for starting points to begin your hunt. Perfect Captures require the animal to be Tranquilized without it seeing you or being injured.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 保育需要麻醉步枪和回声诱饵，这些物品可以从福尔图娜中的操盘手处获得。通过军械库将这些物品装备到你的携带装备轮盘。进入奥布山谷后，装备麻醉步枪或是回声诱饵，并查看进阶地图来寻找狩猎的起始点。完美捕获要求动物在没有发现你或受伤的情况下被麻醉。
完成 |COUNT| 项任务
任务完成 X

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图中的每个星球上都可以找到任务。
