在双衍王境中完成 1 个谜题
谜惑不解

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Collect Enigma Gyrum by completing puzzles in The Duviri Experience. Look for pillars with blue letters for the code to each puzzle.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过完成双衍历程中的谜题来收集奥理刻珠。寻找带有蓝色字母的柱子来找到每个谜题的代码。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Find |COUNT| Syndicate Medallions. You can search by yourself or with a squad.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 找到 |COUNT| 集团奖章。可以自己搜索，也可以组队搜索。
狩猎开始

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start a mission from the Syndicate tab in Navigation. Syndicate Medallions are manual pick-ups that can be found throughout the mission. Loot Radar Mods such as Animal Instinct, and Thief's Wit can help locate them via the minimap.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 从星图导航中的集团标签下开始任务。在任务中可以找到并手动拾取集团奖章。使用寻物雷达 Mod，比如动物本能和盗贼天赋，能为你在小地图中标记它们。
拾取 |COUNT| 个稀有 Mod
增强！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Mods frequently drop from killed enemies. Rare mods have a golden glow when dropped and a golden border when picked up.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: Mod 经常从被击杀的敌人身上掉落。稀有 Mod 掉落时会发出金色光芒，捡起时会出现金色边框。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在夜灵平野完成 |COUNT| 个赏金任务。
地球赏金猎人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start Bounties by either talking to Konzu in Cetus or going directly to the Plains of Eidolon and finding Bounty Source outposts.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 赏金任务可以通过与希图斯的孔尊交谈，或是直接前往夜灵平野，并找到一处赏金任务前哨战来开始。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: While piloting a hijacked Crewship, destroy 3 enemy fighters
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在驾驶劫持的战舰时，消灭 3 架敌方战斗机
友军炮火

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start a Railjack mission and destroy enemy fighters until a Crewship enters the sector. Approach with your Archwing and enter it to hijack it from the enemy. The front section of the ship has a pilot seat which gives you access to the ship’s controls and weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 开始一个航道星舰任务并摧毁敌方战斗机群，一直到一艘战舰进入该星域。使用你的 Archwing 靠近、入侵并劫持它。敌人战舰的头部有一个飞行驾驶位，使用它能够登入该船的控制和武器系统。
完成 |COUNT| 项航道星舰任务
探险家

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: While in Navigation, use the Railjack button on the top right to switch to the Railjack Proximas. Complete the specified number of non-Free Flight Proxima missions.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在星图导航中，使用右上角的航道星舰按钮切换到航道星舰比邻星域。完成指定数量的非自由航行比邻星任务。
在火卫二激活 3 座安魂方尖碑。
远古方尖碑

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Broken Requiem Obelisks are scattered across the Cambion Drift of Deimos. Focus your Operator or Drifter's Void energy on an Obelisk's core to charge it.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 损坏的安魂方尖碑散落在火卫二的魔胎之境各处。将指挥官或漂泊者的虚空能量集中在方尖碑的核心上为其充能。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Rifle.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用主要步枪击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
步枪进攻

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Rifle count. Eligible weapons can be found in the primary Rifle category in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用主要步枪击杀的敌人才会被计入。符合条件的武器可以在军械库的主要步枪分类中找到。
在任意任务中找到 |COUNT| 个储藏箱。
箱子猎人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Resource Caches can appear as a secondary objective, meaning they will be listed as an optional objective if they spawned in the mission. Eligible missions include various types of Sabotage missions, but they can also be found in Lua Exterminate and Kuva Exterminate missions, and in certain Bounty objectives on Open Landscapes.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 资源储藏箱可能会作为次要目标出现。若其在任务中生成，则会被列为可选目标。可出现资源储藏箱的任务包括各种破坏任务，以及月球歼灭、赤毒歼灭任务，和开放世界中的特定赏金任务目标上。
完成 |COUNT| 个圣殿突袭的区域。
测试对象

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start Sanctuary Onslaught from the World State panel in Navigation after completing The New Strange quest. The 8 zones do not need to be completed in a single session.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《新疑谜团》系列任务后，即可在星图的世界状态面板中开始圣殿突袭任务。不需要在单场任务中完成 8 个区域。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Shotgun.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用主要霰弹枪击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
霰弹枪进攻

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Shotgun count. Eligible weapons can be found in the primary Shotgun category in the Arsenal.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用主要霰弹枪击杀的敌人才会被计入。符合条件的武器可以在军械库的主要霰弹枪分类中找到。
完成 |COUNT| 个中枢 Simaris 的扫描。
圣殿研究者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Request a Synthesis assignment from Cephalon Simaris on a Relay and find the assigned enemy type. You can acquire Synthesis Scanner charges from his Offerings.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在中继站通过中枢 Simaris 接下结合仪式任务，并找到指定类型的敌人。你可以从他的声望奖励获取结合扫描器。
在双衍王境击杀 |COUNT| 名禁卫敌人
不为人知的事

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Dax enemies can be found in The Lone Story, The Duviri Experience, and The Circuit missions after completing The Duviri Paradox quest.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《双衍悖论》系列任务后，即可在孤独纪事、双衍历程和无尽回廊任务中找到禁卫敌人。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Sniper Rifle.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 使用主要狙击步枪击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
狙击枪进攻

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Only enemies that you personally kill using your Primary Sniper count.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 只有你亲自使用主要狙击枪击杀的敌人才会被计入。
入侵 |COUNT| 个控制台。
黑客

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Interact with a console and then complete the hacking minigame. Using ciphers counts!
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 与控制台互动，然后完成入侵小游戏。使用破解器也会被计入！

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete 1 mission with only a single pistol and a glaive equipped.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 仅装备一把手枪和战刃来完成 1 次任务。
老路子

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Equip only a Pistol as your Secondary and Glaive as your Melee weapon before entering a mission.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在只装备手枪作为次要武器、战刃作为近战武器的情况下开始一场任务。
为荧尘分解一个赋能。
化为灰烬

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Dissolve Arcanes via Loid in the Sanctum Anatomica on Deimos after completing The Whispers in the Walls quest. Use the "Dissolve Arcanes" option to dissolve Arcanes into Vosfor, which can then be used to purchase Arcane packs.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 完成《墙中低语》系列任务后，前往火卫二的解剖圣所，通过洛德分解赋能。选择"分解赋能"选项，即可将赋能分解为荧尘，荧尘可用于购买赋能组合包。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Unlock |COUNT| Dragon Key vaults on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 解锁 |COUNT| 个火卫二龙钥宝库。
宝库劫者

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Orokin Vaults are found in Orokin Derelict tileset missions on Deimos. There are four different Dragon Keys, of which one random kind is used to unlock the Vault. The correct Dragon Key must be equipped on your Gear Wheel during the mission to unlock it. Multilpe keys can be equipped at a time if desired, or different keys can be carried by squadmates. Obtain Dragon Key blueprints via Clan Dojo research, then build them in the Foundry.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 奥罗金宝库可以在火卫二的奥罗金遗迹场景的任务中找到。一共有四种不同的龙钥，会随机使用其中一种来解锁宝库。任务中必须将正确的龙钥装备在你的携带装备轮盘中才能解锁宝库。如果需要，可以同时装备多个龙钥，或由小队成员携带不同的龙钥。龙钥蓝图可以通过在氏族道场研究获得，然后在铸造厂进行制造。
解开 |COUNT| 个遗物
解开遗物

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start Void Fissure missions from Navigation and make sure you equip a Relic. Unlock the Relic by picking up Reactant dropped from killed enemies.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 可以从星图进行虚空裂缝任务，并确保你装备了遗物。通过捡起被击杀的敌人掉落的反应物来解开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Polarize a Weapon, Companion, or Warframe (not in Simulacrum).
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 极化一个武器、同伴或战甲（不在幻影装置中）。
已极化

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Forma blueprints are earned from Void Relics, or built Forma can be obtained from the Market or various vendors throughout the Origin System. Once acquired, open the equipment's Upgrade menu in the Arsenal, and select Actions to Polarize the item with Forma. Installing Forma applies a new Polarity Slot, which reduces the cost of matching Polarity Mods installed in that Slot.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: Forma 蓝图可以通用虚空遗物获得，或者也可以在游戏内商店或始源星系各地的商人那里获得成品 Forma。获得后，在军械库打开装备的升级菜单中，选择指令按钮来用 Forma 对装备进行极化。安装 Forma 会赋予槽位新的极性，可减少安装在该槽位上与之相符极性 Mod 的容量消耗。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| Bounties in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在奥布山谷完成 |COUNT| 个赏金任务。
金星赏金猎人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Start Bounties by either talking to Eudico in Fortuna or going directly to the Orb Vallis and finding a Solaris contact to speak to.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 通过与福尔图娜的 Eudico 交谈，或是直接前往奥布山谷，并找到可与之交谈的索拉里斯联系人来开始赏金任务。
收集 |COUNT| 个虚空光体。
虚空之网

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Void Traces can be obtained from playing Void Fissure missions. You are awarded some after collecting 10 Reactant in-mission from defeated Corrupted enemies.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 虚空光体可通过完成虚空裂缝任务获得。在任务中，从击败的堕落者敌人身上收集 10 个反应物后，即可获得一些虚空光体。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Complete |COUNT| different Bounties in the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 在扎里曼号完成 |COUNT| 项不同的赏金任务。
扎里曼赏金猎人

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.text: Select and begin a Bounty by talking to Quinn in the Chrysalith aboard the Zariman.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Chal.zhText: 登录「扎里曼号」，通过与羽化之穹中的奎因交谈来选择并开始赏金任务。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.text:
Shigg-

Have you dropped your mind? We’ve chipped on those scaffolds together since we were kids. Filled your empty bowl with half of mine. Every time. That is our way, our law.

I’m giving you until moonfall before Elder Konzu hears you’ve been skimming.

-|HINT|
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.zhText:
希格-

你疯了吗？我们从小就在这些脚手架上打拼生活。我跟你分享我有的一切，甚至是把我的食物分一半给你。每次都是这样。这是我们的方式，我们之间的铁律。

你最好在月落之前搞定那件事，不然孔尊长者就会听说你那些偷鸡摸狗的小动作。

-|HINT|

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.text:
'By the Unum' nothing! I am connected, you understand? I am told your client can only be one person. How you found them I do not know but by the Void we will all pay for your ignorance. And now you've dragged me into this? That they even know my name is a gun to my head! 

Now: either you get me an Orokin-era |HINT| or this broadcast unit is as good as dead. And so are we. 

-BV
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.zhText:
说什么"以乌努母神之名"，全都是胡扯！我身边的关系错综复杂，牵一发而动全身，你懂吗？有人告诉我你只接一个客户。我不知道你是怎么找到他们的，但是我以虚空起誓我们这次得为你的无知付出代价。现在你又把我卷进了这件事？哪怕他们只是知道了我的名字，这都相当于是在我头上悬着一把刀！

所以，你要么给我弄来一个奥罗金时代的|HINT|，要么这座广播台就完蛋了。我们也一样。

-BV

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.text:
You remind me of this Venusian kid I knew, pitched me a big score reselling K-charges on the low market. Look at all those munitions, he said, like a threshcone harvest!

Kid was talking about those lanes of unexploded Grineer field ordnance. Just drift up and pluck those detonators off, real gentle. Easy money! You heard of him? See?

Easy money packs hard truth.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.zhText:
你让我想起了这个金星来的孩子，他说服我在低价市场上转卖 K 式弹药让我狠狠赚了一笔。"看看这遍地的弹药"，他说道，"这简直像是去壳毬果的大丰收！"

这个孩子说的是那一列列还没爆炸的 Grineer 战地火炮。只需要小心接近然后轻轻卸下那些引信。钱来得容易得很！你听说过他吗？

你看到了吗？快钱其实伴随着残酷的事实。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.text: The eye projects a flickering symbol from its faintingly glowing gem.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cet.zhText: 这一眼状物从其散发着微弱光芒的宝石中投射出一个闪烁的符号。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.text: A datapad containing a catalog of luxury items - the kind affordable only by the highest echelons of Corpus society.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.zhText: 一个包含奢侈品目录的数据板 — 只有 Corpus 社会中最上流的阶级才消费得起的那种。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.text: Transmit wave reading shows |HINT| Picos, not great, not terrible. Should link up fine to whatever interface this Ostron's got.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.zhText: 发射波的读数显示为 |HINT| 皮可，不是很高，不是很糟。应该能正常连接到这个 Ostron 人手头上的任意接口。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.text: Variant of the standard-issue Corpus workforce gear. Serves protection and identity-masking requirements.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.zhText: 这是 Corpus 劳力工作者穿戴的标准装备的其中一种。符合为穿戴者提供保护以及隐匿身份的要求。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.text: A typical Corpus identification plaque. Assignment details on reverse.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.zhText: 一个典型的 Corpus 身份识别证明。背面写着佩戴者的具体职务信息。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.text:
Some Corpus I turned out to be. Helping refugees, smuggling debt slaves. Mother would turn white if she could see me now. 

Running this wheel... it’s |HINT|.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Cor.zhText:
看看我变成了什么样的 Corpus。帮助难民，走私债务奴隶。要是母亲看到我现在的样子，肯定气得脸都白了。

就像这转动的仓鼠轮……一切都是|HINT|。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ent.text:
Search crime scenes to gather evidence.

Use the evidence to navigate the mysterious Glassmaker's Weave for clues about the killer.

Battle Cephalites in missions to earn required Cephalite Resonance (5) to enter the Weave.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ent.zhText:
调查犯罪现场来收集证据。

使用证据来找到神秘玻璃匠的织网，以获取有关凶手的线索。

在任务中与中枢人进行战斗来收集进入织网所需要的 5 个中枢人共鸣。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.text:
Learnings of the Motherworld, New Loka Essays.

"We were designed by the Earth to live as part of the Earth. We cannot truly belong anywhere else, not in the whole of the universe."
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.zhText:
地球母亲的学问，新世间随笔。

"我们是由地球设计，作为地球的一部分来生活的。我们不会真正归属于任何其他地方，整个宇宙中都没有这样的地方。"

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.text:
Opportunity and Acuity, Protocols of The Perrin Sequence.

"'Create a problem then sell the solution!' No. To embrace Fraudulence is to embrace Idleness. Idleness creates dull minds. Dull minds fail. No. Opportunity is our watchword. Opportunity, and acuity."
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.zhText:
机会与敏锐，佩兰数列的协议。

"‘制造一个问题，然后出售解决方案！'不是的，认同欺诈就意味着认同懒惰。懒惰让人头脑迟钝。头脑迟钝导致失败。不是的，机会是我们的口号。机会和敏锐。"

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.text:
On Strength, Cressa Tal.

"We think where once we obeyed. We bend where once we broke."
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.zhText:
关于力量，Cressa Tal。

"过去我们会服从，但现在这会让我们思考。过去我们会被击垮，但现在这只会让我们折腰。"

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.text: Gral born big. Big Gral follow. Small slugs hide. Big Gral find. Big kill small. Now Gral is small. No more |HINT|.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.zhText: 格拉尔生来大。大格拉尔追。小虫藏。大格拉尔寻。大杀小。如今格拉尔成小虫。|HINT|不再有。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.text: A plush toy, loved and well-worn... by a Grineer? Or does it hold some deeper, sadder significance?
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.zhText: 一件毛绒玩具，被一个……Grineer 喜爱，并且被用的破旧不堪？还是说它有某种更深刻的、更悲惨的意义？

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.text: Grineer comm-link circuits. Broad spectrum, ultra-long range. Weak cipher systems make remote compromise trivial.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Gri.zhText: Grineer 通讯电路。广谱，可超长距离传输。其脆弱的加密系统使得远程攻击不是一件难事。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.text: A device for interfacing with the Weave. These markings indicate an unusual connection signature.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.zhText: 与织网连接的设备。这些标记指出了一个不常见的连接签名。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.text: Metal restraints etched with the number |HINT|.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.zhText: 刻有数字 |HINT| 的金属镣铐。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.text: The shattered remnants of one who once received Nihil's judgement.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.zhText: 曾受无刹审判之人的破碎残骸。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.text: A tablet containing codifications of the laws enforced by Nihil.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.zhText: 一块包含无刹所执行的法律汇编的平板。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.text: Once carried by Nihil's jailers. This weapon was likely never needed, there was no escaping Nihil's judgement.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inf.zhText: 曾由无刹的狱卒携带。这把武器很可能未曾被用到过，无刹的判决是无法逃脱的。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ins.text:
Insufficient Cephalite Resonance to enter (|AMOUNT|/|REQUIRED|).

The Origin System will be regularly influenced by the Glassmaker. Play missions to earn Cephalite Resonance.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ins.zhText:
没有足够的中枢人共鸣来进入（|AMOUNT| / |REQUIRED|）。

始源星系将定期受到玻璃匠的影响。进行任务来获取中枢人共鸣。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Inv.zhText:
<PRE_ATTACK>互动（|REQUIRED| 中枢人共鸣）
|EXIT_CALLOUT| 结束检查

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Lea.text: You must return to your ship first.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Lea.zhText: 你必须先回到你的飞船上。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Nor.zhText: 诺拉的混选 Vol. 4 代币
诺拉的混选 Vol. 7 代币
诺拉的混选：时间风暴代币
诺拉的混选 Vol. 1 代币

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Nor.zhText: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。

Nora's Mix:
Dreams of the Dead Cred

诺拉的混选：
亡者之梦代币

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Nor.zhText: 用于购买午夜电波的贡品。过往的午夜电波系列兑换币可以留作纪念品或出售换取 <CREDITS>现金。
诺拉的混选 Vol. 8 代币

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.text: A standard data tablet containing a personnel file for |HINT| and several other victims of the Glassmaker.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.zhText: 一个数据平板，它包含 |HINT| 的个人档案以及其它多位玻璃匠受害者。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.text: Description: A data tablet that has seen heavy usage. Files are open on |HINT|.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.zhText: 描述：一个被重度使用过的数据平板。|HINT|的文件被打开了。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.text: A data tablet containing several encrypted dossiers.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.zhText: 一个内含多个加密档案的数据平板。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.text:
Low capacity data storage device.

"We had it good under the Corpus. Debt in check. A future. Then Solaris United got into Mum and Dad's heads. And then Deck 12. They're gone, and I'm here, with all their debt and mine as well. I hear Vox knew Deck 12 was a risk, and Vox sent them all down there anyway. To burn."
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.zhText:
低容量数据存储设备。

"我们在 Corpus 的管辖下混得不错。债务得到了控制。未来可期。后来索拉里斯联盟钻进了妈妈和爸爸的脑袋。随后他们去了 12 号甲板。他们走了，而我在这里，背负着所有他们和我的债务。我听说"索拉里斯之声"知道 12 号甲板有风险，但"索拉里斯之声"还是把他们都送到那里去了。去被烧个精光。"

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.text: Part of an unknown communications device intended for transmissions in the |HINT| mGal range.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Oro.zhText: 一个未知通信设备的一部分，这个设备是用来在 |HINT| mGal 区间进行传输的 。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ret.text: Exit Crime Scene? Revisit using the Nightwave interface.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Ret.zhText: 离开犯罪现场？可以使用午夜电波界面来重新进入。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Tim.text: Cephalite Resonance used to enter the Glassmaker's Weave
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Tim.zhText: 被用于进入玻璃匠织网的中枢人共鸣

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.text: Cutter's final note 'To whoever finds this'
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.zhText: 卡特"给任何找到这段话的人"的最后留言

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.text:
I'm not proud. Never been proud. Just angry. It's all I ever had, and now I can let it go, knowing I made this happen. The System took it all from me, so the balance is squared. Let Nihil do what he will. His version of order can't be any worse than debt or war.

The traitors, the deceivers, will all get their time before him. Myself included - the Solaris turncoat.

I've played my part. Everything is in place. I know what awaits me. And I don't care. It was worth it.

Maybe the terror will keep people honest. Maybe that'll be a better life. Better than the one Vox took from me.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.zhText:
我从未得意过。从来没有。只有怒火，是我曾经唯一拥有的。而现在我可以释怀了，因为我知道我就是始作俑者。始源星系从我这里夺走了一切，所以现在一切都翻篇了。让无刹去做他想做的事吧。他所谓的秩序不会比债务或战争更糟糕了。

叛徒们和骗子们都会受到他的惩罚。也包括我自己－索拉里斯的叛徒。

我已经完成了我的部分。一切都已就绪。我知道等待我的是什么。我不在乎。一切都是值得的。

也许恐惧会让人们诚实守信。也许这样的生活会更好。比"索拉里斯之声"从我这里夺走的生活更好。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.text:
Lived too long in the shadow of the Tower. I had allowed myself the belief that all things Orokin were good, as the Unum is good. Not so. The past is no tree of plenty, not all of its fruits sweet.

Ah, that this should be the last thing I learn: 'not so.' 'Not so', learned at the hand of a demon self-made...
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.zhText:
在塔下的阴影中生活了太久。我已经让自己相信奥罗金的一切都很好，因为乌努母神很好。并不是这样的。往昔的森林里并没有枝叶茂密的树，它结的果子也并非全部都是香甜的。

啊，这应该是我学到的最后一件事："并不是这样的。" 从一个自我养成的恶魔那里学到"并不是这样的"。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.text: Colonial after-action report: Colonial Killsquad Trooper 67229 reported crossfire confusion. Is that true? Killsquad casualties were total with only Trooper 67229 returning. Trooper 67229 scheduled for recondition spiking at Saturn Five. Demotion to maintenance tier effective immediately.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.zhText: 殖民事后报告：殖民歼灭小队的 67229 号士兵报告说交火混乱。这是事实吗？歼灭小队伤亡殆尽，只有 67229 号士兵活着回来了。67229 号士兵本应在土星五号进行修整升级。现将其降为维护级别，立即生效。

/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.text:
With one mistake, the spreadsheet of my life tallies to a net ill. I have loosed a whirlwind upon the System - all life exposed beneath its mad and furious gaze. 

A dead thing furious at death. A lost thing that would steal meaning from all life. An ancient doom, and I have welcomed it in.
/Lotus/Language/NightwaveSeasonThree/Wea.zhText:
就这一个错误，使我毕生的努力都化作了乌有。我已经在星系内释放出了一道毁灭旋风 — 所有生命也都处于它那疯狂和愤怒的注视下。

一件死物为死亡而感到愤怒。迷失了自我的它将会偷走所有生命生存的意义。一个远古末日的到来，我已对此表示了欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/AssassinateB.text: Draw Out the Target in |VALUE| Seconds

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/AssassinateB.zhText: 在时间限制内完成额外目标

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.text:
A volatile mushroom with an acrid odor similar to freshly detonated explosives. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.zhText:
一种挥发性蘑菇，散发着类似刚引爆的炸药的刺鼻气味。把它带到气密舱夜帽那里以获取更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.text: Weapons inflict <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage that sends foes flying.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害，炸飞敌人。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.text: A good one for when you need your weapons to explode something or someone, into outer space.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.zhText: 当你需要用武器将某物或某人炸到外太空时，这是一个很好的选择。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.text: For the record, I never blew up any elevator shaft to keep Corporate out of the Deepmines... But if I had, I would have used four-and-a-half buckets of Spring Poppers, and the explosion would have been glorious.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.zhText: 声明一下，我可没有炸毁过任何电梯井来阻止企业的人进入深矿……但如果要我这么做的话，我会用上四桶半的春爆菇，爆炸一定会非常壮观。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.text: This one loves the soil in the Forward Base, lots of trace nitrates and glycerol left over from the mines were first blown out ages ago.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/BlastMushroo.zhText: 这种蘑菇喜欢前线基地的土壤，那里有很多很久以前矿井炸开后留下的微量硝酸盐和甘油。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.text:
This bizarre mushroom appears to be permanently frozen. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.zhText:
这种古怪的蘑菇似乎被永久冻住了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处来了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.text: Weapons inflict <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage. Icey slick sliding.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_FREEZE>冰冻伤害。小心打滑。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.text: A taste of this and you’ll be dealing ice cold fury to anyone who gets on your mean side.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.zhText: 尝一口这个，你就能对任何与你作对的人施以冰冷的狂怒。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.text: Watch your step though, Winter Spear makes everything a bit icy dicey. I remember when Nokko would crush up a bunch and sprinkle the dust on a slope. He'd have the Sprodlings sliding for hours.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.zhText: 不过，小心脚下，前线基地会让一切变得有点危险。我记得 Nokko 会把一堆冬矛菇碾碎，然后把粉末撒在斜坡上。他能让菌宝们滑上几个小时滑梯。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.text: You can usually find Winter Spear clumping in the Forward Bases. She prefers the relative cold there.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ColdMushroom.zhText: 你通常会在前线基地发现冬矛菇。她更喜欢那里相对寒冷的环境。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.text:
This mushroom appears to continually excrete a highly acidic mucus. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.zhText:
这种蘑菇似乎会不断分泌强酸性的黏液。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）
武器造成 <DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀伤害。即将溶解。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.text: This sour little fella loves to make quick work of heavy metals like the ones used in Corpus equipment and armor. Nokko used that trick on some of my equipment before I got to know him better.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.zhText: 这个酸溜溜的小家伙就爱迅速破坏重金属，比如 Corpus 设备和盔甲用的那种。在我更了解 Nokko 之前， 他在我的一些设备上用过这个把戏。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.text: Handle with care. Way back when I had a mate try to pluck some without using the special tongs. It cost him a very expensive arm and a leg. Now I always use the special tongs.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.zhText: 轻拿轻放。很久以前，我有个朋友试着不用专用钳子去拔。结果废了他一只胳膊和一条腿。现在我每次都用专用钳子。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.text: The toxic sludge seeping through the Forward Base keeps the Borica fruiting all year round.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/CorrosiveMus.zhText: 从前线基地渗出的有毒污泥使得波利卡菇全年都结果实。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/DefenseDrone.zhText: 将无人机的生命值保持在 |VALUE|% 以上

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.text:
This fungus appears to emit an electric charge. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.zhText:
这种真菌似乎会释放电荷。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.text: Weapons inflict <DT_ELECTRIC>Electric Damage. Become lighting quick.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_ELECTRIC>电击伤害。迅如闪电。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.text: She’s a bolt of lighting. Quite literally. Useful for times when you want your weapon to turn your opponent into a walking arc welder.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.zhText: 她就像一道闪电。名副其实。当你想用你的武器把对手变成行走的电焊工时，她就派上用场了。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.text: The other roots and fruits seemed to work harder and faster when Thunder Button’s nearby. Try it yourself, if you need to be somewhere in a hurry.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.zhText: 当雷纽菇在附近时，其他根和果子似乎会干得更卖力、更快。如果你需要赶时间，不妨亲自尝试一下。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.text: You will find this one in the Corpus labs where it likes to leach off their power grid.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ElectricMush.zhText: 你可以在 Corpus 实验室中找到它，它喜欢从他们的电网中榨取能量。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ExterminateC.zhText: 在时间限制内完成额外目标

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FieldResearc.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|GATHERING MUSHROOMS|CLOSE_COLOR|
The Deepmines are full of roots and fruits. Find mushrooms listed in the Field Guide in Deepmine Bounties, both as Bounty Bonus Rewards and from mushroom patches.

|OPEN_COLOR|ANALYZING MUSHROOMS|CLOSE_COLOR|
Fill out the Field Guide by Analyzing collected mushrooms. Fully Analyzed mushrooms increase the Nightcap Rank, allowing access to additional rewards.

|OPEN_COLOR|INCREASING YOUR NIGHTCAP RANK|CLOSE_COLOR|
Fully Analyze mushrooms to increase standing with Nightcap.

• Rank 1: One Mushroom
• Rank 2: Two Mushrooms
• Rank 3: Six Mushrooms
• Rank 4: Twelve Mushrooms
• Rank 5: Sixteen Mushrooms

|OPEN_COLOR|COMPOSTING|CLOSE_COLOR|
Compost excess mushrooms into Fergolyte, which can purchase Nightcap’s wares. Certain mushrooms are also used in crafting, so check the blueprint requirements before composting!
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FieldResearc.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|采集蘑菇|CLOSE_COLOR|
深矿里满是根和果子。在深矿赏金任务中寻找野植图鉴中列出的蘑菇，它们既可以作为赏金奖励获得，也可以从蘑菇丛中找到。

|OPEN_COLOR|分析蘑菇|CLOSE_COLOR|
通过分析收集的蘑菇来补全野植图鉴。完全分析过的蘑菇可以提升夜帽等级，从而获得更多奖励。

|OPEN_COLOR|提升你的夜帽等级|CLOSE_COLOR|
完全分析蘑菇以提升夜帽的声望。

• 等级 1：一个蘑菇
• 等级 2：两个蘑菇
• 等级 3：六个蘑菇
• 等级 4：十二个蘑菇
• 等级 5：十六个蘑菇

|OPEN_COLOR|堆肥|CLOSE_COLOR|
将多余的蘑菇堆肥成铁离石，这种资源可以用来购买夜帽的商品。某些蘑菇也可用于制造，因此在堆肥前请查看蓝图要求！

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FindNokkoBab.zhText: 在时间限制内完成额外目标

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexComp.text: Coult not compost selected mushrooms, please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexComp.zhText: 无法堆肥选定的蘑菇，请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexFind.text: Find Mushroom samples in the Deepmines
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexFind.zhText: 在深矿中寻找蘑菇样本

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexRese.text: Could not analyze mushroom sample, please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexRese.zhText: 无法分析蘑菇样本，请稍后重试。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexSele.text: <WARNING> Select a Mushroom to see details <WARNING>
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/FungidexSele.zhText: <WARNING> 选中一个蘑菇查看详情 <WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomD.text:
This gaseous mushroom exhibits a terrible stench. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomD.zhText:
这种气态蘑菇散发出难闻的恶臭。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomH.text: Weapons inflict <DT_GAS>Gas Damage. Beware of stench.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomH.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_GAS>毒气伤害。当心恶臭。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomP.text: Cover your nose and hold your breath, this foul fella causes weapons to release a noxious gas with each strike.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomP.zhText: 捂住鼻子，屏住呼吸，这个邪恶的家伙每次攻击都会使武器释放出有毒气体。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomP.text: Note: do not let the Sprodlings get into a patch of Reeking Puffball. All it takes is a couple bites and those little guys will start pumping out a stench foul enough to turn a kubrodon purple.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomP.zhText: 注意：别让菌宝靠近臭屎菇。只要咬几口，这些小家伙就会开始散发恶臭，足以把库狛顿熏成紫色。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomP.text: You can find this stinker in the caves, just follow your nose.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/GasMushroomP.zhText: 你可以在洞穴里找到这个臭家伙，只要跟着你的鼻子走就对了。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.text:
This mushroom is always hot to the touch. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.zhText:
这种蘑菇摸起来总是炽热的。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.text: Weapons inflict <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage. Not all will be as it seems.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.zhText: 武器造成<DT_FIRE>火焰伤害。表里不一。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.text: Poison is in the dose. Use a little bit to warm up your belly. Put a whole stalk on your weapons to light up your targets from the inside. So hot it’ll weaken their armor.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.zhText: 剂量决定毒性。用一点就能暖暖肚子。把整根菌杆放在你的武器上，可从内里点燃你的目标。热到足以削弱他们的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.text: Much of Venus is still a firestorm. Blister Stalk is the embodiment of Venus. A firestorm contained in fungus.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.zhText: 金星的大部分地区仍然笼罩在火风暴之中。疱杆菇是金星的化身。蕴含在真菌中的火风暴。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.text: Scour the Nutrient Processing facility and you will probably find this guy sucking up the excess calories from the wastes.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/HeatMushroom.zhText: 仔细检查营养加工设施，你可能会发现这个家伙正在吸收废料中多余的能量。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.text:
This mushroom is hard as an anvil and nearly as heavy. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.zhText:
这种蘑菇坚硬如铁砧，重量也几乎相当。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）
武器造成 <DT_GAS>冲击伤害。轰隆隆隆！！

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.text: This is a mean one. Take this if you need to hit hard and have it hurt.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.zhText: 这玩意儿很狠。如果你需要重击对方让对方吃痛，那就用这个吧。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.text: I once saw a rigjockey get hit in the head with one of these. Poor mucker claimed he could see nothing but Waverider graphicas every time he closed his eyes.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.zhText: 我曾经亲眼见过一个技工被这种东西击中头部。那可怜的家伙说，他每次闭上眼睛，满眼都是驭浪者的图案。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.text: Search the Forward Base to find this guy. Plenty of heavy metal contamination in that soil for Ironwood to chew on.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ImpactMushro.zhText: 搜索前线基地可以找到这个家伙。那里的土壤里有大量重金属污染物，供铁木菇啃食。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job1Desc.text: Nef Anyo's captured some poor critters from the Vallis and stuffed 'em in his lab. Break 'em free.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job1Desc.zhText: 奈富·安尤从山谷捕获了一些可怜的小动物，并把它们塞进了实验室。把它们解救出来吧。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job2Desc.text: Got a Corporate manager causing all sorts of trouble from their forward base. Take 'em out.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job2Desc.zhText: 有个企业经理在前线基地造成不少麻烦。快把他们解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job3Desc.text: Got too many merk-merks mucking up the garden in their Nutrient Processing center. Go deal with 'em.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/Job3Desc.zhText: 花园里的营养加工中心被一堆雇佣兵弄得一团糟。去处理掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/JobSPDesc.text: Busy day in the garden. Lots of tough muckers out there. You ready to get dirty?
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/JobSPDesc.zhText: 花园里可真热闹。那里有很多难缠的家伙。你准备好弄得一身泥了吗？

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.text:
An oddly shaped fungus that will latch itself onto metallic objects. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.zhText:
一种形状古怪的真菌，会附着在金属物体上。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽那里了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）
武器造成 <DT_MAGNETIC>磁化伤害。踩踏事件。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.text: This parasitic fungus that feasts on magnetic waves generated by Venus’ highly active mantle. Does nasty work to Corpus shields too.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.zhText: 这种寄生真菌以金星高度活跃的地幔产生的磁波为食。它也会破坏 Corpus 的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.text: Fun fact: Sprodlings love this one. Very much drawn to it, and you too, should you eat some.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.zhText: 冷知识：菌宝超爱这个。被它吊住了胃口，要是给你尝尝，你也一样。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.text: This mushroom favors the Corpus Labs and the many magnetic fields within.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MagneticMush.zhText: 这种蘑菇喜欢出现在 Corpus 实验室及其磁场活跃的地方。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MarsToPhobos.text:
Operator,

After your last trip through the Phobos Junction, Ordis found these items lodged in the Orbiter's bulkhead.
It is unclear when you acquired these items but Ordis is certain it must have been during an act of unwavering bravery.

Your Loyal Cephalon,

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MarsToPhobos.zhText:
指挥官，

在您上次穿越火卫一接合点后，Ordis 在轨道飞行器的舱壁中发现了这些物品。
目前尚不清楚您何时获得这些物品，但 Ordis 确信一定是在一次英勇无畏的行动中获得的。

您忠诚的中枢，

——Ordis

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MushroomScra.text: Decorate whatever cave you call home with this artwork from around the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/MushroomScra.zhText: 用这幅来自深矿周围的艺术品来装饰任何你称之为家的洞穴。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseCor.text: Director of the Subterranean Armaments Division. Responsible for all research into weapons that can more effectively combat all things fungal.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseCor.zhText: 地下军备部门的主管。负责所有能够更有效地对抗真菌的武器的研究。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseHea.text: A Bursa unit that corrals its prey for rapid destruction.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseHea.zhText: 削弱猎物以求迅速破坏的金流恐鸟单位。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseRak.text: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseRak.zhText: 巨型的蛛形机，具有多个攻击向量，在高警戒级别期间最常被部署。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoColonyV.text: Director of the Subterranean Demolitions Division. Responsible for carving out swathes of Venus's mines for Nef Anyo's personal use.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoColonyV.zhText: 地下爆破部门主管。负责在金星上开凿大片矿场，供奈富·安尤个人使用。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoColonyV.text: Director of the Subterranean Strike Division. Responsible for coordinating attacks on targets that draw Nef Anyo's ire.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoColonyV.zhText: 地下打击部门主管。负责协调针对引起奈富·安尤愤怒的目标的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoCurrenc.text:
This highly reactive mineral deposit is the only substance known to make The Prince grow.

Location: The Deepmines below Fortuna, Venus.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoCurrenc.zhText:
这种高反应性的矿藏是已知唯一能让王子菇成长的物质。

获取地点：金星福尔图娜下方的深矿。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoEliteSp.text: A seasoned combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoEliteSp.zhText: 一名老练的战斗人员，擅长在地下作战。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingA.text: An attack drone that deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingA.zhText: 一种攻击无人机，在攻击目标之前会释放热气溶胶。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingN.text: This unit deploys an energy field that blocks projectiles and nullifies powers.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingN.zhText: 该单位可部署一个能量场来阻挡子弹并使能力无效化。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingS.text: A hybrid air-ground unit, armed with a Tetra rifle and a devastating visor mounted beam weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingS.zhText: 空地混合单位，装备有一把特拉步枪，以及一把安装在面罩上的破坏性光束武器。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingS.text: An Osprey that recharges the shields of it's allies.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoFlyingS.zhText: 为友军补充护盾的鱼鹰。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoHeavyEl.text: An elite combatant that controls the battlefield through a combination of teleportation and decoy deployment.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoHeavyEl.zhText: 通过结合传送和诱饵部署来控制战场的精英战斗人员。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfFlyi.text: An attack drone that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys a heat-based aerosol before pummeling targets from range with energy shells.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfFlyi.zhText: 一架受到朔望能量辐射的攻击无人机。它会释放热气溶胶，然后用能量弹远距离攻击目标。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfMele.text: A unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy, wields dual ice-picks and possess a flying charge attack. Explodes upon death.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfMele.zhText: 受到朔望能量影响的单位，持双冰锥，可进行飞行冲锋攻击。死亡时会爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfMini.text: A diminutive Raknoid that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Occasionally lays explosive mushrooms.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfMini.zhText: 暴露于朔望能量之下小型蛛形机。偶尔会产下爆炸蘑菇。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfRang.text: A Moa unit that has been exposed to the to energy of the Syzygy. Capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfRang.zhText: 一只受到朔望能量影响的恐鸟。它能够通过跺脚产生强大的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfRiot.text: A Bursa unit that has been exposed to the power of the Syzygy. Corrals its prey for rapid destruction.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfRiot.zhText: 暴露于朔望能量的金流恐鸟单位。削弱猎物以求迅速破坏。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfSnip.text: A unit that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfSnip.zhText: 受朔望能量影响的单位。部署炮塔并使用激光炮从远处发射致命子弹。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfSpac.text: A seasoned combatant that has been exposed to the energy of the Syzygy. Engages targets with quick strikes from it's shock baton.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoInfSpac.zhText: 一位曾受朔望能量影响且经验丰富的战士。使用电击棍快速攻击目标。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLabMele.text: A quick-moving unit that closes the distance with it's target through a battering shield, before striking with it's hammer.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLabMele.zhText: 移动迅速的单位，通过盾牌冲锋缩短与目标的距离，然后用锤子进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLabVIPA.text: Chief technology officer of the Subterranean Research Division. Responsible for researching Syzygy energy to the benefit of Nef Anyo.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLabVIPA.zhText: 地下研究部首席技术官。负责研究朔望花能量，以造福奈富·安尤。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLaserCa.text: A quick-moving Moa, armed with a laser disc weapon.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLaserCa.zhText: 快速移动的恐鸟，装备有激光盘武器。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMeleeHe.text: A large hatchet and flying charge attacks make this heavy unit a capable foe.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMeleeHe.zhText: 巨斧和飞扑冲锋攻击使这个重型单位成为强劲的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMeleeLi.text: Dual ice-picks and flying charge attacks make this light unit a capable foe.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMeleeLi.zhText: 双持碎冰锥和飞扑冲锋攻击使这个轻型单位成为强劲的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMiniAra.text: A diminutive Raknoid that can close large distances with it's jumping attacks.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoMiniAra.zhText: 一种小型蛛形机，可以通过跳跃攻击来缩短距离。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoPlantMe.text: This mid-sized Raknoid spits immobilizing fluid from it's sac before latching onto prey with it's grappling hook.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoPlantMe.zhText: 这种中型蛛形机会从囊中吐出固定液体，然后用抓钩抓住猎物。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoRailgun.text: A Moa unit that fires from range while laying mines.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoRailgun.zhText: 在部署地雷的同时可从远处射击的恐鸟单位。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoRangedH.text: A seasoned combatant that utilizes multiple grenade types to deal heavy damage.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoRangedH.zhText: 一名老练的战斗人员，可使用多种手榴弹类型来造成巨大伤害。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoShockwa.text: A Moa unit capable of creating a powerful shockwave by stomping it's foot.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoShockwa.zhText: 能够通过跺脚来产生强大冲击波的恐鸟单位。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoShotgun.text: A shotgun wielding combatant specializing in subterranean warfare.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoShotgun.zhText: 一名手持霰弹枪战斗人员，擅长在地下作战。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoSniperA.text: A unit that deploys turrets and fires deadly shots from afar using it's laser cannon.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoSniperA.zhText: 部署炮塔并使用激光炮从远处发射致命子弹的单位。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoSuicide.text: A Moa deployed by an Elite Crewman.

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoTrapped.text: Chief research officer of the Subterranean Energy Division. Responsible for producing new methods of energy production to fuel Nef Anyo's ambitions.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoTrapped.zhText: 地下能源部首席研究官。负责研发新型能源生产技术，为奈富·安尤的野心提供动力。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoVendorF.text: Accept Deepmine Bounties, Field Guide, Blueprints & Decorations
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoVendorF.zhText: 领取深矿赏金任务、野植图鉴、蓝图和装饰物

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.text:
This mushroom is as plain as plain can be. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.zhText:
这种蘑菇普通得不能再普通了。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.text: Clears existing Mushroom effects. Unremarkable flavor.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.zhText: 清除现有的蘑菇效果。味道平平。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.text: Unremarkable bloke. It won’t hurt anybody. It won’t  actually do much of anything.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.zhText: 普通的家伙。它不会伤害任何人。它实际上不会起什么作用。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.text: Dull Button Stew: Add three handfuls of Dull Button to a pot of water. Boil for six hours. Add salt. Serve in the bootleg nutrient canister of your choice.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.zhText: 炖煮淡纽菇：将三把淡纽菇放入一锅水中。煮六个小时。加盐。盛入你喜欢的走私营养罐中即可享用。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.text: If you see some of this while walking in the caves you might as well pluck a few.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlainMushroo.zhText: 如果你在洞穴里走的时候看到一些这样的蘑菇，不妨顺手摘一些。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlayVision.text: Are you sure you want to walk the |KEY_NAME|?

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlayVisionIn.text: You cannot experience The Prince while in a squad. Do you want to leave your squad and play?
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PlayVisionIn.zhText: 你无法在小队模式中体验王子菇。你想离开小队继续游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceErrorF.text: The Prince is not hungry right now. Come back later.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceErrorF.zhText: 王子菇现在还不饿。晚点再来吧。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceFeedNo.text: You need to walk the next path before The Prince will eat again.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceFeedNo.zhText: 你需要走下一条路，王子菇才会再次进食。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceNoFood.text: Find Fergolyte in the Deepmines to feed the Prince.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PrinceNoFood.zhText: 在深矿中寻找铁离石喂给王子菇。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.text:
Avoid stepping on this sharp, spear-like mushroom cap. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.zhText:
小心别踩到这种尖锐如长矛般的蘑菇伞盖。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.text: Weapons inflict <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage. Watch for spikes.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_PUNCTURE>穿刺伤害。注意尖刺。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.text: This delicious fruit has evolved thorns so sharp that they’ll pierce Corpus energy shields. A fierce defense mechanism to stop hungry snackers.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.zhText: 这种美味的果子进化出了锋利的刺，足以刺穿 Corpus 的能量护盾。这是一种强大的防御机制，可以阻止饥饿的植食者,。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.text: One of the oldest fruits on the Vallis, maybe even Venus. Her kind have seen Venus go through so much hardship, but still Thorn Tooth hangs on. Tough as ever.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.zhText: 这是山谷中其中一种最古老的果子，或许也是整个金星上最古老的果子。她的族群见证了金星经历的无数磨难，但刺牙菇依然屹立不倒。坚韧如初。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.text: Watch your step in Nutrient Processing, that’s where Thorn Tooth likes to spike out after absorbing all those minerals.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/PunctureMush.zhText: 在营养加工中心要小心你的脚下，那是刺牙菇喜欢在吸收了所有矿物质后长出刺的地方。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.text:
A potentially radioactive mushroom. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.zhText:
一种可能具有放射性的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）
武器造成 <DT_RADIATION>辐射伤害。突变来袭。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.text: Radiation doesn’t bother me any more, thanks to this rig. Rank and file Corpus on the hand, hits them pretty hard, makes it hard for them to tell friend from foe.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.zhText: 有了这个装置，辐射再也困扰不了我了。不过对于普通 Corpus 士兵来说打击就很大，会让他们分不清敌友。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.text: There’s not much material on Venus that isn’t a little bit radioactive. Gamma Berry eats radiation like it were sugar on a sundae. The whole Vallis would glow green without it.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.zhText: 金星上几乎没什么物质不带点辐射。伽玛莓吃辐射就像是吃圣代冰淇淋上的糖浆。如果没有它，整个金星山谷都会发出绿光。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.text: Nutrient Processing is the first place I would look for Gamma Berry.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RadiationMus.zhText: 营养加工中心是我寻找伽玛莓最先会去的地方。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RankUpHint_T.text: Gain rank with Nightcap by helping him complete the Field Guide.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RankUpHint_T.zhText: 帮助夜帽完成野植图鉴来提升等级。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RescueAnimal.zhText: 将动物的生命值保持在 |VALUE|% 以上

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RescueBonusO.zhText: 将菌宝的生命值保持在 |VALUE|% 以上

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/RescueCitize.zhText: 将逃犯的生命值保持在 |VALUE|% 以上

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ResourceCapt.text: Capture Syzygy Energy Before the Corpus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ResourceCapt.zhText: 在 Corpus 之前收集朔望花能量

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.text:
The spines on this mushroom appear to be extremely sharp. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.zhText:
这种蘑菇上的尖刺看起来极为锋利。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.text: Weapons inflict <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage and maximum mess.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_SLASH>切割伤害，极致混乱。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.text: If you need a close shave, then Devil's Cap is your mate. Slap this on your weapons, and your enemies better have a tourniquet on hand.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.zhText: 如果你需要近身收割，那么魔鬼帽就是你的好帮手。把它涂在你的武器上，你的敌人最好手上有带止血带。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.text: Norgie-Three-Fingers was the first mucker I knew to try and pick a Devil's Cap. Need I say more?
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.zhText: 诺吉三指是我认识的第一个敢去摘魔鬼帽的家伙。还需要我多说吗？

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.text: Keep a lookout for the Devil's Cap in the labs. Its roots can survive in the most shallow substrate while its fruit can slice through just about anything to bloom in the most surprising places.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/SlashMushroo.zhText: 在实验室里留意一下魔鬼帽。它的根可以在最浅的基质中生存，而它的果实几乎可以穿透任何东西，然后在最意想不到的地方开花。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomD.text:
A peculiar looking mushroom that seems not of this world. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomD.zhText:
一种外观奇特，仿佛不属于这个世界的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomH.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_SENTIENT>Tau 伤害。幻觉产生。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomP.text: A relic from the Old War, naturalized in the Deepmines. On your weapons, this one will make your enemies vulnerable to all sorts of attacks.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomP.zhText: 这是远古之战的遗物，在深矿井中被同化。将它附在你的武器上，会让你的敌人对各种攻击产生易伤效果。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomP.text: Fancy a trip to the Plains of Eidolon, but can’t afford the ticket? Then the Vomval Trumpet is the next closest thing. How or why they became part of the ecosystem down here, I haven’t quite figured out yet.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomP.zhText: 想去夜灵平野一趟，却又买不起票？那轰击号角菇就是最接近的选择。它们是怎么、又为什么成为这里生态系统的一部分的，我还没怎么搞清楚。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomP.text: You’ll find this in the labs. It seems to be drawn to some of the more curious specimens in there. The ones from outside the Origin System.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TauMushroomP.zhText: 你可以在实验室里找到它。它似乎会被实验室里一些更奇特的样本吸引。那些来自始源星系之外的样本。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.text:
A snake-like mushroom that should be handled with caution.  Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.zhText:
一种蛇形的蘑菇，处理时应格外小心。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.text: Weapons inflict <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage. Watch out for splashback.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_POISON>毒素伤害。小心飞溅。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.text: This one's a toxic mucker and if you get it on your weapons, they'll be toxic muckers too. Unlucky Corpus have found out the hard way the Muck Bonnet's toxin does not respect their shields.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.zhText: 这玩意儿是剧毒的泥球，如果你的武器沾上它，它们也会变成剧毒的泥球。不幸的 Corpus 用惨痛的经历发现，泥帽菇的毒素根本不把护盾当回事。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.text: One man’s toxin is another’s vitamin. It’s relative. Unless you’re Corpus, in which case, the Muck Bonnet is most certainly a terrible way to die.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.zhText: 甲之蜜糖，乙之砒霜。这都是相对的。除非你是 Corpus，那样的话，泥帽菇绝对是个可怕的死法。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.text: These ones grow mostly in the caves, they love to drink up all those nurturing toxins in the water table.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ToxinMushroo.zhText: 这些植物大多生长在洞穴中，它们喜欢喝光地下水中所有那些有养分的毒素。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/TrappedChest.zhText: 在时间限制内完成额外目标
打开储存箱并拿取补给

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.text:
This multi-capped mushroom should probably not be ingested. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.zhText:
这种多伞盖的蘑菇最好不要食用。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.text: Weapons inflict <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage. May cause hallucinations.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_VIRAL>病毒伤害。引发幻觉。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.text: She looks like a lovely little lady, but she’s packing a nasty viral surprise. Useful on your weapons if you want to engage in a bit of germ warfare.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.zhText: 她看起来像个可爱的小姑娘，却意外地携带着令人作呕的病毒。如果你想玩点细菌战，这玩意儿对你的武器来说很有用。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.text: Be careful with this one, she’ll get you hot under the collar. I’m talking about fever, sweats, and seeing things that have no right to be there.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.zhText: 小心这家伙，她会让你血液沸腾。我指的是发烧、出汗，还有看到不该出现的东西。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.text: You’ll find her sprouting in the caves, often mucking about near Reeking Puffball and Muck Bonnet. Her ability to spread viral infections ensures renewal in the Deepmines and on the surface.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/ViralMushroo.zhText: 你会发现她在洞穴里萌芽，经常在臭屎菇和泥帽菇附近出现。她传播病毒感染的能力确保了深矿和地表的再生。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.text:
A mushroom of unknown origin or effect. Take it to Nightcap in the airlock for further information.

Location: Deepmines Bounties on Venus
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.zhText:
一种来历和效应都不明的蘑菇。把它带到气密舱里的夜帽处了解更多信息。

获取地点：深矿赏金任务（金星）

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.text: Weapons inflict <DT_RADIANT>Void Damage. Is someone watching?
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.zhText: 武器造成 <DT_RADIANT>虚空伤害。疑神疑鬼。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.text: I do not like this one. I do not know why, but every time I see it, I say the same thing, ‘no, no, no'. I have noticed that enemies afflicted with the Nonono seem to have the unfortunate luck of attracting way more stray ordnance.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.zhText: 我不喜欢这个。不知道为什么，每次看到它，我都会说同样的话："不，不，不。"我注意到，受到不不不菇影响的敌人似乎运气都不好，会吸引更多流弹。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.text: It’s like this root has tapped into something I have no business understanding. Now, instead of me studying it, it is studying me. I’m the specimen. I don’t like it.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.zhText: 这根部似乎是触碰到了某种我根本无法理解的东西。现在，不是我在研究它，而是它在研究我。我倒成了样本。我可不喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.text: If you find this one, it will be in Nutrient Processing. I recommend you turn the other way.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/VoidMushroom.zhText: 如果你找到这个，应该会是在营养加工中心。我建议你赶紧掉头。

/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/WhatIsMyFate.text: Music from Koumei & The Five Fates to enjoy from the Somachord in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/WhatIsMyFate.zhText: 来自《Koumei 与五运》的音乐，可通过轨道飞行器中的身心和弦琴欣赏。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: Statuette - Thousand-Year Fish
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 千年灵鱼小型雕像

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: In the age after the fall of the Orokin the grand clade-families of the Ostrons were cast wide across the Origin System, roaming and homeless in their great floating markets.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 于奥罗金陨落后的时代中，Ostron 人的多支庞大的家族逃散到了始源星系中，通过他们巨大的浮空市集四处漂流、居无定所。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: The wrathful Grineer took umbrage at this and sought to block their passage but, upon approaching that ancient Orokin tower, found their transmissions silenced, their engines turned cold, and their weapons reduced to lumps of dead iron.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 易怒的 Grineer 对此愤恨不已，并试图阻断他们的通路，然而一旦接近那座远古奥罗金高塔，就会发现通信被静默、引擎熄火，连武器都变成了一块废铁。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
She was a being of the day; her husband, a spirit of the night. Er-Phryah was a woman of the land; Mer-Sah a man of the sea. Mer-Sah understood the crushing weight of time in which Er existed. In return Er gifted pieces of its ancient self to Mer-Sah: old things shaped to near shapelessness by a thousand years beneath the waves.

Mer-Sah was a man dedicated to finding the sacred in the forgotten, the neglected. And took wisdom from them.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
她是白昼的存在；他的丈夫，则是夜晚的精灵。Er-Phryah 是陆地的女子；弥尔-撒是海洋的男儿。弥尔-撒理解了存在于 Er 之中摧枯拉朽的时间巨力。作为回报，Er 将自己古老的碎片赠与弥尔-撒：这些古物在千年海浪的冲刷下已近乎无形。

弥尔-撒致力于寻找被遗忘、被抛弃的圣物，并从中获取智慧。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: After many decades Mer-Sah had a small collection of such gifts - such that they could be held in two cupped hands - but in them he understood the lifespan of a world. And so he had struck an accord with the creatures of the sea.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 几十年之后，弥尔-撒收集了一小批这样的礼物——少到仅需要两手就可捧起——但是从中他理解了一整个世界的生命历程。也因此他与海之生灵达成了协定。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
For her part, in her times alone, Er-Phryah came to know the birds and animals of the Plains and likewise struck an accord with them.

Even the tortured Eidolons, creatures of this world and the next, left them in peace and made the lands around the Tower safe for the Ostrons.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
对她来说，在她独处的时间里，Er-Phryah 得以了解平野上的鸟类和动物，同样地，她也与陆地的生灵达成了协定。

即使是那些被扭曲的夜灵们——此世界与彼世界的生灵，也与他们和平共处，使得高塔周边的地区对 Ostron 人安全。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
At the center of this place was the Tower. And within the Tower was the Unum: the voice, the force, that had called Mer-Sah and Er-Phryah there so many years ago for this exact purpose.

But the Unum is a being for another time, and another story.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
位于此地中心的就是这座高塔。而位于高塔之中的就是乌努母神：即是那声音、那力量、那在许多年以前以此为目的将弥尔-撒和 Er-Phryah 唤来。

但是乌努母神是另一个时代的存在，那则是另一段故事了。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
The Ostrons named their village Karifamil – 'family and prosperity'. Er-Phryah was overjoyed to see her clade again… but Mer-Sah would not enter Karifamil, for he had no family save Er-Phryah.

Er-Phryah was drawn to her clade, and Mer-Sah felt no resentment. She would one day return to them; Mer-Sah had known it would be so.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
Ostron 人将村子命名为 Karifamil——"家族与繁荣"。Er-Phryah 为能再次见到她的家族而喜出望外……但弥尔-撒从来不曾踏入 Karifamil，因为在那里除了 Er-Phryah， 没有他的家人。

Er-Phryah 被带回了家族，而弥尔-撒也不感到怨恨。她终有一天要回到她的家庭，弥尔-撒早就明白。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
In two cupped hands Mer-Sah took the things the sea had gifted him over his long life, and took to his boat, and sailed out across his midnight ocean. He returned those gifts to the deep... and himself to it too.

But this was no death into which Mer-Sah stepped, for a world is made of cycles upon cycles. Mer-Sah stepped into his midnight ocean, falling down into it. The deeper he sank, the larger he became.

This is how the oceans of Er came to be the home of the thousand-year fish: legendary, vast, reclusive, the rare sight of which changes men. One of the great ancient spirits of Er.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
弥尔-撒双手捧起这漫长一生中海洋赠与他的宝物，将它们带上了船。他于午夜航行出海，他将这些礼物送回了深海……自己也魂归于此。

但对于一个经历了一个又一个轮回的世界而言，弥尔-撒踏入的并非死亡。弥尔-撒踏入了这片午夜的海洋，坠落其中。他沉的越深，就变得越庞大。

Er 的大洋就是这样变成了千年灵鱼的家：传奇、庞大而又隐匿，得见一眼就可改变人的一生。那是 Er 伟大的远古精灵之一。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
The spirits of the land felt Er-Phryah's sadness, mad with grief for the loss of their friend to the spirits of the sea. The accord broke down, the animals and Eidolons returning once more to wildness.

And so the people of clade yingbindunyai rebuilt the great Orokin wall that had, in centuries gone by, ringed their gleaming Tower... and never again ventured out at night.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
陆地的精灵们感受到了 Er-Phryah 的哀伤，弥尔-撒葬身于海之精灵使它们悲痛得近乎疯狂。协定也因此破坏了，动物和夜灵们又一次回归了野性。

于是 Yingbindunyai 家族的人重建了奥罗金长城，在过去数个世纪的岁月中，环绕着熠熠生辉的高塔……此外，他们再也不会在夜晚闯荡平野。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
The villagers decided as one that their home would no longer be known as Karifamil, ‘family and prosperity'. From that day forward it would be known as Cetus: landless, of no one clade, home to any who are blown as dust on the wind.

Er-Phryah lived there the rest of her days, and for the remainder of her nights she held vigil atop the walls of Cetus, looking to the sea and, so some say, occasionally catching sight of a great fish, like an island in a midnight ocean, looking back at her. With love.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
村民们决定，由于他们的家园再也不适合 Karifamil，“家族与繁荣”，这个名字。从今以后村子将被称为希图斯：没有土地、没有家族，这里是所有如同风中飞尘之人的家园。

Er-Phryah 在那里度过了她的余生，并且在她余生的夜晚中，她坚持在希图斯长城的顶部守夜，望向海的那一边。因此有些人说，偶尔会见到一条巨大的鱼，仿佛是午夜海上的一座岛屿一般，回望向她。充满着爱意。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: It is said that Mer-Sah continued to watch over the deep, as he had always done, and Er-Phryah the land. Often she would stand by her husband-sea, speaking in a language only those bound at the soul can know.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 据说就如同过去一般，弥尔-撒继续监护着深海，和陆地上的 Er-Phryah。她经常会站在她丈夫的海边，说着一些只有灵魂相连之人才能理解的话语。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: In this time two young people were in love: the woman Er-Phryah and the man Mer-Sah. Er-Phryah was from the yingbindunyai clade (meaning "great bond"): a very old and wealthy compact of bonded families.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 就在此时一对年轻人相爱了：女子名叫 Er-Phryah，而男子名叫弥尔-撒。Er-Phryah 来自 Yingbindunyai 家族（意思为"伟大的结合"）：这是一支极其古老而富有、并亲密团结的大家族。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
When the day came and Er-Phryah passed from the world, her family buried her on the land.

A great fish watched from the sea, and kept vigil over her, for ten days and nights.

When it again sank beneath the waves, it was never seen again.

Some say Mer-Sah, the thousand-year fish, waits to this day for their story to be retold - relived - that he and Er-Phryah, his great love, may one day be reunited again.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
当 Er-Phryah 终要过世的那天来临时，她的家人将她埋在了陆地上。

一条巨大的鱼从海中望来，并为她守望，整整十天十夜。

当它再一次沉入波涛之下后，就再也不得所踪。

有的人说弥尔-撒，亦即是千年灵鱼，为了他们的故事再次被传颂，等待至今——由此他和 Er-Phryah，他的挚爱，将有朝一日得以再次团聚。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
Mer-Sah, however, had no clade: his family having been shattered by the Grineer many years before. He was cetus, meaning 'landless, cladeless; a body turned to dust turned to motes on a careless wind.'

Er-Phryah belonged to families within families. Mer-Sah was alone.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
然而，弥尔-撒并不来自任何家族：他的家庭多年前就被 Grineer 粉碎了。他当时是希图斯，意为"没有土地，没有家族，随时可能在风中飘散成灰的人"。

Er-Phryah 被重重家族呵护，而弥尔-撒只是孤身一人。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: But, to Er-Phryah, Mer-Sah was a poet who had eyes to see the beauty of things and ears to hear the softly whispered language of the universe. 'I know of a place,' he said. 'Where I may be homeless no more. I have heard a voice, and it leads me there. Come with me.'
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 不过，在 Er-Phryah 眼里，弥尔-撒是一位诗人，能够看透万物之美、能聆听宇宙的低吟。"我知道个地方，"他说道，"在那里我将不再无家可归。有一个声音，将我引领到那里。跟我走吧。"

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: But Er-Phryah’s father was a man made foolish by his wealth, and vociferously disapproved of their love. Mer-Sah was cast adrift from the floating market that was home to his one true love.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: 但是 Er-Phryah 的父亲早已被财富愚钝了头脑，他厉声否决了他们的爱情。弥尔-撒被抛出了浮空市集，而那里正是他挚爱的家。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text: Er-Phryah and Mer-Sah ran away together, as lovers do, and were never heard from again. Rent by grief her family thought her dead. Her father passed away, clutching her cameo, at peace thinking he would see her soon in some moonlit afterlife.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText: Er-Phryah 和弥尔-撒一同私奔了，就像所有情人那样，从此以后就杳无音信。她伤心欲绝的家庭以为 Er-Phryah 死了。她的父亲临终前，紧紧握着女儿的宝石浮雕，内心却无比平静，他觉得很快会在月光照耀的来世与她相见。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
Decades later, ships entering ancient Er's orbit were hailed from the planet's poisoned surface by an old woman's voice, gentle and knowing. Traders would call for her, greet her, offer the latest news on their families and lives - but never did they learn anything of this woman, save that she had a husband and they were, somehow, happy living on the toxic skin of that hostile world.

The old woman would always - always - ask those travellers of news of the yingbindunyai clade.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
数十年后，在星球被毒化的地表上，进入古老 Er 轨道的飞船定会被一位老妇人招呼，她的声音文雅而又知性。商人们会向她求助、向她问好、向她提供关于他们家族和生活的最新消息——但是他们从来不曾了解这位女性一丝一毫，只知道她有一位丈夫，而他们，不知怎的，幸福地生活在这个恶劣世界的剧毒表面。

这位老妇人每次——每次都会询问商人们关于 Yingbindunyai 家族的消息。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
Yingbindunyai junkers came searching for a sign of their missing daughter.

The frail voice of their long-lost child reached out to them, and there was much joy.

You will find us, her message said, by the light of our love.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
Yingbindunyai 的拾荒者前来搜索他们失踪的女儿的迹象。

当失散多年的孩子用脆弱的声音回应时，喜悦已不足以描述他们的情感。

你们会寻见我们的，她传来的信息这么说道，跟随我们爱情的光芒。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.text:
Er-Phryah bade them make their home around a magnificent Orokin ruin, promising them that it would be a source of prosperity for generations to come.

The yingbindunyai arrived in their vast floating market. There, by a ragged coastline, winked a point of light. Follow the brightness of the love between Mer-Sah and I, said her message, and be safe from all harm.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleEido.zhText:
Er-Phryah 吩咐他们在一座宏伟的奥罗金废墟周边建立了住所，允诺他们这将会是万代昌盛的源头。

Yingbindunyai 家族乘坐巨大的浮空市集而来。在那里，在参差的海岸线边，一点光闪烁着。请跟随我和弥尔-撒爱情的光辉，她的信息这么说道，并保佑你们远离一切危险。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleSeri.zhText: 如同镜面成像般的姊妹
他们的军队如大海一般
攻势如接连不断的潮水
成为了复制大军的传奇
不同于其他所有复制人
外貌虽同，却并非真正的兄弟
他们也渴望拥有这份力量

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleSeri.text: If the twins could do it
One by one bowed to the twins
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleSeri.zhText: 一一向双胞胎俯首顺从

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleSeri.text: And led forth by their new masters

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleSeri.zhText: 现今她们是去遵循的力量

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/CollectibleSeri.text: Not a force to be fought

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/EidolonPlains50.text: Operator, sequential analysis suggests you have now collected half of those pretty glass fish! But... there is something more to the information they contain. Closer scrutiny is warranted.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/EidolonPlains50.zhText: 指挥官，序列式分析法显示你目前已经收集完一半的这些可爱的玻璃小鱼！但是……它们包含着更多的信息。详细的检查是有必要的。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/EidolonPlains75.text: Operator, you have found almost all of the glass fish statuettes. Ordis is wondering: have you found anything more to the information they contain?
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/EidolonPlains75.zhText: 指挥官，您找到了几乎所有的玻璃小鱼雕像。Ordis 在想：您有没有发现它们之中其它更多的信息？
传奇已经完成四分之三了

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/EidolonPlainsRe.text:
Operator,

Now that you have collected all those pretty little fish, Ordis thought you might like to celebrate with this item. Does the Operator like it?

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/EidolonPlainsRe.zhText:
指挥官，

现在你已经收集完全部这些可爱的小鱼，Ordis 在想您可能会想用这件物品来庆祝。指挥官还喜欢吗？

－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/EidolonPlainsRe.text: I THOUGHT YOU MIGHT LIKE THIS

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.text:
In the dying days of the Orokin, with forums and promenades still blood-wet from Tenno betrayal, a colossal Sentient descended upon Ancient Er, falling from distant stars to deliver upon the Orokin a terrible and final ruin. 

Tower upon Tower fell to its weapons, but one withstood. The Tower of the Unum.

The Tenno scattered, but one remained. Gara. She and the Unum - inseparable.

The Unum: lodestone of our people, and subject of a hundred stories herself.

The Sentient was a deformed creature, twisted and massive, sent from some dark fold of distant space; a warped thing wounded by daylight. By night it was a terror, felling Tower after Tower, Citadel after Citadel. By day it hid, blinded and pained. It was during the day that Gara roamed, yearning to strike it from Creation while it cowered, weakened and blind, to safeguard her beloved Unum. 

But never could Gara find it.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.zhText:
在奥罗金日渐衰亡的日子里，广场和行道上 Tenno 背叛的血迹还未淡去，一只巨型的 Sentient 降落在了古老的 Er，它从遥远的众星降临，给予奥罗金残酷的最后一击。

一座又一座的塔陨落其手，但是仍有一座耸立。乌努母神之塔。

Tenno 大多已经散去，但是仍有一人留下。Gara。她和乌努母神——不可分割。

乌努母神：她是我们人民的磁石，也是这百层高塔的本体。

那个 Sentient 是异形的生物，扭曲而巨大，被从遥远宇宙的黑暗层叠中派来；这种反常的生物会被日光伤害。到了晚上，它就是恐怖的化身，摧枯拉朽地破坏了一座又一座的塔，一座又一座的堡垒。到了白天，它躲藏起来，失去视力，忍受痛苦。Gara 在白天四处漫游，趁着它退缩起来，虚弱且失明的时候，寻找击败它的根本办法，以此来保护她深爱的乌努母神。

但是 Gara 从来没有找到。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.text:
By night the Sentient was abroad, its titanic mass casting a terrible shadow across the land, the mass of it railing against the walls of the Tower, yet kept at bay by the exertion of the Unum's collossal will and the sacrifice of her faithful. But such exertions could not be maintained forever.

Gara yearned to strike out, to lash and tear at the monstrosity that threatened her love, but the Unum forbade it. At night the Sentient was at the height of its power, and Gara's light would make her the most tempting of targets to a creature of such profound darkness. Gara's death would be certain.

No. A different strategy was required.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.zhText:
在夜晚时，那 Sentient 会来到外面，它硕大无朋的质量在陆地上投出一个恐怖的阴影，它的质量全数倚靠在了塔的墙上，通过乌努母神巨大的意志和她信徒的牺牲，得以将那 Sentient 抵御在外。然而这种抵抗无法永远持续下去。

Gara 渴望出击，去鞭挞，去撕裂威胁她所爱之神的怪物，但是乌努母神禁止这么做。晚上是那 Sentient 力量的巅峰，Gara 的光芒对这只黑暗无边的生物来说，会是最诱惑的攻击目标。如果那样，Gara 必死无疑。

不。需要另一种策略。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.text:
The Sentient prowled and pressed and failed, never risking too much - for the Sentient could not reproduce. What it lost it lost forever.

It had killed many cities before, felled many Towers, but this little one prevailed. Why, it pondered in many voices, was that?

The Unum knew she could not defend forever, nor could her faithful throw their bodies against the Sentient in perpetuity. So she gave to her followers some of her blood - her refined Temple kuva - and they in turn gave it to the animals of the land, and the animals became an extension of her and she became an extension of them. And the animals roamed, and searched.

And they found where the Sentient chose to hide itself.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.zhText:
那只 Sentient 反复地徘徊、攻击并失败，从未过度冒险——因为 Sentient 不能繁殖。失去就意味着永远。

它曾经将许多城市夷为平地，推倒过许多的塔，但是这小小的一座塔仍然屹立。为何，它用许多种声音思考，会这样？

乌努母神知道她无法永远抵御下去，她的信徒也无法无休止地用血肉之躯抵抗。因此她给予了追随者一部分她的血液——她精炼的神殿赤毒——追随者将之给予陆上的动物，由此动物们成为了她的延伸，而她也成为了动物的延伸。动物们四处漫游搜索。

最终他们找到了 Sentient 躲藏的地点。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.text:
The Sentient sensed this subterfuge, and capturing one of the Unum's animals opened it for examination. And what little of the Unum that was present there... lit the Sentient's mind like the dark star from which it had fallen.

The Sentient, you see, could not procreate. But in the Temple kuva it tasted healing. Completeness. A future.

It devoured each and every last Unum-animal, but it was not enough. The Sentient turned its hundreds of eyes toward the Tower with new understanding: it would not destroy the Tower. It would become the Tower. It would kill the Unum, take her place and, one with that healing palace, give birth to a race of itself. 
.
Gara and Unum knew where the Sentient was. 

The Sentient knew the Tower was the future of its race.

The Sentient threw itself at the Tower, no longer cautious, taking great losses and knowing the prize was worthy of it. Should it succeed all losses would be replaced a thousand-fold.

This is when, across the Plains, the great pylons ignited for the first time. Sheets of energy sprung up between them, powered by the will of the Unum at their epicenter, trapping the monstrosity within.

Loyal Gara, unwilling to heed inaction any longer, broke from the side of the Unum and flew out at night, her eyes on the Sentient Mind.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.zhText:
那 Sentient 察觉到了这诡计，并抓住了乌努母神的动物之一，将之剖开进行检查。乌努母神始料未及的是，那简直就是一份厚礼……它暗星般黑暗的头脑一下子被点亮了。

Sentient，你亦知，是不能生殖的。但是从神殿赤毒中，它尝到了治愈。一种完整性，一个未来。

它吞下了每一个乌努母神的动物，但那还不足够。那 Sentient 将数百只眼睛投向了那座高塔，它有了新的认识：不需要摧毁高塔。它要成为塔。它要杀死乌努母神，取代她的位置然后，依靠那座治愈宫殿，诞生它自己的种族。

Gara 和乌努母神知道了它的位置。

而它知道了塔是种族的未来。

那 Sentient 全力对塔展开了进攻，不再保守，蒙受了惨痛的损失，但它知道这是值得的。一旦它成功了，回报将不可计量。

就在此时，横贯平野的巨大能量塔第一次点亮了。能量壁在它们之间出现，由处于焦点处的乌努母神的意志供给能量，将这怪物困住其中。

忠诚的 Gara，不愿再听从按兵不动的指示，从乌努母神的一侧突破飞入夜空，她紧盯着 Sentient 的心智。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.text:
The Sentient, torn between its most coveted prize and a mortal threat, broke from the Tower and turned back on itself to defend itself from noble Gara.

But Gara's eyes were not for the Sentient - but for the glittering, man-sized device resting just beyond the gates. It had not been there before, but it was there now. The Sentient seized upon the object of her transit, and assessed quickly the mortal threat such a thing posed to its very existence.

It swatted Gara from the sky, drew it to herself, meaning to end her life there and then.

The battle was terrible. Gara sustained injuries she would not survive. But! In her final moments brave Gara seized upon the device her beloved Unum had crafted, seized it to her breast, and allowed the Sentient to draw her in one final time.

Toward its body. Toward its core. Toward the seat of its intelligence.

From within the Sentient unfurled myriad feelers, probes, tendrils - viciously-toothed and made for killing. They swept toward Gara, violently, and the Glass Warrior made no defense. Her defense was her final attack. The device detonated, and the Unum cried out as night lit as day.

The battle - the terror - was ended.

Tower walls shook. The Sentient's body shuddered; wracked by a cacophonous energy. Forests fell as piece after piece, giant body after giant body crashed to the Plains and marshes and flatlands. Animals fled in spreading waves from pounding sky-high walls of dust, angered and whipped to fury by the death of a god.

The last of Gara's energy arced from body-to-body, machine-to-machine, piece-to-piece, a horizon-wide applause of light beautiful and terrible. And then… silence. All was still. The Unum's adherents wandered through the haze, calling for one another, lost in the miasma. Husbands seizing onto wives, children onto parents. It was over.

Gara was never seen again.

The Sentients, then, became as they are now: senseless, wandering, yearning for a unity they sense more than remember.

And the Unum. The Unum survived, alone, for centuries. Until today. When you stand here, reading this.

This is Onkko, Cetus Archivist, with my translation of the Gara legend.
/Lotus/Language/Oddities/GaraLoreFragmen.zhText:
那 Sentient，在最垂涎的奖励和最致命的威胁之间左右为难，它挣脱了高塔，防御来自高贵 Gara 的进攻。

但是 Gara 的目光没有看向那 Sentient——而是向着门外不远处闪闪发光、一个人大小的装置。装置过去不在那里，但现在出现了。那 Sentient 抓住她经过的瞬息，迅速地评估出那装置对其存在的致命威胁。

它将 Gara 拍落地面，向她移动，想要彻底终结她的性命。

那场战斗十分惨烈。Gara 受了无法幸存的伤。但是！在她最后的时刻，勇敢的 Gara 抓住她挚爱的乌努母神所制作的装置，紧紧抱在胸前，将那 Sentient 最后一次引向她。

向着它的身体，向着它的核心，向着它的智慧之座。

从那 Sentient 的体内伸展出无数的触须、探针、触手——布满邪恶的牙齿，为杀戮而存在。它们猛烈地向 Gara 扫来，而玻璃战士丝毫没有防御。她的最终一击就是最好的防御。装置引爆了，当夜空如白昼般被点亮时，乌努母神嚎啕大哭。

战斗——恐怖之物——终结了。

高塔的墙壁摇摇欲坠。那 Sentient 的躯体颤动了；被一道刺耳的能量彻底破坏了。随着一片又一片、一块又一块的巨大躯壳坠落在平野、沼泽和平地，森林随之倒伏。动物如四散的潮水般逃离扬至高空的灰尘组成的墙，它们愤恨，被神之殁亡鞭挞至暴怒。

Gara 最后的能量在体与体、机与机、片与片之间形成弧线，美丽而可怖的光芒交织成地平线宽的景象。然后……只有静寂。所有事物都静止了。乌努母神的信徒穿过阴霾，呼喊迷失在瘴气中的同伴。丈夫握紧妻子的手，孩童紧紧抓住父母。一切都结束了。

从此再也没有人见过 Gara。

那 Sentient，自此，就变成了现在的样子：没有知觉，徘徊着想要变回一体，这是比记忆还要深刻的本能。

而乌努母神，她活了下来，数个世纪孤身一人。直到今天，当你站在这里，阅读这个的时候。

我是昂克，希图斯的档案保管人，这是我对 Gara 的传说的翻译。

/Lotus/Language/Oddities/SeriesOne50Perc.text:

/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/KissOption.zhText: 享受一些二人独处时光……

/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/LyonCapturaMess.text:
Mon miracle,

Thank you for showing me what I would have believed to be otherwise truly impossible. And proving to me that there is hope, even for those of us who are the most shattered.

Forever yours,
- Lyon
/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/LyonCapturaMess.zhText:
Mon miracle，

谢谢你让我看到了我原本认为根本不可能的事情。也谢谢你向我证明，即使是最破碎的人，也依然有希望。

永远爱你的，
——里昂

/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/MarieCapturaMes.text:
Thank you for this wonderful time we shared, my wolf. I shall remember it fondly. I hope you will, as well.

With love,
- Your little Marie
/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/MarieCapturaMes.zhText:
我的狼，谢谢你陪伴我度过的美好时光。我会永远珍藏这段回忆。希望你也会如此。

爱你的，
——你的小玛丽

/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/MissionSelect_P.text: Public matchmaking is disabled for those who enabled Mission Preview and are under Mastery Rank 10. We recommend play with friends that might help in you with this harder content.
/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/MissionSelect_P.zhText: 启用任务预览且精通段位低于10 级的玩家，公开匹配将被禁用。我们建议与可能帮助你的好友一起游玩，以便更好地应对这些难度更高的内容。

/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/MissionSelect_W.text: MISSION PREVIEW WARNING: You have chosen to preview The Descendia and The Perita Rebellion game modes. Theses missions feature difficult gameplay intended for experienced players with fully modded, max rank weapons and Warframes. Some items and resources earned while playing can only be exchanged with characters who are unlocked by completing The Old Peace quest.
/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/MissionSelect_W.zhText: 任务预览警告：你已选择预览"沉沦之地"和"佩里塔叛乱"游戏模式。这些任务难度较高，适合拥有完备的 Mod 配置、满级武器和战甲的经验丰富玩家。部分游戏过程中获得的物品和资源只能与完成《旧日和平》系列任务解锁的角色进行兑换。

/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/OperatorSwapLoc.zhText: 在大教堂内无法切换成指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/RoatheCapturaMe.text:
My love,

The future awaits us. But for now, I shall treasure this small portion of our past. I hope you shall keep it close.

Yours,
- Roathe
/Lotus/Language/OldPeace/RoatheCapturaMe.zhText:
我的爱人，

未来在等着我们。但现在，我会珍惜这段短暂的回忆。希望你也能好好珍藏。

你的，
——罗瑟

/Lotus/Language/Operator/AdultSuitJDesc.text: When coolant offgasses or a fusion-gen gets cracked it's everybody out. Everybody except the haztechs. Drifter armor modeled on the daredevils of Fortuna's maintenance crews.
