/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterAmpSkinD.text: Give the Operator Amp the rugged look of the Drifter's Sirocco pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterAmpSkinD.zhText: 让指挥官的增幅器拥有漂泊者赤风手枪的粗犷外观。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterArabicDe.text: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterArabicDe.zhText: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterAthletic.text: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments and accessories.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterAthletic.zhText: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterDemonfra.text: A suit for the Drifter embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterDemonfra.zhText: 一套专为漂泊者设计的套服，完美体现了极致的奥罗金风格和奢华。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterDexDesc.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterDexDesc.zhText: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterGothDesc.text: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterGothDesc.zhText: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterGrungeDe.text: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterGrungeDe.zhText: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterHoodDesc.text: A hood belonging to a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterHoodDesc.zhText: 一顶属于漂泊者套装的头套。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterLasrianA.text: Embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterLasrianA.zhText: 穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterLasrianB.text: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterLasrianB.zhText: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有他们自己的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterSuitDesc.text: The suit of a Drifter outfit.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterSuitDesc.zhText: 一件漂泊者套装的套服。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/DrifterTattooTe.zhText: 佩戴这款纹身墨水，象征着对「征服癌症活动」的支持。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/EntratiAmpSkinD.text: A custom Operator Amp skin extensively modified by House Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/EntratiAmpSkinD.zhText: 由英择谛家族大幅修改的指挥官增幅器自定义外观。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExcaliburDeluxe.text: Only in silence do we truly hear. Honor Excalibur Zato with this inspired earpiece for your Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExcaliburDeluxe.zhText: 我们只有在静默中才能真正去聆听。为你的指挥官戴上这款灵感十足的耳饰来致敬 Excalibur 盲侠。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExcaliburDeluxe.text: One needs no land to be a liege, nor eyes to see. This mask embodies the spirit of Excalibur Zato.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExcaliburDeluxe.zhText: 无需土地即可成为领主，也无需双眼来看见一切。这个面具体现了 Excalibur 盲侠的精神。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExcaliburDeluxe.text: Embody presence and self-assuredness with this Zato-inspired facial accessory for your Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExcaliburDeluxe.zhText: 给你的指挥官佩戴上这款受盲侠启发而设计的脸部装饰来展现风采和自信。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExtraSkinTonesD.text: Cool artificial complexion tones, including imitation Orokin Blue.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/ExtraSkinTonesD.zhText: 人工冷调肤色，包括仿奥罗金蓝。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/GenericOperator.text: Externalized Somatic Link hardware and resulting facial markings crafted by artisans in the time of The Old War.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/GenericOperator.zhText: 外部化的活体连接器硬件和由此产生的面部标记，由远古之战时期的工匠制作而成。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/GildAmpTooltip.text: Visit Onkko or Little Duck to gild your amp
/Lotus/Language/Operator/GildAmpTooltip.zhText: 拜访昂克或是小鸭子来为你的增幅器镀金

/Lotus/Language/Operator/GreaseArmourArm.text: Armor inspired by those Solaris who must work in searing heat.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/GreaseArmourArm.zhText: 护甲的灵感来自那些必须在灼热环境下工作的索拉里斯人。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/HoodLotusWispDe.text: Wherever you are, this is for you.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/HoodLotusWispDe.zhText: 无论你身处何地，这是给你的。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/HoodNName.zhText: 通风泡博通风小子面罩

/Lotus/Language/Operator/HoodNorgDesc.text: A masterwork of the crafter's art, this exquisite headpiece captures the grace and noble bearing of the majestic Norg. Truly, the prince of fish.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/HoodNorgDesc.zhText: 工匠艺术中的杰作，这款精致的头饰展现了雄伟诺格上优雅和高贵的风采。真正的鱼之王子。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/HoodZephyrDelux.text: A hood belonging to an Operator outfit.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/HoodZephyrDelux.zhText: 一顶属于指挥官套装的头套。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/InkSiroccoAmpSk.text: This sleek amp skin is a masterstroke of craftsmanship.

/Lotus/Language/Operator/LeggingsNName.zhText: 通风泡博通风小子护胫

/Lotus/Language/Operator/NoraNightLeggin.zhText: 适合你们所有梦回者的绑腿。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/NoraNightSleeve.text: Sleeves and gloves for all of you Dreamers out there.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/NoraNightSleeve.zhText: 适合你们所有梦回者的袖件和手套。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/NoraNightSuitDe.text: A suit for all of you Dreamers out there.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/NoraNightSuitDe.zhText: 适合你们所有梦回者的套服。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorArabicD.text: Ready yourself for the heat of battle. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorArabicD.zhText: 为激烈的战斗做好准备。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorAthleti.text: Get your game on with this exclusive line of sportswear-inspired garments and accessories.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorAthleti.zhText: 穿上这一系列以运动风为灵感的服饰，来展现你的最佳状态。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorBDesc.text: Nora Night recovered this suit from Saturn’s Keeler Gap. The durable material lined with rebreather tubing shows it was designed with depressurization in mind.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorBDesc.zhText: 诺拉·夜从土星的凯勒环缝取回了这件套服。耐用的材质配上内衬的循环呼吸导管表明它在设计时考量了减压能力。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorDemonfr.text: A suit embodying the ultimate in Orokin style and luxury.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorDemonfr.zhText: 一套体现极致奥罗金风格和奢华的套服。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorDexDesc.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the tenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorDexDesc.zhText: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 10 周年。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorGothDes.text: Watch from the shadows or dance with the dead, with these Gothic-inspired garments.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorGothDes.zhText: 穿上这些哥特风格的服饰，在暗处观察或与亡者共舞。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorGothFac.text: Express your individuality with these spiked ear piercings.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorGothFac.zhText: 使用这些尖刺耳饰来表达你的个性。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorGrungeD.text: Keep it real on the streets with thrifty, downbeat clothing inspired by the grunge scene.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorGrungeD.zhText: 穿上灵感来源于颓废风格的简约低调街头服饰，保持街头风的真实感。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorHelmet1.text: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorHelmet1.zhText: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。
凯恩壳原子摩托车头盔

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorLasrian.text: Have the Operator embody Scaldra's intimidating military style in the uniform of their elusive elite commanders.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorLasrian.zhText: 让指挥官穿上那些神秘精英指挥官的军服，体现炽蛇军令人生畏的军队风格。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorLasrian.text: The mysterious technicians who staff Scaldra's secret Efervon distilleries have a style all their own. Now it can be the Operator's too.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorLasrian.zhText: 炽蛇军的秘密艾弗旺蒸馏厂的神秘技师们拥有自身的风格。现在，指挥官也可以拥有同样的风采。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorLegging.text: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorLegging.zhText: 穿上这套新千年风格的机车服。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。
凯恩壳原子摩托车绑腿

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorOutfit1.text: Look sharp after miles on the dusty trail. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorOutfit1.zhText: 在尘土飞扬中穿行许久依旧锐不可当。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorOutfit3.text: Invite longevity and protection with a look inspired by the origami crane. Fitted for the Drifter and the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorOutfit3.zhText: 这款以千纸鹤为灵感的外观会带来长寿与保护。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorPrimeAr.text: Take command with this regal Operator suit.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorPrimeAr.zhText: 穿上这套庄严的指挥官服饰来发布号令。
海军准将 Prime 护肩

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorPrimeAr.text: Take command with this regal Operator suit.

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorRemaste.text:
With this update the Operator and Drifter Visages have been lovingly reworked to appear more naturalistic and lifelike.

These changes may have altered their appearance somewhat, would you like to take a moment adjust their new look?
/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorRemaste.zhText:
本次更新中，我们对指挥官和漂泊者的面容进行了精心重制，使其看起来更加自然逼真。

这些改动可能会改变其先前外观，你想要调整新造型吗？

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorSleeves.text: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.

凯恩壳原子摩托车袖件

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorSuit199.text: Slide into this biker outfit of the new millenium. Fitted for the Drifter and Operator.

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorVoiceAD.zhText: 一道指挥官的指挥语音。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/OperatorVoiceDD.zhText: 一道指挥官的明智语音。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/SeerArmourAdult.text: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/SeerArmourAdult.zhText: 以坚定的目标和清晰的愿景而打造。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/SeerArmourDesc.text: Crafted with surety of purpose, and clarity of vision.

/Lotus/Language/Operator/SmelterArmourAr.text: Armor modeled on enviro-gear worn by the surveyors and scouts of the Orb Vallis. Protected by an all-weather cloak they catalogue the wildlife, seek out resources and chart safe routes for patrols and miners.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/SmelterArmourAr.zhText: 依奥布山谷的调查员或侦查员穿戴的装备所仿制的护甲。在对应全天候的大衣保护之下，他们编录野生动物，寻找资源，以及为巡逻员与矿工绘制安全路线。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/SuitM2022TennoC.text: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2022.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/SuitM2022TennoC.zhText: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2022 的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/SuitNDesc.text: Armor modeled on the workshop gear favored by Roky, leader of the industrious Vent Pobbers.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/SuitNDesc.zhText: 依勤劳的通风泡博领导人小洛最喜爱的工坊装备所仿制的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/SuitODesc.text: Armor modeled on the K-drive gear favored by Boon, leader of the canny and cunning Kubrodon Ventkids.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/SuitODesc.zhText: 依谨慎又灵巧的库狛顿领导人阿布最喜爱的 K 式悬浮板装备所仿制的护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TauBreathingShe.text: Worn by Operators to ensure ventilation in the hostile atmosphere of Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TauBreathingShe.zhText: 由指挥官穿戴以确保在 Tau 的恶劣环境下正常呼吸。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TechnomancerArm.text: Living in Fortuna a lot of repairs need to happen in the vents. This lightweight and practical armor is designed for flexibility and tight squeezes.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TechnomancerArm.zhText: 居住在福尔图娜，通风管道经常需要维修。轻便实用的护甲，专为灵活机动和狭窄空间而设计。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.zhText: 是否花费 <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|PRICE| 为指挥官和漂泊者购买额外的外观配置槽位？

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.text: Could not unlock Operator config at this time, please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.zhText: 现在暂时不能解锁指挥官配置，请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.zhText: 需要|ITEM|来解锁额外配置槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.text: A visage to be used on its own or blended with another.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.zhText: 既可单独使用，也可与其他面容融合使用。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.text: Blend between Primary and Secondary faces.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.zhText: 融合主要脸部和次要脸部。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TennoCustomizat.text: [PH] Warning: Features will apply to all configs, except for hair, makeup and tattoos which will only apply to your selected config.

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TeshinArmourBlu.text: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set. This Blueprint grants both Hawk and Lark Armor sets for Operator and Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TeshinArmourBlu.zhText: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。该蓝图提供指挥官和漂泊者的鹰之军神和雀之军神护甲套装。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TeshinArmourBod.text: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set. This Blueprint grants both Hawk and Lark Armor sets for Operator and Drifter, and the Lark Bishamo Gear.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TeshinArmourBod.zhText: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。该蓝图提供指挥官和漂泊者的鹰之军神和雀之军神护甲套装，以及雀之军神装备。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/TeshinArmourDes.text: Uphold the elite warrior tradition of Teshin and the Dax in the Bishamo Armor Set.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/TeshinArmourDes.zhText: 身披军神护甲套装来秉承 Teshin 和禁卫精锐的传统。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/WolfHoodDesc.text: A hood from the only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Fitted for Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/WolfHoodDesc.zhText: 唯一能逃脱出土星六号最高戒备监狱的可怕狂人佩戴的头罩。适用于漂泊者和指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Operator/YontaCrownFacia.text: A venerable piece of regalia intended to emphasize the bearer's knowledge, worn to distinguish those who had achieved the rank of Archimedean.
/Lotus/Language/Operator/YontaCrownFacia.zhText: 一件古老而尊贵的特殊饰品，彰显出佩戴者的学识，为达到哲士等级者所穿戴。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaClimbAbilit.text:
Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaClimbAbilit.zhText:
展开 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿，开始狩猎。Oraxia 免疫异常状态并提升最大生命值。她的远程武器充满 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。击杀敌人会使其爆发 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素。

蛛丝游走：轻按冲刺即可跳跃至目标表面。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaDefaultSkin.text: The standard issue skin for the Oraxia Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaDesc.text: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaDesc.zhText: 阴险优雅与致命多面性交织，进化为完美掠食者。恐惧之名，Oraxia。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaEphemeraDes.text: Surround yourself with the growing dread of Oraxia's presence.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaEphemeraDes.zhText: 让自己沉浸在因 Oraxia 的存在而产生的日益增长的恐惧之中。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaHelmetAltDe.text: Bare your fangs and strike fear into the hearts of your prey with this alternate helmet for Oraxia.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaHelmetAltDe.zhText: 戴上 Oraxia 的替代头盔，露出你的尖牙，让猎物心生恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaHelmetDesc.text: The standard issue helmet for the Oraxia Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaPassiveAbil.text: Wall Latching grants Predator's Lurk, rendering Oraxia invisible for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/OraxiaPassiveAbil.zhText: 壁面攀附可获得「捕食者的潜伏」效果，使 Oraxia 在 |DURATION| 秒内隐身。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/SpiderWhipDesc.text: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/SpiderWhipDesc.zhText: （英文：SPINNEREX）Oraxia 的每一次鞭打都会将致命毒素注入敌人体内，受影响的敌人死亡时爆发毒素，对附近的敌人造成伤害并扩散毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/SpiderWhipInnateM.text: On death, enemies have a 10% chance to burst for each stack of <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect applied to them, spreading <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/SpiderWhipInnateM.zhText: 敌人死亡时，每层叠加的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态都有 10% 的几率爆发，扩散 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/TnOraxiaArmourDes.text: The chitinous spines of Oraxia’s armor lend a menacing aura to any Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Oraxia/TnOraxiaArmourDes.zhText: Oraxia 护甲上的甲壳尖刺为所有 Tenno 增添了威胁气息。

/Lotus/Language/OrbEvent/OrbEventGlyphDe.text: A damaged fragment of data. It's contents may be decipherable if enough fragments are recovered.
/Lotus/Language/OrbEvent/OrbEventGlyphDe.zhText: 损坏的数据碎片。如果在收集到足够的碎片后其中的内容可能可以解密出来。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.text: A prism component for an Operator Amp.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.zhText: 指挥官的增幅器的棱镜部件。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.text: Pulses Void energy through a fine-cut pavilion to riddle targets with flashing fire.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.zhText: 精工切割的棱面中脉冲出一道虚空能量，以闪烁的火光困惑目标。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.text: A convex prism table focuses energy toward a fine-point. Semi-auto, long range, precise.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.zhText: 一个凸面棱镜座将能量聚焦成一个精细的点。半自动、长程、精确。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.text: A roughly-tumbled prism held before a heavy-duty triple shutter-gate. Multi-shot grenade burst.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.zhText: 一个粗略打磨的棱镜安装在一道重型的三重翻板快门前。多重榴弹连射。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.text: A broad, double-crowned cabochon prism for maximum spread. Semi-auto. Short range. Wide angle.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpBarrel.zhText: 宽阔、双冠式凸面棱镜来达成最大扩散。半自动。短程。广角。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpChassi.text: A scaffold component for an Operator Amp.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpChassi.zhText: 指挥官的增幅器的支架部件。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpChassi.text: Launch energy discs that ricochet off victims and surfaces, vectoring toward a new target with each strike.

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpChassi.text: Cradles a large-volume, quick-charge capacitor to unleash a wide, killing beam.

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpChassi.text: Elegant and finely-calibrated proton aggregator latches onto a target and hoses them down.

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpChassi.text: Heavyweight, shock-absorbing scaffold capable of short-range, wide-angle flak blast.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpChassi.zhText: 重量级、减震支架能支持短程、广角高射炮爆破。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpCrafti.text: <WARNING> Select a Prism, Scaffold and Brace to construct a weapon <WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripDe.text: A brace component for an Operator Amp.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripDe.zhText: 指挥官的增幅器的曲柄部件。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripFo.text: A dual-purpose brace that reduces Void energy regeneration delay, and decreases regeneration time, though not as quickly as a single-purpose brace.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripFo.zhText: 一把具有双重用途的曲柄。它既能降低虚空能量再生所需的延迟，亦可缩短再生的时间，但效率未如单一功能的曲柄来得高。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripOn.text: Additional microcapacitors are laced within the armpiece's substructure. Increased ammunition.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripOn.zhText: 臂件的底部构造内装有额外的微型电容，增加弹药。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripTh.text: The armpiece doubles as a throttled overcharger, increasing the likelihood of Critical Hits and Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripTh.zhText: 这个臂件可以充当一个节流超载器，增加暴击几率和触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripTw.text: An array of heat sinks reduce recharge delays.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/AmpGripTw.zhText: 一组散热片阵列减少再充能的延迟。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/Amp_GildC.zhText: 你确定要将选取的增幅器镀金吗？它将被命名为 |NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/BadZawPur.text:
Tenno! Good news!

Hok has graciously refunded your Platinum and whatever Forma you used. Bad news, that Zaw you ordered: it is defective. As in broken. 

Pedlek is the worst. Ugh. He is like those horrible people with wide hands who work in sales. Your order, it is messed up. This is Pedlek's fault.

Pedlek. Not Hok.

Hok apologizes. Come again!
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/BadZawPur.zhText:
Tenno！好消息！

霍刻已友好地退回你所使用的白金和 Forma。接下来就是坏消息了，你订购的那件 Zaw：它是个残次品。是坏的。

佩德莱是这世上最差劲的人。呃，他就像是那些外表白白净净，内心奸诈狡猾的销售员。你的那份订单，搞砸了。这都是佩德莱的错。

是佩德莱的错，跟霍刻没有任何关系。

霍刻在此表示歉意。希望你能再次光临我的店铺！

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeBala.zhText: 一系列用于 Zaw 类武器的环接部，以降低速度、暴击几率为代价来增加伤害与触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: The shaft or handle of an Ostron martial weapon.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: Ostron 军用武器的长杆或手柄。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A two handed Zaw grip used for staff and polearm style weapons.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 用于长棍和长柄武器的双手 Zaw 握柄部。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A two handed Zaw grip used for staff and polearm style weapons. Its light weight provides an increase in speed at the cost of damage.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 用于长棍和长柄武器的双手 Zaw 握柄部。它的轻巧以降低伤害作为代价来增加速度。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A one-handed grip, for measured strikes and greater impact.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 一件单手的握柄，为精确的攻击和猛烈的冲击而造。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A Zaw grip used for sword, machete, rapier and dagger style weapons. Its light weight provides an increase in speed at the cost of damage.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 用于剑、砍刀、细剑、和匕首武器的 Zaw 握柄部。它的轻巧以降低伤害作为代价来增加速度。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A two handed Zaw grip used for staff and polearm style weapons. Its heavy weight provides an increase in damage at the cost of Speed.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 用于长棍和长柄武器的双手 Zaw 握柄部。它沉重的重量以降低速度作为代价来增加伤害。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A two-handed grip, for measured strikes and greater impact.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 一件双持的握柄，为精确的攻击和猛烈的冲击而造。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A Zaw grip used for sword, machete, rapier and dagger style weapons. Its heavy weight provides an increase in damage at the cost of Speed.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 用于长剑、砍刀、细剑或匕首类 Zaw 武器握柄。其沉重质量以速度换取了伤害力的增长。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.text: A Zaw grip used for sword, machete, rapier and dagger style weapons.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeHand.zhText: 用于剑、砍刀、细剑、和匕首武器的 Zaw 握柄部。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.text: An Infested one-handed grip. Its light weight provides an increase in speed at the cost of damage.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.zhText: 一种感染单手握柄。它轻盈的重量以伤害为代价提升了速度。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.text: An Infested two-handed grip. Its heavy weight provides an increase in damage at the cost of Speed.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.zhText: 一种感染双手握柄。它沉重的重量以速度为代价提升了伤害。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.text: An Infested rapier-like or polearm strike that also deals <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage. Its light weight provides an increase in Speed at the cost of Damage.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.zhText: 一种感染细剑或长柄的打击部，可以产生 <DT_VIRAL> 伤害。它轻盈的重量以伤害为代价提升了速度。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.text: An Infested scythe or staff head strike that also deals <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage. Its heavy weight provides an increase in Damage at the cost of Speed.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeInfe.zhText: 一种感染镰刀或长棍的打击部，可以产生 <DT_VIRAL> 伤害。它沉重的重量以速度为代价提升了伤害。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipD.text: The offensive component of an Ostron martial weapon.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipD.zhText: Ostron 军用武器的攻击部件。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipE.text: A light Zaw Strike for Scythe or Heavy Blade weapons. Lightweight, for flash and bite.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipE.zhText: 一组极尽适合镰刀或重型刃器的轻型 Zaw。轻量化，追求刀光霍霍且咬骨断肉。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipF.text: A Zaw Strike used for rapier and polearm style weapons. Its light weight increases speed at the cost of damage.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipF.zhText: 用于细剑和长柄武器的 Zaw 击打部。它的轻巧以降低伤害作为代价来增加速度。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipF.text: A Zaw Strike used for machete and polearm style weapons.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipF.zhText: 用于砍刀和长柄武器的 Zaw 击打部

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipN.text: A balanced Zaw Strike for Nikana and Staff weapons. A steady blade for steady hands.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipN.zhText: 用于侍刃和长棍的 Zaw 打击部。沉稳之人适用的沉稳之刃。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipO.text: A Zaw Strike used for dagger and staff style weapons. Its light weight increases speed at the cost of damage.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipO.zhText: 用于匕首和长棍武器的 Zaw 击打部。它的轻巧以降低伤害作为代价来增加速度。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipS.text: A Zaw Strike used for machete and polearm style weapons. Its heavy weight increases damage at the cost of Speed.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipS.zhText: 用于砍刀和长柄武器的 Zaw 击打部。它沉重的重量以降低速度作为代价来增加伤害。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipT.text: A heavy Zaw Strike for Machete and Hammer weapons. Measure twice, strike once... heavily.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipT.zhText: 用于砍刀和重锤的 Zaw 打击部。三思而行，行则致命。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipT.text: A Zaw Strike used for sword and polearm style weapons. Its heavy weight increases damage at the cost of Speed.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipT.zhText: 用于剑和长柄武器的 Zaw 击打部。它沉重的重量以降低速度作为代价来增加伤害。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipT.text: A Zaw Strike used for sword and staff style weapons.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/MeleeTipT.zhText: 用于剑和长棍武器的 Zaw 击打部。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/NoWeaponO.text: No Daily Special available, please check back later.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/NoWeaponO.zhText: 尚无每日特惠，请稍候回来查看。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/OperatorT.text: Amps concentrate and modify an Operator's Void Beam. This starting amp is powerful but lacks the flexibility of assembled amps.
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/OperatorT.zhText: 增幅器能集中并改变一名指挥官的虚空射线。这个初始增幅器很强大，但是缺乏了装配增幅器的灵活性。

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/Prospecto.zhText: 用宝石来换取 Ostron 声望

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/QuillsSta.text: Trade Sentient Cores for Quill Standing
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/QuillsSta.zhText: 用 Sentient 的核心来换取夜羽声望

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/UnableToG.text: Unable to combine parts for preview
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/UnableToG.zhText: 无法组合部件进行预览

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/WeaponMan.zhText: 武器轮换会在 <TIMER> |TIME| 后改变

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/WeaponOfT.zhText: 购买时间将在 <TIMER> |TIME| 后过期

/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/WeaponOfT.text: |TYPE| costs <PLATINUM_CREDITS> |PRICE| and it will be named |NAME|. Purchase?
/Lotus/Language/OstronCrafting/WeaponOfT.zhText: |TYPE| 花费 <PLATINUM_CREDITS> |PRICE| 将它将命名为 |NAME|。要购买吗？
每日特惠会在 <TIMER> |TIME| 后改变

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AllTeralystsH.text: Team up with your fellow Tenno to take down three massive Eidolons.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AllTeralystsH.zhText: 与你的 Tenno 战友一起击倒三只巨型夜灵。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AssassinateBo.text: A Grineer leader will only show their face if we disrupt Grineer operations across several fronts.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AssassinateBo.zhText: 一名 Grineer 领导者只会在我们干扰其多处前线行动的时候现身。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AssassinateBo.text: A new Grineer commander has been no end of trouble. Capture them.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AssassinateBo.zhText: 一名新任的 Grineer 指挥官已经不断在制造麻烦。捉住指挥官。
捕获新任 Grineer 指挥官

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBoun.text: Deal a blow to a Grineer detachment's morale by capturing their commander.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBoun.zhText: 捉住他们的指挥官能对 Grineer 的分遣队造成士气上的打击。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBoun.text: The Grineer grow too strong in number. Weaken them.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBoun.zhText: Grineer 的数量已经太多了。削弱他们。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBoun.text: Expel the Grineer from their outpost on the Plains
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/AttritionBoun.zhText: 将 Grineer 从他们在平野上的外哨赶出去
重创 Grineer 的补给链。
破坏 Grineer 的补给线

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/CaptureBounty.text: A high-ranking Grineer has landed on the plains. Bring them to the Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/CaptureBounty.zhText: 一名高阶的 Grineer 已经登陆到平野上。将他们带给 Lotus。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/CaptureBounty.text: There's a Grineer spy in Cetus. Put pressure on the Grineer and force the spy out.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/CaptureBounty.zhText: 发现一名 Grineer 的间谍潜藏在希图斯村中。对 Grineer 施加压力将那位间谍逼出来。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyAs.text: Hunt down a Ghoul Alpha and weaken their presence on the plains.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyAs.zhText: 猎杀一个尸鬼头领，并削弱它们在平野上的规模。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyEx.text: Launch an assault on Grineer burial grounds and send a message to Vay Hek.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyEx.zhText: 对 Grineer 的埋养地发起进攻，向韦·海克表明立场。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyHu.text: Find and destroy a Ghoul burial site before they can wake.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyHu.zhText: 在尸鬼觉醒前，找到并消灭尸鬼埋养地

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyHu.text: PURGE A MASSIVE GHOUL BURIAL SITE
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyHu.zhText: 净化一个巨型尸鬼埋养地

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyRe.text: Steel Meridian has identified a potential Ghoul defector, rescue them from certain death.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulBountyRe.zhText: 钢铁防线已经辨识出一个可能的尸鬼叛逃者，进行营救，避免其注定的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulsEndInbo.text: The people of Cetus thank you.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulsEndInbo.zhText: 希图斯的人向你表示感谢。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulsStartIn.text: |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|Grineer Ghouls|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| threaten Cetus. Get to the Plains of Eidolon and help control this threat.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/GhoulsStartIn.zhText: |OPEN_COLOR||OPEN_BOLD|Grineer 尸鬼|CLOSE_BOLD||CLOSE_COLOR| 正在威胁着希图斯。前往夜灵平野来帮助控制住这一威胁。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/HeadOfSnakeDe.zhText: 斩首 Grineer 的指挥系统

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/HeadOfSnakeTw.zhText: 破坏 Grineer 的指挥系统

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/HijackIntelDe.text: We have word of a fallen drone somewhere in the Plains. Invade the Grineer to find it's location
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/HijackIntelDe.zhText: 我们得到消息有一架坠落的无人机在平野的某个地方。入侵 Grineer 的领地并找到其位置。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/HurtFeelingsF.text: Deal a blow to Grineer morale

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/JobInProgress.text: A mission is currently in progress for this squad. New bounties cannot be chosen at this time.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/JobInProgress.zhText: 目前小队中有一个正在进行的任务。这时候无法选择新的赏金任务。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/LightsOutDesc.text: Disrupt Grineer monitoring of the Plains
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/LightsOutDesc.zhText: 扰乱 Grineer 对平野的监视

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/NewPlayerJobD.text: Prove your ability. Show Konzu what you're capable of!
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/NewPlayerJobD.zhText: 证明你的能力。让孔尊看看你的能耐！

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/NoJobs.zhText: <TIMER> 没有可执行的赏金。于 |SECONDS| 秒后重置。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/RainalystHunt.text: Kill or capture the Eidolon Hydrolyst
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/RainalystHunt.zhText: 击杀或捕获夜灵水力使

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBo.text: The Grineer have taken an Orokin artifact. Find where they have stashed it.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBo.zhText: Grineer 夺走了一件奥罗金神器。找出他们已埋藏的神器。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBo.text: An item of great importance to the Quills has been taken by the Grineer. Locate the agent who stole it and bring him in.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBo.zhText: 一件对夜羽的重要道具已经被 Grineer 夺取。找出夺走神器的特工并捉住他。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBo.text: The Quills say the Grineer have stolen a precious Orokin artifact. Steal it back.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/ReclamationBo.zhText: 夜羽表示 Grineer 偷走了一件珍贵的奥罗金神器。把它偷回来。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/RescueBountyR.text: An Ostron has gone missing on the plains. Find them and bring them home.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/RescueBountyR.zhText: 一名 Ostron 人在平野上失踪了。找到他们并带他们回家。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/SabotageBount.text: Prototype tech is being delivered to the Grineer. Scour the Plains until you find it!
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/SabotageBount.zhText: 原型科技正要运送给 Grineer。扫遍整个平野直到你找到为止！

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/SpyCatcherDes.text: A Grineer spy was found in Cetus. He flees across the Plains. Catch him.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/SpyCatcherDes.zhText: 希图斯中发现了一名 Grineer 间谍，并已经逃到了平野之中。逮住他。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/StarveEmOutAg.zhText: 切断 Grineer 的供给链

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/TeralystHuntD.text: Team up with your fellow Tenno to hunt a Teralyst.
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/TeralystHuntD.zhText: 与你的 Tenno 战友一起猎杀一只兆力使。

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/TeralystHuntK.text: Kill or capture the Eidolon Teralyst
/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/TeralystHuntK.zhText: 击杀或捕获夜灵兆力使

/Lotus/Language/OstronJobs/WhatsYoursIsM.zhText: 侵占 Grineer 的采矿行动

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/AFEnemy.text: <WARNING> Fully scan enemy types to use them as Articulas <WARNING>
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/AFEnemy.zhText: <WARNING> 完全扫描的敌人种类可以用作可动模型 <WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/AddFish.text: Fish tank capacity has been reached.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/AddFish.zhText: 已经达到鱼缸的容量上限。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Bluepri.text: It's time we made some changes around here.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Bluepri.zhText: 是时候在这里做出一些改变。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Bluepri.text: A SPACE TO MAKE YOUR OWN
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Bluepri.zhText: 一个你私人定制的空间

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/DecoRem.text: Changing vignettes will return any placed decorations in that space to your inventory.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/DecoRem.zhText: 改变装饰景观会使放置在该区域内的所有装饰返回仓库。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishNoT.text: The Aquarium vignette must be selected to place fish in the MAIN tank.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishNoT.zhText: 必须选择水族箱装饰景观才可以在主要鱼缸中放置鱼类。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishSel.text: Fish will be removed from your inventory, but can be retrieved at any time.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishSel.zhText: 这条鱼将会从您的仓库中移除，但是可以在任意时候取回。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishTan.text: Each fish tank can hold up to 10 fish.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishTan.zhText: 每一个鱼缸至多可放置10条鱼。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishTan.text: Each tank can support up to 2 large fish.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishTan.zhText: 每个鱼缸至多可维持2条大鱼。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishTan.text: This fish tank can only support |NUM| large fish.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/FishTan.zhText: 这个鱼缸只能容纳 |NUM| 条大鱼。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: <WARNING> 使用 |CALLOUT| 上下翻阅曲目

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.text: Unlock music tracks to play in your Orbiter by scanning Somachord Tones in missions.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: 通过在任务中扫描身心和弦琴碎片来解锁音调，以在你的轨道飞行器中播放。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.text: Somachord Tones spawn randomly in missions and are marked with<SOMACHORD>.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: 身心和弦琴音调会在任务中随机生成，并被标记为<SOMACHORD>。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.text: The Mods Loot Detector, Animal Instinct and Thief's Wit can help in your search for Somachord Tones <SOMACHORD>.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: Mod 如战利品探测器、动物本能和盗贼天赋可以帮助你搜索身心和弦琴碎片 <SOMACHORD>。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.text: The Helios Sentinel with its Investigator Mod can scan Somachord Tones <SOMACHORD> for you.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: 装备侦察 Mod 的赫利俄斯守护可以为你扫描身心和弦琴碎片 <SOMACHORD>。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.text: You can create your own Orbiter music using Octavia's Mandachord instrument.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: 你可以使用 Octavia 的曼达和弦琴创作自己的轨道飞行器音乐。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.text: Autoplay is enabled by default and can be toggled on unlocked songs with <MENU_RIGHT_CLICK>.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: 自动播放功在默认情况下启用，并可以通过 <MENU_RIGHT_CLICK> 切换已解锁的歌曲。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.text: Autoplay is enabled by default and can be toggled on unlocked songs with <MENU_RTRIGGER1>.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/Jukebox.zhText: 自动播放功在默认情况下启用，并可以通过 <MENU_RTRIGGER1> 切换已解锁的歌曲。

/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/RemoveF.text: No fish in tank to remove.
/Lotus/Language/PersonalQuarters/RemoveF.zhText: 鱼缸中没有鱼可以移除。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/ArmoredInfestedCatb.text: Devolves into its larval form when downed and attacks enemies with quills, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage each. Regains true form after |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/ArmoredInfestedCatb.zhText: 倒地后化为幼体形态，并用毛刺攻击敌人，每发造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。在 |DURATION| 秒后以它的真实形态复活。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/ArtaxPassiveDesc.text: Innate +20% <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage, independent from any other Elemental Damage types.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/ArtaxPassiveDesc.zhText: 自带 +20% <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害，独立于任何其他元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastBloodthirstMod.text: |AMOUNT| health stolen each hit per stack of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastBloodthirstMod.zhText: 每叠加一层 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割，每次攻击都会窃取 |AMOUNT| 点生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastBruteCondition.text: Convert all base Physical Damage to <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastBruteCondition.zhText: 将所有基础物理伤害转换为 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastDisablingCondi.text: Convert all base Physical Damage to <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastDisablingCondi.zhText: 将所有基础物理伤害转换为 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastMagneticImpact.text: |CHANCE|% Chance to apply a <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic status effect when inflicting an <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact status effect
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastMagneticImpact.zhText: 造成 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态时，有 |CHANCE|% 几率施加 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastNeutralStanceD.text: The companion acts freely as they see fit. Staggers enemies within |RANGE|m while moving.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastNeutralStanceD.zhText: 同伴可随心所欲地行动。移动时使 |RANGE| 米范围内的敌人失衡。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastPacifistStance.text: The companion will avoid attacking. +|AMOUNT|% Evasion
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastPacifistStance.zhText: 同伴将避开攻击。+|AMOUNT|% 回避

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastPersistentStan.text: The companion will pick a target and then attack it relentlessly. +|AMOUNT|% Impact Damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastPersistentStan.zhText: 同伴会选择一个目标，然后无情地攻击它。+|AMOUNT|% 冲击伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastPrecisionCondi.text: Convert all base Physical Damage to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastPrecisionCondi.zhText: 将所有基础物理伤害转换为 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastProtectorStanc.text: The companion will prioritize attacking enemies within 15m of the Warframe. Attacks inflict +|AMOUNT| <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Status Effects
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastProtectorStanc.zhText: 同伴将优先攻击战甲 15 米范围内的敌人。攻击造成 +|AMOUNT| <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastReelingImpactM.text: Melee attacks knock down enemies and apply |val| <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effects
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastReelingImpactM.zhText: 近战攻击会击倒敌人并造成 |val| <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastSpreadAttacksS.text: The companion prefers to change its target after each attack. +|AMOUNT|% Status Duration
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastSpreadAttacksS.zhText: 同伴喜欢在每次攻击后更换目标。+|AMOUNT|% 异常状态持续时间

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastVIPStanceDesc.text: The companion will prioritize Eximus and other high-ranking enemies. +|AMOUNT|% Overguard Damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/BeastVIPStanceDesc.zhText: 同伴将优先考虑卓越者和其他高级敌人。+|AMOUNT|% 超宏防护伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/BonusDamageOnNonCri.zhText: 非暴击攻击造成 |val|% 伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/ConfirmUnmaturePet.text:
|NAME| will regress to a cub.

Warning: This will unequip the companion.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/ConfirmUnmaturePet.zhText:
|NAME| 将会回退为一只幼崽。

警告：该操作将卸下装备的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/ConservationLoreDes.text: Available from Son in the Necralisk, Master Teasonai in Cetus, and The Business in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/ConservationLoreDes.zhText: 可从殁世幽都的"儿子"、希图斯的提松奈大师和福尔图娜的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/DuviriCatbrowSkinDe.text: Bring ‘The Tales of Duviri' back to the Origin System with this Kexat skin for your Kavat.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/DuviriCatbrowSkinDe.zhText: 将《双衍王境故事集》中的可娃带回始源星系作为库娃外观。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/EmpyreanSentinelDef.text: The standard issue skin for the Nautilus Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/EmpyreanSentinelDef.zhText: 鹦鹉螺守护的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/EmpyreanSentinelDes.text: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/EmpyreanSentinelDes.zhText: 以「万用自修」和「防线封锁」为默认指令，这件守护是搭乘航道星舰远航的理想同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/EmpyreanSentinelRec.text: The Nautilus Blueprint and necessary construction resources can be found inside Ice Mines around Neptune Proxima.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/EmpyreanSentinelRec.zhText: 鹦鹉螺蓝图和必要的建造资源可以在海王星比邻星域附近的冰矿中找到。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerDethcubeSki.text: The Vegetation and Environment Regulation Drone - Independent Element faithfully maintained Zariman greenery even after all was lost and is thrilled to have company once again.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerDethcubeSki.zhText: 植被与环境监管无人机——独立单元忠实地维护着「扎里曼号」的绿化。即使在失去了一切之后，也为再次拥有了同伴而感到激动不已。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerMaskDesc.text: A mask attachment for the VERD-IE Sentinel Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerMaskDesc.zhText: 环管-独立机守护外观的面具配件。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerTailDesc.text: A stylish tail attachment for the VERD-IE Sentinel Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerTailDesc.zhText: 环管-独立机守护外观的时髦尾部配件。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerWingsDesc.text: A pair of wings for the VERD-IE Sentinel Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/GardenerWingsDesc.zhText: 环管-独立机守护外观的一对飞翼。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/GatherEnemiesPrecep.text: Nautilus forces enemies within |VAL|m of the target into clusters for easier targeting. Cooldown: 15s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/GatherEnemiesPrecep.zhText: 鹦鹉螺把目标范围 |VAL| 米内的敌人强行聚集以便于瞄准。冷却时间：15 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/HelminthChargerPass.text: Innate +25% <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxic Damage, independent from any other elemental damage types.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/HelminthChargerPass.zhText: 自带 +25% <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害，独立于任何其他元素伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/HornedInfestedCatbr.text: Devolves into its larval form when downed and charges at enemies, dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage. Regains true form after |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/HornedInfestedCatbr.zhText: 倒地后化为幼体形态，并冲向敌人造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害。在 |DURATION| 秒后以它的真实形态复活。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/IncubateWhileImprin.text: Cannot incubate a new pet while the current pet is imprinting.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/IncubateWhileImprin.zhText: 当前宠物正在提取基因印记时，无法孵化一只新的宠物。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedCatbrowDual.text: Manifest a pair of Tentacles from the shoulders strike out at enemies within |RANGE|m for |DAMAGE| damage.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedCatbrowDual.zhText: 从肩膀上伸出一对触手，以在 |RANGE| 米范围内对敌人造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedCatbrowEvas.text:
On Bullet Jump:
Enemies lose sight of you for |DURATION|s. <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedCatbrowEvas.zhText:
旋身飞跃时：
敌人会看不见你，持续 |DURATION| 秒。冷却时间为 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedCatbrowGore.text: Charges an enemy within |RANGE|m dealing <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage and lifting them. While lifted, enemy is flung at nearby foes dealing an additional |DAMAGE|% of the thrown enemy's health and adding 5 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status to enemies within 5m.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedCatbrowGore.zhText: 冲向 |RANGE| 米内的敌人，造成 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害并使其浮空。浮空的敌人会被抛向附近的敌人，额外造成相当于被抛敌人生命值 |DAMAGE|% 的伤害，并使 5 米范围内的敌人增加 5 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedKavatViralQ.text: Launches |QUILLS| quills at enemies within |DISTANCE|m, each dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with 40% Status Chance. If the target is affected by a Viral Status, a Spore is added. <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedKavatViralQ.zhText: 对 |DISTANCE| 米内的敌人发射 |QUILLS| 发毛刺，每发造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，且有 40% 的触发几率。如果目标已带有病毒异常状态，则会有一个孢子生出。<LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN| 秒冷却时间。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorBuf.text: Release a cloud of spores that persists for |DURATION|s increasing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage by +|AMOUNT|% for |BUFF_DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorBuf.zhText: 释放一团孢子，以增加 |AMOUNT|% <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害，持续 |BUFF_DURATION| 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorFin.text: Charges at an enemy within |RANGE|m dealing |DAMAGE| damage. This releases spores that affect enemies within 15m, opening them up to Melee Finishers, and slowing them by 50% for 10s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorFin.zhText: 冲向 |RANGE| 米内的敌人，造成 |DAMAGE| 点伤害。这会释放出影响 15 米范围内敌人的孢子，使他们处于可处决状态，并使其减速 50%，持续 10 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorHea.text: Release a trail of spores every <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s that heal the companion and its allies for |AMOUNT| health over |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorHea.zhText: <LOWER_IS_BETTER>每 |COOLDOWN| 秒释放一股孢子，并在 |DURATION| 秒内为同伴及其友军恢复 |AMOUNT| 生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorInf.text: An attack that deals +|DAMAGE|% Finisher Damage and infects the target with a Virus that grows |COUNT| volatile pustules that react to damage and explode.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorInf.zhText: 造成一次 +|DAMAGE|% 伤害的处决攻击，并让目标感染病毒，使其长出 |COUNT| 个对伤害有反应的挥发性脓疱。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorMag.text: Every <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s spits out a maggot that latches onto the nearest enemy, drawing fire from those within |DISTANCE|m. On death, the maggot bursts, dealing |VIRAL_DMG|% of accumulated damage <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage (+40% damage if the enemy dies while latched) to those within |VIRAL_DIST|m.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorMag.zhText: 每隔 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN| 秒吐出一条蛆虫。蛆虫会吸附在最近的敌人身上，吸引 |DISTANCE| 米内的其他敌人对其进行攻击。蛆虫死亡时会爆炸，在 |VIRAL_DIST| 米范围内造成等于其积累伤害 |VIRAL_DMG|% 的 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>|VIRAL_DMG| 病毒伤害（如果敌人在被吸附期间死亡则 +40 伤害）。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorSpi.text: Every <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN|s spit acidic tar at an enemy within |DISTANCE|m, blinding them for |TIME|s and dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorSpi.zhText: 每 <LOWER_IS_BETTER>|COOLDOWN| 秒，向 |DISTANCE| 米内的敌人吐出一团酸性焦油，使其致盲 |TIME| 秒，并造成 |DAMAGE| <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorSpi.text: Transmit an endoparasite to an enemy within |DISTANCE|m. Tentacles spawn from it, clinging to enemies within |RANGE|m slowing them as they move further from the parasite, and dealing |DAMAGE| <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage/sec over |TIME|s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/InfestedPredatorSpi.zhText: 将内寄生虫传至 |DISTANCE| 米内的一名敌人。触须会从其中生成，缠住 |RANGE| 米范围内敌人，敌人离寄生虫越远则速度越慢，并且在 |TIME| 秒内，以每秒 |DAMAGE| <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害的频率造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KavatArmourDuviriDe.text: Sleek armor inspired by the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KavatArmourDuviriDe.zhText: 这款时髦护甲的灵感来自于《双衍王境故事集》。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KavatSkinDaybreakDe.text: Make your Kavat’s fur shine with solar majesty.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KavatSkinDaybreakDe.zhText: 让你的库娃皮毛闪耀着如太阳一般的光辉。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowColdConversio.text: Converts all elemental damage from these claws to <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowColdConversio.zhText: 将这些利爪造成的所有元素伤害转换为 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowElectricConve.text: Converts all elemental damage from these claws to <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowElectricConve.zhText: 将这些利爪造成的所有元素伤害转换为 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowFerocityModDe.text: Kubrow attacks an enemy open to finishers with +|DAMAGE|% crit chance. If the enemy dies during the attack, enemies within |RANGE|m have a 30% chance to be knocked down and opened to finishers.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowFerocityModDe.zhText: 库狛攻击处于可处决状态的敌人时，暴击几率 +|DAMAGE|%。如果敌人在攻击过程中死亡，则 |RANGE| 米范围内的敌人有 30% 几率会被击倒并处于可处决状态。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowFireConversio.text: Converts all elemental damage from these claws to <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowFireConversio.zhText: 将这些利爪造成的所有元素伤害转换为 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowHelminthFeroc.text: Allows the Kubrow to use Finisher attacks on an enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowHelminthFeroc.zhText: 让库狛能对敌人使出处决攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowLockedDetails.text: Your current pet must complete imprinting before another can be equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowLockedDetails.zhText: 你当前的宠物必须完成基因印记的提取才能携带另一只宠物。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowNoCollar_Desc.text: |NAME| cannot accompany you on missions until they have a collar. Complete the "Howl Of The Kubrow" quest to acquire a collar.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowNoCollar_Desc.zhText: 你的 |NAME| 需要一个项圈才能与你一同进行任务，请完成《库狛取得任务》以获取项圈。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowSkinDaybreakD.text: Make your Kubrow’s fur shine with solar majesty.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowSkinDaybreakD.zhText: 让你的库狛皮毛闪耀着如太阳一般的光辉。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowSkinDuviriWol.text: A fur pattern commissioned by Euleria Entrati to manifest a creature from the storybook, Tales of Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowSkinDuviriWol.zhText: 由欧拉瑞娅·英择谛委托制作的毛皮图案，用于显现故事书《双衍王境故事集》中的生物。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowSkinEntratiMe.text: Albrecht Entrati’s experiments have made it possible to give your Kubrow’s fur the look of machinery.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowSkinEntratiMe.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛进行的实验让库狛有了机械般的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowToxicConversi.text: Converts all elemental damage from these claws to <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin damage
/Lotus/Language/Pets/KubrowToxicConversi.zhText: 将这些利爪造成的所有元素伤害转换为 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害

/Lotus/Language/Pets/LuckyCompanionCredi.zhText: |CHANCE|% 几率使现金拾取数量翻倍

/Lotus/Language/Pets/LuckyCompanionModDe.text: |CHANCE|% chance to double Credit and Resource pickups
/Lotus/Language/Pets/LuckyCompanionModDe.zhText: |CHANCE|% 几率使现金和资源拾取数量翻倍

/Lotus/Language/Pets/LuckyCompanionResou.zhText: |CHANCE|% 几率使资源拾取数量翻倍

/Lotus/Language/Pets/RepairShipPreceptDe.text: Nautilus has |VAL|% chance to repair nearby Railjack hull damages and extinguishes fires on Railjack. Cooldown: 20s.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/RepairShipPreceptDe.zhText: 鹦鹉螺有 |VAL|% 的几率修复附近的航道星舰舰体损伤并扑灭航道星舰上的火灾。冷却时间：20 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/UnableToUnmatureCha.text: Age Regression is unavailable for this lifeform.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/UnableToUnmatureCha.zhText: 该生物无法进行年龄回退。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/VampireKavatDesc.text: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/VampireKavatDesc.zhText: 现在，这些库娃已经摆脱了噬血病毒，它们可以通过输送生命来延长自己的生命值，同时也可以延长主人的生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/VampireShieldDesc.text: Drains and stores |INCREMENT_AMOUNT| health from corpses within |RANGE|m up to |POOL_AMOUNT|% of your health. If your health falls below |ACTIVATION_THRESHOLD|%, Companion downs itself to heal you.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/VampireShieldDesc.zhText: 从 |RANGE| 米内的尸体处，吸取并存储 |INCREMENT_AMOUNT| 生命值，上限为其主人最大生命值的 |POOL_AMOUNT|%。如果主人的生命值低于 |ACTIVATION_THRESHOLD|%，那么它会自行倒地并治愈主人。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/VascaImprintDesc.text:
An imprint taken from a kavat infected with the Vasca Virus.

Note: This can only be used with other Vasca Imprints from a Kavat with Vasca virus or Vasca Kavat Starter Kit.
/Lotus/Language/Pets/VascaImprintDesc.zhText:
摘自感染了噬血病毒的库娃的基因印记。

注意：只能与其它噬血型基因印记（来自受噬血病毒感染的库娃或噬血型库娃初心者套装）一起使用。

/Lotus/Language/Pets/VascaSpliceConfirm.text: Vasca Imprints are as wild as Vasca Kavats. Mixing Vasca Imprints with other Kavat Imprints may produce unpredictable results. Proceed?
/Lotus/Language/Pets/VascaSpliceConfirm.zhText: 噬血型基因印记与噬血型库娃一样狂野。将噬血型基因印记与其他库娃基因印记混合，可能会产生不可预知的效果。是否继续？

/Lotus/Language/Photobooth/Photobooth_Ca.text: Cannot place more than |CAMNUM| camera positions.
/Lotus/Language/Photobooth/Photobooth_Ca.zhText: 无法摆放超过 |CAMNUM| 个镜头位置。

/Lotus/Language/Photobooth/Photobooth_Ca.text:
The 'Add Camera Position' button will save the current state of the camera as well as the current state of all other values such as camera speed, field of view, saturation, etc.

The 'Play Camera' button will automatically and smoothly move the camera through each of the positions and rotations that you have added. For best results, avoid having very large changes in rotation between positions.

While the camera is playing, it will interpolate its speed to match the camera speed value that you had set at each position, and the camera speed option can then be used as a global multiplier on top of the camera speeds that you have set at each position.

If you have 'Interpolate Visual Effects' enabled, the camera will also 'move' through the different values for other effects that you set at each point. For example, if you have different saturation values set at each camera position that you added, the saturation will interpolate between those values as the camera moves.

The 'Look At Character' option will force the camera to always look at your currently controlled character.

The 'Detach Camera' option allows you to keep the camera in place (or moving if it's currently playing) so that you may return to controlling your character while the camera operates itself separately from your character.
/Lotus/Language/Photobooth/Photobooth_Ca.zhText:
“增加镜头位置”按钮能将当前镜头状态保存下来，其他诸如镜头速度、视野和饱和度等参数均会被保存。

“播放镜头”按钮可以让镜头在各个已保存的位置和转向点之间自行平滑移动。为了最佳的拍摄效果，请不要将各个位置间的转向角度设置得过大。

镜头在播放过程中会自动根据你在每个位置设定的速度来调整当前速度，而镜头速度选项则可以影响镜头的整体运行速度，你在每个位置上设定的镜头速度都会受到它的影响。

如果你启用了“插值视觉效果”选项，那么镜头还会根据每个位置上设定的其他效果数值来“变动”。举例来说，如果你在每个镜头位置上设定了不同的饱和度参数，那么当镜头在这些位置间移动时，其饱和度属性也会在这些设定值之间逐渐变化。

“看向角色”选项会使镜头始终朝向你当前控制的角色。

“分离镜头”选项可以让你将镜头固定在原地（若镜头处于播放过程中，则其会处于运动状态），这样你就可以在镜头自主运动的过程中将控制对象切回你的角色身上。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AdultPrimeSuitFDe.text: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AdultPrimeSuitFDe.zhText: 将 Tenno 的特能与 Sentient 设计融为一体的 Tauron 学院制服。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AfentisPrimeDesc.text: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AfentisPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：AFENTIS PRIME）Styanax Prime 的镀金标枪如同战场上的灯塔般闪耀，鼓舞盟友，震慑敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkJagaraPrimeDesc.text: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkJagaraPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：AKJAGARA PRIME）精密加工的镜像手枪。填装完毕并蓄势待发。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkboltoPrimeDesc.text: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkboltoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：Akbolto Prime）镀金的导轨装饰着这对凶猛的钉枪。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkmagnusPrimeDesc.text: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkmagnusPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：AKMAGNUS PRIME）给你的拳中塞上这愤怒的金色教条。这种精良的设计可加快操作速度并提高暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkrabuPrimeSyanda.text: The ornate charms on this Syandana represent the ideal of serenity.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkrabuPrimeSyanda.zhText: 这件披饰上的华丽坠饰代表了宁静的理想。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkvastoPrimeDesc.text: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AkvastoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：AKVASTO PRIME）奥罗金精湛工艺与出众火力的结合。两把瓦斯托，已经装弹待发。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AltraPrimeScarfDe.text: A shining garment befitting the Saint of Altra.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AltraPrimeScarfDe.zhText: 适合阿尔特拉圣者的闪亮服装。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AltraPrimeScarfNa.zhText: 阿尔特拉 Prime 披饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AshPrimeDesc.text: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AshPrimeDesc.zhText: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的 Ash Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AshPrimeHelmetDes.text: The standard issue helmet for the Ash Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AshPrimePassiveAb.text: <DT_SLASH>Slash Status Effects inflicted on enemies do |DAMAGE|% increased damage and last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AshPrimePassiveAb.zhText: 敌人受到的 <DT_SLASH>切割异常状态会让伤害增加 |DAMAGE|% 且持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AstillaPrimeDesc.text: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AstillaPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：ASTILLA PRIME）Gara 标志性的霰弹枪以惊人的 Prime 形态呈现，可以射出爆炸性的玻璃弹头来击穿敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AthodaiPrimeDesc.text: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on Weak Point kills, maximizing fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AthodaiPrimeDesc.zhText: 用这把镀金手枪释放正义战士的怒吼，弱点击杀后即可进入超负荷模式，短时间内大幅提升射速和弹药效率。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AtlasPrimeDesc.text: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AtlasPrimeDesc.zhText: 在往事如烟的时代，据说山脉是战士的容身之所。在这个时代，山脉已化身成战士。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AtlasPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Atlas Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AtlasPrimeHelmetD.zhText: Atlas Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AtlasPrimePassive.text: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/AtlasPrimeScarfDe.text: The signature Syandana of Atlas Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/AtlasPrimeScarfDe.zhText: Atlas Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BansheePrimeArmLe.text: Default armor for the Banshee Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BansheePrimeDesc.text: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/BansheePrimeDesc.zhText: Banshee Prime 以操控声波力量造成的致死效果攻击敌人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BansheePrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Banshee Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BansheePrimePassi.text: Weapon noises are hushed so that enemies cannot hear them.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/BansheePrimePassi.zhText: 消去武器的噪音，让敌人无法听见开火的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimeDesc.text: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimeDesc.zhText: 那些破坏和平，以及耗尽这位不愿出手的战士克制力的愚蠢之人注定会灭亡。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimeEpheme.text: Honor your serenity and that of others as you display Baruuk's symbol. In relays, temporarily bestow the Vaaditum Prime Ephemera upon others.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimeEpheme.zhText: 展示 Baruuk 的象征，尊重你与他人的宁静。在中继站中，可暂时将惟喜 Prime 幻纹赠予他人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Baruuk Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimePatter.text: Mark your orbiter with Baruuk Prime’s tranquil mandala. The configuration encourages meditation and contemplation.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimePatter.zhText: 为你的轨道飞行器摆上 Baruuk Prime 的镇静曼陀罗。有助于冥想和沉思。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimeSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Baruuk Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/BaruukPrimeSkinDe.zhText: Baruuk Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/BlastWeaponPrimeD.text: Charge and release powerful bolts of balefire.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/BlastWeaponPrimeD.zhText: 蓄力并放出闪电般的野火。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeAuxFl.zhText: Caliban Prime 的漂浮 Sentient 翅膀。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeDefau.text: The standard issue skin for the Caliban Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeDefau.zhText: Caliban Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Caliban Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeHelme.zhText: Caliban Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeSuitD.text: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeSuitD.zhText: Caliban Prime 是为了庆祝奥罗金与 Sentient 之间短暂的和平而打造的，堪称真正的合璧杰作。双生王国的继承者，身披皇家之金崛起。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeSyand.text: Painstakingly embellished with scavenged gold as a treaty gift for the Orokin, this Sentient spinal symbiote serves as Caliban Prime’s signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CalibanPrimeSyand.zhText: 作为与奥罗金签订的条约礼物，这个 Sentient 脊椎异融者由搜集而来的黄金精心装饰，是 Caliban Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CatenoPrimeSugatr.text: An Orokin relic of the highest distinction.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CatenoPrimeSugatr.zhText: 一件代表着奥罗金最高殊荣的文物。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CedoPrimeDesc.text: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CedoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：CEDO PRIME）一把金色的霰弹枪，为那些执裁者而打造。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeArmorD.text: Martial. Regal. Malevolent. A face to foster fear in all foes.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeArmorD.zhText: 尚武、庄严、凶恶。这张脸将恐惧植入每个敌人心间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeCrysta.text: A gleaming reminder of Citrine Prime to decorate your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeCrysta.zhText: Citrine Prime 闪闪发光的纪念物，用来装饰你的轨道飞行器。
棱彩宝石 Prime 装饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeDesc.text: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeDesc.zhText: 与元素紧密结合并发动无尽毁灭之力的 Chroma Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Chroma Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeAuxDe.zhText: Citrine Prime 的标志性饰物。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeDefau.text: The standard issue skin for the Citrine Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeDefau.zhText: Citrine Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeDesc.text: The crystalline citadel ascends. Citrine Prime captivates with refined radiance, her brilliant gems set within the finest gold filigree.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeDesc.zhText: 水晶堡垒拔地而起。Citrine Prime 散发着令人着迷的夺目光彩，她那璀璨的宝石镶嵌在精美的金丝花纹中。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Citrine Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeHelme.zhText: Citrine Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeMouth.zhText: 尖晶刺 Prime 脸部装饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeOpera.text: Look sharp with this lavish set of facial accessories for both the Drifter and Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeOpera.zhText: 这套华贵的脸部装饰，让漂泊者和指挥官看起来清冷锐利。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeSugat.text: Adorn your weapon with the splendence of Citrine Prime's signature sugatra.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeSugat.zhText: 通过华丽的 Citrine Prime 标志性坠饰点缀你的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeSyand.text: Citrine Prime's signature Syandana sparkles with a brilliant luster.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeSyand.zhText: Citrine Prime 的标志性披饰闪耀着璀璨的光芒。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/CorinthPrimeDesc.text: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/CorinthPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：CORINTH PRIME）份量不轻且具有相当的后坐力。这种霰弹枪的 Prime 版本可以将武器射出的空爆弹远程引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/DaikyuPrimeDesc.text: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/DaikyuPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：DAIKYU PRIME）长久以来，人们一直认为强大的大久和弓 Prime 早已失传，它是许多 Tenno 道场的骄傲。它旨在直击敌人的弱点，其强大的射击威力与精湛的射击技术相得益彰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/DestrezaPrimeDesc.text: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/DestrezaPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：DESTREZA PRIME）用这把 PRIME 细剑将对技巧的掌握提升至更高等级。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/DethcubePrimeDesc.text: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/DethcubePrimeDesc.zhText: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」作为预设指令，死亡魔方 Prime 是致命支援的巅峰。其标配武器为死亡机枪 Prime。
