/Lotus/Language/Primes/DrifterPrimeDDesc.text: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/DrifterPrimeDDesc.zhText: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/DrifterSkirtPrime.zhText: 圣殿骑士 Prime 服饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/DrifterSleevesPri.zhText: 圣殿骑士 Prime 袖件

/Lotus/Language/Primes/DualKeresPrimeDes.text: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/DualKeresPrimeDes.zhText: （英文：DUAL KERES PRIME）当猎物面对 Khora Prime 的标志性双刀时，生命将迅速终结。Khora 挥舞双刀时，其重击效率会被增强。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/DualZorenPrimeDes.text: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/DualZorenPrimeDes.zhText: （英文：DUAL ZOREN PRIME）这是两把配得上行刑者的斧头，是奥罗金工艺登峰造极的体现。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/EmberPrimeDesc.text: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/EmberPrimeDesc.zhText: Ember Prime 具有像 Ember 一样肆意破坏的潜力，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/EmberPrimePassive.text: Receive |STRENGTH|% Ability Strength for every enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range affected by <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/EmberPrimePassive.zhText: 从每个在 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内受到 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态影响的敌人身上获得 |STRENGTH|% 技能强度。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/EpitaphPrimeDesc.text: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/EpitaphPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：EPITAPH PRIME）这把腕式次要武器让你的敌人不寒而栗。作为 Sevagoth Prime 的标志性武器，由他使用时可造成额外的爆头伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/EquinoxPrimeArmou.text: Bold, rugged, stalwart. Stand the night, face the dawn.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/EquinoxPrimeArmou.zhText: 大胆，粗犷，坚定。夜晚而立，面朝黎明。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/EquinoxPrimeCapeD.text: A flowing river of light and grace, a Syandana fit for royalty.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/EquinoxPrimeCapeD.zhText: 充盈着光与优雅的流动之河，此乃适合高贵之人的披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/EquinoxPrimeDesc.text: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/EquinoxPrimeDesc.zhText: 昼夜的最终平衡形态；行走于界线上的优美之型。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/EquinoxPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Equinox Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ExcaliburPrimeDes.text: Excalibur Prime is the epitome of mobility and offense, and features the same abilities as Excalibur, but has unique mod polarities installed allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ExcaliburPrimeDes.zhText: Excalibur Prime 是机动性与攻击性的象征，并拥有与 Excalibur 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ExcaliburPrimePas.text: Excalibur Prime deals |DAMAGE|% increased damage and attacks |SPEED|% faster when wielding swords.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ExcaliburPrimePas.zhText: 当 Excalibur Prime 持剑时，其伤害会提升 |DAMAGE|% 且攻击速度提升 |SPEED|%。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/FreezeRayPrimeDes.text: The icy signature weapon of Nautilus Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/FreezeRayPrimeDes.zhText: （英文：VERGLAS PRIME）鹦鹉螺 Prime 的标志性冰冻武器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/FrostPrimeDesc.text: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/FrostPrimeDesc.zhText: Frost Prime 拥有与 Frost 一样的急冻技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/FrostPrimePassive.text: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last |DURATION|% longer. Frost gains |ARMOR| Armor for each enemy afflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/FrostPrimePassive.zhText: Frost 技能造成的冰冻异常状态持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。Frost 从每个在 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内受到 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态影响的敌人身上获得 |ARMOR| 护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/FulminPrimeDesc.text: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/FulminPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：FULMIN PRIME）唤起风暴。雷霆 Prime 的电击弹可在闪电光束和短距离点射之间切换。Wisp 凭借她的元素之力获得更快的模式切换速度。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeEphemera.text: Levitating crystals weave a web of luminous connections. Gara Prime’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeEphemera.zhText: 轻盈的水晶编织出晶莹剔透的网。Gara Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Gara Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeKavatArm.text: Gird your Kavat in sculpted glass armor fit for the very noblest of beasts.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeKavatArm.zhText: 为你的库娃佩戴上玻璃刻雕护甲，十分适合这最高贵的野兽。
卡斯特兰 Prime 护甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeKavatFur.text: Imbue your Kavat with the unmistakable marks of ancient Orokin lineage.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeKavatFur.zhText: 为你的库娃注入不可忽视的古老奥罗金血脉印记。
莎贝拉 Prime 毛皮花纹

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeSuitDesc.text: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaraPrimeSuitDesc.zhText: 身披玻璃铠甲，继承传奇战士 Gara 的遗志。用水晶的纯净力量统治战场。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeArmour.text: These golden barbs are Garuda Prime’s signature armor.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeArmour.zhText: 这些金色倒刺是 Garuda Prime 的标志性护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeClawsD.text: These nasty things come out when Garuda Prime forgoes a melee weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeClawsD.zhText: 当 Garuda Prime 舍弃近战武器时，这些凶恶的东西便会出现。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeClawsS.text: The standard issue skin for the Garuda Prime Talons.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeClawsS.zhText: Garuda Prime 之爪的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeDesc.text: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeDesc.zhText: 纯白、耀金与至深猩红，血腥女王盛装登场。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeEpheme.text: Spread Garuda Prime's wings of slaughter with this flowing Ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeEpheme.zhText: 用这款流动的幻纹展开 Garuda Prime 的杀戮之翼。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Garuda Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Garuda Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GarudaPrimeSkinDe.zhText: Garuda Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeAltHelm.zhText: 艺术风格与空气动力学的完美结合。
Gauss Prime 耀变聚焦头盔

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeArmourA.zhText: 多普勒线 Prime 肩甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeArmourC.zhText: 多普勒线 Prime 胸甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeArmourD.text: The signature armor of Gauss Prime's aesthetic.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeArmourD.zhText: 彰显 Gauss Prime 美学的标志性护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeArmourL.zhText: 多普勒线 Prime 腿甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeDesc.text: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeDesc.zhText: 以水银打造的外型。Gauss Prime 不容失败。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Gauss Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimePlushDe.text: A cuddly floof of golden thread.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimePlushDe.zhText: 用金色丝线钩织的软萌玩偶。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeSkinDes.text: The standard issue skin for the Gauss Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GaussPrimeSkinDes.zhText: Gauss Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GramPrimeDesc.text: Born anew, the father of swords returns.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GramPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：GRAM PRIME）全然新生，诸剑之祖已经回归。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeDesc.text: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeDesc.zhText: 原始。永不饱足。Grendel Prime 吞食所有反抗他的人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeEphem.text: Take on the look of a monster that can devour an enemy in a single bite.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeEphem.zhText: 呈现出一个能一口吞噬敌人的怪物形象。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Grendel Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Grendel Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeSkinD.zhText: Grendel Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeSyand.text: The signature Syandana of the gilded gourmand, Grendel Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GrendelPrimeSyand.zhText: 镀金美食家 Grendel Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GuandaoPrimeDesc.text: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GunsenPrimeDesc.text: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GunsenPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：GUNSEN PRIME）让这对华丽的武扇彰显其绝美的杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeArmourDe.text: Gleaming with galvanic crystals, Gyre Prime's signature armor crackles with elegance.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeArmourDe.zhText: 闪耀着电镀水晶的光芒，Gyre Prime 的标志性护甲散发着优雅的火花。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeDefaultA.text: Default armor set for the Gyre Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeDefaultA.zhText: Gyre Prime 战甲的基础护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Gyre Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeHelmetDe.zhText: Gyre Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for the Gyre Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeSkinDesc.zhText: Gyre Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeSuitDesc.text: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeSuitDesc.zhText: 镀金电路闪烁着能量，驱动着穿越时空的狂乱舞步。与 Gyre Prime 一起舞向永恒。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeSyandana.text: Enchant onlookers with the crystalline adornments of Gyre Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/GyrePrimeSyandana.zhText: 通过 Gyre Prime 标志性披饰的晶莹剔透的装饰来吸引旁观者。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HarrowPrimeDesc.text: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HarrowPrimeDesc.zhText: 永恒的审判官已经崛起，受虚空洗礼，吟诵铁与火的福音。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HarrowPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Harrow Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HarrowPrimeSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Harrow Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HarrowPrimeSkinDe.zhText: Harrow Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HarrowPrimeSyanda.text: Invest Harrow Prime with this golden Syandana of holy office.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HarrowPrimeSyanda.zhText: 授予 Harrow Prime 这件圣职用的金色披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HeimtPrimeSentine.text: A finely crafted accessory for your sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HeimtPrimeSentine.zhText: 给你的守护一件精心制作的饰品。
骇弥 Prime 守护面具
骇弥 Prime 守护尾部
骇弥 Prime 守护飞翼

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HildrynPrimeDefau.text: Default chest armor for the Hildryn Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HildrynPrimeDesc.text: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HildrynPrimeDesc.zhText: Hildryn Prime 证明了权力是纪律的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HildrynPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Hildryn Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HildrynPrimeSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Hildryn Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HildrynPrimeSkinD.zhText: Hildryn Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HydroidPrimeArmAr.text: Default armor for the Hydroid Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HydroidPrimeDesc.text: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HydroidPrimeDesc.zhText: 以这金银之王号令大海的怒涛。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HydroidPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Hydroid Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HydroidPrimePassi.text: Slam Attacks have a |CHANCE|% chance to summon a tentacle for |DURATION|s.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HydroidPrimePassi.zhText: 震地攻击有 |CHANCE|% 几率召唤出一条能持续 |DURATION| 秒的触角。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/HystrixPrimeDesc.text: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime's signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/HystrixPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：HYSTRIX PRIME）灵活多变的武器与致命的猎人相得益彰。Khora Prime 的标志性手枪可在火焰、冰冻、电击和毒素刺镖中轮换。当 Khora 装备上豪猪 Prime 并造成爆头时，则弹药有几率立即重新装填。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IctusPrimeDesc.zhText: 赫利俄斯 Prime 的黄金配件

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeArmour.text: A resplendent armor set and a ward against death.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeArmour.zhText: 一款光彩照人的护甲套装，亦能抵御死亡的侵袭。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Inaros Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeDefaul.zhText: Inaros Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Inaros Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeSuitDe.text: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeSuitDe.zhText: 唤醒这永恒的存在，以此来把 Inaros 带来的恐惧施加到他们身上。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeSyanda.text: A regal Syandana and a record of Inaros' legacy.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InarosPrimeSyanda.zhText: 一件帝王的披饰，Inaros 的遗迹的载体。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestationPrimeD.text: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestationPrimeD.zhText: 永无止境的突变。贪婪的瘟疫之源以远古之形带着原始感染菌株咆哮而来。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestationPrimeH.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nidus Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestationPrimeS.text: The standard issue skin for the Nidus Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestationPrimeS.zhText: Nidus Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestedMechHelme.text: Make your Necramech even more fearsome with this helmet, based on early experimental designs that employed outer casings of Infested bone and meat.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestedMechHelme.zhText: 基于早期的实验设计，采用感染者骨肉作为外壳，这件头盔让你的殁世机甲更加可怕。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestedMechSkinD.text: Make your Necramech even more fearsome with this skin, based on early experimental designs that employed outer casings of Infested bone and meat.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/InfestedMechSkinD.zhText: 基于早期的实验设计，采用感染者骨肉作为外壳，这件外观让你的殁世机甲更加可怕。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeArmourA.zhText: Anasa 阿耶檀识 Prime 肩甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeArmourC.zhText: Anasa 阿耶檀识 Prime 胸甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeArmourD.text: Inspired by the undulating design of the Anasa Ayatan sculpture, Ivara claims this as her signature armor set.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeArmourD.zhText: 受到了阿耶檀识 Anasa 塑像波浪线设计的启发，Ivara 声称这是她的标志性护甲套装。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeArmourL.zhText: Anasa 阿耶檀识 Prime 腿甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeCapeDes.zhText: Ivara Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeCapeNam.zhText: 阿帕瓦哒 Prime 披饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeDesc.text: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeDesc.zhText: 像夜间的树林一样庄严与致命，这就是狩猎女王的终极形态。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Ivara Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IvaraPrimePassive.zhText: 侦测周围 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/IzvaraPrimeDesc.text: This graceful cape is the signature Syandana of Banshee Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/IzvaraPrimeDesc.zhText: 这件优雅的披风是 Banshee Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KarystPrimeDesc.text: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KarystPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：KARYST PRIME）作为一群已绝迹的 Tenno 刺客的标志性武器，这把大师之刃比原版显得更厚重、更大，以及更为致命。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeAltHelm.text: When force falls short, beauty can go a long way to help ensnare your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeAltHelm.zhText: 当力量不足时，美貌可以帮助诱捕你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeDesc.text: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeDesc.zhText: 女能手和怪物的默契配合。镀金女猎手与她忠诚的库娃——薇娜丽，以她们的意志统治着战场。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Khora Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeScarfDe.text: Flowing lines meet sharpened spikes in Khora Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeScarfDe.zhText: 流畅的线条与尖锐的钉刺在 Khora Prime 的标志性披饰中相逢。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeSkinDes.text: The standard issue skin for the Khora Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KhoraPrimeSkinDes.zhText: Khora Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KnellPrimeDesc.text: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KnellPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：KNELL PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性手枪在敌人的头颅上敲响葬礼的钟声。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KogakePrimeDesc.text: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KogakePrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：KOGAKE PRIME）用这副 Prime 近战武器打出金色的击倒。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KompressaPrimeDes.text: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KompressaPrimeDes.zhText: （英文：KOMPRESSA PRIME）Yareli Prime 的标志性手枪闪耀着金色黎明般的光芒，将敌人吞噬在一连串的剧毒、爆炸性水弹中。没有人能逃出这片水域。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/KronenPrimeDesc.text: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/KronenPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：KRONEN PRIME）远古之刃，但完美契合今日的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeArmourD.text: Command fear and respect as you safeguard what matters most, clad in this indomitable Orokin armor.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeArmourD.zhText: 在你捍卫重要之物时，穿上这件坚不可摧的奥罗金护甲，你会赢得敬畏。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeAuxShou.zhText: Lavos Prime 的可选辅助配件。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeDefault.text: The standard issue skin for the Lavos Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeDefault.zhText: Lavos Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeDeviceS.text: Bring a touch of Lavos Prime's transformative power to the Orbiter with this decorative replica.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeDeviceS.zhText: 使用这件装饰性复制品为轨道飞行器带来一丝 Lavos Prime 的转化性力量。
炼制探头 Prime 装饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Lavos Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeSuitDes.text: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LavosPrimeSuitDes.zhText: 当其他战甲还在逐步提升时，有些战甲生来就是 Prime 的。Lavos 是炼制术大师，他从不向任何人低头，而是开辟了自己的英勇之路。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeCapeDes.text: Step into oblivion with the signature syandana of Limbo Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeCapeDes.zhText: 用 Limbo Prime 的标志性披饰步入遗忘边境。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeDesc.text: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeDesc.zhText: 用这金色的裂隙行者起舞于不同的领域。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Limbo Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimePassive.text: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimePassive.zhText: 闪避动作可以进入或退出裂隙位面。进入位面时会留下一个持续 |DURATION| 秒的小型裂隙传送门。身处裂隙位面之中时，能量会缓慢恢复，并且每一个在裂隙位面被杀死的敌人都会产生 |ENERGY| 点能量恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeSigilDe.text: The signature sigil of Limbo Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeSigilDe.zhText: Limbo Prime 的标志性纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LimboPrimeSigilNa.zhText: 裂隙行者 Prime 纹章

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LisetPropCleaning.text: Merulina’s tiny spawn are used to foraging on the sea bed, and adapt easily to nibbling up dirt from an Orbiter floor.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LisetPropCleaning.zhText: 浪漪珊瑚的幼体习惯于在海床上觅食，很容易适应啃食轨道飞行器地板上的污垢。
浪漪珊瑚 Prime 内务无人机

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LokiPrimeDesc.text: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LokiPrimeDesc.zhText: 混淆、误导与破坏是 Loki Prime 的代名词。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/LokiPrimePassiveA.text: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/LokiPrimePassiveA.zhText: 壁面攀附时间提升 |MULT| 倍。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MPVPrimeAviaArmor.zhText: 飞空 Prime 护甲套装

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MagPrimeDesc.text: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MagPrimeDesc.zhText: 精巧的 Mag Prime 拥有与 Mag 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MagPrimePassiveAb.text: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MagPrimePassiveAb.zhText: Mag 会吸引附近的物品，以便捡取。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MagnusPrimeDesc.text: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to maximize Ammo Efficiency for a few seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MagnusPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：MAGNUS PRIME）奥罗金的优雅与强大制动力在这把精致的左轮手枪中相遇。命中时有几率在数秒内最大化弹药效率。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MasseterPrimeDesc.text: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MasseterPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：MASSETER PRIME）为那些渴求胜利的人所打造巨剑。当 Grendel 使用这把武器进行重击时，他能够免疫群体控制技能。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MesaPrimeAltHelme.text: Conquer the enemy with this alternative helmet for Mesa Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MesaPrimeAltHelme.zhText: 戴上这顶 Mesa Prime 的替换头盔来征服敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MesaPrimeDesc.text: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MesaPrimeDesc.zhText: 通过这名致命的执法者投射一道长影。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MesaPrimeHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Mesa Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MesaPrimePassiveA.text: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MesaPrimePassiveA.zhText: 双持次要武器的射速提升 |SPEED|%，单持次要武器的装填速度提升 |RELOAD|%。未装备近战武器时，获得 |HEALTH| 额外生命值。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MiragePrimeDesc.text: Dazzle the opposition with this golden master of illusion and mayhem. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MiragePrimeDesc.zhText: 用这位精通幻术和破坏的金色大师来扰乱对手吧。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MiragePrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Mirage Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/MiragePrimePassiv.text: Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/MiragePrimePassiv.zhText: 滑行持续时间延长 |DURATION|% 且机动动作的速度加快 |SPEED|%。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NautilusPrimeDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Nautilus Prime Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NautilusPrimeDefa.zhText: 鹦鹉螺 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NautilusPrimeSent.text: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NautilusPrimeSent.zhText: （英文：NAUTILUS PRIME）这位勇敢的水手使用冰凇 Prime 来保护他的船员。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NecrosPrimeDangle.text: Only Nekros Prime is permitted to wear the Mortos Prime Binds.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NecrosPrimeDangle.zhText: 仅有 Nekros Prime有资格穿戴上这件死亡枷锁 Prime。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NekrosPrimeDesc.text: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NekrosPrimeDesc.zhText: 死亡的新主人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NekrosPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nekros Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NekrosPrimePassiv.text: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NekrosPrimePassiv.zhText: 每当周围 |RADIUS| 米范围内有敌人死亡时，恢复 |HEALTH| 生命。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeArmourD.text: Battle dress suitable for the Prince of Flame.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeArmourD.zhText: 与烈焰太子相匹配的战斗服饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeDefault.text: The standard issue skin for the Nezha Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeDefault.zhText: Nezha Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeDesc.text: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeDesc.zhText: 看呐：灼烧之风的后嗣，现在身披最典雅的战袍，出现在你面前。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeEphemer.text: Coiling, hissing, the spirits of flame ride with their kin.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeEphemer.zhText: 盘旋缠绕、嘶嘶作响，烈焰之灵与其亲族同行。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NezhaPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Nezha Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NidusPrimeShipSce.text: These encrusted surfaces and drooping growths give your Orbiter's interior the haunting atmosphere of an Infested derelict.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NidusPrimeShipSce.zhText: 这些结痂的表面和下垂的生长物，能使你的轨道飞行器内充满感染者遗迹那种令人不安的氛围。
感染者轨道飞行器装饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NidusPrimeSyandan.text: Beauty and dread combine in this unique Infested Syandana, alive with swaying gilded tentacles.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NidusPrimeSyandan.zhText: 美丽与恐惧在这件独特的感染者披饰中融为一体，镀金的触须摇曳生姿。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NikanaPrimeMeleeD.text: An ornamental sugatra unique to the Nikana Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NikanaPrimeMeleeD.zhText: 一件专属侍刃 PRIME 的装饰性坠饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NovaPrimeDesc.text: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NovaPrimeDesc.zhText: Nova Prime 以她的反物质能量波来对敌人造成破坏。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NovaPrimePassiveA.text: When knocked-over, emit a |RADIUS|m defensive burst that topples attacking enemies and deals |DAMAGE| Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NovaPrimePassiveA.zhText: 被击倒时，释放出能击倒敌人并造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害的防卫爆震，爆震半径为 |RADIUS| 米。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NyxPrimeDesc.text: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NyxPrimeDesc.zhText: 通过 Nyx Prime 来渗透进敌人的精神中。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/NyxPrimePassiveAb.text: Enemies are |PERCENT|% less accurate when targeting Nyx Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/NyxPrimePassiveAb.zhText: 当敌人以 Nyx Prime 为目标时，其攻击精准度会下降 |PERCENT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OberonPrimeArmArm.text: Default armor for the Oberon Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OberonPrimeDesc.text: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OberonPrimeDesc.zhText: 以这帝王般庄严的森林庇护者维系平衡。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OberonPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Oberon Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OberonPrimePassiv.text: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OberonPrimePassiv.zhText: 当 Oberon 拾取 <HEALTH>生命球时，他与 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围的友军获得正义否决，使玩家抵挡下一次受到的伤害。最多可叠加 |STACKS| 层。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeArmou.text: Raise the curtain on Octavia's full glory, in armor that embodies her living music.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeArmou.zhText: 以这款代表着 Octavia 鲜活音律的护具，来完美展现她的光辉荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Octavia Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Octavia Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeSkinD.zhText: Octavia Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeSuitD.text: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeSuitD.zhText: 女音乐家 Octavia，以其卓绝华美的形态，演奏毁灭的乐章。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeSyand.text: Awe the crowds with this majestic flourish of a Syandana, fit for the mistress of the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OctaviaPrimeSyand.zhText: 这款华丽曼妙的披饰，不仅能让听众折服，与那位演奏曼达和弦琴的女音乐家更是绝配。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorBodySuitP.zhText: 圣殿骑士 Prime 套服

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorHoodPrime.zhText: 圣殿骑士 Prime 头罩
殁世 Prime 复生头罩

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorLeggingsP.zhText: 圣殿骑士 Prime 绑腿

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorPrimeDDes.text: A look worthy of one who has the power to straddle realities. Fitted for the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorPrimeDDes.zhText: 唯有掌控现实之力，方能得此绣罗衣裳。适用于指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorSkirtPrim.zhText: 圣殿骑士 Prime 服饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorSleevesPr.zhText: 圣殿骑士 Prime 袖件

/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorSuitPrime.text: The dress uniform worn with pride by Harrow's faithful legions.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/OperatorSuitPrime.zhText: Harrow 那忠诚的军团自豪地穿戴这套制服。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PanderoPrimeDesc.text: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PanderoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：PANDERO PRIME）以这把 Octavia 的标志性 Prime 手枪，为死亡之舞敲奏节拍。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PangolinPrimeDesc.text: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PangolinPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：PANGOLIN PRIME）Tenno 的经典剑刃，经过精美重制。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PantheraPrimeDesc.text: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PantheraPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：PANTHERA PRIME）完美打造的极速锯片发射器。具有更大的弹匣、更快的射速，以及可在一定范围内弹跳的锋利锯片。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PassiveAbilityEqu.text: Health Orbs generate a little Energy, while Energy Orbs restore a bit of Health.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PassiveAbilityEqu.zhText: 捡取生命球可获得些许能量，捡取能量球可恢复些许生命。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PassiveAbilityIna.text: While bleeding-out, Inaros Prime becomes entombed in a protective Sarcophagus. He can revive himself by draining the life-force from nearby enemies and allies.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PassiveAbilityIna.zhText: 濒死出血时会进入保护石棺，可借由吸收附近敌人或队友的生命能量来复活。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PassiveAbilityNez.zhText: 滑行速度加快，距离更远。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/Prime1HShotgunDes.text: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/Prime1HShotgunDes.zhText: （英文：EUPHONA PRIME）Banshee Prime 的标志性霰弹枪是把可射出集中和散射子弹的破坏性武器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAFurisDesc.zhText: （英文：AFURIS PRIME）以双重火力征服混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAcceltraDesc.text: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAcceltraDesc.zhText: （英文：ACCELTRA PRIME）以致命的速度与敌人交战。当使用者冲刺时，会有更快的装填速度，搭配 Gauss 使用时，速度还会更快。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAkLexDesc.text: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAkLexDesc.zhText: （英文：AKLEX PRIME）双手各持一把雷克斯 Prime 猛攻敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAkariusDesc.text: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAkariusDesc.zhText: （英文：AKARIUS PRIME）挥舞一对金色火箭发射器。冲刺时可以拥有更快的装填速度。搭配 Gauss 使用时，其装填速度更快。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAksomatiDesc.text: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAksomatiDesc.zhText: （英文：AKSOMATI PRIME）优雅的轻灵月神双枪精准定义了它们的终极表现。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAkstilettoDe.text: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAkstilettoDe.zhText: （英文：AKSTILETTO PRIME）时尚、稳定而精准，非常适合那些喜欢与众不同的 Tenno 们。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAlternoxWeap.text: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAlternoxWeap.zhText: （英文：ALTERNOX PRIME）奥罗金黄金增强了 Gyre Prime 标志性步枪的导电性，使其能够发射巨大的带电球体。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeArtifexSyand.text: A techno-organic Syandana, reimagined with regal flair worthy of the Orokin elite.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeArtifexSyand.zhText: 一款科技有机披饰，重塑奥罗金精英的高贵气质。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAviaArmourDe.text: Inspired by the Streamlined design of the Furis and Sybaris, this ornate golden armor can only be adorned by noble warriors.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAviaArmourDe.zhText: 灵感源自于「盗贼」和「席芭莉丝」的流线型设计，这件华丽的金色护甲只能被用于装饰高贵的战士。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAviaSyandana.text: The bold, wing-like arcs of this Syandana have been crafted to complement the Avia Prime armor.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeAviaSyandana.zhText: 这件不羁的、像翅膀一样的弧形披饰，是为了搭配飞空 Prime 护甲而精心打造的。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeBallisticaDe.text: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeBallisticaDe.zhText: （英文：BALLISTICA PRIME）这款豪华镀金连弩的精美无法遮掩它致命的目的。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeBazaDesc.text: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeBazaDesc.zhText: （英文：BAZA PRIME）这把经典的高射速冲锋枪体现了奥罗金工艺对于无声和精确杀伤的定义。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCatbrowFurDe.text: A unique fur pattern for your Kavat.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCatbrowFurDe.zhText: 给库娃使用的独特花纹。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCatbrowFurNa.zhText: 蒂伯 Prime 毛皮花纹

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCatrbrowPack.text: Complement your Kavat’s Tibor Armor with this elegant primed gene-mask.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCatrbrowPack.zhText: 用这套优雅的 Prime 版基因伪装来搭配库娃的蒂伯护甲吧。
蒂伯 Prime 基因伪装包

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCernosDesc.text: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCernosDesc.zhText: （英文：CERNOS PRIME）一把用来狩猎恶兽的高贵之弓。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeChromaCapeDe.text: A blade-like cut in regal red-and-gold, reminiscent of the elite honor guards of ancient Mars.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeChromaCapeDe.zhText: 庄严的红色与金色构成的利刃，令人回想起旧日火星上的精英御卫。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCobraAndCran.text: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCobraAndCran.zhText: （英文：COBRA & CRANE PRIME）向那些考验你克制力的人施予惩罚。在被 Baruuk 使用时，眼镜蛇 & 鹤 Prime 连击中的第一击可以眩晕敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCorufellDesc.text: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCorufellDesc.zhText: （英文：CORUFELL PRIME）闪劫 Prime 的金色藤蔓让变形更流畅，使重击更迅捷。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeDangleEDesc.text: Hook these silvery sleek sugatra onto any blade.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeDangleEDesc.zhText: 可将这件银色且光滑的坠饰钩挂到任意近战锋刃上。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeDangleFDesc.zhText: Mesa Prime 的标志性坠饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeDethMachineR.text: Signature default weapon of Dethcube Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeDethMachineR.zhText: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE PRIME）死亡魔方 Prime 的标志性武器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeDualKamasDes.text: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeDualKamasDes.zhText: （英文：DUAL KAMAS PRIME）这对拥有迷人线条的金色短柄战镰，长久以来一直被奉为 Tenno 武器锻造的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeFragorDesc.text: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeFragorDesc.zhText: （英文：FRAGOR PRIME）一把为了摧毁一切而锻造的终极兵器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeGalatineDesc.text: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeGalatineDesc.zhText: （英文：GALATINE PRIME）只有 Tenno 才足以运用这把高尚野兽般的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeHeliosDesc.text: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeHeliosDesc.zhText: 这个充满求知欲的守护与分离 Prime 一同防卫着它们的主人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeHeliosGlaive.text: Allows the Helios Prime to violently disassemble and turn itself into a deadly projectile.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeHeliosGlaive.zhText: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR PRIME）使赫利俄斯 Prime 剧烈拆卸，并将自身变化为一颗致命的发射体。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeKestrelDesc.text: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeKestrelDesc.zhText: （英文：KESTREL PRIME）凭借更高的敏捷性和力量，红隼 Prime 的重击可以轻松击倒敌人，所向披靡。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeKubrowArmorA.text: Decorative Prime armor for a Kubrow.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeKubrowArmorA.zhText: 喀婆萨 Prime 库狛护甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLiDaggerDesc.text: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLiDaggerDesc.zhText: （英文：SPIRA PRIME）配置这些罕见的投掷匕首，是奥罗金高阶刺客喜欢的工具。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLightningGun.text: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLightningGun.zhText: （英文：VADARYA PRIME）Caliban Prime 的标志性狙击步枪并非仅仅是仪式武器。它或许预示着奥罗金与 Sentient 之间的和平注定转瞬即逝。被击中的敌人会变成避雷针，有几率吸引连锁闪电，这些闪电会跳跃到附近的敌人身上。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLisetFiligre.text: Redecorate your Orbiter's interior with opulent, Orokin-inspired detailing.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLisetFiligre.zhText: 用灵感源自奥罗金的华丽的点缀物来重新装饰你的轨道飞行器。
精工掐丝 Prime 装饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLisetShipDes.text: Explore the system in the style of the Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeLisetShipDes.zhText: 以奥罗金的风貌来探索星系。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeMerulinaSyan.text: Yareli Prime’s faithful water-glider is happy to adorn her body as an additional ornament.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeMerulinaSyan.zhText: Yareli Prime 忠实的水上滑行者很乐意成为她身上额外的装饰品。
浪漪珊瑚 Prime 披饰

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeNamiSkylaDes.text: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeNamiSkylaDes.zhText: （英文：NAMI SKYLA PRIME）由一位被遗忘的大师所锻造，这对精致的刀刃是来自那早已消失的黄金时代的财宝。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeNinkondiDesc.text: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeNinkondiDesc.zhText: （英文：NINKONDI PRIME）一把注入了新真理的古老武器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeOberonCapeDe.text: This long, powerful ribbon symbolizes the Tenno path toward balance.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeOberonCapeDe.zhText: 这条长而有力的缎带标志着 Tenno 的平衡之道。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeOkinaDesc.text: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeOkinaDesc.zhText: （英文：OKINA PRIME）通过这些精细的双叉锋刃彰显权力。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimePerigaleSnip.text: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimePerigaleSnip.zhText: （英文：PERIGAL PRIME）将 Voruna 提升到 Prime 状态的人，也提升了她的标志性狙击步枪，增加了弹匣容量和弹药容量，仿佛是要让她做好长时间狩猎的准备。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeQuassusWeapo.text: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeQuassusWeapo.zhText: （英文：QUASSUS PRIME）挥舞着 Xaku Prime 的优雅扇子，它的镀金边缘尽显精密与尊贵。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeScarfGDesc.zhText: Mirage Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeScarfVDesc.text: Evoking fortress designs of the ancient past, this is Vauban Prime's signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeScarfVDesc.zhText: 这件 Vauban Prime 的标志性披饰令人联想到远古时期的要塞设计。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSentElecRail.text: Standard issue sniper rifle for Diriga Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSentElecRail.zhText: 电气浮囊 Prime 的标准狙击枪。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSentinelBioW.text: Standard issue weapon for Djinn Prime Sentinel. Fires <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin projectiles that embed into enemies and continuously deal damage for 10 seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSentinelBioW.zhText: （英文：STINGER PRIME）引灵 Prime 守护的标准武器。发射 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素投射物，嵌入敌人体内并持续造成伤害，持续 10 秒。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSetFourArmou.text: The swooping lines of this prime armor evoke a ship at sea.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSetFourArmou.zhText: 这款 Prime 护甲的弧形线条令人忆起海上的船只

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSetMirageArm.text: Mesmerize enemies with Mirage Prime’s signature armor.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSetMirageArm.zhText: 用 Mirage Prime 的标志性护甲迷惑敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSetThreeArmo.text: Cast a shadow of pure menace.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSetThreeArmo.zhText: 投下充斥着纯粹威慑的暗影。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeShadeDesc.text: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeShadeDesc.zhText: 阴影 Prime 专长隐形，它装载了激光点发 Prime。和它一同主宰暗影吧。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSilvaAegisDe.text: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSilvaAegisDe.zhText: （英文：SILVA & AEGIS PRIME）完美打造的一对，权杖与盾的组合不仅是为了展示而雕凿，也权衡了战场的用途。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSteflosShotg.text: This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime's signature shotgun.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSteflosShotg.zhText: （英文：STEFLOS PRIME）带有镀金棘刺的玫瑰。通过这把 Citrine Prime 的标志性霰弹枪，从更远的地方施展致命一击。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeStyanaxArmor.text: This proud panoply declares the wearer's bravery on the field of battle.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeStyanaxArmor.zhText: 这套骄傲的护甲彰显着穿戴者在战场上的英勇。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSybarisDesc.text: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSybarisDesc.zhText: （英文：SYBARIS PRIME）纤细而又熠熠生辉，象征着 Tenno 的至善至美。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTiberonDesc.text: Art meets ingenuity with this beautifully deadly rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTiberonDesc.zhText: （英文：TIBERON PRIME）在这柄美丽而又致命的步枪里，艺术与精巧的设计不期而遇。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTigrisDesc.text: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTigrisDesc.zhText: （英文：TIGRIS PRIME）既是精美的工艺品，也是致命的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTrumnaWeapon.text: Sleek lines and golden accents define this masterpiece of the illustrious Entrati family.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTrumnaWeapon.zhText: （英文：TRUMNA PRIME）流畅的线条和金色的点缀定义了这件来自著名的英择谛家族的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTwitchScarfD.text: Twin bands symbolize the balance all Tenno are sworn to uphold.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeTwitchScarfD.zhText: 其两根带子象征了所有 Tenno 发誓要维护的平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVeloxPistolD.text: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVeloxPistolD.zhText: （英文：VELOX PRIME）这把次要武器的圆形设计唤起了 Protea Prime 对时间的感知。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVenkaClawsDe.text: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVenkaClawsDe.zhText: （英文：VENKA PRIME）拥有剃刀般切开敌人的锐利爪子。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVentoScytheD.text: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against "common enemies" of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVentoScytheD.zhText: （英文：VENATO PRIME）由 Sentient Ur-Hatho 自愿捐献的骨骼打造，并由奥罗金奢华工匠森比克·沃尔精心装饰，脉纹 Prime 本应被用于对抗联盟的"共同敌人"——任何从 Tau 之外的黑暗中现身的人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVorunaAxeDes.text: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeVorunaAxeDes.zhText: （英文：SAROFANG PRIME）Voruna Prime 的标志性战斧装饰着奥罗金黄金。她亲自确保了这把战斧的前任主人不会再使用它。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeZhugeDesc.text: Tenno artistry. Ancient craft. A weapon of surgical precision and devastating effect. Each bolt fired by Zhuge Prime explodes shortly after embedding.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeZhugeDesc.zhText: （英文：ZHUGE PRIME）Tenno 技艺。古老工艺。一把极为精确且富有破坏力的武器。诸葛连弩 Prime 的每支箭会在击中嵌入的瞬间爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ProteaPrimeAltHel.text: A regal helmet for the Protea Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ProteaPrimeDesc.text: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ProteaPrimeDesc.zhText: 看这位双父之女。Protea Prime 曾实现帕尔沃斯·格拉努关于操纵时间守护者的愿景。现在，她秉承 Tenno 的理念，保护手无寸铁之人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ProteaPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Protea Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ProteaPrimeSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Protea Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ProteaPrimeSkinDe.zhText: Protea Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/PyranaPrimeDesc.text: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/PyranaPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：PYRANA PRIME）快速地连续 3 次击杀将召唤一把食人鱼的幻影，造成双倍的致命杀伤。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RedeemerPrimeDesc.text: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RedeemerPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：REDEEMER PRIME）以这把 Prime 枪刃制造出双重刀刃、双重口径伤口的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeArmA.text: Default armor set for the Revenant Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeArmo.text: Revenant Prime's signature armor invokes the Unum's grace.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeArmo.zhText: Revenant Prime 的标志性护甲承蒙着乌努母神的福泽。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeCape.text: A spectral glow emanates from this ornate syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeCape.zhText: 这件华丽的披饰散发着鬼魅的幽光。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeDesc.text: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeDesc.zhText: 迷失者之崛起。使用 Revenant Prime 的力量，来具象化夜灵之力。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeHelm.text: The standard issue helmet for the Revenant Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeSkin.text: The standard issue skin for the Revenant Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RevenantPrimeSkin.zhText: Revenant Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RhinoPrimeDesc.text: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RhinoPrimeDesc.zhText: 通过将极性插槽改为更适合自定的配置，使 RHINO 地面震动能力发挥到更高水平。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RhinoPrimePassive.text: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RhinoPrimePassive.zhText: 从高处落地时会产生一道能造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/RubicoPrimeDesc.text: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/RubicoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：RUBICO PRIME）对猎人而言，这是狙击艺术的巅峰。对于猎物而言，这是通向来生的大门。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SarynPrimeDesc.text: A golden blossom conceals deadly nectar. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SarynPrimeDesc.zhText: 一朵隐藏着致命花蜜的金花。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SarynPrimeHelmetD.text: The standard issue helmet for the Saryn Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SarynPrimePassive.text: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last |DURATION|% longer.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SarynPrimePassive.zhText: 对敌人施加的异常状态持续时间延长 |DURATION|%。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ScourgePrimeDesc.text: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ScourgePrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：SCOURGE PRIME）用 Harrow Prime 的标志性标枪打击不义之徒。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeDefa.text: The standard issue skin for the Sevagoth Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeDefa.zhText: Sevagoth Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeDesc.text: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeDesc.zhText: 镀金舵手从暴风雨中现身，他的身影吸引着注定悲怆的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeHelm.text: The standard issue helmet for the Sevagoth Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeHelm.zhText: Sevagoth Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeSign.text: Present yourself as an esteemed captain with Sevagoth Prime’s signature Signa.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothPrimeSign.zhText: 使用 Sevagoth Prime 的标志性头环，让自己成为受人尊敬的船长。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.text: The claws of the shadowy helmsman have cast many foolish foes into the cold below.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.zhText: 幽影舵手的利爪已将众多愚蠢的敌人投入幽寒深处。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.text: The standard issue skin for Sevagoth's Shadow Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.zhText: Sevagoth 幽影 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.text: When the Tempestarii became a void phantom, Sevagoth set aside his body and became a Shadow, to continue his solemn duty of saving lives.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.zhText: 当「风暴使者号」成为虚空诡舰，Sevagoth 舍弃身躯，化为幽影来继续肩负庄严的救援职责。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.text: The standard issue helmet for Sevagoth Prime's Shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SevagothShadowPri.zhText: Sevagoth 幽影 Prime 的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ShawzinPrimeDecoD.text: Long ago this Shawzin was played to entertain the Orokin court. Now its enduring music shall celebrate your victories.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ShawzinPrimeDecoD.zhText: 很久以前，这把三线琴是奥罗金宫廷的御用乐器。而现在，它那悠扬的曲调，将为你的胜利而奏响。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/StradavarPrimeDes.text: Between measured staccato and staggering crescendo, Stradavar Prime never fails to call down a devastating finale.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/StradavarPrimeDes.zhText: （英文：STRADAVAR PRIME）可在整齐的断奏和摇摆的渐强音之间自由切换，让斯特拉迪瓦 Prime 绝不错失任何一个给予毁灭终章的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/StrunPrimeDesc.text: A classic shotgun design, embellished for the elite as only the Orokin could.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/StrunPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：STRUN PRIME）只有奥罗金能为精英们打造出如此经典的霰弹枪设计。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Styanax Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeHelme.zhText: Styanax Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeHelme.text: Styanax Prime's helmet, stripped down and ready to enter the melee.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeHelme.zhText: Styanax Prime 的头盔，已卸去多余装饰，准备投身近战。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeSkinD.text: The standard issue skin for the Styanax Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeSkinD.zhText: Styanax Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeSuitD.text: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeSuitD.zhText: 无罪之盾，正义之矛。Styanax Prime 坚守阵线，对抗暴政。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeSyand.text: A syandana of gold and ethereal glory, for intimidation on the battlefield or celebration in the victory parade.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/StyanaxPrimeSyand.zhText: 一件金光闪闪、光彩夺目的披饰，用于战场上的威慑或胜利游行中的庆祝。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SuitPrimeEDesc.text: Necrotic accents define this testament to the Entrati family’s aesthetic. Perhaps there’s a lesson in how those who gaze into the Void find beauty in the fusion of luxury and oblivion.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SuitPrimeEDesc.zhText: 腐生的特质是英择谛家族美学的见证。也许这是一个教训，告诉那些凝视虚空的人如何在奢华与虚无的融合中发现美。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SurakaPrimeDangle.text: An elegant clasp terminates in five golden points.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SurakaPrimeDangle.zhText: 一件优雅的扣环，以五个金色的点结束。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/SuratorPrimeSyand.text: Feel the energy of the Surator Prime Syandana at your back as you feel the drive to push on.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/SuratorPrimeSyand.zhText: 感受雪瑞达 Prime 披饰在你背后的能量，这是你前进的动力。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TekkoPrimeDesc.text: As merciless and indestructible as Atlas Prime himself, Tekko Prime crush and split with tectonic force.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TekkoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：TEKKO PRIME）如 Atlas Prime 自身一样无情且坚不可摧，铁钩手甲 Prime 通过地动之力粉碎并撕裂敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TenoraPrimeDesc.text: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TenoraPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：TENORA PRIME）通过这件突击步枪大师之作来为 Octavia 的旋律添加致命的顿挫击打。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TipedoPrimeDesc.text: With their final breath they look to the moon, and are gone.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TipedoPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：TIPEDO PRIME）随着凝望月亮时呼出的最后一口气，就这样永久的消散了。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimeArchw.zhText: Titania Prime 的标志性曲翼外观。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimeDesc.text: Tempting and terrifying, this is Titania in her ultimate form.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimeDesc.zhText: 诱人而又令人恐惧，这就是 Titania 的终极形态。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Titania Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimePassi.text: Bullet Jump creates a trampoline lasting |DURATION|s that enhances Bullet Jump maneuvers by |JUMP|% when used by allies.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimePassi.zhText: 使用旋身飞跃会制造一个能持续 |DURATION| 秒的蹦床，队友在使用蹦床时能获得 |JUMP|% 的旋身飞跃增益。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimeScarf.zhText: Titania Prime 的标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimeScarf.text: A miniature twist on Titania Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TitaniaPrimeScarf.zhText: 迷你版的 Titania Prime 标志性披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TrinityPrimeDesc.text: Become the bastion that defends allies using powerful healing abilities with Trinity Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TrinityPrimeDesc.zhText: Trinity Prime 操控强大的治愈能力，成为捍卫友军的壁垒。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TrinityPrimeHelme.text: The standard issue helmet for the Trinity Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/TrinityPrimePassi.text: Revive fallen allies |SPEED|% faster and from |RANGE|% farther away.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/TrinityPrimePassi.zhText: 救援濒死队友的速度提升 |SPEED|%，并且救援距离提升 |RANGE|%。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/UruPrimeScarfDesc.text: Let these massive segments of interlinked gold and silver ripple down a Warframe’s back.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/UruPrimeScarfDesc.zhText: 令那无数交织的金色与银色如水波般飘洒在战甲的背部。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ValkyrPrimeDesc.text: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ValkyrPrimeDesc.zhText: 一位经历了时间与伤痛的洗礼后依然毫发无损的高傲斗士。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ValkyrPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Valkyr Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ValkyrPrimePassiv.text: Recover |PERCENT|% faster from being knocked down.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ValkyrPrimeTubesD.zhText: 正式礼仪的丝带，自豪地配戴上吧。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VaubanPrimeDesc.text: Transform the battlefield into a weapon with this gilded tactician. Features unique mod polarities for extended customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VaubanPrimeDesc.zhText: 使用这位镀金的战术大师来将战场转变成你的武器吧！该战甲拥有​​着特化过的 MOD 极性槽来提供更佳的自定可能性。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VaubanPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Vauban Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VaubanPrimePassiv.text: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VaubanPrimePassiv.zhText: 对失去行动能力的敌人造成 x|DAMAGE| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VenariPrimeDesc.text: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VenariPrimeDesc.zhText: Khora 的意志，薇娜丽的尖牙利爪。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VenariPrimeSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for Venari Prime.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VenariPrimeSkinDe.zhText: 薇娜丽 Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VitamPrimeSyandan.text: Transmute the chaos of battle into golden triumph.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VitamPrimeSyandan.zhText: 将战斗的混乱转化为金子般的胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VolnusPrimeDesc.text: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VolnusPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：VOLNUS PRIME）作为最初由奥罗金所铸造的辉煌，Gara 标志性的玻璃锤看似轻敏，却极具杀伤力。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VoltPrimeDesc.text: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VoltPrimeDesc.zhText: 一位来自过去的荣耀战士，Volt Prime 拥有与 Volt 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VoltPrimePassiveA.text: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VoltPrimePassiveA.zhText: 在地面上移动时可以积蓄电能，每移动一米可积攒 |DAMAGE| 电击伤害，积攒的伤害会在下一次攻击时释放。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeArmArm.text: Default armor set for the Voruna Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeArmArm.zhText: Voruna Prime 战甲的基础护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeDesc.text: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeDesc.zhText: 辉煌与凶猛在 Voruna Prime 身上达到了顶峰。虽然她被奥罗金黄金所装饰，却比以往任何时候都更具野性。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeEpheme.text: The beast may be adorned, but never tamed. Voruna Prime's signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeEpheme.zhText: 野兽或许可以穿着华服，但永远不会被驯服。Voruna Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Voruna Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeHelmet.zhText: Voruna Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeHoodOr.text: Fly howling into battle with Voruna Prime's signature sumdali.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeHoodOr.zhText: 伴随着 Voruna Prime 的标志性船徽，咆哮冲入战场。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeScarfD.text: Wear the trophy of victories past with Voruna Prime's signature syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeScarfD.zhText: 通过 Voruna Prime 的标志性披饰彰显过往胜利的荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeSkinDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Voruna Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/VorunaPrimeSkinDe.zhText: Voruna Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WarPrimeWeaponDes.text: The blade of the world-destroyer reaches its apotheosis, severing conflict itself. In forging this weapon, you have brought unrealized dreams to their ultimate conclusion.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WarPrimeWeaponDes.zhText: （英文：WAR PRIME）灭世之刃终于完成升华，锋芒所至，连战争与冲突本身都被斩断。锻造此武器的同时，你也让那些未能实现的梦想迎来了最终的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WarframeDefaultAr.text: Default armor set for the Lavos Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeDefaultC.zhText: Wisp Prime 的标志性饰物。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeDesc.text: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeDesc.zhText: Wisp Prime 的镀金光彩萦绕在战场上。盟友也十分期待她的多维美貌。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Wisp Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for the Wisp Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeSkinDesc.zhText: Wisp Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeSyandana.text: Call upon the preternatural with Wisp Prime’s signature Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WispPrimeSyandana.zhText: 用 Wisp Prime 的标志性披饰召唤超自然力量。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeDesc.text: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeDesc.zhText: 恶作剧战士提升到了他的最终形态。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeEpheme.text: Luminous plasma leaps off surfaces in your presence.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeEpheme.zhText: 发光的等离子体会在你所经之处跃出地面。
圣艾尔摩之火 Prime 幻纹

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Wukong Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeKubrow.text: Ancient Orokin armor for the most faithful and favored Kubrow wardens.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeKubrow.zhText: 一款上古奥罗金护甲，佩给最忠实和受人青睐的库狛看守者。
三藏 Prime 库狛护甲

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeKubrow.text: The product of untold generations of selective breeding, coupled with multifold iterations of Orokin bioengineering, created this: the Tang breed of Kubrow. Faithful guardians of the most revered.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeKubrow.zhText: 无数代选育的成果，再加上奥罗金生物工程的多重迭代，创造了这个：唐品种的库狛。最崇敬的忠诚守护者。
唐风 Prime 库狛毛皮花纹

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimePassiv.zhText: 近战连击判定时间延长 |DURATION|%。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeScarfD.text: A sleek Syandana that yearns to journey among the clouds.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeScarfD.zhText: 一副造型优美的披饰，展现出要在云间遨游的渴望。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeStaffD.text: A unique staff wielded by the Wukong Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/WukongPrimeStaffD.zhText: Wukong Prime 所持有的独特长棍。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/XakuPrimeDefaultS.text: The standard issue skin for the Xaku Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/XakuPrimeDefaultS.zhText: Xaku Prime 战甲的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/XakuPrimeHelmetDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Xaku Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/XakuPrimeHelmetDe.zhText: Xaku Prime 战甲的标准头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/XakuPrimeSuitDesc.text: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/XakuPrimeSuitDesc.zhText: 战争与虚空之子在黄金中重生。曾经破碎过的东西可能会比从未破碎过的东西更强大。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/YamakoPrimeSyanda.text: An ancient and golden syandana, worn only by those chosen to lead the Orokin High Court.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/YamakoPrimeSyanda.zhText: 一款古老的金色披饰，只有那些被挑选出来带领奥罗金高阶枢密院的勇士才能佩戴。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeBoardA.text: Yareli Prime’s living board is the epitome of elegance and style.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeBoardA.zhText: Yareli Prime 的生物滑板是优雅和风格的缩影。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeDefaul.text: The standard issue skin for the Yareli Prime Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeDefaul.zhText: Yareli Prime 的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeEpheme.text: Creatures of the deep circle and play in your wake. Yareli Prime’s signature ephemera.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeEpheme.zhText: 深海生物在你身后盘旋嬉戏。Yareli Prime 的标志性幻纹。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Yareli Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeSuitDe.text: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/YareliPrimeSuitDe.zhText: 驭浪者从海浪中重生。她以奥罗金时代的风采，体现出青春不朽的活力。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZaktiPrimeDesc.text: A thousand pains, before their end.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZaktiPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：ZAKTI PRIME）在他们临终之前，使其受尽千般痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZephyrPrimeDesc.text: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZephyrPrimeDesc.zhText: 用这只富有破坏力的金色小鸟飞向天空。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZephyrPrimeHelmet.text: The standard issue helmet for the Zephyr Prime Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZephyrPrimePassiv.text: Zephyr Prime moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |PERCENT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZephyrPrimePassiv.zhText: 在空中时，Zephyr Prime 移动更快且下落更慢，同时武器也会获得 |PERCENT|% 的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZylokPrimeDesc.text: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.
/Lotus/Language/Primes/ZylokPrimeDesc.zhText: （英文：ZYLOK PRIME）看似轻巧的武器，却有着与其金色设计相称的巨大威力。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropCitrineDe.zhText: 大型 Citrine 美神玫瑰装饰

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropCitrineDe.text: Decorate your Orbiter with one of Citrine Aphrodita's crystalline blooms.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropCitrineDe.zhText: 通过 Citrine 美神的结晶花朵来装饰你的轨道飞行器。
小型 Citrine 美神玫瑰装饰

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropCitrineDe.text: Decorate your Orbiter with one of Citrine Aphrodita's crystalline blooms.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropCitrineDe.zhText: 通过 Citrine 美神的结晶花朵来装饰你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropCorpusCan.text: A canister of thermal sludge used by the Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropCorpusCan.zhText: Corpus 使用的热能软泥罐。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxFract.text: An unbreakable fractal deposit containing no Rune Marrow.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxFract.zhText: 坚不可摧的分形沉积物，不含任何密印髓质。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxKitch.text: A simple kitchen bowl used on Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxKitch.zhText: 双衍王境中使用过的简约厨房碗。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxLootC.text: An unbreakable container of a kind common to Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxLootC.zhText: 坚不可摧的一种双衍王境常见容器。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxRockC.text: An unbreakable fractal deposit of Aggristone.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDUVxRockC.zhText: 坚不可摧的龙涎结晶分形矿藏。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDuviriPro.text: An unbreakable well containing Saggen Pearls.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropDuviriPro.zhText: 坚不可摧的一口井，里面带有慧珠。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropGrnGrokdr.text: An unbreakable drum used to contain Grokdrul.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropGrnGrokdr.zhText: 坚不可摧的桶，用于盛放葛克度。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropIraditeDe.text: An unbreakable replica of an Iradite formation.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropIraditeDe.zhText: 坚不可摧的伊莱体构造复制品。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxArcRe.zhText: 备用实验性电弧继电器装饰

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxArcRe.text: An unbreakable replica of an experimental Arc-Relay reserve.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxArcRe.zhText: 坚不可摧的备用实验性电弧继电器复制品。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxEferv.text: An unbreakable stockpile of Efervon samples.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxEferv.zhText: 坚不可摧的艾弗旺样本储备。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxPitch.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚沥青防水布装饰
一些坚不可摧的沥青防水布。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxProto.text: An unbreakable replica of a proto-infested clump.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxProto.zhText: 坚不可摧的原型感染肉块复制品。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxProto.text: An unbreakable replica of a Techrot motherboard cluster.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropLASxProto.zhText: 坚不可摧的科腐者主板堆复制品。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropMITWxLoot.zhText: 坚不可摧的低语者石棺复制品。

/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropOrbStoneD.text: An unbreakable replica of a vitrific outcrop.
/Lotus/Language/Props/LisetPropOrbStoneD.zhText: 坚不可摧的晶化突岩复制品。

/Lotus/Language/Purgatory/PurgatoryWelco.text: Kill specters before time runs out
/Lotus/Language/Purgatory/PurgatoryWelco.zhText: 在时间耗尽前击杀魅影

/Lotus/Language/Pvp/PVPWeeklyChallengeRe.text:
Pupil,

I see that you have risen to all your challenges and in doing so you have completed your Conclave Mission for this time cycle. I am impressed. 

The knowledge you have earned is more valuable than anything I can give you, however I hope you can use this gift in your continuing journey through the Conclave.

Teshin
/Lotus/Language/Pvp/PVPWeeklyChallengeRe.zhText:
门徒，

我见到你已经完成了所有挑战，并在此时间周期内完成了武形秘仪的任务。令人钦佩。

你学识渊博以致于超越我所能授与你的知识了。然而，我希望你在武形秘仪接下来的旅途中能善用这份礼物。

Teshin

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/2FACampaignIn.text:
Operator, look what came for you! What have you been up to while Ordis wasn't looking? Whatever the case, this Ephemera is sure to please anyone's sensors. You must equip it at once.

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/2FACampaignIn.zhText:
指挥官，看看您找到了什么！当 Ordis 不注意的时候您做了什么好事？无论如何，这个幻纹肯定会取悦任何人的感知。您必须立刻装备它。

您忠诚的中枢，
-Ordis

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/2FAUpdatedCam.text:
Operator, look what came for you! What have you been up to while Ordis wasn't looking? Whatever the case, this Booster is sure to please your sensors.

Your loyal Cephalon,

-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/2FAUpdatedCam.zhText:
指挥官，看看您找到了什么！当 Ordis 不注意的时候您做了什么好事？无论如何，这个加成肯定会取悦您的感知。

您忠诚的中枢，
-Ordis

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/LeukemiaAware.text:
Tenno,

Wear this ribbon to support other Tenno and our allies. Check your Landing Craft's News console for the meaning behind this ribbon.

-Lotus
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/LeukemiaAware.zhText:
Tenno，

佩戴这个缎带来支持其他 Tenno 和我们的盟友。查看登陆艇的新闻控制台来了解这个缎带背后的意义。

-Lotus

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/PS4FourthAnni.text:
Tenno,

It has been four Earth cycles since the first of you answered my call to wake from your cryogenic slumber. With each passing cycle, your numbers multiply, as does your courage and passion. To celebrate this milestone, I am presenting you with these gifts. A small gesture of gratitude for all you have done for the Origin System.

Sincerely,
The Lotus
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/PS4FourthAnni.zhText:
Tenno，

自你们首次响应我的呼唤并从低温睡眠苏醒以来已经度过四次地球周期循环了。每经历一次循环，你们的人数就日益成长，勇气与热血也随之茁壮。为庆祝达到这样的里程碑，我为你献上这些礼物，以聊表你对始源星系牺牲奉献的感谢之意。

诚挚的，
Lotus

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchDropInb.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

A shrewd warrior can glean as much from watching a battle as from fighting one. Pupil, you appear to be such a warrior. Take this bounty and use it to bolster yourself for battles to come.

-Teshin
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchDropInb.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

一位机敏的战士可以通过观看他人的战斗身临其境地学习战斗技巧。门徒，你就是如此的战士。收下这份奖励，用它来支援你将面对的战斗。

-Teshin

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchDropInb.text: A Twitch Drop has been delivered to your inventory.
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchDropInb.zhText: 一件 Twitch 道具掉落已经送至您的仓库。

/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchPrimeEx.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Lightning has struck twice! That's right. I've found another strange Void Rift.

Where it leads, I have no idea. What's inside? I'm detecting a SOMA PRIME and a SCINDO PRIME. Just waiting for a Tenno to snatch them up, FOR FREE.

Try as I might, I cannot break this ‘fourth-dimensional-wall' and take the items for myself. So it's up to you, Tenno. Find more info in your ship's market.

Your jealous friend,
Darvo
/Lotus/Language/QuestInbox/TwitchPrimeEx.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

闪电竟可以击中一个地方两次！没错，我又发现了一道奇怪的虚空裂缝。

它通向哪里我无从得知。里面有些什么？我探测到一把月神 PRIME 和分裂斩斧 PRIME，正静候 Tenno 免费来取。

我尽全力地尝试，却也无法突破这道「四次元壁」，无法亲自取走这些道具。所以只能交给你来做了，Tenno。前去登陆艇中的商店可以获得更多信息。

羡慕嫉妒恨的老朋友，
Darvo

Take to the skies, Operator!

Ordis

将曲翼发射器装备在携带装备轮盘上，指挥官就能够在开放区域使用它。

指挥官，冲上云霄吧！

Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.text: Attack fighter armed with rapid-fire plasma cannon. Deployed to Jupiter Proxima.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.zhText: 攻击型战斗机，配备了速射等离子炮。被部署在了木星比邻星域。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.text: The elite incarnation of this Corpus attack fighter gains the ability to teleport-dash short distances, leaving a blinding flare in its wake. Deployed to Jupiter Proxima.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.zhText: 作为这种 Corpus 战斗机的精英版本，它可以在短距离内闪现冲刺，并留下耀眼的航迹。被部署在了木星比邻星域。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.text: This Corpus fighter spins and launches target-seeking globes of highly-charged plasma. Deployed to Jupiter Proxima.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.zhText: 这种 Corpus 战斗机可以旋转并发射高蓄能等离子追踪弹。被部署在了木星比邻星域。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.text: The elite incarnation of this Corpus fighter fires a shotgun blast of slow-moving plasma globes. Deployed to Jupiter Proxima.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterJu.zhText: 作为这种 Corpus 战斗机的精英版本，它能发射出慢速等离子球型霰弹。被部署在了木星比邻星域。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusIceRamSle.text: Steel-clad frozen comet chunk capable of icing up target vessels.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusIceRamSle.zhText: 被钢层包裹的冰陨块状物，能冻住目标战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusLichCrewD.text: A converted Sister of Parvos. While Sisters have no Railjack systems training they are fierce and loyal defenders.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusLichCrewD.zhText: 一名被感化的帕尔沃斯的姐妹。虽然姐妹们并未受过航道星舰的系统训练，但她们是凶猛且忠诚的捍卫者。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusRamSledDe.text: This missile-like landing craft penetrates enemy hulls to deliver a payload of fierce raiders.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusRamSledDe.zhText: 这种类似导弹的登陆艇可以穿透敌方舰体，并释放一队凶残的侵入者。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusResourceC.zhText: 强化 CORPUS 存储容器

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMemberRelea.zhText: 你确定要与 |NAME| 解除合约吗？
确定要解约吗？请输入 "|WORD|" 以进行确认。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMemberRelea.text:
Are you sure you want to release |NAME| from your service?

Type '|WORD|' to confirm.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMemberRelea.zhText:
确定要解除与 |NAME| 的合约吗？

输入"|WORD|"以确认。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_AssignL.text: Liches have no Railjack training and so cannot man complex systems - but they excel as Defenders.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_AssignL.zhText: 玄骸们没有接受过航道星舰的训练，所以无法操控复杂的系统，但他们是出色的守护者。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_AssignP.text: Crew skill is at max rank, cannot assign anymore points to it.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_AssignP.zhText: 舰员技能已达到最大等级，无法再为其分配点数。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_AssignP.text: Could not commit changes at this time, please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_AssignP.zhText: 现在暂时不能提交改动，请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_RemoveP.text: No points currently assigned to this skill.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_RemoveP.zhText: 这个技能当前没有分配到点数。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_ResetPo.zhText: 重置所有已分配的点数（|POINTS|）？

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_WeaponC.text: Cannot equip same weapon on multiple crew members.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_WeaponC.zhText: 无法将同一武器装备给多名舰员。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_WeaponC.text: This appearance configuration is shared with your main Arsenal, so any changes you make will apply when you use the weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewMgr_WeaponC.zhText: 这个外观配置与你的主军械库共享配置，你做的任何改动都会在你使用武器时套用。
