/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipAttackA.zhText:
发射  |COUNT| 枚制导导弹。
能量消耗：|FLUXCOST|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipAttackA.text: Fires a volley of homing missiles.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipAttackA.zhText: 连续发射一连串制导导弹。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipAttract.text: Absorbed damage is automatically discharged when the vortex expires. Can be manually detonated.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipAttract.zhText: 吸收的伤害在漩涡时间结束后自动放出。漩涡也可以被手动引爆。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipAttract.text: Vortex that absorbs incoming fire and detonates, releasing damage.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipAttract.zhText: 漩涡能吸收来袭的伤害，并可以引爆来释放伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipBattleC.zhText:
减少 |DURATION| 秒锻造冷却时间
冷却时间：|COOLDOWN| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipBlackHo.text:
Creates a |RANGE|m black hole that sucks in enemies, dealing |DPS| Damage per second over |DURATION|s.
Energy Cost: |FLUXCOST|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipBlackHo.zhText:
创造一个 |RANGE| 米范围的黑洞来将敌人吸入其中，在 |DURATION| 秒内造成每秒 |DPS| 的持续性伤害。
能量消耗：|FLUXCOST|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipBlackHo.text: A black hole that draws in enemies, dealing damage.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipBlackHo.zhText: 一个能将敌人吸引进来造成伤害的黑洞。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipBlindin.text:
[PH] Fires pulse that blinds enemy crewships and fighters for |DURATION|s
Cooldown: |COOLDOWN|s
Range: |RANGE|m(?)
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipBlindin.zhText:
[PH] Fires pulse that blinds enemy crewships and fighters for |DURATION|s
Cooldown: |COOLDOWN|s
Range: |RANGE|m(?)

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipDeathBl.zhText:
取消炮台冷却，效果持续 |DURATION| 秒
冷却时间：|COOLDOWN| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipEMPAbil.text: Manually detonate to increase the Blast Radius. Delivers additional pulses after the initial burst based on how many targets were hit.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipEMPAbil.zhText: 手动引爆来增加爆炸范围。在首次爆炸后，根据击中目标的数量来造成额外的脉冲。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipEMPAbil.text: Electro-Magnetic Pulse that damages enemies and disables them temporarily.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipEMPAbil.zhText: 电磁脉冲可对敌人造成伤害并且使它们暂时瘫痪。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipFlaresA.text: Each subsequent use within 4 seconds doubles the Energy cost up to a maximum of 8x.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipFlaresA.zhText: 4 秒内每再使用一次该技能都会让能量消耗翻倍，最高可达到 8x。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipFlaresA.text: Flares that distract enemy guided projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipFlaresA.zhText: 可干扰敌方制导导弹的热诱弹。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipMassRec.text:
Recall all Crew Members to the Railjack and Heal them for |HEAL|%
Cooldown: |COOLDOWN|s
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipMassRec.zhText:
召回所有舰员到航道星舰，并为他们恢复 |HEAL|% 生命
冷却时间：|COOLDOWN| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipPhoenix.text: Leaves a fiery wake that damages anything it touches, while increasing Speed and reducing incoming damage. Railjack turrets gain additional <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage. Accumulates Damage each second and unleashes it on deactivation.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipPhoenix.zhText: 留下一道炽热的航迹，来对任何被其触及的事物造成伤害；同时可获得速度提升，并减少所受的来袭伤害。航道星舰炮台可获得额外的<DT_FIRE>火焰伤害。伤害随时间累积，并在停用时释放。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipPhoenix.text: Wreathes the Railjack in fire, increasing Turret Damage and Speed.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipPhoenix.zhText: 让航道星舰包裹在烈火中，增加炮台伤害和射速。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipQuadDam.text:
Boost Turret Damage by |DAMAGEBUFF|% for |DURATION|s
Cooldown: |COOLDOWN|s
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipQuadDam.zhText:
炮台伤害提高 |DAMAGEBUFF|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒
冷却时间：|COOLDOWN| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipRamAbil.text: Deals additional damage during a Vector Maneuver. Deactivate to launch the Ram forwards.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipRamAbil.zhText: 矢量机动期间可造成额外伤害。停用技能后可向前发射撞击装置。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipRamAbil.text: Railjack Ram that deals damage to anything it touches when moving forward.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipRamAbil.zhText: 航道星舰的撞击装置在前进时会对所接触的任何东西造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipRenewAb.text:
Heal all Railjack squad members by |VAL|%.
Cooldown: |COOLDOWN|s
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipRenewAb.zhText:
所有航道星舰上成员生命恢复 |VAL|%.
冷却时间：|COOLDOWN| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipStasisA.text:
Freeze all Enemy Boarding Parties for |DURATION|s
Cooldown: |COOLDOWN|s
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipStasisA.zhText:
冻结所有敌方登舰部队，持续 |DURATION| 秒
冷却时间：|COOLDOWN| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipStunAbi.text: Deploy an Electro-Magnetic Pulse to disrupt an enemy target.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipStunAbi.zhText: 部署一个电磁脉冲来扰乱一个敌方目标。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipTetherA.text: Tethered enemies explode when they are destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipTetherA.zhText: 受束缚的敌人会在死亡时爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipTetherA.text: Ensnares enemies, increasing vulnerability to Railjack weaponry.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipTetherA.zhText: 困住敌人，使其更容易受到航道星舰武器的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipThumper.text:
Creates a barrage of |FREQUENCY| explosions per second over |DURATION|s, dealing |AOE_DAMAGE| Damage in |AOE_RANGE|m.
Energy Cost: |FLUXCOST|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipThumper.zhText:
在 |DURATION| 秒内每秒产生 |FREQUENCY| 次连续爆炸，在 |AOE_RANGE| 米造成 |AOE_DAMAGE| 伤害。
能量消耗：|FLUXCOST|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipThumper.text: Delivers a barrage of explosions across a large area.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipThumper.zhText: 在一大片区域内倾泻爆炸弹幕。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipWakeMod.text: Increases the range around the Railjack that Archwings can match its speed.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewShipWakeMod.zhText: 增大曲翼可在航道星舰周围共速伴飞的范围。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill0Desc.text:
Determines maximum Railjack speed when Crewmate is Piloting.

|VALUE|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill0Desc.zhText:
决定了舰员在操纵航道星舰时，可达到的最大速度。

|VALUE|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill1Desc.text:
Determines accuracy and heat accretion when Crewmate mans the Railjack Turrets.

|VALUE|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill1Desc.zhText:
决定了舰员在使用航道星舰的炮台时，拥有的精准度和热量积聚。

|VALUE|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill2Desc.text:
Determines Crewmate's ship repair and self-healing times.

|VALUE|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill2Desc.zhText:
决定了舰员的战舰维修和自我恢复时间。

|VALUE|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill3Desc.zhText:
决定了舰员可造成的战斗伤害。

|VALUE|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill4Desc.text:
Determines Crewmate's health and shield ratings.

|VALUE|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewSkill4Desc.zhText:
决定了舰员的生命值和护盾评级。

|VALUE|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewmateBallDes.text: Call in a designated crew member for backup in non-Railjack missions.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CrewmateBallDes.zhText: 在非航道星舰任务中，召唤一名指定的舰员作为后备支援。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/CubicsDesc.text:

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQu.text: I am Cephalon Cy. I require access to your Dry Dock. Take me there.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQu.zhText: 我是中枢赛伊。我需要进入你的干船坞。带我过去。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQu.text:
Operator,

Last cycle, during routine star count, I detected something unusual. A pattern - hidden in the red shift data.

I did not want to worry you about my sensory stability. So I ran an autonomous scan… I found something! Base schematic data, previously corruption-flagged… was whole again. The weave works in unexpected ways… did I receive parity bits from some unknown source?

As you know, my flight capabilities are confined to the Orbiter here and her companion Lander but this new base structure might interest you and your fellow Tenno?

Your most stable Cephalon,
Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQu.zhText:
指挥官，

在上个周期，日常数星星的时候，我检测到某些异常现象。一种电波模式 — 隐藏在红移数据中。

我不想让你对我的感官稳定性产生忧虑。所以我自作主张对其进行了一次扫描……我有一些发现！先前被标记为损坏的基础原理数据……再次变完整了。这个织网以一种出人意料的方式运作……我是否从某个未知来源收到了用于校验的编码？

你也知道，我的飞行能力仅限于这个轨道飞行器以及她的同伴，着陆器，但是你和你的 Tenno 小伙伴们可能会对这种新型基础结构感兴趣？

你最稳定的中枢，
Ordis

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQu.text:
Operator,

Ordis has been asked to send you this blueprint. It appears to be for... another Cephalon? A Cephalon that was somehow associated with Railjacks? 

Railjacks were magnificent combat spacecraft, not seen since the Old War!

Ordis is - JEALOUS - excited to see what will happen when this new Cephalon is built.

Ordis
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackBuildQu.zhText:
指挥官，

Ordis 受命转交给您这份蓝图。它似乎是用于……另一个中枢？一个与航道星舰有某种联系的中枢？ 

航道星舰是壮观的战斗飞船，自从旧战争以来就再也没有见过了！

Ordis 非常——嫉妒——期待看到这个新的中枢建成后会发生什么。

Ordis
在铸造厂中制造航道星舰中枢

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackHelp_Pl.text:
The Plexus allows you to use your Railjack mod selection with any Railjack you crew upon.

Plexus Mods can be found in Railjack missions. Integrated Mods apply to you on any Railjack! Aura Mods impact the whole squad! Battle Mods determine which Railjack Abilities you can use on a Railjack. Tactical Mods determine which Railjack Abilities you can use in the Tactical Menu.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackHelp_Pl.zhText:
「深控」让你能够在搭乘的任意航道星舰上都可以使用你的航道星舰 Mod。

深控 Mod 可以通过航道星舰任务获得。无论你在哪艘航道星舰上，综合 Mod 都会对你产生效果！光环 Mod 会对全队产生影响！战斗 Mod 决定了你可以在航道星舰上施放哪些航道星舰技能。战术 Mod 决定了你可以在战术菜单中使用什么航道星舰技能。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackHelp_St.text:
Welcome to the Proxima Regions! Here you'll find Railjack missions that combine space and on foot combat.
If you own a Railjack, consider visiting the practice node 'Free Flight' on Earth Proxima to practice Piloting and learning your Railjack's layout. If you do not yet own a Railjack, prepare to assist a squad and work together. We all lift together!
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackHelp_St.zhText:
欢迎来到比邻星域！在这里，你可以找到结合了太空和地面战斗的航道星舰任务。
如果你拥有一艘航道星舰，你可以考虑造访位于地球比邻星域的“自由航行”节点来练习飞行，并学习航道星舰的布局。如果你还没有航道星舰，那请准备好加入一个小队来互相合作协助。让我们一起共同进退！

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackQuestFi.text: Recover the next section of the Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackQuestFi.zhText: 找到航道星舰的下一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackQuestIn.text: Integrate Cephalon Cy into the Railjack?
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackQuestIn.zhText: 将中枢赛伊集成到航道星舰？

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackQuestRe.zhText: 航道星舰维修完成还需要 |TIME|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackQuestRe.text: Repair process fully funded, time until completion: |TIME|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackQuestRe.zhText: 维修程序所需资源已满足，距离完工还有：|TIME|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackRequire.text: A Railjack is required to access Railjack Research
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackRequire.zhText: 需要拥有一艘航道星舰才能进入航道星舰相关的研究。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackRequire.text: A Railjack is required to host Railjack missions
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackRequire.zhText: 需要拥有一艘航道星舰才能作为主机方进行航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackWrasseS.text: Conquer the skies with this noble Railjack skin.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RailjackWrasseS.zhText: 使用这个高贵的航道星舰外观来征服太空。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Railjack_HostSt.text: |OPEN_COLOR|SELECT A MISSION|CLOSE_COLOR| TO FORM A CREW
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Railjack_HostSt.zhText: |OPEN_COLOR|选择一个任务|CLOSE_COLOR|来组建一组舰员

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Railjack_Toggle.text: Only Railjack missions may be launched from Railjack Navigation.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Railjack_Toggle.zhText: 只有航道星舰任务可以从航道星舰星图导航启动。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ReliquaryKeyHun.text: Examine the Reliquary on the Railjack
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ReliquaryKeyHun.zhText: 检查航道星舰上的圣物装置

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RepairToolDesc.text: An Omni is a multi-use Railjack tool for extinguishing fires, grounding electrical hazards, and repairing hull ruptures. Use outside the Railjack to instantly recall back to the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RepairToolDesc.zhText: 万用工具是一种多功能的航道星舰工具，用于扑灭火灾、抢救电力事故，以及修复舰体破裂。在航道星舰外使用可立即被召回舰上。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RescueCrewshipH.text: Find and rescue the hostage on the Prison Crewship
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RescueCrewshipH.zhText: 找到并解救监狱战舰上的人质

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ResearchComplet.text: The blueprint can now be fabricated.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ResearchComplet.zhText: 蓝图现在可以被用来进行制造了。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RushSalvage.text: Rush Wreckage repairs for <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|RUSH_COST|? A Wreckage slot will also be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RushSalvage.zhText: 是否消耗 <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|RUSH_COST| 加速残骸修复？这仍将占用一个残骸槽位。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RushSalvage_Ins.text: Not enough platinum to rush wreckage repairs.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/RushSalvage_Ins.zhText: 没有足够的白金来加速残骸抢修。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SalvageAtMaxCap.text: Wreckage capacity limit of |LIMIT| reached. Any new Wreckage will be automatically scrapped for <CREW_SHIP_FUSION_POINTS>Dirac.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SalvageAtMaxCap.zhText: 已达到残骸容量限制 |LIMIT|。任何新的残骸将自动报废成<CREW_SHIP_FUSION_POINTS> 狄拉克核心。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Salvage_UserRus.text: You will still need <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|credits| to rush wreckage repairs after purchase.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Salvage_UserRus.zhText: 在购买以后您仍旧需要 <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|credits| 来加速残骸抢修。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Salvage_UserRus.text: You will still need <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|credits| to rush wreckage repairs.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Salvage_UserRus.zhText: 您仍旧需要 <PLATINUM_CREDITS>|credits| 来加速残骸抢修。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ScrapDesc.text:
High-density alloy armor plating used in the construction of offensive spacecraft.

Location: Railjack Missions
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ScrapDesc.zhText:
用于建造攻击性战舰的高致密合金装甲板。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SellSalvage.text:
Scrapping this Wreckage will yield <FUSION_POINTS>|SELL_VALUE| Endo.
Continue?
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SellSalvage.zhText:
报废该残骸将产出 <FUSION_POINTS>|SELL_VALUE| 内融核心。
继续吗？

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.text: This Brachiolyst attacks with ground-based melee strikes and projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.zhText: 这种狂战使通过地面上的近战击打和投射物发起攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.text: Targets and disables a ship's systems.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.zhText: 以瘫痪战舰系统为目标。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.text: A specialist unit that targets a ship's systems using Interference Drones.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.zhText: 使用干扰无人机把战舰系统作为攻击目标的特殊单位。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.text: Targets enemies with a fireball projectile.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.zhText: 向目标敌人发射一个火球投射物。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.text: Uses a beam weapon and an energy shield for protection.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardin.zhText: 使用激光武器和能量护盾来进行防护。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientFighter.text: A heavy Sentient fighter that weakens targets with a slicing plasma wave and finishes them off with a massive energy orb.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientFighter.zhText: 重型 Sentient 战斗机，通过切割型等离子波削弱目标，并释放出巨型能量球来终结目标。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientFighter.text: This unorthodox Sentient Fighter tumbles and twists through space, attacking with its dual missile launchers and a barrage of swarming micro missiles.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientFighter.zhText: 这种另类的 Sentient 战斗机在太空中翻滚扭动，借助它的两个导弹发射器和密集的微型导弹进行轰炸攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientFragmen.text:
A shard ripped from a Sentient Anomaly in the Veil Proxima. Little Duck is known to trade these for other exotic goods somewhere in Fortuna on Venus.

Location: Murex ships found in Veil Proxima nodes marked with a special flashing icon (Railjack)
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientFragmen.zhText:
从面纱比邻星域中的 Sentient 异常事件中扯下的碎片。小鸭子会在福尔图娜的某个地方用异域货物交易这些碎片，她以这种交易被人所熟知。

获取地点：面纱比邻星域节点中标有特殊的闪烁图标（航道星舰）的骨螺战舰

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientRamSled.text: Pierces a ship's hull to release a boarding party.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientRamSled.zhText: 刺穿一艘战舰的舰体来派出一组登舰小队。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ShieldThresherA.text:
Launch a Shield Thresher wave dealing |DAMAGE| Damage to enemy Shields.
Energy Cost: |FLUXCOST|
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ShieldThresherA.zhText:
发射一道护盾削弱波，对敌人的护盾造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。
能量消耗：|FLUXCOST|

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ShootTheExposed.zhText: 从航道星舰射击暴露的核心

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_MaxRank.text: Avionic is already at maximum rank.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_MaxRank.zhText: 航电设备已达到最高等级

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.text: Collect |OPEN_COLOR|DIRAC|CLOSE_COLOR| and use it to rank up Avionics, increasing their stats.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.zhText: 收集|OPEN_COLOR|狄拉克核心|CLOSE_COLOR|并用它对航电设备进行升级，以提升它们的数值。
是否消耗<CREW_SHIP_FUSION_POINTS>|COST| 来将区格升级至 |RANK| 级？
没有足够的<CREW_SHIP_FUSION_POINTS>来进行升级。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.text: Selected grid is already at max rank.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.zhText: 所选区格已达到最高等级。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.text: Could not upgrade grid, please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.zhText: 无法升级区格，请稍后重试。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.text: Rank up a Grid Socket using collected |OPEN_COLOR|DIRAC|CLOSE_COLOR|. A ranked up Grid Socket will increase the stats of any Avionic slotted into it.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Systems_Upgrade.zhText: 使用收集的|OPEN_COLOR|狄拉克核心|CLOSE_COLOR|来升级区格插槽。一个升级过的区格插槽可以提升插在其中的航电设备的数值。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TacCallDefender.text: Defends the Railjack against enemy raiders
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TacCallDefender.zhText: 防御航道星舰，抵御敌方侵入者的来袭

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TacCallGunnerDe.text: Operates a Swivel Turret against enemy attackers
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TacCallGunnerDe.zhText: 操作旋转炮台来对抗敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TitaniumDesc.text:
This highly malleable metal was exploited in great quantities by the Orokin and can now only be found within space rock.

Location: Railjack Missions
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TitaniumDesc.zhText:
这种柔软的金属曾被奥罗金过度开采，现在只能在太空陨石里找到。

获取地点：航道星舰任务

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TrachonsDesc.text: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/TrachonsDesc.zhText: 一种在感染者飞船上发现的器官，被认为能促进感染者蜂巢群体思维的交流。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ValenceTransfer.text: Dismantle a matching Railjack part to transfer a boosted version of its innate bonuses to the selected part.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/ValenceTransfer.zhText: 拆除一个航道星舰部件，来将一个增强版部件的自带加成转移到选中的部件上。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/WreckageLimit_C.text: You won't be able to play Railjack missions while you are above the Wreckage capacity limit. Attempting to launch a Railjack mission or opening the Configure Railjack station will reopen this screen. Continue?
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/WreckageLimit_C.zhText: 由于超出残骸容量限制，你将无法进行航道星舰任务。尝试启动一个航道星舰任务或进入配置航道星舰站点时，将会重新跳出这个界面。是否继续？

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/WreckageLimit_R.zhText: 无法报废正在被维修的残骸。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/WreckageLimit_S.zhText: 报废选中的残骸以换取 <CREW_SHIP_FUSION_POINTS>|PRICE|？

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/WreckageLimit_W.text:
You are currently |NUM| weapons over the Wreckage capacity limit. You will not be able to play Railjack missions until you are back under the limit.

Attempting to launch a Railjack mission or entering the Configure Railjack station will reopen this screen if you defer.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/WreckageLimit_W.zhText:
目前你有 |NUM| 件超出残骸容量限制的武器。在残骸数量符合容量限制之前，你将无法进行航道星舰任务。

如果你暂时不采取行动，那么当你尝试启动一个航道星舰任务或进入配置航道星舰工作台时，这条信息将会重新跳出。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Wreckage_Cancel.text: All invested Resources will be refunded and the Wreckage will remain in your inventory.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Wreckage_Cancel.zhText: 所有投入的资源将被返还，残骸将继续保留在你的仓库中。

/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Wreckage_SaleFa.text: Could not scrap Wreckage at this time. Please try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Railjack/Wreckage_SaleFa.zhText: 现在暂时不能报废残骸，请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack <DT_SLASH>Slash Damage results in a Tear Status Effect which increases damage dealt to enemy ships.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 航道星舰<DT_SLASH>切割伤害会导致撕裂异常状态，该状态会增加对敌舰造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack <DT_IMPACT>Impact Damage results in a Concuss Status Effect which reduces the aim and damage of enemy ships.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_IMPACT>冲击伤害会导致震荡异常状态，可降低敌舰的瞄准以及造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack <DT_PUNCTURE>Puncture Damage results in a Decompress Status Effect which temporarily reduces the Shields and Armor of enemy ships.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 航道星舰<DT_PUNCTURE>穿刺伤害会导致减压异常状态，该状态会暂时降低敌舰的护盾及护甲。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack <DT_FIRE>Heat Damage results in a Sear Status Effect which causes rounds to burn through enemy ships and deal Damage Over Time.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_FIRE>火焰伤害会导致灼烧异常状态，该状态会使燃烧的弹药穿透敌舰并随时间对其造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack <DT_ELECTRICITY>Electricity Damage results in a Scramble Status Effect which temporarily disables enemy ship flight controls.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 航道星舰<DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害会导致混乱异常状态，该状态会暂时使敌舰的飞行控制失效。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack <DT_POISON>Toxin Damage results in an Intoxicate Status Effect which confuses enemy ships to attack the nearest target, including allies.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 航道星舰<DT_POISON>毒素伤害会导致迷惑异常状态，该状态会迷惑敌舰使其攻击包括友军在内的最近目标。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack <DT_FREEZE>Cold Damage results in an Immobilize Status Effect which disables enemy ship flight controls and slows them to a halt.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 航道星舰<DT_FREEZE>冰冻伤害会导致冻停异常状态，该状态会禁用敌舰的飞行控制并使其停下。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.text: Railjack Sigma series Armaments can be researched in the Dry Dock, while House series can be found as Wreckage and repaired at the Configure console.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Armaments_.zhText: 可以在干船坞中研究航道星舰西格玛系列的军备，而不同学派系列的军备可以作为残骸被找到，并在干船坞里的配置控制台被修复。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Avionics_0.text: All Railjack Mods can be enhanced by fusing them with Endo in the Modding screen.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Avionics_0.zhText: 所有航道星舰 Mod 都可以在 Mod 界面中使用内融核心来进行融铸。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Avionics_1.text: Modding capacity is the larger of your Plexus Rank and your Mastery Rank, and is doubled if an Orokin Reactor is installed.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Avionics_1.zhText: Mod 容量会随着深控等级和你的精通段位的提升而增加，安装奥罗金反应堆能够让 Mod 容量翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Components.text: Reactors determine your Railjack's Battle Mods Power Strength, Range, or Duration buffs.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Components.zhText: 反应堆决定了你的航道星舰的战斗 Mod 的技能强度、范围，或是持续时间加成。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Components.text: Scrapping unrepaired Wreckage yields Endo, while scrapping repaired Wreckage refunds 80% of the resources used in the repair process.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Components.zhText: 报废未修复的残骸会产出内融核心，而报废已修复的残骸会返还修理过程中使用的 80% 的资源。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_0.text: The price to hire Crew at Ticker in Fortuna varies based on your affiliation with the Syndicate they represent. If you are in good or neutral standing the price is discounted or taxed if you are in bad standing.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_0.zhText: 在福尔图娜的 Ticker 处招募舰员的价格，会根据舰员所属集团与你的关系而变化。如果你在该集团中享有较高的声望，或是与其为中立关系，那么你就能享受到招募折扣；如果你在该集团中的声望为负，那么你招募舰员时将会被收取税金。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_1.text: Competency Points are earned at certain ranks in the Command Intrinsic and can be assigned to any Crew member you hire. Assign points through the Train option to improve their skill and performance in mission.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_1.zhText: "能力点数"可通过达到特定的"命令内源之力"等级后获得，这些点数可以被分配给任何招募的舰员。可通过"训练"选项来分配能力点数，以此来提升舰员的技能以及在任务中的表现。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_2.text: Crew members can be released from duty through the Contracts option. Ending a Crew member's contract refunds the Competency Points spent on them so that they can be redistributed to existing or new hires.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_2.zhText: 可以通过"合约"选项来与舰员解除合约。与一名舰员解约后，在其身上分配的能力点数会被返还给你，以便重新分配给其余或是新招募的舰员。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_3.text: Railjack Mods equipped on the Plexus also apply to Crew members in mission.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_3.zhText: 装备在"深控"上的航道星舰 Mod，也适用于任务中的舰员。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_4.text: At Command Rank 8, Converted Liches are available for Crewing your Railjack. With their incredibly high Health stat, their sole role is to Defend your Railjack from intruders.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_4.zhText: 当"命令内源之力"达到了 8 级时，可以将被感化的玄骸作为舰员加入你的航道星舰。凭借着极高的生命值，它们唯一的职责就是保护你的航道星舰不被入侵。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_5.text: Crew member slots are replaced by players in the order that they are equipped from right to left. Manage your Crew so that the top trained in their role are active in mission when players join the squad.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/CrewMgr_5.zhText: 舰员的位置会按照从右至左的顺序，依次被加入队伍的玩家所取代。当有玩家加入队伍时，管理好你的舰员，以确保在任务中活跃的舰员都是各个职责中训练有素的佼佼者。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Intrinsics.text: Railjack Intrinsics are earned via Affinity for completing Railjack missions and performing various actions including removing hazards with your Omni tool, clearing boarding parties, crafting at the Forge, and more!
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Intrinsics.zhText: 航道星舰内源之力可经由经验值获得，包括完成航道星舰任务以及执行多种操作，例如，使用万用工具消除险情，消灭登舰敌人，在锻造厂锻造，等等。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Intrinsics.text: Each Railjack Intrinsic Rank increase earns you 1,500 Mastery. Completing 10 ranks in a given Intrinsic earns you 15,000 Mastery.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Intrinsics.zhText: 每提升一次航道星舰内源之力的等级，都可以带给你 1,500 精通段位经验。在某项内源之力达到了 10 级，可以让你获得 15,000 精通段位经验。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Intrinsics.text: Intrinsic Ranks and Railjack Mods apply uniquely to you through the Plexus, while Aura Mods apply to your Railjack and your entire squad.
/Lotus/Language/RailjackHints/Intrinsics.zhText: 内源等级和航道星舰 Mod 的效果会通过深控作用于你，而光环 Mod 的效果则会作用于你的航道星舰以及整个小队。

/Lotus/Language/RailjackMissions/Asteroi.zhText: 击杀小行星基地司令官
击杀小行星基地司令官

/Lotus/Language/RailjackMissions/CrpElit.zhText: 瘫痪 CORPUS 精英运输机

/Lotus/Language/RailjackMissions/Grineer.zhText: 清除该区域的敌方势力

/Lotus/Language/RailjackMissions/HangarS.text: AWAY CREW: STEAL THE DOCKED DESTROYER

/Lotus/Language/Recipes/DuelistSuitRecip.text: Narin's main blueprint and component blueprints can be acquired from missions on the Zariman Ten Zero, or in exchange for Entropic Kuva from Cephalon Melica in the Chrysalith (after completing Angels of the Zariman).
/Lotus/Language/Recipes/DuelistSuitRecip.zhText: Narin 的主要蓝图和组件蓝图可以通过在「扎里曼 10-0 号」上完成任务获得，或者（在完成扎里曼天使任务后），在羽化之穹的中枢梅丽卡处用熵之赤毒交换获得。

/Lotus/Language/Recipes/InkblotRecipeHel.text: Follie's main blueprint and component blueprints are acquired via Follie's Hunt missions on Venus, or exchanged with Aspirant Zorba in any Relay (accessible after completing The Chains of Harrow).
/Lotus/Language/Recipes/InkblotRecipeHel.zhText: Follie 的主要蓝图和组件蓝图可通过在金星上完成 Follie 的狩猎任务获得，或在任意中继站（完成《Harrow 的枷锁》 后即可进入）与见习仲裁者左巴交换获得。

/Lotus/Language/Recipes/KoumeiRecipeHelp.text: Acquire Koumei's main and component blueprints from Saya's Visions on Earth or in exchange for Fate Pearls at Koumei's Shrine in Cetus. Access this content by talking to Saya in Cetus after completing both the Saya's Vigil and Once Awake Quests.
/Lotus/Language/Recipes/KoumeiRecipeHelp.zhText: 从地球上的萨娅的异象获取 Koumei 的主要和组件蓝图，或在希图斯 Koumei 的祈运坛处用命运之珠交换。完成《萨娅的守夜》和《悲剧的开端》系列任务后，通过与希图斯中的萨娅交谈来解锁此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Recipes/NokkoArchGunReci.text: Arbucep's main and component blueprints are acquired from Deepmines Bounties on Venus, or purchased from Nightcap in Fortuna. The New War quest is required to access this content.
/Lotus/Language/Recipes/NokkoArchGunReci.zhText: 蕈菇的主要蓝图和部件蓝图可从金星的深矿赏金任务中获得，或从福尔图娜的夜帽处购买。需要完成《新纪之战》系列任务才能访问此内容。

/Lotus/Language/Recipes/SpiderWhipRecipe.zhText: 完成《六人组》系列任务后，丝蛛皇的主要蓝图和部件蓝图可在完成双衍王境的织屿人复眠螺旋获得。蓝图还可以在居住舱的言录使处通过交换急行蛛外壳（从织屿人复眠螺旋中获得）购买。

/Lotus/Language/Recipes/TnOrionScytheRec.zhText: 愤怒的主要蓝图和部件蓝图可以通过天王星比邻星域的航道星舰任务获得，或者通过天王星渡界之塔的商人获得（完成《Jade 之影：众星》后即可进入）。

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Fire.zhText: 防御中继站免于 Sargas Ruk 的攻击！

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.text:
We're rebuilding a lost Tenno relay. Here's how you can help:

- Collect Trembera Essence to complete the Relay Strut Component Blueprint.
- Find Pyrus Essence to complete the new design.
- The Grustrag Three have been hampering, eliminate them.
- Complete Daily Tasks for Cephalon Simaris, so that he can continue his computational design work.

Donate any resources you collect by bringing them to the construction site. Together, we'll show the Grineer that our will cannot be crushed.

-Cressa Tal of Steel Meridian
/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.zhText:
我们正在重建失去的 Tenno 中继站。以下是你可以提供的帮助：

－收集战栗精华以完成中继站结构组件蓝图。
－找到烈焰精华以完成新设计。
－Grustrag 三霸一直在阻挠我们，消灭他们。
－完成中枢 Simaris 的每日任务，使他可以继续进行计算设计的工作。

你可以将任何资源带往建设场地并捐献。齐心合力，要让 Grineer 明白我们的意志是坚不可摧的。

－钢铁防线 Cressa Tal

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.text: With a blazing orange hue and rigid material strength, this compound is prized by ship and station architects.
/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.zhText: 这种化合物具有炽热的橙色色调和坚硬的材料强度，受到船舰及中继站建筑师的青睐。

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.text:
Please take this gift as a token of our everlasting thanks.

-Cressa Tal of Steel Meridian
/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.zhText:
请收下这份代表我们不尽感激的礼物。

-钢铁防线的 Cressa Tal

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.text: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.zhText: Tenno 中继站构造中的一个组成部分。

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.text:
Tenno! Ruk's hit us hard. It's bad, defenses are toast. We're dug in, but we're not gonna last much longer. If you want this relay back you're gonna have to fight for it.

Take this: it's a Zylok. Pretty, nasty, and pretty nasty. Cressa Tal, signing off. Tell Ruk we said hi.
/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.zhText:
Tenno！Ruk 对我们造成了重创，防御系统一团乱麻。我们正全力防守，但恐怕坚持不了多久。如果你想要保住这座中继站，那就要为之而战。

收下吧：这是席尔火枪。漂亮、帅气、帅得漂亮。Cressa Tal 结束通话。替我们向 Ruk “问好”。

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.text: SOS! Sargas Ruk has breached the Relay! SOS!
/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.zhText: SOS！Sargas Ruk 已经突破中继站！SOS！

/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.text: A highly purified mineral compound prized for its strength, resiliency, and resistance to heat. Widely used in the construction of Tenno relays.
/Lotus/Language/RelayReconstruction/Rela.zhText: 高纯度矿物质化合物，因其强度，弹性和耐热性而备受推崇。广泛用于 Tenno 中继站的建造。
帮我们重建失落的中继站

/Lotus/Language/Resources/RivenFragmentD.text:

Location: Eximus units and Requiem Relics

/Lotus/Language/SanctuaryResearch/Resear.text:
The smashing is like music.

PFFT, CRACK.

My machine's striking pin rams the rock in front of me. A rush of bits crumbles from the rock and rolls over my boots. I see glinting in the rubble. I like it when it shines, it means I'm serving well. I thrust my shovel in, its plasma blades slicing clean through the chunks. It vibrates, so I switch on its inducer and the shiny bits clink on. Then I throw them into the sorter and jump out of the way of the next strike.

PFFT, CRACK.

More rumble, more shining. This is a good day. All of us, shoveling to the beat of the machines. Only a fraction of a cycle left on this rock, days really. I keep thinking: What will the next rock be like? 

PFFT, CRACK.

The Outer Terminus has many rocks. Good rocks, I like it here. I shovel again and jump out of the way of the next smash.

PFFT…

The machines stop and it goes dark. Why have the machines stopped? Why is it dark? A voice reverberates all around, a thundering whisper:

|OPEN_COLOR|“MERELY FRAMED”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The rock shakes like never before. Gravel rains in the darkness. I choke on the dust and struggle to find my balance on the shifting ground. The voice booms again. It is in the air. It is on the rock. It is in my head.

|OPEN_COLOR|“MERELY SHAPED THEY ARE CALLED”|CLOSE_COLOR|

My ears ring like sirens. Then I hear new smashing, it is coming from down the tunnel. Not rhythmic smashing, not the music, something else and I do not like it. There are other voices too, screaming voices. They make me think of the way we scream when there is an accident, when one of us gets caught in a sorter. There is much screaming. The voice grows louder.

|OPEN_COLOR|“THERE WAS NO THEIR MOTHER”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Out of the darkness, a new light rounds the distant corner and shines down the tunnel. Our lights do not look like this. It is apart of something big and it moves wildly. Running? Yes, running through our line. Our machines fly up and then slam back down. Miners are smashed and crushed into tiny pieces. I am scared. 

I am angry. Why is this happening? Is that an Orokin? No, we serve the Orokin. The Orokin are golden. This is something else. I pick up my shovel.

|OPEN_COLOR|“THERE WAS NO THEIR FATHER”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The light is close now. I find my footing and grip my shovel like I do when I chip ore. The light sends a machine flying at me. I jump but I am too slow. It crashes into my chest and pins my legs to the floor. I try to breathe but I cannot breathe. I look up and the light charges toward me. I raise my shovel just before it tramples into me. There's a clink. The light catches itself on my shovel's blade, forcing the shovel's butt deep into the hard ground. The light explodes under its own force. All is black.

For a moment there is silence. I pull on the shovel but it is wedged between the ground and that thing. Then, the shovel pulses like it does when I strike a shiny chunk of ore, without thinking, I flick on the shovels inducer. The voice screams. Everything shakes. I like hearing this scream, I do not know why. I use everything I have left to force the shovel in deeper. The thing reels back. I can feel it running. It is running away. 

Everything goes quiet again, so I close my eyes. 

***

|OPEN_COLOR|“Over here. I found one,”|CLOSE_COLOR| a wave of pain rushes through my chest, my eyes dart open. There's a light, I try to get out of the way but I cannot move. The light shouts, |OPEN_COLOR|“hurry, he's not going to last very long.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

I try to talk, but a new voice speaks instead, |OPEN_COLOR|“Doesn't matter, if he can survive that, then they want his sample for the next batch.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

They are lifting me onto something. I catch glimpses of shimmering gold. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“This is a bad idea. I mean, would you trust a Grineer soldier?”|CLOSE_COLOR| The figure presses something into my arm and I want to sleep again. 

The new voice laughs, |OPEN_COLOR|“Do we have any other choice?”|CLOSE_COLOR|
/Lotus/Language/SanctuaryResearch/Resear.zhText:
这冲击声宛如音乐一般。

噼嘶──框啷──

我手中机械的撞钉撞击着眼前的岩石，钻头粉碎岩石的碎屑滚过我的靴子。我看到瓦砾堆微光闪烁，我喜欢它闪动的样子，这表示我做得很棒。我拿铲子用力挖着，它的等离子刀刃干净俐落的将岩石切割成块。它开始震动，于是我打开了它的电感器，光亮的钻头发出金属的碰撞声响。我将石块抛进分类机，并在下一次撞击前闪到一旁。

噼嘶──框啷──

轰隆声不绝于耳，石块更加闪亮耀眼了，这是个美好的一天，我们所有的人都使用这样的机器在挖掘着。这块岩石还差几个圈就挖完了，可真花了我好几天。我常在想: 下一块岩石会是什么样子呢？

噼嘶──框啷──

Outer Terminus 有许多岩石，质地良好的岩石，我喜欢这里。我又铲了一次，并在下次撞击开始前跳回来。

噼嘶…

机器停止运作，熄灭了。它们怎么不动了？为什么陷入一片黑暗？一道如雷鸣的呢喃声从四面八方传来。

|OPEN_COLOR|「仅赋其形，」|CLOSE_COLOR|

岩石前所未见的震动着，碎石在黑暗中如骤雨般降下。我快被尘土窒息了，我努力地在晃动的大地上保持身体平衡。那道声音再次隆隆响起，在空气中，在岩石中，也在我的脑中。

|OPEN_COLOR|「谓之为塑；」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我犯起耳鸣，耳中响起像警笛一样的声音。然后，我听到地底隧道传来新的冲击声，毫无节奏感，一点也不像音乐的冲击声，有什么我不喜欢的鬼东西出没了。我还听到了其他声音，是尖叫声。这种尖叫的方式让我想起某位伙伴发生意外，当他被分类机卡住时我们所发出的悲鸣。好多人在惊呼尖叫着。那道令人震耳欲聋的声音又出现了，而且变得更加响亮。

|OPEN_COLOR|「本为无母，」|CLOSE_COLOR|

黑暗之外的远方有一道光芒照进隧道，看起来不像是我们的灯。不远处某只庞然大物疯狂的移动着。它是在奔跑吗？没错，它冲进了我们的采集线，把我们的机器撞飞到空中，又重重的摔下，矿工们被应声压扁。我害怕极了。

我怒不可遏，怎么会发生这种事情？那是奥罗金吗？不对呀，我们就是为奥罗金服务的。而且奥罗金有着耀金的外观，一定是其他的东西。于是我拿起了我的铲子。

|OPEN_COLOR|「亦无其父。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

光源正在逼近。我站稳脚步，像开采矿石那般握紧铲子。那道光芒向我扔出一台机器，我跳起来想要避开，可是动作太慢了，它直接命中我的胸口，把我的双腿压在地上。我想要呼吸却喘不过气来。我抬起头，那道光冲向我。在它要压扁我之前我举起了我的铲子… 一阵响亮的金属碰撞声后，那道光芒因为自身的重压使我的铲刃插入了它的体内，铲柄也因此深陷进坚硬的地面中。那光芒最终被自己的力量给击溃了，一切重回黑暗。

静默片刻后，我试着拔出铲子，但铲子被卡在地面和那东西之间动弹不得。紧接着，铲子开始脉动，如同我敲击闪亮矿石时一样。我不假思索地打开了电感器，那道声音失声尖叫，周围的一切都不住震动。不知道为什么，我很喜欢听到这个尖叫声，我用尽全力死命地将铲子刺的更深。那鬼东西步履蹒跚的后退。我能感觉到它正在奔窜，逃离这里。

万籁俱寂，我阖上了双眼。

***

|OPEN_COLOR|「在这里，我找到一个」|CLOSE_COLOR|，一阵痛楚涌上我的身躯，我的眼睛猛然睁开。有道光，我想逃走，但我动也动不了。那道光线大喊着: |OPEN_COLOR|「动作快，他就快撑不住了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我本来要开口，不过另一个声音倒是先说话了，|OPEN_COLOR|「没什么大碍，如果他能存活下来，那么为了下一批量产他们会想要他的样本。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

他们把我抬到某个东西上，我瞥见了闪烁发亮的金色微光。

|OPEN_COLOR|「这不是个好主意。我是说，你会去信任一名 Grineer 士兵吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|这个身影在我的手臂上注射了某个东西，令我再次昏昏欲睡。

新的声音笑了，|OPEN_COLOR|「不然我们还有别的办法吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|
结合目标数据处理中

/Lotus/Language/SanctuaryResearch/Resear.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|“How long are you going tinker with that thing?”|CLOSE_COLOR| Father asks.

He's one to talk. Ever since we entered this junk belt, all he's done is tap on that console. This whole time he's just sat there, eyes fixed on the radar, dirty fingers tapping the drum beat to some manic song with no structure or rhythm.

I ignore him and try to go back to work on the robot. Father's tap-tap gets faster and more intense. Is he trying to get to me? I can't concentrate. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Tell me again why we don't just approach at full speed from open space? Couldn't we just slam into the rail and punch,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I ask.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Because that's what we used to do,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he's annoyed but at this point I don't care. Our convoy of transports has skulked through this junk belt for days, the viewscreen an endless parade of rocks and garbage.

|OPEN_COLOR|“We could have been through that rail a long time ago,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I say.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Maybe,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he shrugs.

|OPEN_COLOR|“And why can't I ride in Umpal's ship?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“This again?”|CLOSE_COLOR| he snaps back, |OPEN_COLOR|“you know why.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Umpal is my best and only friend, there weren't many young people in our group and Umpal is the only one close to my age. Truth be told, he was the only person my age I'd ever met. He was on another transport, they said it was for security reasons.

We are on a trade mission, my first time outside our node. These trips were dangerous but Father said it was essential I learn the business. The whole convoy is loaded down with items we have scraped together through months of local trade. It was mostly salvage, with some Ferrite spread between the different transports. Rumor was that Umpal's transport might even have some rubedo in the hold. We are heading to another survivor colony a few nodes away. They had other rare resources but more importantly, they were close enough to the sun to grow food and that was what this mission was really about.

Before we left Umpal and I drew wires to see which one of us got to bring the robot we were building, I won. It was bits and pieces of scavenged Orokin tech slammed together but it was a robot and it could walk, Father didn't think much of it but I was proud. I hoped to trade it for some rare parts when we hit the colony, enough to build a bigger second walker. Maybe even one that could carry a full size cannon.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Does this look anything like you remember from the Orokin days?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I ask in a futile attempt to break the tension.

|OPEN_COLOR|“That thing, yeah, we had ones that walked on two legs like that, but...”|CLOSE_COLOR| his finger stops its tapping and he takes a long look at the robot before continuing, |OPEN_COLOR|“but… they were different.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Don't you miss it?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I ask.

|OPEN_COLOR|“What?”|CLOSE_COLOR| he says.

|OPEN_COLOR|“You know, the empire?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“I don't think about it,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he's back to tapping on the nav console.

|OPEN_COLOR|“What about your Corpus, don't you miss them? Your father?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I say.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Orokin didn't have parents like you do, it was done differently then.”|CLOSE_COLOR| He takes a deep breath and turns to look at me. |OPEN_COLOR|“Listen, the Corpus who raised me are dead, do you know why they are dead?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Because of the plague?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I say.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Because they couldn't forget the past. I survived by worrying about two things, today and tomorrow. That is the only reason I'm alive. That is the only reason you exist. You want to remember something, remember that.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Yeah, okay.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I shrug. He's given this speech before, I had learned the hard way not to push things when he got like this. I go back to working on the robot.

After a few minutes of silence I hear him exhale, |OPEN_COLOR|“Look, we're almost to the rail. After the punch you can go over to Umpal's transport, okay.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

I nod and smile, |OPEN_COLOR|“Okay.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The next few hours go by quickly.

As we get closer to the rail, the density of obstacles in the belt increases. The ships nav module calls out course correction after course correction as we dodge debris. I watch the other transports in our convoy do the same. Our progress is slowed to a crawl but Father swears avoiding detection is worth it.

I am trying to splice a connection deep in the robot's chest cavity when the alarms sound. The radar screen lights up. I look up to see one of the other transports veer off course, seconds later something crashes into their hull. There's a blue flash of electricity and their ship goes dark. Then two more crashes and two more flashes, these are Interceptor Pods, a Grineer trap.

My father jumps up and begins yelling instructions to our nav system. |OPEN_COLOR|“Full power, take us up and out of the belt.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“That's Umpal's ship they're boarding…”|CLOSE_COLOR|

His face collapses into a frown, |OPEN_COLOR|“It is.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“They'll kill him. We have to do something.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I plead.

|OPEN_COLOR|“We keep going. They can't take us all.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I can barely hear him through his clenched teeth.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Umpal is Corpus to us, we can't abandon him.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I shout.

|OPEN_COLOR|“We have to, that's how we survive.”|CLOSE_COLOR| His voice grows louder.

|OPEN_COLOR|“What if it was us? Wouldn't you want them to...”|CLOSE_COLOR|

His fist slams the nav console and as he whips around to glare at, |OPEN_COLOR|“What are you going to do? Fight off those Grineer with your Moa?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

I look down at the robot, a mess of parts and wires that can barely walk, let alone shoot. Neither of us say another word. Out of the viewscreen I watch as Umpal's crippled ship, now swarmed by Grineer, shrink into blackness.
/Lotus/Language/SanctuaryResearch/Resear.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|「你还要摆弄那东西弄多久？」|CLOSE_COLOR|老爸问道。

他还好意思说我。自从我们进入这区太空垃圾带以来，他就一直待在那座控制台上。此刻他只是坐在那里，眼睛盯着雷达，肮脏的手指敲打出一些没什么条理与节奏的鬼歌。

我不理他，并试着回头埋首修理机器人。但老爸敲打的节奏变得更快更激烈，他是在企图惹恼我吗？我实在没办法专心了。

|OPEN_COLOR|「再告诉我一次，为什么我们不干脆全速前进脱离太空区？我们就不能冲入轨道然后直接传送？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我问道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「因为我们一直以来都是这么做的，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他的声音听来有些愠火，但此时我才不想鸟他。我们的运输船队已经花了好几天潜伏在这区太空垃圾带了，屏幕中的风景尽是无止尽成列的岩石和垃圾。

|OPEN_COLOR|「我们本来在早就可以通过轨道的耶。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说。

|OPEN_COLOR|「大概吧。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他耸耸肩。

|OPEN_COLOR|「还有，为什么我不能上Umpal的船？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「又是这问题？」|CLOSE_COLOR|他反驳我，|OPEN_COLOR|「你自己心知肚明。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

Umpal是我最要好，而且是仅有的朋友。我们这群人中没什么年轻人，Umpal是唯一和我年龄相近的人。老实说，他是我遇到唯一跟我同年的。他在另一艘运输船上，他们说这是为了安全考量。

我们正在进行一项贸易任务，这是我第一次离开我们的节点。这些旅程危机四伏，但老爸总是说学习业务是很重要的。整个运输队装载着我们数个月来在当地贸易区搜刮集成的货物，多数是写废弃物，一些铁氧体在其他的运输船上。听说Umpal的运输船甚至可能载着一些红化结晶。我们正朝着另一处有几个节点外的幸存者殖民地前进，他们手中握有其他稀有的资源。而且更重要的是，他们离太阳够近，可以栽种粮食作物，这才是本次任务真正的重点。

在我和Umpal分开前我们两个用电线抽签，决定谁可以获得那台我们建造中的机器人，结果我赢了。它是个由打捞到的奥罗金科技碎片拼凑出来的小东西，不过它可是一台能行走的机器人喔。老爸对此不太关心，但我倒是很自豪，希望当我们抵达殖民地时我可以用它来交易一些罕见的部件，让我可以打造另一台更大步行的机器人；搞不好是一架装有全尺寸火炮的机器人。

|OPEN_COLOR|「奥罗金时代有什么东西和这个相似吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我问道，妄想能打破这紧绷的氛围。

|OPEN_COLOR|「你说那个东西啊，有啊，我们有一些像那样子能用两条腿走路的东西，不过…」|CLOSE_COLOR|他的手指停下敲击的动作，意味深远地看着那台机器人，然后继续说，|OPEN_COLOR|「不过呢…它们并不一样。」|CLOSE_COLOR|


|OPEN_COLOR|「你还怀念吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我问道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「什么？」|CLOSE_COLOR|他说。

|OPEN_COLOR|「你知道的，那帝国？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「我不考虑那种问题，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他又回去敲打着导航控制台。

|OPEN_COLOR|「那你的家族呢，你还会想念他们吗？你的父亲？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说。

|OPEN_COLOR|「奥罗金并不像你一样有双亲，过去并不一样。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他深呼吸了一口气然后转头望着我，|OPEN_COLOR|「听着，养育我的家族已经死了，你知道他们为何死去吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「因为那场瘟疫吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说。

|OPEN_COLOR|「因为他们无法摆脱过去。我能活下来因为我关心的只有两件事——今天和明天。这是我还活着的唯一原因，这也是你存在的唯一理由。你想要记住什么东西的话，那就记住这一点吧。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「好吧，好吧。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我耸耸肩。他以前就讲过这段演讲，我则是吃过一番苦头才学会当他变成这样的时候就先别去招惹他了。于是我继续回去处理我的机器人。

沉默了数分钟后，我听见他呼了口气，|OPEN_COLOR|「你看，我们就快到轨道上了。好吧，成功传送后你就可以到Umpal的运输船去了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我点头微笑，|OPEN_COLOR|「好的。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

接下来的几个小时飞快逝去。

随着我们越靠近轨道，垃圾带中障碍物的密度也随之增加。每回我们避开太空垃圾碎屑时，船舰的导航模组便一次又一次要求修正航道，我看到队伍中的其他运输船也在这么做。我们的进度极其缓慢，但老爸坚持为避免被侦查到，这是值得的。

正当我试着联接接入机器人的胸腔内时，警铃忽然大作，雷达显示器亮起，我抬头看到其中一台运输船偏离了航道，数秒后某个东西撞进了他们的船体。在一阵带电的蓝色闪光后，他们的船舰熄灭变暗了。紧接着又是两次的冲击与两道闪光，那是拦截吊舱，是Grineer们的陷阱！

老爸跳起来并开始大喊指挥着我们的导航系统，|OPEN_COLOR|「动力全开，带我们出去，离开这个地带。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「那是Umpal的船，Grineer正在入侵甲板…」|CLOSE_COLOR|

他的脸紧皱成一团|OPEN_COLOR|「是的。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「他们会杀了他的，我们必须想点法子。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我苦苦哀求。

|OPEN_COLOR|「我们就这样继续前进，他们无法逮到我们所有人。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我勉强从他紧咬的齿缝间听到他这么说。

|OPEN_COLOR|「Umpal是我们家族的一份子，我们不能遗弃他！」|CLOSE_COLOR|我大吼着。

|OPEN_COLOR|「我们必须这么做，我们就是如此生存下来的。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他的声音逐渐变大。

|OPEN_COLOR|「如果是我们被攻击的话呢？你难道不会希望他们…」|CLOSE_COLOR|

他一拳打在导航控制台上，猛然转身怒视着我，|OPEN_COLOR|「不然你想怎样？用你那台破恐鸟去击退Grineer吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我低头看着那由一团乱的零件和电线拼凑出的机器人，只能勉强行走，更不用说开火射击了。我们的喉头像噎住了什么，一个字都吐不出来。我看着屏幕上Umpal那艘残缺的船舰，Grineer蜂拥而上，将其淹没成了无止尽的黑暗。

The faces of the survivors, all lined up for evacuation, were etched with confusion when the lift doors closed in front of them.

We descended to the hum of the lift flying through the tower. I turned and smiled at Avantus, |OPEN_COLOR|“I was beginning to believe you were going to bring them all with us.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Nonsense, Bilsa, that's simply not feasible.”|CLOSE_COLOR| Avantus replied. |OPEN_COLOR|“You know we need to find safety and re-establish the Congress of Executors, we have no time for a rescue mission. Besides, those people know their place and they just did their duty. I will see to it they are honored when our Orokin Empire returns to glory.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

We were safe for the moment. When the Infestation took over the entire tower went into lockdown. Avantus's Executor status meant that she, and by extension, I, were among the few people who could move freely about the massive vessel. 

When the lift slowed and I overrode the controls to keep the doors closed. We listened for what seemed like forever, |OPEN_COLOR|“Do you hear anything?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said.

|OPEN_COLOR|“No, I don't smell anything either, let's go,”|CLOSE_COLOR| said Avantus raising her pistol. The doors opened to a darkened room. The light of the lift illuminated scattering figures but this wasn't the Infested, we were still alive.

|OPEN_COLOR|“You there. Step forth.”|CLOSE_COLOR| Avantus commanded and out of the shadows came several burly figures.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Grineer soldiers!”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said with an almost childlike excitement as others joined them.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Grineer workers, useless to us,”|CLOSE_COLOR| said Avantus. Despite everything, she still looked glorious in her full regalia and golden syandana.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Have you not been taught protocol?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I shouted, |OPEN_COLOR|“an Executor stands before you.”|CLOSE_COLOR| The workers look at each other puzzled, then the biggest one kneeled and bowed before us. One by one the other Grineer followed.

Avantus shook her head in disbelief and went to the nearby console to turn on the lights. We were in the mechanical workshop. Tools in cases line the walls and supply crates edged the room.

|OPEN_COLOR|“That precept said the hangar is through the next hall,”|CLOSE_COLOR| Avantus stepped around the still kneeling Grineer and toward the rear doors. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“No, stop!”|CLOSE_COLOR| protested the big Grineer, |OPEN_COLOR|“Danger.”|CLOSE_COLOR| We kept walking but sure enough when we got close the doors shook and moaned with the scraping of claws. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Those imbeciles,”|CLOSE_COLOR| Avantus cursed. |OPEN_COLOR|“They said this sector wasn't compromised.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“It doesn't sound like that many. Can we fight through?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I asked.

|OPEN_COLOR|“What? Just the two of us, with pistols and no Corrupted?”|CLOSE_COLOR| she snapped.

|OPEN_COLOR|“What about…”|CLOSE_COLOR| I motioned to the Grineer workers.

|OPEN_COLOR|“With no weapons? There's not enough of them to be decoys.”|CLOSE_COLOR| she said.

We paced in silence until one of the Grineer, that big one, ran to a tool case on the wall and tried to force it open.

Avantus noticed this and waved her hands over the nearby console to unlock the case.

The rest of the workers rushed over and grabbed the bigger grinder saws and plasma cutters. They put on safety equipment as if it were body armor. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Always wanting to cut something I see,”|CLOSE_COLOR| said Avantus to the worker. 

The big one nodded and smiled. Did he have any idea what those things might do to him?

They lined up shoulder to shoulder against the door, while we stood a few paces behind with a couple more at our side. The Infested thumped and howled, they could sense us. Their stench penetrated the doors and attacked our nostrils. 

Avantus looked over at me, |OPEN_COLOR|“Bilsa, it goes without saying, we won't be sharing that ship with the likes of these.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

I gave her a sideways look, why would she say that in front of them?

|OPEN_COLOR|“Oh child, they do not have the comprehension.”|CLOSE_COLOR| She laughed. |OPEN_COLOR|“They are content to do the job they were bred to do, only now they get to cut infested flesh instead of scrap metal.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I looked at the Grineer, they did seem unfazed.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Grineer… work!”|CLOSE_COLOR| commanded Avantus and the Grineer revved up their saws. I opened the hall doors and a wave of Infested crashed and collapsed against a solid wall of blades. Viscera pooled at our feet. A monster would tear one down only to have another Grineer take its place. |OPEN_COLOR|“Move!”|CLOSE_COLOR| she yelled and the Grineer wall marched forward, a line of death that eviscerated anything in its path.

We reached the hangar doors at the end of the hall and prepared for the worst, on the other side could be hundreds. Avantus gave the Grineer a moment to shake the guts out of their tools and catch their breath, then she nodded for me to release the locks. We all braced ourselves as the doors opened to… nothing, no Infested, just a lone ship on the other side of a massive hanger. Relieved, we sprinted across the open expanse.

As we approached the ship Avantus said, |OPEN_COLOR|“Bilsa, you open the shuttle,”|CLOSE_COLOR| and then added quietly, |OPEN_COLOR|“I'll make sure we don't have any guests for our trip.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I went to work at the nearest console and the Grineer encircled me to fend off any possible threats. Avantus stood at the ship's entrance with a few more of the grunts guarding her.

|OPEN_COLOR|“More coming.”|CLOSE_COLOR| She pointed at a swarm of Infested charging from where we came. |OPEN_COLOR|“Grineer, attack them. GO!”|CLOSE_COLOR| she bellowed.

The Grineer stiffened, their blades roared but stayed their ground.

Incensed, she cried louder, |OPEN_COLOR|“I said go, NOW!”|CLOSE_COLOR| but the Grineer did not move from the shuttle door.

|OPEN_COLOR|“It's open.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I shouted, turning just in time to see the biggest Grineer drive his saw right through Avantus' spine. The high pitched whir of metal on bone masked her screams and she collapsed to the floor. Her pearl white robes were now dyed crimson. Her dead eyes looked through me.

I started to run but was struck in the face and knocked to my knees.

The big Grineer loomed over me. |OPEN_COLOR|“Now you work for us. Make the shuttle go.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

当电梯的门当着他们的面前关上时，排队等待疏散的幸存者们脸上写满了疑惑。

我们搭上了电梯，电梯发出嗡嗡的运转声，穿过堡垒往下移动。我转身并对 Avantus 笑着说：|OPEN_COLOR|「我之前一直相信你会带着他们全部人和我们一起离开。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「別胡扯了，Blisa，那根本是不可能的。」|CLOSE_COLOR| Avantus 答道。|OPEN_COLOR|「你自己也很清楚我们必须找到一个安全的地方，然后重建执行者会议，我们无暇进行救援任务。再说了，这些人知道他们的立场，他们只不过是尽份内职责而以。我能看到当我们的奥罗金帝国重返荣耀时他们脸上同感光荣的景象。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我们暂时安全了。当感染者占据了堡垒之际，堡垒就已经全面封锁。Avantus 身为执行者的身份意味着仅有她，以及我，是少数几名能在这艘巨大的船舰中自由行动的人。

当电梯逐渐放慢时，我覆写过控制器的权限以保持电梯门紧闭。我们在仿佛听了一辈子后，|OPEN_COLOR|「你有听到什么动静吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我问。

|OPEN_COLOR|「没有，我没察觉出任何异状，走吧。」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus 一边说一面举起她的手枪。电梯开门后是一间毫无灯光的房间。电梯的灯光照亮了零星几人的身影，但并不是感染者，我们还活着。

|OPEN_COLOR|「你们，上前一步。」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus 下令，几名魁武的身影从阴影中走了出来。

|OPEN_COLOR|「Grineer 士兵耶！」|CLOSE_COLOR|当他们陆续集合时我像个孩子般兴奋的说着。

|OPEN_COLOR|「是 Grineer 工人才对，对我们而言毫无价值。」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus 说道。纵使经历了这么多事情，在整套礼服与金黄色披饰的衬托下，她看起来依旧如此光彩耀人。

|OPEN_COLOR|「没人教过你们礼仪吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我怒斥着，|OPEN_COLOR|「在你们眼前这位可是一名执行者啊！」|CLOSE_COLOR|工人们面面相觑，紧接着一名最高大的工人向我们下跪并行礼，余下的 Grineer 纷纷照做。

Avantus 难以置信地摇摇头，走向一旁的控制台打开灯光。我们位于一间机械工作坊，装有工具的箱子沿着墙面整齐排列着，补给箱则堆放于房间的边缘。

|OPEN_COLOR|「那规则上写着停机库要穿过下一间大厅才能抵达。」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus 缓步绕过仍跪下的 Grineer 走向后门。

|OPEN_COLOR|「不，停止！」|CLOSE_COLOR|为首的 Grineer 出声反对，|OPEN_COLOR|「危险。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我们不予理会继续走上前。但是果不其然，当我们靠近时，充满爪痕的门不住震动，门后则传来阵阵呻吟声。

|OPEN_COLOR|「那些蠢材，」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus诅咒着，|OPEN_COLOR|「他们还说这区并未受到波及。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「听起来似乎没有很多只，我们要硬闯过去吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我发问。

|OPEN_COLOR|「什么？只靠我们两个带手枪的人，然后也没有堕落者的支援吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|她厉声问道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「那如果是……」|CLOSE_COLOR|我指了指那群 Grineer 工人。

|OPEN_COLOR|「连把武器都没有？他们这样子连诱饵都当不成。」|CLOSE_COLOR|她说。

我们沉默地来回踱步，直到一名 Grineer 大家伙跑向一个固定在墙上的工具箱，并试图以蛮力把它撬开。

Avabtus 意识到这个状况，接着手朝附近的控制台一挥，工具箱应声解锁。

停下来的工人纷纷冲上前，一把抄起大型研磨锯与电浆切割器。他们将安全装备像盔甲一样穿在身上。

|OPEN_COLOR|「我若是看到什么，把它们切开就对了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus 对工人们说道。

大家伙点了点头并露出微笑。他真的知道门后那些东西会对他做出什么事情吗？

他们一字排开，肩并肩面对着门，而我与Avantus则站在后方，身旁是一对一对的工人。感染者不停重击着门扉并发出咆啸声，看来它们能感觉到我们的存在。刺鼻的恶臭蔓延到门的这边，窜进了我们的鼻孔。

Avantus 打量着我，|OPEN_COLOR|「Bilsa，没什么好说的，我绝不会跟像这样的家伙共享这艘船舰。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我斜眼盯着她，为什么她在要他们面前这么说？

|OPEN_COLOR|「噢，孩子啊，他们毫无理解能力。」|CLOSE_COLOR|她笑了。|OPEN_COLOR|「他们只要能做好被教育去做的工作就能心满意足了，只是他们现在是去切割被感染的血肉，而非金属废弃物罢了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我观察着 Grineer，但他们似乎未受这些话所影响。

|OPEN_COLOR|「Grineer 们……上工了！」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus 下达指令，Grineer 将手工的电锯提高了转速。我打开了厅门，一群感染者蜂拥而上，随即便在一面由刀刃组成的铜墙铁壁前一一倒下，五脏六腑在我们的脚边汇集堆叠。每当这些怪物撕裂一只工人，旋即就会有下一名 Grineer 补上。|OPEN_COLOR|「前进！」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus 大喊，Grineer 所组成的墙缓缓向前推进，所经之处满是内脏，成为了一道死亡之路。

最终我们抵达了在大厅尽头的飞机棚大门。我们做好了最坏的打算，另一头可能还有数以百计的敌人。Avantus 让 Grineer 有些时间去清理他们的工具并调整气息，接着她向我点点头，示意我解开门锁。大门开启时我们全体绷紧神经准备……什么都没有，没有任何感染者，硕大的停机库另一边仅停靠着一艘孤零零的船舰。我们卸下了心防，冲刺穿过广阔的机场。

在我们走近船舰的时候，Avantus 说，|OPEN_COLOR|「Bilsa，打开舱门。」|CLOSE_COLOR|然后低声补了一句，|OPEN_COLOR|「我会确保我们的旅途中没有任何访客来打扰。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我走向最近的控制台，Grineer 将我团团包围，以抵御可能的威胁。Avantus站立在船舰的入口，身旁有也有几名零星的工人在护卫着她。

|OPEN_COLOR|「更多感染者来了！」|CLOSE_COLOR|她指着朝我们的方向冲袭而来的一群感染者。|OPEN_COLOR|「Grinner，攻击他们，快上！」|CLOSE_COLOR|Avantus吼道。

然而 Grineer 却僵在那里，虽然他们的刀刃发出了轰隆隆的声音，但他们就只是待在原地而已。

这个举动激怒了 Avantus，她大声怒吼着，|OPEN_COLOR|「我说了上，立刻！」|CLOSE_COLOR|但是 Grineer 仍旧没有从舱门离开。

|OPEN_COLOR|「门开了！」|CLOSE_COLOR|我大喊着，就在我转身之际，那名最高大的 Grinner 将他的锯子狠狠送入 Avantus 脊椎的景象映入眼帘。金属锯入骨头所发出的高频率声响盖过了 Avantus 悽惨的尖叫声。她被击倒在地，珍珠白的长袍此刻被染成了鲜红色，那双死去的眼睛直直地瞪着我。

我动身逃跑，但脸上却被迎面痛击，膝盖也吃了一记。

模糊的视线中，那名高大的 Grineer 向我贴近，|OPEN_COLOR|「现在该由你来为我们效命了。开船吧！」|CLOSE_COLOR|

/Lotus/Language/SanctuaryResearch/Resear.text:
|OPEN_COLOR|“She's dead,”|CLOSE_COLOR| said Dax Menz, growing impatient.

|OPEN_COLOR|“No, she's not,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I knew it.

Our shuttle touched down in the ancient city center of New Uxmal for the second time in two days. We rushed to the entrance of the lower chambers, a labyrinth of tunnels carved into the rock. Behind us marched a full complement of bodyguards and Moas. 

Menz asked again, |OPEN_COLOR|“How can you be sure?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“We've been connected for a century and a half, I'm sure.”|CLOSE_COLOR| It felt odd to be speaking aloud about something that Remballa and I had always just kept between us. That feeling of attachment, that anxiety that welled up within one of us when the other wasn't right. That emptiness I felt when I thought they'd killed her and the joy when the connection came rushing back this morning.

We were twins bred for purpose, cloned and then modified so that we could both interface with the Lora Device. The Orokin had a visage imbued with variation, beauty and symmetry, but we had the Lora nodes protruding from our right temples. Their skin was silken, ours was weaved with ribbons of metallic facia that snaked around our bodies and into the Lora Device embedded in our palms. We made them uncomfortable and they made that known, that is, until they were sick or hurt and then we were saviors. That never bothered me though, I loved my sister and we had each other. I wasn't about to leave her in the middle of this nightmare.

Hesitation was building in Menz's face. I had command authority but if he balked, the soldiers would follow him. I needed to force his support, |OPEN_COLOR|“If you were Tenno, there'd be no question.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“The betrayers…”|CLOSE_COLOR| he stopped himself. |OPEN_COLOR|“Look, Remballa's gone. The Infested killed her yesterday, we both saw it.”|CLOSE_COLOR| His frustration was building, |OPEN_COLOR|“Damnit, this was supposed to be a relief mission, we can't-”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“It still is a relief mission.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I interrupted, |OPEN_COLOR|“You want to go back to retirement Menz, or are you still a Dax?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I knew that stung. 

Menz stiffened. He'd been cast aside before. He wasn't about to let duty slip through his fingers again. Menz stared into me, |OPEN_COLOR|“Are you willing to risk becoming one of those things for a feeling?”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

I nodded, the answer was yes, for this feeling.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Very well Lorist Ontella,”|CLOSE_COLOR| Menz turned to his squad. |OPEN_COLOR|“Ready up.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

We entered the subterranean passage, weapon lights illuminated chiseled red stone as we marched deeper into the blackness, past shops and apartments, all carved into the rock eons ago. This city was as old as Mars's atmosphere. Everything was silent, save for the occasional snap of bone under a soldier's boot. Three days ago this was a busy thoroughfare, now, bloodied scraps of clothing littered the route like confetti. We emerged from the tunnels into cavernous arcade, the Old Market Road. This is where she had led me.

|OPEN_COLOR|“We're close,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Here they come,”|CLOSE_COLOR| shouted Dax Menz and creatures began to drive at us from every door and window. All teeth and claws and eyes that looked looked so familiar, what kind of animal has eyes like that?

|OPEN_COLOR|“Square formation!”|CLOSE_COLOR| Menz commanded. We backed up to a wall and the Moa's moved to form a perimeter, with the bodyguards behind them and me in the middle. 

I closed my eyes and focused the device, through it I could feel each one of the bodyguards. A sergeant was slashed through the leg and I directed my energy toward him, his wound closed and he resumed fighting. Acid spit burned another soldier's chest, I pushed energy to her, eased the pain, then reversed the damage, she would live. This was so much harder without Remballa. Another soldier was bit on the throat, he's dying, there was nothing I could do, so I ease his pain and let him go. The rate of fire slowed, had we pushed them back?

I opened my eyes to see the Moa's beams incinerate the last few attackers. I was drained. I wasn't a combat Lorist, Remballa and I were relief workers, used in disasters and outbreaks, not this.

I felt a surge of that familiar connection, Remballa's energy pulsed through me. |OPEN_COLOR|“She's coming,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I shouted. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“What?”|CLOSE_COLOR| Dax Menz head whipped around to look at me.

|OPEN_COLOR|“I don't know,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said pointing at a hall exit, |OPEN_COLOR|“she's coming, from that direction.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“More Infested!”|CLOSE_COLOR| Shouted a soldier who motioned to the same exit. 

A mess of figures shambled forth. These were different, bigger and slower. I could feel my sister in there somehow, it was so strong. The Moas opened fire. I wanted to tell them to stop but how could I? I felt plasma beams burn the creatures and then I felt Remballa heal them. Why? Multiple connections now, I felt her many times over, it didn't make sense, until it did; she was those things, all of them. They took our fire and kept coming. I felt her, no them, shudder as bullets ripped through flesh and then as flesh was made new again. They were Lorist Infested, my sister the healer, remade as monster and here to kill us.

More rushed in. I felt the healing in them too. I focused just as the first wave broke through our lines. Moas were toppled, soldiers were tackled, teeth tore flesh. I was overwhelmed, I couldn't control it, their pain fed back through me and I collapsed. Something's jaws latched onto my foot. Infection pulsed into my veins.

And then I felt it, a new presence, another healer? I'd felt this before, was it, it couldn't be… I opened my eyes only to be blinded by an intense flash, followed by a crash, like a thousand crystal goblets all being shattered at once. All went silent, the Infested were dead. I felt nothing now.

My eyes readjusted. I was surrounded by bodies. I saw something run away, a streak of silver and gold. It shot straight up the cavern wall and out into the sunshine above. 

I didn't have time to think, I took a breath and a wave of pain surged through my entire body. The Infestation had already taken my leg, soon it would claim the rest of my body. I didn't care, my sister was gone, this was my time.

A shadow cast itself over me. I looked up. It was Menz, alive, he stared down without speaking and then unsheathed his massive combat blade and raised it high above his head.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Menz wait,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I mumbled, |OPEN_COLOR|“I'm sorry.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

With sudden and sure force his blade sliced down and through me. I contorted in with the pain. 

His hands grabbed my shoulders, |OPEN_COLOR|“Heal yourself!”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The adrenaline must have struck at that moment because I bolted up, still stunned, he had cut the infected leg clean off.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Damnit Ontella,”|CLOSE_COLOR| Menz was shaking me hard now. |OPEN_COLOR|“Heal yourself!”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

Instinct took over, I snapped into focus and sent all the energy I had left through the device and down to the wound. I stopped the bleeding and neutralized the remaining toxin. I nearly passed out, I had nothing left.

Menz hoisted me onto his shoulder, |OPEN_COLOR|“I'm taking us back to the shuttle,”|CLOSE_COLOR| and he began walk out of there. A few scattered survivors and robots pulled themselves along behind us. 

As we approached safety I coughed and whispered to Menz, |OPEN_COLOR|“I can feel her again.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“She's dead.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Yes, she is.”|CLOSE_COLOR|
/Lotus/Language/SanctuaryResearch/Resear.zhText:
|OPEN_COLOR|「她死了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|禁卫 Menz 不耐烦地说道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「不，她还没死。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我很确信。

我们的船近两天内在新乌斯马尔的古城中心着陆了两次。我们赶往下议院的入口，一个以岩石雕刻而成的迷宫。在后面跟随我们前进的是一整队的守卫及恐鸟。

Menz 又问了一次：|OPEN_COLOR|「你为什么能如此确定？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「我们已经连结在一起一个半世纪了，我很确定。」|CLOSE_COLOR|要将我与 Remballa 之间的秘密直接说出来的感觉十分奇怪。那种连结的感觉，当我俩有人状况不对时，另一人的心中就会涌现出这股焦虑。昨天我曾感受到一片空虚，因为我以为感染者杀了她，而今天早上与她连结的喜悦又回来了。

我们是被特意培育出的双胞胎，经由基因复制和修复使我们都能操作络析装置。奥罗金的人有着美丽且对称的多样脸孔，而我们的右侧太阳穴却有着络析装置的突点；他们的肌肤如丝绸般光滑，而我们身上却遍植了一条条的金属仪板、手掌中则嵌入了络析装置。我们的模样让奥罗金的人倍感不适，而他们也毫不隐瞒其厌恶之情，直到他们生病或受伤时才会认为我们是他们的救星。但这一切从未困扰过我，我深爱着我的孪生姊妹，而我们已拥有彼此。即便在这梦魇当中我也不会离她而去。

Menz 的脸上浮现犹豫，虽然我握有指挥权，但若他一旦犹豫，士兵们也将会随他而去。我需要逼迫他协助我：|OPEN_COLOR|「如果你是 Tenno，这就不成问题。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「那些背叛者……」|CLOSE_COLOR|他就此打住|OPEN_COLOR|「听着，Remballa 已经走了，感染者在昨天杀了她，我们都亲眼见到了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他的挫折感越来越重|OPEN_COLOR|「该死！这本来是个救援任务，我们不能——」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「这仍然是救援任务。」|CLOSE_COLOR| 我打断他，|OPEN_COLOR|「Menz，你是想退休回家，或者你还自认是名禁卫？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我知道这话非常刺人。

Menz 僵住了，过去他曾被人抛弃过，而这次他将不再让责任从他指缝间溜过。Menz 凝视着我：|OPEN_COLOR|「你真的愿意因为那股感觉，而冒着变成感染者的风险？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我点头，答案是肯定的，就为了这感觉。

|OPEN_COLOR|「很好，疗愈师 Ontella。」|CLOSE_COLOR|Menz 转向他的队伍：|OPEN_COLOR|「准备好。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我们进入了地下通道，随着我们一步步朝黑暗中前进，武器的光照亮了遥远的过去由红岩雕刻而成的商家与住宅的轮廓。这座城市几乎跟火星的大气一样古老。一切十分安静，仅能偶尔听到士兵们靴子踏碎骨骸的声响。在三天之前这里还是个繁忙的街道，而现在，染血的衣物碎布像纸屑般洒满整条通道。我们从隧道走出、进入了幽深的拱廊。这里是旧市场路，Remballa 曾带我来的地方。

|OPEN_COLOR|「我们很接近了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「它们来了！」|CLOSE_COLOR|禁卫 Menz 吼着， 大量生物从每一扇门窗后朝我们直冲而来。它们的指爪、牙齿与眼眸看起来是如此地熟悉，是什么样的生物会有着如此的眼神？

|OPEN_COLOR|「围成方阵！」|CLOSE_COLOR|Menz 下达命令。我们退到墙边并让恐鸟们形成一道外墙，守卫们则在恐鸟之后，将我们围在中间。

我闭上眼睛，全神贯注在络析装置上，经由这项装置我能感受到每一名守卫的状况。一名中士的腿被割开了，我立刻将我的能量传向他，他的伤口复元后便再次投身战斗。酸液喷溅在一名士兵的胸口上，我将能量导向她以减轻疼痛、消除伤害，让她得以存活。没有了 Remballa 让这一切更加困难。这时另一名士兵的喉咙被咬断、已经奄奄一息，我已无法再为他做些什么，仅能抑止他的疼痛让他获得安息。开火的频率渐缓，我们把它们逼退了吗？

我睁开双眼，看到恐鸟的光束烧毁了最后几名攻击者。我几乎耗尽了所有的力气。我并不是战斗用疗愈师，Remballa 与我是救援人员，我们的职务范围是处理疾病与疫情，不是应付刚刚这种场面。

我突然感觉到那股熟悉的连结，Remballa 的能量波导向我这里。|OPEN_COLOR|「她要来了！」|CLOSE_COLOR|我大喊。

|OPEN_COLOR|「你說什么？」|CLOSE_COLOR|禁卫 Menz 猛地转向我。

|OPEN_COLOR|「我不确定。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我指向大厅出口，|OPEN_COLOR|「从那个方向，她要来了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「是更多的感染者！」|CLOSE_COLOR|一名士兵指着同个出口大叫。

几名扭曲的身影一跛一跛地走了出来。这几个不一样，体型更大、移动更慢。不晓得为什么我知道 Remballa 就在其中。恐鸟们开始射击，我想要它们停火但却束手无策。我感觉到电浆在烧灼那些生物，然后感觉到 Remballa 在治疗它们。为什么？现在感觉变成了好几道，我一次又一次地感受到她。这没有道理，除非……她就是那些生物。它们承受着我们的炮火、不断地前进。当子弹削过它们的不断再生的血肉时，我感觉到 Remballa 在发抖。它们是疗愈师感染者，我的治疗者姊妹变成了怪物，要来杀了我们。

更多感染者扑了上来，我感觉到它们仍持续受到治疗。在我专注时第一波攻势已突破了我们的防线。恐鸟们倒下、士兵们被压倒，肉体被尖牙撕裂。我再也无法承受、无法控制，士兵的痛苦回流到我的身上，我几近崩溃。某种生物的下颚咬住了我的脚，感染毒素进入了我的血管中。

然后我感觉到另一个存在，还有其他治疗者？我以前有过这感觉……这是……这不可能……我睁开眼睛，却被一道强光闪到眩目，难以视物。接着传来一阵像是千支水晶高脚杯同时碎裂的巨响。最后一切终于回归沉静，感染者都死了，我现在什么都感应不到了。

直到我的眼睛重新适应，我才发现我的周围满是尸骸。我看见某样东西一闪而去，留下了一道银色与金色的痕迹。它直直飞上洞穴的墙壁，接着消失在阳光之中。

我没有多余的时间去思考，我吸了口气，一阵痛苦传遍了全身。我的腿已经遭到感染，很快就会遍及全身。我不太在意，我的姊妹死了……现在，轮到我了。

一道影子遮住了我，抬头一看，是 Menz，他还活着。他低头不语地看着我，接着拔出他的巨型战斗刀、高举过头——

|OPEN_COLOR|「Menz，等等」|CLOSE_COLOR|我低声道，|OPEN_COLOR|「抱歉，我……」|CLOSE_COLOR|

突然，他的刀刃切穿了我，我痛苦的卷曲成一团。

他紧抓我的肩膀，|OPEN_COLOR|「快治疗你自己！」|CLOSE_COLOR|

他切除了我受感染的腿，肾上腺素在这时发挥了作用，因为我在晕眩中仍直起了身子。

|OPEN_COLOR|「该死的，Ontella」|CLOSE_COLOR|Menz 更大力地摇晃我，|OPEN_COLOR|「快治疗你自己！」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我的本能取代了意识，我专注将所有剩下的能量通过装置传递到伤口上、止住了流血，也中和了残存的毒素。我差点晕了过去，我已经耗尽了所有的能量。

Menz 将我扛在他的肩上，|OPEN_COLOR|「我要带你回船上」|CLOSE_COLOR|，接着便步行离开。一部分生还者和机器人也跟在我们后面。

当我们抵达安全处时，我咳了几声、低声对 Menz 说道：|OPEN_COLOR|「我又感觉到她了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「她死了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「嗯，她死了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

They opened the chamber door just in time for me to see it happen; the Archimedean erupting into a flash, jade-like and blinding. I knew her. She was the greatest scholar of genetics who ever lived. Except now she was nothing but mist and gore.

A voice boomed from within, |OPEN_COLOR|“The Crewmen project is cancelled. Send in the next.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The rifles at my back tried to urge me inside. Old faces filled the dome's projections, immense and god-like. I walked into the center of the room and the scorched scent choked my lungs. All around me they watched, bored, as I knelt upon the darkened judgment disc.

The projection of Executor Ballas swelled large in front of me. I could see his purity, his symmetry, the beauty of his glittering gold irises. His voice thundered, |OPEN_COLOR|“The principles are clear. Your sentence is death. May the Void forgive you.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

As the judgment disc began to light I stood, took a deep breath and spoke, |OPEN_COLOR|“She will not forgive you.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Laughter broke out among the faces of the dome. Other's asked |OPEN_COLOR|“what did he say?”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas only smiled, |OPEN_COLOR|“You challenge us, Archimedean?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“I do. Kill me and the Empire you are sworn to uphold dies with me.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Ballas turned his head as the judgment disc went suddenly dark, |OPEN_COLOR|“An appeal comes at a price. Should you fail, you and your Corpus will pay dearly.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“They already suffer in this growing wasteland. They have already paid. Will you also sacrifice the royal futures by ignoring my solution?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Your solution is an abomination, like you, it will be annihilated.”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas motioned to a guard in the corner, |OPEN_COLOR|“Present the evidence.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

The chamber doors opened and a mass of guards entered, guns trained inward. As they reached the center, they parted, revealing a small cart. Atop the cart was a motionless creature, no larger than a hand. Its body was symmetrical, star-shaped with a seamless, matte-black shell.

A new projection, that of Executor Tuvul ballooned into the space, |OPEN_COLOR|“It looks harmless.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Harmless?”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas boomed in Tuvul's direction. He turned to the center of the dome, |OPEN_COLOR|“Show them.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

On command, the guards backed away from the cart and readied their weapons. Their leader took careful aim and fired a whisper round into the body of my creation. Two of the limbs tore off the frame revealing a glossy, gelatinous interior.

Silence gripped the dome as Tuvul shook his head. Then suddenly, the creature moved, convulsed, the hard surface started undulating. In a moment the wound closed and the thing was whole again. Beside it, another machine had grown from its severed parts. Their surfaces had changed, however - brighter, harder, resilient to whisper rounds now.

Ballas looked triumphant as voting lights began to appear on the judgment disc.

My green death was coming, so I roared at them, |OPEN_COLOR|“Did our ancestors, burned by fire, reject its power? No. They conquered their fear and learned to control it. The Seven Principles are a joke.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

His projection swooped down to me, |OPEN_COLOR|“The Orokin is the law and the law is the Orokin. We are unbending. Your appeal is denied.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Tuvul interrupted, |OPEN_COLOR|“Our laws are sacred but do not forget The Plan, Ballas.”|CLOSE_COLOR| His visage turned down to me, |OPEN_COLOR|“Countless other ventures have failed The Plan, how will this machine fulfill its design?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

I tried to catch my breath and speak, |OPEN_COLOR|“The crossing to the Tau system is perilous. Adaptation and replication are the only way a terraforming journey can be made. They will build an interstellar rail as they travel, they will adapt to the host planet and prepare it for our arrival. They will save you.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Tuvul peered down at me, |OPEN_COLOR|“And when it completes its task, what will prevent it from turning against us, as the Seven Principles say?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“The flaw.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Tuvul's eyes narrowed, |OPEN_COLOR|“The flaw?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“The Void is poison to them. Once they have reached Tau they will be marooned there. To travel the rail here would destroy them. Whatever the risks, the Origin system will be-”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Ballas shouted, |OPEN_COLOR|“Enough! Dereliction of the law threatens the entire empire. Which one of you will risk this?”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas was growing increasingly frustrated.

|OPEN_COLOR|“The empire is already at risk,”|CLOSE_COLOR| cried the shrill voice of another Executor, |OPEN_COLOR|“Or perhaps you haven't noticed from your cozy position on Mars.”|CLOSE_COLOR| To this there was a round of applause and the judgment disk remained unchanged.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Ballas, you lack consensus.”|CLOSE_COLOR| shouted Executor Tuvul.

His projection seemed to shrink smaller until he finally broke his silence, |OPEN_COLOR|“Archimedean Perintol, against my better judgment,”|CLOSE_COLOR| his disgust was palpable, |OPEN_COLOR|“Your appeal has been accepted. You are free to go.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

One by one the projections of each Executor in the Tribunal flickered off and the guards ushered me into the hall. There I stood, rapt with shock when I heard his footsteps behind me.

|OPEN_COLOR|“You did better than I thought you would,”|CLOSE_COLOR| it was Ballas, the man, not the projection. |OPEN_COLOR|“It would seem nobody truly knows they want a thing until you threaten to take it away.”|CLOSE_COLOR| He broke into a smile, |OPEN_COLOR|“Wouldn't you agree, Archimedean?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

他们打开舱门时，我正好撞见事情的发生：哲士在一道翡翠色般的刺眼光芒中迸裂。我认得她。她是有史以来最伟大的学者。但她现在不过只是一团血雾与肉屑。

舱门内响起一串话：|OPEN_COLOR|“船员计划取消。送下一个进来。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

抵着我背上的步枪催促我进到里面。一张张巨大而神圣的苍老面孔出现在穹顶的投影当中。我走到房间的正中间，烧焦的气味呛得我喘不过气。当我跪在变暗的审判台上时，周围的人只是无聊的看着。

执行者 Ballas 的投影在我面前放大。我能看到他的纯净、匀称和闪闪发亮的金色虹膜。他的声音如雷声般：|OPEN_COLOR|“原则很清楚。你的罪刑是死刑。愿虚空宽恕你。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

当审判台开始发亮时，我起身深吸了一口气，说道：|OPEN_COLOR|“她不会原谅你的。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

穹顶中的面孔投影之间爆出了笑声。一人问道：|OPEN_COLOR|“他说了什么？”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas 只是微微一笑，|OPEN_COLOR|“你这是在挑战我们，哲士？”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“没错。杀了我，而你所宣誓要守护的帝国将随我一同死去。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

在 Ballas 转过头时，审判台瞬间黯淡下来，|OPEN_COLOR|“上诉是有代价的。如果你败诉，你和你的 Corpus 将会付出沉重的代价。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“他们早已在不断扩大的荒地中受苦。他们早已付出了代价。而你愿意因为忽略我的解决方案而牺牲掉皇家的未来吗？”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“你的解决方案是受人痛恨的，就像你一样，它会被消灭。”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas 示意一名角落的守卫，|OPEN_COLOR|“把证据拿上来。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

舱门打开后，一群守卫进来，枪口一致朝里边指着。当他们到达中央后便散开，露出了一个小推车。 推车顶上是一个毫无动静的物体，大小和手差不多大。呈星形对称，有着无缝、雾面黑的外壳。

一个新的投影，执行者涂沃飘进场中，|OPEN_COLOR|“它看起来没什么危险。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“没什么危险？”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas 朝着涂沃的方向发声。他转向穹顶的中央，|OPEN_COLOR|“让他们看看。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

守卫按照命令从推车边退开，并准备好武器。守卫队长小心地瞄准，将一发多用途弹射进我的发明内。两根肢体被撕裂，露出了有胶状光泽的内部。

沉默笼罩了穹顶，当涂沃正摇头时。突然间那东西抽搐了起来，坚硬的表面开始像液体一样起伏不定。一瞬间伤口就闭合了，那东西又变回了完整状态。而它被子弹切开的部位上则长出了机械。它的表面已与先前不同——更亮、更坚硬，足以抵御多用途弹。

当审判台上的投票灯亮起时，Ballas 看起来十分得意。

我知道我的翠玉之死将至，因此我向他们吼道：|OPEN_COLOR|“难道我们的祖先被火所灼伤，就从此拒绝火的力量吗？不。他们克服了恐惧，并学会如何控制火焰。七大原则根本就是个笑话。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

我试着控制我的呼吸并说道：|OPEN_COLOR|“过境 Tau 星系是相当冒险的。唯有自我适应和复制能力才可能让地球化过程得以完成。它们会沿途修建星际轨道，它们会适应宿主星球，并为我们的到来做好准备。它们能拯救你们。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

涂沃低头注视着我，|OPEN_COLOR|“那么当它们完成任务，要如何保证它们不会攻击我们呢，根据七大原则？”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“瑕疵。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

涂沃瞇起了眼睛，|OPEN_COLOR|“瑕疵？”|CLOSE_COLOR|

 |OPEN_COLOR|“虚空对它们有害。一旦它们到达 Tau 星系就会被困在那里。它们想要使用轨道过来的话反而会毁灭自己。无论有何风险，始源星系都将——”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Ballas 喊道：|OPEN_COLOR|“够了！背弃法律将会威胁到整个帝国。你们有谁能冒这个风险？”|CLOSE_COLOR| Ballas 显得越来越受挫败。

|OPEN_COLOR|“整个帝国早已处在危险当中，”|CLOSE_COLOR|另一名执行者喊道，|OPEN_COLOR|“或许你在火星的舒适圈待太久而没有注意到。”|CLOSE_COLOR|接着响起一阵掌声，而审判台仍未有任何变动。

|OPEN_COLOR|“Ballas，你与我们缺乏共识。”|CLOSE_COLOR|执行者涂沃喊道。

他的投影看似逐渐缩小，直到他终于打破沉默，|OPEN_COLOR|“哲士佩林托，尽管我仍坚持己见，”|CLOSE_COLOR|他的厌恶之情溢于言表，|OPEN_COLOR|“你的上诉通过。你可以走了。”|CLOSE_COLOR|

法庭中的执行者投影一个接一个的闪烁消失，守卫则领着我进入大厅。当他的脚步声出现在我后面时，我吃惊地站在那里。

|OPEN_COLOR|“你的表现比我所预期的还要更好，”|CLOSE_COLOR|这男人是 Ballas，不是投影。|OPEN_COLOR|“看来人们只有在面临失去的威胁时，才会意识到自己真正想要的东西。”|CLOSE_COLOR|他突然微笑道：|OPEN_COLOR|“难道你不这么觉得吗，哲士？”|CLOSE_COLOR|
