|OPEN_COLOR|“Bilsa,”|CLOSE_COLOR| Alarez's voice pulsed out of my console, |OPEN_COLOR|“we're here to help but I need to get this straight; you're being held hostage by a…”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“... by a Grineer,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I whispered.

|OPEN_COLOR|“A Grineer?”|CLOSE_COLOR| his skepticism was palpable.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Yes, named Veytok.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“He has a name?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Won't let me call him by anything else,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I needed him to believe me but I could tell he was struggling. |OPEN_COLOR|“The other Grineer are different, they're still slow but they listen to him and do exactly what he says. It must be a mutation-”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Impossible,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I could tell he didn't believe me. |OPEN_COLOR|“Something like that would have been caught during production and destroyed, only the military Grineer are given-”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Should have been caught but wasn't,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I interrupted. |OPEN_COLOR|“Look, the only reason I'm still alive is the genetic lockouts. I'm Sectarus class, this ship's Cephalon listens to me exclusively. The Grineer need me. Stars, you have no idea what it's like living with these-”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Did you say Sectarus class?”|CLOSE_COLOR| now he was interested.

|OPEN_COLOR|“...everything is filthy,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I was rambling. |OPEN_COLOR|“They manufacture filth. My robes have gone from yellow to black. I'm so tired, I don't even feel Orokin anymore.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Did you say you're Sectarus class?”|CLOSE_COLOR| his voice betrayed his impatience.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Of course, aren't you?”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“We're going to initiate docking,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he said.

I looked out the viewscreen, the massive Executorial Frigate begins to pivot toward our tiny Runner. Its marblesque exterior was aglow in the light of the sun. How I missed those white hallways with their perfect golden trim, all busy with Orokin of high station discussing the business of Empire. I belonged on that ship, it was my birthright.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Stop,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I exclaimed in a half-shout, half-whisper, |OPEN_COLOR|“you don't understand, he's dangerous. We've been raiding other ships, gathering Grineer. Stars, I've done things.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I could feel the emotion and fear in my voice, |OPEN_COLOR|“I… I've helped him mass an army of sorts.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Right, a Grineer army,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he paused for a moment then took an audible breath, |OPEN_COLOR|“Bilsa listen, whatever you've done, you had no choice. You know what's happening in the system, there's an honor to be found in surviving,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he asked.

|OPEN_COLOR|“What do you mean; ‘what's happening in the system'?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I asked.

|OPEN_COLOR|“The Executors, the Council, they're all dead or missing, even most of the Sectarus is gone, you might be the last,”|CLOSE_COLOR| His voice was cracked. |OPEN_COLOR|“Do you understand? The system's falling apart but we can rebuild it.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

There was a thud outside the hull. Had they docked?

|OPEN_COLOR|“What about the Tenno?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“The betrayers?”|CLOSE_COLOR| he asked. |OPEN_COLOR|“Hopefully gone.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Wait,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I asked, |OPEN_COLOR|“are you saying your Executorial Frigate has no Sectarus class or Executor? How are you piloting?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

He ignored my question, |OPEN_COLOR|“We've docked. Hurry now, open the airlock doors so we can help you.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“It's too dangerous,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said, |OPEN_COLOR|“they're waiting for you. You'll be slaughtered.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Bilsa, you have no idea what's going on out here. Everything is in chaos. You're lucky we found you, nobody can be trusted but I can help. Open the airlock doors.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“I can't, if I open those doors they'll kill you all. Just talk to me for a while. It's been so long.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Bilsa,”|CLOSE_COLOR| his voice was getting louder. |OPEN_COLOR|“The Orokin are gone. The infrastructure, the rails, none of it works, it's all locked out,”|CLOSE_COLOR| was he actually berating me? |OPEN_COLOR|“The infestation is everywhere, riots...”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“...but they'll kill you-”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Alarez cut me off, |OPEN_COLOR|“The Moon is gone.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“You're not making sense Alarez,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Nothing makes sense anymore,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he shouted. |OPEN_COLOR|“Open those doors!”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Alarez?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“I'm sorry, it's just that we don't have much time,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he began to calm. |OPEN_COLOR|“Where is this Veytok now?”|CLOSE_COLOR| Asked Alarez.

|OPEN_COLOR|“All the Grineer are in the docking bay, it's impassable...”|CLOSE_COLOR| I paused and thought for a second, |OPEN_COLOR|“wait, there's a different way. The emergency hatch, you could extend a maintenance tunnel, come in through the top of the ship.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

|OPEN_COLOR|“And avoid the Grineer entirely. Now you're thinking like a Sectarus. Are you alone right now?”|CLOSE_COLOR| asked Alarez.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Yes. Since they saw your ship, it's like I don't even exist. When you get here, I'll try to seal them in the airlock remotely. That should hold them for a while, hurry.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

I took one last look at the now grimy bridge that had become my home. I stepped onto the compact elevator that connected the Runner's decks. At the top level was a systems room used to access the ship's many segments. I looked up at the hatch on the ceiling when I heard the couplers whiz into place. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Cephalon, execute now,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I called out.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Understood, Sectarus Bilsa,”|CLOSE_COLOR| replied the ship's Cephalon.

Moments later the hatch slid open. Dark eyes stared down at me from behind Dax's helmet mask. He said nothing.

I addressed him, |OPEN_COLOR|“Well met, Dax.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

Silently, the Dax scanned the room with his rifle before jumping down and taking position in front of me. In quick succession, three more guards fell in behind him. The guards were bloodied and battle-scarred, their equipment mismatched and worn. Alarez followed, his symmetry was off and his eyes were dull, was he even Enginus class?

|OPEN_COLOR|“Thank the stars you're here.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I reached out to greet him but the Dax grabbed me. 

|OPEN_COLOR|“Hold her down,”|CLOSE_COLOR| said Alarez. 

He pulled out a device which I recognized instantly as a genetic descrambler, where did he get that from? 

|OPEN_COLOR|“My apologies Bilsa, you seem sweet but I can't miss this chance,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he threw a switch on the descrambler. |OPEN_COLOR|“A sample of your genetic code is all I need for full access to the Executorial.”|CLOSE_COLOR| He pointed the descrambler at me. |OPEN_COLOR|“This won't hurt,”|CLOSE_COLOR|

My skin got instantly hot and then cooled again as waves of radiation passed through me, |OPEN_COLOR|“Look at you all,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said, |OPEN_COLOR|“you're just as tarnished as I. It's really over isn't it?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“The Empire? I'm afraid so,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he lowered the descrambler, |OPEN_COLOR|“There.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Will you kill me then?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I asked, my eyes fixed on the floor.

|OPEN_COLOR|“Can't have you outrank me,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he sighed. |OPEN_COLOR|“But first you'll command your Cephalon to cut off life support to the Grineer in the Runner's airlock.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

I looked up at him, |OPEN_COLOR|“I can't do that.”|CLOSE_COLOR| 

Alarez smiled, |OPEN_COLOR|“Of course you can.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“I wish I could but I already told the Cephalon to open the airlock. They're on your ship.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Confusion washed over Alarez's face just as a drop of blood fell from the hatch above and splashed on the Dax's helmet. His eyes darted up just in time to see Veytok's massive frame fall upon him, driving a machete deep into the Dax's chest. With that, the doors opened behind me as more Grineer flooded the tiny room, the guardsmen stood no chance.

Alarez, the only one left alive, stood frozen, |OPEN_COLOR|“Bilsa, what's going on?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“I warned you not to come,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said, |OPEN_COLOR|“I told you they would kill you all.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

He was beside himself, |OPEN_COLOR|“You're working with Grineer?”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Alarez, you were right, the system is a mess and I can't trust anyone, but these Grineer and I, we've come to an understanding.”|CLOSE_COLOR| I smiled as I got to my feet, |OPEN_COLOR|“But please, will you talk to me for just a while longer? These Grineer are so dull. Where are you from? I don't recognize your-”|CLOSE_COLOR|

Veytok grabbed Alarez and tore his throat open, his red splattering my robes.

|OPEN_COLOR|“I told you I wanted him alive,”|CLOSE_COLOR| I shouted.

|OPEN_COLOR|“No trust,”|CLOSE_COLOR| he said. His words sounded clearer every day. |OPEN_COLOR|“We have the Frigate and the lab. Don't need him.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|“Do you always have to kill them before I can visit?”|CLOSE_COLOR| I said.

Veytok grunted, |OPEN_COLOR|“You are Grineer now, don't need visits.”|CLOSE_COLOR|

我被困在这艘船上久到几乎忘了他那样身份的奥罗金一族该有的声音。我珍视他说的每个字句。

|OPEN_COLOR|「……一名 Grineer 族，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我低声叹着。

|OPEN_COLOR|「一名 Grineer 族？」|CLOSE_COLOR|他的怀疑相当明显。

|OPEN_COLOR|「是的，名为 Veytok。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「他有名字？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「甚至不让我用其他东西称呼他，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我需要让他相信我，但看得出来他对此相当挣扎。|OPEN_COLOR|「其他 Grineer 族人则不同，他们依旧迟缓，但他们听从他、照令行事。这一定是某种突变─」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「不可能，」|CLOSE_COLOR|看得出他不相信我。|OPEN_COLOR|「就像那种会早在生产期间找出并销毁的东西，只有军制 Grineer 士兵才会给予——」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「本该找到但没有，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我插话。|OPEN_COLOR|「听着，让我活到现在的唯一理由是那些基因锁。我是位 Sectarus，这艘船的中枢仅听令于我，毫无婉转余地。Grineer 需要我。众星啊，你根本不晓得活在这些…东西里头的感觉。这里……」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「你刚才提到了 Sectarus？」|CLOSE_COLOR|现在他提起兴趣了。

|OPEN_COLOR|「……藏污纳垢，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我漫不经心的离题。|OPEN_COLOR|「他们根本量产污秽。我的长袍甚至已经染黄转黑。我好累。我甚至再也不觉得自己是奥罗金了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「你刚才说你是 Sectarus？」|CLOSE_COLOR|他的语气透露出了不耐烦。

|OPEN_COLOR|「当然，难道你不是吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「我们即将开始接驳船坞。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他说道。

我看着观景窗外，巨大的执法护卫舰转向我们渺小的舰艇。在阳光衬映之下，其平整光亮的外观闪耀着光芒。我多么想念那些以金黄装潢完美修饰的白色门厅，却完全忙着与高阶奥罗金讨论经营帝国等琐事。我属于那艘船，那是我与生俱来的权利。

|OPEN_COLOR|「慢着，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我几乎是半吼半低语地呼喊着，|OPEN_COLOR|「你不了解，他很危险。我们曾洗劫其他船舰，集结 Gineer 一族。众星啊，我干过不少事。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我从自己的口气查觉到恐惧与激动的情绪，|OPEN_COLOR|「我……我曾帮助他集结一支军队之类的。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「是啊，一支 Grineer 军队，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他停顿半晌然后清楚地叹了一口气，|OPEN_COLOR|「听着 Bilsa，无论你曾作过什么，都不可能有机会。你知道太阳系里发生了什么，能够幸存到被发现已经是倍感荣幸了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他答道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「『太阳系里发生了什么』；这是什么意思？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我问道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「执行者，议会成员，他们全死了要不失踪了，甚至连大多数的 Sectarus 都走了，你多半是最后仅存的，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他声音嘶哑苦涩。|OPEN_COLOR|「你了解吗？太阳系正在分崩离析，但我们能重建它。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

这时船舰外传来一道撞击声。他们停入船坞了吗？

|OPEN_COLOR|「那 Tenno 怎么了？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「那群背叛者？」|CLOSE_COLOR|他回答|OPEN_COLOR|「好在全走了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「等等，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说道|OPEN_COLOR|「你之前不是提到你们的执法护卫舰没有 Sectarus 或执行者吗？你们怎么驾驶的？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

他无视我的疑问，|OPEN_COLOR|「我们入港了。快点，打开气阀门我们才帮的了你。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「这太危险了，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说道|OPEN_COLOR|「他们正等着你。你们会被屠宰的。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「Bilsa，你根本不晓得外面发生了什么事。到处一片混乱。你相当幸运让我发现了你，当今无人可信但我能帮上忙。开启气阀门。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「我做不到，如果我开了这些门他们就会杀掉你们所有人。再跟我多聊一会。已经太久了……」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「Bilsa，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他的声音逐渐转大。|OPEN_COLOR|「奥罗金已经完了。基础设施，轨道，没一个能运作，它们全锁死了，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他这是在指责我吗？|OPEN_COLOR|「到处都是感染者，暴动……」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「……但他们会杀了你——」|CLOSE_COLOR|

Alarez 打断了我，|OPEN_COLOR|「月球不见了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「这一点都没道理 Alarez，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「一切都再也没道理了，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他咆啸道。|OPEN_COLOR|「开门！」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「Alarez？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「我很抱歉，只是我们没有多少时间了，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他开始冷静下来。|OPEN_COLOR|「那这个 Veytok 现在在哪？」|CLOSE_COLOR|Alarez 问道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「所有的 Grineer 都在泊船湾，无路可走……」|CLOSE_COLOR|我停顿想了一下，|OPEN_COLOR|「等一下，还有另一条路。紧急舱门，你可以沿着维修通道，来到船的正上方。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「并且完全避开 Grineer。你总算像个 Sectarus 在思考了。你现在只有一个人吗？」|CLOSE_COLOR|Alarez 问道。

|OPEN_COLOR|「是的。自从他们看到你的船后，现在仿佛当我不曾存在似的。当你抵达之后，我会遥控并尽可能地把他们封在空气阀里。那应该能阻挡他们一段时间，快点。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我看了最后一眼那曾经是我家但现下肮脏不已的舰桥。我踏上链接至舰艇甲板的简洁电梯。在最上层的是用来访问船舰各个区段的系统室。当听到链接器就位的声响时，我抬头看着天花板上的舱门。

|OPEN_COLOR|「中枢，立即执行。」|CLOSE_COLOR| 我大声喊着。

|OPEN_COLOR|「了解，Sectarus Bilsa。」|CLOSE_COLOR|船舰的中枢回应着。

许几过后舱门滑开，一对来自禁卫头盔面罩之后的漆黑双眼往下瞪视着我。箴口不语。

我向他致意，|OPEN_COLOR|「很荣幸遇见你，禁卫。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

沉默着，禁卫在跳下之前以手上的步枪扫描整个房间随后在我身前就位致意。紧接着三名卫兵快速落在他的身后。这些浴血的卫兵全身充至着战痕，他们的装备错配而磨损。Alarez 随后跟上，他的调和感不再而眼神阴暗，他还算是个 Enginus 吗？

|OPEN_COLOR|「感谢众星啊您在这。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我试图伸手致意，但禁卫抓住了我。

|OPEN_COLOR|「压制她。」|CLOSE_COLOR|Alarez 下令。

他拿出一具仪器而我随即认出那是个基因解码装置，他是从哪拿到的？

|OPEN_COLOR|「倍感抱歉，Bilsa，你似乎人畜无害，但我不能错过这次机会。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他启动了解码装置的开关。|OPEN_COLOR|「我仅需要一份你的基因样本来取得访问执法舰的权限。」|CLOSE_COLOR|他将解码装置的枪头指向我，|OPEN_COLOR|「这，不会痛，」|CLOSE_COLOR|

我的皮肤瞬间灼热然后在数道辐射波穿过我后再度冷却，|OPEN_COLOR|「看看你们，」|CLOSE_COLOR|我说道|OPEN_COLOR|「你们就跟我一般的污秽、黯淡。一切真的都结束了，是吧？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「帝国？恐怕是的，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他放低了解码装置的枪头。|OPEN_COLOR|「好了。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「然后你接着要杀了我？」|CLOSE_COLOR|我问道，双眼紧钉着地面。

|OPEN_COLOR|「可不能让你居于我之上啊，」|CLOSE_COLOR|他叹道。|OPEN_COLOR|「但首先你将会命令你的中枢终止供给舰艇气阀室里的 Grineer 氧气的维生装置。」|CLOSE_COLOR|

就在困惑扫过 Alarez 的脸上时，一摊血从舱门上方洒落并溅在禁卫的头盔。他的视线急转向上仅来得急看到 Veytok 那壮硕的体格落在他身上，并运使一把砍刀深深斩进禁卫的胸口。同时，我身后开启的门则有更多的 Grineer 涌进这狭小的房间，守卫毫无反击机会。

他激动到失控地喊道，|OPEN_COLOR|「你居然和 Grineer 一伙？」|CLOSE_COLOR|

|OPEN_COLOR|「Alarez，你说的对，太阳系乱成一团而我不能相信任何人，但这些 Grineer 和我，我们达成了协议。」|CLOSE_COLOR|我微笑着爬了起身，|OPEN_COLOR|「但是拜托，你可以再跟我聊久一点吗？这些 Grineer 太无趣了。你是从哪边来的？我认不出你的——」|CLOSE_COLOR|

Veytok 抓住 Alarez 并撕开他的喉咙，他的鲜红溅上了我的长袍。

/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/RequiemRel.text:
|PLAYER_NAME|,

Thanks to your ongoing research into the enigmatic Void, I have discovered a previously unknown form of Relic.

Requiem Eterna Relics have the potential to yield any one of the standard Requiem Mods.

Palladino is the new custodian of the original Requiem Relics, should you require any.

In the meantime, I am sending you eight Requiem Eterna Relics, so that you may begin your studies in earnest.

-|LOTUS_NAME|
/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/RequiemRel.zhText:
|PLAYER_NAME|，

感谢你对神秘虚空的持续研究，我发现了一种此前未知的遗物。

安魂永恒遗物可能会带来任意一种标准安魂 Mod。

如果你有需要，Palladino 是原版安魂遗物的新保管人。

同时，我给你送了这八个安魂永恒遗物，这样你就可以正式开始研究了。

- |LOTUS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.text: Venture into Follie's Hunt or complete Nightmare missions to earn Nightmare Tatters. Zorba will use these to recreate Follie's Shadowgraph.
/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.zhText: 进入 Follie 的狩猎或者完成噩梦任务，来获得噩梦残片。左巴将使用这些残片重现 Follie 的绘影图。

/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.text:
Tenno,

I can barely believe it. It worked. The Nightmare Tatters you collected have come together to create something amazing, a copy of Follie's Shadowgraph right here in the relay. 

Now everyone can see it, and I can commune with it every day. Just like my master did.

And the best part? It can't hurt anybody. 

I can't thank you enough, but I did make a copy for you too. Display it with pride.

Aspirant Zorba
/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.zhText:
Tenno，

我简直不敢相信。成功了。你收集的噩梦残片汇聚在一起，创造出了一件令人惊叹的东西——Follie 的绘影图摹本，就在中继站里。 

现在大家都能看到它，我也能每天与它交流。就像我的导师当年那样。

最棒的是？它不会伤害任何人。

我实在感激不尽，不过我也为你制作了一份摹本。请自豪地展示它吧。

见习仲裁者左巴
《行动代号：墨痕》：完成！

/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.text:
Tenno,

I can't go to the wreck of Vesper Relay, it's too dangerous for a mere aspirant like me, but I want… no, I need to see Follie's Shadowgraph again. 

To make that happen, I need Nightmare Tatters. Find them on Vesper Relay and also in what you call Nightmare missions. These shreds are remnants of Follie's art. I think if we collect enough of those, we can reproduce a copy of her work right here in the relay. Then everyone can safely see it.

Will you help me do that?

Aspirant Zorba
/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.zhText:
Tenno，

我无法前往 Vesper 中继站的残骸，对于像我这样的见习生来说那里太危险了，但我想要……不，我必须再次见到 Follie 的绘影图。 

要实现这个愿望，我需要噩梦残片。你可以在 Vesper 中继站，以及所谓的"噩梦任务"中找到它们。这些残片是 Follie 作品的残片。我想如果我们收集到足够多的残片，就能在这里的中继站重现她的作品。那样大家就能安全地欣赏它了。

你能帮我实现这个愿望吗？

见习仲裁者左巴
行动代号：墨痕
行动代号：墨痕

/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.text:
Revered Tenno,

My mentor, Arbiter Kozai, is gone. They tell me he is dead, but I reject these lies. Kozai faced down the Wolf of Saturn Six alone! Such a man does not just perish like a dog.

You must think this strange, but I beg you: travel to the wreckage of Vesper Relay. There we will search for the Truth.

Aspirant Zorba
/Lotus/Language/Shadowgrapher/Shadowgrap.zhText:
尊敬的 Tenno，

我的导师——均衡仲裁者科扎伊，已经不在了。世人宣称他已死亡，但我拒绝接受这些谎言。科扎伊曾独自一人对抗土星六号之狼！这样的人绝不会像条狗一般轻易死去。

你一定觉得这很奇怪，但我恳请你：前往 Vesper 中继站的残骸。我们将在那里寻找真相。

见习仲裁者左巴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BallasSt.text: Stripped of its formidable power this trophy of your victory over Ballas and his Narmer forces is a prized decoration for your ship.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BallasSt.zhText: 被剥夺了其强大力量，这个珍贵的飞船装饰代表着你战胜 Ballas 和他的合一众军队的精彩时刻。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BallasSw.text: An ornate sheath for the Paracesis.

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaroKiTe.text: From Baro Ki'Teer: an exquisite ornament of unknown provenance to enhance your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaroKiTe.zhText: 来自 Baro Ki'Teer：一件来源不明的精致饰物，来提升你的轨道飞行器格调。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaroPlan.text: For your viewing pleasure, a curious fungal lifeform encased in zero gravity.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaroPlan.zhText: 为供人观赏，这是一种处于零重力环境中的奇特真菌生命体。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaroShel.text: Showcase your treasures with pride on this stylish pedestal.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaroShel.zhText: 你可以在这个时尚的底座上自豪地展示宝物。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaruukPa.text: Bestow the serenity of Baruuk’s meditative energy mandala upon your orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BaruukPa.zhText: 将 Baruuk 冥想能量曼陀罗的宁静赐予你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BekranZa.text: A replica of the very mop and bucket Bekran Zaft was holding when she witnessed the transmutation of the remains of Archimedean Javi by Lavos. As detailed by Drusus Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/BekranZa.zhText: 这是贝克兰·扎夫特在她目睹 Lavos 对哲士哈维的遗体进行转化时，拿着拖把和水桶的复制品。德枢·莱弗对此有过详细描述。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Conquest.text: An ornament awarded only to the most dedicated of researchers. Said by some to be representative of the eye of an ancient deity, sacrificed in return for wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Conquest.zhText: 只有最敬业的研究者才能获得的饰物。有人说，它代表了古代神灵的眼睛，为换取智慧而牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/CorpusCr.text: A collection of poses for Corpus Crewmen.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/CorpusCr.zhText: 一组 Corpus 船员的动作。
Corpus 船员反应动作组合

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/CorpusSh.text: Industrialize your Orbiter’s interior with these salvaged decorative pieces.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/CorpusSh.zhText: 通过这些回收的装饰物来为你的轨道飞行器内部带来工业化风格。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/CrewmanA.text: A posable, scale model of the Corpus footsoldiers.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/CrewmanA.zhText: 一个可活动的 Corpus 船员比例模型。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Cryobell.text: A mysterious glacial bell, awarded to commemorate defiance in the face of adversity.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Cryobell.zhText: 一只神秘的冰霜之铃，为了纪念身处逆境仍不屈抗争的意志。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Cyte09Ex.text: Long before the Orokin Era, there was a sharpshooter who would become legend. This decoration honors Cyte-09's Protoframe, Quincy.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Cyte09Ex.zhText: 早在奥罗金时代之前，就有一位日后成为传奇的神枪手。这个装饰是为了纪念 Cyte-09 的原型战甲——昆西。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DeerPlus.text: "You will always have a home here, Tagfer. With us." - Loid
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DeerPlus.zhText: "标弃，这里永远是你的家，和我们在一起。"——洛德

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DeimosHa.text: Handcrafted by Grandmother, this macabre ornament tells a special story for Naberus Night. Get comfortable and listen...
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DeimosHa.zhText: 由"祖母"亲手制作，这款令人毛骨悚然的饰物讲述了一个有关纳贝流士之夜的特殊故事。找个舒服的姿势，然后听它慢慢道来……

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DogDays2.text: Give your dirty floors Hell and your Orbiter some hardcore edge.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DogDays2.zhText: 让你的脏地板见识地狱般的清洁，为你的轨道飞行器增添硬核风格。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DogDays2.text: We've got two words for ya: Soak it!
Ride the waves with Yareli. Beverage not included.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DogDays2.zhText: 和 Yareli 一起乘风破浪。饮料不包含在内。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DomsFina.text: A claret with notes of golden sunlight. The Leverian’s history of the Warframe Ash brings into question whether blood runs thicker than fine wine.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DomsFina.zhText: 散发着金色阳光气息的红葡萄酒。Ash 在莱弗博物馆的历史不由让人质疑鲜血是否比红酒更加浓郁。
德纳斯的陈年红葡萄酒

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriAb.text: An ingenious device for arithmetic. Used to keep track of a shopkeeper’s sales, a kingdom’s wealth, or the seemingly endless spiral of time.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriAb.zhText: 一个精巧的算术装置。用来记录店主的销售、王境的财富，或者看似无穷无尽的时间螺旋。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriBi.text: Duviri citizens are expected to keep clean at all times, in case Thrax’s gaze should fall upon them.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriBi.zhText: 双衍王境的公民必须时刻保持干净，以防士魂大帝的目光落在他们身上。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriBo.text: An instructive storybook by Euleria Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriBo.zhText: 由欧拉瑞娅·英择谛写的一本具有教育意义的故事书。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCe.text: A replica of the cryptic monument that overshadows the many graves of Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCe.zhText: 掩盖双衍王境众多坟墓的神秘墓碑复制品。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCh.text: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine's performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCh.zhText: 非常适合欣赏蓬蓬士君的表演。有缓冲，以避免久坐的麻木不适。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCh.text: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCh.zhText: 如果双衍王境的民选政府真实存在，那么一定用的是这种风格的座椅。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCo.text: An ornate display, created by Sillfix.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriCo.zhText: 一张华丽的展示图，由 Sillfix 创作。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriDr.text: An elegant depiction of the fabled Orowyrm.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriDr.zhText: 优雅地描绘了传说中的奥金魇龙。
奥金魇龙的圣所展示图

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriHa.text: Standard fodder for the Kaithes of Duviri, doubling as a humble bed for the weary laborer.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriHa.zhText: 双衍王境里绝灵骥的标准饲料，同时也是疲惫工人的简陋床铺。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriIn.text: Even the lowest Duviri citizen may need to reach a high spot from time to time.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriIn.zhText: 即使是最底层的双衍王境公民，时不时也需要到达一些高度。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriIn.text: A sturdy table on which to enjoy the nutritious dole of simple grains which Thrax’s generosity has blessed you with.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriIn.zhText: 一张坚固的桌子，在上面你可以享受由士魂大帝慷慨赐予的营养丰富的简单谷物。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriPo.text: Ideal for lecturing, preaching, or reading magnificent poetic compositions to a crowd who does not understand or appreciate them.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriPo.zhText: 是向不理解或不懂得欣赏的凡夫俗子们演讲、布教或诵读宏伟的诗歌作品的理想选择。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriPu.text: The Watchful Paragrimm chooses to watch over those with keen minds.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriPu.zhText: 警惕的幽幽鹰选择守望那些思维敏锐的人。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriSc.text: Used to weigh out meager, everyday goods by meager, everyday merchants.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriSc.zhText: 用来给普通商人称量微不足道的日常物品。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriSi.text: For those times when turning into an Orowyrm is not an option.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriSi.zhText: 适用于无法变成奥金魇龙的时候。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriSt.text: Thrax has, grudgingly, allowed his citizens the use of these screens for the preservation of personal modesty. There are some places where even his exalted eyes have no business peering.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriSt.zhText: 士魂大帝勉强允许他的公民使用这些屏风来维护个人的隐私。有些地方即使是他那双尊贵的眼睛也无权窥视。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriTa.text: Draft and redraft endless bureaucratic scrolls with this fine Duviri desk.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/DuviriTa.zhText: 用这张精美的双衍王境书桌，反复起草没完没了的官僚文书。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EliteAle.text: In Arbitrations, where death’s shadow looms, life’s fire burns brightest. This light sculpture is a tribute to that survival.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EliteAle.zhText: 在仲裁之中，死亡阴影隐现之处，生命之火燃得最旺。这座光的雕塑致敬了那种求生的精神。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EntratiT.text: A decorative replica of an Entrati family token.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EntratiT.zhText: 一件英择谛家族石印的装饰性复制品。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EraHypno.text: Erra's gaze brings his hypnotic message.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EraHypno.zhText: Erra 的目光带来了他的催眠信息。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/ErraBobb.text: A small wobbly statue of Erra.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/ErraBobb.zhText: 一小座 Erra 摇头娃娃。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EvilBaro.text: These eerie lights are suspended above the ground by no perceptible means.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/EvilBaro.zhText: 这些怪异的烛光以难以察觉的方式悬浮着。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.text: A posable, scale model of your favorite Warframe!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.zhText: 一个你最喜爱的战甲的可摆姿势的比例模型！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.text: [PH] Description of Excalibur Exalated Blade FX
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.zhText: [PH] Description of Excalibur Exalated Blade FX

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.text: [PH] Description of Excalibur Radial Blind FX
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.zhText: [PH] Description of Excalibur Radial Blind FX

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.text: [PH] Description of Excalibur Radial Javelin FX
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.zhText: [PH] Description of Excalibur Radial Javelin FX

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.text: [PH] Description of Excalibur Slash Dash FX
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Excalibu.zhText: [PH] Description of Excalibur Slash Dash FX

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Explorat.text: Decorate your Orbiter with this Empyrean-themed poster.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Explorat.zhText: 用九重天主题的海报装饰你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Explosio.text: An Explosion Decoration to place in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Explosio.zhText: 一个可放置于轨道飞行器上的爆炸装饰。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FamilyPo.text: A family portrait found on a shelf in a familiar Zariman cabin, it may stir memories.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FamilyPo.zhText: 在一个熟悉的「扎里曼号」船舱架子上发现的一张全家福，它可能会勾起一些回忆。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FishPlus.text: "Biped, you clearly crave the companionship of your intellectual superior. How laudable." - Fibonacci
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FishPlus.zhText: "两脚兽，你显然渴望与智力高于你的人为伴。多么值得称赞啊。"——斐波那契

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FlappyZe.text: An object that serves as proof of your mastery of the winds.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FlappyZe.zhText: 一个证明你掌握了风之力的物品。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FollieBa.text: Bring Follie's Hunt home with this inky balloon.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FollieBa.zhText: 使用这款墨色气球解锁 Follie 的狩猎吧。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FrameFig.text: You traveled the world and collected all the data, this is your prize.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FrameFig.zhText: 你踏遍了世界并且收集了所有数据，这是你的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FusionTr.text: Struck to commemorate the Entrati family's power and prestige, as well as safeguarding their memories of one another. Many things changed in the years that followed, and that which had once shone brightly grew dark and dim. But even a single Ayatan Star may make all the difference.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FusionTr.zhText: 这尊雕像之所以被打造出来，不仅是为了纪念英择谛家族的实力与威望，同时也是为了保存家族成员之间的珍贵记忆。时过境迁，曾今闪耀的雕像现已变得暗淡无光。但只要插上一颗阿耶檀识星，它就会变得截然不同。
阿耶檀识 Kitha 塑像

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FusionTr.text: Some sort of fancy Orokin wizbang that Nightcap found buried in the Deepmines.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FusionTr.zhText: 夜帽在深矿中发现的某种奇特的 奥罗金花哨装置。
阿耶檀识 Chattraka 塑像

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FusionTr.text: This kinetic Orokin sculpture springs to life when filled with Ayatan Stars. It may also be a source of Endo.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/FusionTr.zhText: 当这座带有活动机关的奥罗金塑像填满阿耶檀识之星时，它便会开始自主运动。此外，它也能作为内融核心的来源。
阿耶檀识 Hemakara 塑像

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Gamifica.text: Given to those who complete the TennoCon 2019 game activity.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Gamifica.zhText: 完成 TennoCon 2019 游戏活动的玩家所得到的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GarvLatr.text: Together for the first time in this dynamic poster, the original bad dudes of Deimos, Garv & Latrox.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GarvLatr.zhText: 在这张动态海报中，火卫二上的纯种恶棍加弗 & 拉托罗首次合体。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GaussTow.text: A model Grav Lifter Factory, inspired by Yareli and her battle with the slave driver Vulgran, to save the children forced to work there. A story told in the first Waverider Graphica.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GaussTow.zhText: 一个反重力提升器工厂的模型，灵感来自 Yareli 为了拯救被迫在工厂里劳动的儿童而与奴隶主武戈兰战斗。第一篇刊登在驭浪者漫画图像的故事。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Glassmak.text: Nihil, the once-feared Orokin Glassmaker, now imprisoned for eternity in this tiny bottle. Handle with care.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Glassmak.zhText: 无刹，曾经令人恐惧的奥罗金玻璃匠，现在被永远囚禁在这个小瓶子里。小心轻放。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GlyphPic.text: Proudly display glyph images around the ship. Choose from any unlocked glyph image.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GlyphPic.zhText: 自豪地在飞船中展示浮印图像。可以从任意已解锁的浮印中选择。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GrendelO.text: Own the very dishware that the Orokin Executor Karishh ate his final meal from, before becoming a meal himself. As chronicled by Drusus Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GrendelO.zhText: 拥有这个奥罗金执行者卡瑞什在自己成为一顿饭之前，享用最后一餐的餐具吧。正如德枢·莱弗所记录的。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GrineerA.text: A posable, scale model of Grineer footsoldiers.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GrineerA.zhText: 一个可活动的 Grineer 步兵比例模型。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GrineerP.text: A collection of poses for Grineer footsoldiers.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GrineerP.zhText: 一组 Grineer 步兵的动作。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Guardsma.text: [PH] A posable, scale model of the Grineer Guardsman
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Guardsma.zhText: [PH] A posable, scale model of the Grineer Guardsman

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GyrePuls.text: Gyre will feel right at home with this decoration on display.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/GyrePuls.zhText: Gyre 将在展示这款装饰时感到像在家一样自在。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Hallowee.text: You can almost feel the beast growling, beckoning you closer. Place it in a spot of honor, settle in, and listen to the story its gaze seems ready to tell.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Hallowee.zhText: 你几乎能感觉到那野兽在咆哮，在召唤你走近。把它放在一个荣誉之地，静坐下来，聆听它目光中准备诉说的故事。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HarrowQu.text: Rell used the Donda's soothing motion and hum to bring focus to his mind. This is a sacred object for the Red Veil.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HarrowQu.zhText: Rell 使用 Donda 的舒缓运动和嗡嗡声来集中精神。这是血色面纱的一个神圣物件。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HeartOfD.text: The Entrati family harmonize in a rare moment of unity in this Orbiter decoration.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HeartOfD.zhText: 这个轨道飞行器装饰记录了英择谛家族齐聚一堂的罕见时刻。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HeartOro.text: Celebrate Pride with this heart-shaped ornament.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HeartOro.zhText: 通过这个心形装饰来庆祝骄傲月。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: With the head of an Infested Charger mounted at the front of your craft, you’ll make an instant impression on your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 用疾冲者的头颅装饰你的登陆艇，给你的敌人留下刻骨铭心的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Charger Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 疾冲者船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Ominous hands grace your Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 不祥之手为你的登陆艇增色。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Manus Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 邪手船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: This Sumdali hull ornament is awarded exclusively to Tenno who have earned the rank of True Master.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 这款船徽装饰是专门授予获得了至崇宗师段位的 Tenno 的。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: True Master Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 至崇宗师船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Madurai cloud.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 通过 Madurai 之云装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Madurai Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: Madurai 船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Display this stylish Lander hull ornament proudly.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 自豪地展示这款时尚的着陆器船徽装饰。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Tusker Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 象牙胡船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Naramon tree.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 通过 Naramon 之树装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Naramon Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: Naramon 船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Lead the charge with this chivalrous sumdali.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 装备这枚骑士风范的船徽，冲锋在前。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Chivaler Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 骑士精神船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Bestowed in commemoration of exceptional battlefield achievement. Purged of any malicious code.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 为表彰卓越的战场功绩而授予。已清除所有恶意代码。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Mentor Ayatan Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 导师阿耶檀识船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: A broken shard of Praghasa, splintered from her body and now adorning your landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 「布拉喀萨」身上脱落下来的一块碎片，如今装饰着你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Khadati Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 嚼食船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Proclaim to the cosmos that you bear the mark of death.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 向宇宙宣告你身上带着死亡的印记。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Stalker's Mark Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 追猎者印记船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Unairu mountains.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 通过 Unairu 之山装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Unairu Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: Unairu 船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Vazarin wave.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 通过 Vazarin 之浪装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Vazarin Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: Vazarin 船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Now the Landing Craft is changed, reborn through the energy of the Janus Key.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 现在登陆艇已经改变，通过雅努斯之钥的能量重生。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Janus Key Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 雅努斯之钥船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Adorn your Landing Craft with the Zenurik crystal.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: 通过 Zenurik 之晶装饰你的登陆艇。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.text: Zenurik Sumdali
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HoodOrna.zhText: Zenurik 船徽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HulaGirl.text: An ancient relic found in the ruins of Earth.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/HulaGirl.zhText: 在地球的遗迹中找到的古老纪念品。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/InarosCo.text: Inaros feels welcome in any space that displays this protective sarcophagus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/InarosCo.zhText: Inaros 在任何展示这种保护性石棺的空间里都会感到宾至如归。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/IndexAut.text: An autographed photo of the Employee of the Month, at Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/IndexAut.zhText: 安尤企业的一张本月最佳员工的签名照片。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/IndexChi.zhText: 由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。
由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。
由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。
由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。
由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。
由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。
由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。
由 Neewa 所绘制的图像。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Infestat.text: Invite one of Nidus Prime's gilded maggots to roam your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Infestat.zhText: 邀请一只 Nidus Prime 的镀金蛆虫在你的轨道飞行器中漫游。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Infestat.text: Adopt one of Nidus' adorable maggots to wriggle around your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Infestat.zhText: 收养一只来自 Nidus 的可爱蛆虫在你的轨道飞行器中蠕动。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/IvaraLev.text: A replica of the archive that held "The Secret History of the Orokin Court," by the historian Porvis. Notably containing the telling of Ivara and the Myrmidon.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/IvaraLev.zhText: 保存着由历史学家珀维斯撰写的《奥罗金宫廷秘史》的档案副本。值得注意的是，其中包含了 Ivara 和密尔弥多的故事。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JS2Hunho.text: Reality is merely a point of view in this lenticular display illustrating the conflict between what is and what could have been.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JS2Hunho.zhText: 在这个变图展示图中，现实仅仅是一种视角，它展现了现实与可能之间的冲突。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JS2MAshP.text: Many problems can be solved by the ability to be in two places at once. Many other problems are created this way. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JS2MAshP.zhText: 如果能同时身处两地，许多问题便迎刃而解。但这种能力同时也带来了许多其他问题。微弱的艾弗旺痕迹暗示，这位艺术家可能有一只机械手。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JS2MGaru.text: For the expression of extremely normal and measured feelings toward the object of your affection. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JS2MGaru.zhText: 用于表达对心上人那种极其平常且克制的感情。微弱的艾弗旺痕迹暗示，这位艺术家可能有一只机械手。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeEyes.text: Be not afraid with Jade's gaze in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeEyes.zhText: 不必害怕 Jade 在轨道飞行器中注视的目光。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeMemo.text: Feathers of memory, lovingly collected. The gift of self, immortalized in motes of steadfast light.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeMemo.zhText: 记忆之羽，悉心珍藏。献予自己的礼物，化作永恒的微光，永垂不朽。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.text: This display celebrates the best of both worlds, and the worst of each. United or divided, they are two sides of the same whole.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.zhText: 这个展示图既展现了两种文化的优点，也揭露了它们的缺点。无论团结还是分裂，它们都是同一个整体的两面。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.text: This display honors Orion, the burning heart. Schooled in vengeance, the only love he knows is death.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.zhText: 这个展示图是为了纪念 Orion，他拥有一颗燃烧的心。他从小就被复仇所熏陶，他唯一懂得的爱就是死亡。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.text: This display honors Sirius, the lonely star. Raised in shadow. Trained with dignity.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.zhText: 这个展示图在致敬 Sirius，一颗孤独的星。他在阴影中成长，在尊严中成长。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.text: A portrait of the Stalker forging his lonely path.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.zhText: 追猎者孤独地踏上征程的肖像。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.text: An embrace of lovers, divided by war.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.zhText: 紧密相拥的恋人，他们在战争中被拆散。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.text: A portrait of the Stalker: once a dark avenger, now a devoted father.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JadeShad.zhText: 追猎者的肖像：曾是黑暗的复仇者，现在是一位尽职的父亲。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JavisExp.text: Become a student of Javi. This evolution scrawling is based on Drusus Leverian's records of Lavos.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JavisExp.zhText: 成为哈维的学生。这张进化涂鸦源于德枢·莱弗对 Lavos 的记录。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JavisExp.text: Become a student of Javi. This Ophiuchus scrawling is based on Drusus Leverian's records of Lavos
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JavisExp.zhText: 成为哈维的学生。这张蛇夫座涂鸦源于德枢·莱弗对 Lavos 的记录

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JavisExp.text: Become a student of Javi. This luminosity scrawling is based on Drusus Leverian's records of Lavos.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/JavisExp.zhText: 成为哈维的学生。这张光度涂鸦源于德枢·莱弗对 Lavos 的记录。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KavatBus.text: A sculpture to imbue your Orbiter with the grace and beauty of the Kavat.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KavatBus.zhText: 这个雕塑可为你的轨道飞行器注入库娃的优美和美妙之姿。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KhutKhut.zhText: [PH] Description of Khut Khut Aquarium Fish

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KineticS.text: A decoration representing the specialized trap for capturing synthesis targets.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KineticS.zhText: 一个代表捕获结合仪式目标的特殊陷阱的装饰。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KoumeiSh.text: Place this small shrine in your Orbiter and invite Koumei to guide your destiny.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KoumeiSh.zhText: 将这个小祈运坛放置在你的轨道飞行器中并邀请 Koumei 来指引你的命运。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KubrowBe.text: A comfortable bed for your pet.

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KubrowBu.text: A sculpture to imbue your Orbiter with the regal strength of the Kubrow.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KubrowBu.zhText: 这个雕塑可为你的轨道飞行器注入库狛的庄严之力。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KubrowKa.text: A poster of a Kubrow and Kavat for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KubrowKa.zhText: 一张给轨道飞行器的库狛和库娃的海报。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KubrowTo.text: A new favorite toy for your pet.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KubrowTo.zhText: 为你的宠物准备的新玩具。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KuvaMeta.text: Meditate on The Old Blood with this orbiter decoration.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/KuvaMeta.zhText: 用这个轨道飞行器装饰冥想《远古之血》。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LandingC.text: A Kuva themed skin for your landing craft
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LandingC.zhText: 登陆艇的赤毒主题外观

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LavosAlc.text: The very scrawling found on the cell walls of transmuter Javi can now be yours. Those who hope to interpret these symbols might find the Leverian exhibit of Lavos useful.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LavosAlc.zhText: 你现在可以拥有炼制术师哈维的牢房墙壁上发现的涂鸦。那些希望可以解读这些符号的人也许会发现莱弗博物馆所展示的 Lavos 事迹会有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LavosDev.text: Bring a touch of Lavos’ transformative power to the Orbiter with this decorative replica.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LavosDev.zhText: 通过这件装饰性复制品为轨道飞行器带来一丝 Lavos 转化性的力量。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LensFlar.text: A Lens Flare Decoration to place in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LensFlar.zhText: 一个可以放置于轨道飞行器的镜头光晕装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.text: This mural cycles through four elegant portraits of the wolves that once guarded Lua: Dynar the shadowed, Raksh the defender, Lycath the stalwart, and Ulfrun the fierce.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.zhText: 这幅壁画循环展示了四张曾经守护月球的狼群的优雅肖像：暗影者戴拿、防御者亚克什、顽强的莱卡斯，和凶猛的乌尔佛伦。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.text: An elegant portrait of Ulfrun, the fierce.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.zhText: 凶猛强大——乌尔佛伦的优雅肖像。
乌尔佛伦的莱弗博物馆壁画

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.text: An elegant portrait of Dynar, the shadowed.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.zhText: 暗影者——戴拿的优雅肖像。
戴拿的莱弗博物馆壁画

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.text: An elegant portrait of Raksh, the defender.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.zhText: 守护者——亚克什的优雅肖像。
亚克什的莱弗博物馆壁画

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.text: An elegant portrait of Lycath, the stalwart brother.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Leverian.zhText: 顽强的兄弟——莱卡斯的优雅肖像。
莱卡斯的莱弗博物馆壁画

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: The M stands for mini. Declare martial law over dirt and grime in your base of operations.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: M 代表迷你。在你的行动基地对灰尘和污垢实施戒严。
M-09 艾弗旺坦克内务无人机
眠休传播天线

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A glazed earthenware jug, cracked, but healed with gold and all the more beautiful for its imperfections.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一只裂口的陶土水壶，但被金子修复，它的不完美反而平添了一种美。
碎裂的水壶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A sign, daubed with blue pigment and crafted from reclaimed driftwood. A common feature of the streets and byways of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个标牌，用蓝色颜料涂抹，由回收来的浮木制成。是希图斯街道和小巷中常见之物。
蓝色希图斯标牌

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A sign, daubed with red pigment and crafted from reclaimed driftwood. A common feature of the streets and byways of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个标牌，用红色颜料涂抹，由回收来的浮木制成。是希图斯街道和小巷中常见之物。
红色希图斯标牌

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A sign, daubed with green pigment and crafted from reclaimed driftwood. A common feature of the streets and byways of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个标牌，用绿色颜料涂抹，由回收来的浮木制成。是希图斯街道和小巷中常见之物。
绿色希图斯标牌

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This drone eradicates dust and dirt with quiet efficiency.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这款无人机能够安静高效地清除灰尘和污垢。
锋阵内务无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Reinvented from the ground up, the Ki'Teer Domestik is a revolution in sanitation and style.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 经过了彻头彻尾的改造，Ki'Teer 内务无人机在环境卫生和样式风格领域掀起了一场革命。
内务 Ki'Teer 无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: All the cleaning style of the original Ki'Teer Domestik, in a fresh, elegant new color.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 延续了原版 Ki'teer 内务无人机的经典清洁风格，以全新清新优雅的配色呈现。
内务 Ki'Teer 无人机（薰衣草冰）

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Add some flare to your Orbiter with this blazing sanitation unit.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这台炽热的卫生装置为你的轨道飞行器增添一些闪光。
拾海者内务无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text:
Just like the drone that supplies the Killians with power ups!

Disclaimer: For entertainment purposes only. Actual functionality limited to cleaning, unit will not provide power ups.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText:
就像为基利安带来力量的无人机一样！

免责声明：仅用于娱乐目的。实际功能仅限于清洁，设备不会提供任何升级。
火力女兵无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This drone polishes the Orbiter's floors to luminous brilliance.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这台无人机会把轨道飞行器的地板擦拭得光亮如镜。
内务破晓无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Whether you're a commoner or a king, this diligent drone will keep your home spotless.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 无论你是平民还是国王，这款勤奋的无人机都会让你的家保持一尘不染。
内务讲台无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This drone might leave the Orbiter's floors even more of a mess than it found them.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这款无人机可能会把轨道飞行器的地板弄得比它刚被发现时更加脏乱。
嗜血内务无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Grineer cleaning technology: no less efficient than the Corpus, though significantly more obtrusive.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: Grineer 清洁技术：并不比 Corpus 低效，只不过存在感要强得多。
内务肥皂果无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A Tenno engineered cleaning drone designed in the elegant style of the Liset.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一台 Tenno 设计的清洁无人机，继承了 Liset 优雅的设计风格。
Liset 内务无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stylish upgrade to your Orbiter's sanitation needs.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 为你的轨道飞行器卫生环境来一次时髦的升级。
内务热忱无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Mop up the Orbiter with this Domestik Drone inspired by Yareli's living board, Merulina.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这款受 Yareli 浪漪珊瑚启发的内务无人机清扫轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Fight dirt and grime with this aquatic Domestik Drone inspired by Merulina Pandea.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 使用这款受浪漪珊瑚盘古底启发的水系内务无人机来对抗污垢。
浪漪珊瑚盘古底内务无人机
浪漪珊瑚内务无人机
眠休调节器

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Corpus fighter craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Corpus 战机。
蛇妖战机装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Corpus spacecraft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Corpus 航天器。

鹰掠战机装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Corpus fighter craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Corpus 战机。
旋织战机装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Enjoy Lunar Renewal with this cute and cuddly Chroma by your side.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 与软萌的 Chroma 一起享受新春佳节。
Chroma 尊龙玩偶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A replica of Uriel’s demonic companion Catenach, now content to wander your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个仿照 Uriel 的恶魔伙伴缚魔制成的复制品，它会在你的轨道飞行器里游荡。
缚魔无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A replica of Uriel’s demonic companion Gulphagor to latch onto your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个仿照 Uriel 的恶魔伙伴苦魔制成的复制品，可以附着在你的轨道飞行器。
苦魔无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A replica of Uriel’s demonic companion Vythelas to heat up your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个仿照 Uriel 的恶魔伙伴烙魔制成的复制品，可以用来加热你的轨道飞行器。
烙魔无人机

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A still-living fragment torn free from one of the feared Eidolons that stalk the plains beyond Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 从徘徊在希图斯之外的可怕夜灵身上撕下，仍然活动的碎片。
夜灵遗物

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This delicate Entrati design's slender metal arm holds a subtle blue flame in a state of perfect equipoise.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这件英择谛精巧设计的细长金属臂，以一种完美平衡的状态，托举着一团微妙的蓝色火焰。
靛焰壁灯

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A single boot, possibly of Grineer design, pulled from one of the ponds that dot the Eidolon Plains. Smells of Gulper and pondscum.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一只靴子，可能是 Grineer 设计，从遍布夜灵平野的某个池塘中钓出。闻起来有股囊咽鱼和绿藻的气味。
渔靴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: It is believed that Onkko protected the coffer's contents with a glass shatter lock.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 据信昂克用一把玻璃做的碎裂锁保护了保险箱中的东西。
昂克的保险箱

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Like the morning’s first light, this Shawzin will wake the spirit within. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 如早上的第一道晨光，这把三线琴会唤醒内在的灵魂。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。
黎明三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A Zenith Granum Crown replica for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个给轨道飞行器的顶级格拉努硬币复制品。
顶级格拉努硬币装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A Granum Crown replica for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个给轨道飞行器的格拉努硬币复制品。
格拉努硬币装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An Exemplar Granum Crown replica for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个给轨道飞行器的范本格拉努硬币复制品。
范本格拉努硬币装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer spacecraft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 航天器。
Grineer 战舰装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer fighter craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 战机。
切割战机装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer fighter craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 战机。
高炮战机装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stunningly detailed representation of the signature Grineer fighter craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 以惊人的细节展示了标志性的 Grineer 战机。
战术战机装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A miniature of a Corpus shrine said to represent the hand of their Founder.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 微型 Corpus 神龛，据说代表着他们创始人的手。
黄金之手装饰
眠休储存盒
眠休光影

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A recreation of Narin's icy crest and rapier, forever entombed aboard your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: Narin 的冰冠和细剑的复制品，永远被封存在你的轨道飞行器中。
冰封的寒霜疾剑装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Natural infested forms combine in an eye-catching piece that recalls the singular landscape of Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 感染的自然形态融合在一件夺目的作品内，让人联想到火卫二的独特景观。
偌利佐尔摆件

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Add the perfect infested highlight to any room with this expertly cast decorative piece.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 通过这件专业铸造的装饰品来为任意房间增添完美的感染特色。
附着赤脓

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Sneak in this stand-out accent piece to give your ship’s interior a unique flair.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 悄然拿出这件杰出的装饰品，来为你的飞船内部带来一丝独特的风格。
团簇镇石

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This insectoid plant’s hardy disposition makes it a great, low-maintenance addition to any space.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这种类昆虫植物的顽强性格，使其对任意空间来说都是一种绝佳的易养护的装饰品。
荧虫装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Beauty and strangeness blend in this distinctive tendrilled houseplant.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 集美丽与珍奇为一身的独特卷须室内植物。
靛须盆栽

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This bioluminescent plant is sure to brighten up any dark corner in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这种生物发光植物一定会照亮你轨道飞行器中的任何黑暗角落。
幽光果

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Keep sneaky little babies eternally safe with this Orokin-era bassinet for two.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这款奥罗金时代的双人婴儿床，能让调皮捣蛋的小家伙们永远安然无恙。
双子摇篮装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A sound like no other. Strum an ode to the Lotus with this unique sounding gold and violet Shawzin. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种与众不同的声音。使用这把独特音响的金紫色的三线琴弹拨一首颂歌给 Lotus。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。
莲花三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This antique Orokin string instrument once belonged to a great Dax. The ancient ballad, "Smiles from Juran," is one of the few known examples of music composed for this instrument. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这个古老的奥罗金弦乐器曾经属于一个伟大的禁卫。古老的民谣《朱兰笑》，是为这种乐器创作的为数不多的已知乐曲之一。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Shape intricate melodies with this geometric shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 通过这款几何状的三线琴来编织复杂的旋律。
科尔布三线琴
禁卫的三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Compose ballads of old threats risen anew, with this shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这把三线琴谱写旧时威胁再次崛起的民谣。
提亚马特三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A 1m patch of Tau Xenoflora to decorate your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 1 米长的 Tau 异星花，用来装饰你的轨道飞行器。
异星花丛（1 米）

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A 2m patch of Tau Xenoflora to decorate your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 2 米长的 Tau 异星花，用来装饰你的轨道飞行器。
异星花丛（2 米）

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Wrought in memory of the Xenoflora of Tau, its beauty can be preserved in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 为了纪念 Tau 的异星花而打造，它的美丽现在可以保存在你的轨道飞行器中。
异星花装饰
眠休阵列

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: The golden Shawzin used by Narmer adherents to sing the praises of Ballas.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 合一众信徒用来赞美 Ballas 的金色三线琴。
合一众三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: The cooperative nature of this Necramite can be attributed to its omission from security protocols, and to the (almost) total absence of the Indifference from the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这种殁世微灵的合作性质可以归因于它被排除在安全协议之外，以及轨道飞行器几乎完全没有虚空无情之物的存在。
殁世微灵

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Adorn your Orbiter with this decoration representing the Nightwave Landing Craft.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这个代表午夜电波登陆艇的装饰来点缀你的飞行器。
午夜电波登陆艇装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A decadent recliner to rest one’s weary soul.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一张奢华的躺椅，供人休憩疲惫的灵魂。
躺椅

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A sumptuously appointed place to sit.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一座装饰华美的座位。
贵人椅

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A footstool covered in luxuriant leather.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 脚凳上铺着奢华的皮革。
华丽脚凳

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Orokin archimedean instruments were status symbols as well as tools of study.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 奥罗金哲士仪器既是身份象征，也是研究工具。
镀金显微镜

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Gold assists with conductivity in some areas of study, but here is purely decorative.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 黄金在某些研究领域有助于导电，但在这里纯属装饰用途。
镀金炼金架

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Decorate the Orbiter with this miniature replica of an old model Corpus locker.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这个古老型号的 Corpus 储物柜的微型复制品来装饰轨道飞行器。
古老 Corpus 储物柜

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A wooden frame to display a red-and-black hood of Quill design.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用来展示红黑色夜羽兜帽的木框。
兜帽展示框黑色装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A wooden frame to display a teal-colored hood of Quill design.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用来展示墨绿色夜羽兜帽的木框。
兜帽展示框青色装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A wooden frame to display a grey hood of Quill design.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用来展示灰色夜羽兜帽的木框。
兜帽展示框灰色装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stone marker, miraculously preserved from the Orokin era, polished smooth by time and accented with tooled gold.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个石头记号，奇迹般地从奥罗金时代保存下来，被时光打磨抛光，并被金子手工点缀。
阿格卡尼界石

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An implement for dispensing Orokin energy.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用于分配奥罗金能量的装置。
奥罗金能量导管

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: While purported to house all manner of precious resources, in truth these containers primarily contained various strong drinks.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这些容器虽然号称能存放各类珍贵资源，实际上主要盛装着各种烈性酒。
奥罗金木桶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Tubing used to protect the volatile energy sources the Orokin would often use.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用于保护奥罗金人常用的易挥发能源的管道。
奥罗金导管

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Used to house volatile and dangerous substances in Orokin installations.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用于储存奥罗金设施中易挥发且危险的物质。
奥罗金密封储存装置

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: The functional elegance of Orokin design makes this a versatile piece for storage or display.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 源自奥罗金设计的优雅实用性，使其成为可用作储存或展示的多功能工艺品。
星芒尊

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Evoking the timeless classicism of the Orokin era, the Kybus makes a great base or table.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 唤起奥罗金时代永恒的古典主义，绘玉台是一个很不错的底座或桌子。
绘玉台

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: With its antiqued metal and delicate gold accents, this Orokin floor piece adds grace and style to any room.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 通过使用古式金属和精致的金色装饰，这件奥罗金地面装饰可以为任意房间增添典雅和格调。
描金灯

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A gilded component used in the operation of Orokin infrastructure.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 奥罗金基础设施运作中使用的镀金组件。
奥罗金弧形导管

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Illumination, crafted by Ostron glassworkers, fashioned and gilded to aesthetic perfection.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 照明物，由 Ostron 玻璃工人制作，工艺和镀金都体现了极致的审美。
镀金明光

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A bird of prey to accompany you aboard the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 轨道飞行器中的猛禽伴侣。
笼中秃鹰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A small sample of sacred Temple flesh, iconic export of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一小块神殿肉的样本，希图斯的标志性出口品。
神殿肉

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: One of Cetus' signature sights, in miniature.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 缩小的希图斯标志性景象之一。
回收者气球

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Turquoise glass suspended in a handmade gilded basket, filled with bioluminescence.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 青绿色的玻璃悬挂在手工制作的镀金篮子中，注有生物冷光物质。
查坦灯笼

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A small rodent of Earthly origin to keep you company aboard the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种来自地球的小型啮齿类，可以在轨道飞行器中伴随你。
笼中库阿卡
Tenno 血缘小地毯

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Personalize your quarters with this unique rug.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这个独特的毯子来个性化你的个人房间。
Ostron 蓝色毯子

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An Ostron rug featuring blue bands.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种有蓝色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子
Ostron 绿色毯子

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An Ostron rug featuring green bands.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种有绿色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子
Ostron 橙色毯子

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An Ostron rug featuring orange bands.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种有橙色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子
Ostron 红色毯子

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An Ostron rug featuring red bands.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种有红色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子
Ostron 黄色毯子

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An Ostron rug featuring yellow bands.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种有黄色带装饰的 Ostron 毯子

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A glass carving depicting the colossal Thousand-Year Fish of Ostron legend.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个描绘着 Ostron 传奇的巨大千年灵鱼的玻璃雕刻。
千年灵鱼小雕像

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A large basket piled high with blue-colored spice from the markets of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一大筐来自希图斯市场的蓝色香料。
蓝色香料

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A flat, woven tray piled high with red-colored spices from the markets of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 平底编织盘上堆满了来自希图斯市场的红色香料。
红色香料
眠休支柱
眠休离心支架

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: To one damned within his own mind, a throne can be a prison.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 对于一个内心充满痛苦的人来说，王座也可以是牢笼。
炼狱王座

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Better than the ground, but not by much.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 比睡在地上强，但也好不了多少。
行军床

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A container for all manner of Anarch war supplies.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用来存放自由派战争物资的容器。
自由派储存箱

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A cylindrical storage receptacle used by Anarch forces.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 自由派使用的圆柱形储存容器。
自由派储存桶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A simple trap designed to impede even the most advanced Orokin tank.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个简单的陷阱，足以阻挡最先进的奥罗金坦克。
自由派反坦克陷阱

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A desk used at Tauron Academy.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: Tauron 学院使用的书桌。
Tauron 学院书桌

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A double-leaf table used at Tauron Academy.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: Tauron 学院使用的双层折叠桌。
Tauron 学院桌子

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A stand made for only the most precious of Orokin belongings.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 专为奥罗金最珍贵的物品打造的底座。
镀金柱基

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: An ornate writing implement used primarily to sign paperwork.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一种主要用于签署文书的华丽书写工具。
镀金羽毛笔套装

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A staked figure used by Anarchs to demarcate an area claimed by a belligerent force.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 自由派用于标记交战势力所占领区域的桩状物。
Sentient 骨像（中型）

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A large staked figure used by Anarchs to demarcate an area claimed by a belligerent force.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 自由派用于标记交战势力所占领区域的大型桩状物。
Sentient 骨像（大型）

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Corpus-produced posters and signboards reminding Solaris workers of rights and safety protocols. Report nonconformists! Life is Profit, Profit is Life!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 由 Corpus 出产的海报及布告板，提醒 Solaris 工人的权利及安全措施。一律举报不遵奉者！人生是利益，利益就是人生！
索拉里斯工业带材

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A single, warm Sentient core decoration for your orbiter - still illuminated by a shred of the power it once commanded.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一颗温暖的 Sentient 核心装饰，借由过去所拥有的力量仍在发光。
发光的 Sentient 核心装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Elite audiences appreciate the Courtly Shawzin’s elegant ornamentation.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 精英阶层观众普遍欣赏典雅三线琴那优雅的装饰。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A creative soul rings out with each strum of the Lonesome Shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 孤寂三线琴的每一次弹奏都会响起一个创造性的灵魂。
孤寂三线琴
典雅三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Features an adaptive enamel that senses and mimics the coloring of any musician playing it. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 具有适应性珐琅，可感知和模仿任何演奏它的音乐家的色彩。装备并使用内含的三线琴表情符号来弹奏这把乐器。
拟态三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: For some favored Tenno, Flare's infested guitar has consented to be played like any other instrument. Handle with respect - and caution.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 对于某些受青睐的 Tenno 来说，弗莱尔的感染吉他已同意像其他乐器一样被演奏。请怀着敬意——并小心使用。
丽兹

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A familiar sound with a distinctive new look.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个熟悉的声音配上一款与众不同的新外观。
炫彩三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This instrument belonged to a much-loved member of the Holdfasts, who would often cheer up her companions with it.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这件乐器曾属于坚守者中一位深受喜爱的成员，她经常会弹奏它来鼓舞同伴。
吉拉的三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Kira played her shawzin to uplift the spirits of Zariman crewmembers. Her song and her memory live on in the Void.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 吉拉演奏她的三线琴来振奋扎里曼船员的精神。她的歌声和记忆永存于虚空之中。
虚空之歌三线琴

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Hunter, behold the rewards of your work in Synthesis. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 猎者，看看你结合仪式的成果吧。这是一个可以装点你轨道飞行器的失效的 Simaris 控制台装饰。
Simaris 声望奖励复刻控制台

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: In Synthesis all things may be known, Hunter. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 在结合仪式中所有的东西或许都是已知的，猎者。这是一个可以装点你轨道飞行器的失效的 Simaris 控制台装饰。
Simaris 研究复刻控制台

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Honor the memory of Old Tau and the Somatic Bearers who fought at your side with this interactive Xenoflora decoration.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这款互动式异星花装饰来缅怀远古 Tau 上和曾与你并肩作战的活体载体。
活体载体纪念碑
眠休阶梯

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: You will honor Styanax Tonatiuh when you display these cherished armaments.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 通过展示这些珍贵的军备来向 Styanax 炽阳神致敬。
战盾 & 战矛装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: The exalted armaments of Styanax Prime, ready for place of pride in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: Styanax Prime 的显赫军备，随时准备在轨道飞行器上占据荣耀的位置。
豪勇 & 崇敬 Prime 装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: You will honor Styanax when you display these cherished armaments.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 通过展示这些珍贵的军备来向 Styanax 致敬。
豪勇 & 崇敬装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Decorate the Orbiter with this figurine of an ancient warrior, made from the very finest green polyethylene. Circa 1999.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这尊古代武士雕像来装饰你的轨道飞行器，雕像由最优质的绿色聚乙烯制成。时刻梦回《1999》。
百夫长战士玩偶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Your own Stuffie Buddy astronaut, ready for adventures in outer space!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 属于你的毛绒小伙伴宇航员，随时准备好去外太空冒险！
宇航小子玩具

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Commemorate the Lua landings with this fun, robust rocketship. Batteries not included.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 用这艘有趣、坚固的火箭来纪念月球登陆。不含电池。
火箭飞船月球玩偶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: Bring a piece of Gas City to the Orbiter with this scrolling Corpus sign.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 通过这个会滚动的 Corpus 标志来将集气城市的风光带回轨道飞行器。
滚动标志装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A wide seagrass basket filled with seasonal fruits from the markets of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个宽阔的海草编织篮中盛满了来自希图斯市场的时令水果。
宽型果篮

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A small seagrass basket filled with seasonal fruits from the markets of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个小的海草编织篮中盛满了来自希图斯市场的时令水果。
适中果篮

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.text: A large seagrass basket filled with seasonal fruits from the markets of Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro.zhText: 一个大的海草编织篮中盛满了来自希图斯市场的时令水果。
