/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 种子雕塑

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: An Orbiter decoration for all of you Dreamers out there.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 为所有梦回者准备的轨道飞行器装饰。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: Nightwave Ornament
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 午夜电波饰物

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: An Orbiter decoration commemorating your grim descent into the madness of the Glassmaker.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 一个纪念你冷酷坠入玻璃匠疯狂深渊的轨道飞行器装饰。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: Glassmaker Ornament
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 玻璃匠饰物

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: The mark of Arlo’s devoted is displayed in this Orbiter decoration.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 用这个轨道飞行器装饰品来展现 Arlo 的信徒标记。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: Emissary Ornament
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 使徒饰物

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: A small icon depicting The Wolf of Saturn Six to place in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 一小座可放置于飞船内的土星六号之狼雕像。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: Saturn Six Ornament
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 土星六号装饰品

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: A small icon of the Perrin Sequence to place in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 一小座可放置于飞船内的佩兰数列标志。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: Quittance Sculpture
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 报酬雕塑

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: A small icon of the Red Veil to place in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 一小座可放置于飞船内的血色面纱标志。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: Mark Sculpture
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 印痕雕塑

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: A small icon of the Steel Meridian to place in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 一小座可放置于飞船内的钢铁防线标志。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.text: Insignia Sculpture
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ornament.zhText: 佩章雕塑

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/OrokinMa.text: An Infested stowaway from one of your Missions, now content to wander your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/OrokinMa.zhText: 一个从你的任务中偷跑出来的感染者，现在正满足地在你的轨道飞行器上游荡。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/OstronHe.text: A moment frozen in time, gruesomely magnificent. This harrowing piece was found among a debris field that made Drusus Leverian reconsider legends about the Warframe Atlas.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/OstronHe.zhText: 时光凝结在这一瞬间，美的令人毛骨悚然。这件惊世骇俗的作品是在一片碎石区发现的，这让德枢·莱弗重新考虑了关于 Atlas 的一些传说。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/OwlOrdis.text: A decorative statue that recognizes steadfast loyalty in an ever-changing universe.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/OwlOrdis.zhText: 一个装饰性的雕像，代表着在千变万化的宇宙中矢志不渝的忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Pagemast.text: A Paragrimm ascends from Noctua's pages to accompany you in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Pagemast.zhText: 一只幽幽鹰从夜枭的书页中升起，在轨道飞行器中陪伴你。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/ParazonP.text: Mercy Or Convert? A poster for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/ParazonP.zhText: 怜悯之击还是感化？一张给轨道飞行器的海报。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path in 1999
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了 1999 钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Ceres
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了谷神星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of piloting the Railjack through the Steel Path.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 这是驾驶航道星舰穿越钢铁之路的标志。
钢铁之路 — 航道星舰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Deimos
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了火卫二钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on the Derelicts
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了被遗弃的奥罗金船只钢铁之路的象征。
钢铁之路 — 被遗弃的奥罗金船只

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path in Duviri
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了双衍王境钢铁之路的象征。
钢铁之路 — 双衍王境

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Earth
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了地球钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Eris
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了阋神星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Europa
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了欧罗巴钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Jupiter
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了木星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path in the Kuva Fortress
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了赤毒要塞钢铁之路的象征。
钢铁之路 — 赤毒要塞

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Lua
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了月球钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Mars
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了火星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Mercury
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了水星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Neptune
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了海王星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path in the Dark Refractory.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了深溯池钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Phobos
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了火卫一钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Pluto
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了冥王星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Saturn
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了土星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Sedna
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了赛德娜钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Uranus
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了天王星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path on Venus
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了金星钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path in The Void
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了虚空钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.text: A signifier of walking The Steel Path in The Zariman
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlanetTr.zhText: 踏上了「扎里曼号」钢铁之路的象征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Plush202.text: This Kuaka is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Plush202.zhText: 这只库阿卡非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Plush202.text: This Sawgaw is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Plush202.zhText: 这只梭歌非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushLNY.text: A cuddly rabbit floof, to honor the moon’s companion.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushLNY.zhText: 一只可爱的兔兔玩偶， 以纪念月亮的陪伴。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyAm.text: Now you can give Amir the hugs he appreciates so much!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyAm.zhText: 现在你可以给阿米尔一个他非常期待的拥抱了！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyAo.text: This Stuffie Buddy was approved by Aoi personally. Can be hugged without fear of crushing.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyAo.zhText: 这款毛绒小伙伴是由碧亲自认证的，可以抱在怀里，不用担心被压坏。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyAr.text: "My studies of the 1999 period have revealed a priceless relic known as the Stuffie Buddy. We must recreate the wonders of the past." - Loid
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyAr.zhText: "我对 1999 时期的研究发现了一个名叫‘毛绒小伙伴'的无价文物。我们必须重现过去的奇迹。"——洛德

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBa.text: Change of plans: leave nothing uncuddled with this adorable floof.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBa.zhText: 计划有变：和这个可爱玩偶在一起好好拥抱吧。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBa.text: Baro returns from his latest foray into the Void in a softer, more huggable form.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBa.zhText: Baro 从虚空之旅中归来，现在他的样子更加柔软，更能惹人喜爱。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBa.text: This unusual floof was likely the result of a manufacturing error. Will you accept it into your home, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBa.zhText: 这个奇特的玩偶很可能是生产过程中的瑕疵。Tenno，你会把它带回家吗？

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBe.text: A very special Floof commemorating your participation in Tactical Alert: Dog Days. FOR SQUISHY HONOR!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBe.zhText: 一个非常特别的玩偶，以纪念你在战术警报：三伏天中的参与。为了湿漉漉的荣誉！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyCa.text: A very special Floof commemorating your participation in Tactical Alert: Dog Days. FOR SQUISHY HONOR!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyCa.zhText: 一个非常特别的玩偶，以纪念你在战术警报：三伏天中的参与。为了湿漉漉的荣誉！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDJ.text: When DJ RoM speaks, the world tunes in! And this reporter was no exception. The whole crew from On-lyne nodded along as DJ said, "We became a group because we share a love for music." Talk about squad goals!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDJ.zhText: 当打碟王一开口，全世界都在倾听！这位记者也不例外。当打碟王说"我们之所以组成这个团体，是因为我们都热爱音乐"时，线上时代的所有成员都点头表示同意。这才是团队目标！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDJ.text: When DJ RoM speaks, the world tunes in! And this reporter was no exception. The whole crew from On-lyne nodded along as DJ said, "We became a group because we - infect people." Talk about squad goals!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDJ.zhText: 当打碟王一开口，全世界都在倾听！这位记者也不例外。当打碟王说"我们之所以组成这个团体，是因为我们都——感染人"时，线上时代的所有成员都点头表示同意。这才是团队目标！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDe.text: Avoid shifting sands with this squishy little fella!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDe.zhText: 通过这湿漉漉的小家伙来避免流沙！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDr.text: Drillbit keeps it 100% real, as always. No sugarcoating here. He told us straight up, "Once you get a taste of fame, you're hooked." Honesty like that is why we love him!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDr.zhText: 钻头小子一如既往地保持百分百的真实。从不讲虚话。他直截了当地告诉我们，"一旦你尝到了名气的滋味，你就会上瘾。"正是这种坦率让我们如此喜爱他！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDr.text: Drillbit keeps it 100% real, as always. No sugarcoating here. He told us straight up, "Once you get a taste of - hearts - you're hooked." Honesty like that is why we love him!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDr.zhText: 钻头小子一如既往地保持百分百的真实。从不讲虚话。他直截了当地告诉我们，"一旦你尝到了——心脏——的滋味，你就会上瘾。"正是这种坦率让我们如此喜爱他！
科技细胞钻头小子玩偶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDr.text: In case of waterworks, this cuddly Drippy floof is here to help!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyDr.zhText: 如果想哭了，这只毛茸茸的滴答玩偶可以陪伴你！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyEl.text: Eleanor's cuddly replica, guaranteed not to get in your head or bare her fangs at you.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyEl.zhText: 埃莉诺的可爱复制品，保证不会钻入你的脑袋，也不会对你露出尖牙。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyHa.text: Harddrive is the ultimate hype machine! Right before hitting the stage, he was all about the team spirit, shouting, "Let's get out there and show our fans how much we love them!"
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyHa.zhText: 硬盘是极致的气氛制造者！在登上舞台之前，他充满团队精神，高声呼喊"让我们走出去，向我们的粉丝们展示我们是怎么爱他们的！"

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyHa.text: Harddrive is the ultimate hype machine! Right before hitting the stage, he was all about the team spirit, shouting, "Let's get out there and show our fans how much we - destroy - them!"
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyHa.zhText: 硬盘是极致的气氛制造者！在登上舞台之前，他充满团队精神，高声呼喊"让我们走出去，向我们的粉丝们展示我们是怎么——摧毁——他们的！"

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyHe.text: The fearsome Hemocyte, now a cuddly floof.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyHe.zhText: 可怕的免疫血胞体，现在变成了一只可爱的毛茸茸玩偶。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyIn.text: Mighty Inaros, the Pharaoh of Floofs, can endure any amount of affection.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyIn.zhText: 伟大法老 Inaros 的玩偶，可以接受任何程度的爱。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyJi.text: This tough-as-nails Caliber Chick makes for a surprisingly snuggly floof.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyJi.zhText: 坚韧不拔的火力女兵竟然可以是个暖心玩偶。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyKo.text: This lovable marsupial is a symbol of hope and compassion in trying times.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyKo.zhText: 这个可爱的有袋类动物在艰难时期象征着希望和同情心。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLN.text: Enjoy Lunar Renewal with this cute and cuddly Mirage by your side.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLN.zhText: 与软萌的 Mirage 一起享受新春佳节。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLe.text: This cuddly version of the Hex's weary medic is a lot more accepting of hugs than her real-life counterpart.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLe.zhText: 这个可爱版的六人组疲惫军医比她现实生活中更愿意接受拥抱。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLi.text: The fight against chaotic nihilism just got a little bit cuddlier.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLi.zhText: 与混沌虚无主义作斗争的方式变得更可爱了。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLo.text: This fluffy version of Entrati's loyal butler is in need of some hugs.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLo.zhText: 这个毛绒版忠诚的英择谛管家需要一些拥抱。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLo.text: A great deal of love went into every stitch of this floof.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLo.zhText: 这个玩偶的每一针每一线中都注入了满满的爱。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLy.text: "I do not understand the purpose behind crafting such an image. No, I will not give it back." - F. Lyon Allard
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyLy.zhText: "我不理解制作这种形象的目的是什么。不，我不会把它还回去。"——里昂·阿拉德神父

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyMa.text: "Regardez! Mon visage, but surely far more adorable, n'est-ce pas? I simply must squish mes petites joues!" - Marie Leroux
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyMa.zhText: "Regardez！Mon visage，但肯定可爱多了，n'est-ce pas？我必须捏捏 mes petites joues！"——玛丽·勒鲁

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyMo.text: A very special Floof commemorating your participation in Tactical Alert: Dog Days. FOR SQUISHY HONOR!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyMo.zhText: 一个非常特别的玩偶，以纪念你在战术警报：三伏天中的参与。为了湿漉漉的荣誉！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyNe.text: Can't get enough of Necraloid? Bring home this cuddly, and silent, version.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyNe.zhText: 对殁世械灵爱不释手？那就把这版毛绒绒的、不会说话的他带回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyNo.text: The only thing cuter than a Sprodling is a Sprodling floof. Even more cuddly than the real thing!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyNo.zhText: 唯一比菌宝更可爱的就只有菌宝玩偶了。抱起来比真正的菌宝更令人爱不释手！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyOl.text: Fresh from the Crash Course, it’s Ollie! Give this skateboarding champ a home in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyOl.zhText: 刚从极速赛道的下来的奥利！把这位滑板冠军带回你的轨道飞行器吧。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyOr.text: "The Operator has Floofs in many charming forms. Ordis thought the Operator might add a loyal Cephalon to the collection!" - Ordis
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyOr.zhText: "指挥官有许多迷人的玩偶。Ordis 认为指挥官也许会想在收藏里添加一个忠诚的中枢！"——Ordis

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyPa.text: Packet's dressing room is every gamer's dream! With a console fired up, he flashed the biggest grin and shouted "Instagib!" as digital carnage exploded across the screen. Luckiest teen ever? Absolutely!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyPa.zhText: 数据使者的更衣室是每个玩家的梦想！游戏主机全速运转，他露出灿烂的笑容，高呼"秒杀！"，屏幕里瞬间血花四溅。这是世界上最幸运的少年吗？绝对是！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyPa.text: Packet's dressing room is every gamer's dream! With a console fired up, he flashed the biggest grin and shouted "Instagib!" as - Tenno - carnage exploded across the screen. Luckiest teen ever? Absolutely!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyPa.zhText: 数据使者的更衣室是每个玩家的梦想！游戏主机全速运转，他露出灿烂的笑容，高呼"秒杀！"，屏幕里的——Tenno——瞬间血花四溅。这是世界上最幸运的少年吗？绝对是！
科技细胞数据使者玩偶

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyPr.text: This broody little guy will steal your heart as he stands guard over your most precious things inside your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyPr.zhText: 这个忧郁的小家伙会偷走你的心，因为他在你的轨道飞行器守护着你最珍贵的东西。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyQu.text: An adorable replica of the Hex's sharpshooter. Cuddle him all you like, it won't cramp his style.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyQu.zhText: 一个可爱的六人组神枪手复制品。想抱就抱，这不会影响他的风格。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyRo.text: "What's this? My likeness, rendered in some sort of squishy textile? The indignity." - Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyRo.zhText: "这是什么？居然用某种软绵绵的布料做成我的样子？真是奇耻大辱。"——副摄政总司令罗瑟

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyRu.text: A very special Floof commemorating your participation in Tactical Alert: Dog Days. FOR SQUISHY HONOR!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyRu.zhText: 一个非常特别的玩偶，以纪念你在战术警报：三伏天中的参与。为了湿漉漉的荣誉！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushySn.text: A cuddly snake floof, to honor the most clever of the zodiac animals.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushySn.zhText: 一个可爱的灵蛇玩偶，用来纪念十二生肖中最聪明的动物。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyTi.text: A well-loved Star Days Ticker floof.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyTi.zhText: 一个备受喜爱的星日 Ticker 玩偶。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyTi.text: A cuddly tiger floof, to honor the animal who legends say stood up to the bullies of Earth.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyTi.zhText: 一只可爱的老虎玩偶，以纪念传说中能够抵抗地球恶霸的动物。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVa.text: Valkyr could probably use a hug too, and this squishy floof means it's perfectly safe!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVa.zhText: Valkyr 可能也需要一个拥抱，而这个软乎乎的毛绒玩偶意味着它完全安全！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVi.text: This Virmink is so grateful you adopted it for charity!
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVi.zhText: 这只弗鸣克非常感谢你为慈善事业收养了它！

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVo.text: Embrace the wolf with this cuddly floof.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVo.zhText: 通过这只毛茸茸的玩偶来拥抱这匹狼吧。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyZe.text: Zeke's got us swooning again! He melted this reporter's heart when he shared, "My ideal girl? I just want someone who smiles when she's with me."
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyZe.zhText: 兹克再次让我们神魂颠倒！他在分享时说："我的理想型女孩？我只想要一个在我身边时会笑的人。"这句话让这位记者的心都融化了。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyZe.text: Zeke's got us swooning again! He melted this reporter's heart when he shared, "My ideal girl? I just want someone who - dies - when she's with me."
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyZe.zhText: 兹克再次让我们神魂颠倒！他在分享时说："我的理想型女孩？我只想要一个在我身边时会——死——的人。"这句话让这位记者的心都融化了。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Ropaloly.zhText: 一系统蝠力使的可动模型站姿。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUBookAO.text: Logs of an unknown rail agent. A quaint addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUBookAO.zhText: 一位无名航道特工的日志。给着陆器平添了一份古雅。
航道特工货物清单装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUContai.text: Conforms to standard retention bracket specs for all make of rail tractor. And, coincidentally, your lander.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUContai.zhText: 符合标准的滞留支架，适用于各类航道牵引机。并且，巧合的是，也适用于你的着陆器。
索拉里斯货物储存箱装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUCoolan.text: For sample containment and transfer. Adds a rugged look to any lander.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUCoolan.zhText: 用于样本的储存和运输。给任何着陆器增加了粗犷的外观。
福尔图娜型冷却舱装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUFoodBo.text: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as these energy bars. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUFoodBo.zhText: 那些索拉里斯人仍然使用着传统的进食方式（主要是小孩），从比如能量棒这样的食物中获取养分。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUFoodCa.text: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as processed fish. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUFoodCa.zhText: 那些索拉里斯人仍然使用着传统的进食方式（主要是小孩），从比如能量棒这样的食物中获取养分。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUFoodSe.text: A meal tray for a Solaris citizen still utilizing traditional ingestion methods. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUFoodSe.zhText: 仍以传统方式进食的索拉里斯市民所使用的食物托盘。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。
索拉里斯餐厅托盘装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUSupply.text: Favored by rig jockeys for efficient transportation of parts and supplies. Give your lander that seat-of-your-pants scoundrel feel.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUSupply.zhText: 受到技工的喜爱，可以有效地运输零件和补给。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加一种"老子的专属座驾"的感觉。
索拉里斯补给货车装饰

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUSupply.text: Off-gassed coolant can be fatal to those with organic respiratory systems. Add this decoration to your lander to evoke the smells of Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUSupply.zhText: 废气中的冷却液对于有机呼吸系统是致命的。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以唤起福尔图娜的气息。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUSupply.text: A common sight on various decks and in the sumps, these racks allow much-needed tools and parts to remain within arm's reach. A tasteful addition to any engine room.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUSupply.zhText: 在多种甲板和污水池中常见，这种架子使得许多常用工具和零件触手可及。放置在引擎室中别有一番风味。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUTechTo.text: Can be used as metal-cutter or filer. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUTechTo.zhText: 可以被用于金属切割或锉修。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUTechTo.text: Primarily used in the opening and closing of coolant sluices. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/SUTechTo.zhText: 主要用于打开或关闭冷却液水闸。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/UmbraShe.text: Here it is: the pinnacle of pedestal production. With its luminescent accents and undulating legs, this is a stand so unique it renders all other plinths prosaic. You can search a lifetime, but you'll never find another piece quite like the Umbral Pedestal.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/UmbraShe.zhText: 这是基座制造的巅峰产物。伴随着其发光的装饰和波浪状的支脚，这款基座是如此独特，以至于所有其他基座都显得平淡无奇。即便你穷尽一生去寻找，你也不会找到另一件像 Umbra 基座这样的作品了。

/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/XakuPotE.text: Bren Terrasiam was renowned for his precision. The uniformity of this vase was typical in his fine ceramics.
/Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/XakuPotE.zhText: 布伦·泰拉西姆以精细着称。这个花瓶的均匀性是他精美陶瓷的典型特征。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Install this segment in order to enable the Arsenal within your orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用军械库功能。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Adds the Archwing Launcher to the foundry.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 将曲翼发射器加入铸造厂。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: A foundry upgrade that allows two Forma to be crafted at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 允许在同一时间制造两个 FORMA 的铸造厂升级。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText:
将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能：

－可以制造登陆艇
－可以制造空中支持呼叫道具

在「军械库」>「携带装备」中装备「空中支援呼叫器」。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Install this segment to enable the pet incubator within your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器上以启用宠物孵化器功能。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText:
升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能：

- 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴
- 孵化时间减少一天
HELMINTH 执刑官源力石模块

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 该模块允许 Helminth 将执刑官源力石嵌入当前战甲。执刑官源力石可以永久增强多种属性。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 通过联结融合和升华融合，可让 Helminth 融合执刑官源力石来获得更强大的源力石变体。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 在轨道飞行器强化 Helminth，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 允许 Helminth 为战甲注入活力。活化可以暂时增加战甲的能力。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Install this segment to enable the Mod Fusion function within the MODS terminal of your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 将此模块安装在轨道飞行器的 Mod 终端机上以解锁 Mod 融铸功能。

/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.text: Install this Void Relic Segment in your Orbiter to begin opening Void Relics. Void Relics contain valuables that are only determined when opened in Void Fissure missions. Void Relics can be obtained as mission rewards.
/Lotus/Language/ShipFeatureItems/ShipFea.zhText: 将此虚空遗物模块安装到你的轨道飞行器上，即可开启虚空遗物。虚空遗物内含的宝物只有在虚空裂缝任务中开启后才能确定。虚空遗物可以作为任务奖励获得。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearDrag.text: Soar into the coming year with the power of the honorable dragon.

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearFree.text: Celebrate the Lunar Renewal with the bravery of the legendary tiger.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearFree.zhText: 以虎虎生威之势庆贺农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearHors.text: Gallop into the coming year with the freedom of the loyal horse.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearHors.zhText: 带着忠诚骏马的自由，驰骋进入新的一年。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearOxSi.text: Celebrate the new lunar year with the power of the noble ox.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearOxSi.zhText: 以神牛之力，庆贺农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearRabb.text: Celebrate Lunar Renewal with the kind heart of the gentle rabbit.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearRabb.zhText: 怀揣兔兔的温良之心庆祝农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearSnak.text: Transform in the coming year with the intuition of the elegant snake.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearSnak.zhText: 凭借灵蛇的直觉，在新的一年转变成功。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearTige.text: Face the coming year with the boldness of the legendary tiger.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WeGameNewYearTige.zhText: 以这只传奇老虎的无畏精神迎接新的一年。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WikiaSigilDesc.text: A special sigil worn only by a select few Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WikiaSigilDesc.zhText: 一个特殊的纹章，仅有精选出来的少数 Tenno 可以佩戴。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WolfSigilDesc.text: The mark of an outlaw, once locked away six leagues deep in the gas.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WolfSigilDesc.zhText: 亡命之徒的标记，曾被关押在几十公里的毒气深处。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WreathSigilDesc.text: A sigil containing a festive design.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/WreathSigilDesc.zhText: 一枚带有了节庆设计元素的纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneFourYearSigi.text: Commemorates the Tenno who have honored the Lotus for four cycles.

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneJadeSigilDes.text: A next-generation sigil for your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneJadeSigilDes.zhText: 一款供战甲用的次世代纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneJadeTwoSigil.text: A next-generation sigil for your Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneOneYearSigil.text: Dedicated to the amazing Xbox One Warframe community.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneOneYearSigil.zhText: 献给了不起的 Xbox One Warframe 社区。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneThreeYearSig.text: Commemorates the Tenno who have honored the Lotus for three cycles.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/XBoneThreeYearSig.zhText: 纪念那些在三年里为 Lotus 带来荣誉的 Tenno 。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/YareliSigilDesc.text: A sigil depicting Yareli's deadly Aquablades.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/YareliSigilDesc.zhText: 描绘 Yareli 致命水形之刃的纹章。

/Lotus/Language/Sigils/ZarimanSupporterP.text: Represent the Zariman spirit of comradery and ingenuity.
/Lotus/Language/Sigils/ZarimanSupporterP.zhText: 代表了扎里曼的同志和匠心精神。

/Lotus/Language/Signa/OrfeoSignaCrownDes.text: Fateful whispers linger around this unearthly signa.
/Lotus/Language/Signa/OrfeoSignaCrownDes.zhText: 命运的低语在这个超凡的头环周围回荡。

/Lotus/Language/Signa/ProtoAshCrownDesc.text: Ancient assassin techniques meet future technology.
/Lotus/Language/Signa/ProtoAshCrownDesc.zhText: 远古刺客技艺与未来科技的碰撞。

/Lotus/Language/Signa/ProtoGarudaCrownDe.text: A bloodstained gaze washes all in red.
/Lotus/Language/Signa/ProtoGarudaCrownDe.zhText: 猩红的目光将一切都染成了红色。

/Lotus/Language/Signa/QTCCCatSignaCrownD.text: Support the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation Quest with this playful set of Kavat ears.
/Lotus/Language/Signa/QTCCCatSignaCrownD.zhText: 戴上这对俏皮的库娃猫耳，为玛嘉烈公主癌症基金的慈善活动助力。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AkjagaraIridosSkin.text: A radiant skin for these hard-hitting dual pistols.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AkjagaraIridosSkin.zhText: 这些威力强大的双持手枪的炫彩外观。
觉醒双枪 炫彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AlternoxDeluxeSkin.text: An alternative look for the Alternox, inspired by the Vortengeist Laboratories of old.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AlternoxDeluxeSkin.zhText: 电幻步枪的替代外观，受到过去电涡幽灵实验室的启发。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ArchonDaggerDuelis.text: The dual fang-blades of the Archon Amar, now frozen solid with chilling wrath.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ArchonDaggerDuelis.zhText: 执刑官欺谋狼主的双刃，如今已被刺骨的愤怒彻底冻结。
赤炎流星 冰魄外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshDeluxeIIBowSkin.text: Born of heat and cold as death, this is the signature bow skin for Ash Shroud.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshDeluxeIIBowSkin.zhText: 火热诞生却又带着死亡的寒意，这是 Ash 裹尸布的标志性弓箭外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshDeluxeIIHelmetD.zhText: Ash 裹尸布的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshDeluxeIISkinDes.text: Where once was fire is now cold resolve. A signature look for a prestige killer.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshDeluxeIISkinDes.zhText: 曾经的炙热之心已被寒霜取代。一款顶级杀手的标志性外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshGeminiKunaiSkin.text: Strike silently with this subtle Kunai skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshGeminiKunaiSkin.zhText: 使用这款精致的苦无外观悄无声息地发动攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshGeminiVectisSki.text: This Vectis skin's camouflage is designed for long stakeouts, an essential part of any assassin's toolkit.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AshGeminiVectisSki.zhText: 这款守望者外观的迷彩设计专为长时间的蹲点而打造，是每位刺客必备的装备之一。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AtlasDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Atlas 岩溶的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AtlasDeluxeSkinDes.text: To move a mountain, become the mountain. Embody the tectonic power of Atlas with this landmark skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AtlasDeluxeSkinDes.zhText: 如欲撼动山脉，仅需自身化作山。用这标志性外观来体现 Atlas 的地动之力。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/AtlasDeluxeSparrin.text: With seismic force shatter and sunder, blow upon blow. Enemies quake at the sight of these signature sparring weapon skins.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/AtlasDeluxeSparrin.zhText: 以地震之力粉碎并割裂，爆裂于打击之时。敌人会在这标志性搏击武器声中颤栗。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BallasSwordDuelist.text: The Sentient slayer, veiled in glittering ice.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BallasSwordDuelist.zhText: Sentient 猎杀者，被耀眼的冰层笼罩。
心智之殁 冰魄外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BansheeVoidShellAr.text: Don with morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BansheeVoidShellAr.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BansheeVoidShellHe.text: Don with morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BansheeVoidShellHe.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BansheeVoidShellSk.text: Don with morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BansheeVoidShellSk.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaroInarosPolearmD.text: Angular diamonds define this slender staff skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaroInarosPolearmD.zhText: 其角状钻石定义了这种细长风格的长棍外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaroMoaSkinDesc.text: A striking new skin for your favorite automatic pet, in the style of the System's most enigmatic trader.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaroMoaSkinDesc.zhText: 一款引人注目的全新外观，拥有星系中最神秘的商人的风格，适用于你喜爱的机械宠物。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaroScytheMacheteS.text: A double-bladed Tenno skin of ferocious appearance.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaroScytheMacheteS.zhText: 凶猛外表的双刃 Tenno 外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukDeluxeCapeDe.text: The glow of the Khinn Syandana inspires inward reflection.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukDeluxeCapeDe.zhText: 经行披饰的光芒激发着内心的沉思。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukDeluxeHelmet.zhText: Baruuk 铃僧的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukDeluxeSkinDe.text: Draw on your inner strength through contemplation.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukDeluxeSkinDe.zhText: 通过冥想发挥你的内在力量。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukDeluxeSparri.text: The Harmatt Skin befits the warrior who is skilled in hand-to-hand combat.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukDeluxeSparri.zhText: 沙寂搏击外观适合精通肉搏战的战士。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BaruukImmortalSkin.text: The Immortal skin for the Baruuk Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BillowingPistolSki.text: A skin to provide a billowing, ethereal look for your pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BillowingPistolSki.zhText: 一款为你的手枪带来滚滚云烟般的飘渺外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/BroncoSpectreDesc.text: In the distant past, pistols of this kind packed a mean punch.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/BroncoSpectreDesc.zhText: 在遥远的过去，这种手枪杀伤力巨大。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CalibanDeluxeAuxFl.text: A fragment of Sentient armor suspended above Caliban Orfeo’s right shoulder.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CalibanDeluxeAuxFl.zhText: 一块悬挂在 Caliban 奥菲欧的右肩上方的 Sentient 护甲碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CalibanDeluxeSkinD.text: Venture boldly into the Otherworld. None shall defeat the one who shows honor in the face of adversity and courage in the face of death.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CalibanDeluxeSkinD.zhText: 勇闯异世界。没有人能够打败那些在逆境中展现荣誉、在死亡面前表现勇气的人。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CalibanDlxScytheSk.text: Let nothing hinder you from safeguarding those you hold dear.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CalibanDlxScytheSk.zhText: 不要让任何事情阻碍你保护你所珍视的人。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CephPolearmSkinDes.text: This commanding Cephalon-designed polearm is just the thing for spontaneously interrupting an enemy's hostile processes.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CephPolearmSkinDes.zhText: 这把威严的长柄武器是由中枢设计的，可以自发干预敌人的敌对行动。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CeramicPistolDesc.text: A bold red and white glaze glisten across the surface of this hardened ceramic Pandero skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CeramicPistolDesc.zhText: 鲜明的红色和白色釉彩闪亮在坚硬的陶瓷手鼓外观表面。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CeramicTonfaDesc.text: Strike a bold pose with this hardened ceramic Tonfa skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CeramicTonfaDesc.zhText: 由这个陶瓷拐刃外观打造出一个大胆姿态。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ChameleonSkinDesc.text: Don the morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ChameleonSkinDesc.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CitrineDeluxeExalt.text: Reap enemies and steal hearts as you sweep through the battlefield with Citrine Aphrodita's signature heavy scythe skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CitrineDeluxeExalt.zhText: 使用 Citrine 美神标志性的重型镰刀外观横扫战场，收割敌人并俘获人心。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CitrineDeluxeHelme.text: The signature helmet of Citrine Aphrodita.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CitrineDeluxeHelme.zhText: Citrine 美神的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CitrineDeluxeSkinD.text: Embrace the eternal bond between love and war with Citrine Aphrodita. There are no roses without thorns.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CitrineDeluxeSkinD.zhText: 拥抱 Citrine 美神，感受爱与战争之间永恒的羁绊。没有不带刺的玫瑰。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CompositeLotusSkin.text: A holographic replica of the Lotus.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CorpusSpeargunSkin.text: Adopt your Corpus enemy’s aesthetic. Show them whose vision of the future will prevail.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CorpusSpeargunSkin.zhText: 采用你的 Corpus 敌人的审美。让他们看看谁的未来愿景将得胜。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CosmosArcaTitronSk.text: Elevate the Arca Titron with glowing line work reminiscent of calligraphy.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CosmosArcaTitronSk.zhText: 通过宛如书法般流转的光纹来为弧电振子锤赋予全新风采。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CosmosBurstonSkinD.text: Etched with golden light, the Raya series brings a cosmic sophistication to the Burston.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CosmosBurstonSkinD.zhText: 拉雅系列以金色光芒蚀刻，为伯斯顿注入了宇宙般的精妙。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CosmosEpitaphSkinD.text: This skin for Sevagoth’s signature pistol balances light and darkness, beauty and death.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CosmosEpitaphSkinD.zhText: 这款 Sevagoth 的标志性手枪外观完美平衡了光明与黑暗，优雅与死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CrpArSniperLichSki.text: This executive-class skin for the Ambassador was commissioned for the Sisters of Parvos by the Founder himself.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CrpArSniperLichSki.zhText: 这款行政级的使节外观是由创始人帕尔沃斯亲自为他的姐妹们委托制作的。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/CrpFreezeRayDuelis.text: The glacial cold of the Glaxion freeze ray is now reflected on its exterior.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/CrpFreezeRayDuelis.zhText: 冷冻光束步枪冰冻射线的刺骨寒意如今已映照在其表面上。
冷冻光束步枪 冰魄外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DSWeaponSkinDesc.text: This relic of Earth's long forgotten past is so old that it predates the Orokin Empire.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DSWeaponSkinDesc.zhText: 这来自久远地球的遗存，其历史甚至超过了奥罗金帝国。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DarkDaggerDuelistS.text: This icy look for the Dark Dagger conceals its irradiated nature.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DarkDaggerDuelistS.zhText: 暗黑匕首冰冷的外观掩盖了它辐射的本质。
暗影匕首 冰魄外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DarkSplitSwordDuel.text: The frozen elegance of this skin for the Dark Split-Sword belies its irradiated nature.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DarkSplitSwordDuel.zhText: 暗黑分合剑冰冷优雅的外观，与其辐射的本质形成了鲜明对比。
暗黑分合剑 冰魄外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DarkSwordDuelistSk.text: This skin for the Dark Sword lends a glacial hue to its irradiated metal.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DarkSwordDuelistSk.zhText: 这款暗黑长剑的外观皮肤为其辐射金属表面赋予了冰川般的色调。
暗影长剑 冰魄外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaxDuviriParazonSk.text: The parazon, reimagined as a dagger of the Duviri Dax by the surreal creative power of the land itself.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaxDuviriParazonSk.zhText: 灭骸之刃，经由这片土地本身那超现实的造物之力，重塑为一柄属双衍王境禁卫的匕首。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakCedoSkinDe.text: Watch your enemies fall before this weapon of the sunrise. A vibrant skin for the Cedo.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakCedoSkinDe.zhText: 看着你的敌人在这把破晓武器面前倒下。这是塞多的鲜艳外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakDaxSyandan.text: Bring the early light of Sol to this late-Orokin Dax Syandana.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakDaxSyandan.zhText: 让太阳神初晓的光辉，照耀这件奥罗金晚期的禁卫披饰。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakGlaiveSkin.text: Send your enemies into the long night with this dawn inspired Glaive skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakGlaiveSkin.zhText: 使用这款受黎明启发的战刃外观将你的敌人送入漫漫长夜。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakNukorSkinD.text: Make this sunrise your enemy’s last with this luminous Nukor Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakNukorSkinD.zhText: 凭借这款发光的努寇微波枪外观，让你的敌人最后一睹日出。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakNukorSkinN.zhText: 努寇微波枪 破晓外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakSugatraDes.text: This bright sugatra marks the last dawn your enemies will ever see.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DaybreakSugatraDes.zhText: 这件耀眼的坠饰，宣告了你的敌人将见到的最后一次破晓。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeimosSupporterPis.text: The hammer falls, the cylinder turns, and the cycle begins once again. Flawless machinery moving in sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeimosSupporterPis.zhText: 锤落筒转，周而复始。无瑕的机械在依序运转。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeimosSupporterSho.text: The favored weapon of the Entrati, this Skin bestows your Shotgun with an otherworldly luster.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeimosSupporterSho.zhText: 英择谛钟爱的武器，这款外观能够赋予你的霰弹枪以异界的光泽。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeimosSupporterWhi.text: Equally as elegant as it is ferocious, this mace-tipped whip skin is sure to leave an impression.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeimosSupporterWhi.zhText: 兼具优雅与残忍，这款尖端带刺的鞭子外观一定会给人留下深刻印象。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeluxeAcceltraSkin.text: Acceltra Caduceus turns up the heat of battle.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DeluxeAcceltraSkin.zhText: 迅发电浆炮 双蛇会激起战斗的热度。
迅发电浆炮 双蛇外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertAtteraxSkinD.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Atterax.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertAtteraxSkinD.zhText: 阿特拉克斯使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertAtteraxSkinN.zhText: 阿特拉克斯 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertDirigaSkinDe.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Diriga Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertDirigaSkinDe.zhText: 电气浮囊使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertDirigaSkinNa.zhText: 电气浮囊 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertGrinlokSkinD.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Grinlok.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertGrinlokSkinD.zhText: 葛恩火枪使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertGrinlokSkinN.zhText: 葛恩火枪 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertHekSkinDesc.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Hek.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertHekSkinDesc.zhText: 海克使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertKarakSkinDes.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Karak.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertKarakSkinDes.zhText: 卡拉克使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertKarakSkinNam.zhText: 卡拉克 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertMarelokSkinD.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Marelok.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertMarelokSkinD.zhText: 玛瑞火枪使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertMarelokSkinN.zhText: 玛瑞火枪 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertTaxonSkinDes.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Taxon Sentinel.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertTaxonSkinDes.zhText: 塔克桑守护使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertTaxonSkinNam.zhText: 塔克桑 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertTonkorSkinDe.text: Desert camouflage skin for the Tonkor.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertTonkorSkinDe.zhText: 征服榴炮使用的沙漠伪装外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DesertTonkorSkinNa.zhText: 征服榴炮 沙漠迷彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DevourerDeluxeSkin.text: On Lunar Renewal, Grendel takes the form of the beast from below and comes out to stuff his greedy belly.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DevourerDeluxeSkin.zhText: 春节到了，从地狱而来的 Grendel 将化身为凶兽，遍地游荡来满足他的无穷食欲。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DevourerSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for the Grendel Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DexLisetSkinDesc.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo statis.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DexLisetSkinDesc.zhText: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻催眠中醒来。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DirigaDeluxeSkinDe.text: Your sentinel embodies the jellyfish and its deadly sting with this deluxe skin set.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DirigaDeluxeSkinDe.zhText: 通过这套华丽外观，来让你的守护体现出水母和它致命的刺痛感。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DualRibbonKamasSki.text: An enchanted skin for any Dual Sword combination.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DualRibbonKamasSki.zhText: 适用于任意双剑组合的迷人外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DuelistHoodOrnamen.text: The icy frisson of your presence precedes you into battle.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/DuelistHoodOrnamen.zhText: 你令人不寒而栗的气息在你踏入战场之前便已蔓延开来。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/DuviriSwordTowerSh.text: Evoke the might of a giant.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EidolonLotusSkinDe.text: Partially regenerated and subsisting on Archon Shard energy.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EidolonLotusSkinDe.zhText: 已经部分恢复，现在依靠着执刑官源力石的能量维生。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAmprexDe.text: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAmprexDe.zhText: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAmprexNa.zhText: 安培克斯 终极外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAtomosDe.text: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAtomosDe.zhText: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAtomosNa.zhText: 原子矿融炮 终极外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAtteraxD.text: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAtteraxD.zhText: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EliteAlertAtteraxN.zhText: 阿特拉克斯 终极外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisNikanaDesc.text: Gild the Nikana with this intricate bronze skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisNikanaDesc.zhText: 为侍刃镀上复杂精密的青铜外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisOdonataDesc.text: Gild the Odonata with this intricate bronze skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisOdonataDesc.zhText: 为陨蜓镀上复杂精密的青铜外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisOpticorDesc.text: Gild the Opticor with this intricate bronze skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisOpticorDesc.zhText: 为奥堤克光子枪镀上复杂精密的青铜外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisOpticorName.zhText: 奥堤克光子枪 镀铜外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisParacesisDes.text: Gild the Paracesis with this intricate bronze skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisParacesisDes.zhText: 为心智之殁镀上复杂精细的青铜外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisParacesisNam.zhText: 心智之殁 镀铜外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisSonicorDesc.text: Gild the Sonicor with this intricate bronze skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisSonicorDesc.zhText: 为超音波冲击枪镀上复杂精密的青铜外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisSonicorName.zhText: 超音波冲击枪 镀铜外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisTiberonSkinD.text: Gild the Tiberon with this intricate bronze skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisTiberonSkinD.zhText: 为狂鲨镀上复杂精密的青铜外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisTigrisDesc.text: Gild the Tigris with this intricate bronze skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ElixisTigrisDesc.zhText: 为猛虎镀上复杂精密的青铜外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Ember 朱红的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeIIDefau.text: Default arm armor for Ember Pyraxis.
Default chest armor for Ember Pyraxis.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeIIFlame.text: A flamethrower skin that's twice as hot as the carnage it contains.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeIIFlame.zhText: 一件能发射其内在杀戮双倍热量的火焰喷射器外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeIIHelme.zhText: Ember 燃烬的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeIISkinD.text: Ember refined to her most searing elemental form, the primordial flame.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeIISkinD.zhText: Ember 精炼成了她最灼热的元素形态，原初之火。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxePistolD.text: The signature pistol skin of Ember Vermillion.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxePistolD.zhText: Ember 朱红的标志性手枪外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeSuitDes.text: From the ashes of battle a flamboyant new Ember rises.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EmberDeluxeSuitDes.zhText: 在战斗的烟尘中冉冉升起的全新 Ember。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EquinoxDeluxeHelme.zhText: Equinox 悖异的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EquinoxDeluxeSkinD.text: Few things are more destructive than a secret. Unleash your opposite with this skin for Equinox.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EquinoxDeluxeSkinD.zhText: 没有什么比秘密更具破坏性的了。用这个 Equinox 的外观来释放你的另一面吧！

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EquinoxDeluxeSword.text: Husband and wife, dawn and dusk. A signature Sword and Shield skin for Equinox.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EquinoxDeluxeSword.zhText: 丈夫与妻子，黎明与黄昏。Equinox 的标志性剑盾外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroNecramechH.text: This Necramech helmet is derived from models that fought amongst dying stars.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroNecramechH.zhText: 这款殁世机甲头盔的设计灵感源自曾在垂死星球间征战的机型。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroNecramechS.text: This Necramech skin is derived from models that fought amongst dying stars.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroNecramechS.zhText: 这款殁世机甲外观的设计灵感源自曾在垂死星球间征战的机型。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroParazonSki.text: This nefarious parazon model bears the marks of battle, Void travel, or both.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroParazonSki.zhText: 这个邪恶的灭骸之刃上留有战斗、虚空旅行，或是两者的痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroSilvaAegis.text: The flames emanating from this skin for the Silva & Aegis waver uncertainly, as though they might wish to be elsewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/EvilBaroSilvaAegis.zhText: 这个席瓦 & 神盾外观中散发出的火焰摇曳不定，仿佛它们希望去往别处。
席瓦 & 神盾 终劫外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDeluxeHel.zhText: Excalibur 盲侠的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDeluxeNik.text: This Nikana skin is an ode to a beautiful life cut short. A signature Nikana skin for Excalibur Zato.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDeluxeNik.zhText: 这个侍刃外观是对美好生活的赞歌。Excalibur 盲侠的标志性侍刃外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDeluxeSki.text: He who has nothing to lose is truly free. This skin for Excalibur embodies the nomadic, unbowed spirit of those who call every world home.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDeluxeSki.zhText: 再无可失的人是真正自由的。这个 Excalibur 外观体现了那些四海为家之人流浪的、不屈的精神。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDeluxeSki.text:
He who has nothing to lose is truly free. This skin for Excalibur embodies the nomadic, unbowed spirit of those who call every world home.

Includes Excalibur Zato Agile and Noble animation sets.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDeluxeSki.zhText:
再无可失的人是真正自由的。这个 Excalibur 外观体现了那些四海为家之人流浪的、不屈的精神。

包括 Excalibur 盲侠迅捷和尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDexHelmet.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the fifth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDexHelmet.zhText: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 5 周年。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDexSkinDe.text: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the fifth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburDexSkinDe.zhText: 这份来自 Lotus 的礼物是为了纪念第一位 Tenno 从冷冻睡眠中醒来 5 周年。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburLasriaSki.text:
Arthur Nightingale, gruff leader of the Hex, brings a human face to the Excalibur Warframe.

Switch between Excalibur and Arthur's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Arthur Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ExcaliburLasriaSki.zhText:
粗放的六人组领袖亚瑟·南丁格尔为 Excalibur 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的亚瑟双子表情动作，在 Excalibur 和亚瑟的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/FurisVekeskDesc.text: Give your pistol some primeval kick.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/FurisVekeskDesc.zhText: 给你的手枪带来一丝原始的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/FurisVekeskName.zhText: 协议维克斯克手枪外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaraDeluxeHelmetDe.zhText: Gara 斑斓的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaraDeluxeSkinDesc.text: Walk in fractured beauty amid a dance of light, color, and razor edges.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaraDeluxeSkinDesc.zhText: 那破碎的美丽，慢步在充满光影、斑斓和利刃的舞台上。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaraDeluxeSkinMark.text:
Walk in fractured beauty amid a dance of light, color, and razor edges.

Includes the Starglaze Shards auxiliary attachment.

那破碎的美丽，慢步在充满光影、斑斓和利刃的舞台上。

包含琉璃星翼特殊配件。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaraDeluxeSwordSki.text: Split light into rainbow colours with this sword skin of razor-sharp glass.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaraDeluxeSwordSki.zhText: 通过这件锋利玻璃的长剑外观，来把光线划分为彩虹的颜色。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaraDeluxeWingsDes.text: Bedazzle with Gara Kaleida's auxiliary back pieces.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaClawsSkinDes.text: The standard issue skin for Garuda's talons.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaDeluxeClawsS.zhText: Garuda 残暴的标志性利爪。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaDeluxeHelmet.zhText: Garuda 残暴的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaDeluxeSkinDe.text: The ceremonial dress of a spirit for whom violence is a sacrament.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaDeluxeSkinDe.zhText: 体现暴力即是圣脉之精神的礼服。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaDeluxeWarfan.text: With a snap and a flutter this segmented work of art ribbons the hapless. The signature warfan skin of Garuda.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaDeluxeWarfan.zhText: 这件艺术品可以轻而易举地把那些运气不好的人撕成碎片。Garuda 的标志性武扇外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GarudaSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for the Garuda Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaussDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Gauss 火神的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaussDeluxeSkinDes.text: Fire courses through Gauss Kresnik. Gain momentum with his thermal energy.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaussDeluxeSkinDes.zhText: 火焰穿流过 Gauss 火神身上。以他的热能获得动力。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaussSentinelSkinD.text: In this skin, your Sentinel will be indistinguishable from the air sentries that surrounded the ancient tower of Altra, as described by Drusus Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GaussSentinelSkinD.zhText: 在这件外观下，你的守护将与德枢·莱弗所描述的围绕在古老阿尔特拉塔的空中哨兵一样难以区分。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiAshDaggerSki.text: This Karyst skin bears the markings of a long forgotten assassin's order, the Scoria.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiAshDaggerSki.zhText: 这款凯洛斯特外观上印有早已被世人遗忘的刺客组织火山石的标志。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiGarudaBallis.text: This skin for the Ballistica embodies the philosophy that if your weapon is clean, you're not using it properly.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiGarudaBallis.zhText: 这款布里斯提卡外观体现了"如果你的武器很干净，说明你没有正确使用它"的理念。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiGarudaNagant.text: A bloodthirsty Nagantaka skin for those who prefer to use a crossbow at close range.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiGarudaNagant.zhText: 一款嗜血的噬蛇弩外观，适合喜欢近距离使用弩的玩家。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiGarudaVenkaS.text: Send a gruesome message about the fate of all who encounter these claws with this skin for the Venka.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeminiGarudaVenkaS.zhText: 使用这款凯旋之爪外观，向所有遭遇这些利爪的人传达一个可怕的命运信息。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GeodeSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for the Citrine Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrendelDeluxeHelme.zhText: Grendel 年兽的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrendelDeluxeSkinD.text: On Lunar Renewal, Grendel takes the form of the beast from below and comes out to stuff his greedy belly.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrendelDeluxeSkinD.zhText: 春节到了，从地狱而来的 Grendel 将化身为凶兽，遍地游荡来满足他的无穷食欲。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrimoireEvilBaroSk.text: The seething cover of this skin for the Grimoire does all it can to disinvite touch.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrimoireEvilBaroSk.zhText: 这个魔典外观的封面沸腾翻滚，极尽所能地阻止任何人的触碰。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrimoireFantasySki.text: Set watchful eyes upon the battle.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrimoireSciFiSkinD.text: Give your tome a high-tech appearance.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrimoireSciFiSkinD.zhText: 为你的典籍赋予高科技外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrnGunStockClubDes.text: Bludgeon, hack, and maim with this improvised machete skin fashioned out of broken Grineer weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GrnGunStockClubDes.zhText: 用这款由 Grineer 武器残骸所随兴打造出来的砍刀外观去棒打、劈砍、残害敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GyreDeluxeHelmetDe.zhText: Gyre 电涡幽灵的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GyreDeluxeSkinDesc.text: Garb the electrical dancer in a form evoking the valves and cables of years past, when science was wild and dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/GyreDeluxeSkinDesc.zhText: 将这位电子舞者打扮成一种形态，唤起对往日那个科学界充满狂野与危险的年代中阀门与电缆的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/GyreSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for the Gyre Warframe.

卡帕压力枪 破晓外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KompressaDeluxeSki.text: Capture your prey with Yareli Pandea’s signature Kompressa skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/KompressaDeluxeSki.zhText: 使用 Yareli 盘古底的标志性卡帕压力枪外观来捕获猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KoumeiWarfanSkinDe.text: The deceptive delicacy of the warfan belies the danger within; this stark warfan skin is proof of both.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/KoumeiWarfanSkinDe.zhText: 武扇看似精致，实则暗藏危险；这款武扇的严酷外观便是最好的证明。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoDeluxeBlad.zhText: Kullervo 叛徒的标志性饰物。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoDeluxeDefa.zhText: Kullervo 叛徒的标志性护肩。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoDeluxeHelm.zhText: Kullervo 叛徒的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoDeluxeSkin.text: The eternal outcast has nothing left to fear.  Kullervo embodies rebellion and the will to endure whatever the oppressor can dish out.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoDeluxeSkin.zhText: 永远的放逐者已无所畏惧。Kullervo 是反叛与抵御压迫的化身。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoDeluxeSpar.text: Incarcerated, with his sword Vaenn hidden away, Kullervo learned to fight with fists and feet. This sparring weapon skin pays homage to the sacrifices he made in captivity.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoDeluxeSpar.zhText: Kullervo 被囚禁期间，他的婉剑被藏匿起来，他学会了用拳脚搏斗。这款搏击武器外观旨在向他在被囚期间做出的牺牲致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoTwoHandedS.text: Give your Heavy Blade the look of Kullervo's legendary sword.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/KullervoTwoHandedS.zhText: 让你的巨刃拥有 Kullervo 传奇之剑的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2023SarynHelmet.zhText: Saryn 玉恒的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2023SarynSkinDe.text: Take on the look of a moon goddess to celebrate Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2023SarynSkinDe.zhText: 装扮成月亮女神来庆祝农历新年。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024ChromaHelme.zhText: Chroma 尊龙的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024ChromaSkinD.text: The dragon soars with the wisdom of the ages.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024ChromaSkinD.zhText: 龙腾九天，承载千古智慧。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024ChromaWings.zhText: Chroma 尊龙的标志性翅膀。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024NukorDesc.text: Ward off evil with this Nukor skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024NukorDesc.zhText: 使用这款努寇微波枪外观来辟邪迎祥。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024NukorName.zhText: 努寇微波枪 岁朝外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024OgrisDesc.text: Invite prosperity on the battlefield with this Ogris skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024OgrisDesc.zhText: 使用这款食人魔外观，为战场带来繁荣。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2024OgrisName.zhText: 食人女魔 岁朝外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2025BoltorSkinD.text: Transform in the crucible of battle with this skin for the Boltor.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2025BoltorSkinD.zhText: 使用这款螺钉步枪外观在严峻的战斗考验中完成蜕变。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNY2025BoltorSkinN.zhText: 螺钉步枪 岁朝外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNYDragonSentinelA.text: Prepare your Sentinel for a dance of Lunar Renewal revelry with armor that invokes the dragon.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNYDragonSentinelA.zhText: 为你的守护装扮上唤醒巨龙的护甲，共舞新春华章。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNYDragonSentinelS.text: Prepare your Sentinel for a dance of Lunar Renewal revelry.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNYDragonSentinelS.zhText: 装扮守护，共舞新春华章。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNYHookSwordDesc.text: Carve your own destiny with this Dual Swords skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LNYHookSwordDesc.zhText: 用这款双剑外观开创你自己的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LasOcelotRapierSki.text: Commissioned by Lieutenant Viktor Vodyanoi for his personal use, this elegant officer's weapon incorporates Sol and Lua motifs.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LasOcelotRapierSki.zhText: 这款优雅的军官武器由维克多·维德诺伊中尉委托制造供其个人使用，融合了太阳神和月神的图案。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LasriaSkanaSwordSk.text: Take the fight to a new era with Arthur Nightingale’s signature Skana skin for longswords.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LasriaSkanaSwordSk.zhText: 通过亚瑟·南丁格尔标志性的长剑空刃外观，将战斗带入新时代。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LatoTeknaDesc.text: An ancient look for a reliable pistol.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LatoTeknaDesc.zhText: 一把可靠手枪的古老外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LexHammerDesc.text: A real beauty from a former age.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LimboDeluxeCardSki.text: New rule: with this one-of-a-kind the house always loses.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LimboDeluxeCardSki.zhText: 新规则：有了这独一无二的外观，庄家总是输家。
投掷武器 塔罗外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LimboDeluxeHelmetD.zhText: Limbo 阈限的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LimboDeluxeSkinDes.text: War-garb for the liminal; a new form for the in-between.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LimboDeluxeSkinDes.zhText: 阈限者的战衣; 中庸之道的新样式。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetDuelistSkinDe.text: A chilling skin for the Liset landing craft.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetDuelistSkinDe.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的 Liset 登陆艇外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetSkinAshGemini.text: Slip into battle like a shadow.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetSkinGarudaGem.text: Fly into the next battle covered in what remains of the last.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetSkinGarudaGem.zhText: 带着上一场战斗的余温，飞向下一场战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetSkinTwitchDes.text: A dazzling skin for your Liset.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetSkinTwitchDes.zhText: 为 Liset 打造的耀眼外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetSkinTwitchPri.text: Blast through the Origin System with this alluring Liset skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LisetSkinTwitchPri.zhText: 用这迷人的 Liset 外观飒爽穿越始源星系。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiTwitchHelmetDe.text: In this exquisite alternate helmet, the trickster is sleeker than ever.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiTwitchHelmetDe.zhText: 佩戴上这款精美的替换头盔，诈术师比任何时候都要时尚。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiTwitchSkinDesc.text: Cut a dashing figure as Loki with the stylish, exclusive Verv skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiTwitchSkinDesc.zhText: 以时尚且又别具一格的热忱外观，来勾勒出 Loki 的英姿飒爽。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiVoidshellHelme.text: Don with morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiVoidshellHelme.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiVoidshellSkinD.text: Don with morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LokiVoidshellSkinD.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/LotusSkinDesc.text: A friend to all Tenno, basing her face and voice upon their beloved Archimedean Margulis.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/LotusSkinDesc.zhText: 所有 Tenno 的挚友，她的面容和声音都基于他们最爱的哲士 Margulis。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2020AcceltraS.text: Embody the good fortune of a new year with this fine gold and jade Acceltra skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2020AcceltraS.zhText: 通过这款精巧的金玉迅发电浆炮外观来集新年的好运于一身。
迅发电浆炮 岁朝外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2020OrthosSki.text: Keep the flames of tradition burning with this exquisite festival skin for the Orthos.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2020OrthosSki.zhText: 通过这款精致的欧特鲁斯节庆外观来燃起新春的祥焰。
欧特鲁斯 岁朝外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2020PyranaSki.text: Honor the forces of good luck and enduring prosperity with this celebratory Pyrana skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2020PyranaSki.zhText: 愿这款喜庆的食人鱼外观为你带来连连好运和绵长幸福。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2022HeavyBlad.text: A tiger-inspired double-bladed axe design, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2022HeavyBlad.zhText: 灵感来自于老虎的双头斧设计，以庆贺新春。
巨刃 红彩万象外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2022IgnisSkin.text: A tiger-inspired alternate skin for the Ignis, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2022IgnisSkin.zhText: 灵感来自于老虎的伊格尼斯替换外观，以庆贺新春。
伊格尼斯 璀璨生辉外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2022ZarrSkinD.text: A tiger-inspired alternate skin for the Zarr, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2022ZarrSkinD.zhText: 灵感来自于老虎的沙皇替换外观，以庆贺新春。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2022ZarrSkinN.zhText: 沙皇 璀璨生辉外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2023CedoSkinD.text: A blast from this festive Cedo helps ward off evil.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2023CedoSkinD.zhText: 用带有节日样式的塞多来驱除邪恶。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2023CernosSki.text: Strength and good fortune can be yours as you draw this celebratory Cernos.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2023CernosSki.zhText: 当你拉开这张欢庆的西诺斯长弓时，力量和好运将会降临在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2023Nagantaka.text: Encourage prosperity to come your way with this Nagantaka skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Lunar2023Nagantaka.zhText: 用这个噬蛇弩外观来走向繁荣。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MagDeluxeHelmetDes.zhText: Mag 元气的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MagDeluxeSuitDesc.text: Breathe new life into Mag with her lavish new form.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MagDeluxeSuitDesc.zhText: 用这华贵的全新形态为 Mag 注入新生。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MagDeluxeTonfaDesc.text: Mag Pneuma’s signature skin for tonfa weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MagDeluxeTonfaDesc.zhText: Mag 元气的标志性拐刃外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MagistarDaybreakSk.text: Visit brilliant wrath upon enemies with this skin for the Magistar.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MagistarDaybreakSk.zhText: 通过这款执法者外观，将耀眼的怒火降临到敌人身上。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeArmGunSk.text: Regulator skins to match the Mesa Presidio Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeArmGunSk.zhText: 与 Mesa 边塞外观相配的监察者双枪外观
Mesa 边塞监察者双枪外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeBDesc.text: Mesa reimagined as the Sentients would have designed her.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeBDesc.zhText: Mesa 被重新想象成 Sentient 所设计的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeBHelmDes.text: Mesa reimagined as the Sentients would have designed her.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeBHelmDes.zhText: Mesa 被重新想象成 Sentient 所设计的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeDualPist.text: Transform any dual pistol with this baroque revolver skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeDualPist.zhText: 将任意双持手枪转换为巴洛克式的左轮手枪外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeHelmetDe.zhText: Mesa 边塞的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxePistolDe.text: Transform any pistol with this baroque revolver skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxePistolDe.zhText: 将任意手枪转换为巴洛克式的左轮手枪外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeSuitDesc.text: Conquer the unknown with this fortress of exquisite style.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeSuitDesc.zhText: 用这风格精美的堡垒去征服未知。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeV2ArmGun.text: Regulator skins to match the Mesa Projectilyst Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaDeluxeV2ArmGun.zhText: 与 Mesa 投射使外观相配的监察者双枪外观。
Mesa 投射使监察者双枪外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MesaImmortalSkinDe.text: The Immortal skin for the Mesa Warframe.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MiageLNYHelmetDesc.zhText: Mirage 女娲的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MiageLNYSkinDesc.text: Embody the essence of creation and restoration with this divine, serpentine look.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MiageLNYSkinDesc.zhText: 通过神圣的灵蛇绕身外观体现创造力和恢复力的真谛。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MirageImmortalSkin.text: The Immortal Skin for the Mirage Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MirageImmortalSkin.zhText: Mirage 战甲的的不朽外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleColourSh.text: A color shifting livery for the Atomicycle.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleColourSh.zhText: 原子摩托车的混色涂装。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleDefaultS.text: The factory created livery of the Atomicycle.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleDefaultS.zhText: 原子摩托车的出厂外观涂装。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleFlamesSk.text: Green flames dance across this Atomicycle livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleFlamesSk.zhText: 绿色的火焰在这款原子摩托车外观涂装上舞动。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleGraffiti.text: Rep the streets with this graffiti inspired livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleGraffiti.zhText: 用这种受涂鸦启发的外观涂装来表现街头风格。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleLightsSk.text: Strips of neon illuminate this sleek Atomicycle livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleLightsSk.zhText: 霓虹灯条照亮了这款时尚的原子摩托车外观涂装。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleMedicSki.text: Be first on the scene with this medic inspired Atomicycle livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleMedicSki.zhText: 用这款医疗主题的原子摩托车外观涂装率先到达现场。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleMonsterS.text: Customize your Atomicycle with this voracious livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleMonsterS.zhText: 使用这款贪婪的外观涂装定制你的原子摩托车。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleNakedBik.text: Stripped down and souped up, this livery is ready for a streetrace.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleNakedBik.zhText: 经过拆卸和改装，这款外观涂装是为街头比赛而生。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleNightwav.text: Dreamers, are you ready to ride? Cruise the streets of Höllvania with this Nightwave themed livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleNightwav.zhText: 梦回者们，准备好骑行了吗？用这款午夜电波主题的外观涂装在霍瓦尼亚的街道上驰骋。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleOllieSki.text: Just try to be as cool as Ollie with this signature Atomicycle livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleOllieSki.zhText: 尝试通过这款标志性的原子摩托车涂装变得和奥利一样酷吧。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcyclePrismaSk.text: The Void-hardened Prisma crystals of this Atomicyle livery light up the night with a captivating gleam.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcyclePrismaSk.zhText: 这款原子摩托车涂装的虚空硬化棱晶以迷人的光芒照亮了夜晚。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleRacingSk.text: A race inspired livery for the Atomicycle.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleRacingSk.zhText: 灵感源自赛车的原子摩托车外观涂装。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleRustSkin.text: Scratches mean nothing to this rough and ready Atomicycle livery.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleRustSkin.zhText: 划痕对于这款粗犷的原子摩托车外观涂装来说不算什么。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/MotorcycleTennoSki.zhText: 一款超脱时间的原子摩托车。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecraMechSkinCDesc.text: Rediscover the brutal power of the earliest Necramech designs with this skin. Bruntspar is - in Father's words - 'not out to play nice and make friends.'
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecraMechSkinCDesc.zhText: 这款外观很有最初代殁世机甲的那种残暴力量的风采。冲拳，用父亲的话说就是："不是用来耍花招过家家的。"

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecramechSnakeHelm.zhText: 锰蛇殁世机甲的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecramechSnakeSkin.text: Rusty but trusty. This skin revives the glory of the legendary Old War Necramech, Snake.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecramechSnakeSkin.zhText: 有些生锈但值得信赖。这款外观重现了传说中远古之战时期，锰蛇殁世机甲的荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecramechVoidRigDe.zhText: 虚空锐将的标志性头盔。
虚空锐将殁世机甲头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecramechVoidRigDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Voidrig Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NecramechVoidRigDe.zhText: 虚空锐将殁世机甲的标准外观配置。
虚空锐将殁世机甲外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosDeluxeHelmet.zhText: Nekros 伊卡拉的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosDeluxeScythe.text: The signature scythe skin of Nekros Irkalla.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosDeluxeScythe.zhText: Nekros 伊卡拉的标志性镰刀外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosDeluxeSuitDe.text: A specter of destruction, Nekros breaks free of the underworld with this haunting skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosDeluxeSuitDe.zhText: 一只带来毁灭的幽灵，Nekros 用这鬼魅的外观打破地府的藩篱。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosVoidshellHel.text: Don with morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosVoidshellHel.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosVoidshellSki.text: Don with morphic material created in the Zariman Void Jump. The material manifests chemical structures from liquid to stone.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NekrosVoidshellSki.zhText: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NewPlayerXPBoSkinD.text: A textured red and black Staff skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NewPlayerXPBoSkinD.zhText: 一款带有纹理的红黑色长棍外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NewPlayerXPBratonS.text: A bold red Rifle skin with extra panache.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/NewPlayerXPBratonS.zhText: 一款派头十足的鲜红色步枪外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NewPlayerXPKunaiSk.zhText: 一款夺目的投掷武器外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NewPlayerXPLatoSki.zhText: 一款带有独特纹理的手枪外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/NewPlayerXPParisSk.text: An exotic and eye-catching Bow skin.
