/Lotus/Language/Skins/TekeluStradavarSki.zhText: 斯特拉迪瓦 提奇鲁外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TekeluVastoSkinNam.zhText: 瓦斯托 提奇鲁外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennoCon2024NinjaS.text: An ancient look for a timeless weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennoCon2024NinjaS.zhText: 一把永恒武器的古老外观。
协议刃风投掷武器外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumArcaPlasm.text: A festive skin for the Arca Plasmor.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumArcaPlasm.zhText: 弧电离子枪的节庆外观。
弧电离子枪 冬至外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumAtomosSki.text: A festive skin for the Atomos.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumAtomosSki.zhText: 原子矿融炮的节庆外观。
原子矿融炮 冬至外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumCycronSki.text: A festive skin for the Cycron.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumCycronSki.zhText: 循环离子枪的节庆外观。
循环离子枪 冬至外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumDualKeres.text: A festive skin for the Dual Keres.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumDualKeres.zhText: 凯瑞斯双刀的节庆外观。
凯瑞斯双刀 冬至外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumFulminSki.text: A festive skin for the Fulmin.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TennobaumGramSkinD.text: A festive skin for the Gram.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TeshinGlaiveDuelis.text: The icy glint of this Orvius skin stops enemies in their tracks.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TeshinGlaiveDuelis.zhText: 这一灵枢外观散发出的冰冷光芒足以让敌人止步不前。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ThanomechVoidRigDe.text: The standard issue helmet for the Bonewidow Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ThanomechVoidRigDe.zhText: 骨骸寡妇殁世机甲的标准头盔。
骨骸寡妇殁世机甲头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ThanomechVoidRigDe.text: The standard issue skin for the Bonewidow Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ThanomechVoidRigDe.zhText: 骨骸寡妇殁世机甲的标准外观配置。
骨骸寡妇殁世机甲外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ThanotechSentinelS.text: This faithful Necraloid has served the Entrati family for centuries. He now stands ready to offer his service to you.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ThanotechSentinelS.zhText: 这个忠实的殁世械灵已经为英择谛家族服务了几个世纪。现在他已经准备好为你提供服务了。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TigrisTwitchSkinDe.text: Draw attention with the bold geometric patterns in this exclusive Tigris skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TigrisTwitchSkinDe.zhText: 用这独占的猛虎外观上刚劲的几何图案来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeArchw.text: Flash and dart with this regal skin for the Dex Pixia.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeArchw.zhText: 用这款有着尊贵外观的 Dex 妖精来极速飞舞吧。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeArchw.text: Titania's sword skin - fit for an Empress.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeArchw.zhText: Titania 的长剑外观——与女皇的身份十分相称。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeGunbl.text: A regal, otherworldly gunblade skin - and a striking accompaniment to Titania's Empress skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeGunbl.zhText: 一款尊贵且别具一格的枪刃外观——Titania 女皇外观的绝佳陪衬。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeHelme.zhText: Titania 女皇的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIIArc.text: Soar with weapons that shine like fell stars above your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIIArc.zhText: 带着像流星那样闪闪发光的武器在你的敌人之上翱翔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIIArc.text: The dream will end for all who meet this blade.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIIArc.zhText: 所有对抗这把刀的人梦想都会终结。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIIAux.zhText: 带着恶意的优雅张开翅膀。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIIHel.zhText: Titania 大地女神的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIISki.text: Dream of a deadly night's flight.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIISki.zhText: 梦见在致命之夜的飞行。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIISki.text:
Dream of a deadly night's flight.

Includes Titania's Moyturan Wings, the Aerospri Dex Pixia Skin, and the Hawth Diwata Skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeIISki.zhText:
梦见在致命之夜的飞行。

包含 Titania 莫伊图兰翅膀、Dex 妖精空灵外观，以及仙女赤爪外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeSkinD.text: Ascend in regal splendour with this skin for Titania.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TitaniaDeluxeSkinD.zhText: 以这款 Titania 外观降临于世，尽显尊贵辉煌。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnMilitaryDaggerDe.text: Artistry meets lethality with this elegant dual dagger skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnMilitaryDaggerDe.zhText: 在这款优雅的双持匕首外观，精美手工艺与致命杀伤力双剑合壁。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnRailjackDataKnif.text: This Parazon model was gifted to the first Warframe Railjack crews.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnRailjackDataKnif.zhText: 授予第一批 Warframe 航道星舰舰员的灭骸之刃。
西格玛系列灭骸之刃外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnRibbonStaffSkinD.text: An elegant staff of ancient Tenno design, the Lemnas dangles with a ribbon that distracts as you attack.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnRibbonStaffSkinD.zhText: 一款由远古 Tenno 设计的优雅长棍，浮萍上挂着一条丝带，可以在你攻击时分散对手的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnSubmachinegunPis.text: As no Zundi weapons survive from the Old War this formidable pistol skin was created to honor them. Stout, distinctive and intimidating it is a reminder of times past.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TnSubmachinegunPis.zhText: 由于没有尊谛武器从远古之战留存下来，这种令人敬畏的手枪外观被制作出来以作纪念。强力、与众不同，且又使人望而生畏，令人回想起过去的时代。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Twitch2021AfurisSk.text: An enthralling exclusive Verv skin for the Afuris.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Twitch2021AfurisSk.zhText: 一款为盗贼双枪所设计的迷人的专属热忱外观。
盗贼双枪 热忱外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/Twitch2021FurisSki.text: An alluring exclusive Verv skin for your sidearm.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/Twitch2021FurisSki.zhText: 一款为你的次要武器所设计的迷人的专属热忱外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TwitchOctaviaAltHe.zhText: 重制 Octavia 的致命作曲。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TwitchOctaviaHelme.zhText: Octavia 炫彩的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TwitchOctaviaSkinD.text: Form is in tune with function.

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TwitchPentaSkinDes.text: Intensify your ballistic barrage with this exclusive skin for the Penta.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TwitchPentaSkinDes.zhText: 用这款潘塔的专属外观来加强你的弹道轰击。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/TwitchRubicoSkinDe.text: Snipe enemies in style with this exclusive Rubico skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/TwitchRubicoSkinDe.zhText: 通过专属的绝路外观来以别具一格的方式狙击敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/UmbraDaxGlaiveDesc.text: This imposing glaive was once the trusted battle tool of a mighty Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/UmbraDaxGlaiveDesc.zhText: 这把庄严的战刃曾经一位强大禁卫值得信赖的战斗工具。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/UmbraDaxKatanaDesc.text: A blade forged for the most decorated of Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/UmbraDaxKatanaDesc.zhText: 为战功彪炳的禁卫而锻造的刀刃。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/UnlockKhoraDeluxeA.text: This item lets you use Khora Urushu's agile animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/UnlockKhoraDeluxeA.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Khora 漆花的迅捷站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/UnlockKhoraDeluxeN.text: This item lets you use Khora Urushu's noble animation set with any Warframe of your choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/UnlockKhoraDeluxeN.zhText: 能让任意战甲使用 Khora 漆花的尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/UnmaskedLotusSkinD.text: Modeled on the Tenno's beloved Archimedean Margulis to honor her memory and give them comfort.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/UnmaskedLotusSkinD.zhText: 以 Tenno 最爱的哲士——Margulis 为原型，谨此纪念她并为 Tenno 带来慰藉。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VTBoarExilisDesc.text: Elevate the Boar's rough and ready functionality with this bronzed Elixis skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VTBoarExilisDesc.zhText: 使用这款古铜色的外观，让野猪的粗犷实用功能更上一层楼。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrDeluxeFistSk.text: This beautifully brutal design will compliment any blood on your knuckles.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrDeluxeFistSk.zhText: 这种洋溢着暴力美学的设计会让每一滴挂在你手指关节上的鲜血都熠熠生辉。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrDeluxeHelmet.zhText: Valkyr 行刑者的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrDeluxeSkinDe.text: This beautifully brutal design will compliment any blood on your knuckles.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrDeluxeSkinDe.zhText: 这种洋溢着暴力美学的设计会让每一滴挂在你手指关节上的鲜血都熠熠生辉。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrDeluxeSkinMa.text:
This beautifully brutal design will compliment any blood on your knuckles.

Includes Valkyr Carnivex Agile and Noble animation sets.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrDeluxeSkinMa.zhText:
这种洋溢着暴力美学的设计会让每一滴挂在你手指关节上的鲜血都熠熠生辉。

内含 Valkyr 行刑者迅捷站姿和 Valkyr 行刑者尊贵站姿。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrHeirloomHelm.zhText: Valkyr 传家宝的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrHeirloomSkin.text: Valkyr rises in majesty, casting off her legacy of torment. Heirloom skins signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/ValkyrHeirloomSkin.zhText: Valkyr 的崛起威风凛凛，摆脱了她苦难的过往。传家宝外观象征着时间的流逝和 Tenno 的付出。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VaubanDeluxeAxeDes.text: Sunder all attackers with the signature weapon skin of Vauban Citadel.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VaubanDeluxeAxeDes.zhText: 使用 Vauban 城塞外观的标志性武器外观来斩击攻击者。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VaubanDeluxeHelmet.zhText: Vauban 城塞的标志性头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VaubanDeluxeMeleeD.text: The signature sugatra of Vauban Citadel.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VaubanDeluxeMeleeD.zhText: Vauban 城塞的标志性坠饰。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VaubanDeluxeSkinDe.text: A fortress of ingenuity and style.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VaubanDeluxeSkinDe.zhText: 一个创新且具有边塞风格的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VenariSkinDesc.text: The standard issue skin for Venari.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VenariSkinDesc.zhText: 薇娜丽的标准外观配置。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDOTDHelmetD.text: A morbidly festive helmet for the Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDOTDHelmetD.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的殁世机甲节庆风格头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDOTDHelmetN.text: Day of the Dead Necramech Helmet

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDOTDSkinDes.text: A morbidly festive skin for the Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDOTDSkinDes.zhText: 令人毛骨悚然的殁世机甲节庆风格外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDOTDSkinNam.text: Day of the Dead Necramech Skin

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDSChromaHel.zhText: 原型殁世机甲的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDSChromaSki.text: The metallic substance that makes up this Voidrig casing is of ancient and mysterious origins. It seems to predate the Orokin empire itself.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigDSChromaSki.zhText: 构成这款虚空锐将外壳的金属物质，有着神秘而古老的起源。它似乎早于奥罗金帝国本身。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigTwitchHelme.text: A chromatic variant of the Voidrig’s signature helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigTwitchHelme.zhText: 虚空锐将标志性头盔的色彩变体。
虚空锐将殁世机甲炫彩头盔

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigTwitchSkinD.text: A chromatic upgrade to the standard issued skin for the Voidrig Necramech.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigTwitchSkinD.zhText: 虚空锐将殁世机甲标准外观的色彩升级。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoidrigTwitchSkinN.zhText: 虚空锐将殁世机甲炫彩外观

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeBDesc.text: Volt as he would have been, had the Sentients created him.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeBDesc.zhText: 如果是 Sentient 创造了 Volt，他就会是这个样子。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeBHelmDes.text: Volt as he would have been, had the Sentients created him.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeBHelmDes.zhText: 如果是 Sentient 创造了 Volt，他就会是这个样子。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeHelmetDe.zhText: Volt 原型的标志性头盔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeMaceDesc.text: Make sparks fly with Volt Proto’s signature hammer skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeMaceDesc.zhText: 运用 Volt 原型的标志性战锤外观使电火花飞溅起来。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeSuitDesc.text: Delve into the past with this experimental prototype skin for Volt.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltDeluxeSuitDesc.zhText: 利用这套实验性的 Volt 原型外观探索往昔。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltTwitchHelmetDe.text: Draw attention with the bold geometric patterns in this exclusive Volt helmet.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltTwitchHelmetDe.zhText: 用这独占的 Volt 头盔上刚劲的几何图案来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltTwitchSkinDesc.text: Draw attention with the bold geometric patterns in this exclusive Volt skin.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VoltTwitchSkinDesc.zhText: 用这独占的 Volt 外观上刚劲的几何图案来吸引注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/VorunaDeluxeAxeSki.text: Those who feel the vicious bite of Voruna Medeina’s signature heavy blade skin know why its wielder has no need for subtlety.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/VorunaDeluxeAxeSki.zhText: 那些感受过 Voruna 梅迪娜标志性的重型巨刃凶猛攻击的人，就会明白为什么它的使用者不需要任何技巧。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999AshSkinDesc.text: The keenest blade is a well-ordered mind. Equal parts killer and mentor, Ryoku gives voice to the silent assassin, Ash.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999AshSkinDesc.zhText: 最锋利的利刃，是沉着冷静的头脑。既是杀手又是导师的忍力，为沉默的刺客 Ash 发声。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999FrostHatDesc.text: Nobody is certain exactly what this canister contains, but it appears to complement the Frost Protoframe's abilities in some way. Velimir insists it keeps him 'minty fresh.'
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999FrostHatDesc.zhText: 没人知道这个罐子里到底装了什么，但它似乎在某种程度上增强了 Frost 原型战甲的能力。维利米尔坚持说它让他保持"醒脑提神"。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999FrostSkinDes.text:
Velimir Volkov II, a former Libertatian agent, brings a human face to the Frost Warframe.

Switch between Frost and Velimir's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Velimir Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999FrostSkinDes.zhText:
维利米尔·沃尔科夫二世是前自由军特工，他为 Frost 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的维利米尔双子表情动作，在 Frost 和维利米尔的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999Frumentarius.text:
Quincy Isaacs, the Hex's brash, self-assured sharpshooter, brings a human face to the Cyte-09 Warframe.

Switch between Cyte-09 and Quincy's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Quincy Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999Frumentarius.zhText:
昆西·艾萨克斯是六人组中傲慢而自信的神枪手，他为 Cyte-09 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的昆西双子表情动作，在 Cyte-09 和昆西的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999GarudaSkinDe.text: Vena, the Wytch, emerges from a doomed future to put a sadistic smile on Garuda. Revel in the blood of all those who stand against her.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999GarudaSkinDe.zhText: 女巫维纳从一个注定毁灭的未来中现身，向 Garuda 露出残忍的笑容。尽情沉溺于所有反抗她之人的鲜血之中。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999HarrowSkinDe.text: Father Lyon Allard, a priest of Lua tormented by nightmarish visions, brings a human face to the Harrow Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999HarrowSkinDe.zhText: 侍奉月神的里昂·阿拉德神父饱受噩梦般幻象折磨，他为 Harrow 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999MagSkinDesc.text:
Aoi Morohoshi, the Hex's protective second-in-command, brings a human face to the Mag Warframe.

Switch between Mag and Aoi's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Aoi Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999MagSkinDesc.zhText:
诸星碧是六人组的保卫者副官，她为 Mag 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的碧双子表情动作，在 Mag 和碧的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999NovaHatDesc.text: Kaya fashioned these tiny reactors to experiment with her newfound powers, but more than anything, she just likes how cool they look.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999NovaHatDesc.zhText: 卡娅制作这些微型反应堆是为了试验她新发现的力量，但最重要原因其实是，她就是喜欢它们酷炫的外观。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999NovaSkinDesc.text:
Kaya Velasco, a brilliant science student, brings a human face to the Nova Warframe.

Switch between Nova and Kaya's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Kaya Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999NovaSkinDesc.zhText:
卡娅·维拉斯科是才华横溢的理科生，她为 Nova 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的卡娅双子表情动作，在 Nova 和卡娅的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999NyxSkinDesc.text:
Eleanor Nightingale, the mysterious psychic specialist of the Hex, brings a human face to the Nyx Warframe.

Switch between Nyx and Eleanor's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Eleanor Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999NyxSkinDesc.zhText:
埃莉诺·南丁格尔是六人组中神秘的精神专家，她为 Nyx 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

使用内含的埃莉诺双子表情动作，在 Nyx 和埃莉诺的全配音、可自定义的双子外观之间切换，即使是在任务期间。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999SarynHatDesc.zhText: 米尼娃的标志性太阳镜。

/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999SarynSkinDes.text:
Minerva Hendricks, former Libertatian military agent, brings a human face to the Saryn Warframe.

Switch between Saryn and Minerva's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Minerva Gemini Emote, even during missions.
/Lotus/Language/Skins/WF1999SarynSkinDes.zhText:
米尼娃·亨德里克斯是前自由军特工，她为 Saryn 战甲带来了人性化的一面。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisHeists/HeavyCatal.text:
Operator, 

Eudico has just sent over this wonderful GRAVIMAG upgrade that lets you deploy an Archwing primary on land or in the air. The process to install the GRAVIMAG is straight-forward and simple. Ready? Let's go.

1. In your Arsenal select your Archwing loadout
2. Equip any Archgun that has a CATALYST installed
3. Upgrade that gun by installing a GRAVIMAG
4. Equip that primary weapon in the HEAVY WEAPON slot
5. Finally, add the ARCHGUN DEPLOYER gear item to your gear wheel

See? Easy! Eudico says you will need this item equipped before you can face down that wretched Profit-Taker Orb. 

When in battle simply select ARCHGUN DEPLOYER from you gear wheel and give that thing “the business”.

Your loyal Cephalon,
-Ordis
/Lotus/Language/SolarisHeists/HeavyCatal.zhText:
指挥官，

Eudico 刚刚把这个很厉害的重力磁抵器升级装置送来了，它可让您在地面或空中装备曲翼主要武器。安装重力磁抵器的过程简单明了。准备好了吗？ 开始吧。

1. 在您的军械库中，选择您的曲翼配置
2. 装备任何安装了催化剂的曲翼枪械
3. 在那件武器上安装重力磁抵器来进行升级
4. 将已升级的枪械装备在「重型武器」槽位上
5. 最后，将「曲翼枪械设置器」加入您的携带装备轮盘中

了解了吗？ 如此简单！Eudico 说您需要装备这个物品才能制服那个卑鄙的利润收割者圆蛛。

在战斗时，您只需从携带装备轮盘中选择「曲翼枪械设置器」就能用“大家伙”来对付她了。

您忠诚的中枢，
－Ordis

/Lotus/Language/SolarisQuest/RewardMailB.text:
Sparky,

Smokefinger found this blueprint embedded in a tangle of Vallis fungi years ago. Didn't know what to do with it until you came along. I want you to have it, it's the least we can do to thank you.

Eudico
/Lotus/Language/SolarisQuest/RewardMailB.zhText:
小火花，

Smokefinger 几年前发现了这份蓝图被卡在山谷中的一团真菌里面。要不是你来了，还真不晓得这该怎么处理。我希望你收下，至少我们能用这来感谢你。

别见外啊，
Eudico

/Lotus/Language/SolarisQuest/SayasVigilF.text:
Word of good deeds travels quickly. Even between planets.

Visiting Ostron traders mentioned you taught the Grineer a lesson in humility. Might you be up for teaching the Corpus a lesson or two in good management next?

You see, Nef Anyo eagerly awaits the completion of a coolant tower here on Venus - no matter the human cost. It is time, I believe, to present him with a bill he cannot escape.

I do hope you will visit Venus soon.

The Business
/Lotus/Language/SolarisQuest/SayasVigilF.zhText:
好事传千里，即使是在不同的星球之间。来访的 Ostron 商人提到你给 Grineer 上了一堂关于谦卑的课。接下来，你要不要也教一下 Corpus 如何进行良好管理呢？

如你所见，奈富·安尤焦急等待着金星上一座冷却塔的完工——不惜一切人力成本。我觉得，是时候给他一张逃不掉的账单了。

真希望你能尽快访问金星。

操盘手

<MINI_ARROW> Talk to Eudico in Fortuna
/Lotus/Language/SolarisQuest/VoxSolarisQ.zhText:
<MINI_ARROW> 抵达金星的福尔图娜
<MINI_ARROW> 与福尔图娜的 Eudico 交谈

/Lotus/Language/SolarisQuest/YareliMessa.text:
hey glinty, lady-matey says you've proved you're a decent mucker, sooo.... if i ever got deep in the crud you'd be willing to help out, right? not that i'm deep in the crud... yet.

keep you posted.

roky
/Lotus/Language/SolarisQuest/YareliMessa.zhText:
嘿，闪闪，女士们说你已经证明了自己是一个好伙计，所以……如果有一天我深陷泥潭之中，你会乐意拉我一把让我出来，对吗？虽然现在……我还没有深陷泥潭之中。

随时保持联系。

小洛

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureA.text: Entice and attract nearby wildlife with life-like animal calls.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureA.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的野生动物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureL.text: Entice and attract nearby Kubrodon with life-like animal calls. The Kubrodon is most often found around the Craters in Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureL.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的库狛顿。库狛顿最常在奥布山谷的陨石坑周围被发现。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureO.text: Entice and attract nearby Stovers with life-like animal calls.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureO.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的炽托法。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.text: Entice and attract nearby Bolarola with life-like animal calls. The Bolarola is most often found around the Mountainous areas of Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的波雷罗拉。通常可以在奥布山谷的有山的地方周围发现波雷罗拉。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.text: Entice and attract nearby Sawgaw with life-like animal calls.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的梭歌。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.text: Entice and attract nearby Virmink with life-like animal calls. The Virmink is most often found around the Lakes in Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的弗鸣克。通常可以在奥布山谷的湖泊周围发现弗鸣克。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.text: Entice and attract nearby Horrasque with life-like animal calls.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的惑瓦斯克。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.text: Entice and attract nearby Pobbers with life-like animal calls. The Pobbers is most often found around the Mushroom Fields of Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalLureS.zhText: 以拟真的动物叫声来诱惑、吸引附近的泡博。通常可以在奥布山谷有蘑菇的地域周围发现泡博。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Kubrodon.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种库狛顿稀有亚种的几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Stover.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种炽托法稀有亚种的几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Bolarola.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种波雷罗拉稀有亚种的几率。
波雷罗拉费洛蒙合成器

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Sawgaw.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种梭歌稀有亚种的几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Virmink.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种弗鸣克稀有亚种的几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Horrasque.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种惑瓦斯克稀有亚种的几率。
惑瓦斯克费洛蒙合成器

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.text: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Pobbers.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/AnimalRarit.zhText: 在使用回声诱饵前部署可以提升吸引一种泡博稀有亚种的几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidCa.text: A canister of thermia, diluted with coolant.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidCa.zhText: 给热美亚用的罐子，由冷却液稀释。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.text:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Crisma Toroids by defeating the Profit-Taker Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.zhText:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

通过击败金星奥布山谷的利润收割者圆蛛来获取圣油环型装置。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.text:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Lazulite Toroids by defeating the Exploiter Orb on the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.zhText:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

通过击败金星奥布山谷的剥削者圆蛛来获取天蓝环型装置。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.text:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Calda Toroids from enemies located at the Enrichment Labs in the Orb Vallis and from Scyto Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.zhText:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷升华实验室内的敌人那里和赛托蛛形机那里获取告达环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.text:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Vega Toroids from enemies located at the Spaceport in the Orb Vallis and from Mite Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.zhText:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷航天站内的敌人那里和微螨蛛形机那里获取维加环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.text:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Sola Toroids from enemies located at the Temple of Profit in the Orb Vallis and from Kyta Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ArachnoidPo.zhText:
一种功能和来源未定的装置。受到索拉里斯之声和夜羽的高度珍视。

从奥布山谷润盈殿内的敌人那里和凯塔蛛形机那里获取索拉环型装置。也可以在金星奥布山谷周围的洞穴中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CamperSpide.text: Monster of the Vallis and protector of Enrichment Labs, this massive Orb appears to be invulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CamperSpide.zhText: 山谷中的怪物以及升华实验室的保护者，这只巨大的圆蛛似乎是无敌的。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CaveContami.text:
This bait is composed of aromatic tetraxin that is known to attract Mirewinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CaveContami.zhText:
这种鱼饵由芳香性的四氢素组成，能够吸引污泥绕环者，一种出没于山洞鱼点中的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CaveContami.text:
This bait is synthesized from complex hexophenol that is known to attract Charamotes, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CaveContami.zhText:
这种鱼饵由复杂的己苯酚合成，能够吸引重筑虾，一种可于山洞鱼点中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CaveContami.text:
This bait is synthesized from specialized A-disulphex-A compounds that are known to attract Synathid, a legendarily rare Servofish found only in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CaveContami.zhText:
这种鱼饵由特制的A－二硫科斯－A化合物合成，能够吸引海龙，一种可于山洞鱼点中找到的传奇稀有伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_Exceed.text: [PH] Message can contain a maximum of |LIMIT| K-Drive parts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_Exceed.zhText: [PH] Message can contain a maximum of |LIMIT| K-Drive parts.

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_Exceed.text: Message can contain a maximum of |LIMIT| Kitgun parts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_Exceed.zhText: 信息中至多带有 |LIMIT| 个组合枪零件。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_Exceed.text: Message can contain a maximum of |LIMIT| MOA parts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_Exceed.zhText: 信息最多包含最多 |LIMIT| 恐鸟部件。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_NoModu.text: You do not own any K-Drives.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_NoModu.zhText: 你并未拥有任何 K 式悬浮板。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_NoModu.text: You do not own any Kitguns.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_NoModu.zhText: 你并未拥有任何组合枪。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Chat_NoModu.text: You do not own any MOAS.

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CondensedTh.text: A canister of volatile condensed thermia
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CondensedTh.zhText: 给不稳定的浓缩热美亚使用的罐子。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Conservatio.text: Awarded for the diligent preservation of the Horrasques, Sawgaws and Stovers of the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Conservatio.zhText: 授予勤于保育奥布山谷的惑瓦斯克、梭歌以及炽托法之人。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Conservatio.text: A symbol of your dedication to the safety and security of all creatures on the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Conservatio.zhText: 象征对奥布山谷上所有物种安全和保障的奉献精神。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CoolantCont.text: Cannister built to safely store Thermal Sludge.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CoolantCont.zhText: 用于安全储存热能软泥的罐子。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CoolantDesc.text:
A by-product from the Weeping Towers terraforming processes.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CoolantDesc.zhText:
地球化改造过程中渗流之塔的一种副产物。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CoolantSpid.text: Often found near the Exploiter Orb, these Raknoids carry deep-ice coolant that they use to protect themselves while harvesting Thermia fractures.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CoolantSpid.zhText: 通常可以在剥削者圆蛛附近找到，这些蛛形机在收割热美亚裂缝时会携带深冰冷却液来保护自己。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.text: A fine-cut pavilion married to a shutter-governor allows for rapid-yet-economical fire.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.zhText: 当精细切割的底壳和快速调节器结合在一起，快速而又节约的火力诞生了。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.text: Loose an incendiary attack that damages over time.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.zhText: 能释放出可持续伤害的燃烧攻击。
能释放出短程，宽范围的能量束。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.text: Lob a powerful fragmentary explosive charge.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.zhText: 可投射出威力十足的爆炸物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.text: Throws out explosives to be triggered by passing foes.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.zhText: 投出能被路过敌人触发的爆炸物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.text: Oversized capacitor. Increased ammunition, longer recharge time.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.zhText: 过大电容。弹药增加，充能时间增长。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.text: Smaller, more numerous, microcapacitors. Less ammunition, quicker recharge time.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.zhText: 较小，较多个微型电容。较小弹药，较快充能时间。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.text: The armpiece incorporates several internal lenses, increasing the likelihood of Critical Hits.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpAmpSet1.zhText: 臂件包含了几个内建镜头，增加暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusBothU.text: Surveys the water for impurities. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusBothU.zhText: 侦测水中的杂质。可以在金星洞穴的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCamer.text: This security drone is assigned to Corpus installations on Venus, it triggers alarms when intruders are spotted.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCamer.zhText: 这种安保无人机被设置于金星的 Corpus 设施，当发现入侵者时会启动警报。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCoolC.text: Collects fluid samples in the aqua system for the Research Station. It can be found in lakes around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCoolC.zhText: 为研究站收集水系统中的液体样本。可以在金星周围的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCoolU.text: A surveillance drone that monitors any activity that disturbs the waters. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusCoolU.zhText: 一种侦查无人机，监视着水体中的任何扰动。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmC.text: Used to record visual data in the aqua systems and transmits the telemetrics to the Research Station. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmC.zhText: 用来记录水系统中的视觉数据，并将遥感数据传送回研究站。可以在金星的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmC.text: Developed to perform remote construction and maintenance routines. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmC.zhText: 被开发用于远程建筑和日常维护。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmU.text: Identifies organic threats to Corpus operations in the Aqua Systems and eliminates them. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWarmU.zhText: 识别水系统中对 Corpus 行动有危害的有机物，并将其消灭。可以在金星的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWidge.text:
A modular component that regulates latitude and altitude in various Corpus systems. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWidge.zhText:
一种可以在各种 Corpus 系统中调节纬度和高度的模组部件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWidge.text:
A modular component that compensates for the multitude of atmospheric conditions encountered in the Origin System. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWidge.zhText:
一种可以抵消在始源星系中遇到的许多大气条件的模组部件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWidge.text:
Anti-gravity system that allows massively heavy objects to be manipulated by a single user. 

Location: Obtained by completing Heists on the Orb Vallis (Venus)
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CorpusWidge.zhText:
反重力系统可以让一名使用者单独操控沉重的物件。

获取地点：可以通过完成奥布山谷（金星）的抢劫任务获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Crafting_Bu.text: Construct the Moa Companion? Selected parts will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Crafting_Bu.zhText: 是否建造恐鸟同伴？被选中的部件将被消耗。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Crafting_Bu.text: Construct the Hound Companion? Selected parts will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Crafting_Bu.zhText: 是否建造猎犬同伴？被选中的部件将被消耗。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpSentExpe.text: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpSentExpe.zhText: （英文：OCUCOR）在击杀同时便已准备好对下一名受害者伸出魔爪的一种武器。每次击杀，这把手枪会生成能量卷须伸向邻近目标。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpSentExpe.text: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpSentExpe.zhText: （英文：BATTACOR）一把借由击杀敌人来充能的武器。蓄满后可以释放出毁灭性的力量。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpVenusHat.text: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CrpVenusHat.zhText: （英文：KRESKA）这把简易的 Corpus 生存工具履行了它的设计目标：砍杀和分裂任何攻击对象。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CryoxionWea.text: Fires volleys of icy grenades that inflict a lingering chill on the blast zone.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CryoxionWea.zhText: （英文：CRYOTRA）发射一连串冰冷的手榴弹，在爆炸区域留下持久的寒气。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenAD.text:
The Taxmen call it an investment in our future, but loans to cover vocational and specialist training almost always cost more than you'll ever earn. Especially with the interest.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenAD.zhText:
税务官将其称为对我们未来的投资，但是用来支付职业和专业培训的贷款几乎超过你的收入。尤其还有利息。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenBD.text:
Covers everything from hab rent to insurance, docking permits and paying off that rail tractor. Big ticket items.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenBD.zhText:
涵盖从栖所租金到保险，登陆许可和支付航道船舰的所有费用。高价物品。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenCD.text:
To get work you need mods. Then you need more work to pay for the mods, so you get more mods. And here we are.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenCD.zhText:
要有更多工作，你需要改装。然后你需要更多的工作来支付改装，这样你才能得到更多的改装。所以我们现在才会这样。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenDD.text:
Sometimes a rig jockey needs a helping hand, so they get an advance on the next pay. Massive interest rates almost guarantee they'll be paying that off forever.

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenDD.zhText:
有时候一个技工需要一些帮助，所以他们可以预支下一次的工资。高额利率几乎可以保证他们将一辈子来偿还这笔费用。

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenED.text:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenED.zhText:
上一代未付清的债务由下一代承接。努力付出偿还债务被视为一种值得的骄傲。他们有还能有什么选择？

可从奥布山谷（金星）赏金中获得、或从福尔图娜（金星）Ticker 处购得

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DebtTokenVe.zhText: 交易债券换取索拉里斯声望

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DetailedPur.text: Blueprint for the Oxylus Sentinel is available for purchase from The Business in Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/DetailedPur.zhText: 奥克绪罗斯守护的蓝图可向福尔图娜的操盘手购得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FishmongerS.zhText: 用伺服鱼来换取索拉里斯声望

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Fishmonger_.text: Dismantling selected Servofish will produce following components.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Fishmonger_.zhText: 拆卸已选的伺服鱼将产生以下部件。
将选择的伺服鱼提供给 <REPUTATION>|STANDING|？

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FissureumDe.text:
A magma like liquid that is diluted with coolant during the extraction process. Thermia can be found fracturing the surface of the Orb Vallis during thermal flare-ups. Could this be the key to weakening the Exploiter Orb's defenses?

Location: Thermia Fractures event in the Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FissureumDe.zhText:
在萃取过程中能被冷却液稀释的液态岩浆。在热爆过程中，热美亚会出现在奥布山谷表面，并导致热美亚裂缝的产生。或许它就是瓦解剥削者圆蛛防御机制的关键？

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）上的热美亚裂缝活动

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FortunaIntr.zhText: 索拉里斯债务拘役殖民地

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FungusHeart.text: This sprouting, fungal body protects and conceals mytocardia spores, its hidden treasure.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FungusHeart.zhText: 这种发芽的真菌体保护并隐藏着心肌菌孢子，它隐藏起来的珍宝。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FungusHeart.text:
A fungal body prized for its varied uses.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/FungusHeart.zhText:
一种真菌体，因其用途广泛而备受推崇。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/GenericCont.text:
A simple cocktail of short-chain polymers and contaminants. Easily detected by rudimentary Servofish in the Orb Vallis under all conditions, but ignored by more specialized models. Good for Sapcaddies (found in the lake), and Tinks and Brickies (found in ponds).

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/GenericCont.zhText:
一种短链聚合物及污染物的简单混合。在所有情况下都能轻易被奥布山谷中基本的伺服鱼侦测到，但是被更特殊型的伺服鱼所忽略。适用于液集者（可在湖泊找到）、修补机和砖瓦匠（可在池塘找到）。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/GenericPlus.text: They're the squeezy little fellas from the ranges of the Vallis! Take them home today!
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/GenericPlus.zhText: 来自山谷一带的抱抱小家伙！今天就把它们带回家吧！

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Gun_BuildCo.text: Construct the Kitgun? Selected parts will be consumed.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Gun_BuildCo.zhText: 组装组合枪？选取的部件将会被消耗掉。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Gun_Hint.text: Select a Chamber, Grip and Loader to construct a weapon
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Gun_Hint.zhText: 选择一个枪膛、握把，及填弹器来制造一把武器

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HextraWeapo.text: Launches a volley of bomb darts that embed themselves in targets, exploding a short time later.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HextraWeapo.zhText: （英文：MULTRON）发射一连串炸弹飞镖，嵌入目标中并在短时间后爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HoundPetIte.text: Hounds are powerful robotic companions optimized for combat. They are programmed to excel at battlefield control and can be configured for countless scenarios.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HoundPetIte.zhText: 猎犬是专为战斗而优化的强大机械伙伴。它们经过编程，擅长在战场上控制局势，并可根据无数场景进行配置。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HungerSpide.text: This mid-sized Raknoid is highly mobile and attacks by latching onto prey with a grappling hook or spitting deadly fluid from its sac.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HungerSpide.zhText: 这只中型蛛形机具高度机动性，并可以通过擒抱钩锁或从其囊中吐出致命的液体来锁定猎物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/KDriveItemD.zhText: 通过选取四个部分进行配置

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/KDriveRaceT.text: Needed if you wanna race. Sometimes called 'dedhedz' by the Ventkids.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/KDriveRaceT.zhText: 如果你想要比赛，那就需要它。有时候被通风小子们叫做"空车返回"。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LakeContami.text:
This bait is synthesized from Methacalcene-1 that is known to attract Krillers, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lakes during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LakeContami.zhText:
这种鱼饵由甲烷活性钙-1合成，可以吸引磷虾杀手，一种可在温暖天气中于湖泊中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LakeContami.text:
This bait is synthesized from beryzene that is known to attract Longwinders, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis lake hotspots during warm weather.

Obtained via The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LakeContami.zhText:
这种鱼饵由铍苯合成，用于吸引长型环绕者，一种可在温暖天气的湖泊中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LandscapeTr.text: Field-and-forget, the Beckonsnare emits an ultrasonic frequency enticing to targeted lifeforms. Upon entering they are comfortably contained within a one-way photon fence for easy collection at your convenience.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LandscapeTr.zhText: 一种采田忘野的装备，引诱陷阱可发出对目标生命体具有吸引力的超声波频率。目标进入后，它们轻松地被圈在一个单向光子围栏内，以便您轻松采收。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LegendaryKu.text: The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts travel in groups and mark the territory surrounding Orokin cooling towers as their own. Kubrodons are a danger best avoided.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/LegendaryKu.zhText: 金星平原上的顶级掠食者。这些体格巨大的野兽成群活动，并将奥罗金冷却塔周围的区域标为自己的领地。库狛顿是最好避开的危险野兽。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToFis.text: PURCHASE FISHING/CONSERVATION GEAR, TRADE/DISMANTLE CAUGHT SERVOFISH
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToFis.zhText: 购买钓鱼/物种保育道具，交易/分解捕捉到的伺服鱼

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToKDr.zhText: 制作/购买 K 式悬浮板，交易/调整制作好的 K 式悬浮板

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToMoa.zhText: 制作/购买恐鸟，交易/调整制作好的恐鸟

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToQue.text: VIEW STANDING WITH FORTUNA, ACCEPT BOUNTIES
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToQue.zhText: 查看福尔图娜的声望，接受赏金任务

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToSto.zhText: 将市民从债务中解放出来

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MenuGoToWea.zhText: 制作/购买组合枪，交易/调整制作好的组合枪

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroMolten.text: Quick and deadly, these Raknoids attack with heat and flame.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroMolten.zhText: 快速而又致命，这些蛛形机会用热量和火焰来进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroSpider.text: This diminutive Raknoid burrows into the Vallis permafrost and patiently waits in ambush for approaching enemies.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroSpider.zhText: 这个微型的蛛形机潜入山谷永久冻土带并耐心等待，埋伏所靠近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.text: [PH] Description of Solaris Mining Laser B
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.zhText: [PH] Description of Solaris Mining Laser B

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.text: [PH] Description of Solaris Mining Laser C
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.zhText: [PH] Description of Solaris Mining Laser C

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.text:
Fast-ignition, high-intensity mining tool capable of extracting the rarest of materials with surgical precision.

Can be used to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape. Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.zhText:
这是一把快速点火、高强度的采矿工具，能够以外科手术般的精确度开采最稀有的矿物。

可在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。
阳点等离子钻头范围改造器
提升等离子光束的距离。
阳点等离子钻头消音改造器

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.text: Mine in peace and avoid alerting nearby enemies with this drill silencing widget.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MiningLaser.zhText: 用这个钻头消音改造器来和平地挖矿并避免让敌人警戒。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetCraft.text: <WARNING> Select a Model, Core and Gear to construct a Moa Companion <WARNING>
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetCraft.zhText: <WARNING> 选择一个型号、核心和装备来建造一个恐鸟同伴 <WARNING>

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.text:
A well-balanced core.

+5.0% Max Health
+5.0% Max Shields
+5.0% Max Armor

Modifiers doubled when Gilded.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.zhText:
一款能力均衡的核心组件。

+5.0% 最大生命
+5.0% 最大护盾
+5.0% 最大护甲

镀金后能力值为双倍。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.text:
This core features durable Armor, but weak Shields.

+5.0% Max Health
+2.5% Max Shields
+7.5% Max Armor

Modifiers doubled when Gilded.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.zhText:
一款特点为护甲坚韧，但护盾薄弱的核心组件。

+5.0% 最大生命
+2.5% 最大护盾
+7.5% 最大护甲

镀金后能力值为双倍。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.text:
This core features enhanced Armor and Health, with standard Shields.

+7.5% Max Health
+0.0% Max Shields
+7.5% Max Armor

Modifiers doubled when Gilded.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.zhText:
一款特点为增强护甲和生命值，并配有标准护盾的核心组件。

+7.5% 最大生命
+0.0% 最大护盾
+7.5% 最大护甲

镀金后能力值为双倍。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.text:
This core features strong Shields, but light Armor.

+5.0% Max Health
+7.5% Max Shields
+2.5% Max Armor

Modifiers doubled when Gilded.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetEngin.zhText:
一款特点为强力护盾，但轻质护甲的核心组件。

+5.0% 最大生命
+7.5% 最大护盾
+2.5% 最大护甲

镀金后能力值为双倍。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadL.text: This model is built for defense, deploying the Stasis Field and Shockwave Actuators precepts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadL.zhText: 这种型号是针对防御而打造的，可以部署「静态力场」和「震波驱动器」指令。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadM.text: This model is built for close-quarters combat, using the Blast Shield and Hard Engage precepts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadM.zhText: 这种型号是针对近距离战斗而打造的，可以使用「爆破护盾」和「以硬碰硬」指令。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadO.text: This model is built for utility, using the Tractor Beam and Security Override precepts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadO.zhText: 这种型号是针对实用性而打造的，可以使用「牵引光束」和「协议覆写」指令。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadP.text: This model is built for offense, utilizing the Whiplash Mine and Anti-Grav Grenade precepts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetHeadP.zhText: 这种型号是针对进攻而打造的，可以利用「牵绳机雷」和「反重力榴弹」指令。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetItemD.text: MOAs are versatile robotic allies that specialize in indirect support both in and outside of combat.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetItemD.zhText: 恐鸟是多功能的机器人盟友，擅长在战斗内外提供间接支援。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegAD.text: A basic bracket with no polarized Mod slots.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegAD.zhText: 一个未带有 MOD 极化槽位的基础脚架

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegBD.text: An armored bracket featuring a Mod slot with a Vazarin polarity.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegBD.zhText: 一个带有 Vazarin Mod 极性槽位的装甲脚架。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegCD.text: A flexible bracket featuring a Mod slot with a Madurai polarity.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegCD.zhText: 一个带有 Madurai Mod 极性槽位的灵活脚架。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegDD.text: A versatile bracket featuring a Mod slot with a Naramon polarity.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegDD.zhText: 一个带有 Naramon Mod 极性槽位的通用脚架。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegMe.text: A versatile bracket featuring a Mod slot with a Naramon polarity.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetLegMe.zhText: 一个带有 Naramon Mod 极性槽位的通用脚架。

+5.0% Max Armor
