镀金后改造的能力值翻倍。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.text: Overrides the default operating system with a caring empath-agent.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.zhText: 以体贴入微的代理情感覆盖预设的作业系统。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.text: Overrides the default operating system with an analytical empath-agent.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.zhText: 以善于分析的代理情感覆盖预设的作业系统。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.text: Overrides the default operating system with a hostile empath-agent.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.zhText: 以怀有敌意的代理情感覆盖预设的作业系统。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.text: Overrides the default operating system with a strong empath-agent.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetPerso.zhText: 以坚强有力的代理情感覆盖预设的作业系统。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPet_Gild.text: Are you sure you want to gild the selected MOA? It will be named |NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPet_Gild.zhText: 您确认要替选取的恐鸟镀金吗？它将会被命名为 |NAME|。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinArtif.text: An ancient device frozen in ice.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinArtif.zhText: 一个被冰封的古老装置。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinArtif.text: These ancient devices have been placed in subterranean caverns where they create localized pockets of intense cold.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinArtif.zhText: 这些古老的装置被放置在地下洞穴，来制造局部区域的极度寒冷。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothL.text: Monitors environmental fluctuations. It can be found in the cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothL.zhText: 监控环境波动。它可以在金星的洞穴池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothR.text: Its primary function is to reconstruct the bio-material used to regenerate Orokin structures. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinBothR.zhText: 其主要功能是重建用于再生奥罗金结构的生物材料。可以在金星的洞穴池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinCoolR.text: Programmed to break down chemical byproducts leaked into the aqua system. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinCoolR.zhText: 被设置用来分解渗入水环境的化学副产物。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinKubro.text: The Stover is a kind of proto-Kubrow, resurrected as Venus thawed. When grouped in a pack Stovers are relentless opponents.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinKubro.zhText: 炽托法是一种原型库狛，随着金星解冻而复活。当炽托法成群时，它们是无情的对手。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinKubro.text: "Because they're dumb as a stove, run hot and because having one on top of you is gonna ruin your day. You walk into a cave system that feels too warm, get out." - Unknown Solaris Rig Jockey.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinKubro.zhText: "因为它们笨的像个炉子，总是过热，而且因为如果你碰上了，你一整天就算是毁了。如果你走进一个山洞，感觉有点暖，那就赶紧退出来。"— 不具名的索拉里斯技工

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinSenso.text: These Orokin devices emerge when the floating glaciers impact on the surface of Venus. Their purpose is unknown.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/OrokinSenso.zhText: 这些奥罗金设备会在漂浮的冰川撞击地面时出现。它们的目的未知。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlaceHeatFi.text: Clear the area of enemies first

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlushyKubro.text: A well-loved Kubrodon Floof, once owned by the Grineer known as Gral.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlushyKubro.zhText: 一件备受喜爱的库狛顿玩偶，曾被称为格拉尔的 Grineer 所拥有。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlushyPobbe.text: A well-loved Pobber Floof, once owned by the Grineer known as Gral.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PlushyPobbe.zhText: 一件备受喜爱的泡博玩偶，曾被称为格拉尔的 Grineer 所拥有。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PondContami.text:
This endochlor/dionium melange attracts both Recasters and Eye-Eyes, Servofish found in Orb Vallis ponds. The Eye-Eye shows up during warm weather and Recasters shows up at Hot Spots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PondContami.zhText:
这种内型联氯 / 釱元素的混合物可以吸引续播机和目－目这类可以在池塘内找到的伺服鱼。目－目会在温暖天气时出现，续播机则在天气寒冷时出现在鱼点中。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PondContami.text:
This bait is synthesized from long-chain LS-74 compounds that are known to attract Tromyzon, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis pond hotspots during cool weather.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/PondContami.zhText:
这种鱼饵由长链的 LS-74 化合物所合成，可以吸引多目鳗，一种可以在寒冷天气中池塘鱼点中找到的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜（金星）的操盘手处获得。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ProspectorS.zhText: 用宝石换取索拉里斯声望

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RadarSentin.text: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RadarSentin.zhText: 以「扫描水生生命体」和「扫描物质」为默认指令，奥克绪罗斯被设计用于奥布山谷外围严酷环境的搜救行动。奥克绪罗斯拥有一把多连穿甲枪。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RobofishSpe.text: [PH] A tool used to disable the mechanical fish of Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RobofishSpe.zhText: [PH] A tool used to disable the mechanical fish of Venus.

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RobofishSpe.text:
Purpose built to recover Servofish without damage. Delivers a disabling electromagnetic pulse after a successful hit if timed correctly.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RobofishSpe.zhText:
一种能够捕获伺服鱼，同时避免对其造成伤害的工具。若在恰当的时机命中目标，它就会释放出带有失能效果的电磁脉冲波。

从福尔图娜的操盘手处获得。这根鱼叉对奥布山谷（金星）的伺服鱼最有效。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RobofishSpe.text:
Successful electromagnetic pulses radiate outward also disabling any nearby Servofish.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/RobofishSpe.zhText:
成功发射的电磁脉冲往外散发同时瘫痪任何附近的伺服鱼。

从福尔图娜的操盘手处获得。这根鱼叉对奥布山谷（金星）的伺服鱼最有效。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.text: High-capacity loader with increased Critical Chance and lowered Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.zhText: 大容量装弹器，具有较高的暴击几率及较低的触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.text: Maximum capacity loader with increased Critical Chance and lowered Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.zhText: 最大容量装弹器，具有较高的暴击几率及较低的触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.text: High-capacity loader with maximum Critical Chance and minimum Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.zhText: 大容量装弹器，具有最高的暴击几率及最低的触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.text: A fast-loader with maximum Critical Chance and minimum Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.zhText: 快速装弹器，具有最高的暴击几率及最低的触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.text: A fast-loader with increased Critical Chance and lowered Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.zhText: 快速装弹器，具有较高的暴击几率及较低的触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.text: Quickest load-speed with increased Critical Chance and lowered Status Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularCr.zhText: 最快填弹速度，具有较高的暴击几率及较低的触发几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.text: Hold tight and unleash hell. Increased range for beam weapons; increased rate-of-fire for non-beam weapons. Reduced damage.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.zhText: 紧握它并释放出地狱般的伤害。光束武器的射程范围增大；非光束武器的射速提高。较低伤害。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.text: Trades lower Damage for faster Fire Rate and more controlled Recoil.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.zhText: 以较低的伤害换取更高的射速，并且更容易控制后坐力。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.text: The weapon grip of the measured killer. Slower Fire Rate and lower Range for Beam Weapons. High Damage with Recoil to match.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.zhText: 给精心计算的杀手所设计的握把。较低的射速，并且光束武器的射程范围较低。具有高伤害和与之匹配的后坐力。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.text: High Damage with Recoil to match. Slower Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularPr.zhText: 具有高伤害和与之相匹配的后坐力。射速较低。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularRe.text: Fast loader with reduced Ammo Capacity.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularRe.zhText: 弹药容量减少的快速装弹器。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularRe.text: Quickest load-speed with lowest Ammo Capacity.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularRe.zhText: 最快的装填速度，最低的弹药容量。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.text:
Secondary: Fires a wide-radius plasma energy projectile with a very short half-life.
Primary: Automatic trigger, faster fire rate and smaller projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.zhText:
次要武器：发射一道具有极短半衰期的宽幅等离子体。
主要武器：自动扳机，具有更快的射速和更小的投射物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.text:
Secondary: fires projectiles semi-automatically with high accuracy; area-of-effect explosion on impact.
Primary: hold fire to charge for an even greater effect.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.zhText:
次要武器：半自动化发射具有高精准度的投射物；撞击时会产生范围爆炸伤害。
主要武器：按住射击来充能，以获得更具破坏性的伤害。
让他们安息吧，有速射特性。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.text:
Secondary: a persistent cutting beam of pure energy.
Primary: same as Secondary, but with explosion on impact.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.zhText:
次要武器：可产生持久的纯粹能量切割光束。
主要武器：与次要武器的攻击相同，但可以在撞击时产生爆炸伤害。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.text: Hold tight and unleash hell. Increased range for beam weapons; increased rate-of-fire for non-beam weapons. Reduced damage.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.zhText: 紧握它并释放出地狱般的伤害。光束武器的射程增大；非光束武器的射速提高。较低伤害。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.text: The weapon grip of the measured killer. Slower Fire Rate and lower Range for Beam Weapons. Greater Damage.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.zhText: 给精心计算的杀手所设计的握把。较低的射速，并且光束武器的射程范围较低。拥有较大的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.text: The ultimate grip for when one shot is all you need. Devastating. Minimum rate-of-fire; minimum range for beam weapons. Maximum damage.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.zhText: 只需射击一次的终极握把。具有毁灭性。最低射速; 光束武器的最低射程。最大伤害。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.text: What it lacks in impact it makes up for with intensity. Maximum rate-of-fire; maximum range for beam weapons. Minimum damage.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSe.zhText: 用强度来弥补它所欠缺的威力。最高射速；光束武器的最远射程。最低伤害。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.text: High-capacity loader with increased Status Chance and lowered Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.zhText: 高容量装弹器，具有较高的触发几率及较低的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.text: Maximum-capacity loader with increased Status Chance and lowered Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.zhText: 最大容量装弹器，具有较高的触发几率及较低的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.text: High-capacity loader with maximum Status Chance and minimum Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.zhText: 高容量装弹器，具有最高的触发几率及最低的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.text: A fast-loader with maximum Status Chance and minimum Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.zhText: 快速装弹器，具有最高的触发几率及最低的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.text: A fast-loader with increased Status Chance and lowered Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.zhText: 快速装弹器，具有较高的触发几率及较低的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.text: Quickest load-speed with increased Status Chance and lowered Critical Chance.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SUModularSt.zhText: 最快填弹速度，具有较高的触发几率及较低的暴击几率。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowArmadil.text: Favoring thunder, lightning and cratered-out areas Bolarolas are all about defense. Their armored plates protect them from most predators, tucking-and-rolling to make good their escape.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowArmadil.zhText: 喜欢打雷、闪电和多坑的区域，波雷罗拉的特点就是防御。它们护甲般的外壳可以保护它们免于大多数掠食者之手，缩起来滚走让它们很善于逃跑。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowBirdDes.text: 'Soar Gore' as the Solaris call it, this crimson-faced bird of prey circles and stalks the cliffs and fungal forests of Venus, searching for rodent prey.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowBirdDes.zhText: "索哥"，索拉里斯人是这么称呼它的，这种有着深红色面容的猛禽在悬崖和菌类森林边徘徊追踪，搜索啮齿目猎物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowCritter.text: Sleek and silky, the adorable appearance of the Venusian Virmink belies its aggressive demeanor. Favoring rocky landscapes Virmink packs nose the air, scenting for Pobbers - their primary food source.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowCritter.zhText: 手感光滑，金星弗鸣克的可爱外观掩盖了它的攻击性。喜欢岩石地形，成群的弗鸣克嗅着空气，寻找泡博的气味——那是它们的主要食物来源。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowPredato.text: Found near bodies of water the Horrasque subsists primarily upon fish. This hideous creature is terrible to behold, but will not attack unless provoked. When it does its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowPredato.zhText: 在水体附近可以找到，惑瓦斯克主要靠鱼类维生。这种可怕的生物看起来非常恐怖，但除非被激怒就不会攻击。当它吼叫时，连最坚定的兽夹师都会抖三抖。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowRodentD.text: Native to the fungal forests of Venus, the Pobber is a skittish rodent possessed of an objectionable odor. Always found in groups they flee at the slightest hint of trouble. They are a primary food source for Virmink and Sawgaw.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SnowRodentD.zhText: 金星菌类森林的居民，泡博是有着讨厌气味的胆小啮齿类。总是成群行动，一旦发现一点点问题就四散逃窜。它们是弗鸣克和梭歌的主要食物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisBadg.text: The emblem of the Solaris, the indebted workers of Fortuna. We all lift together.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisBadg.zhText: 福尔图娜负债工人－索拉里斯人民的徽章。我们共度时艰。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisBoth.text: Analyzes the growth of microbes dwelling in the aqua systems to monitor toxicity levels. It can be found in cave pools on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisBoth.zhText: 分析居住在水系统中的微生物的生长情况，以监测毒性等级。可以在金星的洞穴池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisCool.text: Repairs robotics that have broken down in the aqua systems. It can be found in ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisCool.zhText: 修复在水系统中发生故障的机器人。可以在金星的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisCool.text: Facilitates long-distance communication between robotics deployed in the aqua systems. It can be found in the ponds around Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisCool.zhText: 用于加强水系统中机器人之间的远距沟通性能。可以在金星上的池塘中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisUnit.zhText: 交易环型装置换取声望

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisWarm.text: Repairs leaks and clear blockages within the aqua systems. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SolarisWarm.zhText: 修复水系统中的泄露，清除淤塞。可以在金星的湖泊中找到。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SpeciesCons.text: For saving a specimen of this species.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SpeciesCons.zhText: 该标签代表你保存了这个物种的一个样本。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SubSpeciesC.text: For saving a specimen of this subspecies.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/SubSpeciesC.zhText: 该标签代表你保存了这个亚种的一个样本。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TazronWeapo.text: Releases a burst of static electricity that can jump between foes, incapacitating them.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TazronWeapo.zhText: （英文：TAZICOR）释放出一阵静电，该静电可以在敌人之间跳跃，使他们失去战斗能力。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TerraSpider.text: Exploiter harvests energy from the landscape and uses storms of ice and snow to safeguard the Temple of Profit from trespassers.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TerraSpider.zhText: 剥削者从地貌中收割能量，并使用冰雪风暴来保护润盈殿免受入侵者的破坏。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ThermocorWe.text: Charges up a powerful blast of ultra-heated plasma.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/ThermocorWe.zhText: （英文：VULCAX）可蓄能发射出强力爆发的极热电浆。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TranqRifleC.text: Tranquilizes animals for the purpose of safe relocation.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TranqRifleC.zhText: 以安全重新安置为目的镇静动物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VentkidsSta.zhText: 交易奖章换取通风小子声望

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCoconu.text: Filled with gorgaricus spores, this sac is found hanging from the underside of the Vallis' giant fungus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCoconu.zhText: 充满了葛嘉里孢子，这种包囊在山谷巨大菌类的背阳面悬挂着。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCoconu.text:
The reproductive spore of the giant Vallis fungi is highly coveted for the complex chemical compounds it contains.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCoconu.zhText:
这种山谷巨大菌类的生殖孢子由于其包含的复杂化合物而令人垂涎。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCombat.text: Heavy, energy shotgun wielding combat unit.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusCombat.zhText: 持有重型能量霰弹枪的战斗单位。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusComman.text: Enrichment Labs director of weapons research. Responsible for advanced weapons prototypes and refinement.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusComman.zhText: 升华实验室的武器研究主管。负责高端的武器原型和改进。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusComman.text: Enrichment Labs director of animal dissection and experimentation. Works closely with the Feed and Research Division.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusComman.zhText: 升华实验室动物解剖和实验主管。与饲育与研究部门密切合作。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusComman.text: Director of Sentient studies at Enrichment Labs. The man Nef Anyo has entrusted to reverse engineer recovered Sentient technology.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusComman.zhText: 升华实验室的 Sentient 研究主管。已被奈富·安尤所委托逆向工程来恢复 Sentient 技术的一号人物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusDefens.text: Patrols the Vallis and reports any suspicious activity back to command.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusDefens.zhText: 巡逻山谷并将任何可疑活动报告给指挥部。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusFlying.text: Hybrid air-ground unit, armed with a Tetra rifle and a devastating visor mounted beam weapon.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusFlying.zhText: 空地混合单位，装备有一把特拉步枪，以及一把安装在面罩上的破坏性光束武器。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGrenad.text: Quick-moving heavy unit, armed with an energy bolt weapon.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGrenad.zhText: 快速移动的重型单位，装备有能量射钉武器。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGuardS.text: Guards Solaris who have been detained for repossession.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGuardS.zhText: 负责看守因索回而被拘留的索拉里斯人。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGunner.text: Heavy Corpus assault unit armed with Dual Cestras.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusGunner.zhText: 重型 Corpus 突击单位，装备锡斯特双枪。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHeavyD.text: Deploys a Rabbleback Hyena and then pummels targets from range with energy shells.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHeavyD.zhText: 部署烈背鬣狗，并从远距离用能量弹打击目标。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaA.text: Usually found in the Orb Vallis, this Hyena model lobs ice grenades and fires electric bolts.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaA.zhText: 通常在奥布山谷中被找到，这种鬣狗型号抛出冰冻手雷，并发射电击射钉。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaB.text: This Hyena has been heavily modified to fire its spines as guided projectiles.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaB.zhText: 这种鬣狗被大幅地调整，可以发射出制导的锥刺。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaH.text: Scatters tether mines with its spin attack, or lays down automatic fire with its cannon.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaH.zhText: 通过旋转攻击四散出牵引地雷，或者用大炮对准目标射出全自动火力。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaP.text: This ruthless Hyena variant pounds foes with its mortar attack and then finishes them off with flaming rounds.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaP.zhText: 这种无情的鬣狗变种用迫击炮重击敌人，并用燃烧弹终结他们。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusIcewav.text: Lays bounce mines and launches artillery barrages.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusIcewav.zhText: 排下弹跳地雷，并发射火炮弹幕。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusMushro.text: A mushroom that can be found amid the fungal colonies on Venus.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusMushro.zhText: 在金星上的真菌殖民地中能找到的一种蘑菇。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusMushro.text: Engineered by the Orokin to convert airborne chemicals into breathable air.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusMushro.zhText: 由奥罗金设计将大气中的化学物质转化为可呼吸的空气。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusReinfo.text: Continues to call in Corpus reinforcements until it is destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusReinfo.zhText: 持续地呼叫 Corpus 增援，直至被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusShockw.text: Dual ice-picks and a flying charge attack make a deadly capable foe.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusShockw.zhText: 这名致命的强敌拥有双持碎冰锥以及飞行的蓄力攻击。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.text: Favoring moist environments rich in decaying matter, the Mucksucker leeches nutrients through its cilia-festooned underbelly.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.zhText: 喜欢腐烂物中湿润的环境，吸肥虫用下腹的纤毛吸取养分。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.text: This resurrected Orokin-engineered insect favors damp atmospheres, and has been known to nest inside outpost venting systems. Their original purpose can only be guessed at, and Solaris engineers now consider them a pest.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.zhText: 这种复活了的奥罗金设计的昆虫喜欢潮湿的空气，以在前哨站的通风系统中筑巢著称。它们原本的目的只能推测，而索拉里斯的工程师们认为它们是害虫。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.text: Disgusting to step on, the Squick's cilia-festooned innards reach out to claim and digest any organism that cannot pull free of its ticklish grasp.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.zhText: 踩到十分恶心，恶心虫的纤毛长在内脏中，可以伸出，消化任何不能挣脱它瘙痒抓握的有机体。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.text: Presenting as a common stone or seed pod, Devilfingers use their twin probes to sniff the air for prey and to claim them with lightning-fast strikes.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.zhText: 外形像普通的石头或豆荚，恶魔指用一对探针嗅探空气，以闪电般的速度抓住猎物。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.text: Some form of oversized Orokin-era tapeworm, the Danglebad can be a nightmare if it ever finds its way inside you.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.zhText: 某种奥罗金时代的超大绦虫，要是在你体内发现挂荡恶虫，将会是一场噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.text: Attached to vertical surfaces, the Griplimpet will seize passing wildlife, hijacking their prefrontal cortex, and enlisting them to find and return with nutrients. This the animal will do until it dies.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTrappi.zhText: 附着在垂直的表面，会抓住经过的野生动物，占据其前额皮质，控制它寻找并带回养分。被控制的动物会如此劳碌至死。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTreeCo.text: A plant that thrives in frigid environments. Its nodules are highly sought after for their iridescent properties.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTreeCo.zhText: 一种在冰冷环境中繁荣生长的植物。它的结瘤因为色彩斑斓的性质而备受追捧。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTreeDe.text:
The iridescent nodules on these plants glow brightly in cold environments.

Location: Orb Vallis on Venus
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusTreeDe.zhText:
这些植物上色彩斑斓的结瘤在寒冷的环境中发出明亮的光辉。

获取地点：奥布山谷（金星）

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipPow.text: With brutal melee attacks, this target does not back down.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipPow.zhText: 带有猛烈的近战攻击，这名目标从不退缩。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipRif.text: This high-profile unit is armed with Dual Cestras.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipRif.zhText: 这个高级别单位装备着锡斯特双枪。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipSho.text: A modified Supra makes this high-value target highly dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipSho.zhText: 一把改造后的苏普拉让这名目标变得非常危险。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipSni.text: A Taxmen VIP marked for assassination, armed with a high-powered sniper rifle.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipSni.zhText: 一名标记要刺杀的税务官，其装备着高威力狙击枪。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Weaponsmith.text: Name a Primary or Secondary Weapon
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/Weaponsmith.zhText: 命名一件主要武器或次要武器

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/WheelCarDro.text: A fast-rolling, all-terrain automated weapon platform.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/WheelCarDro.zhText: 快速移动，全地形的自动武器平台。

/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/WrathSpider.text: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.
/Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/WrathSpider.zhText: 巨型的蛛形机，具有多个攻击向量，在高警戒级别期间最常被部署。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactDesc1.text: |BOSS_NAME| is attempting to use experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Little Duck can guide you through the recovery.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactDesc1.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 正尝试使用实验性的导管技术来将偷窃来的资源隐匿在 |LOCATION|。小鸭子可以在将之取回的过程中指引你。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToArti.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToArti.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToAssa.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToAssa.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToAssa.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToAssa.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 拦截到的动员令显示 |LOCATION| 存在重型火炮，并被 |BOSS_NAME| 部队用来轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToDefe.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToDefe.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的败退， |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙对受困于 |LOCATION| 的一位 Tenno 线人发起了一波攻击。在他遭到逮捕前压制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToExca.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToExca.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 已派出部队至位于 |LOCATION| 处的永冻晶矿新采掘点。在此采掘点枯竭以前，尽可能的进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToExte.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToExte.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 接获的证据指出一支 |BOSS_NAME| 的先遣部队部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们进入警戒前歼灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToHive.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToHive.zhText: |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受到惊动的敌人活化了位于 |LOCATION| 繁殖场的 |BOSS_NAME| 幼虫。在疫情爆发前摧毁这些巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToInte.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToInte.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现了一台发射机正以加密资料网络的方式与 |LOCATION| 进行通讯。提取这些资讯，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToLand.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToLand.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToMobi.text: The disruption of |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach the data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToMobi.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的瓦解使得我们得以入侵位于 |LOCATION| 的资料网络。我们的资料块已经部署在该地点，找到它们并覆写终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToPuri.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToPuri.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机显露了一艘位于 |LOCATION| 的遗弃舰艇存有 |BOSS_NAME| 的实验性研究。入侵该舰艇，恢复货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToResc.text: Intel extracted from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToResc.zhText: 提取自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的情报揭露出一座 |BOSS_NAME| 的监牢位处 |LOCATION|。出发前往该处并将被俘虏的作业员平安救出。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToRetr.text: Schematics discovered at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToRetr.zhText: 于先前 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 所发现的数据模型指出在 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 把持着一组高规格能量核心原件。为了达成我们的目标前往回收它。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToSabo.text: Data stores found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToSabo.zhText: 于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 所发现的数据储存装置揭露出一处由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队所掌控的秘密据点，位于 |LOCATION|。趁敌方措手不及之际将其重点设备全数摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToSurv.text: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToSurv.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 残骸废墟中寻获的数据储存装置揭露出位于|LOCATION| 的一具神器，并由 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队所看守着。作业员前往回收的同时，牵制敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToTerr.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOArtifactToTerr.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受困的部队已向位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 数据中继点发送未受加密的通讯。在讯号仍在发送时进行拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssassinationD.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssassinationD.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultDesc1.text: |BOSS_NAME|'s troops stationed at |LOCATION| are bombarding nearby colonies with heavy fire. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put their cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultDesc1.zhText: 驻扎在 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 部队正重火力轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToArtif.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToArtif.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToAssas.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToAssas.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToAssau.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToAssau.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 派出了一支部队去占有在 |LOCATION| 新近探明的永冻晶体矿藏。在那里被占领前尽可能多地进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToDefen.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToDefen.zhText: 为了报复他们在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发起了一次进攻，针对被困在 |LOCATION| 的 Tenno 线人。镇压敌人，防止他被捕获。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToEvacu.text: A prisoner manifest found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates that enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations are being held at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToEvacu.zhText: 根据我们在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的一份囚犯名册中获得的情报，一些了解 |BOSS_NAME| 所主导的行动内情的叛逃者被关押在了 |LOCATION|。你必须在他们被审讯并处决前解救他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToExcav.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToExcav.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 派出了一支部队去占有在 |LOCATION| 新近探明的永冻晶体矿藏。在那里被占领前尽可能多地进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToExter.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToExter.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 获取的证据显示 |BOSS_NAME| 的一组先进部队已经部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们警戒前歼灭之。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToHiveD.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToHiveD.zhText: 来自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的敌人警戒部队已经在 |LOCATION| 启动了 |BOSS_NAME| 培育的幼虫的繁殖地。在疫情爆发前破坏巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToIntel.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToIntel.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机正于 |LOCATION| 的隐蔽数据网络通信。取出情报，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToLands.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToLands.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToMobil.text: The disruption of |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach the data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToMobil.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 对 |BOSS_NAME| 部队的干扰使得我们可以侵入 |LOCATION| 的数据网络。我们的数据端子已经放在了该地点；找到它们并覆写终端。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToPurif.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToPurif.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 派出了一支部队去占有在 |LOCATION| 新近探明的永冻晶体矿藏。在那里被占领前尽可能多地进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToRescu.text: Intel extracted from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToRescu.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 获取的情报揭露了一座位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 监狱。从那里把被俘的特工营救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToRetri.text: Schematics discovered at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToRetri.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现的图纸表面一种大型电池组件正由 |BOSS_NAME| 放置在 |LOCATION|。将其据为己有。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToSabot.text: Data stores found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToSabot.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的数据揭露了一座由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队控制，位于 |LOCATION| 的秘密基地。在敌人措手不及间，破坏所有关键的机械装置。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToSurvi.text: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToSurvi.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的残骸中找到的数据揭示了一件由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队守护，位于 |LOCATION| 的神器。在我们的特工偷取时与敌人交锋。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToTerri.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOAssaultToTerri.zhText: 来自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的受损部队向 |BOSS_NAME| 位于 |LOCATION| 的一个数据中转站派送出了未加密的传输。趁他们还在航行中，拦截这些信号。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureDesc1.text: A double-agent for |BOSS_NAME| has been exposed and tracked down. Find him at |LOCATION| and recover the stolen data at any cost.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureDesc1.zhText: 一名 |BOSS_NAME| 的双面间谍的已经暴露了身份并正被追踪，前往 |LOCATION| 找到他并不惜任何代价取回失窃的数据。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToArtif.text: Interrogation of the target captured at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToArtif.zhText: 审问 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 人质后发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToDefen.text: In retaliation for capturing the target at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToDefen.zhText: 为了报复他们在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 上的目标遭受捕获，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发起了一次进攻，针对被困在 |LOCATION| 的 Tenno 线人。镇压敌人，防止他被捕获。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToExcav.text: Interrogation of the target captured at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| suggest a large Cryotic deposit has been located at |LOCATION|. Excavate the site before |BOSS_NAME|'s units overtake it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToExcav.zhText: 通过审问 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 人质得知，|LOCATION| 存在有大量永冻晶矿。在 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队赶来前挖掘该地点。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToSurvi.text: Interrogation of the target captured at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has revealed an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToSurvi.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 人质审问出的情报揭露了位于|LOCATION| 的一具神器，并由 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队所看守着。作业员前往回收的同时，牵制敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToTerri.text: Interrogation of the target captured at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to decipher transmissions sent to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCaptureToTerri.zhText: 通过审问 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 人质得以让我们解译发送至位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 数据中继点的通讯。在讯号仍在发送时进行拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCounterIntelDe.text: A security breach has provided the opportunity to reroute the communication systems of a base operated by |BOSS_NAME|'s units. Reprogram the console at |LOCATION| before the window closes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOCounterIntelDe.zhText: 安保漏洞的出现，为重设 |BOSS_NAME| 部队所属基地的通讯系统带来了大好时机。趁这个机会对位于 |LOCATION| 的控制台重新编程。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseDesc1.text: A stranded Tenno informant has been discovered at |LOCATION| by a squad of |BOSS_NAME|'s units. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseDesc1.zhText: 一名受困的 Tenno 线人在 |LOCATION| 被|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发现。在线人被捕获以前压制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToArtif.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToArtif.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToAssas.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToAssas.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToAssau.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToAssau.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 拦截到的动员令显示 |LOCATION| 存在重型火炮，并被 |BOSS_NAME| 部队用来轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToDefen.text: A stranded Tenno informant has been discovered at |LOCATION| by a squad of |BOSS_NAME|'s units. Defend him from being captured while an extraction force is established.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToDefen.zhText: 一支 |BOSS_NAME| 部队的小队在 |LOCATION| 处发现一名受困的 Tenno 线人。在撤离准备完成以前，守护他避免遭到捕获。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToEvacu.text: A prisoner manifest found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates that enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations are being held at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToEvacu.zhText: 根据我们在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的一份囚犯名册中获得的情报，一些了解 |BOSS_NAME| 所主导的行动内情的叛逃者被关押在了 |LOCATION|。你必须在他们被审讯并处决前解救他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToExcav.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| suggest a large Cryotic deposit has been located at |LOCATION|. Excavate the site before |BOSS_NAME|'s units overtake it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToExcav.zhText: 拦截到 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的动员命令提示有一座蕴藏丰富的永冻晶矿座落于 |LOCATION|。在 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队捷足先登前抢先一步开采该区域。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToExter.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToExter.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 接获的证据指出一支 |BOSS_NAME| 的先遣部队部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们进入警戒前歼灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToHiveD.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToHiveD.zhText: |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受到惊动的敌人活化了位于 |LOCATION| 繁殖场的 |BOSS_NAME| 幼虫。在疫情爆发前摧毁这些巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToIntel.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToIntel.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现了一台发射机正以加密资料网络的方式与 |LOCATION| 进行通讯。提取这些资讯，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToLands.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToLands.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToMobil.text: The disruption of |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach the data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToMobil.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的瓦解使得我们得以入侵位于 |LOCATION| 的资料网络。我们的资料块已经部署在该地点，找到它们并覆写终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToPurif.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToPurif.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机显露了一艘位于 |LOCATION| 的遗弃舰艇存有 |BOSS_NAME| 的实验性研究。入侵该舰艇，恢复货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToRescu.text: Intel extracted from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToRescu.zhText: 提取自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的情报揭露出一座 |BOSS_NAME| 的监牢位处 |LOCATION|。出发前往该处并将被俘虏的作业员平安救出。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToRetri.text: Schematics abandoned by enemy units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToRetri.zhText: 根据 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 敌方部队所遗留的数据模型指出，在 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 把持着一组高规格能量核心原件。为了达成我们的目标前往回收它。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToSabot.text: Data stores found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToSabot.zhText: 于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 所发现的数据储存装置揭露出一处由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队所掌控的秘密据点，位于 |LOCATION|。趁敌方措手不及之际将其重点设备全数摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToSurvi.text: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToSurvi.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 残骸废墟中寻获的数据储存装置揭露出位于|LOCATION| 的一具神器，并由 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队所看守着。作业员前往回收的同时，牵制敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToTerri.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SODefenseToTerri.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受困的部队已向位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 数据中继点发送未受加密的通讯。在讯号仍在发送时进行拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationDesc.text: Enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations have been captured at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationDesc.zhText: 一些了解 |BOSS_NAME| 所主导的行动内情的叛逃者被关押在 |LOCATION|。你必须在他们被审讯并处决前解救他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToAr.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToAr.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToAs.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToAs.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToAs.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToAs.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队在 |LOCATION| 部署了用于轰炸附近殖民地的重型加农炮。你要潜入赤毒要塞并摧毁这些加农炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToDe.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToDe.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队向被困在 |LOCATION| 的一位协助 Tenno 的线人发动了攻击。你必须赶在他被抓走前消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToEv.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has revealed that more enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations have been captured at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToEv.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，许多了解 |BOSS_NAME| 所主导的行动内情的叛逃者都被关押在 |LOCATION|。你必须在他们被审讯并处决前解救他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToEx.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| suggest a large Cryotic deposit has been located at |LOCATION|. Excavate the site before |BOSS_NAME|'s units overtake it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToEx.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，|LOCATION| 的永冻晶矿储量丰富。你要赶在 |BOSS_NAME| 下手前完成采掘工作。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToEx.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToEx.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，|BOSS_NAME| 手下的一群精英部队已在 |LOCATION| 集结。你要在他们产生警戒之前将其悉数歼灭。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToHi.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToHi.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 而来的敌人已进入警戒状态，并在 |LOCATION| 建立了一个为 |BOSS_NAME| 幼体所准备的孵化场。你要趁感染疫情爆发前破坏掉那些巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToIn.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToIn.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，他们在使用一个处于 |LOCATION| 的隐秘数据网络与外界通信。趁 |BOSS_NAME| 还没有觉察到这一切之前，你要取回那些情报。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToLa.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToLa.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToMo.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach |BOSS_NAME|'s data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToMo.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，我们可以在 |LOCATION| 侵入 |BOSS_NAME| 的数据网络。行动所需的数据块已被部署，你要使用它们去覆写那些终端。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToPu.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToPu.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，在 |LOCATION| 有一艘废弃飞船，上面装有 |BOSS_NAME| 留下的研究资料。你要登上这艘飞船，并回收货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToRe.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToRe.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，有一个处于 |BOSS_NAME| 掌控下的监狱基地就在 |LOCATION|。你需要前往该处，并解救我方被囚禁的特工。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToRe.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToRe.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，有一个处于 |BOSS_NAME| 掌控下的大型能量核心部件就在 |LOCATION|。你要将其夺取，为我方所用。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToSa.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToSa.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，有一个处于 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队控制下的秘密基地就在 |LOCATION|。趁敌人疏于防备之时，你要将基地内所有关键设施都摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToSu.text: Intel provided by the defectors at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToSu.zhText: 根据位于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的叛逃者提供的情报，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队在 |LOCATION| 守护着一个文物。在我们特工回收该文物的过程中，你要去牵制敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToTe.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOEvacuationToTe.zhText: 被困在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的部队向位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 数据中转站发送了未经加密的求救信号。你要在信号尚未到达目的地前，将其截获。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateDesc1.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateDesc1.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 已派出单位至位于 |LOCATION| 处的永冻晶矿新采掘点。在此采掘点枯竭以前，尽可能的进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateDesc2.text: Cryotic deposits at |LOCATION| have caught the attention of |BOSS_NAME|. Excavators are being deployed while the mining opportunity exists; protect them from enemy units.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateDesc2.zhText: 位于 |LOCATION| 处的永冻晶矿采掘点已引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。发现挖掘可能位置时便会布署挖掘机；保护挖掘机不被敌人破坏。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToArti.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToArti.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToAssa.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToAssa.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToAssa.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToAssa.zhText: 对 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的侦查显示 |LOCATION| 存在重型火炮，并被 |BOSS_NAME| 部队用来轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToDefe.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToDefe.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的败退， |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙对受困于 |LOCATION| 的一位 Tenno 线人发起了一波攻击。在他遭到逮捕前压制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToEvac.text: A prisoner manifest found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates that enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations are being held at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToEvac.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|发现的一张囚犯清单表明掌握着|BOSS_NAME| 行动相关信息的敌方叛逃者被囚禁在 |LOCATION|。在囚犯被审讯和处决之前，将他们撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToExca.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToExca.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 已派出部队至位于 |LOCATION| 处的永冻晶矿新采掘点。在此采掘点枯竭以前，尽可能的进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToExte.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToExte.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 接获的证据指出一支 |BOSS_NAME| 的先遣部队部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们进入警戒前歼灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToHive.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToHive.zhText: |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受到惊动的敌人活化了位于 |LOCATION| 繁殖场的 |BOSS_NAME| 幼虫。在疫情爆发前摧毁这些巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToInte.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToInte.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现了一台发射机正以加密资料网络的方式与 |LOCATION| 进行通讯。提取这些资讯，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToLand.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToLand.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOExcavateToMobi.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的瓦解使得我们得以入侵位于 |LOCATION| 的资料网络。我们的资料块已经部署在该地点，找到它们并覆写终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToExcavate.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| suggest a large Cryotic deposit has been located at |LOCATION|. Excavate the site before |BOSS_NAME|'s units overtake it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToExcavate.zhText: 拦截到 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的动员命令提示有一座蕴藏丰富的永冻晶矿座落于 |LOCATION|。在 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队捷足先登前抢先一步开采该区域。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToExtermin.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToExtermin.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 接获的证据指出一支 |BOSS_NAME| 的先遣部队部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们进入警戒前歼灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToHiveDesc.text: A breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae has been detected at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToHiveDesc.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 处发现了滋生 |BOSS_NAME| 幼体的温床，在感染疫情爆发以前摧毁掉所有巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToIntelDes.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToIntelDes.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现了一台发射机正以加密资料网络的方式与 |LOCATION| 进行通讯。提取这些资讯，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToLandscap.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToLandscap.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToMobileDe.text: The disruption of |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach the data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToMobileDe.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的瓦解使得我们得以入侵位于 |LOCATION| 的资料网络。我们的资料块已经部署在该地点，找到它们并覆写终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToPurifyDe.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToPurifyDe.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机显露了一艘位于 |LOCATION| 的遗弃舰艇存有 |BOSS_NAME| 的实验性研究。入侵该舰艇，恢复货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToRescueDe.text: Intel extracted from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToRescueDe.zhText: 提取自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的情报揭露出一座 |BOSS_NAME| 的监牢位处 |LOCATION|。出发前往该处并将被俘虏的作业员平安救出。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToRetrieva.text: Schematics discovered at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToRetrieva.zhText: 于先前 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 所发现的数据模型指出在 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 把持着一组高规格能量核心原件。为了达成我们的目标前往回收它。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToSabotage.text: Data stores found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToSabotage.zhText: 于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 所发现的数据储存装置揭露出一处由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队所掌控的秘密据点，位于 |LOCATION|。趁敌方措手不及之际将其重点设备全数摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToSurvival.text: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToSurvival.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 残骸废墟中寻获的数据储存装置揭露出位于|LOCATION| 的一具神器，并由 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队所看守着。作业员前往回收的同时，牵制敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToTerritor.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOHiveToTerritor.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受困的部队已向位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 数据中继点发送未受加密的通讯。在讯号仍在发送时进行拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOIntelDesc1.zhText: 于 |LOCATION| 处发现 |BOSS_NAME| 的数据储藏金库。避开金库内最先进的保全设施，并取出重要的敏感数据。

Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
