/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseD.text: A compromised network has been found at a remote facility held by |BOSS_NAME|. Datamasses have been deployed to |LOCATION|; locate them and upload their contents to the terminals on site.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseD.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 控制的一个远程设施发现有受损的情报网络。已将数据块送至 |LOCATION|；取得数据块并将内容上传到现场的终端当中。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 拦截到的动员令显示 |LOCATION| 存在重型火炮，并被 |BOSS_NAME| 部队用来轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的败退， |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙对受困于 |LOCATION| 的一位 Tenno 线人发起了一波攻击。在他遭到逮捕前压制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: A prisoner manifest found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates that enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations are being held at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|发现的一张囚犯清单表明掌握着|BOSS_NAME| 行动相关信息的敌方叛逃者被囚禁在 |LOCATION|。在囚犯被审讯和处决之前，将他们撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| suggest a large Cryotic deposit has been located at |LOCATION|. Excavate the site before |BOSS_NAME|'s units overtake it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 拦截到 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的动员命令提示有一座蕴藏丰富的永冻晶矿座落于 |LOCATION|。在 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队捷足先登前抢先一步开采该区域。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 接获的证据指出一支 |BOSS_NAME| 的先遣部队部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们进入警戒前歼灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受到惊动的敌人活化了位于 |LOCATION| 繁殖场的 |BOSS_NAME| 幼虫。在疫情爆发前摧毁这些巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现了一台发射机正以加密资料网络的方式与 |LOCATION| 进行通讯。提取这些资讯，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: A compromised network has been found at a remote facility held by |BOSS_NAME|. Datamasses have been deployed to |LOCATION|; locate them and upload their contents to the terminals on site.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 控制的一个远程设施发现有受损的情报网络。已将数据块送至 |LOCATION|；取得数据块并将内容上传到现场的终端当中。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机显露了一艘位于 |LOCATION| 的遗弃舰艇存有 |BOSS_NAME| 的实验性研究。入侵该舰艇，恢复货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Intel extracted from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 提取自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的情报揭露出一座 |BOSS_NAME| 的监牢位处 |LOCATION|。出发前往该处并将被俘虏的作业员平安救出。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Schematics abandoned by enemy units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 根据 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 敌方部队所遗留的数据模型指出，在 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 把持着一组高规格能量核心原件。为了达成我们的目标前往回收它。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Data stores found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 于 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 所发现的数据储存装置揭露出一处由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队所掌控的秘密据点，位于 |LOCATION|。趁敌方措手不及之际将其重点设备全数摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 残骸废墟中寻获的数据储存装置揭露出位于|LOCATION| 的一具神器，并由 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队所看守着。作业员前往回收的同时，牵制敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOMobileDefenseT.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受困的部队已向位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 数据中继点发送未受加密的通讯。在讯号仍在发送时进行拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierDouble.text: Enemies here have been outfitted with fortified armor.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierDouble.zhText: 此处敌人的护甲已经过强化

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierDouble.text: Enemies here have been outfitted with fortified shields.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierDouble.zhText: 此处敌人护盾的已经过强化

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnemyE.text: Enemy units at this location have been upgraded with |DAMAGE_TYPE| Damage and Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnemyE.zhText: 此处敌人已获得 |DAMAGE_TYPE| 伤害及素质强化。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnemyE.text: Enemy units have been upgraded with additional |DAMAGE_TYPE| Damage and possess superior Elemental Damage resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnemyE.zhText: 敌人已获得额外的 |DAMAGE_TYPE| 伤害和元素抗性强化。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnemyP.text: Enemy units have been upgraded with additional |DAMAGE_TYPE| Damage and possess superior Physical Damage resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnemyP.zhText: 敌人已获得额外的 |DAMAGE_TYPE| 伤害和物理抗性强化。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnergy.text: A Void energy vortex is passing through this location. Warframe Energy capacity and regeneration will be severely reduced.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEnergy.zhText: 虚空的能量漩涡正流经此处，战甲的能量上限将会减半同时能量再生率也会大幅降低。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEximus.text: A large contingent of enemy Eximus units have been stationed here. Proceed with caution.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierEximus.zhText: 敌人的大型卓越者部队正驻扎在此处，务必小心谨慎。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierExtrem.text: Environmental conditions for this location indicate severely low temperatures. Mobility will be impaired as a result.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierExtrem.zhText: 此处的环境状况温度极低，将会影响移动能力。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierFireFl.text: A fire has broken out on the ship; intense heat will be detrimental to health and recovery rate.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierFireFl.zhText: 船舰上发生火灾；高温将损害生命与恢复速率。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierFogFla.text: Dense fog encompasses the area; enemy visibility will be limited.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierFogFla.zhText: 此处垄罩在迷雾之中；可见度将会大幅降低。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierGravit.text: Gravity stabilizers have been compromised. G-forces will be less than optimal.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierGravit.zhText: 重力稳定器受到损伤，G力将低于最佳设定。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierIceFla.text: The cryogenic core on board the ship has malfunctioned resulting in extreme cold temperatures. Your shield capacity will be reduced.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierIceFla.zhText: 这艘船上的低温核心发生故障，导致极度低温。而这将会减少你的护盾量。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierMagnet.text: Location is currently experiencing severe electromagnetic disturbances. Gravitational and magnetic anomalies will be pervasive throughout the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierMagnet.zhText: 当地目前正在经历严重的电磁干扰。磁力异常将会干扰整个任务。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierRadiat.text: Location has been heavily irradiated by a recent solar storm. Any Physical Damage received will also impart <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierRadiat.zhText: 此处由于近期太阳风暴的强烈辐射影响，所受到的任何物理伤害都将会附上<DT_RADIATION>辐射效果。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierSlowSh.text: Ionic interference at this location will significantly reduce the rate at which your shields recharge.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierSlowSh.zhText: 此处的离子干扰现象会明显降低你的护盾恢复速率。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierWeapon.text: Mechanical disruptors at this location are configured to disable a majority of weapons. |WEAPON_TYPE| weapons will be your only available option.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOModifierWeapon.zhText: 此处的机械干扰装置可以使大多数武器失效。因此|WEAPON_TYPE|类型的武器是你的唯一选择。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyDesc1.text: An experimental research vessel has been found at |LOCATION|. Recover the shipping manifests; their contents may be of use in our fight against |BOSS_NAME|.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyDesc1.zhText: 一艘实验性研究船被发现位于 |LOCATION|。恢复其货运清单；其中的内容也许可以用来对付 |BOSS_NAME|

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyName1.zhText: 执刑官猎杀：Infested 资源回收

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToArtifa.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToArtifa.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToAssaul.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToAssaul.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 拦截到的动员令显示 |LOCATION| 存在重型火炮，并被 |BOSS_NAME| 部队用来轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToDefens.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToDefens.zhText: 为了报复他们在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发起了一次进攻，针对被困在 |LOCATION| 的 Tenno 线人。镇压敌人，防止他被捕获。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToEvacua.text: A prisoner manifest found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates that enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations are being held at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToEvacua.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|发现的一张囚犯清单表明掌握着|BOSS_NAME| 行动相关信息的敌方叛逃者被囚禁在 |LOCATION|。在囚犯被审讯和处决之前，将他们撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToExcava.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToExcava.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 派出了一支部队去占有在 |LOCATION| 新近探明的永冻晶体矿藏。在那里被占领前尽可能多地进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToExterm.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToExterm.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 获取的证据显示 |BOSS_NAME| 的一组先进部队已经部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们警戒前歼灭之。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToHiveDe.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToHiveDe.zhText: 来自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的敌人警戒部队已经在 |LOCATION| 启动了 |BOSS_NAME| 培育的幼虫的繁殖地。在疫情爆发前破坏巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToIntelD.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToIntelD.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机正于 |LOCATION| 的隐蔽数据网络通信。取出情报，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToLandsc.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToLandsc.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToMobile.text: The disruption of |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach the data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToMobile.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 对 |BOSS_NAME| 部队的干扰使得我们可以侵入 |LOCATION| 的数据网络。我们的数据端子已经放在了该地点；找到它们并覆写终端。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToPurify.text: |BOSS_NAME| has dispatched units to claim a recently-discovered Cryotic deposit at |LOCATION|. Excavate as much as you can before the site is overrun.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToPurify.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 派出了一支部队去占有在 |LOCATION| 新近探明的永冻晶体矿藏。在那里被占领前尽可能多地进行挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToRescue.text: Intel extracted from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has uncovered a |BOSS_NAME| prison base at |LOCATION|. Go there and return captive operatives to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToRescue.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的数据揭露了一座由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队控制，位于 |LOCATION| 的秘密基地。在敌人放松警惕的时候，破坏所有关键的机械装置。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToRetrie.text: Schematics discovered at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToRetrie.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现的图纸表面一种大型电池组件正由 |BOSS_NAME| 放置在 |LOCATION|。将其据为己有。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToSabota.text: Data stores found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed a secret base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the enemy is taken off guard.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToSabota.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的数据揭露了一座由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队控制，位于 |LOCATION| 的秘密基地。在敌人措手不及间，破坏所有关键的机械装置。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToSurviv.text: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToSurviv.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的残骸中找到的数据揭示了一件由 |BOSS_NAME| 部队守护，位于 |LOCATION| 的神器。在我们的特工偷取时与敌人交锋。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToTerrit.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOPurifyToTerrit.zhText: 来自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的受损部队向 |BOSS_NAME| 位于 |LOCATION| 的一个数据中转站派送出了未加密的传输。趁他们还在航行中，拦截这些信号。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueDesc1.text: A Tenno operative possessing critical security information has been captured by |BOSS_NAME|'s units. Rescue him from the prison base located at |LOCATION| before he is tortured and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueDesc1.zhText: 一名持有重要安全信息的 Tenno 特工被|BOSS_NAME|的部队所捕获。在该名特工被折磨和处决以前，前往位于 |LOCATION| 的监禁基地进行救援。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueDesc2.text: A Tenno Informer has been captured near |LOCATION|. Liberate this hostage before |BOSS_NAME| obtains sensitive intelligence data.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueDesc2.zhText: 一名 Tenno 线人在 |LOCATION| 附近被擒住。在 |BOSS_NAME| 从他身上得到敏感情报数据以前，前去解救这名人质。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToArtifa.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToArtifa.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToAssass.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToAssass.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToAssaul.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToAssaul.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 拦截到的动员令显示 |LOCATION| 存在重型火炮，并被 |BOSS_NAME| 部队用来轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToDefens.text: Outraged by the escape of their hostage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToDefens.zhText: 因 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的人质遭到逃脱一事触动其怒火， |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙对受困于 |LOCATION| 的一位 Tenno 线人发起了一波攻击。在他遭到逮捕前压制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToEvacua.text: A prisoner manifest found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates that enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations are being held at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToEvacua.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|发现的一张囚犯清单表明掌握着|BOSS_NAME| 行动相关信息的敌方叛逃者被囚禁在 |LOCATION|。在囚犯被审讯和处决之前，将他们撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToExcava.text: Mobilization orders overheard by the hostage from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| suggest a large Cryotic deposit has been located at |LOCATION|. Excavate the site before |BOSS_NAME|'s units overtake it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToExcava.zhText: 根据从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 人质所窃听的动员命令提示有一座蕴藏丰富的永冻晶矿座落于 |LOCATION|。在 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队捷足先登前抢先一步开采该区域。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToExterm.text: Evidence obtained from the hostage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToExterm.zhText: 根据从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 人质获得的证据指出一支 |BOSS_NAME| 的先遣部队部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们进入警戒前歼灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToHiveDe.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToHiveDe.zhText: |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受到惊动的敌人活化了位于 |LOCATION| 繁殖场的 |BOSS_NAME| 幼虫。在疫情爆发前摧毁这些巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToIntelD.text: The hostage recovered from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has alerted us to a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToIntelD.zhText: 根据从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 营救之人质警告我们位于 |LOCATION| 的加密资料网络。提取这些资讯，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToLandsc.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToLandsc.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToMobile.text: Intel carried by the hostage recovered from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach |BOSS_NAME|'s data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToMobile.zhText: |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的人质所携带的情报使我们得以入侵 |BOSS_NAME| 位于 |LOCATION| 的资料网路。我们的资料块已经部署在该地点，找到它们并覆写终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToPurify.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToPurify.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机显露了一艘位于 |LOCATION| 的遗弃舰艇存有 |BOSS_NAME| 的实验性研究。入侵该舰艇，恢复货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SORescueToRetrie.zhText: 根据从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 营救之人质所提供的数据模型指出，在 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 把持着一组高规格能量核心原件。为了达成我们的目标前往回收它。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToRetr.text: Schematics abandoned by enemy units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicate a large-scale power cell component is being held by |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Retrieve it for our own purposes.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToRetr.zhText: 根据 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 敌方部队所遗留的数据模型指出，在 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 把持着一组高规格能量核心原件。为了达成我们的目标前往回收它。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToSabo.text: A hidden base controlled by |BOSS_NAME|'s units has been discovered at |LOCATION|. Destroy all essential machinery while the opportunity presents itself.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToSabo.zhText: 在 |LOCATION| 被发现了一座由 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队所管理的隐密设施。把握时机将其重点设备全数摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToSurv.text: Data stores found among the wreckage at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| reveal an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |LOCATION|. Engage enemy units there while our operatives retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToSurv.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 残骸废墟中寻获的数据储存装置揭露出位于|LOCATION| 的一具神器，并由 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队所看守着。作业员前往回收的同时，牵制敌方部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToTerr.text: Distressed units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have dispatched unencrypted transmissions to a |BOSS_NAME| data relay at |LOCATION|. Intercept these signals while they are still in flight.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSabotageToTerr.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受困的部队已向位于 |LOCATION| 的 |BOSS_NAME| 数据中继点发送未受加密的通讯。在讯号仍在发送时进行拦截。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalDesc1.text: Provide a distraction at |LOCATION| while Tenno operatives recover an artifact guarded by |BOSS_NAME|'s units.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalDesc1.zhText: 在 Tenno 特工取出受到|BOSS_NAME| 镇守的神器时，前往 |LOCATION| 支开敌人的注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalDesc2.text: Tenno operatives require your support. Attack the storage facility near |LOCATION|. Keep |BOSS_NAME|'s units occupied for as long as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalDesc2.zhText: Tenno 特工需要你的支持。请攻击 |LOCATION| 附近的仓储设施，尽你所能拖延住 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToArti.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is using experimental conduit technology to hide stolen resources at |LOCATION|. Recover these items with Little Duck's assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToArti.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 使用实验性的导管技术来藏匿偷窃来的资源。通过小鸭子的协助将这些物品取回。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToAssa.text: Reconnaissance efforts at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed that |BOSS_NAME| is directly overseeing an operation at |LOCATION|. Strike now while the opportunity exists.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToAssa.zhText: 侦察 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的时候发现 |BOSS_NAME| 在 |LOCATION| 现身监督一项行动的进行。在机会还在的时候立刻进行打击。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToAssa.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed the presence of heavy cannons at |LOCATION| which are being used by |BOSS_NAME|'s troops to bombard nearby colonies. Infiltrate the Kuva Fortress and put these cannons out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToAssa.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 拦截到的动员令显示 |LOCATION| 存在重型火炮，并被 |BOSS_NAME| 部队用来轰炸附近的殖民地。潜入赤毒要塞，破坏他们的火炮。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToDefe.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an attack on a stranded Tenno informant at |LOCATION|. Suppress the enemy before he can be captured.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToDefe.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的败退， |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙对受困于 |LOCATION| 的一位 Tenno 线人发起了一波攻击。在他遭到逮捕前压制敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToEvac.text: A prisoner manifest found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates that enemy defectors holding pertinent information about |BOSS_NAME|'s operations are being held at |LOCATION|. Evacuate the prisoners before they are interrogated and executed.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToEvac.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|发现的一张囚犯清单表明掌握着|BOSS_NAME| 行动相关信息的敌方叛逃者被囚禁在 |LOCATION|。在囚犯被审讯和处决之前，将他们撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToExca.text: Mobilization orders intercepted at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| suggest a large Cryotic deposit has been located at |LOCATION|. Excavate the site before |BOSS_NAME|'s units overtake it.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToExca.zhText: 拦截到 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的动员命令提示有一座蕴藏丰富的永冻晶矿座落于 |LOCATION|。在 |BOSS_NAME| 的部队捷足先登前抢先一步开采该区域。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToExte.text: Evidence obtained from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| indicates an advanced group of |BOSS_NAME|'s units is deployed at |LOCATION|. Eliminate them before they are alerted.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToExte.zhText: 自 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 接获的证据指出一支 |BOSS_NAME| 的先遣部队部署在 |LOCATION|。在他们进入警戒前歼灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToHive.text: Alerted enemy units from |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have activated a breeding grounds for |BOSS_NAME| larvae at |LOCATION|. Destroy the hives before an outbreak occurs.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToHive.zhText: |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 受到惊动的敌人活化了位于 |LOCATION| 繁殖场的 |BOSS_NAME| 幼虫。在疫情爆发前摧毁这些巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToInte.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| are in communication with a concealed data network at |LOCATION|. Extract information without raising |BOSS_NAME|'s attention.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToInte.zhText: 在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 发现了一台发射机正以加密资料网络的方式与 |LOCATION| 进行通讯。提取这些资讯，不要引起 |BOSS_NAME| 的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToLand.text: In retaliation for their defeat at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION|, |BOSS_NAME|'s units have launched an incursion on the civilians of |LOCATION|. Defend the colony from the attackers.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToLand.zhText: 为了报复在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的失利，|BOSS_NAME| 的部队发动了一次对 |LOCATION| 的平民的入侵。为殖民地抵御入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToMobi.text: The disruption of |BOSS_NAME|'s units at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| has allowed us to breach the data network at |LOCATION|. Our datamasses have been deployed to the site; locate them and override the terminals.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToMobi.zhText: |BOSS_NAME| 的爪牙在 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 的瓦解使得我们得以入侵位于 |LOCATION| 的资料网络。我们的资料块已经部署在该地点，找到它们并覆写终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToPuri.text: Transmitters found at |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| have revealed an abandoned ship containing experimental research of |BOSS_NAME| at |LOCATION|. Infiltrate the vessel and recover the shipping manifests.
/Lotus/Language/Sorties/SOSurvivalToPuri.zhText: 从 |PREVIOUS_LOCATION| 找到的发报机显露了一艘位于 |LOCATION| 的遗弃舰艇存有 |BOSS_NAME| 的实验性研究。入侵该舰艇，恢复货运清单。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/ScenarioJoinNo.text: Could not join session. You may only join squads that are connected to your current Flotilla instance.
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/ScenarioJoinNo.zhText: 无法加入队伍。你只能加入已连接到当前舰队的队伍。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/ScenarioReconn.text: Your Operation Link connection was unexpectedly interrupted. Rejoin the Relay?
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/ScenarioReconn.zhText: 你的联动作战连接意外中断。是否重新加入到中继站？

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/ScenarioRequir.text: This Operation Link session can only be joined by invitation from the host.
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/ScenarioRequir.zhText: 这个联动作战进程只能由主机邀请加入。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SpaceMissionCl.text: This mission can only be launched by the host of your squad.

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SpaceMissionSq.text: You currently do not own a Railjack. Squads cannot access this mission unless they are hosted by a player who owns a Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SpaceMissionSq.zhText: 你当前没有航道星舰。除非作为主机的玩家拥有一艘航道星舰，否则该队伍无法进入这个任务。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SquadStateProg.zhText: 骨螺战舰已被 |PLAYER_NAME| 的队伍驱离！当前总计：|VALUE|

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportHealRai.zhText: 感谢贡献卫星修复无人机！

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportHealSce.zhText: 已收到你发送的联动作战信标强化装置模块！感谢你的帮助，|PLAYER_NAME|！

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportHealSce.text: |PLAYER_NAME|, I have deployed an OpLink Reinforcement Module to your location. Defeat the enemy!
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportHealSce.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME|，我已经部署了一个联动作战信标强化装置模块到你所在的地方。击败敌军！

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportNoSquad.text: No eligible Squads found requiring support
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportNoSquad.zhText: 没有符合条件的小队需要支援

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportNoVendo.text: Unable to send support at this time; please try again later
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportNoVendo.zhText: 现在暂时不能提供支援；请稍后再试。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportSquadAl.zhText: |PLAYER_NAME| 已经支援了这个小队。无法提供额外支援。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/SupportSquadNo.zhText: 这个小队已从他们的任务中撤离。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/WaitForTeammat.zhText: 请等待所有队友返回舰队以便开始任务。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/WaveFail.zhText: 剩下的骨螺战舰已被重新部署到一个新的位置。

/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/WaveSuccess.text: Victory! All Murex have been forced into retreat!
/Lotus/Language/SquadLink/WaveSuccess.zhText: 胜利！所有骨螺战舰都已被迫撤退！

/Lotus/Language/StartingZoneChoice/Parad.text:
Melee-focused, ever-changing gameplay calling for skill and timing.

As the enigmatic Drifter, survive with blade, gun, and the occasional Warframe as you fight to escape the surreal world of ‘The Duviri Paradox'.

The ‘Warframe Path' will open to you early in your progression.
/Lotus/Language/StartingZoneChoice/Parad.zhText:
以近战为重点，不断变化的玩法，对技巧和时机把握的考验。

作为神秘的漂泊者，使用刀枪、偶尔用战甲来生存，奋力逃离《双衍悖论》中的超现实世界。

“战甲之路”将在你的游戏进度初期向你开放。

/Lotus/Language/StartingZoneChoice/Warfr.text:
Fast-paced, parkour-heavy combat against hordes of enemies.

Awaken a Void-marked Tenno and master the ways of the Warframe as you battle through ‘Vor's Prize', and the Origin System.

The ‘Paradox Path' will open to you early in your progression.
/Lotus/Language/StartingZoneChoice/Warfr.zhText:
快节奏、跑酷式的战斗，对抗成群的敌人。

唤醒一个带有虚空标记的 Tenno，掌握战甲之道，并在《沃尔的战利品》和始源星系中战斗。

“悖论之路”将在你的游戏进度初期向你开放。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/Loadout_UpgradeWea.text:
This weapon can be fused with another weapon of the same type into one with superior stats.

See: Actions > Valence Fusion
/Lotus/Language/Stats/Loadout_UpgradeWea.zhText:
这把武器可与另一把同类型武器融合，成为一把属性更强的武器。

参见：指令 > 效价融合

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Accuracy.text: Consecutive shots reduce accuracy. Improve accuracy while using Aim.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Accuracy.zhText: 连续射击会降低精准度。瞄准时可提高精准度。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_AoERange.text: Attacks will damage enemies within this radius.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_AoERange.zhText: 攻击会对这个范围内的敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Armor.text:
Reduces damage to Health by |AMOUNT|%.

Shields are not affected by Armor.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Armor.zhText:
减少 |AMOUNT|% 对生命值造成的伤害。

护盾不受护甲的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_BeamRange.text: The maximum distance a beam can reach. Beam chains between targets are not affected by this range.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_BeamRange.zhText: 光束可以到达的最大距离。目标之间的光束链不受此范围影响。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_BlockingAngle.text: While in hand, melee weapons block incoming attacks within a |AMOUNT|° cone. Blocking is centered around the current point of aim.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_BlockingAngle.zhText: 手持近战武器时，近战武器会格挡 |AMOUNT|° 内来袭的攻击。格挡以当前瞄准点为中心。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CargoCapacity.text: Determines the amount of resources the Railjack can hold in a single mission. Modified by Railjack upgrades.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CargoCapacity.zhText: 决定了在单个任务中航道星舰可容纳的资源量。可由所装备的航道星舰升级物品调整。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ChargeRate.text: Time to charge the weapon before it is ready to fire. Some weapons can fire with less than a full charge but with reduced effectiveness.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ChargeRate.zhText: 在武器可以开火之前所需要的蓄力时间。有些武器可以在没有蓄满力时开火，但威力会变低。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ComboCount.text: New Combos start with |AMOUNT| points instead of zero.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ComboCount.zhText: 新的连击从 |AMOUNT| 点开始，而不是从零。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ComboDuration.text:
Combo Multiplier increases the damage of Heavy Attacks. 

Combo duration determines how long the combo multiplier lasts after it increases. Refresh the timer by adding to the Combo Count (damage multiplier for Heavy Attacks) with melee hits or blocks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ComboDuration.zhText:
连击倍率会提高重击的伤害。 

连击持续时间决定连击倍率增加后持续的时间。通过近战命中或格挡获取连击数（重击为伤害倍率）来刷新计时器。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ComboEfficienc.text: Reduces the amount of Combo Count (damage multiplier for Heavy Attacks) consumed by Heavy Attacks. Efficiency cannot exceed 90%.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ComboEfficienc.zhText: 减少重击所消耗的连击数（伤害倍率对应重击）。效率无法超过 90%。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CreatingStatus.text:
Adding two different types of primary Status Mods can create a new secondary Damage Type.

|OPEN_COLOR|COMBINATIONS|CLOSE_COLOR|
|COMBOS|
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CreatingStatus.zhText:
结合两种不同类型的主要异常状态 Mod 可以创造新的次级伤害类型。

|OPEN_COLOR|组合|CLOSE_COLOR|
|COMBOS|

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CriticalChance.text:
Chance that any given hit will do bonus Critical Damage.

Values over 100% have a chance to become Big Critical Hits (orange), and over 200% have a chance to become Super Critical Hits (red).
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CriticalChance.zhText:
任意给定攻击造成额外暴击伤害的几率。

数值超过 100% 有几率会变为强力暴击（橙色），超过 200% 有几率会变为超级暴击（红色）。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CriticalMultip.text:
The Damage Total is multiplied by this value when a critical hit is inflicted.

The added Damage is doubled for Big Critical Hits (orange), and tripled for Super Critical Hits (red).
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_CriticalMultip.zhText:
造成暴击伤害时，总计伤害会乘上该数值。

强力暴击（橙色）会增加双倍伤害，而超级暴击（红色）会增加三倍伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_CORROSIVE.text:
Created by combining <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin and <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage.

<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive temporarily removes up to |OPEN_COLOR|80%|CLOSE_COLOR| of the target’s armor value with multiple stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_CORROSIVE.zhText:
由 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素和 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害组成。

<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀会通过多次叠加，暂时移除目标至多 |OPEN_COLOR|80%|CLOSE_COLOR| 的护甲值。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_ELECTRICITY.text: <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity chains between nearby enemies, temporarily applying a stun effect and dealing damage over time.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_ELECTRICITY.zhText: <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击将附近的敌人连锁起来，并对其造成眩晕状态与持续的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_ELECTRICITY.text: Railjack <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage results in a Scramble Status Effect which temporarily disables enemy ship flight controls.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_ELECTRICITY.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害会导致混乱异常状态，该状态会暂时使敌舰的飞行控制失效。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_EXPLOSION.text:
Created by combining <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat and <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage.

<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast deals |OPEN_COLOR|30%|CLOSE_COLOR| of base damage after |OPEN_COLOR|1.5|CLOSE_COLOR| seconds as an explosion. At |OPEN_COLOR|10|CLOSE_COLOR| stacks or on death, stacks deal their damage simultaneously to enemies within |OPEN_COLOR|5m|CLOSE_COLOR| while staggering them.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_EXPLOSION.zhText:
由 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰和 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害组成。 

<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸在 |OPEN_COLOR|1.5|CLOSE_COLOR| 秒后造成基础伤害的 |OPEN_COLOR|30%|CLOSE_COLOR|。在叠加到 |OPEN_COLOR|10|CLOSE_COLOR| 层或死亡时，叠加的伤害会同时对 |OPEN_COLOR|5米|CLOSE_COLOR| 范围内的敌人造成伤害并使其失衡。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FIRE.text: <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat sets enemies on fire causing them to panic and temporarily reduces their armor up to |OPEN_COLOR|50%|CLOSE_COLOR| with multiple stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FIRE.zhText: <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰会灼烧敌人，使他们惊慌失措，并可通过多次叠加将他们的护甲暂时降低最多 |OPEN_COLOR|50%|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FIRE_SPACE.text: Railjack <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage results in a Sear Status Effect which causes rounds to burn through enemy ships and deal Damage Over Time.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FIRE_SPACE.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害会导致灼烧异常状态，该状态会使燃烧的弹药穿透敌舰并随时间对其造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FREEZE.text: <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold causes enemies to move and attack slower for each stack and will completely freeze for |OPEN_COLOR|3|CLOSE_COLOR| seconds upon reaching |OPEN_COLOR|10|CLOSE_COLOR| stacks. Increase Critical Damage by |OPEN_COLOR|10%|CLOSE_COLOR| on the first stack, with an additional |OPEN_COLOR|5%|CLOSE_COLOR| per stack. This effect doubles when frozen.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FREEZE.zhText: <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态会降低敌人最高 |OPEN_COLOR|90%|CLOSE_COLOR| 的移动速度和攻击速度，并且在多次叠加时，暂时使敌人受到的暴击伤害最高增加至 |OPEN_COLOR|50%|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FREEZE_SPAC.text: Railjack <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage results in an Immobilize Status Effect which disables enemy ship flight controls and slows them to a halt.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_FREEZE_SPAC.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害会导致冻停异常状态，该状态会禁用敌舰的飞行控制并使其停下。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_GAS.text:
Created by combining <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.

<DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas produces gas clouds that deal damage to all enemies within a |OPEN_COLOR|3|CLOSE_COLOR| meter radius for a short duration.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_GAS.zhText:
由 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害组成。

<DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气会产生毒气云，在短时间内对 |OPEN_COLOR|3|CLOSE_COLOR| 米范围内的所有敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_IMPACT.text:
<DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact causes the target to flail backwards temporarily, with repeated stacks increasing the size and duration of the stagger.

For heavy units such as Eximus, it also lowers the Parazon Mercy Kill threshold to |OPEN_COLOR|80%|CLOSE_COLOR| of total health with multiple stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_IMPACT.zhText:
<DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击使目标暂时蹒跚后退，重复叠加会增加失衡的规模和持续时间。

对于卓越者等重型单位，可通过多次叠加来将灭骸之刃怜悯之击的阈值降低至总生命值的 |OPEN_COLOR|80%|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_IMPACT_SPAC.text: Railjack <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Damage results in a Concuss Status Effect which reduces the aim and damage of enemy ships.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_IMPACT_SPAC.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击伤害会导致震荡异常状态，可降低敌舰的瞄准以及造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_MAGNETIC.text:
Created by combining <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold and <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage.

<DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic increases Shield and Overguard damage by up to |OPEN_COLOR|325%|CLOSE_COLOR| with multiple stacks and disables the target’s Shield Regeneration for a short duration. When Shield or Overguard breaks, deal Electricity Damage for |OPEN_COLOR|3%|CLOSE_COLOR| of enemy's Max Shield or Overguard per stack with a forced <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status Effect.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_MAGNETIC.zhText:
由 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻和 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害组成。

<DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力可通过多层叠加来使护盾以及超宏防护受到的伤害增加至多 |OPEN_COLOR|325%|CLOSE_COLOR|，并且会使目标的护盾恢复短暂失效。当击破护盾或超宏防护时，每层磁力异常状态可对敌人造成其最大护盾或超宏防护 |OPEN_COLOR|3%|CLOSE_COLOR| 的电击伤害，并强制产生 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_POISON.text: <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin allows damage to bypass enemy Shields and deal damage directly to their Health over a short duration.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_POISON.zhText: <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素会无视敌人护盾并对其生命值直接造成短暂的持续伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_POISON_SPAC.text: Railjack <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage results in a Intoxicate Status Effect which confuses enemy ships to attack the nearest target, including allies.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_POISON_SPAC.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害会导致迷惑异常状态，该状态会迷惑敌舰使其攻击包括友军在内的最近目标。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_PUNCTURE.text: <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture temporarily reduces the target's damage output by up to |OPEN_COLOR|80%|CLOSE_COLOR| and increases Critical Chance of damage taken by up to |OPEN_COLOR|25%|CLOSE_COLOR| with multiple stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_PUNCTURE.zhText: <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态可暂时降低目标最高 |OPEN_COLOR|80%|CLOSE_COLOR| 的伤害输出，且可叠加其受到伤害的暴击几率至最多 |OPEN_COLOR|25%|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_PUNCTURE_SP.text: Railjack <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage results in a Decompress Status Effect which temporarily reduces the Shields and Armor of enemy ships.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_PUNCTURE_SP.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害会导致减压异常状态，该状态会暂时降低敌舰的护盾及护甲。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_RADIANT.text:
Highly effective against enemies with Overguard Health and Sentients as it resets their damage adaptation.

<DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void creates a bullet attractor sphere on the target that attracts and concentrates further attacks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_RADIANT.zhText:
对付拥有超宏防护的敌人和 Sentient 非常有效，因为它会重置他们的伤害适应性。

<DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空异常状态会在目标身上创造一个弹丸形引力球，该球体会吸引并聚集后续的攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_RADIATION.text:
Created by combining <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat and <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage.

<DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation causes enemies to attack everything nearby, including allies, for a short duration. Confusion damage increases up to |OPEN_COLOR|550%|CLOSE_COLOR| with multiple stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_RADIATION.zhText:
由 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰和 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害组成。

<DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射使敌人在短时间内攻击附近的一切，包括其友军。通过多次叠加，混乱伤害最多可增加至 |OPEN_COLOR|550%|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SENTIENT.text: <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau increases Status Chance of all subsequent attacks by up to |OPEN_COLOR|100%|CLOSE_COLOR| with multiple stacks.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SENTIENT.zhText: <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态将提升后续攻击的触发几率，可多次叠加至 |OPEN_COLOR|100%|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SENTIENT_RE.text: <DT_SENTIENT> Tau Resistance: Reduces incoming Sentient Damage by |AMOUNT|%.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SENTIENT_RE.zhText: <DT_SENTIENT> Tau 抗性：降低 |AMOUNT|% Sentient 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SLASH.text: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash temporarily ignores the target's armor and causes them to bleed over time for extra damage.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SLASH.zhText: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割无视目标的护甲并且使其持续出血，造成额外伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SLASH_SPACE.text: Railjack <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage results in a Tear Status Effect which increases damage dealt to enemy ships.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_SLASH_SPACE.zhText: 航道星舰 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害会导致撕裂异常状态，该状态会增加对敌舰造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_VIRAL.text:
Created by combining <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.

<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral increases damage to health up to |OPEN_COLOR|325%|CLOSE_COLOR| with multiple stacks for a short duration.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DT_VIRAL.zhText:
由 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害组成。

<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒可在短时间内通过多次叠加，来增加对生命值造成的伤害，最高可达到 |OPEN_COLOR|325%|CLOSE_COLOR|。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DamageFallOff.text: Damage varies depending on the distance to the target. Damage is highest if closer than the first distance, and minimal beyond the second distance.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_DamageFallOff.zhText: 伤害取决于与目标之间的距离。如果距离短于第一个标记的距离则伤害最高，长于第二个标记的距离则伤害最低。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_EngineBoost.text: Temporarily increase Railjack’s mobility in a burst of speed. Boosting drains gauge which recovers when not in use.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_EngineBoost.zhText: 爆发加速来暂时提高航道星舰的机动性。加速会消耗计量条，在不使用时会恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Engines.text: Determines Railjack’s speed, Boost Speed Multiplier, and other special traits based on the equipped Engines type.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Engines.zhText: 根据所装备的引擎类型，决定了航道星舰的速度、助推速度倍率和其他特殊特性。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_FireRate.text: Maximum number of projectiles that can be launched per second.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_FireRate.zhText: 每秒可发射的最大投射物数量。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_FireRateMelee.text: Melee striking speed. The number of attacks per second varies by weapon type and Stance.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_FireRateMelee.zhText: 近战攻击速度。每秒攻击次数会因武器类型和架式而异。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_FollowThrough.text: Modifies the amount of damage dealt in a single strike each time an additional enemy is hit after the first.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_FollowThrough.zhText: 在第一名敌人被击中后，调整同一次攻击命中另一名敌人所造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Health.text: How much damage can be sustained before becoming incapacitated.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Health.zhText: 在失去战斗能力之前可以承受多少伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavyAttack.text: Base damage of the weapon's Heavy Attack. Damage is increased by Combo Multiplier, but consumes Combo Count.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavyAttack.zhText: 武器重攻击的基础伤害。伤害可通过连击倍率提高，但消耗连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavyAttackWin.text: Time it takes to execute a Heavy Attack.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavyAttackWin.zhText: 执行一次重击所需的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavySlamAttac.text: Damage inflicted with a Heavy Slam attack. Damage is increased by Combo Multiplier, but consumes Combo Count.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavySlamAttac.zhText: 重型震地攻击造成的伤害。伤害可通过连击倍率提高，但消耗连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavySlamAttac.text: Additional damage inflicted in the radius of a Heavy Slam attack. Damage is increased by Combo Multiplier, but consumes Combo Count.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavySlamAttac.zhText: 重型震地攻击范围内造成的额外伤害。伤害可通过连击倍率提高，但消耗连击数。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavySlamAttac.text: Heavy Slam attacks hit all enemies around the point of impact within this distance.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_HeavySlamAttac.zhText: 重型震地攻击会在此距离内攻击所有在撞击点附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Mag.text: The number of ammo rounds a weapon’s magazine holds.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Mag.zhText: 一件武器弹匣可容纳的弹药数量。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_MeleeRange.text: Melee attacks hit enemies within this distance. Some Stances offer more Range using throws or lunges.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_MeleeRange.zhText: 近战攻击在此距离内能击中敌人。有些架式可以使用投掷或猛冲来获得更大的范围。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ModCapacity.text: The limit of Avionics that can be installed into the Railjack’s Avionics Grid based on their drain.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ModCapacity.zhText: 根据航电设备的消耗，而设定的可以被安装到航道星舰航电设备区格中的上限。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Mult_SprintSpe.text: Modifies how fast a Warframe moves while sprinting.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Mult_SprintSpe.zhText: 调整战甲冲刺时的移动速度。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Multishot.text:
The number of damage instances fired per shot without consuming additional ammo.

Each damage instance has its own chance to apply Critical Hits or Status Effects.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Multishot.zhText:
每次射击不消耗额外弹药而产生的伤害次数。

每一道伤害自身都有施加暴击或触发异常状态的几率。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Noise.text: Unalerted enemies will react to weapons being fired if they are Alarming, but not if they are Silent.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Noise.zhText: 未警觉的敌人将对武器射击发出的声响做出反应，但如果武器是无声的则不会做出反应。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_OmegaAtten.text: Modifies the performance of an equipped Riven mod. More filled dots indicates stronger stats.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_OmegaAtten.zhText: 调整一张已装备的裂罅 Mod 的性能。点数越多则数值越强。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power.text: Unused Mod Capacity increases the Warframe's Energy at the start of missions.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power.zhText: 未消耗的 Mod 容量会增加你在任务开始时战甲拥有的能量。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_PowerRecovery.zhText: 能量恢复速率为每秒 <ENERGY>|AMOUNT| 能量

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Duration.text: Modifies the Duration of Warframe Abilities and the Energy cost of toggled Abilities. Hover over each Ability to see how its stats are affected.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Duration.zhText: 调整战甲的技能持续时间和启用技能的能量消耗。将鼠标悬停在每个技能上来查看该数值是如何被影响的。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.text: Modifies the |LABEL| cost of Warframe Abilities. |LABEL| cost cannot be reduced below 25% of its initial value.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.zhText: 调整战甲的技能|LABEL|消耗。|LABEL|消耗无法降低至其初始数值的 25% 以下。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.text: Abilities cost |AMOUNT|% of their initial value
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.zhText: 技能消耗其初始数值的 |AMOUNT|%。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.text: Modifies ability cooldown reduction granted by Transmutation Probe.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.zhText: 调整炼制探头带来的技能冷却时间缩短。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.text: Channeled Abilities cost |AMOUNT|% of their initial value. Ability Duration affects the cost.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Efficien.zhText: 导引状态技能消耗其初始数值的 |AMOUNT|%。技能持续时间影响消耗量。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Range.text: Modifies the Range of Warframe Abilities. Hover over each Ability to see how its stats are affected.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Range.zhText: 调整战甲的技能范围。将鼠标悬停在每个技能上来查看该数值是如何被影响的。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Strength.text: Modifies the Strength of Warframe Abilities. Hover over each Ability to see how its stats are affected.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Power_Strength.zhText: 调整战甲的技能强度。将鼠标悬停在每个技能上来查看该数值是如何被影响的。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_PowersuitShiel.text: Shields recharge automatically after damage is taken, with a delay of |AMOUNT| seconds
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_PowersuitShiel.zhText: 受到伤害后，护盾会自动恢复，延迟时间为 |AMOUNT| 秒

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_PowersuitShiel.text: Shields recharge at a rate of |AMOUNT| per second. Rate scales with Max Shields.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_PowersuitShiel.zhText: 护盾以每秒 |AMOUNT| 恢复。恢复速度根据最大护盾变化。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ProcChance.text:
The chance that a hit will apply a Status Effect based on the types of damage the weapon inflicts.

Values over 100% have a chance to inflict multiple Status Effects at once.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ProcChance.zhText:
一发命中有几率触发异常状态，异常状态基于武器所造成的伤害类型。

数值超过 100％ 将有几率同时造成多个异常状态。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ProcChancePerD.text: Chance for each Status Effect type per hit:
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ProcChancePerD.zhText: 每次击中时，每种异常状态的触发几率：

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ProcChancePerS.text: The chance per projectile that a Status Effect will apply based on the type of damage the weapon inflicts.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ProcChancePerS.zhText: 每枚投射物可触发异常状态的几率，异常状态基于武器所造成的伤害类型。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Punchthrough.text: Determines how far projectiles can pass through enemies and objects. Each pierced target subtracts the value of the remaining Punch Through potential for that projectile.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Punchthrough.zhText: 决定投射物可以穿透敌人和物体的距离。每个被穿透的目标都会减少该投射物接下来的穿透系数。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackAmmoRe.text: The rate that Railjack turrets build up heat while shooting.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackAmmoRe.zhText: 航道星舰炮台射击时所累积热量的速率。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackArmor.text: Reduces damage received to Hull by |AMOUNT|%. Can be increased with the Hull Weave Integrated Avionic.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackArmor.zhText: 降低 |AMOUNT|% 舰体受到的伤害。可通过舰体编铸这一综合航电设备提升数值。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackHealth.text: Critical to Railjack integrity. When the Hull goes, the Railjack goes.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackHealth.zhText: 对航道星舰的完整性至关重要。当舰体被破坏后，航道星舰也不复存在。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackMag.text: The limit that Railjack turrets can shoot before overheating. Turrets cannot be fired temporarily when Heat Capacity is hit. Turrets cool off when they are not being fired. Can be increased with the Polar Coil Integrated Avionic.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackMag.zhText: 航道星舰炮台可以在过热前进行射击的上限。炮台将在达到热容量时暂时无法射击。炮台可在停止射击时冷却。可通过「极性线圈」综合航电设备来进行提升。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackReload.text: The time in seconds it takes for Railjack turrets to cool down after overheating. This can be reduced with the Gunnery 7 Intrinsic.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackReload.zhText: 用于冷却过热的航道星舰炮台的所需时间（以秒为单位）。可通过达到枪炮内源之力 7 级来减少此时间。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackShield.text: Shields absorb damage and protect the hull. Shields recharge automatically.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackShield.zhText: 护盾可吸收伤害并保护舰体。护盾会自动恢复。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.text: AUTO trigger weapons fire repeatedly until the trigger is released or the turret overheats.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.zhText: 全自动武器会持续射击直至扳机松开或是炮台过热。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.text: BURST trigger weapons fire a short sequence of shots per press of the trigger.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.zhText: 点射武器会在每次按下扳机时进行一连串短距离点射。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.text: CHARGE trigger weapons must have the trigger held down to fire at full effectiveness.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.zhText: 蓄力武器需要按住扳机发射才能获得最大威力。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.text: HELD trigger weapons create a continuous beam and have a short warm up time to reach full damage.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.zhText: 连射武器会产生一道持续光束，并且只需要很短的预热时间来达到最大伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.text: SEMI trigger weapons fire 1 shot per press of the trigger.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_RailjackTrigge.zhText: 半自动武器会在每次按下扳机时进行一发射击。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Railjack_Power.text: Modifies the Duration of Battle Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Railjack_Power.zhText: 调整战斗 Mod 的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Railjack_Power.text: Modifies the Range of Battle Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Railjack_Power.zhText: 调整战斗 Mod 的范围。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Railjack_Power.text: Modifies the Strength of Battle Mods.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Railjack_Power.zhText: 调整战斗 Mod 的强度。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Reload.text: Time in seconds to refill the Magazine from empty.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Reload.zhText: 装填空弹匣所需的时间（以秒为单位）。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Shield.text: Shields reduce Damage by 50% for all Damage Types except <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin, which bypasses shields.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Shield.zhText: 护盾能降低 50% 所有类型的伤害，但 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害除外，它能无视护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ShieldGate.text: On Shield break become invulnerable for |AMOUNT|s or until any shields are regained. Increase invulnerability duration by increasing Max Shields.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ShieldGate.zhText: 护盾被击破后，进入 |AMOUNT| 秒的无敌状态，或者直到护盾恢复为止。通过增加最大护盾来延长无敌持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ShieldRecharge.text: The time in seconds between when Shields are damaged and recharge.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ShieldRecharge.zhText: 护盾从受损到开始恢复之间的时间（以秒为单位）。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ShieldRecharge.text: The rate Railjack's Shields recover after being depleted.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_ShieldRecharge.zhText: 航道星舰护盾耗尽后的恢复速率。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttack.text: Damage inflicted on enemies by landing a Ground Slam attack near them.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttack.zhText: 通过在敌人附近进行震地攻击对敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttackFall.text: Deal |AMOUNT|% Damage to enemies on the edge of the impact zone.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttackFall.zhText: 对冲击区域边缘的敌人造成 |AMOUNT|% 的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttackRadi.text: Additional |AMOUNT| damage inflicted to all enemies in the radius of a Ground Slam attack.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttackRadi.zhText: 在震地攻击的半径范围内对所有敌人造成额外 |AMOUNT| 伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttackRadi.text: Ground Slam attack hits all enemies around the point of impact within |AMOUNT|m.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlamAttackRadi.zhText: 震地攻击会击中撞击点附近 |AMOUNT| 米内所有的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlideAttack.text: Damage inflicted on enemies by melee attacking while sliding.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_SlideAttack.zhText: 在滑行中进行近战攻击时敌人所承受的伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Status_Duratio.text:
Scales with Ability Duration.

Modifies the duration of any status dealt by Lavos with either abilities or weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Status_Duratio.zhText:
随技能持续时间长短而变化。

改变 Lavos 使用技能或武器所造成的异常状态的持续时间。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Tennokai_Chanc.text: You will occasionally have opportunities to perform faster Heavy Attacks with no cost to your Combo Counter.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Tennokai_Chanc.zhText: 你将偶尔有机遇不消耗连击数，并使出更快的重击。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Total.text: The total combined damage from all listed damage types and modifiers.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Total.zhText: 所有列出的伤害类型和数值调整造成的伤害总和。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Trigger.text: How the weapon operates when the trigger is pressed.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_Trigger.zhText: 按下扳机时武器的运作方式。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerAuto.text: AUTO trigger weapons fire repeatedly until the trigger is released or the magazine is empty.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerAuto.zhText: 全自动武器会持续射击直至扳机松开或是弹匣空了。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerBurst.text: BURST trigger weapons fire a short sequence of shots per press of the trigger.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerBurst.zhText: 点射武器会在每次按下扳机时进行一连串短距离点射。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerCharge.text: CHARGE trigger weapons must have the trigger held down to fire at full effectiveness.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerCharge.zhText: 蓄力武器需要按住扳机发射才能获得最大威力。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerContino.text: HELD trigger weapons create a continuous beam and have a short ramp up time to reach full Damage.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerContino.zhText: 连射武器会产生一道持续光束，并且只需要很短的提升时间来达到最大伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerSemiAut.text: SEMI trigger weapons fire 1 shot per press of the trigger.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_TriggerSemiAut.zhText: 半自动武器会在每次按下扳机时进行一发射击。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_UltChargeRate.text: Tauron Strike charges |AMOUNT| faster. This is affected by certain Mods and the number of Focus Lenses equipped.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_UltChargeRate.zhText: 提高 Tauron 打击充能速度 |AMOUNT| 。这受到特定 Mod 和装备的专精晶体数量影响。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_UltInitCharge.text: Tauron Strike charge partially filled to this percentage at the start of mission and after executing the Tauron Strike.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/TIP_UltInitCharge.zhText: Tauron 打击充能会在任务开始时以及进行 Tauron 打击后部分填充至此百分比。

/Lotus/Language/Stats/Upgrade_Overlevel_.text: Increase this weapon's Max Rank by +2 with forma up to 5 times for a possible Max Rank of 40.
/Lotus/Language/Stats/Upgrade_Overlevel_.zhText: 将该武器的最高等级提高 2 级，最多可提高 5 次，最高等级可达 40。
