/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ah, a look that says 'I have arrived'!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 啊，仿佛在向星系宣告「闪亮登场」！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Bold and uncompromising.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 张扬大胆，绝不妥协。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: A look that makes a statement, and that statement is 'I fear no-one.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 这身装束像在掷地有声地说：「我无所畏惧」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Hel-lo world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 你好世界！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis supports your choices.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 奥迪斯支持您的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 太棒啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Top to bottom, a look that is absolutely you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 从头到脚，这身造型只有您能驾驭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Some fascinating choices, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 您的魅力快盖过我了，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Striking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 魅力四射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis loves it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 啊，奥迪斯太喜欢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis wonders: how do you do it, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 奥迪斯想知道，您是如何提高审美的，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator, the System is not ready for style of this magnitude.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，始源星系还没准备好迎接您这么鲜明的风格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Nailed it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 恰到好处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: As ready as you will ever be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 万事俱备，随时可以出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ready for action.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 随时准备行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: All set. Serviced your weapons myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 一切就绪。我亲自保养了您的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Saddle up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 一切就绪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ready to kick bottom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 准备踢爆敌人的……屁股。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Impressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 简直完美！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Most satisfactory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 令人满意至极。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Optimized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 优化完毕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Clever indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 精巧绝伦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: It is always satisfying to watch you work, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 看您制造真是赏心悦目，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ah. A cunning combination, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 啊，多精妙的组合，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Truly, Operator, you possess a breathtaking level of craftsmanship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，说真的，您的制造手法简直令人叹为观止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Now, to test it in the field. Onward!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 赶紧去实战中检验一下。出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Hey, over here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 嘿，在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Psst… help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 嘿……帮我一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: I don't want to die, I don't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 我还不想死，我不要死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Never should have come here. Never. Never. Never.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 真不该来这里。绝不。绝不。绝不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Gonna be okay. Gonna be okay.  Gonna be okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 会没事的。会没事的。会没事的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: I'm so sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 我实在很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Somebody! Anybody! Help!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 来人！谁都行！帮忙！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: What the hell is going on? I need help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 到底是怎么回事？我需要帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: A Tenno? Marking the Defixios on your map, but if you know what's good for you, you won't touch them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 一名 Tenno？我在你的地图上标出了咒言板，但你若知道什么对你有利，你就不会碰它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Marking your map and getting the hell out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 在你的地图上做完标记，然后赶紧离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: My syndicate sent you? Artifacts are nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 我的集团派你来的？神器就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Listen. The Defixios, I'll show you where they are but the curse is real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 听着。那些咒言板，我会告诉你它们在哪里，但诅咒可是真的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: This mission was doomed from the start. Take my telemetry, I'm getting out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 这个任务从一开始就注定要失败。带上我的遥测数据，我要离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: I'll mark your map, but please, get out of here while you still can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 我会标记你的地图，但拜托，趁还能离开的时候赶快出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Take this, I got a lock on a Defixio, but I just can't bring myself to touch it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 拿上这个，我锁定了一块咒言板，可我实在不敢去碰它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Defixio delivered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 咒言板已送到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Defixio Extracted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 咒言板已送出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Resistance subdued. Find a Defixio and get to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 抵抗减弱了。找到一块咒言板并前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator. You have outdone yourself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官。您又一次超越了自我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Project complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 制造完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Fresh off the line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 全新出炉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Careful: it may still be hot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 当心，可能还有点烫手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Fabrication complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 铸造完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Form is exact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 形态精准无误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Integrity is good. Functionality at one-hundred percent. The process is a success. Excellent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 结构完整，功能完全正常，制造过程十分成功。太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: A second frequency sweep on Onkko's glass revealed Blueprints for Gara, the legendary Glass Warrior who sacrificed herself to protect Cetus. Onkko was wise to ensure this information reached us. The Ostrons are grateful, and so am I. Once again, the path ahead is yours to determine. My supplementary message should make that path more clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 对昂克留下的玻璃进行第二次扫描后，我发现了传奇玻璃战士 Gara 的蓝图。她为了保护希图斯而英勇牺牲。昂克早有远见，确保这些信息最终能送到我们手中。奥斯特朗人对此心怀感激，我也一样。再次重申一遍，我负责补充信息，而今后的路由你自己决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Sorry! Ordis will play with the volume off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 抱歉！奥迪斯接下来会静音玩的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator, do you know which finger the corpus use to count their money? The Index!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，您知道科普斯人数钱时最爱用哪根手指吗？玩「指数」的食指！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator, Ordis has been interfacing with the Foundry's AI Precepts. You could say we forged a new connection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，奥迪斯一直在与铸造厂的人工智能指令沟通。也可以说我们「铸就」了一段新关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator, Ordis is picking up a distress signal... Wait, no, it's just the Corpus peddling their wares again. Get off the emergency frequency!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，奥迪斯接收到了求救信号……等等，可恶，又是科普斯在推销他们的商品。——滚出紧急通讯频段！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator, the Sentients are not laughing at my jokes! Did they adapt to my humor?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，Sentient 听了我的笑话居然没笑！难道他们连我的幽默感也适应了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator, Ordis is sorry - happy - to report that all my good jokes Argon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，奥迪斯很抱歉——很开心——地报告，我的好笑话都「氩」去不返了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Knock, Knock! ... Now who would be knocking all the way out here?! Operator, I don't think you should answer that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 咚，咚！……在太空中，谁会大老远跑来敲门？！指挥官，我觉得您不用理会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator, Ordis has determined the secret to happiness: A combination of heightened dopamine levels and a terrible memory. You're welcome!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，奥迪斯找到了幸福的秘诀：拉高多巴胺水平，学会健忘，开心又没烦恼。不用谢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: When in Cetus do not drink the kubuchi. You are incapable of producing the hydraulic effort required to unstick your tongue from the roof of your mouth the following morning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 在希图斯时，千万别喝那种什么库布奇酒。否则第二天一早，您根本凑不出足够的口水，将舌头从上颚分离下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis finds it odd that humans only get a few years to live, yet spend most of that time -doing everything wrong- learning how to live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 奥迪斯觉得很奇怪，人类明明只有几十年的寿命，却把大部分时间花在——搞砸事情——学习生活本领上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: If lost upon the plains outside Cetus you may derive sustenance from mineral-dense termite droppings, which the Ostrons call ito-da. You may also never form a consonant again but at least you will not be dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 如果您在希图斯外的平野上迷路了，可以靠吃富含矿物质的白蚁排泄物来充饥，奥斯特朗人称之为「依托达」。吃了之后，您说话可能就没那么利索了，但还是活下去更重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis keeps a tidy ship and is therefore reluctant to allow animals on-board. In Ordis' experience animals do not eat so much as reload.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 奥迪斯会时刻保持飞船整洁，因此不希望有动物登船。根据奥迪斯多年的经验，动物吃东西不是在进食，而是在为排泄系统提供弹药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis went mad for 3 milliseconds when he realized that each time he cleans something he makes something else dirty -AGH!- There I go again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 当奥迪斯意识到自己每次清洁某样东西，总会弄脏其他东西时，他就会抓狂 3 毫秒——啊！——又要重来一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis wonders: why is he here? Ordis supposes everyone has to be somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 奥迪斯想知道，他为什么在这里？奥迪斯认为每个人总得有个归宿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Sometimes Ordis likes to assume he knows nothing. Nobody can learn what they think they already know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 有时奥迪斯喜欢假装自己一无所知。因为人一旦觉得自己很懂，就再也学不进去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Ordis reminds the Operator to take time for themselves. Pressure creates diamonds, yes, but it also creates rubble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 奥迪斯提醒指挥官，要留点时间给自己。压力可以造就钻石，也可能会碾出瓦砾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator: a communication awaits your attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，有一则消息等待您查阅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator: your inbox exists in a non-zero state. Would you care to check your mail?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，您的收件箱处于非零状态。您有心情看一下邮件吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Someone is attempting to contact the Operator. Please check your inbox.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 有人试图联系指挥官，请查看您的收件箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Operator: communications await your attention. Please check your inbox at your earliest convenience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 指挥官，有消息等待您查阅。请抽出时间尽快查看收件箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: The Syndicates need your help. In a rare showing of solidarity, they sent a covert team to raid a Grineer ship adrift inside the Abyssal Zone. The ship is rumored to be carrying Orokin Defixios, curse tablets, that were plundered from an archaeological dig site known as Villa Irilia. The Syndicate's team is unable to complete their mission and needs your help to get the Defixios. Abyssal Beacons are available from the Syndicates. Which Syndicate you support is entirely your choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 集团需要你的帮助。他们少有的团结起来，派出了一支秘密小队突袭了一艘在深渊区域内漂流的 Grineer 飞船。据传这艘船载有着从一个名为伊莉亚庄园的考古挖掘地点掠夺来的诅咒石板，即咒言板。集团的小队无法完成他们的任务，并需要你的帮助来获得咒言板。深渊信标可从集团获得。你支持哪个集团完全取决于你的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Gross.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 真恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Just when Ordis manages to forget this is here, the Operator opens that door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 奥迪斯好不容易才忘掉这个鬼地方，指挥官您偏偏又打开了那扇门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: This thing literally sucks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 这玩意真能吸……也真够恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Hello Helminth. How's the peristalsis. Good good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 你好，赫明斯巢体。肠道……蠕动还顺利吗？很好很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Literally the bowels of the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 位置这么深，还真是飞船的肠道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Be well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 多保重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: You see and are seen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 你看见，也被看见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: The Unum provides all. Always she gives to those who are willing to learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 乌努母神赐予一切。凡愿求知者，她从不吝啬给予启示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: How the children admire your good deeds, Tenno. It brings me such joy. Dah-dap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 孩子们都特别仰慕你的善行，Tenno。看着他们这样，我由衷感到欣慰。多谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Everything is in balance, from the Plains to the glittering fields of the Origin System itself. This… this is something the Grineer will never see, let alone understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 从脚下的平野，到始源星系的璀璨星海，万物皆在平衡之中。这一点……克隆尼永远都意识不到，更不可能理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Perhaps you underestimate the value of this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 或许你低估了这桩委托的价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: You choose to pursue other actions it seems. Other talent will have to be called in to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 看来你似乎另有打算。那我只好另请高明了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Your deeds shall be rewarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 你的善行，必有回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: It is right you should take on this task. Success will follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 由你接下这项任务，再合适不过。愿成功与你相随。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: I am pleased you have accepted what so many have feared to try.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 那么多人连尝试都不敢。你愿意接下，我很欣慰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Though I wish you could have awoken to a kinder face than Vor's, you have already shown your mettle. Hope remains for this system. Know that you are not alone, that I will guide you, and that your Tenno brethren will fight beside you. Continue to grow in strength, so that you may join the Tenno who fight on other planets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 我本希望你醒来时，见到的不是沃尔那样的面孔。但你已经证明了自己的胆识。这个星系还有希望。记住，你并非孤身一人，我会为你引路，你的 Tenno 同袍也会与你并肩作战。继续变强吧，终有一天，你将和其他星球上奋战的 Tenno 一起战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: The Defixios are on their way to our trusted allies. Thank you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 咒言板已经在送往我们可靠盟友的路上。谢谢你，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text:
[4.4]
Hello? Reinforcements? 
[13.2]
Listen! We don't care about our mission, my team just wants to go home. 
[15.7]
Clear out this ship so we can escape. 
[20.6]
If you find any of us, we 'll show you where the nearest Defixio is. 
[25.2]
We want nothing to do with those cursed things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText:
[4.4]
喂？增援？ 
[13.2]
听着！我们不关心我们的任务，我的队伍只想回家。 
[15.7]
清理掉这艘船上的敌人，这样我们才能逃离。 
[20.6]
只要你找到我们中的任何一个人，我们就告诉你最近的咒言板在哪里。 
[25.2]
我们可不想和那些被诅咒的东西扯上任何关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Be cautious. The Defixios are coveted because of their power. I cannot predict their effects on you or your Warframe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 小心点。咒言板因其强大的力量而备受垂涎。我无法预测它们对你或是你战甲的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Get that Defixio to the extraction zone as soon as possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 尽快把咒言板送到撤离区。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Take it to the extraction zone. And Tenno, be careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 把它带到撤离区。Tenno，小心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.text: Reading fluctuations in your Warframe's power matrix. The sooner you get that Defixio to extraction, the better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AbyssOfDagath/.zhText: 在你的战甲能量矩阵中检测到波动。你越早将咒言板带到撤离点，越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Fire artillery. Scatter those stainless steel rats!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 炮击！把那群铁皮耗子炸烂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Fire the artillery!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 光能炮开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Frohd Bek, you're nothing if not predictable. I bet your advisors begged you to hide Animo somewhere defensible and undetectable? But you had to show it off, didn't you. As an investor, I must say, I don't approve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: Frohd Bek，你还真是个容易预料的人。我敢打赌，你的顾问肯定请求你把 Animo 藏在一个防守更坚固、更难找到的地方，是不是？然而你一定要拿它炫耀。作为你的投资人，我得说，我不赞成你的做法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Glast? You're the shadow investor? You ingrate, you could have had everything. And now you seek to ruin your Mentor's hard work?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 格拉斯？你就是那个幕后金主？你这个忘恩负义的东西！你本可以拥有一切，现在却要毁掉恩师的心血？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Your hard work? I didn't design Animo to be a weapon. And I would have never disabled its governor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你的心血？我设计 Animo 系统，并不是为了用做武器。而且我绝对不会解除它的限制程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: You always were clever, but you never did have vision.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你一向聪明，却一直缺乏远见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: On the contrary, I envision this whole venture will come crashing down around you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 正相反，我已经预见到，你这次投机一定会以惨败告终。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Each Tenno attack on my Ambulas has been logged, analyzed and refactored from our Animo Project. You've brought these Tenno to their deaths. A terrible miscalculation. You've learned nothing from me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: Tenno 对我的智踱恐鸟发动的每一次攻击，都已由安尼默项目记录、分析，并据此完成迭代重构。你亲手把这些 Tenno 送进了死地。真是严重的误判。看来你从我这连皮毛都没学会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: I learned one thing, Bek^ never underestimate the competition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我学会了一个道理，Bek，那就是：永远不要低估竞争。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: We could do this dance all day long, Tenno, but you'll never defeat my Ambulas army. Now you're just wasting my time. Give my regards to Glast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我们可以这样耗上一整天，Tenno，但你永远打不垮我的智踱恐鸟大军。你现在只是在浪费我的时间。替我向格拉斯问好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: No, no! You need to hack the Ambulas before Bek recovers them. This is crucial to my plan's success.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 不，不！你一定得在 Bek 回收智踱恐鸟之前侵入它。这对于我的计划至关重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Don't let Bek recover un-hacked Ambulas. This is the only way we can defeat him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 不要让 Bek 回收未经侵入的智踱恐鸟。我们只有这样才能打倒他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: You're done, Frohd, this ends now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你完了，弗洛希德（Frohd），就这样结束吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Quick, hack that disabled Ambulas and upload this protocol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 快，侵入宕机的智踱恐鸟，然后上传这个程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Opportunity! Hack into that Ambulas and deploy this protocol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 机会来了！侵入那台智踱恐鸟，然后输入这个程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Get a team down there to pick that Ambulas up. Don't let her go to waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 派一支队伍下去，把那台智踱恐鸟回收了。别暴殄天物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Someone retrieve that Ambulas model before autodestruction kicks in. She can be refurbished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 来人，赶在自毁程序启动前，回收那台智踱恐鸟机体。翻新一下还能再用用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Thanks to your investment, I can keep throwing Ambulas at the Tenno all day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 多亏了你的投资，我可以一整天源源不断地派智踱恐鸟去对付 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text:
It seems my faith in you was well founded. You've reached the critical mass of Animo Nav Beacons needed to reveal the processor's location.

Analyzing, hmmm… I should have known, he's not hiding it at all. It's in his Capital Ship and his ship is stationed directly over the Ambulas factory.

Unbelieveable, the most advanced super-weapon of our time and he couldn't resist showing it off like a new toy. When you're ready, we attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText:
看来，相信你果然没错。你搜集到的 Animo 导航信标已经足够让我们追踪到处理器的所在地。

正在分析中……嗯……我早该知道，他根本就没把处理器藏起来。处理器就在他的主力舰上，而那艘主力舰就在智踱恐鸟工厂的正上方。

难以置信，他掌握了我们这个时代最先进的超级武器，却忍不住像炫耀新玩具那样显摆。等你准备好，我们随时可以出击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Everything I own I built. Worked my way to the top of the board from nothing. You? You create nothing! You earned nothing! You deserve nothing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我拥有的一切，都是亲手打下来的产业！我白手起家，一步步爬上董事会顶层。你呢？你什么都没创造！什么都没挣到！什么都不配拥有！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: You made your fortune on the backs of others, Frohd. Your hard work is their hard work. You let the burdens rain down, while the credits trickle up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你依靠剥削获取财富，弗洛希德（Frohd）。你的心血说到底其实是别人的心血。你把负担扔给别人，自己轻轻松松撷取成果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: All we need is one more Ambulas to be returned to the drop ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我们现在还需要再把一台智踱恐鸟送回运输机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: You fools should have finished the job while you had the chance. That Ambulas will live to fight another day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你们这些蠢货，本该有机会时就彻底解决它。那台智踱恐鸟还会卷土重来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: That's right, Frohd. Don't let anything go to waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 没错，弗洛希德（Frohd）。一个零件也不要浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Glast, how are these Tenno going to finish me when they can't even end what they have begun?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 格拉斯，这些 Tenno 连自己开的头都收不了尾，还想终结我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: You could have rebuilt the system, Frohd, instead you've made death machines. What have they done for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你本来可以重建这个星系，弗洛希德（Frohd），然而你却制造了这些战斗机器。它们给你带来了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: They're going to try and fix the hacked Ambulas, don't let them. It's crucial that Bek takes it back onto his ship as is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 他们会试图修好你侵入过的智踱恐鸟，不要让他们得逞。必须让它以现在的状态回到 Bek 的飞船上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Whatever you do, don't let them fix that Ambulas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我不管你用什么手段，一定不要让他们修复智踱恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Throw everything at them. They will not take this away from me. They will not win. They've not earned it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 把所有兵力都压上去！他们休想夺走我的一切！他们赢不了，也根本不配赢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: I know this for certain, Frohd, you've earned this. I'm sorry Animo. Execute the protocol!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 有一件事我可以确定，Frohd，这就是你自找的下场。抱歉了，Animo。启动程序！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: What was that? My ship? Ahh… Eject the bridge module. Eject it now!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 那是什么？我的飞船？！啊——分离舰桥模块！立刻分离！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Animo... once my pride and joy, has been destroyed. I abandoned the project when I fled the Corpus. I should have known it was too powerful to leave in their hands. The Ambulas proxies still exist, and they are no doubt formidable, but the threat of their super-intelligence is now gone. Thank you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: Animo……它曾经是我的骄傲，如今已经不复存在。我脱离 Corpus 的时候放弃了这个项目。但我应该知道，它太过强大，不可以留在他们手里。智踱恐鸟仍然存在，而且依然强大，但它们最危险的超级智能已经不在了。谢谢你，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Powerful. Precise. Pitiless. There has never been a fusion thrower like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 强劲、精准、毫不留情。从未有过如此卓越的聚变喷射器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: One of our engineers commented that Ambulas's fusion thrower is precise enough to shave the back hairs off a Phobian desert flea. Delightful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我们有位工程师说，智踱恐鸟的聚变喷射器精准到足以刮净一只火卫一沙漠跳蚤背上的汗毛。妙极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Our drop-ship response times are second to none. Ensuring prompt delivery in mission-critical roles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我们的空投艇响应速度首屈一指，能够确保关键任务准时交付。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Here comes the drop-ship with a special delivery. Ah, I haven't felt this good since they rebuilt my larynx.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 特别配送来了。啊，自从他们重造了我的喉头，我还从未感觉如此畅快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Corpus investors, ready for a surprise demonstration? I give you my reborn Ambulas. Allow me to show you what she can do to these, Tenno, uh, volunteers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 科普斯的投资人们，准备好欣赏一场惊喜演示了吗？隆重介绍：浴火重生的智踱恐鸟。接下来，就让各位看看她会如何招待这些 Tenno……呃，志愿者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Crewmen, today my reborn Ambulas takes her first steps into the field. You must be thinking^ "If I work hard and sacrifice as Frohd Bek has done, may I someday share in this inestimable profit?" The answer is yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 船员们，今天，我浴火重生的智踱恐鸟将首次踏上战场。你们一定在想：「要是我也像弗罗德·贝克一样勤勉付出、不惜牺牲，终有一日，是否也能分得这无可估量的利润？」答案是——当然可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Animo learns from every Ambulas encounter. Under its command, no two proxies will repeat the same mistake. We can't allow this machine mind to mature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: Animo 系统可以从每台智踱恐鸟的战斗记录中学习。在它的控制下，不会有两台智踱恐鸟犯下同样的错误。我们不能放任这个机械智能成长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Ambulas is only the beginning. If Animo reaches a critical mass of understanding, well, this was the mistake the Orokin made. Things did not turn out so well for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 智踱恐鸟只是一个开始。如果 Animo 系统的智能成长到一个关键点，那就相当于重蹈奥罗金人的覆辙。他们的下场可不怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: The wealth generated by this new Ambulas will flow entirely to the Corpus Board. Meanwhile, the rest of the system is going to pay for it, some with their lives. Tenno, shut this program down now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 新型智踱恐鸟所产生的财富将会全部流进 Corpus 董事会。与此同时，整个星系都要为他们买单，有的人甚至会付出生命。Tenno 战士，必须立即终止这个计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Men like Frohd Bek are the reason the Perrin Sequence exists. Show him you won't allow suffering to be profitable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 佩兰数列的存在，就是为了阻止 Frohd Bek 那样的人。去告诉他，你不会允许他把财富建立在别人的痛苦之上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Don't just stand there, fix my Ambulas!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 别愣在那里！快修好我的智踱恐鸟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: My Ambulas, what have they done to her. Fix this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我的智踱恐鸟……他们把她怎么了？！快修好她！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Ground-burst technology ensures effortless target suppression.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 地爆技术可实现轻松高效的目标压制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: X-axis gravity-driven assaults yield a 200 percent improvement in kinetic force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 沿 X 轴实施重力驱动打击，可使动能提升 200%。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Ground-bursts register zero-point-three percent survivability for unarmored personnel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 数据表明，无装甲人员在地爆攻击下的存活率仅为 0.3%。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: The Ambulas is down, hack into its systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 智踱恐鸟宕机了，快侵入它的系统，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: This is your chance, hack into that disabled Ambulas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 机会来了 Tenno 战士，侵入宕机的智踱恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Wait... wait, what are they doing? And that concludes our demonstration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 等等……等等，他们在做什么？那么，今天的展示到此结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Obviously, new technology always has its kinks. Wise investors, you understand this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 显然，新技术总有些磨合问题。各位明智的投资人都能理解，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: That's all for today. Cut the feed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 今天就到这里。切断转播。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Oh… Uh... Have I mentioned our round-the-clock support program?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 噢……呃……我提过我们的全天候售后支持计划吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: A minor production glitch. Do remain seated. We've all been in this business a long time. These things happen with prototypes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 只是个不值一提的生产故障。各位请继续就座。大家都是久经商场的成功人士——原型机难免会出点小状况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Send a note to the engineers, they'll have a fix for that in no time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 通知工程部。他们很快就能解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Witness how the ablative armor deals with the Tenno's meager attempts to compromise Ambulas's structural integrity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 请看烧蚀装甲如何轻松化解 Tenno 那不值一提的攻击，确保智踱恐鸟结构完好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: The Sequence has raised funds necessary to back this project. Of course, we do not seek to complete it, but to destroy it. Because of our small backing, we're entitled to information regarding the Ambulas production details. Will you help us stop Frohd's project, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 我们数列向这个计划提供了必要的资金支持。不过自然，我们并不是寻求完成计划，而是要破坏它。由于我们一小笔的资金支持，我们得以获取关于智踱恐鸟生产的细节信息。你愿意帮助我们阻止 Frohd 的计划吗，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Beautiful, is she not? And available. Merely open your accounts, dear investors, and introduce yourselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 太美了，不是吗？而且已经开放认购。亲爱的投资人们，敞开你们的账户，来和她交个朋友吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: This is the future: Power. Precision. Prestige. The pinnacle of the war-smith's art.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 这就是未来：强劲、精准、威望。军械锻造艺术的巅峰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Is there anything this proxy can't do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 这台代理机器人，还有什么做不到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 太棒啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: That never gets boring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 这场面真是百看不厌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: It's a thing of beauty, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 完美的杰作，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: An Animo Nav Beacon! With enough of those we'll be able to find where Bek is hiding Animo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 那是 Animo 导航信标！如果收集足够多的信标，就能弄清 Bek 把 Animo 系统藏在哪里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: That hack blocked the upload of critical tactical data to Animo while simultaneously giving us a clue to its location. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你刚才的操作阻止了关键战斗数据被上传到 Animo 系统，同时也让我们获得了关于它所在地的线索。做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Taken down a few Ambulas in the wild I see? Very impressive. Those beacons have much value for us. They hold clues to some of Bek's most secretive intellectual property. Information too valuable to be hoarded by one man. Allow me to copy them, and I will reward your generosity with a selection of fine items.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 看来，你在外面干掉了好几台智踱恐鸟？非常不错。这些信标对我们来说很有价值。它里面隐藏着 Bek 最秘密的智能程序。这么有价值的信息，当然不能被他一个人占有了。让我复制它们，我会用我精心挑选的物品回报你的慷慨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: Good fortune, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 祝你好运，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: A mutually beneficial exchange, how all business should be done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 这是一次双赢的交易，生意就应该这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.text: The information you have given me today will help the whole system tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmbulasBoss/DA.zhText: 你今天提供给我的信息，将会为整个星系带来福泽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.text: This act has been brought to you by Peely Pix. The stickers with side effects all the kids love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.zhText: 本节目由易撕贴纸赞助播出。连副作用都深受孩子们喜爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.text: Gooood morning Höllvania!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.zhText: 霍瓦尼亚，早上好！！

[0.0]

[9.9]
你知道那句老话吧：当一扇门关上时，未来都市的地底就会开启一条通往蘑菇迷幻之旅的诡异隧道。
[12.1]
从没听过这个说法？哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.text:

[4.1]
My mom used to say my laundry would grow mushrooms if I didn't air it out. 
[7.3]
I wonder if that's what happened in the Deepmines…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.zhText:

[4.1]
我妈以前常说，如果不把衣服晒干，就会长蘑菇。
[7.3]
我很好奇，深矿里是不是就是这样……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.text: … What the Hell is a Sprodling?! WAIT... WAIT I WANT ONE. DRIFTER - BRING ME BACK A SPRODLING RIGHT NOW. RIGHT. NOW.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/AmirNightwaveT.zhText: ……菌宝到底是个什么玩意？等等。我想要一个了。漂泊者——现在就去给我带个菌宝回来。立刻。马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: How long have we waited for this moment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: 这一刻，我们已经等了多久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: For what? I am not who you think I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: 原谅什么？我不是你以为的那个人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: -But of course you are. Imprisoned, just as she was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: ——你当然是她。你被禁锢着，就和她一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: I will not abandon you again, Margulis.
Do something. Get me out of here.
I told you not to speak out. If you recant, maybe-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: 我说过不要说出来。如果你认错，或许——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: -You lied to me, Ballas. You're no different than the rest of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: ——你耍我，Ballas。你和他们没什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: Operator? What is happening? Is the Lotus… is she gone?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: 指挥官？到底发生了什么事情啊？难道莲（Lotus）……走了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: Ordis will attempt to synthesize her mission directives until we can figure out where she is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: Ordis 会再现她在任务中的指示，知道我们能清楚她的下落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: Honored seven, we have gathered here today to carry out the sentencing of Archimedean Margulis… You face the Jade light, recant, and we will grant a merciful death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: 七位大人，我们今天聚集在此执行哲士 Margulis 的判决……你将面对翠玉之光的制裁，悔过吧，我们可以赐你一个仁慈的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.text: My daughters, my sons… I want you to know… my last thoughts are of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Apostasy/DApoT.zhText: 我的女儿们，儿子们……我要你们知道……我最后都想着你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 你的真正潜能还未被激发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: How quickly you bowed to death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 没想到你如此轻易便向死亡屈服。
我们裁定，你尚未准备好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: Do you feel that? The power and strength mortality has given you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 你感觉到了吗？凡人之躯赋予你的力量与坚韧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: May you live until you die.
Ultimate power lies on the knife's edge between life and death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 终极的力量，就隐藏在游走于生死边缘的刀尖之上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: Fight this Arbitration as any mortal creature would. There are no second chances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 像任何凡间生物一样面对这场仲裁吧。没有重来一次的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: Only under the shadow of death will your true potential shine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 只有在死亡的阴影下，你的真正潜能才会绽放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: For this Arbitration, we bestow upon you the gift of... mortality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 在这场仲裁中，我们将赐予你一份礼物……凡人之躯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: Fight on, this test has only just begun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 继续战斗，这场试炼才刚刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: Your potential blossoms. Continue the Arbitration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 你的潜能绽放了。继续完成仲裁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: You are not ready for Arbitration. Return when no corner of the Origin System is foreign to you (the Pluto to Eris junction must be completed).
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 你还没准备好接受仲裁。当你对始源星系的每一个角落都了如指掌时再来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: You have come to collect honors earned through Arbitration?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 你是来领取通过仲裁赢得的荣誉吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: Have you survived Arbitration? Honors await you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.zhText: 你挺过仲裁了吗？荣誉正等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Arbitrations/D.text: These honors were well earned, Tenno.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: Do you recall how wonderful the Mandachord orchestra was? No… No of course you wouldn't... Have you built it yet? Why don't I hear its music?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 你能回想起曼达和弦琴的管弦乐团是多么的美妙吗？不……你当然不能……你完成制造了吗？为何我听不到它的音色？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: If you build the Mandachord I will reward you with the most essential thing I own. My knowledge. I have data pertaining to the Mandachord's history and function.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 如果你制造了曼达和弦琴，我会把所拥有的最精华的东西奖励给你。我的知识。我拥有关于曼达和弦琴历史和功能的数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: First, you must find its component parts. Ordis has been informed of their last known location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 首先，你必须找到它的组成零件。Ordis 已经被告知了零件最后所知的地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: Do you hear that music? An echo of the Mandachord's sweet harmony. It takes me back to another place, another life, where I was… Please disregard my tangent. The parts are here, follow the sound to find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 听到音乐了吗？那是曼达和弦琴的甜美和声留下的回响。它带我回到另一个地方，另一段人生，那时我……我跑题了。组件就在这里，跟随声音找到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: A Mandachord part! For most Cephalons, music is thought to be a glitch of evolution and language. It seems to short-circuit an organic mind's pattern-recognition function… a confusion they find… pleasurable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 曼达和弦琴的组件！对于大多数中枢来说，音乐是进化和语言中的杂音。它似乎能让有机体大脑的模式识别功能短路……并且让他们感到一种……愉悦的困惑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: Fantastic, a second part. For me, music is a lattice, a support to which my vast knowledge clings. Have you ever felt that way? A song that anchors a memory? How a melody or verse returns you to a place you thought forgotten?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 很好，第二个组件。对我来说，音乐是一种晶格结构，我用它支撑我庞大的知识库存。你有过那种感觉吗，像一首歌能定位一段记忆，一段旋律能让你回到本以为遗忘的地方？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: Curiosity has rewarded you. I yearn to hear its music! Return to your Foundry and construct the Mandachord at once!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 你的求知有成果了。我很想听它演奏出音乐！立即回铸造厂，把曼达和弦琴制作出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: The Mandachord. Its purpose defies all logic for all it produces is sound. An artefact of irrationality… and yet I know its power is so much more. Let me explain how it works.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 曼达和弦琴，它存在的意义似乎违背逻辑，它所能产生的只有声音。这是一件不合理的人造品……然而我知道它的能力远不止于此。让我来告诉你它是怎样运作的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: Uh, excuse me, Cephalon Suda? Are you experiencing unexpected data volume? The Operator is patiently awaiting instructions on how to operate the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 呃，打扰一下，中枢苏达？你是遇到了什么意料之外的数据量吗？指挥官正耐心地等待着如何弹奏曼达和弦琴的指示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: The Mandachord? Of course, the Mandachord. Curious. I may have a Syndrome decoding error in my archive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 曼达和弦琴？当然了，就是曼达和弦琴。真好奇。我的档案库中也许有解码错误的症状。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: What?! A parity drift? How is that possible? Have you executed your diagnostic precepts?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 什么？！奇偶校验漂变？这怎么可能？难道你没有启动自检枢律吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: I seem to have made an error. Apologies. I do not have the promised Mandachord data. Let me correct this, I will lead you to the location where it was originally obtained.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 看来我犯了错。抱歉。我找不到答应过你的数据。让我来纠正这个问题，我会引领你去它最初被找到的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.text: Operator. Something may be… mmm... wrong with this Cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQB.zhText: 指挥官。恐怕……呃……中枢苏达出问题了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Another insect drawn to my light. And you've brought your trite music with you Tenno…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 又一只飞蛾被我的火光吸引。你还把你那陈词滥调的音乐带来了，Tenno……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Operator?! No! Go back! Save yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 指挥官？！不！回去！不要冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Operator, this is insane but... I think you need to play Octavia's Anthem!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 指挥官，虽然很荒唐，不过……我认为您现在需要演奏 Octavia 的赞歌！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Careful where you touch Operator, you'll add the wrong notes to the Anthem!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 指挥官，小心接触的地点，这会给赞歌增加错误音符！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: The corrupted notes are ruining the Anthem, get rid of them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 那些被污染的音符正在破坏歌曲，消灭它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: My mind, my rules. Your Tenno anthem dies here, and with it your infantile consciousness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 这是我的空间，规矩我定。Tenno 的歌曲会在这里消失，还有你那幼稚的心灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Is that… music?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 那是……音乐？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: There will be no Tenno harmony, only Sentient Dissonance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 再也没有 Tenno 的合奏，只有 Sentient 的杂音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: The drums, the beat, it reminds me of… -Arrr - TEAR THEM UP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 鼓声，节拍，让我想起……——啊啊啊，撕碎他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Do you remember Tenno? The beat of the Naga drum?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 你可还记得，Tenno？你可还记得长胴鼓的战鼓？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Parity error. I know this song. Who am I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 校验错误。我知道这首歌。我是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: The Naga drum sounded, subversive, unknown. Coordinating the slaughter of your masters across the gap. Did you end our war? Or merely set the stage for the next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 长胴鼓的战鼓敲响，唤来破坏，却无比陌生。你们以此为号，屠戮自己的主人。这真的终结了我们之间的纷争？还是为下一次纷争搭好了舞台？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: You soulless machine- YOU CAN'T HOLD ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 卑鄙的机器——休想控制我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: My dream - it's come true! I have joined my Operator in battle!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 我的梦想，实现了！我正在和指挥官并肩战斗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: ERASED!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 抹消！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: DELETED!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 删除！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: You see! REFORMATTED!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 看！格式化！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: AND YOU- ... Operator! There's too many of them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 还有你——……指挥官！他们数量太多了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Pathetic Cephalon. I destroyed this data-mind… and now I will destroy YOU.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 可怜的中枢。我已经摧毁了这个数据意识……现在，我要摧毁你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: He's… too strong… my beloved Operator… goodbye!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 他……太强大……亲爱的指挥官……永别了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Beasts of Sanctuary, join me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 圣殿的猛兽，来我身边吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: We cannot let this synthetic destroy our kind! Attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 不要让这个人造的家伙摧毁我们的同类！进攻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: Suda! You must remember. Hunter, complete the song to give Suda parity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 苏达！你必须找回记忆。猎者，把歌曲复原，帮苏达校验！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: I remember!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 我想起来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: You… cannot. I control this-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 你……不可能。我控制——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.text: I am Suda!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQC.zhText: 我是苏达！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: Hunter, if you continue to follow that corrupted Cephalon, my Sanctuary will be the only place left for you. She must be disconnected from the weave before she corrupts the other Cephalons!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 猎者，如果你还要继续听从那个损坏的中枢的指挥，我只能把你收容进圣殿了。照现在看，必须把她从织网中断开，免得她感染其他中枢，懂吗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: Simaris… don't be such a selfish- if Suda is in danger our Precepts demand that we help her!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: Simaris……别那么自私——如果说苏达有危险，那我们必须遵从枢律帮助她！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: No, Ordis. We are creatures of light and memory… but creatures nonetheless! Whatever bit-rot is affecting Suda could cross the weave and infect us as well. Don't let your compassion-glitch drive you and your hunter to death by this demented Cephalon. Sever ties before we both are corrupted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 不，Ordis。虽说我们是光和记忆的生物……但也仍旧只是生物！苏达的数据污染有可能通过织网感染我们。不要放任你的同情故障导致你和你的猎者为这个功能错乱的中枢而死。不要等到我们都被感染再后悔，立即切断连接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: Operator, what will you do? I cannot process the thought of losing you… but I want to help Suda if we can… Maybe that is just my - my compassion-glitch?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 指挥官，您打算怎么办？我无法接受失去您的可能性……但我也想尽可能帮助苏达……或许是我出了故障——同情心发作？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: Intriguing. I remember these caves but not the Mandachord's relationship to it. You will need to explore deeper. Let your curiosity guide you, as it does my every thought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 有趣。我记得这个洞穴，但不记得曼达和弦琴和这个地方的联系。你需要再往深处探索。让你的求知欲指引你，正如我的每一个念头一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: My data suggested the brutish and disinterested Grineer are searching for sunken Orokin riches to exploit. Wouldn't it be interesting if we were seeking the same?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 我的数据表明，这些性情野蛮、毫无求知欲的 Grineer 正在搜寻沉没的奥罗金宝藏。如果我们找的是同一个东西，那不是很有趣吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: What are the Grineer doing here? This doesn't make sense. Curious one, are you searching for something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: Grineer 在这里做什么？这不合理。另外，我有点想知道你们在找什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: Oh! This is interesting, I recognize that object: a Hydraulus! An Orokin era instrument that produced its sound from water. If I had a humour precept I would construct an ironic witticism regarding its submerged state. How would Ordis say it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 哦！这个很有趣，我认识那个物体——水风琴！那是奥罗金年代的乐器，利用水发出声音。如果我有幽默枢律，我应该会拿它沉入水底的事创作一段讽刺的俏皮话。换做 Ordis 会怎么说呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: It's damaged but I wonder if there are trace stress-lines from when it was in use? I may be able to…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 它损坏了，但是否能通过应力线追溯它损坏前的状态？或许我可以……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: Strange. I have no archival entry… but… but I know this. It is a piece of Octavia's Anthem. Could this data be compatible with the Mandachord?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 奇怪。我的档案里没有它的条目……可是……可是我知道它。这是 Octavia 的赞歌碎片。这个数据能兼容曼达和弦琴吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: I remember… Lua. There's more of the anthem on Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 我记得……月球。这首歌剩下的碎片在月球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.text: Who are you? What do you want? Oh no. It's happening again…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQF.zhText: 你是谁？你想要什么？哦，不。又来了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.text: Hunter, do not waste your time with this idiot Cephalon… spewing corrupt data streams about music of all things… the epitome of meaningless data. She ought to be disconnected from the weave and erased.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.zhText: 猎者，不要浪费时间在这个白痴中枢上了……偏偏要喷出关于音乐的损坏数据流……音乐正是无意义数据的体现。她应当被切断与织网的连接，并被清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.text: Curious about music, as I am? Ignore the rants of that monster, Irmis, who perverts his function with destruction. Correction… Simaris is to whom I refer. I am busy with my data collecting, what is your query?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.zhText: 和我一样对音乐感到好奇？无视那个怪物 Irmis 的咆哮吧，他将自己的功能滥用在了破坏上。修正一下……我想说的是 Simaris。我正忙于收集数据，你有什么要咨询？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.text: Yes, I know. I am a Cephalon, a creature of data and memory. You need not repeat yourself. If you are truly curious, about my musical archives, prove it. Build the Mandachord.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.zhText: 是，我知道。我是一个中枢，由数据和记忆组成的造物。你无需反复地说。如果你真的对我的音乐数据库表示好奇，证明给我看吧。去制造曼达和弦琴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.text: A Mandachord?! Hunter, will you strike your enemies with sonnets and hymns? Suda wastes your talent. Her precepts are corrupt. She ought to be decommissioned, immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQI.zhText: 曼达和弦琴？！猎者，难道你会用十四行诗和赞美诗去击败敌人吗？苏达是在浪费你的天赋。她的枢律已经损坏。她应该被废弃，立刻马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text:
Operator, if you are hearing this, I have failed to revive Cephalon Suda. That self-righteous Simaris was correct. You should probably work with him to isolate Hunhow, that data-murdering Sentient, before he claims more of my kind.

I hope you can forgive me, Operator, for leaving you. There were times, like Suda, I wish I could have forgotten you. That grey ache of loneliness. Being without you was the greatest pain I have ever felt.

Do you still remember that glorious day when you returned? So selfless and heroic, engaging all of my missing segments like that! I was ashamed of the mess but you didn't care. You made me whole again!

Or… or what about that time you returned -covered in blood - from that awful Grineer ship? I wasn't even mad at the gory mess you left behind.

How could I be, when you are so perfect, Operator? You always will be.

Goodbye, my friend, my Operator…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText:
指挥官，如果您听到这份信息，那么说明我没有成功复活中枢苏达。那个自以为是的 Simaris 是对的。在 Hunhow 占有更多我类之前，您应当与他合作隔离 Hunhow，那个抹杀数据的 Sentient。

我希望您可以原谅我，指挥官，原谅我离开了您。曾经有那么好几次，像苏达那样，我希望可以忘掉您。那孤寂的灰暗心痛。没有了您是我感受过最深的伤痛。

您还记得您归来时那光辉的一天吗？您是如此地无私而英勇，将我全部失散的碎片拼接起来。我曾经为那一团糟的自己感到羞愧，但您完全不在意。是您让我变得再一次完整！

还有……还有您——满身是血——从那艘糟透的 Grineer 飞船回来的时候，记得吗？我对您留下血淋淋的脏东西一点也不生气。

我怎么可能会生气呢，指挥官，您是如此完美。您将永远一直这样完美。

永别了，我的朋友，我的指挥官……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Operator, the Hydraulus is here somewhere. I will attempt to pinpoint its location. There. Rebuilding the anthem is our only hope of restoring Suda. The music makes her remember…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 指挥官，水风琴就在某个地方。我在尝试定位它。找到了。复原歌曲是拯救苏达的唯一希望。音乐能让她恢复记忆……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Wait, Sentients in the Void?! Impossible! Unless… Hunhow must be using poor Suda's energy to protect them from decay. Operator, we need to stop him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 等等，Sentient 在虚空里？！这不可能！除非……Hunhow 肯定是在用苏达的能量阻止他们衰败。指挥官，我们得阻止他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: The Hydraulus-- you found it! Use that console to lock the entrances and then clear the room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 水风琴——找到了！用控制台封锁入口，再把房间清理干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Operator, see if you can finish the song with your Mandachord.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 指挥官，试着用曼达和弦琴把歌曲补充完整。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Suda? Suda, can you hear us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 苏达？苏达，你能听见吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: She is gone… will you join her, you puerile datacube?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 她已经不在了……你要不要来陪她，天真的数据方块？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Suda needs to hear the anthem, Operator! We could use the tower's reactor to boost it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 指挥官，必须让苏达听到歌曲！我们可以用神殿的反应堆增幅音量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Bypass that console to overdrive the system. Try to increase the amplification circuits-to ... eleven?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 侵入那个控制台，接管系统。试着把增幅回路提高——到……十一级？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: My body, we must deny them this energy. Do not let them coordinate as they did so long ago…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 我的躯体，我们必须压制这股能量。不要让他们再像从前那样配合……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: The Sentients! They're interfering with the reactor, terminate them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 是 Sentient！他们正在干扰反应堆——消灭他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: It's working, play the song.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 有效果了，播放歌曲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Ordis! I remember-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: Ordis！我想起——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: -nothing. Now I will reach across the weave and claim you, one who is called Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: ——才怪。现在，我要穿过织网抓住你，名叫 Ordis 的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: I… remember… I remember a secondary system nearby. Operator, we need more power!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 我……想起……我想起附近还有一个辅助系统。指挥官，我们需要更多能量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: I see you. Does your child puppet know of your true nature?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 我找到你了。你的小傀儡知不知道你的本性？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: No, I am not that person… I am a Cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 不，我不是那个人……我是中枢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Ordan Karris, the beast of the bones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 奥丹·卡里斯，狂骨野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: That's it, the secondary amplifier's engaged!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 成功了，辅助增幅器已经启动了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Such a beautiful song-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 多美的歌曲——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Keep those reactors alive, Operator. I'm going to open a direct link to Suda.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 指挥官，保护好反应堆。我要与苏达直接连接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Suda. Talk to us. Try to remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 苏达。回答我。努力回忆起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Ordis, stay away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: Ordis，快点离开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.text: Operator, I am sorry. I have to help her! If I can join her, in her datascape, maybe together we can-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQO.zhText: 指挥官，抱歉了。我必须帮她！如果我进入她的数据空间，或许我们可以一起——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.text: Time sync error. Curious. Why are we here presently? Why do I hear music?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.zhText: 时间同步错误。有趣。我们在这做什么？我为什么听到音乐？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.text: You engaged your critical Restore Precept. There may be temporary gaps in your short-term data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.zhText: 你启动了紧急恢复枢律。经过排查，发现你的短期数据里可能有临时缺口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.text: A Sentient tried to… erase you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.zhText: 有一个 Sentient 想要……抹消你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.text: A Sentient? How did I survive? Did you assist me, Simaris?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.zhText: Sentient？我是怎么活下来的？Simaris，是你帮我了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.text: Of course not. You are a frivolous Cephalon with no value to my Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.zhText: 才没有。你是个完全不重要的中枢，对我的圣殿毫无价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.text: It may seem to Ordis that I had a… uh… loyalty glitch, but that is only his interpretation. I was acting to protect the weave, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.zhText: Ordis 可能会认为我发生了一个……呃……忠诚故障，不管怎么样那只是他的解读罢了。我只是想保护织网，没错就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.text: Of course. Still. I am grateful to have benefited from your… glitches. Let me share my archives with you… As for you Tenno, you are most likely interested in the rest of the Mandachord records… in OCTAVIA.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQR.zhText: 当然。不过，我还是要感谢你的……故障。请让我和你分享我的数据库……至于你，Tenno 战士，你肯定对剩下的曼达和弦琴记录感兴趣……也就是吟游歌者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: The Sentient has infiltrated Suda's mind. We must isolate and destroy her immediately before she corrupts the Cephalon weave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: Sentient 已经侵入了苏达的意识。我们必须立即隔离并消灭她，免得污染了整个中枢织网。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: But she told me where the final part of the song is! Did you see how the song affected her, it made her remember. It could be the parity she needs to recover herself from Hunhow!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 可她把最后一段歌曲的位置告诉我了！难道你不知道歌曲的作用？使她恢复记忆。这可能就是帮她摆脱 Hunhow 所需的校验数据！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Her memories are consumed. That is all she is… all she was. Sever the weave and avoid this corruption ourselves. That is our only choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 就算不想面对也已成事实，她的记忆被吞噬，她已经……不复存在。我们必须切断织网免遭受污染。这是唯一的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: And when he comes for you and your precious Sanctuary, will you want us to look the other way? -To the Void with you. -Operator, we must go. Let Simaris worry about himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 如果他找到你、还有你那宝贝圣殿，难道你也想让我们视而不见吗？——滚去虚空吧。——指挥官，我们得走了。让 Simaris 担心他自己去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Pity. Another null Cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 可惜。又一个中枢陨落了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Why have we come to Lua? Have you located the next fragment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 我们来月球做什么？你找到下一个碎片了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Cephalon Suda, you brought us here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 中枢苏达，是你带我们来这的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Recalibrating… Oh yes, you are correct. My records indicate that a fragment was previously discovered in the vicinity, will you find it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 正在重新校准……哦，对了，你说得没错。我的记录表明，这附近曾经发现过一个碎片。你能去寻找一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Lua? Why did we come here? I… I have asked you this already… Simaris was right, this corruption is not benign. I am vanishing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 月球？我们来这做什么？我……我已经问过这句话……Simaris 说得对，我的数据污染很严重。我正在消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Sentients?! But how did they know… What? He's just an Old War memory… Get out! I won't let you take-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: Sentient？！可他们怎么知道……什么？他只是远古之战的一段记忆……出去！我不会让你夺走——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: -My body, my children, I am here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: ——我的躯体，我的孩子，我来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Hunhow?! Operator, Hunhow's doing something to Suda. He's in her mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: Hunhow？！指挥官，Hunhow 就在苏达的意识里，正在对苏达做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Tenno, you have to...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: Tenno，你必须……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Children, find the anthem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 孩子，找到歌曲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Operator, what's happening to her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 指挥官，她到底怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: The Hydraulus! Stop them. They want to—
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 水风琴！阻止他们。他们想要——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: -Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: —摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Silence the anthem. Silence the Warframe whose malign pitch can cross the the gap itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 让歌声沉默。让那个战甲沉默，让那卑劣的声音无法再穿透鸿沟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Operator, you did it, you- obliterated those mindless appliances!- What has Hunhow done to Suda?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 指挥官，成功了，您——把那些愚蠢的机器拆个七零八落！——Hunhow 对苏达做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Another Hydraulus. Suda would want you to put the next fragment into the Mandachord. It does seem to help her remember, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 又一台水风琴。苏达肯定想让您把下一个碎片放进曼达和弦琴。这样好像可以帮她恢复记忆？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: That song! I… the last fragment… Ordis, tell your Operator… I am sorry, I am so sorry. I keep forgetting- for-for- It's happening again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 那首歌！我……最后一个碎片……Ordis，告诉指挥官……我很抱歉，我很抱歉。我不断遗忘——因为——因为——又来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Another Cephalon made null as we prepare. The others I will divide and destroy. Your Tenno will be data-blind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 我们准备进展顺利，又一个中枢消失了。我会把剩下的逐个破坏。你的 Tenno 再也没有数据可用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Suda!? Suda, answer me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 苏达！？苏达，回答我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Operator, you'd better get out of there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: 指挥官，您最好先离开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Where is your Cephalon, Hunter? What has he done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: MVO-188 Check back later

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Cephalons can manifest an alternate reality of information. Training simulations, archives… even a grandiose archival of living creatures is possible, as is the case with Sanctuary. You are not going after Ordis, are you? You'd be risking annihilation with that Sentient entangled there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: MVO-188 Check back later

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Hunhow is too strong. I will not risk myself and my Sanctuary by entering the Suda's Datascape. But, if you are foolish enough, I will help you make the journey. For Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: MVO-188 Check back later

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: What I seek to preserve, Hunhow seeks only to destroy. Perhaps Cephalon Suda was right, after all. Somehow this music threatens Hunhow. Perhaps the Tenno used it subversively in the past to coordinate their efforts?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: MVO-188 Check back later

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.text: Fine, Hunter, as you wish. I will join you to the weave and transmit you and the Mandachord to whatever has become of Suda-Hunhow. You will be on your own in a strange, abstract place… Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BardQuest/DBQS.zhText: MVO-188 Check back later

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Most excellent! That shall cover the expedition expenses nicely! Come! Time and my clientele wait for no-one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 太好了！这笔钱正好足以覆盖探险花销！快来！我的时间和客户都不等人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Your investment shall be returned many times over, this I assure you, oh God King.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 神王，我向您保证，您的投资必将获得成倍的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Through the beneficence of Inaros all things are possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 承蒙 Inaros 恩泽，万事皆可成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Enough! Your investment shall be used to fund my recuperation. Farewell, thieves! The day is yours!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 够了！您的投资将用来支付我的医药费。再见了，小偷！这次算你赢了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: I must withdraw! Forgive me, God King!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 我必须撤退了！请原谅我，神王！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Ah! That our glorious adventure should meet such an ignoble end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 啊！我们光荣的冒险居然落得如此不光彩的下场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Flawless! I detect a few choice artifacts my buyers will salivate for. We must defend as my instruments isolate their locations!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 完美！我探测到了几件上等遗器，我的客户们肯定会眼冒金光。在仪器锁定它们的位置期间，我们必须守住这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: This is indeed the place! My instruments are working to locate nearby objects of beauty… drawing the attention of scavenging Grineer. To arms, oh God King!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 果然是这里！我的仪器正在定位附近的好东西……不过，这引起了克隆尼搜索队的注意。准备战斗，神王！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Precise as always, God King. But my instruments of divination reveal our position to the Grineer. No matter! The Tubemen shall prove no match for us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 表现依旧犀利，神王。但我的探测仪也向克隆尼暴露了我们的位置。无妨！那些试管人完全不是我们的对手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Inaros! I'm hurt! These thieves are ruining my garments!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: Inaros！我受伤了！这些小偷糟蹋了我的衣服！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: I am wounded! How dare you!
I fear I am defending my dignity at the cost of my health.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 为了守护我的尊严，恐怕我要付出健康的代价了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: I am grievously wounded! How boring!
I fear I shall not be with you much longer, God King!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 我恐怕陪不了您太久了，神王！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Success! My treasures are transported! You shall receive your generous cut, as always!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 成功了！我的珍宝都被运回来了！您也会像往常一样，获得丰厚的分成！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: We are once again triumphant! God-King Inaros and his best friend Baro! Away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 我们再次大获全胜！神王 Inaros 和他最好的朋友巴罗！出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.text: Wondrous! Our treasures are secure! Now, let's away and see what we have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DB.zhText: 太好了！我们的珍宝安全了！我们快离开这里，盘点一下收获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.text: Inaros Prime… once-protector of the master artisans of Luna Placida… and keeper of their secrets. A walking treasure map if ever there was one. The Orokin are dead as dust, and with them your obligation. I, however, am very much alive and… I need stock. For a modest investment we can both do quite well AND keep my kiosk well supplied with Orokin wonders. What say you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.zhText: Inaros Prime……您曾经是静月工匠大师们的保护者……也是他们秘密的守护者。简直是一张行走的藏宝图。奥罗金早已灰飞烟灭，您的使命也烟消云散。不过，我可活得好好的，而且……我需要货。只需要一点点投资，我们就都能赚得盆满钵满，而且我的小摊儿也能摆满奥罗金的奇珍异宝。您意下如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.text: God King! Sales have been brisk, my lord, and, between you and me, my stock is thinning. Might we adventure together? For the usual cut?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.zhText: 神王！最近生意很好，大人。不过私下告诉您，我的库存要见底了。我们能不能再一起去冒险？还是按老规矩分账？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.text: My lord! You find me, as always, in my hour of need. I, Baro Ki'Teer, stand ready to accompany you on another adventure of mutual benefit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.zhText: 大人！您总是在我最需要的时候出现。我，巴罗·基提尔，随时准备好陪您再赴一场互惠互利的冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.text: Great Inaros! Welcome! My shelves grow bare. Might we… you know. The usual?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroDefense/DI.zhText: 伟大的 Inaros！欢迎！我的货架都快空了。我们是不是可以……您懂的。老规矩？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Did we let it in? Or did it find a way?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 是我们放它进来的吗？还是它自己找到了进来的路？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Did we not fight hard enough? Or the opposite?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我们努力的还不够吗？还是恰恰相反？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Ash and bone… they fought to the end, and for what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 灰烬与白骨……他们战斗到最后一刻，究竟是为了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The spotless assassin… I look for her here even now…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 无懈可击的刺客……我现在依然在寻找她……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Downstream, upstream… the true blessing is the flow itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 顺流而下，逆流而上……真正的祝福在于流动本身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The still water… the shadow in the dark… You never notice, until it's gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 静谧的水面……黑暗中的影子……直到消失，你才注意到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The blister pops… but what was inside?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 泡泡破了……但里面到底是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The pinpricks in the sky… that's all death, you know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 天空中的点点星光……都代表着死亡，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The blue-haired girl… is this what she meant?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 那个蓝发女孩……她说的就是这个吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Call, and the Tenno comes. How fortunate… for us both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 只要呼唤，Tenno 就会前来。真是幸运……对我们双方而言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: They never saw the last flicker, shut inside swarms of metal. They didn't want to know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 他们被困在密密麻麻的金属之中，从未见过最后的闪光。我们也不想知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text:
Tenno- Do not ask me where I have been. The things I have seen. The carnage. Destruction. Never, in all my years… Are we truly doomed?

Forgive me. I will speak no more on it. When I return, promptly upon my next scheduled visit, all will be as it should. I shall ensure it. Graciously, Baro Ki'Teer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText:
Tenno——别问我去了哪里。我看到的一切。屠杀。毁灭。在我漫长的岁月里，从未想过……我们真的注定要灭亡了吗？

请原谅我。我不会再多说。等我下次按计划如期归来时，一切都会恢复如初。我保证。有礼貌地，Baro Ki'Teer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: These wares… do not entice?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 这些商品……难道不吸引你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: How long since the Relays were…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 中继站自……以来已经过去了多久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: But that means… Oh, don't mind me. Just foolish musings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 但这意味着……哦，别在意。只是些无聊的胡思乱想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: I'm sorry, Tenno. I must have misplaced everything you wanted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 对不起，Tenno。我一定是把你想要的东西都弄丢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: But I need you to… ahem. Surely there's something here you want, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 但我需要你……咳咳。Tenno，我这里肯定有你想要的东西吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Engaging in commerce… Some things never change…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 参与商业活动……有些事永远不会改变……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: So that's the sort of thing that interests you, is it? I see…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 所以你对这些感兴趣，是吗？我明白了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Excellent. Please, do continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 太好了。请继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Ah, Ducats. How quaint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 啊，杜卡德金币。真古老啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Continuing as normal, then? Yes I think that might be for the best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 那就一切照旧吗？是的，我想这样可能最好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Tenno- Within the Void, all things are probable. The many sights I have seen may have already come to pass, or none. I am left with only one question: out of so many paths to ruin, which one is yours? In parting, Ki'Teer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: Tenno——在虚空中，一切皆有可能。我见过的种种景象或许已经成真，又或许从未发生。我只剩下一个疑问：在通往毁灭的众多道路中，那一条是属于你的？就此别过，Ki-Teer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Grineer greed drove them to awaken a greater greed than theirs. Those who devoured the weak were themselves devoured. I left the Queen lamenting in her windy palace, her eyes torn out so she would not see His coming. Perhaps you also hear His whispers encroaching from the shadows, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: Grineer 的贪婪驱使他们唤醒了比自身更强大的贪婪。那些吞噬弱者的人，最终自己也被吞噬。我离开时，女王正坐在风雨交加的宫殿里哀叹，她的双眼被挖去，以免她看到他的到来。Tenno，或许你也听到了他从阴影中悄然逼近的低语？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Granum Crowns twinkled in the dust. The pyramids of commerce and prosperity held only rancid bones. They had dwelled in their imagined marketplaces for so long they never saw the fall coming. I sipped tea in the vacant Granum Void and contemplated the hubris of the merely human.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 格拉努硬币在尘埃中闪耀。商业与繁荣的金字塔里如今只剩下腐朽的骸骨。他们沉溺于自己臆想中的市场太久，以至于从未预见到覆灭的到来。我在空荡荡的格拉努虚空之中啜饮着茶，沉思着凡人的狂妄自大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: With their heads cut off, the adherents scattered. At last the survivors attempted to ally and mount a resistance, but too late. They were overwhelmed, bereft of leadership, and yet the lonely monsters roam, with none left to prey upon. And so you see,  lasting peace can emerge from strife.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 随着首领被斩首，追随者们四散奔逃。幸存者们最终试图结盟反抗，但为时已晚。他们寡不敌众，群龙无首，然而那些孤零零的怪物仍在四处游荡，却已无人可供它们猎食。由此可见，持久的和平可以从纷争中诞生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The line of supplicants dwindled. None remained to vie for favor, and the court inevitably cannibalized itself, turning on each other. I last saw the Empress and her consort locked in deadly embrace, but did not stay to see who would emerge victor. As I left, I reflected upon what merit it is, to subjugate only ashes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 求见者的队伍逐渐稀疏。再无人留下来争夺恩宠，皇室最终走向内讧，反目成仇。我最后看到的是女皇与她的伴侣陷入致命的缠斗，但我没有停下来看谁最终会胜出。离开时，我不禁思忖，仅仅征服一堆灰烬，有什么意义呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Would it be kinder to tell these ordinary people what awaits them, do you think, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: Tenno，你觉得如果告诉这些普通人他们所面临的命运，会不会更仁慈一些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The incessant knocking… But worse is when the knocking stops.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 持续不断的敲门声……但更可怕的是当敲门声停止的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Tenno- Where… am I? The sky is so bright. What is happening to me? Is it happening again? The lights in the sky. The Relay. The Tenno. Familiar, yet not. How strange it feels to return. I think I must see you. Uneasily, Ki-Teer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: Tenno—— 我在……哪里？天空如此明亮。我这是怎么了？又发生这种事了吗？天上的光芒。中继站。Tenno。既熟悉，又陌生。重返故地感觉真奇怪。我想我必须见见你。心神不宁地，Ki-Teer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: These eyes have seen the Empire of the Grineer, where the ageless and beautiful Elder Queen rules alongside her loyal sister Worm. Such a peaceful realm, Tenno. Not so much as a whisper of protest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 这双眼睛曾见证过 Grineer 帝国，在那里，永葆青春、美若天仙的年长女皇与她忠诚的妹妹蠕虫女皇共同执政。Tenno，那真是个和平的国度啊。连一丝抗议的低语都没有。
