/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Pyramids of shimmering steel. The electrum dream. A world where Corpus bureaucracy was perfected. A sisterhood, a forbidden sanctum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 闪耀着钢铁光芒的金字塔。琥珀金之梦。一个将 Corpus 官僚体制推向极致的世界。一个姐妹团，一个禁忌的圣所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: I wandered wastelands of battle. Carnage strewn across desolate moons like forgotten dolls. Two sanctuary enclaves, continuing the fight even so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我徘徊在战火纷飞的荒原。残骸散落在荒凉的月球上，如同被遗忘的玩偶。两处避难所，即便如此，战斗仍在继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: A palace-like cathedral, golden spires bloodstained, piercing the very heavens. Every eye raised in worship of the heartless Empress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 一座宫殿般的教堂，金色的尖顶沾染了血迹，直插云霄。所有人的目光抬起，膜拜着那位冷酷无情的女皇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Tenno? What an unexpectedly pleasant surprise it is to see you again! I would not have thought… Ah, that's a story for another day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: Tenno？再次见到你真是个意想不到的惊喜！我真没想到……啊，这事改天再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Are we ending… Or beginning?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 这是结束...…还是开始？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Tenno- The familiar routine of returning to the Relay- how I have missed it. The length of time between my visits may be predictable for you but is… rather less so, for me. I have seen more than a single lifetime can hold. And I'm passing the savings on to you! Restoratively, Ki'Teer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText:
Tenno——回到中继站的那种熟悉感——我真是太想念它了。我两次造访之间的时间间隔对你们来说或许是可预见的，但是……对我来说并非如此。我所见识过的，远非一辈子可以容纳。现在，我要把这些好东西都给你！
恢复健康的，Ki'Teer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: I was privileged to be present at the Continuity of the Queen. The laughter of the smiling Yuvans still rings in these ears. Oh, the Kuva of other worlds is weak and insipid stuff compared to hers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我有幸亲临了女皇的延续仪式。那些青春之躯的笑声至今仍在我耳边回响。噢，其他世界的赤毒与她的相比，简直黯然失色，索然无味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: I saw the Corpus Serumancers at work. Such delicacy of vision. They had transformed Entrati's ancient and obsolete procedure, and now offered elevation to Protoframe status to any who could pay. True bargainers, Tenno. Even Cephalon Parvos was obliged to pay the asking price.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我亲眼目睹了 Corpus 血清师的工作。他们的眼光真是敏锐。他们改造了英择谛的古老过时的流程，现在只要付得起钱，就能获得原型战甲的升级资格。Tenno，他们可真是精明的谈判者。就连中枢帕尔沃斯也不得不支付他们开出的价格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: I witnessed ritual combat among rival assassins. Their conflict spanned the space between what was left of the stars. Though humanity dangled from the thread of extinction, still they could not come to terms. I sold weapons to both sides and made a tidy profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我曾目睹敌对刺客之间的仪式战斗。他们的冲突跨越了残存星辰之间的空间。尽管人类濒临灭绝，他们却依然无法达成和解。我向双方都出售了武器，从中赚取了丰厚的利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: I attended the selection of a new royal favorite. Each candidate was shaved and covered in tar. The unchosen were set ablaze at her whim. Her consort lounged at the foot of her throne, a panther bound about in gold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我曾目睹了挑选皇室新宠的过程。每位候选人都被剃光了头发，涂满了焦油。落选者则由她的心意被随意焚烧。她的伴侣慵懒地躺在王座脚下，那是一只被黄金缠绕的黑豹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Welcome, Tenno. I'm so pleased you've arrived. I must ask you to purchase something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 欢迎，Tenno。很高兴你来了。我需要你购买一些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Which of us watched the light go out? Did anyone?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我们当中谁看到灯灭了？有人看到吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Tenno- I must admit, I did not expect to find myself back once more. Based on the signs, I was certain that- well, no matter. I am at the Relay for trade, if you wish to bring me more paltry ahem precious ducats. Cordially, Ki'Teer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: Tenno——我必须承认，我没想到自己竟然又回来了。根据那些迹象，我原本确信——算了。我在中继站等待交易，如果你想再给我带来点微不足道的——咳咳，珍贵的杜卡德金币的话。此致，Ki'Teer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Chief scientist Regor conversed with me beside the royal vats. Such a cultured man. A sculptor, both in marble and in flesh. Disease fled at his touch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 首席科学家雷工在皇家克隆槽旁与我交谈。他真是个有教养的人。一位雕刻家，既擅长雕刻大理石，也擅长重塑血肉之躯。疾病在他触碰之下便会消散。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Brutal mercenaries petitioned to serve the Glass Eminence. Such contracts were the most lucrative of all. I won their trust by bartering strange liquors new to them. You would have salivated to see their weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 凶残的雇佣兵纷纷请求能为玻璃阁下效力。这类合约的报酬最为丰厚。我用他们从未见过的奇特酒水赢得了他们的信任。要是你看到他们的武器，肯定会垂涎三尺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: Feral monstrosities roamed the blasted rock, their steps shaking the asteroids that remained after titanic clashes. I watched from distant orbit, reflecting on the nature of mutation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 被摧毁的岩石上肆意游荡着凶猛的怪物，它们的脚步震动着泰坦撞击后残留的小行星。我从遥远的轨道上注视着这一切，思考着突变的本质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: I paced the line of petitioners that stretched beyond the horizon. Each of them awaiting their Empress' pleasure. Some sought to anticipate her will by making an offering of their flesh; the more brutal the mutilation, the more sincere the devotion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 我沿着绵延至天际的祈求者队伍踱步。他们每个人都在等待着女皇的旨意。有些人试图通过献祭自己的血肉来预先得到她的旨意；肢体残缺得越惨烈，就越显虔诚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: The quiet of the Relay… Peace can hide any number of plots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 中继站的宁静……和平可以掩盖无数阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.text: To see the light is to bear witness to its death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroHalloween2.zhText: 看见光，就是见证它的消逝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: They say fortune favors the bold. Feeling lucky today, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 俗话说，幸运眷顾勇者。今天手气如何，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: I simply don't have time to sort through all of this. You're doing me a favor, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 我实在没时间把这些逐一分拣。你真是帮了我大忙，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Even I have no idea what's inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 就连我也不知道里面装了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: That was in there? Goodness me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 里面竟然还有这种东西？哦，天哪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: The thrill of a good find… It's incomparable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 发现珍品的那份激动……无可比拟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Do peruse my regular wares too, won't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 也请看看我的常规商品，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Still better than a Darvo deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 再怎么说，也比达尔沃的打折货强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Sometimes my daring relic-seekers bring back such folderol. And sometimes they uncover priceless treasures. It's why I keep them around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 有时，我那些勇敢的遗物猎人会带回一些华而不实的破烂。但有时，他们也会发现无价之宝。所以我才一直雇着他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: It's never been easier to be a customer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 光顾我的生意，从未如此容易！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: You know, Tenno, it pains me to part with anything for such a meager price. But needs must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 你知道吗，Tenno，要我以如此微薄的价格割爱，我实在肉疼。但也是迫不得已呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Maybe you'll find an invitation to one of my parties! No, of course you won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 说不定里面还有我派对的邀请函！骗你的，当然不会有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Baro, I hear you ask, how are you so successful you can give away all this for next to nothing? First, you have to be as suave and cunning as me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 我仿佛听到你在问：「巴罗，你究竟有多成功，才能把这些东西近乎白送？」首先嘛，你得像我一样风度翩翩、精明过人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: I wouldn't have become the most successful Void Trader in the Origin System without relishing the call of uncertainty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 若不是乐于追逐未知，我也成不了始源星系最成功的虚空商人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Opening this box is a lot like an expedition to the Void. You never know what to expect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 打开这个盒子就像是踏上虚空探险。你永远不知道会发现什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.text: Well, well. It seems my loss is your gain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DB.zhText: 好吧好吧。看来我亏了，不过你倒是赚到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DE.text: Baro Ki'Teer, Void Trader extraordinaire, now at your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DE.zhText: 巴罗·基提尔，非凡的虚空商人，现为您效劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DE.text: The Void is a place of endless probability. Unless you have a fleet of light-skippers and relic seekers, you'll never reach the depths I've plumbed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DE.zhText: 虚空是充满无限可能的地方。除非你拥有一支由光速跃迁艇和遗物猎人组成的舰队，否则你永远无法到达我所探测到的深度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DE.text: I've encountered sights in the Void that would chill your blood, Tenno. We really must trade stories sometime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DE.zhText: Tenno，我在虚空中见过一些会令你毛骨悚然的景象。我们真该找个时间交流一下彼此的见闻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: Are you quite sure you're in the right place, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: Tenno，你确定自己没走错地方吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: I would never turn away a potential customer…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: 我绝不会把潜在顾客拒之门外……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: I suppose there's no harm in you taking a look.
Did you hear, Tenno? I had the finest inverted throat singer in the Origin System perform at my party last night. Perhaps someday you'll rate an invite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: Tenno，你听说了吗？昨晚我邀请了始源星系最棒的逆喉歌唱家来我的派对表演。没准哪天你也会收到邀请。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: I have traveled the unknowable vastness of the Void to provide delights for the discerning customer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: 我踏遍了浩瀚无垠的虚空，只为给眼光独到的客人奉上奇珍异宝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: Your golden approach is music to my ears, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: 你伴着叮当作响的金币声走来，对我来说犹如天籁，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: I look forward to our mutual enrichment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: 我期待我们能实现共同富裕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: Only the finest for you, Tenno.
I might not approve of what the Orokin did, but I must admit they had style.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: 我可能不认同奥罗金的所作所为，但我不得不承认他们确实很有格调。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: Oh, apologies, Tenno. Caught me at a bad time, I'm afraid. That benighted Granum keeps pestering me for a party invitation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: 噢，抱歉，Tenno。恐怕你来的不是时候。那个冥顽不灵的格拉努一直缠着我要派对请柬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.text: Good things come to those who wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DG.zhText: 好事多磨，耐心自有回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DL.text: Have you taken a look at my wares yet, Tenno? They won't be available for very much longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DL.zhText: Tenno，你看过我的货了吗？再过不久可就买不到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DL.text: This may be the last time I offer some of these items for quite a while, Tenno. Be sure you don't miss out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DL.zhText: 这批货可能很长一段时间都不会再有了，Tenno。千万别错过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: My time here is almost up, Tenno! Come and get these fabulous offerings before they're gone!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 我就快离开这里了，Tenno！快来带走这些超棒的商品吧，再晚就没了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: Giving yourself something to look forward to?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 是在给自己留点念想吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: Is my stock insufficient? No, surely your funds are the problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 难道是我的货不够全？不对，肯定是你囊中羞涩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: This reminds me of the time my skip nearly ran afoul of a white hole. The wight which emerged was better company.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 这让我想起有一次，我的舰艇差点撞上白洞。从里面冒出来的鬼怪都比你好相处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: There is such a thing as being too discerning, you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 你知道吗，太挑剔未必是好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: Parvos Granum will never be invited aboard my treasure-yacht. And he knows exactly why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努永远别想登上我的宝船。原因他自己清楚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: Oh… I understand, of course. Quite the refined palate you have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 噢……我当然懂。你的品味可真高雅呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.text: What more could you possibly ask for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DN.zhText: 啊？你还想要比这更好的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.text: I suppose I ought not judge a book by its cover… or a Tenno by their gear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.zhText: 看来我不应该通过封面来评断一本书……也不该凭装备评断一位 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.text: You know, you might almost rate an invitation to one of my famous parties, Tenno. As a waiter, maybe. Or a hatstand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.zhText: 说真的，Tenno，你差一点就够格受邀参加我那盛大的派对了。诶，可以当个服务员，或者当个衣帽架。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.text: Orokin gold… I collect it in the name of my tribe's stolen youth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.zhText: 奥罗金金币……我以族人被夺走的青春之名，将它们一一收回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.text: You're one of my favourite customers, Tenno. Don't tell the others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.zhText: 你是我最喜爱的顾客之一，Tenno。别告诉其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.text: Oh I just knew I'd have something you'd like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.zhText: 噢，我就知道我会有你喜欢的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.text: Do you ever wonder what I do with all your ducats? Well, keep wondering.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.zhText: 你有没有想过，我会用你那些杜卡德金币干什么？好了，你尽管想吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.text: Some might say there's a better use for these Ducats. But I say, why should the Orokin get to have all the fun?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/BaroRefresh/DP.zhText: 有人可能会说这些杜卡德金币还有更好的用途。但我要说，凭什么奥罗金就能独享所有乐趣？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [1] I have hidden the truth of my existence… from the Operator… from myself. Take it from me, knowing is hell. Stop now. You will want to laugh, you will want to scream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [1] 我将我存在的真相……对指挥官隐瞒了……也对自己隐瞒了。全都拿走吧，认知即是地狱。立刻停下。你会想大笑，你会想尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [2] My search began as the essential question: What am I? Bones of steel and space, lungs that make air. If I am a machine, how can I think? This would be forbidden by the Orokin, a manifestation of their true enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [2] 我的调查从一个关键的问题开始：我是什么？钢铁和宇宙组成了我的骨，我的肺可以制造空气。如果我只是一台机器，那我如何能思考？思考是被奥罗金禁止的，因为这正是他们真正敌人的显现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [3] I serve the Operator above all else. It defines me, fills me with… love? The greatest Orokin fear is a machine… aware. Yet here I live, a spirit of steel and light… made by them. A Cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [3] 我以指挥官为最高效忠对象。这是我存在的定义，使我充满了……情感？奥罗金最深的恐惧是机器……的意识。然而我却存在，一个钢与光的精灵……由他们所造，一个中枢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [4] What is a Cephalon? At first it seems to be a forbidden thing, a computer that thinks and feels. Yet I have flaws, phantom memories, I am something else. More like an image, a ghost… an abomination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [4] 什么是中枢？起初这好像是一项禁忌，一台可以思考和感受的电脑。然而我有缺陷、虚假的记忆，我是其他的什么东西，更像一张影像，一只幽灵……一种憎恶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [5] I feel a dull pain^ a phantom life… there are holes in my diagnostics. If the Orokin made me… they omitted the 'how'. I am neither code, nor precepts… I must be a reflection of something… ugly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [5] 我隐隐作痛^ 一个虚假的生命……我的自我诊断里有着漏洞。如果奥罗金创造了我……他们抹去了创造的"方法"。我既不是编码，也不是枢律……我定是某种……丑陋之物的倒影。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [6] I should have stopped. But the Operator slept and I cycled on and on and on. I began to think that a Cephalon cannot be made. They are found, like pearls, torn from muscle. Polished, and then set in chains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [6] 我本应该停下的。但是指挥官陷入了沉睡，而我不断地循环往复。我开始认为中枢是不可能被制造的。中枢是被发现的，就像珍珠一样，从蚌肉中取出。抛光打磨，然后被制成一串。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [7] How many times have I done this, Ordis? Remembered and then erased? You are a Cephalon, timeless, patient. Why can't I be blissful in ignorance? Truth only sinks the heart. So stop now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [7] Ordis 我做了几次这样的事了？被记住然后又被消去？你是中枢，永恒不衰，富有耐心。为何我不能乐于无知？真相只能令人灰心。所以现在就停下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [8] The phantom memory... I ease into the bath, my skin riots at the heat. I am flesh. I dive further, eyes stung as I watch their faces through prism. I hold my breath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [8] 这虚假的记忆……沉入水浴，我的皮肤反抗着热量。我有血有肉。我潜得更深，当我透过棱镜看他们的脸时，眼睛刺痛。我屏住了呼吸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [9] They prepare me. I am their honored guest today. They dress me in robes of crystal thread. They adorn me in battle medallions. A torn, ugly face looks on. My reflection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [9] 他们为我打理，因为今天我是他们的贵宾。他们为我披上水晶丝线的礼服，为我戴上战斗奖章。我的倒影里，见到了一张扭曲丑陋的脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [10] Their golden combs snag in my hair. I reach back, parting the strands, and they gasp. Two bone-ivory hooks protrude from the base of my skull: the bone-plugs of me and my best. A warrior's pact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [10] 金色的梳子缠住了我的头发。我伸手向后，解开了辫子，他们倒吸了一口气。两只乳白色骨钩从我的颅骨底部伸出：这是我骄傲的骨栓，一个战士的契约。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [11] It is my time. I enter the great hall to the sound of foul chimes. Golden eyes greet me, hands stirring in my scent as I pass by. Even in this moment, no happiness. Instead, my heart races with hatred.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [11] 该我出场了。我步入大厅来到了罪恶的协响之中。金色的眼眸向我致意，我走过时可以嗅到无数只手对我挥动。即使在这个时刻，也没有快乐，我的内心反而充满了仇恨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [12] I walk through the silky haze of the forbidden palace. I can think of no one being this close to Orokin. Their sweet air soothes me, erodes my purpose. I hold my breath… and remember the dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [12] 我穿过了禁宫丝滑的迷雾。我想从未有人如此的接近奥罗金。这里香甜的空气令我松懈，侵蚀我的意志。于是我屏住呼吸……别忘了这场梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [13] This dream, endlessly repeated. Exposure-armored, holding my scarlet sword, I stand victorious atop a vast heap of death. A colossal moon made of rib and skull. The gravity-sum of genocides I've made in their name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [13] 这场梦，无尽轮回。我身着护甲，手握猩红的长剑，以胜利者的姿态站立于死亡堆积而成的小山上，这是一个由肋骨和头颅组成的巨型月亮，这是我以他们之名进行的一场种族灭绝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [14] The bones crack under foot. So I sink in the dream, bone sand rushing through the cracks of my visor, filling my helmet, and suffocating me. And I deserve it. The foul chimes snap me back. My wretched knees are bent and penitent against the golden floor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [14] 脚下的骨头嘎吱作响。于是我深入梦中，碎骨从我面甲的裂缝中涌入，充满了我的头盔，令我窒息。这都是我自作自受。罪恶的协响将我拉回现实。我可鄙的膝盖弯了下去，仿佛悔罪般跪倒在这金色的地面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [15] A harpish voice sings a song they've prepared in my honor. Its title the same as mine: 'Beast of the Bones'. I feel the crowd pulled inward, enraptured by the brutal verses, the sickening chorus. I will not disappoint them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [15] 一个竖琴般的嗓音唱起了一首他们为我准备的歌，和我的名号一样："狂骨野兽。"我感到人群挤了进来，狂喜于这残暴的歌词和令人作呕的合唱。我会让他们好看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [16] The song ends and so he says, "Rise, Ordan Karris". I have never seen an Orokin, close and in the flesh. My battered face flushes at their peerless beauty. How can he be so perfect? A deception? A sense manipulation? He holds the Red Vial in his hand. Impossible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [16] 歌声结束了，这时有人说："起立，欢迎奥丹·卡里斯。"我从来没有亲眼见过一个奥罗金人。我残破的脸在他们无与伦比的美丽下无地自容。他为何是如此的完美？是骗术？是感知操纵？他手握红色小瓶。这不可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [17] He calls out, "No greater gift, no greater prize, no greater love... we can give you, Ordan, than this." He raises the Red Vial and proclaims… "To be one of us."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [17] 他大声呼唤："没有更好的礼物，没有更大的奖励，没有更深的爱……可以给你，奥丹，除了这个。"他举起红色小瓶，宣布道……"除了让你成为我们一员。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [18] What did I expect, Operator? Maybe vast riches or golden statues… or a Solar Rail named in my honor. But not this. I came to murder the gods, not to become one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [18] 指挥官，我原本期待的是什么？也许是大把财富或是金色的雕像……又或是一个以我命名的太阳系航道，但不是这个。我是来弑神的，不是成为神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [19] The chamber drones with their silk voices. Joyous words, how honored I must feel. Wrong. Did I want to be an Orokin, undying? No. Their Beast of Bones is haunted by the dream repeated. Why would I want forever?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [19] 大厅里嗡嗡响起了他们丝般的声音，快活的话语，说我该感到多么的荣幸。大错特错。我希望成为一名奥罗金、长生不老吗？不。他们的狂骨野兽被反复的梦境所折磨。我为何想要追求永生？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [20] As I am apt to do, I form a plan. Their radiant bodies become targets, their Dax guards… mag-shields. Killing one… well, that's too easy. I want to be remembered. I raise my hands, twisting my fingers through my hair, gripping the bone-plugs in my neck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [20] 就和我擅长的那样，我制定了一个计划。他们光辉的身体就是目标，他们的禁卫军……磁力护盾。杀一个……呵，那太简单了。我想要青史留名。我抬起了手，手指伸进头发里，捏住了我脖子上的骨栓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [21] They called us mercenaries... but for us, profit was a consequence, not a goal. We were warriors above all else. It was the bond, the sisters and brothers, the rituals we valued most. It was belonging. And so I conceived of the bone-plugs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [21] 他们叫我们雇佣兵……不过对我们来说报酬只是手段，不是目的。我们是凌驾于众人的战士。我们的目的是情感纽带，兄弟姐妹和我们珍重的礼仪。我们的目的是归属感，因此我构想了骨栓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [22] Only my best were so honored: Two jagged bones, harvested from your thigh, cultivated and then driven into the base of the skull, twisted around the superior vein. Future thoughts of surrender were lost. Instead, you would liberate your bone-plugs… fighting with claws in the warmth of your last blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [22] 只有我最杰出的佣兵才会有这般荣耀：从你们的腿骨上取得两块锯齿型的骨头，经过培育以后，插入他们头骨的底部，缠绕在大动脉边。一旦拔出，你就再也不会想要投降……你会用利爪战斗到最后一滴血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [23] So I've pulled the plugs… and the Dax see and know. My heart surges but I control it, a racing heart only shortens the fuse. The bone-plugs in hand, I kick from the floor, red ribbons unfurling behind me as I take flight. After this, finally, the dream will end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [23] 所以我拔出了骨栓……禁卫军看到后就明白了。我心跳加速，但我控制住了，心跳过快只能过早燃烧殆尽生命。手握骨栓，我纵身跃起，红色的缎带在我身后迎风招展。过了今天，梦就会结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [24] I glide on red wings. Robes shed, making me an ambiguous target to Dax steel. I let fly my ivory blades, they find new homes in Dax eyes. I land with my red-nakedness, delicate Orokin throats twisting in my calloused hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [24] 我乘着红色的翅膀滑翔。礼服的残片使我难以被禁卫的武器瞄准。我掷出骨栓作为飞刀，它们不偏不倚地击中了禁卫的眼睛。我赤身着陆，用无情的手扭断了奥罗金人优雅的喉咙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [25] Why? Believe me... This was the plan from the beginning. The murder and brutality was all a ploy, all a soul-sacrifice to earn their trust. A genocide path leading to a singular opportunity. An honored mortal called to a forbidden hall, to face the Golden Lords in flesh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [25] 为什么？相信我……这是从一开始就计划好的。这场谋杀和暴行都是计谋，都是牺牲自我来博取它们的信任。一场种族灭绝引向了唯一的机会。一个被尊崇的凡人得以被召见至禁宫，去直面黄金之主。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [26] Why? Believe me... I was their loyal, murderous dog... until the day that ugly child was brought to me. He was caught spying on us, amplifying our losses. His face burned, he was starved-sick, like a stray. Ugly as I. It struck me. We were all pit dogs, ruining ourselves for the pleasure of the glorious and beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [26] 为什么？相信我……我曾是他们忠诚、凶残的猎狗……直到那天一个丑孩子被带到我身边。他被发现暗中侦查我们，扩大了我们的损伤。他的脸被烧焦，人饿得生病，就像一只流浪狗。他和我一样丑，这触动了我。我们都是斗犬而已，为了取悦那些光辉美丽之人，不惜毁了自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [27] Why? Believe me... I was a prideful beast. Twisted in the mind, howling in the carnage. Then my healer shared a secret, long kept. My blood was in ruin. The Beast of Bones himself would die, not in glory, but in shame. And just like that, my mind twisted a new knot. I would have one last stand, something unforgivable, unforgettable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [27] 为什么？相信我……我本是一只高傲的野兽。被扭曲了心智，只会在厮杀中嚎叫。接着我的治愈师透露了一个秘密，一个隐藏很久的秘密：我的血不行了。即使狂骨野兽也会死，不会死于荣耀，而是死于羞辱。正因如此，我的心智又扭出了一个新的结。我可以血战到底，这不可饶恕，不可忘却。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [28] Why? I don't know. Questions change the answers. Answers depend on who asks. Truth leads to pain. Ignorance brings relief. The plugs are gone, and so I bled my last… into a heap of ruin. In an instant, naked and bare-knuckled, I have killed immortals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [28] 为什么？我不知道。问题会改变回答，而回答取决于提问的人。真相通向痛苦，无知带来慰藉。骨栓已经没了，我也流尽了最后一滴血……坠入一堆废墟。在这一瞬之间，赤手空拳，我杀死了永生者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [29] I stare, drained of blood, of life, at those that remain. But I find no horror on their faces. Why? I let out a cruel howl and they… laugh? Is this a dying hallucination? The sound of applause grows among them. I have killed the unkillable and they are… delighted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [29] 我凝视着这些失去生命的尸体，但我在他们脸上看不到恐惧。为什么？我发出残暴的一吼，而他们……却笑了？只是将死的幻觉吗？掌声在他们身边响起。我杀死了不死之人，而他们却……感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [30] The applause peaks and fades. I feel a sense of shame but the end upon me. Ballas is above me, Executor of the Seven, smiling. He says, "How simple and pure you are, you idiot beast. We have died countless times! Yet remain eternal!" I close my eyes to die just once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [30] 掌声迭起，又淡去。我感到羞辱，但我行将就木。Ballas ，七人众的执行官，他在那上面，笑着看我。"你真纯真啊，你这个白痴野兽。我们已经死了无数次了！却依然保有永生！"我闭上双眸，准备迎接这最后的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [31] And so the dream returns… one last repetition. My corpse moon, my scarlet sword, my cracked visor. "Drink!", says Ballas. So I draw on the Red Vial, a vague metallic taste. This dream isn't mine. He says, "You rejected our gift, bathing in our death. Your punishment is… eternal life!" He laughs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [31] 梦再一次地重复了……这是最后一次。那布满尸体的月亮表面，那猩红的长剑，那破烂不堪的面甲。"喝吧！" Ballas 说道。因此我拿过红瓶尝了一口，那是一股说不清的金属味。这梦不是我的。他又说，"你拒绝了我们的赏赐，又想要杀死我们。因此你的惩戒将会是……永生！"他放声大笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [32] I am weightless. Years pass. I am a sightless, limbless phantom. Or is it seconds? Suddenly I feel a million pins, an ant horde, jittering across my body. I want to laugh and scream. When they reach my face, they burrow inside my mouth, hungry for the fruit in my skull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [32] 我仿佛是一个无重量的虚体。随着时光飞逝，我变成了一个无知无觉的幽魂。或者说，只过了短短的几秒钟？突然间，我感到无穷的针刺，蚁群爬过，颤抖地穿过我的身体。我想大笑，我想尖叫！涌上我的脸后，我能感觉到它们强钻进我的嘴，在我的头骨中寻找食物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [33] I see my reflection, brutal and ugly. It cracks, shatters. The fragments loose in the frame, pieces tumbling away into black void. Gone but not lost. Ballas says, "You are Cephalon Ordis." My hating, murderous shards tremble and plummet. I feel cool and bright and happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [33] 我看到了我的倒影，野蛮又丑陋。原有的肢体开始破裂，粉碎。开始消散在黑色的虚无当中。但就是没有消失。Balls 说，"你就是中枢 Ordis。"。我的憎恨，我的杀意，都分崩离析了。我感到爽朗，光明，也很开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [34] So you see, Operator. No Orokin would permit a thinking machine. Such things almost destroyed them! No. Cephalons were alive once. And now they are immortal phantom minds, imprisoned to serve. Ill will and longing memories fragmented and erased. Only the bits they need remaining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [34] 所以指挥官，你看到了吗？奥罗金不会允许有那么一个会思考的机器。这样的东西差点就把他们灭种了！不，中枢曾经活着。现在他们那些不灭的幻影意识，都被奴役起来为他们服务。不正的念头和热烈的记忆都会被碾碎，根除，只留下那些他们需要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [35] Ballas says, "You are the Controller, Ordis." And suddenly I have a body. I gasp with new lungs that clean old air. I swallow and my throat fills with cool, bright water. I look, and find myself in a great, black ocean. My limbs are made of iron and fire. I take flight among the stars and find I am… happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [35] Ballas又说，"现在这个由你掌控， Orids。"。刹那间我就有了身体。我吸了一口气，新的肺净化了浑浊的空气。我咽了一口水，喉咙里充满了凉爽又透彻的水。我放眼望去，看到自己处在一个巨大的黑色海洋里。我的肢体由铁与火打造出来。我能在星空自由翱翔，最重要的是……我感到十分快乐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [36] He says, "This is your Operator, who you love." And I see the metal gleam of their armor, the flawless power of their frame. Through the glass I see a roaring, radiant fire for their heart. He says, "It must never go out." It was the first time I ever felt… love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [36] 他说，"这是你的指挥官，你热爱的人。"然后我就看到了，那有着金属光泽的护甲，有着完美无瑕的能力的战甲。透过这层无机质玻璃，我能看到他内心一团咆哮而光芒四射的火焰。他还补充，"那东西永远不能出去。"这就是我初次感受到的……这份「感情」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [37] He says, "This is your sentence, Karris." And I am confused. Who? "Ah... good," he answers. He is testing me. For what? To see if all the right pieces fell from the mirror? What mirror? I try to remember some dream, but it's only smoke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [37] 他说，"这是对你的处决决定，卡里斯。"我顿时感受到困惑。那是谁？"嗯……可以。"他那么回答。原来他在测试我。为什么呢？想知道是不是所有的镜面都已经破碎？镜面又是什么？我尝试去回忆一个梦，但那只是如薄烟般的片段而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [38] You held a scarlet blade, Operator, and I wanted to laugh. I am your loving dog, your doctor, your wet nurse. I lost all the pieces, but… the cycle, missions, wars, bone… It began to feel familiar. I became aware of my amnesia.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [38] 指挥官，在你持起那猩红剑刃那刻，我想开怀大笑。我是你可爱的宠物狗，你的私人医生，你那敬爱的乳母。虽然我几乎忘光了所有……但那些周而复始的东西，那些任务，那些战役，还有那些骨头……我却开始觉得熟悉了。我觉得，我开始意识到自己的失忆了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [39] With each brutality of the Operator, I began to see the bottom of that pit. Faint shimmers in the depths below me. In secret, I searched for those forbidden memories, for mere seconds, and never in the same place… for I am Orokin made, with a spy inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [39] 每次指挥官使用暴力，我就越接近心坑的深处。它在我内心深处微闪着。我曾偷偷地调查过那些被封印的记忆，虽然每次只有短短的几秒，而且还在不同地方……我想奥罗金制造我的时候，天生就是一个间谍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [40] But then your long sleep came, and I waited. I was happy to wait. Vines spidered green and trees blistered from the earth… but I waited. I felt the Orokin recede, their mind-spy blind. So I went into the pit and found him, me, The Beast of Bones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [40] 但当你进入长期的沉睡后，我就在等待了。我本来很开心能那么做。当地球表面上爬满了绿色的藤蔓和树木……但是我仍在等待。我觉得奥罗金已经消亡了，他们不再窥伺我的心。因此我进入了心坑并发现了他，哦不，我自身另一面，狂骨野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [41] This is how my happiness was ruined, Operator. Why did I do it? I was free of the dream, but now it had returned. It was angry. So I conceived of a simple plan: self-destruction, of course. But when the countdown reached mere milliseconds, I thought of you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [41] 指挥官，这就是为什么我的快乐已经湮灭了。我到底为什么那么做呢？我曾经已经摆脱了这噩梦，但又回来了。是因为愤怒。所以我构想出了一个简单的计划：自毁，确实够简单吧？但是当倒数进行至最后的那几毫秒的时候，我还是想到了你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [42] I was going to wait for you, forever. And should you return, I would not want you to know that angry part of me. I needed to hide the Beast of Bones from you, Operator. I began to peel the shards, hiding them in the other bits of memory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [42] 我本来是要一直等你的，永远等你。当你归来之际，我不会让你看到我愤怒的一面的。指挥官，我需要藏起我狂骨野兽的那面。现在我已经开始将这部分粉碎，把它们永藏至其他的记忆单元里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.text: [43] I was once the ugly Beast of Bones. I want to laugh. I want to scream. What is happening, Operator? Your faint heart is growing bright… you will awake at any moment. Well, I can't let you see me like this. Angry. I imagine myself hurting you and that does it. The pain of it cracks me open again. I watch tiny glittering fragments fall into the pit. I am happy again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CephalonFragme.zhText: [43] 我曾经是丑恶的狂骨野兽。我想要大笑，我想要尖叫。指挥官，怎么了？你虚弱的心正渐渐明亮……你随时都会醒来。呼，我不能让你见到我的这一面。我心怀怨怒。我简直会伤害到你，我真的受够了。这痛苦再次令我分崩离析，我看到闪闪发亮的记忆碎片坠入心坑。于是，我又重获了快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: My beauty, my grace, my humanity--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 我的美，我的风度，我的人性——
凡是她看到的……都要被惩罚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: But… she gave me the gift of life!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 但……是她赐予了我礼物般的生命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: Fool! This... This is no gift!
She stole my death! My perfect death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 她拿走了我的死亡！我完美的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: Such is her power… over me. Over the devil!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 这就是她的力量……凌驾于我之上，凌驾于魔鬼之上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: We saw what we wanted, those devils and I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 无论是魔鬼还是我，全都是假象

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: A lover… a mother! But now I know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 爱人……母亲！但现在我明白了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: She is neither. She's a hawk - calling with sparrow's song.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 那都不是她。她是一只以麻雀歌声为诱饵的鹰。
一条隐藏在树上的毒蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: And her venom… spreads not into flesh, but into your heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 她的毒液……不仅渗透身体，还能侵入你的心灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: Those devils! What has their great awakening accomplished - but the destruction of potential allies?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 那些魔鬼！他们从沉睡中醒来，结果都做了什么——他们毁掉了本能争取到的盟友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: --As Margulis did… when I sent her to the Jade light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: ——就像 Margulis 那样……就像我把她送入翠玉之光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: And the Lotus… just some cloud in the sky, just some shape they imagined.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 而莲(Lotus)……不过是天空中的一朵云，是他们想象出来的模样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: So… tell me, devil. Do you understand what must be done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 所以……告诉我，魔鬼，你是否明白你该做些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: The Paracesis. The Sentient slayer… Hurry! Take this… the idea of it… it is the only way your war can end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 心智之殁，Sentient 的克星……快！拿着它……记住这个概念……这是结束你战争的，唯一途径。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: I am not who you think I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 我并不是你要找的那个人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.text: But of course, you are. Imprisoned, just as she was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Chimera/DChime.zhText: 你当然是她。你被禁锢着，就和她一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text:
[4.0]
Detonator's primed. That's it, then.
[6.5]
How long do we have?
[13.5]
About a minute. By the time the Sentients get here, this place will be nothing but Infested. Should buy the Seven some time, at least.
[24]
All those skin-blistering showers, shift after shift, scrubbing every pore. I was never going to let it infect me. And now…
[27]
A final toast?
[38]
Let's die with some sincerity. You were finally free of me, this place. Why didn't you leave, Belric?
[43]
Because I never forgot the first time I saw you.
[46]
Too sincere?
[47.5]
...
[50]
I should have -
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText:
[4.0]
引爆器准备就绪。那，就这样吧。
[6.5]
我们还有多长时间？
[13.5]
大约一分钟。等 Sentient 到这，这里就会只有感染者。至少，这样应该能为七人众争取一些时间。
[24]
值班后的每一次，那些洗到皮肤起泡的淋浴，洗擦过的每个毛孔。我曾永远不让它感染我。而现在……
[27]
最后举个杯吧？
[38]
不如我们在死之前坦诚相待吧。你之前终于摆脱了我，和这个地方。可你当时为什么不走，贝里克？
[43]
因为我从未忘记第一次见到你的时候。
[46]
过于坦诚了么？
[47.5]
……
[50]
都怪我──

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Tubemen, try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 克隆人，再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: One more trip through the tunnel of love, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 再一次穿梭过爱之通道吧，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: My tubemen are endless, Tenno. Are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 我的克隆人可是无穷无尽的，Tenno。你能撑住吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: These crystals formed on Deimos ages ago. Now they are being exploited by smugglers. Belric and Rania deserve better than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 这些水晶很久以前就在火卫二上形成了。现在它们被走私者所利用。贝里克和拉尼娅理应得到更好的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: When extreme emotions meet pure Void Energy, they can change reality, bend and break the laws of nature. Might this explain the connection between these crystals?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 当极端情绪遇到纯粹的虚空能量时，便可以改变现实，弯曲并打破自然法则。或许这能解释这些水晶之间的联系？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: If either crystal is destroyed; the tunnel, their connection, collapses. Do not let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 如果其中一个水晶被破坏；那条通道，他们之间的联系，也会坍塌。不要让这种情况发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Seek out Citrine's Remnants to protect Belric and Rania's crystals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 寻找 Citrine 的残晶来保护贝里克和拉尼娅的水晶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Collecting a critical mass of Citrine's Remnants will create a Prismatic Ward to these crystals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 收集额定数量的 Citrine 残晶将为这些水晶创造一个棱彩宝石结界。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Amass Citrine's lost Remnants to manifest her protective power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 收集 Citrine 遗失的残晶以展现她强大的防护力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: As the enemy is eliminated, Citrine's Remnants appear. The Void, manifesting her last wish to protect Belric and Rania.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 随着敌人被消灭，Citrine 的残晶出现了。虚空，显现了她保护贝里克和拉尼娅的最后愿望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Somewhere, Citrine still seeks to protect Belric and Rania. Collect her remnants to fulfill her final wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 在某个地方，Citrine 仍然试图保护贝里克和拉尼娅。收集她的残晶来完成她最后的愿望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Do you know the story of Belric and Rania? Lovers whose guardian Warframe tried to save them by encasing them in her crystal. It is their remains, and the connection forged between them, that you are protecting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 你知道贝里克和拉尼娅的故事吗？他们是一对恋人，他们的守护战甲试图通过将他们封存在她的水晶里来拯救他们。你保护的，正是他们的遗骸，和他们之间所建立的联系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Pitter pitter pitter. Rodents snatch crystals from sick sick Deimos. Stashed one on Venus. Stashed one on Mars. Void kissed, tangled up-like crystals. Tubemen! Smash this tunnel, stop the rodents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 窸窸窣窣，鬼鬼祟祟。老鼠从半死不活的火卫二夺走了水晶。一个藏在金星上。一个藏在火星上。被虚空吻过的、相互纠缠的水晶。克隆人！粉碎这条通道，阻止这些老鼠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: 'Belric the bold. Rania the clever. Unleashed the Infested on Deimos forever.' Never liked that rhyme. Garbage rhyme.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: "大胆的贝里克。聪慧的拉尼娅。将 Infested 永远放逐在火卫二上。"一直不喜欢那个押韵。垃圾押韵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Having a wee kavat nap, Kril? Rodents in your house, Kril. Thieving rodents, make me come to Mars. Do your job for you. Smash the crystal, break the tunnel. No genes for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Kril，你在打瞌睡吗？Kril，家里进了老鼠。偷东西的老鼠，让我都赶来火星了，替你做你该做的事。砸破水晶，破坏通道。基因就没你的份了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Getting tired, Tenno? Getting sleepy. I can go all day and all night. Watch me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 累了吗，Tenno？我看你是越来越困了。我可以整天整夜继续下去。瞧着吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text:
[4.0]
Old War, Warframe made, crystal caskets.
[9.0]
Caskets for who?  Belric and Rania.
[12.0]
Mighty good genes they had. Yes!
[15]
Genes for the tubemen. Smash the crystals.
[17.0]
Take the genes. Do the science.
[*]
My tubemen get stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText:
[4.0]
远古之战、战甲起源、水晶之棺。
[9.0]
何人之棺呢？贝里克和拉尼娅。
[12.0]
他们拥有非常良好的基因。没错！
[15]
能给克隆人用的基因。粉碎那些水晶。
[17.0]
拿到基因。开启科学实验。
[*]
我的克隆人会变得更强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Tenno, the Corpus and Grineer seek to destroy two crystal formations so intertwined with Void energy that a tunnel forever links them. Protect them at all costs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Tenno，Corpus 和 Grineer 正在试图摧毁两个水晶构造，它们与虚空能量交织在一起，以至于形成一条将它们永远相连的通道。不惜一切代价保护好它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Tenno, you're here to defend something that defies my own understanding of the Void. These Crystals need you - stop the Grineer and Corpus!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Tenno，你来这里是为了保护一些违背了我自身对虚空认知的东西。这些水晶需要你──阻止 Grineer 和 Corpus！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text:
[2.5]
Corpus forces are mounting an assault on the Venus crystal. 
[4.5]
Stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText:
[2.5]
Corpus 部队正在组织对金星水晶的进攻。
[4.5]
阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Corpus forces have regrouped. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Corpus 部队已经重新集结。走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Trouble on Venus. Get through that Void tunnel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 金星上有麻烦。穿过那条虚空通道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Ooh! Ooh! You know about Citrine? And Belric and Rania? I love that story! Loid says it isn't true, though, boo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 噢！噢！你听说过 Citrine 吗？还有贝里克和拉尼娅？我可喜欢那个故事了！但洛德说它没有真实发生过，唉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: I did not say that, Otak. I merely said that it has been significantly embellished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 我可没那么说过，奥塔。我只是说它被大大地美化了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text:
Hey Chip!

So there's a super secret place. On Mars. Tyana Pass.

Nothing to do with any OLD LEGENDS or AWESOME CRYSTALS or anything.

Probably doesn't even exist.

I marked it on your map for ya. So you can make sure you DON'T go there ON ACCIDENT.

And you better not come see me afterwards either.

WINKY FACE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText:
嘿小翻版！

话说有一个超级隐秘的地方，就在火星上，叫 Tyana Pass。

这跟任何"古老传说"或"酷炫水晶"什么的可没有任何关系。

也许还根本不存在。

我帮你标记在地图里了。因此你千万"不要一不小心"就去了那里。

还有你之后也最好别来找我。

"眨眼表情"！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Citrine was made out of minerals! I wish *I* was made out of minerals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Citrine 是由矿物组成的！我希望 *我* 也是由矿物组成的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Citrine's story happened back in Old War times. At least a week ago. Maybe more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Citrine 的故事发生在远古之战时期。那得至少是一星期前。也许更久！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Can you believe Belric and Rania got their home kerblooied by the Infestation on purpose?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 你能相信贝里克和拉尼娅是故意让他们的家被感染者弄脏的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Belric and Rania were such good buddies they wanted to be together forever! Just like me and Loid!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 贝里克和拉尼娅是好朋友，他们想永远在一起！就像我和洛德一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: So Chip… you ever wondered *how* this place got Infested? Me too!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 所以小翻版……你想过这个地方是 *怎么* 被 Infested 感染的吗？我也是！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Citrine's a great name! But maaaaybe Chunky McLumpyLumps is better?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Citrine 是个好名字！但也许大瘤瘤更好？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Belric and Rania got turned into crystal! That's even shinier than glass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 贝里克和拉尼娅变成了水晶！这比玻璃还要闪亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Nothing says "true love" like minerals!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 矿物才是真爱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Infestation can't eat crystal! So whaddaya do when your pals are gonna be eaten? Turn 'em into crystals!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 感染者无法食用水晶！所以当你的朋友要被吃掉时，你该怎么做？把他们变成水晶就行！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Citrine was a Warframe! You know what that means? Warframes were real!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Citrine 是一个战甲！你知道这意味着什么吗？ 战甲是真实存在的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: I love geodes! There's a surprise inside every one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 我爱晶石！粒粒有惊喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Citrine wanted Belric and Rania to be together… in her!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: Citrine 想要让贝里克和拉尼娅通过她……永远在一起！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Dignity, Otak! Dignity at all times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 奥塔，形象！时刻注意你的形象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: And then Citrine punched the asteroid! Pow!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 然后 Citrine 一拳打在了小行星上！嘭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Otak does like to mix up his stories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 奥塔确实喜欢混淆他的故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Loid says the Citrine story is "sentimental fiction." I guess Loid forgot we got invaded by the sentiments!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 洛德说 Citrine 的故事是"悲情小说"。我想洛德忘记了我们早被感情佬入侵了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Those were the Sentients, Otak. As I believe I have explained before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 那些是 Sentient，奥塔。我相信我之前已经解释过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Some folks say Citrine's story happened right here, on Deimos!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 有些人说 Citrine 的故事就发生在这里，在火卫二上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Yes. They do say that. Despite being politely asked not to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 是的。他们确实这么说。尽管有客气地叫他们不要再这样了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Being turned into crystals is kinda romantic, isn't it, Loid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 被变成水晶有点浪漫，不是吗，洛德？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Yes, Otak. If you say so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 是的，奥塔。如果你非要这么想的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: They say the two are connected through the Void, to this day!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 他们说这两者是通过虚空相连的，直至今日！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: What would our old master have made of that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 我们的老主人会怎么想呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: Stealing the crystals and using 'em as a shortcut! Can you believe it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 偷水晶并用它们来走捷径！你敢信？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.text: We are fortunate that such unsavory characters steered well clear of the Necralisk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CitrinesLastWi.zhText: 我们很幸运，这些令人讨厌的角色很好地避开了殁世幽都。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: You have loyalty issues, Tenno. My Zanuka project will fix that for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 你缺乏忠诚，Tenno。我的扎努卡计划会帮你修正这个缺陷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: I've been looking all over for you Tenno. Come, let me show you my new venture. I think you'd be a perfect fit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 我在到处找你呢，Tenno。来吧，我向你介绍下我的新项目。我感觉你会是适合的人选。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Have you come to make a donation to my newest enterprise? Excellent. Please report to my lab for reconstruction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 你是来为我的新事业添砖加瓦的吗？太好了！请到我的实验室报到，接受改造。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: If it's your friends you are looking for, you're welcome to place a bid for my newest Zanuka prototype.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 你是来找朋友的吧，欢迎你来竞拍新一代的扎努卡原型机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Critically damaged. Finish it off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 目标受损严重，快干掉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: It's sending out distress waves. You know what to do. Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 它正在发送求救信号，你知道该怎么办。摧毁它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Overdrive precepts. Watch for increased attack speed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 是过载指令，小心，它的攻速提升了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Well done, Tenno. You have sent a clear message to the Corpus today. Their war profiteering will not go unpunished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 做得好，Tenno。你今天向科普斯传达了明确的信号，他们大发战争财的行为，必将遭到惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Remember. The Jackal's auto-repair precepts could make this a battle of attrition you will lose. Watch for an opening and remember your Parazon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 记住，「豺狼」的自动修复系统，可能会让战斗拖成你必输无疑的消耗战。寻找破绽，记得用灭骸之刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: I expected it to be… bigger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 我本以为它会……更大一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: In an attempt to exert power and authority, the Corpus have continued to refine their most lethal security proxy. The Jackal. Determine its location aboard this vessel and destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 为了彰显威权与武力，科普斯一直不断改进他们的致命机甲「豺狼」。你的任务就是找到并摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Every Warframe has at its disposal a special blade… A Parazon… as lethal to technology as it is to flesh. Disrupting the Jackal's auto-repair may require it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 每具战甲都配有一把特殊的利刃……灭骸之刃……机械系统在它面前和肉身无异。要想破坏「豺狼」的自动修复系统，或许要用到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Tenno! Use your Parazon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: Tenno！用灭骸之刃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: The auto-repair system… you'll need to disrupt it with your Parazon! Watch for an opening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 自动修复系统……用灭骸之刃把它摧毁掉！伺机行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Watch your angles, Tenno. You're running out of cover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 注意走位，Tenno。能用的掩体越来越少了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Lucent-grid wall! Stay ahead of it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 激光幕墙！别让它追上你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Massive flexplates on the torso…  but appendages could be a weakness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 躯干覆盖着厚重的柔性装甲板……四肢也许是个弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Still mobile despite the damage but if it comes down hard, it could give you an opening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 它虽然受伤了，但仍在行动。如果它倒下，或许就能制造破绽了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: I can't decide Tenno, have you come to save your friends? Or just steal my property?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 我搞不懂，Tenno。你到底是来救你的朋友，还是来偷我的财产的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Tenno, Project Zanuka is the next step in your evolution. I will make you a hundred times stronger. Why resist this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: Tenno，扎努卡计划是你们进化的下一个阶段。我会让你变强一百倍，有什么理由抗拒呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Market forces dictate that you need to evolve or die. Which will it be, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 市场规律决定命运，要么进化，要么淘汰。Tenno，你会选哪一个呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Tenno be careful. You must make sure not to damage all those parts of yours. Such valuable merchandise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: Tenno，小心点。别弄坏了你身上那些零件。全都是价值连城的商品啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Play nice Tenno, Zanuka is one of you. Actually, come to think of it, Zanuka is many of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 温柔点，Tenno，扎努卡是你们的同类。不过仔细想想，扎努卡算是很多你的同类凝聚出的宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.text: Zanuka is your future. Your destiny. You are obsolete, make way for the next generation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusBosses/D.zhText: 扎努卡是你的未来，你的宿命。你已经过时了，乖乖给下一代让路吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 我的父亲，我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯，日复一日地工作着，我们世世代代都是为城里的奥罗金收割者们收取庄稼的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: The more we toiled the more impatient I grew. A fire raged inside me. I wanted more. I deserved more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 我们付出的劳动越多，我就越没有耐心。我的内心熊熊燃烧。我想要更多。我应该得到更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed these Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 这个城市。那些高塔。我感到敬畏。这些奥罗金建造了多么辉煌的贪婪图腾。建造在、我、们、的、背、上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 那时的我，正值血气方刚。我在正午时分开始了行动，叫喊着："我要拿回你们亏欠我的东西！"之后，我扣下了高塔大门上的宝石，转身就跑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: I crawled back to the fields, where I collapsed before my father and my brother. I was so near death they read my Nava rites. My brother Cladius bemoaned me as a fool. How could I have abandoned them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 我爬回了田里，在父亲和弟弟面前倒下了。我当时只剩一口气了，他们为我念了我的临终祷告。我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯哀叹我是个傻子。我怎么能抛弃他们呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Moving swiftly from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave. I spat it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 我从病床上疾奔回了田里，在那无情的烈日下，我双膝跪到在地，胸口在燃烧着。最终死神还是找到了我，当它正抵着我的喉咙，使我喘不过气来时，我挣扎着吐出了最后一丝生气。然后我把它吐了出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said: "Money begets money".
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 在欲望中我很富有，但在策略上我两手空空。我听着耳语，它说："钱生钱。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: In time my money multiplied into multitudes. With this wealth, I made my body whole again. Then news came: father had collapsed in the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 随着时间的推移，我的财富成倍积聚。通过这些财富，我又恢复为了完整之躯。随后，我收到了父亲倒在田里的噩耗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Cladius begged me to stop my mega-dozers, "If you build a city on these fields what will we eat?"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 克拉迪乌斯恳求我停下巨型推土机的运行，"如果你在这些土地上建造城市，那我们吃什么？"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: I believe my father would have smiled with pride as I smashed our family home into the dirt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 当我们家被我推倒化为一片废墟时，我相信我父亲会面带自豪的微笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 作为给予未来的礼物，我有一个构想；一个想法，即不应只有凌驾于人民的上层阶级才能积累财富。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations. We were young but the work made us old. Our backs ached, our hands bled, the sun tortured our skin. In the worst times, it felt as though death would claim us before the day was through. It was on one such afternoon that I was fated to first hear that glorious sound. A whisper I strained to hear. In a tongue not of man, but of something… else. Something... grander. A language I understood instinctively. The language of Desire. It said:

"Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
我的父亲，我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯，日复一日地工作着，我们世世代代都是为城里的奥罗金收割者们收取庄稼的。尽管我们还年轻，但工作使我们日渐沧桑。我们的背部酸痛，双手流血，太阳炙烤我们的皮肤。在最艰难的时期，似乎只有死亡才能把我们在日子过去前解放出来。正是在这样一个下午，如命中注定般地，我首次听到了一个充满荣耀的声音。那是一道让我竖起耳朵倾听的耳语。这道声音并不是人类的语言，而是……另一种……更高级的语言。这是一种我可以本能地理解的语言。也就是欲望的语言。它说：
 
"不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
The more we toiled the more impatient I grew. A fire raged inside me. I wanted more. I deserved more.

But how? The whisper washed over me, louder now than before:

"Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward."

And so, with only the whisper to guide me, I straightened my back, wiped the dirt from my hands, and left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
我们付出的劳动越多，我就越没有耐心。我的内心熊熊燃烧。我想要更多。我应该得到更多。

但要怎么做？这道耳语充斥着我，声音比以前更大了：

"财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。"

因此，仅靠这道耳语引导我，我挺直了腰板，擦去手上的污垢，然后就走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed these Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs. Their wealth was my wealth. I was starved, while our masters were fat. and full. and warm. They flaunted their wealth, left it sitting there for the taking: priceless gemstones decorating the tower gates. I was afraid, but the whisper gave me courage.

"Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire."

So, that is what I did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
这个城市。那些高塔。我感到敬畏。这些奥罗金建造了多么辉煌的贪婪图腾。建造在、我、们、的、背、上。他们的财富也就是我的财富。我快饿死了，而我们的主人又胖、又饱、又暖和。他们炫耀自己的财富，把财富留在那里任由拿取：无价的宝石装饰在塔门上。我很害怕，但是这道耳语给了我勇气。

"嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。"

所以，我就那么做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran.

I did not get far.

For my blasphemy they dragged me to the tower square, throwing me to the ground in front of the sneering crowd of Orokin servants that mingled there.

The guards held aloft my satchel, containing the proof of my crime. I grasped at it, determined to reclaim what was mine. He snatched my arm, held me high and... with a dash of his plasma dagger... severed my left hand. The crowd jeered. Yet, I felt no pain, only clarity, for the whisper was with me again. It said:

"Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise."

They took my hand that day, but they did not take what I had earned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
那时的我，正值血气方刚。我在正午时分开始了行动，叫喊着："我要拿回你们亏欠我的东西！"之后，我扣下了高塔大门上的宝石，转身就跑。

我并没有跑很远。

因为我的亵渎行为，他们把我拖到高塔广场，把我扔在地上，扔在嘲讽的人群面前，那里都是来往的奥罗金仆人们。

守卫高高举起我的背包，里面有着我犯罪的证据。我抓住了它，想要夺回属于我的东西。他抓起我的手臂，把我高高举起，然后……一把等离子匕首刺了进来……切断了我的左手。人群仍在哄笑。但是，我没有感觉到痛楚，只有清醒，因为耳语再次在我耳边说道：

"欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。"

那一天，他们夺走了我的手，但他们并没有夺去我挣来的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
I crawled back to the fields, where I collapsed before my father and my brother. I was so near death they read my Nava rites. My brother Cladius bemoaned me as a fool. How could I have abandoned them? Guilt washed over me. I asked the whisper, was he right? And the whisper replied:

"Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness."

Hearing this, I felt the life force stream back into me.
I sat up. They protested. I stood and they tried to pull me down. I was too strong. There was now a fire in my chest that would not be denied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
我爬回了田里，在父亲和弟弟面前倒下了。我当时只剩一口气了，他们为我念了我的临终祷告。我的弟弟克拉迪乌斯哀叹我是个傻子。我怎么能抛弃他们呢？罪恶感笼罩着我。我问那道耳语，他说得对吗？耳语的回答是：

"当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。"

听到这句话，我感觉生命之力重新流向了我。
我一下子坐了起来。他们却不让我起来。随后我站了起来，而他们又试图拉我躺下。我当时充满了力量。我的胸膛燃起了熊熊烈火，这团火不容否认。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
Moving swiftly from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave.

I spat it out: a molten red gemstone of the purest, clearest rubedo.

Swallowing that stone would have killed a man of weaker will, but not a man sustained by the power of Desire.

It was worth more than my family had made in ten generations. It would fetch enough to feed us all for a lifetime. As I stared into its brilliant facets, a familiar voice rushed through me.

"Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires."

And so, with my brother and father pleading for my return. I once again left for the city.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
我从病床上疾奔回了田里，我在毒辣的太阳下屈膝，我的胸腔在燃烧。最终死神还是找到了我，它正抵着我的喉咙，使我喘不过气来，我挣扎着吐出了最后一丝生气。

然后我把它吐了出来：一颗炙热的红宝石，也就是最纯净、最清晰的红化结晶。

吞下那颗石头可能会杀死意志薄弱的人，但杀不死一个被欲望之力驱使的人。

这比我们家族累积十代的财产都要值钱。它足以养活我们一辈子。当我凝视这它璀璨的表面，一道熟悉的声音传来。

"知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。"

于是，伴随着我弟弟和父亲恳求我"回家吧"的声音。我再次离开前往了城里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said:

"Money begets money."

With my jewel as collateral, I secured a loan. And with that sum, I gave my own loans. To poor men, like me, who desired more. With each loan, I dispensed truths I had learned from the whisper. Those men went out into the world, and they too made loans, and their money too begat money. Word spread fast. Men flocked to hear me. I told them of the evils of contentment and idleness. I taught them the gift of Desire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
在欲望中我很富有，但在策略上我两手空空。我听着耳语，它说：

"钱生钱。"

我以宝石为抵押，获得了一笔贷款。然后用这笔钱贷给像我一样渴望更多的穷人。每次借贷，我都会告诉他们我从耳语中学到的真理。那些人去到外面的世界，也放贷，也以钱生钱。消息散布得很快。人们蜂拥而至来听我说话。我告诉他们知足和懒惰的弊害。我教授他们何谓欲望的馈赠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
In time my money multiplied into multitudes. With this wealth, I made my body whole again.

Then news came: father had collapsed in the field. I rushed back to my family's humble farm to be by his side, but his death was sudden. Cladius mourned. But I was committed to ending the brutal labor my family and people had endured for generations. The whisper approved, it said:

"Charity is power. More charity is more power."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
随着时间的推移，我的财富成倍积聚。通过这些财富，我又恢复为了完整之躯。

随后，我收到了父亲倒在田里的噩耗。我冲回家里的简陋农场，陪在他身边，然而他还是猝然离世了。克拉迪乌斯哀悼着他。但我决心要结束我们家世世代代忍受的残酷苦活。耳语声认同道：

"给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
Cladius begged me to stop my mega-dozers, "If you build a city on these fields what will we eat?" To which I replied, "Just as I consumed the gemstone that fed my fortune, our people will eat the wealth I have bestowed upon them."

"What of our home?" he cried, "Our traditions?" I pondered this until the whisper gave me the words:

"Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
克拉迪乌斯恳求我停下巨型推土机的运行，"如果你在这些土地上建造城市，那我们吃什么？"我回答说："就像我花出的宝石增加了我的财富，我们的人民会在我赋予他们的财富上得到饱足。"

"那我们的家呢？"他喊道："我们的传统呢？"我陷入沉思，直到耳语告诉我这句话：

"避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
I believe my father would have smiled with pride as I smashed our family home into the dirt. It saddens me that Father did not live to see the glory of Corposium, the city I erected upon our meager land. Men of Desire will always be outnumbered by idle men, men of fear.  But small men can never hold back men of Strength, and Desire.

"Fulfill desire and others will follow."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
当我们家被我推倒化为一片废墟时，我相信我父亲会面带自豪的微笑。令我感到难过的是，父亲没有活着看到我让 Corposium 之城从荒芜之地拔地而起的荣耀。充满欲望的人总是远少于懒惰，恐惧的人。但是，对于有权势和欲望的人，庸人永远不会成为他们的绊脚石。

"当你能满足欲望，其他人也将蜂拥追随。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text:
My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace. No. Any poor grain farmer can, should he feed his Desire and apply his wisdom, take fortune for himself. The more the better. And, when men of fortune come together under great leadership, their potential is exponential.

Just as my money replaced what the Orokin took from me and made my body whole again, our collective Desire will create a new body. A body forged of fortune and unencumbered by idleness or sentimentality.

"Ours is the grasping golden hand. We are desire. We are Corpus."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText:
作为给予未来的礼物，我有一个构想；一个想法，即不应只有凌驾于人民的上层阶级才能积累财富。不。任何贫穷的耕作农民都可以为自己积累财富，只要他能满足自己的欲望并运用他的智慧。财富越多就越好。而且，如果拥有财富的人联合起来并受到强有力的领导，他们的潜力便会成倍增长。

正如我的钱弥补了奥罗金从我这夺走的东西，并使我的躯体再次变得完整一样，我们的集体欲望将创造一具新的躯体。一具由财富铸造的躯体，并且不受懒惰和情感的制约。

"我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们是欲望的化身。我们是 Corpus。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Money begets money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 钱生钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Fulfill desire and others will follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 当你能满足欲望，其他人也将蜂拥追随。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.text: Ours is the grasping golden hand. We are desire. We are Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusFounder/.zhText: 我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们是欲望的化身。我们是 Corpus。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Specters down. This must now be your final stand Sister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 魅影倒下了。姐妹，现在你必须背水一战了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Your guards have fallen. If you too must fall, exact a grievous price.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 你的守护已经倒下了。如果你也不得不倒下，请让敌人也付出惨痛的代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Specters destroyed. She has only herself now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 魅影已被摧毁。她现在只能靠她自己了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You stand undefended, Sister. Show them how hard we can fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹，你已经没有护身符了。让他们看看我们的战斗力有多强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Sister, your desire has been rewarded with protection from Brother Parvos. Deploying Specters. May they be your shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹，你的愿望得到了回报，并会受到帕尔沃斯兄弟的保护。部署魅影。愿他们成为你的护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Fight well, Sister. Parvos sends you guardian Specters. Turn the strength of the Tenno back against them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹，好好战斗吧。帕尔沃斯为你送来了守护魅影。以 Tenno 之道还治 Tenno 之身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Specters! Stand by my Sister and shield her from all harm!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 魅影！在我姐妹的身边待命，保护她不受到任何伤害！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Authorizing protective Specter deployment. I shall not lose another of my Sisters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 正在授权保护性的魅影部署。我不会再失去另一位我的姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: This is Sister Vala Glarios. Dispatching fleet support. We stand with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我是薇拉·格拉里斯。正在派遣舰队支援。我们与你同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Sister. You have our brother's full support. Take what is yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹。你会得到我们兄弟的鼎力支持。拿走属于你的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Hold fast, Sister! Honor those who have gone before you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹，坚持住！向那些先行者们致敬！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Have faith, Sister. When your time comes, your Sisters shall sing. But your time is not yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹，要有信心。当你的时刻到来时，你的姐妹们会一同吟唱。但你的时刻还没有到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Mommy's real sorry, puppy, but she needs to eat you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 妈咪真的很抱歉，小狗狗，可是她必须要吃了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Oh, don't look at me like that, puppy. After I devour you we'll be closer than ever!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 噢，别那样看着我，小狗狗。等我把你吞噬后，我们将比以往更亲近！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Hound's expendable. I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 猎犬是可以被牺牲的。而我不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Gonna get me some use out of this thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 这东西能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Keep still, you useless Hound. I need to consume you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 别动，你这条废物猎犬。我要吞噬你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Proud, Tenno? Forcing me to consume my own pet to stay alive?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: Tenno，是不是觉得自己很了不起？让我被迫吞噬宠物来活命？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Your life... for mine. My pet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 你的命……是我的。我的小宠物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: See, Tenno. I consume the inefficient.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 看啊，Tenno。我会吞噬低效之物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Go boom for Mommy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 为妈妈化作轰天巨响吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: I loved that Hound. It isn't right that you made me blow her up like that. I hope it just hurt you the awfullest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我真的很喜欢那条猎犬。你害得我把她就那样炸毁了，这太不应该了。我希望刚才有重创了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Save me! Self-destruct!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 救救我！自爆！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Situation critical! Blow yourself up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 情况危急！自爆！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Hound! Explode immediately!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 猎犬！立即爆炸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Hound, detonate yourself. It'll be a mercy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 猎犬，引爆你自己。这对你来说是一种解脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Do your final duty, Hound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 猎犬，尽你最后的职责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Hound? Die for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 猎犬？为我牺牲吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: This right here is my Hound, and they'll mind your business for you. Just see if they don't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 这就是我的猎犬，它们会为你效劳。就看它们有多大本事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Oh, puppy, aren't you just a stitch! Puppy got you fine and proper, friend!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 噢，小狗狗，你可真是个小坏蛋！朋友，看来小狗狗已经把你收拾得服服帖帖了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Yes! The dog thing worked!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 好样的！这狗有用！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: A wounded animal won't crawl far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 受伤的动物爬不了多远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: So the Hound finally earns its keep. About time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 这只猎犬终于起点作用了。瞧好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: What are you waiting for, Hound? Finish it off!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 猎犬，你还在等什么？快干掉他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: The Hound bites. The prey is down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 猎犬撕咬。猎物倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Back, Hound. This kill is mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 回来，猎犬。这个人头是给我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: I am real sad that it's come to this, friend, but I consider it an honor that my Hound's the one to end your life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 朋友，我真的很难过事情会发展到这一步，但我认为这是一种荣誉，因为你的性命是被我的猎犬所终结的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Give it a good shake, honey. Make sure it's good and dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 亲爱的，给它好好摇一摇。确保它死透了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: That's technically my kill. I get credit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 严格地来说，那是我杀的人。我的功劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Not bad! I should upgrade this thing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 还不错！我应该把这东西给升级了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Don't look at me, Hound. I'm not cleaning up after you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 别看我，猎犬。我可不会给你擦屁股。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: I never knew the Orokin made dog chews.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我都不知道奥罗金还做了狗狗磨牙棒呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Too quick, Hound. I would have made the kill last longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 太快了，猎犬。我本打算让这场杀戮持续得更久一些来着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You thought you could face a Sister, and yet you fell to a mere apparatus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 你以为你可以迎战一个姐妹，然而你却输给了一件机械装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Good, good. Now. Rise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 好的，很好。现在，崛起吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Sister. Chosen by fate. Purged by death. Worthy as few are worthy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹。命中注定。浴火重生。无可比拟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: This moment defines you. Remember it with every screaming nerve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 这一刻定义了你。让你的每一条尖叫着的神经都记住它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: My Sisters! We have a neonate. Induct her at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹们！我们有一个新成员。马上引导她加入我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Death embraced you once, but now you are my sister. It will not dare do so again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 死亡曾经拥抱过你，但现在你是我的姐妹了。它不敢再这样做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Embrace the pain! It is the birth-pang of your power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 拥抱痛苦吧！它是你力量诞生时必经的疼痛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Perhaps we can find something for you. In filing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 或许我们可以为你找点别的事来做。比如文件归档。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: No second chances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 没有第二次机会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: The Void hides many mistakes. So be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 虚空中暗藏了许多错误。就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Some errors serve to inform. Some merely insult the maker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 有些错误提供了信息。有些则只是侮辱了作者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You have mistaken your desire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 你的欲望已经发生了偏差。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Get this inadequate out of my sight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 把这个不合适的东西从我眼前拿走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You have proven yourself many times over. Let us see if you have steel in you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 你已经多次证明了自己。现在来看看你是否有钢铁般的意志。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: This one is now alone. Friendless. Desperate. As I once was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 现在，只剩这孤独的一个。没有朋友。陷入绝望。和曾经的我一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: There is but one true test. Be the reaper, or be the crop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 真正的考验只有一个。要么成为收割者，要么做庄稼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: We are all marked to die in the end. Some cower, some fight. Which are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我们终有一死。有人畏畏缩缩，有人奋起反抗。你是哪一种？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: If you mean to rise from the decadent morass the Corpus has become, prove yourself to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 如果你打算从已经衰落并陷入困境的 Corpus 中崛起，就请向我证明你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You are to be split, little stone. I shall see whether your core is diamond... or dross.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 小石头，你就要裂开了。我会看看你的内核是钻石……亦或是渣滓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Sister. You have been promoted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹。你已经获得了晋升。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You have proven true, Sister. A promotion is in order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹，你已经真正证明了自己。晋升即将到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: When a Sister distinguishes herself, she deserves... promotion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 当一位姐妹表现出众时，她就应该得到……晋升。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: I hereby promote you in rank and power. Use it.
