/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 在此，我晋升你的等级和力量。好好利用它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Sister! We honor you with promotion to the highest rank!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹！我们很荣幸将你晋升至最高等级！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You now receive the highest honor the Sisterhood can bestow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 你现在获得了姐妹团所能授予的最高荣誉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: You BRUTE! You MONSTER!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 你这个禽兽！你这个怪物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Oh my. You just worked her right over, din'cha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 天哪。你刚刚揍了她一顿，对吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Get back up and fight, you useless object!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 重新爬起来战斗吧，你个没用的东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: But... that thing was built to be Warframe resistant...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 但是……造出来的那东西应该有战甲抗性的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Great. Now I have to order another one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 真是的。我现在得再订购一个了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: I'm going to do that to your favorite floof and make you watch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我也会对你最爱的玩偶这么做，并让你全程观看！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Finally, you show promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 终于，你展现出了你的发展前景。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: It can be replaced. Can you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 它可以被替换。你行吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: She has eluded the Tenno. A strong candidate, but this was not her time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 她躲过了 Tenno 的追杀。一位强有力的候选者，但此刻还没到她的时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: The Tenno was too weak for her. We shall find her a more suitable match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 这个 Tenno 对她来说太弱了。我们会为她找到一个更合适的对象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: A draw. Impressive. Reward the candidate and return her to the queue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 一场平局。真令人印象深刻。好好奖励这位候选者，并将她送回队列中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Our candidate escaped. How embarrassing for the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我们的候选者逃脱了。这对 Tenno 来说是多么尴尬呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: This Tenno is wasting your time, Brother Parvos. The candidate has eluded them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 帕尔沃斯兄弟，这个 Tenno 正在浪费您的时间。候选者已经躲过了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: We came to judge this candidate, but instead, she judged this Tenno... unworthy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我们是来评判这位候选者的，但她却对这位 Tenno 做出了评判……不及格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Parvos Granum! This next candidate claims she has shed the bonds of idleness and aspires to become your Sister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努！下一位候选者声称，她已摆脱了懒惰的束缚，并且渴望着成为您的姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Candidate, you would be wise to remember your Tenets! Brother Parvos is watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 候选者，你最好牢记你的信条！我们的兄弟帕尔沃斯正关注着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Candidate, your accomplishments are many. Now prove yourself to our brother, Parvos Granum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 候选者，你获得了很多成就。现在，向我们的兄弟帕尔沃斯·格拉努证明你自己吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Brother! Another candidate steps forward in the hope of admission to our Sisterhood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 兄弟！又有一位候选者站了出来，希望能加入我们的姐妹团。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Space the remains. Let them drift, a monument to her failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 把她的尸体扔向太空。让她漂流，成为她失败的纪念碑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Ah, well. I have other, less weak, sisters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 啊，好吧。我还有其他不是那么弱的姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Tenno. That will prove to be a very costly mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: Tenno， 那将被证明是一个非常昂贵的错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Very well, Tenno - you have my attention. So. Be. It.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: Tenno，非常好。你获得了我的关注。就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: Sisters! Retrieve her corpse. Analyze this failure. Learn. Iterate!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 姐妹们！找回她的尸体。分析此次失败。学习教训。重复进行！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: My brother was a witless man. Happy as a hog, face-down in the trough. No thought of the farmer's axe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 我弟弟是个没有智慧的人。他永远像猪一样开心，脸埋在食槽里。从未想过农夫手里的斧头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: He was a brute above my asperous constitution. Yet he had not the will nor the guile to let me guide that brawn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 他是个比饱经风霜的我体质更强的蛮子。但他没有足够的意愿或智慧让我去引导他那浑身的潜力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: So… in my youth, I often imagined I had another sibling. A specter... of sorts. A sister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 所以……在我小时候，我经常幻想自己有另一个兄弟姐妹。一个……像幽灵一般的，姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: And in my mind, she and I - oh, how we would conspire... great schemes, risk-trades, rapacious plots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 然后在我的脑海里，她和我——哦，我们会如何密谋……伟大的计划、充满风险的交易，以及巧取豪夺的阴谋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: And should I ever find myself... back at the trough. Penniless. Betrayed. Rich, only in enemies...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 然后，如果我发现……自己回到了食槽。身无分文，众叛亲离。富有，只存在于敌人那里……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.text: She'd be at my side, axe in hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DCr.zhText: 她会站在我这边，手里握着斧头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Gatecrashers. Get into those sleds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 冲锋部队。进入那些冲锋艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Gatecrashers, bring Mommy that ship. Launch ramsleds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 冲锋部队，把那艘船给妈妈拿下。发射冲锋艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Little men, get on your shooter tubes and do good. Travel true!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 小伙子们，进入你们的弹射管道，然后好好干！一路顺风！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Little men, I would very much like you all to bring me that ship, please. Now fly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 小伙子们，我非常希望你们能为我拿下那艘星舰，拜托了。起飞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ramsled full of angry people, coming towards you, quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 满载着愤怒之人的冲锋艇，正急速向你袭来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Good luck, Ramsledders! With you in spirit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 冲锋部队，祝你们好运！精神上我与你们同在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Execution squad dispatched. Inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 已派遣行刑小队。即将抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ramsled underway. Troops expendable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 冲锋艇正在行进中。部队可被牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, fine. Let's do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，好吧。让我们开干吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well hey there, sweetie. Any last mucking words?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你好啊，亲爱的。有什么龌龊的遗言吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: It just breaks my heart to have to do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我也是不得已这样做的，我的心都要碎了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Why do you have to make me choose? Between you and Mister Parvos? You know that's no choice I can make.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你为什么要逼我做出选择？在你和帕尔沃斯先生之间？你知道我没得选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Mighty Parvos. My desire this day is... not to die. And I grasp it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 伟大的帕尔沃斯啊。我今天的愿望是……活下去。我会紧紧抓住这个愿望决不放手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Whatever happens here, I think we've both learned a lot. Haven't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 无论这里会发生什么，我想我们都学到了很多。不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Is it still here? Is it persisting?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 它还在这里吗？还在坚持吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There is much of worth in you. I shall crack you open and scrape it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你体内还剩下不少价值。我会把你开肠破肚，然后搜刮干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Wait. This is what you wanted the whole time? You know you could have just ASKED.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 等等。这就是你一直以来想要的吗？你知道你只需要开口问即可。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Void. I'll never live this down. Yeah, okay. Let's just... get outta here before someone sees us together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 虚空在上。这将成为我一辈子都摆脱不掉的梦魇。是的，好吧。让我们……在被人发现我们在一起之前离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well. Alright. I assume the position comes with the usual ship, bonus scheme, and insurance plan. Yes? No? SERIOUSLY?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧。我想这个职位会包交通飞船、奖金和保险。对吧？没有？认真的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: But... that would mean... that would mean I have to *leave* Mister Parvos. A girl has to do what's best for her. Goodbye, Mister Parvos. I'll never forget what you did for little ol' me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 可是……那就意味着……意味着我不得不*离开*帕尔沃斯先生。身为一个弱女子，我只能先为自己着想。再见，帕尔沃斯先生。我永远不会忘你为我这个卑微的姑娘所做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh. Oh what kind of choice are you giving me? To betray the man I love... to save my own life? What kind of choice is that? Forgive me, darling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢。你这是给了我什么选择啊？要我背叛自己心爱的男人……来保全自己的性命？这算是什么选择啊？原谅我，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What? To betray or die? What kind of choice is that? I was reborn once. I can be reborn again. All right. Have it your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 什么？背叛或是死亡？这算是什么选择？我曾经重生过一次。也可以再重生一次。好吧。就按你说的做吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, thank you, THANK YOU. Oh, you won't regret this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，谢谢，谢谢你。噢，你不会后悔的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Yes! For a moment there, I thought you were going to... well. Moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 太好了！刚刚有一会儿，我以为你会……好吧。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Thank you so much for this opportunity. I believe my former experience makes me the ideal candidate to join your team, and I can't wait to get started!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 啊，非常感谢你给我这次机会。我相信我以前的经验使我成为加入你们团队的理想人选，我已经迫不及待地想要开始工作了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I... did not expect this. Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我……没想到会是这个结果。那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am to be renegade, then. So be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我要成为叛徒了。那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You would turn me apostate? What efficient cruelty. I submit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你想让我成为叛徒？这招可真够狠的。我只能屈服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Pack lots of burly men into a Crewship and send it on over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 给我把大量壮汉都装到战舰里去，然后把它送上战场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Make ready the next Crewship. I farewell you... with a kiss!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 准备好下一艘战舰。我会用……一个吻来与你告别！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Let's launch a Crewship. That'll keep them busy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 让我们来发射一艘战舰吧。那会让他们忙起来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Remember, Crewship, your families get no compensation if you fail today!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 记住，船员，如果你今天失败，你的家人将得不到任何补偿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Crewship! Put yourselves between me and them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 战舰！把你们自己挡在我和他们之间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Huh. A Crewship I didn't know I had. Send it in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哈。我都不知道自己还有一艘战舰。就派它去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Another Crewship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 再派出一艘战舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Crewship. Launch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 战舰，出动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Nobody gets in here without an invite, ugly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 没有邀请谁都不能进来，丑八怪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Turn around. Get back on your little spaceship. And leave. Right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 掉头。滚回你的小破船上去。赶紧滚。马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What. You can't be here. How can you be here? Oh, this is all gone wrong!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 等等。你不能来这里。你怎么能在这里呢？噢，全都乱套了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This is how you repay me for showing you Mister Parvos' light? You better start showing some gratitude, or I don't think we can be friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我为你展示了帕尔沃斯先生的指引之光，你就是这么回报我的？你最好要懂得感激，不然我觉得咱们就做不成朋友了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Just remember, Tenno. You started this. And you'll only have yourself to blame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 记好了，Tenno。这是你先挑起的。那只能怪你自己了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're making a big mistake here, Tenno! I'm a strong, confident Sister at the height of her power! And you're... not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你已犯下大错，Tenno！我是一位强大、自信且处于巅峰状态的姐妹团成员！而你……不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Let's not make your death a boring one. The Founder is watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不要让你的死亡显得乏味无趣。创始人正看着呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I shall name this ship the traditional way. By smashing a Tenno against the hull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会以传统方式来为这艘战舰命名。那就是把一名 Tenno 狠狠砸向舰体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Fighters, away! Handsome skyboys, I'll be waving from the bridge!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 战斗机，出动！帅气的飞行员们，我会从舰桥上跟你们挥手道别的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Fill the sky with fighters like an angel choir! Sing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 把天空布满战斗机，就像一组天使合唱团那样！吟唱吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Brave Corpus fighter pilots, get out there and earn your pay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 勇敢的 Corpus 战斗机驾驶员啊，快出发吧，去赚回你们的酬劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Your proud moment has come, fighter squadron number one-more-than-the-last-one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 战斗机小队，编号：上一队的编号加一，你们引以为豪的时刻终于来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Why are there fighters that aren't even fighting yet? Do I need a chalkboard?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 甚至还有战斗机都没开始战斗，这是为什么？需要我在黑板上都写清楚吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Launch fighters! Why isn't there a button for that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 发射战斗机！为什么没有一键发射的按钮呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Fighters? Swarm them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 战斗机？包围他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: More fighters. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我们需要更多的战斗机。就是现在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Don't touch what you can't afford, ya microcephalic trog.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不要触碰你买不起的东西，你个头小又畸形的呆子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I would kill for a cryotic cocktail right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 为了一杯永冻晶矿鸡尾酒我现在可什么都做得出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm... I'm so proud of you. But you need to be quiet now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我……我真为你骄傲。但你现在得安静点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're not my friend. You're a fake tin thing as fake as all my SISTERS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你不是我的朋友。你只不过是和我的姐妹一样，都是装模作样的锡人罢了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're not displaying very flexible thinking here, you know! Always it's straight to the violence!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你的思维不够灵活，你知道吗！总是想着用暴力解决问题！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You'll meet a bad end, you will! Bullies always do!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你不会有好下场的，肯定是这样！恶人总会遭报应的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Harder, idiot!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 用点力，白痴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Have you started fighting yet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你已经开始战斗了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I hand selected those men.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我可是亲手挑选了那些人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hey! Hey hey hey! This all costs money, you peasant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嘿！嘿嘿嘿！这些都很贵，你这个土包子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Things are gonna change around here. Oh indeedydoody and yessiree. Things are gonna change.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这里的局势要发生变化了。噢，确实是这样，没错。情况要反转了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You may not say much, but those popguns of yours certainly do sing a sad old opera, don't they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你可能话不多，但你的那些玩具枪倒是一直在唱着可悲的旧日歌剧，难道不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Think! When has killing me ever, EVER worked? Not once! So why don't you just go home, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好好想想吧！我有被杀死过吗？有吗？一次都没有！所以说，你干嘛不赶紧回家去呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: 'Self destruct activated. All personnel evacuate.' Oh no! Hurry, everyone! Let's all get off this ship before it explodes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: "自毁程序已启动。所有人员应尽快撤离。"噢不！大家动作快点儿！我们得赶在爆炸前离开这艘战舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You. Impaled on the prow of my ship. A living figurehead. Screaming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你。被钉在我的舰首。一个活生生的舰首像。伴随着尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am bracing myself. For disappointment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我已做好心理准备。来面对你那令人失望的表现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Figures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 果然是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're a LOSER! You'll always be a loser! *urk*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你是个废、物！你一直都会是个废物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What's the POINT of being part of a SISTERHOOD if they let you down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 如果姐妹团让你伤透了心，那么加入她们又有什么意义！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ha. Hahahaha
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哈。哈哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Wait. No. Not when everything's still so messy...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 等等。不要。不要在所有事情都还是一团糟的时候……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: aaAH! MUCK YOU YA MUCKIN' MUCK MUCKER I'M G...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 啊啊！去你的你这该死的混蛋我要……!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: No no no, wait, just let me ex-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不不不，等一下，让我解——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: No! NOT YET! PLEEEASE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不！还不是时候！拜托了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: No, Tenno, it's me, you can't have meant to... oh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不，Tenno，是我，你刚刚不会是想……噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I... shall be... avenged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 会……有人……替我报仇的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Do it, coward!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 下手吧，胆小鬼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Parvos. Witness me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯。见证我此刻的遭遇吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I know, I know. I know! Ahaha. Oh you. Thank you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我懂。我懂。我懂！哈哈。哦，是你呀。谢谢你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: A promotion? *gasp* Spectacular.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 晋升？*倒吸一口气*太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Thank you. I deserve this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 谢谢你。这是我理应得到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I just want to thank everyone who helped me get here. Now that I've achieved this promotion, you're all fired, and I'm buying real friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我想感谢所有帮助我到这里的人。既然我已经完成了这一晋升，那么你们所有人都被解雇了，我会买几个真正的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well isn't that just lovely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那不是很可爱吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh! Thank you, Mister Parvos! I... I don't know what to say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢！谢谢您，帕尔沃斯先生！我……我不知道该说什么才好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh. Oh! I just want to dance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，哦！我只想尽情跳舞！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Really? Is this...? Am I...? Oh. Oh my. If this isn't just the shiniest star in the heavens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 当真？这种感觉是……？我是不是要……？哦，天哪。这不是天堂里最耀眼的星星吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: My sisters used to say children would dress like me for Naberus. They thought they were so smart. So funny. Well. Who's laughing now, huh? WHO! IS LAUGHING! *NOW*!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我的姐妹们说过，纳贝流士之夜时，孩子们会装扮的跟我一样。她们以为自己有多聪明，真搞笑。哼，那好。现在是谁在笑？现在！是谁！在笑！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh. Mister Parvos. Thank you for making me a part of your life. For welcoming me into your wonderful dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，帕尔沃斯先生。感恩您把我变作了您生活中的一部分。感谢您将我迎入您的美妙愿景。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I just got promooo-ted! Don't be bitter, Tenno. You can't be a loser forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我刚刚被提拔了！别苦着脸，Tenno。你不可能永远是个废物的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: More power? Don't mind if I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 更多的力量？我不介意拥有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Another promotion! This partnership is going places.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 另一重晋升！现在的合作关系正形势大好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There's nothing like having your hard work recognized, is there? Like you'd know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 没有什么比你努力工作之后，得到认可的感觉更好了，不是吗？你懂什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The industrious reap the reward, the idle look on and covet. It's all there in The Founder's Tenets, you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 勤劳的人收获奖赏，懒惰的人只是在一旁干瞪眼并觊觎着。这些都写在创始人的信条里了，你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I have labored and now I claim my due!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我已经付出了努力，而现在，我得到了回报！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am elevated. And you... are trodden underfoot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我已扶摇直上。而你……却被人踩在脚下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Do you see? Do you comprehend? I am winning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你看到了吗？你领会了吗？我正在迈向胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Power grows like a crystal. Cold. In pure, perfect order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 力量如水晶一般增长。如此寒冷、纯粹，而又至臻完美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The more you struggle, the harder the golden hand shall grip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你越是挣扎，黄金之手就越是要握紧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Finally, I get what I'm owed. Ultimate power. Feels good and it looks good on me. Mm hm. Now. Down to business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 终于，我得到了我应得的。终极的力量。这感觉好极了，并且它也很配我。唔——嗯。现在，该做正事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Yes. Yes! This is me, Sisters, how I was always meant to be. There's a new goddess atop the mountain, and you're looking at her. Go ahead. Touch me. I'm real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 是的。是的！这就是我，姐妹们，这是我梦寐以求的样子。在你们的注视之下，一位新女神冉冉升起于山巅之上。来吧。感知我的存在。这感觉如此真实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well. My goodness. I feel... powerful. Mister Parvos, sir, this must be how you feel every single morning. I am going to be such a good Sister, sir. Oh yes I am. Better than all those other doodies you surround yourself with. Better than that Vala. Oh, you'll see. I'll be the only Sister you'll need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 喔。我的天啊。我感觉自己……很强大。帕尔沃斯先生，想必您每天早上都会有这种感觉吧。我会成为一个优秀的姐妹团成员。噢，是的。我会比那些跟在您周围的饭桶们更加优秀。比那个薇拉还要优秀。请您拭目以待。我将成为您唯一需要的姐妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You see? You see me now, all you dirty doodies? Who took the cheap, easy route? I am my best self. I have manifested the life I deserve and Mister Parvos,  he SEES ME. Oh. Oh happy day. I'm gonna kill all of you I swear to the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你们看到了吗？你们这帮肮脏的人渣都看到我了吗？到底是谁在投机取巧？我现在处于最佳状态。我的人生迎来了高光时刻，而帕尔沃斯先生，他注意到我了。噢。噢，今天我好开心。我对虚空发誓，一定要把你们全都杀了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: At last. The pinnacle. And I could never have done it without using you as my footstool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 最终。到达了顶点。如果不是用你当垫脚石我是怎么都做不到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Parvos sees me. He takes me in his golden hand. And he raises. Me. UP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯看到我了。他用黄金之手引领着我。让我飞升到了，更高的境界！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: In azure fire we ascend! I have achieved my full potential, and you did nothing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 在蓝焰中，我的力量获得了提升！我已被激发出了全部潜力，而你却什么都没做！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You must enjoy watching others rise above you. You do it so often.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你一定喜欢看着别人超越你。你可是经常这么做呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Why are you following me? What is your damage?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你为什么跟着我？你有毛病吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh. It's that null-unit who looks like a Tenno only smaller. We meet again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哎呦。这不是那个看着像小号 Tenno 的家伙。我们又见面了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well well. Look who turned up to play soldier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 呦呵。看看是谁来玩士兵扮演的游戏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Now? Call ahead, for Void's sake. Some of us have plans.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 现在吗？虚空在上，你得提前预约才行。我们中的某些人可是有其它安排的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I should have blown your ship to confetti when I had the chance. Now I have to get my nails dirty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 当我之前有机会时，我就应该把你的飞船炸成碎片。现在我又得弄脏我的指甲了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I believe we pick the devil we run with. You picked me, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我相信我们会选择和我们相伴的恶魔。我猜你选择了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You are very brave, but leaving here alive should be of concern to someone as outnumbered as yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你很勇敢，但是像你这样寡不敌众的人更应该担心的问题是活着离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I hope you hugged everyone who cares about you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我希望你已经拥抱过所有关心你的人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I don't like people who just come calling. I DON'T LIKE IT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不喜欢不请自来的人。一、点、都、不、喜、欢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am tired of runnin' you around on the end of a stick. I am an important part of Mister Parvos' endeavors, and you are just a... a... dumb-dumb dooder. And dooders gotta die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我已经厌倦了这种你逃我追的猫鼠游戏。我是帕沃斯先生的事业的一个重要组成部分，而你只是一个……一个……愚蠢的烂人。而且烂人就该去死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ah, Tenno, I see you have blundered into my lair! Prepare to perish in agony! What do you think? Was that too much?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 啊，Tenno，我想你已经误入了我的巢穴！准备在痛苦中毁灭吧！你觉得如何？这是不是太过了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Tenno. Let me explain this in words you will understand. My ship is very big. Your ship is very little.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Tenno。用通俗易懂的话给你解释就是。我的战舰非常大，而你的战舰那么小。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Tenno, are you demented? Do you have the slightest idea how many lethal weapons are on this thing? Should I send you over the documentation?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Tenno，你疯了吗？你知不知道这上面有多少致命武器？需要我把对应的文件都发给你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, look. It's Stabby Parazon-Pants the Stabbing Stabber of Stabsville. Planning on doing a little stabbing, were you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，快看。这不是那个喜欢拿着灭骸之刃到处捅的臭小鬼吗？你这是打算来捅人了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am in control. This battle is happening on MY terms. I am a motivated self-starter who can think on her feet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 一切都在我掌控之中。这场战斗正按我的方式进行。我是一个积极主动，懂得随机应变的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I told you you'd come to me sooner or later. Now here you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我告诉过你，早晚你都会来找我们。现在你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Dogged persistence. Common to both the noble and the deeply stupid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 固执己见。高尚之人和极度愚蠢之人的通病。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Watch this Tenno, sisters. It'll probably climb into an engine vent and incinerate itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 姐妹们，看住这个 Tenno。它可能会爬进引擎排气口，然后把自己烧死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Trying to add novelty by failing in space now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 怎么？为了博人眼球，你甚至打算丢人丢到太空里了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Now it ends. As Parvos foresaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 现在结束了。就像帕尔沃斯预见的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Torpedoes! Blow 'em up real pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 鱼雷！狠狠把他们炸开花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Torpedoes! All bays! Fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 鱼雷！所有港口！开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hit 'em with those crackle-snappers! I wanna see that little tin ship scatter like stars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 给他们来一顿噼里啪啦的痛击！我想看到那艘小锡船像星星一样散落在天上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Deliver Mister Parvos' wrath on trails of fire! Fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 在火焰之径上传递帕尔沃斯先生的怒火！开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Launching torpedo. A nice big one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 发射鱼雷。那可是一个漂亮的大家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Fire torpedoes! Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 发射鱼雷！就是现在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Torpedoes away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 发射鱼雷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Target locked. Fire torpedo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 目标已锁定。发射鱼雷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Get ready to make the biggest mistake of your career.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 准备好犯下你职业生涯中最重大的错误吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hey sweetie guess what? By the time I'm done with you you'll never form a consonant again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嘿，亲爱的，你猜怎么着？当我摆平你之后，你就连半个字都吐不出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: By the time I'm done with you, you're gonna look like a normal person REFLECTED IN A PUDDLE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 等我把你解决掉了，你看起来就会和水坑中倒映的人影一样面目全非。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Blah blah blah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嗯呐，嗯呐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I think you should take some Me Time and drop dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我认为你该一个人静一静，然后去死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, Vala is going to be livid when she hears it was me who took you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，当薇拉知道你是被我干掉的时候，她一定会被气疯的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This is a really bad idea on your part.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 对你而言，这确实是个坏主意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I warn you, I'm a lot stronger than I look!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我警告你，我可比看起来强大得多！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: A Sister of Parvos is an official position. So you see, I'm officially killing you. Perhaps that will be some comfort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯的姐妹是一个正经职位。所以你看，我是在正经地杀了你。也许那将带来一些慰藉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Have you met my Hound? A gormless mass of metallized flesh that follows me around everywhere? You two have a lot in common.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你见过我的猎犬吗？一团紧跟着我到处走动，且呆头呆脑的的金属化肉体？你们俩有很多共同之处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Look, I am actually going to hurt you quite badly, and it's only fair to let you know that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 看着吧，事实上我会把你伤得很重，让你提前知道这一点才对得起你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm sorry! It's too late for mediation! You've escalated this situation waaaaay beyond the original remit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我很抱歉！现在调解为时已晚！此事态已被你升级到远远超出了原先的控制范围。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Shoulda banged a left before you got here. Then we wouldna had ta do this, now would we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 在你抵达这里之前，你就该立刻转头离开。那样我们就不必这样做了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I figure you're gonna last about as long as a moth in a candle factory, yes I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我觉得你也就活得跟蜡烛厂里的蛾子那么久，是的没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'd say you have about as much chance as a snake in a typing contest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我想说你的胜算就和打字比赛中的一条蛇差不多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Don't you tell me you love me, I don't care how bad you wanna live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你可别和我说你爱我，我不在乎你是多么渴望活下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There you are. There's my cheeky sweetie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你在这儿啊。这才是我亲爱的淘气包。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Your rage is fire. And that fire is gonna take you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你的愤怒是火。而火焰是会吞噬你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Now you keep those ticklesticks of yours where I can see them and maybe this doesn't end with my having to spread you out like a map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 现在，你把你那双只能给人挠痒痒的手放在我看得到的地方，也许这样，你就不至于像一张被我摊开的地图一样平躺在地上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You represent an embarrassing mistake. And what do we do with those, Sisters? We shred them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你代表着一个尴尬的错误。姐妹们，我们是怎么处理这类错误的呢？我们会粉碎它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: If I can face a disciplinary meeting with Sister Glarios, I can certainly face the likes of you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 如果格拉里斯姐妹团的纪律会议对我都不算什么，那像你这样的人自然就不在话下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This will be over disappointingly fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这将以令人失望的速度被快速了结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Too late to make an effort now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 现在才努力，为时已晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I have them. The hunt is on. Parvos wills it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我来对付他们。狩猎开始了。一切如帕尔沃斯所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I honor your desire to be torn asunder. My Hound shall have the scraps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我尊重你想要被撕成碎片的愿望。我的猎犬将收下这些残羹剩饭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Let me teach you the value of breath and blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 让我来告诉你气息和鲜血的价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Did you prepare wisely? I doubt it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你做好充分的准备了吗？我看未必。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: It's no coward. I'll give it that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 还算是有些胆量。这点，我得承认。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ugh, you make this so hard to watch. Closer. Closer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 呃，我真的看不下去了。近一点，再近一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Please, *BORING*. Warmer. Closer. Over... no, no, not... UUUUGH
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 拜托，*好无聊* 。近了。靠近了。再往……不，不，不要……呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: If you intend to find me you'll need to do better than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 如果你打算找到我，你得表现得比这再好点才行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Colder... colder.... HA! You actually believe me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 离远了……又远了一点……哈！你还真就相信我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Why are you trying to crack top level Granum security? Are you deranged?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你为什么要试图破解最高级别的格拉努安保？你疯了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Yes, yes, this was funny for a while, but you can stop now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 是的，是的，在此之前这很有趣，但现在你可以停下来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Nobody likes a pokey Pobber. You quit poking around my affairs and I won't have to poke out those pretty peepers of yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 没有人喜欢一个多管闲事的泡博。你不要干涉我的事情，我就不会戳瞎你那双漂亮的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What... what are you doing? Get away! You get away from that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你在……你在干什么？走开！你离它远点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I don't like people who put their sticky little ticklesticks where they haven't been invited.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不喜欢那种没经别人允许，就乱碰东西的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh no. Oh no you don't you dirty dooder. This belongs to Mister Parvos, and nobody touches Mister Parvos' particulars while I'm around! No sir!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，不。噢，这可不行，拿开你的脏手。这是帕尔沃斯先生的东西。只要有我在，任何人都不能碰帕尔沃斯先生的宝贝！绝对不行！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, trying to guess my password? Yawn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦？在猜我的密码吗？哈欠，真无聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're wasting your time, you know. This is com-plete-ly futile. You might as well be knitting socks for the Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你在浪费你的时间，知道吗。这完全是徒劳的。你还不如去给英择谛织袜子呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Do you think to riddle me out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你以为你这样就能解开我的秘密吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This work should have been completed long ago.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这项工作早就应该完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You cogitate like a child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你思考问题的方式和孩子一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Back to your colored blocks, little one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 回去玩你的彩色积木吧，小不点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I claim this system in the name of Me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这个星系已处于*我*的名义之下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'll take that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那个我要了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: All forces! Claim this sector in the name of Parvos Granum! And the rest of the Corpus, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 全员听令！以帕尔沃斯·格拉努的名义占领这个星区！当然了，还有以其余 Corpus 的名义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: While they kiss one hand I'll take with the other. This sector is now under my control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 当他们亲吻我的一只手时，我会用另一只手来进行攫取。这个星区现在处于我的控制之下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Thanks, I'll take it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 谢谢，这个区域我就占领了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hey Vala honey, guess who got a sector? Don't hate me too much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嘿，薇拉宝贝，猜猜是谁拿下了一个星区？别太过记恨我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm in charge! And it's all going SWIMMINGLY.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我负责主管这里！所有一切都在顺利进行中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: With Parvos Granum calling the shots, everyone will benefit! Especially his loyal Sisterhood. Conspiracy is such an ugly word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 伴随着帕尔沃斯·格拉努的号令，每个人都能从中受益！特别是他忠诚的姐妹团。阴谋，一个如此丑陋不堪的词汇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Observe. This sector belongs to Parvos Granum first, to the Corpus Administration second, and to you not at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 请注意。这个星区首先是属于帕尔沃斯·格拉努的，其次是属于 Corpus 政府的，而与你毫不相关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The sector? We got it? Really? Oh happy day! Happy, happy day! What do I win?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 整个星区？到手了？真的吗？噢，今天真是个好日子！大大的好日子！我赢了什么好东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Now. Mr Parvos says this sector's mine and that means everyone in it. Now you all be double-shiny good and I won't ever have to show you my mean face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 现在。帕尔沃斯先生说这个星区是我的地盘了，这也包括这里的每一个人。所以你们都乖乖听话，我就再也不必让你们看到我的臭脸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh. Oh Mr Parvos will be so pleased with me. Do I look okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢。噢，帕尔沃斯先生会对我很满意的。我看起来还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: A sector. Gosh. A sector's a big responsibility. But I can do it. I'm ready, Mr Parvos, sir. You just see if I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 一个星区。天哪。管理一整个星区是很重大的责任。不过我可以做到的。帕尔沃斯先生，长官，我准备好了。我要是不行的话，您也会看出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I do believe I'm getting better at this! Even my Sisters say so. "She should be dead already." Nossir. I'm movin' on up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我坚信我做得越来越好了！甚至我的姐妹都这么说。"她早该死翘翘了。"才不是这样，我在不断前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Look what I got! A sector! Oh, it's perfect perfect perfect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 看我得到了什么！一个星区！噢，太好了太好了太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This sector is under new management. And about time, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这片星区换上了新的管理者。也是时候了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Finally, some competent administration. Any complaints can be filed in the usual bin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 称职的管理者终于上任了。有意见的人，可以把投诉信放到常用的那个收件箱里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Observe. This sector belongs to Parvos Granum first, to the Corpus Administration second, and to you not at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 请注意。这个星区首先是属于帕尔沃斯·格拉努的，其次是属于 Corpus 政府的，而与你毫不相关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: By the power vested in me by the true head of the Corpus, I claim this sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 通过 Corpus 真正的领导人赋予我的权力，这片星区是属于我的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Tread lightly in his dominion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 在他的领区内要轻声慢步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This place is no longer your concern.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这个地方不再需要你费心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Taken. Look elsewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 有主了。去看看其他地方吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Run along, scavenger. There are no scraps for you here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 快走吧，拾荒者。这里没有留给你的残羹剩饭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What Parvos grasps, the Sisterhood keeps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯掌控的，就是姐妹团所保有的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Here I am to perform my contractually-obligated butt-saving. Stand back pew pew whatever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我来了，来履行职责给你擦屁股了。靠后站，随便 piu-piu 两下就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: In trouble again, huh? It's a miracle you get anything done. Alright, who are we shooting?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哈，又遇到麻烦了？我都不知道你是怎么完成任何事的。好了，我们要对付谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Alright look, I'll help you out this one time, but you're buying lunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，这次我会帮你，但你得包饭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ok I'm here. Y'know, when I did this stuff for Parvos, there were incentives. You might wanna think about that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好的，我来了。你知道吗，当我为帕尔沃斯做这些事的时候，是有奖励的。你也可以考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Get away from them! All of you! YOU TAKE YOUR DIRTY HANDS OFF THEM RIGHT NOW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 给我离他们远点儿！你们所有人！别拿你们的脏手碰他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm here, darling. Don't you worry. I'm here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我来了，亲爱的。不必担心。我就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Let me take care of these no-good stinky verminks for you. Don't you tire yourself on their account.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 让我来帮你处理掉这些臭烘烘的弗鸣克吧。他们不值得你去劳神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well, I was on my usual patrol, and here you were - wasting your time with these no-account two-bit muck munchers - and, well, I just couldn't not stop by and help out the System's greatest warrior! And here I am!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嗯，我刚才在例行巡逻，却发现你在这里，跟这些无足轻重的垃圾消磨时间。唉，谁让我忍不住要来给星系里最伟大的战士帮忙呢！于是我就不请自到了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm here! I'm sorry I'm late! I had a thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我来了！对不起我来晚了！我刚刚有点事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I will prove my worth to you, so help me...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会向你证明我的价值，我发誓……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Boss. Looking forward to leveraging our strengths in this challenging combat experience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 头儿。真期待在这场极具挑战的战斗中大显身手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Here we go. This is what I signed up for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这就对了。这才是我加入的目的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I shall do penance through slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会通过杀戮来赎罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: We have parasites and looters to dispatch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我们需要遣散寄生虫和掠夺者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Assignment... accepted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 任务……已接受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This place shall be the abattoir of my shame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这个地方会成为我耻辱的屠宰场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well... this was totally worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧……这完全是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Y'know, I always thought when I went it'd be the usual way: my Sisters framing me in some elaborate plot... or... replacing my breakfast cereal... with... a landmine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你知道，我一直以为我的死法会像这样普通：我的姐妹们把我陷害在一个精心设计的阴谋里……或者……将我的谷物早餐……换成一颗地雷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Thiiiiiiis suuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuucks....
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这真糟糕……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am sorry my love. I got bamboozled. *erk*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 对不起，我的爱人。我受到了蛊惑。*纠结*

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Tricked... by dirty doodies. I feel such... a nincompoop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 被肮脏的人渣……所欺骗。我感觉自己就是……一个傻子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh no. I got all turned around by their flim-flam. On alone you must go. Farewell, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦不。他们的胡言乱语弄得我无所适从。你必须独自上路了。再见了，我的爱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm fine! I can do this! I can - ack...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我很好！我可以做到的！我可以——呃……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am a valued... team... member...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我可是一个有价值的……团队……成员……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Sorry, Boss. Think I might be dying. Yup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 对不起，老大。我想我可能快死了。没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Don't let them salvage my parts!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 别让他们扫荡我的尸体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There is no death while the blue fire burns...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 蓝焰熊熊燃起之际，死亡亦不会降临……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am... dying. Are you this careless with all your equipment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我……快死了。你对你所有的设备都是这么大大咧咧吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: OK done. Anything else? Great. Bye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好了，搞定。还有别的事吗？很好，拜拜啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Still alive? Great. One more reason for my Sisters to never speak to me again. Later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 还活着？很好。我的姐妹们又多了一个不再和我说话的理由。回见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Problem solved, you're green, I'm outta here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 问题解决，你安全了，我撤了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Alright. So, I got a thing. Call me, we'll do lunch, except don't and we won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好的。那个，我有点事。过会儿联系我，我们中午再见。不过还是不要吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh it was like music watching you spin and twirl through all those two-faced scum muffins. I consider it an honor to have been your dance partner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，看到你在那些虚伪的人渣之中，像音乐一般流畅旋转。我认为能成为你的舞伴是我的荣幸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There. All done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好了。都搞定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh! We did it, and you're alive and it was all because I came along at JUST the right time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢！我们做到了，你能活命全靠我及时赶过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There. Now, I must tell you. Enemies like those... those wormy waffles and side-talking snot snakes that you fight so often... well, well they're beneath you. And I'm glad that I came by so maybe you didn't have to anymore. There. I said it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好了。现在，我必须告诉你。那些敌人……比如那些你经常对付的蝼蚁和在背后突施冷箭的狡猾敌人……好吧，好吧，他们都略逊你一筹。我很高兴我的到来可以让你不必再去理会他们。好了。我说完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: All done here, boss!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 都搞定了，老大！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Job done. I look forward to receiving my performance assessment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 任务完成。我十分期待收到我的绩效评估。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: So, uh, now I'm all done with work, I was thinking we could... Oh, never mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 所以，呃，现在我的工作都做完了，我在想我们可以……噢，当我没说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Welp. Looks like I'm done here. Nothing else to stick around for. Unless... nah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 很好。看样子我搞定这里了。我应该可以走了。除非……没有除非。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I have repaid some measure of what I owe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我已经偿还了部分我所欠的债务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The work is done. The spoils are yours. I deserve... nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 结束了。战利品是你的。而我应得的……却一点都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: To serve is a joy. But alas, it must end for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 出手相助是一种乐趣。但遗憾的是，现在它必须要结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Enough. I have done what I could.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 够了。我已经尽我所能了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well, I just found the new background image for my datapad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，我刚刚为我的数据板找到了新的背景图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Aw, who folded up like a little ol' pressed flower?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，这是谁被折叠了起来，像一朵被压扁的残花？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'll just bet you've been waiting your whole life to screw up this bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我敢打赌，你这辈子都在等待着，来把事情搞得这么糟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I know you're probably upset about what just happened, so let me be the first to say it... I forgive you... Your Turn!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我知道你可能对刚刚所发生的事感到心烦意乱，所以让我先把它说出来吧……我原谅你了……轮到你了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: So I think we both learned something from that. Surprised you, didn't I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 所以我想我们都从中学到了某些东西。让你感到惊讶了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Look at you, bouncing back after a defeat! I think we're developing a healthy respect for one another!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 看看你，在一场失败后强势反弹！我想我们之间正在形成一种良性的相互尊重！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well look where those assumptions got you. And you know what they say about assumptions. They make an ass out of 'you'... and... '...mptions'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 看看你的那些假定最后带你到了什么地步。而你知道他们是怎么说的。这些"假定"，全都是假的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Doodies do what they do and then they're dead dead doo-doo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 烂人做烂事，然后死烂烂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Dirty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 真脏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Your pain has much to teach you. Listen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 听着，你能从你所受的痛苦中受益良多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Again and again, I cut you down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不知道是第几次了，我又一次击倒了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Sister Glarios named you well. Tenno rats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 格拉里斯姐妹给你起了个好名字。Tenno 耗子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Not interested. Read the room. Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 没兴趣。拜托你识相一点吧。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I don't think so. Until next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不这么认为。下次再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I literally will not be caught dead here. Leaving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 说真的，我不会就这样死在这里的。溜了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: UUUGH! You have NOT seen the LAST of ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 额——啊！你还没见识到我、的、厉、害！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Alright sweetie. You can have this one. We'll settle this another time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，亲爱的，这次就让你赢了。我们另外找个时间再来解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Must you rip the wings from all the angels?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你一定要扯下所有天使的翅膀吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, not this chicken, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，我可不会就这样死掉，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, I am not at home to Mister Defeat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，我可不会被就此打败！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You should apologize to your mother... for the dirty girty you turned out to be!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 看看你成为了多么肮脏的家伙……你应跟你的母亲道歉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: How COULD you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你怎、么、能、这样？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, we're not done. We are a LONG WAY from done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，我跟你还没完呢。还有很长很长的路要走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This altercation is over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这场争执结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm going to my happy place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我要回我的快乐小窝了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ha! NOT today!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哈！今天没戏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Get me out of here! I said, GET ME OUUUUT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 带我离开这里！我说，快、带、我、离、开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Should have finished me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你该杀死我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Add another failed assassination to its record.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 又一次失败的刺杀被记录在案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Next time I'll see that coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 下次，我一定会做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Not good enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我做得还不够好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Careless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我太粗心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well, look who decided to take a dip in beautiful Lake Moron.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，看看是谁打算一头扎进美丽的白痴之湖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Y'know, when a smart person is on their deathbed... they find another bed. But not you. Ooooh no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你知道，一个聪明的人在临死之时……会找出死里逃生的方法。但你可做不到。哦，不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What were you thinking? The inside of your head must be nothing but strobe lights and circus music.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你是怎么想的？除了闪光灯和马戏团音乐，你的脑子里肯定就啥都不剩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Aw. Sad. You get one life and spend it doing everything wrong. Tsk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢。悲哀啊。你只有一条命，而你却用它来搞砸每一件事情。啧啧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Now lie still. This is for the best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 现在就躺着别动了。这是你最好的下场了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I warned you. I warned you... and I warned you... and I warned you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我警告过你的。我警告过你的……我警告过你的……我警告过你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Why is it always the best in this world who are obliged to do the ugliest of things? I'm sorry it's come to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 为什么这个世界上最厉害的家伙总得去做最丑陋的事？我很遗憾事情发展到这一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well. We thought quite a lot of ourselves, didn't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧。我们高估了自身的实力，难道不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Sorry, didn't quite catch that, could you repeat? 'Flaily flaily bleed bleed'? Ah, thought so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不好意思，我不是很明白，你能再重复一次吗？"垂死挣扎，血流不止"？啊，我就知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh no, no, you're getting blood and bits of yourself all over the place. Do you have to?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦不，不。你把身上的血滴得到处都是。你非得这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You know, I don't think that armor's quite up to snuff. Might want to report that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你知道吗，我觉得这套护甲不合格啊。也许你应该举报它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Be a good Tenno and give the floor a clean while you're down there, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 乖乖的，Tenno。你被击倒的时候顺便擦个地板，行吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Stay down. It's over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 别挣扎了。一切都结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Inferior equipment, inferior results.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 低劣的装备，导致了低劣的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Every heartbeat feels precious now, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 将死之际，每一下心跳都显得弥足珍贵，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Parvos severed his own hand without fear. This thing clings to life like an infant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯曾毫无畏惧地斩下自己的手。而这家伙却只会像婴儿一样挣扎求生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You murdered me. But now I have that whole 'harness the power of lightning' thing, so it's not all bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你谋害了我。但现在我可以完全"利用闪电的力量"，所以这也不都是坏事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, I am operating at charge levels way above the recommended safe rate!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，我正在操作的电击水平远远高于推荐的安全功率！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: It's not good manners to let a girl dance alone. Once I zap you real good? You'll dance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 让一个女孩独自起舞是很没品的举止。一旦我对你来一发真正的电击？那你就会翩然起舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I will lift you up by the head. The current will flow. And you will dance for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会扼住你的脑袋，让你脱离地面。电流会穿过你的身体。然后你就会为我翩翩起舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I was stunning before. I admit it. But now I'm a whole different kind of hot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我以前很惊艳。我承认这点。但是现在，我具备了一种全然不同的热辣气息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I wonder what happens when you get hot. Does stuff start bubbling up through your armor plates? Can we find out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我想知道当你变得"惹火"的时候会发生什么。你的护甲底下会有东西被融化，然后开始冒泡吗？我们能试试看吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: From you I took fire. Nothing makes me happier than burning away anyone who might want to harm Mister Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我从你那里得到了火。没有什么比烧掉任何可能想伤害帕尔沃斯先生的人，更让我高兴的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What will you become when the fire consumes you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 当大火吞噬了你，你会变成什么样子？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm getting a reputation for giving people the cold shoulder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我以待人冷漠闻名于众。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Funny things, fingers. Get them cold enough, and they just snap right off. Like fish sticks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 手指，可有趣了。把它们冻得足够冷，然后它们就会断掉。像鱼竿那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You were a cool customer. Well then, Mister Parvos said, why not take that from them... and return the turn in kind? That Mister Parvos, he's so *clever*.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你曾是个很冷静的家伙。那么好吧，帕尔沃斯先生说："为什么不从他们那夺走……然后再好好报答他们呢？"，不愧是帕尔沃斯先生，他真、睿、智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am cold. Endless numbing cold. When your neck finally snaps, you will not even feel it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我即严寒。无尽的寒冷麻木。当你的脖子折断了，你甚至都感觉不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: So you can slap. I slap harder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你可以扇我耳光，而我会加倍奉还。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh I learned to take a hit long before I met you. Learned how to give one, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，我在遇到你很久之前就被人揍过。我也学会了怎么报复他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Did you ever sit alone in the office with a plasmic hole punch, just punching holes in other people's things? Over and over?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 当你独自一人坐在办公室里，手上又正好有一个离子打孔机。这时的你，会不会百无聊赖地往别人的东西上打孔？而且一动手就停不下来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You killed a weakling. Now you face a Sister of Parvos, and she will pound your face into the dirt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你杀害了一个嬴弱的人。现在你面对的是帕尔沃斯的姐妹，她会把你的脸捣进泥土里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Crank those shields all you want, it won't make any difference to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那些护盾随便你去摇动，这对我不会有任何影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I can make your shields collapse like the Brogen-Steiff derivatives bubble! You don't even know what that IS, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我能让你的护盾像博艮—死代夫衍生的泡沫那样破裂！你甚至不知道那是什么，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm back, and mad enough to smash right through every shield you have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我回来了，并且我现在疯狂到足以砸碎你的每一层护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Do not place your faith in shields to protect you. Turn to Parvos - if you have the wit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不要奢望护盾能保护你。投入帕尔沃斯的怀抱吧——如果你够明智的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Here's what gonna happen. We're gonna fight, you'll try to outsmart me, I'll flood you with a TON of radiation and watch you die from some kind of catastrophic metastasis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这就是待会要发生的。我们会进行战斗，你会想着怎样出奇制胜，而我会用大量辐射把你淹没，然后看着你死于某种灾难性的癌转移。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: How do I achieve this beautiful glow? Simple. Every day I affirm the truth of Parvos's teachings in my heart. And I'm suffused with radioactivity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我是怎么获得这样美丽的光芒的？很简单。我每天都在心中肯定帕尔沃斯教义的真谛。并且我现在还充满了放射性！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm back. You're part of me now, and me a part of you. I'm in you, like radiation, you can't get away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我回来了。现在我中有你，你中有我。我就在你的躯体里，像辐射那样，你无法摆脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm afraid there is no defense against radiation. Soon your own cells will begin to devour one another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 恐怕没有什么措施能抵御辐射。你的细胞很快就会开始互相吞噬了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm not entirely sure what *kind* of poison this is but I did make one guy throw up so hard he pretty much inverted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不是很确定这是*怎样*的毒药，但我确实让某个家伙呕吐得很严重，他整个人几乎都颠倒了过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You realize I'm literally toxic now? I can make you foam and see pretty colours while you die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你意识到我现在是真的具有毒性了吧？我可以让你死的时候口吐白沫，并看到五颜六色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Gonna slip you an oogie. Make you real green around the gills. Just you see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会悄悄给你下毒。让你面如菜色。等着瞧吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Venom will melt you from the inside out. Enjoy the taste of your brains dripping onto your tongue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 剧毒会从内到外地融化你。好好享受你的脑汁滴在舌头上的滋味吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I could make a better opponent by stuffing Clem's pajamas with rags.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我可以把破布料塞进 Clem 的睡衣，以此打造一个更好的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm not sure what's wrong with you, but it's getting worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不确定你的毛病是什么，但它变得越来越糟了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're about as convincing as someone who stars in their own commercials.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你的说服力就和那些为自己代言的人一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Whew. I'm going to need some alone time to think on Mister Parvos and make peace with what I've done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哎。我需要一个人静下来想想帕尔沃斯先生，并接受我所做过的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, I'm sorry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，真是对不起呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You didn't think I'd do it, but I did it. I DID IT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你没想到我会这么做吧，可我就是这么做了。我、做、了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Is... is it dead? It's dead! It's over. Oh, thank blessed Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那玩意死……死了？死了！结束了，哦，感谢帕尔沃斯保佑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Job done. Ticky box. Call a cleaning drone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 搞定。勾掉一个待办事项。呼叫一台清洁无人机过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I think we both knew how this was going to end, didn't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 咱们都知道这场战斗的结局，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Salvage what you can from it. But keep the head intact. We shall find a buyer without Maroo's scruples.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 能回收多少就回收多少吧。不过务必要把头部完整保留下来。我们会找来一个不像 Maroo 那么矫情的买家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: It's down. Disassemble the remains. Usual split.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 它倒下了。进行肢解吧。再按照往常那么分配。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hm. Not as satisfying as my Sisters had led me to expect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哼。根本不像我的姐妹们告诉我的那么爽快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Want some advice? This sucks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 要来点建议吗？这太糟糕了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ha ha yeah, you're about as funny as a broken ankle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哈哈，是的，你差不多和一只骨折的脚踝一样滑稽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I know: me asking for mercy is totally hypocritical, and I hate hypocrites. But I am one, so I'm okay with that. Don't kill me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我知道：我请求怜悯是完全虚伪的行为，我讨厌虚伪的人。但我自己就是，所以我不介意这样做。不要杀我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well, this is humiliating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，这太丢人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You are a bad, bad person!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你真是个大、坏、人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well, this sucks rocks through three miles of bent pipe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，这真是糟糕透顶极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Nothing... nothing stays dead... around... Mister Parvos... that he doesn't want... to stay dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 没有……没有任何东西……能在帕尔沃斯先生不想其……保持死状的时候，维持死亡的状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Why would you be... so mean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你为什么会……这么卑鄙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Time out! Time out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 等一下！等一下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Wait. Wait. Stop. I'm going to throw up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 等等。等一下。停下。我要吐了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're cheating. You've got to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你作弊了。肯定作了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What if you kill me, and I just come back even more powerful? Is that what you want? IS IT?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 如果你杀了我，而我却以更强大的姿态归来了，你该怎么办？那是你想要的吗？是、吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: That taste. Blood and metal. I remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这个味道。血液混合着金属。我记得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: We are the Sisters of Parvos. We are deathless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我们是帕尔沃斯的姐妹。我们不死不灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: We'll be done when I say we're done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 当我说该了结了，我们之间就会做个了结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Come closer. I have broken teeth to spit at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 过来点。我要吐你一脸碎牙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Grineer... GRINEER. Oh buddies, you and me, we have a score to settle. DIE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Grineer……GRINEER。哦哥们，你和我，我们还有一些账要算。死吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Forget the Tenno! Grineer! KILL THE GRINEER!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 别管 Tenno！Grineer！杀、了、GRINEER！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh Grineer. Tatty tin fakemen is what I call them. Copies of copies of copies of a real person. Not even ghosts. Putting them down... well... it's a duty. And one I need to attend to. Excuse me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，Grineer。我称其为废物假人。他们是真人的复制体的复制体的复制体。连幽灵都算不上。消灭他们……呃……是一项义务。而且是我要优先解决的事情。恕我失陪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Grineer. Tatty little tin fakemen. Herky-jerking fun-making of what a real person is supposed to be! Gotta put you down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Grineer。废物小假人。这是对真正人类的拙劣仿制！我要消灭你们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ooh. Someone's sent me some tubemen for taaaarget praaaactice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，有人给我送了一些克隆人来练——手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Just a moment, Tenno. Some Grineer has got in, and this Sister of Parvos needs to take out the trash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Tenno，稍等片刻。有群 Grineer 进来了，所以这位帕尔沃斯的姐妹要去清理下垃圾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Detecting... Grineer! Engaging Grineer. Eliminating Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 侦测到……Grineer！与 Grineer 交战。歼灭 Grineer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Defective Grineer clones detected. Terminating. Invoice the Queens... for the service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 探测到有缺陷的 Grineer 克隆体。立即执行灭杀任务。至于开销费用嘛……就去问双子女皇们要吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Curse my hereditary inner ear imbalance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我这该死的遗传性内耳失衡！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, that's how you want to play it? Fine. Gloves off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，你想这么玩？好啊。那我就不客气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What kind of person tips a lady over?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 什么样的人竟会把女士击倒在地？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Knocking a lady over? That's dirty pool, you dirty doodie! DIRTY POOL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 打趴一位女士？这是犯规，你这个卑鄙的人渣！犯规！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hmph. Gravity test complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嗯。重力测试完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Come on. Push me over again. I'm having FUN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 来吧。再推我一次。我玩得很开心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You shall not do that again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你不要再这样做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Cheap. Recalibrating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 真够卑鄙的。重新校准中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm not here to play hide-and-seek, ya loser. Besides, I can smell you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不是来这儿玩捉迷藏的，你这个废物。况且，我能闻到你的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You know I can smell you right? So stop playing cute and come out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你知道我能闻到你的味道吧？所以别再装可怜了，出来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well well mmm. Don't you just smell sweet as pie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧好吧，嗯。你闻起来像馅饼一样甜，不是吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh no no *no*. You may hide from my eyes but you can't hide from my twitching little sniffer. Smell you from anywhere, I would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦不不*不*。或许你可以逃脱我的双眼，但你无法逃脱我那不停抖动的小鼻子。无论你逃到何处，我都会嗅出你的踪迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Mmm. You're more than usually pungent today, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哼。Tenno，你今天可比平时更刺鼻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh dear, Tenno. What have you been rolling in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦亲爱的，Tenno。你这是在哪摔的呀？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: It thinks it's invisible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 它自认为别人看不见它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: That idle dodge won't work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 懒洋洋的躲闪是不会奏效的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, come on. One-on-one? That's hardly fair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，得了吧。一对一？那不公平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Sure, I'll fight you one-on-one... if I'd left my brain in the closet. Not a chance, buddy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 当然，我会和你一对一决斗……如果我把脑子落在了家里的话。没机会的，兄弟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well. I can see I am clearly in over my little old head. So, if you'll excuse ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 呃。我现在意识到，我有点高估自己了。所以，请恕我先失陪了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Now I may be brave but I am not stupid. A lady has to know her limitations and so I bid you a very good day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我或许算得上勇敢，但我不是傻子。身为一位淑女，自然要认清自己的极限。因此，我郑重地与你道别。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm sorry this is a completely inappropriate mismatch of power levels, and I am therefore leaving immediately. Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 很抱歉，这是场能力相差悬殊的较量，我得马上撤退。告辞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: ... ah. It appears I am severely under-equipped for this assignment. Terminating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: ……啊。看来我的装备难以应对这项作业。正在终止作业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You thought to stack the deck in your favor? I am not stupid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你这是打算用卑鄙的手段占上风？我可不傻。
