/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: If I walked into so obvious a trap, Parvos would spit on me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 如果我中了这么明显的陷阱，肯定会遭到帕尔沃斯的唾弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: That was my best Eximus! Falling back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那是我最棒的卓越者！撤退！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The Eximus is down! Regroup!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 卓越者倒下了！重振队列！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Physical conflict is not something at which I excel. So, if you'll excuse me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我并不擅长这种真刀真枪的战斗方式。所以，我先失陪了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You... you killed my *Eximus*? HOW COULD YOU? Come on home, baby. Let Momma make it better. YOU MONSTER!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你……你杀了我的*卓越者*？你还真下得了手啊？回家吧，宝贝。妈妈会好好照顾你的。这家伙真是人面兽心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Vandalizing company property, is it? I'm leaving! To... file a report.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这是在肆意破坏公司财产？我走了！去……去举报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Impressive. I'm just going to pop off and update your file. Don't wait up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 真不错。我这就去给你更新档案。不用等我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I have been incompetently briefed regarding the Tenno's ability! Mission aborted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 在我事前得到的情报里，有关 Tenno 能力的部分还不够完善！任务中止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The dossier was in error. Target has destroyed an Eximus. Retreating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 档案描述有误。目标已经摧毁了一个卓越者。我这就撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well, you cleared those goobs out pretty quick. How about we talk about this? Like adults?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，你把这些蠢货清除得真快。要不我们好好的商量一下？就像大人一样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Look. I don't have any beef with you. Not really. This was all Parvos' idea. You and me we're just caught in the middle. Let's talk this out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你看。我和你之间并没有过节。真的没有。这全是帕尔沃斯的主意。你和我只是刚好被夹在中间。让我们好好谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Mister Parvos gave me all those shiny men. Now you broke them. Oh no. Oh no oh no oh no he's gonna be so mad. HE'S GONNA BE SO MAD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯先生把那些崭新的部下交给了我。而你却把他们都弄坏了。噢，糟糕。噢，糟了糟了糟了，他肯定会生气的，而且会气得火冒三丈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Nonono. This wasn't how it was supposed to go. I was supposed to lay you low with my army of his Shining Hand and... and... and now it's all RUINED.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不不不。事情不该是这样的。按照计划，他那闪耀之手所创造出的军队会在我的带领下将你击溃……可现在，一切都毁了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I could really use some colleague support here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我现在真的很需要一些同胞的支持！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: No. This is wrong. This was NOT a solo assignment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不。这不对。这不、该、是一个单人任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I refuse to fight undefended!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我拒绝在没有护卫的情况下战斗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You leave me for last, like some unappetizing morsel? No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你这是把我当成了不爱吃的菜，所以才留到了最后？我不允许你这么对待我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Okay. There was nothing in the mission brief about kids being here. RUN! RUUUN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧。任务简介中没有提到过这里有小孩的信息。跑！跑、啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Is... is that... a child? Oh no. Oh nonono. AGH! AAAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这……这是……一个小孩？哦不。哦不不不。啊。啊啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Children are like people not left in the oven for long enough and the way they look at me all clear-eyed like the Void itself is looking back at me and saying 'I come for you, in time, I come for you and take you into the nothing so that you become nothing and...'!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 小孩子就像那些被放进烤箱但还没被烤熟的人一样。他们注视我的眼神，是那么的清澈，就好像虚空对我回眸，并诉说着"我来找你了，总有一天，我会找到你，将你带入虚无之中，让你也成为虚无……"！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Children. No. All wrong and supple-limbed and moving like water. Wrong wrong wrong!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 孩子。不，全都错了，肢体柔软得像水一般挥动。完全是错上加错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I can't deal with children! I'm not certified!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不能和孩子们打交道！我没有资格证啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Child. CHILD. I will NOT have mucky little fingerprints all over my screens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 孩子。孩、子。我不会让这些肮脏的小指纹留在我的屏幕上的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Don't make me look at children. Not after what I did. I can't bear it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不要让我去看孩子。特别是在我做了那些事之后。我受不了这样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The child. It's here again. Whispering. Staring at me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那个孩子。又到了这里。嘴里低吟着。眼睛注视着我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh Void. So high. I'm gonna be sick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，虚空啊。这么高。我要吐了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Whoa. We are... REALLY... high up. Everything's spinning. Whoa. WHOA.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哇哦。我们……真的……高高在上。一切都在旋转。哇哦。哇、哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Wha... what am I meant to do all the way up here with the hard hard ground staring at me like it wants to squash me flat? Flap my arms like a little birdie? I gotta go. I gotta go I say!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 所以……所以我一路爬上来，让坚硬的地面从下往上注视着我，好像它要把我压扁一般，是要干什么？像小鸟拍打翅膀一样挥舞我的手臂？我得走了。我是说，我得走了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Now there is a right place and a wrong place for each thing to be. And things without feathers are not meant to be this... *far*... from the good old ground. Nossir. Nossir THEY ARE NOT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 现在，每件事物都有一个正确的所在之处和一个错误的所在之处。而没有羽毛的事物是不应该像这样……*远离*……美好的地面。不。不。他们不应该这样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Nausea meds! No, these are bullets. Where are my nausea meds?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 晕船药！不，这些是子弹。我晕船药去哪了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: This drop is NOT SAFE. Where is the damn HANDRAIL?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这样落下不、安、全！该死的栏杆在哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: No. I can't. It's too far to fall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不。我做不到。从这高度掉下去会要了我的命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Too high. Too high! Nothing to hang on to! Send an Osprey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 太高了。太高了！没有地方可以让我抓牢！派一架鱼鹰过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hey, back off, you mutt. Hey. Hey hey hey! AAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嘿，退下，你这个杂种狗。嘿。嘿嘿嘿！啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: KUBROW! Keep it away from me! KEEP IT AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 库狛！快把它从我这弄走！快、弄、走、它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am no meat treat for no devil-eyed dirty dog! You keep that wrong one away and maybe I... I won't have to do what I don't wanna do! You hear me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不是被用来饲喂那只恶魔眼脏狗的肉食！你把它给我赶远点，那样或许我……我就不必违心出手了！你好好听我说！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Eyes and hair and fangs all a-red. I know you, devil dog. I have been in those jaws before. You will not have me again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 眼睛、毛发和獠牙全是一片红色。我认得你，恶魔的狗。我曾吃过它们的苦头。但我不会再次中招的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Not Kubrows. Please. Their little eyes and their squashed-up faces. Oh, I don't want that to be the last thing I see!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不要库狛。拜托不要。它们的小眼睛和扭曲的脸。噢，我不想这是我最后看到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Calm. Just imagine it gutted, and skinned, and spread out on the office floor. No. No, it's looking at me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 淡定。只要想象一下它被去了内脏、剥了皮之后摊开在办公室的地板上。不。不，它在看着我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Get that thing away from me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 让那玩意离我远点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Kubrow confirmed. Kubrow confirmed. Retreating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 已确认是库狛。已确认是库狛。正在撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ugh. Gross. *Nature.*  Agh! So... itchy....!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 呃。恶心。*大自然。* 啊！好……痒……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Bugs! Bugs everywhere! Agh! AGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 虫子！到处都是虫子！啊！啊！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: *sneezes* *sneezes* Oh, this... this place is *sneezes* playing merry hell with my allergies. *sneezes*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: *打喷嚏* *打喷嚏* 噢，这……这该死的地方 *打喷嚏* 加重了我的过敏。*打喷嚏*

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Things should be clean and just so. But... *sneezes* this place... *sneezes* this place is all DIRT. *sneezes*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 一切事物应该是干净的。但……*打喷嚏*这地方……*打喷嚏*这地方到处都是尘土。*打喷嚏*

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Bugs! They're inside me! Crawling in my tuuuubing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 虫子！它们在我里面！在我的管管管子里爬行！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What is the POINT of still having organic parts if they're just going to break out in hives?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 如果有机部位只会起麻疹的话，那留着它们还有什么用？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am not optimized for this primitive environment!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我没有为这种原始环境进行过优化！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am unclean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不洁净了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: How... how can you people work like this? In space. How can you not feel... small. Insignificant. Like... like you're nothing. Agh! AAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 怎么能……你们怎么能这样工作？在太空。你们怎么会感觉不到……渺小、微不足道呢？就像……就像是你什么都不是的感觉。啊！啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Was... did we just puncture something? Are we venting atmo? Are we depressurizing? I don't wanna get spaced!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 是……我们刚刚是刺穿了什么东西吗？我们的空气是在外泄吗？我们这是在减压吗？我可不想被吸进太空里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Floating through the infinite inside a tin-thin doohickey just isn't right! It's wrong! It's wrong wrong wrong and I gotta go go go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 身处一个薄锡小玩意内，并在无尽空间中漂浮不定，这是完全不对的！这是错误的！错误，错误，错误的，我该走了，走了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Someone who's a little something sure does feel like no-one floating in the middle of all this nothing. I gotta skidaddle!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 在这团虚无缥缈中漂浮不定，一个稍微正常点的人肯定会感受到自己是多么微不足道。我得马上溜了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The vacuum of space is out there. I am in here. It cannot suck my eyeballs out. But... what if it did?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 真空的太空在外面。而我在这里。它无法吸掉我的眼球。但是……如果它能呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Why is space so QUIET? It makes me think I can hear... things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 为什么太空这么安、静？这样下去我要……幻听了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I can feel it. The cold. The endless cold. The blue fire is dying. Dying in the black.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我能感受到它。寒冷。无止境的寒冷。蓝焰正在消亡。消亡在黑暗中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Space. So close. What if it claims me? What if I drift... forever... in the black... still conscious... unable to die?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 太空。如此之近。如果它想吞噬我该怎么办？如果我永远……漂流……在黑暗中……仍然具有意识……却又无法死亡该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, thank Parvos. I was prepared to go up against a Warframe, but kids? I can totally beat up a kid. C'mere ya little squealer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，谢谢帕尔沃斯。我本来准备好和一个战甲对抗的，不过孩子？我完全可以打败一个孩子。过来吧你这个小尖叫鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Cute. The kids are playing soldier. C'mon then ya little punk. Let's play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 真可爱。孩子们在装士兵。那就来吧，小屁孩。我们一起来玩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh you sneaky faker child! Don't look at me, you knowing-eyed little BRAT! You got secrets, we all got secrets. I don't NEED your secrets! I just need you to STOP LOOKING AT ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，你这个鬼鬼祟祟的假小孩！别看着我，你这个什么都能看透的小屁孩！你有秘密，我们都有秘密。我不需要你的秘密！我只需要你别再看着我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: A child?! A child raises its sticky little grasper to me? Without so much as a how-do-you-do, without a shred of respect. You respect your elders, you hear my words! You tiny little half-person child-thing! You RESPECT. YOUR. ELDERS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 一个孩子？一个孩子向我举起他那粘乎乎的小抓手？连一句"你好吗"都没有，没有一丝尊重。你要尊重你的长辈，你听到我说的了吧！你这个还不能完全算是个人的小孩子玩意！你要尊重。你的。长辈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Is it 'bring your disgusting spawn to work' day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 今天是"带你恶心的小崽子来上班"的日子吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There is a child running about here. We'll have to fumigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 有个小孩老在这跑来跑去的。我们得烟熏消毒一下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Human infant. Waste of resources. Cull it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 人类的婴儿。资源的浪费。宰了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Child. Consumes valuable food, produces only noise and stench. Expendable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 孩子。消耗宝贵的食物，只产生噪音和臭味。他们可以被牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Infested? Gross! GROSS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Infested？恶心！恶、心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ew! Infested! Killitkillitkillitkillit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 咦惹！Infested！杀了它杀了它杀了它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'll get right back to you, but first I need to exterminate this dirty no-good Infested filth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会再来找你的，但是首先我需要消灭这肮脏无用的 Infested。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Infested. All bubbling and roiling and wrong. Help a girl clean this up. We can get back to killing each other soon enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Infested。一群沸腾冒泡的恶毒生物。来帮本姑娘把这些玩意儿清理干净吧。这样我们就能早点开始相互厮杀了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, that is just gross. It's got to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哇哦，那可太恶心了。一定要消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: We've got Infestation! Putrid, scabby masses of... ugh. Clean it all out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 是感染者！一群腐烂生疮的……啊。全部消灭它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Shifting target. These infested mistakes have priority.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 更换目标。优先对付这些感染变异体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Mindless Infested hunger. An insult to the refined desire of Parvos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这些愚昧无知的 Infested 饿鬼。其存在就是对帕尔沃斯高雅品味的亵渎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I really should just kick your ass, but I'm absolutely starving. Hang five.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 要不是我快饿死了，我肯定会给你点颜色瞧瞧。等我一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Gonna a take a mo' to grab a few calories...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我得花些时间补充点卡路里了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Back in the Corpus mess - that fine old place - Mister Parvos feeds us well. I do right by him by making sure I get my three squares.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 话说当时在 Corpus 食堂——那个美好的老地方的时候，帕尔沃斯先生把我们养得好极了。我每天都有好好吃饭，来报答他的恩情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: OK boys, you keep our guest busy while I get a few calories to strong on up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好了，孩儿们。在我获取些许能量的时候，好好陪我们的客人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Sorry! Skipped breakfast. You know how it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 抱歉！我没吃早餐。你知道那感觉的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Deploying tactical reserve sandwich.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 正在部署战术储备三明治。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: A moment. I have a bone to gnaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 等一下。我还有块骨头要啃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I feed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我要开吃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Hey. That critter over there has a pelt that would pair perfectly with a teal Virmink ammo belt. Sorry, can't pass this up. Be right back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嘿。那只小动物身上的毛皮，可以和一条青绿色的弗鸣克弹药带完美搭配。对不起，我不能放你走。马上回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Take five. Spotted a cute little something I can use to line a battle vest. Hey little fella. C'mere. Mama wants to turn you into a snood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 休息一会。发现了个可爱的小东西，我可以用它来做背心的衬里。嘿，小家伙。快来让妈妈用你织些小玩意儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well now. I spy with my little eye a critter that would make the finest of gifts for Mister Parvos. Once appropriately stuffed and mounted. Come here little fella.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 很好。我用我的小眼睛看到了一个小动物，它非常适合作为礼物送给帕尔沃斯先生。不过先要把它填充好，做成标本。快过来吧，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well how do you do my four-legged little friend! I'm going to take a moment to measure you up for a rug. Hey! Come back here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嗯，这位四条腿的小伙伴，你还好吗？我要花点时间测量一下你的尺寸，这样才能制作出一块合适的皮草地毯。喂！快回来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ugh, this place is crawling with wildlife! Do I have to clean it up myself?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 呃，这里到处爬满了野生动物！我要自己清理这儿吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There's my new desk ornament! Just need to make it a little... more... dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我新的桌面装饰就在那！但是得先……把它……弄死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Local lifeform. Possible covert surveillance device. Exterminating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 本地生物。可能是由监控设备伪装的。执行歼灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Weapons test. Selecting unimportant local lifeform. That will do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 武器测试。选择一个不重要的本地生物。就那个吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ah, I didn't need those losers anyway! RAAARGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嗯，反正我也不需要那些废物！额——啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: If you think I need backup to take you down, you're more delusional than I thought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 如果你以为我需要后援来打败你，那么你比我想象中的要更痴心妄想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: They're all gone. Good. I don't like sharing my meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 他们都死了。很好。我可不喜欢分享我的肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: So all my men are dead now. They were just getting between me and you, darling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 看来我的人全都死了。亲爱的，他们只会是你我之间的妨碍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Seeya, losers. I'll handle this by myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 再见，废物们。我会自己搞定的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'll just have to put on my big pants and handle this personally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会成熟起来并亲自处理的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Team eliminated. Retaliating. Full offense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 队伍被歼灭。开始反击。火力全开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: They are dead. I am not. Now you will learn why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 他们都死了。但我没有。现在，你将会明白这其中的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: BOOM! That's what you get if I think you're not giving one-hundred-and-ten-percent when it comes to protecting ME! Anyone else feeling hesitant? No? Then get back to work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嘭！如果我认为你在保护我的时候没有付出百分之一百的努力，这就是你的下场！还有人犹豫不决吗？没有？那就回去工作！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: POW! And let that be a lesson to the rest of ya! If I hear any of ya questioning my orders, you're Kubrow food. Now face forward and keep firing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 嘭！给剩下的人一个教训！如果我听到有人质疑我的要求，那他就会成为库狛的盘中餐。现在面向前方，继续开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I know you know. Don't think... don't think I don't know... that you know. Yeah. You know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我知道你知道的。别以为……别以为我不知道……你知道的。是的。你知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh I get it. I see now. This was all a trap. A trick. A big old flashy fake. All of you. All of you in on it. To get me here. Well. It ain't gonna work. NO SIR.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，我明白了。我现在全明白了。这一切都是一个陷阱。一个骗局。一个老套又华而不实的大假象。你们所有人。你们所有人都身处其中。就是为了把我带到这里。好吧。这是不会奏效的。绝对不会的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I see you. Passing notes. Whispering. Do you think I'm STUPID?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我都看见你了。在传小纸条。还交头接耳。你以为我是大傻子吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Guess what, staff? It's time for a random loyalty test. Anyone still alive after this has passed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 各位，你猜怎么着？是时候进行一次随机忠诚度测试了。只要在事成之后还活着就算通过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You fools were not chosen! Only I was chosen! OFFAL! WASTE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你们这些傻瓜没有被选中！只有我被选中了！下脚料！废物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Parvos whispers, and I hear. 'Execute the traitors. Every one.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯的低吟，我听到了。"处决叛徒。不放过任何一个。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Fire fire burning bright, I'm gonna set your hair alight. Or whatever you have that passes for hair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 熊熊火焰燃烧，把你头发烤焦。或者你头上算是头发的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: What I like most about fire... is that it takes whatever's bothering a girl... and makes it like it never existed...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我最喜欢火焰的一点是……它能带走任何困扰女孩的东西……并抹去一切痕迹……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The thing I like the bestest-best about fire? It doesn't lie. It is what it is, does what it does, please and thank-you. Just like me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我最最喜欢火焰的哪一点？它不会说谎。它就是它自己，做它该做的事，说"请"和"谢谢你"。就像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Doesn't life just look merry as you please in front of a big ol' rip-roaring fire? Well, only if you're not in it, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 面对一大团熊熊燃烧的火焰，生活看起来充满了乐趣，难道不是吗？好吧，我想前提是你没有置身其中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Burrrn. Burn it all. Burn it like I burned my dream journals!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 烧！全部烧掉。就像我烧了我的梦境日记一样烧了它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I can hear Parvos speaking to me from the flames. And he tells me I am worthy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我能听到帕尔沃斯在火里和我说话。他告诉我我是有价值的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Got a fire. But it could be bigger. Brighter! Like the BLUE FIRE IN MY BLOOD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 生起一团火了。但它可以更旺一些。更亮一些！就像我血液中的蓝焰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Your idleness is sickening. Let us see if fire spurs you to action.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你的懒惰真令人作呕。让我们看看火焰的刺激是否能让你动起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Whatever you CLAIM your reasons for wanting to stop me are, I KNOW you're just jealous. Look at this face. Anyone would be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 无论你有什么样的理由想要阻止我，我知道你就是嫉妒。看看这张脸。任何人都想要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm the ideal mix of style and substance, baby. And you just want to destroy what you can't have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我是理想和实体的完美结合，宝贝。而你只想毁掉你得不到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Such fine work Mister Parvos did. Behold the glorious product of his glad hand. Behold my *beauty*.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯先生的技艺是如此精妙。见证吧，这就是出自他那崇高之手的杰出作品。见证吧，这就是我的*绝世之美*。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I was ugly. But now I'm pretty. The prettiest of the pretty. The belle of the ball.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我曾经很丑。但我现在很漂亮。堪称绝世美女，舞会女神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Damn. I look gooood in blue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 该死。我穿蓝的可真好看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Nothing wrong with wearing your wealth, Tenno, and my enhancements are mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: Tenno，你完全可以把值钱的家当都穿在身上，而我的家当就是我的强化装备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The blue fire burned away any imperfections I might have had.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 蓝色的火焰，将我曾经的缺陷，尽数烧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Parvos chose me. And he chose well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 帕尔沃斯选择了我。这是一个明智的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: My Sisters don't like me that much. Because I get things done. You're next on my list.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我的姐妹们并不是那么喜欢我。因为我能把事情搞定。你是我名单中的下一位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You don't really think you can beat me, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你不会真的认为你能打败我吧， 是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ah. The Lout of the Lotus. Is today the day you push your luck just a little too far?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 啊。Lotus 的陋者。今天就是你走背运的日子吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I *like* you! I have the most fun with idiots and mean people and you're both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我 *喜欢* 你！我最喜欢跟白痴和小气鬼一块玩，你两个都占了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Well, you tried killing me and look how that turned out. I guess you just weren't the right tool for the job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧，你试图杀死我，但看看这样做的结果是什么。我想只不过你不是能胜任这份工作的料吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Get me numbers on the most humiliating ways to murder Tenno. Top 5. Wait you're not my assistant. *STATIC*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 告诉我有哪些最羞辱的方式来谋杀 Tenno。给出前五种。等等，你不是我的助手。*静止*

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You think anyone can be a Sister of Parvos? Uh uh. No. Only the best of the best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你以为什么人都能成为帕尔沃斯的姐妹吗？呃，呃，不是的，只有佼佼者中的佼佼者才可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Do you ever clean this squalid little ship?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你有没有打扫过这艘肮脏的小破飞船？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Idle. That's what Parvos would call your sort. Expect everything to be handed to you on a plate. Those days are over, bucko.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 懒汉。这就是帕尔沃斯对你这种人的称呼。期待着所有一切都摆放在盘子里被人端给你。那样的日子已经结束了，伙计。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Ready for another round of relentless persecution? I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 准备好接受又一轮残酷无情的迫害了吗？我准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I love my work. You envy me, I know. And that's okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我爱我的所作所为。我知道你羡慕嫉妒我，而这没关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're really not the kind of person who itemises their storage, are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你真的不是那种会逐项整理存储空间中物品的人，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Shall we schedule a meeting soon? Maybe one of those fun informal ones where one of us DIES?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我们是否应该尽快安排一次会议？也许是那种有趣的非正式会议，比如我们中的某个人会在会议中死去?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I tell my problems to my diary. Maybe you could do that too? When you're not being used as a whimpering human pillow by the largest and most diseased of the felons I'm gonna lock you in a basement with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会向日记诉说我的问题。或许你也可以这样做？当你被我锁在地下室里，不再被最大号、最病态的重刑犯当作哭泣的人肉沙包的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Every time I clean something you just make something else *dirty*.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 每次我清理东西的时候，你都要把其他东西弄、脏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Y'know, I'm not very sure how many of us it'd take to kick your bottom but I got a long line of volunteers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我不确定需要多少人手才能打败你，但没关系，我有一长队的志愿者等着揍你呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I was at the end of my rope, 'til I met you. Now you're at the end of mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我当时已经走投无路了，直到我遇见了你。现在该我让你走投无路了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You can't get away from me, darling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你逃不掉的，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Can we talk about Mister Parvos? I'm sure if you just listened to what he's all about you'd see he has such wonderful, perfect ideas. Would you do that for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我们能谈谈帕尔沃斯先生吗？我相信如果你听了他的想法，你会发现他的主意美妙又完美。你愿意这么去做吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, it's my fault. If I'd done a better job of placing your hand in Mister Parvos' we wouldn't be in this humbugging, bamboozled old situation. Well. I'm not giving up on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 噢，这是我的错。要是当初我能让你和帕尔沃斯先生友好相处的话，我们就不会处在这样荒唐且又尴尬的境地中。好吧，我是不会放弃你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Bom pom pom... taking over the system, one sector at a time, keeping the Tenno distracted, making all their stuff mine... oh, I am GOOD at this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 啵嘭嘭……接管整个星系，一次一个星区，让 Tenno 顾此失彼，把他们的东西都变成我的……噢，这种事我很在行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'll wait. In time, you will come to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会等你的。到时候，你会来找我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I endure. You fester.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我日益强健。你形容枯槁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: The ledger of your debt is growing. Longer. Every. Day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你欠下的帐越来越多了。每、天、都、在、变多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Must I watch you waste your days in idleness?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我非得这样看着你在闲暇时浪费你的时光吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Those you have killed are always with you. We know you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那些死在你手上的人会永远与你同在。我们了解你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I know your value. Every sinew. Every morsel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我知道你的价值。每条肌腱。每咬上一口的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: There are depths you could never sound. Cold you could never endure. In such places we have our birthing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 有些深渊是你永远也无法到达的。有些寒冷是你永远也无法忍受的。我们就出生在了这种地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Bet you didn't think you were gonna bump into me today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我敢打赌，你没想到今天会撞到我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh honey, when you go up against the Sisterhood, you swim with sharks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，亲爱的，当你和姐妹团进行对抗时，你就像在和鲨鱼一起游泳一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: First rule of success: if you think things are going well you've overlooked something. Hello.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 成功的首要原则：如果你认为事情进展顺利，那你肯定忽视了某些东西。你好啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Kinda sucks that you only get experience after you need it, huh? Prepare for an experience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不经一事，不长一智，这样有点糟糕，是吧？准备好来经一事吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I think we need to talk about your attitude.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我认为我们需要谈谈你的态度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Betcha wish you'd never done to me that bad thing you did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我打赌你肯定希望你从未对我做过那件坏事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Wishes aren't fishes, and if my progenitor had wheels, well, she'd a been a wagon. I don't like havin' to do this, but you're just bad. Bad right to the bone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 愿望成不了真，要是我的祖先有轮子的话，额，那她一定是辆货运车。我不喜欢这样做，但你实在是太糟糕了。骨子里就坏透了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Oh, I wished better things for us, but you have broken my faith in you and now things must come to their end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 哦，我曾希望过我们之间能有更好的结果，但你打破了我对你的信任，现在该做个了结了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: If I'm honest... I've been following you since first we met. Does that sound strange?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 老实说……我从咱们第一次见面以来，就一直在跟着你。听起来很奇怪吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: We all have a shadow, darling. I am yours as you are for certain mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我们都有个影子，亲爱的。我是你的影子，就像你是我的一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Focus. It's only a Tenno. We kill them all the time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 集中精神。这只是一个 Tenno。我们经常杀他们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am open to this combat experience - I will learn from this combat experience - I am ready for this combat... ergh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我对这种战斗经验持开放态度 — 我会从这种战斗经验中学到很多 — 我已准备好进行这种战斗……呃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Right. Combat mode. Think empowering thoughts! Power flows through me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好的。战斗模式。想点能带来力量的事物！力量在我体内流淌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I don't want to kill you, you know. So you could always just leave. Then I wouldn't have to!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你知道的，我不想杀你。所以你随时都可以离开。那样我就不用出手了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Right. That's it. I tried being reasonable. But you've gone and pushed it too far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 好吧。就此为止。我是想要通情达理一些的。但你做得太过分了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Bluster in vain. Sooner or later, every debt comes due.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 任你怎么叫喊都没用了。无论如何，每一笔债务，皆有到期之时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Listen. Footsteps. Cold breath on your neck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 听。这逼近的脚步声。冰冷的气息，已然吹向你的后颈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Found them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 发现你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I have waited, just as Parvos waited. Now I strike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我等待了很久，正如帕尔沃斯般苦候。现在我要开始出手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: It is here. Contact Sister Glarios. Ask what she wants done with the parts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那家伙在这。联系格拉里斯姐妹，问问她想用 Tenno 的零件做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I swear to the Void if you were any dumber you'd be a mineral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我向虚空发誓，如果你再笨上一点点，那你就成一块矿物质了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'm taking your stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我在拿走你的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Whatever, just gimme your money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 无所谓了，只要把钱交出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Boo hoo wah wah is this all you have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 呜呜哇哇你只有这点东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I have restructured your finances. I have issued receipts. And there is nothing you can do about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我已经调整了你的财务状况。我已经开出了收据。并且你对此无能为力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I'll put these to responsible use. Which is more than you would have done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我会好好利用它们的。肯定比你做得强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I am good at many talents so opposing me was a silly, stupid, dirt-headed mistake. I will spend this better than you ever would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 多才多艺如我，所以反对我就是一个低级、愚蠢，且又无知的错误。在使用它这方面，我肯定会比你强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Because I am learned and worldly and elegant I have something you never will: I have enough. I also have enough because I am taking your money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 因为我博学多才、老于世故，且又高贵典雅，我拥有某些你永远不会拥有的东西：这些东西我很充裕。而我能很充裕是因为我在拿走你的钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You're not supposed to be here. So I'll take that and you'll say 'Thank you, Sister. I'll be on my way now.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你不应该在这里。所以我会拿走它，而你会说"谢谢你，姐妹。我现在要走了。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: You do bad, you put money in the Bad Jar. I'm gonna get Mister Parvos something nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 你做了坏事，你就要把钱放进坏事钱罐里。我要给帕尔沃斯先生买点好东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: These used to be yours, but now they are not yours. Are we clear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 这些曾经是你的，但现在不是了。明白吗?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: And that's my share. See? We can work together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 那份是我的。看到了吗？咱们还是能一起共事的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I take your meager goods. One day, I shall take your head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我取走了你那点可怜的货物。有一天，我将会取下你的项上人头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: Do not claim what you cannot keep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 不要领取那些你无法保有的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: I see, I desire, I take. Try to stop me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 我看见，我渴望，我索取。试图来阻止我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.text: As a Maprico falls from the shaken tree, so too falls fortune from the idle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CorpusLich/DLi.zhText: 就像马利可会从摇晃不定的树上掉下来一样，财富也会从懒惰之人的身上掉下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: You have a Railjack. But you need a crew. Unconventional people require unconventional work. Purpose. So, naturally, I looked at my little network, saw the state of the System, thought of you and... if I'm honest, this was all Little Duck's idea. She made such a good case I couldn't say no. Come. Let Ticker introduce you to the gang. You'll love them. They're a hoot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 你有了航道星舰，不过还缺一批船员。非常人，就得干非常事——好歹有个奔头。我就顺着自己这张小小的人脉网看了看，又瞧了瞧如今的星系，一下就想到了你。然后……老实说，这全是小鸭子的主意。漂亮话全被她说了，我实在没法拒绝。来吧，让提克尔带你认识一下这帮家伙。你一定会喜欢的，他们一个比一个有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Well, well, well. You've become quite the popular dance partner. Since Ticker saw you last, she's had some very interesting prospects approach her vis-a-vis crewing with you. Your reputation may be preceding you, Stardust, but I'll handle the introductions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 哎哟哟，瞧瞧，瞧瞧。咱们星尘现在可是相当抢手的舞伴呢。自从上次见面后，就有几拨挺有意思的人跑来找我，都在打听能不能加入你的船队。星尘，你的名声怕是已经传开了。不过别担心，牵线介绍这种事，尽管包在我身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: I think this is going to work out wonderfully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 哎呀，你们肯定会相处得很融洽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: I had a feeling about you two. Two rogues who seem positively made for one another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 我就知道你们俩对脾气。两个不安分的家伙，简直就是天造地设的一对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Ticker's had a few captains vying for the services of that one, but they insisted on talking to you first. To see if you were the real deal. I'd say you banished any doubt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 为了请到这位，好几位船长都快打起来了。可人家坚持要先见见你。想看看你到底像不像传闻中那么厉害。依我看，人家悬着的心应该放下来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Top-tier talent that one. And they know it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 这位可是数一数二的好手，他自己也清楚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: A prestigious recruitment to be sure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 这回可真给你的船请来了一尊大神！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Take good care of them, Stardust. I'm quite fond of that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 好好照顾他，星尘。我可是很看好这位的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: I mean to see you again, so no taking stupid risks. Look after them, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 我还等着再见到你呢，别犯傻去冒险。星尘，替我照看好他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Oh, great things are in store for the two of you, Stardust. Just see if there isn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 噢，星尘，前头可有不少好事等着你们呢。不信等着瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: This one's a bit of a legend, Stardust. Practically a verb. Good catch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 这位可是个人才，星尘。名号响得都能当活招牌了。真让你捡到宝了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Like attracts like. Only the best for the best. I love my job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 气味相投的人总能走到一块儿。最拔尖的好手，自然得配最顶级的搭档。我可太爱撮合人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Wonderful! Perfect. This is probably closest I'll get to running a matchmaking agency, so I'll take what I can get.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 太好了！简直完美。这大概是我这辈子最接近当媒婆的一次了。能过把瘾也不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: I'm sure they'll make a wonderful addition to your high-risk little family.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 大家肯定很适合你那个小家，没那么安全的小家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Wonderful! They're just aching to get back into space.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 太好了！他们的心早就飞回太空去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Lovely. I'll just put the paperwork together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 好的。我这就去准备手续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Gather your things, sweetie, you're shipping out with a legend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 收拾东西吧，亲爱的。你要跟着传奇人物扬帆起航了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: I think you'll really like their energy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 你肯定会喜欢他们身上的这股劲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: You're tied to one another now. Keep each other alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 从现在起，你们可就是一条船上的了。彼此照应，都给我好好活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: It's a harsh universe, Stardust. Watch out for each other. You're family now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 这宇宙可没我这么温柔，星尘。往后多互相关照——你们现在是一家人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Now. Don't make me worry about you. C'mon, let's go gather your things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 好了，别让我替你操心。来，去把东西收拾好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: That one wasn't sure they'd ever get back into space. They'll see your ship right, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 这位原以为自己再也回不了太空了。看来他们能替你把飞船维护得很妥当。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Ah well. Same time tomorrow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 好吧。那就明天老时间碰头？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Sometimes you just know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 缘分这东西，有时候交换个眼神就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: I'll let them down easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 我会帮你说点好话的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Hm. Let me see who else I have on the books. Get back to me in a few.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 嗯……我再翻翻名单，看看还有谁。过会儿再来找我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Right you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 好，就依你吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Hm. You know what? I'm going to try something different. Come back in a little bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 嗯……你知道吗？我想换个搭档试试。晚点再来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: So it goes. I don't want you shipping out with anyone you wouldn't trust with your life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 也好。我可不能让你和信不过的家伙一起出航。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Now. What gallant spacefarers are eager to make your acquaintance today...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 那么……今天又有哪些英勇的星海旅人，正盼着与你结识呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Good people and tested sailors looking to get back on their feet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 都是些好人，也是经得住风浪的老水手，只缺一个重新站稳脚跟的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: All rated by Little Duck and vetted by me, Stardust. Chemistry and skill-matching is the key to staying alive. So LD tells me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 他们全都经过小鸭子评定，我也亲自把过关，星尘。想活得长久，人得合得来，本事也得互补——至少小鸭子是这么说的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Many want to crew for a legend, Stardust. No matter the risks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 很多人都想登上传奇之船，星尘。哪怕明知前路危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Everyone on my books wants to make a difference. All of them seasoned professionals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 我名单上的每个人，都心怀能真正改变星系的宏愿。而且个个都是身经百战的行家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Work must have meaning, Stardust, and what is more meaningful than helping one another?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 干活总得有点意义，星尘。还有什么能比彼此扶持更有意义呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: One at a time, you'll all get your chance. Here's the latest likely crop, Stardust. Hand-matched just for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 一个一个来，人人都有机会。星尘，这是最新一批好苗子。提克尔可是照着你的需求，亲手一个个挑的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: I do enjoy playing match-maker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 我还真喜欢替人牵线搭桥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Let me introduce you to our latest batch of hopefuls. No direct Railjack experience, but they know their way around a ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 来认识一下最新一批候选人吧。虽说没直接开过航道星舰，但船上的门道，他们都熟得很。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Here we go. Why don't you introduce yourselves?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 好了。各位，要不先自我介绍一下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Wonderful. Let's start by saying hello.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 太好了。那就先从打招呼开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Nothing but the best for you, Stardust. This ragtag bunch are hot hot hot right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 给你的当然得是最好的，星尘。这帮家伙看似是东拼西凑的，实际上可是抢手得不得了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: Now, they're hardly conventional but I'd bet a shiny credit they're just what you're looking for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 他们或许不太循规蹈矩，不过我敢押上一枚锃亮的星币——他们绝对是你要找的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: It's tough staying alive out there, Stardust. This lot has a better chance of survival with you than without.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 外面的日子满是危险，星尘。跟着你，他们活下来的机会总比独自闯荡要大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.text: There's so much potential in this lot. If you can show them the way, keep them safe, they'll flourish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CrewHireScreen.zhText: 大家还是很有潜力的。只要你替他们指条明路，护他们周全，他们一定能闯出自己的精彩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DChoic.text: Understood. I will begin the process of integrating myself with the ship's systems. This may take some time: commencing. You may now enter your Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DChoic.zhText: 明白。我将把自己集成到战舰系统中。这可能需要一些时间：启动中。现在你可以进入你的航道星舰了，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DConst.text: Online. Crew- Dax- My crew is gone. Tenno. You will do. Awaiting Dry Dock integration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DConst.zhText: 已启动。船员——禁卫——。我的船员不在这里。Tenno 战士，这将是你的工作。等待干船坞完成整合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.text: Tenno. I am Cephalon Cy. You will refer to me as such.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.zhText: Tenno 战士。我是中枢赛伊。以后你可以这样称呼我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.text: The Sentient threat has learned from past defeat. Reforming. Rebuilding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.zhText: Sentient 已从过去的失败中吸取了教训。他们正在重整旗鼓。试图卷土重来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.text: We must rebuild to contain that threat. We will reconstruct an Old-War-Era Sigma Series Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.zhText: 我们必须完成重建，以应对这一威胁。我们将重新建造一艘远古之战时代的西格玛系列航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.text: A Railjack requires a viable Command Cephalon. I am not a viable Command Cephalon. I will identify a viable replacement. But first: recover the wreckage, then assembly. Return to your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DCyPla.zhText: 每艘航道星舰均需要一个可靠的指挥中枢。而我并不是一个可靠的指挥中枢。我会找一个满足要求的指挥中枢来替代我。但首先要回收残骸，然后完成组装。返回飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDestr.text: Scan baffled by interference drones. Destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDestr.zhText: 有无人机正在干扰扫描。干掉他们。
侦测到干扰无人机，扫描被中断。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDestr.text: Drones have established a dampening field. Eliminate them to resume scan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDestr.zhText: 无人机已设置了一个屏蔽场。消灭它们以恢复扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDestr.text: Interference drones. We have work to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDestr.zhText: 干扰无人机。看来我们有活要干了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDrone.text: Back to work. Let us get this over with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDrone.zhText: 返回工作岗位。速战速决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDrone.text: Boom. Drones down. Back to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DDrone.zhText: 砰。击落无人机。继续扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnemy.text: Perimeter breached. Clear them out to resume scan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnemy.zhText: 防线已被突破。清除敌人以继续扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnemy.text: Perimeter breached. Scan interrupted. We do not have time for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnemy.zhText: 防线已被突破。扫描中断。我们已经没时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnemy.text: Scan cannot continue until area of operation is clear. Get on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnemy.zhText: 必须清理行动区域的敌人，否则扫描无法继续。快去做吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnter.text: Welcome to the Railjack. A living thing. A home. And a weapon. Your home. Your weapon. Aboard this vessel, we work before we play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DEnter.zhText: 欢迎来到航道星舰。它拥有生命。它是家园。也是武器。是你的家园。你的武器。在这艘飞船上，工作第一，娱乐第二。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DInsta.text: Tenno. Your assistance is required in the dry dock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DInsta.zhText: Tenno 战士。干船坞需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DInsta.text: Wreckage recovered. Proceed to the dry dock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DInsta.zhText: 残骸已修复。前往干船坞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DInsta.text: Tenno, you are needed in the dry dock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DInsta.zhText: Tenno 战士，干船坞需要你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DMissR.text: Tenno. That wreckage will not recover itself. Coordinates marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DMissR.zhText: Tenno 战士。那部分残骸无法自行回收。坐标已标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DMissR.text: Our enemy rebuilds itself ceaselessly. We must have that Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DMissR.zhText: 我们的敌人正在不停重建。我们必须得到那艘航道星舰上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.text: Confluence aggregator: roasted. Something has nested in the fuel intakes. Astroframe integrity at 87%. Component: viable. Cephalon Ordis: rendezvous with Tenno at extraction point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.zhText: 汇合聚合器：已损毁。燃料进口处存在异物。星体框架完整性为87%。组件：可用。中枢 Ordis：在撤离点与 Tenno 会合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.text: Fuselage. From the Vidar school. Stay in close proximity while I scan it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.zhText: 机身。源自Vidar 学派。在我进行扫描时，请勿远离目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.text: Railjacks died with the Orokin. Only wreckage remains. I have identified faint Void drive traces on the surface of Mars. Investigate. Recover. Rebuild.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.zhText: 航道星舰与奥罗金一同湮灭于世，只留下了些许残骸。我在火星表面发现了虚空引擎留下的微弱痕迹。调查。回收。重建。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.text: Faint Void drive traces in proximity. Locate and mark for recovery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.zhText: 附近存在虚空引擎留下的微弱痕迹。定位，标记，以进行回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.text: I have not seen a Railjack in some time. I remember: Orokin Outer Terminus positions have fallen to the Sentient armada. Our orders: behead the fleet. My crew: Sukhin, Krodhi, Zada. There are none finer. We are - family. We will stop this war in its tracks. We are the Orokin Empire's best hope. We were. There is work to be done. This fuselage requires repair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartA.zhText: 我已经很久没见到航道星舰了。我记得：奥罗金界外空间的阵地已落入 Sentient 舰队之手。我方命令：消灭敌方舰队。我的船员有：苏克辛、克罗迪和扎达。他们就是最棒的。我们就像是家人。我们将阻止战火的蔓延。我们承载着奥罗金帝国最大的希望。但那些都过去了。现在，我们还有工作要做。这个机身需要我们维修。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.text: Orgone accumulator: blown. Aetheric condenser: vaporized. Viable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.zhText: 能量积蓄器：已摧毁。以太冷凝器：已汽化。可用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.text: Propulsion Systems: the most advanced ever produced. Scanning. Remain in proximity. Neutralize all hostiles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.zhText: 推进系统：最先进的系统。正在扫描。与目标保持较近距离。清除所有敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.text: Fuselage restoration complete. Propulsion section located. Earth's forests. Beware of hostiles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.zhText: 机身复原已完成。推进装置已定位。地球的森林。当心敌人出没。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.text: Void contamination points to bleed-out from Railjack catalytic artery. Locate and assess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.zhText: 虚空污染表明催化剂主管道发生泄漏。请确定泄漏位置，并进行评估。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.text: Void engines. Void engines. Zada dances our ship through forward lines. Krodhi identifies and prioritizes targets. Sukhin's turrets track and terminate. Our reputation is earned. Our objective: a Turaga-class Worm ship. Zada plots an arc. We accelerate. Hm. Ancient history. The dead have no needs. The living require that propulsion system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartB.zhText: 虚空引擎。虚空引擎。扎达负责驾驶飞船穿越前线。克罗迪负责识别目标按优先级排序。苏克辛的炮台跟踪并摧毁目标。我们的声望是名副其实的。我们的目标：一艘图拉加级的蠕虫飞船。扎达驾驶的飞船划出一道弧线。我们加速。嗯。都是过去的事了。逝者别无所求。而活着的人还需要那个推进系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.zhText: 可用。正在标记，以便回收。撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.text: Portside nacelle. Seen better days. Scanning. Eliminate interference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.zhText: 左舷舱体。已经陈旧不堪了。正在扫描。消除干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.text: Propulsion restoration complete. Void breach residue identified on Lua. Probable nacelle location. Recover if viable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.zhText: 推进系统复原已完成。在月球上发现了虚空裂口的残留物。此处可能存在舱体。若该舱体可用，请回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.text: Railjack nacelle nearby. Locate and assess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.zhText: 附近存在航道星舰的舱体。请确定位置，并进行评估。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.text: Zada plots a data-gathering lap around the worm-ship. Sukhin targets exposed launch orifices. Power redirects to the Tunguska capacitor. With a pull of the trigger we will end this. The moment arrives. The moment arrives. Tenno, my precepts… I am not a viable Command Cephalon. I will continue my search. Continue repairs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartC.zhText: 扎达环绕这艘蠕虫飞船航行，收集信息。苏克辛瞄准了暴露在飞船外部的发射孔。把能量重新定位，指向了通古斯电容器。只需扣下扳机，我们就将终结这场战争。这一刻到来了。这一刻到来了。Tenno 战士，我的指令……我并不是一个可靠的指挥中枢。我会继续踏上搜寻之路。继续维修。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.text: Integral fission tanks ruptured. Otherwise fine. Cephalon Ordis has been signaled. Proceed to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.zhText: 积分裂变箱破裂。其它完好。已向中枢 Ordis 发送信号。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.text: Starboard Nacelle. Best-in-class. Scanning. Sights up, safeties off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.zhText: 右舷舱体。性能一流。正在扫描。注意观察，保持警戒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.text: Portside nacelle restored. She is coming together... Next site: Venus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.zhText: 左舷舱体已复原。她将与我们同行……下一站：金星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.text: Starboard nacelle located. We-- You… need this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.zhText: 已定位右舷舱体。我们——你……需要这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.text: Precepts: Complete the mission. Preserve the crew. Tunguska capacitor charged. Sukhin pulls the trigger. Nothing happens. Zada reports engines offline. Shields offline. Weapons offline. Personal lights flash on as the first missiles hit. I watch as Sukhin, along with his gunnery chair, is sucked into the infinite. I watch as the port nacelle detonates. We are spinning. Zada calls for assistance. I am silent. Krodhi's attempt to save our engines proves fatal. I watch as he is engulfed in flame. Zada is alone at the helm. She beholds the distant flash of torpedo tubes. She says my name. The viewplate blossoms. She ceases to exist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartD.zhText: 指令：完成任务。保护船员。通古斯电容器已完成充电。苏克辛扣下扳机。什么都没发生。扎达报告引擎已失效。护盾已失效。武器已失效。当导弹击中我们时，船员对应的警报灯不停闪烁。我看着苏克辛和他的炮位一起被吸入无边无际的虚空。我眼睁睁的看着左舷舱体爆炸。爆炸的冲击力使得整艘飞船不停旋转。扎达请求援助，而我默不作声。克罗迪试图挽救飞船的引擎，却葬送了自己的生命。我眼睁睁看着他被火焰吞没。掌舵的只剩下扎达。她看着远处鱼雷发射管发出的闪光，念着我的名字。在剧烈的爆炸声中，她也化为了灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.text: Dorsal stabilizers: salvageable. Cogitators: viable. Marking for recovery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.zhText: 机背稳定器：可回收。数据分析器：可用。正在标记，以便回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.text: Starboard nacelle reinforced. Soon cognitive geometries will self-assemble. She will live. But not yet. Transferring tail section data to your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.zhText: 已加固右舷舱体。很快，那些认知几何体会自动完成组装。她会活过来的。但不是现在。正在将飞船尾部的相关数据传输到你的轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.text: High-probability of Railjack tail section nearby. Clear out hostiles and mark for retrieval.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.zhText: 航道星舰的尾部有很大概率就在附近。清除所有敌人，对其进行标记，以便回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.text: Railjack. Sigma Series. Top-of-the-line. Crew. Four-thousand-eight-hundred-and-ninety confirmed kills. Complete the mission. Preserve the crew. Thirteen systemwide errors. There were no errors. There was only… me. Following my orders. In her final moment I think Zada knew that. Precepts: Complete the mission. Preserve the crew. To complete the mission the crew must die. To preserve the crew is to fail the mission. The crew exist to complete the mission. Therefore… I... completed the mission. Why was I given those orders?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartE.zhText: 航道星舰。西格玛。西格玛系列。船员。确认击杀：四千八百九十人。完成此项任务。保护船员。整个系统内，存在十三个错误。他们并没有犯错。只有……只有我。听从我的命令。我想，扎达在临死前，是知道这一点的。指令：要么完成任务，要么保护船员。如果要完成任务，就必须牺牲船员。如果要保护船员，任务必然失败。船员存在的价值就在于完成任务。因此……我……完成了任务。为什么把那些命令下给了我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.text: Structural integrity: within required tolerances. Marking for recovery. Cephalon Ordis: time for pickup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.zhText: 结构完整性：公差允许范围内。正在标记以便回收。中枢 Ordis：是时候取回来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.text: Engine Cowling. You know what to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.zhText: 发现引擎罩。需要通过目视确认。靠近目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.text: You require a viable Command Cephalon. You understand why I am non-viable. Replacement Cephalon not yet located. A solution must exist. I will find it. Final component marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.zhText: 你需要一个可靠的指挥中枢。你知道我不可靠，你也知道其中的原因。尚未找到替代中枢。一定有解决方案。我一定会找到它。已标记最后的组件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.text: Cowling identified. Visual verification required. Move in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.zhText: 整流罩确认。需要亲眼检查确认。向目标靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.text: All known Cephalons: surveyed. None conform to tactical parameters. None possess necessary astrogation poetics. None possess a comprehensive warfighting database. Viable Cephalons: nil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DPartF.zhText: 所有已知中枢：已调查完毕。均不符合作战标准。均不具备必要的航天诗学。均不具备全面的作战数据库。可用的替代中枢：无。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DParti.text: The Sentients continue to rebuild themselves. Our recovery operations must continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DParti.zhText: Sentient 一直在进行重建。我们的回收行动必须继续进行下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DParti.text: Do not rest. There will be time for R&R when we are done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DParti.zhText: 不能懈怠。任务完成后，我们还有时间休整。
干得漂亮。工作正在快速推进。
将资源分配给工作的船员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DParti.text: We are making good time. I have yet to find a viable Command Cephalon. My search continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DParti.zhText: 我们的工作进展顺利。我还没有找到可用的指挥中枢。我会继续寻找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DRJCom.text: You have a Railjack. Tenno. All records of my mission have been purged from the weave. Why, I do not know. I had a crew. I must accept sole responsibility for their deaths. Conclusion: I am non-viable. But I... I am the only Railjack-compatible Cephalon. The Sentients have almost rebuilt. Conclusion: I am, under the circumstances, a viable Command Cephalon. If you will have me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DRJCom.zhText: 您有一艘航道星舰，Tenno 战士。所有关于我任务的记录都已经在织网中被销毁了。我并不知道原因。我曾有一支舰队。我必须对他们的牺牲承担全部责任。结论：我不可靠。但是我……我是唯一适合航道星舰的中枢。Sentient 即将卷土重来。结论：在这种情况下，我是一个可用的指挥中枢。前提是，如果您想要用我的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DRJCom.text: Work crews report tools-down. Railjack structure: complete. Structure reinforcement: complete. Systems restoration: complete. Your presence is required on the dry dock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DRJCom.zhText: 船员报告已完成。航道星舰结构：已完成。结构加固：已完成。系统还原：已完成。。您必须到干船坞去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DRepai.text: Commencing restoration. You will be contacted upon completion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DRepai.zhText: 正在启动修复。工作完成后我会联系你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DSarco.text: Paradox. You behold an absence. Describe it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DSarco.zhText: 自相矛盾。你看到了我看不见的东西。描述一下它的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DSarco.text: Crew. A color you have never seen: imagine it. That is where you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DSarco.zhText: 船员。一种你从未见过的颜色：想象一下它是什么样的。那就是你现在的处境。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DSarco.text: Attempting to perceive: cognition algorithms fail to prove a negative. Something touches me. Impossible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DSarco.zhText: 正在尝试感知：认知算法无法证明不存在的事物。感知到有什么东西碰到了我。这不可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DStayI.text: Scan interrupted. Maintain proximity to objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DStayI.zhText: 扫描中断。请与目标保持近距离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DUseNa.text: System integration: ongoing. You will be informed when process complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DUseNa.zhText: 系统整合：正在进行。程序完成后，你将获得系统的通知。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Something's out there, kiddo… watching us
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 有些东西在外面，小鬼……他们在看着我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Something's out there, kiddo… watching us
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 有些东西在外面，小鬼……他们在看着我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Something's out there, kiddo… watching us
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 有些东西在外面，小鬼……他们在看着我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey kiddo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey kiddo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey kiddo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey kiddo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey, kiddo, what took you so long?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼，怎么需要这么久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey, kiddo, what took you so long?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼，怎么需要这么久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey, kiddo, what took you so long?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼，怎么需要这么久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Hey, kiddo, what took you so long?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 嘿，小鬼，怎么需要这么久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Don't forget, kiddo… you're nothing without me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 别忘了，小鬼……没有我，你什么都不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Don't forget, kiddo… you're nothing without me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 别忘了，小鬼……没有我，你什么都不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Don't forget, kiddo… you're nothing without me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 别忘了，小鬼……没有我，你什么都不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: Don't forget, kiddo… you're nothing without me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 别忘了，小鬼……没有我，你什么都不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: You mad at me, kiddo? Did you forget? You owe me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 你生我的气吗，小鬼？你忘了吗？你欠我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: You mad at me, kiddo? Did you forget? You owe me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 你生我的气吗，小鬼？你忘了吗？你欠我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: You mad at me, kiddo? Did you forget? You owe me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 你生我的气吗，小鬼？你忘了吗？你欠我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.text: You mad at me, kiddo? Did you forget? You owe me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/CyQuest/DVoidE.zhText: 你生我的气吗，小鬼？你忘了吗？你欠我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: It's that time again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 特卖时间又到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Hey, friends. Check this merch out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 嗨，朋友，来瞧瞧这批尖货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: This looks interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 这玩意有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Tenno, hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: Tenno，快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Hey, you, yeah, you. Friend. You like deals?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 喂，你，对，就是你。朋友，喜欢打折吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Because you're a friend, I'm going to offer you something special. Just remember, one per customer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 既然是老朋友，给你看点不一样的吧。不过，每位顾客限购一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Welcome, friends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 欢迎光临，朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Tenno, it's your lucky day!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: Tenno，你今天走大运了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Only one per Tenno. Don't get greedy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 每位 Tenno 只能买一件。别贪心喔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Hey, Tenno, you ready for today's steal… whoa, I mean deal. Today's deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 喂 Tenno，来看看我今天偷……噢，我是说偷偷给你打个折。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Tenno, you will make an excellent hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: Tenno，你将成为一名出色的猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: May this aid you in the Synthesis of many creatures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 愿它协助你完成更多生灵的结合！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: I knew we had a shared passion, hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 我就知道我们志同道合，猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Good fortune, hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 祝你好运，猎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Hunter, you exceed expectations. You are far more exciting and complex than any specimen in my Sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 猎者，你超出了我的预期。你远比圣殿中任何样本都更复杂，更令我兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: You seek rewards, hunter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 猎者，想要奖励吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Operator, you have returned!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 指挥官，您回来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Thank you for returning to me, Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 感谢您回到我身边，指挥官！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Ordis is pleased to see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: Ordis 真的很想念您。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Welcome back, Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 欢迎回来，指挥官！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Ordis has been --getting tired of waiting-- waiting patiently for your return, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: Ordis 一直，等得我恶心，一直都在耐心地等候您的归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Those who brave the thorn may eat the rare fruit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 勇于披荆斩棘的人，才有资格尝到果实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: These offerings honor your suffering and practice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 这些奖励是对你历练和苦修的嘉许。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: May this bring you honor, pupil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 愿它赐予你荣耀，我的弟子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Use it well, as you walk the harder path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 愿它助你穿越这漫漫险途。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: New strength creates new weakness. Pupil, can you balance these opposing forces?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 新的力量会催生新的弱点，弟子。你能否调和这股相冲之力呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: My pupil, the next summit awaits. Are you ready to make the climb?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 弟子，下一座险峰就在前方，你准备好攀登了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Say hello to treasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 跟宝藏打个招呼吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Heya, Tinsuit, this your first time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 嘿，铁皮罐头，第一次来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Ah, you look like a Tenno who knows the business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 呵，看来你是个懂行的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Oh me, oh my, would you look at these?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 哎呀呀，天哪，瞧瞧这些好东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Lotta good stuff here, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 这儿的好东西可不少，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Here we go, let's find some antiquities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 走吧，去找点老古董。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Jackpot. That's what we're looking for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 中头奖了。我们要找的就是这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Make your choice, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 选择吧，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Perseverance and loyalty are among your greatest assets, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 坚韧和忠诚是你最宝贵的财富，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: You have fought long and hard, Tenno. I want you to have this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 你经历了漫长而艰苦的战斗，Tenno。希望你能收下这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.text: Take this, as recognition for all you have done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DailyTribute/D.zhText: 收下吧，这是对你付出的认可。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Remember: our aim is to safeguard Master Entrati's experiments, repel the enemy, and keep. It. Quiet. The family must never learn of what occurs... down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 请记住：我们的目标是保卫英择谛老爷的实验，击退敌人并保——持——安——静。家族绝对不能知道这里发生的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Heads high and hearts full of fire! Let's finalize those experiments! Or Loid will never let me hear the end of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 抬头挺胸，心中激情似火！让我们完成这些实验吧！否则洛德会没完没了地说我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Prepare for ALL PHASES! The experiments Master Entrati began are irreplaceable; quick and clean would be my preference. I'd rather not endure the bollocking from Loid that will surely follow should we make a dog's breakfast of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 为所有阶段做好准备！英择谛老爷开始的实验可是无法替代的；干净利落地完成是我的首选。 我可不想把这搞砸，那一定会招来洛德的臭骂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Ahem. Attention, Tenno! Now that Loid and the Cavia have settled in, I feel I can be of more use. The laboratories are for research, after all, and science is calling! Henceforth, I shall be dividing my time between the upper Necralisk and down here in the Sanctum Anatomica. Keep it on the hush-hush, if you don't mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 咳咳。请注意，Tenno！既然洛德和科维兽已经安顿下来，我觉得我可以更有用武之地。毕竟，实验室是用来研究的，而科学在召唤！从现在起，我将把我的时间分配在上面的殁世幽都和这里的解剖圣所之间。如果你不介意的话，保持这个秘密好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Oh gosh. You appear to have caught me moonlighting. Mum's the word, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 哦天哪。你似乎发现了我在兼职。记得保密，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Yes... Your eyes aren't deceiving you. Old Necraloid is working in the Sanctum now. So many responsibilities to juggle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 是的……你没有看错。老殁世械灵现在在圣所工作了。要同时应对那么多职责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I wouldn't want Loid to struggle, so here I am. Such a pity when people are too proud to ask for help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我不想让洛德遇到困难，所以我来了。当人们因为骄傲而不愿求助时，真是令人遗憾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Tenno... I need your help to help Loid. It's what Master Entrati would have wanted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: Tenno……我需要你来帮助我，以便我们一起帮助洛德。这是英择谛老爷所希望的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I like it here. Lots of natural light for a basement. Odd that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我喜欢这里。地下室有很多自然光。真奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: These Cavia seem like jolly fellows. Well. Most of them. Well. The bird, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 这些科维兽看起来是快乐的家伙。嗯，大部分是。嗯，至少那只鸟是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Word to the wise, Tenno. Do not ask about Bird 1 and 2.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 给 Tenno 的忠告，别去问鸟一和鸟二的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Explosive Necramech coming for that conduit. Put it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 爆破型殁世机甲正在向那个导管袭来。拿下它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Security systems responding to your intrusion. Watch out for explosive Necramechs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 安全系统对你的入侵作出了响应。小心爆破型殁世机甲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Legacy security protocols dictate that a Necramech must now demolish the conduit. Do not allow that to transpire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 遗留的安全协议规定，现在必须有一个殁世机甲来销毁导管。不要让这种情况发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: When you hear beeping, you know something explosive is coming your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 当你听到哔哔声时，你就会知道有爆炸物正在向你袭来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Eyes and ears open. The system thinks you're hostile and will do everything in its power to destroy the Conduit to thwart you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 保持警觉。系统已将你视为威胁，将不惜一切代价摧毁导管来阻止你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: With a little luck I was able to reverse the conduit's burden. Can you feel the difference?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 侥幸之下，我设法逆转了导管的减益。你能感受到区别吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I have managed to invert the polarization of this conduit's burden. It's working for you now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我已经成功地逆转了这个导管的极性。现在它开始对你有利了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Seems I still have limited control of the conduit's systems, I've converted this conduit's burden to a blessing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 看来我对导管系统仍有些控制，我已经将这个导管的减益转化为祝福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: How are your systems? Feel a boost? You should, I just reversed that burden's effects.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你的系统运行怎么样？感觉到提升了吗？你应该感觉到了，我刚刚逆转了那个减益的效果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Let's see what we can recover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 让我们看看我们能恢复什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Very well. Let's rake up the past.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 很好。让我们回顾一下过去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Time to turn another page of Dante's folio?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 是时候翻开 Dante 档案的另一页了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: What have you discovered?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你发现了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: What you have gathered... may be of use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你收集到的东西……也许有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: To work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 去工作！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Put me to work, Tenno. Drusus has his debts to pay, and I have mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 让我去工作吧，Tenno。德枢有他的债要还，我也有我的债。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The Orokin found conventional books offensive. Primitive. They clung to their precious Ayatans and sneered at our grand libraries. Oh, how we loved to offend the Orokin, Albrecht and I. And how secure our primitive libraries proved while their towers burned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 奥罗金认为传统的书籍令人反感、原始。他们紧抱着他们珍贵的阿耶檀识，对我们宏伟的图书馆嗤之以鼻。哦，阿尔布雷希特和我是多么喜欢冒犯奥罗金啊。当他们的塔楼被焚烧时，我们那看似原始的图书馆却安全无比。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: "Old shapes of song that do not die shall haunt the halls of memory."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: "不朽的旧曲旋律将在记忆的殿堂里萦绕。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The Gods of writing were always Gods of magic, too. Demons and ideas, both bound up in books. Impossible to bind forever, mind you.
