No matter how many locks and chains you fasten a book up with, someone will always prise it back open. That's the frightening thing about ideas, you see. They want to get out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 文字之神同时也是魔法之神。恶魔与思想，都被束缚在书中。当然，要永远束缚它们是不可能的。不管你用多少锁链把书锁紧，总会有人把它重新打开。这就是关于思想的可怕之处，你看。它们总想挣脱束缚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Our adversary seeks to muddy our recollection of true history. We will need reliable chronicles more than ever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 对手试图混淆我们对真实历史的记忆。现在我们比以往更需要可信的编年史。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Granum made the mistake of robbing the same place twice. It's easy to trip up a man blinded by greed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努犯了在同一地方盗窃两次的错误。让被贪婪蒙蔽双眼的人犯错是很容易的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Parvos Granum stole from the Entrati. He boasted of it. All that Albrecht had freely given, all he had sacrificed, was not enough! Can you blame me for despising the man?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努窃取了英择谛的财物，还沾沾自喜地炫耀。阿尔布雷希特慷慨给予的一切，他所有的牺牲，都不足以使他满足！你能怪我鄙视这个人吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The Drusus I knew was a genius. A quick, bright-eyed little man with a taste for fancy waistcoats. I wonder if he even remembers those days now. Or cares to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我认识的德枢是个天才。一个敏捷、目光如炬的小个子男人，喜欢穿漂亮的西装马甲。我不知道他现在是否还记得那些日子。或者对此怀念。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Dante's works on ancient Earth archaeology were some of the finest in their field. Many back then refused to accept a mere Warframe could have written them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: Dante 关于古代地球考古学的著作是该领域中最优秀的著作之一。当时许多人无法相信区区一个战甲就可以编写它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I discovered a forgotten work by Archimedean Otak on crystallography deep in the archives. He was the first to anticipate the unique properties of Argon. We owe him so much. At least... what remains of him... is happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我在档案馆深处发现了一本被遗忘的哲士奥塔关于晶体学的著作。他是第一个预见到氩的独特性质的人。我们欠他太多了。至少……他留下的部分……是快乐的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Drusus never seems to distinguish between the deeds of the Warframes and of the Tenno who presumably operated them. He credits them all with autonomy and dignity. I imagine Dante is responsible for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 德枢似乎从不对战甲的行为和可能操作它们的 Tenno 之间做区分。他相信他们所有人都有自主权和尊严。我想这是受 Dante 的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I remember when we learned of the Warframe insurrections. Their madness, savage and sudden, justifying all the Orokin fear. All their heroic deeds were forgotten in an instant. Those like Dante, who had yet to succumb, became fugitives. To shelter them meant death - or glassing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我记得当我们得知战甲叛乱的消息时。他们的疯狂，野蛮和突然，为帝国的恐惧找到了借口。他们的英雄事迹瞬间被遗忘。像 Dante 这样尚未屈服的人，成了逃亡者。庇护他们意味着死亡——或者玻璃化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Have you ever seen the oldest human art on the walls of the oldest caves, Tenno? It haunts me. Those images of weird, hybrid entities, antler-horned, beast-bodied, privy to an ill-understood magic. I wonder if Ballas truly understood what he was creating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你有没有见过那些古洞穴墙壁上最古老的人类艺术，Tenno？那些图像令我难忘。那些奇异的混合体形象，带着鹿角，兽身，掌握着一种难以理解的魔法。我想知道 Ballas 是否真的清楚他在创造什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Warframes cannot speak, as a rule. Their creator decided they should only scream, or roar, or howl. Dante spoke through his writing, and his voice was beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 通常来说，战甲是不会讲话的。他们的创造者让他们只能尖叫、咆哮或嚎叫。Dante 则是通过他的文字说话，他的声音非常美妙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Dante shared the Entrati fascination with bones. I was content to let him explore our old burial vaults and ossuaries, but his request to examine my own replicated skull was a step too far. Otherwise, his manners were impeccable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: Dante 和英择谛一样对骨头情有独钟。我很乐意让他探索我们的古老墓穴和骨灰堂，但他要求查看我的复制头骨就太过分了。除此之外，他的举止无可挑剔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: What... really?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 什么……不是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: It was the speech, wasn't it? The speech was too much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 是因为那个演讲，不是吗？演讲过头了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Really? After all that wind-up, your response is 'No'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 真的吗？经过那么长时间的铺垫，你的回答竟然是"不"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Lost one. Try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 失去一个。再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: They blew it up. When they do that, you get nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 它们把它炸毁了。当它们这样做时，你什么也得不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Conduit destroyed. Please focus. That may have had what Drusus needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 导管被毁。请专心点。这可能就是德枢所需要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Damn. Lost one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 可恶。失去一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: That one got through. Shake it off and get back in the fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 那家伙突破防线了。振作起来并重新投入战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: That conduit is now defunct. May I remind you that our friend Drusus is counting on you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 该导管现已失效。我可以提醒你，我们的朋友德枢指望着你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: They just took down a conduit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 它们刚刚拆除了一个导管！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Oh. They got one. Listen for the beeps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 哦。它们得手了一个。听好哔哔声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Is that... why, yes it is. A Conduit failsafe. This will negate any negative forces the Conduit has inflicted on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 那是……哦，真的是。一种导管安全措施。这将抵消导管对你造成的任何负面影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: A Conduit failsafe. An emergency off switch for the conduit's negative burdens. A fortuitous find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 一种导管安全措施。导管减益的紧急关闭开关。一次幸运的发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Conduit burdens wiped. Your timing is impeccable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 导管减益已被清除。你挑的时机无可挑剔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Failsafe engaged. Feeling better?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 安全措施已启用。感觉好些了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: That did it. Your conduit burdens are no more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 就这么解决了。你的导管减益已经消除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: That's it. Protect the conduit and watch out for enemy Necramechs. They'll blow the whole apparatus up just to keep you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 就是这样。保护导管并提防敌方的殁世机甲。它们宁愿炸毁整个装置也不让你靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Conduit activated. Explosive Necramechs incoming. Stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 导管已启动。爆破型殁世机甲来袭。阻止它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Docket verified. Protect the conduit until the transfer arrives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 文卷已通过验证。在传输到达前保护导管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Conduit online. Let us hope this one has what Drusus needs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 导管上线。让我们希望这个导管能满足德枢的需要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: That was it. Conduit warming up for transfer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 就是这样。导管预热中，准备进行传输。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Conduit transfer in progress. Stay focused.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 导管传输正在进行中。保持专注。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: A docket. Excellent. Look for a Conduit with a matching glyph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 一个文卷。太好了。寻找具有匹配浮印的导管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I cannot lie, Tenno. I have always felt nervous in the presence of Warframes. The Orokin twisted people into weapons, and I have seen first-hand the bloody and well-deserved consequences of that act. Dante, though? In his company, I felt no such anxiety. He was warm. Earnest. Literate! A fellow seeker. To know that he perished in these very halls while I slept... is a bitterness to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我实话告诉你，Tenno。在战甲面前我总是感到紧张。 奥罗金将人们扭曲成武器，我亲眼目睹其为所带来的血腥和报应。而 Dante 呢？在他的陪伴下，我却没有感到这种焦虑。他很温暖。很挚诚。很有文化！一个同道中人。得知他在我沉睡时丧生在这大厅中……对我来说是一种痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Right. Yes. Hello. Um. Look. Bit of a situation. "Deep Archimedea". Volatile experiments connect the dots, but with one small wrinkle... if we don't keep the Murmur contained, the Family is going to become aware that all is not well in the basement: a basement they cannot know exists. In an unexpected turn of events, Loid has tasked me with the responsibility of ensuring this does not come to pass. I don't know; your guess is as good as mine, but here we are. So. How do we do this? Oh. Right. That's my job. Erm. Come on, Necraloid. If we bollocks this up, we'll never hear the end of it. Tenno: your attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 好的。对了。你好。嗯。听着，有点情况。"深层科研"。危险的实验将把一切串连起来，但有一个小问题……如果我们不能控制低语者，家族会发现地下室有问题：一个他们不应该知道存在的地下室。出乎意料的是，洛德把这个重任交给了我，要确保这种情况不会发生。搞不懂为什么要交给我；你的猜测和我的一样，但现在我们就在这。所以。我们该怎么办？哦。对。这是我的工作。呃。来吧，殁世械灵。如果我们搞砸了，我们将永无宁日。Tenno：请注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Gruzzling detected. That little monster will have a docket.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 侦测到贪囤断肢。那个小怪物会有文卷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Marking a nearby Gruzzling. They always have dockets. And probably half my library.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 标记附近的贪囤断肢。他们总是有文卷。没准还有我的一半藏书。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: A Gruzzling! It'll certainly have a docket, but it might also have the final chapter to the book I was reading.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 一个贪囤断肢！他们肯定会有文卷，但也可能会有我正在读的那本书的最后一章。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Gruzzling in your vicinity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 贪囤断肢就在你附近！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Gruzzling nearby. That thieving freak is certain to have a docket.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 贪囤断肢就在附近。那个偷窃狂肯定有文卷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Ugh... A Gruzzling. For whatever reason those little horrors eat dockets as if they were sugared biscuits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 呃……一个贪囤断肢。不管出于什么原因，这些小怪物吃文卷就像吃甜饼一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: A Gruzzling has appeared. Hoo-ray.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 一只贪囤断肢出现了。好哇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Oh great. Gruzzling in your area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 噢，太好了。贪囤断肢在你的区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Arterial Conduits, Albrecht's inter-lab transport and storage system for high-value goods and materials. If you can get them working, you should be able to find what Drusus needs... and more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 主导管，阿尔布雷希特开发的用于高价值货物与材料的跨实验室运输和存储系统。如果你能让它们运作，你应该能找到德枢所需的东西……甚至更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: All you need to get into an Arterial Conduit is the correct Docket. Ready for a hunt?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 想要启动主导管，只需要正确的文卷。准备好狩猎了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: System's up. You'll need the correct docket to open an Arterial Conduit. Start looking. Also, the conduits share the same technology that makes Keyglyphs so burdensome. I do regret implementing that now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 系统启动了。你需要正确的文卷才能打开主导管。开始搜寻吧。另外，这些导管采用的是那种把钥符变得麻烦的技术。现在想来我真的很后悔采用了那种技术。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
The Leverian... it was floundering, you understand? Going under! All that work I put into it, and so few visited, let alone donated. Oh, I don't mean you, of course. I know you're a friend to the Leverian. It just... wasn't enough. So when Parvos made me an offer... I thought, why not? Just let it go. Let it all go. I took the deal, Tenno. I shouldn't have, but I did. Oh, if only Dante were still around.

Please, you must come see me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
莱弗博物馆……当时已经举步维艰了，您明白吗？眼看就要撑不下去了！我为它倾注了那么多心血，可访客寥寥，愿意捐赠的人更是少之又少。噢，那当然，我不是说您。我知道您一直都是莱弗博物馆的朋友，只是……这些都是杯水车薪。因此，当帕尔沃斯向我提出条件时……我想，也没什么好坚持的了，该……放手了，把这一切都放下吧。于是，我接受了他的交易，Tenno。我知道自己不该，但我还是那么做了。唉……要是 Dante 还在就好了。

求您了，请务必来见我一面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Several experiments are threatened by the Murmur as they near completion. We shall protect Master Entrati's good works via a three-phase response. Prepare well. Before the foe is laid low, we! shall! not! return!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 随着几项实验接近尾声，它们遭到了低语者的威胁。我们将通过一个三阶段的应对计划来保护英择谛老爷的伟大成果。做好准备。在敌人被消灭之前，我们！绝！不！退！缩！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Loid has tasked us with finalizing several experiments, and there will be no coming back until the job is done. We are alone; we must conquer, or we must die. If we fail, we fail life itself. Should we succeed, may our sacrifice be forever unknown. With me, friends. To war!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 洛德交给我们的任务是完成几项实验，直到任务完成我们都不得返回。我们孤军奋战；我们必须胜利，否则就是死亡。如果我们失败，那就是生命的失败。如果我们成功，愿我们的牺牲永远不被人知晓。跟我来，朋友们。赴战吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Master Entrati's experiments are under threat from the Murmur. Nay. Rip from his teeth all that he has taken and teach him this: that woe shall be his sole reward. Prepare well, for we shall not return until the experiments are secured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 英择谛老爷的实验面临着低语者的威胁。不。把他抢走的一切从他嘴里夺回，并让他学到这个教训：痛苦将是他唯一的回报。做好准备，因为直到实验安全无虞我们才能返回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The Murmur have captured the dockets you need. Be aware: The Gruzzlings have a particular appetite for dockets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 低语者已经捕获了你需要的文卷。注意，贪囤断肢特别喜欢文卷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Right. Unmitigated disaster. Provide a distraction, would you, Tenno? I have some records to incinerate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 没错。彻头彻尾的灾难。帮忙分散一下注意力好吗，Tenno？我有些记录需要销毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Let's add this to the ever increasing pile of 'things we never speak of', shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我们将这也归入那些不断增多的"我们永远不谈及的事物"中，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Well... if nothing else, we have learned never to do THAT again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 好吧……至少我们学到了一个教训，那就是绝对不要再做那件事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I think we'll be leaving that little escapade OFF the report, if it's all the same to you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我想，如果没差的话，我们就不把这次小逃避写进报告里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I'm sorry to say we have made a complete hash of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 很遗憾地说，我们完全搞砸了这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Elemental resources. Highest possible purity. You don't need to know why; you only need to procure them and procure them now. Crucible marked. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 元素资源。最高纯度。你不需要知道为什么；你只需要现在就去获取它们，而且是立刻获取。转换坩埚已标记。出发吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Pure elemental resources are essential to the completion of this experiment. Crucible marked. Impress me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 纯净的元素资源对于完成这个实验至关重要。转换坩埚已标记。让我刮目相看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Without elements of the highest purity, our efforts will fail. Should we fail, the enemy succeeds; if the enemy succeeds, the manor falls. The manor will not fall. Crucible marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 没有最高纯度的元素，我们的努力将会失败。如果我们失败了，敌人就会成功；如果敌人成功了，宅邸就会陷落。宅邸是不会陷落的。转换坩埚已标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Elements tagged and bagged. Ready for more?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 元素已标记并打包。准备好获取更多了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Those elements will do nicely. Shall we proceed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 这些元素很合适。我们继续吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Updating mission parameters. Secure key materiel from arterial conduits. I shall monitor your progress from here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 正在更新任务参数。从主导管中获取关键物资。我会在这里监督你的进展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Lock and load. Your task is the retrieval of valuable materiel from arterial conduits. Make it happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 准备就绪。你的任务是从主导管中回收宝贵物资。能做到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Verifying. Arterial payloads are intact and laboratory-ready; on to the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 正在验证。主导管负载完好无损，并且可供实验室使用；继续下一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You got everything we needed. I would hazard to say this is going swimmingly so far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你已经拿到了我们所需的一切。我敢说到目前为止一切进展顺利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The enemy has massed and moves to strike at the heart of our labs and, from there, the manor. Phase one: repel the assault. Phase two to be initiated on the move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 敌人已经集结并且准备攻击我们实验室的核心，进而攻击宅邸。第一阶段：抵御进攻。第二阶段将在行动中启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Incoming assault. Respond and repel. Situation evolving. Expect updates. Move!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 攻击即将来临。应对并反击。局势在变化。等待进一步的更新。行动！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Murmur forces eliminated. Analysis has suggested a logical course of action.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 低语者部队已被消灭。分析表明了一个合理的行动路线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Counterattack successful. Fingers off triggers. Stand by for orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 反击成功。放下扳机。等候指令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: First off, the docket: the enemy seeks to neutralize our sensory equipment - an obvious first-strike attempt to blind us. This will fail. You will see to it. Updating HUD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 首先，是文卷：敌人试图让我们的传感设备失效——这明显是一个先发制人的尝试，目的是让我们看不到。他们不会成功的。你会见证到的。正在更新界面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The Murmur seeks to blind us. Guard detail: Master Entrati's sensors. I shall analyze the enemy's approach and attack to formulate a response. Expect updates on the fly. Go now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 低语者试图让我们的视觉传感失效。保护细节：保护英择谛老爷的传感器。我将分析敌人的进攻方式来制定对策。预计将实时更新。现在就出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Sensors remain intact. You can congratulate yourselves later. New orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 传感器仍然完好。你们可以稍后再庆祝。新指令来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Well done. Eyes and ears remain online, and our next move is clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 做得好。魔瞳和魔耳仍在线，我们的下一步行动很明确。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Master Entrati's experiments have gone a tad... awry. Significant off-gassing of elements harmful to you but not, alas, the Murmur. Please accept life support as I attempt to rectify remotely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 英择谛老爷的实验……出了点岔子。释放了对你们有害但对低语者却没影响的元素。在我远程处理这个问题时，请使用维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Bugger. The experiments have boiled over. Dropping life-support. Prevent enemy vandalization while I get things under control from this end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 糟了。实验这边溢出了。正在投放维生装置。防止敌人破坏，我会从这边控制局面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Experiments stabilized. Very good. Let's continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 实验已稳定。很好。我们继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Well done, live and learn, last time I leave one of those unattended, moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 干得好，边做边学，我再也不会让这些无人照看了，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Home stretch. Crucible marked. Loid's brief demands the urgent retrieval of high-quality elemental resources. Prevent enemy sabotage of same. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 最后冲刺。已标记转换坩埚。洛德的简报要求紧急回收高质量的元素资源。防止敌人对此进行破坏。出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Crucible marked. The enemy would deny Loid access to high-quality elemental resources critical to his ongoing studies. Deny. Retrieve. Return. Phase Three initiated. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 坩埚已标记。敌人试图阻止洛德获取对他持续研究至关重要的高质量元素资源。拒绝。取回。返回。第三阶段启动。出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Elements secured. That's what Loid was after. Well done. And well done me, I suppose. I'm really not designed for this kind of thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 元素已安全。这正是洛德想要的。做得好。我想，我也做得不错。我实在不是为这类任务而生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I'll take those samples, thank you. 99.3% purity. Appropriately conductive while being highly spallation-resistant. How...? Did... did you do this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我来拿那些样本，谢谢。99.3% 的纯度。既有适当的导电性同时又有高度抗剥落性。怎么会……？你……你是怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I... took the liberty of adjusting the initial process, yes. To prevent a heavy ion strike triggering a nuclear shower. Wouldn't do to have you irradiated, now would it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我……擅自调整了初始流程，是的。为了防止重离子冲击引发核级暴雨。你们被辐射了可不好，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Initiating final phase: kill the envoy responsible for this fiasco. Priority One is getting serum into a Vitreum Scanner so we can find the envoy. This ends now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 启动最终阶段：消灭造成这场混乱的使者。首要任务是将血清注射进魔瞳扫描器，以便我们能找到使者。现在结束这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Primary target is the envoy directing this chaos. Get serum into a Vitreum Scanner, and that envoy won't be able to hide. You have your orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 主攻目标是指挥这场混乱的使者。将血清放入魔瞳扫描器中，那个使者就无法隐藏。你们已经接到指令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Necraloid to Loid: primary target eliminated. Master Entrati's experiments remain undisturbed. Well done, team. Time to head back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 殁世械灵向洛德汇报：主攻目标已被消灭。英择谛老爷的实验室未受干扰。干得漂亮，团队。是时候返回了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I... have to admit: you've done quite well. Handily done, Construct.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我……不得不承认：你做得很好。轻松完成任务，构物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 果然是好树生好果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Phase Three: your efforts have ensured the production of essential materiel within arterial conduits. Secure said materiel, ensure the continuation of Master Entrati's research efforts. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 第三阶段：你们的努力确保了在主导管内生产出必要的物资。保护这些物资，确保英择谛老爷的研究工作能够继续。出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Excellent. Arterial conduits are now producing materiel essential to Loid's continuation of Master Entrati's experiments. Ensure said materiel does not fall into the enemy's many, many hands. Green light. Move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 非常好。主导管现在正在生产对洛德继续英择谛老爷实验至关重要的物资。确保这些物资不落入敌人的手中。绿灯亮起。动身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Optimal. We have the arterial materiel Loid tasked us with retrieving, and the family slumbers on. Ah. I need a lie-down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 完美。我们拿到了洛德指派我们要回收的主导管物资，而家族还在沉睡中。啊。我需要休息一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Loid, we're back. Materiel secured. Tenno intact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 洛德，我们回来了。物资已获得。Tenno 依然完好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Let me see. These are... well, they're ideal. Thank you... construct. You have been... you have been most helpful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 让我看看。这些……嗯，它们非常理想。谢谢……构物。你一直……你一直很有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: All right, stand down, stand down. You're clear. We're clear. We're done. It's over. We can go home. I... I shall inform Loid that all is well. My gratitude, Tenno. You have served the family well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 好了，停手，停手。你安全了。我们安全了。我们完成了。一切都结束了。我们可以回家了。我……我会告诉洛德一切都好。感谢你，Tenno。你为家族做出了杰出的贡献。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Construct! Tenno! Construct? Construct... are you all right? I saw... on the screens... Construct?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 构物！Tenno！构物？构物……你还好吗？我在屏幕上看到……构物？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: We are all fine, Loid. Thank you. As are Albrecht's experiments. I shall see you on my return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我们都很好，洛德。谢谢你。阿尔布雷希特的实验也是如此。我回来后会见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Here they come! A last-ditch effort. Emphasis on last. Wipe them out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 它们来了！它们的最后一搏。重点在于"最后"。消灭它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: As expected, denying them Master Entrati's resources has provoked a response. Safeties off, remember to breathe, FIRE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 不出所料，它们因为不能得到英择谛老爷的资源而反应激烈。关闭安全装置，记得呼吸，开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Sensors are now primed, farming behavioral and environmental data. Prognostic model assembling downstream, and here comes the enemy! Keep those sensors pinging!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 传感器现已准备好，正在收集行为和环境数据。预测模型在下游构建中，敌人即将到来！确保这些传感器持续发送数据！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Master Entrati's sensor array is streaming prognostic data to the lab's modeling servers. Keep the Murmur from interrupting the flow of this crucial data! It is invaluable to understanding our enemy! Give no quarter!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 英择谛老爷的传感器数列正在向实验室的建模服务器发送预测数据。不要让低语者打断这一至关重要的数据流！我们对敌人的理解是无价的！绝对不要手软！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Downstream dataflow is of high fidelity. Prognostication model completes in 2... 1. Well done, everyone. Loid has what he needs. Let's go home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 下游数据流的保真度很高。预测模型在2……1 中完成。大家做得很好。洛德得到了他所需要的。我们回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Necraloid reporting completion of prognostic modeling. Sensors remain intact. Restarting sequence. Well done, everyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 殁世械灵报告预测建模已完成。传感器仍然完好无损。正在重新启动数列。大家做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Yes. Albrecht would have been proud. Of all of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 是的。阿尔布雷希特会为你们所有人感到骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: As expected the experiments are generating hazardous, if temporary, side-effects. I am dispensing life support to aid you while you fend off the Murmur's last-minute assault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 如预期的那样，实验产生了有害的副作用，即使是暂时的。我正在提供维生装置来帮助你们抵御低语者的最后攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Hold the Murmur back while the experiments complete. The process is generating some life-threatening airborne compounds. Dispensing life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 在实验完成时阻止低语者。这个过程正在产生一些危及生命的空气化合物。正在提供维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Everyone intact? Check yourselves for signs of gills, monsterism, optical poptitude or the sniffles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 大家都完好无损吗？检查自己是否有鳃、怪物化、眼球凸出或感冒的迹象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Beaming results to you now, Loid. Team is secure. No contamination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 现在向你传送结果，洛德。团队安全无虞。无污染情况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I... appreciate the risks you've all taken to safeguard my Albrecht's work. It is no small thing to me. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我……感激你们为保护我的阿尔布雷希特的工作所承担的风险。这对我来说意义重大。谢谢你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Now, be aware: this next stage is going to require high-quality elements, and lots of them. Proceed to the marked Crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 现在，请注意：下一个阶段将需要高质量的元素，而且是大量的。前往标记的转换坩埚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: All right, we need elements, and we are short on time. No time for a conversation; just go. Crucible marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 好吧，我们需要元素，但时间有限。没时间聊天了；直接行动。转换坩埚已标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Well done. Yes. Those will serve quite handily. All right, let's wrap this up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 做得好。是的。这些将非常适用。好了，让我们结束这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Elemental resources still warm, just the way I like them. All right. One more thing to do, and we can all go home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 元素资源还温热着，正如我所愿。好的。再做一件事，我们就可以回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Arterial conduits. Located... here. Move in. Secure. Retrieve materiel. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 主导管。位于……这里。进去。确保安全。回收物资。行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Check your HUD. You're going to be retrieving a supply of key scientific materiel from tagged arterial conduits. In and out. Hop to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 查看你的界面元素界面。你将从标记的主导管中回收一批关键科学物资。进去再出来。赶快行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Quick and clean. Top notch. Initiating final phase.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 迅速且不拖泥带水。表现一流。启动最后阶段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Arterial materiel received. Stand by for orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 主导管物资已接收。等待进一步指令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Hold. Updating. We've made them angry, and the Murmur is responding in force. Marking location. Get messy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 等一下。正在更新。我们已经惹怒了低语者，它们正在集结反击。正在标记位置。准备混战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Redirecting. I have incoming hostiles approaching at speed from multiple vectors. Converging at marked location. Sweep and clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 正在重新定向。我监测到敌方目标正从多个方向快速逼近。在标记地点会合。搜查并清理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Well done. Phase Three initiating. That was gross.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 做得好。第三阶段启动。那太恶心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Screen is green. Prepare to mobilize to final objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 屏幕显示绿色。准备前往最终目标地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Phase Two: the Murmur are converging on Master Entrati's sensor arrays. Loid is utilizing those to analyze Murmur behavioral patterns. Protect them at all costs! Go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 第二阶段：低语者正在向英择谛老爷的传感器数列集结。洛德正在利用这些来分析低语者的行为模式。不惜一切代价保护它们！出发！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Redirect to sensor arrays at marked location. They are key to furthering our understanding of the Murmur. Ensure the enemy does not succeed in destroying them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 重新定位至标记位置的传感器数列。它们对我们进一步理解低语者至关重要。确保敌人不会成功摧毁它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Sensors remain online, and they tell me the Murmur have redirected. Stand by for update.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 传感器仍在线，并且它们告诉我低语者已经改变方向。请待命等待更新。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Eyes and ears are 20/20. Stand by. Initiating Phase Three.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 视听状态良好。请待命。启动第三阶段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Murmur interference has dropped pressure in key experiments. Toxic compounds have become airborne. Sending life-support. Prevent further damage while I stabilize things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 低语者的干扰导致关键实验的压力下降。有毒化合物已变为气态。正在发送维生装置。在我稳定状况期间，防止进一步的损害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: We're just in time. The Murmur have damaged Master Entrati's experiments, polluting this section. Take this life-support and keep them busy while I try to ventilate the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我们来得正是时候。低语者已经破坏了英择谛老爷的实验，污染了这一区域。带上这个维生装置，牵制它们，我会尝试给这个区域通风。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You can breathe easy. Had we been a minute later, the off-gassing would have had a terminal effect on Loid's experiments as a whole. Stand by for final orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你可以安心呼吸了。如果我们晚到一分钟，泄露的气体对洛德的整个实验来说将是致命的。等待最后的指令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Air is clear. The threat to Loid's current sequence is almost nullified. Just one last thing to take care of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 空气已经干净。对洛德当前数列的威胁几乎被消除。只剩下最后一件事需要处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Given the circumstances, you've done very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 从目前的情况来看，你已经做得很好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Good work. Come and see me in the Sanctum to exchange what you found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 干得好。到圣所见我，来交换你找到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: It's time. Come on home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 是时候了。回家吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: All done? I'll put the kettle on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 全做完了？我去把水壶放上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Quite the haul you've got there. Come and see me. I'd like to take some of it off your hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你在那里得到的收获相当多。来见我。我想从你手中要走一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Thank you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 万分感谢，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I owe you all my gratitude.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我欠您的人情恐怕还不清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: A true friend to the Leverian you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 您，是莱弗博物馆货真价实的挚友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You get to keep your dusty junk, Drusus, for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你可以保留你的布满灰尘的垃圾了，德枢，就目前而言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: We lost them all. It's over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我们失去了所有导管。结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: All conduits destroyed. There's no salvaging this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 所有导管均被摧毁。这个任务没有挽救的余地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You've lost this one. Get back to the Sanctum and regroup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 这个任务你已经失败了。回到圣所并重新集结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Tenno, if there was ever a time to find artifacts to donate to my plight, now would be that time. If I can't pay Parvos Granum soon, I'll lose the Leverian and all the knowledge stored within.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: Tenno，若曾有哪个时候，需要您替我寻找遗物，救莱弗博物馆于水火，那就是现在。如果我不能尽快付清帕尔沃斯·格拉努索要的款项，莱弗博物馆连同这里保存的一切知识，都将落入他手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: My friend, without Dante, I need an associate to bring me the goods Parvos demands. To convey the gravity of my situation, I have relayed my comms with that Corpus robber baron to your ship's Cephalon. I trust you can and will be that associate for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 朋友，没有 Dante 在身边，我需要一位帮手拿到帕尔沃斯索要的货物。为了让您明白事情的严重性，我把自己与那个科普斯强盗大亨的通讯转发给您飞船上的中枢。我相信，您有这个能力，也愿意帮我这个忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Tenno, if you can hear this, then you will have decided to act as my field associate. I need Entrati Artifacts to keep Parvos Granum from taking control of everything I have built. I am counting on you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: Tenno，您要是听到这段留言，说明您已经答应担任我的外勤帮手。我需要英择谛遗物，才能阻止帕尔沃斯·格拉努夺走我苦心经营的一切。全靠您了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[7.1]
Ah. Hello, friend. You find me now amidst the bones of all I am.
[12.4]
Of the thing that mattered most to me, in my too-long life.
[20.4]
You know, I wasn't sure it was possible to be less than a man, for I was a man, once.
[29.1]
This room was to be a shrine to one of my dearest friends, but now that shall never come to pass.
[35.2]
Look around and I will recount what was meant to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[7.1]
啊。你好，朋友。你在我现在仅存的骸骨中找到了我。
[12.4]
在我漫长的一生中，这是对我最重要的东西。
[20.4]
你知道，我不确定这样是否有可能变得还不如一个人，因为我曾经是个人。
[29.1]
这个房间原本是为了纪念一个我最亲爱的朋友而设的，但现在这一切都不会成为现实了。
[35.2]
请四处看看，我会细述这里本该呈现的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[3.9]
I've made such a terrible mistake, you see. 
[11.1]
In a universe at its own throat, where every living thing works daily to keep body and soul together, 
[15.9]
there's not much appetite for history. For stories.


[25.1]
The Leverian may not be a real place - a place you can reach out and touch - but to reality it was anchored. 
[28.8]
And reality demands a tithe. 
[31.9]
It takes coin to keep this place rezzed. 
[34.7]
This shrine to memory. 
[40.6]
And… a savvy businessman I was not.


[45.1]
To be less than a man is to be a fool. 
[48.4]
And fool I was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[3.9]
我犯下了一个严重的错误，正如你所见。 
[11.1]
在一个自相残杀的宇宙中，每一个生物每天都在努力维系生命和灵魂， 
[15.9]
对历史、对故事，几乎没有什么兴趣。 


[25.1]
莱弗博物馆可能不是一个真实的地方——不是一个你可以触及的地方——但它确实扎根于现实。 
[28.8]
而现实是需要付出代价的。 
[31.9]
维持这个地方的存在需要金钱。 
[34.7]
这是纪念记忆的圣地。 
[40.6]
而……我不是一个精明的商人。


[45.1]
不及人者，便是愚者。 
[48.4]
而我，正是那个愚者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[2.8]
Did I never tell you of Dante? 
[9.8]
No. I suppose I didn't. I suppose I hadn't the fortitude. 
[18.5]
The entirety of the Leverian is shaped by the lack of him - though perhaps only in ways that I can see. 


[27.6]
Though by definition a weapon of war, Dante was, first and foremost, a student of history. 
[30.9]
And, he was my friend. 


[47.2]
Truthfully, much of the Leverian would not exist were it not for that bold, two-fisted academician's devotion to both myself and the cause of better understanding our history, and ourselves.


[53.0]
It shames me to think of what he would have to say about what I have done. 
[56.3]
To our shared endeavor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[2.8]
我从未跟你提过 Dante 吗？ 
[9.8]
没有吧。我想我没有。我想我没有那份勇气。 
[18.5]
莱弗博物馆的整体都是由他的缺席塑造的——尽管可能只有我能看见这一点。 


[27.6]
虽然 Dante 被定义为一种战争工具，但他首先和最重要的是，一个历史学者。 
[30.9]
而且他是我的朋友。 


[47.2]
事实上，若非那位勇敢、强壮的学者对我本人以及更好地理解我们的历史和我们自身事业的奉献，莱弗博物馆中的许多部分都不会存在。


[53.0]
想到他对我所做的事情会有何评价，我就感到羞愧。 
[56.3]
对我们共同的努力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[3.5]
Parvos Granum. You know the name. 
[6.9]
He of the gilded hand, and gilded tongue. 
[11.6]
For an age he has sought what Dante and I had gathered together. 
[14.2]
Our collected treasures. 
[20.2]
For one such as Granum there is no such thing as 'enough'.


[30.2]
In an age with no appetite for memory, maintaining a shrine to our shared history seemed folly. 
[37.2]
And so, in a low moment, I signed it all away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[3.5]
帕尔沃斯·格拉努。这个名字你肯定熟悉。 
[6.9]
那个既有黄金之手又有镀金之舌的人。 
[11.6]
世代以来，他一直追求着 Dante 和我共同收集的珍宝。 
[14.2]
我们收集的珍宝。 
[20.2]
对于格拉努这样的人来说，从来就没有"足够"这回事。


[30.2]
在一个对记忆不再渴求的时代，维护我们共同历史的圣地似乎是愚蠢的。 
[37.2]
于是，在一个低谷时刻，我把一切都签让了出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[4.3]
I do not know what possessed me, in that moment. 
[9.9]
I have no need for money, or food, or shelter, or care. 
[21.2]
Perhaps I merely felt my time was done, that the past had served its use, and me along with it.


[30.3]
Whatever the reason, I allowed myself an instant to feel my misery to be greater than my life's purpose. 
[38.9]
A momentary indulgence that may be paid by every future generation until the sun goes dark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[4.3]
我自己也不知道那一刻是什么驱使了我。 
[9.9]
我不需要金钱、食物、住所或照顾。 
[21.2]
也许我只是觉得我的时代已经结束了，历史已经完成了它的使命，包括我在内。


[30.3]
无论出于什么原因，我让自己在那一瞬间觉得我的痛苦大过于我生命的目的。 
[38.9]
这是一种短暂的放纵，可能会由未来的每一代人来偿还，直到太阳熄灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[3.9]
I would give much for my friend to have been here. 
[8.9]
Dante and I, we tempered each other's unique compulsions. 


[12.6]
You would have liked Dante, I feel. 
[20.6]
His end began, as it did for so many souls, with the Entrati family. 
[27.1]
The patriarch of that benighted family had fallen into decadence and disrepute, 
[33.0]
his name sullied by controversy and implications of madness. 


[44.7]
Then an erstwhile associate of mine - a gentleman by the name of Loid, and Master Entrati's man for more than a lifetime - well, vanished. 
[51.9]
Loid, his Master, and his entire lineage. Just… gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[3.9]
我多么希望我的朋友能在这里。 
[8.9]
Dante 和我，我们相互缓和了各自的独特强迫倾向。 


[12.6]
我感觉你会喜欢 Dante。 
[20.6]
他的结局，像许多人一样，与英择谛家族有关。 
[27.1]
那个愚昧家族的族长沉溺于颓废，名声受损， 
[33.0]
他的名字因争议和疯狂的指控而变得污点斑斑。 


[44.7]
然后我曾经的一个伙伴——一个名叫洛德的绅士，超过一个世纪以来一直是英择谛大师的人——就这样消失了。 
[51.9]
洛德、他的主人、还有他的整个家族。就这样……消失了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[2.3]
There were rumors, of course. 
[9.9]
Master Entrati was known at that time for outlandish claims and questionable science relating to… 
[12.9]
voices he was hearing, I believe. 
[16.2]
Gods from beyond the veil and whatnot. 


[22.5]
After the disappearances, Dante, never one to let a good mystery go, 
[28.8]
insisted on infiltrating the Entrati manse and learning the truth for himself. 
[40.1]
I, however, being more familiar with the, uh, confidential details of Master Entrati's… interests… urged him otherwise. 
[49.9]
I suppose you wonder why I would do such a thing, if I believed Master Entrati to be fit for little more than the asylum. 


[56.7]
Loid was, as I said, a dear friend. We spoke often. 
[60.3]
His last missive to me was a simple one.


[64.4]
"We end as we began."


[73.5]
As a student of history and its occult apocrypha I know the terrible import of those words. 
[77.8]
And so I cautioned Dante to remain by my side. 
[82.4]
He promised to do so, then did otherwise. 
[86.1]
And I never saw him again.


[91.6]
Perhaps I was not so deft at tempering him, as he was of me. 
[97.4]
And that, I suppose, was my first great failing. 
[103.3]
The parent of this second, and most final, one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[2.3]
自然，流言蜚语四起。 
[9.9]
那时候英择谛大师因其荒谬的主张和他所说的…… 
[12.9]
听到的声音相关的可疑科学而出名。 
[16.2]
我觉得，那是些来自面纱之外的神灵之类的东西。 


[22.5]
在失踪事件发生后，Dante，一个不愿放过任何好谜团的人， 
[28.8]
坚持要潜入英择谛宅邸，亲自揭开真相。 
[40.1]
而我，对英择谛大师的……兴趣……了解得更深，因此劝阻了他。 
[49.9]
我想你可能会好奇，如果我认为最适合英择谛大师的地方不过是精神病院，我为什么还要这么做。 


[56.7]
如我先前提到的，洛德是我的挚友。我们经常交谈。 
[60.3]
他给我的最后一条消息非常简单。


[64.4]
"我们的结局又回到了开始。"


[73.5]
作为一个研究历史及其神秘文献的学者，我明白那些话背后的可怕含义。 
[77.8]
因此，我劝告 Dante 留在我身边。 
[82.4]
他承诺如此，但却不是这么做的。 
[86.1]
从此我再也没见过他。


[91.6]
也许我并不是那么善于说服他，但他却善于说服我。 
[97.4]
在这一点上，我认为，这是我第一个严重的失误。 
[103.3]
也是导致这第二个、更为终极的失误的根源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[4.4]
I imagine you've surmised why I have summoned you here. 
[8.9]
To ask that, in the name of whatever friendship we share, 
[13.8]
to lend your aid to my impossible predicament. 
[19.6]
To help preserve not me, not this shadow of a man I once was, 
[23.4]
but to keep this monument to history alive - 
[31.8]
so that future generations may learn from it, and never repeat our most shameful mistakes. 


[37.8]
Granum's obsession with that bygone age demands pieces of such. 
[48.1]
Ironic, really, that one man's interest in history serves only to strip an edifice whose singular purpose was to protect it. 
[56.8]
But there remains one slim hope: the sourcing of artifacts from places other than the Leverian.


[60.1]
Sourced by you, at my direction. 
[71.6]
Help me, friend. Help me, that my one, great and final mistake, not be the error that turns our collective history 
[80.8]
and the work of lifetimes to a single, miserable use: making a rich man richer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[4.4]
我想你已经猜到了我召唤你来这里的原因。 
[8.9]
我请求你，基于我们之间的友谊， 
[13.8]
帮助我摆脱这个无解的困境。 
[19.6]
帮助保留的不是我，不是我曾经的那个人影， 
[23.4]
而是让这座历史的纪念馆继续存活—— 
[31.8]
以便后代能从中学到东西，永不重蹈我们最耻辱的错误。 


[37.8]
格拉努对那个逝去时代的执着需要这种碎片。 
[48.1]
真是讽刺，一个人对历史的兴趣，只是为了剥离一个本应保护它的独特建筑。 
[56.8]
但我们仍有一线希望：从博物馆之外的地方寻找神器。


[60.1]
由你来获取，按照我的指示。 
[71.6]
帮助我，朋友。防止我最后一个、严重的错误，变成把我们共有的历史
[80.8]
和毕生努力转变为唯一、悲惨的用途：让一个富人变得更富。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text:
[2.9]
You... found him, Friend. 
[6.6]
And Dante's tale deserves to be known. 
[14.9]
So... allow me to relate it, as he passes it to me. 


[26.9]
Dante… ventured… to the… deafeningly… silenced halls of the… doomed… Entrati lineage, 
[36.5]
encountering… automated defenses, gone senile and violent, chanting in an… 
[45.2]
unright dialect that slurred thought and… annihilated… hope. 
[50.6]
That wrongtongued language invaded Dante's mind - 
[57.7]
infecting it with the one thing he was defenseless against: the promise of knowledge. 


[65.1]
It may be said that a parasite is life from without the body 
[72.0]
fighting to exist within the body, despite the body, even as it risks the body. 
[79.6]
What, then, do we call knowledge from beyond our reality demanding to be let in?


[88.5]
Poor Dante. If only he had recited to me sooner the wrongtongued words he had heard. 
[94.0]
I could have told him, you know, that I had heard that language before. 
[100.4]
Once. Long ago. From the lips of Parvos Granum.


[107.5]
Dante found it, you see. Dante found The Book.


[113.4]
The Dante I knew was many things, but he was not weak. 
[117.7]
He struggled, fought, refused its knowledge. 
[123.5]
There was a moment, I knew, when that chill Indifference felt it had won. 
[130.0]
In those moments I was with him, wrestling the foul thing he had unlocked. 
[137.0]
Impossibly, though it cost him dearly, he was winning. 
[144.4]
But, miserably, I knew the equation was not so simple as that.


[151.9]
I told him: Dante, what you have found can never be brought forth. 
[155.3]
Parvos must never know of this.


[163.6]
I felt the chill, the awful loneliness, of understanding wash through him.


[169.3]
I sensed the moment he chose, and I felt Dante give up. 
[175.4]
When he died, I almost died with him.


[183.2]
But the Book, the word, did not permit Dante to die. 
[189.4]
The violent diplomacy which ensued rewrit the very fabric of who he was. 
[197.5]
I understood things, learned things, on that journey with my old friend, from night to day. 
[206.9]
Things which could not survive in this world, but have forever made a lie, to me, of science.


[213.8]
What became of him, and what stars he may have traveled to, is unknown to me. 
[218.0]
What that wrongtongued Voice may murmur in his mind, 
[222.6]
on long nights, I'm not sure I would want to know. 
[226.0]
But I know it teaches. 
[234.1]
It teaches because it longs to be known, and in being known it exists. 
[239.2]
And in existing, it survives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText:
[2.9]
你……找到他了，朋友。 
[6.6]
Dante 的故事理应被世人所知。 
[14.9]
所以...... 请允许我讲述一下他传给我的故事。 


[26.9]
Dante……冒险……踏入了……寂静的……注定毁灭的……英择谛家族厅堂， 
[36.5]
遇到了……失智暴戾的……自动化防御系统，吟唱着…… 
[45.2]
能够模糊心智……泯灭……希望的扭曲方言。 
[50.6]
那种错乱的语言侵袭了 Dante 的心智—— 
[57.7]
用他最无法抵抗的东西感染了他：对知识的应许。 


[65.1]
可以说，寄生虫是来自身体外部的生命 
[72.0]
努力在身体内部生存，哪怕这可能会威胁到身体本身。 
[79.6]
那么，我们应该如何称呼那些来自我们现实之外、要求被接纳的知识呢？


[88.5]
可怜的 Dante。如果他早点向我复述他所听到的那些扭曲语言。 
[94.0]
我本可以告诉他，你知道的，我以前听过那种语言。 
[100.4]
曾经。很久以前。从帕尔沃斯·格拉努的口中。


[107.5]
Dante 找到了它，你看，Dante 找到了那本书。


[113.4]
我所认识的 Dante 有很多特质，但他不是软弱的。 
[117.7]
他挣扎、反抗、拒绝接受它的知识。 
[123.5]
有那么一刻，我知道冰冷的虚空无情之物觉得它已经胜利了。 
[130.0]
在那些时刻，我和他一起，与他释放的那个邪恶之物进行搏斗。 
[137.0]
不可思议的是，尽管付出了巨大的代价，他正在取得胜利。 
[144.4]
然而，悲哀的是，事情并不像看上去那么简单。


[151.9]
我对他说："Dante，你发现的事物绝不能公之于众。 
[155.3]
帕尔沃斯绝对不能知晓。"


[163.6]
我感受到了那股寒意，那种因理解而产生的可怕孤独感在他身上流淌。


[169.3]
我感觉到了他做出选择的那一刻，也感觉到了 Dante 的放弃。 
[175.4]
他离世时，我差点也跟着他一起走。


[183.2]
但那本书，那个词语，不允许 Dante 死去。 
[189.4]
随后的暴力交锋改写了他的本质。 
[197.5]
在与我老朋友的那次旅程中，从夜晚到白天，我理解了一些事情，学到了一些事情。 
[206.9]
这些事情在这个世界上无法存续，但它们使得科学对我而言，成为了一个永远的谎言。


[213.8]
他最终成为了什么，他可能去过哪些星球，这对我来说是个谜。 
[218.0]
在那些漫长的夜晚， 
[222.6]
那个扭曲之声可能在他心中低语了什么，我不确定我是否真的想知道。 
[226.0]
但我知道，它在教导。 
[234.1]
因为它渴望被认识，在被认识的过程中，它才真正存在。 
[239.2]
通过存在，它得以生存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You're on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 该你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: New conduits active, time to start looking for dockets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 新导管开启，是时候开始寻找文卷了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Conduits up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 导管就绪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: New conduits at the ready... if you can find the right dockets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 新的导管已准备就绪……如果你能找到正确的文卷的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Here we go again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 再来一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: What do you say, Tenno? Once more unto the breach?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你觉得呢，Tenno？是否再次迎难而上？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Drusus, you do remember the penalty for late payment, don't you? Forfeiture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 德枢，你还记得逾期付款的后果，对吧？那就是没收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Mr. Granum... I... I assure you it will not come to that. I'll have more artifacts for you very, very soon. My associate will come through for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生……我……我向您保证，事情绝不会走到那一步。我很快就会给您更多遗物。很快。我的帮手一定不会让我失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Drusus Leverian. What purpose does your Leverian serve? What does it build? What does it earn? Nothing. A dusty temple for idle history worship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 德枢·莱弗。你的莱弗博物馆有什么用途？它建立了什么？赚取了什么？什么都没有。不过是个供人闲暇时崇拜历史的尘封庙宇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: How dare you. It's... no such thing! You will get your payment. As agreed. My associate will make sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你怎敢——绝无此事！你会拿到约定的款项，一分不少。我的帮手一定会办到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Mr. Granum, Sir. I know you are a man of reason. So I ask of you the courtesy of a slight extension on this term's payment. Entrati artifacts are very difficult to come by and-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生，我知道您是讲道理的人。我恳请您容许本期付款稍作延期。英择谛遗物极难寻得，而且——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Drusus Thelonious Leverian, do you think me a gullible man? No. I desire precision. So does our contract, which clearly states: the penalty for missed payment is immediate forfeiture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 德枢·塞隆尼斯·莱弗，你觉得我是个容易上当的人吗？不，我渴望精确。对我们的合约也是如此，它明确规定了：未按时付款的处罚是立即没收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: If you truly desired greatness for the Leverian, you would have made it happen, Drusus. But you haven't. Instead, you idle away the years, content with unfulfilled dreams and comfortable mediocrity. I desire greater things from the Leverian and her archives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 如果你真心希望莱弗博物馆不同凡响，你早该做到了，德枢。但是你并没有。相反，你虚度年华，满足于未实现的梦想和舒适的平庸。我期待莱弗博物馆及其馆藏档案能发挥更多的功用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You will get your payment, Mr. Granum, and nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生，你会拿到约定的款项。除此之外，什么也别想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: When I take ownership of your museum and all its contents. Will you, Drusus Leverian, be included? Make this easy for me, and I will make that transition comfortable for you. But if you prolong the inevitable...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 当我接管你的博物馆和它的一切时。德枢·莱弗，你也包括在内吗？你让我轻松点，我也会让你的过渡更为顺利。但若你拖延那不可避免的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: I... I... cannot lea- You... You will be paid. And I will keep the Leverian.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我……我不能——你……钱会给你的。而莱弗博物馆，谁也别想染指。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: My associate will have your goods imminently, but I must ask, why do you seek these... 'mementos' of Albrecht Entrati?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我的帮手很快就会把货物交给你。但我还想问一句：你为何执意要寻找这些……阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的「纪念品」？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Drusus, you and I are not so different in this regard. I desire knowledge. Any wayward item that crossed his path may offer hidden insights.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 德枢，就这点来说，你我并无太大差异。我渴望知识。任何偶然经过他手的物品可能隐藏着深刻的见解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Do you know the problem with glass, Drusus Leverian? It is so very fragile. But you wouldn't know anything about glass, would you, Drusus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你知道玻璃的问题在哪里吗，德枢·莱弗？它非常脆弱。但你对玻璃一无所知，不是吗，德枢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: As a museum curator, I do know this: when not handled carefully, glass will cut you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 身为博物馆馆长，有件事我很清楚：要是不小心点拿玻璃……可是会……割到手的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Drusus, this associate of yours seem uniquely resourceful. If they could be convinced to do my bidding, things would become much easier for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 德枢，你的这个伙伴看起来足智多谋。若其能被说服且为我效力，你的日子会好过很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Do understand, Mr. Granum. My associate is a friend performing a favor. To earn my friend's favor, you'd first have to learn compassion and empathy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生，还请您明白。我的这位帮手，是出于朋友情分才愿意帮忙。要想让我朋友也出手帮助您，您得先学会何为感同身受，何为设身处地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Mr. Granum. Payment. Promptly. As promised. Now... Piss off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生，款项，会准时，按要求付清。请你……滚吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: As you wish. Until the next payment's due.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 如你所愿。等到下次付款再说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Is that all, Drusus? Doesn't look like much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 就这些吗，德枢？看起来并不多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The goods provided exceed the agreed-upon sum by several times. Something any student of history could tell you. Such is the value of history. Hmm... In all your years, you've never learned this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我们提供的这批货，价值足足是约定款项的数倍。任何懂历史的人都看得出来——历史，就是这么值钱。哼……活一大把年纪，您连这个都还没学明白呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Yes! I haven't seen something this beautiful since the days before the old war.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 我懂得！自远古之战前的日子以来，我还没有见过如此美丽的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: My my. Was that an expression of... Sentimentality, Mr Granum? Careful! You might develop an interest in something other than yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 哦！格拉努先生，难道您……动感情了？当心了，再这么下去，您可就要违背科普斯的利己之道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Goods received. But... I must ask. You wouldn't hold back on me, would you? Your... hmmm... associate hasn't any Warframes, have they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 货已收到。但是……我必须问一下。你不会对我有所隐瞒吧？你的……嗯……伙伴没有拥有任何战甲，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Mr. Granum, our deal was for Entrati Artifacts. If I did find a Warframe, I assure you, it would not be for sale. And even if it was, you could never afford it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生，我们的交易仅限于英择谛神器。如果我真的发现了一具战甲，我向您保证，它不会被出售。即使它会被出售，您也绝对买不起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Mr. Granum. My associate is, as always, reliable. Your goods.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生，我的帮手还是一如既往地值得信赖。这是您的货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Hmm... I should hope nothing happens to this associate of yours, for your sake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 嗯……我希望你的这位伙伴能够平安无事，这是为了你好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Mr. Granum, is this what you desire? You could furnish a hundred Leverians. When will you have enough?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 格拉努先生，这就是您的目的吗？您的财富足够摆满一百座莱弗博物馆。您究竟要到什么时候才能学会满足？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: When I find the artifact that speaks to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 当我找到可以对我说话的神器时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: A new set of Conduits is opening. Up for another round?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 一组新的导管即将开放。准备再进行一轮吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: That's all of them. Standby for more Conduits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 这就是全部了。等待更多导管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Catch your breath. New conduits will be appearing shortly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 先喘口气。新的导管很快就会出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You are fighting admirably so far. Think you can handle another set of conduits?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 到目前为止，你的战斗力令人钦佩。你认为你可以处理另一组导管吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: New conduits coming online momentarily. Steady yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 新导管即将上线。自己稳住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You found an Arterial Conduit, but you need the matching docket, Eximus may have them, Gruzzlings, most definitely will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你找到了一个主导管，但你需要匹配的文卷，卓越者可能有，贪囤断肢则肯定会有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Well done, Tenno - your relic is opened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 做得好，Tenno！你的遗物已打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: You have collected enough reactant to open your relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 你已经收集了足够的反应物来打开你的遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: The Corrupted enemies are dropping Reactant. Collect it to open your Void Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 堕落者敌人正在掉落反应物。收集它来打开你的虚空遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Corrupted foes are dropping Reactant. Use it to crack open a Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 堕落者正在掉落反应物。用它破开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Defeat the Corrupted and use their Reactant to open a Relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 击败堕落者然后用他们的反应物打开遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.text: Collect Reactant to open your Relic. Be aware: only Corrupted enemies will drop it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DanteUnbound/D.zhText: 收集反应物来打开你的遗物。请注意：只有堕落者敌人才会掉落反应物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.text: We need to locate more dig sites. Break into the vaults and grab as much Seismic Data as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.zhText: 我们需要定位更多的挖掘点。破入金库，抓取尽可能多的地震数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.text: With no corroborating evidence, I'm skeptical of Maroo's wild claims, but I will give her the benefit of the doubt. She's been right before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.zhText: 目前没有任何证据能印证麦罗那些离奇的说法，我对此仍持怀疑态度。但我姑且信她一次。毕竟，她以前也确实说对过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.text: Damn right I've been right before. And I'll be right again. Tinsuit, there's treasure in those vaults I guarantee it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.zhText: 那当然啦，我从来不出错。而且这次我也一定是对的。锡皮人，我保证那些金库里藏着宝藏。
地震数据？麦罗？你明明说……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.text: I uh… I said there would be something valuable here, and that data has to be it. Keep searching, I'll come up with something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DarkSectorsEve.zhText: 我，呃……我是说过这里会有值钱的，想必这些数据就是了。继续搜索，我会搞清楚的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Seven for, seven against. Cast and recast, seven times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 七个赞成，七个反对。投票，投票，再投票，如此七次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: So, it is decided. The fleet has been retrofitted and redeployed to begin at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 接下来，敲定计划。舰队经过了翻修和重新部署，已经蓄势待发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: New lanes, trawling for old things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 新的航路，为了寻找旧的古董。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: By profit and Void, by the blessed handless founder... we hereby invoke The Deadlock Protocol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 以利益和虚空之名，以受祝福的无手创始者之名……我们在此诉诸《僵局协议》。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: A Granum Void gateway has been opened. It won't last long. Move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 一个格拉努虚空通道被打开了，它撑不了多久。行动起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Void disturbance. Tenno forces need backup within Granum's Void. Gateway collapse imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 虚空扰动。在格拉努虚空中，Tenno 部队需要后援。通道即将崩塌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: An expedition to Granum's Void has been initiated. Seconds remain until gateway collapse. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 前往格拉努虚空的探险已经开始。数秒之后，通道就会发生坍缩。赶快行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: A gateway to Granum's Void has opened. Hurry, before it closes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 前往格拉努虚空的通道已经开启。趁它还没有关闭，赶快进去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Void rift detected. Granum's realm. It's already closing. If you want in, get moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 侦测到虚空裂隙。那是格拉努的空间。裂隙已经开始闭合。如果你想进去，就赶紧行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Origin-side particle count has dropped, but not enough. I will assign a second team.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 虽然始源星系的粒子数量有所下降，但这还不够。我会安排另一支队伍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: You're disentangling but our target hasn't been hit. Particle count still critical. We can't let up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 你们现在得撤离了，但我们的目标还未达成。粒子数量仍然处于临界值。我们不能松懈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: There's still too many Specters. They're pushing through. I will alert nearby teams.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 还是有太多魅影了。它们正在强势推进。我会提醒附近的队伍的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: It's not enough. We have to go back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 这还不够。我们还得回去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Not enough. Get clear. Another team may be able to clamp a lid on this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 不行。撤离吧。也许其他队伍可以解决这个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Ready your Xoris if it's equipped. Specter particle spillover imminent. Thin the Specters and save any Solaris you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 如果你已经装备了驱魔之刃，就把它拿出来。魅影粒子即将溢出。削弱魅影并且尽可能地拯救索拉里斯人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Free stranded Solaris with the Xoris and destroy Parvos' specters. You don't have long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 使用驱魔之刃解救被困的索拉里斯人，并击败帕尔沃斯的魅影。你们的时间并不多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Specter Particle count is below critical. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 魅影粒子数量低于临界值。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Crisis averted. Prepare to disentangle from the Granum Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 危机解除。准备好从格拉努虚空撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: They will multiply again, but for now the situation is under control. Come on home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 它们会再次增加的，但目前情况已得到控制。回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: That's enough. Particle count dropping sharply on our side. Pulling you back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 已经足够了。我们这里的粒子数量已经急剧下降。准备撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.text: Particle reads have fallen off a cliff. Good work. Prepare to disentangle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeadlockProtoc.zhText: 粒子读数急剧下降。做得好。准备好撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DAyatan.text: And to you... we thank you. You've helped us to realize that even though we've changed, even though we struggle to understand one another, we are still…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DAyatan.zhText: 而对你……我们感谢你……你让我们意识到即使我们已经改变了，即使我们难以理解彼此，我们仍然是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DAyatan.text: Yes. A family that would be honored to include you, Tenno. But... what to name this little star that fell from the sky and brought us together?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DAyatan.zhText: 是的。Tenno，一个家庭因为有你而感到荣幸。但是……对于这颗从天而降并让我们凝聚在一起的小星星，该给它起什么名字呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: A visitor. Quite rare these days. We never receive visitors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 有个访客。这段日子以来很少见。我们从来没有过访客。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Be pragmatic in all aspects of life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 在生活中的每方面都要务实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Many safe returns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 常平安归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Exercise caution whenever possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 请尽可能小心谨慎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Hey, no worries, Chip! Let me get that for ya!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 嘿，不用担心，小翻版！让我来帮你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Hmm. You seem to be limb-u-lar-ly indisposed… Let ol' Otak help you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 唔。你看起来四体微恙……让老奥塔来帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: What's up, Chip? Why aren't ya doing the thing? Do the thing. Do the thing, Chip. Do it. DO IT. Okay, I'll do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 怎么了，小翻版？你为什么不去做那件事？去做。去做，小翻版。去嘛，去吧。好吧，那我去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Ooh! Ooh! Let me! Letmeletmeletmeeeeeeeee! Got it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 噢！噢！让我来！让我让我让我来！拿到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Greetings. May I be of assistance?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 你好。有什么可以帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Hello. Are you requiring something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 你好。您需要什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: So good to see you again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 很高兴再次见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Greetings. Your presence is always a gift to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 你好。我们永远恭候您的大驾光临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Ah! Otak and I were just talking about you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 啊！奥塔和我刚刚在聊你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 这位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Right in front of—
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 就在你前——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Who?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Collaborating towards a common goal is surprisingly gratifying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 为了共同的目标同心协力真是令人高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Welcome to our haven.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 欢迎来到我们的避风港。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Minerals!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 矿藏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Not now, Otak...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 奥塔，现在不是时候……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I must ask that you keep our dealings secret from Mother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我务必请求你，不要将我们的秘密交易告诉"母亲"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: This area is sound-proof. We may commerce freely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 这个区域是隔音的。我们可以自由交易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Perhaps another time then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 那就改天吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: What time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 什么时候再回来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Quiet, Otak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 安静，奥塔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I am sorry we were not able to arrive at a satisfactory arrangement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我很抱歉，我们没能达成一个令人满意的安排。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I trust this does not preclude future dealings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我相信，这并不会妨碍今后的交易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I hope that we might continue to work together in a constructive manner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我希望我们可以继续以建设性的方式合作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I look forward to our subsequent dealings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我期待着我们以后的交易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I am certain we will see you again in the near future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我相信在不久的将来我们会再见到你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Perhaps we can make a trade?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 也许我们可以做个交易？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Greetings. I am prepared to assist you, should you be worthy. Forgive me, I've always wanted to say that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 你好。我准备好协助你了，如果你值得我这样做的话。不好意思，我一直想这么说来着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: Are you interested in a business exchange?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 你对商务来往有兴趣吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I am pleased we were able to come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我很高兴我们能够达成双赢的协议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I am glad to learn that this arrangement is suitable for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 我很高兴得知这种安排很适合你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: I convey my personal thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 谨表达我个人的谢意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.text: You have proven a competent and reliable ally. I suggest we continue nurturing this partnership for the foreseeable future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMe.zhText: 你已经证明自己是一个能干又可靠的盟友。我建议我们在未来继续保持这种伙伴关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Will you be mine? I mean... a miner?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 你愿意做我的？我的意思是…… 矿工？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: So many things to mine on Deimos. For instance, you can mine minerals... ores... gems... minerals...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 火卫二上有很多东西可以开采。比如你可以开采矿藏…… 矿石…… 宝石…… 矿藏……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Yes, Otak, I think they understand the basic concept.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 是的，奥塔，我想他们明白基本的概念。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Mining for minerals! Mining for family! Mining for the future! Also: minerals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 为矿物而采矿！为家庭而采矿！为未来而采矿！还有：矿物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Hi, I'm... I'm not Loid. Loid is Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 你好，我……我不是洛德。洛德就是洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: You'll have to excuse Otak. His personality was damaged irreparably by Deimos' energies, making it necessary to transfer his intelligence to this, our current shared form. Unfortunately, my attempted defragmentation of his persona matrix was not a "complete success." Tell them about mining, Otak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 别跟奥塔一般计较。火卫二的能量对他的性格造成了不可挽回的伤害，所以我们必须把他的意识转移到这个，我们当前共享的躯体上。很遗憾，我尝试对他的性格矩阵进行碎片整理，但并未"完全成功"。跟他们讲讲采矿的事，奥塔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Mining? Oh yeah... mining! There are things to be mined. Minerals. We'll use the minerals to make the—
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 采矿？噢，对……采矿！有好多资源可以开采。矿藏。我们可以用那些矿藏来做——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: The things that are necessary for survival on Deimos. Now, ask politely, Otak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 火卫二生存必需品。现在，奥塔，要有礼貌的问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Would you please mine the minerals?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 可否请您去开采一些矿藏？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Be great! Do great things!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 好好做！做大事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Together, we will build the future!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 我们要共同创造未来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: See you again, Chip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 回头见，小翻版！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Hello, friend. I'd call you "best friend," but Loid is my best friend. Right, Loid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 你好，朋友。我想称呼你是 "最好的朋友"，但是洛德是我最好的朋友。对吧，洛德？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Sigh...
Hey! I'm… uh…
Otak is quite pleased to see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 奥塔很高兴见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: It's the miner!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 采矿者来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Mining is an important part of the plan. Do you remember what the plan is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 采矿是这计划里最重要的部分。你还记得计划是什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: I feel different than I used to, but I don't remember how I used to feel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 我感觉和以前不一样了，但我不记得以前的感觉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: I was damaged. Deimos damaged me. Deimos damages everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 我受到伤害了。是火卫二伤害了我。火卫二伤害一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: We will build things. Great things. Then someday we will leave Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 我们将会建造一些东西。好的东西。然后有一天我们会离开火卫二。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Chip! We are good friends. It's good to have good friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 小翻版！我们是好朋友。有个好朋友真不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Did you come to talk about mining? How did you know that's my favorite subject?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 你是过来说挖石头的事情吗？你怎么知道那是我最喜欢的话题？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Mining isn't my only interest. I'm also interested in mining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 挖矿不是我唯一的兴趣，我还对埋雷感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Oh. Playin' it coy, huh? I get it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 噢。腼腆，是吧？我懂了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Shrewd. A player. I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 真聪明。虚情假意的。我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Well… poot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 好吧……噗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: See? I knew we were friends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 看到了吗？我就知道我们是朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Acknowledge you. Gratitude you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 谢谢你。感激你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: I believe he means to say, "Thank you."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 我想他的意思是，"谢谢你。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: Mining is good. You're a good miner, Chip. Keep on mining!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 采矿很棒！你是个不错的采矿者，小翻版。继续挖掘！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: I can do great things with this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 我可以用这个来做大事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.text: You're the best miner on Deimos! Possibly in the whole System! Will you be my friend?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DCephMi.zhText: 你真是火卫二最厉害的采矿者！也许是整个星系里最棒的！你愿意做我的朋友吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadAss.text: Well, here it is. Put it to good use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadAss.zhText: 好了，给你。要好好利用它。
这是你的 — 私人定制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadAss.text: And that oughta do it. Here you go...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadAss.zhText: 这样应该就可以了。拿去……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.zhText: 记住：无论上哪儿去，都要带好武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.text: Deimos is a dangerous place. Dangerous places require "special preparations."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.zhText: 火卫二是个危险的地方。危险的地方，就要有"特别预备"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.text: The lifeforms of Deimos will be picking you out of their teeth unless you have an edge. I can help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.zhText: 要是没有真本事，火卫二上的生物就会拿你打牙祭。而我可以帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.text: Survival is the priority. You're useless to us dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.zhText: 生存是头等大事。如果你死了，对我们来说也就没用了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.text: You can't out-evolve Deimos. But you can procure what you need to survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.zhText: 你无法通过进化来超越火卫二。但你可以去获取那些能让你生存下去的必需品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.text: Been here so long it's difficult to remember that this isn't normal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBar.zhText: 在这里待久了，就容易忘记什么才是"正常"。
噢，瞧瞧你，是如此的……"未感染"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.text: Well, you're in no hurry. Neither am I, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.zhText: 好吧，你倒是不着急。那我想我也不急。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.text: No rush -- I'm not going anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.zhText: 不着急 — 我又不会走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.text: You really like to "think through" your decisions, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.zhText: 你真的很喜欢"深思熟虑"每个决定，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.text: You know, indecision is a decision.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.zhText: 你知道吗，什么都不做，也是一个决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.text: Don't worry about it -- got nothing but time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.zhText: 别担心 — 我有的是时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.text: Works for me if it works for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.zhText: 如果你觉得可以的话，我就可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadBui.text: Sure, I think that'll do nicely.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.zhText: 谢谢，我没想到你会给我这个。
