/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.text: I'll make good use of this.
Yeah, I'm not seeing anything I can work with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.zhText: 唔，我找不到有什么我可以用的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.text: I'm a pretty good gunsmith, but I don't know what you expect me to do with that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.zhText: 我是一名很好的枪械制造工匠，但我不知道你想让我用这个东西做什么出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.text: Next time, ask yourself 'Does this come up to Orokin standards?' And if it doesn't, you can save us both some time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.zhText: 还有下次的话，先问问自己"这个东西符合奥罗金标准吗？"要是没有的话，还是给彼此省些时间吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.text: Sorry, not much I can do with that junk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadDon.zhText: 抱歉，我对这垃圾玩意无能为力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFir.text: We tried it her way, and where did it get us? Just look at me! So now I'm doing things my way like I should have done all along. We'll show them, won't we? You and me. Make them sit up and pay attention. The weapons, they're just one branch of the project. You keep on like this, and I might cut you in on more of what I've really been working on. You know what I'm talking about. Had a taste of it already, din'cha?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFir.zhText: 我们按着她的想法试过了，可你看看我们落到哪步田地了？看看我这副样子！所以我现在要按自己的想法来了，我早该这么做了。我们会证明给他们看的，不是吗？我们俩。让他们刮目相看。那些武器，只是这个项目的一个分支罢了。你继续这样加油的话，我或许可以让你见识一下我真正在深入研究的东西。你知道我指的是什么。你也尝过它的甜头了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.text: Sure. What else would you call it?
It really does suit it, huh?
That thing needs to be a little more battle-tested before I could even think about gilding it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.zhText: 在我考虑给这个东西镀金之前，它还需要更多的实战测试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.text: That looks like it just came out of the box. Shoot it a few times, and then we can talk gilding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.zhText: 这看起来像刚拆封的。用它开几次火，然后我们再来讨论镀金的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.text: Slow down. That thing isn't near ready enough for me to gild it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.zhText: 慢慢来。这东西还没准备好让我给它镀金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.text: Niiiiice. So what are you thinking of calling her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.zhText: 很——好。你想给她取什么名字呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.text: A fine piece of craftsmanship like that deserves a name. Got one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.zhText: 像这样精美的手作工艺值得有个名字。有什么想法吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.text: Please tell me you have a name for that. You do, don't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadFor.zhText: 请告诉你有给它取名。你有的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadGoo.text: Be seeing you again, I'm sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadGoo.zhText: 我敢肯定，我们会再次见面的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Always good to see you, Ayatan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 阿耶檀识，总是很高兴见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: I was worried about you. I'd be a lot less worried if I knew you were carrying a sensible weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我很担心你。你要是带的是一把有用的武器，我就不用担心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Let's go over your arsenal once again. Look, I'm sorry, but I could not have you going out there without the best weapons I can offer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我们再看一次你的军械库。听着，抱歉这么多事，但你要是没装备上我这最好的武器，我可不会让你出去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: I underestimated Grandmother. She may not be a scientist, but what she knows is worth knowing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我低估了"祖母"。她或许不是科学家，但有必要了解一下她都知道什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: It's been hard to forgive Kaelli. But desperate people lash out. I should have never made her so desperate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 要原谅凯莉是不容易的。但是，绝望的人才会这样大肆谴责。我不该让她变得这么绝望的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: You know, Tenno, you can't bully people into respecting you. All you can do is make them afraid, and when that fear goes away…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 你知道的，Tenno，你不能通过欺凌别人来让他们尊重你。这样做只能让他们感到惧怕，而一旦这惧怕消失了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: I should spend more time with Loid and Otak. They've served us loyally since this mess began.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我应该在洛德和奥塔身上多花点时间的。自这场混乱爆发以来，他们一直对我们忠心耿耿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: There you are! What can I do for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 你来了！有什么我能帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Who would I be if I let you go out there improperly equipped?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 要是我就这么放任你带着不正确的装备出去了，我成什么人了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: It's you again! I knew it was only a matter of time before you came back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 又是你！我就知道，你迟早要回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Look... whatever I said about my wife, I'm putting it in the past now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 听着……不管过去我是怎么说我的妻子的，那都过去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: She's still the woman I married. One mistake doesn't change all that. Not if I don't allow it to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 她仍旧是我娶的那个女人。一个错误并不能改变这一切。只要我不想改变，就不会改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Well, sunnier days ahead, I say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 好吧，前路还是光明灿烂的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: At the very least, being stranded on Deimos has given me a lot of time for self-reflection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 最起码，被困在火卫二上，还是给了我很多自我反省的时间的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Glad you joined our little family, my friend. There's a lot we still need to talk over. But at least we're talking now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我很高兴你加入了我们这个小家庭，我的朋友。我们还有很多要说开的事情。不过我们现在至少开始和彼此讲话了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Let's see if we can do something for each other...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 咱们看看能不能为对方做点什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: I've been here a long time. I know what you need to survive this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我在这里待了很久了。我知道在这个地方生存下去的必需品是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: "An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure." I think Ballas said that. No, that can't be right. Well, someone said it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: "要未雨绸缪。"我想这是 Ballas 说的。不，这不可能。我只知道有人这样说过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Need weapons? Of course you do: this is Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 需要武器吗？当然了：这可是火卫二。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Tenno. Good to see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: Tenno，很高兴见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: My son knew what he was doing. We all suffered because of his rashness. It was a fair punishment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我的儿子知道他自己的所作所为。我们都因他的鲁莽饱受折磨。这惩罚很合理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: My wife was the only one with a plan. It was madness, but I went along anyway. It was the only plan we had.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我妻子是唯一一个有计划的人。虽然那计划太疯狂了，我还是坚持下去了。我们当时就只有那一个计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Ha! Have you met my wife? I wish I hadn't. Ah, ok, forgive me. That was cheap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 哈！你见过我妻子了吗？我倒是希望我从没遇见她。啊，好吧，抱歉，这话太刻薄了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: I said, 'He's gone. Put the shard away. Move on.' And she cut me with it, over and over. And I just stood there. I took it. Every slice. I had to. You understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我说："他不在了。把碎片收起来，向前看吧。"然后她就拿着那片玻璃开始割我，一遍又一遍。而我只站在那里。我忍受了。每一个割伤。我别无选择。你明白的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: That boy brought his stinking beasts in here and mocked us all with them. Gave them names of honor! Whatever they were. Pets! They were vermin. I did what I had to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 那小子把他那些该死的野兽带到了这里，然后用它们嘲弄了我们一番。还给它们起了那么荣耀的名字！虽然我早忘了那些名字是什么。还说什么宠物！都是畜生！害虫！我只是做了我必须做的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Kaelli and I have done a lot of talking. She was afraid she'd turn out like her mother. And she was right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我和凯莉聊了很多。她担心自己会变得像她母亲一样。事实证明她是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Couldn't possibly have seen this coming. That's what she'll say. Isn't it funny how all the rest of us saw it coming?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 没人能提前预料到这个结果。她肯定会这么狡辩。搞笑的是，除了她我们所有人都预料到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: I should have put my foot down. Drawn the line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我本应该坚决反对的。划清界限。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: I can't undo what happened, but I can keep making progress here… maybe my children will see me differently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我没法挽回已经发生了的事，但是我可以继续前进……或许我的孩子们会用不一样的眼光看我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: There's useful material all over the Drift, it isn't just a mass of senseless flesh. There's sophisticated organs in there too. Bring me anything good you find out in the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 魔胎之境到处都是有用的材料，不只是没有任何存在意义的肉块。那里也有精细复杂的器官。把你在外面发现的好东西带给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Don't let the Infestation intimidate you. Get out there and shoot the hell out of it. Even the stuff that doesn't move. Chances are there's something worth taking from the debris.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 不要让感染者吓倒你。不管会动不会动，去外面把它们都打个稀烂。散落的残骸里很可能有值得带回来的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Two giant wyrms, screaming at one another and raining down bloody chunks. Just another day on Deimos. At least their viscera is useful for something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 两只巨大的蛟龙，彼此嘶吼，它们血淋淋的碎块如雨倾盆。又是一个稀疏平常的一天。好在它们的内脏还有点用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Okay. I guess not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 好吧。我想并不是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Sure. Take your time, think it over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 当然。慢慢来，好好想一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Sure I can't tempt ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 确定你没兴趣购买？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Still here if you change your mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 如果你改变主意的话，我就在这儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Guess you have everything you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 看起来你现在有的已经足够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: Look, they're all ignoring me. And that's just how I want it! They'd only mess things up. Alright, let's get to business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 看呐，他们都在无视我的存在。这正是我想要的！他们只会把事情搞砸。好了，让我们开始干正事吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: That shard of seriglass my wife clutches means more to her than the damn wedding ring. None of us could ever live up to her father, least of all me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我妻子握着的那块玻璃碎片，对她来说比那个该死的结婚戒指还要重要。我们谁都比不上她的父亲，尤其是我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: 'Look, Daddy, I caught a fish! I am good for something!' Great. Try fighting off a full-grown Predasite with a fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: "爸爸，看！我抓到一条鱼！我还是能行的！"真棒。下面试试用一条鱼来打败成年扑猎达赛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: We needed those rituals. The discipline of it. Might have kept us from ending up like… this. She clawed me! My own daughter! And she laughed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我们需要那些仪式。要它来训练我们。也许不至于让我们的下场变成……这样。她用利爪抓伤了我！我的亲生女儿！她竟然还笑了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.text: We needed to be firm, I said. Strong against the enemy inside and out. She drew her claw, said I was the only enemy here, and she… Tenno. What do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadInt.zhText: 我说："咱们要坚定才行。"内忧外患，我们都得顽强抵抗。她亮出来利爪，说我才是唯一的敌人，然后她……Tenno，你需要什么帮助？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadNoP.text: Here's the problem: you have no components. Weapons require parts. You bring me said parts, I will build you said weapon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadNoP.zhText: 现在的问题是：你没有组件。武器需要零件。你带来我要的组件，我才能制造你要的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadOut.text: I guess you know what's best for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadOut.zhText: 我想你知道什么是最适合你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadOut.text: Okay, maybe not today... but you'll be back. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadOut.zhText: 好吧，也许不是今天……但你会回来的。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadOut.text: Let's keep this between us for now.
See? I knew you were smart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadOut.zhText: 看到了吗？我就知道你是个聪明人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.text: If you're gonna be useful, you'll need the tools. Here. This is what I mean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.zhText: 如果你想派上用场的话，你需要某些工具。拿着。这就是我说的工具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.text: Look, I've been working on something special. I think I'm ready to show it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.zhText: 听着，我一直在研制个很特别的东西。我觉得自己已经准备好，把它公诸于世了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.text: Now, this is the kind of thing you can produce if you're willing to put in the hours. I'm telling you, most don't have the patience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.zhText: 看看，只要舍得花时间，你也能造出来这样的东西。信不信由你，大多数人都没有这样的耐心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.text: Don't go out there ill-equipped. Hey, I'm serious. If I had to pick one thing for the job, it'd be this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadSpe.zhText: 不要在装备不全的情况下过去。听好，我是认真的。如果一定要我带一样装备的话，我会选这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.text: Tenno. Working with you - it's... it's meant a lot to me. Just having someone who respects my experience, someone I can be a guiding hand to, it's… well, you get what I'm trying to say. All this time I've been blaming her for what's happened, but now? Maybe, just maybe, this was meant to be. I think… I might owe her an apology.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.zhText: Tenno。和你共事……对我来说意义重大。能有这样一位尊重我的阅历，接受我的辅导的人，真是太……哎呀，你知道我的意思的。一直以来，我都在责怪是她是祸端。可是现在看来？或许，我是说也许，这都是注定的。我觉得……我可能欠她一个道歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.text: Tenno. Working with you - it's meant a lot to me. Just having someone who... well, you get what I'm trying to say. I can hold my head up again… I see the person I almost became. All this time I've been blaming her for what happened, but now? Maybe this was meant to be. I think… I owe her an apology.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.zhText: Tenno。和你共事……对我来说意义重大。能有这样……哎呀，你知道我的意思的。我又可以抬起头来了……我看到了自己差点变成了什么。一直以来，我都在责怪是她造成了这些祸端。可是现在看来？或许，我是说也许，这都是注定的。我觉得……我可能欠她一个道歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.text: I remember the claw you made for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.zhText: 我记得那只利爪，是你为我做的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.text: With love, to protect you from the Void-horrors. But it was me you attacked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.zhText: 那是出于对你的关爱，为了让你免受虚空恐怖的侵扰。可你却起来攻击我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.text: It was you that was stifling the life out of me! Those stupid, insane rituals… why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.zhText: 是你在扼杀我的生命！还利用那些愚蠢且疯狂的仪式……你为什么要那么做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.text: I didn't know what else to do! I just didn't want to be useless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.zhText: 我不知道还能怎么办了！我只是不想做个没用的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.text: You were never useless. Just lost. I name you Vilcor. The whip in its moment of striking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDadUnl.zhText: 你从来都不是无用之人。只是迷失了自我而已。我称你为维尔科。一条挥舞出击的长鞭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: There are fascinating things down in the exocrine. Grotesque, yes, but survival isn't pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 外分泌液里有很多非常吸引人的东西。长相怪异，没错，不过要生存下来并不需要长的漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: By all means, go fishing unprepared. When I pick you out of a Cryptosuctus' gut sac, I'll be sure to say hello.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 当然，你可以在没有准备的情况下去钓鱼。当我把你从墓沼隐龙的肠囊里挑出来时，我一定会跟你打招呼的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Are you thinking of doing some fishing in the exocrine? I can help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你是不是想在外分泌液中钓鱼？我可以帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: There's all sorts swimming in the exocrine here on Deimos. And above it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 在火卫二的外分泌液里有各种各样的东西在游泳。而且其上方也有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: This would be where I showed you my birthright of ancestral fish, but… well, you've already met my charming brother. Some remnants of the original genetic matrix appear to have survived in the exocrine, though the Infestation is steadily claiming them. If you can catch any and bring them to me, I'd appreciate it. We can salvage anything useful. I can't undo what he did, but I won't let him have the last word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我本打算给你展示一下我那条祖传的远古鱼样本，不过……嗯，你已经见过我那位可爱的哥哥了。有些遗留下来的原始基因矩阵似乎在外分泌液中存活了下来。不过感染仍然在缓慢地侵蚀它们。如果你能去捕捉一些，然后带到我这里来，我会很感激的。我们可以去回收那些还有价值的部分。就算无法撤销他所造成的后果，我也决不会让他得偿所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: A practiced hand, I see!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 好手艺，我知道了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Excellent job. And hardly any mess. Well done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 完美无暇。并且几乎没有出任何乱子。干得漂亮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You wouldn't think you could fit that lot inside one fish, would you? Quite remarkable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你想不到那么多东西能塞进一条鱼里吧，对吧？真了不起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Be careful with the first incision. One clumsy moment can wreck everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 开第一个切口的时候要小心。一个手抖会毁了一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You know what you're doing, so I'll let you get on with it. I'd appreciate being allowed to watch, however.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你知道自己在做什么，所以我就让你继续了。不过，如果我可以有幸旁观的话，我会非常感激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Thank you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 谢谢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Nothing can bring my lost specimens back, but this is some comfort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 虽然什么也不能让我可怜的样本复生，但这多少算点安慰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Oh, very generous. Thank you. I'll go and put it with all the others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 哦，真慷慨。谢谢你。我会将它与其他的鱼放在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You can always donate your catch to my research archive. Since I lost my original specimens, I'm doing what I can with their Infested descendants. It's not as easy for me to go fishing myself as it used to be, so I'd appreciate anything you can spare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你随时可以把捕到的鱼捐给我的研究档案馆。由于我失去了我的原始标本，我正在尽我所能地收集它们的感染者后代。对我来说，钓鱼不像以前一样容易了，所以对你能提供的任何鱼类，我都会很感激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You don't have to keep what you catch. I'm happy to find a home for it in my archive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你没必要非得留下抓到的鱼。我会很开心为它在我的档案馆中找到一席之地的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I'd be glad to take any fish off your hands that you don't want. Father thinks I've got more than enough already, but you don't have to listen to him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我很乐意拿走任何你不想要的鱼。"父亲"认为我有的已经够多了，不过你不必理会他说的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: When you've caught something, just bring it back to me. Then we can split open the casing and dig through the innards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 当你有收获时，就把它带回来给我。然后我们可以刨开外层掏出内脏来仔细研究。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: The exocrine is just seething with creatures. Bring some back, and I'll show you how to gouge out the most useful bits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 外分泌液内散布有很多生物。带一些回来，我会向你展示该如何获取最有用的部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: There's a lot you can do with the parts. Bring one back, and I'll show you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你可以用这些部件做很多事情。带一个回来，我就告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Definitely, plenty more of these where this came from.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 毫无疑问，在它源头的老窝里还有更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You've got a hybrid here. Orokin and Infested ancestry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 这是一只混种。有奥罗金和感染者的血统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Hmm. Totally infested, this one, inside and out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 嗯。这条，从内到外，完完全全的被感染了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Now, this takes me back. A Myxostomata! The original Orokin stock was all but extinct. This one must have been hiding in a deep dark artery somewhere. Look at that gilding. He's an antique, aren't you? Almost seems a shame to bust him open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 现在我回想起来了。独角米索鳎！奥罗金原始种群几乎已经全部灭绝了。这只一定是躲藏在主干道某处阴暗的角落里。看那镀上的金。他是一件古董，对吧？把他就这么解刨似乎太可惜了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Ah! This is one of the uncorrupted Orokin strains. No mistaking that contouring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 啊！这是毫发无损的奥罗金品种。看它的外形，没错的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: This was a lucky catch. Most of these get eaten by the others or get so overwhelmed with Infestation they just sink to the bottom. You hardly ever see these.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 这次捕鱼的运气真好。大多数像这样的鱼，要么被吃掉，要么被感染吓得潜到深深的底部。几乎很少见过它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You don't see this type every day, but there's lots about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 这种类型的不常见，不过它们的数量还是有很多的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: See you soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 回头见？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You know where to find me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你知道去哪儿找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Until next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 下次再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I went out fishing whenever I needed to get away from the sound of my brother's voice. Three or four times a day, on average. What can I get for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 每当我需要摆脱我哥哥的声音时，我都会出去钓鱼。平均每天三到四次。有什么我能帮你的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You can't just chuck a spear in the exocrine and hope for the best. Not on Deimos. You've got to respect what you're up against. Take lures, dyes, all the proper tools for the job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你不能只是把鱼叉扔进外分泌液，然后希望有鱼上钩。在火卫二这行不通。你必须尊重你的对手。带上鱼饵、染料，以及所有适用于此行动的工具。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Whisper it, but Mother's started listening to me again. Not just eavesdropping, either. She's more herself than she's ever been. I'll never forget what you did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 悄悄地说，"母亲"又开始听我说话了。不只是偷听而已。她比以往任何时候都更像她自己了。我永远不会忘记你所作的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: The fish are evolving. Did you notice that about them? I wonder what they'll turn into after a thousand years. I wonder what I'll look like then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 鱼儿正在进化。你注意到了吗？我想知道一千年以后它们会变成什么样。我想知道那时我会是什么样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I wonder - what exactly did Grandmother cook up, to help bring this reconciliation about? Probably best not to ask. Crafty old harridan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我想知道－"祖母"到底做了什么，来促成这次和解？也许最好不要问出口。狡猾的老妇人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: 'Kermerros and Kaelli. Sibling pioneers researching together on the threshold of the Void.' Yes, that could work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: "克梅罗斯和凯莉。先驱两兄妹一起对虚空入口进行研究。"嗯，那应该能行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I wish Loid and Otak would visit us more often. The family isn't truly united until the servants have come home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我希望洛德和奥塔能多来看看我们。在仆人们回家之前，这个家还不算真正团结起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: My father's spent years regretting what he didn't do, and my mother's spent just as long refusing to regret anything she ever did. I don't quite understand how you brought them back together, but I'm glad. And grateful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我父亲多年来一直在为自己没有做过的事而后悔，我母亲也花了同样长的时间拒绝为她做过的任何事后悔。我不太明白你是怎么让他们重归于好的，但我很高兴。也很感激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: All that time wasted hating one another. You learn to relish the cruelty. Torturing ourselves was better than feeling nothing at all. Anyway, it's over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 那么多时间都被浪费在仇恨彼此上。你学会了享受残忍。折磨我们自己总比毫无知觉要强。总之，一切都结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I do know, you know. What we look like. I always did. But you didn't hesitate, did you? To help us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我很清楚，你明白的。我们看起来这么可怖。我一直都清楚。但你毫不犹豫地来了，不是吗？来救赎我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I'm not just someone's daughter. I'm me. I'm Kaelli. Of all the people to name me, I never thought it would be him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我不只是某人的女儿。我是我。我是凯莉。在所有为我起名的人中，我从来没有想过会是他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I wasted years being angry with my brother for what he did to my specimens. Now I think they meant more to him than they ever did to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我浪费了许多年月在和我哥哥置气上，我气他怎么能那样对我的样本。现在我却觉得，它们对我哥哥的意义，可能远胜于曾带给我的欢乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You understand, don't you? The feeling of splitting open a nice fresh Ostimyr. That heady smell of acetone, liver, and corrosion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你懂的，不是吗？将一条新鲜奥斯蒂剑鱼分解的感觉。那种令人上头的丙酮、肝和腐蚀的气味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: My father tried to lead us in 'martial discipline' every morning. It was a farce. I only wish I'd ripped him open sooner. He's so spineless nowadays.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我父亲试着每天早晨都带我们一起，进行"武术训练"。那就是一场闹剧。我要是能早点把他开肠破肚就好了。他现在太没骨气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I've got fishing supplies. Father has useless guilt. Mother's cornered the market in disappointed tutting, and my brother does mindless vandalism. Browse away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我这里有钓鱼用具。"父亲"有没什么用的内疚感。"母亲"被失望的咂嘴声吞没了，而我的哥哥在无脑地搞破坏。随便看看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Look at him. Smirking. He knows what he did. You know he had the gall to call himself a scientist, before Deimos? I remember when he ate mud!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 看看他。皮笑肉不笑。他知道他干了什么好事。你知道在来火卫二之前，他竟然有胆量自称为科学家吗？我可是还记得他小时候吃土的样子呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You know what Grandmother said? 'Just ignore it. Don't rise to it. It's the attention he craves.' As if one day he'll have had enough and he'll just stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你知道祖母说了什么吗？"忽略他就行。别费心思。那是他一直渴望得到的关注。"说的好像有一天他有了足够关注，就会消停似的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: It's magical, isn't it? That first moment when you see the fish glimmering down in the deep, and you know you have to have him. It's just you and the fish, and you forget all about drowning your brother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 很神奇，不是吗？当你看到小鱼儿在深海中闪闪发光的那一刻，你就知道自己一定要拿到它。全世界只剩下了你和小鱼儿，想要淹死你哥哥的想法也被抛之脑后了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I wonder if I'll ever find out what I did. Why he hates me so much. You know what? On second thought, no. He's not that important.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我怀疑自己是否能弄明白我到底干了什么。他为什么这么讨厌我。又想了一下，算了。他没那么重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Ancient Orokin strains. I was meant to seed a new world with them. Burned to cinders for a cheap joke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 古老的奥罗金品种。我本来想和它们一起孵育一个新世界的。结果为了一个低级的笑话被烧成了灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I was just dreaming about you, Ayatan! About how different things would have been if you'd never come here. I'm glad you woke me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我刚才梦到你了，阿耶檀识！梦见如果你没来过这里，事情会变得多么不同。很高兴你把我唤醒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Let's hear the tokens rattle! Put them on your eyes if you like. It's tradition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 让我们来听听石印发出的声响！如果你愿意，可以把它们放在你的眼睛上。这是传统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I used to put black roses all around Loid's skull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我过去常常在洛德的头骨周围摆满黑玫瑰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: When Otak was Otak and had his own shell, I used to put black roses all around his little skull. Tried that with Loid, but he wasn't having it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 当奥塔还是奥塔，就是他还有属于自己的身体时，我常常在他的小头骨周围摆满黑玫瑰。我对洛德也试过同样的事，但他不喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: The Orokin would laugh at Death on Naberus night. I guess the last laugh was Death's. Here's to her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 奥罗金人会在纳贝流士之夜嘲笑死神。我想最后的笑声终归是会属于死神的。敬她一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Scuttle-buttle… whispery-hisspery… chitter-chatter-SNAP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 咚咚哒哒……嘶嘶唏唏……叽叽喳喳——啪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Naberus is meant to be frightening. But if you like bones and blood, it can be fun too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 纳贝流士原本是令人恐惧的。但是如果你喜欢骨头和鲜血，它也可以很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: 'Let the wedding night begin, Lift the latch and let me in, Though I'm only bones and skin'. Oh, the winds of Deimos...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: "新婚之夜尽情开启，抬起门闩许我入邸，虽然鄙人仅存骨骸与陈皮"。哦，那火卫二上的惊惧之风……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Mother wasn't really one for fun. I mostly amused myself dissecting specimens. But I always loved Naberus night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 母亲并不是一个喜欢玩乐的人。我主要是以解剖样本来自娱自乐。但我一直都很喜欢纳贝流士之夜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: I'm a Kubrow this year. Again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 今年，我又装扮成了一只库狛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: It's Naberus! You… do know what that is, right? The ancient Orokin festival of death, darkness and deviance? The happiest time of the entire year? I've dug out all the old family decorations! Take a look. One of them even tells a story...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 是纳贝流士！你……知道那是什么吧？古时候奥罗金关于死亡、黑暗，以及越轨的节日？一整年中最快乐的时刻？我已经把家族所有的旧装饰物都翻出来了！看一下吧。其中一件甚至还有一段故事……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Naberus is all about raising the ghosts of the past. For the immortal Orokin, that meant everything we thought we left behind. Mortality. Mystery. Fear of the dark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 纳贝流士全都是关于唤醒古时亡魂的。对于不死的奥罗金人来说，这代表所有我们认为自己已经遗忘的东西。死亡、神秘力量，以及对黑暗的恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Now, these ghoulish little knick-knacks have been in the family for generations. I can't just give them away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你看，这些令人毛骨悚然的小玩意已经在家族内世代相传了。我不能就这样把它们送人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Happy Naberus!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 纳贝流士节快乐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Go and cause trouble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 去搞点事情出来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Let's keep tradition alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 让我们把传统保留下来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: The darkness is always watching!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 黑暗总是在盯着我们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Careful nothing catches you out there...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 小心点，不要被外面的什么东西发现了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: This… this specimen is a descendent of my original collection. How… how did…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 这……这个样本是我原始样本库的后代。怎么……怎么会……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You didn't incinerate them at all. You...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 你根本没有烧掉它们。你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Promise you won't yell at me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 答应我，你不会朝我大喊大叫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: Dumped them in the exocrine. We can rebuild. They're still out there, and doing quite well it seems. I wanted to wound you, not maim. You're right to hate me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 它们被扔进了外分泌液。我们可以重建。它们还在那里，而且似乎还混得不错。我想让你受点伤，但不是让你残废。你有理由去恨我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: No. I deny you my hatred. Find something else to feed on. Whatever you've become, I am still your sister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 不，我不会恨你的。找点别的东西滋养你吧。无论你变成什么样子，我都是你的妹妹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.text: You are more. I see that now. I name you Kaelli. Water scourge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DDaught.zhText: 我现在明白了，你不仅仅只有这点能耐。我给你取名叫凯莉。水之祸根。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Xata. (Truth). It began long before us, we who now live our perfect and dull, endless lives. It began long before these moon-palaces and body-markets hurling around our golden sun. It began long before our light-coil thinkers, our radiation wars, our oil, smoke. It began with us. The continuity and its twin, wanderlust. The need for unseen shores deep in our marrow. No judge, jester, queen, or king can escape this old blood. We are nomads, eternal. And when no ocean, mountain, or sky could contain us… our gaze hungered star-ward. Afar, they mocked us with their brittle light. Winking and jeering like dangling Ayatans forever out of reach, illuminating the truth: immortal as we are - we die with the sun. That's where I come in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Xata。（真理）。早在我们过着现阶段完美但却永无止境的枯燥生活之前，它就已经出现了。早在这些月宫和身体市场遍布我们金色的太阳之前，它就已经出现了。早在我们的线圈思想家、我们的辐射战争、我们的石油、烟尘出现之前，它就已经出现了。它与我们一同出现。延续性，以及与它成对的探求欲。对那片未知海岸的渴望深藏在我们的骨髓内。无论是法官、小丑、女王，或是国王，他们都无法跳出古老血脉的宿命。我们是永恒的流浪者。当海洋、高山，或是天空都无法容纳我们时，我们便将贪婪的目光投向星际。在很远的地方，它们发出微弱的萤光，眨着眼睛，嘲笑着我们。就像那悬挂着的阿耶檀识 ，永远都那么遥不可及。它们让我明白了一个道理：即便我们是长生不老的，我们也会随着太阳一同消亡。而这正是我想要改变的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Jahu. (Form). My departure was a day less than any other. When I stepped inside the Bell, I saw no crowd through its seriglass. No skeptical onlookers. No regal sendoff. They all had given up on me and my paradoxical formulations. The wasted years had all shown the Void to be just that. Nothing. No energy. No entanglement. No form. To space-faring ambitions, a dead end. On the day, my laboratory was mostly vacant of witnesses, most of all, of expectation. Only my sluggish attendants, my sagacious Kavat, Kalymos, and of course, my daughter. I had raised her alone but with inconsistent vigor. In those eyes, her mother's, I did see a terrible reflection. Of a man that did not exist. A brave and principled man about to make history. In truth, he was a Void himself. An outcast, a joke, a nothing. Driven by my humiliation. Failure had made me bitter and reckless. I would dive into the depths myself to prove them all wrong. I gave the signal. My daughter grasped the lever. Kalymos, then, belted out a desperate, rasping growl. But it was too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Jahu。（形态）。与平日相比，我离去的那天并没有什么不同。当我踏进钟舱时，透过玻璃窗，我没有看到人群。没有表示怀疑的围观者。没有庄严的送别。他们都已经抛弃了我，以及我那些貌似自相矛盾的方程式。荒废了的岁月已经表明，虚空就是虚空。什么都没有。没有能量。没有纠缠。没有形态。这对于探索太空的雄心壮志无疑是一条死胡同。那天，我的实验室基本没什么人来围观，这也和我对实验的预期差不多一致。只有我那行动迟缓的随从、我聪明敏锐的库娃，卡利莫斯，当然，还有我的女儿。我独自把她养大，但投入的精力却不稳定。在那双酷似她母亲的眼睛里，我确实看到了一个可怕的映像。那是一个不存在的人。一个勇敢，讲原则，即将创造历史的人。但事实上，他本身就是一个虚空。我受到的屈辱使我成了一个流浪汉，一个笑柄，一个废物。失败使我变得痛苦和鲁莽。我会亲自进入到虚空深处，来证明他们所有人都错了。我发出了信号。我女儿抓住了控制杆。随后，卡利莫斯发出一阵绝望且又刺耳的咆哮。但这为时已晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Vome. (Order). The calipers yawed open the wall between worlds, stretching there a black, trapezoidal gap. A door. A mouth. It yawned in the light of the room, splintering it to mesmerizing, unearthly hues. And I, inside the Bell, dropping obliquely toward it from my gallows. Mass and time rippled as a sudden vortex jawed before me. My head was vapor, my feet, lodestone. The Bell around me, flexed like a rat paralyzed in a winding, gulping snake. I faltered in the awe of it, stumbling against the seriglass and, with that, shifted the Bell's path through the wall. It grazed the caliper membrane, the edge of the door. No worldly edge was as thin, as sharp as could split even light. As the Bell faintly grazed it, the seriglass was all at once rendered like strips of flesh by Dax blade. My enclosure was beheaded in an instant, but still, I fell… sideways… Into the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Vome。（秩序）。卡钳撑开了那不规则形状的漆黑裂缝，打开了星界之间的大门。一道门。一张嘴。在光芒之中，它缓缓地张开，同时散发出各种迷幻且怪异的色泽。而处于钟之内的我，正从从我的绞刑架上斜身落向它。质量与时间开始波动，宛如一个向我张开大口的漩涡。我头轻如雾，脚重如石。就连那钟舱，也开始弯折，就像是在巨蛇缠绕吞食之下，一只身僵体硬的老鼠。我在惊恐中步履蹒跚，不小心撞到了钟舱玻璃上。而钟舱也因此偏离了原来的运行轨迹。它刮蹭到了卡钳的封膜，那里正是大门的边缘。在这世界上，没有任何东西比这边缘更为锋利，就连光线也会被切开。就在钟舱轻微刮蹭到它之后，防护玻璃就如同被禁卫之刃切开的血肉一般四分五裂。尽管我在刹那间失去了防护罩，但却依然感觉自己在……侧身……落入虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Fass. (Chaos). Death was on me; I was certain. I was face-down, eyes clenched. My heart pulsing the last of its seconds, and my lungs burning the last of its air. A sudden nostalgia gripped me. I grasped desperately, for memory, of a storm, just passed, the fumbling pitch of a child's song… yet all these thoughts seemed to steal away from my mind like smoke through a vent. I would die empty. I then became aware of another sensation. Physical. A web of pain, needles itching into my arm. At once I realized: I was alive! Laying in the Bell's shattered seriglass! I groped the ground. Warm stone. The floor of my laboratory. So: I had never left… and so: I had failed. Again. I heard a crunch alongside me. Someone stepping through the shattered glass. With great shame, I gasped and rose my head to face my daughter above me. But as I opened my eyes, it wasn't her. It was me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Fass。（混乱）。当时，我确信自己必死无疑。我面朝下，闭上了眼睛。我的心脏还在进行着最后几下跳动。我的肺也在消耗着最后那一口气。我的眼前，浮现出了无数记忆中的画面。我拼命想要抓住那些记忆。一场刚刚平息风暴，还有一个孩子笨拙的歌声……然而这些思绪如同流入通风管的烟雾一样离我而去。我本以为自己会这样空虚地死去。然而，另一种感觉却向我袭来。那是真实的感觉。就好像我被卷入一张疼痛之网，无数针头扎进了我的手臂。我立刻意识到：我还活着！现在的我，正躺倒在钟舱的碎片之中！我摸了摸地面。那是温暖的石板，是我实验室的地面。原来，我并没有前往另一个世界……这也表明，我又失败了。这时，我身边又传来了玻璃的挤压声。有人正踩着玻璃碎片向我走来。带着羞愧之情，我一边喘气，一边爬起来，准备面对我的女儿。然而，当我睁开双眼之后，眼前出现的却不是她。而是我自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Ris. (Light). The senselessness of it, the paradoxic, the vague untime form. I was alone, but not. For I stood there confronted by myself. A twin, but no brother. A reflection but with dimension. Behind him, no horizon, but a vast broiling sea of caustic light pierced at random by black-pin stars. And closer, around me, a gale of flowing vapor. Profane in color, billowing relentlessly into the nascent lack, seeking all directions. I was standing on a precipice of familiar stone, jagged and unanchored, as though cleaved directly from the very floor of my laboratory. I wondered at the vapor's path, smoking outward more, leaving behind now, the walls, the filigree gold, the rare cuts of marble from my home. I knew at once the vapor's source. I turned away, back toward the wall, the trapezoid I had yawed into it. Vapor erupted inward at the gap, but not just from there. For as I rolled my eyes back, I saw the same... a great-steam of scintillation, smoking out from my skull. Dumb in awe, I faced toward my chimerical twin. He spoke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Ris。（光明）。它的存在超脱了常理，是一种悖论，一种模糊不定、超脱了时间的形态。我独自一人，但又并非如此。因为我站在这里，面对着自己。看似孪生，但不是兄弟。看似镜像，但又有实体。在他身后，看不到地平线，只有宛如沸腾海洋般的焦散光芒，而那光芒之中，还有零星的黑点。我看了看自己周围，发现有一股雾气。它的颜色有些污浊，同时还不停地翻腾着，朝四周的空隙处涌去。我站在一块由熟悉的石板构成的悬空平台上。这平台的边缘很不规整，就像是从我实验室的地面直接剥离出来的一样。我仍在观察雾气的轨迹。随着气流消散开来，我看到了墙壁、金丝装饰以及我家中的高档大理石。此时，我立刻明白了这雾气的源头。我转过身，朝墙上看去，那里正是我之前穿越通过的不规则形状缺口。雾气正从缺口内散发出来。不过，散发雾气的地方不止这一处。当我拉回视线的时候，我看到了同样的……大量火花蒸汽，正从我的头颅内冒出。在惊愕之余，我扭头朝另一个我看去。他开口说话了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Khra. (Time). An old name, unspoken in the centuries since my mother reared me. A soft hiss, soothing as a viper's gaze. Little Bengel. The other me reached out, offering his hand, gliding toward me without moving, as though the distance between us was now collapsing. A confusion, most euphoric, filled my mind. With the shred of wit that remained, I decided that I should run for my life. At once, crazed and frantic, I fled. But I made no forward progress. Instead, the world compressed evermore around me, as though I were an anchor pulling the shore to reach. When I arrived at the door, or rather, the door arrived at me, I howled, hurling myself inside. Out. And then and there, I was. Lost and unlost. Howling on the floor in harmony with my wretched Kalymos. Lacerated in flesh and heart. Scattered as the bell glass. Spilling blood and stomach on the cold, stone floor. But I sensed the other there, at the wall's breach behind me, reaching still. I screamed, but my voice was gone. Forever. I looked, but my eyes would never see again. I swept my fist across the floor, snatching broken shards. And in gripping tightly, I filled my hands with ink. Close it! I wrote.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Khra。（时间）。他说出了一个尘封的名字。这是几个世纪前，我母亲抚养我的时候才会使用的名字。温柔的唏嘘声，如同毒蛇的凝视，让人心神宁静。小 Bengel。另一个我向我伸出手，一动不动地向我漂浮而来，就好像我们之间的距离在自行坍缩一样。兴奋，夹杂着困惑，充斥着我的头脑。依靠着仅剩的理性，我决定逃跑。于是乎，我开始疯狂地奔跑。但这样做似乎并没有什么效果。相反，我周围的世界愈发向我坍缩，就好像我变成了一个不断拉扯海岸线的巨锚。当我跑到门口时，或者说门口来到我身边时，我大吼着跳进了门。终于逃出来了！在那一刻，我游离于迷失的边缘。在地板上，和我那悲惨的卡利莫斯齐声嚎啕。我身心俱裂，就像那支离破碎的钟舱一样，地砖上则流淌着我的鲜血和呕吐物。但我还感受到了另一个存在，就在我身后墙上的裂口中，依然在朝我伸手。我发出尖叫，但我的声音已经永远消失。我想去看，但我的眼睛却再也看不见了。我用手扫过地面，攥起一把碎片，紧紧握住。墨水，从我的手中涌出。我写下了这几个字：关上它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Netra. (Decay). Time, to us, is all but conquered. Our sacred Kuva moves us on to new skin. We numb to our daily, yearly, trifles… and remedy those memories that bring lasting misery. With all our misdeeds, our excess, our indignity… we are haunted by nothing. But not for me. For with each passing day, there grew within a tumorous idea. It was minute in those early days: The pale reaching digits severed on the floor… studied with reverence, with greed. And it swelled larger in the latter days: the regal domes, the Rail dedications, the unholy Zariman parade. I had put the stars within reach, but at what cost? I never spoke of him, that man, trapped in the wall. And while there have been countless souls who have followed me through, with their light-skippers, and field-wave skins and vari-eyed instruments… not a single one ever saw him. Me. And so it is that I will not take the Kuva now. Or ever again. This is the last skin I'm in. Because of this idea: That I cannot be sure. That in all that smoked commotion, in all that panic and fear, in that bending light and blinding dark… was it I who escaped? Or the other?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Netra。（衰退）。对我们来说，时间已经被完全征服了。神圣的赤毒为我们带来了全新的皮囊。对于每日、每年发生的琐事，我们只是感到麻木……然后对那些充满持久痛苦的记忆进行纠正。我们所有的劣迹，我们的无节制，我们的无礼举动.……没有任何东西能困扰我们。但我却不行。随着时间的推移，我的内心产生了一个病态的想法。一开始，这个想法还难以察觉。地板上苍白笔直的断指……令人敬畏和诱人贪欲的研究对象。而在随后的日子里，它变得越来越清晰：威严的穹顶，航道的奉献，不再神圣的扎里曼阅兵。我让星星不再遥不可及，但付出的代价是什么？我从未提起过他，那个被困在墙里的男人。虽然有无数的灵魂随我走过，还有他们的光速跃迁艇、力场防护服，以及复眼观测仪……但除了我，从未有一个人见过他。所以，我现在不会享用赤毒了。再也不会了。这是我占据的最后一副皮囊了。因为这个想法，我无法确信。在一切的烟雾与骚动中，在一切的不安与惶恐中，在那弯折的光线与刺眼的黑暗中……是我，还是另一个，逃了出来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.text: Lohk. (Void). From brooding gulfs are we beheld by that which bears no name. Its heralds are the stars it fells. The sky and Earth aflame. Corporeal laws are unwrit. As suns and love retreat. To cosmic madness, laws submit. Though stalwart minds entreat. In luminous space, blackened stars. They gaze, accuse, deny. Roiling, moaning, this realm of ours. In madness, lost shall die. Carrion hordes trill their profane accord with eldritch plans. To cosmic forms from tangent planes. We end as we began.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DEntrat.zhText: Lohk。（虚空）。来自沉思之渊的视线，落在了我们身上，其源头为无名之物。掉落的星辰是它到来的先兆。天地燃烧。定律归零。太阳和爱退缩。面对疯狂的宇宙，法则选择了屈服。但那些坚定之人却前去乞求。光明的太空之中，飘荡着焦黑的星辰。它们凝视、指责、否认。我们的世界，沸腾着，呻吟着。在癫狂之中，等待迷失者的只有死亡。诡异的计划让腐尸大军在亵渎的契约中狂热震颤。对于从相切位面演化出的宇宙来说。我们的结局又回到了开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: If they can remember the truth, then they can forgive one another. This will help both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 如果他们能记住真相，那么他们可以彼此原谅。这将对双方都有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: A salve for the bitterness in their hearts. We used to say it dripped from the cracked moon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 治愈他们内心苦难的药膏。我们以前常常说它是从破裂的月球滴落下来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I once thought time would heal, but it's only turned resentment gangrenous. This may serve us better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我曾经以为时间可以治疗一切，但这只会让怨恨变得败坏。也许这更好地支撑我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Take your pick of our cargo! It's precious little use to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 挑点儿我们的货物吧！我们拿它们几乎没什么用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Let's sift through the wreckage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 让我们来筛查一下这些残骸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Such a mess they've made. And I suppose it's down to you and I to tidy up. Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 他们把事情搞得一团糟。我想现在是由你和我来负责收拾了。那么来吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: It is going to be alright. I promise. But the work. Has. To. Be. Done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 一切都会好的。我保证。但工作—必须—要—完成！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Hello, dear. Ready to muck in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 你好，亲爱的。准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Let's have a good old rummage in the medicine chest, shall we? See if we can't set things right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我们去药匣里好好翻翻，可以吗？看看能不能让事情恢复正常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I know what you're thinking. Old and a bit cracked. But still useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我知道你在想什么。这是有点老且还有点坏。但还是有用的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 开始吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Go on, dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Let's you and I have a chin-wag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 咱们来唠会儿嗑吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: This stuff's been in storage for years. I hope it's still good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 这个东西已经闲置很多年了。我希望它还能用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I never could persuade them to throw anything away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我不可能劝他们扔掉任何东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Why they bothered packing all this, I'll never know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 为什么他们要打包这些东西，我永远弄不明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Go on, dear. Have a good rummage around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，去吧。祝你淘到好东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: You make sure you stay safe and snug, dear. Wrap up well. It's a thief and a liar, is Deimos. Steals over girls and boys and Cephalons too like a nasty fog, until all the bright lights in your memory are quite blotted out. That's why they're like that, you see. So much forgotten. Oh, but we mustn't cry over it, never that. Help me bring them back, would you, dear? Remember how it's done. Pinch of this, dab of that; mend a kettle, mend a heart, and it's all one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的宝贝，在这好好待着。裹好自己。火卫二就是个小偷，是个骗子。像一团讨厌的雾气一样，偷偷掠过小男孩女孩还有中枢，直到你记忆中所有的亮光都被抹去了为止。所以他们才会这样，你明白吗？忘记太多东西了。噢，但我们绝不能就此消沉，绝不。帮我把他们带回来，可以吗，亲爱的？记好该怎么做。捏一捏这个，抹一抹那个；修好一个水壶，填补一颗心灵，都没什么区别。我们去药匣里好好翻翻，可以吗？看看能不能让事情恢复正常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Scurry back quick, skippety-hop!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 早点回来，快快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I'll be right here, gathering dust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我会在这里，积灰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Goodbye, dear. I'll see what else I can unearth for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，再见。我会看看还能为你找出些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Always nice to see you. Do stop by again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 见到你总是很高兴。下次再来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: And where have you been scampering, little skitterkin? Hither and yon and round about, and tying knots in the fiend's tail?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 你最近都跑哪去了，小家伙？这里那里的到处跑，又惹什么麻烦了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I do believe it's our little Ayatan. What a pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我相信这就是我们的小阿耶檀识。很高兴见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Dear child. The stories we've told now they're speaking! Great golden armadas rising in the night. Forests of song. And the dreams run clear again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的孩子。现在他们开始交谈了，分享着我们之间的故事！巨大的金色舰队在夜里升起。充满歌声的森林。还有梦境再次清晰起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: They all have names now. I don't think I shall bother with one. I know perfectly well who I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 他们现在都有名字了。我就不用了。我非常清楚我是谁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I wish I could have done something for poor Otak. Though, I suppose he's content, in his own haphazard way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我当初要是能帮上可怜的奥塔就好了。不过，我想他现在也挺知足的， 以他自己那种随性的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Do you know, we're all sitting down to dinner again? They're all talking to one another! And nobody's poisoned anyone for ages!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 你知道吗，我们现在又坐在一块儿吃晚饭了。大家都在互相交谈！而且很久都没人对任何人下毒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: The children are on speaking terms again. This doesn't feel like another of their temporary truces. Something's changed in them both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 孩子们关系又变好了。感觉他们不像是暂时休战。有什么东西改变了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Do you know, they were days away from eating one another's heads off, and I am not speaking metaphorically.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 你知道吗，他们之前就差那么一点就要手足相残了，这句话并不是隐喻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Hold still a moment. Don't be in a hurry to rush off. There. I want to remember you, just like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 保持别动。别急着走。对就这样。我想记住你，就像这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Stripped the sheets from off her bed, Stripped the skin from off his head, Bridegroom's bones she ne'er shall wed, Oh, the winds of Deimos...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 掀起了她床上的被单，刮走了他头上的皮肤，她永远无法嫁给新郎的骨头，哦，火卫二上的飓风……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Poor things. They'd become monuments, you see. Statues raised to their own memory. What sort of a life was that? They're excited now. Talking about what they'll do next, instead of what they did wrong. Bless them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 真可怜。你知道，他们本该成为纪念雕像的。纪念他们自己的雕像。那到底是个什么体验？他们现在很兴奋。一直在谈论他们下一步的计划，而不是反思他们做错了什么。祝福他们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Goodness me. Look at what you did for our little family. You found a poor, lost, broken thing, fallen down the back of the system, and you picked it up and worked to make it better. And thus do we thumb our nose at Master Entropy, stitch by dogged stitch, every day. That's how the work gets done. Now, shall we sit and talk awhile?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我的天啊。看看你为我们这个小家庭做了什么。你找到了一个可怜迷失的，被逐出家门的小东西；然后你把它捡起来，付出努力把它变好。就这样，我们家人还是每天对熵师嗤之以鼻，一针一线地弥补，一点也不着急。这才是办正事该有的样子。现在，我们可以坐下来好好聊聊吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: We are nameless now. Relations existing only in relation. Deimos has stolen more than flesh from us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我们现在都没有名字了。只保持着家族成员之间的关系罢了。火卫二从我们身上偷走的不只是肉体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: My granddaughter's fish were meant to be her legacy, to seed a new world. The boy reduced them to ash and bone splinters. I warned his parents not to neglect him so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我孙女留下的鱼本是她的遗产，是用来繁育一个新的世界的。但"儿子"却把它们化为了灰烬和骨骸。我警告过他的父母，不要这样忽视他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: The 'observations of martial discipline'. How futile. But my granddaughter's ridicule went too far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: "武训监察"。是没用。但我孙女的嘲笑也太过分了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: The boy was rash, no doubt. Gallivanting across Deimos on secret odysseys, coming back with Infested on his trail! Well, he paid for it. Scalded, lashed, and banished from the family archives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 毫无疑问，那小子太轻率了。在火卫二上进行秘密的远征，回来的时候还被感染者跟踪了！唔，他为此付出了代价。烫伤、鞭打，并从族谱中被驱逐出去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: That's quite enough. Foolish old woman. Snap out of it. … I'm sorry, dear, were you saying something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 够了。愚蠢的老女人。振作起来。……抱歉，好孩子，你刚才说了什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: The boy should have known better. With tainted flesh, he mocked his own parents. So his father brought slaughter down, as well he might.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 这孩子应该更懂事点的。他用被污染的肉体，嘲笑了自己的父母。他的父亲开始了屠杀，尽其所能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: The boy clothed Infested beasts as Father and Mother. She blundered into a pit, and mindlessly he followed after, lured by her pheromones! Hit a little too close to home, that did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 那小子把感染者野兽打扮成了"父亲"和"母亲"的样子。她失足掉进了一个坑里，而他被她的信息素引诱着，无脑跟随着她！这操作，简直是我们家的真实写照。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: He's a fine boy at heart, my grandson. Got his head screwed on right. And he's clever enough to know how little he knows. Not like his bloody mother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我的孙子，本质是个好孩子。他办事很有章法。而且很聪明，清楚自己有几斤几两。不像他那该死的母亲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: That woman clings to her seriglass shard like she could wring her lost father out of it. Her husband was a fool to tell her to throw it away. When she carved her anger deep into his flesh, he never once raised his hand to her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 那女人紧紧抓住她的玻璃窗碎片，好像能从里面拧出她失去的父亲似的。她的丈夫是个傻的，叫她扔掉它。当她把愤怒深深地刻在他的肉体上时，他从来没有向她反抗过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Husband and wife! They've not been that for years. Not since she took that shard to him and lacerated him for his insolence. His own children watched him endure it. He did nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 好一对夫妻！他们已经很多年没有这样了，自从她因为他的无礼，用那块碎片割伤他之后，他们就不再亲近了。他的亲骨肉就眼睁睁的看着他忍受着一切，什么也没说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Her first duty was to her family, not to some fatuous dream! If I were her mother… oh, I'm sorry, dear. I didn't mean to take it out on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 她首要的职责是照顾好她的家人，而不是为了什么荒唐的白日梦！我要是她的母亲……啊，对不起孩子。我不是有意当着你的面这么说的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Pay close attention. When you hit the first marker, the timer begins. No turning back after that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 密切注意。当你击中第一个标记时，计时开始。从那之后就没有回头路了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Strike the first marker and the timer shall start. Hit them all - neglect not a one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 击中第一个标记，然后计时开始。把它们全部都击中 — 一个不落！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Once you strike the first marker, the race is begun. It ends when you have struck them all, or else in disgrace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 一旦你击中第一个标记，比赛就会开始。当你将它们全部都击中才会结束，不然你要丢脸了

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Hold fast! Bridle the wind! The aim, dear, is to outstrip your predecessors!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 抓紧！控制风！亲爱的，你的目标是超越前人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Brace yourself! Face straight ahead, bite down, and wrest all good speed from your mount!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 准备好！直面前方，咬紧牙关，然后在你的载具上全速前进！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Weave like a shuttle, dart like a blade. Let swiftness be your watchword!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 如星舰般穿梭，如飞刃般疾驰。让速度成为你的座右铭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Victory steals in upon you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 胜利就在你的眼前了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: So close. Is the fiend at your back?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 差一点。你是被衰神附体了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Knuckle down! Thunder on! But a few remain!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 全神贯注，雷霆之势！还剩一点了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: In and out and round about, a whisper, a flit and away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 进进出出，兜兜转转，一声低语，轻巧掠过，你就离开了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Down the ancient track the riders go, like ghosts racing the dawn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 古道上，骑手离开了，就像那与黎明赛跑的幽灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: So many years gone. They had quicksilver in their veins back then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 这么多年过去了。那时候的骑手们风驰电掣，在极速下像水银般灵活优雅地穿梭着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: And thus the circuit is complete. A most worthy jaunt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 一圈赛道结束。一次值得的短暂之旅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: The wild ride is done. Creditable it was, if not masterly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 狂野之旅结束。这很值得称赞，更何况是这样的高超技艺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Swift you were, indeed, and yet others were swifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 的确，你速度很快，而其他人更快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Magnificent! Etch your path in ribbons of fire as a testament to the ages, for it was kingly!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 漂亮！用火舌作为时代的见证，蚀刻你的前路，那是王者的象征！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I witness this with joy. You have flown like few others have flown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我很高兴见证这一刻。几乎没有人能像你那样飞起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Ha! I salute you, wild rider! Needle-keen and shadow-swift you have proven today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 哈！狂野的骑手，我向你致敬！今天你证明了什么是风驰电掣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: To the heart!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 直冲向"心"！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Through and onward!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 穿过后前进！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Be proud! But not overly so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 骄傲点！但也不要太骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: You'll end up like me if you stand in one place for too long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 如果你在一个地方站太久，你会变得像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I might have a nap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我先歇一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Might I prevail upon you to make a decision, dear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，我能劝你去做个决定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Very well. Return when the time is right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 很好。等时机到了再回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: As you wish. Don't be too cautious, dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 如你所愿。亲爱的，不要太谨慎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: You'll find me here again! And in other places...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 你以后可以在这里找到我！或者在其他地方……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Oh dear. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 哦，亲爱的。没关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Don't fret. We need never speak of this again, dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 不用担心。亲爱的，我们再也不会提起这个了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Goodness. What a catastrophe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 天哪。真是场灾难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Excellent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 非常好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: A sure first step!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 迈出坚定的第一步！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Boldly done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 放手一搏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Well, if you're sure I can't persuade you...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 好吧，如果你确定我不能说服你……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Very well. I'll be here. Waiting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 很好。我会在这里。等候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Of course. Take your time. I quite understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 当然。慢慢来。我很理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Don't fret, dear. We'll find another way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，别担心。我们会找到另一种方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Of course. I quite understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 当然。我很理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Well, we've kept going this long...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 好吧，我们已经坚持了这么久……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Ah well. Can't be helped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 呃，好吧。没办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Hmph. Maybe later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 嗯。下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Help me bring them back, would you, dear? Remember how it's done. Pinch of this, dab of that; mend a kettle, mend a heart, it's all one. Let's have a good old rummage in the medicine chest, shall we? See if we can't set things right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 帮我把他们带回来，可以吗，亲爱的？记好该怎么做。捏一捏这个，抹一抹那个；修好一个水壶，填补一颗心灵，都没什么区别。我们去药匣里好好翻翻，可以吗？看看能不能让事情恢复正常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Lovely. We're all done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 真好。我们完事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Eminently satisfactory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 非常令人满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Plenty more left if you want a second helping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 还剩很多，如果你想要再来一次的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Ooh, that's a potent choice!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 哦，这个选择很有眼光！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: No meddling with the ingredients, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 现在，不要瞎弄这些材料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Oh, do you really think you could? Marvelous!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 哦，你真的认为你可以吗？了不起！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Go on, dear, you're more than ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，继续。你已经准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Now this one has a kick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 这个可带劲了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: I'm fairly sure I've remembered the procedure correctly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我相当确定自己没记错步骤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Do try not to get any blood in it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 尽量不要把血滴在里面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Not what we would have used in my day, but it's not like we have a choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 这不是我们平常所用的东西，不过我们又没有得选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Well… only if you're sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 好吧……只要你确定就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Oh, yes! Unfog the mind and unclog the bowels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 哦，很好！醒脑提神，清道润肠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Of course, it's not conventional medicine. After all, we're stranded on a chunk of septic rock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 当然，这又不是传统医学。毕竟，我们被困在一块腐烂的石头上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: You'd make a magnificent apprentice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 你会成为一个出色的学徒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Medipacks for wounds of the body, this for wounds of the heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 医疗包用于身体上的伤口，而这个用于"心"上的伤口。

[4.0]
Would you like to hear a story for Naberus?
[11.0]
One that I told my grandchildren when they were small? Very well!
[21.0]
Long ago, in the Orokin days, a golden people lived in spoiled luxury.
[30.0]
If a body wore out, why, they would take a new one as easily as plucking a Maprico.
[33.0]
Such was the mystery of the Kuva.
[42.0]
So what became of death and disease? Oh, they were abundant, but not for the Orokin.
[45.0]
They were above petty death.
[52.0]
Such was their contempt that they decreed a special day on which to make fun of it.
[62.0]
On Naberus, the night of memory, the shining people laughed at death.
[71.0]
They dressed in costumes that recalled the old days. Of mortality.
[82.0]
Skulls grinned. Hallways guttered with demon-lights. For one night, beauty was banished.
[87.0]
Rot and monstrosity held sway.
[97.0]
Now on one very special Naberus, three pretty Orokin were bored, as Orokin so often were.
[103.0]
Naberus no longer holds its magic for me, sighed one.
[108.0]
Masks and costumes are for children, grumbled another.
[116.0]
Why follow the crowd, mused the third? Are we not the very elite of the elite?
[129.0]
Haha! Up, my kissingtons, my luscious loves; send for blue Kuva and hot lights; I have a sport that will mend all!
[143.0]
And in the corridor, behind a curtain, a solitary, silent girl heard them and said nothing.
[151.0]
Then the three were very wicked, for what do you think they did?
[165.0]
Down into the streets, they went, and they caught three poor Ostrons and bore them back to their gilded halls.
[178.0]
One, they peeled like a fruit and decked out with glassy splinters, and his naked jaws went chitter-chatter-snap, and it echoed all around.
[183.0]
Scarlet footprints he left.
[189.0]
Another's limbs they twisted, and wrenched his neck, and made a bundle of him,
[200.0]
until he scuttled upsy-downsy like a horrid crab, with his sockets all empty and his stretched-out nose snuffling. 
[205.0]
The third they pulled thin in hand and foot.
[215.0]
She walked spindly-wise on long tiptoes like a spider, and her entrails hung delicately down.
[222.0]
She whispered, split-tongued and hissing, as she went.
[232.0]
Fine costumes we've made, chortled the three Orokin. Let us now try them on, and visit our friends!
[244.0]
What shrieking there will be! Oh! Our names will live forever in the Court, for such a prank as this!
[250.0]
Now. The silent girl brought them their blue Kuva,
[258.0]
so they could take on these twisted bodies for only a short time before returning to their own. 
[266.0]
They drank and slept and woke in their three. Horrid. Forms.
[274.0]
Off they went, down the stairs, out the door, into the city, into the night of banners and masks and wild hilarity.
[279.0]
Chitter-chatter-snap, scuttle-buttle, whispery-hisspery.
[289.0]
As you can imagine, there were many screams and laughs. Such cleverness. Such wit!
[299.0]
But in a high room of the tower, the silent girl looked at the faces of the three sleeping Orokin.
[305.0]
She went and opened a little ivory door that she was not supposed to know about,
[311.0]
and drew forth a flask that she would have been glassed for even looking at.
[320.0]
A flask of crimson Kuva. The scarlet seal upon Continuity. Permanent.
[327.0]
And she tipped it. Down three. Cruel. Throats.
[334.0]
With a little laugh, she went skating away, never to return.
[340.0]
There were many screams that Naberus night. But when the sun came up,
[349.0]
none screamed so loud as the three who found they were trapped in the hideous bodies they themselves had fashioned.
[357.0]
Forever and ever.
[365.0]
So listen carefully, Tenno, and beware. For you may hear them coming tonight.
[369.0]
Whispery-hisspery on long stalking bones,
[373.0]
Scuttle-buttle with his eyes all empty,
[379.0]
And skinless, dripping-handed, chitter-chatter-snap.
[387.0]
Happy Naberus!

你想不想听一个关于纳贝流士的故事？
[11.0]
在我的孙辈们还小的时候，我给他们讲的那个故事？很好！
[21.0]
很久以前，在奥罗金时代，有一族非常成功的人生活在纸醉金迷的奢华之中。
[30.0]
如果有人的躯体衰竭了，那么，他们会像采摘马利可一样，轻而易举地换个新的。
[33.0]
这就是赤毒的奥秘。
[42.0]
那么，死亡和疾病变成什么样了呢？哦，它们还是很常见的，只有奥罗金人例外。
[45.0]
他们不惧怕死亡。
[52.0]
他们对死亡的藐视到了极点，以至于专门规定了一个日子来取笑它。
[62.0]
在纳贝流士来临之际，那追忆之夜，金光闪闪的人们嘲笑着死亡。
[71.0]
他们身着奇装异服，让人想起过去那怀拥死亡的时光。
[82.0]
嘴巴咧开带着笑意的骷髅头。走廊在带有恶魔气息的灯光下显得忽明忽暗。在这个夜晚，美丽不复存在。
[87.0]
腐烂和怪物掌控了一切。
[97.0]
听好，曾经有个很特别的纳贝流士节，那时有三个百无聊赖的奥罗金人，正如他们一如既往的样子。
[103.0]
"纳贝流士对我没有什么吸引力了"，一个人叹了口气。
[108.0]
"面具和奇装异服都是小孩子们的玩意"，另一个人抱怨道。
[116.0]
"为什么我们要随波逐流？"第三个人这样若有所思地问道。"难道我们不是精英中的精英吗？"
[129.0]
"哈哈！起来吧，我的好伙伴，我亲爱的朋友们；快去把蓝色赤毒和无影灯带过来；我想到了一个能让所有人都满意的乐子。"
[143.0]
而就在走廊里，在窗帘的后面，隐藏着一位安静的女孩，她听到了他们的谈话，却没有作声。
[151.0]
那三个人非常邪恶，你猜他们做了什么？
[165.0]
他们仨走到大街上，抓住了三个可怜的 Ostron 人，把这些人带回自己那金碧辉煌的大厅。
[178.0]
其中一个人，被他们像剥果子皮一样地剥去皮肤，并用玻璃碎片装饰起来。他裸露的下巴发出叽叽喳喳的声响，那声音在四周回荡。
[183.0]
他留下深红色的足印。
[189.0]
而另一个人，四肢被他们扭起来，拉脱脖子，整个人被捆成一团，
[200.0]
直到他像一只恐怖的螃蟹一样，带着完全空了的眼眶，还有被拉长了的、抽着气的鼻子，一上一下地逃窜。
[205.0]
至于第三个人，手和脚都被他们拉得细长。
[215.0]
她就像一只蜘蛛一样，只能用拉长的脚尖踮着走路，而她的脏器微微地垂下来。
[222.0]
她一边走一边低声说着话，口齿不清，嘶嘶作响。
[232.0]
"我们做出来的套装简直太棒了。"三个奥罗金人哈哈大笑，"让我们现在把它们穿上，去走亲访友吧！"
[244.0]
"那将会引起多大的尖叫声啊！噢！ 我们将因如此美妙绝伦的恶作剧，名垂青史！"
[250.0]
这时，那个安静的女孩把蓝色赤毒拿给了他们。
[258.0]
这样，他们就能只占据这些奇形怪状的躯体一小会，然后再回到自己的身体上。
[266.0]
他们饮下，睡去，又醒来，变成了三个恐怖至极的模样。
[274.0]
他们离去，下楼，出门，进城，进入了充满着条幅、面具，以及狂欢的夜晚。
[279.0]
咚咚哒哒……嘶嘶唏唏……叽叽喳喳——啪！
[289.0]
可想而知，当时的尖叫声和笑声此起彼伏。如此的聪明，如此的智慧！
[299.0]
但在塔楼高层的房间里，那位安静的女孩看着三个奥罗金人陷入沉睡的脸庞。
[305.0]
她走向一扇小象牙门，并打开了那扇她不应该知道的门。
[311.0]
随后她取出了一个烧瓶，一个仅仅看上一眼，就会让她受惩罚变成玻璃的瓶子。
[320.0]
那是一瓶深红色的赤毒。封印着代表延续的深红色，效用是永久性的。
[327.0]
她把它倒进了，那三个，暴徒们的，喉咙里。
[334.0]
笑了一下，她就溜走了，并且再也没有回来。
[340.0]
在那个纳贝流士之夜，尖叫声不绝于耳。但是当太阳升起时，
[349.0]
没有谁比那三个人的尖叫还要大声，因为他们发现，自己被困在了他们精心打造的恐怖躯体里。
[357.0]
直到永永远远。
[365.0]
所以听好了，Tenno，要当心。因为今晚，你可能会听到他们到来的声音。
[369.0]
嘶嘶沙沙是长长直立的骨头悄然靠近，
[373.0]
咚咚哒哒是空洞的眼眶藏在附近，
[379.0]
然后就是没有皮肤覆体，血淋淋的手，在叽叽喳喳——啪。
[387.0]
纳贝流士节快乐！

[7.5]
There was once a Dax cavalrywoman, the lover of an Orokin couple named Corphel and Irilia.
[12.5]
What was her name? We do not know, for they never used it.
[24.2]
They called her by many pet names, though, for an exotic pet she was to them. Little Sweetness. Tender Petal. Wild Rider.
[32.2]
Had a mere Dax been known to be engaging in relations with her betters, she would have been executed on the spot.
[39.3]
But the couple's power and influence were such that the affair would never be publicly addressed.
[45.4]
Still they feared to use her name, for names have power.
[56.5]
Many gifts they gave her. Fine armor. Rubedo rings. And a horse of her own, on the condition that she never, ever named it.
[71.4]
Names were for people, not possessions. So long as it remained a mere nameless thing, she would never love it more than them.
[92.0]
But the rider could not bear to deny her friend the simple kindness of a name. So she whispered into its ear: you are Rakhali, freshness-after-rain.
[99.4]
And just as the couple had feared, she came to love the horse dearly.
[111.7]
This was intolerable to them. The horse had to go. An accidental impalement was arranged. 
[125.3]
But fate played a cruel trick, and both rider and horse were impaled. Corphel and Irilia hastened to her side. 
[132.5]
Ignoring the dying horse, they fretted over their lover as she coughed blood. 
[148.2]
Continuity was out of the question. In desperation, they turned to a certain… expert, and pleaded with him to let her live forever.
[165.3]
He returned the rider to them, transformed to a warrior of living steel. Her sweet and pretty face looked upon them with a smile that would never fade. 
[175.5]
For all their talk of 'forever', they wearied of her immediately. Now that the relationship was no longer taboo, they abandoned it. 
[183.8]
Parties became awkward when the rider stood vacantly by, useless as an abandoned doll. 
[187.9]
She had to go, they agreed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText:
[7.5]
从前，有一名禁卫女骑士，她是一对名为科费尔和伊莉亚的奥罗金夫妇的情人。
[12.5]
她的名字是什么？我们不知道，因为他们从来没有用过她的名字。
[24.2]
他们给她起了很多昵称，因为对他们来说，她就像一种珍稀的宠物。"小甜心"、"绵软花瓣"、"野性骑手"。
[32.2]
只是一个区区禁卫的她如果被发现与上流人士有染，她将会立即被处决。
[39.3]
但这一对夫妇的权势和影响力大到足以让这件事永远不会被公之于众。
[45.4]
尽管如此，他们依然害怕用她的名字，因为名字具有力量。
[56.5]
他们送给她许多礼物。精美的盔甲、红化结晶戒指，还有一匹只属于她的马，但有一个条件：她永远不得为它命名。
[71.4]
因为名字是给人的，而不是给物品的。只要它没有名字，她就永远会更爱他们而不是它。
[92.0]
但良心使然，这名骑士无法忍心不给她的朋友一个名字。于是她对它耳语道："你是拉卡里，含义是雨后的新鲜空气。"
[99.4]
正如这对夫妇所害怕的，她深深地爱上了这匹马。
[111.7]
这对他们来说是无法忍受的。必须除掉这匹马。于是他们安排了一场意外刺杀。
[125.3]
但命运却开了一个残酷的玩笑，骑士和马都被刺穿了。科费尔和伊莉亚赶到她的身边。
[132.5]
他们无视垂死的马，只关心他们咳血的爱人。
[148.2]
续命已不再可能。在绝望中，他们找到了某位……专家，恳求他让她永生。
[165.3]
当他把她还给他们时，这名骑士已经变成了一个活生生的钢铁战士。她用甜美而漂亮的脸庞看着他们，脸上挂着永不会消失的微笑。
[175.5]
尽管他们曾口口声声说"永远"，他们却立即厌倦了她。现在这段恋情已不再是禁忌，他们抛弃了它。
[183.8]
在聚会上，当这名骑士茫然地站在一旁，就像一只被丢弃的玩偶，气氛就会变得尴尬。
[187.9]
她必须死，他们一致认为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text:
[15.0]
So arrangements were made with a master of industry, and the rider - all unknowing - accompanied the couple to a facility.
[36.5]
She lay down obediently when instructed, showed no emotion when the restraints clamped her limbs, and made not a sound when the full force of the dissolution beam blazed through her head and out of the back of her steel skull. 
[51.4]
The couple were satisfied. Their sentimental mistake was dead, and furthermore, the smiling doll's face was erased. Now they could erase it from their memory.
[66.1]
I doubt I need to tell you what faceless thing clambered jerkily from the facility's waste disposal heap, in the still of a Naberus night. 
[74.4]
How she sought for her Dax Nikana, and found only the overseer's whip-blade.
[85.0]
Confused, vacant, she wandered. Why was she alone? Where was her loyal Rakhali? 
[95.4]
She reached deep into despair and memory, and summoned up a ghost-horse to run alongside her on the night winds. 
[102.1]
Now, at least, she was no longer alone.
[111.8]
She groped for other memories, came up with hands overflowing with betrayal. 
[122.5]
When the morning sun rose on Corphel and Irilia, they were faceless too, and quite still.
[133.2]
After that, she wandered without purpose, and the legend of the hollow rider grew. 
[138.0]
And so we come to my part in her story.
[146.3]
You must understand, dear, that it is terribly bad luck to be out on Naberus with no gift to give a reveler.
[159.4]
And yet that was my plight as I stood, my old bones aching, before the dreadful figure on the road, many years ago.
[182.6]
"I have no face," the figure before me seemed to say, in a whispering voice that spoke in my mind. "I have no name. Only a need. And you come before me empty-handed this Naberus night?"
[209.0]
"I do have one thing to give, if it please you," I said to her. "My name. When you ride away, you shall be Dagath. And I shall be only Grandmother."
[223.6]
And that is the story of how I lost my name, and kept my head, though many others have since lost theirs. 
[232.6]
For with her name came a new purpose. Dagath, you see, means 'the mirror that accuses'. 
[249.0]
They say that none now can look into the gulf where once her face was, without their own sins rising to accuse them, and a swift, sharp sentence following.
[255.9]
A happy Naberus to you all!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText:
[15.0]
于是他们与一位业界大师作了安排，这名毫不知情的骑士随他们夫妇来到了一处设施。
[36.5]
她乖乖地按照命令躺下，当束缚装置夹住她的手脚时，她没有流露出任何情感，当解体光束全功率穿过她的头部并从她的钢铁头骨的后部射出时，她没有发出任何声音。
[51.4]
这对夫妇觉得很满意。他们的情感污点已经死了，而且那张永远微笑的玩偶脸也被抹去了。现在他们可以将它从记忆中抹除了。
[66.1]
我相信我无需告诉你，在纳贝流士之夜，是哪个无脸的东西从设施的废物处理堆里笨拙地爬出来的。
[74.4]
她又是如何寻找着她的禁卫侍刃，却只找到了监工的鞭刃。
[85.0]
带着困惑、茫然，她四处徘徊。为什么她独自一人？她忠诚的拉卡里在哪里？
[95.4]
她深入到绝望和记忆的深处，召唤出一匹幽灵马，在夜风中与她一同疾驰。
[102.1]
现在，至少她不再孤单。
[111.8]
她寻找其他的记忆，却发现满手都是背叛。
[122.5]
当早晨的阳光照在科费尔和伊莉亚身上时，他们也没有了脸，一动不动。
[133.2]
从那以后，她继续无目的地游荡，空洞骑士的传说越传越广。
[138.0]
这就引出了我在她故事中的角色。
[146.3]
你必须明白，亲爱的，在纳贝流士之夜，如果没有礼物送给狂欢者，那将是非常不吉利的。
[159.4]
然而多年前我的处境正是如此，当我站在那条路上面对那个可怕的身影时，连我的老骨头都在隐隐作痛。
[182.6]
"我没有脸，"站在我面前的身影似乎在我的脑海中低语道，"我没有名字，想要的只有一个。而你在纳贝流士来之夜到我面前，却什么也没有带来？"
[209.0]
"如果你愿意，我确实有一样东西可以给你，"我对她说。"我的名字。当你离去时，你将被称为 Dagath。而我将仅仅是'祖母'。"
[223.6]
这就是我如何失去我的名字，并保住我脑袋的故事，不过后来有许多其他人失去了他们的脑袋。
[232.6]
因着她的名字而来的，是全新的使命。你看，Dagath 意味着"控诉的镜子"
[249.0]
据说如今谁若凝视她脸庞曾经所在的那片深渊，都会感觉到自己的罪恶像潮水般涌出控告他们，紧随其后便是一道迅速且犀利的制裁。
[255.9]
祝大家纳贝流士快乐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: We never see the stars here. But tonight, we'll remember them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 我们在这里从来看不到星星。但是今晚，我们会记住它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: And so the fog clears, little by little, and the heart remembers. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 就这样，雾一点一点消失，而"心"也会铭记。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: You're bringing them back. To one another and to me. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 你把他们带回到彼此的身边，也带回到我的身边。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Perch and bide with me a while now, dear one. The task is well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，和我一起坐下来等候一会儿吧。这次的任务做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: And not a moment too soon. Bravo, dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 正正好好赶上了。亲爱的，好极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Excellent. Dutiful and prompt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 了不起。尽职又麻利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Oh, magnificent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 哦，太好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: Thank you, dear. Very kind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 亲爱的，谢谢你。非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.text: May you have much joy of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DGrandm.zhText: 愿你为此感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: You there: You may prove useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 那边儿的，对，就是你：你或许能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: The arrival of the Tenno is fortuitous. I would capitalize upon it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: Tenno 的到来实属意外。我可要好好利用这个机会。
