/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I have work for you, if you are so inclined.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 如果你愿意，我可以给你一些工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: There is much to be done here on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 火卫二上有很多事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: You there. You are here to assist, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 喂。你是来协助我的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I have bounties, should you have the interest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 如果你有兴趣的话，我这里有一些赏金任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Very well then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Disappointing. May you reconsider.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 真令人失望。希望你重新考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: So be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I do appreciate one who is not afraid of a little work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我很欣赏一个不怕辛苦的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: This moon requires a curious mind and a firm hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 这个卫星期待着拥有好奇的心灵和坚强的臂膀的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: So be it, let's see what you're made of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 那就这样吧，让我们看看你的实力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: There is so much to be done here on Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 在火卫二上有很多事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: You are here to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 你是来帮忙的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Yes, there are bounties... if you have the interest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 是的，这里有些赏金任务……如果你有兴趣的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: This is not how I would have chosen to welcome a colleague, but embarrassment is a luxury I discarded long ago. Frankly, my daughter is an entitled, self-pitying whelp, my son, an arrogant upstart, and my husband, a mealy-mouthed relic of his old self. Every last one of them has let me down. You may find them useful; I barely find them tolerable. If I can count upon your loyalty, we will work well together. I intend to tame this place, and you can help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 若换做是我，我可不会这样对待自己的同僚。不过，尴尬这种情感，对我而言也只是一件从很久以前就被抛弃的奢侈品。坦白来说，我女儿是一个小有所成却又自怨自艾的黄毛丫头，我儿子，狂妄自大的暴发户，还有我丈夫，说话拐弯抹角的老古董。他们所有人都让我失望透顶。或许你认为他们还有些许用处，但我对他们的忍耐已经快到极限。如果你的忠诚值得我依靠，那我们就能好好合作。我打算将这里驯服，而你可以协助我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Yes, goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 是的，再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Very well. I am reasonably certain I shall see you again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 很好。我确定我会再见到你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: If that concludes our business I shall bid you farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 如果我们的事儿办完了，我就向你道别了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Until our next appointment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 下次见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: On Deimos, be aware of all things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 在火卫二上，要小心所有东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 确实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Of course this place is harsh. It's testing us. You have to be harsher still. Look it in the eye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 当然，这里是一个严酷的地方。它在考验我们。你得比它更狠才行。直视其眼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: No time wasted in idle talk. Good. If people want to stand around gossiping, they can go to Grandmother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 没时间浪费在闲聊上了。很好。如果人们想闲站着聊天，那他们可以去"祖母"那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Interested in bounties, are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 你对赏金很感兴趣，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I trust you are prepared to get your hands dirty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我相信你已经准备好亲自动手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Together, we will pacify this moon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 携起手来，我们将平定这颗卫星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Back again. How enterprising.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 又回来啦。挺有上进心的嘛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: My Ayatan!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我的阿耶檀识！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: You are an enviable ally, Tenno. Diligent, loyal, reliable. My father would have approved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: Tenno，你是一个令人羡慕的盟友。勤奋、忠诚、可靠。我的父亲也会认同的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: My father was only a man, in the end. As is my husband. They all have their flaws and their frailties.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 说到底，我的父亲只是一个男人。和我丈夫一样。他们都有自己的缺点与脆弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Grandmother would never take anyone's side. I despised her for that. I never once considered what such detachment must have cost her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: "祖母"永远不会站在任何人那边。我鄙视她这样的行为。我从来没有考虑过，她为这样的离群一定付出了不少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Kermerros has become quite the scientist. I should have nurtured that hunger, but I punished him for it. Because it wasn't part of my "grand" plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 克梅罗斯已经成为一名很不错的科学家。我本该培养那种欲望，但我为此惩罚了他。因为它不属于我的"宏大"计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Loid and Otak never deserved any of this. In my darkest moments I believed even they were conspiring against me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 洛德和奥塔从来都不配得到这些。在我最黑暗的日子里，我甚至觉得它们在密谋害我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: There you are again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 又见到你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Ah, it is you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 啊，是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Another bounty, is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 再做个赏金任务，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Have you come here for your latest assignment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 你是为了最新的任务来的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I am named, and my light is my own. It is not a debt I owe to the dust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我有名字了，我的光属于我自己。这些都不是我欠谁的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I do not know that we are happy, Tenno. I am not sure we ever were. But it seems we are all far less fond of idle cruelty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: Tenno，我不知道我们其实是幸福的。我都不确定我们是否曾经幸福过。但是似乎我们都不那么喜欢这毫无价值的残忍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: My behaviour has been suboptimal, Tenno. I accept that. It has not been easy to swallow my... pride... and admit my... mistakes... but without you, it might never have happened at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: Tenno，我的行为不太恰当。我承认。放低我的……自尊心和承认我的……错误，都不是件容易的事情。但如果不是因为你，这可能永远都不会发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: My son will no doubt complain to you. He thinks I was too strict with him. Perhaps I was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 毫无疑问，我儿子会向你抱怨。他认为我以前对他过于严格。或许确实如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: One shard of seriglass is all I have left of my father. But it's all I need to find him again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 这是我父亲留下的唯一一块玻璃窗碎片。不过，只要有它，我就能再次找到我的父亲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: They all knew! They came willingly! They accepted the risks! And now they blame me? Now they turn on me? Don't you think of betraying me, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 他们当初都知道！他们是自愿来到这里的！他们都愿意承担风险！可现在他们却怪罪于我？与我反目成仇？你可别背叛我啊，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Welcome, Tenno. There is no doormat, but feel free to wipe your feet on my husband. He won't dare stop you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 欢迎，Tenno。这里没有门垫。如果你有需要，可以随时在我丈夫身上蹭鞋子。他不敢阻止你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I admire your proactiveness. This family could learn something from you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我很欣赏你的积极性。这个家里的人应该多向你学学。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I can't say I blame you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我并不怪你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Perhaps it's just as well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 也许这样也好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Yes, definitely the better part of valor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 嗯，谨慎总好过鲁莽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Not for the faint-hearted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 不适合胆小的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I hesitate to even ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我不知道当问不当问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: You might consider bringing friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 你可以考虑带上你的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Good and faithful, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 你要又良善又忠心，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Excellent. Report back with your results.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 非常好。回头过来报告你的任务结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I look forward to your return, as do we all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我和大家一样，都期待着你的归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: This place truly has a life of its own. Your aid in studying and controlling it is forever welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 这个地方确实有自己的生命力。随时欢迎你帮助我们来研究和掌控它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: And how have the day's adventures been proceeding? Kaelli and Kermerros tell me good things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 今天的成果如何？凯莉和克梅罗斯给我带来了一些好消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Short notice, I appreciate that, but I would benefit from your assistance at this time. What say you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 这可能有些突然，我很感谢，不过这一次，我还需要你的协助。你愿意帮忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: You wish to negotiate? Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 你想谈判？很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Let us speak then, perhaps as equals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 那么或许让我们，平等对话吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Earning the trust of this family is no small thing, small thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 小家伙，获得这个家庭的信任并非易事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Come, stand before me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 过来，站在我面前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Of course! I very much enjoy our talks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 当然！我很享受我们之间的对话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Shall we come to an arrangement?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我们可以达成一致了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I am open to dialogue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我洗耳恭听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 也许吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Let us negotiate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 咱们商量一下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Excellent. This is to our mutual benefit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 太好了。这是为了我们的共同利益。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: This is agreeable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 可以接受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: You have yourself a deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: No. I refuse to accept this. My shard…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 不，我拒绝接受这个。我的碎片……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Just one of thousands, dear. Nothing special.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 同样的东西还有数千个呢，亲爱的。这没什么特别的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Be kind. She knew, once. Deimos stole the memory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 友善点。她曾经知道过，不过不是现在罢了。火卫二把记忆偷走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: It's not some mystical relic of Grandfather.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 这不是什么"外祖父"的神秘遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: It's just a bit of glass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 那只不过是一小块玻璃罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: It's all I have left!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我剩下的只有它了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: Is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: … no. Father, I release you. Let me live for the sake of the living.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: ……不。"父亲"，我要向前看了。让我为了活着的人而活吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.text: I name you Gomaitru. The goblet refilled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DMother.zhText: 我为你取名叫戈迈特鲁。酒盏又满溢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.text: The atmo's pulsing today, friend. Just smell those pheromones. Bring me back a little something, what do you say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.zhText: 今天的空气有些躁动不安，朋友。那些费洛蒙激素的气味真是太冲了。帮我去带点儿东西回来吧，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.text: Hey friend. Round up some Infested for the ingested, if you wouldn't mind? I'd do it myself, but… I'm physically inconvenienced. Just mind the Predasites. Like any good antibody they'll take you out if they can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.zhText: 嘿，朋友。如果你不介意的话，能帮我们围捕一些感染者？我本想自己来的，但是……我这样子不太方便。只是要小心扑猎达赛。像任何好的抗体一样，它们会尽一切可能送你上路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.text: Oh. Hey. Heading for the ventricle? If you find an interesting sample or two out in the chamber - say, a Vulpaphyla or an Avichaea - I'd love a closer look. I can kit you out so it's a more pleasurable experience?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.zhText: 哦，嘿！你要去心室吗？你要是在心房里找到一两个有意思的标本的话——比如，一只狐帕菲拉，或是一只古羽鸟——我会很乐意好好研究一下的。我可以给你准备一些装备，让你有一趟更愉快的旅程？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.text: Am I to understand from your swagger that you intend to venture out there and bring something exotic in here? Excellent. Let's talk equipment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonBar.zhText: 我是不是可以从你的狂妄中理解到，你打算去那里探险，然后带回一些异域风情的东西？很好。来聊聊装备的事吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: This one's an adult.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 这只成年了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Fully grown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 完全成熟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Made it to adulthood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 生长至了成年期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Barely developed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 尚未发育。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Still has some growing to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 还有发育的空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A mere neonate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 还是个幼崽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: It is a thrill to watch you at work. A shame I have to cheapen it by paying you… but pay you I shall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 看你工作的样子可真让人兴奋。可惜我付给你的报酬贬低了它的价值……不过我必须付给你报酬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Oh, they're off to the happy land of dreams. Stand by. Reward incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 哦，它们要去梦境中的快乐国度了。准备好，奖励就要来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Didn't feel a thing, did you? A rare mercy on Deimos. Your fee, bold hunter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 什么也没感觉到，是吗？火卫二上难得的恩惠。这是你的报酬，勇敢的猎人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Contaminated. But not unworthy of affection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 被污染了，但还是值得被喜爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: There, there. Whatever nightmare spawned you, you're ours now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 乖，乖。不管你是从哪个噩梦中生出来的，你现在是我们的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: You understand Deimos like few others, hunter. I sense we are alike in that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 猎人，像你这么了解火卫二的人很少。这是我们之间的共同点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: I'm sure this one put up a fight. Well done for bringing it in alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 我确定这只激烈反抗过了。你把它活着带回来了，干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Better clean it up. It's crawling with spores, but then, which of us isn't?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 最好把它弄干净。它身上爬满了孢子，不过话说回来，我们又何尝不是呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: I hope you immersed yourself in the pleasure of the hunt. It's the chief reward! Naturally, you will be paid, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 我希望沉浸在狩猎的乐趣里。这可是最棒的奖励！当然，你也会得到应有的报酬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Welcome to our little menagerie. Outcasts, strays and foundlings all welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 欢迎来到我们的小型动物避难所。遭到驱逐的、流浪的，还有遗弃的都欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: I wonder what you will teach us, my malformed friend? And for you, the agreed sum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 我想知道你会教会我们什么呢？畸形的小家伙？至于你 Tenno，你会收到说好的报酬的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Well done. Another adorable bundle of mutated flesh plucked from the harsh face of Deimos and given a new, caring home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 做得好。又有一只可爱的变异肉体组合被从环境恶劣的火卫二中解救出来，并获得了一个新的、充满爱心的家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Very well done, Tenno. Once it recovers from the sedation, it'll think itself in paradise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: Tenno，做得很好。一旦它从麻醉中醒来，它就会觉得自己到了天堂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Now this is a rarity. A Viscid Avichaea! Strange that something so glutinous and sticky should take to the sky with such easy grace, but then, Deimos is a place of aberrations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 这可真罕见。一只粘质古羽鸟！奇怪的是，如此黏糊糊的东西居然能如此轻松地飞上天，火卫二实在是一个诡异的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Where did you find this lovely specimen? You've done well. Bringing in a Viscid Avichaea is no task for a beginner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 你是在哪里找到这只可爱样本的？你做得很好。对一个初学者来说，捕获粘质古羽鸟不是什么易事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: We may capture the Viscid Avichaea, Tenno, but we can never tame it. Such winged, gluey beauty belongs to the wild, forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: Tenno，我们也许能捕获粘质古羽鸟。但我们永远无法驯服它。这种长着翅膀的美丽粘性生物，永远属于大自然。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: My, my. A Caustic Cryptilex. A little miracle of digestion. The stuff these critters secrete can burn through a Landing Craft's hull. I hope you handled it carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 不会吧，不会吧。一只腐蚀隐疾虫。一个消化系统的小奇迹。这些小动物的分泌物可以烧穿登陆艇的舰体。我希望你能小心处理它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: I'm surprised to see you caught a Caustic Cryptilex, Tenno. They can be a headache to subdue. Well, you seem none the worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: Tenno，我很惊讶看到你抓到了一只腐蚀隐疾虫。要降伏它们可真让人头疼啊。看起来你做得还不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Grandmother used to squeeze the juice out of these to burn off 'warts'. Of course, what we all thought were warts turned out to be something a bit worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: "祖母"过去常常用这些动物榨出的汁来去除"疣"。只不过我们都以为是疣，但其实是更糟糕的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: The Scarlet Nexifera. Rare, striking, unforgettable. The pendulous glory of Deimos. And you captured it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 猩红悬匿兽。很难得，太震撼了，真令人难忘。火卫二上令人垂涎的荣耀。而你竟然抓住它了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Oh, this is a tricksy creature. They knocked me off my feet many times, back in the days when I had feet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 噢，这只很棘手。在我还有脚的日子里，它们击倒了我好多次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A Medjay Predasite! I should paint your picture with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 守卫扑猎达赛！我应该把你和它画下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A Medjay Predasite. As noble and regal in bearing as anything can be on this twisted flesh-pit of a moon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 一只守卫扑猎达赛。在这个烂肉横生的卫星上，有什么东西能比得上它的高贵和庄严。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: What a magnificent creature. I want to rest my cheek against its chest and listen to its entrails stirring in its sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 多么壮丽的生物啊。我想把我的脸颊贴在它的胸前，然后听着它的内脏在睡梦中搅动的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A Howler Undazoa. I shall assemble a little choir of these, I think. My own chorus of the damned, to sing me to sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 一只尖啸水螅履虫！我想我该将它们集结一个小合唱团的。属于我的诅咒之团，来唱歌伴我入眠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: One doesn't often hear a Howler Undazoa, much less see one. I fear for the day they have all been eaten, and Deimos will forever be deprived of their dulcet shrieks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 人们很少会听到一只尖啸水螅履虫的叫声，更别说看见一只。我担心有一天它们都被吃掉了，而这些尖啸声则会从火卫二上永远地消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Did it scream for you, Tenno? Did you find it unpleasant? I confess, its voice pulls at something deep within me. My infested bodily organs, I suspect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: Tenno，它有向你尖叫吗？你有没有觉得很不舒服？我承认，它的声音击中了我内心深处的某些东西。我怀疑是我的感染者身体器官在作祟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: So, you bagged the rare and elusive White Velocipod, all on your lonesome. That seems a little like showing off. I approve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 看来，你一个人就抓住了一只罕见、并擅长隐藏的白色迅敏节虫。你是在显摆吧。我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A White Velocipod! Quite an achievement to bring one of those down without killing it. Excellent work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 一只白色迅敏节虫！在不杀死它的情况下，使它倒下真是不容易。非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: What a beauty. I salute your efforts. You didn't try to tranq a Velocipod while riding another Velocipod, did you? Don't. I watched someone try. It usually doesn't end well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 太美了。我赞赏你的努力。你没有在骑着一只迅敏节虫的情况下，试着麻醉另外一只迅敏节虫吧？不要那么做。我看过有人那样做。通常都没有什么好结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: I expect this one took some dedication to bring down. Let's not tell Father you've got it. He'd only want to peel its armored hide off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 我想这家伙一定是你历经千辛万苦才捕获的。我们不要告诉"父亲"你已经捕获了它。他只会想要把它的盔甲扒下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: The rare and exquisite Panzer Vulpaphyla! Oh, there are some old scars here. Just imagine what it must have endured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 罕见而又优美的铁甲狐帕菲拉！哦，这里有一些老的疤痕。想象一下，它一定是经历了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: I don't often see a Panzer Vulpaphyla. Look how well it's adapted to living here. Thick armor and a killer instinct.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 我很少看到铁甲狐帕菲拉。看，它可真适应这里的生活。厚厚的盔甲外加杀手的本能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: You've brought down a Sporule Avichaea in one piece. I'm impressed. They're delicate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 你捕获了一只完好无损的孢子古羽鸟。我很满意。它们很精美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: The Sporule Avichaea. Infested though it is, it still soars.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 孢子古羽鸟。虽然受到了感染，但它仍在飞翔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: You have to take care transporting these. A few stray spores in the wrong place doesn't sound like much, but… well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 你必须小心运输这些东西。在错误的地方出现零星的孢子，这听起来似乎不算什么， 但是……唔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A Septic Cryptilex. I confess, I'm deeply fond of these obnoxious little pests.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 一只脓化隐疾虫。我承认，我很喜欢这些令人讨厌的小害虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Deimos isn't about to run out of these any time soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 这些东西不会很快就从火卫二上消失的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: I've got a nice clump of Ganglions for this little one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 我为这个小家伙准备了一簇漂亮的神经节囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A Viridian Nexifera. Tether neatly snapped. Enviable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 铬绿悬匿兽。绳索齐齐地咬断了。令人称羡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: It'll be fine here. I have plenty of Cryptilex to feed it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 应该没什么问题。我有足够的隐疾虫喂它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Look at those gas ducts twitching in its sleep! Lethal little bundle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 看看那些在它睡觉时抽动的气囊！看着不大却及其致命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A Pharaoh Predasite. Menacing in the field. Rather adorable when asleep, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 一只法老扑猎达赛。平时很凶猛。但睡着后却很可爱，你不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: When the Pharaoh Predasite goes to sleep, so do all its little parasites. Awww.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 当法老扑猎达赛入睡的时候，它所有的小寄生虫也会入睡嗷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: One less Pharaoh Predasite active in the wild. There are things with too many legs that will sleep easier tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 又少了一只活跃在野外法老扑猎达赛。某种腿很多的家伙今晚将会睡得比较轻松了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Ah. There's nothing to equal the earthy, rich bouquet of a Vaporous Undazoa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 啊。没有什么能比得上幻雾水螅履虫那浓郁的泥土芳香。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: What is that smell, redolent of a Grineer locker room with hints of horse meat and ketones?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 那是什么味道，Grineer 更衣室混合着马肉和酮类的芬芳？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: No matter how long you spend on Deimos, you never quite get used to the... ripeness... of a Vaporous Undazoa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 无论你在火卫二上呆了多久，你都完全无法适应……幻雾水螅履虫的……成熟老练。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A Green Velocipod. Gorgeous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 一只绿色迅敏节虫。美丽极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Not the most dangerous creature on Deimos, nor the rarest. But certainly one of the most useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 不是火卫二上最危险的生物，也不是最稀有的。但肯定是最有用的生物之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Ah, Green Velocipods. Proof that not everything on Deimos wants to eat you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 啊，绿色迅敏节虫。这可以证明不是所有火卫二上的动物都想吃了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: A fine specimen of the Crescent Vulpaphyla.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 月刃狐帕菲拉的精美样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: Can you believe the Grineer snap the horns off these beautiful lifeforms? Appalling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 你能相信 Grineer 会把角从这些美丽的生物身上折下来吗？真是骇人听闻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.text: This specimen must have looked majestic in the wild.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonCat.zhText: 这个样本当初在野外看起来一定很威风。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonFir.text: My family may choose to live in witless denial of our condition, but I accept it. Deimos is my mistress, whether I chose her or not. Her bitter kisses fester in my veins. Witness, Tenno. We are truly become one flesh. I crave to understand her for myself. Whatever you need to provide me samples of her processes and function - wildlife - I will provide. But, if I am to understand them, I require them intact. You sedate them, I shall arrange retrieval, you shall be rewarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonFir.zhText: 我的家人或许会愚昧地否认我们的现状，但我却愿意坦然接受它。无论是否是我选择了火卫二，她都是我的爱人。她那苦涩的亲吻在我的血管中溃烂。见证这一切吧。Tenno。我们已经真正地化为一体。我迫切地想要去了解她。我可以向你提供任何东西，只要你给我她在代谢过程中，所产生的样本——也就是那些野生动物。不过，如果我要了解它们，那它们就必须毫发无损。你去让它们丧失行动能力，我来安排回收作业，你将会得到奖励的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonGoo.text: I shall languish in weary solitude until you return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonGoo.zhText: 我将在令人疲惫的孤独中倍受煎熬，直到你回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonGoo.text: Bye for now, you shiny thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonGoo.zhText: 过会见，你这闪闪发光的家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Bra-vo. Annihilate that lifeform. Obliterate any morsel of data we might have gleaned from it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 干得漂亮。消灭那个生物，以及我们可能从它身上获取的任何信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: I appreciate how much your kind enjoy bathing in spilled ichor and viscera, but I specifically asked for the lifeform to be sedated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 我很欣赏你们这些家伙，享受地泡在溢出的脓液和脏器里面，但我特别要求给生命体注射镇静剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A little over-zealous there, Tenno. You were not supposed to massacre it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: Tenno，你有点做过头了。你不该残忍杀害它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Well done. Tranq ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 干得漂亮。麻醉步枪准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Tranq rifle ready… easy now...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 准备好麻醉步枪……放轻松……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You'll likely only get one shot, so let's not choke, hmm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你大概率只有一次机会，所以，别掉链子，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Tranq ready. If you need to sneeze, do it now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 麻醉步枪就绪。如果你要打喷嚏的话，趁现在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Lovely. Now, drop that thing like a sack of rocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 很好。现在，让那东西像袋石头一样倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Here they come. Get your eye down those sights.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 它们来了。盯好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: I'm very keen to examine this one. Tranq ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 我很想研究这个。麻醉步枪准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Time to put my money where your mouth is. Wherever your mouth is. Tranq ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 该你上场了。证明自己。准备好麻醉步枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: "The quarry approached, the noble hunter raised their weapon and with one shot theeeeey…"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: "当猎物靠近，高贵的猎人举起了武器，只要一发子弹他就……"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: End of the line. Where'd it go, I wonder. Try using your echo-lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 到头了。我想知道，它去哪了。试试你的回声诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: The little bugger's around here somewhere. Use the lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 这小东西就在这里的某个地方。使用诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You've gone to them, now bring them to you. Use your echo-lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你已经去找过它们了，现在让它们来找你。使用你的回声诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: It didn't just vanish. Call with your echo-lure. It'll show itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 它不会凭空消失的。用你的回声诱饵呼叫它。它会自己现身的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Stop. It's bloody close. Use your echo-lure, and wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 停下。它很近了。使用你的回声诱饵，然后耐心等待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: This is its environment, all right. Do you have your echo-lure? Draw the specimen toward you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 这是它会出现的环境，很好。你带了你的回声诱饵吗？把它引向你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Stop. Stop stop stop. Echo-lure, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 停。停停停。现在，用回声诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Curious. Trail ends. Tenno, call to them with the echo-lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 真令人好奇。踪迹消失了。Tenno，用回声诱饵来"联系"它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: It was here very recently. It's very, very close. Play them a little song on that echo-lure of yours. And… you know. Make it sexy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 它不久前就在这。我们非常，非常接近了。用你的回声诱饵给给它们弹奏一曲吧。还有……你懂的。弄得诱惑一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Avichaeas are primitive, high-strung creatures. Definitely more inclined towards "flight" than "fight."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 古羽鸟是一种原始且高度敏感的生物。比起"打斗"，它们更倾向于"打溜"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: If you're trying to locate an Avichaea, my first inclination would be to simply look up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 如果你想找到一只古羽鸟，我首先会建议你往上看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Avichaeas are known to cling to walls, so inspect your surroundings thoroughly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 古羽鸟常会攀附于墙壁上。所以你要仔细观察四周。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: While cautious, an Avichaea's curiosity can be piqued with a call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 尽管古羽鸟生性谨慎，但它们依然会被鸣叫声吸引。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: By the sound of that cry, I'd say there's an Avichaea not far from here. You won't mistake it when you see it -- they look like something from another geological era.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 根据那个叫声，我认为这附近有一只古羽鸟。等你看到了，肯定能一眼认出来——它们看上去就像是来自其他地质时代的生物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Hm. That could only be a Cryptilex. Don't underestimate them. It's a small insect, but it will attack should it feel threatened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 嗯。那肯定是一只隐疾虫。别小看它们。虽然它们只是小型昆虫，但在受到威胁时也会发起攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: If you discover a pool of bile on the ground, there's likely to be a Nexifera somewhere near.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 如果你在地上发现一滩胆汁，那说明附近很可能有一只悬匿兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Nexiferas always leave a viscous trail behind them, so inspect the ceilings for slime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 悬匿兽总是在它们身后留下黏糊糊的踪迹，所以要检查天花板上是否有粘液。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Nexiferas are coy little creatures -- be certain you're out of sight when in their presence. You'll also find an echo-lure handy in hunting them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 悬匿兽是易受惊吓的小动物——当它们出现时，你一定要在它们的视野外。你也会发现在狩猎它们的时候，回声诱饵会相当有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Remember: when attempting to tranq a Nexifera, aim for their soft tissue -- your darts will bounce right off their keratin shell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 请记住：当尝试麻醉一只悬匿兽时，请瞄准它们的的软组织——你的麻醉飞镖在射中了它们的角质壳后会直接反弹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Look up and proceed cautiously. That sounds like a Nexifera, and given the opportunity, it won't think twice about "thwomping" you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 抬起头来，小心前行。听起来这像是一只悬匿兽，只要它有机会，它就会毫不犹豫地让你"栽个跟头"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: That sounds distinctly like a Predasite, Deimos' most majestic predator. Let's hope it's not with its young. They can get aggressive when defending their offspring against a perceived threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 那声音的确像是扑猎达赛——火卫二上最威风的掠食者。但愿它没有和幼崽一起行动。为了守护幼崽，它们会主动向可能的威胁发起猛攻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Undazoa require a fluid environment.  Secreted within some warm runnel or artery they will surface to investigate. Tranq it before it can escape back to the depths.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 水螅履虫需要一个流动的环境。它们潜藏在一些沟渠或主干道的暖流中，并会浮出液面进行探查。在它逃回深处之前麻醉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Undazoa. Luscious. Wait for it to emerge from its plasm before firing, lest it escape back into that velvety thickness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 水螅履虫。美丽极了。得等它浮出等离子液后再掷出鱼叉，以免它逃回到那片浑水中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Undazoa are extraordinarily simple organisms, subsisting primarily on what Deimos excretes. That alone makes them a trove of potential discoveries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 水螅履虫是非常简单的生物体，主要靠火卫二的分泌物为生。仅此一点，就使它们成为了潜在的宝库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: The Undazoa will not emerge from its endoplasmic home if it senses a threat. Wait until it flops ashore before tranqing it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 如果水螅履虫察觉到了威胁，它是不会浮出等离子内液的。等到它浮上来后才能麻醉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: I'd say that's an Undazoa. A striking-looking thing. Reproduces asexually. Lives on contaminants. The sort of creature only Deimos would beget.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 我觉得那是一只水螅履虫。一种引人注目的生物。无性繁殖。以污垢物质为生。只有火卫二上才会有这样的生物出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: That's definitely a Vulpaphyla. They're scavengers, who prefer to travel in packs, so I wouldn't be surprised to find more than one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 那绝对是狐帕菲拉。它们是食腐动物，喜好群体行动。如果我们发现了多个目标，那也不足为奇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Ganglions are considered quite a delicacy by Cryptilexes. So it might behoove you to search any Haptic Fronds you come across.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 对于隐疾虫来说，神经节囊是一种美味食物。因此，你应该去把所有遇到的触突蕨叶都搜索一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Don't underestimate a Cryptilex: they're small but quite aggressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 不要低估隐疾虫的能力：虽然它们个头不大，但却很有攻击性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: If you spot a Cryptilex, best tranq it before it bites. They are very bitey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 如果你发现了一只隐疾虫，那最好赶在它咬人前将其制服。它们很喜欢咬人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Cryptilexes will respond to a call. Just be sure you're ready with that tranq rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 隐疾虫会对呼叫声作出反应。你务必要准备好自己的麻醉步枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Well. That's that then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 哎，只能这样了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Right. They… have… eluded you. I'm sure it wasn't a particularly fetching specimen anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 好吧，它们……躲过了你。反正这也不是一个特别迷人的标本，我敢肯定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: It appears to have outwitted you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 似乎它瞒过了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: This is a lost cause. Nothing for it but to try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 这是一次失败的捕捉。没办法，只能再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Tenno: zero. Mutant: one. Ah well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: Tenno：0 分。变异体：1 分。呃，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Forget it, it's lost. Back to the drawing board.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 别管它了，已经跟丢了。回到原处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Perhaps you should try again... after a nap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 或许你应该……休息一会儿之后再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: I needed one thing from that specimen, and it wasn't their absence. Again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 我需要从那个样本处得到一样东西，而不是眼睁睁看着它消失。再试一次？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Vanished, vanished, forever vanished. Back! To whatever pulsing orifice it squirted from. I am desolate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 消失，消失了，永远消失了。回去！回到把它喷出来的脉冲孔那里。真绝望啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Lost it. Ah well. At least we have this view.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 跟丢了。呃，好吧。我们至少欣赏到了这个景色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: I could watch you do this forever… but I'd rather not. From the top?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 我可以一直看你做下去……但我想还是不了。从头来过？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Yeah, no. The tune needs to be a bit longer than that, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 嗯，不是这样。你的曲调得再长一点，我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Sustain the note, Tenno. If it doesn't sustain, it won't carry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 保持这个调子，Tenno。如果没办法保持这个调子，就没办法引出我们的猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You have to hold the note for it to work. Once more, from the top.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你必须保持住这个调子才行。再来，从头开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Bravo! That was terrible. We are not at home to stage fright. Let's do it again, and sustain the note this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 真行！真糟糕。我们又不是像在家里可以怯场。我们再做一次，这次把音调维持住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Too short. Too short too short too short! Hold the note. Hold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 这些声音太短了。太短太短太短！维持音调。维持。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: No. Longer, more sustained. Again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 不。要更长，更持久。再来一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You've essentially screamed, "Hello, I'm a total fraud" to every specimen in earshot. Try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你几乎就是在对着每个样本的耳朵大喊，"你好，我是个大骗子。"再来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Predasites. Two concepts in one. Neither one of them good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 扑猎达赛。两个物种的概念合二为一。都不怎么好就是了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Predasites usually hunt alone. That makes it easier for you to hunt them. Of course, you might fail to spot a lone specimen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 扑猎达赛通常独自狩猎。这会让你捕杀它们变得容易点。当然了，你也有可能连一个落单的样本都发现不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Be wary when luring Predasites. You might get more than one coming to the party, and you won't be the kind of company they were expecting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 引诱扑猎达赛的时候要小心。你很有可能引来不止一头，问题是你又不是它们翘首以盼的那种同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Some Predasites spit, you know. Very rude. Especially when you notice you're being digested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 有些扑猎达赛会吐酸，你知道的。非常粗鲁。特别是当你意识到自己正在被它们消化着的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You won't have seen anything like Predasite mating season in the swamps. Methane and pheromones. It's a head-spinner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 处于扑猎达赛交配季的沼泽，绝对能让你大开眼界。到处都是沼气和费洛蒙激素的气味。简直能把人熏得头晕眼花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A Common Avichaea. They're skittish things, so tread lightly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只常见古羽鸟。它们很容易受到惊吓，所以脚步要放轻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A Viscid Avichaea! I haven't seen one in decades. But there it is: alive and in living color! Please, be careful though. They can be a bit... "mucousy."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只粘质古羽鸟！几十年来我都未曾见到一只了。但它就在那里：生动且又活泼！但是还请注意，它们会有点……"黏糊糊的"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: That's the "Sporule" variety of Avichaea. Now, don't startle it, or you're likely to get a faceful of infested spores.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 那是古羽鸟的"孢子"品种。现在，不要惊动了它，否则你很可能会被弄一脸的感染孢子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A Burrowing Cryptilex. Insects are the base of Deimos' food webs, that's why conservation of even these humble creatures is so vital.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只穴居隐疾虫。昆虫是火卫二食物网的基础，这就是为什么即使是这样不起眼的生物，对它们的保育工作也是如此的重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Now that's something you don't see everyday: a very rare Caustic Cryptilex! But do exercise caution: they have glands in their abdomens that release an acidic spray.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 这可不是每天都能见到的：一种非常罕见的腐蚀隐疾虫！但请千万要小心：它们的腹部有会喷出酸雾的腺体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: That's a Septic Cryptilex! The Grineer invested quite a bit of time trying to eradicate all these little fellows… probably because they're infectious. But that's not their fault, is it? They were born that way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 那是一只脓化隐疾虫！Grineer 花了很多时间来彻底消灭这些小东西……可能是因为它们具有传染性吧。但这不是它们的错，对吧？它们生来就是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: An Amethyst Nexifera. Not the most "visually pleasing" creature, but worthy of study all the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只紫晶悬匿兽。它并不是最"赏心悦目"的生物，但仍然值得研究。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: I couldn't mistake that coloration. It's the rarest of all Nexifera: the Scarlet! Beautiful, in its way… and dangerous. Beware its shockwave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 我不会搞错那种颜色的。这是所有悬匿兽中最稀有的：猩红品种！自有它的美丽之处……和危险。当心它的冲击波。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Hunter, that's a Viridian Nexifera! Now, you'll have to be quick -- like all Nexifera they tend towards flightiness. Oh, and maybe wait for the poison cloud to disperse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 猎人，那就是铬绿悬匿兽！现在，你必须得快——就像所有悬匿兽一样，它们总想要逃跑。哦，也许先等这片毒云散开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: That's a Vizier Predasite. Magnificent beasts... though they do have the habit of spitting poison.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 那是一只宰相扑猎达赛。惊人的野兽……尽管它们确实有吐毒的习惯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Do you know what that is? It's a Medjay Predasite! What a rare and unexpected find! Judging by its size, I'd say you'll have to tranq it twice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你知道那是什么吗？是一只守卫扑猎达赛！多么难得的意外发现！从它的大小来看，我想你必须麻醉它两次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A Pharaoh Predasite. Powerful, majestic and with a mouth full of parasites!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只法老扑猎达赛。强劲有力、威风凛凛，且嘴里长满了寄生虫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: An Umber Undazoa, and a fine specimen, too. Let's see if we can capture him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只深棕水螅履虫，同时也是个精美的样本。试试看我们能不能抓到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A Howler Undazoa! I've been concerned that competing fauna might render them extinct. Try not to startle it -- those things can scream bloody murder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只尖啸水螅履虫！我一直担心跟它们竞争的生物会使它们灭绝。尽量不要惊动它……那些东西的尖啸特别响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Hmm… I can tell by its color, we have a Vaporous Undazoa on our hands. Now, they're a belchy lot, so be careful you don't inhale anything it might expel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 嗯……从它的颜色来看，我们抓到了一只幻雾水螅履虫。它们现在会喷出很多幻雾，小心不要吸入它们排出的任何东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Ah, is that a Purple Velocipod, basking in the wyrm-light? Did you ever see a lovelier thorax?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 啊，那是一只在蛟龙光下取暖的紫色迅敏节虫吗？你见过比这更可爱的胸腔吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A White Velocipod! The rarest and fastest of the breed. Get close enough, don't spook it, and you can ride it right on out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 一只白色迅敏节虫！最稀有也是速度最快的品种。离它足够近且不要吓到了它，然后你就能骑上它离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: The Green Velocipod. Nimble little creatures. Serviceable mounts, too, if a little tricky to catch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 绿色迅敏节虫。敏捷的小动物。也是很好用的坐骑，虽然说有点难抓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Ah, the Sly Vulpaphyla. The most common variety, but still an invaluable addition to our menagerie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 啊，狡黠狐帕菲拉。最常见的品种，但对于我们的动物园来说，它仍算得上是无价之宝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Hold on… that's a Panzer Vulpaphyla! We must bring it in! I'd estimate by its armor-plating that it might take a few darts before you can safely secure it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 等等……那是一只铁甲狐帕菲拉！我们必须捕获它！根据它的盔甲，我估计可能需要几支麻醉飞镖，你才能安全拿下它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Unless my eyes deceive me, that's a Crescent Vulpaphyla! Just be careful you don't get tangled up in its horns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 除非我的眼睛骗了我，否则那就是一只月刃狐帕菲拉！注意不要被它的角给缠上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Clear bio signs. Follow them, if you would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 明显的生物痕迹。跟紧它们，如果你想的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: There! Bio sign. Do you think you can find whatever left it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 在那！生物痕迹。你能找到它的主人吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Something was here, not long ago. Yes, yes, this is promising. Please, pursue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 之前有东西在这，时间不长。太好了，有希望。请继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Fresh bio sign. On your way, if you would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 新鲜的生物痕迹。继续行动，如果你想的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Bio sign.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 生物痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: The specimen left in that direction. I'd be grateful if you caught it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 样本朝那个方向离开了。如果你能抓住它的话，我将不胜感激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Well, you're close to something that's certain. Not to backseat drive, but I think if you head that way, you might find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你肯定离什么东西更近了。我不想指手画脚，但我认为如果你朝那边走的话，可能会找到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Close. Very, very close. Tell me: do you see a trail?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 靠近了。非常，非常接近了。告诉我：你是否看到了一道踪迹？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Yes. That's what we want. Softly, softly now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 太棒了。那正是我们要的。轻点，现在悄悄接近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: They're nearby. Move. Carefully. These things have senses we have only begun to understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 它们就在附近。动起来。小心点。我们也才刚刚知道，这些东西有些很特别的感知能力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Vulpaphyla is a scavenging bioform, surviving by doing its best to not get killed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 狐帕菲拉是一种食腐生物。它的生存之道就是尽全力躲避捕杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Vulpaphyla. Skittish, agile, somewhat tactical. Non-aggressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 狐帕菲拉。易受惊吓，行动敏捷，甚至还能使用一些策略。没有攻击性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You'll need patience and cunning. Vulpaphyla's first instinct is to distance itself from a threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你需要耐心与智谋。狐帕菲拉的第一个本能就是让自己远离威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Vulpaphyla is a bioform adapted from old Earth canid scavenger stock. Likely cargo from one hapless wreck or another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 狐帕菲拉是从一种古代地球上的食腐性犬科家畜进化而来。它们的祖先多半是某艘不幸坠毁的飞船上的货物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Vulpaphyla. Easy to take down, if you can sight them before they flee.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 狐帕菲拉。很容易捕捉，前提是你能在它们逃走前发现其行踪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: A mating call excellently performed… but…  that's the wrong lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 漂亮的觅偶呼唤……可是……用错诱饵了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Wrong lure. You'll need to match their call, if you want to get their attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 诱饵错了。如果你想引起它们注意的话，需要与它们的叫声吻合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You've chosen the incorrect lure. A common mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你的诱饵选错了。你犯了一个大家都会犯的错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Tenno. You are using the wrong sedative for your quarry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: Tenno，你对你的猎物使用了错误的麻醉剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: You've mixed up your tranquilizers. Fix it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 你把你的麻醉剂弄混了。修正它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.text: Try loading a tranquilizer that will actually work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonHun.zhText: 试着装填一支真正能起作用的麻醉剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Are you well, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: Tenno，你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Grandmother had the measure of us all from the start!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: "祖母"从一开始就对我们了如指掌！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: My mother is more than just her father's daughter now. She's finally loosed her own shackles, just as she did mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 我的母亲现在可不仅仅是她父亲的女儿。她终于把自己从枷锁中释放出来了，就像她把我解放出来一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: I wonder what kind of man my father will become; now he's emerged from his corroded chrysalis of duty. I wonder if we shall ever be friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 我很好奇我的父亲会成为什么样的人；现在他已经摆脱了他那腐坏的蛹。我想知道我们能不能成为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Loid used to lift me onto his back to ride around the gardens! How strange to suddenly think of that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 洛德过去常常把我举起来，让我骑在他的背上绕着花园四处跑！突然这么一想真是奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Wonderful to see you again. Come. Let's exchange words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 很高兴再次见到你。来。我们来聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Tenno. You appear quite intact and well-sealed. This is good. If you intend to venture out, perhaps we might talk samples?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: Tenno。你看起来完好无损、严丝合缝。这样很好。如果你打算出去探险，也许我们可以谈一下样本？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: I believed Father lacked the spine to save us from Mother's hubris, but I see now that he believed her delusion as much as Mother herself - indeed, what choice did we have? Without void travel, our people would have been helpless before the threat. Her plan was our last hope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 我认为"父亲"不敢把我们从"母亲"的傲慢中解救出来，但是我现在看到他跟"母亲"一样，相信她的妄想－事实上，我们能有什么选择？要是没有了虚空旅行，我们的人们在那次威胁中无能为力。她的计划是我们最后的希望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Kaelli wasn't even meant to be here. She stowed away, not wanting to be left out of the adventure. Somehow still as sweet as ever, she is my greatest sorrow. My parents' too, I know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 凯莉甚至不应该来这里。她把自己藏了起来，不想被排除在冒险之外。不知怎的，她还是那么可爱，她是我最大的悲哀。我知道我父母也这么认为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Mother surrounded herself with experts, married a leader in his field, and took advice from none of them. She may have some regrets, sure. But not enough. I doubt she has the capacity. That would expose too many cracks in the story she tells about herself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: "母亲"的身边都是专家，她还嫁给了行业的领头人，却从来都不向他们寻求建议。当然，她可能会有一点遗憾。但还不够。我怀疑她缺少这能力。这会使她所讲述关于她自己的故事中出现太多的问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: I was to be married, you know? She would now be as dead as the empire that raised us. Sometimes I wish I had been there, with her, when your kind came for us. No hard feelings. Our time had more than come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 你知道吗，我本来是要结婚的。可她现在跟生养我们的帝国一样，死去了。有时候我希望，在你们袭击我们的时候，我要是和她在一起就好了。别往心里去。我们的时代早就该结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Salutations, Ayatan of the Entrati.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 你好，英择谛家族的阿耶檀识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: So. The stranger at the family feast turned out to be the one who guided us to find one another again. There will be scars, ugly ones, but healing too. Thank you, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 那么。这个家庭宴会上的陌生人原来是指引我们彼此相互了解的那个人。丑陋的伤疤是会有的，但也会愈合。朋友，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: I have the honor of a name and a little taste of freedom! Whatever you're doing out there, Tenno, keep at it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 我有幸得到了一个名字，也尝到了一点自由的滋味！不管你在外面做什么，Tenno，继续努力吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Deimos is unfolding before us like a puzzle-box. I must have more samples.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 火卫二就像一个迷箱一样打开在我们面前。我需要得到更多的样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: None of the monstrosities you'll find out there are as fearsome as the demons inside my mother's head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 你在外面所见到的怪物远不及我母亲脑海中的恶魔可怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Poor Kaelli thinks this family may yet have a future. Monotony is bearable. Hope? That'll kill you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 可怜的凯莉认为这个家庭可能还有未来。单调是可以忍受的。希望？那种东西会杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Deimos is bewitching. And when you're bewitched, you're not. Paying. Attention. Then… this happens. So try to be less easily impressed out there, hm? For all our sakes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 火卫二令人着迷。当你被迷住的时候，你就没有集。中。注。意。力。然后……就会发生这种事。所以不要太意乱神迷？就当是为了大家？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: You'd do well to listen to my Grandmother from time-to-time. Oh, she was never a soldier or a scientist. Sometimes I think that freedom from stricture is what makes her the most intellectually nimble of us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 你最好常听我"祖母"的话。哦，她从来没有当过兵，也没有当过科学家。有时候我觉得，不受拘束的自由是让她成为我们中最聪明的人的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: She collared me like a cur. And for what? Refusing to bend the knee to her arbitrary rules?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 她像个疯子一样，给我套上项圈。为什么？因为我拒绝对她那些专横的规则卑躬屈膝？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: She should have trusted me to strike out alone! Yes, the Infested followed me home, and yes, we became tainted travesties of ourselves, but I hadn't learned how to control them then!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 她本该在我独自出击的时候给予我信任！是的，感染者跟着我回到了家里，是的，我们变成了肮脏可笑的怪物，可当时我并不知道该如何控制它们啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: I was to be a scientist. Now I see the shortsightedness of mere intellect. Provide me samples. Soon my parents can come crawling to me to beg for my data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 我本该成为一名科学家。而现在，我意识到，仅有智力会让人目光短浅。把样本带给我吧。用不了多久，我的父母就会爬着来求我提供数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Wander freely through this savage romping ground as I once did. Oh, she punished me for it. I desired only solitude, and for that, she made me scapegoat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 像我曾经那样，在这个野蛮的游乐场里自由游荡。哦，她为此惩罚了我。我只想独处，为此，她让我当了替罪羊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Father massacred my Infested pets. He and Mother plunged us into this chaos - all I did was rub his face in it. Why did he take it so personally?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: "父亲"残忍杀死了我的感染者宠物。他和"母亲"使我们陷入这片混乱－而我只是把这些甩到他脸上。他至于那么介意么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.text: Yes, I once dressed an Infested as my father and had him blindly follow the mother-creature into the abyss. It was hilarious, and I'm not sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonInt.zhText: 是的，我有一次将感染者打扮成我父亲，让他盲目地随着像母亲的生物步入深渊。这事儿很搞笑，并且我也不觉得内疚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonOut.text: I look forward to your return.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: The antigen you choose will determine how you can further optimize the creature's abilities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 你选择的抗原将决定你可以如何进一步优化这只动物的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: It's time to choose an antigen. I'm breathless with anticipation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 是时候选择一种抗原了。我期待得屏住了呼吸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Rewriting a creature's biology is a huge responsibility. Choose the antigen with care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 重新构造一个生物是一项重责。请谨慎选择抗原。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Depending on your eventual choice of mutagen, the creature will become robust in one of several ways.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 根据你最终选择的突变原，该生物将以以下某种方式变得强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: The mutagen converts Infestation into resistance. Gaining strength from what tried to kill you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 突变原把感染转化为抵抗力。从那些试图杀死你的东西中获取力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: We should apply a mutagen at this stage. If the creature could speak, it'd thank you for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 现阶段我们应使用突变原。如果这只动物可以说话，它一定会为此感谢你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: With mutagens and antigens, I can restore an injured specimen to complete health. There will be side effects, however.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 借助突变原和抗原，我可以让一只受伤的样本完全康复。但是这会有副作用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Both the Predasite and the Vulpaphyla are formidable allies. Just be sure you're up to the task of raising one decently before you commit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 扑猎达赛和狐帕菲拉都是强大的队友。在你救下它之前请确保你有抚养好它的能力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: There's no hurry. The Infestation won't overwhelm this creature now. Its fate is in your hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 不用着急。现在感染不会压垮这只动物。它的命运掌握在你的手中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Good, good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 好，很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: You'll notice the lifeforms of Deimos are constantly ripping chunks out of one another. If you happen across a Predasite or a Vulpaphyla that's been wounded by the Infested, you have a chance to save it. Just tranq it quickly before it succumbs. Use as many shots as you need. Once it's recovered, you can raise it as a loyal companion. I'll even be able to redirect some of its Infested mutations into a more useful form. Taking liberties with Creation, perhaps, but where's the harm in that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 你会发现火卫二的生命体不断地自相残杀。如果你遇到一个被感染者所伤的扑猎达赛或狐帕菲拉，就有机会救它。只需在它濒死之前快速地麻醉它。麻醉药你尽管用。一旦它康复了，你可以将它抚养成你的忠实同伴。我甚至可以将它的感染者变异体重塑成一种更有用的形态。也许，这对生物不太尊重，但这样做又有什么错呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Your time together isn't over yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 你们在一起的时光还没有结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Why end such a successful partnership?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 为什么要结束这样成功的伙伴关系？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 我明白了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: So. Your friend needs a name. What's it to be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 所以，你的朋友需要一个名字。它会叫什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Without a name, you're only half real. What are you calling this one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 没有名字，充其量只是个半虚幻的存在。你要怎么要叫这个呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: I'm glad to see this, Tenno. There's honor in a name. So, choose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: Tenno，我很高兴看到这个。名字是一种荣誉。所以，做出选择吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: They are named.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 它有名字了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: So be it, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 那就这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: May it endure in glory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 愿它在荣耀中长存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Grandmother would approve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: "祖母"会同意的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Taking Deimos as you find it? Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 保持火卫二的原汁原味吗？很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Not yet. Come back when you've spent some more time in action together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 还没到时候。等你们在一起行动的时间长了，再回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Sorry. Not until you've proven you can take care of each other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 抱歉。直等到你证明了，你们能互相照顾好对方才可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: I can't do that for you. Yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 我现在还不能为你做这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: I can't wait for you to experience the joys of bringing up a festering little friend of your very own, but first, you need to catch one. Find a Predasite or Vulpaphyla the Infested have wounded, tranq it, and hurry back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 我已经迫不及待地想让你体验一下养育一只属于你自己的溃烂小家伙的乐趣了，但首先，你得先去抓一只来。去找一只被感染者打伤的扑猎达赛或狐帕菲拉，将其麻醉，然后赶紧回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: I'm dreadfully sorry, but despite appearances, this is not a pet shop. Sedate a Predasite or Vulpaphyla that's been wounded by the Infested, then we can talk mutagens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 我很抱歉，尽管从外表上看，这不是一家宠物店。去麻醉一只被感染者伤害的扑猎达赛或狐帕菲拉， 然后我们可以来聊下突变原。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: There. The creature's healthier than ever and looking superb with it. It's yours now, collared and bonded. May you always have one another's back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 好了。这只动物比以往任何时候都要健康，而且看起来也很棒。现在它是你的了，戴着项圈和纽带。愿你们永远彼此扶持。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: All done. The Infestation is purged, and the patient is well. Look out for each other. Found family is the truest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 全部完成了。感染已得到净化，病患的状况也很不错。请相互照应。通过缘分聚在一起的家人才是最真挚的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Congratulations, Tenno. The creature is saved. So begins a beautiful friendship, forged in the filth of Deimos. I may weep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: Tenno，恭喜。这只动物得救了。就这样，一段铸就于火卫二污浊的美好友谊就此开始了。我可能要哭了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: A noble choice I won't soon forget.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 一个不会让我很快忘却的崇高抉择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Very well. Let it have its freedom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 很好。让它获得自由吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: I'll let you say goodbye, then. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 那么，我会让你说再见的。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: It came from the Cambion Drift. Maybe it's time to let it go back home, never to return to your side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 它来自魔胎之境。也许是时候让它回家了，永远不再回到你的身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: If you let your companion go, you'll never see it again. But you will have my respect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 如果你让同伴离开，你将再也见不到它了。但你会赢得我的尊重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Has the time come to set your loyal friend free forever? The decision rests with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 到了让你忠诚的朋友永远自由的时候了吗？决定权在你的手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Just in time. Stasis will arrest the spread of the Infestation for now. Bring the stricken beast to me, and we can discuss how to proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 时间刚刚好。冷冻舱将暂时阻止感染扩散。把受伤的野兽带给我，我们可以讨论该如何继续进行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: You've saved its life, Tenno. It'll serve you loyally, but first, we need to address the Infestation in its system. Pay me a visit soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: Tenno，你救了它的命。它会忠心侍奉你，但首先，我们要解决它体内的感染问题。尽快来找我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.text: Good work. That tranquilizer will stop the Infestation in its tracks. Bring the specimen to me, and we can decide what happens next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonPet.zhText: 干得好。麻醉步枪将阻止感染继续扩散。把样本带给我，我们可以决定接下来做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: What you did with those... things... was a deliberate insult.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 你在那些……东西……上的所作所为是一种蓄意侮辱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: Wait. Is that… why you did it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 等等。那就是……为什么你要这么做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: Do you remember when I first bred Infested? How we played with them for hours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 你还记得我第一次繁殖感染者的时候吗？当时我们和它们一起玩耍了很久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: I'm sorry you don't appreciate my sense of humor. But I did make you happy, didn't I? When you killed them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 我很遗憾你并不欣赏我的幽默感。但是我确实让你乐了，不是吗？当你杀死它们的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: Vilcor, my sweet sire. What good is a weapons expert without something to kill?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 维尔科，我亲爱的父亲大人。如果一位武器专家没有东西供他击杀，那他还有什么用处呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: Your work proceeds, my son. Clearly you thrive in isolation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 你的工作还在继续，我的儿子。很明显，你在孤独中成长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: Outside your control. Shackling me was never going to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 在你的控制之外。用"镣铐"束缚我是没有用的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: 'Shackling?' You contaminated the family... and yourself! You had to be protected from these… mad urges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: "镣铐"？你玷污了这个家族……还有你自己！我们得把你保护起来，免受这些……疯狂冲动的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: You were worried about me. Thank you for the overdue recognition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 你担心我。谢谢你的迟来的重视。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.text: Your restrictions will be eased. Slightly. I name you Kermerros. The runner who outstrips his own shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Deimos/DSonUnl.zhText: 你受到的限制将被放宽。只是一点点。我给你取名叫克梅罗斯。跑得比自己的影子还快的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Finding the parts necessary to make bait should not be too hard. Take down a few Infested and look for parts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 寻找制作诱饵所需的肉块应该不会太难。把几个感染者大卸八块就能找到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I suggest eliminating Infested in the vicinity to secure bait-construction materials.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我建议通过消灭附近的感染者，来获取制作诱饵的材料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: In order to proceed, you will now need to gather materials.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你现在需要收集材料，然后才可以继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Enhanced target eradicated. Going the extra mile there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 增强版的目标已经消灭了。你这次超越了自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Target down. Eliminating this enhanced opponent will prove worth the trouble, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 目标已击杀。我认为事实会证明，费力消灭这种增强型的对手是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Objective complete. Enhanced target terminated. A rousing display of martial vigor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 目标已完成。增强型目标已被消灭。一次令人振奋的军事能力展现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested will now be drawn to the Infusion. Terminate them close to the vessel to expedite the process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者现在会被注入的过程吸引来。在靠近容器的地方解决掉它们，以加快诱饵的制作过程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This will draw more Infested. Dispatch them while they are close to the vessel in order to complete the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这会引来更多感染者。在它们靠近容器时处理掉它们，以确保诱饵能顺利制作完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This will lure Infested to the area. Kill them near the vessel to finish concocting the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这将会引诱感染者这里来。在容器附近杀掉它们，好完成诱饵的炮制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have located a suitable vessel to use in creating the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我找到了一个合适的容器用来制作诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You should see a cauldron-like outgrowth close by you can use as a vessel to make the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你应该能在附近看到，地里长出来的，像锅一样的东西，可以把它当作制作诱饵的容器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Use the vessel nearby to make the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 使用附近的容器来炮制诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A shame to have missed an opportunity. Still, the bait remains useable if...mundane.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 可惜错过机会了。不过，如果要求不高的话，诱饵也勉强可用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That is unfortunate. You can still use the bait; it just lacks that added 'oomph'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真可惜。诱饵还是可以用；只是少了那么点"魅力"罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Never mind then, we all miss out some times, y'know? Bait's still good, just not EXTRA good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 没事啦，我们都会犯错啦！诱饵还能用啊，只是不算特别棒啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning. Juggernaut inbound. Kill it close to the vessel to enhance the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 小心。巨兽来袭。等它到容器附近时再杀死它，这样可以增强诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An apex Infested is approaching. Slay it near the bait-vessel to infuse its ichor for improved effect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一只最致命的感染者来袭。在盛有诱饵的容器附近干掉它，这样可以把它的脓液注入，增强效果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You got a big boy comin'. Stuff that in your bait-box to max it out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有个大家伙来了。把它塞进诱饵盒里来最大化它的用处！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, you got the big guy, huh? With that gore in the mix, the bait's gonna be irresistible!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，你居然把那个大家伙都搞定了？掺上这个血淋淋的东西，诱饵会变得无法抗拒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Elimination of this enemy has substantially improved the effectiveness of the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 杀死这个敌人，大大提高了诱饵的效力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Good work. Extra effort that I believe will pay off handsomely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 做得很好。我相信这些额外的努力将会取得丰厚的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's no good! You gotta bop the infested near the jug, or we'll get nowhere!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 不对不对！你得在罐子附近杀掉感染者才行，不然我们白忙一场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Only Infested that are terminated in proximity to the vessel contribute to the Infusion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 只有在容器附近干掉的感染者才能注入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: If the Infested are eliminated too far from the vessel, this will not work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果感染者被杀死在距离容器过远的地方，就什么用都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Good. Now place the materials in the vessel and start the infusion process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很好。现在把材料放入容器，并开始注入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That should be sufficient. Use the vessel to begin infusing the bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那应该够了。使用容器来注入诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We are now ready to begin the bait infusion. Move to the vessel to proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们现在准备好，可以开始诱饵注入了。到容器那里去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Bait successfully deployed. The desired target is approaching. Eliminate it to fulfill mission parameters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 诱饵部署完毕。目标正在靠近。杀死它就可以满足任务参数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Proximity alert. Baited target has arrived. Immediate termination is advised...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 目标进入攻击范围。诱饵引出的目标来了。建议立即对其实施处决……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ah. The main event has arrived. Here's your chance. Kill the target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 啊，重头戏来了。这是你的机会。杀死目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Target eliminated. Congratulations on a job well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已消灭目标。恭喜你出色完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Confirmed target is down. Deimos just fractionally improved its odds of survival.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 目标确认已经倒下了。稍稍地提高了点在火卫二的生存几率。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A flawless victory. Well, effective anyway. The target is no more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 完美的胜利。嘛，反正很有效就是了。目标已经不复存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hostiles eliminated. None of these appear dangerous enough to fit the rather colorful descriptions of the infested we are hunting. Keep looking, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已消灭敌方势力。它们看起来都不够危险，不符合我们所要消灭的感染者的"多彩"描述。继续寻找，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Carnage comprehensively complete. Additional incentives/rewards have been authorized, well done, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 全面完成对敌屠杀。额外激励/奖励已被批准，干得好， Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I don't think we found Mr. Scratchikins, but I think we've found some of his friends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我想我们还没找到抓挠兽先生，但是我想我们已经找到他的一些朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All done! You're absotively posolutely the best of what's left!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 全部完成！你绝对是我们所有人中最棒的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent work, Tenno. With the ground well-prepared we can now proceed to the next step.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 干得好， Tenno。在地面做好准备工作后，我们现在可以进行下一步了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You will need to create a killing zone. Activate local excavators to clear yourself some room to maneuver.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你需要清出一圈狩猎范围。激活挖掘机来给自己腾出一些操作空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, that showed them! I don't think any of those were Mr. Scratchikins though; he's a slippery one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，让它们知道你有多厉害了！但我认为这些都不是抓挠兽先生；它可狡猾了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It will be necessary to clear nearby Infested in order to achieve optimal hunting conditions. Please proceed when ready.
