/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 为了达到最佳狩猎条件，有必要清除附近的感染者。请在就绪后开始行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Cephalons tell me the Infested specimen was located and slain. A small victory, but victory nonetheless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 中枢告诉我感染者样本已被找到，并且被消灭。尽管这是个小小的胜利，但也是胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Loid tells me the target was eliminated along with a perhaps deadlier secondary target. Two entities working together would go a long way to explain the more lurid stories. A most satisfactory outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 洛德告诉我目标已被消灭，连同可能更加致命的第二目标。两个反派会让这些骇人听闻的故事更加多彩。一个令人满意的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There is a strong possibility the target can be lured here with the correct bait. Locate the relevant ingredients to proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 目标有极高的概率可以被对的诱饵引至此处。定位相关材料以继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Grineer confirmed losing several squad members to the infested you are hunting. I have uploaded coordinates to where the encounter occurred.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Grineer 方已确认，你正在追击的这只感染者使他们失去了好几名队员。我已经上传了遭遇战的方位坐标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Wow, the grunters can't keep up with you! They look all mad hehe! They said we should go play with Mr. Scratchikins if we're so **expletive deleted**!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哇噢，那些菜鸟们跟不上你！看起来他们都气疯了，哈哈！他们说如果我们这么**消音** 的话应该去跟抓挠兽先生一起玩！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I bet if you check in with the Grinner survivors they can point you to Mr. Scratchikins!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我敢肯定，如果你问 Grinner 幸存者们，它们会告诉你抓挠兽先生在哪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning: You are now in the region indicated in the reports of a "murderous" infested, caution...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警告：你现在所在的区域，是"凶残"感染者报告中提到的它的出没区域，小心……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh, I can't wait to meet our new Mr. Bitey Scratchikins!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，我等不及想见我们新的咬人抓挠兽先生了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infestation is a marvel, in its own way; an endless fountain of ever-changing flesh, bone and gristle. A particularly murderous specimen has been reported assaulting other teams. Would you be so kind as to find it and put an end to it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 就其本身而言，感染者是一个奇迹；是其血肉、骨头和软骨不断变化的无尽源泉。有报告称一个尤其致命的样本袭击了其它队伍。你愿意找到并杀死它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: With the larger fellow out of the way, maybe there's a chance for me yet. Salvation!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 随着大块头被消灭，也许我还有机会。得救了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You exterminated both the alpha specimen AND its mother? Most impressive! And unlikely. But impressive! Is the next step, by any chance, saving me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你消灭了最优样本和它的母亲？太让人印象深刻了！虽然有点不太真实，但太令人深刻了！那么下一步， 如果有可能话，是拯救我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Perhaps if you bait out the Prime Infested in the area - and kill it  - you might then retrieve me! You can do that, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 或许你可以引出这里的感染者头目－杀死它－然后你才可以带走我！你能做到的，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Goodness. You Tenno really are as scary as they say. Oh, I'm getting a positive fix on you, please keep going.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 天哪。你们 Tenno 确实像他们所说的那样可怕。噢，我是在表扬你，请继续加油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: They… they barely breached your perimeter! You're almost to me, don't stop now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他们……他们几乎逃不过你的手掌心！你就快要找到我了，不要现在停下来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I...errr... I think you maybe stumbled on some sort of nest, there's a LOT more infested showing up out there. Guard yourself, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我……呃……我想你可能碰巧找到某种巢穴，那里出现了更、多、的感染者。Tenno，保护好你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, friend Latrox has marked off a few places NOT to look. I guess we keep going to the other places...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，朋友"拉托罗"标记了几个"不要"去看的位置。我想我们得继续去别的地方了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, if I'd had you around, I never would have gotten into this mess. Keep looking, Tenno, I think you're close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，如果我有你在身边，我肯定不会陷入这种困境之中。Tenno，继续寻找，我想你很接近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh! Oh! Ah. Those pack of monstrosities that were chasing me gave up around there. I'm sure they've all crawled off by now, should be perfectly safe...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦！哦！啊。那堆追我的怪物在这附近放弃了。我敢肯定它们现在都爬走了，应该是安全了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Congratulations, Tenno. As I said, Une has his uses. The sample data he just sent, for example, is... acceptable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，恭喜。正如我所说，"恩"是有他的用处的。例如，他刚刚发送的样本数据，是合格的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It's always nice to have one's expectations exceeded. You saved Une, and he, in turn, sent a large quantity of data. Most agreeable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真是大喜过望。你救了"恩"，作为回报，他发送了大量数据。十分令人满意的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You made it! Oh, I could kiss those scary metal feet of yours! One last favor: Please watch my back while I collect the last of my samples, I can't go back empty-handed after all of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你做到了！哦，我愿意对你那双可怕的金属脚行吻脚礼！最后一个请求：请在我收集最后的样本时掩护我，我可不能空手而归。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hello? Anyone? This is Corpus representative Latrox Une. I'm lost, cornered by Infested, and my locator is... well, it's been eaten. I am in the direst need of assistance... help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你好？有人吗？我是 Corpus 代表拉托罗·恩。我迷路了，被感染者逼得走投无路，而我的定位器…… 好吧，被吃掉了。我迫切需要援助…… 救救我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh perfect! Your signal is getting stronger, so you're getting closer to my position. Please keep at it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，完美！你的信号越来越强，所以你也越来越接近我的位置。请继续努力！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: My stars. Those chimeric monstrosities were never provided the remotest chance of disrupting things. You're terrifying. Well, come, save me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我的天啊。那些四不像的怪物根本一点机会都没有。你很可怕。那么，来吧，来救我吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You must locate me. I was near a Purifier before I got chased off, I remember that much. Perhaps look around there? Try to pick up my trail?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你必须找到我。在我被赶走以前，我在净化器附近，我只记得这么多了。你可以到那里看看？试着找到我的踪迹？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Unsurprisingly you are not our only guest. A stranded Corpus agent, Latrox Une, has run into difficulties amid the Grey Strain. Latrox is useful at times, kindly see if you can help him at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 不出所料，你不是我们唯一的客人。拉托罗·恩，一位被困的 Corpus 特工，陷入了被"灰种"包围的困境。拉托罗有时候还是有用的，请看看你是否能帮助他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, hey, who's the king? That's right; you're the king! Long live the king!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，嘿，谁是国王？没错；你就是国王！吾王万岁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Parameters exceeded. Well done, Tenno. In my defense there was no indication of a second entity, let alone one so... unpleasant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 超出参数。干得好，Tenno。在我看来，没有任何第二个活体的迹象表明，更何况对于一个……如此令人不喜的活体来说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A large predatory organism in the vicinity must be removed before we can reclaim the base. Use bait to lure it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们必须清除附近存在的一只大型掠食者，才能收复基地。使用诱饵来引出它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Friend Latrox says we're all clear to proceed. He says we're in the right area and everything! This is SO exciting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 朋友拉托罗让我们继续前进。他说我们在正确的地方，一切都对！这可太令人兴奋了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent work, Tenno. With Latrox' help we now have full scan data for the area around the base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好样的，Tenno。有了拉托罗的帮助，我们现在有了基地周围区域的完整扫描数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Researcher Latrox Une has agreed to assist our reclamation efforts. Please protect him while he conducts the necessary survey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 研究员拉托罗·恩已同意协助我们进行收复工作。请在他进行必要调查时，保护他的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Efficiently done. Now we can continue the restoration project unimpeded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 高效完成。现在我们可以不受阻碍地继续进行修复工程了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It will be necessary to clear the area of hostile Infested before any positive inroads can be made to reclaiming the base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在积极采取行动收复基地之前，必须先清除敌方感染者的侵扰区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The site has been restored, and Loid tells me it went even better than we hoped. Very well done, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 该地点已被恢复，洛德告诉我这次进展比预期的还要好。Tenno，做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All clear. Loid tells me there are strong connections across the network. The reclamation is a success.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 敌人已被全数歼灭。洛德告诉我网络连接很顺畅。这次的回收很成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You are in proximity to the base location. Once I reactivate the dormant elements the Infested will attempt to prevent completion of the process. Prepare for area defense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你在基地附近了。一旦我重新激活了休眠元素，感染者会试图阻止这个过程。准备好进行区域防御。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Of old, there was an Entrati base installation in this region. See if you can...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很久以前，这个区域有一座英择谛基地。看看你能否……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Are you going to look for the old base near here? I'd love to see it again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你要去找附近那个旧基地吗？我很想再去看看！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Good work, Tenno. There are useful materials here that will assist us in the reclamation project.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好样的，Tenno。这里有能协助我们进行收复工程的有用材料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hooo boy, did you just use the cache to lure that humungous thing out? Brilliant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢天啊，你刚才是不是用这个储藏箱来引出那只大家伙？聪明！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh hey! Hey! There's a cache nearby. Maybe see if you can open it? We could use the resources inside to fix the base!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，嗨！嗨！这附近有个储藏箱。也许去看看你能不能打开它？我们可以利用里面的资源来修缮基地！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infestation has covered them now, but there are key installations on Deimos that could still serve us well. Locating and securing one of these places will help the reclamation, Loid can give you the details.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 虽然感染者已经把它们遮蔽住了，但火卫二上还有一些关键设施可供我们使用。找到并且保卫其中一处，这样做能够帮助我们取回设施，洛德可以为你提供详细信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I feel sympathy for them sometimes - after all, they're just acting naturally, as naturally as can be expected for a macro-plague. We're the real monsters here, after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我有时候很同情它们－毕竟，它们的行为只是本能。至少，对一个大型瘟疫说是本能。归根结底，我们才是这里真正的怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Another cycle continues unbroken - they rise, they attack, they are repelled. At least you dealt with them with merciful efficiency, I applaud that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 又一个无法打破的轮回－它们苏醒，它们攻击，它们落败。至少你用仁慈的速度解决了它们，这点值得我称赞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A tragic waste of flesh and blood in a way, but what are we to do? We cannot simply sit back and allow the Infested to consume us, can we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 用另一个角度来看，这是一场血肉之躯的悲剧，但我们该怎么办呢？我们不能坐视不管，任由那些感染者吞噬我们，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infested have been put back in their place, I gather. They will return, I have no doubt of that, I hope you will be able to help us again when they do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我想，那些感染者已经掂量到了自己的分量。它们会回来的，我对此毫不怀疑，我希望它们卷土重来时你能再次帮助我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested breach point located. Proceed to the breach point indicated, then...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者突破口的位置已确认。到指示给你的突破口去，然后……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Make new friends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 结交新朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Congratulations, Infested activity has been reduced to within acceptable parameters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 恭喜，感染者的活动已降低到可接受的参数范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: No further hostiles detected. Breach designation: closed... until next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 没有探测到其他敌方势力。破坏指令：关闭……到下次的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's the way! A good, no, a GREAT haul! You've got a nose for this, Chip! Wish I had a nose...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 就是那样！咱们有了一个好的，不，非常棒的收获！你的嗅觉真敏锐，小翻版！要是我也有鼻子就好了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Check you out! Ya big old treasure hunter, you! You're amazing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你看起来棒极了！你这个大块头寻宝者！你太牛了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You're King of the Hill! That was out-standing my Tenno! I'm gonna make you a crown!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你就是这片山头之王！我家 Tenno 真是太太太出色了！我要给你做个皇冠！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Our squiggly new friends look all tuckered out! They won't be coming back... for a while at least.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 咱们那些扭来扭去的朋友看起来都精疲力竭了！它们不会回来了……至少有一阵子不会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested activity registers at zero. Well done, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者活动指数归零。干得好，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All hostiles eliminated. Breach designation: Crushed. Good job, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已消灭所有敌人。破坏指示：已损毁。好样的，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: WOW! You're fantiddliastic at this! Those little ole artifacts never stood a chance!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哇！你真是忒棒了！那些小古董们根本就没机会反抗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: No way! I think you got everything! What makes you so good at this? It's me, isn't it? I make you good!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 天哪！我想你拿到所有东西了！是什么让你这么厉害的呢？肯定是我，对吧对吧？有了我你才这么厉害的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Wow! You're the best dancer on all of Deimos; our squiggly new friends are totally tired out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哇！你是火卫二上最棒的舞者了；咱们那些七扭八歪的新朋友都累瘫了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Phew! Guess we won't be seeing our squiggly friends ever again. Nah, I'm sure they'll be back someday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 吁！我猜咱们再也不用见到那些蠕动的朋友了。当我没说，我肯定它们还会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Aggression from the Infested is a given, but it cannot be allowed to go unchecked. Loid can direct you to locations where the Infested are massing to breach our perimeter. Work to cull their numbers for the security of us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者的进攻是必然会到来的，但也不能任其肆意妄为。洛德可以指引你前往聚集有大量感染者的地方，它们试图在那里突破我们的防线。为了我们所有人的安全，尽可能地让它们多损失一些人手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A sterling effort, I suppose. Do enjoy the fruits of your labor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我想，这是个很不错的努力。好好享受你的劳动成果吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Very good. Very good. You see, Deimos is unforgiving, but not without its gems hidden beneath the mire. Every scrap and crumb is welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 非常好。非常好。你看，火卫二的环境残酷，但是它在地下隐藏着宝石。任何废料和碎渣都不要放过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Loid informs you have excelled yourself. With more help like yours perhaps we can turn the tide, perhaps...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 洛德告诉我你表现出色。有了你的帮忙，也许我们能扭转局势，也许……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It's a little unseemly, isn't it? Grubbing for resources like some rock-hopper. Essential, though, we couldn't continue without it. How far we have fallen...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这有点不得体，不是吗？在石头中跳来跳去寻找资源。但这是必要的，不做的话建设就无法继续。瞧瞧我们堕落成什么样了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Strip mining for resources can be accomplished in indicated zones. Begin processing when...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 可以在指定区域露天开采资源了。在以下情况开始操作……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh boy! You going to do it? There's gold in them there hills!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦！你真的要去吗？那些山上有的是宝贝！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Resource extraction completed within satisfactory parameters. Kindly undertake further extraction operations when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 成功在令人满意的参数范围内完成了资源提取。当你就绪后，请继续进行提取操作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Although crude, strip mining is the most efficient method to use for resource extraction. It's not like we have to worry about marring Deimos' natural beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 虽然露天开采有些粗暴，但这是最有效的开采资源的方法。我们又不必担心破坏火卫二的自然"美景"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Wow, you've tapped out the whole seam. Isn't it time to go home?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哇，你把整条裂缝都挖干了。是不是该回家了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You're really good at this! Shouldn't you get a reward now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你真的很厉害！你现在不是应该得到奖励吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Operation complete. Baseline parameters... exceeded. Congratulations Tenno on your exceptional performance: Well done, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 行动完成。基准参数……已超出。恭喜你发挥了出色的表现：干得好 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Your virulent oppression of the unresisting Infested substrate is truly impressive. It does make me wonder at your motivation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你对没有抵抗能力的感染者不共戴天的镇压，着实令人印象深刻。我都开始怀疑你的动机了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I can't believe how much you did there! Way to go above and beyond, Chip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我不敢相信你在那里付出了多少！继续加油，小翻版！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Incredible, you make it look so easy! How did you learn to do that? Can you teach me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 难以置信！你让这看起来小菜一碟！你是怎么做到的？你能教我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Proximity alert. Strip mining zones are located nearby. Commence mining when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 邻近警告。露天采矿区位于附近。准备好后进行开采。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Scan data indicates natural resources in this area. Strip mining recommended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 扫描数据显示这片区域有天然资源。建议进行露天挖掘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Are you going to do some mining, Chip? Can I come along too?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 小翻版，你要不要去采一些矿？我可以一起来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: What are the chances we'd end up at a mining spot? You're SO lucky!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们出现在这个采矿点的几率能有多少？你真幸运！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It may not look like it now but Deimos is rich in natural resources. These resources can still be liberated by strip-mining the Infested substrate in designated areas. Tenno, if you have a mind to go digging Loid can show you the most fruitful spots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 火卫二拥有丰富的自然资源，尽管现在看起来不像。只要去露天开采指定区域的感染基质，这些资源仍然可以重见天日。Tenno，如果你想去采矿，洛德可以告诉你资源最丰富的地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You have restored a great deal to us, Tenno. More than you know, I think. Your dedication and single-mindedness is... admirable, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，你已经为我们复原了很多。我认为远比你知道的还要多。你的贡献与专注都应是……令人钦佩的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Thank you. We've lost so much to the Infestation over time, but it was necessary - absolutely necessary. Or so I thought...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 谢谢你。随着时间的流逝，我们输给了感染者很多，但这是必要的－绝对必要。也或者是如此必要……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: More lost treasures for the collection, I appreciate your efforts to reclaim what we could not. I hope the compensation I can offer is adequate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 更多失落的宝物回到了珍藏中，我很感激你努力去取回我们取不回的东西。希望我所提供的报酬是足够的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ah, most pleasing, Tenno. I don't hold any delusions that we can regain our former glory - I'm not such a fool - but seeing these again is... a comfort to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 啊，最令人高兴的，Tenno。对于重拾我们昔日荣耀，我不抱有任何的幻想－我又不是傻子－但是能再次看到这些……对我来说是一种安慰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Artifacts are located in the indicated zones. Infested substrate will require removal prior to...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 古物就在标记的地点。要先移除感染基质以后才能……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Yay! Treasure hunt time, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 耶！寻宝时间，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Artifact collection complete. Proceed to debrief for cataloguing and archiving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 完成古物收集。现在开始进行分类和存档汇报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A satisfactory quantity of artifacts, I suppose. You will be adequately recompensed for your efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 古物的数量应该足够了。你的辛勤付出将得到相应的回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An impressive display, Tenno; artifact retrieval parameters exceeded. Additional reward-incentives have been authorized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，你的演出真是令人印象深刻；超额完成预定的古物回收任务。额外的奖励已经批准了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I find it interesting you have such an obsession with artifact hunting. Truly no stone left unturned...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真有意思，你对搜寻古物如此痴迷。真是没放过一条漏网之鱼……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Proximity alert. Deimos artifacts are located nearby. Commence retrieval when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 邻近警告。火卫二古物就在附近。准备开始进行回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Archival data indicates artifacts can be found in the vicinity. Collection advised.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 存档数据显示可在附近找到古物。建议开始收集行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You smell that, Chip? Smells like artifacts, y'know; T_R_E_A_S_U_R_E!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 小翻版，你闻到了吗？你懂的，闻起来像古物的味道；财！宝！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ready to get rich, Chip? There's artifacts close by, you go ahead and grab 'em!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 小翻版，准备好发财了吗？附近有古物，你去把它们取回来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Location and retrieval of Deimos artifacts is always a priority. The data I can collect from them is a valuable resource in its own right. If you want to join the hunt then Loid can direct you some likely spots. Bring back all you can carry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 定位火卫二古物并把它们回收，一直都是首要任务。从它们那里收集到的数据本身，就是一种宝贵的资源。如果你想加入一起狩猎的话，洛德可以给你一些它们可能的坐标。去把你能带的东西都带回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Proximity alert. Motile Infested aggressor incursions imminent. Prepare for defense.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 接近警报。活跃型感染侵略者即将侵入。准备防御。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Proximity alert. Breach point of Infested aggressors detected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 敌人接近警报。探测到感染者侵略者的突破点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh boy! Heeeere we go! Are we gonna start some playtime at the breach?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哎呀！开始了！咱们要来找点乐子吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Here's the Infested breach! Are we going to make some new friends?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这就是感染者突破点！咱们要交到一些新朋友了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The big puppy is taking a nap! You tired him out good, Chip. And you got a core sample, too!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 大狗崽正在睡午觉！小翻版，你把他累坏了。而你也获得了核心样本！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Taking down the apex alone would have been sufficient. Just had to prove yourself, hmmmm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 只除掉那个致命的家伙就足够了。但是你非要证明自己，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There is an apex Infested in this area that you'll need to deal with before you can take a core sample. Prepare some bait and draw it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在获取核心样本之前，你需要干掉这附近最致命的一个感染者。去准备一些诱饵，把它引出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Latrox has now routed core sample data to us, Tenno, he does have his uses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 拉托罗已经把核心样本数据发送给我们了，Tenno。他确实有点用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent, Latrox has collected a number of samples on our behalf. Well done, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 太好了，拉托罗为我们收集了许多样本。干得好，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Contact our Corpus friend Latrox! He can help you to get a core sample if you protect him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 联系我们的 Corpus 朋友拉托罗！如果你保护他的话，他会帮你拿到核心样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Now THAT's all done with, I suppose you could grab a core sample.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 现在全都完成了， 我想你可以去拿一个核心样本了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Proximity alert, eliminate local infested aggressors in order to procure a core sample.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 敌人接近警报，要想获取一份核心样本，需要消灭当前区域内的感染侵略者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I'm told you have extracted a set of core samples. Good work, Tenno, I believe we're done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我听说你已经提取了一组核心样本。干得好，Tenno，我相信这已经没我们什么事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Loid tells me you got all the core samples needed and more. Excellent. These will give me considerable insight into the problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 洛德告诉我，你得到了所有需要的核心样本，还有其他更多的战利品。好极了，这些会让我对问题有更深入的了解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Based on the other core samples I have located the best place to get the final set. Proceed to the excavators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 根据其他核心样本，我找到了获取最后一组的最佳位置。到挖掘机那里去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well done, Tenno, that little fracas has secured us a core sample from the grateful Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 干得好，Tenno。由于刚才那场小打小闹，表示感谢的 Grineer 给了我们一份核心样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There's some Grineer survivors workin' round here that might help out; I should have baked cookies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这附近有些 Grineer 幸存者在这里工作，也许能帮上忙；我应该烤些饼干的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Geological core samples can be procured nearby that will reveal vital data about Deimos Infestation levels. Please...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这附近可以拿到地质核心样本，它们是可以揭示有关火卫二感染者水平的重要数据。请……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Just ignore them and blast infested, it'll do more good!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 忽略他们然后炸飞感染者，这样做才会更好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It is vital that we gain a proper understanding of the Infestation on Deimos in order to protect the heart. Loid will instruct you on how to procure geological core samples in relevant areas. This would be a great help to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 为了保护"心"，我们必须充分了解火卫二上的感染者。洛德将会指引你如何在相关区域采集地质核心样本。这将会对我大有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Mission parameters have been violated. The mission is no longer tenable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已违反任务参数。任务已无法继续执行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh no! You can't complete the mission now. Booooo!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢不！你现在没法完成这个任务。啧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well...that was less than ideal, wasn't it? Mission failed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嗯……和最理想的状态还差一点，不是吗？任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh, tough luck! You can't finish the mission now, so there'll be no cake for anyone - frowny face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦，运气不好！你现在无法完成任务，所以就没有蛋糕给大家吃了－失望脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Mission objective now unachievable. Fantastic. Now we are just going to have to start over...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 任务目标现已无法实现。真、好、呢，我们现在得从头再来了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It is likely the Grineer ran into difficulties when they encountered this organism. Continue your search, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Grineer 很有可能是在遭遇了这种生物时遇到的困难。继续你的搜索，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ssssssh. The big puppy AND its momma are taking a nap! You rule at playtime!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘘嘘嘘嘘！大狗崽和它的妈妈正在小憩！游戏时间你说了算！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A large predator roams this area. It must be neutralized before we can attempt to locate the Grineer. Advice - look for appropriate bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有一头大型掠食者在该区域游荡。在我们试着定位 Grineer 之前，必须先解决这个威胁。建议 — 找到合适的诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Maybe these were what chewed on the grunters? They don't normally like asking for help, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 也许这些就是啃食了那些菜鸟？他们一般不喜欢寻求帮助的，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A large concentration of Infested are close by. They must be dealt with before we attempt to locate the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 大量感染者集中在附近。在我们试着定位 Grineer 之前，必须先处理掉它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I'm sure that the Grineer will be able to make it out on their own now. Thank you for indulging me, Tenno, all non-infested are allies, and we need allies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我十分肯定 Grineer 现在能够自己解决问题。Tenno，谢谢你纵容我，所有的非感染者都是盟友，并且我们需要盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The poor Grineer are out of peril thanks to your charitable efforts. Such a demonstration of your destructive power is also... helpful in keeping the peace, should they ever consider becoming... aggressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 多亏了你的善行，可怜的 Grineer 现在摆脱了危险。成功地展现了你的破坏力，也能……维护和平，它们应该不会再那么……好斗了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have a positive fix on the Grineer beacon. Please move to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我对 Grineer 信标有一个比较确切的位置。请移步来协助我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Whee, I always like the grunters, so funny!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，我一直都很喜欢菜鸟们，太有趣了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The contents of this cache appear to be Corpus in origin. Useful but not what we are looking for. Continue, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这个储藏箱里的东西似乎源自 Corpus。有点用处，但不是我们要的。继续，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An impressive victory, Tenno. Sadly the cache itself gives us no clues about the Grineer, although the resources it contains are always welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你打了一场漂亮的胜仗，Tenno。很可惜，这个储藏箱本身并没有给我们提供任何关于 Grineer 的线索，尽管它里面的资源还不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh, hey, there's a cache! Maybe the grunters left it behind. We should try and open it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦，嘿，那里有个储藏箱！会不会是那些菜鸟们留下的？我们应该试试打开它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: These look old, I don't think they're from the squad we're looking for. Shame... no wait that means they're still alive, maybe, yay!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他们看起来很老，我不认为他们是我们要找的小队里的人。真可惜…… 不，等等，这也许意味着他们还活着，耶！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent data recovery, Tenno. It appears that some Grineer lost a fight with infested here, but that was long ago. We need to keep searching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 数据恢复得很好，Tenno。看来是一些 Grineer 被感染者打败了，但这是很久以前的事了。我们需要继续搜寻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There are Grineer artifacts buried in the infested substrate nearby. Activate a Purifier so we can get a better look at them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有一些 Grineer 的古物埋藏在附近的感染基质里。激活净化器，以便我们更容易地找到它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Grineer may be... unsavory, but ultimately they are not the infested and we need all the help we can get. Kindly locate and assist a stranded squad of Grineer. Rest assured they will be non-hostile, these Grineer fully grasp their situation here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Grineer 或许……让人反感，但说到底，他们并不是感染者，而我们则需要任何可能的帮助。麻烦你前去搜寻一支受困的 Grineer 小队，并给予他们必要的援助。我向你保证，他们不会与你敌对，这些 Grineer 很清楚自己的处境。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Latrox has his uses, but he seems clueless about the location of any caches. He is likely lying to keep them for himself. Corpus is as Corpus does.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 拉托罗有他的用处，但他看起来似乎对任何储藏箱的位置都一无所知。他很可能是在撒谎，想把那些储藏箱占为己有。Corpus 就是 Corpus。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Corpus researcher Latrox Une is in the area. Seek his assistance for cache reclamation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Corpus 研究员拉托罗·恩在这片区域。去寻求他的帮助，来收复储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's it; you're all clear. Now... where were we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好了；都搞定了。现在……我们在哪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent work, Tenno. With the Infested so comprehensively out of the picture, you should be clear to proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 做得好，Tenno。随着感染者的彻底消失，你可以进行下一步了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Proximity alert. Multiple Infested aggressors. Secure the area to continue with cache reclamation mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 敌人接近警报。出现多个感染侵略者。保护这个区域来继续执行回收储藏箱的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Loid tells me you have a cache unlocked. A decent enough haul for our collective efforts, I am not sure what we would do without these occasional windfalls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 洛德告诉我你已经解锁了储藏箱。这对我们的建设是一笔不错的贡献，要不是有这些额外物资，真不知道我们该怎么办。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: According to Loid, you located a cache and brought additional bounties home along with it. Very good, Tenno, I'm starting to like you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 根据洛德的说法，你找到了一个储藏箱并且从中获得了一些额外收获。Tenno，很好。我开始喜欢你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh, hey, there's a cache near here, maybe it's the one we're looking for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，嘿，这附近有个储藏箱，也许这就是我们要找的那个？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ok, so Mr. Grunty waved his fist and said something rude when I asked him about caches, so I don't think he knows about any.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，当我向"暴脾气"先生问起关于储藏箱的事情时，他挥动拳头还说了一些粗鲁的话，所以我不认为他知道点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Given the poor performance of those Grineer it's a good bet they haven't found any caches lately. Keep looking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 鉴于那些 Grineer 的糟糕表现，我打赌他们最近没发现任何储藏箱。继续寻找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have located a squad of Grineer survivors in the area, questioning them may assist in finding any abandoned loot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我在这个区域找到了一队 Grineer 幸存者，我在想他们是不是能帮我们找到被遗弃的物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Scan logs have registered a substantial cache of lost resources in this area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 扫描日志记录了这一区域有大量遗失的资源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Time to make some new friends, best brush your teeth! Wait - Do you even have teeth?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 是时候结交新朋友了，最好刷个牙！等等－你有牙齿吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Some useful data was revealed but the primary cache has not been located. Keep looking, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一些有用的数据被揭示出来了，但是尚未找到主储藏箱。继续寻找，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That is a positive wealth of data, but sadly not the data we are looking for. Nonetheless, good work Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那绝对是一组很有用的数据，但可惜不是我们要的。话虽如此，你做得很好了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Maybe you could use a Purifier? The cache might be covered up by squelchies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 也许你可以使用净化器？储藏箱可能会被咯吱声所掩盖了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Over the years many expeditions of both Grineer and Corpus have become trapped on Deimos. Caches of resources left behind by the survivors still dot the surface. See what you can find and bring back, Loid will show you where to look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这么多年来，有许多 Grineer 和 Corpus 的探险队都被困在了火卫二上。那些幸存者们丢下的资源储藏舱依然零星散落在星球表面。去找找看吧，能拿回多少是多少。洛德会向你展示搜索地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I've successfully established a link with the researcher's data stream... interesting. Proceed to the indicated location, I believe I've found something noteworthy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我已经成功地建立起来，你与研究员之间的数据流连结了……有意思。前往指定的地点，我相信我发现了一些值得注意的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well done, full sample upload complete. This data will be invaluable in cleansing Deimos.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 做得好，所有的样本上传完毕。对于清洗火卫二来说，这些数据非常宝贵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, there's a Corpus researcher close by! Latrox Une! I bet he'll help us if we help him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，这附近有个 Corpus 研究员！拉托罗·恩！我敢打赌，如果我们帮助他，他会帮助我们的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Those old diggers sure can go, right? We got deep enough; you can stop now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那些老式挖掘机运转得特别快，对吗？我们挖得够深了；你现在可以停下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well ok then, mister smarty-pants! ALL of the excavators made it through their cycles, you rock at this! Pun fully intended!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那好吧，自作聪明先生！所有的挖掘机都在有效周期内撑过去了，你真棒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The anomaly appears to be buried. You will need to use an excavator to reach it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那个异常似乎掩埋在地下。你需要使用挖掘机才能够到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Loid tells me you have retrieved the samples I wanted. I am... pleased. I suppose you should have a reward for your efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 洛德告诉我你，已经拿到了我想要的样本。我……很高兴。我想你的努力应该为你赢得了一份奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Loid tells me you have exceeded expectations by retrieving all of the samples I desired. You have materially assisted my progress through your activities. Well done, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 洛德告诉我，你出人意料地取回了我想要的所有样本。因为有你参与任务，你对我的进展有实质性的帮助。Tenno，干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: According to the scan data, this is the final location. Whatever is buried here represents the most unique anomaly detected. Please, proceed with extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 扫描数据显示，这里就是我们要找的位置。不管这里埋着的是什么，它都代表了最独特的异常数值。请继续挖掘吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Everything's better with new friends, don't you think? Oh, and I got the coordinates of where to go next off them, nice guys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 只要有了新朋友就什么都好起来了，你不觉得吗？哦，我从他们那里得到了下一站的坐标，真是好人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You have achieved double the Grineer's kill-count and saved the day, a salutory lesson in lethality I'm sure they won't forget.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你的击杀数成功达到了 Grineer 击杀数的一倍，救了大家。还顺便炫耀了一下，和你为敌是什么下场，他们肯定不会忘记的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I am detecting Grineer transmissions in the area, somewhat panicked ones to be precise. Please investigate and render assistance - we are mutual enemies of the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我探测到这个区域的 Grineer 通讯，确切地说是一些充满恐慌的信息。请前往调查并提供帮助－我们都是感染者的共同敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Anomalous objects were scanned within this region. Be on the lookout for...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在该区域内扫描到了异常目标。需要留意……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Don't be silly, retrieving them won't make a difference!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 别傻了，找回它们也不会有什么区别！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Anomalous object secured. Keep searching, there are more out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 找到异常目标。继续搜寻，这样的东西还有更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Wow! You got all the pieces and the big puppy too! I wonder what it's been chewing on to get like that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哇！你获得了所有东西，还击退了大狗崽！我很好奇，它是吃什么吃成这样的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have detected a nearby cache that may be the source of an anomaly. Kindly locate it...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我在附近探测到一个储藏箱，它可能是异常活动的源头。请找到它……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I'm sure you've apprehended by now that Deimos is...not as it should be. Several anomalous objects worthy of study have come up in recent scans. Loid can take you through the retrieval process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我敢肯定，你现在已经意识到火卫二……本来不是这样的。在近期的扫描中发现了几个值得研究的异常目标。洛德会指引你进行取回操作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: What a lot of fresh Infested body parts. Shame we're not making stew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这么多新鲜的感染者肉块。可惜我们没打算做炖肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You slaughtered both of them! So exciting. The Orokin designed you well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你把它们俩都杀了！太刺激了。奥罗金把你设计得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Lifeform detected. Predator. Large. Loid, help them deal with it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 探测到生命体。掠食者。是个大块头。洛德，帮他们对付它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Mmm. A fine harvest of polyps, fermented the old-fashioned way: in a Juggernaut's digestive tract.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嗯。收获了这么多的息肉，发酵采用了老式的方法：通过一只巨兽的消化道来处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Listen up, Tenno. We will not be making more Loid stew today. We are going after some sweet Fungal Polyps. And not a word to Mother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，听好了。我们今天不会再做更多的洛德乱炖了。我们要去寻找一些可爱的真菌息肉。不要告诉"母亲"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: These supplies are a little aged, but maybe it'll improve the flavor. Good job!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这些补给物资有些年头了，但也许这样会使它们的口味更好。做得好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: What a haul. Luscious and perfectly preserved. Very nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很不错的收获。甘美香甜且保存完好。非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A sealed supply cache! Loid, help them get it open, please?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一个密封的补给储藏箱！洛德，请帮他们打开它，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Thank you, little sprouts. You've been very helpful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 谢谢你，小芽菜。你一直很有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Amazing! I can discern so much information from these samples! Orrrr I could eat them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 太神奇了！我可以从这些样本中识别出这么多的信息！或者——我也可以把它们吃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A Purifier can scan for those Polyps. Luckily, we have a helpful Necraloid who can find one. Oh, Loid...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 净化器可以扫描那些息肉。幸运的是，我们有一个殁世械灵能帮我们找到它。哦，洛德……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: My daughter and Loid regularly prepare simple food that the family can ingest in our... current state. A straightforward task, but she would appreciate help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我的女儿和洛德会定期准备一些简单的食物，可以在我们一家人……当前状态下摄入的食物。一项简单明了的任务，但对于你伸出的援手，她将不胜感激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Wowee! Blam! Blam! Schnikt! That'll put a scare into the rest of them for sure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 喔噫！砰！砰！咻！这下其余的也肯定会被吓跑了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Outstanding. The loss of prime organisms will help to dissuade other Infested from entering the vicinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 出色极了。失去头目生物体将有助于震慑其他感染者远离附近区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Eliminating the dominant Infested is vital to our progress. Proceed with caution and lure out the Infested prime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 消灭占主导的感染者对我们的进度至关重要。谨慎行事并把感染者头目引诱出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Area secured. You may proceed further into the tunnels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已确保该区域安全。你可以继续深入到地道内了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Enemy count... zero. That was excellent work, Tenno. Please continue towards the objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 敌人数量……为零。Tenno，干得漂亮。请继续向目标前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Whoop! Here they come! Man the barricades!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 呜！它们来了！守住路障！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Awesome! You got 'em all! That'll teach 'em not to mess around in here. Right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 太棒了！你把它们都搞定了！这能教会它们不要在这里乱来。对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infestation threat levels have been shattered. A most effective expedition. Congratulations, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者威胁级别已受到严重打击。一次卓有成效的探险。Tenno，恭喜你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Damage in this area is at critical levels. You will need to exterminate all mobile Infested in the vicinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这个区域内的伤害处于临界水平。你需要消灭附近所有移动着的感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I trust you are fully equipped to deal with the large numbers of Infested awaiting you in the ruins. You will need to be... uncompromising in your aggression.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我相信你已经做好了充分的准备，来应对废墟中大量等待着你的感染者。你需要……坚定不移地进行攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The mist has dispersed sufficiently. You may continue your sweep of the ruins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 雾气已完全散去。你可以继续打扫废墟了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's so much better! You got this place locked down in no time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这样好多了！你超快就把这个地方封锁了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We must find a way to clear this infernal mist before we can continue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在我们继续之前，我们必须想办法消除这层可恶的雾气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infestation is creeping into the vaults, and it's threatening to undo everything we have worked for. Eradicate them for me please, Tenno. It's what you're best at, after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者正悄然蔓延到隔离库，并威胁着要毁掉我们所做的一切。Tenno，请你帮我消灭它们。毕竟，这是你最擅长的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An adequate kill-count. You may proceed further into the tunnels when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 足够多的击杀数量。你可以在准备好以后，继续深入到地道内了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You rocked them! It should be pretty quiet in the tunnels for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你把它们吓坏了！现在地道里应该安静多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested incoming. It is imperative we maintain area control. Hold fast and head high!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者来袭。当务之急是我们必须保持区域控制。抓紧时间，抬起头来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Welp I guess friends explode on you sometimes. Daughter doesn't seem too sad, though!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，我猜朋友们有时会对你爆发。虽然"女儿"看起来没有太过悲伤！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You did a valiant job of keeping the Juggernaut alive... while it mattered. I suggest we press onward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你很英勇地让巨兽活在……该活的时候。我建议我们继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Fungal Polyps have grown in the fissures. It might be... expedient to gather some for Daughter while here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已经有真菌息肉从裂缝中长了出来。也许……可以在这里为"女儿"收集上一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Done and done! There's no stopping you, shiny!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 大功告成！没有什么能够阻挡你，亮闪闪的朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A most meritorious resolution to the problem at hand. We are most impressed by your conduct, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这是一种对于当前问题的最佳解决方案。Tenno，你的行为举止给我们留下了深刻的印象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We're real close to the place that's been rrrrrumbling! Let's see what's popping!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们离那个一直隆隆作响的地方已经很近了！让我们看看是什么东西在爆裂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I'm glad you're available, Tenno. We need to discover what is destabilizing the tunnels and what long-term effects the fissures are causing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，我很高兴你能来。我们需要发现是什么让地道变得不稳定，以及裂缝会造成怎样的长期影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have sufficient data to chart a route to the fissures. Please proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我有足够的数据来绘制通往裂缝的路线。请继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All clear! We know how to get to the fissures now! Let's go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 全部清理完毕！现在我们知道该怎么前往裂缝了！出发吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You will need to get that Purifier functional to gain access to the fissures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你需要让那个净化器发挥作用，来进入到裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The seismographs have been dancing a merry tune of late. Kindly find a way to seal the fissures currently opening up in the tunnels before even more of Deimos becomes uninhabitable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 最近地震仪一直在跳地很欢快。请在火卫二变得更加不适宜居住前，想办法封住当前出现在地道中的裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Aww I was just starting to like him, her or it. Purifier's not far now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，我才开始喜欢他、她，或是它。现在离净化器不远啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Very good. Thanks to your adroit handling of the Infested, you have harvested an outstandingly good crop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 非常好。多亏了你对感染者的干练处理，你得到了一个好收成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I am detecting Fungal Polyps ahead. Disgusting, but I understand Daughter has a use for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我探测到前方有真菌息肉。真令人恶心，但我明白它们对"女儿"有用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Most satisfactory. I estimate it will be a considerable time before the Infestation achieves critical levels again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 非常令人满意。我估计，感染者要再次达到临界水平还将需要相当长的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh that showed them! They won't be showing their Infested faces around here again! At least not for a while...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦，那对它们可太秀了！感染者不会在这里再次露面了！至少在一段时间内不会……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, we made it! Fire up that Purifier and we can get out of here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，我们成功了！启动净化器，然后我们就能离开这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have located within the ruins a functioning Purifier. If we can activate it, that should push the Infestation back for a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我已经在废墟里找到了一个能运行的净化器。如果我们可以启动它，那它应该会在一定时间内驱离感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Yay! Goodies from the box! We can push on now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 耶！盒子里的东西真不错！现在我们可以继续前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We've gained more than enough resources to cover our needs. Good work, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们已经获取了足够的资源来满足我们的需求。Tenno，干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We will need to access a cache for the resources necessary to activate the Purifier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们需要获取一个储藏箱，以取得启动净化器所需的资源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, mixed results, I suppose. The samples you collected will prove useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，我认为结果好坏参半。你收集的样本将会派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Brilliant! You throw like a pro! You should do this more often!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真不赖！你的投掷很专业！你应该更常这样做才对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There is an experimental fluid we can deploy that may temporarily disrupt the Infested. Call this a test.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们可以部署一种试验性液体，它可以使感染者暂时陷入混乱。把这看作测试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: If the Infested gain too much ground in the subterranean ruins they are sure to breach the isolation vaults eventually. Cleaning is always such a chore... though perhaps you could help out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果感染者在地底废墟中占据了太多地盘，最终它们肯定会突破隔离库。打扫卫生总是很麻烦……不过也许你可以帮上忙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Congratulations, the Infested are in retreat. We can now push onward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 恭喜，感染者正在撤退。现在我们可以继续前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You cleaned them all out! That was amazing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你把它们都清除出去了！太了不起了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested are gathering to drive you back. Defend this location until their numbers dwindle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者正在聚集起来把你赶回去。守住这个地方，直到它们的数量减少下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well now, THAT'S all taken care of. You can be a bit scary sometimes, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，现在，这一切都搞定了。你有时还真有点吓人，你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Exceptional lethality. Very good work, Tenno. We can move on now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 卓越的杀伤力。Tenno，做得很好。现在我们可以继续前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It will be necessary to thin the Infested herd even further before we can proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们在继续行动之前需要进一步削减这群感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A tricky undertaking, but you responded commendably. A job well done, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一项棘手的任务，但你的反应值得称赞。我认为你做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You aced it! You've got a great throwing arm, y'know, anyone ever tell you that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你成功了！你有一只擅于投掷的手臂，有人告诉过你这点吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Finally. We can get the experiment underway whenever you are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 终于，只要你准备好了，我们就可以进行实验了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We have a unique opportunity to conduct an experiment upon the Infested in their natural environment. Continue into the tunnels, and I shall explain the procedure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们有一个难得的机会，来在感染者生活的自然环境中对它们进行实验。继续进入地道，我会解释这个过程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh boy. This mist stuff was real nasty-smelly. I'm sooo glad you got rid of it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 天啊。这雾气可真难闻。多亏你把它处理掉了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That was handled with commendable alacrity, Tenno. Kindly continue to the experiment site.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，迅捷的处理速度值得称赞。请继续前往实验场地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The mist in this area will hinder our efforts. You will need to find the source and shut it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这个区域内的雾气将阻碍我们的工作。你需要找到源头，并让它停下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Loid tells me he has an experiment he wishes to conduct on the Infested in the tunnels. In the interests of science I would like to indulge him. See what he needs and help out if you have a mind to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 洛德告诉我，他想用地道里的感染者来做一个实验。出于对科学的兴趣，我想满足他的愿望。看看他需要什么，如果你愿意的话，就帮他一把。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Exquisite! Rapturous! Fermented to perfection! Oh, we must do this again. Very soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 太棒啦！真是令人喜出望外！发酵程度堪称完美！噢，我们一定要再来一次。我都等不及了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An interesting expedition, I trust? You did well according to Loid, a reward is in order for your efforts. I do hope you'll go again, there is so much more to be found, things hidden from... a mundane gaze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 想必这对你来说，是一场有趣的探险吧？听洛德说，你做得不错。作为对你所付出的努力的肯定，我们准备了一个奖赏。我衷心希望你能再去一次。那里还埋藏着太多的东西了，还有许多……常人无法看到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You are to be congratulated, Tenno. Few can confront the guardians of the isolation vaults. A fuller mastery of the Void and all its implications would be helpful, of course, but this must suffice for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 祝贺你，Tenno。能够对抗隔离库守卫的人并不多。当然，若能对虚空有更加透彻的理解，我们的行动就会更加顺利。但就目前而言，这一次的成果已经不错了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Very, very good. You descend and return, most pleasing. So many descend and remain as remains. Perhaps you might learn more once you strengthen your Void connection, it is a difficult place to navigate with only one eye open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很好，非常好。你完成了探索，并且全身而退，这是最令人欣喜的结果了。有太多人去了之后就再也没有回来。或许，在强化了你的虚空能力以后，可能还会有更多收获。但在能力有限的情况下，那里的确是一个凶险之地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You have returned as I knew you would. You dance a delicate ballet, Tenno, no obstacle seems to get in your way. Your forebears would be proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你回来了，我就知道你能行的。Tenno，你步履轻盈，健步如飞，没有什么障碍能阻挡你的脚步。你的先祖会感到自豪的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Truly no stone left unturned. Your dedication and skills do you credit. It seems there is little wonder in what befell the old order, how could they resist such focused fury?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真是不遗余力。你的敬业精神和技能功不可没。旧秩序的遭遇似乎没有什么好奇怪的，他们怎么能抵挡如此专注的愤怒？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: My favored explorer, back from the depths. It was all that could be hoped for, I trust? Loid tells me you overcame all perils with pleasing verve, you have earned my gratitude.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我最欣赏的探险家，从深渊归来。我相信这是最好的结果了吧？洛德告诉我，你以出色的表现克服了重重困难。对此，我向你表示感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: When intrepid explorers returned from the Void they would isolate themselves in the vaults until they re-aligned with causality and sanity. Technology useful against the Infestation may still -
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 当无畏的探险者从虚空返回的时候，它们会在隔离库中停留上一段时间，直到他们恢复了心智与理智。可用于对抗感染的科技将继续——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You stay out, Tenno, there's only death and decay down there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 快停下来，你别去那里，Tenno 战士。你不知道那里只有死亡与腐化！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Much has been hidden from us on Deimos. The old ruins beneath the surface must surely contain the deepest and darkest secrets. Find a way to get inside and the Necraloid will guide you through. See what's happening down there. Tell me what HE has been up to...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 火卫二中隐藏了很多东西。地表下的古老废墟中，一定蕴藏着最深最黑暗的秘密。找到进去的办法，殁世械灵会指引你通过。看看那里发生了什么。告诉我「他」在忙些什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That should do it, hand the samples over to me, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那应该够了，请把样本交给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Marvelous. That should be enough to keep the Entrati happy, give them here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 棒极了。那应该够英择谛高兴的了，把它们给我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's more than enough. I'm in your debt, my gargantuan metal friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这些绰绰有余。算我欠你的，我的金属大块头朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Tenno! You're close by! Can I...err beg a moment of your time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno！你在这附近啊！我能不能……呃，占用你一点时间？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Someone's here! I'm saved! Wait... you are here to help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这儿有人！我得救了！等等……你是来帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There you are! Oh, a sight for sore eyes. Look at you! Magnificent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你来啦！哦，见到你真高兴。你看看你！多么伟岸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: And that, my friend, is a clean sweep. All samples uploaded. I'm going to lie down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我的朋友，那简直就是一扫而空。所有样本已上传。我要去休息了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Done and done. Every sample uploaded. Science and your Entrati friends owe you a debt. Huzzah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 完事。所有样本均已上传。科学和你的英择谛朋友都欠你一个人情。太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We are green across the board, all samples cleared. Remarkable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 正合我意，所有样本都传完了。真优秀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Fantastic. I'm starting the data upload; this always draws infested, so keep me safe, if you wouldn't mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 太棒了。我现在开始上传数据；这会引来感染者，因此如果你不介意的话，请保护我的安全？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This is the part I hate. When I upload the data, the Infested will undoubtedly come sniffing about. Do not let them interfere!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这是我讨厌的部分。当我上传数据时，感染者无疑会来嗅过来。请不要让它们来干扰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Here we go. Processing... Oh, I hate it here. Hate it. I would give anything to get off this forsaken rock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们开始啦。正在处理……哦，我恨死这地方了。恨得咬牙切齿。只要能逃离这颗被遗弃的石头，要我付出什么都可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Beautiful, now we just need a few more like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 漂亮，我们现在只需要再来几个像这样的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Lovely. Think we can get a few more?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很好。估计我们还能多拿一点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Perfect, now we need to grab some more samples, just to be sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 完美，以防万一，现在我们需要去获取更多的样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There! That one dropped a sample! Grab it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在那儿！那一只掉了一个样本！抓住它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That ugly one just coughed up what we're after, could you grab a sample for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那个丑陋的家伙刚刚吐出我们要找的东西，你能帮我捡回来一个样本吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I swear if the Entrati weren't demanding samples... Ooh, there's one! Pick it up quick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我发誓如果不是英择谛非得要这些样本……哦，这儿有一个！赶紧捡起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: ...I repeat, this is Latrox Une, intrepid Corpus explorer and in something of a spot of truly terrifying bother. I really would very much appreciate some timely and violent assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: ……我再重复一遍，我是拉托罗·恩，无所畏惧的 Corpus 探险家，正处于某个让我完全魂飞魄散的地方。如果能立即获得一些火力上的帮助，我会十分感激的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Is there anybody out there? Please let there be somebody out there...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那边有人吗？拜托一定务必有个人吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: No! Bad monsters! Get away! Shoo! ...Will somebody PLEASE come and help me out of this jam? Back! Back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 不！可恶的怪物！走开！滚！……能不能请个人来帮我脱困啊？退后！退后！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh. I say. Hello there. Look, hate to bother, but I need to collect samples, and, frankly, I'm in a bit over my head. Orienteering. Organ landscapes. Monsters. Mainly the monsters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦，我的意思是。你好。听着，不是我想打扰，但我真的需要收集样本，坦白说，我有点招架不住。定向越野、器官地貌、怪物，其实主要是怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hello? Latrox Une. Our Entrati friends have, I suppose, 'requested' that I provide them samples of native… fauna. Not the kind of people one can really fail, if you catch my drift. Help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你好？这里是拉托罗·恩。我们的英择谛朋友"请求"过我，让我提供给他们一些本地……动物群的样本。他们不是那种可以随随便便应付了事的人，如果你明白我的意思的话。帮个忙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: What a relief! I was expecting to get my head bitten off at any moment. While you're here, can you help me collect some samples? Just a few, and then we're gone, I swear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 松了一口气！我还以为我的头随时会被咬掉。既然你在这儿了，你可以帮我收集一些样本吗？我发誓， 只需要一点我们就可以走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I think that's a respectable amount, given the circumstances. We could have gathered more, I suppose, but frankly, our Entrati friends can go and suck egg sacs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我认为在现有情况下，这是一个可观的数量。我想我们本来可以收集更多的，但坦白说，我们的英择谛朋友可以见鬼去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Upload complete. I couldn't manage the whole spread of samples, but screw it; I'm out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 上传成功。我不能传送所有的样本，去他的；我要走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: How can a whole moon be so disgusting? That's enough samples for today, catch you on the flipside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一整个卫星怎么能这么恶心？这些样本够今天用的了，再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Protect the immediate area from incursion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 守住这块区域，抵御入侵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Please keep the established perimeter secure. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 请保护好建立的防线。多谢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You keep this part locked down for a bit, okay, Chip?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你守一会这部分区域行吗，小翻版？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hostiles eliminated... Utterly eliminated. The area is secure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 敌人消灭了……彻底消灭了。这里安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A crushing and comprehensive victory. The Infested have lost their appetite for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一次压倒性的全面胜利。感染者暂时失去了胃口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh man, you made that look easy, they won't be back anytime soon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，伙计，你使这看起来小菜一碟，它们暂时是不会回来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That took care of the first wave. More are coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那解决了第一波袭击。还有更多敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infested appear to see this as a territorial dispute. They are not backing down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者似乎将这次作战视为领土争端。它们没有退缩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh boy, I think you made them mad, there's a bunch more coming!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 天啊，我想你惹它们生气了，又有一群过来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Scans are clear of further reinforcements. Finish what is left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 扫描结果显示没有其他援军了。解决掉剩下的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: These are the last stragglers. I can detect no more are approaching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 只剩下这些的落单的了。我没有探测到其他敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I think they got all tired out; there's no more coming. This is all that's left now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我想它们都累垮了；不会再有更多的过来。现在就只剩下这些了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested casualty rate has topped fifty percent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者伤亡率高达百分之五十。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You have eliminated more than half of them. Keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你已经解决了一半以上的敌人。继续保持。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You go, Chip! You're halfway through 'em!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 加油啊，小翻版！你已经搞定一半了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested are gathering. Kindly move to disperse them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者正在聚集。请采取行动来驱散它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A large concentration of Infested is massing nearby. Action required.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 附近有大量的感染者聚集。需要采取行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Whole buncha Infested coming together. Could be trouble!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一大群感染者正拥过来。这可能有点棘手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That was the last of them. Defense protocol successful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那是最后一个了。成功完成防御任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested incursion defeated. The perimeter is secure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已击溃感染者入侵。守住阵地了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, you ok there, buddy? I thought they'd get you for sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿哥们，你还好吧？我以为它们会抓到你呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Here's your sniffer! Juggernauts find polyps simply intoxicating... and so do I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这是你的嗅探器！巨兽觉得息肉的气息简直令人沉醉……我也这么觉得！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ah, a motile infested protomass! Juggernaut, to you... and just what we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 啊，一条移动感染原虫！也就是你们所说的巨兽……正是我们所需要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This guy will sniff out the polyps. Just make sure nothing else eats him first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这家伙能嗅出息肉的位置。只要确保没有别的东西先把他吃掉就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Let him gobble these up. They're no good raw, but processed through a Juggernaut? Intoxicating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 让他把这些吃掉吧。生的一点都不好，但是经过巨兽消化之后的？令人沉醉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's it. Eat up that raw fungus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 就是这样。把生的真菌吃掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Just let him eat. He's happy. And soon? I will be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 让他吃吧。他会很开心的。不久之后呢？就该我开心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: One more polyp should do it...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 再多一个息肉应该就够了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Just one more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 再有一个就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Almost done. Last one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 快好了。最后一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: He's oblivious! So, uh, keep him safe and quiet? Mother can't know I'm doing this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他很健忘！所以，你，呃，需要保护好他，并让他保持安静？不能让"母亲"知道我在做这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Keep him safe while he grubs around for polyps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在他四处寻找息肉时要保证他的安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: He's in a trance. Total synaptic overload. This is the good stuff alright.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他开始嗨了。神经突触彻底兴奋。这肯定是上等货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Let him sniff out a few more...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 让他再多嗅闻一会儿……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Stay with him. He's still hungry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 跟他待在一起。他还没吃饱呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: He's not done yet, and nor are we.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他还没吃够，我们的任务也没完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: On to the next one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 去找下一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Keep on sniffing, Juggernaut.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 继续嗅吧，巨兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There he goes. Our boy's got a nose for the good stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他找到了。我们这小家伙的鼻子对好东西真敏感。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: No, no, no. They'll kill him. Don't let that happen!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 不，不，不。它们会杀了他的。不要让这种事发生！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An overfed, slow Juggernaut is easy prey. Protect him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一个吃撑的，行动缓慢的巨兽特别容易被掠食者捕获。保护好他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: If those Infested kill him, it'll ruin everything!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果那些感染者杀了他，那就全毁了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Limbic system overload! He's berserk. Better pop his pustule!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 脑边缘系统过载！他疯了。最好把他的脓包炸开花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Those polyps have gone straight to his head! Take him down, fast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他吃息肉上头了！搞定他，快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: He's had enough alright! Look out! Harvest time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他已经吃够了！注意了！收获时间到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Alright, alright, we got our polyps nice and fermented. Grab 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好了，好了，我们得到了完美发酵的息肉。收集它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Smell that? The good stuff served hot. Collect 'em before they go cold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 闻到了吗？好东西要趁热。在它们变冷之前收集起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ta-da! Fermented polyps, swimming in digestive juices. Just what we came for. Time to collect!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 就是它们了！发酵的息肉，在消化液中游动。正是我们来的目的。该去收集了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: He's getting good and full. Do NOT let anything burst him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他就快吃饱了。千万别让他被打爆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Keep him alive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 别让他死了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Protect him. He's looking like a five-course meal on legs right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 保护好他。他现在在敌人眼里看起来就像一顿满汉全席。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, you're near some Fungal Polyps! Mother takes a dim view of them... but YOU could collect some FOR me! Please?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，你附近有一些真菌息肉。"母亲"看不上它们……但是你可以帮我收集一些！拜托了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Polyps are dreeeamy... but Mother forbids me from having any. You get it. Be a love and grab me some?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 息肉特别棒……但"母亲"禁止我获取任何息肉。你懂的。大好人，帮我弄来一点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, I need to keep this between us - don't tell Mother - but would you be a dear and pick me up some fermented polyps? It won't take long. Promise!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，我得悄悄进行，就只有我们俩知道——别告诉"母亲"——你能做个好心人，帮我取来一些发酵的息肉吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: He's caught the scent. Help him dig!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他嗅到了息肉的气味。帮他一起挖！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: He's found one! Quick, dig it up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他找到了一个！快，把它挖出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's what we're after. Be a love and dig it up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这就是我们想要的。你愿意把它挖出来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Mmm. These babies put the fun back in fungus. You'll keep this just between us, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嗯。这些小宝贝让真菌变得有趣起来了。你会保守秘密的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent job. Now, this stays a secret between you... and me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 干得漂亮。现在，这依旧是你……和我之间的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Delicious. And the dreams you get... indescribable. Mother would never understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 美味极了。它们带来的美梦是……难以形容的。"母亲"永远不会明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It's a brutal process, but you handled it expertly. We'll be doing this again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那是个残酷的过程，但你处理得很专业。我们要再来一次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You're a genius. An artisan. A culinary master!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你真是个天才。一名巧匠。一位烹饪大师！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Incredible job. Healthy, happy Juggernauts make the best fermentation tanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 干得漂亮。健康，快乐的巨兽成为了最好的发酵罐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have detected a high concentration of resources in this area. Dispatching excavator units for exploitation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我探测到这片区域里存在着大量资源。正在派遣挖掘单位进行开采。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Scanning... detecting sub-surface resources. Excavation units en-route. Kindly assist in their deployment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 正在扫描.……探测到地表下有资源贮藏。挖掘单位正在来的路上。请协助其进行部署。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, there's a ton of resources buried around here. I'm calling in the diggers!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，这里埋藏着大量资源。我这就呼叫挖掘机！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Full excavation of site complete. An excellent haul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 挖掘工作已全部完成。这次的收获非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A full cycle has been made by all excavators. Outstanding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 所有挖掘机都完成了一个完整的工作周期。很出色。
