/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All the diggers got through digging, that's great!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 所有挖掘机都完成了挖掘工作，太棒啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An excavation unit has been disabled. Kindly prioritize protection of the surviving units.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有一个挖掘单位失灵了。请优先保护其他剩余的单位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We have lost an excavator. Focus on protecting the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们已经损失了一台挖掘机。注意保护好剩下的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh man, we lost a digger. Better be super careful with the rest!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，伙计，我们损失了一个挖掘机。最好对剩下的那些超级小心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An excavator has completed its digging cycle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一台挖掘机已经完成了它的挖掘工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An excavator reports - mining sequence complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一台挖掘机报告－挖掘序列完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Green light! That's a digger finished diggin'!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 绿灯！那是一台挖掘机完工了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Autonomous excavation units can be found in the vicinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 自动挖掘单位就在这儿附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have located excavation units that may prove useful for this next task.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我已经找到了能在下一步任务中用到的挖掘单位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We need to find a way to dig down. Guess we could use those digging machines?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们得想办法往下挖。或许我们可以利用那些挖掘机？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An excavator has been severely damaged. Do try to keep it functional.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一台挖掘机已经严重损坏了。至少维护一下，让它可以正常运转吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Severe damage has been registered to an excavation unit. Please prioritize it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一个挖掘机已被严重损坏。请优先处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: One of the diggers is getting smashed up! Don't let it blow up or we'll lose out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有一台挖掘机正遭到破坏！别让它炸了，不然我们就吃亏了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An excavator has powered down. If you can scavenge an energy source, it can be brought back online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一台挖掘机失去动力了。如果你能搜刮来一个能量源，它就能重新启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: An excavator has lost power. Re-initiate it with a locally-procured power source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一个挖掘机失去电力了。用"本地产"的电源重新启动它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: One of the diggers ran out of juice. We better see what we can find to power it up again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有一台挖掘机没能量了。我们最好四处找找，看有没有什么东西能给它提供能源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excavator back online. Continue protection and monitoring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 挖掘机重新启动。继续防卫和监视。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excavator power levels acceptable. Mining sequence restarted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 挖掘机电量可接受。挖掘序列重新开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Okey dokey, that fixed it! It's working again now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好了好了，修好了！现在又可以用了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excavation complete. A satisfactory haul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 挖掘完成。令人满意的收获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Mining completed within acceptable parameters. We took what we could.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 挖掘工作在可接受的范围内完成了。我们拿到了我们能获得的所有东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, we got some stuff, I guess, coulda been better, no?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，我们得到了一些东西，我想，还可以更好，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hive located. Destroy it with weapon-fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 成功定位巢囊。开火摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have detected a hive nearby. Shoot to destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我在附近探测到了一个巢囊。击毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh! Oh! Look! There's a hive! Nuke it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢！噢！看呐！这有个巢囊！灭了它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You will need to destroy some Infested hive-tumors to draw out the larger specimens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你得消灭一些感染巢囊肿瘤，来引出更大的样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: If you destroy Infested hives the larger Infested will soon appear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果你摧毁了感染巢囊，更大的感染者很快就会出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Blast some hives to call up the bitey brigade!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 炸开一些巢囊来唤出那些爱咬人的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That got their attention. Hostiles incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 被他们发现了。敌人向我们靠近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested activity spiking. They will be upon you soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者活动激增。它们马上就要来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ok, now that they're good and mad, hope you're ready!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，它们现在彻底生气了，希望你准备好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All hostiles down. Move on and destroy the next hive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已消灭所有敌人。继续前进，摧毁下一个巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Area cleared. We should locate another hive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这没有敌情了。我们应该再找一个巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: They're all tuckered out! Let's go find some more playmates, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他们都不行了！让我们去找其他人玩玩吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infestation activity has been reduced to within acceptable parameters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者的活动已降低到可接受的参数范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Area clear. That should buy us breathing room for a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 区域安全。我们应该能有时间喘口气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It's gone all quiet, that means we won!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好安静啊，这意味着我们赢啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: FRIENDS now, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们现在是朋友了么，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh, this good. So close and not dead yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，太好了。刚才差点儿就没命了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Grineer, friend. Tenno, friend. All friends together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Grineer，朋友。Tenno，朋友。所有的朋友们都到一起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All alive. You GOOD, Tenno. How Garv help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 全员存活。你很厉害，Tenno。有什么需要加弗帮忙的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Grineer live, Infested die. A GOOD day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Grineer 活着，感染者死了。真是个好日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Garv is glad Tenno on side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 加弗很高兴看到 Tenno 在身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Har Har, Grineer best!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哈哈，Grineer 是最棒的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ha! Grineer strong!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哈！Grineer 很强！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh, Tenno! Not so fierce, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢，Tenno！似乎也不怎么厉害嘛？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey! Tenno! Come!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 喂！Tenno！快过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Want something, shiny?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 想不想要个，闪闪发亮的东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All friends on Deimos. Come!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 火卫二上的朋友们。快来啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We kill Infested. You kill Infested. See who's best, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们杀感染者。你也杀感染者。我们比比看谁更厉害，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We all kill Infested. Yes? See who kills most.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们都要去杀感染者。没错吧？看看谁杀得最多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Up for contest? See who kill most Infested first, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 想比一比吗？看谁先杀死最多的感染者，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Grah! Kill quicker! Tenno is winning!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 呃啊！快点儿杀！Tenno 就要赢了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Tenno won't beat us! Shoot! Shoot!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 绝不能输给 Tenno！射击！快射击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Don't let Tenno win! Shoot more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 别让 Tenno 获胜了！加大火力，射击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ok, ok, Tenno wins. What you want to know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，好吧，Tenno 赢了。有什么你想知道的么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Bah! Tenno is king. Garv knows secret, wanna hear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 唉！Tenno 现在称王称霸了。加弗知道秘密，想听吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Impressive. How can Garv help Tenno-ally?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 厉害啊。那么接下来，加弗该如何帮助 Tenno 盟友？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: If you gather the correct materials you can persuade the Infestation to open up for us. Think of it like gathering bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果你收集了正确的材料，你就能说服感染者给我们让出一条通路。就像收集诱饵一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey that entry looks like it eats stuff, maybe we can get it to open up if we feed it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，那个入口看起来是要吃东西的，如果我们喂它也许能打开它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infestation is strong but stupid, with the right materials we can fool it into letting us enter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者虽然很强大，但却不聪明。只要有合适的材料，我们就能骗过它让我们进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Protect the vessel while it is stewing. The stench is bound to draw Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 烹饪的时候保护好厨具。那股恶臭势必会引来感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Now we're cooking! Uh-oh something's coming, don't let it grab the snacks!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 现在我们进行烹饪！啊哦，有什么东西过来了，别让它抢走我们制作的点心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Be on the lookout for Infested, they will likely come and investigate - do not let them disrupt the process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 留意感染者，它们很可能会来调查－不要让它们打断这个进程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested giblets. That should do nicely, find more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者的内脏。这个应该会很有用，再多找点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That looks yummy for a monster-door, let's find some more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 看起来怪物门觉得这个很好吃，我们再去多找点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Collecting tissue samples from Infested can supply us with a biological 'key'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 从感染者那里收集组织样本，可以为我们提供一个生物"钥匙"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oops. Well we can make another concoction I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哎呀。好吧，看来我们要再制造多一个混合诱饵了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ha! You suck. We'll have to make another snack now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哈！你真菜。我们现在得再做一个小零食了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You need to hit the orifice when you throw. Now we will need to start over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你需要扔中地道门孔。现在我们得重新再来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: To access the isolation vaults you will need to find a way through the Infestation first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 要想进入隔离库，你得先想办法越过这些感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Sooo the Infestation's got the entrance to the iso-vaults squeezed tight, any ideas?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者已经把隔离库入口牢牢控制住了，你有什么应对办法吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The isolation vault entrances are deep beneath the surface, we'll need to enter Infestation tunnels to reach them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 隔离库的入口深藏在地表之下，我们需要进入充斥感染者的地道才能到达那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Good. Now take the concoction and throw it against the large cloaca I have marked on the map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好。现在去取出混合诱饵，然后把它扔到那坨巨大的地道门上，我已经把它的地点在地图上标出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ok, now grab the snack and throw it at the monster-door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好了，现在带上零食，然后把它扔到那个怪物门上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The combined sample is ready. Hurl it against orifice-portal and it should open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 混合样本已准备就绪。把它投进地道门孔里，应该能打开大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Very unpleasant, but undoubtedly what we need. Just a little more...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 非常令人讨厌，但无疑是我们所需要的。还差一点点……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ok, we better get another one to be sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，保险一点儿，我们最好再弄来一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We will need additional samples, but this is a good start.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们还需要更多的样本，但这是一个好的开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That should suffice, place the components into the vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这应该足够了，把样本放到容器里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Now we just need a jug to mash everything together in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们现在只需要找个罐子来把所有东西混起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent. Take what you have gathered and place it into the vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 太棒了。把所有你收集的东西放到容器里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There. Now we can progress into the tunnels. Do not dawdle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好了，现在我们可以进去地道了。不要磨蹭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Yay! Let's go inside before it starts chewing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 耶！咱们趁着它开始大嚼特嚼前赶紧进去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well done, we can access the Infested tunnels now. Head inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 干得好。我们现在可以前往感染者的地道了。进去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning. The mist in this area is charged with growth hormones. The Infested will become unkillable if we cannot disable the source. See if the containment unit can be of any help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警告。这片区域的雾气中充斥着生长激素。如果我们不能从源头解决问题，感染者将变得无法被杀死。看看控制装置是否能帮上忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This mist is weird, isn't it? Sure makes the Infested mad! Now we gotta find a way to stop the alarm and the mist! Hey! Maybe the alarm is 'cause of the mist!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这雾气很奇怪，不是吗？感染者肯定会变得疯狂！现在我们得想办法阻止警报和雾气！也许雾气就是警报产生的原因！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The composition of this mist is heavily altered. It will greatly enhance Infested tissue regeneration and aggression. We need to shut this down quickly. Locate the containment unit; it may be of assistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这种雾气的成分发生了很大变化。它将极大地增强感染者组织的再生和攻击能力。我们需要尽快让它停下来。找到控制装置的位置；它可能会有所帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ah, I believe we have found what has been creating the fissures, and likely the mist too. Destroy them, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 啊，我相信我们已经找到了是什么在制造裂缝，可能也是它在制造雾气。Tenno，消灭它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh wow! They are NOT happy! I bet they're the ones making the mist... ewww!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哇！它们不高兴了！我敢打赌，就是它们在制造雾气……呃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Interesting. I suggest you eliminate the Infested immediately. They are undoubtedly the source of the mist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有意思。我建议你马上消灭那些感染者。毫无疑问，它们是雾气的源头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Pick up that emitter unit. Its duration will be limited, but if you can deliver it to a fissure, it should be able to nullify the mist at source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 捡起那个发射器装置。它的持续时间有限，但如果你能把它带到一处裂缝，它应该能在源头上消除雾气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh hey! It's a containment unit. If you grab that emitter thingy and get it to a fissure it'll flush the mist!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦，嘿！这是一个控制装置。如果你拿起那个发射器，并把它放到一处裂缝里，它就能把雾气冲开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Take the emitter from the unit. It should be able to disperse the mist as long as it has power. Carry the emitter to a fissure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 从设备上拿到发射器。只要它还有能量，就能驱散雾气。把发射器带到一处裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well done. The mist has reduced somewhat but is still present. Recharge the emitter and seek out another fissure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 做得好。雾气已经有所减少，但仍然存在。给发射器重新充能，并寻找另一个裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Phew! That got rid of some of the mist, but there must be others! Recharge the thingy and find another fissure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 唷！雾气少了一些，但一定还有其它的！给这个东西重新充能，然后找到另一个裂缝！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Good. I am detecting less mist, but I believe there are more Infested like this. Ensure the emitter is charged and hunt down another fissure to close it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很好，我探测到的雾气变少了，但我相信还有更多像这样的感染者。确保发射器有在充能，并找到另一个裂缝来将其关闭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The emitter will be useless without energy. Perhaps recharge it at the containment unit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 发射器没有能量就将毫无用处。或许可以在控制装置处来为它充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The emitter requires more energy to function. The containment unit it came from should be able to restore its charge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 发射器需要更多能量才能运作。而它原先所处的控制装置应该能为其恢复充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Uh oh! The emitter's getting dim. Can you power it up somehow?  Maybe take it back to where we got it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 啊哦！发射器变得越来越黯淡。你有办法给它充能吗？也许把它带回到我们得到它的地方？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Quickly! The emitter still has some charge left - put it into the fissure to seal away the mist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 快！发射器里还剩一些能量－把它放进裂缝来把雾气密封起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The emitter's running out of juice! Get it to a fissure quick before it flakes out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 发射器的能量快用完了！在它失效前，快把它送到一处裂缝里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The emitter will be able to seal off the mist incursion if it has sufficient power left. Apply it directly to the fissure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果发射器还留有足够的能量，它就能把侵袭的雾气封闭起来。直接把它应用在裂缝处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The containment unit is close by. Let us hope it can offer a solution to this mist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 控制装置就在附近。希望它能解决这片雾气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Mr noisy-alarm is near us. He's gotta have some way of dealing with the mist, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 聒噪先生在我们附近。他肯定有某种办法来对付雾气的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You are approaching the hazard containment unit. It should have some utility in combating the mist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你正在接近危险控制装置。它在对抗雾气方面应该有一定的作用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The mist is definitely coming from these fissures. The emitter will need more energy to seal them. Perhaps the containment unit can recharge it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 雾气一定是来自于这些裂缝。发射器需要更多的能量来密封它们。也许控制装置可以给它充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Look! The mist is coming from the fissures! Go back to the containment unit, charge the emitter, and we can seal that fissure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 看！雾气是从裂缝里出来的！回到控制装置那里，给发射器充能，这样我们就能封住裂缝！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The fissures appear to be the source of the mist. You will need to power up the emitter to close them off. You can return to the containment unit to recharge the emitter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 裂缝似乎是雾气的源头。你需要给发射器通入能量以关闭它们。你可以返回到控制装置那来为发射器充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Watch out! If the bad puppies get close to the fissure they could dig it up again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 小心！如果坏狗狗靠近裂缝，那它们可能会把裂缝再挖开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Caution. The Infested may be able to re-open the fissure if you do not stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 小心点。如果你不阻止感染者，它们可能会重新打开裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Keep the Infested away from the fissure, or they may find a way to crack it open again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 让感染者远离裂缝，否则它们可能会找到一种方法，来把裂缝再次打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent work, Tenno. We'll have these all sealed in no time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，干得好。我们很快就能把这些都密封起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well done, but there's no time to waste. Find and close the other fissures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 做得好，但时间不等人。找到并关闭其他的裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You shut it down! That's great, but I think there's more that need shutting...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你把它关停了！很好，但我认为还有更多需要关停的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hmm. An old hazard containment unit in the tunnels is sending out an alert. Kindly see what has set it off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嗯。地道里一个旧的危险控制装置发出了警报。请去看看是什么触发了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We got alarms going off in the tunnels! We gotta find out what's making all the racket!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 地道里的警报响了！我们得弄清楚是什么东西这么吵！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Alert! I have detected warning signals emanating from a hazard containment installation. We should investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警报！我探测到一个危险控制装置发出的警告信号。我们应该进行调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Those maggots are unusual. They may be related to the mist in some way. Perhaps they are emerging from the fissures?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这些蛆虫很不寻常。它们可能与雾气有某种关联。也许它们是从裂缝中冒出来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You see those squiggly, glistening, gross, dangerous-looking things crawling at us? Let's go see where they're coming from!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你有看到那些弯弯绕绕、闪闪发亮、让人恶心，且看起来很危险的东西在向我们爬来吗？让我们去看看它们是从哪里来的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have not seen anything like these maggots before. They must be emerging from the fissures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我从来没见过类似这些蛆虫的东西。它们一定是从裂缝中冒出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent. The mist has been contained, and the fissures sealed. That was difficult work; I trust it was not too draining. I will monitor the area in case the mist returns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 非常好。雾气已经被控制住了，裂缝也被封住了。这是一项艰巨的工作；我相信它没有消耗你太多精力。我将监视该区域，以免雾气重新出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You shut all the fissures and the mist is gone. That was tough but you cracked it! Go you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你关上了所有裂缝，雾气也消失了。虽然这特别难，但你还是解决了它！干得好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Crisis averted. Only trace compounds of the mist remain, and they will soon degrade. It is fortunate you were able to endure the experience, Tenno. I will keep watch in case the fissures reopen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 危机解除了。只有微量的雾气化合物残留，并且它们很快就会降解。Tenno，幸好你能经受住这段经历。我将继续观察，以免裂缝再次打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Exceptional work, Tenno. The air is actually purer than it was before. I will maintain a link with the containment unit so we will be forewarned of any future resurgence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，做得很好。空气实际上比以前更纯净了。我会和控制装置保持联系，这样今后我们就能在问题再次出现时得到预警。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The area has been fully stabilized thanks to you, Tenno. I will be monitoring the containment unit in case this happens again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: Tenno，多亏了你，这个区域已经完全稳定下来了。我将监视控制装置，以防这种情况再次发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We're all clear! You made that look easy! I bet those scary mist chumps won't be back anytime soon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们成功了！你让这看起来只是小菜一碟！我敢打包票，那些制造雾气的可怕家伙暂时是不会回来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You will need to release the cache before we can access it. See if you can damage that growth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你需要先释放储藏箱，然后才能拿到它里面的东西。看你能不能先破坏这肿瘤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You will need to release the cache before we can access it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你需要先释放储藏箱，然后才能拿到它里面的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The infestation's got that box gripped tight! Blast that sucker!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者把盒子抓得够牢的！炸死那个混蛋！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A job well done. You have exceeded projected expectations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 干得漂亮。你取得了超出预期的成果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Efficiently procured. The additional cache contents should prove invaluable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 高效的采集。这些额外的储藏箱物资应该是非常贵重的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Wow, you were quick! So quick, I reckon you saved more of the box contents!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哇，你动作真快！照这种速度，我觉得你能从那盒子里回收不少东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That is the last small tumor. Now return to the main growth and break it open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那是最后一个小肿瘤了。现在，回到主干位置，把它打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, that was... unpleasant. Still, you have done enough to make the main tumor vulnerable now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，那真是……让人不爽。尽管如此，为了让主要的肿瘤变得易受攻击，你已经做得够多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That should be enough, try and break open the box again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这应该够了，再试着把盒子打开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh hey, no fair! There's a protective cloud over the Infestation! You gotta get inside it to hurt the blobs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦，嘿，这不公平！有团浓雾保护着感染者！你得进到浓雾里面才能伤害到它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infestation is protecting itself with a sort of barrier membrane. Move inside the barrier before attempting to damage the Infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者正在用一种屏障薄膜来保护自身。在试图对感染者造成伤害之前，需要先进入到屏障内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Interesting. There is a sporoidal barrier protecting the Infestation. Get inside it before attacking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有点意思。有一个孢子状的屏障在保护着感染者。在攻击前先进入它的内部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Smacking down on these tumors seems to be doing something, keep doing that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 攻击这些肿瘤似乎有些效果，接着干吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infested substrate has formed tumors anchoring the cache. Blast them free.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染基质将肿瘤形成在了储藏箱上。炸开它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have detected these tumors are maintaining a grip on the cache. You will need to burst them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我已经探测到这些肿瘤正在维持对储藏箱的控制。你需要打爆它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: These caches are often left by shipwrecked crews. They are usually worth investigation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这些储藏箱往往是遇难舰员留下的。它们通常很值得调查一番。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: These often contain valuable data, as well as resources. Please find a way to access it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 它们里面通常装着有价值的数据和资源。请想办法拿到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: What's in the box? We gotta know what's in the box, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 盒子里是什么？我们得知道盒子里装的是什么，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: No. No. No. You cannot breach the... you cannot breach the Infestation from outside its protective barrier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 不，不，不，你无法突破……你无法从感染者的保护屏障外面来突破它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: No damage! You gotta get inside that bubble to do anything to the growth!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 没有伤害！你必须进入到那个泡泡里面才能阻止它增生！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: As I predicted, no harm can be inflicted from outside the infested barrier. Proceed inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 正如我所预言的那样，在感染者的屏障外面不会对其造成任何伤害。进入到里面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Look for pulsating trails connecting to other nearby tumors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 寻找连接附近其他的肿瘤的时隐时现的光波。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The growth over the cache is seemingly invulnerable. Look for any Infested tumors linked to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 储藏箱上面的肿瘤似乎刀枪不入。寻找与之相连的所有感染肿瘤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Nothing. Maybe we can find another way to break it free? What's that connected to it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 没效果。或许我们能找到其它办法来打开它？连在它上面的那个是什么东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Very good, now we shall see what the cache holds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很好，现在我们来看看储藏箱里装了些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent. You should be able to retrieve the cache now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很好，你现在应该可以找回储藏箱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Woohoo! WHAT'S IN THE BOX?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 呜呼！盒子里装了什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Cache is open, and contents secured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 储藏箱已打开，我们可以拿到里面的东西了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infestation defeated. The cache held some valuable data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者已被击退。储藏箱里存有一些有价值的数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, blasting things was more fun than opening the box...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，炸东西可比开盒子有趣多了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Purifier operational. Prevent any Infested from interfering with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 净化器正在运行。不要让感染者打断它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Keep the motile Infested at bay while the Purifier does its work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在净化器运作时，请将活跃的感染者抵挡在外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: If Mr. Scratchikins pays us a visit and plays too long, the Purifier's gonna stop working.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 要是抓挠兽先生来拜访我们，然后又玩得太久，净化器可是会停止运作的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We call this a 'Purifier'. Once powered up, it establishes a harmonic with local fauna in order to extract data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们叫它"净化器"。通电以后，它会和当地生物建立一道谐波来提取数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Once powered up, a Purifier's influence will make nearby flora extrude sensory filaments. These are a rich source of biological data on the infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 一旦启动，净化器对周遭产生的影响，会使附近的植物探出感应细丝。这些都是有关感染的丰富生物数据来源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: When its got juice, a Purifier upsets the plants, and they stick their tongues out to taste what's different. Power it up, you'll see!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 当净化器有了电的时候，它可以让植物感到不舒服，到时候植物会伸出舌头，尝尝是不是有什么东西不一样了。给净化器通上电，你就知道了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Purifier operation completed, and rare samples gathered. This data is excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 净化器运行完毕，也收集了稀有样本。这个数据很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A fine harvest indeed. The information received exceeds expectations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真是一场大丰收。获得的信息超出了预期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All done. You even got some extra rare shells too - so smooth!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 都搞定了，你甚至还额外找到了一些稀有的壳 — 它们可真光滑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have detected some rare mollusks within range. The data from those would be particularly valuable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我在附近探测到一些罕见的无脊灵蕙。从它们身上获取的数据将会很有价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: More calcified samples have additional data. In particular, look out for unusual mollusks, they are high value.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 更多的钙化样本能获得额外的数据。特别是要注意那些不同寻常的无脊灵蕙，它们具有很高的价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Sometimes we find rare shells, and they are super worth it. Grab them if you can!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有时候我们能发现稀有的壳，它们超有价值的。尽量把它们带走吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Rare sample retrieved. Excellent work, Tenno, keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 已取回稀有样本。Tenno，干得漂亮，继续保持。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Congratulations, you have secured the special samples. Now finish the rest of the job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 恭喜，你已获得特殊样本。现在完成剩下的工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh, hey, you got the special shells! That's top work! Still need to do the rest, though, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦、嘿！你找到特殊的壳了！它们可值钱了！不过，我想咱们还是得把活干完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Purifier sweep is fifty percent complete. Continue operation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 净化器的清扫工作已完成百分五十。继续运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Purifier is halfway through its operation. Remain in proximity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 净化器已运行到一半了。留在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Purifier's half-done, keep at it, and soon it'll be whole-done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 净化器的进度完成一半了，继续坚持，很快就要全部大功告成了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: With the correct stimulus, Deimos can be persuaded to give up some of its secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 只要有正确的刺激措施，就能打动火卫二吐露一些秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infestation on Deimos may seem overwhelming, but we can make that work for us at times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 火卫二上的感染者或许看起来可怖，但我们有时可以让它为我们所用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You ever seen a Purifier? We use them to find out stuff about the Infestation and what's under it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你见过净化器吗？我们用它来找出有关感染者的情报，还有它隐藏的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning. Infested damaging the Purifier will disrupt its operation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警告。感染者对净化器的破坏将会打断它的正常运作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infested aggressors are damaging the Purifier. If this continues, the sweep will have to be abandoned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染侵略者正在破坏净化器。这样下去，清扫工作可能要被迫放弃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Purifier's gonna break if bad puppies keep getting at it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果让小狗狗继续够到，净化器会坏的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Purifier sweep is complete. Assimilating captured data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 净化器的清扫工作已完成。正在吸收采集到的数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Those alien blooms are unsightly but valuable. The Purifier has finished its work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那些外星花朵虽然难看，但是很有价值。净化器完成了它的工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All done! We got a ton of info off those plant tongue things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 完成了！我们从那些舌头状的植物收集到很多信息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The device I am interested in is nearby. Locate it and determine if it is still functional.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我感兴趣的装置就在附近。找到它并确认其是否还能运作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The machine is close by! I hope it still works!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那台机器就在附近了！希望它还能用！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Entrati device is in proximity. Find it and assess its condition, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 英择谛装置就在附近。请找到它并评估其状况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Infested are adapting to the fluid, and the samples show signs of corruption. I will do the best I can with any further samples you recover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者正在逐渐适应液体，并且样本出现了腐败的迹象。对于你在此之后回收到的样本，我会尽力而为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We're about done! We can still get more samples but they won't be quite as fresh as the first batch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们快要完成了！我们还可以去收集更多样本，但它们不会像第一批那么新鲜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The sample quality is degrading as the Infested assimilate the fluid. Recover more samples if you can; quantity must substitute for quality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 由于感染者对液体的同化，样本质量正在下降。尽可能回收更多的样本，必须以量代质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Now, with a full charge, the device should have synthesized a sac of fluid. Retrieve it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 现在，完成充能了，装置应该已经合成了一囊液体。把它取下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Enough charge and the machine makes a gooey sac, grab it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那台装置电量充足的时候，会合成一囊液体，拿好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The device has generated a fluid sac derived from the input. Pick it up, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 装置从输入连接中生成了一个液囊。请把它取下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The device is being charged by enzymes released from the connected tumors. Keep destroying tumors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这个装置正通过连接的肿瘤所释放出的酶来充能。继续消灭肿瘤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Whatever you did, it's charging the machine; keep doing it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 不知道你做了什么，它有用，正在给那台机器充电。继续！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The destruction of connected tumors is charging the device successfully. Keep at it until we have a full charge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 通过消灭连接的肿瘤，装置充能成功。继续努力，直到装置完全充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This is the good bit! Throw the sac at an Infested to mark them and then KILL THEM!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 重头戏来了！把液囊扔到一个感染者身上来做标记，然后杀了它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The experiment begins: Throw the sac at an Infested to mark them, and then destroy the marked Infested however you see fit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 实验开始：把液囊扔向一个感染者来将其标记，然后用你觉得合适的方法消灭被标记的感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Now, simply throw the sac at an Infested to mark them. Once marked, terminate them immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 现在，只需简单的将液囊扔向一个感染者去标记它。一旦标记，立刻消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, that was a waste. Prepare another fluid sac and do try to be more accurate next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，真可惜。再准备一个液囊，下次再瞄准一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Aww that's no good, you gotta hit them with it. Better get another gooey sac...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 啊，这可不行，你必须用这个来击中它们。最好再搞到另一个黏糊糊的液囊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Unfortunately inaccurate, Tenno. We will just have to generate another fluid sac and try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真不走运扔偏了，Tenno。我们只需要再生成一个液囊，然后再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We have located a device in the tunnels that can help us expand our knowledge of the Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们已经在地道中定位了一个装置，它可以帮助我们增进对感染者的认识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We want to know more about the Infested. There's an old Entrati machine in the tunnels that can help us. You're going to love this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们要知道更多关于感染者的事。地道里有台老旧的英择谛机器能帮到咱们。你会爱上这种感觉的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Using an old Entrati device, I intend to undertake an experiment to expand our knowledge of the Infested. Come along!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我打算利用这个旧的英择谛装置来进行一项实验，以增进我们对感染者的认识。一起来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent. I require tissue samples from that Infested to examine the effects of the fluid. Deceased samples, preferably.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 非常好。我需要那些感染者的组织样本来检测液体的影响。尸体样本，最好不过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh that sure made them mad! Kill it and grab me a sample!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦，那样一来，它们肯定都气疯了！把它们杀掉，然后给我取回一个样本！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Interesting. The subject appears to be very aggressive. Please secure a tissue sample once it has been eliminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有意思。对象似乎极具攻击性。请在消灭它后，确保获取一份组织样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh boy! It barely still works! Follow those trails and see if there's a way to charge it up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 天啊！还能凑合着用！沿着这些轨迹，看看有没有办法给它充个电！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: We are fortunate this device still functions at all. Follow the linkages to find a way to charge it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我们真幸运，这个装置还能运作。跟着连接找到给它充能的方法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The device is in poor condition. It will need charging to function. Look around for connections to the Infested substrate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这个装置状况很差。它需要充能才能正常运作。在周围寻找与感染基质的连接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Yay! Victory! Thanks for the help, shiny-friend! Shame we couldn't get better samples, though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 耶！成功啦！太感谢你来帮忙啦，闪闪亮的好朋友！可惜我们没能拿到更好的样本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well, we completed the experiment successfully, although I must admit I was hoping for better results.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，我们成功地完成了实验，但我必须承认我曾希望得到更好的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Adequate, I suppose. I will glean what I can from the samples gained.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我想这些足够了。我会从这些样本中尽可能提取我需要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Outstanding. The samples you took are top-notch, prime Infested meat. Well done, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 出色极了。你采集到的样本都是顶级的，优质的感染肉类。Tenno，干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You got the best samples possible! That was a thing of beauty, friend-o!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你拿到了最棒的样本！干得漂亮，好伙计！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Excellent work, Tenno. These samples will expand our understanding of the Infestation immeasurably.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 做的漂亮，Tenno。这些样本将极大地增进我们对感染者的认识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning. Toxicity levels in these tunnels are deadly even for Warframes. The vaults lie beyond, but they will be inaccessible until the toxicity has been reduced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警告。这些隧道里的毒性水平即使对于战甲来说也是致命的。隔离库就在前面，但它们只有在毒性下降后才能开启。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh wow, it's so toxic in here it'll burn your casing off! We need to do something or the vault won't open!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这儿的毒性太强了，会把你身上的外壳都腐蚀掉的！我们得想个办法，否则就打不开隔离库了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Airborne impurities from the Infested have rendered these tunnels highly toxic to non-Infested. We cannot access the vaults until the toxicity level has been reduced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 畸变感染体生成的空气杂质让这些隧道对非感染生物具有强烈的毒性。我们必须让毒性降低，才能前往隔离库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning. Warframe safety parameters exceeded. We must retreat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警告。超出战甲可承受的安全参数。我们必须撤退了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I gotta go, it's too toxic in here for me. Cya!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我得撤退了，这对于我来说毒性太强了。有机会再见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Accumulated toxicity means it is impossible to proceed. We must leave the tunnels immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 毒性大量累计浓度太高了那里不可能通行了。我们必须立即离开隧道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Organic material from the Infested can help counteract the environment and keep us alive longer. They are well adapted to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 畸变感染体身上的有机材料有助于对抗这里的环境，让我们活得更久。它们都适应了这个环境。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey we can use Infested ick to keep the toxin off you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 朋友，其实我们可以用感染物质来抵挡这里的毒性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Use organic samples to help stabilize yourself against the toxicity levels.  The Infested carry their own 'antidote' of sorts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 可以用那些有机样本来稳定你自己，对抗毒性。畸变感染体已经适应了这里，身上携带着某种"解毒剂"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Some of the Infested are adding to the toxicity level. Deal with them quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有些畸变感染体正在提升这里的毒性水平。快点，把它们收拾了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Some of the Infested are real stinkers, get 'em before they make things worse!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有些畸变感染体简直卑鄙无耻，在它们搞糟事情之前赶紧解决掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Certain Infested organisms are massively increasing the toxicity levels. Eliminate them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 注意了，毒性猛然上升，有某些感染生物正在大幅提升毒性水平。消灭它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning. Toxin levels becoming critical. Find an organic antidote quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警告。毒性水平超出正常范围。尽快找到有机解毒剂，要快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey you don't look so good, find some Infested ick to reduce the toxic level.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，你看起来情况有点糟糕，快找些感染物质来降低毒性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Toxicity is reaching levels beyond even your capacity, Tenno. Use an organic antidote from the Infested to stabilize yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 毒性超过了你能承受的水平，Tenno 战士。用畸变感染体身上的有机解毒剂来稳定你的状况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: These are the last of the Infested in the area, the largest and deadliest specimens from deeper levels. Be careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这是这片区域中最后一批畸变感染体了，来自更深层的最大也是最致命的样本。提高警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The biggest Infested are coming, if we can make it through these we'll make it to the iso-vault!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 最大的畸变感染体就要来了，如果我们能协力突破它们，接下来就能成功抵达隔离库！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The strongest local Infested are inbound. This is their last gasp, defeat these and we should be clear to proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 当地最强的畸变感染体正在接近。这是它们的最后一击了，打败这些，我们应该就能安全前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Toxicity levels are dropping now the Infested have retreated. We can proceed to the isolation vaults.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 毒性水平正在迅速下降，畸变感染体也已经撤退了。我们可以离开这里前往隔离库了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey the tox-level is coming down now the Infested backed off, we can go to the vault!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 现在毒性水平正在下降，畸变感染体逃跑了，我想我们可以立即前往隔离库了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Toxicity is falling away to nothing with the Infested gone. We can now access the isolation vaults.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 畸变感染体正在四处溃散，毒性水平正在下降至零。我们可以前往隔离库了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There is a guardian here, a Necramech. You will need to destroy it so you can explore the ruins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这有个守卫，一个殁世机甲。你需要先把它摧毁，然后才能探索废墟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ok, Chip, now you just need to beat a Necramech so you can explore the ruins in peace  - did I mention that part already?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好吧，小翻版，现在你只需要击败殁世机甲，然后就能悠然自得地探索废墟－我是不是已经说过了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There is a Necramech guarding the ruins. You will need to defeat it in order to roam the ruins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有个殁世机甲守护着废墟。你需要先把它打倒，然后才能在废墟里漫游。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A fruitful exploration and you defeated a Necramech guardian. There are further mysteries to be found when you are stronger, but this must suffice for now. Head to the surface when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 硕果累累的探索，你击败了一个殁世机甲守卫。等你变强后还会有更多的谜团等着你去发现，不过现在这些已经足够了。准备好了就前往地面吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Yay! You got the mech and nosed around the ruins some. There's more to the vaults when you grow into it - right now we should head home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 耶！你击败了机甲还在废墟中探索了一圈。等你对隔离库有进一步了解时，你会发现还有很多值得探索的空间－现在我们该回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: With the Necramech beaten, these ruins hold nothing more for you. However, once you fulfill your true potential, I feel confident you would prove capable of accessing further, more deeply hidden sections of the Isolation Vaults.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 随着殁世机甲被击败，这些废墟对你来说已经没有更多意义了。然而，一旦你发挥出你的真正潜力，我相信你可以更深入到隔离库更隐秘的角落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: With the guardian defeated and the vault open there is nothing more to be found in these ruins. Time to exit, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 打败了守卫，还开启了隔离库，现在废墟里也没什么可带走的了。Tenno，是时候撤离了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You got the 'mech and opened a vault! That's everything you're gonna find down here. Time to get out while the getting's good!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你打败了机甲，还打开了隔离库！所有你能找到的都在这儿了。现在见好就收吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All objectives complete. You may now leave behind the ruins and head to the surface. There is nothing more to be gained here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 所有目标完成。你可以离开废墟，然后前往地面。这里没什么可带走的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This is the logic puzzle you must overcome to access the inner chamber. I cannot help you further. The victory is one you win alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你必须解开这道谜题才能进入内室。接下来，我已经帮不上你了。这场胜利只能由你独自取得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You gotta solve the puzzle to open the iso-vault on your own. They made it like this so nobody crazy could open up the vaults and break iso.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你必须自己解开谜题，才能打开隔离库。这种设计就是为防止那些精神错乱的家伙强行开启宝库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Opening the inner chamber requires you enter all four parts of the code accurately. This final step must be done by you alone, I have reached the boundary of my permissions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 为了打开内室，你需要准确输入四份密码。这最后一步必须由你独自完成。碍于许可限制，我无法继续提供协助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Warning. Damage registered - structural integrity at fifty percent. I can be restored by Void energy, kindly assist if possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警告。记录到结构损伤 — 结构完整性为百分之五十。虚空能量可以把我复原，如果可以的话请帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey hey I'm gettin' kinda busted up here, like half-dead! Help a friend out? You can re-juice me with Void energy if you can spare it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿哟，我有点撑不住了，像半死不活一样！帮帮朋友吧？你可以用虚空能量让我满血复活，如果你愿意慷慨解囊的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I have suffered substantial damage. Request stabilisation with Void energy if available.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我受到了严重伤害。如果可以的话，请求使用虚空能量来把我稳住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Follow me. I will take you to the safety interlocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 跟紧我。我会带你去安全锁那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Come on, I'll show you the locks on the vault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 来，我带你去看看隔离库的门锁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There is one last obstacle to overcome before access is granted. Right this way...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在我们拿到访问权限之前，还有最后一个障碍需要克服。走这边……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Damage approaching critical levels. Self-preservation protocols active.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 受损程度即将达到危重级别。自我保护机制已启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Imma gone have to bail if this keeps up, I'm all but done -help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 再这么下去的话，我真得跑路了。现在正是危急关头 — 来帮帮我吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I must retreat. Farewell, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我必须撤退了。再会，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: W-warning. Damage.. severe. I cannot hold on much longer. Void energy required.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 警-警告。损坏……严重。我撑不住了。需要虚空能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Hey, Chip, help a buddy out? 'Ole Otak is going down hard here...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 嘿，小翻版，帮帮你的朋友吧？老奥塔在这儿可是受罪了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Critical damage has been registered to this unit. System failure imminent. Void energy recharge essential.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 该单位已遭到严重损坏。系统即将失效。急需虚空能量补给。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You can only make three mistakes before the vault will lock permanently. Be sure before you input.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在隔离库永久封锁之前，你只有三次试错的机会。请在输入之前确认好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: If you botch it three times the vault locks you out for good, so don't do that ok?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 如果你搞错三次，隔离库就会永远和你隔离了，所以不要一而再，再而三，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A maximum of three errors are permitted before the failsafe protocol seals the vault. Do not simply guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 在故障安全协议完全封锁隔离库前，最多允许三次错误的尝试。请不要瞎猜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This is a sanity test that was applied to prevent unstable minds from entering or exiting the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这是一项心智测试，用来防止精神不稳定的人进出虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The code's to stop anyone crazy getting in or out, should be easy enough if you're not crazy, Chip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这些密码是为了防止神志不清的人进进出出，小翻版，如果你神志没问题，对你来说应该一点都不难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: A sane, rational thought process is needed to finalize opening the Vault. Void exposure often brought about the opposite state of mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 要最终打开隔离库，需要一个理智的、理性的思考过程。虚空暴露症常常会导致相反的心理状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Beware of the guardian. It will be hastening here to investigate the vault opening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 当心守卫者。它很快就会过来调查隔离库开启的情况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's going to bring the Necramech running, well, striding. You better get ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 那会让殁世机甲动起来的，好吧，是飞奔起来。你最好做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Necramech is coming. Fight well; I wish you luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 殁世机甲来了。奋战吧；祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Emergency. Micro-jump escape activated. Goodbye, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 紧急状况。启动微型迁跃逃脱。再见，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Uh-oh I'm outta here, cya!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 呃哦，我先走了，再见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: My casing is compromised. I must withdraw. Good luck, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我的外壳遭到了破坏。我必须撤退了。祝你好运，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: With the generators all active, it is now possible to open the vault. One obstacle remains...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 所有的发电机已开启，现在已经可以打开隔离库了。只剩下一个障碍……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ok power's on, now we gotta use that code on the door!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 好的，电源打开了，现在我们要在门上使用那个密码了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Now that I have activated all of the generators, the vault door is now active and awaiting the correct code...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 现在我已开启了所有发电机，隔离库的大门现在已被激活，并且正在等待输入正确的密码……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: While disabling one arm is a good start, the Necramech remains eighty-two percent combat effective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 废掉一条手臂是一个好的开始，殁世机甲的战斗力还剩下 82%。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You got his arm! You're doing great!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你打掉了他的手臂！你做得很好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Well done, one arm down. Keep at it, more of the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 干得好，废除了一只手臂。坚持下去，如法砲制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: With both arms disabled the Necramech is still forty percent combat effective. Do not stop attacking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 殁世机甲在废除了两只手臂的情况下仍然具有 40% 的战斗力。不要停止攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You got his other arm! That's brilliant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你打掉了他另外一条手臂！太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Another arm out of action. Excellent work, almost there...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 另一只手臂失灵了。干得漂亮，快结束了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Necramech has ceased function. A most satisfactory outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 殁世机甲已停止运行。真是一个非常令人满意的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Aaaaand he's down! Never doubted you for a minute, Chip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他倒下了！我就知道你一定会赢，小翻版！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I confess I had my concerns, but that was expertly handled. The guardian is completely disabled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 我承认我之前有点担心，不过那已经被专业地处理掉了。守卫完全瘫痪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Ah. The Necramech guardian is here. Defend yourself, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 啊。殁世机甲守卫来了。Tenno，保护好自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Here's the big guy! He sure ain't pleased to see you, Chip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这里有个大家伙！小翻版，他一定不待见你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The guardian of the vault approaches. You must defeat it, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 专门对付擅闯者的守卫。Tenno，你必须打败它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Error. Two attempts left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 错误。还剩两次解谜次数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh boy, that ain't it! Good thing you got two more tries!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 哦我的天，不对！好在你还有两次机会！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Unfortunate. You have two attempts remaining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 真遗憾。你还有两次解谜次数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You have failed the sanity test. The vault is now sealed. Disappointing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你没有通过心智测试。隔离库现已封锁。真令人失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Oh wow you blew it completely! I'm kind of impressed. We ain't getting into that vault now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 噢哇，你完全搞砸了！我可真是佩服。我们现在没法进入隔离库了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Final attempt failed. Vault has locked down permanently. Are you in fact deranged?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 最终解谜失败。隔离库已被永久封锁。你是真的疯了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Error. One attempt left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 错误。还剩一次解谜次数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You just bein' dramatic, right? You know you only got one shot left, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你刚才只是在故弄玄虚，对吧？你知道你只剩下一次机会了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You are down to your last attempt. I suggest you think carefully this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你将进行最后一次解谜。我建议你这次仔细考虑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You are almost through the Infested tunnels. The Entrati ruins lie just ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你马上就要走完感染者地道了。英择谛废墟就在前面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Just a little further! You're almost through the icky infested bits, the ruins await!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 就差一点点了！你几乎马上就要熬过那让人讨厌的感染者篇章了，废墟在等着我们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The Entrati ruins are close. Keep pushing, and you will be there in no time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 英择谛废墟很近了。再加把劲，你马上就要到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Much that was found in the Void ultimately remained buried down here. Even before the Infestation the vaults were a hazardous area to enter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 从虚空中找到的许多东西最终都被埋在这里。即便是在感染者出现前，这些隔离库也是很危险的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: This was a bad, bad place way back when. The Void could send you crazy and you had to stay in here 'til you calmed down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 以前这是个糟糕透了的地方。虚空会让你发疯，但你必须在这儿待到冷静下来为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Isolation was always difficult for the Entrati to endure. It seemed to eat at them, erode them, so each time they dreaded it a little more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 隔离对英择谛来说总是难以忍受的。它似乎在吞噬着他们，侵蚀着他们，所以它们越来越惧怕隔离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Shed no tears for the Necramech. For they are now relentless enemies to all. And there is no countermanding that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 不必为殁世机甲流泪。因为它们现在是全民公敌。这个指令是不能撤销的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Spooky ain't it? I think the family forgot a lot of what's really down here, even before the infestation they'd begun to stay away. Well. most of them had.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 很诡异吧？我想这个家族基本都忘了那下面有什么了，早在感染大爆发之前他们就对那儿敬而远之了。呃好吧，是大多数人敬而远之。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: The vaults were extended and reinforced many times. The outer layers have all but collapsed under the Infestation's relentless spread, but the inner chambers remain unbreached.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 隔离库多次得到了扩大和巩固。它的外层在摧枯拉朽般的感染传播中都坍塌了，但内室仍然安然无恙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: It seemed such a worthy endeavour when it all began. Precautions were taken, protocols followed. Look at them now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 刚开始的时候，人们都认为这值得费一番功夫。大家做好了预防措施，也遵循了准则规范。可结果呢？看看他们现在的样子吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: They knew the Void'd hurt them but they kept going back, poking around trying to figure stuff out. Sure, it was important, but I think they started to hate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 他们明知道，虚空会给他们造成伤害，但他们还是不断回到那里，四处戳戳碰碰，试图弄明白。那固然重要，但我觉得他们开始厌烦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: You are not the only one to take an interest in isolation vaults of late. It is a fascinating development, really. Seeking a future in the past, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 你不是唯一一个最近对隔离库感兴趣的人。确实，这是一个令人着迷的成就。从过往中找寻未来的可能性，或许是这样的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Some of the knowledge that was brought back from the Void never left these vaults. I hope you can find a use for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 有些从虚空中带回来的知识，从未离开过这些隔离库。但愿你能让它们发挥作用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: There's all kindsa stuff down here. Some Void stuff they never let out of iso 'cause  it was sooo not fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这里什么东西都有。包括一些他们从来没从隔离库里拿出来的，虚空的玩意儿，因为这可不是一般的危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: I do not know what riches you may find, if any, but you will certainly discover some small measure of wisdom locked away down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 就算这里真的有宝贝，我也不知道你能找到什么样的东西。不过，你肯定可以在这里发现一点稀世绝学。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: Infestation activity has dropped to virtually zero. A speedy resolution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 感染者的活动几乎降为零。真迅速啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: All clear. Task performed with creditable expedience. Additional reward authorised.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 敌人已被全数歼灭。任务完成得相当出色。已授予额外奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.text: That's the lot! You dealt with the scratch-ikins double-quick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosMissions.zhText: 这些就是全部了！你消灭抓挠兽的速度还真快啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Alright, that's enough. Return the specimens to me, and I'll give Loid what he needs to take you down to the Heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 好，那就够了。把那些样本带给我，我会把东西交给洛德，让他带你前往"心脏"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You're still alive! That means we can fix this, we can get the Heart back if we work together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你还活着！这么说，我们还可以补救，只要合作，我们就能把"心脏"带回去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Tenno! You've got to avoid detection!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: Tenno！你得避开侦测！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Be patient! Let them pass before moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 要耐心！让他们过去，然后再行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Tenno? Still functional? Listen carefully. Getting back to the surface is not going to be easy. I don't know how to break this to you but your Warframe… it's barely functional. You're going to have to stay low and out of sight. I know a shortcut, but you've got to do the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: Tenno 战士？还能动吗？仔细听着。返回地表的旅程不会轻松。我不知道该怎么和你说，但你的战甲……它基本没法用了。你得保持低调、避开视线。我知道一条捷径，但此外的事情就得靠你自己了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Alright, with the Void closing up, you're going to be too weak to help in that frame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 随着虚空的关闭，你会在战甲里虚弱不堪毫无用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Snake's in rough shape, but she's got enough juice for one last ride. What do you say? Ready to go 'Old War' style?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 锰蛇的状况不妙，但还有足够的能量再杀出重围一次。你怎么想？像"远古之争"那样应战吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Alright. Not ideal, but I've cross-routed your Warframe impulse stream directly to Snake. Now, she'll feel heavy but you'll get used to it. Head outside and we'll run a field test before your descent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 好吧。虽然不太理想，但我把你的战甲脉冲流直接连接到了锰蛇。现在，她会让你感觉很笨重，但你得适应。在你下去之前，我们要去外面来一次实地测试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You're nearly out. Be cautious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你快要出去了。小心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: It's too soon for them… Are you sure about this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 对那个人来说还是为时过早……你确定要这样吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Not at all. But we'll have to make an exception. Just this once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 并不是。但是我们必须得破例。就这一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Having fun? I mean it looks fun! And quite dangerous. Oh good, there's another up ahead!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 好玩吗？我的意思是它看起来很有趣！而且也很危险。噢，很好，前面还有一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Alright, but there's another up ahead. Watch for its pattern and try to get past it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 好了，不过前面还有一个。观察它的路线，然后试着越过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Alright. I've got the calculus data for a restart, but I'll need ten quanta of Leptosam. Son?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 好。我弄到了重启的演算数据，但我需要十个勒普多萨姆量子。"儿子"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Let her sleep. Wouldn't want her to worry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 让她睡吧。我不想让她担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Even if I agreed to help, what about the Necramechs down there? Just one of those things…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 即使我同意帮忙，但下面的殁世机甲怎么办？要知道，这只是其中之一……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I… I have it… should we wake up Grandmother?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我……我有……我们应该唤醒"祖母"吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Do you think they will be willing to go back down? Son and I can bait the Wyrm to draw the Infestation away, up to the surface.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你们以为他们还愿意再下去吗？我和"儿子"可以把蛟龙引出来，把畸变感染体赶到地表。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I've got a little something that I've been saving for an occasion like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我有一个小东西，一直留着，就是为了这种场面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Lots of Bitey Scratchikins on the scope. Maybe they're planning a party for you!?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 天哪，视野中出现了许多爱咬人的抓挠兽。也许他们正打算给你开个派对！？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: But think of all the time we'd have for hobbies…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 但是，一想到我们曾经一起度过了许多欢乐的时光……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: To be fair - it was not exactly a 'simple mistake'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 实话实说……那并不只是个"纯粹的错误"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Son has strange ideas about what victory looks like. The Solar Rails, The Tenno, we all depend on the Heart to keep the wall open to the other side. If the Heart stops, everything goes with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: "儿子"对于胜利有着奇怪的想法。星际航道，还有Tenno 战士，我们都依靠"心脏"来让墙壁向另一侧开启。如果"心脏"停止跳动，那么一切都将覆灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Noticed my collar, did you? A not-so-gentle reminder from dearest Mother. No one in the universe can hold a grudge as deep or as long. She took away all my Entrati command words with it. Loid's got more respect in this family than I do. One simple mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 注意到我的项圈了吗？亲爱的"母亲"给我的一个不太温柔的提醒。宇宙中没有人会比她还要记仇。她夺走了我所有的英择谛指令码。在这个家里，连洛德受到的尊敬都比我多。只是因为一个纯粹的错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: How many times do I have to say I'm sorry? I broke the containment protocol. I carried the spores in. I screwed up. And suddenly, they all acknowledged my existence! Suddenly something I'd done actually mattered! As if humiliating me would undo what happened to them. We're a lost cause. The Infestation will come for what's left of us, in time. Ah! Speak of them, and they shall appear!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我究竟要说多少次对不起？我违反了隔离条例。我把孢子带了进来，我把事情搞砸了。而突然间，他们都注意到了我的存在！从这时候起，我做的事情不再无关紧要了！就好像羞辱我就能扭转他们的遭遇。我们注定消亡。感染终归会找上我们剩余的族人。啊！说到他们，他们就来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Admit it, Tenno. It's beautiful, isn't it? Maybe it's not the abomination you think it is. Maybe it knows better than Mother. Maybe we ought to succumb to it. Let it win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 承认吧，Tenno 战士。它很漂亮，对吧？也许它并不是像你想象的那样可憎。也许它比"母亲"知道的还多。也许我们应当臣服于它。让它获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: By the Heart, it's… dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 以"心脏"之名，它……死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Oh, so you're talking to us now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 哦，你现在要和我们聊了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 给我停下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: STOP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 停下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Shut up! I wanna see how low she can dig.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 住嘴吧！我想要看看她能闹出什么名堂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: The wall's closing, Mother. It's over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 墙壁开始关闭了，"母亲"。一切都结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Mother, don't. This isn't the time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: "母亲"，别这样。还不是时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I wonder where he gets that from?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 真不知道他是从哪儿学的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Oh please, you've been playing dead since the day I was born.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 哦，拜托，从我出生起，你就一直在装死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Good? You think this is 'good'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 很好？你觉得这"很好"吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Of course, you do, anything to make you feel better about yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你当然会这么想，一切都会让你自我感觉更好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: At least he didn't try to kill me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 至少他不会想要杀了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Well, I wish you hadn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 嗯，希望你没这么想过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Proceed to the Heart. Otak and I will take a damage-assessment scan of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我们去"心脏"那里。奥塔和我会对它进行一次损伤评估扫描。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Hm. That doesn't sound happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 呃。听起来挺扫兴的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Requiem Cipher. I'm embarrassed to say I'm unsure what to make of this. Tenno, can you figure it out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 安魂密码。尴尬的是，我不确定该怎么理解它。Tenno 战士，你能弄明白它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Don't distract them. This is very mentally taxing for a Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 别去干扰那个人。对于 Tenno 来说，这样会造成相当大的精神负担。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I didn't expect you'd get through the door before I had a chance to finish. Forgive me, but this is the only way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我并没想到你能在我完成前就通过大门。请原谅我，但这是唯一的办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Success!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 成功了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Clearance approved, Tenno. I now grant access… to the Necralisk. Mother awaits, but I should warn you, she is not entirely herself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 同意通行，Tenno 战士。我现在同意你……前往殁世幽都。"母亲"在等着你，但我要警告你，那并不完全是她自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: 'Intra-dimensional' what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: "里次元"？那是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Sounds like it bears repeating, Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 听起来需要重复一遍，洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Otak, I've already explained it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 奥塔，我已经解释过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: It's not that we don't trust ya Chip but... to let you in, I think we'd just feel better with the gesture. Come back with gore on your hands, thanks!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我们不是不信任你这小翻版，但是……想让我们放你进来的话，你需要用你战斗的英姿来打动我们。手上沾满了血以后再回来吧，谢了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: If we were unclear… demonstrate your readiness by destroying Infestation. Only then will I grant entry clearance. Act accordingly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 如果我没讲清楚的话……你要通过摧毁感染者，来证明你已经准备好了。只有这样，我才会把进入许可给你。请照办吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: When you get to the Heart, you'll have to patch the damage and then we'll restart the system. It's a lot, but we're counting on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 当你抵达"心脏"后，需要弥补损伤，然后我们会重启系统。虽然事情很多，但都指望你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --Daughter, the spores… Son, you're on repairs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——女儿，孢子……儿子，你负责修理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --Tenno, can't have this area contaminated. Clear out those Infested and destroy their spore clusters before we seal the chamber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——Tenno 战士，不能让他们感染这片区域。清除那些畸变感染体，在我们封闭密室以前摧毁它们的孢簇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Where the hell is that Necramech?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 呃，那个殁世机甲去哪儿了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: No one listens to me--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 没人听我说话——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I rigged Snake with an old Omni tool. Ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我为锰蛇配备了一个旧的万用工具。准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Spore clusters, clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 孢簇，清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: They're an insufferable lot, aren't they? My son, Father. Blustery and spineless, all at once.
