His absentee wife, Mother, who can't see past what she's lost… to see what she has. And who can blame the children? Daughter, trying to convince herself she's so different. It only makes her more the same. And the boy, poor Son, he mistakes kindness for mediocrity. Who's he competing with other than himself? But in a crisis, they can come together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 他们这群人让人难以忍受，不是吗？我的儿子，"父亲"。指手画脚却又是个软骨头。他不在场的妻子、"母亲"，没法看破她过去经历的……因而也看不到她所拥有的东西。谁又能责怪孩子们呢？"女儿"，一直试图说服自己，她是与众不同的。但这只是让她更加的泯然众人而已。还有可怜的"儿子"，他误以为善良就是平庸。他一直在和谁比较呢，一直都只是他放不过自己罢了。但在危机中，他们可以团结起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I've no idea what you're talking about… but even as they've forgotten themselves, their names, their bonds… they might still be a family. Seems you're an important part of that now. So maybe I can help you and your family? This Warframe Xaku. Somewhat of a family themselves. A sum of many, a composite of others we lost in the ages that our Entrati family has served here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我不知道你在说什么……但即使他们忘记了自己的身份、名字、血缘……他们或许还是能成为一家人的。你似乎在这其中扮演了重要的角色。那么，也许我可以帮助你和你的家人？这是 Xaku 战甲。它们本身也算是一个家族。它是众人的荟萃，英择谛家族在此服务的多年里，我们所失去的人都凝聚于其身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: There… and now… I think we've had more than enough excitement for one day. I could do with a little lie down...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 那么……现在……我想我们今天已经足够兴奋了。我要稍微躺一会儿了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --There's no time for training exercises.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——已经没有时间进行训练了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: ---Tenno. Get down there. You're just going to have to learn as you go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——下去吧，Tenno 战士。你只能在战斗中学习了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Alright, squeeze off a few rounds, and get a feel for the--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 好，先试着打几发，练习一下手感——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: But we've got to prepare--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 但我们得准备好——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Typical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 她一贯如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: That's my girl! Glorious!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 这才是我的宝贝儿！漂亮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You've got this, Snake!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你可以的，锰蛇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Yes. A rest…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 是的。休息……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You gave her a good send-off. You have my thanks. Ah, Snake... I'm gonna miss you. But you've earned your rest, alright? Rerouting you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你给她的送别很用心。我要感谢你。啊，锰蛇……我会想你的。但你已经可以休息了，对吗？重新导向……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Snake? SNAAAAAAKE!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 锰蛇？锰蛇——！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Snake? SNAAAAAAKE!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 锰蛇？锰蛇——！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: There it is! Tenno, you've got to destroy this thing or we're back where we started!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 它在那！Tenno 战士，你得摧毁它，否则我们这一路就白忙活了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Hu-ho-ho! You have no idea how jealous I am right now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 呼嚯嚯！你不明白我现在有多嫉妒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I've managed to bring additional systems online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我已经设法启动了额外的系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: She's waking up. You should have additional functionality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 她正在苏醒。你应该还有额外的功能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Rerouting power to… yes. Secondary systems are back up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 将动力重新导向……对。次级系统是备用的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: That's it! All systems active. She's fully operational. Go get 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 就是这样！所有系统已激活。她已经全力运转了。去干掉它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Seal the Chamber. Initiating restart sequence. By Lohk we pass through and beyond.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 密封心室。开始重启步骤。以 Lohk 之名我们继续前行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Restart in 3… 2… 1…
Again. 3… 2… 1…
It doesn't make sense. Something must be interfering… I checked the equations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 没道理啊。肯定有东西在干扰……我检查过算式了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Don't yell at me! Again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 别朝我大吼大叫的！再来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: That should hold. What do you think, Mother?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 那应该就能维持住了。你觉得呢，"母亲"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Perfect, just perfect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 完美，只能说完美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You sure you've got the correct derivatives?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你确定你用的是正确的导数？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: The chamber's sealed, that's it for your ride and a one way trip for poor Snake. I'll cut the reroute as soon as the Heart's beating, and you'll be back to your old self again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 密室被封闭了，你的旅程结束了，可怜的锰蛇也一去不回了。只要"心脏"开始跳动，我会立即切断连接，你就会回到原本的身体了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Well, check them again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 哦，再把它们检查一遍！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Come on, Snake, stay together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 来吧，锰蛇，坚持住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I know you can do this. Track the patterns, anticipate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我知道你可以的。追踪它的规律，预判它的行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Oh, so it's ok if you do it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 哦，如果你这么做，就行了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --Take it easy. I've summoned some Velocipods too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——放轻松。我们也召唤了一些迅敏节虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: The caves won't be exactly clear... but it should help. I've dispersed some specimens to keep the Infested out of the way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 这些洞穴没法完全清理干净……但至少有些用处。我散布了一些样本来防止畸变感染体碍事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Eat Pobber pellets, you--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 去吞泡博的大粪吧，你这个…——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You're going to help me rebuild my sample collection. You're probably wondering what happened to it in the first place. Why don't you ask Brother when you see him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你要帮我重新构建样本库。你可能会好奇，它之前遭遇了什么。为什么你不去找哥哥问问看呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Note the curious way they float above the surface to feed. Don't bother trying to spear them in the Exocrine itself. Too damn viscous. Their biology is crucial to my study. Infested, but not entangled in shared consciousness. If there's a hope in halting our mental decline, it might be here in these humble little specimens. Get to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 注意它们在水面上漂浮觅食时的奇怪方式。别想着叉它们的外分泌液。那太黏糊了。它们的生物特性对我的研究至关重要。受到感染，但并未受困于集群意识。如果我们的精神衰退症还有救，那或许希望就在这些不起眼的样本身上。开始行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Looks like you've got the hang of it… but you have to understand, helping my so-called 'family' is the last thing I'm inclined to do. You'll have to make it worthwhile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 看来你已经掌握了诀窍……但你得明白，帮助我所谓的"家人"并不是我出于好心才想做的。你不能让我做白工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: We call that Wyrm 'Fass'. Don't worry about him, though; he's got bigger problems than you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我们把蛟龙叫做"混乱"。不过别担心它，它的处境要比你麻烦得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: 'Vome'. His sister. They don't get along, as you'll soon see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: "秩序"。他的妹妹。他们相处得并不融洽，你很快就会见识到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: This is a good opportunity for you, actually. There should be useful detritus falling from the explosion… try not to get crushed, little one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 实际上，这对你来说是个好机会。那里应该会有一些有用的岩屑因为爆炸而掉落……小心别被砸到了，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I'm afraid I cannot open the gate with hostiles in proximity. You'll need to destroy them before I even think of powering the door!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我恐怕没法在有敌人靠近的情况下打开门。你需要先摧毁它们，否则我是不会考虑开门的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I remember my birthday. Woke with a knot in my stomach. The hum of my specimen tanks was missing, silent… but I was surprised to find a little box, wrapped in a red bow. A gift from my family that never, ever remembered. The note said: "Best wishes for my best Sis." Can you guess what was in the box?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我记得我生日那天。醒来的时候我的胃正在抽搐。我的样本水缸没有了以往的吵闹，变得很安静……但我意外发现了一个小盒子，上面还有红色的蝴蝶结。这是一份来自把我遗忘的家人的礼物。旁边的纸条上写着："给我最棒的妹妹送上最好的祝福"你猜盒子里是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: A white powder, as smooth and fine as silk. My entire collection, cremated, atomized, and returned as a gift by my deranged Brother. If you see him on your descent to the Heart, don't be fooled. He'll stab you in the back if he thinks it'll get him a moment's notice from Mother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 一堆白色粉末，和丝绸一样柔滑精致。我所有的收藏品都被我疯狂的"哥哥"焚烧后化为原子颗粒，作为礼物送了回来。如果你在前往"心脏"的路上看见他，别被他骗了。只要他认为有机会吸引"母亲"的片刻关注，他就会从背后捅你一刀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Don't feel the least bit sad for him. He'll regenerate an even emptier head and exact his revenge. An endless cycle. Vome's the only proof I've got that the hivemind can be divided. Just collect what you can so you get to the task at hand…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 不要对他产生任何怜悯。他会重新长出一个更加空荡荡的脑袋，并展开复仇。这是个死循环。"秩序"是我能够证明集群思维可以分离的唯一证据。你只要尽量收集手头任务所需的东西就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Detecting active Necramech signals nearby. It could be Father. He loves a good fight. Whatever you do, don't mention Mother. Nothing he hates more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 在附近检测到活动的殁世机甲信号。可能是"父亲"。他喜欢酣畅淋漓的战斗。不管你怎么做，都别提到"母亲"。他最恨她了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: That went well!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 进展不错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: This must be one of the last of Father's Necramechs - it won't last long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 这肯定是"父亲"的最后一群殁世机甲之一——它们撑不了多久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Guidance signal was coming from over there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 引导信号是从那里传来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Its struggle is a valiant one, but I fear the worst for our metal friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 它的挣扎很勇敢，但我们的金属朋友恐怕要遭到最坏的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Ah! The stalwart defender falls. Rest well, noble Warrior. May you some day rise again. Now: to business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 啊！顽强的守护者倒下了。安息吧，高贵的勇士。愿你有一日能重新屹立。现在，谈正事吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --'Functional'? We are… and we've summoned Chip here to help us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——"能运行"？我们……我们已经召唤小翻版过来帮忙了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Here we go again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 又来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Mother...
No, Mother. You did all of that. You're as wormed as the rest of this place. The Heart is about to fail, remember?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 不，"母亲"。一切都是你干的。你和这里的其他人都一样，都被虫化。"心脏"就要停摆了，还记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Loid, I had the most distressing dream--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 洛德，我做了个痛苦至极的梦——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --The Wall of Lohk was before us, I had my proofs, my father's. I could hear him... I could hear him tapping... tapping at the Untime door--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——Lohk 之墙就在我们面前，我带着我的验算，我父亲的验算。我可以听到他……我能听到他的敲击声……敲着那超脱时空之门……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --we went in but again, he wasn't there. My husband congratulated me. Sarcastic halfwit. All the while, hive-weed was sprouting all around us. But, it was just a dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——我们进去了，但他又不在那里。我丈夫向我表示祝贺。挖苦人的白痴。与此同时，巢囊草在我们周围发芽。但是，那只是一个梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Oh... Oh... oh fu--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 哦……哦……哦，该死——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: It'll take more than an old Orokin thug to keep the Heart beating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 要想维持"心脏"跳动，需要的可不只是一个奥罗金老恶棍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Oh, I don't blame you, you're just the product. The Orokin had no respect for my father's work. Though I suppose you proved him right in the end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 哦，我并没有怪你，你只是个产品而已。奥罗金人对我"父亲"的作品毫无敬意。不过我觉得，你最终证明了他是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Same as Deimos. The Infestation got in. Got to me and my family. Stole our names, our ideas. I can hear its hive-voice scratching in my mind: let the Heart stop beating, let the door close forever. Only my dreams seem real now, so I sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 和火卫二一样。畸变感染体冲了进来，袭击了我和家人。偷走了我们的名字、思想。我可以听到它的集群意识在我的脑海里低语：让"心脏"停止跳动吧，让大门永远关闭吧。现在只有我的梦看起来是真实的，于是我选择睡去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: It's what makes you special, you know that, right? All thanks to my father. It pumps the arteries of 'the here' and the Void. The Entrati family has maintained it for an age. But it's breaking down, and only that idiot knows how to fix it… the man I used to call my husband. I think he's left for good this time… Maybe you can find him? Probably sulking somewhere outside…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 这就是你的特别之处，你也明白吧？这都归功于我的"父亲"。是它催动着"这里"和虚空的动脉。英择谛家族已经维护它长达一个时代之久。但它正在崩坏，只有那个白痴知道怎么修复它……那个我曾经称之为"丈夫"的男人。我想他这次是永远离开了……也许你可以找到他？或许他正在外面的某个地方生闷气呢……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Oh! Aren't you a fascinating specimen? Organic-ferrous exoflesh, hybridized internals, Untime trace… you're a Tenno, aren't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 噢！你真是个超棒的样本！铁质有机体外壳，混合体内脏，凌驾时间之上的踪迹……你是 Tenno 战士，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You need me to tell you where it is. Which I wouldn't have to bother with if not for my parents, whose collective heads are so far up their collective lower sigmoids the only air they breathe is what they secrete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你需要我来告诉你它的去向。要不是因为我父母，我是不会管它的，他们总是高高在上，他们唯一在意的就是他们的秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Aww… that's kind of sweet. But look at us. We are beyond help. The disease vectors are too complex, changing faster than I can study them. We can only prolong the inevitable. Look, if you help me get back some of what my brother shredded, I'd be happy to return the favor. Deal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 啊……真贴心。但看看我们吧。我们已经无可救药了。疾病载体过于复杂，变化的速度超出了我的研究进程。我们不过是在苟延残喘罢了。听着，如果你帮我取回一些我哥哥撕碎的东西，我就乐意帮你的忙。怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: We must prove to Father that the Heart is deteriorating. This will be more dangerous than any Grey Strain monster we've faced: We have to talk to... Daughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我们必须向"父亲"证明，"心脏"的状况正在恶化。这比我们遭遇过的"灰种"怪物还要危险：我们必须告诉……"女儿"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You fight well for a runt-frame! If you're ever interested in something a little more 'Old War' sized… Wait. Wait. She didn't send you looking for me, did she? I'm not going back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 虽然是个弱鸡战甲，但你打得不错嘛！如果你对更有"远古之战"级别的事情感兴趣……稍等。等等。不会是她派你来找我的吧？我是不会回去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Look, you were the second wave, kid. The Necramechs were Void-shielded, Sentient-pulse immune… as bright as a bag of hammers and just as dependable. Not like you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 听着，你是第二世代的产物，孩子。殁世机甲有虚空护盾，免疫 Sentient 脉冲……傻瓜操作，可靠无比。和你截然不同。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: When I met her, Mother, she was as brilliant as she was broken. Chasing her father's ghost, convinced he was still 'out there'. I thought… I thought I could fix things. I thought I could fix her. Like she was a loose light-board or leaky hydraulic. So yes, she's right about me: I am an idiot. But I'm a reformed idiot. I'm done with her. This "Heart is breaking down" is just another tactic of hers. Don't you see? Everything has to be about her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 当我遇到她，也就是"母亲"的时候，她光彩照人，却又心力憔悴。她追寻着她父亲的幽灵，相信他仍然"存在"。我以为……我本以为我可以拯救这一切。我以为我可以拯救她。把她当成了松掉的光板或者漏水的液压泵。没错，她对我的看法是正确的：我就是个白痴。但我是个改过自新的白痴。我和她恩断义绝。"心正在崩溃"这种话，只是她的另一种战术而已。你没看到吗？凡事都要以她为中心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: What?! Visitors?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 什么？！有访客？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Look at you now, a real 'Chip' off the ole monolith! Just the right sort to save us from the coming cataclysm! C'mon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 看看你，简直就是从古老的巨石块上掉落的碎屑！我们正需要你这种人来救我们逃离大难！走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --Sorry Loid, it's just too exciting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——抱歉，洛德，这实在是太让人兴奋了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: --but how are you, anyway? Things good?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: ——但你究竟过得怎么样了？还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: I call that one 'Bitey Scratchikins!'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我把那个叫作"爱咬人的抓挠兽"！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: You received our distress signal. Mother will be pleased--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 你收到了我们的求救信号。"母亲"会高兴的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: We agreed: I was handling orientation protocol--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我们达成过一致：由我来处理定向协议——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: We are in crisis, Tenno. Our defense against the Grey Strain has failed. The NECRALISK is in lock-down but it doesn't matter. The Infestation has compromised the very Heart itself. We have been forced to re-phase into Martian--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我们陷入了危机，Tenno 战士。我们针对"灰种"的防御已经失效。殁世幽都已陷入封锁，但这并不重要。感染已经损坏了"心脏"本身。我们被迫重返火星——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: As I was saying, our defense situation is dire. Our remaining Necramechs have reverted to their autonomous-kill precepts. They will not distinguish you from those things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 正如我说的，我们的防御状况糟糕透顶。我们剩余的殁世机甲已经恢复了自动击杀模式。它们不会对你和其它东西有所区分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: It is imperative you meet Mother, receive her instructions, and prevent the imminent intra-dimensional catastrophe. Demonstrate your combat readiness and I will grant you the requisite security clearance. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 眼下当务之急是，你必须去见"母亲"，接受她的指导，然后阻止即将到来的里次元灾难。展现你的战斗意志吧，我随后会把必要的安全通行证交给你。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: It's not your fault, Chip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 这不是你的错，小翻版！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Have we tried turning it off and on again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 我们有试过把它关掉重启吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: The Infestation wormed into everything. After the great purge - there were no Dax, no Tenno, to defend the place. Just us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 畸变感染者毁掉了一切。在大净化之后，已经没有人保护这里了，没有禁卫，没有 Tenno 战士。只有我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Technically it is… and now you face an existential threat. If the Heart stops beating, the wellspring of your power dies with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: 严格来说是这样……现在你面临着生死存亡的威胁。如果"心脏"停止跳动，你的力量源泉也会随之枯竭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Tenno, meet the head of the Entrati family. What's left of her, anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: Tenno 战士，去见英择谛家族的首领吧。或者说，她的残余。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.text: Mother! Wake up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DeimosQuest/DD.zhText: "母亲"！醒醒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAlc.text: Alchemy? Did we finally figure out how to make gold from lead? Magnifique!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAlc.zhText: 元素转换？我们终于知道怎么把铅炼成金了吗？太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAlc.text: Alchemy. Tinkering with forces they clearly did not understand. What unholy project seared this onto your psyche, Roathe?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAlc.zhText: 元素转换。摆弄他们显然不理解的力量。罗瑟，究竟是什么邪恶的计划将这烙印在你的心灵深处？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArb.text: Bah! Take down the drones first, or else you are simply wasting your time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArb.zhText: 呸！先把无人机打下来，否则你就是在浪费时间！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArb.text: The little flying ones are protecting the others, it seems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArb.zhText: 看来，这些小飞行物在保护其他敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArc.text: Look at you, Drifter, masquerading as a winged angel. As if we don't all know the truth. You're no more angel than I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArc.zhText: 看看你，漂泊者，伪装成一个长着翅膀的天使。好像我们都不知道真相似的。你跟我一样，根本不是天使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArc.text: Take to the skies, Drifter. For Sol's sake you must banish these demons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DArc.zhText: 飞向天空吧，漂泊者。为了太阳神，你必须驱逐这些恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: Whoever gave life to this beast thinks themselves equal to the Luminaries. Please, I ask you, undo this blasphemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 赋予这头野兽生命的人自以为与双耀神平起平坐。请你，我恳求你，阻止这亵渎神明的行径。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: What better fit for the heretic than a creature as unnatural as this archon. Such a chimera could never have been created under the light of our Sol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 对于异端而言，还有什么比这种非自然生物——执刑官——更合适的呢？这样的奇美拉绝不可能在我们的太阳神光辉下被创造出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: I sense nothing from this one. No malice. No hate. No jealousy. Just an overwhelming urge for emptiness. This…entity must be defeated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 我从它身上什么也没感觉到。没有恶意。没有仇恨。没有嫉妒。只有对空虚的强烈渴望。这个……实体必须被击败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: The Fragmented One. When you confront this beast, you are battling against nothingness, fighting for the very concept of life itself. This is a battle none of us can afford you to lose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 接肢至尊。当你直面这头怪兽时，你是在与虚无搏斗，为生命本身的概念而战。这是一场我们谁都输不起的战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: My favorite kind of violence: targeted, vindictive… intimate…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 我最喜欢的暴力类型：有针对性的、报复性的……贴身的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: "In Lua's name, we strike down our enemy - not with joy, but with mercy."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: "奉月神之名，我们击败敌人——不是出于喜悦，而是出于怜悯。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: This must be one of the many demons that does not blindly follow Roathe. Teach it some discipline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 这一定是众多不盲目追随罗瑟的恶魔之一。好好管教它一番。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: So, it falls to our drifter to vanquish the demons from this heretic's psyche. Demons that Roathe seems either unwilling or unable to purge himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 所以，清除这个异教徒心魔的重任就落在了我们这位漂泊者的肩上。而罗瑟似乎既不愿也无力自行清除这些恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: The sinner who leads others into sin carries the weighty guilt of all those they led astray. This creature before you is one such sinner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 引诱他人犯罪的罪人，要背负所有被他误导之人的沉重罪责。你眼前的这个人，就是这样一个罪人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: Drifter, is this hateful wretch a demon from Roathe's past or yours? Either way, your descent is halted until they have been dispatched.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 漂泊者，这个可憎的家伙是罗瑟过去的恶魔，还是你的？无论如何，要是不除掉他们，你就无法继续往下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: What wicked souls this future holds! I do not generally advocate for murder, but in this instance, an exception I must make.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 多么邪恶的灵魂在这个未来涌现！我通常不提倡谋杀，但这一次，我必须破例。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: Oh Kullervo, you sorry beast. So suggestable. So angry. A perfect citizen for this purgatory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 哦，Kullervo，你这可怜的家伙。如此容易受人摆布。如此愤怒。真是这炼狱的完美公民。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: Does this one not understand? All sins are forgivable, but first one must forgive themselves. There is no redemption in revenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 难道这个人还不明白吗？所有的罪过都可以被赦免，但首先必须赦免自己。复仇并不能带来救赎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: All Lua's creatures are sacred… but I am willing to entertain arguments against the spider. I am not a fan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 月神的所有生物都是神圣的……但我愿意听取反对蜘蛛的论点。我并不喜欢蜘蛛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: Wait… Is that? What wicked abomination scuttles forth? I… I must look away. I do not do well with spiders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 等等……那是什么？是什么邪恶的怪物在爬？我……必须别过脸去。我怕蜘蛛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: Were these wretched creatures sentenced to this purgatory because of their music? I have heard their noise, and believe the answer is… yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 这些可怜的家伙是因为他们的音乐才被判入这炼狱的吗？我听过他们的噪音，我相信答案是……是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: In my life I have strived to endure countless mortifications, and none was more arduous, more tortuous, nothing shook my faith like listening to music from the year 1999.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 在我的一生中，我努力忍受了无数的折磨，但没有哪次比聆听 1999 年的音乐更艰难、更痛苦了，没有什么比这更动摇我的信仰了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: This poor creature, corrupted first by ambition, then by the Void. Does he himself know he is not pure? Tenno, help him find Sol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 这个可怜的生灵，先是被野心腐蚀，后又被虚空吞噬。他自己是否明白自己已不再纯洁？Tenno，帮他找到太阳神吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.text: Loyal. Driven. Relentless. Fanatical. I respect this Vor fellow. Even if he is a glorified vat rat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DAss.zhText: 忠诚。干劲十足。坚持不懈。狂热。我敬佩这位叫沃尔的人。即便他不过是个被捧上天的克隆实验鼠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.text: A battle against a powerful foe. It seems Roathe got his own hands bloody, on occasion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.zhText: 与强大敌人的战斗。看来罗瑟有时也会亲自动手，弄得双手沾染鲜血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.text: Such battles were meat and drink to me! Study the foe closely. Match their movements. Honor them with the intimacy of death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.zhText: 这样的战斗对我来说简直是饕餮盛宴！仔细研究敌人，配合他们的动作，用死亡的亲密来缅怀他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.text: Lua! Shield us with your grace! Bless our blades with your light!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.zhText: 月神！请用您的恩典庇佑我们！请用您的光辉祝福我们的利刃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.text: Only the light of Lua can prevail against such hellfire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.zhText: 只有月神之光才能战胜这炼狱之火！
太阳神，请祝福这份自愿的牺牲！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.text: Let the devil strike this holy image! Sol's fire is stronger than his!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBos.zhText: 任那恶魔来摧毁这尊圣像吧！太阳神的火焰远比他的更强大！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBre.text: Mindless destruction. Perhaps this is a memory of the devil's from when he was a little boy, smashing his toys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBre.zhText: 不过脑子的破坏。或许这是那个恶魔小时候砸玩具的记忆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBre.text: A massacre of targets that do not fight back? Familiar. The only problem is narrowing it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DBre.zhText: 对毫无还手之力的目标进行的屠杀？似曾相识。唯一的问题是怎么缩小范围。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.text: Like an unfortunate urchin, Father Lyon Allard has become caught in the machinery. If this descent is to continue, best make sure he is not chewed to pieces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.zhText: 就像个不幸的孤儿，里昂·阿拉尔神父被卷入了这台机器里。如果这种下降还要继续下去，最好确保他不会被碾成碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.text: The devil's depravity has drawn Lyon into its vortex! You must keep him safe!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.zhText: 那个恶魔的堕落已经将里昂卷入其旋涡！你必须保证他的安全！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.text: The Refractory is trying to purge Marie from the system! However amusing that is, if it succeeds, this venture is over!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.zhText: 深溯池正试图将玛丽从系统中清除出去！不管这有多好笑，如果成功了，这次冒险就结束了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.text: No! Marie, take heart. Our friends will defend you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DDef.zhText: 不！玛丽，振作起来。我们的朋友会保护你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: We went to Tau to make a new and glorious home for ourselves. Resources were simply required to begin again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我们前往 Tau 是为了给自己建立一个新的辉煌的家园。而重新开始，需要各种资源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Such machines… what empty scars they must leave in their wake. Yet without them, no progress is to be made.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这样的机器……它们一定会留下空洞的伤痕。然而，没有它们，就不会取得任何进展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Sol, guide-nous à travers cette obscurité et protège nos âmes du mal... Sol, guide-nous à travers cette obscurité et protège nos âmes du mal...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 太阳神，guide-nous à travers cette obscurité et protège nos âmes du mal…… 太阳神，guide-nous à travers cette obscurité et protège nos âmes du mal……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: It is all right, Marie… they are only phantoms, they cannot truly harm you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 没关系，玛丽……它们只是幻影，它们伤害不了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: I can only pray that the Luminaries took pity on all these poor souls…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我只能祈祷双耀神怜悯这些可怜的灵魂……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: How ill-equipped we Orokin were for war - that we had no gods behind which to take shelter from the atrocity of it all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我们奥罗金人应对战争的装备多贫乏啊——我们没有任何神明可以庇护我们，免受战争的残酷摧残。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: In these deepest reaches, I fear Lua's light will not pierce the veil…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 在这些最深的地方，我担心月神的光辉无法穿透面纱……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Be strong, brother of my soul - we will endure this torment!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 刚强起来，我灵里的弟兄——我们能挺过这种折磨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Lua, be with us… Stay with us, now…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 月神，与我们同在……请留在我们身边……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Come, shadows of my past - wage siege upon my mind all you like! You did not defeat me then, and you shall not defeat me now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 来吧，我过去的阴影——你想怎么围攻我的心灵，就怎么围攻！你们过去没能打败我，现在也休想打败我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: "Though my feet step on the sands of the shores of Death, I shall see Thy countenance shining upon the waves, and be glad."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: "即使我的双脚踏在死亡之岸的沙滩上，我仍将看见祢的荣光照耀在波涛之上，并为此欢欣鼓舞。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: My soldiers never recited doggerel. They just wept and cried for their mothers as they died.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我的士兵从不会背打油诗。他们死去的时候，只是痛哭流涕，呼喊着他们的母亲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Is it safe for us to delve this deep?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我们探究这么深安全吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Bah! The only dangers here are imagined ones - though you are the expert of such things, are you not?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 呸！这里唯一的危险都是想象出来的——虽然你才是这方面的专家，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: We have travelled far in one another's company. Nothing like shared horror to breed kinship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我们彼此扶持，结伴同行了这么远。没有什么比共同经历的恐惧更能培养亲密关系了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: 'Horror.' I would have you spend an hour within my mind, Roathe, and see how you fare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: "恐惧。"我会让你在我的脑子里呆上一个小时，罗瑟，看看你过得怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: This is a kingdom built of my mind, and I, its emperor! I command you all - obey me! Stand down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这是一个由我的思想建立的王国，而我，就是它的皇帝！我命令你们所有人——服从我！退下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: There are no servants here for you to scream at, Roathe. Only far braver souls than you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这里没有仆人可以让你吼，罗瑟。只有比你勇敢得多的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Sol has fled from this place - these memories - the Luminaries cannot help us here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 太阳神已经逃离了这个地方——这些记忆——在这里，双耀神也帮不了我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Your "Luminaries" were never real, Marie. And if they were? They would have turned their faces from us in disgust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 玛丽，你口中的"双耀神"从来就不是真的。就算是真的，他们也会厌恶地转过头去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: This suffering begins to feel like great boulders, one more upon my shoulders with each floor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这种痛苦开始像巨石，每往下一层楼，我的肩上就多压上一块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Indeed. Imagine what it was like to live this kind of carnage in the waking world, Marie?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 确实。想象一下在清醒的世界里经历这样的屠杀是什么感觉，玛丽？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: This war you fought, Roathe. Was it… truly madness to such a degree as this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 你参与的这场战争，罗瑟。是不是真的疯狂……到这种程度？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Was it this charmingly fantastical? No. Does this capture the level of egregious cruelty and mindless, horrific butchery? Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 它有这么迷人又充满奇幻吗？没有。它能体现令人发指的残忍和毫无理性的恐怖屠杀吗？能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Par Sol! How are we meant to endure this suffering?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: Par Sol ！我们要如何忍受这种痛苦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: The most simplistic concept that is impossible to teach and yet so very quick to learn the moment one sets foot into the theatre of war is this; those who can, are those who survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 最简单的概念，也是最难教却又最容易在踏入战场的那一刻就学到的：能活下来的，才是能做到的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: More, and more, and more… See them all. Count them if you dare to try. Every bullet. Every corpse. Every life spent. This is the song of war.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 越来越多，越来越多，越来越多……看看吧。如果你敢，就数数看。每一颗子弹。每一具尸体。每一条逝去的生命。这就是战争之歌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Lua, guide us…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 月神，请指引我们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: What was so worth taking, that you were willing to bring… such terrible death?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 是什么东西那么值得夺取，以至于你愿意……召来如此可怕的死亡？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Salvation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 救赎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Cloned soldiers, royal guards, hulking necramechs and Void-torn children. All to see the Sentient uprising laid low. And what did it amount to, in the end?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 克隆士兵、皇家卫队、庞大的殁世机甲和被虚空撕裂的孩童。这一切都是为了镇压 Sentient 的起义。最终，这一切又带来了什么结果呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Such is the cycle of all revolutions…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这就是一切革命的循环……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Drifter - if you feel this is too much, we can turn back. Do not put yourself at risk for his sake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 漂泊者——如果你觉得这太过分了，我们可以回头。不要为了他，让自己处于危险之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: I do not hold the Drifter's leash. If they wish to end this, they are quite free to do so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我并没有控制漂泊者。如果他想结束这一切，他完全有自由这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Hm. This chaotic adaptation of your mind to my memories - is not wholly unlike the Sentient's ability to adapt to new attacks. It is nearly just as irritating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 嗯。你的思想对我记忆的混乱适应——与 Sentient 适应新攻击的能力并非完全不同。它几乎同样令人恼火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Need I remind you that the Drifter is aiding you by doing this, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我需要提醒你，漂泊者这么做是在帮你，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: I commend you assisting Roathe in this pursuit - but do not endanger your psyche on his behalf, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我赞赏你协助罗瑟进行这项任务——但不要为了他而损害你的心理健康，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: They have their own motives in this "pursuit," I assure you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 他们进行这场"追捕"是有他们自己的动机的，我向你保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: I take no responsibility for the corruption that happens to my memories as they are filtered through the Drifter's psyche. I do not want to hear anyone whining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我对我的记忆被漂泊者的心理过滤后，所遭到的破坏，不负任何责任。我不想听到任何人发牢骚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: The only complaints I hear are from you, Roathe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我只听到了你的抱怨，罗瑟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: What could this… even possibly represent?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这到底……会代表什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Oh, yes, that was a fantastic evening…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 哦，是的，那是一个美妙的夜晚……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: The Dark Refractory, as brilliant a design as it is, does not work on those with Infested blood. Oh, how I wish I could do this alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 深溯池的设计虽然精妙，却对 Infested 血液无效。哦，我多么希望自己能独自完成这一切啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Are you certain that is the reason it rejects you? And not some other deeper corruption, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 你确定这就是它拒绝你的原因吗？而不是其他更深层次的腐败？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Phantoms of your past, dancing on puppet strings… a morbid dance, to what end?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 你过去的幻影，在木偶线上跳舞……病态的舞蹈，是为了什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Oh Void. Lyon, you are miserable at poetry. Do us all a favor, and stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 哦，虚空。里昂，你的诗写得好烂。帮我们个忙吧，别再写了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: This place… it reeks of evil. Even the look of it speaks of horror.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这个地方……充满了邪恶的气息。就连它的外表都透露着恐怖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: I hate to tell you, Marie - but your dear Albrecht is to blame for most of this… aesthetic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 玛丽，我不想这么说——但你亲爱的阿尔布雷希特要为这种……审美负大部分责任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Remarkable. Hold the lens of another's mind to your own, and what comes out the other end is a sea of fragmented colors like the twist of a child's toy to rays of light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 真是奇妙。从别人的视角去审视自己的思想，得出的结果就像被儿童玩具扭曲出的光线那样，是一片斑驳的色彩海洋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Ha! I thought this was simply just one of your less flattering evenings, devil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 哈！我还以为你只是今晚少点谄媚呢，恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: And what is this supposed to represent, devil? Your childhood? Your mother, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 这又代表什么呢，恶魔？你的童年？还是，你的母亲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: I will remind you that I could have abandoned you in that primitive and unenlightened hellhole, yet I did not!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我可要提醒你了，我本来是可以把你抛弃在那个原始落后的地狱里的，但我没有！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Why could you not summon a memory of a quaint summer picnic, espèce d'énorme casse-pieds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 你就不能记点好事吗，比如一次有趣的夏日野餐，espèce d'énorme casse-pieds ！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Why, I deeply apologize that my memories of war are troubling you so, Marie! You are welcome to depart at any time! There is the door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 啊，我实在抱歉，战争的记忆让你如此不安，玛丽！你随时可以离开！门在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: Hm. This… This, I admit, I am having trouble discerning where its origins might lie in my memories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 嗯。这……这，我承认，我很难分辨出，在我的记忆里，它究竟源自何处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.text: I do not know which is more troubling - when you can recall… or when you cannot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExc.zhText: 我真不知道哪样更麻烦——是你记起来的时候，还是你记不起来的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExt.text: I believe the meaning of this is quite clear - death. And a great deal of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DExt.zhText: 我相信这句话的意思很清楚——死亡。而且是不计其数的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DFlo.text: Pathetic. Well, wake up. Let us begin again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DFlo.zhText: 真可悲。好了，醒醒吧。让我们重新开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DFlo.text: I am sorry. I do hope this is not causing damage to you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DFlo.zhText: 我很抱歉。我希望这不会对你造成什么伤害……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DFlo.text: Oh! By Sol, you poor thing…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DFlo.zhText: 哦！我的天啊，你这个可怜的人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Ash and bones!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 灰烬和白骨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Uriel, ignite my blood!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: Uriel，点燃我的血液！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: For you, a blistering kiss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 赐你一个炽热的吻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I invoke… devastation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我召唤……毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Do you smell burning?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 你闻到烧焦的味道了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Ignis!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 火咒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I am the Inferno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我便是炼狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Savour the pain!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 享受这痛苦吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: A gift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 一份礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Enough of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: This ends now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 这一切到此为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Is this what you came for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 这不正是你所追求的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Kneel! Kneel and I spare you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 跪下！跪下我就饶你一命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Alight! ALIGHT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 烧起来！都给我烧起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Uriel demands BRIMSTONE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: Uriel 渴求硫磺！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Breathe in the smoke!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 把这烟都吸进去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Melt as wax!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 像蜡一样融化！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Burn!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 燃烧吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Vythelas!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 烙魔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Catenach!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 缚魔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Gulphagor!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 苦魔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Well played.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I will see you… soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我们很快会……再见面的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Good form… nicely done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 好样的……做得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Next time? Aim a little higher - to the left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 下次？瞄高一点——偏左一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Not bad, Drifter… Not bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 不错，漂泊者……不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Match; Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 此局：漂泊者胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I do hate… this part.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我真是讨厌……这个环节。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Effective. Inefficient but effective…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 有效。效率不高但有效……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: And here I thought… you loved me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 而我还以为……你是爱我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: All is fair in love and war, hm…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 爱情和战争里可没有公平可言，对吧……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: You will be paying this back to me later, I assume, lover?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 亲爱的，我想你以后会补偿我的对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: And I thought you were the one who enjoyed taking a beating…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我还以为你才是喜欢挨打的那个人呢……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Was this for what I said last night? You needn't… make it so dramatic…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 这是因为我昨晚说的话吗？你没必要……反应这么大……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Is it strange how romantic I am finding this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我竟然觉得这很浪漫，是不是很奇怪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Is this how you treat all your lovers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 你就是这样对待你所有情人的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: If you wanted me on my knees at your feet… there were easier ways, dear…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 如果你想让我跪在你脚边……亲爱的，其实有更简单的办法……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: No. NO! What have you done?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 不！不！你做了什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Marie, Lyon. Say nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 玛丽，里昂。别说话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: You are a SAVAGE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 你真是个野蛮人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: To the stronger monster: I yield.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 对更强大的怪物：我投降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: When we wake, I'm drowning you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 当我们醒来时，我会把你淹死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Hm. Fire didn't work. I think I'll just drown you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 嗯，火不管用。我觉得我只能淹死你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: It's your throne now, Usurper. Use it wisely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 篡位者，现在王位是你的了。好好利用它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I know what whispers in your skull, Lyon. Fire silences them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 里昂，我知道你脑子里那些低语。火能让那些声音消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I will burn the optimism right out of your very marrow, Marie!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 玛丽，我会把你骨子里的乐观都烧光！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Lyon. Marie. A BAPTISM of Brimstone for you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 里昂。玛丽。给你们来个硫磺洗礼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: There is no concept you could embody that is grander than ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 没有任何概念能比"我"更伟大！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Pray me away, Marie! Just try!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 玛丽，尽管祷告把我送走啊！试试看！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Chain me, wound me, I only grow stronger LYON!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 束缚我，伤害我，我只会变得更强大！里昂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: (Laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: （笑声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Mm, did that hurt? I do hope so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 嗯，那样会疼吗？我希望会疼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Do try a little harder than that!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 再用点力吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Come and dance with the Devil of Tau!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 来与 Tau 之恶魔共舞吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: See how wonderfully it burns?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 你看它烧得多美妙啊？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Yes! Bleed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 没错！流血！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: All turns to ash before me, as will you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 万物在我面前都将化为灰烬，你也将如此！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Oh, how I wish to see you suffer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 哦。我多希望看到你受苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Go! Turn and leave me here, before it is too late! You know not what you do!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 快走吧！转身离开我，趁现在还来得及！你根本不知道你在做什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Why? Come to debase me even more? Or are you just here to rob my corpse?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 为什么？来进一步羞辱我吗？还是只是想来掠夺我的尸体？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I really do not know why I continue to agree to this. Fine…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我真不知道我为什么还要一直同意这种事。好吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: You should be quite glad that you are doing this in a dreamstate. And not, in fact, in real life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 你应该庆幸这一切都是在梦境中发生的，而不是在现实生活中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Tell me, did fighting and dying in Duviri become this boring after a while?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 告诉我，在双衍王境战斗和死亡过了一段时间后是不是也会变得这么无聊了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Must we? Yes, we must. All right, here we are, perfunctory, perfunctory, perfunctory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我们一定要这样吗？是的，我们确实得这样。好吧，我们来了，例行公事，例行公事，例行公事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I suppose this is all at least a distraction from lurking in that crypt all day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我想，这至少能让我暂时摆脱整天躲在那个墓穴里的烦恼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I can think of twenty one reasons why you should have stopped this by now, and one very good reason why I should have stopped going along with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我能想到二十一个理由说明你早该停下了，而我也有一个早就不该继续跟着你干的充分理由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Yes. Come. Laugh at the coward Roathe. Why not?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 来吧，嘲笑一下懦夫罗瑟。为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Oh, how perfect. How transcendently flawless. Of course - of course - I am what waits for us! I am my own worst enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 哦，多么完美。多么无瑕。当然——当然——等待着我们的就是我！我最大的敌人就是我自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Back for more, are we? Yes, I get the feeling we have only begun to scratch the surface of what was hidden away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我们又回来了？是的，我感觉我们只是刚刚开始揭开被深埋的冰山一角。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Third time's the charm, as they say? Have at thee!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 话说，第三次总能成了吧？来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Each time we do this - you bleed a little more out of me… What a sick game this is. I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 每次我们这样做——你都会从我身上再抽走一点……这游戏真够变态的。我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Five times now, you've done all this work to turn over a new stone in my mind… I'm simply flattered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 这已经是第五次了，你费尽心思，就是为了让我改变想法……我真是受宠若惊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Albrecht saw fit to defile my mind! If you want that scrawny little butler of his to march up those stairs, you will do as I say! Fight me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特竟敢玷污我的心智！如果你想让他的那个瘦弱的小管家走上楼梯，你就得听我的！来跟我打一架！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Drop. By bloody. Drop. I will have it all back. Until I know what is missing. SEVEN. AGAIN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 一滴。接着一滴的血。我会把它们全部找回来。直到我知道到底失去了什么。第七次。再来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Eight. And still, I feel there are holes - sections of my mind, left incomplete. Why?! Why, Albrecht?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 第八次。然而我仍然觉得我的内心深处有缺口——某些部分还不完整。为什么？！为什么，阿尔布雷希特？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Nine! Is this what it was like for you in Duviri, Drifter? Endlessly. Tirelessly. Dying. Come. Let us dance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 第九次！漂泊者，你在双衍王境的时候也是这样吗？无休止的。不知疲倦的。濒临死亡。来吧。让我们跳舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: We Orokin played all manner of games with each other, you know. Twisted, political games - psychological warfare - romantic intrigue that would make you sick. But this? Nothing like this. TEN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我们奥罗金人之间玩过各种各样的游戏，你知道的。扭曲的政治游戏——心理战——还有那些令人作呕的浪漫阴谋。但这个？完全不一样。第十次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I think that is what makes me so intensely furious at Albrecht - this level of corruption. What he took from me. We Orokin played games. But memories? Memories to us were… sacred. ELEVEN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我想，这就是我痛恨阿尔布雷希特的原因——这种程度的腐败。他从我这里夺走了什么。我们奥罗金人玩的是游戏。但记忆呢？对我们来说，记忆是……神圣的。第十一次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Look at our ultimate punishment, Drifter. Not the Jade Light - but to turn someone into a Cephalon. To be able to rewrite someone's memories at will! To change what they have experienced is to change who they are. TWELVE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 漂泊者，看看我们最终的惩罚。不是翠玉之光——而是把人变成中枢。能够随意改写别人的记忆！改变他们的经历，就等于改变他们本身。第十二次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: What Albrecht did to me? He corrupted my very being, Drifter. To rob me of my memories… is to change how I know myself. Is to change Roathe. And that. Cannot. Stand. THIRTEEN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特对我做了什么？漂泊者，他腐蚀了我的灵魂。剥夺了我的记忆……就相当于改变了我对自己的认知。就等于改变了罗瑟。而这，绝对不能容忍。第十三次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I will abide by so many kinds of depraved games, Drifter. The kinds that would make your skin crawl just to think about it. We Orokin were fundamentally immortal, after all. But to rob me of myself? No. FOURTEEN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 漂泊者，我甘愿忍受各种堕落的游戏，那些光是想想就让你毛骨悚然的游戏。毕竟，我们奥罗金人从根本上来说是不朽的。但要剥夺我的自我？不！第十四次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I do not care where Albrecht has gone to hide. I do not care what steps he has gone to to protect himself from his so-called "Indifference." I. Will. Kill. Him. FIFTEEN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我不在乎阿尔布雷希特躲到哪里去了。我不在乎他为了保护自己免受他所谓的"虚空无情之物"的伤害而采取了什么措施。我。要。杀。了。他。第十五次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: To render a man into nothing more than - than this? A miserable pile of secrets unto himself? It is a greater sin than any Orokin could ever have dreamt up in their wildest nightmares. SIXTEEN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 将一个人变成——这副模样？变成一堆悲惨谜团的人？这比任何一个奥罗金人在最可怕的噩梦中所能想象到的罪孽还要深重。第十六次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I am a patient killer, Drifter. I am, above all, a strategic man. If you need Albrecht to survive long enough to save the universe? I am not so foolhardy… I will wait. For now. SEVENTEEN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 漂泊者，我可是个耐心十足的杀手。我更是一个战略家。如果你需要阿尔布雷希特活得足够久来拯救宇宙？那我才没那么鲁莽……我会等。至少现在会等。第十七次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Mark my words, Drifter. The moment "the Indifference" is dealt with, and Albrecht is no longer required? I will lick his hot, wet blood from my claws… Eighteen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 漂泊者，记住我的话。一旦解决了"虚空无情之物"，我们就不再需要阿尔布雷希特了，到时我就会舔舐我爪子上他那滚烫的鲜血……第十八次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I have learned enough, Drifter. I am whole enough. Stop here, and turn back. Leave this place now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 漂泊者，我已经知道足够多了。我已经足够完整了。到此为止，回来吧。现在就离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: No. Drifter. Stop. Stop immediately. There are memories that are buried for good reason, and I command you to LEAVE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 不，漂泊者。住手。立刻住手。有些记忆被埋藏是有原因的，我命令你离开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: I am not a man who begs. I am a man who bargains. And whatever you wish for, you shall have it - whatever you desire, it shall be yours. Simply turn around… please…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 我不是会乞求的人，我是那种会谈判的人。你想要什么，我都会满足你；你想要什么，我都会给你。只要你现在转身……拜托了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: On your knees. Where you belong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 跪下。那才是你该待的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Oh, that was fun. Let's go again, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 哦，真好玩。我们再来一次，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.text: Try not to take it personally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHel.zhText: 别往心里去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHiv.text: Bursting pustules. I fear we have strayed into Roathe's adolescence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHiv.zhText: 爆裂的脓疱。恐怕我们已经进入了罗瑟的青春期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHiv.text: Such boils fester within all. Sin is our sickness. We are morbid with guilt and shame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DHiv.zhText: 这样的疖子在所有人的心中溃烂。罪是我们的病。我们因内疚和羞耻变得病态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInf.text: This one is easy - the air on Tau was toxic for us. And so, efforts had to be made to make it less so. See that you do the same, if you wish to survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInf.zhText: 这很简单——Tau 上的空气对我们来说是有毒的。因此，我们必须努力减少毒气。如果你想活下去，也要这样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInf.text: What is that horrible smell? Devil, is that you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInf.zhText: 那可怕的气味是什么？恶魔，是你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Like fleeting thoughts that escape one's grasp, these devices seek to elude us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 就像一闪而过的念头逃过我们的掌控，这些设备也试图躲避我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Chase the drone, catch the drone! Did the devil play children's games once, long ago?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 追无人机，抓住无人机！很久以前，那个恶魔玩过小孩子的游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Ah, the Dark Refractory… a wonderous Orokin invention. Turning memories and visions into lucid waking nightmares. Shall we begin our descent?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 啊，深溯池……奥罗金的伟大发明。它能将记忆和幻象转化为清醒的噩梦。我们开始下降吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Albrecht's serum tore my memories from my mind - and this Dark Refractory is the key to unlocking them. Violently. Let us begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的血清将我的记忆从我的脑海中撕碎——而这深溯池正是解开记忆的关键。不过这需要点暴力手段。我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: A shame this Orokin invention does not work with Infested blood… I could do this in peace and quiet. Well? What are you waiting for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 可惜这个奥罗金发明不能用于 Infested 血液……我本来可以安安静静地做这件事的。对吧？你在等什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: My blood is… unworthy. Violent. The machine demands yours. Offer it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 我的血……不配。太暴戾。机器要的是你的血。给它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Albrecht stole my mind. Violence is the sole means to reclaim it. Show me you speak the language of death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特偷走了我的记忆。暴力是唯一能夺回它的手段。让我知道你会说死亡之语。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Albrecht you thief! I will tear my memories back, whatever the cost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特，你这个小偷！我会把我的记忆夺回来，无论付出什么代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Hush now - let us spill some blood, but we dare not disturb Albrecht's slumbering progeny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 现在安静——我们流点血，但我们不敢打扰阿尔布雷希特的沉睡后代。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: How quaint of Albrecht to make his devices picky. My veins flow too richly with strain, yours do not. A simpler vintage. Go on, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特真是古怪，居然把自己的设备做得如此挑剔。我的血管里流淌着太多毒株，你的却没有。更纯的血液嘛。那就，继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Lucid nightmares in a golden pond. How... Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 金色池塘中的清醒噩梦。真是……太奥罗金了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: A tower like this would have been worth a fortune on Tau. A shame that land is not quite up for grabs anymore, hm, Usurper?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 像这样的塔在 Tau 上会价值连城。可惜现在这片土地已经不再唾手可得了，嗯，篡位者？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: To trespass the halls of ones own mind in search of answers. If the Gods were ever real, they'd have written such a story don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 闯入自己心灵的殿堂去寻找答案。如果神明真的存在，他们一定会写这样的故事，你不觉得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Why? Why return here? To this? To use my past - to use me - for target practice?! Very well! On we go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 为什么？为什么要回到这里？这里？要利用我的过去——利用我——来练射击？！好吧！我们走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: Yes. Come. Kick my corpse. Mock the memories of my violent past. I suppose it is better than you doing this in the waking world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 是啊。来吧。践踏我的尸体。嘲笑我暴力的过去。我想这总比你在清醒的世界里这么做要好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.text: After all you have learned, you return here. Why? Do you believe there is something left to be gained? Some stone left unturned?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DInt.zhText: 在学了这么多之后，你又回到这里。为什么？你觉得还能学到些什么吗？这里还有什么未曾探索的秘密吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLeg.text: Ah! Hunting with a Kavat! We used to set them on convicts back in my day. Splendid for working up an appetite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLeg.zhText: 啊！带着库娃狩猎！想当年我们常放它们去对付罪犯。真是增进食欲的好方法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLeg.text: Dear sweet giant cat, lead us swiftly to the heart of corruption!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLeg.zhText: 亲爱的可爱大猫，快带我们去腐败的中心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: Go on. Rummage through my things. Take what you need, it's not like I can stop you… yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 继续。翻遍我的东西。拿走你需要的，我现在还……拦不住你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: Even his memories are a mess. Clean this place up. Take what suits you, he obviously does not care for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 连他的记忆都一团糟。把这里收拾干净。拿走你想要的东西，他显然不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: What is the gluttonous beast hoarding the spoils of war? And what is that odour? Roathe, is this your true form?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 那只藏匿着战利品的贪婪野兽，到底是什么？那是什么气味？罗瑟，这就是你的真实形态吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: This demon, this Gruzzling, it mocks us all with its greed. It must vanquished. For decency's sake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 这个恶魔，这个贪囤断肢，它用贪婪嘲弄着我们所有人。它必须被消灭。为了体面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: I am accustomed to not trusting that which I see… I may be to blame for this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 我习惯了不相信我所看到的……这可能要怪我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: In the fog of war, that which you perceive often is not as it seems. Be watchful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 战争迷雾中，你所觉察的往往并不是它表面看上去的那样。保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: I dislike being mocked. And I even more so dislike being hunted. Kill that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 我不喜欢被人嘲笑。更不喜欢被人追杀。杀了那东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.text: Do you ever get the feeling as though you are being watched?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLoo.zhText: 你有没过仿佛在被监视的感觉？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: You have arrived… good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 你到了……很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Ah. There you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 啊，你来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: You are… whole?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 你……没受伤吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Enter. Rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 进来。休息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Here, you are safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 在这里，你是安全的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: The phantoms shall not touch you here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 在这里，幻影碰不到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Fear not. Lua shields us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 不要害怕，月神会保守我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Mon miracle - how may I aid you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: Mon miracle——我能帮你做些什么 ？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Let me lend you Lua's shield, my love…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 让我把月神的盾牌借给你，我亲爱的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Lua's light will guard you, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 月神的光辉会守护你，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Wherever you shall go, I shall follow at your side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 无论你去哪里，我都会陪在你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Come, mon miracle, in this place you shall know no fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 来吧，mon miracle，在这里你将无所畏惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: You have come to be blessed, yet it is I who feels lighter by seeing your face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 你是来受祝福的，而我看到你的脸就觉得轻松了很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Let me touch you, and heal what little suffering I can, my love…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 让我触摸你，尽我所能治愈你那一点痛苦，我亲爱的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: To endure such horror… and for what? For him? I am forever in awe of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 忍受如此恐怖的折磨……到底为了什么呢？为了他吗？我永远敬佩你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: And it is I who they would accuse of being part of the statuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 而他们会指责我是座雕像。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Does this idleness serve a purpose? Or has your mind simply wandered?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 这种闲散状态有什么目的吗？还是你只是走神了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Hm. I wonder if you have "transferred" elsewhere. Such as to fetch luncheon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 嗯。我想知道你是不是"传识"到别的地方去了，比如去取午餐之类的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: We all have better tasks we could be seeing to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 我们还有更重要的事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: What, literally, are we waiting for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 我们，到底还在等什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Are you afraid or… merely unprepared?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 你是害怕还是……只是没准备好？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: (Sigh)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: （叹气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: This is becoming insufferable…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 这开始变得让人无法忍受了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Lua's blessing is not so bold as Sol - it will be with you, when all else seems to fall away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 月神的祝福不像太阳神的那么强烈——当一切都似乎要离你而去时，它将与你同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Silver tears of Lua, wash over this soul - be with them in darkness and in pain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 月神的银色泪水，洗涤着这个灵魂——在黑暗与痛苦中与他们同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: In the agony of the night's darkest terrors, Lua comes to bring us home. And she comes to you now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 在夜晚最黑暗的恐怖痛苦中，月神来带我们回家。而此刻，她也来到了你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: A blessing of Lua is a steel thread - clutch it tight, and it shall shatter. Let it weave through you, and it is unbreakable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 月神的祝福如同一根钢丝——紧紧抓住，它就会断；让它穿过你，它便坚不可摧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Lua bless your path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 月神保守你的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: We descend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 我们下降。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Yes. Onward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 是的。向前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: If we must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 如果必须如此的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: Yes, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 是的，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: With me by your side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 有我在你身旁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DLyo.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMan.text: Manics! Their minds are shattered. They know nothing but aggression. For them death is the only possible mercy. Give them salvation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMan.zhText: 狂躁者！他们的精神已经崩溃。他们除了侵略一无所知。对他们来说，死亡是唯一的解脱。请给予他们救赎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMan.text: Would you look at that? Grineer Manics. Madness weaponized. You can't help but admire the mind who brought these to life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMan.zhText: 你看那个？Grineer 狂躁者。疯狂化身成了武器。你会情不自禁地佩服创造这些角色的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I was just about to light the candles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我正准备点燃蜡烛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Bonjour, bonjour! Peace… what little I can grant, in this dreary place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: Bonjour, bonjour ！平安……在这阴沉的地方，我能给予的不多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Come, rest - and take what blessings Sol may grant to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 来，安息吧——接受太阳神所赐予你的祝福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Here, I might gather you into my mind, if only for a little.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 在这里，我或许能让你进入我的思想，哪怕只是一小会儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: A moment to breathe, before we move on, n'est-ce pas?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 在我们继续之前，稍作喘息，n'est-ce pas？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: In this desolation of the devil's mind, we take what shelter we can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 在恶魔心灵的荒芜中，我们只能寻求能找到的庇护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Come! Sol's light has not abandoned you yet - and neither have I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 来吧！太阳神的光还没有抛弃你——我也没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: And did you think little Marie had left your side? Jamais!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 你以为小玛丽会离开你吗？Jamais ！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Mon cœur, there you are! I was so worried!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: Mon cœur，你在那里啊！我好担心啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: And there is my wolf, at last - come, let me tend to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我的狼终于来了——来，让我照顾你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Oh, mon cœur! Come, and let me give you my help in this terrible place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 哦，mon cœur ！来吧，让我在这个可怕的地方帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I do not know why you insist on helping that awful devil - but where my wolf goes, I shall always follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我不知道你为什么坚持要帮助那个可怕的恶魔——但我的狼去哪里，我就会跟到哪里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I shall never leave your side, mon cœur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我永远不会离开你的身边，mon cœur。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Take shelter in me, mon cœur - as I so often have in you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 依靠我吧，mon cœur——就像我常常依靠你一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: My wolf - rest, and let me comfort thee in what little ways I can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我的狼啊，安息吧，让我尽微薄之力来安慰汝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Come, mon cœur! Let Sol bless you, as you have blessed me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 来吧，mon cœur ！愿太阳神赐福你，就像你赐福我一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: If we are going to stand about and collect dust, I would rather do it somewhere else, n'est-ce pas?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 如果我们要站在这里积灰，我宁愿去别的地方，n'est-ce pas？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I do not like lingering in the devil's mind. It makes me… itch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我不喜欢在恶魔的心灵中停留。这让我……觉得很痒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: The longer we stay here, the more I start to feel like I have a tail. Can we go now, s'il vous plaît?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我们在这里待得越久，我就越觉得自己好像长了条尾巴。我们现在可以走了吗，s'il vous plaît?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Is there a purpose to your stalling, or have you fallen asleep?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 你拖延时间是有什么目的，还是你睡着了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I do not think we can stand here forever. Ô Sol, tout sauf ça. Je ne veux pas être piégée dans l'esprit de ce singe pour toute l'éternité...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我不认为我们可以永远站在这里。Ô Sol，tout sauf ça。Je ne veux pas être piégée dans l'esprit de ce singe pour toute l'éternité……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Are we… lingering… for a reason? There must be a reason… n'est-ce pas?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我们……逗留……是有原因的吗？肯定有原因……n'est-ce pas ？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Are you looking for hidden prizes? Trésors de lutin, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 你在寻找隐藏的奖品吗？或许是"trésors de lutin" ？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I do not like the fighting, but… neither do I trust the silence. May we go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我不喜欢争斗，但我也不相信沉默……我们可以走了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Sol has guided us here for a reason… there is much work to be done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 太阳神指引我们来到这里是有原因的……还有很多事要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: May the light of Sol show the way through this dark and accursed place. Stay strong. We are with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 愿太阳神之光指引走出这黑暗诅咒之地的道路。刚强起来。我们与你同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I beseech thee, Sol, to bless them. For though you do not know their face, you know their heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 太阳神，我恳求您祝福他们。因为您虽不识他们的容貌，却参透他们的心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Sol will guide you now through this terrible task, I know it. Be strong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 太阳神会带领你完成这个艰巨的任务，我相信的。刚强起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: May Sol guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 愿太阳神指引你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Sol be in your heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 愿太阳神常在你心中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Oui, we fight on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: Oui，我们继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: With Sol's light, we will endure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 有太阳神之光，我们就能坚持下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Be strong, mon cœur - I am with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 坚强起来，mon cœur——我和你在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: I have faith in you, my wolf.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 我相信你，我的狼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: These corrupted memories will never defeat you, mon cœur!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 这些损坏的记忆永远不会打败你，mon cœur ！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.text: Remember, mon cœur - the devil's horrid past cannot harm you, if you do not let it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMar.zhText: 记住，mon cœur——恶魔可怕的过去无法伤害你，只要你不让它这样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMel.text: A struggle to keep pressure from becoming too great. What were you bursting with, Roathe? Anger? Humiliation? Lust?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMel.zhText: 一种避免压力过大的挣扎。罗瑟，你心里充斥着什么？愤怒？羞辱？欲望？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMel.text: Bon. The devil's is our locomotive and we must blow off his steam.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DMel.zhText: Bon。那个恶魔是我们的火车头，我们必须让他把蒸汽发释放出来。
