/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DNec.text: Ah, the ever-ready, if not always effective Necramechs. Their devisor never received enough credit for his creations…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DNec.zhText: 啊，这些时刻准备着的殁世机甲，虽然不总有用。它们的发明者从未因其发明而获得足够的赞誉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DNec.text: While the effectiveness of these lumbering Necramechs fell off towards the end of the war, we never would have survived to that point without them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DNec.zhText: 虽然这些笨重的殁世机甲在战争后期效力有所下降，但如果没有它们，我们永远不可能活到那个时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRac.text: Speed would be important when on the battlefield, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRac.zhText: 在战场上速度肯定很重要，我想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRac.text: Ah. Yes. I remember training for live combat… I do not miss it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRac.zhText: 啊，是的。我还记得实战训练……我一点也不怀念。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRed.text: Usually, I relish attention, but I recommend staying out of the light. Trust me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRed.zhText: 通常，我很享受被人关注的感觉，但我建议你还是远离光。相信我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRed.text: This light, it is not of Sol. It is the searing attention of scrutiny. It will burn you if you let it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRed.zhText: 这光芒，不是太阳神的，而是审视的灼热目光。如果你放任它，它会灼伤你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRol.text: I do not know what is funnier - the sight of this, or how wonderfully deranged it is!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRol.zhText: 我不知道哪件事更有趣——是眼前的景象，还是它那奇妙的疯狂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRol.text: Un jeu de bagatelle? Children's toys have come to murder us all?! Devil! I blame you for this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRol.zhText: Un jeu de bagatelle？儿童玩具竟然要杀人？！恶魔！这一切都怪你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRol.text: Do not underestimate any kind of foe in large numbers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DRol.zhText: 不要低估任何数量庞大的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSen.text: Ah, finally. The Sentients. My true enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSen.zhText: 啊，终于来了。是 Sentient。我真正的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSen.text: These are them? The lost souls of Tau? I… only feel a kind of sadness for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSen.zhText: 这就是他们吗？Tau 的迷失灵魂？我……只对他们感到一丝悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DShr.text: Deep within Roathe's own psyche we find a shrine. To himself. Why am I not surprised?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DShr.zhText: 在罗瑟的内心深处，我们发现了一座神龛。供奉他自己的神龛。我为何一点也不感到意外？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DShr.text: Our society was rotten through with ritual. I dimly recall some ceremony or other like this one? Offerings? Tribute?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DShr.zhText: 我们的社会早已被仪式腐蚀殆尽。我隐约记得有类似的仪式？祭祀？贡品？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSpe.text: Some advice I learned early in my career, if I may? It is not what you kill, but who you kill that matters in the end. So… get out there and kill someone… special.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSpe.zhText: 如果可以的话，我想分享一下我职业生涯早期学到的一条经验：最终重要的不是你杀了什么，而是你杀了谁。所以……出去杀一个……特别的人吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSpe.text: A rotten fruit will spoil the whole bushel, as the saying goes. Seek out the sinner amongst them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DSpe.zhText: 正如俗话所说，一颗老鼠屎坏了一锅粥。要找出他们当中的罪人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.text: I must give recognition to whatever lunatic managed to repurpose such well-worn Orokin turrets. They certainly were not intended to do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.zhText: 我必须佩服那个能把这些破旧的奥罗金炮塔重新利用的疯子。它们原本的用途绝对不是这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.text: From this, I feel… the ghosts of a great sadness that reach from beyond the veil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.zhText: 从中，我感受到……一种巨大悲伤的幽灵从面纱之外而来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.text: Mm. We used to train like this - forced out of our armor, defenseless, exposed. The ghosts, however? That, I admit, is novel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.zhText: 嗯。我们以前也是这样训练——被迫脱下盔甲，毫无防备，暴露无遗。不过，幽灵？我承认，这倒是新鲜事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.text: A time when the devil was exposed? Forced to fight for his life? Ah, to have seen that in person!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Descendia/DVoi.zhText: 是那个恶魔脆弱的时候吗？被迫为生存而战的时候？啊，还真想亲眼目睹那一刻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No! The work is not done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不！我的事还没了结！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Please, help!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请帮帮我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No. NO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不。不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I do not fear what comes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我并不惧怕接下来发生的一切！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This pain is his will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这种痛苦是他的旨意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Not here. Not now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不该在这。不该现在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You cannot kill my soul!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你无法杀死我的灵魂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I can endure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我可以忍耐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This is impossible!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这不可能！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers grow louder...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 低语的声音越来越大……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Find me in the afterlife.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来生再见吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Of course, this would be how it ends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 当然，结局必然如此！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not avenge me, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请不要为我报仇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You will get me up this instant, do you hear me?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你立刻把我扶起来，听见没？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This pain gives me STRENGTH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这种痛苦给了我力量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Please bury me with my people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请将我和我的家人埋葬在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Help me up, or I will draw and quarter you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 帮我一把，否则我就把你五马分尸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You think this suffering is not welcome?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你以为这种痛苦是不被期待的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I cannot let a heathen win!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我不能让异教徒得胜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will rip off your finger nails one at a time, if you do not help me immediately!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如果你不马上来帮我，我就把你的指甲挨个拔下来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Watch… over Marie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 照顾好……玛丽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I was too weak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我太虚弱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I cannot die, I cannot die, I cannot die, I cannot die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我不能死，我不能死，我不能死，我不能死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Death is a sweet temptation…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡是甜蜜的诱惑……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Papa, I'm coming home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 爸爸，我要回家了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: How much gold will it take to convince you to assist me?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 要多少黄金你才肯帮我？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The walls draw near.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 墙越来越近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A lily on my grave, s'il vous plait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 在我的坟前放朵百合吧，s'il vous plait。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will be forever in your debt, now come here and get me on my feet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将永远欠你这个人情，现在赶紧来扶我起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Sol, Lua. Do not leave me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 太阳神，月神。请不要离开我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: But I must fight! Ah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 可我仍要战斗！啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Whatever it is that you are doing cannot be as important as helping me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你现在不论在干什么都不会比帮我更重要！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My blood is spent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的血已经流尽了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Why?! My mission is incomplete!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 为什么？！我的使命还没完成！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am dying! Help. Me. Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我快死了！赶紧、帮我。立刻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Suffering is strength. I cannot fail!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 苦难就是力量。我是不会失败的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Is this a punishment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这是一种惩罚吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I have access to knowledge heretofore lost and you are just going to let me die?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那些失传的东西我全知道，你居然就这样放任我去死？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There must be a reason for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这其中必定有原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am not worthy of this life…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我不配活着……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Pray there is no soul, for if I die, I will haunt you if there is!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你最好祈求死后没有灵魂，因为如果有的话我死后绝对回来缠着你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Am I to die here?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 难道我要死在这里吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lyon, save me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 里昂，救我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Funny is it not, that I suddenly wish Marie to be correct?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我竟突然希望玛丽说得是对的，可笑吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: MARA LOHK. I have seen his name!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: MARA LOHK。我看见过他的名字！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I know I have killed. This end is just.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我知道我犯下杀戮。这样的结局是公义的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Whatever you are attempting to prove by leaving me here, it is not funny!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 无论你把我留在这里想证明什么，都一点都不好笑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not let them have my flesh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不要让他们得到我的血肉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: La mort...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: La mort……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I have survived for centuries, and I shall not die here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我活了好几个世纪，我绝不要死在这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My life was a gift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的生命是一份礼物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Name your price. Anything! Just help me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 开个价吧。随便什么！快救我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The darkness of Lua's shadow comes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神之影的黑暗，已然降临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No! No!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不！不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not dare walk away from me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你敢走开试试！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I cannot know peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的心中无法有平安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Death… embrace me like a sister…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡……就像姐妹一样拥抱着我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not leave me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 别丢下我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be silenced!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 安静！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Cleansed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 已净化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: An offering of flesh to Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 向月神献上肉祭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: An end to your passage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的旅程结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: It cannot be undone!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 无法回头！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The final verse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 最后一节已成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The walls see your end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 墙见证了你的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No mourners, no rites.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 没有哀悼者，没有仪式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your pain is seen. Felt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的痛苦有被看见，有被感受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Death! The only peace!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡！是唯一的宁静！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: It was willed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这就是旨意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall serve penance for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将为你赎罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Glorious sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 光荣的牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your death, a whisper. My life, a chorus!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的死亡，只是一声低语。我的生命，则是一首合唱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No hymns, no prayers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 没有赞美诗，没有祈祷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: He will see all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 他会看到一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A life extinguished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一条生命就此消逝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I rid this world of your stain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我已将你们在这世间的污痕抹去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There must be sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 必须有牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Death is the only way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡是唯一的出路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This one seeks suffering.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这个人寻求痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not let it escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 别让它跑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Penance shall be delivered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 必须接受忏悔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: By Sol and by Lua I condemn you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 以太阳神和月神的之名，我谴责你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This one must die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这个必须死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Its death shall be swift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 它很快就会死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Marked for death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 注定要死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Heathen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 异教徒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: They are foul in the eyes of the Gods!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 在神的眼中，他们是邪恶的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let it suffer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让它受苦吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We must not suffer that abomination to live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们绝不能容忍这种可憎之物继续存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Grant them the blessing of sweet death!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 赐予他们甜蜜的死亡！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We shall kill this one… slowly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们要杀死这个家伙……慢慢来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: It must pay for its misdeeds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 它必须为其罪行付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: They must fall!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 他们必定会倒下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: An adversary approaches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 敌人逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Turn your wrath upon this one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 把你的愤怒发泄在这个人的身上吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us rain misery upon it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们将苦难倾泻于此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: It must die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 它必须死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Cut the thread of their life!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 剪断他们的生命之线！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A priority target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 优先目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mercy is for the gods.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 怜悯是神的特权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Je te condamne!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Je te condamne！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This life must be snuffed out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这条生命必须被扼杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Contrition unsought arrives all the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 即使无人寻求悔改，悔改之日依然会降临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Destroy them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 消灭他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Crush them like so many others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 像对待其他人那样碾碎他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I condemn thee.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我谴责你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Suffer no heretic to live!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不要让异教徒活着！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Remind this one who we are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 提醒这个家伙我们是谁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Through suffering, may you find peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 愿你在苦难中找到平静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I mark them for execution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我给他们留下了处决的标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let them feel our wrath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让他们感受我们的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Render this one unto Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 将这个交给月神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No mercy for the corrupt!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 决不怜悯堕落者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Murder them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 杀死他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Another soul for the gallows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 又一个灵魂将被送上绞刑架。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Burn out the sickness!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 将瘟疫烧尽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Conscripts, to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 征召者，开始工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My chains shall drag them to hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的锁链会将他们拖入地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There! Take them down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 去那儿！打败他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What is one more war crime, hm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 又多一件战争罪又怎样呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers call their name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 低语声呼唤着他们的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Strike hard, mes camarades!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Mes camarades，加油！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: With prejudice this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这次带着偏见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The Void hungers for a soul. Let it be theirs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 虚空渴望灵魂，就让它取走他们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Slay them. Sol wills it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 杀了他们。这是太阳神的旨意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Reduce this one to memories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 把这人变成回忆吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Cast them into the pit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 把他们扔进坑里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ashes to ashes…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 化为尘土……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A sinner comes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 罪人来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: À l'abîme!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: À l'abîme！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This one saw fit to anger a god.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 此人竟敢触怒神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This one's faith is to be tested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这个人的信仰将受到考验。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Cut them down, and let me bear the blame!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 斩除他们吧，让我来承担这罪责！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Teach this one some manners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 教教这家伙点规矩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Purge them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 清除他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: One with the beyond.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 与异界之人融为一体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Begone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 滚开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: For you - peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 为你——献上平安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: And you thought to stop me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你以为你能阻止我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be at rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请安歇吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What a waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 真是浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: C'est fini.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: C'est fini。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A feast of flesh for Gulphagor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 苦魔的血肉盛宴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Depart in peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 愿你平安离去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I remember this being more of a challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我记得这原本是个更大的挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Death can be a savior.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡也许是救主。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have failed your betters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你辜负了那些比你优秀的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: It is the will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这是旨意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Chaff. Nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 虚张声势。仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There is no shame in dying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡并不可耻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Idiot, did you not have the sense to flee?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 蠢货，你难道没有逃跑的觉悟吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will mourn you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我会为你哀悼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Not even a challenge for my Conscripts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 对我麾下的征召者来说，连个挑战都算不上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I cleanse thee, now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 现在，我将净化你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: If you'll excuse me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This life belongs to him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这条命是属于他的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Pardon me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 打扰一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You die so I may live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的死会换来我的生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I would have retreated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我本该撤退的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We see your sacrifice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们看到了你的牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The correct answer was to run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 正确的答案是逃跑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: While I breathe, Heresy suffocates!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 只要我还活着，异端便会窒息！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: More.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I must do this. Forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我必须这么做。请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Out of my way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Shhh, shhh..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嘘，嘘……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Now you serve a purpose! Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 现在你派上用场了！肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your light has been seen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的光已被看见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Pathetic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 可悲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: May Lua and Sol guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 愿月神和太阳神指引你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: How far you have fallen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你竟堕落至此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua. Sol. Watch over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神。太阳神。守望着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You shall all become dust and ash!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你们都将化为灰烬！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua and Sol be with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神和太阳神与你同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Behold your ruin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 看啊，你的毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Putain! That will be a night's penance for me…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Putain！这下我得忏悔一整夜了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Shall we begin?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们开始吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The Void demon returns. Welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 虚空恶魔回归。欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: As the candle to the flame, we are united.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如同蜡烛与火焰一样，我们合而为一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah. About time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊。总算来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There is work to be done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 还有事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall be your robe of benediction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我愿作你的祝福之袍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Good of you to alleviate the tedium.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 多谢你消除了无聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Douce Lua! A little warning next time, s'il te plait?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Douce 月神！下次稍微提前说下，s'il te plait？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I expect due reverence as you wield this flesh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 当你操纵这具血肉之躯时，我期待你怀有应有的敬畏之心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes. Enough dallying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 好了。别再拖延了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am comfortable, hein?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我很舒服，hein？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The sensation… is a singular one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这种感觉……是独一无二的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am… glad for your return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我……很高兴你回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I pray this strange possession is no sin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 但愿这种奇怪的附体不是罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I may be captained, but never leashed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我或许会服从指挥，但绝不被束缚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Would that all demons came and went with such fanfare…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 但愿所有恶魔来去都那么盛大就好了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall be the chalice, you the wine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将为杯，你将为酒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come… let us add to my many sins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来吧……让我们为我的诸多罪行再添新债。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No scripture could properly describe such a sensation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 没有任何经文能够恰当地描述这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: May I trust you not to pry into my secret thoughts?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我可以相信你不会窥探我的秘密想法吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes. Claim this body as I once did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 是的。将这具躯体据为己有，如同我曾经那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Tell the others to make room, if you would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如果可以的话，请告诉其他人让出空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Fear nothing while Marie is your armor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 只要玛丽是你的盔甲，便无所畏惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do you never tire of sporting the face of another?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你难道不厌倦永远戴着别人的面具吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: And so returns the savior.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 救世主就这样回来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Prends garde. I am no filly to be trotted through the briars!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Prends garde。我不是匹可以任人牵着穿过荆棘的小母马！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Once more you slither back like a worm grown homesick for my guts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你又像条思念我肠子的蠕虫般溜了回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us walk the path of virtue together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们共同走美德之路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, that familiar pressure behind the eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，那熟悉的眼后压迫感。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: And from what new hell have you returned?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你从什么新的地狱回来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Bon. You are safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Bon。你很安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Perfect timing. Vythelas was off lecturing again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 时机正好。烙魔又去讲课了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have stirred me from the strangest thoughts. … Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你把我从最奇怪的想法中唤醒了……谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You return to the fold, and I rejoice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你回归羊圈，我很高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Oh, joy. The nightmare continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哦，真好。噩梦还在继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be changeable as Lua, and I shall remain constant as Sol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你如同月神般灵巧，而我将如同太阳神般永恒不变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Remember. I am no cantering Kaithe, to be bridled at your will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 记住。我并非任你摆布的绝灵骥，任凭你牵制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You return! The Gods are good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你回来了！诸神保佑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I would have murdered Gods. Do you mean to do less?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我本可杀神。你难道要做得更少？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Each time you enter my mind, I taste elderberry. …Should we be concerned?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 每次你进入我的脑海，我都会尝到接骨木的味道……我们应该担心吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What wild visions did those eyes see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那双眼睛看到了什么疯狂的异象？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: At least for these atrocities, we are both at fault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 至少对于这些暴行，我们双方都有过错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes, I am eager to see the work be done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 太好了，我迫切想见证这件事的完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: If you must bloody these hands, do it with compassion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如果你必须让这双手沾满鲜血，就请带着怜悯去做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hm. Oddly enjoyable, once one adjusts to the strangeness of it all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯。一旦适应了这一切的怪异之处，反而觉得奇妙地令人愉悦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Silence the laughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让笑声停止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The Gods have forged me to be a weapon in your grasp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 众神将我锻造成你手中的武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Keep it dignified this time, will you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这次保持体面，行吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I happily welcome your voice. It drowns out all others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我非常欢迎你的声音。它可以掩盖其他所有声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come. Heresy does not sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来吧。异端永不眠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Oh good, more running about like a mad thing…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哦，太好了，又要像疯子似的到处跑了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come. My hands itch from the idleness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来吧。闲着没事，手都痒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I had faith you would return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我相信你会回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am not to be blamed for any nightmares being inside my head might cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 若我脑海中的噩梦引发任何后果，那也与我无关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be my guide in these desolate places.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请在这些荒芜之地做我的引路人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mon ange… you must forgive me if I tremble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Mon ange……如果我颤抖了，请一定要原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your light is soft as stars, sweet as a million kisses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的光如星辰般柔和，如万千的亲吻般甜蜜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You come to me as a smiling devil answers a lonely prayer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你来到我身边，就像一个微笑的恶魔回应着一个孤独者的祷告。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mmm. This lamb has missed her hungry wolf.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯。这只小羊羔好想她那饥饿的狼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I would gladly walk through the fire to be with you, mon ange!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我愿意穿越火线与你在一起，mon ange！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What new rapture is this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这是何等的全新狂喜？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Fill my heart as Sol's light fills the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 就像太阳神的光充满世界一样，也请你充满我的心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Am I to be pierced once more by the thorns of your love?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我是否又要被你爱的荆棘刺伤？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah! My lover. My second devotion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊！我的爱人。我的第二信仰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You enfold my heart, and once more I walk upon the air.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你拥抱我的心，让我再次能够漫步空中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua would blush if my thoughts of you could be seen!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 若我对你的思念被人看到，月神一定也会脸红的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: War shall be my bridesmaid, and Death shall bear my wedding train!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 战争将作为我的伴娘，死亡将托起我的婚礼裙裾！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do you feel this racing heart? This rising heat, this quickening?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你感受到这狂乱的心跳了吗？这不断上升的炽热，这急促的呼吸了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Leave shame to the devil, for love like ours is no sin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 把羞耻留给魔鬼吧，因为我们这样的爱，并不是罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Enfold me. Enflame me. Make me whole.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 拥抱我。点燃我。让我完整。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Are you howling for your Marie again, beloved wolf?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我所爱的狼，你又在为你的玛丽嚎叫吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To be apart from you is the only hell I fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 和你分离，是我唯一害怕的地狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, what has become of this shy little novice?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，这个害羞的小修女如今变成了什么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: If I ever shrank from your embrace, I repent my folly now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如果我曾回避你的怀抱，我现在为当时的愚行后悔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My love. Let us burn together and rise as incense to the Gods.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的爱人。让我们一起燃烧，化作香火献给众神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What… is that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那是……什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hm. There.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯。那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Perhaps this may be of interest?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 可能你会对这感兴趣？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A sacred sign, to show the way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一处神圣的记号，指引着方向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 去调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I hate to intrude…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我实在不想打扰……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ahead, a sign! Left for all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 前面有标记！留给所有人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Go. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 快去。立刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ahem. Pardon me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊咳咳，不好意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Behold, my mark!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 看，是留下的标记！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You - see to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你——去处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A moment of your time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 可以占用你一点时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There. Do you see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那儿。你看到了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: That is important.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那很重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This seems intriguing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这看起来很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Attention!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 注意！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Could be of value.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 也许有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Follow. Do you see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 跟上。你看到了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Of interest, peut-être?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 有点意思，peut-être？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Interesting…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 有意思……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers speak that this is of great import.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那低语提到这里很重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come and see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 快来看看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I have marked your map.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我在你的地图上做了标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There is something here to be found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这里可以找到一些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The light of Lua upon this spot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神之光照耀着这个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Reconnaissance is required.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 需要侦察。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your attention, kindly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 敬请注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Regarde là-bas!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Regardez là-bas！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A new objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一个新目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Excusez-moi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Excusez-moi。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Note this, s'il te plait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 留意一下这里，s'il te plait。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: An instruction for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这是给你的指示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I have… faith. There is something here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我有……信心。这里面一定有东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The hand of Sol points the way!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 太阳神之手指引着方向！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This is critical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这至关重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I have placed a mark. Do with it what you will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我已放了标记。你想怎么处理就怎么处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Seek for traces of heresy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 去寻找异端的踪迹！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hmm. Curious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯。真有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Perhaps here is something to be found?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 也许这里可以找到什么东西？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This requires your complete attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这需要你全神贯注。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Observe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 观察。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I pray you, consult your tabula.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我恳请你看一下你的地图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: For your immediate consideration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 赶紧考虑一下这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Allow me to guide you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请允许我指引你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The Gods call us to this place!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 众神召唤我们去这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have your marching orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的行动指令已下达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Behold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Friends! Grant me your eyes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 朋友们！请借我你们的双眼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I expect no delay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我不希望有任何耽搁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I sense something about this location…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我感觉这地方有什么东西……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Vite! Marie has noticed something!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Vite！玛丽注意到什么了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "My will be done." Heh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "我的意志必将实现。" 呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers grow louder here…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这里的低语声越来越大……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Like a little mouse in the rafters, I see much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 就像房梁上的小老鼠，我看到了很多东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: That is of note.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那值得注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Something wishes to be found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 有某种东西希望被找到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: See with the eyes of the soul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 要用心灵的眼睛去看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Of interest, perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 或许有点意思？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I lay my mark upon this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我已在此处留下了我的标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "Fear not the darkest shadows, for it is but Lua lifting you to Her realm."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "不要害怕最黑暗的阴影，因为那只是月神将你提到她的国度。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Joyful is the kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 杀戮令人愉悦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "May the face of Lua shine with compassion for all who must make the journey from flesh to spirit."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "愿月神的面容充满慈悲，庇佑所有必须经历从肉体到灵魂转变之旅的人们。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have been judged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你已被审判。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I did miss getting my hands dirty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我确实怀念亲自动手的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "Blessed is Lua, for She gathers the weary unto Her gentle embrace."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "月神是受祝福的，因为她将疲惫的人们拥入她温柔的怀抱。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To perdition with your unfortunate soul!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让你的不幸灵魂堕入地狱吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This existence does have its upsides.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这种存在倒也有其优点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "The wise prepare for death as they prepare for sleep."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "智者为死亡做好准备，如同为睡眠做好准备一样。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We shall water our gardens with the blood of the unrighteous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们将用这些不义之人的鲜血来浇灌我们的花园。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Begone, pest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 滚开，害虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hrmph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah! You have made a killer out of little Marie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊！你把小玛丽变成了一个杀手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Like the blink of a nightfly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 恍如夜蛾的一瞬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be. Quiet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 安。静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: May the burden of sin trouble you no more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 愿罪恶的重担不再困扰你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A moment's diversion, now passed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 片刻消遣，转瞬即逝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Unto the Gods I restore you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将你归还给神明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This little wren has the claws of the hawk!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这只小鹪鹩有着鹰的爪子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Used. Discarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 已使用。已丢弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall pray it was not the Void who took you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我会祈祷带走你的不是虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua may weep for you, dead one, but not I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死去的人，月神可能会为你哭泣，但我不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A goblet of Tamoransch, once consumed, now spent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一杯塔莫兰什，饮尽，已空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your suffering ends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的痛苦结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I grant you respite eternal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我赐予你永恒的安息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: That was a bit theatrical, I admit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我承认，那确实有点做作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "To wash in Her silvered embrace is to be free of the darkness of sin."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "沐浴在她银色的怀抱中，就能摆脱罪恶的黑暗。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, mère supérieure, you trained me for sweeter things!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，mère supérieure，您教我的原是做更温柔的事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Needlessly athletic in its execution, but amusing nonetheless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 处决方式不必要地夸张，但仍然有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your pain becomes dust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的痛苦将化为尘埃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The beauty of death never scared me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡的美丽从未吓到我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: One must take pleasure in one's work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 人必须从工作中获得乐趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What would Marie think of me…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 玛丽会怎么看待我呢……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Non! Non, non, non, non, non!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Non！Non，non，non，non，non！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Farewell, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我想，再见了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What a waste…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 真浪费……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The chase is ended!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 追逐结束了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Sand through a chronovial…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 沙粒流经时光瓶……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Pity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 可惜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: 'Those who bear steel in my name shall be crowned with holy gold.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "那些以我的之名佩戴钢铁的人，将戴上圣金的冠冕。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Life was wasted on you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 生命在你身上浪费了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 到月神那去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Now the veil of life is lifted!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 现在生命的幔子已然揭开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Thank you for the… brief distraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 感谢这……短暂的消遣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers hungered for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 低语声渴望着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: 'A kiss of peace on the eyes of the dying.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "在垂死之人的眼睛上留下一个安息之吻。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I saw its smile upon you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我看到了它对你微笑的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Maudit, maudit, maudit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Maudit，maudit，maudit！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Inefficient, but inarguably effective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 效率低下，但效果毋庸置疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Worry not, I do not find delight in your death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 别担心，你的死并不会让我感到高兴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Thus we purge the serpents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这样我们才能清除毒蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: One does relish the chance to experience a kill up close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 人确实渴望亲身经历一场近距离的杀戮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ten strikes I shall take in penance for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将为此自罚十鞭以示忏悔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I do what I must!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我只行当行之事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mm. Deliciously grotesque.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯。怪诞至极。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your voice will join the others…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的声音将与其他人的声音汇合……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall dig no grave; I shall plant no stone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我不会掘墓；也不会立碑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Moving on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: 'Rest in sunset's blood to be reborn with the dawn.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "在日落的血液中安息，于黎明中重生。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Repose en paix.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Repose en paix。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Death cannot claim me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 就连死亡也无法夺走我的性命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am forgiven!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我被赦免了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes. Well. Sensible of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 是的。嗯。你很明智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua has not yet found me worthy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神觉得我还不配被接走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We rise together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们一同崛起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Thank you. Never speak of this again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 谢了。这件事永远别提了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I know my duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我知道我的职责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Oh, thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哦，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will remember that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我会记住的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You carry out His will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你执行了他的旨意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: All is not lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一切还未失去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have made a powerful ally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你为自己赢来了一个强大的盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I have learned from this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我从中吸取了教训。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You were sent to save me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你是他差来拯救我的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We shall write their histories in blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们将用鲜血书写他们的历史。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This pain is no stranger to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这种痛苦对我来说并不陌生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My angel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的天使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Much appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My flesh heals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的肉体痊愈了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A debt owed, forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一笔永远无法偿还的债。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A favor from me is one carefully spent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的人情向来需要慎用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have saved me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你救了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Please, don't tell Lyon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请不要告诉里昂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Finally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 终于。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There is no greater pain than to live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 没有比活着更大的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have guarded my life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你守护了我的生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your assistance is… ruefully accepted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的帮助……勉强接受了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua, I pray.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神，我祈祷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这是一个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes, yes, the great Roathe brought low.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 是的，是的，伟大的罗瑟竟也有今天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I rise!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我重生了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will not be buried here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我是不会被埋葬在这里的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I did not need your help, peasant! I do not know of what you speak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 本不需要你这等贱民相助！我不知你在说什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: History will not find my bones here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的尸骨不会留在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Death will not find me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 死亡不会找到我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I made a miscalculation. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我失算了。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I write my own ending.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的结局由我来书写。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Our duty is to live!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们的使命就是活下去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your assistance does not go unnoticed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的帮助我看在眼里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Sol, Lua. Your mercy is seen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 太阳神，月神。你们的怜悯我已得见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A sacred vow, here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 在此立下神圣的誓言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To pay a favor to an Orokin is to be owed by "the gods."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 为奥罗金效劳，即是神欠下你的人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will repent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我会忏悔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: He wants me saved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 他要我得救。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A misstep brought on by eagerness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一时心急导致的失误罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The pain is the reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 痛苦便是奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Merci.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Merci.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: In the Empire, you would be commended for your duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 在帝国里，你会因尽职尽责而受到嘉奖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I must go on, I seek truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我必须继续前行，我寻求真理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A song of thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 献上感恩的颂唱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I assume you are not seeking payment…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我想你应该不是在索要报酬吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am forgiven.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我被赦免了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Our roads were meant to cross.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们的道路注定要相遇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A Tenno, coming to the aid of an Orokin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一名 Tenno，前来援助一位奥罗金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The Void wills this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 虚空旨意如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Sol bless you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 愿太阳神保守你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This Golden Lord seeks vengeance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这位黄金之主正在寻求复仇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We now have a pact. Live!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们现在立下契约。活下去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua has forgiven me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神已经赦免我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Oh, oh I am going to skin them alive for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哦，哦，我非得把他们活剥了不可。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am the unchained one, freed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我摆脱了束缚，获得了自由！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe. A pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 副摄政总司令罗瑟。幸会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There is much work to be done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 还有很多事情要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us write gospels of fire and steel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们书写火与钢的福音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What need have you for the "Devil of Tau?"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你何必需要"Tau 之恶魔"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Speak. Do you have need of me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 说吧。你需要我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: By the Cardinal's will, I serve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 遵照主教的旨意，我服侍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I do hope you plan to make this interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我真心希望你能让这件事变得有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Father Lyon Allard, at your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 里昂·阿拉德神父，为你效劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The world is heavy with great wickedness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这个世界充满了邪恶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: If we cannot make this efficient, may we at least make this enjoyable?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如果我们无法做到高效，那么至少能让这个过程充满乐趣吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: May the silvered light of Lua guide us both…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 愿月神的银色光芒指引我们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Through me Sol Himself is manifest!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 通过我，太阳神亲自显现！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We shall water the fields with the blood of our enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们将用敌人的鲜血浇灌田野。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What souls must be rendered unto dust this eve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 今晚哪些灵魂将会化为尘土？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What manner of world is this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这是一个什么样的世界？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am not to be wielded lightly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我绝非可以轻易驾驭之人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers grow hungry, and they shall be answered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 低语声变得越来越饥渴，它们将得到回应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The stench of heresy is strong!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 异端的恶臭十分浓烈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come, let us render worlds to ash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来吧，让我们将世界化为灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: …Yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: ……怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We shall carry the torch of truth in godless lands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们将在无神的土地上高举真理的火炬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mind yourself in the presence of your betters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 在高位者面前要谨言慎行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You disturb my prayers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你在打扰我祷告？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Fear nothing while Marie is with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 只要玛丽和你在一起，就什么也不用怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes? What is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯？怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I have answered your call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我已回应你的召唤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We will be tested. Pain and bitter ashes await.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们将接受试炼。痛苦与苦涩的灰烬在等待着我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: For what reason have you disturbed my work?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你为何打扰我的工作？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Corruption must be cleansed… from us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们所有人身上的腐败……都必须清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come. Let us bring about a radiant new day!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来吧，让我们一起迎接灿烂的新一天！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Consider your conscience before unleashing me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 在释放我之前，请扪心自问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "Purity of the body aids purity of the mind."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "身体的纯洁有助于保持心灵的纯洁。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What do I care for my scars, when I can dance upon the air?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 当我能在空中翩翩起舞时，我又怎会在乎我的旧疤？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Wreck and ruin shall follow in my wake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 毁灭与荒芜将随我而至。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The chains that once bound me, I now wield upon our foes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 曾经束缚着我的锁链，现在却被我用来对付我们的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: If Sol is with us, who can stand against us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如果太阳神与我们同在，那么还有谁能与我们对抗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Abandon all hope, all who stand before me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 凡立于我面前者，皆放弃希望吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The voices call for violence. I, for redemption. I do not know why we could not have a bit of both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那些声音呼唤暴力。而我，呼唤救赎。我不明白为什么我们不能两者兼得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The strange angel is calling? Me voici!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 陌生的天使在呼唤我？Me voici！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Now, they shall know the meaning of true violence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 现在，他们将体会到真正暴力的含义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have summoned me for a purpose. I am eager for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你是因为一个目的召唤了我。而我也渴望它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I am Sister Marie Leroux, ordained of Sol, sworn to Lua, and bearer of the holy fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我是玛丽·勒鲁修女，受太阳神任命，宣誓效忠月神，是承载圣火之人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You called?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你召唤了我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Guide my hand. I am your servant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请引领我的手。我是你的仆人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Again I am cast from my own time into this mad reverie!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我又一次从自己的时代中，被抛入这疯狂的幻境之中！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What would you have me do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你想让我做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Pray tell, what souls must be fed to the hungry Void this day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 请问，今天要用什么灵魂来喂养饥饿的虚空？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: From convent walls and gentle prayers… to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 从修道院的墙壁和温柔的祈祷……到如今这般。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A curse you would lay on all those in my path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你将诅咒加诸于我所有前路之人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us wreak our vengeance upon the unholy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们向邪恶施以报复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let the blade be my hymnbook now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 现在，让刀刃成为我的赞美诗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us be quick about it. I have work to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 别磨蹭了，我还有事要处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Greetings and salutations, Void demon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 问候并致敬，虚空恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I may kneel to pray, but never in surrender!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我虽然会跪下祷告，但绝不会下跪投降！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: And who requires suffering on this day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 今日谁又需要承受苦难？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hmm? What is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯？什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: May the Gods forgive me for what I must do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 愿众神赦免我不得不做的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The devil hungers. Let us feast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 恶魔饥渴难耐。让我们大快朵颐吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Fear? I, who have held the hand of the Devil as he wept?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 恐惧？我可是曾握住过哭泣的恶魔的手，还会恐惧什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My love…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的爱人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: They already believe us to be devils… I say we give them new reasons…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 他们早已认定我们是恶魔……我提议我们再给他们些新理由……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I wondered where you had gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我想知道你去哪儿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mmh, there you are. I had wondered where you were hiding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯，原来你在这儿。我还正纳闷你躲哪儿去了呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: And another voice answered my prayers. Hello, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 另一个声音回应了我的祷告。你好，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You wear me like such sweet sin. Let us commit a few more, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你驾驭我的样子就像甜美的罪。让我们再多犯些新罪，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To think, I was about to kneel at the altar, and I find myself at one I much prefer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 想想看，我正要跪在祭坛前，却发现自己来到一个我更喜欢的祭坛前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There is nowhere you could go where I could not reach you, lover…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 无论你逃往何方，我都能找到你，爱人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mon miracle, you have summoned me. And I have answered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Mon miracle，你召唤了我。而我也回应了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, I was wondering when you would call for me…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，我正想着你什么时候会来找我呢……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To what do I owe the pleasure of your presence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 见到你是何等的荣幸？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us drink the blood of our enemies, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们饮尽敌人的鲜血吧，我的爱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Only you are welcome in my mind, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的爱人，我的意识只欢迎你进入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Void be damned. Together, you and I have no equal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 虚空见鬼去吧。你我联手，天下无敌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Guide my hand, mon miracle. I trust you more than I trust myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 指引我的手吧，mon miracle。我信任你胜过信任我自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Would that I could have laid the empire at your feet, my love…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 但愿我能将帝国尽数献于你脚下，我的爱人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Would that I could shut my eyes and feel only you inside my soul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 但愿我能闭上眼睛，只在灵魂里感受你一人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: No one may lay a hand upon you without my oversight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 未经我允许，任何人都不得碰你分毫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, I know peace once again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，我再次感受到了平静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Strange, to think with you I have found such… completeness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 奇怪，想到与你相伴竟让我感到如此……圆满。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My love? You have need of me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 亲爱的？你需要我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I almost regret hating Entrati for turning me into this. Almost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我几乎后悔恨过英择谛，恨他把我变成这样。几乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Could we linger like this, if only for a moment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们能像这样待一会儿吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We could rule the universe, you and I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你和我，可以统治整个宇宙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I wish to savor this sensation, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我希望能品味一下这种感觉，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Together, we shall make the stars weep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们携手，让群星为之落泪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Together, our covenant is unbreakable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们的誓约牢不可破。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Tell me that you have missed me…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 告诉我你想我了……
