/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My body, your shield. My soul, your light. Wield me, my love. I am yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的身体，是你的盾。我的灵魂，是你的光。使用我吧，我的爱人。我是你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Slaughter by the thousands, followed by a romantic night by the fire? Perfection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 屠杀数千人，接着在篝火旁共度浪漫之夜？完美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I kneel in love for you, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我因爱为你屈膝，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: There is no distance nor time between us that could keep me from your side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 距离和时间都无法阻止我与你相伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: When you are near, the world goes just a little quieter…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 当你靠近时，世界会变得清净一些……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your devil has answered your summons, as he always will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你的恶魔已应召而来，永远都会如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What strange flowers you have me lay at your feet, my love. Eh. C'est la vie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你让我在你脚前放着这些奇特的花朵，我的爱人。嗯。C'est la vie。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Tell your devil what need you have for him… here, or in private.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 告诉你的恶魔你需要他做什么……当众说，或私下说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I admit… I was growing a bit lonely for your company, mon miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我承认……我有点想念你的陪伴，mon miracle。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall ensure these memories linger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我定当让这些记忆长存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Were you summoning just myself this evening… or would you like my Conscripts as well?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 今夜你召唤的只是我……还是连同我的征召者也一并召唤？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mm. Whose penance do we seek this night? Our enemies? Mine? Or… yours?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯。今晚我们要向谁忏悔？我们的敌人？我的？还是……你的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come what may, these moments are ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 无论发生什么，这些时刻都属于我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: When I return covered in blood… I trust you not to waste the opportunity to lick me clean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 当我满身鲜血归来……我相信你会抓住机会将我舔得干干净净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes. Of course. Naturally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 是的。当然。理所当然。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Fascinating - if unsettling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 令人着迷——却也令人不安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: One less voice…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 少了一个声音……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah! Once again you leave me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊！你又一次离开我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not tarry overmuch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 别耽搁太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Worthy ghost, must you depart?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 尊贵的灵，你一定要离开吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: And where do you think you are going?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你以为自己要去哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我会等待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: My flesh is mine, once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我的肉体再次属于我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Peace and quiet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 平静安宁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Wander, then, if you must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如果你执意要这样的话，那就去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Void nonsense will never cease to amaze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 虚空的荒诞还真是永不止息地令人惊叹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A moment of solitude…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 孤独的时刻……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not abandon me for long, strange angel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 奇怪的天使，请不要离开我太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will assume this serves a purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将假设此举自有其意义所在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be cautious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 要小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I shall keep vigil alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将独自守夜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Do not be gone long. Catenach has been deeply irritating as of late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 别去太久。缚魔近来实在惹人恼火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers grow louder in your absence… kindly do not stray long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你不在的话，低语的声音会越来越大……请不要走得太远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Bon! I shall dance with the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Bon！我会和影子一起跳舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Privacy, sweet privacy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 隐私啊，美妙的隐私。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Until you return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 等待你归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Go. I have the Luminaries to watch over me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 去吧。我还有​双耀神守护着我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I do wonder if you truly grasp how bizarre that feels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我确实好奇你是否真正明白那感觉有多荒谬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hmfph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哼哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Am I so easily put aside?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我就这么容易被抛弃吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Seems a terrible plan to leave me here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 把我留在这里简直是个糟糕透顶的主意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: "Thou shalt collect dust."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: "你将积聚尘土。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ça va. I shall wait here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Ça va。我会在这里等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What strategic value is this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这有什么战略价值？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: At least to one presence within my mind others can bear witness…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 至少我脑海里有一个存在，还能被他人见证……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Solitude is once again my lot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 孤独再次成为我的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: That - that shall never be - a pleasant sensation, I fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我担心，那永远不会是一种愉快的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let me meditate upon patience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那我只好操练耐心了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: How diminished you look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你现在看起来可真狼狈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Return soon, and lend me your light once more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 快回来吧，再一次把你的光借给我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: So tragically little.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 真是少得可怜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I merely ask you not to forget where you left me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我只求你别忘了把我丢在哪里就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Again you depart? I am a temple, not une auberge!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你又要走了？我这是圣殿，不是 auberge！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You shed your armor as… a deception?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你脱掉护甲就为了……骗人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Very well. I shall pray in silence… and stillness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 好吧。我会在寂静中……祷告。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, transference. What a gift Margulis gave us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，传识。Margulis 可真是给了我们一份大礼啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Leave me to my thoughts. They are crowded enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我一个人去思考吧。我的思绪已经够拥挤的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Walk in the light of Sol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 走在太阳神的光中吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The devil… is no longer possessed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 恶魔……已不再被附身了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Very well. I have my prayers to attend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 很好。我得去祷告了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Bold you are, to go without the armor of Marie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你真大胆，不穿玛丽的铠甲就走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Not so much as a whiff of brimstone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 连一丝硫磺味都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Hm? So soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯？这么快？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Take care. The ways are dark and devil-haunted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 小心些。前路黑暗，魔鬼游走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, I can move independently once more! But why bother?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，我又能自由行动了！可何必费这个劲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The absence of one Void demon returns another…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 一个虚空恶魔走了，另一个又回来了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Sol's blessings go with you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 太阳神的祝福与你同在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Go. Slaughter at will. I shall watch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 去吧。大开杀戒。我在这看戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A polite devil, to exorcise yourself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 真是有礼貌的恶魔，自己把自己驱逐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You come to me to deliver you unto Lua? As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你来找我，是为了把你交给月神吗？如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We are beset!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们被围攻了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You cannot escape my wrath!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你无法逃脱我的怒火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Your suffering shall be great. But brief.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你将承受巨大的痛苦，但会很短暂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Blood is in the air!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 腥风血雨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Naught but your corpses will remain before me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 在我面前，唯余你们尸横遍野！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The voices have sought company. Let us cull the herd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这些声音正在寻找同伴。让我们把这群人清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Paiens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Paiens！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will sit upon a throne of your making!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我将坐上你亲手打造的王座！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What fools come to sing us their hymns of idiocy?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 是哪些蠢货来向我们唱他们的愚蠢赞歌？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: For the faith!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 为了信仰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, you wish to meet my better selves? So be it! Conscripts - to work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，你想见见我更优秀的一面？那就来吧！征召者——开工！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: So much pointless noise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 如此多无意义的噪音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We are attacked!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们受到攻击了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You have only succeeded in annoying me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你唯一做到的就是成功惹恼了我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be silent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 安静！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Stand strong, friends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 坚持住，朋友们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come and dance with the Devil of Tau!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来与 Tau 之恶魔共舞吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Repent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 悔改吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Discord and strife!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 纷争与不和！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will salt the ground beneath your feet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我定要让你脚下的大地化为荒芜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Yes, yes, yes. Rap, tap, tap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 是，是，是。哒、哒、哒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To arms!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 拿起武器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What insolence is this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这是何等狂妄？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Heretics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 异端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You will not make us martyrs today!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 今日我们绝不会成为殉道者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I will pick my teeth with your bones!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我定要拿你的骨头来剔牙！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We are amongst the damned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们都是被诅咒的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Arm yourselves in faith!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 用信仰武装自己！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Oh, how clever you must think you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哦，你一定是觉得自己很聪明吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Flesh seeks pain, and I shall grant it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 肉体寻求痛苦，那我就满足它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Heresy shall not prevail!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 异端休想得逞！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Run while you still have your lives!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 趁还没丧命赶紧滚吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Pray for penance, heathen!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 祈求忏悔吧，异教徒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Grace be our shield!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 恩典就是我们的盾牌！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Bad form!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不成体统！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You are nothing but dust to me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你在我眼中不过是尘埃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Their weapons shall not prosper against us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 他们的武器伤不了我们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I tire of your insolence!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我受够了你的狂妄！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua cares for their souls. I do not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神关心他们的灵魂。而我不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The profane are upon us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 亵渎者已逼近！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let me save you from your own stupidity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 容我把你从你自己的愚蠢中解救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Come, test my faith! I shall test your life!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 来吧，考验我的信心！我将检验你的生命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let the circle be unbroken!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让结界永不破裂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Good! I was becoming restless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 太好了！我正坐不住了呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Strike at me, it shall spell your end!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 攻击我，便是自取灭亡！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We are attacked!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们受到攻击了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, a symphony to my ears.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，简直如同天籁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Light the incense, Marie. Prepare for a vigil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 点燃香火，玛丽。我们准备守夜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Les maudits!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Les maudits！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The more things change-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 万变不离其宗——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: How many of you must be rendered unto the Void?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你们之中，还有多少人会被送入虚空？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: To arms, mes braves!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 战备，我的勇士们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You will regret angering me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你会后悔惹怒我的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The Void hungers. Sol, forgive me...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 虚空饥渴难耐。太阳神，请赦免我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The unclean are upon us! Allons-y!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 那些污秽之徒来了！Allons-y！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You fools!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你们这群蠢货！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The whispers grow loud. I will quiet them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 低语的声音越来越大。我会让它们安静下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us answer this violence!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们来回应这种暴力！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You will come to wish you had not done that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你终将后悔当初不该那样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You seek a reckoning? So be it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你在寻求审判？那就如你所愿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Wait. Wait!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 等等。等等！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Garish, but effective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 花哨，但有效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Certainly, this is in jest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 当然，这只是在开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Let us ride to battle!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 让我们奔赴战场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: And so perishes what little remains of my dignity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我仅存的尊严也消逝殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Lua, preserve me-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 月神，请护佑我——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: A noble charger… perhaps?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 难道这是一匹高贵的马……吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I see. Yes. Of course. Why not?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我明白了。是的。当然。为什么不呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: I think I am going to be ill-!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我想我要受不了——！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: This is not like the time Lyon took me sledding...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这完全不像里昂带我去滑雪橇的那次……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You truly adopted "function over form," as a mantra, I see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 看来你确实把"功能重于形式"奉为座右铭啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Is this an appropriate time to warn you that I am prone to sickness-!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我不知道现在告诉你合不合适，我很容易晕车——！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Allons-y!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: Allons-y！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Tastes must simply have changed since I have been gone…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 品味一定是在我离开后发生了变化……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Oh, no…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哦，不……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: You will not let me fall off, hm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你不会让我掉下去的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Ah, what a clever use of scavenged parts. Oh. Was this on purpose?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 啊，这废旧零件的利用真聪明。哦。这是故意的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Oh mes Dieux. What a sight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 噢 mes Dieux。这也太震撼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Well, on the bright side, it works far better than it looks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不过话说回来，它的实际效果比看起来好得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: The penitent man walks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 忏悔之人应当步行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Is this our flaming chariot?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 这就是我们的火焰战车吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Mm, charming. I am certain the enemy will never see us coming…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 嗯，真迷人。我敢肯定敌人绝对不会察觉我们的到来……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Be grateful for your gift of legs and use them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 应当感恩你有两条腿，并好好使用它们吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We ride swift as the wind!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们像风一样疾驰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: We will arrive quickly, if… not in style.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 我们会很快赶到——虽然……不太体面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Non, non, non, NON, NON!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 不，不，不，不，不！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: Un moment. I must pray first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 等一下。我必须先祈祷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: HAH! Very well, this is rather entertaining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 哈！很好，这倒很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.text: What have you conjured?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DevilsTriadGem.zhText: 你变出了什么魔法？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: What's this now? A failsafe. Yeah, heard about these. They'll cancel any running interference routines. But there's only one per system. Don't waste it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 这又是什么？保险装置。嗯，听说过。能清除当前所有干扰程序。不过每套系统只有一个，别糟蹋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Conduit failsafe. Pop that ducky in a console and it'll cancel any active interference routines. This is the only one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 导管保险装置。把这小宝贝塞进控制台，当前所有干扰程序都会被清掉。只有这一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Interference routines wiped. Your timing is impeccable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 干扰程序清干净了。时机掐得刚刚好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Good choice, that failsafe should make the next few moments a bit more bearable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 还挺会选。有了这个，接下来几分钟能少遭点罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Failsafe in effect. Pay no mind to the interference routines for the next little bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 保险装置起效了。接下来一阵子，可以不用管那些干扰程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Routine subverted and you're juiced. Nice. Shoulda been a boffin. Missed me callin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 成功反制了干扰程序，你也获得充能了。漂亮，我早该去搞科研，真是入错行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Looks like Alad was so keen to make the sale he didn't close every back door. Greed makes a person sloppy, Hotshot, remember that. Enjoy the boost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 看来阿拉德急着做成这笔买卖，连后门都没堵干净。人一贪，就容易露马脚。大佬，记住了。好好享受这份增益吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Perforrrmaaaance... improvement? Won't be looking that Kubrodon in the mouth...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 性——能……提升？行吧。白送的库狛顿，就别掰开嘴挑牙了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.text: Fiddlin' with an incoming routine. Howzat feel?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DBf.zhText: 我准备拿新来的程序动手脚。感觉如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Hope you're not done. Had to pay Maroo a small fortune in rations for this "tip".
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 可别跟我说你玩够了。为了这条「情报」，我可是拿一大笔口粮才喂饱麦罗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Takings squared away. Right: same again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 收获都收拾好了。行，再来一轮？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Got a few seconds before the system resets. We can take 'em again. Game?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 系统还有几秒重置。咱们还能再捞他们一笔。敢不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Care to live up to your reputation and try again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 要对得起你 Tenno 的名声啊，再来一次？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Not goin' home yet, we just got here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 别急着回家，我们才刚到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Why's ol' Alad call you lot Betrayers anyway? Ah, no matter care for another kick at the Conduit?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 话说，老阿拉德干嘛管你们叫「背叛者」？啊，算了。还想再拿导管开一局吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Alright... it's gettin' a little hairy. One more round, whaddya say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 行……情况变得有点棘手了。再来一轮，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Conduits about to reset. Feelin' lucky?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 导管马上重置。手气还在吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: The longer we stick around the more likely we'll get our arses handed to us. Still, with great stupidity comes great reward. Whaddya reckon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 我们待得越久，越可能被人狠狠干趴。不过，傻人有傻福，你说呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Gettin' a little hot. The gloves are comin' off. Got another round in ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 越来越热闹了。对面要动真格的了。你还能撑一轮吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Arse. Conduit down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 可恶，导管没了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Conduit destroyed. We won't be seeing those goods again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 导管被毁了。那批货也彻底没戏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Conduit down. Look, Mumsie may have raised you believin' winnin' aint the most important thing, but piece of advice? It is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 导管毁了。听着，你妈可能教过你，输赢没那么重要。听我一句劝：她错了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: They killed the Conduit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 他们把导管毁了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: That mucker got past you and now the Conduit's blown. Move on, move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 那混球从你眼皮底下溜过去，导管也炸了。别愣着，继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Conduit blown. Mate: this is not how bills get paid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 导管炸了。伙计，这么干可没饭吃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Conduit blown. Find another one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 导管炸了。找下一根。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Conduit destroyed. Dust yourself off. There'll be another 'round here someplace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 导管毁了。拍一拍，站起来。这附近肯定还有别的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Demo unit incoming. Don't let them near the Conduit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 爆破单位来了。别让它靠近导管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Hear that beeping? Demo unit's on its way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 听到那阵哔哔声了吗？爆破单位正在赶来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Demo unit coming in fast. That thing blows and you can kiss the Conduit goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 爆破单位正在高速逼近。它一炸，这根导管就算完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.text: Demo units lookin' to depart this mortal coil and take you with it. Keep it clear of that Conduit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDe.zhText: 爆破单位赶着去投胎，还想拉你垫背。别让它靠近导管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDs.text: Well, looks like the Infested snagged this one. I haven't seen this many zits since puberty. Fortunately for us, the Conduits are still operational. Unfortunately for us; so are the security mechanisms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDs.zhText: 看来感染者抢占了这地方。我过了青春期以后，就没见过这么多痘。好消息是，导管还在运转。坏消息是，安保系统也没打算放过我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDs.text: This isn't your regular vault job. Alad V sold the Conduits with interference routines, specifically designed for the Tenno. Don't you worry though, I got some workarounds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDs.zhText: 这可不是撬保管库那么简单。阿拉德 V 卖出导管的时候，还附送了专门对付 Tenno 的干扰程序。不过别担心，我有办法绕过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDs.text: This isn't your regular vault job. Alad V sold the Conduits with interference routines, specifically designed for the Tenno. Things might get a little weird.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DDs.zhText: 这可不是撬保管库那么简单。阿拉德 V 卖出导管的时候，还附送了专门对付 Tenno 的干扰程序。接下来可能会有点奇怪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.text: You got out while you still could. Smart move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.zhText: 趁还能脱身就撤，真够贼的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.text: Way ahead of you. Time to hit the pub.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.zhText: 早就这么想了。该去喝一杯了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.text: Shinnies secured and we're in the wind. I'll send your cut via the usual. Have a good one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.zhText: 东西到手，咱们也该闪人了。你的那份照老规矩给你送过去。回见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.text: We got as much as we're gettin', Hotshot. We are a vapor trail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DEx.zhText: 能捞的都捞了，大佬。该赶紧闪人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.text: That key worked. Protect the Conduit. And watch out for demo units, they're going to try and blow that thing up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.zhText: 钥匙管用。守住导管。当心爆破单位，它们会过来把这东西炸掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.text: You're about due for more a those whatsits: Interference routines. Demo units too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.zhText: 接下来还会来更多干扰程序。爆破单位也少不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.text: Can't do anything about that last interference routine. You'll just have to wear it. Maybe I can catch the next one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.zhText: 刚才那道干扰程序我没辙，你只能硬扛。下一个或许我能截住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.text: Right, they're havin' a go. Keep the demos away from that Conduit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.zhText: 行，他们要动手了。别让爆破使靠近导管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.text: Next verse same as the first. Mind you don't get flanked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.zhText: 老调重弹。小心别让人包了侧翼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.text: More of the old ultraviolence. Keep your back to the objective, old mate. Lock it down 'til she pops.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.zhText: 又是这套老掉牙的暴力桥段。背靠目标守住，老伙计。死守到它开启。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.text: First key. Right. Find a matching Conduit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DFr.zhText: 第一把钥匙。行，找个匹配的导管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DIn.text: Alad V's sellin' the latest in "asset security". Conduits. Put the key in, and ya can pull the shinnies out. Trick is, you gotta wait to open. Somethin' happens to the Conduit before you can pull the goods? You don't get the goods. Ever. Also the bleeders Alad sold the tech to will try to kill ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DIn.zhText: 阿拉德 V 正在兜售最新款的「资产安保」导管。钥匙插进去，等它开启，就能把好东西取出来。麻烦就在于，你得守到它开启。货出来之前，导管要是出了岔子，东西就没了，永远没了。还有，从阿拉德手里买下这套技术的那帮混蛋，也会来要你的命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DIn.text: Operator, incoming transmission. It's from... Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DIn.zhText: 指挥官，收到一则通讯。是……福尔图娜发来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DIn.text: Give that console the ol' bypass so we can get this thing started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DIn.zhText: 给那个控制台接个老式旁路，咱们开工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.text: Hotshot? C'mon, pal. Get up. Hotshot!
I've lost the feed. Where are you?
I'm punchin' out. Hotshot, if you can hear me, make contact at the usual locale. Little Duck, out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.zhText: 我先断开了。大佬，要是听得见，就在老地方联系。小鸭子，完毕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.text: Sorry, kid. It was a bad play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.zhText: 抱歉，小子。这一手玩砸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.text: Nothin' ventured. You want round two, ping me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.zhText: 有枣没枣打一杆子。想打第二轮，就呼我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.text: All Conduits sealed. I'm pullin' you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DMs.zhText: 导管全封死了。我带你撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DNw.text: Right. They're back, and they're well pissed off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DNw.zhText: 行，他们回来了。火气还不小。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DNw.text: Eyes open, sunshine. Here we go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DNw.zhText: 招子放亮，小太阳。开工了。
敌群信号又出现了。准备迎战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DNw.text: Safeties off. We kicked a clown car. Here we go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DNw.zhText: 关保险。咱们捅了马蜂窝。开工。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DSp.text: That there's a Conduit, useless without the key. Start turnin' out pockets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DSp.zhText: 那边就是导管。没钥匙，它就是堆废铁。去掏掏那些家伙的口袋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DSt.text: Conduit keys are carried by high-ranking muckity-mucks. Knock 'em down, see what they got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Disruption/DSt.zhText: 导管钥匙都揣在那些有头有脸的家伙身上。放倒他们，看看兜里有什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DEndRn.text: Round over! Mop 'em down and rack 'em up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DEndRn.zhText: 回合结束！给我把场地打扫干净！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DEndRn.text: Round over! Back in your corners and wring out your unmentionables! NEW ROUND!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DEndRn.zhText: 回合结束！找个角落把你们说不出口的话写下来吧！新的回合马上开始！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DEndRn.text: The only fun to be had in Rathuum, is by me, watching you, DIE. Why has nobody DIED? Oh. Right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DEndRn.zhText: 在死亡角斗场这里唯一的乐趣，就是让我，看着你们，去死。怎么到现在还没人死啊？噢，对啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DExecL.text: HA ha! My executioners have you hosed, Tenno! D… do you think we're gonna get in trouble for this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DExecL.zhText: 哈哈！我的行刑者把你给浇透了，Tenno！你……你认为我们会因此而惹来麻烦吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DExecL.text: You're all washed up, Tenno! We should solve all our problems like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DExecL.zhText: 你已经被浇成了落汤鸡，Tenno！早知如此，我们就该用这种方式来解决所有的问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DExecL.text: Hah, drip, drip you Tenno squirts! Losing team mops up the arena.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DExecL.zhText: 哈哈，嘀嗒，嘀嗒，你们这帮浑身湿漉漉的 Tenno 小屁孩！输掉的队伍要负责把竞技场拖干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.text: Hosers and Squirts, fill your weapons. Ah stop complaining, ya know ya love it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.zhText: 臭不要脸的小屁孩们，将你们的武器填满。啊，别抱怨了，你知道你喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.text: Ah my executioners are all dressed up and ready for fun. Dey look so cute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.zhText: 啊，我的行刑者都已装备完毕，随时都可以开始狂欢。他们看起来好可爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.text: Are! You! Ready ta GET WET?! Hmm? Sure sure, fix the gas leak, whatever. Don't bother me with details.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.zhText: 你！准备好！被浸透了吗？！嗯？好的好的，去修好那气体泄漏吧，怎么弄都可以。别拿这种琐碎的事情来烦我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.text: Alright! Now get out there and show me some H-2-WHOO-OA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.zhText: 很好！出来吧，给我来点儿一氧—哗—二氢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.text: 3-2-1! I! Order You! To Have! Fun! DING DING DING!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DRndSt.zhText: 三、二、一！我！命令你！要！玩得开心！叮叮叮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTenno.text: It's all fun and games until WE START LOSING! Pick up your act, Executioners! Fix the gas leak? Pfft. Y'know, we never really talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTenno.zhText: 一切都是那么的欢乐美好……直到我们开始落败的时候！行动起来把，行刑者们！解决气体泄漏的问题？嘁，有这回事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTenno.text: Executioners: if those were still acid cannons, you'd be in a world of hurt right now. HOSE THE TENNO! FOR SQUISHY HONOR!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTenno.zhText: 行刑者们：假如那些炮管里射出的还是酸液的话，你们可就痛不欲生了。赶快用你们的水龙头朝 Tenno 射击呀！让他们感受湿漉漉的恐惧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTenno.text: My mighty Executioners, bowing out 'cause they're too wet? Are you even Grineer? Pfft.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTenno.zhText: 我威武的行刑者啊，难道你们看到他们湿漉漉的样子就心慈手软了吗？你们还算是 Grineer 吗？嘁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTourn.text: Well, well, well. Even with all your underhanded Tenno gas leak trickery and slippery weapon-swappery and… and… stuff… Still, mighty Grineer conditioning WINS THE DAY! KE-LA'S NUMBER ONE! KE-LA'S NUMBER ONE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTourn.zhText: 啧，啧，啧，尽管你们这些狡诈的 Tenno 利用了气体泄漏，偷换武器，以及……其他……伎俩……不过，伟大的 Grineer 依然取得了今天的胜利！Kela 是冠军！Kela 是冠军！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTourn.text: Bah! So you won this one. Best out of… out of… how many have… LET'S DO IT AGAIN, MEATSACKS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DTourn.zhText: 呸！这次算你们赢。我们是几局……几胜来着……呃……这是第几局了……那就再来一次吧，蠢货们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DVidIn.text: Tenno. Sneaky, underhanded, snakey little Tenno. A special Rathuum! Executioners and accused will fight with ACID THROWERS! Ret! Lathuum! Beg...! Bet Lath... *cough* Let! Rathuum! Begin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DVidIn.zhText: Tenno，鬼鬼祟祟，阴险毒辣，蛇蝎心肠的小 Tenno。这是一场特殊的死亡角斗场！行刑者和被告们将使用酸液喷射器来对战！浪！死亡脚斗场！啦……！让死亡脚……*咳* 让！死亡角斗场！开始吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DVidIn.text: Do you smell something? GAS LEAK? Gas leak? That's hilarious. Haha. Wait! Exec… Executioners! Iz such a nice day. Do we really wanna fight? Or… dooo weee wannaaa...  PARTY?! WA-TER-RR FIIIGHT! I! Said! WATER FIGHT! WADDAFITE! I want a drink with a pink umbrella in it. WATERFIGHT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DogDays/DVidIn.zhText: 你闻到什么气味了吗？气体泄漏吗？气体泄漏？真可笑。哈哈。等一下！行……行刑者们！今天真是个好日子。想来打一场吗？还是说……来一场 — 派对？！那就打、打水战吧！就！这么！定了！打水战！水战！给我来杯酒，要上面带粉红小伞的那种。打水战！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Ah. A Drifter crosses my path!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 啊，一位漂泊者在我眼前出现了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Curious. What does that portend?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 真有意思。这预示着什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Will you stop, or breeze on by?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你是会停下脚步，还是径直离开呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Let's see what happens next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 看看接下来会发生什么吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: And whose business are you about today, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 漂泊者，今天又是在替谁奔忙呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: My favorite book of all is the one that details suitable tortures for people who mistreat books.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 我最喜欢的那本书里，详细记载了该用何种刑罚惩治那些不爱惜书本的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: He loved her, you know. Bombastine. Claims he didn't. But he cries and whispers her name when he thinks no one's listening. What do you suppose he'll do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你知道吗，蓬蓬士君是爱过她的。他嘴上不肯承认，可一到四下无人的时候，就会流着眼泪、小声念叨她的名字。所以你觉得他会怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: That Mathila. Funny how she has a smile on her face every morning. I'm sure one of the lads could tell us more...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 那个玛蒂拉可真有意思，每天早上都笑容满面。那些小伙子里，没准儿有人知道更多内情……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: It's no wonder this place is in the state it's in when there's a child on the throne. Of course some said it should have been Lodun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 难怪这里会变成这副样子，毕竟王座上坐着的是个小屁孩。当然，也有人说，那个位置本该属于隆沌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Don't waste any sympathy on Sythel. Not with her nasty little ways. I've barely scratched the surface of what she gets up to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 别把同情浪费在袭幽身上。就凭她那些卑劣的小手段，也不值得可怜。至于她都干过些什么，我也就只了解一点皮毛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: He is a martyr to his rages, Lodun is. I think there's something at the bottom of it all. Something he's too ashamed to admit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 隆沌一直饱受怒火折磨。我觉得他之所以如此暴怒，是因为心里藏着一件羞于启齿的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: I told them. I said 'You can't just ask someone what it's like to be executed every day of their life! They'll talk about it when they're ready!' You'll tell me first, of course?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 我早就跟他们说过了。我说：「哪能直接问别人，每天都被处决是什么滋味！等人家愿意说，自然会说！」不过，你肯定会第一时间告诉我的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Did you ever notice how that thing hangs in the sky overhead, and yet nobody ever wants to talk about it? Like it's not really there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你有没有发现，那东西一直悬在我们头顶，却从来没人愿意提起？仿佛它根本不存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Two children and no memory of her husband. Poor Mathila. I wonder if sad memories can even exist in that happy mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 有两个孩子，却完全不记得自己的丈夫。可怜的玛蒂拉啊。我不禁好奇，她那颗快乐的心里，究竟容不容得下悲伤的记忆？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: You know this handful of islands is just what's left, don't you? There used to be so many more...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你知道吧，如今剩下的只有这零星几座岛屿了。以前这里可宏大得多……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: There's a whole universe out there, beyond the Wall. The one that Old Thingybob in the cave comes from. Or... perhaps you already knew that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 「墙」外面还有一整个宇宙。山洞里那个老古董就是从那儿来的。还是说……你早就知道了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: There's a wealth of hidden knowledge out there in Duviri, just waiting to be discovered. I should know. I hid it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 双衍王境里藏着无数奥秘，正等着人去发现。这我最清楚了，因为就是我藏的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: You're not like us at all, are you? I've worked out that much. Now I want more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你跟我们完全不一样，对吧？这点我已经弄明白了。现在我还想知道更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text:
Ah, I thought it was you. And I have a pretty good idea what you're up to. Oh, I wouldn't tell anyone. Not with your reputation.

I think we could be useful to each other. I've built up quite a collection over the years, and you can get your hands on things I never could. So. Trade? Don't tell me you're not… curious?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText:
啊，我就知道是你，我也很清楚你在打什么主意。放心，我不会告诉别人。毕竟，你名声在外。

我想，我们可以互相帮助。这些年我积攒了不少好东西，而你也能弄到一些我永远碰不到的宝贝。所以，做笔交易怎么样？别告诉我你……不感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Something is different about you. What is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你有点不一样了。究竟哪里变了呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: I won't ask where you've been lately. I can tell from the dust on your boots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 我就不问你最近去了哪儿了。看看靴子上的灰，我也猜得出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Hello... "Drifter".
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你好啊……「漂泊者」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: I'll have your secrets out of you. Every one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 我迟早会从你嘴里套出所有秘密，一个不落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Look at us, chatting like old friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 瞧瞧我们，聊起天来就像老朋友一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Whatever can you be up to, armed and unfettered in the King's own country?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 在士魂大帝的王境里全副武装、无拘无束，你究竟在打什么主意呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Ah, the undying vagabond. A tale still in progress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 啊，命硬的流浪者，看来你的故事还远未结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Hmmm. Should I pretend I haven't seen you? No, this is much more interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 嗯……我是不是该装作没看见你？算了，还是这样更有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Some faces tell a story. Yours? More of an epic tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 有些人的故事全写在脸上。至于你？简直是一出史诗般的悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Always stumble across you eventually, don't I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 我总归还是会碰见你的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Hmm. Interesting meeting. Let's see what comes of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 嗯……真是一场有趣的相遇。看看接下来会发生什么吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: You remain quite unpredictable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你还是那么让人捉摸不透。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: There'll be other times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 啊……以后还有机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Nothing tickled your curiosity, hm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 就没有一样能勾起你的好奇心吗？嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Everything you see has been painstakingly cataloged by type, function and flavor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 眼前这些东西，我都费尽心思，按类型、用途和风格，精心整理过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Let's find out what it takes to tempt a specimen like you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 让我看看，究竟什么东西才能诱惑到你这样的稀奇标本。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Now you get to benefit from my hard work. Make the most of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 现在，你可以尽情享用我的劳动成果了。可要好好利用啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: While you were getting yourself slaughtered in any number of fascinating ways, I was digging up secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你在外面换着花样送命的时候，我可正忙着四处挖掘秘密呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: You come to me, all blades and bullets, and you want to know how you could be even deadlier? Here's how.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你全副武装跑来找我，就想知道怎么才能让自己变得更狠？办法就在这儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: If you're not sure what something does, experiment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 如果你不确定某样东西有什么用，试试就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: There's a price, of course, but who can resist learning something new?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 当然，凡事都有代价。不过谁又能抗拒求知的诱惑呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: I wonder what you'll do with that...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 真好奇你打算拿它做什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Interesting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 有点意思！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: I see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 原来如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Will that be all?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 就这些了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Making a note of that...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 啊，记下来了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Hmm. Let's see what happens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 啊……看看接下来会发生什么吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: What drew you to that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你为什么会选它？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: Hmm. Curious...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 啊，真让人好奇……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: You remain endlessly fascinating. Goodbye!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你总是这么耐人寻味。再会！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: And just like that, you're gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 一转眼，人就没影了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.text: What a riddle you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DAcrith.zhText: 你可真是个解不开的谜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
We're gonna take him
Shake him, break him,
Roast him, toast him
Bind him, blind him
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
我们要抓住他，
摇摇他，掰掰他，
烤烤他，烘烘他，
绑绑他，弄瞎他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Punch him, crunch him
Snatch him, scratch him,
Flay him, slay him
Good and DEAD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
揍扁他，咬碎他，
抓住他，挠烂他，
剥了他，宰了他，
让他死透啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
If only fire melted stone
Oh how people's wrath would burn
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
要是火能熔化石头，
人们的怒火就会烧个不休。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
If angry words could break a bone
Oh how the world would moan and groan
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
要是狠话能折断骨头，
整个世界都要嚎个不休。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Let your blood boil
Let your teeth grind,
Let your fire rise
'Cause it's Lodun's Day!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
让热血发烫，
把牙齿磨响，
让怒火狂放，
今天是隆沌的主场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Better make a fist
Better start a fray,
Knock a fella down
'Cause it's Lodun's Day
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
快把拳头攥响，
来痛快打一场，
把对手揍翻在地上，
今天是隆沌的主场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Something's watching through the window,
Watching you and watching me...
Wants what we have, wants to BE us!
We know that can never be,
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
窗外有东西在偷瞄，
盯着你也把我瞧……
它想抢走我们的一切，
想要变成我们的模样！
可它永远只能想一想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Something's waiting, getting closer,
Watching, waiting for its day,
Something needy, cruel and greedy...
Keep that hungry thing at bay!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
有东西在等待，
一步一步靠过来，
它盯着、等着，那一天到来。
它又贪心，
又凶又坏……
把那饿鬼挡在外！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Oh Mister Bombastine
We know why you act so mean,
Everyone else has more than you
Everyone else is bored of you
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
噢，蓬蓬士君先生，
我们知道你为何如此刻薄，
别人样样都比你多，
别人早就听烦你啰嗦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Oh Mister Bombastine
We know why your eyes are green,
Someone else had a sweeter voice
Someone else was the King's new choice
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
噢，蓬蓬士君先生，
我们知道你为何如此妒忌，
别人的声音更甜蜜，
国王的新宠偏偏不是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Go hide your face,
In a lonesome place,
Many miles away from here
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
快把小脸藏好，
躲到没人的荒郊，
离这里越远越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Where the night winds wail,
Till your face turns pale,
And the stones all mock your fear!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
那里夜风呜呜，
脸儿吓得白扑扑，
石头也笑你迷了路！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: What's that whisper on the breeze?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 风里是谁悄悄讲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: Just the rustling in the trees.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 只是树叶沙沙响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: What's that tread upon the stair?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 楼梯上是谁在踩？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: Nothing, darling, nothing there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 没人，宝贝，谁都不在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: What's that rattling at my door?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 门外什么咔哒响？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: Just the wind and nothing more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 只是风吹，没别样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: What's that breathing in my ear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 谁在耳边呼呼吹？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: Nothing, darling, nothing here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 没人，宝贝，这儿没谁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: What's that gleaming sharp and bright?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 又是什么尖又闪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: Hold your tongue and say GOODNIGHT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 闭上嘴巴，快说晚安！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
What are you afraid of?
Empty eyes and,
Distant cries and
Wolves who walk in human guise?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
你害怕哪一样？
空空的眼眶，
远远的哭腔，
还是披着人皮的狼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
What are you afraid of?
Creaks and thuds and,
Trickling blood and
Mouths and noses filled with mud?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
你害怕哪一样？
嘎吱咚咚响，
鲜血滴滴淌，
还是口鼻塞满泥浆？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
What are you afraid of?
Nails in your knees and,
Faces in the trees and
Clowns with hands all full of bees?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
你害怕哪一样？
膝盖钉子扎得牢，
树上怪脸往外瞧，
还是小丑满手蜜蜂嗡嗡叫？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text: Grin, grin, grin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText: 咧嘴笑，笑，笑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
If smiles were all it took,
We would all be happy
With just one look!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
要是笑一笑就好，
那大家都没烦恼，
只要看一眼就好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
There's a face in the sky,
With a great big smile,
So we smile right back today
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
天上有张脸，
咧着大嘴弯又弯，
今天我们也笑给它看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
There's a man in a wall,
With a grin like a skull,
So we grin right back today
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
墙里有人藏里头，
咧嘴笑得像骷髅，
今天我们也笑给他看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Even when your house is burning down
Even when a fool has stolen your crown,
You can smile instead
You can smile
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
哪怕屋子烧光光，
哪怕傻瓜偷走王冠，
别哭呀，笑一笑，
笑一笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Even when you can't afford your tax
Even when your husband's been killed by Dax,
You can smile instead
You can smile
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
哪怕交不起税钱，
哪怕丈夫死在禁卫刀尖，
别哭呀，笑一笑，
笑一笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Lady, lady, why do you weep,
Tear at your hair 
And cry in your sleep?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
姑娘，姑娘，你怎么总在哭，
扯乱头发，
在梦里唏嘘？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Grief and woe have made me a thing...
Fit but to sing
At the will of the King
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
悲伤和苦痛，把我变成这副模样……
只能听命于国王，
为他献唱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Oh the wall rose high...
And it wished it could cry
With the tears of a thousand eyes
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
哦，高墙越长越高……
它多想放声哭号，
流尽千眼的泪潮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
For Sorrow it sought...
But it never ever thought
How it already kept its prize
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
它四处寻找悲伤……
却从不曾想，
想找的已在墙中央。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Cry for a dead love
Cry for your shame,
Cry for the loss
Of your own good name
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
为逝去的爱而哭，
为你的耻辱而哭，
为你失去的好名声，
放声大哭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.text:
Cry for the day and
Cry for the hour,
Cry for the lady
Locked in the tower
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DChildR.zhText:
为那天哭一场，
为那刻哭一场，
为那个锁在高塔上的姑娘，
痛快哭一场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Don't these idiots know the Dax might inspect us at any moment?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 难道这些白痴不知道，禁卫随时都可能过来搜查吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Fix this, fix that, sweep this, sweep that...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 修修这个，修修那个。扫扫这里，扫扫那里……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Yes yes what do you want?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 嗯嗯，你有什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I'm busy, make it quick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我忙着呢，有话快说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: What? What do you want now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 干什么？这回又有什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Ah, wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 啊，太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Ah, to what do I owe the honor?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 啊，来找我有何贵干？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Out with it or move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 有话快说，有屁快放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Sling your hook, I have work to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 走开，别烦我，我还有事要忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Well if I'm devoured today, my children will inherit a clean house.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 唉，行吧，就算我今天被吃掉，孩子们至少还能继承一间干净的屋子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Work, like life, it never ends... it is merely... endured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 唉，工作，就像生活，没完没了……只能……撑着熬下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Oh my achin' back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 噢，我这老腰都要断了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: What? What is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 怎么了？什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Go on. Move along. No lollygagging around here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 快走，起开。可别把我扫的地磨蹭脏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Do I know you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我认识你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Oh, good day my liege. The airs on this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 哟，阁下早上好呀。咳，还挺会摆架子的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: They come, they go, they come, they go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 来了又走，走了又来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Oh. Lovely. Another one. Yes? What?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 噢。真好。又来一个。怎么？什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Ugh, missed a spot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 唉，这儿还没扫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: A woman feels like she's swept the same floor for as long as she can remember...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 感觉从我记事起，就一直在扫同一块地……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Torture would be better than this. But then I guess this is torture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 上酷刑都比这强。不过想想，这何尝不算一种酷刑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: There goes that Drifter again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 那个漂泊者又来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Void-damned kids! Disrespecting their seniors!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 受虚空诅咒的小崽子！一点都不懂尊老敬老！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: First day of the rest of my life. Again. Wa-hoo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 余生中的第一天，又开始了。真让人兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Well, at least this place will fall into the Void one day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 行吧，至少这鬼地方总有一天会坠入虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: My toe's itching! Oh no, wait. It stopped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我的脚趾好痒！噢，没事，又不痒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Bring on the big wyrm. Get it over with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 快让大魇龙来，赶紧给我个痛快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I don't know why I thought today would be any different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 真不知道我为什么会觉得，今天能有什么不同。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Same old, same old.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 老样子，还是老样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Well, it would be nice to want something once in a while.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 唉，偶尔能有点想要的东西，应该也不错吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Eternity. Well, I can't say I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 永恒。反正我是不怎么喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Should I break something? Scream a little? No. I don't think I'll bother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我是不是该砸点东西？再叫上几声？算了，懒得折腾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Wonder what it's like to be a tree. Or a rock. Or a fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 不知道当棵树是什么感觉，当块石头也行，鱼也不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Yesterday, my mood was "bored". Today, it is also "bored". Who knows what tomorrow will bring?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 昨天，我感觉很「无聊」。今天，还是「无聊」。谁知道明天会有什么惊喜呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Guess I could go get run over by a Kaithe again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 要不我再去让绝灵骥撞一次得了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Eighteen million bottles of Kuva on the wall...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 墙上摆着一千八百万瓶赤毒……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: No. I can't quite believe it. What kind of benevolent creator would consign me to this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 不，我还是不敢相信。得是多么「仁慈」的造物主，才会把我扔到这种地方？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I'm going to take off this mask! No. I'm not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我要把这面具摘下来！不，还是算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: It's good that I don't remember. It's good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 不记得也好，这样挺好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I look into the Void, the Void looks into me looking into the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我凝视虚空，虚空也凝视着正在凝视虚空的我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Let's not waste the day His Majesty gave us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 可不能浪费国王赐给咱们的这一天！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Is that... you know, I think it is!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 那是……哦，我觉得还真是！噢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Whatever you may say about Duviri, it's never the same day twice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 不管你怎么说双衍王境，这个地方永远充满变数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I've been doing this all my life and I'm not even tired!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 嗯，我一辈子都在干这个，居然一点都不觉得累！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Who, I ask you, who would ever want to live anywhere else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我说真的，有谁会想住到别的地方去呢？噢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Stay away from the pools and ponds! The Golden Maws are anything but companionable. They're ravenous!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 离水池和池塘远点！黄金喉兽可一点也不亲人。它们饿极了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: The trick is keeping busy. Saves you from having to do any thinking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 诀窍就是让自己忙起来。这样就不用动脑胡思乱想了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Thrax is on his throne, and all is right with the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 哦，在士魂大帝的统治下，世间一切井然有序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Oh, people love to complain! Know what I say? The King is doing his best. Besides, I'd like to see you do better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 人们就是爱抱怨！知道我怎么想吗？陛下已经尽力了。再说，我倒想看看换成你能做得多好。哼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Oh it doesn't matter to me one little bit what color the sky turns. I think this place is beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 哦，对我来说，天空变成什么颜色都根本无所谓。我觉得这儿美极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Prosper the day, stranger!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 祝你今天一切顺利，陌生人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: It's okay! It's going to be fine! It always is!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 没关系！一切都会好起来的！向来都是这样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Go stand under a Materlith and then tell me this isn't a world full of love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 先去母石雕像下站一会，再来跟我说，这世界并没有充满爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Oh! For a moment there I thought that you were the Drifter! Like my little life would ever get that exciting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 哦！有那么一瞬间，我还以为你是漂泊者！像我这样的小人物，怎么可能有那么大的福气呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Well hello there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 喂，你好啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: What a beautiful day! If you want to see the world don't stand in one place! Go go go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 多美好的日子啊！想看看这世界，就别站在原地不动！快走快走，出发吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Feels good to get a body moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 动起来的感觉真不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Hey friend!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 喂，朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: What's the good word?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 近来还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Nice to see you! Any news?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 你好啊！有什么新鲜事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Always nice to see a friendly face. What brings you here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 和蔼的笑容真让人高兴。什么风把你吹来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: You wouldn't be interested in the junk I have for sale. This clutter is for common Duviri folk, not heroes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我卖的破烂你多半看不上。这些东西都是给双衍王境的寻常百姓用的，哪配得上英雄啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I'd swear this place used to be busier. Couldn't remember when, though, if you asked me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我敢肯定，这里以前繁华得多。可你要问是什么时候，我还真不记得了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Alas, my trade is in horseshoe nails and boot laces. Not mighty guns or shining swords.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 哎，我是做马蹄钉和靴带生意的。不卖威风凛凛的枪和寒光闪闪的剑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Hey. What brings you around?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 嗨，你怎么有空过来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: My shoddy wares are far too humble for the likes of you, good Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我这些粗劣货色，哪入得了您的法眼啊，漂泊者大人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Still strugglin' against the King, eh? Good luck to you. Me? I know my place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 你还在跟国王较劲呢？祝你好运。我？我可不掺和。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Lookin' real dangerous today, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 今天看上去浑身杀气啊，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I mean, yeah, some do say Thrax should be murdered every day for a million years... but everyone agrees, he gave us some nice buildings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我是说，对，确实有人说士魂大帝该被千刀万剐个几百万年……不过大家也都承认，他盖的房子还挺漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I've been in this business a long time, met a lot of people and I can tell you this: you're not who you think you are. There's a lot more to you than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我做这行年头久了，也见过形形色色的人。有一点我可以打包票，你并不是自以为的那个你。你身上有无限的可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: When one falls in love with what cannot see, one falls in love with magic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 当一个人爱上看不见的事物，说明他爱上了魔法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: You may as well laugh. Anxiety changes nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 还不如笑一笑，焦虑改变不了任何事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: It is said you cannot cheat an honest man. Untrue. To cheat an honest man one does not appeal to their greed, but to their pity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 大家常说，老实人不好骗。其实不然，要骗过老实人，不必利用他的贪心，而要利用他的同情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: One cannot repair people, only love them. Let go of the fallacy, or be dragged behind it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 人是修不好的，只能用爱治愈。放下这种执念，否则你会被它一路拖着走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: If it is stupid and it works, it is not stupid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 蠢办法要是真能奏效，那就说明还不算蠢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: To adjust perspective on suffering remember that the shape of both comedy and horror are identical.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 想换个角度看待苦难，就记住：喜剧与恐怖，往往只是同一轮廓下的两张面孔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Life is both unkind and unpredictable. But it would be worse if it were unkind and predictable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 生活无情，也无常。但若它无情而有常，那才是真正的绝望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Distance yourself from hurry, from chatter. Sit in silence. Sit in silence long enough that your mind, out of need, converses with itself. From this will be learned a great many things. Things astounding, things terrible, all useful, all impossible to disregard. In this we survive both life, and death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 远离奔忙，远离喧嚣，静坐沉思。坐得足够久，久到心智出于需要，开始与自己交谈。你会从中习得许多事：惊人的、骇人的，无一无用，也都不容忽视。唯此，我们于生亦存，于死亦存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Emperors, kings, popes and tyrants. All tell us things. Strange things. Conflicting things. Confusing things. They tell us these things not so we believe. They tell us these things so we believe nothing. And in believing nothing, do nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 帝王、国王、教皇和暴君，总有话要我们听。这些话奇奇怪怪、自相矛盾，还令人费解。他们并不是要我们相信这些话，而是要我们从此什么都不信。因为一旦无所信，便也无所为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: A nurse held hand after hand day after day as soul after soul fled body after body. She believed her mind had fled and her soul would be next. No. Our minds save us. Saved her. Her mind ferried away horrors before returning for the next day's passengers. The things she believed lost were only borrowed, as company for her savior's journey. This, this is good to remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 曾有一名护士，日复一日，握住一只又一只病人的手，看着灵魂一个又一个逃离肉体。她以为自己的心智也逃离了，灵魂亦将随之而去。不，心智会拯救我们脱离苦海，也曾救过她。她的心智先将那些恐怖渡往彼岸，再回来接走第二天的「乘客」。她以为已经失去的一切，其实只是被她的救赎者暂时借走，陪伴它踏上那段旅程。这一点，务必铭记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: You have a shadow. It is that which you wish you were not, but are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 你有一道影子。那不是别的，正是你不愿承认的部分自我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: If one wishes to be forever young, one must be forever learning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 一个人要想永葆青春，就必须明白：活到老，学到老。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Suffering and misery do not have to be one and the same. Men and women will suffer for anything, so long as they believe it to be meaningful. When their labor is without meaning... then suffering truly becomes suffering.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 痛苦与苦难并非一回事。只要相信所受之苦有意义，人便能忍受近乎一切的苦难。可一旦付出失去意义……届时，痛苦才真正成为了「苦难」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: A mother to a misbehaving child once said "Do it until your father laughs." I say to you, my eyes to Heaven: "Do it until your father laughs."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 曾有位母亲对顽皮的孩子说：「放手去做，要让你的父亲满意。」我也心向天堂对你说：「放手去做，要让你的天父满意。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: You are trapped by your ability to symbolize. Do you understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 你被自己赋予万物象征意义的能力困住了。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: You can't put a price on a view like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 这种美景，哪能用钱来衡量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: My pa always said: there's two ways to be rich. Get a lot or want little. This big sky? All I've ever needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我老爹常说，致富有两条路。要么多赚点，要么少要点。瞧见这片广阔天空了吗？我有它就够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Headed somewhere?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 想去哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: The snap of her sails and the creak of her hull are music to my ears.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 她的船帆迎风作响，船身吱呀低鸣，在我耳中犹如天籁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Wherever a body needs to be, my girl and I can take them there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 不管谁想去哪儿，我和我的船都能把人送到目的地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Mind the crosswinds over Lonesome Outlook and we'll keep her true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 只要多加注意寂寥观景台的侧风，我们就能保持航向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Wind's picking up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 起风了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Another day, girl. Another blessed day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 新的一天，我的小船。又是幸福的一天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: The world down here may be upside down, but up there... up there things are always as they were meant to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 脚下的世界或许早已颠倒，可天上……天上的一切，始终都是它们本该有的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Well. Best get my boots on. Will and wind wait for none.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 好啦，该穿上我的靴子了。风不等人，心也脱锚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Should we? I think we should.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 该走了吗？我想是该走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: In a little bit. Let's just enjoy the light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 再待一会儿吧，先好好晒晒太阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: It'll be fine. You'll see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 会好起来的，你会看到的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: It will always be like this. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 以后永远都会这样，我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I should have been there. I hope she knew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我本该陪在她身边，希望她能知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: What do I think? I think you know what I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 我怎么想？你明明知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: It will happen. There's always time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 总会等到那一天，我们还有的是时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: And that was that. Extraordinary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 事情就这样结束了。真不可思议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: There's also a world out here, you realize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 别忘了，书外面也有个世界呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: You should read to me sometime. I'd like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 哪天也读给我听吧，我很爱听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: If you don't put that down we're going to be late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 再不把那东西放下，咱们可要迟到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I watched an Orowyrm chase a Kaithe and you completely missed it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 刚才有一条奥金魇龙追着绝灵骥跑，你居然没看见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I find something new in this each time I read it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 每次重读这本书，我都有新收获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Delightful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 妙极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: Fascinating. Absolutely fascinating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 真有意思，实在是太有意思了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: No artist tolerates reality. And yes that was something I read in a book.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 没有哪个艺术家受得了现实。当然，这句话也是我从书里看来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.text: I'm almost done. Give me another ten minutes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvAmb.zhText: 快看完了，再给我十分钟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 嚯，还有意外收获？
