/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Such a sweet kittie. Best not give her cause to show her claws.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 多可爱的小猫咪呀。最好不要惹到它，不然她会抓人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Oh my poor sweet cat. Be a good girl for our Outlaw and a bowl of warm milk shall be yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 哦，我可怜的小猫咪。乖乖听游侠的话，就有温热的牛奶喝哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Into the gentle hands of our Outlaw, little kitty. I promise that finding a warm sunbeam shall be your only worry henceforth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 放心交给游侠吧，小猫咪。我保证，以后你只管找个暖和的地方晒太阳，其他什么都不用操心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Doggie! You must be very quiet. They possess hearing most acute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 是狗狗！一定要保持安静，它们的听觉敏锐得很。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Oh… a poor lame puppy. Quietly now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 哦……可怜的瘸腿小狗。安静些，悄悄靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: He has most fearsome fangs, doesn't he? Do be careful, Outlaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 它的尖牙真吓人，对吧？千万要小心啊，游侠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: A Tamm! Such noble bearing! Oh, he does not deserve to be afflicted so! Please, do not startle the poor thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 是塔塔羊！举止多么高雅啊！它不该遭受这样的折磨！求你别吓着这可怜的小家伙，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Ever so quietly now, Outlaw. It would not do to have you twixt those horns!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 游侠，悄悄靠近。要是你被它那对角顶到，那可就惨了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: A lordly Tamm. Free him from this indignity, Outlaw. But softly, lest he startle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 这只塔塔羊好威风啊！快去帮它摆脱这种狼狈的困境吧，游侠。不过动作要轻，别吓着它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Softly, softly, Outlaw. Skittish are these darling ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 轻一点，慢一点，游侠。这些小宝贝很容易受惊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Oh, you must seem a titan to one so small. Quietly and gently, Outlaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 在这个小家伙眼里，你一定像个巨人。安静点，动作轻柔些，游侠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Ah. You are safe with us, little one. You may trust our Outlaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 好啦，小家伙，跟我们在一起很安全。你可以相信这位游侠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Goodness. For one whose domain is the air this raptor is impressive and formidable as stone. Please do be careful, Outlaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 天呐，这只以天空为领地的猛禽，竟有着磐石般的威势。请务必小心，游侠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Soft as a mouse, now, Outlaw - lest our stricken friend take suddenly to the air.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 游侠，要像小老鼠那样悄悄靠近，免得我们受伤的朋友突然飞走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Show your good intentions as softly and quietly as you may, Outlaw. It would not do to have those talons turned upon you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 游侠，尽量放轻脚步，让它看出你没有恶意。要是那双利爪朝你袭来，可就糟了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 看来我交了个新朋友。去吧，小家伙。今天也算做了件好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: I think I made a new friend. Off y'go buddy. My good deed for the day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 看来我交了个新朋友。去吧，小家伙。今天也算做了件好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: All done. There y'go, pal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 都搞定了。去吧，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: All done. There y'go, pal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 都搞定了。去吧，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: All done. There y'go, pal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 都搞定了。去吧，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: All done. There y'go, pal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 都搞定了。去吧，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Alright. Off you go. They're gonna be okay, Koral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 好了，去吧。没事的，小珊瑚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Alright. Off you go. They're gonna be okay, Koral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 好了，去吧。没事的，小珊瑚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Alright. Off you go. They're gonna be okay, Koral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 好了，去吧。没事的，小珊瑚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: Alright. Off you go. They're gonna be okay, Koral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 好了，去吧。没事的，小珊瑚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: They're alive, and themselves. Once they calm down I'm sure they'll understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 它还活着，也恢复正常了。等它冷静下来，一定会明白我们是在帮它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: They're alive, and themselves. Once they calm down I'm sure they'll understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 它还活着，也恢复正常了。等它冷静下来，一定会明白我们是在帮它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: They're alive, and themselves. Once they calm down I'm sure they'll understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 它还活着，也恢复正常了。等它冷静下来，一定会明白我们是在帮它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.text: They're alive, and themselves. Once they calm down I'm sure they'll understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DDuvCon.zhText: 它还活着，也恢复正常了。等它冷静下来，一定会明白我们是在帮它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I suppose she is still chirping away on her perch of honor? Of course she is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 想必她还蹲在那根荣耀的高枝上，叽叽喳喳没个完吧？呵，她一贯如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: My, don't you look fancy. Where do you get those outfits?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 哎哟，瞧你这一身，真够气派的。这些行头都是从哪儿弄来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: If I could just borrow their powers. Lodun's fire. Sythel's lightning. Then I'd be a Wyrm to reckon with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 隆沌的火焰，袭幽的闪电……要是这些力量能借我一用，那我也能成为一条让人望而生畏的魇龙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: The shoe will be on the other foot one day. Oh, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 风水轮流转。嗯，没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Days of being executed all behind you, are they? Be nice if you remembered your old friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 天天被处刑的日子都已经过去了，是吧？你要是还记得你的老朋友，就更好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Look at you. Feared and respected wherever you go. Must be nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 瞧瞧你，走到哪儿都让人敬畏有加。感觉很威风吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Oh, to be a Drifter! No ties. No responsibilities. Nobody to take care of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 哦，做个漂泊者多快活！无牵无挂，不必担责任，也不用照顾任何人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Heard the King put a bounty on your head. How's it feel? To know you're worth that much to someone?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 听说国王悬赏取你性命，感觉如何？没想到自己这条命还挺值钱吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Helping one of the others today, are you? It's okay. I understand. Not a problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 今天又去给别人帮忙了，是吧？没关系，我理解。完全没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: If I had your resources, I'd be on the throne by now. Bombastine the First. Just saying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 要是我有你手头那些资源，早就坐上王座了。蓬蓬士君一世……我只是随口说说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I do not care so much for the denizens of the downbelow. They are ever so gruff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我对底层的那些居民没什么好感。他们总是那么粗鲁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: We fear not, little friends, for though the world may shake and fume the end of the world has not quite come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 别怕，小家伙们。虽说外面地动山摇、乌烟瘴气的，可世界末日还没真正降临呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: The world is ever such a big place. How shall someone as small as myself make their way in it? Such is the nature of adventure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 世界这么大，像我这么小的人，该怎么在这里闯出一条路呢？这正是冒险的真谛呀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: When the weather grows warm, and mother is inattentive, I love to dip my head in the cool, bubbling stream. Mother shies me away from water, ever since father was taken by the sea. Or so she tells me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 天气一暖，趁妈妈没留神，我就喜欢把脑袋浸到清凉的溪水里。可她总不许我靠近水边，说爸爸就是被大海带走的。至少，她一直这么跟我说的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I feel I owe the sweet, little citizens of the world a great debt of compassion. When I am heartsick they afford a great and abiding comfort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我总觉得，应该好好善待世上这些可爱的小生命。每当我伤心难过，都是它们给我长久的安慰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Blessings upon you as broad as your compassionate shoulders, Outlaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 游侠，愿你这双宽厚的肩膀，承载世间最丰厚的祝福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I wonder what father would have had to say about you, Outlaw. Mother looks upon you kindly… and father was always contrary… so perhaps it is best you never did meet. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我常想，父亲会怎么评价你，游侠。母亲对你颇有好感，可父亲向来爱跟她唱反调……所以，也许你们从来没见过面反而更好。嗯，没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I find it curious - do you not? - that one has no memory of what they were before they were themself. As I remember nothing about it, I know nothing of it. And yet, I am certain, I was not always Koral. Were you always an Outlaw, I wonder?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我觉得很奇怪，你不觉得吗？人竟然完全不记得在成为「自己」之前是什么样子。我什么都不记得，自然也无从知晓。可我很确定，我并非一直都是小珊瑚。你呢，游侠？你从一开始就是游侠吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I think I should very much like to be a Tamm. I would live upon cress and milk and gambol with my friends and never ever be sad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我想，当一只塔塔羊一定很不错。每天都有水芹吃、有牛奶喝，还能和朋友们一起蹦蹦跳跳，永远都不会悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I wished to gather some water bugs for our supper. I asked the fishes if they had seen any, but they were greedy and wanted them for themselves and so said nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我本来想去抓点水虫来当晚餐，就问鱼儿们有没有见过。可它们太贪心，想留着水虫自己吃，所以什么都不肯说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: What are you gawping at?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你傻愣着看什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Peasants. Getting their filth all over everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 一群贱民，走到哪儿脏到哪儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: One day, Imp. One day I get to hear your scrawny neck go snap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 小魔头，总有一天，我会亲耳听见你那根细脖子咔嚓一声断掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I haven't forgotten how you spoke to me, "Drifter". I should have your tongue for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我可没忘你当初是怎么跟我说话的，「漂泊者」。就凭这一点，我也该割了你的舌头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Oh, not AGAIN! THAT REALLY BOILS MY… URRRGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 没完了是吧！把老子肺都气炸了……呃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: MY TROOPS SHOULD HAVE BEEN HERE AN HOUR AGO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我的部队一小时前就该到这儿了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: WHY ARE YOU EVEN RIDING A BLOODY KAITHE IF YOU DON'T KNOW HOW TO CONTROL IT?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 连绝灵骥都控制不住，那你还骑它干什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Someone find me some troops with some COMMON SODDING SENSE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 谁能给我找几个有点脑子的兵来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Next time I'll stay in control. Keep out of Wyrm form. Dethrone the little bastard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 下次我一定控制住自己，绝不变成魇龙，然后把那个小混蛋赶下王座。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: One more second of that miserable bloody singing and I'll go to the edge and jump off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 再让我听一秒那难听的破歌，我就直接从悬崖上跳下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Again and again I lose myself, and devastation follows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我一次又一次地迷失自我，随之而来的只有毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Did you come to mock me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你是来嘲笑我的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: If you dare come to me with pity, I shall throw it back in your face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你要是敢来怜悯我，我绝对不会领这个情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Do you see the marks his anger left on the land?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你看到他的怒火在大地上留下的烙印了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I weep for ownerless toys, and empty chairs. Letters unsent and love long forgotten. Should I weep for you, too?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我会为无人认领的玩具、空荡的座椅、未寄出的信，以及被遗忘已久的爱落泪。我也该为你落泪吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Bombastine envies me. The King's Favorite. He wishes we could trade places. So do I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 蓬蓬士君嫉妒我是国王的宠儿，他巴不得能和我互换身份。而我也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: If the Void truly preserves consciousness… then there is no hope of an end!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 如果虚空真的会让意识永存……那我们便永无解脱之日！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I was created to be Sorrow. Written into being. To serve as a lesson. Can that change?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我生来便是「悲伤」的化身，由文字塑造，只为成为一则警示。这样的命运，还能改变吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I have known happiness. Even love. I shall not speak of it. I shall only sing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我也曾幸福过，甚至爱过。但我不会诉说，只会用歌声把一切吟唱出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: The fish never complains of the salt of the sea, for it is all he has ever known. But I? I cannot forget what once was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 鱼儿从不抱怨海水的苦涩，因为那是它唯一知晓的世界。可我呢？我无法忘记曾经的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: We've all experienced unpleasantness, but that's no reason to dwell upon it! Chin up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 谁没遇上过糟心事呀？可老揪着不放也没用！打起精神来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Nothing puts one's woes in perspective like helping people who REALLY need it! People with REAL worries!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 去帮帮那些真正有难处的人吧！跟他们一比，你这点烦恼根本算不了什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: People need to understand that unhappiness is a choice! A little exercise sees me right as rain!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 大家都得明白，不开心只是一种选择！我稍微运动一下，立马就神清气爽了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: People complain about Thrax doing this horrible thing, or that horrible thing. But what about all the good? It's never boring! Have they stopped to think of that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 大家总是抱怨士魂大帝做了这样、那样的坏事。但好的一面呢？起码这儿从不无聊呀！他们就不会换个角度想想吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I know, I know, the Dax are bullies and the weather is apocalyptic. But at least no one's died! Today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我知道，我知道，禁卫总是横行霸道，天气也动不动就像世界末日。可还没闹出人命呀！至少今天没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Yes yes I know being persecuted can be difficult, but try living with someone who won't stop going on about it. Positive thinking! That's the way!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 好啦，好啦，我知道受迫害的日子不好过，可成天听人念叨这事也不轻松呀。凡事往好处想！这才对嘛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: A smile is like a yawn. Someone does it and pretty soon you're doing it yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 笑容就像哈欠，是会传染的。看到别人笑了，你自己也会跟着笑起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: If you're at a loose end, you can always help Koral take care of her animal friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 要是闲着没事，可以去帮小珊瑚照顾她的动物朋友呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I always swear I will not indulge in that horrid… wyrm behavior… But I just get so. Very. Very. Very. Happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我总发誓，说再也不要变成那副可怕的魇龙模样……可我就是觉得，真的、真的、真的好快乐呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: People are so keen to write me off. As if I don't have the hardest job of any of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 大家总爱小瞧我，好像我们几个里，就我的活儿最轻松似的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: You certainly make old Teshin happy. Perhaps one day he'll even tell you that himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你肯定让老泰辛很开心。说不定哪天，他会亲口告诉你呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: To the Void with you, Fergin! The King says I can play as loud as I like! What I wouldn't give to hear his grumpy old voice again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 滚去虚空吧，弗金！国王说了我爱弹多响就弹多响！要是能再听一回他那又老又破的嗓音，要我做什么都行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: You ever gonna make that move? He's never coming back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 这棋你到底还走不走？呵呵！唉，他永远回不来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: "You ever do requests? You do? Go to the edge and jump!" That's what he'd say. Every day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 「你接受点歌吗？行？那我要……你从悬崖上跳下去！」他以前总这么说，天天都说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: "Komi is for true Orokin! Shawzin's nothing but a Dax toy!" Ah, he was full of himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 「真正的奥罗金人会下围棋！三线琴不过是禁卫用来消遣的玩具！」唉，他可真把自己当回事儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: You know what he'd say to me? "You think you're making Father proud? Playing Shawzin all day?" Like I was nothing but a loafer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你知道他以前怎么数落我吗？「你成天弹这破三线琴，你爹能为你自豪吗？」唉，说得好像我是个游手好闲的废物一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Real exciting game you got going on over there! He was there every day. Then one day, he just wasn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你那盘棋可真刺激！他以前每天都守在那。然后有一天，他就再也没出现过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: What was that, Fergin? Can't hear you over the crowds! I keep thinking I'm gonna look up and see him scowling across at me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你说什么，弗金？观众太吵，我听不见！我总觉得，只要一抬头，就会看见他坐在对面，皱着眉瞪我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I've got an audience! I don't see anyone lining up to play Komi with you! Every day it feels like a little bit more of this place is lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我这儿可有观众！怎么没见谁排着队找你下围棋啊？！感觉这地方，每天都在一点一点消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Oh really? Why don't you come over here and say that to my FACE? I know just what he'd say to that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 哦是吗？有种就过来当着我的面再说一遍！唉，我连他会怎么回嘴都能想到，呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: This one's for you, Fergin! He hated my music. Hated me, too. Void, I miss him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 这首歌送给你，弗金！他讨厌我的曲子，也讨厌我。虚空在上，我好想他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: "Shuddup," he would say. "Who taught you to play, a kaithe's arse?" Now all I hear is this shawzin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 「闭嘴。」他总这么说。「谁教你弹的，跟绝灵骥的腚学的吗？」可现在，我耳边只剩三线琴的琴声了。唉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: We're both more dangerous than we look you and I. Keep your distance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我们俩都比看上去危险得多，所以离我远点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Were you followed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 没人跟着你吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Keep your hands where I can see them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 把手放在我看得见的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: You don't know me. You have no idea what I'm capable of!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 你根本不了解我，也不知道我的能耐！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Beetles in the earth. Biting oh-so-gently. Tunneling. Up through my skin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 泥土里的甲虫，轻轻地啃咬，一点点往上钻，就快从我的皮肤里钻出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I've seen them. The black-eyed children. Pointing at me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我见过那些黑眼睛的孩子们，他们用手指着我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: The first scholar looked into the Void and he feared it. And his fear took shape. Do you understand? That's how all this started!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 第一位学者凝视着虚空，感到了恐惧。于是他的恐惧化作了实体。你明白吗？这一切就是这么开始的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: I can't stay in here forever. I'll starve. Get bitten. Catch the swarming rot. Little eggs under my eyelids!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 我不能永远躲在这里。我会饿死，会被咬，会染上腐病……眼皮底下还会长满虫卵！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Listen! There. Did you hear it? Rap. Tap. Tap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 听！那边……听见了吗？哒、哒、哒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.text: Not safe here. They'll find me. Her with her carriage. Always nosing around. Got to move. Find a new place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DGenBar.zhText: 这里不安全，他们迟早会找到我。那个坐马车的女人也总在四处打探……得赶紧走，另找个地方躲起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAb.text: Hey, hey! Where you going? You're no better than the stupid Tamms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAb.zhText: 喂，喂！你去哪儿啊？你跟那群蠢塔塔羊也没什么两样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAb.text: What? So you're going to wander away too? Just my luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAb.zhText: 什么？连你也要跑掉？我真够倒霉的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAc.text: Think they'll listen to you??? Love to see that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAc.zhText: 你觉得它们会听你的？那我倒想看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAc.text: Go ahead, but I don't even think Brimon could get those Tamms back into their pen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAc.zhText: 去试试吧。不过我看，就算布瑞蒙也没法把那些塔塔羊赶回圈里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAc.text: Get them back into the pen… PLEASE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdAc.zhText: 把它们赶回羊圈里去……拜托了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.text: HEY. Get over here you dumb beast. No, here. No. Come… ahhhh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.zhText: 喂！给我过来，你这蠢东西！不对，来这边。不是！过来……呃啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.text: YOU WANT TO GET EATEN. FINE. WALK AWAY. SEE IF I CARE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.zhText: 你就这么想被吃掉是吧？行！走吧！谁稀罕管你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.text: Barris, herd the Tamms. Barris, the Tamms have wandered off again. Barris, why aren't you watching the Tamms. Ugh… I never asked be a stupid shepherd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.zhText: 「小板栗，去赶塔塔羊。小板栗，塔塔羊又跑远了。小板栗，你怎么没看好塔塔羊？」呃……我才不想当个蠢兮兮的牧羊人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.text: HEY! Do you want to fall into the sky??? Wish you would, you straw-brained Tamm. UGHGH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdId.zhText: 喂！你是想一头栽进天空里吗？巴不得你真栽下去，你这草包塔塔羊。呃啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdRe.text: UGH. Stupid Tamms are out again. They won't come when called but I'm the one who gets in trouble when they get lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdRe.zhText: 呃，愚蠢的塔塔羊又跑出去了。怎么叫都不听，可要是它们走丢，最后挨骂的却是我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdRe.text: Being a shepherd is so… dumb. I'm no good at this. Why do I have to do this dumb job anyway?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdRe.zhText: 当牧羊人真是……太蠢了。我根本干不来这个。凭什么非得让我干这种蠢差事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdRe.text: Are they trying to get themselves eaten by Krubies?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdRe.zhText: 它们是巴不得被库贝吃掉吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSi.text: That was one of the smart ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSi.zhText: 那算是比较聪明的一只了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSi.text: Gee… You're kinda good at this.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSu.text: Woah. How did you get them to follow you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSu.zhText: 哇，你怎么让它们乖乖跟着你的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSu.text: What did you say to them?
Okay. I'll try to do it just like you next time. Thanks!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DHerdSu.zhText: 好吧，下次我也照你这样试试。谢啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Oh my, they seem to have friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 哎呀，他们好像还叫了帮手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: You'll just have to dispatch these fellows too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 看来这些人也得劳烦你一并打发了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: My, my. They are hostile aren't they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 哎呀呀，他们可真蛮横，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Bravo, what a show. Time for an encore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 太棒了，真是一场好戏。看来还得再演一幕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: I hoped that was the last of them, alas, no.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 我还盼着那是最后一个。可惜，不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Very efficient. At this rate, I'll be home for supper. What to make?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 效率惊人。照这个速度，我还能赶回家吃晚饭。今晚做什么菜好呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: I never doubted you'd show up. Not for a second.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 我就知道你会来，我一秒都没怀疑过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Ah! There you are! Might I bother you for a spot of assistance?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 啊！你可算来了！能劳烦你稍微搭把手吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Ah ha! Right on time. Be a love and help a fellow out? I appear to have been captured.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 啊哈！来得正好。行行好，帮我一把？我好像……不小心被抓了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: And behold: someone has come along to free me, as I said they would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 瞧吧，果然有人来救我了。我早就说过会有人来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Your task, which I'm sure you will fulfill admirably, is to ensure my freedom from these… ne'er-do-wells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 接下来就拜托你了。当然，我相信你一定能出色完成任务，把我从这些……歹徒手里解救出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: A favor: rescue me, so that my one and only head may remain attached to the shoulders which you see before you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 咳咳，拜托，帮个忙，救我出去，好让我这颗独一无二的脑袋，能待在它该在的肩膀上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: As there seems to be some sort of misunderstanding. Can I implore you to clear things up with my captors?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 这中间肯定有什么误会。能请你和抓我的人好好「解释」一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Please, persuade these brutes to set me free. I told you someone would be along to help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 拜托，去「说服」这些粗人放了我吧。我早告诉过你们，会有人来救我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Very much obliged, oh hand of fate. Cheerio!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 万分感谢，命运之手。告辞啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: And, thanks to your timely intercession I shall be on my way. Ta rah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 多亏你及时出手，我这就告辞了。回见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Wonderful. Funny how things always seem to work out, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 棒极了哈哈。事情最后总会顺利解决，还真有意思，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: Handily done, friend of mine! Until next time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 干得好，我的朋友！下次再见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: A superfluous demonstration of competence! I would expect nothing less!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 哈哈，好一番游刃有余的身手！果然没让我失望！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.text: And that… would appear… to be that! Wonderful! Until next you are needed, my little good luck charm!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DPrison.zhText: 如此看来，事情就……全部解决了！棒极了哈哈！下次需要你时再见，我的小福星！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceAc.text: Beat my time? That's rich. Love it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceAc.zhText: 想打破我的纪录？真会说笑。我喜欢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceFa.text: No shame in losing to the best, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceFa.zhText: 输给最强的人也没什么好丢脸的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceFa.text: Is there nobody capable of challenging me, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceFa.zhText: 难道就没人能挑战我了吗？
哇，差一点就赢我了。就差那么一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceFa.text: Chin up. You'll do better next time. Hopefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceFa.zhText: 振作一点，下次你说不定能跑得更好。但愿吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.text: My best course yet, my best time yet. Neither Dax nor demon can beat me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.zhText: 这是我迄今为止用时最短，表现最佳的赛道。无论是禁卫还是恶魔，都休想赢我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.text: Mathila says I'm both handsome and swift. Is it true? Oh it's not for me to say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.zhText: 玛蒂拉说我人又俊，马又快，这是真的吗？哎呀，这我可不好自己夸自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.text: I'm pretty handy with a blade myself. Makes the Dax jealous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.zhText: 我的刀法也相当利落。那些禁卫可嫉妒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.text: You handle a Kaithe like you've done it countless times before. Reminds me of myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.zhText: 你驾驭绝灵骥的样子，简直像是身经百战的老手。让我想起了我自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.text: Bombastine tried racing me once. He didn't try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.zhText: 蓬蓬士君跟我赛过一次。后来就再也没来比过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.text: You, um, ever wonder why Mathila's so happy…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.zhText: 你，呃……有没有想过，玛蒂拉为什么总是那么开心？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.text: This is MY favorite course but there is no shame in YOU finding it too challenging.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceId.zhText: 这是我最喜欢的赛道。不过你要是觉得太难，也别觉得难为情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceMi.text: By the king, you are fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceMi.zhText: 我的大帝啊，你跑得真快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceMi.text: Not bad. Not bad at all.
Dear me, have you been practicing?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.text: I get it, why race when you know you can't win?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.zhText: 我懂。明知道赢不了，那还比什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.text: I say. You. Fancy yourself a rider? A wager, then! Impress me and I'll help you out. What do you say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.zhText: 喂，你觉得自己骑术不错？那咱们打个赌吧！拿出点真本事让我开开眼，我就帮你个忙。怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.text: Beat the best or wallow with rest. Care for a race, Drifter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.zhText: 要么打败最强者，要么堕入平庸。敢不敢比一场，漂泊者？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.text: Name's Brimon. Fastest Kaithe rider in the Kingdom. If you think you're faster. Prove it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceRe.zhText: 我叫布瑞蒙，王境里最快的绝灵骥骑手。如果你觉得自己比我快，那就证明给我看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSt.text: Best of luck. You'll need it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSt.zhText: 祝你好运。你可得靠点运气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSu.text: What? That's impos- DAH. Fine. A little something for your trouble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSu.zhText: 什么？这不可能……啊！行吧，拿去，算你的辛苦费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSu.text: HOW? I've raced that course a million… Oh very well, take this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSu.zhText: 怎么会？这条赛道我都跑过无数……唉，行吧，拿去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSu.text: Dahh… That was...impressive. Here, this is for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DRaceSu.zhText: 啊……刚才你确实厉害。来，这个给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: My grandfather had a saying. In a fight, anger is as good as courage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 我祖父常说，临阵对敌，愤怒与勇气同等重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: The skies are burning today. There will be conflict in your path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 今日天火燎原，你此行免不了一场恶战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Do not mistake anger for petty spite. Only one of them may be righteous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 别把愤怒与狭隘的怨恨混为一谈。愤怒有时源于正义，但怨恨从来不是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Hmm. You have fire in your eyes today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 嗯，今天你眼中燃着一团火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Remember, only a fool seeks to stifle his anger. It is the loyal bodyguard of conscience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 记住，只有愚者才会压抑自己的愤怒。愤怒，是良知最忠诚的卫士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Trained by a Sentient over a Dax! Is it any wonder things fell out as they did? I could have done so much more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 教你们的偏偏是 Sentient，不是禁卫！难怪后来会落到这一步。要是换我教，绝不会如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: If you coveted anything in this world, Drifter, I would hope you had the courage to go and win it for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 漂泊者，若你渴望得到这世上的某样东西，我希望你有勇气凭自己的本事去争取。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Ambition braces the soul. Envy only embitters it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 雄心能使人意志坚定，嫉妒只会让内心愈发苦涩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: There is a rankness in the air today, Drifter. The sour entitlement of spoiled children.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 今天空气里弥漫着一股酸臭味，漂泊者。那是被宠坏的孩子身上，令人作呕的优越感。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Bombastine will be abroad today. A petty man hiding behind a mask of ingratiating smiles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 蓬蓬士君今天会外出。他就是个躲在谄媚笑容背后的小人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Every time you leave this cave, I fear it will be the last time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 每次你走出这座洞穴，我都怕那会是最后一次见你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Fear kills you twice. First in the mind, and only later in the body. So arm your mind well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 恐惧会杀死你两次。第一次是心智，随后才是肉身。所以，务必武装好你的心智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: "Be hearty therefore, and cautious in your speech. For one who speaks his fear aloud to his comrades before the fight is like unto a cupbearer bringing poison."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 「所以，要坚定心志，也要谨慎言辞。临战前将自己的恐惧说给战友听，无异于为他们奉上一杯毒酒。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: It is good to see you. My dreams were… not wholesome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 能见到你真好。我的梦境……让人心神不宁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Go out into Duviri and fear nothing you find, for the most fearsome being in all Duviri should be you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 去吧，踏入双衍王境，无须畏惧任何遭遇。因为这片土地上最可怕的存在，应当是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: I believe… the years weigh a little lighter on me today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 我觉得……今天岁月压在我身上的重担，似乎轻了几分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: I woke to the sound of the shawzin. Was that you, or my dream?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 我在三线琴声中醒来。是你在弹奏吗，还是我仍在梦中？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: A man spends his joy freely in his youth. In his old age he must hoard what little he has left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 人在年少时总是肆意挥霍快乐。到了晚年，就只能把仅剩的那点喜悦小心珍藏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: (humming Smiles from Juran)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: (哼唱着《朱兰笑》)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: One may chase after happiness through the fields all day like a fool, only to have it alight on one's open hand without warning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 人或许会像个傻瓜一样，整日在原野上追逐幸福。却不曾想，它会在不经意间，悄然落入你张开的掌心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: Valeria...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 瓦莱里娅……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: There is too much I should have set right. The chance will never come again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 有太多的事情，我本该去弥补。可那样的机会，再也不会有了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: "I am bound for the Inn at the End of Days. Death awaits me like a faithful Yaskutai. See, the warming glass is prepared."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 「我要去往终焉客栈。死亡如忠诚的管家，早已在那里等候。看，暖酒也斟好了。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: This leaden day is too much to bear alone. Do not go solitary if you can help it, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 这般沉重的日子，不该独自承受。可以的话，别一个人撑着，我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.text: The heavy heart is all too eager to embrace wounding lies. Truth may hurt, but what hurts is not always true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Duviri/DTeshin.zhText: 心情沉重时，人最容易把伤人的谎言当真。真相或许伤人，但伤人的话未必是真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Tenno seek to assist you. The weapon they have sent is inelegant, but devastating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: Tenno 想助你一臂之力。他们送来的武器虽算不上精巧，威力却十分惊人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A Tenno archgun has manifested. They must feel the situation is truly desperate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: Tenno 送来了一把曲翼枪械。看来他们也认为，局势已经万分危急。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Through the Paradox, the Tenno have sent a formidable weapon. Let us hope it turns the tide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: Tenno 借助悖论送来了一件威力非凡的武器。但愿它能扭转战局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: An enemy that cannot retreat is the most dangerous, for they have nothing left to lose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 无路可退的敌人最为危险，因为他们必定会拼死一搏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: This ruin offers little shelter. Stay mobile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这个废墟的掩体有限。注意走位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The beast is cornered. Wear it down, but be alert. Wyrms have many tricks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 魇龙已被逼入绝境。继续削弱它，但别放松警惕。魇龙诡计多端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Don't hate me because I'm beautiful!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 别因为我的美貌就心生嫉妒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You provoke me at your peril!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 惹我就是在自找苦吃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Don't follow me. This is NOT your concern.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 别再跟着我了，这不关你的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Chase me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 来追我呀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Stop following me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 别再跟着我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I see you, chasing me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看到你了，还在追我呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You play with fire, fool!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蠢货，你这是在玩火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: This is futile. Stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 没有用的，停下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You can't catch me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你追不上我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I know what you're planning!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我知道你想干什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You wish you were this fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你也想像我这么快吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You would goad a DRAGON?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你竟敢挑衅魇龙？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Leave me alone. No further warnings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 离我远点，否则后果自负。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Look how big I am!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看看你多渺小！哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You don't have to do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你没必要这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You're beneath me and you always will be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你永远都只能仰望我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: For this shall you lament and repent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你会为此悔恨终生！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You are only making things worse!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你只会让事情变得更糟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Well? Come on, then!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦？那就放马过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Get back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 别过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'll devour everything that makes you, you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要把你连皮带骨，全部吞掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Will you just PISS OFF?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你能不能滚到一边儿去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I feel you will regret this rashness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我预感，你会为这种鲁莽的行为付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I feel radiant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我感觉自己光芒四射！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh Void, oh no. Oh nononono!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 虚空啊……不，哦不不不不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'll take your face and make it my new mask!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要撕下你的脸皮，做成我的新面具！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You cross a deadly line, fool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蠢货，你这是在找死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You have suffered. You shall suffer again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你曾饱受苦难。如今，苦难将再次降临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Yes! YES! Release your negativity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 对！对！把坏情绪全发泄出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Get them away from me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 让他们离我远点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Well, aren't you persistent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 呵，还真是纠缠不休。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A FATAL mistake, as you will soon LEARN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 自寻死路，马上就让你知道厉害！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Tuneless, tone-deaf ingrates!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 一群五音不全、不懂欣赏的音盲！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Growth through conflict!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 百炼才能成钢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax! Majesty! HELP MEEE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 士魂大帝！陛下！快救救我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What enviable determination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 多么让人羡慕的决心呐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You've had your fun. Now I have MINE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你玩够了，现在该轮到我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I will no longer be victim to your pathetic cruelty!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我不会再任你这般残忍地伤害我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Keep going! I am LOVING this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 继续呀！我爱死这种感觉了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: There's no way out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这里根本没有出路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: This is not a free ride.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这便车可不是白搭的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You! DARE?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你！好大的胆子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Another burden.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 又来个累赘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh, that tickles!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哎呀，好痒啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Augh! It's crawling on me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 呃啊！它在我身上爬！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: No hangers-on!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 别赖在我身上不走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Aagh! Begone, vermin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 呃啊！滚开，臭虫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I will not carry you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我可不会带着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You'd better hold tight!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你最好抓紧喽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: No! Please! Don't hurt me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 不！求求你！别伤害我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Off you get, leech.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 给我滚下去，吸血虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Miserable! TICK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 该死的吸血虫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I will make you regret this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我会让你后悔的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: And where do you think you're going?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你以为自己能逃到哪儿去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I... I don't want this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我……我不想这样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Get your filthy hands off me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 把你的脏手从我身上拿开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Off! OFF!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 滚开！给我滚开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Enough!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 够了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh no you don't!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 不，你想都别想！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Eurgh, its fingers are like slugs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 呃，它的手指就像鼻涕虫一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: IT'S NOT FAIIIIRRR!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这不公平！凭什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'M BURNING!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 烧死我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: WE ARE UNITED!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我们已经融为一体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: IT'S SO BEAUTIFUL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 太美妙了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I KNEW IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我就知道！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Did SHE put you up to this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 是她指使你这么做的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You mock me for the last time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这是你最后一次羞辱我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Misery shall have company. I swear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我发誓，定要让你陪我受尽苦难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Are you as excited as I am?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你也和我一样兴奋吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Got to get OUT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 必须逃出去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: This isn't fair! I deserve this victory!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这不公平！这场胜利本该属于我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Your confidence is misplaced!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哈哈哈 你自信过头了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You should have fled while you still could!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你早该在还能脱身时逃命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Nearly got you there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 就差一点点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What happened to my legs? What happened to ME?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我的腿怎么了？到底怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You wouldn't take these liberties with any OTHER wyrm!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你对其他魇龙，可不敢这么放肆！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'll pound you to a sodding paste! Just wait!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要把你碾成一摊肉泥！呵！给我等着！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I shall provide you with reasons aplenty to mourn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我会让你尝尽悲痛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Am I going too easy on you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我是不是太手下留情了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'm going to be trapped in this ugly form forever and ever!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要永远被困在这副丑陋的躯壳里了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Don't you DARE deny me this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这场胜利本该属于我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'll grab you by the heels and smash your shitty brains out on a rock!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要抓着你的脚踝，把你的破脑袋在石头上砸个稀巴烂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Back into the pit with you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 滚回你的深渊去吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Come on! You can do it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 来啊！你可以的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'll drag you down with me! Don't think I won't!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要拉你一起陪葬！别以为我做不出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: WHAT DO YOU WANT FROM ME?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你究竟想怎样？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: THIS IS THE ABSOLUTE LIMIT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 到此为止了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: SORROW WILL DEVOUR YOU, BONES AND ALL.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 悲伤会将你连皮带骨彻底吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I SHALL ENGULF YOU WITH MY JOY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要让喜悦将你彻底淹没！哈哈哈哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'M DYING! DYYYYING!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要死了！要死了啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: YOU WON'T TAKE MY VICTORY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你休想夺走我的胜利！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: YOU BROUGHT THIS ON YOURSELF!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这都是你自找的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: YOUR EFFORTS ARE WASTED. SORROW IS ETERNAL.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你的努力皆为徒劳。悲伤永不会消逝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: LET ME SEE THAT SMILE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 来！笑一个！哈哈哈哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: YOU'LL BE IN HERE WITH ME FOR ETERNITY! IS THAT WHAT YOU WANT?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你会和我一起被永远困在这里！这就是你想要的结果吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: YOU KNOW I'M BETTER THAN YOU! AND YOU HATE IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你明知道我比你强！你就是嫉妒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: BASTARDS! MISERABLE CONNIVING BASTARDS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 畜生！卑鄙无耻的杂种！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: THIS PAIN WILL PASS. YOURS WILL NOT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我的痛苦终将消散。而你的，永远不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: OH, RAPTURE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦，太美妙了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: DISGUSTING LITTLE MANIKINS ALL OVER ME! AAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我浑身上下都爬满了这些恶心的小人偶！呃啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'M WINNING TODAY AND THAT'S FINAL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 今天赢的人是我！就这么定了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: RIGHT! THAT'S IT! THAT'S THE END!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 好！够了！一切到此为止啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: ALL HEARTS CAN BREAK. EVEN YOURS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 每颗心都会破碎，你的也不例外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: SUCH CATHARSIS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 真是痛快极了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'm so scared I'm so scared I'M SO SCARED
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我好怕，好怕……我真的好怕！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'll see she never sings again. It was ME that gave her that voice... it's I who deserve the stage, not that ungrateful harpy! Me, me, me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我要让她永远无法再开口唱歌。是我赐予了她那副嗓音……有资格站上舞台的人是我，而不是那个忘恩负义的妖女！是我，是我，只能是我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I was the rightful heir, but the boy was chosen... why is this always happening to me? What is wrong with me? Am I not... GOOD ENOUGH FOR ALL OF YOU?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我明明才是名正言顺的继承人，可他们选中的却是那个小屁孩……为什么这种破事总发生在我身上？我到底哪里不够好？难道我就……永远入不了你们的眼吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It's too much! The sadness - nobody else can bear it like I can. They aren't strong enough! It's me. It has to be me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 太沉重了！这份悲伤……除了我，没有人承受得住。他们都不够坚强！只能是我，必须由我来承受！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I tried! So help me, I tried! I have all this JOY in my SOUL and yet when I try to SHARE IT, NOBODY WANTS TO KNOW! WELL, TRY IGNORING ME NOW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我努力过了！我发誓，我真的努力过了！我的灵魂里明明装满了喜悦，可每当我想要分享它的时候，根本没人在乎！哈哈哈哈哈，那好啊，这回我看你们还怎么无视我！哈哈哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You! You were never on my side to start with, were you? All along you've been plotting with them... siding with them... preparing to betray me! IT'S TIME FOR YOU TO BE AFRAID!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你！你从一开始就没站在我这边，对不对？一直以来你都在跟他们串通一气……时刻准备背叛我！现在，该轮到你害怕了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It's not fair! The things I did were supposed to break her, not make her his favorite! I was meant to be the one who was loved! Me! IT'S NOT FAAAAAIR!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这不公平！我做的那些事明明该毁了她，怎么反倒让她成了他的宠儿！那个备受宠爱的人本该是我！是我！这不公平！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I could have been a good King! But I'll never get the chance, because they HATE ME! EVERYONE HATES ME! WELL, GUESS WHAT? I HATE MYSELF MORE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我本来可以成为一位好国王的！但我永远没有机会了，因为他们都恨我！所有人都讨厌我！可你知道吗？我比任何人都更憎恶自己！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'm sorry! I dragged you into this... this spiral... and now I've just doomed us both! It's too much!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 很抱歉！是我让你卷入了这个……这个螺旋里。现在咱们俩都完了！我……我承受不住了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I get it! I do! You all want Happiness, but none of you wants to put in the work! DO YOU THINK THIS BEAUTIFUL LIGHT IN MY HEART JUST GOT THERE BY ITSELF? DO YOU??
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我明白！我真的明白！你们都渴望幸福，但是没有人愿意付出努力！哈哈哈 你以为我心里这道美丽的光芒是凭空冒出来的吗？是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Who are you? Who are you really? Why do I hear whispers in my head when I look at you? WHY ARE YOUR EYES LIKE THAT?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你是谁？你到底是什么人？为什么我一看见你，脑子里就响起那些低语？你的眼睛为什么会是那样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Orowyrm cannot be subdued out in the open. Use the Orvius and find a way to force it back to its lair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 在开阔地带无法彻底制服奥金魇龙。借助灵枢，想办法把它逼回巢穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: To tame a wild kaithe, it must be ridden. The Orowyrm is no different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 要驯服野生绝灵骥，先得骑到它背上。奥金魇龙也不例外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You have control. Cut the ties that bind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你已经能驾驭它了，去斩断束缚的枷锁吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Now, use the beast. Destroy Thrax's bonds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 现在，利用这头魇龙，去切断士魂大帝的枷锁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: For too long, have I been denied the recognition I deserve. Look at these yokels: agog to hear my latest play. Here: deliver the manuscript.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 长久以来，我始终得不到应有的赏识。瞧瞧那些乡巴佬，一个个都翘首盼着我最新剧作。喏，把这份手稿给他们送去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I've written that impish brat of a King an ultimatum. You! Deliver it! IN PERSON!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我给那个乳臭未干的小国王写了封最后通牒。你！亲自给他送过去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: These are the ashes of someone dear to me. Someone... gone from me. I beseech you: take them to their final rest? I cannot bear the loss one moment longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这是我一位挚爱之人的骨灰，一个已经离我而去的人。我恳求你，将这骨灰送往最后的安息之地，好吗？这份失去之痛，我一刻也承受不下去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Party invitations! Splendid! Best deliver them as quickly as you might.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 派对邀请！太好了！抓紧把它们送出去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I found this in one of the crypts. It's put a curse on me, I know it! I need to you take it to a safe place and leave it there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我在一个墓穴中找到了这个。它肯定诅咒我了，我知道！你得把它带去一个安全的地方，把它留在那。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I have written a letter explaining Luscinia's TRUE character for those who need to know. Deliver it. I'll see that songbird roasted yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我写了一封信，向那些该知道真相的人揭露路西尼娅的真面目。把它送出去。早晚有一天，我要让那只唱歌的鸟儿彻底完蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Here! The proofs of my royal ancestry! Take them where they need to go!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 拿着！这是我拥有王室血统的铁证！把它们送到该送的地方去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I have written down my memories of life under Thrax, so even if I perish, the truth shall not. Take it to a safe place for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我已经记录下了我在士魂大帝统治下的种种经历。这样即使我死去，真相也不会随之消逝。请帮我把它带到一个安全的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Be a dear and run these cake recipes over to the needful souls on the other side of Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 能不能辛苦你跑一趟，把这些蛋糕食谱送给双衍王境另一头那些需要它们的人，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Acrithis lent me these books. She said they came from the Scholar himself. Bad things in them. Void things. You need to take them away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这些书是言录使借给我的。她说这都是那位学者本人留下的。里面记着可怕的事情，虚空里的事情。快把它们拿走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You will run errands for absolutely anyone, won't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看来谁都能把你使唤得团团转啊，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I find myself bored. Execute somebody. Anyone will do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 本王有些无聊了。拖个人出去处决吧，随便谁都行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Straight ahead, keep going, off the edge of the world, can't miss it, goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 一直往前走，别停，从世界的边缘跳下去，路就在那儿，再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Those sentries look down on me. "There goes Bombastine," they say. "Fire a shot over his head and watch him jump!" Well, today, you're taking them down to MY level.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些哨兵根本瞧不起我。「看呐，蓬蓬士君走过去啦，」他们嘲笑说，「朝他头顶开一枪，看他吓得抱头鼠窜！」好，今天就把他们打到跟我平起平坐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Smug Dax sentries sitting up there, thinking they're safe. Never been in a real fight in their rotten lives! Go and batter the hell out of them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那帮自以为是的禁卫哨兵躲在高处，还以为自己很安全。他们这辈子根本没打过一场硬仗！去把那帮杂碎给我往死里打！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: From their high perch cruel Dax led by a cruel King ruin and victimize all. Justice is unknown in this cold place, yet I beg: cast them down. For once let THEM be the ones to mourn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些禁卫盘踞高处，在残暴国王的率领下肆意摧残、欺凌众生。这片冰冷之地从不知正义为何物，但我求你……把他们从高处打落。这一次，让他们也尝尝哀痛的滋味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: When you have a heart full of light, toxic people can be SO irritating. Arrogant sentries, for example. I think you'd learn a lot from teaching them some manners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 当你心里充满阳光时，那些满身戾气的人就格外惹人心烦。就比如那些傲慢的哨兵。去教教他们规矩吧，你一定能从中受益匪浅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It makes your flesh creep. Walking under those towers. Knowing a Dax could pick you off any time he wanted. I can't stand it! You have to clear them out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 从那些高塔底下经过，光是想到禁卫随时都能一枪把你放倒，就让人浑身发毛。我受不了了！快把他们清理掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Ah! I know those Dax. They're the ones that like to use me as a target in their spitting contests. Even the score, would you? Oh, I've dreamed of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 啊！我认识那些禁卫。他们以前总喜欢在吐痰比赛里拿我当靶子。你能帮我报仇吗？哈哈哈哈哈，我做梦都盼着这一天！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Nothing galls my arse like the sight of a Dax sentry lording it over the rest of us from on high. Up you go. Beat them to a pulp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 最让我火大的，就是看那些禁卫哨兵高高在上地对我们颐指气使！给我上去，把他们揍成肉泥！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The King watches me... day and night. The Dax... the ones in the high towers... they are the King's eyes. Blind him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 国王日夜监视着我。那些高塔上的禁卫……就是他的眼睛。去让他再也看不见我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Some people really do think they are above others! I'm hesitant to send you into this combat experience at this stage of your personal journey, but it's for the best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有些人还真觉得自己高人一等！以你目前所处的成长阶段，我其实不想让你经历这样的战斗，但这是最好的安排。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Urgh. Watchful eyes always looking down at you. Making your skin crawl. Get rid of those sentries!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 呃，总有双眼睛从高处死死盯着你，让你头皮发麻。快把那些哨兵除掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: All it requires is one fortunate shot, and your Drifting days are over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哪怕只要一枪侥幸命中，你漂泊的日子就到头了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Pointless. You remain massively outnumbered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 白费力气，你依然寡不敌众。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh, dear. I lost a sentry post. I may wet myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哎呀，丢了一座哨塔，本王都快吓尿了呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: One day, so I swear, your head shall adorn that very tower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 本王发誓，总有一天，你的脑袋会挂在那座塔上示众。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The dwelling should be rightfully mine, obviously! We shall claim it, you and I. And if the Dax object, give them your worst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这处宅子理应归我！你我得联手，把它夺回来。要是那些禁卫敢有意见，就让他们吃不了兜着走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That imp knows that I am the rightful heir. His minions have murdered my sage and even now set fire to his records house. Therein are the laws of Duviri succession, soon to ash! Hurry! You must stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那小魔头清楚得很，我才是名正言顺的继承人！他的手下先杀了我的贤者，现在又要烧毁贤者的档案馆。双衍王境的继承法令都存放在里面，眼看就要化成灰烬了！快去阻止他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: This place... holds memories. Sweet ones, of a life that might have been. I can't bear to see the Dax swarming here. Dispatch them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这个地方……承载了太多回忆。那些我本可以拥有的，甜美的人生。我实在受不了那些禁卫在这里横行霸道。把他们给我全部铲除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'm going to need somewhere to run to. In case this all goes wrong. A place to hide. Yes. I know just the place. But they're already there. One step ahead of us. Keep it safe for me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我得给自己留条退路。万一事情出了岔子，还得有个地方藏身。对，我正好知道一个地方。可他们已经抢先到了。替我守好那里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Well. What was the point of that, exactly?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦，所以你折腾这一通，究竟图什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Allow me to assist your faltering recollection: Duviri is mine. I break what I like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 既然你记性不好，我就大发慈悲提醒你一句：双衍王境是我的。我想砸什么就砸什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: No amnesty for insurrectionists.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 叛党逆贼，绝不姑息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I am the King, and The King's word is LAW! Everybody knows that! Everybody!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我是国王，国王的话就是法律！人尽皆知！无人不晓！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You're pathetic and helpless, and nobody cares about you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你既可悲又无助，根本没人在乎你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You're getting nooo-wheeere! Anyone with half a brain would just give up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你根本就是在白费力气！但凡有点脑子的人，早就放弃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You were livestock. Slaughtered at my command every day. Why pretend you're anything else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你本来就是任本王宰割的牲畜。本王一声令下，你就得死。何必还要装模作样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Your struggles are always entertaining. But we both know they're useless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看你拼命挣扎，真是有趣。可你我都知道，这根本没有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Quickly, take the beast through the portal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 快，把魇龙赶进传送门！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Force the beast back to its domain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 逼它回到自己的领地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Force the creature through that portal. Only in its lair will it be vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 把魇龙赶进那道传送门。只有回到巢穴，它才会露出破绽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You will need my Orvius to challenge this Orowyrm. Find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你需要我的灵枢来挑战这条奥金魇龙。去找到它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Our mutual friend waits with my Orvius. If you desire to subdue this Orowyrm, take it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我们的老朋友正带着我的灵枢在等你。如果你想制服这条奥金魇龙，就拿走它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Orowyrm must be subdued, for that, I offer you my Orvius. The rest is up to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这条奥金魇龙非制服不可。我的灵枢交给你，接下来就看你的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bring it on! I never get tired of watching you die!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 来吧！无论你死多少次，本王都看不腻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh, Orowyrm? Looksee. Your main course just rang the dinner bell!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦，奥金魇龙？瞧，你的主菜自己送上门了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You really want to be crushed, burned and humiliated? Very well. I shall indulge your cravings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 既然你这么急着被碾碎、烧焦、受尽羞辱，本王就成全你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Good. Now, overcome its mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 很好。现在，让它听命于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You've mounted the beast, but are you in control?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你已经骑上了魇龙，但你能控制它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You are nothing more than a passenger. Seize control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你现在只是骑在它背上。让它听你号令，才算真正驾驭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Master the brute while you can!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 抓住机会，彻底将它驯服！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The spirits of the greedy dead rise, wanting me to return what is obviously mine! Well, I'm keeping IT ALL! You! Banish them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些贪得无厌的亡魂爬了出来，居然要我归还本就属于我的东西！呵，我一样都不会交出去！你！去把它们赶走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A legion of FARTY LITTLE ANCESTOR PHANTASMS is attempting to deny me my birthright. Some nonsense about ineligible bloodlines. Purge them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 一帮狗屁不如的上古阴魂，竟敢说我没资格继承王位，还扯什么血统不纯的鬼话。把它们统统给我清理掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The ghosts of my past will not let me rest. I sob and I scream and still they haunt me. Please! Banish these shades and let my soul live?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 往昔的幽魂不肯让我安宁。我哭也好，喊也好，它们还是阴魂不散。求你了！驱散这些幽影，给我的灵魂留一条生路好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Not everyone is strong enough to confront the darkness within. Are you going to keep putting it off, or are you going to take action?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 不是每个人都有勇气直面内心的黑暗。你是打算继续逃避下去，还是现在就行动？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: They're coming. Out of the ground. The unhallowed earth. Shadows. Moving. I can't look at them. MAKE THEM GO AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 它们来了，从地底，从那片不洁的土里爬出来了。那些影子……在动。我不敢看！快把它们赶走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: How the shades envy the living. Craving our life, our warmth. Sorry, ghostlings. I feel you, really I do, but I'm going to ask my friend here to put you down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些幽影是多么嫉妒生者，贪恋我们的生命与温暖。抱歉啦，小幽魂们。说真的，我很同情你们，但我还是得请这位朋友送你们上路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That gormless CHILD in the Palace is letting his night-terrors run free. While diddums slurps his cup of warm milk show them what a real nightmare looks like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 王宫里那个呆头呆脑的小屁孩竟然放任他的梦魇四处作乱。趁那个娇气包还在嘬热牛奶，让它们见识见识什么才叫真正的噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The 'King' has many petty demons. You are stronger than he. Tear them to shreds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那位「国王」身边尽是些卑劣的小鬼。你远比他强大，去把它们通通撕成碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It's time for you to face the shadows - oh, but don't be afraid. Everything is joy! You just have to be strong enough to see it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 是时候直面那些阴影了。哦，不过别害怕！世间万物都蕴藏着喜悦！只要你足够坚强，就一定能发现美好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: My own nightmares are bad enough. I don't want Thrax's crawling inside my head too. Kill them kill them KILL THEM!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我自己的噩梦已经够折磨人了，绝不能再让士魂大帝的噩梦钻进我脑子。杀了它们！杀了它们！全都杀了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mmm. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 嗯，谢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You do have your uses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看来你还是有点用处的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I should allow you to dispatch vermin more often.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看来本王该多让你去清理害虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Good luck getting rid of their stench.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 祝你能洗掉沾在身上的恶臭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Dax have been collecting tribute from the peasants. What about ME? I think you should collect tribute from THEM. I'll make better use of it, naturally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫一直在向农民征收贡品。那我的份呢？依我看，你该去向他们收收贡品了。毕竟这些东西在我手里才能真正派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh, that Imp has gone too damn far this time! He's had his Dax confiscate MY BELONGINGS! POUND THEM INTO THE DIRT AND GET MY GOODS BACK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那个小魔头这次实在欺人太甚！他竟敢让禁卫扣下我的东西！把他们往死里打，夺回属于我的东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Dax are guarding their pay chests. Blood money, every coin of it. Repay them for the misery they have caused.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫正守着他们的军饷箱，里面的每一枚钱币都沾满鲜血。去吧，让他们为自己的行为血债血偿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Find out what's inside this chest, and as you do, ask yourself: what painful truths am I locking up inside my own wounded soul?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看看这箱子里装着什么吧。顺便也问问你自己：在你那千疮百孔的灵魂深处，究竟锁着哪些痛苦的真相呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Listen. If I'm ever going to get out of here, set up someplace new, I'm going to need funds. Maybe...maybe you could find some Dax pay chests. They won't miss them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 听着，如果我要逃离这里，换个地方重新开始，我就得有钱。也许……你可以去翻翻禁卫的军饷箱。反正他们也不差这点钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: 'There goes raggle-taggle Bombastine, with nothing to his name but bad verses and bile!' Get me money, Drifter. I want to drip with gold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 「快看那个邋里邋遢的蓬蓬士君，除了那几句烂诗和一肚子怨气，他一无所有！」去给我弄些钱来，漂泊者。我要从头到脚都挂满黄金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'm the rightful king of Duviri, so the Imp's taxes are MY taxes. If these Dax have a PROBLEM with that, then you can make problems FOR them, can't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我才是双衍王境名正言顺的国王，所以小魔头征来的税，自然都该归我。要是那些禁卫敢找麻烦，你就给他们制造更大的麻烦，行吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax melted down my jewellery for coin to pay his thugs. Misery for misery. Let me see them dead. Whatever they have is yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 士魂大帝熔了我的珠宝，铸成钱币去赏赐他的打手。以牙还牙，苦债苦偿。我要亲眼看着他们死去。他们身上的一切都归你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sometimes joy is there for the taking, and sometimes nasty surprises lie in wait! You need to learn the difference. Not for me; for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有时候快乐就在眼前，有时候，等着你的却是讨厌的惊吓！你得学会分辨它们。不是为了我，是为了你自己！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You know what's in those chests the Dax are guarding? Evidence, that's what. I need it. Even if you have to go through them to get it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 知道那帮禁卫守着的箱子里有什么吗？是证据，我要拿到那些证据。哪怕得把他们通通杀光，也在所不惜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Peasant! Stupid thieving peasant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 贱民！愚蠢的窃贼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I shall retrieve that and tear off the thieving fingers that stole it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 本王会把东西夺回来，再把那几根偷东西的脏指头硬生生扯掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That is  not yours, you putrid dimwit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那不是你的，你个满身腐臭的白痴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You evince a sad desperation for all that is mine. Would it then please you, should I spit upon you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你觊觎本王东西的那副穷酸样，真是可悲。那本王若朝你吐口唾沫，岂不是正合你意？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Some days I yearn for the simple life of a farmer. No reason why I shouldn't HAVE that, of course. Why don't you round me up a herd of my own?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有时候，我也会向往农夫那种简单的生活。是啊，我没理由不能拥有。你能帮我圈一群属于我自己的牲畜吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You see how the Imp neglects his duties? Beasts left to roam at will, eating and shitting wherever they like! IT'S MADDENING! ROUND THOSE STINKING THINGS UP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 瞧见那个小魔头有多玩忽职守了吧？竟然放任那些畜生到处乱窜，随地吃喝拉撒！简直气死我了！快把那群臭东西赶回圈里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Poor lost Tamms. Where can their mistress be? It would be too sad a fate if the wolves took them. Round them up, good drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 可怜的塔塔羊迷路了。它们的主人去了哪里？若是落入狼群之口，那命运未免也太凄惨了。善良的漂泊者，把它们圈起来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Look. Tamms running wild. They'd be happier in the safety of a pen, and in their hearts they know it. So you can round them up with a clear conscience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 瞧，塔塔羊全都跑散了。它们心里也明白，待在安全的围栏里才会更快乐。所以放心把它们圈起来吧，完全不用内疚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Don't tell me Tamms are harmless. I've seen the way they look at me. All that CHEWING. Round them up and keep them away from me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 别跟我说塔塔羊人畜无害。我见过它们盯着我的眼神，还有一直嚼个不停的样子。快把它们赶回圈里，离我远点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I want EVERYTHING. Every coin, every thread, every blade of grass. The Tamms in the field! Yes! Steal them for me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我想要一切。每一枚钱币、每一根丝线、每一片草叶，还有田里的塔塔羊！对，对，去把它们给我偷过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That stunted brat can't even keep the Tamms in order. If you don't sort them out sharpish, we'll be tripping over the brainless things for weeks!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那个发育不良的小屁孩，连几只塔塔羊都管不好。再不快点把它们赶回去，咱们接下来几周都会被这些没脑子的牲口给绊倒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I understand how the Tamms feel, lost and listless. Be kind, Drifter. Bring them home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我很能理解那些塔塔羊的感受，迷茫而困倦。请仁慈些吧，漂泊者，带它们回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh Barris, have you let the Tamms out again? He takes his responsibilities SO seriously. I'm sure he wouldn't mind you helping him out, this once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哎呀，小板栗，你怎么又把塔塔羊放出来了？他对待自己的职责可认真了呢。我想这一次，他不会介意你帮个忙的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Tamms are plotting something. They're out of their pens. I don't like it. Round them up. Put them back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些塔塔羊肯定在盘算什么，它们全跑出围栏了。我讨厌这样。把它们赶回来，关到羊圈里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mucking about with farm animals. That really is all you're good for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 跟农场里的牲口一起胡闹，你也就这点出息了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Ranch work. A peasant you are and a peasant you shall always be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 放牧这种活儿正适合你。你生来是贱民，这辈子也只能是贱民。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh, bra-vo, shepherd. Perhaps you should retire and become a dung-shoveler!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦，真了不起啊，牧羊人。不如早点退休，改行去铲粪吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Congratulations, Drifter. Finally you have found creatures who look up to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 恭喜你，漂泊者。你终于找到一群会仰慕你的生物了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: When people have more wealth than they can spend, they hide it. People like that make me sick. I want you to find what they stashed and give it to me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有些人明明拥有挥霍不完的财富，却还要把财宝藏起来，真叫人恶心。去把他们藏匿的宝贝找出来，然后通通交给我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Wait. You're near where the succession scrolls are hidden. If that wretched Imp hasn't burned them all, that is. What are you waiting for? Find them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 等等。你现在离藏匿继承卷轴的地方很近。前提是那个可恶的小魔头还没把它们统统烧光的话。还愣着干什么？快去找啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax has had many secrets buried over the years. Evidence of his cruelty. Fragments of ruined lives. Bring those secrets to light again.
