/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这些年来，士魂大帝埋葬了太多秘密。那些都是他残暴的铁证，也是一段段破碎人生留下的残片。去让那些秘密重见天日吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You won't be happy until you can stand on your own two feet. Something's hidden nearby. YOU are going to find it. By yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 只有学会自食其力，你才能获得真正的快乐。附近藏了些东西，你得靠自己把它找出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I need protection. Talismans. Incantations. Weapons. Whatever you can find. Search around. There has to be something I can use!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我需要能保护自己的东西。护身符、咒语、武器，无论什么都行。四处搜搜，肯定有能派上用场的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: By sacred law, any treasure dug up in Duviri is automatically the property of the King! Not today, 'your Majesty'. Today it's finders keepers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 依照神圣律法，凡是在双衍王境挖出的财宝，一律归国王所有！不过今天除外，「陛下」。今天，谁找到就归谁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: MY REGALIA! This is where the bastard Imp hid it! Find it, and I'll get you a front row seat at my coronation!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我的王权信物！那个该死的小魔头绝对把它藏在这儿了！给我找出来，等我加冕时，绝对让你坐最前排！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: If what Acrithis says is true, there are secrets buried in Duviri that reveal an even greater mystery. If I can understand WHY I am... I might be more able to bear it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 如果言录使所言不假，那么双衍王境里还隐藏着一个更大的秘密。如果我能明白自己存在的意义……也许就能更好地承受这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: This challenge requires patience. Persistence. Oh, and just a little pinch of perspective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这项挑战需要一点耐心和毅力。哦，再加一点点眼界。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I locked something up near here, I know I did. Books. Dried roots. A prisoner? Can't be sure. But I need to find it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我记得自己把什么东西锁在这附近了，肯定没错。几本书？干草根？还是一个囚犯？我不确定，但我必须把东西找回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Nothing but a dog, grubbing in the dirt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 简直就像条在泥地里乱刨的野狗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Someone toss this ragged beggar a coin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 来人，给这个衣衫褴褛的乞丐赏几个子儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh, well done. You found it. Now look for your dignity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦，干得漂亮，东西找到了。现在去把你丢掉的尊严也找回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It is very much like watching a rat run a maze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你还真像只困在迷宫里的老鼠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Some people have it all. This fellow, for instance. Strong. Fast. He even has Void powers. What I wouldn't do to have what he has. You're going to kill him and TAKE what he has.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有些人生来就拥有一切。比如这个家伙，强壮、迅捷，甚至还拥有虚空之力。他的本事要是能长我身上，我什么都肯做。去杀了他，然后夺走他的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That's him. Thrax's enforcer. MY REPLACEMENT. For two pins, I'd come down there and smash his face in myself! But I can't, so you have to. Help yourself to his chest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 就是他，士魂大帝的执法官，抢了老子的位子。我恨不得亲自跑下去砸烂他的脸！可我去不了，只能交给你。记得把他的宝箱给掏空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: How many times did I dream of escape, only for one of those hulking brutes to bar my path? Show no mercy. Whatever he guards, you may keep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我曾无数次幻想着逃离，却总被那些魁梧的恶徒拦住去路。别心慈手软，无论他守着什么，你都可以据为己有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: One can't keep a Krubie and never let it bite. I suppose I'd better let you off the leash, shouldn't I? Fight the bad man and take the goodies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 库贝哪有不咬人的道理呀。唉，看来我该给你松开牵绳了，对吧？去教训那个坏人，把好东西拿回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I can't bear the sight of those things. Thrax's favored. Like something out of a vapor vision. You're going to have to kill it. And take whatever it was put here to guard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我一看见那种东西就受不了。士魂大帝的宠儿，像是从迷雾幻景里爬出来的一样。你必须杀了它，再拿走它看守的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That oaf bars my way every time I try to return to the Palace! Wouldn't he look so much better coughing his last while you loot his chest of goods?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 每次我想回王宫，那个蠢货总要挡我的道！让他一边喘着最后一口气，一边眼睁睁地看着你洗劫他的宝箱，那画面岂不是更赏心悦目？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I TOLD the Imp these Void-sodden travesties were a STUPID idea. 'But they're so strong, Lodun!' Kill one. Take what it's guarding. Prove me right!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我早就告诉过那个小魔头，弄出这些被虚空侵蚀的怪物，根本就是个蠢主意。「可它们很强啊，隆沌！」随便杀掉一个，拿走它守着的东西，证明我才是对的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Centurions and Legates. A child's idea of strength. Break his toys and scatter them. Make his wealth your own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 百夫长和将领，都不过是孩子眼中所谓的强者罢了。砸碎他的玩具，把它们踩个稀烂，再把他的财富据为己有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Today, you fight miscreants and claim your reward! Life is a glorious adventure. I do hope you understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 今天，你要去惩治那些坏人，然后拿走奖赏！唉，生命真是一场绚烂的冒险，希望你能明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax brought monsters to life to defend his Kingdom. But you're stronger than Thrax, aren't you? You're a monster-killer. Treasure-finder. Aren't you? Well?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 士魂大帝唤醒了怪物来保卫他的王国。但你比他更强，不是吗？你是怪物杀手，也是寻宝猎人，对吧？回答我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Interesting! I'm learning so much about your weaknesses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有意思！本王快摸透你的弱点了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Do you suppose that you have won, worm? Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你真以为自己赢了，可怜虫？哼哼，好极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Good fight! I loved the part where you flailed about like a fish on a mudbank!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 啊……打得不错！本王最喜欢看你像条搁浅在泥滩上的鱼一般，拼命扑腾的样子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I suppose not even you can lose all the time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看来就算是你，也不至于每次都输。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sometimes the only thing standing between a man and the wealth he deserves is a bunch of idiots in armor. I'm sure you can handle them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有时候，挡在一个人与他应得的财富之间的，不过是一群穿着盔甲的蠢货。我相信你应付得了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: We're not going to fire a revolution sitting on our arses! Weapons out, take down a few Dax, ferret out their chests. LET'S GO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 整天缩在这儿可点不燃革命的火！抄家伙，干翻那几个禁卫，把他们的宝箱搜刮干净。上啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What little I had to call my own, Thrax took from me. Please, take my possessions back from the Dax. They may be dust and mold now, but they are still mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我仅有的那些属于自己的东西，也全被士魂大帝夺走。求你从禁卫手中替我夺回来。就算它们现在已经落满灰尘、长满霉斑，那也依然是我的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You can't expect everything in life to be handed to you on a plate! You'll appreciate what you have all the more if you fight for it. Like now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你不能指望生活中的一切都不劳而获！亲手争取来的东西，你才会更加珍惜。就像现在这样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Too many people. With grudges. Reasons to hate me. Wanting me dead. Going to need leverage. Funds. Find me some funds even if you have to murder a few Dax to do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 恨我的人太多了。他们满腹怨气，各有理由，都巴不得我死。我得有筹码，也得有钱。去给我弄些钱来，哪怕要杀几个禁卫也无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: So many beautiful masks I might wear, all jealously hoarded by those Dax imbeciles. As if they could ever use them! Take them, Drifter. For ME.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那么多适合我的华美面具，全被那些愚蠢的禁卫出于嫉妒藏了起来。就好像他们用得上似的！漂泊者，去替我把它们拿回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: All that peasant tribute going to the Dax instead of me, Lodun! The True King! IT PISSES ME OFF! KILL THEM AND FIND WHERE THEY'VE HIDDEN IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些贱民上供的东西，居然全进了禁卫的口袋，而不是交给我，真正的国王隆沌！气死我了！杀光他们，把藏贡品的地方给我找出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: There are songs Thrax forbade me to sing. He took them from me. Locked them up. If they have not rotted away, I would dearly love to see them again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有些歌，士魂大帝不准我再唱。他从我手中夺走歌谱，将它们锁了起来。若它们还未腐朽，我真想再看一眼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Along life's path, there are many hidden riches by the wayside. You just have to be brave enough to seize the moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 人生旅途中，路边总藏着意想不到的宝藏。你只要勇敢一点，抓住眼前的机会就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax could have me executed with a snap of his fingers. I need something I can use against him. Whatever these Dax are guarding has to be important.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 士魂大帝打一个响指，就能把我处死。我得找到能用来对付他的筹码。禁卫如此严密看守的东西，一定很重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Orokin knew exactly what to do with your sort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 奥罗金人最清楚该怎么对付你这种人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Feel good, do we? See how bright you feel when you're dangling from a gibbet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 感觉很得意是吗？等把你挂上绞刑架，看你还能不能笑得出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What an irredeemable thug you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你可真是个无可救药的暴徒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Void, I despise you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 虚空在上，本王打心底里鄙视你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The mark of true nobility is an affinity for horseflesh, you know. I want to be the patron of champions. All YOU have to do is win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 真正的贵族，哪有不爱良驹的，你说是吧？我要成为冠军的赞助人。至于你，只需要赢下比赛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: He treated his bloody Kaithes better than he treated me, his own executioner! I want YOU to outrace his champion. That'll wipe the smirk off Thrax's mewling face!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 他对那几匹该死的绝灵骥，都比对我这个御用处刑官好！我要你去跑赢他的冠军，看那个爱哭的小魔头还笑不笑得出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Was there ever a time when Duviri was a happy place? Laughter, Lunaro, games and races? Help me remember. Surely a running Kaithe feels no sorrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 双衍王境曾经也有过快乐的时光吗？有欢声笑语、月动球，各种游戏和比赛吗？请帮我回想起来吧。奔驰的绝灵骥，想必是感受不到悲伤的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Your pain doesn't make you special, you know. What you need is a little exercise! Take that Kaithe of yours for a run!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 痛苦并不会让你变得与众不同，知道吗？你需要的是活动活动！骑上绝灵骥去跑一圈吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Kaithes terrify me. I keep dreaming I'm at a race, and those pounding hooves trample me to pulp. Maybe if you ran a race... and that DIDN'T happen... it might be okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 绝灵骥太可怕了。我总梦见自己站在赛道上，被轰鸣的铁蹄踩成肉泥。也许只要你去跑一场，而梦里的事没有发生……我就能安心一点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: How would it be... to own the fastest Kaithe in all Duviri? Glorious. Make a little boy's dream come true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 拥有整个双衍王境最快的绝灵骥……会是什么感觉？一定无比荣耀。去让一个小男孩的美梦成真吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax has a favorite, Kaithe. None but his own dainty arse may sit upon it. I want YOU to ride it and beat the King's own record! That'll teach the little toe-rag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 士魂大帝有匹最宠爱的绝灵骥，除了他谁都碰不得。我要你骑上它，去打破国王亲自创下的记录！让那个小混球长长记性！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I cannot bear to see the Kaithes neglected, but I am no rider. Perhaps you can bring them joy, even on this dark day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我不忍心看着绝灵骥遭人冷落，可我又不会骑马。或许在今天这样昏暗的日子里，你能为它们带去些许欢乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Think how lucky you are! You get to ride free across beautiful Duviri! Maybe a race would help you keep that in mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 想想你有多幸运呀！你可以在美妙的双衍王境里自由驰骋！要不来场比赛，去亲自体验一下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That Kaithe might be mad. Void-struck. Dangerous. You'd better ride all the crazy out of it. Wear it out. To be safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那匹绝灵骥可能遭到了虚空侵蚀，所以发疯了，非常危险。你最好骑到它筋疲力尽，没力气发疯，这样才安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Behold the adoring crowds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 瞧，万众都在为你欢呼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Well done... Kaithe!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 干得漂亮……绝灵骥！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Aww. You failed to break your neck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦，你居然没把脖子摔断，真可惜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I should lay tripwires down. To make this interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 本王该设几道绊马索，这样才有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Kaithes are your salvation!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 绝灵骥能救你脱险！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Find a mount or perish!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 快找一匹坐骑，否则必死无疑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bombastine, Duviri's preening peacock, was consumed by Envy. Oh, many envied him, but he cared nothing for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蓬蓬士君，双衍王境那只爱炫耀的孔雀，最终被嫉妒吞噬。哦，羡慕他的人其实不少，但他对此毫不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bombastine was envious. Of what? Anything.Wherever his gaze fell, it seemed other people had it better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蓬蓬士君生性嫉妒。他嫉妒什么？当然是一切。目光所及之处，他总觉得别人过得比他好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Hear now of the one they called Lodun — the high and mighty prince of... nothing. For within him burned a fire and a fury he could not control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 现在让我来讲讲隆沌那家伙的故事吧。他表面上高高在上、威风凛凛，但实际上一无所有。因为在他心中，燃烧着连自己都无法控制的烈焰与狂怒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Lodun of Duviri was nicknamed 'the Prince of Fire'. A mocking title, for he ruled over nothing, least of all himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 双衍王境的隆沌，人称「烈焰王子」。这头衔充满讥讽，因为他什么权力也没有，甚至连自己都管不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sorrow is a poison, and yet some drink it like wine. One such was Luscinia.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 悲伤是一剂毒药，但有些人却将其视作美酒般一饮而尽。路西尼娅便是其中之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sorrow is the bitter spice without which life is too sweet. Luscinia indulged in it... to excess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 悲伤是生活的苦味剂，少了它，日子便会甜得发腻。可路西尼娅却沉溺其中……无法自拔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: When happy Mathila wanted to see nothing but happiness wherever she went, it soon caused problems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 满心欢喜的玛蒂拉，无论走到哪里，都只想看见快乐。可麻烦很快便找上了门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Unfortunately, Mathila was convinced she knew what would make people happy better than they did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 可惜的是，玛蒂拉坚信，自己比别人更清楚怎样才能让人快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: One haunted day in Duviri, Sythel awoke with the thought: if I could destroy what I fear, I wouldn't have to fear it anymore!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 在双衍王境某个阴云密布的日子里，袭幽醒来时脑海中冒出了一个念头：只要摧毁我恐惧的一切，我就再也不用恐惧了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Afraid to go outside and afraid to be shut in, Sythel lived a timorous life. Usually, she was too scared to act... but not always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 袭幽既怕出门，又怕被关在屋里，日子过得提心吊胆。大多数时候，她都怕得什么也不敢做……但凡事总有例外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It is unjust that Thrax has the sole power of life and death. I want some too. Nearby a man is marked for execution. Save his life, that I may also, rightly, be thought of as Lord of Life and Death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 凭什么只有士魂大帝能独揽生杀大权，这太不公平了，我也想要这种权力。附近有个人正要被送去行刑，去救他一命。这样我也能当一回「生死主宰」了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I find ONE citizen willing to support my claim, and the bastard Dax are trying to kill him! Keep him alive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 好不容易才找到一个愿意支持我登上王位的人，那帮混账禁卫居然想杀他！一定要给我保住他的命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A man insulted my singing. Thrax has decreed he must die. More pain, of which I am the source and font. I beg of you, spare that man. Spare me just one more misery to live with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有人辱骂了我的歌声。士魂大帝便下令要将他处死。这又是一场因我而起的苦难……我求求你，救下那个人吧。别再让我余生多背负一份痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Maybe helping people who are REALLY suffering would put your woes in perspective? Oh, maybe you could find time to rescue a condemned man?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 也许去帮助那些真正受苦的人，能让你重新看待自己的烦恼？哦，你能不能抽点时间去救一个死囚呀？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I ordered a man executed. I was sure he was conspiring against me. But now... I'm... I'm afraid he might be... innocent. You have to stop the Dax. Before it's too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我下令处死了一个人。当时，当时我确信他在密谋害我，可现在……我怕，我怕，我怕他可能是被冤枉的。趁现在还来得及，快去阻止禁卫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: People owe you their life, don't they, Drifter? How does that feel? Save a condemned criminal for me. I want to see the pathetic gratitude in his eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有不少人都欠你一条命，对吧，漂泊者？这种感觉如何？去替我救一个死囚吧。我想看看他可怜巴巴、感恩戴德的模样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax has a prisoner. The Imp wants him dead. I want him alive. I respect your skill, the Imp does not. Clear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 士魂大帝抓了个囚犯。那个小魔头想要他死，但我偏要他活。我看得上你的身手，那个小魔头可不会。听懂了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A man nearby is marked for execution. I would have him die in pain for what he has done. So... spare him today so he may face an even darker fate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 附近有个人已经被判了死刑。鉴于他的所作所为，我想看他受尽折磨再死。所以……今天先饶了他，好让他去迎接更凄惨的下场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I know the King never makes mistakes, but his officials are only human. They're holding an innocent man. I know you'll do the right thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我知道国王绝不会犯错，可他手下的官员毕竟只是普通人。他们关押了一个无辜的人，我相信你一定知道该怎么做吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Dax want to kill one of MY prisoners. You mustn't let them. I need him alive for... secret reasons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫想杀掉我的一个囚犯，你绝不能让他们得逞。出于一些……不能说的秘密，我得让他活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You sentimental sap!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你这个多愁善感的蠢货！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I kill who I please. I killed you often enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 本王想杀谁就杀谁。你都已经死在本王手里多少次了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You have saved nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你，什么都救不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You are soft. As. Pudding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你真软弱，像块布丁似的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I can hear them now. Little children laughing at me because they could solve the maze and I couldn't. I won't have it. Solve the wretched thing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我现在都能听见那些小屁孩在嘲笑我！就因为他们能解开迷宫，而我却不能。我可受不了这种羞辱！快去，把那破玩意儿解开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Grah! I can never work these STUPID mazes out! Wait. YOU can do it for me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 呃啊！我永远也解不开这些愚蠢的迷宫！等等，你可以替我解啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A Royal maze. I think... I think I lost something precious in a maze like that, long ago... please, would you quest on my behalf, for some small piece of sweetness?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 一座皇家迷宫。我想……很久以前，我似乎也在这样的迷宫里遗失过某样珍贵之物。求求你，能否替我走一趟，寻回那一点点久违的甜蜜？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I think some simple little challenges will perk you right up. Ouu, why not have a go at this Royal Maze?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我觉得来点轻松的小挑战，准能让你精神百倍。喏，要不就试试这座皇家迷宫吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'm scared of mazes. You never know what might be skulking at the center. You go look. I'll wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我害怕迷宫。你永远不知道迷宫正中心藏着什么。你去看看，我就在这儿等着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I grew up hearing stories of these odd configurations. How riches awaited those clever enough to solve them. Show me what that feels like!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我从小就听着这些古怪装置的传说长大。据说只要足够聪明，解开它们便能得到财富。快让我见识一下，那究竟是种什么滋味！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: While I deal with whichever of the Imp's INCOMPETENT ministers set this travesty up, YOU can take it back down again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我去收拾小魔头手下某个无能大臣搞出来的烂摊子，你去把这破烂玩意儿给拆了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Secrets are lost in mazes like this. Sometimes souls are, too. Perhaps some wait for us there, now. Let us look. What choice do we have, after all?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 无数秘密都迷失在了这样的迷宫中。有时，灵魂也未能幸免。或许此刻，就有什么在深处等候。去看看吧，毕竟我们别无选择，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Royal Mazes teach independence and build character! Don't give up! Keep trying!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 皇家迷宫能让人学会独立，还能磨炼品格！别放弃，继续努力！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: One day I might be locked up in one of those mazes. Then you'll have to get me out. I need to know you can do that. Show me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 没准哪天我也会被关进这种迷宫里。到时候，你得把我救出来。我必须确认你有这个本事，所以证明给我看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bra-vo. Aren't you clever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 不错嘛，你真聪明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I must admit: watching you fumble your way through that was becoming embarrassing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 不得不说，看你笨手笨脚地折腾半天，越看越替你觉得丢人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Took you long enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你可真够慢的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: How to keep an idiot occupied...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 让一个蠢货忙活半天，原来这么简单……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Witchcraft. You should be hung.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这是巫术！就该把你绞死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Be warned, Drifter. Your Void-meddlings are forbidden by my law.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 警告你，漂泊者。我的律法严禁你染指虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What goblins and doppelgangers are you consorting with?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你到底在跟什么妖精和怪物来往？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Do not do that again. One of you is quite enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 别再这么干了。有你一个就够我受的了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Something's calling for you through the Void mirror. Aren't YOU special? Get rid of those Dax and see what's so urgent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有东西正透过虚空之镜召唤你。你还真是与众不同呢！解决那些禁卫，看看有什么要紧事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I don't know what Void-cursed nonsense that mirror is harboring, and I don't care. I just want it dealt with. Get rid of those Dax and find out what it wants!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那面镜子里究竟藏着什么虚空邪物，我不知道，也不在乎。我只想把它处理掉。除掉那些禁卫，看看那东西究竟想干嘛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Other Side reaches out to you, through the King's mirror, defying the Dax. Answer their need!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 另一边的世界正越过禁卫的阻拦，借国王的镜子向你求助。去回应他们的呼唤吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Dearest, you've a friend calling from the other side! What fun! Attend to the mirror, and do enjoy yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 亲爱的，镜子另一边有朋友在呼唤你！多有意思呀！快去瞧瞧，好好享受吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Something's trying to reach you. Through the mirror. The GUARDED mirror. This is YOUR problem! Deal with it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有东西正透过镜子找你，就是那面有重兵把守的镜子！这是你的事情！自己去解决！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Hours I've spent gazing into Void mirrors, and here you are, with some mysterious benefactor gazing back! Deal with those, Dax, and see what your friend wants.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我在虚空之镜前凝望了那么久，你倒好，一来便有位神秘贵人在镜中与你对望！除掉那些禁卫，看看你这位「朋友」究竟找你做什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: One of the Imp's mirrors is up ahead. Slaughter the guards and find out what it wants from you. (aside) When I'm King, I'll have them all smashed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 前面有面小魔头的镜子。干掉守卫，弄清楚那东西找你做什么。等我当上国王，非把这些破镜子全砸个稀巴烂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Other Side has known much sorrow. I feel it in my heart. From the far side of the mirror, they call to you. Find them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 另一边承受过太多悲痛，我能从心底感受到那份痛楚。他们正在镜子的另一端呼唤你，去找到他们吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Now, one never turns aside a friendly hand. A dear friend is calling to you from beyond the mirror. Do the polite thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有人主动向你示好，哪能转身不理呢？镜子另一边有位亲爱的朋友在呼唤你，去礼貌回应一下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: One of us has to kill those Dax. Look into that mirror. See whatever's waiting there. You. Obviously. Not me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 总得有人除掉那些禁卫，再看看镜子那头到底有什么。这事当然交给你，别指望我去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I am better than any of them! Fate and small, jealous others have conspired to inflict this upon me! You! Will you defy their cruelty and aid me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我比他们任何人都优秀！是命运，还有那些心胸狭隘的小人串通一气，害我落到这般境地！你，可愿反抗他们的暴行，助我一臂之力？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I've seen YOU drifting among the isles of MY kingdom! If it weren't for that manic little IMP! He's got it in for you. If you're not a complete idiot you'll see that we should... HELP... one another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我早就看见你在我的王国各座岛屿间四处游荡了！偏偏那个疯疯癫癫的小魔头还要从中作梗！他可是铁了心要对付你。你要还没蠢到家，就该明白，我们得……互相帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I am Sorrow, and suffering is my lot, but today the burden is too much to bear. If my pain is avenged, perhaps... perhaps it will be lifted a little?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我即是悲伤，苦难便是我的宿命。可今日，这份重负已经让我不堪承受。若有人能为我遭受的一切讨回公道，或许……这份痛苦便会减轻几分？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: There's no excuse for negativity in this wonderful kingdom. I think someone like you wants to be part of the solution, and I'm happy to say I can help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 在这个美好的国度里，哪有理由垂头丧气呢？我看你也愿意出份力，把问题解决掉。正好，我能帮上忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Can I trust you? I have to. They're everywhere. Plotting against me. I need you to destroy them. Every single last one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我能相信你吗？我别无选择了。他们无处不在，都在暗中算计我。我要你把他们全除掉，一个不留！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Duviri has owed me for an age, short-changed me at every turn. We shall set things to rights. Let us collect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 双衍王境亏欠我太久了，处处都在刻薄怠慢我。是时候让一切重回正轨了。走，我们去连本带利地讨回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Another day, another insult to my dignity... my right! Return me to my rightful place OR SUFFER THE CONSEQUENCES!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 又是新的一天，又是对我尊严的一次羞辱……不，这是在践踏我应有的权利！把本该属于我的位置还给我，否则就等着付出代价吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I have grieved for long enough, while others in Duviri have laughed at my pain. Today, we shall turn the world upside down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我已经哀伤得够久了，而双衍王境的其他人却一直拿我的痛苦取乐。今天，我们就把这世界搅得天翻地覆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You can't dwell on your woes for ever! It's time to spread some positivity for a change. Oh don't worry. I'm on this journey with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 老是愁眉苦脸的可不行！也该换换心情，传播点正能量了！哦，别担心，一路上有我陪着你呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: They've kept me locked up inside my own mind all these years. Frightening me with their tricks. Now I need you to make THEM afraid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这么多年来，他们一直把我困在自己的脑海里，变着法儿地吓唬我。现在，我要让他们也尝尝心惊胆战的滋味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bravely done. For this one night at least, Duviri is calm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 做得好。至少今夜，双衍王境能够安宁了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Emotion is no longer in turmoil. The calm of the true warrior has prevailed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 情绪的动荡归于平息。真战士的沉着最终占了上风。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What happened? My head... Why can't I remember?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 怎么回事？我的头……怎么什么都想不起来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What did you do? I'm... sleepy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你到底做了什么？我……好困。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I feel... nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我……什么都感觉不到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bombastine was never satisfied. He wanted more... for all that others had was an affront to his being.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蓬蓬士君永远不知足。他想要拥有更多……因为别人拥有的一切，对他而言皆是冒犯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh, Bombastine was admired, even loved. But others were loved more, and that was poison to him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦，蓬蓬士君也曾受人仰慕，甚至被人爱戴。但只要别人得到的爱戴比他多，那对他而言便是穿肠毒药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: As the never-to-be king's fortune rose, so too did his fire... his indignation... his Anger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这位「永远无法加冕的王」越是得势，他心中的烈焰、愤懑和怒火，也愈发高涨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The most petty and trivial things could spark Lodun's anger. But the flames quickly rose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哪怕一点微不足道的琐事，也能点燃隆沌的怒火。而那点火星，转眼便会化作熊熊烈焰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Perhaps Luscinia's misery would end if she inflicted suffering upon others? Others who deserved it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 或许，只有让那些罪有应得的人受到折磨，路西尼娅自己的痛苦才会结束？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thoughts of revenge come easily to a heart turned bitter and cold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 一颗苦涩冰冷的心，最容易滋生复仇的念头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: To the Happy mind, all things seem simple. Problems could be solved simply by making them go away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 在快乐的人眼里，一切似乎都很简单。遇到问题，只要让它消失不就解决了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Like a child hiding its face in play, Mathila hid from the truth. Nothing but joy mattered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 玛蒂拉就像玩耍时蒙住双眼的孩子，躲着不肯面对真相。除了快乐，其他都不重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sythel looked in horror upon what had been done in her name. Surely there would be consequences!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 袭幽惊恐地看着那些以她的名义犯下的恶行。她知道，这些事一定会招致报应！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Like the first rumblings of a landslide, the ominous consequences of Sythel's actions began to build.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 如同山崩前最初的轰鸣声，袭幽所作所为带来的恶果也开始不断积聚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: With sweet words, he persuaded others to his side. But his thoughts were only ever of himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 他用甜言蜜语笼络人心，可心里从始至终只装着自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Behind his acts of kindness and generosity lay but one thought: how can this performance benefit me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 在他慷慨善良的行为背后，只藏着一个念头：这样做对我有什么好处？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: So everything was met with Anger. And Anger was his undoing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 于是，他以怒火回应一切。最终，也正是这股怒火毁了他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Now anger is a powerful weapon, be sure of that. But it burns friend and foe alike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 愤怒是一件强大的武器，这一点毋庸置疑。但它也会不分敌我，将一切焚烧殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: At first, Luscinia felt some comfort from her actions. At least she was doing something. But her sorrow grew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 起初，路西尼娅多少得到了一点慰藉。至少，她不再是默默承受。但她的悲伤却与日俱增。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Revenge may bring some relief at first. But as Luscinia found, it is often cold comfort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 复仇起初或许能让人暂时好受一些。但路西尼娅最终发现，那根本于事无补。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mathila did not understand that you cannot bring Happiness to the world by making unhappiness a crime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 玛蒂拉不明白，把不快乐当成是一种罪，并不能为世界带来快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Why could other people not simply be as Happy as Mathila was? Why did they have to be so difficult?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 为什么其他人不能像玛蒂拉一样快乐呢？为什么非要把事情变得这么麻烦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Another might have taken courage from seeing the things she feared exterminated, but not Sythel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 换作别人，看到自己畏惧之物被尽数消灭，或许会从中获得勇气。但袭幽却没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sythel's fear spiraled. The more she tried to be bold, the greater grew her fear of being found out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 袭幽的恐惧愈演愈烈。她越是逼自己表现得勇敢，就越害怕别人看穿她心中的恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: With each new conquest, never once did he think: 'Surely that is enough. Surely now I can stop.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 每次有新的斩获，他从未想过：「这总该够了吧，我可以停下了。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Like a child becoming bored with each new toy, Bombastine moved from one fixation to the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 就像个对玩具喜新厌旧的孩子，蓬蓬士君也总是刚迷上一样东西，转眼又盯上了下一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Friends and family were scorched and retreated away from him, so his rage became like a stone in his chest, weighing him down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 亲友们被他的怒火灼伤，纷纷离他而去。于是，那份愤怒化作胸中的巨石，拖着他坠入了深渊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The more Lodun's anger drove people away, the more certain he became that he was right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 隆沌的怒火越是将人推远，他就越发笃定，错的不是自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Luscinia wept for those she was hurting. She tried to dismiss it as weakness, but her heart rebelled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 路西尼娅为那些受到她伤害的人落泪。她试图把这当成软弱，可内心却不肯认同。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sorrow had made Luscinia compassionate. She could not give pain without feeling it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 悲伤让路西尼娅生出了怜悯之心。她在施加痛苦的同时，自己也感同身受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: If she doubted, she hid it. Her failures merely made her more determined to succeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 即使心中有过怀疑，她也会隐藏起来。失败只会让她更加决意要取得成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mathila's plans were failing, but she put a brave face on it. With a whistle, she went back to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 玛蒂拉的计划一次次落空，却依然装作若无其事。她口哨一吹，便又忙活了起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Her brutal actions had consequences. Like a deadly pestilence, Sythel's fear spread across Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 她的残酷行径终究带来了后果。袭幽的恐惧如同致命瘟疫，在双衍王境蔓延开来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sythel left fear in her wake. Doors were closed and windows barred, and voices spoke in whispers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 袭幽的所到之处，尽是恐惧。家家户户门窗紧闭，人们只敢低声私语。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Demented beyond hope of return, Bombastine set his heart on the throne. Was he not as good a king as Thrax?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蓬蓬士君利欲熏心、无可救药，他甚至觊觎起王座。他心想，难道自己当起国王来，会比不上士魂大帝吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: If Bombastine could only have loved himself, he might not have yearned to become someone else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 如果蓬蓬士君懂得爱自己，或许就不会如此渴望成为别人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Lodun turned his anger inward... and found the source. Not the world of folly and betrayal but his own shortcomings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 隆沌终于将怒火转向自己……也找到了真正的根源。错的不是这个充满愚昧与背叛的世界，而是他自身的不足。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: In his heart, Lodun knew he was angry with his own powerlessness. And no amount of screaming could remedy that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 隆沌心里明白，他其实是在对自己的一无是处感到愤怒。而再怎么嘶吼，也无济于事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Luscinia had set her feet upon a dark path, but she had to walk it to the very end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 路西尼娅已经踏上一条不归路，却不得不硬着头皮走到底。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: As if with a prophet's gift, Luscinia could see disaster looming, but she could not turn aside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 路西尼娅仿佛拥有先知的天赋，能够预见灾难将至，却无力阻止它发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mathila embraced optimism with the zeal of a fanatic. Her plan would work. Duviri would be Happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 玛蒂拉近乎狂热地将乐观奉为信条。她相信自己的计划一定会成功，双衍王境一定会变得快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mathila understood that one sometimes has to be cruel to be kind. If happiness required force, so be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 玛蒂拉明白，有时为了行善，难免要狠下心来。如果必须动用暴力才能带来快乐，那就这么办吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Fear ruled Duviri... and yet Sythel, the embodiment of fear, was more afraid than ever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 恐惧统治着双衍王境……可身为恐惧化身的袭幽，却比以往任何时候都更加害怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: All Duviri now lived in terror of Sythel. What a long shadow this scrawny little figure had cast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 如今，整个双衍王境都活在对袭幽的恐惧中。这样消瘦矮小的身影，竟投下了如此庞大的阴影！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: And so the envy that might have motivated him to better himself hurled him headlong into disaster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 于是，那原本能激励他完善自我的嫉妒之心，却将他径直推向了灾难的深渊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bombastine thought his self-doubt was his alone. If only he had known how many others suffered it too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蓬蓬士君以为，只有自己饱受自我怀疑的折磨。可他不知道，还有许多人也承受着同样的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: He became an enemy to even himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 到最后，他甚至成了自己的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: He saw there was nothing righteous or noble about his anger. It was just the raving of a petty, paltry man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 他终于看清，自己的愤怒毫无正义与高尚可言。那不过是一个心胸狭隘之人的疯言乱语罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: One final act, then. One last howl into the storm. Misery would have company, at least.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那么，就再做最后一件事吧。向风暴发出最后一声哀号。至少，也要让别人陪她一同受苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Even as she prepared to risk everything on a final reckless gamble, Luscinia already knew the outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 路西尼娅早已知道结局，却仍准备不顾一切，押上所有筹码作最后一搏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Now no rational person could look upon this chaos and feel Happiness. So Mathila abandoned rationality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 事到如今，任何理智的人面对这番混乱，都不可能感到快乐。于是，玛蒂拉索性抛弃了理智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Joy and madness are both known to laugh aloud. Mathila leapt from one into the embrace of the other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 人在快乐和疯狂时都会放声大笑。于是，玛蒂拉从喜悦中纵身一跃，落入了疯狂的怀抱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sythel was afraid to go on, but she was even more afraid to stop. Her fears were allying against her now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 袭幽不敢继续，却更不敢停下。如今，她心中的种种恐惧已开始一同反噬她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Even as her plans led to disaster after disaster, Sythel was more afraid of what might still come to pass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 即便自己的计划一次次酿成灾难，袭幽却更害怕那些尚未降临的厄运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Thrax's 'power' is rooted in the Undercroft. Pfeh. Without it, he's not that big of a deal. Not really. Perhaps you should make your way inside for a little... takeover bid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 士魂大帝所谓的「力量」，全盘扎根在地穴之中。呸。要是没了那里，他根本不值一提。不如你亲自进去一趟，试着把那里……夺过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The blasted Undercroft! Nothing but a haphazard mass of chaos under the Imp's rule! Get a portal open. I have HAD ENOUGH. We are FIXING this mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这破地穴！在那个小魔头的统治下，里面简直乱成一团！去把传送门打开，老子已经受够了。我们必须去把这烂摊子收拾干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Undercroft is in agony! The Paradox, twisting the Void, tearing me in two impossible directions... oh, get inside and put an end to it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 地穴正在痛苦中哀嚎！是悖论，它扭曲了虚空，也将我撕扯成彼此冲突的两半……快进去，结束这一切！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Undercroft is a messy, chaotic place, and you will need to work SO hard to keep it together in there, but I believe in you. You've got this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 地穴一片混乱，你得拼尽全力才能在那里面勉强活下来。不过我相信你，你一定能做到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You have to go to the place where bad dreams are real. The Undercroft. Whatever's wrong there, make it right. Hurry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你必须去地穴，那个连噩梦都会成真的地方。不管那里出了什么乱子，赶紧解决掉。快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Ah, the Undercroft. A seething mass of Void-ridden potential, spiced with childish nightmares. Give me some.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 啊，地穴。一锅被虚空煮得沸腾的潜能浓汤，再撒上几撮幼稚的噩梦调味。快给我也尝一口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Imp allows chaos to brood under his very nose! If I had my way I'd have all those Undercroft portals BRICKED UP! Get in there and find out what's wrong this time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那个小魔头竟任由混乱在眼皮底下滋生！换作是我，早把所有通往地穴的传送门通通封死了！进去查清楚，这回又出了什么乱子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Duviri pretends it never happened, but the Undercroft remembers. The tragedy... the Zariman. Whatever calm you can bring to that tormented place, please: do so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 双衍王境佯装这一切从未发生，但地穴却仍然记得……「扎里曼号」的那场悲剧。请你尽己所能，为那片饱受折磨之地带去一丝安宁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It's time for you to descend into the Undercroft and make things right. It may not be what you want, but it IS what you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 是时候下到地穴去，让一切重回正轨了。这也许不是你想做的事情，但却是你该做的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Everyone's afraid of the Undercroft. Even Thrax. It's too close to the Void. To... to HIM. That's why I'm sending YOU in there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 所有人都害怕地穴，连士魂大帝也不例外。那里离虚空太近，离「他」也太近了，所以我才让你去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I want what a man of my talent and worth rightly deserves, and that includes the Undercroft that Thrax guards so jealously. Off you pop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 像我这样才华横溢、身价不菲的人，理应拿到属于我的一切，其中当然也包括士魂大帝严防死守的地穴。哼，赶紧出发吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Undercroft is an ulcer in the guts of Duviri. Something's happening down there. I can feel it. SORT IT OUT, for Void's sake!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 地穴这鬼地方就是双衍王境的一块烂疮。我能感觉到，下面肯定出事了。看在虚空的份上，赶紧去给我把事摆平！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Acrithis tells me the Void is emotion's keeper. Nowhere is the Void stronger than in the Undercroft. Why does it howl so? Please... answer its cry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 言录使告诉我，虚空承载着情感。而地穴中的虚空之力，远胜其他地方。可它为何如此哀嚎？请你……回应它的呼唤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Undercroft is a source of unbridled negativity. We are about joy and nothing but joy. So your path is clear, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 地穴是无尽负面情绪的源头，而我们只要快乐，除此之外什么都不想要。所以，你该怎么做已经很清楚了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I can't go near the Undercroft portals. Can't bear to think about what... might... come out of them. It's going to have to be you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我不能靠近地穴的传送门。一想到可能会爬出什么东西来，我就受不了。所以只能靠你去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Whoever controls the Undercroft grasps all of Duviri by the roots. I won't let its reputation stand in the way of claiming what's mine. Get in and do what you have to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 谁掌控了地穴，谁就扼住了整个双衍王境的命脉。我绝不会让它那点虚名，妨碍我夺回属于我自己的东西。进去，该做什么就做什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Does that brat on the throne have ANY IDEA how often I've had to send forces into the Undercroft to clean up his mess? Maybe you'll do a better job. See what's amiss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 王座上那个小兔崽子到底知不知道，我已经派了多少次人进地穴，替他收拾烂摊子？也许你能干得更漂亮些。去查查到底出了什么岔子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I heard that in the Undercroft, we may prevent tragedies from ever occurring. If that is true... please, see what lies under its veil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 听说在地穴里，我们或许能够阻止悲剧的发生。如果这是真的……求求你，去看看那层面纱之下，究竟隐藏着什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I foresee your life journey taking you into the Undercroft. Don't dwell on the choices that led you there. Just be in the moment, and act mindfully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看来命运注定要让你去地穴。别再纠结自己为何会走到这一步。活在当下，专心做好眼前的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh no. Oh no no. There's something wrong in the Undercroft. I can't go down there. Not after what I saw that time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 不，不好……地穴里肯定出事了。我绝对不能下去。上次看见那些东西以后，我再也不会去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What have you done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你都干了些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You are to stay OUT of the Undercroft.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你不准再踏入地穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Do NOT venture there again. There shall be no further warnings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 绝不准再去那里，否则后果自负！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That place is forbidden for a REASON!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那地方会被列为禁地，自然是有原因的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mmmm. Cunning devices like this feed Duviri with power, just so those witless peasants can piss it away. It's wasted on them. Recalibrate it in MY favor!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 嗯……如此精妙的装置为双衍王境供能，却被那群愚蠢的贱民白白糟蹋。用在他们身上简直是暴殄天物。去重新校准一下，让它为我所用！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Damnation! This ABSURD contraption has broken down AGAIN! Fix it for me. I need all the power I can get!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 可恶！这破烂玩意儿又罢工了！给我修好它，我需要尽可能多的能量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: This structure and I share much. Both of us once useful, both of us discarded, both of us now derelict. Both... forgotten. Might you bring it to life again? That one of us may live on?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这个装置和我有许多相似之处。我们都曾被需要，也都遭人遗弃，如今同样残破……被人遗忘。你能让它重新运转吗？至少让我们之中还有一个能够继续存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I can tell you want to be useful to the Duviri community, and fixing that generator would be a wonderful use of your time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 看得出来，你也想为双衍王境的大家出份力。那就去修好那台发电机好吗，这可是再合适不过的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I don't like this. Broken-down machinery is suspicious. It attracts attention. Hurry, fix it before someone sees!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我不喜欢这样。机器无缘无故坏掉，太可疑了，肯定会招来麻烦。快点，趁还没人发现，赶紧把它修好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The King has these generators built, and then he lets them go to rack and ruin. Get it running again. Give me a taste of his power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 国王命人造了这些发电机，却任由它们变成一堆破铜烂铁。重新启动这台发电机，让我也感受一下他的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Fix this blasted generator! I'm going to find whoever let it break down in the first place, and WHIP THEM RAW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 快把这破烂发电机修好！等我揪出那个让它坏掉的罪魁祸首，一定把那家伙抽得皮开肉绽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: If this ruin could flow with power again, perhaps this purgatory may hold just a little warmth for one such as me. Will you make it right? I hardly dare to ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 如果这片废墟能够重新焕发力量，或许这座炼狱还能为我这样的人留存一丝温暖。你能修好它吗？我简直都不敢奢求。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A broken-down generator. What a useful metaphor for the isolated soul! Reconnect it, and reconnect the currents of your own heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 一台坏掉的发电机，多像一颗与世隔绝的心啊！把它重新接通，也让你内心的暖流再次涌动起来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I think this generator pumps the air in Duviri. And it's... broken? Oh Void. I can't breathe. My head's spinning. I'm going to die. Fix it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我觉得这台发电机是给双衍王境供氧的。可它……坏了？哦，虚空啊，我喘不上气了，还头晕眼花。我要死了，赶紧修好它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Execution was far too kind. I should have set you on a treadmill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 直接处死你简直太仁慈了。就该把你拴在踏车上当一辈子苦力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You are no hero. You are merely... an errand runner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你算什么英雄？你不过是个……跑腿的杂役。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Are you not degraded by such work? I shall never understand the common mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 干这种杂活你就不觉得有失身份吗？本王永远也理解不了凡夫俗子的想法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh. I was hoping you'd fry yourself alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦……啧，本来还指望你能把自己活活电死呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: For that, Drifter, I shall break something of yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 漂泊者，既然如此，本王也要毁掉你的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That witch Luscinia's poured poison in the King's ear with her harpy's verse. After all, I've done for the arts they mean to kill me! Stop his ingrate thugs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 路西尼娅那个老妖婆，用她女妖般的歌声蛊惑了国王！我为艺术鞠躬尽瘁，他们竟想置我于死地！快拦住国王那帮忘恩负义的暴徒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Look: They died with my name on their lips.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 瞧啊，他们临死前，嘴里都还在高呼本王的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The imp's grown suspicious of me. His spies approach even now to *surveil*. ME! One more BUCKET OF PISS splashed in my face for the world to see. Take care of this before we're both in the stocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那小魔头对我起疑心了，派来的眼线已经在路上。竟敢监视……我！这纯粹是当众往我脸上泼尿！在咱们俩被扔进大牢前，赶紧把他们解决掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The hollow ones mock my pain. Find out whether their hearts can be broken.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些内心空洞的人，竟敢嘲笑我的痛苦。去看看，他们的心是不是也会破碎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Either you keep stewing over your grudges against the King's Dax, or you channel that energy into something positive. It's up to you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你要么一直揪着对那些禁卫的怨气不放，要么把这股火气化成行动，做点积极的改变。你自己选！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Dax know EVERYTHING! Why did you let them find out our plan? You've got to wipe them out, quickly! Come on! Let's get cutting throats!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫什么都知道了！你怎么能让他们发现我们的计划？赶紧把他们全部杀光！快去啊！去割断他们的喉咙！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Hah! 'Dax'. She has them wrapped around her little finger. "Oh boys, go smack Bombastine's bot-bot for me." They won't be expecting YOU.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哈！还「禁卫」呢，结果全被她玩弄于股掌之间。「小伙子们，替我去狠狠打蓬蓬士君的屁屁吧。」可他们绝不会料到，这次碰上的会是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You shall have to do away with a greater number than that to trouble me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 想让本王为此烦心，光杀这么几个可远远不够。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The imp thinks he can send his clanking cretins to haul ME away? As if I were nothing but a filthy tam-snaffler? RIP THEIR ARMS AND LEGS OFF!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那小魔头以为派几个哐当作响的蠢货，就能把我押走？真把我当成下三滥的毛贼了吗？！把他们的胳膊腿儿全给我卸了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Dax. Responsible for so. Much. Sadness. And yet they have rarely answered for it. Redress the balance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫，那么多苦难，都拜他们所赐。可他们几乎从未受到应有的惩罚。去讨回这份公道吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Dax hurt you. Give yourself permission to hurt them back. It's what you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫伤害过你。别再逼自己忍着，痛痛快快地还回去吧。你需要的正是发泄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: It's only a matter of time before the Dax find out what we're up to. There's a bunch of them nearby, acting suspicious. You need to get them before they get us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫迟早会发现我们的计划。附近那群人鬼鬼祟祟的，你得在他们动手前，先下手为强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I've often wondered what power the Otherworld spirits could offer a man like me. Nothing ventured, nothing gained... rebuild one of the lost shrines and let's see what happens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我时常在想，那些异界灵魂能赋予我这般人物什么样的力量。不入虎穴，焉得虎子……去重建一座失落的神龛，看看会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: If I have to summon the ghosts of the past to back up my claim to the throne, I WILL! All YOU need to do is put the shrine back together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 如果非得召来祖先的鬼魂，才能证明王位本就该属于我，那我也在所不惜！你只管把神龛重新修好就成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The monuments to the lost now lie in ruins. If you could reassemble one, just one... it might make a difference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那些为逝者而立的纪念碑，如今都已沦为废墟。如果你能重建一座，哪怕只有一座……或许都能带来些许改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Someone's left that shrine in disrepair. It doesn't matter who. If you truly want to be happy, you need to be the bigger person and mend it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 瞧瞧那座神龛，都被糟蹋成什么样了。是谁干的不重要，但如果你真心渴望快乐，就该大度一点，主动把它修好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: There's a broken shrine nearby. That's bad. Leave a shrine broken, and THINGS will come after you. All bony hands and snaking tongues and... Please. Put it back together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 附近有座破损的神龛，这可不是好兆头。如果放任不管，那些东西就会找上门来。骨爪嶙峋的手，还有蜿蜒蠕动的舌头……拜托了，快把它修好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That meddlesome witch Acrithis says there is hidden knowledge in the old shrines. Assemble one. She can't keep it all for herself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那个爱管闲事的女巫言录使说，古老的神龛里藏着隐秘的知识。去重建一座出来，她休想独吞这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The relics of my ancestors, shattered! He's trying to erase my proof of ancestry! Rebuild my great-grandmother's shrine AT ONCE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我祖先的遗物，居然被砸了个粉碎！他这是想抹除老子的血统证明！快点！赶紧修好我曾祖母的神龛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: A gravestone is a sorrowful sight, but sadder still is the rubble where a stone once stood. Let them not be forgotten kind Drifter, rebuild.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 墓碑固然令人哀伤，但更令人心碎的，是墓碑倒塌后剩下的一地碎石。善良的漂泊者，别让逝者被遗忘。请将它重建起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: That shrine's broken. The easy thing to do would be to let someone else fix it. But that wouldn't make you happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那座神龛已经残破不堪。交给别人修当然最省事，可那样做，并不会让你感到快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: There's a shrine. And I thought it was cursed. So I broke it. Into bits. And now I think I'm cursed. Just.. just put it back together for Void's sake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这里有座神龛。我以为它受了诅咒，就把它……砸得粉碎。可现在，我觉得自己反而中了诅咒。看在虚空的份上，快帮我把它修好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Play with fire, burn your fingers. Will you ever learn?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 玩火者必自焚，你能不能长点记性？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Now whatever made you think that was a good idea?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你到底为什么会觉得，那是个好主意？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I declared the Shrines forbidden because I know better than you do. Do not test me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 下令封禁这些神龛，自然有本王的道理。别来试探本王的耐心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You seem more apt to stacking alphabet blocks, I think you would agree.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你还是更适合去玩字母积木，这点你自己也心知肚明吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Look at the beautiful Wyrmlings! How loyal they are!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 瞧瞧这些漂亮的魇龙幼体！它们多忠心啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The little ones would gladly die for their creator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 这些小家伙心甘情愿为它们的造物主赴死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Wyrmlings only emerge when fresh meat is nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 只有闻到鲜肉味，魇龙幼体才会现身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Find a way to stop its spawn!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 想办法阻止那些魇龙幼体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The King expects me to do my best work on a pittance. You can see how unjust that is, can't you? I refuse to live in penury! Fetch me some more suitable reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 国王拿这点可怜的薪酬，就妄想我倾尽心血。你说，这公平吗？我绝不过这种穷困日子！快去给我找些像样的奖赏来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Double the bounty on that thieving scum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 把那窃贼的赏金翻一倍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Our kingly imp's got something precious of mine, and I want it back. Find that boot-licking treasurer's stash!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 咱们那位小魔头国王抢走了我的珍宝，我要把它夺回来。去找出那个马屁精司库的藏宝处！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Others find comfort in material things. Seek them out for me, my dark angel, that I might drown my misery in excess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 有些人喜欢在物质上寻求安慰。我的黑暗天使，去为我搜寻一番吧，好让我用奢靡来麻痹这无尽的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The King can't find out what we're doing here. Oh Void. What if he already suspects? We'll have to make it look like a simple robbery. You don't mind stealing, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 绝不能让国王发现我们在这里做什么。虚空啊……万一他已经起疑了呢？我们得把这一切伪装成一场普通的盗窃。你不介意当回贼，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I shall simply have to kill you and take it back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 那本王只好杀了你，再把东西拿回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I shall extract its value out of your stinking hide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 本王会扒了你这副臭皮囊，把它的价值一分不少地榨出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Oh! A pretender and a thief. What a worm you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哦！装模作样，还偷鸡摸狗。你可真是条可怜虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: What dragon is Envy? A hunger never sated, a gift never enough. It darkens the sunny days with a wanting that never is met.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 嫉妒会化作怎样的魇龙？它是永远无法填满的饥渴，再多恩赐也嫌不够。它以无休无止的欲求，为晴空蒙上阴霾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The fire within Lodun was his Anger. Unable to control it, thus, was he consumed. Behold the great dragon of Lodun!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 隆沌心中的烈焰便是他的怒火。他无法驾驭，最终反被其吞噬。看呐，隆沌所化的魇龙来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Sadness is the dragon that devours itself. It spawns many children - lethargy, self-pity, self-doubt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 悲伤是一条吞噬自身的魇龙。它会滋生出消沉、自怜与自我怀疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Tales of Duviri
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 《双衍王境故事集》，一份给扎里曼先驱者后代的情感指南。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Happiness becomes a dragon when you allow it to master you. The indulgent, the cowardly, the indolent... to whose skirts do they cling?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 当你任由快乐支配自己，它便会化作一条魇龙。那些贪图享乐、怯懦、懒散的人……又都躲在谁的庇护之下呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: For an instant, as she shed her pitiful human form, Sythel was no longer afraid, for she had become fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 就在褪去那副可悲人形的一瞬，袭幽终于不再害怕。因为，她已经化作了恐惧本身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Subdue Lodun's Orowyrm before all Duviri is consumed by his anger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 制服化身奥金魇龙的隆沌，别让他的怒火吞噬整个双衍王境。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Lodun is filled with fury. He will scorch the earth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 隆沌满腔怒火，欲将这片大地焚烧殆尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Orowyrm Bombastine is as jealous as his master. He craves the validation of victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 化身奥金魇龙的蓬蓬士君，与他本人一样嫉妒成性。他渴望用胜利来证明自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Bombastine's bitter envy seethes with venom and spite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 蓬蓬士君心中的嫉妒翻腾不休，尽是恶意与怨恨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: All Duviri lives in terror of the Orowyrm Sythel. Subdue her so that Duviri may have calm, if only for a day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 化身奥金魇龙的袭幽令整个双衍王境陷入恐惧。去制服她，哪怕只为这里换来一时安宁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Orowyrm Sythel flies in the stark terror of the storm, lightning-fanged. All fear her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 化身奥金魇龙的袭幽翱翔于骇人的风暴之中，獠牙间雷光闪动。无人不畏惧她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mathila's Orowyrm seeks to inflict her idea of happiness on all of Duviri. Subdue this tyranny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 玛蒂拉所化的奥金魇龙，正在将她所谓的幸福强加给整个双衍王境。去制止这场暴行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Mathila the Orowyrm rejoices in her dominion. The Void itself is her plaything today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 化身奥金魇龙的玛蒂拉，正沉醉在自己的统治之中。如今，就连虚空也成了她手中的玩物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Luscinia's coils are wracked with sorrow on this day. Her heart is ice, her breath a blizzard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 如今，悲伤缠绕着路西尼娅的身躯。她心如寒冰，吐息如雪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The Wyrm of Sorrow is ravening with despair. She will make all Duviri mourn with her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 哀之魇龙已被绝望吞噬。她要让整个双衍王境陪她一同哀恸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I'm will not be 'kept in my place' by swaggering bullies! Just because I wasn't born with strength of arm, they feel like they can push me around? Teach them that my worth and talent are worth far more than their... engorged biceps!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我绝不会任由那些耀武扬威的恶霸把我踩在脚下！就因为我手无缚鸡之力，他们就觉得能骑到我头上？去教训教训他们，我出众的才华可比他们那……发达的四肢值钱多了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: The king's bounty has risen on both of our heads! You'll need to deal with this before we go any further.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 国王把咱们俩的悬赏金又往上提了！在继续之前，你得先把这麻烦解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: In my time as the King's captive songbird there have been many jailors... many tormentors. One of them now walks nearby. Let them taste the bitterness I have lived with all these years!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 被囚作国王笼中歌鸟的这些年，我见过太多狱卒……也受过太多折磨。如今其中一人就在附近。让那人也尝尝我多年承受的苦楚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Dax Officers are meant to set a good example for the rest of us. This one needs to be punished. Think how happy she'll be when she's learned her lesson!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 禁卫军官本该给大家做个好榜样，可这一位得好好惩罚一下。想想看，等她吸取教训后，该有多开心呀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I feel sick. The King suspects. I'm sure of it. He's going to send an assassin after me. Any moment now. You have to get to the assassin first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我感觉不对劲。我很确定，国王已经起疑了。他随时都会派刺客来暗杀我。你必须先找到那名刺客。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I cannot abide a bully, especially not a bully in uniform. Teach that Dax Officer not to push the little people around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 我可受不了恃强凌弱，尤其还是穿着制服逞威风。去给那位禁卫军官上一课，别总想着欺负弱小。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Ah. My fallen friend. You shall be avenged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 啊，我倒下的挚友。本王定会为你报仇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: Well. He failed me. So he's better off dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 算了，他既然辜负了本王，死了反倒更好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: You! How dare you! He was better than you! Finer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 你好大的胆子！他可比你强多了！也比你优秀得多……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.text: I had such high hopes for that one. Ah well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriBounties.zhText: 本王原本对他寄予厚望。唉，罢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, warrior-born,
From his mother's breast he was torn.
Doomed to go wandering all forlorn,
Kullervo, Kullervo, made to mourn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，天生的战士，
从母亲的怀中被强行扯离。
注定要孤苦伶仃地流浪，
Kullervo，Kullervo，为忧伤而生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, swaddled in lies,
Raised to a life of groans and cries,
Took to his task with sorrowing sighs,
Kullervo, Kullervo, death was your prize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，被谎言包裹着，
在呻吟和哭泣中长大，
带着悲伤的叹息担负起他的任务，
Kullervo，Kullervo，死亡是你的奖赏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, sworn to the sword,
Sweated and slaved for the head of the horde,
Bruised and bludgeoned and scarred and gored,
Kullervo, Kullervo, warrior's ward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，对剑起誓，
为了部落首领，他汗流浃背，饱受奴役，
遍体鳞伤，血肉模糊，
Kullervo，Kullervo，战士的守护者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, far he strayed.
Lips to the steel he blessed and prayed,
Whispered promises that boy made!
Kullervo, Kullervo, friend to the blade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，他漂泊远方。
嘴唇对着武器，他祝福又祈祷，
那男孩低声许下诺言！
Kullervo，Kullervo，刀剑之友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, ragged and thin,
Tracked back the path so steeped in sin,
All the way back where it did begin,
Kullervo, Kullervo, sought for his kin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，衣衫褴褛，消瘦如柴，
追溯那条深陷罪孽的道路，
一直回到它开始的地方，
Kullervo，Kullervo，寻找他的亲人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, burdens he bore,
Many the woes and horrors he saw!
Tyrants and conquerors ravaging the poor,
Kullervo, Kullervo, witness to war.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，背负着重担，
他目睹了太多的苦难和恐怖！
暴君和征服者践踏着贫民，
Kullervo，Kullervo，战争的见证者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, stranger to mirth,
Spoke with the ragged who toiled in the earth,
Learned of the truth of the days of his birth,
Kullervo, Kullervo, what was he worth?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，对欢笑如此陌生，
与在地里辛苦劳作的穷苦人交谈，
得知了他出生时的真相，
Kullervo，Kullervo，他的价值何在？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, stood all alone
Over the graves of the ones he'd known.
Homestead warmth turned to ashes and bone,
Kullervo, Kullervo, cold as a stone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，孤身一人站在
他曾熟识的人们的墓地上，
家园的温暖化作灰烬与白骨，
Kullervo，Kullervo，心寒如石。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, broke like a flood,
Ripped and he ravaged with a slash-slice-thud!
Many lay headless, armless, in the mud,
Kullervo, Kullervo, bathed in blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，犹如洪水倾泻，
肆意撕杀，手起刀落！
多少失首缺臂者，横卧泥中，
Kullervo，Kullervo，沐浴在鲜血中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Kullervo, Kullervo, long did he weep,
In his own breast his sword drove deep.
Down to the dark and a merciful sleep,
Kullervo, Kullervo, your secrets we keep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
Kullervo，Kullervo，悲痛欲绝，
他的剑深深地刺入了自己的胸膛。
深深地进入了黑暗且安详的长眠，
Kullervo，Kullervo，我们为你保守秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text:
Did you hear? Kullervo's Hold can be sighted just off the mainland! The place is steeped in anger, sorrow, and fear, so you only need to wait for one of our King's darker moods.

My archives note that the island was first formed when a ball of fire descended from the sky! It bored a hole straight through the ground, and from the tainted debris, a dungeon spontaneously arose, complete with Warden to berate its sole prisoner, the Warframe Kullervo, for his many crimes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText:
你听说了吗？在大陆近海就能望见 Kullervo 的牢房！那里浸透了愤怒、悲伤与恐惧，只要等士魂大帝陷入阴郁情绪，它就会现身。

据我的档案记载，这座岛最初由一团从天而降的火球造就！它径直贯穿了地面，一座地牢随即从污浊的残骸中凭空拔地而起，里面甚至还有一名典狱长，专门斥责唯一的囚犯，战甲 Kullervo，历数他犯下的种种罪行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: A dungeon island is all well and good, but what happens if there's a prison break?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 监狱岛固然不错，可万一有人越狱呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo appears to hail from that bizarre land that I am convinced lies beyond the Zariman. A violent and cold place that our captive must have been in a hurry to escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo 似乎来自那片诡异之地，而我一直深信，那地方就在「扎里曼号」之外。那里寒冷而残酷，我们这位囚徒想必也是匆忙逃离了那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo did not arrive empty-handed. No, it seems he brought with him the burdensome weight of a guilty conscience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo 可不是空手而来的。他还把沉甸甸的负罪感一并带来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: When Kullervo escapes, no one seems to be safe, save the children. They calm him. Perhaps that's why so many of them are drawn to the island.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo 越狱后，除了孩子，没有人是安全的。孩子们能让他平静下来。或许正因如此，才有那么多孩子受到吸引，来到那座岛上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: I'd steer clear of Kullervo's Hold if I were you. It is no safe place, no matter how tantalizing the details of Kullervo's crimes may seem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 我要是你，就会离 Kullervo 的牢房远一点。就算你再想知道 Kullervo 犯过什么罪，那里也绝不是安全之地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: That Warden is a repugnant, self-righteous man, speaking as though he too came from beyond the Zariman, but deep down both he and I are well aware, he is of Duviri. Of the Void. We know our own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 那个典狱长实在令人厌恶，又自以为是。他说起话来，仿佛自己也来自「扎里曼号」之外。可说到底，我和他都心知肚明，他属于双衍王境，也属于虚空。同类总是能认出同类来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: From the mainland, I use my looking glass to spy on Kullervo's Hold. Have you noticed the children? What draws them there, I wonder? What redeeming value do they see in that terrible place?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 我常在大陆上用望远镜窥探 Kullervo 的牢房。你注意到那些孩子了吗？我一直在想，究竟是什么吸引他们去那里？那样可怕的地方，在他们眼里到底有什么好？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Have you been to Kullervo's Hold yet? You should not go, it is far too perilous… But if you do… Tell me everything. Promise?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你去过 Kullervo 的牢房了吗？千万别去，那里实在太危险了。不过，你要是真去了……一定要把一切都告诉我，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Have you noticed that Kullervo's Hold only comes into view when the king is overcome with fear, anger, or sorrow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你有没有发现，只有在士魂大帝被恐惧、愤怒或悲伤吞没时，Kullervo 的牢房才会显现？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: You, Kullervo, thought an Executor's favor was a thing to be stolen and worn. You spilled precious Orokin blood - before seeking the Executor out for approval. Hated Kullervo, did you truly believe he could love you? You are, forevermore, a low murderer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你，Kullervo，你以为执行者的恩惠是可以被偷来佩戴的是吗。在寻求执行者的认可之前，你就已经洒下了珍贵的奥罗金人的鲜血。可恨的Kullervo，难道你真的以为他会爱你吗？从此以后，你将永远是一个卑劣的凶手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: You witnessed the slaughter as the Orokin eradicated your defective, demented brothers and sisters... and did nothing to aid them, choosing to tremble in your cowardly seclusion. A traitor twice over. Kullervo, bloody-handed, I charge you with Cowardice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你目睹了那场屠杀，目睹了那场奥罗金人将你有缺陷的、癫狂错乱的兄弟姐妹们赶尽杀绝…而你却无动于衷，你什么都没做，只选择懦弱的在隐蔽中颤抖。你是个叛徒，背叛了两次。Kullervo，血手，我控告你是一个懦夫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The Archimedean Ainikki, your... 'mother'... lived. And you, like the vermin you are, scurried after her. In butchering the Dax whom the Executors charged with taking you into just custody, you - laughably - managed to kill the very woman you came to rescue. The third charge: Flight From Just Custody.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 哲士，你的…母亲……活了下来。而你，就像你的害虫一样，跟在她后面匆忙追随着她。执行官指派了禁卫前来抓捕你，你想要杀死那禁卫，然而在杀他的过程中，你竟然荒谬地错杀了你原本要来解救的那个女人。第三项指控：逃离合法监管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Upon the arrival of the wretched Tenno, you struck. Out of, what, a desire for redemption? You thought to strike the Orokin where it hurt: their laboratories, their edifices of government, their homes. To distract. To buy time. Idiot. You are charged with Treason.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 从那可悲的 Tenno 的到来开始，你就出手发动了攻击。你这是出于什么呢，是想要赎罪？还是你认为应该打击奥罗金帝国所最在乎的：他们的实验室，他们政府的建筑，他们的家园。为了分散注意力，为了争取时间。白痴。你被指控叛国罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: You saw the new generation of your kind, and the Tenno whose deviltry blent with theirs; and you began to whisper corruption into their ears, weave dark thoughts through the coils of their minds. Incepting, as is your wont, chaos, and disaster. You are charged with Espionage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你看到过你们种族的新一代，也看到过与他们的邪恶融为一体的 Tenno；你开始向他们的耳边低语一些腐化之恶词，在他们的脑海中编织了黑暗思绪穿插入他们纠结的思维之中。按照你惯常的方式，潜入混乱与灾难。你被指控犯有间谍罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The Night of the Naga Drums. Your incepted chaos... bloomed... and the beautiful gilded Empire... fell. Were you entirely responsible? Of course not. You are, after all, a fool. But one need not be entirely responsible for the murder of an empire to be punished for their role in it. And punished you shall be. For a second count of Treason.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 长胴鼓之夜。你引发的混乱……绽放的如此绚烂……美丽的镀金帝国……就这么倒塌，覆灭了。这一切全部都是你的错吗？当然不是了。毕竟，你是一个傻瓜。不过，一个人虽然不需要对帝国的灭亡负全责，但也会因为其参与其中而受到惩罚。没错你将会受到惩罚。罪名是因第二次叛国罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: As the Empire burned, you found the one Executor you coveted and despised most. You presumed to raise your foul hand against him. One of the Seven. But he did not die so readily as you had hoped. Thus I lay upon your wretched head your ultimate crime: Attempted Regicide. And with it your punishment, and the Executor's eternal vengeance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 当帝国燃烧之时，你找到了那个你最渴望同时又最鄙视的一位执行官。你竟然妄想着伸出那污秽的手去刺杀他，七人众之一。然而他却并没有像你所希望的那样轻易地死去。因此我将你最终的罪名加诸于你那可怜的头上：企图刺杀国王。这是对你的惩罚，并且也是执行官永恒的复仇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Execute the brute! Don't spar with him, you worthless collaborator! Fool. You gave him precisely what he wanted. Dignity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 处决这个畜生！别和他纠缠，你这个没用的同谋者！蠢货。你正好给了他他想要的。尊严。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo… Kneeling? What did this Drifter do to deserve your respect? Do you think you've won? Well? Answer me! AN-SWER MEEE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo……下跪？这个漂泊者究竟做了什么值得你这样尊敬他？你觉得你赢了是吗？是吗？回答我，回答我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The beast is loose. Intent once again on mindless slaughter. Put it down, that both the innocent and the dead may sleep peacefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 野兽被放出来了，意图再一次进行盲目的屠杀。把它解决掉，这样无辜的人和死者都能安详入眠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo ravages Duviri once again. Extinguish his spirit as I once did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo 再次在双衍王境中肆虐。正如我曾经做的，消灭他的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Now, fool Kullervo, for your crimes do you feel the lash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 现在，愚蠢的 Kullervo，你会因为你的罪行而受到鞭笞之罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: No escape, Kullervo. My reach is long, my grip inescapable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 没有逃脱的机会，Kullervo。我的控制力延伸至远方，无法逃脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: This now-tired spectacle no longer delights mine eyes. End this, castspaw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 这场如今已令人厌倦的表演已经不再能取悦我的双眼了。结束这一切，工具人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Just one more defeat amongst countless, Kullervo. When oh when shall you learn this most obvious of lessons and remain low?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 一次又一次，只是在无数败绩中再添一笔。你要什么时候才能学到这最明显的教训，保持低调呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: He feels your wrath, Drifter. Yes. Continue. Tame his.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 他感受到了你的愤怒，漂泊者。是的。继续。驯服他的愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Each time you rise, betrayer, fool, each time it is I who shall cast you down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 每一次你站起来，背叛者，傻瓜，每一次都是我狠狠把你打倒在地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: They fear this berzerking... 'Kullervo'. Hm. Calm him... calm him and ensure that idiot Warden does not kill him. I would make use of this Kullervo... at a future time of my choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 他们害怕这个暴走的……"Kullervo"。嗯。让他冷静……让他冷静下来，并确保那个白痴监狱长不会杀了他。我打算利用这个 刀锋囚徒……就在我选定的未来的某一刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo is a kindred spirit. He rages with a bitter fury I cannot sing back to sleep. Only a warrior's challenge will do that. Grant him the tranquility I have been denied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo 是心灵相通的伙伴。他充满了我无法平息的痛苦愤怒。只有勇士的挑战才能使之平静。请赐予他我从未得到的宁静。
