/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: I'm too scared to give Kullervo what he truly needs, so he can rest. The challenge of an equal! Oh, but you, you're strong. You can do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 我好怕，我不敢给 Kullervo 他真正需要的，这样他就能休息了。一场实力相当的对决！哦，但你，你很强。你可以的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Like knows like. This Kullervo has more spirit than any lickspittle calling itself a Dax. But it will destroy him, if not tamped, measured. Provide his righteous rage the dignity it deserves, in martial combat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 同类相识。这个 Kullervo 比任何自称禁卫的阿谀奉承者都更加有意志。但是，如果没有办法抑制和全权掌控，那么它将毁掉他。在战斗中，给予他应有的尊严。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The tormented Kullervo deserves to be known. To know peace. Give him back his dignity and free him from the Warden's savage cruelty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 受尽折磨的 Kullervo，理应被世人所知道。让他安息，还给他尊严，让他摆脱典狱长的野蛮和残暴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The Warden cages Kullervo, pokes at him, stokes his rage. Putting us all in danger. Give Kullervo what he needs. The honor of a fair fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 监狱长把 Kullervo 关起来，戏弄他，激起他的怒火。把我们都置于危险之中。给 Kullervo 他需要的。一场公平战斗的荣誉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Duviri has changed. You may have your freedom, but a new prisoner has come amongst us. A tormented soul. This dark day is his as much as mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 双衍王境已发生变化。你可能会得到自由，但是，我们之间出现了一个新的囚徒。一个折磨的灵魂。在这个黑暗的日子里，他和我的命运，一样悲惨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo a being imprisoned and tortured by the guilt of his past. I too am condemned to a fate, Drifter. But together we may lighten the burdens of others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo，一个被囚禁和受折磨的人，因为他无法摆脱过去的罪孽。我也注定要遭受同样的命运，漂泊者。但是我们…或许可以一起减轻他人的负担。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Vaenn belongs to Kullervo! I'm hiding it from The Warden. You have to promise not to tell anyone, okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 婉剑是 Kullervo 的！我对监狱长隐瞒了它。你得保证不告诉任何人，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: I hear Vaenn whisper sometimes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 有时候我听见婉剑的低语。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Don't worry, Vaenn. They're just passing by.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 别担心，婉剑。他们只是路过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The Warden will never find us. Not all the way down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 监狱长不可能找到我们。尤其是在这么深的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: A consignment of fine trinkets, waylaid and rudely pitched into the caverns below? Some hapless merchant's loss is my gain! Drifter, if you please?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 一批精美的饰品，被人拦路抢劫，粗暴地扔进了下面的洞穴？一个倒霉商人的损失就是我的收获！漂泊者，愿意知道更多吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: I'm sure that simpering homonculus thought scattering my royal effects would put a stop to my ambitions. Oh no. Not when I have you to find them for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 我敢肯定，那个假惺惺的虚构小人以为把我的王室财物散落一地就能阻止我的野心。哦，不可能。我有你帮我找回它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Are we to leave the treasures of the past mouldering where they fell? No. I pray you, gather them up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 难道我们要任由过去的宝藏就这样留在原地发霉吗？不，我祈求你们把它们收集起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: We need to keep things where they belong! And is a mucky, nasty cave any place for precious items? It assuredly is not!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 我们应该把东西放在它们该在的地方！一个又脏又乱的洞穴能放珍贵的东西吗？显然不能啊。这是无可辩驳的事实！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: What kind of idiot robs a tomb? I saw them. Taking the grave-goods into a cave. Fetch them back. Before the dead... get... upset.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 到底有什么样的白痴会去盗墓？我看到他们了。把陪葬品带到一个山洞里。在逝者……难过……之前。把那些东西拿回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The indulgence of desire occasionally demands a frenzied scrimmage in the dirt. I covet certain gewgawgs. Fetch them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 某些时候，追求与欲望需要闹得不可开交。我觊觎着一些小玩意。去找吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: His Majesty' doesn't like the caves. 'His Majesty' is afraid of the dark. Weakling. Go and find me the treasures he's too gutless to claim.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 陛下不喜欢洞穴。"陛下"害怕黑暗。此为懦弱！去为我寻找他因胆怯而未能取回的珍宝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: A family robbed, their belongings taken underground and divided. If you could retrieve what little was left... it might ease their pain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 一个家庭被抢劫了，他们的财产被转移到地下并被瓜分，如果你能找回所剩无几的东西……也许，能减轻他们的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Some sentimental old items of mine have turned up in one of the caves. Would you be a dear and gather them? I'm not quite up for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 是这样我有一些承载着感情的老物件儿出现在了其中一个洞穴里。您能不能过去把它们收集起来？我现在实在是不想过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Pretty trinkets. Underground. What if children go down there looking for them? What if something... bad... happens? There, in the dark? Get those trinkets!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 漂亮的小饰品。在地底下。要是小孩子们去那找到它们怎么办？万一要是，要是在那黑暗中发生什么……不好的事……怎么办？拿走那些小饰品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: He's waiting for you, Drifter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 他正等着你呢，漂泊者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo is right down there. Or are you having second thoughts?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo 就在下面。或者你还有些其他的想法？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: A wise decision.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 明智的决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: I didn't think so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 我就知道你不想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: I keep him locked up here for his own safety, and that of all Duviri. Care to find out why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 我把他关在这里，是为了他自己和整个双衍王境的安全。想知道为什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The prisoner seems to think you and he have unfinished business. Shall I let him out so that you can conclude it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 看来囚犯觉得你和他还有未了结的事情。我要不要放他出来，这样你们就可以解决呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Do not block my light.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 不要挡住我的阳光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Do not eye me so venomously. I do not know you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 别这么恶毒地盯着我。我不认识你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: What are you? Beggar, lunatic, or monarch clad in rags? Ugh. Trouble me not, chimera.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你是什么人？乞丐、疯子还是衣衫褴褛的君主？啊，不要过来烦我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Children. Idiot children who clap and cheer. What is he to them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 孩子们。那些愚蠢又喜欢鼓掌的孩子，他对他们来说意味着什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Is the wretch howling again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 这个可怜虫又在嚎叫了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: How our ungrateful creations spurn us, once they have taken all they can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 那些不知感恩的创造物，一旦得到了能获得的一切，就会背弃我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Every day he suffers afresh. And so, my purpose is fulfilled. Happy am I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 他每天都在遭受新的痛苦。就这样，我的目的…达到了。我…很快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Again and again, Kullervo revealed the slaughter-drunk beast he was. Again and again, I locked him away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 一次又一次，Kullervo 揭示了他曾是一个醉心屠戮的野兽。一次又一次，我把他关了起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Kullervo. His mother, Ainikki named him well. Cursed from the moment of his creation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: Kullervo。他的母亲艾妮基真是给他起了个好名字。他从被创造的那一刻起就被诅咒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Rage until you burst, Kullervo. You shall never taste freedom again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 怒火中烧吧，Kullervo。你将永远不会再尝到自由的滋味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Society produces filth. We do not rehabilitate it. We hide it away, to stink and fester out of the sight of decent folk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 社会会制造出污秽。我们并不对其进行改正。我们把它隐藏起来，让它在正人君子看不到的地方腐烂发臭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: You crave the sun, Kullervo. But the sun is mine. Squat in your dull stone prison and sob.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你渴望阳光，Kullervo。但阳光是我的。你就蹲在这沉闷的石狱里静静哭泣吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The fool sought oblivion. As if I could not pursue him wherever he went! I, his conscience. His jailer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 这个傻瓜寻求被遗忘。好像无论他走到哪里我都无法追踪到他似的！我，是他的良心。他的狱守。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: See where he rots. The mother-killer. The betrayer. The ingrate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 看看他败坏的地方。那个弑母的人。那个背信弃义、忘恩负义的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: You cannot improve a criminal nature. You may as well be sculpting angels out of dung.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你想改善罪犯的天性，那是不可能的。那你还不如拿粪便雕刻成天使的样子更简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: The brats are at their chanting. Were the King himself not a child, I would have them all hung.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 那些小鬼们正在反复吟唱。如果国王本身不是个孩子，我会让他们全部吊死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: Do not pity the beast! He knows what he did. He cannot forget. That is the nail I force back into his skull every day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 不要怜悯这个野兽！他知道他做了什么。他无法忘记。那就是我每天都钉在他脑子里让他无法忘记的那根刺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.text: You cannot deny your sin, Kullervo. For I am your guilt. The form and voice of your greatest persecutor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriKullervo.zhText: 你无法否认你的罪孽，Kullervo。因为我即是你罪孽的见证。以你最大迫害者的形式和声音存在着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: You have angered Thrax, and because he is a creature of emotion, his world follows. From the Duviri Tales... 'The Prince of Fire.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你激怒了士魂大帝。他受情绪支配，所以他的世界也会随之狂躁。出自《双衍童话》之……「烈焰王子」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Here they come!
Here they come!
Here they come!
Here they come!
Be wary. In the story, the king's men had blades of molten steel!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 小心。故事里，国王麾下的士兵用的是熔钢之刃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Do you feel it? Nearby? The paradox you seek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 感觉到了吗？你要找的悖论就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Good. Return to me when you are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 很好。准备好了就回来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I guess we're born with anger. An instinct like any other. Like squinting at the sun or... flinching from a burn... but some of us... maybe we learn it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我想，愤怒大概如同与生俱来的本能。就像直视太阳时会眯起眼睛，或者被烫到时会猛然缩手。但对有些人来说……也许愤怒是后来才学会的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I guess we're born with anger. An instinct like any other. Like squinting at the sun or… flinching from a burn… but some of us… maybe we learn it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我想，愤怒大概如同与生俱来的本能。就像直视太阳时会眯起眼睛，或者被烫到时会猛然缩手。但对有些人来说……也许愤怒是后来才学会的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Maybe this will help you relax?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 也许这能帮你放松放松？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Haha... what's gotten into you... where's that apathy I've come to love?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 哈哈，你这是怎么了……我喜欢的那副冷漠劲去哪儿了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Wake up, Tenno.
Right now, you're thinking... is this real? Or some fevered dream...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 此刻，你一定在想……这是真实的吗？亦或只是一场怪诞离奇的梦……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I'm wondering why the hell this all feels so damn familiar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 真是见鬼了，我只是想知道所有的这一切，怎么会感觉如此的眼熟。这到底，为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Emotions. They guide where others fail. The king's spiral takes away time… experience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 情感，在别无依凭时，仍会为你指路。国王的复眠螺旋夺走了时间……也夺走了历练。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: You don't seem like the others.
You don't seem like the others.
You don't seem like the others.
You don't seem like the others.
I am Teshin.
Oh! And this is... well, it was you that named her... remember?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 哦！还有她……嗯，她的名字是你取的……还记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: You know you cannot run from here with Thrax on the throne. But by all means, try again. I'll even give you my blades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你清楚，只要士魂大帝仍在王座，你就逃不出这里。但无论结果怎么样，再去试一次吧。我甚至可以把我的双刃交给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Until the next spiral, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 那么，等下个复眠螺旋再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Did someone make a new friend? Trying to make me jealous, are you? I'll find him soon enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 有人交到新朋友了？想让我嫉妒，是吗？我很快就会把他揪出来。

—some fevered dream. Alright, Teshin. I'll try it your way.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你想起来了。很好，现在开始吧。

You saw that ship in the sky... The Zariman. Our child king must be one of those who was abandoned there. A Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你看见天上那艘船了……那是「扎里曼号」。我们那位年幼的国王，想必就是一个当年被遗弃在那里的人，一名 Tenno 。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: You said the Tenno are trying to help me... this paradox stuff. Now you're saying Thrax is one of them? He doesn't seem too helpful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你说过 Tenno 是想帮我……才弄出这些悖论。现在你又说士魂大帝也是他们的一员？他可不像是来帮忙的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: The history I know... that Zariman ship returned from the Void, bringing with it the extraordinary power the Tenno command. But here is a different path, I suppose. A difference in parallel. A paradox in itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 在我熟知的历史中……那艘「扎里曼号」从虚空归来，同时也带回来了由 Tenno 所掌控的非凡力量。可在这里，同一段历史似乎走向了另一种不同的结果。这本身，就是一个悖论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: The world above changes every day following what Thrax feels. Ready yourself for the next day and consider what you have learned...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 地面的世界每日都会随着士魂大帝的心绪而发生改变。好好回想一下你今日的所学，为明日做好准备……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: The day has not changed. The king's mood is the same. I suggest you head back to the Undercroft and hone your skills.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 这一日还未结束，国王的心境依然如故。我建议你回到地穴，继续磨练你的技艺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Well, it seems that Thrax woke on the right side of his crib today...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 好吧，看来士魂大帝今天没在摇篮里闹起床气……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I guess it... felt like a good trade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 因为我感觉……这将会是，一笔不错的交易。

Those beyond the wall have helped you. You will need to repay that debt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 墙外的那些人曾经帮助过你。现在，你也该偿还这份恩情了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: But you've earned your freedom. A way through the paradox and out of the spiral. Be warned... you will not be as you are now... but as you were then. Do you see it? The other side?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 不过，你已经赢得了自由，也找到了穿过悖论、逃离复眠螺旋的路。要当心了……出去后，你不会是现在这样，而会变回从前的自己。你看见了吗？那个世界？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I see it.
I see it.
I see it.
I see it.
What will you do?
I'm trying to laugh it off, but… you're testing my limits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我倒想一笑置之，但……你快把我耐心耗光了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Didn't I warn you?
The Orowyrm Lodun, anger personified. Quick, you must find a way to the mainland.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 奥金魇龙隆沌，愤怒的化身。快，你必须想办法前往大陆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Impressive. If you are done gallivanting across the skies, might I suggest finding shelter on the mainland, before Lodun's wrath is turned upon you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 表现不错。如果你已经在天上游荡够了，趁隆沌的怒火还没烧到你身上，先去大陆找个地方避一避。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Where is he?
Where is he?
Where is he?

Don't you worry. Justice comes swiftly in my kingdom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 用不着你操心。在我的王国里，正义的裁决，向来雷厉风行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Ah!
Ah!

Of course, I didn't trust her. Why not? Well... she was a Sentient! I told you already... no. No! I didn't know all that yet, did I? We believed as the Orokin had us do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我当然不信任她。为什么？拜托……她可是个 Sentient！我已经跟你说过了……不，不对！我那时还不知道那些事，是吧？奥罗金要我们相信什么，我们便相信什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: It was war, after all. It defined us. We were made to hate without reflection. Ha! No. No vacations. Hmm... I suppose Saturn, maybe? I've always wanted to see the rings up close...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 毕竟，那是一场战争。战争定义了我们，也把我们塑造成不假思索便会仇恨的人。哈！不，那时哪有什么假期。嗯……若真能休一次，也许会去土星吧。我一直想近距离看看它的星环……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Feeling better? That Warframe took a greater toll on you than I expected...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 感觉好些了吗？那件战甲对你的消耗，比我预想的更大……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Who were you talking to?
Who were you talking to?
Who were you talking to?
Who were you talking to?

If you are recovered, we must begin at once to seek the other pieces of Thrax's figurine. I expect they will manifest the same... as paradoxes on the surface. Gear up, look around, and tell me when you are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 如果你已经恢复，我们就得立刻去寻找士魂大帝玩偶的其余碎片。估计它们也会和先前一样……以悖论的形式在地表显现。整备一下，四处看看，准备好就告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Thrax will reset the spiral the moment he senses a Warframe on the surface. We will save that for the Undercroft. This should at least give you a fighting chance against his false Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 只要士魂大帝察觉到地表有战甲，就会立刻重置复眠螺旋。战甲就留在地穴中使用吧。至少能让你在对抗伪禁卫时多一分胜算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: All his horses, all his men... The sooner you find the pieces, the sooner you get out of this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 他麾下的千军万马……你越早找齐碎片，就能越早离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: How'd you end up here, anyway?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 说起来，你是怎么到这儿来的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: How'd you end up here, anyway?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Through the eye of a storm... I'm not sure if I was dead or alive at the time. You?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我是穿过风暴之眼来的……当时是生是死，我也说不清。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: It's been too long for me. Maybe I was on that ship.... Or maybe... the same way you did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 那是太久远的事了。也许我当时在那艘飞船上……又或者……和你一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 那是太久远的事了。也许我当时在那艘飞船上……又或者……和你一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: He's in a mood... see for yourself...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 他正在气头上，你自己看吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Well shit. You hungry?
Well shit. You hungry?
Well shit. You hungry?
Well shit. You hungry?
Go ahead! But save some for Sol!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你吃吧！不过记得给赤乌留点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Go ahead! But save some for Terra!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你吃吧！不过记得给坤灵留点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Go ahead! But save some for Lua!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你吃吧！不过记得给婵娟留点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Now, do you believe it?
Let's go.
Let's go.
Let's go.
Let's go.
Stop this childish tantrum RIGHT NOW! Do you understand? He's dead and gone and he's not coming back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 赶紧给我收起你那小孩子脾气！听见没有？他已经死了，再也回不来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I don't care how angry you get! You can't change ANYTHING. You can't even change yourself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 随你怎么发火，我根本不在乎！你什么都改变不了，连你自己都改变不了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Jealous of my wyrms? You think stealing them will bring him back? Are you stupid? It's TOO LATE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 眼红我的魇龙？你以为抢走它们，他就能起死回生了？你是不是傻？已经太迟了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Who is this new friend of yours, anyway? I made you! I kept you safe all this time. They're nothing I can't be!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你这新朋友到底是谁？是我创造了你！一直以来都是我在保护你。他算什么，我哪点比不上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Ignore him. Play out the day. Let him see that his control has weakened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 别理他，继续做该做的事。让他知道自己的控制已经被削弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: It wasn't me that started stirring up this mess with the executions. You got it in your head to get out. Don't you see now that these stories are for you? For us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 掀起这场处决乱子的可不是我，是你自己铁了心要走。难道你现在还不明白，这些故事是为了你，为了我们而写的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Nothing's worse than anger, right? It burns your lungs. It ashes the trees. But you can see it, right? /Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Our whole lives, we run toward it, some 'thing,' some 'one,' some wavering oasis of joy and contentment. Sad thing is... most happiness seems to come by accident. Maybe it's not about getting it... but letting it.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Sometimes you get stuck. Sometimes you go numb. The color drains away. You stop trying, and that just feeds the spiral going down. /Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 有时候，你会陷入泥沼。有时候，你会渐渐麻木，眼前的一切也随之褪去色彩。你放弃挣扎，任由自己坠入无底的漩涡。或许哪天你运气好，在镜中瞥见自己的那一刻猛然惊醒。但对有些人来说……还需要别的契机。一个朋友，一个陌生人，一个故事，亦或是一双援手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Sol. I long to see her purifying light, but a great and terrible wall now divides us. Thrax has trapped you in his bottle... and you must escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 赤乌。我渴望再见她那净化一切的光芒，可如今，一道宏伟而可怖的高墙将我们隔开。士魂大帝把你困在他的瓶中……你必须逃出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Terra. I remember her oceans crashing wild under churning skies. This place is a nightmare facade of that world... a prison from which you must escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 坤灵。我还记得那里的海洋，曾在翻涌的天穹下掀起狂涛。这里不过是那个世界的噩梦倒影……一座你必须逃离的牢狱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Lua. I miss the ebbing of that pensive light. Here we spiral in the constant glare of an absurd purgatory. You need to break free.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 婵娟。我怀念她那抹渐退的幽思清光。可在这里，我们只能在荒诞炼狱无休止的刺目强光中盘旋。你必须挣脱出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I'm... Just. So. Tired.
I'm... Just. So. Tired.

The figurine you pulled from the paradox. The lost toy of a temperamental child. You need only to find the rest of its pieces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你从悖论中取出来的那个小玩偶，是一个喜怒无常的孩童所遗失的玩具。你只需要找齐它剩下的部件即可。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: This thing? What is it?
This thing? What is it?
This thing? What is it?
This thing? What is it?
I've never seen you like this! So ready to fight! It makes me so happy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我头一回见你这副模样！斗志昂扬！本王很高兴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: But why are you doing this?
You never cared this much for me…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你以前，从来没这么在乎过我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: By order of his majesty, Dominus Thrax, you are charged with the crime of treason!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 奉士魂大帝陛下之命，现正式指控你犯有叛国罪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text:
[6.1]
The penalty for which is DEATH!

[6.3]

[13.6]
DEATH BY IMPALEMENT!
DEATH BY IMPALEMENT!
--you've made the king furious! And not just him... ME! We've both had enough of you! By order of his majesty Dominus Thrax, DEATH BY-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: ——你彻底激怒了陛下！不光是他还有……我！我们都已经对你忍无可忍！现在，奉士魂大帝陛下的旨意，赐——你——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: -YOU WILL LOOK AT ME WHEN I-
HA! Even better! Death by... METEOR-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 哈！这倒……更好！处……以……陨星毙命——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Something fell from heaven as hard I fell from the King's favor, not far from here...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 有东西从天穹狠狠坠下，正如我失去了陛下宠信时摔得那般惨，就在离这儿不远的地方……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: For the person who has everything, a little something extra.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你都拥有一切了，那就再来点「锦上添花」的东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Be on your way. That Orowyrm is hunting, and it has your scent. Though you could buy some time if you fed it Luscinia first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 启程吧，那条奥金魇龙正在狩猎，而且已经嗅到了你的气味。不过，要是先把路西尼娅喂给它，倒还能拖些时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: All Kaithes are banished, by my decree!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 本王下令，放逐所有绝灵骥！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Teshin!
Teshin!
Teshin!
Teshin!
Take care... of Sol for me.
Take care of Terra for me.
Take... care... of Lua for me.
I will.
I will.
I will.
I will.
You are feeling, now.
I am.
I am.
I am.
I am.
Good.
Didn't see it coming, did you? That I was just using you? You think there's some magic land outside of here, all there is... is war and suffering. Understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 没想到吧？一直以来我都只是在利用你。你真的以为外面有什么人间仙境吗？但事实却是，那里除了战争和苦难……什么都没有。明白吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I think so.
I think so.
I think so.
I think so.
Do you? Do you really? You keep calling this a prison, but you know what it really is? It's the only place in the entire universe that is... Actually. Safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 是吗？你真的明白？你口口声声把这儿叫作监狱，可你知道它到底是什么吗？这个地方是整个宇宙里唯一，真正，安全的，所在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Clearly.
Clearly.
Clearly.
Clearly.
You had it all. A whole world to yourself. But you were bored. Ungrateful. You had to bite the hand that feeds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你曾经拥有一切，整个世界都归你所有。可你还是觉得无聊，不知感恩，非要恩将仇报，忘恩负义！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Like Sol, eh?
Like Sol, eh?
Like Sol, eh?
Like Sol, eh?
Like Terra, eh?
Like Terra, eh?

Like Terra, eh?
Like Lua, eh?
Like Lua, eh?

Like Lua, eh?
Like what?
Once upon a time… there was a dying old man…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 很久很久以前，有一位垂死的老人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I am the Bombastine of the courtly stage... until that witch, Luscinia, took it from me! A fancy new hand, sire? Lucky you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 小人乃是蓬蓬士君，宫廷舞台的台柱……直到那个女巫路西尼娅把一切夺走！这位是陛下您新收的花哨小跟班？您可真走运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I'm just looking for a way out here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我只是在想办法离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I'm just looking for a way out here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我只是在想办法离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我只是在想办法离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I'm just looking for a way out here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我只是在想办法离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: A way out? When all of us are obliged to stay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 离开这里？我们不是注定都得留在这儿吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Ah! The audience loves you. Of course, they would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 啊！观众可真喜欢你。他们当然会喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I don't belong here. Shit. I don't even know why I'm talking to you. You're just some Thrax plaything, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 告诉你，我根本就不属于这里。妈的，我干嘛跟你废话。你不过是士魂大帝的玩物，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I don't belong here. Shit. I don't even know why I'm talking to you. You're just some Thrax plaything, right?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 告诉你，我根本就不属于这里。妈的，我干嘛跟你废话。你不过是士魂大帝的玩物，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Too true. Not like you. No matter how much work I put in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 说得没错。可惜我不如你，不管我再怎么努力，都得不到眷顾。

What's gotten into you, Drifter? You seem a little… emotional?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你这是怎么了，漂泊者？你看起来有点……激动？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Every time you try, you die. That's the loop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 试一次，死一次。总会如此循环往复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: This won't last. You're as hollow as the rest of these dolls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你撑不了多久的。你和其他玩偶一样浅薄空洞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Now what?
Now what?
Now what?
Now what?
A way out?
A way out?
A way out?
A way out?
I've never seen you get this far… sad, isn't it? Though not like you can feel a thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我还从未见你走到这一步……真可悲，不是吗？不过你反正什么也感觉不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: I am your cloud above, your fire below, your reckoning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 我上为蔽日乌云，下为焚足烈火，我即是末日审判。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: You're as hollow as the rest. Dead inside with the 'out' soon to follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你和他们一样空洞。内在早已枯竭，外壳也很快会随之崩碎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: This... this is-
This… this is-
This… this is-
This… this is-
-MINE!
Mine. Mine. It's mine.
You can have it.
You can have it.
You can have it.
You can have it.
What the hell?
What the hell?
What the hell?
What the hell?
The king's reach is weaker here in the Undercroft. On the surface, I suspect this Warframe would be a liability, attracting his every wyrm. But here, you can roam free and revel in its power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 在地穴中，国王的力量有所削弱。若是在地面上，这具战甲恐怕反而会成为累赘，把他手下的魇龙全引过来。但在这里，你可以自由行动，尽情展现它的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: So what am I doing here, Teshin? A joyride?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 那我来这儿是干嘛，泰辛？兜风吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: So what am I doing here, Teshin? A joyride?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 那我来这儿是干嘛，泰辛？兜风吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: So what am I doing here, Teshin? A joyride?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 那我来这儿是干嘛，泰辛？兜风吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: So what am I doing here, Teshin? A joyride?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 那我来这儿是干嘛，泰辛？兜风吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: You are seeking a paradox. You will need more than her hand and my blades to survive above. Hmm. Here they come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你要寻找的是一个悖论。想在上面活下来，光靠她的手和我的双刃还不够。嗯，它们来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Ah! What the hell?
Ah! What the hell?
Ah! What the hell?
Ah! What the hell?
As I understand it, a Warframe is more than a machine. A hybrid creation. Your senses are linked now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 据我所知，战甲并非单纯的机器。它是一种混合造物。现在，你的感官已经与它相连。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: There's something else down here.
There's something else down here.
There's something else down here.
There's something else down here.
Yes, a paradox. You must find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 没错，是一个悖论。你必须找到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Think you can hide from me down here, Drifter? I play wherever I want!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 以为躲在这下面我就找不到你了吗，漂泊者？本王想在哪儿玩，就在哪儿玩！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: You're no Tenno, but I have seen worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 你不是 Tenno，但也还算过得去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Sure. You want to tell me what's so special about these 'Tenno'? This ain't so hard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 是嘛。那你倒说说，这些所谓的「Tenno」有什么特别的？这玩意儿用起来也没多难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Sure. You want to tell me what's so special about these 'Tenno'? This ain't so hard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 是嘛。那你倒说说，这些所谓的「Tenno」有什么特别的？这玩意儿用起来也没多难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Sure. You want to tell me what's so special about these 'Tenno'? This ain't so hard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 是嘛。那你倒说说，这些所谓的「Tenno」有什么特别的？这玩意儿用起来也没多难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Sure. You want to tell me what's so special about these 'Tenno'? This ain't so hard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 是嘛。那你倒说说，这些所谓的「Tenno」有什么特别的？这玩意儿用起来也没多难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: From the other side... they command the selfsame powers of Void that make the walls of our prison. I suspect the paradox is their attempt to help us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 墙外的 Tenno……掌控着虚空之力，而困住我们的牢狱之墙，也正是由这种力量构成。我怀疑，这个悖论就是他们试图帮我们脱困的证明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: …As he lay on his bed, dying… he called to each of his beloved children…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 他奄奄一息地躺在床上，把他深爱的孩子们一一叫到跟前……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Drifter!!!
When each did hear his rasping call, they answered with a hollow longing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 孩子们听见他嘶哑的呼唤，回应他的，却只有空洞的渴求！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Drifter!!!
Teshin? Teshin!
Teshin? Teshin!
Teshin? Teshin!
Teshin? Teshin!
So they came to his bedside one by one, and his firstborn knelt there, and the old man said, 'my child… my child… why be your eyes so dry?'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 于是，他们接连来到他的榻前。长子屈膝跪下，老人问道：「孩子，我的孩子……为何你的眼中竟无半滴泪水？」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: And the firstborn said, 'So that I might be strong, father.' And so the old man gave to them the deeds for all his lands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 长子答道：「因为我要坚强，父亲。」于是，老人将名下所有土地的契据交给了他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: To his second born, he said again, 'my child… my child… why be your eyes so dry?'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 轮到次子时，老人再次问道：「孩子，我的孩子……为何你的眼中竟无半滴泪水？」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: And his second child said, 'I shed no tears, father, for I chose now to remember only the joy you made of my life.' And so unto him, the old man gave his family home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 次子答道：「父亲，我不流泪，是因为此刻，我只愿记得您带给我的喜悦。」于是，老人将家宅传给了他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: And when his last child had entered, he said again, 'my child, my child, you were my favorite of all. Why show you no feelings at all?'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 当最小的孩子走进来时，老人又问道：「孩子，我的孩子……你一直是我最疼爱的心头肉。为何你却如此无动于衷？」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: And the last child said to him. 'I feel nothing, for it was I… who has killed you.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 最小的孩子对他说：「我什么也感觉不到，因为杀死你的……就是我。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Warframes. Brought here by the paradox. In the world beyond the wall, they were the weapons of a warrior caste called the Tenno. I suspect your 'hand' may offer a way to control them as they did. Choose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 这些战甲，被悖论带到了这里。在墙外的世界，它们曾是属于 Tenno 战士阶层的武器。我猜，你的那只「手」或许能让你像他们一样操控战甲。做出选择吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Relax. Let your mind adjust to the disassociation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.zhText: 放松。让你的意识适应这种抽离感。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriParadoxQ.text: Alright, I think I'm ready.
Alright, I think I'm ready.
Alright, I think I'm ready.
Alright, I think I'm ready.
Then go.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuest/DD.text: Is that where you came from?
I really hope you can fly.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: The king graces us...I  am Bombastine, sire! You do remember your courtly playwright?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 陛下大驾光临……我是蓬蓬士君，陛下！您一定还记得您的宫廷剧作家吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: I'm not--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 我不是……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Have you come to join the performance sire? It would be my deepest honor to see you command the stage! Yonder you might recover your favorite mask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 陛下，您是来参加演出的吗？若能目睹您在舞台上的英姿，那将是小人莫大的荣幸！您最喜欢的面具，或许就在那边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: My favorite mask?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 我最喜欢的面具？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Yes, manifest as only you are able. With untold power as only you command. Quick sire! I can only stall this awful idiot's gallery for a while longer…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 没错，展现出唯有您才具备的英姿，释放那唯有您才能驾驭的神力。快点，陛下！我可拖不了这群蠢货观众太久……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: The king returns! And in such a mood as this he wears! What recitation will you gift us today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 王者归来！瞧陛下今日这一身的气派！不知您今日要为我们吟诵哪一段？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: I'm not... uh... shit... line feed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 我不是……呃，台词呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Of course, sire! Which play?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 好的，陛下！您指的是哪一幕？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: When I bestride him, I soar, I am a hawk: he trots the air; the earth sings when he touches it; the basest horn of his hoof is more musical than the pipe of Hermes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 我一跨上它，便如苍鹰般凌空翱翔。它踏空奔驰，落蹄之处，大地也随之奏响乐章。就连它蹄上最不起眼的一角，发出的声音也胜过赫尔墨斯之笛的乐音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: So, you finally took the hand, did you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 这么说，你终于拿到那只手了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: What? Finally? Today's the first--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 什么叫终于？我今天才第一次……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: --Fool! You know how this works. Why would today be the first time? Your ignorance is second only to your apathy. What I struggle to comprehend is why the other side is even trying to help you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: ……愚昧！你明知道是怎么回事。今天怎么可能是第一次？你不仅一无所知，还麻木不仁。我实在无法理解，为什么「另一边」还在想办法帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: The other side? Who's trying to help me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 「另一边」？谁在帮我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: You are. See for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 是你自己。去亲眼看看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: I thought so. Old dogs and new tricks. Go on, go wallow in your routine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 果然是积习难改。去吧，继续守着你那套老规矩吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Fine. I'm getting out of here on my own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 行，我自己想办法离开这儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Oh now that would be a surprise, wouldn't it? Take my old blades if you want a chance with that mockery of a Dax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 呵，那倒真叫人意外。如果你想对付那个冒牌禁卫的话，就拿上我那对旧剑吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: I see. Until next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 好，下次再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text:
[9.7]
There he is. Now the cowardly knight must face the King's Champion.
[12.7]
Enter: DENPHIUS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText:
[9.7]
他，在那儿。现在，胆小的骑士……必须面对，国王的冠军！
[13.0]
登菲斯，登场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Think a little color is all it takes to change this world? You're too old and too weak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 就凭这点颜色，也想改变这个世界？你太老，也太弱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: You're not leaving! You can't leave!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 你不准走！你不能走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: He didn't do anything to you. Why? WHY'D YOU DO IT?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 他根本没招惹你。为什么？你为什么要这么做？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Lodun, end this now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 隆沌，立刻结束这一切！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Ah sh...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 啊，可恶……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: A glimmer of hope… until the great Orowyrm Lodun darkened the skies above. Hungry for knight flesh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 刚燃起一线希望……伟大的奥金魇龙隆沌便遮天蔽日而来！它饿坏了，正想拿骑士填肚子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: What!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 什……什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Here it comes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 它来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: The king! The king! There goes our honored king!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 国王！是国王！我们尊贵的国王来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Where? Where?! He gave me no eyes to see him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 在哪？在哪？！国王没赐予我双眼，我怎能看见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: There! I think it's him? Sir, will the dragon devour us today? I live to serve, even as food!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 就在那儿！是他吗？大人，今天魇龙会吞了我们吗？我生来就是为了侍奉，被当成食物也行！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: What? There's a dragon too?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 什么？魇龙也在？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Didn't you hear it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 你没听到吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text:
[5.0]
This place... can change?
[10.0]
This place can change!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText:
[5.0]
这地方……还能有变化？
[10.0]
这地方真的会变！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text:
[4.7]
Ever get that feeling you're stuck?
[9.7]
Spinning inside your little wheel, day in and day out.
[13.9]
Only to find... you're right back where you started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText:
[4.7]
你有过被困住的感觉吗？
[9.7]
在无休止的循环里原地打转。
[13.9]
最后却发现……自己又回到了原点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Riveting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: I was on the edge of my seat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 我看得都坐不住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 真感人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Well done, sire, they love you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 精彩绝伦，陛下，他们爱死您了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 行吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: I thought I had lost you for a moment. But you don't get to leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 刚才有那么一瞬间，我还以为把你跟丢了。不过，你休想离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: How do I know this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 我怎么会知道这些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: Oh... At least you're not trying to kill me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 哦……至少你没打算杀我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.text: What the hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriQuestVTw.zhText: 搞什么鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The enemy has been exhausted, if only for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 敌人的气数已尽，至少暂时如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Like ashes, the enemy has been scattered to The Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 敌人如余烬一般，散落到了虚空之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Your resolve is being tested. Do not falter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你的意志正在接受考验，切勿动摇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: This battle is already half won.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 此战我们已占得先机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Prepare yourself. A fresh wave approaches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 做好准备，新一波攻势即将来临。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The enemy musters for a fresh assault. Hold the line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 敌军正在集结，准备发起新一轮攻势。坚守阵地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: No time to rest. Already a new onslaught begins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 没时间歇息了，新一轮攻势已经开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Enemies incoming. Stand fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 敌人来袭，稳住阵线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The winds blow fiercely; the rains do not relent; still the stout bough stands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 狂风怒号，骤雨不歇，坚韧的枝干依旧挺立。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: This Tenno asset is destined to be destroyed by hostile forces. Intervene and change its fate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 这座 Tenno 的舱体注定会毁于敌手。出手干预，改写它的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: History dictates that this Tenno asset was destroyed in a grave setback to the cause. Let us rewrite that event.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 据历史记载，这座舱体的损毁，曾让 Tenno 一方遭受重创。让我们改写这段历史吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Many defensive battles within the Origin System were lost. Through the Paradox, you now have the chance to undo those defeats.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 始源星系中，许多防御战都以失败告终。如今借助悖论，你有机会逆转败局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Hmm. Come to prove yourself in the Undercroft, then? The Other Side is watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 嗯，看来你是来地穴证明自己的？另一边的目光，正在注视着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The endless challenge of the Undercroft makes it an ideal training ground. Hone your skills there, if you have the stamina.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 地穴的挑战永无止境，正是绝佳的试炼场。若你撑得住，就去那里磨炼技艺吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The challenges of the Undercroft mirror the many battles of the Tenno. Prove you are the equal of their fighting spirit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 地穴的试炼，映照着 Tenno 所经历的万千鏖战。去证明你的斗志，绝不亚于他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Thrax must be fought on many fronts. In Duviri we engage his forces, but through the Undercroft we challenge his very essence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 要对抗士魂大帝，必须多线出击。在双衍王境，我们迎战他的军队。但在地穴里，我们要直击他的本源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Access to the Undercroft is strictly controlled. We are lucky to have this undetected portal. Use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 地穴的入口受到严密管控，幸好这道传送门尚未被发现。进去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Other Side has assisted you many times. The Undercroft is where you may repay them, with blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你曾多次得到另一边的帮助。如今，地穴正是你以鲜血偿还这份恩情的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Will you lay your sword aside and rest? Or fight on?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你是打算放下剑休息，还是继续战斗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: This struggle goes on for as long as you can stand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 只要你还撑得住，这场战斗就会继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Leave now or later, but leave you must. For the Undercroft is inexhaustible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 无论早晚，你终须离开。地穴中的挑战永无尽头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Do not expect me to tell you when to stop. Judge for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 别指望我来告诉你该何时收手。你应该自行判断。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: I advise you not to be content with merely "doing enough".
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 我劝你，不要仅仅满足于「点到为止」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: It is my duty to make extraordinary demands of exceptional people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 我的职责，便是对卓越之人提出非凡之求。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: One pebble at a time, you will lift entire mountains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 积微石以成高塔，累寸功可移千山。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The book is closed and set aside. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 书卷已合上，暂且告一段落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: I will await you, just as I did before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 我将一如既往，等候你的归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: While you walk in other spaces, remember: Duviri is real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 当你踏足其他空间时，切记：双衍王境真实存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: There is a time for training, and a time for tea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 训练有适，休憩有时，乃文武之道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Yes. You must move on. It is in your nature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 没错。你要继续前行，这是天性使然。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Duviri is yours. It will wait for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 双衍王境属于你，它会一直等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A Void Treasure has been located.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 已发现一处虚空秘宝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: I sense another Void Treasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 我感应到了另一处虚空秘宝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Void Treasure location established.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空秘宝的位置已确认。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A new Void Treasure may now be extracted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 现在可以开始挖掘新的虚空秘宝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Marking Void Treasure extraction site.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 正在标记虚空秘宝的挖掘地点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A new extraction site may now be claimed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 新的挖掘地点已经开放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Extractor deploying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挖掘机正在部署。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Extractor in place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挖掘机已就位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Excavator under attack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挖掘机正遭到攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Enemies are assaulting your excavator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 敌人正在围攻你的挖掘机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Excavator lost. Your work wasted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挖掘机已损毁，你的努力全白费了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You allowed the enemy to destroy an excavator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你任由敌人摧毁了一台挖掘机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You have gained much. If you choose, you may now leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你已经收获颇丰。若想离开，现在便可以走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A way out is now open to you, but further buried riches are here for the taking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 撤离的通道现已开启。不过，此地还有更多秘宝等你发掘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Excavator is severely damaged. Protect it or lose it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挖掘机严重受损。保护好它，否则一切将前功尽弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Your excavator is on the brink of destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你的挖掘机已濒临损毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Excavator is almost destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挖掘机即将损毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Void Treasure extracted. We have done well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空秘宝已成功开采，干得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The treasures of the Void are ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空秘宝归我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void Treasure has been brought to the surface. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空秘宝已送达地表世界。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Secrets lie buried deep within the Undercroft. The Paradox provides the means to extract them. You must protect the Excavators and keep them powered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 地穴深处埋藏着诸多秘宝。唯有借助悖论，才能将它们发掘出来。你必须保护好挖掘机，并让它们维持运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: An extractor is out of power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 一台挖掘机能源耗尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Extractor charge expended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挖掘机能源耗尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: An extractor requires power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 一台挖掘机需要补充能源。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The battle is won, the Paradox tamed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 战斗已然胜利，悖论已被驯服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You have calmed the storm. Return to the world above.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你平息了风暴，返回地表世界吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Little by little, the madness of the Undercroft is curbed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 地穴的狂乱被逐渐遏制住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The foe is staggered but not yet defeated. Persist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 敌人阵脚已乱，但尚未溃败。坚持住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Do not relent. The battle has barely begun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 不要松懈，战斗才刚刚开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The spark of victory has been struck. Fight on and fan the flame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 胜利的星火已被点燃。继续战斗，让它越烧越旺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Undercroft seethes with Thrax's violence. Burn it out with force. Destroy every enemy you find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 地穴中充斥着士魂大帝的暴戾之气。以武力将其荡尽。消灭你遇到的每一个敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Confront the maddened ones who walk the Undercroft, the shadows of armies that do not yet exist. Ensure they never become fully real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 迎战那些游荡在地穴中的疯魔之徒吧，那不过是尚未降世的军团残影，绝不能让它们真正成形。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Like an infected wound, the Paradox breeds defenders out of the raw Void. Contain the Paradox. Kill the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 悖论宛如溃烂的伤口，正从原始的虚空中孕育出守卫。遏制悖论，消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You can hold no more healing energy. Get to a rupture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你的修复能量储备已满，快去封闭裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Seal a rupture! You have gathered enough healing energy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 修复能量已经足够，快去封闭裂隙！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Your reserves of healing energy are full.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你的修复能量已经储满。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Enough. You can gather no more. Attend to the ruptures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 够了，无法再收集了，赶紧去封闭裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Be aware. Fallen enemies may drop valuable life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 多加留意，你击杀的敌人可能会掉落维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void gives as well as takes. Those you slay may drop concentrated life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空既会索取，也会给予。你击杀的敌人可能会掉落浓缩维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You may now return to the upper world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你现在可以返回地表世界了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Exit the Undercroft if you choose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 若已做出决定，随时可以离开地穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A path is now open for your return to Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 返回双衍王境的通道现已开启。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The situation is critical. Leave. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 情况危急，立刻撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You can no longer survive here. Leave the Undercroft immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你在这里只有死路一条，马上离开地穴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A warrior knows when to retreat. That time has come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 能进亦能退，方为战士。撤退的时机已到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Your tenacity has paid off. If you can endure more, consider staying.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你的坚韧换来了回报。若还能坚持，不妨继续留下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void rewards those who endure its ordeals. Can you endure further?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空眷顾那些经受住试炼的人。你还能继续坚持吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: To those who struggle, much is given. Will you continue?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 奋战之人，终有所得。你还要继续吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Life support will be scarce. Do not waste it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 我会定期提供维生装置。切勿浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The life support is limited. It must not be squandered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置极其有限，绝不可肆意浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Periodically life support will appear. Use it only as you must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置会定期投放。不到万不得已，切勿使用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Endurance is defiance. Prove you can endure the Undercroft at its most oppressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 坚持即是反抗。去证明你能在这地穴最严酷的绝境中存活下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The longer you can keep this Undercroft manifestation active, the greater the gains for the Other Side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你让这处地穴维持的时间越久，另一边的世界能获取的收益就越丰厚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Your presence is enough to hold the paradox at bay, but the environment itself will fight to choke you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你的存在足以牵制住悖论，但这片环境，会不断侵蚀你的生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Life support capsule delivered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置已安全送达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Life support drop complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置已投放完毕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Additional life support has arrived.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 额外的维生装置已经抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The longer you stay, the more of the Void's treasures may be garnered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 坚持得越久，收获的虚空秘宝就越多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Stay as long as you can bear to. This will not get easier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 坚持到你的极限为止。接下来的试炼只会愈发艰难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: As the challenge intensifies, so too do the gains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 挑战越艰巨，回报也越丰厚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Life support has been activated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置已激活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Systems charged with life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 系统已注入维生能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Life support replenished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置已补充完毕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Life support is inbound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置即将送达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Predicting life support drop point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 正在预测维生装置投放点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Life support drop imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置即将投放。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Prepare to receive life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 准备接收维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Only sixty seconds remain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 时间仅剩六十秒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You have sixty seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你还有六十秒的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Sixty seconds left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 还剩六十秒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Thirty seconds remain. You walk the blade's edge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 还剩三十秒，你已命悬一线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Thirty seconds left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 还剩三十秒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Your life support expires in thirty seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 维生装置将在三十秒后失效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Globes of ambient Void energy hover around you. Collect them to seal the breaches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 逸散的虚空能量在你身边飘浮。收集它们，封闭裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The spheres you see are ambient Void energy. Gather as much as you can and use it to heal the damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你看到的光球，便是逸散的虚空能量。尽量多收集一些，再借助它们修复裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You will have to be nimble to collect those energy globes, but they are the only means to close the breaches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 要想收集能量球，就得身手敏捷。只有靠它们，才能封闭裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The ruptures can be closed, but only if you collect enough ambient Void energy. Seize the globes that float nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 只有收集足够的虚空能量，才能封闭裂隙。去收集周围漂浮的光球吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void can heal as well as harm. Gather the floating spheres and take them to the ruptures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空既能带来伤害，也能修复创伤。收集漂浮的能量球，带去修复裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The entity has been dispersed. Duviri is safer for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 邪物已被驱散，双衍王境又安全了一分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Well done. These aberrations of the Void serve a greater master than Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 干得好。这些虚空畸变之物所效忠的主人，远比士魂大帝更强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A bold stroke. Yet the Indifference is persistent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 果断的一击，可虚空无情之物不会轻易罢休。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Thrax's torment spawns these creatures, yet he has no power over them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 士魂大帝的苦痛催生了这些造物，可它们并不受他掌控。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Thrax's primal nightmares have a special power in this place. They will take form and hunt you down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 士魂大帝内心深处的梦魇在这里格外强大。它们会化为实体，对你展开追杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void Angels' influence is having... unwholesome effects.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空天使的影响正在产生……不良后果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Be cautious. The Void Angels are manipulating reality around you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 谨慎行事，虚空天使正在扭曲你周遭的现实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The longer the ruptures go unrepaired, the harsher conditions will become.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 裂隙若迟迟得不到修复，情况就会愈发严峻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: It is now safe to leave, should you so desire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 若你愿意，现在便可安全撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You have achieved as much as you need to, though perhaps not as much as you desire to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你已完成分内之事，只是或许还未及你的期许。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: You may now leave without blame, or continue the fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 你现在可以问心无愧地离开，也可以留下继续奋战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: We have failed. Abandon this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 我们落败了，赶紧撤离此地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The damage is too severe. The battle is lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 损伤太过严重，败局已经注定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Retreat. There is no more you can do here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 撤退吧，留在这里也无济于事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The walls are crumbling. Get out before madness claims you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 墙体正在崩塌。快离开，别让疯狂将你吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Creatures of the deep Void are assaulting the Undercroft, tearing rents in its fabric. Seal them up again, or worse foes than Thrax may emerge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空深处的造物正在侵袭地穴，撕开一道道空间裂隙。将裂隙重新封印，否则，比士魂大帝更棘手的敌人便会从中现身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void Angels that roost in the Zariman are breaking into the Undercroft. Repair the damage to keep them at bay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 盘踞在「扎里曼号」上的虚空天使正在入侵地穴。修复裂隙，阻止它们涌入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Paradox has drawn Void Angels to besiege the Undercroft. Undo what their claws have done, or Duviri may fall to something worse even than Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 悖论引来了虚空天使围攻地穴。修复它们利爪撕开的裂隙，否则，双衍王境将面临比士魂大帝更可怕的威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Duviri's defences are weakest here. You have done well to reinforce them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 这里是双衍王境防守最薄弱之处。你加固了防线，做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The smallest breach in the Wall may become a gaping wound. Thanks to you, that will not now happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 墙上哪怕再微小的裂隙，也可能撕裂成一道巨大的伤口。多亏有你，否则后果不堪设想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The enemy has been held at bay. Congratulations are in order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 敌人已经被成功击退，干得漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: A breach has been sealed. Excellent work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 一道裂隙已被成功封闭。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void Angels are unrelenting. You are all that is keeping them at bay. Hold fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空天使的攻势不会停歇。你是唯一能阻挡它们的人，稳住阵脚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: If the Void Angels break through the Wall, their master will be freed. Do not allow that to happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 若让虚空天使冲破那堵墙，它们的主人就会获得自由。绝不能让这一切发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The rupture is closed. The Paradox stabilizes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 裂隙已成功封闭，悖论正在恢复稳定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Fight on. Close the ruptures as you would staunch the wounds of a comrade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 继续战斗。如同为战友止血疗伤那般，封住这些裂隙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: Rupture damage is critical. We are seconds away from defeat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 裂隙的损坏情况十分严重。再过几秒，我们就会落败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Undercroft is on the verge of collapse. Fix those ruptures immediately!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 地穴即将崩塌，立刻修复裂隙！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: If you cannot repair the ruptures, this entire region will be lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 若再不修复裂隙，整片区域都将沦陷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: We are losing this struggle. You MUST close a rupture at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 局势正在失控，必须立刻封闭一处裂隙！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: One of Thrax's personal demons has taken physical form! Destroy it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 士魂大帝的心魔已经化为实体！消灭它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: The Void has lent substance to Thrax's dark dreams. Exorcize this fresh abomination.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 虚空让士魂大帝的黑暗梦魇化为了实体。去消灭这个刚刚成形的邪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.text: What a waste! Your scarred vessel comes to beg once more! You will never pry the Janus Key from the clutches of its rightful owner - I, Captain Vor, have ascended and the Void salutes me! You will die a lifetime, an eternity, a universe of deaths before you are blessed by the endlessness of this place, this, paradise. I will never close an eye to the gift that is the Void. Even as my flesh hardens, a wall of bone awaits my joining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuviriUndercro.zhText: 真是个废物！你这伤痕累累的容器又来乞讨了！你永远也无法从雅努斯之钥的合法拥有者——我，的手中撬走它！我，沃尔上尉，已经升天，虚空向我致敬！在你得到这个地方，这个，天堂，的无限祝福之前，你将经历永生永世，无穷无尽的死亡。我永远不会将我的眼目从虚空这份馈赠上移开。即使我的肉体变得僵硬，白骨之墙依然守候着我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: A pinch of the Void, and any weapon can be made to sing a new tune.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 一抹虚空的力量，任何武器都能奏出新的旋律。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: So. You interested in custom tune-ups for your gear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 那么，你有兴趣为你的装备进行自定义调整吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Here's a few pieces I put together in my own time. Void knows I got plenty of that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 这是我自己在空闲时间里制作的几件作品。虚空知道我有大把时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: The foe has fallen. Stab it to the heart!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 敌人已经倒下了。刺进它的心脏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: It will not get up again. Finish it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 它现在不会再起来了。了结它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Seek out what protects it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 找出是什么在保护着它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: It has support. Change your focus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 它是有支援的。转变关注点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Turn your fury upon what is vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 将你的怒火投向脆弱之处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Something is shielding it from harm. Find out what.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 有东西在保护它免受伤害。找出它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Let this victory serve as a warning. Duviri is defended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 就把这场胜利当作是一次警告吧。双衍王境是被守护的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Jackal destroyed. More will follow, no doubt. Some nightmares recur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 豺狼被摧毁。之后一定会有更多。有些噩梦会重现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Skill has triumphed over mere machinery. You have done well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 最终还是技巧战胜了单纯的机械。你做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Your cover is gone. Rely on your quickness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 你的掩护消失了。要依靠敏捷的身法了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: See how it destroys your cover. Move or suffer the same fate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 看看它是如何摧毁你的掩护的。犹豫就是同样的下场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Avoid the beams!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 快避开光束！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Evade! You can attack later!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 避开！你可以稍后攻击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: The body is well armored. The limbs, less so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 躯体防护完备。四肢则相对较弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: A warrior must strike where the foe's armor is weakest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 战士必须朝攻击敌人护甲最薄弱的地方攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Do not hesitate to attack when an opening presents itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 出现机会时，不要犹豫，立即攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: First bring it down, then work on keeping it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 首先将它击倒，然后别让它爬起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Like a dying animal, its ferocity increases. Be aware.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 像垂死的动物一样，它的凶猛程度愈发增强。要警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Attack speed increasing. The foe is fighting for its life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 攻击速度在提升。敌人正在为自己的生命而战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: The Jackal may have been sent to explore Duviri. Ensure it never returns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 豺狼可能是被派去探查双衍王境的。要确保它再也回不去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: The Jackal. A graceless machine with no business here. Dispatch it and move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 额，豺狼。一台在这里毫无存在意义的粗鲁机器。消灭它，然后继续前行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Cowards send minions to fight in their stead. This Jackal is a mere envoy. Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 懦夫派小喽啰代替他们战斗。这个豺狼只不过是个使者而已。摧毁它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: A Corpus Jackal. I do not know how it found its way into the Undercroft, but it cannot be allowed to report back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 一个头Corpus 豺狼。我不知道它是如何找到进入地穴的路的，但不可以让它回去汇报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: Now! Strike while it is down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 进攻！趁它被击倒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: You have an opportunity! Take it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 你的机会来了！把握住！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: You have triggered its defensive precepts. Find where it has fled to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 你已经触发了它的防御指令。找出它逃往何处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.text: The foe flees before your onslaught. Hunt it down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/DuvuriOnePoint.zhText: 敌人在你的猛攻之下逃跑了。追击它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EidolonDemo/DD.text: The Plains of Eidolon… the site of an historic battle between the Orokin and a great Sentient.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EidolonDemo/DD.zhText: 夜灵平野……很久以前，奥罗金和 Sentient 在这里展开了一场载入史册的大战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EidolonDemo/DD.text: These plains are a vast graveyard of the Sentients who attacked the Tower long ago. If local legends are true, you do not want to be out here at night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EidolonDemo/DD.zhText: 从前，Sentient 试图袭击塔，最后却葬身于此。如果传说是真的，那么你最好不要夜里出门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: (Quiet whispering)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: （小声耳语）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: The Kalymos Sequence has begun? Did he send you? Is he... No. No, of course he didn't. That would be impossible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 卡利莫斯数列已经启动了？是他派你来的吗？他是不是……不。不，他当然不会。那是不可能的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: This is, well, Loid. The original. All emotional centers very much intact. Did you have a good sleep?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 这个，嗯，就是洛德。最初的洛德。所有的情绪处理中枢都完好无损。你睡得还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: Ah. The 'helpful' Necraloid my Albrecht had made, so that I might have assistance... and company. Perhaps that made it easier for him to leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 啊。这个"提供帮助"的殁世械灵是我主人阿尔布雷希特创造的，为的就是让我有帮手……和陪伴。也许这让他离开时心里会轻松些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: Resume your duties, construct.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 回去继续你的职责，构物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: "Resume your duties, construct."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: "回去继续你的职责，构物。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: Please, follow me, ah…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 请，跟我来，啊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: This is a Tenno. An orphan of the Void, continuing the struggle our Master abandoned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 这是 Tenno 战士。一个虚空的孤儿。是他承担起了英择谛老爷所舍弃的抗争。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: A Tenno? A deserter, presumably? Is it not aware there's a war going on? So. The war, too, is just a memory now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 一名 Tenno？恐怕是个逃兵吧？难道他不知道有场战争正在进行中吗？那么，现在这场战争也只是一段记忆而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: Tenno, while Loid completes his inspections, you'd better meet the Cavia... a reminder of darker times. Though Master Entrati always hoped the awaited Operator would be able to understand them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: Tenno，当洛德在做检查的时候，你最好去拜访一下科维兽……它们象征了更加黑暗的时代。不过英择谛老爷竟然一直期望着那个即将到来的指挥官能够理解它们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: Ugh, an... incomplete experiment, one might say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 呃，有人可能会说这是一个……未完成的实验。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: Albrecht left a great deal incomplete. The Vessels are unfinished, like a book one might one day return to. Operable, barely. The Sequence dictates I am to wait for their Operator... Clearly, that cannot be you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特留下了大量未完成的工作。承载体尚不完整，就像一本可能会再次翻开的未完之书。它们勉强还能运作。数列指示我要等待它们的指挥官……显然，不可能是你？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: It can be. Tenno, Master Entrati's Grimoire suggests you are the key. That colorless antique there - use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 那可不一定。Tenno，英择谛老爷的魔典表明你才是关键。那边那台无趣的古董，用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text:
Kalymos, obviously.

Hmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText:
卡利莫斯，很显然。

嗯。

Hmm.

卡利莫斯，很显然。

嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 请注意：支付处理系统已关闭。所有售票站只收取现金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.text: You are late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DC.zhText: 你来晚了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: Necramechs. Poor, abandoned things. Still faithfully following Master Entrati's last command, to defend. Show mercy, Tenno. End them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 殁世机甲。这可怜的被遗弃之物。还在忠诚地遵循着英择谛老爷最后的命令，进行着防御。行行好吧，Tenno。了结他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: There! That book was like a diary to Master Entrati, his grimoire! No doubt it holds the secrets of the Vessels, and of the Kalymos Sequence! Take it, Tenno!
