/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 看那儿！那本书对英择谛老爷来说简直就像是他的日记，那是他的魔典！在那本书里面一定记载了关于承载体和卡利莫斯数列的秘密！带走它，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: The grimoire is very… active. It is… reading… you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 魔典非常非常得……活跃。它……正在……读你呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: I confess it galls me slightly to see a compendium of knowledge used as a weapon, but needs must. We need be in no doubt of your skill, at any rate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 我承认，看到一本知识全书被用作武器让我有些不爽，但是没有别的选择。无论如何，我们对你的能力毫无疑问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: Master Entrati called it the Voidtongue. He feared it was meaningless... and feared more that it was not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 英择谛老爷称之为"虚空语"。他担心它是没有任何含义的……更担心它是有含义的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: A monstrous danger, these labs. Better off sealed. We can only hope The Sleeper has been untouched by this vast horror. This great Indifference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 这些实验室隐藏着极大的危险，最好将它们封锁。我们只能希望沉睡者没有被这种巨大的恐怖、这个强大的虚空无情之物所影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: I ask too much of you, Tenno. These horrors must be stopped!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 我对你要求太多了，Tenno。这些恐怖的东西必须被阻止！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.text: A trap? Master Entrati jealously protected his most adored possessions - be they objects… or people. Come. The Sleeper awaits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DE.zhText: 陷阱？英择谛老爷小心翼翼地保护着他最心爱的财产——无论是物品……还是人。来。沉睡者在等待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: Ah! My lonely vigil is over. Follow me, Tenno, and on no account wake the family! Despite their conflicts they sleep in peace, but a solitary dream plagues me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 啊！我孤独的守夜结束了。跟着我，Tenno，千万要小心千万不可吵醒这个家族！尽管他们之间有冲突，但他们却能安然入睡，而我一直被场孤独的梦困扰着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: You must understand: constructs CANNOT dream. And yet, I have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 你必须明白：构物无法做梦。然而，我却可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: In my dream, one single name repeats. KALYMOS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 在我的梦里，有一个名字不断重复。卡利莫斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: The memories surface, long locked away. This was no dream, Tenno. It was a precept. The Kalymos Sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 那些被长期封锁的记忆浮出水面。这可不是梦，Tenno。这是一道指令。卡利莫斯数列。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: I must fulfill this dormant precept. The Kalymos Sequence has begun, and it cannot be undone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 我必须要履行这则潜在的指令。卡利莫斯数列现在已经开启了，它是不可以撤销的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: I have one responsibility in the Kalymos Sequence: Awaken the Sleeper. But I cannot do it alone. Please, assist me once more?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 我在卡利莫斯数列中身负一项职责：唤醒沉睡者。但我一人是无法做到的。恳请你，再帮我一次好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: I fear we are off the edge of the map, and into the domain of monsters. Master Entrati never completed his final project: the VESSELS. The Sequence dictates they cannot awaken before the Sleeper does.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 恐怕我们现在已经脱离了地图的边缘，进入了怪物的领域。英择谛老爷从来没完成过他的终极任务：承载体。数列规定它们不能在沉睡者醒来之前先醒来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.text: Do you hear that? Let us hope The Sleeper is untroubled by such... strangeness. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabs/DI.zhText: 你听到了吗？希望沉睡者不会被这种……奇怪的事情打扰。找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. 

At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
起初，我除了遗忘带来的安逸，什么也不想要。我毫无念想地漂浮在忘忧草水箱中，仿佛进入了第二次孕育。不见世事，不发一言。我的脑海中偶尔会闪过游离的光线，照亮了那残留在我头骨内的洞穴壁画。 

在感知的尽头，我隐约认出了一个模糊的轮廓，那是洛德，在水箱的另一面，如同慈母般低声吟唱。我的舌头太过污浊，无法诵出那歌谣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
Too craven to chase death, I awaited it. The father of fears, and yet I was still afraid. 

The currents whispered coward. I clenched my body into a fist as a foetus must and blinded myself afresh.
 
Stark pain smoked the juice of my living tomb. Why did the saga not end by itself? Why must I still act?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
我太过怯懦不敢追逐死亡，所以我等待着它的降临。它是一切恐惧的根源，然而我依然害怕。

水流低语着懦夫。我如同胎儿一般将身体蜷缩成拳，再次让自己坠入黑暗。

我在这个活体坟墓里，剧烈的疼痛随着血雾扩散。为什么这个传说没有自己终结？我为什么还要采取行动？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
Steeped in solitude, I found I could no longer endure my own company. 

Disgust did the work of courage. I tore the mundane membrane, slid weak and mucosal into Loid's embrace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
独自浸泡着，我发现自己再也无法忍受孤身一人。 

厌恶让我鼓起了勇气。我撕开世俗的隔膜，虚弱而粘滑地投进了洛德的怀抱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
Loid nursed me then, tending first to the uprooted ruin of my eyes, then to the mouth whose grin no longer hid behind flesh. 

The agony bit deep, but it was clean. Blameless love bled up from me. 

I had decided to live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
那时，洛德照料我，先是照料我那如同被完全摧毁的眼睛，然后是那张不再能隐藏在皮肉下微笑的嘴。

那剧痛虽深，但我痛得纯粹。无可指摘的爱从我身上涌现。

我决定活下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
I felt no certainty as I donned clothes rough and strange to the touch of newgrown skin. I had none of the selfless zeal of the soldier. 

The same cursed question still pursued me as it had before: was I, even now, trapped in the rictus of the Wall?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
当我穿上的那些粗糙且陌生的衣物，它们与新生的皮肤摩擦时，我并没有感到任何确定。我没有军人那种无私的热忱。 

那个该死的问题依然困扰着我，就像以前一样：即便到了现在，我是否仍被墙中的邪笑所困？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
The apparatus of logic would never yield an answer. Only resolute action remained. If I must be a demon, let me be an honest one. Let me prove my nature by what I do next. 

Purpose. Let me leave such blazing footprints behind me as no unclean thing would dare to walk in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
逻辑装置永远不会给出答案。剩下的就只有坚决行动。如果我注定成为恶魔，就让我做一个诚实的恶魔吧。让我用接下来的行动来证明我的本性。

目的。在我的身后留下如此炽热的脚印，让任何不洁之物都不敢跟随。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That book. I look at it and I want to spit or split. That thing's wrong. Capital W Wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我看到那本书就想撕烂它或者朝它吐口水。那玩意儿是邪恶的。特别邪恶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If I ever see that Grimoire, I'm gonna bolt. You gotta understand, it's... a predator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 要是我再看到那本魔典，我就立马跑路。要知道，那玩意儿……就是个掠夺物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How can you even go near that book? You're made of stronger stuff than me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你怎么能靠近那本书呢？你比我坚韧多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: 'Papa' left some bad things behind. That book's one of 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "爸爸"留下了些不好的东西。那本书就是之一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The beast sleeps here. Wake it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 怪兽在这里沉睡。唤醒它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Summon the tide now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 现在就召唤断肢潮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Now or never. Challenge it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 机不可失。挑战它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The hand of violence conceals the eye of indifference. Destroy it! Seize what lies within!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 暴力之手掩盖了冷漠之眼。摧毁它！夺走里面的东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Observe! The Murmur places a hand over its eye. Swat it away. Naughty hand!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看！那个低语者把手覆盖眼睛上。打掉它。不乖的手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Observe. The Murmur seeks to protect its eyes. I've got a Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看。低语者试图保护其眼睛。我这可是有个 Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A well-oiled machine is truly a thing of beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一个运转良好的机器真是美妙之极。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Well done, lads! Well done! I daresay the Murmur is quaking in its ambulators, what with the hiding our friend has dispensed it - slap!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 干得好，小伙伴们！干得好！我敢说低语者正因为我们朋友给它的毒打而在它的步行器中颤抖着呢——啪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: With your courage and our expertise, we hold the line. Your fish needs you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有了你的勇气和我们的专业知识，我们守住了阵地。你的鱼需要你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A new day dawns! Let us to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 新的一天来临了！我们开始工作吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah! I have here a toothsome conundrum which I believe you will find quite engaging.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊！我这里有一个吸引人的难题，我相信你会觉得很有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ahoy-hoy! Might you have time for a quick run? You're a biped that's a pun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊嚯嚯！你有时间快跑吗？你是个两脚兽，这是一个双关语。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: He-ey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Come and get it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 过来拿吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Boomies sorta scare me. Kinda glad I don't have hands. Wuk. 'Hands.' Wuk. Who needs 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 砰砰弹有些吓人。我还挺庆幸自己没有手。呜咕。"手"。呜咕。谁需要它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey, buddy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿，朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey! How's it goin'? Are we winning?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿！怎么样了？我们赢了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Lemme know if I can he-elp!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 需要我帮忙的话尽管说！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bird 3 at your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 鸟三竭诚为你服务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[4.5]
I'm glad to be here, but Mister Loid wants to be somewhere else. 
[8.6]
Where I am he wants to go from. 
[14.9]
But when I was where I was, I think this is where I wanted to get to. Rark. Wuk. 
[18.8]
Maybe everyone's here is a there someone else wants. 
[22.8]
Maybe everyone's there is a here someone wants to leave. 
[27.5]
Maybe that's what all those voices are murmuring about all the time WILL YOU SHUT THE HELL UP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[4.5]
我很高兴来到这里，但洛伊德先生想去别的地方。
[8.6]
他想离开我现在的地方。
[14.9]
但当我身处那个地方时，我想这里才是我想来的地方。Rark。Wuk。
[18.8]
也许大家在这里，是别人想要去的地方。
[22.8]
也许大家在那里，是别人想要离开的地方。
[27.5]
也许这就是那些声音一直在低声议论的事情！你们能不能闭嘴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yeah. Love you too, baby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好的。我也爱你，宝贝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You in the mood for a little Netracell action?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有兴趣来点衰退室活动吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Happy lowing)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （快乐低鸣）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I was thinking: maybe we can be de-volved. Back to what we were. Maybe... maybe I could live with that. Simplicity, y'know? Nothing complicated upstairs. No demons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我在想：也许我们可以退化，回到原来的样子。也许……我可以接受那样。简单，你懂吗？头脑简单，就没有心魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bird 3. What I wouldn't give for some of that optimism.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 鸟三。我多想有一些他那样的乐观。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Another day another Netracell another poke in the eye for the motherhugger that consigned us to this mess. C'mon. Let's roll.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 新的一天，新的衰退室，又是对那个把我们弄到这烂摊子上的混蛋的一击。来吧。我们走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Murmur or no Murmur, I've been sleepin' better since comin' back from the dead. Try it sometime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不管有没有低语者，自从我从死里复活后，我睡得更香了。你也试试吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno! Our work goes on!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno！工作继续！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Samples over here, if you please!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果需要的话，样品在这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Let us... let us to work. Time... Time waits for no-one, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 让我们……让我们去工作。时间……时间不等人，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: He-ey! Blech. Okay. Better now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿嘿！哕。好吧。好多啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Hello. Forgive me. One moment. Right. Yes. Apologies. Is there something you require?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。你好。不好意思。等一会儿。对。好的。抱歉。有什么你需要的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Hey. Can I help? I can help. Whew. Room got spinny. Okay. Whaddya need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。嘿。我可以帮忙吗？我可以帮忙的。呼。房间好像在转。好了。你要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I say... would you care for a quick excursion? One... One could use the distraction. Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我说……你想不想来一次短途旅行？一个人……一个人可以用这个来分散注意力。我们走吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[3.8]
Oo-oh. Friends and me not feeling good. 
[8.5]
But… but we get better. Right? 
[14.0]
Wuk wuk wuk. Blech. There. 
[18.9]
Better. Huh-BLECK! Ugh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[3.8]
哦哦。我和朋友们都感觉不舒服。 
[8.5]
但……但是我们会好起来的。对吧？
[14.0]
呜咕呜咕呜咕。哕。那里。 
[18.9]
好多了。哈——哕！呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Coughs)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （咳嗽）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Breathing)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （呼吸声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey ho friend. Do you think maybe... Minn felt like this? Y'know... before she... ...y'know. Up and at 'em!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿嘿朋友。你觉得小敏可能……有过这种感觉吗？你知道……在她之前……你知道的。行动起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[4.2]
Mister Tagfer says if we go with Minn that's okay. 
[7.9]
But did he mean going to the Void, 
[14.3]
or becoming dead things, or is Minn not a dead thing? 
[20.7]
I'm confused. I think I want to stay here. 
[22.1]
I just got this brain. 
[24.3]
I'm still figuring out what to do with it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[4.2]
标弃先生说如果我们和小敏在一起就没问题。 
[7.9]
但是他是指去虚空， 
[14.3]
还是变成死亡的东西，还是小敏不是死亡的东西？ 
[20.7]
我很困惑。我想我要留在这里。 
[22.1]
我才刚刚有了这个大脑。 
[24.3]
我还在思考该怎么用它呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The fish has been on his best behavior. Can't tell if he's really sorry, or just scared. Mm... What can I help with?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那条鱼一直表现得很好。分不清他是真的后悔，还是只是害怕。嗯……需要我帮忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Loid's been less condescending since Bird gave that speech. I'm still gonna kill Albrecht, though. If Loid makes the mistake of saving me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 自从鸟发表那个讲话后，洛德就没那么居高临下了。但我还是要杀掉阿尔布雷希特。如果洛德犯了错救了我的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That Bird... not as dumb as the fish thinks. As far as I can see... he's the only one... really coming to grips... with what we are now. Sorry. Short of breath. Better now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那只鸟……没鱼想的那么笨。就我看来……他是唯一一个……真正在适应……我们现在的状态的。抱歉，有点喘不过气。现在好些了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur... the 'Great Indifference'. It doesn't seem so indifferent to me. Seems to me it knows exactly what it wants.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语者……"强大的虚空无情之物"。对我来说似乎并不那么无情。在我看来，它确切地知道自己想要什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Let's tackle a Netracell. Give me something to focus on other than my woes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 让我们来处理一个衰退室吧。除了我的痛苦之外以，给我一些可关注的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wanna hit a Netracell? Focusing seems to be good for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 想砸衰退室吗？集中注意力似乎对我有好处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Coughs)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （咳嗽）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Pained lowing)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （痛苦低鸣）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tagfer is the last example of his entire species. That howl... a call for a mate he knows will never respond. How I wish he would just stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃是他整个物种里仅存的最后一个了。那声嚎叫……是对一个永远不会回应的伴侣的呼唤。我多希望他能停下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Come, Tagfer. Let's have you tidy up, hmm? Take your mind off things?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 来吧，标弃。让我们帮你收拾一下，嗯？把你的心思从事情上移开？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bird 3? Be a lad and distract Tagfer? I fear he's being devoured by a grief he's only just learned a name for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 鸟三？能不能当个好孩子去分散标弃的注意力？我担心他正被一种他刚刚才认识到的悲伤所吞噬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tagfer. Do come along. You are needed and this melancholy is unbecoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃，一定要来。我们需要你，而这种忧郁不适合你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You. Papa's plan must not be delayed. To work! Use those legs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你。爸爸的计划不能耽搁了。开始干活！用用你的腿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thank you... Bird. Void preserve me from a newly-minted brain and a beginner on the fiddle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 谢谢……鸟。愿虚空保佑我，远离刚开始思考和初学小提琴的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bird? Be a love and look into the meaning of 'internal monologue'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 鸟？能不能帮个忙查查"内心独白"的意思？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Loid, when you've a moment I've prepared an efficiency optimization plan for the Cavia and I believe you'll be pleased by my conclusions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 洛德，等你有空的时候，我已经准备好了一个针对科维兽的效率优化计划，我相信你会对我的结论感到满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Loid, you're looking rested. Might there be anything I can assist you with? I have some thoughts on... ah, yes. Of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 洛德，你看起来休息得很好。有什么我可以帮忙的吗？我有一些想法关于……啊，是的。当然。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Come come! We have much to accomplish!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 来吧来吧！我们还有很多事情要做！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There you are. I would speak with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你来了。我想和你谈谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There's something wrong with the story? Of what happened to us? Something off. Something... fishy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 故事里有什么不对劲吗？关于我们的遭遇？感觉不对劲。有些……可疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Fibonacci seems to have taken to this whole situation quite well? Better than Bird and I, at least. What do you think of him? Fibonacci, I mean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 斐波那契似乎对这整个情况适应得很好？至少比我和鸟好。你怎么看他？我是说斐波那契。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're human, like Loid. Like... Papa? Does Papa have a plan? Do you think? That, someday, we'll look back and see that... this was all worth it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你是人类，像洛德一样。像……爸爸一样？爸爸有计划吗？你觉得呢？会不会有一天，我们回头看，发现……这一切都是值得的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bird... Bird 3's... sweet? I think my... mood... is scaring him. But I don't know what to say, how to tell him how this feels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 鸟……鸟三还……好吗？我觉得我的……心情……吓到他了。但我不知道该说什么，不知道怎样告诉他这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Loid doesn't think much of us, does he? What am I even doing here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 洛德并不太看重我们，对吗？我在这里到底在做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Come on. Let's at least pretend this mess can still work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 来吧。我们至少假装这种混乱还能行得通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno. Welcome to the bloody circus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno。欢迎来到血腥马戏团。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We've had a few setbacks. But we are going to crack on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们遇到了一些挫折。但我们会继续努力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Dignity. Dignity at all times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 形象。时刻保持形象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: People are talking by being quiet. Saying things with flicky glances. Everyone's hiding something? Should I hide something? Oh! Would that make them like me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 人们在交谈，静静地交谈着。他们用眼神在说话。每个人都在隐藏什么？我也应该隐藏点什么吗？哦！那会让他们喜欢我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sorry... Sorry to bother. Would you have time to look at this? That is, if it's all right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不好意思……不好意思打扰了。你有时间看看这个吗？如果可以的话？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I have a secret too. It's that I. Have. No. Secrets! Haha, is that a good one? Should I tell them? Would that... is that what we're doing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我也有一个秘密。那就是……我。没有。任何的。秘密！哈哈，这个好吗？我要告诉他们吗？那……这是我们在做的事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I... have a request. If you have the time, of course. Trying to keep busy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我……有个请求。如果你有时间的话。尽量让自己忙起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk. Wuk. Wuk. Wuk. Rark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕。呜咕。呜咕。呜咕。啦嘎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Hello. Might you care to work on something? Together, I mean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。你好。你愿意做一些事吗？我是说一起做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hunh. Hunh. Hunh. I'm... I'm fine. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哼。哼。哼。我……我很好。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Smacks beak)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （咂嘴）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Exhale)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （叹气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Sighs)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （叹气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: nnnnnnnGAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I should have killed him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我本该杀了他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I can't keep feeling like this. I can't keep feeling like this. I gotta... I gotta get it out. Minn. Minn... what do I do? What do I do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我不能再继续这样的感觉了。我不能再继续这样的感觉了。我得……我得把它释放出来。小敏。小敏……我该怎么办？我该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Labored breathing)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （呼吸困难）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Coughs)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （咳嗽）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What would you have told me to do? I don't know. I never met the person you became. You existed only for an instant and then... gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你会让我怎么做呢？我不知道。我从未见过你成为的那个人。你只存在了一瞬间，然后……就消失了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The voices in the walls... are they getting closer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 墙里的声音……它们越来越近了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Maybe, those voices in the walls will solve all of this for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 也许，墙里的那些声音会为我们解决这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tagfer? Oh. Yes. Best left to his own devices for now I suspect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃？哦。是的。我想现在最好还是不要打扰他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hello. Sorry to bother, but... has Tagfer, um, said... anything... to you? About me? No? No. No particular reason. A good leader keeps abreast of the spirit of the team. Thank you. Carry on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你好。抱歉打扰了，但是……标弃，嗯，有……对你说过……关于我的事情吗？没有吗？好吧，没有。没什么特别原因。一个好领导应该要了解团队的情绪。谢谢你。你继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I think I'm starting to understand how brains work. The things you remember, the things you don't... until someone says something that brings it all rushing back...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我觉得我开始理解大脑是如何运作的了。你记得的事情，你忘记的事情……直到有人说了些什么，一切都涌上心头……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You need something?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你需要什么东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I feel sorry for Bird. He deserves better than to be stuck with us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我为鸟感到难过。他值得更好，而不是和我们在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do you think... do you think Loid knew? The bell I mean. What would happen. To us. Down there. Do you think Papa told him?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你觉得……洛德知道吗？我指的是那个钟舱。会发生什么。对我们来说。就在那下面。你觉得爸爸告诉他了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do you think Loid stood by, while Papa pulled the lever? On those screens... do you think he watched?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你觉得当爸爸拉动控制杆时，洛德会站在一旁吗？在那些屏幕上……你觉得他看了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do you think Papa saw the moment Minn became a person? The exact same moment she realized she was going to die? The only moment I ever really had with her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你觉得爸爸看到了小敏成为一个人的那一刻吗？就是她意识到自己将要死去的那一刻？我和她真正拥有的唯一的时刻？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I like you. You're not like the others here. Are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我喜欢你。你和这里的其他人不一样。对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Now that you're here, Tenno, let's put you to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 既然你来了，Tenno，那就开始工作吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That sound Mister Tagfer makes... makes me feel squinchy inside. Makes my eyes prickle. Makes me think of Minn. He misses Minn. I miss her, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃先生发出的声音……那声音让我心里发紧。让我眼睛发酸。让我想起小敏。他思念小敏。我也想她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Please remember to hand in any Voca you encounter. For analysis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 请记住，交出你找到的任何音魂。用作分析。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (sobbing)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （抽泣）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Whaddya use these things for anyway? Mister Tagfer says they solve problems. How do they solve problems? I tried asking them how I could get a bunch of sticks so I could make a nest like I had when I lived in the green thing called a jungle, but they didn't say. Wuk. Rark. Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你到底用这些东西做什么呢？标弃先生说它们能解决问题。它们怎么解决问题呢？我试着问它们我怎么可以弄一堆树枝来做个巢，就像我之前住在那个叫丛林的绿色地方时那样，但它们没说。呜咕。啦嘎。呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: One must make the best of things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 人必须尽力而为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The bell... everything that happened? I wish I could remember. But it's all just... flashes. Horrible, horrible flashes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那个钟舱……发生的一切？我真希望我能记得。但现在只剩下……些许片段。恐怖的，极其恐怖的片段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh hey! You wanna bang-make-flat? Uh, loud sleepymaker? Y'know, a make-em-go-floppy! Shouty shouty! Ugh. Words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦嘿！你想玩"砰砰砰-倒地-躺平"吗？呃，吵吵的瞌睡虫？就是让他们变得软趴趴的那个！大喊大叫的！哎，讲话真难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sorry. I'm... not very good company right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 对不起。我现在……不是很好的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey. I still got a bunch of that noisy metal wood you like so much. Least I'm told it's noisy. Mister Tagfer says he made it all safe. How do you make wood safe? Is wood not safe? Has Mister Tagfer made all wood safe? What about the wood I made nests from back when I lived in the green thing? Hello? Is wood my friend? Hello? Rark. Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿。我还有一堆你超喜欢的吵吵的金属木头。至少我听说很吵。标弃先生说他把它们都弄安全了。怎么能让木头变安全呢？木头不安全吗？标弃先生把所有的木头都弄安全了吗？那我以前住那个绿色东西里的时用来做窝的木头呢？喂？木头是我的朋友吗？喂？啦嘎。呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Hello. Don't mind me. Just... thinking? I don't like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。你好。别理我，我只是……在思考？我不太喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey, does the sky still exist? Mister Fish-oh-nah-chee just makes weird breathy sounds when I ask. Mister Tagfer says it does. Why can't we see the sky? Can we see the sky? When? Is it when I give you all this noisy metal wood Mister Fish-oh-nah-chee says you need? He says it's important. Why is it important? Can you take it now? Is the reason you can't take it now because you don't have enough arms? Can you get more arms? Hey. Rark. Wuk. Rark. Humph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿，天空还在吗？每次我问肥鱼那契先生，他都只会发出奇怪的呼吸声。标弃先生说天空还在。我们为什么看不到天空？我们能看到天空吗？什么时候？等我把肥鱼那契先生说你要的那些吵吵的金属木头都给你的时候？他说这很重要。为什么？你现在能拿走它吗？你现在不拿是因为你没有足够的胳膊吗？你能长出更多的胳膊吗？嘿。啦嘎。呜咕。啦嘎。哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Sorry. I... I didn't see you there. Can I... help you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。对不起。我……我没看到你在那里。我能……帮你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hmm, I wasn't me, then I was me. Will I be not me again? When I'm not me will I remember being me? Will I miss me? I think I miss being not me. When I was not me names weren't things. Things weren't things. Everything was anything. When I was not me there was nothing I wasn't. Now I'm just... me. And things are just things. Rark. Wuk. Being a person is hard. I don't feel like me fits in me. Inside me is the wrong size for outside me. Outside me is the wrong size for outside. I wonder if the other mes feel like this. Wuk. Rark. Hm. Rark. I was bigger when I was smaller.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯，我原本不是我，后来我又是我了。我还会不是我吗？当我不是我的时候，我还会记得我是我吗？我还会想我自己吗？我觉得我怀念不是自己的时候。那时候我不是我，名字都不是事儿，事情也不是事儿。什么东西都是一切。当我不是我时，没有什么不是我。现在我只是……我自己。而且事儿只是事儿。啦嘎。呜咕。做人真难。我感觉我不适合我自己。我里面的我和外面的我大小不合。外面的我和外面的世界大小不适。我想知道其他的我有没有这种感觉。呜咕。啦嘎。嗯呣。啦嘎。我更小的时候其实更大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Mating call)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （求偶叫声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sometimes, when I try to sleep, I hear noises. Word-noises. Word-noises saying things. Things I don't wanna hear. From the walls. An' I say SHUT UP WORDS! I'M TRYNA SLEEP! Wuk. Wuk. Stupid voices. Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有时候，我想睡觉时就会听到噪音。说话的噪音。说话噪音在说着事情。那些……那些我不喜欢听的事情。从墙里传来的。然后我就会说，说话声闭嘴！我要睡觉了！呜咕。呜咕。愚蠢的声音。呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Mournful lowing)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （悲痛低鸣）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: "So... once I didn't think, now I do. Once I was a what, now I am a who. So what's don't think but whos do. That makes me me and makes you you." If my thinking makes me a who it makes everyone else a who. But I can't see what other whos think... and I'm pretty sure they can't see what I'm thinking... and when Mister Tagfer and Mister Fishonacci tell me what I'm thinking I'm pretty sure they're wrong... so when I think I know what they're thinking I'm probably wrong. So... everybody's wrong about what everybody's thinking so everybody's wrong about who everybody is. I think. So... that means... we should probably stop thinking about it... and just be nice to each other. Wuk. Rark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "所以……以前的我不思考，现在的我会了。以前我是什么，现在是个谁。因此什么不会思考，谁会。让我成为我，让你成为你。"如果我的思考让我成为一个谁，让每个人成为谁。但我看不到其他的谁们在想什么……我很确定他们也看不到我在想什么……当标弃先生和肥鱼那契先生告诉我我在想什么时，我很确定他们错了……所以当我知道他们在想什么时，我可能也是错的。所以……每个人对别人在想什么的思考都是错的，每个人对别人是谁的思考也是错的。我想。那么……这意味着……我们可能该停止思考这些……并且对彼此好点。呜咕。啦嘎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What do I do? What do I do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 怎么办？我该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark. Rark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎。啦嘎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Minn... it should have been me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 小敏……出事的应该是我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark. Wuk wuk wuk. Rark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎。呜咕呜咕呜咕。啦嘎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Whimper)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （呜咽）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Can I help? I can help! Let me help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我能帮忙吗？我能帮忙的！让我帮忙吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Pull it together. Do it for her. Pull it together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 振作起来。为了她，要振作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Within this crucible heat and cold birth a Blast force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 火焰和冰冻结合产生了爆炸元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bring hot and cold together. It's a blast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 把热和冷结合起来。就变成了爆炸。哈哈哈哈……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Crucible creates Blast Force. Gather Heat and Cold Amphors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这个是用来制造爆炸元素之力的。收集火焰和冰冻的元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Success! The Vitreum beholds swarm!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 成功！魔瞳看到了敌群！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Success! The Vitreum beholds swarm! Attack now, if you keep searching you risk discovering a purer, more virile foe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 成功了！魔瞳看到了大批敌人！立即进攻，如果你继续搜索，可能会遇到更纯粹、更强劲的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We... We have a lock. The Vitreum stares down our target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们……我们锁定目标了。魔瞳紧盯着我们的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We... We have a lock. The Vitreum stares down our target. Press the attack now, if you keep searching I cannot be responsible for what horrors the Vitreum may find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们……我们锁定目标了。那只魔瞳正注视着我们的目标。现在就出击，如果你继续搜索，我可不敢保证魔瞳还会找到什么恐怖的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If I may: do not tarry overlong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果我可以提醒的话：不要停留太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Well... I mean... if you're sure?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯……我的意思是……如果你确定的话？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh, you are called away?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦，你被叫走了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The enemy does not sleep, Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 敌人是不会睡觉的，指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If you deem that best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果你认为那样最好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What do you mean, "no"?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "不"，是什么意思？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Weh? Wah? Bluh! Blabawaghawagh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 喂？哇？布鲁！布拉巴瓦瓦瓦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: One struggles to fathom your priorities. Bloody biped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我很难理解你的优先事项。该死的两脚兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Well. Don't let me hold you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。好吧。别让我耽搁你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: One does not wipe one's arse with the Grand Design!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没人会用宏伟的设计来擦屁股！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Of course, of course. Oh dear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧，好吧。这下完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Are you quite sure? I mean... the threat, you know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你很确定吗？我的意思是……威胁，你知道吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Well if there is anything one can do to change your mind...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧，如果有人可以做些什么来改变你的想法……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Excelsior!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 精益求精！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Our noble struggle continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们的崇高斗争仍在继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The enemy does not rest, nor do we.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 敌人不休息，我们也不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We hold the line.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们坚守防线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We are the threshold the Great Indifference shall not cross.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们是那个巨大虚空无情之物无法跨过的门槛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thank you. Do excuse me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 谢谢。实在不好意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: On... Onward. Ah. What a bother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 向……向前进。啊。好讨厌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We have an ac an ac... an accord. I'm fine, I'm fine. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们有一个协一个协……一个协议。我没事，我没事。谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Honour Papa's plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 兑现爸爸的计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We trust in Papa's wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们相信爸爸的智慧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You have your orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你已经收到命令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那就这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thank you. I am grateful for the distraction. Begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 谢谢。我很感激可以分个心。开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Very kind. I find it helpful to have work to focus upon. Let us begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 非常好。我发现专注于工作对我很有帮助。让我们开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thank you very much. I am ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 非常感谢。我已经准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I know what it must have cost you to bring me these.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我知道你为了给我带来这些付出了多少代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Remain of stalwart mind, Tenno, even in the face of madness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 即使是面对疯狂，Tenno，也要保持坚定的心智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The debris of monstrousness. Let us learn from it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 怪物的残骸。让我们来研究它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah, a fresh opportunity to continue my Albrecht's work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊，这是一个继续我阿尔布雷希特的研究的新机会！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: To do what you do would vex my sanity, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 要我做你所做的事会考验我的理智，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 下次见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 行吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: No problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You got it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你做到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mmhmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: All right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do not stay away overlong. Our enemy does not tire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 别待得太久。我们的敌人可不会停歇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Until the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 下次再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Good day to you... I love you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 祝你有美好的一天……我爱你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bye?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 再见？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Sigh)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （叹气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So... that's all?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那……就这样了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yeah, okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯，好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我明白。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Off you trot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 赶紧走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yes yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好，好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Run along.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 赶快走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Very good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: As you were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一如既往。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 果然。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Exhales)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （呼气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Any. Time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 随时。恭候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yyyep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 行吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Ah. Thank you. For your time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。啊。谢谢。谢谢你的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Lovely to see you. As always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一如既往，很高兴见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. 

The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
我用多种科维兽试图消灭对手。

这个原理足够简单，尽管事后回想起来我讨厌自己的天真。我的人性被腐蚀性的虚空揭开，而现在又隔着鸿沟对我笑，对我所有肆无忌惮的恶意和狭隘了如指掌。作为回应，我决定将非人的思想投入到虚空。让虚空去拙劣地模仿它们。野性的接近将迫使它经历一场屈辱的退化。至少我是怎么认为的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
The majority of the Cavia merely died. I gave the Void living beings and it sent me back bedraggled cadavers. The dead lay stacked in pyramids around my deserted lab. I was nothing but a failed priest.

But a glass splinter of stubbornness still stuck in me. And so, I persisted. The correct combination of creatures would work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
大多数科维兽只是死了。我给虚空送去鲜活的生命，它却还我一具具肮脏的尸体。尸体在我被遗弃的实验室周围堆成了金字塔。我不过是一个失败的牧师。

但一丝倔强如玻璃碎片般刺在我心里。所以，我继续尝试。正确的生物组合会起作用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
I realized my error as I sweated by visionary nestawood cinders, beside Loid who curled pale and sick from chewing too much of the root. The catalyst was uniqueness. That attribute was what caught the interest of the bland and undifferentiated Void. 

It was not necessary to explore queasy debates about the Oro; animal minds simply lacked the full distinction of a singular persona. My Kalymos, I was sure, was an exception, but I would not sacrifice that loyal being.

Perhaps I should have. The sin I was to commit was worse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
当我在致幻的巢木余烬旁汗流不止时，我意识到自己的错误，而洛德因咀嚼太多的树根，脸色苍白而病态地蜷缩成一团。独特性是催化因素。正是这一属性吸引了那个单调且一体化的虚空。

探讨关于奥魂那些令人不适的议题是没有必要的；动物思维并不具备单一人格的完整区分。我确信我的卡利莫斯是个例外，但我不会牺牲那个忠诚的生命。

或许我早就该那么做了。我即将犯下的罪孽更加严重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
The very last breeding pair of Cervulites was smuggled to me, causing Loid no small inconvenience. A species on the brink of extinction. Here was the uniqueness the Void sought. I was certain to the pit of my entrails.

I loaded the pair on to their Seriglass bridal barge, along with an expendable avian and a Norg for mental ballast. Fish, fowl and beast. A facile equilibrium.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
最后一对用于繁殖的石鹿被偷运到我这里——这一行径让洛德颇为困扰。这是一个濒临灭绝的物种。正是虚空所追寻的独特性。我深信不疑。

我将这对动物装载到它们的玻璃窗婚船上，连同一只可供牺牲的鸟类和一条用于维持心理平衡的诺格。鱼、禽和兽构成了一个简易的平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
They did not die, save one. They came back changed. Witnesses. Pilgrims, even, chanting freakish praise to the one beyond the wall.

I knew, then, that my gambit had lost. So long as I worked through scapegoats, my guilt would only deepen. I must atone for what I had done through my own blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
他们并没有死，除了一个。他们变了样回来了。成为了见证者。甚至可以说是朝圣者，对着墙外的那个存在吟唱着怪异的赞歌。

我那时明白了，我的策略已经失败了。只要我继续使用替罪羊，我的罪恶感就会愈发深重。我必须用自己的血来赎罪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
Standard laboratory hygiene would have been to dispose of them. But some instinct stayed my hand. The Voidtongue was an enigma to me, but another - more habituated to the Void than I - might one day unravel it. Through the imposition of form upon the formless they could, perhaps, glean some meaning. 

I assigned the Cavia to Loid, for I could not bear to look upon them. Not yet.

Loid is, at heart, a good and kind man - better than I deserve. And completely oblivious to his own true worth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
根据标准的实验室卫生流程，它们必须被丢弃。但某种本能却让我停了下来。虚空语对我来说是一个谜，但另一个比我更适应虚空的人也许有一天会解开它。通过对无形施加形态，他们或许能够领悟出某些意义。 

我把科维兽交给了洛德，因为我不忍直视它们。暂时还不行。

洛德骨子里是一个忠顺纯良的人——优秀到不应留在我身边。他完全没有察觉到自己的真实价值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're in. Grab and go. Can't wait to see what you got when you get back here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好，进去了。赶紧拿东西。我迫不及待想看你拿了些什么回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Take whatever Albrecht was hiding and get back to Sanctum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 把阿尔布雷希特的藏品全带走，然后再返回圣所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Albrecht didn't want anyone in here. I want to know why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特不想让任何人进来。我想知道为什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That's the Netracell. Open it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那就是衰退室。打开它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Using the Keyglyphs will open the Netracell. So be ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 使用钥符会打开衰退室。所以，做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This is it. Use the Keyglyph and... get ready for whatever happens next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没错，就是这个。使用钥符然后做好准备……应对一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[3.3]
Albrecht designed the Netracell's Keyglyphs to hobble anyone carrying them.
[9.6]
Meat for the lab's defenses. Buuut those same defenses will see you as undesirable.
[11.3]
Easy come, easy go.
[17.3]
To leave the Anchorhold, you need all four Keyglyphs. Good luck to ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[3.3]
拿着阿尔布雷希特做的衰退式钥符很难走，难逃于实验室防御单位。
[9.6]
当然，这些防御单位看你也不顺眼。
[11.3]
来得容易，去得快。
[17.3]
想离开这个安全所，得集齐全部四个钥符。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You or your squad need to grab all four of these Keyglyphs. Pick your poison, pal. I won't lie, there's no version a this that feels good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不管是你还是你的小队都必须拿齐四个钥符。选择你的痛苦吧，伙计。说实话，不管怎么选你都不会好受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Anchorhold, where Albrecht stored the Keyglyphs. Grab 'em. No wrong answers, they all suck. But you're not cracking a Netracell without them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 安全所，阿尔布雷希特存放钥符的地方。拿上。哪个都行，反正都一般。但没钥符，就打不开衰退室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This is gonna hurt. You need all four Keyglyphs from these pillars. Choose your pain. It's the only way to open a Netracell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这会有点痛。你得从这些柱子上拿齐四个钥符。选择你的痛苦吧。这是打开衰退室的唯一方法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's comin' up to midnight, folks! Is YOUR PC ready for the new millennium? Orrrr... are YOU one of the switched-on thinkers who can tell this so-called Y2K event is just a bunch of bullpucky? Stay tuned. Here's where we find out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 快到午夜了，朋友们！你的电脑准备好迎接新的千禧年了么？或——者……你也是一位头脑灵光得能分辨出这所谓的千年虫问题只是一派胡言的人吗？锁定本台。这就是我们找到答案的地方！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Norg status: fully alert. Brain function: exceptional. Checking nutrients.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Norg status: fully alert. Brain function: exceptional. Checking nutrients.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (moan)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （呻吟）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Cervulite status: extreme depression. No substitute mate available. Species extinction: imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Cervulite status: extreme depression. No substitute mate available. Species extinction: imminent.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Zek? Aba! Zek? Zek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Zek？Aba！Zek？Zek？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Avian status: overstimulated. Sedative recommended. Revival process ongoing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Avian status: overstimulated. Sedative recommended. Revival process ongoing.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno? That colorless antique there - use it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno？那边那台无色的古董——去用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This isn't right. The Transference stream... it's being diverted!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这不对劲。传识流……正在被转移！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yara mig!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Yara mig！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Aoi? Feels like there's someone in my head...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 碧？感觉我脑子里有个人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I do hope you find that useful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我确实希望你觉得这很有用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: And well-earned, I might add.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我还想补充一点，这是应得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: With my compliments.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 伴随着我的称赞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Now take your sweetie and run along.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 现在带着你心爱的宝贝上路吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa must believe this aids in conditioning, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我想，爸爸一定认为这对训练有帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: All right! There you go! Back to work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好的！就这样！回去做事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A Crucible. You must feed it the correct Amphors: capsules of elemental forces, compressed to a near impossible density. Volatile enough to be used as a grenade, should the need present itself. The problem? Our adversaries have taken Papa's Amphors. Be a dear and repatriate them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 转换坩锅。你必须给它放入正确的元素瓶：元素之力胶囊，被压缩到几乎不可能的密度。其不稳定性足以将其用作手榴弹，如果需要的话。问题是？我们的对手拿走了爸爸的元素瓶。请你帮个忙，把它们赶走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This Crucible requires feeding with the prescribed elemental forces. These can be found within the Amphors. Retrieve them from the Murmur and put them to use. Or, if emergency arises, hurl them at your assailants and observe the results. Stupid mineral things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 需要向这个转换坩锅投放特定的元素之力。这些力量可以在那些元素瓶里找到。从低语者那里取回它们，然后加以利用。或者，如果遇到紧急情况，就把它们扔向敌人，看看会发生什么。真是些无脑矿物玩意儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Don't forget to gather up those Vosphene Glyphs when you can. A bit of automated security never goes amiss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有机会的话别忘了去收集那些荧音浮印。多一点自动化的安全措施总是不会错的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If you need assistance, try to focus on gathering the Vosphene Glyphs. It'll trigger the security system I put in place for just such an eventuality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果你需要帮助，就试着专注于收集荧音浮印。这样就会触发我专门为此类情况预设的安全系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I didn't install that security system just to have it gather dust! Collect Vosphene Glyphs to bring it online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我安装这个安全系统可不是为了让它闲置在那积灰的！把那些荧音浮印收集来，启动它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tools are there to be used, Tenno. Scoop up the Vosphenes and fire up the backup Defenses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 工具就是要拿来用的，Tenno。去收集荧音浮印，并将备用防御开启。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm confident you can handle the Murmur by yourself, but if you need a spot of backup, gather the Vosphene Glyphs and the lab can do some of the work of defending itself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我相信你一个人就可以搞定低语者，但如果你需要一些支援的话，收集荧音浮印，实验室就能自行分担一部分防御工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: To produce Corrosion you'll require Amphors of Toxin and Electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 要产生腐蚀元素之力，你需要毒素和电击的元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Take Toxin and Electrical amphors, mix well, and presto, Corrosion shall result.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 拿上毒素和电击元素瓶，充分混合，很快，腐蚀元素之力就产生了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Corrosive force results from the interplay of electricity and toxicity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 腐蚀元素之力是由电击和毒素这两种元素相互作用产生的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Don't just stand there. The Crucible requires the prescribed Amphors to work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你别光站在那。转换坩锅需要特定的元素瓶才能运作！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You must lob the correct Amphors toward the Crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你必须向转换坩锅扔出正确的元素瓶才行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Quickly now, throw the elemental Amphors at the Crucible. Well, go on!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 赶紧的，将那些元素瓶投向转换坩锅。去呀，还不快去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If I do this too much am I gonna molt?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果我经常这样做，我会不会掉毛？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ooh. Me like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: SHIINEEE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好闪亮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hee hee!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘻嘻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Spiffy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm fancy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我好有范儿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey! Hey! Lookit! Hey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿！嘿！看看我！嘿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Might take some gettin' used to, but... I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 可能需要一些时间来适应，但是……我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If she could see me now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果她现在能看到我就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Not bad!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah. Glorious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊。光彩照人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A consummate triumph... look at the fins on this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一个完美的造型……看看这上面的鳍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I daresay I shall... grow used to it. Eventually.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我敢说我会……会习惯这个的。迟早。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Decisions, decisions...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 怎么选择呢，选择……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So? Whadda we think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 所以？我们觉得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I mean, I could get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我是说，我可以习惯这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Feels like me, but is it me me, y'know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 感觉像是我，但是真的是我自己吗，你懂我意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hmm. Meretricious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯。俗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You may wish to accentuate the brain. After all, that's what they look at.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你也许想要凸显头脑。毕竟，那是他们看重的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Are you afflicted with choice paralysis?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你是否患有选择困难症？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: One must be bold, but not gaudy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一个人必须要大胆，但不要花哨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: New plumage?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 新的羽毛？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh! Feathers changing? What season is it now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦！羽毛变了？现在是什么季节了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ooh! Ooh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦！哦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Just... promise me you won't laugh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 只……请你答应我不会笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A change is as good as a bender. Whatta we got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 改变有时候就像纵情一样美妙。我们得到了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Time for a new me, maybe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 也许是时候让我焕然一新了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You think so? Oh, very well. Spruce me up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这是你的想法吗？哦，那好。那就请帮我打扮一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: By all means, improve upon perfection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 尽一切可能，让完美更上一层楼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What tremendous designs do you dream of? I think I'd look rather spiffing with a moustache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你梦想中有什么出色的设计？我觉得我留着小胡子应该挺有型的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It manifests as one! Steel yourself and attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它显化为接肢了！稳住自己，然后进攻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There! The demon finally takes form! At last, it can be destroyed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那里！这个恶魔终于成型了！终于，它可以被摧毁了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Here comes the tide. Let it break itself against you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 断肢潮来了。让它在你面前溃不成军。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Defeat the tide, to face the One.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 打败断肢潮，然后去迎战接肢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark. Rark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎。啦嘎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuuuuuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜——咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Sighs low)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （低声叹气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Sigh)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （叹气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Necramites are slowing us down. Find 'em, smash 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 殁世微灵正在减慢我们的速度。把他们，给我干了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Albrecht's damn Necramites are reinforcing the Netracell. Your hands are tied until you knock 'em out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的殁世微灵正在强化衰退室。打倒它们，你别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Something's going on with...Necramites. Trying to lock this thing down. Take 'em out. We ain't got all day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 似乎出了些问题……啊......是殁世微灵。它们想封锁这个地方。消灭它们。没时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Acquire a fresh probe, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 获取一个新的探测器，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Atropos Probes in your vicinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 命运之神探测器就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hurry! You require more Atropos serum!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 快！你需要更多命运之神血清！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Fresh serum. Take it, it's yummy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 新鲜的血清。拿去吧，很美味的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah. A splendid result.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊。一个极好的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Out with the old, eh, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 要清理旧东西了，对吗，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A wealth of Vosfor, and all of it yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 大量的荧尘，全是你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: And here's the yield.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 然后这就是产出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Dissolved as requested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 按照要求已分解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your Vosfor, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这是你的荧尘，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders.

But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
在双衍王境， 我每天都在我女儿的声音中醒来。起初，我因良心的责备而退缩。我无法面对我所抛弃的女儿，哪怕只是表面上的。于是我改头换面成为一位师长，告诫少年国王注意他王境之外的威胁。

但随着时光流逝，我开始认出欧拉瑞娅创造的那些古怪角色及其目的。我听到了那些声音，那是我最初在她孩童时代房间的漆黑中召唤出来的，不求任何回报，只为了她的喜悦。她不仅保留了这份我曾认为微不足道的礼物，还把它变成了一种治愈的工具。不仅如此：它还成为了一个堡垒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Despite my legacy of neglect, despite my shoddy example, my needs, my demands, my daughter had triumphed in my absence. Her confidence, her warmth, shamed me. I had fled from the horror, but she? She had stood alongside the most vulnerable, those with the most to lose, and told them a different story.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 尽管有我留下的忽视，尽管我的不良榜样、我的需要、我的要求，我的女儿却在我缺席的情况下取得了胜利。她的自信，她的温暖，让我感到羞愧。我从恐惧中逃离，而她呢？她与那些最脆弱的，可能失去最多的人站在一起，给他们讲述了一个不同的故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
I did not perceive the significance of Euleria's stance at first. Her concern for the children was not merely pastoral attentiveness. It was a direct strike against the Indifference. She was teaching the weak to be strong in the very places where those cold fingers would reach, and through her act of compassion, spitting in the face of alienation and despair.

Could I do less?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
起初我没有意识到欧拉瑞娅的态度有何意义。她对孩子们的关心远不止牧师般的关怀。这是对虚空无情之物的直接打击。她在那些虚空无情之物将要触及的地方教导着弱者变得坚强，并通过她的怜悯之举，唾弃疏远和绝望。

我怎能不去做更多？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
Shame is an inert state, but fertile. It primes the mind, bolstering it for repentance.

I had thought to make a difference in Duviri. But Duviri had made a difference in me. My own daughter's creations, reverberating and growing in the womb of the Void, had shown me another path than that of the indulgent coward. I was neither helpless nor irredeemable. Like she had, I could fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
羞愧是一种不变的状态，却极富生机。它预备心灵，并加固心灵促使悔改。

我曾以为能为双衍王境带来改变。然而，是双衍王境改变了我。我自己女儿的创造，在虚空的子宫中回荡成长，向我展示了另一条道路，不同于纵容懦夫的路。我既不是无助的，也不是无可救药的。就像她一样，我也能战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
I took inspiration from Euleria's example. To the people of Duviri I bequeathed a legacy of cautionary stories. In them I spoke of fears that an infinity of spirals would not, could not, erase.

I slipped away from those lands, silent and unnoticed. From their joys, their sadnesses. From the celebration in my honor. In her, they already had all they needed. My work, I now understood, must proceed from a different point.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
我从欧拉瑞娅的行为中受到了启发。对于双衍王境的人民，我留下了一系列警世故事。在这些故事中，我讲述了即使是无尽螺旋也无法抹去的恐惧。

我悄无声息地离开了那片土地。离开了他们的喜悦、悲伤。离开了为我举办的庆典。因为有了她，他们已经拥有了所需的一切。我现在明白，我的工作必须从一个不同的角度着手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Auricle, Tenno! Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 魔耳那边，Tenno！快去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Collating sensory reports, determining next target... it's the Auricle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 正在整理传感报告，确定下一个目标……是魔耳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: They're targeting the Auricle. Hurry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它们的目标是魔耳。赶快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Attackers shifting focus to... the Auricle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 攻击者将目标转移到……魔耳了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I need you at the Auricle. Post-haste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我需要你火速前往魔耳，以最快速度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: They're attacking the Auricle. Keep it intact! We need to hear every whisper the Indifference utters!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它们正在攻击魔耳。要保持其完好无损！我们需要听到虚空无情之物发出的每一个低语！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur are shifting to the Auricle! We must hear them, whatever the cost to our sanity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语者正在转向魔耳！无论我们的心智付出多大代价，我们都必须要听到它们的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: They're trying to destroy the Auricle! Beneath the bone, the eardrum is fragile. All too easy to rupture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它们正在试图摧毁魔耳！在骨头的下方，耳膜非常脆弱。十分容易破裂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Success! A new complex element has been created. Locating the next Crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 成了！一个新的复合元素之力诞生。正在定位下一个转换坩锅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Would you look at that, the purity! Do it again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你快瞧瞧，那纯度！再来一次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Shazam! What a gorgeous samp... who's a pretty sample? You are, you're a pretty sample aren't you? Create another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哎呀嘿！多美的样……谁是那个漂亮的样本？是你，没错吧？再制造一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Why... I do say. It's perfect. Make another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊……我得说，这简直太完美了。再制造一个吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah, progress. But we require more. Again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有进展。然而我们还需要更多。再来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Attackers. Keep them clear of the Vitreum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 敌人来了。让它们远离魔瞳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Vitreum cannot see with the Murmur atop it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 当低语者遮盖住魔瞳，它就不能看见了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do not allow anything near our Vitreum!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不要让任何东西靠近我们的魔瞳！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Keep them away! The Vitreum cannot see with those things around it. I mean what on Earth are you thinking?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 把它们赶走！有那些东西在周围，魔瞳是看不见的。你到底在想什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Does that look like a happy eyeball to you? Keep it clear of obstructions, lest our work be for naught!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你看那像是个高兴的眼球么？要确保它周围无障碍，以免我们白忙一场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Place yourself between the Vitreum and the enemy! Stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你要站在魔瞳和敌人之间！阻止它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We cannot expect the Vitreum to perceive anything whilst being poked at in such a manner! What if I poked you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 魔瞳被这样戳，我们怎能指望它感知到什么！如果换成是我戳你呢？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We are losing the signal. Protect the Vitreum scanner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们正在失去信号。保护好魔瞳扫描器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The search is being hampered. Something is blinding the Vitreum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 搜索过程被干扰了。有东西在使魔瞳看不见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If these fragments were to unite... Destroy them swiftly, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 倘若这些断肢结合在一起……尽快消灭它们，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This ought to keep the group cohesive for a little longer...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这应该能让团队的凝聚力保持更长时间……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We appreciate it, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们感激不尽，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Research keeps the Cavia busy, and that keeps them off my back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 研究让科维兽有事可做，这样它们就不会来烦我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I guess that's all of them? Welp! Time to head back to the nest!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我猜这些就是全部了吧？好啦！该回窝窝里了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mmm. Gross. Okay all done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呃。好恶心哦。好啦，全部搞定！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yeah! They were like "Grr!" and you were like "Pow!" and they were like "Aaagh!" and you were like "That's cool" and I was like "Whoa."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没错！它们"咕噜"的一声，你就"砰"的一下，它们"啊"地叫，你就"酷酷"的样子，然后我就"哦哇"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Those boomies really boom, huh. I'm startin' to think maybe I shouldn't be makin' a nest outta some a that stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那些砰砰弹真的会砰砰响。我开始觉得，也许我不该用那些东西来搭窝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That was more fun than checking Mister Tagfer for fleas. And, to be clear, I really enjoy doing that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊，这个比在标弃先生身上抓跳蚤有趣多了。还有要知道，我可是真的很喜欢抓跳蚤的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ha. And don't come back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哈。还有不许再回来哦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: No thank you! That showed 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不，谢谢！这下它们好看了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yeeeah, I saw a few more down the hall. Figured I'd, y'knooow, go clean 'em up for ya, but thennn, y'know, I saw you're pretty into it, sooo I figured I'd leave 'em for ya. Figured you could use the practice. I'll get the next bunch, no problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯，我看到大厅里还有几个。我本来想，你懂的，去帮你清理掉它们，但后来我看你挺喜欢这个，就想说还是留给你吧。我觉得你可以用来练手。下一批我来搞定，没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Startin' ta smell better in here already.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这里的味道已经开始变好闻了呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Go get 'im friend!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 抓它们，朋友！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: RARK! Big, bad, should-not-be-in-here things in here. Make them go away? Puh-leeeeeze?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎！这里有些大大的、坏坏的东西，不应该在这里。可以把它们弄走吗？求求了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: No! RARK! No! RARK!  Too close to our nest. TOO CLOSE. Outie-outie!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不！啦嘎！不！啦嘎！太靠近我们的窝了。太近了。快出去，快出去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ssshhh listen. You hear that? Things are too close. Bird snatching, jump out of nowhere and grab you things... Use the loud metal sticks... tell those things this is OUR SPOT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘘，听。你听到了吗？有些东西太近了。会抓鸟、突然跳出来抓你的东西……用那些响响的金属棍子……告诉他们这里是我们的地盘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Those creepies got no manners, comin' back when we saw them off for comin' back. See 'em off for comin' back after we saw 'em off for comin' back. Yeah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那些怪物真是一点礼貌都没，来了之后刚赶走它们就又回来了。得再赶走它们，因为来了之后刚赶走就又回来了。对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ok, here's my nope list. Nope the ones with crawly arms. Nope the ones that look like tasty insects but are not tasty insects. Nope the clangy ones that used to be nice but aren't anymore. Nope them. Nope them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧，这个就是我的黑名单了。有爬行手臂的，不要。看上去像是好吃的虫子但又不是好吃的虫子的，不要。呕，那些以前很好现在不好的响响东西，不要。不要它们，全都不要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur weeps. My, my. You are quite something. Return to the Sanctum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语者在哭泣。我的天，你还挺有两下子的。返回圣所吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: As it was written, so has it come to pass. The awaited Operator has slain the many armed envoy. 'Vashtav, Mara Lohk.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 正如文字所记，一切都已经成真。那位被期待的指挥官战胜了多臂使者。"Vashtav, Mara Lohk"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The harder won the victory the greater the spoils. Return to the Sanctum and collect your bounty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 胜利越是来之不易，奖励就越丰厚。回到圣所去领取你的奖励吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do you always do this, pick the hardest path? One of these times, you may not be so lucky. Until then, enjoy the fruits of your wrath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你总是这样，选择最艰难的路吗？总有一天，你可能不会再那么走运。在那之前，享受你的愤怒结出的果实吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Get out now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 立即撤离！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That area has been permanently compromised. Extract!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这片区域情况很糟，已经永久失陷。撤离！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You are out of options. Retreat to the Sanctum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你已经没有别的选择了。撤退到圣所去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Formidable progress. I urge you: keep the crucibles firing, should opposition grow too great of course, return home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 显著的进展。我认为你应该继续保持转换坩锅的运转。当然，如果进攻的敌人势头太猛的话，回家也是一种选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa's vessels move one step closer to completion, huzzah! Should you feel the need to withdraw, the path to the Sanctum is open to you, naturally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸的承载体又向完成迈进了一步，万岁！如果你觉得需要撤离，通往圣所的道路自然而然为你敞开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: When need arises you may return to the Sanctum. Until then, give the murmur hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 若有需要，你可以回到圣所。不过在那之前，给那个低语者一点颜色瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If you wish, you may return to the Sanctum. But I think you have more fight in you than that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果你愿意的话，你可以返回圣所。但我认为你内心的斗志远不止于此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: When you are ready to return, the Sanctum is waiting for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 当你准备好返回时，圣所就会等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You can come home now. No need to be a hero on my account. Unless of course, you want to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你现在可以回家了。无需为了我去逞英雄。呃，当然了，除非你想这样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: To the Vitreum!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 前往魔瞳处！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Vitreum under attack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 魔瞳正在遭受攻击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Back to the Vitreum, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 返回魔瞳处，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Attackers shifting focus to... the Vitreum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 攻击者将目标转向了……魔瞳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Defend the Vitreum! Quickly, please!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 守护魔瞳！请快点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Vitreum is under attack! Defend it, Tenno. If it is punctured, the consequences will be catastrophic. And disgusting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 魔瞳正在遭受攻击！去保护它，Tenno。如果它被刺破，那么后果将会是灾难性的。而且还很恶心。
