/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur is targeting the Vitreum! Hurry, Tenno. An eyeball cannot defend itself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语者的目标是魔瞳！快点，Tenno。眼球是无法保护自己的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Defend the Vitreum, Tenno. The Murmur knows we cannot protect the Labs if we are blind to their presence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 保护魔瞳，Tenno。低语者深知如果我们看不见它们的存在，我们就无法保护实验室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Netracell is hidden somewhere in these labs. Sniff it out yourself or get control of Terminals - they'll tell you where it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 衰退室就藏在这些实验室的某个地方。要么你自己找出来，要么控制这些终端机——它们会告诉你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Netracell is deep in this lab-maze. Get control of a few terminals. That'll help you zero in on 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 衰退室就在这座实验室迷宫的深处。去控制几台终端机。他们会帮你定位它的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That was the easy part, now you have to find the Netracell. Albrecht left terminals coded with partial coordinates in these halls. Yeah, even he got lost down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 刚才那只是简单的部分，现在得去找衰退室了。阿尔布雷希特在这些大厅的终端机里留下了些坐标。没错，连他也在这里迷过路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah, the Atropos Probes! Take one, and fill the waiting eyeball full of visionary juice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊，命运之神探测器！捡起一个，让那颗等待的眼球充满洞察力的汁液。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Equip yourself with an Atropos Probe that you may pierce the Vitreum with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 给自己配上一个命运之神探测器，用它刺穿魔瞳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Vitreum may not gaze into the abyss without Atropos Serum! Acquire a probe, quickly!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没有命运之神血清，魔瞳则无法凝视深渊！获取一个探测器，快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Atropos Serum. A drug that opens perception to other realms, causing madness. Fortunately the Vitreum lacks a mind to lose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 命运之神血清。一种开启对其他领域的感知力并导致疯狂的药剂。幸运的是，魔瞳无心，亦无法发狂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Look what this fish just caught. You keep fighting, and I'll keep finding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 瞧瞧本鱼刚刚找到什么。你继续战斗，我会继续寻找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: They're so distracted by your attack that I'm able to siphon valuables from murmur strongholds. They will never see this fish coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 因为你的攻击它们被分散了注意力，所以我才能如此顺利的从低语者的据点中搜刮贵重物品。它们绝不会察觉本鱼的到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's not dead! You have to kill the... the smell of it. Understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它还没死！你得去除掉……那股气味。懂了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's still hunting. Find the burrow it winters in. Kill that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它还在狩猎。找出它过冬的洞穴。杀死它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Not safe. It's still out there. You have to kill all of it. Not just the skin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 还不安全。它还在外面。你得把它彻底消灭，不只是表皮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay. You have to hunt it now. Find what it doesn't want you to find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧。你现在必须去猎杀它。找到它不想让你找到的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You can't. Kill. A shadow! Find what's casting it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你无法。杀掉。影子！找出投射它的东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's running. Growing a new skin. If you're quick and ballsy you can finish it. Maybe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它在逃跑。正在长出新皮肤。如果你够快的话，或许能干掉它。或许。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yes. That. There. The book. That's its real body. Kill it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没错。就是那个。就在那。那本书。那才是它的真身。杀了它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You found it! Kill it, fast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你找到了！杀了它，快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay, now's your chance. Destroy. The. Book.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好了，现在是你的机会。毁掉。这本。书。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This Crucible creates Gas. Feed it Heat and Toxin Amphors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这个转换坩锅是用来制造毒气的。往里投入火焰和毒素的元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Gas elemental force! Heat and Toxin Amphors required.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 毒气元素之力！需要火焰和毒素的元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I wait upon your pleasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我会等待你的指示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: All satisfactory, I trust?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我相信一切是都满意？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Our service is but a shadow of yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们的服务相较于你只是影子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: To better times ahead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 为了更好的未来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Company is always welcome, down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 在这里，始终欢迎有人来做伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Whistle)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: (吹哨)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Have fun!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 玩得开心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'll miss you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我会想你的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bye bye now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 拜拜喽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur stares back at us. Take its eyes, they will lead you to your target. Quickly now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那低语者也在凝视着我们。取下其眼睛，它们将指引你找到你的目标。赶快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Can you feel that? The Murmur's eyes gaze upon you. Pluck them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你能感觉到吗？低语者的眼睛在注视着你。把它们拿下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The eyes, the eyes! They're everywhere! Grab them whilst you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 眼睛，眼睛！它们无处不在！趁你还能抓住它们的时候赶快行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Take the eyes, whilst we can still see them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 趁我们还能看见那些眼睛，把它们取走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This is your chance, go for the eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这是你的机会，去取下眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah! Quickly! The eyes! Grab 'em and run!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊！赶紧的！那些眼睛！抓住它们然后快跑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You woke up a bad thing, but then you killed it, so uh, I guess you did okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你唤醒了一个可怕的东西，但后来你又杀了它，所以，我觉得你做得还行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I told you not to mess with it! I'm glad you're okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我跟你说过别去碰它！幸好你没事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Collect your Necramech from the dispenser at your convenience. Give them hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你方便的时候就从分配站那里取走你的殁世机甲。让它们见鬼去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Additional firepower authorized. If the Murmur are capable of regret, make them feel it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 额外的火力已经得到了授权。如果低语者能感到后悔，就让它们尝尝这滋味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your Necramech is en route to you even as we speak. I look forward to the ensuing mayhem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 就在我们交谈的这会儿，你的殁世机甲已经在路上了。我十分的期待接下来的大混战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Excellent. Your Necramech is on the way. I wager you're due for some fun?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 非常好。你的殁世机甲正在路上。我敢打赌你要享受一番乐趣了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your Necramech will be waiting at the designated dispenser. You may fire when ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你的殁世机甲会在指定的分配器那里等待着你。准备好后就可以开火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: These consoles are so dreadfully finicky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这些控制台实在是太过挑剔了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah. Not to worry. Maybe next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊。不用担心。也许下一次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm afraid the Necramech will have to wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 恐怕殁世机甲得等一等了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Convince the system to let you in and I'll send your personal Necramech to a dispenser.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 系统允许你进入了，我就把你的专属殁世机甲送到一个分配站。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Preparing your Necramech. Waiting for you to unlock the transit path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 正在准备你的殁世机甲。等待你成功解锁运输通道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Necramech almost ready to deploy. This next part is down to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 殁世机甲几乎已准备好部署。接下来的部分都取决于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Recalibrate the console to recognize you, and your Necramech will be with you in seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 重新校准控制台以便识别你，你的殁世机甲将在几秒钟内来到你身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What charming arrogance. I do hope you are ready for what must now be unleashed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 何等迷人的傲气啊。希望你已经准备好迎接即将被释放的事物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You allowed the Vitreum to locate the beast's most powerful form. Well, get on with it then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你让魔瞳定位到了这头怪兽的最强形态。那么，现在就行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Albrecht may have told you to build that thing, but given how he used people and threw them away, he may not have cared for your safety. If that gargoyle is a threat you must take it from the Sanctum immediately. Now, activate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特或许告诉过你要制造那个东西，但考虑到他过去对人的利用和抛弃，他可能并不在乎你的安全。如果那个合成兽像构成了威胁，那么你就必须立刻从圣所中带走它。现在，激活它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: AT LAST. IF IGNORANCE IS BLISS THEN YOU, TENNO, MUST BE ECSTATIC. COME ON THEN. BRING IT CLOSER! WAKEY WAKEY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 总算来了。如果无知是福，那么你，Tenno，一定欣喜若狂。那就来吧。把它拿近些！快醒醒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Where did that come from? Identify yourself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那是从哪里来的？报上你的名字！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: PLEASE, LOID, LET THEM FIGURE IT OUT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 拜托，洛德，让他自己去搞清楚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: THAAAT'S IT. ALMOST THERE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 就——是这样。快到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: YES, YES, VERY GOOD. KEEP GOING.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 对，对，非常好。继续走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: THAT'S THE RIGHT DIRECTION! WHO'S A GOOD BIPED?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 就是这个方向！谁是优秀的两脚兽？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: THAT'S THE RIGHT DIRECTION! WHO'S A CLEVER LITTLE AIR-BREATHER? YOU ARE, YES YOU ARE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 就是这个方向！谁是那个聪明的小呼吸生物？是你，是的就是你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: NOOOO. THIS WAY.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不——这边走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: NO! I... WE'RE GOING TO BE HERE ALL DAY, AREN'T WE?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不！我……我们不会是要在这里待一整天吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[3.2]
...AND NOW IT'S WANDERING OFF AGAIN. HELLO!
[9.2]
WRONG. WAY. Bipeds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[3.2]
……现在他又开始乱走了。喂！
[9.2]
走。错。了。两脚兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: OH, BY ALL MEANS STAND AROUND CATCHING SNOWFLAKES ON YOUR TONGUE. IT'S NOT LIKE WE HAVE AN UNFOLDING CRISIS OR ANYTHING.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦，你一定要站在那里努力地用舌头接雪花。反正我们也没有什么危机之类的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: HELLOOO? WAKE UP, TENNO. YOU NEED TO FIND ME.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你——好？醒来吧，Tenno。你需要找到我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: HERE! IN THE JAR! "WHA? THE FISH WITH THE BIG BRAIN?" YES THE FISH WITH THE BIG BRAIN! CAN WE PLEASE, FINALLY, GET THIS INTERMINABLE PROCESS OVER WITH?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这里！在水缸里！"什么？大头鱼？"是的，大头的鱼！拜托，我们能不能赶紧结束这个没完没了的过程？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Albrecht used you to give the Cavia a voice, just as he used me to keep them alive. Such a resourceful man.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特利用你给科维兽赋予声音，就像他利用我来让它们存活。可真是个足智多谋的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So here we are then: the best of what's left. Clearly Papa's plan was countered. Color me surprised. Right, then. We may proceed with the Sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那么这就是我们：剩下的最优秀物种。很显然爸爸的计划被阻挠了。真让我意外。好吧，那么，我们可以继续执行数列了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You animals have observed us all this time, have you not? You've given yourself a ROLE in the Sequence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你们这些动物一直在观察我们，不是吗？你们已经给自己在数列中安排了一个角色吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Indeed we have - come, Loid, it's named after Papa's favored pet! Spared the rod and spoiled. We know the Fragmented Ones are heralds of the Indifference. We know the Chosen Operator must summon and destroy them. And regrettably, you, Loid, have made this impossible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 的确如此——来吧，洛德，这是以爸爸最喜欢的宠物命名的！被宠溺到没有受过惩罚。我们知道断肢怪是虚空无情之物的先驱。我们知道被选中的指挥官必须召唤并摧毁它们。遗憾的是，你，洛德，让这一切变得不可能了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Choose your words carefully, fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 注意你的措辞，鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno: the Grimoire is incomplete, the final page hidden away. By Loid. Be a darling and retrieve it. That's all. Run along.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno：这个魔典不完整，里面的最后一页被藏起来了。是洛德干的。当个好人，把它取回来吧。就这样。快去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So be it - the gift of decency was clearly not bestowed upon the Cavia, Tenno, but I cannot deny the page's current status is lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 只能这样了——科维兽显然没有被赋予体面的恩赐，Tenno，但我无法否认这张书页目前是丢失的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Talk? Talk! I can talk! Hey! Hey! Ooh! Ooh! Mister Loid! Mister Loid! Where is Papa? Why did Papa leave us? Mister Loid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 说话吗？说话呀！我会说话！嘿！嘿！哦！哦！洛德先生！洛德先生！爸爸在哪里？爸爸为什么离开我们？洛德先生？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa is gone. We could all be gone too. In an instant. Like... like... We have to keep quiet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸走了。我们可能也都消失了。就在一瞬间。就像……就像……我们必须保持安静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thank you. A moment, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 谢谢。请稍等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Would you do the honors?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 能请你来执行这个光荣任务吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[5.9]
Arthur? Tenno? Forgive me. 
[14.3]
I need Loid to understand why I had to leave. Without him. 
[20.5]
Why I forced him to destroy the device after I had gone. 
[26.1]
And why I could never say the words he so needed to hear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[5.9]
亚瑟？Tenno？请原谅我。
[14.3]
我需要让洛德明白我为什么必须离开。且没有带上他。
[20.5]
为什么我要求他在我离开后销毁那个装置。
[26.1]
以及为什么我从未能说出他渴望听到的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[12.7]
If I had remained in the Deimos laboratory, Loid would never have been safe from... Him. 
[15.5]
You know of what I speak. 
[24.5]
And so I retreated to the only place in history where that entity could not easily follow. 
[28.8]
To draw His greedy eye away from Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[12.7]
如果我留在火卫二实验室，洛德就永远无法远离危险……也就是"他"。 
[15.5]
你知道我说的是什么。
[24.5]
因此我撤退到了历史中唯一一个那个实体难以跟随的地方。
[28.8]
为的是将"他"的贪婪目光从洛德身上转移开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[7.5]
Tenno - I require your trust. 
[12.4]
Craft the little curio whose blueprints you will find in the computer's memory. 
[17.0]
Complete the Kalymos Sequence. Repair. Rebuild. 
[23.2]
When the time is right, find me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[7.5]
Tenno——我需要你的信任。 
[12.4]
制作那个小玩意，你会在计算机的存储中找到它的蓝图。 
[17.0]
完成卡利莫斯数列。修复。重建。 
[23.2]
当时机成熟时，找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The skin of a martyr doesn't suit you, Albrecht! If something mattered... he'd have found a way. It's too late. You heard him, Tenno! He requires your trust. So craft the bloody thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你不适合扮演殉道者，阿尔布雷希特！如果真的有什么重要的……他肯定会找到办法的。已经太晚了。你听到他的话了，Tenno！他需要你的信任。那就去制造那个破东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This stillness... Tenno. No. Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这种寂静……Tenno。不，是指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The strand of Khra has been cut while the Indifference remains undeterred. I foresee a grim and continuing struggle to safeguard Papa's laboratory from its fell and ruinous grasp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 时间丝线已被切断，而虚空无情之物依然不为所动。我预见到了一场艰苦且持久的战斗，为了保护爸爸的实验室免受其邪恶和毁灭性的控制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Indeed. I shall not waver.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 的确。我不会动摇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: In the version of the past we saw, Papa said help came too late. The solution, obviously, is to arrive on time, next time. You keep the Murmur at bay, I shall fulfil the Cavia's role in the Kalymos Sequence. Punctuality.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: In the version of the past we saw, Papa said help came too late. The solution, obviously, is to arrive on time, next time. You keep the Murmur at bay, I shall fulfil the Cavia's role in the Kalymos Sequence. Punctuality.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: 'Protect the Vessels. Repair. Rebuild.' So runs the Kalymos Sequence, and such is our task. In the version of the past we saw, My Albrecht said we were too late. The solution, naturally, is to arrive on time, next time. You keep the Murmur at bay, I shall fulfil my role: Punctuality. The Entrati family never could arrive on time without my help. And so... here I am, back to my old role. The diligent servant. Albrecht would have smiled at that, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "保护承载体、修复、重建。"卡利莫斯序列就是这样运行的，我们的任务也是如此。在我们看到的不同过去中，我的阿尔布雷希特说我们来得太晚了。解决的办法，自然是下次准时到达。你去阻止低语者，我去完成我的任务：守时。没有我的帮助，英择谛家族永远不会准时到达。所以……我又回到了原来的角色，勤劳的仆人。我想，阿尔布雷希特会对此会心一笑的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: He said...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 他说……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: ...do not let it see you weeping, Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: ……不要让它看到你在哭泣，洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: ...my last sight of your face must not be marred by tears.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: ……我对你的面容的最后印象，不应该是泪水满面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: ...how do I still deserve your tears after all I have done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: ……我做了这么多的事，还怎么值得你流泪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
We had a deal. The deal was shook.
A little handshake, all it took!
Though from the deal the wee child ran...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
我们明明约定好的。都握手了呢。
只需握一下手，就足够了！
然而那个小鬼却逃离了这个约定……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:

A little handshake, all it took!
Though from the deal the wee child ran...

A little handshake, all it took!
Though from the deal the wee child ran...

我们明明约定好的。都握手了呢。
只需握一下手，就足够了！
然而那个小鬼却逃离了这个约定……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
We had a deal. The deal was shook.
A little handshake, all it took!
Though from the deal the wee child ran...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
我们明明约定好的。都握手了呢。
只需握一下手，就足够了！
然而那个小鬼却逃离了这个约定……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[2.5]
Yet still...
[7.8]
WE END AS WE BEGAN.
[9.3]
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[2.5]
尽管如此……
[7.8]
我们的结局又回到了开始。
[9.3]

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're right, Fish. Loid could never figure things out. We have nothing to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你说得对，小鱼。洛德永远无法弄清楚这些事。我们没什么可担心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're right, Fish. Loid could never figure things out. We have nothing to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你说得对，小鱼。洛德永远无法弄清楚这些事。我们没什么可担心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're right, Fish. Loid could never figure things out. We have nothing to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你说得对，小鱼。洛德永远无法弄清楚这些事。我们没什么可担心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're right, Fish. Loid could never figure things out. We have nothing to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你说得对，小鱼。洛德永远无法弄清楚这些事。我们没什么可担心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If the Cavia have been babbling our secrets to the Murmur I shall immolate the lot of them, promise or no promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 要是那些科维兽把我们的秘密泄露给了低语者，我会把它们全部烧掉，不论之前有过什么承诺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It seems Albrecht said more than we heard. Despite the signal becoming corrupted, his words to you are preserved in the Transference buffer. We should extract them... but for that the Pom-2 requires a replacement "board", and those are all hidden away in the Netracells. You do understand that accessing a Netracell without a Keyglyph is completely impossible?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 似乎阿尔布雷希特说了些我们没听到的话。尽管信号被干扰，他对你说的话却被保存在传识缓冲区中。我们应该提取它们……但这需要更换石榴 2 代的一块"电路板"，而这些板子都被藏在衰退室中。你知道不用钥符就根本无法进入衰退室吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mara lohk! Mara lohk!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Mara lohk！Mara lohk！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A Keyglyph. So. The Cavia have provided the very item we require. Very well: proceed to the Netracell at your own risk, Tenno. That babbling oddity may be sending you into a trap, and if you do end up in one, I'm afraid you are on your own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一枚钥符。看来，我们需要什么科维兽就恰好提供什么。那好：继续前往衰退室，但风险自负，Tenno。那个叽叽喳喳的怪物可能正引你入陷阱，如果你真的落入其中，恐怕你得自求多福了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So, Albrecht made it to 1999 in one piece. But that thing is still on his heels. Albrecht rarely smiled, after his return from the Void. And never like that. I smashed the casket for nothing. It followed him anyway!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这么说来，阿尔布雷希特一路平安地到达了 1999 年。但那个东西仍然紧随其后。阿尔布雷希特自从从虚空回来后就很少笑了。更别提那样的笑了。我砸了棺材也没用。它还是跟着他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: YARA MIG! URU URU YARA MIG!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: YARA MIG！URU URU YARA MIG！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: ZEK! ZEK! ABA? ZEK! ZEK! ABA?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: ZEK！ZEK！ABA！ZEK！ZEK！ABA？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: MIG? MIG? RE-UN?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: MIG？MIG？RE-UN？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: SILENCE, CREATURES! It seems the Murmur overloaded your connection. Unfortunately for Albrecht's cherished Pom-2. Not as 'future proof' as the label claimed, alas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 安静，生物们！看来低语者让你的连接过载了。不幸的是阿尔布雷希特所珍爱的石榴 2 代电脑它并不像标语上所宣传的那样"永不过时"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur. They're attacking the sensory network I installed, our eyes and ears! To arms, Tenno - play the warrior, and leave the tactics to me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语者。它们正在攻击我建立的传感网络，我们的眼睛和耳朵！拿起武器，Tenno——你扮演战士，战术就交给我吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Construct - I'm awake. Your one responsibility is fulfilled. Be with the family. They must be kept in the state of ignorance to which my Albrecht so wisely consigned them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 构物——我醒了。你的唯一职责已经达成。留在家族身边。必须让他们继续保持无知的状态，这是我的阿尔布雷希特对他们的明智安排。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: But I - Yes. I see. Until we meet again, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 可是我——好的。我明白了。我们下次再见，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'd crawl away in shame too if I'd done what LOID did. Doesn't that Grimoire feel a little - light?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果我干了洛德做的那种事，我也会羞愧地爬开。那本魔典感觉是不是稍微——轻了些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'd crawl away in shame too if I'd done what LOID did. Doesn't that Grimoire feel a little - light?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果我干了洛德做的那种事，我也会羞愧地爬开。那本魔典感觉是不是稍微——轻了些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'd crawl away in shame too if I'd done what LOID did. Doesn't that Grimoire feel a little - light?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果我干了洛德做的那种事，我也会羞愧地爬开。那本魔典感觉是不是稍微——轻了些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'd crawl away in shame too if I'd done what LOID did. Doesn't that Grimoire feel a little - light?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果我干了洛德做的那种事，我也会羞愧地爬开。那本魔典感觉是不是稍微——轻了些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There! A Vitreum! Administer the Atropos serum, and defend the boggling eye as it searches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 在那！一颗魔瞳！注入命运之神血清，在魔瞳搜索的时候，保护住这个令人费解的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Inject the Vitreum, Tenno, and keep it intact. We require it to see on our behalf.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 给魔瞳注射，Tenno，且保留其完好。我们需要它来替我们看见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Vitreum awaits. Administer the serum! Do not allow the vision to be interrupted by anything! And don't talk to it, even if you die!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那只魔瞳在等待着。赶紧注射血清！千万不要让任何事情中断其视觉！哪怕是死，也别和它说话！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Open that waiting eye unto the Abyss, Tenno, and defend it whilst the serum does its potent work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 向着深渊开启那只等待着的眼睛，Tenno，并在血清发挥其强大作用时保护它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sending another capsule. These don't grow on trees you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 正在发送另一个维生装置。这些东西很稀有的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Looks like you could use a bit of life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看起来你可以用些维生装置了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your hard work is really paying off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你的努力确实得到了回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I do not think the Murmur will miss this, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我不认为低语者会想起这东西，你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I shall put this one on the pile. We're going to need a bigger Sanctum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我要把这个放到那堆东西中。我们需要一个更大的圣所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Aaaand it's out. You let it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 然后，它跑出来了。你放出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Listen! It's not you. It's... wearing your skin but it's not you. Kill it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 听着！那不是你。它只是披着你的皮囊，但绝不是你。杀了它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What kinda moron lets a starving predator out of a trap? Well, now you gotta deal with... whatever that is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 什么样的白痴会放走一个饿扁的掠食物？好吧，现在你得自己去搞定……那啥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tick tock, kiddo! You don't wanna be late again, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 滴答，小鬼！你不想再次迟到，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tick tock, kiddo! You don't wanna be late again, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 滴答，小鬼！你不想再次迟到，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tick tock, kiddo! You don't wanna be late again, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 滴答，小鬼！你不想再次迟到，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tick tock, kiddo! You don't wanna be late again, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 滴答，小鬼！你不想再次迟到，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Jahu Gargoyle. Bring it back here and we shall... examine what 'Form' will do to help us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 形态合成兽像。把它带回来，我们将……研究"形态"能如何助我们一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[9.5]
One minute I existed only to eat? And flee? And breed? 
[15.6]
The next I was... me. 
[26.7]
But Minn... did Minn have time to be Minn, before... before...? 
[35.7]
She and I... we were the last. Did you know that? 
[44.0]
Without her... there's no more... us. No more Tagfer and Minn. 
[50.3]
No soft calls... no gentle nuzzling muzzle. 
[60.3]
No little Tagfers... no little Minns... ever. 
[69.3]
Fibonacci says we have to trust that it's all part of Papa's plan... 
[73.0]
How? Why? 
[80.4]
And now I have a purpose, so the fish says. 
[86.2]
To help you, in the ways in which I have been instructed. 
[92.5]
When all I want is to be with her! Minn...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[9.5]
前一分钟我存在只是为了吃？还有逃跑？和繁衍？
[15.6]
下一分钟我就成了……我。 
[26.7]
但小敏……小敏有时间成为小敏吗，在……在……之前？
[35.7]
她和我……我们是最后一对。你知道吗？
[44.0]
没有她……就不再有……我们。不再有标弃和小敏。
[50.3]
不再有温柔的呼唤……不再有轻柔的鼻子对蹭……
[60.3]
不再有小小标弃……不再有小小敏……永远不再有。
[69.3]
斐波那契说我们必须相信这一切都是爸爸的计划……
[73.0]
怎么可能？为什么？
[80.4]
现在我有了一个目标，正如那条鱼所说。
[86.2]
那就是帮助你，按照我被教导的方式。
[92.5]
但我只想和她在一起！小敏……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[8.4]
You've met the animals? The catastrophe Albrecht's saddled me with? Well? Any ideas? 
[14.2]
Their roles were intended to be filled by qualified personnel. 
[21.9]
People. Instead, we have... this. It's bad comedy. 
[32.4]
They're imprinted with whatever information they need to function, and an understanding of our current state of affairs - including Albrecht's absence. 
[37.8]
They were sent into the Void using a bell of the same design that Albrecht initially used. 
[43.2]
The Void got in, somehow. Again. 
[51.1]
One of the animals was lost, and the rest came back... like that. 
[56.4]
We placed them in stasis pending a proper examination. 
[62.5]
For them, the disaster, intelligence and selfhood all occurred only hours ago. 
[68.4]
They're psychological shrapnel and they're all we've got. 
[73.6]
See what you can do with them. I simply do not have the time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[8.4]
你见过那些动物了吗？那是阿尔布雷希特给我留下的灾难。有什么想法吗？
[14.2]
本来它们的角色应该由有资质的人员担任。
[21.9]
人类。而我们却得到了……这个。简直是荒谬的闹剧。
[32.4]
它们被赋予了运作所需的一切信息，以及对我们现状的理解——包括阿尔布雷希特的缺席。
[37.8]
它们被送入虚空，使用的是阿尔布雷希特最初使用的同款设计的钟舱。
[43.2]
不知何故，虚空又入侵了。
[51.1]
有一只动物失踪了，其余的……就那么回来了。
[56.4]
我们将它们置于静止状态，等待适当的检查。
[62.5]
对它们而言，灾难、智慧和自我感知都只发生在数小时之前。
[68.4]
它们是心理碎片，也是我们唯一拥有的。
[73.6]
看看你能怎么处理它们。我实在没有时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah yes. 'Operator', correct? 'Drifter', perhaps? You'll find our merry band share that unconventional relationship with their appellations. I am Fibonacci. Papa's design has uplifted me to function as the coordinating factor of this little group. You... may have heard that one of our number was consigned to Paradise before our return from the Void. Minn. Tagfer's mate. Yes. Most unfortunate. Too often it is the good and the young who forge our future, laying their lives upon Progress' unfeeling anvil. Now: let us apply ourselves to the grand work at hand, and deny our minds melancholy's frigid caress. To work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊，是的。 "指挥官"，对吗？也许是，"漂泊者"？你会发现我们的快乐小团体与他们的称呼有着非传统的关系。我是斐波那契。爸爸的设计让我成为这个小团体的协调因素。你……可能听说过，在我们从虚空返回之前，我们中的一员被送到了天堂。那是小敏。标弃的伴侣。非常遗憾。往往是那些善良的小年轻缔造了我们的未来，把自己的生命置于进步的无情铁砧上。现在：让我们全身心投入到手中的伟大工作中，拒绝心头忧郁冰冷的爱抚。开工！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If enough people bang their heads on the same brick wall for long enough, it will fall down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果足够多的人，长时间地对着同一堵砖墙撞头，那它终将会倒塌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I am going to see him again, one day, Tenno. It is decided.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一定会有那么一天，我会再次见到他，Tenno。这是决定好了的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's wonderful to see you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 很高兴见到你，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: When what was left of my Albrecht came crawling back from the Void, I swore I would take care of him forever. I will be honored to do the same for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 当我的阿尔布雷希特剩下的部分从虚空中爬回来时，我发誓要永远照顾他。我也会很荣幸为你做同样的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I do wish my Albrecht could have met you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我真希望阿尔布雷希特能见到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I helped chart mankind's path to the stars, and now I am half zookeeper, half shopkeeper. How perverse fate can be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我曾帮助制定人类通向星空的道路，但如今的我却成了半个动物园管理员，半个店主。命运真是反复无常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Fibonacci cheats at Komi, you know. He thinks I haven't noticed. Inferior human brain, and all that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 斐波那契在下围棋时作弊，你知道吧。他以为我没注意到，还老是以为人类大脑不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I talk and talk of changing the past, but Tagfer has swallowed his own unthinkable grief for the sake of our common survival. That creature is a better man than I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我总是谈论着改变过去，但标弃为了我们共同的生存承受了他难以想象的悲痛。那个生物比我更称得上是男人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What news of the family, Tenno? I miss them all so very, very much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 家族那边有什么新消息吗，Tenno？我非常、非常地想念他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We have our work cut out for us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们的任务很艰巨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: "Once more unto the breach", wot?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "再次向缺口进发"，懂了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Together again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 又在一起了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey. Listen. Thanks for... well, giving us a purpose. Stopping us breaking apart. Better to be alone together, right? The last little while has been the... well, 'happiest' is a stretch, but 'least miserable' I've been since all this happened. We all owe you, for saving what little we had left. But, just so we're clear, when we find Albrecht the old man is mine. Even if I have to go through Loid to get to him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿。听着。谢谢你……给了我们一个目的。阻止我们分裂。毕竟，一起孤独总比单独孤独强，对吧？最近这段时间……算不上"最快乐"，但自从这一切发生以来，我是"最不痛苦"的。我们都感激你，感谢你拯救了我们所剩无几的东西。但是，要明确一点，找到阿尔布雷希特后，那老家伙归我处理。哪怕我不得不先过洛德这关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Splendid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The enemy shall not find us wanting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 敌人不会发现我们有什么不足。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The threat persists, and we stand ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 威胁依然存在，但我们已做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I knew you'd come back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦！我就知道你会回来的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How may I be of assistance? Rark. Crap. Rark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我能帮上什么忙吗？啦嘎。哎呀。啦嘎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I may not be able to see sky blue no more, but it makes me feel good to help you protect it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我可能再也没有机会看到蓝天了，但能帮助你保护它让我感觉很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Help me help you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你帮我等于我帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We all got somethin' to do. Mr Fish-o-nah-chee's got his thing, Mister Tagfer's got his thing, I got my thing. It's so nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们都有自己事情要做。肥鱼那契先生有他的事情，标弃先生有他的事情，我也有我的事情。这样真好啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hope you're havin' a luv-erly day. Rark. Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 希望你今天能过得很开心。啦嘎。呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
When the grandchildren were still very small, Kalymos fell sick. I did what I could, but there seemed to be no hope.

Albrecht took Kalymos away, out of our sight. He told us she was recovering, and mustn't be disturbed. And one bright morning, Kalymos came running up to greet us, all better.

I often wondered if he simply cloned her, and the original had died. If he did, he never gave any sign of it. So far as Albrecht was concerned, Kalymos was Kalymos. 

I'm glad the Cavia made it, Tenno. I couldn't help Kalymos. But we saved them, didn't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
当孙儿们还很小时，卡利莫斯生病了。我尽了自己所能，但似乎无济于事。
 
 阿尔布雷希特把卡利莫斯带到我们看不见的地方。他告诉我们卡利莫斯在康复中，不能被打扰。然后在一个阳光明媚的早晨，卡利莫斯跑来迎接我们，完全恢复了。
 
 我常常想，他是否只是克隆了她，而原来的已经死了。如果他真的那么做了，他也从未表露过。对于阿尔布雷希特说，卡利莫斯就是卡利莫斯。 
 
 我很庆幸科维兽活了下来，Tenno。我帮不了卡利莫斯。但我们救了它们，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Listen. I only been thinkin' for a little while, and I think I mighta been dead there for a bit? So maybe I'm not doin' it right, but I know I'da been dead for more than a bit if it wasn't for you. So anytime you wanna go in that chamber and get irradiated and then killed and then come back as a rainbow like we did I'll ask Mister Loid to put it back together and I'll be the one pullin' the lever on ya. That's what they call 'returnin' a favor'. I think. Anythin' for you, pal. You're a regular Bird 4.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 听着。刚才我只是稍微的想了一下，我在想是不是我刚才可能死了一下？所以可能我做得不对，但是我知道如果不是因为你，我可能就不只是死了一下而已。所以任何时候你要想进入那个房间，像我们一样经过辐射、死去然后变成彩虹回来的话，我会叫洛德先生把它重新组装起来，而且，我还会亲自为你拉杠杆。这就是他们说的'报恩'。我想。我为你做什么都行，伙计。你就是一个鸟四了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We have our work cut out for us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们的任务很艰巨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: "Once more unto the breach", wot?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "再次向缺口进发"，懂了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Together again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 又在一起了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Splendid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The enemy shall not find us wanting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 敌人不会发现我们有什么不足。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The threat persists, and we stand ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 威胁依然存在，但我们已做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What ya need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 喂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What'll it be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你想要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I... I do hope Tagfer understands what occurred was... Oh! Yes yes what what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我……我确实希望标弃明白之前发生的事情是……哦！是的，是的，什么什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do I have your complete attention?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你可以全神贯注地听我说话吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Let us see if we cannot find something suited to your... competencies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 让我们看看是不是找不到适合你……能力的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: One has no choice but to entrust you with this. Please, be worthy of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我别无选择，只能把这个托付给你。拜托，一定不要辜负我的好意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa saw promise in you. I shall strive to do the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸在你身上看到了希望。我也会努力这样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You... understand what is required of you, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你……明白对你的要求是什么，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I have attempted to explain your task as simply as possible. No big words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我试着尽可能简单地解释你的任务。不用晦涩难懂的词。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yes yes good good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是的，是的，很好很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your attention please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 请你注意了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Eyes front! We begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 眼睛向前看！我们开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mister Fish-oh-nah-chee said I had to hold these for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 肥鱼那契先生叫我一定要把这些东西留给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Like 'em?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 喜欢它们吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Heyo!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿哟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How many and where do I send 'em?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有多少？要我要送到哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So, you collect these or what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那，你收集这些还是？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: When I find things I like I keep 'em. So... if we're not keeping these then they must not be very good? But if you need 'em then your stuff must be worse. I am happy to help give you better stuff by handing you our garbage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我找到喜欢的东西就会留着。所以……如果我们不留着这些，那它们肯定不怎么好吧？但是如果你需要它们，那你的东西肯定更糟。我很乐意把我们不要的垃圾给你，帮你得到更好的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Fingers are weird. They're just there, on you, doin'... stuff. Gross.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 手指真是奇怪。它们就在那，在你身上，做着……事情。真恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ooh! Conversation! Who goes first?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 噢！要聊天了！谁先来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Y'ello!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你好呀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What do these do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这些是用来干啥的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa's plan, the fish says. All of this to his design. But... how could Papa have known it would go down like this, us getting smart, Minn... unless he had some hand in it? But Papa's trip to the Void went bad as well, right? That wasn't planned, or else he wouldn't be so rushed, and... panicked? Maybe Papa screwed up. Maybe this was all an accident. Loid put me in charge of getting you into the Netracells. I'm thinking maybe... maybe there's something in there that might give us a clue. To why this all had to happen. Or at least smash or steal something the dirtbag that did this to us cares about. A Cervulite's gotta have some hope, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 老鱼说，是爸爸的计划。这一切都是按照他的设计。但……爸爸怎么可能知道事情会这样发展，我们变聪明，还有小敏……除非他也参与其中？但是爸爸的虚空之行也出了问题，对吧？那不是预先计划好的，否则他不会这么匆忙，也不会……慌张？也许爸爸搞砸了。也许这一切都是意外。洛德让我负责把你带进衰退室。我在想也许……也许里面有什么东西可以给我们线索。告诉我们为什么这一切会发生。或者至少砸坏或偷走那个对我们做这种事的混蛋在乎的东西。一只石鹿总得有点盼望，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno. Is all well... down below? In the lab!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno。在实验室里，下面的一切……都还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I am no longer troubled by my dreams, Tenno. It is my waking hours that are filled with dread.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我已经不再受到梦境的困扰了，Tenno。让我感到恐惧的是清醒时的每一刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How is my... counterpart? If you can endure his bitterness, Tenno, and honor the man within, he will be your friend for life. Just as I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我的对应角色……怎么样了？如果你能忍受他的尖酸，Tenno，并尊重他内心的那个人，那么他会成为你一生的朋友，就像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Otak is none the worse for his forced slumber. Perhaps it was wrong to keep the truth of the Labs from him... but that truth might have wounded him, and I will not see him hurt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 奥塔因为被迫沉睡并没有受到什么坏影响。或许，向他隐瞒实验室的真相是不对的……但那真相可能会伤害他，我不想让他受到伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How goes the Kalymos Sequence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 卡利莫斯数列进展的怎么样了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thank you. Here you go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 谢谢你。就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: These are all I have, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 恐怕，这些就是我的全部了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What do you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你怎么想？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: He-ey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿——诶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mmmmmm.
What.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You wanna head out I guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我猜你想出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sure, let's go. It'll take my mind off things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好的，咱们走吧。这能让我暂时不去想那些事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ok now what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧，现在怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I have a small battery of tasks to complete, and once they are done, I shall repeat them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我现在需要完成一些任务，在完成之后，我打算重做一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I wouldn't bother going mad, Tenno. It may be dreadfully tempting but it really does not help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 别费劲去发疯，Tenno。这或许非常诱人，但实际上并无帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: "Tis better to have loved and lost, than never to have loved at all."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 经历过爱的得失，总比从未爱过要好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The backroom boys have been beavering away in your absence. Slow progress is still progress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你不在的时候，幕后的小伙子们一直在辛勤工作。进展再慢也是进展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I was trained to assist Archimedeans, not warriors, or animals, but I shall do my best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我接受训练是为了帮助哲士，而不是战士或动物，但我会尽力而为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: And how may this relic make himself useful to you today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我这个老古董今天要怎么样做才能帮到你呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah, Tenno. I forget what one is meant to do with company.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊，Tenno。我忘记该如何与他人相处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Welcome, once again, to the chaotic waltz that is my life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 再次欢迎你来到我那混乱的华尔兹人生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm never alone down here, Tenno. It's always watching from behind the walls. Flattering, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我在这里从来不孤单，Tenno。它总是在墙后注视着。我觉得这挺讨人喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Hello.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。你好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Uh, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呃，怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Who, me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 谁，我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do you need me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你需要我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Are we heading out, then?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那，我们要出发了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We truly have accumulated a bewildering quantity of... stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们确实积攒了一堆令人眼花缭乱的……东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: My Albrecht did his best to prepare the stockrooms for your arrival.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我的阿尔布雷希特为你的到来尽全力准备了储藏室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm quite content down here, I assure you. A chap has to have his space.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我在这里很满意，我向你保证。一个人必须有自己的空间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sometimes I wonder how much of this Albrecht saw coming. And then I try not to think about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有时我在想，阿尔布雷希特对这些事情有多少预见。然后我就尽量不去想这件事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: 'Arcanes'. The very name smacks of sorcery. Asking for trouble, in my view.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "赋能"。这个名字本身就带有魔法的味道。在我看来，这是自找麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So much of what we do resembles magic. No wonder we found demons in the forbidden spaces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们所做的很多事情就像魔法一样。难怪我们在禁地里发现了恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Be patient with me, Tenno. I am still adjusting to this era.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 请对我耐心一些，Tenno。我还在适应这个时代。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I hear his voice sometimes, when I walk these halls alone. Quiet, entreating. Insistent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 当我独自漫步于这些大厅时，我偶尔会听到他的声音。那声音安静、恳切、坚定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Like 'em?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 喜欢吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Whaddya think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你说怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Take that one! Ooh! No. That one! Or... hm. I'm helping!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 拿那个吧！哦！不。那个！或者……嗯。我在帮忙！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You got it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没问题！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ooh! Ooh! I love this bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦！哦！我喜欢这部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Listen: You're not getting out of the Anchorhold without all four Keyglyphs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 听着，如果没有集齐四个钥符，你就无法离开安全所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Take your Keyglyphs and get to it. C'mon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 拿上你的钥符开始吧。快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If you want to find out what Albrecht was up to in that Netracell you'll need one of each Keyglyph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果你想知道阿尔布雷希特在衰退室里干了什么，你就得拿到每一个钥符才行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Security's freaking out. The Netracell doors won't open 'til you get clear out the uglies around the entrance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 安全系统都吓坏了。得先把入口周围的那些丑东西清理干净，否则衰退室的门不会打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We ain't done. Local threats are triggering a security override. Clear out the uglies to pop the door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 还没完呢。附近的威胁触发了安全系统覆写。清理掉那些丑东西再来开门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I was afraid of this. Netracell's security system won't open up with all the uglies around. Clear 'em out. And make sure the system can see you doing it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我就害怕这种情况。这些丑东西在这，衰退室的安全系统是不会开门的。听好了，把它们清理干净，还得让系统看到你干了这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Keep thinning them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 继续减少它们的数量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Security level dropping. Hit 'em til they stop moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 防卫等级正在降低。打到它们动不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's working. You gotta keep going.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有效果了。继续，你还得接着干。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Security level dropping. Don't quit now. I gotta know what's in that Netracell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 防卫等级已经降低了。可别放弃，我要探清那个衰退室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ready? To leave Anchorhold access that terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 准备好了？要想离开安全所，就得使用那台终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You got ya glyphs, so hit the terminal to exit into the labs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你拿到钥符了，那么使用那台终端机进入实验室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Only one way out of the Anchorhold. Use that terminal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 离开安全所只有一个方法。那台终端机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah. Okay then. Maybe later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊。好吧。也许晚点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Are... are you sure? Is everything okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你……你确定吗？一切都好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. Okay. Should I be doing something different?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。好的。我应该做点别的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Fine by me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我没意见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Don't let me keep you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我可不想耽误你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're the boss, boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你才是老大，老大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: C'mon. Who am I gonna ask? Bird?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 来吧。我还能问谁？鸟？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You really got something better to do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你真的有更重要的事要做吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay. You're the boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧。你是老大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I wonder what Albrecht planned on doing with that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我很好奇阿尔布雷希特想用那个做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Not what I was looking for, but if you're happy I'm happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 唉，不是我要找的东西，但是既然你开心，那我也开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bet you can make use of that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我敢肯定你会用到它的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Not what I was hoping for, but... that could still come in handy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 虽然不是我想要的东西，不过……说不定能派上点用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Nothing about Albrecht? Okay. Next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没有和阿尔布雷希特有关的？行吧。等下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Magnetic Crucible: The forces of electricity and extreme cold are required for this alchemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 磁力转换坩锅：这个转换过程需要电击还有冰冻之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A magnetic force can be created by electrical stimulation of an intensely cold subject.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你要对着一个冰冻的对象进行电击，这样，才能够创造出磁力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Unlike conventional science, Alchemy produces Magnetic energy by blending cold and electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 与传统科学不同的地方在于，元素转换需要通过结合冰冻和电击来产生磁力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That's seen them off for now. Stand down, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这样就暂时击退它们了。放松 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It seems they've had enough. Well, there's more where that came from next time they come slinking back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看来它们已经吃不消了。好吧，如果它们下次再悄悄回来，我们还有更多手段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Splendid work, Tenno. No wonder Albrecht thought you were worth waiting for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 干得好，Tenno。难怪阿尔布雷希特会认为你值得等待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: To arms, Tenno! The Murmur are mounting a fresh attack on the lab's sensory equipment! I trust you are ready to repel them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 准备战斗，Tenno！低语者正在对实验室的传感设备发动新一轮攻势！我相信你已经准备好击退它们了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We are under attack, and you are our first line of defense. The Murmur are targeting our sensory emplacements. Fight hard. The loss of even one will spell defeat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们正在遭受攻击，而你是我们的第一道防线。低语者的目标是我们的传感设备。拼尽全力战斗。哪怕失去一个也意味着我们的失败！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Time to do our duty, Tenno. Albrecht's laboratory is under siege, with the Murmur attacking on two separate fronts. I need you to defend every single one of them, with all your might.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是时候履行我们的职责了，Tenno。阿尔布雷希特的实验室正遭受围攻，低语者正分别在两个战线上发起攻击。我需要你全力以赴地守卫每一个阵地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The sodding Indifference seeks a path through the walls, and then, Tenno, through you. Keep it at bay!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 该死的虚空无情之物正在寻找穿过墙的途径，然后，Tenno，它会穿过你。一定要阻止它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: VOULL NE XATA VOK, MARA LOHK?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: VOULL NE XATA VOK，MARA LOHK？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The strand holds. The Indifference approaches. Soon... it will take on mass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 丝线依然牢固。虚空无情之物正在接近。很快……它将具现化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Get out! There is nothing for you here! Get out! OUT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 滚出去！这里没有你要的！出去！出去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno, the Grimoire must speak with its own voice!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno，魔典必须用它自己的声音说话！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[2]

[10.1]
Loid... you gave me back my sight, but I would not spare you a glance.
[17.7]
You gave me back my voice, but I never spoke to praise you as I should have.
[21.9]
For you were my right hand.
[27.8]
My strength, my support, my sanctuary.
[31.7]
Even when the galleries hurled scorn upon me,
[38.9]
your sole desire was to suffer it in my stead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[2]

[10.1]
洛德……你让我重见光明，但我却未多你看一眼。
[17.7]
你让我重拾声音，但我却从未开口称赞过你。
[21.9]
因为你是我的左右手。
[27.8]
我的力量、我的支撑、我的庇护之处。
[31.7]
即使旁观者对我嗤之以鼻，
[38.9]
你唯一的愿望就是代替我承受这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[2]

[4.9]
On your first day of service,
[9.4]
you aspired to be worthy of me.
[17.1]
I only wish that I could have been worthy of you, my Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[2]

[4.9]
自你服侍我的首日起，
[9.4]
你就渴望配得上我。
[17.1]
而我只愿我曾经能配得上你——我的洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: He wasn't running away to a new life without me. He was going to his death! And he knew it! He wasn't saving the world, he was saving me. Oh, Albrecht…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: He wasn't running away to a new life without me. He was going to his death! And he knew it! He wasn't saving the world, he was saving me. Oh, Albrecht…

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: TENNO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: TENNO！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Allow me to boil this down for you: should the Indifference's corrupting touch reach us and take back our speech? We would be screwed. So: be a love and eradicate the Murmur in this patch before the big bad gets word that Loid's awake and the fish is talking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 请允许我为你总结一下：如果虚空无情之物的邪恶力量触碰到我们并夺回我们的言语？我们很有可能就完蛋了。所以，在那个大坏蛋得知洛德醒来以及鱼说话之前，请你做个好人清除这片区域的低语者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno... there is some truth to what the... fish... says. That page was the last thing my Albrecht ever wrote. Meant for me. Since I had no interest in reading his endless self-justifications, I hid it away instead. But with all this chaos, it's undetectable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno……那条……鱼……说的有些是真的。那张书页是我的阿尔布雷希特（Albrecht ）最后所写的东西。专门为我而写。由于我对他没完没了的自我辩解不感兴趣，就把它藏了起来。但在这一切混乱之中，它已经无法被检测到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: So long as the Indifference is missing a digit, it is confined to the strands of Khra. Don't ask, your tiny mind would likely pop under the strain of understanding. This limitation is our one hope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 只要虚空无情之物缺少一根手指，它就被限制在时间丝线中。别问了，你的小脑袋可能会在理解的压力下爆炸。这个限制是我们唯一的希望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do not patronize the Tenno, fish. The strands of Khra are merely Void-renderings of the chains of cause and effect. Conceptually embodied timelines, if you will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不要对 Tenno 摆出一副高人一等的姿态，鱼。时间丝线不过是虚空对因果链的呈现。概念上讲就是具象化的时间线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa's daughter excelled at explaining complicated concepts in childish terms. I see now where she learned it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸的女儿非常擅长用童稚的语言来解释复杂的概念。我现在明白她是从哪里学来的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A fell hand raps upon the Untime Door, and sans Grimoire we are undone! We've been rumbled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一只邪恶的手正敲击着超脱时空之门，没有魔典我们就完了！我们被发现了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Arousing as I'm sure this is for you, the rest of us are moments away from an extinction grim. Black! And FINAL! So. If you would be so kind. Finish up. So I can point you. Toward. That. Sodding. Page.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我知道这对你来说很刺激，但我们其他人正面临着灭绝的严峻时刻。黑暗！而且是终结！所以，如果你能这么好心的话，请尽快结束。这样我才能指引你。找到。那张。该死的。书页。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This is all my fault…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: This is all my fault…

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yes it is, Loid. Yes it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Yes it is, Loid. Yes it is.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bravo. It was a long walk toward competence, but here you are. Now, please, the page.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 太好了。走到这个程度不容易，但你终于做到了。现在，请前往书页处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How about you give me the page instead, Kiddo? Consider it part of our deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不如你把书页给我，小鬼？可以看作是我们交易的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How about you give me the page instead, Kiddo? Consider it part of our deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不如你把书页给我，小鬼？可以看作是我们交易的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How about you give me the page instead, Kiddo? Consider it part of our deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不如你把书页给我，小鬼？可以看作是我们交易的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How about you give me the page instead, Kiddo? Consider it part of our deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不如你把书页给我，小鬼？可以看作是我们交易的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There. It's done. Keep it to yourself, Tenno. I'm damned if I'm giving Albrecht the last word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那里。完成了。你自己拿着吧，Tenno。我才不会让阿尔布雷希特有最后的发言权。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tenno? Are you there? Thank Void! Listen. The Murmur diverted your Extraction-jump. We need you back at the Sanctum, now! Hurry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Tenno？你在吗？感谢虚空！听着。低语者转移了你的撤离方向。我们需要你回到圣所，马上！尽快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It takes and it takes. It took my future, it's taking the Labs inch by inch... well, I won't let it take his bloody Cavia!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它一直在夺取，没完没了地夺取。它夺走了我的未来，现在正慢慢侵吞实验室……我绝不会让它夺走他的那些该死的科维兽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Heat, cold, toxin, and electricity; 'the elemental forces that create our universe'. To wield them Papa invented the Crucibles, incredible devices capable of fusing these elements into the 'complex elemental forces'. Forces we require to complete Papa's vision. I have marked a Crucible. Go there now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 火、冰、毒、电；它们是"构成我们宇宙的元素之力"。为了驾驭它们，爸爸发明了转换坩锅，这些不可思议的设备能将这些元素融合为"复合元素之力"。我们需要这些力量来完成爸爸的愿景。我已经标出了一个转换坩锅的位置。立即前去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa knew that the path to understanding this universe lay in mastering the elemental forces. So Papa invented the Crucibles, alchemic devices for combining the simple elemental forces into complex forces. Through the Crucibles Papa's work can live on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸深知，要想洞悉这个宇宙，必须掌握元素之力。因此，爸爸发明了转换坩锅，一种将基础元素之力组合成复合元素之力的转换装置。借助这些转换坩锅，爸爸的研究才能继续下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your mission: attrition. The longer you hold out, the weaker the Murmur gets. Make your presence known.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你的任务：消耗战。你坚持得越久，低语者就越虚弱。让它们感受到你的存在感。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I will not lie, this is a risky gambit. You are here to draw out Murmur and then grind them down. Fight them out there, so we need never again battle them in here. Trigger the alarms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 其实不瞒你说，这次是一个冒险的策略。你来这里是为了引出低语者，然后逐渐削弱它们。在外面与它们交锋，这样我们就再也不用在这里与他们战斗了。触发警报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Keyglyphs are a heavy burden for living beings to bear. Each type will impede you in its own way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 钥符对生物来说是个沉重的负担。每种都将以其特有的方式来阻碍你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I must say, watching you smash those Murmur into little bits is extremely cathartic. Keep it up, Tenno. Those bastards have it coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不得不说，你把那些低语者一个个都打成了碎片，看着真是让人痛快啊。继续加油，Tenno。那些混蛋活该。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Necramechs could never be compelled to attack the Murmur. Albrecht suspected they could no longer distinguish between the Indifference... and himself. A theory he was reluctant to confirm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那些殁世机甲从来不会被驱使去攻击低语者。阿尔布雷希特怀疑它们已经分不清"虚空无情之物"……和他自己。这是一个他不愿去证实的理论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Cold stone. Sardonic aloofness. I was a fool not to see the resemblance before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 铁石的心肠。讥讽的淡漠。我真是糊涂，之前没能看出这种相似之处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （笑声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （笑声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （笑声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （笑声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Look at these things. Lying around. ABANDONED. Like you, Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看看这些东西。四处散落。被遗弃。就像你一样，洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Look at these things. Lying around. ABANDONED. Like you, Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看看这些东西。四处散落。被遗弃。就像你一样，洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Look at these things. Lying around. ABANDONED. Like you, Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看看这些东西。四处散落。被遗弃。就像你一样，洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Look at these things. Lying around. ABANDONED. Like you, Loid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看看这些东西。四处散落。被遗弃。就像你一样，洛德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You are his demon. Not mine! I won't listen!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你是他的魔鬼。不是我的！我是不会听的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: My apologies, Tenno. I shall refrain from further outbursts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我向你道歉，Tenno。今后我会避免再次情绪失控。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There. A Netracell. Albrecht stored all manner of sentimental old junk in these. Insert the Keyglyph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 就在那里。一个衰退室。阿尔布雷希特把许多有纪念意义的旧物品都存放在这些地方。把钥符插进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Netracell's security apparatus is diligent. That door won't open while it can sense The Murmur nearby. So. Eliminate them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 衰退室的安全机制非常严密。当感应到附近有低语者时，那扇门就不会打开。因此，消灭它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Necramites! The lab's automated systems are trying to lock down the Netracell. Your only option is to destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 殁世微灵！实验室的自动化系统正试图封锁衰退室。你唯一的选择就是摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You shoulda left well enough alone, kiddo! It'll NEVER get BETTER if you KEEP. ON. PICKING. AT. IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你本应该让事情保持原样，小鬼！如果你一。直。揪。着。它。不。放。它永远都不会变好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You shoulda left well enough alone, kiddo! It'll NEVER get BETTER if you KEEP. ON. PICKING. AT. IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你本应该让事情保持原样，小鬼！如果你一。直。揪。着。它。不。放。它永远都不会变好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You shoulda left well enough alone, kiddo! It'll NEVER get BETTER if you KEEP. ON. PICKING. AT. IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你本应该让事情保持原样，小鬼！如果你一。直。揪。着。它。不。放。它永远都不会变好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You shoulda left well enough alone, kiddo! It'll NEVER get BETTER if you KEEP. ON. PICKING. AT. IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你本应该让事情保持原样，小鬼！如果你一。直。揪。着。它。不。放。它永远都不会变好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Excellent. Return to me with the board, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 非常好。带着电路板回到我这里，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur presumes to destroy our auditory and visual sensors. In all the time I have been asleep, they have never ONCE been so bold!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语者竟然胆敢摧毁我们听觉和视觉传感。自从我沉睡以来，它们从未这么放肆过！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: IIRE! SHOGRUN UKUL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: IIRE！SHOGRUN UKUL！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ignore the Cavia, Tenno. If Albrecht ever understood their babble, he never bothered to share that knowledge with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不必搭理那只科维兽，Tenno。就算阿尔布雷希特真听懂它们的叽叽喳喳，他也从未想过要把那知识分享给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Here they come. After all those years of creeping, silent encroachment... something has changed them. Stirred them up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它们来了。经过多年的悄无声息地蔓延侵蚀之后……有什么改变了它们。挑动了它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: They're shifting focus! Get to the Vitreum! Look at them. 'The Indifference.' He could have given lessons in indifference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它们正在改变目标！前往魔瞳那里！看看它们。"虚空无情之物"。他完全可以教人什么是无情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: KOMEK! UTEH KOMEK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: KOMEK！UTEH KOMEK！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Albrecht once thought the Cavia should have been destroyed. Failures, all. But he briefly showed reluctance. And I saw no reason to punish them for his negligence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特曾经认为科维兽应该被销毁。全都是失败品。然而他有过短暂的犹豫。我找不到任何因他的疏忽而去惩罚它们的理由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: They're back at the Auricle! Look at them. 'The Indifference.' He could have given lessons in indifference.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它们又回到了魔耳那里！看看它们。"虚空无情之物"。他完全可以教人什么是无情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I saw off Granum's thugs. I beat back the Infested. And by the Void, I shall see the end of these monstrosities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我赶走了格拉努的小混混。我击退了感染者。以虚空之名，我将要见证这些怪物的覆灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh Void, is there no end to them? Defend the Auricle, Tenno. If it falls… the best we can hope for is a speedy cessation of existence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: Oh Void, is there no end to them? Defend the Auricle, Tenno. If it falls… the best we can hope for is a speedy cessation of existence.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: And now the Vitreum again! Why didn't he prepare for this? Always poring over that Grimoire… traipsing off to the forgotten past, leaving devoted Loid to clean up in his wake… and when I wanted more time with him, duplicating me, for Void's sake! Like an implement!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: And now the Vitreum again! Why didn't he prepare for this? Always poring over that Grimoire… traipsing off to the forgotten past, leaving devoted Loid to clean up in his wake… and when I wanted more time with him, duplicating me, for Void's sake! Like an implement!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Dust yourself down, Tenno. We are still alive. Rejoin me, and the Kalymos Sequence may proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 拍拍身上的灰尘，Tenno。我们还活着。回到我这里来，卡利莫斯数列可以继续进行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There is a defense system, of sorts. Gather enough of the floating Vosphene Glyphs, and they should reinvigorate the organs you're here to protect. A fallback system, in case... the promised Operator never showed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这里有一种防御系统。收集足够的漂浮荧音浮印，它们应该能够恢复你要保护的器官。这是一种备用系统，以防……那位预定的指挥官没出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Multiple Vitreum scanners can be Probed simultaneously. A gamble, a risk. But, worth considering to get this over with faster!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 可以同时探测多个魔瞳扫描器。这是一场赌博，一个风险。但，为了更快结束这件事，值得考虑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This can all be over quickly if you want to risk probing multiple Vitreum scanners at once. Potentially a valuable case study in risk assessment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果你愿意冒险同时探测多个魔瞳扫描器，这一切都可以很快结束。这可能是风险评估中一个宝贵的案例研究。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Were you to assign colleagues to administer serum to multiple scanners at the same time, it would speed up the process while adding to the, ah... excitement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果你指派同伴们同时给多个扫描器注射血清，这将加快进程，同时增加一些，呃……刺激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Don't feel you have to inject the Vitreums one at a time. By all means, make this a group project! Plenty of eyeballs to go around! But do be careful. Go bipeds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不必觉得你一次只能注射一个魔瞳。尽管把这当作一个团队项目！可以用的眼球多着呢！但是要小心。加油，两脚兽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa never wanted anyone to know what he was up to. That's why he built the Netracells. Little hideaway vaults. Not even Loid knows what he got up to in there. I want to know. I can get you into the Anchorhold, where Albrecht stored all his Keyglyphs. They're on a rotation timer, only one Netracell can be opened at any given time, and before you can do that, you've got to find the Netracell and neutralize any opposition. Impossible for a guy like me, but maybe not for someone with a working pair of opposable thumbs? What do you say?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸从不想别人知道他在忙些啥。这就是他为什么建那些衰退室的原因。小小的隐蔽宝库。连洛德都不知道他在里面干了些什么。可我想知道。我能带你进入那个安全所，阿尔布雷希特把他所有的钥符都放在那。它们是定时轮换的，一次只能打开一间衰退室。而在此之前，你得找到密室并消除所有阻碍。这对我来说是不可能的，但对于有着灵活双手的你来说可能不难，你觉得呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We have seen all that we may from this vantage. I have marked a new Atropos Probe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们已经从这个位置看到了我们所能看到的一切。我已经标记了一个新的命运之神探测器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Vitreum is spent, but we must see more. Locate another Probe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这只魔瞳已经疲惫，但我们还需要看到更多。找到另一个探测器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Adequate, but not enough. Acquire more serum and stimulate another Vitreum!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 还行，但还远远不够。获取更多血清并激活另一个魔瞳！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Nnngh. Our quarry evades detection. More serum! More visions!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯。我们的目标避开了侦测。需要更多血清！更多的视觉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Insufficient! We must outstare the Murmur! Fetch a probe and narcotize another Vitreum!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 还不够！我们必须比低语者凝视得更久！取来探测器并对另一个魔瞳进行注射！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This Vitreum's tormented visions have undoubtedly helped, but our work is not yet complete. Repeat the process.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这只魔瞳看到的痛苦景象无疑是有帮助的，但我们的工作尚未完成。重复这个过程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yes, I'm sure we've all got better things to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是的，我相信我们都有更有要紧的事情要去忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Maybe I'll just take another little nap?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 或许我可以再小睡一会儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh. No matter, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦。我想应该没关系的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I would be delighted to dissolve your Arcanes for you, if you had any.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我很乐意为你分解你的赋能，如果你有赋能的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah. It would appear that you have neglected to bring the Arcanes.
