/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊。看来你应该是忘记带赋能了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh, it's always so awkward when you fancy a spot of Arcane Dissolution, but then you realize you've left all your Arcanes at home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦，当你想要来点赋能分解，随后却意识到所有的赋能都落在家里时，真是太尴尬了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (Pffft)
Oh I'll pop off and find something to dust, shall I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦，我是不是该去找些东西来擦擦灰呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Very good, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 非常好，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'll just put this all back, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那我就把这一切都放回去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好哒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Aw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Are they too good?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是它们太好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好哒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: There we are, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那就是这些了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Will there be anything else, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 还要别的东西吗，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Splendid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk wuk wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕呜咕呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ooh! That's a good one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦！这可是好东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Whatcha gonna do with that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你要用它做什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur's envoy lurks somewhere within the Great Indifference. To find it, administer a visionary serum to our Vitreum scanners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语者的使者潜藏在虚空无情之物的内部。要找到它，就得给我们的魔瞳扫描器注入一种具有洞察力的血清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Great Indifference spreads desolation via the mechanism of its fearsome, many-armed Envoy. Vitreum scanners shall aid in locating it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 虚空无情之物通过其可怕的、多臂使者带来荒凉。魔瞳扫描器将帮助我们定位它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
Tenno, the Warframe Qorvex was designed by my Albrecht's own hand, to protect the chosen Operator from the hazards of his laboratory. This design is yours by right. I intend to keep the promise I made to him. When the time is right and the equipment repaired, I will assist you to travel back to the past, to the pivotal year of 1999. Perhaps, between us, we may change history.

Loid
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
Tenno 战士，Qorvex 战甲是由我的阿尔布雷希特亲手设计的，用来保护被选中的指挥官免受他实验室的危害。这个设计理应属于你。我打算履行我对他的承诺。一旦时机成熟，设备修复，我将协助你回到过去，回到关键的 1999 年。也许，我们两个，可以改变历史。
 
洛德

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
[9.4]
Chosen Operator. A friendly suggestion: you could do so much more with those Melee weapons of yours.
[15.3]
I donate my wisdom on both tool and technique.
[27.0]
Listen well. TENNOKAI, a fighting technique fusing Void and Beastial instinct. Raw power.
[37.4]
While I have never used Tennokai, I understand it perfectly. Somewhat of a mind master.
[45.3]
Enough so that lost materials pertaining to Tennokai have been stored just out of my reach in the Sanctum.
[53.9]
Tools. Papa was not one to rest, use this segment to unlock more potential for your Arsenal.
[67.9]
The Arcane was an art and science that Papa studied well - the convexity of my bowl a magnifying glass on his research, and now your gain.
[80.7]
Install this segment, acquire Melee Arcanes, find Tennokai Modules, and observe the results: a swift deletion of your foes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
[9.4]
被选中的指挥官。友情提示：你能用你的近战武器做更多更多的事情。
[15.3]
我把我对于工具和技术上的智慧都贡献给你。
[27.0]
听好了。Tenno 气解，一种融合了虚空和兽性本能的战斗技巧。原始的力量。
[37.4]
虽然，我从未使用过 Tenno 气解，但我却对其了如指掌。某种程度上，我是个心灵大师。
[45.3]
以至于与 Tenno 气解相关的丢失资料被放在我够不着的圣所。
[53.9]
工具。爸爸是个闲不住的人，用这个模块来为你的军械库释放更多潜力。
[67.9]
赋能是爸爸研究得很透彻的一门艺术和科学——我的鱼缸凸面是他研究的放大镜，现在成了你的收获。
[80.7]
安装这个模块，获取近战赋能，找到 Tenno 气解模块，然后观察结果：迅速消灭你的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: A Radiation Crucible. Key Amphors are Heat and Electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 辐射转换坩锅。关键元素瓶是火焰和电击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: This Crucible craves Heat and Electricity. Together they will yield Radiation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这个转换坩锅急需火焰和电击。二者结合将生成辐射。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Combine Electricity with Heat to make Radiation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 结合电击和火焰来制造辐射元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The chamber is sealed. Prepare for saturation. I've done all I can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 舱室已经密封。准备饱和处理。我已经尽力了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Increasing saturation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 正在增加饱和中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Their levels of decay aren't shifting. Pushing to maximum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 他们的衰变水平根本没有变化。正在推进到最大值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm sorry. I tried. I daren't open the chamber. The radiation... in you... I don't know what...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我很抱歉。我尽力了。我不敢打开这个舱室。那些辐射……在你们体内……我不知道会怎样……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Is... is there nothing...?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 有……有没有什么办法吗……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We're done, Fish. No point in howling about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们完蛋了，鱼。再怎么嚎叫也没意义了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Just... just gonna sit down. Will... will we be like Minn, now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我只是……我只是要坐下来。我们……我们现在也会变得像小敏那样吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We'll all get to meet her, Bird. Don't you worry about nothin'. You can talk her ear off and she'll love you for it. Bird? Bird?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们都会见到她的，鸟。你不用担心什么。你可以和她聊个够，她会很喜欢你的。鸟？鸟？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tagfer...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's not your fault, Fib. We just played the hand we were dealt. As best we could. Not your fault. None of our fault. Fib? So long, Fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不怪你，老斐。我们只是打好了手中的牌。我们尽力了。不是你的错。也不是我们中谁的错。老斐？再见了，老鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (exhale)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （叹气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Loid, you did good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 洛德，你做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: (sobbing)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: （抽泣）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bad comedy. Their void contamination levels are dropping. Of course. Huzzah. At least I'll be able to bury...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 荒谬的闹剧。他们的虚空污染水平是在下降的。很显然。太好了。至少我可以去埋……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Agh! Their... their contamination levels haven't dropped... they've...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊！他们的……他们的污染水平并没有下降……它们已经……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Alchemized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 已经转化了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You were dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你们已经死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I guess it didn't take. But there is definitely some weird crap going on with us right now. You wanna explain this? We're...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看来它没有带走我们的命。但我们身上肯定发生了奇怪的事。你要不要解释一下？我们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Incandescent. Some kind of... chromatic volatility? A side-effect of Void and anti-Void and something I can't quite identify... a reaction that saved your lives but... did that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 在发亮。是某种……色彩的波动吗？虚空与反虚空的副作用，还有些我无法完全识别的东西……一种挽救了你们生命但……造成了那种情况的反应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I look ridiculous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我看起来很可笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hahahaha. We look bee-yootiful!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哈哈哈哈。我们看起来美死了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We look purple.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们看着很紫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Not me. I wanna be yellow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我不要。我想变成黄色的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Good grief.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 真让人头疼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How did he do that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 他是怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I wanna be... red.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我想变成……红色。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Whoa!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哇哦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Amazing. Amazing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 神奇。真神奇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I am still purple!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我还是紫色的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Everything's green, so everything's clean. Let's... let's get you out of there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 所有的指标都是绿色，所以一切都是安全的。让我们……让我们把你们带出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Everything is not 'green'! Oh Void. I'm green. I'm green!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一切都不是"绿色"的！哦，虚空。我变绿了。我变绿了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Loid... Loid is prepared for us to undergo treatment. Hoo... As we are the only creatures to have fallen afoul of this particular affliction it will be quite an achievement should we survive. Perhaps you'd join us, for the big event? You never know it may actually work. And if not, be a love and ensure the silly old thing doesn't flagellate himself for the failure. You know how he is. This way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 洛德……洛德已经为我们的治疗做好了准备。呵……既然我们是唯一受这种病痛困扰的生物，如果我们能存活下来，那将是一项了不起的成就。或许你想加入我们，见证这一大事？没准儿真能成功呢。如果失败了，麻烦你行行好确保这个傻老头不会因为失败而自责。你知道他的性格。这边请。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Alright. Tagfer. Fibonacci.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 行了。标弃。斐波那契。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Listen. I can work with the fish. The Murmur has to be kept in check.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 听着。我可以和这条鱼合作。必须得控制住那些低语者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tagfer, I...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃，我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hmp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Like it or not the fish is more clued-in to Albrecht's diseased brain than I could ever be. If I'm gonna find that prick I need the fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不管你喜欢与否，这条鱼比我更了解阿尔布雷希特的神经病脑袋。如果要找到那个混蛋，我得靠那条鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tagfer! You won't regret this. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃！你不会后悔的。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Goes to show, Fish: you ain't as smart as you'd like and your promises are shit. I already do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这正说明了，肥鱼：你并没有你想象的那么聪明，而且你的承诺都是狗屁。我已经后悔了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: He made you a widow, but he made me a murderer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 他让你成为鰥夫，却让我成了凶手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: HEEEEY!
HEY! HEY HEY HEY HEY HEEEEEY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嘿！嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿——！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Uuh...

If this is smart I wanna be dumb. Yell yell yell yell yell! Hit and hit and hurt and hurt. We lost it all. We lost green and run and food want and smell follow. And sky blue. And Minn. And all we got for all that losing... are these big brains. Big brains and each other. And you wanna lose that too. Brains by being dumb and each other by throwing us away. We're all we got! Nobody knows what it's like being us. Nobody but us. You're not mad at each other. You're mad at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果聪明就是这样，那我宁愿当个笨蛋。就知道吵吵吵吵吵！打来打去，伤了又伤。我们失去了一切。我们失去了绿地、奔跑、想吃的东西和对气味的追逐。还有蓝天。还有小敏。而我们失去这些所得到的……就只有这些头脑。头脑和彼此。可你连这个也想失去。做傻事而失去头脑，抛弃我们再失去彼此。我们只有我们自己了！没有人知道成为我们是什么感受。只有我们自己知道。你们不是对彼此生气。是在生自己的气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You can't hurt everything that hurt you. Sometimes things just hurt. Sometimes things not wrong, sometimes things just are. We're all we have left, and you want that to die, too. KNOCK IT OFF!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你是伤害不了一切那些伤害你的事的。有时候，事情就是会让人受伤。有时候，事情并不是错的，有时候，事情就是那样。我们只剩下彼此了，你却想让这也消失。别闹了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: "The sea rises, the light fails, lovers cling to each other, and children cling to us. The moment we cease to hold each other, the moment we break faith with one another, the sea engulfs us and the light goes out."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "海水上升，光线消逝，恋人相互依偎，孩子们亦紧紧抱住我们。我们不再扶持的那一时、不再守信彼此的那一刻，便会被汹涌的海浪吞没，光亮也将随之消失。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What's that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Something from Pa... from Albrecht's library.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是来自爸……来自阿尔布雷希特图书馆的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: No. I mean what's that? You don't look right. Shit. Neither do I. Loid?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不，我的意思是：那是什么？！你看起来不太对劲。该死。我也是。洛德？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your color... the Void sickness is advancing. Remaking you the way the Murmur remakes everything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你的颜色……显然，虚空病在加剧。就像低语者重塑一切一样重塑着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Loid...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 洛德……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm close to a means to reverse the process. I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我快要找到逆转这个过程的方法了。我……我觉得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You "think"?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你"觉得"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I need to return to my instruments. Forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我得回去看看我的仪器。请见谅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bird 3.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 鸟三。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Bird? Hey... Bird?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 鸟？嘿……鸟？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You have stood with us. Within this benighted valley, besieged and friendless as we are, you have stood with us. Thank you. Tagfer has requested we gather. I hope you will be there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你和我们站在同一阵线。在这个黑暗的山谷里，我们孤立无援，但你们却与我们并肩作战。谢谢你。标弃提出我们聚聚。我希望你会去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yes, yes, that's it. Gather 'round now. I have much to impart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是的，是的，就是这样。现在集合起来。我有很多话要传达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I wanted them organized. They're organizing. Void preserve us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我本想让他们组织起来。现在他们正这么做。虚空保佑我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Now. Let us review. In our time thus far you have both done, uh... better than expected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 现在。让我们回顾一下。在我们这个时代到目前为止，你们俩都做得，呃……比预期的要好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mister Confident, isn't he? Very polished. I didn't see him helping.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 他很自信，不是吗？很光鲜。但没见他帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yeah... but then there's more for us to do!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是的……但是这样我们就有更多要做的啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Right...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 没错……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: However. Some of us are still allowing the past to exert undue influence upon our minds. Minds Papa gifted to us in order that we might aid in the fulfillment of his grand and masterful plan... ... of which our dear friend Minn's... unfortunate... passing was a... uh, tragic... component.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 然而。我们中的有些人仍然允许过去对我们的思想施加不适当的影响。爸爸赐予我们的思想，是为了我们可以帮助实现他的宏伟且精妙的计划……在这个计划中，我们亲爱的朋友小敏的……不幸……去世是一个……呃，悲剧的…成分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You okay, Mister Fish-o-nah-chee?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你还好吗，肥鱼那契先生？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hm? What? Yes. Please do not interrupt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯呣？什么？是的。请不要随意打断我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Hmmmmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯呣——。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Well. I'm sure it'll work out wonderfully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧。我相信事情会非常顺利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mister Tagfer? Mister Tagfer? You look mad. Why are you mad, Mister Tagfer? Huh? Mister Tagfer? Why are you mad?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 标弃先生？标弃先生？你看起来很生气。标弃先生为什么生气？哈？标弃标弃先生？你在生什么气？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Gather the others. I have something to say to all of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 召集其他人。我有话要告诉你们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: STOP HIM! STOP HIM! ANYONE! HE'S LOST HIS MIND!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 拦住他！快拦住他！有人吗！他失去理智了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: MY TANK! BY THE VOID HE'S KILLED ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我的玻璃缸！虚空在上，他杀了我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: STOP! Stop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 停！停下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm leaking, I'm leaking...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 漏水了，漏水了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You're fine. What in blazes... ?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你不会有事的。这究竟是怎么了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: WHAT THE HELL DO YOU CARE?! You put us in that bell! You watched as she...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你在乎个屁啊？！都是你把我们弄到那个钟舱里的！你亲眼看着她……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I. SAVED. YOUR. LIVES! Do you really think Albrecht thought to freeze you? To preserve you? That was me. In the hope that we might find a cure for...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我。救了。你的。命！你真以为是阿尔布雷希特想要冷冻你吗？为了保护你？其实是我做的。怀着希望我们能够找到治疗……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: For void exposure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 治疗虚空暴露症的方法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Then that means...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那么也就是说……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The clock's still ticking. We're gonna die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 时间不等人。我们要死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I'm... I'm working on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我……我正在处理这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I don't care. I want the fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我不管。我要得是那条鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: He did it. He killed her. He killed Minn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是他下的手。他杀了她。他杀了小敏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What, I just told you that you're going to...?! Hold on a minute. The spec... Minn... was lost to the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 什么，我刚刚才告诉过你你要……？！稍等。那个样本……小敏……在虚空中消失了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Vented to the Void! By him!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 被排到虚空！都是他造成的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Why would...?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 为什么会……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: To save himself! Or so the coward thought! Tell them. Tell them what you did!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 就为了自保！至少那个懦夫是这么想的！说。说你做了什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Void had penetrated the bell. It was in there with us. Before it started talking, though, it made us smart enough to understand it. And that's when Fibonacci here lost his shit. Panicked. Tried to get it out by blowing the seal. Minn was closest when it popped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 虚空渗透进了钟舱。它和我们一起在那里。然而，在它开口说话之前，它让我们变得聪明到可以理解它。就在那时，眼前这位斐波那契彻底疯了。陷入恐慌之中。试着炸开封印来把它赶出去。小敏在它爆炸时离得最近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: After the monitors failed Albrecht wondered how you all came to be exposed to that degree. Fibonacci?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 监控失效后，阿尔布雷希特很好奇你们是怎么遭受那种程度的暴露的。斐波那契？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: His name isn't 'Fibonacci'. Of the four of us he's the only one without a name. Aren't you, mate? Weren't even part of the group. Didn't even get a label. A late addition is all he was. An afterthought. A fish. Why name something too stupid to hold a memory for longer than fifteen seconds?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 他的名字不是"斐波那契"。在我们四个中，他是唯一一个没有名字的。不是吗，伙计？甚至都不属于这个团队。连个标签也没有。他就只是一个临时凑数的。一个后来才被想起来的动物。一条鱼。所以告诉我，为什么要给一个记忆力最多只有十五秒的笨蛋起名字呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I want to hear what...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我想听听……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: "He's killed me!" YOU'VE KILLED US! ALL OF US!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 说什么"他杀了我！"你杀了我们！我们所有动物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Forever kissing the fist that beats you. 'Papa'? 'Papa' is a stinking liar. Minn and I were the last Cervulites. But Albrecht didn't see our species as having worth. We were just one more component in one more experiment and Papa didn't think much of the results. So... 'tag for disposal'. That was us. Both of us were 'Tagfer' But I won't let her go on with that. I gave her something better. She's. Minn. We were never meant to be here! We only ever had each other! And now? Not even that. 'Papa'? 'Papa'? Spineless Void-damned Albrecht? I want to find him as bad as you do. And you'll know when I do, because his head's going right in your stinking tank.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你永远都是奴颜婢膝。"爸爸"？"爸爸"是个臭名昭著的骗子。小敏和我是最后的石鹿。但阿尔布雷希特并不认为我们这个物种还存在价值。在他眼里，我们只是又一个实验里的又一个组成部分，而"爸爸"对这个实验结果并不看重。所以……"标记为弃品"。那就是我们。我们俩都是'"标弃"，但我不会让她继续那样。我给了她更好的。她是。小敏。我们原本就不该在这！我们只有彼此！现在呢？连这些都没有了。"爸爸"？还"爸爸"？没骨气的、该死的阿尔布雷希特？我和你一样恨不得马上找到他。等我找到他，你就知道了，因为他的头会被放进你那恶臭的鱼缸里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I... I never meant... Loid. You can't imagine what it was like. To suddenly exist is horror enough, but to suddenly exist - to comprehend so much - only to be faced with extinction... I... I'm sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我……我并不是故意的……洛德。你无法想象那是怎样的体验。忽然有了存在感，这……这本身就已经够恐怖了，更何况是突然间理解这么多——然后却面临着灭亡……我……我很抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wuk. Wuk. Wuk. Wuk. Wuk. Wuk. Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呜咕。呜咕。呜咕。呜咕。呜咕。呜咕。呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You. You are my ally, yes? A... friend? You understand the tortures of the soul? The manner in which a crisis reveals character, yes? How... how one might... might be ashamed of what a calamity reveals? About oneself? Yes? Please. Prove to me you are an ally. Stand with me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你。你是我的盟友，对吗？一个……朋友？你明白灵魂的煎熬吗？知道危机怎样显露一个人的本质吗？怎么……一个人怎么可能……因为灾难所展现的自己而感到羞耻？关于自己？是的？请你。向我证明你是我的盟友。和我并肩作战，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Mister Fish-o-nah-chee? Mister Fish-o-nah-chee? Mister Fish-o-nah-chee? Mister Fish-o-nah-chee! Mister Tagfer's been bumping his head against that pipe a LOT. I mean... a LOT a LOT. Mister Fish-o-nah-chee? Why is Mister Tagfer bumping his...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 肥鱼那契先生？肥鱼那契先生？肥鱼那契先生？肥鱼那契先生！标弃先生他一直在用头撞着那根管子。我的意思是……一直一直。肥鱼那契先生？为什么标弃先生要撞他的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I DON'T BLOODY KNOW! I don't know, Bird 3. I... Tagfer? One couldn't help but notice your behavior taking on an... idiosyncratic? Bent? Of late? Is... is everything quite all right? Tagfer? Tagfer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我怎么知道！我不知道，鸟三。我……标弃？我觉得你最近的行为……有点异常？或者扭曲？最近？一切……一切都还好吗？标弃？标弃？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What reason would I have to think everything isn't 'quite all right'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我有什么样的理由，能认为周遭的一切都……"不太好"呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Should I rephrase?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我应该换种方式表达吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I merely wish to comfort you. To... aid you... if I can... in this, the moment of your gr...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我只是想安慰你。为了……帮助你……如果我可以……在这，你……的这一刻

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: NNNNNNNNOT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 闭嘴——！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: ...another word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 别再……说了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Oh I've had quite enough of this! You are not the only one here dealing with the horrors that besieged us in that accursed bell! The fears? The nightmares? The guilt...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 哦，我实在是受够了！在那个被诅咒的钟舱中经历恐怖的，不仅仅是你而已！那些恐惧？噩梦？还有罪恶感……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What would any of us have to feel guilty about. 'Fibonacci'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们当中又有谁需要为什么事而感到内疚呢。 "斐波那契"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Rark?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啦嘎？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You have proven yourself worthy of trust. Stick around for a while, will you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你已经证明自己值得信任。再坚持一段时间，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Ah. It grew a new shell. Now you have to crack it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 啊。它长出了新的外壳。现在得再次破开了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That thing is back. Walking around in a new body. You gotta finish it off for good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 那东西又回来了。在一个新躯体里四处游荡。你得彻底消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You know it's playing with you, right? You can't kill it like this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你知道它在耍你，对吗？你这样是杀不死它的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Every time it does this because it's leading you away from something. Find the thing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它每次这么做都是在引你离开某个东西。找出那个东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's gonna kill you, isn't it? I don't wanna watch that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 它会杀了你，对吧？我可不想看到那一幕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Behold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 看啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Cor-nu-copia.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 丰——丰——富富。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Spoilt for choice, I'd say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我得说，选择太多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I suppose you deserve a little something for your efforts. Only little though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我想你的努力应该得到一些回报。不过就只有一些哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I do not consider this an effective use of resources, but what do I know? Have at it. Don't listen to the fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我不认为这是对资源的有效利用，但我知道什么呢？拿去试试吧。别听肥鱼的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa has... set aside certain things for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸已经……为你预留了一些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Good condition. Shouldn't take long to dissolve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 状态良好。分解起来应该不会花太长时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Say the word, and I shall break your Arcanes down into Vosfor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 只要说一声，我就可以把你的赋能分解成荧尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Make your selection, and the Vosfor shall flow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 作出你的选择，然后荧尘自然会有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Tick tock. Time and oxygen are running out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 滴答滴答。时间和氧气都快耗尽了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sixty seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 六十秒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: You have but sixty seconds of life support remaining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你的维生装置只能维持六十秒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The automated defenses can probably handle it from here. Unless you'd prefer to fight on?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 从这里开始应该就可以由自动防御系统来处理了。除非你想继续战斗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Your strength has made all the difference. We can hold the line without you now, if we must.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 正是你的力量让一切发生了改变。现在没有你我们也能守住防线，必要的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We can take it from here, so you can rest. But if you still have some fight in you, keep at it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们可以从这里接手，你可以休息了。但如果你还想战斗，就继续吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Breath well... Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好好呼吸……Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Like a fish back in water. But with air.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 就像鱼儿回到水中。而人回到了空气中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The Murmur aims to choke you out. Not today, preparing a life support capsule.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 低语的目的是让你窒息而死。不过今天不会，我正在准备一个装置——维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Our foes have compromised the habitation systems. How predictable. Standby for life support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们的敌人竟然已经破坏了居住系统。这可真是意料之中。待命等候维生装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Life Support approaching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 维生装置即将抵达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Capsule incoming. Use it well. They're expensive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 维生装置即将抵达。好好利用。它们很昂贵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa always outfitted the labs with emergency life support kits, but our adversaries have taken them. Take them back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸总是会为了实验室配备好紧急维生套件，但我们的对手已经把它们拿走了。现在必须要把它们夺回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Listen. I know Loid cares for 'Papa', so if you find him and anything... goes down, do me a solid. Keep Loid away. You understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 听着。我知道洛德很在乎"爸爸"，所以如果你找到他且出了什么事……帮我个忙，别让洛德涉及进来。懂吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Netracells... Far as I'm concerned, anything of Papa's is yours. Archon shards. Jewelry. Loose furniture. Secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 衰退室……在我看来，爸爸的所有东西都是你的。执刑官源力石。珠宝。散落的家具。甚至是秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Turns out Papa has a whole family upstairs. A daughter. Grandkids. None of them have any idea about any of... this. If he was hiding them, in the here and now, what was he hiding back in 1999?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 原来爸爸在楼上还有一整个家庭。一个女儿，还有孙子孙女。他们对这一切都……毫不知情。既然他现在隐瞒着他们，那他在 1999 年又隐藏了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Whatever Papa touched, the Indifference, the Murmur, I think it's lonely. It wants to be a part of what we've got going on. Only, it doesn't know that. And it does its best to join in, but it's clumsy. Ignorant. So everything about it is... skewed. Half-assed. You follow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不管爸爸触碰过什么，虚空无情之物、低语者，我觉得它是孤独的。它想融入到我们当中。只是，它自己并不知道这一点。它尽力去融入，但却做得很笨拙、无知。因此，它们的一切都是……歪曲的，半吊子的。你懂我的意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Settling the score with Albrecht won't bring Minn back. I'm not stupid. You gotta understand, I'm not doing it for me. Or her. Or Loid, or any of us. I'm doing it because it needs doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 跟阿尔布雷希特算旧账并不会让小敏回来。我不傻。你得明白，我这么做不是为了我自己，也不是为了她，或者洛德，或我们中的任何一个。我这么做是因为这件事必须要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Do you see what I see, over thataway? A monument to something taken from me, forever. When you rebuild Papa's Vessels, rip that one's head off next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 你看到我在那边看到的了吗？那是对我永远失去的东西的纪念。当你重建爸爸的承载体时，把那个的头给扯下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I've kicked dirt. Galloped through sand. But that out there, it isn't of nature. It's just, nothing. It's not natural. Sometimes it looks like Papa's Vessel is sinking in, like... quicksand? But it doesn't move. I hope you can control it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我曾蹬过土地，奔驰在沙地上。但外头那个，它并非自然之物。它就是，什么也不是。它不符合自然。有时它看起来像爸爸的承载体正在下沉，就像……流沙？但它并没有动。我希望你能控制得了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: If there's anything in the Netracells about the Vessels, steal it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果在那些衰退室里有关于承载体的任何东西，偷走它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Right. Right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 行。行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 现在？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay. I think I'm ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好的。我想我已经准备好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yep. Okay. Let's... let's go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 嗯。好的。咱们……咱们走吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: What, right now? Right, right, okay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 什么，现在？行行行，好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Whatever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 随便吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay okay let's get this over with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好了好了，咱们快点了结这件事吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Sure sure. C'mon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 当然当然。来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Not. A good time. Fine. Maybe I could use the distraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不是。时候。行吧。也许我可以利用这个分散注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Perfect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Works for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Alright. What's his is ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧。他的就是我们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Let's rob the old fart blind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 咱们去把那老不死的东西洗劫一空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Be with you in five.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 五分钟后和你汇合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Let's crack that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们去破解那个东西吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Only thirty seconds left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 只剩下三十秒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thirty seconds before this area is lost to the Murmur for good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 三十秒后，这片区域将永远落入低语者之手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Thirty very short seconds left to save your hide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 只剩下短短的三十秒，来保你的小命了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Our pressure target is shifting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们的压力目标在改变！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: New pressure band identified!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 已确定新的压力范围！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Pressure calibration changing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 压力校准正在变更。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: We have a new pressure target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我们有一个新的压力目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Release valve pressure now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 现在释放阀门压力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Shoot the valve to release pressure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 射击阀门以释放压力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Should pressure exceed mandated tolerances your work shall be for naught. Hit the release valve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果压力超过了标准值，你所有的努力就都白费了。赶紧射击施放阀门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The process will not succeed if pressure continues to rise. Open the release valve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 如果压力继续上升，这个过程就不会成功。打开释放阀门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Now for the Alchemy. Manage the venting system to keep pressure within the desired range.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 现在开始元素转换。要注意调节通风系统，使压力维持在理想范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: On your toes! We must keep the pressure in range.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 注意！必须让压力保持在范围内。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Crucible: under pressure. Let's keep the system cooking, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 转换坩埚正承受着高压。让我们继续，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Now the tricky part: pressure management. Stay limber, biped. You know, with your limbs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 现在来到了棘手的部分：压力控制。要灵活些，两脚兽。你懂的，用你的四肢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than mere health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我在瘟疫之年的居民中穿行，如同一个救世主，双手充满治愈之力。对于那些自愿者，我带去的不仅仅是健康。他们的身体已经做好了准备；只需要从我自己的时代带来的 Helminth 注入，就能实现转化的炼金术。他们已经成为了部分战甲，仍保有自由意志，同时得到了增强，适应虚空，能力出众。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Their humanity may not last. My deliverance may yet consume them, the human swallowed up in the sacred beast. And if my wayward disciples turn on me, what words of comfort shall I have beyond: this is the bargain we have made. Through our sacrifice, history will be saved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 他们的人性可能不会长久。我所带来的拯救可能还会吞噬他们，人类被神圣的野兽所吞噬。如果我那些不守规矩的门徒背叛了我，除了：这是我们之间的协议，我还有什么安慰的言语。通过我们的牺牲，历史将被拯救。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: As their loyal doctor, I have taken repeated samples from them. The sight of their Technocyte-riddled cells mutating gave me fresh visions. I could take this material, work with it, forge new creations. Eagerly I brought the samples back to Deimos and began to cultivate them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 作为他们的忠实医生，我反复地从他们身上取样。他们那些被科技细胞填满并发生突变的细胞给了我新的灵感。我可以利用这些材料，加以研究，打造出新的生物。我急切地将样本带回火卫二，并开始培养它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It was Loid who pointed out the singular attributes of the Grey Strain. How it stimulates growth to monstrous dimensions. Many thoughts converged in me then. What if, through precise biochemical engineering, I could create the equivalents of Warframes, yet built to a titanic scale? Surely such a legion could stand against the Adversary... assuming, of course, that an Operator could be found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 是洛德指出了灰种的独特属性，关于它如何增殖成庞然大物。当时有许多想法在我心中涌现。如果我能通过精确的生化工程创造出能与战甲比肩的造物，但却拥有巨人般的躯体呢？这样的军团无疑能与对手抗衡……当然，得先找到一位指挥官才行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Not long after, the first of my Vessels took form. A giant to battle giants, merging the humanity of the man Arthur, the anatomical perfection of Ballas's Warframes, and the titanic potency of the Grey Strain. My saviors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不久之后，我的第一个承载体成型了。这是一个巨人，用来对抗巨人，融合了亚瑟的人性、Ballas 创造的完美战甲结构，以及灰种的巨人力量。是我的救星。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Go with the herd, you know. You'll get eaten if you go alone in a Netracell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 带些人去，你懂的。如果你一个人去衰退室，你会被生吞活剥的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: IMO solo's a no-go. Have at it but I'm tellin' ya: Albrecht wasn't messin' around with his security. Bring friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 在我看来，单打独斗是行不通的。尽管试试看，但我告诉你：阿尔布雷希特在安全方面可不是闹着玩的。带上些朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: In my humble opinion you'll last longer with a few warm bodies to soak up the damage. Albrecht's security's no joke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 以我拙见，如果有一些温暖的身体来吸收伤害，你就能坚持更长时间。阿尔布雷希特的安保措施可不是开玩笑的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I know you can take a punch, but crackin' a Netracell's serious business. Keep ya friends close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我知道你能挨打，但破解衰退室可不是闹着玩的。让你的朋友守在身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Don't wanna tell you your business, but if I was trying to get into a Netracell, I'd go with a pack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 不想对你的事指指点点，但如果我要进入一间衰退室，我会带上一群人去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Maybe... maybe there's some clue to where Albrecht went? Down there? In those Netracells?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 也许……也许有一些关于阿尔布雷希特去了哪里的线索？就在那下面？在那些衰退室中？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa kept his treasures down there. Nothing you can eat, though. Or build a nest with. But it sounds important.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸把他的珍宝藏在那里。虽然，没有你能吃的东西，也不能用来筑巢。但听起来似乎很重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay. I'm ready. We off?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好的。我准备好了。咱们出发？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: It's so weird, this 'owning' thing. Papa really thought all this was his. Like... like his hands are his? Was his brain broken?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: "拥有"这件事，真是太奇怪了。爸爸真的认为这一切都是他的，就像他的手是他的一样？他的脑子坏了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Okay. So, what do you think? Ready to head out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧。所以你怎么看？准备好出发了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: These Netracells were important to Albrecht. Maybe there's answers down there? I... I could use some answers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 这些衰退室对阿尔布雷希特来说很重要。也许下面有答案？我……我需要一些答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 呵？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Go, don't go, I don't care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 去，或者不去，我都无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: I gotta believe there's some clue to where Albrecht went in those Netracells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 我相信那些衰退室里有阿尔布雷希特去哪里了的线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: The old man kept a lot of weird crap down here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 老头子在这里放了很多奇怪的垃圾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: For an old guy to build all this, just to have somewhere to keep goodies. They gotta be worth something to him - and I don't mean money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一个老头子打造这一切，只是为了有个地方放好东西，这些东西对他来说一定有价值——我指的不是钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Netracells. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 衰退室。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: How long someone has to live to get his hands on this much stuff... I dunno. Too long, that's for sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 一个人要活多久才能拥有这么多东西……我不知道。但肯定是太久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 咱们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Viral Elemental. Hmm. You'll require Toxin and Cold Amphors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 病毒元素之力。嗯，你需要毒素和冰冻元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Papa's darkest Alchemic texts direct us to combine Cold with Toxin; a Viral elemental force shall surely result.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 爸爸的那些最深奥的元素转换文献教导我们把冰冻和毒素结合起来，无疑会产生病毒元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Viral energy is extremely dangerous. Mingle your Toxin and Cold Amphors with caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 病毒元素之力极其的危险。在混合毒素和冰冻元素瓶时要格外的谨慎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text:
All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path.

As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task.

I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives.

The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn.

The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning.

Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText:
一切已准备就绪。洛德会按照命令行事，尽管他的眼神在无声地恳求我选择另一条道路。

在我等待着最后一次穿越到过去，我在思索，一个科学家在'赦免'这样一个灵性问题上能发挥什么作用。在灵魂的炼金术中，即使是悔改也必然是一项经过计算的任务。

我将修复我所破坏的，不多也不少。天平必须保持平衡。在这样巨大的忏悔面前，我不会关心任何一边上可能落下的尘埃，那些琐碎人生的尘埃。

古代建筑师用血液混合砂浆，以安抚最古老的土地神灵。我们本应如此明智。然而，现在学习还不算晚。

沙子落下，循环闭合。我回到了一切的起点。

任由那些无知人们对每个热切计划表示轻蔑吧；
交易已成，命运已定。我的结局又回到了开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Wrong Keyglyph. Try another one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 错了，不是这个。试试另一个钥符。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: That wasn't the right Keyglyph. Try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 错了，那个，不是正确的钥符。再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.text: Right door, wrong keyglyph. Try a different one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/EntratiLabsFul.zhText: 对的门，错的钥符。再试下别的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Too many crew have died. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 阵亡的船员太多了。任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Gonna die. Gonna die! GONNA DIE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 要死了。要死了！快要死了！
我活过一段愉快的时光了。
感染者身上带着能量电池。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Kill those Infested to get your power cell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 击杀感染者来获取能量电池。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: There are still survivors to be evacuated but this operation is becoming increasingly risky, you have permission to seek extraction when you feel you can no longer protect the crew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 还有幸存者等待撤离，但这次行动的风险正在不断上升。一旦你觉得无法保障船员的安全，可以随时前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The Infestation is growing more aggressive with each passing minute. Head to extraction when you can no longer guarantee the crew's safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 感染者的攻势正在变得愈发猛烈。一旦无法继续保障船员安全，就立即前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: We lost one. Keep crew members alive. Lose too many and I'll be forced to abort the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我们折损了一名船员。保护好其余船员。若伤亡过多，我将被迫中止任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The first batch of survivors are beyond this door. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 第一批幸存者就在这扇门后。找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Only death there. But death means peace. Let us go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这仅剩死亡一途。但死亡意味着平静。让我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Trust Tenno SCOOM? Hmm… no choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 信任 Tenno 杂碎？哼嗯……没得选。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Need quiet! You make them quiet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 想要安静！你让他们安静么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Cressa Tal sent you? Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Cressa Tal 派你过来的？走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: A Tenno? What choice do we have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一名 Tenno？我们有什么选择？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Infestation called us here, no lie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 感染者召唤我们到这里，没有半句谎话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Better not be a trap, Tenno.
This again? Fight or die? Rraahudd
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 又这样？要么战斗，要么去死？Rraahudd

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: They said Tenno kill us for sport. Did they lie?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 他们说 Tenno 猎杀我们只是娱乐消遣而已。他们有说谎吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: We came to help, the distress call was a PRETAkkang trap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我们前来救援，求救信号是一个 PRETAkkang 陷阱

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Escape Grineer to die here? No!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 逃离 Grineer 是为了死在这里？不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Eyes closed, there is only blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 闭上双眼，仍见血流成河。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The infestation can think^ it can hunt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 感染者能思考；它能狩猎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Not the plan! Plan was no fighting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这没有按照计划！计划是不战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: This ship, our dream… both dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这艘船，我们的梦想……都死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Look at me like that?? You were made to kill too, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 用那种眼神看我？？你生来也是杀戮的命，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: sikkaht monsters feel no pain, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Sikkaht 怪兽感觉不到疼痛，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: How, Tenno? How you kill so much?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 怎么，Tenno？ 你怎么杀的了这么多？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: A group of survivors has escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一批幸存者已成功撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Success! A group of crew members has reached the transport.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 成功了！一批船员已抵达飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Survivors have just reached the safety of our transport. Keep them coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一批幸存者已安全抵达运输船。继续护送其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: That's everyone. Let's get out of here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 所有人都撤离了。我们也走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: All crew members accounted for. Time to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 所有船员都安全撤离了。该走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: You may use this console to send a signal that you want the survivors to hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 你可以使用这台控制台发出信号，催促幸存者加快速度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Use this comms console to rush out more survivors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 使用通讯控制台，催促更多幸存者尽快撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The scattered survivors of this infestation have barricaded themselves in safe areas throughout this galleon. Escort the crew to the waiting escape ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这次感染爆发中失散的幸存者们把自己封锁在这艘帆船战舰各处的安全区域。护送这些船员前往正在等候的逃生飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Let the survivors know you're ready to keep moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 让幸存者知道你准备好继续前进了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Tell the survivors when you're ready to move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 准备好继续前进时，告诉幸存者一声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The crew will die if you don't find power-cells for that Med Booster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 再不找到能量电池为那台医疗增效器供能，船员们就撑不住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: This Med Booster is the only thing keeping the crew alive, make sure it doesn't run out of power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这台医疗增效器是船员活下去的唯一保障。别让它耗尽能量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Find power cells and bring them to the Med Boosters to keep them operational.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 寻找能量电池，然后把它们带到医疗增效器处，让增效器维持运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: We'll go with you, but… we cannot fight like before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我们会跟你走，但……我们再也无法像过去那样作战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: One, two, three, I can do this again.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一直都知道 Sargas 会来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Manic… a manic, he's here to kill us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 狂躁…一个狂躁者，他是来这里杀我们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: It will kill us, please, Tenno, help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 它会把我们杀掉，Tenno，求你帮帮我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Ruk's Manic assassin? We are dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Ruk 的狂躁刺客？ 我们死定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Ruk will never let us go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Ruk 不会让我们离开的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Grineer Manic! He's here to kill the defectors. Take him out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 克隆尼狂躁者！他是冲着叛逃者来的。解决他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The Infestation is airborne and it's slowly killing the crew. The Med Boosters scattered throughout the ship are their only hope for survival.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 感染已通过空气传播，正在慢慢蚕食船员的生命。散布在飞船各处的医疗增效器是他们唯一的生机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The galleon's atmosphere has become toxic^ it will kill the crew members within minutes. Their only hope is the Med Boosters, but you must keep them powered. The survivors will never reach the transport without them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这艘帆船战舰内的空气充斥着剧毒，几分钟内就能夺去船员的生命。医疗增效器是他们唯一的希望，但你必须维持供能。没有它们，幸存者绝不可能抵达运输飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Careful Tenno. My scans show something big is coming your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 小心，Tenno。扫描显示，有大型目标正向你逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Stay alert! An unusually large organism has entered the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 保持警惕！有个异常庞大的生物体进入了这片区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Don't be alarmed by the crew. they're Grineer defectors, rescued by Steel Meridian, but too broken to join their ranks. Instead, they've banded together in search of a more peaceful life. They call themselves, Kavor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 不必提防这些船员。他们是被钢铁防线救出的克隆尼叛逃者，却因饱受摧残，无法加入钢铁防线阵营。于是，为了寻求更安宁的生活，他们聚在了一起，自称为卡沃尔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The crew here are Kavor Defectors, Grineer who rejected the violence they were created for. Rather than join Steel Meridian, they've chosen a different path, seeking a dream of a existence where they would not be forced to commit more atrocities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这里的船员是卡沃尔叛逃者。他们本是为暴力而生的克隆尼，却拒绝服从这一宿命。他们没有加入钢铁防线，而是选择了另一条道路，追寻一种不再被迫犯下暴行的生活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: This Med Booster needs power cells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这台医疗增效器需要能量电池。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Find power-cells for the Med Booster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 找到能量电池，为医疗增效器供能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: This Med Booster is out of power.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 这台医疗增效器的能量耗尽了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Get power-cells in that Med Booster, now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 快把能量电池装进医疗增效器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The survivors are hurting, keep the Med Boosters powered to give them the relief they need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 幸存者情况不妙。维持医疗增效器供能，减轻他们的痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: For the survivors, these Med Boosters mean the difference between life and death. Keep them powered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 对幸存者而言，这些医疗增效器关乎生死。维持供能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The survivors need first-aid before they can move on. Find power-cells for the Med Booster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 幸存者必须先接受急救，才能继续前进。找到能量电池，为医疗增效器供能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Kavor, you could be the key to a future of peace. You must be studied. Alas, Steel Meridian has denied our requests for a specimen, so now we are forced to take one. Stand aside, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Kavor，你们可能是未来和平的关键。你们必须被研究。唉！钢铁防线拒绝了我们索要样本的要求，所以现在我们被迫来取了。请让开，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: What defect made you reject violence, Kavor? Can we exploit it? Our questions need answers, and our answers require a sacrifice. Do not interfere, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 是什么缺陷让你们拒绝暴力，Kavor？我们可以利用吗？我们的问题急需答案，而答案需要牺牲。不要干涉，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Red Veil? We never hurt them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 血色面纱？我们从未伤害他们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Red Veil^ As bad as Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 血色面纱；和 Grineer 一样坏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: We hate noone, but they all want us dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我们不讨厌谁，但是他们却都希望我们死。
为什么我们到处树立敌人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: The more we try to change, the bigger target we become.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我们越是试着改变，就越是成为更大的攻击目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Why do they hate our peace?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 为什么他们憎恨我们的和平？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: We will learn much from this specimen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我们从这标本中受益匪浅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Fear not Kavor, your comrade's sacrifice will not be in vain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 不要害怕，Kavor，你们的同僚不是白白牺牲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: A specimen! Kavor, consider your comrade's life a gift to the greater good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一件标本！Kavor，把你同僚的牺牲当做牺牲小我成全大我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: A crew member is down, heal them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一名船员倒下了。立即救治他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Heal that crew member before they die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 立刻救治那名船员，再晚就来不及了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Kavor wretches thought you were too good to be Grineer! But no Grineer would cower in this cesspool of genetic filth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 卑劣的 Kavor，竟觉得作为 Grineer 是委屈了自己！但是 Grineer 可不会屈服于这滩肮脏的基因粪池。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Pathetic! Wiggling like bait for the infested. Let them rend your coward flesh. A mercy, compared to my judgement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 可悲！瑟瑟发抖得如同喂感染者的食饵。就让它们撕碎懦夫的肉，相比我的审判来说，这已经是慈悲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Did I not birth you? Feed you? Give you enemies to conquer? Ingrates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 不是我养了你、喂了你、给了你去征服的敌人？忘恩负义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: You deserted to practice peace?? I will bathe you in violence until you drown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 你们做逃兵就为了和平？？我要让你们溺于暴力之中，直到淹死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Delicate Kavor flowers say they saw too much. You have not seen anything yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 娇滴滴的 Kavor 小花说他们见了太多。但是你们还远远没见识到我的手段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Cavorting with Tenno scoom? You betray your genes. You betray your Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 跟 Tenno 杂碎一起玩得开心？你们背叛了基因。你们背叛了女皇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: You were born of violence, you will die of violence. I command it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 你们生于暴力，那么也要死于暴力。这是我的命令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: You humiliate all Grineer, there is no higher crime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 你们让所有 Grineer 丢脸，没有比这更重的罪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Tenno? You aid and abed these fugitives? You too will face judgement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Tenno？你对这些逃亡者提供帮助？那你也要面对审判。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Look what I found. The Kavor. The high and mighty. Dead fools walking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 看看我找到了什么。是 Kavor。神在上。蠢猪们死定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Kavor, betrayed your post. Betrayed your comrades. Betrayed me. Your punishment^ endless suffering.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Kavor，背叛了你们的岗位。背叛了你们的同志。背叛了我。对你们的惩罚：无尽受难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Poor Kavor, the Tenno led me right to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 可怜的 Kavor，Tenno 正好把我引向你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Kavor. You're the worst of a bad batch. Inflicted with that mutation, the pacifism defect. You should have been incinerated like the garbage you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: Kavor。你们是劣质批次中最烂的。遭受到了那名为和平主义的变异缺陷。你们本该像垃圾一样被焚烧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: You Kavor are a mistake, a factory malfunction. Your pacifism? Nothing more than a defect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 你们这些 Kavor 生来就是个错误，是残次品。你们是和平主义者？只不过是逃兵而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: I will never stop hunting you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我永远不会停止猎杀你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Your betrayal breathes fire in my soul. I will find you Kavor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 你们的背叛令我的灵魂喷出火来。我一定会找到你们，Kavor。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Not even the Tenno will keep you safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 即使 Tenno 也保不住你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: I will remember what you did here today, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我会记住你今天的所作所为，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Even the Tenno cannot save you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 就算 Tenno 也救不了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Now it's my turn to round up the deserters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 现在轮到我围捕这些逃兵了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Look at that Kavor, the Tenno failed you, just as you failed me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 看看吧， Kavor，Tenno 辜负了你们，如同你们辜负了我一般。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Nothing will save you now, Kavor.
A survivor has safely reached the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一名幸存者安全抵达了飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Crew member rescued, keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一名船员已获救。继续行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Crew member killed, protect the remaining survivors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 一名船员阵亡。保护其余幸存者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Another crew member has been killed.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 不可能是真的吧？可能吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Too many crew members have been lost, we need to regroup, head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 船员伤亡过多，我们需要重新整顿。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: You've let too many of the crew be killed. I can't allow this to continue, head to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 你没保护好船员，伤亡人数太多了。我不能让情况恶化下去，前往撤离点。
更多的 sikkaht 要来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Another group of defectors needs an escort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 又有一批叛逃者需要护送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: I've found a new group of survivors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我找到了另一批幸存者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: There's another group of survivors looking for an escort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 还有另一批幸存者需要护送。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: Survivors are trying to get to the transport, they aren't going to make it without your help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 幸存者正打算前往运输飞船，没有你的帮助，他们根本撑不到那里。
又有一批幸存者。保护好他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.text: I've located the first group of survivors. Find them and escort them to the waiting transport.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Evacuation/DEV.zhText: 我已锁定第一批幸存者的位置。找到并护送他们前往接应的运输飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.text: Tenno, the level of resistance you are encountering is far beyond anything I had predicted. Something very valuable is aboard this ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.zhText: Tenno，你遇到的抵抗远远超出我的预期，船上肯定有极其重要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.text: Tenno, the security force on this ship is unlike anything I have ever seen on a Corpus transport. We need to find out what is going on here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.zhText: Tenno，这艘船上的安保措施，跟我见过的其他科普斯运输船完全不是一个档次。我们必须调查清楚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.text: Radio silence and intense security indicate that someone is trying very hard to keep this ship and its cargo a secret. Look out for anything out of the ordinary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.zhText: 无线电静默，加上如此森严的警戒，说明有人正极力掩盖这艘舰船及其货物。留意一切反常迹象。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.text: This vessel appears to be part of a larger operation. Its purpose remains unclear but the threat is obvious. Do not let this ship reach its destination^ eliminate the crew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAladsC.zhText: 这艘舰船似乎隶属于某项规模更大的行动。它的目的尚不明确，但威胁显而易见。绝不能让它抵达目的地。消灭全体船员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAnnoun.text: Tenno, I admit, I've made mistakes. Terrible mistakes, that have left me crippled with decay. ^Now, I ask you for your mercy. ^Tyl Regor's hidden cloning labs hold secrets. Secrets that could prove most regenerative for me. ^If I get you into the labs, will you bring me the data I need. ^What do you say, will you give a sick man one more chance?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAnnoun.zhText: Tenno，我承认，我犯了错，使我衰败残破的严重错误。我恳求你的慈悲与宽容。^泰尔·雷工所隐藏的克隆人实验室有着能助我再生的秘密。^ 如果我请你进入实验室，你愿意替将资料带来给我吗？^ 你怎么想呢？你愿意再次给病人机会吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAnnoun.text: Blasphemy! You must not help Alad purge his body of the Infestation. I have an alternate proposition.^ I pay you to destroy the labs before Alad can get his rancid hands on Tyl Regor's research. ^The Grineer lose, Alad loses and The Void, The Void is pleased. ^It's up to you, Tenno, will you make the righteous choice?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DAnnoun.zhText: 亵渎之举！你绝不可帮助 Alad V 净化他的肉体感染，我这另有一项提议。^在 Alad V 对泰尔·雷工的研究伸出他那双臭手之前，你若破坏掉那座实验室，我付你钱。^ 让 Grineer 和 Alad V 双双挫败，虚空必因此而喜悦。^选择权决定在你，Tenno，你会做出最符合正道的抉择吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DBlacko.text: Tenno, my contact has informed me of a convoy of abandoned merchant vessels drifting in dead space. Seems like such a waste of good product to just leave it floating there when it could be on my shelves instead. Reactivate the navigation consoles, and I can reroute them to a... secure location. After I take down the inventory of each ship, we can share the dividends, minus my usual finder's fee of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DBlacko.zhText: Tenno，我的线人告诉我，有支被遗弃的商船队在宇宙中漂流。这么漂着实在是太暴殄天物了，它们应该摆上我的货架才对。去重新激活导航控制台，我来修改航线，把它们运到……安全的地方。等我卸完船上的货物，我们可以把东西分一分，当然，还要扣掉我的中介费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DBursaD.text: Watch yourself, the alarms have attracted a Bursa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DBursaD.zhText: 小心，警报把金流恐鸟吸引过来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DBursaD.text: The alarms have triggered a Bursa.
They've brought in reinforcements^ a Bursa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DBursaD.zhText: 敌方调来了一台金流恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Is this it? Is this what I've been searching for? The fix, the fix that will stop my flesh from crawling?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 是这个吗？这就是我一直在寻求的吗？那复原的方法，可以将我的肉体从病变中解脱的方法吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: So it was you Alad, bringing them into my house... why? You gone 'n ruined your own skin 'n now you you want my tubes to set you right... not gonna happen... rather watch you rot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 所以是你干的好事 Alad，把他们带进我的屋子里……为什么呢？你离开了，然后把自己的外貌弄得残破不堪，结果你现在又想要得到我的试管来让自己恢复原状……我不会让你得逞的……而是看着你渐渐腐烂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: It's done. This lab won't produce any more of Tyl Regor's killers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 完成了。这间实验室无法再为泰尔·雷工培育杀手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Can you feel that Tenno? The Void has shown Alad V and Tyl Regor the brunt of its justice. The Void be the word and the word be profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 你能感受到吗 Tenno？虚空已经显现了 Alad V 与泰尔·雷工所受其正义的冲击。当虚空为圣言时，此圣言即象征利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Attack me? My science? Maybe you thought you were dealing with that legless parrot... NO! I'm no Hek. You give me a Fomorian fleet 'n you get a different outcome... hellish outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 你胆敢攻击我？破坏我的科学？你大概以为你在对付的是一只没腿的鹦鹉……才不是！我可不是海克。你送来了一支巨人战舰舰队给我，结果落得全然不同的下场……炼狱般的后果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Neffy Neffy. Should have known. Should have put two and two in combination... no surprise... no surprise at all... to find a bottom feeder at the bottom of the sea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 小 奈富、虔诚的信徒，我早该想到，把你和虚空联想在一起……不意外……完全不意外……就如同在海底最底层会发现食物链最底层的生物一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: This lab is out of commision.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 这座实验室已经彻底报废。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Good work. The lab is useless now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 做得好，这座实验室彻底无法运作了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: You've arrived, Tyl Regor's advanced Grineer cloning labs. His secrets will be mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 你到了，这就是泰尔·雷工先进的 Grineer 克隆人实验室，他的秘密将归我所有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Activate that console and I will download the lab data for Alad. When the cloning tubes rise up, destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 启动控制台，我会帮阿拉德下载实验室数据。克隆培养管升起时，摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Find a way to sabotage this lab.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 想办法破坏这座实验室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Make sure this lab never clones again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 确保这座实验室再也无法制造克隆体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: Praise The Void Tenno, for it has led you into the cradle of evil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 赞美虚空吧 Tenno，因为它引导你踏入了罪恶的摇篮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.text: This is the cloning lab. Raise the tubes and destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DClonin.zhText: 这里就是克隆实验室。升起培养管，摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DConsol.text: The pumps have started, guard the controls, the Grineer must not stop the flooding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DConsol.zhText: 水泵启动了。守住控制台，绝不能让克隆尼阻止注水。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DDestro.text: Tyl Regor's research drones are crucial to this operation, neutralize them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DDestro.zhText: 泰尔·雷工的科研无人机是这次行动的关键，摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DDestro.text: Try to stop my science? My progress... the inevitable... that's impossible. Too many numbers now... 'n when the research is finished... so many more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DDestro.zhText: 你想阻碍我的科学？我的进步……是必然的……不可能阻止我。现在有很多数字了……然后当研究完成时……还会多更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DDestro.text: Sick thing you're doing Tenno. Suppose I can't blame you though... these'll be full grown soon... 'n we both know what'll happen when they grab hold of a tender little thing like you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DDestro.zhText: 你现在的作为相当病态，Tenno。假设我不能责怪你好了，然而……他们长成完全体的速度非常快……接着我们就会知道当他们攫取到像你这样鲜嫩的小东西时会发生什么好事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackFa.text: You failed to kill the Bursa in time. Nef Anyo took your credits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackFa.zhText: 你没能及时摧毁金流恐鸟，奈富·安尤把现金都转移走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.text: Uh... Believer? There seems to have been some problem processing your offering. Perhaps you could commit another?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.zhText: 呃……这位信徒？验收你的献礼时好像出了些问题，也许你可以再献上其它献礼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.text: We had an error processing your offering. Please, try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.zhText: 我们验收你的献礼时出了点错误，请再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.text: Success, you made our hack look like a banking error. Nef Anyo has no idea what's hit him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.zhText: 成功了，我们这次入侵看起来就像是银行系统故障。奈富·安尤完全被蒙在鼓里了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.text: Good work. We've taken Nef's credits without him even noticing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHackSu.zhText: 做得好，奈富·安尤毫无察觉，我们成功转走了他的现金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.text: You are near a hive. Destroy the tumor nodes to make the hive vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.zhText: 你附近有座巢囊，摧毁肿瘤结来削弱巢囊的防御。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.text: A hive is nearby. Be on alert, there's no way to know how the infestation will react to this hive's destruction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.zhText: 附近有一座巢囊，提高警惕。没人知道摧毁巢囊后，感染者会作何反应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.text: There is a hive in the area. You must destroy all the tumor nodes before you can damage the hive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.zhText: 这片区域内有座巢囊。你必须先摧毁所有肿瘤结，才能对巢囊造成伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.text: You are approaching a hive. Every hive is protected by a series of tumor nodes, destroy those and you can destroy the hive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveAp.zhText: 你正接近一座巢囊，每个巢囊都由多个肿瘤结保护。摧毁这些结，才能摧毁巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.text: Taking out that hive has disrupted the environmental system. Expect sub zero temperatures and weakened shields.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.zhText: 摧毁巢囊扰乱了环境系统。气温预计将降至零下，护盾会因此受到削弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.text: Watch out! Destroying that hive realeased clouds of toxins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.zhText: 小心！摧毁巢囊释放了大量毒雾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.text: Destroying that hive damaged the stabilization module, expect reduced gravity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.zhText: 摧毁巢囊破坏了稳定模块，预计重力会降低。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.text: Killing that hive seems to have triggered nearby laser traps. Proceed with caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.zhText: 消灭巢囊似乎触发了附近的激光陷阱。谨慎前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.text: Hive destroyed, but be careful, I am now detecting fields of intense magnetic disturbance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.zhText: 巢囊成功摧毁，但是要小心，我侦测到强烈的磁场干扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.text: That last hive was interfering with the defense systems. Beware, turrets are now online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveDe.zhText: 上个巢囊干扰了防御系统。小心，炮台恢复运作了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveMi.text: This infestation must be contained. Destroy the hives to sterilize the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveMi.zhText: 必须铲除这些感染者。摧毁巢囊，净化这片区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveMi.text: We must not let this infestation get any more out of control. Destroy the spawning hives in the area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveMi.zhText: 绝不能让这些感染者进一步失控蔓延。摧毁区域内的孵化巢囊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveOb.text: All hives destroyed. Head to Extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveOb.zhText: 巢囊已尽数摧毁。前往撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveVu.text: All nodes destroyed, the hive is vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveVu.zhText: 肿瘤结全数摧毁，巢囊防护解除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DHiveVu.text: That's it, now take out the hive.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DInboxB.text: Scoundrels, heretics, believers, listen! Do you crave redemption? Do you feel that burden of poverty crushing you? You need relief but how?
