How can you ask for help, unless you first help yourself? Give unto The Void. I was once a wretched Crewman, breaking my back just to earn a Credit. Then I found that glorious Energy! Oh and when I gave my first offering... how its richness rained down upon me! Do you want what I have received? Do you want it for yourself? Then - Give unto The Void. Let your Credits be the seeds of your prosperity. Give unto The Void... and you will be rewarded a hundredfold. The Void be the word and the word be Profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DInboxB.zhText: 恶棍们，异端们，信徒们，听着！^你渴望得到救赎吗？你觉得贫穷的负担要压垮你了吗？你想寻得解脱却苦无方法吗？除非你先自救，不然你凭什么求助于他人？^向虚空进献吧。^我曾经也是一名可怜的船员，为了赚取现金而不辞辛劳地卖命工作。后来我发现了那光辉夺目的能量！^噢……而当我献上第一份捐献时……如雨点般的丰厚赏赐尽数落在我身上！你们也想得到吗？你们也想为自己争取吗？^ 那么——向虚空进献吧。^让你的现金成为致富的种子。^向虚空进献吧……^……而你将会得到百倍的回报。^ 虚空即是道，道即是利益。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicA.text: This is Tyl Regor's latest and greatest. Pity, this one's still brewing, would have been interesting to see it in action. Nevertheless, I need you to retrieve any data that can help me with my predicament.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicA.zhText: 这便是泰尔·雷工最崭新，最了不起的杰作。只可惜它仍在孕育中，若能看到它行动会很有趣的。话虽如此，我还是需要你为我取回任何能让我脱离当前困境的资料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicA.text: Access the console so that I can find Alad V what he needs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicA.zhText: 操作控制台，我会找到阿拉德 V 需要的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicI.text: You are nearing one of Tyl Regor's newest creations. Make sure it never sees the surface.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicI.zhText: 你正接近泰尔·雷工最新的作品之一，绝不能让它重见天日。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.text: Look... it's Alad the coward... quivering behind the lizards? Shameful... never thought I'd see it...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.zhText: 看……是懦夫 Alad V……痛苦颤抖的躲在那群蜥蜴人后面是吗？太羞耻了……我从未想过会见到这画面……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.text: Most agreeable of you Tenno. Yes, you know what I always say^ if you can save just one life... it better damn well be mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.zhText: 我对你十分满意，Tenno。是的，你知道我总会这样说^ 如果你只能拯救一条人命……那最好就是拯救我的命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.text: Ah, who am I kiddin... always knew you had no bone in that back... Alad the jellyfish... stinky floppy jellyfish... washed up on the beach now... 'n then what you going to do, jelly, when I come by 'n poke at you with my stick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.zhText: 啊，我在骗谁呢……我早知道你是个没骨头的……Alad 水母……发臭的软烂水母……洗干净后跑上岸来了……当我来这用我的棍子戳弄你时，你这水母打算想做什么啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.text: Good work. That beast won't be able to threaten any Tenno in the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.zhText: 做得好，那头野兽再也无法威胁到执行任务的 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.text: The beast is dead. Your work is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.zhText: 野兽已被消灭，任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.text: Preacher, preacher... this your idea? Ha... how 'bout I scalpel off your little danglers... give them unto void... What ya think 'bout that idea Neffy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicK.zhText: 传道者、传道者……这是你的主意吗？哈……信教的，让我割掉你身上那条垂着的装饰……然后献给虚空……你觉得这想法如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicN.text: Behold, Tyl Regor's latest abomination. Let The Void work through you and strike the beast down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DManicN.zhText: 看啊，泰尔·雷工最新的邪恶之举。就让虚空借由你来击溃这头野兽！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DMissio.text: Every time you hack Nef Anyo's account we put him one step closer to bankruptcy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DMissio.zhText: 每入侵奈富·安尤的账户一次，他就离彻底破产又近了一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DMissio.text: Nef Anyo may appear to be nothing more than a swindler, but his growing Bursa army presents a serious threat to the entire system. We must bankrupt him before he grows any stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DMissio.zhText: 奈富·安尤虽然看上去只是个神棍，但他不断扩张的金流恐鸟大军却对整个星系构成了严重威胁。我们必须在他做大之前，让他彻底破产。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DOfferi.text: Transaction complete. In the name of profit, I commit this offering to The Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DOfferi.zhText: 交易完成。以利益之名，我认可这份给虚空的献礼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.text: The Shadow commands us. Betrayers will die. Orokin blood will dry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.zhText: Shadow 命令着我们。叛徒将会死亡。 Orokin 血缘将会枯竭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.text: Those who oppose will be consumed. Emotion drives us. Blood divides us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.zhText: 那些反对的人将会被消灭。情感驱使着我们。血液使我们产生分歧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.text: These children will not stop us from punishing you. The Shadow commands it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.zhText: 这些孩子们将不会阻止我们来惩罚你。这是 Shadow 的命令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.text: We asked… what is thy will, Shadow? Punishment was his call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.zhText: 我们问......什么是你的意志，Shadow？处罚曾是他的呼唤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.text: We serve the Shadow, the Stalker, the truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.zhText: 我们服务于 Shadow ​​，其为 Stalker，又为真理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.text: The Shadow is pure, undreaming, untainted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcly.zhText: Shadow 是纯洁的，从未做过梦，也未受过污染。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.text: It's going to make us do this the hard way, isn't it? And by us, Tenno, I mean you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.zhText: 看来我们得来硬的了，是吧？ 就靠我们了，Tenno，我是指你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.text: Haha, that's what happens when you mess with Alad V! Hah yes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.zhText: 哈哈，这就是与 Alad V 做对的下场！哈，好啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.text: Feel that? One of them is here. They won't stay hidden for long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.zhText: 感觉到了吗？ 他们其中之一就在这里。他们不会藏身太久的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.text: Acolyte! We know you're here. Show yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.zhText: 追随者！我们知道你就在这里，现身吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.text: It's here. Find it and hurt it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.zhText: 就这这里。找到他，让他尝尝厉害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.text: I know that an Acolyte is here somewhere, keep poking around until it tries to kill you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSAcol.zhText: 我知道一名追随者就在这里的某个地方，继续四处探索，直到他试图来做掉你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSClos.text:
By the stars, I am relieved! I feel like I have a whole new life ahead of me! 

All thanks to you, you glorious Tenno! That's what I would have said, if you'd actually taken care of all those blood-hungry Acolytes. 

But no. I can't say that because the last Acolyte, the worst one of the bunch, is on his way right now! 

He's after the one thing I love more than profit. My precious life! 

Finish what you started, Tenno. I'll even sweeten the deal if moral obligation isn't enough incentive…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSClos.zhText:
众星啊，我终于解脱了！我感觉有全新的美好前程在等着我！

这全都得感谢你，光荣的 Tenno！就跟我之前说的一样，如果你能好好对付那些嗜血的追随者的话。

才怪，我才不会这样说。因为那群里面最可怕的一名追随者，现在就要来找我了！

他正要来夺走我那比利益还重要的东西，我宝贵的性命！

结束这一切吧，Tenno。如果道德上的义务还不足以激励你的话，我会加码回报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSClos.text:
Maybe next time the Stalker will think twice before messing with Alad V! 

Okay, I'll admit it, you got me out of a sticky situation back there, so let's just call it even, shall we?

Well, I guess I should give you some sort of reward or something, just don't tell anyone. Even though I'm in no way obliged to do so. Take this, just don't point it at me, got it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSClos.zhText:
也许下一次追猎者会在跟 Alad V 作对以前再三考虑！

好吧，我承认。你将我从那困境中解救出来了，所以我们之间就扯平了，好吗？

嗯，我想我得给你某些奖励之类的。别跟任何人提起，虽然我没有义务这么做。收下这个，别拿它指着我，了解？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: Ah, yes, exactly what I'm looking for. Now, if I cross-reference the signal inversions from this stream with the… wait, why am I telling you this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: 啊，对，这就是我想要的。现在，如果我从这道信号数据流中反向交叉参考，再用……等等，我跟你说这些做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: You know, these Acolytes won't be easy marks. No one shot kills here. It's going to take an army of you to dispose of just one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: 你知道的，这些追随者并不容易找出。同时也很难杀掉他们，可能得出动一整队的你们这些人才能解决一名追随者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: Yes. This is exactly what I wanted... Tenno, make your way to extraction but watch out for those pesky Acolytes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: 太好了，这正是我想要的……Tenno，前往撤离点，不过要小心那些烦人的跟随者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: That's what we're looking for. Why do these Acolytes come for me? I've done nothing to them! But don't worry, I will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: 这就是我们在找的。为何这些追随者要找上我？ 我什么也没对他们做！不过别担心，接下来就会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: Those Acolytes have been through here, I can just feel it. Find the security data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: 这些追随者曾行经这里，我能感觉到。找出安保数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: Tenno, I'm glad you didn't 'forget' the favor I'm owed. Looks like your 'virtuous nature' has its benefits… for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: Tenno，我很高兴你没有"忘了"欠我的人情。看来你的"德行"对我来说……挺有帮助的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: I know you'll find me that data because it's in your best interest. If these Acolytes get me, you'll be next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: 我就知道你会为我找到数据，因为那是你最感兴趣的。如果这些追随者找上我，你就会成为下一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.text: Don't just stand there, find me that security data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSData.zhText: 别光站在那，快帮我找数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: Enough! You will regret your past crimes...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: 够了！你会为你过去犯下的罪行而后悔的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: Perhaps I got a little too confident. Help me out, why don't you? Then we'll call it even. Hmm… fineprint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: 也许我有点太过自信了，你为何不来帮帮我？ 这样我们就扯平了。嗯……仔细考虑吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: Tenno, may I encourage you to think of all the times I've helped you and not all the times I tried to have you killed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: Tenno，我诚挚地建议你细数我帮过你多少次，而不是我试着想杀你的次数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: We've had our differences in the past, but right now I can really see the benefit in being nice to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: 我们过去有些歧见，但现在我能清楚知道与你站在同一阵线有着多少好处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: Fighting alongside the Tenno… I won't lie, this feels weird.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: 与 Tenno 携手作战……我得坦白说，感觉挺奇怪的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: Fighting off a horde of shadow warriors was most certainly not on my agenda for today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: 我十分确定击退一群影子战士不是我的今日排程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: All these shadows. Those Acolytes don't have the guts to come fight me themselves!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: 都是影子。这些追随者根本没胆来亲自对付我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.text: I may have spoken too soon, yes...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSDefe.zhText: 我可能话说得太急了，对……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSFirs.text: There. An Acolyte, do you see it? Do what you can and I'll call in your shiny friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSFirs.zhText: 那里，一名追随者，你看到了没？ 尽量大展身手吧，我会把你那些闪亮亮的朋友都找来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSIntr.text:
Bad news, Tenno.

The Stalker has found others as twisted as himself. He calls them his Acolytes and he's sent them after ME?! 

SHHH. I have to be very quiet, they cloak, they could be hiding anywhere… even listening to this.
 
I'm calling in my favor... yes. Break into Corpus and Grineer installations and steal their security data. With enough data, I can determine their cloaking patterns and turn the tables on these… betrayers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPSIntr.zhText:
有坏消息，Tenno。

追猎者找到了跟他自己一样扭曲的人，并称这些人为追随者，还派出这些追随者来杀我？！

嘘。我得小声点，他们会隐形，可能躲在任何地方……甚至可能会听到这段话。

……是的。闯进 Corpus 和 Grineer 的设施，窃取他们的安保数据。有了足够的数据，我就能确定追随者的隐藏型态，向这些背叛者展开……反击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPipesD.text: Good, now start the pumps and flood this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPipesD.zhText: 很好，启动水泵，把这里淹了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: I don't need your credits, I am a rich man but The Void, The Void needs to know you have faith.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 我不需要你的现金，我是个有钱人。但，虚空得知道你有信仰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: When you trust in The Void, The Void will grant you all you desire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 当你相信虚空，虚空就能满足你的一切欲望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: The Void has chosen me as its prophet, a prophet of profit. Isn't that wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 虚空选择了我作为它的先知，利益的先知。这不是很美妙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: Lovers of profit, devout followers of the Void, have you given your offering today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 利益的爱好者，虚空的虔诚信徒，你今天进献了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: And I say, let the void bathe you in its beautiful energy, only prosperity can follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 我说，让虚空以它的美丽能量为你洗涤，唯有繁荣能跟随它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: Before you can be rich, you must be poor. Give unto the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 在你致富以前，你定是贫困的。向虚空进献吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: Until the seed is sown, the harvest will not begin. Give unto the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 在种子播好种以前，是不会开始收获的。向虚空进献吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.text: Credits. Credits come and go, but The Void's richness is forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPreach.zhText: 现金，现金来去如流，但虚空的富裕是永恒的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPremat.text: The Bursa was destroyed too soon. Next time, wait until after you hack to kill it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPremat.zhText: 金流恐鸟被过早摧毁了，下次等到入侵完成后再消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPremat.text: Wait until after the Bursa is hacked to destroy it. You will have to try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPremat.zhText: 等成功入侵金流恐鸟后再摧毁它，你得再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPremat.text: No Tenno, hack the Bursa first, then kill it. You will have to draw out another one before you can attempt this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPremat.zhText: 不对，Tenno。先入侵，后击杀。你得先引出另一只，然后再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPumpCo.text: Flooding complete, proceed to the caves below.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPumpCo.zhText: 注水完毕，前往下方洞穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPumpRe.text: You've reached the pump station. Look for weak points in the pipes and break them open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DPumpRe.zhText: 你已经抵达了抽水站。找出管道的薄弱处，然后砸开它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAdve.text: Listen up, scum! Idiots! Rotting freaks of our great war machine!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAdve.zhText: 听着渣渣们！白痴们！我们伟大战争机器中的腐烂怪胎们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAdve.text: Captured deserters have cried for Rathuum. Do you know what that means? Trial by combat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAdve.zhText: 被捕的叛逃者曾经为死亡角斗场哭泣。你明白这意味着什么吗？用战斗进行审判！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAdve.text:
Confused? It's simple. Shooty-live innocent. Shooty-die… GUILTY!!!

This court is now in session!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAdve.zhText:
困惑吗？很简单。在枪炮中存活无罪。在枪炮中死亡……有罪！！！

现在开始执行这项法律！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.text: You greedy bunch'a savages. This is all you ever wanted, isn't it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.zhText: 你们这帮贪婪的野蛮人。这就是你要的不是吗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.text: All you Grineer are sick in the head, I do respect that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.zhText: 你们全体 Grineer 脑袋里都很病态，不过我确实很欣赏这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.text: You wall-hugging, clone monkeys, can't get enough, can you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.zhText: 你们这群卡墙的克隆猴子，永远满足不了，对不对？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.text: Did you like that, let's hear it for our Executioners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.zhText: 你们喜欢吗，喜欢就让我们的行刑者听到吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.text: Hear that, snakes? You got an audience and they wanna see you bleed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUAudi.zhText: 听见了吗臭蛇们？你有观众了，而且他们想看到你流血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: This isn't basic training, this is Rathuum. Get out there and deliver your judgement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 这可不是基本训练，这是死亡角斗场。滚出这里然后通报你的的裁定结果把。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: Watching this one fight is like watching a fly trying to swat a lion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 观看这场战斗就像看一只苍蝇拍击一头狮子一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: No, no, no. Just stop and die. You're wasting this court's time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 不，不，不。快点停下然后去死吧。你在浪费法庭的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: The Tenno, I was expecting… I don't know… more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 那个 Tenno，我原本期待着……说不上来，你有更多表现吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: Come on, Tenno, you're like a Corpus drone with a dead battery, you ain't getting no air time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 卖力点，Tenno，你就像一架没电了的 Corpus 无人机，不会有活跃的时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: Really now, Tenno, my roller balls are sharper than you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 该动真格了，Tenno，我的滚子都比你锋利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: Where do you think you are? Your Dojo? This is Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 你以为自己身处何处，你的道场？这可是死亡角斗场啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: You'll never win your case, Tenno, not like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: Tenno，你永远赢不了这案子，不是这种赢法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: The Tenno, I was expecting… I don't know… more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 那个 Tenno，我原本期待着……说不上来，你有更多表现吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: You're wasting the court's time, Tenno.
Come on, Tenno, you're like a Corpus drone with a dead battery, you ain't getting no air time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 卖力点，Tenno，你就像一架没电了的 Corpus 无人机，不会有活跃的时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: Really now, Tenno, my roller balls are sharper than you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 该动真格了，Tenno，我的滚子都比你锋利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.text: Where do you think you are? Your Dojo? This is Rathuum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUInsu.zhText: 你以为你身在何处？在你家道场吗？这可是死亡角斗场的地盘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUIntr.text:
Listen up, Tenno. I don't care if you support Steel Meridian or not, I need your help. 

An entire company of Grineer defectors was just captured by Kela De Thaym.

Now they face Rathuum, Trial by combat. Of course, the fight's rigged, a show of force to Grineer everywhere, meant to scare off future defectors. But there's a way we can turn this thing back on Kela, an obscure rule. All you need to do, Tenno, is take their place in the arena and defeat the Grineer Executioners. You game?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUIntr.zhText:
听着，Tenno。我不管你支不支持钢铁防线，我需要你的帮助。

一整个团的 Grineer 叛逃者被 Kela De Thaym 捕获了。

现在他们要面对死亡角斗场，审判的战斗。当然这场战斗是被非法操控的，为的是展示力量给到处的 Grineer 看，用来震慑未来的叛逃。但有一个方法可以反转 Kela 的这件事情，一个模糊的规则。Tenno，你要做的就是在竞技场上取代他们并且击败 Grineer 的行刑者。你愿意加入这场游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Tenno, you really want this? Fine, let's do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: Tenno，你真的要来吗？好吧，那就开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text:
Wake up you gutsacks! 

The Tenno cheaters have decided to disrespect the rules of Rathuum and have come after me directly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText:
醒醒你这个肠袋！

这些 Tenno 骗子决定不遵重死亡角斗场的规则而直接朝着我来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Should I show them what we do to cheaters?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 要给他们展示一下我们是怎么对待作弊者的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: I can tell you understand what an honor this will be, to have your tiny necks snapped by THE Kela De Thaym. That's why you're so eager. I can appreciate that and so does my audience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 我看得出你知道什么是荣誉，那就是由尊贵的 Kela De Thaym 大人来扭断你的小细脖子。这就是你期待的死法吧，我非常钦佩你这一点，我的观众也是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Snakes, you can be part of my story, but I don't think you'll like the ending.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 臭蛇们，你们会成为我故事中的一份子，但我不觉得你会喜欢这个结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Come now, Tenno, can't hit harder than that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 来啊，Tenno，就这么点力气吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: I'll be back, right after these missiles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 我会回来的，就随着这些导弹之后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Let's pickup where we left off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 从哪停止的就从哪开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: No, you will not...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 不，你真不会……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: This is MY show, my audience. I call the shots. Who do you think you are?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 这是"我的"秀场，我的观众。由我作主，你算哪根葱？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: I'm losing my patience, Tenno. No more playing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: Tenno 我快失去耐性了，别再闹了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Ah, Stop, Tenno... I can make you famous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 噢，住手啊 Tenno……我可以让你大放异彩的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Tenno, listen. I can help you. Become an Executioner. You can kill all the Grineer you want!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 听着 Tenno，我可以帮助你成为一名行刑者，杀光所有你想干掉的 Grineer！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: You maggot-minded-mongrels, they're the enemy! Not me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 你这个脑袋跟蛆虫一样的杂种，他们才是敌人！不是我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Silence! Who said you could boo me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 安静！谁准你们对我发出嘘声了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Shut up, SHUT UP.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 闭嘴，给我闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: You can't kill me, I'm Kela De Thaym, dammit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 你杀不了我的，去你的，我可是 Kela De Thaym。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: No, no, no. AHHHH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 不，不，不。啊啊啊啊啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: Nicely done, Tenno. Defeating Kela in front of her audience will show all Grineer that there is another way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: Tenno，干得漂亮。在 Kela 的观众面前击败她会让 Grineer 知道他们还能有别的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text:
Grineer, you always knew it and now there's proof. The Tenno are cheaters and I hold them in contempt. 

The accused will be executed the old fashioned way, bound and shackled. And don't worry, I'll let all you phlegm-stained sadists watch that too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText:
Grineer，一直以来你们都晓得，而现在证据就在这。Tenno 都是些骗子而我鄙视他们。

被告将由老手段处决，连绑带铐。别担心，我会让你们这些痰迷心窍的虐待狂欣赏的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.text: I knew Kela would never respect the rules of Rathuum. That's a crime that I'm gonna let you punish. I'm sending your Cephalon her coordinates. Take her out before she can execute my recruits. Some very brave Grineer are counting on you, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUKela.zhText: 我知道 Kela 决不会尊重死亡角斗场的规则。这份罪行我将交由你来惩戒。我正把她的座标传送给你的中枢。赶在她处决我的新兵前解决她。那些英勇的 Grineer 士兵全指望你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUMatc.text: Justice has been served. Prepare the accused for death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUMatc.zhText: 正义得到了伸张。准备对被告的死刑。
看到了吗？这套系统能正常运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUMatc.text: Justice is blind, and now, so are you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUMatc.zhText: 正义是盲目的，现在呢，你也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRURela.text: There you are. Do you have the coordinates to the defector's ship?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRURela.zhText: 你来了，有叛逃者飞船的坐标吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRURela.text:
Good, my marines are on their way as we speak. The defectors are safe and that's thanks to you, Tenno.

You've done more for our cause than words can say. Steel Meridian thanks you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRURela.zhText:
好的，我的海军陆战队已经在路上了。叛逃者现在安全了。多亏了你，Tenno。

你已经做了许多我们都不知道该怎么说好了。钢铁防线非常感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Mongrels, Blood-starved Morons - are you ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 杂种们，嗜血的傻子们-准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Let the Rathuum begin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 让死亡角斗场开始吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Grineer, look. Today's Executioners are more brutal than you are ugly. They love their Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: Grineer，看啊。今天行刑者的残暴更甚你们的丑陋。他们深爱着他们的女皇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Today's accused are coward deserters. They hate their Queens so much, they're using Tenno to defend them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 今天的被告是这帮怯懦的叛逃者们。他们如此讨厌他们的女皇，以至于想要利用 Tenno 来保护自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: What more do you need to know?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 你们还需要知道什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: They abandoned their Queens. Why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 他们抛弃他们的女皇，为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Maybe they're too smart for their own good. Not something you maggot-minds will need to worry about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 或许他们以为自谋私利真是太聪明了。不是你们这些蛆虫头脑需要担心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: What? I… I am declaring this a Mistrial! The Rathuum must be repeated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 什么？我……我声明这次审判错误！死亡角斗场必须再来一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Not good enough. We need proof beyond a reasonable doubt. Try again, snakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 还不够好。我们需要超越合理怀疑的证明。臭蛇们请再试一次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: It's round 3, the accused still live and the Tenno still fight. Color me disappointed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 都第三回合了，被告还活着而 Tenno 仍在战斗。真让我失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Executioners, show these genetic rejects how to kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 行刑者，给这些基因废品展示一下如何杀戮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Oh, you should've all been strangled in your tubes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 哦，你应该已经被掐住脖子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Come on, Executioners, you're flopping 'round like dying skates out there. It's embarrassing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 快点行刑者，你就像快死了的鳐鱼一样啪啪跳动着。多丢人呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Are you going to make me do this myself?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 你们非得要我亲自动手吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Another Tenno win…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 又让 Tenno 赢了一回……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: No, no, no. This is not what was supposed to happen. The Steel Meridian have not been pardoned. This is not over.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 不，不，不，不应该是这样的。钢铁防线还没被赦免。一切都还没结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Grineer, you sweet belligerent savages, are you hungry for justice?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 野蛮疯狂好战的 Grineer，大声告诉我，你们渴望正义吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Is that…? Looky here, the Tenno are back? My my, these snakes crave sunshine today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 那是……？看那里，Tenno回来了？我的天，今天这些臭蛇渴望着阳光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Do you one-thought-wonders want to see the traitors cry?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 你们可曾有一闪念想看到这些叛徒痛哭吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Do you want to see them torn to pieces?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 你们想要看到他们被撕成碎片吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Oh, I knew it, Grineer, that's exactly what you genetic-rot-bags are gonna get!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 哦我就知道，Grineer，这正是你们这些基因腐烂的动物即将得到的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Too easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 太简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Another win for the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 另一次属于 Tenno 的胜利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: THAT'S BAD, you...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 这可不妙，你……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.text: Do I have to do every damn thing myself?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUStag.zhText: 必须要我亲自来做该死的所有事情吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.text:
We see that you have gone to great lengths to help those who wish to join Steel Meridian. We want to see all Grineer purged, but we recognize that you have found another way. 

Just know, when this ordeal is over, you will be asked prove your loyalty to Red Veil.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.zhText:
为了帮助这群志愿加入钢铁防线的人，你可谓是不遗余力。我们希望净化所有 Grineer，然而你似乎走上了别的道路。

但记住，等这场考验结束，你需要重新向血色面纱证明忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.text:
We know you must right the imbalance caused by Kela De Thaym and her disgusting trial. This is clear.

We also know your alignment has not drifted toward another Syndicate. A fact you will prove to us when the time is right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.zhText:
我们知道，你需要去纠正被 Kela De Thaym 及其丑恶的审判所破坏的平衡。我们非常清楚。

我们也知道，你的忠诚并没有转向别的集团。等时机到来，你会向我们证明这一点，Tenno 战士。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.text:
Most interesting. What would cause a Grineer clone to turn against his prescribed nature? To abandon his Queens? 

I am certain your activities with Steel Meridian are born out of a desire to study this phenomenon and are not a sign of your own shifting allegiances. Correct?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.zhText:
非常有趣。是什么导致这些 Grineer 人违背基因里写定的天性，背叛他们的女皇呢？

我能确定，你之所以支援钢铁防线，是因为想要研究这个现象，而不是因为你的忠诚转移了。没错吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.text:
Tenno, we are in bitter competition with Steel Meridian. Defectors to their cause are not our allies. By all means, battle De Thaym and her Grineer horde, but do not forget who your partners are.

You will be given the opportunity to make this right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.zhText:
Tenno 战士，我们和钢铁防线之间的竞争非常激烈。他们的敌人并不是我们的朋友。你可以尽管放手去对抗德赛姆和她的 Grineer 军队，但可千万别忘了你的合作伙伴到底是谁。

我们会给你机会去纠正这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.text: Trial by Rathuum is a disgusting farce. How can any being be judged by one as impure as Kela De Thaym? In time, you will help us give these defectors the fate they deserve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUSynT.zhText: 死亡竞技场的审判是一出令人作呕的闹剧。像 Kela De Thaym 这样不纯净的个体有什么资格审判他人？迟早有一天，你会帮助我们的。让这些叛逃者获得他们应得的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUTenn.text: Down you go. I'd say 'better luck next time', but you's dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUTenn.zhText: 下地狱去吧，我本想说「祝你下次好运」，但你已经死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUTenn.text: Ohhh, Snake, a couple more hits to the face and you'll look just like my audience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRUTenn.zhText: 哦蛇们，这下再往你们的脸上多来几下就像我的观众们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRathuu.text: That Executioner's a mean one, downright brutal. Makes me smile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRathuu.zhText: 那个行刑者真是个难对付的家伙，彻头彻尾的残暴。不禁让我愉悦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRathuu.text: Hear that, Executioners? They're cheering for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRathuu.zhText: 听见了吗行刑者？他们在为你欢呼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRathuu.text: What a performance. I can feel your hunger, like you want to rip that Contenders throat with your teeth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DRathuu.zhText: 多么强大的本领。我能感受到你的饥渴，好像你想用利齿撕裂竞技者的喉头一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DSealab.text: These labs will be out of commission for a long time. That's what matters most. Get to extraction, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DSealab.zhText: 这些实验室将会有很长一段时间无法运转了，这才是最重要的。前往撤离点吧，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DSealab.text: These labs will be out of commission for a long time. That's what matters most. Get to extraction, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DSealab.zhText: 克隆尼阻止了注水。本次任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartA.text: Ah Tenno, I knew you couldn't resist an opportunity to stick it to those Grineer dogs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartA.zhText: 啊，Tenno，我了解你无法拒绝能将这东西插进 Grineer 狗身上的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartA.text: Helping Alad V after all he's done to hurt the Tenno is a difficult choice but if we can destroy these Grineer labs then the compromise is justified. Get to the pump station.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartA.zhText: 帮助阿拉德 V 是个艰难的抉择，毕竟他曾屡次伤害 Tenno。但如果我们能借此摧毁这些克隆尼实验室，这种妥协就是值得的。前往抽水站。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartG.text: You're here to sabotage Tyl Regor's cloning labs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartG.zhText: 你的任务是破坏泰尔·雷工的克隆实验室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartG.text: This lab is the birthplace of some of the most dangerous Grineer to date. Knock it out of commission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartG.zhText: 这座实验室孕育出了迄今最危险的一批精锐克隆尼。让实验室彻底报废。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartN.text: Tenno, it pleases The Void to see you taking the first steps toward righteous profit. Go forth and remember, The Void is watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartN.zhText: Tenno，虚空因见到你踏上利益这条正道而为此雀跃。继续向前并牢记在心，「虚空」在盯着你呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartN.text: We cannot trust Nef Anyo but he's brought us this far, so we need to live up to our end of the agreement. Find the pump station.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStartN.zhText: 我们绝不能信任奈富·安尤，但他既然带我们来到这里，我们也要信守承诺。找到抽水站。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStkrTa.text: There is no salvation for your crime against |BOSS_TAG|.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStkrTa.zhText: 你对 |BOSS_TAG| 犯下的罪行，不可饶恕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DStkrTa.text: You shall not leave this place!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIAfte.text: The bell! Start killing, fishies, er, brokers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIAfte.zhText: 铃声响了！开始杀戮吧，杂鱼们，呃不，经纪们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIAfte.text: And the brokers start trading bullets!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIAfte.zhText: 经纪们开始交换子弹吧！
就让交易开始吧。激动人心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIAfte.text: An eruption of chaos on the trading floor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIAfte.zhText: 交易厅爆发出一阵混乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.text: Anyo Corp, is working its way out of debt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.zhText: 安尤企业，正在努力还债。
安尤企业一次重大的资本化得分。
安尤企业，走在反超的路上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.text: Capitalization Anyo. A dark day for the Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.zhText: 安尤资本化得分。对 Tenno 来说是个黑暗的日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.text: Can Tenno turn this one around? Let's watch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.zhText: Tenno 可以逆转吗？我们拭目以待。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.text: Tough break for Tenno. Investors upset.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.zhText: 对 Tenno 来说是一次重挫。投资人很失望。
安尤企业领先了。令人可喜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.text: The Tenno are feeling the pain- financially.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.zhText: 大出血，Tenno 的钱包要大出血了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.text: Nef's rising on the index with that Capitalization.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapC.zhText: 随着这次资本化得分，奈富在《指数之场》中冉冉上升。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapN.zhText: 要克制对这次得分的兴奋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapN.text: Shares soar on that brutal Capitalization.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapN.zhText: 股份在无情的资本化得分中上升。
投资人对资本化得分露出了微笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Tenno, one step closer to financial freedom.
The Tenno desperately trying to become the market leader.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: Tenno 不顾一切地想要成为市场的领导者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: A Cap for Team Tenno. Investors asking, "will it be enough to stop Anyo Corp?"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: Tenno 队伍得分。投资人问道："如此足够阻止安尤企业吗？"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: The Tenno are swimming up The Index.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: Tenno 在《指数之场》中向上游动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Tenno rally on The Index. Dramatic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: Tenno 在《指数之场》集结了。戏剧性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Tenno rally drives Anyo Corp confidence down, down, down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: Tenno 的集结把安尤企业的信心压低，再低，更低。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Come on Brokers, how long are you going to let them do this to you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: 振作点经纪，你们还要让他们这样羞辱多久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Brokers, you need turn this around. Your livelihood and life depend on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: 经纪，你们需要逆转这个局势。你们的生计和小命都取决于这次的结果。
奈富的经纪 - 面临赤字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Nef, taking big hits on The Index.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: 奈富，在《指数之场》中饱受打击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Not a good day on The Index for Nef and his brokers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: 今天对奈富和他的经纪来说不是个好日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: Bad day for Anyo, and his investors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: 安尤和他的投资人倒霉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: It's a hostile market for ANYO Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: 对安尤企业来说行情太差了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.text: The Tenno score. Investors get jittery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICapT.zhText: 看看 Tenno 的得分。投资人惴惴不安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIClos.text: Either side could take The Index today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIClos.zhText: 今天双方都有机会在《指数之场》获胜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIClos.text: The Analysts are at a loss to predict this outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIClos.zhText: 分析师们难以预测结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIConv.text: Shocking turn of events- appropriate expression.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIConv.zhText: 形势突变 - 恰当的表情。
大屠杀。到处都是点数。太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIConv.text: All eyes on that market upset.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIConv.zhText: 所有眼睛都盯着这次市场扰乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: Look at this! Nef's brokers are rallying and the Tenno are desperate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 看看这个！经纪们集结一致，Tenno 绝望了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: Nef's investors have to be smiling today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 奈富的的投资人今天一定笑得很开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: The Tenno are losing. Biased excitement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: Tenno 要输了。偏心的兴奋状。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: By the Void, keep it up!
There's a bonus for each one of you at the end of this match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 这场比赛后你们每个人都有一笔奖金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: Do you see Investors, this is why you choose Anyo Corp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 投资人你们看到了吗，这就是你选择安尤企业的理由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: Anyo Corp comes out on top. Go boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 安尤企业占得上风。加油老板。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: A win for Anyo Corp. Sark, barely able to restrain joy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 安尤企业的胜利。Sark 我几乎不能抑制喜悦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: The boss wins. Sark is pleased.
The Void was not good to you today Tenno. But keep investing, perhaps it will smile on you next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 虚空今天对你不善，Tenno。不过别停下投资，也许下一次虚空会对你露出微笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: Thank you for the credits, Tenno.
Don't worry Tenno, I'll put these credits to excellent use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 别担心， Tenno。我会好好利用这笔钱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.text: To be quite honest Tenno, I don't think you have what it takes to be a broker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICorp.zhText: 坦白地说，Tenno。我不觉得你有做经纪的资质。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICrow.text: Lots of investors on the floor today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICrow.zhText: 今天这里有很多投资人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICrow.text: Investors, welcome to The Index. May the Void bless your precious credits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICrow.zhText: 投资人，欢迎来到《指数之场》。愿虚空祝福你们宝贵的资金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICrow.text: Investors, are you down on The Index? There's only one answer: invest more credits. The Void rewards faith.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTICrow.zhText: 投资人，你在《指数之场》中亏损了吗？只有一个选择：投入更多资金。虚空会奖励信仰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIDrop.text: Investors are eyeing those dropped points.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIDrop.zhText: 投资人紧盯着那些掉落的点数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIInde.text: Who will swim to the top of the Index first?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIInde.zhText: 谁会首先游到《指数之场》的顶端？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIInde.text: Capitalize, capitalize, capitalize. This is the Index.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIInde.zhText: 赚取资本，累积资本，利用资本。这就是《指数之场》。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIInde.text: Can the Tenno fend off Nef's brokers to rise to the Top of the Index?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIInde.zhText: Tenno 是否可以阻止奈富的经纪爬升到《指数之场》的顶端呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIIntr.text:
Has the Void been good to you? Has it taken your seed and turned it into a tree of wealth? Well, what if I told you the Void could turn that wealth into a fortune? It can, but only if you have faith. Ask yourself, "Do I trust in the Void? Am I willing to put my investment into its glorious hands? Is my belief strong enough to reap its massive rewards?" Believer, if you're crying out "YES", then The Index is for you. 

The Index, it's where investors of faith seek fortune.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIIntr.zhText:
虚空是否让你受益？你为虚空播下的种子，是否已长成财富的大树？你是否知道，虚空能让你的小小财富变成一笔巨款？但前提是，你必须抱有信仰。扪心自问吧："我是否相信虚空？我是否愿意把我的钱财投资给虚空？我的信念是否坚定，好从虚空收获丰厚的奖赏？"心存信仰的人啊，如果你的回答是肯定的，那么"指数之场"就是你该来的地方。

指数之场——投资者寻求财富的地方！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIIntr.text:
Has the Void been good to you? Has it taken your seed and turned it into a tree of wealth? Well, what if I told you the Void could turn that wealth into a fortune? It can, but only if you have faith. Ask yourself, "Do I trust in the Void? Am I willing to put my investment into its glorious hands? Is my belief strong enough to reap its massive rewards?" Believer, if you're crying out "YES", then The Index is for you. 

The Index, it's where investors of faith seek fortune.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIIntr.zhText:
虚空是否让你受益呢？你为虚空播下的种子，是否已长成财富的大树？你又是否知道，虚空能让你的小小财富变成一笔巨款呢？但前提是，你必须抱有信仰。扪心自问吧："我是否相信虚空？我是否愿意把我的钱财投资给虚空？我的信念是否坚定，好从虚空收获丰厚的奖赏？"信仰之人啊，如果你的回答是肯定的，那么"指数之场"就是你该来的地方。

指数之场——它就是投资者寻求财富的地方！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.text: That broker's carrying a lot of points. This is a risky transaction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.zhText: 那个经纪身携很多点数。这是一次危险的交易。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.text: Points in the bank mean credits in the pocket.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.zhText: 点数进入银行才是真正进了口袋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.text: Eyes on broker with many points, risky move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.zhText: 很多人盯上了那个有很多点数的经纪，冒险的举动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.text: Brokers holding many points look like shiny bait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.zhText: 持有大量点数的经纪仿佛就是鲜活的鱼饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.text: Holding lots of points is dangerous- and thrilling!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.zhText: 持有大量点数很危险 - 但也很刺激！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.text: Watch this broker with a bucket load of index points. Will they make it to the vault?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIMany.zhText: 注意这个有着一堆点数的经纪。他能够抵达金库吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.text: Capitalists, are you ready for The Index?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.zhText: 资本家们，你们准备好进入《指数之场》了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.text: Investors ready your brokers. The Index is about to open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.zhText: 投资人准备好你们的经纪，《指数之场》即将开门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.text: Investors nervous. Brokers in position. The bell, about to ring. This is The Index!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.zhText: 噢投资人都等不及了。经纪也已各就各位。铃声，马上敲响。这，就是《指数之场》！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.text: Who rules The Index? Find out when the bell rings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.zhText: 谁将主宰《指数之场》？铃声之后见分晓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.text: Excited mood. The Index begins soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.zhText: 情绪高涨。《指数之场》即将开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.text: This is The Index. I'm Cephalon Sark, your unbiased host.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTIPreS.zhText: 这就是《指数之场》。我是中枢 Sark，公正的主持人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.text: This is why Sark wakes up in the morning, folks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.zhText: 这就是为什么 Sark 在早上醒来，朋友们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.text: Cephalon Sark is faking it til he makes it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.zhText: 中枢 Sark 要假装到他成功为止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.text: Sark has no idea what happened to previous announcer. Shifty eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.zhText: Sark 可不知道前一个播音员怎么了哦。眼珠乱转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.text: Cephalon Sark's been resequenced as an announcer. Surprised look!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.zhText: 中枢 Sark 被重新排序为播音员了。惊讶脸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.text: Cephalon Sark likes his new boss, Nef Anyo. Praise the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTISark.zhText: 中枢 Sark 喜欢他的新老板——奈富·安尤。赞美虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTITenn.text: Market upset! Tenno win. Sark hides from boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTITenn.zhText: 市场扰乱！Tenno 获胜。Sark 要回避一下老板。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTITenn.text: So be it, the Void giveth and the Void taketh away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTITenn.zhText: 那就这样吧，虚空时而给予，时而夺取。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTITenn.text: Congratulations, Tenno. Just remember, on The Index nothing stays up forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTITenn.zhText: 恭喜，Tenno。不过记住，在《指数之场》没有人永远高高在上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTransf.text: The transfer is in progress. The Bursa must remain functional until the transfer is finished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTransf.zhText: 资金正在转移。在转移完成前，必须确保金流恐鸟正常运行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTransf.text: Keep that Bursa alive until the transfer finishes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTransf.zhText: 在资金转移完成前，确保金流恐鸟不被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.text: Jealous... that's why you've come... my tubemen are too healthy... too resilient... too strong... too vicious! No wait... that's not jealous... that's frightened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.zhText: 忌妒……这就是为什么你会前来的原因……我的克隆人实在是如此地健康……富弹性……强悍……以及凶恶异常！不，等等……这就不会是忌妒……是被吓傻了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.text: Tenno Lizards scampering 'bout my house. Messing with my work... contaminating my science. Who let them in. Which twit did this thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.zhText: Tenno 这群蜥蜴在我房子里跳来跳去，打乱我的工作……污染了我的科学。谁让他们进来的？是哪个蠢货搞得鬼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.text: Old Grineer... life too short... mind too small. My tubemen overcome... leave old mistakes behind... 'n all of a sudden, along slithers the Tenno, sick, sick things... here to ruin this flesh made right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.zhText: 衰老的 Grineer……寿命短暂……头脑萎缩。我的克隆人将能克服……把陈年的错误抛诸脑后……但就在这一刻，一个 Tenno 摸进这里，恶心，令人作呕的东西……破坏这副能成就 Grineer 的躯体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.text: You hate my science. Hate my tubes 'n my tubemen! But I have the numbers, add those numbers... mix those waters. Grow the tubemen so they kill forever!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.zhText: 你厌憎我的科学，我的克隆设备和我的克隆人！但我对此了如指掌，输入数据……与水混合，克隆人完成，然后他们就能无止境的进行屠杀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.text: Needs to be secret. Needs to be clean... this house. Not some dirty Galleon... hatch open... for trespassers to spread their filth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DTylDis.zhText: 必须要保密，必须要把这间房子……清理干净。跟那肮脏的帆船战舰不同……开启舱门……让那些入侵者去传播他们的污秽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DVerify.zhText: 就是现在！摧毁金流恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DVerify.text: Hurry. Destroy the Bursa before the verification is finished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Events/DVerify.zhText: 快！在验证完成前摧毁金流恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: She's exposed. Shut her down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 她暴露了。干掉她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: We shall not suffer disrespect!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我们不能蒙受侮辱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Ssh. That's enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 呼。已经足够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: And... so I turn from the tumult of the world... toward home... that sweetest spot... 'neath the circuit... of the sun….
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 还有……所以我从世界的喧嚣……转向家乡……那个最甜蜜的地方……在环绕太阳的……轨道之下……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Sparky, get in there! Grab what you can before she goes critical!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 小火花，进去那里！在她进入危急模式时前，拿走一切可以带走的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: She… She's down. Zuud? You did it! Zuud? Zuud, you okay?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 她……她被击败了。祖德？你办到了！祖德，你还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Score's paid. Debt's settled. Slate's clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 旧仇已报。恩怨已结。记录两清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: You remember them. That's all that matters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 你还记得他们。这才是最重要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: I remember us. You knew us. You know our name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我记得我们。你知道我们。你知道我们的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: We've never forgotten. Me, Biz, Smokefinger… any of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我们绝不会忘记。我，盘总，烟指……我们所有人都是如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: We had a name. Our name was… Our name was Zuud. (soft Chatter) The Zuud. Thank you. (sweet chatter) Yeah? don't get used to it! The lot of ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我们有一个名字。我们名字曾是……我们名字曾是祖德。（温和的语音）祖德。谢谢你。（甜美的语音）嗯？别太得意忘形了！你们这帮家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Division.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 布阵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: More thermia! More thermia!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 要更多热美亚！更多的热美亚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Kill her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 杀了她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Nothing shall replace a child's love for their Mother.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 对妈妈来说，孩子的爱是无可替代的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Raknoids! Bringing in refined coolant. Don't let them reach the Orb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 蛛形机！正将精炼冷却液带进来。不要让它们靠进圆蛛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: If… When… I…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 如果……什么时候……我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Attentive children are a joy to all. Attend me, little ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 殷勤的孩子人人都喜欢。来照顾我吧，小家伙们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Call them. Call them, and know what it means to feel them die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 叫它们来。叫它们来，然后感受一下，眼睁睁地看着它们死去是什么样的感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Don't let those Raknoid's cool her off. Keep the heat on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 不要让那些蛛形机冷却她。保持加热状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Some fresh, cooling… air… I think… shall do me good…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 一些新鲜的，冷却……空气……我想……应该对我有好处……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: If you will not be a model, you shall be an example.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 若你成不了楷模，那就沦为反例吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Gonna need more thermia!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 需要更多的热美亚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Rip that panel! Before she comes to!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 在她醒来之前撕开那个面板！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Medicine, Children. Mother needs her medicine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 药，孩子。妈妈需要她的药。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Stop those spiders!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 阻止那些蜘蛛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Mother needs to rest her eyes… just... for a moment…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 妈妈需要休息一下……只是……一小会儿……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Her cognition engine is exposed! Shred it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 她的认知引擎暴露了！撕碎它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: We are not at home to visitors!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我们不欢迎不速之客！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: DIE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 去死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Watch it! She's fracturing the terrain!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 注意！她在破开地面！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Tell me and we'll make it quick. What. Were. Their. Names?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 快告诉我，这样我们可以给你个痛快的。他们，的，名字，是，什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: There is… We shall… Those who…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 那是……我们将……那些人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: She's rattled. Quickly: rip off that hatch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 她慌乱了。赶快：把那个外壳弄下来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Oh no you don't! Get down here and take what's comin' to you. Blow out her footholds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 哦，不，你可别想走！给我下来，接受惩罚。炸翻她的立足点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Hey! We wanna talk to you! Sparky, be a love and potshot her footing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 嘿！我们想和你说说话！小火花，变得有爱点然后射她的立足点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Her footing, shoot out her blasted footing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 她的立足点，射爆她那该死的立足点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Solaris. United. You shall not be spared the rod… as those who came before you. Were. Not. Spared.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 索拉里斯。联盟。你们必将受到惩罚……就跟你们那些前任成员一样。没有，一个，幸免。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: HEY! I remember you. Word of advice… Run while you still got legs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 嘿！我记得你。提个建议……如果你还有腿的话就赶紧跑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Her vents! Bust'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 她的通风口！快破坏掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Children, the winter chill invigorates our character and fortifies our bodies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 孩子们，凛冬的寒气让我们性格更加鲜明，也让我们的身体更加坚韧

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Take out her ventilation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 干掉她的通风装置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Come, Children. It is a fine day to visit the city. Burn. Them. All.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 过来，孩子。这是一个游览城市的好日子。烧，光，他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Fortuna. She's going to attack Fortuna! Her mind has snapped. Get out there and stop her!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 福尔图娜。她要攻击福尔图娜！她脑子烧坏了。快出去阻止她！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: You will not have me so easily. MY fangs… are fully grown.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 你不会那么简单就击败我的。我的獠牙……已经长齐了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: My chiiiildrennnn. They did NOTHING to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我的孩子们。他们跟你无冤无仇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: My sisters! TELL. ME. THEIR. NAAAAMES!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我的姐妹！告诉-我-她们的-名字！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Shields down. Do your thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 护盾没了。该你动手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: NO! Monsters! You kill children?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 不！怪物！你杀了孩子？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Bullies! Bullies are not tolerated in my presence!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 欺凌！欺凌在我面前是不能容忍的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: AAAAH... unkind… unkind...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 啊啊啊……刻薄……刻薄……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Children: Mother requests the pleasure of your company.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 孩子们：妈妈需要你们的陪伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Iced her vents? Thinks she's indestructible. Not today. Purging the condenser. How's your throwing arm, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 她把通风口冰住了？大概她觉得这样就安全了吧。但今天不是了。我正在清空热凝器。你的投掷水平怎么样，Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Lob the canister at her vents. Don't miss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 把罐子投掷到她的通风口中。不要投歪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Toss that thermia onto her frozen vents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 把热美亚丢到她那冰冻的通风口上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Oh yeah! Now she's sweating! Now she's sweating!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 哦，太棒了！现在她热得流汗了！现在她得流汗了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Hardship. Builds. Character.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 艰难。培养。性格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Solaris. United. You must be taught what to think, not how to think. Look at me when I'm speaking to you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 索拉里斯。联盟。你必须被教育应该想什么，不是如何去想。在我跟你说话的时候看着我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Why can't I remember their names? What was that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 为什么我不能记住他们的名字？到底是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: No. (chatter) No. (insistent chatter) No. (frantic chatter!) No. (comforting chatter)... (sad chatter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 不行。（噪音）不行。（坚决的语音）不行。（胡闹的语音！）不行。（妥协的语音）……（悲伤的语音）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: More? Why do you bother me with more? (chatter) I do not… (insistent chatter) There is no… (very insistent chatter) FINE! Chatter thinks… believes… these are glyphs. Part of a… part of a passphrase.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 又来？你为什么又拿这种玩意儿来烦我？（噪音）我可不……（坚决的语音）没必要……（非常坚决的语音）好吧！杂音认为……认定……这些都是浮印。是某种……某种密码的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Passphrase? For what? How'd these get out here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 密码？什么的密码？这些怎么会出现在这里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Weird. It's junk data but… strange that it's here of all places. I'll get Zuud to take a look. You never know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 奇怪了。那是垃圾数据但是……奇怪的是它在所有地点中会出现在这里。我会让祖德好好检查一下。说不定这里面大有文章。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Sparky, I think I know what that passphrase opens and it's not a place I thought I ever could, or would, want to return to. Look for a gateway in the caves north east of Harindi Crater… You'll know what you're looking for when you find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 小火花，我想我知道了那个密码能解开什么的了，并且那不是一个我认为可以或是想要回到的地方。在哈云滴陨石坑的东北边的洞穴中寻找一个入口……你找到它之后就会知道你寻找的是什么了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Sparky, you've nearly uncovered the full set. Zuud? Could really use your help right now. What exactly does the passphrase open?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 小火花，你已经几乎找出全套了。祖德？我们现在真的需要你的帮忙。那密码到底是拿来解开什么的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: You can never go home. We should never go home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 你永远都不能回家。我们永远都不该回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: What? More? Whatever. Put it with the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 什么？还有？无所谓了。把它跟其余的放在一起吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Yes, Eudico showed me your little discovery. To find meaning in this garbage you do not need a craftsperson, you need a fortune teller. (chatter) I will not… Fine. (chatter) Fine! I will examine your treasure once I have nothing better to do. Which will be never.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 是的，Eudico 已向我展示了你的小发现。若想在这堆垃圾里找到情报，你需要的不是一位工匠，而是一个占卜者。（噪音）我不会……好吧。（噪音）好吧！等我闲下来了，我会去研究一下你的那些宝贝。不过，那种时候大概永远都不会到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Quick geology lesson: thermal fractures are what you get when you pump too much coolant into the ground too fast. Displaced thermia has to go somewhere. Now we've got thermia fractures threatening to roast Fortuna. Nef can fix this, but he won't… Instead, he's got that mucking Exploiter Orb harvesting the surface thermia for quick profit. Get out there, locate a fracture and I'll help you seal it. Oh, and Sparky; you run into that Exploiter Orb out there, you leg it. Once she ices up, nothing can touch her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 地质学快速科普：当你往地面过快灌入太多冷却液时，就会产生热美亚裂缝，因为那些被置换出来的热美亚总得有个去处。现在，福尔图娜正处于热美亚裂缝的炙烤威胁之下。虽然奈富能够解决这个问题，但他不会这么做……他反而在让那讨厌的剥削者圆蛛采集地表的热美亚来获取近利。出去找到裂缝后我会帮助你封起来。哦，还有件事 小火花，当你遇到剥削者圆蛛时，跑吧。当她冰起来时，没有什么东西能碰到她的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Nef's using the Exploiter Orb to mine those fractures. One breach and Fortuna's concourse floods with thermia. We tried taking Exploiter down, back in the day. We… We have to try again, but this time we have to succeed. We don't, it'll be Deck 12 all over again... and I can't have that. Zuud and her sisters built a thermic condenser. Load it with thermia and we can start prepping for a fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 奈富用剥削者圆蛛来开采这些裂缝。一旦发生崩溃，福尔图娜就会被热美亚淹没。我们过去试过打倒剥削者。我们……我们必须要再试一次，但这次必须成功。如果失败的话，将会是 12 号甲板事件的再现……我们不能允许那种事发生。祖德和她的姐妹们制作了热凝器了。用它装上热美亚后我们可以准备战斗了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Done, but there's still coolant in the canister. Grab it and let's find another fracture. This diluted thermia could come in handy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 完成，不过罐子里还有冷却液。拿上它后我们再去找另一个裂缝。这个稀释过的热美亚可以派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Grab the canister and get to another fracture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 拿上罐子去找另一个裂缝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Fracture sealed. Let's do it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 裂缝已封印。我们再来做一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Keep 'em off the canister while it does its thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 在它起作用的同时将他们驱离罐子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Incoming forces. Protect the canister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 敌人来了。保护罐子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Defensive positions. Do not let them destroy the canister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 变成防守阵形。不要让它们摧毁罐子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Exploiter loads her Raknoids with refined coolant. They need the thermal regulation when harvesting thermia. We can use that coolant to dilute the thermia and seal these fractures. Go crack open a Coolant Raknoid and use its canister on this fracture.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 剥削者装载有带精炼冷却液的蛛形机。它们在收割热美亚时需要热量控制。我们可以使用冷却液来稀释热美亚从而封上这些裂缝。去敲开一个冷却蛛形机并在这些裂缝上用上它的罐子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: We need refined coolant to close the fracture. Find a Coolant Raknoid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我们需要精炼冷却液来关闭裂缝。找到一个冷却蛛形机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Head to Deck 12 and load the thermia into the Condenser. Then we start planning an attack on Exploiter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 全部完成。采集器已经满载了。前往 12 号甲板并将热美亚装入热凝器中。然后我们开始计划对剥削者展开一场攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: You ready? Drop that refined coolant into that fracture to get the party started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 你准备好了吗？把那个精炼冷却液投入那个裂缝里面来开始狂欢吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: If Nef won't do anything about these fractures we'll do it for him. Let's get this fracture sealed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 如果奈富对这些裂缝置之不理，我们会帮他处理的。我们一起把这个裂缝封起来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Learn from what I am, Children. Destroy our past to build our future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 以我为榜样吧，孩子们。摧毁我们的过去以建立我们的未来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: To keep your feet upon the ground, I place burdens upon your shoulders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 为了让你们乖乖呆在地上，我将重担放在你们的肩膀上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: The unruly require instruction, not sympathy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 不守规矩的人需要的是命令，而不是同情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Those who intrude at unwanted hours are never welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 那些在讨厌的时间闯入的人，是永远不会受到欢迎的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: The disobedient shall not be spared the rod. Solaris United: value the punishment I provide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 忤逆之人不可饶恕。索拉里斯联盟：估算一下我给你们的惩罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: We protect our virtue. We safeguard against the rogue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我们守护自身的美德。我们防范叛逆者的出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: As Nef Anyo sows, so do we reap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 奈富·安尤如何播种，我们就将如何收割。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Thermia, Children. To me. Better out than in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 热美亚，孩子。对我来说。在外面比在里面更好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Obedience is efficient. Efficiency brings Profit. An obedient child profits all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 服从即是效率。效率带来利益。一个服从的孩子会让所有人得利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: You have everything you need to figure out the passphrase. Can you unlock this gateway? You know, I come back to Deck 12 most nights, in my dreams. I don't know if I'm ready for this. Open the door. Sorry, Zuud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 你有解开密码所需要用到的一切。你可以解锁这道入口吗？你知道吗，我几乎每晚都会回到 12 号甲板，在我梦里。我不知道我是否准备好做这件事。开门吧。对不起，祖德。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Nnnng… Chatter… Chatter says we must pass through… through that... gateway.  NnnnngAAH! NO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 呃……杂音……杂音说我们必须通过……通过那个……大门。呃啊！不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: I was afraid of this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我害怕的就是这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: The words… open this gateway. This gateway… leads to… nnnnnno. NO. They wait for us. Some debts can never be paid. Some debts… we are too small to collect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 这些密文……能打开大门。而这大门……通向……不——。不行。他们在等着我们。有些债务永远无法得到偿还。有些债务……对于我们这样弱小的人来说，根本无法讨回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Zuud. Zuud. Sparky: those glyphs you uncovered are the key to opening this gateway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 祖德。祖德。小火花：那些你发现的浮印就是打开这个入口的关键。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Home again. Deck 12. Most of the old SU... never made it out. Legs' folks. And Zuud's sisters. It broke her, you know? We've all tried getting through to her, but… she insists they never existed. Zuud?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 再次回到家了。12 号甲板。大部分的旧索联成员……都没能逃出来。Leg 的亲人。还有祖德的姐妹们。那事件击溃了她，你知道吗？我们都尝试过将她带出伤痛，但是……她坚持他们没有存在过。祖德？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: I hear them. My sisters. Everything they hear… echos from my sisters' ears to my... Mind. One-by-one… I remember them saying... goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我能听见她们。我的姐妹们。她们所听到的一切……从她们的耳中……回响到我的意识中。一个接一个……我记得她们在说……再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: We never thought Nef would trigger fractures here, in Deck 12. They huddle together. Thermia… everywhere. My sisters...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 我们根本没想到奈富会故意触发位于12号甲板的裂缝。她们抱在一起。热美亚……无处不在。我的姐妹们……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: This is... the last, Thing. We made together. Seven minds. All thoughts communal. Before we were reduced to one. A thermic condenser… Wait… Condensed thermia… volatile. Like, melt Exploiters defenses volatile. Finish what we started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 这是……我们共同制作的，最后一个，"东西"。七个意志。思绪相通。最终只剩下一个。一个热凝器……等一下……浓缩的热美亚……易燃易爆。它可以让剥削者的防御灰飞烟灭，完成我们当初的计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.text: Only problem. We can't make condensed thermia without diluted thermia. So... get us some diluted Thermia.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/ExploiterEvent.zhText: 唯一的问题是。我们不能在没有稀释的热美亚的情况下制作浓缩的热美亚。所以……给我们搞点稀释的热美亚来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Awwuhhh!! The Ex-imannuususess got to the secret treasure before we did! Oh well…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 啊啊啊！！那个卓越者居然比我们先找到了秘密宝藏！唉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Yeah, we got other things to focus on, like not getting my ass killed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 是啊，我们还有其他事情要关注，比如别让我的小命没了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: More important priorities right now than cache boxes…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 现在有比储藏箱更重要的事……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: MORE LOOT! MORE LOOT! More eximus! More eximus!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 更多战利品！更多更多的战利品！更多卓越者！更多更多的卓越者！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: We rolled a successful save on lockpicking! We got into the treasure chest! Unfortunaaately, the exi-muss-muss are PISSED. Incoming!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我们开锁检定成功了！我们打开了宝箱！不幸——的是，那些异形怪们很生气。来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: "We have stolen the secret treasure and now the Evil Hoardes seek revenge." Happy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: "我们偷走了秘密宝藏，现在邪恶的宝藏家族要来复仇了。"满意了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Amir? You do realize… we're not still playing Fables & Frontiers… right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 阿米尔？你知道……我们不是在玩《寓言与边疆》……对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: What treasure? Why're we wasting our time on- I just see a cache. Oooh, ay no names… Great…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 什么宝藏？我们干嘛浪费时间——我只看到一个储藏箱。哦——，哎，没有名字……太好了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: For the last time, Amir, that's a CACHE, not SECRET TREASURE. And I am not rolling for "save throws" every time we come out here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 阿米尔，我最后再说一遍，那是储藏箱，不是秘密宝藏。而且我可不想每次来这里都要掷"豁免检定"！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Al menos te estás divirtiendo, bólido… Just don't get too into character, yeah? I don't want to see what happens next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: Al menos te estás divirtiendo, bólido……别太入戏了，好吗？我不想看到下次又出什么幺蛾子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text:
[0.0]

[5.6]
Eey! The Amir-Brand Super-Fast Eximus units are aaaaaall dead. 
[12.9]
Hey, it's a good thing we're not stuck in a situation where these things endlessly repeat without making meaningful progress, right?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText:
[0.0]

[5.6]
哎呀！阿米尔牌超高速卓越者单位全——都报废了。
[12.9]
嘿，幸好我们不用陷入这种事情不断重复却毫无进展的困境，对吧？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: We did it! Yes! Uhh. Though, I think we only killed this batch of Eximus-es-es… But hey! It'll keep us on our toes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我们成功了！呃。不过，我们好像只消灭了这一批卓越者……但是，嘿！这至少让我们保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Heeey, we did it! The Amir-y Exim-ys are Dead-ys. For now-ys. … You know how this is gonna go…ys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 嘿，我们成功了！阿米尔的卓越者都死翘翘了。暂时的。……你知道接下来会发生什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: 99 Piles of Dead Eximi… 99 Piles of Deeeath! Kill some more, go back around, 98 piles of Dead Eximi!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 99 堆死卓越者……99 堆死死死人！再杀一些，绕回去，98 堆死卓越者！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text:
[0.0]

[2.9]
Yay, we did it! 
[9.2]
Y'knooooow… Now that I know I can do this… I wonder what else I can do - 
[13.3]
OW OW OW OW OW ARTHUR OW OKAY OW I'M SORRY.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText:
[0.0]

[2.9]
耶，我们成功了！
[9.2]
你知道吗……既然现在我知道我能这样做……我想知道我还能做什么——
[13.3]
哎哟哎哟哎哟哎哟亚瑟哎哟好吧对不起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: How many of these things did you make, Amir? Or am I happier not knowing?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 阿米尔，这样的东西你搞出多少个？还是我不知道更改好？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I'm not saying Fables & Frontiers is bad. I'm not even saying playing was a bad idea. I'm just saying that this is probably not what the designers had in mind so maybe we ought to think this through next time, ey?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我不是说《寓言与边疆》不好。我甚至不是说玩这游戏是个坏主意。我只是说这可能不是设计师的初衷，所以下次我们或许应该好好考虑一下，对吧？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I'm gonna hand it to you Amir, when you have a crisis, you have a crisis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 阿米尔，我得承认，当你遇到危机的时候，那是真的危机了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: ¡JODER! Estos cabrones son rápidos. Amir, how much of your "special sauce" did you have before you dreamt up these assholes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: ¡JODER! Estos cabrones son rápidos。阿米尔, 你在想出这些混蛋之前，到底喝了多少你的"秘制酱料"？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Okay. Okay. I know this looks bad. But hey… at least it's not boring, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 好啦，好啦，我知道这看起来很糟糕。但是，嘿……至少不无聊，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Think about the upsides! We now know that we can have an effect on the universe! … By creating horrible monsters, but it's a start!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 想想好处吧！我们现在知道我们可以影响宇宙！……虽然是通过创造可怕的怪物，但这总算是个开始！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Amir. Darling. When I suggested trying to work on "manifesting," this is not what I had in mind…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 阿米尔，亲爱的。当我建议你尝试"显化"时，我指的可不是这个意思……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: As horrifying as all this is, I must say, it opens the door to a great number of interesting questions about what we can and cannot do from here…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 尽管这一切令人震惊，但我必须说，这也引出了许多有趣的问题，让我们思考接下来我们能做什么，不能做什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Amir. Cuz. Cuz. I'm gonna level with you, yeah. This is funny as shit, my man! I'm sorry, look, I'm sorry. I know, I know, but - look at 'em all go! It's Amirs, as far as the eye can see! All of time 'n space! Everywhere! Just - Amirs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 阿米尔。老表。老表。我跟你说实话，真的。这太他妈搞笑了，我兄弟！抱歉，听着，我很抱歉。我知道，但是——看看他们都去哪儿了！到处都是阿米尔，目之所及！时空之内！到处都是！全是——阿米尔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: You could've come'n said something. You know none of us enjoy being stuck in this loop. Me, least of all. But I get it. We all gotta do what we gotta. You just… screw up all of reality, cuz. Respect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你本来可以过来跟我说一声的。你知道我们谁都不喜欢被困在这个循环里。我尤其不喜欢。但我理解。我们该做的事还是得做。你只是……把整个现实都搞砸了，老表。佩服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Oooh, that's a lotta… eximus-eses… What is the plural of Eximus, anyway? Exi-meeses? Ex-mooses? Exi-many? Exi-multi? Exi-mi? Hey! Where're you going?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 哦，好多……卓越者……卓越者的复数到底是什么来着？卓越者堆？卓越者群？卓越者团？卓越者队？嘿！你要去哪儿？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text:
[0.0]

[6.4]
Sorry about the whole… "breaking reality with a F&F adventure" thing… 
[10.6]
Oh! Hey! What's over there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText:
[0.0]

[6.4]
抱歉啊，关于之前那件"用《寓言与边疆》冒险打破次元壁"的事……
[10.6]
哦！嘿！那边是什么！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Hey, think we can talk a few of these exi-ma-whatevers into joining the next adventure? What?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 嘿，你觉得我们能不能说服这些所谓的卓越者什么的加入下一次冒险？什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: HARK! I'm gonna cast "Detect Assholes." Yup. We're in for a rooouuugh time. Roll for initiative!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 听着！我要施放"侦测混蛋之术"了。没错。看来我们有的受——了。掷骰决定先攻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Well, it's like what my gramps always said: "Amir, if you ever go ripping holes into the time-space continuum, remember it's your responsibility to go kill whatever comes out of it." … And here I thought my gramps was just crazy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 嗯，就像我爷爷常说的那样："阿米尔，如果你哪天真的撕开了时空连续体的裂缝，记住，你有责任把从那里冒出来的东西统统解决掉。" ……我之前还以为我爷爷只是疯了呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Ooof. Nat 1.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 哎——呀。掷出 1 点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Critical fail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 严重失误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Party wiiiipe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 团灭——。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: How did you even get in here?! I thought I locked the door! Sneaky Drifter-ses, wicked, tricksy, false!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你是怎么进来的？！我明明锁门了！鬼鬼祟祟的漂泊者，邪恶、狡猾、虚伪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Zzzz. Yeah, I mean, great! Everyone party needs a basic b-- I mean, a good old fashioned fighter! Next question!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: Zzzz。嗯，我的意思是，太好了！每个队伍都需要一个基本的——我是说，一个好的老派战士！下一个问题！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Do you want to wield a two handed sword, or sword and shield? Do you like to "give" or do you like to "receive?"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你想使用双手剑，还是剑盾？你喜欢"攻"还是"守"？
