/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Sneakity-sneak-sneak! A Drifter after my own heart. Next question!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 鬼鬼祟祟！果然是和我志同道合的漂泊者。下一个问题！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Do you want to start with a bonus in stealing and stealth or a bonus in assassination?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你想从偷窃和潜行的加成，还是暗杀的加成开始？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: The arcane forces are yours to wield! Next question.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 奥术之力任你驾驭！下一个问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Do you want to start with an ice bolt specialty or a fire ball specialty? Freeze them where they stand, or roasty toasty?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你想先学冰箭专精还是火球专精？把人冻在原地，还是烤得焦香四溢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Sure! A Knight is a fighter class. Pick a sword & shield or a two-handed sword as your starter weapon. Hit things real hard, or.... take hits real hard. Take hard hits real... bad... good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 当然！骑士是战士职业。选择剑盾或双手剑作为你的初始武器。要么使劲打人，要么……狠狠挨打。挨很重的打真的……很糟……酸爽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Anway! A Wizard's a kind of magic user! Pick from a collection of cool magical spells like fireball or ice ray! Fwoosh! Bang! Boom! Real squishy though. Gotta watch out for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 总之！巫师就是一种使用魔法的人！你可以选择各种炫酷的魔法咒语，比如火球术或冰射线！嗖！砰！轰！不过这角色很脆，要小心哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: And then there's my personal favorite - the rogue. Pick locks, commit crimes, do murder. 'Nuff said.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 还有我个人最喜欢的——盗贼。他们会撬锁、犯罪、杀人。无需多言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Sooooo... whatcha wanna be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 所——以……你想当哪个？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: So… about that whole… "accidentally flooding every part of the timeline and the whole of the known universe with a bunch of hyperactive and electrically charged baddies for the foreseeable forever," thing…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 所以……关于那个……"意外地让时间线的每个部分以及整个已知宇宙在可预见的未来都充斥着一群异常活跃且带电的坏蛋"的事情……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Yeah, yeah. Sorry...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 恩，是的。抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Hey, I gotta keep you on your toes somehow, right! It's not like you have better things to be doing. Sorry...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 嘿，我得让你保持警觉，对吧！反正你也没什么更重要的事要做。抱歉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: But, hey. Let's go mop the floor with a few of them schmucks, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 但是，嘿。咱们去把那几个笨蛋揍一顿吧，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: ... Jerk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: ……混蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Oooookay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 好——吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Let me know if you change your mind, I... guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我……想，如果你改变主意了，告诉我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Awesome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Shit. I uh. I have a lot of prep to do. So I'll see you all on KIM for the adventure!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 糟了。呃，我还有很多准备工作要做。所以我们在即时通上一起冒险吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: BYE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 再见！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Let's find out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我们来看一下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Is this why you had no friends in Duviri? I think this is why you had no friends in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 这就是你在双衍王境没朋友的原因吗？我想这一定是你在双衍王境没朋友的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Greetings, traveler! You have summoned me from the depths of the mechanical dimension! Dig the decor?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你好，旅行者！是你把我从机械次元的深处召唤了出来！喜欢这里的装饰吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Fare thee well!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 保重！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Go with the wind at thy back and LOOT in thy pockets!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 愿你一路顺风，满载而归！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Til we meet again, brave soul!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 勇敢的灵魂，后会有期！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: May the road rise to meet thee! And may it not, y'know, rise TOO much, cuz that's an earthquake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 愿你步步高升！但也别升过头，不然那就变地震了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Onward, hero! To GLORY! To VICTORY! To… wherever it is you're going!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 英雄，勇往直前！奔向荣耀！奔向胜利！奔向……你要去的任何地方！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Until next time, traveler! May your HP stay full and your inventory encumbered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 旅行者，下次再见！愿你血条常满，背包也常满。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: The realm thanks thee for thy coin! As do I! Mostly me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 王国感谢你赐予的金币！我也感谢你！尤其是我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Farewell, sweet patron! Don't forget about me out there! WRITE SOMETIMES.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 再见了，亲爱的顾客！别忘了我哦！记得偶尔写信。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: HAVE FUN STORMING THE CASTLE!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 尽情享受攻城战吧！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Safe passage through the realm, friend! And if anyone asks where you got that gear — — AMIR'S.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 朋友，一路平安！如果有人问你这身装备是从哪儿来的——就说是阿米尔的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Whaaaaaat?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 什——么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Hail, fellow Fable-r! Beehooold, my Kingdom of A Million Dead Colored Markers! Let their sacrifices not be in vain!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我的寓言伙伴，向你致敬！看啊，我的百万支彩色马克笔王国！愿它们的牺牲不要白费！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Do you smell burning? I smell burning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你闻到烧焦的味道了吗？我闻到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I asked Velimir to get me a hotel bell. Two days later? Poof there it was. He said "no questions." Which means… I have so many questions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我让维利米尔帮我拿个酒店铃。两天后？啪的一下就出现了。他说"别问"。这意味着……我有很多问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Summon me not in vain, mighty traveler from beyond the veil of time and space. Or I'll be like… annoyed. And shit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 来自时空彼岸的伟大旅行者，没事别召唤我。不然我会……烦的。还有该死的什么的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Ah, balls. Arthur's gonna yell at me about marks on the floor, inn'he?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 啊，糟了。亚瑟肯定会因为地板上的痕迹冲我吼，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I'm trying out a new non-caloric, silicon-based kitchen lubricant - it creates a surface 500 times more slippery than any cooking oil!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我正在试用一种新型的无热量、硅基厨房润滑剂——它能让表面比任何食用油滑 500 倍！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Every time I come in here I have to play 52 pickup with all my sheets… Gotta get me some Ye Old-e Paperclip-ies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 每次我来这里，我都得用我所有的纸片玩 52 张捡牌游戏……我得搞点老式回形针才行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Mighty and fearsome Wanderer! What need have you of your resident Fablemaster this day?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 强大而可怕的流浪者！你今天需要你的常驻寓言主持人做什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I asked Kalymos if she wanted to play and I swear she rolled her eyes at me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我问了卡利莫斯要不要一起玩，我发誓她朝我翻了个白眼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: You suuuuuuuure about that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你真的确定吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Okiedokie! BEGIN. AGAIN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 好嘞！重新开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Aww, shucks. Buttering up your Fablemaster won't get you free advantage rolls, y'know. Uh... speaking of!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 哎呀，真可惜。讨好你的寓言主持人并不能让你免费获得优势骰子，你知道的。呃……说到这个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Y'know? Less time than you'd think, but probably more time than you'd like. The real pain in the ass was those rock walls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你知道吗？实际时间比你想的要短，但可能比你希望的要长。真正让人头疼的是那些岩壁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: You should've seen the look on the Scaldra's goons faces when I was zipping past 'em up from the underground arcade! So!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你真该看看我从地下游戏厅一路冲上来的时候，炽蛇军那帮人脸上的表情！真是的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I have a new adventure of Fables & Frontiers ready to go! All the rest of the Hex are game. You in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我准备好了新一轮的《寓言与边疆》冒险！六人组的其他人都会来玩。你来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Ok-ok-ok-ok-ok cool. Right! You don't have a character for this adventure yet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 好好好好好，没问题。对了！你在这轮游戏还没有角色呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Everybody else has already built theirs, so... to round out the team, do you want to be a Knight? A Wizard? Or a Rogue?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 其他人都已经选好角色了，那么……为了让队伍完整，你想成为骑士？巫师？还是盗贼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I've got your character sheet right here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我这有你的角色卡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Yeah, well... I guess it is kind of a fun party trick. So! Character sheet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 嗯，这算是个挺有趣的派对小把戏吧。那么！角色卡！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: If you squint just hard enough that looks like it comes with +2 to social competence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 如果你眯起眼睛仔细看，它看起来好像能给社交能力 +2。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: One time, I choked on some dice, and then one flew out my nose, and I got a nat 20. … No, I will not explain, thank-you-very-much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 有一次，我被骰子噎住了，然后有一个从我的鼻子里飞了出来，我就掷出了自然 20 点。……不，我不会解释的，非常感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Lizzie asked to play in the next game. Please, help me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 丽兹说要参加下一局游戏。请帮帮我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: You think I could talk Kaya into bringing me back manuals from the future?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你觉得我能说服卡娅帮我从未来带回一些手册吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Velimir wanted to play but Minerva said no, they had to stay on watch. And seeing as she is absolutely the scariest protoframe in the mall? Fair. Totally, totally fair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 维利米尔想玩，但米尼娃说不行，他们必须留下看守。考虑到她是商场里最可怕的原型战甲。合理，完全合理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Flare is the one who drew all the art! I mean. The absolutely sick character art on everybody's sheets. Not the crappy doodles. That was all me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 弗莱尔画了所有的插图！我是说，每个人角色卡上那些超赞的角色插图。不是那些乱七八糟的涂鸦。那些都是我画的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Think I could set up Kalymos with all this stuff? "Kalymos has wares, if you have coin…" Nah, she'll probably just bite me again…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我觉得我能让卡利莫斯来处理这些？"卡利莫斯有货，如果你有币的话……" 算了，她可能又会咬我一口……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: And they said I was crazy when I started hoarding all those magic markers…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 当我开始囤那些马克笔的时候，他们都说我疯了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Look upon my works, ye foolish, and despair; for they are all dweeby and full of in-jokes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 看看我的作品吧，你们这些愚蠢的人，然后绝望吧；因为它们都很宅，还全是只有自己人才懂的笑话！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Growing up, my friends said being a Fablemaster wasn't real work. Well, I'll have you know, it takes at least fourteen hours to write a day's session! Who's the loser now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我小时候，朋友都说当寓言主持人不算什么正经工作。哼，我告诉你，写一天的剧情至少要花十四个小时！现在谁才是废物？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Aah, come to peruse my Fine Wares of Royal Attire, Enchanted… Stuff… and… honestly whatever crap it looks like I've managed to glue together. Look, I'm doing my best over here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 啊，快来看看我的皇家服饰精品、魔法……玩意儿……还有……说实话，就是我拼凑起来的那些乱七八糟的东西。瞧，我已经尽力了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: What, not nerdy enough for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 什么？这还不够宅吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Yo-ke-dokie then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 那好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Oop. That's fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 哦。没关系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Fie!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 呸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Booooo.
A pox on thee.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 祝你得瘟疫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Rolled a one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 掷了个一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Critical fail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 严重失误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Sure, see if I care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 行吧，我无所谓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Were my wares not up to your liking, Peasant?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 土包子，我的货物不合你的心意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Good fortune upon thee, Wanderer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 流浪者，祝你好运！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Huzzah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 万岁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: May your wits stay sharp, and your pockets stay - - lighter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 愿你头脑敏锐，口袋空空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: You have chosen… wisely. Seriously though, good pick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你的选择……是明智的。讲真，选得挺好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: The gods smile upon this transaction!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 诸神眷顾这笔交易！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: You walked in a customer and you walked out a legend! Terms and conditions apply.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 你进来时只是个普通顾客，出去时已然成为传奇！须遵守相关条款和条件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Handle with care, mighty hero! Or don't. I got paid either way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 小心轻放，伟大的英雄！或者不用也行。反正钱我已经收到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Aah, a patron of the fine arts! And by fine, I mean… my nightmare doodles.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 啊，艺术的赞助人！而我说的艺术，指的是……我那些鬼画符。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: BOOM. Official. Notarized by the Kingdom of Höllvandeim: Population, Me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 砰！正式生效。经霍凡德姆王国公证：人口，就我一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: By the ancient rites of commerce, this transaction is SEALED. No takesies-backsies. That's canon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 根据古老的商业惯例，这笔交易已成完成，不容反悔。这是铁律。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Adventurer! Ready to embark upon thy next… Um… adventure?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 冒险家！准备好踏上你的下一次……呃……冒险了吗？

这可怜的家伙。当我说到"多面体"这个词时，我发誓我看到他的笑容瞬间凝固了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text:
FRIENDS! INVICTIANS! COUNTRY-PEOPLES! Lend me thine ears! Today on this day of… whatever-the-hell-ass loop we're in, I, your most beloved, honorable Fablemaster, am proud to announce the Grand Opening of the Dominion of Höllvandeim! 

 Previously known as the Internet Cafe upstairs.

If thy wishes to begin a new journey into strange and mysterious lands, venture forth and - eh - summon thy loyal servant with the - um - Enchanted Bell of Fablemastery!

 …Yeah just go upstairs and ring the bell if you wanna make a character and get this party started.

Fare thee well, until we speak again!

 - Fable Master Amir
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText:
朋友们！不败者们！还有各位乡亲父老！请听我一言！

在今天——这个……管它是什么鬼循环的日子里——我，你们最爱也最敬重的寓言主持人，郑重宣布：霍凡德姆王国盛大开国！ 

 以前叫楼上的网吧。

若诸位有意踏上一段通往奇异与神秘之地的全新旅程，便请勇敢前行，并——呃——以那……寓言主持人的魔法铃铛，召唤诸位忠诚的仆从！

 ……好吧，总之想创建角色、开始跑团的话，就上楼摇铃。

愿诸位一路顺风，后会有期！

 ——寓言主持人 阿米尔

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: I smell LOOT. Careful, if we don't get the box open in time, the eximus-is-s get to it first!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 我闻到了战利品的味道。小心，如果我们不能及时打开箱子，那些卓越者就会抢先一步！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Hey! My Loot-Sensing-Sword is glowing. But we'll have to hurry if we want to beat the eximanys to it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 嘿！我的寻宝剑在发光。不过，如果我们想赶在卓越者之前拿到它，就得抓紧时间了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.text: Oh! Oh! Oh! Hey! On my map, I have here that there's a Super Secret Treasure! We should try to steal it before the eximooses do!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FablesAndFront.zhText: 哦！哦！哦！嘿！我的地图上显示这里有个超级秘密宝藏！我们应该赶在那些卓越者之前把它偷走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You want somethin' dolled up? All right. Can't be any different to repainting a rail tractor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你想给它打扮得漂漂亮亮？没问题。这跟给航道牵引机刷漆没多大区别。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sure. Let's take a look at it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好啊。拿来看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Show us the piece, let's see if it's worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 把东西亮出来，看看它够不够格。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: How do. Our lines are open. Comms and contracts. Whaddya need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗨，我们开张了。有通讯用具和委托。想要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Comms are patched and Eudico's on the horn if you need work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 通讯已恢复。想找工作的话就找尤迪科。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Base is locked down and comms are up. Let's get you resupplied, Outworlder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 基地被封锁了，但通讯正常。拿些补给吧，异世者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Weather like this, I do not miss my organics. So uh, what do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这种鬼天气，倒是让我庆幸不是以前的肉身。呃，有什么需要？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Lovely day for a little commerce.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 做点小买卖的好日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text:
[6.1]
Hoo! And THIS is WHY we get our bits replaced!
[14.0]
Look, I'm not a fighter, me. Got a family, but a Dad's gotta do what's right for his kids.
[22.0]
Give 'em a different future. So I'll keep standin' here in the freezing cold, just as long as you need me.
[24.0]
You give 'em hell, Outworlder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText:
[6.1]
呼！正因如此，我们才把身体换成机械！
[14.0]
我呢，虽然不会战斗，但我有家室了。一个当爹的，总得为孩子们做点什么。
[22.0]
得给他们更好的未来。所以只要你需要，不管多冷我都会一直在这里守着。
[24.0]
给他们点颜色看看，异世者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Copy that. See ya next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 收到。下次见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Signing off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 先挂断了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Have a better one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 祝你今天顺利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You have a great day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 祝你今天过得愉快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Transaction logged and bundled out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 交易已记录，货物已打包。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Copy that. Ruin their day, Outworlder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 明白。给他们找点不痛快，异世者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Roger. Scan yer optics over this lot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 收到。检查下这批货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nice, eh? See anythin' ya like?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不错吧，嗯？有没有喜欢的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Old, new, stolen, illegal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 新的老的，偷的抢的，一应俱全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You see something you wanna tackle? I'll get Eudico on the blower.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有想接的活吗？我可以帮你联系尤迪科。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Pick a run, and I'll patch ya through.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 挑个任务吧，我给你接线。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Always fancied a life of action, me. 'Cept, y'know, an old injury. And an aversion to having a cauterized hole blown through me parts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我以前总幻想着过那种刀光剑影的生活。可惜啊，身上有旧伤。还有，我也不想身上再被烧出个窟窿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, this specimen's quite complex. Heavily modified. Fascinating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯，这个样本结构相当复杂。很多地方都改造过，有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A pleasure watching you work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 看你做事，确实赏心悦目。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Handily done, there. Nice outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 手法利落，结果漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I love what I do, but never quite get used to the smell. All those built-up toxins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我热爱我的事业，但总习惯不了这股气味。全是沉积下来的毒素。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: All right. Have at it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好的，请随意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Good choice. I'll leave you to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 明智之举。交给你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You don't seem to need help with that. Shout out when you're done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 看起来你不需要帮忙。完事说一声就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 多谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah, wonderful. I know just who will benefit from this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，太好了。我刚好知道谁能用上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I'll find those who need the parts and have them seen to. It is a fine thing you do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我会把这些零件亲手送给有需要的人。你做了一件大善事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Part with some of your catch, we'll separate their components and distribute them to the needy. There's certainly enough of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 匀几条渔获给我吧。我们会拆出零件，再分给真正需要的人。需要它们的人可不少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Making friends can be a simple thing: be kind. Fortuna's rig jockeys are in constant need of parts and repair, and many can't afford it. Share some of your catch. They'll remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 交朋友其实不难：乐善好施。福尔图娜有很多工人长期需要零件和身体维修，却负担不起。分享一些渔获吧，他们会铭记于心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: If you've a spare Servofish or two, I can take the parts to those who need them. The Temple frowns on charity, so people are hurting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 要是你手头有多余的伺服鱼，我可以把零件带给那些急需它们的人。润盈殿历来反对慈善，所以大家的日子都不太好过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Wait. Do you know what this is? An original Orokin custodial drone. Where in the world did you find this? Most people have only ever seen this fellow in pictures. Old. Pictures. He must have been down there for… centuries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 等等，你知道这是什么吗？这可是一台货真价实的奥罗金环卫无人机。你到底是在哪找到的？大多数人只是在照片里看到过它，还是年代久远的照片。它肯定在那里待了……好几个世纪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hm. When did I last see one of these? The Orokin deployed automated cleaners, much as we do. Their designs influencing the workings of much of our own. A rare catch indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯，我最后一次看到这种型号是什么时候了？奥罗金当年也和我们一样，也有自动清洁机。我们的许多设计至今都深受其影响。确实是极其珍贵的收获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hm. Simple. Stripped-back design. A bit primitive but handsomely made.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯。结构简单，设计基础。有点简陋但做工精致。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Finished. Opinion?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 完成了。觉得如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Beautiful. She's all yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 真美。她是你的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: And done. Majestic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 弄好了。气派得很。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Very good. I'll begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 很好。马上开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: She's a bit of a mess at the moment, granted, but with a little attention, she'll be fit for the wall of a lodge. Just a moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别看她现在有些狼狈，不过只要稍加整理，她就能成为墙上精美的装饰。马上就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Mounting board's ready. Let's begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 背景板就绪。开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Decent. Needs maintenance but in good condition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不错，该保养了，不过整体状况良好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I see this particular model quite a bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个型号我见过很多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Black-Banded Bolarola. Their appealingly laminated plates were sported for a time as part of Grineer formalwear. Which is why we don't often see them anymore. Well, if I have my way that'll change. Let's bring it in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 黑条纹波雷罗拉。它们那层次分明的美丽甲片，曾一度被克隆尼军官当作礼服上的装饰。这也正是如今很难再见到它们的原因。只要有我在，这种局面迟早会改变。把它带回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Spotted Bolarola. Happy little thing. Let's bring it in, there's plenty of friends waiting for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 斑点波雷罗拉，快乐的小家伙。快带它回来吧，有好多小伙伴都在等着它呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That is an… unusual silhouette for a… oh my. Look at that. Iridescent laminate to its defensive bands… and what look like defensive barbs. Outworlder, this is a most unusual Bolarola. Bring it in, but carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这轮廓还真……不寻常。噢，天呐，瞧瞧它。防御用的甲带上闪烁着流光溢彩的虹光……还长着防御尖刺。异世者，这是一只极其罕见的波雷罗拉。把它带回来，务必小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Mountains, caves: these are things Bolarolas find… comforting. Craters, too, on occasion. Now, this species is all about defense. Their armored plates protect their vulnerable undersides from predators, tucking and rolling to make good their escape. So, when it appears, while you can, target their belly and strike true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 山丘和洞穴能让波雷罗拉感到安心。它们偶尔也会出现在陨石坑附近。这种机灵的生物非常善于保护自己。它们的外甲可以保护柔软的腹部，遇到危险还能缩成一团翻滚逃走。你一旦看到它就得迅速瞄准腹部，务必一击拿下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Right. Nature's little tank this one. Your only chance will be to target the soft underbelly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯，它就是自然界中的小坦克。你唯一的胜算就是瞄准它柔软的腹部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Bolarola. Armored. Except for the belly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 波雷罗拉。浑身是甲，除了腹部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: This little fella's topside is impenetrable to tranqs, so target their underbelly. This may require a little patience on your part.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个小家伙背甲连麻醉弹也打不穿，你得朝它的腹部打。这可能需要一点耐心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Forget about targeting the Bolarola any old where. The underbelly is its only vulnerable spot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别指望随便打中波雷罗拉的任意部位都能奏效。柔软的下腹部，是它唯一的弱点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A careless tranq shot will simply bounce off the bolarola's carapace. It's the underbelly or nothing for this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 麻醉弹要是随便乱打，只会从波雷罗拉的甲壳上弹开。必须朝腹部打才有效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Horrasque. This hideous creature is terrible to behold, but will not attack unless provoked preferring to be left to wallow and hunt in peace. When riled, however, its roar will shake the bowels of even the most steadfast trapper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只惑瓦斯克。这种丑陋的生物长相确实不讨喜，不过只要不主动招惹，它通常不会主动攻击。它更喜欢独自打滚和安静地捕猎。可一旦被激怒，它们的吼声足以让最勇敢的猎手胆战心惊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Horrasque are tunnelers. This one will surface, tentatively, and if he sees you… vanish. Lay low. Let him emerge. Then fire your tranq.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 惑瓦斯克很擅长掘地。它会先试探着探出地面，要是它看见你……转眼就会钻回去。保持隐蔽，等它自己出现。然后再开枪麻醉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Alright. The Horrasque will tunnel towards the call, then poke its head aboveground. If it feels safe it will emerge and wander. Then, you fire the tranq.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好了。惑瓦斯克会顺着声音从地下挖过来，然后探出头来。如果它觉得安全了，就会钻出来闲逛。然后，你就可以开枪麻醉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Horrasque will surface nearby. Give it a moment, let it emerge, and then tranquilize it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 惑瓦斯克会在附近露头。给它一点时间，等它完全钻出来，再用麻醉枪放倒它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Horrasque will leave its tunnel only if it feels safe. So be quiet and careful, give it a moment, and then tranq.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 惑瓦斯克只有确认附近安全，才会离开地洞。所以要保持安静，再小心点，耐心等它出来，然后再开枪麻醉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah. Yes. Well. This is interesting. You've managed to attract a Kubrodon. The apex predator of the Venusian plains. These massively framed beasts often travel in groups, claiming the whole of the Vallis as their domain. Needless to say: be careful. Especially when it gets dark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，太好了。这下有意思了。你吸引来了一只库狛顿，它是金星平原上的顶级掠食者。这种体格庞大的野兽经常成群出没，占谷为王。不用多说：千万要小心，尤其在入夜之后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That is the call of a Pobber. Not the mightiest of beasts… but worthy of salvation nonetheless. Despite the odor. Now, you must be stealthy: preyed upon by Sawgaws and Virmink, Pobbers will flee at the slightest hint of danger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那是泡博的叫声。算不上什么强壮的猛兽……但即便气味难闻，也一样值得拯救。你现在得保持隐蔽：泡博是梭歌和弗鸣克的猎物，一有风吹草动它就会逃走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That is the cry of a formidable raptor the Solaris call a Sawgaw. This crimson-faced bird of prey circles and stalks the cliffs and fungal forests of Venus, searching for rodent prey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那是种强悍猛禽的啼鸣，索拉里斯人称它为梭歌。这种赤面猛禽会盘旋在金星的悬崖和真菌森林上空，搜寻啮齿类猎物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Remember: the Sawgaw enjoy perching atop the Gorgaricus fungi. So look up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 记住：梭歌喜欢栖息在葛嘉里菌的顶端。所以，抬头看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sawgaw perch high up, the better to scan for prey undetected. Check the fungi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 梭歌喜欢栖息在高处，以便在不被察觉的情况下搜寻猎物。好好看看真菌顶部。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Gorgaricus fungi are preferred perches for Sawgaw. That's where we'll find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 葛嘉里菌是梭歌最喜欢的落脚处。我们去那儿准能找到它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Being an avian the Sawgaw prefers a high vantage point. Nothing higher than the oversized Vallis fungi.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 梭歌毕竟是鸟类，自然喜欢视野开阔的高处。而这片山谷里，没有什么能比那些巨型真菌更高的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sawgaws and the giant Vallis fungi go hand-in-hand. Remember to look up. The little fellow could be eyeballing us right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 梭歌和山谷里的巨型真菌总是形影不离。记得抬头，那小家伙说不定现在正盯着我们呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Stover: a kind of proto-Kubrow. When grouped in a pack they are relentless opponents. I once asked 'why 'Stover'?' and was told it was because they're dumb as a stove, run hot... and having one on top of you ruins your day. Remember this: if you walk into a cave system that feels too warm, get out. Stover den.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 炽托法是一种原始库狛。它们要是成群结队，会是极其难缠的对手。我曾经问别人「为什么它们叫炽托法？」他们说，因为它们像炉子一样蠢，脾气像炉子一样火爆……遇到一只能让你难受一天。记住：如果你走进洞穴，觉得里面热得反常，赶紧跑。那是炽托法的巢穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Check the caves. Stovers are near-blind but hear fantastically well and don't take kindly to intruders. And they're beefy as hell so you'll need to tranq them more than once. Hopefully before you get mauled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 去洞穴里找。炽托法近乎全盲，但听觉极其灵敏，而且对闯入领地的家伙也绝不客气。此外，它壮得离谱。最好赶在你被撕碎前，多开几枪麻醉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Good news: Stovers are nearly blind. Bad news: they hear well enough to make up for it, don't like intruders and will take multiple shots to tranquilize. So… don't mess about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好消息是，炽托法几乎是瞎子。坏消息是，它的听觉完全可以弥补这一点。它讨厌入侵者，还得挨上好几发麻醉弹才会倒下。所以……小心些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Stovers: cave dwellers. Bad eyesight, excellent hearing, highly territorial. Hardy, so you'll need more than one shot to put them down. And they're aggressive. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 炽托法是穴居动物。视力极差，听觉极佳，领地意识极强。它们皮糙肉厚，想放倒光一枪可不够。而且攻击性很强。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Check the caves and remember: they investigate sound. Also: you'll need to tranq the animal a few times before they go down. They're… impressively proportioned. They're basically a bicep with a face if I'm honest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 搜寻洞穴时记住：它们会循着声音找来。此外：你得连中几发麻醉弹，才能放倒它们。它们的体格……相当强壮。老实说，简直就是一块长了张脸的肱二头肌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The mating call of a Virmink. They're capable hunters of smaller prey, but will turn tail and run at first sight of something as formidable as yourself. You'll find Virmink loping across the plains or lying in wait amongst the giant fungi, stalking Pobbers. Now, where is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 是弗鸣克的求偶叫声。它们擅长捕猎小型动物，但一看到像你这样有威胁的家伙，绝对掉头就跑。弗鸣克经常在平原地带出没，或者潜伏在巨型真菌附近捕捉泡博。那么，它究竟藏在哪呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You don't know how lucky you are my rare little friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你知不知道你有多幸运，小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Upon awakening the coolant towers, and the great geophysical upheavals that followed, new life emerged. This Bolarola, for example, a rare Black-Banded variant seen almost nowhere else. Fascinating. What this place must have been, once upon a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们唤醒冷却塔后，剧烈的地质变化给这个山谷带来了新的生命。就比如说，这只黑带波雷罗拉。这个品种在其他地方几乎从来没有出现过。啊，它真漂亮。这个地方在古代该有多美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Feisty. We're lucky to have found this one before some wandering Sawgaw, or worse, did. These rare breeds need protection more than most.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它真活泼。看来我们很幸运，赶在某只游荡的梭歌，或者别的东西之前找到了它。这是个稀有的品种，尤其需要保护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Spotted Bolarola. Happy little thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 斑点波雷罗拉，快活的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A yes, the Spotted Bolarola. Let's bring it in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，没错。斑点波雷罗拉。带它回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Spotted. A somewhat common subspecies, this one. Such a sweet face, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 斑点波雷罗拉。算是比较常见的亚种。看它的脸蛋多可爱，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A species I've only heard tell of in legend. What a prize! Ha ha!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我只在传说里听过这个物种。无价之宝！哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Incredible. Just look at the way its defensive plating has evolved to include an offensive component! Not many have ever seen a Thorny Bolarola. Well done, Outworlder! Well done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不可思议。快看它的防御甲片，居然进化出了兼具攻击性的倒刺！没多少人亲眼见过尖角波雷罗拉。干得好，异世者！干得好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Plates, barbs, and an iridescent sheen to enhance mate attraction. Outworlder, you've found an exceedingly rare specimen here! Oh, this is fascinating! Well done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 护甲、倒刺，还有一层用来吸引配偶的虹光。异世者，你找到了极其稀有的个体！噢，太迷人了！干得好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Female.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 雌性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Dappled Horrasque! You're quite the handsome specimen aren't you? Yes you are. Yes you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 斑纹惑瓦斯克！长得可真俊，是不是呀？对，说你呢，俊得很。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The common Dappled Horrasque. Lovely. Let's bring them in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 常见的斑纹惑瓦斯克。不错，带它回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Common subspecies. And quite a pleasing mottling to this one, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 常见的亚种。这身斑纹倒很漂亮，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hunted to near extinction, the rarest of all Horrasques, yet it perseveres. Singular.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 被捕杀至近乎灭绝，惑瓦斯克中最稀有的物种，如今仍然存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The rarest of the rare. A Horrasque Stormer. I admit, I never thought to see one again. And we have brought it to safety. I must secure it a mate as quickly as possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 暴猛惑瓦斯克，稀世罕见。我承认，从来没想过自己能再见到一只，我们必须把它带到安全地带。我必须尽快给它寻个配偶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Unbelievable. Exquisite. A Horrasque Stormer, Outworlder, I wouldn't have thought it possible. Dazzling. Wondrous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 难以置信，无与伦比。异世者，这是一只暴猛惑瓦斯克。我不是在做梦吧，简直是奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: This one's a bit of a rarity. Let's keep them safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 罕见的品种，得好好保护它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: They say Swimmer Horrasques don't make mistakes. I've seen one explode from beneath the water to take down prey twice their size. Terrifying and yet… awe-inspiring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 据说游水惑瓦斯克从不失手。我曾亲眼见过一只从水下干倒比自己大两倍的猎物。令人胆寒，却又……叹为观止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A rare Swimmer Horrasque. Not conventionally pretty, I'll grant you. But remarkably graceful in its chosen environment. Exquisite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只稀有的游水惑瓦斯克。该说不说，按传统审美它算不上好看。不过一踏进熟悉的水域，它的动作便无比高雅。优美至极。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Brindle Kubrodon, and quite a hardy specimen at that. Wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 斑纹库狛顿，这只看上去体格健壮。真是太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Kubrodon is misunderstood. They're no more savage than anything else, when home is threatened, it possesses the means to defend. They don't even like how we taste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 库狛顿总被人误解，家园受到威胁时，它们和任何生物一样都会反击，并不比别的动物更凶残。而且，它其实也不喜欢我们的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Such dignity. A reasonably common variant of the apex predator, distilled to its purest form.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 威风凛凛。虽是较为常见的变种，却把这种顶级掠食者的特征展现得淋漓尽致。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Monstrous, but worthy of life nonetheless. Thank your lucky stars it was we who found you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它很凶残，但也有活下去的权利。小家伙，还好是我们先找到了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We have captured a devil, Outworlder. Future generations may question our wisdom, but I have taken an oath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 异世者，我们抓住了一个恶魔。后世可能会质疑我们的决定，但我发过誓要保护所有动物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The implacable hatred one species bears toward the other who usurped it positively radiates from this one. I shall be handling this particular specimen… carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个物种对夺走其家园的入侵者有根深蒂固、无法消解的仇恨。处理它时……我会格外小心的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: This one's a rare thing these days, and never outside the Vallis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个变种如今十分少见，而且从未在山谷外发现过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Once an Orokin playground, perhaps, the Vallis is a discarded crown overgrown with fungus and flora, now home to little fellas such as this. The Vallis Kubrodon. Glorious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这座山谷以前可能曾是奥罗金的游乐场，这里长满了真菌和各种植被，而现在已经成了一群小家伙赖以生存的家园了。山谷库狛顿，真美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Spectacular. And with enough mandibular strength to snap your femur clean in half, had it a mind to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 太惊人了，它的下颌力量很强。如果它真想下口，能把你大腿咬成两截。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Male.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 雄性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Fully developed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 发育完全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Mature.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 成年个体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A fully-grown specimen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它已经成年了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Settle down little friend. Settle down. We're almost done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别怕，小家伙。放松，马上就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Just a little worse for wear but we can see to that. Nicely done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 受了一点皮外伤，我们能把它治好的。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Mmm. Clear-eyed and in good health. Excellent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯。眼神清澈，体征良好。太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You've caught us a wild one, friend. Quite a handful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，你抓到了一只野性十足的家伙。确实很难应付。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Easy now. Parasites, cracked footpads… nothing some attention and a good meal won't fix. Well done, Outworlder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 放松。寄生虫，脚掌开裂……悉心照料再加上一顿饱饭，很快就能好起来。做得好，异世者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh... they. Are. Beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 噢……它，太美了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Now then. Vitals are solid. I'll take it from here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 很好。生命体征稳定。接下来就交给我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Easy now, sweet thing. We're going to take good care of you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别紧张，小家伙。我们会好好照顾你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You've done a noble thing here, friend. This one might be a little cranky, but they owe you their life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，你做了一件值得敬佩的事。它或许脾气不太好，但它这条命是你救下来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: And oh. I see now this one needs medical attention, and soon. You got to them just in time. I will see to this immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 噢，不妙，这家伙现在急需治疗，刻不容缓。你找到它的时机刚刚好。我马上处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah. A Delicate Pobber. A descendant of an Orokin domesticated strain. A rare find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，一只精巧泡博。奥罗金时代驯化品种的后代。难得的发现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Delicate Pobber! A rare breed! Just marvelous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 精巧泡博！稀有品种！太神奇了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: An ancient Orokin legacy strain. Quite rare. I'll be sure to take extra special care of our new friend. Yes I will, lovely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这是古老的奥罗金品种。很稀有。我会格外小心照顾这个新朋友的。别担心，小可爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hello, my cute little friend, you're in good hands now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你好呀，小可爱，你现在安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Note the adaptations for belowground survival, away from the claws of Sawgaw and Virmink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好好看看它。看来它为了躲避梭歌和弗鸣克，适应了地底生活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Mmm. Upon awakening the coolant towers new life emerged. Genetic material carried, I believe, in the coolant itself… interacting with some ancient hidden component of the Orokin Vallis landscape. Life was seeded, quite literally, across its length and breadth. And here, now, we see the next stage of that emergence and evolution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯……冷却塔被唤醒后，新的生命随之出现。我认为在冷却液中包含着遗传物质……它在这座奥罗金山谷中与某些古代构造接触，产生了反应。它把生命播撒到山谷的每个角落。在此，我们见证了生命繁衍和演化的全新阶段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Sunny Pobber. Slightly less common than your garden variety but a happy little thing nonetheless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 阳光泡博，比普通品种要稍微罕见一点。真是个乐天的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Fairly common but lovely coloration.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 很常见，但颜色很可爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: In no danger of extinction this one, but a life is a life is it not?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它倒没有灭绝的危险，不过能救一只是一只，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Just look at it. Magisterial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 看看它。威风大气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hardy. Formidable. Gorgeous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 强壮。凶猛。华丽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: What Corpus or noble wouldn't give a fortune to have this magnificent avian confined to a gilded enclosure in some distant villa. You've preserved a rare and magnificent thing this day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 科普斯富商和贵族，愿意花大价钱把这威风凛凛的飞禽关到偏僻别墅的镀金笼子里。你今天保护了一头珍禽异兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Flossy Sawgaw. Very pretty. A fine catch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 丝绵梭歌。真漂亮，你真走运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Flossy Sawgaw. Sometimes prized for its feathers. Safe now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 丝绵梭歌。它们有时会因为羽毛而遭人猎捕。现在它安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: While their vision is remarkable, when it comes to mating the Sawgaw appreciate the tactile more than the visual. Delightful plumage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 虽然梭歌的视力非凡，但在求偶时，它们其实更注重触感而非外表。这身羽毛是真漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Corpus ravage their populations in the name of short-term profit, yet here the rarest, most exquisite of them survives… albeit barely. The Frogmouthed Sawgaw. A thing I'd only ever seen in books. Safe now. This one, at least.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 科普斯为了眼前的蝇头小利大肆屠戮它们，然而它们之中最稀有、最精美的品种却幸存了下来……尽管濒临灭绝。蛙嘴梭歌，我还以为只能在书里看到它们。至少，这一只安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Frogmouth Sawgaw. I wouldn't have thought it possible, Outworlder. This species hasn't existed since before my grandfather was a boy. And yet here it is. Miraculous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 蛙嘴梭歌。异世者，我做梦也想不到。这个物种在我爷爷小时候就绝迹了，而今天它就在这里。真是奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Extinct for generations. And yet here it is, now, and Nef's first instinct would be to display it stuffed in his boardroom. I will treat this one with the utmost care and find a mate... if a counterpart exists anywhere on this planet. The future demands nothing less of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它们消失了数代之久，可如今它又出现在这里。如果是奈富，第一反应肯定是把它做成标本，摆在自己的会议室里。我会竭尽全力照料这一只，还会给它找配偶……前提是这个星球上还能找到它的配偶。未来就掌握在我们手中了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Tough and cranky. A very lucky find!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 强壮又暴躁。你运气真不错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A rare Dax Stover of the Fuming variety. I may have to use a sedative, unfortunately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只罕见的禁卫炽托法。抱歉朋友，恐怕得多给你用点镇静剂了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Fuming Dax Stover. Rare. And angry. Special care will be taken transporting this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 燃烟禁卫炽托法。稀有，还暴躁。运送它时得格外小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: How can you not admire such noble bearing, even in one so brutish. Wondrous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 虽然它有点野蛮，但你又怎能不赞叹它的高贵呢。真是太美妙了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: This specimen would have been central to the entire den. Right now the pack will be choosing a new leader, butting and roaring for superiority. Might help us find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个物种此前无疑是整个巢穴的核心。现在，它的族群大概正在争夺新首领的位置。打斗和咆哮声应该会此起彼伏。我们可以借此找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: With this specimen secured, I have all I need to begin a new breeding colony. Today, we have safeguarded the future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有了这个样本，我们便具备了建立全新繁育基地所需的一切。可以说，我们今天保住了这个物种的未来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sentinel Stover. Must be a den nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哨兵炽托法，附近肯定有巢穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sentinel Stover. I'll send out a party, see if we can find its packmates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哨兵炽托法。我会派出小队，看看能不能找到它的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sentinel Stover. It would have been keeping watch for its pack. Look at it: such a proud bearing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哨兵炽托法。它们为自己的族群站岗放哨。看看它多神气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Dusky-Headed Virmink, favored by the Corpus for their pelts. Lucky we found them first. A rare find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 灰首弗鸣克，科普斯喜欢它的毛皮。很幸运，是我们先找到了它。比较稀有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A rare Dusky-Headed Virmink! Just look at the gloss on that coat! Gorgeous. Just gorgeous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只稀有的灰首弗鸣克！快看那身毛皮的光泽！美极了。真漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nef would have given quite a bit for your hide my pretty little thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 奈富绝对愿意开天价来换你的皮毛，可爱的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A subspecies extinct since the age of the Orokin. Dare I hope there are others? This specimen will be tended with the greatest of care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个亚种自从奥罗金时代之后就灭绝了。会不会还有其他同类存在？我们必须以最高规格来照顾它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Vallis lifeforms emerged like memories, as Venus herself remembered who she was. This, here, is one of the most distant, most precious remembrances - an original Orokin strain, unseen for millennia. And Nef would have it ground down to make nutrient paste. Another sacrifice to short-term thinking. To profit. To that I say no. I say never.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 山谷中的生命不断从记忆涌现，一如金星逐渐找回了她的过去。这就是其中一段最古老、最珍贵的记忆——原始的奥罗金品种，已经上千年没被发现过了。而愚昧的奈富只想把它抓去做成营养剂。目光短浅、急功近利。我不赞同他的做法，永远不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I never thought, in all my wildest imaginings, I would behold a subspecies crafted in the gene forges of the Orokin themselves. But here it is. The Red-Crested Virmink. A miracle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我从未设想过，有一天能亲眼看到它。奥罗金人亲自改造的物种，红冠弗鸣克。而现在，它就在我眼前。简直是个奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A White-Breasted Virmink. Fairly common. And lively!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 白胸弗鸣克，比较常见。而且精神得很！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A common variation. Such noble bearing. Let's get them to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 常见的变种。动作优雅。把它带到安全的地方吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The White-Breasted is a popular pet, when they can be tamed. Not for this one though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 白胸品种在被驯化后很受欢迎。不过这只显然不打算给谁当宠物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hm. Quite young.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯，还很年轻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A juvenile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只幼体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Just a pup, this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 还是个小宝宝呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Blast. We've lost them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 该死，我们跟丢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: They've eluded us. I only hope they find somewhere warm until we meet again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它把我们甩掉了。希望我们下次再相遇之前，它能找到一个温暖的住处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Outsmarted. Damn it all. Wily little thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 被摆了一道。真见鬼。狡猾的小家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We've lost them, Outworlder. Let's regroup… and try again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 跟丢了，异世者。我们重整旗鼓……再试一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Failure. Happens to the best of us. We'll have other chances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 搞砸了。谁都有失手的时候，以后还有机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Curses. I can almost hear that little bugger laughing. Oh well. Next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 晦气。我几乎都可以听到那个小混蛋在笑。算了，下次再来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Easy come easy go. Still: we persist. They'll not evade us for long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 来得容易去得也快。不过，我们要坚持下去。它躲不了多久的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: And there they go. Next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它跑了。下次吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Vanished. You have to admire their resilience. Ah well. We'll be back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 消失了。不得不佩服它的生存本领。罢了，我们会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Not today, Outworlder. The field is theirs. Let's withdraw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 今天运气不好，异世者。这里是它们的地盘。撤退吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah, well. If the little fella wants to remain here that badly we can't hold it against them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，好吧。既然这小家伙这么想留在这儿，我们也不强求了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Track-and-tranq: the basis of our conservation efforts. Now, what are you short on?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 追踪和麻醉是我们保育工作的基础。好，你还缺哪样装备？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Track the beast, lure it out, then subdue it with a well-placed tranquilizer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 追踪目标，用诱饵把它引出来，再找准位置，用麻醉弹制服它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You get paid, and we save something rare from Corpus… 'scientists'. Stay downwind, and aim true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你拿酬劳，而我们能从科普斯那帮所谓的……「科学家」手中救下珍稀动物。守在下风口，瞄准些再开枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: When we woke the Orokin terraforming engines we also revived species long since extinct. I need your help to save these beasts from the Corpus' Feed and Research Division… 'scientists'. Track-and-tranq. Now: let's get you sorted out with a tranq rifle and echo lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 当我们重启奥罗金星球改造引擎时，也唤醒了一些早已灭绝的物种。我需要你帮忙拯救这些动物，不要让它们被科普斯的饲育与研究部门那些所谓的……「科学家」抓到。要领是追踪，然后麻醉。好，现在先给你备齐麻醉枪和回声诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh, a Dappled Horrasque! What a handsome fellow he is. Let's bring him in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 噢，一只斑纹惑瓦斯克！长得可真俊俏。把它带回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Would you look at that. Outworlder. A Horrasque Stormer. Hunted to near extinction for the insulating properties of its fur. I never thought to see one again. We must bring this magnificent beast in safely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 快看呐，异世者。一只暴猛惑瓦斯克。因为皮毛极其保暖，它们曾被捕杀至濒临灭绝。我从没有想过这辈子还能再见到一只。我们必须把这大家伙平安带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Horrasque favor bodies of water, what with their mainly fish diet, but they're not especially good swimmers. This particular subspecies, however, is. A bit of a rarity. Let's keep him safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 惑瓦斯克喜欢水域，毕竟它们主要以鱼类为食，但它们本身不怎么擅长游泳。不过这个亚种却很擅长，比较罕见。把它安全带回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Enough! The intention is to aid these poor animals, not kill them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 住手！我们的目的是要帮助这群可怜的动物，不是杀了它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Do you perhaps think yourself on safari? We are here to capture and preserve. Outworlder! Holster your weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你以为自己在游猎吗？我们的目标是捕捉和保护动物。异世者！把武器收起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Track-and-tranq. Tranq. Do you understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 追踪。然后麻醉。是麻醉。听明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Brindle Kubrodon, and quite a hardy specimen at that. Wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 斑纹库狛顿，这只看上去体格健壮。真是太棒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Now there's something to give the children nightmares. The legendary Kubrodon Incarnadine: the canine equivalent of the monster in your closet. Possessed of a particular malevolence, a dark intelligence, it kills not to survive, but for the raw pleasure of doing so. Nonetheless, I have tasked myself with preservation… so we will bring this devil in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这家伙足够让孩子连做几晚噩梦了。传说中的血红库狛顿，堪称犬类中的终极梦魇。它本性凶残，非常狡猾。它杀戮并非为了生存，而是单纯享受血腥的快感。尽管如此，保育物种是我的职责……把这个恶魔也带回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah. This old fellow. I've encountered a few of these, but never outside the Vallis. As such, unimaginatively, I've named them the Vallis Kubrodon: our little planet's contribution to the genetic diversity of the Origin system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，这位老朋友。我以前遇到过几只，但从未在山谷以外见过。因此，我也就直接叫它山谷库狛顿了。算是我们这颗小星球，为整个始源星系基因多样性作出的贡献。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ready your tranq and wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 准备好麻醉枪，等待时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Now, we wait for the animal to approach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 现在，我们静候动物接近吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Now, ready your tranq.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好，准备好麻醉枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well done. Now, prepare your tranq rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 干得好。现在，准备好麻醉枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Tranq rifle at the ready...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 麻醉枪准备好……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Perfect. Alright. Shoulder your tranq rifle and make the shot count.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 完美。好了，举起你的麻醉枪，这一枪务必命中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A melodic response. And now, something equally gentle from us. Prepare your tranq, and let's carry this animal to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 回应实在悦耳。现在，我们也要同样温柔。准备麻醉枪，把它安全带回来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Here they come. Ready your tranq rifle, and prepare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它来了。端起麻醉枪，做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Remember. Identify. Inhale. Exhale. And tranq.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 记住要领：锁定目标、吸气、呼气、然后射击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Final stage. When the animal appears aim your tranq well and our work is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 最后一步。等动物现身后，瞄准它开枪，我们的任务就完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah. The moment of truth. Ready your tranq rifle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊。关键时刻到了。准备好麻醉枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yes. Come on out, little friend. A quick and painless tranq shot and it's off to safety with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没错。出来吧，小家伙。扎一下，不疼的。马上就好，然后咱就去安全的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: As you were.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 去忙吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Maybe later, then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那就回头再说吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: All right, well, be careful out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好吧，出门在外，多加小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah. A Delicate Pobber. A descendant of an Orokin domesticated strain. Less odorous, with a sweeter temperament, but far less hardy. A rare find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，一只精巧泡博。奥罗金时代驯化品种的后代。气味较淡，性情温驯，但没有那么健壮。相当罕见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: My word. This little fellow shouldn't be up here. Note the near-white coat, the vibrant pink eyes. He's adapted to survive belowground, away from the claws of Sawgaw and Virmink. We may have found the first uniquely Venusian mutation of the Pobber genus. Astounding!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 天啊！这小家伙根本就不应该在地表。看那近乎全白的毛色，鲜艳的粉红眼睛。为躲避梭歌和弗鸣克的利爪，它已经适应了在地下生活。我们可能发现了泡博属第一个金星特有变种，太神奇了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Sunny Pobber. Slightly less common than your garden variety. Lovely coloration though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只阳光泡博，比常见的品种要稍微稀有些。不过颜色挺招人喜欢的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: All right. Travel safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好。一路小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Stay sharp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 在外小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Keep your face to the wind, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 迎风前行吧，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Alpine Monitor Sawgaw. Quite the Alpha. Hardier and more formidable than the Common and Flossy varieties. This one would have their own little coterie around here somewhere. Perhaps we can find them, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 山地监视梭歌，颇有首领风范。比普通梭歌和丝绵梭歌都更强壮、更凶悍。这品种在附近应该有自己的小族群跟随它。也许我们能找到它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Is that… ? I hadn't dared to hope. Outworlder, I have managed - at great risk - to secure an exceedingly rare Frogmouthed Sawgaw in the hope of someday locating a breeding partner for it. You have just found that mate. Please, very carefully, tranquilize our little friend and bring it in. The future demands this of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这是……？我是在做梦吧。异世者，我曾冒着极大风险，好不容易保全了一只极其稀有的蛙嘴梭歌，就是希望有朝一日能为它寻得繁衍的伴侣。而你刚刚找到了它的另一半。请务必小心，把我们的小家伙麻醉后带回来，这个物种的未来就寄托在我们身上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 就是现在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: It's close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 它靠近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Take a breath, appreciate its beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 深呼吸，好好欣赏它的美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Fuming Dax Stover. Hardier and, frankly, crankier than your typical Sentinel Stover. They tend to boss the others around, ordering the den through brute force and intimidation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 燃烟禁卫炽托法。比一般的哨兵炽托法更强壮。坦白说，脾气也更暴躁。它喜欢当土皇帝，靠着蛮力和恐吓来统治整个巢穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: 'Majestic' isn't a term I often reserve for something as dense and ungainly as Stovers, but for this magnificent creature I'll make an exception. I wonder why it's out here? Let's not question this bizarre good fortune. Tranquilize it and let's get it to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我一般不会用「威严」这个词来形容炽托法这种迟钝笨重的生物。但对眼前这个高贵的生物，我可以破个例。它为什么会出现在这里？算了，没必要去质疑我的好运。把它麻醉，送去安全地带吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sentinel Stover. Must be a den nearby. Bring it in. I'll send out a party, see if we can find its packmates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哨兵炽托法，附近肯定有巢穴。带回来吧。我会派一支小队出去，看看能不能找到它的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Dusky-Headed Virmink, favored by the Corpus for their pelts. She's lucky we found her first. A rare find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只灰首弗鸣克，科普斯喜欢它的毛皮。很幸运，是我们先找到了它。这可是稀有品种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Is that… ? Outworlder. That is a Red-Crested Virmink, a subspecies extinct since the age of the Orokin. It must have lain preserved here, revived along with the Orb Vallis. Dare I hope there are others? We must preserve this specimen! We must!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那是……？异世者，这是一只红冠弗鸣克，这个亚种自奥罗金时代结束后就灭绝了。它之前一定是被封存在这片冰雪下，直到奥布山谷复苏，才一同被唤醒。是否还有其他同类存在？我们必须把它保护起来！保护好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A White-Breasted Virmink. Fairly common. Let's get him to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只白胸弗鸣克，挺常见的。快带它到安全地点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A mating call excellently performed… but… that's the wrong lure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 求偶叫声模仿得相当完美，不过……你拿错诱饵了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Wrong lure. You'll need to match their call, if you want to get their attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 诱饵不对。想吸引它的注意，就必须模仿对应的叫声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You've chosen the incorrect lure, Outworlder. A common mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你选错了诱饵，异世者。这是很常见的失误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Used to be you had a problem you came to me. Now… I just sell fishing gear. Little Duck told me I was going soft, but a quiet life isn't so bad. I recommend it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 以前，谁遇上麻烦都会来找我。而现在……我只管贩卖渔具。小鸭子说我变得心软了，但平静的生活也不错。你也可以试试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I wasn't always about the… preservation of life - more the strategic deletion of it. Conservation... is my calling, now. The scales... need balancing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我以前并不热衷于……保护生命，而是更偏向于有战略性地清除生命。保育……是我现在的使命。有些失衡……需要被纠正。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: She looks peaceful out there. But she'll turn. Prepare for that inevitability.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 山谷看着风平浪静，但她随时会翻脸。准备迎接宿命吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I've a soft spot for Fortuna. Good people dealt a bad hand. I try to help when I can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我对福尔图娜情有独钟。这里的好人却偏偏没好报。但凡力所能及，我都愿意帮一把。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I think the time's come to dispense with formality, to meet eye-to-eye. This is who I am, friend. Pleased to meet you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 时候差不多了，省去客套，敞开聊吧。朋友，这就是我，幸会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, hello. How have you been keeping?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 噢，你好。最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well well. Good to see you. Let's talk, you and I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，是什么风把你吹来了。来，我们聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, look who it is. Keeping warm, I trust? If you're heading out, we should have ourselves a talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 呀，瞧瞧谁来了。没冻着吧？要是准备出门，咱们最好先聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Eudico lost a lot of friends the first time SU was crushed - blames herself. Zuud may be the one hearing voices, but Eudico… she's the one with ghosts. I'm glad you're with us. We need you. She needs you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 索联第一次被镇压时，尤迪科失去了很多朋友，她很自责。祖德脑海里挥之不去的是声音，可缠着尤迪科的……是亡魂。很高兴你能站在我们这边。我们需要你。她也需要你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Legs makes me laugh. Anyone who can do that is twice as valuable as any soldier or saboteur. Look out for him. Kid deserves better than this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 腿哥总能逗我笑。能做到这一点的人，比任何士兵和特工都难得。帮我照顾好他，这孩子配得上更好的生活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I've trained many. None possessed Little Duck's aptitude for spycraft. But we differed in philosophy. That, ultimately, was our end. I don't regret much, but I regret that. I do regret that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我教过不少人，但论谍报工作的天赋，谁都比不上小鸭子。但我们观念不和，最终分道扬镳了。我这辈子很少感到后悔，但那件事……我确实后悔了。真的很后悔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I was there when we lost Zuud's sisters. For a lifetime they shared a sensorium, created as one. Losing them crushed Zuud, her universe narrowing to a single set of eyes, one pair of hands. The isolation broke her, remade her. A tragic figure, to be sure and loved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 祖德的姐妹牺牲时我就在场。她们生来就是一个整体，一生共享着同一套感官。她们的死彻底压垮了祖德。她的整个世界，最后只剩下一对眼睛和一双手。那份孤独逼疯了她，也彻底重塑了她。她的一生确实是场悲剧……但她也一直被人爱着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I prefer not to talk about myself. An old habit, from another time. You understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我不太想提起自己的过往。老习惯了，当年留下的毛病。你懂的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Boon, Roky, and their assembled orphan tribe. Troublemakers, but they're just getting by. I can't begrudge anyone who has to live in the vents - though I do wish they had better taste in music. 'Skeg,' is it? Sounds like a bag of hammers being thrown down a flight of stairs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 阿布、小洛和他们那群孤儿很会惹麻烦，但也只是为了糊口。我没法苛责一群只能住在管道里的孩子——但我倒真希望他们能提升一下音乐品味。「管道乐」是吧？听起来就像是一整袋铁锤被劈里啪啦扔下楼梯的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: When you've apprehended a Servofish, bring it to me, and we can decide what best to do with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 等你捕获了伺服鱼，把它带给我，然后我们再决定如何处置它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Servofish serve a purpose, to a point, but like almost any introduced species they've gone too far. Every Servofish you remove from the reservoirs brings us closer to environmental rehabilitation. Bring them to me, here, and we can put them to better use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 伺服鱼在一定程度上的确起了作用，但就像绝大多数外来物种一样，它们有些繁衍过头了。你从冷却池中移走的每一条伺服鱼都能让我们朝生态修复更进一步。把它们带给我，我们能妥善处置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Once you've caught an Servofish or two bring them here. They could be useful for parts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 捞上一两条伺服鱼之后就带到这来吧。它们的零件能派上大用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Cheknah sis, glinty thinks his kickin' terminal. Nosegrab, bombed the landin', washed out hard and hit skin for a stretch. Came up livid! Hahahah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哟，老姐，闪闪以为自己玩得多极限呢。结果鼻子一抓，落地砸锅，摔了个大马趴，脸刹着陆。爬起来气得脸都绿了！哈哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Fancy. Whatcha doin'? Got biz?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 穿得挺炫，干嘛来的？谈生意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Skill don't mean nah lookin' like you dressed by mumsie. Get your crew decked, look the part. Ain't nobody respectin' a pack a fish-lookin' null-units.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 穿得土里土气，技术再好也没用。把你那帮兄弟拾掇出点样子，穿出范儿。谁瞧得上一群死鱼脸废柴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Bah-bah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拜咯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Problem is, see, people are too rich. Not enough to go 'round. That's why we're down this hole.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 问题是，有些人太有钱了，剩下的人就不够分了。所以我们才得窝在这个通风管道里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Drop 'em down a hole.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 把他扔进窟窿里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You could bigflip off an Orb Mother, come down flair and smilin', but it's aaaaall idiot shivers for the crowd you dress bad, sis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 就算你从圆蛛头上玩个空翻，落地完美，也只有傻子才会给你喝彩。因为你的衣品实在太差，老姐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Word is Nef's gonna sweep the ducts, net up all the Ventkids. Sortin' merk-merks for the job. They's a special unit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 据说奈富要清扫管道，把通风小子一网打尽。他正为这差事调集雇佣兵呢，那可是一支特种部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Gonna net us all up, make us work deep deep down we ain't wily. Nef don't like no Ventkids an' he don't like no skeg neither.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 他要把我们一网打尽，让我们去最底下当苦工，我们又不傻。奈富不喜欢通风小子，他也不喜欢管道乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Skeggin' it up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 来点管道乐？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: He's gettin' by hard, same as us. Ain't no self-pity in there, neither. Just grit. Scope it clean and you'll klokkit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 他也过得很不容易，跟我们一样。但他从来不卖惨，全凭骨气硬扛。你仔细一看就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Arright, klokkit! I say go, ya floor it. Time kicks off once you hit that first marker. Ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好，抓紧时间！我说走，你就走。碰到第一个标记就开始计时。准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Rules are simple: timer starts once you hit the first marker. Now, let's see whatya packin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 规则很简单：到达第一个标记就开始计时。来吧，让我看看你的真本事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Works like this: hit the marker, the timer starts. Vapor trail, chek? Ya bomb and ya done. Ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 规则很简单：抵达标记，开始计时，你就全速冲。摔倒就出局。准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ssh ssh, we got a player. Howzit, Glinty! We got a time record on this stretch. Test it ta best it, chekchek? You game?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嘘，嘘，来熟人了。嘿，闪闪！这条赛道我们保持着纪录。想不想试试，懂我意思吧？搞一把？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh! Howzit Glinty! We fast. You faster? Drop a board and let's see you beat this loop. Haha, haha. C'mon, let's give em a chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哟！咋样闪闪！我们超快，你能更快吗？下板跑一圈，瞧瞧你的本事。来吧，给人家一个机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Glinty! Feelin' fast and fancy? Faster'n us? Drop a plank and flash some terminal skills, chekchek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 闪闪！觉得自己很快很帅？比咱们还快？下板秀下技术，懂不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Boon still owns this loop, beh-beh. Win or lose!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不管输赢，这圈场地还是我阿布说了算！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I gots ta chekkity-chek the mods on that deck!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我得看看你那块板子上装了什么高级模组！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Don't choke, beh-beh! Wash out and ya chek out!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别掉链子，宝贝儿！一翻车你可就直接出局了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Lord a the Board! Boon! Lord a the Board! Boon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 滑板之王！阿布！滑板之王！阿布！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: HAHAHA! Bomb! Wipeout! Get up! Do it again! HAHAHAHA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哈哈哈！太逊！翻车！爬起来！再来一次！哈哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Koo-bro-dons! Koo-bro-dons! Koo-bro-dons!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 库狛顿！库狛顿！库狛顿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You's a lucky mucker an' no mistake. Skin a ya teeth, Glinty!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 算你走狗屎运。险胜呀，闪闪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ya, don't get smug. You did fine but chek no flair. You scored that one, but I'm still king.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行了先别得意。你技术还行，但一点范儿都没有。这把算你赢，但滑板王还是我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nothin' fancy, but got it done. Ya plank okay for a glinty mucker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没什么花活，但好歹跑完了。你板子玩得还算凑合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Still up? Maybe you ain't shammin' flair. Huh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 还没翻车？看来你还真有点本事。呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ain't over 'til it's necked, beh-beh. I still got the record here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 还没完呢，宝贝儿，最快纪录还是我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You been practicin', Glinty?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 最近没少练吧，闪闪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oi! Fancy! We gonna do this or what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂！花架子！到底还玩不玩了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: While we're young, chek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 趁咱们还年轻，懂？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Cold feet, I reckon. They picked the place for it. Hahahaha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我看是临阵腿软了。地方倒是挑得挺应景。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: NAHSKEGGIDUP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 都给我燥起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: No testin' no bestin'! Lord a the Board! Boon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不练不强！滑板之王！阿布！布！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yeah, the more ya age the more ya beige. S'why I'm never gettin' that old. Boon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 人嘛，老了就蔫儿了。活到半截入土我也算够本了。阿布！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, Can't say nah bout your skills, but I do like your rags. Keep 'er shiny side up, Glinty!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好吧，你的技术我不知道，但我还挺喜欢你这身行头的。帅翻他们，闪闪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ha ha! Klokked it. Fish-lookin' null-unit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哈哈！看懂没，死鱼脸废柴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oof. Idiot shivers all 'round. Ya bombed that one, Glinty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哎哟，大家都替你捏把汗。这把玩砸了，闪闪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Put in the hours, Glinty. You'll get there. Hahahaha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 多练练，闪闪。你总有一天会成功的。哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Boom!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嘭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nice form. Let's see you keep it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 姿势不错。看看你能撑多久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: First marker gone bah-bah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 第一个标记，拜咯！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Flair! Terminal! Smooth! Chekchekchek!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 够绝！够帅！够丝滑！懂懂懂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You stylin' like a ventkid! Who's you logical fam? Where you hangin'? Got tips?
