/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你和通风小子一样棒！你平时都和谁混？平时在哪混？有没有诀窍？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You ain't fancy, Glinty. You terminal. You got moves, beh-beh!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你不是帅，闪闪。你是酷毙了。身手太绝了，宝贝儿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A Flossy Sawgaw. Pretty little thing… as long as you're not a rodent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一只丝绵梭歌。真漂亮……幸好我们不是啮齿类动物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Choice paralysis, matey?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 选择困难症犯了，朋友？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: First time putting one a these together?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 第一次组装这些玩意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Fortune favors the bold, matey. Just pick somethin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 富贵险中求，朋友。快决定吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Tab A into Slot B and… there we go. One amp, as requested. Maybe just step outside before you fire that up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个，插到这里……搞定。你要的增幅器。要是想试试的话，记得到外面再用哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh…... kay. Okay. Right. Here y'go. Good luck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯……好。搞定了。给你。祝你好运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I think I'm getting better at this! And they told me I needed 'training'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我感觉我的手艺进步了！他们还说让我去多「练练」呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Okeydoke. You choose the bits, and I put 'em together so you can go off and kill people with your brain. I assume that's how these things work. Never been game to try one meself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行。你挑零件，我来组装。然后你就可以出门用意念杀人了。我猜这玩意儿就是这么使的。反正我自己可没胆去试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Quills tell me you need to be careful picking what bits you want. An extension of your will or somethin'. I guess you don't want to go plugging in something unfriendly to your software.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 夜羽说，挑选零件得谨慎些。说什么这是你意志的延伸。我想你也不想有病毒跑到你的软件里吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Amps are powered by the human brain… I guess? So choose wisely, yeah? You wind up with a head full of fried bacon I don't have a lot of ways to air this room out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 增幅器应该……是由人脑驱动的吧？所以得挑仔细点。万一你把脑子烧糊了，我这屋子可不太好散味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Gonna need parts to work with here, friend. Maybe come back when you're good to go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 得有零件才能组装呀，朋友。等你备齐了再来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Wanna pass it on? Right you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 想把它送人？没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh. A giver. Step this way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哦，来捐赠啊。这边走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: If you're sure, matey. No idea what they do with these things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你确定就好。我也不知道他们拿这个去做什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You're a good sort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你是好样的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I'm sure someone'll know what to do with this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 应该有人知道怎么用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Done. So, like, do I give you a receipt… or…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好。需要我给你开张收据……什么的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I don't know what to tell you, matey. Quills are a fussy lot. Won't take any kind of donation if the amp ain't - their words - 'proven.' So. Just FYI, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我不知道该怎么跟你讲，朋友。夜羽很难搞的。用他们的话说，增幅器没经过「实战检验」，就算白捐的也不收。就当我跟你提个醒，好吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well well well. Another Tenno. This ain't my usual line a work, y'understand. I'm not from around here. But I got a fast tractor and know how to jump a rail, so a new friend in Cetus set me up with all... this. Name's Little Duck: fortune hunter, rail agent and the girl your Mumsie warned you about. And, now, somehow, the local Quill-endorsed purveyor of amps and assorted paraphernalia. So, what'll it be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哎哟喂，又来个 Tenno。先说好，我平时不干这行，我也不是本地人。不过我有一艘飞得很快的牵引机，还知道怎么在航道行驶。于是希图斯的一位新朋友，就帮我置办了这些家当。我叫小鸭子，是宝藏猎人、航道特工，还是你妈从小告诫你千万别招惹的坏女孩。现在呢，不知怎么的，我还成为了夜羽钦定的增幅器和各种杂件的本地供应商。说吧，想要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Amp gilding. Right. Look. If it ain't battle-proven it doesn't get no love. Strict orders. Quills. You know what they're like. "Power, Will, blah blah blah, co-author the future, endings and beginnings nyah nyah nyah" Honestly, I'd never hear the end of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 给增幅器镀金。行。要是没经历过实战检验，就别给它镀金。这是夜羽定的死规矩。你知道他们就这德性。「力量、意志、共创未来，终结与开端」，诸如此类，叽里呱啦。老实说，他们能在我耳朵边念叨一辈子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Now she looks right expensive. Don't go wavin' this around, wouldn't do havin' you get stabbed for it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这下它看起来身价倍增。在外面可别瞎显摆，万一被抢了可划不来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Good luck to ya. I'd never be able to relax ownin' somethin' that pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 祝你好运。要是我有这么个宝贝，晚上睡觉都不踏实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Looks like a whole new amp, dunnit? I don't trust 'em. Too... pokey-mindey. I'll stick with the ol' Buzlok. Gimme homing rounds and a crap-eating grin any day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 像脱胎换骨了，对吧？我不太信任那些东西。太……玄乎了。我有我的老巴兹火枪就够了。追踪弹最配我胜券在握的笑容。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ready to dance on some faces?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 要不要去搞点破坏？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: If Solaris United is gonna be what it once was, things need getting done. Run your optics over this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟要想恢复当年的辉煌，我们就必须行动起来。看看这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Feel like gettin' into trouble?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 想惹点麻烦吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We keep meeting like this, people are gonna talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 咱们再这么见面，可要有人说闲话了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Been seein' a lot of your kind since a certain incident with a blind girl and a Void Gate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 自从那个盲眼女孩和虚空传送门闹出风波之后，我就经常见到你们这帮人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well. This is me. What? Didn't expect me to be so pretty? I put in a lot of miles in this rig. Some days it shows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好吧，这就是我。怎么了？没想到我这么漂亮？我这副身体用了很久了。确实能看出有点年头了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Spoke to The Business, lately? How is he? Does he ever…? Nevermind. You and me, we need to talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 最近见过「操盘手」吗？他怎么样？他有没有……？也没什么。那我们俩好好聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Me old mate. 'Tween you and me, I ain't here just to sell this stuff. There's… somethin' to this place. Somethin' other. I'm stickin' around 'til I crack it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 老朋友。跟你交个底，我留在这里不只是为了卖东西。这地方……有点古怪。有某种不同寻常的东西。没弄明白之前，我哪儿也不去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hotshot! The once and future maker of all trouble. Pull up a pew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 大佬！全世界最能惹麻烦的家伙。过来随便坐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: What kept you, Hotshot?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 大佬，怎么才来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So here we are: just the two of us, and me with somethin' to make your day. Check this out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 现在这里没别的人了。我有些能让你开心一整天的东西。来瞧瞧吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So, apparently, I'm supposed to ask if you want to… name it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好，按规矩，我该问你一声……你要不要给它起个名字？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Onkko said some of you like to name these things? Any requests?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 昂克说你们有些人喜欢给它取名字？有需要吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So, naming is a thing, yeah? Got your heart set on anything?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 起名字很重要是吧？你有钟意的名字没？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey, whatever works.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂，起什么名都行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I dub thee… what they said.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我赐予你名为……刚才说的那个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So, is that, like, a regular name where you come from?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 话说，你老家叫这名的人多吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Probably for the best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不起也好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yeah, just thought I'd ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯，我就随口问问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey, they said to ask, so I'm askin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂，他们让我问问，走个形式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Kid? I got what you're after. I got… oh. Right. Another one. Look. Initiating you into the mysteries of the universe is a bit above my wage bracket, mate. So, piece of advice: get y'self to Cetus, find the Quill. He'll sort you out. OK? Ta ta for now. Poor kid has no idea what they're in for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 孩子？我有你想要的东西。我有……喔，又来一个。听好了，带你参透宇宙奥秘这种事，可不在我的薪水范畴内。朋友，给你个建议：去希图斯找夜羽。他会帮你的，好吗？我先告辞了。可怜的孩子，都不知道自己要面对什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Get to Cetus, find the Quill. Then talk to me. Just find a bloke who looks and sounds like the opposite of normal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 去希图斯找夜羽，然后再来找我。你就直接去找那个满脸写着「不正常」三个字的人就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh, a serious customer are we? Alright then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哟，你诚心想买东西？没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: All right. I'm listening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 说吧，我听着呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Your call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你说了算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: No skin off my proverbial, matey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不买也没事，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Easy come, easy go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 来得快，去得快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Don't get too comfy, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 打起精神来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: See you on the rails.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们航道上见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: See you when I see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 后会有期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Any of this useful?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有看上的东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Authentically hand-crafted by colorful locals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 地道本地货，都是各路奇人纯手工打造的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oi. See anything you fancy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂，有钟意的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Anything else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 还要别的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You've got a deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 成交。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Works for me. All yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行，归你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I deal with people, not machines, mate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，我跟人做生意，不跟机器掰扯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Can't say I like the way you look, if you catch my drift.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我不太喜欢你现在的样子……你懂我意思吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: If you knew who I was, who I represent, you wouldn't have walked in here lookin' like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你要是知道我是谁，我代表谁，那你就不会这副样子走进来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You don't know the Quills. If you knew the Quills, they'd have mentioned your name. You'd best be goin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你根本不认识夜羽。真认识的话，他们肯定会跟我提起你。哪凉快哪待着去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You wanna deal with me? Lose the rig. Know what I mean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 想跟我做买卖？先把这身铁皮脱了。懂吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So you wanna work for Solaris United, huh? You look pretty, but pretty don't mean legit. Could be some two-faced ambidexter in Corpus employ. Get out there, show me you're authentic. 'Til then these ears are off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这么说，你想替索联办事，是吗？长得倒挺顺眼的，可顺眼不代表靠谱。谁知道你是不是科普斯雇来的间谍。去露两手，证明你是真心的。在那之前，免谈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, we are a cove as capable as we are pretty. Copy that. You got your own ship? Own weapons? All right. Keep your ears on, 'cos Solaris U has work for you, Sparky, and lots of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好吧，看来你不只长得顺眼，本事也不差。知道了。你有自己的飞船？自己的武器？行，竖起耳朵听好了，索联有大把活儿给你，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sparky. We got somethin' in the works. Not ready to talk about it yet, though. You keep doin' what you're doin'. We'll have somethin' to discuss soon enough. Mark my words. Somethin' big.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小火花，我们在筹划一件大事。现在还不方便透露。你继续干你该干的活。用不了多久就会告诉你的。记住我的话，搞的是惊天动地的大事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sparky. Receiving? Green. Well, you've got the details. Get going. I'll stay in touch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小火花，能听到吗？很好。细节你都清楚了。出发吧，我会和你保持联络。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sparky. Eudico. You have the brief, you know the gig. Get it done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小火花，我是尤迪科。你收到简报了，该怎么干你心里有数。办妥它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: All set? Good. Then get out there and give us a show.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 都准备好了？很好，那么就去露两手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: There's work, if you want it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有个活儿，想干就来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Make it quick. What's it gonna be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 长话短说，到底是什么事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Outworlder. We gonna do this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 异世者，这活儿到底接不接？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Biz ain't from around here. Or anywhere that I know of. Only gotta hear the accent to clock that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 比兹不是本地人，也不是任何我知道的地方来的。听他那口音就知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Don't let Zuud's attitude skew ya. She's an odd bird, but she'll kit you with a shooter that'll do you proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别被祖德那脾气吓住。她是怪了点，不过她组装的武器肯定能让你满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: SU don't trust easy, and for good reason. But we see you. What you are: family. It's only right you get to see us. This is the face you'll be dealin' with from hereon. It's good to see you with my own eyes. Let's get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 索联从不轻信任何人，理由你也明白。但是我们认可你，你现在是一家人。因此向你展示真容也是理所应当。以后你就要和这张脸打交道了。能亲眼见到你真好。我们开干吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Heeey there, Sparky. Good to see you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嘿哟，小火花。见到你真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey there, Sparky. Got a fresh batch, just came in. You want first pick?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂喂，小火花。刚来了一批新活儿，让你先挑？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sparky! Ugh. Sorry, kid. Thinking about Zuud's sisters. Bad day for bad memories. Enough of that. You're here for work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小火花！呃，不好意思，孩子。刚才想起……祖德的姐妹们了。今天不该提这些伤心事。不提了，你是来接活儿的吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Biz and I go back a long way. Weren't for The Business there'd be no Solaris U. But I don't know you could call us friends. He's Solaris, but he ain't from here. He helps Fortuna, but he's not one of us. Never chose to be. Strange bird, our Biz. I do wonder how he got that accent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我和比兹是老相识了。要是没有「操盘手」先生就不会有索联，但我也不知道我们算不算朋友。他是索拉里斯人，但不是本地人。他帮助福尔图娜，却从没选择成为我们的一员。咱们这个比兹，是个怪咖。我倒挺想知道他那口音是怎么来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sparky! Ha HAAA! Good to see you, kiddo! Step aside you dimwits, let a real doer get on in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小火花！哈，哈哈！很高兴见到你，小子！你们这帮蠢货让开点，给真正干实事的人腾地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Zuud lost her sisters when I… when the Corpus crushed Solaris United the first time. Think that's got anything to do with those voices she hears?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 祖德的姐妹，是在我……在科普斯第一次镇压索拉里斯联盟时死的。你觉得这和她听见那些声音有关吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Business and I go… way back. If courage and integrity is the measure of a person, Biz is the one takin' your inseam. Anyway, roster's full. Help me out here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我和「操盘手」是……老相识了。要是勇气和正直是衡量一个人的标准，那么他就是最严格的标尺。总之，活儿排满了。来搭把手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Little Duck. The Business, he thought the world of her. Didn't get him much in the end. Anyway, you lookin' for work?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小鸭子啊，「操盘手」以前没少替她操心。可到头来，也没落着什么好。话说，你是来找活干的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The most valuable person in your squad ain't the crack shot, it's the kid who keeps your spirits up. That's Legs. The rhymin's a bit much, but can that little mucker make me hoot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 队伍里最值钱的，不是神射手，而是能让大家打起精神的那小子。也就是腿哥。虽然他满嘴顺口溜，但那小混球确实能逗我开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nef wants the Ventkids gone, and I'm wedged between roller and a pit. Stealin' Corpus supplies? Spendin' night-cycles bangin' out music in the walls? My heart bleeds for 'em, but I don't do somethin' Nef's gonna start askin' questions. About me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 奈富想把通风小子赶尽杀绝，而我现在真是左右为难。小子们偷科普斯的物资，整夜躲在墙里玩敲击乐。我是真心疼他们，可我要是完全不管，奈富就会起疑心，而且迟早会怀疑到我头上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Alright. Let me know when you're available.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行，等你有空了随时喊我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Not gonna lie, we could use you, but we made it this far on our own. Get in touch when you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不瞒你说，我们确实用得上你，不过没你，我们也靠自己撑到了现在。以后多保持联络。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Roger that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 收到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: No worries. I've got others on standby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别担心，我安排了其他人待命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Keep your boots tight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Outstandin'. Now get out there and void some muckin' warranties.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你真棒。现在就去把那些机器砸烂吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Anyone asks: we never talked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有人问起，就说咱们从没说过话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Get movin'. We're short-short.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好，动起来，我们时间很紧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Show 'em how it's done, Sparky. We ain't got all cycle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 让他们瞧瞧你的能耐吧，小火花。咱们可没时间去浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Green. An' remember: you never heard of me, you never heard of Solaris U.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 通讯正常。记住：你从没听说过我，也从没听说过索联。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Welcome aboard. We don't got much, but what we have...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 欢迎入伙，我们没多少家底，但我们有的……哼哼

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: All right, let's deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 很好，谈买卖吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: No worries. We got you sorted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别担心，都帮你安排好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Alrighty, let's see what we have for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好了，看看有什么适合你的活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You do have an eye, Sparky. I always say that. That'll serve you mighty fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 眼光确实不错，小火花。我一直这么认为。这东西你肯定能派上大用处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Done and done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 大功告成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Does that conclude our business here, Sparky?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小火花，这就买完了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You help me, I help you. Everybody's happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你帮我，我帮你，皆大欢喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sure, we can talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行，我们聊聊吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Solaris United don't trust easy. But… make good and… we can talk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟从不轻信任何人。不过……你要是能把事办漂亮……那可以再说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Solaris. United. You are not alone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 索拉里斯人，团结起来，你们并不孤单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Temple profits from your labor. Without your labor, then, there is no profit. What is the Temple of Profit without profit? What, then, are the Corpus without us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 润盈殿靠你们的劳动获利。没了你们的劳动，便没有利润可言。没有利润还叫什么润盈殿？没了我们，科普斯又算得了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Taxman teaches that Truth plus Profit equals Life. Solaris United reminds you that, if this is true, then Truth is Life without Profit, and Profit is Life without Truth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 收税佬教导大家，真理加上利润等于生命。索拉里斯联盟提醒各位，如果这话不假，那么追求真相就要舍弃利润，追逐利润就代表无法看清真相。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: How does the Taxman keep you under his boot? Deny you that which you need. Blame the poor for it. And then tell you: working even harder will fix it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 收税佬是如何把你踩在脚下的？剥夺你们赖以生存的必需品。将贫穷怪罪在你们自己头上。然后告诉你，只要加倍努力，一切都会好起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: How often have you sat in the Temple of Profit, as your parts fail and your family starves, looked up at all that gold and grandeur, and wondered if you've been had?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你有多少次坐在润盈殿里，眼看着自己的零件逐渐报废，家人们忍饥挨饿，仰望着那些富丽堂皇的殿厅，心中暗自怀疑自己是不是被骗了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: No other species rents their autonomy. No other species works to own their own body. No other species takes such pride in their enslavement. Solaris divided, we are slaves. Solaris United, we are a force. The future can be different. Believe. Resist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没有哪个物种需要靠劳作来赎回自己的身体，也没有哪个物种会为自己被奴役而感到自豪。索拉里斯，分则蝼蚁，合则洪流。未来是可以改变的。去相信，去反抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: People say MOAs don't got no personality, but it's all in choosing the right components. You take your time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 都说恐鸟缺乏个性，其实关键就在组件怎么搭配。你慢慢挑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I'd offer you a nutrient canister but you don't look like you're hooked up for it and I'm all out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 本想请你喝罐营养液的，不过你应该用不上它，况且我这也刚好断货了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: This is my favorite part, y'know. The parts get chosen, and a little fella gets born from it all. It's all down to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这可是我最喜欢的环节。零件一件件选好，一个小家伙就这么诞生了。全看你的选择咯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Just one more piece and I can get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 再来最后一个零件，我就可以开工啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Need any help with that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 要哥帮你参谋一下吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Last piece. Big moment. Drum roll!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 最后一个零件。大功告成，来点鼓声！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I ain't part of what you might call… a legitimized supply chain. But! Bring in your own gear: heads, engines, payloads - and I'll put together a little buddy for ya quick smart, no questions asked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哥干的确实不算……正规的供应链。但是别担心！只要你自备零件：头部、引擎、负载这些——我就能干净利落地帮你拼个小伙伴出来，绝不多问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I work with salvage. Bring in heads, engines, payloads, and I'm your mucker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哥专门和废旧零件打交道。把头部、引擎和负载带来，剩下的我搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Can't work with what I don't have, cove. Gonna need some parts before have this conversation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 无米难下锅啊，哥们。先弄点零件来，咱们再往下聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: If your ambition is the acquisition of a new addition, I'm just the patrician to hear your submission. Pets? MOAs? We got 'em all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 想给家里添个新丁？尽管把诉求说给腿哥听。宠物？恐鸟？咱这儿样样齐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Look around. Now, don't be shy. Good friends, good buddy, ain't hard to buy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 随便瞧瞧，别害臊。好朋友，好搭档，花点钱就能买到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Step on up, quick-like and snappy. I pay off some debt, you walk away happy. Now whaddya need? MOAs? We got MOAs. Right!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 快来快来，步子要快，我清了债，你笑开怀！需要什么？恐鸟吗？我这管够！对头！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You seem ace, so here's my face. But understand: I just got lucky, and I think you're beautiful just as you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你这样子真够帅，那哥也把真脸亮出来。不过我只是运气好，你已经够帅，根本不用改。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well! I do delight in the sight of my fave-oh-RITE. How are you, friend?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哟！来啦！这不是我最铁的哥们吗？最近怎么样啊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Lookee before me, who's this that I see? The Outworlder! Buddy! Long time absentee! HOW ARE YA BABY?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 瞧瞧我眼前，是谁露的脸？原来是异世者！哥们！好久不见！最近如何？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well hey! It's the familiar killer to whom I love to deliver! Tell me the good news, sweets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哟嚯！这不是我最喜欢的老熟人嘛！有什么好消息吗，宝贝？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I keep tryin' to get Biz to tell me stories, but nothin'. That cove was a real doer back in the day. Eudico'd say "Give 'em The Business" and then things'd get real hectic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我一直想套比兹的话，可是他口风太紧了。那老哥当年可是个狠角色。只要尤迪科说一句「让操盘手去解决」，肯定就有人要倒大霉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: My family didn't make it out the first time Solaris U got stomped. Aw, I know Eudico reckons it's her fault but I don't see it thataway. She's done right by me. Way I see it, she and Zuud? They're my family now. Need anything?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟第一次被血洗的时候，我家里人没能活下来。唉，我知道尤迪科一直觉得那是她的错，可我不这么想。她一直没亏待过我。在我眼里，她和祖德，都是我的家人。今天想买点啥？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Why's Smokefinger always gotta be ridin' me? "Wastin' my youth". Better wastin' my youth hangin' out with awesome robots than talkin' to dirt. Whatever. What can I getcha?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 烟指怎么总跟我过不去？天天唠叨我「浪费青春」。我宁愿浪费青春和机器人玩，也不要玩泥巴。算了，你要点什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sure, why not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好啊，没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Does kinda complete her, don't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 简直绝配，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Welcome to the world, kiddo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 欢迎来到这个世界，孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yeah. She is what she is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没错。她独一无二。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A thing unto herself. Sounds like somethin' The Business would say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 自成一体啊。哈哈，听着倒像「操盘手」会说的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Free to be her own thing. Awright.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 尊重她的自由。妥了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: And that… is that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 大功……告成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: There y'go, little fella. On your feet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 来吧，小家伙。站起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hello beautiful. Nicely put together if I do say so myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你好啊，小可爱。不是我自夸，组装得真不赖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So. She got a name?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那么，你想好名字了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I always like to name 'em. You should name her. What's her name?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哥最喜欢给它们起名了。你也该给她起一个。有想法吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Something this beautiful shouldn't be walkin' around without a name. Anything spring to mind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这么可爱的小家伙，可不能没名没姓地到处晃。想到好名字了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nooo sale. Right. It was the rhyming, wasn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没卖出去。行吧。果然是哥的韵脚有点烂，对不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, I'm also available for parties.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行吧，派对暖场我也能上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Just here for the show?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 合着就是来看表演的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Golden.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 完美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Aaaaand your change.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 来——找你的零钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Here's your manual and bot, so full of potential, instructions for use, you'll find 'em essential. Use it well, this device, g'wan an' have fun. But do check the fine print: there ain't no refunds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 恐鸟到手，潜力也有。说明书要收好，照着看准不愁。拿去好好用，尽管玩个够。不过小字看清楚：售出概不退货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Okay. Okay. I see where you're goin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行，行。哥看懂你的思路了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个好看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ya wanted a Moa since you were protozoa, mechanical friend, fides that are bona. Wait no more cove, my gear's all class, it's the daily special! I only take cash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 看一眼我就知晓，你就惦记着恐鸟，机械好伙伴，忠心又可靠！别等了哥们，我这全是上等货，今日特惠！只收现金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ya know ya want it, this revel's on the level. Bust open that wallet, it's a one time Special!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 心动不如行动，性价比高得没话说。快把钱包掏出来！过了这村就没这店了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A sleek little freak, take a peek, step on up! Critique this physique! Hand-made, hand-designed, one of a kind. For today only. Seriously chic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 小巧又古怪，来瞧个痛快，往前站一站！身板多气派！纯手工，亲手造，全宇宙独一份。今日特供，帅到没边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey there stranger, welcome to the dregs. Don't let it change yer, take it from Legs. Hey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 欢迎到底层，出泥不染尘，就跟哥一样，守住这点真。嘿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: C'mon. Little applause? No? Place like this showmanship should be appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拜托，来点掌声吧？成吗？卖艺都没人捧场，真是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: MOAs. Big, beautiful, faithful and stable. Waitin' for ya here, ready and…! Ah forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 卖恐鸟！高大、威猛、忠诚、稳重。就在这儿等你，随时准备……登场！唉，算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Give unto the Void, and be rewarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 向虚空进献，必得福报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Life is Profit. Profit is Life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 生命即利润，利润即生命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Void be the Word, and the Word be Profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 虚空即福音，福音即利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Clasp hands with us! The Order of Profit is home to all. Clasp hands, and know the ecstasy of a strong return on your Faith!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 让我们并肩同行！润盈教是所有人共同的家园。让我们共同携手，领受信仰带来的厚报，沉醉于无上至福之中！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nef Anyo's Order of Profit welcomes you, off-world philanthropists and entrepreneurs! The Void be the Word, and the Word be Profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 奈富·安尤的润盈教欢迎你们，来自异星的慈善家与企业家！虚空即福音，福音即利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: There is a place for you within the Order of Profit, visitor. Speak to one of our evangelists today! The Void be the Word, and the Word be Profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有缘人，润盈教中必有你的一席之地！今天就去和我们的传教士聊聊吧！虚空即福音，福音即利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Give unto the Void and be rewarded a hundredfold. Clasp hands with the Order of Profit, plant that seed, and watch together as it grows into a mighty tree! Such a broad trunk! Such deep, strong roots! And behold its broad and mighty branches, with which it collects the bountiful rains of fortune! Life is Profit, Profit is Life. The Void be the Word, and the Word be Profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 向虚空进献，必得百倍福报。与润盈教携手，播下利润的种子，让我们一同见证它长成参天大树！瞧那粗壮的树干！瞧那深扎坚固的根系！再仰望那繁茂而有力的枝桠，承接着滚滚而来的财富喜雨！生命即利润，利润即生命。虚空即福音，福音即利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Venus restoration is not progressing fast enough. To lighten your workload, I have instituted a small interest rate hike, which compounds at each cycle. As ever, good and faithful Solaris, the Order's flock receive 15% toward this debt amalgamation. Profit Is Life. Plan today!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 金星复兴工程的进度太慢了。为了减轻各位的工作负担，我决定微微上调一点利率，按每个周期复利计息。一如既往，善良而虔诚的索拉里斯人，只要加入教派的信徒，即可享受 15% 的债务减免。利润即生命。今天就规划未来吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You desire riches, friend? Well, let me tell you, so does your neighbor. What to do? Desire. Riches. More than your neighbor. More than your brother. More than your overseer. Desire, friend, will RAISE you from the muck! Will RAISE you to the stars. Will RAISE you to your rightful place with the faithful, here, in orbit, by my side. Tell me: will I see you soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，你渴望财富吗？其实，你周围的人也和你一样。那该怎么办呢？去渴望，去追求财富。比身边的人更富有，比兄弟更富有。比监工更富有。朋友，欲望会把你从泥潭中托起！托举你飞向群星！托举你前往属于虔诚信徒的应许之地。就在这儿，在这航道之上，在我身旁！告诉我：我们还要多久才能见面？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Solaris: are you listening? Know that I have plans for you. Know that the Order of Profit safeguards your hope, your well-being, and our shared future. Donate today, with the credits in your account and the sweat of your brow. Give.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 索拉里斯人，你们在听吗？我为你们安排了长远的规划，润盈教会保障各位的希望、福祉，以及我们共同的未来。来吧，献出你们账户里的金钱和额头上的汗水吧。奉献吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Donate your seed that the Order of Profit may nurture that seed to a bountiful crop^ a crop that you may harvest, your faith returned to you tenfold. The larger your seed, the greater your reward, the stronger we all become for your wisdom. Donate. Harvest. Grow. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 献出你的种子，奉献给润盈教来播种。未来，它会变成由你亲手收获的果实。你所付出的信仰，将换来十倍的回报。投入越多，回报越丰厚。我们也会因为你的远见而更加强大。奉献。收获。成长。就趁现在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nef Anyo, speaking directly to you. Well done, members of the Corpus-Solaris Order of Profit! I have this cycle's figures, and they are very pleasing. I embrace you all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我是奈富·安尤，向各位报告。科普斯—索拉里斯润盈教的成员们，你们做得很好！我已经拿到了本周期的财务报表，数字非常喜人。我为各位感到骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nef Anyo here. Like you, I toiled, friends. I toiled. But I pulled myself up, dusted myself off, and purchased my future. Join me here, in orbit. Out of the dirt. Above everyone else. It's just… better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，请听奈富·安尤一言。我也曾和你们一样当牛做马。但我凭一己之力逆天改命，拍掉身上的灰尘，然后亲手买下了我的未来。加入我吧，来航道上。远离污垢，凌驾于一切之上。这里……比下面好多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I dunno, Boon. I think maybe they're havin' one a them, wotsit, flashbacks. Oi! Glinty! You in there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我不知道，阿布。我觉得他们可能正在经历那个，那个什么，「走马灯」。喂！闪闪！你还在吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yeah, I know, but we need the credits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 对，我知道，不过我们需要现金。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So, ah… you don't make a lot a snap decisions, I guess?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 所以，呃……我猜，你平时应该也有选择恐惧症吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Still decidin'? Fair call, fair call. You don't want the balance to be off, or the plank to be flyin' out from under ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 还纠结呢？理解，理解。你肯定不想平衡没调好，或者滑一半板子从脚底下飞出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Need any advice?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 要我帮你参谋不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The combo of bits give the plank its personality. Kinda like gettin' married. Not that I ever will. Bachelor for life, me. Married to me art.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 零件搭成什么样子，板子就是啥脾气，就跟找对象结婚一样。反正我这辈子不结，姐单一辈子，我只跟我的板子过日子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hahahahahaaa! Klokkit. We got a buyer. Howzit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哈哈哈哈！瞧瞧，我们有顾客上门了。最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Pump the brakes, bro. This one's a buyer. Need a ride, friend? The Kubrodons and Vent Pobbers are at your service!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 可得慢着点，有金主来咯。缺板子吗，朋友？库狛顿和通风泡博随时为您效劳！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hit the rail, movin' terminal, klokkit? Grinded for a lifetime offa that taxie loader. Vapor trail. Couldn't touch Roky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 飞上护栏，一路火花带闪电，懂不？老娘我能顺着滑上一辈子，就给你们留道尾迹，谁也跟不上我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Glinty mucker wants in. I tells him: our family's logical, see? Hand-picked. Your lot's biological. Mumsie. Dadsie. Luck a the draw. All coddled and swaddled. Mucker wouldn't last ten seconds in a vent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 臭闪闪也想入伙。我挑明告诉他：咱们的家人是自己挑的，懂不？亲手挑的。你们那是亲生父母。老爹老妈，全靠抓阄。从小娇生惯养、蜜罐里泡着的乖宝宝，在通风管里十秒钟都撑不过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Bah-bah-beh-beh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拜了个拜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Know how you stop someone gettin' too rich?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 知道该怎么断了别人的财路吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Skill, bro. Every. Time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 全靠本事，老兄。每次，都是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Win hard and folks be dressin' bad by breakfast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 明早大伙儿就会模仿你的穿搭了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You're a special unit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你是特种部队吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Vent Pobbers got new digs. Old filtration chamber they don't use no more. Movin' our racks and gear end of cycle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 通风泡博发现新基地了。是个废弃不用的旧过滤舱。挑个日子把睡架和家当都搬过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yeah. It's square in the D-7 vent-tangle. Bang and bounce is dog. Keep the whole section up we will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没错，D-7 通风管交叉口中间。敲起来带劲，回声更绝。我们会让这片街区热闹起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Legs? All that rhymin'? You want that hangin' logical? How we get somethin' his size into a ventspace? With a mallet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 腿哥？就那个满嘴顺口溜的？还想让他进家门？他那么大的块头，怎么塞进通风管里啊？用锤子砸吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ventkids got no folks, so Ventkids look after themselves. We can sort you with a dog board, no worries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 通风小子没爹没娘，只能彼此罩着。给你搞块够带劲的板？包在我们身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Psst! Glinty! Need a plank? Parts? Talkin' primo K-drive bits. Get you ridin', kick it terminal out on the Vallis. Cheap, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂！闪闪！来块板子不？还是零件？顶级 K 式悬浮板配件，包你在山谷上驰骋，一路拉风。而且贼便宜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Checknah, glinty! All K-Drive bits we got legit! Now, you want expert parts and service, or you suckin' wind?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 来瞧瞧，闪闪！咱这的 K 式悬浮板配件，样样都是正品！你是想要专业的零件和服务，还是只想站在这里干吹风？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Can't help ya, glinty. I need somethin' to work with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我帮不了你，闪闪。手里没零件，我拿啥干。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Want me to bolt two canisters to a piece a siding, charge you fifty so you can make broom-broom noises? Need parts, glinty. Parts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 怎么，想让我随便拿俩破罐子往侧板上一焊，然后收你五十，让你「嗡——嗡——」地过飙车瘾？得要零件啊，闪闪。零件懂不懂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Gonna need some bits and pieces, glinty. We live in the vents, not a relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 总得给我几样材料吧，闪闪。我们住在通风管，又不是什么中继站。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We'll take that board off your hands, if it shows better than what we got. Let's see… hmmm… It don't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 要是这块板子看起来比我们手头的更像样，我们倒乐意接手。我瞧瞧……嗯……成色也就那么回事嘛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Board's too green, glinty. Prove it terminal and Ventkids pass it on for sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 板子还太嫩了，闪闪。等你滑到极致、滑出名堂的时候，通风小子绝对会抢着要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You're a primo mucker, glinty, an' no mistake. But we need somethin' dog to make the cut. This ain't it… yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你是最棒的，闪闪，这没得说。不过要过咱这关，板子必须够带劲。这块嘛……还差点火候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You sure? She's primo, this one. Nothin' off the rack about her. Yeah? Well all right. Here's to you, glinty. You're level.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你确定？这板子可是极品，可不是那种烂大街的普通玩意儿。真不要？那好吧。祝你好运，闪闪。还得是你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Our crews lose boards all the time. Misadventure, confiscation… dares. This'll be handy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们的人经常搞丢板子。出意外、被没收……或打赌输掉。这个正好派得上用场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You're logical, glinty. One in the family. Thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你真讲义气，闪闪。咱们是一家人。谢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We Ventkids. No Mumsie-Dadsie for us. No biological kin^ just our logical kin. This here's me logical-bro, Boon. He runs the Kubrodons, scores the parts. I run the Vent Pobbers, we make the boards. You buyin'? Need a plank? Once a cycle I got somethin' dog. Best prices, too, glinty. Mates rates, chek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们这些通风小子，没爹没娘的。没有血亲，只有拜把子的义亲。这是我认的弟弟，阿布。他带库狛顿搞零件，我带通风泡博造滑板。想整点货吗？缺板子不？每隔段时间我都能弄点狠货出来，最低价，闪闪。绝对兄弟价，懂不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That board's box-fresh, glinty. You want gildin' ya gotta earn it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那块板子才刚出炉呢，闪闪。想要镀金，你得自己去挣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I earned my gildin'. Boon earned his. You don't get yours til you leave some skin out there, chek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我的镀金是自己挣来的，阿布的也是。不去外面摸爬滚打，就别想拿到自己的勋章，懂不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Not 'til that plank's taken a few knocks, glinty. A lot of knocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 在这块板子饱经磕碰之前可不行，闪闪。历经无数次磨难才能成就一块板子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Howzit. Boards and bits, let you grind terminal. Check me wares.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哟，板子跟组件，保你一路滑到飞起。来瞧瞧货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Howzit, glinty. You lookin' or what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 咋样，闪闪。随便瞧瞧还是带点啥？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Look, we need dosh, you need a plank. You ride, we get fed, chekchek?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 对嘛，我们缺票子，而你缺板子。你滑起来，我们才有饭吃，懂不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Howzit, glinty. Got a need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 怎样，闪闪。缺什么不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Boon. Boon! Get over here! It's our Outworlder buddy. How ya doin' Outworlder-buddy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 阿布，阿布！快滚过来！咱们的异世哥来喽。最近混得咋样啊，老哥！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I scope you, Outworlder-buddy! Lookin' dog as always. What can the Vent Pobbers fit you with?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这不是我们的异世哥嘛！你看起来还是一如既往的帅嘛。我们通风泡博能帮你配点啥？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey, just in time. We were about to hit the Vallis, grind some off Nef's face. Ten points for the eyebrows. Need anything?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嚯，来得正好。我们正准备去山谷，拿奈富的脸当护栏滑，蹭过眉毛加十分。你缺点什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: My kids don't go near that hunter-trapper Business cove. Not since Bobo. The Business moves in, starts talkin' cute and furry animals. Bobo thinks Biz is an easy mark. By the time Bobo's pulled his Kitgun Biz is handin' it back to him without the clip. Dunno what that old cove told Bobo, but Bobo ain't touched a gun since. We got no idea who that Biz mucker really is, an' we don't wanna know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们不会靠近那个又打猎又捕兽的「操盘手」老兄。自从博博那档子事之后就绝不可能了。那时操盘哥刚搬过来，张口闭口聊的都是些毛茸茸的小动物。博博还当他是个好捏的软柿子。结果博博刚掏出他的组合枪，操盘哥就把弹匣拆了，把枪递了回来。不知道那老哥和博博说了什么，自那以后博博就再也没碰过枪。我们根本不晓得那混蛋到底什么来头，也压根儿不想知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey, you know some old cove Smokefinger? Me and the crew bang Skeg in the vents of a down-cycle, and he leaves us these wedged in the grills come up-cycle. Says it's sheet music. What's a sonata? Woss'e sayin'? Our clangin' ain't dog enough for his old receptors? Woss a Mandachord anyway?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂，你认识个叫烟指的老头吗？我们有天晚上在通风管里奏管道乐，第二天他居然在铁栅格里给我们留了这些废纸，说是什么乐谱。奏鸣曲是什么鬼？他是啥意思？难不成这老古董嫌我们敲得还不够顶？再说了，曼达和弦琴又是哪门子玩意？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Zuud's a bit lateral, in'she? We get calls some down-cycles, wantin' parts. It's Zuud, 'cept it ain't always her voice. Some other lady. Imagine if that was yer Mumsie. That was your biological, an' you just had to live with that. Pfeh. That's why me and Boon and the kids hang logical. Choose the kind of crazy we live with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 祖德脑子有点问题，发现了吧？有时下半夜会有人打来说要零件，一看是祖德要的，可声音不总是她本人的。有时会变成别的女人。想象一下如果那是你老妈，亲生的，你还非得跟她过一辈子。噗，所以我和阿布，还有这帮孩子才选择彼此当家人。至少跟哪种疯子一起过，是我们自己选的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey… erm… you klok Boon's keen on that Legs mucker? He says we should make Legs logical. Part of our fam. I tell him he won't fit in the vents. He says Legs could just take his head off and we could lug him 'round. Jealous? Nah! Boon's me logical! That'd be weird. I jus'... he's me most logical fam. I got no other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 喂……呃……你发现没，阿布对腿哥那家伙挺上心的。他说我们应该把腿哥也认进家里，当咱们的家人。我说他塞不进通风管。阿布说他只要把头摘下来就行，咱们可以扛着他到处走。吃醋？才没有！阿布是我义弟！吃醋也太奇怪了。我只是……他是我最亲的家人。我没有别人了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nice. I don't get the reference, but that sounds real poetic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 酷，虽然我不懂里头的梗，不过感觉挺有诗意的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Aw, pretty. OK, all done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哇，好听。好了，都搞定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Now get out there and give 'em hell. Tell 'em the Ventkids sent ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 现在就出去给他们点颜色瞧瞧。告诉他们，是通风小子派你来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That works, too. OK, all done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那也行。好了，都搞定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You're the boss. All done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 听你的，全部搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Chek that. The Board With No Name. And done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 妥了，「无名板」。搞定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Dog. In'she dog? Come on! A little appreciation, glinty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 牛吧，这板子够顶的吧？来嘛！好歹夸两句，闪闪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Someday, glinty, the system's gonna know my name - and you'll be able to say: 'I bought one a the first Rides by Roky.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 闪闪，总有一天，整个星系都会记住我的大名——到时候你就能跟人吹：「我买的板子可是小洛第一批打的」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Boon! Klokkit. This be terminal style, chek? Yeah? No? Ah, go stick your head in one. This board'll make you a star, glinty. No mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 阿布！瞅瞅。这可拉满了，懂？帅吧？不帅？！嘁，滚蛋你懂个屁。有了这块板，你绝对是最靓的仔，闪闪。妥妥的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: There y'go. Pinnacle. Sometimes, if a plank's somethin' special, I give her a name. How 'bout you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 妥了，神板。有时某块板子要是真的很出色，我会给她取个名字。你呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: What's she called, then?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那你想叫她什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Primo. Whaddya reckon? Do we give 'er a name?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 绝了。你觉得怎样？要不要给她起个名字？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Bah-bah-beh-beh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拜了个拜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Cheknah, glinty. Scope ya.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 少来，闪闪。回见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Pfft. Yeh-no yeh-no cheknah. Glinty all flitty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 噗，一会儿要，一会儿又不要。又来这套，闪闪真是反复无常。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Klokkit. Lookin' dog, glinty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 瞧瞧，帅爆了，闪闪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Bah-bah. Scope me in a cycle, see what's new.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拜咯。下次再来看看我这上了什么新货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Chekchek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拜拜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah, yeah. Okay. Sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，对。行，没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hmm. Intriguing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗯，有点意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Couldn't have picked better meself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 换我来挑，也不可能比你挑得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Fell off the back of a loader. Wanna bargain, today's it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 从装载机后头掉下来的。要想捡便宜，今天算你撞大运了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Parts freshly nicked by the Kubrodons - Boon's crew. Bashed this plank together meself, I did. One-of-a-kind, guaranteed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这些零件是阿布手下的库狛顿刚顺回来的。这块板可是我亲手敲出来的，保证找不到第二个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Boon's crew taxed the parts quiet-like, an' we Vent Pobbers bashed it together last cycle. Terminal ride. I'll gutterball the price n'all. Deal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 阿布他们悄悄把零件「征」过来了，咱们通风泡博昨天才把它们组装好。这座驾太酷了。我给你个跳楼价，成交不？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Boon's crew got air over a zap-fence to score this lot. Corpus maintenance crew gonna be comin' up short next cycle, but hey - we Vent Pobbers pass the savings on to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这批零件是阿布他们越过电网才搞到的。看来科普斯的维修队明天要缺零件了。不过，喂——我们通风泡博直接让利给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: So, here's the thing, glinty: me supply chain's a little stretched, see? I get in whatever Boon's Kubrodons can lift when the taxman ain't lookin' - you want somethin' different you're gonna need to load me up with the parts. We Vent Pobbers only charge for labor and expertise. Like I toldja, mates rates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 是这么回事，闪闪：我的货源最近有点吃紧，懂吧？阿布的库狛顿趁收税佬不注意能顺出什么，我这就卖什么。你想整点不一样的？那你得自带零件过来。我们通风泡博只收手工费和技术费。还是我说的兄弟价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hello. I am Smokefinger. Antiquarian, historian and now, through a bewildering series of circumstances, an avid geophile. That is to say: I am interested in soil and all the things that may be found in it. Let me show you what I mean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你好，我是烟指。一名古文物收藏家、历史学家，而现在，经历了一连串眼花缭乱的机缘巧合，我成了一名狂热的地质爱好者。也就是说，我对土壤和所有出土的东西都很感兴趣。容我给你展示一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Taxmen have imposed strict limits on the mining ventures we Solaris can undertake, which I don't approve of, but I can't do anything about. So… go out and do it for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 税务官严格限制了我们索拉里斯人能承接的采矿活动。尽管我十分反对，但也无能为力。所以……就拜托你到外面去帮我挖吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hello again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 又见面了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah yes, my itinerant friend. How are we today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，是的，我萍水相逢的朋友。今天还好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I feel our relationship has progressed sufficiently that I have unfastened my casing. Let us now continue openly in our efforts geological, refreshingly devoid of formality, hmm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我感觉我们的交情越来越深，已经可以让我敞开心扉了。让我们坦诚地一起继续研究地质学，不必拘于礼数，如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ah yes yes. Wonderful wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，对，对。很好很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I am very pleased to see you, very pleased indeed. Let's get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 很高兴见到你，真心高兴。让我们开始工作吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Welcome welcome welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 欢迎欢迎，热烈欢迎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: My life was transformed the day a pre-eminent geologist saw potential in my younger self. I should like to do the same for another young person, and I see such potential, drive, and commitment in the young man who sells mechanical contrivances just over yonder. I do wish he would allow me to help him, to show him the universe in a grain of sand. Oh, forgive me. How might I assist?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我年轻的时候，有位杰出的地质学家觉得我很有潜力，自此之后我的人生就彻底改变了。我也希望能向另一位年轻人传递这份幸运。我物色到一位年轻人，他充满潜力、干劲和勤奋，他就在不远处贩卖机械小玩意。我真心希望他能允许我帮帮他，带他从一粒沙中窥见宇宙万物。噢，抱歉，又说多了。有什么能为你效劳的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The music of the vent-children - 'Skeg,' they call it - is a self-evolved musical form, unrestrained by conventional rules of composition. Utilizing improvised instruments, the vents themselves become part drum, part valve, part echo chamber, playing a vital role in the creation of this entirely original acousmatic experience and making sure I never get any mucking sleep!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 通风小子们的音乐——他们称之为「管道乐」，是一种自然演化的音乐形式，完全不拘泥于传统的谱曲规则。利用即兴乐器，那些通风管本身就变成了某种鼓、阀门和共鸣腔。它们在创造这种原创而不知声源的听觉体验中起到了至关重要的作用，同时也让我一整晚都合不上眼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: While our composite physical natures afford a longer-than-typical life expectancy, I fear I am simply too advanced in my years to be of any quantitative aid to the resistance. But I will, of course, do my little bit if that is deemed to be of value. That Eudico. What a spark she has. Were I younger, much… younger. That younger, different me, would have signed up faster than you could say zip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 尽管我们复合构造的身体，能让我们比常人更长寿。不过恐怕我如今年事已高，无法再给抵抗活动提供任何实质性的帮助了。不过，我当然会尽我所能。尤迪科，她身上那股蓬勃的朝气。要是我再年轻点，年轻得多的话……那个更年轻，与如今截然不同的我，绝对会二话不说立刻参加抵抗活动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh. Well. I do hope you will reconsider.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 噢，好吧。希望你能重新考虑一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: This decision is ill-advised. The pursuit of mineralogy can make a person very happy indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这个决定欠考虑。钻研矿物学，本来是件快乐的事，真的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The first time you uncover something rare and special and pull it from the soil, something magical happens. It bewitches you. I do hope you have that experience someday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 当你第一次从土壤中发掘出稀有而特别的东西，并把它亲手取出时，神奇的事情就发生了。它会让你彻底着迷。我真心希望有一天你能体验到这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Good good. Rug up, and I'll see you when you get back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 很好，很好。穿严实点，等你回来再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That should do you quite nicely I should think. Now: Argon Crystals. They've not been found on Venus… but if they were… well… that would support my Tellurium theory now, wouldn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我觉得这应该很适合你。接下来说说氩结晶。金星上从未发现过这种物质……但假如真发现了……那岂不是正好能佐证我的碲元素理论？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: There we are. Now, there is no evidence for this theory, but I believe the Orokin used Tellurium in Void gate creation. Finding traces here could be significant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好了。眼下并没有证据支撑这个理论，但是我坚信奥罗金在创造虚空之门时使用了碲元素。如果能在这儿找到蛛丝马迹，将会是重大的科学突破。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: All done. Now Gallium is interesting. I theorize it had a role to play not just in Dax weapon manufacture… but in creating Warframes themselves. Just a theory, just a theory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 大功告成。说起镓，这种元素相当有意思。我的理论是，它不仅用于制造禁卫武器……甚至参与了战甲本身的创造。当然，这只是我的推论，推论而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text:
[9.0]
Well, well. Look at you: a Tenno, fine, kind and, benign.
[17.5]
Ticker can spot an ambidexter a block away, and, Stardust, you. Ain't. It.
[28.0]
So listen, and listen tight: My real line is debt forgiveness. Charity.
[36.2]
You buy some poor rig jockey's debt and they sidestep brain-shelving. Every sinner's a winner.
[52.1]
Now… I'd appreciate you keepin' this little ol' conversation to yourself. And when I ask you for help, you look me in my baby blues and say 'yes.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText:
[9.0]
哎呀呀。瞧瞧你：一位出色、善良又温和的 Tenno。
[17.5]
我一眼就能看穿两面三刀的伪君子，而你，星尘，你显然不是那种人。
[28.0]
听好了，听仔细了：我真正做的，是替人免债，也就是做慈善。
[36.2]
你替某个打工人买下债务，他就能躲过被「强行摘脑」的下场。罪人得救，人人得利。
[52.1]
好了……希望你能把咱们这点小秘密烂在肚子里。等我找你帮忙时，你可得看着我这水汪汪的蓝眼睛说「没问题」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: They could use your help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 他们需要你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: One of the good ones, that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 这位可是真正的好人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Everyone makes mistakes. Shouldn't be a crime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 人非圣贤，孰能无过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Some day things will be different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 总有一天，一切都会改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We all do what we can, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们都尽力而为，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Really quite sweet that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 真是心地善良的人啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Terrible choice to have to make.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 被逼无奈的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: They can save themselves, with a little help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拉他们一把，他们就能拯救自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We all need help time to time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 谁都有需要别人拉一把的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: There is no shame in helping your fellow creatures.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 向受苦的生灵伸出援手，没什么可羞愧的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Keep the light from dying inside them, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别让他们心中的光熄灭，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Life's a hell of an adventure, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 生命就是一场冒险，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Some see life as adversity or adventure. The adventurers make it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有人把人生当磨难，有人把人生当冒险。后者往往能走得更远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: An entire life can change thanks to one act of kindness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 一个善意的举动，就足以改写一个人的一生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: They never gave up on themselves. We shouldn't, either.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 他们从未放弃自己。我们也不该放弃他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Life's a ride, isn't it? Hell of a ride.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 人生无常，不是吗？真是够折腾的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Comedy or tragedy, depending on your wage bracket. Isn't right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 悲喜不由人，全看钱袋子。世道不公啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Time's running out for those on my books, Stardust. What have you got for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我名单上的人都没多少时间了，星尘。你能帮帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Got good people hoping to see another sunrise. No time for sweet talk, Stardust. Save some lives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 还有很多善良的人在苦盼着能看到明天的太阳。没时间闲聊了，星尘。救救他们吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well well, here comes hope for the hopeless. Gimme some good news, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哎呀呀，这下子那些绝望的人有希望了。你今天带好消息来了吧，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Here's the kicker for Ticker: The Temple teaches charity? Mortal sin. Ticker gets caught helping a repo? That's me done, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 最要命的地方在这儿：润盈殿是怎么宣扬慈善的？那是重罪。我要是帮人逃避回收令，一旦被抓住可就彻底玩完了，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Don't matter to Nef one whit you're an engineer or a lowly thrower. You owe, you go. That's where Ticker comes in, ray of sunshine that she is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 奈富根本不在乎你是工程师还是底层工人。欠了债，就得被带走。这时候就该我登场了，我是冬日里的暖阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: It takes long winter nights to teach a girl how to cultivate within herself invincible summer days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 姑娘得熬得住漫长的冬夜，才能学会在自己的心田耕种出不败的盛夏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sometimes strangers don't know any better, but I swear. To. The. Void... I do try to keep a lid on it, but sometimes the wrong thing just lets all the bats out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有时候外人确实不知情，但我向、虚、空、发、誓……我已经尽力压着火了。可有些混账事，偏偏能一下把人逼得彻底崩溃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A person gets told a lot of things over the course of a life. Who they are, who they should be. Amateurs, lecturing a professional. Anything that can't survive scrutiny, shouldn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 人活一辈子，总会被别人指手画脚地教育。说你是谁，你该活成什么样。一瓶子不响，半瓶子晃荡。经不起推敲的东西，都不该继续存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Best advice I was ever given? "Ticker, you'll be a lot happier once you stop caring about the opinions of a culture that is beneath you." I learned my worth, learned the places and people that matter. Opened my eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我听过的最好的建议？「提克尔，只要你不再去关心那些低你一等的文化成见，你就能活得更开心。」我找回了自我价值，看清了哪些地方、哪些人才是真正重要的。我幡然醒悟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text:
[11]
Ain't no victims on these lists, Stardust. Every one of them workin' against the impossible to make things right for them and theirs. 
[20]
Makes them a hero in Ticker's eyes. Still… like the man said… show me a hero and I'll write you a Void-damned tragedy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText:
[11]
这些名单上没有受害者，星尘。他们每个人，都是在以凡人之躯向不可能抗争，只为让自己和在乎的人过得好一些。
[20]
在我眼中，他们都是英雄。可话又说回来……正如那人所说：只要你敢做英雄，下场注定是一出被虚空诅咒的悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I never met a priest who could tell you anything about Heaven but they knew every square inch of Hell. They should. They built it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我从没见过有牧师能说清天堂的样貌，但他们对地狱却了如指掌。也难怪，毕竟那里是他们自己亲手造出来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ugh, finally, I do so prefer dealing with clients face-to-face, but, you know, one doesn't just give it up on the first date. Pleased to meet you. Again. Shall we deal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 呃，我们终于见面了。我还是更喜欢和客户面对面交流。不过，你也知道，第一次约会，哪能一下就把底全交出去。很高兴见到你。那我们开始谈正事吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well well, if it isn't my little spray of Stardust. Ticker's gonna put the comm on the hook and take five. How are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哎呀呀，这不是我的小星尘嘛。我这就挂断通讯，歇上五分钟。你最近怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ugh, Stardust, don't even ask what kinda day Ticker's having. Tell me about you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 唉，星尘，千万别问我今天过得有多憋屈。还是说说你自己吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well! Pump the brakes, look who it is! Stardust. Where have you been?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哎呀呀！都停一停，瞧瞧谁来了！星尘，你最近跑去哪了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Stardust. Let's you and me talk about what I can do for you, then I've got to run a few nutrient canisters to little ol' Smokefinger. I swear if I didn't make him intake once a cycle he'd spend all week just staring at rocks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 星尘，咱们先聊聊我能为你做点什么。之后我还得赶紧给老烟指送几罐营养剂。我向你保证，要不是我每隔一段时间都逼着他吃点东西，他能一整个星期都蹲那儿，盯着破石头看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Some think Zuud is a bit much, but I got time for the old lady… and all her invisible friends. 'Ticker,' my mother once said. 'You be home by 12. The Void's takin' me at 12.' And, sure enough, I get home at 12:02 and there she is, dead in her rack. So yeah, I got time and an open mind. Anyway, What can I do you for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有人觉得祖德这人有点烦，不过我倒是愿意陪陪她……还有她那些看不见的朋友。有一次我妈妈跟我说：「提克尔，你十二点前必须到家。虚空十二点会准时带我走。」结果呢，我十二点零二分赶到家，她就在床上咽气了。所以，我有耐心，也看得开。那么，你需要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I don't think much of myself, if I'm honest. Oh, don't misunderstand. Ticker's astounding and she knows it. Just that I've been so many people over the course of a life long lived. These days I think more of the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 老实说，我对自己的评价不高。噢，别误会。我知道自己很迷人，只是在这漫长的人生中，我活成了很多种样子。但现在，我更愿意去多考虑一下这个世界。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text:
[12.6]
Modification's a strange bird, Stardust. It happens, and you think you've lost yourself. I was my arms, I was my legs, I was that person. 
[28]
But, live with it long enough, truth is the only thing you didn't really lose was precisely who you are. Ain't nothin' left but what's behind your eyes. So you make sure that's beautiful. 
[33]
And Ticker… mmm mmm. She loves her some beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText:
[12.6]
身体改造是种奇特的体验，星尘。接受改造后，有时会有一种迷失自我的感觉。我的手臂曾是我，双腿曾是我，那个人，曾是我。
[28]
但只要你带着这副身体活得足够久，就会发现，其实你唯一没有失去的东西就是自我。只有你最本真的灵魂会保留下来。所以，一定要让它保持美丽。
[33]
提克尔呢，嗯~嗯~嗯。她很欣赏自己的美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Love took me places, Stardust. And love brought me back. We fell to this place together, he and I. But I was the only one who stood back up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 爱曾带我走遍天涯，星尘。爱又把我带了回来。我和他一起坠落到这里。但最终，只有我重新站了起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Business loves Venus for the growing thing that it is. But not all things that grow are good. Bad days, Stardust. Bad days lead to bad thoughts, and bad thoughts grow like weeds. Livin' here you learn fast: keep that garden tidy. Blood's a hell of a fertilizer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 「操盘手」热爱金星，因为这颗星球在不断孕育生命。但并非所有长出来的生命都是好的。人总有低谷的时候，星尘。黑暗的日子会催生糟糕的念头，而糟糕的念头会像杂草一样野蛮生长。生活在这里，你很快就会明白：必须把内心的花园收拾干净。毕竟，鲜血是绝佳的肥料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You like stories? Someone like you, Gara, faced up to an Eidolon - might as well have been a god - never blinked, saved a world. See, the value of stories isn't in telling you there are monsters, Stardust. It's in showing you they can be kicked square in the down-belows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 想听故事吗？曾经有位和你一样的人，她的名字是 Gara，曾与拥有神力的夜灵正面交锋。她连眼皮都没眨一下，就拯救了一方世界。看，故事的价值，不在于让你知道怪物真实存在，星尘。而是要告诉你，怪物也可以被踹得稀巴烂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We all do as best we can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们都尽力了就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I have other options. There may still be a chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我还有别的办法。也许还有机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: There is no shame in giving what you can, when you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 尽己所能、量力而行，不用自责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The life we get is so rarely the one we planned for. You've done good, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 人生不如意，十有八九。你已经做得很好了，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: No guarantees in life, but that don't mean we gotta like it. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 人生无常，但不代表我们得逆来顺受。感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The only happiness we ever know is love, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 爱是世上的唯一幸福，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Void sent you to us, I'm sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你一定是虚空派来的天使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You're doing good, Stardust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 做得很棒，星尘。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Your wish is my commish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你的事就是我的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Hey, this cover's gotta be useful for something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 嗨，我这层身份总得派上点用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Not sure what's in here, to be honest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 老实说，我也不清楚里面有什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: See a little somethin' somethin' to make a house a home?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 来点小玩意儿，拿回去给你的小窝添点烟火气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Ticker don't do retail, so… lemme know what you find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 提克尔不做零售，所以……你看上什么直接告诉我就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: A cool head. I like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 够冷静。我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Mm-hmm. Knowing when to move is half the game, luvvie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 唔——哼。把握时机，事半功倍。宝贝儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Mm-hmm. Do what you gotta.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 唔——哼。做你该做的就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: … And this is for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: ……这，是给你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Done deal, darlin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 成交，宝贝儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Isn't that a pretty little thing. Here y'go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 瞧瞧这漂亮的小东西。拿好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: What is it you have for us, Stardust?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 星尘，给我们带东西了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I'm listening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 请说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Something you want to talk about?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有什么事要和我说吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Another time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 下次见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Something else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 还有其他事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Chekchek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拜拜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Appreciated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, aren't you lovely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 啊，你可真招人喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You're one of the good ones, Stardust, and no mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你是个好人，星尘，错不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Take your time. I live to serve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 您慢慢挑。我活着就是为了伺候您的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: (impatient chatter) I know. (static chatter) I know! (happy chatter) Hey, friend, I can't help if you don't pick something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我知道。我知道！喂，朋友，如果你不挑点东西，我没办法帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: (muttering static) I dunno. I think they've gone to sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不知道。他们估计睡着了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I can't do you a weapon... if you don't have weapon parts. Get the weapon parts... and I can make you a weapon. Oh-kay? Roger roger?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你没武器零件……我也没法造出武器。先去弄点武器零件……这样我才能帮你造武器。好吗？听懂了没？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: No parts no weapon. Next!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没零件没武器。下一位！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Look, matey, without weapon components I can't help you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，你没零件的话，我也帮不上忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Thanks. Fills a need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 谢了。我正好需要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Much obliged. Anything else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 多谢。还有吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You sure you wanna part with this? Alright. She'll see good use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你真舍得交出来吗？好吧。她会派上大用场的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We'll take your guns, matey, but only if they're worth it. Battle-tested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，我们收枪，但是只收身经百战的枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: We can't take anything that might let us down. Get us the good stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我们不收靠不住的破烂。拿点真家伙来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Substandard. We can't take that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不合标准。这个不收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Oh. It's you. (impatient chatter) Yes, yes they're here. (indignant blatting chatter) I do not like your attitude. (static chatter) You. We… I am Zuud. Kitguns are what we do. Bring parts or purchase Chatter's daily design. Just… do it quickly. (static chatter) I have people skills. I am very skilled in getting them to leave. (static)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 哦，是你。对，对，他们来了。我不喜欢你的态度。你。我们……我是祖德。我们是造组合枪的。要么带零件来，要么买下杂音每天给出的设计图。总之……搞快点。我嘴可甜了，最会叫人滚蛋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Nothin' gets gilded without its worth bein' known. Pretty sure there's a moral in there somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 未立其功，焉得其名。这里面多少有点人生哲理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I ain't gildin' nothin' without it bein' battle-tested first. So git.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没经过战火洗礼的物件，我是不会镀金的。多练练吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That little plinker ain't fired near enough. Come back when you know its worth, then we can talk gildin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 那个小玩具连开火的次数都远远不够。等你什么时候明白了它的价值，再来找我镀金吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Whaddya need? Specify the target and I'll sell you the tool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 想要点啥？告诉我你要打谁，我就把趁手的家伙卖给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text:
[4.7]
Guns guns guns! (static chatter) What?
[12.4]
Look I can't talk to two people at once. (binary chatterr) No, not you. So whaddya want? (static chatter) 
[16.2]
Not you, the other you. SHADDUP. (sad chatter)
[23.5]
You need a shooter, stranger? A little point-and-click murderizer? Zuud's got more than you'll ever need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText:
[4.7]
枪！枪！枪！什么？
[12.4]
我又不能同时跟两个人讲话。不，没说你。你到底想要点什么？
[16.2]
不是说你，我在跟别人说话。闭嘴。
[23.5]
你需要枪吗，陌生人？来一把指哪打哪的小杀器？你想要什么都可以说，我这随便挑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I channel Chatter to craft guns unlike any other. (binary chatter) We craft kitguns, fine. (chatter) Your neediness is profoundly unattractive. (static chatter) Kill-sticks like you've never seen, stranger. Click, bang, their limbs fall off. This pleases you, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我靠着倾听脑子里的杂音，造出举世无双的枪械。行吧，是我们一起造枪。我真的很讨厌你这黏人的样子。你没见过这种杀人的武器吧，陌生人。扣下扳机，砰，他们的胳膊腿儿就全飞了。怎么样，感兴趣吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: You are one of us, so Chatter says. So Eudico says. They've never steered me wrong, so… hello. Now. Go away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 杂音说，你是我们的朋友。尤迪科也这么说的。她们从没骗过我，所以……你好。然后，滚吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Chatter was right about you, Friend. (static chatter) I wish it wasn't, could turn it off (surprised chatter), grab me some peace but no (relieved chatter)… Chatter is always right. So, you are welcome and Chatter… (static chatter) keeps on... talking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 看来杂音没看错你，朋友。我倒希望它错一次，好让我把它关掉，清静一会儿……杂音总是对的。那，随时欢迎你；唉。至于那些杂音……还在……说个没完。
