/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: (happy chatter) Chatter is pleased with itself, Friend. Pleased to aid your purpose. Keen to aid again. (static chatter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 杂音很开心，朋友。它很开心能帮上你，以后也想继续帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yes, yes, all hail the conquering hero. (happy chatter) Must we go through this every time? You were right, I was wrong, the Outworlder is amazing. (static chatter) Zip it. How may I assist?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好，好，向无所不能的英雄致敬。每次都得来这一套吗？你都对，我错了，异世者确实很了不起。闭嘴。你到底需要些什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Chatter says Eudico feels guilty about things long past. Eudico worries Chatter means I'm not right in the braincase. It's nice to have so many people thinking of me. Well, what do you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 杂音说尤迪科一直为陈年旧事自责。尤迪科担心我是脑子有些问题才会听到杂音。有这么多人惦记着我，真让人感动。好了，你要什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: The Business: good man. Always has been. Deserves a better protege than that Little Duck. Swanning off, breaking his heart. Pfft. Man should find himself a wife, don't you think? Anyway, store's open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 「操盘手」是个老好人，一直都是。但是他怎么就收了小鸭子那种徒弟呢。一走了之，伤透了他的心。啧，或许他应该给自己找个伴了，你说呢？算了，你想买点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: I like the children in the walls. Chatter makes requests, and the children bring me parts. Parts make guns. At night the children perform music in the walls. Chatter sings. And I sleep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 我喜欢墙里那些孩子。有时候杂音想要些东西，他们就给我弄来零件，造枪用的那种。到了晚上，孩子们会在墙里面演奏音乐。杂音会跟着哼唱，然后我就沉沉睡去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Smokefinger is an irritant. He brings us things. Pretty things. Useless things. Smokefinger knew our sisters, he says. We… did not have sisters. I do not like the way Chatter falls silent when he visits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 烟指烦人得很。虽然他经常给我们带各种东西，有漂亮的，也有没用的。烟指说他以前认识我们的姐妹。但我们根本……没有姐妹。每次他一来杂音就不喜欢出声了，说实话，我不喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yeah. That'll do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 不错。我觉得可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Yep. I reckon that fits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好的。我看挺合适的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well, you'd best get goin'. Take care of that now. She's some of my best work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好了，你现在该走了。好好待她，这可是我迄今为止最好的作品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Some things are what they are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 有些东西浑然天成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Seems like that works for her, I reckon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 别说，看起来还挺合适。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 只要没出问题，就别乱动它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Well. All right. Here y'go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 搞定，好了，拿走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Potshot a few lube cans, calibrate 'er to your satisfaction. Otherwise, she's flawless. As per.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 找几个铁罐试试手感，校准到你满意为止。除此之外，一如既往的完美无瑕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Here y'go, just like you asked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 给你，如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Beautiful. She got a name?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 真美。你想好名字了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: What're ya gonna call her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你准备叫她什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Pretty enough. What's her name?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 真漂亮。她叫什么名字？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: (static chatter) Sure, I'll just jump the counter and make 'em buy something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 行吧，我干脆翻过柜台，按着他们的头逼他们买东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Are you sure you don't want… (static chatter) I'm asking! Are you… (binary chatter) Ah forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 你确定不想要……我正问着呢！你是不是……啊，算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Fine. NEXT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好吧。下一位！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: If you go past Eudico ask if we're still on for after work. (binary chatter) No you can't come. (static chatter) Ugh… as if I have a say in it anyway. (happy chatter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 要是你见到尤迪科，帮我问问下班后还约不约。不，你不能来。呃……反正我也拿你没办法，随你好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Keep your boots tight and your lips locked. Read me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 鞋带绑紧，嘴巴闭严。懂吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Checkcheck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 懂了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Look matey, I appreciate the need to choose well. I only ask that you decide before you get here? I got other customers, y'know!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 朋友，我理解买东西得精挑细选。但拜托你能不能在进店之前先想好？我还得招待别的客人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Until you got here and jammed up my day I'd forgotten what constipation could feel like.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 要不是你来我店里给我添了一天堵，我都快忘了便秘是什么感觉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: (static chatter) Yeah it's a big decision but I swear if this kid were any dumber they'd be a mineral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 没错，这是个重大决定。但我敢发誓，如果这孩子再笨点，简直就是石头脑袋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Great! Top choice! Woo hoo! Balloons fall from ceiling shove over lemme get this done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 太棒了！真厉害！呜呼！全场撒花！赶紧让开，让我把这活儿干完吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: That'll work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 可以的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Sure, why not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 好啊，没问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Chatter said build - said you would be coming. You are meant for this kitgun. So buy it. Buy it so I can get some muckin' sleep!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 杂音让我造的，说你会来。看来这把组合枪注定属于你。那就买了吧，好让我去睡个好觉了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: (static chatter) Do what? This one? (cranky chatter) Very well, very well. Here, you. Outworlder. Kitgun. Buy it. Chatter tells me this is intended for you. (static chatter) Yes, yes, I told them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 什么？这把？行了行了，知道了。异世者，组合枪，买走吧。杂音说这是专门留给你的。对，对，我已经跟她说了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Weighted. Balanced. Calibrated. The output of a lifetime's focus. I would pair this with your focus, Outworlder, to achieve a second, far more violent, outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 配重、平衡、校准。我这辈子的手艺全凝聚在这儿了。异世者，让它配上你的狠劲儿，去干一票更痛快的买卖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.text: Here. I have kept this for you. It would not… allow me to sell it to another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFortu.zhText: 拿着。我一直给你留着它。它根本……不准我卖给别人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: Observe. Our quarry has marked their passing with more than… Hm. Follow the tracks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 仔细看。我们的目标留下的痕迹，可不止这些……嗯。顺着踪迹走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: Fresh leavings and… there. A trail. Follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 新鲜的排泄物……瞧那。有踪迹，跟上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: Our quarry was here very recently. As that trail of prints attest. Track them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 目标刚刚还在这里。这串足迹就是证据。跟上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: They were here very recently, and departed in that direction. Follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 它不久前还在这里，之后朝那个方向去了。跟上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: We're very close to them now. Follow that trail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 我们离它很近了。跟着那条踪迹走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: We've almost got you now, my little friend. They're very close by. Follow the trail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 我们就快找到你了，淘气的小家伙。它就在附近。顺着踪迹走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: Good. Good good. We're very close. Pursue, but quietly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 很好，很好。我们已经离得很近了。继续追踪，动静小些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: Scat! Fresh too. This your chance to lure them in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 新鲜的粪便！嗯，这是引出它的好机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: They'll be nearby. Follow their trail carefully. We don't want to startle them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 它就在附近。小心跟进它的踪迹。千万别吓到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.text: A tuft of fur. There will be creatures nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Fortuna/DFotun.zhText: 一撮毛发。附近肯定有动物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[5.7]
Busy. Oh, an Outworlder? A Tenno.
[10.3]
Look, we're a Corpus operation we are, but these people are Solaris.
[17.0]
We work for a livin'. We don't need no trouble, and we don't need no-one gettin' hurt.
[20.2]
You wanna help? Go buy something from Thursby.
[24.5]
He's been staring down the barrel of a repo order ever since he took on his parents debt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[5.7]
我在忙。哦，异世者？还是个 Tenno。
[10.3]
听着，虽然我们是科普斯手底下的组织，但我们骨子里都是索拉里斯人。
[17.0]
大家只是为了讨口饭吃。我们不想惹麻烦，也不想看到任何人受伤。
[20.2]
想帮忙吗？去照顾照顾瑟斯比的生意吧。
[24.5]
自从他背上父母的债务后，他每天都怕收到回收令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[9.0]
Ugly thing, repossession. A Solaris falls too deep in debt, and Nef sends in his repo squads to take what he says he's owed.
[13.3]
You know, mechanical body parts, even a full rig.
[19.6]
In Thursby's case, cause he got none of that, they take the organics: arms and legs.
[22.9]
Yeah, there's a market for those too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[9.0]
强制回收可真膈应人。只要索拉里斯人欠的债太多，奈富就会派回收小队来讨他所谓的债。
[13.3]
你懂的，就是机械义肢，甚至整副义体。
[19.6]
至于瑟斯比，他没钱买这些，他们就只能回收掉原装的胳膊和腿。
[22.9]
没错，这玩意儿在黑市也有销路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[10.3]
Aye... Mucking what. Nef wants to start that fossilized coolant tower back up... today.
[15.4]
It's damaged Orokin tech, not a bleeding moa, you can't just turn it on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[10.3]
哎……真他妈见鬼。奈富想把那座休眠的冷却塔重新启动……而且今天就要。
[15.4]
那是损坏的奥罗金科技，又不是该死的恐鸟，哪是随便按个开关就能启动的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[14.1]
She means well. Don't want to see nothing bad happen to us workers… but, there was a time she had another name - Vox Solaris, the voice of the resistance, the voice of Solaris United.
[18.1]
She stood up for us. Said how wrong this all is.
[25.6]
She always said Solaris United was all of us, but it weren't nothing without her.
[30.8]
When the trouble happened... Nef did try to identify her...
[43.4]
What he did to the others… What happened on Deck 12… She's always been kind to me, what happened to them was never her fault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[14.1]
她是好心。不想看我们这些苦工遭殃……过去她还有一个名字——索拉里斯之声，那是反抗的呐喊，是索拉里斯联盟的呼声。
[18.1]
她为了我们挺身而出。痛斥这一切有多么荒谬。
[25.6]
她总说索拉里斯联盟是我们大家组成的，但要没有她，一切都将不复存在。
[30.8]
后来出了乱子……奈富确实想把她揪出来……
[43.4]
他对其他人的所作所为……在12号甲板发生的惨剧……她对我一直很好，那些人的死绝不是她的错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[4.7]
When my parents… passed. I inherited their debt.
[13.7]
And boy were they owing deep. Can't work to pay it off 'cause I ain't got no augmentations, and I can't buy augmentations on account of all my debt.
[21.0]
Vicious cycle, right? So here I am, selling useless scrap at the edge of a coolant canal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[4.7]
我爸妈……去世后，一屁股债都落到我头上了。
[13.7]
唉，那可是个无底洞。我没法靠工作还债，因为我没改造过身体。可我又负债累累，哪有钱去做身体改造。
[21.0]
这就是恶性循环吧？所以呢，我就只能像现在这样，在冷却剂管道边上，卖点没用的废料度日。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[2.7]
You ever been out on the Vallis, Boss?
[7.6]
She's a miracle, she is. A blizzard in a firestorm.
[12.6]
All thanks to the magic of rebooted Orokin tech, and...
[18.2]
the blood, and the sweat of so many thousands of Solaris.
[21.9]
But, you know what Eudico always says...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[2.7]
你去过山谷里吗，老大？
[7.6]
那可真是个奇迹。真的，火风暴里卷着暴雪。
[12.6]
这一切全靠重启奥罗金科技的魔法，以及……
[18.2]
成千上万索拉里斯人民的血汗。
[21.9]
不过，你知道尤迪科总爱说什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: She says--
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 她说——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Welcome to Venus, it'll kill ya. Thursby, what's going on, you keepin' your nose clean?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 欢迎来到金星，这地方会要你的命。瑟斯比，怎么样，没给我到处惹事吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Eudico? Ah, sure am! Just giving a - a, tour to my shiny Boss here, ya know, earnin' a wage any way I can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 尤迪科？啊，当然没有，大姐头！我这不是带着这位闪亮亮的老大，呃，随便转转，能赚一点是一点嘛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Alright then, Thursby. Just don't let this Outworlder get you into trouble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 行吧，瑟斯比。别让这位异世者把你卷进麻烦里就好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Fortuna! You are behind schedule. The final coolant tower must be operational in time for my investor showcase. Failure to meet your quotas means one thing. Repossession! If you aren't willing to work for your rig, someone else is!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 福尔图娜！你们进度落后了！最后一座冷却塔必须赶在我的投资人展示会前投入运作。如果完不成任务，你们唯一的下场就是强制回收！既然你们不愿意为这身义体卖命，有的是人愿意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[3.7]
If ya need scrap in a snap just talk to your junkyard diplomat!
[7.6]
That'd be me. Thursby. Thunderstruck, short on pluck, down on his luck.
[10.2]
Ah whatever. Tell me you wanna buy something.
[14.0]
Please. I need this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[3.7]
老哥想要废材料？垃圾场大使为您效劳！
[7.6]
那就是我。心发慌，胆不壮，运气还够呛。
[10.2]
唉，算了。想买什么尽管开口。
[14.0]
求你了，我等着这口饭吃呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[5.2]
Eudico sent you, a Tenno, to help meet me quota?
[7.6]
Well, I'll be…
[12.1]
You know, you could buy scrap... but...
[19.2]
if you really wanted to help, you could source me some supplies. Sumtin' I can sell. Not this garbage.
[22.3]
I know where the Taxmen keeps the good stuff.
[25.6]
If you're up for that sort of thing, Boss, head topside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[5.2]
尤迪科派你这么个 Tenno，来帮我完成指标？
[7.6]
哎呦，我的乖乖……
[12.1]
我说，你可以随便买点废品……不过……
[19.2]
你要真想帮忙，可以帮我弄点儿货来。能卖上价的货。而不是这些破烂。
[22.3]
我知道税务官把好东西都藏在哪儿。
[25.6]
如果你愿意干这一票，老大，就回地面上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[3.0]
I know where the Taxmen keeps the good stuff.
[5.6]
If you're up for that sort of thing, Boss, head topside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[3.0]
我知道税务官把好东西都藏在哪儿。
[5.6]
如果你愿意干这一票，老大，就回地面上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Roky lent us her personal K-Drive. Fastest board in the Vallis. See if you can't slip right past that spider momma.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 小洛把她自己的动力滑板借给我们了。这是全山谷最快的板子。你就直接从那个破圆蛛眼皮子底下冲过去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Solaris, rejoice. Due to my overwhelming generosity, I have canceled any open repossession orders and returned your work quotas to their agreed-upon levels. In unrelated news, I am offering a two million credit reward for information leading to the arrest of the radical agitator known as Vox. Report any suspicious activity to your foreman, immediately. Praise be to profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 索拉里斯人，欢呼吧。出于我的慷慨仁慈，我已撤销所有待执行的回收令，并将你们的工作指标恢复到原先说好的水平。另外，顺便通知你们，我正在悬赏一个叫「索拉里斯之声」的暴乱煽动者，如果有人提供关于此人的信息，我愿意提供两百万现金作为奖励。如果发现任何异常情况，立即向你们的工头汇报。赞美利润！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Investors, please. I swear the system works. This is just a minor hiccup. Some minor labor-relations issues to deal with. You understand, right? Right? Where are you going?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 各位投资人，请留步！我发誓这系统绝对没问题啊。只是出了点小岔子。小小的劳务纠纷，马上就能解决。你们能理解的吧？是吧？你，你们要去哪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: The heat cascade is dissipating. Readings returning to normal. That did it. Well then, Sparky, looks like SU is back. Only a matter of time. If it wasn't me, someone else woulda' done it. Meanwhile, you come see me anytime, Solaris United's got plenty of work for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 热能失控正在平息。各项读数恢复正常。成了。好吧，小火花，看来索拉里斯联盟正式回归了。本来就是迟早的事。就算不是我，也会有别人站出来。以后欢迎你随时来找我，我们有大把的活儿等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Hit the accelerator, Sparky. No hope of outgunning that Orb.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 速度提起来，小火花。论火力是拼不过圆蛛的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: How's the ride? If you want one see Roky when this is all over. Right now we got a job to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 兜风的感觉怎么样？如果你想要块板子，等完事后去找小洛。眼下先办正事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: You made it. Time to give Nef a taste of repossession. Patch me into the coolant towers' control system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 到了。该让奈富尝尝被回收的滋味了。帮我接入冷却塔的控制系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Corpus engineers? What's going on down there? I've lost control of the coolant tower. The investors are watching. Acknowledge!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 科普斯工程师？下面怎么回事？我控制不了冷却塔了。投资人都看着呢。快回话！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: You never had control, Nef Anyo. This tower is Solaris United property. We do with it as we please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 你从未掌控过这里，奈富·安尤。这座塔是索拉里斯联盟的财产。我们想怎么处置，就怎么处置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: You weasels picked the wrong day for collective bargaining. Corpus Kill Squads, converge on the control cluster at once! Investors, everything is under control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 你们这群鼠辈，偏偏挑今天来搞集体谈判。科普斯刺杀小队，立即到控制中心集合！各位投资人，一切尽在掌控。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Let's turn up the heat on Nef.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我们帮奈富添把火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Are you freeloaders trying to damage my coolant tower? Oh of course. All your groveling has moved the bleed-heart Tenno to come to your aid. No matter. My Kill Squads will carry you all swiftly… to the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 你们这群好吃懒做的废物，想毁掉我的冷却塔？噢，我明白了。你们指望用卖惨的故事来博得 Tenno 同情，好让他替你们出头。无所谓，我的刺杀小队马上就来送你们……去虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: You have been warned. Say goodbye to your precious terraforming project.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我已经警告过你了。你得向你的环境改造项目说再见了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Investors, enjoy this display of security prowess. Rest assured your investment is protected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 各位投资人，接……接下来我要向你们展示我的安保实力。请放心，你们的投资万无一失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Solaris United, in the name of the Void, I command you to stop. You're putting my entire enterprise at risk!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟，我以虚空之名，命令你们立刻停手。你们这是要毁了我整个商业帝国！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Stop the repossessions. Acknowledge our work. Honor the age-old accord between Solaris and Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 停止回收作业。承认我们的劳动价值。履行索拉里斯和科普斯之前的约定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Blow that tower and you'll destroy Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 炸掉那座塔，也就等于毁灭福尔图娜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Your fortune is what dies with us, Nef Anyo. And we know that, to men like you, poverty holds a greater dread than death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 奈富·安尤，我们会拉着你的产业一起陪葬。对于你这种人来说，贫穷远比死亡更可怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Wait! Wait! Fine. I'll halt the repossessions. Is that what you want? Stop this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 等等！等等！好吧，我同意叫停回收。你们满意了吧？啊！快停手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Never forget: Solaris make the Vallis work. No Solaris, no Vallis. Do we have an understanding?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 别忘了，是索拉里斯人盘活了这座山谷。没有索拉里斯，就没有山谷。这一点，说得够清楚了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Yes. I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 嗯，我……知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: All I needed to hear. Sparky, drop the Amarast in. Fingers crossed this even works.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 要的就是这句话。小火花，把紫苋石扔进去吧。但愿这玩意真的管用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Where's my fifty Solaris, Fortuna? You're wasting my time. Who do you think you are?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 福尔图娜，我那五十个索拉里斯人呢？你们在浪费我的时间。你们以为自己是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: We are the used. The mutilated. The indebted. We are Solaris United. And this Tenno is our messenger. Hello, Nef.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我们被压榨，被剥夺肢体，被债务套牢。我们，我们是索拉里斯联盟。这位 Tenno 是我们的信使。久违了，奈富。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Investors! Despite some recent, mmm, labor-relations issues, we are going ahead with today's showcase. You will witness Orokin terraforming technology. Expanding the Vallis more quickly than you could possibly imagine. Making available land for new opportunities, new investments. Behold this 'coolant tower,' once thought damaged beyond repair, returned to glorious, profitability.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 各位投资人！虽然最近有一些，嗯，劳务纠纷，不过我们今天的展示会仍将如期举行。你们将有史以来第一次，亲眼目睹奥罗金的环境改造技术。它可以快速扩大山谷面积，绝对超出你们的想象。新的土地就意味着新的机遇和新的投资。请看这座「冷却塔」，过去我们认为它无法修复，但如今它已经能为我们带来丰厚的利润。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Sparky, Solaris United's just getting started. Nef won't want us messing with his Investor Showcase - he's planted that Orb Mother out there to make sure we stay in here. But now is the time to press for leverage. Head to the surface when you're ready, I've arranged little something for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 小火花，索拉里斯联盟才刚重振旗鼓。奈富可不想我们搅黄他的投资人展示会——他把圆蛛派到外面守着，就是为了把我们堵在这。但现在正是趁机施压、逼他让步的时候。准备好了就去地表，我给你备了点小惊喜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Now, Sparky. Get that case as close as you can to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 去吧，小火花。把那个箱子送到他们身边，越近越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Now give 'em hell. For Thursby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 现在送他们下地狱吧。为了瑟斯比。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Solaris United? I know that voice. I killed that voice! You are... a ghost. But. I. Don't. Believe in ghosts!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 索拉里斯联盟？我记得那个声音。我明明让那个声音闭嘴了！你是……幽灵。但是，我，不相信，幽灵！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Halt repossessions immediately. Recognize the importance of our work. These are our demands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 立即停止回收。承认我们的劳动价值。这是我们的诉求。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: I will find you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我一定会找到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Whoever you are, you don't know what hell you've brought upon your people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我不管你是谁，你根本不知道你给你的人惹了多大的麻烦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Sparky, not worth it. Get back in here. Nef, won't risk destroying Fortuna with that Orb. We've bought the time we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 小火花，没必要死磕。回来吧。奈富是不会冒险让圆蛛毁掉福尔图娜的。我们已经争取到时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: That's right, scuttle back to your hole. I'm going to replace the lot of you with Moas. In the meantime, Profit-Taker here will make sure you stay good and planted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 没错，夹着尾巴滚回你们的狗窝。我要把你们全换成恐鸟。在此期间，我的利润收割者会确保你们乖乖待在家里，哪都别想去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: I… I owe you an apology, Eudi. And if you see… 'Vox' pass along my thanks as well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我……欠你一句道歉，尤迪科。要是见到了……「索拉里斯之声」，记得替我说声谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: No, Biz. Thank you - for not giving up on me. We all lift together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 不，比兹，我要谢谢你——谢谢你没放弃我。我们一起共度难关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: And we will... We just poked a kubrodon, and if we don't show who's in charge, we're lunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我们还得继续一起扛下去。我们这次是捅到库狛顿的窝了。要是不能让它明白谁才说了算，我们就会变成它的午饭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: The drone is nearby. Ground it. And I'll see if I can still hack one of these things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 无人机就在附近。把它打下来。我看看能不能黑进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Well, well, well. You're a bright spark and no mistake. Could have used you back in the… Don't let me catch you running more missions for Thursby, understood?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 哎呀呀，小火花可真机灵。当年要是能有你……别让我再逮到你帮瑟斯比跑腿了，听见没？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Hold on, Tenno, been a while since I did this. Now, where is that recording of Thursby?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 坚持一下，Tenno。我好久没干这种技术活了。好，瑟斯比的那段录音在哪呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: This is bad. We've put all of Fortuna in jeopardy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 情况不妙，这下整个福尔图娜都被我们拖下水了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Tenno, you're looking for the Corpus spy drone that overheard Thursby's little "guided tour." Find the drone before it reports back to central command.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: Tenno，去把偷听了瑟斯比的「导游词」的科普斯窃听无人机找出来。赶在它向中央指挥部汇报前截住它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Corpus are legging it. Take out as many as you can. Keep 'em quiet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 科普斯想开溜。能解决多少是多少。让他们永远闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Moa parts. Get a head start. If you're building a cart with… Thursby... no? Bah. I need to work on that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 恐鸟零件，一路领先。要想组装，找……瑟斯比……呃，还是不太行。啧，这词我还得再顺顺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Maybe I was wrong about you, Sparky. You managed to pull that off without getting Thursby killed. Biz says he has work for you. Fine by me, long as you stick to savin' little animals and nothin' else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 也许我误会你了，小火花。你摆平了事，还没让瑟斯比送命。比兹说有事让你办。我没意见，只要你们安分地救救小动物，别搞什么有的没的就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Ah. The Tenno Eudico mentioned. How do you do, Outworlder. My mission is to conserve this region's unique species. You know, before the Corpus drive them to extinction. I'm known as 'The Business'. Eudico calls me… 'Biz'. I wasn't always about the… preservation of life - more the strategic deletion of it. Conservation may be my calling now, but the scales still require an occasional… adjustment. Head to the Vallis if you're looking for some work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 啊，原来你就是尤迪科提过的 Tenno。幸会，异世者。我的使命，是保护这片地区独有的物种——要赶在科普斯把它们赶尽杀绝之前。大家叫我「操盘手」。尤迪科却叫我……「比兹」。其实我以前不是干……这行的——准确来说是战略性生物清除。虽说动物保护是我现在的目标，但天平偶尔也需要……校正一下。你要想找点活干，就去山谷吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Sneak and peak, Boss. Crates full of the good stuff should be nearby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 悄悄摸进去，老大。装满宝贝的箱子应该就在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Haha, outstanding. If we had the old Eudico, we'd be taxin' the Taxmen on the regular. What else can you find?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 哈哈，太棒了。要是以前的尤迪科还在，咱们肯定时不时从税务官身上捞点油水。你还找到什么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Haha, outstanding. If Eudico would just loosen up, we'd be taxin' the Taxmen on the regular. What else can you find?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 哈哈，太棒了。要是尤迪科有这胆量，咱们肯定时不时从税务官身上捞点油水。你还找到什么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Amazing! With this haul... won't be just my debts getting paid off. You're gonna make more than one Solaris happy today, Boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 真厉害！有了这批货……还清我的债简直绰绰有余。你今天够让好几个索拉里斯人乐开花了，老大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[3.1]
I need something I can sell, you know?
[7.1]
Spare parts. Quality merchandise, see?
[10.3]
I know where the Corpus drop supplies.
[13.9]
You can get in and out, before anyone catches wind of what we're up to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[3.1]
我得弄点能卖上价的货，懂吗？
[7.1]
备用零件啊，像样的东西之类的。
[10.3]
我知道科普斯在哪投放补给。
[13.9]
你可以溜进去再出来，别让人发现就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: You're making me nervous here. Hurry it up, Boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 你搞得我都紧张了。动作快点，老大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[8.1]
Unbelievable! Why stop here? With your power, we could hit Nef hard, make him pay for all he's done to us.
[13.8]
Blow up his precious coolant tower before he's even has a chance to show it off to his mucking board…!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[8.1]
真不敢相信！怎么在这就收手了？凭你的本事，我们可以狠狠教训奈富一顿，让他对我们做过的事付出代价。
[13.8]
炸掉他的宝贝冷却塔，他就别想给那个该死的董事会显摆了……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Thursby! What are you thinkin?! You're on an unsecured channel. You want a Corpus spy drone hearing what you're up to? Ah, Muckers! Too late. Got no choice. Tenno, you got Thursby into this mess, so you can damn well help him out of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 瑟斯比！你疯了吗？！你用的是未加密的频道。你想让科普斯的窃听无人机听到你的计划吗？啊，可恶！迟了。没别的办法了。Tenno，是你把瑟斯比卷进这摊浑水的，你最好能把他捞出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Resurrect a dormant Orokin coolant tower? They said it was impossible. Yet such profitous glory is within our grasp! But… I can't get there without you, Fortuna. That is why I am so grateful that all here have volunteered to dispense of work breaks in the name of my glorious enterprise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 唤醒一座沉睡的奥罗金冷却塔？有人说不可能，然而，这一本万利的买卖马上就是我的功劳了！不过……没有你们也做不到，福尔图娜。所以我由衷感谢诸位自愿放弃工休，也要为我的光辉事业添砖加瓦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Aye, Boss, Eudico says that if I try anything like that again, she'll rip me arms off herself. But... Look at this! Yesterday, 'didn't have 'nuff Lucre to stay outta repo. Now I got what I need to open me own shop. Get me head outta' the red. All I needs is a ripe hook. Something ta set ol' Thursby apart. Somethin'... memorable. Oh, almost forgot, Biz, heard what you did, said he wanted to speak with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 哎，老大，尤迪科说，要是我再敢搞这出，她就亲手把我的胳膊卸下来。不过……你看呐！昨天我还穷得差点被回收，今天就有本钱自己清债开店了。我现在只缺一段够抓人的揽客词，就能让瑟斯比脱颖而出……让人过耳不忘。哦，差点忘了。比兹听说你的事了，说想跟你聊聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Nef's pushing ahead with activating that coolant tower. But it's not ready. My engineers need a mineral, Amarast, to counter the inevitable heat cascade. I've marked an excavation site where you should find some. Bring it back, and maybe we stop the entire Vallis from being bathed in slag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 奈富急于启动冷却塔，但它还没修复好。我的工程师们需要一种叫紫苋石的矿物，来抵消不可避免的热能倾泻。我标记了一个挖掘场，你应该能在那找到矿石。把东西带回来，也许我们能阻止整座山谷化为熔渣火海。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: That should be enough. Get to the coolant tower before Nef turns on the juice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 这些应该够了。把它送到冷却塔，不要让奈富抢先启动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Understand this, Solaris: you are all replaceable. Corpus Engineers are more expensive but far cheaper than the loss of an Orokin coolant tower! Fifty Solaris now, or the lot of Fortuna tomorrow. The Void commands it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 听好了，索拉里斯人。你们都是可替代的。雇科普斯工程师是不便宜，但比起损失一座奥罗金冷却塔，那可便宜太多了！今天是五十个索拉里斯人，明天就是整个福尔图娜。这是虚空的旨意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Ever since Nef crushed Solaris United, killed my friends, I've focused on one thing, keeping him happy. Thought it was the only way to keep people safe. It's not working. Biz is right, someone needs to say something. Do something. Listen. You don't have to help. You can leave Fortuna and never come back. Wouldn't blame ya', this isn't your fight. But, Sparky, Nef's massing his troops outside our doors. And you're the only thing standing between us and bloody oblivion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 自从奈富摧毁索拉里斯联盟，杀了我的朋友，我脑子里就只剩一件事，那就是讨他的欢心。我以为只有这样才能护住大家。可我错了。比兹说得对，必须得有人站出来说点什么，做点什么。听好，你可以不帮忙，也可以离开福尔图娜，永远别回来。我不会怪你，毕竟这不关你的事。不过，小火花，奈富已经把部队集结在大门外了。现在就只有你才能让我们大家免遭血光之灾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Sparky, Nef's massing his troops outside our doors. And you're the only thing standing between us and bloody oblivion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 小火花，奈富已经把部队集结在大门外了。现在就只有你才能让我们大家免遭血光之灾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Knew I could trust you. Take this, there's a present in there for the mucking Taxmen. Why don't you deliver it to them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我就知道信得过你。拿上这个，我给该死的税务官们备了一份大礼。不如你去送给他们吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: What are you trying to do, Eudico? Buy him off? You've lost it. Wait. Where's my K-bomb?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 你到底想干什么，尤迪科？收买他？没用的。等一下，我的 K 型动力炸弹哪去了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Amarast? Do you not understand? Nothing you do will make Nef kind. The more you give, the more he'll take. When you rise up, people get hurt, but if we left that fear divide us… it will only get worse. I saw a Eudico I haven't seen for years back there. Fortuna needs that Eudico back. We need Vox.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 紫苋石？你还不明白吗？不论你做什么，奈富都不会发善心。你越退让，他越得寸进尺。我们反抗确实会有伤亡，可要是任凭恐惧将我们撕裂……情况只会越来越糟。尤迪科，你刚才的样子我已经好几年没见过了。福尔图娜需要那样的你，我们需要索拉里斯之声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Solaris. This disaster is your bumbling. Present me your Floor Boss.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 索拉里斯人，这场灾难都是你们这群蠢货一手造成的。把你们的现场负责人叫来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: I… I am. Floor Boss Eudico FB-9. I take responsibility for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我……我就是。现场负责人，尤迪科 FB-9。我为这一切负责。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Finally. One of you shows some backbone. Floor Boss, select fifty workers of low efficiency and have them in front of Fortuna for repo. Their upgrades I shall bequeath to Solaris of greater efficiency. And for the failures: brain-shelving. Make your list. You have one orbit-hour.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 总算是有人肯拿出点骨气了。现场负责人，挑选五十个效率低下的工人，押到福尔图娜门前接受回收。他们的强化零件，我会赐给效率更高的索拉里斯人。至于那些残次品，移除大脑上架封存。去列名单。给你一个轨道时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Eudico?!? You're not going through with this, are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 尤迪科？！你不是认真的吧？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Not now, Biz.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 别说了，比兹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Solaris! The investor showcase is tomorrow and you lot still maintain the coolant tower is not ready. Have you no faith? My test-run will commence now, and the Board shall know it was I, Nef Anyo, who brought the glory of the Orokin to life once more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 索拉里斯人！投资人展示会明天就要举办了，你们这群废物还没把冷却塔准备好。你们难道没有信仰吗？我现在就要开始试运行，让董事会知道，是我奈富·安尤让奥罗金科技的荣光再次闪耀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: He's starting already? Nef's gonna trigger a heat cascade if he boots that coolant tower up without the Amarast. He's going to get us all killed. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 他这就要开始了？如果奈富不加紫苋石就强行启动冷却塔，一定会引发热能倾泻。他会害死我们所有人。赶快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Solaris! Why isn't it working? Fix this!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 索拉里斯人！为什么没反应？还不修好它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: We're… too late. Come back to Fortuna, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我们……来迟了。回福尔图娜吧，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Are you averse to getting your hands dirty? Send a message? I've learned that the head of the Corpus repo squad has a made a hit-list of indebted Solaris. Before his goons can do their thing, I've got a K-Bomb with his name on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 不介意弄脏双手吧？顺便帮我捎个口信。我收到风声，科普斯回收小队头领手里有份猎杀名单，专挑欠债的索拉里斯人下手。你要赶在他的打手动手之前，替我送颗 K 型动力炸弹给他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Biz! That's not what we discussed! Wait. There's a repo list? Who's on it? Ah, crap. Okay fine, but we do this my way. No K-Bombs, had about enough mess for one day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 比兹！咱们说好的可不是这样！等等，回收名单？上面都有谁？啊，该死。好吧，但这次得按我的规矩来。不许再用 K 式炸弹，今天的乱子已经够多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[4.1]
Hey fellas! Thursby? Nah, ya just missed him. He…
[8.8]
No, I didn't do nothing. You don't understand.
[13.8]
Stop. Ahh…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[4.1]
喂，哥几个！瑟斯比？哎呀，他刚刚还在这。他……
[8.8]
不，我什么都没干。你们搞错了。
[13.8]
住手。啊……住手……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Remember friends, forgo hard work for cheating and stealing, and the Void will judge not just you, but the collective. Lift together, punished together. If you lot continue along this path, I'll gladly repossess all your rigs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 记住，朋友们。如果你们放弃努力工作，而去偷蒙拐骗，那么虚空不仅会审判你，还会审判你身边的人。你们一荣俱荣，一损俱损。如果你们继续执迷不悟，我也不介意回收你们的义肢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Thursby... I was... I was supposed to protect him, and now he's in pieces. The medics aren't sure if they can stabilize him with… so much… missing. This was a mistake, letting you get involved. Why did I listen to Biz? Maybe it's not too late to impress Nef before his big unveiling. Appeal to his mercy - show him what we can do. Get topside. I'll fill you in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 瑟斯比……我本该保护好他的，结果他现在被拆得支离破碎。他……被拆走……那么多器官，连医生也不确定能不能稳住他的伤势。让你牵扯进来就是个错误。我怎么就信了比兹的鬼话？我们应该赶在奈富的揭幕仪式之前讨好他，也许还来得及。求他发发善心——向他证明我们还有用。上去吧，我跟你细说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: They were in debt because they choose the calling of conservation over filling Nef's pockets. It seems like the preacher wanted to make a point. But… this isn't the whole team. We need more info, search the bodies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 他们会欠下债，只因为他们选择保护生灵，而不是替奈富填满腰包。看来那位传教士想杀鸡儆猴。不过……我的小队不止这几个人。我们需要更多线索，搜一下尸体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Repo squad leader. That's the one that terrorizes the lower habs. He's responsible for this, and so much worse. Sparky: show him what it's like to have your arms ripped off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 是回收小队头领。在底层居住区作威作福的就是他。他干的坏事多了去了，可不止这么点。小火花，让他也尝尝胳膊被卸掉的滋味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: That's the Eudico I remember.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 那才是我印象中的尤迪科。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: My team's being held nearby. Awaiting 'processing'. Eudico, we don't have long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 幸存者就被关在附近，等待被「处理」。尤迪科，我们没时间了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Not again... Listen, Sparky. I need you to get in there and get our people back. And you don't need to be nice about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 又来这一套……听好，小火花。我需要你杀进去，把我们的人救出来。压根不用跟他们客气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Here come the Taxmen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 税务官来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: You have no business on the Vallis, betrayer. This is an internal matter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 山谷里的事还轮不到你插手，叛徒。这是我们内部的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Tenno, did you think I didn't notice your little heist earlier? Quite a stunt you pulled with that young, what was his name? Thursby...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: Tenno，你以为我没发现你们之前的小偷小摸吗？你和那小子演得挺来劲啊。他叫什么来着？瑟斯比？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Oh no. Tenno, you have to get back here before they get to him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 噢，不。Tenno，赶快回来，别让他们把他抓走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: You're nearing the secure area. Steal that list. Don't get noticed. If they destroy the data, we won't know who to hide from Nef's repo squad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 你快到安保区了。把名单偷出来。别惊动他们。如果他们销毁了数据，我们就没法知道是哪些人被奈富的回收小队盯上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: We do this quietly and maybe, just maybe, Nef doesn't find out. Biz, this isn't the old days. We've got no leverage now. All we can do is try to save our people from getting ground up by the bureaucracy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我们悄悄行动，也许，我是说也许，奈富不会发现。比兹，今时不同往日，我们现在手里没有任何筹码。我们唯一能做的，就是尽量在这体制下保全我们的人民。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: People are already 'getting ground up', Eudi. Debt on debt, accident by accident, repo by repo! How many even remember actual freedom?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 人们已经快被「压垮」了，尤迪科。旧债添新债，事故连着事故，没完没了的回收！还有几个人记得自由到底是什么滋味？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Accessing the file… Okay, okay, Ah, guts. Biz. This says they're going after your field team… today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 正在读取文件……好，好。啊，完了。比兹，这上面说他们要对付你的现场行动小组……就在今天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: They're already overdue for a check-in. Outworlder, you need find my team before Nef's repo squad does.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我们说好的联络时间已经过了。异世者，你必须赶在奈富的回收小队前找到我的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text:
[3.5]
What? Don't recognize me? It's Thursby!
[5.8]
Look what Biz and Eudico put together.
[12.2]
Top shelf parts. Not just that, Biz gave me enough spare stock to start my own shop.
[16.2]
Legs' Pets & Parts. That's my new name: Legs
[22.3]
Don't call me Thursby no more. I got a new body, new store, new hook, new name.
[27.2]
Come back any time, and Legs'll build a Moa just for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText:
[3.5]
怎么，不认识我了？我是瑟斯比呀！
[5.8]
瞧瞧比兹和尤迪科给我组装的行头。
[12.2]
全是顶级的零件。不光如此，比兹还给了我足够的备货让我开店。
[16.2]
「腿哥宠物和零件店」。对，我的新名字就叫——腿哥。
[22.3]
以后可别叫我瑟斯比了。我有了新身体、新店面、新的揽客词，还有新名字。
[27.2]
随时欢迎回来，腿哥专门给你组一台恐鸟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Outworlder. You've altered the calculus in the Vallis to our favor. Thank you. A… pity… it took young Thursby's tragedy to… motivate Eudico to take up the mantle of leadership once more. But she is the leader Solaris United needs… and tragedy is the unavoidable cost of progress. I'll make sure Thursby gets up on his new feet. I... owe it to him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 异世者，你帮我们扭转了山谷的局势。谢谢你。只可惜……在瑟斯比遭此一劫后，才逼得……尤迪科重新扛起领袖的责任。可她正是索拉里斯联盟需要的领袖，而前进道路上往往避免不了悲剧的发生。我会让瑟斯比在福尔图娜重新立足。我……欠他的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: Are you in debt, Solaris? Then you need to push yourself, work harder, longer. The Void does not give unto the freeloader.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 欠债了吗，索拉里斯人？那你们更得逼自己一把，干得更卖力些、工时再拉长些。虚空不会眷顾好吃懒做的废物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: I was once like you. Poor. Indebted. Lazy. Then The Void spoke to me. It said: "work harder." And so I did. I earned what I have. And now, Fortuna, it's your turn. Listen to The Void. Work. Harder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我也曾和你们一样，贫穷、欠债、懒惰。后来，虚空向我降下神谕，它说：「更努力些。」于是我照做了。我靠打拼挣来了今天的一切。现在轮到你们了，福尔图娜。聆听虚空的教诲吧。努力，再努力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.text: I, Nef Anyo, with the will of the Void, have turned this wasteland into a paradise of profit. Soon, I will perform another miracle, the resurrection of a final dormant coolant tower. Praise be the Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaIntroQu.zhText: 我，奈富·安尤，秉承虚空的意志，把这片废土一手打造成了利润的天堂！很快，我会展现新的奇迹，让最后一座休眠的冷却塔重获新生。赞美虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Files extracted and they hardly laid a round on that CoilDrive! Whatever it's carrying is all yours! OK, analyzing data...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 文件提取完毕，而且他们几乎没怎么伤到线圈滚轮！它运的东西全归你！好了，开始分析数据……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Done! They hardly touched that CoilDrive either. Just gonna need a second to make sense of this info.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搞定！他们也没怎么伤到线圈滚轮。给我点时间，把这些情报理清楚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: In and out, quick and clean. Got us a solid lead on our objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 进得快，撤得利索。我们拿到了直指目标的可靠线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Stand down! We need the Coildrive to hit that trap!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 停手！得让线圈滚轮撞上陷阱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Are you trying to blow this whole operation? Stand down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你想把整个行动搞砸吗？住手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: What are you doing? If that Coildrive doesn't hit the trap this whole operation's toast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你在干什么？线圈滚轮没撞上陷阱，整个行动就完了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Boom! It's down. Now get me access to its datamass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 砰！它瘫痪了。现在帮我接入它的数据块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: It's down! Now crack the casing and plug me into the datamass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 它停下了！撬开外壳，把我接入数据块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Perfect! Coildrive disabled. Aaaand the board just lit up. Corpus response is enroute. Get me access to that datamass, quick as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 完美！线圈滚轮已瘫痪。指示面板果然全亮灯了。科普斯反应部队正在赶来。帮我接入数据块，越快越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky... I can't hack this thing if it goes boom. Keep 'em off it. Not kidding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花……这玩意儿要是炸了，我就没法入侵了。别让他们靠近。不带开玩笑的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That Coildrive is almost wrecked, Sparky. Do something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 线圈滚轮就快报废了，小火花。想点办法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: If the datamass is shattered I'm not gonna be able to pull zip out of it! Protect it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 数据块要是碎了，我可就半点东西都扒不出来了！保护好它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I have it on sensors. Once it hits the trap get down there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 感应器锁定它了。一旦它中招，立刻过去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: There it is! Steady... Steady...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 来了！稳住……稳住……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Do you see it? It's headed right for the trap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 看见了吗？它正往陷阱开呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That CoilDrive copped some damage, but whatever you find in there is yours. SU thanks you kindly. OK, analyzing data...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那台线圈滚轮受了点损伤，不论里面能翻出什么，都归你。索联感谢你。好了，分析数据……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Yes! Hack complete! We have what we came for. Checking it's datamass. One second.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好样的！黑进去了！我们要的东西到手了。我看看数据块里有什么。稍等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We got it! Ha! The CoilDrive's a mess, but it looks like some of its cargo survived. Gimme a second to analyze the data it was hauling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 得手了！哈哈！线圈滚轮已被毁坏，不过好像有些货逃过了一劫。给我点时间，分析一下它运载的数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's got a CoilDrive patrolling the Vallis. Ambush it and I'll rip the datamass. It'll provide key info on what we're looking for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富派了一台线圈滚轮在山谷巡逻。伏击它，我来扒数据块。那里面应该有我们要找的关键情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I need you to ambush a Coildrive. Plant an EMP mine, disable the 'drive, then protect it. Once I've ripped its datamass, get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我需要你去伏击一台线圈滚轮。埋个电磁脉冲地雷，让它瘫痪，再守住它。等我把数据块扒出来，你就马上撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Our informant reports a CoilDrive running a standard picket. Prep for ambush.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们的线人报告，有台线圈滚轮正在执行例行巡逻。准备伏击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Our informant took a risk sending us the Coildrive's route. Don't let it be for nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 线人冒着风险才把线圈滚轮的路线图送出来。别让这番心血白费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We need you in position to hit that Coildrive. What's the hold up?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你得赶去伏击位置截住那台线圈滚轮。怎么还没到位？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky? I'm not reading you at the ambush coordinates. Something wrong?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花？伏击地点没看见你的信号。有情况？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hold position. Once the Coildrive hits the trap, protect it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 原地待命。线圈滚轮一中招，就立刻保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sit tight, and get ready to move. Once the trap goes off the Taxmen are going to respond.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 沉住气，准备行动。陷阱一触发，收税佬就会立刻反扑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Wait for the trap, then get down there. Remember: if I'm going to rip its datamass we need that Coildrive in one piece.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 等陷阱触发，再赶过去。记住，要想我把数据块扒出来，必须保证那台线圈滚轮完好无损。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Making progress. Keep the Corpus off this thing just a bit longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 在处理了。别让科普斯士兵靠近，再撑一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Getting there, getting there. Just keep that Coildrive in one piece for a little longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 快了，快好了。保证线圈滚轮完好无损，再多撑一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Going as fast as I can but this datamass has some seriously tangled architecture. Gonna need you to buy me more time, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我已经尽快了，但这个数据块的架构非常复杂。还得帮我再争取点时间，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I'm seeing alerts kicking off across the board. Don't let up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 各处的警报都响了。别停手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You got their attention. Keep it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你引起他们的注意了。保持住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They just woke up to what you're doin'. Now let's see who comes crawlin' outta the pipes. Keep goin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们才反应过来你在干嘛。现在看看有谁会从管道里钻出来。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Record time, Sparky! Biz should feel envious. And you've drawn out our man. Bring 'im down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 破纪录了，小火花！这速度比兹听了都得眼红。猎物也被你引出来了。放倒他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That might be some kind of speed record, Sparky. Whoop! They're onto us, not gonna be able to steal anything else. Now hit that target before he's a vapor trail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这搞不好都能破某项纪录了，小火花。嚯！他们盯上我们了，这下没法偷别的了。在目标一溜烟逃走前，赶紧干掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Cleaned them out before they could blink! Hurry! The target's spooked!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们还没来得及眨眼，钱就被薅光了！快！目标被惊着了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They figured out what we're up to, right on schedule. Nothing gets a Taxman to pop his head up like threatening his income stream. Leg it, he won't linger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们发现我们在搞什么了，时间正好。只要断了收税佬的财路，就不怕他不露头。动作快，他可不会久留。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Excellent. We can use those credits to help people. Now: response scrambled aaaaand we got a target. Go get 'im Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 太好了。这笔钱应该能帮上不少人。现在，敌人的应急响应已被扰乱，我们也锁定了目标。去干掉他，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Money's in the bag, and there he is. Right on schedule. Target marked. Take him down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 钱已到手，他也现身了。时间正好。目标已标记。干掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Not sure why, but some of the Corpus higher-ups think this mucker's important. Hit his funds, take him out, steal his access codes and let's see what happens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 不知道为什么，有些科普斯高层还真把这混蛋当回事。冻结他的资金、干掉他、抢走访问密码，看看能挖出什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Change of plan: Corpus VIP just stepped out. If we get his codes I can get some real info on what we're after. Give 'im the business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 计划有变，科普斯的大人物刚露面。要是能搞到他的访问密码，我就能挖出咱们真正要找的情报。好好招呼他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hey, Biz just had a word in my ear. I'm flagging a target. VIP's a nobody, but Biz says he has access to sensitive info. Info we can use to wrap this mission up good and proper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 嗨，比兹跟我通了气。我给你标个位置。这个大人物本身不值一提，但比兹说他有权限接触到机密情报。拿到那些情报，我们就能给任务画上圆满的句号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The current Corpus supervisor carries codes we can use to crack certain databases. Take him down. Steal those codes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这里的科普斯主管身上带着能破解某些数据库的密码。拿下他，把密码拿回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We're on a clock, friend. Move it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们赶时间，朋友。动起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: E's not pickin' his nose and talkin' to flies. You don't hit that target now we'll lose 'im!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 人家可不会傻站着等你。要是现在不动手，他可就溜了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You're cuttin' this close, Tenno. Too close. Hit that target sharpish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你的时间很紧了，Tenno。太悬了。赶快把目标干掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You've got a short window to steal enough credits that a high-value target sticks their head up. Then you kill him and we've got his money. Easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你只有很短的时间。得偷到足够多的现金，把重要目标逼出来。等他露头就干掉他，卷走他的钱。很简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nothing riles the Corpus like income loss. Steal their cash but do it fast - you don't have long. When the headman shows up, take him out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯最怕的就是少赚钱。偷走他们的现金，但动作要快——你的时间不多。当头领一现身，就干掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You got very little time to steal as much Corpus cash as you can. The VIP will be heading the Corpus response. Once he shows, kill him and make off with all that money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 时间很紧，能偷多少科普斯的现金就偷多少。重要目标会亲自带队反击。他一露面就干掉他，再带着那笔钱走人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: One less mucker makin' life harsh for us. Let's see what a quick look around his files tells us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 又少了一个为难我们的混蛋。快翻翻他的档案，看看能查出点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Deleted, and a kick in the ribs for the mighty Temple. A-ha. This looks useful. Yes. Solid lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 删除了，也算给高高在上的润盈殿狠狠来上了一脚。啊哈，这玩意看着有点用。嗯，靠谱的线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's operation just copped a serious limp and we're into their data structures... having a quick sticky-beak aaaand... yeah this looks promising. Gimme a sec.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富的行动刚刚遭受了重创，我们也黑进了他们的数据系统……快速瞄两眼……嗯，这个感觉有点料。等我一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus supervisor's carrying the datamass and we need to steal this camp from 'em. Find him and take it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯主管携带着数据块，而我们得用它来夺下这座营地。找到他，把数据块抢过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: All we need to control this area is the datamass being carried by the head Taxman. He'll be in there somewhere, lordin' it over the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 要控制这片区域，只差主管税务佬身上的数据块。他就在里面某处，正骑在别人头上作威作福呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: If you want to control this area find the Taxman who runs this camp. Take his datamass. Leave the rest to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 想拿下这片营地，就得找出管理这一带的收税佬。夺走他的数据块。剩下的交给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You copy? Green. Connection's good. We're open for business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 听得到吗？没问题。连接稳定。咱们开张了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: ...got your ears on? Wait. Boost the gain. There. We're live. Store's online.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: ……听得见吗？等等，增强一下信号。好了，线路通了，商店联网了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Camp is live. I got more work for you, and we can drop in whatever you need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 营地上线了。我这还有活儿，需要什么也可以给你空投过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We lost this one, but only for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这次我们栽了，但只是暂时的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We've failed. We'll try again later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 失败了。晚点再来试试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Base lost. We missed our shot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 基地没拿下。机会错过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hack nearly complete. Ish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 入侵马上完成。快了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Still working. Keep 'em off my back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 还在破解。别让他们来烦我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Gonna need a little more time, friend. Keep at it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 再给我一点点时间，朋友。顶住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Well, that kicked the nest. Taxmen on the way. Hold 'em off while I finish up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好吧，这下捅马蜂窝了。收税佬正在赶来。在我完成之前挡住他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: ... aaaaand here come the Taxmen. Keep 'em busy while I colonize the base system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: ……收税佬果然来了。在我收编基地系统之前，给他们找点事做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus incoming. They'll try to stop what I'm doing. Prefer they didn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯要来了。他们想要阻止我。我可不希望他们得逞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Slot the datamass and I'll start the hack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 把数据块插进去，我这就开始入侵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That'll get me past the first layer of security. Plug the datamass into the terminal, then make sure I'm not bothered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有了它，我就能绕过第一层安防。把数据块插入终端机，别让人来打扰我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Green. Slot that datamass into the base terminal and I'll get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 正常。把数据块插进基地的终端机，轮到我发挥了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Just so you know: we hack that terminal and your current base is gonna go dark.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 提醒你一下，我们已经黑进了终端机，你目前所在的基地会断网。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I can hack that terminal, but your current base is gonna disconnect if I do. Your call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我可以黑进那台终端，但这样一来，你当前所在的基地将断开连接。你来决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I can hack that terminal if you wanna trade the base you got for this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 想拿你现有的基地来换这里的话，我可以帮你黑进那台终端。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The artifact was unearthed during routine mineral extraction. I located the excavators that made the find. Commandeer them so I can get a look at their logs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这件遗物是在常规挖矿时挖出来的。我找到了当时那批挖掘机。接管它们，让我查查里头的记录。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They had the info alright AND we got a mineral haul. Anyway, let's make use of this lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 日志里不仅有情报，还顺手捞了一批矿。好，顺着这条线索查下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I might have a lead on our courier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我可能有条线索，关于要找的运送目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: So some locals heard about the artifact, figured they'd go after it themselves. Rescue them, Sparky. If nothing else they can tell us what direction the Coildrive was headed in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有些当地人听说了遗物的风声，打算自己去分一杯羹。救救他们，小火花。好歹他们还能告诉我们线圈滚轮的去向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: And let that be a lesson, yeah? I'll have Biz drop by with medical supplies, patch you up. Sparky, we got a lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这次长记性了吧？我会让比兹送点医疗物资过去，给你们处理伤口。小火花，有线索了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Courier located. Its a Coildrive. Intercept and disable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 运送目标已锁定。是台线圈滚轮。拦截并阻止它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Artifact secured! And a few other things besides. Take what you can and get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 遗物安全到手！另外有几样添头。能拿多少拿多少，然后撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A recently unearthed Orokin artifact is being couriered to Nef's command. Find the courier and liberate the artifact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一件刚出土的奥罗金遗物正运往奈富的指挥部。找到运送目标，别让遗物落到他手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus geographical survey teams keep core samples as part of their work. Find me the samples and I'll get Smokefinger to tell me where on the Vallis they were digging.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯地质勘察队会留存岩芯样本。把样本找来，我就能让烟指判断他们究竟在山谷哪里开挖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Smokefinger's narrowed down the possible location of the dig site. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 烟指缩小了发掘点的范围。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Finding the dig site won't be easy, but maybe we can take a closer look at Corpus activity in the area and narrow it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 想找到发掘点可不容易，不过可以仔细研究一下科普斯在这一带的活动轨迹，缩小范围。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus geographical survey teams submit reports to central outposts. Marking the nearest one. Get in there, go through those surveys and find a lead on the Orokin dig site.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯地质勘察队会向中央前哨站提交报告。我标记了最近的一处。潜进去，翻翻那些勘察报告，找出奥罗金发掘点的线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Perfect. They found something alright. And I have an idea that might get us closer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 不错。他们真找到好东西了。而且我有个点子，能让我们离目标更近一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Triangulations based on collected data puts the Corpus dig site around about... here. Marked. Now, get over there and start digging.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 按收集到的数据做了三角定位，科普斯的发掘点大概在……这里。标好了。过去开挖吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We took some hits but, baby, we hit paydirt. I've got a rail agent on standby, ready to ship these artifacts offworld pronto. Good work, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 是挨了点打，但亲爱的，咱们算是挖到宝了。我安排了一名航道特工待命，马上把这些遗物运往星外。干得很好，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Smokefinger believes the Corpus have located Orokin relics. Do some research. Find the dig site and salvage them before the Taxmen can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 烟指认为科普斯找到了一批奥罗金遗物。去查查，找到发掘点，赶在收税佬之前把遗物抢救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Incoming Coildrive! These things often serve as prisoner escorts. Any money it knows about those missing rail agents.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有台线圈滚轮过来了！这铁疙瘩经常用来押送俘虏。我敢打赌，它知道那些失踪航道特工的下落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This Coildrive escorted a Corpus contingent tasked with engaging the rail agents. Last whereabouts... ok. Got something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这台线圈滚轮曾护送过一支奉命围剿航道特工的科普斯小队。最后的行踪……好，有线索了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: If we're gonna find those missing rail agents we need to hack the surveillance network. Bring down a drone. Marking one now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 想找到那些失踪的航道特工，就必须入侵监控网络。先击落一台无人机，我现在标给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: OK, we got something. The agents are still on the Vallis. But where? Think. OK, got an idea.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好，我们有收获。特工们还在山谷里，可到底在哪儿？我想想。啊，有主意了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Biz tried to contact the rail agents. No response. That's never good. Let's try this first:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 比兹联系过那些航道特工，却无人回应。感觉不是好兆头。先试试这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've analyzed our collected data. I've marked the rail agents last known location. Move fast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我分析了收集到的数据。还标出了航道特工最后出现的位置。动作快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Some casualties, but the mission's a success. We got the artifact, and those rail agents will think twice before hotdropping into the Vallis again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有些伤亡，但任务成功了。遗物到手，那些航道特工下次再想空降山谷，应该会先掂量掂量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Word from Biz is that some offworld Solaris rail agents are trying to rob an Orokin ruin. They have no idea what they're up against, find them before the Corpus do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 比兹传来消息，说有群在星外跑运输的索拉里斯航道特工，正打算洗劫奥罗金遗迹。他们根本不知道自己惹上了什么，赶在科普斯之前找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Here's the plan: You're gonna tear up everything he's built. He'll have to show or lose face. Then you put him out of business. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 计划是这样，把他建起来的东西砸个稀巴烂。他要是不露面，脸上可就挂不住了。等他现身，你就可以让他永远消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We smashed his assets, now hit the target where he lives. Rob this bank. And when he shows up, close his account.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们砸了他的产业，现在去直捣黄龙。抢了这家银行，等他露面，就销了他的户。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A regular stiletto in the night you are! It was over before it began. Polite applause, Sparky. Polite applause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你简直就像夜色里的夺命匕首！他们还没反应过来就结束了。礼貌鼓掌，小火花。礼貌鼓掌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: One particular Taxman overseer's been giving us no end of trouble. We've tried to hit him before, but he always disappears.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有特别难缠的收税工头一直在找我们的麻烦。以前也动过他，但他总能像泥鳅一样溜掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Alright. Let's deal with the first order of business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好，我们先办头等大事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Here we go. The main prize. Protect those excavators!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 来了，重头戏。守住那些挖掘机！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Done and done. We've got weapons to make, vehicles to repair, bodies to mend and this right here is gonna make it possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 齐活。有武器要造，有车要修，身体还得修理，有了这批资源就都不成问题了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus extractors are inbound. Once they get here you're gonna hijack them. Meanwhile I have a few things for you to take care of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯挖掘机马上到。一旦设备就位，你就立刻接管。同时，我还有几件事要你去处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The Overseer's panicking. The only way he's gonna show is if his cash is threatened. Steal it: crates and goons are both carryin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 工头已经慌了神了。只有断了他的财路，才能把他逼出来。偷他个一干二净。箱子和他打手身上都装着钱呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: So long, ya sack a crap. That particular worker-control network is in ruins and its Overseer is dead. They'll install another, they always do, but this gives dozens of workers a clean slate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 再会了，你们这些渣滓。这套劳工管控体系已经垮了，工头也死了。他们迟早会再换一个，向来如此。但至少能让几十个工人迈向新生活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Surveillance, Sparky, is key to keeping people oppressed. Let's go poke him in a few floating eyes. Hard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花，监视可是压迫大家的关键。咱们去戳瞎几只飘在天上的眼睛。往死里戳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Surveillance system offline. Now, what else has he built that we can kick over?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 监视系统瘫痪了。现在看看，他还有什么家当能让我们踹翻？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We'll start with somethin' easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 先从简单的入手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We're gonna wipe the debt ledgers stored at my waypoint. Break-in, we'll do a little hacking, and Fortuna's day gets a whole lot brighter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们要去清空存放在我标记位置的债务账本。闯进去，稍微动点手脚，福尔图娜的天就能亮堂不少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Network wiped. Debts cleared. Now: let's dismantle the next element of this mucker's crappy little empire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 系统已清空，债务一笔勾销。接下来，去拆掉这破烂帝国的下一个据点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Your target is a worker-control network. Dismantle it from the bottom up: wreck their infrastructure, then target the Overseer. Give 'em the business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 目标是一套劳工管控体系。从下往上瓦解它。先毁掉基础设施，再收拾工头。给他们点颜色看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Y'know what? Let's wrap this up. Endgame. Maximum destruction. Every Corpus unit is a target. Give 'em the business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 知道吗？来收个尾吧。最终决战，拉满火力打。所有科普斯士兵都是目标。好好招呼他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Haha! They think they're under attack from a Tenno assault force. I wish you could hear this. Sparky, you make my day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈哈！他们以为自己撞上了一整支 Tenno 突击队。真想让你也听听。小火花，你帮我出了口恶气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Intercept patrols, engage Corpus forces, hack their networks and take off with their resources. Let's start simple.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 拦截巡逻队，迎战科普斯部队，入侵网络，顺走他们的资源。先从简单的来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's running training drills. Fresh units on maneuvres all over. Good opportunity to kneecap their morale.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富正在搞训练演习。到处都是新兵在拉练。正好狠狠挫一下他们的士气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Found the cove running this little ant-farm. Found where he keeps his stuff, too. Take that. Vaporise him. Move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 找到这个蚂蚁窝的头头了。他藏宝贝的地方也找到了。把东西拿走，再让他消失。然后继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Aaand there goes their unit cohesion. Can't protect a stockpile if you can't protect your own rear end now, can ya? Movin' on then.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 然后他们就树倒猢狲散了。要是连自己的屁股都护不住，还拿什么守物资？咱们继续吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Stockpile security's thick. Step One: Draw security away. Step Two: Robbery. Let's get started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 储备库守得很严。第一步是把守卫引开。第二步直接开抢。动手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: OK. Security is thin and scattered, but they will regroup fast. Let's get what we came for. Move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好了，守卫被打散了，不过他们很快就会重新集结。拿上我们要的东西。行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Good haul! We've got projects that this ore is gonna prove invaluable for. We're done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 大丰收！这批矿石对我们的几个计划大有用处。我们撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: It'd be useful if we could draw off a bit more heat. Maybe infiltrate that security station over there, hack the emergency system and tell them the main base is on fire?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 最好再把火力引开。要不潜入那边的安保站，然后入侵应急系统，告诉他们主基地着火了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They'll figure out it's a false alarm before long, but we're not gonna need that much time. Okay, next thing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们迟早会发现那是假警报的，不过对于咱们来说时间足够了。好了，下一项任务！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The target's a rare mineral stockpile. First we hurt em. Then, while they're reelin', we take everything they've got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 目标是一座稀有矿物储备库。先给他们点苦头吃。等他们乱了阵脚，再把东西全搬走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Forget it, they won this one. Get outta there, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 算了，这局算他们赢。撤吧，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Mission's a wash. We're done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 任务泡汤了。这没我们的事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We blew it. Gotta let this one go, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们搞砸了。这次只能认栽了，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Well. That made us look like amateurs. Maybe Biz would be willing to run you through Wetwork 101.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈，搞得我们跟外行似的。也许比兹会愿意给你补一堂「脏活入门」课。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: There's a big shipment coming in. Just not sure where it's headed. Maybe I can find a lead. Try this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有一大批货物要运来了，可还不知道会送去哪儿。也许我能查到线索。试试这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Getting what we need means faking our way into Corpus systems. Supply crates will contain passes that we can use. Find 'em. Steal 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 想弄到我们要的东西，就得冒充自己人混进科普斯的系统。补给箱里会有能用的通行密码。找到它们，然后拿走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Okay we can work with this. We got a code or two and it looks like a big shipment is coming in. Just need to find where...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好，这玩意能派上用场了。我们拿到了一两个密码，而且看样子还有一大批货要运来了。现在只差查清要运去哪……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The drone network gets antsy in the leadup to major deliveries. Let's dial that down. Break into this control station and lower the alert level.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 每逢重大运输任务前，无人机网络就会热闹得像热锅上的蚂蚁。让我们给它降降温。闯进控制站，调低警戒等级。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Alert level dropping to green. Good job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 警戒等级降到绿色了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Heads up! The parts Roky needs are beaming into the marked facility. Get over there and nab them before the Corpus can transport them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 注意！小洛要的零件正被运往标记设施。赶过去，趁科普斯把它们运走之前抢到手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: All done. Roky's already working out how to use it all. She says they're gonna... "skeg it up, super loud, all night." Oh. Good. Good good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 全搞定了。小洛已经在琢磨怎么用这批零件了。她说他们要……「嗨翻天，音响开到最大，嗨上一整夜」。年轻，好，挺好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Roky was wondering if you'd help her out. The Vent Pobbers are short on parts. Would you mind nicking some K-Drive bits from the Corpus?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小洛想请你帮个忙。通风泡博正缺零件。介不介意去科普斯那儿顺点 K 式悬浮板的零件回来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Drones are rich sources of Corpus metadata - just what we need. Got one marked. Take it down and I'll see what it knows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 无人机里有大量科普斯的元数据——我们要的就是这个。标记了一台。把它打下来，我看看它都记录了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nicely done! According to this drone our target keeps all his dirt off the grid in a secure facility. Sentimental value maybe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 干得好！根据这台无人机的记录，目标把所有黑料都离线藏在一座安全设施里。也许是留着当纪念。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You don't work shady without acquiring a few dirty secrets of your own. Need you to break into the investigators files and find anything we can use as leverage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 干这种见不得光的活，自己屁股上肯定也不干净。潜进调查员的档案库，找出能拿来当把柄的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Codes are stored at this marked location. They'll help us get into that secured facility, once we find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 密钥就存放在标记位置。等找到那座安全设施，用这些密钥就能进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sorted. Got the codes we're after. Onto the next step.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搞定，拿到我们要的密钥了。下一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Found it! He keeps all his sensitive information in this secured facility. Grab as much incriminating evidence as you can. We'll turn the tables on this lowlife and keep our people clear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 找到了！他把所有见不得光的资料都藏在这座严密设防的设施里。能搜集多少罪证就拿多少。咱们要反将这杂碎一军，保我们的人平安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Done! We've got enough to persuade this cove to turn his attentions elsewhere. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搞定！我们手里的把柄足够让这杂碎识趣地把目光移开了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A Corpus investigator is getting too close to our informants. Send him a message: look elsewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有个科普斯调查员好像盯上了我们的线人。给他递个话：别多管闲事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Drones are rich sources of Corpus metadata - just what we need to forge a credible cover story for our rail agent. Got one marked. Take it down and I'll see what it knows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 无人机里有大量科普斯的元数据——正好能给航道特工编造一套可信的身份背景。我标了一台。把它打下来，我看看它都记录了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Right. Rail tractor convoy inbound from Neptune. Using a variation of their hexadecimal callsigns I can forge a passkey once we hit orbital control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 没错，一队航道牵引机正从海王星驶来。只要接入轨道控制系统，我就能利用它们十六进制呼号的变体，伪造出密钥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We need the hexadecimal passkey for the orbital traffic network to forge that landing permit. The codes are changed daily, and beamed to this marked location. You intercept, I'll decrypt, and that gets us closer to what we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们需要轨道交通网络的十六进制通行密钥来伪造登陆许可。密钥每天都会更换，并发送到标记地点。你负责拦截，我负责解密，这样就离目标更近一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's it! The orbital network passkey. This data is exactly what we needed. Alright, next steps:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就是这个！轨道网络的通行密钥。正是我们需要的数据。好了，下一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A rail tractor loaded with supplies Solaris United desperately needs can't land til we forge a docking permit. We need a few things to make that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一艘满载索联急需补给的航道牵引机无法登陆，除非我们能伪造出登陆许可。我们得先准备点东西才能把事办成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Location marked. Hack the orbital traffic network and I'll use the information we stole to fabricate a landing permit for that rail agent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 位置已标记。入侵轨道交通网络，我会用偷来的资料，给那名航道特工伪造登陆许可。
