/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The supplies are en route to a docking platform. By the time they realize the landing permit was forged our rail agent will be in another system. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 补给正送往登陆平台。等他们发现许可是假的，我们的航道特工早就跑到别的星系了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A sympathetic rail agent needs a faked landing permit to get us supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有位愿意帮忙的航道特工，需要一份伪造的登陆许可，才能把补给送进来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Debt ledgers are stored on encrypted databanks. We need to find that debt processing center.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 债务账本存放在加密的数据库里。我们得找到那座债务处理中心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Right. When in doubt pull the brain out of a drone and see what it knows. We need to find that missing team before it's too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 对，遇事不决，就拆台无人机的脑袋，看看它知道什么。我们得赶在事情无法挽回之前，找到失踪的小队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I know they're part of a system of oppression, but some days I think we get as much info out of these things as Nef does. Solid lead. Listen up:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我知道它们是压迫系统的一环，可我有时候觉得，咱们从这些铁疙瘩身上挖到的情报一点不比奈富少。有条可靠的线索。听好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: If there's an interrogation unit out here, with prisoners, their resupply drop will reflect that. Marked an airdrop.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 如果附近真有支押着俘虏的审讯队，他们的空投补给肯定会暴露他们的位置。空投点标好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Yes! Based on the amount and nature of these supplies the team has prisoners. Hm, there was something in yesterday's dispatches. Something about.... oh of course. Right. It's a long shot, but here goes:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 没错！从补给数量和种类来看，那支队伍确实带着俘虏。嗯，昨天的调度报告里好像提到过。等等，当然。好，虽然把握不大，只能死马当活马医吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I need to bring my team home safe. First we need to know where they went. I have a lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我必须把我的人平安带回来。先查清他们去了哪儿。我有线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Best info says the team last reported in from somewhere in the marked area. Go look around.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有可靠情报显示，小队最后一次报告的位置，就在标记区域的某个地方。去那边找找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Losing people never gets easier. I'll pass their information on to our analysts and see what they make of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 牺牲带来的伤痛永远无法抚平。我会把他们的情报传给分析员，看看他们能查出什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I had a recon team keeping tabs on Nef's special operations unit. The team found something - something big - but went silent before they could pass the info on. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我派了一支侦察小队去盯着奈富的特种作战部队。小队发现了重要情报——但没来得及传回来就失联了。去找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Alright. I've found the base we're looking for. Plans for upcoming operations will be stored in lockboxes there. Take 'em and run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好，找到了基地。后续行动计划应该就锁在那儿的保险箱里。拿上就撤吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Golden. The info we have here is more than enough to keep our agents safe in the short term. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 成了。这些情报足够让我们的特工暂时避开危险。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The Corpus love paperwork, which means eventually someone slips up. The facility I've marked handles resource distribution. If the operations post we're looking for leaves a footprint, it'll be in the paperwork.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯热衷于搞文书工作，这意味着迟早会有人漏出马脚。我标记的设施负责处理资源调配。如果那座行动哨所留下过蛛丝马迹，那肯定能在文书里找到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A ha! I knew it! Listen to this:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈！我就知道！听听这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We know the plans are waiting for local commanders at a regional operations post, but where? Figuring that out is our first order of business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们知道计划正存放在区域行动哨所，等着当地指挥官去取，可哨所在哪儿呢？这就是头一件要查的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Infiltrate this facility I'm marking. We'll nose around their files, see what we can turn up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 潜入我标记的设施。翻翻他们的文件，看看能挖出什么料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Perfect. A list of commanders recieving the plans. This narrows things down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 完美。一份接收计划的指挥官名单。这下范围缩小了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Whisper network says upcoming operation plans just came down from Nef. I need to know those plans.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 底下情报网有消息说，奈富刚刚下发了下一步行动计划。我得搞清楚具体内容。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've got a Coildrive rolling a dodgy looking route. I reckon it might know something. Let's get this thing talking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我发现一台行迹可疑的线圈滚轮。估计它知道点什么。我们去撬开这玩意的嘴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I think I've pulled something useful from it's datamass. Here we go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我好像从它的数据块里挖到了点有用的东西。过来瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Spy drone near by. I want to check its patrol manifest, see if it mentions the debt processing center.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 附近有台间谍无人机。我想查查它的巡逻清单，看看里面有没有提到债务处理中心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ding, ding, ding. We have a winner. But... I need to cross reference something. Here we go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 叮，叮，叮。中大奖了。不过……我还得交叉比对点数据。来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Found it, the final account processing for all no-hopers facing full-body repossession. Find every last file, and I'll make sure their debts are wiped clean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 找到了，这里专门处理那些面临全身回收的人的最终账目。把文件全找出来，我保证把他们的债务抹得一干二净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is how you do it. Good people saved from brain-shelving and some very relieved families in Fortuna. Well done, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 各位，这就是我们的行事作风。好人避免了大脑被冷藏的命运，福尔图娜也有不少家庭终于能松口气了。干得好，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've just learned of a hab block with a high number of Solaris up for repo and brain-shelving. We're gonna erase their debt ledgers and give 'em a second chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我刚得知，有个居住区的大批索拉里斯人即将被全身回收，大脑也会被上架冷藏。咱们要抹掉他们的债务账本，给他们一次重来的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Coildrive patrol. A good source of info on troop movement and reinforcement. Hit it with an EMP mine and let's see what it can tell us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一台在巡逻的线圈滚轮。正好能查到部队动向和增援情报。用电磁脉冲地雷截停它，看看它能吐出点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Good job protecting the Coildrive. The info I pulled is... interesting. Can analyse it later. Let's move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 线圈滚轮保护得很好。我扒出来的情报……有点意思。晚点再分析，先继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Last step and we're done. There's a lone drone I want disabled. I'll raid its patrol logs, pair it with the other info you've assembled and that should provide good operational intelligence for a little while.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 最后一步，干完就收工。我想让你截停一台落单的无人机。我会把巡逻日志扒出来，再配上你收集的其他情报，够我们接下来用一阵子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Perfect! 100% memory download, intact. Oh this is good stuff. Top job, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 完美！内存完整下载，数据完好无损。噢，这可是好东西。干得好，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We need intel. Find out as much as you can about what the Corpus are currently up to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们需要情报。尽可能查清科普斯眼下在搞什么鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: If we want Corpus intel, go to the source. Infiltrate and hack their systems.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 想要科普斯的情报，就该直捣黄龙。潜进去，入侵他们的系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Good stuff. We can use this. Right, get out of there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好东西，派得上用场。行，赶紧撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Patrol. Recon. We need to know what's going on out there to better plan our next few operations.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 巡逻，侦察。我们得摸清外面的情况，才方便安排接下来的行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Your target is the ringleader of Nef's intimidation and interrogation efforts. I think it's time he had a performance review.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你的目标是负责奈富恐吓和审讯行动的头目。我想是时候给他做次绩效考核了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's one mucker nobody's gonna miss. Got a lead on his squad's operation. Let's move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那个混蛋死不足惜。我们拿到了他那支小队行动的线索。走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I need to learn the enforcement squad's next move. Drones know things. Knock one down and I'll interrogate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我得查清执法小队的下一步动向。无人机知道不少东西。打下一台，我来审它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The enforcement squad has a target. Those people are short on time. Let's move!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 执法小队锁定了目标。他们撑不了多久了。快走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: SU is back, but Nef's not taking it lying down. An enforcement squad is pulling citizens from their sleep racks, hauling them off for questioning. Shut down the squad and find any survivors. End this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 索联回来了，但奈富绝不会善罢甘休。一支执法小队正把市民从床架上拽起来，拖去审问。端掉那支小队，找到幸存者。做个了结。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky, the info you gathered points to an interrogation unit not far from you. Our people are in that area, make sure they're safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花，你收集的情报指向了离你不远的审讯小队。我们的人就在那片区域，确保他们安全。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We got 'em. Good work. We all know the risks, but losing people never gets easier. I'll pass their information on to our analysts and see what they make of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们救下他们了。干得好。我们都清楚风险，但牺牲带来的伤痛永远无法抚平。我会把他们的情报传给分析员，看看他们能查出什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's getting serious about finding us, he's abducting citizens and torturing them for info. Put a stop to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富为了揪出我们也是动真格了，他绑架市民并严刑拷打逼问情报。必须阻止他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Found a Coildrive sighting animals and alerting hunting parties. Intercept, and find out who and where it reports to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 发现一台线圈滚轮正在搜寻动物，给狩猎队报点。拦截它，查清楚它向谁、往哪儿汇报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I pulled the info we need. The hunting party is still in the area. Just need to find em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我拿到需要的情报了。狩猎队还在这一带。现在只差把他们找出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The hunting parties are using drones to sight animals. Take one down and find out what it knows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 狩猎队在用无人机侦察猎物。打下一台，看看它有没有记录。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This narrows our search significantly. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这下搜索范围小多了。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Humane.... that's not a word I'd use to describe the traps used by the Corpus Feed and Research division. So let's make sure they can't use them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯的饲育与研究部门用的那些陷阱……绝对谈不上人道。所以必须确保别让他们用上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Here's the shipment. Empty everything, I'll make sure the traps get destroyed. Hurry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 货就在这儿。把东西搬空。陷阱交给我销毁。快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Score one for the mammals of the Vallis. Biz, sends his regards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 算是替山谷的哺乳动物扳回一城。比兹托我给你带个好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus Feed and Research Division is expecting a shipment of baits and traps. Biz want us to make sure they never get those supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯的饲育与研究部门正在等着接收一批诱饵和陷阱。比兹要我们确保这批货永远送不到他们手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've got a lead. Listen up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我有条线索。听好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This is what I know. Our agent hid her field notes in a data vault deep in the heart of Nef's facility. Get in there and retrieve those notes before they're destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 据我所知，我们的特工把她的外勤记录藏在奈富设施核心的数据密库里。潜进去，赶在记录被销毁前拿回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Weapons shipments, troop movements, security targets. So this is what Nef is up to. Our agent, she paid dearly for this info, but it's gonna save people's lives.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 武器运输、部队调动、安保目标……原来奈富在打这个算盘。我们的特工为这些情报付出了惨痛的代价，但这足以挽回许多人的性命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky, hold up. Our agent's support unit activated their emergency beacon. They went looking for her. I told them not to. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花，稍等。我们特工的支援小队启动了紧急信标。他们去找她了，我明明交代他们别去。找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Our agent is dead but her mission must go on, listen up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们的特工牺牲了，但她的任务必须继续，听好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's up to something - personnel transfers, strange shipments, odd silences. I tasked an agent on the inside with finding out more, and then they went quiet. Find out what you can and, if you have to, finish the agent's mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富肯定在打什么鬼算盘——人员调动、古怪的运输路线，还安静得反常。我派了名内线去探探底，结果人就失联了。尽你所能去查清楚，必要的话，替她完成任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've located the Coildrive! Remember: if I'm going to upload the virus to the network we need that CoilDrive in one piece.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 找到线圈滚轮了！记着，必须保证那台线圈滚轮完好无损，我才能把病毒传进网络。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Yes! Upload complete! Haha! Look at that virus spread. This is really gonna help us keep one step ahead of the Taxmen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 漂亮！上传完毕！哈哈！瞧瞧这病毒扩散得多快。以后咱们就能一直抢在收税佬前头了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Alright. We need to find that Coildrive if I'm going to upload the virus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好。想上传病毒的话，就得先找到那台线圈滚轮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky, a scout team just had a run-in with the Coildrive we're after... and came off second best. Find any survivors and find that Drive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花，一支侦察小队刚撞上了我们在找的那台线圈滚轮……结果吃了大亏。找找有没有幸存的队员，再把那台线圈滚轮找出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You saved who you could and they had good intel on the Coildrive's whereabouts. Let's act on it:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 能救的你都救下了，他们也掌握了线圈滚轮去向的可靠情报。按线索行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Comms from that CoilDrive suggest a resource drop at the waypoint. Intercept that drop and see what you can find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那台线圈滚轮的通讯显示，有个资源空投会落在路标点。拦截那个空投，看看你能找到什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Done. One of those crates had an action manifest for the Coildrive. This is a big step forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搞定。其中一个箱子有线圈滚轮的行动清单。这可是个大收获。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I'm looking for a datamapping Coildrive with a direct line to Nef's central server. You get me access to that CoilDrive's systems and I can upload a virus to the network.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我在找一台负责数据测绘的线圈滚轮，它能直连奈富的中央服务器。只要让我接入它的系统，我就能把病毒送进他们的内网。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Intercept resupply drops. The Corpus will swarm in and I'll calculate a point of origin, which should get us closer to that resource field. Easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 拦截空投补给。科普斯部队肯定会蜂拥而来，我就能反推出他们的出发点，顺着找到那片矿区。简单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Well, that worked. Okay here's what I got.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 喔，成了。好，看看都搞到了什么东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The subcontractor hired to perform the dig will have made a claim. Need you to recover any record of that claim.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 承包开采的分包商肯定登记过采矿权。你得把相关记录全都找回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Here's the claim. Guts, it's even bigger than I thought. Let's get moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 采矿权记录就在这。天啊，这规模比我想的还大。我们动手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Finding their latest resource field is gonna be tricky, but I've got a lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 想找到他们新开的矿区可不容易，不过我有线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This is it! The resource field we've been looking for. Excavators incoming!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就是这儿！我们一直在找的矿区。挖掘机正在投放！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Good haul! Resources enroute to Solaris United. Ah, I need more days like this. We're done here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 大丰收！资源正在运往索拉里斯联盟。啊，真希望天天都过这样的好日子。咱们的任务完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The Taxmen have located a rich resource vein, but are keeping it hush-hush. We're gonna locate their operation and take that haul for ourselves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 收税佬探明了一条资源丰富的矿脉，却捂得严严实实。咱们去找出他们的采矿点，然后把资源收下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've detected a Coildrive patrolling a bizarre route. Maybe guarding the vault we're after. Take it down, I'll hack its datamass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我侦测到一台线圈滚轮正沿着一条反常路线巡逻。说不定是在给我们要找的现金库站岗。截停它，我来入侵它的数据块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's tractor jockeys are waiting for the collection signal. We need to locate the facility, and fast. I've got a lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富的牵引机驾驶员正等着提货信号。我们得赶快找出那处设施。我有条线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Vault marked! Take 'em before the rail tractors can make collection. Every last crate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 保管库已标记！赶在航道牵引机来收货前，把东西全拿走。一箱都不留。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ha! So long ya blockheaded scum! This is all going back to the people who earned it, Sparky. They'll be toasting you in the habs tonight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈！再会了，你们这些方头杂碎！这些东西都会交还给真正付出劳动的人，小火花。今晚，居住区的人们都得敬你一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky, one of my scout teams just reported a lead on that vault we're after... before being cut off by gunfire. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花，我的一支侦察小队刚报告了那座现金库的线索……然后通讯就被枪声打断了。去找他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Thanks, Sparky. Their intel looks like a solid lead on Nef's vault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 谢了，小火花。他们的情报看来确实能帮我们找到奈富的现金库。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Bosses are prepping their takings for shipment to Nef's vaults. Locate the facility before the rail tractors can load up and break orbit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那帮头头正准备把搜来的油水运往奈富的保管库。在航道牵引机装完货并驶离轨道前，找到那处设施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hit every Corpus unit you can find. One of 'em should be carrying a lead we can use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯士兵给我见一个打一个。总有一个身上带着能用的线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Wait, hold up. This looks promising. Yep, that one had solid intel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 等等。这看起来有戏。没错，那家伙身上有可靠的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: So. This murderous scumbag heard we're onto him. You can bet he's gonna leg it offworld, but he'll be smart about it. No straight run for a landing pad. No, he'll be hiding someplace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 听着，这杀人如麻的人渣知道我们盯上他了。他肯定准备逃往星外，但是他很狡猾，肯定不会蠢到直奔起降平台。对，他会先在某个地方藏起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Our target was set up with a safehouse. That's where he keeps his escape funds. Follow the paper trail, find out where he's holed up. All the info we need is in one of these security department crates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 目标被安排在一处安全屋。他的跑路钱就藏在那。顺藤摸瓜，找出他的藏身处。我们需要的情报，都在这些安保部门的箱子里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Found something. Yeah, this is good stuff. Saddle up, we gotta move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有发现了。不错，这情报不赖。准备好，我们得走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Our target can't escape without funds, and we just found where he's keepin' it. Steal it. Draw him out. And deliver justice for all the terror he's dealt over the years.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他要跑路就少不了钱，而我们恰好找到了他藏钱的地方。把钱抢了，逼他现身。再替那些被他荼毒多年的人讨回公道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Quick, clean and right. If we live in fear then they live in fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 干净、利落、就该这样。他们让我们活在恐惧中，那他们也别想安宁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A notorious Corpus war criminal has been found living in the Vallis. He knows SU is on to him. Don't let him escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们发现一名臭名昭著的科普斯战犯正躲在山谷里。他知道索联盯上他了，别让他跑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I have reason to believe a nearby CoilDrive is operating on the same encryption scheme as the shuttle. Hit it with an EMP mine and let's see what it can tell us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我有理由相信，附近的一台线圈滚轮采用了和穿梭机相同的加密方案。用电磁脉冲地雷截停它，看看它能吐出点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I got what we need. OK, let's move fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 要的东西到手了。好，迅速撤离吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Your target is the Corpus who runs orbital control. We need his security key to descramble comms and trigger that bomb. Take him down and get that security key.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你的目标是负责轨道控制的科普斯主管。我们需要他的安全密钥，解开通讯加密并引爆炸弹。干掉他，拿到密钥。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We got the key! But we still need to work out which comm station is handling the channel encryption.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 密钥到手了！但还得查清，到底是哪个通讯站负责这个频道的加密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Need to locate the comms station, determine encryption protocol, and upload. Busy day, so let's get moving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 先找到通讯站，查明加密协议，再上传起爆信号。今天会很忙，赶紧行动吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's it! That's the comm station! Get in there quietly, get me access and I'll send the trigger signal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就是那座通讯站！悄悄潜进去，帮我获取权限，然后我来发送起爆信号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: 3. 2. 1. And... BOOM. So long, sucker. Heh heh. Comms just lit up. Command has no clue what just happened. They. Are. Panicked. Just how we like 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 三、二、一。然后……轰。再见了，蠢货，嘿嘿。通讯频道炸锅了。指挥部还没弄明白发生了什么。他们，慌了。正合我们的意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Visiting Corpus dignitary is about to leave the sector by Solar Rail. Need you to trigger a bomb on his shuttle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一位来访的科普斯高官正准备经星际航道离开这个星区。我要你引爆他穿梭艇上的炸弹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hold up! That's a digitized manifest. It should tell us where the remaining caches are located. Hack it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 慢着！那是电子货运清单。里面应该标着剩余箱子的位置。黑进去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Now there's a piece of luck: the Corpus manifest. See if you can hack it. If we're lucky it'll gutterball our search time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 嚯，运气不错，是科普斯的货运清单。看看你能不能黑进去。运气好的话，应该能省下大把搜索时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Oh-ho yes. Sparky, they've left their manifest. Hack it, and find out where the rest of our loot is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哦吼，好东西。小火花，他们把货运清单落下了。黑进去，看看剩下的战利品在哪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's all of them. Well done. Found something useful, too. Listen to this:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 全找齐了。干得好。顺带找到点有用的东西。听听这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: All supply drops accounted for. Shipping code on that last crate matches something from my records. I want to follow a hunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 空投补给全部到手。最后一个箱子上的货运代码跟我记录上的信息对上了。我想验证一下我的猜想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: SU get a boost, the Corpus get kneecapped. Color me happy. Plus I think I just put two and two together. It's just a hunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 索联获得了补给，科普斯被敲了闷棍。快把我乐坏了。另外，我应该把事情捋清楚了。不过，只是猜想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: All pockets picked and in record time! Hell of a show, Sparky. Hell of a show. Found something useful, too. Listen to this:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一点油水都没落下，用时也破了纪录！简直完美，小火花。太棒了。顺带找到了点有用的东西。听听这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ha ha! Done and out like a Pobber up a drainpipe! Someone's gettin' fired over this. But here's the interesting bit: the shipping code on that last crate matches something from my records. I want to follow a hunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈哈！拿完就撤，快得像泡博钻排水管！这下肯定有人要被炒了。不过有趣的是，最后一个箱子上的货运代码跟我记录上的信息对上了。我想验证一下我的猜想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You did that so fast they never even got to wake their supervisor. Ha ha! 10 outta 10 AND I think I just worked something out. Humor me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你的动作太快了，他们甚至都没来得及把主管喊醒。哈哈！给你打满分，而且，我好像理清点头绪了。陪我验证一下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: House cleaned. Well done. Found something useful, too. Listen to this:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 扫得干干净净。干得好。顺带找到点有用的东西。听听这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sweep and clear, done and done. The shipping code on that last crate matches something from my records. I want to follow a hunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一扫而空，大功告成。最后一个箱子上的货运代码跟我记录上的信息对上了。我想验证一下我的猜想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nothing left in there. Get on out Sparky. Your job's done. Plus I think I just put two and two together. It's just a hunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 里面啥也不剩了。撤吧，小火花。活儿干完了。另外，我应该把事情捋清楚了。不过，只是猜想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: First cache tagged. Onto the next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 第一个箱子已标记。去找下一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Right. First cache. Two to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 很好，第一个箱子。还差两箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Yes. Cache number one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 没错，第一箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The second cache. One more to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 第二箱。还差一箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Good work. Conduct a quick sweep for the remaining cache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 干得好。赶紧搜一圈，找出最后一箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The second cache. That leaves just one more and I can signal for pickup.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 第二箱。再拿到最后一箱，我就叫人来接货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Before we continue: Nef's ordered supply drops for his troops. Our people need those nutrients. And I can trace the supply codes to lead us toward our objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 继续之前先办件事，奈富给他手下安排了空投补给。我们的人正缺那些营养补给。并且我还能追踪补给代码，顺藤摸瓜找到真正的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Taxman supply drop incoming. Count three. Find 'em, steal 'em, search 'em for clues. Waypoint marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 收税佬的空投补给马上就到。一共三个。找到它们，然后偷走，再搜搜里面的线索。已标记路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: SU needs weapons, ammo, and parts. Fortunately, Nef just airdropped a bunch of that across the Vallis. Nick the lot. Waypoint marked. Our next lead is in those crates, I'm sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富刚往山谷各处空投了一大批补给。全部顺走。坐标已标记。我敢肯定，下一条线索就在这些箱子里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Some Taxmen keep their valuables - cash, info, codes - in fortified stashes. Make Mama proud, rob 'em blind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有些税务官喜欢将他们的宝贝——现金、情报、密码——藏在戒备森严的隐蔽处。让老娘瞧瞧你的本事，把他们抢个精光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: An informant's marked a Taxman supply depot. We'll find something useful in there. Break in, nick the lot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 线人标记了一处税务官的补给库。里头肯定能找到好东西。闯进去，全部顺走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's stockpiling supplies. That's not a good sign. Get in there, steal everything. Bet my left actuator we'll find something that'll point us toward our objective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富在囤积补给。这可不是个好兆头。潜进去，把东西偷光。赌上我的铁胳膊，里面肯定有指向目标的线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Look around. The goods are here somewhere. If the Taxmen secure them first, the mission's a wash.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搜搜周围，货就在这附近。要是让收税佬抢先一步收走货物，任务就算黄了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Search the area. Nef Anyo's supply caches are somewhere around here. Get 'em before the Corpus do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搜查这一带。奈富·安尤的补给箱就在附近。赶在科普斯运走前拿到东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: SU needs those supplies more than the Corpus. Lock 'em down before the Taxmen make off with em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 索联比科普斯更需要这批补给。在收税佬运走货物之前，拿下补给箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: All right, Sparky, clock's tickin'. Let's bring those supplies home before the Corpus can lock 'em down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好了，小火花，时间不等人。赶在科普斯封锁之前，把这些补给带回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Standard Corpus response time is pretty tight, so you're gonna have to lock those supplies down fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯向来反应很快，你必须赶紧拿走那批补给。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They know we're here. Nab those caches before the Corpus can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们发现我们了。抢在科普斯之前抢走箱子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Pristine. With the drone perfectly intact our engineers should have unfettered access to the entirety of its datamass. And here it comes. Okay:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 完好得和刚出厂一样。这样一来，工程师应该能顺利访问它全部的数据块。出结果了，来看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That drone is perfectly intact. We've got some very excited engineers, Sparky. Nice job. Wow, this is great intel. Listen up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 无人机完好无损。工程师们都激动坏了，小火花。干得好。哇哦，这情报绝了。来听听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Barely a mark on her. Perfect. Just perfect. Tell me what you know, baby. Got it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 连道划痕都没有。完美，简直完美。把你知道的都交代出来，宝贝儿。拿到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Perfect. Its datamass is undamaged. The visual log ain't much, but... now, this is interesting. Right. Listen up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 完美，它的数据块毫发无损。虽然影像日志没什么料，不过……这个倒有意思。好，仔细听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They'll wreck that drone rather than let it go, obviously. So... y'know. Stop that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 显然，他们宁可毁了无人机，也不肯让我们得手。嗯……你懂的，拦住他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Aaaaand they're gonna try to wreck it rather than let us take it. Hold 'em off while I get this done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 看来他们宁愿毁了它，也不想让我们得手。挡住他们，掩护我把活干完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Here come the Taxmen. Keep em off the drone til I'm finished with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 收税佬来了。在我搞定之前，别让他们靠近无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Alright. Once we get this thing rewired it'll auto-teleport to a destination of our choosing, where one of our people is waiting to pick it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 好。等我们给这玩意儿重新接好线，它就会自动传送到我们指定的地点，咱们的人在那儿等着接手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Starting a remote hack. Once I'm done it should teleport into the waiting arms of one of our people, far from here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 开始远程入侵。等我搞定，它就会传送走，落进我们大后方接应的人手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: One hack coming up, and then a quick teleport into our custody.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就快入侵好了，接着一传送，它就归我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The bad guys are ejecting. We got what we need. Reads like a happy ending to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那些杂碎逃命去了。我们要的东西也到手了。怎么看都是皆大欢喜的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Zapping that baby outta there. You too, Sparky. We're done. Pulling data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 把那台宝贝无人机传送走。你也撤吧，小火花。完活儿，开始提取数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Bzzt. She's ours now. Choke on that, ya muckers. The engineers will have something for us in just a second.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 现在她归我们了。吃瘪吧，混蛋们。工程师很快就能给我们结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That was a close one, Sparky. But I've managed to pull some useful data. This little bird's seen some things. OK, here we go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 真是有惊无险啊，小火花。好在我还是弄出了点有用的数据。这台小鸟见多识广。好，我们看看吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've stolen Corpus drone routes. Take one down, I'll hack it, and our engineers will harvest its datamass for useful info.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我搞到了科普斯无人机的巡逻路线图。打下一台，我负责入侵，然后我们的工程师会从它的数据块里挖出有用的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Our engineers want a closer look at Corpus drone architecture. Take it down and we'll go from there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们的工程师想仔细研究一下科普斯无人机的架构。把它打下来，然后我们就可以从它入手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: For this mission to succeed we need a Corpus drone. Take it down, I'll hotwire it and get it to our engineers ASAP.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这项任务少不了一台科普斯无人机。把它打下来，我会强制接管，再尽快送去工程师那边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I've managed to isolate a drone from the other patrol routes. Bring it down and let's see what it can tell us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我成功把一台无人机单独引出了巡逻路线。把它打下来，看看它能吐出点什么情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Bad guys are on the run. Feel free to pick off stragglers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 坏家伙在四处逃窜。那些落单的随你发落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's crew are falling back. Follow up if you're feelin' it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富的手下正在撤退。你要是想玩玩的话，可以去追追他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Yeah, run ya muckers! Chase 'em if ya want, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 没错，你们这帮混蛋还不赶紧跑！想追就追，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: There's the drone. Swat it outta the sky so we can get to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 无人机在那儿。把它打下来，咱们好干活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: One drone, as ordered. Knock it down, Sparky. We gotta hack that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们要的无人机，送上门了。把它打下来，小火花。我们得黑进那玩意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus drone, right there. Take it down and we can start the hack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯无人机，就在那。把它打下来，我们就能黑进去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's a full haul and we didn't lose a single extractor. A perfect run. Now let's get back on-mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 满载而归，而且挖掘机都完好无损，堪称完美。现在继续执行任务吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We're out with full tanks and every extractor still intact. Couldnt have asked for a better outcome. Alright, let's get back to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 满载收工，而且每台挖掘机都毫发无伤。简直无可挑剔。好啦，咱们接着干吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ha ha! A full load and zero losses. Ah, I need more days like this. Now, where were we.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈哈！满载而归、零损失。啊，真希望每天都这么顺。好了，咱们刚说到哪儿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Excavator lost! Dammit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 挖掘机毁了！该死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We've lost an excavator! Don't let it happen again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们损失了一台挖掘机！别再出现损失了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Excavator down! Those things aren't cheap, Sparky!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 挖掘机报废了！这些玩意儿可不便宜，小火花！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Resources extracted. Alright, let's get back to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 资源采集完毕。好了，接着办正事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Done and done. Good job, Sparky. Now, where were we.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 妥了妥了。干得好，小火花。好了，我们刚说到哪儿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Good haul! Resources enroute to Solaris United. Now, let's get back to the job at hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 大丰收！资源正在运往索联。现在，继续干手头上的活吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Smokefinger's pointing me to a rich resource deposit. Corpus teams closing in. This is an opportunity too good to miss. Do this fast and get back to the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 烟指给我指了条资源丰富的矿脉。科普斯部队也要过去。这可是千载难逢的好机会。速战速决，然后回来办正事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Wait up. I've had to pull the protection detail from our resource extractors. Think you can protect those excavators 'til the process is complete?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 稍等，我必须把保护资源采集机的人手撤走。你能守住那些挖掘机，直到开采结束吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hold up. Hold up. Corpus mining operation detected nearby, we could really use those resources. Defend the excavators until their work is complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 等等，等等。附近发现了一处科普斯采矿点，咱们正需要那批资源。保护挖掘机，直到开采完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Excavator offline! Find a power cell, fast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 挖掘机宕机了！赶快找块能量电池！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We got an excavator offline! It needs a power cell!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 有台挖掘机宕机了！它需要一块能量电池！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Find a power cell! Keep that excavator chuggin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 找块能量电池来！保持挖掘机继续运转。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky, the dig can't begin without support and the window is closing. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花，没你掩护的话，开采工作没法开始，而且机会快没了。抓紧点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Where are you? Those excavators need protection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你在哪儿？挖掘机需要有人保护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Sparky! We're short-short, you read? If we dont start excavation soon we've missed our shot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 小火花！时间紧迫，听到没？再不赶紧开挖，这趟就白跑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Excavators incoming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 挖掘机来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Excavator drop initialized. Protect them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 开始投放挖掘机了。保护它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Excavators incoming. The Corpus will attempt to disrupt operations. Prevent this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 挖掘机来了。科普斯会扰乱开采行动。拦住他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A-plus, Sparky. Toward the end their emergency comms got real interesting. I want you to check something out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 无可挑剔，小火花。他们最后的紧急通讯很有意思。得拜托你去查点东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Haha! I wish you could hear this. You hit 'em so fast they're blaming each other. And one of 'em let a juicy little tidbit slip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈哈！真希望你也能听见。你下手太快，他们都在互相甩锅。其中有个家伙还漏了点有用的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You're a mean little thing when you wanna be. I like it. I know where you need to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你狠起来还真够吓人的。对我胃口。我知道你接下来该去哪儿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus radio traffic is a hairball right now. Total confusion. Snagged something from one panicked transmission. Check this out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯无线通讯现在乱成了一锅粥。我从一条慌乱的通讯里截到点东西。瞧瞧这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I managed to pull something from the radio panic. Hit the jets, Sparky. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我从他们混乱的通讯里扒出了点线索。可以撤了，小火花。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That was just the outcome we needed. In all the confusion they let something slip over comms. I know just where to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这正是我们要的结果。趁着混乱，他们在通讯里漏了口风。我知道接下来该去哪儿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Search and Destroy. Corpus, MOAs, drones. Doesn't matter. The objective here is chaos. Just do it fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搜到就毁掉。科普斯、恐鸟、无人机，管他是什么。这次要的就是制造混乱。动作快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This couldn't be simpler: if it's Corpus, kill it. And do it quick. We got places to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 任务再简单不过：只要是科普斯就干掉。而且动作要快。我们赶时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We want the Corpus presence here thinned, so we can do what we gotta do without interruption. And do it fast, we're on a clock here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 得削减科普斯在这的兵力，后面办事才不会有人碍手碍脚。动作快，时间不等人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We need a distraction. Get out there, cause trouble, and do it fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们需要转移他们的注意力。出去闹点乱子，动作要快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's trying to smoke us out, blanketing the Vallis with drones. I need you to put a dent in that surveillance network. Trash as many drones as you can find.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富想把我们逼出来，整个山谷都布满了无人机。去给他的监控网捅个窟窿。只要是能找到的无人机，统统干碎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hm. Nef's cranked up the surveillance. That's gonna make it hard for us to move. I need you to get those eyes off us. Trash as many drones as you can, fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 嗯，奈富又加强了监控。咱们行动起来会很麻烦。把那些盯着我们的眼线拔掉。能毁一台是一台，快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We need to deal with something else first. If SU is going to increase in popular support, Nef's surveillance drones have to go. Seek and destroy, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 还有件事得先处理。索联要想让更多人站到我们这边，奈富的监控无人机就必须消失。找出来，毁掉，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's field-testing a new batch of MOAs. That's a problem for us. Be a love and solve it. Quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富正在实地测试一批新恐鸟。这对我们可不是好事。劳驾你，解决掉它们。越快越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Too many MOAs around here. Gonna be a problem for the next step. Thin 'em out, and fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这附近的恐鸟太多了。会影响我们下一步的行动。赶紧清掉它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hit the MOAs. The less you leave standing the less resistance to our next move. Do it quick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 摆平那些恐鸟。站着的恐鸟越少，咱们接下来遇到的阻力就越小。利索点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You've got a narrow window to get this done before Nef's crew realizes what you're doing. Move fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 得赶在奈富的手下反应过来之前搞定，时间很短。行动要快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Once they clock what you're doing they'll react, then it's all diminishing returns. Time's short. Go go go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一旦他们察觉到你的意图，就会立刻反扑，越往后阻力越大。时间紧迫。快快快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This one's all about easy wins. Once they wake up they'll shift to a defensive posture. So smash often, smash fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这回主打出其不意，能毁则毁。等他们回过神来，就会转入防守。所以要打得快准狠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Keep going. Take out the same amount again for this to be worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 继续。照刚才的数量再来一轮，这趟才不算白来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Looking good. Trash the same amount again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 不错。照这个数再来一轮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I'd say you're about half done. Anything less and this op won't be effective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 差不多过半了。数量不够的话，这次行动就白费了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [1] So I ain't got no fam - biological or logical. Mumsie and Dadsie got burned up workin' for Solaris United the first time. Figured I'd be a Ventkid, but then the Temple came lookin' to collect on what I took from 'em, an' left me barely a head. So, really things could only get better from there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 是啊，我没有家人——血缘上没有，逻辑上也没有。第一次索联起义时，我老爸老妈就为这事没了。我本来想去投奔通风小子，结果润盈殿那帮人找上门来收我账，最后把我拆得只剩个脑袋了。哎，都已经到这份上，以后的日子总不能更糟了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2] Can't be a Ventkid all MOA'd up. Don't fit, can't crawl, can't board. So I make my logical fam right here in me shop. Y'can see the resemblance. Runs in the family. Woulda been a Ventkid, though. For sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 浑身挂着恐鸟零件，可当不了通风小子。身体塞不进管道，也爬不上去，悬浮板也踩不了。我就在自己的小店里，亲手造出我的机械家人。瞧，我们长得多像，家族遗传嘛。不过我本来肯定能成为通风小子。绝对能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [3] Mister The Business has been really good to me since… since my accident. Always comin' over with somethin'. I tell him he doesn't have to, but he says to me: "In revolution, it is the weakest who sacrifice the most. You've done your part, that I might do mine." And then he hands me a nutrient canister or a part I can use. It's nice and all, but why's he looks so sad about it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 自从……自从我出事以后，「操盘手」先生就一直很关照我。他时不时会带点东西来看我。我跟他说过不用这样，可他对我说：「在革命中，往往是弱者做出了最大的牺牲。你已经尽了你的那份力，也让我尽尽我的那份吧。」然后他就递给我一罐营养液，或者一个我能用上的零件。是挺好的，可他为什么看起来那么难过呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [4] Mister The Business got me thinkin': me and my MOAs, we're tight. I need it, they do it. If Nef does try musclin' the Solaris out with his MOAs again… I might just replace his with some of my own. Get inside his head, chek? I mean, I'd rather be gettin' my music to the people, but who says I can't also be a beautiful spider at the center of a big ol' web of subterfuge and intrigue?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 「操盘手」先生的话让我开始琢磨：我和我的恐鸟，都是铁哥们。我一句话，他们就去办。要是奈富再敢用他的恐鸟来镇压索拉里斯人……说不定我能拿我的恐鸟，把他的全换掉。从内部瓦解他，懂吗？我是说，我当然更想把音乐带给大家，但谁规定我就不能同时做一只漂亮的蜘蛛，坐在一张由渗透与暗线织成的大网中央出谋划策呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [5] I was hangin' in my rack the other cycle, 'bout to power down, an' I hear Boon and Roky and the venters bangin' skeg on the pipes and ducts. They had a good bounce goin' so's I start singin', as I do. Got a little loud, and the skeg stops. I get all quiet like. Really stepped in it, thinks me. Then the grill pops and Boon's got his head in my hab sayin' "Hey, keep it goin'!" Didn't sleep much that night. Neighbors neither. Ventkid. That's me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 上个周期，我正挂在床架上准备睡觉，忽然听到阿布、小洛和通风小子们在管道和风道上敲打奏乐。他们敲的节拍很带劲，于是我也就照老样子跟着唱。唱着唱着声音有点大，然后乐声突然停了。我吓得赶紧闭嘴。心想，完了，踩雷了。紧接着通风口格栅「砰」地一声弹开，阿布把脑袋探进我的舱室说：「喂，接着唱啊！」那一晚我没怎么睡，邻居们也被我吵得够呛。那天晚上我终于当上了通风小子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [1] I founded Solaris United the day an old woman had her pet taken from her. The day my best friend watched her arms be given to someone else. The day my mother lost her head. I founded Solaris United the day I sold my heart. To buy a gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [1] 我创立索拉里斯联盟，是在一位老妇人的宠物被夺走的那天。是在我最好的朋友眼睁睁看着自己的双臂被装到别人身上的那天。是在我母亲失去头颅的那天。也是在我卖掉自己的心，换来一把枪的那天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [1] I… have no truck with the Corpus. The greatest damage done by avarice for the sake of avarice is precisely that it, without remorse or relent, demonstrates the easy sale of men and women who lend their bodies, their intellects, their voice... to ends in which they themselves do not believe. The Temple of Profit is an ideology that teaches one thing only: that all creations of the mind^ words, images and ideas, are meaningless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我……和科普斯没什么好说的。贪婪之所以为害至深，恰恰在于它冰冷赤裸地证明了：人们能多么轻易地出卖自己的身体、才智和声音……去替连他们自己都不相信的目标效力。润盈殿的信条只教人一件事——一切思想的造物、言辞、图像和观念，皆为虚妄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [1] Used to be every time an old love ended and a new one began, friends would say "You seem so much happier now." And I'd smile and I'd agree and then I'd go back to my hab... and say your name. Just to feel it on my lips again. Like summoning a ghost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [1] 过去，每当一段旧情落幕，又有一段新欢开始，朋友们总会说：「你现在看起来开心多了。」我会一笑而过，点头赞同，然后回到我的住处……默默念叨你的名字。只为了能再次感受它在我唇间滑过的触感。仿佛在召唤幽灵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2] Biz just appeared one day, taught us how to fight economically, intelligently. Oh… Sparky, you should have seen us. Fireballing refineries by night, dutiful clean-up crew during the day. My job was to get people believing in us. Believing we could change things. That got more people killed than anything Zuud and her sisters could have hoped to make.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 比兹有一天突然出现了，教会我们如何精打细算、动脑子作战。噢……小火花，你真该瞧瞧我们那时候的样子。夜里把精炼厂炸成火球，白天却扮成尽职尽责的清理工。我的工作，是让大家相信我们，相信……我们能够改变一切。而这份信念……它害死的人，比祖德和她的姐妹们造出的任何武器都要多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2] And that is how you keep people beaten. By starving them not only of models of something better, but draining them of wholesome inspiration, denying them examples of a higher way of being and sapping them of any belief that they can achieve it. To be blunt: to Hell with the Corpus. Although… although there was one Corpus, a singular man, for whom I make a singular exception. His name was Sigor Savah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这就是你让他们一败涂地的方式。夺走他们对美好的向往，榨干他们所有积极的灵感，否定任何更高尚的生存方式存在，再瓦解他们实现这一切的最后一丝信念。说白了，让科普斯见鬼去吧。只不过……只有一个人例外，一个……一个非凡的人，我愿意为他破一次例。他叫西格·萨瓦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2] We met in unspoken agreement. You called me by the name of the one who had hurt you. My name for you was the name of the one who had wounded me. We played the part for each other. When I spoke, I spoke for them. Through you I told the one who had wounded me all the little things I never had a chance to. Cooked them all the meals I never got to share. Made all the jokes. Laughed all the laughs. With them, through you. And you, with yours, through me. Then, one day, you called me by my own name and we never looked back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText:
[2] 我们心照不宣地走到了一起。你用伤害你的那个人的名字称呼我。而我也用刺伤过我的名字称呼你。我们为彼此扮演着那些角色。每当我开口，便是替他们说话。透过你，我向那个曾伤害我的人倾诉了未曾出口的点点滴滴。

我为他们烹制了所有我不曾分享过的饭菜，开了所有来不及说的玩笑，也笑完那些本该一同笑出的笑声。透过你，我与他们重逢。你也透过我，和伤害你的那个人相遇。直到有一天，你喊出了我真正的名字。那一刻之后，我们便再也没有回头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [3] It... it was a small operation, one we... one we almost didn't run. That's what keeps me up at night. Deck 12.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那……那只是一次……很小的行动，小到我们差点就作罢了。可偏偏就是这件事，让我每天夜不能寐。12 号甲板的行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [3] I was a younger man then, an assistant to the efforts of Morphology Specialist Sigor Savah, though I don't think he ever knew my name. Morphology Specialist Savah's job was to catalog and assess whatever lifeforms - dead or alive - were uncovered as Venus sprang back to life. That man sacrificed everything - career, future, perhaps even his life - to save a kavat, if you can believe that. I know, because I helped him. Though he never knew that, either.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那会儿我还年轻，给赫赫有名的形态学专家西格·萨瓦当助手，哦不过他估计连我的名字都没记住。萨瓦专家负责记录和评估金星复苏过程中发现的一切生命，无论死活。你信吗？为了救一只库娃，那个男人舍弃了一切——事业、前途、甚至他的生命。我知道，因为是我暗中帮了他。而这件事，他同样被蒙在鼓里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [3] There's a dream I have every now and then. You are you, in your own first body. And I am there in mine. I stand on the shore. You stand in the sea. I watch as the waves roll in, but never break against your back. They whisper right through you, and you fade away from me. Again. I still have your glove. Just the one. The only thing I have left of you. In quiet moments I lay it on my lap, lace my fingers through yours, and make promises. I promised that what happened to you would never happen to another. Promises. I couldn't keep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText:
[3] 我时常会做这样一个梦。梦里你还是最初的你，灵魂还住在原先的身体里。我的灵魂也在我自己的身体里。我站在岸边，你站在海里。
我看着浪潮滚滚而来，却从未在你背上溅开。浪花低声呢喃着，直直地穿过你的身体，然后你在我眼前渐渐消散。一如以往。我还留着你的手套，不过只剩一只了。这是我唯一留下的、属于你的东西。在安静的时刻，我把它放在膝上，把手指一根根套进去，与你十指相扣，然后许下诺言。
我向你保证，发生在你身上的悲剧，绝不会在别人身上重演。而我……没能守住这个诺言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [4] Everyone I knew, everyone who believed in us, everyone I CONVINCED to sign on… died. Parents, lovers… whole families. Zuud's sisters. Legs' folks. All gone. Except us, and a few others. Me, Biz, Zuud, Little Duck. I washed my hands of it. They were bloody enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 所有我认识的人，所有信任我的人，所有被我说服加入的人……全都死了。父母、爱人……一个个完整的家庭。祖德的姐妹、腿哥的双亲，所有人都不在了。如今活着的，只剩我们寥寥几个，我、比兹、祖德、小鸭子。我也金盆洗手了，因为手上沾的血，已经够多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [4] The kavat, Specimen VK-7, had been tracked to her lair and was to be destroyed. Sigor prevented that at the cost of his liberty, and was soon to lose his life. Coward that I was I told myself there was nothing I could do. Then she was there. VK-7. In front of my hab, waiting, looking at me with more intelligence than any kavat should have. And she dropped keys at my feet. The keys to the security center. It was I who opened the door to Sigor's cell. Who watched as VK-7 dispatched Sigor's would-be executioner, a Corpus I had often worked with in Reclamation 3. It was I who ensured one cargo pod in particular was replotted, to intercept an outbound Solaris rail tractor. It was I who sealed multiple bulkheads, to stem the flow of troopers meaning to end them both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那只库娃的样本编号是 VK-7，她的巢穴已被锁定，等待她的只有毁灭。西格以葬送自由为代价阻止了他们，而很快，他连命也得搭进去。像我这样的懦夫，只能一遍遍告诉自己：我也无能为力。然后，她出现了。VK-7，她就蹲在我的住处外，等待着我。她的眼神中带有一种库娃不该有的智慧，定定地注视着我。她把钥匙丢在了我脚边，那是安全中心的钥匙。是我打开了西格的牢门，眼睁睁地看着 VK-7 解决掉前来处决他的刽子手——我在3号开垦区还和他共事过。是我暗中操作，让某个特定的货舱偏离航线，去拦截一艘出航的索拉里斯航道牵引机。也是我，封死了一道道舱壁，把那些要置他们于死地的士兵，牢牢截在身后。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [4] I sold my arms to buy you an arm. I sold my legs to buy you a leg. I sold my lungs, my bones, my heart... to buy a safe place to cradle your beautiful head. I bought you back from them. I brought you back to me. You in the body I had bought for you, me in the body I had earned to replace the one I sold. But you weren't you. Not anymore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [4] 我卖掉自己的双臂，给你换来一条胳膊。我卖掉了双腿，给你换来一条腿。我卖掉了肺、骨头、心脏……只为买下一处安全的地方，好安放你那美丽的头颅。我把你从他们手里赎了回来，把你带回了我身边。你住进我为你买来的新身体，而我被困在靠出卖原本躯体换来的义体中。可你已不再是你，一切都回不去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [5] Then, years later, Biz showed up again. And then you. And then, somehow, here we are. This isn't the first Solaris United. It's the second. And, one way or another, the last.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 几年过去后，比兹又现身了。接着是你。再然后，不知怎么的，我们就走到了这一步。索拉里斯联盟不是第一次建立了，这是第二次。而且，无论结果如何，这也将是最后一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [5] Why did I do it? Hmm.. I remember Sigor best this way: he puts down an instrument, respects me enough to look me in the eye, and he tells me: "Every living thing longs to be whole. Every living thing yearns to defy death. If from death you returned, yet the part you loved best did not… what then?" That was the last thing he ever said to me. That is why I helped him. In saving that animal Sigor Savah had saved himself. How many of us can say that? I was not about to stand by and let the Corpus steal from him the one thing that was truly his. To a flaming Hell with the bloody Corpus. Cetus, is where Sigor went. The Plains. His story is out there, if you want to hear it. To this day I hope he is, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我为什么这么做？嗯……我记忆里的西格，印象最深的画面是：他放下手中的仪器，郑重地抬眼望着我，对我说：「每一个生命都渴望完整。每一个生命都奋力向死亡抗争。如果从死亡的深渊中归来，而你最深爱的那部分却没能回来……那又该怎么办？」那是他对我说的最后一句话。这就是我帮他的原因。在拯救那只动物的过程中，西格·萨瓦也救赎了自己。我们之中有多少人能拍着胸脯说出这句话？我绝不能袖手旁观，任由科普斯夺走唯一真正属于他的东西。让这帮该死的科普斯统统滚进烈焰地狱。西格去了希图斯，去了夜灵平野。他的故事就发生在那里。你想听的话就去那找吧。直到今天，我仍然希望他还在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [5] Sat so long on the Taxman's shelf, you barely knew who you were. And you certainly didn't know me. The goodbyes I said decades earlier… they stuck. These days you work the canal with few memories of who you were. And I'm in the business of keeping promises.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [5] 你在税务官的货架上放了太久，久到连你自己都快忘了自己是谁。而你，自然也不可能认得我。几十年前我跟你说过的那些告别……终究是成真了。如今你在运河区工作，只剩下以前零零散散的记忆。而我干起了另一门营生——履行之前的诺言。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [1] Chatter wakes me, tells me a woman is at my lock, asking for water. Her carapace is scorched. Her raiments, burnt. I fetch water. When I return there are five more women. All singed. They say they are from... Deck 12.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [1] 杂音叫醒了我，说有个女人站在我门口，想讨口水喝。她的外表被烧焦了，衣服也被烧烂了。然后我就去给她拿水。等我回来时，门外又多五个女人。她们全被烧焦了，还说她们来自……12号甲板。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2] There is no Deck 12. I am certain I have seen those faces before. I fetch more water. I return, they are gone. I return to my rack, feeling… I return to my rack angry at the inconvenience is what I do!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [2] 压根就没有什么12号甲板。我敢肯定，我之前见过那些面孔。我又去拿了些水。等我回来，她们全都不见了。等我回到床架边，感觉……不，我是憋了一肚子火，带着这一通烦心事，就这么一头栽倒在床上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [3] The gentleman Business visited with me. Inconvenient. Why? Why so much talk when there is so much to do? The gentleman Business communicated the belief that… such nonsense… that I must 'make peace with what happened on Deck 12.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [3] 那位体面的「操盘手」先生来找我聊过。真是添麻烦。为什么？明明我还有那么多活要做，为什么偏要说那么多弯弯绕绕的废话？「操盘手」先生向我表达了一个看法……简直胡说八道……他说我必须「与12号甲板上发生的事和解」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [4] Deck 12. Deck 12. What is this Deck 12. Chatter had stopped speaking entirely, then. "It's all right that you weren't there, Zuud. That's what your visitors wanted you to know. That fire was not for y…" Ach! Enough! Nonsense and stupidity and a waste of my time!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [4] 12号甲板，12号甲板，12号甲板到底是什么？然后，杂音就没再念叨了。「还好你没在那儿，祖德。来找你的人就是想让你知道这一点——那场大火不是冲着你……」啊！够了！胡说八道，一帮蠢货，纯粹浪费我的时间！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [5] So many visitors, every one of them hoping to take something away. Dealing with them is like an uncomfortable dream, while speaking with Chatter is like being shaken awake. Are they real? How real are you, when you're sleeping? How real are you, floating, dreaming you are somewhere else? That's what Chatter wants to know. How did the women at my lock know my name?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [5] 来找我的人太多了，每个人都指望着能带走点东西。和她们打交道就像做了场烦人的梦，而和杂音说话就像猛地被摇醒。她们是真实存在的吗？当你入睡时，你能感受到几分真实？当你飘飘然梦到自己在别处，你能有多少真实可言？这就是杂音想要知道的事。那些守在我门外的女人，是怎么知道我名字的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [1] In this life a person has to find that which is more important than themselves. The Orb Vallis died a long time ago. It should not exist. But here it is. It has a second chance. If that's not hope, then what is? I respect anything... that fights its way back from death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [1] 人这一生，总得找到某种比自己更重要的东西。奥布山谷早已死过一次。照理说，它就不该存在。可它如今就在这里，重获新生。倘若这都不算希望，那什么才算？任何能从死亡手里挣脱的生命……都值得我尊重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2] A sculptor sees the shape within the rock. Their skill lies in removing anything that is not that shape, delivering something beautiful and lasting into the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [2] 雕刻家能看到藏在岩石里的轮廓。他们的本事，在于凿去一切不成形的部分，把美丽而长久的作品带到世上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [3] I was a sculptor, of sorts. Modest. My task was the considered removal of those who obscured the shape of what we wanted to be. With their deletion a just society came into clearer focus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [3] 我从前姑且也算是个雕刻家。我的任务就是经过思考，剔除阻碍我们雕刻出理想社会形态的杂质。随着他们被逐一抹除，一个公正社会的轮廓便越发清晰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [4] Small actions lead to powerful outcomes. One example: a young man is repoed, and Eudico resurrects the resistance. Wise conservation is all about understanding patterns. Cause and effect. When orchestrating change in an ecosystem, ask: how will the system reconfigure in response to this new species. New forests? Redirected rivers? Diverse and beneficial new breeds? It is all connected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [4] 蝴蝶轻轻拍动翅膀，可能就会掀起一场飓风。比如，一个年轻人惨遭回收，而最终尤迪科却借此振兴了抵抗势力。明智的生态保护，核心在于掌握规律——也就是因果关系。想改变生态系统，得先问问：新物种加入后，整个系统将如何重塑？会长出新的森林？河流会改道？会不会诞生更多样、更有益的新种群？这一切都紧密相连。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [5] It was Legs' punishment that inspired Eudico to resurrect Solaris United. Lean and wise, it's time for that hungry, furious wolf to enter the woods. For the Corpus to receive a selective and beneficial extinction. A small price to pay. A young man's body. An old man's soul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [5] 正是腿哥遭受的惩罚，点燃了尤迪科要振兴索拉里斯联盟的决心。这头饥饿而愤怒的狼，如今已变得精悍而狡黠——是时候让它重返森林了。也该让科普斯迎接一场有选择性的良性灭绝了。代价并不高，就是一具年轻人的身体，还有一位长者的灵魂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [5] Biz saved me from a life of swabbing latrines on Phobos. He made me what I am. But only because I left before I became what he was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 是比兹把我从火卫一刷马桶的日子里捞了出来。是他成就了今天的我，但这正是因为我及时抽身，才没有变成曾经冷酷无情的他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Now… now I had to go back. Everything Jubb knew… Biz had to know. Eudi had to know. They, and everyone in Fortuna, could be proper beached if I didn't. Pencil-necks like Jubb don't risk their hide unless they mean it. Whatever Nef was doin' with those Orb Mothers would be a hammer on the head of SU. Had to go back. If I didn't, if somethin' happened to Fortuna, I'd never sleep proper again. So. No more treasure hunting for LD. No more rescues. Back to where it all happened, and the hope that this time it wasn't burning, and me along with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 如今……我必须回去。朱布知道的一切……比兹必须也得知道。尤迪科也得知道。如果我隐瞒不报，他们，还有福尔图娜的大家，都得在阴沟里翻船。除非他们真下定决心，否则像朱布那种胆小鬼，是不会冒着身份暴露的危险去赌的。不管奈富在拿圆蛛搞什么名堂，对索联来说都会是当头一棒。我必须回去。我要是不回去，万一福尔图娜出事了，我这辈子都别想睡安稳觉了。就这样，小鸭子不寻宝了，营救行动也到此为止。我们要回到一切发生的地方，但愿这次那里不会烧起来，别把我一并烧成灰了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [4] So. Solaris United was on its feet again. I've got friends in Fortuna. The first time SU tried to knock the crown off Nef's head it almost got every last one of them killed. Some of them, it did. Biz once told me how he survives atrocity. 'If there's a fire on Deck 12, you seal off Deck 12. You don't go in. That's how you burn up. You wait 'til the fire's starved of oxygen. That's when you go in, assess the damage and clean up.' I can't seal off Deck 12. Deck 12 is where I live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 所以说，索拉里斯联盟又站起来了。我在福尔图娜还有朋友。上次索联试图颠覆奈富的统治，结果差点全军覆没。有些人，确实没能活下来。比兹曾告诉我，他是如何在那场灾难中苟活下来的。他说：「如果12号甲板着火了，就封死它。但千万不能进去，进去就是送死。等火焰把氧气耗光，再进去评估损失和清理现场。」我实在没办法封死12号甲板，因为那儿就是我的家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: What information? Tell me! Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 什么情报？说！立刻！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef. Vallis. Orb Mothers… It's been developed…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富。山谷。圆蛛……已经研发出来了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: What? What's been developed?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 什么？到底研发了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Shielding... Satellites... The Orb Mothers… cannot be…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 护盾……卫星……没法将……圆蛛……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Jubb? What? The Orb Mothers cannot be what? Jubb!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 朱布？什么？你说没法将圆蛛怎么样啊？朱布！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [1] Quills wanted me sellin' arms to the Tenno. Back in Fortuna. Not bloody likely. Quills. Shady, side-mouthed, double-talking ambidexter-feeling muckers. Never trust anyone who don't speak plain. Told 'em thanks but hop it. I'd a previous commitment: a contract to extract a Corpus defector name of Jubb Lott. Quill smiled that smile. The smile I hate the most. The smile of a body who thinks he's two steps ahead. The more I think about it, the more I know he was. Pratoo. That was his name. Quill Pratoo Secondary Sahd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: [1] 夜羽想让我回福尔图娜，给 Tenno 卖武器。想得美。夜羽那帮混蛋，个个都是阴阳怪气、满嘴瞎话、两面三刀的无赖。千万别信那种说话遮遮掩掩的家伙。我跟他们说「谢了，一边玩去吧」。我先前还有个活没交差——是一份合同，要把一个叫朱布·洛特的科普斯叛逃者捞出来。那个夜羽冲我笑了笑。我最痛恨的那种笑，那种自以为比你多算计了两步的轻笑。越琢磨那个笑，就越发现他确实算计了我。普拉图，他就叫这个名字。二级三席夜羽普拉图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [3] It was hairy but I managed to get us behind a sealed bulkhead, and into Lott's office.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 过程虽然惊险，不过我还是想办法带大家从密封仓后头穿过去，溜进了洛特的办公室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2] They don't fight like this for mid-level pencil-necks! Who are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们绝对不会为了你这种小文员这么拼命的！你到底是谁？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Jubb. Lott. Secondary Sub-Architect of Nef Anyo's Venusian Restoration. I… have information.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我是朱布·洛特，奈富·安尤金星改造工程的副建筑师。我……我掌握了……重要情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: And then he said it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 然后他把情况交代了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: For Solaris United.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 为了索联。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: And then he got killed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 接着他就被干掉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Unf!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 呃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: [2]Today?! I didn't know you were coming today!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 今天？我怎么不知道你今天要来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's how hostile extractions typically work, Jubb! Unless you'd like to pencil me in for a two-thirty next week? Maybe copy in your supervisor and half the security team?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 强行撤离通常就是这么办的，朱布！除非 你想 给我预约到下周两点半？顺便再抄送给你的主管和半支安保队？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: AAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: What is their problem?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这帮人到底什么毛病？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I MEAN ALL MY FILES ARE STILL IN MY OFFICE! YOU KNOW: THE WHOLE REASON YOU'RE DOING THIS?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 是这样的，我所有文件还留在办公室呢！你懂吧，你们大老远跑来救我，不就为了这个吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: What files? I wasn't told about any files!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 什么文件？可没人跟我提过什么狗屁文件！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's because I didn't tell them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 因为我谁都没告诉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Tell who? Tell who, Jubb!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 告诉谁？你没告诉谁啊，朱布！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: The Quills, alright? The Quills!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 夜羽，行了吧？夜羽那帮人！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: And that's when it all made a cruddy kind of mucking sense. I'd been set up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就在那一刻，所有糟心事都他妈对上号了，我被人摆了一道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: And here's the brains of the outfit. Pleased to be shooting him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 瞧，领头的终于露面了。劳驾你把他毙了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: So that's the mucker behind all this. Sparky, show him what Solaris United does to people who threaten our family.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 原来是这混蛋在背后搞鬼。小火花，让他见识一下，威胁我们家人是什么下场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Oh, hello, you gib-faced fish-lookin' mucker. So you're the one behind this. Sparky, delete this idiot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哟，你好啊，你这烂鱼脸的杂碎。原来是你在背后捣鬼。小火花，把这蠢货删了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This is the place. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就是这儿。找到他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: If they're still alive our team will be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 如果小队的人还活着，肯定就在这儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Here we are. Find any survivors. Get them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 到了，去找幸存者。把他们救出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They were captured. Pinpointing location. Anyone gets in your way, give em the business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们被捕了。正在锁定位置。如果有人敢挡道，就给他们好看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Oh no. They were jumped by a Corpus patrol. I'm willing to bet they were taken... here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 糟了，他们被一支科普斯巡逻队埋伏了。我敢说他们肯定被抓到了……这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: It's what I was afraid of. The Corpus found them. If they're still alive the Taxmen would have taken any survivors *here*.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 果然是我最担心的情况。科普斯发现了他们。只要有人还活着，收税佬肯定会把活口押到这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's their emergency transmitter. Damaged and failing. Find someplace to decode the onboard log, before it dies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那是他们的紧急通讯器。受损而且快失灵了。赶在它彻底报废前，赶紧找个地方来解码它的飞船日志。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Damaged. There's something in the buffer. We need to get it decoded before the device fails.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 受损了，缓存里有东西。我们必须在设备彻底报废前破解它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Accessing buffer. Analyzing...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 读取缓存。正在分析……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I'm in. Taking a quick look around. Itinerary. Patrol log, Coordinates. Reports. blah blah blah...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 进去了。我快速看一遍。行程表、巡逻日志、坐标、报告，都没用……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Password... Hello... Buffer... Accessing final transmissions.... C'mon, c'mon, final transmissions....
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 密码……搞定……缓存……正在读取最近通信……快点，快点，最近通信……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's everyone, but their sacrifice wasn't for nothing. They found something^ something that could make or break this mission. Listen up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 所有人都在这了，不过他们没有白白牺牲。他们发现了一些足以决定任务成败的东西。注意听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Good job. There's families here who are in your debt. The Corpus tried to silence them, but they got us what we need: a lead. Listen up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 干得好。这里的家属们都欠你一份人情。科普斯想杀人灭口，可他们还是拿到了我们需要的东西，一条线索。听好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We all know the risks, but losing people never gets easier. The survivors gave us a solid lead, and a blow to the Corpus. So listen closely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们都知道其中的风险，可每次失去同伴还是很难释怀。幸存者给了我们一条可靠的线索，也让科普斯挨了记狠的。仔细听好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: I haven't seen a hit-and-run that fast and clean since Biz was The Business. You do good work, Sparky. The team had solid intel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 自从比兹还是「操盘手」那会儿，我就没见过这么干净利落的游击战了。干得好，小火花。小队拿到了可靠的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Never knew what hit 'em. Some very relieved families in Fortuna tonight, Sparky. The team had solid info, and I know just what to do with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 敌人连自己怎么死的都不知道。今晚福尔图娜好几户人家终于能松口气了，小火花。小队带回了可靠的情报，我清楚该怎么利用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Reckon even Biz'd be impressed. Let's put what the survivors know to good use. Listen up:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 估计连比兹也会对你刮目相看。把幸存者拼死带回的情报好好用起来。注意听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Wait. An emergency transmission from one of Biz's survey teams was cut short. I have a feeling they found something they weren't meant to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 等等，比兹的一支侦察小队发出的紧急通讯突然断了。我有种不祥的预感，他们肯定是看了什么不该看的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Hold that thought. One of our recon teams went silent. Find out what happened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 打个岔，我们的一支侦察小队失联了。去查查出什么事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Wait. One of our picket teams got themselves surrounded. Corpus patrol. Bring 'em home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 等一下，我们的一支侦察小队被科普斯巡逻队包围了。把他们平安带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: A recon party was to contact our agent. They never came back. Find out what happened.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 一支侦察小队本来该和我们的特工接头。但却一直没回来。去查查怎么回事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's one, now get the others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 找到一个，现在去找其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They're alive. Thank the Void. Now find the others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们还活着。感谢虚空。去找其他人吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's one survivor. Account for the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 找到一名幸存者。把其他人也找齐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Oh no. I knew some of these people. Search the bodies. Find any survivors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哦不，这些人里有我认识的。搜索尸体，看有没有幸存者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Dammit. But this isn't the whole team. Where are the others? Search the bodies, see if there's any clues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 该死，这里人不齐。其他人呢？搜索尸体，看看有没有线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: What happened here? Search the bodies, Sparky. That's not everyone. Survivors must have escaped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这里发生了什么？搜索尸体，小火花。人数不对，肯定有幸存者逃出去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We've got more coming in! Pick 'em up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 还有货在路上！全都拿下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Another shipment! Move fast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 又一批货！动作快点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Obelisk reports a second beamload! Don't let the Taxmen lay a hand on any of it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 天碑战舰报告称，已卸下第二批货！别便宜了收税佬！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Perfect! We got everything! And I know exactly what we need to do next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 完美！东西全都到手了！我知道接下来该怎么做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ha! Ya lucky we're leavin' ya' the light fittings! Right. This info is golden. Here's what we're gonna do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈！给你们留个灯泡都算你们走运！好了，这情报很珍贵。接下来就这么办。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Cleaned em out! And it leads us one step closer to our objective. New orders:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 搬空了！我们离目标更近了一步。有新指令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Case retrieved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 货箱已到手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's one for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这个归我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Got it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 得手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's it! Get clear, Sparky. Let's see what we've got. Right. Here we go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 齐活！撤吧，小火花。看看都搞到了什么好东西。行，瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ha! So long ya fridge-faced pack a hosers. We're out. Right, let's see what we have here. Yes, this we can use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哈！再会了冰柜脸的蠢货。我们先走一步。好了，来看看我们都弄到了什么。不错，这些我们用得上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's plenty. Get outta there, Sparky. Job done. We got what we need. Now, listen carefully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 够多了。撤出来吧，小火花。任务完成，我们要的东西到手了。好了，注意听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ah, they got one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 啊，他们抢走了一箱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Muckers made off with one. Be more careful!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 混蛋们抢走了一个。小心点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We lost a case. Sharpen up, Sparky!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们丢了个箱子。打起精神来，小火花！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Resource cases are gonna be teleported to the site I've just marked for you. Get there, intercept 'em, steal 'em, get out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 资源箱会被传送至我刚标的位置。去那拦截它们，再把东西顺走，然后撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Resource crates are gonna be teleported to a holding site. Our agent stashed stolen Corpus files inside one. Check every last crate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 资源箱会被传送到暂存点。我们的特工把偷来的科普斯文件藏进了其中一箱。每一个箱子都查一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus cargo is meticulously tracked. Shipment incoming. We get lucky and one serial number might just point us in the right direction. Check every last crate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯给每批货都编了号，追踪得严严实实。货马上就到。运气好的话，某个序列号能给我们指明方向。每箱都查一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: This is the place. New shipment about to teleport in. Take 'em for all they're worth. Every last crate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就是这儿。新一批货马上就传进来。把值钱的都拿走。一箱都别放过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Right. Resource cases are gonna be teleported to this site, Intercept 'em, steal 'em, get out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 没错。资源箱会被传送到这里。拦截它们，再把东西顺走，然后撤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Gathering site for Corpus resources. Now's the time to hit it. So hit it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这就是科普斯资源的集散地。装货的箱子按计划随时会传进来。正是下手的好机会。动手。
