/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: First load's beamed in. Snatch 'em before the locals do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 第一批货传送进来了。赶在他们接手前把东西抢到手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Shipment's arrived! Grab 'em!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 货到了！全都抢走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Corpus Obelisk reporting first shipment's beamed down. That's your cue, Sparky!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 科普斯天碑战舰报告称，已卸下第一批货物。该你上场了，小火花！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ugh, that's not the good noise. Pull that data now, Sparky, or it's gone!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 呃，这动静听着不妙。快提取数据，小火花，不然就全没了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You've tripped an alarm. It's now or never, Sparky! Yank that data!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你触发警报了。成败在此一举，小火花！弄出数据！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Counter-intrusion just made you! It's started erasing files! Pull that data immediately!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你触发反入侵系统了！它开始删库了！立刻提取数据！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's better. Okay, back to business.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 这样才对。好，接着干活。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Alert lowered. Good. Now get in there. *Quietly* this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们降低警戒了。很好，现在潜进去。这次一定要「安静」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Comm chatter's calming. Now get in there, and this time *be careful.*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 敌方通讯没这么频繁了。现在潜进去，这次千万「小心点」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Quick and slick, friend of mine. Quick. And. Slick. Check this out:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 干净利落，小火花。干净，而且，利落。瞧瞧这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: And that, ladies and gentlemen, is how you do it. Listen to this:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 各位，这个就叫专业。看看这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Well well, we are a nimble-fingered little so-and-so. You snagged us a primo piece of info.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 哎哟哟，我们的小火花还真是手脚麻利。你帮我们搞到了一份顶级情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: There's the console, approach with caution.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 控制台就在那，小心靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: There. That console. Careful as you please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 那边，那个控制台。千万千万小心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That's the console we want. Now, very carefully, hack the crap out of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 就是那个控制台。入侵进去，千万小心点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Ugh. We got it. It's okay, we got it. Let's never do that again. Anyway, listen up:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 呃，到手了。还好，数据保住了。咱们以后可别这么玩心跳了。总之，听听看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: That was too close, Sparky. Way too close. Data retrieved. I know what we need to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 刚才太险了，小火花。实在是太惊险了。数据到手，我知道下一步该怎么做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We got the data. You'd best get out of there. You've got somewhere to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 数据拿到了。你最好赶紧离开那儿。你还得赶下一个场子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Nef's up to something. There's a data storage facility nearby. I need you to get in there quietly as you can, and retrieve their encrypted comm logs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 奈富肯定在打什么算盘。附近有座数据存储设施。尽可能别惊动任何人，潜进去，把加密的通讯记录带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We've got some major operations planned, but I need to be certain Nef isn't suspicious. There's an encrypted high-level comms log stored at this location. Get in there and download it, quiet as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们筹划了几场大行动，但我得先确认奈富还没起疑心。这里存放着一份加密的高层通讯记录。潜进去把它下载下来，动作越轻越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: We're gonna make Nef's surveillance network work for us. Infiltrate that facility, steal the data, and get out - as quietly as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 我们要反过来利用奈富的监控网络。潜入设施，偷走数据，然后悄悄撤回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You're nearing the secure area, watch out for patrols and security measures. The enemy will destroy the data if they detect you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你正在接近警戒区，留意巡逻队和安防系统。敌人一旦发现你，就会销毁数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: You're close to the facility. Security's gonna get thicker. If they smell you, they're gonna purge those databanks. So be *quiet.*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 你快到设施了，安保会越来越严密。一旦他们发现你，就会清空数据库。记得「安静」点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: They take their security seriously here. Trip an alarm, and they could slag their entire databank in response. So be sodding careful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 他们很看重这里的安保。一旦触发警报，他们说不定会把整个数据库销毁。千万要谨慎点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.text: Files extracted. Yeah, this thing's definitely security for Nef's credit vault. OK, listen up:
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaMission.zhText: 文件提取完毕。没错，这玩意就是用来保护奈富现金库的。好了，听着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Final phase. Thanks to that data you gathered, Biz can slow Profit-Taker's sentient shield adaptation long enough for you to do some real damage. Then, once the shields are gone use your Gravimag-modified Archwing weaponry to punch through her carapace and end this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 最后一步。多亏了你收集的数据，比兹可以拖慢利润收割者 Sentient 护盾的适应速度，足够你造成实打实的伤害。等护盾消失，就用装有重力磁抵器的反重力曲翼武器打穿她的外壳，结束这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: So… if Profit-Taker makes it to those new coordinates...?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 那么……如果利润收割者抵达了那些新坐标呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Sparky, to the Vallis, now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小火花，去山谷，快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Leg it. Once that mother hits the overcharge radius we're done for. No second chances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 快跑！一旦那个圆蛛进入过载范围，我们就完了。没有第二次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Eudi. The Profit-Taker… she's moving. Looks like she's headed for… the middle of nowhere? Why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 尤迪科，「利润收割者」好像……在动。她看起来正朝……一个荒无人烟的地方行进？为什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Little. Duck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小……鸭子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Her shields will be impenetrable and we're done for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 等她的护盾变得无法穿透，我们就完蛋了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: So we gonna pull the trigger on this thing? I got a card game to get to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 这玩意到底还开不开火？我还赶着去打牌呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Uh…

All right, look. It might be that it turned out those satellite protocols didn't shut the overcharger down, just… realigned it. And it might be that you sounded so pleased about the whole thing that I didn't tell you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 好了……听着。可能是……那些卫星协议最后并没有关闭过载卫星，只是……重新对准了一下。也可能是因为……感觉你对此很有把握，我……就没告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Heads up, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小心点，小火花。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: You're making progress, Sparky, keep hitting those pylons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 有效果，小火花，继续攻击护盾塔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Guts. Pylons back up. Wreck 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 可恶，护盾塔又启动了。摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Not again. Take out those pylons!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 又来？把那些塔解决掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: D? What is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小鸭子？怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Duds? No… look. They're syncing with the Orb. Shields going back up. Outworlder, deal with those pylons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 哑弹？不……看，它们正在和圆蛛同步。护盾又回来了。异世者，处理掉那些护盾塔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Those things are nearly as strong as the Orb. They must have some tactical weakness!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 这些塔几乎和圆蛛一样坚固。它们一定有什么弱点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Shields are waning, whatever you're doing, it's working.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 护盾正在减弱，看来你找对了路数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Her shields are vulnerable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 她的护盾露出破绽了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: That did it. She's vulnerable. Aim true, Outworlders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 就是这样。她很脆弱。瞄准了，异世者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Heads up, bombardment in-bound. This should confuse her adaptation system!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小心点，全面炮击。这应该能扰乱她的适应系统！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: That's it. Focus your Archwing weapons on the Orb. Compromise the exoskeleton at the legs and then work your way to the torso.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 就是这样。用你的反重力曲翼武器集火圆蛛。破坏腿部外骨骼，然后一路打到躯干。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: There she is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 她在这儿呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Uh. Is this a bad time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 呃……我来得不是时候吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Satellite just moved. Nef's crew must have figured out our bypass. It's realigning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 卫星刚刚移动了。奈富的手下一定已经发现了我们的手段。它正在重新校准。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[3.0]
Pretties circle
murderous dolls
[6.0]
doom infernal
watch them fall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[3.0]
环绕的美人
凶残的娃娃
[6.0]
厄运的地狱
看着他们倒下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[3.5]
Dolly, dolly I'm a giant
Big and bad as Hunhow's heart
[6.5]
Salty squishies are my diet
Death and murder are my art.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[3.5]
娃娃，娃娃我是个巨人
又大又坏，像 Hunhow 的心脏
[6.5]
咸咸的碎渣是我的盛宴
毁灭与梦魇是我的艺术。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[4.5]
Salty squishy, dancing doll
I pin you to the Vallis floor
[8.5]
Limb from limb at once I'll tear you
Dancing dolly nevermore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[4.5]
又咸又软的跳舞娃娃
将它钉在山谷表面
[8.5]
一块一块撕成碎片
跳舞的娃娃永不变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[4.5]
Sky-Eye shift!
Save me from the Void!
[9.0]
Salty squishies come a-dancing
To see my soul destroyed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[4.5]
天眼转移！
从空虚中拯救我！
[9.0]
咸咸的碎渣来跳舞
看着我的灵魂被毁灭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: LD, I still think it's strange: Why would your contact just… let himself get killed? Quills don't make mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小鸭子，我还是觉得不对劲。为什么你的线人……会放任自己被人干掉？夜羽不会犯这种错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: That's what I'm afraid of. Superlative work, as always, Outworlder. Thank you. See you back in Fortuna. LD, Eudi? How about that drink?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 这就是我所担心的。你的表现还是一如既往地完美，异世者。谢谢你。我们福尔图娜见。小鸭子，尤迪科？一起喝一杯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: I need a drink. Let's never do that again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 我确实需要喝一杯。咱们可别再打这种硬仗了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Quills don't make mistakes, and there's always an agenda. Always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 夜羽从不犯错，而且总是带着自己的目的，没有例外。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Sparky! You're running out time. You have to kill her now. We won't get another chance at this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小火花！快没时间了。你必须马上消灭她。这是我们最后一次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Is... is it… ? Did…? Holy crap. We did it. WE DID IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 这……结束了？我们？天啊，我们做到了。我们真的做到了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Get in there Tenno, rip out anything you think might help our cause.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: Tenno，快进去，凡是对我们有用的，全拆下来带走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Biz? What's that sound?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 比兹？那是什么声音？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Still too close, Sparky. LEG IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 还是离太近了，小火花。快跑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: I've only got a few mortars left. Firing them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 我只剩下几发迫击炮了。全部打出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: The satellite it's… continuing to overcharge the Orb. At this rate, in a matter of seconds, it will…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 卫星……还在继续让圆蛛过载。照这样下去，用不了几秒，就会……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Outworlders… ruuUUUUUN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 异世者……快跑！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Suppressing fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 火力压制！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[5.5]
Dollies should not move. 
Dollies should not bound. Bounce. 
[10.0]
Dollies should… shouldn't. 
Dollies should… 
[14]
Dollies should
DIE AND BE SMASHED BAGS OF SALT AND FLUID YOU CANNOT BRING MY RUIN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[5.5]
娃娃不许动。
娃娃不许跳。跳。
[10.0]
娃娃应该……不应该。
娃娃应该……
[14]
娃娃应该被彻底支离破碎之后面对死亡
你永远无法让我毁灭！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Sparky, you and your team know what to do. Take that base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小火花，你们知道要做什么吧。拿下那座基地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Wait. Show me that. Drone patrol route, custom programmed, in the middle of nowhere. Why would the Taxmen send this out there? Get after it, Sparky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 等等，给我看看。专门编程的无人机巡逻路线，地点居然在个鸟不拉屎的地方。收税佬为什么要派无人机去那儿？小火花，跟上它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Stand by. Guts… looks like they wiped the grid before we could lock the place down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 待命，妈的……看来他们赶在我们封锁这里之前就把网络清空了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Not an option. Comms just lit up. The Taxmen are on to your Quill. Sparky, get your team over there. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 没得选了。通讯频道刚炸锅了。收税佬盯上了跟你接头的夜羽。小火花，快带人过去，立刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: This is the place. Eliminate those Corpus teams before they find the Quill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 就是这儿。趁科普斯小队还没找到夜羽，消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Sparky! Drone, dead ahead. LD, when that thing's down, I need you to...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小火花！无人机就在前面。小鸭子，等无人机被打下来，你得……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Way ahead of you. Quill-encrypted data bloc. Working. Tenno: get between the drone and those Moas.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 早料到了。是夜羽加密的数据块，正在破解。Tenno，挡住那些恐鸟，别让它们靠近无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Satellite protocols are in the bag. Right: next steps. I'm comin' out. Meet me on the field.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 卫星协议已是囊中之物了。下一步，我也出发了，咱们战场见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Another wafer, jammed in the intake. Coordinates, definitely. Pointing to somewhere on the Vallis. You can keep fishing to be certain, but it seems to be pointing toward a taxmen base.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 另一块数据晶片卡在进气口了。里面肯定有指向山谷某处的坐标。你可以继续放长线来确认一下。不过看样子，似乎指向一处收税佬的基地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Dead? What kind of Quill walks into an ambush? Search the body, though I suspect the Corpus will have already snatched up our protocols.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 死了？什么夜羽会蠢到中埋伏？快去找尸体，但我怀疑科普斯早就抢走了我们要控制的协议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: No protocols, just… fish bait. This is a bust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 没有协议，只有……鱼饵。这次白忙活了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Hmm… something lodged in that servofish's intake. A digital wafer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 嗯……那条伺服鱼的进气口卡了点东西。是块数字圆晶片？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Quills are always one step ahead. Never seen one take a hit. He'll be around, hidin' somewhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 夜羽永远都快人一步。从没见过哪个夜羽吃过亏。他肯定藏在附近的某个地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Nah. For everything a Quill does there's a reason. Tenno: got a shock spear handy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 不，夜羽做的每件事都有深意。Tenno，你带电击鱼叉了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Hand etched, with numbers. Coordinates maybe. We'll need the rest, try to- Guts! Raknoids! Tenno, getcha fists up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 手工刻上去的数字，也许是坐标。我们需要找到剩下的数字，加油——老天！是蛛形机！Tenno，准备战斗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Sequence complete. Coordinates to this taxmen base. Time for a degree of violence. We need the codes to that satellite or this whole plan is beached.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 序列补全了，坐标指向这个税务官的基地。是时候上点暴力手段了。我们必须拿到那颗卫星的密码，否则整个计划就全泡汤了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Your rendezvous point is a cave. Coordinates marked. Lots of Corpus traffic so you'll wanna do this softly-softly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 接头地点就是一处洞穴，坐标标记给你了。附近有许多科普斯的人出没，你最好低调行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: So, the good news is LD found those big guns we promised you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 好消息是，小鸭子找到了我们答应给你的重火力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Profit-Taker moves, you engage the Orb…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 只要利润收割者一动，你就去缠住它……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: We'll update you on the rest as you go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 其余情况，行动中再告诉你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Enrichment Labs has gone into full lockdown, Boon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 升华实验室已经全面封锁了吗，阿布？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: The plan, if you would?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 说说你的计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: You get all that? I think he said… Intake/outtake vent C7A, rear of Enrichment Labs… though most of that Ventkid jargon sounds like a Kavat coughing up fur-clots.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 都听明白了吗？我想他说的是……升华实验室后部的 C7A 进排气口……通风小子那套黑话，听上去就像库娃在咳毛球。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Leave that to me. First things first, the overcharger satellite. Get into the Labs, locate the controls, inject our recoded protocols, and shut that satellite down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 交给我吧。当务之急，你得先搞定过载卫星。潜入实验室，找到控制台，注入我们重写好的协议，最后把那颗卫星关掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Meanwhile I'll gather data to develop a weakness in her shields using that stolen harmonic schema. The longer you keep her engaged the more observable data I can gather.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 与此同时，我会用偷来的谐波图谱收集数据，找出她护盾的弱点。你拖延她越久，我能采集到的实战数据就越多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Bad news is my info places that firepower in a vault directly beneath the building-sized slaughtermatic horror show we're trying to kill. We need her shifted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 坏消息是，我这的情报显示，重火力就藏在一个保管库里，而上面正好压着那头我们绞尽脑汁想干掉的巨型杀人机器。我们得把她引开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: …and while you take her dancin' I slip in and nick the weapon schematics.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: ……然后趁你领她跳舞兜圈子的时候，我再溜进去，顺走武器蓝图。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: And the less likely she'll wander back and squat on top of my only way out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 我想，她也不太可能突然杀回来，一屁股堵在我唯一的出路上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Good… night… sweet… heart… good... night...
Howzit, lady-matey.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 咋样了，大姐头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Right, Kubrodons got all the tricks, chek? Been taxin' lab parts since we was sprogs. Primo electromags, that place. Anyways: intake/outtake vent C7A, innit? Back a the place. Blocked, but your ol' mucker Boon here's rigged it askew, just for you! chek chek!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 就是，库狛顿门道多着呢，懂？打咱还穿开裆裤起，就开始从实验室里顺零件了。那地儿有顶级的电磁设备。说正经的，进出风口 C7A，晓得吧？那地方本来被封住了，但你阿布哥给你撬松了，专门为你留的缝！懂的都懂！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Deploying satellite protocols.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 开始上传卫星协议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Rejected. Guts, I was afraid of this. You'll need to reboot the antenna array, from outside, at the same time as satellite protocols are uploaded. Outworlders, split up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 上传被拒绝了。可恶，我就怕来这一出。在上传卫星协议的同时，你得从外部重启天线阵列。异世者们，分头行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: First things first: disable the shield overcharger satellite so Biz can knock her of her perch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 首先要做的是，关闭护盾过载卫星，这样比兹才能把她从高处轰下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Good work, all of you. Everyone: we've got all we need. The time is now. Get back to Fortuna and arm up. It's time to finish off Profit-Taker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 大家干得好。都听着，我们需要的都拿到了。现在是时候回福尔图娜了，准备好武器。是时候干掉利润收割者了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Team: somebody has to stay with the console while the others head outside to reboot the antenna array.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 大家注意，在其他人出去重启天线阵列时，必须有人留守控制台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Remember. You need to do this at the same time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 记清楚了。你们必须要同时动手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Execute. Now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 动手。现在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: That's it. Protocol injection is taking. The satellite is going down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 成了，协议注入正在生效。卫星马上就瘫痪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Huh. High-Impact Mortars. That takes me back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 哟，高冲击迫击炮。真让人怀念。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Biz, they're throwing everything they've got at her and it's barely making a scratch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 比兹，他们已经火力全开了，可几乎伤不到她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: LD, what's your situation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小鸭子，你那边什么情况？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Biz, tell me you have enough data!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 比兹，数据应该够了吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: They're sending in heavy reinforcements.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 他们派出了重装增援部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Biz!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 比兹！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Alright, I've got enough! Outworlders! Get ready to run in 3… 2… 1… !
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 行了，数据够了！异世者！准备撤离！3……2……1……跑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: This is a little something I've been saving for a rainy day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 这点小东西，我一直留着以备不时之需。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: From that cache we put aside after the Reclamation uprising?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 从之前我们在回收行动后私藏的那批物资里拿的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Just... keep shooting. I'm getting excellent data from all this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 继续……开火。我从这些攻击中获取了很有用的数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Need… just… a little more… data.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 需要……再……多一点……数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Not yet, we need to be sure! Cycle your damage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 还没完，我们必须确认无误！轮换你的伤害元素！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Biz: get her down, if you would.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 比兹，麻烦你把她弄下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: I hate to interrupt this flashback but I'm goin' in now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 好吧我真不想打岔，但我现在要进去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: I'm inside. Security is thicker than anticipated. I need more time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 我进来了，安保比预期的还要严密。我需要更多的时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Got it. The Gravimag. I'm coming out. Can't wait to introduce that Orb to your archwing weapons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 找到了，重力磁抵器。等不及想看你拿反重力曲翼武器去招呼那个圆蛛了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[4.5]
Who comes hither
Salty wrigglers spitting stones
[8.0]
Foulness. Wetness.
Far from home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[4.5]
来此地者
咸蠕唾石
[8.0]
腌臜湿潮。
欲归无门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: THIEFLINGS! THIEFLINGS! GIVE IT BACK! FIND YOU! CATCH YOU! CRACK CRACK CRACK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 你这小偷！你这小偷！把它还给我。抓他！抓他！咔咔咔

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[3.5]
Stones on bones
Hurt not me
[7.5]
Stingers fly nastily
Damn you damn you dollies cry
[10.5]
Catch you crush you die die die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[3.5]
即便石头
亦打不断我的骨头
[7.5]
虫蝇飞舞嗡嗡嗡
讨厌的洋娃娃快哭吧
[10.5]
抓到你碾碎你快叫吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[4.0]
A hundred soldiers hi
a hundred soldiers ho
[7.5]
I'm having fun
your days are done
[10.0]
run little dollies run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[4.0]
一百个士兵说嗨
一百个士兵说哈
[7.5]
我玩得很开心
你却要完蛋了
[10.0]
快跑吧小洋娃娃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: We have to move fast. Little Duck's waiting for you in the field. Gear up and get out there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 必须加快速度。小鸭子在外面等你呢。带齐装备，出发吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: It's pretty and all but I find it hard to give two-tenths of a paramecium's crap for a place this cold. Right, so: the satellite's sorted but the Orb's shields are gonna adapt to your attacks. Enrichment Labs holds the harmonic schema of Profit-Taker's shields. With it Biz thinks he can slow the adaptation long enough for your crew to inflict some real damage. Raid the place. I'll cover the entrance. And be quick about it, I don't want you having to blowtorch me off whatever I froze to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 这的景色漂亮归漂亮，但在这么鬼冷的地方，我实在没有半点看风景的兴致。好了，说正事。卫星已经搞定了，但圆蛛的护盾还是会适应你们的攻击。升华实验室里保存着「利润收割者」护盾的谐波图谱。比兹认为有了这东西，他就能大幅减缓护盾的适应速度，足够你们对她造成重创。突袭实验室，我负责守住入口。动作要快，我可不想被冻住，然后靠你生火帮我解冻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Ah guts. Nothing's ever easy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 啊，该死，没一件事省心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Two up, two down. That wasn't so bad. Now crack open the data vault and grab that datamass.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 搞定两个，还剩两个。还行，现在打开数据密库，然后取走数据块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Got it. Now get out of there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 到手了。赶紧撤！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: What. The. Balls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 到底搞什么……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
Squishy-pretties come out to play
My two friends, it's you they'll slay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
小可爱们快点出来玩
 我的两位朋友你们可能会完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Right, listen up. Take those passkeys to the data vault outside Enrichment Labs. With the directors taken care of you shouldn't meet much resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 来，听好。把这些密钥带到升华实验室外的数据密库。那些主管都被干掉了，你应该不会遇到太多抵抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: The taxman cares more about self-profit than self-preservation. Watch this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 收税佬把利润看得比自己的小命还重。瞧好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: With your Directors shaking within their panic rooms we come to claim what is ours: the profit of our suffering. We will not leave until every, last, credit has been taken from this facility.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 趁着你们的主管还躲在安全屋里瑟瑟发抖，我们来讨回本属于我们的东西。我们用苦难换来的利润。在拿走这座设施里的最后一毛钱以前，我们绝不会离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Each passkey is held by a Corpus Director. They're skin-scored passkeys, high-value, and the directors have orders to self-preserve. They're not coming out unless you leave them no choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 每个密钥都由一名科普斯主管贴身保管。这些高级别密钥都被植入皮下，价值连城，而且主管们都收到了保命优先的死命令。除非把他们逼上绝路，否则他们绝不会现身的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Profit-Taker's designs are in a triple-locked data vault. Probably a late model Hangvuun-Mercer if I know the Corpus. That means you need three passkeys and you gotta get them quick as those suckers expire if they're not reauthorized on the regular.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 「利润收割者」的设计图锁在三重加密的数据密库里。以我对科普斯的了解，估计是最新型号的翰温-默瑟锁。你需要尽快拿到三个密钥，如果不及时重新授权，它们很快就会失效。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Reinforcements! Kill 'em or lose 'em. Just don't let 'em see you entering Fortuna.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 增援来了！干掉他们或者直接甩掉。只要别让他们看到你进了福尔图娜就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Can't let you in until you deal with those taxmen. I've got families down here to think of.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 那些收税佬还没解决，我不能放你进来。我得为下面的一大帮家属考虑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: All right. Get your crew back to Fortuna. But do it quietly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 行了。带你的小队回福尔图娜吧。不过要注意隐蔽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text:
[3.5]
I am patient
I am still
[7.0]
When I descend
It's you I'll kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText:
[3.5]
耐心如我
沉着如我
[7.0]
于我降临之际
即你毁灭之时。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: You're on the clock, Sparky. The directors carry passkeys for the data vault. Take the directors down before the keys expire and we lose our chance. Your first target is the Armaments Director.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 你得抓紧时间了，小火花。主管们身上带着数据密库的通行密钥，你要赶在密钥失效前解决他们，否则就没机会了。你的第一个目标是军备主管。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Armaments research? How much blood was on that muckers hands?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 搞军备研究的？那混蛋手上得沾多少血？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: The pass keys just expired. Time's up. We'll never get Profit-Taker now. Guts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 密钥刚失效，时间到了。我们现在永远没法打败利润收割者了，妈的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Vivisect Director? Animal experimentation. He deserved his fate. One target remains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 解剖主管？哼，拿动物做试验的。死有余辜。还剩最后一个目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Can't believe they fell for that. Well we got the directors' attention. Comin' out for a nosey. Heavily armed and all, with security.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 真不敢相信他们居然上钩了。好了，我们成功引起了主管们的注意，他们全副武装，带着一群安保，准备出来一探究竟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Scratch one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 搞定一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Nighty-night.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 睡吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: How many more of you are there?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 你们还有多少人在这儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Better you than me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 死道友不死贫道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Scratch another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 又搞定一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Another one down. You Outworlders can thank me later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 另一个也拿下了。你们这些异世者回头再谢我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Sentient Research Director? So that's what you get for messin' with things you don't understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: Sentient 研究主管？瞎搞自己也不懂的玩意儿，只有死路一条。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: From her perch above Enrichment Labs, Profit-Taker has a perfect vantage to bombard anything she doesn't like. That's a huge problem for us. So we're taking her down. Biz?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 利润收割者盘踞在升华实验室上方，占据绝佳的制高点，随时可以轰炸她看不顺眼的目标。这对我们可是个大麻烦。那么要把她打下来吗，比兹？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Successful elimination proceeds in three stages: first we knock out the orbital overcharger. Second: decoding Profit-Taker's Sentient shielding to ensure the Tenno can land fire on her directly. Third: providing the weaponry needed to penetrate that heavy duty carapace. Little Duck's chasing a lead on something with a lot more grunt than your usual hand weapons. But, first things first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 想成功解决她，得分成三个步骤：第一，打掉轨道过载卫星。第二，破解利润收割者的 Sentient 护盾，确保 Tenno 的火力能直接落在她身上。第三，准备能打穿她重型外壳的武器。小鸭子在找一件大家伙，那玩意儿的威力可比常用的单兵武器猛多了。不过，饭要一口一口吃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Gear up. Hit the field. Once you're topside we'll provide directions to your meeting with the Quill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 整备装备，出发。你抵达地表后，我们会指引你去和夜羽接头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Profit-Taker is an autonomous battle platform piloted by hybrid AI, with Sentient adaptive shielding, reinforced by an overcharger satellite in geosynchronous orbit. Beneath that her armor is a composite carapace usually reserved for Corpus warships.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 「利润收割者」由混合人工智能驾驶的自主战斗平台，配备 Sentient 自适应护盾，并由同步轨道上的过载卫星提供能量强化。在护盾之下，她的装甲是用通常只用于科普斯战舰的复合材料打造而成的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Phase One: With the overcharger online Profit-Taker is, as far as our little group is concerned, invulnerable. The satellite overcharges the Orb's shield. We knock the overcharger on the head, and she's down to regular shielding. Here's how we do that. Little Duck?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 第一步，只要过载卫星还在运行，就凭咱们这点人手，根本无法摧毁「利润收割者」。过载卫星会一直给圆蛛的护盾充能。要是我们能把她头顶的卫星打掉，她就只能被迫使用常规护盾了。就这么办，行得通吗小鸭子？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Satellite behaves according to protocols. We control the protocols, we control the satellite. That's where my weirdy-beardy Quill mate comes in. Almost as if he knew we'd need this he's got himself perfectly placed to provide. We're meeting him today for the handoff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 卫星是按照协议运行的。我们控制了协议，就等于控制了卫星。这就得靠我那神叨叨的夜羽老兄出马了。他好像早料到我们需要他的帮助，都完全准备好了。我们今天就去跟他对接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Nef has the entire Vallis locked down with his Orb Mothers. They watch over the central lakes… patrol the eastern grids… It's next to impossible for Ticker to get families out of Fortuna or smuggle in supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 奈富用圆蛛封锁了整个山谷。它们监视着中心湖区……在东部区域巡逻……提克尔如今想把一家老小送出福尔图娜，或是走私点补给进来，几乎是不可能的事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Questions?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 还有问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: Sparky. Right. We're all here, let's get started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 小火花。很好，人都齐了，那就开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.text: The Mothers are a product of Corpus breakthroughs using salvaged Sentient technology. Traditional weapons are ineffective against them. Their command and control systems have, thus far, proven impenetrable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/FortunaOrbHeis.zhText: 圆蛛是科普斯利用 Sentient 技术研发的突破性产物。传统武器对她们毫无用处。到目前为止，她们的指挥和控制系统也被证实是铁板一块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Come home to daddy, little Ghoul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 回爸爸身边来吧，小尸鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Oh Ghoul, we are going to have a discussion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 哦，小尸鬼，我们可得好好「谈谈」。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: You didn't see this coming. Did you?
Ghouly, ghouly, ghoul. I'm going to make you wish you were captured by the Lotus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 尸鬼呀，尸鬼呀，小尸鬼。我会让你后悔当初没落到莲手里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Back in the bag, Ghoul. I'm never letting you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 滚回孕育袋里去，尸鬼。这回我绝不会再放你出来。
你挑起的乱子，我来收尾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: This does not make us allies. Is that understood, maggot?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 别以为这样就算结盟了，蛆虫。听明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: You filthy Tenno have saved us both from a future headache. I don't hate you right now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 你这肮脏的 Tenno，倒替我们双方省去了日后的大麻烦。至少现在，我不恨你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Not bad for a Tenno maggot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 对 Tenno 蛆虫来说，干得不赖。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: The traitorous instigator skulks somewhere on this galleon. Find him. Capture him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 那个叛变的闹事者就躲在这艘帆船战舰上。找到他，活捉回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: An instigator cowers somewhere in the bowels of this ship. Find and capture the wretch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 有个闹事者就藏在这艘船的深处。抓住这个废物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: An instigator hides like a coward. Blow up every corner of this galleon until he shows his putrid face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 有个闹事者像懦夫一样躲了起来。炸毁这艘帆船战舰的每一个角落，直到他露出那张腐烂的嘴脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Ghouls! You arrogant wretches. My hatred for you has caused me to work WITH THE TENNO!!! Do you know how ANGRY THAT MAKES ME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 尸鬼！你们这群狂妄的杂碎。我恨你们恨到竟然不得不与 Tenno 联手！！！知道这让我有多愤怒吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Come out, come out, wherever you are, little troublemaker. This Tenno has a present for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 出来吧，出来吧，不管你藏在哪儿，小捣蛋鬼。Tenno 有份礼物送给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Attention, you insolent Ghoul corpse: this Tenno will blow up anything that moves until they find you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 听好了，你这坨不知天高地厚的尸鬼烂肉！这个 Tenno 会把一切会动的东西炸上天，直到把你揪出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text: Ghouls. Remember when you all cried 'mmm the Ogris is too dangerous'. Maybe you were right!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText: 尸鬼，还记得你们当初一个个哼哼唧唧地说：「食人女魔太危险了」吗？看来你们说得对！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.text:
Tenno, you wretched maggots. My Ghouls have betrayed me. Stolen my galleons and weapon parts. They aim to attack me AND YOU. So… We both have a problem.

My solution: you. You capture the instigators. Use my favorite instrument of explosive violence: the Ogris. In return, you keep what they stole, and we both crush an enemy. 

Take it or leave it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GalleonOfGhoul.zhText:
Tenno，你这可恶的蛆虫。我的尸鬼背叛了我。偷走了我的帆船战舰和武器部件。它们打算袭击我——还有你。所以……我们俩都有麻烦了。

我的解决办法，就是你。你去抓住带头闹事的尸鬼。用我最喜欢的暴力武器——食人女魔。作为回报，它们偷走的东西就归你了，我们就能消灭共同的敌人了。

干不干随你便。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Bird, a word: you saw nothing. You say nothing...yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 鸟，记住这话：你什么都没看到。你什么都不要说……好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Bird, you saw nothing, remember? Everybody's talking about you, Bird, because everybody knows Bird's as good as his word. Bird, bird?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 鸟，你什么都没看见，记住了吗？大家都在谈论你，鸟，因为大家都知道鸟言出必行。鸟，听见了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Bird, keep that beak in the OFF position!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 鸟，把喙闭上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Bird, distract yourself with your favourite colour and forget what you heard! Good chap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 鸟，用你最喜欢的颜色分散自己的注意力，忘记你所听到的！好孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Now that was a scary dream, RIGHT BIRD? You can't see but I'm winking, I don't have eyelids.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 那真是一个可怕的梦，对吧，鸟？虽然你看不到，但我在眨眼，只是我没有眼皮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: A Dimensional Orb! Papa's research anticipated such wonders, though he never witnessed them himself. As a mathematician, I rejoice - as a sane being I feel my mind folding in on itself while screaming 'destroy it'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 一个次元球体！爸爸的研究曾预测到这类奇观，但他自己却未曾亲眼目睹过。作为一名数学家，我兴奋不已——但作为一个理智的生物，我感到自己的思维在崩溃，内心叫嚣着"摧毁它"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: The Dimensional Orb protects the Angel. Pass through to destroy it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 次元球体保护着天使。穿过去破坏它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Mr Fish-o-nah-chee? It flew away! Hey! Chase it. Chase it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 肥鱼那契先生？它飞走了！嘿！追它。去追它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Ooh that's loud. Well we're loud too! RARK! Go get 'em! RARK! Wuk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 噢，好大声。不过我们也很大声！啦嘎！去抓他们吧！啦嘎！呜咕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: They got wings, I got wings, they angels... am I an angel? DON'T PLUCK ME! THEY WENT THATTAWAY! RARK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 他们有翅膀，我也有翅膀，他们是天使……我也是天使吗？不要拔我的羽毛！他们去那边了！啦嘎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Corrective measures, now! Pluck and de-feather those Void Angels! If you do not leave here with both Plume and Curse, my exceptional error will go forever uncorrected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 立即采取纠正措施！拔掉那些虚空天使的羽毛！如果你不带着翎羽和诅咒离开这里，我的重大失误将永远无法纠正。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: My design is flawed! The Gargoyle in your Dojo has a blind spot. Fell the Angel. Silence the Murmur. Then I may yet... adjust for this oversight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 我的设计是有缺陷的！你道场里的合成兽像有个盲点。消灭那个天使。让低语者闭嘴。然后我或许还能……补救这个疏漏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: I neglected to account for Void emergence within my own sphere! An angel must fall, and the Murmur must be hushed. Both things must happen here, in sequence! Lest our doors be perpetually flung wide to the horrors of the beyond.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 我没有考虑到虚空会在我的领域的出现！天使必须被打倒，低语者必须被压制。这两件事必须依次在这里发生！以免我们的大门永远向外界的恐怖敞开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: A simple sequence.: Awaken. Pluck. Delete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 一个简单的顺序：觉醒。拔掉。清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: It is waking up. Un-make it, quickly now! Before my miscalculation takes effect... and draws the attention! Of the Murmur.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 它正在苏醒。迅速消灭它，快！在我误算产生影响……并引起低语者的注意之前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text:
Tenno,

I was brash - thank you for banishing the Void Angels from the halls beyond the Sanctum. I thought it wiser to detect the Murmur getting out, but the real risk was Void Angels getting in. 

Thank you. All of you, from those clans numbering but one, to the mighty coalitions encompassing thousands.

The Gargoyles are aligned. A proverbial net has been strung across the known system. The Angels are repelled. I hear them bellowing even now, in their cheated rage. The Indifference is caged and confined.

Should it break forth in some future time, those who stand against it then will look back on what you did this day and say: they did their part, all of them. And so shall we.

Be proud, Tenno. It is well deserved.

Fibonacci
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText:
Tenno，

我曾冒失过——感谢你们在圣所外的大厅赶走虚空天使。我原本认为监测敌人的撤退更为明智，但真正的风险在于虚空天使的闯入。 

谢谢你们。感谢你们每一个人，无论是那些仅有一个成员的氏族，还是那些拥有数千成员的强大联盟。

合成兽像已经就位。一张众所周知的网已经在整个已知的星系中张开。天使们被击退了。我现在还能听到他们在被愚弄的愤怒中咆哮。虚空无情之物仍被禁锢和限制。

如果将来它再次爆发，那时站出来对抗它的人们将会回顾今天你们所做的，并说：他们每个人都尽了份内之事。我们也会这样做。

自豪吧，Tenno。这是你当之无愧的。

斐波那契

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: You must become curse-bearer for my error to be rectified. Seize it. I must compensate for the blind spot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 你必须成为诅咒背负者，我的失误才能得到纠正。抓住它。我得对这个盲点进行补救。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Grasp that lingering curse and pray no one heard!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 抓住那个徘徊的诅咒，并祈求没人听到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: From that curse, I shall glean the knowledge to re-calibrate the Jahu Gargoyle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 我将从那个诅咒中收集知识来重新校准形态形态合成兽像。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Rewards for your discretion concerning the um... my miscalculation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 关于你对我的……计算失误保持谨慎行事的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Items of value, worth silence in the Sanctum, wouldn't you agree?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 有价值的物品，足以换取圣所中的缄默，你同意吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Immeasurably powerful things. Treasures. And they're only for you, so long as you don't puff a word of this in the Sanctum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 强大无比的东西。宝藏。而且它们都是你的，只要你在圣所里一字不提。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: An error in your favor, I miscalculated the Gargoyle's Cry, but I also miscalculated the value of these items. They're cheap, biped, and they'll stay that way so long as the Sanctum's many ears catch no wind or word. Nod for yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 这是个对你有利的错误，我误算了合成兽像的悲鸣，但我也低估了这些物品的价值。它们很便宜，两脚兽，只要圣所那些耳朵收不到任何风声或消息，它们就会保持这样的价值。点头表示同意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: One hears stories of demented architects. One does not expect to admire their work first-hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 常听说一些疯狂建筑师的故事。没想到自己能亲自欣赏到他们的作品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Do please remember that I can see everything that goes on in this Dojo. EVERYTHING.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 请记住，我可以看到这个道场中发生的一切。一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: You should invite some friends to explore this jolly maze you've built. Based on Escher was it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 你应该邀请一些朋友来探索你建造的这个欢乐迷宫。这是依照埃舍尔的风格建造对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Why not ask some guests from another Clan over to admire your handiwork? Think how jealous they would be of your Gargoyle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 为何不邀请其他氏族的客人来欣赏你的手艺呢？想想看，他们会有多羡慕你的合成兽像。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Decluttering. Ever heard of it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 整理杂物。你听说过这个吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: My humble tank is a palace compared to some Dojos I've seen. Real shit holes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 与我见过的一些道场相比，我的简陋玻璃缸简直就像宫殿。那些地方是真正的粪坑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Who picked out the color scheme, and are they wanted for any additional offenses?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 是谁选的这个配色方案？他们还因为其他什么罪行而被通缉吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Thank you so much for bringing me into your home. You know, it's not quite as squalid as I had feared.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 非常感谢你带我来到你家。你知道吗，这里并没有我之前担心的那样肮脏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Were you aiming for a sort of... rococo... effect?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 你是在追求某种……洛可可风格……的效果吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: This gargoyle feeds upon the corrupt and accursed energies of the Murmur. It enrages the Void Angels. This is your task, Tenno: destroy the Fragmented Ones. Draw their curse into yourself. An ordeal, but a noble one to be sure. Return to me here, and I shall absorb all trace of the curse.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 这个合成兽像以低语者的腐化和诅咒能量为食。它激怒了虚空天使们。这是你的任务，Tenno：消灭接肢。将它们的诅咒吸收到自己身上。这是一场考验，但无疑是高尚的。回到我这里，我会吸收掉所有诅咒的痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Feeding this Gargoyle shall require an unfashionable activity known as 'work'. If you are not willing to commit, then perhaps your Dojo would be best kept as a playroom for truculent infants.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 给这个合成兽像喂食将需要进行一项不太受欢迎的活动，也就是"工作"。如果你不愿意全力以赴，那么你的道场或许更适合成为熊孩子的游戏室。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Tenno? Can you hear me? Allow me to be the first to congratulate you on the laying of this, the foundation stone of a future both stable and secure. Your Dojo may now connect with others to form a mighty bastion against the Murmur's nullifying and relentless expansion. What? A miscalculation, surely...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: Tenno？你能听到我吗？请允许我首先祝贺你，你为未来的稳定和安全奠定了基础。你的道场现在可以与其他道场连接，形成对抗低语者抹杀式的无情扩张的坚固防线。什么？这一定是个误算……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Uh... New plan. The Gargoyle must be re-calibrated, DISCREETLY, as it would appear that, already, something is attempting ingress. I only calibrated for egress. Why did I only calibrate for egress? To the labs. To Effervo! Like, now! Quickly, to Effervo! Calm heads, everyone! Calm heads!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 呃……新计划。合成兽像必须谨慎地重新调整，因为似乎已经有什么东西在试图进来。我只针对外出做了校准。我怎么只对外出的情况校准？到实验室去。快到恶涌那里！马上！赶紧去恶涌！大家要保持镇定！保持冷静！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Discretion. Bird. You. Discretion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 慎重。鸟。就是你。要慎重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Curse-bearer, to the Gargoyle in your Dojo. Not a word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 诅咒背负者，前往你道场中的合成兽像处。什么也别说。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Thank you curse-bearer. The error in my formula is... partly redeemed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 谢谢你，诅咒背负者。我的公式中的错误……部分已得到了补救。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: What happened here, did not happen. Savvy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 这里发生的事情，其实未曾发生。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Now, a secret shared between... friends, yes?... is a secret made... sacrosanct. Yes? I can rely upon your... discretion?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 现在，作为朋友之间……的一个秘密，是吧？……就是一个神圣不可侵犯的……秘密，好吗？我可以依赖你的……慎重吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Silently, quickly, traverse to your Dojo and feed the Gargoyle!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 悄悄地、快速地前往你的道场并喂食合成兽像！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Bird, should you vow to forget this... oversight... I do solemnly swear to do all in my power to ensure you one day again nest beneath... sky blue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 鸟，如果你愿意发誓忘记这个……疏忽……我郑重地发誓会尽我所能确保你有朝一日能再次在……湛蓝的天空下筑巢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Ahhh. Recalibrating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 啊。重新校准中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Mmhh. Delicious, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 嗯。美味，是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Such exquisite despair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 如此绝妙的绝望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: Is that... all?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 就……这样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: You are... purged. Go and become cursed once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 你被……净化了。去吧，去再次受到诅咒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text: I must have more. Recalibration takes energy you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText: 我需要更多。毕竟，重新校准是需要消耗能量的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.text:
Your attention please.

The Murmur threat demands immediate action. Our first order of business must be surveillance. An early detection system lest we be caught sans trousers. 

You would agree that a Jahu Gargoyle installed within each Tenno Dojo is the obvious solution. Not a whisper could be uttered in the system without the connected Dojos overhearing it first. 

Your compliance is appreciated. The Jahu Gargoyle awaits you within your Dojo - simply place it as a Decoration. The enemy does not hesitate. We must do no less.

Fibonacci
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GargoylesCry/D.zhText:
请注意。

面对低语者的威胁，我们需要立刻行动。我们的首要任务是监视。建立一个早期警报系统，以免被敌人突然袭击。

你一定会同意，将形态合成兽像安置在每个 Tenno 道场内是一个显而易见的解决方案。在这些相互连接的道场中，星系内的任何低语都无法逃过我们的监听。 

感谢你的合作。形态合成兽像已在你的道场中等候——只需将其作为装饰摆放。敌人不会犹豫。我们也必须如此。

斐波那契

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Security in today's marketplace is more important than ever. So why trifle with organics? Our Model-3 Jackal is second-to-none in lethal enforcement solutions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 就目前的市场而言，安保的重要性已然达到了前所未有的高度。既然如此，何必把精力浪费在有机体上？我们这款豺狼3号机就是武力介入的最佳方案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: We Stand Tall, disciples. Remember your Corpus vows. Our profit is your peace. Your peace is our prosperity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 我们昂首挺胸，信徒们。牢记你们的 Corpus 誓言。我们的利润就是你们的安稳。而你们的安稳就是我们的繁荣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Leadership. Growth. Corpus Robotics create new opportunities in colonial suppression. Security is safety. Comfort is containment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 领导。发展。Corpus 的机器人为殖民地镇压行动带来了新机遇。安保意味着安全。舒适意味着遏制。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Market forces demand we Evolve, Overturn, Adapt. Opportunity demands we Partner with those we once called the Enemy... and move forward together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 市场的推动力迫使我们进化、革新、适应。机遇迫使我们与曾经的敌人合作……并且一同前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Partners may attempt to communicate. If so disengage immediately, note the exchange and convey it to your supervisor. Again: there is to be no contact between Corpus personnel and our Partners. Carry on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 这些合伙人可能会试图与你们交流。如果发生这种情况，请保存通讯记录，然后将记录转交给你们的上级。特此重申：Corpus 人员无需与合伙人发生任何接触。继续执行任务吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Please note: Lab stations are to be prepped for the next shift prior to being unmanned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 请注意：在进入无人值守状态之前，实验站必须为下一次轮班做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Remember: Amalgam technology is first-of-kind. You are not. In the event of a mishap secure the asset first, tend to casualties second. Have faith in our work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 记住：并合技术是首屈一指的。但你们不是。一旦发生意外，务必先保护资产，再处理伤患。在工作的同时，要抱有信心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: In the event of contact with our Partners, remember your vows! Permit, Preserve, Proclaim! Permit aggression in the name of data science. Preserve the Partner, resist defensive action. Proclaim quarantine to advance further study.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 在与我们的合伙人接触的情况下，请牢记你的誓言！应许，援护，预告！以研究数据的名义，应许攻击性举动。援护合伙人，抵制防御行动。及时预告并采取隔离操作，以便进一步研究。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Remember: a class-D7 breathing apparatus is required for outdoor labor. How many times do I have to tell them this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 记住：户外劳作需要 D7 级呼吸器。我到底还得告诉他们多少次？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Partner Amalgam units may seem unnatural, incomprehensible, unethical. They may trigger irrational responses in fellow disciples. Be vigilant for these reactions. Safeguard our new friends. They are our future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 合伙人并合单位可能看起来不太自然，行为难以理解，且毫无道德可言。它们可能会引发其他信徒不理智的反应。警惕这些反应。保护好我们的新朋友， 他们是我们的未来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Seize initiative to seize the moment. Seize the moment... to seize the future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 掌握主动来把握时机。抓住时机……来掌握未来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: All disciples are to memorize the location of the nearest fire extinguisher, optical flusher, auto-medic, and decontamination cabinet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 所有的信徒都要记住距离最近的灭火器、双眼紧急冲洗器、自动医疗器和去污柜的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Abandoning your station without supervisor authority will result in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 在没有监管权限的情况下离开工作岗位将受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Failure to wear mandated safety gear will result in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 未按要求穿戴安全防护装备将受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Failure to honor non-disclosure vows will result in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 未按要求履行保密承诺将受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Initiating contact with the Partners will result in severe sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 主动与合伙人接触将受到严厉处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Failure to obey sterilization protocols will result in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 未按要求遵守消毒程序将受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Failure to keep solids out of the waste sinks will result in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 未按要求将固态废弃物保存在废弃池外将会受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Reminder: possible sanctions include work therapy, wage garnishment, shock protocols, organ donation, exposure, and 'the floor'. Conduct yourselves righteously, disciples.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 记住：可能受到的处罚包括加班治疗、工资抵扣、电击流程、器官捐赠、暴晒和"楼层作业"。信徒们，你们要按规章行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Consumption of food or drink within the laboratory spaces will result in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 在实验室区域内进食或饮水将受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Speak your mind! All complaints may be lodged with the Sub-Personnel Comptroller, Level 6, Bisection Zeta, Indigo Quadrant, Room 74390-point-beta-beta-333 every alternate day of, every alternate week.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 说出你的想法！所有投诉均可在隔周每隔一天向位于第6层、Zeta 二分区、靛蓝四分区、74390-beta-beta-333号房间的低级员工审计长提出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Remember: if you have to ask, the answer is 'No.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 记住：如果你一定要些问什么，答案肯定是否定的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: The latest candidates for the Partner Amalgamation process have been chosen. May we all bless their fortune.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 合伙人并合流程招募中的最新候选人已经确定。在此我们预祝他们一切顺利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: New amalgam batches awake! And sections 4 through 8 expect reduced oxygen levels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 新一批次的并合机械体已经苏醒！此外第 4 至第 8 区域预计氧气水平会降低。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Pilots. Our Partners complain that you are flying too close to their vessels. Their airspace is now considered sacred. Violation of this no-fly-zone will result in severe sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 飞行员们，我们的合伙人抱怨你们飞得太靠近他们的船只了。他们的领空现在是神圣不可侵犯的。违反此禁飞区域条例将受到严厉处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: If you encounter our Partners moving about the installation; eyes forward. Do not tempt fate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 如果你们碰到我们的合伙人正在执行安装作业，千万别盯着他们看。不要拿自己的性命开玩笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Vow Catalog Updated: Vow 137, commit to memory, "It is forbidden to disturb the partners."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 誓言条例更新：137 号誓言，"严禁打扰合伙人"，请务必牢记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: For your peace of mind the Vow Catalog has been updated: commit to memory new subclauses to Vows 7, 17, 28, 29, 30, 50, 54, 78a, 88, 94, 99, 107g, 112 and 138. Testing may occur at any time. Failure results in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 为了让你们安心，誓言条例已经更新：请务必牢记第7、17、28、29、30、50、54、78a、88、94、99、107g、112和138号誓言的新增子条例。我们随时都可能会进行抽测。未能通过测试的人将会受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: A reminder that all 136 Employment Vows are to... what... 138, is it that many... all 138 employment vows are to be committed to memory. Testing may occur at any moment. Failure results in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 请注意，全部136项雇员誓言都要……什么……138项，有这么多吗……全部138项雇员誓言都需要牢记。我们随时都可能会进行抽测。未能通过测试的人将会受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Corpus disciples, our new Partners are allies in power and prosperity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: Corpus 信徒们，我们的新合伙人是拥有力量与财富的盟友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Attention. Meetings with our partners continue in Section 2. We are not to be disturbed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 注意。与我们合伙人的会谈将在区划2内继续进行。请勿打扰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: All personnel: eavesdropping on Partner data transfers will result in neuro-carnivorous memes birthing themselves in your subconscious. You are to avoid channel Upsilon-3.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 所有人员请注意：窃听合伙人的数据传输将会导致窃听者的潜意识中产生肉食性神经模因。请避免使用Upsilon-3频道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Our Partners continue to aid in the Amalgam effort. We are to extend them every courtesy. That includes respecting their privacy. Failure to do so will result in sanction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 我们的合伙人仍在协助我们完成并合项目。我们要用行动来回报他们。这其中就包括：尊重他们的隐私。没能做到这一点的人将会受到处罚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Everyday objects may exhibit anomalous responses. Remember your vows: Accept And Ignore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 日常事物可能会表现出异常反应。请谨记你们的誓言：接纳并且无视。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Exposure to Partner communications may provoke aberrant mental patterning. If you experience these visions, report to the nearest auto-medic for shock protocol.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 与合伙人的通讯信息接触可能导致神经回路发生畸变。如果你们发现自己出现了幻觉，请到最近的自动医疗机上执行电击流程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Your environment may change unexpectedly. Remember your vows: Accept And Ignore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 你们所处的环境可能会发生意料之外的变化。请谨记你们的誓言：接纳并且无视。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Key operational assets may be obfuscated. Accept And Ignore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 关键的行动资料可能会经过数据混淆处理。接纳并且无视。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Friends and coworkers may change without warning. Accept And Ignore.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 你们的朋友和同事们的身上可能会出现毫无征兆的突变。接纳并且无视。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Any sign of the Tenno threat must be investigated and reported immediately. Investigate and report, disciples.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 任何与 Tenno 相关的迹象必须调查并立即汇报。调查并且汇报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Neither I, nor our partners will tolerate Tenno incursions into these sacred halls. If you see something, investigate and report.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 我和我们的合伙人都不会容忍 Tenno 侵犯这些神圣的殿堂。如果你发现了任何蛛丝马迹，调查并且汇报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Like the sun, my wealth enlightens everything in the system, including you, my disciples.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 就像太阳唤醒万物一样，我的财富启迪了系统里的一切事物，其中也包括你们，我的信徒们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.text: Our enemies offer poverty and desolation. Your vows, Disciples, are the only path to prosperity and fortune, my fortune.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DAladP.zhText: 我们的敌人只会带来贫穷和荒芜。你们的誓言，信徒们，是通往荣华富贵的唯一之道，而这富贵也将属于我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: Things have never been this bad. The currents are strengthening in that rank cesspool of a Board. Nef Anyo has consolidated his power on Venus, winning Frohd Bek's favor. All eyes are turning toward their new darling. And the currents… the currents would drag me down. I am underestimated. I am unseen. I must turn that to my advantage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: 情况从未如此严峻过。董事会那个污水坑让暗流变得更加汹涌了。奈富·安尤已经巩固了他在金星上的力量，赢得了 Frohd Bek 的青睐。所有人都把目光转向他们的新欢。而那些暗流……会让我万劫不复。我被低估了，被忽视了。我必须利用这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: I seek advantage and advantage appears! I'd long thought that old fool Regus dead, but here is - rich and gullible as ever! With an offer of shared wealth. Says he has tech like I've never seen! Old War tech. And he wants an investor. Oh, I'll invest all right…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: 我寻求机遇，机遇就送上门来了！我一直以为那个老傻瓜 Regus 已经死了，可瞧瞧现在——他跟以前一样有钱又容易上当受骗！他提供了一个能一起牟利的途径。他说他有我从未见过的技术！远古之战的技术，而且他想要一个投资人。哦，我会投资的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: This is about more than investment. Regus surprises me. How a man of his limited intellect came by such wonders is…. But… forget that. What he has is… exceptionally viable. Where did he find this technology? It stinks of Tau, but the advantages to be had in the exploitation of it… the things I could create… the profits I could accrue… the Board will never dare underestimate me again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: 这不仅仅是投资的问题。Regus 让我感到震惊。一个像他这样脑子不灵光的人是如何取得这样的奇迹的……但是……算了。他现在所拥有的技术……尽管诡异，但却可行。他是在哪里找到了这项技术？它散发着来自 Tau 星系的恶臭，但只要合理利用，它就能让我取得优势……想想那些我能借此创造出来的东西……我能获得的利润……董事会再也不敢低估我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: Regus' price was high, but I dangled the Board's most enticing intellectual property, SysComm, to seal the deal.  Then I placed a contract, loaded with escape clauses and loopholes, in that slack, idiot's fingers… And he signed! The fool signed without even reading it! Any partner that thick is a liability. A liability soon to be nullified.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: Regus 的要价很高，但是我拿出了董事会最诱人的知识产权，SysComm，作为交易筹码。随后，我起草了一份合同，里面附加了各种免责条款和漏洞，并把它交到了那个懒散的白痴手里……然后他签了名！这个笨蛋连看都没有看就签了名！任何一个迟钝的合作伙伴都是一种负担。一种很快就会被废弃的负担。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: Regus has changed. Or, perhaps, he is not such a fool... and today I saw beneath the mask. He is no longer so agreeable. Rather he came to our meeting with a raft of his own, radical, proposals. An entire shift in direction. And then, as I made to leave, he smiled. He smiled and, for just a second, I don't think his face was human at all. This is all wrong. I'm tearing up the contract. I have a terrible feeling that if do not escape this partnership immediately, I never will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: Regus 变了。或者，也许，他根本就不傻……今天我看到他面具下的真面目了。他不再那么讨人喜欢了。相反地，他来参加我们的会议时，提出了大量他自己的激进建议。整个战略方向的转变。然后，当我准备离开时，他冲我笑了。他笑了，但就在那一瞬间，我觉得他的脸根本就不像人类。这一切都是错误。我要撕毁这份合同。有一种可怕的感觉萦绕在我的心头，如果再不立即摆脱这种合伙关系，我会永远无法脱身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: That was not Regus. It was never Regus. It revealed its true face to me and… by the Void. I've entered into a partnership… with Sentients. The world-builders, the world-killers. Our enemy under all. This contract is worthless. Instead, they demand submission. CT! Assemble the disciples. Arm the Condors. Those oversized crustaceans have no idea who they're dealing with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: 那不是 Regus，它从来就不是 Regus。它通过虚空……给我展示了它的真面目。原来……我和 Sentient 结成了合伙关系。那些世界的改造者，世界的毁灭者。我们所有人的劲敌。这份合同毫无价值。相反，它们要求我的服从。终端机！召集信徒们，武装好秃鹫空投艇。让那些巨大的甲壳生物明白自己到底在跟谁打交道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: That did not go as planned. Thousands against one. That massive grotesque tore through my forces like a shark through a shoal. We never inflicted so much as a scratch. Now it perches outside my home. The message is clear. I am to make Amalgams, and if I cross them, the Ropalolyst makes an ash cloud of this city. If my rivals find out I'll be executed for treason. What choice do I have but to comply?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: 事情没能按计划进行。千军万马对付一只怪物。那个大家伙像鲨鱼穿过浅滩一样撕裂着我的部队。而我们却无法伤到它分毫。现在，它就栖息在我的家门外。这一切所要传达的信息已经很明显了。我得开始制造并合体了，如果我反抗它们的话，蝠力使就会把这座城市变为废墟。如果我的竞争对手们发现了我的背叛行为，那我肯定会遭到处决。可现在，我除了服从，还有什么选择呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.text: Disciples! Good news! The Amalgam program has entered into a fruitful partnership. Pursuant to our agreement, their identities will be kept confidential, and a strict no-fly zone shall be instated around their craft. In time the nature of our project will be made known. Until then know that we work for a brighter Corpus future! Life is Profit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCAla.zhText: 信徒们！好消息！并合计划缔结了一段富有成效的合伙关系。根据我们的协议，他们的身份会得到保密，而他们的飞船周围也会设立严格的禁飞区。假以时日，我们的计划终会被世人所知。在那一刻来临之前，请所有人谨记，我们是在为 Corpus 光明未来而奋战！生命，就是为了盈利！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: Helium-3 processors are key to the operation of this facility's reactor cores. It would be a shame if something happened to them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 氦－3 处理器是这个设施反应炉核心连转的关键。要是它们发生了一些问题的话就太可惜了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: These Elemental Condensers are the heart of Alad's operation. His profit center. ---Smash. It. Up.---
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 这些元素冷凝器是阿拉德一切操作的核心。他的获利中心。——-砸。了。它——-

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: Success! Core melt initiated. In a few brief moments, this facility will cease to exist. May Ordis suggest ---running for your life.---
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 成功！核心熔解已启动。在片刻过后，该设施将不复存在。Ordis 想建议您——赶快跑啊——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: Now, turn your attention to the reactor core. Locate the console and initiate the overdrive sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 现在，将您的注意力转向反应炉核心。找到控制台并启动超载序列。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: Overdrive sequence in progress. This will take a few moments. Do not allow Alad's personnel to reverse the sequence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 超载序列进行中。这会花上一些时间。不要让阿拉德的人员反转了这个序列。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: Elemental condensers... helium-3 processors. Alad's facility is consuming Jupiter's resources on a massive scale... Operator, you certainly have an eye for strategic targets. Ordis has marked key infrastructure for demolition... ---Get in there and kick aaaaaaa... access the facility.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 元素冷凝器……氦－3 处理器。阿拉德的设备正在大规模处理木星的资源。指挥官，您对战略目标很有眼光。Ordis 标记了需要拆除的关键基础设施……进入那里然后大肆破……调查吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: First targets marked: Render them non-functional.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 第一目标已标示：彻底破坏它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.text: Most efficient, Operator! Ordis has located the next bank of machinery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DGCSab.zhText: 真有效率，指挥官！Ordis 已经找到了下一排机器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: The data's good at least. Worth more than a few trinkets to our business partners, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 至少数据看来还不错。我们可以拿这些数据跟那些生意伙伴换几个小钱 ，很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: CT, integrate this for the next generational cycle. We need to recoup… aggressively.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 终端机，将这些数据整合进下一轮循环里。我们的回收操作……应当更积极一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Another weakness revealed and removed. Who knew these violent prongs would be so good at science!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 另一个弱点暴露了，然后被移除了。没想到这帮野蛮的家伙还挺擅长科学研究的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Unfortunately. But this is how evolution works. One generation closer to an Amalgam they just can't kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 很遗憾。但这就是进化的运作方式。我们的目标是制造出无敌的并合体，而每当新的一代出现时，我们离这个目标又近了一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: This is getting out of hand.
Wasteful, but failure teaches faster. Our Partners will be pleased.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 真浪费，但失败会加快进化的速度。我们的合作伙伴将会很开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: And now, Betrayers, for something completely different.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 好了，背叛者们，现在我为你们准备了一些完全不一样的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Betrayers, my Partners and I have been working on a new project, and I wanted you to be the first to see... my... Amalgams!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 背叛者们，我和我的合伙人正在研究一个新项目，我希望你第一个看到……我的……并合体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Amalgam technology. It's beautiful. Experience it! One death at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 并合科技。这太美妙了。尝尝它的厉害！一击毙命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Betrayers, let me introduce my new friends. My latest in hybrid commerce. My Amalgams!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 背叛者们，让我来介绍一下我的新朋友们。我最新的合成生意。我的并合体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Amalgams; hybrid lifeforms. A familiar concept to you, is it not, Betrayers?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 并合体；合成的生命形态。这个概念听起来很耳熟吧，难道不是吗，背叛者们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Tenno: relics of a bygone era. My Amalgams are the new paradigm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: Tenno 不过是旧时代的遗物。我的并合体才是新的典范。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: Any last requests, Tenno? Moa got your tongue? Fine - release the Amalgams!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 还有什么临终的请求吗，Tenno？怎么了，舌头被恐鸟叼走了吗？好吧，派出并合体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.text: While the rest of the system cowered in fear, I took risks. I made a bold new partnership. Bear witness, Betrayers, to my exciting new product line!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentA.zhText: 当星系里的其他人都吓得躲起来的时候，我选择承担风险。我建立了一个大胆的合作关系。做个见证吧，背叛者，看看我这令人兴奋的新生产线！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: Give the Betrayers a little hope, and we'll sink the hook deeper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 给背叛者们一点希望，然后再让他们落入更深的陷阱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: Let's flip the program, and see what these Amalgams can do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 让我们试试其他程序，看看这些并合体能做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: CT, the model is getting a bit predictable. A little morale boost might be good for conditioning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 终端机，这个模式正逐渐被我们的敌人识破。采取一些能提高士气的措施吧，这样有助于我们取得更好的实验数据。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: Let the Betrayers have a little fun while we crunch the numbers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 当我们进行运算时，让背叛者们享受一点乐趣吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: CT, invert the algorithm. Give them a little false hope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 终端机，把算法反转过来。给他们一点虚假的希望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: What... what if we make the Tenno more of a threat… really see what these Amalgams can do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 假如……假如我们让 Tenno 更具有威胁性……那这些并合体还会有怎样的表现呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: Some kind of failsafe? If placed in a conduit it will cancel the running interference routines. Use it wisely, Operator, there's only one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 某种故障安全防护装置？如果将它放置在导管中应该能取消运作中的干扰程序。指挥官请您明智地使用它，防护装置只有一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: You found a conduit failsafe. This will likely cancel active interference! There's just one, Operator. A real tactical dilemma, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 您找到一个故障安全防护装置了，这或许能取消启动中的干扰。指挥官，这只有一个，真正的战术难题，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: What happened to the interference routines? CT, what's going on?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 干扰程序出了什么问题？终端机，现在是怎么回事？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: The interference routines have vanished. What is going on up there? CT, we need diagnostics!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 干扰程序消失了。发生了什么？ 终端机，我们需要诊断！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.text: Failsafe activated? They've trashed the active cycle. CT, sweep the authorization-codes, immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentB.zhText: 异常保护装置被激活了？他们破坏了这一轮数据。终端机，清除授权码，快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: Betrayers, frustrated yet? Get used to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 背叛者，沮丧了吗？ 你最好习惯这种感觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: This week on Nightwave, Tenno lose big, give up on life! Details at the next cycle!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 下面是来自午夜电波的本周要闻：Tenno 损失惨重，连命都丢了！详细情况请听下期节目！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: Don't be discouraged! Failure has made you what you are… a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 不要气馁！失败造就了现在的你……一个失败者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: Will you try again? Will you give me another reason to laugh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 你想要再试一次吗？ 你想要再给我一个嘲笑的理由吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: A pity… you could have used that. Hmm, but I'm bad at sharing you know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 真可惜……你本可以使用一下……那个。嗯，你知道的，我这个人不擅长跟别人分享。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: I thought you were better than this! You're making me look bad in front of my new business associates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 真没想到你的表现竟如此狼狈！在我的新商业伙伴面前，你让我难堪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: Finally. Some investments take longer to earn out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 终于有成效了。某些投资的确需要更长的时间才能开始获利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: CT, fast track these disciples for promotion… I mean… conversion, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 终端机，马上找来这些信徒，他们需要升职……我是说……改造，反正都一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.text: These disciples finally show some merit. Credit where credit is due, I am an excellent leader.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentC.zhText: 这些信徒们终于表现出了一些优点。身为一名优秀的领导者，我也算是实至名归吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Thank you for your generous brutality and violence! My Amalgams have never been better!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 感谢你们如此慷慨的残忍行径与暴力表现！我的并合体得到了前所未有的改良！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Take your trinkets. A small price to pay for a superior product.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 拿走你们的纪念品吧。这是为了能开发出高级产品而付出的小小代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Good! Keep it up. Every single bit-stream of this carnage only makes me richer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 很好！保持下去。这场杀戮中的每一个比特的数据流只会让我变得更加富有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: What did they get? This is spiraling on us. I'm hemorrhaging inventory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 他们拿到什么了？我们的情势正急速恶化，我的库存在大量流失中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: CT, transfer more disciples and begin conversion at once. We're deep in the red now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 终端机，传送更多信徒并立刻开始改造。我们目前陷入赤字亏损了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Impressive! Ordis is just fluttering with anticipation! What will the Operator murder find… next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 太令人敬佩了！Ordis 满怀期待地翩翩起舞着！指挥官接下来将会谋杀……呃，找到什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Scans indicate these Conduits are connected to a massive stockpile of resources. Just how long is the Operator planning to fight for?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 扫描显示这些导管连结着一座大量的资源储量。指挥官您预计能争取多少时间？
