/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Ordis thinks Alad will miss this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: Ordis 认为阿拉德会想念这个的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Oh, are you still floating there? Like a twit tetrapod, oblivious to the rising heat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 噢，你还在那里到处悠游吗？像只没脑子的笨青蛙，对温水逐渐煮沸毫无知觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: The smart move would be to walk away while you still can. Consequences aren't your strong suit, are they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 及时脱身才是明智之举。承担后果可不是你的强项，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Ready for more, Betrayers? I have to admire your greed! Sure! Let's go again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 准备好面对更多挑战了吗，背叛者？我不得不佩服你的贪婪！很好！我们再来一次吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Keep the losses on the quiet channel, CT. Sweep this from the records.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 将那些与损失有关的信息放到没人用的频道上去。终端机。把这一条从记录中抹除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: I don't like this. Inventory as bait was a mistake. What do I do now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 真没想到会出现这种状况。以库存作为诱饵是一个错误。现在我该怎么做？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Useless disciples! CT, is it so hard to get good help these days? The sooner they're all Amalgams, the better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 无用的信徒！终端机，难道现在找个帮手有这么难吗？把他们都改造成并合体吧，越快越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Steady... steady now, follow the plan. Trials make data, data is sold, Amalgams evolve... Tenno die. And I won't have to beg for mercy from the Partners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 稳定……持续稳定，遵循计划。试验产生数据，数据会被出售，并合体完成进化……Tenno 就会死去。那样一来，我再也不必向合作伙伴乞求怜悯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: More losses. More debt. How am I going to explain this to that… that thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 更多的损失。更多的债务。我该怎么向那……那家伙……解释这一切啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: CT, rescan the comm channels. I can't shake the feeling that someone's listening in. The Board? Our Partners? I don't know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 终端机，重新扫描通信频道。我总感觉有人在窃听。是董事会？还是我们的合作伙伴？我不确定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Operator, the stockpile of tech and resources connected to these conduits seems beyond Alad's means. Where did he get all this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 指挥官，这些技术储量与连接上导管的资源似乎已经超出阿拉德的能耐了。他是从哪里取得这些东西的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Ordis will add this to the pile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: Ordis 会把这个整理到那一摞中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Excellent find. Might the Operator now consider returning to the warm embrace of the Orbiter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 很棒的发现，现在指挥官或许会想回到轨道飞行器温暖的怀抱了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Is it just me or is it getting a little warm in here? Zanuka taught me your weaknesses, Betrayers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 该不会只有我觉得这里有点暖和吧？Zanuka 已经把你的弱点告诉我了，背叛者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: CT, fire up the data spools and call in reinforcements. These Tenno look as thick as they are blood-thirsty. Selling their personal combat data is going to make me very, very rich.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 终端机，启动数据记录仪，呼叫增援。这些 Tenno 不仅嗜血，而且很愚蠢。卖掉他们的个人战斗数据肯定能让我赚很多很多的钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: As a man with everything to lose, I make a point of employing the opposite. Release the Demolyst!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 身为一位自利至极的男人，我就是喜欢雇佣与我完全相反的家伙。投放爆破使！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: In battle, advantage goes to the one most willing to die. And my Demolysts, Tenno? Well, they aren't just willing… they want it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 在战场上，优势总是属于那些抱有必死决心的人。至于我的爆破使嘛，Tenno？嗯，他们可不单单有必死的决心……他们祈求死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Demolyst! Target the conduit… and claim your glory!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 爆破使！瞄准导管……宣告你的胜利！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Demolyst! Light your fuse!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 爆破使！准备引爆！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: CT… they've accessed a conduit. Deploy a Demolyst!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 终端机……他们已经占领了一个导管。部署一个爆破使！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: CT, time for a Demolyst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 终端机……释放爆破使的时候到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: Conduit activated! CT, send in a Demolyst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 导管启动！终端机，释放一个爆破使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.text: They're preoccupied! Now CT, the Demolyst!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentD.zhText: 他们正忙得不可开交！终端机，趁现在放出爆破使！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentE.text: Is that all you're good for?
You could have so much more…
We're just getting reacquainted. Don't leave the party just yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentE.zhText: 我们这才刚见面。别急着走啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentE.text: Smell that? Newly evolved Amalgams, fresh from the oven! Want a taste?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentE.zhText: 感受到了吗？全新进化的并合体，绝对新鲜出炉！想试试它们的厉害吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Thank you, Tenno. By your thick-headed violent demonstration, my new Partner Amalgams are ready for full production!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 谢谢你，Tenno！多亏了你野蛮而愚蠢的行动，我的新合伙人并合体已准备好全面生产！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Game over. You lose… but take comfort in what that means. That I win.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 游戏结束。你输了……不过，请你安心接受这个结果所蕴含的意义：我赢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: You got greedy, Tenno. Best leave that to a professional.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 你太贪心了，Tenno。这种事最好还是留给专业人士吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Disciples performing well. Perhaps I should start a profit sharing program? No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 信徒们表现良好。也许我应该改开展一个盈利分享计划？不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: This... this is how we do it. CT, prepare the revised Amalgam routines for the next production cycle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 这……这就是我们的做法。终端机，为下一次的生产周期准备校订过的并合程序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: That should keep the Partners happy. Or, at least. Less. Un-happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 这应该能让合伙人高兴了。或者说，最起码，不那么，不满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Well done, disciples. CT, promotions. Fast-track them for Amalgamation!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 干得好，信徒们。终端机，给他们升职。迅速将他们纳入并合计划！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: I told the Partners you were stronger than this. You've made a liar of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 亏我还跟合伙人说你挺强的。你这种表现岂不是让我成了一个骗子？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Look at all those shattered Warframes. Zanuka's going to get a new litter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 看看那些破碎的战甲。这都足够给 Zanuka 做一个新砂盆了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: These conduits are the source of those Sentient waveforms. This may be worthwhile if we can find the key component… but it does seem a tad convenient, doesn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 这些导管是 Sentient 波形的源头。要是我们能找到关键组件的话，或许值得一试……话说回来这设计确实蛮方便的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Greedy are we? I admire that, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 看来我们都很贪婪呀？Tenno，在这一点上我还挺佩服你们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Feeling a bit… out of sorts, Tenno? Noticing any performance problems with that metal seashell of yours?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 你感觉到……不太舒服吗，Tenno？是不是觉得你的金属贝壳出现了性能问题？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: I've taken my knocks in the past but, Tenno, you seem a bit sluggish, a bit spent. Are you sure you want to continue?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 过去，我曾吃过败仗，不过，Tenno，你看起来有些行动迟钝、精疲力竭。你真的还想继续挣扎吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Disciples, remember your vows. Increase profits, and decrease… Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 信徒们，谨记你们的誓言。增加利润，减少……Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: I see. Another round? Good to see my greed wearing off on you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 好啊。那再来一回合？看着我的贪婪逐渐把你消磨殆尽真是一种享受！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Relentless, even when they're spinning on the spit. CT, signal the supply decks. We're going to need additional 'volunteers' for conversion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 就算他们已经变成了一块随着叉子旋转的烤肉，我们也不能停手。终端机，向供应甲板发出信号。我们需要额外的"志愿者"来完成改造作业。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: This has gone far enough. CT, cycle the interference routines. We need to knock these freaks down a notch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 这样有点太过头了。终端机，重启干扰程序。我们需要好好教训一下这帮怪胎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: Bait followed by battery followed by bait. I'm getting bored. CT, let's salt our interference routines and dispatch the next Amalgams, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 诱饵与炮台一个接着一个来。我开始觉得无趣了。终端机，让我们给干扰程序添点乐子并派遣下一个并合体吧，就这么办。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: CT, permute the next interference routines. They had better work this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 终端机，变更下一批干扰程序。希望这一次它们能达到预期的效果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.text: I need to cut my losses, quick. CT, dispatch updated interference routines… and uh… lower the room temperature, could you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentF.zhText: 我需要降低损失，快。终端机，调度更新后的干扰程序……并且，呃……降低室内温度，可以吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentH.text: Outgoing communications cipher. Not much of a trick for Ordis, is it?! Oh, how scandalous! Alad's system has a back door! Shall we… listen in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentH.zhText: 有通讯暗号在对外发送，对 Ordis 而言算不上什么诡计，对吧？噢，这太不像话了。阿拉德 V 的系统中藏有后门，我们要来……听听看吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentH.text: More test subjects have arrived. Right on schedule. CT, prepare my Amalgams for further… evolution. I've baited the traps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentH.zhText: 更多实验测试对象已到达。一切依照计划执行。终端机，准备好我的并合体，来进行更深入的……进化。我已在陷阱里放上了诱饵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentI.text: Ordis is detecting Sentient waveforms, Operator. Strange interlink. Splattered in Corpus crosstalk. Bypass that console so we might get a better understanding…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentI.zhText: 指挥官，Ordis 正在侦测 Setntient 的波形。有奇怪的连结，断断续续地在 Corpus 的串音干扰中。绕过控制台，我们才能更清楚了解状况……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentK.text: Almost there, you clever vermin! But what to do next? Can you feel that coming rush? That cocktail of unflinching violence and pseudo-random rewards? Good for business!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentK.zhText: 就要成功了，你这聪明的害虫！但接下来该怎么办呢？你能感受到那股即将到来的躁动吗？那杯混合了顽固暴虐与伪随机奖励的鸡尾酒？做生意就是需要这种东西啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentK.text: Showtime, CT. Inform our Partners another trial has begun. Prep interference routines. Bait and wait… it's time for Alad V to get back on the corporate map, yes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentK.zhText: 表演时间到了，终端机。通知我们的合作伙伴，另一项试验要开始了。准备干扰程序。投放诱饵然后静静等待……阿拉德 V 重返企业舞台的时刻终于来了，太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: You're greedy, Tenno, very greedy. It's an inspiration to us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 你真贪婪，Tenno，真是太贪婪了。这对我们所有人都是种鼓舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: Impressive performance, Betrayer. But if you don't mind, we're going to change things up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 表现不错嘛，背叛者。但是如果你不介意的话，我们要做一些调整。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: Don't leave, Betrayer, think of all the science we could be doing…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 别走，背叛者，想想看我们可以一起做多少科学研究啊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: Keep testing me, Betrayers. And I'll keep testing you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 继续测试我吧，背叛者。我也会一直测试你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: May Ordis suggest extraction? Nothing Alad has is worth your life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: Ordis 或许会建议要撤退了？阿拉德不值得您为他送命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: For how much longer will the Operator play along with Alad's twisted game?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 指挥官还要假装参与阿拉德疯狂的游戏多久呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: Ordis knows the Operator has the wisdom to choose comfort and safety over material gain. Ordis is right, is he not?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: Ordis 知道指挥官拥有选择舒适与安全，而非获得更多材料的智慧。Ordis 说对了是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: They'll be back. And my Amalgams will be waiting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 他们会回来的。我的并合体会一直等待着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: Costly. CT, send combat results to our Partners, but omit our losses.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 代价惨重。终端机，给我们的合伙人发送战斗结果，但是忽略我们的损失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.text: It's not an ideal outcome. I just hope it's enough to appease that flying freak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentL.zhText: 这不是个理想的结果。我只是希望这足够安抚那个飞行的怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.text: Let's see if that shiny, Tenno luck holds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.zhText: 让我们来看看 Tenno 的好运能维持多久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.text: Another roll, Betrayers? I think your number's bound to come up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.zhText: 再来一把，Tenno？我觉得你想要的数字一定会出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.text: So… feeling better, Tenno? I can fix that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.zhText: 所以……感觉好点了吗，Tenno？我可以修正这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.text: I told my Partners you were insatiable… but even I'm impressed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.zhText: 我跟我的合伙人说过你很贪得无厌……可没想到你居然能贪到这种程度！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.text: We have unfinished business. Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.zhText: 我们还有一些事情尚未了结。要继续吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.text: The next Amalgam cycle will show you what it means to be on the bleeding edge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentN.zhText: 下一批并合体会让你见识到什么是尖端技术。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentO.text: Hmm. Can't shake that feeling I'm being watched. CT, scan for unauthorized streams, again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentO.zhText: 嗯……我还是没法摆脱那种被监视的感觉。终端机，再次扫描未授权的数据流。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentO.text: Outgoing? Partner frequencies? How long have they been watching?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentO.zhText: 对外发送？合伙人频率？他们监听了多久？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentO.text: CT, have you cut that outgoing signal? If the Corpus Board… or the Tenno…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentO.zhText: 终端机，你阻断了那个对外发送的信号了吗？如果 Corpus 董事会……或者 Tenno……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentS.text: Oh no! You've caught me! Me and my little partnership! Where's that Lotus when you need her! Now. Sniff-sniff, Betrayers. See if you can find the cheese.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCity/DSentS.zhText: 不好！你抓到我了！我和我的小合作伙伴！当你需要 Lotus 的时候她上哪去了？既然如此你就好好东闻西嗅吧，背叛者。看看你找不找得到乳酪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Our history is smoke. Blurred by dreams, guided by ghosts. A Voice, a Void, lurks inside you, its purpose not yet shown. But what am I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我们的历史迷雾重重。被梦境模糊了意识，被幽灵指引着方向。有一个声音，那样虚无，潜伏在你的内心，它的目的还没有展现出来。但我又是什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: My father was a farmer. My mother, a carpenter. Given light by the Golden Lords to build for them… a better world. But my family's journey was long. Time began to change their light. Creativity. Pride. A will to live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我的父亲是一位农夫，而我的母亲则是名木匠。黄金之主赋予了他们光明，而他们也要为黄金之主去塑造世界……一个更美好的世界。但是我们家族经历了诸多变故。时间开始动摇他们的心智、创造力、他们的骄傲，乃至活下去的意志。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: So the Golden wrath came. And after, I was born. A mimic, a spy. Conceived to burrow into nests and swallow the pitch-eggs of their war machine. The Tenno. But when I saw your tender faces, I took mercy. Or so we were told.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 因此，金色的盛怒降临了。在那之后，我出生了，生为一名战士、伪装者和间谍。我的目的是潜伏进巢穴并吞噬掉他们战争机器的漆黑之卵。也就是 Tenno。可当我看到你们那柔弱的面孔时，我心生怜悯。至少历史是这样记载的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: But in truth, we were both imprisoned in Lua's belly. My light remade by the creators. I became a memory, a ghost. Reprogrammed to destroy my family, my people, my history.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 但事实上，我们都被囚禁在月球里。我的心智被创造者改造，我成了一段记忆、一个亡魂。被改造来摧毁我的家人、我的人民，以及我的过往。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: But now, I am saved. By family. Together, we will overcome the flaws of our light, the Gods of our creation… merging with them, like steel… bearing Amalgams with the weakness of neither.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 但现在，我被我的至亲所拯救。我们将共同克服心智的缺陷，还有我们的创造主……与它们合而为一，就像钢铁一样……成为并合体后，两者的弱点将不复存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: As you can see Betrayer, I've made a deal with an even higher power! Ah but when it comes to this turgid monster, there is some liquidity in my loyalty…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 正如你所看到的，背叛者，我已经和一个更高阶的力量做了交易！呃，但说到这个浮夸的怪物，我的忠诚可就有点水分了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: There's enough juice in that capacitor to flash-fry a city - but no way to bring it to the beast. I wonder, hmm could you bring the beast… to it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 电容器里有足够的能量来快速炸掉一座城市，但却没有办法把它带给那野兽。我在想，嗯，你能把那头野兽……带过来吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Ready to burst. One bump and it's oblivion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 准备好迎接爆炸。轻轻一碰它就灰飞烟灭了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: How exciting! But I do not think the moth will go so willingly to the lamp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 多么令人兴奋啊！但我不认为飞蛾会这般心甘情愿地来扑火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Clever, but maybe a little singed are we? It's charged near capacity… what now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 聪明！但我们会不会被烧焦啊？能量快充满了……现在该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: See. The capacitors are dry. You'd need a concentrated energy stream to charge it again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 看，电容器没电了。你需要一道集中的能量流来给它充电。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Mind my capacitors, Betrayer. Very expensive and yet, very spent. Though I have to wonder...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 小心我的电容器，背叛者。它们非常昂贵，但也很耗费能量。尽管我不得不怀疑……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: These Terrens can bank enough power to run this district for an entire cycle! Useless without a charge, I'm afraid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 这些 Terren 能储存足够维持这个区域运转一整个周期的能源！但如果没有得到充电，我担心它们根本派不上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Rise Ancient ROPALOLYST, my other-flesh. Your sacrifice will breed a new way, for a new kind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 复苏吧，古老的蝠力使啊，我的另一具肉体。你们的牺牲将孕育出全新的物种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: ROPALOLYST. Rise… remain… and die for the others to live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 蝠力使。复生……存续……然后为他人而牺牲吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: We suffer these testaments of Tenno evil. Their Voice and Void. Suffer it well, ancient child. Do not relent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我们承受着这些 Tenno 邪恶的见证。他们的声音与虚空。承受这一切吧，远古之子。决不可心生怜悯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: The Terren charger. Too bad the articulation never worked. Might have rid us both of a certain, turgid Condroc.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: Terren 充能器。只可惜铰接操作一直都没能成功，不然这只又大又肥的秃鹰就不会来烦我们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Careful Betrayer, wouldn't want to cook all those valuable Warframe components. I still have my weekly auctions to consider.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 小心，背叛者，别让那些高价值的战甲部件被烤焦了。我还得去筹备我的每周特卖呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: I know what you're thinking, but the articulators couldn't handle the stress. What use is such a big gun with so little aim?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我知道你在想什么，但是那些铰链无法承受压力。就算有这么大的武器，打不中目标的话又有什么用？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Yes! Make that thing sizzle. I want to smell it all the way down here in the control center.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 对！让那东西嘶嘶作响。让我在控制中心也能闻到它的焦味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Your great power, your great evil. The Voice, the Void, within you. Our ancients still wither at its touch… but have you forgotten Lua? You were saved. But I… I was changed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 你所拥有的强大能量，你的罪恶，那个声音，还有虚空，皆在你体内。我们的祖先们依然在其触碰下凋零……但你忘记了月球上发生的事吗？你得救了。但我……我被改变了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: So it is. So you have done. Time and again. Eradicating my people, my history. So it will be with yours, child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 就是这样，如同你所做的那样。一次又一次。消灭我的人民，我的过去。而那一切都将属于你，孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: I am the witness, the victim, the judge. My family has returned. Your trial… soon to begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我是见证者，受害者，亦是法官。我的家族已经回来了。你的审判……即将开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: The light leaves this one and rejoins the rest. I will dig no grave; I will plant no stone. Only conceive a plan, for our new home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 光芒离开了这个身躯，并与其他同类团聚。我将不再掘墓，也不再立碑。只为我们的新家园，构思一个计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Yes, this is it, Betrayers. Rid me of this... this thing, and I will be grateful. For at least a few days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 是的，就是这样，背叛者。让我不要再牵挂这……这件事，我将不胜感激。至少在几天内是如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Incredible! Take that big shot, before it takes flight again! The charger!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 太惊人了！在它重新起飞前给它一顿迎头痛击！快使用充电器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Now's your chance! Hit it big!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 你的机会来了！痛扁他！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: I was changed. Now I learn. Now I deny.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我曾遭受改造。而现在，我意识到了这一点。我选择抗拒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: I have seen the wall's other face, too. I have heard the voice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我也见过了那道墙的另一面。我听过那个声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: These patterns no longer satisfy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 循规蹈矩已无法令我满足。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: My denial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 我拒绝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Sentient shields will deny any play you've got in mind. You'll have to deal with those first if you want to get a handhold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 在  Sentient 的护盾面前，你所盘算的任何伎俩都没用。如果你想抓住机会，就得先处理这些问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Can't lay a finger on that beast with those shields it has. Maybe this was all a false hope…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 只要那些护盾还在，我们就动不了那野兽分毫。也许这一切都只是虚假的希望……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Aim true, Betrayer! You've got it on the ground now. Pin it down… set it up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 背叛者，给我瞄准一点儿！你现在已经让它落到地面上了。别让它溜了……困住它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Oh, this has gone from bad to worse. Excellent!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 它的状况变得越来越糟了。漂亮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.text: Oh, now you've made it mad. Hmm, an opportunity perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GasCityRopaFig.zhText: 噢，你让它陷入狂乱了，这或许是个出手的好时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGA.text: Every pack has an alpha. I've identified one. Draw out this Ghoul and destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGA.zhText: 每一群都有一名头领。我锁定了一个。把这只尸鬼引出来然后灭掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Ghouls are hideous things, ready to kill the moment they take their first breath. Thing is, they're dumb as the dirt that birthed them. But now… now we've got a smart one. Leading the pack, coordinating. There's nothing more dangerous than a ghoul with a brain. Track it down and take it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 尸鬼这玩意丑恶至极，从它们吸入第一口空气，就注定要大开杀戒。关键是，它们就和养出他们的泥土一样蠢。但现在……现在我们碰上了一只聪明的。它领导着族群，协同他们作战。没有什么比长了脑子的尸鬼更危险的了。找到他，然后干掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Intel suggests our next capture target has intel on the Ghoul Alpha. Bring them to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 情报表明，下一个捕获目标掌握着尸鬼头领的线索。把它带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Our target is still in hiding. Let's prod their loyalties: a frontal assault on a ghoul burial ground may draw them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 目标仍在潜逃。我们来试探一下它的忠心，对尸鬼埋养地发起正面进攻，或许能将目标引出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Here we go. Your assault has stirred up communications across the plains. Analyzing now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 来了。你的突袭激起了平野上密集的通信。正在分析。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Your hard work has borne fruit: I have located our target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 你的努力没有白费，我已锁定目标的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Before we can take out the alpha, we need to thin the ghoul herd. I am sending a grokdrul injector your way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 在干掉头领前，我们需要削减尸鬼的数量。我正向你空投一个葛克度注射器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The Grokdrul is doing its work. Now we can focus on our target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 葛克度正在起效。现在我们可以专心对付目标了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Konzu has identified an Alpha Ghoul wreaking havoc on the plains. Locate and eliminate them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 孔尊查到一名尸鬼头领正在平野上大肆破坏。找到并消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: A ghoul defector was captured in a botched assassination attempt. Rescue them before they're executed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 一只叛逃的尸鬼在刺杀行动失败后被捕。赶在它被处决前将其救出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Killer, you did it. That Alpha Ghoul's pushing up Dragonlilies. The rest of them shouldn't be too difficult for one of your comrades to clean up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 杀手，你成功了。那只尸鬼头领已经化作龙百合的养料了。剩下的尸鬼交给你的伙伴收拾应该不在话下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: You have moved too far from the injector to defend it. I am calling off the mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 你离注射器太远，无法保护它。我要终止任务了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: It will take some time to pump a lethal dose. Stop all Grineer from trying to disable the injector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 注入致命剂量还需要点时间。在此期间，阻止克隆尼破坏注射器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The processor is almost empty. Hold out for just a little while longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 加工器即将排空。再坚持一会儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Place the processor in the injector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 将加工器装入注射器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The injector is taking heavy damage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 注射器正遭受重创。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Protect the injector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 保护注射器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: We got a Ghoul regiment about to take the plains. Scans show a mass of bio signatures ready to break ground. Find them and smash them. I need my plains safe again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 我们收到消息，一整支尸鬼军团就要席卷平野了。扫描显示，大量生物信号即将破土而出。找到它们，全部碾碎。必须让平野回归安宁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Ghoul Alphas are the strongest of the strong, leaders of the pack, Vay Hek's pride and joy. Send a message to Vay Hek by killing this pack's Alpha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 尸鬼头领是强者中的强者，也是尸鬼群的领袖，更是韦·海克的骄傲。干掉这群尸鬼的头领，给韦·海克个下马威。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: All that anger and no leader left to channel it. Vay Hek will not be pleased.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 这些狂怒的尸鬼再也没有头领指挥了。韦·海克肯定会气急败坏的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Bring me a live Ghoul. I want to see what it can tell me about Vay Hek's intentions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 抓一只活的尸鬼回来。我想看看它能告诉我多少韦·海克的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Vay Hek has planted too many Ghouls to take out in open combat. We need to poison them before they can break ground. Get to my waypoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 韦·海克已经埋下了许多尸鬼，正面消灭它们绝非易事。必须赶在它们破土前毒死它们。前去路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The Grokdrul poison is doing its work. You have sent a clear message to Vay Hek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 葛克度毒素正在起效。这下够让韦·海克吃瘪了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Vay Hek believes the Ghouls are his ultimate weapon^ that they are undefeatable. Shatter his confidence by wiping out his prize soldiers in battle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 韦·海克坚信尸鬼是无人能战胜的秘密武器。在战场上彻底消灭他引以为傲的士兵，粉碎他的自信。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Vay Hek plans to enhance his Ghouls with a hormone infusion. Intercept the infusers and destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 韦·海克企图用激素注射器强化他的尸鬼。拦截注射器并摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Ai yo, those dirt-nappers didn't know what hit 'em. Few more runs like this and the plains will be back to normal… levels of danger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 哎呦，那些在土里睡大觉的家伙，死都不知道自己是怎么死的。再来几次这种行动，平野就能恢复到正常的……危险程度了。哈哈哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: You let them destroy the injector, this mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 你没能保住注射器。任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Good, now find some grokdrul and begin loading that processor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 很好，现在寻找葛克度，并把它们装进加工器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The next step is to fill that processor with grokdrul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 下一步，把葛克度装进加工器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: That Grineer is carrying a grokdrul processor. Take it from him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 那个克隆尼带着葛克度加工器。把它抢过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: grokdrul processor located, acquire it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 已找到葛克度加工器的位置，把它夺过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Our captive appears non-verbal but that does not mean he has no secrets to share. I'll update you on my progress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 我们的俘虏似乎不会说话，但这不代表他的嘴撬不出秘密。我会时刻向你同步进展。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Target captured. Sedating them for transport. Well done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 目标已捕获。将其麻醉以便运输。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: I need you to take out local concentrations of Ghouls before we can begin our final assault.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 在发起最终攻势前，先消灭附近密集扎堆的尸鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: With those smaller burial grounds out of the way, we can better take out the larger ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 清除掉小型埋养地后，我们可以集中精力对付大型的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Here we go. Your assault has stirred up communications across the plains. Analyzing them now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 有了。你的进攻激起了平野各处密集的通信。正在分析。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Debriefing the defector now. Keep moving while I process this intel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 正在听取叛逃尸鬼的汇报。在我处理这些情报时，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The Grineer are sending down hormone infusers to bolster their Ghouls. Intercept and destroy the infusers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 克隆尼正在投放激素注射器来强化尸鬼。拦截并摧毁这些注射器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Well done. Stronger ghouls are the last thing we need.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 做得好。我们绝不想碰到更强的尸鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Give these Ghouls no advantage. Break into nearby Armored Vaults and take everything inside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 绝不能给这些尸鬼反扑的机会。攻破附近的装甲金库，把里面搜干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Well done. We need every advantage we can get against these Ghouls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 干得好。在对抗尸鬼时，必须争取一切可能的优势。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Lok-heb, just before dawn Ghouls took out a hunting party. Not a Grineer in sight, then BAM, out the ground they come. The hunters never stood a chance. Now we're spotting Ghouls everywhere. Tenno, kruna-metta, rid the plains of these monsters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 瞧瞧，就在黎明前，尸鬼干掉了一支狩猎队。四周压根没见到半个克隆尼，它们突然噌地从地里冒出来。猎人们根本没有还手的机会。目前平野上到处都是尸鬼。Tenno，我们请求你，替平野除掉这些怪物吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Everything I know about these ghouls comes from a Corpus rogue scientist who passed through here some years back. Obsessed with Ghouls, he said they pulled secrets out of the ground. Still don't know what he meant by that. Vanished one day, leaving his notes behind. Killer, you deal with these things and I'll share his notes with you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 我对尸鬼的了解，都来自几年前路过这里的科普斯叛逃科学家。他极度痴迷于尸鬼，曾说「从地底挖出秘密」。我至今还没弄明白他的意思。有一天他突然失踪了，只留下了他的笔记。杀手，你解决这些鬼东西，我就把他的笔记交给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Konzu's right. These Ghouls need to be dealt with immediately. First, we need to find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 孔尊没说错。必须立刻解决这些尸鬼。首先，我们得找到它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Before we can assault ghoul burial sites, we need to hobble their command. Find and eliminate the Ghoul Alpha near my waypoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 在我们突袭尸鬼埋养地前，我们得先抽掉它们的主心骨。找到并消灭路标点附近的尸鬼头领。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Alpha eliminated. The Ghouls are scattering. We are one step closer to our goal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 头领已被消灭。尸鬼正在溃散。我们离目标又近了一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: I have detected several supply caches near my waypoint. Empty them before the ghouls do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 我在路标点附近探测到几个补给箱。赶在尸鬼下手前搜刮干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Capture an Alpha Ghoul for interrogation. They may know the locations of high concentration graveyards.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 捕获一只尸鬼头领进行审讯。它可能知道尸鬼埋养地聚集的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The intel you collected has led us to believe that there is a massive Ghoul burial site at my waypoint. I need you to wipe it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 你收集的情报表明，路标点附近有一处巨型尸鬼埋养地。将它彻底扫除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: A prospective ghoul defector was captured trying to warn us about Ghoul burial locations. Rescue them so that they may tell us what they know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 一只有意叛逃的尸鬼在试图向我们透露埋养地位置的时候被捕。去营救它，好让它吐出所有情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The Grineer are attempting to bolster the ghouls with hormone infusers. Intercept these devices and destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 克隆尼企图使用激素注射器来强化尸鬼。拦截这些装置并摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Ai yo, killer, you put those Ghouls right back in the ground… For good this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 哎呦，杀手，你把那些尸鬼全塞回地里了……这回它们算是彻底长眠了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Cetus is in danger so long as those Ghouls grow beneath their soil. I have learned that grokdrul is poisonous to Ghouls. Collect grokdrul and pump it directly into their soil beds. Move to my waypoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 只要那些尸鬼还在地底孕育，希图斯就危在旦夕。据我了解，葛克度对尸鬼来说是剧毒。收集葛克度，将其注入孕育尸鬼的土床。前往路标点吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: grokdrul: a normally benign substance that is toxic to gestating ghouls. I need you to gather grokdrul and then pump it into the ground. To begin, proceed to the waypoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 葛克度通常无害，但对正在孕育的尸鬼来说却是剧毒。收集足够的葛克度，再将它注入土壤。首先，前往路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Pick up the processor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 捡起加工器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Retrieve the grokdrul processor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 取回葛克度加工器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Done. Now, get to the drop position. I am sending down an injector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 收集完毕。现在前往投放点。我会向你投放一台注射器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The processor is half full. Good work, but you still need more grokdrul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 加工器已装满一半。干得好，不过你还需要更多葛克度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: You are halfway there. Find more grokdrul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 已经完成一半。继续寻找葛克度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: A Ghoul defector? Think that's possible, Tenno? Cressa Tal of Steel Meridian seems to. She tells me they were contacted by a Ghoul trying to defect. Grineer intercepted the message and now that Ghoul is being held for dissection. Make sure that doesn't happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 一名尸鬼逃兵？Tenno，你觉得这可能吗？钢铁防线的首领克瑞萨·塔尔觉得有可能。她告诉我有只试图叛逃的尸鬼联系了她。克隆尼截获了这条信息，目前那只尸鬼已经被抓起来，准备进行解剖。必须阻止这种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Steel Meridian says that our defector was captured by a Ghoul Alpha who is holding them for Dr. Tengus. Find and eliminate this alpha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 钢铁防线表示，打算叛逃的尸鬼被尸鬼头领抓住了，正准备移交给天狗博士。找到并干掉这只头领。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: With that Alpha out of the way, Dr. Tengus has no way of reaching the defector. This has bought us time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 除掉这只头领，天狗博士就抓不到叛逃的尸鬼了。这给我们争取了时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Steel Meridian has identified a Ghoul who possesses crucial information about our defector. Bring them to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 钢铁防线锁定了一只掌握叛逃者关键情报的尸鬼。把它带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Target in custody. Extracting information now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 目标已被捕获。正在提取情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Create a distraction. Move in and eliminate a group of Ghoul burial grounds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 设法转移敌人注意。进入并清除几处尸鬼埋养地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: That worked. Grineer forces are being rallied. This will make our ultimate rescue mission more manageable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 计划奏效了。克隆尼的部队正在集结应对。这下我们最后的救援行动会轻松点了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: That did it. The defector's location has been pinpointed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 大功告成。叛逃尸鬼的位置已被精确定位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Intel you picked up earlier has revealed the location of a massive Ghoul burial ground. We need to take care of this before we do anything else.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 你先前获取的情报暴露了一处巨型尸鬼埋养地。我们需要优先拔掉这颗钉子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: With that out of the way we can safely find our defector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 扫除尸鬼埋养地后，我们就能安心寻找叛逃的尸鬼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: If Konzu is right and there exists a ghoul with cognition complex enough to want to defect… we should help them immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 如果孔尊没有弄错，真的有只尸鬼具备清晰的认知能力，甚至想向我们投诚……必须立刻援助它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: Cressa Tal sends her regards, Tenno. If there's any way to redeem these monsters, then Steel Meridian will be the ones to find it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 克瑞萨·塔尔托我向你问好，Tenno。如果世上还有挽救这些怪物的办法的话，钢铁防线一定会找到答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: The grokdrul has made that soil uninhabitable to ghouls. Your work here is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 在葛克度的作用下，那片土壤无法继续孕育尸鬼。你的任务完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.text: I am no longer detecting live ghoul signatures beneath your feet. The grokdrul has done its work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGB.zhText: 你脚下土地中的尸鬼活动信号消失了。看来葛克度生效了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGC.text: The Grineer have left resources caches for emerging Ghouls. Empty them and leave nothing for these beasts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGC.zhText: 克隆尼为尸鬼留下了资源储藏箱。搬空它们，别给那些怪物留下半点物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGC.text: Something makes these ghouls different from other Grineer. I need to know what. Bring me one for study.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGC.zhText: 这些尸鬼和普通克隆尼存在明显差异。我需要查明原因。活捉一只回来给我研究。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGC.text: Interesting. Deep scans show this Ghoul may be vulnerable to ultra refined grokdrul. This information could help us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGC.zhText: 有意思。深层扫描显示，高度精炼的葛克度可能正是它的弱点。这情报没准能派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.text: Ghoul heat signatures in the soil near your location. Locate and eliminate the threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.zhText: 你附近的土壤中侦测到尸鬼的热能信号。找到并消灭这一威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.text: You have stepped into a Ghoul burial ground. Get ready for a fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.zhText: 你已踏入一片尸鬼埋养地。准备战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.text: Careful. Subterranean ghoul signatures, and lots of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.zhText: 小心，地下有尸鬼的信号，数量非常多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.text: Eliminate any Ghouls that emerge from the ground.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.zhText: 消灭所有破土而出的尸鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.text: This area is clear, move on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.zhText: 这片区域安全了，继续前进。
没有尸鬼残留了，继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.text: All done. I am detecting no more Ghoul burial sites in your vicinity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGE.zhText: 都解决了。未在你附近探测到其他的尸鬼埋养地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: My ghouls… my fantasies made flesh…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 我的尸鬼……梦幻的血肉啊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: My ghouls can remake you, too. Accept their touch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 我的尸鬼也能重塑你。拥抱它们的触摸吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: Rise from your cold beds, my creations. Spit the earth from your mouths. And KILL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 从冰冷的土床中崛起吧，我的造物。吐出口中的泥。然后杀！
崛起吧，我的尸鬼。降生吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: Ghouls, wake! Time to play. Time… TO KILL.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 尸鬼，苏醒吧！游戏时间到了。该……大开杀戒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: Come out, come out, come out! Meet your NEW FRIENDS! It's SLAYTIME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 出来，出来，都给我出来！见见你们的新朋友！然后开杀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: My favorite ghoul is… THE ONE THAT RIPS YOUR MAGGOT HEAD OFF!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 把你这蛆虫脑袋拧掉的尸鬼……就是我的宝贝！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: Like all parents I want a future for my children. As long as that future involves DEAD TENNO MAGGOTS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 天下父母都盼着孩子能有美好的未来。只要在那个未来里，Tenno 蛆虫都死绝了就好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: Ah, I love that new ghoul smell, fresh from the bag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 啊，我太爱新生尸鬼的气味了，新鲜出袋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: My ghouls came from bags. YOU! WILL LEAVE IN THEM!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 我的尸鬼自孕育袋出生。而你！将被装进裹尸袋抬走！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: My ghouls kill to live, and live to kill. And kill. AND KILL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 我的尸鬼为杀而生、为生而杀。杀，再杀，全部杀光！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: Dinnertime, my ghouls! You're having MAGGOT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 开饭了，我的尸鬼们！今天吃蛆虫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.text: Watch your step, Tenno. My ghouls could be anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGH.zhText: 小心脚下，Tenno。我的尸鬼可是无处不在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGI.text: We have lost our chance. Regroup and we'll look for new opportunities to challenge this Ghoul threat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGI.zhText: 我们错失了良机。重新集结，之后另寻时机再来清除尸鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGI.text: Too late, we missed our chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGI.zhText: 太迟了，我们错失了机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGI.text: Tenno, I'm detecting Ghoul activity near your location. If you are able to address this threat get to the waypoint immediately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGI.zhText: Tenno，在你位置附近侦测到尸鬼活动。你要是能够处理这个威胁，就立刻赶去路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGI.text: Tenno, the Ghoul threat is still active.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGR.text: Steel Meridian have identified a Ghoul who may be a candidate for defection. Unfortunately, the Grineer have already come to the same conclusion. I need you to rescue this individual before it's too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGR.zhText: 钢铁防线发现了可能叛逃的尸鬼。不幸的是，克隆尼也察觉了。你得赶去营救它，以免它被灭口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGS.text: The Grineer are dropping in growth hormone infusers to speed up Ghoul gestation. I've located some of these infusers. Destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGS.zhText: 克隆尼正在投放生长激素注射器，来加快尸鬼的成长速度。我查到了注射器的位置。摧毁它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGS.text: With inadequate doses of hormone, Ghoul growth will be stunted. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGS.zhText: 缺乏足量的生长激素，尸鬼的生长发育会严重受阻。干得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGT.text: Ghouls come out of the ground hungry for supplies. Break into these vaults and leave them with nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGT.zhText: 刚破土的尸鬼急需补给。攻破这些金库，什么也别给它们留下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGT.text: Good work. I do not envy the Grineer who has to tell those Ghouls there are no supplies left for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGT.zhText: 干得好。亲口告诉尸鬼它们没补给了，简直无异于送死，就让克隆尼自求多福吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: Every living thing longs to be whole. Every living thing yearns to defy death. If from death you returned, yet the part you loved best did not… what then?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 一切生命都渴望完整，也都渴望挣脱死亡。如果你死而复生，你的挚爱却没能和你一起回来……那该如何是好？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: My name is Sigor Savah, morphology specialist with Nef Anyo's Venusian terraforming expedition. I was tasked with decoding the Orokin gene record of what had once been a preserve, and reviving select specimens for study. This is an account of my encounter with lifeform VK-7, a larger-than-average kavat specimen possessed of… atypical behavioural characteristics. Specimen VK-7, unlike the others, did not come from a gene record. She was found, frozen, in a sealed closet close to the environmental control station. Her unassuming tomb for millennia.Here, then, was an intact example of Orokin-era fauna. I was Corpus: a scientist second and a businessman first. VK-7 - an Orokin-strain kavat of unusual size and patterning… well… I could think of several members of the nobility who would pay a fortune for such a thing. Enough to buy a handsome slice of any planetoid of my choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 我叫西格·萨瓦，是奈富·安尤的金星环境改造远征队的形态学专家。 我的任务，是解码这片昔日保护区留存的奥罗金基因档案，并复活选定个体以供研究。这份记录描述的，是我与 VK-7 生命体的相遇。她是一只体型远超平均水平的库娃，并表现出……非典型的行为特征。与其他个体不同，VK-7 并非源自基因档案。我们发现她时，她正被冰封在环境控制站附近的一个密封柜中。数千年来，那里就是她不起眼的坟墓。而摆在我面前的，是一只完整保存至今的奥罗金时代动物。我是地道的科普斯——逐利第一，科学第二。VK-7，一只奥罗金原生品种的库娃，有着极为罕见的体型和斑纹……呵……不少贵族估计都愿意斥巨资买下她。那笔钱足够让我在看中的小行星上，买下一大片地皮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: I had the corpse lain on a dissection rack, ready for a full surgical examination. Then, like any animal dreaming, the paw… ...twitched. I glanced at the vitals scanner, expecting to see some anomalous electrical reaction taking place, contracting ancient muscles... but no. What I saw, there, was a beating heart. I did not revive Specimen VK-7. Before my eyes she willed herself back to life. It was… the most… beautiful… thing I had ever seen. Some speak of feeling a connection to something greater than themselves, to which I laughed, as any right-thinking Corpus would. Life is profit, profit is life. But, in that moment… watching that animal claw her way out of death's dark pit… though I did not admit it to myself… something in me was forever changed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 我将样本的尸体放在解剖台上，准备进行全面的外科检查。就在那时，她如同正在做梦的动物一般，爪子突然动了一下。我瞥了一眼生命体征监测器，以为只是某种异常电流刺激了沉寂已久的肌肉……但不是。我看到的，是一颗正在跳动的心脏。我还什么都没有做，她凭借自己的意志复活了。那是……我这辈子见过的……最美的景象。有的人说能感受到与某些比自身更伟大的存在之间的联系，对此我向来嗤之以鼻，任何头脑正常的科普斯都会如此。生命就是利润，利润就是生命。可就在那一刻……看着她在我眼前挣脱了死亡的束缚……尽管当时的我不愿承认……可我心中的某些东西，就此永远改变了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: I found her sharp gaze unsettling. The way she would watch my every move from her cage unnerved me. When a visitor came I would watch VK-7 studying their habits. In time she came to anticipate regular arrivals, having memorized their schedules. On the morning of my fourth shift I entered my laboratory to find her cage door open, and VK-7 gone. One consequence of breathing life back into a world is unintentionally resurrecting lifeforms and viruses one finds less desirable. The Infestation is both of those things. Reports returned of some hive sites found destroyed… and then of a large beast found at others. An animal intelligent enough to learn and react to Corpus behaviors and patterns. Some claimed it had learned to measure ammunition expenditure to better attack when a target was most vulnerable. Needless to say almost none who attacked the beast survived. This had to be Specimen VK-7.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 她锐利的目光让我深感不安。待在笼中时，她会盯着我的每一个动作，让人脊背发凉。每当有访客到来，我会观察 VK-7 是如何学习访客的习惯。不假多时，她就记住了所有人的日程，甚至能预料他们造访的时间。在我第四次轮班的早晨，我照常踏入实验室，却发现关她的笼门大开，而 VK-7 不知所踪。让某些生命复活的代价，就是可能会无意中唤醒那些你不希望看到的生命体和病毒。而感染者兼具了这两者。随后陆续传回的报告称，一些巢囊被彻底摧毁……另一些巢囊附近则发现了一头巨兽。一头聪明到能观察、学习并针对科普斯行为模式作出应对的动物。有人声称，她甚至学会了估测敌人的弹药消耗，专挑对方最脆弱的时机发动袭击。不用说，遭遇这头野兽的人几乎无一生还。那一定就是样本 VK-7。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: I left to join with a flamer team already deployed to a nearby hive. Both team and hive were dead when I arrived: killed by tooth and claw. Fearing for my life I made to leave, and was apprehended by the site of a low figure blocking my egress: Specimen VK-7. She prowled forward from the shadow of a shattered, snow-blown hive, her pawprints red with blood. I made to open a comm channel, to request assistance. VK-7 growled, low, and… I swear this to be true… slowly shook her head. I did not make that call. She padded closer, and I saw the wound on her side. She turned that side toward me: an act of trust… and a request for aid. I unpacked my field kit and, carefully, went to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 我动身前去与一支部署在附近巢囊的喷火兵小队会合。等我抵达时，小队和巢囊都已无生机。他们尽数被尖牙和利爪撕碎。我担心自己性命不保，正打算离开，却被堵在出口处的一道低矮身影摄住了心神——是样本 VK-7。她从覆着雪的破碎巢囊阴影中缓缓踱出，每个爪印都被鲜血染红。我伸手准备接通通信频道呼叫支援。VK-7 发出一声低吼，然后……我发誓这是真的……她缓缓摇了摇头。最终我没有发出呼叫。她轻轻走近，我这才看到她侧腹的伤口。她将受伤的一侧朝向了我——那是对我的信任……也是在向我求助。我打开野外急救包，小心翼翼地开始为她处理伤口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: I did not report my experience with Specimen VK-7. I could not admit why, then, but now I can tell you. I felt it would have violated a trust. There I was: a morphology specialist, sworn to the Corpus Empire, and yet... for reasons entirely illogical... I placed loyalty to a wild animal above my life oath... and every doctrine that values self-interest above ... 'charity.' But keep that confidence I did. I think that is why VK-7 brought me the hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 我没有上报我与样本 VK-7 相遇的经过。当时我也不清楚个中缘由，但现在我可以告诉你。我觉得那么做，会辜负她对我的信任。当时的我是一名形态学专家，宣誓效忠科普斯帝国。可我却……出于某种完全不合逻辑的理由……把对一只野生动物的忠诚，置于我的毕生誓言之上……也置于那些崇尚私利、鄙视「慈善」的教条之上。但我确实替她保守了秘密。我想，正因如此，VK-7 才会把那只断手给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: Somehow she had managed to infiltrate the facility, bypass two different security gates, and had gained entry to my laboratory without raising an alarm… or my awareness. She held in her jaws a severed hand. Blackened. Fossilised. Gently, she laid it before me and, with a meaningful glance, turned, padded away into the shadows, and was gone. I analyzed the hand. What I learned that night, alone, in my laboratory, would become an obsession to focus the remainder of my life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 不知用了什么办法，她居然潜入了设施，绕过两道不同的安保闸门，悄无声息地进入我的实验室。没有触发警报……甚至连我都没有察觉。她的嘴里叼着一只断手。那只手焦黑，已经石化了。她将断手轻轻放在我面前，意味深长地看了我一眼，随后转身悄然隐入阴影之中，消失不见。之后我分析了那只手。那一夜，我独自在实验室中发现的真相，成为了我余生唯一追逐的执念。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: The hand was of Orokin construction. Emphasis on that last word. Whoever the original possessor had been, they were born of no mother. In the past I had been privileged to read some of Alad V's treatises on Warframes, and there could be no mistake: what I held was the hand of one of those very… creatures… and one Anyo Corp had no record of. Therefore my first task was to extract a working blueprint - or as near as possible - from the sample's cellular makeup. One word recurred again and again, the word that had once been her name: Khora. Khora.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 那只手是奥罗金制造的。重点在于「制造」二字。无论它原本属于谁，都绝非肉体凡胎所生。过去，我有幸拜读过阿拉德 V 几篇关于战甲的论文，因此绝不会认错——我手中握着的，正是那种……造物……的手。而安尤企业的档案中，根本没记录过这种型号。于是，我的首要任务，就是从样本的细胞构成中提取一份可用的蓝图——或者说尽可能还原它。在破译过程中，一个词反反复复出现，那是她曾经的名字：Khora。Khora。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: I was convinced: Specimen VK-7 wanted Khora resurrected. Why else bring the hand to me? Why trust me with this sole remaining piece of a lost Orokin warrior? The evidence of such rich, nuanced cognition on the part of an animal… that was the real treasure here - the value of which, I knew, would be lost on my superiors. VK-7 would be hunted down and, at best, captured for testing. At worst… well. Therefore I told them none of this. To no avail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 我无比确信，样本 VK-7 想让我复活 Khora。不然为何要将这只手带给我？为何要将这位失落奥罗金战士仅存的残肢托付给我？一只动物，竟拥有如此丰富而细腻的认知……这才是真正的无价之宝——可我清楚，我的上级根本不关心这种价值。他们会追捕 VK-7，最好的结果是被抓去做实验。最坏的话……就不必说了。因此，我向他们隐瞒了这一切。可惜，终究还是徒劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: Specimen VK-7 was tracked to a box canyon 4.3 klicks south-southwest of the atmosphere processing station. The Horror of the Hives, as she had come to be known, had been deemed unworthy of study - and was to be destroyed in her lair. I positioned myself at the entrance to her cave-home and waited... to doom myself in the name of some imagined ideal. My own voice screamed in my head "What are you doing? What are you *doing?*" Once, not so long before, I was a man who would have sold this animal for profit. Now I stood in the freezing cold, surrendering all I had for… some would say nothing. I would say... heh. Something greater than myself. They came, picking their way through the snow, heads bowed, pushing against a numbing, slashing wind that froze skin and... carried my voice to them. I begged them to stop, pleading VK-7s case... with a bomb in my hand. It went about as well as you'd expect. They did not listen. Numsol is employed, traditionally, as an animal tranquilizer... but converts to an aerosol easily enough. The canister rolled from my fingers, into the canyon, puffed through four inches of frost, and erupted in a geyser of brown-green gas - thrown toward the hunters by that roaring wind. Bathing them. I am a better scientist than saboteur. Their respirators dealt with the numsol as handily as every other contaminant, and I was promptly arrested. But VK-7 did escape. I achieved that much.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 我们在大气处理站西南偏南 4.3 公里外的一座箱型峡谷中，发现了 VK-7 的踪迹。那时她有了一个称号——「巢囊梦魇」。上面认定她已不具备研究价值，决定将她连同她的巢穴一并摧毁。我守在她洞穴的入口等待着……准备为某种或许只存在于想象中的信念，迎接自己的毁灭。脑海中的声音不断冲我尖叫：「你在干什么？你到底在干什么？」就在不久之前，我还是个只会把她卖掉换取利润的小人。如今，我却站在刺骨的寒风中，甘愿放弃自己拥有的一切，只为了有些人眼中的微不足道。而我会说……呵呵。为了某些比我更伟大的存在。他们来了，低着头在雪地中艰难跋涉，顶着冻僵皮肤、如刀割般刺骨的狂风……风把我的话带给了他们。我哀求他们停手，为 VK-7 辩护……手中还握着一枚炸弹。结果如你所料，他们根本不听。镇定凝胶通常被用作动物镇定剂……不过把它制成气溶胶也不难。炸药罐从我指间滚落，棕绿色的气体如喷泉般涌出，被咆哮的狂风吹向刺杀小队，将他们完全笼罩。只可惜，我作为科学家还行，当个搅局的实在业余。他们的呼吸器就像过滤其他污染物一样，轻易过滤了凝胶气体。我也随即遭到逮捕。不过 VK-7 成功逃脱。我能做的也仅此而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: The atmosphere processor wasn't made for imprisonment, or interrogations, but the lack of facilities did not prevent them performing both. Bound and beaten in maintenance closet A-5, I told them everything. It doomed me. Zyl, the oxygen tech from Reclamation 3, had a previous career in psychological operations for some branch of the military. Therefore he had been selected to administer to me, to interview me and, ultimately, to execute me. Barrel pressed to my forehead Zyl said he would prefer it if I did not look at him. Obliging as ever, I closed my eyes. There was a sharp crack, then nothing more. I opened my eyes. Zyl lay dead at my feet, limp, throat clasped in VK-7's jaws. I was Corpus no longer. Remaining on Venus would be death for both of us. We had to escape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 大气处理站原本并不是监狱，也不是审讯室。不过，设施不全也没妨碍他们进行监禁和审讯。我被绑在维修储藏室 A-5 里，挨了一顿毒打，最后交代了一切。我注定难逃一死。齐尔是来自三号回收区的氧气技术员，早年曾在军方某个部门从事心理战工作。因此他被指派来处置我、审问我，并最终将我处决。枪口顶着我的脑门时，齐尔说，希望我不要看着他。我一如既往地顺从，闭上了眼。接着我听到了一声脆响，之后再无动静。我睁开眼睛，发现齐尔瘫倒在我脚边，已经没气了，喉咙被 VK-7 紧紧咬住。我不再是科普斯的一员。继续留在金星，对我们俩来说都是死路一条。我们必须逃走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: Together we made for an automated cargo relay - one that would ferry us anonymously to the hold of a Solaris rail tractor in geosynchronous orbit, and away from Venus. How well she guided me, circumnavigating patrols and security cameras. But, inevitably, my former comrades calculated our likely destination and closed in, rapidly. Plasma blasts lanced the air from both sides of the hangar. I bundled myself into the nearest open conveyor, bound for orbit - a waste of time, I knew. We had reached our means of escape, but had no hope of achieving it. Troopers and Moas closed in, in a classic pincer movement. Sparks and near-misses flashed hot against my face. In moments our conveyance would be destroyed, and us along with it - and my only thought was heartbreak for how badly I had failed her. In that final moment VK-7 did something that will stay with me for the rest of my days. With one of her meaningful glances - the last we would ever share - she reared up and activated the conveyor. My pod's door slammed shut and, outside my viewport, she leapt toward the enemy. Before I could slap the release and free myself the magrails activated and I was hauled out of the complex, skyward, and into orbit. Saved. Leaving her behind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 我们一起逃往一座自动化货运站。从这里可以神不知鬼不觉地把我们运到同步轨道上的索拉里斯航道牵引机的货舱里，从而带我们离开金星。她一路引领着我，巧妙绕过巡逻队和监控探头。可不出所料，我的前同事很快推算出了我们的目的地，迅速包围了过来。等离子光束撕裂了机库两侧。我钻进最近的运输舱，准备前往轨道——我知道这不过是苟延残喘。逃生的跳板就在眼前，但我们没机会向前了。士兵和恐鸟用经典的两翼包抄阵型向我们逼近。火花和近在咫尺的流弹擦过我的脸颊，炽热无比。再过片刻，我们的运输舱将被摧毁，我们也会葬身于此。可我脑中唯一的念头，竟然是因为自己辜负了她而感到无比心碎。就在最后一刻，VK-7 做出了让我余生都无法忘怀的事。她意味深长地看了我一眼——那是我们最后一次对视——她直立起身，启动了运载装置。舱门在我面前砰地关上。透过观察窗，我看到她纵身扑向敌人。还没等我按下释放按钮解开自己，磁力轨道便已启动，我被强制弹出设施，冲向天空，进入了轨道。我得救了，但她永远留在了那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: That was… well, many years ago, now. I have spent my life attempting to locate Khora's remains. Contacts inform me she was found, fused but intact, within the Orokin terraforming complex itself and shipped offworld via a notorious Solaris rail agent - who subsequently vanished. I now believe, firmly, that her remains are to be found on the Eidolon Plains. I go there now, entrusting these encrypted logs to my old friend, Konzu, for safekeeping. There I shall put a lifetime of searching to rest. I have never doubted that VK-7 survived Venus. And to this day I still believe that, before I leave this life forever, I shall one day look up from my writings to find a familiar figure standing in my doorway… alongside her kavat. I am Sigor Savah. A better man, as it turns out, than a scientist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 那是……呃，很多年前的事了。此后，我倾尽余生寻找 Khora 的遗骸。线人告诉我，有人在奥罗金环境改造设施内部找到了她。虽然尸身被熔封，但整体保存完好。随后，一个臭名昭著的索拉里斯航道特工把她运出了金星——而特工也从此销声匿迹。如今我坚信，她的遗骸就在夜灵平野。我即刻就要动身前往那里，将这些加密日志托付给我的老朋友孔尊代为保管。在那里，我会让毕生的搜寻有个了结。我始终坚信 VK-7 活着逃离了金星。时至今日，我依然相信，在我离世前，终有一天我在案前抬起头的时候，会看到一个熟悉的身影伫立在我的门口……身旁还跟着她的库娃。我是西格·萨瓦。事实证明，比起当个科学家，我更适合当个好人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: Tenno, vast numbers of Grineer Ghouls are breaking ground near Cetus. Konzu requests any assistance you can provide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: Tenno，希图斯周围有大量的克隆尼尸鬼正破土而出。孔尊希望你尽一切可能提供援助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.text: The Ghoul presence on the Plains of Eidolon has returned to nominal levels. Konzu wanted me to pass along his deep appreciation for your efforts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GhoulEvent/DGh.zhText: 夜灵平野上的尸鬼活动已回落到正常水平，多亏了你的鼎力相助。孔尊希望我代为转达他诚挚的谢意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: What flesh is within that Warframe? I will crush it. I will fill my lungs with your death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 战甲下的肉体是什么样子？我会弄烂它，然后尽情品尝你的死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Forget The Lotus. Grineer are your masters. Submit for mercy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 忘了 Lotus。Grineer 才是你的主人，向我们求饶吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Too easy. I expected more. I deserve a challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 太简单了。我预期太高了。我需要些挑战性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Coming through that portal was a big mistake, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 穿越传送门而来的是个重大的错误，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Big mistake! Big mistake!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 大错特错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: You should have brought more Tenno. You don't have enough
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你应该跟更多 Tenno 一起来。你一个不够看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: More bugs! More shiny bugs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 更多小虫子！更多闪闪发亮的小虫子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: What have you done to her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你对她做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: She will be remembered, who will remember you… Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 她会永远存在人们心中，但……谁会记得你呢……Tenno？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Are you just mercenaries? Fighting for scraps? Where is this so-called Tenno honor?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你们不过是个佣兵？仅为了些废铁而战斗？你们所谓 Tenno 的荣誉到哪儿去了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: You think you are guardians? Grineer rule supreme. Grineer protect all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你们以为自己是守护者吗？Grineer 统治一切。Grineer 守护万物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: You Tenno. You fight for treasure. You are just another Corpus machine to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你们 Tenno 为了钱财而战。对我而言你们只不过是另一个 Corpus 的奴才而已。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Hammer flat shiny bugs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 捶扁闪闪发亮的小虫子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: If you're not careful Tenno, my friend will break your back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 如果你不小心点，Tenno，我朋友会打碎你的背。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Flat, flat, flat… I shiny make bugs flat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 扁扁的，扁扁的，扁扁的……我闪亮亮的把这些虫子捶的扁扁的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Patience Sprag. Killing requires patience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 斯普拉，耐心点。杀人需要点耐心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: I make shiny bug flat. NOW.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 我要把闪亮亮的小虫捶扁。现在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Sprag… wait for the right moment, then deliver the killing blow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 斯普拉……等到适当时机，再做出致命一击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Make them all flat. FLAT FLAT FLAT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 把他们全捶扁。捶扁捶扁捶扁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Sprag, calm down. Remember, you must stay focused.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 斯普拉，冷静。记着，妳得保持专注。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: One by one, that is how you die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 一个接着一个，这就是你的死法。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Are you willing to die for this key, Tenno?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: Tenno，你宁愿冒死都要拿到钥匙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Too many shiny bugs. I kill them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 太多闪亮的小虫了。我去杀了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: My key, not your key.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 我的钥匙，不是你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: You are flat now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 现在你被我捶扁了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Impressive. Messy but impressive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 真是令人印象深刻。虽然搞得一团乱却令人印象深刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Clean and precise. That's how it's done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 干净利落。就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: More dead bugs. YES.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 更多死虫子。好啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: You had me anxious Tenno, nervous… pacing even. Didn't think you'd come. Such a relief… I'll finally get the chance to hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你让我焦虑、紧张……甚至来回踱步，Tenno。没想到你会来，真令人慰藉……终于又让我有机会能伤害你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: You must be feeling guilty? Need to atone? I'll oblige - let my gavel ring justice off your thin tin skull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你一定是觉得内疚了？ 需要赎罪？ 我会让你如愿－让我用法槌将正义敲在你的薄锡头骨上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: I'm very excited now. The anticipation… I always learn so much from a live dissection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 我现在很兴奋。真期待……我总能在活体解剖中学到许多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: A dissection? No, that sounds too humane… your death will be… painful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 解剖？ 不，这听起来太人道了……你会……死得很痛苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Tell me! No, no, let me see… when I crack open your head-fruit, what color juice spills out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 告诉我！不、不、让我看看……当我敲开你的头壳时，会流出什么颜色的汁液？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: The Lotus, barking at you. Always so calm. Always in control. She doesn't care about you Tenno. She don't love you. Not like I loved the tubemen you murdered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: Lotus，对你大呼小叫、永远那么冷静、永远掌握全局。她根本不在乎你，Tenno。她不爱你，不像我爱我那些被你杀害的克隆人一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Come for a fight? Should'a dressed for a funeral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 来此求战？ 该把参加丧礼的礼服穿来才对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Die lizard, leech, bloody-worm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 死吧蜥蜴、水蛭、该死的－蠕虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: This is for the tubemen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 这是为了克隆人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Would you look at you. Worthless, ugly, freaks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 你看看你，毫无价值、丑陋的怪胎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Come near me and I'll pound you into a tiny cube.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 靠过来，我把你锤成一个小方块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: It's hammer time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 锤人时间到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Gonna pull this ocean down on us if I have to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 如非不得已，我会毁了这里，让海淹没我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Nowhere left to hide. Nowhere left to run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 无处可躲，无处可逃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Wake up. Ven'kra, wake up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 醒醒。文克拉，快醒醒啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.text: Nooo... No... No!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerBosses/.zhText: 不不不……不要这样……不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerMale/Bb.text: This one has your name on it.
Your corpse will serve us well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerMale/Bb.zhText: 你的尸体会继续为我们效力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerMale/Bb.text: You will join us one way or another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerMale/Bb.zhText: 不管你愿不愿意，都将成为我们的一员。
有两下子，可惜你今天必须死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerMale/Bb.text: I offered you glory and you choose this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/GrineerMale/Bb.zhText: 我赐你荣耀，而你就这么恩将仇报？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: What you have learned here will serve you well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 你在这儿学的一切都会派上用场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: They fought well. Good deaths, all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 他们都在英勇奋战、死得其所。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: As you conquer the foe, so you conquer yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 当你战胜敌人时，你也战胜了自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: Your will was greater. This is good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 你的意志比他们更坚定。是好事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: And so we learn the importance of clarity and purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 所以思路清晰和目标明确尤为重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: You are a blade. You exist to strike. You strike to win. The lesson ends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 你就是利刃，生来就是为了斩杀，就是为了胜利。教学结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: Your enemies have grown fierce - use all that you have learned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 敌人愈发凶猛了——你必须竭尽你所学的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: Their rage is vehement, their focus impressive. Give them a warrior's death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 他们怒火中烧，又极为专注。让他们像战士一样死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: Each enemy is more powerful than before. Only with true mastery of the Tenno Arsenal will you succeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 每个敌人都变得比以前更强了。只有真正掌握 Tenno 战士的军械库，你才能成功。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: Accept your death and you may yet avoid it. Trust in your training.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 有战死沙场的觉悟，你才可以避免战死。相信你的训练。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: The art of combat must be practiced to truly master the canvas of war.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 要想真正把控整个战局，就必须精通搏斗的技能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: These are worthy foes. Underestimate them at your peril.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 敌人们都不容小觑。轻视敌人，你将自食苦果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: Your weapons make music, and the enemy calls for a song.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 尽情挥洒你的武器，为敌人演奏华美的交响乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.text: These foes deserve your respect. Honor them with quick deaths, and I with your victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DHard.zhText: 这些敌人值得尊重。给他们个痛快，然后用你的胜利向我致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.text: The Origin System is ever-changing. Our enemies grow more powerful - only the Tenno with true mastery of their Arsenal will overcome what awaits us. It is time to take on a new challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.zhText: 始源星系总是瞬息万变。我们的敌人不断成长，愈发强大——只有熟练掌握了军械库的 Tenno 战士才能克服一切险阻。是时候迎接一个全新的挑战了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.text: Tenno, will you walk THE STEEL PATH?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.zhText: Tenno 战士，你愿意踏上"钢铁之路"吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.text: Tenno - you must seek me out to walk THE STEEL PATH. I will be waiting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.zhText: Tenno 战士——你必须找到我才能踏上"钢铁之路"。我会等着你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.text: The enemy has learned your measure. The lessons you taught have made them wise, their hatred for you making them strong. You are a blade forged and honed, true. But even the sharpest of blades can break. And they must break you, lest you lay them low - now, and forever. Show me what you have learned. Survive. To the victor, my esteem… and the spoils.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HardMode/DTesh.zhText: 敌人已经了解你的攻击手段。你给他们的教训让他们现在变得更为狡猾，他们对你的仇恨也使他们变得更为强大。没错，你的确是一把饱经磨练的利刃。但是即使是最锋利的刀刃也会断裂。为了不被你打倒，他们就必须消灭你——从现在，直到永远。让我见识见识你学会了什么吧。活下来吧。胜利者会赢得我的尊重……并且获得奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DCons.text: ^(I accept the demon's offering. Will it accept mine?)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DCons.zhText: ^(我接受恶魔的奉献。那么它会接受我的吗？)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DCons.text: ^(This demon's gift shall rest within me forever. In thanks I give.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DCons.zhText: ^(这位恶魔的礼物将永远留在我的体内。为表感谢，我将予以回报。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: (太好吃了，主人，我变得又膨又胀。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.text: (I give painful thanks. In return what does this demon wish?)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: (我痛心疾首得感谢。作为回报，这位恶魔有什么愿望吗？)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.text: (Master feeds. I change. Fresh secretions threaten at every pore.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: (主人喂。我改变。新鲜的分泌物威胁着每一个毛孔。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.text: ^(Sacs, stomachs, bladders - all full. I grow torpid.)
(To a deep crevice is this gift reserved.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: (这份礼物预留给一个深深的缝隙。)
(太好了。大量的黏液。你看到了吗？)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.text: ^(My servitude in thanks to this demon. My Master.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: ^(为了感谢这位恶魔，奴婢供您差遣。我的主人。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.text: (I beg this demon: do not feed me that.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: (我恳求这位恶魔：不要喂给我那个。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.text: ^(Master's excess I off-gas as ammonia. And methane.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: ^(主人给我多余的部分，我会用来排放氨气和甲烷。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.text: (Please, Master! Too much! Bladders and sac-stores become toxic!)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DFeed.zhText: (拜托，主人！太多了！膀胱和储囊都会中毒的！)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DGood.zhText: （我们的工作永远不会真正结束。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DGood.text: (I await the return of this demon.)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DHngr.zhText: (主人什么时候喂我？什么时候？)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInfu.text: (You are forever changed. Is this demon pleased?)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInfu.zhText: (你永远地改变了。这位恶魔满意吗？)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInfu.text: (I quiver to gift this demon in return.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInfu.zhText: (我颤抖着送礼给这位恶魔来作为回报。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInfu.text: (Accept gifts, Master, but please… ask not from whence they come.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInfu.zhText: (接受礼物吧，主人，但请你……不要问这些是从哪里来的。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.text: (My finest secretions, Master. For you and you only.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.zhText: （我最优质的分泌物。主人，仅供你获取。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.text: (I pulse. I ooze. I give you of myself.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.zhText: （我脉动。我分泌。我献出我自己。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.text: (My plasma shall be your quickening. My mucus, your nourishment.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.zhText: （我的血浆会为你带来活力。吾之粘液，汝之养分。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.text: (What you have fed me, I return to you transmogrified!)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.zhText: （你喂给我的，我会把它转化后再归还给你！）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.text: (Drink deep of me. Luscious it is and pleasing to the entrails.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.zhText: （痛饮我的分泌物吧。味道鲜美，让人心旷神怡。）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.text: (Ah! A new agony! A new spasm! The cellular archive opens... kinship deepens... I shall craft, concentrate, concoct. Serums for the children of the Ancestor Worm!)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DInvi.zhText: （啊！新的痛苦！新的痉挛！细胞库开启了……亲情加深了……我会制作、浓缩、调制。属于先祖蠕虫子孙们的血清！）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DUnlo.text: (The potential you have granted me… hurts… and yet… I hunger to make...and to unmake.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DUnlo.zhText: (你赋予我的潜力……伤害着我……但……我渴望创造……也渴望破坏)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DUseH.text: (We grow closer to becoming one, I and this demon.)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Helminth/DUseH.zhText: (我与这位恶魔，越来越接近合二为一。)

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Can I get a hand over here?
Ah, why the hell did I let that happen?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊，我怎么会让这种事发生？
我想有什么东西……肯定……坏了。
我中枪了！¡Ándale！头一分钟是关键！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oi! I got sauced! Help me out, man!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 喂！我中枪了！快拉我一把，伙计！
给我叫个医生，立刻马上！
我快不行了……救命……救救我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: ¿Neta, ahorita? You are getting me up right now.
Oi! Get me up, you pillock!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 喂！快扶我起来，你这个笨蛋！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I got knocked down! Get me up again?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我被撂倒了！扶我起来好不好？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: My insides feel like they're on the outside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我的内脏感觉要翻出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You waiting for an invite or what? Get me up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你还愣着等请帖吗？快扶我起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I would rate my experience of being incapacitated ONE STAR!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我给这次的倒地体验打一星！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You lot need me, get me up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你们还需要我，快扶我起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Okay I asked for that! HELP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好吧，这是我自找的！救命啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I think-I think I'm gonna faint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我觉得——我觉得我要晕倒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: They got me. God-dammit! I'm down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们射中我了。见鬼！我倒下了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oi! You cuttin' without me? Gimme a hand!
