/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 喂！你们不带上我就走了？快扶我一把！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Great. Now I'm on the ground and bleeding! TWO OF MY LEAST FAVORITE THINGS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 太好了。现在我躺在地上还流血了！双倍快乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oh dear. This is bad. Help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦天哪。情况不妙。能帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't you leg it without me, you prick!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别丢下我自己跑了，你这个混蛋！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: This is the WORST game of tag EVER. HELP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这是有史以来最糟糕的捉迷藏了。救命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oi! What, you gonna let me die here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 喂！怎么，你真打算让我死在这？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oooh, I've never seen my insides from THIS perspective before. LITTLE HELP HERE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 噢，我以前从没从这个角度看过我的内脏呢。这里需要帮点忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I can taste my spleen! My spleeeeeeeeeen! MEDIC!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我都能尝到我的脾脏了！我的脾——脏啊！军医！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oh. Hello floor. Just going to … lie down on you… for a bit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 唔，地板你好。我只想……在你身上……躺一会。
连医护人员也需要医护了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Aaagh! Don't just stand there, get me up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊啊啊！别傻站在那里，快扶我起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Remember that time I almost died? Haha. Yeah. I do. GET ME UP.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 还记得我差点死掉那次吗？哈哈。对。我记得。快扶我起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: If-if you're not busy-can you help me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 如果——如果你不忙的话——你能帮帮我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Can I please get a hand up?
Not to rush you but these creeps wanna murder me to death and let me tell you they are on a clock. HELP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 不是催你，但这些家伙真想要我命，我告诉你，他们在赶时间呢。救命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Could somebody help me out here?
Could you get over here, please?
Lucky shot, that's all it was!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 运气好而已，就这么简单！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Funny story: I've been hideously wounded. HELP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 一个搞笑的故事：我受了重伤。救命！
生命体征受损……需要帮助……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll be fine. Just get me up.
Oi! Took one in the side! Staple me up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哎呦！侧身中弹！赶紧来给我缝一下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: DOWN! Clean in and out, just need a hand up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我倒下了！子弹穿过去了，就是需要人帮忙站起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ow. Ow. I said Ow ow fricking OW! GEMME UP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哎哟。哎哟。我说了哎哟哎哟，真特么的疼！快扶我起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Assistance, if you would? I'm losing equal parts blood and dignity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你能帮我一下吗？我真是失血又失尊严。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Drop what you're doing and help me!
They got me. They got me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们打中我了。他们打中我了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I am not done living yet.
Oh the humanity, oh the humanity!  Oh can the HUMANITY PICK ME UP!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦，天啊，哦，天啊！哦，有没有人性啊，救我起来啊！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: If you let me die… I will haunt you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你要是见死不救……我做鬼也不会放过你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oi! I got got! Oi! Cloth-ears! I'm hit ain't I!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 喂！我中枪了！喂！你在听吗？我可中枪了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I was totally paying attention. I didn't get distracted at all. I swear. …help?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我可是一直在全神贯注的。我一点也没分心。我发誓。……帮帮忙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll just lie here and finger-paint with my own blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我就在这躺着，然后用手指沾着血画画。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm hit! You got a man down here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我中枪了！我在这里倒下了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm down! Today is not Amir's day for making friends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我倒下了！今天不是阿米尔交朋友的日子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Those I have ended… look far too happy to see me…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 被我杀掉的那些人……好像很高兴能再见到我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: ¿En serio? Really? You're just gonna stand there? Help me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: ¿En serio？不是吧？你就这么站着？救我啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey! No man left behind! Flippin' law of the battlefield, right? Hey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿！绝不抛下队友！这是战场上的铁律，对吧？嘿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: On my back! And not in the fun way!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我在躺着！但一点也不好玩！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: My time is short. Are you going to hurry up or what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我的时间不多了。你到底要不要快点？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: They got me good, friend! Not gonna last long without an assist!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们把我打得不轻，朋友！没人帮忙我撑不了多久！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Agh! Help me up, you muppet!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊！快来救我，你这个笨蛋！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm down! If I die, delete my hard drive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我倒下了！如果我死了，记得清除我的硬盘！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I can practically smell Death's cologne…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我隐约闻到了死神古龙水的味道……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Get me up! Get me up! I ain't done with these ojetes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 扶我起来！快扶我起来！我跟这些 ojetes 还没完呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oi. Oi! Get the mandem 'fore they come back, yeah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 喂。喂！快，在敌人回来前帮帮我，懂吗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm down! I'm… I'm seeing a very bright light! It's very annoying!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我倒下了！我……我看到了一道超级亮的光！它太刺眼了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm hit! Aagh! ¡Apúrate, güey! Get me up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我中枪了！啊！¡Apúrate, güey！扶我起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm down. That muppet downed me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我倒下了。那个笨蛋把我击倒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oh God, I'm down! I… I see my grandmother! She… she says… you're all really lousy friends. HELP!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦天哪，我倒下了！我……我看到我奶奶了！她……她说……你们这群朋友真是不靠谱。救命！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Help me. This is not where I end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 救救我。我不应该死在这。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Drop what you're doing and help me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 放下手头的事，快来帮我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Well, it was quick at least.
Violence solves nothing, violence solves nothing, violence solves nothing…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 暴力是解决不了问题的，暴力解决不了问题，暴力解决不了任何问题……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Death is just a journey, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 朋友，死亡只是一段旅程。
嘿，搞定一个，一切都在掌握中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey, not even a challenge, c'mon.
NEVER turn your back on the cute ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 永远不要对可爱的家伙掉以轻心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Guys, guys, guys… you could be doing so much more with your lives! Kinda.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 伙计们，伙计们，伙计们……你们的生命本可以更精彩的！大概吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: "Aaah, she got me!" Yep, I did!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: "啊，她打中我了！"是的，我打中你了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey yo!  Made that look easy.
And so war makes monsters of us all.  But especially you guys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 然而战争把我们全都变成了怪物。但尤其是你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: One more added to my "dead asshole" quota.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我的"死混蛋"名单又增加了一个。
他们的思绪就此……停止了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Urgh. Best not look too close.
Okay, who has who by the tail here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好吧，看看到底谁能把谁拿下？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You didn't need those organs, did you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你不会需要那些器官的，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Pull up, clean up, ride out.
Oo, not your day, dude.  Ha, ew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 呜，你今天点儿真背，老兄。哈，呃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Another one bites the dust.  Ew.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 又干掉一个死肥佬。继续前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ha HA! Did you see that? Tell me you saw that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哈哈！看见没有？告诉我你看见了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: They are done, and no more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们全部被干掉了，不会再出现了。
嘿，他们连怎么死的都不知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oh. Why'd you have to make me do that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦。你为什么要逼我这么做呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: From darkness you came, and to darkness I consign you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你从黑暗中来，我也将你送回黑暗。
正在标记。他们藏不住的。
优先级别高的——就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I want this one taken out.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 正在标记。我们不会让他们溜掉的。
关键敌人，在你的瞄准范围内。
发现敌人！检查你的近距离和远距离安全！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Let's mop up these dipsticks and get home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 让我们清理这些蠢货，然后回家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Go at 'em like Dracula at a low-cut top.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 冲上去，就像德古拉冲向白花花的脖子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And the next contestant is… that guy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 下一位选手是……那个家伙。
让他们排成一排，全部解决掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Putting the evil eye on this one.
Plus ten to gonna kill it.
Pleased to be bullseying that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 很乐意对那东西一击毙命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't let this one get away.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 干掉他们，家人！火力全开！
那家伙看起来是个麻烦。
他们被标记了。干掉他们。
已发现整顿敌方势力的机会。
标记了。让他们灰飞烟灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: A rising star in the pop-up target community. Everyone, meet Dennis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 快闪目标群体中冉冉升起的新星。给大家介绍一下，这是丹尼斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey buddy, be a pal and hold these bullets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿，伙计，交个朋友，收下这些子弹。
有人竟然幻想自己有胜算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yo, fam. Bad guys on approach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 喂，家人。坏蛋们正在靠近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I AM A SYMPHONY OF DEATH
Well well, look at this cheeky bugger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哎呀哎呀，看看这个得寸进尺的家伙。
我差点就内疚了。就差一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: This one thinks they have a chance. Precious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这家伙认为他们有胜算。勇气可嘉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Gotta admit, he clashes with the decor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 不得不承认，他跟这里的装潢格格不入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And the black spot was given…
First to shoot this one gets a cookie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 谁先射中这个就有饼干吃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: This one won't be getting up in the morning.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 血压归零。正在重新锁定目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: They won't be giving us any more trouble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们不会再给我们添麻烦了。
他们根本不知道是怎么死的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Eres buena onda. You're always a good time, friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: Eres buena onda。和你在一起总是很愉快，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey! ¿Qué onda? ¿Cómo has estado? How'd we do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿！ ¿Qué onda？¿Cómo has estado？我们做得怎么样？
你准备好了我们就出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oh! You wanna some chingadazos, friend? Target marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦！你想来点 chingadazos，朋友？目标已标记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Might wanna whack that one as a priority.
Don't like the way this one's eyeballin' me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我不喜欢这家伙的眼神。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: GAH! You startled me. Gimmie a heads up next time, never know what a fella might be doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 天哪！你吓我一跳。下回出现先说一声，可能人家在忙别的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'LL CLEAN MY ROOM MOM I PROMISE! Wuh? Huh. Where are we? What time is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我会打扫房间的，妈妈，我保证！呃？啊。我们在哪儿？现在几点了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Need medical support? Or just a 'friendly' face?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 需要医疗支援吗？还是只需要一张"友好"的面孔？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And lo: Amir did bring the pain. And there was much tapping out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 看吧，阿米尔带来了痛苦。而且个个都在求饶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey, here to help. Got nothin' better to do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿，我来帮忙。反正我也没别的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Glad you called! No, really. I'm like really really bored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 很高兴你打过来！不，真的。我真的很无聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ooooh, where we goin'? Somewhere fun?  Somewhere dangerous?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 噢，我们去哪儿？好玩的地方？ 危险的地方？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Me estaba haciendo güey, where we going?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: Me estaba haciendo güey，我们要去哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Am I late? I brought death! I hope nobody's allergic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我来晚了吗？我带来了死亡！希望没人对这个过敏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: So. We got a job or this just another joy ride?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那么，我们有任务吗，还是这又是一次兜风？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Where we goin? To the park? Huh? Huh? Better not be the vet again, I fell for that last time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们要去哪儿？公园吗？啊？啊？最好不是去兽医那里，上次我就上当了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We make a good team. A weird team, but a good team.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们真是个不错的组合。一个奇怪的组合，但确实不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You brought nibbles for Vaquero, I hope?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你有给瓦奎罗带点零食吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Places to see, people to maim, people to patch back up…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 有很多要去的地方，有要受伤的人，也有需要我们治疗的人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Can I pick the radio station this time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这次电台频道可以我来选吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We dance con la flaca again today, eh, friend?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 今天我们再次与 la flaca 共舞，是吧，朋友？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: What's on the docket today, boss? Errands? Casual slaughter? Property damage? Shopping?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 老板，今天有什么安排？跑腿？随意杀戮？破坏公物？购物？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Another day, another… whatever all this is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 又是一天，又是……不知道是些什么的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Will there be explosions? … I do love it when there's explosions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 会发生爆炸吗？……我真的很喜欢爆炸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Always good to see you. Well. Me. Us. You get it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 见到你总是很开心。嗯，我。我们。你懂的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Tell me we're going somewhere fun this time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 告诉我，这次我们要去一个有趣的地方吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Fully charged and ready to GO!
Multiplayer's more Amir's thing, but sure - let's roll.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 多人游戏更适合阿米尔，但好吧——我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I thought you might call, so I ate like TEN BOWLS OF CHOCOLATE FROSTED SUPER SUGAR PUFFS. LET ME AT 'EM, BOSS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我想你会打电话过来，所以我吃了大概十碗巧克力糖霜超甜泡芙。让我来对付他们，老大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Never a dull moment with you. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 和你在一起永远不会无聊。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: The couple that slays together, stays together!
Funny, I was just thinking about you, my lil velvet owl.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 真有趣，我刚刚还在想你，我的小丝绒猫头鹰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just - don't do anything I wouldn't do. Yeah? While you're me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 只是——别做我不会做的事。好吗？在你变成我的时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Awww, I missed you too, my widdle fwuffy duck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗷，我也想你，我的毛绒小鸭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hola, mi vida. Good to see you.
This is gonna be good! You are just so adorable when you're covered in blood! …That came out wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这太好了！你血淋淋的样子真是太可爱了！……好像说错话了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Anytime you call, I'll be here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 只要你叫我，我就会在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You okay? I will ruin them- Just point me at 'em.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你还好吗？我会毁了他们——只要你将他们指给我看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: For you, I'm always just a ringtone away. Smooches!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 对于你来说，我永远只是一个铃声的距离。亲亲！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: After this, what do you say we go out for pad-thai?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这之后，我们出去吃泰式炒河粉怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: What field of death are you bringing me to today, mi vida? So romantic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 今天你要带我去哪片死亡之地，mi vida？真浪漫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: D'aw, I love you too, cuddly-wumpums.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 噢，我也爱你，我的小可爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Show me something grotesque and beautiful, corazón.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 给我展示一些既怪异又美丽的东西，corazón。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: That's right, nobody touches my S.O.! GRRRRR ARF ARF ARF!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 没错，谁都别想碰我的另一半！嗷呜汪汪汪！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Miss me? Or do you just need stitches?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 想我了吗？还是你只是需要缝针？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Some people give each other flowers. Other people wear each other around like meat suits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 有些人会互送鲜花，而其他人就像肉服一样把对方穿在身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Are you hurt? Do you want to be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你受伤了吗？还是你想要受伤？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: My Shmoopy And Me: The Love Story of A Genius Haxxor And His Wacko Timetraveler.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我的宝贝和我：天才黑客与他的古怪时间旅行者的爱情故事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey, I'd rather be gettin' shot at with you than sharing space with Arthur's monstrosa sister.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿，我宁愿和你一起挨枪子，也不愿与亚瑟的怪物姐姐待在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Never fear! Your baby Amir is here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别害怕！你的宝贝阿米尔来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I love that we can do this. Give it to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我很喜欢我们能一起做这些。交给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Anybody order the smart and sexy? I got an order here, hot off the grill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 有人点了聪明性感套餐吗？我接到一份订单，火热出炉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey, your heart beats with mine. Together, we live - or together, we die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿，你的心与我的心一起跳动。我们一起生，或一起死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Our bodies, our hearts and our souls, are one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们的身体、心灵和灵魂已合为一体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Gonna pwn some losers with my snuggle-monster! … In the manliest way possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我要和我的抱抱怪物一起暴揍那些废物！……以最有男子气概的方式。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Let's show them what happens when they stand against us, corazón.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们让那些与我们为敌的人，看看他们的下场，corazón。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Y'know, this whole "having somebody drive me around" thing would suck if it weren't you. Looooove you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你知道吗，被人载着到处走的感觉本来挺糟糕的，但如果是你的话就不一样了。爱你噢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Mm? Are we going on a date? Or a bloodbath? … All the same to us, huh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗯？我们是去约会？还是去大开杀戒？ ……对我们来说都一样，哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I wonder if I'm still ticklish like this. Maybe we can find out later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我想知道自己是不是还这么怕痒。也许以后可以试试看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You and me against the world. Bring it on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 就你和我对抗全世界。来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: A Haiku For You. Because I love you so much. Let's go kill things. … Fish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 一首俳句送给你。因为我太爱你了。我们去杀戮吧。…… 鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Gonna share a body with the one I love! Which is weird! But it's okay cuz we're in love! Doo de doo!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 要和心爱的人共享一个身体！这很奇怪！但没关系，因为我们相爱！嘟嘟嘟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Pleasure. Pain. We feel the world together like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 快感。痛苦。我们就这样一起感受着世界。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hey! After this we go for dinner. Te invito.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿！这个结束后我们去吃晚饭。Te invito。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Okay, corazón. Might make for a fun date. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好的，corazón。这也许会是个有趣的约会。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You didn't have to make up excuses to see me, but… I'm glad you did. Hola, bebé.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你其实不必找借口来见我，但……我很高兴你这么做了。Hola，bebé。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You get to feel every beat of my heart. Keep it safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你能感觉到我每一次心跳。请保护好它。
侦查一下，如果可以的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hm. Take a shufty at this.
Hey, what do we think about this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嘿，我们对这个有什么看法？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I spy with my little eye…
Lookie lookie, I got a cookie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 快看快看，我找到好东西了。
猜猜阿米尔发现了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: My my, what do we have here?
Hey, should we check that out?
I spy with my little eye…
What's that? Is that a thing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那是什么？那是个东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: One moment. What do you make of this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 稍等。对这你觉得怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Could be somethin' could be nothin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 可能有什么，也可能什么也没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Well well, what have we here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好吧好吧，我们看看这里有什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hm. There might be something to this.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别挣扎了。一切都结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm sorry it came to this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我很抱歉事情发展到这个地步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You should have picked an easier target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你应该去找一个更容易的目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: That's quite enough out of you.
I need a cup of tea and a lie down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我需要喝杯茶，再躺一会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: There really was no need for that.
Where do they find these people?
Let's call it a day, shall we?
Nasty piece of work, that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 真是给恶心东西，那家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And don't make me tell you again.
…knock one down, pass it around, 98 bottles of beer on the wall…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: ……拿走一瓶传下去，98 瓶啤酒在墙上……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yech. That guy definitely looks worse on the inside than he did on the outside.  And that's saying something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 是啊。那家伙的内在看起来绝对比外表更糟糕。这足以说明问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: He had to split.  Like a bana...uh...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他裂开了。像一根香蕉一样……呃……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Plus five to backstab really paid off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 在背刺技巧上再加五点真是很值。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And that, as they say, is that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 正如他们所说，就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I was just tryin' to scare him. Whoops.
Was that worth it, my unpleasant friend?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 值得吗，我那不开心的朋友？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: WHAT HAVE I DONE? I gotta hide the body - Oh - Ha. Ah Amir, you silly sausage. Everything is murder in a hellscape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我做了什么？我得把尸体藏起来——哦——哈。啊，阿米尔，你这个傻瓜。地狱里的一切都是谋杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: A little touch up, nothin' fancy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 简单处理了一下，没什么花里胡哨的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And that's a nine-point-five on the dismount!
Talent's wasted on these muppets for real.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这些蠢货真是白瞎了我的才能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Look at me, Ma! I'm a ballet of death!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 妈妈，快看我！我跳的是死亡芭蕾！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Now, answer my questions or do I have to get rough? Hey. aaaaHHH FFFF…!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 现在，回答我的问题，还是要我动粗？嘿。啊啊啊啊……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We are all born astride the grave, are we not? Farewell, my friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们都是向死而生的，不是吗？永别了，我的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Could win gold for that. No lie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 刚才那一下都能拿金牌了。没骗你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: In that final moment, they never resist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 在那最后一刻，他们从不反抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I oughta leave survivors or I'm never buildin' a rep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我应该留几个活口，不然我的名声永远建不起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ah, Mother. Whatever has become of your sweet daughter?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊，母亲。你可爱的女儿现在怎么样了？
哈！我的手法简直是工艺品级别的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: So that's what you look like on the inside. Huh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 原来你里面长这样啊。呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Always, always, it comes to this. Adieu.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 总是这样，总是这样。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just another day at the office.
No matter the story, the ending is the same. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 无论故事如何，结局都是一样的。永别了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll take Kicking Your Ass for five hundred, Alex.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我要选"暴打你"题目，直接加 500 分，亚历克斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Right. Wonder what's on the telly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好了。不知道电视上在播些什么呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: All right, gotta admit, I made that look cool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好吧，我得承认，我让它看起来超酷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Fret no more, my brave friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别再仿徨了，我勇敢的朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Didn't even mess up my hair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 甚至连我的发型都没弄乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And Coach Plonket said I'd never amount to anything. HAH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 普隆克特教练说我永远不会出人头地。哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Did you see that? Mate? Oh. Right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那个你看到了没？伙计？噢。好吧。
这种事我可以做一整天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: A kiss upon your lips, breath as cold as clay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 亲吻你的嘴唇，呼吸如泥土般冰冷。
让希波克拉底誓言见鬼去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Thought I was done that time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我还以为我当时死定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Not walking into the light just yet.
You're one of the good ones.
Seems fate's not done with me yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 看来命运还不打算放过我。
哦，还在呼吸的感觉真好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Got a little too close that time.
Oh, thank the Gods for you.
I'm not afraid to die… but I'm glad I didn't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我并不怕死……但仍然很庆幸我还活着。
我的天，内啡肽还挺有趣的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I got too close. I heard his Voice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我离得太近了。我都听见他的声音了。
命悬一线的感觉还真是让人神清气爽。
所以——我还是那么漂亮吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll make a point of being more aware in future. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我以后会更注意的。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I probably deserved that. Thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这也许是我应得的。谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I owe you a drink for that.
Oooop... back on my feet. Cheers.
I'm up. And now I'm pissed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我起来了。现在我真的很生气。
谢谢。我不会忘记这个的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Thanks! I'll send you a card.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 谢谢！我会寄张感谢卡给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Thanks. Takes more than one of them fools to get me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 谢谢。想打倒我，光靠他们这些傻瓜可不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll try not to screw up next time.
They just got lucky, that's all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们只是运气好，仅此而已。
对了。我们刚才说到哪了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yeah, thanks. Feel a right arse, still.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗯，谢谢。不过我还是觉得挺丢人的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: No hay tos. Just winded. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: No hay tos。只是有点喘。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Thanks. Reckon they're proper bad, don't they?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 谢谢。我觉得他们真够狠的，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Come out to the ass-end of nowhere, we'll get together, have a few laughs…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 大老远跑到这鸟不拉屎的地方，就为了聚一聚，开心一下……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ok. Ok. Ok. Here we go.
I went down like a sack of spuds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我就像一袋土豆一样倒下了！
我还没打够呢。我们走吧。
多谢了，伙计。是时候报仇了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Thank you thank you I'm fine fine fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 谢谢谢谢，我很好很好很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: They gonna regret not finishing me off. Safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们会后悔没杀了我。现在安全了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: My hero, yeah? Next one's on me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你是我的英雄，对吧？下一次我来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Man ain't nothin' without his mains. Respec'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 一个人没有可靠的伙伴，就什么都不是。致敬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: The only thing wounded is my dignity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 只有我的尊严受了点伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't fuss, you're like my maiden aunt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别大惊小怪的，你跟我亲姑妈似的。
伤口处理得很干净。我没事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Groovy. Heh. Ow. Ow ow ow.
Thanks for the lift, fam. Gonna make them pay for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 谢谢你的帮助，家人。我会让他们付出代价的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You came through for me. Thanks.
Let us never speak of this again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们再也不要提这件事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: The close ones make you feel alive. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 身边的人让你感觉到自己是活着的。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Proper certy, man. All good, I'll sleep this off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 多谢了，伙计。没事，我睡一觉就好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Gran'ma? Is that... Is that you, Gran'ma?
Knew you wouldn't let me down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我就知道你不会让我失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Let 'em have a win every once in a while, y'know? It's only fair.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 偶尔让他们赢一把，懂吗？公平点嘛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: There you are, right on time.
I'm gonna make them feel for that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我会让他们为这个付出代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Man, that was a close one.
Man sauces me, man gets sauced.
Once more unto the breach etcetera and so forth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 再次冲锋陷阵，诸如此类的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yeah yeah thanks. Whatcha want: a medal?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好了好了，谢谢。你想要个勋章吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Tell me the truth. Can you see daylight where my spleen should be?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 老实告诉我。我脾脏那里是不是能透光了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Nobody hits me and gets away with it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 没人能打了我然后全身而退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: This stays between you and me, seen? Man's got a reputation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这件事就咱俩知道，明白吗？我得保住我的名声。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm running out of sick days.
Musta thought they were pretty hot, catching me like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们一定以为自己很牛，能这样逮到我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Easy. Sol's tits, where'd you learn your bedside manner?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 轻点。天啊，你这手法哪学的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I love the smell of facepalm in the morning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我可太爱大清早的无语味了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Havin' a proper mare with these ops, ya feel me? I'm good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这些敌人真让人头疼，懂我意思吗？我没事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm good. Pretty sure I… didn't need… all that… blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我没事！说真的我……不需要……那么多……血吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Bastard. Yeah, I'm good. Let's roll.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 混蛋。嗯，我还行。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You have to admit-this is an improvement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你必须承认——这是一个进步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Well, what kind of hellscape adventure are we on today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那么，今天我们要进行什么样的地狱冒险呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Never a dull moment with you, eh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 和你在一起从来不会无聊，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: They don't stand a chance against us.
Arthur James Nightingale, reporting for duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 亚瑟·詹姆斯·南丁格尔，前来报到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Calling on me? Must be serious.
This is exactly what I'm trained for.
My day just got a whole lot better.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊哈。我们可以开始了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just can't do without me, huh?
A little bit of Aoi, by your side.
You only ever had to ask.
Damn, I should have brought pizza.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 该死，我应该带披萨来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ooooh! Where're we going? Somewhere fun?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 噢！我们要去哪儿？去好玩的地方吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Aoi is ready for action! Accessories sold separately.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 碧已准备就绪！配件需单独购买。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Your one-woman wrecking crew is in the house.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你的单人破坏小组就在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We come alive, under the neon glow- Oh! Hi!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们在霓虹灯下尽情摇摆——哦！嗨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: There better be something metal around here I can mess with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这附近最好有一些金属东西可以让我摆弄。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I do so love to make an entrance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我真的很喜欢华丽登场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Quincy-K, reporting for duty, lookin' sick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 昆西-克，报道就位，看上去真帅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We do make a sublime team, don't we?
Oh, thank the Void. I was getting positively ravenous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦，感谢虚空。我已经饥肠辘辘了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Is this a social call? Or are things going to get a bit bloody?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这是日常问候吗？还是会有血腥的事情发生？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: One brief and somewhat tingly jaunt through space and time later…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 经过短暂而又有些刺激的时空之旅之后……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm game. Well bored bein' posted up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我来吧。守在这实在是无聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: What wondrous escapades shall we go on today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 今天我们要进行哪些奇妙的冒险呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I can't imagine you called me here just to improve the look of the place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我无法想象你叫我来这里只是为了提高这里的颜值。
承认吧：我看起来挺有型的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: How might I be of service?
Dem man never see me coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那帮人根本没想到我会出现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Need me to give someone a tongue-lashing?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 需要我痛骂某人一顿吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Enter: Eleanor Nightingale, with attendant demons.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 有请：埃莉诺·南丁格尔，以及伴随她的恶魔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yeah yeah. I'm game. What's up?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那么，戴手套还是不戴手套？
让枪淋弹雨来得更猛烈些吧，老表？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Let's sow a little chaos, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们来制造点混乱吧，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: When you need the job done proper, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 需要我来干净利落地收拾战场了，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: What's on the docket tonight? Mayhem, murder, and mutilation?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 今晚有什么节目？暴乱、谋杀、还是肢解？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just look what you've conjured up.
Drop me in the field - expect  mayhem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 派我去战场——准备迎接混乱吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ah, I needed to stretch my legs.
Imma do this calm. Imma do this cold. Ya feel me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我要平静地做这件事。我要冷酷地完成。你懂我意思吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: 'Bout time, need to get proper cruddy. Bones itchin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 是时候了，该好好大闹一场了。骨头都开始痒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: And who needs to meet their makers today, dear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 亲爱的，今天谁需要去见他们的制造者呢？
彻底嗨起来了。放开手脚来吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We work well together, don't we, love?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们合作得很好，不是吗，亲爱的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: No one I'd rather be fighting beside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你是我最乐意并肩作战的伙伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Any excuse to be by your side, I'll take.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 能留在你身边的任何借口，我都接受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You and me: here we go again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你和我：又要并肩作战了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I know how you can make this up to me later…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我知道你以后该怎么补偿我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: For you, I'll always be here, sweetheart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 为了你，我会一直在这里，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I don't think they know what they're up against, do they babe?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我想他们还不知道自己的对手是谁，不是吗宝贝？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Aw, just can't stay away from me, huh?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 噢，你就是离不开我，是吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Did you miss me that badly?
You don't mind a bit of stubble, do you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你不介意我留点胡须吧？
我就是这么……有吸引力，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: My body is in your hands.
Right here by your side, now and always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 就在你身边。现在如此，永远如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just remember, when we're like this you feel what I feel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别忘了，这样时我的感受就是你的感受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: So, what's your plan? Take this body for a spin, then shower it down after?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那么，你的计划是什么？带着这个身体兜兜风，然后洗个澡？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Is it weird that I find this kind of… romantic?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 很奇怪，这……竟然有些浪漫？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I have to admit, this is… weirdly romantic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我不得不承认，这……竟然有些浪漫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Is this a date? Will there be violence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这是约会吗？会遇到暴力吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: So, what romantic adventure are we off to?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那么，我们将要踏上怎样的浪漫冒险呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Always an adventure with you, babe!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 和你在一起总是一场冒险，宝贝！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Nobody lays a hand on my Drifter.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你随时可以给我打电话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You get to feel every beat of my heart. Keep it safe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你能感觉到我每一次心跳。请保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just don't go peeking while you're in there - your birthday gift's are on order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你在里面不要偷看——你的生日礼物已经订好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Couples who slay together, stay together.
Us, against the universe? They don't stand a chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们，对抗整个宇宙？他们毫无胜算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm here to watch your back, sweetheart. Also because it's my back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我会看护好你的后背，亲爱的。也因为这是我的后背。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm not going to let anybody hurt you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我不会让任何人伤害你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Anybody comes near you, babe? I'll crush their skulls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 宝贝，谁敢靠近你？我就打碎他们的头骨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Anytime, anywhere, I'm here for you, sweetheart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 无论何时何地，我都会陪在你身边，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Somebody bothering you, baby? Want me to hurt them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 有人骚扰你吗，宝贝？想让我伤害他们吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll always pick up when you call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 只要你打电话我就会接。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Let's paint the town red, lover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 让我们把小镇染成红色的吧，爱人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Couldn't stop dreaming of me, hm? It's mutual…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 无法停止梦见我，嗯？这是相互的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Come, let's cut. Just you 'n' me, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 来吧，我们闪人。就我们俩，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Nobody lays a hand on you but me.
Yo. What you tryin' to do after?
I trust you are, as ever, well, my love?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我相信你像平常一样安好，我的爱人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: This feels proper wrong. Probly why I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这样感觉挺不合规矩的。或许这正是我喜欢的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We do feel… magnificent together, don't we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们在一起确实感觉……棒极了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You 'n me, against all of them? Babe, them fools are gonna get shaved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 就我们俩对抗他们所有人？宝贝，那些蠢货要被削了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Perhaps later you might do a variety of things to your beloved that would shame her dear mother?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 也许你以后会对你心爱的人，做各种各样让她亲爱的母亲感到羞耻的事情？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Dem opps got no hope. You 'n' me? We got this patterned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那些敌人没希望了。你和我？我们已经把一切掌控好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I like that you don't mind asking for help occasionally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我喜欢看你无所顾忌地偶尔求助的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Okay, okay. We ride. But later, I need me some skin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 行，行。我们出发。但之后，我想要点亲密接触。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Can't leave you alone for a minute, can I?
Babe, geezer messes with you? Straight merked. Boom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 宝贝，有家伙敢惹你？直接干掉他。砰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: One does not mess with those for whom I have affection.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我知道。我看起来美极了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm likin' how you wear me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我喜欢你"穿上"我的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Let's ensure that both our lovely rear ends stay intact today, hm?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 今天我们要确保我们俩可爱的屁股都完好无损，嗯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Here's how this works: you need me, you call. Feel me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 规矩是这样：你需要我，就联系我。懂了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: In our future I see a fireside, a drink…and us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 在我们的未来，我看到了炉火、美酒……和我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Um, I had… partners… get in my head before, but not like this. I kinda… like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗯，我以前也曾有过……伙伴……进入我脑海，但没有像这次这样。我有点……喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Life and death - body and soul - heart and mind. We are duality, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 生命与死亡——肉体与灵魂——心灵与思想。我的爱人，我们是一体两面的羁绊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Damn, babe. You got a real feel for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 该死，宝贝。你真的很懂我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: To feel you guiding my hand is a bliss I cannot describe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 感觉你在牵着我的手，这是一种我无法形容的幸福。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yo, later we hit a movie, blag a two-for-one, yeah? Just messin'. Films are dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哟，等会儿我们去看电影，搞个买一送一的票，好吗？只是开个玩笑。电影已经过时了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I am glad not to be parted from you for long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我很高兴没有和你分别太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Sure sure, but after this: you, me, long shower, a few drinks… what you sayin'?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 行行，但这件事做完后：你我一起，洗个长时间的澡，来几杯酒……你觉得怎样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ah, there you are. I was growing lonely without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊，你来了。没有你，我愈发觉得孤独。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Glidin'? Scoped the opp block, yeah? Gotta do what you gotta do, innit?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 在巡视吗？探了一下"敌区"，对吧？得做该做的事，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I don't think they know who they're dealing with, do they? Poor fools…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我想他们还不知道对手是谁吧？可怜的傻瓜……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I would cross the dark ocean of the void itself for your call, my love.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我的爱人，为了你的呼唤，我愿意穿越虚空的黑暗海洋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: One of these days imma take you on a proper date. Flowers, candles, all that good shit. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 总有一天我会正式地带你出去约会。鲜花、蜡烛，还有所有美好的东西。我保证。
爱人，现在我们合二为一了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Enough room in there for you?
Slip me on like a body bag, why don't you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 把我当成尸袋套上吧，怎么样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll just take a back seat.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这事永远不可能看起来正常。
哦耶，现在是骑高高时间。
噢。我们来玩"我是小间谍！"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't set any important bits of me on fire, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 请不要让我的关键部位着火，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Remember, if we get hurt, I feel it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 记住，如果我们受伤，我会感觉到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Let's just keep in mind if you get shot, I get shot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们得记住，如果你中枪，我也中枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: In you go - there we are.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 让我们看看你学了些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Try not to scuff the paintwork.
Let's stretch our legs, shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们去活动活动腿脚吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Six P's: Prior Planning Prevents Piss-Poor Performance. You're ready?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 送你十个字：事前先规划，以免掉链子。你准备好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Still can't believe I let you do this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 还是不敢相信，我竟然允许你这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: The kitty is in the basket. Let's roll.
Now *this* is company I don't object to.
nnnnnNNNGAH buy a guy dinner first at least.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯进来之前好歹先请我吃顿饭吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't get lost in the mind palace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 不要迷失在心灵的宫殿里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Keep me in good nick, yeah?
Just thought you'd slip into someone more comfortable?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 还以为你会换个更舒适的人进去呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You should let me drive you someday.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你应该哪天让我也驾驭驾驭你。
就像水银穿过鸭子一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: What you sayin', G? You cool?
Sure, just don't go through any of my memories labeled 'Recipes'. They're just… they're not recipes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 当然，只是别翻我那些标着"食谱"的记忆。那些……那些其实不是食谱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You know everytime we do this I can't remember yellow for an hour, right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你知道吗，我们每次这样做，我一小时都想不起来黄色是什么样的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: About time! I was getting lonely in here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 是时候了！我在这里越来越孤独了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Arright yeah. Come on in. Make y'self comfortable n'at.
Sweet Lua, at least hold a guy for a minute.
Y'know I'm pretty sure this is giving me brain dam-HHHUK.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你知道吗，我敢肯定这真的在损伤我的脑子——呼哧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: They'd have burned me for this, once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 曾经他们会因为这个烧死我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Aaaaall aboo- HEY! Gimme your ticket!
What. Is. Love?  Baby don't hurt me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 问世间情为何物？不爱请别伤害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Lock up when you're done, yeah?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 日程表上有什么安排吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just remember I need an oil change every ten thousand kilometers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 记得哦，我每跑一万公里需要换一次机油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll be just over your shoulder, if you need anythin'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我就在你身后，有事随时找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Fortunately I have that dumptruck cerebellum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 幸好我有颗大货车似的小脑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Are we off? I'll let Arthur know. He frets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们要出发了吗？我要告诉亚瑟。他比较担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: So nice to have company again. Welcome back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 很高兴又有人来陪我了。欢迎回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ugh, happy to take a break.
I'll sit out for a second.
Rest? Don't mind if I do.
Don't forget about me over here.
Off on a jolly, are we?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 只是要记住，你不是铁打的，好吗？
别忘了你把我留在了哪里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: If you wouldn't mind, pick us up a coffee while you're out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 如果方便的话，出去的时候顺便给我带杯咖啡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Give us a yell when you're ready.
Get some rest. You must be chin-strapped.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 去休息一下吧。你一定累坏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Right. Ablutions... and maybe some Mahler.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好的。先梳洗一下……或许还能放点马勒的音乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Off you go. I'll put my feet up.
Oh! Pick me up something fancy!
Off wit ya, just like that, yeah?
So, should I wait here? I'll just wait here. I'm waiting here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那，我要在这等吗？算了，我就在这等吧。我还在这等着呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I always forget how human you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我总是忘记你是活生生的人类。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Right. Everythin' where I left it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗯，一切还是原来的样子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You're coming back, right? You'll be back? Yeah, they'll be back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你会回来吧？应该会吧？嗯，他会回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't go far. Stay in communication.
Ugh. That feels proper raw, cuz.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 呃。这感觉真不习惯，老表。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: GET ME SNACKS WHILE YOU'RE OUT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你出去的时候顺便给我带点零食！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Just like that, a magical stranger appeared.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 就这样，一个神奇的陌生人出现了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oooh, perfect time to beat a few levels while you're busy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 噢，正好趁你忙的时候再刷几关。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I've got my games, I'm good!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这是我们两个人的力量。
享受灵魂出窍的体验吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yeah yeah. I see how it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好吧好吧，我知道怎么回事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: So, what? I jus' stand 'round the gaff lookin' bad? Waste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 所以说？我只能在这站着装酷吗？真浪费时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Holy sh - Where'd you come from?! Oh. Right. Me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我靠——你从哪里冒出来的？！哦。对哦。是我自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'll just stand 'round and count sheep, then, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 那我就站在这数羊好了，可以吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Y'know we'd make a killing as a magic act.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你知道吗，如果我们去表演魔术的话肯定能赚翻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I love how easily our minds separate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我很喜欢我们的心灵能如此轻易地一分为二。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't get yourself killed while you're out, chief.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 在外头别出什么事啊，老板。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: You roam free while I meditate, all right?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 当我冥想的时候，你四处逛逛，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Nah, do you. I got this patterned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别，你做你的。我这边都安排好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: AGH! CHESTBURSTER! Oh. It's just you. Never mind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊！异形破胸怪！哦。原来是你啊。没事了。
好吧。正好可以休息一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Soooo I'll just stand here? Cool, cool. No big deal.
Merchandise untrammeled, for which I thank you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 老子终于能放开手脚了，我得感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Don't do anything I wouldn't do! Or anything I would do!  Wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别做我不会做的事！也别做我会做的事！等等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I'm good! Nope. Bored. Booooored. Booooooooooooored. Bored. Boooored, bored.  Oh God you gotta come back. Boooooooooooooooooooored!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我没事！不对，好无聊。超——无——聊——。无聊无聊无聊。超级无聊。无聊死了。天哪，拜托你快回来吧。好——无——聊——啊！
没关系，当我不存在就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: SHLROOORPH! … That never stops being weird.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 咝噜噗！……这种感觉总是怪怪的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Try to stay out of trouble.
Maybe he's born with it, maybe it's Trans-fer-ence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 也许是来自内心，也许是来自传识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Fair warning: if you scuffed the finish I'll be pissed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 丑话说在前：如果你刮花了我的涂装，我会很生气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I will be quite all right on my own, don't you fret.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我自己就可以过得很好，你不必担心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: No faffing about, you ain't so tough without me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 别磨蹭了，没有我你不算什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Well, that burned a few calories.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗯，这可燃烧了不少卡路里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Think it's gonna get a bit tasty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 感觉接下来会变得很刺激。
你想开战吗？那就开始吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yeah, I'm up for a scrap.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 是的，我准备好大干一场了。
区域非常危险！注意安全！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I am not in the mood.
Someone wants a word with us.
Enemies in their natural habitat. And we've upset them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 敌人正待在他们的老窝。哦，我们把他们惹毛了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Enemy at… front! Or whatever Arthur would say! Over there!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 敌人在……前方 ！或者类似亚瑟会说的话！那边！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Do you know how much metal's in your body? I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 你知道你身体里有多少金属吗？我可是知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Wake up! Drillers in the field!
C'mahn! Ahm right hea! Do eet! Keel me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 来啊！小爷就在这！动手啊！杀了我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: We appear to have angered the locals.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们好像激怒了当地人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Hostiles! Contain them before it's a ball of chalk!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 有敌人！在一切变成废墟前控制住他们！
遇敌！检查你的近距离和远距离安全！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Locked, cocked and rrrrready to rock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 锁定目标，扳上扳机，然后准——备干架。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: What is their major malfunction? Return fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 他们出了什么大问题？开火还击！
遭遇敌人！事情严重起来了！
好吧……看来和平解决是不可能了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Are these guys trying to kill me? I hate that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这些家伙是想杀我吗？我讨厌这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: A good deal of aggression heading our way!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 大量侵略者朝我们来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Bad guys! Bad guys! Get your bad guys here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 坏蛋！坏蛋！让你们的坏蛋滚过来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I could turn them against one another, if that's agreeable?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我可以让他们自相残杀，如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Well, somebody woke up on the wrong side of the hellscape today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 好吧，有人今天起了床就气不顺。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Something out there wants to kill us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 外面有东西想干掉我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Opps pullin' up on us for real! Rise!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 敌人真的冲上来了！起身迎战！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: It would appear they've chosen violence.
We have company and they do not look happy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们有客人上门了，可他们看上去不高兴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: That's why we step out strapped. Let rip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这就是我们全副武装出战的原因。开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Time to strap on our action pants!
Certainly. By all means let's fight.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 嗯，今儿个咱们真受欢迎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Shall we all pick a target and get creative?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们选一个目标好好教训他一下，如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Reading a lot of anger, and not much intelligence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 能看出十足的愤怒，智慧倒是不多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yeah yeah shoot shoot bang bang die die.
Some truly putrid minds are heading this way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 一些恶意的想法正冲着我们来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Wake up! We got bad guys!
Oh. Somebody likes the rough stuff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦，有人喜欢粗暴的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: I am here to kick bubblegum and chew ass and I am all outta ass! …Wait, hold on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我要在这里踹泡泡糖，嚼着屁股，但屁股嚼光了！……等一下，串词了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Our little friends want to play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 我们的小伙伴们想玩玩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ah. Adversaries. I'll be right with you, pets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 啊，对手。我马上就来陪你们玩，小宠物们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Steady on lads, one at a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 小伙子们，沉住气，一个一个来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Ah I was gettin' lonely anyway!
Murder! Table for a bunch of dudes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 催命服务员！给这群货安排一桌！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Now this is more like it.
Let's get this show on the road.
This is easily the best part of my day so far.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 这是我今天最开心的时刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Saddle up, let's ride the devil down.
Yes yes, let's hurry it up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 是的是的，让我们抓紧时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Well, would you look at that.
Just… don't mess up the hair.
Oh, ff- I'm fine, I'm fine. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦，我没事，我没事。我们走吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Yeah let's go cause some property damage.
Situation blows but I like the ride.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 虽然情况很糟糕，但我喜欢这辆摩托。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Once more unto the breach, hm?
Flyin' like I don't mind dyin'.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 必须更快必须更快必须更快——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Oh, but it does look like fun, I will admit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 哦，但我得承认，这看起来确实很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.text: Isn't it a thing of beauty?
Just don't crash - I don't want to have to set my own bones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/HumanFrameSkin.zhText: 千万别撞了——我可不想给自己接骨头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Take what you may.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 能拿多少就拿多少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: An offering.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 一份馈赠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: We have safeguarded these for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我们一直为你守护着这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: A child once hid here, and waited.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 曾经有个孩子藏身于此，静候时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Fate has brought you to this sanctuary of plenty. Choose wisely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 命运将你带到这片丰饶之地。请明智地选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: What reward has fate called on you to have?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 命运赋予了你怎样的奖励？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Make a choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 做出选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Fate has brought you to this reward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 命运让你获得了这份奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Crystalize this victory. Take your prize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 将胜利化为现实。领取你的奖励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: His voice grows dim while you grow strong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 他的声音日渐微弱，而你却日益强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: In ancient times there were Six who stood against Him. The Hex. Six shall stand against Him now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 古时，曾有六人挺身与他抗衡。六人组。如今，也将有六人再次与他抗衡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: For each point of the cryobell a warrior stands before me. For each ring a warcry against His onslaught.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 冰珠铃的每一个尖端，都有一名战士立于我面前。每一声铃音，都是抗击他来袭的战吼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: The one who torments our realm is of a body eightfold. Six may prevail against Him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 他身具八重之躯，荼毒着我们的世界。六人合力，或许可以战胜他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Six have answered the cryobell's ring. Six warriors steadfast against His eternity of stone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 六人已应冰珠铃之鸣而来。六名战士屹立不移，对抗他那永恒不朽的石躯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: What a beautiful sounnnndddd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 多么美妙的声音啊啊啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I feel funnnnnyyyyyy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我感觉怪——怪——的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: That's a new sensation…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 那可是种全新的感觉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Where did you come frooommmm??
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 你是从哪里来呢呢呢？？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I find the frequency at which this Cryobell rings, strangely hypnotic…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我发现这只冰珠铃的鸣响频率，有一种奇特的催眠效果……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: RE-UN KAIVBOK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: RE-UN KAIVBOK！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: This is not the fate I envisioned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 这并非是我曾设想的命运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: The chime must ring again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 冰珠铃必须再次响起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: You must not waste these chances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 你绝不能浪费这些机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Stillness will not still us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 静默无法让我们停下脚步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: MARAHU KALOHK KAIVBOK SHOKARIS
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: MARAHU KALOHK KAIVBOK SHOKARIS

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: MARAHU KALOHK NE TAV
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: MARAHU KALOHK NE TAV

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Was I chosen to find him. Or did he find me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 是我被选中去寻找他，还是他找到了我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: It matters little if my teacher cheered my demise until she met my eyes. What matters is what she did next. What choices will you make?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 老师在我死亡之前是否曾幸灾乐祸，直到她与我四目相对，这都无关紧要。重要的是她接下来的举动。你会做出怎样的选择？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: MARA LOHK NE RIS
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: MARA LOHK NE RIS

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I speak through the Cryobell. This time and place has been beset by His corruption. Reestablish order.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我借着冰珠铃之音传达信息。此时此地已遭他的腐化侵袭。去恢复秩序。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: There was once a child who stared oblivion in the face and walked away. Now oblivion seeks a foothold here. Defeat these creatures before their minds and bodies are saturated with His corruption.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 曾经有一个孩子，直面了虚无并全身而退。如今，虚无正试图在此立足。趁这些生物的心智与躯体尚未被他的腐化彻底侵蚀之前，击败他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: His corruption weighs too heavily on the scales of fate. MOLOM GITH-ULLAH.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 他的腐败在命运的天平上占据了太重的重量。MOLOM GITH-ULLAH。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: He promises a universe of stone and dust. You must not submit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 他许诺的是一个由石头和尘埃构成的宇宙。你绝不能屈服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I am no longer, but a single drop of Kuva allows a sliver of what was consciousness to inhabit the Cryobell. Through its tone I will guide you against His influence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我已不复存在，但一滴赤毒仍能让昔日意识的一缕残片寄居于冰珠铃之中。我将借它的铃音，引导你们抵抗他的影响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Listen! Each bell leads to a place where His hold grows strong. I call on you, break His grip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 听！每一声铃音都会指引你们前往被他掌控日渐加深的地方。我呼唤你们，去挣脱他的束缚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Your foes welcome his corruption. They must be defeated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 你的敌人乐于受到他的腐化。必须击败他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I have brought you here for one purpose. Though they do not know it, your enemy serves His will. Break them, for the good of us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我将你们带到这里只有一个目的。你们的敌人虽然不清楚这点，却在奉行他的意志。击溃他们，为了我们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: His power corrupts those of weak mind and vulnerable ego. The forces you are about to face will fall under his influence should you not defeat them now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 他的力量会腐化那些意志薄弱、心性脆弱的人。若是不能现在击败你即将面对的敌人，他们最终也会落到他的掌控之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I am Nuri, a Zikhaio. This means 'ice-speaker' in His tongue. My message to you; stop him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我是努里，一名齐凯奥人。在他的语言中，这个名字的意思是"冰语者"。我要传达给你们的信息只有一句：阻止他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I speak to you and say you are pure of heart, child. I speak to Him and say, RE-UN KA-UUGRUN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我对你说，孩子，你心地纯洁。我对他说，RE-UN KA-UUGRUN。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: We are the architects of our own fate. We will never allow your stone walls to be our crypt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我们是自己命运的缔造者。我们绝不会让你们的石墙成为我们的坟墓。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: As a girl my father sent me away for a new life in a new land. I found myself in the depths of a maelstrom and with my father's voice demanding I submit to oblivion. Even then I knew it was not my father, it was Him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我还是个小女孩时，父亲将我送往异乡去开启一段新的生活。可我却发现自己坠入了漩涡深处，耳边响起父亲的声音，逼我向虚无屈服。即便那时我知道，那并不是我的父亲，而是他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Friend, we have both touched Him and lived. That is why I have sought you out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 朋友，我们都曾与他相遇并活了下来。这就是我来寻找你的原因。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: She calls it entropic Kuva, we call it the bile of The Void. We must never let it spill onto the mortal plane.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 她称其为熵之赤毒，而我们称它为虚空胆汁。绝不能让它流入凡世。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: We met briefly in our youth. Now I am but an echo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我们年少时曾有过短暂的相遇。如今我只不过是一缕回响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Mel Cantor, celebrated theorist, teacher, devoted servant of her Orokin masters. I remember you, not for your titles, but what you did for a frightened child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 梅尔·坎托，著名的理论学者、教师，也是她那些奥罗金主人忠心耿耿的仆从。我记得你，并非因为这些头衔，而是因为你曾为一个惊惶无助的孩子所做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Narin is my daughter. Narin is my mother. Narin is my messenger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: Narin 是我的女儿。Narin 是我的母亲。Narin 是我的信使。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: We must halt His transgressions. We reject His corruption. We will freeze him out of our realm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我们必须制止他的罪行。我们拒绝他的腐化。我们要将他彻底驱逐出我们的世界。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I have heard my own voice beckon me to his path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我听到自己的声音在召唤我走向他的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Your teacher is wiser than she is permitted to appear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 你的老师比她表面上表现出来的要睿智得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Though I have ceased my voice echoes on through the Cryobells.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 虽然我已不复存在，我的声音仍会透过冰珠铃久久回响。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: I have seen this moment as the turning point. Do not let the cascade begin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我曾见过这一刻，它将成为一切的转折点。绝不能让这场连锁崩塌开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: My people warned the Orokin about the Void. We begged them not to proceed. Their greed begat His corruption.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我的族人曾警告过奥罗金人，不要染指虚空。我们苦苦恳求他们不要继续下去，可他们的贪婪最终催生了他的腐化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: The entity from beyond our realm yearns for our collapse. He seeds it. He nurtures it. This moment is a nexus of his desire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 那来自我们世界之外的存在，渴望看到我们崩塌。他播下毁灭的种子。又亲手将其滋养。而这一刻正是他欲望汇聚的节点。
