/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Narin's crest freezes His river of decay. Her ice will not break.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: Narin 的冰冠冻结了他那腐朽的河流。她的冰不会破碎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: The Orokin in their arrogance pierced the Void and ushered Him into our plane. We do not belong there and He does not belong here. We will freeze him out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 奥罗金人狂妄自大，刺穿了虚空，也将他引入了我们的世界。我们不属于那里，他也不属于这里。我们会将他彻底逐出此地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: There is no math, no equation or formula that predicts Him. That is why the Orokin failed. Their Archimedeans could not fathom what they could not quantify.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 没有任何数学、等式或公式能够预测他。这就是奥罗金人失败的原因。他们的哲士无法理解那些无法量化的事物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Typical Orokin Archimedea, acknowledging only the science of the instrument, and not the science of the heart. Listen to these tones, friend, what do you hear?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 典型的奥罗金式科研，只认可仪器背后的科学，却不认可心灵的科学。朋友，听听这些音调，你听到了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text:
[0.0]

[2.3]
Do you see what formed here?
[8.8]
The Tethyan people of Saturn use these to develop tolerance to cold to survive their climate,
[13.5]
but I think there's more to it. A Ceremony of some kind.
[17.2]
I think Narin might have something to do with this.
[24.1]
It contains a structure of perfectly crystalline ice, with a ring just as pure.
[30.3]
Will the ice affect us? Ring the bell, and see what happens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText:
[0.0]

[2.3]
你看到这里形成了什么吗？
[8.8]
土星的特提斯人利用这些东西来逐渐适应严寒，以便在当地的气候中生存。
[13.5]
但我觉得事情没这么简单。这似乎是某种仪式。
[17.2]
我怀疑 Narin 可能也与这有关。
[24.1]
这里有一块完美结晶的寒冰，还有一圈同样纯净的冰环。
[30.3]
这些冰会对我们产生影响吗？敲响铃铛，看看会发生什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text:
[0.0]

[5.2]
Fascinating. That inscription almost looks like a map?
[9.1]
But to where or… when?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText:
[0.0]

[5.2]
有趣。那些铭文看起来几乎像是一幅地图？
[9.1]
可它指向的究竟是哪里，或是……什么时期？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text:
[0.0]

[4.6]
A Cryobell! What an interesting artifact.
[12.4]
These were part of a clever ritual meant to acclimate the Tethyan people to the extreme cold of their home moon.
[19.4]
Yet, a student of mine once insisted the bells were the voice of an ancestor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.6]
是个冰珠铃！真是件有趣的神器。
[12.4]
这些冰珠铃曾被用于一种颇为巧妙的仪式，帮助特提斯人逐渐适应母星的严寒。
[19.4]
不过，我曾有一名学生坚持认为，这些铃音其实是某位祖先的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Science needs to study how these form here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 科学界应该研究这些物质是如何在这里形成的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text:
[0.0]

[3.0]
Pay close attention, students.
[9.5]
The crystalline structure of these ice bells is not unlike the glass crystals of a Cephalon.
[12.9]
Is that a coincidence?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText:
[0.0]

[3.0]
同学们，仔细看。
[9.5]
这些冰铃的晶体结构，与中枢的玻璃晶体颇为相似。
[12.9]
这只是巧合吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text:
[0.0]

[6.5]
Scans indicate that the nucleus of every ice bell is a tiny drop of Kuva.
[8.9]
Is that why they form here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText:
[0.0]

[6.5]
扫描结果显示，每一颗冰珠铃的核心都是一小滴赤毒。
[8.9]
难道这就是它们在这里形成的原因吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Did Narin leave these here? Or maybe my former student?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 是 Narin 留下了这些吗？还是我以前的学生留下的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Oh, time for an experiment. What happens if you ring that bell?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 哦，正好可以做个实验。敲响那颗冰铃，看看会发生什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Okay students, time for a cultural exercise. Who brought their Ice Bell today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 好了同学们，现在是文化体验时间。今天谁带了冰珠铃？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Remember students, when the chime of the Cryobell rings, a new destination it brings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 同学们，请记住：当冰珠铃响起时，新的去向便会显现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text:
[0.0]

[4.3]
These ceremonies always began with the ringing bell…
[7.5]
When you are ready, ring the bell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.3]
这些仪式总是以铃音开启……
[7.5]
当你准备好时，就敲响冰珠铃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Shall we begin?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 我们开始吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Students, this is a group exercise. Make sure you have your friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 同学们，这是一项小组练习。请确保你的朋友全都在场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.text: Ready? Don't forget to communicate with your group members.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DCryo.zhText: 准备好了吗？别忘了和你的组员沟通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: If you come across any Entropic Kuva, I'll be happy to contain it for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 如果你遇到任何熵之赤毒，我很乐意帮你保存。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: Entropy?!? That is not tolerated in my classroom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 熵？！？这在我的课堂上是绝对不允许出现的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text:
[0.0]

[7.1]
While not an Archimedean, theorist Mel Cantor was a celebrated lecturer on the topic of Kuva.
[12.6]
She was also a distinguished Zariman crew member… Now why did I blurt that out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText:
[0.0]

[7.1]
虽然不是哲士，但理论学者梅尔·坎托却是赤毒领域著名的讲师。
[12.6]
她也曾是扎里曼号的杰出船员……我怎么突然说了这些？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: Entropy is the tendency of ordered systems to fall into disorder over time. Much like a group of students left unattended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 熵是指有序系统随时间推移而趋于无序的趋势。就像一群没人看管的学生一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: If Kuva is the life blood of the Void, it appears that Entropic Kuva is its immune system. Where Kuva creates, Entropic Kuva destroys.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 如果赤毒是虚空的生命之源，那么熵之赤毒似乎就是它的免疫系统。赤毒创造，熵之赤毒负责毁灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: While there are many diverse theories, Archimedea still does not understand where Entropic Kuva originates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 尽管存在许多不同的理论，但科研仍然不明白熵之赤毒从何而来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text:
[0.0]

[8.2]
Entropic Kuva is a dangerous substance that threatens the Zariman and any other place it should flow from.
[13.9]
While some will try to claim it's the lifeforce of a vast and unknowable spirit,
[20.9]
I am here to tell you that everything is knowable when we shine the light of Archimedea upon it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText:
[0.0]

[8.2]
熵之赤毒是一种危险物质，它威胁着扎里曼以及任何它所流经的其他地方。
[13.9]
虽然有些人会声称它是某种浩瀚而不可知之灵的生命力，
[20.9]
但我在此要告诉大家，科研之光照耀下，万物皆可被认知。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: Students. Eyes on me. Who can tell me how to capture Entropic Kuva? Anyone? Anyone? No? Entropic Kuva can only be contained by freezing it to absolute zero!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 同学们。看着我。谁能告诉我该怎么捕获熵之赤毒？谁知道？有人吗？没人知道吗？熵之赤毒只能通过被冷冻到绝对零度才能将其封存！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text:
[0.0]

[7.3]
The Tethyan people of Saturn believe that chaotic spirits possessed people and turned them to evil.

[0.0]

[7.3]
土星的特提斯人相信混沌之灵会附身于人，使他们堕入邪恶。

特提斯人说她是冰语者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: Students form an orderly line!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: Who knows, had you and your families not been chosen for the Zariman, you might have been called upon to fulfill an even higher purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 谁知道呢，如果你们和你们的家人没有被选中进入扎里曼，说不定也会被召唤去完成一项更崇高的使命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: Students, I need a volunteer to free Narin's Iceblade! Who can help me?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 我们完全可以在扎里曼上使用 Narin 的冰刃。我相信你们当中一定有人既有力量又有智慧，能把它拔出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.text: Who will be the first to free the Iceblade of Narin?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBAm.zhText: 谁想第一个解封 Narin 的冰刃？

I couldn't fight the sleep much longer, and that's when I heard her...

警报大作。我们拔腿就跑。
[38.1]
我们打开舱门，本以为会遇到护卫，但所有负责人这时都正忙于应对新的危机。
[49.2]
我们找到了穿梭机，我把她安全地安置进了一艘登陆艇。在指挥控制台上，我输入了自己的安全权限，并为她设定了飞往 Tethys 的航线。 
[60.5]
她在那里会安全吗？我不知道。不过如果如果我把中枢交给涂沃，说不定他就会把她忘得一干二净。
[66.1]
我坐在地上，等待安保的到来。
[74.2]
我在扎里曼号上赢得了这一席之地，现在，它将永远属于我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text:
Students. Attention please. Entropic Kuva is seeping into the Zariman. Some of our unauthorized visitors have been gripped by it, making them more hostile than usual. Which brings me to our class project, we must confiscate this Entropic Kuva at once, but how?

Students, we're going on a field trip. Meet me on Earth, at Yuvan Peak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText:
同学们，请注意。熵之赤毒正在渗入扎里曼。我们一些未经授权的访客已被它控制，导致他们比平时更加具有攻击性。这也引出了我们的班级项目，我们必须立即没收这种熵之赤毒，但该如何做呢？

同学们，我们要去实地考察。在地球的青春峰顶与我汇合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Do you have anything to turn in today?
Let's see what you have to show for all your hard work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 让我们看看你辛勤努力的成果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: If we all do our part, we can keep the Zariman in tip-top shape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 如果我们每个人都尽自己的一份力，就能让扎里曼保持最佳状态。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Entropic Kuva is no plaything. Those who have embraced it are a danger to all of us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 熵之赤毒绝非儿戏。那些接受它的人对我们所有人来说都是威胁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Did you know our Reliquary Drive is leaking Entropic Kuva? A Zarium Accolade to whomever can tell me why that's very bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 你知道我们的圣物装置正在泄露熵之赤毒吗？谁能告诉我这为什么非常糟糕，谁就能获得一枚耀金奖章。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: I remember when Eximus were friend and not foe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 我记得以前卓越者还是朋友而不是敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text:
[0.0]

[4.7]
You are not going to believe this. Narin came to visit,
[8.9]
I gather that she was related to a former student of mine.
[17.7]
How beautiful she was, dancing in her frozen robes. She got herself into some very unpleasant trouble back then.
[23.2]
Not every student is an angel but they all deserve our love.
[32.5]
Actually… Was she even my student? Or is she… And… That was before I…
[39.9]
What we saw-Precepts! It's not polite to talk about such things.
[42.3]
Do you have any Entropic Kuva for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.7]
你绝对不会相信这件事。Narin 来拜访我了，
[8.9]
我听说她和我以前的一个学生有亲戚关系。
[17.7]
她穿着冰霜长袍翩然起舞，真是太美了。那时，她给自己惹上了一堆非常棘手的麻烦。
[23.2]
虽然不是每个学生都是天使，但每个人都值得我们去关爱。
[32.5]
其实……曾经她真的是我的学生吗？还是说她……还有……那是在我……之前的事了。
[39.9]
我们刚刚看到的那一幕——枢律！谈论这种事是不礼貌的。
[42.3]
你有熵之赤毒给我吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text:
[0.0]

[8.6]
Hello Students, by the miracle of portable Cephalon projection, I am able to join you here on Yuvan Peak.
[14.3]
We're here to experience the beauty and the power of Narin's Crest.
[18.0]
I'm talking about that ice formation over there.
[23.3]
Do you see what's in the center of it? That's Narin's Iceblade.
[28.2]
But I'm afraid not one student has been able to pull it from the ice...
[30.3]
...maybe you can figure out a way?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText:
[0.0]

[8.6]
同学们好，多亏了便携式中枢投影的神奇力量，我才能来到青春峰顶与大家相聚。
[14.3]
我们来到这里是为了亲身体验 Narin 冰冠的美丽与力量。
[18.0]
我说的就是那边的冰峰。
[23.3]
你们看到它正中央有什么吗？那就是 Narin 的冰刃。
[28.2]
但我恐怕至今还没有一位学生能把它从冰中拔出来……
[30.3]
……也许你们能找到办法？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Hello Students, isn't portable Cephalon projection wonderful. Do you see Narin's Crest? It is as beautiful as the view from up here. In fact Narin's Crest is the reason for our visit. You see, a blessing from the Iceblade of Narin will help you contain those nasty unwanted visitors and their Entropic Kuva.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 同学们好，便携式中枢投影是不是很棒？你们看到 Narin 的冰冠了吗？它和从这里俯瞰的景色一样美丽。事实上，Narin 的冰冠正是我们此行的目的。要知道，Narin 冰刃的祝福可以帮助你们控制那些讨厌的不速之客还有他们的熵之赤毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Narin came to visit the Zariman, she beckoned me to come to this mountain, but I told her that Cephalons cannot travel. So instead, she brought this handy holo-projector. Now, where is she?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: Narin 来拜访扎里曼，她招手让我到这座山，但我告诉她中枢无法出行。于是，她带来了这个方便的全息投影仪。现在，她在哪里呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Bonus marks to the first student who writes me a descriptive essay on how it feels to breathe this fresh mountain air. I would really like to know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 第一个写一篇描写呼吸这清新山间空气感受的文章的学生将获得额外加分。我真的很想知道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Has this trip been educational? Have you experienced Narin's Iceblade?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 这次旅行有收获吗？你体验过 Narin 的冰刃了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Narin was supposed to meet us here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: Narin 原本应该在这里和我们会合。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Oh my, could it be? Is that Narin herself? Children, gather round we have a special guest today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 天哪，难道是她？Narin 本人？孩子们，快过来，今天我们有位特别的客人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Well, look who it is, Narin! What a strong Warframe you've turned out to be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: 哇，看看是谁来了，Narin！你已经成长为如此强大的战甲了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.text: Narin! The students are going to be so excited to see you! You weren't followed, were you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBIn.zhText: Narin！学生们见到你一定会非常兴奋！你没被跟踪吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.text: It's okay. We all go at our own pace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.zhText: 没关系。大家都有自己的节奏。
我会一直在这里。直到……永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.text: I will make sure this Entropic Kuva is stored away safely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.zhText: 我会确保妥善保管这些熵之赤毒的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.text: With your tireless effort, there's hope for order after all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.zhText: 凭借你孜孜不倦的努力，秩序终究还是有希望恢复的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.text: Our Golden Lords would be proud of you, student.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.zhText: 我们的黄金之主会为你感到骄傲的，同学。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.text: We'll have this place cleaned up in no time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBOu.zhText: 我们很快就能把这里打扫干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 大家都准备好了吗？我们走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: All aboard? Your parents will be waiting to pick you up in the Chrysalith.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 都上来了吗？你们的父母会在羽化之穹等着接你们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: Time to go. Has anyone seen Jenva?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 该走了。有人看到珍瓦了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: Back to the Zariman. Does everyone have a buddy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 返回扎里曼。大家都有搭档了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: Who wants to apply what they've learned?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 谁想把所学知识付诸实践？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: Students, does everyone know who their buddy is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 同学们，大家都知道自己的搭档是谁了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: Does everyone have their buddy? Okay. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 大家都有搭档了吗？很好。出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: The day is finally here. We are going to Yuvan Peak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 这一天终于到了。我们要去青春峰顶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: Children, did you remember to pack warm clothes? Time for our mountain top field trip. My former student Nuri has something to show us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 孩子们，你们记得带保暖的衣服了吗？是时候去山顶进行实地考察了。我的前学生努里有东西要给我们展示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.text: Pack your lunches and we're visiting the mountains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBTr.zhText: 带上午餐，我们要上山了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: Remember to keep things neat and tidy.
Don't forget to bring me more Entropic Kuva tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 别忘了明天再给我带些熵之赤毒过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: If you see Narin, give her my best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 如果你见到 Narin，请代我向她问好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: Well… If you really want to know what I think. They don't care what happens to us. They just want to get to-Precepts! Sometimes I forget to use my teacher's voice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 嗯……如果你真的想知道我的想法的话。他们根本不在乎我们会怎么样。他们只是想——枢律！有时候我会忘记用老师的语气说话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: When humans pass through time, entropy erodes their organic systems causing them to age and die. Cephalon Glass is highly resistant to entropic decay. Who knows how long I'll live?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 当人类穿越时光时，熵会侵蚀他们的有机系统，导致衰老和死亡。中枢玻璃对熵具有极强的抵抗力。谁知道我还能活多久呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: Did I ever tell you about the time we had a stowaway on the Zariman? Turns out it was just a- KALOHV MARA. What was I saying?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 我有没有跟你说过我们在扎里曼上偷渡的那件事？结果发现那只是个——KALOHV MARA。我刚才说到哪儿了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: Entropy is the enemy of tidiness, and our long-term existence in this universe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 熵是整洁的敌人，也是我们在这宇宙中长期存在的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text:
[0.0]

[6.2]
My precepts dictate that I maintain an exemplary professional tone at all times.
[17.9]
But just between you and me? Whoever defined those precepts left just enough of a gap that my carefree side gets to speak its mind from time to time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText:
[0.0]

[6.2]
我的枢律要求我时刻保持得体的专业态度。
[17.9]
不过你我之间悄悄告诉你，制定这些枢律的人故意留了一点余地，让我偶尔也可以流露出随意洒脱的一面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: A build up of Entropic Kuva could be disastrous for any Reliquary Drive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 熵之赤毒的堆积可能会对任何圣物装置造成灾难性后果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: It is tough to decide when there are so many choices.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 选择太多，确实很难做决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: Do remember to tell your parents they forgot to show up for parent teacher night, again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 记得告诉你的父母，他们又忘了参加家长会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: Don't tell anyone I said this, but if the Orokin had listened to the Zikhaio of Tethys instead of persecuting them, I think we would be in a-Precepts! Did you need anything else?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 别告诉别人是我说的，但如果奥罗金人当初听从了 Tethys 的齐凯奥人的建议，而不是迫害他们，我想我们现在应该——枢律！你你还需要什么吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.text: The literature says that shared trauma creates bonds that last a lifetime. Cephalons can theoretically live forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Iceblade/DIBVe.zhText: 文献指出，共同经历的创伤会产生终生的羁绊。从理论上讲，中枢可以永生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.text: If you came here to use Albrecht's Crucibles, the only thing you'll create is a corpse. Yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.zhText: 如果你来这里是为了使用阿尔布雷希特的坩埚，那么你唯一能制造出来的只会是具尸体。你的尸体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.text: Albrecht's Crucibles. Crimes against the laws of nature. Do not think for a second that I will let you desecrate my kingdom with your element mixing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特的坩埚。那是违反自然法则的罪行。休想用那些乱七八糟的元素亵渎我的王国。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.text: The Crucibles. One of Albrecht's many sins. Try and finish his work. See what happens to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.zhText: 转换坩埚。阿尔布雷希特众多罪孽之一。试下完成他的工作。看你会有什么下场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.text: You only pollute this kingdom with these… elements.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.zhText: 你们只会用这些……元素污染这个王国。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.text: You've made a mess of those elements. A shameful mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.zhText: 你把这些元素弄得一团糟。真是太丢脸了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAl.text: Enough of this play-time. Get out.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAr.text: I believe this Void flotsam is a weapon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAr.zhText: 我相信这个虚空漂流物是件武器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAr.text: Take this barbaric device and put it to use!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DAr.zhText: 拿这个野蛮的装置，把它派上用场！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.text: She's taunting me. Just like Sythel said. Raising old ghosts out of the earth. Go down there and stop them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.zhText: 她在挑衅我。就像袭幽说的一样。她把古老的亡魂从地里唤出来了。下去阻止他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.text: I'm not afraid. Really, I'm not. I just need those shades banished. That's all. I'll be right as rain after that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.zhText: 我不怕。真的不怕。我只需要把那些界影赶走。只要这样。我就没事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.text: Why do you think Thrax is so scared to be abandoned?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.zhText: 你猜士魂大帝为什么这么害怕被抛弃？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.text: Nobody, not artists nor dreamers nor prophets, has an imagination to compare with that of a terrified child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.zhText: 无论是艺术家、梦想家还是先知，没有谁的想象力能与一个受惊的孩子相提并论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.text: I know you're sore about what happened to you, but look how creative you got!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.zhText: 我知道你对发生在你身上的事感到痛苦，但看看你变得多有创意啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.text: The real shadows are inside his head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCa.zhText: 真正的阴影在他的脑海里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.text: The Scholar's research is the key to casting her out! We need it all. Voidtongue tablets, lost Requiems, anything!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.zhText: 学者的研究成果是驱逐她的关键！这些东西我们都需要。虚空语石板、失落的安魂浮印，什么都行！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.text: Thrax hid the Scholar's books safely away until our time of need. You need to bring them to light!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.zhText: 士魂大帝把学者的书藏在了安全的地方，只为等到我们需要的时候。你得让它们重见天日！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.text: Don't expect too much from the Scholar's writings. Most of it is just tortured love poetry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.zhText: 别对这位学者的著作抱太大期望。大多只是痛苦的情诗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.text: Remorse, remorse, remorse. That's all you'll find in those sainted pages.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.zhText: 悔恨，悔恨，悔恨。在这些被奉为神圣的书页里，你只会找到这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.text: Thrax hid those books away out of fear, Mathila. I wouldn't mess with them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.zhText: 士魂大帝是因为害怕才把那些书藏起来了，玛蒂拉。换做我，是不会去碰它们的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.text: Taking refuge in books? After what happened last time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DCo.zhText: 在书中寻求庇护？在上次的事发生之后？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEl.text: You are really starting to bother me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEl.zhText: 你真的开始让我感到烦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEl.text: You are playing with things you don't understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEl.zhText: 你这是在玩弄你根本不了解的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEv.text:
Drifter, the menace of Neci Rusalka is now contained. The tale she attempted to weave is forever sundered from the canon. She shall fester in an apocryphal Spiral all of her own. 

We are satisfied.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, Dominus Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEv.zhText:
漂泊者，内奇·鲁莎卡的威胁如今已被遏制。她试图编织的故事将永远与正典隔绝。她将在她自己伪造的复眠螺旋中溃烂。 

我们很满意。

荣耀而永恒的陛下，
士魂大帝

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEv.text:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias 'Drifter': Duviri is in grave peril.

While you were off on your frivolous ventures the Lost Island of Scholar's Landing returned, bringing with it that menace of the Void of which the Scholar spoke.

That she-demon has usurped Our Throne. She must be stopped.

I await you on board the Zariman for a most urgent conference.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, Dominus Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEv.zhText:
致化名为"漂泊者"的昔日叛徒和阴谋家：双衍王境处境危急。

在你进行那些无聊的冒险时，失落的儒临地卷土重来，带来了学者提到过的虚空威胁。

那个女恶魔篡夺了我们的王位。必须阻止她。

我在扎里曼号上等你来参加一场紧急会议。

荣耀而永恒的陛下，士魂大帝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: Valiant. Honorable. And, an utter waste of energy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 英勇。荣誉。不过是在浪费精力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: I have all the time in the universe. You know that better than anyone, don't you, kiddo?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 我拥有宇宙中所有的时间。你比谁都清楚这一点，不是吗，小鬼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: If you're wasting your time here, who's protecting those freaks back in Höllvania?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 你在这里浪费时间？霍瓦尼亚那边谁来保护那些怪胎？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: Why are you fighting, Kiddo? This place was your prison. We can dismantle its pieces together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 你为什么要反抗，小鬼？这里曾经是你的牢笼。我们可以一起把它拆掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: Sure, kiddo. Fight back, we can do this, spiral after spiral, after spiral.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 当然，小鬼。反击吧，我奉陪，一个螺旋接一个螺旋，一个螺旋接一个螺旋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: Sure, waste your time down here in the Undercroft. I'll have my fun up in Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 好吧，你就继续在地穴里浪费时间吧。我会在双衍王境尽情享受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: Kiddo, is this where all your secrets are buried? Well, well, you do have a messy mind. My forces will sort it out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 小鬼，你把所有的秘密都埋在这里了吗？好吧，好吧，你的脑子确实很乱。我的部队会帮你梳理的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: This isn't your Undercroft anymore, Kiddo. These creatures are no Scaldra, but they'll crush you still.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 这已经不是你的地穴了，小鬼。这些生物不是炽蛇军，但它们依然能碾死你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.text: The Void longs for stillness, emptiness. But first, things must be made still.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DEx.zhText: 虚空渴望寂静，渴望空无。但首先，要先让万物静止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DFi.text: The entity the Scholar warned of. The wall's other face. It's here! It broke into Mathila's spiral. It sits on my throne and mocks me! We have to stop her, Drifter. Fighting together, side by side, like the old days. For our people. I shall await you in person in the hermit's hovel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DFi.zhText: 学者发出示警的那个存在。墙的另一张脸。它就在这里！它闯入了玛蒂拉的复眠螺旋。它坐在我的王座上，嘲讽着我！我们必须阻止她，漂泊者。像往日一样，并肩作战。为了我们的人民。我会亲自在隐士洞穴里等你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DFi.text: You are a cohort of the sometime traitor who styles themself 'the Drifter', are you not? Bid them return to Duviri with all speed. There is a usurper upon the King's throne.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DFi.zhText: 你是那个自称"漂泊者"叛徒的同伙，对吧？命令他尽快返回双衍王境。国王的王位被篡夺了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.text: She slaughters my people and takes their possessions! Get them back, Drifter. I'll bury them alongside the honored dead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.zhText: 她屠杀我的人民，还夺走了他们的财产！把它们夺回来，漂泊者。我要把它们埋在那些英勇的逝者身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.text: She has no right to my people's goods. Return them, so the survivors can benefit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.zhText: 她无权占有我子民的财物。把它们拿回来，至少还能帮到幸存者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.text: Aren't you sick of these games by now, kiddo?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.zhText: 你现在还没玩腻这些游戏吗，小鬼？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.text: You grew up long ago. Thrax never will. Leave him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.zhText: 你早就长大了。而士魂大帝永远都不会长大。离开他吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.text: He's an entertaining little imp. I could keep him around as my jester.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.zhText: 他真是个有趣的小淘气。我可以把他留在身边当个小丑取乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.text: I'm in charge now, Thrax. You're done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DGu.zhText: 现在掌权的是我，士魂大帝。你已经完了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: The Murmur are lurking everywhere. Waiting to ambush me. I don't like the look of that chest!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 低语者到处潜伏，就等着伏击我。那个箱子的样子，我不喜欢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: She's hidden her servants all over my kingdom. She thinks I'm stupid enough to open that chest. Ha! You do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 她把她的爪牙藏在我王国的每个角落。她以为我会蠢到打开那个箱子。哈！你去打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: Some doors really should stay closed.
I remember when I first opened the door on to that smiling face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 我还记得当我第一次打开门时看到的那张笑脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: Whoever told you there had to be a happy ending?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 是谁告诉你结局一定要美满的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: Some stories end with the king's head bouncing down the throne room steps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 有些故事就是以国王的头从王座厅的台阶上滚下来而结束的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: The Scholar knew this day was coming. He prepared for it. Hid things. Find them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 学者早就知道这一天会来。他已经做好了准备。把东西藏了起来。把它们找出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: There were people here. She… unmade them. You have to find what they left!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 这里曾经是有人的。她……把他们抹去了。你必须找到他们留下的东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: You never could let the past go, could you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 你永远都不能放下过去，是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: You can be ripped out and burned up as easily as a storybook page.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 你可以像故事书的书页一样，轻易地被撕下来烧掉。
别哭，玛蒂拉。没有人会听。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.text: Didn't you have children once, Mathila? Did you forget about them too?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DHi.zhText: 你以前不是有过孩子吗，玛蒂拉？你连他们也忘了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DIn.text: Remember what the Scholar told us. The Fragmented Ones tether down the Strands of Khra that weave her false Duviri. Get to the heart of her power, call forth the beast, then kill it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DIn.zhText: 记住学者告诉我们的话。接肢至尊束缚着编织她虚假双衍王境的时间丝线。深入她力量的核心，召唤野兽，然后杀死它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.text: Remnants of the King's power remain, locked away in the Royal Mazes where she cannot reach. Find them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.zhText: 国王的残余力量仍然存在，被封存在她无法触及的皇家迷宫中。去寻找它们吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.text: We have to delve deep, beyond the madness. Unlock the reserves the Scholar instructed us to keep!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.zhText: 我们必须深入挖掘，越过疯狂。解锁学者曾指示我们守护的力量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.text: Grovelling in the dust for lost morsels?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.zhText: 为了丢失的碎片在尘土中卑躬屈膝？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.text: Human hands achieve what figments cannot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.zhText: 虚构世界无法实现的事情，人类的双手可以实现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.text: Don't tell Mathila it was the crack in her mind that let me in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMa.zhText: 别告诉玛蒂拉，正是她精神上的裂缝让我进来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.text: This isn't enough. We need to call in more help. From you. Another you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.zhText: 这还不够。我们需要呼叫更多支援。从你那里。另一个你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.text: There are two creatures that look very much like you out there. Find the wholesome one and keep the other at bay!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.zhText: 有两个和你长得一模一样的生物。找到好的那一个，并阻止另一个接近！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.text: Children are feral. Savage. They just need the right encouragement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.zhText: 小孩子都很野蛮，很残忍。他们只需要适当的鼓励。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.text: Don't be jealous of Neci, kiddo. I'll still wear your face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.zhText: 别嫉妒内奇，小鬼。我还是会戴着你的脸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.text: Only two of you. Pity about all the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.zhText: 就剩你们两个。其他人真是太可惜了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.text: Ask Mathila where her children went.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DMi.zhText: 问问玛蒂拉她的孩子们都去了哪里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.text: Once there was a beautiful garden where cruel children played. Nobody ever had to grow up. And then, one day, a magical stranger came to teach them a new and fabulous game.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.zhText: 从前，有一座美丽的花园，有一群残忍的孩子在那里玩耍。孩子们永远无需长大。直到有一天，一位会魔法的陌生人到来，教会了他们一个全新而奇妙的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.text: They ousted me from my city, so I found myself a kingdom to rule. Mother would be proud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.zhText: 他们把我赶出了城市，而我建立了属于自己的王国。母亲一定会为我感到骄傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.text: Oh, kiddo. How long have you been hiding out here thinking I couldn't see you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.zhText: 哦，小鬼。你在这儿躲了有多久，以为我看不见你吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.text: This is where he ran to first. His old workshop! Too bad I have the keys, kiddo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DNa.zhText: 他一开始就逃到这儿了。还是他以前的工作室！可惜钥匙在我这，小鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 我自有办法利用那些毁约者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: My herald looked like you, once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 我的使者曾经和你很像。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: How will I reassemble your pieces?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 我要如何重新组装你的肢体？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: She is vulnerable! Get to the heart of the corruption!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 她现在很脆弱！快深入腐化的核心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: Her grip weakens at last. Call forth the beast that binds her to Duviri.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 她的手终于松动了。召唤出那只把她束缚在双衍王境的野兽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: And back into the realm of untold stories she goes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 她又回到了那个不为人知的故事世界！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: She's banished, for now. But she'll climb back up the waterspout again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 她现在是被驱逐了。但她还会再次沿着水管爬上来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: Her thread is cut! You may safely resume your throne, your Majesty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 她的控制切断了！陛下，您可以安心回到您的王位了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: Too late, kiddo. This is how the story goes now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 太迟了，小鬼。现在故事只能按我说的发展了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: They're all real. All the bad old memories. Here's one now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 它们都是真实的。所有那些不好的旧回忆全都是真的。这就是其中一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.text: This place is mine. It only exists because of me! That means I get to keep it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOc.zhText: 这地方是我的。它的存在，全是因为我！也就是说，我才能拥有它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.text: The wise Paragrimms were the Scholar's friends. Look through their eyes to find the eyes of the beast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.zhText: 智慧幽幽鹰是学者的朋友。透过它们的眼睛，可以找到野兽的眼睛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.text: Approach the Paragrimm. Do not fear the wide eyes or the gaping beak. They will help you see her eyes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.zhText: 靠近幽幽鹰。不要害怕它睁大的眼睛和张开的喙。它们会帮你看清她的眼睛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.text: You and Albrecht were pretty close in his Duviri days, weren't you, kiddo? Don't say you've forgotten.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特在双衍王境时，你和他挺熟的，对吧，小鬼？可别说你已经忘了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.text: Taking my eyes now, kiddo? Wasn't Margulis enough?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.zhText: 现在就要把我的眼睛夺走吗，小鬼？Margulis 的还不够吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.text: You're wasting time. Duviri is more mine by the minute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.zhText: 你在浪费时间。双衍王境正一点一点属于我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.text: Tired of your human body? Want me to reshape it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DOw.zhText: 厌倦了你的人类躯壳？想让我重塑它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: Don't tell me you're siding with the brat? It's about time to grow up, don't you think?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 别告诉我你站在那小子那边？你也该长大了，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: The King isn't a real boy. He's just a doll. Shall I pull his arms and legs off for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 国王并不是真正的男孩，他不过是个玩偶罢了。要不我帮你把他的胳膊和腿扯下来？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: Poor little Thrax. The monster from Albrecht's stories finally came for him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 可怜的小士魂。阿尔布雷希特故事里的怪物，终于来找他了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: You ran all the way back to my poisoned garden. Now you're chasing me here? What is it you need?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 你一路逃回了我那座被毒害的花园。现在还追我到这里来？你到底想干什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: Do you remember the Zariman? How much you learned once the restraints were taken off? Think what we could do here, together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 你还记得扎里曼号吗？当束缚解除后，你学到了多少？想想看，如果我们联手，能在这里做到什么程度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: Two identical souls raised in such different environments. Haven't you figured it out yet? You're fascinating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 两个相同的灵魂，在截然不同的环境中长大。你还没想明白吗？你真是令人着迷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: Tear away a finger. Hack off a hand. An arm. A face. Keep on taking and see what grins back at you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 扯掉一根手指。砍断一只手。一条胳膊。一张脸。接着来啊，看看对你咧嘴笑的会是谁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: This is where he stowed it away. The secret of my lost flesh. Not lost. Stolen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 这里就是他藏匿的地方。我那失去的血肉的秘密。不，不是失去，而是被偷走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: Look at it, this edifice of guilt. He knew what he did. What he took.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 亲眼看看，这些罪恶的建筑。他知道自己做了什么，夺走了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: I was dying all along, did you know that? Dying from the poison I sucked down to kill the Techrot in my lungs. Until it held out my own severed hand to me… and offered me life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 我一度都快死了，你知道吗。我吞下那毒药，想要杀死肺里的科腐者，却要因此死去。直到它，把我那断手递还给了我……也给了我新生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: I can be your father. Your lover. Your friend. I can give the dead back their voice. All you have to do… is ask.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 我可以做你的父亲。你的爱人。你的朋友。我甚至可以让死者重新发声。你只需要……开口就行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: You want to deny me a place. Even here in the remains of your childhood. Not very nice of you, kiddo.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 你竟然想把我拒之门外。就连这片你童年残留的地方都不让我来。这可不太像话啊，小鬼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: You saw what he did to Arthur. His cold calculations. His bottled disease. And you still trusted him?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 你也看到了他对亚瑟的所作所为。他那冷酷的算计。他那瓶子里的病毒。你居然还会信他？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: Go ahead. Smash them all. I can make more. I can dream. I can shape. I'm better at this than you are!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 继续吧。把它们全部砸碎。我能创造更多。我能想象。我能塑造。而且我比你更擅长！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.text: He doesn't care about you! When you were weeping all alone in the hungry dark, who offered you a light?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPh.zhText: 他根本不在乎你！当你在饥饿的黑暗中独自哭泣时，是谁伸出手给了你光明？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: We need to cut this whole embodiment of Duviri loose. I authorize you to enter the Undercroft.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 我们必须彻底切割这个双衍王境化身。我授权你进入地穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: You have to burn her influence out at the very roots. If that means sending you into the Undercroft, then so be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 你必须彻底根除她的影响力。就算这意味着把你送进地穴，也得这么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Her underbelly is weak. Exposed. To the Undercroft!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 她的弱点暴露无遗。快去地穴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Thank the Void, the Undercroft portals remain open. Use one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 感谢虚空，地穴传送门仍然敞开。用它进入！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Descend into the Undercroft. I permit it. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 下降至地穴。我准允了，不过只是暂时的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Did you hear the angels singing?
You really want me to spit this body out? With how chewed up she is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 你真想让我把这个身体吐出来？即使她已经被嚼成这样了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: All those possibilities, and yet the story only ends one way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 有这么多可能性，但故事却只有一个结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Only a few pages left, kiddo. And the book always has a monster at the end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 就剩最后几页了，小鬼。而每本书的结尾总会有个怪物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: We need every scrap of armament we can find! Get this working, whatever it is!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 我们需要所有能找到的武器！别管是什么，先把它发动起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Look what she's driven me to. Assembling weapons. And me a loving mother! Can you get it done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 看看她都把我逼成什么样子了。我居然在组装武器。我可是个慈爱的妈妈啊！你能来装吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Oh, Mathila. What weapons will you use against the sorrows you refuse to face?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 哦，玛蒂拉。你会用什么武器来对抗你不愿面对的悲伤呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Why not deal with the real source of your problems? Obliterate yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 为什么不处理你问题的真正根源呢？消灭你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: That's right, Mathila. Carve that grin into your face.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 就是这样，玛蒂拉。把那笑容刻在你的脸上吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.text: Nothing can truly be wrong so long as you keep smiling through it all, can it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPo.zhText: 只要你始终保持微笑，就不会真的有什么问题，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: This hovering fortress should be mine. Are the skies over Duviri not part of Duviri?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 这座悬浮要塞就应该是我的。双衍王境的天空难道不也是双衍王境的一部分吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Such a wretched place to be raised in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 在这种地方长大也太可悲了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Automated servants! How cheap. Though… loyal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 全自动仆人！真廉价。不过倒是……忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: This is far enough. I shall manifest no further in. Not without my Centurions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 到这里就够了。我不会再往前一步。除非我的百夫长在场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Think not that I stand alone! My legions would come if I summoned them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 别以为我是孤军奋战！只要我召唤，我的军团就会来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: For years this place has mocked me from above, and now through sheer force of will, I have reached it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 多年来，这个地方一直在俯视嘲笑我，而现在，凭借着坚强的意志力，我终于到达了那里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: I claim this proud steel bastion in the name of Thrax. Perhaps next I'll venture beyond the wall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 我以士魂大帝之名，宣称拥有这座傲然屹立的钢铁堡垒。或许，接下来我将踏上墙之外的冒险之旅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: How Bombastine will envy me for this bold expedition.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 蓬蓬士君一定会羡慕我这次大胆的探险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Contain her here. Seal her twisted story up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 把她关在这里。封住她那扭曲的故事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: The Scholar told us what to do. Shut her up in the Apocrypha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 学者告诉我们该怎么做。把她打入伪典里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: You must sever her hold on Duviri. Thread by thread by thread.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 你必须斩断她对双衍王境的控制。一点一点地斩断。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: If she cannot be banished, she must be contained.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 如果不能驱逐她，那就必须将她关起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: She mocks me. Sends me nightmares. Shows me myself, stripped of my armor, torn to pieces. Screaming endlessly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 她嘲笑我，让我做噩梦，让我看到自己被剥去盔甲，被撕成碎片。让我不断地尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Do not trust the Spider. It serves the Scholar no more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 不要相信蜘蛛。它不再效忠学者了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: She is slaughtering my people! As if they did not matter!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 她正在屠杀我的人民！仿佛他们根本不重要！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Dominus Thrax is king of all Duviri. So it is written and so it must be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 士魂大帝是双衍王境的国王。这是书上所记，也必然如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: If you see the Scholar again, tell him his work was not finished here! Why did he abandon us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 如果你再见到那个学者，就告诉他，他的工作还没完成！他为什么要抛弃我们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Why does she torture Mathila so? There are rules! You stop when it stops being funny!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 她为什么要这么折磨玛蒂拉？规矩就摆在那！不好笑了就该收手！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: It's broken through before. But never like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 以前也出现过破口，但从来没出现过这种情况。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: She doesn't belong here. She's not even in the book.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 她不属于这里，甚至在书里也没有她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: To think Teshin grew old hiding from me here! In this flea-pit!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 突然想起 Teshin 竟然躲在这里变老了！就在这个跳蚤坑里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.text: Duviri is mine. I bow to no false gods or mocking angels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DPr.zhText: 双衍王境是我的。我是不会向任何假神或嘲弄的天使低头的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DQu.text:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias 'Drifter':

That profane monstrosity of which the Scholar spoke has sought to claim our throne. It wears a face and puppets a body that knows you.

We have confined it in the Apocrypha, the realm of Untold Stories, but you now have a duty to keep it there.

If it gains sufficient power, its story will supplant ours!

Seek its heretical tale, 'The Triumph of Dust'. Sever it from the true tales of Duviri.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, Dominus Thrax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DQu.zhText:
致化名为"漂泊者"的昔日叛徒和阴谋家

那位学者所言的亵渎之物正企图夺取我们的王座。它戴着一张假面，操纵着一个了解你的躯体。

我们把它囚禁在伪典，那些不为人知的故事里，但你现在有责任让它留在那里。

如果它获得足够的力量，它的故事将会取代我们的！

寻找它的异端故事，"尘埃的胜利"。把它和双衍王境的真实故事分开。

荣耀而永恒的陛下，士魂大帝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.text: These Murmur. They're nothing but horrid old stone! I'm not afraid of them! SMASH THEM TO BITS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.zhText: 这些低语者。它们不过是些难看的老石头！我才不怕它们！把它们都砸碎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.text: You're the one with the weapons, and the War-suits, not me. So you have to make the Murmur go away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.zhText: 拥有武器和作战服的人是你，不是我。所以你必须让低语者消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.text: Butchering freely like your forebears did, kiddo?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.zhText: 小鬼，像你的祖先那样肆意屠杀是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.text: I send you playmates and you give me back rubble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.zhText: 我送你玩伴，你却还我一堆瓦砾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.text: You and Thrax, friends again. Ending as you began.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.zhText: 你和士魂大帝，又成了朋友。结局又回到了开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.text: How are you going to expel us when we're in every grain of dust?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DRe.zhText: 当我们存在于每一粒尘埃中时，你又将如何驱逐我们？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSe.text: Is there no end to them?
There weren't supposed to be two!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.text: The shrines are symbols of my divine right to rule! How dare that thing pollute them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.zhText: 那些圣坛是我神圣统治权的象征！那玩意儿竟敢玷污它们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.text: Those shrines were here before she came and they will still be here after we cast her back into the Void. Cleanse the Shrine of her influence!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.zhText: 那些圣坛在她来之前就已经存在，即使我们将她驱逐回虚空，它们仍会存在。净化圣坛，清除她的影响！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.text: We punished that kind of idolatry with fire back in Höllvania.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.zhText: 在霍瓦尼亚，我们用火惩罚了这种偶像崇拜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.text: Why does the little King worship one heap of stones, but fear another?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.zhText: 为什么小国王膜拜一堆石头，却害怕另一堆？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.text: You're so close to understanding what you really are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.zhText: 你已经离真正的自我，非常接近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.text: Sticks and stones, kiddo. Sticks and stones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSh.zhText: 小鬼，棍石可伤，笑骂无妨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: Come on, my beautiful scuttler! Secure this kingdom for me, and I will feed you as your old master never did!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 来吧，我美丽的急行蛛！替我拿下这个王国，我会好好喂养你，是你那前主人从未给过的美食！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: Little Thrax remembers Oraxia, doesn't he? The guardian of Scholar's Landing! That's why he's trembling, isn't it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 小士魂大帝还记得 Oraxia，对吗？儒临地的守护者！所以他才颤抖的，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: You owe this place nothing! All it did was torment you, just as he tormented me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 你不欠这地方什么！它只会折磨你，就像他折磨我一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: Albrecht left nothing but dust and darkling spiders in his wake. Isn't it time for a new story?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 阿尔布雷希特身后只留下尘土和黑暗的蜘蛛。是时候开始一段新的故事了吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: The spider's helping her! It's keeping this false Duviri tethered to my kingdom! Cut it down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 这只蜘蛛在帮她！它把这个假的双衍王境牢牢拴在我的王国里！砍掉它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: Oraxia. The Scholar's pet. I heard the Usurper imitating his voice. The spider is her servant now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: Oraxia。学者的宠物。我听到过篡位者模仿他的声音。这只蜘蛛现在是她的爪牙了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: Killing your own kind? Nothing new for you, is it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 屠杀同族？这对你来说不是什么新鲜事，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: Bad luck to kill a spider, kiddo. Especially when I can just bring her back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 杀了一只蜘蛛可不吉利哦，小鬼。尤其是我明明可以把她带回来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: Not very nice, kiddo. Albrecht wanted her to help you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 不厚道啊，小鬼。阿尔布雷希特原本是让她来帮你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.text: You had to put her down. She was crazy. Do Mathila next!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSp.zhText: 你得杀了她。她已经疯了。下一个该轮到玛蒂拉了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: If you breathe it's because I let you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 你之所以能呼吸，是因为我让你呼吸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: You can only tread water for so long.
I am playing the long game.
The paradox can't help you forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 悖论并不能永远帮助你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: I can do this forever. I doubt the same is true for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 我可以一直这样下去。但我怀疑你能不能撑得住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: Back to Duviri with you, kiddo. Find out what I was up to while you were gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 回双衍王境去吧，小鬼。看看你不在的时候我都干了些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: Don't think for a second that you are winning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 千万别以为自己已经赢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: This isn't your home anymore. It's time for you to get out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 这里不再是你的家了。你该离开了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: Have you ever played that game where you see how long you can hold your breath? Let's play it now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 你玩过那种游戏吗，看你能憋气多久的那种？现在就来玩吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.text: I thrive on nothingness. You choke on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DSu.zhText: 我因虚无而成长，你却因虚无而窒息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Duviri raised you. Answer her call.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 双衍王境抚养了你。回应她的召唤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: We shall look favorably upon your loyalty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我们将赞赏你的忠诚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Remember: the hermit's hovel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 记住：隐士洞穴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: We only have days in which to stop her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我们只有几天的时间来阻止她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Do right by our Kingdom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 为我们的王国做正确的事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Remember what the Scholar said. It mocks us because it fears us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 记住学者说过的话。它嘲笑我们，因为它害怕我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Do not wander far. You are needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 别走远。我们都需要你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Remember what the Scholar told us. The Fragmented Ones tether down the Strands of Khra that weave her false Duviri. Get to the heart of her power, call forth the beast, then kill it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 记住学者告诉我们的话。接肢至尊束缚着编织她虚假双衍王境的时间丝线。深入她力量的核心，召唤野兽，然后杀死它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: She can't change the story. It's written. Finished. Done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 她无法改变故事。故事已经写好了，结束了，完结了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: I warned you not to leave! Where was your sword-arm when the usurper came?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我警告过你别走！篡位者来的时候，你那拿剑的手呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: That thing on my throne? Whatever face it wears now, it was here before Duviri. It means to devour me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我王座上那个东西？不管它现在是什么样，它在双衍王境之前就在这里了。它想吞噬我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Mathila will not betray me. She knows what I do to conspirators.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 玛蒂拉不会背叛我。她很清楚叛徒的下场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: I hear angel song. What a cursed cradle you were rocked in.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我听到天使的歌声。你在被诅咒的摇篮中长大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: All that lamentation about the executions, and yet here you are, none the worse for them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 当初你对那些处决哭天喊地，而现在看看你，不也照样活得好好的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: You tried to rebel, as children always do, but I taught you respect. In a way, I was your real father, wasn't I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 你像孩子们一样试图反抗，但我教会了你尊重。某种程度上，我才是你真正的父亲，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: I will spit in its leering face! Effigy of dust! Mutilated Void-dog!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我要朝它那张邪恶的脸上吐口水！尘土的雕像！残废的虚空走狗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: She weaves the strands of Khra to tether her false Duviri to the true. You must be bold, like I taught you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 她编织着时间丝线，将她虚假的双衍王境与真实的双衍王境束缚在一起。你必须勇敢起来，就像我教你的一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: The Dominus Aureus is the sacred symbol of my dominion. I need them back. Every last one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 大帝金币是我统治的神圣象征。我需要它们全部归还。一枚都不能少！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Return every Dominus Aureus, and her hold on the throne shall crumble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 归还每一枚大帝金币，她对王座的掌控便会土崩瓦解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: There is still time to stop her. Hurry, before this ink fades away on the page!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 现在还有时间阻止她。快点，趁这页纸上的墨迹还没褪去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Break her control, or hers will be the only Duviri there has ever been!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 打破她的控制，否则双衍王境将会只属于她！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: We are glad you have moved beyond petty grudges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我们很高兴你已经放下了那些无谓的怨恨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: You defied a King. Now stand beside that King to defy a God.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 你曾违抗了一位国王。现在，你站在国王身边，违抗一位神明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Do not forget: we were friends once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 不要忘记：我们曾经是朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: I suspect you know what meddling beyond the Wall has brought her here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我想你心里清楚，是墙外的事把她带到了这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Time is wasting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 时间正在流逝。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Have you not learned the folly of pride?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 难道你还没有认识到骄傲是多么愚蠢吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: This is what there is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 目前就只有这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Perhaps Acrithis has some bauble to tempt you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 也许言录使有一些小玩意儿可以吸引你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: I shall not haggle like a mere merchant!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我不会像普通商人一样讨价还价！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: You do not entirely want for wisdom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 看来你也不完全是没智慧的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: May it aid you in our fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 希望它能在我们的战斗中助你一臂之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: We are satisfied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 我们很满意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.text: Yes. Indeed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVe.zhText: 是的，不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 你只是在拖延注定会发生的事情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.text: I do enjoy watching you dance so frantically.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 我确实喜欢看到你这么惊慌失措地跳来跳去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.text: Kiddo, you are trying so hard.
Look at you, desperately trying to hold back the infinite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 你看你，拼命地想阻挡无尽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.text: The foundation is crumbling. My will floods in. Flail away, the end is inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 根基在崩塌，我的意志如洪水般涌来。再怎么挣扎，结局早已注定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.text: Is this where you hide all your secrets, kiddo? Your shame? Let me wash it all away for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 这就是你隐藏所有秘密的地方吗，小鬼？你的耻辱？让我为你洗去一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.text: All will be still when the flood has passed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 洪水过去后，一切都将归于平静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.text: We can do this, again, and again, and again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 我们还能再来一遍，一遍又一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.text: Don't get too excited. I'm just getting started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/Isleweaver/DVo.zhText: 别太激动了，我这才刚刚开始呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: A blast crucible. Mix heat and cold Amphors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 爆炸转换坩埚。混合火焰和冰冻元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: When heat and cold crash together, the blast elemental force is created.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 当火焰与冰冻元素碰撞时，就会产生爆炸元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Mixing Amphors of heat and cold creates a blast elemental force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 将火焰和冰冻元素瓶混合在一起，会产生爆炸元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: You found a crucible. Now liberate the necessary Amphors from your enemies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 你找到了一个转换坩埚。接下来，从敌人手中夺取所需的元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Your enemies hoard the Amphors the crucibles need. Retrieve them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 你的敌人囤积了转换坩埚所需的元素瓶。去取回它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Corrosion's elemental force is the deadly byproduct of Toxin and Electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 腐蚀元素之力是毒素和电击结合的致命副产品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: This Crucible creates the Corrosive elemental force by mixing Toxin and Electricity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 此转换坩埚通过混合毒素和电击来产生腐蚀元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Combine Electricity and Toxin Amphors to produce the Corrosive elemental force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 将电击与毒素元素瓶结合起来，以产生腐蚀元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Cut the enemy forces down, take the Amphors, and hurl them at the crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 击败敌军，夺取元素瓶，并将其投向转换坩埚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Throw the needed Amphors at the Crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 将所需的元素瓶投向转换坩埚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Find an Amphor and throw it at the crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 找到一个元素瓶并将其投向转换坩埚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: A new element is born. Find the next crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 新元素已诞生。寻找下一个转换坩埚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Very good. Find another crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 很好。找到另一个转换坩埚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Finished. A new crucible hungers for elements.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 完成。新的转换坩埚急需元素。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: You understand now. Again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 你现在应该明白了。再做一遍！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: You have birthed a complex elemental force. Create another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 你已创造出一种复合元素之力。再创造另一种。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Hmmm... Gas crucible. Seek Heat and Toxin Amphors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 嗯……毒气转换坩埚。寻找火焰和毒素元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Gas: the ephemeral elemental force is created by combining Heat and Toxin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 毒气：这种短暂的元素之力由火焰与毒素的结合产生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Crucibles: bizarre contraptions left behind from the time of Scholar's Landing. Master their alchemy to understand the elemental forces you wield. Locate a crucible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 转换坩埚：儒临地时期留下的奇异装置。掌握这些装置的元素转换技术，以理解你所运用的元素之力。找到一个转换坩埚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Combine Electricity and Cold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 将电击与冰冻元素结合起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: A magnetic crucible! Find Electricity and Cold Amphors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 磁力转换坩埚！找到电击和冰冻元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Cold and Electricity, these are the Amphors you seek.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 冰冻与电击，这些就是你要寻找的元素瓶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: The forces of Heat and Electricity unleash radiation when combined.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 火焰和电击元素结合在一起就会释放出辐射元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Deadly Radiation, the product of Heat And Electricity Amphors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 致命的辐射元素之力，由火焰和电击元素瓶结合产生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Marry Electricity and Heat Amphors to create Radiation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 将电击和火焰元素瓶结合以产生辐射元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: It is a comfort to know that even in the depths of the Undercroft the laws of alchemical science remain unbroken.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 令人欣慰的是，即使在地穴深处，元素转换的科学定律仍然保持不变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: I imagine the long-departed Scholar would have been impressed with how you've wielded his crucibles today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 我想那位早已离世的学者若见到你今天如何操控他的转换坩埚，定会感到惊叹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Good. Replicate these elemental combinations as you modify your weapons and Warframes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 很好。复制这些元素组合，就像你改造武器和战甲那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Toxin and Cold are the seeds of the Viral elemental force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 毒素和冰冻元素是病毒元素之力的种子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Even in the Undercroft, toxin and cold create a viral elemental force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 即使是在地穴，毒素和冰冻元素也能创造出病毒元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Whether on your weapons or in the crucible, Toxin and Cold Amphors will create a Viral elemental force.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 无论是运用在你的武器上还是在转换坩埚中混合，毒素和冰冻元素瓶都会产生病毒元素之力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Operator, did you know Cephalon Simaris is here? Ordis was so TERRIFIED respectful of Simaris, once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 指挥官，您知道中枢 Simaris 在这里吗？Ordis 曾经，对 Simaris——害怕地——尊敬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: For so long it has just been Ordis and the Operator, together on the Orbiter. Now there are many, MANY other people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 很长时间以来，只有 Ordis 和指挥官，一起在轨道飞行器上。现在还有很多，——很多——其他人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: One Fomorian could wipe this whole Relay out. Does the Operator know where the nearest emergency exit is?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 一艘巨人战舰就能把整个中继站摧毁。指挥官知道最近的紧急出口在哪里吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Operator! Did you bring motes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 指挥官！你把微粒带来了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Ordis is doing his part. Keeping the System free from OROKIN GARBAGE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: Ordis 正在尽自己的责任。让系统免受——奥罗金垃圾——的侵害。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Keep those motes coming, Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 指挥官，继续把微粒送来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: So, these are the ordinary, everyday people the Operator has been fighting to protect. Some of them have even been speaking to Ordis. Ordis is glad his Operator is here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 所以，这些就是指挥官一直在保护的普通的平凡人。他们中的一些人甚至和 Ordis 说过话，Ordis 很高兴他的指挥官在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Ordis knows what to do. Ordis has been taking motes! That was a pun, Ordis. That fault was supposed to be bypassed, Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: Ordis 知道要做什么。Ordis 已经在积蓄微粒（威力）了！那是个谐音梗，Ordis。那个错误应该已经被绕过了，Ordis。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Ordis should visit the Dry Dock. Ordis has not spoken to Cephalon Cy in so long! We will have so much to talk about!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: Ordis 应该造访干船坞。Ordis 太久没和中枢赛伊说话了！我们有好多可以聊的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Corpus reinforcements! Inbound to your position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: Corpus 增援！正在前往您的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Auxiliary elevator inbound. Full of CORPSES- Corpus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 辅助电梯已入站。满是——尸体——Corpus。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.text: Reinforcements arriving via the auxiliary elevator bay. Should Ordis tell them they are GOING DOWN?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DA.zhText: 敌军增援正通过辅助电梯停靠区抵达。Ordis 应该告诉他们，他们注定要失——败吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Did that bush move? Oh, that is just Septimus. He is a rodent. I call him Septimus. Goodbye, Septimus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 那个灌木动了吧？哦，那只是塞蒂默斯。他是一只啮齿动物。我叫他塞蒂默斯。再见，塞蒂默斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Nights are beautiful here. The stars. The hush of the trees. The sound of adorable furry lifeforms murdering one another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 这里的夜晚很美。星空灿烂。树木静谧无声。还有那些可爱的毛茸茸的小动物们互相厮杀的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: War feels so very far from this place, does it not, Operator?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 战争离这个地方似乎很遥远，不是吗，指挥官？
Ordis 已准备好提供帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Has the Operator had an epiphany?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 指挥官领悟到什么了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Parvos Granum already has Eximus units in the field, but if he gets his hands on enough of Jade's Volatile Motes, he can perfect them. Build a true Jade Eximus. He would be unstoppable. Ordis knows the Operator would not let that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努已经在战场上部署了卓越者单位，但如果他获得足够的 Jade 的不稳定微粒，他就能完善它们。打造出真正的翠玉卓越者。他将势不可挡。Ordis 知道指挥官不会让这种情况发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: The Volatile Motes are in limited supply, if the Tenno can snatch them all up. Parvos and his Jade Eximus project will be halted in its tracks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 不稳定微粒的数量有限，如果 Tenno 能将它们全部抢走的话。帕尔沃斯和他的翠玉卓越者项目将被迫中止。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Unlike her Vestigial Motes, Jade's Volatile Motes are finite and irreplaceable. Get to them all first, and no desire or ambition will be able to replace them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 与她的残存微粒不同，Jade 的不稳定微粒是有限且不可替代的。先抢到它们，没有任何欲望或野心能够取代它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Operator, do you see anything you would like?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 指挥官，您看到想要的东西了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: The Operator is not working alone. So many Tenno have come together to help Jade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 指挥官并不是孤军奋战。许多 Tenno 都团结起来，一同来帮助 Jade 了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Who does Parvos Granum think he is bringing up ghosts from the past? Does he think that will get under Ordis's skin? It has not. Really. REALLY. Ordis is fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努以为他是谁，竟然提起过去的幽灵？他以为这样就能激怒 Ordis 吗？并没有。真的。真的。Ordis 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: This Ordan Karris fellow. Ordis feels like he too would have stood up for Jade.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: 这个叫奥丹·卡里斯的家伙。Ordis 觉得他也会为 Jade 挺身而出。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Ordis knows the stories of Ordan Karris. What the Orokin did to Jade, is not dissimilar to what they did to him. Both were used and then discarded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: Ordis 知道奥丹·卡里斯的故事。奥罗金对 Jade 所做的事与对他所做的事并没有什么不同。他俩都被利用，然后被丢弃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.text: Could Ordis have saved Jade? Ordis has rerun a simulation of the event six-hundred million, four thousand and forty-three times, and Ordis has still not found a satisfactory course of action. Do these things... just happen sometimes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DB.zhText: Ordis 能救出 Jade 吗？Ordis 已经重复模拟这一事件六亿四千零四十三次，但 Ordis 仍然没有找到满意的行动方案。这种事情……有时候就是会发生吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: The capsule is taking critical damage, Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 指挥官，提取器正在遭受严重损坏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: Hurry! The enemy is close to destroying the capsule!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 快点！敌人快要摧毁提取器了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: The Corpus are dealing serious damage to the capsule!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: Corpus 正在对提取器造成严重损坏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: Protect the capsule-it is suffering grievous damage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 保护好提取器——它正遭受严重损坏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: Operator! The capsule is rebuilding its shields and will not move until it is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 指挥官！提取器正在重建护盾，它在完成之前不会移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: Stars! The capsule's shields have failed. It will stop moving until it rebuilds them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 群星啊！提取器的护盾已失效。在重建护盾前它都无法移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: The capsule has to rebuild its shields, and is diverting all propulsion to that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 提取器必须重建护盾，正在将全部推进力用于此项工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: Until the capsule's shields are back up, Ordis is afraid it will not budge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 在提取器的护盾恢复之前，Ordis 觉得它恐怕不会移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: Fantastic! The Capsule is full of motes. Now, we can escort it up the elevator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 太棒了！提取器里装满了微粒。现在，我们可以护送它上电梯了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: The Capsule is ready. Onward and then upward!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 提取器准备好了。前进，然后向上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.text: The Capsule is ready for transport to the surface.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DC.zhText: 提取器已准备好运送到地面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: Operator! The collector's systems suffered a critical failure and are now rebooting from the beginning. You must defend it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: 指挥官！收集器系统发生严重故障，正在重新启动。您必须保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: Uh oh...it seems that the collector has taken serious damage. It's going to have to start the process over again. Keep defending it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: 啊哦……看来收集器已经严重受损。它需要重新启动。继续守卫它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: Ordis is getting an 'error 826570' from the collector...whatever that means, it cannot be good. Its internal timer has reset-you must not let it take damage!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: Ordis 从收集器接收到"错误代码 826570"……无论这是什么意思，都不是好事。它的内部计时器已重置，您不能让它受到损坏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: Any critical failure of the collector will require that it reboots and begins again. Please keep the equipment safe, Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: 收集器发生任何严重故障，都需要重新启动并从头开始。指挥官，请确保设备的安全！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: While Ordis would never tire of STANDING AROUND cheering you on, if you do not protect the collector, we will never progress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: 虽然 Ordis 站在您身边为您加油永远都不会累，但如果您不保护好收集器的话，我们就永远都不能继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: Ordis must admit that he is very impressed with how durable this collector is! Even if the Operator has let it suffer so much damage that it is resetting...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: Ordis 必须承认对这个收集器的耐久性印象深刻！即使指挥官让它受了如此多的损坏，它都已经在重启……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: Ah-yes! In the manual for this thing, it says "Excessive Concussive Force to the Collector is Not Recommended For Optimal Use." Well, perhaps if that stopped happening...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: 啊，没错！这个东西的使用手册里写着："不建议对收集器施加过多的冲击力，以确保最佳使用效果。"嗯，也许如果现在这种情况能停止的话……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: The process is starting over again. And we were so close...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: 这个过程又重新开始了。我们刚刚就差一点点……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.text: A true Tenno understands how to combine the elements coursing through their Warframes. Prove yourself. Find a Crucible and the Amphors it needs to create a 'Complex Elemental Force.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DD.zhText: 真正的 Tenno 懂得如何融合其战甲中流动的元素。证明你自己。找到转换坩埚和所需的元素瓶，以创造"复合元素之力"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Starting elevator ascension and... Ugh, they have cut the power. Ordis is afraid you will have to power it manually. Look for ionic charges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 电梯开始上升……呃，他们切断了电源。Ordis 觉得您恐怕得手动供电了。寻找离子进行充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordis fears they have cut power to the elevator. Find ionic charges nearby, or else we will be going nowhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: Ordis 担心他们切断了电梯的电源。找到附近的离子进行充能，否则我们哪里也去不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: What??? The elevator's power lines have been severed? You will have to supply power manually. Find ionic charges scattered about. You do not want to take the stairs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 什么？？？电梯的电缆被切断了？您必须手动供电了。找到散落在周围的离子进行充能。您不会想走楼梯的。
