/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Operator, the elevator has stopped! Find more ionic charges!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 指挥官，电梯停下了！找到更多离子来充能！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: The elevator is out of power! Find more charges, or it is stuck here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 电梯没电了！请寻找更多离子来充能，不然电梯就卡在这里了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: The elevator's power is depleted. Operator! Without more ionic charges, it goes not an inch farther.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 电梯能量已经耗尽。指挥官！如果没有更多离子来充能，电梯就连一寸也动不了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Time to recharge the elevator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 是时候给电梯充能了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Could that be? You're Ordan Karris. I'd recognize that voice anywhere. How far you've fallen. Corpus, these thieves and their renegade 'leader' are taking my Volatile Motes. End them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 难道？你就是奥丹·卡里斯。无论在哪我都能认出那声音来。你竟落得这般下场。Corpus，这些小偷及其叛逆的"首领"正夺走我的不稳定微粒。消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordis' name is Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: Ordis 的名字就叫 Ordis。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Is that? The Beast of Bones? Unbelievable. They made ballads of you, Ordan. Shadow-figures told your story on alley walls. Children sat agog to listen. A legacy wasted. Troops! Dismantle this puny operation and retrieve the Volatile Motes for the Eximus project.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 那是？狂骨野兽？难以置信。他们谱写了关于你的歌谣，奥丹。影子般的人物在小巷的墙上叙说你的故事。孩子们兴奋地坐下来听。一份被浪费的传承。军队们！解散这个微不足道的行动，并为卓越者项目取回不稳定微粒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: The man you refer to is dead. But Ordis is sure he would have also told you to GET FFF- far out of our way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 你说的那个人已经死了。但 Ordis 确信，他也会让你离——我们——远点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: That voice! I remember a certain inspirational man. A hero to the Tenno, for he too slaughtered Orokin at a ceremony in his own honor. Tell me. Does any memory of that valiant man still reside in your shallow, glassy brain?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 那个声音！我想起了一个鼓舞人心的男人。他是 Tenno 的英雄，因为他同样在自己的荣誉仪式上屠杀了奥罗金人。告诉我，你那浅薄、空洞的脑袋里是不是还装着有关那个勇敢男人的任何记忆？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Mis-ter Gra-num. Ordis does not know what you are babbling about.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 格拉-努先生。Ordis 不知道你在胡言乱语什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Cephalon, I know who you are- well, were. Do you think you are helping Jade? Preserving her honor. Her dignity? The Orokin used her, like they used you. A pantomime of justice and truth. She could have been a force of something greater. She still can. As a weapon of my righteous desire. The free hand of the market made freer, one smoldering beam of Jade light after another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 中枢，我知道你是谁——或者说，你曾经是谁。你认为你在帮助 Jade ？维护她的荣誉。她的尊严吗？奥罗金利用了她，就像他们利用了你一样。一出正义与真理的哑剧。她本可以成为更伟大事物的力量。她依然可以。成为我正义愿望的武器。通过一束又一束慢燃的翠玉之光，使市场的自由之手变得更加自由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Funny. You do not even realize it. You sound exactly like one of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 真有趣。你甚至都没有意识到，你说话听起来和他们完全一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Everything changes, little Cephalon, and yet nothing is forever lost. You could be a man again, if you had the will. Consider my offer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 一切都在变化，小中枢，但没有什么是永远消失的。如果你有意愿，你还可以再次成为一个人。考虑一下我的提议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordis is INTERESTED trying to do his job, Granum. Leave Ordis in peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 格拉努，Ordis 有兴趣——要努力工作。请让 Ordis 安静一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: There is no greater enemy of freedom than a happy slave. Do you still believe you earned your happiness through honest work? Have you forgotten how they burned that placid smile into your face?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 自由的最大敌人就是快乐的奴隶。你依然相信你所获得的幸福是通过诚实劳动而来的吗？你忘了他们是怎么把那平静的微笑烙在你脸上的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordis is not listening. La la la.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: Ordis 没有在听。啦啦啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordan. Does it not thrill you to watch your beloved Operator spilling torrents of blood? Do you not yearn to be by their side, blades in hand, amid the fury of the hot stench?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 奥丹。看着你心爱的指挥官让人鲜血横流，难道你不会感到兴奋吗？难道你不渴望与他们并肩作战，手握刀剑，置身于那股炽热的恶臭之中吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: You are an old man, Mister Granum, and you were by yourself in the Void for a very long time. Please seek medical treatment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 格拉努先生，你年纪不小了。你独自在虚空中呆了很长时间。请去就医。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: A man who has known starvation in his youth will never tolerate waste. Be warned. I will not let Jade's legacy be squandered. Nor that of... Ordan Karris.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 一个年轻时经历过饥饿的人是不会容忍浪费的。请注意。我不会让 Jade 的遗产被浪费。也不会让……奥丹·卡里斯的遗产被浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordis fears you are wasting your breath, Mister Granum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 格拉努先生，Ordis 觉得你恐怕在浪费口舌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Mr. Granum, do you see how my Operator MURDERS - dispatches your private army. Looks expensive. Has your desire outmatched your will?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 格拉努先生，你看到我的指挥官是如何——杀死——解决你的私人军队了吗？看起来代价不菲。你的欲望是否超过了你的意志？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: I will not forget this... Cephalon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 这事我可不会忘了……中枢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: You know the problem with the Orokin, Ordan. They would never say what they truly desired. Hid their aims behind golden platitudes and the cruelest of pageantry. That's where our Jade came in. The executioner. The boogey woman. Are you going to let that be her legacy? Surely, she deserved more. To be part of something real. Something honest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 你知道奥罗金的问题所在，奥丹。他们从不直言真正的欲望。总是将目的隐藏在华丽的空话和极其残忍的表演之后。这就是我们的 Jade 出现的理由。刽子手。那个可怕的女人。你真的要让这成为她的遗产吗？当然，她值得拥有更多。成为某个真实事物的一部分、诚实事物的一部分。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Honest??? Ordan did not trust you back then, and Ordis does not trust you now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 诚实？？？奥丹那时不信任你，并且 Ordis 现在也不信任你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Do you remember Corposium, Ordan? Do you recall the founding principle blazoned proudly in letters not of arrogant gold, but honest brass? "None shall be slaves." We used simple robotics, not cloned labor or mind-shackled Cephalons, and we do so to this day. In Corposium's name I offer you sanctuary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 你还记得 Corpus 主义之城吗，奥丹？还记得那些创立宗旨，它们自豪地展示在城里，由铜制成，而不是金。"无人为奴。"我们使用简单的机器人，而不是克隆的劳动力或意识被束缚的中枢，并且一直保持至今。以 Corpus 主义之城的名义，我为你提供庇护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: And in exchange you turn Jade into an assembly line widget? NEVER.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 然后作为交换，你把 Jade 变成了一个流水线上的零件？想都别想。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: You are industrious, Cephalon, I will give you that. But what was Jade to you, that you would defy me to preserve her dusty remains? Is it merely the courteous regard of one killer for another, Ordan Karris?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 你很勤奋，中枢，我承认这一点。但是 Jade 对你来说算什么，你竟然违抗我的命令去保存她那尘封的遗体？这难道仅仅是一个杀手对另一个杀手的礼貌吗，奥丹·卡里斯？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Continue this assault on Jade's legacy and Ordan is not the killer you will need to concern yourself with.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 如果你继续这样攻击 Jade 的遗体，那么你需要关注的将不再是奥丹这个杀手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Mr. Granum, you will not succeed in this venture. Leave now, while your losses are minimal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 格拉努先生，你在这场冒险中不会成功。在你的损失可以最小化的时候，现在就离开吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: This will not do, Ordan. You are causing me considerable inconvenience. Which of your many precepts has gone awry? Would you like me to arrange a realignment purge? Some time in the photonic baths would do your venerable systems good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 这可不行，奥丹。你给我带来了很多不便。在你的众多枢律中，是哪一条出了问题？你想让我安排一次重新校准清除吗？在光子浴中呆上一段时间会对你那古老的系统有好处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: You are not immortal, Ordan. Even a doughty Series Two will inevitably burn out. And what will your last conscious thought be, as your housing clouds obsidian-black and your identity dissipates into sour smoke? You will recall these moments of stubbornness, and regret them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 你并非不朽的，奥丹。即使是勇猛的第二型号也会最终耗尽。当你的外壳变成黑曜石般的黑色，你的存在逐渐散为酸烟时，你的最后一丝意识会是什么？你会回想起这些固执的时刻，并为此感到后悔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordan Karris should have SLIT YOUR THROAT when he had the chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 奥丹·卡里斯当时应该趁机割断你的喉咙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Mr. Granum, you were once a reasonable man. Let Jade rest. Her motes are not yours to exploit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 格拉努先生，你曾经是个讲理的人。让 Jade 安息吧。她的微粒不是你可以利用的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Jade fulfilled her purpose. She provided an heir. In doing so, she died. What further closure can your actions possibly bring her? It is sentimentality, and as such, weakness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: Jade 完成了她的使命。她留下了一个后代。在这个过程中，她去世了。你的行动还能为她带来什么进一步的结局？这纯属感情用事，因此也是软弱的表现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Troops, the enemy is attempting to extract. Failure to stop them will incur my extreme displeasure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 各部队，敌人正在试图撤退。若不能阻止他们，我将会非常不悦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Corpus. The enemy is on their way to Extraction. Does that seem like a satisfactory outcome to you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: Corpus。敌人正前往撤离点。你们认为这是一个令人满意的结果吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: This is your last chance to avert failure, troops. Grasp it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 这是你们最后的机会来避免失败，部队。把握住它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Collector configured to capture Volatile Motes. The Corpus will try and blow it up. Do stop them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 收集器已配置好以捕捉不稳定微粒。 Corpus 将试图将其炸毁。一定要阻止他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: The collector will now siphon Volatile Motes. Our enemies will certainly try to kill you, so- *BUCKLE UP.*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 收集器将吸取不稳定微粒。我们的敌人肯定会试图杀死你，所以——*做好准备*。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: If Parvos thinks he can waltz in here and take what is left of Jade he has not met my Operator. Defend the collector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 如果帕尔沃斯认为他可以轻而易举地过来夺走 Jade 残余部分的话，那他一定还没见识过我指挥官的厉害。保护好收集器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Larunda Relay awaits. There, Jade's Volatile Motes can be committed to the Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 水神中继站正在待命。在那里，可以把 Jade 的不稳定微粒给太阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: You did it. Now bring the Volatile Motes to me on Larunda Relay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 您做到了。现在把不稳定微粒带到水神中继站来找我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: You are home free! I have a command post on Larunda Relay. Bring the Volatile Motes there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 您搞定了！我在水神中继站有一个指挥中心。把不稳定微粒带到那里来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordis will not stand idly by while Parvos Granum reaps the last vestiges of Jade for his Eximus executioner program. He must be DENIED.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: Ordis 不会袖手旁观，看着帕尔沃斯·格拉努为他的卓越者行刑者项目收割 Jade 的最后残余。他必须被拒绝。必须阻止他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Ordis applauds your - EXTREMELY RISKY - bold decision to collect Volatile Motes despite Parvos Granum's relentless greed for them. Surely, you will dispatch his OVERWHELMING FORCES and escort her motes out of this cave. From there, Ordis will commit them to the Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: Ordis 对您——极其冒险的——大胆决定表示赞赏，尽管帕尔沃斯·格拉努对不稳定微粒有着无尽的贪婪，您毅然决定收集它们。毫无疑问，您一定会消灭他的浩浩大军，并将她的微粒护送出这个洞穴。届时，Ordis 将把它们献给太阳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: All that is left of her is the  Motes in this cave. Ordis could have- SHOULD HAVE -done more. Help Ordis stop Parvos Granum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 她留在这洞穴的只有微粒了。Ordis 本来可以——本来应该——做更多。请帮助 Ordis 阻止帕尔沃斯·格拉努。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: We have reached the top! But now we must escort the capsule to extraction. Be careful not to slip, it is a loooooooong way down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 我们已经到顶了！但现在我们必须把提取器护送到撤离点。小心不要滑倒，从这里掉下去的距离可是非常非常长的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: Now that we've reached the top, they will stop at nothing! Protect the capsule!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 现在然我们已经到顶了，他们将不惜一切代价！保护好提取器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.text: We're almost done-one final stretch. We have to get the capsule to extraction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DE.zhText: 我们就快搞定了——还有最后一段路要走。我们必须把提取器送到撤离点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DF.text: You turn around and someone who meant the world to you can be gone. Ordis... suspects... he has spent years missing people. But... their names... their faces... are lost to him. They were important. Then I... then Ordis... changed. Ordis turned around, and they were gone. We are obliged to keep on without them. That's the lesson, Ordis supposes. Perhaps there is a life after death, because what's the point of learning a lesson if it can never be applied. Life's not so much a dream, as a dream sequence. To the dream, we surrender them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DF.zhText: 转身之间，曾经对您意义重大的人就可能已经离您而去。Ordis……怀疑……他已经花费了多年时间来怀念着某些人。但是……他们的名字……他们的面容……已经从他记忆中消逝。他们曾是重要的存在。然后我……然后 Ordis……变了。Ordis 转身，他们就不见了。我们有责任继续前行，即便没有他们。这是一个教训，Ordis 认为。也许真有死后的生活，因为如果学到的教训永远无法实践，那学来又有什么意义呢？生活并不只是一场梦，更像是一连串的梦。我们将他们托付在梦之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DF.text: We shall lay Jade's Volatile Motes to rest in the embrace of the Sun, well out of reach of Parvos Granum and his tawdry schemes. She will, once again, be a part of the giving of life. Ordis... hopes this is what she would have wanted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DF.zhText: 我们将会让 Jade 的不稳定微粒在太阳的怀抱中安息，远离帕尔沃斯·格拉努和他的卑鄙阴谋。她将，再一次，成为赋予生命的一部分。Ordis……希望这就是她想要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DG.text: I am, as always, your ORDAN-Ordis.
Ordis will see the Operator back on the Orbiter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DG.zhText: Ordis 回轨道飞行器上等指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DG.text: All done, Ordis will warm up the Orbiter for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DG.zhText: 全部完成。Ordis 会为您启动轨道飞行器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DG.text: Okay. Ordis will be here. As well as the Orbiter. Benefit of being a Cephalon. Two places at once. That is the upside.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DG.zhText: 好的。Ordis 会在这里。轨道飞行器也会在。作为中枢的好处就是能同时待在两个地方。这是优点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.text: Ordis understands that this both is, and is not, the Jade that was lost. It does not matter. Ordis is overjoyed to see Jade again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.zhText: Ordis 明白，这既是也不是那个失去的 Jade。这并不重要。Ordis 非常高兴再次见到 Jade。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.text: Does the Operator feel what Jade is feeling? Ordis hopes she is happy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.zhText: 指挥官能体会 Jade 的感受吗？Ordis 希望她开心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.text: Good day, Operator. Good day, Jade.
Granum said that everything changes, and nothing is forever lost. In that much, at least, he may have been right.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.zhText: 格拉努说，一切都在变化，没有什么是永远消失的。至少在这一点上，他可能是对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.text: Take note, Operator, nearby vertical thrust platforms may be advantageous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.zhText: 指挥官，注意了，我们也许能利用附近的垂直推进平台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.text: Operator, it's a long way up, so be on the lookout for vertical thrust platforms.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.zhText: 指挥官，去往上面的路很长，所以要留意垂直推进平台。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.text: May Ordis suggest using the nearby vertical thrust platforms to get a leg up on the enemy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DJ.zhText: Ordis 建议利用附近的垂直推进平台来抢占敌人先机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.text: Bringing the mote collector  online. Defend it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.zhText: 微粒收集器该上场了。保护它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.text: Protect the collector while it draws motes from the air. Ordis would hate for more of Jade to be turned into TERRIBLE WEAPONS-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.zhText: 在收集器从空气中吸取微粒时保护它。Ordis 不愿看到 Jade 的更多部分被制成可怕的武器——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.text: First things first, defend the marked collector while it siphons motes from the cave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.zhText: 当务之急是，保护那个被标记的收集器，让它能从洞穴中吸取微粒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.text: Done! Ramping up the second collector. Get up there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.zhText: 完成！开始推进到第二个收集器。快上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.text: This collector is full! Protect the next collector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.zhText: 收集器装满了！保护下个收集器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.text: Success. Next step? Defend the upper level collector while it does its thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DL.zhText: 成功。下一步？ 在上层收集器工作时保护好它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.text: The capsule is secure and the enemy have been denied more Jade Motes. Ordis could not be more delighted with the Operator...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.zhText: 提取器已确保安全，敌人未能获取更多 Jade 的微粒。Ordis 对指挥官的表现感到非常满意……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.text: You have extracted the capsule. Mission complete!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.zhText: 提取器已成功送出。任务完成！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.text: Ordis is just so thrilled that the Operator has succeeded. Well done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.zhText: Ordis 非常高兴指挥官已经成功了。做得好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.text: Operator! When Jade- left us. This area was infused with the light of her motes. A power the Corpus want to take for themselves. Not today! Ordis has gained control of the mote collectors. They work for the Operator now. Protect them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.zhText: 指挥官！当 Jade——离开我们时，这个区域充满了她的微粒之光。这是 Corpus 想要占为己有的力量。但今天不行！Ordis 已经控制了微粒收集器。它们现在为指挥官服务。请保护它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.text: This cavern is infused with Jade's Motes. The Corpus have set up mote collectors to extract Jade's energy from the air. Due to BRAINDEAD- basic security protocols, the collectors are under our control. Operator, defend the first one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.zhText: 这个洞穴充满了 Jade 的微粒。Corpus 已经设置了微粒收集器，从空气中提取 Jade 的能量。由于脑残——基本的安全协议，这些收集器已经被我们控制。指挥官，请保护第一个收集器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.text: The walls of this cave are saturated with Jade's final energy, her Motes. The Corpus have no shame, and they aim to harvest her motes for their own twisted purposes. But not if we get to them first. Defend the filtration system.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DM.zhText: 这个洞穴的墙壁上充斥着 Jade 的最后一股能量，也就是她的微粒。Corpus 无耻至极，他们为了自己的邪恶目的企图收集她的微粒。但如果我们抢先一步，他们就无法得逞。请保护过滤系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DN.text: All things in their time, Operator.
If Ordis can be of any assistance, to his Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DN.zhText: 如果 Ordis 能够帮到指挥官的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.text: Magnificent. Ordis truly appreciates all you have done to honor Jade's memory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.zhText: 太好了。Ordis 真心感谢您为纪念 Jade 所做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.text: Are you going to use that to SLAUGHTER GRANUM'S FORCES- restore balance to the system?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.zhText: 你打算用这个来屠杀格拉努的部队——从而恢复星系的平衡吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.text: Ordis will contemplate Jade while her Motes are committed to our Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.zhText: 当 Jade 的微粒被奉献给我们的太阳时，Ordis 会想起 Jade。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.text: Jade's light will be returned to the life-giving fire of our Sun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.zhText: Jade 的光将回归到我们太阳的生命赋予之火中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.text: Perhaps the Operator needs to take another trip to the depths of Uranus? Uh, to find more Volatile Motes, of course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.zhText: 也许指挥官需要再去一趟天王星的深处？呃，当然是为了寻找更多的不稳定微粒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.text: Tough choices. Ordis does not envy the Operator.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DO.zhText: 困难的选择。Ordis 不嫉妒指挥官。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DP.text: Operator, Ordis has received what amounts to... an offer of help from an unexpected source.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DP.zhText: 指挥官，Ordis 从一个意想不到的来源收到了一份相当于……帮助的提议。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DP.text: Operator, you will not believe this...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DP.zhText: 指挥官，您肯定不会相信……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DP.text: There has been an offer of help. Ordis believes it is genuine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DP.zhText: 有人愿意协助我们。Ordis 认为这是可信的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Ordis is excited to see this put to use once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: Ordis 很兴奋见到这个东西再次被使用起来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: It is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Unfortunate. They have disabled the capsule's shields. Elevator power will be diverted to restoring them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 很不幸。他们已经禁用了提取器的护盾。电梯的电力将被转移用来恢复护盾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: The elevator has stopped until the shields on the capsule are replenished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 在提取器的护盾得到充能之前，电梯将停止运行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Capsule shields are down. The elevator will not move until they are restored... sorry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 提取器的护盾已经失效。电梯在它们恢复之前不会移动……抱歉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Operator! What have you done? That was a Sister Beacon! Do that again and one will join the fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 指挥官！您都做了什么？那是个姐妹信标！再来一次，您就能看到一个姐妹加入战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: A Sister Beacon? Trigger too many of those and you will have to fight a Sister of Parvos. SO TRIGGER THEM.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 一个姐妹信标？触发太多次，您就得与一个帕尔沃斯的姐妹对战。所以——触发——它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Those Sister Beacons are meant for the Corpus Troops to call in backup! PICK A FIGHT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 那些姐妹信标是为了让 Corpus 部队呼叫支援而设计的！挑起一场战斗吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Operator, those Sister Beacons are for the Corpus to use in emergencies! Are you issuing a challenge?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 指挥官，那些姐妹信标是供 Corpus 在紧急情况下使用的！您是在发出挑战吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: If you insist on triggering those Sister Beacons, Ordis suggests you prepare for an extremely hostile response. SWEET!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 如果您坚持要触发那些姐妹信标，Ordis 建议您做好迎接极端宿敌的准备。真——好！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Operator! Those beacons are set up to summon a Sister of Parvos! If we meddle with them, she is certain to arrive!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 指挥官！那些信标被设置用来召唤帕尔沃斯的姐妹！如果我们碰了它们，她肯定会来的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Triggering one Sister Beacon may be overlooked, but tripping all three of them will undoubtedly be seen as provocation -DO IT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 触发一个姐妹信标可能会被忽视，但是三个全部触发肯定会被视作挑衅，行——动——吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Keep triggering those Beacons and the Sisterhood will attempt to eliminate you. Ordis would like to see them try!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 继续触发那些信标，姐妹团会试图消灭您。Ordis 倒是要看看她们会怎么做！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Willfully triggering those Sister Beacons? Ordis HOPES- fears his Operator is looking for trouble!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 故意触发那些姐妹信标？Ordis 希望——担心——他的指挥官是在自找麻烦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: An ancient text says that if tears come easily one is 'built close to water'. Ordis thinks that is a lovely image.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 古书上说，如果一个人容易流泪，那么他就是"水做的人"。Ordis 认为这是一个很美的比喻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: We have returned Jade to the Sun. A homecoming of sorts. Yes. This feels... right... to Ordis.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 我们已将 Jade 送回太阳。这可以算是一种回家。是的。对于 Ordis 来说……这感觉……很对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: It has been said that your shadow is that which you wish you were not but are. Ordis wishes this were true for himself. Ordis fears his shadow may be that which he was... and may once again be. Anyway! Does the Operator have any new NOGGLES?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 据说，您的心理阴影反映的是您不愿见到但实际上属于您的那一面。Ordis 希望这对他来说是真的。Ordis 害怕他的心理阴影可能正是他过去的自己……也许还会再次成为那样。话说回来！指挥官有新的摇头娃娃吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Whatever the Stalker and Jade have brought forth, it will be no ordinary child! Ordis wonders whether he will ever encounter an 'ordinary child'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 无论追猎者和 Jade 生下了什么，那绝不会是一个普通的孩子！Ordis 想知道他将来是否会遇到一个"普通的孩子"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Ordis suggests advising the... 'locals'... to initiate adequate water-filtration protocols lest the radio-fluorine levels cause their fingernails to fall off.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: Ordis 建议提醒……"当地人"……采取适当的水过滤措施，以免因放射性氟含量过高导致指甲脱落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Ordis hopes the Stalker will give up his vendetta one day, just as Ordis did. Perhaps he too will grow weary of CLEANING UP BLOOD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: Ordis 希望有一天追猎者会像 Ordis 一样放弃他的复仇。也许他也会厌倦清理血迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Ordis remains fascinated by the gladiatorial frenzy of competing organic forms that vie for territorial dominance in this region. The wildlife is also interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: Ordis 对这个区域内的有机生物为争夺领土主权而展开的激烈斗争深感兴趣。对这里的野生动物也很感兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Some societies are yet to master tools. That one over there appears yet to master consonants.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 有些社会还没学会使用工具。而那边的人似乎连辅音都还没学会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: In his time here Ordis has fallen in love with this place. He has also fallen in love with what he cannot see. Ordis thinks he may finally understand what is meant by the word 'magic'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: Ordis 在这里的经历让他深深爱上了这个地方，他也爱上了那些他看不见的东西。Ordis 认为他可能终于理解了"魔法"这个词的真正含义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: In the silence Ordis hears a music of celestial complexity. Deep.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 在寂静中，Ordis 听到了来自天堂的复杂而深沉的音乐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Oh! How nifty. It seems some of the ionic charges contained a more refined storage system. It should provide the elevator with an additional boost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 哦！太棒了。看来一些离子有更精致的储存系统。应该能给电梯提供额外的推动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Some of the ionic charges seem to contain more juice than others-that should make powering the elevator faster, if you can find them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 一些离子电荷似乎有更多的能量——如果您能找到它们，那应该可以加快给电梯供能的速度！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Not all the ionic charges are the same-some are more powerful. If you find those charges, it might make this easier!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 并非所有的离子都相同——有些更强大。如果您找到了那些离子，可能会让一切更轻松！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Ordis has preemptively supplied you with unique air support. You will be able to jump higher! Have FUN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: Ordis 已预先为您配备了独特的空中支援。让您能够跳得更高！打得开心！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Sending air support to help you jump higher.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: 正在派出空中支援来帮助您跳得更高。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.text: Ordis has unilaterally enabled air support that will boost the height of your gallant leaps, enjoy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DS.zhText: Ordis 已经单方面启用了空中支援，这将提升您英勇跳跃的高度，尽情享受吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DU.text: Collection complete. Next, through a complicated system of- Oh. You do not care. The Extraction Capsule has been filled! Time to go to the elevator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DU.zhText: 收集完毕。接下来，通过一个复杂的系统——哦。您不必懂。提取器已装满！该去电梯了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DU.text: Ordis is so proud of the Operator! The motes have been transferred to the Extraction Capsule. It awaits you in the elevator shaft!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DU.zhText: Ordis 真为指挥官感到骄傲！微粒已被转移到提取器。它就在电梯井里等着您！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DU.text: We did it! And by "we," Ordis means you, but Ordis helped! On to the elevator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadows/DU.zhText: 我们做到了！Ordis 说的"我们"指的其实是你们，但 Ordis 也帮了忙！上电梯吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I… miscalculated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我……失算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ooh, look how I bleed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦吼，看看我这血流得多漂亮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: As it should be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 本应如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I taste delicious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我尝起来真不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My blades grow heavy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的刀，变得沉重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Wonderfully done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 做得太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I accept this ending.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我接受这个结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I still bleed red!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我竟也会流红色的血！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I moved like smoke. They moved like the wind.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我行如烟，而他们行如风。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You want to play rough?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你想点激烈的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The way continues. Without me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 道路还在继续。但不再有我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Help me up. I want you to do that again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 扶我起来。我想让你再做一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The teacher who stops learning becomes the lesson.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 停止学习的老师，终将成为他人的教训。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh, I liked that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，这个我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I die as I lived. Aware.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我死得其所，就像我活着的时候一样。清醒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Not good enough!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 差点意思！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Pride. My final lesson.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 傲慢。是我的最后一课。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: More! MORE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 还要！还——要！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My time as teacher… is finished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的导师生涯……结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ooh, I can see inside myself…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦吼，我能看见自己的内部……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The wheel turns. I fall beneath it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 命运的齿轮运转，而我坠落其下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come back, finish your kill!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 回来，完成你的猎杀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let me rest. It is… enough.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让我休息一下吧……够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A mistake to leave me breathing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让我活下来真是个错误！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Certainty will rust the purest of blades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 确定性，会使最纯净的刀刃生锈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: When I get up, it'll be my turn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 等我起来，就轮到我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I accept this verdict.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我接受这个判决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you think I care?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你以为这能影响我？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: He who teaches humility but does not practice it will learn it painfully.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 教人谦卑而自己却不谦卑的人，终将为此付出惨痛的代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Every master… will someday find his better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 每一个高手……总会遇到更强的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Join me, won't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一起玩呀，不想吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I face this without fear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我坦然面对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come! Have a sip!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 来！尝一口！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The lesson is mine. But it comes too late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我吸取了教训，但为时已晚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: So much crimson… so much beauty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 满眼猩红……竟如此美丽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Even silent blades make a sound when they fall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 即便是无声的刀刃，在落地时也会发出声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Rivers of red, they flow from me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 鲜血如河，从我体内奔涌而出！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I see it clearly…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我看清了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'll finish it myself if you won't!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你不动手，那我自己来解决！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A foe. Defeated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 敌人。已击倒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Blood for the Blood Queen! Me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 以鲜血献祭血之女王！正是在下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am the scythe. You are the wheat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我是镰刀，你是麦子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Another drop!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又干掉一个！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My blade is honed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的刀刃已磨利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will paint whole worlds red!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我要把整个世界染成红色！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The dance continues.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这场战斗，还没结束。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes, sate my thirst!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好样的，让我解解渴吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The student who does not listen… feels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不听话的学生……只能亲身感受代价。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Scream all you like! It won't save you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 尽管放声尖叫吧！谁也救不了你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Potential. Wasted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这份潜力，白白浪费了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My blades drink deep of you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的利刃会把你吃干抹净！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your example will teach others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的死，会成为别人的教训。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your time has come. And gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 眼看你起朱楼。眼看你楼塌了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This was inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这一切，本来就是必然。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Behold, my "art!"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 瞧，这就是我的"艺术"！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The blade does not forgive haste.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 刀，不容仓促。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I shall bathe in your blood!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我要沐浴在你的鲜血之中！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You drew without understanding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你出手时毫无悟性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your remains adorn my altar!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的遗骸将装点我的祭坛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Violence without precision is merely noise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 缺乏精准的暴力，只是噪音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Grotesque. Tragic. Perfect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 怪诞。悲剧。完美。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The way was shown. You refused it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 路已经给你了。是你自己不走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Delicious!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 真美味啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am what awaits the reckless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我，就是鲁莽者的终点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: More, please!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 还不够，再来点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your death was written in your stance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的死，从你的架式里便已注定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A little drop of you will stay with me. Forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的一部分，将永远属于我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Another who mistook anger for strength.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又一个，把愤怒当作力量的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Mincemeat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 给我变成肉酱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The path ends here for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的路，到此结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: YES!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Discipline defeats fury. Always.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 纪律永远胜过愤怒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I could slice into you for days!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我可以把你慢慢切割，持续数日！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am the consequence of your choices.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我就是你选择的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Gone so soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这么快就结束了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You fought with passion. I fought with purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你靠情绪战斗，我靠使命战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Added to the pile!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又多了一具！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your technique was flawed. Fatal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的技法有缺陷。是致命的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Feel my blades! So sweetly they carve!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 感受我的利刃吧！它们切得多么优雅！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It. Dies. NOW.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 它。现在。就得死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That one is our foe.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那是我们的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Kill it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 杀了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Make it clean.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 要干净利落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can we make it bleed? Pleeeeease?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们能让它流血吗？求求你了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Mark them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 标记他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I think I will eat its heart.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我估计我会吃掉它的心脏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I see our kill. Strike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我看到了我们的猎物。攻击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It will dance on my blades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 它会在我的利刃上翩翩起舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ah. I see them. Quietly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 啊，我看到他们了。安静点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That one has a debt to pay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那个家伙有债要还。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The one I have marked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我标记的那个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are you thirsty? Let us drink of that one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你渴了吗？让我们在那家伙身上痛饮吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Finish it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 了结它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Aaah, look. A new victim has joined us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 啊，瞧。又有新的受害者加入了我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They do not leave here alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不能让他们活着离开这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Look. It's time to dine!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 瞧。开饭了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Silence them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让他们闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I shall add that one to my altar next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 接下来我要把那家伙也献上祭坛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Walk with shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 与影子同行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are about to add a new line to our ledger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们马上要在账本上添一笔新记录。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: One strike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一击解决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Quickly! My blades itch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快点！我的利刃已经在发痒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Take the head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 砍下头颅。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I can almost taste it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我几乎已经尝到那种味道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That one breathes their last.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那个人将迎来最后一口气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That one, now! Now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 就是它！就是它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Our priority is there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们的首要任务是那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What are we waiting for?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们还在等什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Our blades are ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们的刀刃已就绪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They'll regret today. For the next few seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在接下来的几秒钟里。他们会后悔今天所做的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不容失误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Mmm. Barely even worthy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 唉。几乎都不值得我出手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Silence them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让他们闭嘴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We'll make due with this one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 就拿这个凑合吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Swift death awaits them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 速速杀灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A morsel ready for the slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一只待宰的羔羊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The shadow shall move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 影子将行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Another? For me? Yes, please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 再来一个？交给我了？好的，谢谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Move without sound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 无声行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Something is there. I hope it's killable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那里有东西。最好是能杀的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There. Move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在那里。出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Go there. So I don't have to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你去处理。就不用我动手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Go. Search.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 去搜索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Find whatever is there. I need to murder things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看看那边有什么。我得去杀点东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Stay in the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 待在阴影里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Whatever that is, it's not breathing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 无所谓那是什么了，反正不是活的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Move silently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 悄悄地移动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Does it bleed?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 能流血吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That direction. Quickly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 朝那个方向走。快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can we kill it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们能杀它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 去调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is it alive?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 它是活的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Report back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 请回复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If it doesn't die, I don't care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 杀不死的，我没兴趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Remain patient. But vigilant.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 保持耐心，但也要保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Go look. Or whatever. I want to kill something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 去看看，随你。我现在只想杀点东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Eyes open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 保持警惕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Investigate, I guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我觉得，应该调查一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Blades sharp. Mind sharper.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 刀刃锋利，头脑更敏锐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can I stab it anyway?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那我能捅捅它吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Check that. Thoroughly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 仔细检查一下那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: But it's not bleeeeding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 但它怎么不流血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Move like water.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 像水一样行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Go look. If you make me, I'll kill you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 去看看。你要是敢逼我，我就杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Observe first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 先观察。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That might be important to you. It isn't to me, but you don't seem to care about that, do you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那或许对你很重要。对我来说却不是，但你似乎并不在意，对吧？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Be unseen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 隐身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Waste your time on that! Instead of killing! Of course!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是把时间浪费在那种事上！还是去杀戮！这还用想吗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Stay low.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 低调行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This thing that can't be murdered? Sure! Why not?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这东西根本杀不死？那正好！为什么不试试呢？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What do you see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你看到了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Investigate this? But-but why?! It can't bleed…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 调查一下？可是——可是为什么？！它又不会流血……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Trust your instincts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 相信你的直觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Maybe it has something living in it that can die a horrible way?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 说不定里面有活物，可以用一种很惨的方式弄死？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That way. Be cautious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那里。要小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Just… go look, I don't know. I'm wasting my skills.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那就……去看看吧，我不知道了。这是在浪费我的技能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Leave no trace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不留痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You. Go. Look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你。过去。看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Swift. Silent. Gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快速，无声，然后消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There are only two gods. Blood and money. You just died at the hands of one!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 世上只有两位神。鲜血与金钱。你刚刚死在其中一位的手上！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Another name tattooed upon my soul.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又一个名字，烙印在我的灵魂上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: More!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 还、有、吗！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You have fallen to your better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你败给了更强者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Dead too soon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这么快就死啦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This was necessary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这是必要的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Get up! Fight me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 起来啊！跟我打！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I take no pleasure in this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我并不享受这一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I would eat your heart, if it were worthy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你的心脏够资格，我会把它吃掉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This was inevitable from the moment your name was written.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 从你的名字被写下的那一刻起，这结局便已注定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Feed my blades!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 给我的利刃填肚子去吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A quick death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死得痛快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A drop in the ocean!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 简直是沧海一粟！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I was the answer to someone's problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我曾是他人问题的答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: DIE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 给我死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You join the many who come before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你加入了众多先辈的行列。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes, death!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 对喽，去死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your death was purchased. I merely delivered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的死是买来的，我只是执行者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Sweet nectar!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 甜如蜜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have ended better souls with less effort.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我曾用更少的力气就终结了更强者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Give to me all that you are!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 把你的一切都给我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Be silent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 安静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The world moves on without you. It will not notice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 世界不会因为你的离开而改变，它不会注意到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will lick my blades clean!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我会把我的利刃舔得一干二净！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your road led to me. It has now ended.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的道路将我引向此处，如今却已走到尽头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Slaughter! Carnage! Viscera! You are my gods!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 屠杀！残暴！内脏横飞！你们是我的神！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You had but one moment to escape. You wasted it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你只有一瞬间的逃跑机会，你却浪费了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You are mine!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是我的了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The blade does not judge. It simply concludes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 刀刃不评判，它只作结论。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Another!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 再来一具！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You exit quietly. As you should have lived.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你悄然离去。你本该如此活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will chew on your bones!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我要啃你的骨头！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do not mistake speed for mercy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不要把速度误认为仁慈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You make a poor sacrifice!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的牺牲真是轻如鸿毛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have forgotten you already. The world will follow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我已经把你忘了。世界亦将如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A debt. Paid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 债还清了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The Void claims you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 虚空将带走你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: BLOOD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This was your last mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这是你的最后一个错误。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death had me. You were faster.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死亡来找我。但你更快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Leave the blood. I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 就让它流。我喜欢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I owe you a debt. I will not forget it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我欠你一个人情，我不会忘记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Awwh, I was having fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哇，我玩得正开心呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I walked with death. Now I return.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我曾与死同行，如今我归来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Whaaaat do you waaaant?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你到底——想干什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My stance was broken…now it is restored.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的架式已被打乱，现在恢复了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You're right, I should probably get back to work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你说得对，我可能该回去工作了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I fell. You raised me. Together, then?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我倒下了，是你把我拉回来。那么，我们一起打吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Aren't you the Corpus task master!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你可真是个 Corpus 监工啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have seen the other side. It… can wait.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我已见过另一边。那边……可以等等。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Couldn't you see I was in the middle of bleeding?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 难道你没看到我刚刚在流血吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My body was broken. My will was not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的身体垮了，但我的意志仍在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will hate you forever for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我会为此恨你一辈子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I fell in shadow. I rise in purpose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我曾坠入阴影，如今我因使命而崛起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fine! I suppose I'll have to take it out on other people.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好吧！看来我只能把气撒在别人身上了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death teaches. Life demands action.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死亡教会我们道理，生命要求行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: UGH. You made me CLOT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 啊。你让我血都凝住了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The fight continues. I am ready.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 战斗仍在继续。我已准备好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No! Damn it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不！该死！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Twice-risen. Twice-dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 两次复活，两倍危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: But that was such a pretty wound…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不过那伤口真是漂亮啊……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My blades once more find my hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的刀刃再次回到了我的手中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will never forgive you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我永远不会原谅你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I owe you a debt beyond words.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我欠你一份无法用言语表达的恩情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You ruined my fun!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你扫了我的兴！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I stand. Therefore, I fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我站着。因此，我战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Must I?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 非要我这么做吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My gratitude is measured in steel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的感激之情，以钢铁衡量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Don't clean it! It's better this way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 别清理掉！这样才更好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Their victory was temporary. My resolve is not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们的胜利只是暂时的。而我的决心不会改变。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Leave the gore. I'm saving it for later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 先别见血。留着给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The grave held no lessons I needed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 坟墓里没有我需要的教训。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are you expecting a thank you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是等着我说谢谢吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I owe you my life. Allow me to spend it wisely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我这条命是你救的。请允许我好好使用它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I did that on purpose. I wanted to bleed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我故意的。我就是想流点血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Defeat is a whetstone that can sharpen the dullest of blades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 失败就像是磨刀石，能磨利最钝的刀刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Well if I can't bleed anymore, can you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 既然我流不了血了，那就你来吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The river that meets the stone does not break. It finds another way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 河流遇到石头不会断裂，而是另寻出路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What did I ever do to you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我到底哪里得罪你了？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I hope I was expensive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 真希望我当初把价报高点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am called many things. Ryoku is the kindest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我有很多称呼，忍力算是最友善的一个了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let us go collect some debts. The fun way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让我们用一种有趣的方式去收债吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My name is unimportant. My instruction is not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的名字并不重要，但我的指示却很重要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am a debt worth bleeding for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 用血来支付我的报酬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have trained warriors and buried students. Which are you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我训练过战士，也埋葬过学生。你是哪一种？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And who dies today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 今天都会有谁死掉呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Speak less. Observe more. We begin now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 少说话，多观察。我们现在开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tell me it's to be a slaughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 告诉我，这将是一场屠杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The shadows whisper the name of my blades. You will learn them if you falter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 阴影低语着我刀刃的名字。若你稍有失误，便会知晓它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: These blades of mine are thirsty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的利刃现在如饥似渴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am what stands between you and failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我是阻止你失败的唯一屏障。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Time is money. Money is blood. Let's go collect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 时间就是金钱，金钱就是鲜血。我们快去收钱吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will be your guide through the shadows.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我将成为你穿越阴影的向导。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh, does someone need to die? Someones?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，是有人得死吗？还是说不止一个人？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Discipline brought you to me. A wise choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 纪律让你来到我身边。这是个明智的选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I can taste the death on my lips already.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我仿佛已经尝到了死亡的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My methods are not gentle. Neither is the world.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的手段并不温和，这个世界也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Finally! I am dying for a little mayhem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 终于来了！我渴望来点混乱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The first lesson: Silence is not absence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 第一课：沉默并不等于缺席。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let the rivers run red.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让血流成河。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You seek me out? Few do this willingly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是主动来找我的？很少有人会心甘情愿地这样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The clouds will weep crimson in my wake!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 云朵将在我所过之处泣下猩红之雨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Talent means nothing without discipline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 没有纪律，天赋毫无意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The entrails of our enemies will decorate my altar.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我将用敌人的内脏装点我的祭坛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You wish to walk unseen? First, learn to see.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你想隐身行走？首先，要学会观察。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There is work to do. Let's be quick about it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 还有很多活要干，我们得抓紧时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death is not to be relished. It is to be respected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死亡不值得享受，而应该受到尊重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You better not be planning on handing me a gun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你可别递给我一把枪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Break what does not serve you. Hone what remains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舍弃无益之物，精益求精。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Mm, they'll tell stories about me. If we leave any survivors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 嗯，他们会传颂我的事迹。如果我们留下任何幸存者的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hrmph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I want to feel them die on my claws. Pretty please?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我想亲眼看着他们死在我的爪下。求你啦行吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You summon me with eagerness. I do not know why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你如此急切地召唤我，我却不知为何。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Have you ever drained a heart dry? Watched it die?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是否曾将一颗心榨干？眼睁睁看着它死去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am not here to inspire you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我来这里不是为了激励你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Working with you means I get to kill more things. I like it…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 和你一起工作意味着我能杀掉更多东西。我好喜欢……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Some would know me as Yaiba. But they do not whisper that name in these times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 有些人会知道我的名字叫刃。但如今，人们不会再低声谈论这个名字了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A Void-Demon and The Blood-Wytch. A perfect match… made in hell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 虚空恶魔与血之女巫。多么完美的组合……简直是地狱的杰作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your reputation precedes you. It means nothing to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的名声早已在外，对我来说毫无意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Didn't the Cephalon tell you to come back covered in blood? Well? Where is it?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 中枢不是让你带着一身血回来吗？嗯？血呢？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Two minds, one form. We are complete again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 两个意识，一个身躯。我们再次完整了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Time for more murder?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又到杀戮时间了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You return to flesh. I feel your presence settle like snow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你回到了血肉之躯。我感到你的存在，如同雪花般飘落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can we please be on our way now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们现在可以走了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The body accepts what the spirit brings back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 身体会接受灵魂带回的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I thought I was going to rust!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我还以为自己要锈掉了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are whole. Stronger for the reunion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们现在是完整的。重聚让我们更强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'm so thirsty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我好渴啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am no longer alone in this skin.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我不再独自存在在这具皮囊之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We've wasted enough time. We have lives to end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 别浪费时间了，我们还有人要杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your essence merges with mine. How… odd.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的本质与我的融合了。多么……奇妙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am simply itching to slaughter something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我就是手痒，想杀点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This body holds us both now. Crowded, but purposeful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这具躯体现在容纳了我们两个人。拥挤，却意义非凡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There you are! I thought you were going to leave me here forever. I've seen forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你终于来了！我还以为你会把我永远丢在这儿。我见过什么叫永远。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Like a blade into its sheath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 就像刀刃入鞘一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Did you bring me anyone fun to kill?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你给我带了什么好杀的东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Two become one. The mathematics of the soul defies logic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 二人合二为一。灵魂的奥秘超越逻辑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I wish I could hollow you out and crawl inside your skull. So you know how it feels.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我真想把你掏空，钻进你的脑袋里，让你也尝尝那种滋味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I feel your presence flood through me like water. I accept its peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我感到你的存在如水般涌入我的体内。我接受这份宁静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Once a puppet… always a puppet. Just more literal, now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 做过傀儡……就永远都是傀儡。只是现在更直观了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Separation ends. Unity begins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 分离结束，合一开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh, no, it's fine. I spent the whole time imagining I was drowning in blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，没事。我全程都在幻想被血吞没。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: As one, we move in shadow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们合而为一，在阴影中行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I was just wondering, how long can you exist outside your body? Or does it go with you? No reason…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我就是想知道，你能在身体之外存在多久？还是它会一直跟着你？没别的意思……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Two paths, together one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 两条路，合而为一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Going to have to pick up the pace, if we're going to meet our quota!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 再不加快，就完不成目标了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your return is seamless. As if you never left.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的回归无比顺畅，仿佛你从未离开过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Where have you been? Those idiots are not going to stab themselves!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你跑哪去了？那帮蠢货可不会自己互相捅刀子！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The boundary between us blurs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们之间的界限变得模糊不清。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: When you do that, I can almost-almost-picture what your blood tastes like on my lips.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 当你那样做的时候，我几乎、几乎能想象你血在我唇上的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am the house. You, the returning guest. Shall I make tea?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我就是这栋房子。你是归来的客人。要不要我泡杯茶？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And you came back in one piece? Aw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你平安回来了？哇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are singular. Yet doubled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们是一个整体，却有两个意识。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You're not even bleeding! Then what was the point?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你都没流血！那意义何在？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The body adjusts. Slowly. Uncomfortably.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 身体在适应。缓慢而又不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Did you bring me back anyone juicy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你给我带什么好玩的回来了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I had grown accustomed to the silence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我已经习惯了这种寂静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Shall we? We have places to be. People to kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 走吧？我们还有地方要去。还有人要杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My body. Your commentary. This will take… adjustment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的身体。你的言语。这需要……适应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Aww. Look at how puny you are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哇哦。你就这点能耐啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Which one of us is the blade? Which one of us, the sheath?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们之中谁是刀刃？谁又是刀鞘？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Time is money!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 时间就是金钱！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The cage opens and a bird emerges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 笼子打开了，鸟飞出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'm. Expensive. Leaving me here is expensive. Did you hear me?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我可是很贵的。把我丢在这儿，代价可不小。听清楚了吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Few can walk in two places. Fewer still return unchanged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 能行于这两个状态之间的人很少，能毫无变化回来的人更少。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You are either very wealthy or very stupid for leaving me here like this. Or both. Both are very likely. Mmm. I'm voting for both.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你要么非常有钱，要么非常愚蠢，才会把我一个人丢在这儿。或者两者兼有。这两种可能性都很大。嗯，我倾向于两者兼有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You stand outside your shell. Impressive. Also dangerous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你走出了你的外壳，这很了不起，但也十分危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: But I want to be killlinnnnnnggg…!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 但我想要杀戮……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The spirit unbound is powerful but the body unguarded is weak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不受束缚的灵魂固然强大，但缺乏保护的肉体则十分脆弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you have a habit of leaving your very deadly, beautiful, deadly, expensive, deadly, companions unattended on the regular?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你平时就这么把你那位又致命又漂亮、还很贵的伙伴丢一旁不管？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: To leave the body is to trust the world not to destroy it in your absence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 离开肉体，就是相信这个世界不会在你离开后将其摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Cephalon Parvos warned me about that…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 中枢帕尔沃斯警告过我这件事……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Two forms, two throats. Easier to be killed. Harder to protect.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 两种形态，两个咽喉。更容易被杀死，更难守护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Two people can in theory kill better than one… Mmm. No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 按理说，两个人比一个人更适合杀戮……嗯。算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Separation is not transcendence. It is merely risky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 分离并非超越，它仅仅是一种冒险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ooh. Can I stab you? Just a little? Only a little. I promise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦吼。我能捅你一下吗？就一点点？真的只捅一点点。我保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You show me your essence. Bold. Foolish. Honest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你向我展现了你的本质。大胆。愚蠢。诚实。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: How much can I pay you to try a little of your blood?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 要给你多少钱，才肯让我尝点你的血？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The body without soul is empty. The soul without body is exposed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 没有灵魂的躯体是空的，没有躯体的灵魂是是暴露的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You're not just going to leave me parked here, are you? I'm not a Railjack!
