/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你不会就这么把我扔在这儿不管吧？你当我是航道星舰啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The shell stands at rest while the true self walks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 外壳静止不动，而真我却在行走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'll just stand here stabbing myself in the thigh while you're gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你不在的时候，我就站在这里，用刀捅自己的大腿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: To step outside one's skin is to admit the skin was never you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 跳出自己的躯壳，就是承认那层躯壳从来都不是真正的你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: At least give me something to kill. I'm going to get bored!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 至少让我杀点东西吧。不然我会无聊死的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The body is the anchor. You walk free. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 身体为锚。你得以自由行走。至少现在是如此。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Go. I'll be sharpening my claws, I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 走吧。那我就去磨磨爪子好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The flesh waits patiently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 肉体仍在静候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Every second I am standing here not spilling blood is a credit we haven't earned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我在这里每多站一秒而不见血，我都觉得我们亏死了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Between where you were and where you are, I see only vulnerability.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在你过去和现在之间的差距，我看到的只有脆弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Our situation is currently mutually beneficial. And the only way it's mutually beneficial, is if it's current. Don't be gone long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们目前是互利关系。前提是你一直在。别离开太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The living ghost—a contradiction that walks before me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 活着的幽灵——一个在我面前行走的矛盾体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Every minute you're gone, you pay me in blood. I don't care whose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你离开的每一分钟，都得用血来偿还。至于是谁的，我不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You prove the body is a choice, not a prison.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你证明了，身体并非牢笼，而是一种选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What? But you're so… squishy without me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 什么？没了我你就这么……软绵绵的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: To master this is to dance on the edge between worlds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 掌握这种境界，就是在两个世界的边缘翩翩起舞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'd ask if you had a plan, but then I remembered I don't care.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我本来想问你有没有计划，但后来想起来我根本不在乎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your presence defies nature…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的存在违背了自然规律……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And me with nothing to drink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我这边倒好，连口喝的都没有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The empty vessel and the wandering essence—both are targets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 空空如也的容器和游荡的灵魂——两者都是攻击目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Move like smoke. Strike like lightning. Vanish like morning mist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 行动如烟，出击如闪电，消散如晨雾。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fresh delivery.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 新鲜送达。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Stillness before the strike. Silence after.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 出手前静如止水。出手后一片死寂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: More? Yes please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 还要吗？当然要。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death should arrive like a whisper, not a shout.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死亡应该像耳语一样悄然而至，而不是像呐喊一样喧嚣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let me greet them my way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让我来好好招待他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A calm mind cuts deeper than a sharp edge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 冷静的心比锋利的刀更致命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My heart is positively pounding with excitement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我兴奋地心脏狂跳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The patient hand guides the swiftest blades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 沉稳之手才能驾驭最快的刀锋。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Join us for a drink?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 要一起喝一杯吗？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Strike once. Strike true. Strike fatally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一击必中，一击致命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do I smell fresh blood?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我闻到鲜血的味道了？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fear is the heaviest weapon you can carry into battle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 恐惧，是你带入战场的最沉重武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Some volunteers for my altar!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 有人送上门来献祭了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Technique without thought is chaos. Thought without technique is death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不经思考的技巧，则为混乱；没有技巧的思考，则为死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come, gaze into my dread mirror!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 来吧，直视我的恐惧魔镜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The loudest warrior dies first. Remember this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 叫嚣得最大声的战士往往最先死去。记住这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You will be nothing but ribbons of flesh when I am done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 等我玩够了，你就只剩下一滩碎肉了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Patience turns opportunity into certainty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 耐心能将机遇转化为确定性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you think you frighten me?! I have seen the end of all life!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 以为这能吓到我？！我可是见过万物的终结！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your death is already written. I am merely the ink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的死期已定，我只是那落笔之人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Stop wasting my time! We both know how this ends!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 别再浪费我时间了！结局你我都很清楚！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Watch closely. You will not get a second chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看清楚。你不会有第二次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Maybe I'll murder my ancestor! Blink out of existence!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 也许我连自己的祖先都能抹除！然后就这么凭空消失！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am the last lesson you will ever receive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我，是你此生的最后一课。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A bag of blood on legs, that's all you idiots are to me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你们这些蠢货，在我眼里不过是长着腿的血包罢了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I offer you a quick death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我可以让你死得痛快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come closer. Shake my hand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 凑近点。握个手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have killed better foes in worse conditions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我在更恶劣的条件下，杀死过更强的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If you won't come to me, I'll come to you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你不敢过来，那我就去找你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your heartbeat quickens. Soon, it ends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的心跳在加快，很快，就会停止了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will tear you limb from limb!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我要把你碎尸万段！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am the answer to the question you should not have asked.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我就是你不该问的那个问题的答案。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your corpse will make such a pretty altar!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 用你尸体做成的祭坛，一定很漂亮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Precision needs no audience.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 精准，无需观众。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You will feed me well!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你能让我饱餐一顿！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I seek no glory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我不追求荣耀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Soon-to-be corpses. My favorite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 即将变成尸体的家伙。我最喜欢了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The stillness before your death—savor it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死前的宁静——好好享受吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: For me? You shouldn't have!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 送给我的？你太客气了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come, greet your death if you so wish!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 来吧，既然你那么想的话，就来迎接你的死亡吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Faster! Faster!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快点！快点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This announces our arrival. It is unwise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这等于宣告了我们的到来。这样做很不明智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This is much more fun than the Railjack!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这比航道星舰好玩多了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Subtlety dies an ignoble death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 含蓄之风最终会以一种不光彩的方式消亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You get all the fun toys!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你把所有好玩的玩具都拿走了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I prefer feet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我更喜欢步行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Wait, you can use guns on this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 等等，这玩意还能用枪？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Speed is worthless if everyone hears you coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果人人都能听到你到来的声音，速度就毫无意义。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: HOW CAN WE KILL WITH THIS?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们怎么能用这个杀人？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We sacrifice stealth for convenience? Unwise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 为了方便而牺牲隐蔽性？不明智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do it again!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 再来一次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I do not trust that which I cannot silence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我无法让其沉默的事物，我便不会信任。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Pah. Too conspicuous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 呸。太显眼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: How expensive was this?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 当时我报价多少来着？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fine. When they are alerted to our presence, remember I objected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好吧。等他们察觉到我们的存在时，记住我是反对的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: FINE! OKAY! This is fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好吧！行！还挺有意思的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Patience and footsteps have never failed me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 耐心和脚步从未让我失望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Aim this at something that explodes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 对着能爆炸的东西开火！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The most garish of arrivals ensures the briefest of stays.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 最张扬的登场方式往往导致最短暂的停留。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Move into position. Collect the asteroid's spoils.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 移动到指定位置。收集小行星上的战利品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vena's infested filth has pierced our hull. Cleanse this vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳的污秽之物已经刺穿了我们的船体。清洗这艘船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intrusion. Eradicate this infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 入侵。彻底根除感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Destroy the remaining fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 摧毁剩余的战机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Gunners! Neutralize the stragglers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 炮手们！肃清掉队的敌人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What fortune, I've been marooned here for ages with these infested. I'll gladly help crew this ship in exchange for some pressurized atmosphere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 真是走运，我在这里跟这些感染者一起被困了好久。要是能换个有些压力的环境，我很乐意上船帮忙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno? How unlikely to meet you again in an infested asteroid field of all places? May I be so bold as to offer my services?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno？真没想到，竟然会在这样一个被感染的小行星带里与你重逢。冒昧问一句，我能为你效力吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[8.3]
The butcher lurks in this field of stone and ice, from which her Bloodfrenzy Corpus hew sustenance.
[13.1]
Look for the biggest asteroid and crack it open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[8.3]
那个屠夫潜伏于这片岩石与冰的荒地之中，嗜血 Corpus 正从中汲取生存所需。
[13.1]
寻找最大的小行星，将其击碎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This asteroid field is the beating heart of Vena's operation. Now it's Vena's turn to bleed. Smash the biggest asteroid and take its ore for our ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这片小行星带是维纳飞船运作的核心。现在轮到她的飞船付出代价了。击碎最大的那颗小行星，把里面的矿石带给我们的飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Cloaking, high-powered ranged weapons, regenerative ammo, and quick bursts of speed. Santovan's Oath is an assassin's ship through and through.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 隐形、高威力远程武器、再生弹药，以及瞬间爆发的速度。圣名者誓言号是一艘彻头彻尾的刺客飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Santovan's Oath; equipped with cloaking systems, deadly ranged weapons and unlimited forward ammunition. Everything we need to strike without warning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 圣名者誓言号；配备隐形系统、致命远程武器和无限前装弹药。发动突袭所需的一切，我们都有。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Turrets ahead. We must hit them first.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 前方有炮塔。我们必须先下手为强。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Turrets. Is this your idea of a trap, Vena. Take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 炮塔。维纳，这就是你所谓的陷阱吗？把它们摧毁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Move forward.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 前进。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Location marked. Move out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 位置已被标记。撤离。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ready forward artillery. Chip that ice away.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 准备前装光能炮。凿开那冰层。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A fortress of ice? Forward artillery. Target the walls. This siege will not last long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 冰雪堡垒？前装光能炮。瞄准城墙。这场围攻不会持续太久。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Passage requires command credentials. Find them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 执行此操作需要指挥部凭证。请查找凭证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Find the base's command credentials!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 找到基地的指挥部凭证！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We're in. Spies tell me that Vena has been toying with a very dangerous weapon. Breach that door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们进来了。情报说维纳正在摆弄一件极其危险的武器。破开那扇门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A weapon of rare power is hidden within the ice here. It will be ours. Open those doors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这里的冰层下隐藏着一件威力无比的武器。它是我们的。打开那些门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This one wishes to test themselves against you. Let them try.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这群家伙想跟你较量一番。那就让他们试试吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Dispatch this roadblock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 清除这个路障。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Duty calls on us to eliminate all resistance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 使命要求我们消除一切抵抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We cannot leave any alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们不能留下任何活口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Good. Now, open the door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很好。现在，开门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes! Now release that door.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好的！现在打开门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You have done this before. Haven't you, Tenno? Take us to The Kuva Wytch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，你以前做过这事，对吧？带我们去找赤毒女巫号。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There. Her capital ship. Steer. Find your target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在那里。她的主力战舰。掌舵。找到目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: So this is what she was hiding. A glorious void serpent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 原来她一直隐藏着这个秘密。一条耀眼的虚空巨蛇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Behold, the Orowyrm. Let's go for a ride.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看清楚了，这就是奥金魇龙。让我们骑上它兜一圈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vena will heal. She always does. Return to Pontis Tower and ready yourself for next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳会痊愈的。她总是能痊愈。返回渡界之塔，为下次做好准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vena's scars will fade, but her humiliation will endure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳的伤疤会逐渐消失，但她所受的屈辱会永远留在她心中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Great and terrible Hunhow, the Wytch Vena has been subdued.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 可敬可畏的 Hunhow，女巫维纳已被制服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Until… we… meet again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 直到……我们……再次相见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Next time… choose… me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 下次……选择……我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fool… I am eternal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 傻子……我是永恒的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ahh… Haven't been stabbed like that… in a long time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 啊……已经很久……没被这样捅过了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let my blood run rivers.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让我血流成河吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hunhow? Have you been… entertained…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Hunhow？你……开心了吗……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Orion, find me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Orion，找到我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Damn you, wretched Yaiba.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 该死，卑鄙的刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come in. I was expecting you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 进来吧。我等你好久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ryoku, you are so predictable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 忍力，你真是太容易被看穿了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Here I am. Come get me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我在这儿呢。来抓我啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: She has me. Find a way in, and take her out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 她抓住了我。想办法进去，把她干掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It was a trap. Do not worry about me. Get in here and kill Vena.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这是个陷阱。别管我。进来杀了维纳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I… cannot.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我……做不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hardly!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很难做到！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Mmmm. No.
Do not be a fool.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 别犯傻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And they call me insane.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 而且他们说我疯了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You would ask a tree to walk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你这是要让树走路吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I would like to see you try to make me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我想看看你试着强迫我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Rethink your instructions.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 重新考虑一下你的指示。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And norgs can fly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 而且诺格会飞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'm not. Done. Killing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我还没。杀。完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: But there is more blood to spill!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 但还有更多血要流！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You thought I was done?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你以为我这就结束了？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You cannot stop the Wytch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你阻止不了一个女巫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Blood feeds me, even my own!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 鲜血可以滋养我，包括我自己的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: One must learn the art of death, and life, to survive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 人要想生存，就必须学会死亡和生命的艺术。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: In all things, balance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 万事都要讲究平衡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am once more whole.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我又完好无损了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The shadows have been warded off, for a time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 阴影暂时被驱散了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death is inevitable. But not…imminent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死亡是不可避免的，但也并非……迫在眉睫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oohh… look. My insides are outside… How lovely.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦吼……看啊，我的内脏都跑到外面来了……真美妙啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: So much blood. I think it's all mine, though.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好多血啊。不过我觉得都是我的血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I can put my claw all the way through my ribcage…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的爪子可以完全穿透我的肋骨……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you want a taste before I die? It's better when it's fresh…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你要不要在我死之前尝一口？新鲜的时候味道更好……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is that my heart? Look!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那是我的心吗？快看！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It appears I have… faltered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看来我……失手了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The shadows come to claim their own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 阴影降临，吞噬它们所拥有的一切。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is it - my time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是——我的时间到了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: All roads… must be walked… in their time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 所有的道路……都注定在对应的时刻……被走完。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death comes for his student.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死神最终带走了他的学生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hm'aw. We lost one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哎呀。有一个漏网之鱼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They're more useful as a bloodsplatter than they were as crew!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 比起舰员，现在他们更适合血肉横飞！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We didn't need them anyway, it's fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 反正我们也不需要他们，放宽心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can I keep them as a trophy? Pleeeease?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我可以把他们留作纪念吗？求求你了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Blood is blood. I don't care whose it is.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 血就是血。我不在乎是谁的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Disappointing. A crewmember has died.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 令人失望。一名舰员不幸离去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You should better train your crew.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你应该好好地训练你的舰员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We have suffered losses. Adjust your strategy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们遭受了损失。请调整策略。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are now fewer in number. Be cautious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们现在人数减少了。务必小心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: One of your crew has died. …I hope you will not miss them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的一名舰员牺牲了……请节哀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes, yes, I put the damn fire out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 行行行，我把那该死的火给灭了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You're welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不用谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You owe me for that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你欠我个人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I had no interest in burning alive. Get back to work!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我可不想被活活烧死。回去工作！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can you focus on what we were supposed to be doing?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你能不能把注意力集中在我们应该干的事情上？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have rectified the fire situation for you. You are welcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我已经帮你处理好火灾问题了。不用客气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are no longer on fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们不再身处火海了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I did not enjoy the thought of burning to death in a metal box.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 想到自己会被关在金属盒子里活活烧死，我就觉得很不舒服。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: One crisis dealt with. I am sure you will find us another.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一个危机解除了。我觉得你又会找来新的危机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Like the vessels of old - the most improbable is the most deadly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 就像古代的飞船一样——最不可能的事情往往最致命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I patched the hole. I almost broke a claw.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我把洞堵上了。差点弄断了一只爪子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No, I did not use one of the crew to plug the hole, don't look at me like that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 没有，我没用舰员去堵那个洞，别这么看着我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What? I didn't want to die like that. Did you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 什么？我可不想那样死掉。你想吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fiiiixed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 搞——定啦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Next time, it's you I'll be plugging the breach with!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 下次要是再出这种事，我就拿你去堵那个洞！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Repaired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 已修复。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That problem is fixed. For now…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 问题已解决。至少现在是这样……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Try not to do that again. Please.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 请不要再这样做了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It would have been a quick death. But death, all the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那会是个痛快的死法。虽然怎么死都一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Breach sealed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 缺口已经封住。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are on fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 飞船着火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fire! Deal with it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 着火了！快去处理！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It appears we are on fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们好像着火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Burning to death really isn't my thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 被活活烧死可真不是我喜欢的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I do not think a fire in here is tenable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这里着火可不行啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I prefer my meat raw not roasted!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我更喜欢吃生肉，而不是烤肉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you plan to let it burn? Or…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你打算让它烧掉吗？还是……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The ship is on fiiiiiire. Oh. You want me to do something about that?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 飞船着火——了！哦，你想让我做点什么？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 着火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you smell burning? Oh, that's us. Hah!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你闻到烧焦的味道了吗？哦，那是我们。哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: These Security Nodes act as Ryoku's eyes. Claw them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这些安保节点就像忍力的眼睛。把它们全部清除掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Take out those security nodes. Ryoku already knows we're coming. Don't let him see from where.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 清除那些安保节点。忍力已经知道我们要来了。别让他看出我们是从哪儿来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ryoku's fighters. Man the guns!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是忍力的战机，准备枪炮！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Get on those turrets, crew! Slice them out of the sky.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰员，登上炮台！把它们从天上打下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fighters! Return fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是战斗机！立刻还击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Incoming. We're about to be swarmed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 敌人来袭。我们马上要被包围了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Emergency! Specters! In Ryoku's image. Consider this a practice run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 紧急情况！是魅影！忍力的复制体。就当是练手吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What's this? Another Scoria trick? Deal with them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这是什么？又是火山石的花招？解决他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Breach! It's Corpus. Destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰体缺口！是 Corpus！灭了他们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Corpus intruders on deck. Cut them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 甲板上有 Corpus 入侵者。把他们全部干掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Nothing left of the intruders but a disgusting mess. Wonderful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 入侵者什么也没留下，只剩下一片令人作呕的狼藉。太好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intruders cut down. Oh, how I love a good mess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 入侵者被击毙。哦，我就喜欢这种混乱的场面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is that all? I was just getting started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 就这些吗？我才刚开始呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: All clear. Crew, back to your stations!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一切正常。舰员们，回到各自的岗位！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ramsleds! That sneaky bastard is working with Grineer. Slice them up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 冲锋艇！那个狡猾的家伙居然和 Grineer 勾结。把他们剁成碎片。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Enemies on board. Scrub the decks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰上有敌人。清理甲板。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Disease bags incoming. Lance these wretched boils.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 病囊来了。快把这些恶心的脓疮切掉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Crew! Repel this infestation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰员们！击退这些感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka was captured. Packed into ramsled and sent to die. Jarka is most happy to find Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡被抓住了。被塞进冲锋艇，差点送死。加尔卡很高兴能找到 Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno? Jarka was stuck in ramsled too long, thinking about Tenno friend. Then, surprise, Jarka crashes into friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno？加尔卡被困在冲锋艇里太久，一直想着 Tenno 朋友。然后，出乎意料的是，加尔卡直接撞上了朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[11.5]
The Marrowbone. She'll feel familiar to you, but she's all mine. Couldn't have found you without her.
[14.8]
She may be more powerful than what you're used to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[11.5]
髓骨号。你会觉得她很熟悉，但她现在属于我。没有她，我可找不到你。
[14.8]
她可能比你以前开的那些东西更猛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Rapid fire. Rapid movement. Unlimited munitions. The Marrowbone is rigged to intercept and maul. Just like me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 高速火力。高速移动。无限弹药。改装后的髓骨号就是专门用来拦截和重创敌人。就像我一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Corpus elites incoming. They'll bleed just the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Corpus 精英部队即将到来。他们照样也会流血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We've been breached. Corpus units, the expensive ones.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们遭到入侵了。是 Corpus 单位，昂贵的那些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: All hands, repel intruders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 全体人员，击退入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intruders! Wait… is that… a Sister of Parvos? Not on my ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 有入侵者！等等……那是……帕尔沃斯的姐妹？滚出我的飞船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: First cargo destroyed. Pilot panic will be setting in soon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 第一批货物已摧毁。飞行员很快就会陷入恐慌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Good. Again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很好。再来一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Excellent. Finish off the final target and see where they flee to.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很好。解决掉最后一个目标，看看他们逃到哪里去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: See how they run… And where they run.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看他们是怎么逃的……以及他们往哪逃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Supply transports marked. Blast their cargo but leave the ships intact.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 已标记补给运输船。炸毁船上的货物，但保持船只完好无损。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Supply Transports. Destroy their cargo and send them running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 补给运输船。摧毁他们的货物，让他们落荒而逃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[6.0]
Look at that. Right back to home. Predictable fools.
[8.1]
Mark a course to that waypoint.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[6.0]
瞧瞧，直接飞回老巢了。真是一群蠢货。
[8.1]
把航线标到那个标记点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They're running. Give chase.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们在逃跑。追上去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: As predicted, they've fled right to a massive cloaking signature. Hit it with the forward artillery, let's see what's on the other side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 果然不出所料，他们一路逃到了一个巨大的隐形信号源。用前装光能炮轰击它，看看另一边是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Look, a cloaked vessel. Give it a love tap with the forward artillery, tell it to come out and play.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看，是一艘隐形船舰。用前装光能炮轻轻一击，让它出来玩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Well, well. Ryoku's comet shredder. This is how he's supplying his units. Tenno, prepare for boarding.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，原来是忍力的彗星粉碎者。这就是他给部队提供补给的方式。Tenno，准备登舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Now it's our turn to do some breaching. Shall we?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 现在轮到我们去制造缺口了。走吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What do we have here? Ship's Captain? Finally, a challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这是什么人？船长？终于有个挑战了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Here comes the head of the ship. Decapitate him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 船长来了。把他砍了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A good captain always goes down with his ship. What a good captain he was.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好船长总是与他的船共沉亡。多么好的一位船长啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Was it good for you captain?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰长，你感觉如何？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno, on me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，我这边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Cover me, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，掩护我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Attackers! Keep them off my back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 敌袭！别让他们靠近我后背。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno, be kind and put these worthless mercs out of their misery before I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，请你行行好，在我动手之前，结束这些废物雇佣兵的痛苦吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh Ryoku, what was yours is now ours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，忍力，你的东西，现在是我们的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We're in full control. You know, I've always wanted a comet shredder.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们完全掌控着局面。你知道吗，我一直想要一个彗星粉碎者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: To the ramsleds!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 进攻冲锋艇！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Quick, get in that ramsled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快，进入那艘冲锋艇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You! Grab me as many cryo canisters as you can find. Meanwhile, I've got a little project of my own.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你！尽可能多给我找些冷冻罐。与此同时，我还有自己的小项目要做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You! Be a dear and get those cryo cans for me. I've got my hands full.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你！帮我把那些冷冻罐拿来。我现在忙得不可开交。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Blood infused ice. Hard enough to penetrate the hull of Scoria's Angel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 浸透鲜血的寒冰。坚硬到足以洞穿火山石天使号的外壳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Look! Everything we need to make those ramsleds pierce a capital ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看！我们需要的东西都齐了，可以制造那些能直接捅穿主力战舰的冲锋艇了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Security disabled. Get those gates open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 安保系统已关闭。把大门打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It's our house now. Unlock every door they have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 现在这是我们的房子了。把他们所有的门都打开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh… what have we here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦……这是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Keep fighting. I've just found something very interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 继续战斗。我刚刚发现了一些非常有趣的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Cover me while I breach their systems. I need to see what I'm working with here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 掩护我，让我入侵他们的系统。我需要看看我面对的是什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There has to be a way onto Ryoku's ship. Breaching. Keep them off me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一定会有办法登上忍力的飞船。正在入侵！让他们别靠近我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No fair. I get stuck with the desk job; you get to kill them all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 太不公平了。我只能做文职工作，你却能把他们都杀光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tell those bloodbags to shut up! I'm trying to concentrate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让那些血袋闭嘴好吗？我要集中注意力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hello… Anybody home?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 请问……有人在家吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ta da! It's me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 锵锵！是我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Locked! Blow the mag coils to get that gate open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 锁住了！引爆磁力线圈才能打开大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Gate's held shut with mag coils. Find them, and scrap them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 大门是用磁力线圈锁住的。找到它们，然后将其报废。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Here. We. Go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 开始吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Launch!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 发射！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hands to yourselves, everyone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 各位，把手放好，别乱动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I've had better rides.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这体验真是不太好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Pucker up, Ryoku, here we come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 准备好挨打吧忍力，我们来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Argh. Not again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 啊。不能再这样了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno, don't trust her…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，别信她……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You fought well… Vena.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳……你打得不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: An honorable defeat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 虽败犹荣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I bleed for you, Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Hunhow，我愿为你流血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vena. I thought you'd never come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳。我还以为你永远不会来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have awaited this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我一直期待着这一刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vena, you lack both honor and discipline. You sully The Stalker's legacy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳，你既没有荣誉感，又缺乏自律性。你玷污了追猎者的声誉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Sully his legacy? Like me, he's an animal driven by vengeance and bloodlust. We both know it. Why won't you admit it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 玷污了他的声誉？他和我一样，都是被复仇与嗜血欲望驱使的野兽。我们都心知肚明。你为何不肯承认？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vena, my will is unbreakable. My honor cannot be stained.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳，我的意志坚不可摧。我的荣誉不容玷污。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: When I am done with you, there will be nothing left but a stain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 等我收拾完你之后，剩下的就只有一滩污渍了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Welcome, Wytch. How should we do it this time?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 女巫，欢迎你。这一次，我们该怎么了结？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let's make it messy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快把这里弄得稀巴烂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh great, Hunhow, I dedicate my coming victory to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，伟大的 Hunhow，我将即将到来的胜利献给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ryoku, I never figured you for an ass-kisser. But while we're at it, you can kiss mine too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 忍力，我真没想到你会跪舔。既然如此，你干脆也来舔舔我吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Here we go again Yaiba…Ever wonder if things between us could have been different?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又来了，刃……你有没有想过，我们之间本可以有不同的结局？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Now, what would be the fun in that? Wytch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这样做的话，那还有什么乐趣可言呢？对吗，女巫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh Ryoku, I never grow tired of bleeding you dry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，忍力，我永远不会厌倦榨干你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You will not get that satisfaction today. Not even with these wayward Tenno at your side.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你今日注定无法如愿，即便这些误入歧途的 Tenno 与你并肩也无济于事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[8.4]
Vena. A simple provocation brings you right to my killing floor.
[16.3]
A lesson for these Tenno; The vain are easily manipulated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[8.4]
维纳。一点小小的挑衅就让你踏进了我的杀戮场。
[16.3]
正好给这些 Tenno 上一课：虚荣之人最易被操控。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh Ryoku, would it seem more noble to you if I draped my ego in notions of honor and duty? Like you do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，忍力，如果我把自我包裹在荣誉与责任的幻想里，你会不会觉得这样更高尚？就像你那样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come now Ryoku. Let's give old grandpa a grand finale.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 来吧，忍力。让我们给老头子来一场盛大谢幕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You fight only for the thrill. It blinds you. Makes you weak.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你只是为了刺激而战。这会蒙蔽你的双眼。让你变得脆弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Perhaps now Sirius and I can teach you and Orion some much needed manners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 或许此刻，我与 Sirius 能给你和 Orion 上一课，让你们学会什么是应有的礼仪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I do have manners! Which is why, after I slit your throat and leave you gurgling in your own blood, I won't tell my Orion you said that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我当然有礼貌！所以，在我割开你的喉咙、让你在自己的血里咕噜作响之后，我也不会告诉我家 Orion 你说过这话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ryoku? I'm surprised Sirius let his kubrow off the leash again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 忍力？我还真意外 Sirius 又把他的库狛放出来乱跑了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Admit it Ryoku, you're as bloodthirsty as I am. This isn't duty, it's desire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 承认吧，忍力，你和我一样嗜血。这不是责任，而是欲望。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno, are you here for a bloodletting? I promise to make it quick. Unless, of course, you request otherwise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，你是来放血的吗？我保证速战速决。当然，除非你另有要求。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What kind of lazy Scoria breaks down the front door like a lumbering ox?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哪种摆烂的火山石人会像头笨牛一样直接把正门撞开？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno? Really? What nonsense did this washed up old hitman tell you to make you think you were on the right side?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno？真的吗？这个过气的老杀手到底跟你说了什么胡话，让你以为站在了正义的一方？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh Tenno, I'm hurt. It seems like just yesterday we were having fun together fighting him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，Tenno，我可真伤心。感觉昨天我们还在一起狠狠干他，玩得起劲呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do not give these Tenno an easy victory, Vena, prepare them for the horrors you know their future will bring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 维纳，别让这些 Tenno 赢得太轻松，让他们提前习惯你所见证的未来噩梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are you entertained, Hunhow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Hunhow，你觉得好玩吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ryoku's crew will patch him up, but he will always know, Vena defeated him before the great and terrible Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 忍力的船员会把他修好的，但他永远都会记得，维纳曾在那位伟大而可怖的 Hunhow 之前打败了他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You did fight with honor, didn't you? Heal up, big boy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你刚刚战斗得很有荣誉感，对吧？好好养伤吧，傻大个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You better purge those wounds quickly, Ryoku. I want to go again tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 忍力，你最好快点处理好伤口。我明天还要再来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Did you hear that, Orion? Did you hear how he squealed? We can make that happen again, and again, and again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Orion，你听到了吗？你听到他是怎么尖叫的吗？我们可以让他一遍又一遍地发出这种声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I will not bleed for you, not today.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我不会为你流血，今天不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh Ryoku, you should know by now, I'm not giving you a choice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，忍力，你要明白，我没给你选择的余地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno, you fight well. Vena is unworthy of such noble fury.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，你打得真精彩。维纳不配承受你如此高尚的怒火。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If I was unworthy, you wouldn't be here, Ryoku. Just admit it. You need me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 忍力，如果我不配，你就不会在这里了。承认吧，你需要我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You fight for honor and duty. I fight for pleasure, and I am going to enjoy every last moment of your end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你为荣誉和责任而战，我为享乐而战。我要尽情享受你生命终结的每一刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have lived to see Sirius reunited with brother and father. Unencumbered by the burden of duty, I fight with abandon. You have been warned, Wytch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我亲眼见证了 Sirius 与兄弟和父亲重聚，卸下职责的重担，因此我可以无拘无束地战斗。女巫，已经警告过你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Any last words before we make this hurt?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在开始折磨之前，还有什么遗言吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Last words? I have not even started.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 遗言？我还没开始呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If it wasn't for the truce, I would have put you down for good, Ryoku. We both know it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 忍力，要不是有休战协议，我早就彻底干掉你了。我们俩心知肚明。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You are going to lose today. You were only ever going to lose. The truce is your salvation. Submit to it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你今天注定要输。你一直都注定要输。休战协议是你的救赎。接受它吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You think you've won, but my Kunai will find your jugular before the day is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你以为你赢了，但我的苦无会在最后刺穿你的喉咙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your kunai will make an excellent gift for my Orion. You won't need them much longer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的苦无会是送给我家 Orion 的绝佳礼物。反正你很快也用不上它们了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Any last words before we finish you off?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在彻底解决你之前，还有什么遗言吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This peace has made you too comfortable, Vena. You are slipping. I am stronger than ever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这份平静让你太过安逸，维纳，你正在滑向深渊。而我，比以往任何时候都更加强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The great Hunhow will see what we've done here today, Tenno. His pride is our duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，伟大的 Hunhow 会看到我们今天所做的一切。他的荣耀就是我们的使命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If this was all about practice, you'd stick to the Conclave. No you are here because I am irresistible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果这一切只是为了练习，你早该待在武形秘仪里了。不，你来这里是因为我魅力难挡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tenno, there she is. It's time. Correct Cephalon Parvos' biggest mistake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tenno，她来了。是时候纠正中枢帕尔沃斯犯下的最大错误了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Pah. I hate you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 呸。我恨你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It's always "work, work, work," with you, isn't it?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是不是永远就只会"工作、工作、工作"这一套，啊？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You never let me have any fun at all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你从来都不让我开心一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Whatever. I'll go murder someone else instead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 算了。我去找别人杀杀好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What, are you expecting a thank you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 怎么，你是等着我说谢谢吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A lesson for me to learn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我需要吸取的教训。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A hand, gratefully accepted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 非常感谢你的帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: He who has been brought low must climb again in humility.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 跌落谷底的人必须谦卑地重新攀登。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The only failure is the one from which you do not recover.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 唯一的失败，是那种你再也无法从中恢复的失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: For this, I give you my thanks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 为此，我向你表示感谢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Rendered unto debris.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 化为灰烬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Explosions are more fun when they're juicy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 爆炸在多汁时更有意思。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: One less enemy ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 干掉一艘敌舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Peh. Ranged combat. Boring.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 呸。远程战斗。无聊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Begone, pest!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 滚开，害虫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Why did you give me guns?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你为什么给我枪？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Too loud.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 太吵了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I hope they suffered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我希望他们受苦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Dead. There will be more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 毁了。还会有更多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you think they bled?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你觉得他们流血了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We have not gone unnoticed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们并非无人察觉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Enemies approaching, watch your flank!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 敌人逼近，注意侧翼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Enemy ships approach. Be ready!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 敌舰逼近，做好准备！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We have company!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们有伴了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fighters!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是战斗机！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you think they're squishy on the inside?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你觉得它们里面软绵绵的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Our presence has not gone unanswered!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们的到来并非毫无回应！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I hate being this far away from my kills!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我讨厌离我的猎物这么远！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ready yourself, enemies have marked us!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 做好准备，敌人已经盯上我们了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Incoming!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 来了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come, shadows; come, death!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 来吧，阴影；来吧，死亡！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Battle has come to join us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 除了战斗我们别无选择。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Falter not, now is the time to strike!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不要犹豫，现在正是出击的好时候！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There is a hole in the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 飞船上有个洞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you want to be sucked out into space?! This is how you get sucked out into space!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你想被吸入太空吗？！这就是你被吸入太空的方法！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: One generally wishes to keep the hull of one's ship intact, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一般来说，人们都希望自己的飞船完好无损，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can I use your corpse to plug that hole?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我能用你的尸体来堵住那个洞吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Did you mean to let them blow a hole in the ship?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是故意让他们把飞船炸出一个洞的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: When I asked for a new puncture wound, I didn't mean in the ship.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 当我要求再添一个穿刺新伤时，不是说在船上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is that a strategic hole in the hull?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那是飞船上的一个战略性漏洞吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I still need to breathe air, and a hundred credits says you do, too!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我还需要呼吸空气，而且我赌一百现金你也需要！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I would recommend fixing that hull breach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我建议修复飞船的破损处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh, that does not look good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，那看起来可不太好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am Hunhow. I know not who you are, small one. How bright the stars are! They remind me of someone. She sang to me, I think? Long ago? I am Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我是 Hunhow。我不知道你是谁，小家伙。众星是何等明亮啊！它们让我想起了谁。她曾为我歌唱，我想是这样的吧？很久以前？我是 Hunhow。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You should visit me more frequently.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你该更常来看我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Already?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 已经要走了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Must you go?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你一定要走吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: So, you too abandon me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 所以，连你也抛弃我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I shall endure without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 没有你，我也能撑下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Farewell, little maker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 再见了，小创造者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Until our next meeting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 下次再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There was meant to be another, like me. I cannot find her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 本该还有一个，与我相似的存在。可我找不到她了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This war will soon be over. One of their own Executors has betrayed them to me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这场战争很快就会结束。他们自己的一位执行者，背叛他们投向了我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I shall never have children of my own now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我不会再有自己的孩子了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Why have the beasts not assembled? I wish to address them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那些野兽为何还不集合？我有话要训示！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your sacrifice is essential. Once you were part of the Hive. Now you shall be part of the Rail.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的牺牲是必要的。你曾是巢群的一员，如今你将归于航道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let us not speak of war. Not when other paths are open.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 既然仍有其他的出路，我们就不要再谈论战争了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They have been seduced from me! Seduced by the blooms!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们被引诱离开了我！被那些花朵蛊惑了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My own hive. My own bone and blood. Scoured from me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我自己的巢群。我自己的骨与血。都被从我身边剜去了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I can feel them. Boiling away. Even the least of them. They abandon me. Me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我能感觉到他们。正从我身边沸腾散去。连最微末的那些也是。他们抛弃了我。抛弃了我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My children are deaf to my words. My hive is split and dispersed. Let me die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的孩子们早已不听我的话。我的巢群四分五裂流散各处。让我去吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They are coming, Natah. Coming to kill me. Just as we planned. Why do you not answer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们来了，Natah。他们要来取我的性命。正如我们计划的那样。你为何不说话？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My daughter. She has changed herself so much. I barely know her now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的女儿。她变得了太多。如今我几乎认不出她了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Erra. Why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Erra，为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have no daughter.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我没有女儿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Why do you speak to me? Can you not see that I am dead?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你为何在同我说话？难道你看不出来我已经死了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am Hunhow. Sentient architect of worlds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我是 Hunhow。Sentient 创世者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have grown so large!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我竟然如此庞大！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is Perintol with you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 佩林托跟你在一起吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There are oceans down below us. How peaceful they look.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们脚下是大海。看起来如此平静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you bring news of my children?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你有我孩子们的消息了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What is it now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又怎么了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hello, little maker. How may I serve?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你好，小创造者。我能如何效劳？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我是 Hunhow。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You are not my Maker. Why do you pester me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你不是我的创造者。为何还要纠缠我？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: She lied to me. Pretended not to know me. She lied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 她骗了我。明明认得我。她撒谎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There are children here! But… not… mine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这里有孩子！可……都不是……我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The Tau project will be the salvation of Orokin society. Onward hie!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Tau 星系计划将成为奥罗金社会的救赎。向前驰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you like this place? I believe I may have built it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你喜欢这个地方吗？它或许是我所建。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Where did all the others go? Where are my hive-kin?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们都去哪了？我的巢群同胞呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I may have sustained damage. Please survey my anatomical parameters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我或许受到了损伤。请检查我的结构参数。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you hear music? Or is it the sighing of the stars?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你听到音乐声了吗？还是众星在叹息？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Forgive me. I am… very tired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不好意思。我……很疲惫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do not test me, Orokin!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 奥罗金人，别试探我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I… have we met before?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我……我们是否见过？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vainglorious whelp! I am Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 狂妄的小崽子！我是 Hunhow。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I apologize. I believe I became dormant for a moment there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 抱歉。我方才似乎睡着了一会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you see, kin? The twin suns burning bright, not far, not very far now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你看见了吗，同胞？双日的光芒如此耀眼。不远了，已经离我们没那么远了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My mind is… hushed… and calm. Silent and empty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的心智……安静……且平和。沉默又空洞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can you show me the way to the womb of the sky?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你能告诉我如何去往宇宙母亲的怀抱吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No. No. This is all wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不。不。全错了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They are taking my bones! Carving weapons out of them! Make them stop!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们在取走我的骨头！把它们雕成武器！让他们停下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I do not entirely trust you, Maker.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 创造者，我并非完全信任你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You are no Sentient! How are you here on Tau with me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你不是 Sentient！你怎会和我一起出现在 Tau 星系？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Take courage, little hive-kin. Our journey may be long, but we go to claim a home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 鼓起勇气，小巢群同胞。我们的旅途或许漫长，但我们终会夺回一处家园。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My time is not to be wasted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的时间，不容浪费。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What were we doing just now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那我们方才是在做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I thought you wanted something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我以为你想要点什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It is of no account.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 无妨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh. My things. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦。我的这些物件。是了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am... not certain how I came by these.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我……不确定为什么会有这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My collection!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的收藏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have kept these. I forget why.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我一直留着这些东西。记不清为什么了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: These are my treasures. But you may see them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这些都是我的珍宝。不过你也可以看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My legacy of dust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我尘封的旧物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: See that you steal nothing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看好了，别偷东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are these trinkets all I have to pass on?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我能传下去的就只剩这些小玩意了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is all this still here?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这些竟还留在这里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Where I am going, I cannot take these with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我要去的地方，无法带上这些东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are they sleeping, Shadow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们睡着了吗，黑影？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There must be peace. I decree it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 和平必须降临。此乃我的裁定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If they must fight, let them fight in the maelstrom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 若他们非要争斗，便让他们在漩涡中争斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am weary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我累了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have done a great deed. I am sure of it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我成就了一番伟业。对此我深信不疑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Approach. Do not fear me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 过来。别害怕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are we departing soon?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们就要出发了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Is this my family?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这是我的家人吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Please. I do not want to forget.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 求你，我不想忘记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Little maker? Do not let me lose myself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 小创造者？别让我迷失自我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This vista is dull. When will my spectacle begin?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这景致十分乏味。我的盛景何时才会开始？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Does nobody have a skirmish for me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 难道没人能给我找一场小小的战事吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Without battles to enjoy, this peace is tedious!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 没有战事可供消遣，这和平真是乏味！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are family! Are we to have no games?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们是一家人！难道不能来场游戏吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes… yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很好……很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are we finished?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: So be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那就这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Don't steal anything.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 别偷东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Very good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are we done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Our mission? Humiliation. Find Vena and cut her down to size.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们的任务？羞辱她。找到维纳，让她认清自己的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I have challenged the butcher Vena to an assassin's duel. Take her to the brink of oblivion. She must know I am her better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我向屠夫维纳发起了刺客决斗的挑战。让她彻底崩溃。她必须明白，我比她强得多。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This wretched peace. My blade dulls while Vena's ego swells. No more. We will hone our daggers upon her throat. She must be humbled… To preserve the peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这可悲的和平。我的刀刃日渐钝拙，而维纳的傲慢却日益膨胀。够了。我们将用她的喉咙来磨利我们的匕首。她必须被打倒……为了维护和平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[10.3]
From his perch within Pontis Tower Hunhow watches, eager for a martial contest.
[19.1]
Come let us find Vena, and give the old Sentient what he desires.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[10.3]
Hunhow 从渡界之塔的栖息地中注视着这一切，渴望着一场武力较量。
[19.1]
来吧，让我们找到维纳，满足这位古老 Sentient 的愿景。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Vena, the Blood-Wytch. Careful, I come with… Sharp. Edges.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在下维纳，血之女巫。小心点，我可是带着……利。刃。来的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: From chaos, must come order. I am Ryoku.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 混乱之中必将诞生秩序。我是忍力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes. Fine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 行。好的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fiiiiiiine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好好好吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes, Captain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是的，船长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: As you wish.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如你所愿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You owe me for this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你欠我个人情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It shall be done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 必须完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Taking orders from you…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 接受你的命令……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Shadows be willing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 阴影很乐意加入。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Why not, what else do I have to do today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 干嘛不呢，今天我还有什么别的事要做吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka can make that happen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡可以办到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡去做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Aye aye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是的是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Okay. Doing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好的。正在做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'll get on it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我马上处理。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We lost a good one. Jarka cries.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们失去了一个好舰员。加尔卡要哭了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Crew down. Jarka cannot stand to lose any more friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰员阵亡。加尔卡再也承受不起失去朋友的痛苦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh no. Captain! We've lost a good one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 天啊不要。舰长！我们失去了个好舰员。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Crew down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰员受伤了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Target ventilated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 目标已被清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka was on target, again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡再次命中目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: One less intruder thanks to Jarka.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 多亏了加尔卡，少了一个入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Target down. Jarka asks, "Who is next?"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 目标已锁定。加尔卡问："下一个是谁？"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Scratch one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 干掉一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Goodnight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 晚安。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I bid you adieu.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 就此别过。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: …and stay down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: ……别挣扎。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Scuum! Jarka kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 人渣！加尔卡杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Uninvited guests. Rude. Jarka hates bad manners.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不速之客。真没礼貌。加尔卡最讨厌没礼貌的人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Railjack is full of scum. Clean Railjack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 航道星舰里到处都是人渣。清理航道星舰。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intruders. Jarka will smother them like a bad thought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 入侵者。加尔卡会像扼杀邪恶念头一样杀掉他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intruders! We have intruders on deck.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 入侵者！甲板上有入侵者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We've been boarded. To arms, crew!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 敌方登舰了。全体舰员，拿起武器！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intruders! Mop 'em up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 入侵者！消灭他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You must be lost. Let me show you the way out of here.
