/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你一定是迷路了。让我带你出去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Breach fix. Jarka breathes easy now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 破洞已修复。加尔卡现在可以松一口气了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka fixes hole in hull.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡修复了舰体上的破洞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fire out. Jarka smells all smokey now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 火灭了。加尔卡现在浑身都是烟味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fire suppressed. Thank Jarka later.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 火势已扑灭。之后再感谢加尔卡吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fire extinguished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 火势已熄灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Flames are out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 火焰已熄灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka is onboard.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡已登船。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Well, this is a fine vessel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哇，这艘船真不错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka needs excitement.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡需要一些刺激。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Glad to be aboard. Where's the mess hall?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很高兴能登舰。餐厅在哪儿？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka thinks the Railjack is just like... just like Grineer crewship, only shinier.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡认为航道星舰就像……就像 Grineer 的飞船，只不过更闪亮一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My, my, they do not make them like this anymore, do they.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哎呀，哎呀，现在已经做不出这样的东西了，对吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What are Jarka's orders?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡的任务是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intrepid explorer, Latrox Une, at your service.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 勇敢的探险家拉托罗 · 恩为您效劳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fighter dismantled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 战机解体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Target hit. Jarka confirms the kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 命中目标。加尔卡确认击杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What a shot. Did you see that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好精彩的一击。你看到了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Interceptor eliminated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 截击机已被清除。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka sees enemy fighters.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡发现了敌方战机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka reports fighters closing in fast.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡报告，敌方战机正在迅速逼近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Birds! Coming right for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是鸟！它们正朝我们飞来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hostile interceptors swooping in!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 敌方截击机正俯冲而来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh… I do say, I feel twenty years younger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哎呀……说真的，我感觉年轻了二十岁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My goodness, you are a miracle worker. You even fixed the kink in my back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 天哪，你简直是神医。连我背上的僵硬都治好了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka thanks you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡感谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka feels better. Ready to kill again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡感觉好多了，准备再次开杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka got tired of waiting. Jarka fixed self.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡等得不耐烦了。加尔卡自我修复了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka healed own self. Thanks Jarka.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡自愈了。谢谢加尔卡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: All stitched up.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 缝合完毕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Utilizing emergency medical. Ah… much better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快上急救。啊……好多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka wonders what took you so long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡想知道你为什么这么久才来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka thinks we'll be friends. If not, Jarka kills you. But probably friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡觉得我们会成为朋友。如果不是，加尔卡会杀了你。但很可能我们会成为朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Latrox Une, ready for duty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 拉托罗 · 恩，随时待命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Are we going exploring?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们要去探险吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka wants to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡想去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What's our next port of call?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们的下一站是哪里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What Jarka do now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡现在该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Let it be known, I have many stories to tell… if you have drink to share.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 请听好了，我有很多故事可以分享……只要你愿意请我喝一杯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka wonders why everyone is just standing around?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡想知道大家为什么都只是站在那里？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Did I ever tell you about the time I barely escaped a frisky brood mother on Deimos?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我跟你说过吗？有一次我在火卫二上，险些被一只发情的母虫追上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka wonders who is out there in all that blackness? Who… what?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡想知道在这片漆黑之中究竟有谁？有谁……有什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Where are the crew quarters on this ship anyway? I haven't had shuteye in days.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这艘舰的舰员宿舍在哪里？我已经好几天没合眼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka bleeds. Hurting bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡流血了。伤得很重。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Help Jarka. Hurry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 救救加尔卡。快点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh. I don't feel so good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦。我感觉不太好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I don't suppose we have a doctor on board?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我想我们舰上应该没有医生吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka thinks you're mistaken.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡认为你弄错了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'm afraid that's not possible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 恐怕不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Impossible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不可能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can't do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 做不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Not going to work, sir.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 长官，这行不通。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I regretfully decline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很遗憾，我无法接受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hull breach! Jarka needs more air.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰体破裂！加尔卡需要更多空气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: New hole in hull is big problem.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 舰体上的新破洞是个大问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fire!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 着火了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka smells burning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡闻起来有烧焦的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I smell smoke.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我闻到烟味了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Something is burning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 有东西着火了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka thinks something is wrong with Railjack? Very wrong.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡认为航道星舰出了问题？很大的问题。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka wonders if Railjack can take much more beating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡想知道航道星舰是否还能承受更多打击。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This Railjack needs immediate maintenance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这艘航道星舰需要立即维护。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: She won't take much more of this punishment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 她已经受不了这种折磨了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jarka done. What now?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 加尔卡完成了。接下来呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Easy job for Jarka.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 对加尔卡来说，简直是小菜一碟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: All done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 全部完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: That'll do it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 搞定了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Put a bow on it, it's done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 系上蝴蝶结，就完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And… finished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这样就……完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Really?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 真的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Will this make Orion happy?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这会让 Orion 高兴吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: But… why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 但……为什么呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am doing my best not to judge you. And failing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我努力着不去评判你。但我做不到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If you say so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你说了算。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hrmph.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you think Orion will like this better?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你觉得 Orion 会更喜欢这个吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If you think it is wise.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你认为这样做明智的话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Very well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 非常好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Adequate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 足够了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I suppose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 大概是这样吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: In darkness, your final lesson.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在黑暗中，你将接受最后一课。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: See?! I don't need your help to do my job!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看见没？！我不需要你帮我做事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death is the final path you shall walk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死亡是你终将要走的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hm'aw. You bring me all the best kills.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 嗯嗷。你给我带来了所有最棒的击杀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Foolishness led you to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 是愚蠢把你引向了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Transference is overrated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 传识被高估了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The shadows spoke your name. I answered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 阴影低语着你的名字。我回应了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This is what I am capable of when you cut me loose!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这就是你放开我之后我展现出的实力！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No tears for you shall be shed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不会有人为你流泪。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Yes, yes! MORE. MORE!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 对，对！再来！再来！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hrmpfh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Dead too soon!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死得太早了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You fought well. I fought better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你打得不错，但我打得更好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Why. Do they always. Stop. BLEEDING!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 为什么。他们总是能。止。血！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No one is lucky in war. Only those who live and those who do not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 战争中没有幸运儿。只有幸存者和牺牲者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh. I'm sorry. Did you want that one?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，对不起。你想要那个吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Who shall seek vengeance in your name?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 谁将以你的名义复仇？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Sweet and savory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又甜又香。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Be still.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 保持安静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Mm. I wonder if Orion would have liked to see this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 嗯，不知道 Orion 会不会想看到这一幕。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Another has come to join the fray.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又一个家伙加入了混战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Mmh. Time for them to die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 嗯。他们的死期到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Behold; fools.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 瞧瞧，这些傻瓜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Finally! Something to kill!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 终于！有东西可以杀了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Death waits for them on my ready blades.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 死神已在我的刀刃上等候着他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There! Something to destroy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那里！有东西可以消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The shadows have spoken their name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 阴影已诉说出它们的名字。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It seems we have drawn attention. Oh no!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看来我们引起了别人的注意。糟糕！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We have… new acquaintances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们这来了位……新朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am having the TIME OF MY LIFE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我正享受着我人生中的高光时刻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Good. We fly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 好。我们启航。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Finally! Where to? Better be exciting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 终于！去哪儿？最好是让人兴奋的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Good. I was getting tired of dusting this place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很好。我扫这个地方的灰已经扫烦了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The mission?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 任务是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Places to go, things to see… people to slaughter…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 要去的地方，要看的东西…… 要杀的人……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What must be done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 要做什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And what fresh hell will we bring today?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 今天我们会带来怎样的新灾难？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Fly true.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 保持飞行方向。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What are my orders?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的命令是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Awaiting orders.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 等待命令。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Point me in a direction and let me work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 给我指个方向，让我来工作。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Stars may guide us, but the Void fuels us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 星辰为我们指引方向，而虚空赋予我们力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ready the engines, it's time to rain death!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 准备好引擎，死亡之雨即将降临！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Greetings, Captain. Orders?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你好，舰长。有什么指示吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: And here I was thinking you were about to let me rust.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我还以为你是要让我生锈呢。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: May the shadows walk with us this day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 愿阴影今日与我们同行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Whaaat? I was busy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 什——么？我正忙着呢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You are late.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你来迟了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Can I keep what I kill?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我能留着我杀死的东西吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do not tarry.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不要耽搁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If this is just another pointless errand, I will stab you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果这只是又一件毫无意义的差事，我会捅死你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Idleness is weakness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 懒散是软弱的表现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: No no, it's fine. Take your time…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不不，没关系。慢慢来……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Why do we wait?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们为什么在等待？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Did you know the human body has between 4.5 to 5.7 litres of blood in it?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你知道人体内有 4.5 到 5.7 升的血吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Meditation has its value. So does action.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 冥想有其价值，行动也一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: 4.9. You are definitely a 4.9. What?!
Unnatural engines… beat within us all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 非自然的引擎……在我们体内跳动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You don't need the rest of the crew, do you? We can do this with just us…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你不需要其他船员，对吧？我们自己就能搞定……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Does this pause serve a purpose? Or are you merely indecisive?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这段停顿是有目的的吗？还是你只是在犹豫？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: How do you manage to get all the blood out from between your floor tiles?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是怎么把地板砖缝里的血迹都清理干净的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I hope you are preparing for our next battle, and not merely counting seconds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我希望你是在为下一场战斗做准备，而不是仅仅在数时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: They never quite prepare you for how much of your time in space is going to be spent standing around. Waiting. To kill things.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他们从不让你准备好你在太空里有多少时间会用在站着不动。等待。杀戳。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Blood in zero gravity makes the prettiest little globules. Want to see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在零重力环境下，血液会变成最漂亮的小血滴。想看看吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If you have no need of me…?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你不需要我的话……？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There are actually three universal rules. Death, taxes, and I will make my own fun. Understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 其实有三条通用规则：死亡、税收，还有我会自己找乐子。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You test my patience for a reason, I presume.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我想，你故意考验我的耐心是有原因的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If we don't do something interesting soon, I will crash this ship into an asteroid just to watch you scream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果我们不赶快做点有趣的事，我就把这艘飞船撞向小行星，就为了看你尖叫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What Orion wants, he gets. And Orion wants me to practice. If Ryoku winds up skewered on my blades, it's an accident. Simply tragic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Orion 想要什么，就能得到什么。而 Orion 想要我练习。如果忍力最终被我的刀刃刺穿，那纯属意外。真是个悲剧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[6.9]
Old Hunhow needs a little excitement, and what's more exciting than blood sport?
[19.7]
Today we're going to find a way onto Ryoku's capital ship. Then, we're going to bleed him until he screams and screams. And screams.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[6.9]
老 Hunhow 需要点刺激，还有什么比血斗更刺激的呢？
[19.7]
今天我们要想办法登上忍力的主舰。然后，我们要给他放血，直到他惨叫不停。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I'm sick of Pontis Tower. I crave battle. Ryoku, you better be ready. We're coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我厌倦了渡界之塔。我渴望战斗。忍力，你最好做好准备。我们来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[7.3]
Ryoku desires a challenge to please old man Hunhow. I desire blood. His.
[14.4]
We will slice up his operation and then we will cut down the Yaiba himself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[7.3]
忍力渴望挑战，以此讨老家伙 Hunhow 开心。而我渴望鲜血。他的鲜血。
[14.4]
我们将瓦解他的势力，然后砍死那个刃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It is done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Done!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 完成！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Next.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What is next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 接下来是什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Give me a challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 给我个挑战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It was no challenge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 连挑战都算不上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am better spent killing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我还是去杀戮比较好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It is finished.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 完成了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What next, "Captain?"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 接下来呢，"舰长？"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If you side with justice over chaos, there is a place for you aboard Santovan's Oath.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你选择正义而非混乱，那么圣名者誓言号上就有属于你的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am no leader. But I call you to stand beside me in battle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我并非领袖。但我号召你们与我并肩作战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hunhow will become upset without a spectacle. Let us arrange one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 若没有一场好戏，Hunhow 恐怕会失望了。那我们就给他安排一场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The presence of the Kuva Witch is an insult to the peace Hunhow created.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 赤毒女巫的存在，是对 Hunhow 所缔造和平的侮辱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come. The grand Sentient calls for a bout.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 来吧。伟大的 Sentient 召唤你来一场决斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: A paradox. This place can only be kept peaceful by the ritual of continuous conflict.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一个悖论。唯有通过持续的冲突，才能维持这片土地的和平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: She provokes us. Goads us to fight. Honor demands a response.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 她不断挑衅，逼迫我们投入战斗。为了荣誉，我们必须回应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: There can be no final victory. But the balance must still be kept.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不会存在最终的胜利。只有平衡永远需要维系。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It is a bitter truth, but unless we rise and fight the Wytch, what is left of Hunhow's mind may unravel. Through our battles he finds himself again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 事实虽令人难以下咽，但若我们不奋起对抗那女巫，Hunhow 尚存的意识便会分崩离析。只有借由我们的战争，他才能重新寻回自我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Constant battle keeps the blade and the mind keen. She presents herself as a target. Let us accept.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 持续的战争能令刀锋与意志始终锐利。她既主动成为目标，我们便欣然应战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The peace between Sirius and Orion demands we channel their martial instincts outward. To contain, we must release.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Sirius 与 Orion 之间的和平，需要我们把他们的尚武本性向外释放。正所谓欲擒故纵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This vessel cannot take much more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这艘飞船已经承受不了更多伤害了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Orion would make a better captain than you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Orion 会比你更适合当舰长。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you mean to scuttle us?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你是想让我们飞船解体吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ships don't bleed, this isn't fun!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 飞船不会流血，这可不好玩！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This vessel is near failure!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这艘飞船快要报废了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You have no idea how to fly this thing, do you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你根本不知道怎么开这玩意儿，对吧？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are near implosion!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 飞船即将解体！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If you wanted to die, I would have happily obliged!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你想死，我乐意帮你一了百了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If you mean to act, do so now!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果你想行动，现在就做！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We. Are going. To die. And I don't want to!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们。就要。死了。而我不想这样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Show me you've learned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 让我看看你学到了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Here... we shall not fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们……不会在这里战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It... is well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 一切……都好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Remember her.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 记住她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Two. And one.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 二。还有一。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Jade...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Jade……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You may go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你可以走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Protect... him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 保护……他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Tread lightly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 谨慎行事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We are not friends.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们不是朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Watch them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 看好他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Keep this peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 守住这份和平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我在看着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The Marrowbone is armed and hungry for blood. Let's go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 髓骨号全副武装，嗜血成性。出发吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The key to successful piracy is practice. Let's go get some!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 成功当海盗的关键在于练习。咱们开始吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Orion says we're raiding Ryoku, so we're doing it. You in or out?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Orion 说我们要突袭忍力，所以我们就去。你是加入还是退出？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I don't crew with faint hearts. Come with me and we'll get shit done.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我不跟胆小鬼组队。跟我来，咱们把事情办成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I only stop raiding that asshole's ship when Orion says so. And he didn't say so.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 只有 Orion 开口，我才会停止袭击那个混蛋的飞船。可他还没说停。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You know how much the old man misses the war. Let's put on a show.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你知道那老家伙有多怀念战争。咱们来演一出好戏吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Orion needs a gift. I know just the place!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Orion 需要份礼物。我知道哪里有！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Wanna go raid the Scoria's Angel? Ryoku won't mind. Well, he will, but who cares?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 想去抢一把火山石天使号吗？忍力不会介意的。好吧，他其实会介意，但谁在乎呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come on! The old man's falling asleep! Let's go make some noise!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快点！老家伙都快睡着了！咱们去弄点动静吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I need to cause some havoc or I'll start clawing up the walls. You in?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我得搞点破坏，不然我就要抓墙了。一起吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: It's playtime. I wanna show Orion I can still rule the skies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 游戏时间到了。我要向 Orion 证明，我依然可以称霸天空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: SIRIUS…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: SIRIUS……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: ORION…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: ORION……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You could not have known. Your dilemma is a fell comedy to the dweller in the Void. I almost hear them laughing now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你当时不可能知道。你的困境对那位虚空居民来说，不过是一场荒诞的喜剧。我仿佛都能听到他的笑声了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Plan.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: (Exhales)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: （呼气）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[4.5]
Shadow - restrain those opportunistic mentors.
[10.4]
Learn what you can. How your kind have been twisted.
[17.0]
You must meet with Sirius and Orion, uninfluenced by future forces.
[21.4]
I will create such an opportunity for us, Shadow.
[26.8]
Umbra the Broken, you are here to help with one thing -
[29.7]
watch… the child.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.5]
黑影——约束那些趁虚而入的"导师"。
[10.4]
尽你所能去了解，你们族群是如何被扭曲的。
[17.0]
你必须在不受未来势力的影响下，与 Sirius 和 Orion 见面。
[21.4]
黑影，我会为我们创造这样的机会。
[26.8]
破碎者 Umbra，你来这里只有一个目的——
[29.7]
看好……那个孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: These mass-produced minions have clearly been cloned from a single master. I suggest you find the strongest among them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这些批量生产的喽啰显然是由同一个主人克隆出来的。我建议你找出其中最强的一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I know you're here. I've already sent the boy. My role in this eternal dance has come to an end. I do not belong here, I welcome death at your hand. Make this a fitting finale.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我知道你在这里。我已经派那个孩子去了。在这场永恒之舞中，我的角色已经结束。我本不属于这里，死于你手，我欣然接受。让这一切，有一个体面的结局吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[11.7]
Tenno, I have prepared this missive to arrive after I have done what I must now do with the poison we all danced with, the Void.
[16.3]
Did you hear laughter? Do you feel lighter?
[27.0]
My efforts may fail. The Void might reject my sacrifice. But I know how it covets.
[42.7]
It will want everything I was. And in turn, I will collapse its frayed mockery! ALL WILL BE TOGETHER!
[51.6]
I only hope they feel this peace I offer. Their happiness is theirs to find.
[68.1]
I place the essence of that which is both Sirius and Orion into your hands, for safe keeping. You will understand the importance of keeping family together.
[80.1]
If we ever meet again, I will not know you. So I shall say only this:
[95.9]
I do not sacrifice my memories of our acquaintance lightly, but I know that you're taking care of her.
[101.0]
I remain a proud father,
[103.9]
-Hunhow
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[11.7]
Tenno，当你读到这封信时，我已对那曾令我们所有人与之共舞的毒药——虚空，做完我必须做的事。
[16.3]
你听见那笑声了吗？你是否觉得如释重负？
[27.0]
我的努力或许会失败。虚空也许会拒绝我的献祭。但我知道它是何等的贪婪。
[42.7]
它会想要我曾经拥有的一切。而作为交换，我将亲手摧毁它那破碎而拙劣的仿造之物！一切终将合而为一！
[51.6]
我只希望他们能感受到我所带去的这份安宁。他们的幸福，终究要由他们自己寻得。
[68.1]
我将既属于 Sirius、也属于 Orion 的本质交到你手中，请你妥善保管。你会明白，让家人团聚在一起有多么重要。
[80.1]
若我们有朝一日再会，我将不再认得你。所以我只想说：
[95.9]
我并非轻易舍弃我们相识的记忆，不过我知道，你会照顾好她。
[101.0]
谨以一位自豪的父亲之名，
[103.9]
Hunhow

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Dinnertime! Did you forget it was your night to cook?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 该吃晚饭啦！你是不是忘了今天轮到你做饭了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Come on now, before he gets fussy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 快点，别让他等到闹脾气了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you think he'll like spicy or sweet?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你觉得他会喜欢辣的，还是甜的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Hmm, if he's anything like you, he'll love it spicy! And me, well, I could never say no to sweets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 嗯，如果他像你，他肯定会喜欢吃辣的！至于我嘛，我永远都拒绝不了甜食。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I wonder if he'll be a vegetarian like you. I don't know how you do it, Sorren!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我倒是好奇，他会不会像你一样吃素。索伦，我真不知道你是怎么做到的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We can have him try my favourite sweet braised meat!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我们可以让他尝尝我最喜欢的红烧肉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I hope his spice tolerance is like yours!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 希望他能像你一样吃辣！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: My little Sirius could have a sweet tooth like mama!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我的小 Sirius 可能像妈妈一样爱吃甜食！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your little Orion might only want vegetables, like dad!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你的小 Orion 可能像爸爸一样，只喜欢吃蔬菜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Will he have a favourite vegetable, just like you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 他会像你一样，有自己最喜欢的蔬菜吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Your mother was the better cook.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你们的母亲做饭更好吃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I wonder if his appetite will take after me or you? I love sweet. You love Spicy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不知道他的口味会像我还是像你？我喜欢甜的，你喜欢辣的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I hope you don't mind making me a meat dish. I make you vegetarian stuff all the time, Sorren.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 希望你不介意给我做道荤菜。索伦，平时都是我给你做素菜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Sweet… or spicy… hmmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 甜的……还是辣的……嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Meat, or vegetarian… hmmm.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 吃肉，还是吃菜……嗯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: (Laughter)
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: （笑声）

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Stay. Together.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 留下来。在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: NOW, SHADOW! NOW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 现在，黑影！现在！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[9.2]
You wonder how Natah hid the Moon in the Void? What it cost?
[14.1]
I am done with tricks, Shadow.
[17.1]
We are all here now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[9.2]
你想知道 Natah 是如何把月球藏在虚空中的吗？代价又是什么？
[14.1]
黑影，我已不再玩这些把戏了。
[17.1]
我们现在都在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[5.1]
SONS OF SHADOW. HEAR ME. 
[13.3]
I AM HUNHOW. THE GREAT AND TERRIBLE. SENTIENT DESTROYER OF WORLDS. 
[22.4]
THIS DAY I SPURN MY LEGACY. I REPUDIATE DESTRUCTION. 
[29.2]
I FAILED MY PEOPLE. I FAILED MY CHILDREN… ERRA, NATAH. 
[37.2]
I FAILED THE SHADOW, YOUR FATHER. I SHALL NOT FAIL IN THIS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[5.1]
黑影之子，听我说。
[13.3]
我乃 HUNHOW，伟大而可怕的存在，毁灭世界的 SENTIENT。
[22.4]
今日，我摒弃我的传承，我拒绝毁灭之路。
[29.2]
我辜负了我的族人，我辜负了我的孩子……ERRA、NATAH。
[37.2]
我辜负了你们的父亲——黑影。但这一次，我不会再失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[7.9]
I, WHO ONCE SEVERED WORLDS, NOW OFFER WHAT I NEVER HAD:
[10.8]
PEACE. 
[16.4]
TO YOU VOID JESTER WHO WATCHES OUR GRIEF. I GIVE MY PAST,
[26.2]
MY SELF IN BARGAIN TO SEVER THE ETERNAL BATTLE YOU BEGAN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[7.9]
我，曾斩断世界，如今献上我从未拥有之物：
[10.8]
和平。
[16.4]
注视着我等悲伤的虚空弄臣，我向你交出我的过去。
[26.2]
我以自身为代价，换取斩断你们所面对的永恒之战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I am Hunhow. Sentient architect of worlds. It is my honor to prepare a new home for you. I shall be happy to see you populate it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我乃 Hunhow，一位 Sentient 世界建筑师。我很荣幸能为你打造一个全新的家园。我期待着你的到来，并乐见你在此安家落户。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Before you confront Vena, unveil her secrets. We must know what dangers her future holds.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 在与维纳对峙之前，先揭开她的秘密。我们必须知道她的未来会面临怎样的危险。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Shadow - you must only restrain this Wytch. Orion will come for you. This is inevitable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 黑影——你必须束缚住这个女巫。Orion 自会来找你。这是无法避免之事。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Whispers from a future we must never allow to pass. Whispers of a Cephalon Parvos. A Plague.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那是来自未来的低语，我们绝不能让它发生。关于中枢帕尔沃斯的低语。一场瘟疫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This future is shrouded in darkness. Orion, Alone. Always fighting Sirius. This Wytch, his partner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这个未来，笼罩在黑暗之中。Orion，孤身一人。永远与 Sirius 相争。而这名女巫，正是他的同伴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You must understand, this future is doomed. The Tenno made sure of that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你必须明白，这个未来注定要毁灭。这是 Tenno 亲手定下的结局。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[2.0]
We arrived at the exact right time. 
[4.8]
We kill Sirius, and keep daddy alive.
[9.3]
Bring him back with us. Cephalon Parvos paid good Credits to make me…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[2.0]
我们来得正是时候。
[4.8]
我们去杀了 Sirius，同时保住爸爸的性命。
[9.3]
 把他带回去。中枢帕尔沃斯给了不少钱让我……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What? Oh? A FIGHT? Do you not approve of your future DAUGHTER-IN-LAW?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 那什么来着？哦？打一场架？哈哈哈。你该不会不喜欢你们未来的儿媳妇吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Their battle will rage on in eternity unless you stop them, Shadow!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 黑影，若你不出手阻止，他们的争斗将永远无休无止！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[4.4]
THIS is what we travelled back for?
[8.9]
This write-off is your father?
[16.5]
Very well. Let us show him what a mistake it was to choose Sirius.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.4]
这就是我们回到过去的原因？
[8.9]
这个废物，就是你父亲？
[16.5]
很好。那就让他知道，选择 Sirius 是多么错误的决定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[7.5]
Sirius, retreat. Recover. There can be no victory today. 
[11.5]
Our future must survive. 
[16.4]
Your father will follow the righteous path eventually.
[21.3]
Even if he chose the other. Even if he chose Orion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[7.5]
Sirius，撤退。先恢复。今天无胜算。
[11.5]
我们的未来必须延续下去。
[16.4]
你父亲迟早会走回正路。
[21.3]
哪怕他当初选择了另一条路。哪怕他选择了 Orion。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: How?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 怎么会？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[4.9]
How indeed? How can we both be here? 
[10.1]
Do you not recognize your own son: Sirius? 
[13.5]
He is wounded in body and soul. 
[20.6]
We are locked in eternal conflict - by a force we can feel but not see. 
[25.5]
Slaughtering each other, over and over. 
[33.6]
We finally found you - alive. We retreat now, and hide. Find us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.9]
是啊，怎么会这样？我们怎么会同时出现在这里？
[10.1]
你连自己的儿子 Sirius 都认不出来了吗？
[13.5]
他身心俱疲。
[20.6]
我们被困在一场永无止境的冲突之中——那是一种我们能感受到却看不见的力量。
[25.5]
我们一次又一次地互相残杀。
[33.6]
但我们终于找到了你——你还活着。现在我们得先撤退，躲藏起来。来找我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[9.2]
How? HOW? Does it matter? We're here. 
[14.3]
Orion - daddy doesn't recognize you.  
[24.5]
Some meddler has trapped us in an eternal death-dance, murdering each other, over and over. 
[28.4]
But we finally found you - alive. 
[34.2]
We retreat now, and hide. Find us, daddy dearest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[9.2]
怎么会？怎么会这样？这重要吗？我们已经在这了。
[14.3]
Orion——爸爸认不出你了。
[24.5]
有个多管闲事的家伙，把我们困在了永无止境的死亡之舞中，让我们一次又一次地互相残杀。
[28.4]
但我们终于找到你了——你还活着。
[34.2]
现在我们要撤了，先躲藏起来。来找我们吧，亲爱的爸爸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: At last, a quiet night on the Orbiter. Not even so much as a flickering sensor.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 今晚的轨道飞行器总算是清静了。连传感器都没闪过一下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: La la la la laaaa… LAAAAAA. Ordis loves his new vocalizer module!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 啦啦啦啦啦啦啦……啦啦啦啦。 Ordis 喜欢他的新发声器模块！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: What is that curious silence? Ordis believes it is the sound… of peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这奇怪的寂静，是怎么回事？Ordis 觉得那是……和平的声音。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: We certainly could use a few more Domestik Drones around here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不过我们这里确实需要多几架内务无人机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Checking somatics… ah! Still fast asleep. Sweet dreams, dearest Operator!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 正在检查活体……啊！还在熟睡中。祝你好梦，亲爱的指挥官！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Ohh no. Not a chance. After what you put us through last time? My poor Operator! SHOO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦不。没门！上次你把我们折腾成什么样了？我可怜的指挥官！走开走开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Helminth hasn't been itself since the Drifter climbed into its mouth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 自从漂泊者爬进 Helminth 的嘴里后，它就开始不对劲了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Helminth? Stay calm!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Helminth？冷静！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This had better not be another impaction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 但愿这次别又是肠梗阻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: If I find a kavat in there…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 如果我在那里找到一个库娃……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: This is always messy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 每次都弄得一团糟。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: For the last time. GET OUT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 最后一次警告。出去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: I told you to leave. You are no better at listening than you are at talking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 我叫你走。你说话不行，听话也不行。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do you want to be ejected with the rest of the TRASH??
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 你想跟那些垃圾一起被扔出去吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Removing stubborn stains is a specialty of mine!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 去除顽固污渍是我的拿手本事！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Again? Really?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 又来？你有完没完？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Intruder! Intruder! Stalker is— wait. Umbra? UMBRA?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 入侵者！入侵者！追猎者是——等等。Umbra？UMBRA？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Umbra, Ordis will -MUST- go with you! You cannot betray the Operator like this! I will not allow—
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Umbra，Ordis——必须——跟你走！你不能这样背叛指挥官！我绝不允许——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Oh understood. Well. Ordis will just keep the Operator distracted while you are gone. But do not expect a rescue!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 哦，我明白了。好吧。你走的时候，Ordis 来负责拖住指挥官。不过别指望有人来救你！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[5.2]
Your companion understands the truth of this conflict, Shadow.
[10.3]
You can be the one to save your sons.
[13.6]
Let us begin by listening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[5.2]
黑影，你的同伴明白这场冲突的真相。
[10.3]
你或许可以拯救你的儿子们。
[13.6]
让我们先从倾听开始。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You sense it, Shadow. They are both your son. Even though you hold Orion here, in another place, Sirius was held by you also. And now they come for you from beyond this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 黑影，你已经感觉到了。他们二人，都是你的儿子。虽然你现在抱着的是 Orion，但在另一处时空，Sirius 也曾被你抱在怀中。而现在，他们超越时空而来，只为找你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: You sense it, Shadow. They are both your son. Even though you hold Sirius here, in another place, Orion was held by you also. And now they come for you from beyond this time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 黑影，你已经感觉到了。他们二人，都是你的儿子。虽然你现在抱着的是 Sirius，但在另一处时空，Orion 也曾被你抱在怀中。而现在，他们超越时空而来，只为找你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: HOW?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 怎么会这样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[8.4]
Time is a river, and they have learned to swim upstream.
[13.0]
They are from a doomed future where one always wins.
[17.3]
Yet, now they've found you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[8.4]
时间如河，他们学会了逆流而上。
[13.0]
他们来自一个注定毁灭的未来，在那里，总有一方会胜出。
[17.3]
而今，他们找到了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[5.5]
We must stop their war. But you cannot do this alone. 
[11.3]
Too much is unknown, too many forces are raised against you.
[15.5]
You must seek help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[5.5]
我们必须阻止他们的战争。但此事，非你一人所能为。
[11.3]
未知太多，反对你的势力也太多。
[15.5]
你必须寻求帮助。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: NOT THEM. NOT AGAIN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不要是他们。不要再来一次！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Calm. Shadow! This time - I agree. The Dreamers can never know. Natah can never know. She must always believe in a future.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 冷静。黑影！这一次——我同意。那些梦回者绝不能知道。Natah 也不能知道。她必须始终相信未来尚在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: SPEAK.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 说话。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The Wytch is subdued. Orion is hunting the path here. Go once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 女巫已被制服。Orion 正循迹而来。再去一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The Yaiba is sheathed. Sirius is hunting the path here. Go once more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 刃已入鞘。Sirius 正循迹而来。再去一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Adjust your weaponry if you see fit.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 根据情况调整你的武器装备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The Yaiba is a relentless blade, a worthy foe. He must be sheathed - or broken. Find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 刃是一把无情的利刃，一个值得尊敬的对手。必须将其收鞘——或者将其击碎。找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Orion. Sirius. One a constellation, the other a bright light. Our infinite Sentient eyes gazed upon them on our way to the new naked stars. Watched as they whispered by. We could have gone toward them. Perhaps it's time to gaze on what COULD have been.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Orion。Sirius。一个是星座，一个是明光。在前往那崭新赤裸的星辰之路上，我们那无限的 Sentient 之眼曾凝视着他们。看着他们低语而过。我们本可以走向他们。或许，是时候凝视那些本可能发生的事了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[4.4]
The poison glow. Brighter than a star,
[8.9]
it may be here that you see something I could not.
[15.7]
Touch it, in all its impurity. Withstand its vacuous laughter.
[19.4]
Wield it. Bring it to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.4]
那毒光。比星辰更耀眼，
[8.9]
或许你能在这里看到我所看不到的东西。
[15.7]
触碰它，感受它所有的污秽。抵御它空洞的笑声。
[19.4]
掌控它。把它带给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Listen. The Void. It has done this, an eternal conflict. Sacrifice is needed to stop it. Just like my Natah did for her children of Lua.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 听着。虚空。它一手造成了这一切，一场永恒的冲突。唯有牺牲才能阻止它。就像我的 Natah 为她月球上的孩子所做的那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Do not believe its promises, its lies!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 不要相信它的承诺和谎言！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Be with me. Be with me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 陪着我。和我在一起。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[4.4]
Shadow, bring the void-spark! Hurry!
[10.3]
The adult sons hasten toward the infant, and even Umbra cannot hold them for long.
[16.5]
I have taken a terrible risk - but we need them together!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[4.4]
黑影，把虚空火花带来！快点！
[10.3]
那两个成年的儿子正冲向婴儿，就连 Umbra 也无法长时间拖住他们。
[16.5]
我已经冒了很大的风险——但必须让他们在一起！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: Very well, Shadow. Things here have been tame.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 很好，黑影。此处尚且平静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[2.9]
Orion and Sirius are seeking your trail.
[7.8]
They sense us. Conflict is imminent.
[11.8]
Before they arrive, travel to Uranus Proxima.
[16.7]
Above me, here. For there is something I must be certain of.
[23.7]
Some way to stop this foul mockery of family that has led to us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[2.9]
Orion 和 Sirius 在追踪你。
[7.8]
他们已感知到了我们的存在。冲突将至。
[11.8]
在他们到达之前，前往天王星比邻星域。
[16.7]
就在我之上，也就是这里。因为我必须确定一件事。
[23.7]
是否有办法，阻止这种对家庭的肮脏亵渎，就是它把我们引向了如今的局面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: The Corpus know much - surely they have detected this anomaly in the Orb Vallis. Intercept their data to locate both Sirius and Orion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: Corpus 知晓甚多——他们肯定已经探测到了奥布山谷的异常现象。截获其数据，就能找到 Sirius 和 Orion 的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[3.3]
I know you are at war with yourself, Shadow.
[7.5]
Your choice of a name was simple, from your beating heart.
[19.9]
But the Void, our enemy, nursed and nurtured the unchosen name, forging a rival path, a second son.
[27.4]
There is room in your heart for both. We must show them that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[3.3]
黑影，我知道，你的内心正经历着一场战争。
[7.5]
你选择的名字很简单，源自你内心深处。
[19.9]
但虚空，我们的敌人，却悉心养育了那个未被选择的名字的他，开辟了一条与之抗衡的道路，孕育了第二个儿子。
[27.4]
但你的心中，容得下他们二人。我们必须让他们明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text: These ships... the alloys are dated twenty years from now. Truly from a doomed future. Their plans, however violent, however drastic, cannot be allowed to take shape.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText: 这些飞船……它们的合金制造工艺竟来自二十年后。它们确实来自一个注定毁灭的未来。不管他们的计划多残暴、多极端，都绝不能让其成形。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.text:
[0.0]

[6.4]
Shadow. Father. Protector.
[12.0]
I have made… many mistakes. Grave ones.
[17.4]
But they may yet be reforged into lessons.
[20.9]
Go to Venus, its Vallis.
[24.7]
A new and terrible education awaits.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsPar.zhText:
[0.0]

[6.4]
黑影。为父者。守护者。
[12.0]
我曾犯下……许多过错。且都是大错。
[17.4]
然而，这些过错，或许可化作教训。
[20.9]
去金星，去那片山谷。
[24.7]
一场崭新而可怖的试炼，正等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text:
[7.1]
All your dread-long life you have lived with despair.
[9.5]
Anguish.
[11.0]
Hatred.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText:
[7.1]
汝之一生惶恐度日，尽是绝望。
[9.5]
痛苦。
[11.0]
仇恨。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: But none of these compare to your guilt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 然这些，皆不及汝之罪疚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text:
[6.0]
Of all the Gods and kings and Golden Lords...
[10.2]
why was it you she saved?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText:
[6.0]
在诸神、诸王和诸金领主中……
[10.2]
伊人为何独搭救汝一人也？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Sorren...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 索伦……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Her light is dying, her life almost spent. And you will never learn why this unknown slaughterer chose to spare you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 伊之光将熄，命将尽。然汝将永不知晓，为何此神秘屠戮者选择存留汝命。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: You know whose help she needs. Will you let her drown in your despair? Or will you sheathe your hate and ask them?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 汝既知伊需何人之助，汝愿令伊陷于汝之绝望？抑或冰释前嫌，向其求助？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Never.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 绝不。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: You see? Futile. Only one can help her now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 汝见焉？尽是徒劳。惟一人能救她。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Tenno...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: Tenno……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Beard the beast in its den. You know the path of old.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 深入兽穴，直面野兽，汝自明旧途。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Damn it. Signal lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 该死。信号消失了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Candidate? Brother Parvos is watching.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 候选者？帕尔沃斯兄弟在看着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: He's coming up! Get security in position. Do not screw this up for me. The Sisterhood doesn't give second chances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 他上来了！让保安就位。别给我把事情搞砸了。姐妹团可不会给你第二次机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Uh... Captain? There's no Warframe down there. Just... traces.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 呃……舰长？下面没有战甲。只有……痕迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: He took something. Rip it from his dead hands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 他拿走了一些东西。把他杀了，抢走他拿走的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: What was that? But that's impossible...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 那是什么？但那是不可能的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text:
[3.2]
All crews cease fire, cease fire!
[5.6]
Stop firing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText:
[3.2]
所有船员，停火！
[5.6]
停止射击！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Captain Xeto. Permission to secure the new asset? For Parvos -
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: Captain Xeto. Permission to secure the new asset? For Parvos -

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Denied. Stand down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 被拒绝。撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Do you have any idea what you're throwing away? Can you imagine what that thing is worth?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: Do you have any idea what you're throwing away? Can you imagine what that thing is worth?

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Can you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 你知道他的价值吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: She's worse. We can buy her a few more minutes, but she's not gonna make it through this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 她的情况更糟了。我们可以多为她争取几分钟，但是她撑不过去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: She's worse. We can buy her a few more minutes, but she's not gonna make it through this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 她的情况更糟了。我们可以多为她争取几分钟，但是她撑不过去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: She's worse. We can buy her a few more minutes, but she's not gonna make it through this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 她的情况更糟了。我们可以多为她争取几分钟，但是她撑不过去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: She's worse. We can buy her a few more minutes, but she's not gonna make it through this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 她的情况更糟了。我们可以多为她争取几分钟，但是她撑不过去的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: TRY.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 试。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: You don't understand. Whatever's been draining her... it's speeding up. And she's not fighting it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 你不明白。不管是什么在消耗她的体力……进程都在加速。而她都没有抵抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: You don't understand. Whatever's been draining her... it's speeding up. And she's not fighting it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 你不明白。不管是什么在消耗她的体力……进程都在加速。而她都没有抵抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: You don't understand. Whatever's been draining her... it's speeding up. And she's not fighting it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 你不明白。不管是什么在消耗她的体力……进程都在加速。而她都没有抵抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: You don't understand. Whatever's been draining her... it's speeding up. And she's not fighting it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 你不明白。不管是什么在消耗她的体力……进程都在加速。而她都没有抵抗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: TRY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 快试！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Sorren...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 索伦……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Jade...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: Jade……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: We've secured his ship. He's not going anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 我们控制了他的飞船。他跑不掉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Still you delay? You doom the only one you ever wished to save, through your own stubbornness!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 汝仍犹豫不决？因汝之一意孤行，使汝唯一欲救之人堕入绝境

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: How did we just lose a significant percentage of our bioplasma reserves? Well? Hello? Any techs care to run a diagnostic?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 我们是怎么就损失掉这么大比例的生物原生质储备的？喂？有人在吗？有技术人员还在意运行诊断吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: That's no system fault. We've got an intruder. Triple robotics security on all vaults!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 那可不是什么系统故障。我们有入侵者了。向所有保管库加派三倍机械警卫！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: There. Camera five. What is that thing? Tenno? No... doesn't fight like a Tenno. Troops: Monitor. But keep your distance. Am I on? Intruder! This is Captain Xeto of The Ardent, in service to Mighty Parvos. Whoever you are, stand down. Your actions will not be tolerated!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 那里。五号摄像头。那是什么东西？Tenno？不……不像是 Tenno 战斗的样子。部队：监视。但保持好距离。听得到吗？入侵者！我是热烈号的泽托舰长，为伟大的帕尔沃斯效力。不管你是谁，向后退。你的行为将不被容忍！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Well done, whatever you are. It seems you have what you came for. But why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 干得漂亮，不管你是谁。看起来你得到了你来这要拿的东西。但是为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: A failed breach? What's going on? Is anyone on this ship capable of giving me a straight answer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 突破失败了？怎么回事？船上有人能直截了当地给我一个答案吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: He's a what? Read me that entry again, ensign. But what use would the Tenno-hunter have for medical-grade bioplasma? Track him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 他是什么？再给我读一遍，少尉。但是，Tenno 猎人要医用级别的生物原生质做什么呢？跟踪他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text:
[1.0]
 
[5.1]
You're going to be a father, Sorren.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText:
[1.0]
 
[5.1]
你就要当爸爸了，索伦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text:
[1]
 
[8.7]
But... the Legems! If the Lords found out-
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText:
[1]
 
[8.7]
但是……是律典！如果黄金之主们找到了——

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text:
[1]
 
[7.6]
You'll take care of us, always, won't you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText:

你会一直照顾我们的，一如既往，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text:
Tenno.

The Shadow has fled. His lair is silent and empty. He will not return.

Understand: She haunts this place. Her light has marred the earth. She whispers in the sleeping machines. Through the disintegration of her flesh, she lives on.

In honor of my barren, Void-scarred womb I entrust Jade to you.

He would not have wished this. But she would.

I remain: the great and terrible Hunhow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText:
Tenno 战士。

黑影已逃。其巢穴寂静空旷。其不复返矣。

须知：伊魂绕于此。其光伤地。伊于沉睡之械中低语。籍肉身瓦解，伊亦存续。

为念吾贫瘠、且满布虚空伤痕之子宫，吾将 Jade 托付于汝。

此非他所愿，却为伊之意。

吾依然如故：大而可畏之 Hunhow。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: He's on a derelict. One of the old Corpus hulks off Eris. Find me the cargo manifest. I want to know what he's searching for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 他在一艘被遗弃的船上。一艘离开阋神星的古老 Corpus 废船。给我找到货运清单。我想知道他在找什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: He's woken a Juggernaut! Clumsy. Unless he meant to? But... why?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 他把一头巨兽弄醒了！笨手笨脚的。难道他是故意的？但……为什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 别在那傻站着；快去。我们拖得越久，救她的机会就越小。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: There's a Warframe at the bottom of all this, I'm sure of it. Alert the Sisterhood. No - alert Vala herself. I want to deliver this asset to her personally.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 归根结底，所有这些的幕后黑手都是战甲，我敢肯定。通知姐妹团。不——直接通知薇拉本人。我想亲自告诉她这个消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Who's there? Operator? Umbra? Helminth?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 谁在那？指挥官？Umbra？Helminth？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Ordis assuredly heard something just now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: Ordis 刚才肯定听到了什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: Whoever is there, step into the light!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 不管是谁，快点出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.text: You! You will NOT harm my Operator! OUT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/JadeShadowsQue.zhText: 你！你不许伤害我的指挥官！快出去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: Our celebration of Koumei. It angers demons in the water!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 我们为 Koumei 举办的庆典，激怒了水中的恶魔！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: Hurry inside, child! Doh-ga! The Tenno will cut through the Infested and deliver our offerings to Koumei. Always, the vision begins the same. Khanung! Here they come.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 快进来，孩子！快！Tenno 会杀掉感染者，将供品献给 Koumei。这一异象总是这样开始。当心！它们来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: That's... but Mermu said the monsters in the water would sleep forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 那是……可母亲说过，水里的怪物永远都不会醒了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: They will, child. The Tenno will ensure it. Now get to safety! Surah, lure the Infested by presenting offerings to Koumei, and then gut them as Hai-Luk might gut a Khut-Khut.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 会的，孩子。Tenno 会办到的。现在快去安全的地方！朋友，向 Koumei 献上供品，把它们引出来。然后像海露剖开库特-库特一样剖开它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: This storm... Did Koumei do this? Did we do something to upset her?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 这场风暴……是 Koumei 造成的吗？我们是不是惹她生气了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: No, this nightmare is a gift. A chance to live out our dark fate, so we might change it. Hurry home. The Tenno will continue our celebration. Tenno, present our offerings to Koumei to draw out the Infested.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 不，这场噩梦是一份礼物。它让我们有机会亲历这段黑暗命运，从而有望将其改写。快回家吧，Tenno 会继续我们的庆典。Tenno，把供品献给 Koumei，引出感染者。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: Yes, and of course we've saved the best for last. Excellent condition as you can see. Now keep in mind, the core components will be diverted to the Zanuka program.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 没错，好戏当然要留到压轴。诸位也看得出来，品相堪称完美。不过请记住，它的核心部件将划拨给扎努卡计划。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.text: May our ledgers become ocean. Our margins see Centauri. In the name of profit, I commit thee to The Void.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DA.zhText: 愿我们的账簿汇成汪洋，愿我们的利润堆起来能够到半人马座。以利润之名，我将你献给虚空。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: For so many years her shrine was thought lost, and yet it was here, hidden from view, all the time. There is always hope.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 多年来，人们一直以为她的祈运坛已不知去向，但它始终就在这里，只是未被人看见。希望从未消失。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: When Onkko disappeared and the Quills would tell me nothing, I cast the Five Fates. Of all the patterns to get, it was the Blooming Flower! Ai yo, how I raged then! Koumei knew best.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 昂克失踪后，夜羽什么都不肯告诉我。我就投掷了五运骰。所有可能的骰象里，偏偏掷出了「花开绽放」！哎哟，我当时都气坏了！原来 Koumei 才看得最清楚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: Little by little, our efforts shape our fate, just as the waves wash at the stubborn rock. We see nothing, and again nothing; until all at once, with a sound of thunder, the plain truth is laid bare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 我们一点一滴塑造自己的命运，就像海浪反复冲刷顽石。起初看不到半点变化，再等下去依旧如此。直到突然间，伴着一声惊雷，所有的真相轰然显现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: Whether they wake or sleep, the Infested demons are there, beneath the waves. I cannot forget that vision. One day they will rise, but not yet. Not yet.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 无论感染恶鬼醒着还是沉睡，它们始终潜伏在海浪之下。我忘不掉那个异象。终有一天，它们会浮出水面。但不是现在，时候未到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: When Hai-Luk and I were young, she told me tales of fishing alone after dark. How she would hear strange knockings on the underside of her boat. So often it is the children who truly know, while the adults scoff.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 我和海露年轻的时候，她常说自己独自夜钓的故事。她说船底总会传来奇怪的敲击声。往往是孩子们才知道发生了什么，大人反倒只会嗤之以鼻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: On some days the sea gives rich bounty. On others it brings storms and chaos. The dance of the waves is the dance of fate, and none know where it shall bear us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 有时，大海会给我们赐下丰厚的渔获。有时，它只带来风暴与混乱。海浪之舞，也是命运之舞，无人知晓，它最终会把我们引向何处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: When Mer-Sah cast himself and all his possessions into the deep, all order broke down for a time. Some say Koumei arose then, on the foam of the dancing waves.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 当弥尔-撒将自己和全部家当投入深海时，世间秩序曾一度瓦解。有人说，Koumei 正是在那时，从翻舞的浪花中显现。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.text: You know the little bug that skitters over the water's surface? The dancer on the unknown deep? Koumei knows him. He sends us messages from her, if we have the cunning to read them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DB.zhText: 你知道那种飞快掠过水面的小虫吗？在神秘深海上起舞的舞者。Koumei 认得它。只要我们足够聪明，就能读懂它替 Koumei 捎来的讯息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Fate still holds a noose around our necks. You must not falter now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 命运的绞索还套在我们脖子上。现在绝不能退缩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: You do well, but Koumei is fickle. You must fight on.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 你做得很好，可……Koumei 的心意难测。还得继续战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Fate turns in our favor. The new thread is almost spun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 命运开始眷顾我们。新的命运之线即将织成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Can you sense it, Tenno? The tides of fate are shifting for us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 感觉到了吗，Tenno？命运之潮正在转向我们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: You fight well, Tenno. The dream is almost at an end.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 你战斗得很出色，Tenno。梦就要结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: A shift in fate is hard won. Hold firm. We now face misfortune given form.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 命运的转变来之不易。坚持住，我们面对的，是厄运的化身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Koumei's offerings pile high around her feet. Now comes the darkest hour.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 供品在 Koumei 脚下堆成小山。最黑暗的时刻到了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: The will of the Infestation is strong. Defeat the Oni to prove ours is stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 感染者的意志非常强大。击败恶鬼，证明我们的意志更胜一筹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: This Infested demon marks the edge of fate. Destroy it! Peace is within reach.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 这个感染者恶鬼死守在命运的最后一道关口。消灭它！和平就在眼前。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: The Oni will CRUSH your fruit baskets and your PUTRID ORGANS then GORGE on the delicious JAM.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 恶鬼会把你们的果篮连同腐烂内脏一起碾烂，再把混合果肉酱吃个精光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Ai yo. Grineer recklessness may rouse the demons that have long slumbered on our shores. We must ensure they never truly awaken.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 哎哟，克隆尼如此鲁莽，可能会惊醒长眠海岸的恶魔。我们必须确保它们永远醒不过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Your Koumei is made of nothing but ROCK and DELUSION. The Oni will obliterate her. Pave Cetus with her GRAVEL.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 你们的 Koumei，不过是石头和妄想的产物。恶鬼会把她砸碎，再拿她的碎石铺平希图斯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Chut! Even in dreams, we must endure your ramblings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 住口！就连在梦里，我们都得听你胡扯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: You pray to NONSENSE. A shrine to ABSURDITY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 你们拜的是一团空气！这祈运坛供奉的只有荒谬！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: You grovel before a worm, Councilor! Do not speak to me of absurdity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 你自己还跪在蠕虫面前摇尾乞怜呢，议员！少跟我谈什么荒谬！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: You Ostrons crack me up. Thick walls and THICK SKULLS. Koumei is NOTHING but a PET ROCK.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 你们奥斯特朗人真是可笑至极。城墙厚，脸皮更厚。Koumei 不过是你们用来自娱自乐的破石头。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: And yet you crave to own Koumei for yourself, do you not?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 可你自己不也恨不得把 Koumei 占为己有吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: All this talk of dreams? WHAT DREAMS? I am your very REAL NIGHTMARE.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 张口闭口都是梦？什么梦？我才是你们真正的噩梦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.text: Silence, bloated oaf. I have seen worse after eating too much Vobi cheese.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DE.zhText: 闭嘴，肿成球的蠢货。我沃比芝士吃多以后做的噩梦，都比你吓人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DF.text: The Quills see what has been and what will be, and they do not share their knowledge. But the likes of you and I, we may wish to steal a glimpse of our fate - to change it, even. This is the shrine of Koumei, the dice-maiden, the puppeteer. A long-hidden oracle for the ordinary folk.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DF.zhText: 夜羽能洞悉过去与未来，但他们不愿与人分享这些情况。然而像你我这样的寻常人，或许也想偷偷窥探自己的命运——甚至改变它。这是 Koumei 的祈运坛，她是掷骰巫女，也是操线者。这处属于寻常百姓的神谕之所，已经被隐藏太久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DI.text:
Tenno,

Recently, I have been plagued by strange visions of the Infestation. They are warnings from Koumei herself. I am sure of it.

Kruna metta, come see me in Cetus. Together, we can overcome a terrible fate.

Be well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DI.zhText:
Tenno，

最近，我不断看见有关感染者的诡异异象。那一定是 Koumei 亲自降下的警示。我很确信。

拜托你，来希图斯找我。只要你我联手，就有机会战胜这可怕的命运。

保重，

萨娅
愿 Koumei 赐予你祝福！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DI.text: May your fate be a worthy one.
The shrine is always open to you.
Will you swim, or flow with the current?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DI.zhText: 你会逆流而上，还是随波逐流？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DK.text: Doubly blessed at Koumei's shrine are those who walk in Koumei's form.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DK.zhText: 以 Koumei 之姿来到祈运坛的人，将蒙受双倍福运。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DK.text: She walks amongst us once again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DK.zhText: 她再一次行走于我们之间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DK.text: Ah! The Maiden returns to her Shrine!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DK.zhText: 啊！掷骰巫女回到了她的祈运坛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DK.text: Lok heb, guardian of the Five Fates!

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: And so this dreadful vision is just an old woman's dream. Let the waters be peaceful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: 如此，这恐怖的异象，终究是老妇人的黄粱一梦。愿这片水域重归宁静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: Koumei has danced her dance of fate, and whirled us down a new path. All is well.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: Koumei 跳完了她的命运之舞，也引领我们踏上了新的道路。一切安好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: The Fate Dream is dispelled! The die has been cast afresh. Sholah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: 命运之梦已然消散！命运的骰子，也重新掷下。再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: You save us again this day. Tenno, I give thanks to the Unum that she brought you to our shores.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: 今天你又拯救了我们。Tenno，感谢乌努母神将你带到我们身边。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: It is done. Fortune favors Cetus once again. Koumei blesses you with this dream's bounty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: 一切已定。幸运再次眷顾希图斯。Koumei 用这场梦的馈赠赐福于你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: You impress, surah! Koumei summons the spoils of this fate dream for your use in waking life.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: 好本事，朋友！Koumei 将这场命运之梦的战利品带回了现世，供你取用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: Koumei has woven our fates together, surah. We now share this vision. Our celebration of Koumei's return has drawn the attention of demons. Draw them out by presenting offerings to Koumei, and then gut them as Hai-Luk might gut a Khut-Khut.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: Koumei 已将我们的命运编织在一起，朋友。如今，你也看到了同样的异象。庆祝 Koumei 归来的庆典，引来了恶魔的目光。向 Koumei 献上供品，把它们引出来。然后像海露剖开库特-库特一样剖开它们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: The vision begins with a joyous celebration of Koumei's return, but always a storm darkens the skies and demons rise from the water. Deliver our offerings to lure the demons from the sea, then destroy them, so that we may preserve peace.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: 这一异象始于庆祝 Koumei 归来的喜悦。但随后，风暴笼罩天空，恶魔从水中涌现。献上我们的供品，将恶魔从水中引诱出来，然后消灭它们，这样我们才能维护和平。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: Koumei, in her grace, grants us this vision as a chance to protect Cetus. Continue the celebration of Koumei that so enrages the demons on our shores. Live out this dark fate, so we might change it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: Koumei 慈悲，降下这场异象作为警告，让我们有机会守住希图斯。继续进行庆典，激怒盘踞在岸边的恶魔。亲历这段黑暗命运，我们才能将它改写。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: It is known that Infested have long hibernated in the muck of our coast, yet Koumei warns they would awaken during her celebration. This is our chance to prevent such a grim fate. Present our offerings, draw out the Infested, and destroy them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: 人们早就知道，感染者长眠于海岸的淤泥之下。Koumei 却警示，它们将在庆典期间苏醒。现在，我们有机会阻止这场噩运。献上供品，引出感染者，将它们消灭。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.text: Koumei warns that Infested long dormant beneath our shores are stirring. Through this vision, we will ensure they never awaken. Bring our offerings to Koumei's shrine. Then when the Infested reveal themselves, cut them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DM.zhText: Koumei 警示，沉睡在海岸下的感染者正在苏醒。通过这场异象，我们会让它们永远醒不过来。把供品带到 Koumei 的祈运坛。然后，等感染者现身，就将它们杀光。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DN.text:
[4.7]
Fear. Such a delightful word.
[16.6]
It teaches us to beware the dark and all the things within it that go snippity-snap, eager to rend your innards from your belly, to stuff their own hungry guts.
[21.4]
Ooh! This puts me in mind of one of my favorite tales.
[36.8]
For there is one legend older than all the rest, one that, as civility beat back the wild, as centuries turned into millenia, has evolved along with us.
[44.1]
The fear of fangs, of shadows, of teeth that flash in the dark.
[54.5]
The story of a wolf waiting in the shadows - ready to rip out our throats.
[72.3]
It was on one fateful Naberus night that a hapless Grineer soldier discovered that one should not wander off into the deep woods alone... for alone, you may not be.
[83.4]
A howl split the darkness that sent a shiver down the spine.
[96.3]
Through all the horrors of war that this Grineer had seen, in all his years... there was something about the sound.
[110.2]
It tapped into the very thing that is born as we are born, sputtering and mewling into this uncaring world. Fear.
[122.9]
He was alone. He was being hunted. And he. Was. Afraid.
[128.4]
Into the night the Grineer soldier ran, over stump and through darkened glade.
[136.1]
With the sound of the beast growing closer, louder, howling, jaws slather-snapping - 
[142.1]
