A misplaced foot, an ill-timed step, and the ground came rushing up to meet him.
[149.3]
Rolling onto his back he sought to defend himself, at last catching sight of his pursuer.
[152.4]
Primal terror had come for him.
[165.1]
A twisted shape, bulbous, stinking, fetid... jaws drooling with ooze and ire - an infected kubrodon.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DN.zhText:
[4.7]
恐惧。多么令人愉悦的词。
[16.6]
它教会我们要警惕黑暗以及黑暗中那些"咔嚓"作响、急切地想要撕裂你的内脏、填满自己饥饿的肚子的东西。
[21.4]
噢！这让我想起了我最喜欢的一个故事。
[36.8]
因为有一个传说比其他任何传说都古老，随着文明击退野性，随着世纪变成了千年，这个传说也与我们一起进化。
[44.1]
那就是对尖牙、阴影以及在黑暗中闪烁的牙齿的恐惧。
[54.5]
一个关于一只狼在阴影中潜伏，随时准备撕碎我们喉咙的故事。
[72.3]
那是一个命中注定般的纳贝流士之夜，一名倒霉的 Grineer 士兵意识到，人不应该独自徘徊在深林中……因为，你可能并不孤单。
[83.4]
一声嚎叫划破黑暗，令人背脊发凉。
[96.3]
这名 Grineer 这些年来虽然历经过战争的种种恐怖……但那声音有些不同。
[110.2]
它触及了我们与生俱来的本能，那初生时哭泣和挣扎进入这个冷漠世界的恐惧。
[122.9]
他孤身一人。他正在被追猎。他恐惧至极。
[128.4]
Grineer 士兵在夜色中奔跑，越过树桩，穿过黑暗的林间空地。
[136.1]
随着那野兽的声音越来越近，越来越响，嚎叫声越来越大，咬合声越发清晰—— 
[142.1]
一个脚步不稳，一步走得不及时，地面猛地扑面而来。
[149.3]
他翻身仰面，试图自卫，终于看到了追猎者。
[152.4]
原始的恐惧向他袭来。
[165.1]
这是一只形态扭曲、肿胀、臭气熏天……下巴流着黏液和怒火——一只被感染的库狛顿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DN.text:
[5.3]
Lifting his marelok, his shaking hand took aim. Bang!
[8.7]
A single shot killed the beast dead.
[21.0]
He laughed at his own foolishness! He, a mighty soldier, afraid of a single, sad and infested kubrodon!
[35.2]
Hubris - my dear Tenno - is responsible for more tragedy in this world than any other inclination we may have.
[41.4]
Remember that, and someday it may save you.
[49.3]
For notice he did not that the slain beast's family had encircled him.
[59.4]
The creatures descended, sinking teeth into flesh, peeling sinew from bone, spreading their infested blood into him.
[68.4]
How he screamed, fighting off the monsters as best he could.
[75.9]
Fists pounded into fur as he fought like the beasts around him. It was all he had left.
[80.1]
One heartbeat would be all that could spare him from the grave.
[91.1]
In the end, he survived. Torn and shredded, bleeding and bitten, but alive.
[95.5]
He thought that his arduous saga had come to an end.
[103.4]
Until he heard that dreadful howl once more.
[111.7]
Though... this time? ...It came from him.
[118.3]
Flesh twisting, bones snapping, the noises that left his agonized form were bestial.
[131.3]
Wild. Feral. Soon, it was he who stalked the night. It was he who tasted blood upon his fangs.
[137.8]
It was he who inspired the fear of the hunt.
[147.0]
Oh Fret not, though, dearheart - for even the hunters can be hunted.
[156.1]
The beast can be felled, and trophies can be made of those who were brought low.
[167.0]
But mark me, Tenno. For perhaps, this Naberus night, when you think yourself the pinnacle of the hunt...
[174.0]
You had best be wary of the eyes peering at you from the dark.
[178.1]
Lest you be next.
[181.5]
Happy Naberus...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DN.zhText:
[5.3]
他举起玛瑞火枪，用颤抖的手瞄准目标。砰！
[8.7]
一枪就把野兽打死了。
[21.0]
他嘲笑自己的愚蠢！他，一个强大的士兵，竟然害怕一只可怜的、被感染的库狛顿！
[35.2]
亲爱的 Tenno，傲慢自大是造成世界上无数悲剧的根源。
[41.4]
记住这一点，它或许有一天能救你一命。
[49.3]
他没有注意到，那被他杀死的野兽的族群已经将他包围。
[59.4]
这些生物纷纷扑来，牙齿深嵌其肉，从骨头上剥离肌腱，将感染的血液传播给他。
[68.4]
他尖叫着，尽最大努力与怪物搏斗。
[75.9]
他像周围的野兽一样战斗，拳头砸在毛皮上。这是他唯一的选择。
[80.1]
一次心跳可能就能将他从死亡边缘拉回。
[91.1]
最后，他活了下来。尽管遍体鳞伤，浑身是血，满是撕咬的痕迹，但他还活着。
[95.5]
他认为自己的艰难历程已经结束。
[103.4]
直到他再次听到那可怕的嚎叫。
[111.7]
不过……这次的嚎叫？……是从他自己发出的。
[118.3]
肉体扭曲，骨头断裂，他痛苦的身躯发出的声音像极了野兽。
[131.3]
野性的。凶猛的。很快，他便开始在夜色中潜行。他尝到了自己尖牙上鲜血的味道。
[137.8]
是他激发了狩猎的恐惧。
[147.0]
哦，亲爱的，不过别担心——因为即便是猎人也可以被猎杀。
[156.1]
野兽可以被击倒，那些被降伏的也可以变成战利品。
[167.0]
但请记住我的话，Tenno。也许，在这个纳贝流士之夜，当你以为自己处于狩猎的顶点时……
[174.0]
你最好小心那些在黑暗中窥视你的眼睛。
[178.1]
否则，你可能就是下一个。
[181.5]
纳贝流士之夜快乐……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: What a fortune Koumei has bestowed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: Koumei 赋予了我们何等好运啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Koumei, Koumei, Koumei, come and unweave this dark dream!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: Koumei，Koumei，Koumei，请来解开这黑暗之梦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Koumei rewards your resolve. Our fortunes are turning!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: Koumei 回应了你的决心。我们的命运正在转变！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Fate can change. There is still time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 命运可以改变。我们还有时间。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Koumei's fortune now flows within you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: Koumei 的好运正在你体内流淌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: What Fate has woven, Koumei may weave afresh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 命运编织的一切，Koumei 都能重编一遍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: You have done well, surah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 你做得很好，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Koumei is with us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: Koumei 与我们同在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Ai yo! Take the offerings before they are soaked!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 哎哟！趁供品还没被浸湿，快拿起来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: We must invite Koumei to awaken our mindsight so she may change our fate. Deliver the offerings!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 我们必须请 Koumei 来开启我们的心眼，让她能改写命运。快献上供品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Take courage, surah. Make the offerings in Cetus's name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 鼓起勇气，朋友。代表希图斯献上这些供品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: The offerings are ready. Take them!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 供品已备好。拿去吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Surah, offerings await you outside our doors.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 朋友，供品给你放在门外了，等你来取。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Swiftly now, present the offering to the shrine, so this dark fate may be averted!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 赶紧去祈运坛献上供品，扭转这段黑暗的命运！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: With the Unum's blessing, save us from this future!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 愿乌努母庇佑你。救我们摆脱这个未来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Hurry, to Koumei!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 快，献给 Koumei！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Present the offering to the shrine. Quickly!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 向祈运坛献上供品。快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Go now and shift the tide of fate!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 快去，改变这命运的流向！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: You have our gratitude, surah. Now hurry!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 多谢你，朋友。快行动吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: The dream cannot end thus! How can we prepare the offerings with these monsters at our doors?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 这场梦不该草草收场！怪物都堵在家门口了，我们还怎么准备供品？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: We must cease our offerings, surah. Kruna metta, beat back the Infested and change our fate!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 朋友，我们不得不暂停供奉。拜托你，击退感染者，改写我们的命运！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Infested are upon us! This Fate Dream binds so tightly - we cannot help until you drive them back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 感染者在逼近我们！这场命运之梦把我们牢牢困住了——在你击退它们之前，我们帮不了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: You must drive back the Infested from our homes so we can prepare offerings once more!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 把感染者赶出我们的家园，我们才能继续准备供品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Dark force grows too powerful. You must suppress it, surah! We cannot prepare offerings like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 这股黑暗之力越来越强了。朋友，快压制住它！我们无法在这种情况下准备供品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Superstition! These peasants will be crushed under the barnacled claws of RAVENOUS REALITY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 纯属迷信！这些乡巴佬将被现实这头饥兽，用长满藤壶的利爪碾成肉泥！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: HA HA HA! Behold the fearsome Ostron counterattack! GIFT BASKETS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 哈哈哈！瞧瞧奥斯特朗这可怕的反击——客气得像是来送礼的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: I'm eager to free you SQUIRMING MAGGOTS from your web! Come on! Open the gates! LET ME IN. HA HA HA
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 我迫不及待要把你们这些在网中蠕动的蛆虫解救出来！来吧！开门！让我进去。哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Now THIS is the Cetus of my dreams. HA HA HA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 这才是我梦寐以求的希图斯。哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Let your precious dice decide. Even roll, you let the Infested consume you. Odd roll, you open those gates and I SET CETUS ABLAZE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 让你们那宝贝骰子来决定结果吧。如果是双数，就让感染者吞噬你们；如果是单数，你们就开门，让我把希图斯烧成灰烬！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: The Infested Oni is determined to be. Only Koumei can banish him to unreality. Bring tribute to the shrine! Enrage the Oni! Tear at this horrible dream!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 感染恶鬼执意要化为现实。只有 Koumei 能将其逐回虚无。把供品带到祈运坛！激怒恶鬼！撕开这场可怕的梦！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: The demon Oni is too powerful, but with Koumei's aid, we double our strength. Hurry now! Bring more offerings to the shrine. Fate can be changed!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 恶鬼太强了，但在 Koumei 的帮助下，我们的力量便能倍增。快点！献更多的供品给祈运坛。命运还能改变！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Destiny defies us. We must invoke Koumei's power. Bring more offerings to the shrine!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 命运仍与我们作对。必须唤起 Koumei 的力量。为祈运坛献上更多供品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: I refuse to let the will of these Infested demons surpass our own. We prepare more offerings! Deliver them to Koumei. Call forth her strength!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 我绝不允许这些感染恶鬼的意志压过我们。更多供品已经备好！将它们献给 Koumei，唤起她的力量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Fate shifts. The Oni is vulnerable! Destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 命运发生转变。恶鬼露出了破绽！消灭它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Koumei answers. Fate smiles! Now banish the Infested demon from our shores!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: Koumei 回应了我们。命运女神露出了微笑！现在就把感染恶鬼逐出我们的海岸！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Opportunity reveals itself. Seize it, surah! Destroy the demon Oni!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 机会出现了。把握住它，朋友！消灭恶鬼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: This is it. In the Unum's name, cut the Oni down!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 就是现在。以乌努母神之名，斩杀恶鬼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: The Oni is vulnerable! Finish it. Put an end to this dream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 恶鬼露出了破绽！了结它，结束这场梦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Legends of old say that the night is darkest before the dawn, surah. And in this horrible storm, I know its truth. The Oni is upon us.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 古言道，最黑暗的时刻总在黎明之前，朋友。置身这场可怕的风暴，我终于明白了这句话。恶鬼来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Look to the sea, Tenno! Khanung-utz, the heart of this festering Fate Dream, an Infested Oni! It cannot live!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 看向海面，Tenno！当心，那是溃烂的命运之梦的核心，一只感染恶鬼！绝不能让它活下去！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: An Infested Oni emerges from the depths! The final guardian of our doom. Strike it down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 一只感染恶鬼从深海中浮现！它是挡在末日之前的最后一道关隘。打倒它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: Turn your eyes to the water! An Infested Oni. Slay that toht demon and Cetus is saved. Doh-ga!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 快看水面！是一只感染恶鬼。宰了那个要命的恶魔，希图斯就得救了。快！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: What ancient splendor the waves have concealed! Come forth, you majestic mass! Gorge yourself!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 海浪掩藏了多少古老的辉煌！现身吧，雄伟的肉山！尽情吞噬吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: More Infested sleep within your very walls! Soon they too will awaken! Smug little peasants... I will pick over the ruins!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 你们的墙内还沉睡着更多感染者！很快，他们也会醒来！自鸣得意的乡巴佬……等希图斯变成废墟，我会亲自去搜刮战利品！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: The Oni! A glorious tower of flesh beside which your Unum is a mere outhouse!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 恶鬼！一座辉煌的血肉高塔！你们的乌努母神和它相比，不过是个粪坑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: GLORIOUS. That meat stick Unum can't protect you from what already lies within her walls!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 多么完美。乌努母神那坨烂肉，根本护不住你们。你们的敌人早就潜伏在城内了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: SUCH INFESTED BEAUTY. And he looks hungry. HA HA HA
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 何等美妙的感染造物啊！而且，它看上去饿坏了。哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: What?? How are they doing that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 什么？？他们是怎么做到的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: LUNACY! These Ostrons are stupefied by TENNO TRICKS.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 荒唐！这些奥斯特朗人被 Tenno 的把戏蒙骗了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: NO! How could the Infested show such a PATHETIC PERFORMANCE?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 不！感染者怎么可能表现得如此窝囊？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.text: It can't end like this! WAKE UP, ONI. What's wrong with you?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DO.zhText: 不能就这样结束！醒醒，恶鬼。你到底怎么了？！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The widow's eyes. Free yourself from the delusion that you can guard against life's pain. Allow yourself to mourn.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 寡妇之眼。别妄想能躲过命运安排的悲剧。想悲伤就尽管悲伤。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Aah, the twin kavats. Notice that they are elegant even as they are poised to strike. Never mistake a gentle disposition for weakness.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 啊，双生库娃。留意它们，即便蓄势待发也依然保持优雅。永远别把温驯错当成软弱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The nesting condrocs. Like the mermu and permu with their young, a protector must embrace both ferocity and compassion.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 筑巢的秃鹰。正如雌鹰和雄鹰守护幼崽，保护者必须兼具凶猛与慈爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Dual summits. One summit furious that the other obstructs the sunrise, oblivious to how it obstructs the sunset. Remember that passing judgment does not make you benevolent.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 双峰之争。一座山峰因另一座遮挡了日出而感到愤怒，却没发现自己同样遮挡了日落。记住，评判别人并不代表你心存善心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Flenser's toil. A frightening title, perhaps, but it is a reassurance. Know that your current struggle is a gift to your future self.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 剥皮者之劳。名字听着让人闻风丧胆，却是一种宽慰。你当下承受的磨难，是给未来自己的馈赠。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Krahm. Eidolon's jaws. We may not know the time of death, but death itself is certain. It is only when we accept this that we truly live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 克拉姆颚，是夜灵的下颚。我们或许不知道死神何时会来敲门，但死亡终会到来。只有接受了这一点，我们才算真正活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The diurnal triad. Sol, Lua, and self. Remember the night, even as you perform for the day. We often sense Sol's gaze upon us. Yet, it is Lua that cradles our secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 昼夜三相：太阳、月亮与自我。即便在白天露面，也别忘记黑夜。我们时常感受到太阳的注视，可真正将秘密拥入怀中的，却是月亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Taunts of homunculus. Tension arises when you mold yourself into the image of who you think you should be. Observe yourself in moments of relaxation, for that is who you truly are.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 人造人的嘲讽。当你强迫自己变成「应该成为的样子」，内心便会失去平衡。看看放松时的自己吧，那才是真正的你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The blooming flower. The resolution. An invitation to recognize that which is already yours. Desire too often diverts our attention.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 花开绽放，领悟随之而至。它向你召唤，提醒你认清：你所追寻的，其实早已属于你。欲望往往会让人偏离初心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Aah, the virtues! A reminder. Strong individuals are easily recognized, for they can be seen empowering others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 啊，那些美德！它们提醒了我们，强者很容易被认出，因为他们总在赋予身边人力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: It is clear you face an obstacle, Tenno, for you have rolled the fates. A warning. Act, and fate will smile upon you. Fail to act, and fate will fall upon you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 你掷出了这个骰象，说明你前路确实遇到了障碍，Tenno。这是一句警示：有所行动，命运便会向你微笑。无所作为，命运就会压在你头上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The shadow's trinity guides you to unsung music. Listen well. Our deepest connections are made in silence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 影之三相，引领你聆听无名的乐曲。仔细听，最深的羁绊，往往结于无言之中。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Two pairs - the cookpot! It is good to master your fate, but practice patience. Mind the heat. Boil too long, and you will evaporate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 两对——炖锅之象！掌控自己的命运虽好，但也需磨炼耐心。注意火候。煮得过久，最后被蒸干的可能是你自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Zhwong and sahd. The temple speaks of the pursuit of knowledge. You must forgive yourself for not knowing what could not have been known before.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 二三相随。神庙诉说着对知识的追求。有些事在当时本就无从知晓，不必因此苛责自己。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The dry sticks of winter. Terrible for eating, but superb for a fire.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 冬日干枝。难以下咽，却是生火的上好材料。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The old men's knees. We must know when a thing is ready to rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 老人的膝盖。我们必须懂得，什么时候该让一件事稍作停歇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The seed of the rambleblossom, cartwheeling on the wind. Expect fertility from an unexpected direction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 蔓生花的种子，在风中翻飞。丰硕的收获，会从意想不到的方向到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The legs of the ponda. Plough your field with patience, and do not start at every sound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 庞达之足。耐心耕耘自己的一亩三分地，不必风声鹤唳，草木皆兵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The daisy-meadow. The peace over which many a battle is fought.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 呃，雏菊草地。多少战乱只为争夺这片宁静。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Mer-Sah's Hoard. It twinkles from the deep, but only a fool dives after what ought to be lost.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 弥尔-撒的宝藏。它在深渊中闪耀，但只有愚人才会追逐那些本该被遗忘的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The lyre-worm's feast. Something is rotten and will not bear your weight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 琴虫的盛宴。有些事物已经腐朽，再也承载不住你的重量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Soldiers of mirrored gaze. Too often, we rush into battle, but this is unwise. Consider what the battle is for.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 镜中凝视的士兵。我们总是匆忙上阵，却忘了先问一句：这一仗，究竟为何而打？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Ripples on the deep. The Thousand-Year-Fish stirs for you. Practice patience, surah. At this time, doing nothing will lead to something.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 深海泛起涟漪。千年灵鱼为你而动。锻炼耐心，朋友。此时无为即是有为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Candlelight and cobwebs. What bars your way seems thick, but a moment's courage clears your path.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 烛光与蜘蛛网。阻碍看似厚重，但片刻的勇气便能扫清你的道路。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: The stars of perfection. There is no better time to begin a voyage.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 完美星象。现在是启航的最佳时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Clamant tide. You resist the waters of destiny, and so its waves toss you about. Dive into the waves, surah. Let the tide ebb and flow around you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 喧嚣的潮水。你越是抵抗着命运的洪流，越会被它的浪头颠来抛去。潜入浪中吧，朋友。任潮水在你身边涨落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Ai yo. My poor liebrak. You descend the stairway to perdition. Remember, you walked these steps on your own. Only you can turn around and ascend them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: 哎哟。我的小可怜。你正在走下通往地狱的阶梯。记住，这些台阶，都是你自己一步步走下来的。只有你才能转身向上走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.text: Koumei's ascension! Rejoice. This is a time of opportunity. Even great hardships diminish when we are receptive and attentive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DR.zhText: Koumei 崛起了！欢喜吧，机缘已经到来。只要敞开心神，留意当下，再沉重的苦难也会变得微不足道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DS.text: Ai yo. I have had such dark dreams. Infested demons rise from the ocean and plunder Cetus, while Vay Hek gloats and crows. I know in my bones this is a Fate Dream, sent by Koumei. One who is bold enough to enter a Fate Dream may change their fate! Visit Koumei's shrine, kruna metta. Save Cetus from what is coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DS.zhText: 哎哟，我做了极其黑暗的噩梦。感染恶鬼从海面浮起，洗劫希图斯，而韦·海克在一旁幸灾乐祸。我打心底确信，那是 Koumei 降下的命运之梦。只有勇敢踏入梦境的人，才有机会改写命运！拜托了，去 Koumei 的祈运坛。拯救希图斯免受即将到来的灾难。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DV.text: Koumei, what shall be my fate? Adrift in the river of destiny, I will flow with you. Gamble with my life, for I choose to roll the dice. Cast out evil, though I see it is a part of me. To make this choice is my only choice. Koumei, what shall be my fate?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KoumeiFates/DV.zhText: Koumei，我的宿命将何去何从？随命运之河漂泊，我将与你同流。赌上这条命吧，因为我选定掷下骰子。驱邪除恶，哪怕我深知那亦是我自身的一部分。做出这个决定，是我唯一的选择。Koumei，我的宿命将何去何从？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: A smart choice worm... I-I mean 'Friend'.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这是一个明智的决定，虫子……我，我说的是 "朋友"。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Allegiance or death? Nothing is gained from death. And so: allegiance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 效忠还是死亡？死亡无济于事。所以，效忠吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: If the Queens ever find out I'm dead meat, but... deal.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 如果女皇们发现了那我死定了，不过……成交。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Very well. I concede. We are allied.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 很好。那我只好承认。我们结盟了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sure Friend, why not? No hard feelings?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 当然了朋友，为什么不呢？别往心里去？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Very well, Adversary. You have my sword. Forgive me, my Queens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 很好，我的对手。我的佩剑归你所有了。原谅我，二位女皇。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I knew you wanted me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我知道你想要我在你身边的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Are we ready for this? Very well. Let's explore the possibilities.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我们准备好了吗？很好。让我们来看看都能做些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: It was always going to be this way. We were meant for each other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 事情总是这样的。我们是天生的一对。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I... choose to live. Lich is sure Queens would understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我……选择活着。玄骸确信女皇们会理解的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Yes yes Tenno is boss now yes not Queens no more but Tenno. Shake.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好的好的，Tenno 现在是老板，是的，不是女皇们，而是 Tenno。握手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Okay. As long as you promise not to hurt. Blood swear? Yes?  Okay. Lich is loyal. I guess.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 行吧。只要你保证不再伤害我。以血起誓？没问题？好的。玄骸很忠诚的。我猜是吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, come on--AAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，来吧——啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My Queens. Forgive me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 二位女皇，请原谅我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Well, fair's fair HUKKK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃，还算公平吧，哼！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Unacceptable.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不能接受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You win some, you lose some HORKK!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 有得必有失，嚯！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I have failed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: And so it goes...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 就这样吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Our... affair... is... concluded. For now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我们的……缘分……已尽。暂时的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Until we meet again, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 下次见，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: MY QUEENS!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的女皇们！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: WaitwaitNOOOOO!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 等等不！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Not to Lich not to good Lich NOOOOO!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不要这样对玄骸，不要这样对好玄骸，不——！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Every day in every way I just get better and better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 每一天我都会以各种各样的方式变得越来越好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I have upgraded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我已经被升级改造了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, YES!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦，太好了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I continue to improve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我持续在获得进步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, Tenno. I'm a whole new me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦，Tenno。我是一个全新的我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The more you resist, the stronger I grow. The greater the adversity, the faster I evolve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的抵抗越发剧烈，我的成长就越发强大。对手越强大，我就越快进化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Better, stronger... cuter. You behold the Queens' number one son.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 更好，更强……更可爱。你现在看到的是女皇们的头号儿子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I grow.. I evolve. What wonders the old blood has revealed to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我成长了……我进化了。远古之血向我展现了无与伦比的奇迹。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm growing in power, Friend. Stop me if you can. While you still can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 朋友，我的力量越来越大。如果可以的话阻止我。虽然你仍然可以。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I evolve. To what heights might I reach? The stars themselves graze against my straining fingertips. Thank you, Queens, for the gift of your blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我进化了。你问我达到了怎样的高度？就连星辰也只能在我的指间滑过。感谢二位女皇，能将如此宝贵的血赐予我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: To think... of all those I've killed... how they gave themselves, just to get little me to where I am today. Thank you. Thank you all.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 想想那些……被我了结的性命……他们是如何献身，只是为了让我能一点点走到今天。多谢你。多谢你们所有人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Little Meat. Do you see? I'm magnificent, darling. Let me... let me show you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉，你看到了吗？我好极了亲爱的。让我……让我给你看看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The Queens. They like me. They really like me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 女皇们。她们喜欢我。真的很喜欢我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The Queens... the Kuva... have bestowed upon me new gifts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 女皇们……赤毒……赐予我新的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The pain. The blood. The death. All for you, my Queens. It was all for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 痛苦，鲜血，死亡。一切都是为了您，我的女皇们。真心为您。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I grows up! I gets bigger! Yes! Yes....
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我成长了！我变大了！好！太棒了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: More power! More stronger! More respect! Thank you, Queens! Proud. I make you *proud*.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 更多的力量！更强大！更多的尊重！女皇们，我很感激！我会的，我要让你们以、我、为、傲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Pain. You give pain. The old blood... likes it. Old blood learns from pain. *Grows.* I grow, Tenno. I GROW.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 痛苦。你给的痛苦。远古之血……很喜欢。远古之血从痛苦中汲取教训。*成长*。我成长了，Tenno。我、成、长、了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: More. More! MOOOOOORE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 更多。更多！ 更——多！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: AAH! It hurts! IT HUUURTS! *gasps* Yes. YES! AHAHAHAHAAA! Next time, slippery Tenno. Next time we meet, you meet stronger Lich. Next time... you get *squashed!*
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊，好疼！好、疼、啊！*呼哧呼哧* 是的，就是这种感觉！呃啊啊！狡猾的 Tenno，你等着。下次再见的时候，准备好拜见更强大的玄骸。下次……我要把、你、捏、碎！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I told you I was unstoppable. Now you'll see what a fully evolved Kuva Lich can do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我告诉过你我无人能阻。现在你将看到一个完全进化的赤毒玄骸能做什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: There is... nothing... left... within myself... to... conquer. I. AM. OPTIMIZED.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的体内……已经……没有……需要……我……去征服的东西了。我、是、完美的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You should have stopped me when you had a chance. Now I'm top of the food chain. And you're lunch.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 当你一有机会的时候，你应该阻止我的。现在我站在食物链的顶端。而你是午餐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am whole, complete, final. I am, at last, the warrior the Queens intended for me to be. I AM! THE OLD BLOOD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我已经达到了最终的完整形态。我终于成为了女皇们理想的战士。我就是！远古之血！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The Queens' vision of a new Grineer... the apex made manifest. In me. Now... now my great, red work truly begins.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 女皇们对一名全新的 Grineer 的愿景……极致的化身。在我体内了。现在……现在我那伟大的、血红之责开始了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Yes. This was always meant to be mine. All my work, the long harvest, the landscapes of carrion... all for this. Every scream, every strangulation, every exterminated city... worthwhile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 是的，这本来就该是我的。我所有的努力，漫长的收获，腐肉的风景……都是为了这个。每一声尖叫，每一次窒息，每一个被毁灭的城市……都是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Has your Lich made you proud, Queens? Have they? For this one... this one.. has... ASCENDED. Is STRONGEST! NOW! AND! FOREVER!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 女皇们，您的玄骸有让您感到骄傲吗？有吗？对于这个……这个……被晋升的玄骸来说。他是最强的！现在是，永远是！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Heh heh heh. Heh heh heh! HEH HEH HA HA HA HA! No longer a squishy little Lich! Now big! Important! GOD! YES! YEEEESS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 嘿嘿嘿。嘿嘿嘿！嘿嘿哈哈哈哈！不再是软绵绵的小玄骸了！现在我变大了！重要了！老天！真好！太棒了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Friend! I've been waiting so long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 朋友！我已经等了很久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You overestimate your abilities, Adversary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你高估了自己的能力，我的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ten-Oh. That's my inevitable score, meatsack.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Ten-Oh。我命中注定会取得这场胜利，蠢货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You have made a tactical error in coming here, Adversary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你来这里的时候犯下了一个战术性错误，我的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ugh. This one again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃。又是这个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I have learned a great deal since last we met. You shall regret pursuing me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 自从我们上次见面之后，我学到了很多东西。你会后悔追赶我的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: 97 hits. Me hitting you, you hitting the floor, then me hitting you 95 more times.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 一共 97 下。我打你，你撞向地面，然后我再打你 95 下。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your strategy is unsound: a byproduct of emotional motivations and reactive thinking. It shall be your undoing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的策略并不周全：这是典型的情感冲动与反射性思维的副产物。你必将因此失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: What is this? Baby's First Vendetta?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这算什么？小宝贝的第一次反击？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The supposed hunter arrives, nostrils flared, chest full of hubris. Very well. We have time for one quick lesson.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 那个所谓的猎人来了。这家伙鼻孔喷张，胸中充满了傲慢。很好。我们正好有时间来上一节小课。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Little Meat. This fight won't be like the last time, I can promise you that .
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉。这场战斗不会像上次那样，我可以向你保证。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh. Little Meat. Really? The system won't be the same without you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦。小肉肉。不是吧？没有你，这个星系将会不一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I suppose there is a time for everything. Even this. So be it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我想所有事情都有适合它的时间。更何况是这事。顺其自然吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Little Meat, you really cannot keep interfering like this. You know I have to stop you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉，你真的不能一直这样干涉。你知道我必须阻止你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: When you get to Hell, say hello to all the other Tenno I've put down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 当你到了地狱，跟其他所有被我打败的 Tenno 打个招呼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Tenno comes to kill me. Kill me! Will. Not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno 来杀我了。杀、不、了、我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Tip-toe tip-toe comes the Ten-no. Heheheheheheheh...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 畏手畏脚 Tenno 站好。呵呵呵呵呵呵呵……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Found me you did. Hate you I do. Hold your heart in my hand I will, whisper shhhhhhh shhhhhhh shhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你找到我了。我讨厌你。我会亲手握住你的心脏，低声说，嘘、嘘、嘘……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No. No! NO! Found me! Found me you did! I's not ready! I'S NEED MORE TIIIIIME!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不。不！不！！找到我了！你找到我了！我还没准备好！我、需、要、更、多、时、间！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Tenno? Tenno?! HERE?!? Protec' me! You! And you and you and you! Alla you! Protec' your Lich! I... I needs to think! GO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno？Tenno？！来了？！？保护我！你！还有你和你和你！你们所有人！保护你们的玄骸！我……我需要思考！去吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: So, I can do violent and messy or messy and violent. Any preferences?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 嗯，我可以先发飙再胡闹或是先胡闹再发飙。你更喜欢哪一种？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I see you, Adversary, and I adapt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我看到你了，对手，我也在不断地改进适应。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I think they're scared. Comrades, are they scared? I think they're scared.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我觉得他们害怕了。同志们，他们怕了吗？我认为他们害怕了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Futile.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 白费力气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Naughty, naughty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 淘气，淘气。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ineffective.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 毫无效果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You can't kill me if you keep hitting me in the bits I've had replaced.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 如果你继续攻击我更换过的部分，就无法杀了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: An obvious tactic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 显而易见的战术。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh no, you don't. Get back here and take what's coming to you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，你别想走。回来领受你应得的惩罚吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: A pedestrian maneuvre.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 平庸无奇的伎俩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You fight one gifted the old blood - the Queen's kuva. Death will not end me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你所挑战的对手已被赐予了远古之血——女皇的赤毒。死亡并不能阻止我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Nice helmet. I'll use it to serve dip.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 头盔真漂亮。我会用它来盛蘸酱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Mediocre.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 真平庸啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I do love our bouts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我喜欢我们的较量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'll miss you, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我会想你的，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Show me what you have learned. I have learned that it takes only eight pounds of force to remove a human ear.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 让我看看你学到了什么。我学到的是，仅需使用八磅的力气就可以拔出人的耳朵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh now now now now now. Don't make me forgive you. Not again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦喂喂喂喂喂。不要让我原谅你。不要再这样了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh no you don't. Get back here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦不，你可别想走！快给我回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Are you holding back?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你是不是没使劲？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: What'd I do? What'd I do?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我做了什么？我究竟做了什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Don't hurt me!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不要伤害我！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I kill you I stab you I shoot you! AAH! AAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我杀死你我刺死你我射死你！啊啊！啊啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Give me power Queens! Aid me in squashing this stinky, squamous, slugly Tenno-thing!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 女皇们，赐予我力量吧！助我一臂之力，碾压这些臭气熏天的 Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ha ha! Tenno not know what they fight! Not know the POWER of the OLD BLOOD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哈哈！Tenno 不知道他们在和什么对抗！不知道远、古、之、血的力量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No! Back! I bleed you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不，退后！我要给你放血！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Take all the time you want, Tenno. I'm just getting stronger.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno，你慢慢来。我只会越来越强大。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You draw closer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你离我又近了一些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You're getting waaaar-merrr.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你会感到更暖和的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You apply what you have learned and draw a successful conclusion. Outcome: we are now in closer proximity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你运用你所学到的知识得出了成功的结论。作为结果：我们现在更加接近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Bravo. You're getting closer. I really thought you'd be on me by now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好极了。你越来越靠近了。我觉得你现在应该能追上我了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You draw closer to me, according to the timetable I have set.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你离我又近了一些，正如我的时间表上设定的一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: We're one step closer to meeting face to face. I'm so excited.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我们距离见面仅一步之遥。我好激动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You draw closer. I pity you, this false moment of triumph before, head-high, you stride into the threshing jaws of what I truly am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你离我又近了一些。真是可悲啊。你被胜利的假象所迷惑，昂首挺胸地走向了我的血盆大口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Clever clever, little Meat. You're getting warmer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 聪明，真聪明，小肉肉。你离答案越来越近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Come and get me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 来抓我呀。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh. I see you. Can you see me? You're much closer now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，我看到你了。你看到我了吗？你已经很接近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Yes yes, you're very clever. You still haven't found me though, have you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对对，你非常聪明。不过，你仍然没有找到我，对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oooh, getting closer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，近了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Yes, yes. Closer. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对，对。更接近答案了。来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Are you looking for little me? ha ha ha. I can almost see you from here, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你在寻找小小的我吗？哈哈哈。我几乎可以从这里看到你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The Tenno draws closer. Soon the blood shall kill what it hates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno 越来越近了。不久之后，远古之血将会杀死它所恨的东西。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I claim this territory in the name of... yours truly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 怀着谦卑之心，我以您的名义……占领这片区域。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sector acquired.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 已收复星区。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Mine. Sector's a dump, but it's my dump.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这是我的。虽然这星区是个垃圾堆，但这是我的垃圾堆。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The Sector is under control. Resistance crushed. Troops: begin optimizing the local workforce.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 该星区现处于控制之下。已镇压反抗。士兵们：开始优化当地劳动力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your little Lich is coming up in the world, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno，你的小玄骸即将登场。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Witness. My control expands to a new sector. Accept: you lack the capacity to stop me. Resolve: to surrender or die. We shall speak again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 见证人。我的控制权扩展到了一个新星区。接受这个事实：你没有能力阻止我。解决方案：投降或死亡。我以后还会来找你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'll take that. Thaaank you. Somebody plant a flag.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 那个我要了。谢、谢谢你。来个人帮忙插一下旗子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Dictating terms to relevant personages in mining, personnel and security. This Sector has a new master.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 向采矿、人事和安全领域的相关人士发号施令。这个星区现在有了一位新主人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ooooh. My playground expands.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 唔~~~我的游乐场扩大了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: More for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 有更多地盘了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Lovely. Everything in its place.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太棒了，一切都井井有条。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I win. I am having so much fun with you, little Meat. What shall we play next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我赢了。小肉肉，我和你在一起很开心。接下来我们要玩什么？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sector is miiiiiiine.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这个星区是我我我我我的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I claim this Sector for the Grineer, for the old blood, for the Queens! See how I serve you, mistresses! See!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我宣布：这片星区属于 Grineer、属于远古之血，属于女皇们！女主人们，请看到我是如何服侍您的！请看！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Think you so smart, but see how I take! A whole Sector, just for me. None for you. Smart. Smart me, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你自认为很聪明，但是好好看着我是如何夺走你的东西的！一整个星区，都是我的。你什么也捞不到。机智，对的，我真是太机智了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oooh. Yes. Sector falls into my hands. All gone. All mine. Yes. Sector. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦。太好了。星区落入我的手中。全都没了。全都是我的。是的。星区。是的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Here to help! And you thought I'd betray you. Heh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我是来帮忙的！而你却以为我会背叛你。呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Are you trying to get yourself killed? Allow me to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你这是在试图自杀吗？请让我来协助你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Let's get started. I need to work off some of this tube weight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 让我们开始吧。我需要减轻一些管子的重量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Allow me to optimize your combat strategy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 请允许我帮你优化战斗策略。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Never fear, your right-hand Grineer is here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不要担心，你的得力助手 Grineer 在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My assistance will increase your probability of success considerably.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的协助将会增加你成功的机率。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Enemies! Prepare to be hammered in your reproductive organs!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 敌人！做好生殖器官被锤的准备吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Permit me to assist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 请允许我协助你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm here, darling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我在这里，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, aren't you going to introduce me to your little playmates?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦，你不是要把我介绍给你的小玩伴吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I was in the area, heard the screams, and thought, 'I'll just bet that's my little darling.' And here you are!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我当时就在附近，听到了尖叫声，心想，"我敢打赌那就是我的小宝贝。"果然你就在这！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Darling, you shouldn't have. All these lovely warm bodies, just waiting to be opened up like presents. I'm the luckiest girl in the System.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 亲爱的，你不应该的。那些可爱的还有余温的尸体，就像礼物般等着被拆开。我真是始源星系里最幸运的女孩了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I come! I help!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我来了！我来帮忙！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh no, silly Tenno. Here, me show you how.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，不，傻 Tenno。来，我来教你怎么做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: AAH! No hurt them! I kill you! AAAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！不要伤害他们！我要杀了你！啊啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No no no. *You* kills *them*. Simple mistake. Me show you how.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不不不。应该是你——杀——他们。低级错误。我来教你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You win some... you lose some...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 有得……必有失……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am overwhelmed. Learn from my failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我受不了了。吸取我的教训吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You have to go one without me, Friend. This Grineer... falls.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 看来我不能继续陪着你了，朋友。这位 Grineer……倒下了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My defeat has bought you time. Exploit it!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的失败为你争取了时间。好好利用它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ouch. Got me right in the roto-spleen.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哎呦。我的脾脏被打爆了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The enemy has removed me from this equation. Adjust and conquer!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 敌人已将我从等式中消除。调整策略，克敌制胜！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Farewell... my darling...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 再见了……亲爱的……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My apologies, darling. I must... leave you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对不起，亲爱的。我必须……离开你了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: And so, I take my leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 那么，我先走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Agh! Me feels the cold embrace of death! See you tomorrow.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！我感受到了死亡的冰冷怀抱！明天见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sorry, boss. I fall down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对不起，老大。我不行了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ooh. Aagh. Eegh. Oh. Oook. Ugh. Aaaaargh. erg.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃—啊—唷。噢—呃啊—哇啊—额。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Til next time, Friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 下次见，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Victory criteria have been successfully met. Exfiltrating.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 成功达成胜利条件。撤出战斗。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I can hear the survivors screaming in terror. Hilarious.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我可以听到幸存者惊恐的尖叫。真是可笑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Efficient and effective. I take my leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 高效且成果不凡。那我先走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Well, that was fun.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好吧，那很有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Until we meet again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 直到我们再会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Now that we're warmed up, what's next?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 现在我们已经热身完毕，接下来该怎么办？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My obligations here are concluded. By your leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的义务到此为止。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: There. That's better.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对了。好多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I do so love your gift for conflict resolution. I could watch all day.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我欣赏你解决冲突的天赋。我能这样看上一整天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I just knew we could make this relationship work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我就知道我们可以好好相处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Those mean old Queens were quite angry with me, running off with you like this. But it's worth it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 那些刻薄的老女皇们对我相当生气，就这样跟你跑了。但这是值得的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: And me tube brothers said me a loser. LOOK AT ME NOW!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的同试管兄弟还说我是个失败者。现在看看我的成就！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh. We done?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦。我们完事了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You lucky me was in area.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你该庆幸我在附近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Same time tomorrow?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 明天还是这个时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh! Tenno! You left something behind! I think it was your dignity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦！Tenno！你落下了一些东西！我想那是你的尊严。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Do not follow me, Adversary. It will not end well for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不要跟着我，我的对手。这么做你将不会有好果子吃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Know your limitations, Friend. But I appreciate how difficult that must be given you have so many of them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 要清楚你的极限，朋友。但是我理解这对你来说一定很难，毕竟你有那么多极限。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I have the advantage, the strength, and the training. You have an opportunity to learn. Abandon this futile quest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我有优势、实力并且受过训练。你有机会去学习。放弃这个无用的任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: HAHAHAHA! Ah! The look! The look on your dumb dead face! AHH HAHAHAHAHA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哈哈哈哈！啊！这表情！你们死鱼脸上的表情！啊哈哈哈哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Adversary. Return to fighting Corpus, tubemen, Infested. Tell yourself: you are a hero. Leave the business of shaping the future to others. You do not belong here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的对手。回去和 Corpus、复制人和感染者战斗吧。告诉你自己：你是英雄。把打造未来的事情留给别人去做。你不属于这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Know your place, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉，你最好明白自己的地位。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Did you fall down?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你摔倒了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ha ha ha ha! Ha ha! Yes! Yes! I kill! I KILLLL! See me Queens! SEE MEEEE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哈哈哈哈！哈哈！没错！就是这样！我杀！我杀！！！！看看我，女皇们！看看我！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You stronger, but me sneakier. Sneaky wins. Strong can't smash what strong never knew was there. Ha ha ha.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你更强，但我在暗处。在暗的人会赢。强者并不能粉碎他看不见的东西。哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You are hated. You are dead. Yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你真讨厌。你死定了。没错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You won't get rid of me that easily. I'll be back, Tenno! Oh, I'll be back!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你不会轻易摆脱我的。我会回来的，Tenno！哦，我一定会回来的！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Engagement aborted. Self-extracting!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 交战中止。自行撤离！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Hahaha, Ta ta, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哈哈哈，我来了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Troops! Your commander is exfiltrating!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 士兵们！你们的长官正在撤离！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Until next time, Friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 再会，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Very well. I am terminating this engagement. We shall meet again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 很好。这场战斗结束了。我们会再见面的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ugh. For the love of... Fine. Lich out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃。为了爱与……算了。玄骸先撤了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Until next time, Adversary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 再会，我的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Won't lie, this literally always hurts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我没有骗你，这就是字面意义上的一直很疼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Fascinating. I shall factor this experience into future engagement models. Farewell.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太好了。我会将这次经历作为因数纳入未来的交战模型。永别了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You thought you had me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不要以为你打败了我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I love you. To death. 'til next time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我爱你到死。下次见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I know you didn't mean any of that. Farewell, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我知道你不是那个意思。永别了，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh. Look at you, standing up for yourself. So long, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢。看看你，为自己而战。再见了，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My love cannot be contained any more than it can be killed. And so, I go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的爱不能被抑制，也不能被扼杀。所以，我走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: NO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You will not slay. I slip away, to return to stab again one day. Yes yes yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你下不去手，我悄悄溜走，改天再来把你送走。棒棒棒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You let me live, yes? You not follow, yes? Let Lich go, live and let live, yes yes yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你让我活着，对吗？你不会跟过来的，对吗？放玄骸走，若要人敬己，先要己敬人 ，对吗对吗对吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am sorry, mighty Tenno! Kind Tenno! Lich did offend! Bad Lich! Lich departs, yes? Lich bothers nevermore kind Tenno, good Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对不起，伟大的 Tenno！善良的 Tenno！玄骸多有得罪！坏玄骸！玄骸可以滚了，对吗？玄骸再也不会打扰善良的 Tenno、好心的 Tenno 了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I run! I RUN! AAAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我跑！我、跑！啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Please, Friend, tell me that's not all you got?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 拜托，朋友，告诉我你不仅仅只有这些。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Pathetic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 真可悲啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Did you trip?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你刚刚跌倒了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Feeble.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 真软弱啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Having a little trouble, I see?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 如我所见，遇到点麻烦了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Pitiful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 真可怜啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oops. Did I do that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哎呀。这是我做的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Inadequate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 真不够看啊。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oops!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哎呀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: And now I have you right... where... I want you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 现在你……任我为所欲为了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You tried your best, didn't you? Here. Let me help.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你已经尽力了，不是吗？来，让我帮帮你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: AH HAHAHA! HAAAAA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊哈哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Now... the sticking and the cutting and the wetness, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 现在……开始狠狠地刺穿、毫不留情地切开血肉，那些湿漉漉的感觉，啊，就是这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: See you now! Wriggling like a grub! Waggling like a flipped little terrapin! Belly all white and succulent! HAHAA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 看看你现在的样子！像条蛆虫在蠕动！像只被翻过来的乌龟那样挣扎！看看你洁白多汁的肚皮！哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Now you die, Tenno. Now you die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 现在你去死吧，Tenno。现在你去死吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You tore me to pieces, Tenno. That wasn't very nice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno，你把我碎尸万段。那可不太好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your dismemberment of me has not resulted in a conventional outcome.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你对我的肢解，没有达到预期的结果。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Do you have any idea what it takes to reattach severed limbs? You will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你知道把断掉的四肢重新接上要费多大功夫吗？你会知道的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Arms. Legs. Organs. There is nothing you can take from me that I cannot replace. No Hell you can consign me to from which the blood of the Queens cannot retrieve me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 双臂。双腿。各种器官。没有什么是你能从我体内取走，而我却无法替换的。也没有什么地狱是你能让我跌落，而女皇们的血却不能将我从中挽回的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You tore me limb from limb. But I've pulled myself together since then. Hah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的四肢被你一肢接一肢地扯下。但从那以后我就振作起来了。哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The dismemberment you subjected me to was not my first. Will not be my last. Death is no solution to the problem of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你对我的肢解，并不是第一次发生在我身上。同样也不会是最后一次。死亡对我并不是一种解脱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You know, as I watched you hack my limbs off, I thought to myself... "I really don't like this person."
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你知道吗，当我亲眼看着你砍下我的四肢，我心想……"我真不喜欢这个人。"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I have been bisected, dissected, autopsied, upgraded... the line between who I was and what I am erased and redrawn more times than I have bothered to record.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的肉体经历了切割、解剖、尸检和改造升级……我的过去与现在之间的界线，已被一次次地擦除重划。至于这个过程到底发生了多少次，我已经懒得去记了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Anyone can hack someone to pieces. But it takes a GODDESS to put themselves back together again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 任何人都能把别人劈成碎片。但只有神——灵——才能让他们完好如初。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Did you know the human head lives for up to twenty seconds after decapitation? Why do I ask? Oh, no reason.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你知道人的头被砍下后还能活最多二十秒吗？我为什么要问你这个？噢，没有理由。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Flesh, can be replaced. Limbs, exchangeable. But my broken heart? You made off with that, didn't you, little Meat?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 身体，可以替换。四肢，可以交换。但是破碎的心？你拿着它跑了，不是吗，小肉肉？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: When skinning a person alive hypothermia is a risk. The victim may die too quickly. Remember this, should we ever meet in a warm room.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 当活剥一个人的皮时，体温过低是有风险的。这样受害者可能会过快死亡。如果我们在温暖的房间里相遇的话，记住这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You took my arms, yes. And my legs. Yes, yes. And yet here I am. For the old blood never lets a chosen one sleep. Not even when ripped lengthwise, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 没错，你夺走了我的手臂。还有我的腿，是，没错。不过我来了。远古之血永远不会让它的选中者深眠。即使被纵向撕开了，也不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: All debts, Tenno, must be paid, Tenno. To me is owed arms and legs. Arms for the ones you hacked off, legs for the ones you took from me. All debts must be paid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno，血债、血偿。对我来说，你该把我的四肢还来了。胳膊是你砍掉的，腿是你从我这里夺走的。血债血偿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I remember the dismembering. The sight of the world spinning away from my tumbling head, landing amidst my own scattered limbs. Revenge, yes, I think.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我还记得被肢解时的情景。我看到世界从我翻滚的头顶旋转而去，落在我破碎的四肢中。是的，我想，该复仇了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You picked me apart; a perverse child plucking legs from a fly. Grotesque. Nasty. Got m'limbs back, new ones, better ones. Gonna take yours.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你把我拆开了。就像一个变态的孩子把苍蝇的腿拔下来那样。挺怪诞的。也挺令人不快的。我的四肢回来了，全新的，更好的四肢。我要夺走你的了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ah Tenno. You lit up my life. And my body. And organs. And teeth. And now I'm gonna romance you just the same.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 天啊，Tenno。你点燃了我的生命，还有我的身体、器官，和牙齿。现在我要把同样的浪漫给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your voltage exceeded survivable tolerances. And yet, I live.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的电压超过了可存活的极限。然而，我还活着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Remember me? The energy between us is undeniable. Some might say... electric. Ha! You fried me is what I'm saying. Get ready to die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 还记得我吗？我们之间的能量是不可否认的。有人也许会说……很带电。哈！我会说是你把我电到焦了。准备死吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: In a flash your current rewrote who I am. Optimized me. Focused me. On you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 瞬间，你的电流重塑了我的本质。优化了我。聚集我的精力。在你身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm gonna light you up like a Corpus showroom.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我要把你点亮，就像 Corpus 展览室一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I may be electric, but I'm anything but static.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 或许，我是电的化身，但绝不是静电。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your voltage contracted every muscle in my body hard enough to break every bone. Today the role of ME, will be played by YOU. Lights up!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的电压将我身体的每块肌肉收缩变硬，硬到足以折断每根骨头。今天 "我" 这个角色由 "你" 来演。灯光打出来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You thought you put me down. Instead... I was supercharged.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你认为我已被你杀死。然而……我却得到了充能。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: When you electrocuted me my eyes exploded. Isn't that funny?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 当你电击我的时候我的眼球炸开了。那是不是很有趣？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: With a tingle and a flash of light you granted me so many delicious new gifts. Let me thank you, little Meat. I insist.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 仅用一丝刺痛和一刹那的光芒，你给予了我那么多份的大礼。我要感谢你，小肉肉。必须的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm fully-charged and ready for playtime.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我现在电力十足，可以开始玩游戏了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I was electrocuted and you, naughty little Meat... you're grounded.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我被电击了，而你，淘气的小肉肉……你被接上地线了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Lightning struck more than twice, wicked one. Struck me again and again. I strike you, now, as your lightning once struck me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 雷电不止劈了两次，恶人。一次又一次地击中了我。我现在劈打你，就像你的闪电曾经劈中我一样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The lightning-struck oak is the strongest of all. And so the lightning-struck Grineer?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 被雷击的橡木是最坚固的。那么被雷电击中的 Grineer 也是一样的吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your electrickery robbed me of life, made me WISH I were dead, I was not. Make YOU wish, I think I will.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的电击术夺走了我的生命，我多希望自己就那么彻底死去啊，但我没有。现在换你拿走这份"希望"吧，我想我会实现的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: And zap! Just like that! I am back. Crackling with your electrickery. You ten-and-zero wish-to-be-hero. Hoist upon your snapping petard, you will be.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 咔嚓！就像这样，我回来了！还带着你那电击术的噼里啪啦。你这个想当英雄的笨蛋 Tenno，最后搬起石头砸了自己的脚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You might have forgotten the first time we met, but I've still got the third degree burns.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你可能已经忘记了我们的初次交锋，但我的三度烧伤至今还在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I burned, I learned.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 经一焚者，长一智。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: It isn't that you immolated me. It isn't that I died. No. It's that now, the only thing I can smell is pork.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 并不是因为你把我献祭了。也不是因为我死了。都不是。而是因为现在，我唯一能闻到的就是猪肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Flames kill some... forge others.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 一些人被烈焰烧死……幸存者从烈焰中重生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You introduced me to fire. We became friends. We don't like you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你把我介绍给火焰。我们成为了朋友。我们都不喜欢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You incinerated me once, but you'll learn this: the only fire in which we burn, is time. And the blood of the Queens? Has rendered me... fire-proof.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你曾经将我化为灰烬，但是你会了解这一点：我们燃烧的只有时间。至于女皇们的血？赋予了我……对火焰的耐抗性。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Time for a thermal facelift!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 是时候用热拉提除皱了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Fire. Building a revenge is like building a fire. You wait, work, accumulate and then, at the right moment, toss the match.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 火。实施一场复仇如同生起一团火。你等候，努力，累积，然后，在适当的时候，抛出火柴。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Do you remember me, little Meat? The way you turned your fire on me, resculpting me? I'm not mad. I understand.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你还记得我吗，小肉肉？你把你的火撒在我身上，重新塑造了我？我没有生气。我理解。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Fire runs through my body with the pain of loving you. Pain runs through my body with the fires of my love for you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 火焰带着爱你的痛苦在我的身体里流淌。痛苦带着爱你的火焰在我的身体里流淌。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You dressed me in flame, little Meat. We shall be the envy of the ball, you and I.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你给我穿上了火焰，小肉肉。我们会成为舞会上令人羡慕的对象，你和我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Did you know that someone's body can burn for seven whole hours? Did you know that?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你知道某人的身体可以燃烧整整七个小时吗？你知道吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: What you did to me. In my dreams I still burn, Tenno. In my dreams I still burn!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你对我做了什么。Tenno，在我的梦里，我仍在燃烧。在我的梦里，我仍然在燃烧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Rolled in pitch I was, by your dark desires. Set alight by your evil intent. But soon... soon... all scores shall be settled.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我因你的邪念浴火重生。你的邪念燃起了我强大的力量。然而很快…… 很快…… 一切都会尘埃落定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I've not felt a thing since the day you scored away my nerve endings with unholy fire. Not a wince. Not a tickle. What's left to fear now that you hosed my pain away?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 自从你用邪恶的火焰烧掉我神经末梢的那天起，我就没有任何感觉了。没有一丝畏惧，连瘙痒都没有，现在你把我的痛苦都赶走了，还有什么好怕的？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Flame had its way with me, by the mocking flicker of firelight. Undid me, remade me, and now I come a-calling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 火焰在火光的嘲弄下，用它的方式与我相处。毁了我，重塑了我，现在我又回来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Word of advice: when you kill someone, make sure it takes!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 忠告：当你解决掉一个人，一定要确保他咽气！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your murder of me is now redefined as your attempted murder of me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你对我的谋杀现在被重新定义为你对我谋杀未遂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm alive. Alive! Oh. Oh, Tenno. You have no idea what you have brought down upon your head.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我还活着，还活着！噢，噢，Tenno。看来你还没有意识到，你就要自食恶果了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am of the old blood. We do not die, foolish Adversary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我体内流淌着远古之血。我们不会死去，愚蠢的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Death... it's overrated, really.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 死亡……被高估了，真的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am no stranger to the lands beyond Death. It is a sunless place, in a direction you cannot point to. Soon... you shall reside there.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我对死亡之外的土地并不陌生。这是一个不见阳光的地方，你找不到想去的方向。很快……你就将定居在那里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The next time you drop someone at death's door? Knock.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 下次如果你要把某人扔进死亡之门，先敲门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My primate ancestors attempted to fell the moon by hurling stones at it. Your attempts to fell me are no different. You have been... out-evolved, Adversary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的灵长类祖先试图向月球掷石头来使其坠落。这与你伤害我的企图也没什么不同。你已经……在进化中落后了，我的对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: How shocking it must have been for you, to have killed a girl, only to turn around and find the body... gone.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你一定很震惊吧，杀死了个女孩，只是一转身就发现尸体……消失了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Right before someone dies their last word is almost always 'no'. It was my last word to you. Remember?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 人临死前说的最后一句话几乎都是 "不" 。这也是我对你说的最后一句话。还记得吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The Queens have ensured that I can play my games with you - and others like you - for a long, long time.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 女皇们保证了我可以和你——还有其他像你这样的其他人，一起玩很久、很久的游戏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: If all those I've killed were alive right now, do you know what they'd say? "Let me out! Let me out! Where am I? Oh Void it's so dark! AAAGH!"
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 如果我杀死的那些人现在还活着的话，你知道他们会说什么吗？"让我出去！让我出去！我这是在哪？噢，虚空，这里太黑了！啊啊啊！"

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Back from the dead I am. With business to settle. But done smartly. Wisely. Take from you quick smart, never know I was there, yes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我从死里复活，还有一些事情要解决。不过要机智地、明智地完成。没错，就是要快速地、机智地、不被察觉地从你身上掠取。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I carry the old blood. Cannot kill the Queen's Kuva. Was small once, am now the vessel of their red message. Hear it and die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我身怀远古之血。你无法杀死女皇的赤毒。我曾经很渺小，然而现在我是承载着她们红色信息的容器。听完就去死吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The old blood pumps within me. Bit-a-bump, bit-a-bump. The sound of your funeral march it is. Death's gaunt steed, and me astride it. Bittabumpbittabumpbittabump AHAHAHAHAA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 远古之血在我体内流淌。噗通、噗通。这是你葬礼进行曲的节奏。我骑着死亡的骏马。啪嗒啪嗒，啪嗒啪嗒，啊哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Hellooo! Back again. Can't die, won't die. Hahahahaaa...!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哈喽喽喽！又回来了。死不掉，也不会死。哈哈哈哈哈……！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I don't take kindly to being frozen solid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我不喜欢被冻成冰块。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: They say freezing to death is like going to sleep. No. It was an awakening.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 有人说，冻死就像入眠一样。不。这个过程，其实是觉醒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Giving me the cold shoulder? For that I think I'm gonna kick your... ICE! Hahahahaha..
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 给我冷脸？那我会想踢烂你的……冷屁股！哈哈哈哈哈。。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Since you froze me, I feel nothing. Numb. I do not feel the world. I do not feel. I am naught but my will. I will you... ill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你让我陷入了寒冷之中，我失去了知觉。变得麻木。也不再去感受。留存下来的，只有我的心愿。而我的心愿就是……让你受苦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Here's how you're getting out of here: frozen solid, covered in syrup and given to my kubrows as a sugar lick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 告诉你一个离开这里的方法：被冻成冰块，浇上糖浆然后给我的库狛当成糖果来舔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: With your freezing touch my blood pressure dropped to zero. My mind is clear. My thoughts... crystalline.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你那冰冷之触，使我的血压降为零。我的心中毫无杂念。我的思绪……如同水晶般透彻。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm gonna freeze you, feed you feet first into a snowblower and spray what comes out all over Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我会把你冻住，先从你的脚开始放进铲雪机，然后把喷出来的东西洒在希图斯的每一个角落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: With cold comes silence. In silence, with cognitive processors supercooled, I can think. Plan. Execute.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 沉默，随着寒冷一同降临。在沉默之中，认知处理器进入了超低温冷却状态，我才能够思考。计划。执行处决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: If you snap-freeze and flash-fry someone they explode into bloody confetti. This is why I'm not allowed near weddings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 如果将某人速冻后再大火油炸，就会爆炸成血腥的碎末。这就是为什么我不被允许参加婚礼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I had a long time to think, as I thawed out. Naughty little Meat. Naughty, naughty, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 当我等待解冻的时候，有了很多时间去思考。淘气的小肉肉。淘气，淘气，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I've always hated the cold.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我一直都很讨厌寒冷。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Cold kills slowly. The last sense to go is hearing. That means the last voice you'll hear will be mine. Isn't that romantic?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 寒冷会慢慢把人杀死。最后消失的感官是听觉。也就是说你最后听到的声音将是我的。是不是很浪漫呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: How long I slept I do not know. But deep is the sleep of the one you froze.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我睡了多久，我不知道。但是，被你冻结的我，像死人一样沉睡着。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Kuva is stronger than blood. Would not be stilled. By blizzard and flurry I'll see you killed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 赤毒比血液更强大。我不会就这样沉寂的。以漫天飞舞的雪暴之名，我会见证你被杀死的那天。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: To an endless winter you thought me consigned, by the power of your infant will. No. I think not.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你以为凭你那婴儿般的力量，就能让我交代在这无尽寒冬里吗？当然。不会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: By the power of your chilling will you imagined me dispatched. But I carry the old blood, and the old blood learns. Learned from you! Now... now my will knows your secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你自以为凭着自己令人毛骨悚然的力量，就能把我干掉。但我身上流淌着远古之血，它们吃一堑长一智，从你这里学到了！现在……我知道你的秘密了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Whatever poison you pumped me full of, Friend, it didn't do what you thought it would. Heh heh heh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 朋友，无论你给我注满任何毒药，都不会达到你的预期。呵呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your poison did not kill. I evolved. You are no poisoner. You lie. You are a lie.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的毒药没能杀死我。我得到了进化。你不配当投毒者。你只会撒谎。你就是谎言的化身。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The poison is in the dose, Friend. Whatever it was, turns out I'm partial to it. FEELING GOOD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 朋友，这毒药的剂量刚刚好。不管这是什么毒药，我都已经喜欢上它了。这感觉真棒！
