/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: If a poison does not poison it is not a poison. If a killer does not kill they are not a killer. Conclusion: you are not very good at your job.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 如果毒药毒不死人，那就不是毒药。如果杀手杀不了人，那就不算杀手。综上所述：你办事不靠谱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You make me sick, Tenno. No, I mean you literally have made me violently ill and now I'm comprised primarily of foreign bacteria.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno，你让我感到恶心。不对，我是说你的确让我身体严重不适，而且我现在主要就是由外来细菌组成的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: With the addition of your toxin, my body has become a laboratory. In it I develop new miracles. I open gateways... to death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 在你的毒素影响下，我的身体成为了一个实验室。一个能让我研发出奇迹的实验室。我打开了……通往死亡的大门。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your toxin. IMAGINE if a hangover could kill you. Now imagine that hangover is a person. Surprise! It's me and I'm going to kill you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的毒素。想像一下，如果宿醉能杀死你。再想像一下，宿醉是一个人。惊讶吗！是—我—我要杀了你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh little Meat, tiny serpent with your tiny poison... did you really think you could kill a big. Mean. Dragon. Like me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦小肉肉，带着一丢丢毒液的小毒蛇……你真的以为你能够杀死一条像我这样的大、恶、龙？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You imagine yourself toxic. I'll show you toxic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你以为自己充满毒性。那我就给你点毒性瞧瞧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I choked down enough poison from you to kill ten normal Grineer. But a Grineer who has shared the old blood? Is no. Normal. Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我从你那咽下了足够杀死十个普通 Grineer 的毒素。不过对分到了远古之血的 Grineer 来说嘛？他可不是。普通的。Grineer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am grateful for your toxin, little Meat. There was a little too much blood in my poisonstream.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 感谢你的毒素，小肉肉。我毒液里的血太多了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The old blood learns fast. Passes on to me the secrets of your poison. Now those I possess... and soon more.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 远古之血学得很快。它正在告诉我你毒药的秘密。现在我拥有了这些秘密……并且很快会有更多的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your gift of poison has served me well. Rapidly through Grineer ranks I have risen, leaving bodies of friend and superior in my wake. Now I return your toxic favour.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的毒素大礼对我很有帮助。我在 Grineer 的队伍中迅速崛起，踏着朋友和上司的尸体。现在该我回报你的大礼了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: A little poison in your ear, Tenno... a little blackness to shred your veins, muscle-lock those lungs, ferry the life from you on a wave of bile and nausea...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Tenno，洗好耳朵听我说……一小片黑色阴影将会切碎你静脉、让你肺里的横膈膜失去作用，在一阵胆汁和恶心里送走你余下的生命……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Swooning with nausea, I return. Your terror is a panacea, yes. Your pain, reprieve.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 在一阵恶心里，我回来了。你产生的恐惧是灵丹妙药。你的痛苦，能缓解我的症状。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Now you know how it feels, Friend.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 现在你也感同身受了，朋友。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Task complete.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 任务完成。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Uuugh. Nasty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃。恶心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Conflict resolved.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 冲突已解决。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You folded up like a dead man's spine, didn't ya?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你像死人的脊椎那样对折起来，不是吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Outcome has been determined.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 结果出来了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Good night, darling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 晚安，亲爱的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I think you love me because you want to die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我想你是爱我的，因为你想死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: What is this like... for you?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对于你来说……这是什么感觉呢？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I win! I WIN! Now you see. NOW EVERYONE SEES!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我赢了！我、赢、了！现在你看到了。现在所有人都看到了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Yes, Tenno. Now you slack-bodied. Now you fish-cold. Now you understand. Me... is *old*. *Blood.* You. Is just. Bloody. Hahahahaaa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 是吧，Tenno。你现在软成了一滩。像条死鱼一样。现在你能理解了吧，我……就是远、古、之、血。你嘛。血糊糊的。啊哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You fight, you lose. You get, I take. You *learn*, yes. Queens knew: me special. Now you learn, too.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你战斗，你输了。你得到，我拿走。你*得到教训*，没错。女皇们知道：我是特别的。现在你也知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh. I can taste my spleen. That's not good.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦。我能尝到我的脾脏。这不好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Bodily stress... exceeds... engineering... tolerances.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 肉体上的压力……超出了……工程上的……容差。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm just going to come back as somethin' even more horrible.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我很快就会回来的。到那时，我将成为更加可怕的存在。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I have not... planned... for this... contingency.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我还没有……为此……计划……应急措施。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Easy come, easy go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 来得容易，去得快。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Probability... mapping... has... failed... me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 概率……映射……让……我……失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Thank you... for keeping this... interesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 谢谢你……让事情变得……有趣。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Queens! I am in need!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 女皇们！我请求帮助！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ah well...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃，好吧……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, little Meat. I will not die easily. The Old Blood flows within me, deathless.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦，小肉肉。我可没这么容易死。远古之血在我体内流淌，永生不死。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Death is my lover, little Meat. She has held me closer than this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 死亡是我的情人，小肉肉。她曾经离我比现在更近。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Perhaps you deserve this. We both do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 也许这是你活该得到的结局。我们都是。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me... miscalculated.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我……失算了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: It hurts... it hurts...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好痛……好痛……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No. Wait. Let's talk, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不，等等，让我们谈谈，好吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ugh! My dignity!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！我的尊严！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ugh. Down I go. Again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊。我摔倒了。又一次。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My sense of balance is the worst.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的平衡感最差。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Gyroscopic malfunction! Destabilized!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 陀螺仪故障！稳定性已被破坏！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: How dare you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你，怎么敢！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: How could you? You know I have an unusually high center of gravity.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你怎么可以这样呢? 你知道我的重心特别高。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Agh! Me fall down AGAIN?!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！我又双叒叕摔倒了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me fall down, me stand up, me fall down, me stand up! AGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我摔倒了，我站起来，我摔倒了，我站起来！唉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Theeeere you are…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你在这里……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I may not see you, but I smell you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 也许我看不到你，但我感知到了你的气息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Either I need to swab out my pits, or... there's a Tenno in here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 是我该清理了吗，还是……有一个 Tenno 在这。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I smell you. You are... close.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我感知到你了。你很……接近.

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your delicate scent betrays you, little Meat. I know you are here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉，你那美味的气味出卖了你。我知道你在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Little Meat. I'd know your scent anywhere.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉。无论在哪我都能认出你的味道。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I smeeeell yooou...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我闻到你了……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Can hide your awful Tenno body. Cannot hide your awful Tenno stink.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你可以藏起你那具难看的身躯。但你藏不住那股难闻的 Tenno 臭味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I can see, I'm outmatched! Good day, Tenno!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我可以看出，我技不如你。再见，Tenno！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I have... overestimated my capabilities. Withdrawing. Withdrawing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我……高估了我的能力。撤退。撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Well, I don't remember you being quite so... potent. Running away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好吧，我不记得你是如此……强。逃了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Adversary more competent than modeled. Withdrawing to restrategize.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 对手比建模分析的结果还要强大。撤退以制定策略。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You should let a girl know they will be facing you... under-matched. What am I supposed to do now? Run? So undignified.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你应该让一个女孩知道她的对手会…… 比她更强。我现在该怎么办？跑？真怂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You've... grown. That's no fun. Time to leave.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你……变强了。真没意思。是时候走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No! Please! Do not hurt! DO NOT HURT! AAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不！求求你！手下留情！手、下、留、情！啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: What? I am outnumbered! Run away! RUN AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 什么？我寡不敌众。快逃！快、逃！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Wait... if you can kill an Eximus... then... conceivably... you could kill... me? RUN!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 等一下……如果你能杀掉卓越者……那么……换句话说……你能杀了……我？快跑！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: If... if you could defeat an Eximus...! I must fall back... to rethink!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 如果……如果你可以击败一名卓越者……！我必须回头……来重新审视！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Troops! Hold them off while I go for reinforcements! For the Queens!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 军队！当我去强化时拖延住他们！一切为了女皇们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Reassessing: Adversary more formidable than anticipated. Query: have you been working out? Strategy: retreat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 重新评估：对手比预想的还要难以对付。疑问：你有规划过吗？策略：撤退。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You kill my lackeys, now you kill my shiniest. I liked those! I don't want to play with you anymore, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你杀了我的随从们，你杀了我最得意的手下。我喜欢他们！我再也不想和你玩了，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My finest. You killed my finest. YOU KILLED MY FINEST. I thought you liked me. I'm leaving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我最好的士兵。你杀了我最好的士兵。你！杀！了！他！们！我以为你喜欢我的。我走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No! Get up, Eximus! Get up! Save your liege! Save me from Tenno! AAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不！起来，卓越者！站起来！快救你的领主！把我从 Tenno 手中救下来！啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You... you killed my Eximus. Me's did not plan for that. I... I go now. AAAAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你……你杀了我的卓越者。这在我的计划之外。我……我走了。啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Come on, Tenno. Me, by myself? That's hardly a fair fight. Be a good sport.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 来吧，Tenno。我吗，就只有我自己？这可不是一场公平的战斗。有点风度吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Outnumbered! Engagement is tactically unsound. Rethinking strategy!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 敌人数量过多！这种情况下选择交战是很不利的。请重新考虑作战策略！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Uh... I appear to be in this fight... alone. Could we possibly reschedule?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃……我好像在这场战斗中……单打独斗。我们可以重新约时间吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Allies all gone. Odds of success falling. Help! I need help!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 队友全死了。成功机率下降。救命！我需要帮助！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: It... would appear... I am... now... unaccompanied... and... am, therefore... leaving.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 看起来…… 我…… 现在…… 无人伴随…… 因此…… 我要…… 离开。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Why are all my men dead? Why am I now undefended? I was assured they were the best! I CANNOT WORK LIKE THIS. Goodbye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 为什么我的人都死了？为什么我现在毫无防备？他们应该是个中好手啊！我不能再这样工作了。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Wait. Where my backup go? Oh. All dead. AAAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 等等。我的后援去哪儿了？哦。都死了。啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me running now to lull you into false sense of security, not because all my backup dead. AAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我现在逃跑是为了让你陷入虚假的安全感，而不是因为我所有的后援都死了。啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ugh… brats… sticky hands and… shrieking voices! Stay away!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 呃……乳臭未干的小孩……黏黏的手和……尖叫的声音！离我远点！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Children? Children! Unevolved, undeveloped, single-function, parasitic lifeforms! Too human... TOO HUMAN! AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 孩子？孩子！未进化的，未开化的，单细胞寄生生物！太人类了……这太人类了！走开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Agh! Furious children! Coming for meee! This is just like that dream I had!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！愤怒的孩子们！为我而来！就像我曾经做过的梦一样！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Human... human children? From a... human mother? No. Too much. I cannot bear it. AWAY!  AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 人类……人类的孩子？来自一个……人类母亲？不。太过分了。我不能忍受。走开！走开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Aaah! Children!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！小屁孩！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Children? CHILDREN? Away you brats! AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 孩子？孩、子？走开你们这些小鬼！走、开！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: AAAH! CHILDREN! LIKE UNCOOKED TUBEMEN! AAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！！小屁孩！就像半成品的克隆人！啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Away from me kiddies! Little not-men! Little not-ripes! All wrong! ALL WRONG!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 离我远点臭小子！小恶魔！半成品！全都乱套了！全、都、乱、套、了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Too high, too high…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太高了，太高了…

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Vision spinning... breath... short. Altitude...  I have to get away! Away! AWAY!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 眼花……呼吸……急促。这高度……我得走了！得走了！走了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Last person I saw drop from this height... exploded like a bag of soup. I Gotta get away... now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我最后一次看到从这个高度掉下来的人……像一袋汤炸开一般。现在……我得走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No. Too close... too close to the edge. No more! NO MORE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不，太近了……太靠近边缘了。不！不！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh my. Get me down. Get me down. GET ME DOWN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 天啊。让我下来。让我下来。让、我、下、来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh. Please, let's move this away from the edge, hmm? I'm asking you nicely… I HAVE TO GET AWAY FROM THE EDGE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦，拜托，咱们快离开这边缘，嗯？我在友好地问你……我、必、须、远、离、这、边、缘！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: AAH! CLIFF! AAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！悬崖！啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: AAH! ME TERRIBLE WITH HEIGHTS! AAAH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！我恐高！啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Good doggie… GOOD DOGGIE! AAAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 狗狗乖……乖狗狗！啊！！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Aah! Back! Back foul beast!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！退下！污秽的畜生退下！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Good kubrow. Who's a good kubrow? Back. Back! GET BACK YOU MUTT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 乖库狛。谁是乖库狛？退下。退下！别过来，你这狗杂种！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: A kubrow. I am processing... terror.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 一只库狛。我正感受到……恐惧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No! Nononono! Not Kubrows! NOT KUBROWS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不！不不不不！不要库狛！不！要！库！狛！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Kubrows? No. No! Not again. Not after last time!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 库狛？不，不！别再来了。我已经受够了！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Kubrow! With the biting and the gnashing and the bark bark bark! No no NOOOO!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 库狛！又咬人又磨牙又吠个不停！不不不——！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No kubrow! Call it off! Good Tenno! Call it OOOOFFF!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 严禁库狛！让它走开！好 Tenno！让它走——开——！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: This void-forsaken place… is… an abomination... AND I CANT STOP ITCHING!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这一被虚空遗弃之地……真是……令人憎恶……并且我无法摆脱这种厌恶的感觉！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: 'Nature'. A festering cesspit of allergens… and… IRRITANTS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: "自然"。一个充满过敏原的污秽泥沼……还有……刺激物！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Bugs in my ARMOR! This thing's air tight! HOW? AAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的装甲里有虫子！这东西应该是密不透风的！怎么会这样？啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Nay-churrr.... Variables. Detail. Variables. Movement. Variables! Odors, colors, barometric fluctuations, atmospheric agitation...! VARIABLES!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 自 - 然……变量。细节。变量。运动。变量！气味，颜色，气压波动，大气搅动……！都是变量！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Nature. Bugs. Filth. Crawling, burbling, rustling, multi-legged, susurrations of feelers and eyes, and AAAAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 大自然、虫子、脏东西。窸窣作响，有很多条腿的恶心虫子，蠕动的触须和复眼，还有……呃啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You do understand that 'dirt' is just another word for 'filth'? This entire planet is made of... f... feculence. I'll never get clean. I'LL NEVER GET CLEAN.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你知道"污垢"是"肮脏"的另一个词吗？这整个星球都是由…… 污…… 污秽组成的。我永远不会是干净的。我永远都不会变干净。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Nature. Green things. Me no like green things. Crawly things. Slippery things. Bitey things. Nature bad! YES NATURE BAD!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 大自然。绿色的东西。我不喜欢绿色的东西。爬行的东西。滑溜溜的东西。咬人的东西。大自然的坏东西！是的，自然的坏东西！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The mud suckings, the greeny things whisperings, the shadows flitting and moving, and eyes! Eyes everywhere. Me must flee this wild place! Flee at once! FLEE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 泥浆的吸吮，绿不拉几的东西悉悉索索，诡异的影子飘来飘去，还有无数的眼睛！到处都是眼睛。我必须逃离这片荒野！马上逃走！快逃啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Space. Spaaace! Limitless… void! Crushing existential dread! Get it together Lich...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太空。太——空！无边无际的……虚空！碾碎存在的恐惧！玄骸冷静下来……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Space! Infinite... Space! Should never have come here!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太空！无尽的……太空！我真不该来这里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I hate space. If I wanted to be crushed by infinite meaninglessness I'd read your diary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我讨厌太空。如果我想被无边的空虚征服我宁愿读你的日记。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Space. Gulfs. Of Space. Incalculable void. My mind... a recursive... plummeting... loop... AAAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太空。深渊。无尽的虚空。我的意识……不断往复着……坠落的……轮回……啊啊啊啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: No no. Too high. Too far. Get me back on the ground! Get me… back on the ground!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦不。太高了，太远了。快让我回到地面！让我……回到地面！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Space! Who planned this! Get me out of here. GET ME OUT OF HERE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太空！这是谁计划的！让我离开这里。让、我、离、开、这、里！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: OK. Enough... enough time in space. Ground now, yes? Yes. Ground. GROUND. GROUUUND!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好了。够了……在太空中待得够久了。现在回地面，好吗？是的。地面。地面。回地面！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Space. So... so much space. Me. So small. Small me. Nothing me. Floating. Floating forever. FOREVER!  AAGH! AAGH! AAGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 太空。太……空旷了。我，小可怜，如此渺小，什么也做不了的我。漂浮。无尽漂浮。永远停不下来！啊！啊！啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: C'mere you little worm. Time for a spanking.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你这只小虫子过来。是时候打屁股了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Come and get it you little BRAT.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 过来抢啊你这个小孩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh! Kids! I hate kids.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦！孩子！我讨厌孩子。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Children! Your lack of evolution offends me! Your presence here will not be TOLERATED!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 孩子们！你们的止步不前使我反感。你们的存在不能被容忍。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, the little ankle-biters think they can take on the big scary Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦吼吼，只能给我挠痒痒的小虫虫们觉得它们能打败伟大可怖的 Grineer。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Hahaha! Oh, children. I'm about to teach you a VERY important lesson. In HUMILITY.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哈哈哈！小朋友们，我要教给你们很重要的一课。关于谦卑。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me gonna squash the little not-ripe tube men! The little brats. Squash!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我要压扁那些半成品克隆人！小屁孩们。统统压扁！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me properly cooked! Kiddies half-cooked, not right, all wrong. Me fix the all wrong! FIX!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我是完全的成品！小破孩们才是半成品，这不对，都乱套了。我要修正这些错误！修正！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, hey! Corpus! How's it going pencilnecks? RAAARGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，嘿！Corpus！你们这些细脖子的人最近怎么样？啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Death! To the Corpus!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 死亡！正向着 Corpus 走来！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Excuse me one moment, Friend. I have Corpus bugs to squash!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不好意思请给我一点时间，朋友。我要先去拍扁 Corpus 的害虫。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Corpus targets. Negative: Adversary is priority. Kill Corpus. Negative... nyaagh... KILL CORPUS!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 目标 Corpus。不：对手才是优先目标。摧毁 Corpus。不……呀……摧毁 Corpus！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Corpus. How dull. Die, you boring little men.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Corpus。真没意思。死吧，你们这些无聊的小矮人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Corpus, Corpus, Corpus. Boring, Boring, Boring, you really really must leave this party immediately and, above all, violently thank you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Corpus，Corpus，Corpus。无聊，无聊，无聊，我必须要用暴力手段，确保你们提前离场了。非常感谢你们！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Corpus? CORPUS? Shiny, smug, think-so-smart stupid Corpus?! KILL!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Corpus ？Corpus ？？自作聪明的蠢蛋 Corpus？！杀！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: COOOOORPUUUUUSSSS?! Excuse me, Tenno. Me have old score to settle. KILL CORPUS!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: COOOOORPUUUUUSSSS ？！不好意思，Tenno。我有旧账要算。杀了 Corpus ！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Festering! Writhing! Filth! DIE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 腐烂的！蠕动的！污秽！去死吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Infested filth! I consign you to the void!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 肮脏的感染者！我要把你们扔到虚空中！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Infested. I HATE Infested. RAAARGH!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Infested。我讨厌 Infested。啊！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Infested? Priority Target. Eradicating filth.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Infested？头号目标。消除污秽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Infested. Infested! INFESTED! KILLITKILLITKILLITKILLITKILLIT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: Infested。Infested！INFESTED！杀了它杀了它杀了它杀了它杀了它！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Infested. Like a dream of everyone I've ever eviscerated come crawling back to drown me in cold, glistening innards. Die. DiedieDIEDIEDIE!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 感染者。就像一场噩梦，梦见所有被我撕裂的人都爬了回来，把我淹没在冰冷闪亮的内脏里。死吧。死吧，死吧，死吧！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Infested! Writhing, snotty Infested! KILL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 感染者！丑八怪的感染者！杀！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ugh! Infested! So gross. So disgusting. Hate Infested! HATE!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！感染者！真粗野！真恶心！我恨感染者！我恨！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Spreading terror certainly builds up an appetite.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 散布恐惧肯定能增加食欲。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Nutrient levels low. Consuming vitamin slurry...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 营养水平低。正在消耗维生素浆……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Mmm... Mmm. Tastes better than victory.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 嗯……嗯。比胜利更美味。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Refilling nutrient levels. One moment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 正在提升营养水平。马上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: A small morsel, something light. A girl has to keep up her strength.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 清淡的小吃，只吃一小口。女孩子必须保持她的力量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Time for a little meat, little Meat. And then... then the main course.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 是时候来点肉了，小肉肉。然后……然后是主菜。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Snacky snacky snacky...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 吃点心、吃点心，吃点心啦……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Mmm
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 唔，嗯，吧唧吧唧，啊~~~

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You are a fine trophy, Tenno. But this particular beast has caught my eye...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你是一个不错的战利品，Tenno。但是这头特别的野兽引起了我的注意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: A moment, Adversary. I have spotted a prize specimen I simply must have for my wall.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 等一下，对手。我发现了一个优秀的标本，这个标本我势在必得。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Okay, you won't understand, but I HAVE to have that critter. For my collection. Let's just put this on hold for five minutes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好吧，你是不会理解的。不过为了我的收藏品，我对那个生物志在必得。让我们先把这事搁置五分钟吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Pristine fauna specimen. Collection will take but a moment. Reprioritizing target.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 原始动物群系样本。收集它们需要花一点时间。重新确定目标的优先级。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh! What a cutie little critter! I simply must kill it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哦！多可爱的小生物！只是我必须杀了它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: What is that thing. That... that four-legged thing, looking at me. Kill it. I have to kill it. Stop looking at me like that! STOP IT!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 那是什么。那个…… 那个四条腿的东西，正看着我。杀了它。我要杀了它。别那样看着我！不要！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Wait! Waitwaitwait! Pretty animal! Must have pretty animal. Yes. Here pretty pretty pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 等等！等等等等！漂亮的小动物！我必须得到漂亮的小动物。是的。漂漂亮亮可可爱爱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Animal. Pretty animal. Here pretty pretty. Me want. Me KILL!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小动物。漂亮的小动物。漂漂亮亮可可爱爱。可可爱爱没有脑袋！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Finally just us. Those others were just holding me back.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 终于只剩我俩了。其他人只会妨碍我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Reinforcements are superfluous to needs. The strategy coalesces. I am focused.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 增援是多此一举的。策略合并。我将集中精力。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: One-on-one. Just how I like it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 一对一。我就喜欢这样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Alone at last. Just you and me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 曲终人散。只剩我俩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Ah. Alone at last. Time to let my hair down and slice my way into aaaall your delicious little secrets.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 啊！终于孤独一人了。可以放松一下，并以我的方式将你切开，获取你所有美妙的小秘密。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Those troopers were cheap and expendable anyway. You did me a favor. Now I can really cut loose.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 反正那些士兵都是没有价值的，可以随时抛弃。你帮了我一个忙。现在我真的能随心所欲了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Finally all alone. Troopers all gone. Room to really flex on stupid Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 终于一个人了。骑兵们都走了。可以对愚蠢的 Tenno 大展拳脚了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You kill my men, only make me angrier. Stupid Tenno. Now you really feel pain.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你杀了我的人，只会让我更生气。愚蠢的 Tenno。现在你真的感觉到痛苦了吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I've heard the muttering… the scheming… the plotting behind my back. I know. Oh, I know…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我听见我背后的嘀咕声……谋划……情节。我知道。噢，我知道……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Every Grineer traitor has a tell. And when I see that tell… it's lights out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 每个 Grineer 叛徒都有一个破绽。当我注意到那个破绽时……一切就结束了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Men: sure, I may be paranoid... but that doesn't mean EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU ISN'T BACKSTABBING SCUM!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 伙计们：当然，我可能有点偏执……但这并不意味着你们中的每一个人都不是背后阳奉阴违的人渣！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Traitors executed. Ranks optimized.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 叛徒已被处决。部队已经优化。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: THAT'S what traitors get for talking behind my back! Summary dismissal, without references. Or burial.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 那就是叛徒说我坏话的后果！毫不客气地解雇。或埋葬。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Traitor! And as for the rrrrrest of you! I'll find his little compatriots! Oh yes. And when I do. Ooooh, when I do.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 叛徒！至于你们剩下的人嘛！我会找到他那小同伴的！噢就是这样。等我行动的时候，唔哦，等我行动时候你们就知道了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: DIE! Me never liked that guy anyway.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 去死吧！反正我从来都不喜欢那家伙。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me gave you an order, Tube Man! Anyone else feel like a debate?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 克隆人，我给你下了一条命令！还有谁觉得这个情况需要进一步讨论吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Burn. BURN. BURN!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 燃烧。燃烧。燃烧！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Witness the universe in a tongue of flame! As it licks the very flesh from your snotty little bones…
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 见证这个世界被火焰之舌席卷！它会从你那流涕的骨头上舔噬掉最后一点骨肉……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You are gonna light up like a little girl seeing her first Pobber.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你将会像一个小女孩见到她的第一只泡博那样，焕发光彩。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Flame! Efficiency made manifest!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 烈焰！就是高效本身！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Love and flame, little Meat. Both burn, both hurt, both kill.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉，爱情和火焰，都会燃烧，都有伤害，都能杀人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You'll make such a pretty candle, little Meat. Such a pretty, pretty candle.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉，你会成为一根漂亮的蜡烛的。多么漂漂亮亮的蜡烛。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Fire Fire Fire! Ooh, gives me an idea...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 火，燃烧吧！唔，我有了个主意……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Pretty flame! Pretty fire! More pretty! More flame! MORE FIRE!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这火焰真漂亮！好火火！还要更漂亮！更多的火焰！更、多、火、焰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Loo-king GOOD.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 看起来——不错！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You really can't improve upon perfection.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你确实不能在完美上获得进步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I'm either loved or hated... just because I'm so beautiful.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我要么被爱要么被恨……仅仅是因为我如此美丽。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Visual feedback confirms a Platonic ideal of perfection/imperfection. I am pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 视觉反馈证实了一个完美的精神上的优点/缺点。我很漂亮。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Armor polished. Presentation impeccable. I am the very vision of a modern major murderer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 盔甲打磨好了。看起来无可挑剔。我化身成了一名现代主力杀人犯。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Allow me to provide a lesson in personal style, little Meat. You don't have to die... shabby.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 请允许我以个人风格教授一课 ，小肉肉。你不必死得…… 如此寒酸。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me soooo pretty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我真好看。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Me good looking tube-man. Me prime specimen, yes indeed. Ugly Tenno fight because ugly Tenno jealous.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 帅气克隆人如我。顶级标本如我，没错，就是这样。丑陋的 Tenno 战斗是因为丑陋的 Tenno 嫉妒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I hope you haven't forgotten me, Tenno. I most certainly have not forgotten you.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我希望你没有忘记我，Tenno。我当然也没有忘记你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I can wait forever, Adversary. But I won't.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的对手，我可以一直等下去。但是我不会这样做。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You are dead already. I know it. The System knows it. My fifteen friends who are betting on it, know it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你死定了。我明白。这个星系明白。我的十五个为此下注的朋友都明白这一点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your crime has not been forgotten, Adversary. Your crime of existence.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的对手，你的罪行并未被人遗忘。你的罪行仍存于世。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Are you ignoring me, Tenno? You bruise my feelings.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你这是在无视我吗，Tenno？你伤害了我的感情。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your reactions fall within expected parameters. Outcomes have been mapped. Continue as you are. I shall be waiting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的反应在预期参数区间内。结果已被映射。照原样继续。我会等下去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I've been taking time to work on... me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我一直有把时间花在……我身上。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You can no more resolve a solution for the equation I represent than a kubrow might fathom a card trick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 库狛也许能看破纸牌魔术，但你绝对无法解出我提出的方程。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Yoo hoo. Snickety-snack, guess who's back?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哟吼。餐前小吃，猜猜谁回来了？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Think, Adversary. Fathom me. Find me. And die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 想想吧，我的对手。研究我。找到我。然后就是你的死期。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Hard-to-get isn't a good look for you, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 欲擒故纵不适合你，小肉肉。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Are you receiving visitors?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你在接待访客吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, you. Don't be in a snit. Let's talk, you silly thing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，你不要发脾气。让我们谈谈，你这个蠢货。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You've been bad.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你可真坏。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The chase continues, little Meat.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 小肉肉，追逐继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Kill you I will, yes. In a time of my choosing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 没错，我会宰了你。由我选择时机。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I know where you are. Floating, in your little ship. But I wait. Never see me coming.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我知道你在哪。在你的小破船上，漂流。不过我会再等等的。你永远预见不了我的到来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am alive, not dead. I am dead, not alive. Kill and live, live and kill. Hahahahaa.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我还活着，还没死。我已经死了，不再活着了。生死之间，死生之间。哈哈哈哈。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The old blood smells what it hates, and it smells you. Nowhere to hide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 远古之血能闻到它讨厌的东西，而它闻到了你。无处可逃。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Nice Tenno. Good Tenno. We can be friends, yes? Tell me where you are, yes? Tell your friend WHERE YOU ARE!!!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 好 Tenno。乖 Tenno。我们可以成为朋友，对吗？告诉我你在哪里，好吗？告诉你的朋友你、在、哪、里！！！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Found you!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 找到你了！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Your arrival is noted. Your expulsion inevitable. Proceed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你的到来记录在案。你的驱逐不可避免。继续。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Friend! It's been too long.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 朋友！已经过去很久了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Encounter: modeled. There are three solutions in which you win, 439 in which you die. Your move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 遭遇战：预测模型已建立。你能获胜的情况只有 3 个，而在其余 439 种可能之中，你都会死。轮到你行动了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Wakey, wakey!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 醒醒，快醒醒！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You shall die, and I shall allow myself... enjoyment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你将会死去，而我则会……享受愉悦。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am the hunter, you are the prey. That's how this works! Questions?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我是猎人，你是猎物。就是这样！有什么问题吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I am here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我在这里。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Friend, Friend, Friend. We keep meeting like this.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 朋友，朋友，朋友。我们一直这样见面。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Prepare.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 准备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Remember how much fun we had when you killed me?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 还记得你杀死我的时候，我们玩得有多开心吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I forgive you for what you did.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我原谅你的所作所为。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I remember every moment we've shared. Every touch. Every lash. Every wound.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我记得我们分享的每一刻时光。每一次触碰。每一次鞭打。每一个伤口。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You are mine, little Meat. No-one else's.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你是我的，小肉肉。只属于我一个人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: This has to hurt, little Meat. Or else why bother?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这必须得疼，小肉肉。要不然何必这么麻烦？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I seeeee you... hahahaha...
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我看见你了……哈哈哈哈……

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Where you look... I am not. And then, suddenly, I am.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你追踪的那里……没有我的真身。突然间，我就出现了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Never safe no no no. I find you. My blade soon calls your heart its home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 不不不，你将永无宁日。我会找到你。我很快就会把利刃捅进你的心脏，给它找个永远的归宿。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: So certain you were, so safe. You will not be remembered.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你以为，自己很安全。呵，到时候这个世界上不会有人记得你的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I find you. I take you. Like plucking fruit from a tree.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我会找到你。带走你的性命。就像从树上摘下水果那样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I think I have something of yours? AHAHAHAHA!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我想我这有你的东西？啊哈哈哈哈！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: All who pass through my Sector must pay the tax. You are no exception, my little Adversary.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 所有从我星区通过的人都必须留下买路财。你也不例外，我的小对手。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Yoink! What was yours is now mine. Bye bye.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 哟！你曾经所拥有的现在都是我的了。再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Adversary: I have taken my tithe, as is my right as holder of this Sector.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的对手：我负责征税，这是我作为这个星区的控制者所享有的权利。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Wallet feeling a little light, Friend? Heh heh heh heh.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 朋友，你的钱包有点薄？呵呵呵呵。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I take your coin as easily as I take your life, your power, your joy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我取走你的硬币，就像我取走你的性命、你的力量和你的喜悦一样轻而易举。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Operating in MY sector, Friend? Time to pay the idiot tax.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 想要经过我的领地，朋友？是时候留下买路财了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Tithe accepted. You may go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 征税已接受。你可以走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: I didn't say you could play here. Now give me that.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我没说你可以在这里玩。现在，交上来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Everyone pays in my playground. One way or the other.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 所有人在我的地盘上都得付出代价。不管怎样。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Oh, little Meat. Too kind. I shall buy something lovely with this. A germ weapon, perhaps.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 噢，小肉肉。太好了。我要用这个买些可爱的东西。或许买个细菌武器。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: A little treat from my little Meat. Thank you, darling.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 从我的小肉肉那收取一个小礼物。亲爱的，谢谢你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You earn. I take. Now I make the rules, yes?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你赚。我拿。现在轮到我制定规则了，对吧？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: My Sector. My rules. Your money? My money.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我的星区听我的。你的钱？是我的钱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Everyone who passes through my Sector pays tax to Lord Me. Yes. My Sector, my kingdom, you pay.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 每一个经过我星区的人都要向领主我交税。是的。我的星区，我的王国，你买单。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: This all you got? Hmm. Next time you pay more, Tenno. Now go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 你就只有这些吗？唔。Tenno，下次你得多付点。现在退下吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sukjekkt found. Moderate clone rot. Initiating reclamation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 发现实验体。克隆体腐烂程度中等。开始进行回收。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Queens will not be pleased. Clone rot has gone too far. Send word.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 这可不是什么能让女皇陛下满意的结果啊。克隆体腐烂程度过于严重。向上头汇报吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sukjekkt found. In her name.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 发现实验体。女皇万岁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Soldier - you have been nominated. Your glory awaits in her fortress.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 士兵，你已获得提名。前往女皇陛下的要塞吧，你的荣耀就在那里等着你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sukjekkt found. Significant trauma. Removing to galleon to assess Kuva Lich viability.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 发现实验体。受伤严重。运到帆船战舰上去吧，在那里进行赤毒玄骸资格检测。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Inform the Queens we have found their sukjekkt.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 快快禀报双子女皇，我们发现了陛下们的实验体。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: Sukjekkt secured. Removing from battlefield. Peezporr enkkaagge kraaft!
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 实验体收容完毕。撤离战场。所有人速速登舰！

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: The Queens have chosen you, soldier. You are to be… gifted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 士兵，女皇陛下钦定了你。你将获得……恩赐。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: You are Queen-chosen, soldier. Greatness awaits you. Greatness… or perhaps death.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 士兵，你是被女皇陛下钦定的人。伟大的成就在等着你。成就……亦或是死亡。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.text: We have the chosen sukjekkt. They will become Lich, or die.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DLich.zhText: 我们找到了被选中的实验体。他们将成为玄骸，或者死去。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DWitc.text: We hope. More life. Work. Kill… maybe Queens notice.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DWitc.zhText: 我们想要。更长的寿命。更多的任务。更多的杀戮……也许女皇们能注意到。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DWitc.text: Maybe they share. The old blood.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DWitc.zhText: 说不定她们会分给我们，远古之血。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DWitc.text: We are maggots. But… eventually… even maggots… can fly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaLich/DWitc.zhText: 我们是蛆虫。但是……最后……即便是蛆虫……也能飞翔。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: Predictable. As expected Grineer have shut down the environmental systems. Sending modified Life-Support Capsules. Use these to sustain your environment or attach Kuva Catalysts to begin harvesting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 正如我所料。Grineer 果然已经关闭环境系统。我正在配送改良的维生装置。利用这些来维持环境或连接赤毒催化剂来开始采集。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: You have found a Kuva Catalyst, attach it to a Life Support Capsule to begin harvesting Kuva.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 你找到了一个赤毒催化剂，将它连接到维生装置来开始采集赤毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: This capsule will now harvest Kuva.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 这台装置现在开始采集赤毒了。
改良完成。开始收集赤毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: Scans show Grineer are harvesting Kuva nearby. Set off the alarms to draw them out, then steal their Kuva Catalysts.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 扫描显示 Grineer 正在附近采集赤毒。触发警报把敌人引出来然后夺取他们身上的赤毒催化剂。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: A Kuva harvesting capsule has been destroyed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 一台赤毒采集装置已被摧毁。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: A harvester has finished, collect the Kuva.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 一台采集器已经完成，去收集赤毒。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: Kuva is ready to be collected.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 赤毒已经可以准备收集了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.text: Grab the Kuva from that capsule.
Caution, Tenno, capsules harvesting Kuva provide minimal life-support.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/KuvaSurvival/D.zhText: 注意，Tenno，采集赤毒的装置只能提供极少的生命维持量。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The target is in the vicinity, but you need to draw them out to fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 目标就在附近，但你需要将其引出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Our target is nearby but won't engage us until you force the issue.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们的目标就在附近，但你得主动施压，他才会现身应战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Draw the target out of hiding by taking out their troops.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 消灭他们的部队，将目标引出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's it. The target's come out for a fight. Make it their last.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 就是这样，目标已经现身应战。让其有来无回。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The target escaped. This mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 目标已逃脱。本次任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The target has left the area. Our opportunity window has closed.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 目标已经离开该区域。我们再也没有机会了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: A high-profile enemy who has evaded us for quite some time has just shown up on scans. I need them eliminated. Move to the waypoint to accept this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 一名潜逃已久的重要敌人刚刚现身了，我需要你解决掉他。前往路标点，接受任务。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I have just spotted a high-ranking Grineer target of opportunity in your vicinity. If you're available, proceed to the waypoint at once.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我刚在你附近发现了一名地位很高的克隆尼目标。如果你有空，就立刻前往路标点。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Hurry up. Our target won't stay exposed forever.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 抓紧，目标不会一直冒险暴露的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You're running out of time our Grineer target is preparing to move.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你的时间不多了，克隆尼目标正准备转移。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Enemy target eliminated. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌对目标已消灭。做得很好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: New Grineer boss-man's been givin' us no end of trouble. You're my go to Tenno. Make him go away, yeah?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 新来的克隆尼头头找了我们不少麻烦。你可是我这最靠谱的 Tenno。让他从平野上消失，怎么样？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I've located the Commander, he's moving on foot. Intercept and bring him in alive.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我已锁定敌方指挥官的位置，他正在徒步移动。把他带回来，一定要抓活的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Good work, Tenno, I'm about to show bossman some Ostron "hospitality". Sho-lah.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 干得好，Tenno。我要让这位领导，好好领教一下奥斯特朗人的「待客之道」。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿，再见。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Commander is in the area. Scanning... He's hiding. Okay, Tenno, see if you can draw the Commander out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌方指挥官就在这一带，正在扫描……他藏起来了。Tenno，试试能不能把他引出来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Lights out for bossman. You're off the clock, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 那个头头休息啦。你也可以收工了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I'm tracking a Grineer drone with information about our target. Bring it to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我正在追踪一台克隆尼无人机，里面有和目标相关的情报。把它截落，然后带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The drone is ours. Analyzing data stream. Excellent, a possible lead.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 无人机到手了，正在分析数据流。很好，找到一条线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Konzu is right, we must create chaos to draw this Grineer Commander into an open fight.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 孔尊说得对，我们必须制造混乱，才能引这个克隆尼指挥官出来和你进行交战。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Seized intelligence has revealed the location of the Commander's camp. Liberate it from him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们得到情报，发现了克隆尼指挥官营地的位置。把营地从他手中夺过来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: We've captured the camp. The Commander has retreated to a new position.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们已成功占领营地，敌方指挥官已撤往新的阵地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Our target is about to receive pieces of a communications array in a supply drop. Interrupt the drop and destroy the equipment.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 目标即将接收一批空投补给，里面装有通信阵列的组件。拦截敌方空投，摧毁他们的设备。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Their comms just lit up. They're not happy about what you just did. Let's keep it that way.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人的通信频道乱成一团了。他们对你刚才的行动非常不满。继续给他们添点乱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Commander has requested a supply drop to quell unrest among his troops. Intercept the drop to keep them on edge.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌方指挥官要求总部投放补给，想安抚部下的骚动。拦截空投，让他们继续人心惶惶。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Radio chatter indicates falling morale within the Grineer ranks. That's bad news for the Commander.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 截获的通讯显示，克隆尼部队的士气正在下滑。这对敌方指挥官来说，可不是什么好消息。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Plains living is tough living. Grineer are finding that out the hard way. Let's make 'em find out a little faster. Cut off their supplies.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 平野上的日子可不好过，克隆尼要吃点苦头才能明白。咱们可以教教他们，先断了他们的补给。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Commander in charge of this detachment is hiding somewhere near my waypoint. Draw them out and eliminate them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这支部队的指挥官就躲在我标的位置附近。去把他引出来，然后干掉他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The loss of that Commander will lead to uncertainty and in-fighting among his former troops. Good work.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 没有了指挥官，他的旧部肯定会军心动摇，陷入内讧。做得好。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Emergency Grineer supply caches are hidden in the vicinity of my waypoint. Empty them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 路标点附近藏着克隆尼的应急补给箱。把里面的物资全部拿走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: With that last cache you sent a message to this detachment, 'Nothing they have is safe.'
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 物资全部到手，也等于向这支部队传达了一个信号：「他们的东西都不再安全了。」

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Without supplies, the Grineer rank and file have fallen into disarray. This is the time to strike.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 没有了补给，克隆尼部队陷入一片混乱。现在正是出击的好时候。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The detachment won't soon recover from that strike. You've weakened them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这支部队短时间内没办法恢复过来了。你成功削弱了他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You've left the Commander of this detachment weak and exposed. Capture him and let's see what he has to say.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你削弱了这支部队的力量，他们的指挥官也彻底暴露了。将其活捉，看看他能交代些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: All your work has lead to this, take out as many Grineer as you can.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 之前的一切行动，都是为了这一刻。尽可能多地消灭克隆尼。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Almost feel sorry for 'em. Then I remember what's been done to us and I'm at peace. Here's your bounty, swazdo-lah, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我差点都要同情他们了。可一想起他们做过的事，心里就踏实多了。赏金拿好。谢谢你，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You've weakened the Grineer detachment^ now it's time to send them running. Force them out of their camp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你大幅削弱了这支克隆尼部队。现在该送客了。夺下营地，把他们彻底赶走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Starved 'em out of house and home. I'd feel bad, but this isn't their house or their home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 断了敌人的粮，也端了他们的窝。别人我可能会同情，但这本来也不是他们的家。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Thanks to you, Grineer morale is desperately low. Command wants to remedy the situation with a supply drop. Make sure that never happens.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 多亏了你的行动，克隆尼部队的士气已跌至谷底。敌方指挥部想通过空投补给来挽回局面。绝不能让他们得逞。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You got them itchin' to run home to the safety of their galleons. Exactly what I wanted.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你把敌人吓得无心作战，只想逃回飞船避难。这正合我意。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I was never able to imagine a future without Grineer. Now I can, thanks to you Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 以前，我从来不敢想象没有克隆尼的日子是什么样。现在能了，多亏了你，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I need you to recover a Grineer drone so that I can access its logs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我需要你回收一台克隆尼无人机，我要查看它的记录。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Thank you. I can use the codes in this Grineer drone to sow confusion within the Grineer ranks.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 谢谢。这台克隆尼无人机的代码，可以用来扰乱克隆尼部队的指挥系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Konzu is right^ the Grineer can never be allowed to live comfortably on the plains. Let's make this place as inhospitable as possible for them.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 孔尊说得对，不能让克隆尼在平野上过得太舒服了。我们来给他们找点不痛快吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I want you to liberate a key operations camp.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我想让你夺下一座重要的敌方营地。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Without control of that camp, their resources cannot move freely around the plains.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 失去那座营地之后，他们就无法像以前一样随意运输资源了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: This Grineer detachment is running low on material. Let's hasten the process by taking out one of their armored supply vaults.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这支克隆尼部队的物资已经所剩无几。摧毁他们的装甲物资仓库，给他们火上浇油。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Grineer troops were desperate for those supplies. Let's see if that got a reaction.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼部队急需那批补给。看看这次打击能否逼他们有所行动。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Quills say some high up Commander is here to inspect the troops. Sent by the Queens they say. So, send the Queens a message^ their troops are not welcome near Cetus.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 夜羽说，有个高级指挥官来到希图斯视察部队，好像是女皇亲自派来的。那就替我给女皇带个口信儿：希图斯不欢迎她们的部队。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Our Commander has run out of options. Find him at the waypoint and capture him for me. I have questions I want him to answer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌方指挥官已经无路可走。去路标点抓住他，活着带回来。我有些问题，需要他亲口回答。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Lotus has the commander in her custody? He won't be sleeping too good tonight. But I will. Dah-dap, surah
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 哈哈哈哈莲把那个指挥官关起来了？他今晚怕是睡不安稳咯。不过我正好能睡个好觉。谢谢，朋友。哈哈哈哈哈

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Intel suggests the Commander has released surveillance drones onto the plains to complete his assessment. Find one and bring it to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 情报表明，敌方指挥官在平野上投放了监控无人机，用来协助视察。找到并截落一台，带回来给我。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Scanning the drone's systems... Here we go, standby for coordinates.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 正在扫描无人机系统……找到了，准备接收坐标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Konzu's intel aligns with my own. A high-ranking Grineer Commander landed on the plains hours ago, but his precise location is still a mystery. Let's track him down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 孔尊的情报和我掌握的一致。几小时前，有一名克隆尼高级指挥官在平野着陆，但我还没掌握他的确切位置。我们来追查他的下落。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I've found the Commander's camp. Liberate it from Grineer control.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我找到敌方指挥官的营地了。将那里从克隆尼手中夺下来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Commander has one less place to hide.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌方指挥官又少了一个藏身之处。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Commander is having special supplies sent in just for him. Intercept the shipment and destroy it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌方指挥官正在调运一批专供他使用的物资。做好准备，拦截运输，摧毁货物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Comms just lit up, the Commander's subordinates are all trying to deflect blame. Let's see if they drop any more intel.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人的通信频道乱成一团。指挥官的手下争相推卸责任。看看他们会不会透露出更多的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Resources plundered from the plains and destined to be a tribute for The Queens, are being held in the armored vault near my waypoint. Make sure the Queens see none of this bounty.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人在平野上劫掠资源，准备当作贡品献给女皇。他们把物资储藏在路标点附近的装甲仓库里。别让女皇见到半点贡品。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Commander is going to have a hard time fleeing without his tribute for the Queens. He's stuck here, now we find him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 没有献给女皇的贡品，他们的指挥官就不敢擅自撤离。他已经被困在这里。趁此机会找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Shhh... we don't know who could be listening. Quills tell me there's a Grineer spy lurking in Cetus. As usual, they're short details. Looking for you to put some pressure on the Grineer out there, so we can find the spy in here.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 嘘……小心隔墙有耳。夜羽告诉我，有个克隆尼间谍潜伏在希图斯。和往常一样，他们一个字也不肯多说。希望你能给外面的克隆尼上点压力，好让躲起来的间谍露出马脚。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Thanks to you, the spy has been unmasked. They're fleeing Cetus on foot. Find them and bring them to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 多亏了你，我们识破了间谍的身份。他正打算徒步逃离希图斯。找到他，把人活着带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Thank the Unum! Without you, we may have never have caught him. You earned this bounty, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 感谢乌努母神！要不是你，我们恐怕永远抓不住他。这份赏金是你应得的，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I suspect the spy is communicating with nearby drones. I'll need to examine one to know for sure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我怀疑间谍在利用附近的无人机联络外界。不过我需要检查其中一台，才能确定。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Just as I thought, the spy was using that drone to relay information to Grineer command. You've cut off his line of communication.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 一切正如我所料，间谍一直在利用那台无人机，向克隆尼总部传递情报。不过你已经切断了他的通信手段。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Konzu has little information about the spy's identity or location. Collect enough intel to unmask this spy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 孔尊掌握的情报有限，无法确认间谍的身份或位置。收集足够的情报，尽快撕下这个间谍的伪装。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Take out this camp. Once liberated I'll scan it for intel on the spy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 夺下这座营地，清除敌军后，我会扫描该区域，搜寻有关间谍的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Plenty of intel was left behind. I'm closer than ever to identifying the spy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人留下了大量情报，我们离查清间谍的身份又近了一步。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Grineer have just captured one of Konzu's scouts. Rescue them and see what they know.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼刚刚抓住了孔尊的探子。去营救他，看看他都知道些什么。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The scout has relayed crucial information about the Grineer spy.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 探子提供了有关克隆尼间谍的关键情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Raid the Grineer resource vault at my location. I want to put them on edge, so they start making mistakes.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 袭击标记点的克隆尼资源仓库。我要让他们人心惶惶，开始犯错。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Radio chatter during that strike gave away crucial details about the spy. The walls are closing.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 刚才突袭期间截获的通讯，泄露了有关间谍的关键情报。这次他逃不掉了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: We can no longer complete our objective. I will let Konzu know we have failed him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们无法完成目标了。我会通知孔尊，任务失败了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Quills are at it again. Telling me an important Orokin relic is being unearthed by the Grineer. The Quills would like this relic back, and I would like to keep the Quills happy. Will you oblige?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 夜羽又有消息了。他们说，克隆尼正在挖掘一件重要的奥罗金遗物。夜羽想把遗物拿回来，我可不想让他失望。你愿意帮忙吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: At my waypoint, you'll find the Commander responsible for taking the relic. Eliminate him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 负责夺走遗物的指挥官就在路标点。消灭目标。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: With that Commander eliminated the Quill's relics are much safer. But we still need to find the one they have.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 指挥官死后，夜羽的遗物就安全多了。不过我们还得找到被拿走的那一件。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Scans indicate the Grineer have a hidden supply cache at this waypoint. Search the area for the relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 扫描结果显示，克隆尼在路标点附近藏了补给箱。去那里寻找遗物吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: No sign of the relic. But the Grineer will not be happy about losing those resources.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 没有发现遗物。不过失去了这批资源，克隆尼肯定也不好受。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Quick. The Grineer archeologist who uncovered the relic is on the move. Bring them in for questioning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 赶快行动，那名挖掘出遗物的克隆尼考古学家正在转移。把他带回来审问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Interrogation complete. We have new leads to investigate.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 审问结束，我们现在掌握到了新的线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: They're trying to hide the relic on us in the hopes we'll forget about it and call the search off. Search the caches near my waypoint to recover it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼试图把遗物藏起来，指望我们放弃搜索。搜索路标点附近的储藏箱，并取回遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Ah there it is. Beautiful-utz. Sho-lah, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 啊，就是这个。真漂亮。再见，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I'm tracking a Grineer agent in possession of the Relic. It appears he's trying to get it off the plains on foot. Capture him, and the relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我追踪到一名克隆尼特工，遗物就在他身上。他似乎打算徒步将遗物带出平野。活捉目标，拿回遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You captured the relic and the Grineer Archeologist? He and I are going to have an interesting conversation. Dah-dap, Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你不光拿回了遗物，还抓到那个克隆尼考古学家？我可得跟他好好聊聊。谢了，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I located the relic. The Grineer hid it in an armored vault at my waypoint. Go. Quick.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我找到遗物了。克隆尼把它藏在路标点的装甲金库里。立刻出发。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The relic! You found it! The Quills will be very happy to hear this, or they would be if they were capable of emotion. Either way, I'm happy. Bounty paid.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 遗物！你找到它了！夜羽听到这个消息肯定很开心。前提是他们还有感情的话。不管怎样，我很高兴。赏金给你。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Grineer have been using drones to perform subsurface scans of the plains. Hijack one for me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 克隆尼一直在用无人机扫描平野的地下。帮助我侵入一台无人机的系统。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The drone had a complete imprint of the relic^ I know what to look for now.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 无人机存有遗物的完整扫描信息，现在我知道该找什么了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Details about this relic and its whereabouts are scarce. I need you to do some digging.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 关于这件遗物，我们目前还没什么情报。我需要你进一步调查。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: This camp is the command point for Grineer archaeological operations. Shut them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这座营地就是克隆尼考古工程的指挥中心。趁这个机会，一举端掉它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The relic was here, and not long ago. We'll keep hunting.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 遗物不久前还在这里，可能刚被运走。继续寻找。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I've learned of an Ostron miner who was captured by the Grineer. Bring him home.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我得到消息，有一名奥斯特朗矿工被克隆尼抓住了。把他安全带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Thanks to that miner we have new leads on the relic's location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 多亏这名矿工，我们掌握了有关遗物位置的新线索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Our latest intel points to the armored vault at my waypoint. Break in and look for the relic.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 最新情报显示，我在路标点发现一座装甲金库。入侵金库，寻找遗物。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Too late. The Grineer moved the relic already.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 来晚了，遗物已经被克隆尼转移走了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The Quills whispered about some sort of new weapon the grineer have. They've deployed in bits and pieces to avoid detection. They want to attack the Unum's tower and I don't want to find out if that's possible. Understand?
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 夜羽那边传来风声，克隆尼弄出了一种新武器。他们把武器拆开运输，好躲开我们的探测。他们想袭击乌努母神之塔，但我并不想知道这把武器到底有没有用。明白了吗？

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: A Grineer science officer responsible for deploying the array has just arrived on the plains. Bring him to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 有消息说，负责部署阵列的克隆尼科学专家刚刚抵达平野。想办法把他活着带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Thank you, Tenno, this science officer will have much to tell us about his project.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 谢谢你，Tenno。从这位科学专家口中能套出不少阵列相关的情报。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: A regiment of Grineer combat engineers who have been ordered to assemble the weapons array is massing at my waypoint. Go there and take them out.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 一支奉命组装武器阵列的克隆尼作战工兵团，正在路标点集结。抓紧时间去解决他们。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's enough. You've broken this regiment and with it, the Grineer's ability to quickly deploy the array.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这样就足够了。你击溃了这支兵团，克隆尼也无法快速部署阵列了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Codes obtained from the science officer disabled the array's control drone. Find it and bring it to me.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我用科学专家提供的代码关闭了阵列的控制无人机。找到这台无人机，把它带回来。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Ai yo, Tenno. You put that weapon on ice. Now the Unum's safe. Not that I ever worry much 'bout the Unum.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 啊呀，Tenno，多亏你，那件武器算是彻底歇菜了。乌努母神也安全了，不过她也用不着我替她操心。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: An Ostron patrol was able to knock out the array's control drone. Locate the downed drone before the Grineer.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 一支奥斯特朗巡逻队击落了敌方武器阵列的控制无人机。一定要抢在克隆尼之前找到它。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's one piece of the puzzle. Now for the rest.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这是第一条线索，接下来我们要继续找剩下的。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Disrupt and destroy anything associated with this weapons project. The Orokin Tower is what protects Cetus from Grineer^ we can't give them the opportunity to attack it.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 破坏并摧毁一切与该武器项目有关的设施。这座远古奥罗金塔一直保护着希图斯，抵御克隆尼的侵袭。绝不能给他们袭击塔的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Resources needed to assemble the weapons array are stored in an armored vault at my waypoint. Put them to better use.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 组装武器阵列所需的资源，就藏在路标点的装甲金库中。把资源夺走，让这些资源发挥更有价值的作用。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That strike has delayed Grineer operations significantly.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这次袭击大幅拖延了克隆尼的行动进度。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: This Grineer Commander is likely responsible for the Ostron's disappearance. Bring them to me for questioning.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 这名克隆尼指挥官很有可能与奥斯特朗人的失踪有关。把他活着带回来，我亲自审问。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: An easy interrogation. Our prisoner is on the move, with more data we can pinpoint the route.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 审问没费太多功夫。我们的俘虏正被转移，如果有更多的数据就可以精确定位移动路线了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, with the intel you've gathered I've managed to pinpoint the trapper's location. Rescue him.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，多亏你收集的情报，我已经成功锁定了俘虏的位置。去营救他吧。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Our citizen is safe, and the Grineer now know what happens when you mess with our people. You earned this bounty Tenno.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们的同胞安全了。克隆尼现在也该明白，招惹奥斯特朗人会有什么下场。这份赏金是你应得的，Tenno。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I've identified a drone that was active near the Ostron's last known location. Bring it to me so I can examine its logs.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 在那名奥斯特朗人最后出没的位置附近，我发现了一台无人机。把它带回来，好让我检查数据日志。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Just as I suspected, the Grineer drone saw the Ostron. We can use this information to help pinpoint his current location.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 和我预料的一样，这台克隆尼无人机拍到了那名奥斯特朗人。我们可以利用这条情报来定位他的位置。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: We can't let the Grineer terrorize the people of Cetus. Find this trapper and if he's alive bring him back to safety.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们绝不能容忍克隆尼恐吓希图斯的人民。找到这名布兽夹的村民，如果他还活着，将他带回安全的地方。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: We need to put the Grineer on alert, let them know the Ostrons are off limits. Raid their camp and send them running.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 我们需要给克隆尼一点警告，让他们明白奥斯特朗人可不是好惹的。突袭他们的营地，把他们赶走。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: During the chaos, I intercepted a transmission that confirms the Grineer are holding the Ostron prisoner.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 趁着刚才的混乱，我拦截到一段通讯，确认克隆尼确实囚禁了那名奥斯特朗人。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: You're nearing the supply caches but I am unable to pinpoint their locations. You'll have to search them all out for yourself.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 你正在靠近补给箱，但我无法确定它们的具体位置。只能由你亲自搜索。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The enemy have escaped with the remaining supply caches. We cannot allow this to happen again.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌人已经带着剩余的补给箱逃脱了。绝不能再让这种事发生。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Excellent hunting, you found one of the caches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 找得漂亮，你发现了一个储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's one of the caches.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 那里有一个补给储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Cache found.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 发现储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Those supply caches have disappeared from my scans. We missed our chance.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 那些补给箱已经从我的扫描数据中消失。看来我们错失了机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Intel indicates the enemy has dropped a number of supply caches nearby. If you are able to accept this mission, travel to the waypoint and recover supplies before our enemy does.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 情报显示，敌人在附近投下了数个补给箱。如果你能够接受这项任务，就前往路标点，抢在敌军之前回收物资。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's it, only one more to go.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 就是这样，还差一个。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Just one cache remaining.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 只剩一个储藏箱了。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: That's the last cache.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 那就是最后一个储藏箱。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The officer is nearby, track them down.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 那名军官就在附近，马上找到他。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: The officer has escaped, this mission is a failure.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 很遗憾，敌方军官逃走了，任务失败。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: I've lost the officer, and with them our opportunity for interrogation.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: 敌方军官不见了，很遗憾，我们失去了审问他的机会。

/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.text: Tenno, I have just pinpointed the location of an enemy officer wanted for interrogation. I need them brought to me alive. Travel to the waypoint to take on this mission.
/Lotus/Language/Subtitles/LandscapeMissi.zhText: Tenno，我刚刚锁定了一名敌方军官的位置，必须将其活着带回来。前往路标点接受任务。
